english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Ah, good day to you [milady/sirrah]! Your face is unfamiliar, did you perhaps join us aboard the ship at Lunar Isle?
translation: 你好[milady/sirrah]！你的面孔很陌生，你该不会是在月亮岛登上我们船的吧？

english: No, Lokar offered me a lift in Rellekka actually.
translation: 不，其实是洛卡尔在雷勒卡城让我搭的便船。

english: Oh, really? You don't look like a Fremennik to me!
translation: 真的吗？但你看起来不像费明尼克人啊！

english: Well... I kind of am, and I kind of aren't. It's a long story.
translation: 这个嘛……我算是，也不算吧。说来话长。

english: Sorry I don't have time to hear it then! See you around young fremennik-who-is-not-really-a-fremennik!
translation: 那抱歉我没时间听了！回头见啦，你这个不算真正费明尼克的年轻人！

english: Bye.
translation: 再见。

english: Aren't you a little short for a pirate?
translation: 你作为海盗是不是有点太矮了？

english: My mother was a gnome. Apparently it was a very painful birth.
translation: 我的母亲是地精，据说她生我时非常痛苦。

english: More info than I wanted, thanks!
translation: 这信息我可不想听，谢谢！

english: ARGH! SOUND THE ALARM! STOWAWAY ON BOARD! STOWAWAY ON BOARD!
translation: 啊！拉警报！船上有偷渡客！船上有偷渡客！

english: No! I'm not a stowaway! Honest! I was invited here!
translation: 我不是偷渡客，真的！我是被邀请来的！

english: Oh, sorry, my mistake then.
translation: 抱歉，那我弄错了。

english: You must admit you do look a lot like a stowaway though.
translation: 不过你得承认，你看起来确实很像偷渡客。

english: Why, what do they usually look like?
translation: 那他们通常长什么样？

english: Erm... I've never actually met one...
translation: 呃……其实我从没见过真正的偷渡客……

english: Okay then...
translation: 那好吧……

english: Brrrr! Its cold up here!
translation: 嘶！上面好冷！

english: You think this is cold? Up by Acheron it gets so cold that when you talk you see the words freeze in the air in front of you!
translation: 你觉得这算冷？在阿刻戎那边，冷到你连说出的话语都能冻在空中！

english: REALLY?
translation: 真的吗？

english: Nah, not really. I was exaggerating for humourous effect. It is very very cold though!
translation: 哈，当然不是真的。我只是为了搞笑夸张了一下。不过那里确实非常非常冷！

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: So... You're a pirate, huh?
translation: 那么……你是海盗，对吧？

english: It's what it says on my pay-packet at the end of the month.
translation: 我月底工资单上就这么写的。

english: How's that working out for you?
translation: 干得怎么样？

english: Pretty good so far. All the grog and loot that we can plunder, plus full medical including dental.
translation: 到目前为止还不错。有喝不完的格罗格酒和抢不完的战利品，甚至还有全套医疗保障，包括牙科。

english: You mean you have insurance?
translation: 你是说有保险？

english: Not as such. If any of us get sick we kidnap a doctor and don't let him go until we're better.
translation: 倒也不是。要是我们谁生病了，就绑架个医生，直到我们康复才放他走。

english: You'd be surprised what an incentive for expert health care that is.
translation: 说出来你可能不信，这可是让医疗水准提升的一大动力。

english: I can imagine.
translation: 这倒不难想象。

english: Hello there. So what brings you aboard the Lady Zay?
translation: 你好啊，是什么风把你吹上赛夫人号的？

english: Well, I was planning on visiting the Moon Clan, but I have to say your ship is very impressive.
translation: 我本来打算去拜访月氏族，但不得不说你们的船令人印象深刻。

english: Aye, she's a beauty alright! The Lady Zay has been my home for many hard months, through storm and sun, and she always gets us to here we were headed!
translation: 是啊，她确实是个美人！赛夫人号作为我的家陪伴我度过了许多艰苦岁月，风雨无阻，她总是能把我们送到目的地！

english: Yes, she's certainly one of the finest boats I've seen on my travels!
translation: 是的，她确实是我旅行中见过的最棒的船之一！

english: That she is [lad/lass], that she is.
translation: 确实是啊[lad/lass]。

english: Hello to you too.
translation: 也向你问好。

english: Yar! We be pirates, yar! Avast, ye scurvy land-lubbing lychee!
translation: 呀！我们是海盗！停下，你这个可怜的旱鸭子荔枝 (羞辱性称呼)！

english: Please don't talk like that, it is extremely irritating.
translation: 请不要那样说话，这很令人討厌的。

english: Also, please don't call me a lychee, whatever that may be.
translation: 还有你别叫我荔枝 (羞辱性称呼)，不管那是什么。

english: Oh. Okay. Sorry.
translation: 好的，抱歉。

english: So how's life as a pirate?
translation: 海盗日子过得怎么样？

english: What kind of question is that? How's life as a... I dunno. Whatever it is that you do for a living.
translation: 这算什么问题？生活怎么样……我也不知道。就像你靠什么谋生一样。

english: I'm a freelance troubleshooter.
translation: 我是个自由接活的麻烦解决者。

english: What does that entail then?
translation: 那具体是做什么的？

english: Mostly killing things for money and delivering items around the planet for people.
translation: 主要是拿钱办事杀人，帮人把物品送到世界各地。

english: I collect stuff.
translation: 我喜欢收集东西。

english: So how's that life?
translation: 那生活怎么样？

english: Can't complain, can't complain...
translation: 还过得去啦……

english: Well, there you go.
translation: 给，拿好。

english: Sorry, can't stop, the Captain will have my guts for garters if he catches me slacking off talking to the stowaway.
translation: 不能再聊了，要是船长发现我在偷懒跟偷渡客聊天，会把我大卸八块的！

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard!
translation: 我不是偷渡客！我是被邀请上船的！

english: Yeah, whatever [guy/lady], it doesn't really matter who you are I'll get in trouble!
translation: 随便啦[guy/lady]，不管你是谁，反正我都会惹上麻烦！

english: You know, I've always wondered what life as a pirate actually entails.
translation: 你知道吗，我一直想知道海盗生活到底是怎样的。

english: Well, at the moment it mostly involves being asked random questions by a stowaway.
translation: 嗯，目前主要是被一个偷渡客问各种问题。

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard! By Lokar! Ask him!
translation: 我不是偷渡客！我是被邀请上船的！洛卡尔邀请的！你问他！

english: Hey, whatever [love/pal]. Just make sure the captain doesn't catch you, pirates don't like stowaways much.
translation: 随便啦[love/pal]。只要别让船长抓到你就行，海盗都不太喜欢偷渡客。

english: What are you cooking?
translation: 你在煮什么？

english: My speciality! What else could I be cooking?
translation: 我的拿手菜！不然我还能煮什么？

english: Ok, and your speciality is...?
translation: 好的，那你的拿手菜是……？

english: Boiled shark guts with a hint of rosemary and a dash of squid ink.
translation: 煮鲨鱼内脏，加一点迷迭香和少许乌贼墨。

english: I think I'll stick to making my own food.
translation: 我想我还是自己做饭吧。

english: Your loss!
translation: 你亏大了！

translation: 这趟旅行让我有点晕船。

english: Well there's a good remedy for that.
translation: 我有个好办法能治。

english: There is?

english: Yes.
translation: 有。

english: What?
translation: 什么？

english: Swim.
translation: 游泳。

english: Oh HA HA. Thanks for the help!
translation: 哦哈哈，谢谢你的''帮助''！

english: My pleasure.
translation: 不用谢。

english: I was being sarcastic.
translation: 我刚才在讽刺你。

english: I know. So was I.
translation: 我知道，我也一样。

english: I'd like to access my bank account, please.
translation: 我想查看我的银行账户。

english: I'd like to collect items.
translation: 我想领取物品。

english: I'd like to check my PIN settings.
translation: 我想查看我的PIN码设置。

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: This is a branch of the Bank of Gielinor. We have branches in many towns.
translation: 这里是基利诺尔银行的分行。我们在许多城镇都有分行。

english: And what do you do?
translation: 那你们是做什么的？

english: We will look after your items and money for you. Leave your valuables with us if you want to keep them safe.
translation: 我们会为你保管物品与金钱。若想确保贵重物品安全，可交由我们保管。

english: Hi.
translation: 嗨。

english: How's Cyrisus? Where is he?
translation: 西里苏斯怎么了？他在哪？

english: He's fine now. Back to full health.
translation: 他现在已经完全康复了。

english: Good, I'm pleased.
translation: 很好。

english: No problem.
translation: 没问题。

english: Don't think that this means I like you now!
translation: 别以为这就意味着我现在喜欢你了！

english: Look at my face.
translation: 看看我的脸。

english: Yes? What about it.
translation: 嗯？怎么了。

english: Does it look like I care?
translation: 看起来我在乎吗？

english: Not really.
translation: 不太像。

english: Well, there you go.
translation: 给，拿好。

english: Cyrisus in the mine
translation: 矿洞中的西里苏斯

english: What's going on?
translation: 发生什么事了？

english: Ah, we be building this 'ere tower. Lookin' good ain't it?
translation: 我们正在建这座塔，看起来不错吧？

english: It does look pretty impressive, but what are you doing hanging around?
translation: 确实看起来令人印象深刻，但你在闲逛什么？

english: Tea break, naturally.
translation: 当然是喝茶休息。

english: Naturally. Not sure why I asked.
translation: 好吧，真不知道我为什么要问。

english: Fancy some?
translation: 要来点吗？

english: Tea? Sure.
translation: 茶？好啊。

english: You'll find a kettle in the box to the-

english: Erm...yeah...no...sorry...gotta go.
translation: 呃……嗯……不……抱歉……我得走了。

english: Say, that's a nice helmet.
translation: 话说，你那头盔不错。

english: Why, thanks.
translation: 哦，谢谢。

english: I was just wondering if you might be able to help me out with one?
translation: 我在想你能不能帮我弄一个？

english: Always glad to help a budding builder. But first, prove your Construction knowledge by answering some questions.
translation: 我很乐意帮助有志成为建筑师的人。但首先你要回答几个问题来证明你的建筑知识。

english: How many nails does it take to make a rocking chair?
translation: 做一把摇椅需要多少颗钉子？

english: One?
translation: 一颗？

english: One? How do you suppose you'd use a single nail?
translation: 一颗？你觉得怎么用一颗钉子做？

english: Five?
translation: 五颗？

english: Nope. Keep guessing!
translation: 不对。继续猜！

english: Three?
translation: 三颗？

english: Bingo! Okay, now what takes 3 planks, 3 cloths and 3 nails to make, and helps remove light from a room?
translation: 答对了！好的，那做什么东西需要3块木板、3块布和3颗钉子，还能遮挡房间里的光线？

english: Torn curtains?
translation: 破窗帘？

english: Nice one. Last question: I like fish and I want to put some in my garden, but I need a special water feature. What materials would I require?
translation: 不错。最后一个问题：我喜欢鱼，想在花园里养一些，但我需要一个特别的水景。我需要哪些材料？

english: 8 clay pieces and 3 limestone bricks?
translation: 8块粘土和3块石灰石砖？

english: Oh, and you were so close!
translation: 哦，就差一点！

english: 10 clay pieces?
translation: 10块粘土？

english: That's it! You seem to know your stuff. I got a spare helmet from a builder that died on... I mean, err, had to leave the job for greener pastures.
translation: 对了！你好像很懂行。我有个备用的头盔，是从一个死在……我是说，呃，为了更好的发展而离职的建筑工那里得来的。

english: Greener pastures?
translation: 更好的发展？

english: Fair enough.
translation: 好吧。

english: Wait a minute! Is there blood on this helmet?
translation: 等一下！这头盔上的是血吗？

english: Erm, no, that's just, erm, paint. Yes, paint! That's what it is!
translation: 呃，不，那只是，呃，油漆。对，油漆！就是那样！

english: Oh, okay. Thanks. Bye.
translation: 好的，谢谢。再见。

english: Ha, gullible fool.
translation: 哈，容易上当的傻瓜。

english: What?
translation: 什么？

english: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: 10 limestone bricks?
translation: 10块石灰石砖？

english: Guess again.
translation: 再猜一次。

english: A brown rug?
translation: 一块棕色地毯？

english: Of course, because that's what everyone needs - a rug up at their window.
translation: 当然，因为每个人都需要在窗上挂块地毯。

english: Opulent curtains?
translation: 豪华窗帘？

english: Those curtains are not going to be in any way opulent, matey.
translation: 那些窗帘可一点都不豪华，伙计。

english: Thank you - just as nice as the one in your bank!
translation: 谢谢——和你银行里的那个一样好！

english: Yes - just as nice as the one you're carrying I'd say.
translation: 是的——我想和你带的那个一样好。

translation: 我的母亲是地精，据说她生我时非常痛苦。

english: More info than I wanted, thanks!
translation: 这信息我可不想听，谢了！

english: Sorry, can't stop, the Captain will have my guts for garters if he catches me slacking off talking to the stowaway.
translation: 不能再聊了，要是船长发现我在偷懒跟偷渡客聊天，会把我大卸八块的！

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard!
translation: 我不是偷渡客！我是被邀请上船的！

english: Yeah, whatever [guy/lady], it doesn't really matter who you are I'll get in trouble!
translation: 随便啦[guy/lady]，不管你是谁，反正我都会惹上麻烦！

english: You know, I've always wondered what life as a pirate actually entails.
translation: 你知道吗，我一直想知道海盗生活到底是怎样的。

english: Well, at the moment it mostly involves being asked random questions by a stowaway.
translation: 嗯，目前主要是被一个偷渡客问各种问题。

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard! By Lokar! Ask him!
translation: 我不是偷渡客！我是被邀请上船的！洛卡尔邀请的！你问他！

english: Hey, whatever [love/pal]. Just make sure the captain doesn't catch you, pirates don't like stowaways much.
translation: 随便啦[love/pal]。只要别让船长抓到你就行，海盗都不太喜欢偷渡客。

english: Ah, good day to you [milady/sirrah]! Your face is unfamiliar, did you perhaps join us aboard the ship at Lunar Isle?
translation: 你好[milady/sirrah]！你的面孔很陌生，你该不会是在月亮岛登上我们船的吧？

english: No, Lokar offered me a lift in Rellekka actually.
translation: 不，其实是洛卡尔在雷勒卡城让我搭的便船。

english: Oh, really? You don't look like a Fremennik to me!
translation: 真的吗？但你看起来不像费明尼克人啊！

english: Well... I kind of am, and I kind of aren't. It's a long story.
translation: 这个嘛……我算是，也不算吧。说来话长。

english: Sorry I don't have time to hear it then! See you around young fremennik-who-is-not-really-a-fremennik!
translation: 那抱歉我没时间听了！回头见啦，你这个不算真正费明尼克的年轻人！

english: 'Bye.
translation: 再见。

english: Brrrr! Its cold up here!
translation: 嘶！上面好冷！

english: You think this is cold? Up by Acheron it gets so cold that when you talk you see the words freeze in the air in front of you!
translation: 你觉得这算冷？在阿刻戎那边，冷到你连说出的话语都能冻在空中！

english: REALLY?
translation: 真的吗？

english: Nah, not really. I was exaggerating for humourous effect. It is very very cold though!
translation: 哈，当然不是真的。我只是为了搞笑夸张了一下。不过那里确实非常非常冷！

english: Hello to you too.
translation: 也向你问好。

english: Yar! We be pirates, yar! Avast, ye scurvy land-lubbing lychee!
translation: 呀！我们是海盗！停下，你这个可怜的旱鸭子荔枝 (羞辱性称呼)！

english: Please don't talk like that, it is extremely irritating.
translation: 请不要那样说话，这很令人討厌的。

english: Also, please don't call me a lychee, whatever that may be.
translation: 还有你别叫我荔枝 (羞辱性称呼)，不管那是什么。

english: Oh. Okay. Sorry.
translation: 好的，抱歉。

english: ARGH! SOUND THE ALARM! STOWAWAY ON BOARD! STOWAWAY ON BOARD!
translation: 啊！拉警报！船上有偷渡客！船上有偷渡客！

english: No! I'm not a stowaway! Honest! I was invited here!
translation: 我不是偷渡客，真的！我是被邀请来的！

english: Oh, sorry, my mistake then.
translation: 抱歉，那我弄错了。

english: You must admit you do look a lot like a stowaway though.
translation: 不过你得承认，你看起来确实很像偷渡客。

english: Why, what do they usually look like?
translation: 那他们通常长什么样？

english: Erm... I've never actually met one...
translation: 呃……其实我从没见过真正的偷渡客……

english: Okay then...
translation: 那好吧……

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: So... You're a pirate, huh?
translation: 那么……你是海盗，对吧？

english: It's what it says on my pay-packet at the end of the month.
translation: 我月底工资单上就这么写的。

english: How's that working out for you?
translation: 干得怎么样？

english: Pretty good so far. All the grog and loot that we can plunder, plus full medical including dental.
translation: 到目前为止还不错。有喝不完的格罗格酒和抢不完的战利品，甚至还有全套医疗保障，包括牙科。

english: You mean you have insurance?
translation: 你是说有保险？

english: Not as such. If any of us get sick we kidnap a doctor and don't let him go until we're better.
translation: 倒也不是。要是我们谁生病了，就绑架个医生，直到我们康复才放他走。

english: You'd be surprised what an incentive for expert health care that is.
translation: 说出来你可能不信，这可是让医疗水准提升的一大动力。

english: I can imagine.
translation: 这倒不难想象。

english: Hello there. So what brings you aboard the Lady Zay?
translation: 你好啊，是什么风把你吹上赛夫人号的？

english: Well, I was planning on visiting the Moon Clan, but I have to say your ship is very impressive.
translation: 我本来打算去拜访月氏族，但不得不说你们的船令人印象深刻。

english: Aye, she's a beauty alright! The Lady Zay has been my home for many hard months, through storm and sun, and she always gets us to here we were headed!
translation: 是啊，她确实是个美人！赛夫人号作为我的家陪伴我度过了许多艰苦岁月，风雨无阻，她总是能把我们送到目的地！

english: Yes, she's certainly one of the finest boats I've seen on my travels!
translation: 是的，她确实是我旅行中见过的最棒的船之一！

english: That she is [lad/lass], that she is.
translation: 确实是啊[lad/lass]。

english: Wow, that looks pretty heavy.
translation: 哇，那看起来相当重。

english: Umpf! Yeah, mate...argghh...this is...umpf...hard work...
translation: 唔！是啊，伙计……呃……这……唔……真是苦力活……

english: What would happen if I were to say...
translation: 要是我说……会怎样？

english: Stop! Stop! Humpf...I'll beat you to...urghh...a pulp!
translation: 停！停！哼……我要把你揍成……呃……肉酱！

english: Okay, okay! Don't cry!
translation: 好了好了！别哭了！

english: Why, I oughta...
translation: 哼，我真该……

english: What do you do when you're not lifting logs above your head?
translation: 你不举木头的时候都做什么？

english: In my free time?
translation: 在我有空时？

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: All sorts. I like...hummff...a good kebab and a cold beer down...urrghh...the pub. And for those quiet evenings...hurrr...
translation: 有各种各样的事。例如我喜欢……嗯……来份好吃的烤肉串和一杯冰啤酒，在……呃……酒馆里。至于那些安静的夜晚……呼……

english: A bit of needlepoint is always welcome.
translation: 做点针线活总是不错的。

english: I can honestly say you're a very original guy.
translation: 老实说，你真是个与众不同的人。

english: [xxxx]
translation: [xxxx]

english: Huh?
translation: 哈？

english: Bah
translation: 呸

english: Start again!
translation: 重新开始！

english: Hi there. What is this place?
translation: 嗨。这里是什么地方？

english: Ah, this be the Tower of Life! Beautiful, isn't it?
translation: 啊，这里是生命之塔！很美吧？

english: I prefer ordinary houses.
translation: 我更喜欢普通的房子。

english: Pah, you have no taste.
translation: 呸，你真没品味。

english: Hello?
translation: 你好？

english: Hello?
translation: 你好？

english: Hey, I started the conversation!
translation: 嘿，是我先开始对话的！

english: No you didn't. Get out of my spell!
translation: 才不是。从我的法术里滚出去！

english: No! Get out of my spell!
translation: 不！从我的法术里滚出去！

english: Cry-baby.
translation: 爱哭鬼。

english: What! I'm no cry-baby, you cry-baby!
translation: 什么！我才不是爱哭鬼，你才是爱哭鬼！

english: I'm reporting you!
translation: 我要举报你！

english: Oh, how scary!
translation: 哦，好可怕啊！

english: Idiot.
translation: 白痴。

english: Welcome to the Emir's Arena! Are you interested in 1v1 Tournaments? We organise ranked Tournaments here, or alternatively you can organise your own unranked Tournaments.
translation: 欢迎来到埃米尔竞技场！你对一对一锦标赛感兴趣吗？我们在这里组织排位赛，或者你也可以自行组织非排名锦标赛。

english: What's a 1v1 Tournament?
translation: 什么是一对一锦标赛？

english: A group of fighters is divided into pairs of opponents, and they all fight their opponent. The winners of those fights proceed to the next round, where they're divided into pairs, and they each fight their new opponent.
translation: 一群战士两两配对，各自与对手战斗。这些战斗的胜者进入下一轮，在那里他们再次被分成对，每个人与新的对手战斗。

english: The number of surviving fighters is halved each time, until eventually only one person is left standing. They're the winner of the Tournament.
translation: 每次比赛剩余的战士人数减半，直到最终只剩下一人，他就是锦标赛的获胜者。

english: Ranked or unranked? What does that mean?
translation: 排位赛或非排位赛？那是什么意思？

english: Everyone has a rank. It's meant to indicate how good they are at fighting, compared to other people.
translation: 每个人都有排名。这是用来表示他们与其他人相比战斗水平如何。

english: In ranked fights, the winners gain rank and the losers lose rank. The Arena staff will decide who'll be fighting in each ranked Tournament, and send the invitations.
translation: 在排位赛中，胜者提升段位，败者下降段位。竞技场工作人员将决定每场排位赛的参赛选手，并发出邀请。

english: But if you just want some casual fun, you can have an unranked Tournament, where no-one gains or loses rank. You can organise your own unranked Tournament, and decide for yourself who'll fight in it.
translation: 但如果你只是想轻松娱乐一下，可以举办非排名锦标赛，这种锦标赛不会影响排名升降。你可以自行组织非排名锦标赛，并自行决定参赛选手。

english: Only the ranked fights offer access to the other rewards of the Arena.
translation: 只有排位赛才能获得竞技场的其他奖励。

english: How do I get invited into a Tournament?
translation: 我怎样才能受邀参加锦标赛？

english: You'll need to sign up to a recruitment group...
translation: 你需要报名参加一个招募队伍……

english: You can carry on with your adventures while you're waiting for a Tournament to begin, since it may be a while before suitable fighters are available.
translation: 在等待锦标赛开始期间，你可以继续你的冒险，因为可能需要一段时间才能找到合适的对手。

english: I want to organise my own Tournament.
translation: 我想自行组织锦标赛。

english: Just use my Recruitment Board here to form your own recruitment group. Once you've got one, wait for other fighters to join it.
translation: 只需使用我的招募板创建你自己的招募队伍。队伍创建完成后，等待其他战士加入即可。

english: Okay, goodbye.
translation: 好的，再见。

english: I'm okay, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: What's a 1v1 Tournament?
translation: 什么是一对一锦标赛？

english: Ranked or unranked? What does that mean?
translation: 排位赛或非排位赛？那是什么意思？

english: How do I get invited into a Tournament?
translation: 我怎样才能受邀参加锦标赛？

english: I want to organise my own Tournament.
translation: 我想自行组织锦标赛。

english: Okay, goodbye.
translation: 好的，再见。

english: I'm okay, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Are you all right?
translation: 你还好吗？

english: Who goes there?
translation: 谁在那里？

english: Arr! A landlubber!
translation: 啊！一个旱鸭子！

english: Begone afore I take my cutlass to ye! I've been charged with guardin' this gate and no noodle-armed landlubbers will make it past me alive!
translation: 滚开，不然我就用弯刀伺候你！我奉命守卫这道门，像你这种软手软脚的旱鸭子，休想从我面前活着走过去！

english: That's not a cutlass.
translation: 那不是弯刀。

english: I think it's a twig.
translation: 我觉得那是根小树枝。

english: Ye cheeky begger! I was wavin' my finger at ye!
translation: 你这厚脸皮的乞丐！我是在对你摇手指！

english: All right...
translation: 好吧……

english: Arrr... just 'cos me body happens to be 50% wood does not mean I'm heartless.
translation: 啊……仅仅因为我的身体有50% 是木头，并不意味着我没有心。

english: I got a bag of 'em here. Wanna see?
translation: 我这里有一袋心。想看看吗？

english: I think I'll pass.
translation: 我想我还是不要了。

english: What happened to you?
translation: 你怎么了？

english: That be a tale so heart-wrenchin' that it has so far wrenched the hearts from over a dozen sturdier men than thee!
translation: 那是个令人心碎的故事，至今为止已有十几个比你坚强的人心碎不已！

english: A tale of such woe that none but the stoniest hearts can hear it without sheddin' a single, poignant tear...
translation: 一个如此悲惨的故事，只有最铁石心肠的人听了才不会流下一滴眼泪……

english: And I'll never tell ye, not even if ye wore an item, such as a ring, with powers of mind control!
translation: 我永远不会告诉你，就算你戴着能控制心智的物品，比如戒指，也不行！

english: What if I said please?
translation: 如果我说请呢？

english: Hmmmm...well alright...
translation: 嗯……好吧……

english: Wait, no!
translation: 等等，不！

english: Get goin' landlubber before I take my splintery foot to yer behind!
translation: 快滚吧旱鸭子，不然我就用我这长满木刺的脚踢你屁股！

english: Well ye seem like a [lad/lass] that can handle such a tale...so I'll tell ye...
translation: 好吧，你看起来像是个能听这种故事的[lad/lass]……那我就告诉你……

english: Well, it all starts with this albatross...
translation: 嗯，这一切都从一只信天翁开始……

english: Wait, never mind, I'll skip forward a bit.
translation: 等等，算了，我跳过一点。

english: Are you sure?
translation: 你确定吗？

english: I have to [lad/lass], Cap'n Donnie will flay what little is left of me if I told ye.
translation: 不行啊[lad/lass]，要是我告诉你，唐尼船长会把我剩下这点皮都剥了。

english: But anyway, I got recruited to the zombie pirates along with the rest of the crew in an unspecified incident involvin this albatross.
translation: 但不管怎样，在一次跟这只信天翁有关的不明事件中，我和其他船员一起成了僵尸海盗。

english: We was sailin' along happily, and I was partakin' of a little 'rum' in the crows nest.
translation: 我们当时正愉快地航行，我在瞭望台上喝了一点''朗姆酒''。

english: Well, we hit either a really rough wave or some rocks.
translation: 嗯，我们要么撞上了巨浪，要么撞上了礁石。

english: Twas kind of hard for me to tell which, as I was well out of it by then!
translation: 我有点分不清是哪个，因为那时我已经醉得不行了！

english: Regardless I toppled from the crows nest into the water.
translation: 不管怎样，我从瞭望台掉进了水里。

english: Is that how you got so badly injured?
translation: 你就是那样受重伤的？

english: No [lad/lass]!
translation: 不，[lad/lass]！

english: What happened next was that I discovered a new, previously uncharted reef of hard, spiky coral.
translation: 接下来我发现了一片新的、以前从未标注过的坚硬多刺的珊瑚礁。

english: I made a mental note of its location, and to this day it is still marked on our fleet's charts as Lukes Reef.
translation: 我记下了它的位置，直到今天它仍然在我们舰队的海图上标记为卢克礁。

english: I managed to grab a hold of our ship, the Inebriated, as it passed overhead.
translation: 当我们的船''醉汉号''从头顶经过时，我设法抓住了它。

english: And then I discovered another, taller, spikier reef of even sharper and more painful coral.
translation: 然后我又发现了另一片更高、更尖、更锋利、扎人更疼的珊瑚礁。

english: To this day it is still marked on our fleet's charts as The Other 50% Reef.
translation: 直到今天它仍然在我们舰队的海图上标记为另一半礁。

english: Owwwwwwwww...
translation: 嗷呜……

english: It gets worse...
translation: 更糟的还在后面……

english: When they hauled what was left of me on deck, they dropped me onto the floor while they decided what to do with me.
translation: 当他们把我剩下的部分拖到甲板上时，他们把我扔在地上，同时决定怎么处置我。

english: Bear in mind this would be on a ghost ship, the planks of which sweat a thick mixture of stagnant water...and pure salt crystals.
translation: 要知道这可是在一艘幽灵船上，船板渗出的是死水和纯盐晶体的浓稠混合物……

english: Oh...my...god...
But on the good side, all my thrashin' and pained squealin' settled the matter in the Captain's mind, and he had the shipwright carve me half a body out of his Witchwood Planks.
translation: 但好的一面是，我那些拼命挣扎和痛苦的尖叫声，让船长终于下定了决心，他让船匠用巫木木板给我做了半个身体。

english: Witchwood? What's that?
translation: 巫木？那是什么？

english: Tis a special, magical wood from a now extinct tree.
translation: 那是一种特殊的魔法木材，来自一种现已灭绝的树木。

english: Once they nailed it all in place the stuff moves like it is part of me body.
translation: 一旦他们把它固定到位之后，这东西动起来就像是我身体的一部分。

english: The stuff will also grow back if it breaks, which is dead handy!
translation: 这东西如果断了还会重新长出来，特别方便！

english: Wow, that stuff must be very valuable!
translation: 哇，那东西一定很值钱！

english: Arr! That it be!
translation: 啊！确实是！

english: So, that be the tale of how I managed to lose precisely 50% of my body.
translation: 所以，这就是我如何失去整整50% 身体的故事。

english: There there.
translation: 好啦好啦。

english: So how flammable are you?
translation: 那你有多易燃？

english: What kind of a question is that?
translation: 这是什么问题？

english: A rather rude, personal one?
translation: 一个相当粗鲁、人身攻击的问题？

english: Ye've got that right!
translation: 你说对了！

english: I'll soon have you out of the way! Burn!
translation: 我很快就会让你消失！烧死你！

english: Don't make me angry! Ye'll not like me when I'm angry!
translation: 别惹我生气！你不会喜欢我生气时的样子！

english: Let that be a lesson to ye!
translation: 让你长点记性！

english: My world is an ocean of paaaain!
translation: 我的世界是一片痛——苦——的——海——洋！

english: So what is going on here anyway?
translation: 那么这里到底发生了什么事？

english: Ye expect me to talk?
translation: 你指望我说话？

english: No Mr. Luke, I expect you to die!
translation: 不，卢克先生，我指望你去死！

english: Hah! I'm one step ahead of ye!
translation: 哈！我比你快一步！

english: Egad, outsmarted by the man with the wooden brain.
translation: 天哪，被这个木头脑袋的人耍了。

english: But seriously, what is going on here?
translation: 但说真的，这里到底发生了什么事？

english: I can't tell ye [lad/lass].
translation: 我不能告诉你[lad/lass]。

english: The Cap'n would have me whittled down to toothpicks if I did.
translation: 如果我说了，船长会把我削成牙签。

english: Well if you can't tell me, perhaps you could show me through the medium of Interpretive Dance?
translation: 好吧，如果你不能告诉我，也许你可以通过表现性舞蹈来展示给我看？

english: No. Just...no.
translation: 不。就是……不。

english: Mime?
translation: 哑剧？

english: Look, [lad/lass] I'm not tellin' ye a thing! So clear out while ye still can!
translation: 听着，[lad/lass]我什么都不会告诉你！所以趁你还能走赶紧离开！

english: Arr! Tryin' ter get away eh? Well ye'll never sneak past me, I'm the best lookout this crew has ever seen!
translation: 啊！想逃跑吗？你休想从我眼前溜过去，我是这艘船上有史以来最好的瞭望员！

english: Who's that making faces behind you?
translation: 你后面那个做鬼脸的是谁？

english: That is the most amazing thing I have ever seen!
translation: 那是我这辈子见过的最神奇的东西！

english: Is that your distraction?
translation: 那是你在分心吗？

english: Who is that behind you?
translation: 你身后是谁？

english: Hey you! Look over there!
translation: 嘿！看那边！

english: Oh my! Is that a genuine 3rd Age Diversion?
translation: 哦天！那是真正的第三纪元分心术吗？

english: Where?
translation: 哪里？

english: Hey! What are you doing out there?
translation: 嘿！你在外面干什么？

english: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: Well Cap'n Donnie said no livin' landlubbers were allowed out of the compound.
translation: 唐尼船长说过不允许任何活着的旱鸭子离开营地。

english: So get yerself back in here, or yer for it!
translation: 所以赶紧滚回来，不然你有麻烦了！

english: What happened to you?
translation: 你怎么了？

english: How flammable are you?
translation: 你有多易燃？

english: So what is going on here anyway?
translation: 那么这里到底发生了什么事？

english: Urrrrr...
Hi!
translation: 嗨！

english: Hi. How can I help?
translation: 嗨，我能帮什么忙？

english: Can you heal me?
translation: 你能治疗我吗？

english: Sorry, I'm not on duty.
translation: 抱歉，我今天不上班。

english: PLEASE DON'T KILL ME!
translation: 求求你别杀我！

english: I was... looking to be healed.
translation: 我……是想来治伤的。

english: No way, I'm out of here just as soon as I've packed up my stuff!
translation: 没门，我收拾好东西就走！

english: You look healthy to me!
translation: 你看起来挺健康的！

english: Of course!
translation: 当然！

english: Do you see a lot of injured fighters?
translation: 你见过很多受伤的战士吗？

english: Yes I do. Thankfully we can cope with almost anything. Jaraah really is a wonderful surgeon, his methods are a little unorthodox but he gets the job done.
translation: 是的，幸好我们几乎应付得了任何状况。贾拉赫真是个了不起的外科医生，他的手法虽然有点不按牌理出牌，但确实很有两下子。

english: I shouldn't tell you this but his nickname is 'The Butcher'.
translation: 我不该告诉你这个，但他的绰号是''屠夫''。

english: That's reassuring.
translation: 这可真是让人安心啊。

english: Do you come here often?
translation: 你经常来这里吗？

english: I work here, so yes!
translation: 当然，我就在这里工作！

english: You're silly!
translation: 你真傻！

english: Can you heal me?
translation: 你能治疗我吗？

english: Do you see a lot of injured fighters?
translation: 你见过很多受伤的战士吗？

english: Do you come here often?
translation: 你经常来这里吗？

english: Greetings traveller.
translation: 你好，旅行者。

english: Can you heal me? I'm injured.
translation: 你能治疗我吗？我受伤了。

english: Ok.
translation: 好的。

english: Abbot Langley places his hands on your head. You feel a little better.
translation: 兰利院长将手放在你的头上，你感觉好了一些。

english: Isn't this place built a bit out of the way?
translation: 这地方建得是不是有点偏僻？

english: We like it that way actually! We get disturbed less. We still get rather a large amount of travellers looking for sanctuary and healing here as it is!
translation: 其实我们就喜欢这样！这样被打扰的机会比较少。即便如此，还是有相当多的旅行者来这里寻求庇护和治疗！

english: How do I get further into the monastery?
translation: 我该如何进入修道院内部？

english: I'm sorry but only members of our order are allowed in the second level of the monastery.
translation: 抱歉，只有我们教团的成员才能进入修道院的第二层。

english: Well can I join your order?
translation: 那我能加入你们的教团吗？

english: No. I am sorry, but I feel you are not devout enough.
translation: 不，抱歉。我觉得你还不够虔诚。

english: You need a prayer level of 31 to join the order.
translation: 你需要31级祈祷等级才能加入教团。

english: Ok, I see you are someone suitable for our order. You may join.
translation: 好的，我看你适合加入我们的教团。你可以加入。

english: Oh, sorry.
translation: 哦，抱歉。

english: I might be able to... What did you have in mind?
translation: 我也许能……你有什么想法？

english: Can you remove the sigils from my spirit shields?
translation: 你能从我的精神护盾上移除符印吗？

english: I think I shoud be able to manage that. However in doing so, I'm afraid I'll have to destroy the blessed shield itself. You'll only get the sigil back.
translation: 我想我应该能做到。但这样做的话，恐怕我得摧毁盾牌本身。你只能拿回符印。

english: I can go ahead and break down all of the shields in your inventory now if you'd like?.
translation: 如果你愿意，我现在就可以把你物品栏里所有盾牌都拆解掉。

english: Not right now.
translation: 暂时不用。

english: Only members of our order can go up there.
translation: 只有我们教团的成员才能上去。

english: Oh, sorry.
translation: 哦，抱歉。

english: Ah, I was told to expect you, please take this as thanks!
translation: 啊，有人跟我说你会来，请收下这个作为感谢！

english: Congratulations, traveller!
translation: 恭喜你，旅行者！

english: Hey, I have something for you but you don't have any space for it!
translation: 嘿，我有东西给你，但你背包没空间了！

english: Here you go.
translation: 给，拿好。

english: You are handed a torn part of a clue scroll.
translation: 你获得了一张线索卷轴碎片。

english: I must say, I despise the equipment you have chosen to wear.
translation: 我不得不说，我不喜欢你穿的装备。

english: I've got a message for you from your friend in Draynor Village.
translation: 你德雷诺村的朋友有一条消息要给你。

english: Gosh, you are very kind to bring a message to my remote monastery!
translation: 天哪，你真好心，把消息带到我这偏远的修道院！

english: I'd give you a reward, but you don't seem to have any space for it. Come back when you do.
translation: 我很想给你奖励，但你好像没地方放。等你有地方放了再来吧。

english: I grow a few herbs in my little cabbage patch; please take some as a sign of my gratitude.
translation: 我在我的小菜园里种了一些草药，请收下一些以表我的感激。

english: Allow me to bestow on you Saradomin's blessings...
translation: 请允许我赐予你萨拉多明的祝福……

english: Can you heal me? I'm injured.
translation: 你能治疗我吗？我受伤了。

english: Isn't this place built a bit out of the way?
translation: 这地方建得是不是有点偏僻？

english: How do I get further into the monastery?
translation: 我该如何进入修道院内部？

english: Well can I join your order?
translation: 那我能加入你们的教团吗？

english: Can you help with spirit shields?
translation: 你能帮忙处理精神护盾吗？

english: Yes.
translation: 是的

english: No.
translation: 不

english: Herbs
translation: 草药

english: Coins
translation: 金币

english: Runes
translation: 符石

english: Seeds
translation: 种子

english: Prayer experience
translation: 祈祷经验值

english: Grr ... Get out of my way...
translation: 咕……让开……

english: Hello there...
translation: 你好……

english: Ahhh, hello there my friend. You look like you could do with some assistance.
translation: 你好啊，你看起来需要一些帮助。

english: We do?
translation: 我们真的可以吗？

english: Yes, of course... Here, prepare yourselves!
translation: 是的，当然……来，做好准备！

english: Abidor blesses the player, boosting their defence and turning any rotten food into stews.
translation: 阿比多尔祝福玩家，提升他们的防御力，并将任何腐烂的食物变成炖菜。

english: There you go... Right, I must be off now. Good luck with your travels.
translation: 好了，我现在得走了，祝你旅途愉快。

english: Ohhh, hello again... sorry my friend, but I have to get going.
translation: 哦，又见面了……但我得走了。

english: A good samaritan teleports you out of Morytania.
translation: 一位好心人将你传送出莫利塔尼亚。

english: Well, this is no good at all! You'll never survive in Morytania, you'll have to go back.
translation: 唉，这可不行！你在莫利塔尼亚永远活不下去，你得回去。

english: The player is teleported to Paterdomus.
translation: 玩家被传送到帕多姆斯。

english: What can I help you with, dear?
translation: 你好，有什么事吗？

english: Who are you and what are you doing?
translation: 你是谁？你在做什么？

english: I'm Abigaila, from Morytania. It's a terrible place, run by the vampyres. They visit the towns and collect everyone's blood for food!
translation: 我是阿比盖拉，来自莫利塔尼亚。那是个可怕的地方，由吸血鬼统治。他们会到各个城镇搜集所有人的血作为食物！

english: I tried for years to escape, with my son, Suro, to make a better life for ourselves in Misthalin. I scraped together enough money to bribe a boatman to get us out.
translation: 我多年来一直试图和我的儿子苏罗一起逃离，在米斯特林王国过上更好的生活。我东拼西凑才攒够了钱贿赂船夫带我们离开。

english: The journey was tough. Some men in pink hoods attacked our boat, shouting at us to go back where we belonged, and to keep out of their country. In the struggle, the boat overturned.
translation: 这趟旅程非常艰辛，一群戴着粉色兜帽的人袭击了我们的船，对我们大喊让我们滚回原来的地方，别踏入他们的国土。在挣扎中，船翻了。

english: It was dark, and I couldn't find Suro in the water. I swam as deep as I could, until my lungs screamed, but I couldn't find him. He wasn't good at swimming.
translation: 天很黑，我在水中找不到苏罗。我拼命往深处游，直到肺都要炸了，还是找不到他。他不太会游泳……

english: Eventually I got myself to the shore. The sun was rising, and I found Suro there. On the shore, where the water had dumped his... body.
translation: 我最终还是游到了岸边。太阳正在升起，我在那里找到了苏罗。海水把他的……尸体冲到了那里。

english: *sob*
translation: (抽泣)

english: I've done alright in Misthalin, I guess. I know a bit of magic, and the local gentry pay me well for my scrying skills. I'm good at turning a profit on Grand Exchange trades too.
translation: 我想我在米斯特林王国过得还不错。我懂一点魔法，当地的绅士们也付我不少钱请我占卜。我在交易所做买卖也很赚钱。

english: Anyway, I'm able to rent a room in Lumbridge, and to buy food. I'm not being a burden on anyone, and there are no vampyres coming for my blood.
translation: 总之，我能在仑桥镇租到房间，也能买得起食物。我没有成为任何人的负担，也没有吸血鬼来吸我的血。

english: I am free!
translation: 我自由了！

english: But I haven't forgotten my people in the east. There's one vampyre there who runs a place she calls the Theatre of Blood, challenging humans to face monsters in her arena.
translation: 但我没有忘记我在东方的同胞。那里有一个吸血鬼经营着一个她称为血腥剧场的地方，让人在她的竞技场里与怪物搏斗。

english: My husband went there, trying to win freedom from the blood-gatherers by surviving her arena, but he never returned. No-one does.
translation: 我丈夫去了那里，想通过在她的竞技场里活下来，从嗜血者手中赢得自由，但他再也没回来。从没有人能回来。

english: So now I pass my spare time scrying on the Theatre of Blood, watching other adventurers there. You can have a look, if you like.
translation: 所以现在我把空闲时间花在占卜血腥剧场上，观看那里的其他冒险者。如果你愿意，可以看看。

english: I'd like to look in your scrying ball.
translation: 我想看看你的占卜球。

english: I'm afraid I can't let you use my scrying ball now, dear. Clear out everything you're carrying, and make sure you're not sick or poisoned.
translation: 恐怕我现在不能让你使用我的占卜球。把你身上所有的东西都收拾干净，确保你没有生病或中毒。

translation: 我就不打扰你了。

translation: 我就不打扰你了。

english: [House owner] killed an abyssal demon! Cool!
translation: [House owner]击杀了一只深渊恶魔！真酷！

english: Cool for [him/her] maybe. How would you like to be stuck on a wall?
translation: 对[him/her]来说也许酷。但你想被钉在墙上吗？

english: Have you considered visitingTHE ABYSS?
translation: 你有没有考虑过前往深渊？

english: I visit the abyss all the time!
translation: 我一直都有去深渊！

english: I bet you just rush through it though. Everyone there is in such a rush. No one stops to appreciate the beauty ofTHE ABYSS.
translation: 我肯定你只是匆匆而过。那里的每个人都行色匆匆。没有人停下来欣赏深渊之美。

english: I have to run through it quickly or I'll die!
translation: 我必须快速穿过不然我会死！

english: Death is a small thing compared to the beauty ofTHE ABYSS.
translation: 与深渊之美相比，死亡是小事一桩。

english: The abyss looks pretty ugly to me.
translation: 深渊在我看来相当丑陋。

english: Poor deluded fool. There is no hope for you at all.
translation: 可怜的糊涂虫。你完全没有希望了。

english: It's too scary for me!
translation: 它对我来说太可怕了！

english: But does not the fear contribute to your appreciation ofTHE ABYSS?
translation: 但恐惧难道不会增加你对深渊的欣赏吗？

english: No, it's just scary.
translation: 不，就是可怕而已。

english: Poor human. You must not judgeTHE ABYSSby the standards of this world. You must learn to embrace your fear as part of the experience ofTHE ABYSS.
translation: 可怜的人类。你不应该用这个世界的标准来评判深渊。你必须学会拥抱你的恐惧，将其作为深渊体验的一部分。

english: I suppose fear does heighten the senses.
translation: 我想恐惧确实能增强感官。

english: Then you should enhance them further by raising the stakes. Next time you go toTHE ABYSSyou should take all your most valuable items with you.
translation: 那你应该通过提高赌注来进一步增强它们。下次你去深渊时，应该带上你所有最珍贵的物品。

english: Could I get an abyssal whip?
translation: 我能得到一条深渊鞭吗？

english: You must take all your gold and all your most valued items, and take them intoTHE ABYSSwithout weapons or armour.
translation: 你必须带上你所有的金币和所有最珍贵的物品，不带武器或盔甲进入深渊。

english: And then will I get an abyssal whip?
translation: 然后我就能得到深渊鞭了吗？

english: You'll get anABYSSAL WHIPPING!
translation: 你会得到一顿深渊鞭打！

english: That pun was abyssmal.
translation: 那个双关语太糟糕了。

translation: 我一直都有去深渊。

translation: 深渊在我看来相当丑陋。

translation: 它对我来说太可怕了！

translation: 不，就是可怕而已。

translation: 水蛭对那个不感兴趣。

english: Yes, give it.
translation: 是的，给它。

english: No, keep it.
translation: 不，留着吧。

english: You killed my father.
translation: 你杀了我父亲。

english: Yeah, don't take it personally.
translation: 是啊，别太往心里去。

english: In his dying moment, my father poured his last ounce of strength into my creation. My being is formed from his remains.
translation: 在他临终之际，我父亲将最后一丝力量倾注于我的创造。我的存在由他的遗骸构成。

english: When your own body is consumed to nourish the Nexus, and an army of scions arises from your corpse, I trust you will not take it personally either.
translation: 当你的身体被吞噬以滋养枢纽，当一群子嗣从你的尸体中诞生时，我相信你也不会太往心里去。

english: No, I am your father.
translation: 不，我是你父亲。

english: No, you are not.
translation: 不，你不是。

translation: 是啊，别太往心里去。

english: Do you know what happens when you stare into the Abyss?
translation: 你知道凝视深渊时会发生什么吗？

english: What?
translation: 什么？

english: It stares back!
translation: 深渊也在凝视你！

english: Right...
translation: 好吧……

english: We don't spend enough time in the Abyss!
translation: 我们在深渊里待的时间不够！

english: Well how much time do you think we should be spending there?
translation: 那你觉得我们应该在那里待多久？

english: All the time! Eternal time in the eternal Abyss!
translation: 每时每刻！在永恒的深渊里度过永恒的时光！

english: Yeah... I don't think that's going to work.
translation: 嗯……我觉得那不太可行。

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Nilsal! Welcome to the Grand Museum.
translation: 你好！欢迎来到大博物馆。

english: Hello there! Hope you're enjoying the museum.
translation: 你好！希望你在博物馆玩得开心。

english: Sorry, I'd love to stop and talk, but I have some studying to do.
translation: 抱歉，我很想停下来聊聊，但我还有些研究要做。

english: Have you seen the new Old One display? Fascinating stuff!
translation: 你看过新的古老者展柜了吗？太迷人了！

english: Isn't this place wonderful? There's just so much knowledge to be found!
translation: 这地方是不是很美妙？这里有太多知识可以发掘！

english: Hello there. How's it going?
translation: 你好，最近怎么样？

english: Sorry, but I'm busy right now.
translation: 抱歉，我现在很忙。

english: Hello there. Thanks again for helping with Bumpty Numpty.
translation: 你好，再次感谢你帮忙处理邦普蒂‧纳普蒂的事。

english: Always happy to help, iknami.
translation: 随时乐意帮忙，朋友。

english: Hello. Who are you?
translation: 你好，你是谁？

english: I'm the Account Guide. I'm here to tell you about your account.
translation: 我是帐号导师。我来这里告诉你关于帐号的事。

english: What's an account?
translation: 什么是帐号？

english: Your character IS your account! It's what you are using to play the game right now. Everyone here has one and some people even have multiple!
translation: 你的角色就是你的帐号！就是你此刻用来玩游戏的东西。这里每个人都有帐号，有些人甚至有多个！

english: There’s various things you can do with your account which is where the Account Management menu comes into play. Let’s take a look at it now.
translation: 你的帐号可以做各种事情，这就是帐号管理菜单发挥作用的地方。我们现在来看看吧。

english: As you can see, there's a few things you can do with your account.
translation: 如你所见，你的帐号可以做几件事。

english: First, you have membership. All accounts are free to play by default but if you desire, you can buy membership to unlock members' worlds. These worlds give you access to extra skills, areas, quests, and more!
translation: 首先是会员资格。所有账号默认均可免费游玩，但如果你愿意，可以购买会员资格来解锁会员世界。这些世界让你可以体验额外的技能、区域、任务等等！

english: What's a world?
translation: 什么是世界？

english: A world is what you play the game on. Most worlds can hold up to 2000 players. They are split into two main types: free worlds and members' worlds. You can swap worlds with the World Switcher in the Logout menu.
translation: 世界就是你玩游戏的地方。大多数世界最多可容纳2,000名玩家。它们主要分为两种类型：免费世界和会员世界。你可以在登出菜单中用世界切换器更换世界。

english: You are currently on a free world. If you want to switch to a members’ world and enjoy all of the benefits, you’ll need to purchase membership. You can do so using the store in the Account Management menu.
translation: 你目前在免费世界上。如果你想切换到会员世界并享受所有福利，你需要购买会员资格。你可以在帐号管理菜单的商店中购买。

english: You are currently on a members' world so you already have access to everything that being a member has to offer. Enjoy!
translation: 你目前在会员世界上，所以你已经可以享受会员的所有福利了。好好享受！

english: Bonds are another thing that you should know about. You can purchase Bonds from the store in the Account Management menu. Once you have some Bonds, you can redeem them for membership!
translation: 债券是另一件你应该了解的东西。你可以从帐号管理菜单的商店中购买债券。一旦你有了债券，就可以用它兑换会员资格！

english: But why would I use a Bond instead of just buying membership normally?
translation: 但我为什么要用债券而不是直接购买会员资格呢？

english: Unlike membership, Bonds can be traded with other players. You could purchase a Bond and then sell it to another player for some gold. Alternatively, you could use your gold to buy a Bond from another player!
translation: 与会员资格不同，债券可以与其他玩家交易。你可以购买债券，然后卖给其他玩家换取金币。或者，你也可以用金币从其他玩家那里购买债券！

english: So if I used my gold to buy a Bond from another player, I could get membership without spending any real money?
translation: 所以如果我用金币从其他玩家那里购买债券，我就可以不花现实中的金钱获得会员资格？

english: Exactly!
translation: 没错！

english: Next up, you have your inbox and name changer. The inbox is where you’ll receive important information related to your account and the game. Be sure to keep an eye on it.
translation: 接下来是你的收件箱和改名器。收件箱是你接收与帐号和游戏相关的重要信息的地方。一定要留意它。

english: The name changer allows you to change your display name if you don't like your current one. Be aware though that this is only available to accounts with membership.
translation: 如果你不喜欢当前的显示名称，可以用改名器进行更改。但请注意，此功能仅适用于会员账户。

english: Finally, the bottom of the menu has some links which you might find useful. Make sure you check them out at some point.
translation: 最后，菜单底部有一些你可能觉得有用的链接，请务必抽空查看一下。

english: Awesome. Is there anything else I should know about accounts?
translation: 太好了，关于账号还有什么需要注意的吗？

english: Your account is very valuable and it's important you look after it. Various tools can help with this, such as Bank PINs and two-factor authentication options.
translation: 你的帐号非常宝贵，请务必妥善保管。你可以利用多种工具来保护账户安全，例如PIN码和双重验证选项。

english: You'll find more information on account security on the Customer Support webpage. You can use the Useful Links section of the Account Management menu to get there.
translation: 你可以在客户支持网页上找到更多关于帐号安全的信息。你可以使用帐号管理菜单的有用链接部分访问该网页。

english: Anyway, that's everything I have to tell you about accounts. Let me know if you need a recap, otherwise head on to your next instructor.
translation: 好了，关于账户我就讲这么多。如果需要复习请告诉我，否则就去下一位导师那里吧。

english: Hello. Would you like to hear about your account again?
translation: 你好，你想再听一次关于帐号的介绍吗？

english: Yes!
translation: 是的！

english: Excellent. Well there's a few things you can do with your account.
translation: 太好了，你可以使用你的账户进行一些操作。

english: You are currently on a free world. If you want to switch to a members' world and enjoy all of the benefits, you'll need to purchase membership. You can do so using the store in the Account Management menu.
translation: 你目前在免费世界上。如果你想切换到会员世界并享受所有福利，你需要购买会员资格。你可以在帐号管理菜单的商店中购买。

english: Next up, you have your inbox. The inbox is where you'll receive important information related to your account and the game. Be sure to keep an eye on it.
translation: 接下来是你的收件箱。收件箱是你接收与帐号和游戏相关的重要信息的地方，一定要留意它。

english: Finally, you have your display name. Every account has a unique display name. If you don't like your current one, you can change it with the name changer.
translation: 最后是你的显示名称。每个帐号都有唯一的显示名称。如果你不喜欢当前的名称，可以用改名器更改它。

english: Anyway, that's everything. I hope that has helped you out.
translation: 总之，就是这些了。希望这对你有帮助。

english: Yes!
translation: 是的！

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Hey there adventurer. I am Gordon, the Account security tutor. I can help you with anything account security related, would you like to know anything?
translation: 你好冒险者。我是戈登，一位帐号安全导师。我可以帮助你解决任何与帐号安全相关的问题，你有什么想了解的吗？

english: How can I keep my account secure?
translation: 如何保障我的账号安全？

english: There are many ways you can strengthen your account security, which would you like to hear more about?
translation: 有很多方法可以加强你的帐号安全，你想了解哪方面？

english: Tell me about passwords.
translation: 和我说说密码的事。

english: Your password is the first line of defence in keeping your account secure.
translation: 密码是保护帐号安全的第一道防线。

english: When choosing a password, make sure to keep it unique. You can do this by using a mix of letters and numbers. You could even use numbers in the middle of your password.
translation: 选择密码时，务必确保密码独一无二。你可以混合使用字母和数字，甚至可以在密码中间加入数字。

english: For extra security, you should make sure you use a different password for your account and email.
translation: 为了更加安全，你应该确保帐号和电子邮箱使用不同的密码。

english: You should keep your password safe and tell no one. Not even your friends or family.
translation: 你应该妥善保管密码，不要告诉任何人，包括你的朋友和家人。

english: Is there anything else you would like to know?
translation: 还有什么你想了解的吗？

english: Tell me about securing my email.
translation: 告诉我如何保护电子邮箱安全。

english: Make sure you use a separate password for your email account. This will help boost your security and make it less likely for hijackers to steal your account.
translation: 确保你的电子邮箱帐号使用独立的密码。这有助提高你的帐号安全性，并降低帐号被盗用的可能性。

english: You should also enable two-step authentication on your email account, if your email supports it.
translation: 如果你的电子邮箱支持，你还应该启用两步验证。

english: This could be done through an authenticator app supplied by your email provider, or it could be done using your mobile phone number.
translation: 这可以通过电子邮箱提供商提供的验证器应用完成，也可以使用手机号码完成。

english: The type of authenticator changes based on provider, but when active, hijackers will find it hard to access your account. Also, if you get any backup codes, keep them safe.
translation: 验证器类型因提供商而异，但启用后，黑客将难以访问你的帐号。此外，如果你收到任何备用验证码，请务必妥善保管。

english: Tell me about the authenticator.
translation: 和我说说验证器的事。

english: The RuneScape authenticator will provide your account with another layer of security against hijackers who might want to steal your account.
translation: RuneScape 验证器将为你的帐号提供另一层安全防护，防止黑客窃取你的帐号。

english: As well as requiring a password to enter your account, you will also need a randomly generated number from the authenticator app to login.
translation: 除了需要密码登录帐号外，你还需要验证器应用生成的随机数字才能登录。

english: You can enable the authenticator by checking your account page on the official RuneScape website.
translation: 你可以在官方 RuneScape 网站上查看帐号页面来启用验证器。

english: If you like, I can take you to a useful web page about the RuneScape authenticator.
translation: 如果你愿意，我可以带你去一个关于 RuneScape 验证器的实用网页。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Tell me about securing my bank.
translation: 告诉我如何保障我的银行帐户安全。

english: If someone does get into your account, you should make sure your bank is secure.
translation: 如果有人入侵了你的账户，你应该确保你的银行账户安全。

english: To keep your bank secure, you should make sure to set a bank pin. A bank pin is a 4 digit code you will need to put in to access your bank.
translation: 为了保护银行账户安全，你应该设置PIN码。PIN码是你使用银行账户时需要输入的4位数字代码。

english: It seems I don't have one setup. How do I gotabout setting up a bank pin?
translation: 我好像没有设置。我该如何设置PIN码？

english: To setup a bank pin you will need to visit any bank where you can find a banker. You should then speak to the banker and ask them about setting up a bank pin.
translation: 要设置PIN码，你需要前往任何有银行职员的银行。然后你应该与银行职员交谈，询问他们如何设置PIN码。

english: After the bank pin has been set, you will need to wait a few days for the pin to take effect.
translation: 设置PIN码后，你需要等待几天才能生效。

english: Thanks, I should go speak to a banker right away.
translation: 谢谢，我马上去找银行职员。

english: Good thing I already have one set.
translation: 幸好我已经设置了一个。

english: Good on you [lad/lass]! Great work.
translation: 干得好[lad/lass]！做得好。

english: Tell me about the Stronghold of Security.
translation: 和我说说安全要塞的事。

english: The Stronghold of Security can be found in the Barbarian Village, west of Varrock.
translation: 安全要塞位于维洛克城西边的野蛮人聚落。

english: Here you will be tested on your knowledge of account security. You will need to make your way to the bottom floor while answering question on account security and fighting monsters.
translation: 在这里你将接受帐号安全知识的测试。你需要一边回答有关账户安全的问题，一边与怪物战斗，最终到达最底层。

english: Be aware, the deeper into the stronghold you go, the tougher the monster will be. So make sure you bring your best equipment and some food.
translation: 请注意，你越深入要塞，怪物就越强大。所以务必带上最好的装备和一些食物。

english: If you do manage to make it to the end of each floor, you will be able to loot the chest for some loot. But only once per floor.
translation: 如果你成功到达每一层的尽头，就可以打开宝箱获得一些战利品。但每层只能打开一次。

english: If you decide to kill the monsters, you might find they drop some skull sceptre pieces.
translation: 如果你决定击杀怪物，你可能会发现它们掉落一些头骨权杖碎片。

english: Interesting, thanks for the information.
translation: 很有意思，谢谢你的信息。

english: Can I have a Security book?
translation: 能给我一本安全手册吗？

english: Sure thing, here you go.
translation: 当然可以。

english: The Account security tutor hands you a Security book.
translation: 帐号安全导师递给你一本安全手册。

english: Use it well.
translation: 好好使用它。

english: You already have one, maybe you should read that one instead.
translation: 你已经有一本了，也许你应该先读那本。

english: Don't I know you from somewhere?
translation: 我是不是在哪里见过你？

english: Ah, you're probably talking about my twin brother who works at the Port Sarim prison.
translation: 啊，你可能说的是我在沙林港监狱工作的双胞胎兄弟。

english: He spends all his time giving out security books when he could tell you about security instead.
translation: 他把所有时间都用来发放安全手册，而不是告诉你关于安全的知识。

english: But don't you give out security books too?
translation: 但你不也发放安全手册吗？

english: Well yes, but at least I tell you about account security as well.
translation: 嗯，但至少我会告诉你关于帐号安全的知识。

english: That's true. Maybe I shouldn't be too quick to judge.
translation: 说得对。也许我不该这么快下判断。

english: No, thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Come back any time you need any more information on account security.
translation: 当你需要更多关于帐号安全的信息时，随时回来找我。

english: Greetings. Welcome to the Heroes' Guild.
translation: 你好，欢迎来到英雄公会。

english: Only the greatest heroes of this land may gain entrance to this guild.
translation: 只有这片土地上最伟大的英雄才能进入这个公会。

english: I'm a hero - may I apply to join?
translation: 我是英雄——我可以申请加入吗？

english: You're a hero? I've never heard of YOU. You are required to possess at least 55 quest points to file an application.
translation: 你是英雄？我从没听说过你。你需要至少拥有55个任务点数才能提交申请。

english: Additionally you must have completed the Shield of Arrav, Lost City, Merlin's Crystal and Dragon Slayer I quests.
translation: 此外，你还必须完成阿拉夫之盾、失落之城、梅林的水晶和屠龙者 I 任务。

translation: 你好，朋友！你想沿着河走吗？

english: Currently, my service runs from here to Tal Teklan and then on to the Gloomthorn Trail on the edge of the Auburn Valley. I make the most of the river currents to move rapidly from point to point.
translation: 目前我的服务路线从这里到塔尔‧特克兰聚落，然后到奥本谷边缘的幽棘小径。我利用河流的水流快速往返于各点之间。

english: The best part is, I make enough money doing deliveries, so if you just want to travel, it's entirely free of charge!
translation: 最棒的是，我靠送货赚的钱足够了，所以如果你只是想旅行，那就完全免费！

translation: 我需要另一个任务。

english: You're actually very strong, are you sure you don't want Vannaka under Edgeville to assign you a task?
translation: 你其实很强，你确定不想让边陲镇的范纳卡给你安排任务吗？

english: No that's okay, I'll take a task from you.
translation: 没关系，我接受你的任务。

english: Oh okay then, I'll go talk to Vannaka.
translation: 哦那好吧，我去找范纳卡。

english: Excellent, you're doing great. Your new task is to kill [amount] [task monster].
translation: 太好了，你做得很好。你的新任务是击杀 [amount] 只 [task monster]。

english: Got any tips for me?
translation: 有什么建议给我吗？

english: Great, thanks!
translation: 太好了，谢谢！

english: Okay, great!
translation: 好的，太棒了！

english: Good luck! Don't forget to come back when you need a new assignment.
translation: 祝你好运！需要新任务时别忘了回来。

english: You're still hunting [task monster], you have [amount] to go. Come back when you've finished your task.
translation: 你仍在猎杀[task monster]，还剩 [amount] 只。完成任务后再回来吧。

english: Alright, consider the task cancelled. You can now get a new assignment when you want one.
translation: 好的，任务已取消。你现在可以随时获取新任务。

translation: 你有什么奖励给我，或者有什么可以交易的吗？

english: I have quite a few rewards you can earn, and a wide variety of Slayer equipment for sale.
translation: 我有不少你可以获得的奖励，还有各种杀戮者装备出售。

english: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
translation: 我们来谈谈我任务的难度。

english: The Slayer Masters may currently assign you any task in our lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: 无论你的战斗等级如何，杀戮大师目前可以分配列表中的任何任务给你。

translation: 好的，从现在开始，无论你的战斗等级如何，所有杀戮大师会从他们的列表中分配任何任务给你。

english: Indeed I am. It's been a while since he last asked me to step in, but it's good to get out and see the sights, to meet mortals and to generally socialise.
translation: 确实如此。他上次让我帮忙已经有一段时间了，不过出去走走，看看风景，结识一些普通人，社交一下挺好的。

english: So do you know Mazchna well?
translation: 那你很了解马斯纳吗？

english: Oh, yes, he's such a mine of information. He hears what's going on at the pub, listens to the gossip of passing adventurers, and now he's off on a great adventure himself.
translation: 是的，他简直是信息宝库。他听酒馆里的动静，听过路冒险者的八卦，现在他自己也要踏上一段伟大的冒险之旅了。

translation: 没关系——我能应付任何任务。

english: In future, please don't give anything too tough.
translation: 以后请不要给我太难的任务。

english: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.
translation: 没关系——我不想要太难的任务。

english: Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!
translation: 别再检查我的战斗等级了——我能应付任何任务！

english: So you're filling in for Mazchna?
translation: 所以你是来顶替马斯纳的？

english: Er... Nothing...
translation: 呃……没什么……

english: Err... Nothing...
translation: 呃……没什么……

english: Don't mind me, but if you're looking for something to do, this man here needs a hand.
translation: 别在意我，不过如果你正想找点事做，这位先生需要帮忙。

english: Nilsal, traveller. What brings you out here?
translation: 你好，旅行者。什么风把你吹到这里？

english: Just exploring. What about you?
translation: 我只是随便逛逛，你呢？

english: You'll find me here quite often. I like to come and tend to this grave.
translation: 你会经常在这里看到我。我喜欢来照看这座坟墓。

english: Whose is it?
translation: 这是谁的坟墓？

english: I don't know. I don't understand the markings on it. They are not of this land. All I know is that it is the grave of someone from Kourend.
translation: 我不知道。我看不懂上面的标记。它们不属于这片土地。我只知道这是某个库兰德人的坟墓。

english: They'll have been a soldier of some sorts, fighting here in the war. I'm guessing they were quite important. Very few people would have been afforded a burial in those times.
translation: 他们应该是某种士兵，曾在这场战争中奋战过。我猜他们当时的地位相当显赫，毕竟在那个年代，很少有人能得到安葬。

english: If you don't know who they are, why tend the grave?
translation: 如果你不知道他们是谁，为什么要照看坟墓？

english: It was my father's generation who fought in the war, but they're all gone now. My generation will soon follow. In time, this grave will go as well. Eventually, they'll be no trace left of the war.
translation: 我父亲那一代人参加了战争，但他们现在都已不在人世。我们这一代人很快也会如此。总有一天，这座坟墓也会消失。最终，战争的痕迹将荡然无存。

english: I guess that's why I tend the grave. The future is inevitable, but for now, I'd like to try and hold onto the past for a bit longer.
translation: 想这就是我守墓的原因吧。未来不可避免，但现在我只想尽可能多地留住过去。

english: I see. In that case, I'm sorry to have disturbed you. I'll leave you to it.
translation: 我明白了，那样的话我就不打扰你了。

english: Thank you, traveller.
translation: 谢谢你，旅行者。

english: You! Time for some questions.
translation: 你！是时候问些问题了。

english: Why did you join the Emissaries?
translation: 你为什么加入使者团？

english: To be honest, I wasn't too sure about joining at first. My friend convinced me though. Here we're part of something bigger than ourselves.
translation: 老实说，一开始我不太确定要不要加入。不过我的朋友说服了我。在这里，我们成为了比我们自身更伟大的事业的一部分。

english: Who do you worship?
translation: 你信仰谁？

english: I've never been one for proper worship, but I believe in the teachings of Ralos and Ranul. I hope those teachings guide me through whatever is to come.
translation: 我从来不是那种循规蹈矩虔诚拜神的人，但我相信拉洛斯和拉努尔的教义。我希望这些教义能指引我度过未来的一切。

english: Tell me about the Final Dawn.
translation: 和我说说最终黎明的事。

english: They say the Final Dawn is inevitable. It's the end that we can't escape from. It's a scary thought, but the Twilight Emissaries have embraced it, so I have as well.
translation: 他们说最终黎明是不可避免的。那是我们无法逃避的终结。这个想法很可怕，但暮光使者们已经接受了它，所以我也接受了。

english: Why did you join the Emissaries?
translation: 你为什么加入使者团？

english: Who do you worship?
translation: 你信仰谁？

english: Tell me about the Final Dawn.
translation: 和我说说最终黎明的事。

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: Hello friend. I wish to slay evil and avail them of their loot! Take me to Burgh de Rott!
translation: 你好，我想斩妖除魔，夺取他们的战利品！带我去伯格德罗特镇！

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
translation: 你准备好与那里的邪恶势力对抗了吗？

english: I think so? At least my heart knows courage and that should be sufficient for the meantime. I expect that when we get to Burgh de Rott, we'll be able to purchase suitable provisions.
translation: 我想是的？至少我内心充满勇气，这暂时应该足够了。我想等我们到了伯格德罗特镇，我们能够购买合适的补给品。

english: But you do realise that the vampyres in Morytania are immune to everything except silver?
translation: 但是你难道不知道莫利塔尼亚的吸血鬼除了银以外，对其他任何东西都免疫吗？

english: Er...well, I've not heard mention of that fact, but I have faith that Saradomin will provide the means to furnish me with suitable weapons when I reach Burgh de Rott.
translation: 呃……好吧，我没听说过这件事，但我相信萨拉多明会在我到达伯格德罗特镇时提供合适的武器。

english: And if we happen to run into some vampyres on the journey down there?
translation: 如果我们在去那里的路上碰到一些吸血鬼怎么办？

english: I trust that you will help us to avoid them. You are a guide after all, aren't you? Anyway, you look like you can handle yourself. I presume you've fought such creatures before and won? How hard can it be?
translation: 我相信你会帮我们避开他们。毕竟你是向导，对吧？不管怎样，你看起来能照顾好自己。我猜你以前和这种生物交过手并赢了？能有多难？

english: It can be pretty difficult, actually. But you're right, I'll be your guide so I should be able to handle the situation.
translation: 其实挺难的。不过你说得对，我会做你的向导，应该能应付得了。

english: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: 你为什么想去伯格德罗特镇？

english: I'm going down there to teach those vampyres a lesson or two. I've heard about the terrible conditions down there and I intend to put a stop to it.
translation: 我要去给那些吸血鬼点教训。我听说过那里的糟糕状况，我打算阻止这一切。

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Burgh de Rott?
translation: 如果我们在前往伯格德罗特镇的路上遇到敌人，你有办法自保吗？

english: Let's just say that I'm somewhat experienced and I'm happy to take on my fair share of enemies. You don't need to worry about that.
translation: 这么说吧，我还算有点经验，而且我很乐意承担我该对付的那份敌人。你不需要为我担心。

english: I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
translation: 我可以带你去伯格德罗特镇。

english: Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: 嗯，看来你有个随从。我想若是让它独自乱跑，这趟路上恐怕会走丢。等你的随从安顿好了我们再动身。

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: 真的吗？那太好了！到达目的地后我会给你报酬的。

english: Burgh de Rott Ramble begins
translation: 伯格德罗特镇漫步之旅开始

english: Ok, which route should we take?
translation: 好的，我们应该走哪条路线？

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: 啊，所以你想给我一些补给？让我打开我的背包看看。

english: This place is a bit grim. How can people live here?
translation: 这地方有点阴森，人们到底是怎么在这种环境下生活下去的？

english: Do you visit Burgh de Rott often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: 你经常来伯格德罗特镇吗？你似乎很熟悉这条路。

english: When are we going to get to Burgh de Rott?
translation: 我们什么时候能到伯格德罗特镇？

english: We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on. I have loot to get.
translation: 我们没时间闲聊，赶紧前进吧。我还有战利品要拿。

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than the opulet life styles forced on us adventurer types. I'd much rather be up to my eyes in mud and having a good fight!
translation: 我讨厌这趟行程，但这总比强加在我们冒险者身上的那种奢华生活要好。我宁愿浑身泥泞，痛快地打一场！

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...
translation: 你没看见我正在挨打吗

english: Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
translation: 谢谢，我会吃掉的。

english: Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Paterdomus. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: 天哪，看来我们得回帕多姆斯了。我们过不了那座桥！

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
translation: 我相信我们能找到办法的！

english: Player completes the bridge event
translation: 玩家完成了桥梁事件

english: Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Paterdomus.
translation: 这下糟了……看来我们过不了这片沼泽，得回帕多姆斯了。

english: Player completes the bog event
translation: 玩家完成了沼泽事件

english: Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
translation: 太棒了！干得漂亮，我会跟紧你。

english: Whahay...that was great!
translation: 哇哈……太棒了！

english: But we really should be heading off now.
translation: 不过我们现在真得赶紧上路了。

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
translation: 放心，我们一定能找到路过去的！

english: Player completes the river event
translation: 玩家完成了河流事件

english: That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
translation: 太厉害了！我也得照做。

english: Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: 哇哈……太棒了！不过我们现在真得赶紧上路了。

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
translation: 那……那些气泡是什么？

english: This is scary!
translation: 这太可怕了！

english: Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
translation: 啊，那应该是触手……

english: Ahhh, two tentacles!
translation: 啊，两根触手！

english: ...three tentacles!
translation: ……三根触手！

english: I think I'm going to faint!
translation: 我觉得我要晕了！

english: Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: 天哪！看那怪物！你得自己解决那东西！

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the Burgh de Rott. Here's your reward.
translation: 多谢你平安把我带到伯格德罗特镇，这是你的报酬。

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
translation: 你准备好与那里的邪恶势力对抗了吗？

english: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: 你为什么想去伯格德罗特镇？

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
translation: 如果我们在路上遇到敌人，你能自保吗？

english: I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
translation: 我可以带你去伯格德罗特镇。

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: Hello there. Who are you?
translation: 你好，你是谁？

english: Ada! Nice to meet you!
translation: 我是艾达！很高兴见到你！

english: What are you waiting here for?
translation: 你在这里等什么？

english: I'm looking for an adventure! This place is meant to be the perfect place to find one for a budding pirate like me!
translation: 我在寻找冒险！这个地方对像我这样初出茅庐的海盗来说简直是完美之地！

english: Pirate?
translation: 海盗？

english: Well... the good kind!
translation: 嗯……是那种好的冒险！

english: I see. Well, I've never really had to look for an adventure myself. Personally I find I just stumble into them instead.
translation: 我明白了，我从来没有刻意寻找过冒险。我个人觉得，我总是会不经意间就遇到它们。

english: Really? Well, I hope that happens to me soon!
translation: 真的吗？那我也希望这种事能尽快发生在我身上！

english: I'm sure it will. Good luck!
translation: 我相信会的，祝你好运！

english: Really? Well, perhaps I'd be better off sticking with you then.
translation: 真的吗？那看来我还是跟着你比较好。

english: Sorry, but I'm still pretty new to it all. I don't think I'm ready to be hiring a crew yet, but I'll let you know when I am.
translation: 抱歉，但我对这一切还不太熟悉。我还没准备好雇佣船员，但等我准备好了会告诉你的。

english: Oh, fair enough.
translation: 哦，好吧。

english: You need a Sailing level of 40 to manage a crew.
translation: 你需要40级航海等级才能管理船员。

english: I'd definitely be happy to have you on my crew.
translation: 我很欢迎你成为我的船员。

english: Hang on... You don't actually look like much of an adventurer to me. I don't think this will work.
translation: 等等……你看起来不太像个冒险者，这件事还是算了吧。

english: You require the following to recruit this crew member: Level 55 Sailing.
translation: 你需要满足以下条件才能招募这名船员：55级航海。

english: Great! I reckon this will be a fun adventure! I'll see you on your boat...
translation: 太好了！我想这会是一次有趣的冒险！船上见……

english: You recruit Adventurer Ada as a crew member.
translation: 你招募了冒险者艾达作为船员。

english: You have recruited Adventurer Ada as a crew member.
translation: 你已招募冒险者艾达作为船员。

english: Sorry, but I'm not really in a place for you to join me right now.
translation: 抱歉，但我现在的情况不太适合让你加入我。

english: Hello again! Reckon you're ready for me to join you yet?
translation: 又见面了！你觉得你准备好让我加入你了吗？

english: Captain!
translation: 船长！

english: Hey there. How are you enjoying being part of the crew?
translation: 嘿，在这里当船员还习惯吗？

english: I'm looking forward to the next adventure! I might start writing down what we get up to.
translation: 我很期待下一次冒险！我可能会把我们的冒险经历记下来。

english: Well, that might save me a bit of time on my captain's log.
translation: 嗯，那可能会帮我省点写船长日志的时间。

english: Great!
translation: 太好了！

english: I'd definitely be happy to have you on my crew.
translation: 我很欢迎你成为我的船员。

english: Sorry, but I'm not really in a place for you to join me right now.
translation: 抱歉，但我现在的情况不太适合让你加入我。

english: Hello [player name], what can I do for you?
translation: 你好，冒险者。有什么能帮你的？

english: What are Adventure Paths?
translation: 什么是冒险路径？

english: A long time ago, I was a newbie just like you who didn't know what to do and I would be more than happy to pass on my experience.
translation: 很久以前，我也和你一样是个什么都不懂的新手，我很乐意把我的经验传授给你。

english: I've created some Adventure Paths which I recommend you to start off with. An Adventure Path is a list of tasks which you can complete in any order.
translation: 我建立了一些冒险路径，我建议你可以从这里开始。冒险路径是一系列任务列表，你可以按任意顺序完成。

english: To help you get started on your Adventure Path, I'll also give you a starter kit with some useful items.
translation: 为了帮你展开冒险路径，我还会给你一个包含一些有用物品的新手包。

english: Once you've completed an Adventure Path task, come back to me and I'll give you a reward.
translation: 当你完成了冒险路径中的任务后，回来找我拿奖励吧。

english: Do you have any Adventure Path starter kits for me?
translation: 你有没有冒险路径的新手包能给我吗？

english: Adventurer Jon gives you a Combat path starter kit
translation: 冒险者乔恩给你一个战斗之路新手包。

english: Here are all of the starter kits you have left to claim.
translation: 以下是你剩余的可以领取的新手包。

english: You seem to have already claimed all of your starter kits.
translation: 你似乎已经领取了所有的新手包。

english: I'd like to claim my Adventure Path rewards.
translation: 我想领取冒险路径的奖励。

english: I have no rewards to give you at the moment.
translation: 我目前没有任何奖励可以给你。

english: I have no rewards to give you at the moment. But I do have some members rewards left to give you, visit me on a members world to receive them.
translation: 我目前没有任何奖励可以给你，但我还有一些会员奖励可以给你，你去会员世界找我领取吧。

english: You should make sure you have space before asking for rewards.
translation: 你在领取奖励前应该确保有足够物品栏空间。

english: That is the last of the rewards you have currently earned. But I do have some members rewards left to give you, visit me on a members world to receive them.
translation: 这是你目前获得的所有奖励了。但我还有一些会员奖励可以给你，你去会员世界找我领取吧。

english: That is the last of your rewards which you have earned.
translation: 这是你获得的所有奖励了。

english: I can't give you any more rewards until you come back with more inventory space.
translation: 在你回来腾出更多物品栏空间之前，我没法给你更多奖励。

english: Can you show me some Adventure Paths?
translation: 你能给我展示一些冒险路径吗？

english: Of course, here you go.
translation: 当然可以。

english: Opting out of Adventure Paths will hide the interface and you will no longer receive task and path notifications. You can talk to Adventurer Jon to opt back into Adventure Paths
translation: 退出冒险路径后，界面将被隐藏，你将不再收到任务和路径通知。你可以和冒险者乔恩交谈以重新加入冒险之路。

english: You have now opted out of Adventure Paths.
translation: 你已退出冒险路径。

english: You are currently not participating in Adventure Paths. Would you like to join back in?
translation: 你目前没有参与冒险路径，你想重新加入吗？

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Opting into Adventure Paths will allow you to see the interface and you will be able to receive task and path notifications. You can talk to Adventurer Jon to opt back out of Adventure Paths
translation: 加入冒险之路后，你将能看到相关介面，并接收到任务与路径的通知。你可以随时找冒险者乔恩取消加入。

english: You have opted back into Adventure Paths.
translation: 你已重新加入冒险路径。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: I am simply an adventurer like yourself taking a break on my journey.
translation: 我和你一样，只是一个在旅途中休息的冒险家。

english: I wish you luck on your next adventure.
translation: 祝你下一次冒险好运。

english: And I to you.
translation: 也祝你好运。

english: Hey [player name]! Come over here.
translation: 嘿[player name]！过来这边。

english: You look new around here, welcome to the world of Gielinor!
translation: 你看起来是个新人，欢迎来到基利诺尔！

english: Thanks, it's my first time here and I'm not sure where to start.
translation: 谢谢，这是我第一次来这里，我不知道该从哪里开始。

english: Well, lucky for you, that is exactly why I am here.
translation: 嗯，你运气真好，这正是我来这里的原因。

english: Start by opening your quest panel and then selecting the flashing yellow star.
translation: 首先打开你的任务面板，然后选择闪烁的黄色星星。

english: What are Adventure Paths?
translation: 什么是冒险路径？

english: Do you have any Adventure Path starter kits for me?
translation: 你有没有冒险路径的新手包能给我吗？

english: I'd like to claim my Adventure Path rewards.
translation: 我想领取冒险路径的奖励。

english: Can you show me some Adventure Paths?
translation: 你能给我展示一些冒险路径吗？

english: Disable Adventure Paths.
translation: 禁用冒险路径。

english: Yes
translation: 是

english: No
translation: 否

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Greetings, [Sir/Madam].
translation: 你好，[Sir/Madam]。

english: The King needs someone to take over the rule of the Kingdom. If I were you, I should consider the position.
translation: 国王正打算找人治理这个国家。如果我是你，我会考虑这个职位。

english: Greetings, Your Royal Highness.
translation: 你好，殿下。

english: Your Royal Highness, I should tell you right away that killing the people of this Kingdom will not make you popular with anyone.
translation: 殿下，我必须立刻提醒你，杀害这个王国的子民绝对不会让你受到爱戴。

english: How is the Kingdom faring?
translation: 王国现在情况如何？

english: Your subjects are worried about the possibility of war, but they are still happy to work for you.
translation: 你的子民担心战争爆发，但他们目前仍乐意为你效劳。

english: What am I meant to be doing again?
translation: 我应该做什么来着？

english: Dealing with all the little troubles that come up from time to time, Your Royal Highness.
translation: 处理不时出现的所有小麻烦，殿下。

english: Such as the predicament we are now in.
translation: 比如我们现在所处的困境。

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你什么意思？

english: Has anything been happening in the kingdom recently?
translation: 王国最近有什么事发生吗？

english: Interesting that you should ask that, Your Royal Highness.
translation: 殿下，你问这个问题很有意思。

english: You see, the people are worried that war will break out again.
translation: 人们担心战争会再次爆发。

english: King Vargas has found himself with little to do now that you are the regent. He intended, at first, to return to adventuring.
