translation: 这是侮辱女巫的罚款，你应该学会一些尊重。

english: Thank you for your kind present of some flour. I am sure you never meant to insult me.
translation: 谢谢你送我的面粉。我相信你不是有意冒犯我的。

english: You should be careful about insulting a witch. You never know what shape you could wake up in.
translation: 你应该小心不要侮辱女巫。你永远不知道自己醒来时会变成什么样子。

english: Can you make dyes for me please?
translation: 你能为我制作染料吗？

english: What sort of dye would you like? Red, yellow or blue?
translation: 你想要什么颜色的染料？红色、黄色还是蓝色？

english: What could you make for me?
translation: 你能做什么？

english: What do you need to make red dye?
translation: 制作红色染料需要什么？

english: Okay, make me some red dye please.
translation: 好的，请给我做一些红色染料。

english: I don't think I have all the ingredients yet.
translation: 我还没有备齐所有材料。

english: I can do without dye at that price.
translation: 这种价格的话，我不用染料也行。

english: Where do I get redberries?
translation: 哪里可以弄到红莓？

english: What other colours can you make?
translation: 你还能调出什么颜色？

english: Thanks
translation: 谢谢

english: What do you need to make yellow dye?
translation: 制作黄色染料需要什么？

english: Okay, make me some yellow dye please.
translation: 好的，请给我做一些黄色染料。

english: Where do I get onions?
translation: 哪里可以弄到洋葱？

english: What do you need to make blue dye?
translation: 制作蓝色染料需要什么？

english: Okay, make me some blue dye please.
translation: 好的，请给我做一些蓝色染料。

english: Where do I get woad leaves?
translation: 哪里可以弄到菘蓝叶？

english: No thanks, I am happy the colour I am.
translation: 不用了，我对现在的颜色很满意。

english: Cool, do you turn people into frogs?
translation: 嗨，你能把人变成青蛙吗？

english: You mad old witch, you can't help me.
translation: 你这个疯老巫婆，根本没办法帮我。

english: Can you make dyes for me please?
translation: 你能为我制作染料吗？

english: How do I use the agility course?
translation: 我如何使用敏捷训练场？

english: I'll throw you a stick, which you need to fetch as quickly as possible, from the area beyond the pipes.
translation: 我会给你扔一根棍子，你需要尽快从管道后面的区域把它捡回来。

english: Be wary of the deathslide - you must hang by your teeth, and if your strength is not up to the job you will fall into a pit of spikes. Also, I would advise not carrying too much extra weight.
translation: 小心死亡滑索——你必须用牙齿咬住不放，如果你的力量不够，就会掉进尖刺陷阱。另外我建议你身上别带太重的东西。

english: Bring the stick back to the werewolf waiting at the end of the death slide to get your agility bonus.
translation: 把棍子带回死亡滑索尽头等待的狼人那里，来获得你的敏捷经验值。

english: I will throw your stick as soon as you jump onto the first stone.
translation: 你一跳到第一块石头上，我就会把你的棍子扔出去。

english: Grrr - you don't belong in here, human!
translation: 嗷呜——人类，你不该待在这儿！

english: FETCH!!!!!
translation: 快去捡回来!!!!!

english: Why didn't you hand the stick over?!!?
translation: 你为什么没有把棍子交出来？!!?

english: He doesn't look like he wants to talk right now.
translation: 他看起来现在不太想说话。

english: Have you brought the stick yet?
translation: 你把棍子带来了吗？

english: What stick?
translation: 什么棍子？

english: Come on, get round that course - I need something to chew!
translation: 快点完成训练——我需要嚼点东西！

english: You need to take your headgear off before you try the Deathslide, otherwise you won't be able to get a good enough grip with your teeth.
translation: 在尝试死亡滑索之前你需要摘下头盔，否则你的牙齿无法咬紧绳索。

english: Grrr - you don't belong in here, human!
translation: 嗷呜——人类，你不该待在这儿！

english: That headgear won't help you here, human! Take it off!
translation: 人类，你戴着那头盔没用！把它摘下来！

english: Remember - a slow wolf is a hungry wolf!!
translation: 记住——跑得慢的狼可是会饿肚子的！！

english: Get on with it - you need your whiskers perking!!!!
translation: 快点行动——你得把胡须竖起来!!!!

english: Claws first - think later.
translation: 先出爪——后动脑。

english: Imagine the smell of blood in your nostrils!!!
translation: 想象鲜血的气味充斥你的鼻腔!!!

english: I never really wanted to be an agility trainer...
translation: 其实我从没真想当什么敏捷训练师……

english: It'll be worth it when you hunt!!
translation: 等你去打猎时就值了!!

english: Let's see those powerful backlegs at work!!
translation: 让我看看你那强壮的后腿发力!!

english: Let the bloodlust take you!!
translation: 让嗜血的欲望吞噬你吧!!

english: You're the slowest wolf I've ever had the misfortune to witness!!
translation: 你是我有生以来见过的最慢的狼!!

english: When you're done there's a human with your name on it!!
translation: 等你完成了，就有个人类等着被你撕碎!!

english: You idiot - you've forgotten the stick!!!!
translation: 你这蠢货——你把棍子忘了!!!!

english: Give my regards to the ground...
translation: 替我向地面问个好……

english: WAAAAAARRRGGGHHHH!!!!!!
translation: 嗷嗷嗷嗷嗷!!!!!!

english: Don't let the spikes or the blood put you off...
translation: 别让尖刺和鲜血吓到你……

english: Now for a true test of teeth...
translation: 现在来真正测试一下你的牙齿……

english: You shouldn't even be here, human!
translation: 你根本就不该来这里，人类！

english: Let's see how strong human teeth are...
translation: 让我看看人类的牙齿有多结实……

english: Remember - no stick, no agility bonus!
translation: 记住——没棍子，就没敏捷经验值！

english: Bring me the stick when you've finished the course!
translation: 完成训练后把棍子带给我！

english: Don't forget to give me the stick when you're done!
translation: 完成后别忘了把棍子交给我！

english: Oh no, not another human... what do you want then?
translation: 哦不，又来个人类……你想干嘛？

english: Oh, do you get humans here often?
translation: 这里经常有人类来吗？

english: Not that often, no, but sometimes.
translation: 不常来，但偶尔有。

english: Of course, since you people are too big for dwarven clothes, they typically don't stay very long.
translation: 当然咯，你们人类体型太大，穿不了矮人的衣服，所以通常待不了多久。

english: Why don't you make bigger clothes then?
translation: 那你为什么不做大点的衣服呢？

english: What'd be the point? Besides, I don't make these clothes myself.
translation: 有什么意义呢？再说了，这些衣服又不是我做的。

english: Who makes these clothes then?
translation: 那是谁做的？

english: Oh, my sister, she lives in Keldagrim-East. Has a little stall on the other side of the Kelda.
translation: 我妹妹，她住在凯尔达格林城东。在凯尔达河对面有个小摊位。

english: If she only worked a little harder, like me, she wouldn't have to live in the sewers of the city. Shame really.
translation: 如果她像我一样更努力一点，就不用住在城市的下水道里了。真是可惜啊

english: The sewers? Your sister lives in the sewers?
translation: 下水道？你妹妹住在下水道里？

english: Keldagrim-East, such a ghastly place. Not civil, polite and clean like we are in the West.
translation: 凯尔达格林城东就是这种糟糕的地方，不像我们城西这样文明、礼貌又干净。

english: Uh-huh.
translation: 嗯哼。

english: So do you have any quests for me?
translation: 那你有什么任务给我吗？

english: Quests? Why would I have any quests?
translation: 任务？我哪来的任务？

english: Oh, just anything to do would be fine.
translation: 哦，随便什么都行。

english: No, not right now... maybe I'll have something for you to do later, but nothing at the moment.
translation: 不，现在没有……也许以后会有事让你做，但目前还没有。

english: I ehm... find myself in some slight trouble, human. I was wondering if you were busy?
translation: 我呃……遇到点小麻烦，人类。不知道你有没有空？

english: What do you need help with, exactly?
translation: 具体需要我帮什么忙？

english: I need some clothing equipment for my sister. But hurry up! I will need [2/3/4] [needles/thread/pieces of wool/balls of wool] before [10/15/20] minutes are up.
translation: 我需要一些制衣材料给我妹妹。但快点！我需要在 [10/15/20] 分钟内拿到 [2/3/4]个[needles/thread/pieces of wool/balls of wool]。

english: Hmm, [X] [item] in [X] minutes, that sounds about alright.
translation: 嗯，[X] 分钟内拿 [X]个[item]，听起来还行。

english: I'm incredibly busy, yes.
translation: 我很忙的。

english: Pfft, I'm sure you are!
translation: 哼，我相信你很忙！

english: I'm in need of some raw supplies. Get me [X] [pieces of/bars of] [item] and be quick about it! I need them within the next [X] minutes!
translation: 我需要一些原材料。给我弄 [X] [块/条]个[item] 来，快点！我需要在接下来 [X] 分钟内拿到！

english: Hmm, [X] pieces of copper ore in [X] minutes, that sounds about alright.
translation: 嗯，[X] 分钟内拿 [X] 块铜矿石，听起来还行。

english: I'm still waiting for [X] [item]! Are you getting them or are you still looking for the way out of the palace?
translation: 我还在等 [X]个[item]！你到底在找东西还是在找离开宫殿的路？

english: I've had enough of this lousy job!
translation: 我受够这破工作了！

english: That just goes to show you can't trust humans!
translation: 这正好说明人类不可信！

english: Actually, I'm still just looking for your [X] [item].
translation: 其实，我还在找你的 [X]个[item]。

english: Hurry up then, I haven't got all day you know!
translation: 那快点，我可没一整天等你！

english: Oh, I should have known not to assign a human anything more complex than tying together [his/her/their] shoelaces. You didn't get me my [X] [item], did you? The [X] minutes have run out.
translation: 哦，我早该知道，给人类的任务不能比系鞋带更复杂。你没拿到我的 [X]个[item]，对吧？[X] 分钟已经到了。

english: Yes, ehm... sorry about that.
translation: 是的，呃……抱歉。

english: Actually, yes, I do have your [X] [item] right here.
translation: 其实，是的，我这里就有你的 [X]个[item]。

english: Can't you humans tell the time! You're too late!
translation: 你们人类不会看时间吗！你太晚了！

english: Look, I've got you your [X] [item]!
translation: 看，我给你拿到 [X]个[item] 了！

english: I'm amazed at your level of competence!
translation: 你的能力真让我惊讶！

english: Do you want me to pay you in gold or would you prefer me to tell you about some crafting secrets?
translation: 你想要我付你钱，还是想让我教你一些制作技巧？

english: Do you want me to pay you in gold or would you prefer me to teach you a bit about how you can mine more efficiently?
translation: 你想要我付你钱，还是想让我教你一些更高效的采矿技巧？

english: Do you want me to pay you in gold or would you like me to show you some smithing tricks?
translation: 你想要我付你钱，还是想让我教你一些锻造技巧？

english: I'd like the gold.
translation: 我想要金币。

english: Please teach me that.
translation: 请教教我。

english: You feel more experienced.
translation: 你的经验值提升了。

english: Show me the gold!
translation: 把金币给我！

english: Enlighten me.
translation: 指点我吧。

english: Who makes these clothes then?
translation: 那是谁做的衣服？

english: I still want to buy your clothes.
translation: 我还是想买你的衣服。

english: So do you have any quests for me?
translation: 那你有什么任务给我吗？

english: What do you need help with?
translation: 你需要什么帮助？

english: I'm incredibly busy, yes.
translation: 我很忙的。

english: I've had enough of this lousy job!
translation: 我受够这破工作了！

english: Actually, I'm still looking for your [X] [item].
translation: 其实，我还在找你的 [X]个[item]。

english: I'd like the gold.
translation: 我想要金币。

english: Please teach me that.
translation: 请教教我。

english: Show me the gold!
translation: 把金币给我！

english: Enlighten me.
translation: 指点我吧。

english: I cannot speak to you outerlander! Talk to Brundt, the Chieftain!
translation: 我不能和你说话，外乡人！去找酋长布伦特！

english: You stay away from me outerlander!
translation: 离我远点，外乡人！

english: They are too suspicious of you for you to get close enough to steal from them.
translation: 他们对你太警惕了，你没法靠近偷东西。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Hello again [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. What need you of me this day? You can always rely on my assistance!
translation: 又见面了，[brother/sister][Fremennik name]。今天找我有什么事？你随时可以找我帮忙！

english: Nothing thanks. I just fancied a chat.
translation: 没什么。就是想聊聊天。

english: My door is always open should you ever need my help [Fremennik name].
translation: 如果你需要帮助，我的门随时为你敞开，[Fremennik name]。

english: [Fremennik name]... It has been too long since last we met!
translation: [Fremennik name]……我们好久没见了！

english: Welcome back [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It is always a pleasure to see you here!
translation: 欢迎回来，[brother/sister][Fremennik name]。见到你总是令人高兴！

english: My apologies [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! I have not time to tarry here with you!
translation: 抱歉，[brother/sister][Fremennik name]！我没时间在这里陪你！

english: That's okay, I didn't really want anything.
translation: 没关系，我其实也没什么想要的。

english: How are you [Fremennik name]? I hope all fares well with you this day!
translation: 你好吗，[Fremennik name]？希望你今天一切顺利！

english: I'm fine, thanks, how are you?
translation: 我很好，谢谢，你呢？

english: All is well with me also!
translation: 我也一切都好！

english: Hello to you, too!
translation: 也向你问好！

english: Hello. Did you want something [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你好，你想要什么吗，[Fremennik name]？

english: No, not really.
translation: 不，没什么。

english: Well... okay then!
translation: 好吧……那行！

english: Always good to see you [brother/sister] [Fremennik name].
translation: 见到你很高兴，[brother/sister][Fremennik name]。

english: You shame us, [Fremennik name]!
translation: 你让我们蒙羞，[Fremennik name]！

english: How can you steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你怎么能偷我的东西，[Fremennik name]？

english: You have betrayed your heritage, [Fremennik name]!
translation: 你背叛了你的传承，[Fremennik name]！

english: Why would you try to steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你为什么要偷我的东西，[Fremennik name]？

english: Arrr, matey!
translation: 啊，伙计！

english: I'm looking for Redbeard Frank.
translation: 我在找红胡子弗兰克。

english: Redbeard Frank ye say? He be outside. Says he likes the feel of the wind on his cheeks.
translation: 你说红胡子弗兰克？他在外头，说是喜欢海风吹拂在脸上的感觉。

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

english: Arrr!
translation: 啊啊！

english: Are you going to sit there all day?
translation: 你打算在那儿坐一整天吗？

english: Aye, I am. I canna walk, ye see.
translation: 没错，如你所见，我这腿脚不利索。

english: What's stopping you from walking?
translation: 什么让你走不了路？

english: Arrr, I 'ave only the one leg! I lost its twin when my last ship went down.
translation: 啊哈，我只有一条腿！另一条随我的老船沉进海底了。

english: But I can see both your legs!
translation: 但我能看到你两条腿！

english: Nay, young [laddie/lassie], this be a false leg. For years I had me a sturdy wooden peg-leg, but now I wear this dainty little feller.
translation: 不，年轻的[laddie/lassie]，这是义肢。多年来我一直用结实的木腿，但现在我戴这个精致的小玩意儿。

english: Yon peg-leg kept getting stuck in the floorboards.
translation: 那木腿老是卡在地板缝里。

english: Right...
translation: 好吧……

english: Perhaps a [bright young laddie/bonnie young lassie] like yerself would like to help me? I be needing another ship to go a-hunting my enemy.
translation: 也许像你这样[bright young laddie/bonnie young lassie]愿意帮我？我需要另一艘船去追捕我的敌人。

english: Well, I do have a ship that I'm not using. It's the Lady Lumbridge.
translation: 嗯，我确实有一艘没用的船。这是仑桥夫人号。

english: Arrr! That ship be known to me, and a fine lass she is.
translation: 啊啊！那船我知道，是艘好船。

english: I suppose she might be...
translation: 我想她可能是……

english: So would ye be kind enough to let me take her out to sea?
translation: 那你能好心让我把她开到海上吗？

english: I had to pay 2000 gp for that ship. Have you got that much?
translation: 我那艘船花了2,000金币。你有那么多钱吗？

english: Hmmm. And can you afford another ship?
translation: 嗯。那你能再买一艘船吗？

english: Nay, I have nary a penny to my name. All my worldly goods went down with me old ship.
translation: 不，我现在身无分文，全部家当都随那艘老船沉了。

english: So you're actually asking me to give you a free ship.
translation: 所以你其实是想让我白送你一艘船。

english: Arrr! Would ye be so kind?
translation: 啊啊！你能这么好心吗？

english: No I jolly well wouldn't!
translation: 不，我绝对不会这么干！

english: Arrr.
translation: 啊啊。

english: Do you have anything for trade?
translation: 你有什么可以交易的吗？

english: Nothin' at the moment, but then again the Customs Agents are on the warpath right now.
translation: 现在没有，不过话说回来，海关官员现在正到处找麻烦。

english: Oi matey, leave my beer alone!
translation: 喂伙计，别动我的啤酒！

english: Sorry!
translation: 抱歉！

english: Oi matey, no casting spells on my beer!
translation: 喂伙计，别对我的啤酒施法！

english: I'm looking for Redbeard Frank.
translation: 我在找红胡子弗兰克。

english: Arrr!
translation: 啊啊！

english: Are you going to sit there all day?
translation: 你打算在那儿坐一整天吗？

english: Do you want to trade?
translation: 你想交易吗？

english: You dare disturb my rest!
translation: 你竟敢打扰我的休息！

english: You dare steal from us!
translation: 你竟敢偷我们的东西！

english: Gratias tibi ago!
translation: 感谢你！

english: Hello. Do you wish me to exchange banknotes for you? I charge only 5 coins for each banknote.
translation: 你好，需要我帮你兑换票据吗？每张票据我只收5枚金币。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Hand me the banknotes you wish me to exchange.
translation: 把你想兑换的票据给我。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: I am Aisles. I can exchange banknotes for real items. Do you want any banknotes converted?
translation: 我是艾尔斯，可将票据兑换为实体物品。你想兑换票据吗？

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: I exchange banknotes for real items. That's not a banknote.
translation: 我用票据兑换实物。你拿的这个不是票据。

english: I charge 5 coins for exchanging each banknote.
translation: 我每张票据兑换收5枚金币。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Exchange [item name]: 5 coins
translation: 兑换[item name]：5枚金币

english: Exchange All: [number of banknotes x 5] coins
translation: 全部兑换：[number of banknotes x5] 枚金币

english: Cancel
translation: 取消

english: Greetings, fellow warrior. I am Ajjat, former black knight and now training officer here in the warrior guild.
translation: 你好啊，战友。我是阿加特，曾是黑骑士，现在是战士公会的训练官。

english: Can you tell me about skillcapes, please?
translation: 你能和我说说技能斗篷的事吗？

english: Skillcapes, also known as Capes of Accomplishment, are reserved for the elite of the elite. Only a person who has truly mastered a skill can buy one, and even then a skillcape can only be bought from one who is
translation: 技能斗篷，亦被称为成就斗篷，是精英中的精英才能拥有的。只有真正精通某项技能的人才能购买，而且即使如此，技能斗篷也只能从该技能公认的顶尖高手那里购买。

english: recognised as the highest skilled in the land at any particular skill.
translation: 被公认为该技能的顶尖大师。

english: I have the privilege of being the person that controls access to the Skillcape of Attack, which Kamfreena will recognize and allow you to access her Cyclopes without the need for guild tokens.
translation: 我有幸担任攻击技能斗篷的管理员，只要穿上它，坎弗里娜就会认出你的身份，让你无需公会代币便直接进入独眼巨人区域。

english: Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 还有什么我可以帮你的吗？

english: Black Knight? Why are you here?
translation: 黑骑士？你为什么在这里？

english: Indeed I was, however their... methods... did not match with my ideals.. so I left. Harrallak, recognising my talent as a warrior, took me in and offered me a job here.
translation: 的确如此。然而，他们的……手段……与我的理想并不相符，所以我选择了离开。哈拉拉克看中了我作为战士的天赋，便收留了我，并在这里给了我一份差事。

english: Hmm... well if Harrallak trusts you, I guess I can.
translation: 嗯……好吧，如果哈拉拉克信任你，我想我也可以。

english: What's the Dummy Room all about?
translation: 那间假人训练室是做什么用的？

english: Ahh yes, the dummies. Another ingenious invention of the noble Dwarf Gamfred. They're mechanical you see and pop up out of the floor. You have to hit them with the correct attack mode before they disappear again.
translation: 啊，没错，那些假人。那是高贵的矮人甘弗雷德又一项精妙的发明。你看，它们是机械式的，会从地板下面冒出来。你必须在它们消失之前，用正确的攻击模式击中它们。

english: So how do I tell which one is which?
translation: 那我怎么区分它们呢？

english: There are two different ways. One indication is their colour, the other is the pose and weapons they are holding, for instance, the one holding daggers you will need to hit with a piercing attack.
translation: 有两种方法。一种是看颜色，另一种是看它们的姿势和持有的武器，比如拿匕首的那个你需要用穿刺攻击击中。

english: In the room you will find a poster on the wall which can help you recognise each different dummy.
translation: 房间里墙上有一张海报，可以帮你识别每种不同的假人。

english: That sounds ingenious!
translation: 听起来真巧妙！

english: Indeed, you may find that you need several weapons to be successful 100% of the time, but keep trying. The weapons shop upstairs may help you there.
translation: 的确如此。你可能会发现需要准备好几种武器才能百分之百成功，但请继续尝试。楼上的武器店可以帮到你。

english: May I claim my tokens please?
translation: 我可以领取我的代币吗？

english: Of course! Here you go, you've earned [amount] tokens!
translation: 当然！给你，你已经赚了 [amount] 个代币！

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！

english: I'm afraid you have not earned any tokens yet. Try some of the activities around the guild to earn some.
translation: 恐怕你还没赚到任何代币。试试公会里的各种活动来赚一些吧。

english: Ok, I'll go see what I can find.
translation: 好的，我去看看能找到什么。

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！

english: Farewell warrior. Stay away from the dark side.
translation: 后会有期，战友。千万别堕入黑暗。

english: Ah, but I can see you are already a master in the fine art of attacking, perhaps you have come to me to purchase a Cape of Attack, and thus join the elite few who have mastered this exacting skill?
translation: 啊，但我看出你已经是攻击艺术的大师了，想必你是来买攻击技能斗篷的？这样一来，你就能加入那些掌握了这项严苛技能的精英行列了。

english: When wearing this cape, Kamfreena will recognize your ability and allow you to access her Cyclopes without the need for guild tokens.
translation: 穿上这斗篷后，坎弗里娜会认可你的能力，让你无需公会代币便进入独眼巨人区域。

english: May I buy a Skillcape of Attack, please?
translation: 我可以买攻击技能斗篷吗？

english: Most certainly; unfortunately being such a prestigious item, they are appropriately expensive. I'm afraid I must ask you for the princely sum of 99000 gold!
translation: 当然可以，但作为如此名贵的物品，它们的价格自然也相当不菲。恐怕我得向你收取99,000金币的巨款！

english: 99000! Are you mad?
translation: 99,000金币！你疯了吗？

english: Not at all; there are many other adventurers who would love the opportunity to purchase such a prestigious item! You can find me here if you change your mind.
translation: 没关系，还有许多冒险者梦寐以求想买下这么名贵的物品呢！如果你改变主意了，随时可以来这里找我。

english: I would gladly pay such a paltry sum for a splendid cape.
translation: 我很乐意支付这点小钱买一顶华丽的斗篷。

english: But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: 但不幸的是，我身上没带够钱。

english: Well come back and see me when you do.
translation: 嗯，等你有钱了再来找我。

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 不幸的是，所有技能斗篷都附带免费兜帽，这是技能促销的一部分；买一送一，你懂的。所以你得先腾出一些物品栏空间我才能卖给你。

english: Excellent! Wear that cape with pride my friend.
translation: 太好了！自豪地戴上那斗篷吧，我的朋友。

english: May I have another hood for my cape, please?
translation: 我可以再要一个斗篷的兜帽吗？

english: Most certainly, and free of charge!
translation: 当然可以，而且免费！

english: Ajjat hands you another hood for your skillcape.
translation: 阿加特递给你另一个技能斗篷的兜帽。

english: Can you tell me about skillcapes, please?
translation: 你能和我说说技能斗篷的事吗？

english: Black Knight? Why are you here?
translation: 黑骑士？你为什么在这里？

english: What's the Dummy Room all about?
translation: 那间假人训练室是做什么用的？

english: May I claim my tokens please?
translation: 我可以领取我的代币吗？

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！

english: May I buy a Skillcape of Attack, please?
translation: 我可以买攻击技能斗篷吗？

english: 99000 gold! Are you mad?
translation: 99,000金币！你疯了吗？

english: I would gladly pay such a paltry sum for a splendid cape.
translation: 我很乐意支付这点小钱买一顶华丽的斗篷。

english: Skillcape
translation: 技能斗篷

english: Hood
translation: 兜帽

english: Thank you for the translation manual, Ak-Haranu - it may save many souls before long.
translation: 谢谢你给的翻译手册，阿克‧哈兰努——它之后可能会救了许多人。

english: And Ak-Haranu thanks you for kind gift of longbow.
translation: 阿克‧哈兰努也感谢你赠送的长弓。

english: Hi there!
translation: 你好啊！

english: Why, helloooo!
translation: 哎呀，你好啊！

english: A camel?
translation: 一只骆驼？

english: Well this is grand darling. How nice it is to make your acquaintance!
translation: 哎呀这可太棒了，亲爱的。能认识你真是太好了！

english: Thank you. Nice to meet you too.
translation: 谢谢，我也很高兴认识你。

english: Wait a minute. How am I talking to you without a Camulet?
translation: 等一下。我没有戴骆驼护符怎么跟你说话的？

english: My dear, I'm a camel, how should I know?
translation: 亲爱的，我是骆驼，我怎么会知道？

english: Hmmm. I suppose this spell must tap directly into your mind. So, there's no need for language to get in the way.
translation: 嗯……我想这个法术一定是直接接入你的思维。所以语言不会成为障碍。

english: I think I am somewhat confused.
translation: 我觉得我有点糊涂了。

english: May one ask how you contacted me?
translation: 能问一下你是怎么联系到我的吗？

english: I'm just using one of the Lunar spells.
translation: 我只是施展了一个月魔法。

english: Oh my, oh my. These youngsters today and their new-fangled gadgets!
translation: 哎呀呀，现在的年轻人啊，还有他们那些新奇的玩意儿！

english: Hello Effendi!
translation: 你好，先生！

english: I am Al Shabim, greetings on behalf of the Bedabin nomads.
translation: 我是阿尔‧沙比姆，代表贝达宾游牧民向你问好。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: I am Al Shabim Effendi! I am the leader of the Bedabin peoples!
translation: 我是阿尔‧沙比姆，贝达宾人民的领袖！

english: Okay Thanks!
translation: 好的，谢谢！

english: Good day Effendi!
translation: 你好！

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这里有什么可以做的？

english: Well, we are all very busy most of the time, tending to the pineapples. They are grown in a secret location, to stop thieves from raiding our most precious prize.
translation: 嗯，我们大部分时间都很忙，要照料菠萝。它们种在一个秘密地点，防止小偷来偷我们最珍贵的宝贝。

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: This is the home of the Bedabin. We're a peaceful tribe of desert dwellers. Some idiots call us 'Tenti's', a childish name borne of ignorance.
translation: 这里是贝达宾人的家园。我们是一个和平的沙漠居民部落。有些蠢货叫我们''帐篷人''，这是个出于无知的幼稚称呼。

english: We're renowned for surviving in the harshest desert climate. We also grow the 'Bedabin ambrosia.'... A pineapple of such delicious sumptiousness that it defies description.
translation: 我们因能在最恶劣的沙漠气候中生存而闻名。我们还种植''贝达宾仙果''……一种美味得无法形容的菠萝。

english: Take a look around our camp if you like!
translation: 如果你喜欢的话，在我们营地里随便看看！

english: Many thanks with your help previously Effendi!
translation: 非常感谢你之前的帮助！

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Okay thanks!
translation: 好的，谢谢！

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这里有什么可以做的？

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: Okay Thanks!
translation: 好的，谢谢！

english: I'm sorry to bother you, but could you spare me a little dung?
translation: 抱歉打扰你，但能给我一点粪便吗？

english: The camel didn't seem to appreciate that question.
translation: 骆驼似乎不太喜欢这个问题。

english: If I go near that camel, it'll probably bite my hand off.
translation: 如果我靠近那只骆驼，它可能会把我的手咬掉。

english: Mmm... looks like that camel would make a nice kebab.
translation: 嗯……看起来那只骆驼做成烤肉串会不错。

english: I wonder if that camel has fleas...
translation: 不知道那只骆驼有没有跳蚤……

english: Are you serious?
translation: 你是认真的吗？

english: Oh yes. If you'd be so kind...
translation: 哦是的。如果你能行个好……

english: The camel ponders for a moment...
translation: 骆驼思索了片刻……

english: I'm sorry, but I can't really help you right now. Perhaps you should ask me again later, or try a different camel.
translation: 抱歉，我现在真的帮不了你。也许你待会儿再来问我，或者试试别的骆驼。

english: Fair enough.
translation: 好吧。

english: Well, just you close your eyes first. I'm not doing it while you're watching me!
translation: 嗯，你先闭上眼睛。我可不想让你看着我这么做！

english: I hope that's what you wanted!
translation: 希望这就是你想要的！

english: Ohhh yes. Lovely.
translation: 哦是的。太好了。

english: Sorry, were you saying something to me?
translation: 抱歉，你刚才是在跟我说话吗？

english: No, er, nothing important.
translation: 不，呃，没什么重要的。

english: Never mind, it is unimportant when I have such important matters weighing on my soul.
translation: 没关系，当我心中有如此重要的事压着时，这就不重要了。

english: How important can a camel's problems be?
translation: 骆驼的问题能有多重要？

english: Well, you see, there is a camel called Elly. A beautiful, wondrous camel, with hide like spun gold and teeth that shine like an oasis.
translation: 嗯，你看，有只叫艾莉的骆驼。一只美丽奇妙的骆驼，皮毛如金丝织就，牙齿如绿洲般闪耀。

english: ...I see.
translation: ……我明白了。

english: I've written many poems describing her beauty. Would you like to hear one?
translation: 我写了很多诗来描述她的美。你想听一首吗？

english: It's all right, I'm...
translation: 没关系，我……

english: Shall I compare thee to a desert's day? Thou art drier and more rough-skinned.
translation: 我能否将你比作沙漠之日？你更干燥，皮肤更粗糙。

english: Rough sandstorms shake the cactuses away And summer's heat defers to autumn wind.
translation: 狂暴的沙暴摇落仙人掌，夏日炎热让位于秋风。

english: Look, I don't really have the time to...
translation: 听着，我真的没时间……

english: Sometimes too hot the eye of heaven shines, With Guthix' gold complexion often dimmed;
translation: 有时天堂之眼过于炽热，古斯的金色面容常被遮蔽；

english: And every fair from fair sometime declines, By chance or desert's changing course untrimmed...
translation: 每份美好终会从美好中凋零，因偶然或沙漠变迁而未加修饰……

english: Please, stop.
translation: 求你，停下。

english: But I've only got six lines left!
translation: 可我还有六行没念！

english: That's six too many. If I really want to hear your poetry, I'll tell you, okay?
translation: 那六行太多了。如果我真想听你的诗，我会告诉你的，好吗？

english: Very well. Come back and talk to me if you want to hear more.
translation: 好吧。如果你想听更多，再回来找我。

english: Oh, it's you again. Have you come back to listen to my poems?
translation: 哦，又是你。你回来听我的诗了吗？

english: I'd love to!
translation: 我很乐意！

english: That's so kind of you. Which one would you like to hear?
translation: 你真好。你想听哪一首？

english: 'Shall I compare thee to a desert's day' is my finest yet, but I've also composed others.
translation: 《我能否将你比作沙漠之日》是我最得意的作品，但我也写过其他的。

english: That's my favourite poem. Ahem...
translation: 那是我最喜欢的诗。咳咳……

english: But thine eternal desert shall not fade Nor lose possession of that sand thou owest;
translation: 但你永恒的沙漠不会消逝，也不会失去你所拥有的那片沙；

english: Nor Zamorak brag thou art in his shades, When in eternal lines to sand thou growest,
translation: 扎莫拉克也无法夸口你在他阴影之下，当你在永恒的诗行中化为沙土，

english: So long as camels breathe or eyes can see, So long lives this, and this gives life to thee.
translation: 只要骆驼还在呼吸，只要眼睛还能看见，这首诗就将长存，并赋予你生命。

english: Ah, Elly, how beautiful you are.
translation: 啊，艾莉，你是多么美丽。

english: What does Elly think of your poems?
translation: 艾莉觉得你的诗怎么样？

english: She's never heard them.
translation: 她从来没听过。

english: Why not?
translation: 为什么不？

english: I suspect she loves another - Ollie, another camel who roams with her to the north.
translation: 我怀疑她爱着另一个——奥利，另一只和她一起游荡到北方的骆驼。

english: So I shall stay here and compose poems for her.
translation: 所以我就留在这里为她写诗。

english: Why not tell her how you feel?
translation: 为什么不告诉她你的感受？

english: She seems happy enough as she is, and I have my poems to comfort me.
translation: 她看起来已经够开心了，而我有我的诗来安慰自己。

english: Well, best of luck with that.
translation: 嗯，祝你好运。

english: If you want to hear my poems once more, please come back again.
translation: 如果你想再听我的诗，请再回来。

english: I wrote this poem when I went to the oasis to nibble at a tree, then discovered I'd left nothing for Elly to nibble. I was distraught.
translation: 我写这首诗时，我去绿洲啃树，然后发现我没给艾莉留任何东西啃。我很难过。

english: This Is Just To Say
translation: 我只是想说

english: I have nibbled the cacti that were by the oasis,
translation: 我啃了绿洲旁的仙人掌，

english: and which you were probably saving for lunch.
translation: 而你可能正留着当午餐。

english: Forgive me, they were delicious, so crunchy and so cold.
translation: 原谅我，它们很美味，又脆又凉。

english: I wonder if she's forgiven me for eating her snack.
translation: 不知道她有没有原谅我吃了她的零食。

english: No, thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Ah, well. I shall return to writing poems to Elly's beauty.
translation: 啊，好吧。我要回去继续写赞美艾莉美貌的诗了。

english: Ask the camel about its dung.
translation: 找骆驼讨点粪便。

english: Say something unpleasant.
translation: 说些不愉快的话。

english: Neither - I'm a polite person.
translation: 都不——我是个有礼貌的人。

english: I'd love to!
translation: 我很乐意！

english: Listen to 'Shall I compare thee to a desert's day'.
translation: 听《我能否将你比作沙漠之日》。

english: Why not tell her how you feel?
translation: 为什么不告诉她你的感受？

english: Well, best of luck with that.
translation: 嗯，祝你好运。

english: Listen to 'This Is Just To Say'.
translation: 听《我只是想说》。

english: No, thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Would you look after my crops for me?
translation: 你能帮我照看庄稼吗？

english: I might - which patch were you thinking of?
translation: 也许吧——你想的是哪块地？

english: You don't have any seeds planted in that patch. Plant some and I might agree to look after it for you.
translation: 那块地里还没播种。你先种点什么，我才可能考虑帮你照管。

english: That patch is diseased - you should cure it before asking me to be responsible for it!
translation: 那块种植地的作物染病了——你先治好再让我管！

english: That patch is dead - it's too late for me to do anything about it now.
translation: 那块种植地的作物已经枯死了——现在我也无能为力了。

english: That patch is already fully grown! I don't know what you want me to do with it!
translation: 那块种植地的作物已经完全成熟了！我不知道你还想让我做什么！

english: I'm already looking after that patch for you.
translation: 我已经在帮你照看那块种植地了。

english: If you like, but I want [payment] for that.
translation: 可以，但我想要[payment]。

english: I'm afraid I don't have any of those at the moment.
translation: 恐怕我现在没有那些东西。

english: Well, I'm not wasting my time for free.
translation: 嗯，我可不会白白浪费时间。

english: Okay, it's a deal.
translation: 好的，成交。

english: [That'll do nicely, sir/That'll do nicely, madam/That'll do nicely]. Leave it with me - I'll make sure that patch grows for you.
translation: [That'll do nicely, sir/That'll do nicely, madam/That'll do nicely]。交给我吧——我会确保那块种植地的作物好好生长。

english: No, that's too much.
translation: 不，那太多了。

english: Poison ivy bushes don't get diseased, so you needn't worry about having it protected.
translation: 毒藤灌木不会生病，所以你不用担心要保护它。

english: Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: 你能给我一些农业建议吗？

english: You can put up to ten potatoes, cabbages or onions in vegetable sacks, although you can't have a mix in the same sack.
translation: 蔬菜袋里最多能装十个土豆、卷心菜或者洋葱，不过一袋里可不能混着装。

english: You can put up to five tomatoes, strawberries, apples, bananas or oranges into a fruit basket, although you can't have a mix in the same basket.
translation: 你可以在水果篮里放最多五个番茄、草莓、苹果、香蕉或橙子，但不能在同一篮里混装。

english: You can buy all the farming tools from farming shops, which can be found close to the allotments.
translation: 你可以在农业商店买到所有农具，这些商店就在农田附近。

english: You can fill plantpots with soil from any empty patch, if you have a gardening trowel.
translation: 如果你有园艺铲，可以用任何空地的土壤填满花盆。

english: Tree seeds must be grown in a plantpot of soil into a sapling, and then transferred to a tree patch to continue growing to adulthood.
translation: 树木种子得先在装土的花盆里养成树苗，再移栽到树木种植地，才能继续长成大树。

english: If you want to make your own sacks and baskets you'll need to use the loom that's near the Farming shop in Falador. If you're a good enough [craftswoman/craftsman], that is.
translation: 如果你想自己做袋子和篮子，你需要用法拉多城农业商店附近的织布机。前提是你得是个足够好的[craftswoman/craftsman]。

english: You don't have to buy all your plantpots you know, you can make them yourself on a pottery wheel. If you're a good enough [craftswoman/craftsman], that is.
translation: 你知道吗，你不必买所有花盆，你可以在陶轮上自己做。前提是你得是个足够好的[craftswoman/craftsman]。

english: Don't just throw away your weeds after you've raked a patch - put them in a compost bin and make some compost.
translation: 耙完地后别直接把杂草扔掉——把它们放进堆肥箱里做堆肥。

english: Applying compost to a patch will not only reduce the chance that your crops will get diseased, but you will also grow more crops to harvest.
translation: 给地里上点堆肥，不仅能防病害，产量也会更高。

english: Supercompost is far better than normal compost, but more expensive to make. You need to rot the right type of item; show me an item, and I'll tell you if it's super- compostable or not.
translation: 超级堆肥比普通堆肥强多了，但做起来也更费事。你得用对东西才能堆出来——拿件物品给我看看，我告诉你它能不能做成超级堆肥。

english: Vegetables, hops and flowers need constant watering - if you ignore my advice, you will sooner or later find yourself in possession of a dead farming patch.
translation: 蔬菜、啤酒花和花卉需要经常浇水。如果不听劝，你这块地迟早得荒废。

english: The only way to cure a bush or tree of disease is to prune away the diseased leaves with a pair of secateurs. For all other crops I would just apply some plant-cure.
translation: 灌木或树木要是生了病，只能用修枝剪修掉病枝。至于其他作物，洒点植物治疗药水就行。

english: There are five other Farming areas like this one - Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Kragen's area near Ardougne, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius and Oswallt's area
translation: 还有五个像这样的农业区——埃尔斯坦在法拉多城附近的区域，丹塔拉在凯瑟比镇镇附近的区域，克拉根在阿多尼城附近的区域，莱拉在莫利塔尼亚的区域，马利西在霍西迪乌斯城的区域，

english: in Prifddinas.
translation: 以及奥斯瓦尔特在普里夫迪纳斯城的区域。

english: If you want to grow fruit trees you could try a few places: Catherby, Brimhaven, Gnome Stronghold and the Farming Guild all have fruit tree patches.
translation: 如果你想种果树，可以试试这几个地方：凯瑟比镇镇、布尔哈文镇、地精要塞和农业公会都有果树种植地。

english: Hops are good for brewing ales. I believe there's a brewery up in Keldagrim somewhere, and I've heard rumours that a place called Phasmatys used to be good for that type of thing. 'Fore they all died, of course.
translation: 啤酒花适合酿造麦酒。我相信凯尔达格林城某处有个酿酒厂，我还听说一个叫法斯玛提斯的地方以前也酿造这种酒。当然那是在他们都死光之前的事了。

english: Bittercap mushrooms can only be grown in a special patch in Morytania, near the Mort Myre swamp. There the ground is especially dank and suited to growing poisonous fungii.
translation: 苦帽菇只能种在莫利塔尼亚、莫特迈耶沼泽附近的特殊种植地里。那里阴暗潮湿，适合毒蘑菇生长。

english: There is a special patch for growing Belladonna - I believe that it is somewhere near Draynor Manor, where the ground is a tad 'unblessed'.
translation: 颠茄有专门的种植地——我记得是在德雷诺庄园附近，那地方的土嘛，有点''不受祝福''。

english: Greetings, adventurer. Welcome to the Myths' Guild.
translation: 你好，冒险者。欢迎来到神话公会。

english: Tell me about the guild.
translation: 跟我讲讲公会吧。

english: The Myths' Guild is home to those who wish to uncover the lost secrets of this world. We investigate the myths of these lands to see if any facts may be hidden within them.
translation: 神话公会是为那些希望揭开世界失落秘密之人所建。我们调查这片土地上的神话，看看其中是否隐藏着任何事实。

english: Here, we discover things that others only dream of. However, the cost of entry is not insignificant. Only the most worthy may share in our secrets.
translation: 在这里，我们发现别人只能梦想的东西。然而，入门代价不菲。只有有资格的人才能分享我们的秘密。

english: Am I worthy?
translation: 我有资格吗？

english: Not yet. However, that could well change.
translation: 还不行。但这很可能会改变。

english: For as long as history remembers, dragons have roamed these lands, but despite how long they've been here, much of their history remains hidden.
translation: 自有历史记载以来，龙就一直在这片土地上出没，但尽管它们在此已久，它们的大部分历史仍不为人知。

english: There are tales of course, but tales are not enough for us. We want you to discover the truth. Where did the dragons come from? Why are they here? Who do they serve?
translation: 当然有传说，但传说对我们来说不够。我们希望你发现真相。龙从哪里来？它们为什么在这里？它们效忠于谁？

english: Answer these questions for us. Help us fill our Library of Knowledge. In return, we will grant you access to the guild and you will reap the rewards within.
translation: 帮我们解答这些问题。帮助我们充实知识图书馆。作为回报，我们将让你进入公会，你将获得其中的奖励。

english: So, do you feel up for the challenge?
translation: 那么，你敢接受这个挑战吗？

english: Yes. Where should I begin?
translation: 是的。我该从哪里开始？

english: Head to Karamja Wines, Spirits, and Beers at Musa Point. There you'll find Dallas Jones. We've heard that he is investigating the destruction of Crandor. This seems like a good place to start.
translation: 前往穆萨角的卡拉姆詹葡萄酒、烈酒和啤酒店。在那里你会找到达拉斯‧琼斯。我们听说他正在调查克兰多岛的毁灭。这似乎是个好的起点。

english: Good luck.
translation: 祝你好运。

english: No. This is too much for me.
translation: 这对我来说太多了。

english: As you wish. If you change your mind, you know where we are.
translation: 随你便。如果你改变主意，你知道我们在哪儿。

english: Absolutely. You've proven your worth to the guild and may enter whenever you please.
translation: 当然，你已经向公会证明了你的价值，可以随时进入。

english: How can I gain access to the guild?
translation: 我怎样才能进入公会？

english: Only the most worthy are allowed access into the Myths' Guild. If you wish to enter, you'll need to prove yourself.
translation: 只有最值得的人才被允许进入神话公会。如果你想进入，你需要证明自己。

english: How can I do that?
translation: 我该怎么证明？

english: As time passes, that which was once fact, becomes myth. Some tales are just that, tales. However, some tales are something more.
translation: 随着时间流逝，曾经的事实会变成神话。有些传说只是传说。然而，有些传说则不止于此。

english: Here at the Myths' Guild, we live to tell the difference between the two. If you wish to join us, you must do the same.
translation: 在神话公会，我们致力于分辨两者的区别。如果你想加入我们，你也必须这样做。

english: So what myth would you like me to investigate?
translation: 那么你想让我调查什么神话？

english: Let's talk about my quest.
translation: 谈谈我的任务吧。

english: How are things progressing?
translation: 进展如何？

english: I'm yet to discover anything.
translation: 我还没发现什么。

english: Well return to us once you do. If you help us fill our Library of Knowledge, we shall grant you access to the guild.
translation: 那你发现后再回来找我们。如果你帮助我们充实知识图书馆，我们将授予你进入公会的权限。

english: I'm investigating the origin of Elvarg. I've found some old doors on a ruined island but they're locked. I'm trying to find the key.
translation: 我正在调查艾尔瓦格的起源。我在一个废墟岛上发现了一些旧门，但它们锁着。我正在找钥匙。

english: When we do, you should return here. We may well have a place for you.
translation: 到时候你应该回来。我们很可能会有你的位置。

english: How can I gain access to the Guild?
translation: 我怎样才能进入公会？

english: Only the most worthy may access our Guild and I'm afraid you are not quite there yet. Go out and hone your skills then return to us.
translation: 只有最值得的人才能进入我们的公会，恐怕你还不够格。出去磨练你的技能，然后回来找我们。

english: You do not meet all the requirements to start the Dragon Slayer II quest.
translation: 你不满足开始屠龙者 II 任务的所有要求。

english: Only the most worthy are allowed access into the Myths' Guild. If you want entry, you'll need to prove yourself.
translation: 只有最值得的人才被允许进入神话公会。如果你想进入，你需要证明自己。

english: Well return to us once you do. If you help us fill our Library of Knowledge, we shall grant you access to the Guild.
translation: 那你做到后再回来找我们。如果你帮助我们充实知识图书馆，我们将授予你进入公会的权限。

english: Farewell adventurer.
translation: 再会，冒险者。

english: Tell me about the guild.
translation: 跟我讲讲公会吧。

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: How can I gain access to the guild?
translation: 我怎样才能进入公会？

english: Let's talk about my quest.
translation: 谈谈我的任务吧。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Tell me about the Guild.
translation: 跟我讲讲公会吧。

english: How can I gain access to the Guild?
translation: 我怎样才能进入公会？

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Hello, hello, and a most warm welcome to my Hunter Emporium. We have everything the discerning Hunter could need.
translation: 你好，欢迎光临我的猎人商店。本店备有有品位的猎人需要的一切。

english: Would you like me to show you our range of equipment? Or was there something specific you were after?
translation: 你想让我给你看看我们的各类装备吗？还是你有什么特别想要的？

english: Ok, let's see what you've got!
translation: 好的，让我看看你有什么！

english: I'm not interested, thanks.
translation: 我没兴趣，谢谢。

english: Well, if you do ever find yourself in need of the finest Hunter equipment available, then you know where to come.
translation: 嗯，如果你真的需要最好的猎人装备，那你知道该去哪儿。

english: Who's that guy over there?
translation: 那边那个人是谁？

english: Him? I think he might be crazy. Either that or he's seeking attention.
translation: 他？我觉得他可能疯了。要么就是在吸引注意。

english: He keeps trying to sell me these barmy looking weapons he's invented. I can't see them working, personally.
translation: 他一直想推销他发明的那些古怪奇特的武器。我个人不觉得它们能有用。

english: Ok, let's see what you've got!
translation: 好的，让我看看你有什么！

english: I'm not interested, thanks.
translation: 我没兴趣，谢谢。

english: Who's that guy over there?
translation: 那边那个人是谁？

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: [Vampyre name].
translation: [吸血鬼名字]。

english: Not the one I'm expecting. Move along.
translation: 不是我在等的那个。走开。

english: Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: 人类！在我叫守卫之前滚回奴隶栏去！

english: I can't believe we've finally arrived, I can't wait to explore!
translation: 我真不敢相信我们终于到了，我迫不及待想探索！

english: So much to see, I don't know where to start!
translation: 太多东西可看了，我不知道从哪里开始！

english: A whole new continent to explore... what a time to be
translation: 一个全新的大陆等待探索……这是多么好的时代。

english: Are you the tour guide?
translation: 你是导游吗？

english: Nope, I'm just as lost as you.
translation: 不，我和你一样迷路。

english: I overheard someone mention there are pirates and thieves here, be careful!
translation: 我无意中听到有人说这里有海盗和小偷，小心点！

english: Would you look after my crops for me?
translation: 你能帮我照看庄稼吗？

english: You don't have a sapling planted in that patch. Plant one and I might agree to look after it for you.
translation: 那块种植地里没种树苗，你先种点什么，我才可能考虑帮你照管。

english: If you like, but I want 6 dragonfruit for that.
translation: 可以，但我要6个火龙果作为报酬。

english: Okay, it's a deal.
translation: 好的，成交。

english: That'll do nicely, sir. Leave it with me - I'll make sure that patch grows for you.
translation: 没问题，交给我吧——我会帮你照看好这块种植地的。

english: No, that's too much.
translation: 不，那太多了。

english: Well, I'm not wasting my time for free.
translation: 嗯，我可不会白白浪费时间。

english: I'm afraid I don't have any of those at the moment.
translation: 恐怕我现在没有那些东西。

english: That patch is already fully grown! I don't know what you want me to do with it!
translation: 那块种植地的作物已经完全成熟了！我不知道你还想让我做什么！

english: These take ages to clear! If you pay me 2000 Coins I'll chop it down for you.
translation: 这些清理起来要花很长时间！如果你给我2,000枚金币，我可以帮你砍掉它。

english: Here's 2000 Coins - chop my tree down please.
translation: 这是2,000枚金币——请帮我把树砍掉。

english: Alexandra sets to work...
translation: 亚历山德拉开始工作……

english: I don't want to pay that much, sorry.
translation: 我不想付那么多钱，抱歉。

english: I don't have 2000 Coins I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕我没有2,000枚金币。

english: Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: 你能给我一些农业建议吗？

english: You can put up to five tomatoes, strawberries, apples, bananas or oranges into a fruit basket, although you can't have a mix in the same basket.
translation: 你可以在水果篮里放最多五个番茄、草莓、苹果、香蕉或橙子，但不能在同一篮里混装。

english: There are seven main Farming areas - Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Kragen's area near Ardougne, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius, Alan's area in the Farming Guild and
translation: 有七个主要农业区——埃尔斯坦在法拉多城附近的区域，丹塔拉在凯瑟比镇镇附近的区域，克拉根在阿多尼城附近的区域，莱拉在莫利塔尼亚的区域，马利西在霍西迪乌斯城的区域，艾伦在农业公会的区域，以及

english: Oswallt's area in Prifddinas.
translation: 奥斯瓦尔特在普里夫迪纳斯城的区域。

english: Supercompost is far better than normal compost, but more expensive to make. You need to rot the right type of item; show me an item, and I'll tell you if it's super- compostable or not.
translation: 超级堆肥比普通堆肥强多了，但做起来也更费事。你得用对东西才能堆出来——拿件物品给我看看，我告诉你它能不能做成超级堆肥。

english: Vegetables, hops and flowers need constant watering - if you ignore my advice, you will sooner or later find yourself in possession of a dead farming patch.
translation: 蔬菜、啤酒花和花卉需要经常浇水。如果不听劝，你这块地迟早得荒废。

english: There is a special patch for growing Belladonna - I believe that it is somewhere near Draynor Manor, where the ground is a tad 'unblessed'.
translation: 颠茄有专门的种植地——我记得是在德雷诺庄园附近，那地方的土嘛，有点''不受祝福''。

english: Hops are good for brewing ales. I believe there's a brewery up in Keldagrim somewhere, and I've heard rumours that a place called Phasmatys used to be good for that type of thing. 'Fore they all died, of course.
translation: 啤酒花适合酿造麦酒。我相信凯尔达格林城某处有个酿酒厂，我还听说一个叫法斯玛提斯的地方以前也酿造这种酒。当然那是在他们都死光之前的事了。

english: Bittercap mushrooms can only be grown in a special patch in Morytania, near the Mort Myre swamp. There the ground is especially dank and suited to growing poisonous fungii.
translation: 苦帽菇只能种在莫利塔尼亚、莫特迈耶沼泽附近的特殊种植地里。那里阴暗潮湿，适合毒蘑菇生长。

english: You can buy all the farming tools from farming shops, which can be found close to the allotments.
translation: 你可以在农业商店买到所有农具，这些商店就在农田附近。

english: Tree seeds must be grown in a plantpot of soil into a sapling, and then transferred to a tree patch to continue growing to adulthood.
translation: 树木种子得先在装土的花盆里养成树苗，再移栽到树木种植地，才能继续长成大树。

english: The only way to cure a bush or tree of disease is to prune away the diseased leaves with a pair of secateurs. For all other crops I would just apply some plant-cure.
translation: 灌木或树木要是生了病，只能用修枝剪修掉病枝。至于其他作物，洒点植物治疗药水就行。

english: You can fill plantpots with soil from any empty patch, if you have a gardening trowel.
translation: 如果你有园艺铲，可以用任何空地的土壤填满花盆。

english: If you need to be rid of your fruit trees for any reason, all you have to do is chop them down and then dig up the stump.
translation: 如果你因任何原因需要移除果树，只需砍倒它们然后挖掉树桩即可。

english: Don't just throw away your weeds after you've raked a patch - put them in a compost bin and make some compost.
translation: 耙完地后别直接把杂草扔掉——把它们放进堆肥箱里做堆肥。

english: Applying compost to a patch will not only reduce the chance that your crops will get diseased, but you will also grow more crops to harvest.
translation: 给地里上点堆肥，不仅能防病害，产量也会更高。

english: If you want to make your own sacks and baskets you'll need to use the loom that's near the Farming shop in Falador. If you're a good enough craftsman, that is.
translation: 如果你想自己做袋子和篮子，你需要用法拉多城农业商店附近的织布机。前提是你得是个足够好的工匠。

english: You don't have to buy all your plantpots you know, you can make them yourself on a pottery wheel. If you're a good enough craftsman, that is.
translation: 你知道吗，你不必买所有花盆，你可以在陶轮上自己做。前提是你得是个足够好的工匠。

english: You can put up to ten potatoes, cabbages or onions in vegetable sacks, although you can't have a mix in the same sack.
translation: 蔬菜袋里最多能装十个土豆、卷心菜或者洋葱，不过一袋里可不能混着装。

english: Can you sell me something?
translation: 你能卖我点东西吗？

english: That depends on whether I have it to sell. What is it that you're looking for?
translation: 那得看我有没有卖的。你在找什么？

english: I'll come back another time.
translation: 我改天再来。

english: I want 6 dragonfruit for that.
translation: 我要6个火龙果作为报酬。

english: I'm already looking after that patch for you.
translation: 我已经在帮你照看那块种植地了。

english: I'll want 2000 Coins to chop down your redwood. These take ages!
translation: 砍你的红杉树我要2,000枚金币。这些要花很长时间！

english: Would you look after my crops for me?
translation: 你能帮我照看庄稼吗？

english: Okay, it's a deal.
translation: 好的，成交。

english: No, that's too much.
translation: 不，那太多了。

english: Okay, it's a deal and don't ask again.
translation: 好的，成交，别再问了。

english: Would you chop my redwood tree down for me?
translation: 你能帮我把红杉树砍掉吗？

english: Here's 2000 Coins - chop my tree down please.
translation: 这是2,000枚金币——请帮我把树砍掉。

english: I don't want to pay that much, sorry.
translation: 我不想付那么多钱，抱歉。

english: Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: 你能给我一些农业建议吗？

english: Can you sell me something?
translation: 你能卖我点东西吗？

english: I'll come back another time.
translation: 我改天再来。

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: 如果我和你一样丑，我都不敢在公共场合露面！

english: Out of my way, punk.
translation: 滚开，小混混。

english: Hmm... you smell strange...
translation: 嗯……你闻起来很奇怪……

english: Strange how?
translation: 怎么奇怪？

english: Like a human!
translation: 像人类！

english: Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: 哦！呃……因为我刚吃了一个！

english: Leave me alone.
translation: 别烦我。

english: Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: 如果你珍惜生命就别再跟我说话！

english: Get lost!
translation: 滚开！

english: I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: 我没什么可给你的，所以别烦我，乞丐。

english: Have you no manners?
translation: 你没有礼貌吗？

english: I don't have time for this right now.
translation: 我现在没空。

english: I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: 我没兴趣和你这样可怜的肉袋说话。

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
translation: 我打赌你的爪子很漂亮。

english: A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: 真是悲惨的一天啊……趁还能享受就享受吧。

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: 你要是抓到谁，答应分我一口。

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
translation: 我以前没在这里闻到过你……

english: You smell familiar...
translation: 你闻起来很熟悉……

english: Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: 附近瞧见人类了吗？我可饿——坏——了。

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: 你看起来也是个嗜血之人。

english: Good day to you, my friend.
translation: 你好，我的朋友。

english: Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
translation: 想去城堡吃点零食吗？

english: Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
translation: 等一下，我牙缝里卡了点人肉渣……

english: Welcome to the Shrimp and Parrot. Would you like to order, madam?
translation: 欢迎来到虾与鹦鹉酒馆，你要点餐吗？

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Where do you get your Karambwan from?
translation: 你们的卡拉姆班鱼从哪儿来的？

english: We buy directly off Lubufu, a local fisherman. He seems to have a monopoly over Karambwan sale.
translation: 我们直接从当地渔夫卢布富那儿进货。卡拉姆班鱼的生意好像全被他垄断了。

english: Where can I find Lubufu?
translation: 我在哪儿能找到卢布富？

english: He is usually working just to the south of the town.
translation: 他通常在城镇南边工作。

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

english: How does he manage a monopoly?
translation: 他是怎么做到垄断的？

english: Simple - nobody else knows how to catch Karambwan. It is a closely guarded secret.
translation: 很简单——没人知道怎么抓卡拉姆班鱼，这可是个不传之秘。

english: Hey! You can't go through there! That's private property!
translation: 嘿！你不能从那儿过！那是私人财产！

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Where do you get your Karambwan from?
translation: 你们的卡拉姆班鱼从哪儿来的？

english: Where can I find Lubufu?
translation: 我在哪儿能找到卢布富？

english: How does he manage a monopoly?
translation: 他是怎么做到垄断的？

english: Hello, my friend. Have a look at my wares.
translation: 你好，我的朋友。看看我的商品吧。

english: No, I'm really too busy.
translation: 不，我真的太忙了。

english: Hello [player name]. How's the adventuring going?
translation: 你好[player name]。冒险进展如何？

english: Hi Ali. Not bad. How are you?
translation: 嗨，阿里。还不错。你呢？

english: Still selling.
translation: 还在做生意。

english: Hang on a second while I get my stock of blackjacks out.
translation: 等一下，我把我的短棍拿出来。

english: Hang on a second while I get the garments.
translation: 等一下，我把衣服拿出来。

english: Hang on a second.
translation: 等一下。

english: Well at the moment I don't exactly have a selection of runes.
translation: 嗯，目前我还没有符石存货。

english: You don't?
translation: 你没有？

english: Those boxes from your friend Aubury have a very odd locking mechanism.
translation: 你朋友奥布里的那些箱子有很奇怪的锁定机制。

english: You have managed to get them off?
translation: 你成功把它们打开了？

english: Not exactly.
translation: 不完全是。

english: What do you mean by 'not exactly'?
translation: 你说的''不完全是''是什么意思？

english: What I mean by 'not exactly' is 'no, I haven't managed to get the lock off'.
translation: 我说的''不完全是''意思是''不，我没成功打开锁''。

english: Oh.
translation: 哦。

english: I was kind of hoping that you would have a look at them. There are two distinctive types of caskets one with a simple locking mechanism and another, which ummm... looks a little tricky to say the least.
translation: 我本来希望你能看看它们。有两种不同的箱子，一种锁定机制简单，另一种……嗯……至少可以说有点棘手。

english: I think I'll have a go at opening a small casket of runes.
translation: 我想试试打开一个小符石箱。

english: Your arms tire from the exertions of trying to open the casket...
translation: 你的手臂因试图打开箱子而感到疲惫……

english: You fail to open the chest.
translation: 你没能打开箱子。

english: You fail to pick the lock - your fingers get numb from fumbling with the lock.
translation: 你没能撬开锁——你的手指因摆弄锁而麻木。

english: I'm feeling lucky, let's have a look at opening one of those large caskets.
translation: 我今天运气不错，试试打开一个大箱子吧。

english: Hmmm... This lock looks like it may be impossible to prise open.
translation: 嗯……这把锁看起来可能撬不开。

english: Hmmm... This lock looks like it may be impossible to pick open.
translation: 嗯……这把锁看起来可能撬不开。

english: On second thoughts I don't really need any runes.
translation: 再想想，我其实不需要符石。

english: I hear you're planning to expand your business here...
translation: 我听说你打算在这里扩展生意……

english: Of course, my friend. Any good salesman ought to take the opportunities that present themselves.
translation: 当然，我的朋友。任何好商人都应该抓住出现的机会。

english: But your men are threatening the other shopkeepers!
translation: 但你的手下在威胁其他店主！

english: That is regrettable, I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕那很遗憾。

english: And the gnomes don't sound very happy about your magic carpet business.
translation: 而且地精们对你的魔毯生意似乎不太高兴。

english: A good businessman looks for all the opportunities he can.
translation: 好商人会寻找所有可能的机会。

english: Aren't you going to do anything about your men?
translation: 你不打算管管你的手下吗？

english: Well, these associates of my nephew can be somewhat... overenthusiastic.
translation: 嗯，我侄子的这些合伙人可能有点……过于热情。

english: I'm sure they'll settle down soon.
translation: 我相信他们很快就会安分下来。

english: But they're threatening to hurt the shopkeepers if they don't cooperate!
translation: 但他们威胁说如果店主不合作就要伤害他们！

english: Well, there's a simple solution there, don't you agree?
translation: 嗯，那儿有个简单的解决方案，你同意吗？

english: Are you planning to take over all of Al Kharid's shops?
translation: 你打算接管阿尔卡里德城的所有商店吗？

english: It's a step in the right direction.
translation: 这是朝正确方向迈出的一步。

english: Now, would you like to have a look at my wares?
translation: 现在，你想看看我的商品吗？

english: Okay.
translation: 好的。

english: What will you do about the gnomes?
translation: 你打算怎么对付地精？

english: They can continue running their gliders into trees, and I'll keep my business going. Sooner or later it'll all work out in my favour.
translation: 他们可以继续把滑翔机撞到树上，我会继续我的生意。迟早一切都会对我有利。

english: I suppose so...
translation: 我想也是……

english: Anyway, before you go, take a look at my wares.
translation: 不管怎样，在你走之前，看看我的商品吧。

english: Well, good luck with your business.
translation: 嗯，祝你生意兴隆。

english: Before you go, have a look at my wares.
translation: 在你走之前，看看我的商品吧。

english: Hi! I have this money off voucher!
translation: 嗨！我有这张折扣券！

english: Oh! Unfortunately it seems to have expired yesterday!
translation: 哦！不幸的是它似乎昨天就过期了！

english: But I only just got it from Ali the Leaflet dropper!
translation: 但我刚从发传单的阿里那儿拿到！

english: I'm sorry, there's nothing I can do.
translation: 抱歉，我无能为力。

english: But you're the one that had them printed!
translation: 但印刷这些的人就是你！

english: Look, I had those printed to win over the local traders. They weren't too pleased with the money off voucher, but I promised them I would repay their losses.
translation: 听着，我印那些是为了赢得当地商人的支持。他们对折扣券不太满意，但我答应会补偿他们的损失。

english: So that would be why they're all out of date then?
translation: 所以这就是它们都过期的原因？

english: I don't know what you mean...
translation: 我不知道你在说什么……

english: Anyway, it would be a shame for you to leave without looking at my wares.
translation: 不管怎样，你不看看我的商品就走就太可惜了。

english: No, I'm really too busy.
translation: 不，我真的太忙了。

english: Okay.
translation: 好的。

english: I would like to have a look at your selection of blackjacks.
translation: 我想看看你的短棍。

english: I would like to have a look at your selection of clothes.
translation: 我想看看你的衣服。

english: I would like to have a look at your selection of runes.
translation: 我想看看你的符石。

english: Try opening a small casket of runes
translation: 试试打开一个小符石箱

english: Force box.
translation: 暴力破箱。

english: Buy all the runes for [amount].
translation: 以 [amount] 购买所有符石。

english: Find out what the runes are.
translation: 鉴定符石。

english: Pick lock.
translation: 撬锁。

english: Examine lock.
translation: 检查锁。

english: Try opening a large casket of runes
translation: 试试打开一个大符石箱。

english: On second thoughts I don't really need any runes.
translation: 再想想，我其实不需要符石。

english: I would like to have a look at your general stock.
translation: 我想看看你的普通商品。

english: I hear you're planning to expand your business here...
translation: 我听说你打算在这里扩展生意……

english: Aren't you going to do anything about your men?
translation: 你不打算管管你的手下吗？

english: But they're threatening to hurt the shopkeepers if they don't cooperate!
translation: 但他们威胁说如果店主不合作就要伤害他们！

english: Well, good luck with your business.
translation: 嗯，祝你生意兴隆。

english: What will you do about the gnomes?
translation: 你打算怎么对付地精？

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Good day. Can I help you with anything?
translation: 你好。有什么能帮你的吗？

english: Yes, I'd like a drink please.
translation: 是的，我想要一杯酒。

english: What's going on in town?
translation: 城里有什么事？

english: Nothing much really. About what you'd expect from a sleepy little town like ours.
translation: 没什么大事。就像你对我们这样安静小镇的期望一样。

english: What about those two gangs? That seems exciting.
translation: 那两个帮派怎么样？那似乎很刺激。

english: They're paying customers, so I won't rock the boat if you don't mind.
translation: 他们可是给过钱的。只要你不介意，我也没必要自找麻烦。

english: Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 还有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: No thanks, I'm ok. Thanks for your time.
translation: 不了，我没事。谢谢你。

english: I'm looking for Traitorous Ali.
translation: 我在找叛徒阿里。

english: He was just here! Look, he's even left his drink on the table by those barrels. Must have nipped out to go to the toilet.
translation: 他刚才还在这里！看，他的酒还放在那些桶旁边的桌子上。肯定是出去上厕所了。

english: He might be gone a while though. The nearest outhouse is all the way over on Fossil Island.
translation: 不过他可能要去一会儿。最近的厕所在化石岛那边。

english: I'm looking for Ali from Pollnivneach.
translation: 我在找波尼尼镇的阿里。

english: Well, I'm called Ali and I'm from here. Are you looking for me?
translation: 嗯，我叫阿里，我是这里的。你在找我吗？

english: Do you have an uncle called Ali?
translation: 你有叫阿里的叔叔吗？

english: Yes! All my uncles are called Ali!
translation: 有！我所有叔叔都叫阿里！

english: Oh dear. Well do any of your uncles have a stall in the Bazaar in Al Kharid?
translation: 哦天哪。那你的叔叔们有在阿尔卡里德城集市摆摊的吗？

english: Um... no.
translation: 嗯……没有。

english: Well do you know if anyone here does?
translation: 那你知道这里有人有吗？

english: That's a difficult question to answer. I don't know anyone else's uncles.
translation: 这问题很难回答。我不认识别人的叔叔。

english: The 'Asp and Snake'? What a strange name for a bar.
translation: '毒蛇''？这酒吧名字真奇怪。

english: Maybe around these parts. Were you expecting it to have 'Ali' in the name?
translation: 也许这附近吧。你期望名字里有''阿里''吗？

english: I did think about calling it 'Ali's', but then it'd get confused with the Camel Shop, the Kebab House, the Mayor's residence...
translation: 我确实想过叫它''阿里酒馆''，但那会和骆驼店、烤肉店、市长住所混淆……

english: Yes, I get your point. It's a perfectly fine name.
translation: 是的，我明白你的意思。这名字挺好的。

english: Yes, I'd like a drink please.
translation: 是的，我想要一杯酒。

english: What's going on in town?
translation: 城里有什么事？

english: No thanks, I'm ok.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我没事。

english: Yes, I'd like to talk about something else.
translation: 是的，我想聊点别的。

english: I'm looking for Traitorous Ali.
translation: 我在找叛徒阿里。

english: I'm looking for Ali from Pollnivneach.
translation: 我在找波尼尼镇的阿里。

english: The 'Asp and Snake'? What a strange name for a bar.
translation: '毒蛇''？这酒吧名字真奇怪。

english: That beast would probably bite my fingers off if I tried to pet it.
translation: 如果我试图摸它，那野兽可能会咬掉我的手指。

english: If you want me to bite your fingers off, you're going the right way about it!
translation: 如果你想让我咬掉你的手指，你走对路了！

english: I'm not going to pet that! It will probably bite my hand off, that filthy beast.
translation: 我才不摸它！那肮脏的野兽可能会咬掉我的手。

english: Watch who you're calling a filthy beast, human.
translation: 注意你在叫谁肮脏的野兽，人类。

english: Mmmm... you'd make a tasty kebab.
translation: 嗯……你会做成美味的烤肉串。

english: And you'd make an excellent spit bucket! Pchoo!
translation: 你倒是能当个上好的痰盂！呸！

english: I'm not going to pet that nasty creature! I might get fleas... or worse!
translation: 我才不摸那讨厌的生物！我可能会染上跳蚤……或者更糟！

english: You're fairly nasty yourself, human. When was the last time you took a shower?
translation: 你自己也相当讨厌，人类。你上次洗澡是什么时候？

english: Welcome to my discount camel store. Can I help you with anything?
translation: 欢迎来到我的折扣骆驼店。有什么能帮你的吗？

english: A discount camel store?
translation: 折扣骆驼店？

english: Yes - it's my great idea - selling camels at discounted prices so that the common man can experience the joys of owning a camel of their very own! They're not just a source of kebab meat you know!
translation: 是的——这是我的好主意——以折扣价出售骆驼，让普通人也能体验拥有自己骆驼的乐趣！它们可不只是用来做烤肉串的！

english: So can I buy a camel then? I'm hungry!
translation: 那我能买只骆驼吗？我饿了！

english: I would never sell one to the likes of you! They are beautiful, majestic creatures, not food! Get out of my shop.
translation: 我绝不会卖给你这样的人！它们是美丽、威严的生物，不是食物！离开我的店。

english: Yes, camels are beautiful creatures.
translation: 是的，骆驼是美丽的生物。

english: Ah, wondrous camels! Best of all Saradomin's creations. Ships of the desert, far more useful than any horse or donkey. Truly, they are a man's best friend.
translation: 啊，奇妙的骆驼！萨拉多明所有创造物中最好的。沙漠之舟，比任何马或驴都有用得多。确实，它们是人类最好的朋友。

english: Perhaps you'd like a camel of your own? You're in the right place, if so...
translation: 也许你想要一只自己的骆驼？如果是的话，你来对地方了……

english: Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 还有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: No but thanks for your time.
translation: 没有了，但谢谢你。

english: Why would I want a camel? All they do is spit and...
translation: 我为什么要养骆驼？它们只会吐口水和……

english: Pah! I've seen mummies with more brains than you! If you treat camels badly then of course they're going to spit at you. May your robes never be clean again!
translation: 呸！我见过的木乃伊都比你聪明！如果你虐待骆驼，它们当然会朝你吐口水。愿你的长袍再也洗不干净！

english: Actually, I think I was a camel in a previous life.
translation: 其实，我想我前世是只骆驼。

english: You're teasing me now! You rogue!
translation: 你现在在耍我！你这家伙！

english: Everyone laughs at the poor Discount Camel Seller.
translation: 每个人都嘲笑可怜的折扣骆驼卖家。

english: So is the discount camel business good then?
translation: 那折扣骆驼生意好吗？

english: Business is booming! Pollnivneach has never seen this number of visitors.
translation: 生意兴隆！波尼尼镇从未有过这么多游客。

english: In fact I'm thinking of expanding and trying to break into the camel hire market.
translation: 其实我在考虑扩展业务，尝试进入骆驼租赁市场。

english: If only I could figure out how to get people to return the camels...
translation: 只要我能想办法让人们归还骆驼……

english: Tell me about this town.
translation: 跟我讲讲这个城镇。

english: Well, Pollnivneach is a funny little place. It's a small town and you'd think it'd be nice and quiet.
translation: 嗯，波尼尼镇是个有趣的小地方。它是个小镇，你会以为它很安静。

english: But those Menaphites and bandits are making the place quite unbearable.
translation: 但那些梅纳菲特人和强盗让这地方变得难以忍受。

english: In what way?
translation: 怎么说？

english: Well, one group is as bad as the other! They steal, they fight, they cause trouble with us locals. Just yesterday one of those bandits came looking for protection money!
translation: 嗯，两伙人一样坏！他们偷窃、打斗、给我们当地人惹麻烦。就在昨天，还有个强盗跑来收保护费！

english: Why don't the authorities stop this?
translation: 当局为什么不阻止这种事？

english: We're a small town. We don't have the resources to keep the gangs off our backs! Menaphos and Al Kharid are no help either.
translation: 我们是个小镇。我们没有资源来摆脱帮派！梅纳菲特和阿尔卡里德城也帮不上忙。

english: To tell the truth we live in hope that an outsider, someone with no ties to either group, could broker a deal to halt the hostilities between them.
translation: 说实话，我们寄希望于一个外人，一个与两伙人都没有关系的人，能出来调解一下，平息他们之间的敌对。

english: Hmm...
Well the weak will always be trodden on. Why not stand up to them?
translation: 嗯，弱者总是被践踏。为什么不反抗他们？

english: That's a little unfair, my friend. We can't all be brave adventurers. If we were, where would you purchase quality camels at discounted prices?
translation: 那有点不公平，我的朋友。我们不能都是勇敢的冒险者。如果是的话，你在哪儿能以折扣价买到优质骆驼？

english: You might think about that. Anyway, isn't it the job of the brave adventurer to protect the weak and innocent from evil and harm?
translation: 你可以想想这个。不管怎样，保护弱者和无辜者免受邪恶和伤害不就是勇敢冒险者的工作吗？

english: Perhaps I could help.
translation: 也许我能帮忙。

english: Yes, perhaps you could.
translation: 是的，也许你能。

english: You know the politics better than I do. What do you recommend?
translation: 你比我更了解政治。你有什么建议？

english: Me?! I am but a humble discount camel seller. You're the adventurer, don't you know what to do?
translation: 我？！我只是个卑微的折扣骆驼卖家。你是冒险者，你不知道该做什么吗？

english: Of course I know what to do! I was just testing you!
translation: 我当然知道该做什么！我只是在测试你！

english: That is reassuring to hear. Too often one meets brainless adventurers whose solution to every problem is to hack, maim and murder.
translation: 听到这个很欣慰。太常见到无脑冒险者了，他们解决问题只会靠砍砍杀杀，残害人命。

english: I'm glad to know you're not of that ilk.
translation: 很高兴知道你不是那种人。

english: Perhaps I should know, but offered advice should never be shunned.
translation: 也许我应该知道，但送上门的建议总没理由拒之门外。

english: The state of adventurers today. They need everything spelled out for them.
translation: 现在的冒险者啊，什么事都得给他们说清楚。

english: What, you want me to put a little note in your quest journal?
translation: 什么，你想让我在你的任务日志里写个小纸条？

english: But fine, I'll give you a hint. Try and see if you can get the gangs to agree to a truce by offering them each a token gift as an act of reconciliation.
translation: 但好吧，我给你个提示。试试看能否通过给每伙人一份象征性礼物作为和解姿态，让他们同意休战。

english: If that fails to work, you must consider trying to influence the gangs from within.
translation: 如果那不起作用，你必须考虑尝试从内部影响帮派。

english: Lovely day isn't it?
translation: 天气真好，不是吗？

english: It's a beautiful day today, but word has it that it will rain tomorrow.
translation: 今天天气很好，但听说明天会下雨。

english: Really?
translation: 真的？

english: No! When have you ever known it to rain here in Gielinor?
translation: 不！你什么时候见过基利诺尔这里下雨？

english: Oh. Anyway...
translation: 哦。不管怎样……

english: Hello! Welcome back to my discount camel store. How are those camels getting along?
translation: 你好！欢迎回到我的折扣骆驼店。那些骆驼过得怎么样？

english: Hey Sami!
translation: 嘿，萨米！

english: Hello adventurer.
translation: 你好，冒险者。

english: Any news?
translation: 有什么消息吗？

english: Not much really, I just want to thank you for what you have done for this town. I might even stick around now that business is better!
translation: 没什么大事，我只是想感谢你为这个城镇所做的一切。现在生意好了，我甚至会留下来！

english: Any grand plans?
translation: 有什么宏伟计划吗？

english: Well I've been debating whether I should diversify into camel rental, too. Although I do have all these cages lying around... do you think there's a market for discount jackals?
translation: 嗯，我一直在考虑是否也应该多元化经营骆驼租赁。虽然我确实有这些笼子闲置……你觉得折扣胡狼有市场吗？

english: Maybe! Best of luck, in any case.
translation: 也许！无论如何，祝你好运。

english: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。

english: A discount camel store?
translation: 折扣骆驼店？

english: So can I buy a camel then? I'm hungry!
translation: 那我能买只骆驼吗？我饿了！

english: Yes, camels are beautiful creatures.
translation: 是的，骆驼是美丽的生物。

english: Well yes actually I'd like to ask about something else.
translation: 嗯，是的，其实我想问点别的。

english: No but thanks for your time.
translation: 没有了，但谢谢你。

english: Why would I want a camel? All they do is spit and...
translation: 我为什么要养骆驼？它们只会吐口水和……

english: Actually, I think I was a camel in a previous life.
translation: 其实，我想我前世是只骆驼。

english: So is the discount camel business good then?
translation: 那折扣骆驼生意好吗？

english: Tell me about this town.
translation: 跟我讲讲这个城镇。

english: In what way?
translation: 怎么说？

english: Well the weak will always be trodden on. Why not stand up to them?
translation: 嗯，弱者总是被践踏。为什么不反抗他们？

english: Perhaps I could help.
translation: 也许我能帮忙。

english: Indeed I should know, and indeed I do! I was just testing you!
translation: 我确实应该知道，而且我确实知道！我只是在测试你！

english: Perhaps I should know, but offered advice should never be shunned.
translation: 也许我应该知道，但送上门的建议总没理由拒之门外。

english: Lovely day isn't it?
translation: 天气真好，不是吗？

english: Water, water get your fresh water here, 1000 coins a waterskin, a bargain in these difficult times.
translation: 水，水，来买新鲜水吧，一个水袋1,000枚金币，在这困难时期真是便宜货。

english: That's extortionate! Why so much?
translation: 这简直是敲诈！怎么这么贵？

english: Well it's the cheapest water you'll find in this town.
translation: 哈，这可是你这镇上能找到的最便宜的水了。

english: You don't have 1000 coins to buy the water with.
translation: 你身上没有1,000枚金币来买水。

english: You buy a full waterskin for 1000 coins!
translation: 你花了1,000枚金币买了一整袋水！

english: I think I'll give it a miss.
translation: 我想我还是不要了。

english: You look glum.
translation: 你看起来闷闷不乐的。

english: Business here really seems to have dried up. I had a good thing going here and you spoiled it.
translation: 这里的生意真的好像枯竭了。我本来在这里做得很好，你把它搞砸了。

english: Well it serves you right really. Taking advantage of people like that.
translation: 这是你自作自受，谁让你那样占别人便宜。

english: So want to buy some water?
translation: 那想买点水吗？

english: How much?
translation: 多少钱？

english: To you 1000 coins for a waterskin!
translation: 对你来说一个水袋1,000枚金币！

english: If you want water you need to buy it off me.
translation: 如果你想要水，你得从我这里买。

english: That's extortionate! Why so much?
translation: 这简直是敲诈！怎么这么贵？

english: Ok, I'll buy some!
translation: 好的，我买一些！

english: I think I'll give it a miss.
translation: 我想我还是不要了。

english: Ok, I feel sorry for you.
translation: 好吧，我为你感到难过。

english: Hello there!
translation: 你好！

english: Oh, er, hello. What do you want?
translation: 哦，呃，你好，你想要什么？

english: What can you tell me about Al Kharid?
translation: 你能跟我说说阿尔卡里德城吗？

english: There's not much farming land around here. Only that little patch outside.
translation: 这附近没什么农田，只有外面那一小块地。

english: Can you give me any advice on farming here in the desert?
translation: 你能给我一些在这沙漠里耕作的建议吗？

english: Like I said, I only know about cactuses...
translation: 就像我说的，我只懂仙人掌……

english: Just tell me about cactuses, then.
translation: 那就跟我说说仙人掌吧。

english: First you have to weed the patch using a rake.
translation: 首先你得用耙子清理种植地的杂草。

english: Can you give me any other advice?
translation: 你能给我其他建议吗？

english: Not really. I've not done much farming recently.
translation: 不太行。我最近没怎么耕种。

english: Well, can you at least sell me any gardening tools or seeds?
translation: 嗯，你至少能卖我一些园艺工具或种子吗？

english: Sorry. They haven't been delivered yet.
translation: 抱歉，货还没送到呢。

english: So, what do you do here?
translation: 那么，你在这里做什么？

english: I'm going to set up a shop selling farming implements. That patch out there may be small, but it's all we've got.
translation: 我打算开一家卖农具的店。外面那块地虽然小，但已经是我们全部的家当了。

english: I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
translation: 我听说你在为阿里‧莫里桑做事……

english: Yes, he bought these tents and had them put up for us. He says he'll also get our goods in so we can start selling them soon.
translation: 是的，他买了这些帐篷并帮我们搭好。他说还会帮我们进货，这样我们很快就能开始做生意了。

english: I only know how to farm cactuses, so this spot is perfect.
translation: 我只会种仙人掌，所以这个地方正合适。

english: Maybe I should talk to him...
translation: 也许我该去跟他谈谈……

english: Of course. He's always happy to talk to possible business partners.
translation: 当然，他总是很乐意跟潜在的生意伙伴聊聊。

english: I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
translation: 我听说你一直在恐吓其他店主。

english: Now why would you think that?
translation: 你怎么会这么想呢？

english: One of the shopkeepers told they were threatened by a man with a rake...
translation: 有个店主说他们被一个拿耙子的人恐吓过……

english: Those people just don't want us to succeed. Don't listen to them!
translation: 那些人只是不想让我们成功。别听他们的！

english: What can you tell me about Al Kharid?
translation: 你能跟我说说阿尔卡里德城吗？

english: So, what do you do here?
translation: 那么，你在这里做什么？

english: I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
translation: 我听说你在为阿里‧莫里桑做事……

english: I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
translation: 我听说你一直在恐吓其他店主。

english: Hello there!
translation: 你好！

english: I'm working. What do you have to say that's so urgent?
translation: 我在上班。你有什么急事要说？

english: What can you tell me about Al Kharid?
translation: 你能跟我说说阿尔卡里德城吗？

english: There's a lot of space here. More open space than back home.
translation: 这里空间很大。比老家开阔多了。

english: So where is back home?
translation: 那你的老家在哪儿？

english: Pollnivneach. It's a town to the south of the Shantay Pass.
translation: 波尼尼镇，那是沙泰隘口南边的一个小镇。

english: So, what do you do here?
translation: 那么，你在这里做什么？

english: I'm on guard duty. Making sure nobody tries to steal anything from the house and tents in the middle of town.
translation: 我在站岗。确保没人试图偷城镇中央房屋和帐篷里的东西。

english: Why are you only guarding those buildings?
translation: 你为什么只守着那些房子？

english: That's all I've been hired to guard.
translation: 那就是我受雇要守的全部。

english: I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
translation: 我听说你在为阿里‧莫里桑做事……

english: Yeah, he hired me. He owns this house and these two tents, too.
translation: 是的，他雇了我。这房子和这两个帐篷也是他的。

english: Is the work good?
translation: 工作怎么样？

english: It pays better than back home.
translation: 报酬比老家高。

english: Why, what did you do back home?
translation: 是吗，你在老家做什么？

english: Never you mind.
translation: 不关你的事。

english: But Ali Morrisane pays us well, at least.
translation: 但至少阿里‧莫里桑给我们的报酬不错。

english: Maybe I should talk to him...
translation: 也许我该去跟他谈谈……

english: Why not? He always likes to meet potential business partners.
translation: 为什么不呢？他总是乐意跟潜在的生意伙伴聊聊。

english: I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
translation: 我听说你一直在恐吓其他店主。

english: So? They talk too much.
translation: 那又怎样？他们话太多了。

english: You're not going to deny it?
translation: 你不打算否认吗？

english: Why bother? None of them can fight back, after all.
translation: 何必呢？反正他们都没法还手。

english: What can you tell me about Al Kharid?
translation: 你能跟我说说阿尔卡里德城吗？

english: So, what do you do here?
translation: 那么，你在这里做什么？

english: I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
translation: 我听说你在为阿里‧莫里桑做事……

english: I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
translation: 我听说你一直在恐吓其他店主。

english: Good day old hag.
translation: 你好，老巫婆。

english: Old hag indeed! I have a name you know!
translation: 老巫婆？我可不是！我可是有名字的！

english: Does it happen to be... Ali?
translation: 该不会是……阿里吧？

english: Oh, it's actually Alisha, but they let me move in anyway. Not many hags about these days, and beggars can't be choosers!
translation: 哦，其实是阿丽莎，但他们还是让我搬进来了。现在女巫不多了，乞丐哪能挑三拣四！

english: So can I call you Al?
translation: 那我能叫你阿尔吗？

english: Only if I can call you Betty!
translation: 除非我能叫你贝蒂！

english: Now what do you want from the old hag of Pollnivneach? Hexes? Curses? Eternal youth? Poisons? You name it, I can brew it.
translation: 那你想从波尼尼镇的老巫婆这里得到什么？诅咒？厄运？永葆青春？毒药？只要你说得出，我就能调出来。

english: Actually I don't want any of that stuff, I'm new in town and I wanted to get to know the locals.
translation: 其实我不想要那些东西，我刚来这里，想认识一下当地人。

english: I'm busy brewing potions, so if you disturb me again without reason, I will turn you into a frog!
translation: 我正忙着调制药水，如果你再无故打扰我，我就把你变成青蛙！

english: Sorry! I won't let it happen again.
translation: 抱歉！我不会再犯了。

english: Good day, Hag.
translation: 你好，巫婆。

english: Good day to you too, Blockhead.
translation: 也祝你日安，笨蛋。

english: Now what do you want from the old hag of Pollnivneach? Hexes? Curses? Eternal youth? Poisons? You name it, I can brew it.
translation: 那你想从波尼尼镇的老巫婆这里得到什么？诅咒？厄运？永葆青春？毒药？只要你说得出，我就能调出来。

english: I'm busy brewing potions, so if you disturb me again without reason, I will turn you into a frog!
translation: 我正忙着调制药水，如果你再无故打扰我，我就把你变成青蛙！

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Hello. What can I do for you?
translation: 你好，有什么能帮你的？

english: I don't know, what can you do for me?
translation: 我不知道，你能做什么？

english: Well, that depends.
translation: 嗯，那得看情况。

english: Depends on what?
translation: 看什么情况？

english: It depends on whether you like kebabs or not.
translation: 得看你喜欢不喜欢烤肉串。

english: Why is that?
translation: 这是为什么？

english: Seeing as I'm in the kebab construction industry, I mainly help people in need of a kebab.
translation: 毕竟我是做烤肉串行业的，主要帮助需要烤肉串的人。

english: Well then, what kind of kebabs do you, er, construct?
translation: 那么，你''制作''什么样的烤肉串？

english: I offer two different types of kebabs: the standard run- of-the-mill kebab seen throughout Gielinor and enjoyed by many an intoxicated dwarf, and my speciality, the extra-hot kebab. So which shall it be?
translation: 我提供两种烤肉串：一种是基利诺尔各地常见的普通烤肉串，很多醉矮人都喜欢；另一种是我的特色，超辣烤肉串。你要哪种？

english: I want a standard kebab, please.
translation: 我想要一份普通烤肉串，谢谢。

english: That will be three gold coins.
translation: 三枚金币。

english: Here you go.
translation: 给，拿好。

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

english: No thanks, I'm good.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我没事。

english: Come back soon, I could do with a few more customers.
translation: 常来啊，我还需要更多顾客。

english: I seem to be short on coins. Sorry.
translation: 我好像钱不够，抱歉。

english: Is there anything else I can do for you?
translation: 还有什么我能为你做的吗？

english: Could I have one of those crazy hot kebabs of yours?
translation: 能给我一份你那超辣的烤肉串吗？

english: One super kebab coming up! Be careful, they really are as hot as they're made out to be.
translation: 一份超级烤肉串马上好！小心点，它们真的像传说中那么辣。

english: Sure, sure.
translation: 好的，好的。

english: Would you sell me that bottle of special kebab sauce?
translation: 你能把那瓶特制烤肉酱卖给我吗？

english: Well, that depends. What do you intend to do with it?
translation: 嗯，那得看情况。你打算用它做什么？

english: Don't worry, I've no intention of setting up a rival kebab shop.
translation: 别担心，我没打算开竞争的烤肉店。

english: But then what do you want it for?
translation: 那你要它做什么？

english: I don't know, but I think I could have a little bit of fun with it.
translation: 我不知道，但我想可以拿它找点乐子。

english: You're not going to put it in Drunken Ali's drink, are you? That's what happened the last time I gave someone the sauce.
translation: 你不会把它放进醉汉阿里的饮料里吧？上次我把酱给别人就发生了这种事。

english: No, that would be a bit cliché. I think I'll come up with something more original.
translation: 不，那太老套了。我想我会想点更有创意的。

english: Actually, I might get back to you on the sauce. I'm a bit overburdened as it is.
translation: 其实，关于酱料我可能回头再找你。我现在已经够忙的了。

english: Just be careful with it, it's potent enough to give a camel the runs.
translation: 小心点用，这酱料劲大到能让骆驼拉肚子。

english: Thank you very much.
translation: 非常感谢。
