english: What is the difference between the standard and the extra-hot kebab?
translation: 普通烤肉串和超辣烤肉串有什么区别？

english: If I told you that I would have to kill you. Kebab construction is a cut-throat industry. The extra-hot kebab gives me my competitive edge and if I were to divulge my secrets to every passing adventurer, I'd
translation: 如果我告诉你就得杀了你。烤肉串行业竞争很激烈。超辣烤肉串是我的竞争优势，如果把秘密告诉每个路过的冒险者，我很快就得关门大吉。

english: soon be out of business.
translation: 我很快就得关门大吉。

english: So there's no difference except the sauce you use?
translation: 所以除了酱料没别的区别？

english: Shh! Keep your voice down. You should have told me you were from the union.
translation: 嘘！小声点。你早该告诉我你是工会的人。

english: Listen, I've got to run. I'll catch you later.
translation: 听着，我得走了。回头再聊。

english: I need some information.
translation: 我需要一些信息。

english: If information is what you need, there are many better people to ask than myself who could help you. One of the town's street urchins or perhaps the local drunk. I may be many things to many different people, but a
translation: 如果你需要信息，镇上有很多比我更适合问的人。比如街头流浪儿或者当地醉汉。我对不同人来说可能有很多身份，但我不是八卦的人。

english: gossip I am not.
translation: 但我不是八卦的人。

english: Ah! Here you go!
translation: 啊！给，拿着！

english: What?
translation: 什么？

english: I need you to answer this for me.
translation: 我需要你帮我回答这个问题。

english: Ali the Kebab seller has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 烤肉贩阿里给了你一张挑战卷轴！

english: Please give me your answer!
translation: 请把你的答案告诉我！

english: Nope, not correct!
translation: 不对，不正确！

english: Spot on!
translation: 完全正确！

english: Ali the Kebab seller has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
translation: 烤肉贩阿里给了你[another clue scroll/a casket]！

english: I want a standard kebab, please.
translation: 我想要一份普通烤肉串，谢谢。

english: Yes, actually.
translation: 其实是的。

english: Could I have an extra-hot kebab please?
translation: 能给我一份超辣烤肉串吗？

english: Would you sell me that bottle of special kebab sauce?
translation: 你能把那瓶特制烤肉酱卖给我吗？

english: What is the difference between the standard and the extra-hot kebab?
translation: 普通烤肉串和超辣烤肉串有什么区别？

english: I want a kebab, please.
translation: 我想要一份烤肉串。

english: Listen I've got to run. I'll catch you later.
translation: 听着，我得走了。回头再聊。

english: I need some information.
translation: 我需要一些信息。

english: I don't have time to talk right now! Ali Morrisane is paying me to hand out these flyers.
translation: 我现在没时间说话！阿里‧莫里桑付钱让我发这些传单。

english: Who is Ali Morrisane?
translation: 阿里‧莫里桑是谁？

english: Ali Morrisane is the greatest merchant in the east!
translation: 阿里‧莫里桑是东方最伟大的商人！

english: Were you paid to say that?
translation: 你是收了钱才这么说的吗？

english: Of course I was! You can find him on the north edge of town.
translation: 当然收了！你可以在城镇北边找到他。

english: What are the flyers for?
translation: 这些传单是做什么用的？

english: Well, Ali Morrisane isn't too popular with the other traders in Al Kharid, mainly because he's from Pollnivneach and they feel he has no business trading in their town.
translation: 嗯，阿里‧莫里桑在阿尔卡里德城的其他商人中不太受欢迎，主要是因为他来自波尼尼镇，他们觉得他没资格在他们的地盘做生意。

english: I think they're just sour because he's better at making money than them.
translation: 我觉得他们只是眼红，因为他比他们更会赚钱。

english: The flyer advertises the different shops you can find in Al Kharid.
translation: 传单宣传的是阿尔卡里德城的各种商店。

english: It also entitles you to money off your next purchase in any of the shops listed on it. It's Ali's way of getting on the good side of the traders.
translation: 它还让你在任何列出的商店购物时享受折扣。这是阿里讨好商人们的方式。

english: Which shops?
translation: 哪些商店？

english: Here! Take one and let me get back to work.
translation: 给！拿一张让我回去工作。

english: I still have hundreds of these flyers to hand out, I wonder if my boss would notice if I quietly dumped them somewhere?
translation: 我还有几百张传单要发，不知道如果我悄悄把它们扔在某处老板会不会发现？

english: Are you trying to be funny or has age turned your brain to mush? Look at the flyer you already have!
translation: 你是想搞笑还是年纪大了脑子糊涂了？看看你已经有的传单！

english: I'd give you a flyer but it looks like your hands are full. Come back when you have space for my flyer.
translation: 我想给你传单，但看起来你手上满了。等有空间放我的传单时再来吧。

english: What is there to do round here, boy?
translation: 孩子，这里有什么可做的？

english: I'm very busy, so listen carefully! I shall say this only once.
translation: 我很忙，所以听仔细了！我只说一次。

english: Apart from a busy and wonderous market place in Al Kharid to the south, there is the Emir's Arena to the south-east where you can challenge other players to a fight.
translation: 除了南边阿尔卡里德城繁忙奇妙的市场外，东南边还有埃米尔竞技场，你可以在那里向其他玩家发起挑战。

english: If you're here to make money, there is a mine to the south.
translation: 如果你来这里赚钱，南边有个矿场。

english: Watch out for scorpions though, they'll take a pop at you if you go too near them. To avoid them just follow the western fence as you travel south.
translation: 不过要小心蝎子，靠太近它们会攻击你。要避开它们，往南走的时候沿着西侧栅栏走就行。

english: If you're in the mood for a little rest and relaxation, there are a couple of nice fishing spots south of the town.
translation: 如果你想休息放松一下，城镇南边有几个不错的钓鱼点。

english: Thanks for the help!
translation: 谢谢你的帮助！

english: I don't want this! It's out of date!
translation: 我不要这个！已经过期了！

english: Then why would I want it? Keep moving, I have to hand all these flyers out before I get paid.
translation: 那我为什么要？继续走，我得把这些传单都发完才能拿到报酬。

english: Ali's Discount Wares...
translation: 阿里的折扣商品店……

english: The finest store in the world!
translation: 世界上最好的商店！

english: Dommik's crafting store...
translation: 多米克的制作商店……

english: The place for all your crafting needs.
translation: 满足你所有制作需求的地方。

english: Ellis' Tannery...
translation: 艾利斯的制革厂……

english: The prices are better than the smell!
translation: 价格比气味好多了！

english: Run your enemies through in style...
translation: 用时尚的方式刺穿你的敌人……

english: with a Scimitar from Zeke's Superior Scimitars!
translation: 用齐克优质弯刀店的弯刀！

english: Visit Louie's Armoured Legs Bazaar...
translation: 光顾路易的装甲裤集市……

english: Number one for clanky trousers!
translation: 叮当裤的首选！

english: Visit Ranael's Super Skirt Store ..
translation: 光顾拉纳尔的超级裙子店……

english: for the most stylish protection money can buy!
translation: 金钱能买到的最时尚保护！

english: Keep west as you travel south ...
translation: 往南走时保持靠西……

english: to avoid the killer scorpions!
translation: 以避开杀人蝎子！

english: Very well done, take this.
translation: 做得很好，拿着这个。

english: Who is Ali Morrisane?
translation: 阿里‧莫里桑是谁？

english: What are the flyers for?
translation: 这些传单是做什么用的？

english: What is there to do round here, boy?
translation: 孩子，这里有什么可做的？

english: Welcome, adventurer, to the town of Pollnivneach, the gateway to Menaphos and Al Kharid. My name is Ali and I'm the mayor of this town. I hope you enjoy your stay here.
translation: 欢迎，冒险者，来到波尼尼镇，通往梅纳菲特和阿尔卡里德城的门户。我叫阿里，是这座城镇的市长。希望你在这里过得愉快。

english: Thank you. That is one of the warmest welcomes I've ever had! People generally treat travelling adventurers with suspicion.
translation: 谢谢，这是我收到过最热情的欢迎之一！人们通常对旅行冒险者都很警惕。

english: All are welcome here. Now more than ever I suppose.
translation: 这里欢迎所有人。我想现在比以往更需要这样。

english: What do you mean by that?
translation: 你什么意思？

english: There's trouble in town, and a lot of villagers have left as a result. Things are looking dire.
translation: 镇上有麻烦，很多村民因此离开了。情况看起来很严峻。

english: Thank you once again. Have you spoken to Ali Morrisane yet?
translation: 再次感谢。你和阿里‧莫里桑谈过了吗？

english: Yes, I spoke to him already. He really had me going with his little 'tourism' trick!
translation: 是的，我已经和他谈过了。他那个''旅游''小把戏真把我骗到了！

english: Well, not to be immodest, but it was all my idea.
translation: 嗯，不是自夸，但这都是我的主意。

english: Our little town needed help, and I knew it'd take the greatest salesman in Gielinor to attract an adventurer strong enough to help us out.
translation: 我们小镇需要帮助，我知道只有基利诺尔最伟大的推销员才能吸引到足够强大的冒险者来帮我们。

english: In any case, I have my mayoral duties to attend to. I have lots of new citizens to register!
translation: 不管怎样，我还有市长职责要处理。我有很多新市民要登记！

english: Hello good sir.
translation: 你好，先生。

english: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？

english: I'm new in town and wanted to get to know the locals.
translation: 我刚来这里，想认识一下当地人。

english: What do you want to know?
translation: 你想了解什么？

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 跟我说说你自己。

english: That information is available on a need to know basis and right now, you don't need to know.
translation: 这些信息只在需要知道时提供，而现在，你不需要知道。

english: Can I help you with anything else?
translation: 还有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: Yes I'd like to ask you about something else.
translation: 是的，我想问你点别的。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Tell me about the other people in the town.
translation: 跟我说说镇上的其他人。

english: Sheep, ready for the slau... hang on. I shouldn't be telling you that. Just forget I said anything.
translation: 一群待宰的羔羊……等等，我不该告诉你那个。就当我什么都没说。

english: I'm looking for Ali.
translation: 我在找阿里。

english: You will have to be a lot more specific if you want help finding him. Everyone here is called Ali.
translation: 如果你想让我帮你找他，你得说得更具体点。这里每个人都叫阿里。

english: I've discovered that. Well he has an uncle called Ali Morrisane, a market vendor in Al Kharid and that's all I really know about him.
translation: 我已经发现了。嗯，他有个叔叔叫阿里‧莫里桑，是阿尔卡里德城的集市商贩，我就知道这些。

english: Say no more. I too am looking for him. The little tyke robbed me too, if we work together perhaps we can catch him and teach him a lesson.
translation: 别说了。我也在找他。那小家伙也抢了我，如果我们合作也许能抓住他并给他个教训。

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 跟我说说你自己。

english: Yes I'd like to ask you about something else.
translation: 是的，我想问你点别的。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Tell me about the other people in the town.
translation: 跟我说说镇上的其他人。

english: I'm looking for Ali.
translation: 我在找阿里。

english: Hello there! Who is this?
translation: 你好！这是谁？

english: Ali.
translation: 阿里。

english: Any particular Ali?
translation: 哪个阿里？

english: Only the best there is! I'm Ali the Sandsweeper.
translation: 当然是最好的那个！我是扫沙工阿里。

english: You sweep sand?
translation: 你扫沙子？

english: Certainly do!  I'm the best darn sandsweeper this side of the Lum.
translation: 当然！我是仑河这边最厉害的扫沙工。

english: There's more of you?
translation: 还有更多像你这样的？

english: We have a union, mate! There's always sand to sweep.
translation: 我们有工会，伙计！总有扫不完的沙子。

english: Indeed. Um, I have to go.
translation: 确实。嗯，我得走了。

english: Hello there!
translation: 你好！

english: You seem rather cheerful. Is there anything you're after?
translation: 你看起来挺高兴的。你在找什么吗？

english: What can you tell me about Al Kharid?
translation: 你能跟我说说阿尔卡里德城吗？

english: Well, it's hot and full of sand.
translation: 嗯，这里很热，到处都是沙子。

english: Anything else?
translation: 还有别的吗？

english: Don't ask me, I'm not from around here.
translation: 别问我，我不是这里的。

english: So where are you from?
translation: 那你是哪儿的？

english: A town to the south of the Shantay Pass, called Pollnivneach.
translation: 沙泰隘口南边的一个小镇，叫波尼尼镇。

english: So, what do you do here?
translation: 那么，你在这里做什么？

english: Not very much, at the moment. I came from further south to set up a smithy here...
translation: 目前没做什么。我从更南边来这里开铁匠铺……

english: ...but we still haven't set up the shops, so we have no customers yet.
translation: ……但我们还没把店铺建好，所以还没有顾客。

english: I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
translation: 我听说你在为阿里‧莫里桑做事……

english: Yes, he's the one who persuaded us to come here.
translation: 是的，是他说服我们来这里的。

english: He said we'd have lots of customers once we set up our shops, and all he asks for is a cut of the profits.
translation: 他说我们开好店后会有很多顾客，而他要求的只是从中抽成。

english: Maybe I should talk to him...
translation: 也许我该去跟他谈谈……

english: Of course. He's always happy to talk to possible business partners.
translation: 当然，他总是很乐意跟潜在的生意伙伴聊聊。

english: I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
translation: 我听说你一直在恐吓其他店主。

english: What? Who's spreading that rumour?
translation: 什么？谁在散布这种谣言？

english: Well, one of the shopkeepers told me a man with a large hammer came to threaten them.
translation: 嗯，有个店主告诉我一个拿大锤子的人来威胁他们。

english: Don't pay any attention to those people.
translation: 别理那些人。

english: They're just worried that they'll lose money when we open our shops.
translation: 他们只是担心我们开店后会抢他们生意。

english: What can you tell me about Al Kharid?
translation: 你能跟我说说阿尔卡里德城吗？

english: So, what do you do here?
translation: 那么，你在这里做什么？

english: I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
translation: 我听说你在为阿里‧莫里桑做事……

english: I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
translation: 我听说你一直在恐吓其他店主。

english: Wow, a snake charmer! Can I have a go? Can I have a go? Please?
translation: 哇，耍蛇人！我能试试吗？能试试吗？求你了？

english: The snake charmer is focusing intently on his music and doesn't seem to notice you.
translation: 耍蛇人正全神贯注地演奏音乐，似乎没注意到你。

english: The snake charmer snaps out of his trance and directs his full attention to you.
translation: 耍蛇人猛地回过神来，把全部注意力转向你。

english: If it means that you'll leave me alone, I will happily give you my snake charming super starter kit, complete with flute and basket. But you're clearly over burdened as it is.
translation: 如果这样能让你别烦我，我很乐意把我的耍蛇超级入门套装给你，包括笛子和篮子。但你显然已经负重过多了。

english: Ah, I see you've lost your basket. Here you are, now leave me alone! You're ruining the show.
translation: 啊，我看你把篮子弄丢了。给你，现在别烦我了！你在毁我的表演。

english: Ah, I see you've lost your snake charming flute. Here you go, now leave me alone! You're distracting my punters... er, I mean, crowd.
translation: 啊，我看你把耍蛇笛子弄丢了。给你，现在别烦我了！你在让我的顾客们分心……呃，我是说观众。

english: If you're that desperate to try, have my patented snake charming starter kit. It comes with a special snake charming flute and a basket to keep your charmed snakes in. Now, leave me alone!
translation: 如果你这么想试试，就拿走我的专利耍蛇入门套装吧。包括特制耍蛇笛子和装驯服蛇的篮子。现在，别烦我了！

english: The snake charmer gives you a snake charming flute and a basket.
translation: 耍蛇人给了你一支耍蛇笛子和一个篮子。

english: I'm not stopping you! You have your own snake charming flute.
translation: 我没拦你！你有自己的耍蛇笛子。

english: I want to talk to you about animal charming.
translation: 我想和你谈谈动物驯服。

english: I've lost some of the gear you gave me.
translation: 我把你给我的装备弄丢了一些。

english: What do you need?
translation: 你需要什么？

english: I've lost the music.
translation: 我把笛子弄丢了。

english: There you go. Now if you don't mind I'm busy trying to charm this here snake.
translation: 给，拿好。现在如果你不介意的话，我正忙着驯服这条蛇。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Yes?
translation: 什么事？

english: Can you teach me any more about animal charming.
translation: 你能教我更多关于动物驯服的知识吗？

english: No, I doubt it. I believe your talents lie in other areas.
translation: 不，恐怕不行。我相信你的天赋在其他方面。

english: Wow, a snake charmer! Can I have a go? Can I have a go? Please?
translation: 哇，耍蛇人！我能试试吗？能试试吗？求你了？

english: I want to talk to you about animal charming.
translation: 我想和你谈谈动物驯服。

english: Hello there!
translation: 你好！

english: I'm a little busy at the moment. What is it?
translation: 我现在有点忙。什么事？

english: What can you tell me about Al Kharid?
translation: 你能跟我说说阿尔卡里德城吗？

english: Oh, it has wonderful weather.
translation: 哦，这里天气很好。

english: Wonderful? It's hot and dry all the time!
translation: 很好？这里一直又热又干！

english: Not quite as hot as back home.
translation: 没老家那么热。

english: Where's home, then?
translation: 那老家在哪儿？

english: Oh, it's a town to the south of the pass, called Pollnivneach.
translation: 哦，是山口南边的一个小镇，叫波尼尼镇。

english: So, what do you do here?
translation: 那么，你在这里做什么？

english: If I had cloth, patterns and customers, I'd be a tailor. As it is, I'm a tailor with nothing to do.
translation: 如果我有布料、图样和顾客，我就是裁缝。但现在，我是个没事做的裁缝。

english: The silk merchant won't even sell me any silks, because he doesn't trust me!
translation: 丝绸商人甚至不卖我丝绸，因为他不信任我！

english: Anything I can do to help?
translation: 有什么我能帮忙的吗？

english: No, no, it's all being dealt with.
translation: 不，不，都在处理中了。

english: I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
translation: 我听说你在为阿里‧莫里桑做事……

english: Of course, he's the one who's going to obtain cloth and clothes patterns so I can set up shop here.
translation: 当然，是他负责获取布料和服装图样，这样我才能在这里开店。

english: And in such a good location, too. Not out of the way like back home.
translation: 而且位置这么好。不像老家那么偏僻。

english: The customers will soon pour in!
translation: 顾客很快就会蜂拥而至！

english: Maybe I should talk to him...
translation: 也许我该去跟他谈谈……

english: Why not? He's always happy to talk to potential business partners.
translation: 为什么不呢？他总是很乐意和潜在的生意伙伴交谈。

english: I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
translation: 我听说你一直在恐吓其他店主。

english: Me, threaten people?
translation: 我，威胁人？

english: One of the shopkeepers did say they were threatened by a man with large scissors...
translation: 有个店主说他们被一个拿大剪刀的人威胁了……

english: Oh, them. Don't mind them. I think they're worried about what effect our shops will have.
translation: 哦，他们。别理他们。我想他们是担心我们开店会对他们造成影响。

english: For all they know, when we open our shops their wares will look cheap and shabby by comparison!
translation: 对他们来说，等我们开店后他们的商品相比之下就会显得廉价破旧！

english: What can you tell me about Al Kharid?
translation: 你能跟我说说阿尔卡里德城吗？

english: So, what do you do here?
translation: 那么，你在这里做什么？

english: I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
translation: 我听说你在为阿里‧莫里桑做事……

english: I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
translation: 我听说你一直在恐吓其他店主。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Welcome! I'm Ali, and this is my tea shop! Is there anything I can do for you today?
translation: 欢迎！我是阿里，这是我的茶店！今天有什么能为你效劳的吗？

english: Hmm... Could I get some tea?
translation: 嗯……能给我来点茶吗？

english: Of course! I'll get the water boiling at once. Is there anything else I can do for you while you wait?
translation: 当然！我马上烧水。你等的时候还有什么我能为你做的吗？

english: How's the tea coming along?
translation: 茶怎么样了？

english: Oh! Yes, the water is boiling. Just give me a minute!
translation: 哦！是的，水开了。稍等一分钟！

english: I'm so thirsty.
translation: 我好渴。

english: I know, the desert is forever hot. Thirsty work here!
translation: 我知道，沙漠永远炎热。这里的工作真让人口渴！

english: How's business here? Seems quite out the way.
translation: 生意怎么样？看起来位置挺偏僻的。

english: Hmm...
Not good?
translation: 不好吗？

english: It's not that. It's just that I've been having issues with a few thieves lately. Four to be precise!
translation: 不是那个。只是我最近遇到了一些小偷的问题。准确说是四个！

english: They've been stealing your tea?
translation: 他们在偷你的茶？

english: There have been a few break-ins. A recent shipment from Karamja has been taken! That was some of the finest stuff I've ever managed to get my hands on.
translation: 发生了几起入室盗窃。最近一批从卡拉姆詹岛运来的货被偷了！那是我能搞到的最好的货。

english: That's awful. If I see any shifty characters, I'll be sure to teach them a lesson.
translation: 太糟糕了。如果我见到任何可疑人物，我一定会给他们个教训。

english: Ha! Very courageous, adventurer! These thieves are big and brutish. I wouldn't start something you may not be able to finish.
translation: 哈！真勇敢，冒险者！这些小偷又大又凶。我劝你别招惹你可能对付不了的麻烦。

english: I'm pretty tough. I think I can handle them.
translation: 我很厉害的。我想我能对付他们。

english: If you say so.
translation: 你这么说就是了。

english: I'd best be heading off.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: You're leaving? But the tea is almost done!
translation: 你要走了？但茶快好了！

english: I've been waiting quite a while. Perhaps another time.
translation: 我已经等了很久了。也许下次吧。

english: Well you never actually made me that tea...
translation: 嗯，你其实从来没给我泡过那茶……

english: Ah yes! I'll get the water boiling at once. Is there anything else I can do for you while you wait?
translation: 啊对！我马上烧水。你等的时候还有什么我能为你做的吗？

english: How's the tea coming along?
translation: 茶怎么样了？

english: How's business here? Seems quite out the way.
translation: 生意怎么样？看起来位置挺偏僻的。

english: I'd best be heading off.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: Wow! lookat this place, it's so colourful.
translation: 哇！看看这个地方，真多彩。

english: Why thank you. Can I help you with anything?
translation: 哦谢谢，有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: I take it by the clothes you are wearing and this room that you are in the dye trade?
translation: 从你穿的衣服和这个房间来看，你是做染料生意的吧？

english: How observant of you.
translation: 你观察得真仔细。

english: Can you make dyes for me please?
translation: 你能帮我制作染料吗？

english: What colour dye do you want? I can make you blue, red or yellow dyes for you. If you bring me the correct raw materials.
translation: 你想要什么颜色的染料？我可以帮你制作蓝色、红色或黄色染料。如果你给我正确的原材料。

english: What do you need to make red dye?
translation: 制作红色染料需要什么？

english: Hmm.... 3 lots of redberries should do the trick and 25 coins should cover any other costs.
translation: 嗯……3份红莓应该就够了，25枚金币应该能覆盖其他成本。

english: You don't have enough berries to make the red dye.
translation: 你没有足够的浆果来制作红色染料。

english: You don't have enough coins to pay for the dye.
translation: 你没有足够的硬币来支付染料费用。

english: Ok make me some red dye please.
translation: 好的，请给我做一些红色染料。

english: You hand the redberries and some coins to Rana, who then rummages around some shelves, eventually finding a red bottle, which she then hands to you.
translation: 你把红莓和一些硬币交给拉娜，她在架子上翻找了一番，最终找到一瓶红色染料，然后交给你。

english: I don't think I have all the ingredients yet.
translation: 我想我还没有凑齐所有材料。

english: You know what you need to get, now come back when you have them. Goodbye for now.
translation: 你知道你需要什么，凑齐了再来找我。先这样吧。

english: I can do without dye at that price.
translation: 那个价格我还是不用染料了。

english: Fair enough, I still think that the price is fairly reasonable considering that I'm the only source of dye this side of the Shantay pass.
translation: 好吧，不过考虑到沙泰隘口这边只有我一家染料来源，我觉得这价格还算合理。

english: Where would I find a redberry bush?
translation: 我在哪儿能找到红莓丛？

english: Well you could try growing them. They shouldn't be too hard to grow.
translation: 嗯，你可以试试自己种。应该不难种。

english: If I didn't care to grow my own, where else could I get some?
translation: 如果我不想自己种，还能从哪儿弄到一些？

english: Well I know for sure that the desert climate wouldn't suit them. I have mine picked for me in the woods south of Varrock.
translation: 我很确定沙漠气候不适合它们。我的红莓都是有人在维洛克城南边的树林里帮我采的。

english: What do you need to make yellow dye?
translation: 制作黄色染料需要什么？

english: Yellow is an awkward colour to recreate, I guess if you got me 2 onions I could use their skins to make a warm yellow dye for you. Oh yes and lest I forget I'll need 25 coins to cover the cost of the glass ware and
translation: 黄色是个很难调配的颜色，我想如果你给我2个洋葱，我可以用洋葱皮为你制作一种暖黄色染料。还有，我得收25枚金币，

english: my wages.
translation: 算作玻璃瓶的钱和我的劳务费。

english: You don't have enough onions to make the yellow dye.
translation: 你没有足够的洋葱来制作黄色染料。

english: Ok make me some yellow dye please.
translation: 好的，请给我做一些黄色染料。

english: You hand two onions to Rana, who then rummages around some shelves, eventually finding a yellow bottle, which she then hands to you.
translation: 你把两个洋葱交给拉娜，她在架子上翻找了一番，最终找到一瓶黄色染料，然后交给你。

english: Where could I find some onions?
translation: 我在哪儿能找到一些洋葱？

english: Generally you would find onions in vegetable gardens, silly.
translation: 通常你可以在菜园里找到洋葱，傻瓜。

english: Ok you have me there but is there anywhere around here where I could get my hands on some onions?
translation: 好吧你说得对，但这附近有什么地方能弄到洋葱吗？

english: I really don't know. A friend of mine grows hers on a farms near Draynor village. But that's a little far from here to be useful.
translation: 我真不知道。我有个朋友在德雷诺村附近的农场种洋葱。但那儿离这里有点远，不太方便。

english: What do you need to make blue dye?
translation: 制作蓝色染料需要什么？

english: To make a bottle of blue dye I'll need 2 woad leaves and 25 coins from you.
translation: 制作一瓶蓝色染料，我需要你提供2片菘蓝叶和25枚金币。

english: You don't have enough woad leaves to make the blue dye.
translation: 你没有足够的菘蓝叶来制作蓝色染料。

english: Ok make me some blue dye please.
translation: 好的，请给我做一些蓝色染料。

english: You hand the woad leaves and some coins to Rana, who then rummages around some shelves, eventually finding a blue bottle, which she then hands to you.
translation: 你把菘蓝叶和一些硬币交给拉娜，她在架子上翻找了一番，最终找到一瓶蓝色染料，然后交给你。

english: Where can I get some woad leaves?
translation: 我在哪儿能弄到一些菘蓝叶？

english: Woad leaves are fairly rare. My other customers tell me there's a gardener in Falador who grows them.
translation: 菘蓝叶相当稀有。我的其他顾客告诉我法拉多城有个园丁种这个。

english: On second thoughts, I don't think that I need some dye right now.
translation: 再想想，我觉得我现在不需要染料。

english: How did you get into the colour business?
translation: 你是怎么做起染料生意的？

english: Well, it's quite simple reallymy mother was a drysalter and I learnt the trade from her.
translation: 嗯，其实很简单，我母亲是个染料商，我跟她学的手艺。

english: Umm, what's a drysalter, it isn't a medical condition is it?
translation: 嗯，染料商是什么？不是某种疾病吧？

english: No silly, it's someone who deals with preservatives and dyes. I didn't really enjoy the preservative side of things so I've chosen to deal solely in dyeing.
translation: 不，傻瓜，那是经营防腐剂和染料的人。我不太喜欢防腐剂那部分，所以我选择只做染料。

english: So how's business then?
translation: 那生意怎么样？

english: It's a dyeing trade! Oh gosh, I'm sorry, that was a truly dreadful joke.
translation: 这是个''染色''行业！哦天哪，抱歉，这笑话真烂。

english: Hmm yes, about the worst I've heard today at least.
translation: 嗯，是的，至少是我今天听到最烂的笑话。

english: Thanks. But really, it's not the best around here, nearly everyone in this town wears only white, which means I don't exactly do a roaring trade. Now is there anything I can get you?
translation: 谢谢。但说真的，这里生意不太好，镇上几乎人人都只穿白色，这意味着我的生意并不兴隆。现在有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: No thanks, I'm just having a look around.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我只是随便看看。

english: Could you make some dye for me please?
translation: 你能帮我制作一些染料吗？

english: What do you need to make red dye?
translation: 制作红色染料需要什么？

english: Okay, make me some red dye please.
translation: 好的，请给我做一些红色染料。

english: I don't think I have all the ingredients yet.
translation: 我想我还没有凑齐所有材料。

english: I can do without dye at that price.
translation: 那个价格我还是不用染料了。

english: Where would I find a redberry bush?
translation: 我在哪儿能找到红莓丛？

english: What do you need to make yellow dye?
translation: 制作黄色染料需要什么？

english: Okay, make me some yellow dye please.
translation: 好的，请给我做一些黄色染料。

english: Where could I find some onions?
translation: 我在哪儿能找到一些洋葱？

english: What do you need to make blue dye?
translation: 制作蓝色染料需要什么？

english: Okay, make me some blue dye please.
translation: 好的，请给我做一些蓝色染料。

english: Where can I get some woad leaves?
translation: 我在哪儿能弄到一些菘蓝叶？

english: On second thoughts I don't really need any dye.
translation: 再想想，我其实不需要染料。

english: How did you get into the colour business?
translation: 你是怎么做起染料生意的？

english: No thanks, I'm just having a look around.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我只是随便看看。

english: Hello. How can I help you?
translation: 你好，有什么能帮你的吗？

english: Can you give me any Farming advice?
translation: 你能给我一些农业建议吗？

english: Yes - ask a gardener.
translation: 可以——去问园丁。

english: I'm okay, thank you.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

english: What are you selling?
translation: 你在卖什么？

english: Can you give me any Farming advice?
translation: 你能给我一些农业建议吗？

english: I'm okay, thank you.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

english: I'm sorry to bother you, but could you spare me a little dung?
translation: 抱歉打扰你，但能给我一点粪便吗？

english: The camel didn't seem to appreciate that question.
translation: 骆驼似乎不太欣赏这个问题。

english: If I go near that camel, it'll probably bite my hand off.
translation: 如果我靠近那只骆驼，它可能会把我的手咬掉。

english: Mmm... looks like that camel would make a nice kebab.
translation: 嗯……看起来那只骆驼做成烤肉串会不错。

english: I wonder if that camel has fleas...
translation: 不知道那只骆驼有没有跳蚤……

english: Are you serious?
translation: 你是认真的吗？

english: Oh yes. If you'd be so kind...
translation: 哦是的。如果你能行个好……

english: The camel ponders for a moment...
translation: 骆驼思索了片刻……

english: I'm sorry, but I can't really help you right now. Perhaps you should ask me again later, or try a different camel.
translation: 抱歉，我现在真的帮不了你。也许你待会儿再来问我，或者试试别的骆驼。

english: Fair enough.
translation: 好吧。

english: Well, just you close your eyes first. I'm not doing it while you're watching me!
translation: 嗯，你先闭上眼睛。我可不想让你看着我这么做！

english: I hope that's what you wanted!
translation: 希望这就是你想要的！

english: Ohhh yes. Lovely.
translation: 哦是的。太好了。

english: What did you say?
translation: 你说什么？

english: Nothing, nothing.
translation: 没什么，没什么。

english: Well, don't interrupt me, I've got work to do.
translation: 好吧，别打扰我，我有工作要做。

english: Really? What sort of work?
translation: 真的吗？什么工作？

english: I'm participating in the construction of a shopping and sales extravaganza!
translation: 我正在参与一个购物销售盛会的建设！

english: ...What?
translation: ……什么？

english: My masters have me hauling boxes around. There's not much to do at the moment, though.
translation: 我的主人让我搬箱子。不过目前没什么事可做。

english: Are your masters those men called Ali?
translation: 你的主人是那些叫阿里的人吗？

english: Yes, that's them. They're traders working for Ali Morrisane.
translation: 是的，就是他们。他们是替阿里‧莫里桑工作的商人。

english: So, what's it like working for your masters?
translation: 那么，为你的主人工作感觉如何？

english: It's hard work sometimes, but it could be worse.
translation: 有时候工作很辛苦，但还可能更糟。

english: I heard about a pair of camels back in Pollnivneach who were poisoned!
translation: 我听说波尼尼镇有一对骆驼被毒死了！

english: They say someone put spicy sauce in their food.
translation: 据说有人在它们的食物里放了辣酱。

english: Really? That's very cruel of whoever did it.
translation: 真的吗？不管是谁做的都太残忍了。

english: I sincerely hope whoever did it was punished. Do they have no compassion for camels?
translation: 我真心希望作恶者受到了惩罚。他们对骆驼就没有一点同情心吗？

english: Ask the camel about its dung.
translation: 找骆驼讨点粪便。

english: Say something unpleasant.
translation: 说些不愉快的话。

english: Neither - I'm a polite person.
translation: 都不——我是个有礼貌的人。

english: Greetings and welcome to my farming equipment shop. Would you like to buy some equipment?
translation: 欢迎光临我的农业设备店。你想买些设备吗？

english: No, thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Yes, please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No, thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Ah, hello there. Nice to see an outsider for a change. Are you busy? I have a problem.
translation: 啊，你好，很高兴见到个外人换换口味。你忙吗？我有个问题。

english: How can I help?
translation: 我能帮什么忙？

english: It's my son Hudon, he's always getting into trouble. The boy's convinced there's hidden treasure in the river and I'm a bit worried about his safety, the poor lad can't even swim.
translation: 是我儿子胡顿，他总是惹麻烦。这孩子坚信河里有隐藏的宝藏，我有点担心他的安全，可怜的孩子连游泳都不会。

english: I could go and take a look for you if you like?
translation: 如果你愿意，我可以去帮你看看？

english: Would you? You are kind. You can use the small raft out back if you wish, do be careful, the current down stream is very strong.
translation: 你真的愿意？你真好。如果你愿意，可以用后面的小木筏，但要小心，下游的水流湍急。

english: I'm afraid I'm in a rush.
translation: 恐怕我赶时间。

english: Oh okay, never mind.
translation: 哦好吧，没关系。

english: Hello Almera.
translation: 你好，阿尔梅拉。

english: Hello adventurer, how's your treasure hunt going?
translation: 你好，冒险者，你的寻宝进展如何？

english: Oh, I'm just sight seeing.
translation: 哦，我只是观光。

english: No adventurer stays here this long just to sight see. But your business is yours alone, if you need to use the raft go ahead. But please try not to crash it this time!
translation: 没有冒险者会在这里待这么久只为观光。但这是你自己的事，如果你需要用木筏就用吧。但这次请尽量别把它撞坏了！

english: Thank Almera.
translation: 谢谢，阿尔梅拉。

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: Hello, Alomone.
translation: 你好，阿洛蒙。

english: Welcome, adventurer. Know that as a friend to Hazeel, you are always welcome here.
translation: 欢迎，冒险者。要知道作为哈兹尔的朋友，这里永远欢迎你。

english: Hello Madam.
translation: 你好，女士。

english: Oh, hello there.
translation: 哦，你好。

english: Are you ok?
translation: 你没事吧？

english: Not too bad... I've just got some troubles on my mind...
translation: 不太好……我心里有些烦心事……

english: Thank you for rescuing my daughter! Elena has told me of your bravery in entering a house that could have been plague infected. I can't thank you enough!
translation: 谢谢你救了我的女儿！埃琳娜告诉我你勇敢地进入了一栋可能充满瘟疫的房子。我真是不胜感激！

english: They've taken her...
translation: 他们把她带走了……

english: Who?
translation: 谁？

english: Elena! They came and took her away!
translation: 埃琳娜！他们来把她带走了！

english: Oh no! Is there anything I can do?
translation: 哦不！我能做什么吗？

english: I'm not sure... Speak to Edmond, he was there when they took her.
translation: 我不确定……去找埃德蒙，他们带走她时他在场。

english: Thank you so much for helping Elena. It means so much to Edmond and I.
translation: 非常感谢你帮助埃琳娜。这对埃德蒙和我意义重大。

english: I need another tabard.
translation: 我需要另一件战袍。

english: Not a problem. I still have enough materials to make another. Here you go.
translation: 没问题。我还有足够的材料再做一件。给，拿好。

english: It'a not a problem.
translation: 没问题。

english: I need another tabard.
translation: 我需要另一件战袍。

english: It's not a problem.
translation: 没问题。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Good day.
translation: 你好。

english: Good day, Your Royal Highness.
translation: 你好，殿下。

english: Oi!
translation: 喂！

english: Rahr!
translation: 啊！

english: No!
translation: 不！

english: Grr!
translation: 咕噜！

english: Aargh!
translation: 啊！

english: I'm a gonner!
translation: 我完了！

english: It's no use, I'm done for!
translation: 没用了，我死定了！

english: Uggh!
translation: 呃！

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: What brings you to these parts, stranger?
translation: 什么风把你吹到这里来了，陌生人？

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: I suppose it is a little different to the places your type are used to...
translation: 我想这地方跟你这样的人习惯的地方有点不同……

english: This is my humble little hideaway! Plenty of fish around to sustain a man like me, with the help of my trusty cormorant.
translation: 这是我简陋的小隐居地！周围有很多鱼，在我可靠的鸬鹚帮助下，足以养活我这样的人。

english: A bird helps you to fish?
translation: 一只鸟帮你钓鱼？

english: Sure she does! I haven't used a rod in years, just send her out to the waters and she takes care of it for me!
translation: 当然！我好几年没用鱼竿了，只要把她派到水里，她就帮我搞定！

english: Could I have a go with your bird?
translation: 我能试试用你的鸟吗？

english: These birds can be a lot of work... I'm not sure you could handle them, let alone to catch a fish!
translation: 这些鸟可能很难伺候……我不确定你能驾驭它们，更别说抓鱼了！

english: You need 43 Fishing and 35 Hunter to go aerial fishing.
translation: 你需要43级钓鱼和35级狩猎才能进行猛禽式捕鱼。

english: I don't know, I doubt that your type's up to the task...
translation: 我不知道，我怀疑你这样的人胜任不了这任务……

english: But it would be quite the amusing sight. Go on!
translation: 但那会是个有趣的景象。去吧！

english: I'll keep an eye on you and make sure you don't have too much trouble with her!
translation: 我会盯着你，确保你别跟她惹太多麻烦！

english: You're going to need to free up your hands first, though. Nothing in or on your hands.
translation: 不过你得先腾出双手。手上不能拿任何东西，也不能戴东西。

english: I don't think that's for me... I'll leave that to you.
translation: 我想那不适合我……我还是留给你吧。

english: No surprises there! Your type never have been cut out for it.
translation: 不出所料！你这样的人从来就不是干这个的料。

english: What's in the sack?
translation: 袋子里是什么？

english: Oh, this? This is my trusty old fish sack!
translation: 哦，这个？这是我可靠的老鱼袋！

english: Fish sack?
translation: 鱼袋？

english: Yeah, fish sack! I might sell you one if you've found any of those pearls around here.
translation: 是的，鱼袋！如果你在这里找到了一些珍珠，我可能会卖给你一个。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: I found this big fish...
translation: 我发现了这条大鱼……

english: Now that is a biggun! How she managed to wrangle one like that I'll never know.
translation: 那真是条大家伙！我真不知道她是怎么抓到这样的鱼的。

english: If you don't want it, I could take it off your hands for a few of those pearls!
translation: 如果你不想要，我可以用几颗珍珠跟你换！

english: I'm interested... How many pearls are we talking?
translation: 我感兴趣……我们要谈多少颗珍珠？

english: I'll give you a hundred pearls for it. What do you say?
translation: 我给你一百颗珍珠换它。你觉得怎么样？

english: On seconds thoughts, I'd rather keep it.
translation: 再想想，我还是留着它吧。

english: As you wish.
translation: 随你便。

english: It's a deal.
translation: 成交。

english: Pleasure doing business with you!
translation: 很高兴和你做生意！

english: Well, let me know if you change your mind.
translation: 好吧，如果你改变主意就告诉我。

english: Hello again.
translation: 又见面了。

english: Ah, it's you. How are you finding things?
translation: 啊，是你。你觉得怎么样？

english: It certainly is a challenge...
translation: 这确实是个挑战……

english: Yes, your type do often seem to underestimate it! Are you finished?
translation: 是的，你这样的人似乎总是低估它！你完成了吗？

english: Not yet. I think I'll keep trying.
translation: 还没有。我想我会继续尝试。

english: Just come back and let me know when you get tired!
translation: 累了就回来告诉我！

english: I'll try again another time.
translation: 我下次再试。

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: Could I have a go with your bird?
translation: 我能试试用你的鸟吗？

english: I don't think that's for me.
translation: 我想那不适合我。

english: What's in the sack?
translation: 袋子里是什么？

english: Let's take a look.
translation: 让我看看。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: I found this big fish...
translation: 我发现了这条大鱼……

english: It's a deal.
translation: 成交。

english: No, keep the tench.
translation: 不，留着丁鲷吧。

english: Yes, exchange the golden tench.
translation: 是的，交换金色丁鲷。

english: Not yet. I think I'll keep trying.
translation: 还没有。我想我会继续尝试。

english: Yeah, I'll try again another time.
translation: 是的，我下次再试。

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: He seems to be in deep concentration.
translation: 他似乎正全神贯注。

english: ...I'll leave you to it.
translation: ……我就不打扰你了。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Well hello there. Are you hungry? If so you've come to the right place. Eat green, eat gnome cuisine. My waiter will be glad to take your order.
translation: 你好啊。你饿吗？如果是的话你来对地方了。绿色饮食，地精美食。我的服务员会很乐意为你点餐。

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

english: On the other hand, if you're looking for some gnome cooking training, this is also the place to be. My son Lufty is looking for staff at the moment.
translation: 另一方面，如果你在寻找地精烹饪训练，这也是个好地方。我儿子阿卢夫目前正在招聘员工。

english: No thank, I'm no cook.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我不是厨师。

english: In that case, please eat and enjoy.
translation: 既然如此，请慢用。

english: Ok, I'll give it a go.
translation: 好的，我试试。

english: Well that's great. I'm Aluft Gianne, owner of this restaurant, and you are...?
translation: 那太好了。我是阿卢夫‧吉安，这家餐厅的老板，你是……？

english: Most people call me [player name].
translation: 大多数人都叫我[player name]。

english: Really? Sorry, how rude of me. It just takes a little while to get used to the funny names you humans have.
translation: 真的吗？抱歉，只是要习惯你们人类那些古怪的名字还需要点时间。

english: Of course if you're going to work for me I'll have to see what you're like first. Here, take a look at our menu.
translation: 当然，如果你要为我工作，我得先看看你的水平。给，看看我们的菜单。

english: Aluft hands you a cook book.
translation: 阿卢夫递给你一本烹饪书。

english: When you've had a look at the book, come back here and I'll let you prepare a few dishes.
translation: 看完书后回到这里，我会让你准备几道菜。

english: Ok then.
translation: 好的。

english: Hi Mr. Gianne.
translation: 你好，吉安先生。

english: Hello [player name]. So what did you think of the book?
translation: 你好[player name]。你觉得那本书怎么样？

english: I'm not too sure about toad's legs.
translation: 我对蟾蜍腿不太确定。

english: They're a gnome delicacy, very tasty. Chicken tastes like toad's legs you know. You'll love them. If I give you what you need, can you make me some Toad Crunchies?
translation: 那是地精美食，非常美味。你知道吗，鸡肉吃起来像蟾蜍腿。你会喜欢的。如果我给你所需材料，你能给我做一些蟾蜍脆饼吗？

english: I'll give it a go.
translation: 我试试。

english: Aluft gives you two pairs of toad's legs, some gnome spice, some equa leaves, some dough and a crunchy tray.
translation: 阿卢夫给你两对蟾蜍腿、一些地精香料、一些伊库瓦叶、一些面团和一个脆饼托盘。

english: The dough is made according to a secret family recipe. If you need any more, I suggest you speak to Hudo the grocer. He's very reliable.
translation: 面团是根据家族秘方制作的。如果你需要更多，我建议你去跟杂货商胡多谈谈。他很可靠。

english: Let me know how you get on.
translation: 让我知道你的进展。

english: Hi Mr Gianne.
translation: 你好，吉安先生。

english: So how did you get on with the toad crunchies?
translation: 那么蟾蜍脆饼做得怎么样了？

english: I think I've got one.
translation: 我想我做好了一个。

english: That looks identical to the crunchies I cooked not five minutes ago. You'll have to prove to me that you can make one yourself if you want my recommendation.
translation: 那看起来跟我五分钟前做的脆饼一模一样。如果你想得到我的推荐，你得向我证明你能自己做一个。

english: Erm, I've not quite finished it yet.
translation: 呃，我还没完全做好。

english: Ok, let me know when you have.
translation: 好的，做好了告诉我。

english: I'm afraid I've lost the crunchie tray you gave to me.
translation: 恐怕我把你给我的脆饼托盘弄丢了。

english: Ok, I'll give you another one. Obviously I can't expect you to cook without the proper utensils.
translation: 好的，我再给你一个。显然我不能指望你没有合适的厨具就做饭。

english: I've not finished yet.
translation: 我还没做完。

english: Ok, well let me know when you're done.
translation: 好的，做好了告诉我。

english: Call me Aluft. So how did you get on with the toad crunchies?
translation: 叫我阿卢夫就好。那么蟾蜍脆饼做得怎么样了？

english: No problem, it was easy.
translation: 没问题，很简单。

english: You give Aluft the toad crunchies. He takes a bite...
translation: 你把蟾蜍脆饼交给阿卢夫。他咬了一口……

english: Not bad, not bad at all.
translation: 不错，真不错。

english: Ok, now for something you might prefer. Try making some chocolate chip crunchies for me. They're my favourite. Here's everything you need. You can re-use the spice from the last recipe - one tin goes a long way.
translation: 好的，现在来做点你可能更喜欢的。试着给我做一些巧克力碎片脆饼。那是我的最爱。这是你需要的所有材料。你可以重复使用上次配方里的香料——一罐能用很久。

english: Aluft gives you two bars of chocolate, some chocolate dust, and some dough.
translation: 阿卢夫给你两块巧克力、一些巧克力粉和一些面团。

english: Ok Aluft, I'll be back soon.
translation: 好的阿卢夫，我很快回来。

english: Hello Aluft.
translation: 你好阿卢夫。

english: Hello there, how did you get on.
translation: 你好，进展如何。

english: I haven't made it yet.
translation: 我还没做好。

english: It's one trayful of chocolate chip crunchies that I need. Just follow the instructions carefully.
translation: 我需要一盘巧克力碎片脆饼。只要仔细按照说明做就行。

english: Here you go.
translation: 给，拿好。

english: You give Aluft the chocolate crunchies. He takes a bite...
translation: 你把巧克力脆饼交给阿卢夫。他咬了一口……

english: Yes, yes, yes, that's superb. I'm really impressed.
translation: 是，是，是，太棒了。我印象很深刻。

english: Ok then, can you make me a toad batta?  Here's what you need.
translation: 好的，那你能给我做一个蟾蜍芭塔吗？这是你需要的。

english: Aluft gives you some cheese, some dough, some equa leaves, a pair of toad's legs and some more gnome spice.
translation: 阿卢夫给你一些乳酪、一些面团、一些伊库瓦叶、一对蟾蜍腿和更多地精香料。

english: Let me know when the batta is ready.
translation: 芭塔做好了告诉我。

english: Aluft.
translation: 阿卢夫。

english: Sorry, Aluft.
translation: 抱歉，阿卢夫。

english: So where's my toad batta?
translation: 那么我的蟾蜍芭塔呢？

english: That looks identical to the toad batta I cooked not five minutes ago. You'll have to prove to me that you can make one yourself if you want my recommendation.
translation: 那看起来跟我五分钟前做的蟾蜍芭塔一模一样。如果你想得到我的推荐，你得向我证明你能自己做一个。

english: I'm afraid I've lost the batta tin you gave to me.
translation: 恐怕我把你给我的芭塔烤盘弄丢了。

english: I'm afraid I've lost the batta tin you gave to me.
translation: 恐怕我把你给我的芭塔烤盘弄丢了。

english: Ok, be as quick as you can.
translation: 好的，尽量快点。

english: Here you go, that was no problem.
translation: 给你，没问题。

english: You give Aluft the toad batta. He takes a bite...
translation: 你把蟾蜍芭塔交给阿卢夫。他咬了一口……

english: Ooh, that's some good toad. Very nice.
translation: 哦，这蟾蜍肉真不错。很好。

english: Let's see if you can make a cheese and tomato batta next.
translation: 让我们看看你接下来能不能做一个乳酪番茄芭塔。

english: Hello again Aluft.
translation: 又见面了阿卢夫。

english: Hello [player name] have you made my Cheese and tomato Batta?
translation: 你好[player name]，你做好我的乳酪番茄芭塔了吗？

english: That looks identical to the cheese and tomato batta I cooked not five minutes ago. You'll have to prove to me that you can make one yourself if you want my recommendation.
translation: 那看起来跟我五分钟前做的乳酪番茄芭塔一模一样。如果你想得到我的推荐，你得向我证明你能自己做一个。

english: Here, see what you think.
translation: 给，看看你觉得怎么样。

english: You give Aluft the batta. He sniffs it then takes a bite...
translation: 你把芭塔交给阿卢夫。他闻了闻然后咬了一口……

english: Hmm, that's actually really good.
translation: 嗯，这实际上真不错。

english: How about this? Hmmm. I think you may well be ready for real cooking. Well I'm happy to give you my recommendation to Jnr, if that's what you want.
translation: 这个怎么样？嗯。我想你可能已经准备好真正烹饪了。好吧，如果你愿意，我很乐意把你推荐给小吉安。

english: It all came out of the wizards' experiments. They found a way to fold space, so that they could pack many acres of land into an area only a foot across.
translation: 这一切都源于法师们的实验。他们找到了一种折叠空间的方法，这样他们就能把数英亩的土地塞进一个只有一英尺宽的区域里。

english: They created several folded-space regions across Gielinor. Each one contains hundreds of small plots where people can build houses.
translation: 他们在基利诺尔各地创建了几个折叠空间区域。每个区域都包含数百个小地块，人们可以在那里建造房屋。

english: Quite. The wizards didn't want to get bogged down in the business side of things so they hired me to sell the houses.
translation: 没错。法师们不想被商业事务缠身，所以他们雇我来卖房子。

english: There are various other people across Gielinor who can help you furnish your house.

english: You should start by buying planks from a sawmill operator. Sawmills are located in north-east Varrock, the Woodcutting Guild located in south-west Hosidius and north-east Prifddinas.

translation: 跟我讲讲你穿的那件技能斗篷。

translation: 如你所知，技能斗篷只提供给技能大师。我一生都在建造房屋，现在我花时间出售它们！作为我能力的象征，我穿着这件建筑技能斗篷。

english: If you ever have enough skill to build a demonic throne, come and talk to me and I'll sell you a skillcape like mine.
translation: 如果你有足够的技能建造恶魔王座，来找我，我会卖给你一件像我这样的技能斗篷。

english: The Cape of Construction also provides you with as many teleports as you like to any of the house portals or even directly inside!
translation: 建筑斗篷还可以为你提供无限次传送到任何房屋传送门甚至直接进入房屋内部的机会！

english: Can you sell me a Skillcape of Construction?
translation: 你能卖我一件建筑技能斗篷吗？

english: Alright, that'll be 99000 coins, please. A small price to pay for such an illustrious cape that can teleport you to any of the house portals or even directly inside your house!
translation: 好的，请付99,000金币。对于这样一件能让你传送到任何房屋传送门甚至直接进入房屋的杰出斗篷来说，这只是个小价钱！

english: I'm not paying that!
translation: 我才不付那么多！

english: Suit yourself. There are many other heroes who would love the opportunity to purchase one. You can find me here if you change your mind.
translation: 随你便。还有很多英雄渴望有机会购买一件。如果你改变主意，可以来这里找我。

english: But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: 但不幸的是，我身上没带够钱。

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.
translation: 嗯，等你有钱了再来找我。

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 不幸的是，所有技能斗篷都附带免费兜帽，这是技能促销的一部分；买一送一，你懂的。所以你得先腾出一些物品栏空间我才能卖给你。

english: I'm Alyssa the housekeeper and this castle needs constant attention! I've enough trouble with the guards messing up my carpets without you adding to the problem.
translation: 我是管家阿丽莎，这座城堡需要持续照料！守卫们已经把地毯弄得一团糟，够我忙的了，别再给我添乱。

english: Hmm, yeah sorry about that. Speaking of carpets, ever thought how strange that there are carpets beneath the stairs?

english: It's cut to fit! If I had a gold piece for everytime I was asked that question!

english: Sure... Cut to fit... Not an oversight at all.

english: Alright, believe what you like. I've a castle to clean.

english: Are you the Alyssa this entry mentions?
translation: 你就是这条记录里提到的阿丽莎？

english: You show her 'A Dark Disposition'.

english: Ah, I suppose I am.

english: Got anything to say about it?

english: Why should I tell you anything? There are private matters of a late royal family! It wouldn't be proper to divulge such information to an adventurer like you.
translation: 我为什么要告诉你？这可是已故王室的私事！向你这样的冒险者泄露此类信息，实在不妥。

english: ...Most people don't know when to stop sharing. I guess you have a point though.
translation: ……大多数人都不知道适可而止。不过你说的倒也有道理。

english: Yes, I do indeed. Off with you, I've had my fair share of nosy adventurers for one day.
translation: 没错，确实如此。你走吧，好奇的冒险者我今天已经见得够多了。

english: Alright, sorry for disturbing you. Bye.
translation: 好吧，抱歉打扰了。再见。

english: Bye.
translation: 再见。

english: ...Most people don't know when to stop sharing. It's probably worth mentioning that I've found all entries of this memoir.
translation: ……大多数人都不知道适可而止。不过值得一提的是，这本回忆录的所有条目我都已经找到了。

english: Yes, how did you come across this? I'm fairly certain it was destroyed... At least, I recall seeing a man removing the pages...
translation: 是的，你怎么找到这个的？我很确定它被销毁了……至少，我记得看到一个人把书页拿走了……

english: Honestly, I've never really questioned it. I do things for people and they give me things.
translation: 说实话，我从没仔细想过这个问题。我帮人办事，人家给我报酬。

english: Well, I suppose if you've already nosily rifled through the princesses personal memoirs, I can tell you a little more.
translation: 好吧，既然你都偷偷翻遍了公主的私人回忆录，那我不妨多告诉你一些。

english: Fantastic! I've got to say, there's some great little gems in this old book. I think I'm unravelling a great mystery!
translation: 太棒了！不得不说，这本旧书里藏着不少精彩的小线索。我感觉自己正在解开一个惊天谜团！

english: Well, if I were you I'd keep shush on the whole matter.
translation: 嗯，换作是我，我会对整个事情守口如瓶。

english: How come?
translation: 为什么？

english: You must be new here. When the king died, everyone assumed the princess would take the throne when she came of age.
translation: 你肯定是新来的吧。国王驾崩时，人人都以为公主成年后便会继承王位。

english: But the council kept control...
translation: 可议会却牢牢掌控着大权……

english: Indeed, and poor young Rose was shipped off and labelled as crazy.
translation: 确实如此，可怜的罗斯公主年纪轻轻就被送走，还被扣上了疯子的帽子。

english: I do very much miss her, but one can't change the past.
translation: 我确实很想念她，可往事已矣，无法挽回。

english: What if I were to say she's still out there! Read this entry that I found hidden within a secret part of the memoir.
translation: 要是我说她其实还活着呢！你看看这条记录，是我在回忆录的隐秘之处发现的。

english: I'm sorry adventurer, but what does this prove exactly? For all you know someone else wrote this to mislead you.
translation: 抱歉了冒险者，但这究竟能证明什么呢？说不定是有人故意写了这个来误导你。

english: Ah, you do make a good point...
translation: 啊，你说的倒也有道理……

english: If she did write this I'm afraid to say she must be mad after all.
translation: 若这真是她所写，恐怕她终究还是疯了。

english: What makes you say that?
translation: 为什么这么说？

english: Are all adventurers as dense as you? If you were in danger, do you really think leaving a hidden message in an old lost book for any stranger to pick up is the best way to get help?
translation: 难道所有冒险者都像你这般迟钝不成？若你真身处险境，难道真会觉得在一本遗失的旧书中留下隐秘讯息、任由陌生人拾取，是求援的最佳法子？

english: It's certainly peculiar, but it should be investigated regardless. Y'know, just in case...
translation: 这确实很奇怪，但无论如何都应该调查一下。你知道，以防万一……

english: Alright, spring the trap! Don't come crying to me when it all turns sour.
translation: 好吧，那你就去触发陷阱吧！等事情搞砸了可别来找我哭诉。

english: Don't you worry! I'm a brave adventurer with a damsel in distress to rescue! This is my bread and butter.
translation: 别担心！我是个勇敢的冒险者，要去拯救落难少女！这是我的拿手好戏。

english: Yes, yes, of course. Well, I'd be glad to hear of her being safe but perhaps you should heed the warning.
translation: 嗯，听到她平安无事我自然高兴，但或许你还是该听劝一句。

english: Which warning?
translation: 什么警告？

english: Tread carefully.
translation: 小心行事。

english: Oh, of course! Thanks for chatting with me Alyssa, I'll see you around.
translation: 那是自然！多谢你肯跟我聊这些，阿丽莎，后会有期。

english: Farewell.
translation: 告辞。

english: I'm sorry, but I'm not paid to serve every lazy adventurer who walks their dirty feet through my halls!
translation: 抱歉，我没拿工资去伺候每个把脏脚踩进我大厅的懒惰冒险者！

english: Sorry, I'll be going.
translation: 抱歉，那我先走了。

english: Just making small talk.
translation: 只是随便聊聊。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Headman Ur-tag, I cannot stress enough how important it is that this train link be completed on time. The mining companies have taken out considerable loans...
translation: 乌尔 - 塔格头领，这条铁路专线务必按时完工，其重要性我再怎么强调也不为过。矿业公司已贷下巨额款项……

english: I understand your concerns, Ambassador, but you must realise that the discoveries must change the whole schedule. To remove them too hurriedly would be a crime against knowledge.
translation: 大使，您的担忧我理解，但您必须明白，这些发现势必会打乱整个工期。若过于匆忙地将它们移除，那简直是对知识的亵渎。

english: What are you talking about?
translation: 你在说什么？

english: It's the new underground train link being built between our city and the dwarven city of Keldagrim.
translation: 说的是正在我方城池与矮人城池凯尔达格林之间修建的新地下铁路专线。

english: Shh! What if they're a human spy come to steal our engineering secrets?
translation: 嘘！万一他们是人类派来的间谍，专程来窃取我们的工程机密呢？

english: You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Another Slice of H.A.M. quest.
translation: 你尚未满足开启另一个反怪物人联任务的全部条件。

english: It will be the pinnacle of dwarven engineering! A great leap forward from the old steam-powered minecarts! A monument to the power and ingenuity of the Consortium!
translation: 这将是矮人工程学的巅峰之作！比旧的蒸汽动力矿车前进了一大步！这是财团力量和智慧的纪念碑！

english: And it would be finished by now, except that they found some old goblin bones they want to dig up.
translation: 本来现在应该完工了，除非他们发现了一些想挖出来的旧哥布林骨头。

english: We've unearthed some very important artefacts that were buried during the Dorgeshuun Civil War. They could shed important light on our history.
translation: 我们发掘出了一些于多格舒恩内战期间埋藏的重要文物，它们或许能为我族历史揭开关键一页。

english: [player name], do you have any experience with archaeology?
translation: [player name]，你可有考古方面的经验吗？

english: I passed my archaeology exam at the Digsite!
translation: 我在考古挖掘场通过了考古考试！

english: Excellent! We have not had a major archaeological project for generations, so if you could give us some help we would appreciate it.
translation: 太好了！我们几代人都没有进行过大型考古项目了，所以如果你能帮我们一些忙，我们将不胜感激。

english: I'd love to help!
translation: 我很乐意帮忙！

english: Splendid! The path to the train tunnel is in the south- west of the city.
translation: 太好了！通往火车隧道的路径在城市的西南边。

english: Perhaps now we can get this finished quickly and get on with laying the tracks.
translation: 也许现在我们可以快点完成这个，继续铺设轨道。

english: Do your own digging!
translation: 你自己挖去吧！

english: Oh well. We will continue at our own pace.
translation: 哦好吧。我们会按自己的节奏继续。

english: What can I do in the city?
translation: 我在城里能做什么？

english: Why don't you visit the market? I hear there is quite a craze for surface foods at the moment, so you might be able to sell something there.
translation: 你为什么不去市场看看？我听说现在地表食物很流行，也许你可以在那儿卖些东西。

english: You might also want to visit the caves to the south of the city. There are many monsters to fight there, and Zanik apparently found ways to cross over their heads!
translation: 你可能也想去城市南边的洞穴看看。那里有很多怪物可以打，扎尼克显然找到了越过它们头顶的方法！

english: Why did you decide to open the city?
translation: 你为什么决定开放城市？

english: For trade, and for fostering goodwill between races! I am sure that it will benefit both our races.
translation: 为了贸易，也为了促进种族间的友好关系！我相信这将惠及我们两个种族。

english: It's funny... whenever we dwarves have ventured onto the surface, we've found ourselves at war with the goblins there.
translation: 真有趣……每当我们矮人冒险到地表，总会发现自己在和那里的哥布林打仗。

english: But now we meet these goblins underground, and they're no threat at all. Maybe this will herald a change in our relations with the surface goblins as well.
translation: 但现在我们在地下遇到了这些哥布林，他们根本不构成威胁。也许这也将预示着我们与地表哥布林关系的改变。

english: I can't stand these goblins sometimes! I come up with suggestions to make their city more efficient, and they just say it would spoil their precious way of life!
translation: 有时候我真受不了这些哥布林！我提出让他们的城市更高效的建议，他们却说这会破坏他们珍贵的生活方式！

english: Trade with the goblins is going well at the moment. It's a pity they don't seem as interested in our beer as in your food, though!
translation: 目前与哥布林的贸易进展顺利。不过可惜他们似乎对我们的啤酒不如对你的食物感兴趣！

english: Thank you again for helping us complete the train link. Further delays would have cost the Consortium a lot of money.
translation: 再次感谢你帮助我们完成铁路链接。进一步的延误会让财团损失很多钱。

english: Oh, and I hear you saved someone's life as well. Well done on that count too.
translation: 哦，我还听说你救了一条命。那方面也做得很好。

english: I miss Keldagrim. This city is all very well, but no one makes an underground city like the dwarves!
translation: 我想念凯尔达格林城。这座城市很好，但没人能像矮人那样建造地下城市！

english: Answer this, please.
translation: 请回答这个。

english: Well done.
translation: 做得好。

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: What are you arguing about?
translation: 你们在争论什么？

english: What can I do in the city?
translation: 我在城里能做什么？

english: Why did you decide to open the city?
translation: 你为什么决定开放城市？

english: Hello Ambassador. Are you here visiting King Roald?
translation: 你好大使。你是来拜访罗尔德国王的吗？

english: Well, in theory, but he always seems to be busy.
translation: 嗯，理论上是的，但他似乎总是很忙。

english: You don't seem that upset by that, though...
translation: 不过你似乎对此并不太难过……

english: Oh no, I like travelling, and if you become a diplomat patience is a vital skill.
translation: 哦不，我喜欢旅行，如果你成为外交官，耐心是一项至关重要的技能。

english: I'll try to remember that.
translation: 我会尽量记住的。

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 虽然你找到了顾客，但你似乎没带正确的食物！你需要[a/some][ordered gnome food/drink item]！

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 恐怕预制菜不行。只有手工制作的地精美食才配得上高空阿卢夫的顾客。

english: You hand over your delivery of [item] to Ambassador Ferrnook
translation: 你把[item]配送交给费尔努克大使

english: Excellent. A taste of home.
translation: 太好了。家乡的味道。

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: 你一定走了很远的路才把这个送到我这里，这里有点额外的小意思，拿着当小费。

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
translation: 你有 [number] 积分可以兑换免费配送代币。你还没有资格获得地精美食配送。

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 你有 [amount] 积分可以兑换免费配送代币。你可以获得 [amount] 份地精美食配送。

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: 别忘了从小阿卢夫‧吉安那里领取你的免费配送代币。

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 你的配送太晚了！回去找小阿卢夫再拿一份订单。你扔掉了配送箱，因为不再需要它了。

english: I can't believe that I've been made to wait so long.
translation: 真不敢相信让我等了这么久。

english: What are you waiting for?
translation: 你在等什么？

english: I have been waiting for an audience with the King for days!
translation: 我已经等了好几天要觐见国王！

english: Well, he's clearly a busy man.
translation: 嗯，他显然是个大忙人。

english: Bah! I think he's just trying to insult the gnome nation, by making me wait. The cheek of these humans. Just because they're vertically challenged they think they can ignore us.
translation: 呸！我觉得他只是想通过让我等待来侮辱地精民族。这些人类真厚颜无耻。就因为他们身材矮小，就以为可以无视我们。

english: I'm not ignoring you.
translation: 我没无视你。

english: Hmm. I should be thankful for small mercies, I suppose.
translation: 嗯。我想我应该为这点小恩惠感到感激。

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 虽然你找到了顾客，但你似乎没带正确的食物！你需要[a/some][ordered gnome food/drink item]！

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.

english: You hand over your delivery of [item] to Ambassador Gimblewap
translation: 你把你的个[item] 配送交给金布尔瓦普大使

english: Many thanks. This will help wile away the time whilst I'm waiting for an audience.
translation: 多谢。这有助于消磨我等待觐见的时间。

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: 你一定走了很远的路才把这个送到我这里，这里有点额外的小意思，拿着当小费。

translation: 你的配送太晚了！回去找小阿卢夫再拿一份订单。你扔掉了配送箱，因为不再需要它了。

english: It's all very bright round here, isn't it?
translation: 这里周围都很明亮，不是吗？

english: Well, it is the White Knights' Castle.
translation: 嗯，这是白骑士城堡。

english: I think it would all look better in a nice dark green. At least then I wouldn't be squinting all the time.
translation: 我觉得要是漂亮的深绿色会更好看。至少那样我就不必一直眯着眼睛了。

english: Yes, but then they'd have to become the Dark Green Knights. Doesn't really have the same ring to it.
translation: 是的，但那样他们就得变成深绿骑士了。听起来不太顺耳。

english: Bah, humans have no sense of style...
translation: 呸，人类没有品味……

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 虽然你找到了顾客，但你似乎没带正确的食物！你需要[a/some][ordered gnome food/drink item]！

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 恐怕预制菜不行。只有手工制作的地精美食才配得上高空阿卢夫的顾客。

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Ambassador Spanfipple
translation: 你把你的[a/some][ordered gnome food/drink item] 配送交给斯潘菲波大使

english: Thank you kindly. I haven't got used to this human food and drink yet.
translation: 非常感谢。我还没习惯这种人类食物和饮料。

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: 你一定走了很远的路才把这个送到我这里，这里有点额外的小意思，拿着当小费。

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
