english: This is the Emir's Arena. Fighters come from far and wide to arrange fights against their friends and rivals. They can fight in 1v1 Tournaments or Duels.
translation: 这是埃米尔竞技场。战士们从四面八方赶来，与亲友或对手约战。他们可参加1v1锦标赛或决斗。

english: The Arena is open only on PvP Arena worlds. Switch to one of those game worlds to play in the Arena.
translation: 竞技场仅在 PvP 竞技场世界上开放。切换到那些游戏世界之一才能在竞技场中游玩。

english: Head over to the hospital north of the Arena, and speak to the Guides. They'll help you sign up to a fight. Now, can I help you with anything else?
translation: 前往竞技场北边的医院，与向导交谈。他们会帮你报名战斗。现在，还有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: The Emir of Al Kharid has decreed that his Arena should be guarded, to stop ruffians like the Calamity Coven from returning. But is there something I can do for you?
translation: 阿尔卡里德城的首长已下令守卫竞技场，以防灾厄女巫团这类恶棍卷土重来。不过有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: Tell me about the Calamity Coven.
translation: 跟我讲讲灾厄女巫团。

english: The Calamity Coven were three brigands, followers of an ancient and derelict religion. Through their foul arts, they turned this Arena into a hotbed of corruption.
translation: 灾厄女巫团是三个强盗组成，信奉一个古老而没落的宗教。凭借邪恶技艺，他们将这座竞技场变成了腐败的温床。

english: Maoma was a captain of the Emir's guard, but she abused her authority to rig fights so that the Coven would get rich at the people's expense.
translation: 玛奥玛曾是埃米尔守卫的队长，却滥用职权操纵比赛，使巫会以民众为代价敛财。

english: Saika was the brains behind their operation, forging the Arena's accounts so that the Coven could keep all the profits, starving the Emir's public works of all funding.
translation: 赛卡是他们行动的智囊，伪造竞技场账目，使巫会独吞全部利润，导致埃米尔的公共工程资金枯竭。

english: Koriff used her charms to act as a gracious hostess, whipping up the crowds' excitement so that they'd gamble more and more unwisely, enriching the Coven.
translation: 科里夫凭借魅力扮作亲切优雅的女主人，煽动人群狂热，诱使他们愈发不计后果地下注，使巫会大发横财。

english: The Calamity Coven are long gone now; some of their old possessions are even being sold as rewards. Now, we are here to prevent a resurgence in such crime. But is there something I can do for you?
translation: 灾厄女巫团早已销声匿迹，其部分旧物甚至被作为奖励出售。如今我们在此防止此类罪行死灰复燃。不过有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: Do you have any tips on how to win duels?
translation: 你有什么关于如何赢得决斗的建议吗？

english: The easiest way to win is to knock your opponent out in one blow!
translation: 最简单的获胜方法是一击击倒你的对手！

english: But I can't hit that hard!
translation: 但我打不出那么重！

english: Don't stop believing.
translation: 别放弃信念。

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

english: Please stay within the Arena's boundaries.
translation: 请待在竞技场边界内。

translation: 在 PvP 竞技场世界上，你只能使用 PvP 竞技场。若想使用常规角色游玩，请切换至其他世界。

english: Respect the souls, traveller.
translation: 请尊重这些灵魂，旅行者。

english: Why are all these souls here?
translation: 为什么所有这些灵魂都在这里？

english: A corporeal body is a mere flesh-temple in which the soul dwells. As the body fails, the soul loses its home. Without guidance, it would drift into oblivion.
translation: 肉体不过是灵魂居住的血肉圣殿。当身体衰败，灵魂便失去家园。没有指引，它便会飘入虚无。

english: However, the Soul Altar provides a beacon, drawing the souls to this place where they may join the River.
translation: 然而，灵魂祭坛提供了一座灯塔，将灵魂吸引到这个地方，使它们可以加入冥河。

english: The River leads the souls through unchartable realms, transcending the plane of the world as you see it, but the three-headed Guardian keeps them safe.
translation: 冥河引导灵魂穿越无法绘制的领域，超越你所见的世界平面，但三头守护者保护它们安全。

english: The souls are the dead of Kourend - ensure you respect the souls.
translation: 这些灵魂是库兰德王国的死者——请务必尊重他们。

english: Why are you here?
translation: 你为什么在这里？

english: I am here to salute the dead of Kourend whose souls are joining the River. Ensure you respect the souls.
translation: 我来此向魂归冥河的库兰德逝者致敬。请务必尊重他们。

english: I've been reading your book: 'The Journey of Souls'
translation: 我一直在读你的书：《灵魂之旅》

english: Let me guess, traveller... did you come to ask me where the soul bearer was buried? Every mortal who reads my book seems to want to get their hands on it.
translation: 让我猜猜，旅行者……你是来问我灵魂载体埋在哪里的吗？每个读我书的凡人都似乎想得到它。

english: Mortals are so predictable. This is the kind of thinking that led that adventurer to break into the Guardian's cave and damage the soul bearer in the first place.
translation: 凡人总是这么好猜。正是这种念头，才让那名冒险者当初闯入守护者洞穴，损毁了灵魂载体。

english: It occurs to me, though, that even if you dig it up, the artefact is damaged. Although the Elders of Arceuus never had the knowledge to repair it, there is one who may be able to help.
translation: 不过我想到，即使你把它挖出来，神器也损坏了。尽管阿西乌斯城的长老们从未掌握修复之法，但或许有一人能施以援手。

english: I speak of the Key Master, he who watches over the cave of the three-headed Guardian of the River. He has been there for countless years, and will have absorbed power from the River in that time.
translation: 我说的是钥匙守护者，他看守着三头河流守护者的洞穴。他在那里待了无数年，在此期间吸收了来自冥河的力量。

english: Now, we buried the artefact in the crypt of the Arceuus church. As I have revealed this secret to you, you will no longer be affected by the spells that prevent unwary explorers from stumbling across it.

english: A rare carnivorous plant originally from Morytania. When grown, the plant becomes conscious and highly aggressive. They are truly fascinating.
translation: 一种原产于莫利塔尼亚的稀有食肉植物。长大后，植物会变得有意识且极具攻击性。它们真的很迷人。

english: Can I grow one?

english: Of course. Just plant some Hespori seeds in the cave below and it will grow like any other plant. A Hespori is pretty tough so you don't need to worry about it getting diseased.
translation: 当然，只要在下面的洞穴里种一些赫斯波里种子，它就会像其他植物一样生长。赫斯波里很顽强，所以你不用担心它生病。

english: Do be careful though. A fully grown Hespori can be quite troublesome to deal with.
translation: 不过要小心。成熟的赫斯波里可能很难对付。

english: Do you need anything else?
translation: 你还需要别的吗？

english: Do you have any of my items?

english: I'm afraid not. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.
translation: 恐怕没有。如果我确实有你的任何物品，但你在收集前死了，它们现在就会丢失。

english: I do indeed. You really should be more careful.
translation: 我确实有。你真的应该更小心点。

english: I don't want to find Hespori seeds when farming.

english: I want to find Hespori seeds when farming.
translation: 我想耕种时找到赫斯波里种子。

english: Very well. You'll now have a chance of finding Hespori seeds when farming.
translation: 很好。你现在耕种时将有机会找到赫斯波里种子。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: I'm afraid I don't have anything for you. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.
translation: 恐怕我没有什么给你的。如果我确实有你的任何物品，但你在收集前死了，它们现在就会丢失。

english: Can you hear me down there? I have some of your items, from a previous visit. Shouldn't you collect them from me before fighting the Hespori again?
translation: 你能听到我在下面说话吗？我有一些你的物品，来自上次前往。你不应该在再次对抗赫斯波里之前从我这里收集它们吗？

translation: 谢谢你帮我找到剑。你找到所有人的物品了吗？

english: I did! Thank you for the reward.

english: You're more than welcome to it, for getting our belongings back.

He looks too sick to chat.

english: Looks to me like you're the only one.
translation: 在我看来你是唯一一个。

english: This is true. However, in the future, I will have my own entire floor of the Museum with paintings galore!
translation: 这是真的。然而，在未来，我将拥有博物馆整整一层楼，挂满画作！

english: Er... has that been approved, or are you just dreaming?
translation: 呃……那被批准了吗，还是你只是在做梦？

english: Ah, I see you're being witty, eh?
translation: 啊，我看你很诙谐，嗯？

english: I am?
translation: 我？

english: Yes! You're poking fun at me! I shall have my gallery. You will see eventually. Then I shall be the one with the last laugh!
translation: 是的！你在取笑我！我将拥有我的画廊。你迟早会看到的。那时我将是笑到最后的人！

english: What do you do here?

english: I critique the art! See the beautiful colours and the masterful use of the brush to capture perfectly the royal presence...
translation: 我鉴赏艺术！看这美丽的色彩和精湛的笔触完美捕捉了皇室的存在……

english: Yes, I see!
translation: 是的，我明白了！

english: And look at the use of shade and contrast - isn't it just magnificent?
translation: 再看这阴影和对比的运用——难道不宏伟吗？

english: So it is. So perfect, it almost makes me weep with joy! The grandiloquent strokes of the brush convey a kind of mystic quality... It is almost as if he were here with us.
translation: 确实是。如此完美，几乎让我喜极而泣！宏大的笔触传达了一种神秘的品质……几乎就像他与我们在一起。

english: No words can truly describe my feelings, so let us continue to admire this work in silence.
translation: 没有任何言语能真正描述我的感受，所以让我们继续在沉默中欣赏这幅作品。

translation: 啊致以许多问候和欢迎来到博物馆！

english: Ahh, good. Zis verse is from a poem by a most talented writer of ze poetry, Charles Baudelaire. My father would place me on 'is knee and read to me like zis...

english: What can I do for you?
translation: 有什么能帮你的？

english: What are beginner clues?
translation: 什么是新手线索？

english: Arthur's eyes light up.
translation: 亚瑟的眼睛亮了起来。

english: Beginner clues are the lowest tier of clue scroll and as such only require a couple of steps to solve.
translation: 新手线索是最低等级的线索卷轴，因此只需要几步就能完成。

english: Beginner clues are gained through various activities. Those activities are as follows.
translation: 新手线索通过各种活动获得。这些活动如下。

english: Slaying monsters for a chance at a clue being dropped. I hear goblins are sneaky, maybe they have some clue scrolls on them ripe for the taking.
translation: 击杀怪物有机会掉落线索。我听说哥布林很狡猾，也许他们身上有一些可以拿的线索卷轴。

english: Maybe someone left one in the cow field, who knows where you could obtain them.
translation: 也许有人把线索留在了奶牛场，谁知道你在哪儿能获得它们。

english: Beginner clues have also been known to be left in geodes while mining, as well as sometimes in bottles that you may fish up from time to time and from nests which fall out of trees.
translation: 已知新手线索也会在采矿时从晶球中获得，有时也会从钓到的瓶子或树上掉落的鸟巢里找到。

english: Although this is a much rarer occurrence.
translation: 虽然这种情况要罕见得多。

english: Unlike more advanced clues, you should not expect to get very valuable items from completing a beginner clue.
translation: 与更高级的线索不同，你不应该指望从完成新手线索中获得非常有价值的物品。

english: What are more advanced clues?
translation: 什么是更高级的线索？

english: Advanced clues have tiers between easy and master.
translation: 高级线索分为简单到大师之间的各个等级。

english: You can gain advanced clues the same way you would get a beginner clue. But to get higher tier scrolls you will need to defeat more powerful foes.
translation: 你可以通过与获得新手线索相同的方式获得高级线索。但要获得更高等级的卷轴，你需要击败更强大的敌人。

english: The chance to get a higher tier clue from geodes, bottles and nests is lower the higher the tier. But if you chop down higher-level trees you will have a higher chance of receiving a nest which contains a clue. Same with fishing and mining.
translation: 从晶球、瓶子和鸟巢中获得更高等级线索的几率随着等级升高而降低。但如果你砍伐更高级的树，你将有更高的几率收到包含线索的鸟巢。钓鱼和采矿也一样。

english: The only exception to this is master clue scrolls.
translation: 唯一的例外是大师线索卷轴。

english: Master clues can only be obtained as a rare chance when opening your casket or by handing in one of every type of clue, apart from beginner, to Watson who resides in Hosidius.
translation: 大师线索只能在开启宝箱时作为稀有奖励获得，或者通过向居住在霍西迪乌斯城的沃森提交除新手外的每种线索各一份来获得。

english: But with more advanced tiers of clue, come better loot.
translation: 但随着更高级别的线索，会有更好的战利品。

english: This type of clue has you talk to someone around Gielinor. Although the clue does not tell you exactly who to talk to.
translation: 这种线索让你与基利诺尔各地的某人交谈。虽然线索不会确切告诉你跟谁交谈。

english: You will see a couple of words that may or may not make sense together. You will have to rearrange the letter to make the name of the person you need to talk to.
translation: 你会看到几个词，它们可能有意义也可能没意义。你必须重新排列字母以组成你需要交谈的人的名字。

english: This type of clue has you work out a logical problem for the person you need to talk to. This type of challenge only appears in clue tiers medium, hard and elite.
translation: 这类线索需要你为交谈对象解决一个逻辑问题。这类挑战只出现在中等、困难和精英线索等级中。

english: There are also challenges that will involve you gathering an item or crafting an item for a certain person.
translation: 还有一些挑战需要你为特定的人收集物品或制作物品。

english: This type of clue has you talk to someone around Gielinor. Although the clue does not tell you exactly who to talk to. This type of challenge only appears in clue tiers medium, hard and elite.
translation: 这类线索需要你与基利诺尔各地的某人交谈。虽然线索不会确切告诉你跟谁交谈。这类挑战只出现在中等、困难和精英线索等级中。

english: A cipher is a string of letters that have been scrambled using the shift cipher method.
translation: 密码是一串使用移位密码方法打乱的字母。

english: An example of this would be ZCZL which, shifted forward by one, would be Adam.
translation: 例如 ZCZL，向前移位一位就是 Adam。

english: This type of clue will have you use a sextant, chart and a watch to find out the place you will need to dig. This type of challenge only appears in clue tiers medium and above.
translation: 这类线索需要你使用六分仪、海图和怀表找出需要挖掘的地点。这类挑战只出现在中等及以上线索等级中。

english: After you find the place you need to dig, you may find a casket or another scroll.
translation: 找到需要挖掘的地点后，你可能会发现一个宝箱或另一份卷轴。

english: This type of clue can be as simple as talk to the specified person or searching a crate in a specified location.
translation: 这类线索可能很简单，比如与指定的人交谈或在指定地点搜索箱子。

english: But the higher the tier of clue, the more steps you will have to do beforehand. An example of this would be needing to find a key before opening a chest.
translation: 但线索等级越高，你事先需要完成的步骤就越多。例如需要在打开箱子前先找到钥匙。

english: This type of clue will give you a location that you will need to visit, along with some items you will need.
translation: 这类线索会给你一个需要前往的地点，以及你需要携带的一些物品。

english: At this location you will need to perform an emote, as well as wear the items that you had to bring along.
translation: 在这个地点你需要做一个表情动作，并穿上你必须携带的物品。

english: Some clues may have you wear nothing at all.
translation: 有些线索可能要求你什么都不穿。

english: But please don't do that in public!
translation: 但请不要在公共场合这样做！

english: This type of challenge only appears in clue tiers medium and above.
translation: 这类挑战只出现在中等及以上线索等级中。

english: Depending on the tier of clue, you will need to obtain a strange device from either Reldo, located in Varrock, or Jorral, located south of Tree Gnome Stronghold.
translation: 根据线索等级，你需要从位于维洛克城的雷尔多，或位于地精要塞南边的乔拉尔那里获得一个奇怪装置。

english: You will then need to use this device to find the location you will need to dig.
translation: 然后你需要使用这个装置找到需要挖掘的地点。

english: There are many different puzzles that you can come across while doing clues. These range from light boxes to puzzle boxes.
translation: 在做线索时你会遇到许多不同的谜题。从灯箱到谜题盒都有。

english: Puzzle boxes are puzzles that will have you complete a slider puzzle that, when complete, will look like an image in game.
translation: 谜题盒是一种滑块谜题，完成后会看起来像游戏中的图像。

english: Light boxes are a puzzle which contains a 5 by 5 grid of lights with some lights on and some lights off.
translation: 灯箱是一种谜题，包含一个5x5的灯格，有些灯亮着，有些灯灭着。

english: The puzzle will have you click the buttons below to turn on or off some of the lights with the end goal being, having all the lights turned on.
translation: 谜题需要你点击下方的按钮来打开或关闭某些灯，最终目标是让所有灯都亮起。

english: This type of clue will show you a map of an area.
translation: 这类线索会向你展示一个区域的地图。

english: This map will show you where you will need to dig, or what you will need to search to get the next clue.
translation: 这张地图会显示你需要挖掘的地点，或者你需要搜索什么以获得下一条线索。

english: This type of clue will show you which fairy ring code you will need to use to get to the right place to dig.
translation: 这类线索会显示你需要使用哪个仙女环代码才能到达正确的挖掘地点。

english: You will then need to use the numbers to figure our where you will need to dig after arriving to your destination.
translation: 然后你需要使用数字来计算到达目的地后需要挖掘的具体位置。

english: Hey Arthur, can I stop receiving clues from vessels? They're clogging up my backpack!
translation: 嘿亚瑟，我能停止从容器中接收线索吗？它们把我的背包都塞满了！

english: Vessel containers include mining geodes, fishing bottles and clue nests. Are you sure you want to stop receiving them?
translation: 容器包括采矿晶球、钓鱼瓶和线索鸟巢。你确定要停止接收它们吗？

english: Yes please, I want to stop receiving vesseled containers.
translation: 是的，我想停止接收容器中的线索。

english: Very well, you'll no longer find clues from mining, fishing and woodcutting.
translation: 很好，你将不再从采矿、钓鱼和伐木中发现线索。

english: Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 还有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: Hey Arthur, can I start receiving clues from vessels?
translation: 嘿亚瑟，我能开始从容器中接收线索吗？

english: Vessel containers include mining geodes, fishing bottles and clue nests. Are you sure you want to start receiving them, again?
translation: 容器包括采矿晶球、钓鱼瓶和线索鸟巢。你确定要再次开始接收它们吗？

english: Yes please, I want to start receiving vesseled containers.
translation: 是的，我想开始接收容器中的线索。

english: Very well, you'll now find clues from mining, fishing and woodcutting.
translation: 很好，你现在将从采矿、钓鱼和伐木中发现线索。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: So long and happy clue hunting!
translation: 再见，祝线索狩猎愉快！

english: I've got it!
translation: 我找到了！

english: I'm going to be rich!
translation: 我要发财了！

english: Hmm.... What could this mean?
translation: 嗯……这可能是什么意思？

english: Why is this so hard...
translation: 为什么这么难……

english: Why did I not think of that before.
translation: 为什么我之前没想到那个。

english: Ask about beginner clues.
translation: 询问新手线索。

english: Ask about more advanced clues.
translation: 询问更高级的线索。

english: Ask about the types of clues.
translation: 询问线索类型。

english: Anagrams.
translation: 字谜。

english: Challenge scrolls.
translation: 挑战卷轴。

english: Cipher clues.
translation: 密码线索。

english: Coordinate clues.
translation: 坐标线索。

english: Cryptic clues.
translation: 隐晦线索。

english: Emote clues.
translation: 表情动作线索。

english: Hot Cold clues.
translation: 热冷线索。

english: Puzzle clues.
translation: 谜题线索。

english: Map clues.
translation: 地图线索。

english: Fairy ring clues.
translation: 仙女环线索。

english: Toggle gaining vesseled clue scrolls.
translation: 切换是否从容器中获取线索卷轴。

english: Yes please, I want to stop receiving vesseled containers.
translation: 是的，我想停止接收容器中的线索。

english: Nevermind.
translation: 没关系。

english: Yes please, I want to start receiving vesseled containers
translation: 是的，我想开始接收容器中的线索。

english: Nilsal. Here to do some crafting? I've got some supplies that might help you if so.
translation: 你好，来这里做点什么吗？如果是的话，我有些补给可能帮得上你。

english: What do you have?
translation: 你有什么？

english: Have a look.
translation: 看看。

english: Just passing through, thanks.
translation: 只是路过，谢谢。

english: Well come back if you change your mind.
translation: 嗯，如果你改变主意就回来。

english: What do you have?
translation: 你有什么？

english: Just passing through, thanks.
translation: 只是路过，谢谢。

english: Greetings, friend; my business here deals with Hunter related items. Is there anything in which I can interest you?
translation: 你好，我这里的生意是狩猎相关物品。有什么能让你感兴趣的吗？

english: What kinds of items do you stock?
translation: 你储备什么样的物品？

english: Take a look for yourself.
translation: 你自己看看。

english: I'm not in the market for Hunter equipment right now, thanks.
translation: 我现在不需要狩猎装备，谢谢。

english: Maybe another time, then.
translation: 那也许下次吧。

english: What kinds of items do you stock?
translation: 你储备什么样的物品？

english: I'm not in the market for Hunter equipment right now, thanks.
translation: 我现在不需要狩猎装备，谢谢。

english: Hello again Artur.
translation: 又见面了，阿图尔。

english: Hello [player name]. Thanks for your help in recovering the Accord.
translation: 你好 [player name]。谢谢你帮助找回协议。

english: No problem.
translation: 没问题。

english: Why is the Accord important?
translation: 为什么协议很重要？

english: The signing of the Accord marked the start of a golden age. Once the Royal Lords replaced the Council of Elders, Kourend prospered like never before.
translation: 签署协议标志着一个黄金时代的开始。一旦皇家领主取代了长老议会，库兰德王国就前所未有的繁荣。

english: But that was a long time ago. Why does it matter now?
translation: 但那是很久以前的事了。为什么现在很重要？

english: Because I think it's time for another golden age. The Kourend Council, like the Council of Elders before them, have failed to do a good job in running this kingdom.
translation: 因为我认为现在该迎来另一个黄金时代了。库兰德议会，就像他们之前的长老议会一样，没能管理好这个王国。

english: And you think the five houses would do a better job?
translation: 你认为五大家族会做得更好吗？

english: Exactly.
translation: 没错。

english: What makes you say the Council have done a bad job?
translation: 你为什么说议会做得不好？

english: More crime. Fewer homes. More illness. Loss of jobs. The list goes on.
translation: 犯罪增多。住房减少。疾病增多。失业。名单还在继续。

english: But aren't the five houses partially to blame as well? They rule the cities.
translation: 但五大家族不也有部分责任吗？他们统治着城市。

english: The Council sets the laws and the Council sets the budgets. We have to do as they say, just like everyone else.
translation: 议会制定法律，议会制定预算。我们必须按他们说的做，就像其他人一样。

english: Hmmm, fair enough. Anyway, we'd better get off.
translation: 嗯，有道理。不管怎样，我们最好走吧。

english: Fair enough. See you later.
translation: 有道理。回头见。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Hello there Artur. Actually... I guess I should say Your Majesty now.
translation: 你好阿图尔。其实……我想我现在应该说陛下。

english: For you friend, Artur is fine.
translation: 对你来说，朋友，叫阿图尔就好。

english: You should not dispense formalities Artur. A king should command respect.
translation: 你不应该省略礼节，阿图尔。国王应该获得尊重。

english: I can command respect without using fancy titles, mother.
translation: 母亲，我不用华丽的头衔也能获得尊重。

english: So, how are you doing.
translation: 那么，你过得怎么样。

english: I have a lot of responsibility now. There's much to learn and not much time to learn it in. The loss of father still weighs heavily on me as well.
translation: 我现在责任重大。有很多东西要学，但时间不多。父亲的离世也让我倍感沉重。

english: Still, I am well supported by those around me. I'm sure that with their help, I can be the ruler the people deserve.
translation: 不过，我得到了周围人的大力支持。我相信在他们的帮助下，我能成为配得上人民的统治者。

english: I'm sure you can as well. Anyway, I'll let you get on with you work.
translation: 我相信你也能。不管怎样，我不打扰你工作了。

english: Until next time
translation: 下次见

english: Why is the Accord important?
translation: 为什么协议很重要？

english: What makes you say the council have done a bad job?
translation: 你为什么说议会做得不好？

english: Fair enough. See you later.
translation: 有道理。回头见。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Good day traveller. You are far from home, what brings you here?
translation: 你好旅行者。你离家很远，什么风把你吹到这里来了？

english: I am a wandering hero, I come here in search of adventure.
translation: 我是个流浪英雄，我来这里寻找冒险。

english: Sounds ghastly, I just want to live in peace.
translation: 听起来可怕，我只想和平生活。

english: Unfortunately without people like me, peace doesn't last for long.
translation: 不幸的是，没有像我这样的人，和平不会持久。

english: True, but then again most adventurers cause as much trouble as they put right.
translation: 确实，但话说回来，大多数冒险者制造的麻烦和他们解决的差不多。

english: You've got a point there... Hmm...
translation: 你说得有道理……嗯……

english: Well, good day traveller. And always do the right thing.
translation: 嗯，日安旅行者。永远做正确的事。

english: Good day traveller.
translation: 你好旅行者。

english: Hi there, how's it going?
translation: 你好，最近怎么样？

english: Well we're still alive, after all that's happened, we should be thankful of that.
translation: 嗯，我们还活着，经历了这一切，我们应该为此感激。

english: Hopefully this war is over soon.
translation: 希望这场战争很快结束。

english: Indeed, but how many more need to die before that happens?
translation: 确实，但在那之前还需要多少人死去？

english: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你觉得你在做什么？

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: He seems to be lost in his own thoughts...
translation: 他似乎沉浸在自己的思绪中……

english: Howdy stranger. What brings you out to these parts?
translation: 你好，陌生人。什么风把你吹到这里来了？

english: Nothing much - What are you doing here? It doesn't seem like there's much to do out here in the desert!
translation: 没什么——你在这里做什么？这沙漠里似乎没什么可做的！

english: Well, that's where you'd be wrong. I work for the Archaeological Society of Varrock, and have been excavating around here recently.
translation: 嗯，那你可就错了。我为维洛克城考古协会工作，最近一直在这里附近挖掘。

english: Was there something you specifically wanted?
translation: 你有什么特别想要的吗？

english: Do you have any quests? Call it a hunch, but you look like the type of man who might...
translation: 你有什么任务吗？算是直觉吧，但你看起来像是那种可能有……

english: Well, it's funny you should say that. I'm not sure if I would really call it a quest as such, but I found this ancient stone tablet in one of my excavations, and it would really help me out if you
translation: 嗯，真巧你这么说。我不确定是否真的能称之为任务，但我在一次挖掘中发现了一块古代石碑，如果你

english: could go and take it back to the digsite for me and get it examined.
translation: 能帮我把它带回考古挖掘场并让人检查一下就真的帮大忙了。

english: It's very old, and I don't recognise any of the inscriptions on it.
translation: 它很古老，我不认识上面的任何铭文。

english: Sure, I was heading that way anyway. Any particular person at the digsite you want me to talk to?
translation: 当然，反正我也要去那边。挖掘场有什么特别的人你想让我交谈吗？

english: His name's Terry Balando. Give it to nobody but him. I'm sorry, I can't entrust you with the actual tablet I found, it is far too valuable to give away, but I took these etchings - they should be enough for him to make
translation: 他叫特里‧巴兰多。只给他，别给任何人。抱歉，我不能把实际发现的石碑托付给你，它太珍贵了，但我拍了这些拓片——应该足够让他做

english: a preliminary translation on. Come back and let me know what he says, I would hate to waste my time excavating anything that isn't worth my time as a world famous archaeologist!
translation: 初步翻译了。回来告诉我他怎么说，作为一个世界著名的考古学家，我讨厌浪费时间挖掘任何不值得的东西！

english: No thanks. Playing delivery boy doesn't really sound much like fun to me.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。扮演跑腿对我来说听起来不太有趣。

english: Well, okay. Can't say as I blame you for thinking that. I'll go take it there myself later I guess.
translation: 嗯，好吧。不能说怪你那么想。我想我稍后自己送去吧。

english: Who are you, anyway?
translation: 你到底是谁？

english: You don't recognise me??? I am the world famous Asgarnia Smith, Archaeologist extraordinaire!
translation: 你不认识我？？？我是世界闻名的阿斯加尼亚‧史密斯，非凡考古学家！

english: I am the one who discovered the long forgotten Temple of Ikov! The one who unearthed the strange trap filled arena in Brimhaven!
translation: 我是发现被遗忘已久的伊科夫神殿的人！我还挖掘出布尔哈文镇那个充满奇怪陷阱的竞技场！

english: I'm the leading archaeological expert of our time! I was voted archaeologist of the year four years running by the Varrock Herald! Are you REALLY sure you've never heard of me?
translation: 我是我们时代领先的考古专家！我连续四年被维洛克城先驱报评为年度考古学家！你真的确定从来没听说过我？

english: No, I really haven't.
translation: 不，我真的没有。

english: Well then, I'm confused. Why did you come over and speak to me if you don't know who I am? What do you want?
translation: 那我很困惑。如果你不知道我是谁，为什么过来跟我说话？你想要什么？

english: Nothing really. I'm just wandering around for no good reason.
translation: 没什么。我只是无缘无故到处逛逛。

english: Uh-huh. Well, if you'll excuse me, I have a lot more work to do before I can bed down for the night.
translation: 嗯哼。嗯，如果你不介意，我还有很多工作要做，然后才能睡觉。

english: Hello again. You find any signs of that treasure yet?
translation: 又见面了。你找到任何宝藏的迹象了吗？

english: Well... not as such, but I unleashed a powerful demonfrom its tomb in return for unbelievable magical power.
translation: 嗯……不完全是，但我从坟墓里释放了一个强大的恶魔，换取了难以置信的魔法力量。

english: So... no gold then?
translation: 所以……没有金子？

english: Not as such, no. Sorry about that.
translation: 不完全是，没有。抱歉。

english: Aw... I was hoping to go abroad on holiday this year.
translation: 唉……我本来希望今年出国度假的。

english: Maybe I'll go check out Karamja next, I hear there's treasure to be found there...
translation: 也许我下次去看看卡拉姆詹岛，我听说那里有宝藏……

english: I was wondering...
translation: 我在想……

english: As you are a big famous archaeologist, maybe you could spare the time to tell me a couple of tales of your exploits?
translation: 既然你是个大名鼎鼎的考古学家，也许你能抽空给我讲讲你的事迹？

english: Hey, sure thing kid! Well, this one time I found this spooky old temple in the middle of the jungle.
translation: 嘿，当然了小家伙！嗯，有一次我在丛林中间发现了一个阴森的古庙。

english: The entrance was hidden from sight by all these vines and stuff, and it was full of zombies and crazy tribesmen and stuff.
translation: 入口被藤蔓之类的东西遮住了，里面全是僵尸和疯狂的部落民。

english: That wasn't the worst thing though! There were all these crazy traps that were hidden around the place too!
translation: 但那还不是最糟糕的！周围还隐藏着所有这些疯狂的陷阱！

english: Well anyway, I found the secret entrance, fought my way in through the zombies and tribesmen, and came to a big pedestal with a statue of solid gold sat on top of it!
translation: 嗯不管怎样，我找到了秘密入口，一路杀过僵尸和部落民，来到一个大基座前，上面坐着一尊纯金雕像！

english: Solid gold, huh? Wow.
translation: 纯金的，嗯？哇。

english: That's right! It was a cunning trap though! As soon as I picked up the statue, a trapdoor opened up underneath me, and I fell into a darkened room, full of
translation: 没错！但那是个狡猾的陷阱！我一拿起雕像，下面的活板门就打开了，我掉进了一个黑暗的房间，里面全是

english: bones, and the biggest meanest tribesman you ever did see!
translation: 骨头，还有你见过的最大最凶的部落民！

english: Huge he was, and real ugly looking! He had this huge sword too, and he came running towards me screaming something in some language I didn't understand!
translation: 他身材巨大，而且真丑！他还有这把巨大的剑，他朝我跑来，用某种我不懂的语言尖叫着什么！

english: What did you do?
translation: 你做了什么？

english: Well, while he was screaming at me, and swinging his sword around in front of me, trying to intimidate me before attacking, I cooly and calmly...
translation: 嗯，当他朝我尖叫，在我面前挥舞剑，试图在攻击前吓唬我时，我冷静地……

english: Yes?
translation: 是的？

english: All the while, knowing that if I died in this spot nobody would even know where I was...
translation: 一直以来，都知道如果我死在这个地方，没人会知道我在哪……

english: What then?
translation: 然后呢？

english: I knew, if this tribesman killed me, that would be the end of Asgarnia Smith, and all of his treasure hunting...
translation: 我知道，如果这个部落民杀了我，那就是阿斯加尼亚‧史密斯的终结，以及他所有的寻宝……

english: SO WHAT DID YOU DO?!?!
translation: 那你到底做了什么？！?!

english: Well, while he was screaming and waving his sword around, I stood behind a nearby stalactite, then shot him with my shortbow.
translation: 嗯，当他尖叫挥舞剑时，我站在附近的钟乳石后面，然后用我的短弓射了他。

english: And that was how I recovered the Golden Monkey of Tee-Ta-Toh.
translation: 我就是这样找回了提 - 塔 - 托金猴。

english: So... How exactly did you get into this line of work anyway?
translation: 那么……你到底是怎么入行的？

english: It seems an odd choice of career for a man like yourself.
translation: 对你这样的人来说，这似乎是个奇怪的职业选择。

english: Thinking of joining your pal Asgarnia in the wonderful world of treasure hun- um, archaeology, huh?
translation: 想加入你的伙伴阿斯加尼亚进入奇妙的寻宝——嗯，考古世界，嗯？

english: Well, it all started the day I was fishing in catherby, funnily enough.
translation: 嗯，这一切都始于我在凯瑟比镇镇钓鱼的那天，有趣的是。

english: Ah yes, I remember it well... I was just sat there, hoping to catch a bass or two, when I made the most amazing discovery!
translation: 啊是的，我记得很清楚……我正坐在那儿，希望能钓到一两条鲈鱼，这时我有了最惊人的发现！

english: In my fishing nets, I had found an ancient casket, marred and worn by centuries underwater!
translation: 在我的渔网里，我发现了一个古代宝箱，在水下历经几个世纪的侵蚀磨损！

english: With trembling hands, I slowly and cautiously opened it, wondering what ancient secret may have been kept inside...
translation: 我用颤抖的手慢慢小心翼翼地打开它，想知道里面可能藏着什么古代秘密……

english: What valuable heirloom may have been dredged up by my nets that had not decayed underwater long ago...
translation: 什么珍贵的传家宝可能被我的网打捞上来，在水下这么久都没腐烂……

english: And you know what I found inside?
translation: 你知道我在里面发现了什么？

english: No, what?
translation: 不，什么？

english: I found 320 coins! Just like that! Just by fishing I had found 320 coins! 320 coins! Can you believe it?
translation: 我发现了320枚金币！就这样！光靠钓鱼我就发现了320枚金币！320枚金币！你能相信吗？

english: Um... Yes, yes I can.
translation: 嗯……是的，是的我能。

english: Well, it might not seem much to us now kid, but back then, it was a revelation!
translation: 嗯，现在对我们来说可能不多，小家伙，但那时，这是个启示！

english: Why waste my time fishing when there were secret treasures from long ago hidden around the world?
translation: 当世界各地隐藏着古老的秘密宝藏时，为什么要浪费时间钓鱼？

english: I immediately applied to the Museum of Varrock as a field agent, and the rest is history!
translation: 我立即申请成为维洛克博物馆的实地代理人，剩下的就是历史了！

english: Nice hat!
translation: 帽子不错！

english: Hey, thanks kid. Looking snazzy is an important part of being a treasure hunter!
translation: 嘿，谢谢小家伙。看起来时髦是成为寻宝者的重要部分！

english: Well, I'll see you again sometime maybe. Sorry I couldn't get you any treasure...
translation: 嗯，也许我什么时候再见到你。抱歉没能给你弄到宝藏……

english: Ah, don't sweat it kid. I'll be honest with ya - I'm already rich many times over, and its more the kicks of being a treasure hunter I do it for than the actual cash!
translation: 啊，别担心小家伙。我跟你说实话——我已经很富有了，我做这个更多的是为了寻宝的刺激而不是真正的现金！

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Do you have any quests?
translation: 你有什么任务吗？

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Nothing really.
translation: 没什么。

english: Tell me of your adventures
translation: 告诉我你的冒险

english: Tell me how you became an Archaeologist
translation: 告诉我你是如何成为考古学家的

english: Nice hat!
translation: 帽子不错！

english: See you later...
translation: 回头见……

english: Dung cook human.
translation: 邓格煮人类。

english: Ash eat human.
translation: 阿什吃人类。

english: Dung will fry human.
translation: 邓格要炸人类。

english: Dung is wrong!
translation: 邓格错了！

english: My brother in stronghold best cook.
translation: 我兄弟在要塞是最好的厨师。

english: Ash will boil human 'till it tender.
translation: 阿什要把人类煮到软烂。

english: Much more tasty.
translation: 好吃多了。

english: Ash will not cook human!
translation: 阿什不煮人类！

english: Ash will boil!
translation: 阿什要煮！

english: Dung will boil Ash's head!
translation: 邓格要煮阿什的头！

english: Boil better!
translation: 煮更好吃！

english: Fry better!
translation: 炸更好吃！

english: Boil!
translation: 煮！

english: Fry!
translation: 炸！

english: Ow!
translation: 哦！

english: Ugh!
translation: 呃！

english: Dung not hit Ash!
translation: 邓格别打阿什！

english: Ow!
translation: 哦！

english: Ouch!
translation: 哎哟！

english: Dung hate Ash!
translation: 邓格恨阿什！

english: Ash hate Dung!
translation: 阿什恨邓格！

english: Excuse me...
translation: 打扰一下……

english: Can I help you?
translation: 我能帮你吗？

english: Can you tell me anything about the castle?
translation: 能说说城堡的情况吗？

english: There aren't many guards in it.
translation: 里面守卫不多。

english: We don't have an army, you see.
translation: 你看，我们没有军队。

english: How's the weather doing?
translation: 天气怎么样？

english: Could be better.
translation: 可能会更好。

english: How's life in Etceteria?
translation: 埃西特利亚岛的生活怎么样？

english: *sigh* Times are tough.
translation: (叹气)时世艰难。

english: Though they're getting better.
translation: 不过正在好转。

english: What's it like being an Etceterian?
translation: 成为埃西特利亚岛人是什么感觉？

english: Fairly pleasant, though it gets cold in the winter.
translation: 相当愉快，虽然冬天会变冷。

english: Nice town you have here.
translation: 你这里的城镇不错。

english: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。

english: What is it?
translation: 什么事？

english: Thank you for finding my tools for me. Did you find everyone's belongings?
translation: 谢谢你帮我找到工具。你找到所有人的物品了吗？

english: I did! Thank you for the reward.
translation: 我找到了！谢谢你的奖励。

english: You're more than welcome to it, for getting our belongings back.
translation: 你能帮我们找回物品，这是应该的。

english: Can you tell me how the kingdom approves of me?
translation: 你能告诉我王国对我的认可度吗？

english: [amount]% of people approve of you.
translation: [amount]% 的人认可你。

english: Hello, [player name].
translation: 你好，[player name]。

english: Tell me more about Nex.
translation: 多和我说说奈克斯的事。

english: Long ago, these lands were dominated by a great empire, ruled over by an ancient god. The Empty Lord is what they often called him, but his true name was Zaros.
translation: 很久以前，这片土地被一个伟大的帝国统治，由一位古老者统治。他们常称他为空无之主，但他的真名是扎罗斯。

english: Zaros? I've heard of him.
translation: 扎罗斯？我听说过他。

english: At the height of his power, Zaros seemed untouchable, but he was eventually defeated by those he trusted the most. With him gone, the empire collapsed. War broke out soon after.
translation: 在他权力的巅峰，扎罗斯似乎不可触碰，但他最终被他最信任的人击败。随着他的离去，帝国崩溃了。战争很快爆发。

english: Although their god was gone, many Zarosians fought to keep his empire alive. Among them was Nex. She was Zaros' most powerful weapon, and she led a great army to try and restore his empire.
translation: 虽然他们的神走了，许多扎罗斯信徒为保持他的帝国而战。其中包括奈克斯。她是扎罗斯最强大的武器，她率领一支大军试图恢复他的帝国。

english: Not that she needed an army of course. Nex alone was powerful enough to hold back hundreds of lesser beings.
translation: 当然她不需要军队。仅奈克斯一人就强大到足以抵挡数百个较弱的生物。

english: So how did she end up here?
translation: 那她怎么最终到了这里？

english: The forces of Saradomin knew that Nex needed to be dealt with. They were able to lure her into these caverns.
translation: 萨拉多明的势力知道必须处理奈克斯。他们设法把她诱骗到这些洞穴里。

english: After great effort and sacrifice, they managed to place Nex and her followers into a frozen, enchanted sleep.
translation: 经过艰苦卓绝的努力与牺牲，他们最终成功将奈克斯及其追随者封印在了一场受魔力加持的冰封沉睡之中。

english: Once Nex was no longer an immediate threat, they built the Temple of Lost Ancients around her. Most of the temple has since fallen to ruin, but you can still see some of the remains.
translation: 一旦奈克斯不再是直接威胁，他们就在她周围建造了失落远古老者殿。神殿的大部分此后已沦为废墟，但你仍能看到一些遗迹。

english: But she wasn't frozen forever, was she? You said you were fooled into freeing her.
translation: 但她没有被永远冻结，对吧？你说你被骗释放了她。

english: Yes. Later in the war, a great battle broke out in the Temple of Lost Ancients. I was a Saradominist soldier at the time, and I was among those who fought for him in that battle.
translation: 是的。战争后期，失落远古老者殿爆发了一场大战。我当时是萨拉多明士兵，我是那场战斗中为他而战的人之一。

english: By then, many of us had grown tired of war. One of our priests discovered this. He came to us and revealed that he felt the same way, and that he had secretly converted to Guthix. He encouraged us to join him.
translation: 那时，我们许多人对战争感到厌倦。我们的一位牧师发现了这一点。他来找我们，透露他也有同样的感觉，并且他已秘密皈依古斯。他鼓励我们加入他。

english: We abandoned the cause of Saradomin and became followers of Guthix. Our new leader taught us the ways of the druids, including an ancient ritual that had the power to awaken Guthix himself.
translation: 我们放弃了萨拉多明的事业，成为古斯的信徒。我们的新领袖教我们德鲁伊之道，包括一个有能力唤醒古斯本人的古老仪式。

english: We believed this ritual to be the only way to end the war.
translation: 我们相信这个仪式是结束战争的唯一方法。

english: But I'm guessing that's not how things went?
translation: 但我猜事情不是那样发展的？

english: No... When our leader led us to perform the ritual, it was not Guthix we woke, but Nex and her forces. The ritual also destroyed the protective enchantments on their prison.
translation: 不……当我们的领袖带领我们进行仪式时，我们唤醒的不是古斯，而是奈克斯和她的势力。仪式也摧毁了他们监狱的保护附魔。

english: And that was exactly what your leader wanted?
translation: 那正是你的领袖想要的？

english: It was. He had never been a follower of Guthix, or Saradomin. His real goal had always been to free Nex.
translation: 是的。他从来不是古斯或萨拉多明的信徒。他的真正目标一直是释放奈克斯。

english: The rest is as I already told you. Nex posed such a danger, that the four armies temporarily joined forces to drive her back into the prison. They resealed it, but were unable to fix the enchantments we destroyed.
translation: 剩下的就像我已经告诉你的。奈克斯构成了如此大的危险，四国联军暂时联手将她赶回监狱。他们重新封印了它，但无法修复我们摧毁的附魔。

english: As for me, I was one of the first to fall after Nex was freed, but I didn't truly die. Something about our ritual tied me to this place. I've been trapped here ever since. Not dead, but not really alive either.
translation: 至于我，我是奈克斯被释放后最早倒下的人之一，但我没有真正死去。我们的仪式有什么东西把我束缚在这个地方。从那以后我一直被困在这里。没死，但也不是真的活着。

english: I'm sorry.
translation: 我很抱歉。

english: Don't be. This is the punishment for my sins.
translation: 别这样。这是对我罪孽的惩罚。

english: What of the one that led the ritual. What came of him?
translation: 那个领导仪式的人呢。他怎么样了？

english: He'd achieved his goal, so he left. I never saw him again.
translation: 他实现了目标，所以他离开了。我再也没见过他。

english: But who was he really?
translation: 但他到底是谁？

english: He never gave us his true name, but as Nex was freed, she spoke to him.
translation: 他从未告诉我们他的真名，但当奈克斯被释放时，她对他说话了。

english: She knew him?
translation: 她认识他？

english: It seemed that way. I heard little of what they said, but I did hear what she called him.
translation: 似乎是那样。我很少听到他们说什么，但我确实听到她怎么称呼他。

english: What was it?
translation: 是什么？

english: Sliske.
translation: 斯利克。

english: Forgive me, but this conversation has brought back many memories. Let us speak no more of this.
translation: 原谅我，但这次谈话勾起了许多回忆。我们别再谈这个了。

english: Of course.
translation: 当然。

english: Can I access my bank?
translation: 我能使用我的银行账户吗？

english: Of course.
translation: 当然。

english: I'd like to collect some items.
translation: 我想收集一些物品。

english: I need to go.
translation: 我需要走了。

english: Good luck out there.
translation: 祝你好运。

english: Tell me more about Nex.
translation: 多和我说说奈克斯的事。

english: Can I access my bank?
translation: 我能使用我的银行账户吗？

english: I'd like to collect some items.
translation: 我想收集一些物品。

english: I need to go.
translation: 我需要走了。

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Hey there, buddy. You're an outerlander, huh? I'm not really supposed to talk to you.
translation: 嘿，伙计。你是外乡人，嗯？我不应该跟你说话。

english: Why not?
translation: 为什么不？

english: I dunno buddy. Some stupid tradition or other. We're always told not to talk to outerlanders unless the Chieftain has allowed it.
translation: 我不知道伙计。一些愚蠢的传统之类的。我们总是被告知不要和外乡人说话，除非酋长允许。

english: The Chieftain? Who is that?
translation: 酋长？那是谁？

english: His names Brundt, buddy. He's a real boring guy. You can find him in the longhall there.
translation: 他叫布伦特，伙计。他是个很无聊的家伙。你可以在那边的长厅找到他。

english: Can you take me to see him?
translation: 你能带我去见他吗？

english: Sorry buddy, I'm not allowed into the Longhall. Don't worry, he's easy to spot. He's the one in the fancy helmet. Oh, and he only has one eye.
translation: 抱歉伙计，我不允许进入长厅。别担心，他很容易认。他是那个戴华丽头盔的。哦，他只有一只眼睛。

english: He's a cyclops?
translation: 他是独眼巨人？

english: Nah, nah, nah... He just wears an eyepatch! Well, see ya around buddy!
translation: 不，不，不……他只是戴了眼罩！嗯，回头见伙计！

english: Hey there, buddy. You're an outerlander, huh?
translation: 嘿，伙计。你是外乡人，嗯？

english: Didn't think old Jarvald would let an outerlander come kill dagger-mouths with him!
translation: 没想到老贾瓦尔德会让外乡人来跟他一起杀深潜者！

english: Well, obviously he did. So what are you doing up here?
translation: 嗯，显然他同意了。那你在这里做什么？

english: Well buddy, let me tell you, killing those dagger-mouths is sure thirsty work!
translation: 嗯伙计，让我告诉你，杀那些深潜者肯定是口渴的工作！

english: If you got a keg of beer on you I'll buy it off ya for 500 gold coins, buddy!
translation: 如果你身上有一桶啤酒，我会用500金币买下来，伙计！

english: Or if you got any animal parts, I'll trade ya something for 'em!
translation: 或者如果你有任何动物部件，我会用东西跟你换！

english: No... I don't have anything like that with me...
translation: 不……我身上没有那样的东西……

english: Well, I'm not going back down there until I get a drink buddy! Come see me if you find me a keg, I pay good money!
translation: 嗯，在我喝到酒之前我不会回那里去，伙计！如果你给我找到一桶酒就来找我，我付好钱！

english: Wanna sell me ya kegs of beer for 500 gold coins each outerlander?
translation: 想把你的一桶桶啤酒以每桶500金币卖给我吗外乡人？

english: I don't know... Seems a little off to sell alcohol to a child...
translation: 我不知道……卖给小孩酒似乎有点不对劲……

english: Hey, don't judge our customs outerlander! Now you want the cash or you want to bug me?
translation: 嘿，别评判我们的习俗外乡人！现在你想要钱还是想烦我？

english: You wanna sell me the lot buddy, or one at a time?
translation: 你想把全部都卖给我伙计，还是一次一个？

english: You sell Askeladden your Kegs of Beer.
translation: 你把你的啤酒桶卖给阿斯卡拉登。

english: You sell Askeladden a Keg of Beer.
translation: 你把一桶啤酒卖给阿斯卡拉登。

english: But I don't have any kegs of beer to sell...
translation: 但我没有啤酒桶可卖……

english: I'll trade ya animal parts for cooked tuna, ya interested outerlander?
translation: 我用动物部件跟你换熟金枪鱼，你感兴趣吗外乡人？

english: You wanna trade me the lot buddy, or just one type?
translation: 你想把全部都换给我，还是一次换一种？

english: You trade Askeladden your animal parts for food.
translation: 你用动物部件与阿斯卡拉登交换食物。

english: What ya selling buddy?
translation: 你卖什么伙计？

english: You trade the parts for food.
translation: 你用部件换食物。

english: No offence Askeladden, and it's not that I don't trust you... Er, actually it is that I don't trust you.
translation: 别介意阿斯卡拉登，不是说我不信任你……呃，其实是我就是不信任你。

english: Aw, buddy... What did I ever do to you?
translation: 唉，伙计……我到底对你做了什么？

english: Well, if ya change your mind, I'm gonna be here waiting for a drink, buddy!
translation: 嗯，如果你改变主意，我会在这里等着喝酒，伙计！

english: Hey buddy, I'll trade ya that for some food! Ya interested?
translation: 嘿伙计，我用那个换些食物！你感兴趣吗？

english: Okay buddy, suit yerself!
translation: 好吧伙计，随你便！

english: Hello again Askeladden.
translation: 又见面了阿斯卡拉登。

english: Hey buddy! That ain't my name no more! My new Fremennik name is Larravak! What's yours?
translation: 嘿伙计！那不再是我的名字了！我的新费明尼克名字是拉拉瓦克！你的呢？

english: My Fremennik name is [Fremennik name].
translation: 我的费明尼克名字是 [Fremennik name]。

english: Ha! Ain't as good as my name buddy! So what can I do ya for?
translation: 哈！没我的名字好听伙计！那么有什么能帮你的？

english: So, Askeladd- sorry, Larravak; What is there to do around here now that we are both Fremenniks?
translation: 那么，阿斯卡拉登——抱歉，拉拉瓦克；既然我们都是费明尼克人了，这里有什么可做的？

english: I guess you could do a bit of shopping. We got fresh fish at the docks, and some armour and weapons at Skulgrimen's place.
translation: 我想你可以去逛逛。码头有新鲜鱼，斯库尔格里门那儿有些装备和武器。

english: Okay, thanks.

translation: 哼。好吧。瓦拉莫尔人不会提这个，但我们是第一批在这里定居的。当泽里克在库兰德王国掌权时，我们的祖先就预见到不祥之兆。他们选择不留下。

translation: 未必。我的人民对那种事太熟悉了。洛瓦肯吉城矮人大多忘记了他们的历史，但我们卡姆托鲁姆城矮人记得太清楚了。

translation: 这你可不一定知道。
