translation: 但我知道。正如我所说，我们记得我们的历史，我们知道那些不记得的人注定要重蹈覆辙。

english: The Varlamorians nearly destroyed themselves in their War of Betrayal, but it was not them who were betrayed, it was us.
translation: 瓦拉莫尔人在背叛之战中几乎自我毁灭，但被背叛的不是他们，是我们。

english: I was a young dwarf when their war risked destroying our home. I saw the results of their pride. Meanwhile, they've all but forgotten it.
translation: 他们的战争危及我们家园时我还是个小矮人。我看到了他们骄傲的后果。同时，他们几乎忘记了它。

english: Sorry. I didn't mean to dig up old wounds.
translation: 抱歉。我不是有意揭开旧伤疤。

english: Hmph. It's fine. Your intentions are good, [player name], which is more than can be said for most of your kind. Who knows, maybe one or two dwarves here might even grow to tolerate you.
translation: 哼。没事。你的心意是好的，[player name]，这比你们大多数人都强。谁知道呢，也许这里的一两个矮人甚至会逐渐容忍你。

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: How are things?
translation: 情况怎么样？

english: So how long has Cam Torum been around?
translation: 那么卡姆托鲁姆城存在多久了？

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: Hey there. How's it going?
translation: 嘿。最近怎么样？

english: Good thanks.
translation: 很好谢谢。

english: Glad to hear it.
translation: 很高兴听到。

english: Hello again. Was Fox happy with the material?
translation: 又见面了。福克斯对材料满意吗？

english: He was. You found the perfect match.
translation: 他满意。你找到了完美匹配。

english: Wonderful!
translation: 太好了！

english: Would you look after my crops for me?
translation: 你能帮我照看庄稼吗？

english: Okay, it's a deal.
translation: 好的，成交。

english: You pay the gardener [requested payment] to protect the patch.
translation: 你付给园丁 [requested payment] 来保护这块种植地。

english: [That'll do nicely, sir./That'll do nicely, madam./That'll do nicely.] Leave it with me - I'll make sure that patch grows for you.
translation: [That'll do nicely, sir./That'll do nicely, madam./That'll do nicely.] 交给我吧——我会确保那块种植地的作物好好生长。

english: No, that's too much.
translation: 不，那太多了。

english: Well, I'm not wasting my time for free.
translation: 嗯，我可不会白白浪费时间。

english: I'm afraid I don't have any of those at the moment.
translation: 恐怕我现在没有那些东西。

english: I'm afraid I don't have enough of those at the moment.
translation: 恐怕我现在没有足够的那些东西。

english: You don't have a sapling planted in that patch. Plant one and I might agree to look after it for you.
translation: 那块种植地里没种树苗，你先种点什么，我才可能考虑帮你照管。

english: I don't know what you're talking about - I'm already looking after that patch for you.
translation: 我不知道你在说什么——我已经在帮你照看那块种植地了。

english: Oh sorry, I forgot.
translation: 哦抱歉，我忘了。

english: That patch is already fully grown! I don't know what you want me to do with it!
translation: 那块种植地的作物已经完全成熟了！我不知道你还想让我做什么！

english: That patch is dead - it's too late for me to do anything about it now.
translation: 那块种植地的作物已经枯死了——现在我也无能为力了。

english: That patch is diseased - you should cure it before asking me to be responsible for it!
translation: 那块种植地的作物染病了——你先治好再让我管！

english: Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: 你能给我一些农业建议吗？

english: You can buy all the farming tools from farming shops, which can be found close to the allotments.
translation: 你可以在农业商店买到所有农具，这些商店就在农田附近。

english: Supercompost is far better than normal compost, but more expensive to make. You need to rot the right type of item; show me an item, and I'll tell you if it's super- compostable or not.
translation: 超级堆肥比普通堆肥强多了，但做起来也更费事。你得用对东西才能堆出来——拿件物品给我看看，我告诉你它能不能做成超级堆肥。

english: Tree seeds must be grown in a plantpot of soil into a sapling, and then transferred to a tree patch to continue growing to adulthood.
translation: 树木种子得先在装土的花盆里养成树苗，再移栽到树木种植地，才能继续长成大树。

english: You can put up to ten potatoes, cabbages or onions in vegetable sacks, although you can't have a mix in the same sack.
translation: 蔬菜袋里最多能装十个土豆、卷心菜或者洋葱，不过一袋里可不能混着装。

english: You can fill plantpots with soil from any empty patch, if you have a gardening trowel.
translation: 如果你有园艺铲，可以用任何空地的土壤填满花盆。

english: Bittercap mushrooms can only be grown in a special patch in Morytania, near the Mort Myre swamp. There the ground is especially dank and suited to growing poisonous fungii.
translation: 苦帽菇只能种在莫利塔尼亚、莫特迈耶沼泽附近的特殊种植地里。那里阴暗潮湿，适合毒蘑菇生长。

english: Vegetables, hops and flowers need constant watering - if you ignore my advice, you will sooner or later find yourself in possession of a dead farming patch.
translation: 蔬菜、啤酒花和花卉需要经常浇水。如果不听劝，你这块地迟早得荒废。

english: You don't have to buy all your plantpots you know, you can make them yourself on a pottery wheel. If you're good enough at crafting, that is.
translation: 其实花盆不用全买，手艺够好的话，自己用陶轮做就行。

english: If you want to make your own sacks and baskets you'll need to use the loom that's near the Farming shop in Falador. If you're good enough at crafting, that is.
translation: 想自己做袋子和篮子的话，得去用法拉多农业商店附近的织布机，当然手艺得够好才行。

english: There are many Farming areas out there. I know of Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Kragen's area near Ardougne, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius and Alan's area in
translation: 外面有很多农业区。我知道埃尔斯坦在法拉多城附近的区域，丹塔拉在凯瑟比镇镇附近的区域，克拉根在阿多尼城附近的区域，莱拉在莫利塔尼亚的区域，马利西在霍西迪乌斯城的区域，以及艾伦在

english: the Farming Guild. That said, I'm sure there's plenty more that I don't know about.
translation: 农业公会的区域。话虽如此，我相信还有很多我不知道的。

english: If you want to grow fruit trees you could try a few places: Catherby, Brimhaven, Gnome Stronghold and the Farming Guild all have fruit tree patches.
translation: 如果你想种果树，可以试试这几个地方：凯瑟比镇镇、布尔哈文镇、地精要塞和农业公会都有果树种植地。

english: You can put up to five tomatoes, strawberries, apples, bananas or oranges into a fruit basket, although you can't have a mix in the same basket.
translation: 你可以在水果篮里放最多五个番茄、草莓、苹果、香蕉或橙子，但不能在同一篮里混装。

english: There is a special patch for growing Belladonna - I believe that it is somewhere near Draynor Manor, where the ground is a tad 'unblessed'.
translation: 颠茄有专门的种植地——我记得是在德雷诺庄园附近，那地方的土嘛，有点''不受祝福''。

english: Applying compost to a patch will not only reduce the chance that your crops will get diseased, but you will also grow more crops to harvest.
translation: 给地里上点堆肥，不仅能防病害，产量也会更高。

english: The only way to cure a bush or tree of disease is to prune away the diseased leaves with a pair of secateurs. For all other crops I would just apply some plant-cure.
translation: 灌木或树木要是生了病，只能用修枝剪修掉病枝。至于其他作物，洒点植物治疗药水就行。

english: Hops are good for brewing ales. There's a brewery over on Aldarin if you fancy trying it.
translation: 啤酒花适合酿造麦酒。如果你想试试，阿尔达林岛那边有个酿酒厂。

english: Don't just throw away your weeds after you've raked a patch - put them in a compost bin and make some compost.
translation: 耙完地后别直接把杂草扔掉——把它们放进堆肥箱里做堆肥。

english: Can you sell me something?
translation: 你能卖我点东西吗？

english: That depends on whether I have it to sell. What is it that you're looking for?
translation: 那得看我有没有卖的。你在找什么？

english: I'll come back another time.
translation: 我改天再来。

english: Well it's a lot of hard work - if you pay me 200 Coins I'll chop it down for you.
translation: 嗯那是很多苦活——如果你付我200金币我帮你砍掉。

english: I don't have 200 Coins I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕我没有200金币。

english: Here's 200 Coins - chop my tree down please.
translation: 这是200金币——请帮我把树砍掉。

english: I don't want to pay that much, sorry.
translation: 我不想付那么多钱，抱歉。

english: Why? You look like you could chop it down yourself!
translation: 为什么？你看起来自己能砍！

english: Would you look after my crops for me?
translation: 你能帮我照看庄稼吗？

english: Okay, it's a deal.
translation: 好的，成交。

english: No, that's too much
translation: 不，那太多了

english: Okay, and don't ask again
translation: 好的，别再问了

english: Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: 你能给我一些农业建议吗？

english: Can you sell me something?
translation: 你能卖我点东西吗？

english: I'll come back another time.
translation: 我改天再来。

english: Would you chop down my tree for me?
translation: 你能帮我把树砍掉吗？

english: Here's 200 Coins - chop my tree down please.
translation: 这是200金币——请帮我把树砍掉。

english: I don't want to pay that much, sorry.
translation: 我不想付那么多钱，抱歉。

english: Yes you're right - I'll do it myself.
translation: 是的，你说得对——我自己做。

english: I can't be bothered - I'd rather pay you to do it.
translation: 我懒得做——我宁愿付钱让你做。

english: I have this voucher for completing the combat Adventure Path, it says to come talk to you about claiming my Adventure Path reward.
translation: 我有这张完成战斗冒险路径的凭证，上面说来找你领取冒险路径奖励。

english: Why yes, here are some air and mind runes.
translation: 哦是的，这里有些风符石和心灵符石。

english: I do have more rewards for you, but you need to be on a members world for me to give you the reward. Maybe there is something else I can help you with.
translation: 我确实还有更多奖励给你，但你需要在会员世界上我才能给你奖励。也许还有其他我能帮你的。

english: Do you want to buy some runes?
translation: 你想买些符石吗？

english: Certainly! Skillcapes are a symbol of achievement. Only people who have mastered a skill and reached level 99 can get their hands on them and gain the benefits they carry.
translation: 当然！技能斗篷是成就的象征。只有精通某项技能并达到99级的人才能获得，并享受其带来的好处。

english: The Cape of Runecrafting has been upgraded with each talisman, allowing you to access all Runecrafting altars. Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 符石制作斗篷已用每个护符升级，允许你进入所有符石制作祭坛。还有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: No thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Well, if you find someone who does want runes, please send them my way.
translation: 嗯，如果你找到确实想要符石的人，请把他们送到我这里。

english: Oh, it's a rune shop. No thank you, then.
translation: 哦，是符石店。那不用了，谢谢。

english: Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence?
translation: 你能把我传送到符文精华矿场吗？

english: Of course. By the way, if you end up making any runes from the essence you mine, I'll happily buy them from you.
translation: 当然，顺便说一下，如果你用开采的精华制作了任何符石，我很乐意从你那里购买。

english: Senventior Disthine Molenko!
translation: Senventior Disthine Molenko!

english: Can you tell me about your cape?
translation: 能说说你的斗篷吗？

english: I'd like to view your store please.
translation: 我想看看你的商店。

english: No thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Yes please!
translation: 好的，谢谢！

english: Oh, it's a rune shop. No thank you, then.
translation: 哦，是符石店。那不用了，谢谢。

english: Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence?
translation: 你能把我传送到符文精华矿场吗？

english: Gather round, one and all! It's time for the Darkmeyer Auctions!
translation: 大家围过来！达克迈尔拍卖时间到了！

english: We've got quite the lineup for you today! So, let's get started!
translation: 我们今天为你们准备了不错的阵容！那么，开始吧！

english: First up, a 37 year old male from sector four!
translation: 首先，来自第四区的37岁男性！

english: He's got plenty of blood in him, and he'll keep your home clean of any mess!
translation: 他体内有很多血，他会帮你把家里清理得干干净净！

english: Let's start the bidding at 1,000 coins! Do I have 1,000?
translation: 我们从1,000金币开始竞价！有1,000金币吗？

english: Here!
translation: 这里！

english: 1,000 coins to the vyre at the back! Do I have 2,000?
translation: 后面的吸血鬼贵族出1,000金币！有2,000金币吗？

english: I'll take it!
translation: 我要了！

english: 2,000 for the lady in red! Anyone for 3,000?
translation: 红衣女士出2,000金币！有人出3,000金币吗？

english: I have 3,000! But do I have 4,000?
translation: 有人出3,000金币！但有4,000金币吗？

english: Anyone for 4,000?
translation: 有人出4,000金币吗？

english: 3,000 going once!
translation: 3,000金币一次！

english: 3,000 going twice!
translation: 3,000金币两次！

english: Sold to the vyre at the back!
translation: 卖给后面的吸血鬼贵族了！

english: Right then! Next we have a 22 year old female from sector six!
translation: 好的！接下来是来自第六区的22岁女性！

english: She's young and filled with optimism! Perfect for those who enjoy a taste of hope!
translation: 她年轻且充满乐观！非常适合那些喜欢希望味道的人！

english: We'll start with 5,000 for this one! Do I have any takers!
translation: 这个我们从5,000开始！有人要吗！

english: Right here!
translation: 这里！

english: 5,000 coins for the lady at the front! How about 6,000?
translation: 前面的女士出5,000金币！有出6,000的吗？

english: Give it to me!
translation: 给我！

english: I have 6,000! Who wants 7,000!
I'll take her for 10,000!
10,000! We have a bid of 10,000! You lot really want this one! Anyone up for 12,000?
translation: 10,000！我们有10,000的出价！你们真想要这个！有人出12,000吗？

english: Anyone for any more? 13,000?
translation: 还有人出更高吗？13,000？

english: 12,000 going once!
12,000 going twice!
Sold for 12,000 coins! Enjoy!
translation: 12,000金币成交！享受吧！

english: Okay, finally we have a 41 year old male from sector three!
translation: 好的，最后是来自第三区的41岁男性！

english: Careful! This one is feisty! In fact, we've had to put him in a cage!
translation: 小心！这个很暴躁！事实上，我们不得不把他关在笼子里！

english: If you can put him in his place though, you're in for a treat! His blood is the sweetest around!
translation: 不过如果你能制服他，你就有口福了！他的血是最甜的！

english: We'll begin with 4,000 coins!
translation: 我们从4,000金币开始！

english: I have 4,000! But do I have 5,000?
5,000 coins to the vyre in red! Do I have 6,000?
translation: 穿红衣的吸血鬼贵族出5,000金币！有6,000吗？

english: 6,000 coins! Looks like we have a competition here! Let's take it to 7,000!
translation: 6,000金币！看来我们有竞争了！加到7,000！

english: We're at 7,000! But will it go higher? 8,000 coins?
translation: 到7,000了！但会更高吗？8,000金币？

english: 7,000 going once!
7,000 going twice!
Sold to the vyre in red!
translation: 卖给穿红衣的吸血鬼贵族了！

english: Well there you have it! That's all for now from the Darkmeyer Auctions!
translation: 好了就是这样！达克迈尔拍卖到此为止！

english: Fear not though. We'll be back with more, very soon!
translation: 不过别怕。我们很快就会带着更多货回来！

english: Oh, don't bother me human.
translation: 哦，别烦我人类。

english: Why not? What's wrong?
translation: 为什么不？怎么了？

english: You are wrong, human. Your attire is outrageous. Your presence is obnoxious.
translation: 你错了，人类。你的着装太离谱。你的存在令人讨厌。

english: What? What are you saying?
translation: 什么？你在说什么？

english: I'm saying you're in my way.
translation: 我说你挡我的路了。

english: Greetings!
translation: 你好！

english: What are you doing?
translation: 你在做什么？

english: Ah, it's a secret I'm afraid.
translation: 啊，恐怕是个秘密。

english: You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Enlightened Journey quest.
translation: 你不满足开始启蒙之旅任务的所有要求。

english: Greetings! Would you like to be my number one  accomplice? I mean, assistant?
translation: 你好！你想成为我的头号同谋吗？我是说，助手？

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: I am Auguste. I am going to be the first balloonist in all of Gielinor!
translation: 我是奥古斯特。我将成为整个基利诺尔第一个热气球飞行家！

english: Balloo-what? I thought only monks lived on Entrana.
translation: 气球什么？我以为只有僧侣住在恩特纳岛。

english: Well, they do... I was a monk. But I'm so sick of living on this island! I want to explore new frontiers!
translation: 嗯，确实是……我以前是个僧侣。但我受够了住在这个岛上！我想探索新领域！

english: And go where no man has gone before?
translation: 然后去前人未至之地？

english: Maybe! That sounds good. I was thinking just over to Taverley, though.
translation: 也许！听起来不错。不过我正想着就去塔韦利村。

english: Why not take the boat then?
translation: 那为什么不坐船？

english: Ugh! Ocean! Don't talk to me about the ocean...oh dear...I feel ill.
translation: 呃！海洋！别跟我提海洋……哦天哪……我想吐。

english: Whoa, ok, no ocean. How exactly are you going to get off the island, then?
translation: 哇，好吧，没有海洋。那你到底要怎么离开这个岛？

english: I have devised a new way to travel. But I need an assistant balloonist to help me build my design.
translation: 我设计了一种新的旅行方式。但我需要一个助手热气球飞行家帮我建造我的设计。

english: Are you an experienced adventurer willing to help me?
translation: 你是个愿意帮我的经验丰富的冒险者吗？

english: Yes! Sign me up.
translation: 是的！算我一个。

english: Wonderful! Let's get started.
translation: 太好了！我们开始吧。

english: Wait, I still don't know exactly what we're doing.
translation: 等等，我还是不知道我们到底要做什么。

english: Of course, of course, how foolish of me. Well, we are going to make a balloon.
translation: 当然，当然，我真蠢。嗯，我们要做一个热气球。

english: Which is what exactly?
translation: 那到底是什么？

english: Let me show you!
translation: 让我展示给你看！

english: I don't think so.
translation: 我不这么认为。

english: Oh, never mind then.
translation: 哦，那就算了。

english: Hello, [player name]. It is good to see you again. My enterprise has grown since we last met. I've expanded all over Gielinor!
translation: 你好，[player name]。很高兴再次见到你。自从我们上次见面后，我的企业发展了。我已经扩展到整个基利诺尔！

english: If you'd like to go to a new location, you will have to help fly the balloon again. Some of the routes are very dangerous!
translation: 如果你想去新地点，你得再次帮助驾驶热气球。有些路线非常危险！

english: But each route you complete will earn you Firemaking experience.
translation: 但你完成的每条路线都会给你生火经验。

english: Once you've opened a route, it only costs 1 log of the corresponding type to travel there again, from any location you've already opened!
translation: 一旦你开通了一条路线，从任何你已开通的地点再去那里，只需花费1根相应类型的原木！

english: I have also hired assistants to watch over the balloons at each new location we go to. They will help you get where you want to go.
translation: 我还雇了助手在我们去的每个新地点照看热气球。他们会帮你去你想去的地方。

english: Do you want to use the balloon? Just so you know, some locations require special logs and high Firemaking skills.
translation: 你想使用热气球吗？要知道，有些地点需要特殊原木和高阶生火技能。

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: Could you tell me how to make an origami balloon?
translation: 你能告诉我怎么做折纸气球吗？

english: First, use the papyrus on the ball of wool. The papyrus is folded into an origami box and the yarn will support the heat source.
translation: 首先，在毛线球上使用纸莎草。纸莎草被折成折纸盒，纱线将支撑热源。

english: Next, add the unlit candle to the balloon structure. It will act as the heat source.
translation: 接下来，将未点燃的蜡烛添加到气球结构中。它将作为热源。

english: Now you have an origami balloon!
translation: 现在你有一个折纸气球了！

english: If you use your origami balloon with any dye, you can change the colour.
translation: 如果你在任何染料上使用你的折纸气球，你可以改变颜色。

english: You can release the balloon and watch it float in the air, just use a tinderbox on it.
translation: 你可以释放气球看着它飘在空中，只需在上面用火绒盒。

english: You don't have enough free space for your cap.
translation: 你的物品栏空间不足，无法拿取帽子。

english: Here's your cap. Try to keep better track of it.
translation: 这是你的帽子。试着好好保管它。

english: You don't need a new jacket; you still have your original one.
translation: 你不需要新夹克；你还有原来的那件。

english: You don't have enough free space for your jacket.
translation: 你的物品栏空间不足，无法拿取夹克。

english: Here's your jacket, to keep you warm during flight.
translation: 这是你的夹克，让你在飞行中保暖。

english: There you go! You look like a true airship pilot now.
translation: 好了！你现在看起来像个真正的飞艇飞行员了。

english: I can't combine them if you are wearing them.
translation: 如果你穿着它们，我不能组合它们。

english: You don't have enough free space for the cap and goggles.
translation: 你的物品栏空间不足，无法拿取帽子和护目镜。

english: Yes.
translation: 是。

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: Could you tell me how to make an origami balloon?
translation: 你能告诉我怎么做折纸气球吗？

english: Could you replace some items for me?
translation: 你能帮我替换一些物品吗？

english: Could you combine my cap and goggles?
translation: 你能组合我的帽子和护目镜吗？

english: Hey it's the hero! Thank you so much for saving us from Gadderanks. And the town is looking lovely as well. You've done a great job!
translation: 是英雄来了！非常感谢你从加德兰克斯手中救了我们。城镇看起来也很可爱。你做得很好！

english: You're more than welcome.
translation: 别客气。

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: I'm Aurel the village store owner.
translation: 我是奥雷尔，这家村庄商店的老板。

english: Can you open the shop for me please?
translation: 你能帮我打开商店吗？

english: How do you like your town?
translation: 你觉得你的城镇怎么样？

english: It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
translation: 太完美了，非常感谢你的付出。

english: What's happening around here?
translation: 这里发生什么事了？

english: Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: 哦，没什么大事，我们都还在躲避吸血鬼，在这鬼地方勉强糊口，希望很快我们就能强大到前往萨鲁夫河上的神殿。

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: 有什么我能帮忙的吗？

english: Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: 据我所知没有，我们现在有一些基本设施，非常有用，我们都对你感激不尽。我从前没见过真正的英雄，没法比较，

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: 但我相信，在大多数人眼中，你定是英雄无疑！我个人很高兴见到你。

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: I've lost Gadderanks' Warhammer.
translation: 我把加德兰克斯的战锤弄丢了。

english: Hmm, how careless of you! However, you're in luck! Someone found it earlier and sold it to me.
translation: 嗯，你真粗心！不过，你运气好！有人早些时候发现了它并卖给了我。

english: Now I can pass the hammer back to you for the remarkably cheap price of 3000 gold coins. Deal?
translation: 现在我可以以非常便宜的3,000金币价格把锤子还给你。成交吗？

english: But I don't have 3000 coins on me?
translation: 但我身上没有3,000金币？

english: So that means you can't have it then! Come back when you have 3000 coins.
translation: 那就意味着你拿不到它了！等你有3,000金币再来。

english: Oayk, I'll pay 3000 coins for the hammer.
translation: 好吧，我付3,000金币买锤子。

english: A good deal and I'm sure of it!
translation: 我确定这是笔好买卖！

english: No thanks, I'll leave it, 3000 coins is too much to pay.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我不要了，3,000金币太贵了。

english: Very good then! I'll have no guilty conscience in offering it to other adventurers that frequent my shop then. Many thanks for your time and good day to ya sir.
translation: 那很好！那我就可以问心无愧地把它提供给其他常来我店的冒险者了。感谢你抽空前来，先生，祝您今日愉快。

english: Why does the hammer cost so much?
translation: 为什么锤子这么贵？

english: So much! That's cheap! The adventurer I bought it from wanted twice as much but I managed to knock him down to a reasonable price.
translation: 那个价！那算便宜的了！我从那个冒险者手里买的时候，他开价可是两倍，但我硬是砍到了一个合理的价格。

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: How do you like your town?
translation: 你觉得你的城镇怎么样？

english: What's happening around here?
translation: 这里发生什么事了？

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: 有什么我能帮忙的吗？

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: I've lost Gadderanks' Warhammer.
translation: 我把加德兰克斯的战锤弄丢了。

english: Okay, I'll pay 3000 coins for the hammer.
translation: 好的，我付3,000金币买锤子。

english: No thanks, I'll leave it. 3000 coins is too much to pay.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我不要了。3,000金币太贵了。

english: Why does the hammer cost so much?
translation: 为什么锤子这么贵？

english: Okay, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: I'm blending in. Scopin' out the place.
translation: 我在融入环境。侦察这个地方。

english: Are you preparing for a heist? You're only a kid.
translation: 你在准备抢劫吗？你只是个孩子。

english: Let's just say there are some wealthy people about, with full pockets.
translation: 就说附近有些有钱人，口袋满满的。

english: Any tips? I'm not having much luck myself.
translation: 有什么建议吗？我自己运气不太好。

english: I'm quite sneaky. Every now and then I'll get their attention so their pockets aren't being so carefully watched.
translation: 我很机灵。时不时我会吸引他们的注意力，这样他们就不会那么小心看管口袋了。

english: That is sneaky. I'll keep an eye out for your... distractions.
translation: 那真狡猾。我会留意你的……干扰。

english: Now leave me be. I'm already distracting!
translation: 现在别烦我。我已经被够干扰了！

english: Hmmph. What do you want?
translation: 哼。你想要什么？

english: I was just wondering what was down those stairs?
translation: 我只是想知道那些楼梯下面是什么？

english: You can't go down there!
translation: 你不能去下面！

english: I didn't want to anyway.
translation: 反正我也不想去。

english: Good. Because you can't.
translation: 好。因为你不能。

english: Because I don't want to.
translation: 因为我不想去。

english: Because you can't. So that's fine.
translation: 因为你不能。所以没关系。

english: Yes, it is.
translation: 是的，没关系。

english: Yes. Fine.
translation: 是的。没关系。

english: Absolutely.
translation: 当然。

english: Well then.
translation: 那么。

english: Why not?
translation: 为什么不？

english: This is the home of the Mountain Dwarves. How would you like it if I wanted to take a shortcut through your home?
translation: 这是山地矮人的家园。如果我想抄近路穿过你的家，你会怎么想？

english: Ooh... is this a shortcut to somewhere?
translation: 哦……这是去某处的近路吗？

english: Well, it is a lot easier to go this way to get past White Wolf Mountain than through those wolf filled passes.
translation: 嗯，走这条路穿过白狼山比穿过那些充满狼的山口容易多了。

english: Oh, sorry, I hadn't realised it was private.
translation: 哦，抱歉，我没意识到这是私人的。

english: Well, it is.
translation: 嗯，确实是。

english: If you were my friend I wouldn't mind.
translation: 如果你是我的朋友我就不介意。

english: Yes, but I don't even know you.
translation: 是的，但我甚至不认识你。

english: Well, let's be friends!
translation: 那，我们做朋友吧！

english: I'd rather not, thank you.
translation: 我宁愿不用了，谢谢。

english: This quest is not available on Speedrunning Worlds.
translation: 此任务在速通世界上不可用。

english: You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Fishing Contest quest.
translation: 你不满足开始钓鱼比赛任务的所有要求。

english: And how am I meant to do that?
translation: 那我该怎么做？

english: My, we are the persistent one aren't we?
translation: 天哪，我们真执着不是吗？

english: Well, there's a certain gold artefact we're after. We dwarves are big fans of gold! This artefact is the first prize at the Hemenster fishing competition.
translation: 嗯，我们在找某个黄金神器。我们矮人最爱黄金了！这个神器是赫门斯特钓鱼比赛的一等奖。

english: Fortunately we have acquired a pass to enter that competition...
translation: 幸运的是我们已经获得了参加那场比赛的通行证……

english: Unfortunately Dwarves don't make good fishermen.
translation: 不幸的是矮人不是好渔夫。

english: Fortunately I'm alright at fishing!
translation: 幸运的是我钓鱼还行！

english: Okay. I entrust you with our competition pass. Don't forget to take some gold with you for the entrance fee.
translation: 好的。我把我们的比赛通行证托付给你。别忘了带些金币付入场费。

english: Go to Hemenster and do us proud!
translation: 去赫门斯特，为我们争光！

english: You're a grumpy little man aren't you?
translation: 你这小个子脾气可真够暴躁的，是吧？

english: Don't you know it.
translation: 你才知道啊。

english: I'm bigger than you. Let me by!
translation: 我比你大。让我过去！

english: ...stumpy.
translation: ……小矮子。

english: Go away! You're not going to bully your way in HERE!
translation: 走开！你别想欺负人闯进这里！

english: I was just stopping to say hello!
translation: 我只是路过打个招呼而已！

english: Hello then.
translation: 那你好。

english: Do you have a brother?
translation: 你有兄弟吗？

english: What if I do! It's no business of yours.
translation: 就算有又怎样！不关你的事。

english: Have you won yet?
translation: 你赢了吗？

english: No, not yet.
translation: 不，还没有。

english: Well don't give up! Maybe old Jack can give you a few tips.
translation: 嗯别放弃！也许老杰克能给你一些建议。

english: Welcome, oh great Fishing Champion! Feel free to pop by and use our tunnel any time.
translation: 欢迎，哦伟大的钓鱼冠军！随时欢迎过来使用我们的隧道。

english: Thank you, I think I'll stop by for a beer one day.
translation: 谢谢，我想某天我会过来喝杯啤酒。

english: I was wondering what was down those stairs?
translation: 我只是想知道那些楼梯下面是什么？

english: I didn't want to anyway.
translation: 反正我也不想去。

english: Why not?
translation: 为什么不？

english: Ooh... is this a shortcut to somewhere?
translation: 哦……这是去某处的近路吗？

english: Oh, sorry, I hadn't realised it was private.
translation: 哦，抱歉，我没意识到这是私人的。

english: If you were my friend I wouldn't mind it.
translation: 如果你是我的朋友我就不介意。

english: Well, let's be friends!
translation: 那，我们做朋友吧！

english: Yes.
translation: 是。

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: You're a grumpy little man aren't you?
translation: 你这小个子脾气可真够暴躁的，是吧？

english: I'm bigger than you. Let me by.
translation: 我比你大。让我过去。

english: I was just stopping to say hello!
translation: 我只是路过打个招呼而已！

english: Do you have a brother?
translation: 你有兄弟吗？

english: Hello again. Are you after another device, or some information, or would you like to see my goods for sale?
translation: 又见面了。你是想要另一个装置，还是一些信息，或者想看看我出售的商品？

english: Devices, please.
translation: 装置，谢谢。

english: I'd like information, please.
translation: 我想要信息，谢谢。

english: Just a few bits of information before you run away to persecute rock crabs or cows.
translation: 在你跑去找岩石螃蟹或奶牛麻烦之前，先给你几条信息。

english: Firstly, your new device won't work if you are wearing certain metallic chest armours.
translation: 首先，如果你穿着某些金属胸甲，你的新装置将无法工作。

english: The magnetic attraction required for operation would cause feedback, so the device does not allow such incompatible item equip page.
translation: 操作所需的磁吸引力会导致反馈，所以装置不允许装备此类不兼容物品。

english: Secondly, although the device is calibrated to attract only arrow heads, there is a chance that other magnetically active items will be attracted.
translation: 其次，虽然装置校准为只吸引箭头，但其他带磁性的物品也有可能被吸过来。

english: The arrow recovery function of the devices is slightly different and relies upon a harmonic bond between your arrows and the chicken's magnet. You'll thus only recover arrows which you have fired rather than those
translation: 装置的箭矢回收功能略有不同，依赖于你的箭矢和小鸡磁铁之间的和谐纽带。因此你只能回收你射出的箭矢，而不是那些

english: fired by nearby folks.
translation: 附近的人射出的。

english: You'll also need to move about if you want to collect arrows since the gathering of long-lost arrowheads can't work otherwise.
translation: 如果你想收集箭矢，你还需要四处走动，否则收集丢失已久的箭头无法工作。

english: Finally, the device will only work when worn. It automatically deactivates in other circumstances.
translation: 最后，装置只有在穿戴时才会工作。在其他情况下它会自动停用。

english: I was worried about what would happen if you were to place it in a bank in its active state, so I've made sure it only works when it's on your back.
translation: 我担心如果你在其激活状态下把它放进银行会发生什么，所以我确保它只有在你背上时才工作。

english: Can I have more locator orbs, please?
translation: 我能要更多定位宝珠吗？

english: Ava gives you [another orb/[amount] orbs].
translation: 阿瓦给你 [another orb/[amount] orbs]。

english: I'd like to see your stuff for sale, please.
translation: 我想看看你出售的商品，谢谢。

english: Here's my shop.
translation: 这是我的商店。

english: I'll just head off, I think.
translation: 我想我该走了。

english: Thanks for the help with my bed; see you again.
translation: 谢谢你帮我整理床铺，下次见。

english: Mind taking a look at this quiver for me?
translation: 能帮我看一下这个箭袋吗？

english: Hmm...
That truly is a remarkable piece of equipment.
translation: 那确实是一件非凡的装备。

english: Bring me one of my devices. I might be able to link the two!
translation: 去拿一个我的装置来。我也许能把两者连接起来！

english: Wow! Really? I better go and grab one.
translation: 哇！真的吗？那我去拿一个。

english: If you've got the materials, I can make one now for you?
translation: 如果你有材料，我现在能为你做一个吗？

english: Let me see...
translation: 让我看看……

english: Extraordinary...
translation: 非凡……

english: That quiver has some of the finest leatherwork I've ever seen!
translation: 那个箭袋有着我见过的最精美的皮革工艺！

english: I was wondering if you could maybe make it... better?
translation: 我在想你能不能让它……更好？

english: Better? Let me see... I might be able to do something.
translation: 更好？让我看看……我也许能做点什么。

english: I'll see if I can link it to the device you have with you.
translation: 我看看能不能把它和你随身携带的装置连接起来。

english: Ouch!
translation: 哎哟！

english: That's some tough material...
translation: 那真是坚韧的材料……

english: Move that here...
translation: 把那个移到这里……

english: There we go! That's some of my finest work, if I do say so myself.
translation: 好了！那是我最出色的作品之一，如果我敢这么说的话。

english: Great! Thanks for the help!
translation: 太好了！谢谢帮助！

english: Looks like that quiver could be modified further. Come back to me with another device to modify it.
translation: 看来那个箭袋可以进一步改装。带着另一个装置回来找我改装它。

english: Fair enough.
translation: 好吧。

english: Mind taking another look at that quiver I showed you before?
translation: 介意再看看我之前给你看的那个箭袋吗？

english: Hmm, interesting... It seems to lack the power you have in your other device there.
translation: 嗯，有趣……它似乎缺乏你另一个装置中的能量。

english: That's right. I was wondering if you could help with that?
translation: 没错。我在想你能不能帮忙？

english: I'll give it a good go!
translation: 我会好好试试！

english: It seems like that quiver is as good as it's going to get!
translation: 看来那个箭袋已经到顶了！

english: I'm not sure what you are trying to do; are you sure you aren't slightly deranged?
translation: 我不确定你想做什么，你确定自己没疯吗？

english: Devices, please.
translation: 装置，谢谢。

english: Ava's devices.
translation: 阿瓦的装置。

english: Dizana's Quiver.
translation: 迪扎纳的箭袋。

english: I'd like information, please.
translation: 我想要信息，谢谢。

english: Can I have more locator orbs, please?
translation: 我能要更多定位宝珠吗？

english: I'd like to see your stuff for sale, please.
translation: 我想看看你出售的商品，谢谢。

english: I'll just head off, I think.
translation: 我想我该走了。

english: What are you doing out here on your own?
translation: 你一个人在这里做什么？

english: I'm not alone! Me and my mates run these streets. You'd better watch your pockets, stranger.
translation: 我不是一个人！我和我的伙伴掌管着这些街道。陌生人，你最好看好你的口袋。

english: What do you mean you run the streets?
translation: 你说掌管街道是什么意思？

english: You see those fancy houses?
translation: 你看到那些漂亮的房子了吗？

english: I think so?
translation: 我想是吧？

english: We keep a lookout to see when the owners leave and come back. Once they're out, we can break in and steal all their stuff!
translation: 我们放哨看业主什么时候出门和回来。一旦他们出去了，我们就可以闯进去偷走他们所有的东西！

english: That sounds risky don't you think? There are guards everywhere.
translation: 那听起来很冒险你不觉得吗？到处都是守卫。

english: No one suspects us street urchins. Hidden in plain sight, as they say.
translation: 没人怀疑我们这种街头流浪儿。俗话说，灯下黑嘛。

english: I can give you some info on which houses are free if you like...
translation: 如果你愿意，我可以给你一些关于哪些房子没人的信息……

english: Sounds good.
translation: 听起来不错。

english: You're new around here. Normally I'd charge 15 valuables for information, but I'm feeling generous.
translation: 你是这附近的新人。通常我会收15个贵重物品作为信息费，但我今天心情好。

english: Looks like [Wealthy citizen name] isn't home right now. Go quickly!
translation: 看来 [Wealthy citizen name] 现在不在家。快去吧！

english: Do you want me to point you in the right direction?
translation: 你想让我给你指个方向吗？

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: His house is south of here.
translation: 他的房子在这南边。

english: I'm alright for now.
translation: 我现在没事。

english: Suit yourself.
translation: 随你便。

english: Hello. Have you met our crew leader yet?
translation: 你好，你见过我们的头目了吗？

english: I don't think I have...
translation: 我想我没有……

english: Go chat to them! They should be near the bank... naturally.
translation: 去跟他们聊聊！他们应该在银行附近……自然地。

english: I'll head over there soon.
translation: 我很快就过去。

english: Happy thieving, stranger.
translation: 祝你偷窃顺利，陌生人。

english: I could do with some information on houses.
translation: 我需要一些关于房子的信息。

english: You don't have any house keys, do you? You won't find yourself getting very far without any. Maybe come back later?
translation: 你没有任何房屋钥匙，对吧？没有钥匙你走不远。也许晚点再来？

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: Sounds good.
translation: 听起来不错。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: I'll find my own way.
translation: 我自己找路。

english: I'm alright for now.
translation: 我现在没事。

english: I could do with some information on houses.
translation: 我需要一些关于房子的信息。

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: What? Can't you see I'm busy?
translation: 什么？你没看到我很忙吗？

english: Well, sooooorry...
translation: 嗯，真对不起……

english: I have received word from my father of your assistance to our family in this matter. You have my thanks for restoring our honour.
translation: 我收到父亲的消息，说你在这件事上帮助了我们的家族。感谢你恢复我们的荣誉。

english: Not a problem.
translation: 没问题。

english: Yes well... Is there anything I can help you with?
translation: 是的嗯……有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: Can you change my gauntlets for me?
translation: 你能帮我改造手套吗？

english: Yes certainly, though it will cost you 25,000 coins.
translation: 当然可以，不过要花你25,000金币。

english: Great thanks!
translation: 太谢谢了！

english: Avan takes your gauntlets, takes out a small hammer, and pounds them into a slightly new shape, then hands them back to you.
translation: 阿凡拿走你的手套，拿出一个小锤子，把它们敲成稍有不同的形状，然后还给你。

english: No that's okay thanks.
translation: 不，没关系，谢谢。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: I have received word from my father that you assisted us again! I get the feeling you weren't going to stop trying until you did though.
translation: 我收到父亲的消息说你再次帮助了我们！我感觉你不会停止尝试直到成功。

english: As a token of my appreciation, I will happily forge you as many pairs of Goldsmith gauntlets as you desire.
translation: 为表谢意，我很乐意为你锻造任意数量的金匠手套。

english: You will find the rate you gain experience when smelting gold much improved whilst wearing these gauntlets.
translation: 你会发现戴着这些手套时，熔炼金矿石获得的经验值会大大提高。

english: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。

english: Could I have some more goldsmith gauntlets, please?
translation: 我能再要一些金匠手套吗？

english: You're welcome.
translation: 不用客气。

english: Can you change my gauntlets for me?
translation: 你能帮我改造手套吗？

english: Great thanks!
translation: 太谢谢了！

english: No that's okay thanks.
translation: 不，没关系，谢谢。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Could I have some more goldsmith gauntlets, please?
translation: 我能再要一些金匠手套吗？

english: You're welcome.
translation: 不用客气。

english: Hey there.
translation: 嘿。

english: Need something, iknami?
translation: 需要点什么吗，朋友？

english: Not really. Just wondering what brings you out here?
translation: 不怎么需要。只是想知道什么风把你吹到这里来了？

english: I'm here to trade with the dwarves here on behalf of Fortis. Stonecutter Outpost is the main supplier of the stone we use for building.
translation: 我代表福蒂斯城来这里和矮人贸易。石匠前哨站是我们建筑用石的主要供应商。

english: And is the trading going well?
translation: 贸易进展顺利吗？

english: Well it's significantly better than dealing with the dwarves in Cam Torum, but they're still not the easiest to work with.
translation: 嗯比和卡姆托鲁姆城的矮人打交道好多了，但他们仍然不太好合作。

english: Ah, well in that case, I'd better leave you to it.
translation: 啊，那样的话，我最好不打扰你了。

english: You have brought peace between our kingdoms, [player name].
translation: 你为我们王国之间带来了和平，[player name]。

english: I've instructed my people to allow you full access to our Island, but beware I do not command the undead beneath us.
translation: 我已告知我的子民允许你在这座岛屿自由通行，但小心我不指挥我们下面的亡灵。

english: Now that's quite the banana. Where did you get it?
translation: 那香蕉可真够大的。你从哪儿弄来的？

english: Far from here, deep in the Kharidian Desert.
translation: 离这里很远，在卡里迪安沙漠深处。

english: Interesting... Continue.
translation: 有趣……继续。

english: You recount your experiences with the baboons in Osmumten's Tomb...
translation: 你讲述了你在奥斯穆滕之墓与狒狒的经历……

english: Well, that was a fascinating story. We have of course heard of various troops of our kind spread across the land, but this is the first I have heard of these ones.
translation: 嗯，那真是个迷人的故事。我们当然听说过散布在这片土地上的各种同类部队，但这是我第一次听说这些。

english: Now that we know their story, you can rest assured that their memory will live on here.
translation: 既然我们知道了他们的故事，你可以放心，他们的记忆将在这里永存。

english: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。

english: Now, about that large banana...
translation: 现在，关于那个大香蕉……

english: Here you go.
translation: 给，拿好。

english: Ah! Here you go!
translation: 啊！给，拿着！

english: What?
translation: 什么？

english: I need you to answer this for me.
translation: 我需要你帮我回答这个问题。

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
translation: 请输入问题的答案。

english: How can that be? Go check again!
translation: 怎么会这样？再去确认一下！

english: Spot on!
translation: 完全正确！

english: King Awowogei has given you another clue scroll/a casket!
translation: 阿沃沃盖伊国王给了你另一张线索卷轴/一个宝箱！

english: Thank you kind madam. The town is saved and the water is flowing freely.
translation: 谢谢你，好心的女士。城镇得救了，水也畅通无阻了。

english: You're welcome.
translation: 不用客气。

english: What's more when we now pray at the shrine we now feel rejuvenated and healthier than ever!
translation: 更重要的是，现在我们在神殿祈祷时，感觉比以往任何时候都更精神焕发、更健康！

english: That's interesting to know.
translation: 知道这个很有趣。

english: 'Ello, and what are you after then?
translation: 你好，那么你想要什么？

english: I need another assignment.
translation: 我需要另一个任务。

english: You're actually very strong, are you sure you don't want Chaeldar in Zanaris to assign you a task?
translation: 你其实很强，你确定不想让扎纳里斯的凯尔达给你分配任务吗？

english: No that's okay, I'll take a task from you.
translation: 不没关系，我从你这里接任务。

english: Oh okay then, I'll go talk to Chaeldar.
translation: 哦好吧，那我去找凯尔达谈谈。

english: Excellent, you're doing great. Your new task is to kill [amount] [task monster].
translation: 太好了，你做得很好。你的新任务是击杀 [amount] [task monster]。

english: You're still hunting [task monster], you have [amount] to go.
translation: 你仍在猎杀 [task monster]，还剩 [amount] 个。

english: Although, it's not an assignment that I'd normally give... I guess I could give you a new assignment, if you'd like.
translation: 虽然，这不是我通常会分配的任务……我想如果你愿意，我可以给你一个新任务。

english: If you do get a new one, you will reset your standard task streak of [task streak amount]. Is that okay? It won't affect your Wilderness task streak of [task streak amount].
translation: 如果你接了新任务，你将重置你的标准任务连续完成次数 [task streak amount]。可以吗？这不会影响你的荒野任务连续完成次数 [task streak amount]。

english: No, thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: You're still hunting [monster], with [amount] to go.
translation: 你仍在猎杀 [monster]，还剩 [amount] 个。

english: I don't think that's a suitable task for you. Shall I cancel it? This will not wipe your task streaks.
translation: 我觉得那不适合你。要我取消吗？这不会清除你的任务连续完成次数。

english: Yes, please cancel it.
translation: 是的，请取消。

english: Alright, consider the task cancelled. You can now get a new assignment when you want one.
translation: 好吧，任务已取消。你现在可以随时接新任务了。

english: No, thanks, I want to try doing it.
translation: 不，谢谢，我想试试做它。

english: Good luck with that.
translation: 祝你好运。

english: Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
translation: 你有什么奖励给我，或者有什么可以交易的吗？

english: I have quite a few rewards you can earn, and a wide variety of Slayer equipment for sale.
translation: 我有不少你可以获得的奖励，还有各种杀戮者装备出售。

english: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
translation: 我们来谈谈我分配任务的难度。

english: The Slayer Masters may currently assign you any task in our lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: 杀戮大师目前可能会从列表中分配任何任务给你，无论你的战斗等级如何。

english: That's fine - I can handle any task.
translation: 没关系——我能应付任何任务。

english: That's the spirit.
translation: 这才是精神。

english: In future, please don't give anything too tough.
translation: 以后，请不要给太难的任务。

english: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.
translation: 好的，从现在开始，所有杀戮大师在为你选择任务时都会考虑你的战斗等级，所以你应该不会接到太难的任务。

english: The Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.
translation: 杀戮大师在为你选择任务时会考虑你的战斗等级，所以你应该不会接到太难的任务。

english: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.
translation: 没关系——我不想要太难的任务。

english: Okay, we'll keep checking your combat level.
translation: 好的，我们会继续检查你的战斗等级。

english: Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!
translation: 别检查我的战斗等级了——我什么都能应付！

english: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will assign you anything from their lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: 好的，从现在开始，所有杀戮大师都会从他们的列表中分配任何任务给你，无论你的战斗等级如何。

english: Hello, I'm here about the blessed axe again.
translation: 你好，我这次来还是为了祝福斧头的事。

english: I suppose you want a new axe?
translation: 我想你想要一把新斧头？

english: Actually, yes.
translation: 其实，是的。

english: You'll need to hand over both a mithril axe and holy symbol of Saradomin. You don't have an axe in your pack, so I'm not able to help.
translation: 你需要交出一把秘银斧头和萨拉多明神圣符号。你包里没有斧头，所以我帮不了你。

english: Here's the replacement; be more careful with this one, eh?
translation: 这是替换的斧头，这次可要小心点。

english: Not right now.
translation: 现在不要。

english: Goodbye, then. You may, of course, return if you decide you want a new axe.
translation: 那再见。当然，如果你决定想要新斧头，可以随时回来。

english: You already have an axe in your bag but you want another?
translation: 你包里已经有一把斧头了，但你还想要一把？

english: So you're filling in for Turael?
translation: 所以你是来代替图拉尔的？

english: That I am. It's been quite a while since I last did this sort of thing, but my brother wants one last adventure, so here I am.
translation: 是的。我上次做这种事已经是很久以前了，但我哥哥想要最后一次冒险，所以我来了。

english: So you've done this before?
translation: 所以你以前做过这个？

english: Oh yes. In fact, I was doing it before my brother was. Back in his adventuring days, I was the one here teaching people the basics.
translation: 哦是的。事实上，我在我哥哥之前就在做这个。在他冒险的日子里，是我在这里教人们基础知识。

english: After Spria was born, he retired from his life of thrill- seeking. That's when he took over from me.
translation: 斯普里亚出生后，他退休不再追求刺激。那时他接替了我。

english: Interesting... I never knew that.
translation: 有趣……我从不知道那个。

english: He doesn't talk about his adventures much, but once you get him going, you won't be able to make him stop!
translation: 他不太谈论他的冒险，但一旦你让他开口，你就无法让他停下！

english: About Turael...
translation: 关于图拉尔……

english: You need not share your condolences with me, adventurer. I've been prepared for this for a long time.
translation: 你不必向我表示哀悼，冒险者。我为此准备了很久。

english: You have?
translation: 你有？

english: My brother was a thrill-seeker his whole life. Even after he retired, I always knew something would come and pull him back in.
translation: 我哥哥一生都在追求刺激。即使他退休后，我也知道总会有什么事把他拉回去。

english: And that something was me. I'm sorry...
translation: 而那件事就是我。我很抱歉……

english: Don't be. He died doing what he loved, and he died a hero. He wouldn't have had it any other way.
translation: 别这样。他死在他热爱的事业上，死得像个英雄。他不会希望有其他结局。

english: Er... Nothing...
translation: 呃……没什么……

english: Very well done, take this.
translation: 做得很好，拿着这个。

english: I need another assignment.
translation: 我需要另一个任务。

english: No that's okay, I'll take a task from you.
translation: 不没关系，我从你这里接任务。

english: Oh okay then, I'll go talk to Chaeldar.
translation: 哦好吧，那我去找凯尔达谈谈。

english: Yes, please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No, thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Yes, please cancel it.
translation: 是的，请取消。

english: Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
translation: 你有什么奖励给我，或者有什么可以交易的吗？

english: Look at rewards.
translation: 查看奖励。

english: Look at shop.
translation: 查看商店。

english: Cancel.
translation: 取消。

english: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
translation: 我们来谈谈我分配任务的难度。

english: That's fine - I can handle any task.
translation: 没关系——我能应付任何任务。

english: In future, please don't give anything too tough.
translation: 以后，请不要给太难的任务。

english: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.
translation: 没关系——我不想要太难的任务。

english: Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!
translation: 别检查我的战斗等级了——我什么都能应付！

english: I'm here about blessed axes again.
translation: 我又来是关于祝福斧头的事。

english: Actually, yes.
translation: 其实，是的。

english: I can do without for now, thanks.
translation: 我现在可以不用，谢谢。

english: So you're filling in for Turael?
translation: 所以你是来代替图拉尔的？

english: About Turael...
translation: 关于图拉尔……

english: Er... Nothing...
translation: 呃……没什么……

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Ah, a stranger to our island. How can I help?
translation: 陌生人啊。我能怎么帮你？

english: Ah! [player name], I'm glad to see you've returned. How can I help?
translation: 啊！[player name]，很高兴看到你回来了。我能怎么帮你？

english: It's a very interesting house you have here. Does he have a name?
translation: 你这里的房子很有趣。他有名字吗？

english: Why of course. It's Berty.
translation: 当然有。它叫伯蒂。

english: Berty? Berty the Chicken leg house?
translation: 伯蒂？鸡腿伯蒂房子？

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: May I ask why?
translation: 我可以问问为什么吗？

english: It just has that certain ring to it, don't you think? Beeerteeee!
translation: 它听起来就是那个味儿，你不觉得吗？伯——蒂——！

english: You're ins...
translation: 你疯……

english: Insane? Very.
translation: 疯了？非常。

english: There's a lunar spell in my spell book that I can't use. Could you...?
translation: 我的法术书里有个月魔法我用不了。你能……？

english: Help you? Certainly. It's one I've just rediscovered! I can teach it to you if you like, but you have to listen to a story first.
translation: 帮你？当然，这是我刚重新发现的！如果你愿意，我可以教你，但你得先听个故事。

english: Okay, I don't mind hearing sto-
translation: 好的，我不介意听故……

english: Wonderful!
translation: 太好了！

english: Well, I was going through some ancient documents recently, expanding my knowledge of our great ancestors...
translation: 嗯，我最近在查阅一些古老文件，扩展我对我们伟大祖先的了解……

english: Hmm, actually, I think I had better go further back, so you will understand.
translation: 嗯，其实，我想我最好再往前追溯一点，这样你才能理解。

english: You know of our ancient war with the Fremennik that you recently healed?
translation: 你知道我们最近化解的与费明尼克的宿怨吗？

english: Of course! I am a great diplomat, aren't I?
translation: 当然！我是个伟大的外交官，不是吗？

english: Some diplomat. Did you even discover WHY we were at war for so long?
translation: 什么外交官。你甚至发现我们为什么战争这么久了吗？

english: Errr... You couldn't see eye to eye about magic, or something like that.
translation: 呃……你们在魔法上意见不合，或者类似的事。

english: Not too far off; it goes deeper than that.
translation: 差不多；但比那更深。

english: The Fremennik were actually the first to discover how to make runes, but there was disagreement within the tribe about the implications of making such powerful objects.
translation: 费明尼克实际上是最早发现如何制作符石的，但部落内部对制作如此强大物品的影响存在分歧。

english: Most Fremennik felt we were stealing power from the gods. They could not see past that to the great things we could do with such power, so we split from them and became the Moon Clan. Our ancient leader, who first
translation: 大多数费明尼克人觉得我们在窃取神的力量。他们看不到我们可以用这种力量做的伟大事情，所以我们与他们分裂，成为了月氏族。我们的古代领袖，他是第一个

english: discovered the rune essence mine here on Lunar Isle, travelled far and wide searching for more places of power. He and his followers built altars all over Gielinor - which you use today to create runes - and at their
translation: 在月亮岛发现符文精华矿的人，走遍各地寻找更多力量之地。他和他的追随者在基利诺尔各地建造了祭坛——你们今天用它来制作符石——在他们

english: height they made runes by the crateful. They had perfected the process and even advanced it, creating altars that could create any type of rune regardless of the crafter's ability. But the strife between the Moon
translation: 鼎盛时期，他们成箱地制作符石。他们完善甚至改进了这个过程，创造了无论制作者能力如何都能制作任何类型符石的祭坛。但月亮

english: Clan and the Fremennik heightened. The Fremennik had grown strong in body, while our clan had grown stong in mind. They overpowered our tribe and we retreated to Lunar Isle, where we had lived ever since.
translation: 氏族和费明尼克之间的冲突加剧了。费明尼克身体变得强壮，而我们的氏族心智变得强大。他们压倒了我们部落，我们撤退到月亮岛，从此住在那里。

english: The Fremennik then swept over Gielinor destroying the altars we had made, in an attempt to remove all trace of magic from the land.
translation: 然后费明尼克席卷基利诺尔，摧毁了我们建造的祭坛，试图从这片土地上消除所有魔法痕迹。

english: That's all very interesting, but what's it got to do with this spell?
translation: 这些都很有趣，但这和这个法术有什么关系？

english: I'm getting to that!
translation: 我正要说那个！

english: The Fremennik were not as thorough as they thought. They destroyed only the entrances to the altars, for the altars themselves were on a different plane, but they were successful in wiping out our ability to create
translation: 费明尼克没有他们想的那么彻底。他们只摧毁了祭坛的入口，因为祭坛本身在不同的位面，但他们成功抹杀了我们制作

english: runes. That ability has only recently been rediscovered on the mainland, so I hear.
translation: 符石的能力。据我所知，这种能力最近才在大陆被重新发现。

english: Our people were left isolated on Lunar Isle but we used it to our advantage. Our control over Magic advanced beyond the need for runes and all knowledge of the altar locations passed from memory. Fortunately,
translation: 我们的人民被孤立留在月亮岛，但我们利用了这一点。我们对魔法的控制超越了符石的需求，所有祭坛位置的知识都从记忆中消失了。幸运的是，

english: some records survived... The manuscript I discovered contains the teleportation spell to an advanced altar called Ourania. It's an altar that allows the user, regardless of their Runecrafting ability, to craft any
translation: 一些记录幸存了下来……我发现的手稿包含传送到一个叫欧拉尼亚的高级祭坛的传送法术。这是一个允许使用者，无论其符石制作能力如何，制作任何

english: type of rune upon it. Ourania is a powerful altar indeed. What state it is in after so many millennia, I know not, but it's interesting all the same.
translation: 类型符石的祭坛。欧拉尼亚确实是一个强大的祭坛。经过数千年它处于什么状态，我不知道，但这仍然很有趣。

english: So, will you teach me the spell?
translation: 那么，你会教我这个法术吗？

english: Certainly.
translation: 当然。

english: *Baby Yaga whispers in your ear*
translation: 芭芭雅嘎在你耳边低语

english: And now you know the teleportation spell, off with you! Go explore.
translation: 现在你知道传送法术了，走吧！去探索。

english: I don't really have ti-
translation: 我真的没时……

english: *Sigh* Very well. Another time, perhaps.
translation: 叹气 好吧。也许下次。

english: Why do you ask questions if you're going to read my mind anyway?
translation: 既然你要读我的心，为什么还要问问题？

english: I was being polite, silly foreigner.
translation: 我这是出于礼貌嘛，傻老外。

english: I'm good thanks, bye.
translation: 我很好，谢谢，再见。

english: Have you got anything to trade?
translation: 你有什么可以交易的吗？

english: It's a very interesting house you have here.
translation: 你这里的房子很有趣。

english: There is a lunar spell I can't use in my spell book - can you help me?
translation: 我的法术书里有个月魔法我用不了——你能帮我吗？

english: Okay, I don't mind hearing stories.
translation: 好的，我不介意听故事。

english: I don't really have time right now.
translation: 我现在真的没时间。

english: I'm good, thanks, bye.
translation: 我很好，谢谢，再见。

english: Hey, Mole. How is life above ground?
translation: 嘿，鼹鼠。地面生活怎么样？

english: Well, the last time I was above ground, I was having to contend with people throwing snow at some weird yellow duck in my park.
translation: 嗯，上次我在地面上时，正碰上人们在我的公园里向一些奇怪的黄色鸭子扔雪。

english: Why were they doing that?
translation: 他们为什么那样做？

english: No idea, I didn't stop to ask as an angry mob was closing in on them pretty quickly.
translation: 不知道，我没停下来问，因为一群愤怒的人正迅速向他们逼近。

english: Sounds awful.
translation: 听起来很糟糕。

english: Anyway, keep Molin'!
translation: 不管怎样，继续挖！

english: *slap*
translation: 拍打

english: Grrr!
translation: 咕噜！

english: Grrrr!
translation: 咕噜！

english: Grarrr!
translation: 咕噜！

english: Squeak squeak!
translation: 吱吱吱！

english: Squeaka squeaka!
translation: 吱吱吱！

english: Squeee
translation: 吱

english: Squeak
translation: 吱

english: Hello Bailey.
translation: 你好贝利。

english: Well, hello again, [player name]. What brings you back out here?
translation: 嗯，又见面了，[player name]。什么风把你吹回这里来了？

english: Just looking around.
translation: 只是四处看看。

english: Well, be very careful out there! Those dratted slugs have been joined by giant lobsters!
translation: 嗯，在外面要小心！那些该死的蛞蝓身边又多了巨型龙虾！

english: Good day [Sir/Madame]. Would you like some nice freshly baked bread? Or perhaps a nice piece of cake?
translation: 你好[Sir/Madame]。你想要一些新鲜出炉的面包吗？或者来块不错的蛋糕？

english: No thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Hey! Get your hands off there!
translation: 嘿！把手拿开！

english: You're the one who stole something from me!
translation: 是你从我这里偷了东西！

english: Guardsguards!
translation: 守卫守卫！

english: Good day, Monsieur. Would you like ze nice freshly-baked bread? Or perhaps a nice piece of cake?
translation: 你好，先生。你想要些新鲜出炉的面包吗？或者来块不错的蛋糕？

english: Let's see what you have.
translation: 让我看看你有什么。

english: No thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: You've tried the rest, but how about the best? Our baked goods won't be beaten!
translation: 其他的你都试过了，但最好的试过没？我们的烘焙食品无与伦比！

english: Let's see what you have.
translation: 让我看看你有什么。

english: I'm good.
translation: 我没事。

english: Hmph!
translation: 哼！

english: I'm good.
translation: 我没事。

english: Get out of this village. You are not welcome here.
translation: 滚出这个村庄。这里不欢迎你。

english: So you're the one who freed Azzanadra from his prison? Thank you!
translation: 所以你就是把阿扎纳德拉从监狱里放出来的人？谢谢！

english: Time to die, Saradominist filth!
translation: 去死吧，萨拉多明信徒的垃圾！

english: Prepare to suffer, Zamorakian scum!
translation: 准备受苦吧，扎莫拉克信徒的渣滓！

english: You chose the wrong place to start trouble!
translation: 你选错了地方惹事！

english: You dare steal from me?
translation: 你敢偷我的东西？

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？

english: Nothing really, I'm new to town and wanted to get to know the locals.
translation: 没什么，我刚来镇上，想认识一下当地人。

english: I'm too busy for chitchat. Come back if you have some business to discuss with us.
translation: 我太忙了没空闲聊。如果你有生意要和我们谈就再来。

english: You dog! You killed our champion and for that you will die!
translation: 你这狗东西！你杀了我们的冠军勇士，为此你得死！

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Stuff for sale. You buying?
translation: 有东西卖。你买吗？

english: No? 'Bye then.
translation: 不买？那再见。

english: Yes
translation: 是

english: No
translation: 不

english: Gggggrrrrrrrrr!!!
translation: 咕噜咕噜咕噜！！！

english: Yes?
translation: 什么事？

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Banisoch.
translation: 巴尼索克。

english: Thanks, that was informative.
translation: 谢谢，长见识了。

english: It leads to the caves beneath this part of the island. I think there's dragons at the other end; you can hear the noises and smell the smoke coming up the passage.
translation: 它通向这个岛屿下方的洞穴。我想另一端有龙；你能听到噪音，闻到从通道里飘上来的烟味。

english: Can I go down?
translation: 我能下去吗？

english: Eh, I could sort something out for you. Thing is, my brother's got a job guarding the main entrance to the caves. I'd be undercutting him if I let people go down this hole.
translation: 呃，我可以为你安排点什么。问题是，我哥哥有个工作是守卫洞穴的主入口。如果我让人从这个洞下去，我就抢他生意了。

english: Oh, does this mean you won't let me go in?
translation: 哦，这意味着你不会让我进去？

english: No, it means I'd need something to assuage my conscience after betraying my brother. 5,000 trading sticks ought to cheer me up nicely.
translation: 不，这意味着背叛我哥哥后，我需要点东西来安抚良心。5,000交易棒应该能让我心情好点。

english: Oh.
translation: 哦。

english: It's a deal - here's 5,000 trading sticks.
translation: 成交——这是5,000交易棒。

english: Um, no thanks.
translation: 嗯，不用了，谢谢。

english: Never mind.
translation: 没关系。

english: Never mind.
translation: 没关系。

english: I'll leave you alone.
translation: 我就不打扰你了。

english: Can I climb down that hole now?
translation: 我现在能下那个洞了吗？

english: Yes, you've paid, you can climb down there whenever you like. Go, go.
translation: 是的，你付钱了，你想什么时候爬下去都可以。去吧，去吧。

english: Why are you waiting by this hole?
translation: 你为什么在这个洞旁边等着？

english: Ever seen a toilet around here?
translation: 你在这里见过厕所吗？

english: Actually, never mind.
translation: 其实，没关系。

english: Hey, I didn't say you could do that!
translation: 嘿，我没说你可以那样做！

english: Either go down it or don't go down it, but stop messing around with it!
translation: 要么下去，要么别下去，但别瞎折腾它！

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Tell me about this hole.
translation: 跟我讲讲这个洞。

english: Can I go down?
translation: 我能下去吗？

english: It's a deal - here's 5,000 trading sticks.
translation: 成交——这是5,000交易棒。

english: Um, no thanks.
translation: 嗯，不用了，谢谢。

english: I'll leave you alone.
translation: 我就不打扰你了。

english: Can I climb down that hole now?
translation: 我现在能下那个洞了吗？

english: Why are you waiting by this hole?
translation: 你为什么在这个洞旁边等着？

english: Actually, never mind.
translation: 其实，没关系。

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: What does it look like I'm doing? I'm here to help cleanse the Devourer's corruption from this sacred place.
translation: 你看不出来吗？我是来净化这片圣地、清除吞噬者的腐蚀。

english: I didn't expect a camel to be capable of standing up to such a strong enemy. Aren't you worried for your safety?
translation: 我没想过骆驼能面对这么强大的敌人。你不担心你的安全吗？

english: Not particularly. We camels are known for our durability in harsh environments. I think you should be more concerned about yourself. You humans seem so much more fragile than many other species.
translation: 不太担心。我们骆驼向来以耐受恶劣环境著称。我想你应该更关心你自己。你们人类似乎比许多其他物种脆弱得多。

english: I'm sure I'll be fine, but I appreciate your concern.
translation: 我相信我会没事的，但我感谢你的关心。

english: How did you get all my stuff?
translation: 你怎么拿到我所有东西的？

english: I don't have any of your stuff.
translation: 我没有你的任何东西。

english: Oh yeah, I don't use a bank!
translation: 哦对，我不用银行！

english: Good for you.
translation: 对你有好处。

english: Don't you understand how banking works? I don't have all of your stuff, I have simply been trained to access the place where it is all stored.
translation: 你不明白银行是怎么运作的吗？我又没拿着你所有东西，只是受过训练能访问存放你物品的空间。

english: But you're a camel. I didn't know camels could train to become bankers.
translation: 但你是只骆驼。我不知道骆驼可以训练成为银行职员。

english: Well there are ghost bankers, gnome bankers, dwarf bankers, goblin bankers and more! Is it really all that surprising that camels can do it too?
translation: 嗯，有幽灵银行职员、地精银行职员、矮人银行职员、哥布林银行职员等等！骆驼也能做真的那么令人惊讶吗？

english: I suppose when you put it like that...
translation: 我想你这么说的时候……

english: So, what do you make of all this?
translation: 那么，你对这一切怎么看？

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你什么意思？

english: I mean everything that's been going on here. It seems like a lot to take in.
translation: 我的意思是这里发生的一切。似乎有很多要接受。

english: Well, it really was inevitable, which is a shame really. It saddens me to see what has happened to this tomb.
translation: 嗯，这真的是不可避免的，真是遗憾。看到这座坟墓发生的事让我很难过。

english: Well at least we're fixing it now.
translation: 嗯至少我们现在正在修复它。

english: We? Are you sure about that? I find you adventurers often have ulterior motives.
translation: 我们？你确定吗？我发现你们冒险者经常有不可告人的动机。

english: What do you mean by that?
translation: 你什么意思？

english: You may say that you are here to fight the corruption. Indeed, there may be some truth to that. However, would you really be here if there wasn't something for you to gain?
translation: 你可能会说你是来对抗腐蚀的。确实，那可能有些道理。但是，如果没有什么可获得的，你真的会来这里吗？

english: I swear, I'm only here to deal with the Devourer's corruption!
translation: 我发誓，我来这里只是为了处理吞噬者的腐蚀！

english: I hear you speak those words, but I feel no conviction behind them.
translation: 我听到你说那些话，但我感觉不到背后的诚意。

english: How can I prove it to you? What is it that you are looking for?
translation: 我怎么向你证明？你在找什么？

english: Why do you care what opinions a camel has of you?
translation: 你为什么在乎骆驼对你的看法？

english: I want everyone to like me.
translation: 我想让每个人都喜欢我。

english: If your only goal in life is to be liked by all, then you'll probably spend the rest of it chasing the impossible.
translation: 如果你人生的唯一目标是让所有人都喜欢你，那你可能会用余生去追逐不可能。

english: I want to prove you wrong.
translation: 我想证明你错了。

english: So you only care because my words cut close to the bone? If you truly want to prove me wrong, then it's your outlook that should change.
translation: 所以你只在乎是因为我的话戳到了痛处？如果你真想证明我错了，那应该改变的是你的看法。

english: It seems to be important to you.
translation: 这对你似乎很重要。

english: You think so?
translation: 你这么认为？

english: I do, so tell me, what can I do to show you that not all adventurers are the same?
translation: 我是，所以告诉我，我能做什么来向你证明不是所有冒险者都一样？

english: Hmm...
Every adventurer seems to destroy without any thought as to what they are doing, nor with any intent to restore what was lost.
translation: 每个冒险者似乎都不假思索地破坏，也无意弥补所造成的损失。

english: If you can do that, then that would prove to me that you are infact different from the rest.
translation: 如果你能做到那样，那就向我证明了你确实与众不同。

english: Restore what was lost? What do you mean by that?
translation: 恢复失去的东西？你什么意思？

english: That's for you to figure out.
translation: 那得你自己想。

english: Yeah, you're right, I'm here for the loot.
translation: 是的，你说得对，我是来拿战利品的。

english: Well, just try not to desecrate this place any more than it already has been.
translation: 嗯，尽量别再亵渎这个地方了，它已经够惨了。

english: What did you ask me to do again?
translation: 你刚才让我做什么来着？

english: So you want me to restore what was lost?
translation: 所以你想让我恢复失去的东西？

english: Indeed.
translation: 确实。

english: I believe I understand now.
translation: 我想我现在明白了。

english: Oh? Do tell.
translation: 哦？说说看。

english: Well, while us adventurers have been doing our best to fight against the Devourer's corruption, we've been neglecting what has been lost to achieve that goal. Namely, the four guardians we defeated along the way.
translation: 嗯，当我们冒险者尽力对抗吞噬者的腐蚀时，我们忽视了为实现那个目标而失去的东西。 也就是，我们沿途击败的四个守护者。

english: Ba-Ba was a proud baboon who wished for her troop to flourish. To honour her, I made sure that they won't be forgotten by telling their story to the monkeys of Ape Atoll.
translation: 巴巴是一只骄傲的狒狒，期盼族群繁荣。为纪念她，我确保她们不被遗忘——已将她们的故事讲给猿猴岛的猴子们听。

english: Akkha was cruelly denied death by the Devourer, so I gave his ashes to the High Priest of Icthlarin to give him a proper send-off.
translation: 阿卡被吞噬者残忍地剥夺了死去的权利，所以我把他的骨灰交给了伊克哈林的大祭司，让他得以体面安息。

english: Zebak was fooled into leaving his home and confined within the tomb, so I took his fang and buried it on an island surrounded by crocodiles.
translation: 泽巴克被骗离开家园并被禁锢在墓穴中，所以我拿了他的尖牙，把它埋在鳄鱼环绕的岛上。

english: Kephri was promised a future for her race, but it was all a lie. I found a scarab egg within some of her dung, and I gave it to the High Priest of Scabaras to try and nurture it.
translation: 凯弗里被许诺了她的种族未来，但那是谎言。我在她的一些粪便中发现了一个圣甲虫卵，便将其交给斯卡巴拉斯大祭司尝试培育。

english: Well well, colour me impressed adventurer. It seems that you do care after all.
translation: 好吧好吧，你可真让我刮目相看，冒险者。看来你确实在乎。

english: It's a shame that much of the damage cannot truly be undone, but I know that Het, Apmeken, Crondis and even Scabaras will be grateful for your actions.
translation: 很遗憾许多损害无法真正挽回，但我知道赫特、阿普梅肯、克伦迪斯甚至斯卡巴拉斯都会感激你的行为。

english: I just wish there was more I could do.
translation: 我只希望我能做得更多。

english: We always do, but you have still done more than most.
translation: 我们总是这样想，但你已经做得比大多数人多了。

english: Now, I have something for you. I've been looking for someone worthy enough to pass this on to.
translation: 现在，我有东西给你。我一直在找一个值得托付的人。

english: A key? What's this for?
translation: 一把钥匙？这是做什么的？

english: I'll leave that as another puzzle for you to solve.
translation: 我把那个留作另一个谜题让你解。

english: Well thanks, I guess... You know, out of all the camels I've met, you're definitely the strangest one.
translation: 嗯谢谢，我想……你知道，在我见过的所有骆驼中，你绝对是最奇怪的一个。

english: Well, it does take a special kind of camel to master the portal magic used for bank access.
translation: 嗯，确实需要一种特殊的骆驼才能掌握用于前往银行的传送门魔法。

english: I've lost that key you gave me.
translation: 我把你给我的钥匙弄丢了。

english: And it conveniently found its way back to me. Try not to lose it this time.
translation: 它恰巧回到了我这里。这次尽量别弄丢了。

english: Do you have a name?
translation: 你有名字吗？

english: My name is my own, adventurer. It's hardly important right now.
translation: 我的名字是我自己的，冒险者。现在不太重要。

english: I suppose you've earned the right to know. My name is Cam the Camel.
translation: 我想你赢得了知道的权利。我的名字是骆驼卡姆。

english: Well, nice to meet you, Cam the Camel. It'll be nice to call you something other than 'the bank camel' from now on.
translation: 嗯，很高兴见到你，骆驼卡姆。从现在起能叫你别的而不是“银行骆驼”真好。

english: I'm glad I met a kind adventurer such as yourself. I look forward to seeing you continue your diligent work in cleansing this tomb of the Devourer's corruption.
translation: 很高兴见到像你这样善良的冒险者。我期待看到你继续勤奋工作，清除这座墓穴中吞噬者的腐蚀。

english: As I said, my name is Cam the Camel.
translation: 正如我所说，我的名字是骆驼卡姆。

english: Can you follow me into the tomb?
translation: 你能跟我进墓穴吗？

english: Why would I want to do that?
translation: 我为什么要那样做？

english: It would be very helpful. Think of all the supplies I'd have access to if you came with me and followed me around like a portable bank.
translation: 那会很有帮助。想想如果你跟我来，像个移动银行一样跟着我，我能接触到多少补给。

english: But you don't even use a bank.
translation: 但你甚至不用银行。

english: Oh yeah! I forgot.
translation: 哦对！我忘了。

english: Right...
translation: 好吧……

english: What do you take me for? Some kind of pack yak?
translation: 你把我当什么？某种驮马？

english: Besides, if I leave this place then I won't be able to help any other adventurers with their banking needs.
translation: 而且，如果我离开这个地方，我就无法帮助其他冒险者满足他们的银行需求。

english: I need to get going.
translation: 我得走了。

english: Suit yourself.
translation: 随你便。

english: Bleh, this grain is disgusting! Do you think I am but a simple cow, adventurer?
translation: 呸，这谷物真难吃！你以为我是头普通奶牛吗，冒险者？

english: No, no, I was just...
translation: 不，不，我只是……

english: This is why I eat the grain in that sack over there. It's specially grown out here in the desert. Once harvested, it goes through a preparation process of several years that...
translation: 这就是为什么我吃那边袋子里的谷物。它是专门在沙漠里种植的。一旦收获，它要经过几年的准备过程……

english: The bank camel talks at length about the process of producing such fine grain...
translation: 银行骆驼长篇大论地讲述生产这种优质谷物的过程……

english: ...and that's why this grain is so special. Not to mention so hard to come by.
translation: ……这就是为什么这种谷物如此特别。更不用说它有多难得了。

english: My, this is some good grain, adventurer! Great flavour profile, not too salty and with just a hint of sweetness. It almost reminds me of...
translation: 天哪，这是些好谷物，冒险者！味道很棒，不太咸，带点甜味。它几乎让我想起……

english: The bank camel looks at you for a moment as if lost in thought.
translation: 银行骆驼凝视着你，仿佛陷入了沉思。

english: Erm, yes?
translation: 呃，是的？

english: Oh, never mind, I was just thinking about something.
translation: 哦，没关系，我只是在想事情。

english: The bank camel stares at you in silence for an uncomfortably long time.
translation: 银行骆驼沉默地盯着你，时间长得让人不适。

english: Well, I can't stand around here all day. I've got some things I need to take care of.
translation: 嗯，我不能整天站在这里。我有些事要处理。

english: I won't be eating this, but I do like to collect them. Thank you.
translation: 我不会吃这个，但我喜欢收集它们。谢谢。

english: The bank camel looks at you with piqued interest, then rolls their eyes as they realise you can't understand them.
translation: 银行骆驼饶有兴趣地看着你，随后翻了个白眼——它意识到你听不懂它说话。

english: Quite the banana you have there! Ba-Ba and her baboon troop were always known for finding the biggest of these. It's a shame that their memory will now disappear into history.
translation: 你这香蕉可真不一般！巴巴和她的狒狒族群向来以能找到最大的香蕉而闻名。可惜他们的记忆现在将消失在历史中。

english: Hey there. What are you lot doing out here?
translation: 嘿。你们在这里做什么？

english: We're from the College of Bards in Tempestus. We thought we'd set up camp here to do some performances for anyone travelling through the savannah.
translation: 我们来自坦佩斯图斯城的吟游诗人学院。我们想在这里扎营，为任何穿越草原的旅人表演。

english: With the kingdom now open to tourists, we've had plenty of new fans!
translation: 随着王国现在向游客开放，我们有了很多新粉丝！

english: Nice trumpet.
translation: 不错的喇叭。

english: Thanks! I made it myself. The College of Bards insist that we all have the ability to create and maintain our own instruments. I'm quite proud of what I came up with!
translation: 谢谢！我自己做的。吟游诗人学院坚持要求我们都有能力制作和维护自己的乐器。我对自己的作品相当自豪！

english: Well I hope it serves you well.
translation: 嗯，希望它对你有用。

english: Hey there.
translation: 嘿。

english: Think you've got what it takes to join the College of Bards?
translation: 觉得你有资格加入吟游诗人学院吗？

english: I'm not sure.
translation: 我不确定。

english: Well it only takes a lifetime of practice, so maybe give it a go one day.
translation: 嗯，只需要一生的练习，所以也许哪天试试。

english: Hi there. Are you enjoying the view?
translation: 你好，你在欣赏风景吗？

english: I am, though I do wish it would be blocked by the ferry to Tempestus.
translation: 是的，不过我真希望去坦佩斯图斯城的渡船能挡住它。

english: The ferry? Is there something wrong with it?
translation: 渡船？它有什么问题吗？

english: I'm not sure exactly. All I know is that it's not running at the moment.
translation: 我不太确定。我只知道它现在没运行。

english: How urgently do you need to get there?
translation: 你有多急需去那里？

english: We should be back at the College of Bards already, but I'm sure they'll understand why we got delayed.
translation: 我们本该已经回到吟游诗人学院了，但我相信他们会理解我们为什么延误。

english: Oh, you're a bard? Could you sing for me?
translation: 哦，你是吟游诗人？能为我唱首歌吗？

english: Maybe. Can you take us to Temptestus?
translation: 也许。你能带我们去坦佩斯图斯城吗？

english: Unfortunately not.
translation: 不幸的是不能。

english: Then I'm afraid you don't get any singing this time.
translation: 那恐怕这次你听不到歌了。

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Nilsal! Have you come to hear a song from the Sister Songstresses of the College of Bards?
translation: 你好！你是来听吟游诗人学院歌女修女会的歌吗？

english: Sister Songstresses? So you're a group of sisters who sing together?
translation: 歌女姐妹？所以你们是一群一起唱歌的姐妹？

english: Don't be silly! Of course we aren't!
translation: 别傻了！当然不是！

english: Oh... The name did suggest otherwise...
translation: 哦……名字确实让人那样想……

english: Well, we realised when we met that we were all very similar, so we've been using it as a selling point! Everyone loves Snappy Sister, Stormy Sister, and of course me, Spirited Sister!
translation: 嗯，我们见面时意识到我们都很相似，所以我们就用它作为卖点！大家都喜欢活泼姐妹，暴躁姐妹，当然还有我，精神姐妹！

english: Does that work?
translation: 那有用吗？

english: People love a nice story about a trio of sisters coming together! So yes, it works rather well.
translation: 人们喜欢三姐妹聚在一起的精彩故事！所以是的，相当有效。

english: That seems... unethical.
translation: 那似乎……不道德。

english: It's all storytelling! Songs, appearance, history. We're telling a story and people want to hear it!
translation: 这都是讲故事！歌曲，外表，历史。我们在讲故事，人们想听！

english: I'm not sure if people wanting to hear it makes it entirely ethical.
translation: 我不确定人们想听是否就让它完全道德了。

english: Is it made better if our songs are good?
translation: 如果我们的歌好听会更好吗？

english: Now that you mention it... no of course it isn't.
translation: 既然你提到了……不，当然不是。

english: Well, you're just no fun, iknami.
translation: 嗯，你真没趣，朋友。

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

translation: 哦，你好。

translation: 你看起来有点低落。怎么了？

english: I just want to get back to the College of Bards. It's like my spark has gone out being away from such a creative environment.
translation: 我只想回到吟游诗人学院。就像离开这样一个充满创造力的环境，我的火花熄灭了一样。

english: I'm sure you'll be back there before long.
translation: 我相信你不久就能回去。

english: You think?
translation: 你这么认为？

english: It doesn't hurt to be hopeful, does it? Not to mention, hope can be a great inspiration!
translation: 抱有希望没什么坏处，对吧？更不用说，希望可以是巨大的灵感！

english: Hope can be a great inspiration... Perfect! I'll use that!
translation: 希望可以是巨大的灵感……完美！我要用它！

english: You'll use it?
translation: 你要用它？

english: To write our next song!
translation: 写我们的下一首歌！

english: Oh... Well, I'm happy to have helped.
translation: 哦……嗯，很高兴能帮上忙。

english: Ah! Outerlander! Do not interrupt me in my business! I must cull these fiends!
translation: 啊！外乡人！别打扰我办事！我必须消灭这些恶魔！

english: What are you doing down here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Only an outerlander would ask such a question! Is it not obvious what I am doing?
translation: 只有外乡人才会问这种问题！我在做什么不明显吗？

english: I kill the daggermouths for glory and for sport! When I have had my fill, I move on to the daggermouths' lair!
translation: 我猎杀深潜者是为了荣耀和娱乐！等我尽兴之后，我就前往深潜者的巢穴！

english: Erm... okay then. I'll leave you to it.
translation: 呃……好吧。我就不打扰你了。

english: I do not trust you outerlander, I will not accept your gifts, no matter what your intention...
translation: 我不信任你外乡人，我不会接受你的礼物，不管你的意图是什么……

english: Hello there Bardur. How's it going?
translation: 你好巴杜尔。最近怎么样？

english: I have been here all the long day, slaughtering the daggermouth spawns so that none may pass!
translation: 我在这里待了一整天，屠杀深潜者幼崽，不让任何一个通过！

english: My sword arm grows weary, and the blood of my foes hangs heavy upon my clothing!
translation: 我的持剑手臂变得疲惫，敌人的鲜血沉重地挂在我的衣服上！

english: Can you tell me anything about the caves down here?
translation: 你能和我说说下面洞穴的事吗？

english: Aye, that I can [Fremennik name]! Yonder lies the lair of the daggermouth kings, the three beasts of legend!
translation: 是的，我可以 [Fremennik name]！那边就是深潜者之王的巢穴，传说中的三只野兽！

english: I train my skills upon its foul brood, to prepare myself for the fight ahead!
translation: 我在它们邪恶的后代身上训练技能，为即将到来的战斗做准备！

english: Okay, thanks Bardur. Do you have any food with you?
translation: 好的，谢谢巴杜尔。你带食物了吗？

english: Ah, you did not come prepared [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你没准备好就来吗， [Fremennik name]？

english: I have nothing to spare, but my equipment grows weaker under the onslaught of the dagger-mouth spawns!
translation: 我并无富余，但我的装备在深潜者幼崽的猛攻下日渐损耗！

english: I will trade you a finely cooked shark if you have a replacement for my helm, my shield or my blade...
translation: 如果你有替换我的头盔、盾牌或刀刃的装备，我就跟你换一条精心烹制的鲨鱼……

english: Give me any equipment you wish to trade, and I will pay you a shark for it.
translation: 给我任何你想交易的装备，我会用一条鲨鱼跟你换。

english: Ah, just what I was looking for! You wish to trade me that for a cooked shark?
translation: 啊，正是我在找的！你想用那个跟我换一条熟鲨鱼？

english: Ah, this will serve me well as a backup! My thanks to you [Fremennik name], I trust we will one day sing songs together of glorious battles in the Rellekka longhall!
translation: 啊，这个作为备用很好！谢谢你 [Fremennik name]，我相信总有一天我们会在雷勒卡城长厅一起唱关于光荣战斗的歌！

english: As you wish, [Fremennik name] My weapons have lasted me this long, I will keep my trust in them yet.
translation: 随你便，[Fremennik name] 我的武器陪伴我这么久，我还是信任它们。

english: No [Fremennik name], I will trade you my finely cooked shark for a trusty Fremennik blade, a sturdy Fremennik helm, or a mighty Fremennik shield...
translation: 不 [Fremennik name]，我会用我精心烹制的鲨鱼换一把可靠的费明尼克刀刃，一顶坚固的费明尼克头盔，或一面强大的费明尼克盾牌……

english: I have no interest in that... thing... you are trying to offload on me.
translation: 我对那个……东西……没兴趣，你想甩给我。

english: Listen, [Fremennik name]. I'm sorry about the way I acted while you were exiled. Bardur gets hostile around outerlanders.
translation: 听着，[Fremennik name]。我很抱歉在你被流放时我的行为。巴杜尔在外乡人周围会变得敌对。

english: Don't worry about it, I understand! All's well that ends well! How've you been?
translation: 别担心，我理解！结果好就一切都好！你最近怎么样？

english: Ah, this will serve me well as a backup! My thanks to you [Fremennik name] Dräpare, I trust we will one day sing songs together of glorious battles in the Rellekka longhall!

english: Why are you not still sailing?
translation: 你为什么不再航行了？

english: Chronic sea sickness. My first, and only, voyage was spent dry heaving over the rails.
translation: 慢性晕船。我的第一次也是最后一次航行都在栏杆上干呕度过了。

english: If I had known about the sea sickness I could have saved myself a lot of money.
translation: 如果我知道会晕船，我就能省下一大笔钱。

english: What are you up to now then?
translation: 那你现在在做什么？

english: Well my ship had a little fire related problem. Fortunately it was well insured.
translation: 嗯，我的船有点火灾相关的问题。幸运的是它保险买得好。

english: Anyway, I don't have to work anymore so I've taken to canoeing on the river.
translation: 不管怎样，我不需要再工作了，所以我开始在河上划独木舟。

english: I don't get river sick!
translation: 我不会晕河！

english: Would you like to know how to make a canoe?
translation: 你想知道怎么做独木舟吗？

english: Could you teach me about canoes?
translation: 你能教我关于独木舟的事吗？

english: Well, you don't look like you have the skill to make a canoe.
translation: 嗯，你看起来没有做独木舟的技能。

english: You need to have at least level 12 woodcutting.
translation: 你需要至少12级伐木。

english: Once you are able to make a canoe it makes travel along the river much quicker!
translation: 一旦你能做独木舟，沿河旅行会快得多！

english: It's really quite simple. Just walk down to that tree on the bank and chop it down.
translation: 其实很简单。走到岸边那棵树把它砍倒。

english: When you have done that you can shape the log further with your axe to make a canoe.
translation: 做完后你可以用斧头进一步塑造原木做成独木舟。

english: Hah! I can tell just by looking that you lack talent in woodcutting.
translation: 哈！我一眼就能看出你缺乏伐木天赋。

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你什么意思？

english: No Callouses! No Splinters! No camp fires littering the trail behind you.
translation: 没有老茧！没有木刺！没有营火散落在你身后的小路上。

english: Anyway, the only 'canoe' you can make is a log. You'll be able to travel 1 stop along the river with a log canoe.
translation: 不管怎样，你唯一能做的“独木舟”是原木独木舟。你可以用原木独木舟沿河旅行1站。

english: With your skill in woodcutting you could make my favourite canoe, the Dugout. They might not be the best canoe on the river, but they get you where you're going.
translation: 以你的伐木技能，你可以制作普通的独木舟。它们可能不是河上最好的独木舟，但能带你去想去的地方。

english: How far will I be able to go in a Dugout canoe?
translation: 我能用独木舟走多远？

english: You will be able to travel 2 stops on the river.
translation: 你可以沿河旅行2站。

english: The best canoe you can make is a Stable Dugout, one step beyond a normal Dugout.
translation: 你能做的最好的独木舟是稳固的独木舟，比普通独木舟高一级。

english: With a Stable Dugout you can travel to any place on the river.
translation: 有了稳固的独木舟，你可以去河上的任何地方。

english: Even into the Wilderness?

english: Not likely! I've heard tell of a man up near Edgeville who claims he can use a Waka to get up into the Wilderness.
translation: 不太可能！我听说边陲镇附近有个人声称他能用瓦卡舟进入荒野。

english: Phileas Rimor has supposedly been looking for some assistance with something in Shayzien. Maybe worth investigating.
translation: 菲利亚斯‧里莫据说在谢兹恩城寻找某种协助。也许值得调查。

english: I hear that the rulers of Lovakengj have some work available. You'll find them in the Lovakengj Assembly.
translation: 我听说洛瓦肯吉城的统治者有些任务委托，你可以在洛瓦肯吉城议会找到他们。

translation: 显然阿西乌斯城中心区域有些骚动，也许值得去看看。

translation: 库兰德城堡外的抗议开始引起一些注意。也许值得去看看。

english: No, it hasn't been very busy lately.

english: A wise man once told me to never fear a drink... But perhaps I'm a little bias.
translation: 一位智者曾告诉我永远不要怕喝酒……但也许我有点偏见。

english: I'll have a pint.
translation: 我要一品脱。

translation: 当然，我要一品脱。

translation: 我能弄点吃的吗？

translation: 是的，谢谢，听起来不错。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

translation: 赞美萨拉多明！

translation: 感受萨拉多明的愤怒。

translation: 感受扎莫拉克的愤怒。
