english: How much wood would a woodchuck chuck if a woodchuck could chuck wood?
translation: 如果土拨鼠能扔木头，一只土拨鼠能扔多少木头？

english: Approximately 32,768 depending on his woodcutting level.
translation: 大约32,768，取决于他的伐木等级。

english: What did the oak tree drop?
translation: 橡树掉了什么？

english: What?
translation: 什么？

english: A-corny joke!
translation: 一个橡果笑话！

english: Aaaaaaaan I, willow-ays love youuu.
translation: 啊……我，柳树远爱你。

english: Why do maple trees not try to explore new lands?
translation: 为什么枫树不尝试探索新土地？

english: Why?
translation: 为什么？

english: They're afraid of treespassing.
translation: 它们害怕树越界。

english: Can we teak a break? My legs are tired.
translation: 我们能柚木休息吗？我的腿累了。

english: If you had a pet pig, you could call it ma-hog-eat-any.
translation: 如果你有个宠物猪，你可以叫它猪 - 任何 - 吃。

english: Is there anything I can't eat?
translation: 有什么我不能吃的吗？

english: Yew are a great companion.
translation: 你(紫杉)是个好伙伴。

english: Yew are too kind, my furry little friend.
translation: 你(紫杉)太好了，我毛茸茸的小朋友。

english: I'm feeling blue today...
translation: 我今天感觉忧郁……

english: Anything I can do to cheer you up?
translation: 我能做什么让你高兴吗？

english: A dam and some logs could be some fun....
translation: 一个坝和一些原木可能有趣……

english: It sure is hard to cut the top off of a redwood tree... You can't take any short cuts!
translation: 砍掉红杉树顶真难……你不能抄近路！

english: Why do I even try talking to you.
translation: 我为什么还要跟你说话。

english: I almost choked on a log! I don't know if I camphor-give you for that!
translation: 我差点被原木呛到！我真不知道我怎么(樟木)能原谅你！

english: The truth is...
translation: 真相是……

english: I am ironwood.
translation: 我是铁木。

english: Everyone always asks why, what and when but never how. I'm jatoba-whelmed with all of this!
translation: 大家总是问为什么、什么和何时，但从不问如何。我对所有这些贾托巴 - 不知所措！

english: Eating logs is like enjoying wine. They all have a nuance of flavour. That last one for example was earthy, with hints of nuts and redberries, along with a scent of rose.
translation: 吃原木就像品酒。它们都有细微的味道差别。比如最后一个有泥土味，带有坚果和红莓的提示，还有玫瑰的香气。

english: I almost choked on a log! This is not a larching matter!
translation: 我差点被原木呛到！这不是落叶松事！

english: After I've eaten the ce-dar it will be called ce-where.
translation: 在我吃了雪松之后，它将被称为雪何处。

english: ...maybe if we all made an underground village together...
translation: ……也许如果我们一起建个地下村庄……

english: What are you pondering, my furry friend?
translation: 你在思考什么，我毛茸茸的朋友？

english: Oh, just a grand plan to save all the wildlife from being hunted.
translation: 哦，只是个拯救所有野生动物免受狩猎的宏伟计划。

english: That is quite fantastic, fox!
translation: 那相当棒，狐狸！

english: Hello fox, what do you say?
translation: 你好狐狸，你说什么？

english: I do wish people would stop asking me that!
translation: 我真希望人们停止问我那个！

english: I'm famished! Do you have any food?
translation: 我饿死了！你有什么食物吗？

english: I'm sure we could find you something.
translation: 我相信我们能给你找点东西。

english: How about we visit a chicken coop to, uh, admire the scenery!
translation: 我们参观鸡舍去，呃，欣赏风景怎么样！

english: I better find you something to eat quickly.
translation: 我最好快点给你找点吃的。

english: You shake your tail feathers.
translation: 你摇尾巴羽毛。

english: You look rather delicious today...
translation: 你今天看起来相当美味……

english: Ooh, don't mind if I do!
translation: 哦，不介意我这么做！

english: You feed the chicken to your fox.
translation: 你把鸡喂给你的狐狸。

english: *chomp* Delicious!
translation: (嚼)美味！

english: While I appreciate the offer, I won't eat any old thing!
translation: 虽然我很感激你的好意，但我不会随便吃任何东西！

english: I can't believe people try to eat us.
translation: 我不敢相信人们试图吃我们。

english: What would you taste like? Chicken?
translation: 你尝起来像什么？鸡肉？

english: I'd taste fowl, you wouldn't like it at all...
translation: 我尝起来像禽类，你根本不会喜欢……

english: What's the Freaky Forester like?
translation: 怪癖护林员怎么样？

english: You mean the odd fellow who recruits random adventurers to butcher an exorbitant amount of my kind daily in exchange for his spare clothing?
translation: 你是说那个奇怪的家伙，每天招募随机冒险者屠杀过量的我的同类，以换取他的备用衣服？

english: Why yes, he's simply delightful...
translation: 为什么是的，他简直令人愉快……

english: You look a bit on edge. Are you okay?
translation: 你看起来有点紧张。你没事吧？

english: I have the strangest urge to run infront of a fast moving adventurer...
translation: 我有最奇怪的冲动想跑到快速移动的冒险者面前……

english: Redberries! Please and thank you!
translation: 红莓！拜托了，谢谢！

english: You feed the berries to your pheasant.
translation: 你把浆果喂给你的雉鸡。

english: *chomp* Scrummy!
translation: (嚼)好吃！

english: Bwak! I am not some common fowl that will eat anything, I have standards!
translation: 呱！我不是什么都会吃的普通禽类，我有标准！

english: Eww! What is that spell? Why would I want to chew on that? It stinks!
translation: 咦！那是什么法术？我为什么要嚼那个？它臭！

english: What's this strange coating on the log?
translation: 原木上这个奇怪的涂层是什么？

english: Olive oil blessed at an alter deep in Morytania. The oil helps with burning the shades in the area.
translation: 在莫利塔尼亚深处祭坛祝福的橄榄油。这油有助于燃烧该地区的阴魂。

english: ...and you want me to chew on it?
translation: ……你想让我嚼它？

english: Well...
That's a hard pass from me.
translation: 那我坚决拒绝。

english: There's something not quite right about this log.
translation: 这原木有点不对劲。

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你什么意思？

english: I'm not sure, it looks like it's in pain, maybe a little... achey?
translation: 我不确定，它看起来像在痛苦，也许有点……阿奇痛？

english: Sigh...
*sniff* *sniff* No thanks. These may look like logs but they stink of iron, what do I look like a rock golem?
translation: 嗅 嗅 不用了，谢谢。这些可能看起来像原木但它们臭得像铁，我看起来像岩石魔像吗？

english: *sniff* *sniff* No thanks. These logs smell just a bit too botanical for my liking. More of a beer beaver myself.
translation: 嗅 嗅 不用了，谢谢。这些原木闻起来植物气息太重了，不合我意。我自己更像是个啤酒海狸。

english: Wow, that was awesome! You've really opened my eyes to the different types of logs out there in the world. I'll happily take any others you have!
translation: 哇，太棒了！你真的让我看到了世界上不同类型的原木。我会高兴接受你有的任何其他原木！

english: Your pet Beaver may enjoy this more.
translation: 你的宠物海狸可能更喜欢这个。

english: What a splendid noise!
translation: 多美妙的声音！

english: Feathers?! How novel!
translation: 羽毛？！多新奇！

english: You can unlock the ability for your pet Beaver to change colour by feeding it a Funky shaped log.
translation: 你可以通过喂它一个奇特形状的原木来解锁你的宠物海狸改变颜色的能力。

english: You can change the colour of your pet Beaver by feeding it different types of logs.
translation: 你可以通过喂它不同类型的原木来改变你的宠物海狸的颜色。

english: You can unlock other forms for your pet Beaver by finding special items during Woodcutting events.
translation: 你可以通过在伐木事件中找到特殊物品来解锁你的宠物海狸的其他形态。

english: Your pet is already a Beaver.
translation: 你的宠物已经是海狸了。

english: Your pet is already a Fox.
translation: 你的宠物已经是狐狸了。

translation: 你的宠物已经是雉鸡了。

translation: 咕噜！

translation: 你好，先生！有什么能帮你的吗？

translation: 这是什么地方？

english: Sorry, but you can't use the tent without permission. Orders of Al Shabim.
translation: 抱歉，没有许可你不能使用帐篷。这是阿尔‧沙比姆的命令。

english: Sorry, but you can't use the tent without permission. But thanks for all your help with the Bedabin people.
translation: 抱歉，没有许可你不能使用帐篷。不过还是感谢你为贝达宾人所做的一切帮助。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: So how's life as a pirate?
translation: 海盗日子过得怎么样？

english: What kind of question is that? How's life as a... I dunno. Whatever it is that you do for a living.
translation: 这算什么问题？生活怎么样……我也不知道。就像你靠什么谋生一样。

english: I'm a freelance troubleshooter.
translation: 我是个自由接活的麻烦解决者。

english: What does that entail then?
translation: 那具体是做什么的？

english: Mostly killing things for money and delivering items around the planet for people.
translation: 主要是拿钱办事杀人，帮人把物品送到世界各地。

english: I collect stuff.
translation: 我喜欢收集东西。

english: So how's that life?
translation: 那生活怎么样？

english: Can't complain, can't complain...
translation: 还过得去啦……

english: Well, there you go.
translation: 给，拿好。

english: Aren't you a little short for a pirate?
translation: 你作为海盗是不是有点太矮了？

english: My mother was a gnome. Apparently it was a very painful birth.
translation: 我的母亲是地精，据说她生我时非常痛苦。

english: More info than I wanted, thanks!
translation: 这信息我可不想听，谢了！

english: Sorry, can't stop, the Captain will have my guts for garters if he catches me slacking off talking to the stowaway.
translation: 不能再聊了，要是船长发现我在偷懒跟偷渡客聊天，会把我大卸八块的！

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard!
translation: 我不是偷渡客！我是被邀请上船的！

english: Yeah, whatever [guy/lady], it doesn't really matter who you are I'll get in trouble!
translation: 随便啦[guy/lady]，不管你是谁，反正我都会惹上麻烦！

english: You know, I've always wondered what life as a pirate actually entails.
translation: 你知道吗，我一直想知道海盗生活到底是怎样的。

english: Well, at the moment it mostly involves being asked random questions by a stowaway.
translation: 嗯，目前主要是被一个偷渡客问各种问题。

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard! By Lokar! Ask him!
translation: 我不是偷渡客！我是被邀请上船的！洛卡尔邀请的！你问他！

english: Hey, whatever [love/pal]. Just make sure the captain doesn't catch you, pirates don't like stowaways much.
translation: 随便啦[love/pal]。只要别让船长抓到你就行，海盗都不太喜欢偷渡客。

english: Ah, good day to you [milady/sirrah]! Your face is unfamiliar, did you perhaps join us aboard the ship at Lunar Isle?
translation: 你好[milady/sirrah]！你的面孔很陌生，你该不会是在月亮岛登上我们船的吧？

english: No, Lokar offered me a lift in Rellekka actually.
translation: 不，其实是洛卡尔在雷勒卡城让我搭的便船。

english: Oh, really? You don't look like a Fremennik to me!
translation: 真的吗？但你看起来不像费明尼克人啊！

english: Well... I kind of am, and I kind of aren't. It's a long story.
translation: 这个嘛……我算是，也不算吧。说来话长。

english: Sorry I don't have time to hear it then! See you around young fremennik-who-is-not-really-a-fremennik!
translation: 那抱歉我没时间听了！回头见啦，你这个不算真正费明尼克的年轻人！

english: 'Bye.
translation: 再见。

english: Brrrr! Its cold up here!
translation: 嘶！上面好冷！

english: You think this is cold? Up by Acheron it gets so cold that when you talk you see the words freeze in the air in front of you!
translation: 你觉得这算冷？在阿刻戎那边，冷到你连说出的话语都能冻在空中！

english: REALLY?
translation: 真的吗？

english: Nah, not really. I was exaggerating for humourous effect. It is very very cold though!
translation: 哈，当然不是真的。我只是为了搞笑夸张了一下。不过那里确实非常非常冷！

english: Hello to you too.
translation: 也向你问好。

english: Yar! We be pirates, yar! Avast, ye scurvy land-lubbing lychee!
translation: 呀！我们是海盗！停下，你这个可怜的旱鸭子荔枝 (羞辱性称呼)！

english: Please don't talk like that, it is extremely irritating.
translation: 请不要那样说话，这很令人討厌的。

english: Also, please don't call me a lychee, whatever that may be.
translation: 还有你别叫我荔枝 (羞辱性称呼)，不管那是什么。

english: Oh. Okay. Sorry.
translation: 好的，抱歉。

english: ARGH! SOUND THE ALARM! STOWAWAY ON BOARD! STOWAWAY ON BOARD!
translation: 啊！拉警报！船上有偷渡客！船上有偷渡客！

english: No! I'm not a stowaway! Honest! I was invited here!
translation: 我不是偷渡客，真的！我是被邀请来的！

english: Oh, sorry, my mistake then.
translation: 抱歉，那我弄错了。

english: You must admit you do look a lot like a stowaway though.
translation: 不过你得承认，你看起来确实很像偷渡客。

english: Why, what do they usually look like?
translation: 那他们通常长什么样？

english: Erm... I've never actually met one...
translation: 呃……其实我从没见过真正的偷渡客……

english: Okay then...
translation: 那好吧……

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: So... You're a pirate, huh?
translation: 那么……你是海盗，对吧？

english: It's what it says on my pay-packet at the end of the month.
translation: 我月底工资单上就这么写的。

english: How's that working out for you?
translation: 干得怎么样？

english: Pretty good so far. All the grog and loot that we can plunder, plus full medical including dental.
translation: 到目前为止还不错。有喝不完的格罗格酒和抢不完的战利品，甚至还有全套医疗保障，包括牙科。

english: You mean you have insurance?
translation: 你是说有保险？

english: Not as such. If any of us get sick we kidnap a doctor and don't let him go until we're better.
translation: 倒也不是。要是我们谁生病了，就绑架个医生，直到我们康复才放他走。

english: You'd be surprised what an incentive for expert health care that is.
translation: 说出来你可能不信，这可是让医疗水准提升的一大动力。

english: I can imagine.
translation: 这倒不难想象。

english: Hello there. So what brings you aboard the Lady Zay?
translation: 你好啊，是什么风把你吹上赛夫人号的？

english: Well, I was planning on visiting the Moon Clan, but I have to say your ship is very impressive.
translation: 我本来打算去拜访月氏族，但不得不说你们的船令人印象深刻。

english: Aye, she's a beauty alright! The Lady Zay has been my home for many hard months, through storm and sun, and she always gets us to here we were headed!
translation: 是啊，她确实是个美人！赛夫人号作为我的家陪伴我度过了许多艰苦岁月，风雨无阻，她总是能把我们送到目的地！

english: Yes, she's certainly one of the finest boats I've seen on my travels!
translation: 是的，她确实是我旅行中见过的最棒的船之一！

english: That she is [lad/lass], that she is.
translation: 确实是啊[lad/lass]。

english: I'm sorry to bother you, [player name], but I need some help with a bee hive.
translation: 抱歉打扰你，[player name]，但我需要帮忙处理蜂巢。

english: Ooh, a bee hive. I'll help you.
translation: 哦，蜂巢。我来帮你。

english: Player is teleported to a field of beehives
translation: 玩家被传送到一片蜂巢区域。

english: Buzz off!
translation: 走开！

english: Ah, [player name]. I'm sorry to drag you away like this, but I need some help building a new hive for my bees.
translation: 啊，[player name]。抱歉这样把你拉来，但我需要一些帮助为我的蜜蜂建造新蜂巢。

english: What do you expect me to do?
translation: 你希望我做什么？

english: All the parts of the beehive are jumbled up. You've got to put them in the correct order for building a hive.
translation: 蜂巢的所有部件都乱成一团了。你得把它们按正确顺序排列好才能建造蜂巢。

english: Oh, very well. Let's take a look...
translation: 哦，好吧。让我看看……

english: Ready to try again?
translation: 准备好再试一次了吗？

english: First remind me of what I'm doing.
translation: 先提醒我要做什么。

english: Yeah, let me get on with it.
translation: 是的，让我继续吧。

english: No, that doesn't look right. You have to put the parts in the right order, otherwise it'll be no good as a beehive.
translation: 不，那看起来不对。你得把部件按正确顺序排列，否则就做不成蜂巢了。

english: I'll let you have 5 more tries.
translation: 我再给你5次机会。

english: I'll let you have 4 more tries.
translation: 我再给你4次机会。

english: I'll let you have 3 more tries.
translation: 我再给你3次机会。

english: I'll let you have 2 more tries.
translation: 我再给你2次机会。

english: I'll let you have one more try.
translation: 我再给你最后一次机会。

english: Uh-oh, the bees are fed up with waiting for you to build them a home!
translation: 哎呀，蜜蜂已经等不及你给它们建家了！

english: Three bee swarms start stinging the player, while the player runs around for a while and attempts to defend themself helplessly.
translation: 三群蜜蜂开始蜇玩家，玩家四处跑动，无助地试图自卫。

english: Aaaaargh - BEES!
translation: 啊啊啊——蜜蜂！

english: Ooch!
translation: 哎哟！

english: Eek!
translation: 哎呀！

english: Beees!
translation: 蜜——蜂！

english: Ow!
translation: 嗷！

english: I'll help you!
translation: 我来帮你！

english: The bee keeper starts casting a tele-other spell.
translation: 养蜂人开始施放传送他人法术。

english: The bee keeper obligingly teleports you away from the angry swarms.
translation: 养蜂人好心把你传送离开愤怒的蜂群。

english: Player is teleported back to their original location, with no reward and no losses.
translation: 玩家被传送回原位置，没有奖励也没有损失。

english: That's perfect! I'll get some bees moved in immediately.
translation: 太完美了！我马上让一些蜜蜂搬进去。

english: Now, I'm sure I must have something to offer you for all your help...
translation: 现在，我肯定得给你点什么作为帮助的报酬……

english: Player is teleported back to their original location
translation: 玩家被传送回原位置

english: Sorry, you're not the person I need.
translation: 抱歉，你不是我需要的人。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Hello, [player name]?
translation: 你好，[player name]？

english: Please help me, [player name].
translation: 请帮帮我，[player name]。

english: I need your help, [player name]!
translation: 我需要你的帮助，[player name]！

english: Can I borrow you for a minute, [player name]?
translation: 能借你一分钟吗，[player name]？

english: Maybe later.
translation: 也许晚点吧。

english: Ooh, a bee hive. I'll help you.
translation: 哦，蜂巢。我来帮你。

english: Buzz off!
translation: 走开！

english: First remind me of what I'm doing.
translation: 先提醒我要做什么。

english: Yeah, let me get on with it.
translation: 是的，让我继续吧。

english: Hello, what's going on?
translation: 你好，发生什么事了？

english: Hello, it seems you've found a wild bee hive. I'll pay you to help me rehome them.
translation: 你好，看来你发现了一个野生蜂巢。我会付钱请你帮我把它们搬新家。

english: Oh, well, if you ever want to find out how to help, just ask.
translation: 哦，好吧，如果你想知道怎么帮忙，尽管问。

english: It's easy, simply add logs to the unfinished bee boxes I create. Most common types of log work just fine.
translation: 很简单，只要往我制作的未完成蜂箱里加原木就行。大多数常见的原木都可以。

english: Once a bee box is completed I will start a new one, let's see how many of these bees we can save.
translation: 一旦一个蜂箱完成，我就会开始新的，看看我们能救多少蜜蜂。

english: Oh, Bees!
translation: 哦，蜜蜂！

english: I'll find a nice new home for those bees.
translation: 我会为那些蜜蜂找个好的新家。

english: Come with me little bees I'll keep you safe.
translation: 跟我来吧小蜜蜂，我会保护你们的。

english: Another new hive.
translation: 又一个新蜂巢。

english: Well, I must be getting on now.
translation: 好吧，我现在得走了。

english: I'm not interested.
translation: 我没兴趣。

english: How can I help?
translation: 我能帮什么忙？

english: If only that gigantic snake hadn't moved in.
translation: 要是那条巨大的蛇没搬进来就好了。

english: Well hello there sweetheart.
translation: 你好啊亲爱的。

english: Hi!
translation: 嗨！

english: What brings you down here?
translation: 什么风把你吹到这里来了？

english: I'm looking for the Easter Bunny.
translation: 我在找复活节兔子。

english: Fancy that! You're in luck, he's in the next room.
translation: 真巧！你运气不错，他在隔壁房间。

english: I'm trying to cheer up the Easter Bunny, do you have any suggestions?
translation: 我想让复活节兔子高兴起来，你有什么建议吗？

english: Hmm, well, he's a sensible bunny, I'm sure he'd love to go carrot bowling!
translation: 嗯，他是只懂事的兔子，我肯定他会喜欢玩胡萝卜保龄球！

english: Bowling? Where can we do that?
translation: 保龄球？我们在哪里可以玩？

english: It just so happens we have a carrot bowling alley right here in the Rabbit Hole!
translation: 碰巧我们兔子洞里就有一个胡萝卜保龄球馆！

english: Really? Wow! That's fortunate. Where is it?
translation: 真的吗？哇！太幸运了。在哪里？

english: Through the door to the east, turn left, then it's on the right. You can't miss it!
translation: 从东边的门进去，左转，然后在右边。你不会错过的！

english: Well, maybe you can. Depends on your navigational skills I suppose.
translation: 嗯，也许你会错过。这得看你的方向感了。

english: Anyway, talk to Bowley Moley when you get there, I'm sure he will be happy to help.
translation: 总之，到了那里跟鼹鼠波利谈谈，我相信他会很乐意帮忙的。

english: Alright, I'll have a look for this bowling alley and speak to Bowley Moley. Thanks!
translation: 好的，我去找找这个保龄球馆，跟鼹鼠波利谈谈。谢谢！

english: Look who it is! I heard the Easter Bunny gave you a true thrashing on that alley.
translation: 看看是谁来了！我听说复活节兔子在那个球道上把你打得落花流水。

english: Oh yeah, I got outplayed fair and square!
translation: 哦是的，我被他堂堂正正地打败了！

english: It seems to have lifted his spirits somewhat, thanks for doing that.
translation: 看来这让他心情好了一些，谢谢你这么做。

english: I'm just glad to cheer him up a bit.
translation: 我只是很高兴能让他开心一点。

english: Hey, [player name]. I thought it was really sweet of you to help cheer up that bunny.
translation: 嘿，[player name]。我觉得你帮忙让那只兔子开心真的很贴心。

english: Maybe we could go bowling sometime and you could cheer me up too?
translation: 也许我们什么时候可以去玩保龄球，你也让我开心开心？

english: That would be fun, though I'm quite busy at the moment, and in the near future.
translation: 那会很有趣，不过我现在以及近期都很忙。

english: What about the far future?
translation: 那遥远的未来呢？

english: Oh the far future is looking very busy for me.
translation: 哦，遥远的未来我看起来也会很忙。

english: But if I find the time, we could invite the Easter Bunny too! We'd all have a great game I'm sure.
translation: 但如果我找到时间，我们可以邀请复活节兔子一起！我相信我们都会玩得很开心。

english: Oh, I see. Nevermind then, if you're so busy.
translation: 哦，我明白了。既然你这么忙，那就算了。

english: Hello puss.
translation: 你好猫咪。

english: Hiss!
translation: 嘶！

english: Hello human.
translation: 你好，人类。

english: Would you like a fish?
translation: 想要条鱼吗？

english: I don't want your fish. I hunt and eat what I need by myself.
translation: 我不想要你的鱼。我自己狩猎和吃我需要的东西。

english: Hello human.
translation: 你好，人类。

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: This guild contains minerals that haven't been found anywhere else. I'm here to try and identify them.
translation: 这个公会有在其他地方都没发现过的矿物。我来这里是为了尝试识别它们。

english: If you come across any unusual minerals when mining here I'll take them off your hands. Don't worry, I'll make it worth your while.
translation: 如果你在这里采矿时遇到任何不寻常的矿物，我会从你那里收购。别担心，我会让你觉得值得的。

english: I've also been digging out this cave recently. I found a bunch of amethyst in there.
translation: 我最近也在挖掘这个洞穴。我在里面发现了一堆紫水晶。

english: What can you offer me?
translation: 你能给我什么？

english: I have some gloves that will help you when Mining. When you wear these gloves you'll find that some rocks will instantly respawn.
translation: 我有一些手套可以在采矿时帮助你。戴上这些手套后，你会发现有些岩石会瞬间刷新。

english: How do they do that?
translation: 它们是怎么做到的？

english: Magic!
translation: 魔法！

english: Beyond that, I could consider letting you access this new cave. It seems to contain even more minerals.
translation: 除此之外，我可以考虑让你进入这个新洞穴。它似乎含有更多的矿物。

english: So, what would you like?
translation: 那么，你想要什么？

english: I'd like access to the cave.
translation: 我想进入洞穴。

english: Now hold on. There's a lot of minerals in there, and digging out the cave was hard work. Only a true friend of Falador would be allowed in there.
translation: 先等等。里面有很多矿物，挖掘这个洞穴可是辛苦活。只有法拉多城的真正朋友才能进入。

english: You don't seem like you're quite there yet. Come speak to me again once you have completed the Elite Falador Achievement Diary.
translation: 你看起来还没到那个程度。等你完成法拉多城精英成就日志后再来找我。

english: And you truly are a friend of Falador. Well done on completing the Elite Falador Achievement Diary. Go on in, you may access the cave.
translation: 你确实是法拉多城的朋友。恭喜你完成法拉多城精英成就日志。进去吧，你可以进入洞穴了。

english: That's all thank you.
translation: 就这些，谢谢。

english: Don't forget to come to me if you find any minerals.
translation: 如果你发现任何矿物，别忘了来找我。

english: I don't want to receive minerals.
translation: 我不想接收矿物。

english: Very well. You'll no longer find any minerals when you mine here. If you change your mind just let me know.
translation: 很好。你在这里采矿时将不再发现任何矿物。如果你改变主意告诉我。

english: I'd like to receive minerals.
translation: 我想接收矿物。

english: As you wish. You'll now find minerals when you mine here. Let me know if you want to change this.
translation: 如你所愿。你现在在这里采矿时会发现矿物。如果你想改变这个告诉我。

english: Can you combine my mining gloves?
translation: 你能组合我的采矿手套吗？

english: I guess I could combine some Mining gloves with some Superior mining gloves. These new gloves would require 70 Mining to equip.
translation: 我想我可以把一些采矿手套和一些高级采矿手套组合起来。这些新手套需要70级采矿才能装备。

english: It wouldn't be free though. I'd want 40 minerals in return.
translation: 不过不是免费的。我想要40个矿物作为回报。

english: You don't have any gloves for me to combine. You'll need to bring me some Mining gloves and some Superior mining gloves.
translation: 你没有任何手套让我组合。你需要带一些采矿手套和一些高级采矿手套给我。

english: There you go. I've combined your gloves into some Expert mining gloves. Enjoy.
translation: 给你。我已经把你的手套组合成专家采矿手套了。享受吧。

english: Fair enough. I'll be here if you change your mind.
translation: 好吧。如果你改变主意我会在这里。

english: Hey, you! You're not allowed in there! Come speak to me first.
translation: 嘿，你！你不允许进去！先来跟我说话。

english: I'm sorry.
translation: 抱歉。

english: I have minerals to trade.
translation: 我有矿物要交易。

english: What can you offer me?
translation: 你能给我什么？

english: I'd like to view the shop.
translation: 我想看看商店。

english: I'd like access to the cave.
translation: 我想进入洞穴。

english: That's all thank you.
translation: 就这些，谢谢。

english: I don't want to receive minerals.
translation: 我不想接收矿物。

english: I'd like to receive minerals.
translation: 我想接收矿物。

english: Can you combine my mining gloves?
translation: 你能组合我的采矿手套吗？

english: That's fine. Combine my gloves.
translation: 好的。组合我的手套。

english: That's too much.
translation: 那太多了。

english: That's all.
translation: 就这些。

english: Thanks so much for saving me from being a vampyre. Here, take this certificate, I'm sorry but it's all I can offer as a reward.
translation: 非常感谢你把我从吸血鬼状态中救出来。给，拿着这个证书，抱歉这是我唯一能作为报酬提供的东西。

english: Thanks for changing me back, it must have been hard for you. I must be off now.
translation: 谢谢你把我变回来，这对你来说一定很不容易。我现在得走了。

english: Can I have a newspaper, please?
translation: 能给我一份报纸吗？

english: Certainly, Guv. That'll be 50 coins, please.
translation: 当然，一共50金币。

english: Maybe when I've got more money on me.
translation: 也许等我身上有更多钱的时候。

english: Well, no cash, no paper. Live in ignorance.
translation: 好吧，没钱就没报纸。那就继续蒙在鼓里吧。

english: Sure, here you go...
translation: 给，拿好。

english: Okay, suit yourself. Plenty more fish in the sea.
translation: 好吧，随你便。机会多的是。

english: How much does a paper cost?
translation: 一份报纸多少钱？

english: Just 50 coins! An absolute bargain! Want one?
translation: 只要50金币！绝对划算！想要一份吗？

english: Varrock Herald? Never heard of it.
translation: 维洛克先驱报？从来没听说过。

english: For the illiterate amongst us, I shall elucidate. The Varrock Herald is a new newspaper. It is edited, printed and published by myself, Benny Gutenberg, and each edition promises to enthrall the reader with
translation: 对于不识字的各位，我来解释一下。维洛克先驱报是一份新报纸。由我本人本尼‧古腾堡编辑、印刷和出版，每一期都承诺让读者着迷于

english: captivating material! Now, can I interest you in buying one for a mere 50 coins?
translation: 引人入胜的内容！那么，不知你是否有意花区区50金币买一份呢？

english: Anything interesting in there?
translation: 里面有什么有趣的内容吗？

english: Of course there is, mate. Packed full of thought provoking insights, contentious interviews and celebrity scandalmongering! An excellent read and all for just 50 coins! Want one?
translation: 当然有，伙计。充满了发人深省的见解、有争议的采访和名人八卦！极好的读物，只要50金币！想要一份吗？

english: Read all about it!
translation: 快来看看！

english: Extra! Extra! Read all about it!
translation: 号外！号外！快来看看！

english: Buy your Varrock Herald now!
translation: 现在就买你的维洛克先驱报！

english: Varrock Herald, now only 50 coins!
translation: 维洛克先驱报，现在只要50金币！

english: Get you Varrock Herald here!
translation: 在这里买你的维洛克先驱报！

english: Varrock Herald, on sale here!
translation: 维洛克先驱报，在此出售！

english: Can I have a newspaper, please?
translation: 能给我一份报纸吗？

english: Sure, here you go...
translation: 给，拿好。

english: No, thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: How much does a paper cost?
translation: 一份报纸多少钱？

english: Varrock Herald? Never heard of it.
translation: 维洛克先驱报？从来没听说过。

english: Anything interesting in there?
translation: 里面有什么有趣的内容吗？

english: Do you mind? You're in my home.
translation: 介意一下好吗？你在我家里呢。

english: I'm sorry, should I have knocked?
translation: 抱歉，我应该敲门吗？

english: Very funny, human.
translation: 真有趣，人类。

english: We can't all live in plush houses, you know. But that doesn't mean us mining dwarves don't work hard.
translation: 要知道，不是所有人都能住在豪华房子里。但这并不意味着我们采矿矮人不努力工作。

english: Where do you do your mining?
translation: 你们在哪里采矿？

english: Normally the coal mine to the north. We need a lot of coal to keep our steam engines going, you know.
translation: 通常是北边的煤矿。你知道的，我们需要很多煤来维持蒸汽引擎运转。

english: Can I do a bit of mining there as well?
translation: 我也能在那里采点矿吗？

english: I'm not sure, but as long as no one notices I don't think anyone is going to care.
translation: 我不确定，但只要没人注意到，我想没人在乎。

english: Do you know anything about grapevine diseases?
translation: 你了解葡萄藤疾病吗？

english: No, I'm afraid I don't.
translation: 不，恐怕我不了解。

english: Oh that's a shame. I hope I find someone soon, otherwise I could lose all this year's crops.
translation: 哦那真可惜。我希望尽快找到人，否则我可能会失去今年的所有收成。

english: How are your grapes coming along?
translation: 你的葡萄长得怎么样了？

english: Marvellously, thanks to your help, [player name]!
translation: 非常好，多亏了你的帮助，[player name]！

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Good day, adventurer. If you have any questions, I'm sure Lars will be more than happy to answer them. He's in the building to the south.
translation: 你好，冒险者。如果你有任何问题，我相信拉尔斯会很乐意回答。他在南边的建筑里。

english: Also don't forget to visit my sister's axe shop. She works in the same building as Lars.
translation: 也别忘了去我妹妹的斧头店看看。她和拉尔斯在同一栋建筑里工作。

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！

english: Welcome to the Woodcutting Guild, adventurer.
translation: 欢迎来到伐木公会，冒险者。

english: Bert! Good news!
translation: 伯特！好消息！

english: Arrr...Good news be always handy.
translation: 啊……好消息总是好的。

english: They arrested Sandy for the murder of a wizard and the sand pit now refills itself!
translation: 他们逮捕了桑迪，因为他谋杀了一名法师，现在沙坑会自己重新填满！

english: ME JOB! I'VE LOSTED ME JOB! 'ow c'n yer say tha' be good news?? Me wife'll tear me limb fr'm limb!
translation: 我的工作！我丢了工作！你怎么能说那是好消息？？我老婆会把我撕成碎片的！

english: Don't worry, the Wizardsare going to pay you a large pension so that you can retire...
translation: 别担心，法师们会给你一大笔养老金，这样你就可以退休了……

english: Bu' wha'll I be doin' wit' me day now! I be lovin' tha sand.
translation: 但我现在一天要做什么！我热爱沙子。

english: What will you do with your day? Well....You could build sand castles with your own two hands!
translation: 你一天要做什么？嗯……你可以用双手建造沙堡！

english: I din't think so... bu' iffen yer ever need someone ta haul buckets o'sand 'round, ye be lettin' me know [player name], I's can help yer!
translation: 我不这么想……但如果你们需要有人帮忙搬运沙桶，告诉我[player name]，我可以帮你们！

english: Wow! That would be great, buckets of sand direct to bank everdayyou say? That's great!
translation: 哇！那太好了，你说每天直接把沙桶送到银行？太棒了！

english: Once per day you may ask Bert to help you by carrying 84 buckets of sand to your bank. Just talk to him!
translation: 每天一次你可以请伯特帮忙，把84桶沙子送到你的银行。只要跟他说话就行！

english: 'Ello there [player name]!
translation: 你好[player name]！

english: Can you deliver my sand to my bank, please?
translation: 你能把我的沙子送到我的银行吗？

english: Aye, give me a minute cause I be rushed off me feet!
translation: 好的，给我一分钟，我忙得脚不沾地！

english: Hello Bert, could I have my sand today please?
translation: 你好伯特，今天能给我沙子吗？

english: Thanks for the sand Bert!
translation: 谢谢你的沙子伯特！

english: Hope you're having a good day!
translation: 希望你今天过得愉快！

english: Oh arr, no' too bad, though sometoimes, I could do wi' a second pair o' hands! I'll be gettin' on movin' them there buckets o' sand to yer bank!
translation: 哦啊，还不错，虽然有时候，我需要多一双手！我这就去把那些沙桶搬到你的银行！

english: Thanks Bert, see you tomorrow!
translation: 谢谢伯特，明天见！

english: I'll ge' on wi' movin' it. Thankee fer makin' sure Sandy go' it in t'neck fer 'is double dealin's!
translation: 我这就去搬。谢谢你确保桑迪因为他的两面三刀得到了报应！

english: Eeee, ye've go' no free space in yon bank [player name]. Make some room 'tween the fishes 'n boots fore ye come back ta me.
translation: 哎呀，你的银行里没有空位了[player name]。在鱼和靴子之间腾点空间再来找我。

english: Ok, I'll make some more space in my bank and come back!
translation: 好的，我会在银行里腾出更多空间再回来！

english: Did you already give me some sand today?
translation: 你今天已经给我一些沙子了吗？

english: Yep, I dropped it off a while ago. Mebbe come back tomorrow fer some more.
translation: 是的，我刚才送过去了。也许明天再来拿一些。

english: Please don't notify me when you deliver sand.
translation: 你送沙子时请不要通知我。

english: Aye, when I take yer bucket o' sand to yer bank each day, I'll not bother ye wi' any messages 'bout it. Ye'll just find yer sand in there.
translation: 好的，当我每天把你的沙桶送到银行时，我不会用任何消息打扰你。你会发现沙子就在那里。

english: Can you notify me when you deliver sand?
translation: 你送沙子时能通知我吗？

english: Aye, when I takes yer bucket o' sand to yer bank each day, I'll drop ye a message ter tell yer 'bout it, so ye knows I been workin'!
translation: 好的，当我每天把你的沙桶送到银行时，我会给你发个消息告诉你，这样你就知道我在干活了！

english: I no longer want sand deliveries.
translation: 我不再想要沙子配送了。

english: Suits me, [Player Name]! I be a wee bi' busy, an' I'll happily stop takin' sand to  yer bank for ye. Come an' see me if ye changes yer mind.
translation: 随你便，[Player Name]！我有点忙，我很乐意停止为你送沙子到银行。如果你改变主意来找我。

english: (Same as above)
translation: (同上)

english: I'd like daily sand deliveries again.
translation: 我想再次每日配送沙子。

english: Aye, ye bin a big help to me, an I'll be 'appy to take yer sand to yer bank.
translation: 好的，你帮了我大忙，我很乐意把你的沙子送到银行。

english: I'll see you another time.
translation: 下次见。

english: Hello there. Welcome to my magic emporium.
translation: 你好。欢迎来到我的魔法商店。

english: Can I see your wares?
translation: 我能看看你的商品吗？

english: Of course.
translation: 当然。

english: Sorry, I'm not into magic.
translation: 抱歉，我对魔法不感兴趣。

english: Well, if you see anyone who is, please send them my way.
translation: 好吧，如果你看到有兴趣的人，请把他们送到我这里。

english: Hello again. What can I do for you?
translation: 又见面了。有什么能帮你的？

english: I managed to decipher those notes.
translation: 我成功破译了那些手稿。

english: Oh really? Please do tell. It's been driving me crazy!
translation: 哦真的吗？请告诉我。这一直让我抓狂！

english: It seems like he was trying to find the runes for the Varrock teleport spell.
translation: 看起来他试图找到维洛克城传送法术的符石。

english: Ah, of course. I'm not sure how I didn't figure that out!
translation: 啊，当然。我不明白我怎么没想到！

english: Could I buy some more pink dye?
translation: 我能再买一些粉色染料吗？

english: Of course. It's 20 coins per bottle.
translation: 当然。每瓶20金币。

english: Sounds good.
translation: 听起来不错。

english: Actually, I'll pass.
translation: 其实，我就算了。

english: Fair enough.
translation: 好吧。

english: Oh, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: 哦，我身上没带够钱。

english: Oh, I don't have enough room for any.
translation: 哦，我没有足够的空间放任何东西。

english: I'm good, thanks.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

english: Good job. I have new information to share with you.
translation: 干得好。我有新信息要和你分享。

translation: 其实，我就算了。

english: I'm good, thanks.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

english: Hey kid, what's all the shouting about?
translation: 嘿孩子，吵什么呢？

english: Christmas is ruined!
translation: 圣诞节完了！

english: Again? What's happened this time?
translation: 又怎么了？这次发生什么了？

english: The man in the shop won't give us our Gingerbread Gnomes, he's keeping them for himself.
translation: 店里的那个人不给我们姜饼地精，他自己留着了。

english: That doesn't sound right, are you sure that's really what he's doing?
translation: 那听起来不对劲，你确定他真的是那样做的吗？

english: Of course he is, why else won't he give us any?
translation: 当然是，不然他为什么不给我们？

english: Something seems off, maybe I should go talk to Santa to find out what's happened.
translation: 有些事情不对劲，也许我应该去找圣诞老人问问发生了什么。

english: Do whatever you want, I want my Gingerbread Gnomes!
translation: 你想做什么就做什么，我要我的姜饼地精！

english: Where are our Gingerbread Gnomes!
translation: 我们的姜饼地精在哪里！

english: I'm working on it, I'm working on it.
translation: 我在处理了，我在处理了。

english: Hurry up!
translation: 快点！

english: You've ruined Christmas!
translation: 你毁了圣诞节！

english: Give us the Gnomes!
translation: 把姜饼地精给我们！

english: Why are you still here? I saved Christmas, you can go home.
translation: 你们怎么还在这里？我拯救了圣诞节，你们可以回家了。

english: We still have to wait for the delivery to come in, dummy.
translation: 我们还是得等送货进来，笨蛋。

english: I'll leave you to it then.
translation: 那我不打扰你们了。

english: Christmas is Saved!
translation: 圣诞节得救了！

english: Hurry up with the delivery!
translation: 快点送货！

english: I have much tidying to do, so please be brief.
translation: 我有很多整理工作要做，请简短点。

english: I'm looking for a book:[book]
translation: 我在找一本书：[book]

english: Try the [bottom/middle/top] floor, [central area/north-eastern bay/south-eastern bay/south-western bay/north-western bay].
translation: 试试[底层/中层/顶层]，[中央区域/东北湾/东南湾/西南湾/西北湾]。

english: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢你。

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: I assist the Chief Librarian, Logosia, in the running of the Library. There is always much tidying to be done.
translation: 我协助首席图书管理员洛戈西亚管理图书馆。总是有很多整理工作要做。

english: Logosia is a truly great scholar, but her temperament may not be entirely suited to the duties of a librarian.
translation: 洛戈西亚确实是一位伟大的学者，但她的性情可能不太适合图书管理员的职责。

english: Okay, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我走了。

english: Here you go.
translation: 给，拿好。

english: You are handed a torn part of a clue scroll.
translation: 你获得了一张线索卷轴碎片。

english: Have you seen any dark manuscripts?
translation: 你见过任何黑暗手稿吗？

english: Hey, I have something for you but you don't have any space for it!
translation: 嘿，我有东西给你但你背包没空间了！

english: I'm looking for a book...
translation: 我在找一本书……

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我走了。

english: Have you seen any dark manuscripts?
translation: 你见过任何黑暗手稿吗？

english: Hey guy! Always nice to see a fresh face!
translation: 嘿伙计！总是很高兴看到新面孔！

english: So you're the champ?
translation: 所以你是冠军？

english: That's right, guy! Ain't nobody better at fishing round here than me! That's for sure!
translation: 没错，伙计！这附近没人比我更擅长钓鱼！这是肯定的！

english: Can I fish here instead of you?
translation: 我能代替你在这里钓鱼吗？

english: Sorry guy! This is my lucky spot!
translation: 抱歉伙计！这是我的幸运点！

english: Do you have any tips for me?
translation: 你有什么建议给我吗？

english: Why would I help you? I wanna stay the best! I'm not givin' away my secrets like old Grampa Jack does!
translation: 我为什么要帮你？我想保持最好！我可不像老杰克爷爷那样泄露我的秘密！

english: Who's Grampa Jack?
translation: 谁是杰克爷爷？

english: You really have no clue do you! He won this competition four years in a row! He lives in the house just outside the gate.
translation: 你真的不知道吗！他连续四年赢得了这个比赛！他就住在门外的那栋房子里。

english: So you're the champ?
translation: 所以你是冠军？

english: Can I fish here instead of you?
translation: 我能代替你在这里钓鱼吗？

english: Do you have any tips for me?
translation: 你有什么建议给我吗？

english: Why, hello there!
translation: 哎呀，你好！

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: The name is Big Mo. I'm a travelling salesman and businessman from overseas.
translation: 我叫大莫。我是个来自海外的旅行推销员和商人。

english: I drop by these parts every so often to see what wares I can get my hands on.
translation: 我时不时来这里看看能买到什么货物。

english: What do you mean by 'overseas'? Karamja?
translation: 你说的''海外''是什么意思？卡拉姆詹岛？

english: Ha! It seems you've got a lot of the world left to explore. hey, maybe I could help you with that.
translation: 哈！看来你还有很多地方没探索过。嘿，也许我可以帮你。

english: Exploration? I'm listening...
translation: 探索？我在听……

english: When I buy stock, I buy almost everything I can get my hands on. I always end up finding clue scrolls mixed in with my stock.
translation: 我进货时，几乎什么都买下来。我总是会发现线索卷轴混在我的货物里。

english: Usually my little brother would follow up on them, often coming back with a big pile of loot.
translation: 通常我弟弟会去跟进，经常带着一大堆战利品回来。

english: Unfortunately, my brother got wrapped up in some nasty dealings with some faulty dragon claws so we had to part ways.
translation: 不幸的是，我弟弟卷入了一些肮脏交易，跟有问题的龙爪有关，所以我们不得不分道扬镳。

english: Since you seem interested in an adventure, you seem like the perfect [man/woman] for the job!
translation: 既然你对冒险感兴趣，你看起来是这份工作的完美[男人/女人]！

english: So... You would give me a clue scroll and we would split the loot once I find it?
translation: 所以……你会给我线索卷轴，找到后我们平分战利品？

english: Not quite. I'm sure you're a lovely chap and all, but I can't trust a stranger!
translation: 不完全是。我相信你是个好伙计，但我不能信任陌生人！

english: I'd be more than happy to cut you a deal. I can sell you any clue scrolls I come across for 50gp.
translation: 我很乐意给你个优惠。我可以把我遇到的任何线索卷轴以50金币卖给你。

english: I'm sure you'd make a killing on any loot you find.
translation: 我相信你找到的任何战利品都能大赚一笔。

english: Why don't you do the clue scrolls yourself? Wouldn't you make more money?
translation: 你为什么不自己做线索卷轴？那不是能赚更多钱吗？

english: HA! Sure, the guy in the 50,000,000 coin suit is going to run around all day digging holes. Come on! Now, do you want to buy one?
translation: 哈！得了吧，穿得起5000万金币西装的家伙会整天跑来跑去找洞挖？得了吧！那么，你想买一个吗？

english: Sounds good to me.
translation: 听起来不错。

english: Okay, they're 50 coins each. How much of a challenge would you like? I'll take a look and see if I have a clue fitting for your experience.
translation: 好的，每个50金币。你想要多大挑战？我看看有没有适合你经验的线索。

english: The easier the better.
translation: 越简单越好。

english: Perfect! I've got just the clue right here. Pleasure doing business with you!
translation: 完美！我这里正好有合适的线索。很高兴和你做生意！

english: If you can track me down again another day I will do my best to have the perfect clue for you. Good luck.
translation: 如果你改天再找到我，我会尽力为你准备完美的线索。祝你好运。

english: Not too easy, not too hard.
translation: 不要太简单，也不要太难。

english: I'm afraid this is the best I can do right now. Pleasure doing business with you!
translation: 恐怕这是我现在能提供的最好的了。很高兴和你做生意！

english: I like a challenge. Give me one to wrinkle my brain.
translation: 我喜欢挑战。给我一个让我绞尽脑汁的。

english: Give me the hardest clue you can get your hands on.
translation: 给我你能拿到的最难的线索。

english: Forget it, I changed my mind.
translation: 算了，我改变主意了。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Exploration? Sounds exhausting. I'm off.
translation: 探索？听起来很累。我走了。

english: Why, hello there! Want to buy another clue scroll?
translation: 哎呀，你好！想再买一个线索卷轴吗？

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 跟我说说你自己。

english: The name is Big Mo. I was a travelling salesman and businessman, passing through the towns to see what wares I could get my hands on.
translation: 我叫大莫。我曾是个旅行推销员和商人，穿梭于各个城镇看看能买到什么货物。

english: I do remember buying clue scrolls off you, long ago.
translation: 我确实记得很久以前从你那里买过线索卷轴。

english: Yes, I was selling them to encourage people to explore. I'd only sell each person one clue scroll per day, of course.
translation: 是的，我卖它们是为了鼓励人们探索。当然，我每天只卖给每个人一个线索卷轴。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Where were you from originally?
translation: 你来自哪里？

english: HA HA HA! I deliberately didn't tell people where I was from. Mostly they assumed me to be from Zeah.
translation: 哈哈哈！我故意不告诉人们我来自哪里。大多数人以为我来自泽赫。

english: That may or may not be true, though - no-one else in Zeah looks much like me. I'll leave it as a mystery...
translation: 那可能是真的也可能不是——泽赫没有其他人长得像我这样。我就让它保持神秘吧……

english: Exploration? I'm listening...
translation: 探索？我在听……

english: Why don't you do the clue scrolls yourself?
translation: 你为什么不自己做线索卷轴？

english: Sounds good to me.
translation: 听起来不错。

english: The easier the better.
translation: 越简单越好。

english: Not too easy, not too hard.
translation: 不要太简单，也不要太难。

english: I like a challenge. Give me one to wrinkle my brain.
translation: 我喜欢挑战。给我一个让我绞尽脑汁的。

english: Give me the hardest clue you can get your hands on.
translation: 给我你能拿到的最难的线索。

english: Forget it, I changed my mind.
translation: 算了，我改变主意了。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Exploration? Sounds exhausting. I'm off.
translation: 探索？听起来很累。我走了。

english: Buy an easy clue.
translation: 买一个简单线索。

english: Buy a medium clue.
translation: 买一个中等线索。

english: Buy a hard clue.
translation: 买一个困难线索。

english: Buy an elite clue.
translation: 买一个精英线索。

english: Cancel
translation: 取消

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 跟我说说你自己。

english: Where were you from originally?
translation: 你来自哪里？

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Oh, hello there. Welcome to the Drumstick Kingdom. King Biles is the name. I am the ruler of this land.
translation: 哦，你好。欢迎来到鸡腿王国。我叫拜尔斯国王。我是这片土地的统治者。

english: You are?
translation: 你是？

english: That's right. Once I was a banknote exchange merchant, but after becoming stranded here, I decided to make the best of it.
translation: 没错。我曾经是个票据兑换商人，但被困在这里后，我决定随遇而安。

english: Okay...
translation: 好吧……

english: Can you exchange some banknotes for me?
translation: 你能帮我兑换一些纸币吗？

english: Well, it's not something I do as much now that I'm a king, but I suppose I can. Just hand me the banknotes you wish me to exchange. It will cost you 5 coins for each banknote.
translation: 嗯，现在我当国王了不太做这个，但我想我可以。只要把你想兑换的纸币交给我就行。每张纸币收费5金币。

english: The Drumstick Kingdom?
translation: 鸡腿王国？

english: Yes, I wanted to call this place Drumstick Isle because I thought it looked like a chicken drumstick, but apparently that name was taken. I settled for Drumstick Kingdom instead.
translation: 是的，我本来想叫这里鸡腿岛，因为我觉得它看起来像个鸡腿，但显然那个名字已经被用了。所以我改叫鸡腿王国。

english: So that's the name of this island?
translation: 所以这就是这个岛的名字？

english: No, just the kingdom. This island already had a name as well, so I can't change it. It all seems stupid to me. It's not like there's some central authority in charge of naming islands!
translation: 不，只是王国的名字。这个岛本来就有名字，所以我不能改。这一切在我看来都很愚蠢。又不是有什么中央机构负责给岛屿命名！

english: Besides, I'm a king! I should get to name whatever I want, just like Sleve does. He gets to name everything. He even named me! Before all this, my name was Friedrich Henglebert!
translation: 再说了，我是国王！我应该能随便命名，就像斯莱夫那样。他能命名一切。他甚至给我起了名字！在这之前，我叫弗里德里希‧亨格伯特！

english: Right... Well, good luck with... the kingdom.
translation: 好吧……那么，祝你……王国好运。

english: I need to get going.
translation: 我得走了。

english: Very well.
translation: 很好。

english: Oh, hello again. Welcome back to the Drumstick Kingdom.
translation: 哦，又见面了。欢迎回到鸡腿王国。

english: Can you exchange some banknotes for me?
translation: 你能帮我兑换一些纸币吗？

english: The Drumstick Kingdom?

english: Mumblelandlubbermumblemumble...

english: Hello!

english: I dunno, [lad/lass/kid], I need a pirate to help me with my problem, but none will sail with me.

english: Well, ye look like ye might have the right stuff, tell me would ye like te be a pirate?

english: Aye, that it be. Come back when yer liver ain't so lily-like, [lad/lass/kid].
translation: 是啊，确实是。等你的胆子不那么小了再回来，[lad/lass/kid]。

english: If yer after a lift go to the ship and I'll take ye where ye want to go.

english: Ye'll notice I'm not fallin' to the floor in shock right now. Look, if I gives ye another copy will ye keep a better eye on it?
translation: 你应该注意到我现在没有震惊得倒在地上。听着，如果我再给你一本，你会好好保管吗？

english: Aye Cap'n!

english: Then here, have this other copy I dug up.

english: No, I should be gettin' back anyway. Come on [lad/lass/kid], let's be off.
translation: 不，反正我也该回去了。来吧[lad/lass/kid]，我们走。

english: Nothin' I won't put on hold. Come on [lad/lass/kid], let's be off.

english: No thanks, Cap'n.
translation: 不用了谢谢，船长。

english: Well, come see me if ye ever do.
translation: 好吧，如果你改变主意就来找我。

english: Yes, I've always wanted to be a pirate!

english: No thanks, it sounds quite dangerous.

english: Hey! scheck it out! Itsh an outerlandub! Yer shud go shpeak to the chieftain!

english: The who?

english: Hey! Itsh you again! Whatshyerfashe!

english: Nah nah nah, not them, the other one, whatshyerfashe!

english: Um.... okay. I'll leave you to your drinking.

english: Thanksh pal! You're alright!

english: Nilsal. Interested in buying some weapons or armour?
translation: 你好。有兴趣买些武器或盔甲吗？

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Do you make these yourself?
translation: 这些都是你自己做的吗？

english: Of course, and you won't find anything finer than what I offer. I didn't become the official blacksmith to the Royal Family of Varlamore by producing subpar goods.
translation: 当然，你找不到比我提供的更好的东西了。我可不是靠生产次品成为瓦拉莫尔王国王室官方铁匠的。

english: You're the official blacksmith? Does that mean you can sell me some armour like the knights around here wear?
translation: 你是官方铁匠？那你能卖我一些像这里骑士穿的盔甲吗？

english: Are you a Knight of Varlamore?
translation: 你是瓦拉莫尔骑士吗？

english: No.
translation: 不是。

english: Than I cannot. However, I still have plenty of other items that might interest you. Would you like to take a look?
translation: 那我就不能卖了。不过，我还有很多其他可能让你感兴趣的东西。想看看吗？

english: Can you repair something for me?
translation: 你能帮我修理东西吗？

english: You don't have anything I can repair.
translation: 你没有什么我能修理的。

translation: 给你，很高兴和你做生意！

english: A human? Either buy something or get out!
translation: 人类？要么买东西要么滚出去！

english: In a blacksmith? What do you think? Weapons!
translation: 在铁匠铺？你觉得呢？武器！

english: Good.
translation: 很好。

translation: 你有什么？

translation: 你好！

english: No! I have many things to do right now so I can't add that to my list!
translation: 不行！我现在有很多事要做，不能把那加到我的清单上！

english: But...
translation: 但是……

english: Afraid not! Bye now!

english: Greetin's[player name], fine day today!
translation: 你好[player name]，今天天气真好！

english: Please leave me alone, I'm busy trapping the pygmy shrews.
translation: 请别打扰我，我正忙着捕捉侏儒鼩鼱呢。

english: Wunnerfulweather we're having today!
translation: 我们今天遇到的天气真棒！

english: Looking to buy some armour?
translation: 想买些盔甲吗？

english: Show me what you've got.
translation: 让我看看你有什么。

english: I'm good thanks.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

english: My stock is only for those trusted in Shayzien, sorry.
translation: 我的存货只卖给谢兹恩城信任的人，抱歉。

english: Hello, I wonder if you could help me on this whole brewing thing...
translation: 你好，我想知道你能不能帮我了解一下酿酒的事……

english: I might be able to - what do you need to know?
translation: 我或许能帮——你想了解什么？

english: How do I brew ales?
translation: 我怎么酿麦酒？

english: Well first off you need to fill the vat with water - two bucketfuls should do the trick. Then you'll need to put in two handfuls of barley malt - that's roasted barley by the way.
translation: 首先你需要把大桶装满水——两桶水就够了。然后你需要放入两把大麦麦芽——顺便说一下，那就是烤过的大麦。

english: After that you'll be putting your main ingredient in - this will decide which ale it is you're brewing. There should be some good guides around with recipes in.
translation: 之后你要放入主要原料——这将决定你酿的是哪种麦酒。周围应该有一些不错的指南里面有配方。

english: Lastly you pour a pot full of ale yeast in, which'll start it off fermenting. Then all you have to do is wait for the good stuff.
translation: 最后你倒入一罐麦酒酵母，这会开始发酵。然后你要做的就是等待佳酿完成。

english: How do I brew cider?
translation: 我怎么酿苹果酒？

english: First you'll need some apples. You'll need to crush them using this cider-press - four apples should make a full bucket of apple-mush. Take four buckets of mush and fill up the vat.
translation: 首先你需要一些苹果。你需要用这个苹果榨汁机把它们压碎——四个苹果应该能装满一桶苹果泥。取四桶苹果泥装满大桶。

english: After that you pour a pot full of ale yeast in, which'll start it off fermenting. Then all you have to do is wait for the good stuff.
translation: 之后你倒入一罐麦酒酵母，这会开始发酵。然后你要做的就是等待佳酿完成。

english: What do I do once my ale has matured?
translation: 麦酒成熟后我该做什么？

english: Well, once you've got a full vat of the good stuff, just turn the valve and your barrel will fill up with eight pints of whatever your chosen tipple is. Mind it's an empty barrel, though.
translation: 一旦你有一大桶佳酿，只需打开阀门，你的酒桶就会装满八品脱你选择的酒。不过要注意得是空桶。

english: Do you have any spare ale yeast?
translation: 你有多余的麦酒酵母吗？

english: Well, as a matter of fact I do, although I wouldn't describe it as spare. This ale yeast I've got is the best money can buy, but if you've got a pot I'll fill it for you for 25GP - very cheap as it happens.
translation: 事实上我确实有，虽然我不会说它是多余的。我这麦酒酵母是花钱能买到最好的，但如果你有罐子，我可以25金币帮你装满——碰巧非常便宜。

english: I don't have an empty pot, or enough money I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕我没有空罐子，或者钱不够。

english: I don't have an empty pot I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕我没有空罐子。

english: I don't have enough money I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕我钱不够。

english: That's a good deal - please fill my pot with ale yeast for 25GP.
translation: 这交易不错——请用25金币帮我把罐子装满麦酒酵母。

english: No, that's too much I'm afraid.
translation: 不，恐怕那太贵了。

english: That's all I need to know, thanks.
translation: 这些就是我需要知道的了，谢谢。

english: Good day.
translation: 你好。

english: Good day to you [sir/ma'am].
translation: 祝你日安[先生/女士]。

english: That's one less thing to worry about.
translation: 这样就少一件要操心的事了。

english: Glad I could help.
translation: 很高兴能帮上忙。

english: The new statue looks beautiful, don't you agree?
translation: 新雕像看起来很漂亮，你不觉得吗？

english: Oh yes, quite.
translation: 哦是的，确实。

english: My finest piece of work, without a doubt.
translation: 毫无疑问，这是我最出色的作品。

english: Say, I was wondering, did you do the statues down in the mines as well?
translation: 话说，我想知道，矿井下面的雕像也是你做的吗？

english: What, out with the trolls?
translation: 什么，和巨魔在一起的那些？

english: If only! But no, they've been there for many thousands of years, actually. Been there before dwarven recorded history.
translation: 要是就好了！但不是，它们实际上已经在那里几千年了。在矮人有记录的历史之前就存在了。

english: No no, I'm sure they weren't there before!
translation: 不不，我确定它们之前不在那里！

english: Of course they were, don't be silly!
translation: 当然在了，别傻了！

english: Alright... my mistake then.
translation: 好吧……那是我弄错了。

english: You! Get to work!
translation: 你！去干活！

english: What?
translation: 什么？

english: You are here to help work the blast furnace, aren't you?
translation: 你是来这里帮忙操作高炉的，对吧？

english: What's the blast furnace?
translation: 高炉是什么？

english: The blast furnace is the pinnacle of dwarven metal- processing! Ore goes in the top and comes out as metal bars almost at once! And it's so efficient it only takes half as much coal to purify it as a regular furnace.
translation: 高炉是矮人金属加工的巅峰！矿石从顶部进去，几乎立刻就能变成金属锭出来！而且效率极高，净化矿石所需的煤只有普通熔炉的一半。

english: But we've got a bit of a labour shortage at the moment, which is why I have to rely on immigrant workers to keep the furnace going. So, are you here to start work?
translation: 但我们目前有点人手短缺，这就是为什么我得依靠外来工人让高炉运转。那么，你是来开始工作的吗？

english: How can I help work the blast furnace?
translation: 我怎么帮忙操作高炉？

english: The blast furnace will only work if there is a group of people keeping it going. Let me explain...
translation: 高炉需要一群人一起操作才能运转。让我解释一下……

english: Firstly, the stove needs to be kept filled with coal. If this runs out the furnace will not work.
translation: 首先，炉子需要保持装满煤。如果煤用完了高炉就无法工作。

english: Secondly, someone needs to operate the pump that keeps the hot air blast circulating through the furnace.
translation: 其次，需要有人操作泵，让热气流在高炉中循环。

english: Thirdly, someone needs to keep an eye on the temperature gauge. They should tell the pumper to start or stop so that the temperature stays in the right range.
translation: 第三，需要有人盯着温度表。他们应该告诉泵工启动或停止，以保持温度在合适范围内。

english: Lastly, someone needs to be on the pedals to power the conveyor belt that puts ore into the furnace.
translation: 最后，需要有人踩踏板为传送带提供动力，把矿石送入高炉。

english: Someone will also need to be on standby with a hammer in case the machine breaks!
translation: 还需要有人拿着锤子待命，以防机器故障！

english: While that's going, anyone else can put their ore on the conveyor belt to have it smelted.
translation: 与此同时，其他人可以把矿石放在传送带上进行冶炼。

english: So what do I get out of it?
translation: 那我能从中得到什么？

english: Keeping the furnace going is valuable experience in itself!
translation: 维持高炉运转本身就是宝贵的经验！

english: Keeping the stove alight will train your Firemaking, working the pump will train your Strength, pedalling the conveyor belt will train your Agility and repairing the furnace will train Crafting.
translation: 保持炉子燃烧能训练你的生火技能，操作泵能训练你的力量，踩传送带能训练你的敏捷，修理高炉能训练你的制作技能。

english: Plus, everyone working the furnace will get a bit of experience in Smithing whenever anyone smelts ore in it.
translation: 而且，每当有人在高炉中冶炼矿石时，所有操作高炉的人都能获得一些锻造经验。

english: So I don't actually get paid then?
translation: 所以我实际上拿不到报酬？

english: I offer you the privilege of working on the greatest example of dwarven engineering and you want to be PAID?
translation: 我给了你在矮人工程学最伟大的杰作上工作的特权，你还想要报酬？

english: If you co-operate with a group of people you can all get your smelting done pretty quickly. Or perhaps some humans who need to do some smelting will pay you, since you humans are all so obsessed with money.
translation: 如果你和一群人合作，你们都能很快完成冶炼。或者也许有些需要冶炼的人类会付钱给你，毕竟你们人类都这么迷恋金钱。

english: No wonder you have a labour shortage if you don't pay your workers!
translation: 你不付钱给工人，难怪人手短缺！

english: What would be the point of making money if I gave it all away to menial workers?
translation: 如果我把赚的钱都分给普通工人，那赚钱还有什么意义？

english: I mean... Money isn't important! What about the greater glory of dwarven engineering? What about the satisfaction of helping others? What about the XP?
translation: 我是说……钱不重要！矮人工程的伟大荣耀呢？帮助他人的满足感呢？经验值呢？

english: Okay, I'll get to work.
translation: 好吧，我去干活。

english: Splendid!
translation: 太好了！

english: Can I use the furnace to smelt ore?
translation: 我能用高炉冶炼矿石吗？

english: You can, although you'll need to find some people to work it for you as well. But the furnace is very delicate so I charge a fee for anyone who doesn't have level 60 smithing.
translation: 可以，不过你也需要找些人帮你操作。但高炉非常精密，所以锻造等级不到60级的人我要收费。

english: I have level 60!
translation: 我有60级！

english: A human has level 60 smithing? How extraordinary!
translation: 人类有60级锻造？太非凡了！

english: Feel free to use the furnace. Remember, you only need half as much coal as with a regular furnace.
translation: 请随意使用高炉。记住，你只需要普通熔炉一半的煤。

english: I don't have level 60.
translation: 我没有60级。

english: Hmm, well, I'll let you use the furnace if you want, but you must pay a fee of 2,500 coins.
translation: 嗯，好吧，如果你想用高炉我可以让你用，但你必须支付2,500金币的费用。

english: Okay, here you are.
translation: 好的，给你。

english: Where?
translation: 哪里？

english: Actually I don't have enough money on me.
translation: 其实我身上钱不够。
