translation: 你好布鲁贝瑞。

english: So, have you got my Short Green Guy?
translation: 那么，你有我的小绿人鸡尾酒了吗？

english: No, I need you to make the SGG yourself. I'm afraid it doesn't really work if you try to sell the bar its own drinks.
translation: 不，我需要你自己制作小绿人鸡尾酒。如果你想把酒吧自己的酒卖回给酒吧，那不太行。

english: You give Blurberry the SGG. He takes a sip...
translation: 你把小绿人鸡尾酒 给布鲁贝瑞。他尝了一口……

english: Ooh, that's a frisky little number. Very tart, how it should be. Excellent. Well I'm happy to recommend you to the Giannes. You truly are a gnomish bartender now..
translation: 哦，这是个活泼的小家伙。很酸，正应该这样。太好了。我很乐意向吉安家族推荐你。你现在真是个地精酒保了。

english: Well your training is over [player name]. Are you interested in some work?
translation: 好吧你的训练结束了[player name]。你对工作感兴趣吗？

english: I may be...
translation: 我可能有兴趣……

english: I think you're almost ready to do some work for Aluft Gianne Jnr. He is in charge of a new family venture: Gnome Food Delivery. There are good tips to be made if you make and deliver gnome foods - though you may
translation: 我想你差不多准备好为小阿卢夫‧吉安工作了。他负责一个新的家族企业：地精美食配送。如果你制作并配送地精食物，可以得到不错的小费——虽然你可能需要走遍基利诺尔来完成其他订单……

english: have to travel all over Gielinor to fulfil some of the other orders...
translation: 虽然你可能需要走遍基利诺尔来完成其他订单……

english: However, you'll need some basic gnome cooking training if you want to work for Lufty. Go and have a chat with his Dad, Aluft Gianne Snr. Hel'll tell you what you need to do.
translation: 不过，如果你想为卢夫蒂工作，你需要一些基本的地精烹饪训练。去和他爸爸老阿卢夫‧吉安聊聊。他会告诉你需要做什么。

english: Thanks for your help!
translation: 谢谢你的帮助！

english: Aluft Gianne Snr. tells me that you have finished training with him, so I think you're ready to do some work for Aluft Gianne Jnr. He is in charge of the new Gnome Food Delivery service. I've heard there are
translation: 老阿卢夫‧吉安告诉我你已经完成了他的训练，所以我想你准备好为小阿卢夫‧吉安工作了。他负责新的地精美食配送服务。我听说如果你制作并配送地精食物，

english: good tips to be made if you make and deliver gnome foods - though you may have to travel all over Gielinor to fulfill some of the other orders...
translation: 可以得到不错的小费——虽然你可能需要走遍基利诺尔来完成其他订单……

english: Sounds interesting....
translation: 听起来很有趣……

english: Go and have a chat with my young Lufty Jnr. and he'll fill you in with details.
translation: 去和我的小路夫蒂小吉聊聊，他会告诉你详情。

english: No thanks, I prefer to stay this side of the bar.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我更喜欢待在吧台这边。

english: Ok then I'll give it a go.
translation: 好吧那我来试试。

english: I'm afraid I lost the cocktail shaker you gave to me.
translation: 恐怕我把你给我的鸡尾酒摇壶弄丢了。

english: I've not finished yet.
translation: 我还没完成。

english: Why do you keep killing boars?
translation: 你为什么一直杀野猪？

english: Because they drop bones which I am going to use to train my prayer. The meat is also a nice addition.
translation: 因为它们会掉落骨头，我可以用它来训练我的祈祷技能。肉也是不错的补充。

english: Wouldn't it be best to go steal cakes for food?
translation: 去偷蛋糕当食物不是更好吗？

english: And then go to Wintertodt? I do that every time I make an Iron person account. About time I try something new.
translation: 然后去冬将军？我每次创建铁人模式账号都那样做。是时候尝试点新东西了。

english: Are you at least killing the boars on task?
translation: 你至少是在做杀戮任务时杀野猪吧？

english: No, maybe I should go get a slayer task now you mention it. Thanks for the reminder.
translation: 不，也许我现在应该去接个杀戮任务，谢谢你提醒我。

english: You can only trade with people in your group.
translation: 你只能和你队伍里的人交易。

english: Give me a quest!
translation: 给我个任务！

english: Get yer own!
translation: 自己去接！

english: Have you anything to sell?
translation: 你有什么要卖的吗？

english: Yes! I buy and sell axes! Take your pick (or axe)!
translation: 是的！我买卖斧头！随便挑(或斧)！

english: Can you repair my items for me?
translation: 你能帮我修理物品吗？

english: Of course I'll repair it, though the materials may cost you. Just hand me the item and I'll have a look.
translation: 当然我会修理，不过材料可能要你花钱。把物品递给我，我看看。

english: You don't have anything I can repair.
translation: 你没有什么我能修理的。

english: There you go, happy doing business with you!
translation: 给你，很高兴和你做生意！

english: Sorry friend, but I can't do anything with that.
translation: 抱歉，但我对那个无能为力。

english: Give me a quest!
translation: 给我个任务！

english: Have you anything to sell?
translation: 你有什么要卖的吗？

english: Can you repair my items for me?
translation: 你能帮我修理物品吗？

english: Repair that item: [x] coins.
translation: 修理该物品：[x] 金币。

english: Cancel.
translation: 取消。

english: Miaoww
translation: 喵呜

english: Hi Bob!
translation: 嗨鲍勃！

english: Hmm... Wish I had a cat to talk to.
translation: 嗯……希望我有只猫可以说话。

english: Erm, hello? Can you understand me?
translation: 呃，你好？你能听懂我说话吗？

english: I certainly can. I am wearing this amulet I got in Sophanem!
translation: 当然能。我戴着这个在索法尼恩城得到的护符！

english: Ah so you've met some of the local felines. Wise and confusing, those Sphinges.
translation: 啊所以你见过一些当地的猫科动物。那些斯芬克斯既聪明又令人困惑。

english: Wow!! You know the plural of Sphinx!! What else do you know?
translation: 哇！！你知道 Sphinx 的复数形式！！你还知道什么？

english: All sorts of stuff! I pick up no end of comments on my travels. Want to hear one?
translation: 各种东西！我在旅途中听到了无数的评论。想听一个吗？

english: I certainly do. Share your wisdom Bob!
translation: 当然想。分享你的智慧吧鲍勃！

english: Hi Bob, how's tricks?
translation: 嗨鲍勃，怎么样？

english: Tricks? Dogs are for tricks! Cats are for admiring and fussing over.
translation: 把戏？狗才玩把戏！猫是用来欣赏和宠爱的。

english: OK then, how about a joke instead?
translation: 好吧，那来个笑话怎么样？

english: Woof woof. Yip yip!
translation: 汪汪。呜呜！

english: Excuse me?
translation: 什么？

english: Ah, don't mind me. I am learning a second language!
translation: 啊，别在意我。我在学第二语言！

english: No, you don't understand. I wanted to hear a joke.
translation: 不，你不明白。我想听个笑话。

english: Sigh... OK. Did you hear about the cat who drank 10 bowls of milk? He set a new lap record.
translation: 唉……好吧。你听说过那只喝了10碗牛奶的猫吗？他创造了新的舔食记录。

english: Did he? Wow. What about this joke then?
translation: 是吗？哇。那这个笑话呢？

english: Are you trying to be funny?
translation: 你想搞笑吗？

english: No, that's your job isn't it?
translation: 不，那是你的工作不是吗？

english: Grrrowl. OK, last try. What do you call a cat that lives in an igloo?.... An Eskimew!
translation: 咕噜。好吧，最后一次。你叫住在冰屋里的猫什么？……爱斯基猫！

english: An Eskimew... That's not funny. I waited all this time for that? Sheesh.
translation: 爱斯基猫……那不好笑。我等这么久就为了这个？天哪。

english: You know, sometimes I wonder why I still bother with this place. It's just not the same since the humans arrived.
translation: 你知道吗，有时候我想知道为什么我还烦这个地方。自从人类来了就不一样了。

english: Speak to me, Bob! Give me some wise words of advice!
translation: 和我说话，鲍勃！给我一些明智的建议！

english: Advice you want eh? Well, I could just enlighten you with a snippet of my vast knowledge.
translation: 想要建议是吧？好吧，我可以用我渊博知识的一小部分来启发你。

english: That would be fantastic! I heard you were very very wise indeed.
translation: 那太好了！我听说你确实非常非常聪明。

english: Well, I think I will let you decide that.
translation: 好吧，我想我让你来决定。

english: OK, bamboozle me with your intelligence!
translation: 好吧，用你的智慧来迷惑我吧！

english: Hi, my name is Bob.
translation: 嗨，我叫鲍勃。

english: Hello Bob!
translation: 你好鲍勃！

english: Do you two know each other?
translation: 你们两个认识吗？

english: I don't think so...
translation: 我想不认识……

english: Yes you do. Dive deep, search your feelings.
translation: 是的你们认识。深入挖掘，搜索你的感觉。

english: OK, I will try.
translation: 好吧，我试试。

english: What's up puss?
translation: 怎么了猫咪？

english: If only you knew the power of Bob. Your master never told you who your real father was, did he?
translation: 要是你知道鲍勃的力量就好了。你的主人从来没告诉过你你真正的父亲是谁，对吧？

english: No, but what's that got to do with... no, nooooooo! It cannot be!!
translation: 不，但那和……不，不不不不！不可能！！

english: Yes. I am your father!
translation: 是的。我是你父亲！

english: That's impossible!!
translation: 那不可能！！

english: You can destroy Zamorak. He has foreseen this. It is your destiny. Join me, and together we can rule this place as father and son.
translation: 你可以摧毁扎莫拉克。他已经预见了这一点。这是你的命运。加入我，我们可以一起以父子的身份统治这个地方。

english: OK dad, maybe later, you're scaring me!
translation: 好吧爸爸，也许改天，你吓到我了！

english: I think that's about enough of that. I'm off.
translation: 我想那已经够了。我走了。

english: [player name], why do you keep your cat in the bank?
translation: [player name]，你为什么把你的猫放在银行里？

english: I thought it was too dangerous to bring it out with me.
translation: 我觉得带它出来太危险了。

english: Or, I could let the poor thing get butchered! Is that what you want?
translation: 或者，我可以让这可怜的东西被宰杀！那是你想要的吗？

english: Butchered!!! I think not. Cats are easily as tough as sheep. Cats were the second thing Guthix brought here, after sheep of course.
translation: 宰杀！！！我想不会。猫和羊一样坚韧。猫是古斯带到这里来的第二样东西，当然是继羊之后。

english: Weird. I thought Gnomes and the Dwarves were the first ones. Oh well back to school for me.
translation: 奇怪。我以为地精和矮人是最早的。哦好吧我回学校了。

english: Hi Bob. I didn’t think I would ever see you round here. Long way from home isn’t it?
translation: 嗨鲍勃。我没想到会在这里见到你。离家很远对吧？

english: Yes I guess so. But I’ve been asked to get some coal for Dunstan. He ran out, you see.
translation: 是的我想是的。但我被要求为邓斯坦弄些煤。他用完了，你知道的。

english: Anything I can do to help?
translation: 有什么我能帮忙的吗？

english: No thanks. I’m on my way back now.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。我现在在回去的路上了。

english: Ok Bob, see you around.
translation: 好的鲍勃，回头见。

english: Hi Bob. I didn't think I would ever see you round here. Long way from home isn't it?
translation: 嗨鲍勃。我没想到会在这里见到你。离家很远对吧？

english: Yes, but the fish round here are oh so tasty! And there's nobody who can make a good old fashioned seafood gumbo like the Lumbridge cook!
translation: 是的，但这里的鱼真好吃！而且没人能像仑桥镇厨师那样做出正宗的海鲜秋葵汤！

english: Gumbo?
translation: 秋葵汤？

english: Oh yes, an old recipe passed down from generation to generation of cooks. But this might be the last generation since the Duke's current cook doesn't have any children.
translation: 哦是的，一个代代相传的古老食谱。但这可能是最后一代了，因为公爵现在的厨师没有孩子。

english: Ah, I will have to ask him for the recipe then.
translation: 啊，那我得向他请教食谱了。

english: Oh, I wouldn't do that if I were you, he's very sensitive about his gumbo responsibilities. I'm sure that if you're a good enough fisherman and cook the knowledge will reach you one day.
translation: 哦，如果我是你我不会那样做，他对自己的秋葵汤职责很敏感。我相信如果你是个足够好的渔夫和厨师，总有一天你会学到这个知识。

english: OK, I shan't bring it up with him. Cheers for the chat Bob.
translation: 好的，我不会跟他提这个。谢谢聊天鲍勃。

english: No problem. Just make sure you bring me some of you ever get the chance to make it. I love that gumbo!
translation: 没问题。只要确保如果你有机会做的话给我带一些。我爱那个秋葵汤！

english: Hi Bob. What are you doing here?
translation: 嗨鲍勃。你在这里做什么？

english: Ah, another person who thinks I want to talk to them just because they can understand me.
translation: 啊，又一个人以为我想和他们说话就因为他们能听懂我。

english: Aww, come on!
translation: 哎呀，拜托！

english: OK, you asked what I'm doing here.
translation: 好吧，你问我在这里做什么。

english: I'm here to study the druids. They're boring, but they know how to treat animals, and they don't go around bothering you just because they've got a silly gadget that lets them understand what you say!
translation: 我来这里研究德鲁伊。他们很无聊，但他们知道如何对待动物，而且他们不会因为你有个愚蠢的小玩意能听懂你说话就到处烦你！

english: Hi Bob. What are you doing hanging around Varrock?
translation: 嗨鲍勃。你在维洛克城闲逛做什么？

english: Not much. Just came to see how things are going. Not visited here in a while you see. Me and Roald used to talk all the time.
translation: 没什么。只是来看看情况如何。有一段时间没来这里了。我和罗尔德以前经常聊天。

english: Oh really, about what?
translation: 哦真的吗，聊什么？

english: Well, those white knights are far more complicated than you might imagine. Not the ‘goodie goodies’ they claim to be. Just watch your back.
translation: 嗯，那些白骑士比你想象的要复杂得多。不像他们自称的那样''好人''，你小心点。

english: Will do Bob, and thanks.
translation: 会的鲍勃，谢谢。

english: Yikes!! Where did you pop up from?
translation: 哎呀！！你从哪里冒出来的？

english: Oh sorry Bob, didn't mean to make you jump.
translation: 哦抱歉鲍勃，没想吓你一跳。

english: Noooooo. Now that mouse I was chasing has got away. Can you be a bit more sneaky next time? You know, sneaky sneaky stick da chompy as my old friend Rantz often says.
translation: 不不不不。现在我追的老鼠跑掉了。你下次能偷偷摸摸一点吗？你知道的，偷偷摸摸抓住大嘴鸟，就像我的老朋友兰茨常说的。

english: Sure thing Bob.
translation: 当然鲍勃。

english: Argh! My thumbs have gone weird!
translation: 啊！我的拇指变得奇怪了！

english: But Bob, you don't have any thumbs!
translation: 但是鲍勃，你没有拇指！

english: Exactly!! Clearly I must go home, the sky's beginning to bruise, night must fall and I shall be forced to camp.
translation: 正是！！显然我必须回家，天空开始变紫，夜晚必须降临，我将被迫露营。

english: Is everything Ok Bob?
translation: 一切都好吗鲍勃？

english: No, not really. I've just had a severe disappointment.
translation: 不，不太好。我刚刚经历了严重的失望。

english: Whats up Bob, lost your favorite toy?
translation: 怎么了鲍勃，丢了最喜欢的玩具？

english: No, it's just that there comes a time in every cats life where he realises how much time he has wasted just.... playing with rats.
translation: 不，只是每只猫的生活中都有一个时刻，他会意识到自己浪费了多少时间……玩老鼠。

english: Doesn't sound like a waste of time to me! They deserve it!
translation: 对我来说听起来不像浪费时间！它们活该！

english: Ahh, I guess yourright. Thanks!
translation: 啊，我想你是对的。谢谢！

english: Actually no. I come from round here originally. Back then all this was just fields.
translation: 其实不是。我原本就来自这里。那时候这里还只是田野。

english: Back then? How old are you Bob?
translation: 那时候？你多大了鲍勃？

english: Ha! How old indeed. How old are the trees? How old are the waves that crash against the shore? How old is the stone we walk on?
translation: 哈！多大确实。树有多老？拍打海岸的波浪有多老？我们踩的石头有多老？

english: I see. Cryptic as ever. Cheers Bob.... I think.
translation: 我明白了。还是一如既往的神秘。干杯鲍勃……我想。

english: If a player falls down in a forest and nobody is there, do they make any noise?
translation: 如果一个玩家在森林里摔倒而没人在那里，他们会发出声音吗？

english: Now, where did the rest of my PK clan go?
translation: 现在，我的 PK 团队其他人去哪了？

english: Be wery, wery quiet... I'm hunting pwayers.
translation: 安静，非常安静……我在猎杀玩家。

english: Ah, don't mind me. I'm just looting bodies.
translation: 啊，别在意我。我只是在搜刮尸体。

english: Look out!! He's over there!! Run!!
translation: 小心！！他在那里！！快跑！！

english: You know, my feet are knackered. This walking lark isn't all it's cracked up to be. Give me a nice monitor to sleep on any day.
translation: 你知道吗，我的脚累坏了。这走路的事没传说中那么好。我宁愿睡在舒服的显示器上。

english: In this place it's not HOW you die that matters. It's who you take with you.
translation: 在这个地方，重要的不是你怎么死的。而是你拉谁一起死。

english: Those who live by the sword, die by the mage.
translation: 玩剑者，必死于法师之手。

english: Did you see that? Someone with a big shiny new halberd hiding behind that rock. I thought only rangers acted as cowardly as that.
translation: 你看到了吗？有人拿着闪亮的新戟躲在那块石头后面。我以为只有射手才会那么懦弱。

english: Are you really just a cat Bob?
translation: 你真的只是只猫吗鲍勃？

english: Apparently so yes. Well, that's what they told me after the experiment.
translation: 显然是的。嗯，那是实验后他们告诉我的。

english: What experiment?
translation: 什么实验？

english: Yes. There was this professor called 'Oddenstein' I think. He must have tricked me into that machine of his, then the next thing I knew I was feline!
translation: 是的。我想有个叫''奥登斯坦''的教授。他一定把我骗进了他的机器，然后下一秒我就变成猫了！

english: Oddenstein? I am sure I have heard that name...
translation: 奥登斯坦？我肯定听过这个名字……

english: Yes. Once the authorities found out about his experiments he ran away. Lucky for him or I would scratch his eyes out.
translation: 是的。一旦当局发现他的实验他就逃跑了。他运气好，否则我会抓瞎他的眼睛。

english: Is this really all true? Sounds a bit suspicious to me.
translation: 这都是真的吗？听起来有点可疑。

english: Never question the logic of a cat, however flawed.
translation: 永远不要质疑猫的逻辑，无论多么有缺陷。

english: Flawed? So it isn't true... so, erm, eh?
translation: 有缺陷？所以不是真的……那么，呃，嗯？

english: Perhaps one day you will learn the truth. Until then, the Oddenstein story is what we will tell the 'others'. Understood?
translation: 也许有一天你会知道真相。在那之前，奥登斯坦的故事是我们告诉''其他人''的。明白了吗？

english: OK. Your secretssafe with me Bob.
translation: 好的。你的秘密在我这里很安全鲍勃。

english: This is a long way from Burthorpe. What you doing out here?
translation: 这里离伯索普公国很远。你在这里做什么？

english: I am drawing a picture of that thing over there.
translation: 我在画那边那个东西的画像。

english: Really? What thing?
translation: 真的吗？什么东西？

english: That gullible thing over there. Next to that tree where that man sometimes stands.
translation: 那边那个容易上当的东西。在那个人有时站的那棵树旁边。

english: Wow. Could you be any more vague and sarcastic?
translation: 哇。你能不能再模糊和讽刺一点？

english: Probably. It's just no challenge these days.
translation: 可能。只是现在没什么挑战了。

english: It's not safe here Bob. You should leave.
translation: 这里不安全鲍勃。你应该离开。

english: No way. I am here catching mice.
translation: 没门。我在这里抓老鼠。

english: But there aren't any mice in the Wilderness.
translation: 但荒野里没有老鼠。

english: Ahh, the human shows signs of a brain. Why do you think that is?
translation: 啊，人类显示出有大脑的迹象。你觉得那是为什么？

english: Because you caught them all?
translation: 因为你把它们都抓光了？

english: Exactly. Well done!
translation: 正是。干得好！

english: Hey Bob. Got any wisdom to share?
translation: 嘿鲍勃。有什么智慧可以分享吗？

english: Sorry, I am far too busy marking my territory.
translation: 抱歉，我太忙着标记我的领地了。

english: Your territory? This place is ruled by the Grand Highmage Gower and his minions.
translation: 你的领地？这个地方由大法师高尔和他的手下统治。

english: I think not. They are my minions, and I let him think that he's in charge. I'm the real power behind the throne.
translation: 我不这么认为。他们是我的手下，我让他以为他是老大。我才是幕后真正的掌权者。

english: I knew it!!
translation: 我就知道！！

english: Yeah, it keeps them happy that way, but don't tell anyone!
translation: 是的，那样让他们开心，但别告诉任何人！

english: Hee hee. OK Bob.
translation: 嘻嘻。好的鲍勃。

english: Dogs believe they are human. Cats believe they are Guthix!
translation: 狗认为自己是人类。猫认为自己是古斯！

english: What do you believe, Bob?
translation: 你相信什么，鲍勃？

english: Well, I don't believe much really since I know I am Zar... erm, well, no, I erm, meow?
translation: 嗯，我真的不太相信什么，因为我知道我是扎……呃，好吧，不，我呃，喵？

english: Don't get distracted so easily! See, I'm distracting you right now!
translation: 别这么容易分心！看，我现在就在分散你的注意力！

english: Sorry, I'm far too busy calculating thermal vectors.
translation: 抱歉，我太忙着计算热向量了。

english: Eh?
translation: 嗯？

english: Oh, sorry... I meant, erm, meow?
translation: 哦，抱歉……我是说，呃，喵？

english: Nothing interesting happens.
translation: 没什么有趣的事发生。

english: Eh? That's hardly useful.
translation: 嗯？那几乎没用。

english: Ahh, but it is you see. It does all sorts of wonderous things.
translation: 啊，但它确实有用你看。它做各种奇妙的事情。

english: Like what?
translation: 比如什么？

english: Well, it's more to do with what happens when you hear that being said. You see, something interesting happens somewhere else.
translation: 嗯，这更多与你听到那句话时发生的事有关。你看，别的地方会发生有趣的事。

english: So what you're saying is that if nothing interesting happens to me, then something interesting is happening for someone else somewhere that IS interesting?
translation: 所以你的意思是如果没什么有趣的事发生在我身上，那么有趣的事正在别的地方为别人发生，那才是有趣的？

english: Yes, that's about it.
translation: 是的，差不多就是这样。

english: OK... I see.... I think.
translation: 好吧……我明白了……我想。

english: Cats are rather delicate creatures and they are subject to a good many ailments, but I never heard of one who suffered from insomnia.
translation: 猫是相当脆弱的生物，它们容易患很多疾病，但我从未听说过有猫患失眠症。

english: So, you want to know how us cats keep so clean all day?
translation: 那么，你想知道我们猫怎么整天保持这么干净吗？

english: Must be all that washing you do.
translation: 一定是你们洗了很多。

english: You would think so wouldn't you. But is being covered in spit really clean?
translation: 你会这么想对吧。但被口水覆盖真的干净吗？

english: Eeeww. Gross.
translation: 呃呃。恶心。

english: Anything not nailed down is a cat toy.
translation: 任何没钉住的东西都是猫玩具。

english: If at first you don't succeed, take a short nap.
translation: 如果一开始你没成功，小睡一会儿。

english: Yeah, I could tell you something really useful, but then I would have to '1-hit you' to death.
translation: 是啊，我可以告诉你一些真正有用的东西，但那样我就得''一击秒杀''你了。

english: Bob, you couldn't 1-hit a noob.
translation: 鲍勃，你连菜鸟都一击秒杀不了。

english: Care to place a wager on that? Sorry, hang on, I've got no pockets. Maybe next time.
translation: 想打个赌吗？抱歉，等等，我没有口袋。下次吧。

english: I'll be waiting.
translation: 我会等着的。

english: Dogs have owners, cats have staff.
translation: 狗有主人，猫有仆人。

english: I have studied many philosophers and many cats. The wisdom of cats is infinitely superior.
translation: 我研究过许多哲学家和许多猫。猫的智慧无限优越。

english: There are many intelligent species in the universe. They are all owned by cats.
translation: 宇宙中有很多智慧物种。它们都被猫拥有。

english: Cats and teleporting just don't mix well. That's why I walk everywhere. Messes my hair up terribly.
translation: 猫和传送就是合不来。所以我到处走路，把头发都弄乱了。

english: Cats are smarter than dogs. You can't get eight cats to pull a sled through snow.
translation: 猫比狗聪明。你没法让八只猫拉着雪橇穿过雪地。

english: Sorry, no time for chat. Still got mouse bones stuck in my teeth. How awkward.
translation: 抱歉，没时间聊天。牙缝里还卡着老鼠骨头。真尴尬。

english: You know, cats are the first species to fully evolve. We're perfect.
translation: 你知道吗，猫是第一个完全进化的物种。我们是完美的。

english: Preserve nature. Pickle a dog!
translation: 保护自然。把狗腌了！

english: Do you like dogs?
translation: 你喜欢狗吗？

english: Yes!
translation: 是的！

english: Me too. Care to swap recipes? I have a rather unique hotdog sauce.
translation: 彼此彼此。想交换食谱吗？我有个相当独特的热狗酱配方。

english: Bob, you're a bit messed up really aren't you.
translation: 鲍勃，你有点问题。

english: No, I just know what I like. Besides, it was a joke.
translation: 不，我只是知道我喜欢什么。而且，那是个笑话。

english: A joke? I doubt the dogs are laughing.
translation: 笑话？我怀疑狗们笑不出来。

english: What dogs? I have already rid this place of dogs. Have you ever seen one?
translation: 什么狗？我已经把这地方的狗都清除了。你见过狗吗？

english: Yes actually. I heard there are a few wild dogs about here somewhere.
translation: 实际上见过。我听说这附近有几只野狗。

english: Right!! Fellow cats, prepare for war!!
translation: 好！！猫同胞们，准备战斗！！

english: Mmm. Maybe another time.
translation: 嗯。也许改天吧。

english: Cat Rule number 1: Always act afraid when near dogs, especially if you're near a human. They will pick you up and fuss you, then shout at the dog. Most amusing!
translation: 猫规则第一条：在狗附近总要装害怕，尤其是有人在的时候。他们会把你抱起来安抚你，然后对狗大喊。太有趣了！

english: Cat Rule number 2: When assisting a human at work, make sure you sit behind its right leg. You stand a much better chance of getting picked up and stroked. Also, it's very amusing
translation: 猫规则第二条：当人类工作时，要坐在它右腿后面。这样被抱起来抚摸的机会更大。而且很有趣

english: Cat Rule number 3: If you ever make a mistake, which is rare and probably involves a dog, make sure you wash yourself immediately. This will give everyone the impression that
translation: 猫规则第三条：如果你犯了错，这很罕见而且可能和狗有关，一定要立刻舔毛。这会让所有人觉得

english: it was done on purpose.
translation: 你是故意的。

english: Cat Rule number 4: Beware the bag monster. These things live in small bags and under newspapers, sometimes even hidden in shoes if they are very clever. They will be very small and
translation: 猫规则第四条：小心袋子怪物。这些东西住在小袋子和报纸下面，有时甚至藏在鞋子里如果它们很聪明的话。它们会很小而且

english: take on the same colour as the hiding place. Attack these things on sight - stop at nothing. If you see a bag or shoe you have not inspected recently, pounce!!
translation: 伪装成藏身处的颜色。见到这些东西就攻击——不惜一切代价。如果你看到最近没检查过的袋子或鞋子，扑上去！！

english: Do you like all the monsters around here?
translation: 你喜欢这附近所有的怪物吗？

english: No, not really. I'm actually signed up with all those HAM fanatics. Kill the whole lot of 'em!!
translation: 不，不太喜欢。其实我加入了那些反怪物人联狂热分子。把它们全杀了！！

english: That's a bit cruel isn't it?
translation: 那有点残忍不是吗？

english: Yeah, that's one of my best qualities. Just behind sneaky and vicious. Besides, after a few doses of catnip, they all look like mice to me!
translation: 是啊，那是我最棒的品质之一。仅次于狡猾和凶残。而且，吃了几剂猫薄荷后，它们在我眼里都像老鼠！

english: Hi Bob! Do you have another one of those mouse toys? I lost mine.
translation: 嗨鲍勃！你还有那种老鼠玩具吗？我把我的弄丢了。

english: Hi [player name]. Mouse toy?
translation: 嗨[player name]。老鼠玩具？

english: You know, a fake mouse on a string.
translation: 你知道的，系在绳子上的假老鼠。

english: Oh, you mean an ACTD.
translation: 哦，你是说高级战斗训练装置。

english: An Advanced Combat Training Device, every cat should have one. Here's another one.
translation: 高级战斗训练装置，每只猫都应该有一个。再给你一个。

english: I don't have the space, one second.
translation: 我没有空间，等一下。

english: Thanks Bob! You're the best!
translation: 谢谢鲍勃！你最棒了！

english: You're welcome!
translation: 不客气！

english: Hi Bob, how's tricks?
translation: 嗨鲍勃，怎么样？

english: Speak to me, Bob! Give me some wise words of advice!
translation: 和我说话，鲍勃！给我一些明智的建议！

english: Please excuse me, I'm rather busy.
translation: 请原谅，我很忙。

english: Hey, I'm your contractor from Mahogany Homes, what did you want done?
translation: 嘿，我是你的红木家园承包商，你想做什么？

english: I'd like a Wooden table built.
translation: 我想建造一张木桌。

english: I'd like my clock fixed.
translation: 我想修钟表。

english: I'd like two Wooden cabinets built.
translation: 我想建造两个木柜。

english: I'd like two Wooden bookcases built.
translation: 我想建造两个木书架。

english: I'd like a Wooden wardrobe built.
translation: 我想建造一个木衣柜。

english: I'd like a Wooden drawer built.
translation: 我想建造一个木抽屉柜。

english: I'd like a Oak table built.
translation: 我想建造一张橡木桌。

english: I'd like two Oak cabinets built.
translation: 我想建造两个橡木柜。

english: I'd like two Oak bookcases built.
translation: 我想建造两个橡木书架。

english: I'd like a Oak wardrobe built.
translation: 我想建造一个橡木衣柜。

english: I'd like a Oak drawer built.
translation: 我想建造一个橡木抽屉柜。

english: I'd like a Teak table built.
translation: 我想建造一张柚木桌。

english: I'd like two Teak cabinets built.
translation: 我想建造两个柚木柜。

english: I'd like two Teak bookcases built.
translation: 我想建造两个柚木书架。

english: I'd like a Teak wardrobe built.
translation: 我想建造一个柚木衣柜。

english: I'd like a Teak drawer built.
translation: 我想建造一个柚木抽屉柜。

english: I'd like a Mahogany table built.
translation: 我想建造一张红木桌。

english: I'd like two Mahogany cabinets built.
translation: 我想建造两个红木柜。

english: I'd like two Mahogany bookcases built.
translation: 我想建造两个红木书架。

english: I'd like a Mahogany wardrobe built.
translation: 我想建造一个红木衣柜。

english: I'd like a Mahogany drawer built.
translation: 我想建造一个红木抽屉柜。

english: I've finished with the work you wanted.
translation: 我已经完成你想要的工作了。

english: Thank you so much! Would you like a cup of tea before you go?
translation: 太感谢了！走之前想喝杯茶吗？

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
translation: 是的，我想喝一杯。

english: Aaah, nothing like a nice cupppa tea!
translation: 啊，没有什么比得上一杯好茶！

english: No thanks, I better be off.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我最好走了。

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
translation: 是的，我想喝一杯。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: He is ignoring you.
translation: 他无视了你。

english: Apparently you aren't as stupid as you look.
translation: 显然你没看起来那么笨。

english: Hello, chum, fancy buyin' some designer jewellry? They've come all the way from Ardougne! Most pukka!
translation: 你好，伙计，想买些设计师珠宝吗？它们都是从阿多尼城远道而来的！绝对正宗！

english: Erm, no. I'm all set, thanks.
translation: 呃，不。我都有了，谢谢。

english: Okay, chum, would you like to show you the very latest potion prices?
translation: 好吧，伙计，想看看最新的药水价格吗？

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Why, I'm Bob! Your friendly seller of smashin' goods!
translation: 哎呀，我是鲍勃！你友好的优质商品卖家！

english: So what do you have to sell?
translation: 那你有什么卖的？

english: Oh, not much at the moment. Cuz, ya know, business being so well and cushie.
translation: 哦，目前没什么。因为，你知道，生意太好了太舒服了。

english: You don't really look like you're being so successful.
translation: 你看起来不太像那么成功。

english: You plonka! It's all a show, innit! If I let people knows I'm in good business they'll want a share of the moolah!
translation: 你个笨蛋！都是装样子的，懂吗！如果让人知道我生意好他们就想分一杯羹！

english: You conveniently have a response for everything.
translation: 你倒是每件事都有说辞。

english: That's the Ardougne way, my son.
translation: 这就是阿多尼风格，我的孩子。

english: Can you show me the prices for potions?
translation: 你能给我看看药水价格吗？

english: Lets see what you have...
translation: 让我看看你有什么……

english: You're a bit short of inventory space.
translation: 你的物品栏空间有点不够。

english: You're a bit short of empty vessels or cash. Empty vials cost 5 coins each, cups 8 coins each, and anything else is 5 coins each.
translation: 你的空容器或现金有点不够。空瓶每个5金币，杯子每个8金币，其他都是每个5金币。

english: There, I've done what I can, but you're a bit short of empty vessels or cash. Empty vials cost 5 coins each, cups 8 coins each, and anything else is 5 coins each.
translation: 好了，我已经尽力了，但你的空容器或现金还是有点不够。空瓶每个5金币，杯子每个8金币，其他都是每个5金币。

english: There, all done.
translation: 好了，都完成了。

english: Two plus two is four, minus one that's three...
translation: 二加二等于四，减一等于三……

english: I don't think you've got anything that I can decant.
translation: 我想你没有什么我能分装的。

english: Please, please, please work.
translation: 求求……

english: I'm in the money!
translation: 我发财了！

english: I could have sworn that would have worked.
translation: 我敢发誓那应该有用的。

english: Now what should I buy?
translation: 现在我该买什么？

english: Hope this item sells well.
translation: 希望这个商品卖得好。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Can you show me the prices for potions?
translation: 你能给我看看药水价格吗？

english: I'll leave you to it.
translation: 那我不打扰你了。

english: Hello, how are you doing?
translation: 你好，最近怎么样？

english: I'm good thank you, how can I help you today?
translation: 我很好谢谢，今天有什么能帮你的吗？

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: This is our agility course, we use it to stay nimble and to keep our wits sharp. My name is Bobawu and I look after the course.
translation: 这是我们的敏捷训练场，我们用它来保持敏捷和头脑清醒。我叫博巴乌，负责照看这个训练场。

english: As a friend and fellow monkey, you're free to use it anytime, but you'll need to be as nimble as a ninja first!
translation: 作为朋友和同类猴子，你可以随时使用，但首先你得像忍者一样敏捷！

english: Oh great, thank you.
translation: 哦太好了，谢谢。

english: Are there any rewards you can offer me?
translation: 你有什么奖励能给我吗？

english: Could you tell me how many laps I've completed?
translation: 你能告诉我完成了多少圈吗？

english: I can't offer you anything for now, so I don't see much reason to count your laps either.
translation: 我现在没什么能给你的，所以也没什么理由帮你记圈数。

english: You need to complete Monkey Madness 2 for Bobawu to offer rewards and to count your lap total
translation: 你需要完成疯狂的猴子 II，博巴乌才会提供奖励并记录你的总圈数

english: Looks like you haven't completed any laps, but I'll be sure to keep track of them, when you do.
translation: 看起来你还没完成任何圈数，但等你开始后我会帮你记录的。

english: Sure thing my friend, so far you've completed 1 lap, don't stop now!
translation: 没问题我的朋友，目前你完成了1圈，别停下！

english: Sure thing my friend, so far you've completed [number] laps, don't stop now!
translation: 没问题我的朋友，目前你完成了 [number] 圈，别停下！

english: What can you offer me?
translation: 你能给我什么？

english: I see you have your own monkey friend, by completing laps here you can transform him into different monkeys!
translation: 我看你有自己的猴子朋友，在这里完成圈数可以把他变成不同的猴子！

english: That's neat, what can he turn into?
translation: 真不错，他能变成什么？

english: I've got the list here!
translation: 我这里有清单！

english: Bobawu pulls out a tattered piece of paper from his ninja costume.
translation: 博巴乌从他的忍者服装里掏出一张破旧的纸。

english: Ahem, here we are, At 100 you'll unlock a Karamjan Monkey transformation.
translation: 咳咳，来了，完成100圈你就能解锁卡拉姆詹猴子变形。

english: After completing 250 laps, you'll unlock a scary zombie monkey.
translation: 完成250圈后，你能解锁可怕的僵尸猴。

english: With 500 laps finished, you'll get a maniacal monkey.
translation: 完成500圈，你能获得疯狂猴子。

english: At 1000 laps, you'll be able transform him into a spooky skeleton monkey,
translation: 完成1000圈，你就能把他变成恐怖的骷髅猴子，

english: 1500 laps for a little Kruk Jr monkey,
translation: 1500圈能获得小克鲁克猴子，

english: Finally at 2000 laps, he can transform to look like our King Awowogei.
translation: 最后完成2000圈，他能变形得像我们的国王阿沃沃吉一样。

english: On second thought, never mind.
translation: 再想想，算了。

english: That's okay my friend, come back anytime.
translation: 没关系我的朋友，随时回来。

english: Hey there, how do you do my fellow monkey?
translation: 嘿，你好啊我的猴子同胞？

english: So far you've completed 1 lap, don't stop now!
translation: 目前你完成了1圈，别停下！

english: So far you've completed [number] laps, don't stop now!
translation: 目前你完成了 [number] 圈，别停下！

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: How many laps have I done?
translation: 我完成了多少圈？

english: What can you offer me?
translation: 你能给我什么？

english: Never mind.
translation: 算了。

english: Hello there friend! I'm Bobby the gnome child.
translation: 你好朋友！我是地精小孩鲍比。

english: Are you heading into The Nutcracker?
translation: 你要去胡桃钳酒馆吗？

english: Oh yes. Me and Pa have been looking forward to this all year. Isn't that right Pa?
translation: 哦是的。我和爸爸盼了一整年了。对吧爸爸？

english: Yes Bobby. There's no doubt we will be sipping mulled pine inside The Nutcracker in no time.
translation: 是的鲍比。毫无疑问我们很快就能在胡桃钳酒馆里喝热红酒了。

english: Mulled pine? Sounds very... Organic.
translation: 热红酒？听起来很……天然。

english: It's delightful.
translation: 很好喝的。

english: Wishing you happy holidays [player name].
translation: 祝你节日快乐[player name]。

english: You too Bobby.
translation: 你也是鲍比。

english: Woah, you're very big for a Gnome.
translation: 哇，你对于地精来说很高大。

english: And you're very rude for a human.
translation: 而你对于人类来说很无礼。

english: Don't listen to them Bobby. You're just a little different.
translation: 别听他们的鲍比。你只是有点不一样。

english: Nice to meet you [player name]. Does somebody need a hug?
translation: 很高兴认识你[player name]。有人需要拥抱吗？

english: Bobby stumbles and steps on his dad's foot while trying to hug you.
translation: 鲍比绊了一下，试图拥抱你时踩到了他爸爸的脚。

english: Son of a nutcracker!
translation: 胡桃钳的！

english: Sorry Pa!
translation: 对不起爸爸！

english: I'll walk it off.
translation: 我走走就好了。

english: Heading into The Nutcracker?
translation: 要去胡桃钳酒馆吗？

english: You're a gnome?
translation: 你是地精？

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Hello stranger, new to these parts?
translation: 你好，陌生人，刚来这地方？

english: I'm Bolkoy by the way. I'm the village shopkeeper. Would you like to buy something?
translation: 顺便说一下我叫博尔科伊。我是村里的店主。想买点什么吗？

english: What have you got?
translation: 你有什么？

english: Take a look.
translation: 看看吧。

english: No thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Ok, maybe later.
translation: 好的，也许晚点。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Welcome, welcome. It's good to see you again. The village is much safer now you have returned the orbs.
translation: 欢迎欢迎。很高兴再次见到你。你找回宝珠后村子安全多了。

english: By the way, I'm the village shop keeper. Would you like to buy something?
translation: 顺便说一下，我是村里的店主。想买点什么吗？

english: Hello! I take it you're here about the trail?
translation: 你好！我想你是来参加挑战的吧？

english: Yes, do you have a challenge for me?
translation: 是的，你有什么挑战给我吗？

english: Yes, right here!
translation: 有，就在这里！

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
translation: 请输入问题的答案。

english: What's the matter with you? Can't you count? Try harder!
translation: 你怎么回事？不会数数吗？再努力点！

english: Lucky for you, that's the right answer!
translation: 算你走运，答对了！

english: What have you got?
translation: 你有什么？

english: No thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Yeah?
translation: 是吗？

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: Granddad's fruit farm. It's a right dump. This whole corner of the city is a dump.
translation: 爷爷的水果农场，就是个破烂地方。整个城区都是垃圾场。

english: So why are you here if it's a dump?
translation: 那既然是垃圾场你为什么还在这里？

english: My cow of a sister kicked me out of her bar. Said I was getting the place a bad name. So I'm staying here until I'm old enough to get my own place.
translation: 我那讨厌的姐姐把我从她的酒吧赶出来了。说我让那里名声变坏。所以我待在这里直到够大能自己找地方住。

english: I want to move to Arceuus. It's properly awesome up there. I'll do bartending or something until I can learn to be a necromancer.
translation: 我想搬去阿西乌斯城。那里真的很棒。我会先做酒保之类的，直到能学习成为死灵法师。

english: Anyway, why are you here? Do you want something?
translation: 话说，你为什么在这里？想要什么吗？

english: Never mind.
translation: 算了。

english: Okay, thanks for the info.
translation: 好的，谢谢你的信息。

english: Yeah, you're in the biggest dumpster of Dumpsterville. Now you know. Anyway, do you want something?
translation: 是的，你在垃圾城最大的垃圾堆里。现在你知道了。话说，你想要什么吗？

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 跟我说说你自己。

english: Yeah, alright...
translation: 是的，好吧……

english: I am Bologa Gricoller, seeker of forbidden wisdom, wanderer of the dark pathways, thinker of the unthinkable. I can do bartending too.
translation: 我是博洛加‧格里科勒，禁忌智慧的追寻者，黑暗道路的流浪者，不可思议之事的思考者。我也会做酒保。

english: I used to work at The Golden Field. That's my sister's bar. It's mostly farmhands drinking there, but you get some interesting people as well.
translation: 我过去在金色原野酒馆工作。那是我姐姐的酒吧。 mostly 是农场工人在那里喝酒，但也能遇到一些有趣的人。

english: See, most Hosidius people are Saradominists. My sister, she's always listening to Father Jean at the church with his goodie-goodie sermons.
translation: 你看，大多数霍西迪乌斯人都是萨拉多明信徒。我姐姐，她总是去教堂听让神父那些假正经的布道。

english: But some of us in the bar thought we'd give Zamorak a try. Like, you gotta be open-minded, right? What did Saradomin ever do for us anyway?
translation: 但我们酒吧里有些人想试试扎莫拉克。就像，你得保持开放心态对吧？萨拉多明到底为我们做过什么？

english: So we'd meet in the bar, sharing books that the Piscarilius smugglers would bring us, learning what the Saradominists don't want us to know.
translation: 所以我们会在酒吧聚会，分享皮斯卡里乌斯走私者带给我们的书籍，学习萨拉多明信徒不想让我们知道的东西。

english: Anyway, my sister - she's a right cow, by the way - she fired me and kicked me out. Said I was bringing bad sorts to her bar.
translation: 话说，我姐姐——顺便说她是个讨厌鬼——她解雇了我把我赶出来。说我给她的酒吧带来了坏人。

english: Bad sorts, she said! Like, morality is totally subjective, right? So who's she to call us bad sorts just 'cos we're not afraid to think differently?
translation: 坏人，她说！就像，道德完全是主观的对吧？她凭什么说我们是坏人就因为我们不怕不同思考？

english: Anyway, I've learnt all this cool stuff about Zamorak, and being stuck in a fruit farm doesn't stop me being his loyal servant, right?
translation: 话说，我已经学到了这么多关于扎莫拉克的酷东西，被困在水果农场也不能阻止我成为他的忠诚仆从，对吧？

english: In fact I've invented a Zamorakian blessing that works on fruit! You can use it to make Zamorak's wine out of grapes from the Vinery.
translation: 事实上我发明了一种对水果有效的扎莫拉克祝福！你可以用它把酿酒厂的葡萄做成扎莫拉克之酒。

english: Can you help me to make Zamorak's wine?
translation: 你能帮我制作扎莫拉克之酒吗？

english: I'll let you have access to the Zamorakian blessing I invented, so you can invoke Zamorak's unholy power upon the grapes... if I think you're up to it.
translation: 我可以让你使用我发明的扎莫拉克祝福，这样你就能对葡萄召唤扎莫拉克的邪恶力量……如果我觉得你够格的话。

english: I'll want 75,000 coins too.
translation: 我还要75,000金币。

english: And do you think I'm up to it?
translation: 那你觉得我够格吗？

english: Nah, I bet you couldn't even bless an unholy symbol - you're not going to get very far with my grape blessing.
translation: 不，我打赌你连邪恶护符都祝福不了——用我的葡萄祝福你走不了多远。

english: You need a Prayer level of 50 to use Bologa's blessing.
translation: 你需要50级祈祷才能使用博洛加的祝福。

english: Not likely - I can see from your kit that you're supporting other gods. Dress Zamorakian if you want to impress me. And I'll still want 75,000 coins.
translation: 不太可能——我从你的装备看出你支持其他神。想让我印象深刻就穿扎莫拉克风格的装备。而且我还是要75,000金币。

english: You don't look much like a Zamorakian to me. Dress Zamorakian if you want my help. And I'll still want 75,000 coins.
translation: 你看起来不太像扎莫拉克信徒。想让我帮忙就穿扎莫拉克风格的装备。而且我还是要75,000金币。

english: Yeah, I guess you'll do. But I want 75,000 coins. One day I'll need to buy my own house, y'know!
translation: 是的，我想你凑合吧。但我要75,000金币。总有一天我需要买自己的房子，你懂的！

english: Maybe another time.
translation: 也许改天吧。

english: Here's how it works... I'll write the blessing on scrolls. You need to carry some of the scrolls when you're harvesting grapes.
translation: 原理是这样的……我会把祝福写在卷轴上。你收获葡萄时需要携带一些卷轴。

english: As each fruit is severed from its stem, it begins to die. That's the moment of vulnerability when Zamorak's unholy power can infest it.
translation: 当每个果实从茎上被切断时，它开始死亡。那就是脆弱时刻，扎莫拉克的邪恶力量可以侵入它。

english: The power consumes the scroll on which the blessing is written, so you'll need one for each grape. I suggest you take a stack of blessings with you.
translation: 力量会消耗写有祝福的卷轴，所以每个葡萄需要一个。我建议你带一叠祝福卷轴。

english: By the way, Lord Zamorak's chaotic power is quite volatile. You'll likely get a smaller harvest from your vine if you're using these blessings.
translation: 顺便说一下，扎莫拉克领主的混沌力量很不稳定。如果你使用这些祝福，葡萄藤的收成可能会减少。

english: I'll give the scrolls to Granddad downstairs. You can get them off him as a reward if you work on his farm. Hey, it's a dump, but he's family. So, do you accept?
translation: 我会把卷轴给楼下的爷爷。如果你在他的农场工作，可以从他那里作为奖励拿到。嘿，虽然是垃圾场，但他是我家人。那么，你接受吗？

english: You pay Bologa 75,000 coins. You can now claim her blessings from Farmer Gricoller as a reward for working on his farm.
translation: 你支付给博洛加75,000金币。你现在可以从格里科勒农夫那里领取她的祝福，作为在农场工作的奖励。

english: Actually, no thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Meh.
translation: 唉。

english: I'll leave you to it.
translation: 那我不打扰你了。

english: Hello again.
translation: 又见面了。

english: You said you can make Zamorak's wine from grapes.
translation: 你说你能用葡萄制作扎莫拉克之酒。

english: Yeah, I've invented a blessing that invokes Zamorak's unholy power upon the grapes, so Zamorak's wine can be made from them.
translation: 是的，我发明了一种祝福，能对葡萄召唤扎莫拉克的邪恶力量，这样就能用它们制作扎莫拉克之酒。

english: But I won't let you use it unless I think you're up to it. Also, I want 75,000 coins.
translation: 但除非我觉得你够格否则不会让你用。而且，我要75,000金币。

english: Tell me about yourself again.
translation: 再跟我说说你自己。

english: It's really nice of you to take an interest...
translation: 你真有心感兴趣……

english: Hello again, [player name].
translation: 又见面了，[player name]。

english: How do those blessings work again?
translation: 那些祝福是怎么运作的？

english: My blessing is written on scrolls. You need to carry some of the scrolls when you're harvesting grapes.
translation: 我的祝福写在卷轴上。你收获葡萄时需要携带一些卷轴。

english: I've given the scrolls to Granddad downstairs. You can get them off him as a reward for working on his farm. The place may be a dump, but he's family.
translation: 我已经把卷轴给楼下的爷爷了。你可以在他的农场工作后从他那里作为奖励拿到。那地方可能是垃圾场，但他是我家人。

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

english: Tell me the story about yourself again.
translation: 再跟我讲讲你的故事。

english: Yeah, okay. It's nice of you to ask...
translation: 好的。你有心问……

english: So that's how I came to invent that Zamorakian blessing for making Zamorak's wine out of grapes from the Vinery.
translation: 所以我就是这样发明了那种扎莫拉克祝福，用来把酿酒厂的葡萄做成扎莫拉克之酒。

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: So why are you here if it's a dump?
translation: 那既然是垃圾场你为什么还在这里？

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 跟我说说你自己。

english: Never mind.
translation: 算了。

english: Okay, thanks for the info.
translation: 好的，谢谢你的信息。

english: Can you help me to make Zamorak's wine?
translation: 你能帮我制作扎莫拉克之酒吗？

english: Pay 75,000 coins to access Bologa's blessings.
translation: 支付75,000金币以使用博洛加的祝福。

english: Decline.
translation: 拒绝。

english: I'll leave you to it.
translation: 那我不打扰你了。

english: You said you can make Zamorak's wine from grapes.
translation: 你说你能用葡萄制作扎莫拉克之酒。

english: Tell me about yourself again.
translation: 再跟我说说你自己。

english: How do those blessings work again?
translation: 那些祝福是怎么运作的？

english: Tell me the story about yourself again.
translation: 再跟我讲讲你的故事。

english: Hi there.
translation: 你好。

english: A'up, mate, how's it gowin'?
translation: 嘿，伙计，怎么样？

english: Not bad, thank you.
translation: 不错，谢谢。

english: What are you building here?
translation: 你在这里建什么？

english: Nowt at moment. We're on strike!
translation: 目前什么都没建。我们在罢工！

english: You're on strike? Whatever for?
translation: 你们在罢工？为什么？

english: Those strange alchemists are up ta somefin', best go ta one ov 'em.
translation: 那些奇怪的炼金术士在搞什么名堂，最好去找他们其中一个。

english: Oh, okay.
translation: 哦，好的。

english: You still hangin' around the tower?
translation: 你还在塔附近晃悠？

english: Yeah, we need another job. But til then, we figured we may as well wait ta see what else would turns up.
translation: 是的，我们需要新工作。但在那之前，我们想不如等着看还有什么会出现。

english: Fair enough.
translation: 好吧。

english: Who's a cute little kitty?
translation: 谁是可爱的小猫咪？

english: Jimmy doesn't like me talking to strangers.
translation: 吉米不喜欢我和陌生人说话。

english: Miaow!
translation: 喵！

english: Hello champ!
translation: 你好冠军！

english: So any hints on how to fish?
translation: 有什么钓鱼的建议吗？

english: I think I'll keep them to myself.
translation: 我想我还是自己留着吧。

english: You've already won the Fishing Competition and don't need to enter again.
translation: 你已经赢得了钓鱼比赛，不需要再参加了。

english: Hello tall person.
translation: 你好高个子。

english: Hello short person.
translation: 你好矮个子。

english: Why are you called Boot?
translation: 你为什么叫靴子？

english: I'm called Boot, because when I was very young, I used to sleep, in a large boot.
translation: 我叫靴子，因为我小时候曾经睡在一只大靴子里。

english: Yeah, great, I didn't want your life story.
translation: 是的，很好，我不想知道你的人生故事。

english: Hello short person.
translation: 你好矮个子。

english: Why are you called boot?
translation: 你为什么叫靴子？

english: Can I come through this gate?
translation: 我能通过这个门吗？

english: You must pay a toll of 10 gold coins to pass.
translation: 你必须支付10枚金币的过路费才能通过。

english: No, thank you. I'll walk around.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。我绕路走。

english: Ok suit yourself.
translation: 好的随你便。

english: Who does my money go to?
translation: 我的钱给谁？

english: The money goes to the city of Al-Kharid.
translation: 钱交给阿尔卡里德城。

english: Yes, ok.
translation: 好的。

english: You pay the guard.
translation: 你支付给守卫。

english: Oh dear, I don't actually seem to have enough money.
translation: 哦天，我好像钱不够。

english: You may pass for free, you are a friend of Al-Kharid.
translation: 你可以免费通过，你是阿尔卡里德城的朋友。

english: Can we come through this gate?
translation: 我们能通过这个门吗？

english: You may pass for free, for you are a friend of Al-Kharid, but your goblin friend must stay on this side.
translation: 你可以免费通过，因为你是阿尔卡里德城的朋友，但你的哥布林朋友必须待在这边。

english: Why?
translation: 为什么？

english: Why do you think this gate is here, if not to keep the goblins out of Al Kharid?
translation: 你觉得这个门在这里是为什么，不就是把哥布林挡在阿尔卡里德城外吗？

english: But Zanik isn't like the other goblins!
translation: 但扎尼克不像其他哥布林！

english: Nevermind, player name. I don't think we need to go to Al Kharid anyway!
translation: 算了[player name]。我想我们反正也不需要去阿尔卡里德城！

english: You cannot pass as you haven't unlocked access to both theMisthalinandKharidian Desertareas in this League.
translation: 你无法通过，因为你在这个联赛中还未解锁米斯特林王國和卡里迪安沙漠区域的前往权限。

english: No thank you, I'll walk around.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我绕路走。

english: Who does my money go to?
translation: 我的钱给谁？

english: Yes, ok.
translation: 好的。

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Can I help you?
translation: 我能帮你吗？

english: Just wondering what brings you out here?
translation: 只是想知道什么风把你吹到这里来了？

english: This is the only land border into the Kingdom of Varlamore. We're here to make sure no one enters without permission.
translation: 这是进入瓦拉莫尔王国唯一的陆路边境。我们在这里确保没有人未经许可进入。

english: I see. Would I be able to enter?
translation: 我明白了。我能进入吗？

english: No. The Queen is currently making arrangements to allow outsiders like yourself to enter Varlamore without needing to obtain permission first. However, until then, you must remain on this side of the border.
translation: 不能。女王目前正在安排让像你这样的外人无需事先获得许可就能进入瓦拉莫尔。但在那之前，你必须待在边境这边。

english: Fair enough.
translation: 好吧。

english: Well, arrangements have now been made to allow outsiders like yourself to enter Varlamore. However, this is an inhospitable route into the kingdom. I'd suggest you find an alternate way to travel.
translation: 嗯，现在已经安排好让像你这样的外人进入瓦拉莫尔了。不过，这是进入王国的一条不友好的路线。我建议你找其他交通方式。

english: Just passing through.
translation: 只是路过。

english: Fair enough.
translation: 好吧。

english: If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: 如果我和你一样丑，我都不敢在公共场合露面！

english: Out of my way, punk.
translation: 让开，小混混。

english: Hmm... you smell strange...
translation: 嗯……你闻起来很奇怪……

english: Strange how?
translation: 怎么奇怪？

english: Like a human!
translation: 像人类！

english: Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: 哦！呃……我刚吃了一个所以！

english: Leave me alone.
translation: 别烦我。

english: Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: 如果你珍惜生命就别再跟我说话！

english: Get lost!
translation: 滚开！

english: I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: 我没什么能给你的所以别烦我，乞丐。

english: Have you no manners?
translation: 你没有礼貌吗？

english: I don't have time for this right now.
translation: 我现在没时间应付这个。

english: I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: 我没兴趣和像你这样可怜的肉袋说话。

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
translation: 我打赌你有漂亮的爪子。

english: A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: 真是悲惨的一天啊……趁还能享受就享受吧。

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: 如果你抓到任何人答应我你会分享。

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
translation: 我之前没在这里闻到过你……

english: You smell familiar...
translation: 你闻起来很熟悉……

english: Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: 这附近有看到人类吗？我非——常饿。

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: 你看起来也是个嗜血之人。

english: Good day to you, my friend.
translation: 祝你日安，我的朋友。

english: Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
translation: 想去城堡吃点零食吗？

english: Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
translation: 等一下，我牙缝里卡了点人肉渣……

english: I cannot speak to you outerlander! Talk to Brundt, the Chieftain!
translation: 我不能和你说话外乡人！去找酋长布伦特！

english: You stay away from me outerlander!
translation: 你离我远点外乡人！

english: They are too suspicious of you for you to get close enough to steal from them.
translation: 他们对你太警惕了，你没法靠近到能偷东西的程度。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Hello again [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. What need you of me this day? You can always rely on my assistance!
translation: 又见面了 [兄弟/姐妹][Fremennik name]。今天你需要我什么？你随时可以依靠我的帮助！

english: Nothing thanks. I just fancied a chat.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。我只是想聊聊。

english: My door is always open should you ever need my help [Fremennik name].
translation: 如果你需要我的帮助随时来找我[Fremennik name]。

english: [Fremennik name]... It has been too long since last we met!
translation: [Fremennik name]……我们上次见面已经过去太久了！

english: Welcome back [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It is always a pleasure to see you here!
translation: 欢迎回来 [兄弟/姐妹][Fremennik name]。见到你总是很高兴！

english: My apologies [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! I have not time to tarry here with you!
translation: 抱歉 [兄弟/姐妹][Fremennik name]！我没时间在这里陪你！

english: That's okay, I didn't really want anything.
translation: 没关系，我其实没什么想要的。

english: How are you [Fremennik name]? I hope all fares well with you this day!
translation: 你好吗[Fremennik name]？希望你今天一切顺利！

english: I'm fine, thanks, how are you?
translation: 我很好谢谢，你好吗？

english: All is well with me also!
translation: 我也一切都好！

english: Hello to you, too!
translation: 也向你问好！

english: Hello. Did you want something [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你好。你想要什么吗[Fremennik name]？

english: No, not really.
translation: 不，没什么。

english: Well... okay then!
translation: 好吧……那好吧！

english: Always good to see you [brother/sister] [Fremennik name].
translation: 总是很高兴见到你 [兄弟/姐妹][Fremennik name]。

english: You shame us, [Fremennik name]!
translation: 你让我们蒙羞，[Fremennik name]！

english: How can you steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你怎么能偷我的东西，[Fremennik name]？

english: You have betrayed your heritage, [Fremennik name]!
translation: 你背叛了你的传承，[Fremennik name]！

english: Why would you try to steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你为什么要试图偷我的东西，[Fremennik name]？

english: Ah, another fan! Hello!
translation: 啊，又一个粉丝！你好！

english: Er... Who are you?
translation: 呃……你是谁？

english: You don't know me? I am Bosun Zarah!
translation: 你不认识我？我是水手长扎拉！

english: I won twelfth place in the Etceteria Boatswain Championships!
translation: 我在埃西特利亚水手长锦标赛中获得了第十二名！

english: I mopped the deck on the fastest ship to complete the Kourend Circuit!
translation: 我在完成库兰德环线的最快船上拖过甲板！

english: I was one of only three survivors on the first ship to almost damage the Sharhai!
translation: 我是第一艘差点损坏沙尔海号的船上仅有的三名幸存者之一！

english: I see...
translation: 我明白了……

english: Well, at some point I hope to be hiring a crew of my own. When that happens, you seem like you have all the... qualifications... needed to join.
translation: 嗯，我希望有一天能雇佣自己的船员。到那时，你似乎具备所有……资格……可以加入。

english: Great! Don't take too long though, as I'm sure plenty of others will be wanting to try and recruit me first!
translation: 太好了！但别太久，因为我肯定很多人会想先招募我！

english: You need a Sailing level of 40 to manage a crew.
translation: 你需要40级航海才能管理船员。

english: Given your... skills... would you like to join my crew?
translation: 鉴于你的……技能……你想加入我的船员吗？

english: Ha! You can't command the legendary Bosun Zarah!
translation: 哈！你指挥不了传奇水手长扎拉！

english: You require the following to recruit this crew member: Level 80 Sailing. Completion of Royal Trouble. Completion of the Easy, Medium and Hard Fremennik Achievement Diaries.
translation: 你需要以下条件才能招募这名船员：80级航海。完成王室麻烦任务。完成简单、中等和困难的费明尼克成就日志。

english: Anything for another shot at the Sharhai!
translation: 只要能再有机会挑战沙尔海号什么都行！

english: You recruit Bosun Zarah as a crew member. She heads off in search of your boat.
translation: 你招募了水手长扎拉作为船员。她出发去寻找你的船。

english: Well, good luck with it all.
translation: 嗯，祝一切顺利。

english: Thank you!
translation: 谢谢！

english: Ah, one of my fans is back! Hello!
translation: 啊，我的一个粉丝回来了！你好！

english: Sorry, who are you again?
translation: 抱歉，你又是谁来着？

english: Bosun Zarah of course! Boatswain Championships... Kourend Circuit... The list is endless!
translation: 当然是水手长扎拉！水手长锦标赛……库兰德环线……清单无穷无尽！

english: Ah, yes, of course...
translation: 啊，是的，当然……

english: Captain!
translation: 船长！

english: Hello there. How are you enjoying being part of the crew?
translation: 你好。作为船员感觉怎么样？

english: I suppose the real question is how are you enjoying having me as part of your crew?
translation: 我想真正的问题是作为船长有我在船员中感觉怎么样？

english: It's fine I suppose, thanks for asking.
translation: 我想还不错，谢谢关心。

english: You are welcome, Captain!
translation: 不客气，船长！

english: Sometimes I even impress myself.
translation: 有时候连我自己都佩服自己。

english: Let me know when we reach the Sharhai.
translation: 我们到达沙尔海号时告诉我。

english: You don't want me doing anything so I don't show up the rest of the crew, right?
translation: 你不想让我做什么事以免我让其他船员相形见绌，对吧？

english: I was born for this.
translation: 我为此而生。

english: Given your... skills... would you like to join my crew?
translation: 鉴于你的……技能……你想加入我的船员吗？

english: Well, good luck with it all.
translation: 嗯，祝一切顺利。

english: You drink the bottle of fishtongue tonic.
translation: 你喝下那瓶鱼舌补剂。

english: Glub blub blub glub glub, glub glub blub.
translation: 咕噜 bub bub 咕噜咕噜，咕噜咕噜 bub。

english: Blub blub glub, gulp!
translation: Bub bub 咕噜，咕嘟！

english: Glub.
translation: 咕噜。

english: Blub! Glub gulp blub!
translation: Bub！咕噜咕嘟 bub！

english: Glub, blub glup!
translation: 咕噜，bub 咕噜！

english: Gulp.
translation: 咕嘟。

english: Blub.
translation: Bub。

english: Hey, friend of Snowflake!
translation: 嘿，雪花的朋友！

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: We met at entry gate, remember? Boulder sent you away, 'cos we not trust humans here in Weiss, an' also you sound crazy. But you our friend now, an' you always welcome.
translation: 我们在入口大门见过，记得吗？巨石把你赶走了，因为我们在魏斯聚落不信任人类，而且你听起来很疯狂。但你现在是我们的朋友，随时欢迎。

english: Boulder used to guard entry gate, but now Snowflake trusted Boulder with important farming job. Much more fun.
translation: 巨石过去守卫入口大门，但现在雪花信任巨石做重要的农场工作。有趣多了。

english: Boulder gotta grow goutweed for tribe, an' also make sure your herbs stay healthy. Snowflake's husband troll very strict on it.
translation: 巨石必须为部落种植痛风草，还要确保你的草药保持健康。雪花的巨魔丈夫对此很严格。

english: Tell me about this place.
translation: 跟我讲讲这个地方。

english: This here is Weiss. Trolls built it years ago, after we got kicked out from caves further south. Now Weiss is our home.
translation: 这里是魏斯聚落。巨魔们多年前建造了它，在我们被从更南边的洞穴赶出来之后。现在魏斯聚落是我们的家。

english: It great here, now Snowflake an' her husband troll taught us goutweed farming. Food so much better now.
translation: 这里很好，现在雪花和她的巨魔丈夫教我们种植痛风草。食物现在好多了。

english: Do you like it here?
translation: 你喜欢这里吗？

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it getting better. Snowflake, she taught us goutweed farming. Goat, wolf, human all taste so much nicer with goutweed in.
translation: 呃，有点艰苦，但正在变好。雪花教我们种植痛风草。山羊肉、狼肉、人肉加了痛风草都好吃多了。

english: So yeah, Weiss is good place to live, now Snowflake in charge. All trolls like Snowflake. Her husband troll kinda weird, but that not our problem.
translation: 所以是的，魏斯聚落是个好地方，现在雪花负责。所有巨魔都喜欢雪花。她的巨魔丈夫有点怪，但那不是我们的问题。

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我走了。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Tell me about this place.
translation: 跟我讲讲这个地方。

english: Do you like it here?
translation: 你喜欢这里吗？

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我走了。

english: Hi! What are you up to?
translation: 嗨！你在做什么？

english: Watering the pretty flowers, you want to help?
translation: 给漂亮的花浇水，你想帮忙吗？

english: I don't have time to water flowers, I have people to save!
translation: 我没时间浇花，我有人要救！

english: Pft, you should take time to enjoy the simple things.
translation: 呸，你应该花时间享受简单的事物。

english: I'm not a simple person.
translation: 我不是个简单的人。

english: So it seems.
translation: 看来如此。

english: Hi, I...
translation: 嗨，我……

english: What are you doing here, Fremennik?!
translation: 你在这里做什么，费明尼克人？！

english: I have a seal of pass...
translation: 我有通行证……

english: No you do not! Begone!
translation: 不你没有！滚开！

english: The player is teleported back to Rellekka
translation: 玩家被传送回雷勒卡城

english: Ooops. Suppose I need a seal of passage when I'm walking around that island.
translation: 哎呀。我想我在那座岛上走动时需要通行证。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: A fair day, traveller. Would you like to see my wares?
translation: 天气不错，旅行者。想看看我的商品吗？

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: I'd like to ask you about magic crossbows.
translation: 我想问问你关于魔法弩的事。

english: Ahh crossbows. Not exactly what I'd call skilled ranging, but I guess dwarven engineering is good, what did you want to know?
translation: 啊弩。不算是我所说的专业远程，但我想矮人工艺还不错，你想了解什么？

english: The dwarves don't work with magic logs, I'm wondering if you know how to make a crossbow out of them?
translation: 矮人不使用魔法原木，我想知道你是否知道如何用它们制作弩？

english: As it happens, a recent discovery of dragon limbs has allowed the creation of such a crossbow.
translation: 碰巧的是，最近发现的龙肢让制作这种弩成为可能。

english: That's fantastic!
translation: 太棒了！

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Okay good day to you.
translation: 好的祝你日安。

english: I don't... however I will look into it when I get spare time, for now you'll have to stick with the dwarven way of doing things.
translation: 我不……不过我有空时会研究一下，现在你只能用矮人的方式做事。

english: Ok, perhaps one day in the future I'll get to make magic crossbows!
translation: 好的，也许将来有一天我能制作魔法弩！

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: I'd like to ask you about magic crossbows.
translation: 我想问问你关于魔法弩的事。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Hello! Have you come to take part in the festivities?
translation: 你好！你是来参加庆典的吗？

english: I should set up a moleyball court next, the king of all ball-based sports.
translation: 我接下来应该建一个鼹鼠球场，所有球类运动之王。

english: What was that?
translation: 那是什么？

english: Oh nothing. Just thinking out loud.
translation: 哦没什么。只是自言自语。

english: Alright I'll leave you to it then.
translation: 好吧那我不打扰你了。

english: The Easter Bunny is looking awfully glum this year.
translation: 今年的复活节兔子看起来非常沮丧。

english: Perhaps we can help raise the Easter spirits?
translation: 也许我们能帮忙提升复活节的气氛？

english: You want to do some necromancy... To cheer up the Easter Bunny?
translation: 你想做死灵法术……来让复活节兔子高兴？

english: No no no! It's just a figure of speech.
translation: 不不不！只是比喻而已。

english: I just wonder if we could do anything to help.
translation: 我只是想知道我们能做什么来帮忙。

english: Leave it to me boss.
translation: 交给我吧老板。

english: I happen to know the E.B. is a big fan of bowling. In fact, he used to be a wizard on the lanes. A champion!
translation: 我碰巧知道复活节兔子是保龄球的忠实粉丝。事实上，他曾经是球道上的巫师。一个冠军！

english: I also happen to have the ability to...
translation: 我也碰巧有能力……

english: ...Rig the game in his favour.
translation: ……操纵比赛让他赢。

english: Which is handy, he's very out of practise nowadays.
translation: 这很有用，他现在很生疏了。

english: Won't he suspect something?
translation: 他不会怀疑什么吗？

english: Oh no! You see, I have these gears set up just here.
translation: 哦不会！你看，我在这里设置了这些装置。

english: Wait, are you just trying to get my trade secrets?
translation: 等等，你只是想套取我的商业机密？

english: This is strictly a humanitarian effort!
translation: 这纯粹是人道主义努力！

english: Bun-itarian..?
translation: 兔道主义……？

english: Look, I just want to get Easter back on track.
translation: 听着，我只是想让复活节回到正轨。

english: You can keep your hustle going, I just want to help the Easter Bunny.
translation: 你可以继续你的把戏，我只是想帮助复活节兔子。

english: Oh alright, since I do owe the big softie. But I've got my whiskers on you!
translation: 哦好吧，既然我确实欠那个大软蛋。但我会盯着你的！

english: So, what is it you wanted to show me, [player name]?
translation: 那么，你想给我看什么，[player name]？

english: Well, Bowley here let me in on your secret. Bowling champion three years in a row.
translation: 嗯，这里的波利告诉了我你的秘密。连续三年保龄球冠军。

english: Oh. Those were the days, I haven't partaken for while now though...
translation: 哦。那是过去的日子了，我已经很久没参与了……

english: I just haven't had the spring in my step with my egg responsibilities.
translation: 只是有了产蛋责任后我就没那种活力了。

english: Well, here's your chance!
translation: 嗯，这是你的机会！

english: What do you mean? It's hardly fun without decent competition.
translation: 你什么意思？没有像样的对手没什么好玩的。

english: And nobody here quite likes bowling.
translation: 而且这里没人喜欢保龄球。

english: They what now?
translation: 他们什么现在？

english: I've only just gone and spent ages digging out this place and installing the machinery!
translation: 我才刚花了好长时间挖出这个地方并安装了设备！

english: Nothing to worry about I'm sure!
translation: 我相信没什么好担心的！

english: Ah Bowley, it is good to see you again.
translation: 啊波利，很高兴再次见到你。

english: Long Ears Johnson. Come to terrorise me pins again?
translation: 长耳约翰逊。又来恐吓我的品了吗？

english: We'll see about that.
translation: 我们拭目以待。

english: Oh yes, [player name] is apparently quite good.
translation: 哦是的，[player name] 显然很厉害。

english: It's been so long since I've had a decent set with a worthy opponent.
translation: 我已经很久没有和值得的对手好好比赛了。

english: Chin up bucko, I'm here and ready to challenge your rule of these alleys!
translation: 振作点伙计，我来了准备挑战你对这些球道的统治！

english: Well, I suppose I'm not doing anything else. Why not?
translation: 嗯，我想我也没别的事做。为什么不呢？

english: The player bowls down 3 carrot pins.
translation: 玩家击倒了3个胡萝卜球瓶。

english: A fine shot, but not quite enough!
translation: 好球，但还不够！

english: Watch this!
translation: 看这个！

english: The Easter Bunny bowls a strike.
translation: 复活节兔子击出了全中。

english: A lucky strike?
translation: 幸运的全中？

english: I'd better shape up or this will be quite one sided.
translation: 我最好振作起来不然这就太一边倒了。

english: And that would be no fun at all.
translation: 那就一点意思都没有了。

english: The player bowls down the middle 6 pins.
translation: 玩家击倒了中间6个瓶。

english: Ah, so you have some fight in you.
translation: 啊，所以你还有些斗志。

english: I could do this all day.
translation: 我可以打一整天。

english: That's exactly what I wanted to hear!
translation: 这正是我想听到的！

english: The screen fades black with the text "Some time later..."
translation: 屏幕渐黑显示文字''一段时间后……''

english: I'm surprised I hadn't heard about your prowess before, [player name].
translation: 我很惊讶之前没听说过你的实力，[player name]。

english: Ah you know me, the most modest adventurer in Gielinor.
translation: 啊你了解我，基利诺尔最谦虚的冒险者。

english: Ah, well I suppose I should pack it in while I'm ahead.
translation: 啊，嗯我想我应该在领先时收手。

english: But we should do this again.
translation: 但我们应该再来一次。

english: Aye we should! Also if you could get the word out about my establishment, I'll be raking it in!
translation: 是的我们应该！另外如果你能帮我宣传我的店，我会赚翻了！

english: I mean... The Rabbit Hole will enjoy all the visitors?
translation: 我是说……兔子洞会欢迎所有访客？

english: Well, anyway...
translation: 嗯，总之……

english: It was a close match. How are you feeling now?
translation: 比赛很激烈。你现在感觉怎么样？

english: Oh it was fun but I think I'm just going to sit in the Rabbit Hole a bit longer.
translation: 哦很有趣但我想我会在兔子洞再坐一会儿。

english: I should be off. Always a pleasure, Bowley.
translation: 我该走了。总是很愉快，波利。

english: Aye, till next time.
translation: 是的，下次见。

english: This is the Rabbit Hole.
translation: 这是兔子洞。

english: Who me? Nah I'm just a mole.
translation: 谁我？不我只是只鼹鼠。

english: Well that went well!
translation: 嗯进行得很顺利！

english: We may have gotten away with it!
translation: 我们可能蒙混过关了！

english: Oi, not so loud.
translation: 喂，别那么大声。

english: Don't worry I'm sure those excessively large ears are just for show!
translation: 别担心我相信那些超大的耳朵只是摆设！

english: Aye reyt.
translation: 是的没错。

english: He seems to have more of a spring in his step.
translation: 他看起来更有活力了。

english: But still not quite himself.
translation: 但还是不太像他自己。

english: I'll see if anyone else around here can help.
translation: 我看看这附近还有谁能帮忙。

english: With Long Ears Johnson looking a bit more chipper, hopefully we'll get the Egg deliveries finally.
translation: 长耳约翰逊看起来精神多了，希望我们终于能拿到彩蛋配送。

english: Hello Bowley, I didn't expect you up here!
translation: 你好波利，没想到你会来这里！

english: And why would that be? I deserve an Egg too, look how much I'm helping out!
translation: 凭什么？我也该得到一个彩蛋，看看我帮了多少忙！

english: Oh it's just bright is all, we don't often get moles here on the surface.
translation: 哦只是阳光太刺眼了，我们鼹鼠很少到地面上来。

english: Hm yes, I could do with something to keep the sun out of my eyes.
translation: 嗯是的，我需要点什么来挡住阳光。

english: A new machine perhaps that could lift a whole load of earth and hold it over my head!
translation: 也许需要台新机器，能举起一整块土举在我头顶上！

english: Well enjoy that thought!
translation: 那你就慢慢想吧！

english: The Easter Bunny is looking awfully glum this year.
translation: 今年的复活节兔子看起来非常沮丧。

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Talk about bowling.
translation: 聊聊保龄球。

english: Hello young man.
translation: 你好年轻人。

english: The boy sobs.
translation: 男孩抽泣着。

english: What's the matter?
translation: 怎么了？

english: I've kicked my ball over that hedge, into that garden! The old lady who lives there is scary... She's locked the ball in her wooden shed! Can you get my ball back for me please?
translation: 我把球踢过树篱，掉进那个花园了！住在那里的老太太很凶……她把球锁在她的木棚里了！你能帮我把球拿回来吗？

english: Ok, I'll see what I can do.
translation: 好的，我看看能做什么。

english: Thanks mister!
translation: 谢谢先生！

english: Get it back yourself.
translation: 自己去拿回来。

english: You're a meany!
translation: 你真小气！

english: The boy starts crying again.
translation: 男孩又开始哭了。

english: Well if you're not going to answer, I'll go.
translation: 好吧，如果你不回答，我走了。

english: The boy sniffs slightly.
translation: 男孩轻轻吸了吸鼻子。

english: Thank you for getting my ball back!
translation: 谢谢你帮我把球拿回来！

english: What's the matter?
translation: 怎么了？

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: No.
translation: 不是。

english: Well if you're not going to answer, I'll go.
translation: 好吧，如果你不回答，我走了。

translation: 我叫艾梅里修士，我是来自遥远瓦拉莫尔土地的旅行僧侣，正在揭开这座神庙秘密的旅途中。

english: I worship Ralos, a common practice where I am from. However, I found out that our order may have originated from this temple. If you find anything of interest, please let me know.
translation: 我崇拜拉洛斯，这在我家乡很常见。不过，我发现我们的教团可能起源于这座神庙。如果你发现任何有趣的东西，请告诉我。

english: I'll keep my eyes open.
translation: 我会留意的。

english: You have my gratitude. Any information you do find would also be of interest to the Arceuus Library. I hope we can uncover the secrets of this place for the greater good.
translation: 你得到我的感激。你发现的任何信息也会让阿西乌斯图书馆感兴趣。我希望我们能为更大的利益揭开这个地方的秘密。

english: The greater good.
translation: 更大的利益。

english: How did you get injured?
translation: 你怎么受伤的？

english: I found out about this place from Logosia in the Arceuus Library. I came to investigate but was ambushed by the spiders in the room to the north.
translation: 我从阿西乌斯图书馆的洛戈西亚那里了解到这个地方。我来调查但在北边的房间里被蜘蛛伏击了。

english: I'm a scholar not a fighter. I didn't have time to think through my options so I did what came naturally and ran away.
translation: 我是学者不是战士。我没时间考虑选择所以做了本能反应——逃跑。

english: Why didn't you decide to run back the way you came from instead of running further into the dungeon where there could be more dangerous creatures?
translation: 你为什么决定不跑回来时的路，而是跑进可能有更危险生物的地牢深处？

english: See, the problem with that... Is that it is an excellent idea I wish I had thought of at the time.
translation: 看，问题在于……那是个极好的主意，我希望当时能想到。

english: You've been trapped here for a while! No wonder you were hungry!
translation: 你被困在这里一段时间了！难怪你饿了！

english: I found a strange creature possessing an adventurer within the dungeon and it has cursed one of the altars. Do you know how I can remove it?
translation: 我在地牢里发现一个奇怪生物附身了一个冒险者，它诅咒了其中一个祭坛。你知道我怎么移除它吗？

english: How strange. Tell me, what did the creature look like?
translation: 真奇怪。告诉我，那生物长什么样？

english: It was a dark black creature with a white skull on its head and curved horns.
translation: 它是个深黑色的生物，头上有白色头骨和弯曲的角。

english: Let me see... According to my notes that appears to have been a Shaeded Beast, a vile creature which posseses people and corrupts their minds.
translation: 让我看看……根据我的笔记那似乎是影缚兽，一种附身人类并腐蚀他们心灵的邪恶生物。

english: Only the power of Ralos can remove such a curse. I suggest making an offering to Ralos somewhere within this temple.
translation: 只有拉洛斯的力量能移除这种诅咒。我建议在这座神庙内某处向拉洛斯献祭。

english: What kind of sacrifice should I offer?
translation: 我应该献什么样的祭品？

english: As Ralos is the sun god, any normal bone just won't do. I'd recommend the bones of any dragon.
translation: 由于拉洛斯是太阳神，普通骨头不行。我推荐任何龙的骨头。

english: I'd advise staying away from the altar in the mean time.
translation: 我建议你暂时远离祭坛。

english: Thanks. I'll have a look around.
translation: 谢谢。我去看看。

english: I received a key from the bone burner but unfortunately I have lost it.
translation: 我从焚骨者那里收到一把钥匙但不幸弄丢了。

english: The great Ralos foresaw this and presented me with the same key for safe-keeping should you lose it.
translation: 伟大的拉洛斯预见了这一点，给了我同样的钥匙保管，以防你弄丢。

english: That's awfully convenient!
translation: 那太方便了！

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。

english: Disgusting! I don't know why you have that, I'd destroy them before they have a chance to hatch.
translation: 恶心！我不知道你为什么有那个，我会在它们有机会孵化前毁掉它们。

english: Actually, I believe they're used as supplies in potion making, they might have some use.
translation: 其实，我相信它们被用作药水制作的材料，可能有用。

english: Do with it as you wish, just don't come crawling back to me if it comes back to bite you.
translation: 随你便，只是如果它反过来咬你，别爬回来找我。

english: I see what you did there.
translation: 我明白你做了什么。

english: Hmm, interesting. I recall seeing a chest to the west of here further down the passage with colouring similar to this key. Perhaps this key opens that chest?
translation: 嗯，有趣。我记得在更远处的通道西边看到一个箱子，颜色和这把钥匙相似。也许这把钥匙能打开那个箱子？

english: Thanks for your help!
translation: 谢谢你的帮助！

english: My, you adventurer'sare a strange bunch. I suppose there is a reason why you have kept the creatureseyes in a jar?
translation: 天，你们冒险者真是奇怪的一群。我想你把生物眼睛保存在罐子里是有原因的？

english: I'm not sure myself, though I've heard some people like to display items like this in their house.
translation: 我自己也不确定，虽然我听说有些人喜欢在家里展示这样的物品。

english: As I said, you are a strange bunch indeed.
translation: 正如我所说，你们确实是一群奇怪的人。

english: That looks like the legs of Sarachnis, bound together by her web. I suppose if anything, it looks heavy enough to crush your enemies.
translation: 那看起来像是萨拉克尼斯的腿，被她的网绑在一起。我想如果有的话，它看起来足够重可以压碎你的敌人。

english: Hey, let go of me! What are you doing?
translation: 嘿，放开我！你在做什么？

english: It talks?
translation: 它会说话？

english: Yeah, I killed Sarachnis and she started following me, I think she's cute so I've decided to keep her around.
translation: 是的，我杀了萨拉克尼斯她开始跟着我，我觉得她很可爱所以决定留着她。

english: Do as you wish. I've certainly seen people keep worse company than a spider.
translation: 随你便。我确实见过有人结交比蜘蛛更糟的伙伴。

english: Oh, very interesting. This page appears to be taken from a religious script which speaks of Ranul.
translation: 哦，很有趣。这一页似乎来自讲述拉努尔的宗教经文。

english: This is very sad. To see such religious scripts desecrated, it's blasphemy!
translation: 这很悲伤。看到这样的宗教经文被亵渎，这是亵渎！

english: Perhaps the script still exists?
translation: 也许经文还存在？

english: Yes, yes! I hope so. I would expect a temple of this nature to have a library of sorts within it. Maybe the original is somewhere within it.
translation: 是的，是的！希望如此。我期望这种性质的神庙内会有某种图书馆。也许原件就在里面某处。

english: I'll have a look for it. Thanks for your help!
translation: 我去找找。谢谢你的帮助！

english: Oh, very interesting. This page appears to be taken from a religious script which speaks of Ralos.
translation: 哦，很有趣。这一页似乎来自讲述拉洛斯的宗教经文。

english: Oh, very interesting. This page appears to be taken from a historical script about the temple itself.
translation: 哦，很有趣。这一页似乎来自关于神庙本身的历史文献。

english: This is very sad. To see such information desecrated in this way.
translation: 这很悲伤。看到这样的信息被这样亵渎。

english: No! Keep that away from me! I can sense an ominous power coming from that coin. Where did you find it?
translation: 不！把它拿远点！我能感觉到那枚硬币散发出不祥的力量。你在哪里找到的？

english: A fellow adventurer I met within the temple had it on him. What should I do with it?
translation: 我在神庙里遇到的一个冒险者身上有这个。我该怎么处理它？

english: I'd find out where it came from and put it back immediately.
translation: 我会找出它从哪里来并立即放回去。

english: The markings on it resemble that of the cult of Ranul, I'd look around for something of religious significance to them.
translation: 上面的标记类似于拉努尔邪教的，我会在周围寻找对他们有宗教意义的东西。

english: Fascinating. I'm not quite sure what this is for, perhaps there are doors within the temple which this unlocks?
translation: 迷人。我不太确定这是用来做什么的，也许神庙内有门能用这个打开？

english: Amazing! This is exactly what I was looking for. This tome contains information about the religion of Ranul.
translation: 太棒了！这正是我在找的。这本典籍包含关于拉努尔宗教的信息。

english: Oh, it appears that there are some pages missing from it. The missing information could prove valuable.
translation: 哦，似乎缺了一些页。缺失的信息可能很有价值。

english: Where do you think the missing pages are?
translation: 你认为缺失的页在哪里？

english: This Temple has been abandoned for some time. Maybe the creatures within have destroyed the tome while looking for food. You may have to kill them to recover the pages.
translation: 这座神庙已被废弃一段时间了。也许里面的生物在寻找食物时破坏了典籍。你可能需要杀死它们来找回书页。

english: The book seems to be intact! I'm sure Logosia in the Arceuus Library to the north would find this information valuable.
translation: 书似乎是完整的！我相信北边阿西乌斯图书馆的洛戈西亚会发现这些信息很有价值。

english: Amazing! This is exactly what I was looking for. This tome contains information about the religion of Ralos.
translation: 太棒了！这正是我在找的。这本典籍包含关于拉洛斯宗教的信息。

english: Amazing! This is exactly what I was looking for. This tome contains information about the temple itself.
translation: 太棒了！这正是我在找的。这本典籍包含关于神庙本身的信息。

english: I'm afraid I don't know anything about that item.
translation: 恐怕我对那个物品一无所知。

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: How did you get injured?
translation: 你怎么受伤的？

english: Ask about the cursed altar.
translation: 询问被诅咒的祭坛。

english: Ask about the Temple Key
translation: 询问神庙钥匙

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。

english: Very nice rosebushes you have here.
translation: 你这里的玫瑰丛很漂亮。

english: Yes, it has taken me many long hours in this garden to bring them to this state of near-perfection.
translation: 是的，我在这个花园里花了很多长时间才把它们培育到这种近乎完美的状态。

english: Hello, brother. Could you help me with a quest, please?
translation: 你好，兄弟。你能帮我做个任务吗？

english: Yes, certainly. I'll help if I can. Which quest would you like help with?
translation: 是的，当然。我会尽力帮忙。你想让我帮哪个任务？

english: Are you a member of the Group of Advanced Gardeners?
translation: 你是高级园丁公会的成员吗？

english: Fairy Tale Part I - Growing Pains
translation: 童话故事第一部——成长的烦恼

english: Garden of Tranquility
translation: 宁静花园

english: Good day, brother.
translation: 你好，兄弟。

english: Hello, I'm Brother Brace. I'm here to tell you all about Prayer.
translation: 你好，我是布雷斯修士。我来告诉你关于祈祷的一切。

english: You should open the indicated menu to continue.
translation: 你应该打开指示的菜单继续。

english: This is your Prayer list. Prayers can help a lot in combat. Click on the prayer you wish to use to activate it, and click it again to deactivate it.
translation: 这是你的祈祷列表。祈祷在战斗中很有帮助。点击你想使用的祈祷来激活它，再次点击来停用。

english: Active prayers will drain your Prayer Points, which you can recharge by finding an altar or other holy spot and praying there.
translation: 激活的祈祷会消耗你的祈祷点数，你可以通过找到祭坛或其他圣地并在那里祈祷来补充。

english: As you noticed, most enemies will drop bones when defeated. Burying bones, by clicking them in your inventory, will gain you Prayer experience.
translation: 你注意到了，大多数敌人被击败时会掉落骨头。通过点击物品栏中的骨头来埋葬它们，会获得祈祷经验。

english: I'm also the community officer 'round here, so it's my job to tell you about your friends and ignore lists.
translation: 我也是这里的社区官员，所以告诉你好友和忽略列表是我的工作。

english: Right. Now I'll tell you a little about each list. You can add people to either list by clicking the add button then typing their name into the box that appears.
translation: 好的。现在我来告诉你每个列表。你可以通过点击添加按钮然后在出现的框中输入他们的名字来将人添加到任一列表。

english: You remove people from the lists in the same way. If you add someone to your ignore list they will not be able to talk to you or send any form of message to you.
translation: 你用同样的方式从列表中移除人。如果你将某人添加到忽略列表，他们将无法与你交谈或向你发送任何形式的消息。

english: Your friends list shows the online status of your friends. Friends in red are offline, friends in green are online and on the same world and friends in yellow are online, but on a different world.
translation: 你的好友列表显示你好友的在线状态。红色好友离线，绿色好友在线且在同一世界，黄色好友在线但在不同世界。

english: Okay, thanks, I'll bear that in mind.
translation: 好的，谢谢，我会记住的。

english: Peace be with you, my child. Can I help you?
translation: 愿平安与你同在，我的孩子。我能帮你吗？

english: Ah, yes, your prayer list. Prayers can help a lot in combat. Click on the prayer you wish to use to activate it, and click it again to deactivate it.
translation: 啊，是的，你的祈祷列表。祈祷在战斗中很有帮助。点击你想使用的祈祷来激活它，再次点击来停用。

english: Do you need anything else?
translation: 你还需要什么吗？

english: Your friends and ignore lists, yes... I'll tell you a little about each. You can add people to either list by clicking the add button then typing their name into the box that appears.
translation: 你的好友和忽略列表，是的……我来告诉你每个列表。你可以通过点击添加按钮然后在出现的框中输入他们的名字来将人添加到任一列表。

english: Nope, I'm ready to move on!
translation: 不，我准备好继续了！

english: Okay then.
translation: 好吧。

english: Tell me about Prayers again.
translation: 再跟我讲讲祈祷吧。

english: Tell me about my friends list again.
translation: 再跟我讲讲我的好友列表吧。

english: Nope, I'm ready to move on!
translation: 不，我准备好继续前进了！

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Honey, money, woman and wine!
translation: 蜂蜜、金钱、女人和美酒！

english: Are you ok?
translation: 你没事吧？

english: Yesshh...hic up...beautiful!
translation: 是……嗝……太美了！

english: Take care old monk.
translation: 保重，老僧侣。

english: La..di..da..hic..up!
Brother Omad sends you his thanks! He won't be in a fit state to thank you in person.
translation: 奥玛德修士向你致谢！他现在醉得厉害，没法亲自感谢你。

english: What can you do to help a bold adventurer like myself?
translation: 你能为像我这样勇敢的冒险者做些什么？

english: I can tell you about holy symbols or the Skillcape of Prayer.
translation: 我可以跟你讲讲圣徽或者祈祷技能斗篷。

english: Tell me about holy symbols.
translation: 跟我讲讲圣徽吧。

english: If you have a silver star, which is the holy symbol of Saradomin, then I can bless it. Then if you are wearing it, it will help you when you are praying.
translation: 如果你有一枚银星，也就是萨拉多明的圣徽，我可以为它祝福。佩戴它后，祈祷时它会帮助你。

english: Tell me about the Skillcape of Prayer.
translation: 跟我讲讲祈祷技能斗篷吧。

english: The Skillcape of Prayer is the hardest of all the skillcapes to get; it requires much devotion to acquire but also imbues the wearer with the ability to briefly fly!
translation: 祈祷技能斗篷是所有技能斗篷中最难获得的；它需要极大的虔诚才能获取，但也能赋予穿戴者短暂飞行的能力！

english: The Cape of Prayer also increases the amount of Prayer points restored from drinking potions when it is equipped. Is there something else I can do for you?
translation: 装备祈祷斗篷后，饮用药水恢复的祈祷点数也会增加。还有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: No thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Well I can bless that star of Saradomin you have, or I could tell you about the Skillcape of Prayer!
translation: 我可以为你那枚萨拉多明之星祝福，或者跟你讲讲祈祷技能斗篷！

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。
