english: You give Jered the symbol. Jered closes his eyes and places his hand on the symbol. He softly chants. Jered passes you the holy symbol.
translation: 你把圣徽交给杰瑞德。杰瑞德闭上眼睛，把手放在圣徽上，轻声吟唱。杰瑞德把圣徽递还给你。

english: Well, seeing as you are so devout in praising the gods, I could sell you a Skillcape of Prayer, which increases the amount of Prayer points restored when drinking potions.
translation: 既然你如此虔诚地赞美诸神，我可以卖给你一件祈祷技能斗篷，它能增加饮用药水时恢复的祈祷点数。

english: Yes, please. So few people have Skillcapes of Prayer!
translation: 好的，谢谢。拥有祈祷技能斗篷的人太少了！

english: One as pious as you has certainly earned the right to wear one, but the monastery requires a donation of 99000 coins for the privilege.
translation: 像你这样虔诚的人当然有资格穿戴它，但修道院要求捐赠99,000金币才能获得这份殊荣。

english: No thanks, I can't afford one of those.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我买不起。

english: I am sorry to hear that. If you should find yourself in wealthier times come back and see me.
translation: 很遗憾听到这个。等哪天你手头宽裕了，再来找我吧。

english: I am always happy to contribute towards the monastery's upkeep.
translation: 我一直很乐意为修道院的维护出一份力。

english: But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: 但不幸的是，我身上没带够钱。

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.
translation: 嗯，等你有钱了再来找我。

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 不幸的是，所有技能斗篷都附带免费兜帽，这是技能促销活动的部分；买一送一嘛。所以你得先腾出一些物品栏空间，我才能卖给你。

english: Excellent! Wear that cape with pride my friend.
translation: 太好了！自豪地穿上这件斗篷吧，我的朋友。

english: Praise be to Saradomin!
translation: 赞美萨拉多明！

english: Yes! Praise he who brings life to this world.
translation: 是的！赞美赐予这个世界生命的神明。

english: I'm here to help with Oziach!
translation: 我是来帮忙对付奥齐亚克的！

english: That is great, thank you! Speak to me downstairs in my office though, I don't have the paperwork up here.
translation: 太好了，谢谢！不过请到楼下我的办公室找我，文件不在这里。

english: Hi Brother Jered!
translation: 你好，杰瑞德修士！

english: I hear Oziach has been scared, thank you! And thank your friend too.
translation: 我听说奥齐亚克被吓跑了，谢谢！也谢谢你的朋友。

english: Iffie? She helped a lot, I need to go and give her the reward I promised.
translation: 伊菲？她帮了大忙，我得去给她我承诺的报酬。

english: You better go and do that then, thanks again!
translation: 那你最好赶紧去吧，再次感谢！

english: Hey Brother Jered!
translation: 嘿，杰瑞德修士！

english: Iffie had something she wanted to give you, you should talk to her.
translation: 伊菲有东西要给你，你应该去找她谈谈。

english: I will do that right away!
translation: 我这就去！

english: What can you do to help a bold adventurer like myself?
translation: 你能为像我这样勇敢的冒险者做些什么？

english: Tell me about holy symbols.
translation: 跟我讲讲圣徽吧。

english: Tell me about the Skillcape of Prayer.
translation: 跟我讲讲祈祷技能斗篷吧。

english: Yes, what else can you do for a bold adventurer like myself?
translation: 行，那还能为像我这样勇敢的冒险者做些什么？

english: No, thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Bless star, please.
translation: 请为圣徽祝福。

english: None of those, thanks.
translation: 都不需要，谢谢。

english: Yes, please. So few people have Skillcapes of Prayer!
translation: 好的，谢谢。拥有祈祷技能斗篷的人太少了！

english: I'm afraid I can't afford that.
translation: 恐怕我买不起。

english: I am always happy to contribute towards the monastery's upkeep.
translation: 我一直很乐意为修道院的维护出一份力。

english: No thanks, I can't afford one of those.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我买不起。

english: Praise be to Saradomin!
translation: 赞美萨拉多明！

english: Talk about the Halloween event.
translation: 谈谈万圣节活动。

english: Hello Brother Jered, the monks in Varrock sent me. What is going on?
translation: 你好杰瑞德修士，维洛克城的修士们派我来的。发生什么事了？

english: Thank Saradomin that you came! We need help! Oziach is trying to buy the monastery!
translation: 感谢萨拉多明你来了！我们需要帮助！奥齐亚克想买下修道院！

english: What can I do to help?
translation: 我能帮什么忙？

english: We've tried everything, there is nothing!
translation: 我们试遍了所有办法，都没用！

english: Unless...
translation: 除非……

english: Are you any good at climbing trees?
translation: 你擅长爬树吗？

english: Pretty good, why?
translation: 还不错，怎么了？

english: Oziach is scared of ghosts! If you can climb a tree and make a scary noise, that might scare him off!
translation: 奥齐亚克怕鬼！如果你能爬上树发出可怕的声音，也许能吓跑他！

english: I see, I can give that a go! What should I make the scary noise with?
translation: 明白了，我可以试试！我该用什么发出可怕的声音？

english: How about one of these wine bottles? I have loads!
translation: 用这些酒瓶怎么样？我有很多！

english: I'm sure there's a perfectly sane explanation why.
translation: 我肯定这背后有个完全合理的解释。

english: I might have looked for a solution in them... And I found one, too!
translation: 我可能在酒里寻找过解决方案……而且还真找到了！

english: Take this wine bottle and climb the tree nearest Oziach, then blow on it to scare him!
translation: 拿着这个酒瓶，爬到离奥齐亚克最近的树上，然后对着它吹气吓他！

english: Brother Jered now has said to take the wine bottle.
translation: 杰瑞德修士让你拿走酒瓶。

english: Not a lot from down here, sorry, I'm currently dealing with this mess! Come and see me upstairs and I can assist you with your question there.
translation: 从这里帮不上什么忙，抱歉，我现在正忙着处理这烂摊子！上楼来找我，我可以在那里帮你解答问题。

english: I've lost the bottle, can I have another one please?
translation: 我把酒瓶弄丢了，能再给我一个吗？

english: You don't have any space for the bottle! Talk to me again once you have space.
translation: 你物品栏没空间放酒瓶了！等有空位再来找我。

english: There you go. You can blow into the top to make a spooky sound.
translation: 给你。你可以对着瓶口吹气发出诡异的声音。

english: Brother Jered now remembers the player has received his bottle at least once.
translation: 杰瑞德修士记得你至少拿过一次他的酒瓶。

english: If you're hiding up a tree when you do it, it should fool Oziach into thinking it's a ghost!
translation: 如果你躲树上这么做，应该能骗过奥齐亚克让他以为是鬼！

english: Would you like to try that now?
translation: 你想现在就试试吗？

english: There you go, try not to lose this one!
translation: 给你，这次尽量别弄丢了！

english: Would you like to try and scare Oziach now?
translation: 你想现在就试试吓跑奥齐亚克吗？

english: Brother Jered!
translation: 杰瑞德修士！

english: Hi [player name].
translation: 你好，[player name]。

english: Could I have another wine bottle? I dropped the other one.
translation: 能再给我一个酒瓶吗？我把另一个弄丢了。

english: Sure, I have plenty.
translation: 当然，我有很多。

english: Yes, let's scare Oziach!
translation: 好的，我们去吓奥齐亚克吧！

english: Be careful, make sure you don't get too close to him, or take too long, he'll be sure to spot you!
translation: 小心点，别离他太近，也别花太久时间，他肯定会发现你的！

english: Good luck!
translation: 祝你好运！

english: The camera fades to a cutscene.
translation: 镜头淡出至过场动画。

english: Not just yet.
translation: 还不是时候。

english: Okay, come back and talk to me when you're ready to try scaring Oziach!
translation: 好吧，等你准备好吓奥齐亚克时再来找我！

english: It didn't work!
translation: 没用！

english: Scaring Oziach? He wasn't scared?
translation: 吓奥齐亚克？他没被吓到？

english: No! He said one ghost wasn't enough! But I have a plan...
translation: 没有！他说一个鬼不够！但我有个计划……

english: A plan?
translation: 计划？

english: Yes! ONE ghost wasn't enough. We need more than one ghost. We need TWO ghosts!
translation: 对！一个鬼不够。我们需要不止一个鬼。我们需要两个鬼！

english: Will you be my accomplice and be the second ghost?
translation: 你愿意当我的帮手，做第二个鬼吗？

english: I would, but I don't feel too well from all the stress.
translation: 我愿意，但压力太大让我感觉不太舒服。

english: Are you sure it's not all the wine and food?
translation: 你确定不是因为酒和食物吃太多了？

english: What?
translation: 什么？

english: Nothing! That's okay, I hope you feel better soon!
translation: 没什么！没关系，希望你早点好起来！

english: I need to find an accomplice elsewhere, then. Do you have any ideas?
translation: 那我得去别处找帮手了。你有什么建议吗？

english: The price to place an advert is 500,000 coins. I've always had good responses to my ads in the past.
translation: 刊登广告的价格是500,000金币。过去我的广告总是反响不错。

english: 500,000 coins? That is quite a lot!
translation: 500,000金币？那可真不少！

english: Ah yes, don't worry about that. I have this pre-paid ad coupon you can use.
translation: 啊对，别担心这个。我有张预付广告券你可以用。

english: I bought an ad spot in the paper the other week. I was going to place an ad for recruiting some new monks.
translation: 我上周买了个报纸广告位。本来打算登广告招些新修士。

english: However with everything going on right now, I think this is more important.
translation: 不过鉴于目前的情况，我觉得这个更重要。

english: You don't have any space for the coupon! Talk to me again once you have space.
translation: 你物品栏没空间放券了！等有空位再来找我。

english: There's now a coupon waiting for the player.
translation: 现在有张券等着你来领取。

english: Here you go.
translation: 给，拿好。

english: The player can now talk to Benny about the Halloween event.
translation: 玩家现在可以和班尼谈谈万圣节活动了。

english: Thank you! You had me worried there that I was going to have to find 500,000 coins. I'll go and place the advert.
translation: 谢谢！刚才我还担心得去找500,000金币呢。我去登广告了。

english: Good luck, I hope you find a good accomplice!
translation: 祝你好运，希望你能找到好帮手！

english: I've lost the coupon, can I have another one please?
translation: 我把券弄丢了，能再给我一张吗？

english: Have you placed the advert in the Varrock Herald yet?
translation: 你在维洛克先驱报上登广告了吗？

english: Not yet.
translation: 还没有。

english: Don't wait too long, the purchase will go through soon!
translation: 别等太久，购买很快就生效了！

english: You can find Benny in the Varrock Square. You should talk to him about the ad.
translation: 你可以在维洛克广场找到班尼。你应该跟他谈谈广告的事。

english: I'll go and do that now!
translation: 我这就去！

english: Could I have another coupon before I go? I lost the other one.
translation: 走之前能再给我一张券吗？我把另一张弄丢了。

english: You don't need a coupon anymore!
translation: 你不再需要券了！

english: Here is a copy of it. I made it before I gave you the original, try not to lose this!
translation: 这是副本。我给你原件前就做好了，这次尽量别弄丢！

english: How is it going?
translation: 进展如何？

english: Well thanks, I've just placed the advert in the Herald.
translation: 挺好的谢谢，我刚在先驱报上登了广告。

english: Lovely! Where are you meeting the candidates?
translation: 太好了！你在哪里见应聘者？

english: At the Blue Moon Inn, I'm going to head there now.
translation: 在蓝月酒馆，我这就过去。

english: Hello [player name]. I thank you for helping us, we've been running out of ideas!
translation: 你好，[player name]。感谢你的帮助，我们快没主意了！

english: Hello! I saw an old lady sneaking around in the trees south of the monastery, that wouldn't be anything to do with you, would it?
translation: 你好！我看见有个老太太在修道院南边的树林里鬼鬼祟祟的，应该跟你没关系吧？

english: That sounds like Iffie, she is my accomplice! I'd be careful calling her an old lady!
translation: 那应该是伊菲，她是我的帮手！你叫她老太太可得小心点！

english: You found somebody! Great, good luck!
translation: 你找到人了！太好了，祝你好运！

english: I'll make sure not to say that to her face if we meet!
translation: 如果我们见面，我一定不当面这么说！

english: Hello there!
translation: 你好！

english: Hello, Brother Jered!
translation: 你好，杰瑞德修士！

english: Hello! I was just passing by and saw you both in here.
translation: 你好！我刚好路过，看见你们俩在这里。

english: I'd like to thank you Iffie, and you [player name]. You both saved the monastery.
translation: 我要感谢你们，伊菲，还有你，[player name]。你们俩救了修道院。

english: That means more than you can imagine!
translation: 这意义远超你们的想象！

english: It was really no problem, if anything, it was rather fun!
translation: 真的没什么，要说有什么的话，还挺有趣的！

english: Yes, very fun! I haven't had such an adventure in years!
translation: 是的，非常有趣！我好多年没经历过这样的冒险了！

english: Well, I am glad you both enjoyed it! I do have something for you, [player name]...
translation: 很好，很高兴你们俩都玩得开心！我确实有东西给你，[player name]……

english: It's not a reward as such, but it is interesting. I've been tidying up my office since I don't need it anymore.
translation: 这不算什么奖励，但挺有趣的。既然我不再需要办公室了，我一直在整理。

english: And in doing so, I found this old bottle.
translation: 整理时，我发现了这个旧瓶子。

english: Is that... a ghost, inside? It's haunted?!
translation: 那是……里面有鬼？闹鬼了？！

english: Yes! There is a ghost inside, it's trapped! Would have been handy to have earlier on, really. Would have been very scary for Oziach!
translation: 对！里面有个鬼，被困住了！早点拿到就派上用场了。对奥齐亚克来说肯定很可怕！

english: But the monastery is saved, so I don't need it anymore. I'd like you to have it!
translation: 但修道院已经得救，所以我不再需要它了。我想把它给你！

english: Thank you. What do I do with it?
translation: 谢谢。我该怎么用它？

english: Not a lot really. I did shake it earlier and the ghost got pretty angry with me, so I'd probably avoid doing that too much.
translation: 其实没什么用。我之前摇过它，里面的鬼对我很生气，所以我建议你别太频繁这么做。

english: It does seem quite chatty for a ghost, although it doesn't always make sense.
translation: 这鬼话还挺多的，虽然不总有道理。

english: There you go. Now I'll be off, I've got a monastery to look after!
translation: 给你。我得走了，还得照看修道院呢！

english: See you later Brother Jered!
translation: 回头见，杰瑞德修士！

english: Ask for another bottle.
translation: 再要一个瓶子。

english: Yes, let's scare Oziach!
translation: 好的，我们去吓奥齐亚克吧！

english: Not just yet.
translation: 还不是时候。

english: Talk about something else.
translation: 谈谈别的。

english: Ask for another ad coupon.
translation: 再要一张广告券。

english: Hello monk.
translation: 你好，修士。

english: Hello adventurer. My name is Brother Kojo. Do you happen to know the time?
translation: 你好，冒险者。我叫科乔修士。你知道现在几点了吗？

english: No, sorry, I don't.
translation: 不知道，抱歉。

english: Exactly! This clock tower has recently broken down, and without it nobody can tell the correct time. I must fix it before the town people become too angry!
translation: 没错！这座钟楼最近坏了，没有它没人知道准确时间。我得在镇民太生气之前修好它！

english: I don't suppose you could assist me in the repairs? I'll pay you for your help.
translation: 你能帮我修理吗？我会付你报酬。

english: OK old monk, what can I do?
translation: 好的，老僧侣，我能做什么？

english: Oh, thank you kind [sir/madam]! In the cellar below, you'll find four cogs. They're too heavy for me, but you should be able to carry them one at a time.
translation: 哦，谢谢你这位好心的 [sir/madam]！在下面的地窖里，你会找到四个齿轮。它们对我来说太重了，但你应该能一次搬一个。

english: I know one goes on each floor... but I can't exactly remember which goes where specifically. Oh well, I'm sure you can figure it out fairly easily.
translation: 我知道每层楼放一个……但我记不清具体哪个放哪里了。不过我相信你很容易就能弄明白。

english: Well, I'll do my best.
translation: 好吧，我尽力而为。

english: Thank you again! And remember to be careful, the cellar is full of strange beasts!
translation: 再次感谢！记得小心点，地窖里到处都是奇怪的野兽！

english: Not now old monk.
translation: 现在不行，老僧侣。

english: OK then. Come back and let me know if you change your mind.
translation: 好吧。如果你改变主意，再来告诉我。

english: Hello again Brother Kojo.
translation: 又见面了，科乔修士。

english: Oh hello there traveller. You've done a grand job with the clock. It's just like new.
translation: 哦你好，旅行者。你把钟修得很好。跟新的一样。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Hello, traveller, how can I help?
translation: 你好，旅行者，我能怎么帮你？

english: I'm trying to learn how to be a navigator.
translation: 我想学习如何成为领航员。

english: I don't know if I can help you there.
translation: 我不知道能不能帮上你。

english: The professor from the Observatory says that I need a watch.
translation: 天文台的教授说我需要一块手表。

english: Ah, that I can help you with. I've been tinkering with this new idea of a watch and made a few. The problem is the villagers don't see the point as they have the Clock Tower!
translation: 啊，这个我能帮你。我一直在研究手表这个新玩意儿，做了几个。问题是村民们觉得没必要，因为他们有钟楼！

english: Can I have one?
translation: 能给我一个吗？

english: You can have this one! It's the display model.
translation: 这个可以给你！这是展示品。

english: Ah! Here you go!
translation: 啊！给，拿着！

english: What?
translation: 什么？

english: I need you to answer this for me.
translation: 我需要你帮我回答这个问题。

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
translation: 请输入问题的答案。

english: How can that be? Go check again!
translation: 怎么会这样？再去确认一下！

english: You really clocked that one!
translation: 你真是说到点子上了！

english: Yes.
translation: 是。

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: The blessings of Saradomin be with you child.
translation: 愿萨拉多明的祝福与你同在，孩子。

english: Hello there, What's wrong?
translation: 你好，怎么了？

english: *yawn*...oh, hello...*yawn* I'm sorry! I'm just so tired! I haven't slept in a week!
translation: (打哈欠) 哦，你好……(打哈欠) 抱歉！我太累了！我已经一周没睡觉了！

english: Why can't you sleep, what's wrong?
translation: 你为什么睡不着，怎么了？

english: It's brother Androe's son! With his constant: Waaaaaah! Waaaaaaaaah! Androe said it's natural, but it's so annoying!
translation: 是安德鲁修士的儿子！他一直哭：哇啊啊！哇啊啊啊！安德鲁说这很正常，但太烦人了！

english: I suppose that's what kids do.
translation: 我想小孩子都这样吧。

english: He was fine, up until last week! Thieves broke in! They stole his favourite sleeping blanket!
translation: 他之前都好好的，直到上周！小偷闯进来了！偷走了他最喜欢的睡觉毯子！

english: Now he won't rest until it's returned... ...and that means neither can I!
translation: 现在毯子不找回他就不会休息……也就意味着我也不能休息！

english: Can I help at all?
translation: 我能帮上忙吗？

english: Please do. We won't be able to help you as we are peaceful men but we would be grateful for your help!
translation: 请一定帮忙。我们是和平之人帮不上你，但我们会感激你的帮助！

english: Where are they?
translation: 他们在哪里？

english: They hide in a secret cave in the forest. It's hidden under a ring of stones. Please, bring back the blanket!
translation: 他们躲在森林里的一个秘密洞穴里。藏在一圈石头下面。拜托，把毯子带回来！

english: I'm sorry to hear that! I hope you find his blanket.
translation: 听到这个我很遗憾！希望你能找到他的毯子。

english: Sorry! I'm too busy to hear your problems!
translation: 抱歉！我太忙了没时间听你的问题！

english: Dum dee do la la! *hiccup* That was some party!
translation: 嘟嘀嘟啦啦！(打嗝 ) 那派对真棒！

english: Ah! Here you go!
translation: 啊！给，拿着！

english: What?
translation: 什么？

english: I need you to answer this for me.
translation: 我需要你帮我回答这个问题。

english: Brother Omad has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 奥玛德修士给了你一个挑战卷轴！

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
translation: 请输入问题的答案。

english: How can that be? Go check again!
translation: 怎么会这样？再去确认一下！

english: Spot on!
translation: 完全正确！

english: Why can't you sleep, what's wrong?
translation: 你为什么睡不着，怎么了？

english: Can I help at all?
translation: 我能帮上忙吗？

english: I'm sorry to hear that! I hope you find his blanket.
translation: 听到这个我很遗憾！希望你能找到他的毯子。

english: Sorry! I'm too busy to hear your problems!
translation: 抱歉！我太忙了没时间听你的问题！

english: Excuse me...
translation: 打扰一下……

english: Yes? Can I help you?
translation: 什么事？我能帮你吗？

english: Sorry to have bothered you; I'm looking for a more experienced adventurer.
translation: 抱歉打扰你；我在找更有经验的冒险者。

english: How's your head feeling?
translation: 你头感觉怎么样？

english: A lot better, thanks. Can I help you with anything?
translation: 好多了，谢谢。有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: This washed up on the beach earlier. I thought you could get it fixed by Smithing Smith in Mos Le'Harmless. It could be valuable.
translation: 这是之前冲上岸的。我想你可以找莫斯‧勒哈姆莱斯的铁匠史密斯修好它。可能很有价值。

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

english: Not really. I was just popping by to see how you were all getting on and possibly help cull some of the zombies.
translation: 没什么。我只是顺道来看看你们过得怎么样，顺便帮忙清理些僵尸。

english: Your concern is most gratifying. Saradomin be with you.
translation: 你的关心令人欣慰。愿萨拉多明与你同在。

english: Would you like me to take you to Harmony?
translation: 你想让我送你去和谐岛吗？

english: Yes, please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: The player is teleported to Harmony Island.
translation: 玩家被传送至和谐岛。

english: Not at the moment, thanks.
translation: 暂时不用，谢谢。

english: Do you want me to take you back to Mos Le'Harmless?
translation: 你想让我送你回莫斯‧勒哈姆莱斯吗？

english: The player is teleported to Mos Le'Harmless.
translation: 玩家被传送至莫斯‧勒哈姆莱斯。

english: Ah! Here you go!
translation: 啊！给，拿着！

english: What?
translation: 什么？

english: I need you to answer this for me.
translation: 我需要你帮我回答这个问题。

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
translation: 请输入问题的答案。

english: How can that be? Go check again!
translation: 怎么会这样？再去确认一下！

english: Spot on!
translation: 完全正确！

english: Yes, please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Not at the moment, thanks.
translation: 暂时不用，谢谢。

english: I'm too important to talk to the likes of you, leave.
translation: 我太重要了，没空跟你这种人说话，走吧。

english: My secretary will deal with any inquiries you have about the Brown Engine.
translation: 我的秘书会处理你对布朗引擎公司的任何询问。

english: My secretary is sitting just over there, thank you.
translation: 我的秘书就坐在那边，谢谢。

english: I'm busy, please leave.
translation: 我很忙，请离开。

english: Today is not a good day, can you come back tomorrow?
translation: 今天不太方便，你明天再来好吗？

english: If you're looking for the market, it's downstairs.
translation: 如果你在找市场，它在楼下。

english: Do you mind? You're blocking my view.
translation: 你介意吗？你挡住我的视线了。

english: How did you get in here? I don't have time to talk to you!
translation: 你怎么进来的？我没时间跟你说话！

english: I can't help you, go and see my secretary.
translation: 我帮不了你，去找我的秘书。

english: Talk to my secretary, I don't have time to deal with you.
translation: 去找我的秘书，我没空理你。

english: But...
translation: 但是……

english: I said go!
translation: 我叫你走！

english: I told you to leave, human!
translation: 我叫你离开，人类！

english: What can I do for you, human?
translation: 人类，我能为你做什么？

english: Can I help you with anything?
translation: 有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: Was there anything you wanted?
translation: 你有什么事吗？

english: What did you need of the White Chisel?
translation: 你需要白凿子公司什么？

english: Is there anything you need assistance with?
translation: 有什么需要我协助的吗？

english: And what can I do for you?
translation: 有什么能帮你的？

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: I am the head secretary of the White Chisel.
translation: 我是白凿子公司的首席秘书。

english: The what?
translation: 什么公司？

english: The Brown Engine. We are one of the eight major mining companies, and one of the finest if I do say so myself!
translation: 布朗引擎公司。我们是八大矿业公司之一，而且是最优秀的之一，容我自夸一下！

english: Where am I?
translation: 我在哪里？

english: These are the offices of the Brown Engine.
translation: 这里是布朗引擎公司的办公室。

english: This is the official residence of the Brown Engine.
translation: 这里是布朗引擎公司的官方驻地。

english: Why, you are in the headquarters of the Brown Engine.
translation: 哎呀，你在布朗引擎公司的总部。

english: We share this floor of the palace with the other companies of the Consortium. And trade with them on the Trade Octagon.
translation: 我们和其他财团公司共用这层楼。在贸易八角场跟他们交易。

english: The Trade Octagon?
translation: 贸易八角场？

english: See those traders out there, just out the door? They're all standing in the Trade Octagon. There's an awful lot of trade going on in the palace, you know.
translation: 看到门外那些商人了吗？他们都站在交易八角广场里。要知道，宫殿里的交易可繁忙着呢。

english: Anything else of interest in the palace?
translation: 宫里还有什么有趣的地方吗？

english: You will have to find that out on your own, I'm afraid. I do have more work to do.
translation: 恐怕你得自己去发现了。我还有工作要做。

english: Goodbye, human.
translation: 再见，人类。

english: See you later.
translation: 回头见。

english: Okay.
translation: 好的。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Where am I?
translation: 我在哪里？

english: Is there anything I can help you with?
translation: 有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: I have to go!
translation: 我得走了！

english: Hello, and welcome to the Grand Exchange! How can I help you?
translation: 你好，欢迎来到大交易所！我能怎么帮你？

english: Could I have a starter pack?
translation: 能给我一个新手包吗？

english: Here you go. One starter pack. Enjoy.
translation: 给，好好用你的新手包。

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: This is the Grand Exchange, the best trading spot in the land! People come from all across the country to buy and sell every item under the sun.
translation: 这里是大交易所，全国最好的交易场所！人们从全国各地来这里买卖各种物品。

english: When you want to buy or sell an item, talk to the clerks in the middle. They'll tell you how to set up a trade offer.
translation: 想买卖物品时，跟中间的职员谈谈。他们会告诉你如何设置交易报价。

english: Now, is there something I can do for you?
translation: 现在，有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: Let's talk about where I respawn when I die.
translation: 我们来谈谈我死后在哪里复活。

english: You're currently due to respawn somewhere else. Would you rather respawn here, at the Grand Exchange, instead.
translation: 你目前会在别处复活。你愿意改在这里，也就是大交易所复活吗？

english: Yes, I'd like to respawn at the Grand Exchange.
translation: 是的，我想在大交易所复活。

english: Okay, you can respawn here when you die. Let me know if you change your mind.
translation: 好的，你死后可以在这里复活。如果改变主意告诉我。

english: No thanks, leave me alone.
translation: 不用了谢谢，别管我。

english: You're currently due to respawn here, at the Grand Exchange.
translation: 你目前会在大交易所这里复活。

english: I'd rather respawn in Lumbridge.
translation: 我更想在仑桥镇复活。

english: Please yourself. You will now respawn in Lumbridge when you die. Let me know if you change your mind.
translation: 随你便。你现在死后会在仑桥镇复活。如果改变主意告诉我。

english: Okay, respawning here sounds great.
translation: 好的，在这里复活听起来不错。

english: Can you tell me the price of an item?
translation: 你能告诉我物品的价格吗？

english: What had you in mind?
translation: 你想问什么？

english: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

english: Ask for a starter pack.
translation: 要一个新手包。

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: Let's talk about where I respawn when I die.
translation: 我们来谈谈我死后在哪里复活。

english: Yes, I'd like to respawn at the Grand Exchange.
translation: 是的，我想在大交易所复活。

english: No thanks, leave me alone.
translation: 不用了谢谢，别管我。

english: I'd rather respawn in Lumbridge.
translation: 我更想在仑桥镇复活。

english: Okay, respawning here sounds great.
translation: 好的，在这里复活听起来不错。

english: Can you tell me the price of an item?
translation: 你能告诉我物品的价格吗？

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

english: Greetings outerlander!
translation: 你好，外乡人！

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: This place? Why, this is Rellekka! Homeland of all Fremennik! I do not recognise your face outerlander; Where do you come from?
translation: 这个地方？哎呀，这里是雷勒卡城！所有费明尼克人的故乡！我不认识你的脸，外乡人；你从哪里来？

english: That's not important...
translation: 那不重要……

english: Hmmm... I will not press the issue then outerlander. How may my tribe and I help you?
translation: 嗯……那我就不追问了，外乡人。我和我的部落能怎么帮你？

english: Do you have any quests?
translation: 你有什么任务吗？

english: Quests, you say outerlander? Well, I would not call it a quest as such, but if you are brave of heart and strong of body, perhaps...
translation: 任务，你说吗，外乡人？嗯，我不太会称之为任务，但如果你勇气可嘉、身体强壮，也许……

english: No, you would not be interested. Forget I said anything, outerlander.
translation: 不，你不会感兴趣的。当我没说过，外乡人。

english: Actually, I would be very interested to hear what you have to offer.
translation: 其实，我很想听听你有什么提议。

english: You would? These are unusual sentiments to hear from an outerlander! My suggestion was going to be that if you crave adventure and battle,
translation: 真的吗？从一个外乡人嘴里听到这种话真不寻常！我本来想说的是，如果你渴望冒险和战斗，

english: and your heart sings for glory, then perhaps you would be interested in joining our clan, and becoming a Fremennik yourself?
translation: 内心向往荣耀，那你可能会有兴趣加入我们的部落，自己成为费明尼克人？

english: What would that involve exactly?
translation: 那具体需要做什么？

english: Well, there are two ways to become a member of our clan and call yourself a Fremennik: be born a Fremennik, or be voted in by our council of elders.
translation: 嗯，成为我们部落成员并称自己为费明尼克人有两种方式：生来就是费明尼克人，或者被长老议会投票接纳。

english: Well, I think I've missed the first way, but how can I get the council of elders to vote to let me join your clan?
translation: 嗯，我想我错过了第一种方式，但我怎么才能让长老议会投票让我加入你们的部落呢？

english: Well, that I cannot answer myself. You will need to speak to each of them and see what they require of you as proof of your dedication.
translation: 嗯，这个我自己回答不了。你需要跟每位长老谈谈，看看他们要求你提供什么作为忠诚的证明。

english: There are twelve council members around this village; you will need to gain a majority vote of at least seven councillors in your favour.
translation: 这个村子周围有十二位议会成员；你需要获得至少七位议员的支持票。

english: So what say you? Give me the word, and I will tell all of my tribe of your intentions, be they yea or nay.
translation: 那你怎么说？给我个答复，我就告诉全族你的意图，无论他们同意还是反对。

english: I think I would enjoy the challenge of becoming an honorary Fremennik. Where and how do I start?
translation: 我想我会享受成为荣誉费明尼克人的挑战。从哪里开始，怎么开始？

english: As I say outerlander, you must find and speak to the twelve members of the council of elders, and see what tasks they might set you.
translation: 正如我说的，外乡人，你必须找到并与十二位长老议会成员交谈，看看他们会给你什么任务。

english: If you can gain the support of seven of the twelve, then you will be accepted as one of us without question.
translation: 如果你能获得十二位中七位的支持，那你就会毫无疑问地被接纳为我们的一员。

english: No way do I want to become like YOU! Forget you, and forget your whole stupid town! You're a bunch of stupid primitives, from what I've seen!
translation: 我才不想变得像你们一样！忘了你，忘了你们整个愚蠢的镇子！据我所见，你们就是一群愚蠢的原始人！

english: I am sorry to say that I expected such a response from an outerlander. I thought perhaps you might have been different to all the others...
translation: 很遗憾我预料到外乡人会有这种反应。我还以为你或许跟其他人不一样……

english: You're right. I really couldn't care less.
translation: 你说得对。我真的毫不在乎。

english: It is as I thought outerlander. Your kind care nothing for the Fremennik, and we feel the same about you. This is the way of the world.
translation: 正如我所料，外乡人。你们这种人不在乎费明尼克人，我们对你们也一样。这就是世道。

english: Why will no-one talk to me?
translation: 为什么没人跟我说话？

english: Do not take it personally, outerlander! We are a simple people, and it is our experience that keeping ourselves to ourselves is best. This is why speaking to outerlanders is forbidden.
translation: 别往心里去，外乡人！我们是单纯的民族，根据我们的经验，独善其身是最好的。这就是为什么禁止与外乡人交谈。

english: We do not wish to enter war with the outerlanders and their strange magics, so we limit all unauthorised communication.
translation: 我们不想与外乡人及其奇怪魔法开战，所以我们限制所有未经授权的交流。

english: Then how come you're talking to me?
translation: 那你为什么跟我说话？

english: Ah, this is because I am the chieftain. I am the one who authorises contact. You will not find many of my tribe so forthcoming with you, as I.
translation: 啊，这是因为我是酋长。我是授权接触的人。你不会发现我部落里有太多人像我这样对你坦诚。

english: Is there a way for you to authorise your tribe to talk to me then?
translation: 那你有办法授权你的部落跟我说话吗？

english: Well, there is one way... but I doubt it is of any interest to you.
translation: 嗯，有一个办法……但我怀疑你不会有兴趣。

english: Yes.
translation: 是。

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: Why do you call me outerlander?
translation: 你为什么叫我外乡人？

english: Do not take it as an insult, outerlander. For us, this town is the center of all. Anyone not born here, or that we do not know and trust is an outerlander.
translation: 别把这当侮辱，外乡人。对我们来说，这个镇子是一切的核心。任何不是在这里出生，或者我们不认识和信任的人都是外乡人。

english: So it basically means stranger?
translation: 所以基本上就是陌生人的意思？

english: Aye, but that is an outerlander word. We do not judge someones ways by their name. It simply means one from the outerlands, or one not from Rellekka.
translation: 对，但那是外乡人的词。我们不会根据名字评判一个人的方式。这只是指来自外地的人，或者不是来自雷勒卡城的人。

english: I know our customs are foreign to you; perhaps you would like me to explain something else?
translation: 我知道我们的习俗对你来说很陌生；也许你想让我解释别的什么？

english: I seek an army to destroy Asgarnia!
translation: 我寻求一支军队摧毁阿斯加尼亚！

english: We will have no part in the squabbles of outerlander tribes. Their magics are strange and deadly to us, as we learnt long ago.
translation: 我们不会参与外乡人部落的纷争。他们的魔法对我们来说既奇怪又致命，我们很久以前就领教过了。

english: If this is all that you came here for, then you have had a wasted journey. If you are looking for something else, then speak now for my patience dwindles.
translation: 如果这就是你来这里的目的，那你白跑一趟了。如果你在找别的，现在就说话，因为我的耐心快没了。

english: Who are the Fremennik?
translation: 费明尼克人是谁？

english: It is the name we call ourselves. Outerlanders tend to call us 'Barbarian', but they do not understand our ways...
translation: 这是我们自称的名字。外乡人倾向于叫我们''野蛮人''，但他们不理解我们的方式……

english: Why will no-one talk to me?
translation: 为什么没人跟我说话？

english: Nice hat!
translation: 帽子不错！

english: Do not mock me outerlander; this helm has saved my life more times than I care to recall right now.
translation: 别嘲笑我，外乡人；这头盔救过我的命，次数多到我现在不想回忆。

english: As a matter of fact [Fremennik name], I do have a quest for you. Are you interested?
translation: 事实上，[Fremennik name]，我确实有个任务给你。你有兴趣吗？

english: I’m ready for adventure
translation: 我准备好冒险了

english: Excellent, now-
translation: 太好了，现在——

english: So what will it be this time? Joining warring islands?
translation: 那这次是什么？加入交战的岛屿？

english: I’m a fan of you enthusiasm, [Fremennik name], but-
translation: 我喜欢你的热情，[Fremennik name]，但是——

english: Would you have me slay a mighty daggermouth? Or do you need my expertise in conquering untamed lands?
translation: 你要我去斩杀强大的深潜者吗？还是需要我征服未开化之地的专业知识？

english: Nothing quite that fancy I’m afraid, [Fremennik name]. I just need you to investigate a minor disturbance.
translation: 恐怕没那么隆重，[Fremennik name]。我只需要你去调查一点小状况。

english: Oh.
translation: 哦。

english: Freygerd and Reeso run the sandpit a little north of here. They mentioned they heard some rustling by their hut lat night and wanted an official to investigate. You’ve proven yourself more than worthy of our people’s trust.
translation: 弗雷格德和里索经营着这里北边一点的沙坑。他们提到昨晚听到小屋附近有沙沙声，想要一位官员调查。你已经证明自己值得我们的信任。

english: Well that doesn’t sound so bad. I’ll get right on it.
translation: 嗯，听起来不算太糟。我这就去办。

english: Thank you, [Fremennik name].
translation: 谢谢你，[Fremennik name]。

english: Not right now.
translation: 现在不行。

english: Very well. Return when you wish to help.
translation: 很好。想帮忙时再回来。

english: Hi there Brundt the Chieftain. Could you help me out with a Seal of Passage?
translation: 你好，酋长布伦特。你能帮我弄个通行印章吗？

english: A Seal of Passage? Whatever for?
translation: 通行印章？用来做什么？

english: Well, I've heard that there have been great troubles between your people and that of the Moon Clan. I was hoping to help. And so I need the Seal of Passage to show my intentions.
translation: 嗯，我听说你们和月氏族出了大麻烦。我想帮忙。所以我需要通行印章来表明我的意图。

english: Ah [Fremennik name], many have tried, but The Moon Clan are by no means a sharing group of people. They do everything by magic, something we never use. But they are so secretive about it. If only they would share, we
translation: 啊，[Fremennik name]，很多人试过，但月氏族绝不是乐于分享的民族。他们什么都靠魔法，而我们从不用那玩意儿。但他们对此保密至极。要是他们愿意分享，我们

english: wouldn't have to kill them all the time!
translation: 就不用老是跟他们打打杀杀了！

english: I will see what I can do.
translation: 我会看看我能做什么。

english: Can I have that seal then?
translation: 那我能拿到印章吗？

english: If you are to bring peace to our two warring clans, then perhaps it is best that you do...
translation: 如果你要为我们两个交战的部落带来和平，那也许最好让你拿着……

english: Hi there.
translation: 你好。

english: Yes?
translation: 什么事？

english: I lost my Seal of Passage!
translation: 我把通行印章弄丢了！

english: Then you had better take a replacement and be less careless in future.
translation: 那你最好拿个新的，以后别这么粗心。

english: Well if it isn't [Fremennik name]. I've heard of your exploits in the Lunar Isles!
translation: 哎呀，这不是 [Fremennik name] 吗。我听说你在月亮群岛的壮举了！

english: Already? News really does travel fast!
translation: 这么快？消息传得真快！

english: Thank you so very much, I think we can really make progress now.
translation: 非常感谢你，我想我们现在真的能取得进展了。

english: No worries. I am pleased I could help.
translation: 别客气。很高兴能帮上忙。

english: Oh, erm, could you help me out with a Seal of Passage?
translation: 哦，呃，你能帮我弄个通行印章吗？

english: Seal of Passage, well I suppose so.
translation: 通行印章，嗯，我想可以。

english: Ok, here you go.
translation: 好的，给你。

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！

english: So how did the meeting go?
translation: 那会面进行得怎么样？

english: It went surprisingly well! We are at least at the point where we will freely acknowledge each other's existence now.
translation: 出乎意料地顺利！我们至少现在已经能坦然承认对方的存在了。

english: You are definitely a great asset to the Fremennik, [Fremennik name]!
translation: 你绝对是费明尼克人的宝贵财富，[Fremennik name]！

english: I've lost V's Shield.
translation: 我把 V 的盾牌弄丢了。

english: I don't think you have [Fremennik name]. I suggest you try looking for it again.
translation: 我觉得你没有弄丢，[Fremennik name]。我建议你再找找看。

english: You really should be more careful [Fremennik name]. Luckily for you I found it again but you'll have to pay to get it back.
translation: 你真该更小心点，[Fremennik name]。算你运气好我又找到了，但你得付钱才能拿回去。

english: How much?
translation: 多少钱？

english: 50,000 coins. Consider it a lesson in looking after things better.
translation: 50,000金币。就当是让你学学好好保管东西的教训。

english: Sounds good to me.
translation: 我觉得可以。

english: Here you go [Fremennik name]. Use it well.
translation: 给你，[Fremennik name]。好好用它。

english: That's a bit too much I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕有点太贵了。

english: Fair enough. I'll be here if you change your mind.
translation: 好吧。如果你改变主意，我在这里等你。

english: I don't have that much.
translation: 我没那么多钱。

english: Well come back when you do.
translation: 那等你有了再来吧。

english: Hello again [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! I hope your travels have brought you wealth and joy! What compels you to visit me on this day?
translation: 又见面了，[brother/sister][Fremennik name]！希望你的旅途带给你财富和欢乐！今天什么风把你吹来了？

english: I just came to say hello.
translation: 我只是来打个招呼。

english: Well met, [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It is always good to see your face in glorious Rellekka once more!
translation: 幸会，[brother/sister][Fremennik name]。能在光荣的雷勒卡城再次见到你总是好事！

english: Not at the moment [Fremennik name]. Rest assured, should your services to the Fremennik be required, I will call upon you.
translation: 暂时不需要，[Fremennik name]。放心，如果需要你为费明尼克人服务，我会找你。

english: Aye, that it is [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. Should you desire one of your own, you should go to Skulgrimen's shop and see what they have available!
translation: 是的，[brother/sister][Fremennik name]。如果你想要一个自己的，应该去斯库尔格里门的商店看看有什么可用的！

english: Can I hear the history of your people?
translation: 我能听听你们民族的历史吗？

english: Why, of course [Fremennik name]! Do not say 'your people' like that, for you are now a Fremennik yourself! What did you want to hear of?
translation: 哎呀，当然可以，[Fremennik name]！别那样说''你们民族''，因为你现在也是费明尼克人了！你想听什么？

english: I'm interested in finding out about that mysterious warrior I fought as part of Thorvalds' combat trial. His name is Koschei I believe.
translation: 我有兴趣了解我在托尔瓦尔德战斗试炼中对战的那位神秘战士。我记得他叫科斯切伊。

english: Ah... the deathless one... We do not even know if Koschei is his name, when we found him he had no memory, he was simply repeating that single word.
translation: 啊……不死者……我们甚至不知道科斯切伊是不是他的名字，我们发现他时他失去了记忆，只是不断重复那个词。

english: Whatever happened to him must have rattled his soul so hard that his memory ran away from him, and he has not yet found it'shiding place.
translation: 不管他经历了什么，一定把他的灵魂震得太厉害，连记忆都离他而去了，而他还没找到记忆藏在哪里。

english: So how exactly did you find him?
translation: 那你们到底是怎么发现他的？

english: Well, it was a raiding party like any other. We had just struck one of the smaller northern islands to harvest supplies by combat, as our laws allow,
translation: 嗯，那是一次普通的突袭队。我们刚袭击了北方一个小岛，通过战斗获取补给，这是我们的法律允许的，

english: when we saw a figure in the iceywaters. As we were at least a 3 week sail from any port, and saw no other ships nearby, he must have been there some time.
translation: 这时我们在冰水中看到了一个人影。我们离任何港口至少有3周航程，附近也没看到其他船只，他一定在那里待了一段时间。

english: We could not leave someone to the cold death of the ocean, even an outerlander, so we fished him aboard. He muttered continually, but his words made no sense.
translation: 我们不能把人丢下任由他被海水冻死，即使是外乡人，所以我们把他捞上船。他不停地咕哝，但说的话谁也听不懂。

english: He had no clothes or possessions with him, and seemed to have been burnt somehow before he had landed in the water.
translation: 他身上没有衣服或财物，而且似乎在落水前就被烧伤过。

english: I cannot help but wonder what burnt him, for as you may have seen, he is incredibly powerful and resistant to damage by any means I know of!
translation: 我不禁想知道是什么烧伤了他，因为正如你可能看到的，他异常强大，对我所知的任何攻击都免疫！

english: Anyway, we decided to bring him back to Rellekka, for he did not seem of good health or sound mind, and simply repeated the word Koschei over and over.
translation: 总之，我们决定把他带回雷勒卡城，因为他看起来身心都不太好，只是一遍又一遍地重复科斯切伊这个词。

english: Yrsa tended to him for many weeks, until one day it was as though a new soul had entered his burnt and broken body.
translation: 伊尔萨照顾了他好几周，直到有一天，仿佛有个新灵魂进驻了他那烧伤破碎的躯体。

english: He suddenly left her house one day, fully healed, and able to speak to us as though nothing had happened to him.
translation: 有一天他突然离开了她的房子，完全康复了，能够跟我们说话，仿佛什么都没发生过。

english: He still had no recollection of how he had come to be in the iceyocean, or of who he was, or where he had come from, but this did not matter to us or him.
translation: 他仍然不记得自己是怎么来到冰洋的，也不记得自己是谁、从哪里来，但这对我们和他来说都不重要。

english: He took his trials of adulthood, as you did, and has been a boon to our clan ever since. Someday I fear he may regain his memory, and leave us for his past...
translation: 他像你我一样完成了成年试炼，从那以后一直是我们氏族的得力帮手。我担心总有一天他会恢复记忆，为了追寻过去而离开我们……

english: But I will always respect any decision he decides to make should that day ever come upon us. Until then, he is more than welcome to stay here.
translation: 但如果那一天真的到来，我会尊重他做的任何决定。在那之前，他非常欢迎留在这里。

english: So, [Fremennik name]. Was there anything more you wished to hear?
translation: 那么，[Fremennik name]。还有什么你想听的吗？

english: I would like to hear of the lands across the ocean to the North.
translation: 我想听听海洋北方那片土地的事。

english: Well, I think the best thing for you would be to go to the docks and ask to join one of our longboats on a journey.
translation: 嗯，我觉得你最好去码头，请求加入我们的长船一起航行。

english: My affairs are concentrated mostly on Rellekka, so my knowledge is not great, but I will happily share what I do know with you [Fremennik name].
translation: 我的事务主要集中在雷勒卡城，所以我的知识有限，但我很乐意与你分享我所知道的，[Fremennik name]。

english: North of this town the atmosphere becomes bitterly cold. There are a number of small inhabited islands that we have sea routes with.
translation: 这个镇子以北，气候变得极其寒冷。那里有一些有人居住的小岛，我们有海上航线通往那里。

english: The largest of these is possibly Miscellania, although I hear that there has been some recent incident with their monarch, but I don't know the details.
translation: 其中最大的可能是米斯凯兰尼亚国，虽然我听说最近他们的君主出了点事，但我不知道细节。

english: There is also of course the island of the moon clan, who change with the tides. They are our bitterest enemies, and we are currently at war with them.
translation: 当然还有月氏族的岛屿，他们随潮汐而变化。他们是我们最痛恨的敌人，我们目前正在与他们交战。

english: They are an evil people, equally cursed and blessed by the magic in their blood. Beyond those islands, there is the large frozen wasteland we call Acheron.
translation: 他们是一个邪恶的民族，血液中的魔法既诅咒他们也祝福他们。那些岛屿之外，有一片广阔的冰冻荒原，我们称之为阿刻戎。

english: It is an inhospitable land, and you will need an agile and sturdy body just to keep alive in it's perils.
translation: 那是一片不毛之地，你需要敏捷强壮的身体才能在其险境中生存。

english: As I say, my knowledge outside of this town is rather limited, and I know no more than this. Was there anything else you wished to hear tell of?
translation: 正如我说的，我在这个镇子之外的知识相当有限，我知道的就这么多了。还有什么你想听的吗？

english: I would like to hear a little of the history between the Fremenniks and the outerlanders.
translation: 我想听听费明尼克人和外乡人之间的一点历史。

english: Ah, now that is something I know a great deal about. Believe it or not, all outerlanders were once orginally Fremenniks.
translation: 啊，这个我知道很多。信不信由你，所有外乡人原本都是费明尼克人。

english: When first man came to these lands all were Fremenniks, and followed our ways. We lived a happy life, and never settled in one place for long.
translation: 当初人类第一次来到这片土地时，所有人都是费明尼克人，遵循我们的方式。我们过着幸福的生活，从不在一个地方久居。

english: We travelled by boat along the coastlines, never taking more from the land than could be regrown by the same time in the following year.
translation: 我们乘船沿着海岸线航行，从不在土地上索取超过来年同期能再生的东西。

english: However, many moons past, some of our tribesmen were weary of constantly travelling the lands, and decided to build themselves permanent homes.
translation: 然而，许多个月过去后，我们的一些族人厌倦了不断四处漂泊，决定为自己建造永久的家园。

english: Unfortunately, the other races that had also migrated here did not like this. They waged war against us at every opportunity.
translation: 不幸的是，其他也迁徙到这里的种族不喜欢这样。他们一有机会就向我们开战。

english: We were driven mostly to the coastlines, where we could escape by boat when attacked. Remember, at this time we had no real way to defend against constant attack.
translation: 我们被赶到了海岸线一带，被攻击时可以乘船逃跑。记住，当时我们没有真正的方法抵御持续的攻击。

english: Then one day one of our Seers, whose name has been lost in the telling of this tale, discovered a cave full of strange rocks.
translation: 然后有一天，我们的一位先知(他的名字在故事流传中已经失传)发现了一个充满奇怪岩石的洞穴。

english: This rock would never be consumed, no matter how much we took, and sparkled at its peak, and broke off in small and regular sized chunks when mined.
translation: 这种岩石无论开采多少都不会耗尽，在矿脉顶端闪闪发光，开采时会断裂成小而规则的块。

english: Stranger than this, we found that these rocks would become filled with power when taken to certain places across this land!
translation: 更奇怪的是，我们发现这些岩石被带到这片土地的某些地方时会充满力量！

english: There was a terrible argument in our tribe! Some said that we should take as many of these rocks as we could, and use them in defending against our enemies attacks!
translation: 我们部落里为此爆发了激烈的争论！有人说我们应该尽可能多地开采这些岩石，用它们来抵御敌人的攻击！

english: Others said that we had found a place that belonged only to the gods, and that should we steal what was not ours we would find only torment and misery.
translation: 其他人说我们发现了一个只属于神明的地方，如果我们偷取不属于自己的东西，只会招致折磨和痛苦。

english: We voted on this, and decided that it was in the best interests of the tribe to leave these strange rocks where they lay, for the gods can be spiteful and cruel,
translation: 我们对此进行了投票，决定为了部落的最大利益，让这些奇怪的岩石留在原地，因为神明可能心胸狭隘且残忍，

english: especially to those who do not treat them with the respect they desire. Some of our number refused to accept this ruling by our council however.
translation: 尤其是对那些不以他们期望的方式尊敬他们的人。然而，我们中有些人拒绝接受议会的这项裁决。

english: They began to mine these rocks, and set up transport systems to the various places of power that enchanted them.
translation: 他们开始开采这些岩石，并建立运输系统通往各个赋予它们力量的地方。

english: They even created temples at each of these places! This was going too far! We had no choice, but to expel them from our tribe forever!
translation: 他们甚至在每个地方都建造了神庙！这太过分了！我们别无选择，只能永远将他们逐出部落！

english: We turned our backs upon them, and let them know they would never be welcome back to our tribes until they had released themselves from the rocks.
translation: 我们与他们决裂，让他们知道除非他们摆脱这些岩石，否则永远不欢迎他们回到我们的部落。

english: This is the tale of how the outerlanders came about; through stealing from the gods, and from betraying our ideals. This is why we show them no trust.
translation: 这就是外乡人如何产生的故事；通过偷窃神明，背叛我们的理想。这就是我们为什么不信任他们。

english: Was there something else you wished to hear?
translation: 还有什么你想听的吗？

english: Actually, history isn't really my thing.
translation: 其实，历史不是我的菜。

english: Well let me know should you wish to hear our lore and histories. We value them highly.
translation: 如果想听我们的传说和历史，随时告诉我。我们非常重视它们。

english: Sorry, but your trail is not over quite yet.
translation: 抱歉，但你的试炼还没结束。

english: Great...
translation: 太好了……

english: Find the answer to this question for me.
translation: 帮我找到这个问题的答案。

english: Brundt has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 酋长布伦特给了你一个挑战卷轴！

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
translation: 请输入问题的答案。

english: Wrong answer!
translation: 答案错误！

english: Perfect!
translation: 完美！

english: Brundt has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
translation: 酋长布伦特给了你 [another clue scroll/a casket]！

english: Do you have any quests?
translation: 你有什么任务吗？

english: Yes, I am interested.
translation: 是的，我有兴趣。

english: No, I'm not interested.
translation: 不，我没兴趣。

english: Why do you call me outerlander?
translation: 你为什么叫我外乡人？

english: I seek an army to destroy Asgarnia!
translation: 我寻求一支军队摧毁阿斯加尼亚！

english: Who are the Fremennik?
translation: 费明尼克人是谁？

english: Nice hat!
translation: 帽子不错！

english: Ask about a Seal of Passage
translation: 询问通行印章

english: Ask about the mountain camp.
translation: 询问山地营地。

english: Ask for a quest.
translation: 请求任务。

english: Ask about anything else.
translation: 询问其他事情。

english: Ask about a Seal of Passage.
translation: 询问通行印章。

english: Ask about V's Shield.
translation: 询问 V 的盾牌。

english: I just came to say hello.
translation: 我只是来打个招呼。

english: Can I hear the history of your people?
translation: 我能听听你们民族的历史吗？

english: Tell me of the finding of Koschei
translation: 告诉我科斯切伊的发现经过

english: Tell me of the lands to the North
translation: 告诉我北方土地的事

english: Tell me of the outerlanders
translation: 告诉我外乡人的事

english: Don't tell me anything
translation: 什么都别告诉我

english: What are you doing down here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Could you explain this place to me again?
translation: 你能再给我解释一下这个地方吗？

english: This here is the Gauntlet, the finest creation of the Amlodd clan. It was built years ago to help train Prifddinas' finest warriors and survivalists.
translation: 这里是试炼之路，阿姆洛德氏族最杰出的作品。它是多年前建造的，用于帮助训练普利夫迪纳斯最优秀的战士和生存专家。

english: Train?
translation: 训练？

english: That's right. The Gauntlet contains a range of deadly creatures formed from crystal. Defeating them is the key to victory, but it is no easy task.
translation: 没错。试炼之路包含一系列由水晶形成的致命生物。击败它们是胜利的关键，但这绝非易事。

english: This is because all participants start with nothing at hand beyond a few basic tools.
translation: 因为所有参与者开始时除了几件基本工具外两手空空。

english: But how do people fight without their gear?
translation: 但没有装备人们怎么战斗？

english: Resources can be gathered throughout the dungeon. These can be used to create the weapons, armour, food and potions needed to survive.
translation: 整个地下城都可以收集资源。这些可以用来制造生存所需的武器、盔甲、食物和药水。

english: Without any armour, those crystalline creatures can be real nasty. Any armour that you make down there will greatly reduce the damage they do to you.
translation: 没有任何盔甲，那些水晶生物会非常棘手。你在那里制作的任何盔甲都会大大减少它们对你造成的伤害。

english: Okay, I think I follow... But I thought this was all about combat, not just gathering my own equipment.
translation: 好的，我想我明白了……但我以为这完全是关于战斗的，不只是收集自己的装备。

english: That's right. Once you feel you're ready, or once we decide that you've spent long enough down there, you'll have to face the fearsome Crystalline Hunllef.
translation: 没错。等你觉得自己准备好了，或者我们觉得你在下面待得够久了，你就必须面对可怕的结晶汉勒夫。

english: And what makes it so dangerous, if it's just for training?
translation: 如果只是训练，为什么它这么危险？

english: Once you go down there, there are only two ways out... You can make a break for the exit, or if you're bested in combat we'll send someone in for you.
translation: 一旦你下去，只有两条出路……你可以冲向出口，或者如果你在战斗中被击败，我们会派人进去救你。

english: Things can be a little unstable down there at times, too... Everything gets corrupted, and it might be a little frightening, but it makes for a good challenge.
translation: 下面有时候情况也会有点不太稳定……一切都会被腐蚀，可能有点吓人，但这构成了很好的挑战。

english: The Corrupted Gauntlet can be accessed by rightclicking the entrance.
translation: 可以通过右键点击入口进入堕落试炼。

english: I think that covers it... Everything else, you'll have to work out for yourself while you're in there.
translation: 我想就这些了……其他的你得在里面自己摸索。

english: Okay... I think I've got it.
translation: 好的……我想我明白了。

english: You can always come back and ask me to go over things again.
translation: 你随时可以找我给你再讲一遍。

english: I'm thinking of giving the Gauntlet a go.
translation: 我想试试试炼之路。

english: You? Attempting the Gauntlet? If you say so!
translation: 你？挑战试炼之路？你说了算！

english: Just passing by.
translation: 只是路过。

english: Alright... Well be careful down here. I've got my eye on you.
translation: 好吧……在下面小心点。我盯着你呢。

english: Don't think you want to be heading down there without knowing what you're getting into! Come and see me, if you really want to go down there.
translation: 别在不知道要面对什么的情况下就下去！如果你真的想下去，来找我。

english: Don't think you can be taking any plus ones down there with you.
translation: 别想带任何人跟你一起下去。

english: There's something in that there chest waiting for you. Don't leave it for too long.
translation: 那个箱子里有东西在等你。别放太久。

english: Hey! Finish your fight before you come in here!
translation: 嘿！进来之前先打完你的战斗！

english: You know, if things start getting comfortable down there, things can be a little unstable at times.
translation: 你知道，如果下面开始变得舒适，有时候情况会有点不稳定。

english: It might be a little frightening, but it makes for a good challenge!
translation: 可能有点吓人，但这正是个不错的挑战！

english: Maybe I'll check it out at some point!
translation: 也许我什么时候会去试试！

english: The Corrupted Gauntlet can be accessed by right-clicking the entrance.
translation: 可以通过右键点击入口进入堕落试炼。

english: Could you explain this place to me again?
translation: 你能再给我解释一下这个地方吗？

english: I'm thinking of giving the Gauntlet a go.
translation: 我想试试试炼试炼。

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: Just passing by.
translation: 只是路过。

english: You's better talk to Dad, him chasey sneaky da chompy.
translation: 你最好去找爸爸，他追那个偷偷摸摸的贪吃兽。

english: Thanks for da chompy, it was deloverly!
translation: 谢谢你的贪吃兽，太好吃了！

english: A bug! Hahaha.
translation: 一只虫子！哈哈哈。

english: HAHAHAHAHA
translation: 哈哈哈哈哈哈

english: ...ahahaha
translation: ……啊哈哈

english: HA!
translation: 哈！

english: Ok... I'm done.
translation: 好了……我笑完了。

english: The bunny thinks you laughed at them and looks both angry and embarrassed.
translation: 兔子以为你在嘲笑它，看起来既生气又尴尬。

english: Oh, sorry. I didn't mean to turn you into a... Hot cross bunny!
translation: 哦，抱歉。我不是故意把你变成……热十字兔子的！

english: It's a bit rude of 'em to take up the whole bridge with their conversation, isn't it, mate?
translation: 他们占着整座桥聊天有点不礼貌吧，伙计？

english: Aye, mate, but wouldn't it be just as rude for us to interrupt?
translation: 是啊伙计，但我们打断他们不也一样不礼貌吗？

english: A good point well made, mate. Who are we to decide that the dig is more impor'ant than a personal disagreement between two people?
translation: 说得有理，伙计。我们凭什么断定挖掘工作比两个人之间的私人分歧更重要？

english: You're not wrong, mate. We often place matters of industry above those of people, and it's chippin' away at our ability to relate to each other on a human level.
translation: 你说得没错，伙计。我们常常把工作事务置于人情之上，这正在削弱我们人与人之间的情感联系。

english: What's going on here?
translation: 这里发生什么事了？

english: We're part of a dig into some ruins beneath Cam Torum, but the way's blocked by these folks.
translation: 我们是来挖掘卡姆托鲁姆城地下遗迹的，但路被这些人挡住了。

english: Have you tried asking them to move?
translation: 你们试过请他们让开吗？

english: We're considering the moral implications of doing exactly that, mate.
translation: 我们正在考虑这么做的道德影响，伙计。

english: Are you two philosophers?
translation: 你们两位是哲学家吗？

english: No mate, builders.
translation: 不是伙计，我们是建筑工。

english: But thinking, talking, discussing, it's what makes us human, mate.
translation: 但思考、交谈、讨论，这些才是让我们成为人类的东西，伙计。

english: It's not just humans that do those things.
translation: 不只是人类会做这些事。

english: Fair play, mate. I guess we're reflecting more on the condition of sen'ience in general then.
translation: 说得对，伙计。我想我们是在更广泛地反思感知意识的本质了。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Have a good one, mate.
translation: 祝你顺利，伙计。

english: Thanks for that, mate. You should speak to Jess inside. She'll be in the north of the city. She could use a problem solver like yourself.
translation: 谢了伙计。你应该进去找杰西。她在城北。她正需要你这样能解决问题的人。

english: Who's Jess?
translation: 杰西是谁？

english: She's the archaeologist in charge of the dig into these ruins they've found. Discovering the mysteries of the past and that.
translation: 她是负责挖掘这些遗迹的考古学家。就是探索过去之谜那类工作。

english: You should head inside, mate. Remember, Jess will be in the north of the city. She could use a problem solver like yourself.
translation: 你该进去了，伙计。记住，杰西在城北。她正需要你这样能解决问题的人。

english: To me!
translation: 敬我！

english: To you!
translation: 敬你！

english: Keep it down!
translation: 小声点！

english: G'day, mate.
translation: 你好啊，伙计。

english: I'm surprised to see you both in such high spirits after walking past all those jeering dwarves.
translation: 我很惊讶你们经过那些嘲笑的矮人后还能这么精神饱满。

english: Ah, well it's unfortunate, but no reason to be sad. It's them that ought to be sad.
translation: 啊，这确实不幸，但没必要难过。该难过的是他们。

english: Aye, mate. Livin' a life unable to connect with others because they look different must be miserable.
translation: 是啊伙计。因为长相不同而无法与他人交流的生活一定很痛苦。

english: We wish 'em the best. Hopefully their paths to personal growth are near and smooth.
translation: 我们祝福他们。希望他们的成长之路近在眼前且一帆风顺。

english: Thanks for taking care of those base camps, mate.
translation: 谢谢你照顾那些基地营地，伙计。

english: No problem. I hope there's no hard feelings over Jessamine asking me to do a part of your jobs.
translation: 没问题。希望杰萨明让我做部分你们的工作不会让你们介意。

english: That's no worries, mate, I've no issue admitting you're better cut out for building camps in dangerous dungeons than I am.
translation: 别担心伙计，我承认你比我更适合在危险的地下城里建造营地。

english: We may not be mul'i-disciplined adventurers like you, but we don't need to be. The world needs more than just heroes, don't it?
translation: 我们可能不像你那样是多面手冒险者，但我们不需要是。世界需要的不仅仅是英雄，对吧？

english: Aye, mate, I'm content and proud to just be a hard working, decent builder.
translation: 是啊伙计，我满足于做一个勤劳、正直的建筑工，并为此感到自豪。

english: Besides, without us, building supplies wouldn't be there in the first place. Life's all about working together.
translation: 况且，没有我们，建筑材料根本就不会到位。生活就是关于合作。

english: Glad to hear it. Keep up the good work then!
translation: 那就好。那继续加油吧！

english: You too, mate.
translation: 你也是，伙计。

english: You seem remarkably calm considering everything that's going on.
translation: 考虑到发生的一切，你看起来异常冷静。

english: Life's unpredictable, mate. No sense stressin' over what's out of your control.
translation: 生活难以预测，伙计。为无法控制的事情焦虑没有意义。

english: It's not like we're not aware of the danger we're in, but worryin' about it ain't productive.
translation: 我们不是不知道身处危险之中，但担心也无济于事。

english: Shouldn't you be getting out of here if you feel like you're in danger?
translation: 如果觉得危险，你们不应该离开这里吗？

english: We may not be in total control of our surroundings, but we can still impact them positively through our actions. Like bein' here to support you.
translation: 我们可能无法完全控制周围环境，但仍可以通过行动产生积极影响。比如在这里支持你。

english: Even if that's just emotionally. We believe in you, mate.
translation: 即使只是情感上的支持。我们相信你，伙计。

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

english: No worries, mate. Go get 'em.
translation: 别客气，伙计。去加油吧。

english: I am a fool...
translation: 我是个傻瓜……

english: Well... yes, a bit.
translation: 嗯……是的，有点。

english: You meant well. You thought you were helpin'. Can't fault you for that part, mate.
translation: 你是好意。你以为自己在帮忙。这部分不能怪你，伙计。

english: You made a mistake. Coulda been any of us. Just gotta make sure we learn from our mistakes is all.
translation: 你犯了个错。我们任何人都可能犯。只要确保我们从中吸取教训就行。

english: And if yer genuinely sorry, best you can do is work to be better, not mope around. So keep your chin up, mate!
translation: 如果你真的感到抱歉，最好的做法是努力变得更好，而不是消沉。所以振作起来，伙计！

english: Thank you...
translation: 谢谢你……

english: What did you do, anyway?
translation: 你到底做了什么？

english: I saw sun and moon runes on that thing. Recalled something from Ranul's teachings, a rite he once performed...
translation: 我看到那东西上有太阳和月亮符石。想起了拉努尔教义中的某些内容，他曾经施行过的仪式……

english: I tried to emulate it, and it worked. I thought I had freed his emissaries. But they weren't that at all...
translation: 我试着模仿，结果奏效了。我以为我解放了他的使者。但他们根本不是……

english: Interesting. Maybe there was some sort of connection between Ranul and this place after all.
translation: 有意思。也许拉努尔和这个地方之间确实有某种联系。

english: Well, all's well that ends well.
translation: 好吧，结果好就一切都好。

english: We never had any doubts! Always knew you'd get it sorted, mate.
translation: 我们从未怀疑过！一直知道你能搞定，伙计。

english: No worries, mate.
translation: 别担心，伙计。

english: Good to see you again, mate.
translation: 很高兴再次见到你，伙计。

english: Good to see you both as well. How's things?
translation: 也很高兴见到你们俩。最近怎么样？

english: Never better, mate. Never better. This here ruin was the find of the century!
translation: 再好不过了，伙计。再好不过了。这处遗迹是世纪大发现！

english: All credit to Jess, o'course, but we're glad to be doing our bit!
translation: 当然都要归功于杰西，但我们也很高兴能出一份力！

english: Glad to hear it.
translation: 那就好。

english: Pretty good, mate. There was a little commotion in here earlier, but things soon got straightened out.
translation: 挺好的，伙计。之前这里有点骚动，但很快就平息了。

english: Aye, that nagua ain't to be messed with. She soon dealt with the troublemakers.
translation: 是啊，那个那伽可不是好惹的。她很快就收拾了捣乱的人。

english: Makes you wonder why someone would try to mess with her in the first place.
translation: 让人不禁好奇为什么有人一开始就想惹她。

english: Aye, they must have had some pretty strong convictions to take on that risk. Ain't it crazy how far some people will go?
translation: 是啊，他们一定有很强的信念才敢冒这个险。有些人能做到什么程度真是疯狂，对吧？

english: Too right. Glad I'm not one of them. I'll just stick to my attempts at being a top-notch builder, thank you very much.
translation: 太对了。很高兴我不是他们中的一员。我还是继续努力做个顶尖建筑工吧，非常感谢。

english: Anyway, mate, look at us getting you all sidetracked. Nice of you to drop in, but don't be letting us distract you now.
translation: 总之伙计，看我们把话题扯远了。你能来真好，但现在别让我们分散你的注意力。

english: Though sometimes a distraction can be a good thing. We're all 'bout efficiency these days, but sometimes it can be good to take a step back.
translation: 不过有时分心也可能是好事。如今我们都讲究效率，但有时退一步也不错。

english: You make a very good point.
translation: 你说得很有道理。

english: Tell you what, mate, when the opportunity next presents itself, you should kick back and relax. You've earned it.
translation: 这样吧伙计，下次有机会时，你应该放松休息一下。你值得的。

english: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。

english: Don't mention it, mate.
translation: 别客气，伙计。

english: What's going on here?
translation: 这里发生什么事了？

english: Are you two philosophers?
translation: 你们两位是哲学家吗？

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Can I help you today?
translation: 今天有什么能帮你的？

english: Can I go for a ride?
translation: 我能坐矿车吗？

english: Minecart rides are 20 coins.
translation: 乘坐矿车要20金币。

english: Of course.
translation: 当然可以。

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。

english: As a loyal customer of the Lovakengj Minecart Network, you're entitled to this.
translation: 身为洛瓦肯吉矿车网络的忠实客户，你自然享有这项权益。

english: Now, can I help you today?
translation: 现在，今天有什么能帮你的？

english: You're already here, human.
translation: 你已经在这里了，人类。

english: Can I go for a ride?
translation: 我能坐矿车吗？

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。

english: How are things, Bunkdo?
translation: 最近怎么样，邦克多？

english: It's great to be back home, Azacor.
translation: 回到家真好，阿扎科尔。

english: We'd spent so long out there on Ape Atoll I was starting to doubt I'd ever see the Grand Tree again!
translation: 我们在猿猴岛待了太久，我都开始怀疑还能不能再见到大树了！

english: How does it feel to be back home?
translation: 回到家感觉如何？

english: Ayyy ... *hiccup* ... Ish been sho long sinsh I've ... *hiccup* ... ad a deshent cocktail!
translation: 唉……打嗝……我太久没……打嗝……喝过像样的鸡尾酒了！

english: Glad to see you enjoying yourself... I guess.
translation: 很高兴看到你玩得开心……我想。

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: Hello sir, are you going to make a snowman?
translation: 你好先生，你要堆雪人吗？

english: Maybe, I'm not sure I'd be very good at it!
translation: 也许吧，我不确定我擅不擅长！

english: I think you would be!
translation: 我觉得你会的！

english: I want to make a snowman, but I can't reach high enough to stack the snowballs properly.
translation: 我想堆雪人，但我够不到那么高，没法好好堆雪球。

english: Hello Buoy and Gurl!
translation: 你好布伊和格尔！

english: Hello sir!
translation: 你好先生！

english: How do you know our names?
translation: 你怎么知道我们的名字？

english: I had a chat with your dad. He's super busy, so he's asked me to help you build a snowman!
translation: 我和你们爸爸聊过。他超级忙，所以让我帮你们堆雪人！

english: Really? We get to make a snowman?
translation: 真的吗？我们可以堆雪人？

english: Yes! And I'm going to build whatever snowman you want!
translation: 是的！而且你们想要什么样的雪人都可以！

english: Yay! Can it be three snowballs tall?
translation: 耶！能堆三个雪球高吗？

english: But I want it to be five tall!
translation: 但我想堆五个高！

english: Five is a bad number, it should be three tall!
translation: 五是个坏数字，应该是三个高！

english: You're a bad number. Five is so much better.
translation: 你才是坏数字。五好多了。

english: Okay, okay, wait a second. Why don't we meet in the middle. How about four snowballs tall?
translation: 好了好了，等一下。我们各退一步怎么样。四个雪球高如何？

english: Fine, it can be four tall.
translation: 好吧，四个高可以。

english: Yes, four tall is okay.
translation: 是的，四个高可以。

english: Great. Now, we need to pick what size snowballs we want for each tier. Why don't you take it in turns? You can do two each.
translation: 太好了。现在，我们需要为每一层选择雪球大小。不如轮流来？你们各选两个。

english: The bottom one should be a huge snowball!
translation: 最下面的应该是巨大的雪球！

english: The next one should be big!
translation: 下一个应该是大的！

english: This is working nicely, we're half way! What about the top two parts?
translation: 进展顺利，已经完成一半了！上面两层呢？

english: The next one should be a small snowball!
translation: 下一个应该是小的雪球！

english: No, it should be little!
translation: 不，应该是微小的！

english: But it needs to be small, little would look bad.
translation: 但应该是小的，微小的看起来不好。

english: It wouldn't look bad. Small is better for decorations.
translation: 不会不好看的。小的更适合装饰。

english: My decorations will fit on a little one.
translation: 我的装饰适合放在微小的上面。

english: Why do you always ruin everything?
translation: 你为什么总是搞砸一切？

english: You ruin everything with your silly ideas!
translation: 你用那些愚蠢的想法搞砸一切！

english: Okay, okay, wait. This clearly isn't working, and I don't want you two to fall out. It's Christmas, we shouldn't be arguing!
translation: 好了好了，等一下。这显然行不通，我不想你们俩闹翻。这是圣诞节，我们不应该吵架！

english: How about I make you both a snowman? It can be whatever height and size you like. One each!
translation: 我给你们俩各堆一个雪人怎么样？高度和大小随你们喜欢。一人一个！

english: So mine can be five snowballs tall?
translation: 那我的可以五个雪球高？

english: And mine can be three snowballs tall?
translation: 那我的可以三个雪球高？

english: Yes, I'll make you both whatever snowman you like!
translation: 是的，你们想要什么样的雪人我都给你们堆！

english: What would you both like?
translation: 你们俩想要什么样的？

english: I'd like mine to be three snowballs tall please! And I want the bottom one to be small, the middle one big, and the top one huge!
translation: 我想要三个雪球高！而且我想要最下面的是小的，中间的是大的，最上面的是巨大的！

english: I'd like mine to be five snowballs tall please! I want the bottom one to be humongous, then large, then normal, then big, and then a little one for the top!
translation: 我想要五个雪球高！我想要最下面的是超大的，然后是大的，然后是普通的，然后是小的，最上面是微小的！

english: That's two very different snowmen, I see why this didn't work before!
translation: 这是两个非常不同的雪人，我明白之前为什么行不通了！

english: What do all these different sizes mean? Humongous? Normal? Little? How big are those?
translation: 这些不同的大小是什么意思？超大？普通？微小？那些有多大？

english: You silly billy! Humongous is the biggest snowball of course!
translation: 你这个小傻瓜！超大当然是最大的雪球！

english: Normal is the normal size that you get when you make a snowball normally. It's easy!
translation: 普通就是你正常堆雪球时得到的正常大小。很简单！

english: Right, thank you for clearing that up. I'll figure something out.
translation: 好的，谢谢你们解释清楚。我会想办法的。

english: What are you two going to do for decorations?
translation: 你们俩打算用什么装饰？

english: I already know what I want mine to look like!
translation: 我已经知道我想要什么样的了！

english: Me too!
translation: 我也是！

english: Why don't you guys find some decorations while I build the snowmen? Then you can add them once I'm done.
translation: 不如我堆雪人的时候你们去找些装饰？等我完成后你们可以加上。

english: Okay sir!
translation: 好的！

english: We will do that!
translation: 我们会的！

english: Well, that seems sorted. I should speak to Larry again, and see if he has any advice about building the snowmen.
translation: 好吧，看来解决了。我应该再和拉里谈谈，看看他有没有堆雪人的建议。

english: Hello there!
translation: 你好！

english: Have you started making the snowmen yet?
translation: 你开始堆雪人了吗？

english: You should talk to dad if you need some help, he knows how to make snowmen!
translation: 如果需要帮助你应该去找爸爸，他知道怎么堆雪人！

english: Yeah, he always used to make really big ones with us!
translation: 是的，他以前总是和我们一起堆特别大的！

english: Maybe I'll go talk to him and see what advice he has.
translation: 也许我去找他看看有什么建议。

english: He'll say, make them really tall!
translation: 他会说，堆得特别高！

english: He'll say make them shorter, because that's better!
translation: 他会说堆矮点，因为那样更好！

english: I should go and speak to Larry. I'm sure he has some handy advice for me!
translation: 我应该去找拉里。我相信他有些实用建议给我！

english: That looks good! It needs a [size] snowball next!
translation: 看起来不错！接下来需要一个[size]雪球！

english: They're done! They're so cool!
translation: 完成了！太酷了！

english: Yay! Can we decorate them now?
translation: 耶！我们现在可以装饰了吗？

english: Yes! Can we decorate them now please [player name]?
translation: 是的！我们现在可以装饰了吗，[player name]？

english: Of course you can. Are they what you wanted?
translation: 当然可以。这是你们想要的吗？

english: Mine is perfect!
translation: 我的完美！

english: Mine too. It's just how I wanted it.
translation: 我的也是。正是我想要的样子。

english: I am happy to hear that. It was harder work than I thought.
translation: 那就好。这比我想象的要难。

english: You did a good job. Thank you very much [sir/madam].
translation: 你做得很好。非常感谢你，[sir/madam]。

english: Yes, thank you [sir/madam]!
translation: 是的，谢谢你，[sir/madam]！

english: It was no problem. Merry Christmas to you both!
translation: 没问题。祝你们圣诞快乐！

english: I should go and speak to Larry. Hopefully he has that festive white wine ready for me.
translation: 我应该去找拉里。希望他为我准备好了节日白葡萄酒。

english: Those snowmen look amazing!
translation: 那些雪人看起来太棒了！

english: Thank you! Decorating them was quite hard!
translation: 谢谢！装饰它们相当难！

english: Yeah, they took ages to do! Do you like mine?
translation: 是啊，花了好长时间！你喜欢我的吗？

english: It's really good! Reminds me of something actually.
translation: 真的很棒！其实让我想起了什么。

english: What about mine? Do you like it?
translation: 我的呢？你喜欢吗？

english: I like yours too. They both remind me of something!
translation: 我也喜欢你的。它们都让我想起了什么！

english: Mine is Thermy! My favourite monster! She's so big and scary, makes me go woah!
translation: 我的是瑟米！我最喜欢的怪物！她又大又可怕，让我哇哦！

english: Mine is Tempy! My favourite monster! He lives in the water, a huge mass of angry wet!
translation: 我的是海灵！我最喜欢的怪物！他住在水里，就是一大团愤怒的水元素！

english: They're both amazing! I didn't know you guys would be so good at decorating.
translation: 它们都太棒了！我不知道你们这么擅长装饰。

english: Dad lets us decorate every year. We get a lot of practice!
translation: 爸爸每年都让我们装饰。我们有很多练习！

english: Last year we made them into the Fragment of Seren and the King Black Dragon!
translation: 去年我们把它们做成了塞伦碎片和黑龙王！

english: What... really??? I'd like to have seen that. Those sound even more difficult than these two!
translation: 什么……真的？？？我真想看看。那些听起来比这两个更难！

english: How do you know all these monsters anyway? There is no way your dad would let you anywhere near them!
translation: 你们怎么知道这些怪物的？你们爸爸肯定不会让你们靠近它们！

english: Dad reads us lots of stories, and we hear about them from passing adventurers, like you.
translation: 爸爸给我们读很多故事，我们也从路过的冒险者那里听说，就像你一样。

english: You must meet some interesting and cool adventurers!
translation: 你们一定见过一些有趣又酷的冒险者！

english: Not as cool as you though; none of them helped us make our snowmen!
translation: 但没你酷；他们都没帮我们堆雪人！

english: Yes, you're the first to help us make them!
translation: 是的，你是第一个帮我们堆雪人的！

english: Well, you're welcome. I really enjoyed it. What are you guys going to do now you're finished?
translation: 不用客气。我真的很享受。你们完成后打算做什么？

english: We're going to go and play! And maybe visit the festival. Will you be there?
translation: 我们要去玩！也许还会去节日庆典。你会去吗？

english: I sure will be. Maybe see you there!
translation: 我肯定会去。也许在那里见！

english: Bye sir, Merry Christmas.
translation: 再见先生，圣诞快乐。

english: Merry Christmas, have fun!
translation: 圣诞快乐，玩得开心！

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Be vigilant, citizen.
translation: 保持警惕，市民。

english: Err, right.
translation: 呃，好的。

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 虽然你找到了顾客，但你似乎没带正确的食物！你需要 [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]！

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 恐怕预制菜不行。只有手工制作的侏儒美食才配得上阿鲁夫‧阿洛夫特的顾客。

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Burkor
translation: 你把 [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] 的订单交给伯科尔

english: Thank you. Can't talk now I'm on duty.
translation: 谢谢。我现在值班，不能聊天。

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 你有 [number] 积分可以兑换免费配送券。你可以获得 [number] 份侏儒美食配送。

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: 别忘了从小阿鲁夫‧吉安那里领取你的免费配送券。

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 你的配送太晚了！回去找小阿鲁夫重新接单。你丢弃了配送箱，因为不再需要它了。

english: Ah, you come back again.
translation: 啊，你又回来了。

english: How are things at Weiss?
translation: 魏斯聚落那边怎么样？

english: Snowflake and My Arm are ruling the town together, and now I've built them a special fire, they can grow goutweed there.
translation: 雪花和''我的手臂''一起统治着城镇，现在我为他们生了一堆特殊的火，他们可以在那里种植痛风草。

english: I plan to stay here, in the Stronghold, with my friend Burntmeat, but it good to hear of my home. Thank you.
translation: 我打算留在这里，在要塞里，和我的朋友烧肉一起，但很高兴听到家乡的消息。谢谢你。

english: Stronghold trolls not all that interested in firemaking, after all, but t'anks for bringing book anyway. It taste lovely.
translation: 毕竟要塞巨人对生火不太感兴趣，但还是谢谢你带来这本书。味道不错。

english: ... you're welcome.
translation: ……不用客气。

english: Buy ush a drink.
translation: 给我们买杯酒。

english: I think you have had enough.
translation: 我想你喝得够多了。

english: Pleash, buy ush a drink.
translation: 求求你，给我们买杯酒。

english: How you holding up Burntof? Must have had quite the fright when you woke that monster.
translation: 你怎么样，烧焦？唤醒那个怪物时一定吓坏了吧。

english: You're right [lad/lass]. It did give me a little fright.
translation: 你说得对 [小伙子/姑娘]。确实吓了我一跳。

english: But I saw some interesting things down in the ruins...
translation: 但我在遗迹下面看到了一些有趣的东西……

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你什么意思？

english: Some of the markings on the wall look very familiar to me. I've seen them before.
translation: 墙上的一些标记对我来说很眼熟。我以前见过。

english: Well, when I defeated the monster, an Imcando dwarf opened the barred door...
translation: 嗯，当我击败怪物时，一个伊姆坎多矮人打开了栅栏门……

english: An Imcando dwarf! I thought they were all but extinct! You've found something truly amazing [player name]!
translation: 一个伊姆坎多矮人！我以为他们几乎灭绝了！你发现了真正了不起的东西，[player name]！

english: I wish I had a drink to celebrate, but this desert is bone dry.
translation: 我真想喝一杯庆祝，但这沙漠干得要命。

english: How's it going, Butch?
translation: 最近怎么样，布奇？

english: Ah... How could I forget... You don't have a head!
translation: 啊……我怎么能忘记……你没有头！

english: Shall we head off on an adventure together?
translation: 我们要一起去冒险吗？

english: Sorry, poor choice of words.

english: Can you speak?
translation: 你能说话吗？

english: Yes...
translation: 是的……

english: Er... Who's speaking? Is this Butch, or something else?
translation: 呃……是谁在说话？是布奇，还是别的什么？

english: That's unsettling.
translation: 真让人不安。

english: Good day, [sir/madam]. Would [sir/madam] care to hire a good butler for 5000 coins?
translation: 你好，[sir/madam]。[sir/madam] 愿意花5000金币雇一位好管家吗？

english: What can you do?
translation: 你能做什么？

english: I can fulfill all [sir/madam]'s domestic service needs with efficiency and impeccable manners. I hate to boast, but I can say with confidence that no mortal can make trips to the bank or sawmill faster than I!
translation: 我能高效且礼貌地满足 [sir/madam] 的所有家政服务需求。我不想吹嘘，但我可以自信地说，没有凡人能比我更快地往返银行或锯木厂！

english: Tell me about your previous jobs.
translation: 跟我讲讲你之前的工作。

english: From a humble beginning as a dish-washer I have worked my way up through the ranks of domestic service in the households of nobles from Varrock and Ardougne. As a life-long servant I have naturally
translation: 我从一个卑微的洗碗工做起，一步步在维洛克和阿多尼贵族家庭的家政服务中晋升。作为终身仆人，

english: suppressed any personality of my own and trained myself never to use the second person when talking to a superior. I have usually worked in the large households of the aristocracy, but now that such a large
translation: 我自然压抑了自己的个性，并训练自己与上级交谈时从不使用第二人称。我通常在贵族的大家庭工作，

english: number of private persons are building their own houses I decided to offer them my services.
translation: 但现在有这么多私人建造自己的房子，我决定向他们提供我的服务。

english: I must respectfully decline, [sir/madam]. I offer a very exclusive service and will only work for people with over level 40 Construction.
translation: 我必须恭敬地拒绝，[sir/madam]。我提供非常专属的服务，只为建筑等级超过40级的人工作。

english: You already have a servant.
translation: 你已经有仆人了。

english: You need a second bedroom with a bed for your servant to sleep in.
translation: 你需要第二间卧室，放张床让仆人睡觉。

english: You're hired... well, I don't have the money on me, but can I owe you? I'm good for it, honest.
translation: 你被雇用了……嗯，我身上没带钱，但我能欠你吗？我说话算话，真的。

english: I regret that I cannot agree to begin my duties until I have been paid.
translation: 很遗憾，在收到报酬之前我不能开始工作。

english: Thank you, [sir/madam]. I can start work immediately.
translation: 谢谢你，[sir/madam]。我可以立即开始工作。

translation: 你按铃了吗，[sir/madam]？

english: Your tea, [sir/madam]. Does [sir/madam] take milk?
translation: 你的茶，[sir/madam]。[sir/madam] 要加牛奶吗？

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: I regret that I cannot make a meal unless [sir/madam] has a dining table for me to serve it on.

translation: 除非你有带啤酒桶的厨房，否则我无法提供饮料，[sir/madam]。

english: Can you fetch something from the bank for me?

english: Certainly, [sir/madam]. If [sir/madam] would simply tell me the items [he/she] requires?

translation: 好的，这是5000金币。

english: Thank you sir.
