english: Good day [sir/madam].
translation: 你好，[sir/madam]。

english: Hello. I'm helping Lord Hosidius find his missing son. I was wondering if you could help me.
translation: 你好。我在帮霍西迪乌斯领主寻找他失踪的儿子。我想知道你能否帮我。

english: I'm afraid I know not where Artur has gone. I do not speak to him much. He keeps himself to himself.
translation: 恐怕我不知道阿图尔去了哪里。我不怎么和他说话。他独来独往。

english: However, I've noticed him speaking to Olivia before. Maybe she can help.
translation: 不过，我注意到他之前和奥利维亚说过话。也许她能帮忙。

english: Great, thanks.
translation: 太好了，谢谢。

english: Good day [sir/madam]. I hope your quest is going well.
translation: 你好，[sir/madam]。希望你的任务进展顺利。

english: Good day [sir/madam]. On behalf of the Hosidius family, I thank you for bringing Artur home.
translation: 你好，[sir/madam]。我代表霍西迪乌斯家族感谢你带阿图尔回家。

english: Good day [sir/madam]. I'm afraid I can't stop to talk. The new Lord Hosidius has plenty of work for me.
translation: 你好，[sir/madam]。恐怕我不能停下聊天。新霍西迪乌斯领主有很多工作给我。

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Hello. How are you today?
translation: 你好。今天怎么样？

english: Good thank you, and yourself?
translation: 很好谢谢，你呢？

english: Very well, thank you.
translation: 很好，谢谢。

english: It's an honour to be in your presence again, adventurer. I hope things are well?
translation: 再次见到你是一种荣幸，冒险者。希望你一切安好？

english: Not bad, thanks. Yourself?
translation: 不错，谢谢。你呢？

english: Unfortunately, I am still forced to deal with this insufferable family. Many generations have passed, but they are still the enemy. As such, they must be kept a close eye on.
translation: 不幸的是，我仍被迫对付这个难以忍受的家族。许多代过去了，但他们仍然是敌人。因此，必须密切关注他们。

english: Still, I have no doubt that the time will soon come for me to leave this place. Our lord will certainly have need of me elsewhere once his current work is complete.
translation: 不过，我毫不怀疑我离开这里的日子很快就会到来。一旦我们领主目前的工作完成，他肯定会在其他地方需要我。

english: I see. Well good luck with it all.
translation: 我明白了。那祝你好运。

english: Hey, friend of Snowflake!
translation: 嘿，雪花的朋友！

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Not much to say. Came to Weiss with other trolls when we got kicked out of caves further south, but I was just young troll then.
translation: 没什么好说的。当我们被赶出更南边的洞穴时，我和其他巨人一起来到了魏斯聚落，但那时我还年轻。

english: Mostly been enjoying living round Weiss, 'cos wildlife is interesting here.
translation: mostly 一直在享受魏斯聚落周围的生活，因为这里的野生动物很有趣。

english: Tell me about this place.
translation: 跟我讲讲这个地方。

english: This here is Weiss. Trolls built it years ago, after we got kicked out from caves further south. Now Weiss is our home.
translation: 这里是魏斯聚落。巨人们多年前建造的，在我们被赶出更南边的洞穴之后。现在魏斯聚落是我们的家。

english: It great here, now Snowflake an' her husband troll taught us goutweed farming. Food so much better now.
translation: 这里很好，现在雪花和她的巨人丈夫教我们种植痛风草。食物现在好多了。

english: Do you like it here?
translation: 你喜欢这里吗？

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it getting better. Snowflake, she taught us goutweed farming. Goat, wolf, human all taste so much nicer with goutweed in.
translation: 呃，有点艰苦，但正在变好。雪花教我们种植痛风草。山羊、狼、人类加了痛风草后味道都好多了。

english: So yeah, Weiss is good place to live, now Snowflake in charge. All trolls like Snowflake. Her husband troll kinda weird, but that not our problem.
translation: 所以是的，现在雪花掌管，魏斯聚落是个居住的好地方。所有巨人都喜欢雪花。她的巨人丈夫有点奇怪，但那不是我们的问题。

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我走了。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Tell me about this place.
translation: 跟我讲讲这个地方。

english: Do you like it here?
translation: 你喜欢这里吗？

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我走了。

english: Would you like some help?
translation: 需要帮忙吗？

english: Urgh, it just happened again! Every time I almost have it my hand slips.
translation: 呃，又发生了！每次我快要拿到时手就滑了。

english: Oh, that's unfortunate. Are you using a lockpick?
translation: 哦，真不幸。你在用撬锁器吗？

english: Yes. Well actually, I'm using a Strange old lockpick. I found it while looting one of these coffins and I typically have better luck with it.
translation: 是的。其实，我在用一个奇怪的旧撬锁器。我是在洗劫这些棺材时找到的，通常用它运气更好。

english: Oh, that's interesting. I'll keep my eyes out for one.
translation: 哦，有意思。我会留意找一个。

english: I've found a few of them while raiding this place. There appear to be more of them on this floor than the floors above.
translation: 我在洗劫这个地方时找到过几个。这一层似乎比上面的楼层更多。

english: I see. If you don't mind me asking, you already have dark graceful so why are you still looking for hallowed marks?
translation: 我明白了。如果不介意我问，你已经有黑暗优雅套装了，为什么还在找圣痕？

english: Oh, it's because of this little fellow following me. I've heard that the Dark acorn sold by the guy upstairs will transform him into a Dark Squirrel.
translation: 哦，是因为这个跟着我的小家伙。我听说楼上那个人卖的黑暗橡果能把它变成黑暗松鼠。

english: Wow, I didn't know that! That sounds pretty cool.
translation: 哇，我不知道这个！听起来很酷。

english: Yeah, that's what I thought but that mysterious stranger is asking for 3,000 Hallowed marks for it.
translation: 是啊，我也是这么想的，但那个神秘的陌生人要价3,000圣痕。

english: 3,000? That sounds extortionate!
translation: 3,000？听起来太敲诈了！

english: Yeah, that's what I thought. Feels like he set the price just to keep me down here for longer. Still, it's not like I have anything better to do.
translation: 是啊，我也是这么想的。感觉他定价就是为了让我在这里待更久。不过，反正我也没什么更好的事可做。

english: I see, well best of luck. Hopefully you survive long enough to finish your goal.
translation: 我明白了，那祝你好运。希望你能活够久完成目标。

english: I'm sure I'll be fine.
translation: 我相信我会没事的。

english: Yeah, I ended up buying one myself and fed it to my Giant Squirrel. It took a while but it was definitely worth it.
translation: 是啊，我最后自己也买了一个，喂给了我的巨型松鼠。花了不少时间，但绝对值得。

english: Wow, I'm impressed! How long did it take you to get the 3,000 marks?
translation: 哇，我印象深刻！你花了多久才拿到3,000圣痕？

english: Long enough... Still, at least I feel much more agile now than when I started.
translation: 够久的……不过，至少我现在比开始时敏捷多了。

english: I don't think I'm going to get any more agile while looking for it myself. I'm glad you received some benefit from the grind though.
translation: 我觉得自己找的话不会再更敏捷了。不过很高兴你从刷取中获得了好处。

english: You shouldn't feed someone's pet without their permission.
translation: 你不应该未经允许就喂别人的宠物。

english: C'mon, almost got it...
translation: 加油，就差一点了……

english: Agh, thought I had it that time!
translation: 啊，以为这次拿到了！

english: C'mon, almost got it...
translation: 加油，就差一点了……

english: Having problems?
translation: 遇到问题了？

english: Can't you see I'm busy?
translation: 你没看到我很忙吗？

english: Do you have a lockpick?
translation: 你有撬锁器吗？

english: No and even if I did have one I wouldn't give it to you!
translation: 没有，即使有也不会给你！

english: I already have one. I was just letting you know that having a lockpick helps when getting into these coffins. You appear to be struggling.
translation: 我已经有一个了。我只是想告诉你，有撬锁器有助于打开这些棺材。你看起来有点吃力。

english: I was just letting you know that having a lockpick helps when getting into these coffins. You appear to be struggling.
translation: 我只是想告诉你，有撬锁器有助于打开这些棺材。你看起来有点吃力。

english: Wait, are you serious? The last adventurer I spoke to down here told me that lockpicks don't help!
translation: 等等，你是认真的吗？我之前在这里遇到的另一个冒险者告诉我撬锁器没用！

english: Yes I'm serious. Also that outfit you're wearing doesn't help you get more loot from these coffins either.
translation: 是的我是认真的。另外，你穿的那套装备也不能帮你从这些棺材里获得更多战利品。

english: They lied about that too? I feel like a fool!
translation: 他们也骗了我这个？我觉得自己像个傻瓜！

english: At least you look cool dressed like that though.
translation: 不过至少你穿那样看起来很酷。

english: Who cares about that? If it doesn't work then I should just wear the full graceful outfit since that would be much more efficient.
translation: 谁在乎那个？如果没用，我应该直接穿全套优雅套装，那样效率高多了。

english: Each to their own I suppose.
translation: 我想各有所好吧。

english: Ahhh, harvest day!
translation: 啊哈，收获日！

english: I sure can't wait to feed my family with these hard-earned cabba-
translation: 我迫不及待要用这些辛苦收获的卷心菜喂家人了——

english: No! What have you done?!
translation: 不！你做了什么？！

english: The farmer performs the Cry emote.
translation: 农民做出哭泣表情。

english: Urgh...
He looks too sick to chat.
translation: 他看起来病得太重，没法聊天。

english: Hello again. Coming back to Corsair Cove?
translation: 又见面了。要回海盗湾吗？

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: The ship sails to Corsair Cove...
translation: 船驶向海盗湾……

english: Not just now, thanks.
translation: 现在不用，谢谢。

english: The Captain's letting me command his boat now I'm fully recovered. Did you want to leave?
translation: 船长让我指挥他的船了，现在我完全康复了。你想离开吗？

english: Please take me back to Rimmington.
translation: 请送我回里明顿村。

english: The ship sails to Rimmington...
translation: 船驶向里明顿村……

english: I'll talk to you later.
translation: 我稍后再和你谈。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Not just now, thanks.
translation: 现在不用，谢谢。

english: Please take me back to Rimmington.
translation: 请送我回里明顿村。

english: I'll talk to you later.
translation: 我稍后再和你谈。

english: Hey.
translation: 嘿。

english: Hey there. If you need something, you should speak to Veos. I'm just the cabin boy.
translation: 嘿。如果你需要什么，应该去找维奥斯。我只是船舱服务员。

english: Fair enough.
translation: 好吧。

english: Hey. Veos left something for you. Here you go.
translation: 嘿。维奥斯给你留了东西。给你。

english: Now, do you need something?
translation: 现在，你需要什么吗？

english: Can you take me somewhere?
translation: 你能带我去某个地方吗？

english: I'm afraid that you're not eligible to travel to Great Kourend at the moment. Come back when you are and I'll happily take you there.
translation: 恐怕你目前不符合前往大库尔德的资格。等你符合了再来，我很乐意带你去。

english: Where would you like to go?
translation: 你想去哪里？

english: I'd like to travel to Port Sarim, please.
translation: 我想去沙林港，谢谢。

english: As you wish, I hope you don't get seasick, it is a long voyage.
translation: 如你所愿，希望你不要晕船，航程很长。

english: I'd like to travel to Port Piscarilius, please.
translation: 我想去皮斯卡利留斯港，谢谢。

english: As you wish.
translation: 如你所愿。

english: I'd like to travel to Land's End, please.
translation: 我想去兰兹角村，谢谢。

english: Actually I'd like to stay here.
translation: 其实我想留在这里。

english: I'm good.
translation: 我很好。

english: Hey there. Do you need something?
translation: 嘿。你需要什么吗？

english: Can you take me somewhere?
translation: 你能带我去某个地方吗？

english: Travel to Port Sarim.
translation: 前往沙林港。

english: Travel to Port Piscarilius.
translation: 前往皮斯卡利留斯港。

english: Travel to Land's End.
translation: 前往兰兹角村。

english: Stay where you are.
translation: 留在原地。

english: I'm good.
translation: 我很好。

english: Woooo wooo wooooo woooo.
translation: 呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜。

english: Jenkins?!
translation: 詹金斯？！

english: I'm sorry, Jenkins, but... why are you here?
translation: 对不起，詹金斯，但是……你为什么在这里？

english: I hope you find it, Jenkins. And you just let me know if I can help you do so.
translation: 我希望你能找到它，詹金斯。如果需要我帮忙，尽管告诉我。

english: Hello again, Jenkins. How are you doing?
translation: 又见面了，詹金斯。你怎么样？

english: Oh, it's you.
translation: 哦，是你。

english: Nice to see ye' remember me, seein' as you watched me die 'n all!
translation: 很高兴看到你记得我，毕竟你亲眼看着我死了！

english: S'pose me business ain't done yet. Gotta find me a purpose or somethin'.
translation: 我想我的事还没完。得找个目标之类的。

english: Aye, I will, but I reckon I'm all good fer now.
translation: 是的，我会的，但我想我现在还好。

english: Well, I'd love to let you sail with me again, but I don't think I'm ready to hire a crew yet.
translation: 嗯，我很想让你再和我一起航行，但我想我还没准备好雇佣船员。

english: Aye, best ye' make sure ye' know what yer doin' this time, though s'pose it ain't like ye' can get me killed again!
translation: 是啊，这次你最好确保知道自己要做什么，不过反正你也不能再让我死一次了！

english: You need a Sailing level of 40 to manage a crew.
translation: 你需要40级航海等级才能管理船员。

english: Maybe you could join my crew?
translation: 也许你能加入我的船员？

english: Reckon ye' need t' work on yer skills a bit first, considerin' what happened first time round.
translation: 我想你得先提升一下技能，考虑到第一次发生的事。

english: You require the following to recruit this crew member: Level 60 Sailing. Completion of Dragon Slayer I. Completion of The Restless Ghost.
translation: 你需要满足以下条件才能招募这名船员：60级航海等级。完成屠龙者 I。完成不安的幽灵。

english: Well, s'pose it ain't like ye' can get me killed again!
translation: 嗯，反正你也不能再让我死一次了！

english: You recruit Cabin Boy Jenkins as a crew member. He heads off in search of your boat.
translation: 你招募了船舱服务员詹金斯作为船员。他出发去寻找你的船。

english: You have recruited Cabin Boy Jenkins as a crew member.
translation: 你已招募船舱服务员詹金斯作为船员。

english: I hope you find it, Jenkins.
translation: 我希望你能找到它，詹金斯。

english: Aye, I reckon I will.
translation: 是的，我想我会的。

english: Oh, you're back.
translation: 哦，你回来了。

english: S'pose I'm alright. Still tryin' t' find me a purpose or somethin' though.
translation: 我想我还好。不过还在努力找个目标之类的。

english: Oh, 'ello... Cap'n.
translation: 哦，你好……船长。

english: How are you doing, Jenkins?
translation: 你怎么样，詹金斯？

english: How d'ye think I'm doin', Cap'n? I'm dead!
translation: 你觉得我怎么样，船长？我死了！

english: But at least you are still with us I suppose?
translation: 但至少你还在我们身边，我想？

english: I s'pose, but I ain't sure 'ow big of an upside that is really.
translation: 我想是吧，但我不确定这到底有多大好处。

english: Fair enough.
translation: 好吧。

english: Maybe you could join my crew?
translation: 也许你能加入我的船员？

english: I hope you find it, Jenkins.
translation: 我希望你能找到它，詹金斯。

english: Hi.
translation: 你好。

english: I bet you're after another lens!
translation: 我打赌你是来要另一个镜片的！

english: How could you possibly know that?
translation: 你怎么可能知道？

english: Hey, I think I'm learning a thing or two from these Moon Clan ladies.
translation: 嘿，我想我从这些月氏族女士那里学到了一两招。

english: Oi! I need another lens, boy.
translation: 喂！我需要另一个镜片，小子。

english: But you don't have space.
translation: 但你没空间了。

english: Good point.
translation: 说得对。

english: Huh, oh ok, I suppose I owe you one.
translation: 哈，哦好吧，我想我欠你一次。

english: I think I'll pass. But thanks..
translation: 我想我还是不要了。但谢谢……

english: So you've plucked up the courage to come and confront that girl!
translation: 所以你鼓起勇气去面对那个女孩了！

english: That I did, that I did!
translation: 确实如此，确实如此！

english: And?
translation: 然后呢？

english: She turned out to be really nice! She's joining us to become a pirate!
translation: 她结果人很好！她要加入我们成为海盗！

english: Really? And you're not sceptical about this? You know, after what she did last time?
translation: 真的？你不怀疑吗？你知道，鉴于她上次做的事？

english: She---has---no---spell---on---me.
Huh? Why are you talking like that?
translation: 哈？你为什么那样说话？

english: Like what?
translation: 像什么？

english: Like someone else was talking for you. Are you sure she hasn't put a spell on you again? Did she wave a watch in front of your face? You know, tell you to look deep into her eyes?
translation: 就像别人在替你说活。你确定她没再对你施法吗？她有没有在你面前晃手表？你知道，告诉你直视她的眼睛？

english: I think you've been hypnotised. I wonder what happens if I click my fingers?
translation: 我想你被催眠了。我想知道如果我打个响指会发生什么？

english: *click*
translation: 打响指

english: *Cluck* *cluck* *bwaarrk*
translation: 咯咯 咯咯 咕呱

english: Oh dear. Oh well, I'm sure you'll learn one day.
translation: 哦天哪。哦好吧，我相信你总有一天会明白的。

english: Please
translation: 请

english: No thanks
translation: 不用了，谢谢

english: Hello there; I see you're qualified. Come to help us out?
translation: 你好；我看你有资格。来帮我们吗？

english: Hello! You're that student who recently finished all three Earth Sciences exams, aren't you? Come to help us out?
translation: 你好！你就是那个最近完成了所有三门地质学考试的学生，对吧？来帮我们吗？

english: Greetings, my dear [sir/madam]. Have you come to give us a hand?
translation: 你好，亲爱的 [sir/madam]。你是来帮我们的吗？

english: Yes, how can I help out?
translation: 是的，我能怎么帮忙？

english: Well, you'll need to get your equipment first - it's all there on the tool rack. Use what you learned from your Earth Sciences exams. You'll need to be wearing your leather gloves and boots as well as have access to
translation: 嗯，你需要先拿到装备——都在工具架上。用你从地质学考试中学到的知识。你需要戴上皮手套和皮靴，

english: your trowel, rock pick and specimen brush.
translation: 还要有泥铲、岩石鎬和标本刷。

english: I see you have your equipment - well done.
translation: 我看你有装备了——做得好。

english: To really give us a hand, you could clean some finds for us. They're mostly done - just some fine work to finish off. Take a find from the pile that the workmen are bringing in, then there are spare tables over there
translation: 要真正帮我们的话，你可以帮我们清理一些发现物。它们基本完成了——只是一些精细工作需要收尾。从工人们搬进来的一堆发现物中拿一个，

english: to clean them on. If you find anything interesting, let us know and we'll see if it's good enough to go on display.
translation: 那边有空桌子可以清理。如果你发现什么有趣的东西，告诉我们，我们会看看是否值得展出。

english: I found something interesting.
translation: 我发现了有趣的东西。

english: Oh? Let's take a look...
translation: 哦？让我们看看……

english: I found this pretty necklace.
translation: 我发现了这条漂亮的项链。

english: Interesting...yes...yes...hmmm.... It looks like it's enchanted.
translation: 有趣……是的……是的……嗯……它看起来被附魔了。

english: With what?
translation: 用什么附魔的？

english: Oh, I think it's just a benign teleportation spell. I tinker in magic when I'm not doing archaeology. I can teach you how to make more necklaces like this. Amazing that they had this kind of knowledge back then.
translation: 哦，我想只是个无害的传送法术。我不做考古时会研究魔法。我可以教你怎么做更多这样的项链。真令人惊讶他们当时就有这种知识。

english: That would be good. Where is the teleport to?
translation: 那太好了。传送到哪里？

english: Hmm...all the indications are that it's somewhere to the east of us, but I'm not sure how far. Perhaps it was a teleport back to Saranthium. Let me just take a closer look.
translation: 嗯……所有迹象表明它在我们东边某处，但我不确定有多远。也许是传送回萨兰提姆城的。让我仔细看看。

english: So I just make a ruby necklace and use five fire runes and one cosmic rune to enchant it.
translation: 所以我只需要制作一条红宝石项链，然后用五个火符石和一个宇宙符石附魔。

english: Yes, indeed. Well done, youngster, thanks for helping us.
translation: 是的。做得好，年轻人，谢谢你的帮助。

english: I've cleaned this old coin - is it of any use?
translation: 我清理了这枚古币——有用吗？

english: Oh my! What a wonderful find! If this is what I believe it to be, it would allow us to date the Dig Site city.
translation: 哦天哪！多棒的发现！如果这是我认为的那样，它将帮助我们确定挖掘场城市的年代。

english: And look here, it has the name of the city too! Saranthium! That must be during the Saradominist occupation. This is a wonderful find. Please take it and place it in display case 45.
translation: 看这里，它还有城市名字！萨兰提姆城！那一定是在萨拉多明占领期间。这是个很棒的发现。请拿着它放在45号展示柜。

english: Right, display case 45 it is...
translation: 好的，就45号展示柜……

english: Back again? Have you put the old coin in display case 45 yet?
translation: 又回来了？你把古币放进45号展示柜了吗？

english: No, I'll go do that now
translation: 不，我现在就去

english: You've already shown me one of those, but it was in better condition. It's in the display case over there. You can pop this one in the finds crate over in the corner.
translation: 你已经给我看过一个那样的，但状况更好。它在那边的展示柜里。你可以把这个放进角落的发现物箱里。

english: I found this really old coin - is it of any use?
translation: 我发现了这枚很古老的金币——有用吗？

english: What have we here?
translation: 我们这里有什么？

english: Oh! This is very interesting...and confusing at the same time. This coin means that the city that we're excavating on the Digsite - Saranthium - was actually inhabited much, much earlier by followers of Zamorak,
translation: 哦！这非常有趣……同时也令人困惑。这枚币意味着我们在考古挖掘场挖掘的城市——萨兰提姆城——实际上更早被扎莫拉克信徒居住，

english: at which time, the city was known as Senntisten.
translation: 那时，城市被称为森蒂斯坦。

english: This is a most remarkable discovery, as we have other evidence indicating that Zarosian followers were resident before the Saradominists took over, but it also seems that Zamorakian forces used it during a battle of some
translation: 这是个最显著的发现，因为我们有其他证据表明扎罗斯信徒在萨拉多明信徒接管前居住在此，但也似乎扎莫拉克部队在某次战斗期间使用了它。

english: sort. Still, it allows us to roughly date when the city changed from following Zaros and Zamorak to following Saradomin. Put it in display case 44.
translation: 不过，它让我们能大致确定城市从追随扎罗斯和扎莫拉克转变为追随萨拉多明的时间。把它放在44号展示柜。

english: Case 44 it is!
translation: 就44号柜！

english: Back again? Have you put the ancient coin in display case 44 yet?
translation: 又回来了？你把古币放进44号展示柜了吗？

english: No, I'll go do that now.
translation: 不，我现在就去。

english: I found this crumbly old decoration - is it of any use?
translation: 我发现了这个易碎的旧装饰——有用吗？

english: Ahh... That looks like an altar piece. Hmm, yes...from the early Saradominist worshippers by the looks of it. Quite delicate, too. Put it in display case 37.
translation: 啊……那看起来像个祭坛装饰。嗯，是的……从外观上看来自早期萨拉多明信徒。相当精致。把它放在37号展示柜。

english: Case 37 it is!
translation: 就37号柜！

english: Back again? Have you put the ancient symbol in display case 37 yet?
translation: 又回来了？你把古符号放进37号展示柜了吗？

english: I found this really old decoration - is it of any use?
translation: 我发现了这个很旧的装饰——有用吗？

english: Wow!
translation: 哇！

english: That's in rather good condition, isn't it? An old altar decoration by the looks of things, from the Saradominist city no doubt. Put it in display case 36.
translation: 那状况相当好，不是吗？从外观上看是个旧祭坛装饰，无疑来自萨拉多明城市。把它放在36号展示柜。

english: Case 36 it is!
translation: 就36号柜！

english: Back again? Have you put the old symbol in display case 36 yet?
translation: 又回来了？你把旧符号放进36号展示柜了吗？

english: I found this piece of pottery - is it of any use?
translation: 我发现了这块陶器——有用吗？

english: Ahh... Oh! Hmm...yes...made by Zaros worshippers, by the looks of it. Beautifully-shaped. It looks as if this would go nicely in display case 22. This piece reinforces our evidence that the city was occupied by
translation: 啊……哦！嗯……是的……从外观上看是扎罗斯信徒制作的。形状优美。看起来放在22号展示柜很合适。这件物品加强了我们的证据，表明这座城市在萨拉多明教徒之前

english: Zarosians before Saradominists.
translation: 被扎罗斯信徒占领。

english: Case 22 it is!
translation: 就22号柜！

english: Back again? Have you put the pottery in display case 22 yet?
translation: 又回来了？你把陶器放进22号展示柜了吗？

english: I found these old arrowheads.
translation: 我发现了这些旧箭头。

english: Ahh, yes, we find lots of those - they're not important. We already have some in our display. Just add it to the crate of finds over near the door.
translation: 啊，是的，我们发现很多那种——它们不重要。我们展示柜里已经有一些了。把它加到门附近的发现物箱里。

english: If there is anything already in the crate, feel free to take it as a reward for your work.
translation: 如果箱子里已经有东西，随意拿走作为你工作的奖励。

english: Oh, okay.
translation: 哦，好的。

english: Take a look at this...
translation: 看看这个……

english: I found these old necklaces.
translation: 我发现了这些旧项链。

english: An interesting find... Here, let me offer you something in return.
translation: 一个有趣的发现……来，我给你点东西作为回报。

english: Oh! Okay.
translation: 哦！好的。

english: I cleaned up this old vase.
translation: 我清理了这个旧花瓶。

english: Ah, the vases... I've lost count of how many we've found of those... The only completely intact one is in the display case already. Just add it to the crate of finds over near the door.
translation: 啊，花瓶……我都数不清我们找到多少个了……唯一完全完好的那个已经在展示柜里了。把它加到门附近的发现物箱里吧。

english: Right.
translation: 好的。

english: Err... I seem to have lost it. Sorry.
translation: 呃……我好像把它弄丢了。抱歉。

english: Sounds like you never had it, [lad/lass]!
translation: 听起来你从来没有过，[lad/lass]！

english: No, just here to watch.
translation: 不，只是来看看。

english: Thank you, but I don't need that
translation: 谢谢，但我不需要那个

english: Yes, how can I help out?
translation: 是的，我能怎么帮忙？

english: I found something interesting.
translation: 我发现了有趣的东西。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Are you interested in buying or selling spice?
translation: 你有兴趣买卖香料吗？

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Hey! Get your hands off there!
translation: 嘿！把手拿开！

english: You're the one who stole something from me!
translation: 你才是偷我东西的人！

english: Guards guards!
translation: 守卫！守卫！

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: You try to pet the bird, but it pecks your hand in return.
translation: 你试着抚摸这只鸟，但它反过来啄了你的手。

english: Ouch!
translation: 哎哟！

english: Have I seen you before?
translation: 我以前见过你吗？

english: I don't think so... I've just got one of those faces.
translation: 我想没有……我只是长了一张大众脸。

english: You're probably right.
translation: 你可能是对的。

english: I'm rather busy at the moment. I've got to organise my cupboards of jewels.
translation: 我现在相当忙。我得整理我的珠宝柜。

english: Want any help?
translation: 需要帮忙吗？

english: Absolutely not! You stay away from my jewels.
translation: 绝对不要！你离我的珠宝远点。

english: Interested in buying a house like mine?
translation: 有兴趣买一栋像我这样的房子吗？

english: Not sure I've got enough coins to do that.
translation: 不确定我有足够的金币买。

english: Silly me! I mistook you for one of us wealthy folk.
translation: 我真傻！我把你当成我们这样的有钱人了。

english: Well that's rude.
translation: 那可真无礼。

english: You'll catch on.
translation: 你会明白的。

english: Hello there. Are you liking the city?
translation: 你好。你喜欢这座城市吗？

english: It's beautiful!
translation: 它很美！

english: It really is.
translation: 确实是。

english: Huh? Are you an encyclopediasalesman?
translation: 哈？你是百科全书推销员吗？

english: No, sir, I'm a burglar. I burgle people.
translation: 不，先生，我是窃贼。我入室盗窃。

english: Hmm... I think you're an encyclopediasalesman?
translation: 嗯……我觉得你是百科全书推销员？

english: Not at all. I just want to ransack the place. Honestly.
translation: 完全不是。我只是想洗劫这个地方。真的。

english: Hmm... Alright then.
translation: 嗯……那好吧。

english: I love the fresh air outside, don't you?
translation: 我喜欢外面的新鲜空气，你不吗？

english: It is quite nice out here.
translation: 外面确实很不错。

english: Lovely day for a stroll, wouldn't you say?
translation: 适合散步的好天气，你不觉得吗？

english: It is!
translation: 确实是！

english: I've got something in the back of my mind telling me I should go back home.
translation: 我总觉得我应该回家。

english: You don't say...
translation: 真的吗……

english: I do love being rich! I can take leisurely strolls whenever I want, without a care in the world!
translation: 我真的很喜欢有钱！我可以随时悠闲地散步，无忧无虑！

english: Enjoy it! Take as much time as you want!
translation: 好好享受！想花多少时间就花多少时间！

english: Time to go check how rich I am!
translation: 该去检查我有多富有了！

english: Lovely day for a stroll.
translation: 适合散步的好天气。

english: You are escorted out of the house as the owner has locked the door.
translation: 房主锁了门，你被护送出了房子。

english: You hear someone outside spot the homeowner coming back!

english: Now where did I put my keys...
translation: 我把钥匙放哪了……

english: Ah, there they are!
translation: 啊，在那儿！

english: It smells funny in here...
translation: 这里闻起来有股怪味……

english: There's mud all over the floor!
translation: 地板上到处都是泥！

english: Something isn't right here...
translation: 这里有些不对劲……

english: How did you get in here?
translation: 你怎么进来的？

english: Who are you? What are you after?
translation: 你是谁？你想干什么？

english: Nothing, I will be on my way.
translation: 没什么，我这就走。

english: I see you are a chef... Could you cook me something?
translation: 我看你是厨师……能给我做点吃的吗？

translation: 我想，但我很忙。我正试图通过准备一道特别独特的鱼沙拉来提高我作为顶尖厨师之一的声誉。

english: Caleb! As an adventurer, I am ready to help you with whatever you need... again! What can I help you with?
translation: 凯勒布！作为一名冒险者，我随时准备帮助你做任何你需要的事……再次！有什么能帮你的？

english: You daydream briefly of what the rich family could offer you this time as a reward.
translation: 你短暂地幻想着这个富裕家庭这次会给你什么奖励。

english: ... and that's when I found the broken lamping stick. Maybe you could help me investigate?
translation: ……就在那时我发现了断掉的灯杆。也许你能帮我调查一下？

english: Sorry, I didn't quite catch that, my mind was erm... elsewhere.
translation: 抱歉，我没太听清，我的心思在……别处。

english: Well if you aren't going to listen to the problem, it's fine, don't worry about it. Nothing an experienced chef can't solve himself!
translation: 好吧，如果你不打算听这个问题，没关系，别担心。没有什么是一个经验丰富的厨师自己解决不了的！

english: I'm sorry! Please let me help.
translation: 对不起！请让我帮忙。

english: No! Not every problem in my life needs an adventurer to come solve it for me anyway. I'm happy and there's nothing else either!
translation: 不！反正我生活中的不是每个问题都需要冒险者来帮我解决。我很高兴，也没什么别的事！

english: Very well, I'll go and see if your other brothers need anything...
translation: 好吧，我去看看你的其他兄弟是否需要什么……

english: The sweet smell of the great rewards that may come fades slightly.
translation: 可能到来的丰厚奖励的甜美气息稍微消散了一些。

english: Are you sure there's nothing I can do, a chef can always do with help in their kitchen right?
translation: 你确定没什么我能做的吗？厨师在厨房里总是需要帮助的，对吧？

english: I'm a very competent cook! I do not need your assistance [player name]. Please leave me be.
translation: 我是个非常能干的厨师！我不需要你的帮助，[player name]。请别打扰我。

english: I hear you have brought the completed crest to my father. I must say, that was awfully impressive work.
translation: 我听说你把完成的徽章带给了我父亲。我必须说，那活儿干得真漂亮。

english: It was easy really.
translation: 其实很简单。

english: Yes well... Is there anything I can help you with?
translation: 是的，好吧……有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: Can you change my gauntlets for me?
translation: 你能帮我改造手套吗？

english: Your gauntlets have already been treated with my potions.
translation: 你的手套已经用我的药水处理过了。

english: You don't have any gauntlets I can imbue.
translation: 你没有任何我可以强化的手套。

english: Yes certainly, though it will cost you 25,000 coins.
translation: 当然可以，不过要花你25,000金币。

english: Oh, right.
translation: 哦，好的。

english: Great thanks!
translation: 太感谢了！

english: Caleb takes the gauntlets from you, pours some herbs and seasonings on them, bakes them on his range for a short time, then hands them back to you.
translation: 凯勒布从你手中拿过手套，在上面撒了些草药和调料，在他的炉灶上烤了一小会儿，然后递还给你。

english: No that's okay thanks.
translation: 不了，没事，谢谢。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: I have received word from my father that you assisted us again! I get the feeling you weren't going to stop trying until you did though.
translation: 我收到父亲的消息说你再次帮助了我们！不过我感觉你不会停止尝试直到成功。

english: As thanks, I'll provide you with as many pairs of Cooking gauntlets as you wish.
translation: 作为感谢，我会为你提供任意数量的烹饪手套。

english: You will find the rate you burn certain foods is much reduced whilst wearing these gauntlets.
translation: 你会发现戴上这些手套后，烧焦某些食物的几率大大降低。

english: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。

english: Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: 嘿，是英雄！哇！你太厉害了，你到底是怎么对付那两个成熟吸血鬼和加德兰克斯的？这城镇现在真不错，你做得太棒了！

english: You're more than welcome.

english: What do you do here?

translation: 我是卡林，正在这火堆旁取暖。

english: How do you like your town?

translation: 非常完美，非常感谢你的努力。

english: Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?

english: Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: 据我所知没有，我们现在有了一些基本设施，非常有用，我们都非常感激你。我从前没见过真正的英雄，没法比较，

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.

english: I'm just mining... Problem is, it's a struggle to get past all these fossil looking things.
translation: 我只是在采矿……问题是，很难清理这些看起来像化石的东西。

english: Can I help?
translation: 我能帮忙吗？

english: The others wouldn't like it if a human got involved... You lot tend to take too much from the rocks.
translation: 如果有人类参与，其他人会不高兴的……你们人类从岩石里挖得太狠。

english: But what if I were to sort out these fossil things you mentioned?
translation: 但如果我帮你处理这些你提到的化石东西呢？

english: Hmm... I shouldn't... And yet...

english: Okay, I'll tell you what... If you mine through these calcified deposits, you can keep whatever you get from them.
translation: 好吧，我告诉你……如果你开采这些钙化矿床，你可以保留从中得到的任何东西。

english: Are you sure?
translation: 你确定吗？

english: Yeah, why not. I'm tired of getting sprayed with all the water that leaks from these walls anyway. Not to mention it just brings out lots of extra useless bits with it!
translation: 是的，为什么不呢。反正我已经厌倦了被这些墙壁渗漏的水喷一身了。更不用说它还带出很多额外的无用碎片！

english: So the water makes the walls even more lucrative?
translation: 所以水让墙壁更有利可图？

english: If you consider pointless fossils lucrative, then I suppose.
translation: 如果你认为无意义的化石有利可图，那我想是的。

english: I see. I'll get to work then! See what I can do to help.
translation: 我明白了。那我开始工作吧！看看我能帮上什么忙。

english: What are these weird chippings?
translation: 这些奇怪的碎片是什么？

english: Bone shards! Totally pointless if you ask me, but I hear the humans up atop the mountain quite like them.
translation: 骨片！要我说完全没用，但我听说山顶上的人类很喜欢它们。

english: Apparently they offer them up as some sort of sacrifice, but I'm not too sure on the specifics. It's not like I ever go up there myself.
translation: 显然他们把它们作为某种祭品献上，但我不太确定具体细节。反正我自己从不去上面。

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！

english: Can you have a look at this chunk of rock?
translation: 你能看看这块岩石吗？

english: That's quite the chunk indeed. It looks to be a big mass of calcified rock.
translation: 那确实是块大岩石。看起来是一大块钙化岩石。

english: I reckon you'll be able to break it up on an anvil. Perhaps there might be something interesting inside...
translation: 我想你应该能在铁砧上把它敲碎。也许里面有什么有趣的东西……

english: Thanks! I'll go smash it open.
translation: 谢谢！我去把它砸开。

english: Smashing!
translation: 太棒了！

english: I found this weird moth.
translation: 我发现了这只奇怪的飞蛾。

english: Strange... I've never seen one of those before. That's quite the find.
translation: 奇怪……我以前从未见过那种。这可是个大发现。

english: Of all the creatures to find stuck in a wall, I didn't expect a moth.
translation: 在所有可能卡在墙里的生物中，我没想到会是飞蛾。

english: Moths carry a lot of magical power within this mountain. You can probably crush it to consume whatever power is left inside.
translation: 飞蛾在这座山里携带着很多魔法力量。你可能可以碾碎它来消耗里面剩余的力量。

english: Is that safe?
translation: 那安全吗？

english: Only one way to find out!
translation: 只有一个办法知道！

english: No, thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。

translation: 你想要一支点燃的蜡烛，1000金币？

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: But I don't have that kind of money on me.
translation: 但我身上没带那么多钱。

english: Well then, no candle for you!
translation: 那好吧，没蜡烛给你！

english: Here you go then.
translation: 那给你。

english: I should warn you, though, it can be dangerous to take a naked flame down there. You'd be better off making a lantern.
translation: 不过我应该警告你，带明火下去可能很危险。你最好做个灯笼。

english: What's so dangerous about a naked flame?
translation: 明火有什么危险的？

english: Heh heh... You'll find out.
translation: 嘿嘿……你会知道的。

english: Thanks, bye.
translation: 谢谢，再见。

english: One thousand gold?!
translation: 一千金币？！

english: Look, you're not going to be able to survive down that hole without a light source.
translation: 听着，没有光源你无法在那洞里生存。

english: So you could go off to the candle shop to buy one more cheaply. You could even make your own lantern, which is a lot better.
translation: 所以你可以去蜡烛店更便宜地买一支。你甚至可以自己做灯笼，那要好得多。

english: But I bet you want to find out what's down there right now, don't you? And you can pay me 1000 gold for the privilege!
translation: 但我打赌你现在就想知道下面有什么，对吧？你可以付我1000金币来获得这个特权！

english: All right, you win, I'll buy a candle.
translation: 好吧，你赢了，我买支蜡烛。

english: No way.
translation: 没门。

english: How do you make lanterns?
translation: 你怎么做灯笼？

english: Out of glass.The more advanced lanterns have a metal component as well.
translation: 用玻璃做的。更高级的灯笼也有金属部件。

english: Firstly you can make a simple candle lantern out of glass.It's just like a candle, but the flame isn't exposed, so it's safer.
translation: 首先你可以用玻璃做一个简单的蜡烛灯笼。就像蜡烛一样，但火焰不暴露，所以更安全。

english: Then you can make an oil lamp, which is brighter but has an exposed flame.But if you make an iron frame for it you can turn it into an oil lantern.
translation: 然后你可以做一盏油灯，更亮但有暴露的火焰。但如果你给它做个铁框架，就可以把它变成油灯笼。

english: Finally there's the bullseye lantern.You'll need to make a frame out of steel and add a glass lens.
translation: 最后是牛眼灯笼。你需要用钢做一个框架，再加一个玻璃透镜。

english: Once you've made your lamp or lantern, you'll need to make lamp oil for it.The chemist near Rimmington has a machine for that.
translation: 做好灯或灯笼后，你需要为它制作灯油。里明顿村附近的化学家有台机器可以做。

english: For any light source, you'll need a tinderbox to light it. Keep your tinderbox handy in case it goes out!
translation: 对于任何光源，你都需要火绒盒来点燃它。把火绒盒放在手边，以防它熄灭！

english: But if all that's too complicated, you can buy a candle right here for 1000 gold!
translation: 但如果这些都太复杂了，你可以在这里花1000金币买支蜡烛！

english: No thanks, I'd rather curse the darkness.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我宁愿诅咒黑暗。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: What's so dangerous about a naked flame?
translation: 明火有什么危险的？

english: How do you make lanterns?
translation: 你怎么做灯笼？

english: Thanks, bye.
translation: 谢谢，再见。

english: One thousand gold?!
translation: 一千金币？！

english: All right, you win, I'll buy a candle.
translation: 好吧，你赢了，我买支蜡烛。

english: No way.
translation: 没门。

english: No thanks, I'd rather curse the darkness.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我宁愿诅咒黑暗。

english: Player: Hello there.
translation: 玩家：你好。

english: Darling, who's this?
translation: 亲爱的，这是谁？

english: I don't know, darling. Why don't you ask them?
translation: 我不知道，亲爱的。你为什么不问问他们？

english: Yes, good idea!
translation: 是的，好主意！

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: I'm [Vampyre name].
translation: 我是 [Vampyre name]。

english: Hello, [Vampyre name]. I'm Caninelle Draynar and this is Pipistrelle Draynar.
translation: 你好，[Vampyre name]。我是卡尼内尔‧德雷纳，这是皮皮斯特雷尔‧德雷纳。

english: Hello there!
translation: 你好！

english: Draynar? Any connection to Draynor?
translation: 德雷纳？和德雷诺村有关系吗？

english: Oh yes. The Draynar family has been around since before vampyres came to this world.
translation: 哦是的。德雷纳家族在吸血鬼来到这个世界之前就存在了。

english: Over time, some people took the name and started pronouncing it differently. Hence Draynor.
translation: 随着时间的推移，有些人采用了这个名字并开始用不同的方式发音。因此有了德雷诺村。

english: Draynor is more commonly used as a first name though, with Draynar as a last name.
translation: 不过德雷诺更常用作名字，而德雷纳用作姓氏。

english: Thanks for the information. I wonder if there's a Draynor Draynar out there.
translation: 谢谢你的信息。我想知道外面有没有叫德雷诺‧德雷纳的人。

english: Now that would be funny.
translation: 那就有趣了。

english: See you around.
translation: 回头见。

english: Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: 人类！在我叫守卫前滚回奴隶栏！

english: Arrr, what do ye want?
translation: 啊，你想要什么？

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Arrr, it be a sad tale. I used to sail the seven seas, a-lootin' and a-plunderin' whatever took my fancy.
translation: 啊，这是个悲伤的故事。我曾经航行七大洋，掠夺任何我喜欢的东西。

english: Then I got a conscience, so I stopped being a pirate, and travelled the world giving back some of the loot I'd taken.
translation: 后来我有了良心，所以我不再当海盗，环游世界归还一些我掠夺的战利品。

english: Seems people didn't appreciate me interruptin' their business to give 'em free stuff, so now I'm locked up for harassment.
translation: 似乎人们不喜欢我打断他们的生意给他们免费东西，所以我现在因骚扰被关起来了。

english: Oh, I see.
translation: 哦，我明白了。

english: Nothing, thanks.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。

english: Nothing, eh? Nothing be all I got, anyway.
translation: 没什么，嗯？反正我一无所有。

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Nothing, thanks.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。

english: Ahoy Cap'n!
translation: 你好船长！

english: Ahoy there!
translation: 你好！

english: Avast ye scurvy swabs!
translation: 喂，你们这些坏血病擦甲板工！

english: Huh?
translation: 哈？

english: Don't mind me parrot, he's Cracked Jenny's Tea Cup!
translation: 别在意我的鹦鹉，它是破碎珍妮的茶杯！

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: This, me hearty, is the entrance to the Brimhaven Agility Arena!
translation: 这里，我的伙计，是布尔哈文敏捷竞技场的入口！

english: I were diggin for buried treasure when I found it! Amazed I was! It was a sight to behold!
translation: 我在挖掘埋藏的宝藏时发现了它！我很惊讶！那景象令人难忘！

english: Buried treasure!
translation: 埋藏的宝藏！

english: It were the biggest thing I'd ever seen! It must've been at least a league from side to side!
translation: 那是我见过的最大的东西！从一边到另一边至少有一里格！

english: It made me list, I were that excited!
translation: 它让我倾斜，我太兴奋了！

english: Get on with it!
translation: 继续说！

english: I'd found a huge cave with all these platforms. I reckon it be an ancient civilisation that made it. I had to be mighty careful as there was these traps everywhere! Dangerous it was!
translation: 我发现了一个巨大的洞穴，里面全是这些平台。我认为是某个古代文明建造的。我必须非常小心，因为到处都是陷阱！很危险！

english: Danger! Danger!
translation: 危险！危险！

english: Entrance is only 200 coins!
translation: 入场费只要200金币！

english: What do I do in the arena?
translation: 我在竞技场里做什么？

english: Well, me hearty, it's simple. Ye can cross between two platforms by using the traps or obstacles strung across 'em. Try and make your way to the pillar that is indicated by the flashing arrow.
translation: 嗯，我的伙计，很简单。你可以利用横跨平台的陷阱或障碍物在两个平台之间穿行。设法到达闪烁箭头指示的柱子。

english: Ye receive tickets for tagging more than one pillar in a row. So ye won't get a ticket from the first pillar but ye will for every platform ye tag in a row after that.
translation: 连续标记多个柱子会获得票券。所以第一个柱子不会给你票券，但之后连续标记的每个平台都会给你一张。

english: If ye miss a platform ye will miss out on the next ticket so try and get every platform you can! When ye be done, take the tickets to Jackie over there and she'll exchange them for more stuff!
translation: 如果错过一个平台就会错过下一张票券，所以尽量到达每个平台！完成后，把票券交给那边的杰基，她会给你兑换更多东西！

english: Tag when green light means tickets! Tag when red light means green light!
translation: 绿灯时标记意味着票券！红灯时标记意味着绿灯！

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！

english: I'd like to use the Agility Arena, please.
translation: 我想使用敏捷竞技场。

english: Aye, entrance be 200 coins.
translation: 是的，入场费200金币。

english: Pieces of eight!
translation: 八个里亚尔！

english: A word of warning me hearty! There are dangerous traps down there!
translation: 警告一句，我的伙计！下面有危险的陷阱！

english: I don't have the money on me at the moment.
translation: 我现在身上没带钱。

english: *squawk*
translation: 嘎嘎叫

english: No coins, no entrance!
translation: 没钱，别想进！

english: Okay, here's 200 coins.
translation: 好的，这是200金币。

english: You hand Cap'n Izzy 200 coins.
translation: 你把200金币交给伊兹船长。

english: May the wind be in ye sails!
translation: 愿风在你的帆中！

english: Never mind.
translation: 算了。

english: Can you tell me a bit about the Skillcape of Agility, please?
translation: 你能告诉我一些关于敏捷技能斗篷的事吗？

english: Aye, to be sure! The Skillcape of Agility be the symbol of the master of dexterity! Providing weight reduction, one who wears it can climb like a cat, run like the wind and jump like...err, well, jump like a jumping thing!
translation: 是的，当然！敏捷技能斗篷是敏捷大师的象征！提供减重效果，穿戴者可以像猫一样攀爬，像风一样奔跑，像……呃，好吧，像会跳的东西一样跳跃！

english: Now, be there anything else ye'd like to know?
translation: 现在，还有什么你想知道的吗？

english: May I buy a Skillcape of Agility, please?
translation: 我可以买一件敏捷技能斗篷吗？

english: Most certainly, having it equipped reduces your weight and I think it will really suit you. All that remains to be done is pay me 99000 gold!
translation: 当然可以，装备它可以减轻你的体重，我觉得它很适合你。剩下的就是付我99,000金币！

english: I'm afraid I can't afford that.
translation: 恐怕我买不起。

english: So sad, too bad. Go and pickpocket some wealthy people and come back here once you're richer.
translation: 真遗憾，太糟糕了。去偷窃一些有钱人，等富有了再回来。

english: Certainly, here you go.
translation: 当然可以。

english: But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: 但不幸的是，我身上没带够钱。

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.
translation: 嗯，等你有钱了再来找我。

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 不幸的是，所有技能斗篷都附带免费兜帽，这是技能促销活动的一部分；买一送一嘛。所以你得先腾出一些物品栏空间，我才能卖给你。

english: Excellent! That cape really does suit you.
translation: 太好了！那斗篷真的很适合你。

english: May I have another hood for my cape, please?
translation: 能再给我的斗篷要一个兜帽吗？

english: Most certainly, and free of charge!
translation: 当然可以，而且免费！

english: Cap'n Izzy No-Beard hands you another hood for your skillcape.
translation: 无须伊兹船长递给你另一件技能斗篷的兜帽。

english: See you later.
translation: 回头见。

english: Can I help you with something?
translation: 有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: Well, I'm here about a treasure trail...
translation: 嗯，我是来寻宝线索的……

english: Ah, you'll be wanting to talk to him then.
translation: 啊，那你想跟他谈谈。

english: Him?
translation: 他？

english: Avast!
translation: 喂！

english: Answer this and I'll give you treasure!
translation: 回答这个我就给你宝藏！

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
translation: 请输入问题的答案。

english: Try again! Try again!
translation: 再试一次！再试一次！

english: Squawk! Pieces of eight!
translation: 嘎嘎！八个里亚尔！

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: What do I do in the arena?
translation: 我在竞技场里做什么？

english: I'd like to use the Agility Arena, please.
translation: 我想使用敏捷竞技场。

english: Okay, here's 200 coins.
translation: 好的，这是200金币。

english: Never mind.
translation: 算了。

english: Can you tell me a bit about the Skillcape of Agility, please?
translation: 你能告诉我一些关于敏捷技能斗篷的事吗？

english: Is it true you sell Skillcapes of Agility?
translation: 你真的卖敏捷技能斗篷吗？

english: I'm afraid I can't afford that.
translation: 恐怕我买不起。

english: Certainly, here you go.
translation: 当然可以。

english: Skillcape
translation: 技能斗篷

english: Hood
translation: 兜帽

english: See you later.
translation: 回头见。

english: [Ah, hello there, laddie/Ah, hello there, lassie/Ah, hello there]! I've just dug up an old treasure chest of mine.
translation: [啊，你好啊，小伙子/啊，你好啊，姑娘/啊，你好]！我刚挖出了一个旧宝箱。

english: Problem is, these old hands o'mine aren't as useful as they used t'be, and the lock on that chest is a little bit too fiddly for ol' Cap'n Arnav. Could you help me out?
translation: 问题是，我这双老手不如以前好用了，那宝箱的锁对老阿纳夫船长来说有点太复杂了。你能帮我吗？

english: Yes, I'll help you unlock your chest.
translation: 是的，我帮你打开宝箱。

english: There are three columns. What you need to do for me is to match up each picture with the word underneath the column, and then unlock the chest.
translation: 有三列。你需要帮我把每张图片与列下方的单词匹配，然后打开宝箱。

english: No, sorry.
translation: 不，抱歉。

english: Ah, well done matey, that's the right combination. Here, have a little somethin' for helpin' me out.
translation: 啊，干得好伙计，那是正确的组合。来，给你点小东西作为帮忙的回报。

english: Arrr! That be nowhere near close! Did ye not listen the first time around?
translation: 啊！差得远了！你第一次没听吗？

english: Sorry, I must have misunderstood your instructions. Could I hear them again please?
translation: 抱歉，我一定误解了你的指示。能再说一遍吗？

english: Right, right. What you need to do is click on the arrows to roll the cylinders round to the different items.
translation: 好的，好的。你需要点击箭头转动圆柱到不同的物品。

english: When the items in the middle row all match the words written under the column then you'll have solved the lock.
translation: 当中间行的物品都与列下方写的单词匹配时，你就解开了锁。

english: Is that a little clearer?
translation: 这样清楚一点了吗？

english: Certainly. Let me try again.
translation: 当然，让我再试一次。

english: Arrr! I'd better find someone else.
translation: 啊！我最好找别人。

english: Arrr, I'd better be off.
translation: 啊，我最好走了。

english: Arrr, you're not the person I be needin'.
translation: 啊，你不是我需要的人。

english: Avast there, [player name]!
translation: 喂，[player name]！

english: Ahoy, [player name]!
translation: 你好，[player name]！

english: Parley wi' me, my old fruit!
translation: 跟我谈谈，我的老朋友！

english: I needs yer help, [player name]!
translation: 我需要你的帮助，[player name]！

english: I got treasure here, [player name]!
translation: 我这里有宝藏，[player name]！

english: Shiver me' timbers, are you ignoring me?
translation: 天哪，你在无视我吗？

english: Will ye help an old pirate, [player name]?
translation: 你会帮助一个老海盗吗，[player name]？

english: I knows somethin' you should knows, [player name].
translation: 我知道一些你应该知道的事，[player name]。

english: Maybe later.
translation: 也许待会儿。

english: Yes, I'll help you unlock your chest.
translation: 是的，我帮你打开宝箱。

english: No, sorry.
translation: 不，抱歉。

english: What do you want, civilian?
translation: 你想要什么，平民？

english: What are you doing?
translation: 你在做什么？

english: What does it look like I'm doing? I'm training this useless bunch of recruits!
translation: 你看我在做什么？我在训练这群没用的新兵！

english: Oh yes, they look very fit.
translation: 哦是的，他们看起来很强壮。

english: They're nothing but a useless bunch of weaklings who won't survive an hour once they're out on patrol.
translation: 他们只是一群没用的弱者，出去巡逻后活不过一小时。

english: Have you lost your mind? Earlier you said they looked fit! Just go away and leave me alone.
translation: 你疯了吗？刚才你说他们看起来很强壮！走开别烦我。

english: Oh yes, they look very weak.
translation: 哦是的，他们看起来很弱。

english: Show some respect when you talk about my men, civilian!
translation: 说到我的人时放尊重点，平民！

english: Have you lost your mind? Earlier you said they looked weak! Just go away and leave me alone.
translation: 你疯了吗？刚才你说他们看起来很弱！走开别烦我。

english: Can I have some armour like yours?
translation: 我能要一套像你这样的盔甲吗？

english: Only guards of Varrock can wear this armour.
translation: 只有维洛克城守卫才能穿这套盔甲。

english: Well, I could become a guard of Varrock.
translation: 嗯，我可以成为维洛克城守卫。

english: Oh yeah? I see you've got a Thieving level of [thieving level]. That must give you quite a long criminal record.
translation: 哦是吗？我看你的盗窃等级是 [thieving level]。那你的犯罪记录一定很长。

english: I could repent of my evil ways if you like.
translation: 如果你愿意，我可以改邪归正。

english: So you really want to be a guard, huh?
translation: 所以你真的想当守卫，嗯？

english: Yes, that's right.
translation: 是的。

english: Does it worry you that the life expectancy of a guard is about 30 seconds?
translation: 守卫的寿命大约只有30秒，你不担心吗？

english: No, that doesn't worry me.
translation: 不，我不担心。

english: Bah! You just failed the intelligence test. Go away, civilian.
translation: 呸！你刚通过了智力测试。走开，平民。

english: Actually, forget it.
translation: 其实，算了。

english: Go away, coward.
translation: 走开，懦夫。

english: I want nothing.
translation: 我什么都不想要。

english: Lucky you. Go away.
translation: 你真幸运。走开。

english: Make those dummies suffer!
translation: 让那些假人受苦！

english: Imagine it's your aunt!
translation: 想象那是你姑妈！

english: You won't last 2 minutes in the real world!
translation: 你在现实世界里撑不过2分钟！

english: Show some backbone!
translation: 拿出点骨气来！

english: Let's get some proper bloodlust here!
translation: 让我们这里有点真正的嗜血欲望！

english: Bah, why do I bother with you lot?
translation: 呸，我为什么要跟你们这些人费心？

english: Just hit the thing already!
translation: 快打那个东西！

english: Hit the dummy! Hit the dummy!
translation: 打假人！打假人！

english: Useless! Utterly useless!
translation: 没用！完全没用！

english: Hit the dummy before I come over there and hit you!
translation: 在我过来打你之前先打假人！

english: What are you doing?
translation: 你在做什么？

english: Oh yes, they look very fit.
translation: 哦是的，他们看起来很强壮。

english: Can I have some armour like yours?
translation: 我能要一套像你这样的盔甲吗？

english: Oh yes, they look very weak.
translation: 哦是的，他们看起来很弱。

english: No, that doesn't worry me.
translation: 不，我不担心。

english: Actually, forget it.
translation: 其实，算了。

english: I want nothing.
translation: 我什么都不想要。

english: Good day, traveller.
translation: 你好，旅行者。

english: Hello there. I was wondering if you could tell me anything about the missing people.
translation: 你好。我想知道你能否告诉我一些关于失踪人员的事。

english: Not really. We put a lot of effort into finding them, but nothing came of it.
translation: 不太清楚。我们花了很多精力寻找他们，但一无所获。

english: Where do you think they went?
translation: 你认为他们去了哪里？

english: Well, some say they got lost in the mountains. Others say they decided to go and live somewhere like Fortis instead of here. I'm not too sure myself. It is a large number of people who've vanished...
translation: 嗯，有人说他们在山里迷路了。其他人说他们决定去福蒂斯城之类的地方生活而不是这里。我自己也不太确定。失踪的人数很多……

english: But you stopped looking?
translation: 但你们停止寻找了？

english: It was taking up a lot of resources. We don't have a huge number of guards here, so I need to use my people wisely.
translation: 这占用了很多资源。我们这里守卫不多，所以我需要明智地用人。

english: If we get a new lead, I'm happy to send them out again, but right now it's like looking for a needle in a haystack.
translation: 如果有新线索，我很乐意再派人出去，但现在就像大海捞针。

english: I see. Thanks for the information.
translation: 我明白了。谢谢你的信息。

english: Hello there. Would you like to travel somewhere? I can take you to Rimmington or Brimhaven for 30 coins.
translation: 你好。你想去某个地方吗？我可以带你去里明顿村或布尔哈文镇，30金币。

english: I'd like to go to Rimmington.
translation: 我想去里明顿村。

english: Come back when you've got 30 coins for me.
translation: 等你有30金币再来找我。

english: You board the ship and sail to Rimmington.
translation: 你登上船驶向里明顿村。

english: I'd like to go to Brimhaven.
translation: 我想去布尔哈文镇。

english: You board the ship and sail to Brimhaven.
translation: 你登上船驶向布尔哈文镇。

english: I'm good thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。

english: Or I could pay you nothing at all...
translation: 或者我完全可以不付你钱……

english: Well that seems totally reasonable. Where would you like to go?
translation: 嗯，那似乎完全合理。你想去哪里？

english: Hello there. Would you like to travel somewhere? I can take you to Ardougne or Brimhaven for 30 coins.
translation: 你好。你想去某个地方吗？我可以带你去阿多尼城或布尔哈文镇，30金币。

english: I'd like to go to Ardougne.
translation: 我想去阿多尼城。

english: You board the ship and sail to Ardougne.
translation: 你登上船驶向阿多尼城。

english: Hello there. Would you like to travel somewhere? I can take you to Rimmington or Ardougne for 30 coins.
translation: 你好。你想去某个地方吗？我可以带你去里明顿村或阿多尼城，30金币。
