english: Hello, [player name]! Let's go!
translation: 你好，[player name]！我们走吧！

english: Glider here for [player name].
translation: [player name] 的滑翔机在这里。

english: Come on, [player name]!
translation: 快点，[player name]！

english: Don't keep me waiting, [player name]!
translation: 别让我等，[player name]！

english: Where's [player name]?
translation: [player name] 在哪？

english: [player name]? Where are you?
translation: [player name]？你在哪里？

english: Oh, I give up.
translation: 哦，我放弃了。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Well hello there, how you doing?
translation: 哟你好啊，最近怎么样？

english: Not bad, yourself?
translation: 还不错，你呢？

english: I'm great now, those goblins can't get close with this cannon blasting at them!
translation: 我现在好多了，有大炮轰着那些哥布林，它们靠不近！

english: Don't let any goblins through the breach in our fence!
translation: 别让任何哥布林穿过我们围栏的缺口！

english: Keep an eye open for goblins!
translation: 留意哥布林的动向！

english: Don't just do something! Stand there!
translation: 别瞎忙活！就站那儿！

english: Stop dawdling soldier! You're in the army now!
translation: 别磨蹭了士兵！你现在在军队里！

english: Hurry up on that patrol route, trooper!
translation: 快点完成巡逻路线，士兵！

english: Hello! What can I do for you?
translation: 你好！有什么能帮你的？

english: Where am I exactly?
translation: 我具体在哪里？

english: This is the port of Land's End!
translation: 这里是兰兹角港！

english: Can you tell me about the local area?
translation: 你能跟我说说这片区域吗？

english: Certainly. We're on the southern edge of the Kingdom of Great Kourend.
translation: 当然。我们位于大库尔德王国的南端。

english: The kingdom is made up of five main cities. You'll find Shayzien and Lovakengj to the north, and the remaining cities to the north east.
translation: 王国由五座主要城市组成。谢兹恩和洛瓦肯吉在北方，其余城市在东北方。

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

english: I'd like to travel to Port Piscarilius, please.
translation: 我想去皮斯卡里琉斯港。

english: As you wish.
translation: 如你所愿。

english: I'd like to travel to Port Sarim, please.
translation: 我想去沙林港。

english: As you wish, I hope you don't get seasick, it is a long voyage.
translation: 如你所愿，希望你不要晕船，航程很长。

english: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: Where am I exactly?
translation: 我具体在哪里？

english: Can you take me to Port Piscarilius please?
translation: 你能带我去皮斯卡里琉斯港吗？

english: Can you take me to Port Sarim please?
translation: 你能带我去沙林港吗？

english: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: Adventurer. The General warned us about you.
translation: 冒险者。将军警告过我们要留意你。

english: Warned?
translation: 警告？

english: Yes. He said you might show up here again. We're not to harm you, but make no mistake, we're keeping a close eye on you. You're not to be trusted.
translation: 是的。他说你可能会再来这里。我们不能伤害你，但别搞错，我们正密切关注你。你不可信。

english: Well I guess that's the best I can hope for. So how are things going here?
translation: 嗯，我想那已经是最好的结果了。这里情况怎么样？

english: We are not here to make small talk. Leave us to our work.
translation: 我们不是来闲聊的。让我们工作吧。

english: Hey, how's it going?
translation: 嘿，最近怎么样？

english: You again? As I told you before, we are not here to make small talk. Leave us to our work.
translation: 又是你？我之前说过，我们不是来闲聊的。让我们工作吧。

english: I already told you to stop bothering us. Please go away.
translation: 我已经告诉过你别打扰我们。请走开。

english: Hello, what are you doing here, so far from home?
translation: 你好，你在这里做什么，离家这么远？

english: I'm enjoyn' the local hoschpitalieee. hee hee.
translation: 我在享受当地的……款待……嘻嘻。

english: Looks like you've enjoyed more than your fair share of hospitality.
translation: 看来你享受的款待有点过头了。

english: tee hee, I probblie schoodn' 'av anuva drinkie right now. But dis dwarven beer ish kind of moreish after the fiff pint.
translation: 嘻嘻，我可能……现在不该再喝了。但这矮人啤酒……第五杯之后有点……上头。

english: I'd go easy on the dwarven stout if I were you.
translation: 我要是你，会少喝点矮人黑啤酒。

english: I yousht to be a tesht pilot yoo know. I reeel hero.
translation: 我……曾经是试飞员……你知道吗。真正的……英雄。

english: But I loscht my bottle. Scho I now ffind scholiss in the bottle.
translation: 但我……丢了胆量。所以我现在……在瓶子里找胆量。

english: What happened? Did you have a glider crash or get attacked by huge flying birds or something?
translation: 发生什么事了？滑翔机坠毁了还是被巨型飞鸟袭击了？

english: Naaah, I realished I woz scared ov heightsh.
translation: 不……我发现我……恐高。

english: Ah, I can see that would be a problem ... You should keep an eye on your drinking, though.
translation: 啊，我明白那会是个问题……不过你该节制点喝酒。

english: I'll try. Bofe eyez...
translation: 我会的。两只……眼睛都盯着……

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 虽然你找到了顾客，但你似乎没带正确的食物！你需要 [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]！

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 恐怕预制菜不行。只有手工制作的地精美食才配得上高空阿卢夫的顾客。

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food item] to Captain Ninto.
translation: 你把 [a/some] [ordered gnome food item] 的配送交给宁托船长。

english: Aaa shomefing ter go wiv my beer. Thish dwarf beerz quite shtrong you know...
translation: 啊……配啤酒的……东西。这矮人啤酒……挺烈的，你知道……

english: Here you go, have a dashing pilot's scarf.
translation: 给你，拿条帅气的飞行员围巾。

english: I have some spare goggles, you might as well have them.
translation: 我有些备用的护目镜，你也拿着吧。

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: 你一定走了很远的路才把这个送到我这里，这里有点额外的小意思，拿着当小费。

english: You are given [a/some] [reward item(s)] as a tip.
translation: 你获得 [a/some] [reward item(s)] 作为小费。

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
translation: 你有 [number] 积分可以兑换免费配送代币。你还没有资格获得地精美食配送。

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 你有 [number] 积分可以兑换免费配送代币。你可以获得 [number] 份地精美食配送。

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: 别忘了从小阿卢夫‧吉安那里领取你的免费配送代币。

english: Hello, who are you?
translation: 你好，你是谁？

english: Ahoy! I'm Cap'n Pudi, currently assisting the Spirit Anglers in their effort against Tempoross.
translation: 你好！我是普迪船长，目前正在协助海灵垂钓者对抗海灵。

english: Tempoross? Spirit Anglers? Who are they?
translation: 海灵？海灵垂钓者？他们是谁？

english: You 'aven't heard?! The freak storms? Sailors running into trouble? Ye really must be a landlubber!
translation: 你没听说过？！那些怪异的风暴？水手们遭遇麻烦？你真是个旱鸭子！

english: Tempoross is some kind o' great sea spirit that's been spookin' sailors and causing crazy storms!
translation: 海灵是某种伟大的海洋灵体，一直恐吓水手并引发疯狂风暴！

english: Taiman and his crew were one of the first t' run into it. Washed up outside Al Kharid amongst piles of debris, they did. 'Tis a troublin' time to be a cap'n!
translation: 泰曼和他的船员是最早遭遇它的其中之一。他们被冲到阿尔卡里德城外的一堆残骸中。当船长可真不容易！

english: Oh that doesn't sound good at all!
translation: 哦，那听起来一点都不好！

english: It isn't, but worry not. The Spirit Anglers 'ave been formed t' tackle this beastie! We're recruiting all skilled sailors and fisherfolk t' help us.
translation: 确实不好，但别担心。海灵垂钓者已经组建起来对付这头野兽！我们正在招募所有熟练的水手和渔民来帮忙。

english: Well I can definitely fish!
translation: 嗯，我肯定会钓鱼！

english: Are you sure? It's pretty rough out there and you look like you could do with more experience.
translation: 你确定吗？外面风浪很大，你看起来需要更多经验。

english: You need a Fishing level of 35 to fight Tempoross.
translation: 你需要35级钓鱼等级才能对抗海灵。

english: Excellent!
translation: 太好了！

english: The ships on the dock regularly embark to Tempoross Cove. Once there, you'll need to keep the cannons loaded with Harpoonfish t' weaken the Spirit. You can fish 'em on the island.
translation: 码头上的船定期前往海灵海湾。到了那里，你需要用叉鱼装填大炮来削弱灵体。你可以在岛上钓到它们。

english: When Tempoross submerges, get up close and clear the fish from its whirlpools; they're how it gets its energy.
translation: 当海灵潜入水中时，靠近并从它的漩涡中清理鱼；那是它获取能量的方式。

english: Well, that sounds easy enough!
translation: 嗯，那听起来挺简单的！

english: Aye, that be the easy part!
translation: 是的，那是简单的部分！

english: The storm of Tempoross will rage around you, so you better be ready to deal with lightning strikes and avoid getting zapped when Tempoross attacks the cannons.
translation: 海灵的风暴会在你周围肆虐，所以你最好准备好应对雷击，避免在海灵攻击大炮时被电到。

english: Also, watch out for those mighty waves! You'll want t' tether yourself t' something solid so you don't find yourself lost in the deep blue when they come crashing down!
translation: 另外，小心那些巨浪！你要把自己绑在坚固的东西上，这样当浪打下来时你不会迷失在深海中！

english: Oh... Well, I suppose I can do that.
translation: 哦……嗯，我想我能做到。

english: Will I need any special equipment?
translation: 我需要任何特殊装备吗？

english: Everythin' you need can be found on-board. Though if you have a favourite harpoon, you can always bring that!
translation: 你需要的一切都能在船上找到。不过如果你有喜欢的鱼叉，随时可以带上！

english: The complete Spirit Anglers outfit also has an 'andy harness built-in, so you won't need a rope if you're wearin' it. You can speak t' Gita about getting one.
translation: 完整的海灵垂钓者套装还内置了安全 harness，所以如果你穿着它就不需要绳子了。你可以跟吉塔谈谈弄一套。

english: Ye can find Gita just east of 'ere, next t' some fishin' equipment.
translation: 你可以在这里东边找到吉塔，就在一些钓鱼装备旁边。

english: When you're ready, just board the ship and we'll set sail soon!
translation: 准备好后，直接上船，我们很快就起航！

english: Aye aye cap'n!
translation: 是是，船长！

english: Are there any benefits to helping the Spirit Anglers?
translation: 帮助海灵垂钓者有什么好处吗？

english: Other than maintainin' safe passage and savin' lives?!
translation: 除了维持航道安全和拯救生命之外？！

english: Well...
I'm just messin' with ye! Of course there are benefits!
translation: 我只是逗你玩的！当然有好处！

english: We find all sorts washed up by the storms. Aside from the usual junk, we often find old chests from merchant supply ships, as well as the odd artefact here and there.
translation: 我们会发现各种被风暴冲上来的东西。除了常见的垃圾，我们经常能找到商船补给箱，还有一些零散的古董。

english: If it's not needed for the Spirit Anglers' research, it's yours to keep!
translation: 如果海灵垂钓者研究不需要，就是你的！

english: Some of the more resourceful Spirit Anglers also discovered a fishing use for the spirit energised scales shed by the fish within Tempoross. You're free t' keep any you find.
translation: 一些更聪明的海灵垂钓者还发现了海灵内鱼类脱落的灵能鱼鳞的钓鱼用途。你找到的都可以留着。

english: Can you remind me what to do on the island?
translation: 你能提醒我在岛上要做什么吗？

english: Can you tell me more about the Spirit Anglers?
translation: 你能告诉我更多关于海灵垂钓者的事吗？

english: Well, as I mentioned before, Taiman and his fishing crew from Al Kharid 'ad a tussle with Tempoross. They barely made it back.
translation: 嗯，如我之前所说，泰曼和他的阿尔卡里德渔民船员与海灵交手过。他们勉强逃了回来。

english: I was sitting down by the shore enjoying one of Karim's kebabs at the time, when suddenly the crew washed up amongst a pile of debris. Looked like they'd just seen a ghost!
translation: 我当时正坐在岸边享受卡里姆的烤肉串，突然船员们被冲到一堆残骸中。看起来就像刚见到鬼一样！

english: As soon as they could talk sense they went to the Chancellor and within days more shockin' tales of the Sea Spirit's wrath came in.
translation: 他们一能说话就去找了总督，几天内更多关于海洋灵体愤怒的惊人消息传来。

english: The Chancellor called a meeting for all us local seafarin' folk and we agreed action must be taken!
translation: 总督召集了我们所有当地航海人士开会，我们同意必须采取行动！

english: Ain't nothin' goin' t' take the seas from me, even if it is a powerful spirit!
translation: 没什么能夺走我的海洋，即使是强大的灵体也不行！

english: Anyway, it was decided that we'd setup a base 'ere amongst these ruins, and so the Spirit Anglers was formed!
translation: 总之，我们决定在这片废墟中建立基地，海灵垂钓者就这样成立了！

english: Don't ask me what the ruins used to be. And it's not like Menaphos can 'ave a say!
translation: 别问我这些废墟以前是什么。反正梅纳菲特也插不上话！

english: Whatever they are, they make a fine base for the Spirit Anglers!
translation: 不管它们是什么，作为海灵垂钓者的基地再好不过了！

english: Since moving in, we've been recruiting fisherfolk from all over, and some of the readin' types 'ave been studyin' Tempoross durin' our trips to subdue it.
translation: 搬进来后，我们一直在从各地招募渔民，一些爱读书的人在我們制服海灵的航行中研究它。

english: I like t' get stuck in, me-self; face off toe t' toe with the beastie. I'll be right by your side when you go out there!
translation: 我喜欢亲自上阵；与那头野兽正面交锋。你出去时我就在你身边！

english: Well that's encouraging, I think...
translation: 嗯，那挺鼓舞人心的，我想……

english: I'm still 'ere, ain't I?
translation: 我还在这里，不是吗？

english: Anyway, there's plenty o' research going on, so maybe you can find some notes lyin' around if ye want to know more.
translation: 总之，有很多研究在进行，所以如果你想了解更多，也许能找到一些笔记。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Hello again!
translation: 又见面了！

english: Ahoy there! What can I 'elp ye with?
translation: 你好！有什么能帮你的？

english: Sorry, it's pretty rough out there and you look like you could do with more experience.
translation: 抱歉，外面风浪很大，你看起来需要更多经验。

english: What do you need, adventurer? There is a battle to fight!
translation: 你需要什么，冒险者？有场战斗要打！

english: How do I help?
translation: 我怎么帮忙？

english: Get yerself a harpoon from the crate on the ship, then go fish around the island t' catch some harpoonfish. They make fer fine ammo against Tempoross!
translation: 先从船上箱子里取把鱼叉，再去岛屿周边钓些叉鱼。这些叉鱼可是对抗海灵的绝佳弹药！

english: Once ye caught some, ye can cook 'em at the shrines on the island if ye want 'em to pack more of a punch. Then come back t' the ship an' load 'em in the ammunition crates next to the cannons.
translation: 捕获一些后，若想增强威力，可在岛上的神龛处烹饪。随后返回船只，将它们装入大炮旁的弹药箱内。

english: Our cannoneers will get t' firin' the harpoonfish at Tempoross. When it's weak an' submerges to recover its energy, get down to the jetty next t' the ship an' fish those spirit pools.
translation: 我们的炮手会向海灵发射叉鱼。待其虚弱潜入水中恢复能量时，前往船旁的码头钓那些灵池里的鱼。

english: Be quick with fishin' those spirit pools though, or it'll come back so strong we'll have to abandon the fight! With any luck, we'll weaken those spirit fish enough t' subdue Tempoross. Now get t' the fight, sailor!
translation: 不过钓那些灵池里的鱼要快，否则它恢复得太强我们就得放弃战斗！运气好的话，我们会削弱那些灵魂鱼足以制服海灵。现在去战斗吧，水手！

english: Aye aye!
translation: 是是！

english: What should I watch out for?
translation: 我应该小心什么？

english: If Tempoross electrocutes a cannon t' stop it from firin', ya better load your harpoonfish into the other ammunition crates t' keep them cannons firin' instead.
translation: 如果海灵电击一门大炮使其无法开火，你最好把叉鱼装进其他弹药箱，让那些大炮继续开火。

english: Also, make sure t' grab a rope from the ship crates an' keep an eye out for big waves. We'll make sure t' shout about them. Then ye best quickly tether yerself t' an island totem pole or ship mast with that rope.
translation: 另外，一定要从船上的箱子里拿根绳子，注意大浪。我们会大声提醒。然后你最好 赶紧用那根绳子把自己绑在岛的图腾柱或船桅上。

english: If the waves break the totem pole or ship mast, ye can grab a hammer from the ship crates t' fix 'em up before the next big wave hits.
translation: 如果海浪打断了图腾柱或船桅，你可以在下次大浪来临前从船上的箱子里拿个锤子修好它们。

english: Oh, an' keep an eye out for lightnin' clouds causin' fires. Get a bucket from the ship crates, fill it with water at a pump, and get t' puttin it out before it spreads.
translation: 哦，还要注意闪电云引起的火灾。从船上的箱子里拿个桶，在水泵处装满水，在火势蔓延前把它扑灭。

english: If ye get hit by the waves or fire, don't be surprised when ye lose those fish an' tools ye gathered. Now get t' the fight, sailor!
translation: 如果你被海浪或火焰击中，别惊讶于你丢失了那些鱼和工具。现在去战斗吧，水手！

english: I want to leave.
translation: 我想离开。

english: Really? You will receive no reward if you do.
translation: 真的？如果你离开将不会获得任何奖励。

english: Yes, I really want to leave.
translation: 是的，我真的想离开。

english: No, I don't want to leave.
translation: 不，我不想离开。

english: I'll get on with the fighting.
translation: 我继续战斗。

english: We did it! Tempoross has been sudbued once again. Well done!
translation: 我们做到了！海灵再次被制服了。干得好！

english: Take a well deserved rest but don't get too comfy, it'll regain its energy soon enough!
translation: 好好休息，但别太舒服，它很快就会恢复能量！

english: What should I do now?
translation: 我现在该做什么？

english: We usually find some debris washed up near the docks back at Unkah. Feel free t' have a look. Ya might find somethin' useful!
translation: 我们通常在昂卡遗址附近的码头发现一些被冲上来的残骸。随便看看。你可能会找到有用的东西！

english: It won't be long before Tempoross regains enough energy to be a problem and we'll have to wrangle it again. Hopefully we can count on you to 'elp!
translation: 用不了多久海灵就会恢复足够能量再次成为问题，我们得再次对付它。希望我们能指望你帮忙！

english: I'm ready to leave.
translation: 我准备离开了。

english: Aye aye!
translation: 是是！

english: Excellent work out there! The seas are safe for a little longer thanks to you!
translation: 外面干得漂亮！多亏了你，海域安全了一段时间！

english: We usually find some debris washed up near the docks. Feel free to have a look. Ya might find somethin' useful!
translation: 我们通常在码头附近发现一些被冲上来的残骸。随便看看。你可能会找到有用的东西！

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！

english: Argh, we let that storm grow too fierce... As soon as it's safe we'll 'ead straight back out!
translation: 啊，我们让那场风暴变得太猛烈了……一旦安全我们就直接回去！

english: Aye aye, Cap'n!
translation: 是是，船长！

english: Join the Spirit Anglers!
translation: 加入海灵垂钓者！

english: Plenty of room for more adventurers!
translation: 还有 充足空间给更多冒险者！

english: Come and help us fight Tempoross!
translation: 来帮我们对抗海灵！

english: It'll be worth your while...
translation: 这会值得的……

english: To the boats! We'll set sail soon!
translation: 上船！我们很快就起航！

english: We'll set sail in the next [25/20/15/10/5] seconds.
translation: 我们将在接下来的 [25/20/15/10/5] 秒内起航。

english: Let's get underway!
translation: 我们出发吧！

english: Belay that! We'll try again later.
translation: 取消！我们稍后再试。

english: Tempoross will surface soon, prepare yourselves!
translation: 海灵很快就会浮出水面，做好准备！

english: More fish!
translation: 更多鱼！

english: Load those cannons!
translation: 装填那些大炮！

english: Keep an eye on the waves!
translation: 注意海浪！

english: Tempoross is drawing in water, prepare yourselves!
translation: 海灵正在吸水，做好准备！

english: The mast has been damaged!
translation: 桅杆受损了！

english: Storm clouds are rolling in, get your buckets ready!
translation: 暴风雨云来了，准备好你们的桶！

english: Tempoross has disabled a cannon! Switch to another!
translation: 海灵使一门大炮失效了！换另一门！

english: Tempoross has submerged, fish from the whirlpools!
translation: 海灵潜入水中，从漩涡里钓鱼！

english: Tempoross has surfaced, keep those cannons firing!
translation: 海灵浮出水面，让那些大炮继续开火！

english: Tempoross has retreated to the depths!
translation: 海灵撤退到深处了！

english: Tempoross has gathered too much energy!
translation: 海灵聚集了太多能量！

english: The storm has grown too strong, we must retreat!
translation: 风暴变得太强了，我们必须撤退！

english: Are there any benefits to helping the Spirit Anglers?
translation: 帮助海灵垂钓者有什么好处吗？

english: Can you remind me what to do on the island?
translation: 你能提醒我在岛上要做什么吗？

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Can you tell me more about the Spirit Anglers?
translation: 你能告诉我更多关于海灵垂钓者的事吗？

english: How do I help?
translation: 我怎么帮忙？

english: What should I watch out for?
translation: 我应该小心什么？

english: I want to leave.
translation: 我想离开。

english: Yes, I really want to leave.
translation: 是的，我真的想离开。

english: No, I don't want to leave.
translation: 不，我不想离开。

english: I'll get on with the fighting.
translation: 我继续战斗。

english: What should I do now?
translation: 我现在该做什么？

english: I'm ready to leave.
translation: 我准备离开了。

english: Attention! Front and centre!
translation: 注意！立正！

english: Yes ma'am!
translation: 是的，女士！

english: I have to ask you to get back from here [sir/lady].
translation: 我必须请你离开这里，[sir/lady]。

english: Why? What's going on here?
translation: 为什么？这里发生什么事了？

english: This is the Lizardman Canyon. The lizardmen from the west are desperately trying to invade Great Kourend.
translation: 这里是蜥蜴人峡谷。来自西方的蜥蜴人正拼命试图入侵大库尔德王国。

english: We were able to hold them back, so they've started tunnelling under the kingdom and into this canyon to bypass our defences.
translation: 我们成功挡住了他们，所以他们开始在王国地下挖隧道，进入这个峡谷以绕过我们的防御。

english: Luckily, we were able to work out what they were doing and move to stop them. So far we've managed to keep them trapped within the canyon, but we need to constantly hold them at bay.
translation: 幸运的是，我们弄清楚了他们的计划并采取措施阻止他们。到目前为止，我们成功把他们困在峡谷内，但我们需要持续遏制他们。

english: I'm a very strong adventurer. Would I be able to help out in the battle?
translation: 我是个很强的冒险者。我能帮忙战斗吗？

english: No! We would never trust a stranger in the importance of a battle! A lot is at stake.
translation: 不！我们绝不会在如此重要的战斗中信任陌生人！事关重大。

english: You may. Head into the canyon and take the fight to those monsters!
translation: 你可以。进入峡谷，与那些怪物战斗！

english: Beware the Chambers of Xeric, adventurer.
translation: 小心泽里克圣所，冒险者。

english: These dungeons and the perils within them are unique. You will encounter both dangerous and mysterious creatures here.
translation: 这些地下城和其中的危险是独特的。你会在这里遇到危险和神秘的生物。

english: Remember that you may be kicked out at any time - any items dropped on the ground will be lost inside.
translation: 记住你可能随时被踢出——任何掉落在地上的物品都会丢失在里面。

english: Do not allow your curiosity to get the better of you.
translation: 别让你的好奇心战胜理智。

english: Thanks for the warning.
translation: 谢谢警告。

english: Can I have a cape like yours?
translation: 我能要一件像你这样的斗篷吗？

english: Of course, you have earned it.
translation: 当然，你已经赢得了它。

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！

english: Take Xeric's guard.
translation: 获得泽里克守卫。

english: Take Xeric's warrior.
translation: 获得泽里克战士。

english: What are you doing up here? Only the palace guards are allowed up here.
translation: 你在这里做什么？只有宫殿守卫才能上来。

english: I am one of the palace guards.
translation: 我是宫殿守卫之一。

english: No, you're not! I know all the palace guards.
translation: 不，你不是！我认识所有宫殿守卫。

english: I'm a new recruit.
translation: 我是新招募的。

english: I interview all the new recruits. I'd know if you were one of them.
translation: 我面试所有新招募的。如果你是其中之一我会知道。

english: That blows that story out of the water then.
translation: 那这个说法就站不住脚了。

english: Get out of my sight.
translation: 从我眼前消失。

english: I've had extensive plastic surgery.
translation: 我做过广泛的整形手术。

english: What sort of surgery is that? I've never heard of it. Besides, you look reasonably healthy.
translation: 那是什么手术？我从未听说过。况且，你看起来相当健康。

english: Why is this relevant anyway? You still shouldn't be here.
translation: 这有什么关系？你还是不应该在这里。

english: What about the King? Surely you'd let him up here.
translation: 那国王呢？你肯定会让他上来。

english: Well, yes, I suppose we'd let him up. He doesn't generally want to come up here, but if he did want to, he could.
translation: 嗯，是的，我想我们会让他上来。他通常不想来这里，但如果他想，他可以。

english: Anyway, you're not the King either. So get out of my sight.
translation: 总之，你也不是国王。所以从我眼前消失。

english: Yes, I know, but this is important.
translation: 是的，我知道，但这很重要。

english: Ok, I'm listening. Tell me what's so important.
translation: 好吧，我在听。告诉我有什么重要的。

english: Erm I forgot.
translation: 呃我忘了。

english: Well it can't be that important then.
translation: 那肯定没那么重要。

english: How do you know?
translation: 你怎么知道？

english: Just go away.
translation: 走开就是了。

english: The castle has just received its ale delivery.
translation: 城堡刚收到啤酒配送。

english: Now that is important. However I'm the wrong person to speak to about it. Go talk to the kitchen staff.
translation: 那确实重要。但我是错的人。去找厨房工作人员谈。

english: I am one of the palace guards.
translation: 我是宫殿守卫之一。

english: I'm a new recruit.
translation: 我是新招募的。

english: I've had extensive plastic surgery.
translation: 我做过广泛的整形手术。

english: What about the King?
translation: 那国王呢？

english: Yes I know, but this is important.
translation: 是的我知道，但这很重要。

english: Erm I forgot.
translation: 呃我忘了。

english: The castle has just received its ale delivery.
translation: 城堡刚收到啤酒配送。

english: What's going on here?
translation: 这里发生什么事了？

english: Beyond this wall you'll find the Kebos Lowlands. Most of the region is lizardman territory. We're here to keep them from entering Kourend.
translation: 越过这堵墙你会发现凯博斯低地。大部分地区是蜥蜴人领地。我们在这里阻止他们进入库尔德王国。

english: We used to keep this passage properly barricaded shut, but then the fancy historians from the Arceuus Library wanted to go do some research out there.
translation: 我们过去一直把这通道妥善封锁，但后来阿西乌斯图书馆的那些 那些讲究的历史学家想去那里做研究。

english: Soon the farmers joined them, and before you knew it, everyone wanted to go explore. Some of them have even started living out there.
translation: 很快农民们也加入了，不知不觉间，每个人都想去探索。有些人甚至开始住在那里。

english: I can see it all ending badly, but that's the problem with intellectuals - they always think they know better.
translation: 我能预见这一切会以悲剧收场，但这就是知识分子的问题——他们总认为自己更懂。

english: Anyway, maybe they'll all get themselves killed. Then we can put the barricade back up.
translation: 总之，也许他们都会送命。然后我们就能把路障重新设起来。

english: If you go out there yourself, give the lizardmen a kicking from me. They've killed too many of my soldiers.
translation: 如果你自己去那里，替我踢蜥蜴人几脚。他们杀了我太多士兵。

english: Beyond these walls is a Lizardman settlement, we're defending against it.
translation: 这些墙外是蜥蜴人定居点，我们正在防御。

english: Why do they hate humans?
translation: 他们为什么仇恨人类？

english: Who knows, all I know is offence is the best type of defence, we will attack soon, will you help us, brave warrior?
translation: 谁知道呢，我只知道进攻是最好的防守，我们很快就会进攻，你会帮助我们吗，勇敢的战士？

english: I don't know... Sounds dangerous.
translation: 我不知道……听起来很危险。

english: Oh, the assault is not for a while, go train and prepare, for there will be all sorts of grand rewards from this expedition.
translation: 哦，进攻还有一段时间，去训练和准备吧，这次远征会有各种丰厚的奖励。

english: Rewards? I'm in! Hopefully some brand new armour or something.
translation: 奖励？我加入了！希望能有些全新盔甲之类的。

english: Hmm...
Oh dear, this ship is in a terrible state. And I just can't get the items I need to repair it because Shilo village is overrun with zombies.
translation: 哦天哪，这船状况太糟了。我拿不到修理需要的物品，因为希洛村被僵尸占领了。

english: Hello there shipmate! I sail to Khazard Port and to Port Sarim. Where are you bound?
translation: 你好啊船友！我航行到卡扎德港和沙林港。你要去哪里？

english: I see you don't have a ticket for the ship, my colleague normally only sells them in Shilo village. But I could sell you one for a small additional charge. Shall we say [number] gold pieces
translation: 我看你没有船票，我的同事通常只在希洛村出售。但我可以收点额外费用卖你一张。[number] 金币怎么样

english: Yes, I'll buy a ticket for the ship.
translation: 是的，我买一张船票。

english: Sorry me old shipmate, but you seem to be  financially challenged at the moment. Come back when your coffers are full!
translation: 抱歉老船友，但你目前似乎财政困难。等你的钱箱满了再来！

english: It's a good deal and no mistake. Here you go me old shipmate, here's your ticket.
translation: 这是笔好交易，没错。给你老船友，这是你的票。

english: Ok, now you have your ticket, do you want to sail anywhere?
translation: 好了，现在你有票了，想去哪里航行吗？

english: Khazard Port please.
translation: 卡扎德港。

english: Very well then me old shipmate, I'll just take your ticket and then we'll set sail.
translation: 很好老船友，我收你的票然后我们就起航。

english: You arrive safely in the quiet fishing port of Khazard.
translation: 你安全抵达安静的卡扎德渔港。

english: Port Sarim please.
translation: 沙林港。

english: The ship arrives in busy Port Sarim.
translation: 船抵达繁忙的沙林港。

english: Nowhere just at the moment thanks.
translation: 暂时哪里都不去，谢谢。

english: Very well then me old shipmate, Just let me know if you change your mind.
translation: 很好老船友，改变主意告诉我。

english: No thanks, not just at the moment.
translation: 不用了谢谢，暂时不用。

english: Very well me old shipmate,  come back if you change your mind now.
translation: 很好老船友，改变主意再来。

english: Yes, I'll buy a ticket for the ship.
translation: 是的，我买一张船票。

english: Khazard Port please.
translation: 卡扎德港。

english: Port Sarim please.
translation: 沙林港。

english: Nowhere just at the moment thanks.
translation: 暂时哪里都不去，谢谢。

english: No thanks, not just at the moment.
translation: 不用了谢谢，暂时不用。

english: Can you take me on the glider?
translation: 你能带我坐滑翔机吗？

english: Of course!
translation: 当然可以！

english: Why are gliders better than other transport?
translation: 为什么滑翔机比其他交通工具好？

english: Oh we have a whole network! It's wonderful for getting to hard to reach places.
translation: 哦我们有个完整的网络！去那些难以到达的地方非常方便。

english: There are so many places where your teleports cannot reach!
translation: 有很多地方你的传送术到不了！

english: How did you all manage to build such an established network?
translation: 你们是怎么建立起这么完善的网络的？

english: I think you'll find that is a gnome trade secret!
translation: 我想你会发现那是地精的商业秘密！

english: Sorry, I don't want anything now.
translation: 抱歉，我现在什么都不需要。

english: Can you take me on the glider?
translation: 你能带我坐滑翔机吗？

english: Why are gliders better than other transport?
translation: 为什么滑翔机比其他交通工具好？

english: Sorry, I don't want anything now.
translation: 抱歉，我现在什么都不需要。

english: How is the camp holding up?
translation: 营地情况怎么样？

english: The whole place is falling apart, to be honest. I'd jump at the chance to shut it all down for good.
translation: 说实话，整个地方都快垮了。我巴不得有机会彻底关闭它。

english: Why don't you leave this camp and join my crew?
translation: 你为什么不离开这个营地加入我的船员？

english: Your crew? As in, go back to sailing?
translation: 你的船员？也就是说，回去航海？

english: Of course!
translation: 当然！

english: It's tempting, but you don't look like you'd last a day on the high seas.
translation: 很诱人，但你看起来在公海上撑不了一天。

english: You require the following to recruit this crew member: Level 50 Sailing. Completion of The Tourist Trap.
translation: 你需要满足以下条件才能招募这名船员：50级航海等级。完成旅游陷阱任务。

english: I can't see how I could refuse an offer like that! Let's get to it!
translation: 我无法拒绝这样的提议！我们开始吧！

english: You recruit Captain Siad as a crew member. He departs for the Pandemonium.
translation: 你招募了西亚德船长作为船员。他出发前往潘德莫尼姆。

english: You have recruited Captain Siad as a crew member.
translation: 你已招募西亚德船长作为船员。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Until next time.
translation: 下次再见。

english: How is the camp holding up?
translation: 营地情况怎么样？

english: Why don't you leave this camp and join my crew?
translation: 你为什么不离开这个营地加入我的船员？

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Hello there. Do you want to go on a trip to Karamja? We can take you to Musa Point for only 30 coins.
translation: 你好。想去卡拉姆詹岛旅行吗？我们可以带你去穆萨角，只要30金币。

english: Oh dear, I don't seem to have enough money.
translation: 哦天哪，我好像没有足够的钱。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No, thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Hello there. Do you want to travel somewhere? We can take you to Musa Point on Karamja, or if you prefer, we can drop you off at the Pandemonium on the way. It only costs 30 coins.
translation: 你好。想去某个地方吗？我们可以带你去卡拉姆詹岛的穆萨角，或者如果你愿意，我们可以在途中让你在潘德莫尼姆下船。只要30金币。

english: Hello there. Do you want to travel somewhere? We can take you to Musa Point on Karamja for 15 coins, or if you prefer, for 30 coins we can drop you off at the Pandemonium on the way.
translation: 你好。想去某个地方吗？我们可以带你去卡拉姆詹岛的穆萨角，15金币，或者如果你愿意，30金币我们可以在途中让你在潘德莫尼姆下船。

english: Where would you like to go?
translation: 你想去哪里？

english: I'd like to go to Musa Point.
translation: 我想去穆萨角。

english: I'd like to go to the Pandemonium.
translation: 我想去潘德莫尼姆。

english: Actually, I don't want to go anywhere.
translation: 其实，我哪里都不想去。

english: Well done, matey! Here you go!
translation: 干得好，伙计！给你！

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No, thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: I'd like to go to Musa Point.
translation: 我想去穆萨角。

english: I'd like to go to the Pandemonium.
translation: 我想去潘德莫尼姆。

english: Actually, I don't want to go anywhere.
translation: 其实，我哪里都不想去。

english: No thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Arrr, 'tis the young [lad/lass] who helped save my crew from that scoundrel, Ithoi! How be ye this fine day?
translation: 啊，是那位帮助我从那个恶棍伊索伊手中救出船员的年轻 [lad/lass]！今天过得怎么样？

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。

english: Arrr, ye looks fine. Stiff in the spine, firm in the mind an' long in the leg. 'Tis good to see ye again.
translation: 啊，你看起来不错。脊梁挺直，意志坚定，腿脚有力。很高兴再次见到你。

english: What is there to do here?
translation: 这里有什么可做的？

english: Well, ye could maybe explore the ogre caves. Arsen says the ogres be fearsome, though, so watch yer step. An' there be places for ye to train yer skills, over to the west.
translation: 嗯，你可以探索食人魔洞穴。不过阿森说食人魔很可怕，所以小心点。西边还有一些可以训练技能的地方。

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

english: Eh, goodbye.
translation: 呃，再见。

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。

english: What is there to do here?
translation: 这里有什么可做的？

english: Eh, goodbye.
translation: 呃，再见。

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Do you need something?
translation: 你需要什么吗？

english: Not that I know of.
translation: 据我所知不需要。

english: Move along then. I have a lot of work to be doing.
translation: 那走吧。我有很多工作要做。

english: Good day to you, adventurer. Do you need something?
translation: 你好，冒险者。你需要什么吗？

english: No. Just thought I'd come and see how things are going.
translation: 不。只是想来瞧瞧情况怎么样。

english: Things are very well thank you. Prince Itzla has tasked me with keeping an eye on the remaining Emissaries.
translation: 情况很好，谢谢。伊兹拉王子 tasked 我监视剩余的使者。

english: Swift justice must be dealt if they try anything, but until then, the Prince would prefer we not stir the pot. They no longer pose a real threat now their leaders have gone.
translation: 如果他们敢轻举妄动必须迅速制裁，但在那之前，王子希望我们不要轻举妄动。他们的首领已走，不再构成真正威胁。

english: Well, I'm glad to hear all is well. Until next time.
translation: 嗯，很高兴听到一切安好。下次再见。

english: Indeed. May the sun light your way, adventurer.
translation: 确实。愿阳光照亮你的道路，冒险者。

english: The capybara and hippo don't seem to care for your moves.
translation: 水豚和河马似乎对你的动作不感兴趣。

english: The hippo seems to find your moves interesting, but isn't totally sold on them. The capybara doesn't seem to care.
translation: 河马似乎觉得你的动作有趣，但还没完全被说服。水豚似乎不在乎。

english: The hippo seems to like your moves, but the capybara isn't convinced.
translation: 河马似乎喜欢你的动作，但水豚没被说服。

english: The hippo seems to really enjoy your moves, but while the capybara likes them, it doesn't appear to quite love them.
translation: 河马似乎真的很享受你的动作，而水豚虽然喜欢，但似乎还没到热爱的程度。

english: Good day, Carado.
translation: 你好，卡拉多。

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Well, I figured that with Glough being gone and all...
translation: 嗯，我想既然格劳夫已经走了……

english: Hi.
translation: 你好。

english: You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 你知道吗，跟人打招呼的方式可多了。你好、嘿、你好啊……

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: 那也只能算一种！

english: Hello. How are you today?
translation: 你好。今天怎么样？

english: I'm great, thank you!
translation: 我很好，谢谢！

english: Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 你好！水晶城的天气真好，对吧？

english: Indeed.
translation: 确实。

english: What can I do for ya?
translation: 有什么能帮你的？

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这里有什么可做的？

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 各种事情！塔楼是值得一看的奇观。

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 像今天这样的好日子，我建议去市场逛逛。

english: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你觉得你在做什么？

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这里有什么可做的？

english: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: Hello there!
translation: 你好！

english: Hello! You're not from around here, are you? It's exciting to see that even people from outside of Varlamore are looking to join the Emissaries!
translation: 你好！你不是本地人，对吧？看到就连瓦拉莫尔以外的人都想加入使者，真令人兴奋！

english: Well after I heard about all the good work they were doing, I could hardly say no! What about you? What made you want to join them?
translation: 嗯，听说了他们做的好事后，我很难说不！你呢？什么让你想加入他们？

english: Well it's our duty of course! The Church of Ralos has become lost, but the Emissaries know the truth. Ximoua will not come to be unless we make it so!
translation: 嗯，这当然是我们的责任！拉洛斯教会已经迷失，但使者知道真相。除非我们行动，否则西穆阿不会到来！

english: So you're quite eager to see the end of the world then?
translation: 所以你很期待世界末日？

english: End? Ximoua is no end! It is the beginning! We will all come together as one and bring about a new world! I can't wait!
translation: 末日？西穆阿不是末日！是开端！我们将合为一体，带来新世界！我等不及了！

english: Well I'm glad to see you're so excited. Good luck with the tests.
translation: 嗯，很高兴看到你这么兴奋。测试祝你好运。

english: And you!
translation: 你也是！

english: What ales are you serving?
translation: 你们供应什么啤酒？

english: We serve Crombwick's finest Bloody Bracer, that is all.
translation: 我们供应克伦布维克最好的血腥护腕啤酒，就这个。

english: Sounds rough, how much?
translation: 听起来很烈，多少钱？

english: 99 of you finest coins.
translation: 99枚你最优质的金币。

english: Alright, one Bloody Bracer, if that's all you have.
translation: 好吧，来一杯血腥护腕，如果只有这个的话。

english: I said 99 coins! You haven't got 99 coins!
translation: 我说99金币！你没有99金币！

english: Sorry, I'll come back another day.
translation: 抱歉，我改天再来。

english: Thanks, Carl.
translation: 谢谢，卡尔。

english: 99 coins? That's ridiculous!
translation: 99金币？太荒谬了！

english: What can I say? The ingredients are locally sourced so it's high quality, I promise.
translation: 我能说什么？原料都是本地采购的，所以质量很高，我保证。

english: Well, I guess I shouldn't shoot the messenger.
translation: 嗯，我想我不该迁怒于传话的人。

english: So...
translation: 那么……

english: What can you tell me about this town?
translation: 你能和我说说这个城镇的事吗？

english: I've not been here long myself, so I'm afraid I may not be of much help.
translation: 我自己来这里也不久，恐怕帮不上什么忙。

english: What happened to the previous barkeep?
translation: 之前的酒保怎么了？

english: Oh, he had to leave.
translation: 哦，他不得不离开。

english: How come?
translation: 为什么？

english: Scared of turning.
translation: 害怕转变。

english: Turning?
translation: 转变？

english: Yes, into a sleeper.
translation: 是的，变成潜伏者。

english: Oh right! You see, for a second there I thought you were talking about vampyres.
translation: 哦对了！你看，刚才一瞬间我以为你在说吸血鬼。

english: Ha ha! We, err, don't see many of those types around here. No, no, not at all.
translation: 哈哈！我们，呃，这里不常见那种类型。不，不，完全没有。

english: If you say so.
translation: 你这么说就是吧。

english: I do. So...
translation: 我确实是。那么……

english: Actually, I'm no longer thirsty.
translation: 其实，我不再口渴了。

english: Oh, the red thirst will be upon you soon.
translation: 哦，红色饥渴很快就会降临到你身上。

english: Excuse me?
translation: 你说什么？

english: Just a jest, traveller.
translation: 只是开玩笑，旅行者。

english: Oh.
translation: 哦。

english: Alright, one Bloody Bracer, if that's all you have.
translation: 好吧，来一杯血腥护腕，如果只有这个的话。

english: 99 coins? That's ridiculous!
translation: 99金币？太荒谬了！

english: What can you tell me about this town?
translation: 你能和我说说这个城镇的事吗？

english: Actually, I'm no longer thirsty.
translation: 其实，我不再口渴了。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Oh, hello.
translation: 哦，你好。

english: You seem upset... What's wrong?
translation: 你看起来心烦……怎么了？

english: My son fell ill with the plague...
translation: 我儿子染上了瘟疫……

english: That's awful, I'm sorry.
translation: 太糟糕了，我很抱歉。

english: It would be easier to cope with if I could have spent his last few days with him.
translation: 如果我能陪他度过最后几天，会容易承受一些。

english: Why didn't you?
translation: 为什么没有？

english: Those mourners came and whisked him away. He didn't even seem that ill, I thought it was a common cold... But the mourners said that he was infected and had to be taken away.
translation: 那些哀悼者来把他带走了。他看起来甚至没那么病重，我以为是普通感冒……但哀悼者说他被感染了，必须被带走。

english: Two days later the mourners returned and told me he had died.
translation: 两天后哀悼者回来告诉我他已经死了。

english: Again, I'm sorry. Life can be harsh.
translation: 再次抱歉。生活可能很残酷。

english: Where did the plague come from?
translation: 瘟疫从哪里来的？

english: It's down to King Tyras. He and his men brought the plague here from the west, and then left us to suffer. One day he'll pay for what he's done!
translation: 都怪泰拉斯国王。他和他的手下从西方把瘟疫带到这里，然后让我们受苦。总有一天他会为自己的所作所为付出代价！

english: Have there been many victims of the plague?
translation: 有很多瘟疫受害者吗？

english: You could say that... I've heard reports that half of West Ardougne is infected! Many have lost friends and family...
translation: 可以说有……我听说西阿多尼城有一半被感染了！很多人失去了朋友和家人……

english: It sounds an awful way to live.
translation: 听起来生活很糟糕。

english: People are very depressed and scared. I've never met anyone fully infected though. I suppose we should be grateful to the mourners for that.
translation: 人们非常沮丧和恐惧。不过我从未见过完全感染的人。我想我们应该为此感激哀悼者。

english: I hope things get easier for you.
translation: 希望你的情况会好转。

english: Me too...
translation: 我也是……

english: Hey Carla, how are you doing?
translation: 嘿卡拉，你怎么样？

english: I'm okay. The loss of my son is something that I'll never be over. At least no one else has to suffer at the hands of those mourners though.
translation: 我还好。失去儿子是我永远无法释怀的。不过至少没有人再需要遭受那些哀悼者的折磨了。

english: Where did the plague come from?
translation: 瘟疫从哪里来的？

english: Have there been many victims of the plague?
translation: 有很多瘟疫受害者吗？

english: I hope things get easier for you.
translation: 希望你的情况会好转。

english: Squeak!
translation: 吱吱！

english: She is ignoring you.
translation: 她在无视你。

english: Apparently you aren't as stupid as you look.
translation: 显然你不如看起来那么蠢。

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Is there any chance you could help me?
translation: 你有没有可能帮我？

english: What's wrong?
translation: 怎么了？

english: It's my husband, he works on a fishing platform. Once a month he takes our son, Kennith, out with him.
translation: 是我丈夫，他在钓鱼平台上工作。每个月他会带我们的儿子肯尼斯一起出去。

english: They usually write to me regularly, but I've heard nothing all week. It's very strange.
translation: 他们通常定期写信给我，但这一周我什么都没收到。很奇怪。

english: Maybe the post was lost!
translation: 也许信丢了！

english: Maybe, but no-one's heard from the other fishermen on the platform. Their families are becoming quite concerned.
translation: 也许吧，但平台上其他渔民也没有消息。他们的家人开始非常担心。

english: Is there any chance you could visit the platform and find out what's going on?
translation: 你有没有可能去平台看看发生了什么事？

english: I suppose so, how do I get there?
translation: 我想可以，我怎么去那里？

english: That's very good of you [player]. My friend Holgart will take you there.
translation: 你真好，[player]。我的朋友霍尔加特会带你去那里。

english: Ok, I'll go and see if they're ok.
translation: 好的，我去看看他们是否安好。

english: I'll reward you for your time. It'll give me peace of mind to know Kennith and my husband, Kent, are safe.
translation: 我会奖励你的时间。知道肯尼斯和我丈夫肯特安全，我会安心。

english: I'm sorry, I'm too busy.
translation: 抱歉，我太忙了。

english: That's a shame.
translation: 真遗憾。

english: Bye.
translation: 再见。

english: Bye.
translation: 再见。

english: Hello again.
translation: 又见面了。

english: Hello traveller, how are you?
translation: 你好旅行者，你怎么样？

english: Not bad thanks, yourself?
translation: 不错谢谢，你呢？

english: I'm good. Busy as always looking after Kent and Kennith but no complaints.
translation: 我很好。像往常一样忙着照顾肯特和肯尼斯，但没怨言。

english: Yes.
translation: 是。

english: No.
translation: 否。

english: Hey there. How're you holding up?
translation: 嘿。你怎么样？

english: Not too bad. Still, I hope we can get rid of these spots soon.
translation: 还不错。不过，我希望我们能快点摆脱这些斑点。

english: The embalmer has been importing a soothing balm from a merchant called Ali M. It's meant to stop the itching.
translation: 防腐师一直在从一个叫阿里 M 的商人那里进口一种舒缓膏。据说能止痒。

english: Does it work?
translation: 有效吗？

english: Not even remotely, but it sure does keep the flies away.
translation: 完全没用，但确实能驱赶苍蝇。

english: Much better now that we've finally got rid of those spots.
translation: 现在我们终于摆脱了那些斑点，好多了。

english: That's great to hear! All the best.
translation: 听到这个太好了！祝一切顺利。

english: What are you doing?
translation: 你在做什么？

english: I thought this acne potion might help ease your spots.
translation: 我想这个痤疮药水可能有助于缓解你的斑点。

english: What? You intolerable, insufferable idiot. That won't work! I would say get out of my sight but that's not far enough away!
translation: 什么？你这个无法容忍、难以忍受的白痴。那没用！我本想让你从我眼前消失，但那还不够远！

english: I was just trying to help.
translation: 我只是想帮忙。

english: Clear off before I give you something to feel sorry about!
translation: 在我给你点真正值得后悔的东西之前滚开！

english: Hey! This is the Queen's forest. You'll need her approval to make use of it.
translation: 嘿！这是女王的森林。你需要她的批准才能使用。

english: Good day. What are you doing?
translation: 你好。你在做什么？

english: I'm cutting down mahogany and teak trees to make into furniture. It takes a while.
translation: 我在砍伐桃花心木和柚木来做家具。需要一段时间。

english: Good luck with that.
translation: 祝你好运。

english: Thank you, Your Royal Highness.
translation: 谢谢你，殿下。

english: Can you tell me how the kingdom approves of me?
translation: 你能告诉我王国对我的认可度吗？

english: [amount]% of people approve of you.
translation: [amount]% 的人认可你。

english: The storerooms are full, your Highness. You should talk to Advisor Ghrim to collect what we've gathered for you.
translation: 储藏室已满，殿下。请去找顾问格里姆领取我们为你收集的物资。

english: Mmm... looks like that camel would make a nice kebab.
translation: 嗯……看起来那只骆驼可以做成不错的烤肉串。

english: That camel looks vicious, it'll probably eat me if I go too near!
translation: 那只骆驼看起来很凶，如果我靠太近它可能会吃掉我！

english: I wonder if I can catch something from that camel?
translation: 我想知道我能从那只骆驼身上染上什么病吗？

english: You and whose army mate? You and whose army?
translation: 你和谁的军队，伙计？你和谁的军队？

english: Oooh, sorry, didn't realise you could hear me?
translation: 哦哦，抱歉，没意识到你能听到我？

english: Well I can, so watch what you say in future.
translation: 我能听到，所以以后说话注意点。

english: Righto!
translation: 好的！

english: Well, I have to say, I am pretty peckish, but thankfully, I don't eat humans... often.
translation: 嗯，我得说，我挺饿的，但幸运的是，我不吃人类……经常。

english: You'll catch a stiff kick if you talk about me like that again!
translation: 如果你再那样说我，你会挨一脚！

english: Yes [sir/m'am]? Can I help you at all?
translation: 是的 [sir/m'am]？我能帮你什么吗？

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: You're in the main waiting area of Keldagrim Carts- station.
translation: 你在凯尔达格林矿车站的主候车区。

english: Cart-station? What goes on here then?
translation: 矿车站？这里做什么的？

english: Keldagrim is the hub of all the traffic of the dwarven realm. Almost every dwarven outpost has railtracks leading to Keldagrim, connecting them all for easy travel and transportation of goods.
translation: 凯尔达格林是矮人王国所有交通的枢纽。几乎每个矮人前哨站都有铁轨通向凯尔达格林，连接所有地方方便旅行和货物运输。

english: Amazing! And what powers the carts? Magic?
translation: 太棒了！那矿车用什么驱动？魔法？

english: Oh, no no, we dwarves don't use magic. No, all of this is powered by steam engines, developed during the past few centuries after the Consortium came to power.
translation: 哦，不不，我们矮人不用魔法。不，所有这些都由蒸汽机驱动，是财团掌权后过去几个世纪开发的。

english: Thanks for the info.
translation: 谢谢你的信息。

english: Where can you take me?
translation: 你能带我去哪里？

english: Let's see, we could let you travel to Ice Mountain, or to the Grand Exchange.
translation: 让我看看，我们可以让你去冰霜山，或者去大交易所。

english: I could also let you go to White Wolf Mountain, since you've befriended our brothers there.
translation: 我也可以让你去白狼山，既然你已经和那里的兄弟们成了朋友。

english: I'd like to buy a ticket.
translation: 我想买张票。

english: And where would you like to go?
translation: 你想去哪里？

english: I'd like to buy a ticket to the Grand Exchange.
translation: 我想买张去大交易所的票。

english: Oh, that service is free. Just hop on a cart on Track 3, and away you go.
translation: 哦，那服务是免费的。直接上3号轨道的矿车，就可以走了。

english: I'd like to buy a ticket to Ice Mountain.
translation: 我想买张去冰霜山的票。

english: That'll be 150 gold coins please.
translation: 那是150金币。

english: I'm sorry, I've run out of money.
translation: 抱歉，我没钱了。

english: I'm sorry, [sir/madam], but I don't believe you can hold the ticket.
translation: 抱歉，[sir/madam]，但我不认为你能拿这张票。

english: Thanks, carts to Ice Mountain depart from track 1.
translation: 谢谢，去冰霜山的矿车从1号轨道出发。

english: No thanks, I changed my mind.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我改变主意了。

english: You're alright, I suppose... I can let you go for 75 coins. And remember, carts to Ice Mountain depart from track 1.
translation: 你还行，我想……我可以让你75金币走。记住，去冰霜山的矿车从1号轨道出发。

english: I'd like to buy a ticket to White Wolf Mountain.
translation: 我想买张去白狼山的票。

english: That'll be 100 gold coins please.
translation: 那是100金币。

english: Thanks. Go to track 4 for carts heading to White Wolf Mountain.
translation: 谢谢。去4号轨道坐前往白狼山的矿车。

english: You're a decent human, I suppose... I can let you go for 50 coins. Go to track 4 for the carts heading to White Wolf Mountain.
translation: 你是个不错的人类，我想……我可以让你50金币走。去4号轨道坐前往白狼山的矿车。

english: I have to go.
translation: 我得走了。

english: Just remember, wherever you go, you go there faster through Keldagrim Carts.
translation: 记住，无论你去哪里，通过凯尔达格林矿车都会更快。

english: That service is free. Just hop on a cart on Track 3, and away you go.
translation: 那服务是免费的。直接上3号轨道的矿车，就可以走了。

english: Anything I can help you with?
translation: 有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: This is the Keldagrim Carts-station, human.
translation: 这里是凯尔达格林矿车站，人类。

english: Out of the way human!
translation: 让开，人类！

english: Why, what's happening?
translation: 为什么，发生什么事了？

english: There's important traffic coming through here and I don't want any stray humans distracting me.
translation: 有重要交通要经过这里，我不希望有任何闲逛的人类分散我的注意力。

english: Tickets, tickets, get your tickets here!
translation: 票，票，来这里买票！

english: Wot you want?
translation: 你想要什么？

english: Can't you see I'm 'aving a lil' break?
translation: 你没看到我在休息吗？

english: Now that you mention it, yes.
translation: 既然你提到了，是的。

english: Then why did ya waste my time?
translation: 那你为什么浪费我的时间？

english: Ahoy up there! Would you like to ride our minecart to Keldagrim? It's free.
translation: 上面好！你想坐我们的矿车去凯尔达格林吗？免费的。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Ahoy up there! You'd better pick up your follower before you come down here and ride the minecart.
translation: 上面好！你下来坐矿车前最好先把你的随从带上来。

english: Watch out, [sir/madam]! Don't want anything to run over your follower!
translation: 小心，[sir/madam]！不希望有什么东西碾过你的随从！

english: Tickets! Tickets!
translation: 票！票！

english: Buy your tickets here!
translation: 来这里买票！

english: Selling tickets!
translation: 售票！

english: Ice Mountain carts departing from Track 1!
translation: 冰霜山矿车从1号轨道出发！

english: Grand Exchange carts departing from Track 3!
translation: 大交易所矿车从3号轨道出发！

english: White Wolf Mountain carts departing from Track 4!
translation: 白狼山矿车从4号轨道出发！

english: Mind the cart!
translation: 小心矿车！

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: Where can you take me?
translation: 你能带我去哪里？

english: I'd like to buy a ticket.
translation: 我想买张票。

english: To the Grand Exchange.
translation: 去大交易所。

english: To Ice Mountain.
translation: 去冰霜山。

english: Buy.
translation: 买。

english: Don't buy.
translation: 不买。

english: [Charm] Only pay half.
translation: [魅力] 只付一半。

english: To White Wolf Mountain.
translation: 去白狼山。

english: Nowhere.
translation: 哪里都不去。

english: I have to go.
translation: 我得走了。

english: Grand Exchange (free)
translation: 大交易所(免费)

english: Ice Mountain (150 coins)
translation: 冰霜山(150金币)

english: White Wolf Mountain (100 coins)
translation: 白狼山(100金币)

english: Cancel
translation: 取消

english: Ice Mountain (75 coins)
translation: 冰霜山(75金币)

english: White Wolf Mountain (50 coins)
translation: 白狼山(50金币)

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: I'm an employee of Keldagrim Carts. I make sure the carts in this area run on time and that people pay their fares.
translation: 我是凯尔达格林矿车的员工。我确保这个区域的矿车准时运行，人们支付车费。

translation: 曾经有个疯狂宗教的大祭司叫克伦特。

english: What, a religion called Klenter? What kind of name is that?
translation: 什么，一个 called 克伦特的宗教？那是什么名字？

english: No no. The high priest was called Klenter and he was the high priest of Icthlarin, god of the dead.
translation: 不不。大祭司叫克伦特，他是死神伊克哈林的大祭司。

english: Ok, I'm with you that far.
translation: 好吧，目前我跟得上。

english: He dies, and a struggle starts for his soul.
translation: 他死了，他的灵魂开始了争夺。

english: Ah - the wanderer.
translation: 啊——那个流浪者。

translation: 不过，自从人类开始来这里，矿工在落石中死亡的比例大幅下降！

translation: 进展顺利。我发现反复敲击岩石很治愈。

translation: 你好！我是哈桑，阿尔卡里德首长的大臣。

english: It's just too hot here. How can you stand it?

english: We manage, in our humble way. We are a wealthy town and we have water. It cures many thirsts.
translation: 我们凑合过，用我们卑微的方式。我们是个富裕的城镇，我们有水。它能解很多渴。

english: Do you mind if I just kill your warriors?

english: Kill our warriors? I assume this is some sort of joke?

english: I'll take that as a no. Forget I asked.
translation: 我当那是“不”。当我没问。

english: I'd better be off.

english: Thank you for being a friend to Al Kharid. You are always welcome here.
translation: 谢谢你成为阿尔卡里德城的朋友。这里永远欢迎你。

english: Hey, do not treat the Emir's palace like a climbing frame for children, whoever you are!
translation: 嘿，不管你是谁，别把国王的宫殿当成儿童的攀爬架！

english: Hey, while you have our gratitude for saving the prince, you must earn our trust more fully before the Emir will tolerate you climbing through his windows like a thief!
translation: 嘿，虽然你救了王子我们很感激，但在国王容忍你像小偷一样爬窗户之前，你必须赢得我们更多的信任！

english: Greetings I am Hassan, Chancellor to the Emir of Al- Kharid.
translation: 你好，我是哈桑，阿尔卡里德首长的大臣。

english: We manage, in our humble way. We are a wealthy town and we have water. It cures many thirsts.

english: You are welcome. They are not expensive. We have them here to stop the elite guard being bothered. They are a little harder to kill.
translation: 不用客气。它们不贵。我们这里有它们是为了防止精英守卫被打扰。它们有点难杀。

english: You are a friend of the town of Al-Kharid. If we have more tasks to complete, we will ask you. Please, keep in contact. Good employees are not easy to find.

english: Is there anything I can help you with?

english: I'd better be off.

translation: 我能帮你吗？你在沙漠里一定需要帮助。

english: Hello! Playing solitaire?
translation: 你好！在玩纸牌接龙吗？

english: Hush - I'm trying to perfect the art of dealing off the bottom of the deck.
translation: 嘘——我在完善从牌底发牌的艺术。

english: Hush - I'm trying to perfect the art of dealing off the bottom of the deck. Whatever you want, come back later and I'll speak to you then.
translation: 嘘——我在完善从牌底发牌的艺术。不管你想要什么，晚点再来，那时我再跟你说。

english: Good morning.
translation: 早上好。

english: Leave me alone. I'm trying to find my gambling buddies!
translation: 别烦我。我在找我的赌友！

english: Leave me alone. I'm trying to find my gambling buddies! Whatever you want, come back later and I'll speak to you then.
translation: 别烦我。我在找我的赌友！不管你想要什么，晚点再来，那时我再跟你说。

english: Is it true a level 3 skiller caught one of your siblings?
translation: 真的有个3级生活技能玩家抓了你的一个兄弟姐妹吗？

english: Yes, they killed my mummy, kidnapped my brother, smiled about it and went to sleep.
translation: 是的，他们杀了我妈妈，绑架了我哥哥，还对此笑了笑然后去睡觉了。

english: Aww, well you have me now! I shall call you Squishy and you shall be mine and you shall be my Squishy.
translation: 哎呀，现在你有我了！我要叫你软软，你是我的，你是我的软软。

translation: 嘶！

translation: 咕噜咕噜！

english: Swshh!
translation: 哗！

translation: 呜！

english: Very well done, take this.
translation: 做得很好，拿着这个。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Charlie Windar, natural historian, at your service [sir/madam]
translation: 查理‧温达，自然历史学家，为你效劳 [sir/madam]

english: What do you do?
translation: 你是做什么的？

english: I study the marvelous creatures and plants that are here on this island. There appears to have been a much higher rate of evolution here than on the mainland. I suspect an outside influence from something.
translation: 我研究岛上奇妙的动植物。这里的进化率似乎比大陆高得多。我怀疑有某种外部影响。

english: We're exploring this island.
translation: 我们在探索这个岛。

english: What have you found?
translation: 你发现了什么？

english: Several very interesting species of fungi and insects so far. But I haven't wandered much beyond the camp yet.
translation: 目前发现了几种非常有趣的真菌和昆虫。但我还没怎么走出营地。

english: Take the chance to explore!
translation: 抓住机会去探索！

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: What is going on here?
translation: 这里发生什么事了？

english: What should I do?
translation: 我该做什么？

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: Arr? Be ye wantin' te go on account with our gang o' fillibusters?
translation: 啊？你想跟我们要去当海盗吗？

english: The powder monkey be takin' a caulk after gettin' rowdy on bumboo, so there be plenty of room for ye.
translation: 火药猴喝朗姆酒闹腾后去休息了，所以有很多位置给你。

english: Riiiiight...
translation: 好吧……

english: I'll just be over here if you need me.
translation: 如果你需要我，我就在这边。

english: I got fish, you got gold?
translation: 我有鱼，你有金币吗？

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: Yes, but I don't want your fish.
translation: 是的，但我不想要你的鱼。

english: Then what are ye doin' in a fish shop? Looking fer work?
translation: 那你在鱼店做什么？找工作？

english: Possibly, do you have any quests?
translation: 可能，你有什么任务吗？

english: I dunno, I haven't gone through the last catch yet. What sort of a fish is it?
translation: 我不知道，我还没检查上一批渔获。那是什么鱼？

english: A quest isn't a type of fish!
translation: 任务不是一种鱼！

english: Then I don't have any, and yer wastin' my time!
translation: 那我没有任何任务，你在浪费我的时间！

english: What happened to your legs?
translation: 你的腿怎么了？

english: Ye wanna know what happened to my legs?
translation: 你想知道我的腿怎么了？

english: Yer too much of a lilly-livered, hat wearin' landlubber to know what happened to my legs!
translation: 你这个胆小戴帽的旱鸭子，不配知道我的腿怎么了！

english: No I'm not! I've seen some freaky stuff! I can take it!
translation: 我不是！我见过一些怪事！我能承受！

english: All right, [lad/lass], since yer so insistent, I'll tell ye.
translation: 好吧，[lad/lass]，既然你这么坚持，我告诉你。

english: See, I was clingin' onto a barrel, me ship havin' just had an encounter with this albatross.
translation: 看，我当时抓着一个桶，我的船刚跟一只信天翁遭遇。

english: The sea was thrashin' and wild, but not so wild that I didn't see the fins of some sharks closin' in on me.
translation: 海面波涛汹涌，但还没汹涌到我没看见一些鲨鱼的鳍向我靠近。

english: I managed to yank a sliver of wood from the barrel just as one of them grabbed me from below, but I slipped down the things throat by about two feet before I managed te kill it.
translation: 我设法从桶上扯下一块木片，就在其中一只从下面抓住我时，但我在杀死它之前滑进了那东西的喉咙大约两英尺。

english: How did you survive?
translation: 你怎么活下来的？

english: A passin' ship saw the sharks and knew there would be survivors in the water. They sent a longboat and picked me up, but not before the sharks had taken off my legs.
translation: 一艘路过的船看到了鲨鱼，知道水里会有幸存者。他们派了长艇把我救起来，但在那之前鲨鱼已经咬掉了我的腿。

english: And that [lad/lass] is why they call me two feet Charley, because they found me jammed two feet down a shark's throat.
translation: 所以 [lad/lass] 那就是他们叫我两英尺查理的原因，因为他们发现我被卡在鲨鱼喉咙里两英尺深。

english: I think I'm gonna be sick...
translation: 我想我要吐了……

english: I knew ye couldn't handle the truth!
translation: 我就知道你承受不了真相！

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: Yes, but I don't want your fish.
translation: 是的，但我不想要你的鱼。

english: What happened to your legs?
translation: 你的腿怎么了？

english: Hi!
translation: 你好！

english: Yes, er, welcome to the zoo! I'm afraid I'm kind of busy right now; what was it you wanted?
translation: 你好，呃，欢迎来到动物园！恐怕我现在有点忙；你想要什么？

english: Ah, you sound like someone who needs a quest doing!
translation: 啊，你听起来像需要做个任务的人！

english: Well... maybe. How much do you know about hunting?
translation: 嗯……也许。你对狩猎了解多少？

english: Well I know a little bit...
translation: 嗯我知道一点……

english: No, I could do with some help, but I'm afraid I need somebody with a little more experience.
translation: 不，我需要一些帮助，但恐怕我需要一个更有经验的人。

english: Actually, now that you come to mention it, you might be able to help me.
translation: 其实，既然你提起了，你也许能帮我。

english: A few weeks ago we had a delivery of a northern ferret. They're funny little creatures. Turns out they're tricksy little blighters too.
translation: 几周前我们收到了一只北方雪貂。它们是有趣的小生物。结果它们也是狡猾的小家伙。

english: Whilst we were unloading him from the cart he managed to escape his cage. What's more he gave the driver a nasty nip on the way out too.
translation: 当我们从车上卸货时，它设法逃出了笼子。更糟的是，它在出去时还狠狠咬了司机一口。

english: This was obviously a bit of a blow, you can't make a new attraction without any animals.
translation: 这显然是个打击，没有动物你就没法搞新景点。

english: We got in contact with one of our associates, a huntsman called Nickolaus, who agreed to capture us another.
translation: 我们联系了一个合作伙伴，一个叫尼古拉斯的猎人，他同意再为我们抓一只。

english: Funny thing is we haven't heard from him for some time now. I don't suppose you'd mind having a look for him?
translation: 有趣的是我们有一段时间没收到他的消息了。我想你不会介意去找找他吧？

english: Sure. Any idea where I should start looking?
translation: 当然。知道我从哪里开始找吗？

english: Well the northern ferret is mostly found around the mountains just west of the Gnome Stronghold, so that would probably be as good a place as any to start looking.
translation: 嗯，北方雪貂主要在地精要塞西边的山脉附近发现，所以那可能是个开始寻找的好地方。

english: Okay, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Sorry, I don't have the time.
translation: 抱歉，我没时间。

english: Oh well, I'm sure he'll be okay out there on his own.
translation: 哦好吧，我相信他自己在外面会没事的。

english: Where did you get the animals from?
translation: 你从哪里得到这些动物的？

english: We get them from all over the place! The most exotic creatures have been brought back by explorers and sold to us.
translation: 我们从各地得到它们！最奇异的生物是探险家带回来卖给我们的。

english: Where on Gielinor did you get that scary looking Cyclops?!
translation: 你在基利诺尔哪里得到那只看起来可怕的独眼巨人？！

english: Yes he is scary looking!
translation: 是的，他看起来真可怕！

english: He's from a very far away land, we couldn't find out more as the explorer who brought him back died shortly afterwards!
translation: 他来自非常遥远的地方，我们无法了解更多，因为带他回来的探险家不久后就死了！

english: Hi, how are you getting on with that ferret?
translation: 你好，那只雪貂怎么样了？

english: Well he seems to be just as vicious as the one we lost, but we're still very grateful for your help in acquiring him.
translation: 嗯，他似乎和我们失去的那只一样凶狠，但我们仍然非常感激你帮我抓到它。

english: Hey, I've got another ferret if you're interested?
translation: 嘿，如果你有兴趣，我还有一只雪貂？

english: Er, oh! Well that's very kind of you, but we don't really need another ferret at the moment, I'm afraid. We're having enough trouble taming the one we've got.
translation: 呃，哦！嗯，你真好，但恐怕我们目前不需要另一只雪貂。我们驯服现有的这只已经够麻烦了。

english: Ah, you sound like someone who needs a quest doing!
translation: 啊，你听起来像需要做个任务的人！

english: Sure. Any idea where I should start looking?
translation: 当然。知道我从哪里开始找吗？

english: Sorry, I don't have the time.
translation: 抱歉，我没时间。

english: Where did you get the animals from?
translation: 你从哪里得到这些动物的？

english: Hello! Who are you?
translation: 你好！你是谁？

english: Hello! The name's Charlie Brown and I've just arrived in Kourend.
translation: 你好！我叫查理‧布朗，我刚到库尔德王国。

english: Nice to meet you Charlie, my name is [player name]. What are you doing here?
translation: 很高兴认识你查理，我叫 [player name]。你在这里做什么？

english: I've come to Kourend in search of luck, [player name]. I seek many fortunes and as you know you need luck to find fortune!
translation: 我来库尔德王国寻找运气，[player name]。我寻求许多财富，如你所知，你需要运气才能找到财富！

english: If you're searching for luck, why are you dressed as a monk?
translation: 如果你在寻找运气，为什么你穿得像和尚？

english: Ah these robes keeps me holy, I must remain holy when praying to the God of Luck, [player name].
translation: 啊，这些长袍让我保持神圣，向运气之神祈祷时我必须保持神圣，[player name]。

english: God of Luck? I don't think I've heard of such a God...
translation: 运气之神？我想我没听说过这样的神……

english: Ah, would you perhaps allow me to enlighten you?
translation: 啊，你愿意让我 enlighten 你吗？

english: Sure.
translation: 当然。

english: Arengeesus, God of luck. We do not know much about her or where she comes from, we just know she is there looking over us.
translation: 阿伦杰苏斯，运气之神。我们对她或她来自哪里了解不多，我们只知道她在那里照看着我们。

english: Those who praise Arengeesus enough to get her attention are rewarded. She will gaze down upon you providing you with luck on your adventures.
translation: 那些赞美阿伦杰苏斯足以引起她注意的人会得到奖励。她会俯视你，在你的冒险中提供运气。

english: That sounds a little farfetched to me, luck isn't a thing. Hard work is all you need.
translation: 那听起来有点牵强，运气不是东西。努力工作才是你需要的。

english: Perhaps working hard is merely a form of praise to the God of luck, [player name].
translation: 也许努力工作只是对运气之神的一种赞美形式，[player name]。

english: Hmmm... well good luck Charlie. Good bye!
translation: 嗯……好吧祝你好运查理。再见！

english: Farewell [player name], may Arengeesus shine down upon you.
translation: 再见 [player name]，愿阿伦杰苏斯照耀你。

english: And you!
translation: 你也是！

english: Maybe another time, I must be going.
translation: 也许下次吧，我得走了。

english: Very well, farewell.
translation: 很好，再见。

english: Sure.
translation: 当然。

english: Maybe another time, I must be going.
translation: 也许下次吧，我得走了。

english: Spare some change guv?
translation: 给点零钱吧，老板？

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Charles. Charles E. Trampin' at your service. Now, about that change you were going to give me...
translation: 查尔斯。查尔斯‧E‧特拉姆平为你效劳。现在，关于你打算给我的零钱……

english: Sorry, I haven't got any.
translation: 抱歉，我没有。

english: Thanks anyway.
translation: 还是谢谢。

english: Go get a job!
translation: 去找工作！

english: You startin? I hope your nose falls off!
translation: 你开始了吗？我希望你的鼻子掉下来！

english: Ok. Here you go.
translation: 好的。给你。

english: Hey, thanks a lot!
translation: 嘿，非常感谢！

english: No problem.
translation: 没问题。

english: So...don't I get some sort of quest hint or something now?
translation: 那么……我现在不该得到某种任务提示之类的吗？

english: Huh? What do you mean? That wasn't why I asked you for money.
translation: 哈？你什么意思？那不是我要钱的原因。

english: I just need to eat...
translation: 我只是需要吃饭……

english: Oh wait. I haven't got any, sorry.
translation: 哦等等。我没有任何，抱歉。

english: Is there anything down this alleyway?
translation: 这条小巷里有什么吗？

english: Funny you should mention that...there is actually.
translation: 你提到这个真有趣……确实有。

english: The ruthless and notorious criminal gang known as the Black Arm Gang have their headquarters down there.
translation: 无情且臭名昭著的犯罪团伙黑臂帮的总部就在那里。

english: Thanks for the warning!
translation: 谢谢警告！

english: Don't worry about it.
translation: 别担心。

english: Do you think they would let me join?
translation: 你觉得他们会让我加入吗？

english: You never know. You'll find a lady down there called Katrine. Speak to her.
translation: 谁知道呢。你会在那里找到一位叫卡特琳的女士。跟她谈谈。

english: But don't upset her, she's pretty dangerous.
translation: 但别惹她，她很危险。

english: I was under the impression you were already a member...
translation: 我以为你已经是成员了……

english: No. You're a collaborator with the Phoenix Gang. There's no way they'll let you join now.
translation: 不。你是凤凰帮的合作者。他们现在绝不会让你加入。

english: How did YOU know I was in the Phoenix Gang?
translation: 你怎麽知道我在凤凰帮？

english: In my current profession I spend a lot of time on the streets and you hear these sorta things sometimes
translation: 在我目前的职业中，我花很多时间在街上，有时会听到这类事情

english: Any ideas how I could get in there then?
translation: 有什么主意我怎么进去吗？

english: Hmmm. I dunno.
translation: 嗯。我不知道。

english: Your best bet would probably be to find someone else... Someone who ISN'T a member of the Phoenix Gang, and get them to infiltrate the ranks of the Black Arm Gang for you.
translation: 你最好的办法可能是找别人……一个不是凤凰帮成员的人，让他们为你潜入黑臂帮。

english: If you find someone like that, tell 'em to come to me first.
translation: 如果你找到这样的人，告诉他们先来找我。

english: Ok. Good plan!
translation: 好的。好计划！

english: I'm not just a pretty face!
translation: 我不只是花瓶！

english: Like who?
translation: 比如谁？

english: There's plenty of other adventurers about besides yourself. I'm sure if you asked one of them nicely they would help you.
translation: 除了你之外还有很多其他冒险者。我相信如果你好好请求，他们会帮你。

english: Please [, sir/, madam], can you help me.
translation: 请 [, sir/, madam]，你能帮我吗。

english: What can I do for you?
translation: 有什么能帮你的？

english: I really need a cooked trout.
translation: 我真的很需要一条熟鳟鱼。

english: I really need a cooked pike.
translation: 我真的很需要一条熟梭子鱼。

english: I really need a raw herring
translation: 我真的很需要一条生鲱鱼

english: I really need a raw trout.
translation: 我真的很需要一条生鳟鱼。

english: I really need some leather chaps.
translation: 我真的很需要一些皮裤。

english: I really need a leather body.
translation: 我真的很需要一件皮甲。

english: I really need an iron dagger.
translation: 我真的很需要一把铁匕首。

english: I really need a piece of iron ore.
translation: 我真的很需要一块铁矿石。

english: Sure, I'll be glad to help a person in need.
translation: 当然，我很乐意帮助有需要的人。

english: You give Charlie the [item].
translation: 你把 [item] 给了查理。

english: Charlie gives you a [new clue/casket]!
translation: 查理给了你一个 [new clue/casket]！

english: Thank you so much [sir/madam].
translation: 非常感谢你 [sir/madam]。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Sorry, I haven't got any.
translation: 抱歉，我没有。

english: Go get a job!
translation: 去找工作！

english: Ok. Here you go.
translation: 好的。给你。

english: No problem.
translation: 没问题。

english: Don't I get some sort of quest hint or something now?
translation: 我现在不该得到某种任务提示之类的吗？

english: Is there anything down this alleyway?
translation: 这条小巷里有什么吗？

english: Thanks for the warning!
translation: 谢谢警告！

english: How did you know I was in the Phoenix Gang?
translation: 你怎么知道我在凤凰帮？

english: Ok. Good plan!
translation: 好的。好计划！

english: Like who?
translation: 比如谁？

english: Any ideas how I could get in there then?
translation: 有什么主意我怎么进去吗？

english: Do you think they would let me join?
translation: 你觉得他们会让我加入吗？

english: Hello?
translation: 你好？

english: Hey! You haven't paid your Magic Training Arena Membership money!
translation: 嘿！你还没付魔法训练竞技场会员费！

english: You're lying. I can see right through you!
translation: 你在撒谎。我能看穿你！

english: Oh, HA HA, very funny.
translation: 哦，哈哈，真有趣。

english: Can't you see I'm busy?
translation: 你没看到我很忙吗？

english: Well, I can't really see YOU.
translation: 嗯，我真的看不到你。

english: Is there anybody there?
translation: 那里有人吗？

english: What do you think?
translation: 你觉得呢？

english: Wooo wooo! Be afraid for I'm a scary ghost. Wooo!
translation: 呜呜！害怕吧，我是个可怕的鬼魂。呜呜！

english: Er, whatever.
translation: 呃，随便吧。

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: Good day! What can I do for you?
translation: 你好！有什么能帮你的？

english: Junior Jim told me that you might be able to help me out with sea charting.
translation: 小吉姆告诉我你也许能帮我进行海图测绘。

english: Ah, that I can do indeed. You see, I am a map maker extraordinaire.
translation: 啊，我确实能。你看，我是个非凡的地图制作者。

english: I find that a little hard to believe...
translation: 我觉得那有点难以相信……

english: Charles gestures at his blindfold.
translation: 查理指了指他的眼罩。

english: Don't let this fool you. It takes more than eyes to make a map. They named the mapping book after me, you see...
translation: 别让这骗了你。制作地图需要的不仅仅是眼睛。你看，地图册是以我的名字命名的……

english: Both of them...
translation: 两本都是……

english: I see...
translation: 我明白了……

english: So, as you can now see, I am very much the man to speak to about this sort of thing.
translation: 所以，如你现在所见，我是谈论这类事情的最佳人选。

english: Here, I have a spare spyglass you can have.
translation: 给，我有个备用的望远镜你可以用。

english: You are quite welcome to use it to admire me from afar!
translation: 你完全可以用它从远处欣赏我！

english: So, what specifically would you like to know about charting?
translation: 那么，你具体想了解关于测绘的什么？

english: Good day!
translation: 你好！

english: How do I go about charting the sea?
translation: 我如何进行海图测绘？

english: Well, that very much depends. You see, when it comes to charting, there are quite a few different things you'll want to track. What you need to do is going to vary depending on what it is you're tracking.
translation: 嗯，那很看情况。你看，说到测绘，有不少不同的东西你想追踪。你需要做什么取决于你追踪的是什么。

english: That said, the starting point is always going to be your captain's log. I actually helped author the standard log that we give out around the Pandemonium.
translation: 话虽如此，起点总是你的船长日志。我实际上帮助撰写了我们在潘德莫尼姆周围分发的标准日志。

english: I made sure to include some big hints in there about the things you might find on your sailing adventures.
translation: 我确保在里面包含了一些关于你在航海冒险中可能发现的东西的重要提示。

english: You get the distinct impression you were just winked at by a blindfolded eye.
translation: 你明显感觉到一只戴眼罩的眼睛向你眨了眨眼。

english: You say there are a few different things I might want to track. What are they?
translation: 你说有几件不同的东西我可能想追踪。它们是什么？

english: Well, you have both big and small points of interest, water currents, sea depths, weather patterns, and then there's also drink crates. They're a curious one that Steve likes people to track.
translation: 嗯，你有大小兴趣点、水流、海深、天气模式，还有饮料箱。那是史蒂夫喜欢人们追踪的一个奇怪东西。

english: Can you tell me about charting smaller points of interest?
translation: 你能和我说说测绘较小兴趣点的事吗？

english: Well, you'll likely spot some interesting things in the sea and on some of the less explored islands that you find whilst out sailing.
translation: 嗯，你可能会在海上和你航海时发现的一些较少探索的岛屿上发现一些有趣的东西。

english: Charting these things is simple. All you need to do is just make a note of them as you find them!
translation: 测绘这些东西很简单。你只需要在发现它们时记录下来！

english: Many points of interest don't require any tools to chart. Just interact with them from your boat or while on foot when close enough to them.
translation: 许多兴趣点不需要任何工具来测绘。只需在船上或步行靠近时与它们互动。

english: Can you tell me about charting larger points of interest?
translation: 你能和我说说测绘较大兴趣点的事吗？

english: Ah, for them, you'll want to find a good spot and use a spyglass to take it all in.
translation: 啊，对于它们，你想找个好地方用望远镜观察。

english: But how do I know where a good spot is?
translation: 但我怎么知道好地方在哪里？

english: That can take a bit of practice, but if you pay close attention, you might find some very subtle, definitely not obvious signs of where the best places are...
translation: 那可能需要一点练习，但如果你仔细观察，你可能会发现一些非常微妙、绝对不明显的迹象，表明最佳地点在哪里……

english: Can you tell me about drink crates?
translation: 你能和我说说饮料箱的事吗？

english: They're a bit of an interesting one. It's been argued that they're not actually completely essential for charting the sea, but Steve thinks otherwise. Probably best you talk to him if you want to know more.
translation: 它们有点有趣。有人认为它们实际上对海图测绘不是完全必要的，但史蒂夫不这么认为。如果你想知道更多，最好跟他谈谈。

english: They're a bit of an interesting one. On your travels, you may spot some sealed crates floating in the sea.
translation: 它们有点有趣。在旅途中，你可能会发现一些漂浮在海上的密封箱。

english: Once you find one, just pry it open with your crowbar. If you're lucky, there will be a refreshing beverage inside for you to try.
translation: 一旦你找到一个，只需用撬棍撬开。如果幸运，里面会有清爽的饮料供你品尝。

english: Be careful though, as some of them can be a tinge on the ripe side...
translation: 不过要小心，因为有些可能有点熟过头了……

english: I must admit, I'm not totally sure what these crates have to do with charting...
translation: 我必须承认，我不太确定这些箱子与测绘有什么关系……

english: Yes, that opinion has come up before. However, according to Steve, it's an unwritten rule in this world that alcohol is the key to solving all problems.
translation: 是的，这种观点以前出现过。然而，根据史蒂夫的说法，在这个世界上，酒精是解决所有问题的关键是一条不成文的规定。

english: It's also been said that these crates add a bit of much needed danger to the whole charting effort.
translation: 也有人说这些箱子为整个测绘工作增加了一点急需的危险。

english: Can you tell me about tracking currents?
translation: 你能和我说说追踪水流的事吗？

english: Absolutely! Understanding the various currents around the seas is essential. As you sail around, you'll likely spot many currents of potential interest.
translation: 当然！了解海洋周围的各种水流至关重要。当你航行时，你可能会发现许多有潜在兴趣的水流。

english: But once I spot them, how do I track them?
translation: 但一旦我发现它们，我怎么追踪它们？

english: Ah, for that, you'll need the right tool. Well, I suppose in this case, it's less of a tool and more of a friend.
translation: 啊，为此，你需要正确的工具。嗯，我想在这种情况下，它更少是工具，更多是朋友。

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你什么意思？

english: It will probably make more sense if you head out and discover the art of tracking currents for yourself!
translation: 如果你出去自己发现追踪水流的艺术，可能会更有意义！

english: We had someone passing through recently who said that Arhein in Catherby was looking to track some currents. I'd suggest you go and speak to him.
translation: 最近有人路过说凯瑟比镇的阿海因正在寻找追踪一些水流。我建议你去跟他谈谈。

english: To track them, you'll need to make use of your good friend, the current duck! Specifically, once you've found some currents you want to track, you'll want to let your current duck head out for a swim.
translation: 要追踪它们，你需要利用你的好朋友，海流鸭！具体来说，一旦你找到了一些想追踪的水流，你想让你的海流鸭出去游泳。

english: He'll track the currents for you, so all you need to do is follow him wherever he goes. Once he's done, just pick him up again and let him share what he discovered with you.
translation: 他会为你追踪水流，所以你只需要跟着他去任何地方。一旦他完成，只需再次抱起他，让他与你分享他的发现。

english: Is this really the standard way of doing this?
translation: 这真的是标准做法吗？

english: Of course! I simply can't think of any alternatives!
translation: 当然！我简直想不出任何替代方案！

english: Can you tell me about checking sea depths?
translation: 你能和我说说检查海深的事吗？

english: Ah, for that, you'll need to go diving. However, you don't want to rush it. You'll need to make sure you're skilled enough for that sort of thing before you... dive in.
translation: 啊，为此，你需要去潜水。但是，你不想匆忙。在……潜水之前，你需要确保你有足够的技能。

english: Ah, for that, you'll need to go diving. Doing so will let you take a record of the sea depth, but it's also great for learning more about the local underwater flora and fauna.
translation: 啊，为此，你需要去潜水。这样做可以让你记录海深，但也非常适合了解更多当地水下动植物。

english: However, I wouldn't reccomendgoing it alone. Fortunately, a lot of mermaids have been popping up recently, interested in the extra sea traffic.
translation: 但是，我不建议独自去。幸运的是，最近出现了很多美人鱼，对额外的海上交通感兴趣。

english: I hear they will guide you for a price, and for some inexplicable reason, that price seems to be solving a word-based puzzle for them.
translation: 我听说她们会收费引导你，出于某种 inexplicable 原因，那个价格似乎是为她们解决一个基于文字的谜题。

english: A puzzle?
translation: 一个谜题？

english: Indeed, so get your thinking cap on... under your diving gear of course. It's very important you don't forget that.
translation: 确实，所以戴上你的思考帽……当然是在你的潜水装备下面。非常重要你别忘了。

english: Can you tell me about tracking weather patterns?
translation: 你能和我说说追踪天气模式的事吗？

english: Well, all good captains need to have a strong understanding of the weather out at sea. However, it requires a fair bit of skill to do it well. I'd suggest you wait until you're more experienced.
translation: 嗯，所有好船长都需要对海上天气有强烈的了解。但是，要做好这需要相当多的技能。我建议你等到更有经验。

english: Of course! All good captains need to have a strong understanding of the weather out at sea. However, to do it well, you'll probably want to enlist the help of a meteorologist.
translation: 当然！所有好船长都需要对海上天气有强烈的了解。但是，要做好，你可能想寻求气象学家的帮助。

english: Where can I find one of those?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到其中一个？

english: Well, it's a bit of an odd one, but I've been told there's a troll who has started working as one recently.
translation: 嗯，有点奇怪，但我听说最近有个巨魔开始做这个工作。

english: A troll?
translation: 一个巨魔？

english: Indeed. It's a bit unusual, but who am I to judge! Anyway, apparently she's aquired a portable weather station, a very fine piece of equipment for measuring weather data.
translation: 确实。有点不寻常，但我凭什么评判！总之，显然她获得了一个便携式气象站，一个测量天气数据的非常好的设备。

english: If you come across this troll, she'll hopefully allow you to use this weather station for yourself.
translation: 如果你遇到这个巨魔，她希望你能允许你自己使用这个气象站。

english: And how is it used?
translation: 它怎么使用？

english: Well, what you'll find is that the wind typically blows in large circles. What you need to do is find the middle of this circle, or the eye as we often call it.
translation: 嗯，你会发现风通常在大圆圈中吹。你需要做的是找到这个圆圈的中心，或者我们常说的风眼。

english: You can use the weather station to work out the wind direction. If you follow it for a bit, you should be able to work out which way the circle is curving, and from that, you should be able to find the eye.
translation: 你可以使用气象站计算风向。如果你跟随它一会儿，你应该能够计算出圆圈弯曲的方向，从中你应该能够找到风眼。

english: Just remember not to keep following the wind forever, or you'll just keep going around in circles!
translation: 只要记住不要永远跟随风，否则你只会一直在兜圈子！

english: Anyway, once you reach the eye, you can use the weather station to take the readings you need. After that, just make sure to return the weather station to the troll.
translation: 总之，一旦你到达风眼，你可以使用气象站获取你需要的读数。之后，只要确保将气象站归还给巨魔。

english: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们谈谈别的事吧。

english: Very well.
translation: 很好。

english: What do I get from charting the sea?
translation: 我从海图测绘中得到什么？

english: Other than the thrill of exploration?
translation: 除了探索的刺激？

english: Yes, other than that.
translation: 是的，除了那个。

english: Well, the more you know about the sea, the more you'll be able to take advantage of it. Specifically, learning about the seas will offer the discerning captain a shortcut or two.

english: And for the less discerning captain, I have a stock of alcohol I'd be willing to part with for up to date charting information, along with some coins of course.

english: My observational skills are not what they used to be after all!

english: Absolutely! As you become more familiar with the sea, you will likely start to notice rapid flowing waters where you hadn't before.
