english: Assuming you have a strong enough helm on your boat, sailing over them should give you a noticable speed boost!
translation: 假设你的船上有足够坚固的舵，在上面航行应该会给你明显的速度提升！

english: Can you tell me about these drinks?
translation: 你能和我说说这些饮料的事吗？

english: Of course! There's the kraken ink stout, the perildance bitter, the trawler's trust, and of course, the horizon's lure! Which do you want to hear more about?
translation: 当然！有克拉肯墨汁黑啤酒、佩里丹斯苦啤酒、拖网渔船的信任，当然，还有地平线的诱惑！你想听更多关于哪个？

english: Kraken ink stout.
translation: 克拉肯墨汁黑啤酒。

english: Well, kraken ink stout is the perfect drink if you consider yourself a bit of a magical sailor as it's said to improve both your sailing and magical abilities.
translation: 嗯，如果你认为自己是个有点魔法的水手，克拉肯墨汁黑啤酒是完美的饮料，据说它能提高你的航海和魔法能力。

english: Many claim that it also increases the likelihood of encountering interesting things while out at sea. I'm not sure how a drink does that, but the world works in strange ways.
translation: 许多人声称它还能增加在海上遇到有趣事情的可能性。我不确定饮料怎么做到这一点，但世界运作方式很奇怪。

english: While I'd love to sell you some, I'm afraid you need to do some more charting first.
translation: 虽然我很想卖给你一些，但恐怕你需要先做更多测绘。

english: Anyway, I'm pleased to say that you've done enough charting for me to sell you some! Would you like to buy a glass to sample it? Or do you want enough to fill a keg?
translation: 总之，我很高兴地说，你已经做了足够的测绘，我可以卖给你一些了！你想买一杯尝尝吗？还是想要足够装满一桶的？

english: Perildance bitter.
translation: 佩里丹斯苦啤酒。

english: Ah, they say perildance bitter is the best drink you'll find for a sailor who likes to get themselves into a fight or two. It will supposedly improve your strength, along with your sailing and ranging abilities.
translation: 啊，听说佩里丹斯苦啤酒是给喜欢打上一两架的水手准备的最好的饮料。据说它能增强你的力量，还有航海和射手能力。

english: But that's not all, for plenty of sailors also claim that a bit of perildance bitter has helped them out of a tight spot by improving their ability to man their boat cannons.
translation: 还不止如此，很多水手还说，喝点佩里丹斯苦啤酒能帮他们摆脱困境，因为它能提高操作船炮的能力。

english: Trawler's trust.
translation: 拖网渔夫的信赖。

english: Well, as the name suggests, trawler's trust is the drink you want if you're planning to head out trawling. It's said to improve both your sailing and fishing abilities.
translation: 嗯，顾名思义，如果你打算出去拖网捕鱼，这就是你想要的饮料。据说它能提高你的航海和钓鱼能力。

english: I've been told before that drinking it also helps you catch more fish when out deep sea trawling.
translation: 我之前听说喝它还能帮你在深海拖网时捕获更多的鱼。

english: Horizon's lure.
translation: 地平线的诱惑。

english: Ah, the old classic. In many ways, there's nothing too fancy about horizon's lure. It's quite simply the perfect drink when all you care about is sailing.
translation: 啊，老经典了。在很多方面，地平线的诱惑没什么太花哨的。简单来说，当你只关心航海时，这就是完美的饮料。

english: Not only is it said to make you a better sailor, but it apparently also helps you improve your sailing abilities faster.

english: Welcome to the Ardougne Domestic Service Agency!
translation: 欢迎来到阿多尼家政服务机构！

english: Tell me about servants.
translation: 跟我讲讲仆人。

english: Do you need help around your house? Our trained, efficient workers are ready to serve you.
translation: 你家里需要帮忙吗？我们训练有素、效率高的工人随时为你服务。

english: They can cook meals for you and your friends, make tea, serve drinks, greet guests, and even take items to and from the bank for you.
translation: 他们可以为你和你的朋友做饭、泡茶、端饮料、迎接客人，甚至帮你把物品送去银行或从银行取回。

english: The more expensive servants will be able to make trips to the bank more quickly. Some of them can also go to the sawmill to change logs to planks for you.
translation: 越贵的仆人去银行的速度越快。他们中的一些人还可以去锯木厂帮你把木头变成木板。

english: Remember, you'll need to keep paying your servant. You pay them once when you hire them, and then they'll periodically ask for wages. You can dismiss your servant at any time.
translation: 记住，你需要持续支付仆人工资。雇佣时付一次，然后他们会定期要工资。你可以随时解雇仆人。

english: I'd like to dismiss my servant, please.

translation: 我把你给我的地图弄丢了。

english: What's the point? Take this one and go away!
translation: 有什么意义？拿着这个走吧！

english: You imps always store things in places and forget. Go look for it.
translation: 你们小精灵总是把东西存放在地方然后忘记。去找找看。

english: Are you blind? What is that you are carrying?
translation: 你瞎了吗？你拿着的是什么？

english: Oh, that map...
translation: 哦，那张地图……

english: I am an ogre killer come to destroy you!
translation: 我是来毁灭你的食人魔杀手！

english: I seek passage into the skavid caves
translation: 我寻求进入斯卡维德洞穴的通道

english: Do you have any other riddles for me?
translation: 你还有其他谜语给我吗？

english: I don't know...
translation: 我不知道……

english: A nice pizza?
translation: 不错的披萨？

english: I have lost the map you gave me.
translation: 我把你给我的地图弄丢了。

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Oh hello, I'm sorry, I'm a bit worn out.
translation: 哦你好，抱歉，我有点累坏了。

english: Busy day?
translation: 忙的一天？

english: Oh, It's those mice! They're everywhere! What I really need is a cat. But they're hard to come by nowadays.
translation: 哦，是那些老鼠！它们到处都是！我真正需要的是一只猫。但现在它们很难弄到。

english: No, you're right, you don't see many around.
translation: 不，你说得对，周围看不到多少。

english: I have a cat that I could sell.
translation: 我有一只猫可以卖。

english: You don't say, is that it ?
translation: 你不会说吧，是那只吗？

english: Say hello to a real mouse killer!
translation: 跟真正的捕鼠器打个招呼！

english: Hmmm, not bad, not bad at all. Looks like it's a lively one.
translation: 嗯，不错，真不错。看起来它很活泼。

english: Erm...kind of...
translation: 呃……有点……

english: I don't have much in the way of money. I do have these!
translation: 我没多少钱。但我有这些！

english: The peasant shows you a sack of Death Runes.
translation: 农民给你看一袋死亡符石。

english: The dwarves bring them from the mine for us. Tell you what, I'll give you [100/200] Death Runes for the cat.
translation: 矮人从矿里为我们带来它们。告诉你吧，我用 [100/200] 个死亡符石换你的猫。

english: Nope, I'm not parting for that.
translation: 不，我不会为了那个放手。

english: Well, I'm not giving you anymore!
translation: 嗯，我不会再给你更多了！

english: Ok then, you've got a deal.
translation: 好吧，成交。

english: Great! Hand over the cat and I'll give you the runes.
translation: 太好了！把猫交给我，我给你符石。

english: Nope, they're not easy to get hold of.
translation: 不，它们不容易弄到。

english: I have a cat...look!
translation: 我有一只猫……看！

english: Hmmm...doesn't look like it's seen daylight in years. That's not going to catch any mice!
translation: 嗯……看起来它好几年没见过阳光了。那抓不到任何老鼠！

english: Hi there.
translation: 你好。

english: Good day to you traveller.
translation: 你好，旅行者。

english: What are you up to?
translation: 你在做什么？

english: Chasing mice as usual! It's all I seem to do nowadays.
translation: 像往常一样追老鼠！这似乎是我现在唯一做的事。

english: You must waste a lot of time?
translation: 你一定浪费了很多时间？

english: Yes, but what can you do? It's not like there's many cats around here!
translation: 是的，但你能怎么办？这里又没有多少猫！

english: I'm a bit busy to talk right now, sorry.
translation: 我现在有点忙，不能说话，抱歉。

english: Why? What are you doing?
translation: 为什么？你在做什么？

english: Trying to kill these mice! What I really need is a cat!
translation: 试图杀死这些老鼠！我真正需要的是一只猫！

english: You hand over the cat. You are given [100/200] Death Runes.
translation: 你交出猫。你获得 [100/200] 个死亡符石。

english: Great, thanks for that!
translation: 太好了，谢谢！

english: That's ok, take care.
translation: 没关系，保重。

english: I have a cat that I could sell.
translation: 我有一只猫可以卖。

english: Nope, I'm not parting for that.
translation: 不，我不会为了那个放手。

english: Ok then, you've got a deal.
translation: 好吧，成交。

english: Nope, they're not easy to get hold of.
translation: 不，它们不容易弄到。

english: Welcome to the Alchemical Society. What can I help you with?
translation: 欢迎来到炼金协会。有什么能帮你的？

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: This is the main facility of the Alchemical Society. We're an organisation who fuse the forgotten teachings of the Old Ones with traditional Gielinorian Herblore practices.
translation: 这是炼金协会的主要设施。我们是一个将古老者被遗忘的教义与传统的基利诺尔草药学实践融合的组织。

english: The lab under our feet allows us to fund our research by producing useful products for the kingdom.
translation: 我们脚下的实验室允许我们通过为王国生产有用的产品来资助我们的研究。

english: So you do things differently to the druids of the mainland?
translation: 所以你们做事的方式与大陆的德鲁伊不同？

english: In a way, but we very much respect Herblore as a profession and recognise that whatever your druids do definitely works. Our goal is to advance the study of Herblore, not replace it.
translation: 在某种程度上，但我们非常尊重草药学这个职业，并认识到你们的德鲁伊所做的肯定有效。我们的目标是推进草药学的研究，而不是取代它。

english: Anyway, I'm a little busy at the moment, but I'm sure some of the other lab assistants would love to tell you more!
translation: 总之，我现在有点忙，但我相信其他实验室助理会很乐意告诉你更多！

english: Thanks! I'd better be going now.
translation: 谢谢！我得走了。

english: What do you do around here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: When I'm not working in the lab, I'm normally somewhere around here researching or administrating our orders. There's an awful lot of paperwork to get through!
translation: 当我不在实验室工作时，我通常在这里附近的某个地方研究或管理我们的订单。有大量文书工作要处理！

english: Can I buy some potions?
translation: 我能买些药水吗？

english: We're not really a shop, so our products are not available to buy directly. Everything we make gets shipped wholesale around the kingdom.
translation: 我们不是真正的商店，所以我们的产品不能直接购买。我们制作的所有东西都会批发运往王国各地。

english: You look like the adventuring type anyway. I can't imagine our products would be of much use to you.
translation: 反正你看起来像冒险者类型。我想我们的产品对你没什么用。

english: Nothing. I'll be going now.
translation: 没什么。我现在走了。

english: Hey! Where do you think you're going?
translation: 嘿！你想去哪里？

english: I wanted to see what was down these stairs.
translation: 我想看看这些楼梯下面是什么。

english: We are the Alchemical Society and those stairs lead to our lab and production facilities.
translation: 我们是炼金协会，那些楼梯通向我们的实验室和生产设施。

english: Oh... I think its best that I stay away then.
translation: 哦……我想我最好还是离远点。

english: A Herblore level of 60 is required to enter the lab.
translation: 进入实验室需要60级草药学。

english: I'm actually quite skilled in Herblore. Would it be possible for me to join?
translation: 我其实草药学很熟练。我能加入吗？

english: You are? Well, we're always looking for new members, provided they have the aptitude needed. In that case, head on in and talk to Supervisor Lalo. He'll show you how everything works.
translation: 你是吗？嗯，我们一直在寻找新成员，只要他们有所需的资质。那样的话，进去找主管拉洛谈谈。他会向你展示一切如何运作。

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: Thanks! I'd better be going now.
translation: 谢谢！我得走了。

english: What do you do around here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Can I buy some potions?
translation: 我能买些药水吗？

english: Nothing. I'll be going now.
translation: 没什么。我现在走了。

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Sorry, can't stop to chat! You would be amazed at how many meals this family gets through daily!
translation: 抱歉，不能停下聊天！你会惊讶于这个家庭每天消耗多少饭菜！

english: Hey.
translation: 嘿。

english: Well hello there, adventurer! Are we fit and well?
translation: 嗯你好，冒险者！我们身体健康吗？

english: Absolutely.
translation: 当然。

english: Glad to hear it.
translation: 那就好。

english: Oh, hello there. Sorry, but I can't really talk right now. Things haven't been great here recently, and I have a lot of work to do.
translation: 哦，你好。抱歉，但我现在真的不能说话。最近这里情况不太好，我有很多工作要做。

english: Thank you for helping me. A golem can have no greater satisfaction than knowing that its task is complete.
translation: 谢谢你帮我。对魔像来说，没有什么比知道任务完成更大的满足了。

english: But the whole city is destroyed! Doesn't that bother you?
translation: 但整个城市都被毁了！那不影响你吗？

english: I was never programmed to appreciate the city. My only purpose was the destruction of the demon, and that is achieved!
translation: 我从未被编程去欣赏城市。我唯一的目的就是毁灭恶魔，而且已经实现了！

english: I regret that I could not assist you in the slaying of Agrith-Naar.
translation: 很遗憾我未能协助你斩杀阿格里斯 - 纳尔。

english: Don't worry, golem! You've done enough demon-slaying in your time.
translation: 别担心，魔像！你已经杀了足够多的恶魔了。

english: Hello, welcome to the Civic Office of West Ardougne. How can I help you?
translation: 你好，欢迎来到西阿多尼市政厅。有什么能帮你的？

english: Who is through that door?
translation: 门那边是谁？

english: The city warder Bravek is in there.
translation: 城市守卫布拉维克在里面。

english: Can I go in?
translation: 我能进去吗？

english: He has asked not to be disturbed.
translation: 他要求不被打扰。

english: I'm just looking thanks.
translation: 我只是看看，谢谢。

english: I suppose so.
translation: 我想是的。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Sorry, I don't have time to talk. Bravek needs lots of help running the city.
translation: 抱歉，我没时间说话。布拉维克需要很多帮助来管理城市。

english: Who is through that door?
translation: 门那边是谁？

english: I'm just looking thanks.
translation: 我只是看看，谢谢。

english: Good day.
translation: 你好。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: My name is Clerk. I work on gathering people together to form what we call clans.
translation: 我叫职员。我负责把人聚集在一起形成我们所说的氏族。

english: What is a clan?
translation: 什么是氏族？

english: Ah, clans. Where do I begin? Clans are groups of people gathered together for numerous reasons. Usually they have shared interests, like activities they enjoy together.
translation: 啊，氏族。我从哪说起？氏族是因多种原因聚集在一起的人群。通常他们有共同的兴趣，比如一起享受的活动。

english: These activities could include improving certain skills, battling the same monsters, or even battling other clans!
translation: 这些活动可能包括提高某些技能、对抗相同的怪物，甚至对抗其他氏族！

english: Other clans form together because they just enjoy the company of other like-minded people. The clan community can be a great resource if you should ever need help with anything.
translation: 其他氏族形成是因为他们只是喜欢志同道合的人的陪伴。如果你需要帮助，氏族社区可以是一个很好的资源。

english: How do I join a clan?
translation: 我如何加入氏族？

english: You can either form your own clan with your friends, or apply to an already existing clan.
translation: 你可以和朋友组建自己的氏族，或者申请加入已有的氏族。

english: Should you choose to form your own clan you will need four friends to join you, and it is recommended that you have spent a good amount of time in this world first. Leadership is not for everyone.
translation: 如果你选择组建自己的氏族，你需要四个朋友加入你，建议你先在这个世界花费相当多的时间。领导权不是适合每个人的。

english: However, fret not. There are plenty of interesting and exciting clans out there! Check out the clan recruitment board to see which clans are currently accepting applications.
translation: 不过，别担心。外面有很多有趣和令人兴奋的氏族！查看氏族招募板，看看哪些氏族目前正在接受申请。

english: What can a clan offer me?
translation: 氏族能提供我什么？

english: Clans offer you the ability to have an official gathering of friends or like-minded individuals in a hierarchical structure.
translation: 氏族为你提供在层级结构中与朋友或志同道合的人正式聚会的能力。

english: In other words, you and your friends get an exclusive chat channel and a Clan Hall, as well as the ability to assign ranks to members.
translation: 换句话说，你和你的朋友获得一个专属聊天频道和一个氏族大厅，以及为成员分配等级的能力。

english: Ranks can be assigned from custom pre-sets, which then determine what permissions that person has.
translation: 等级可以从自定义预设中分配，然后确定该人拥有的权限。

english: For example: One person may have the rank to kick players from the chat, while another has the rank to access the Clan Coffer.
translation: 例如：一个人可能有从聊天中踢出玩家的等级，而另一个人有访问氏族保险箱的等级。

english: What is the Clan Coffer?
translation: 什么是氏族保险箱？

english: The Clan Coffer is a shared coin store, used by members of the clan. Highly ranked members can assign who has permission to deposit and withdraw coins.
translation: 氏族保险箱是一个共享金币存储，由氏族成员使用。高等级成员可以分配谁有权限存入和取出金币。

english: What is a Clan Hall?
translation: 什么是氏族大厅？

english: A Clan Hall is a private area only accessible for the people with the permission to enter. High ranked members of the clan can restrict it to only allow certain ranks in, or open it up to even allow guests.
translation: 氏族大厅是一个私人区域，只有有权限进入的人才能访问。氏族的高等级成员可以限制只允许某些等级进入，或开放甚至允许客人进入。

english: Why would I need a Clan Hall? Can't I get a house instead?
translation: 我为什么需要氏族大厅？我不能买个房子代替吗？

english: The beauty of it is that you can have both. You can keep your house for private guests and your own personal use, but when you wish to see larger groups then the Clan Hall may be more fitting.
translation: 它的好处是你可以两者兼得。你可以保留房子用于私人客人和个人使用，但当你想见更多人时，氏族大厅可能更合适。

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: My mission is to administer clans; I help form them and can tell you anything you need to know about them.
translation: 我的任务是管理氏族；我帮助组建它们，并能告诉你任何你需要知道的关于它们的事。

english: Sure, but why are you here specifically?
translation: 当然，但你为什么 specifically 在这里？

english: Why does anyone go anywhere? As a gatherer of people, I go where people gather. The Grand Exchange is known to be a place where people come together. What better place to bring them even closer?
translation: 为什么任何人去任何地方？作为人的聚集者，我去人聚集的地方。大交易所已知是人们聚集的地方。还有什么地方能让它们更亲近？

english: I suppose this usually is a crowded place.
translation: 我想这通常是个拥挤的地方。

english: Very much so. I was lucky to find this charming corner to set up the clan hub.
translation: 非常如此。我很幸运找到这个迷人的角落设立氏族中心。

english: What's the clan hub?
translation: 什么是氏族中心？

english: The clan hub is what I call this area, my little corner of the Grand Exchange. This is where every clan is born, as well as the best place to look for new recruits.
translation: 氏族中心是我称这个区域的名字，我在大交易所的小角落。这是每个氏族诞生的地方，也是寻找新 新兵 的最佳地点。

english: If you're in a clan you can also access your Clan Hall from here.
translation: 如果你在氏族里，你也可以从这里访问你的氏族大厅。

english: I'm in a clan. Can you give me anything?
translation: 我在氏族里。你能给我什么吗？

english: I've got cloaks that let you show your clan's colours, and vexilla to help you recruit more people into your clan, but you don't have space to take any.
translation: 我有能让你展示氏族颜色的斗篷，还有旗帜帮你招募更多人加入氏族，但你没空间拿任何。

english: I suppose I'd better free up some space.
translation: 我想我最好腾出些空间。

english: Yes, you should! Now, did you want to ask me anything else while you're here?
translation: 是的，你应该！现在，你在这里时还想问我什么吗？

english: Certainly. I've got cloaks that let you show your clan's colours, and vexilla to help you recruit more people into your clan.
translation: 当然，我有能让你展示氏族颜色的斗篷，还有旗帜帮你招募更多人加入氏族。

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Goodbye. Come back any time.
translation: 再见。随时回来。

english: Sorry, you'll have to come back another day. I'm not ready to serve you yet.
translation: 抱歉，你得改天再来。我还没准备好为你服务。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: What is a clan?
translation: 什么是氏族？

english: How do I join a clan?
translation: 我如何加入氏族？

english: What can a clan offer me?
translation: 氏族能提供我什么？

english: What is the Clan Coffer?
translation: 什么是氏族保险箱？

english: What is a Clan Hall?
translation: 什么是氏族大厅？

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: I'm in a clan. Can you give me anything?
translation: 我在氏族里。你能给我什么吗？

english: Sure, but why are you here specifically?
translation: 当然，但你为什么 specifically 在这里？

english: What's the clan hub?
translation: 什么是氏族中心？

english: The people of Hosidius require sulphurous fertiliser for the farms. I see you have [number] buckets here, and [number] more in the bank. We require [number] buckets.
translation: 霍西迪乌斯城的人民需要硫磺肥料用于农场。我看到你这里有 [number] 桶，银行里还有 [number] 桶。我们需要 [number] 桶。

english: Do you wish to donate your fertiliser? We'll take what we need directly from your bank.
translation: 你愿意捐赠你的肥料吗？我们会直接从你的银行拿走我们需要的。

english: Thank you very much.
translation: 非常感谢。

english: No, sorry.
translation: 不，抱歉。

english: The people of Hosidius require sulphurous fertiliser for the farms. We currently require [number] buckets. Do come back if you every get any you'd be willing to donate.
translation: 霍西迪乌斯城的人民需要硫磺肥料用于农场。我们目前需要 [number] 桶。如果你有任何愿意捐赠的，请回来找我们。

english: If you were planning to bring any fertiliser for the stores, please try again later. The stores are very full at present.
translation: 如果你打算带任何肥料来商店，请稍后再试。目前仓库已经非常满了。

english: That's alright, I haven't brought any.
translation: 没关系，我没带任何。

english: Yes
translation: 是

english: No
translation: 否

english: Good day.
translation: 你好。

english: Hey there. What brings you here?
translation: 嘿。什么风把你吹来了？

english: This is the dense essence mine. The essence we gather here is used across Arceuus, and indeed all of Kourend. If you wish, you are welcome to mine some yourself.
translation: 这里是密集精华矿场。我们这里采集的精华用于整个阿西乌斯城，乃至整个库尔德王国。如果你愿意，欢迎你自己开采一些。

english: I might do that. Thanks.
translation: 我可能会那样做。谢谢。

english: I have a question for you.
translation: 我有个问题问你。

english: Clerris has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 克莱里斯给了你一个挑战卷轴！

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
translation: 请输入问题的答案。

english: No, try again.
translation: 不，再试一次。

english: Correct!
translation: 正确！

english: [Clerris has given you another clue scroll!/You've obtained a casket!]
translation: [克莱里斯给了你另一个线索卷轴！/你获得了一个宝箱！]

english: The mages of Arceuus seek dense essence for their experiments. I see you have [amount] blocks; we require [amount]. Donations will be marked with gratitude.
translation: 阿西乌斯城的法师们为实验寻求密集精华。我看你有 [amount] 块；我们需要 [amount]。捐赠将被铭记感激。

english: Your donation has been gratefully recieved.
translation: 你的捐赠已感激地收到。

english: No, sorry, they can't have it.
translation: 不，抱歉，他们不能得到它。

english: We do not require any dense essence from you at present. Thank you for your support.
translation: 我们目前不需要你的任何密集精华。谢谢你的支持。

english: Yes
translation: 是

english: No
translation: 否

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: What do you want, adventurer?
translation: 你想要什么，冒险者？

english: Just passing by.
translation: 只是路过。

english: You have no business here. Leave now.

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: The Kourend Royal Guard protect and serve the ruler of Kourend. As their leader, I am responsible for ensuring that the Royal Guard are well trained and well supplied.
translation: 库尔德皇家卫队保护和服务库尔德的统治者。作为他们的领袖，我负责确保皇家卫队训练有素且补给充足。

translation: 不。与谢兹恩城卫军不同，皇家卫队直接服务于王国统治者。

english: The Royal Guard was established by King Byrne I. He felt that it was dangerous for Shayzien House to control the only military in the kingdom, so he decided to establish a small one of his own.
translation: 皇家卫队由拜恩一世国王建立。他觉得让谢兹恩家族控制王国唯一的军队很危险，所以他决定建立一支自己的小军队。

english: Ever since then, the Royal Guard have served Kourend's ruler.
translation: 从那时起，皇家卫队一直服务于库尔德的统治者。

english: Who's the current ruler of Kourend?

english: The current ruler, or rulers as I should say, are the Kourend Council. They've ruled the kingdom for the past twenty years, ever since the last King died.
translation: 目前的统治者，或者说统治者们，是库尔德议会。自从上一任国王去世后的过去二十年里，他们一直统治着王国。

translation: 谢兹恩城卫军分为六个团加上谢兹恩治安队。虽然六个团共同负责保护库尔德免受外部威胁，我们处理更接近家园的问题。

english: The Intelligence Corps, the Medical Corps, the Engineering Corps, the Logistics Corps, the Rangers and of course, the Infantry. Each regiment is led by a general who reports directly to Lord Shayzien.
translation: 情报团、医疗团、工程团、后勤团、游骑兵团，当然，还有步兵团。每个团由一名直接向谢兹恩领主汇报的将军领导。

english: It feels like there must be a bit of overlap between the Constabulary and the regiments, especially the Intelligence Corps.
translation: 感觉治安队和各个团之间肯定有点重叠，尤其是情报团。

translation: 纸上我们完全与各个团分离。然而，实际上你是对的。内部和外部威胁之间的区别日益模糊。

translation: 票可以兑换我们商店的商品。你想试试吗？只要200金币。

translation: 又见面了，需要提醒规则吗？

translation: 票可以兑换我们商店的商品。祝你好运！

english: No thanks, I've got it.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我知道了。

english: Glad to hear it, good luck!
translation: 很高兴听到这个，祝你好运！

english: How am I doing so far?

translation: 目前你的得分是：0。你还没开始。

translation: 目前你的得分是：[number]。不错，继续。

translation: 目前你的得分是：[number]。你相当不错，保持下去。

english: Well done. Your score is: [number]. For that score you will receive [number] Archery tickets. Would you like to try again for another 200 coins?
translation: 做得好。你的得分是：[number]。凭那个得分你将获得 [number] 张射箭票。你想再花200金币试试吗？

english: I haven't got the money.
translation: 我没有钱。

english: Sure, I'll give it a go.
translation: 当然，我会试试。

translation: 规则是什么？

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No thanks, I've got it.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我知道了。

english: How am I doing so far?
translation: 我目前做得怎么样？

english: Hey there. Looking to buy or sell some jewellery?
translation: 嘿。想买或卖些珠宝吗？

english: Sure.
translation: 当然。

english: Good choice.
translation: 好选择。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Well come back if you change your mind.
translation: 如果你改变主意再来。

english: Sure.
translation: 当然。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Excuse me, you don't look very happy. What's wrong?
translation: 打扰一下，你看起来不太高兴。怎么了？

english: There's an egg-shaped hole in my life.
translation: 我的生活中有个蛋形的洞。

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你什么意思？

english: Usually Varrock is full of Easter merriment by now...
translation: 通常维洛克城现在应该充满了复活节的欢乐……

english: Wagons heaving with eggs being hauled up through the streets...
translation: 满载鸡蛋的马车在街道上穿行……

english: Giant rabbits hopping about, building stalls and putting up decorations...
translation: 巨型兔子跳来跳去，搭建摊位和装饰……

english: That sounds nice.
translation: 听起来不错。

english: It was a bloody racket to be honest, and dangerous!
translation: 老实说，那是个该死的喧闹，而且危险！

english: But I'd gladly stand on a rusty nail or take a plank to the face for one of them delicious chocolate eggs.
translation: 但为了其中一个美味的巧克力蛋，我乐意踩在生锈的钉子上或挨块木板砸脸。

english: Fair enough. Now that you mention it, I would have expected the Easter Bunny to have turned up by now. You're sure you haven't seen him?
translation: 好吧。既然你提到了，我本以为复活节兔子现在应该出现了。你确定没见过他？

english: Nobody has, and yet the streets are full of old carrots. We don't usually have such a problem with vegetable waste unless him and his lot have turned up.
translation: 没人见过，但街道上全是旧胡萝卜。除非他和他的伙计们出现了，否则我们通常不会有这样的蔬菜垃圾问题。

english: Vegetable waste, eh?
translation: 蔬菜垃圾，嗯？

english: Aye. It wasn't so bad when it was just the crates lying around, but someone's been in them and scattered carrots all over the place.
translation: 是的。如果只是箱子放在周围还不算太糟，但有人进了箱子，把胡萝卜撒得到处都是。

english: Curious... I wonder...
translation: 奇怪……我在想……

english: It's not just Varrock mind, it's the woods to the south of here too!
translation: 不只是维洛克城，这里南边的树林也是！

english: Hmmmmmmm.......
Crates of carrots you say? Woods to the south?
translation: 你说胡萝卜箱子？南边的树林？

english: Aye, proper suspicious if you ask me.
translation: 是的，要我说很可疑。

english: You wait right here sir, I've got a hunch...
translation: 你在这里等着，先生，我有个预感……

english: Oh lunch is it now eh? Can I have some?
translation: 哦现在是午餐时间吗？能给我一些吗？

english: No, a hunch. About the carrots.
translation: 不，是预感。关于胡萝卜的。

english: They're old and dirty, I don't want to eat those!
translation: 它们又旧又脏，我不想吃那些！

english: No... Just... I'll be back later! I need to investigate some rotten vegetables.
translation: 不……只是……我晚点回来！我需要调查一些腐烂的蔬菜。

english: They best not end up in my lunch!
translation: 它们最好别出现在我的午餐里！

english: You should probably have a look around for a suspicious crate of carrots.
translation: 你应该四处看看有没有可疑的胡萝卜箱子。

english: Wait, what was I thinking about? Oh nevermind, it's gone. Can't have been that important I suppose.
translation: 等等，我在想什么？哦没关系，忘了。想必没那么重要。

english: *sigh*
translation: 叹气

english: Fetch me lunch for me then eh, I'm right peckish!
translation: 那给我拿午餐来，我饿极了！

english: I'm a bit busy at the moment.
translation: 我现在有点忙。

english: Busy mucking about with carrots!
translation: 忙着摆弄胡萝卜！

english: Yeah, where did you say that crate was again?
translation: 是啊，你说那个箱子在哪里来着？

english: It's in the woods just south of here. Carrots all over the place too!
translation: 就在南边的树林里。胡萝卜也到处都是！

english: Oh yes, I remember. Thanks.
translation: 哦是的，我记得。谢谢。

english: Mate, it took you so long to get me lunch the Easter Bunny showed up, I had some choccy eggs instead.
translation: 伙计，你给我拿午餐花了太长时间，复活节兔子出现了，我吃了些巧克力蛋。

english: Great. That was all me you know.
translation: 太好了。那都是我做的你知道。

english: What are you talking about? It was definitely the Easter Bunny.
translation: 你在说什么？肯定是复活节兔子。

english: You know what?
translation: 你知道吗？

english: I'm still too busy to talk to you.
translation: 我还是太忙了不能跟你说话。

english: Alright, cheerio!
translation: 好吧，再见！

english: Yes.
translation: 是。

english: No.
translation: 否。

english: Take it up with the anteater. I'm a bit busy right now.
translation: 去找食蚁兽谈。我现在有点忙。

english: Well, that's not something you hear everyday...
translation: 嗯，那不是每天都能听到的……

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Welcome, traveller.
translation: 欢迎，旅行者。

english: Could you tell me about crystal singing?
translation: 你能和我说说水晶歌唱的事吗？

english: Of course! We elves learned the art long ago, allowing us to form crystals in any way we would like, using just our voices.
translation: 当然！我们精灵很久以前就学会了这门艺术，允许我们仅用声音以任何方式塑造水晶。

english: It's allowed us to make weapons, armour and tools using the finest crystals.
translation: 它让我们能用最精细的水晶制作武器、盔甲和工具。

english: Wow. Is there any way I could do it?
translation: 哇。有什么办法我能做吗？

english: You might be able to with the help of the crystal bowl over there. As long as you've got the right knowledge of what you're trying to craft.
translation: 也许在那边水晶碗的帮助下你能做到。只要你有关于你想制作什么的正确知识。

english: Could you do it for me?
translation: 你能帮我做吗？

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！

english: Could you sing a song for me?
translation: 你能为我唱首歌吗？

english: Of course! Would you like me to craft something for you? For some crystal shards, of course.
translation: 当然！你想让我为你制作什么吗？当然，需要一些水晶碎片。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No, thank you. I'd just like to hear you sing.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。我只想听你唱歌。

english: Conwenna sings you a beautiful song of the elves.
translation: 康温娜为你唱了一首美丽的精灵之歌。

english: Wow! Thank you.
translation: 哇！谢谢。

english: You do not have all of the required materials and requirements to make anything.
translation: 你没有制作任何东西所需的所有材料和要求。

english: What would you like me to craft for you?
translation: 你想让我为你制作什么？

english: A crystal helm.
translation: 一个水晶头盔。

english: Thank you!
translation: 谢谢！

translation: 你能和我说说水晶歌唱的事吗？

translation: 你能帮我做吗？

translation: 谢谢！

translation: 你能为我唱首歌吗？

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No, thank you. I'd just like to hear you sing.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。我只想听你唱歌。

english: Yes.
translation: 是。

english: Yes, and don't ask again.
translation: 是，别再问了。

english: No.
translation: 否。

english: What do you want? I'm a little busy here, so make it quick!
translation: 你想要什么？我这里有点忙，所以快点！

english: Can you sell me any food?
translation: 你能卖我些食物吗？

english: I suppose I could sell you some cabbage, if you're willing to pay for it. Cabbage is good for you.
translation: 我想我可以卖你些卷心菜，如果你愿意付钱。卷心菜对你有好处。

english: Oh, I haven't got any money.
translation: 哦，我没有钱。

english: Why are you asking me to sell you food if you haven't got any money? Go away!
translation: 如果你没钱为什么要我卖你食物？走开！

english: Oh, I haven't got enough space to carry it.
translation: 哦，我没有足够空间带它。

english: Why are you asking me to sell you food if you can't carry it? Go away!
translation: 如果你带不了为什么要我卖你食物？走开！

english: Alright, I'll buy a cabbage.
translation: 好吧，我买一个卷心菜。

english: It's a deal. Now, make sure you eat it all up. Cabbage is good for you.
translation: 成交。现在，确保你把它全吃完。卷心菜对你有好处。

english: No thanks, I don't like cabbage.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我不喜欢卷心菜。

english: Bah! People these days only appreciate junk food.
translation: 呸！现在的人只欣赏垃圾食品。

english: Can you give me any free food?
translation: 你能给我任何免费食物吗？

english: Can you give me any free money?
translation: 你能给我任何免费钱吗？

english: Why should I give you free money?
translation: 我为什么给你免费钱？

english: Why should I give you free food?
translation: 我为什么给你免费食物？

english: Oh, forget it.
translation: 哦，算了。

english: I don't want anything from this horrible kitchen.
translation: 我不想要这个可怕厨房的任何东西。

english: How dare you? I put a lot of effort into cleaning this kitchen. My daily sweat and elbow-grease keep this kitchen clean!
translation: 你怎么敢？我花了很多精力清洁这个厨房。我每天的汗水和努力保持这个厨房清洁！

english: Ewww!
translation: 咦！

english: Oh, just leave me alone.
translation: 哦，别管我。

english: Very well done, take this.
translation: 做得很好，拿着这个。

translation: 你能给我任何免费食物吗？

english: I don't want anything from this horrible kitchen.
translation: 我不想要这个可怕厨房的任何东西。

english: Hello...
translation: 你好……

english: I distinctly remember you saying you were going to stop talking to me. Yet here you are again, yakking on and on in my earhole when I'm trying to cook! What do you want now?
translation: 我清楚记得你说过要停止跟我说话。然而你又在这里，当我试图烹饪时在我耳边喋喋不休！你现在想要什么？

english: What do you want? I'm busy!
translation: 你想要什么？我很忙！

english: Can you cook me something?
translation: 你能给我做点吃的吗？

english: What? No! Go away.
translation: 什么？不！走开。

english: Well, you're meant to be a cook. Why can't you cook something for me?
translation: 嗯，你应该是厨师。为什么不能给我做点吃的？

english: I don't want to, that's why! Now, leave me alone.
translation: 我不想，这就是原因！现在，别管我。

english: You're not a very nice man.
translation: 你不是个很好的人。

english: Yet you keep talking to me!
translation: 但你一直跟我说话！

english: Good point. I should stop that.
translation: 有道理。我应该停止。

english: Yes, do us both a favour.
translation: 是的，帮帮我们俩。

english: Why do you work here?
translation: 你为什么在这里工作？

english: Why do you think I work in a disreputable inn filled with rough scoundrels on the very edge of the Wilderness? I work here because I need the job!
translation: 你以为我为什么在荒野边缘一个充满粗鲁恶棍的声名狼藉的旅馆工作？我在这里工作是因为我需要这份工作！

english: Do you like it?
translation: 你喜欢吗？

english: Like it? It's sucked the warmth and humanity out of me, and I've become a hollow shell holding nothing but anger, misery and gourmet recipes.
translation: 喜欢？它吸干了我的温暖和人性，我成了一个空壳，只装着愤怒、痛苦和美食食谱。

english: Oh.
translation: 哦。

english: What did you expect to hear? I suppose you expected me to tell you an inspiring story about how working here can teach you to find hope in the darkest places, or how to see the best in everything?
translation: 你期望听到什么？我想你期望我告诉你一个鼓舞人心的故事，关于在这里工作如何教你在最黑暗的地方找到希望，或者如何看到每件事最好的一面？

english: Maybe you should think about moving to a different inn.
translation: 也许你应该考虑搬到不同的旅馆。

english: Bah! I'm not letting it defeat me. Now, let me concentrate on my cooking.
translation: 呸！我不会让它打败我。现在，让我专心烹饪。

english: Okay.
translation: 好的。

english: Can you tell me any good jokes?
translation: 你能告诉我任何好笑话吗？

english: Ohhh, if you insist...
translation: 哦，如果你坚持……

english: What did the half-wit say to the cook?
translation: 半白痴对厨师说了什么？

english: I don't know.
translation: 我不知道。

english: [He/She/They] said 'Can you tell me any good jokes?' Got ya! Hahahaha!
translation: [He/She/They] 说“你能告诉我任何好笑话吗？”骗到你了！哈哈哈！

english: Whatever.
translation: 随便。

english: Can you cook me something?
translation: 你能给我做点吃的吗？

english: Why do you work here?
translation: 你为什么在这里工作？

english: Can you tell me any good jokes?
translation: 你能告诉我任何好笑话吗？

english: How is the adventuring going, my friend?
translation: 冒险进展如何，我的朋友？

english: I don't have anything for you to do right now, sorry.
translation: 我现在没什么给你做的，抱歉。

english: I am getting strong and mighty. Grrr
translation: 我变得强壮有力。咕噜

english: Glad to hear it.
translation: 那就好。

english: I keep on dying.
translation: 我一直在死。

english: Ah well, at least you keep coming back to life!
translation: 啊好吧，至少你一直复活！

english: Can I use your range?
translation: 我能用你的炉灶吗？

english: Go ahead - it's a very good range. It's easier to use than most other ranges.
translation: 请用——这是个很好的炉灶。比大多数其他炉灶更容易使用。

english: Its called the Cook-o-matic 100. It uses a combination of state of the art temperature regulation and magic.
translation: 它叫烹饪自动机100。它结合了最先进的温度调节和魔法。

english: Will it mean my food will burn less often?
translation: 这意味着我的食物更少烧焦吗？

english: Well, that's what the salesman told us anyway...
translation: 嗯，反正推销员是这么告诉我们的……

english: Thanks?
translation: 谢谢？

english: You were seriously great when you defeated the Culinaromancer! I can't believe I nearly caused all of those people to be killed! So how is the adventuring going now?
translation: 你击败烹饪魔法师时真是太棒了！我不敢相信我差点导致那些人被杀！那么现在冒险进展如何？

english: Hey, who said you could use that?
translation: 嘿，谁说过你可以用那个？

english: Well done.
translation: 做得好。

english: You've [found a new clue scroll/obtained a casket]!
translation: 你 [发现了一个新线索卷轴/获得了一个宝箱]！

english: I've always wondered how many cannons the castle has. Could you find out for me?
translation: 我一直想知道城堡有多少门大炮。你能帮我查查吗？

english: The cook has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 厨师给了你一个挑战卷轴！

english: Please tell me how many cannons there are.
translation: 请告诉我有多少门大炮。

english: Hmm, I don't think that's right.
translation: 嗯，我想那不对。

english: Cheers!
translation: 干杯！

english: The cook has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
translation: 厨师给了你 [另一个线索卷轴/一个宝箱]！

english: Do you have any other quests for me?
translation: 你还有其他任务给我吗？

english: I am getting strong and mighty.
translation: 我变得强壮有力。

english: I keep on dying.
translation: 我一直在死。

english: Can I use your range?
translation: 我能用你的炉灶吗？

english: You're not aristocracy but I suppose you'd do. Do you want a good cook for 3000 coins?
translation: 你不是贵族但我想你可以。你想要一个好厨师，3000金币？

english: What can you do?
translation: 你能做什么？

english: I am the finest cook in all Gielinor! I can also make good time going to the bank or the sawmill.
translation: 我是整个基利诺尔最好的厨师！我还能快速去银行或锯木厂。

english: Tell me about your previous jobs.
translation: 跟我讲讲你之前的工作。

english: I used to be the cook for the old Duke of Lumbridge. Visiting dignitaries praised me for my fine banquets!
translation: 我过去是老牌仑桥镇公爵的厨师。来访的政要称赞我的精美宴会！

english: But then someone found a rule that said that only one family could hold that post.
translation: 但后来有人发现一条规则，说只有一个家族能担任那个职位。

english: Overnight I was fired and replaced by some fool who can't even bake a cake without help!
translation: 一夜之间我被解雇了，被某个连蛋糕都不会烤的傻瓜取代了！

english: Hmph! I don't work for just anyone, you know! I refuse to work for someone who's below level 30 Construction!
translation: 哼！我不是为任何人工作的，你知道！我拒绝为建筑等级低于30级的人工作！

english: You already have a servant.
translation: 你已经有一个仆人了。

english: You need a second bedroom with a bed for your servant to sleep in.
translation: 你需要第二间卧室，放张床让仆人睡觉。

english: You're hired... well, I don't have the money on me, but can I owe you? I'm good for it, honest.
translation: 你被雇用了……嗯，我身上没带钱，但我能欠你吗？我说话算话，真的。

english: Are you having a laugh? No cash up front, no cook.
translation: 你在开玩笑吗？没有预付现金，没有厨师。

english: You're hired!
translation: 你被雇用了！

english: [Alright, sir./Alright, madam./Alright.] I can start work immediately.
translation: [好的，先生。/好的，女士。/好的。] 我可以立即开始工作。

english: What can you do?
translation: 你能做什么？

english: Tell me about your previous jobs
translation: 跟我讲讲你之前的工作

english: You're hired!
translation: 你被雇用了！

english: Can you teach me the basics of cooking please?
translation: 你能教我烹饪的基础吗？

english: The simplest thing to cook is raw meat or fish.
translation: 最简单的烹饪是生肉或鱼。

english: Fish can be caught, speak to the fishing tutor south of here in the swamp. Killing cows or chickens will yield raw meat to cook too.
translation: 鱼可以捕获，跟这里南边沼泽里的钓鱼导师谈谈。杀牛或鸡也会产生生肉烹饪。

english: You can use your own fire... but it's not as effective and you'll burn more. To build a fire use a tinderbox on logs.
translation: 你可以用自己的火……但没那么有效，你会烧焦更多。生火用火绒盒对木头使用。

english: Once you've found your range, click on it. This will bring up a menu of the food you can cook.
translation: 一旦你找到炉灶，点击它。这会弹出你可以烹饪的食物菜单。

english: If you're interested in quests, I heard my friend the cook in Lumbridge Castle is in need of a hand. Just talk to him and he'll set you off.
translation: 如果你对任务感兴趣，我听说我在仑桥堡的厨师朋友需要帮手。跟他谈谈，他会让你开始。

english: I already know the basics of cooking. Got any tips?
translation: 我已经知道烹饪基础了。有什么提示吗？

english: Using a range cuts down the possibility of burning the food. In fact, the range in the Lumbridge Castle is particularly good for some foods, I hear.
translation: 使用炉灶减少烧焦食物的可能性。事实上，我听说仑桥堡的炉灶对某些食物特别好。

english: Compare the skills you learn to the effort put into making the food and the health that it heals, find a good combination for you.
translation: 比较你学习的技能与制作食物的努力及其恢复的生命值，找到适合你的组合。

english: Any advice for an advanced chef?
translation: 有什么给高级厨师的建议吗？

english: As you get better and better you'll find that you can cook better food such as pizza! These are very good for healing you when fighting the big monsters.
translation: 随着你变得越来越好，你会发现你可以烹饪更好的食物，比如披萨！这些在对抗大怪物时非常适合治疗你。

english: How can I train my cooking?
translation: 我如何训练我的烹饪？

english: It seems we have a real master chef in our mists. Maybe you should be the one giving me cooking advice.
translation: 看来我们迷雾中有一位真正的大厨。也许应该是你给我烹饪建议。

english: If you feel up to the task, you could try your hand at making pizza. A pizza is comprised of flour with water/ Put some tomato on there, sprinkle on some cheese then cook it. You might consider adding a topping too.
translation: 如果你能胜任，可以尝试制作披萨。披萨由面粉和水组成/放些番茄在上面，撒些乳酪然后烹饪。你也可以考虑加些配料。

english: Potatoes are another great food, but I won't go into much detail about those I'm afraid.
translation: 土豆是另一种很好的食物，但恐怕我不会详细说明。

english: Of course, you can try making a curry or baked potato if you feel up to it.
translation: 当然，如果你能胜任，可以尝试制作咖喱或烤土豆。

english: Tell me about different foods.
translation: 跟我讲讲不同的食物。

english: Fish and meat of most varieties can be cooked very simply on either a fire or range, expirement which one works for you.
translation: 大多数种类的鱼和肉可以在火或炉灶上非常简单地进行烹饪，试试哪个适合你。

english: You can brew your own beers using the fermenting vats in either Keldagrim or Port Phasmatys. Use two buckets of water, two handfuls of barley malt, 4 hops of your choice and a pot of ale yeast, then leave to
translation: 你可以使用凯尔达格林城或法斯玛提斯港的发酵桶酿造自己的啤酒。使用两桶水、两把大麦麦芽、4个你选择的啤酒花和一罐啤酒酵母，然后放置

english: ferment for a few days!
translation: 发酵几天！

english: Simply turn the tap and let the ale flow into the barrel next to the vat, then use empty beer glasses on the barrel.
translation: 只需打开龙头，让啤酒流入桶旁边的桶里，然后在桶上使用空啤酒杯。

english: Baked potatoes are excellent foods and they are healthy too! You'll need to churn some butter and cheese. Look for the churn icon on the minimap. There is a churn in the farm building northwest of Lumbridge.
translation: 烤土豆是极好的食物，而且健康！你需要搅拌一些黄油和乳酪。在小地图上寻找搅拌器图标。仑桥镇西北的农场建筑里有一个搅拌器。

english: The nearest dairy cow is north of the nearby water mill. Take buckets of milk with you to the churn and use the milk on the churn to make butter or cheese.
translation: 最近的奶牛在附近的水磨坊北边。带几桶牛奶去搅拌器，在搅拌器上使用牛奶制作黄油或乳酪。

english: Use a pot of flour with a bucket of awter. You will then get an option to make bread dough, pitta bread dough, pastry dough, or pizza dough. Select pizza or pastry dough.
translation: 使用一罐面粉和一桶水。然后你会获得制作面包面团、皮塔饼面团、糕点面团或披萨面团的选项。选择披萨或糕点面团。

english: Use the pastry dough with a pie dish then add your filling such as apple or red berries.
translation: 将糕点面团与派烤盘一起使用，然后添加你的馅料，如苹果或红莓。

english: Finally cook your pie by using the unbaked pie on a cooking range. Mmmm...pie.
translation: 最后通过在烹饪炉灶上使用未烤的派来烹饪你的派。嗯……派。

english: There's pizza too! Find yourself some tomato and cheese, use on the Pizza dough. Cook the pizza on a range then add any other toppings you want, such as anchovies.
translation: 还有披萨！找些番茄和乳酪，用在披萨面团上。在炉灶上烹饪披萨，然后添加任何你想要的其他配料，如凤尾鱼。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Hello there! Are you interested in hearing all about cooking?
translation: 你好！你有兴趣听关于烹饪的一切吗？

english: The simplest thing to cook is raw meat or fish. Shrimp can be caught south of here, to the east of Lumbridge Swamp. You could ask the fishing tutor for a net if you have not got one.
translation: 最简单的烹饪是生肉或鱼。虾可以在这里南边，仑桥镇沼泽东边捕获。如果你没有网，可以向钓鱼导师要一个。

english: Alternatively, you could acquire some raw beef or chicken. You can find cows and chickens north of here. Go over the bridge then follow the path north, you can't miss them!
translation: 或者，你可以获得一些生牛肉或鸡肉。你可以在这里北边找到牛和鸡。过桥然后沿着路向北，你不会错过它们！

english: You could use my range here if you like.
translation: 如果你愿意，可以在这里使用我的炉灶。

english: If you wanted to, my friend the cook in Lumbridge Castle has a range you could use. You might find you burn even less on that range as its top notch.
translation: 如果你愿意，我在仑桥堡的厨师朋友有一个你可以使用的炉灶。你可能会发现那个炉灶烧焦更少，因为它是顶级的。

english: Alternatively, you can use your own fire, but it's not as effective and the food will burn more frequently. To make a fire, use a tinderbox on some logs.
translation: 或者，你可以用自己的火，但没那么有效，食物会更频繁烧焦。生火，用火绒盒对一些木头使用。

english: Once you've found your range or fire, use your raw food on it. This will bring up a menu of the food you can cook. Then select the food you want.
translation: 一旦你找到炉灶或火，在上面使用你的生食物。这会弹出你可以烹饪的食物菜单。然后选择你想要的食物。

english: When you have a full inventory of cooked food, drop the useless burnt food and find a bank.
translation: 当你有一整包熟食物时，丢弃无用的烧焦食物，找个银行。

english: Is there anything else you want to know?
translation: 还有什么你想知道的吗？

english: What kinds of things can I cook?
translation: 我能烹饪什么样的东西？

english: Many things! You can cook anything from fish to poultry. You could try your hand at making baked potatoes or even brew some of the good stuff.
translation: 很多东西！你可以烹饪从鱼到家禽的任何东西。你可以尝试制作烤土豆，甚至酿造一些好东西。

english: What would you like to hear about?
translation: 你想听关于什么的？

english: Tell me about Fish and Meat.
translation: 跟我讲讲鱼和肉。

english: You might find that when killing monsters, they drop some raw meat for you to cook.
translation: 你可能会发现杀怪时，它们会掉落一些生肉给你烹饪。

english: Some of them might have hidden properties. Such as anglerfish, but you will find it hard getting hold of any of them at this time.
translation: 其中一些可能有隐藏属性。比如鮟鱇鱼，但你现在会发现很难获得任何。

english: Most of the time, cooking meat and fish requires nothing else but a range or fire. More complicated dishes might require specialized equipment.
translation: 大多数时候，烹饪肉和鱼只需要炉灶或火。更复杂的菜肴可能需要专用设备。

english: Would you like to hear about anything else I mentioned?
translation: 你想听我提到的其他东西吗？

english: Tell me about Brewing.
translation: 跟我讲讲酿造。

english: You might find it hard getting to these places but you can always buy beer at any pub. Some pubs sell unique beers too.
translation: 你可能会发现很难去这些地方，但你总是可以在任何酒馆买啤酒。一些酒馆也出售独特的啤酒。

english: Tell me about Vegetables.
translation: 跟我讲讲蔬菜。

english: They require many different ingredients to make, such as butter and vegetables, but you will find it hard to acquire the ingredients needed.
translation: 制作它们需要许多不同的配料，如黄油和蔬菜，但你会发现很难获得所需的配料。

english: Tell me about Pies and Pizzas.
translation: 跟我讲讲派和披萨。

english: Next, we have pizza. You will first need to make yourself a pizza base, use a pot of flour with a bucket of water and make a pizza base.
translation: 接下来，我们有披萨。你首先需要制作一个披萨饼底，使用一罐面粉和一桶水制作披萨饼底。

english: If you want to, you could add yourself a topping to the pizza too. Why not try some anchovies?
translation: 如果你愿意，你也可以给自己加些配料。为什么不试试凤尾鱼？

english: No, thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Well, just come back any time you want to know how to cook up a storm!
translation: 好吧，随时回来，如果你想知道如何大展厨艺！

english: Some foods have hidden properties. Anglerfish can provide you with an overheal effect where you have a few more hitpoints than your level. The higher your hitpoints the better the boost.
translation: 一些食物有隐藏属性。鮟鱇鱼可以为你提供超量治疗效果，你的生命值比等级多几点。你的生命值越高，提升越好。

english: Use two buckets of water, two handfuls of barley malt, 4 hops of your choice and a pot of ale yeast, then leave to ferment for a few days!
translation: 使用两桶水、两把大麦麦芽、4个你选择的啤酒花和一罐啤酒酵母，然后放置发酵几天！

english: You'll need to churn some butter and cheese. Look for the churn icon on the minimap. There is a churn in the farm building northwest of Lumbridge.
translation: 你需要搅拌一些黄油和乳酪。在小地图上寻找搅拌器图标。仑桥镇西北的农场建筑里有一个搅拌器。

english: Now you will need to pick your topping if you want one. Get yourself a boweland create the perfect topping. Then put the topping onto the potato.
translation: 现在如果你想要，需要选择你的配料。给自己弄个碗，创造完美的配料。然后把配料放在土豆上。

english: Some pies might even be able to boost some of your skills, be it temporarily.
translation: 一些派甚至可能暂时提升你的一些技能。

english: I'm Zanik of the Dorgeshuun! Pleased to meet you!
translation: 我是多格舒恩族的扎尼克！很高兴见到你！

english: Hello there Zanik! How can I help?
translation: 你好扎尼克！我能怎么帮你？

english: What kind of foods do you eat up here on the surface?
translation: 你们在地表吃什么样的食物？

english: All sorts of foods! There are lots of kinds of fish, and there are stews, pizzas, bread, baked potatoes...
translation: 各种食物！有很多种类的鱼，还有炖菜、披萨、面包、烤土豆……

english: This is so exciting! Perhaps later I'll come back and sample lots of different surface foods!
translation: 太令人兴奋了！也许晚点我会回来品尝许多不同的地表食物！

english: I'm sure you'll like them! What about you, [player name] Can I help you?
translation: 我相信你会喜欢的！你呢，[player name] 我能帮你吗？

english: Can you teach me the basics of cooking please?
translation: 你能教我烹饪的基础吗？

english: I already know the basics of cooking. Got any tips?
translation: 我已经知道烹饪基础了。有什么提示吗？

english: How can I train my cooking?
translation: 我如何训练我的烹饪？

english: Any advice for an advanced chef?
translation: 有什么给高级厨师的建议吗？

english: Tell me about different food I can make.
translation: 跟我讲讲我能制作的不同食物。

english: Fish and Meat
translation: 鱼和肉

english: Brewing
translation: 酿造

english: Vegetables
translation: 蔬菜

english: Pies and Pizza
translation: 派和披萨

english: Go back to teaching
translation: 回到教学

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: What kinds of things can I cook?
translation: 我能烹饪什么样的东西？

english: Tell me about Fish and Meat.
translation: 跟我讲讲鱼和肉。

english: Tell me about Brewing.
translation: 跟我讲讲酿造。

english: Tell me about Vegetables.
translation: 跟我讲讲蔬菜。

english: Tell me about Pies and Pizzas.
translation: 跟我讲讲派和披萨。

english: No, thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Get out of my way stinky! I've got stew to make!
translation: 让开，臭家伙！我有炖菜要做！

english: What do you want, stinky?
translation: 你想要什么，臭家伙？

english: Hello to you too. You must be Weasel then.
translation: 也向你问好。那你一定是韦塞尔。

english: Yes I am. Cooky Weasel to you. Finest cook this side of, well, pick an object - or a concept - or a location! I'm the best cook any side of anything what you can think of!
translation: 没错就是我。叫我库奇‧威瑟尔。我是这一带……嗯，随便挑个地方——或者东西——或者概念！只要你能想到的，我就是最好的厨师！

english: Is that why you're down in this hole?
translation: 所以你才待在这个洞里？

english: Hole?! This is a fine establishment. At least it was until you stank it up.
translation: 洞？！这可是家好店。至少在你把它弄臭之前是。

english: Good grief, this is going to be a long day.
translation: 天哪，这将是漫长的一天。

english: What was that?
translation: 那是什么？

english: I said Wheeler told me you might have some extra nice carrots I could use?
translation: 惠勒告诉我你可能有些多余的胡萝卜能给我用？

english: Wheeler sent you eh? Hmm... Why would I give you my good carrots? Thems for roasting with honey, not for stinking up with your grubby mitts.
translation: 惠勒派你来的，嗯？哼……我为什么要给你我的好胡萝卜？那些是用来蘸蜂蜜烤的，不是让你脏手碰臭的。

english: I want to make some special carrot juice for the Easter Bunny, to try and cheer him up.
translation: 我想为复活节兔子做些特别的胡萝卜汁，试着让他高兴起来。

english: Oh! Well why didn't you say so? Smells like a good idea to me. If anyone deserves some good juice, it's him!
translation: 哦！那你早说啊？听起来是个好主意。如果有人值得喝好果汁，那就是他！

english: Smells like you don't have space for these wonderful carrots. Clear some room and come back when you can handle the veggies!
translation: 看来你没地方放这些美妙的胡萝卜了。腾点地方，等你能装下蔬菜了再回来！

english: There's 3 fancy carrots for you, stinky. Now go and get that juice made before your stench rots 'em!
translation: 给你3根高级胡萝卜，臭家伙。现在快去把果汁做了，别让你的臭味把它们弄烂了！

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！

english: You've managed to make carrot juice? Surprising, and it doesn't seem to stink. Almost unbelievable!
translation: 你居然做成了胡萝卜汁？真让人惊讶，而且闻起来不臭。简直难以置信！

english: Smells to me like you've already got enough of my fancy carrots. Go away!
translation: 我看你已经拿够我的高级胡萝卜了。走开！

english: What are you after now?
translation: 你现在想要什么？

english: I need another carrot, I lost one.
translation: 我需要另一根胡萝卜，我丢了一根。

english: I need more carrots, I lost some of them.
translation: 我需要更多胡萝卜，我丢了一些。

english: I need more carrots, I lost them all.
translation: 我需要更多胡萝卜，我全丢了。

english: You weren't nibbling at them were you? I bet you were thinking about it.
translation: 你没偷吃它们吧？我打赌你想过。

english: Of course not.
translation: 当然没有。

english: Yeah right. Here, take 'em. Take all of my lovely carrots! Just make sure the Easter Bunny gets his juice this time.
translation: 是啊是啊。给，拿去。把我所有可爱的胡萝卜都拿去！这次确保复活节兔子拿到他的果汁。

english: Thank you. Won't happen again.
translation: 谢谢。不会再发生了。

english: You've been eating the carrots! I can smell 'em on your breath! You big stinking piggy!
translation: 你一直在吃胡萝卜！我都能从你口气里闻出来！你这头臭猪！

english: I'm sure I would remember eating such a delicous, sweet, crunchy, orange, juicy...
translation: 我肯定记得吃过这么美味、香甜、脆口、橙黄、多汁的……

english: What was the question?
translation: 问题是什么？

english: Take these carrots and get out of my sight.
translation: 拿着这些胡萝卜，从我眼前消失。

english: You've got orange stains around your mouth!
translation: 你嘴巴周围有橙色污渍！

english: Probably from the carrot juice.
translation: 可能是胡萝卜汁弄的。

english: YOU WHAT?!? You DRANK the juice that you made for the Easter Bunny?
translation: 你说什么？！你喝了你为复活节兔子做的果汁？

english: It was very good.
translation: 非常好喝。

english: Oh for... Please use these carrots for their intended purpose.
translation: 哦真是……请把这些胡萝卜用在正途上。

english: Not only that, I drank the juice!
translation: 不仅如此，我还喝了果汁！

english: YOU WHAT?!? You're a real piece of work. Do you think these carrots grow on trees?
translation: 你说什么？！你真是个奇葩。你以为这些胡萝卜是长在树上的吗？

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: Well they don't. They grow underground. And they're expensive. So either help the Easter Bunny, or stop wasting my stock!
translation: 才不是呢。它们长在地底下，而且很贵的。所以要么帮助复活节兔子，要么别浪费我的库存！

english: I'll do my best.
translation: 我会尽力。

english: Good news! The Easter Bunny loved the juice I made with your fancy carrots!
translation: 好消息！复活节兔子很喜欢我用你的高级胡萝卜做的果汁！

english: I'm glad to hear it.
translation: 那就好。

english: Now clear off!
translation: 现在滚蛋！

english: Keep your hands away from these lovely carrots, stinky!
translation: 把手拿开，别碰这些可爱的胡萝卜，臭家伙！

english: I wasn't anywhere near them!
translation: 我根本没靠近它们！

english: I can smell you getting closer, stinky!
translation: 我能闻到你靠近了，臭家伙！

english: I don't want any carrots I'm just here for eggs!
translation: 我不想要任何胡萝卜，我只是来拿鸡蛋的！

english: Good, cause these carrots aren't for you, stinky!
translation: 很好，因为这些胡萝卜不是给你的，臭家伙！

english: Fine, I'm going!
translation: 好吧，我走了！

english: Greetings human.
translation: 你好，人类。

english: Hello, who are you?
translation: 你好，你是谁？

english: Corkat quo Sihar. I am one of the mystics of the Kahlith. Are you here to serve the balance?
translation: 科卡特‧夸‧西哈尔。我是卡利斯的秘术师之一。你是来效命于平衡的吗？

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: Then you should speak to Konar quo Maten. She will guide you.
translation: 那你应该跟科纳‧夸‧马滕谈谈。她会引导你。

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: A shame. You are a bringer of death, you could be of great use to the balance.
translation: 真可惜。你是死亡使者，本可以对平衡大有用处。

english: I'm not sure.
translation: 我不确定。

english: Then you should speak with Xorrah quo Sihar. He will show you the way.
translation: 那你应该跟佐拉‧夸‧西哈尔谈谈。他会给你指路。

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: I'm not sure.
translation: 我不确定。

english: Hey it's the hero! Thank you so much for saving us from Gadderanks. And the town is looking lovely as well. You've done a great job!
translation: 嘿是英雄！非常感谢你从加德兰克斯手中救了我们。城镇看起来也很可爱。你做得太棒了！

english: You're more than welcome.
translation: 不用客气。

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: I'm Cornelius. I run the bank now.
translation: 我是科尼利厄斯。我现在经营银行。

english: How do you like your town?
translation: 你觉得你的城镇怎么样？

english: It's just perfect. Thanks so much for your efforts.
translation: 非常完美。非常感谢你的努力。

english: What's happening around here?
translation: 这里发生什么事了？

english: Oh, not much really. We're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place.
translation: 哦，其实没什么。我们都还在躲避吸血鬼，在这个鬼地方艰难度日。

english: Hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey across the Salve.
translation: 希望很快我们能强大到足以穿越萨鲁夫河。

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: 有什么我能帮忙的吗？

english: Not as far as I know. We have some basic amenities now which is so very useful and we're all incredibly grateful to you.
translation: 据我所知没有。我们现在有了一些基本设施，非常有用，我们都非常感激你。

english: I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: 我从前没见过真正的英雄，没法比较，但我相信，在大多数人眼中，你定是英雄无疑！至少我很高兴能见到你。

english: Okay, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: How do you like your town?
translation: 你觉得你的城镇怎么样？

english: What's happening around here?
translation: 这里发生什么事了？

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: 有什么我能帮忙的吗？

english: Okay, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Excuse me! This area is different than the rest of the Wilderness, are you sure you understand the rules?
translation: 打扰一下！这片区域跟荒野其他地方不同，你确定了解规则吗？

english: I can tell you everything you need to know, but if you're in a rush then be warned my overlords will NOT be happy if they find you to be fighting with no honour.
translation: 我可以告诉你所有你需要知道的，但如果你赶时间，警告你，如果我的霸主发现你战斗没有荣誉，他们不会高兴的。

english: Just don't go doing anything silly like selling your soul to your opponent else there will be big trouble!
translation: 别做蠢事，比如把你的灵魂卖给对手，否则会有大麻烦！

english: [How may I help you, sir/How may I help you, madam/How may I help you]?
translation: [How may I help you, sir/How may I help you, madam/How may I help you]？

english: I'd like to learn the rules of combat in this arena!
translation: 我想学习这个竞技场的战斗规则！

english: Sure. Which part do you want to learn?
translation: 当然，你想学哪部分？

english: Let's talk about Targets.
translation: 我们谈谈目标吧。

english: Sure. Upon entering the arena, you will be assigned a Target based on your combat level, and if you wish to adjust the range of potential Targets, you may do so by speaking with the Trader.
translation: 当然，进入竞技场后，系统会根据你的战斗等级给你分配一个目标，如果你想调整潜在目标的范围，你可以跟商人谈谈。

english: If you wish to change your Target, you may skip your current one, but please note that if you skip three skulled Targets within 30 minutes, you will not be able to receive a new Target for the next 30 minutes.
translation: 如果你想改变你的目标，你可以跳过当前的，但请注意，如果你在30分钟内跳过三个带骷髅头的目标，你在接下来的30分钟内将无法接收新目标。

english: Additionally, it's worth mentioning that killing a player who is not your Target will not reward you with any bonuses related to Emblem or Bounty Hunter Points.
translation: 另外，值得一提的是，杀死不是你的目标的玩家不会奖励你任何与徽章或赏金猎人点数相关的奖励。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Tell me about Emblems.
translation: 跟我讲讲徽章。

english: After defeating your Target, you may come across a tier one Emblem. Defeating another Target will level up the Emblem; the higher its tier, the greater its value.
translation: 击败你的目标后，你可能会遇到一级徽章。击败另一个目标会升级徽章；等级越高，价值越大。

english: If you die while carrying an Emblem, its tier will be reduced by one. If you die with a Tier 1 emblem, you will lose the emblem.
translation: 如果你携带徽章时死亡，其等级会降低一级。如果你携带一级徽章死亡，你将失去徽章。

english: You may use Bounty Hunter Points to purchase a tier one Emblem from the Trader, or sell your own Emblem to him for Bounty Hunter Points. You can only have one Emblem at a time.
translation: 你可以使用赏金猎人点数从商人那里购买一级徽章，或者将你自己的徽章卖给他换取赏金猎人点数。你一次只能拥有一个徽章。

english: Can you explain Bounty Hunter Points to me?
translation: 你能给我解释一下赏金猎人点数吗？

english: You can earn Bounty Hunter Points by defeating your target or selling Emblems to the Trader. Once you have Bounty Hunter Points, you may use them to purchase rewards from the reward shop.
translation: 你可以通过击败目标或向商人出售徽章来赚取赏金猎人点数。一旦你有了赏金猎人点数，你可以用它们从奖励商店购买奖励。

english: What is the Coffer for?
translation: 金库是用来做什么的？

english: To participate in Bounty Hunter, you must have a certain amount of coins in your Coffer, which varies based on your combat level. Currently you need at least [x] coins to participate.
translation: 要参与赏金猎人，你的金库中必须有一定数量的金币，这根据你的战斗等级而不同。目前你至少需要 [x] 金币才能参与。

english: If you are unskulled and another person kills you in Bounty Hunter, [x] coins will be deducted from your Coffer and given to your killer.
translation: 如果你没有骷髅且另一个人在赏金猎人中杀死你，[x] 金币将从你的金库中扣除并给予你的杀手。

english: If you are skulled, 10,000 coins will be deducted from your Coffer and given to your killer. However, any surplus money in your Coffer will remain safe.
translation: 如果你有骷髅，10,000金币将从你的金库中扣除并给予你的杀手。但是，金库中的任何多余资金将保持安全。

english: To manage your Coffer, talk to the Trader.
translation: 要管理你的金库，跟商人谈谈。

english: How do I get bounty crates?
translation: 我怎么获得赏金箱子？

english: Well, if you want crates, you'll need to be fighting a target in the arena while having a minimum value of risked items on you. Anything you can protect, we won't count.
translation: 嗯，如果你想要箱子，你需要在竞技场中战斗目标，同时身上有风险物品的最低价值。任何受保护的物品，我们都不计入。

english: If you meet these requirements, we'll keep track of how long you're in there for. We'll occasionally give you a bonus if you die as well.
translation: 如果你满足这些要求，我们会跟踪你在里面的时间。如果你死了，我们偶尔也会给你奖励。

english: When you kill a target, if you've been in long enough, you'll get a crate. If you've been in there longer, you'll get a higher value crate.
translation: 当你杀死一个目标时，如果你在里面待得够久，你会得到一个箱子。如果你在里面待得更久，你会得到更高价值的箱子。

english: The crates don't contain anything special; just coins and supplies to help cover what you'll use in the crater.
translation: 箱子里没有什么特别的东西；只有金币和补给品，帮你弥补在坑穴中的消耗。

english: If you keep killing your target, you probably won't get many high value crates, but you'll certainly get a lot more points and Emblems instead.
translation: 如果你一直杀死你的目标，你可能不会得到很多高价值箱子，但你肯定会得到更多点数和徽章。

english: Can you corrupt my Ancient Warrior armour?
translation: 你能腐蚀我的古代战士盔甲吗？

english: Do you know anything about Bounty Hunter hats?
translation: 你知道关于赏金猎人帽子的什么事吗？

english: Ah yes, you'll be able to collect them from me, once you've got some targeted kills that is.
translation: 啊是的，一旦你有了一些目标击杀，你就可以从我这里收集它们。

english: Ah yes! I've been told to hold onto some hats for you, for your uhm... deeds in the wilderness.
translation: 啊是的！我被告知为你保管一些帽子，为了你在荒野的……事迹。

english: Oh wonderful, can I take a look?
translation: 哦太好了，我能看看吗？

english: You need [number] target kills to claim this hat. You currently have [number].
translation: 你需要 [number] 次目标击杀才能领取这顶帽子。你目前有 [number] 次。

english: I'm afraid you've already got one of those hats, I can't let you have another.
translation: 恐怕你已经有一顶那种帽子了，我不能给你另一顶。

english: I'm afraid you've got nowhere to put a hat if I gave one to you.
translation: 恐怕如果我给你一顶帽子，你也没地方放。

english: Here you go, enjoy!
translation: 给你，享受吧！

english: Can you tell me my current EP value?
translation: 你能告诉我我当前的 EP 值吗？

english: Of course. Your current EP value is [number]%.
translation: 当然，你当前的 EP 值是 [number]%。

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: Beyond this portal lies Daimon's Crater, a place where you'll fight other adventurers like yourself for glory and rewards.
translation: 这个传送门后面是戴蒙的坑穴，一个你将与其他像你一样的冒险者为了荣耀和奖励战斗的地方。

english: Sadly, I can't let you into Daimon's Crater right now.
translation: 可惜，我现在不能让你进入戴蒙的坑穴。

english: Bounty Hunter is only available on specific Bounty Hunter worlds.
translation: 赏金猎人只在特定的赏金猎人世界可用。

english: If you step through this portal, you'll be taken to Daimon's Crater, where we've set up a lobby area for you to ready yourself for combat.
translation: 如果你穿过这个传送门，你将被带到戴蒙的坑穴，我们在那里为你设置了一个大厅区域，让你准备战斗。

english: If you'd like, I can explain the rules of Bounty Hunter to you.
translation: 如果你愿意，我可以给你解释赏金猎人的规则。

english: Can I access my Bounty Hunter coffer?
translation: 我能访问我的赏金猎人金库吗？

english: Certainly. Would you like to add or remove coins from it?
translation: 当然，你想往里面存入或取出金币吗？

english: Deposit coins.
translation: 存入金币。

english: Withdraw coins.
translation: 取出金币。

english: Yes, I acknowledge these rules.
translation: 是的，我承认这些规则。

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: I'd like to learn the rules of combat in this arena!
translation: 我想学习这个竞技场的战斗规则！

english: Let's talk about Targets.
translation: 我们谈谈目标吧。

english: Tell me about Emblems.
translation: 跟我讲讲徽章。

english: Can you explain Bounty Hunter Points to me?
translation: 你能给我解释一下赏金猎人点数吗？

english: What is the Coffer for?
translation: 金库是用来做什么的？

english: How do I get bounty crates?
translation: 我怎么获得赏金箱子？

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Tell me about the Emblems.
translation: 跟我讲讲徽章。

english: Can you corrupt my Ancient Warrior armour?
translation: 你能腐蚀我的古代战士盔甲吗？

english: Ask about Bounty Hunter Hats.
translation: 询问赏金猎人帽子。

english: Ask about the EP value.
translation: 询问 EP 值。

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: Can I access my Bounty Hunter coffer?
translation: 我能访问我的赏金猎人金库吗？

english: Yawwwwwn!
translation: 哈欠！

english: Ye'll pay!
translation: 你会付出代价的！

english: Curse you!
translation: 诅咒你！

english: Curse 'em all!
translation: 诅咒他们所有人！

english: Arrr, land-lubber!
translation: 啊，旱鸭子！

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Salutations traveller! It is unusual for one of the creatures called 'humans' to visit this plane. How can I assist you?
translation: 问候旅行者！被称为“人类”的生物之一访问这个位面是不寻常的。我能怎么帮你？

english: I'm just looking around, thanks.
translation: 我只是四处看看，谢谢。

english: I hope the beauty of my world brings you great joy.
translation: 希望我世界的美丽给你带来巨大的喜悦。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: My name, in your language, would be Bubrezankaldargarez'jk, but you can just call me Bub. This small plane is my home, here I study and ponder the mysteries of existence.
translation: 我的名字，用你们的语言，会是布布雷赞卡尔达加雷兹jk，但你可以叫我布布。这个小位面是我的家，我在这里研究和思考存在的奥秘。

english: Mysteries of existence, eh? Like what?
translation: 存在的奥秘，嗯？比如什么？

english: I'm looking for a Star Flower.
translation: 我在找星花。

english: Then you've come to the right place. Star Flower, which is much prized for its magical properties, only grows on this plane. It has a very short life-span; plants grow, flower and die in the space of minutes! If you search
translation: 那你来对地方了。星花因其魔法属性而备受珍视，只生长在这个位面。它的寿命很短；植物在几分钟内生长、开花和死亡！

english: around you might find some growing somewhere.
translation: 如果你四处搜索，可能会发现某处生长着一些。

english: Where do flies go at night?
translation: 苍蝇晚上去哪里？

english: Have you ever flicked through a dictionary and afterwards felt really depressed by how much you don't know?
translation: 你有没有翻过字典，然后因为不知道自己知道的有多少而感到非常沮丧？

english: Do other birds speak pigeon pidgin?
translation: 其他鸟说鸽子皮钦语吗？

english: Political philosophy is an oxymoron.
translation: 政治哲学是一个矛盾修辞法。

english: Why are yawns contagious?
translation: 为什么打哈欠会传染？

english: Do sick days include when you're sick of work?
translation: 病假包括你厌倦工作的时候吗？

english: To be is to be the value of a variable.
translation: 存在就是成为一个变量的值。

english: How do you know when you've run out of invisible ink?
translation: 你怎么知道什么时候隐形墨水用完了？

english: Where does a snake's tail begin?
translation: 蛇的尾巴从哪里开始？

english: How long do fish wait to swim after they eat?
translation: 鱼吃完后等多久才游泳？

english: If you're halfway from here to there, which is which?
translation: 如果你从这里到那里的一半，哪个是哪个？

english: I'm just looking around, thanks.
translation: 我只是四处看看，谢谢。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: I'm looking for a Star Flower.
translation: 我在找星花。

english: You were very brave for going on stage to confront a killer. Looks like you did well to get her to surrender without damaging her costume.
translation: 你上台面对杀手非常勇敢。看起来你做得很好，让她投降而没有损坏她的服装。

english: It was very well made. Makes the job of not damaging it much easier!
translation: 它做得非常好。让不损坏它的工作容易多了！

english: Why thank you! I credit my needles for the good work.
translation: 为什么谢谢你！我把功劳归于我的针。

english: Would I be able to get one of them for my own purposes?
translation: 我能为了自己的目的得到一个吗？

english: I suppose I could part with one... If you're careful not to lose it.
translation: 我想我可以放弃一个……如果你小心别弄丢它。

english: I'll be careful.
translation: 我会小心的。

english: Have you still got that needle safe and secure?
translation: 你还把那根针安全保管好吗？

english: I have indeed.
translation: 我确实有。

english: Aww, what a cute cat! I better not wake it up.
translation: 哎呀，多可爱的猫！我最好别叫醒它。

english: I certainly wouldn't hand you over for any runes, you're too adorable.
translation: 我肯定不会为了任何符石把你交出去，你太可爱了。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: How do. You planning on crossing this here bridge and heading up to Rellekka then?
translation: 你好。你打算过这座桥去雷勒卡城吗？

english: Yes, actually I was.
translation: 是的，其实我是。

english: Aye, 'tis a good thing we fixed this 'ere bridge, I reckon. You best be careful up there. Them Fremenniks are odd 'uns.
translation: 是的，我想我们修好这座桥是好事。你最好小心点。那些费明尼克人很奇怪。

english: So you fixed this bridge yourself?
translation: 所以你自己修了这座桥？

english: Aye, that I did. 'Twas real thirsty work too. If only some kind stranger would buy us a bit of beer to sup, eh?
translation: 是的，我修了。那真是口渴的工作。要是某个好心的陌生人能给我们买些啤酒喝就好了，嗯？

english: What with that inn at seers so close by and all, eh?
translation: 毕竟先知那里的旅馆那么近，嗯？

english: The workman winks at you
translation: 工人向你眨眼

english: Just make sure yer don't get me none of that non alcoholic rubbish from that poison salesman guy at the tavern!
translation: 确保你别从酒馆那个毒药推销员那里给我弄那些无酒精的垃圾！

english: I wasn't planning on it, no.
translation: 我没打算那样，不。

english: Aye, that's what I told t'gaffer. Nobody wants to go up and hang out with a buncha dumb barbarians when there's a perfectly good inn to sup in, in t'seers village.
translation: 是的，我就是这么告诉工头的。既然先知村有个很好的旅馆可以喝酒，没人想上去跟一群愚蠢的野蛮人混在一起。

english: Ain't much better in life than having a nice cold beer to sup on a hot day like this, eh? Better'n fixing bridges, eh?
translation: 生活中没什么比在这样的热天喝杯冰啤酒更好的了，嗯？比修桥好，嗯？

english: A bit early in the day fer that ain't it?
translation: 今天有点早了吧？

english: Ta very much, like. That'll hit the spot nicely. Here, you can have this. I picked it up as a souvenir on me last hols.
translation: 非常感谢，伙计。那正合我意。给，你可以拿这个。我上次度假时把它当纪念品捡来的。

english: What is it?
translation: 它是什么？

english: I dunno rightly, but if you use a tinderbox on it, it don't half make a loud noise!
translation: 我也不太清楚，但如果你用火绒盒用它，它会发出巨大的噪音！

english: No ta, not my brand of beer.
translation: 不用了谢谢，不是我的啤酒品牌。

english: No ta, not a big wine fan, me.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我不是葡萄酒迷。

english: Yes
translation: 是

english: No
translation: 否

english: Hi there.
translation: 你好。

english: Good day to you.
translation: 你好。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: My name is David Andrews. I'm the Head Councillor of the Kourend Council.
translation: 我叫大卫‧安德鲁斯。我是库尔德议会的首席议员。

english: Tell me about the Kourend Council.
translation: 跟我讲讲库尔德议会。

english: Kourend's last King, Kharedst IV, had only one child when he died. She was too young to take the throne, so the Kourend Council was formed to look after things until she came of age.
translation: 库尔德的最后一位国王，卡雷德斯特四世，去世时只有一个孩子。她太小不能继承王位，所以成立了库尔德议会来照管事务，直到她成年。

english: Alas, she was very close to her father and his sudden death drove her to insanity. With no suitable ruler, the Kourend Council was made permanent.
translation: 唉，她跟父亲很亲近，他的突然去世使她精神失常。由于没有合适的统治者，库尔德议会成为永久性的。

english: How is the Council structured?
translation: 议会结构如何？

english: The Kourend Council is made up of four councillors. Every four years there is an election for the people to decide who the councillors should be.
translation: 库尔德议会由四名议员组成。每四年有一次选举，让人民决定议员应该是谁。

english: One of the councillors holds the position of Head Councillor and this rotates every year. I am the current Head Councillor.
translation: 其中一名议员担任首席议员职位，每年轮换。我是现任首席议员。

english: The other councillors are Councillor Hughes, Councillor Unkar and Councillor Orson.
translation: 其他议员是休斯议员、昂卡议员和奥森议员。

english: The other councillors are Councillor Unkar and Councillor Orson. The fourth seat on the Council is currently vacentafter the recent arrest of Councillor Hughes.
translation: 其他议员是昂卡议员和奥森议员。议会的第四个席位目前在休斯议员最近被捕后空缺。

english: So where do the five houses fit in?
translation: 那么五个家族在哪里融入？

english: The five houses of Kourend each have their own leader who rules over their city. The leaders of the individual houses must enforce and obey the laws set out by the Kourend Council, but can otherwise rule as they see fit.
translation: 库尔德的五个家族各自有自己的领导者统治他们的城市。各个家族的领导者必须执行和遵守库尔德议会制定的法律，但可以按他们认为合适的方式统治。

english: I hope that helps.
translation: 希望那有帮助。

english: Yes, thank you.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Time for me to go.
translation: 我该走了。

english: Good day citizen.
translation: 你好公民。

english: Come to gloat?
translation: 来幸灾乐祸？

english: Well I do enjoy it when people get what they deserve.
translation: 嗯我确实喜欢人们得到他们应得的。

english: You'll never know what it's like to be on top of the world. The power I had was unconquerable. I'd do it all again without hesitation.
translation: 你永远不会知道站在世界之巅是什么感觉。我拥有的力量是不可征服的。我会毫不犹豫地再做一次。

english: You never had any power. You were just a puppet. You've always been nothing, and that's all you'll ever be.
translation: 你从未有过任何力量。你只是个傀儡。你一直什么都不是，那也是你永远的样子。

english: That's not true!
translation: 那不是真的！

english: Enjoy your cell, puppet. Won't be seeing you.
translation: 享受你的牢房吧，傀儡。不会再见到你了。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Tell me about the Kourend Council.
translation: 跟我讲讲库尔德议会。

english: Time for me to go.
translation: 我该走了。

english: Welcome to the Catherby Council Office. Your views are important to us.
translation: 欢迎来到凯瑟比镇议会办公室。你的观点对我们很重要。

english: That's good to hear...
translation: 听到这个很好……

english: Unfortunately, all of our operatives are too busy to help you today. Please try again soon.
translation: 不幸的是，我们所有的操作员今天都太忙了，无法帮助你。请稍后再试。

english: Delightful...
translation: 令人愉快……

english: Hello. How are you?
translation: 你好。你怎么样？

english: I've been better.
translation: 我曾经更好。

english: What's wrong?
translation: 怎么了？

english: You may or may not be aware, but a plague has spread across West Ardougne. Now, so far, our efforts to contain it have been largely successful, for the most part.
translation: 你可能知道也可能不知道，但瘟疫已经蔓延到西阿多尼城。现在，到目前为止，我们控制它的努力在很大程度上是成功的。

english: However, some sheep recently escaped from a farm near the city. When they were found, we noticed that they were strangely discoloured, so we asked the mourners to examine them.
translation: 然而，一些羊最近从城市附近的一个农场逃跑了。当它们被发现时，我们注意到它们奇怪地变色了，所以我们请哀悼者检查它们。

english: They believe that the sheep have become infected with the plague.
translation: 他们认为羊已经感染了瘟疫。

english: Are you sure it's the plague?
translation: 你确定是瘟疫吗？

english: Well the mourners seemed convinced and they're the experts. Even if it's not though, the sheep are clearly diseased in some way.
translation: 嗯哀悼者似乎确信，他们是专家。即使不是，羊也显然以某种方式患病了。

english: As the councillor responsible for public health and safety here in East Ardougne, I am in charge of dealing with this problem.
translation: 作为负责东阿多尼城这里公共卫生和安全的议员，我负责处理这个问题。

english: We need someone to herd these sheep into a safe enclosure, kill them quickly and cleanly and then dispose of the remains hygienically in a special incinerator.
translation: 我们需要有人把这些羊赶进一个安全的围栏，快速干净地杀死它们，然后在特殊的焚化炉中卫生地处理尸体。

english: Unfortunately, nobody wants to risk catching the plague, and I am unable to find someone willing to undertake this mission for me.
translation: 不幸的是，没人愿意冒险感染瘟疫，我也找不到愿意为我承担这个任务的人。

english: I can do that for you.
translation: 我可以为你做那个。

english: You will? That is excellent news! Head to the enclosure we have set up on Farmer Brumty's land to the north of the city; the four infected sheep should still be somewhere in that vicinity.
translation: 你会吗？那是个好消息！去我们在城市北边布鲁姆蒂农夫土地上设置的围栏；四只感染的羊应该还在那附近。

english: Before you will be allowed to enter the enclosure, however, you must ensure you have some kind of protective clothing to prevent contagion.
translation: 但在你被允许进入围栏之前，你必须确保你有某种防护服以防止传染。

english: Where can I find some protective clothing then?
translation: 那么我在哪里可以找到一些防护服？

english: Doctor Orbon should have something suitable. You should be able to find him in the chapel just north of here.
translation: 奥本医生应该有一些合适的。你应该能在北边的教堂找到他。

english: Please also take this poisoned sheep feed; we believe poisoning the sheep will minimise the risk of airborne contamination, and is of course also more humane to the sheep.
translation: 请也带上这个毒羊饲料；我们相信毒死羊将最小化空气传播污染的风险，当然对羊也更人道。

english: How will I know which sheep are infected?
translation: 我怎么知道哪些羊感染了？

english: The poor creatures have developed strangely discoloured wool and flesh. You should have no trouble spotting them. There should be four in total.
translation: 可怜的生物长出了奇怪变色的羊毛和肉。你应该不难发现它们。总共应该有四只。

english: That's not a job for me.
translation: 那不是我该做的工作。

english: I do not blame you adventurer. It is not particularly pleasant work. My problem remains however. If you know of anyone suitable please send them this way; time is of the essence.
translation: 我不怪你冒险者。这不是特别愉快的工作。但我的问题仍然存在。如果你知道任何合适的人，请把他们派到这里；时间紧迫。

english: That's life for you.
translation: 这就是生活。

english: That's what concerns me... There might not be much life around here soon.
translation: 那就是我担心的……这里可能很快就没有多少生命了。

english: Hello again sir.
translation: 又见面了先生。

english: Well hello again adventurer! How are you today?
translation: 嗯又见面了冒险者！你今天怎么样？

english: Fine thank you. And yourself?
translation: 很好谢谢。你呢？

english: I'm okay. Sadly some more diseased sheep have appeared so I have them to deal with.
translation: 我很好。可惜又出现了一些病羊，所以我得处理它们。

english: Do you need me to help again?
translation: 你需要我再帮忙吗？

english: Thank you for the kind offer. You've done enough though. We'll find someone else to deal with these ones.
translation: 谢谢你的好意。但你已经做得够多了。我们会找别人来处理这些。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Hello, is there any news about how our sheep keep getting infected with the plague?
translation: 你好，有关于我们的羊如何不断感染瘟疫的消息吗？

english: Not that I know of, sorry.
translation: 据我所知没有，抱歉。

english: I'd sure like to know why we can't contain it. Please raise the issue next time you see the Head Mourner.
translation: 我肯定想知道为什么我们无法控制它。下次你见到首席哀悼者时请提出这个问题。

english: I'll keep it in mind.
translation: 我会记在心里的。

english: Hello again.
translation: 又见面了。

english: Not too bad, I've a lot to do though. King Lathas left plenty of things for us to clean up.
translation: 还不错，但我有很多事要做。拉萨斯国王留下了很多我们要清理的东西。

english: What's wrong?
translation: 怎么了？

english: Yes.
translation: 是。

english: No.
translation: 否。

english: That's life for you.
translation: 这就是生活。

english: Thank you for helping to repair the Doors of Dinh. Kourend is a safer place because of you.
translation: 谢谢你帮助修复丁之门。因为你，库尔德是一个更安全的地方。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: I'm Councillor Unkar, one of the members of the Kourend Council. We are responsible for running the entire Kingdom of Great Kourend.
translation: 我是昂卡议员，库尔德议会的成员之一。我们负责管理整个大库尔德王国。

english: What brings you to Lovakengj then?
translation: 那么什么带你来洛瓦肯吉城？

english: It's important for the council to maintain a good relationship with the rulers of the five houses. Although it is the council that rules, we can only do so with their support.
translation: 议会与五个家族的统治者保持良好关系很重要。虽然是议会统治，但只有得到他们的支持我们才能这样做。

english: I'm here to help Lady Lovakengj out and to make sure she has everything she needs to rule effectively.
translation: 我来这里帮助洛瓦肯吉女士，确保她拥有一切有效统治所需的东西。

english: What are the Doors of Dinh?
translation: 什么是丁之门？

english: They are a great set of doors built by the legendary smith, Dinh, in the early days of Kourend. They were created to imprison a deadly beast known as the Wintertodt.
translation: 它们是传奇铁匠丁在库尔德早期建造的一组大门。它们是为了囚禁一种称为冬将军的致命野兽而创建的。

english: Unfortunately, the doors were recently damaged, putting Kourend at risk. The master smith Undor, managed to repair them though, something he couldn't have done without you.
translation: 不幸的是，大门最近被损坏，使库尔德处于危险之中。大师铁匠温多尔设法修复了它们，没有你他做不到。

english: I'll get going.
translation: 我走了。

english: Human.
translation: 人类。

english: How's the cell?
translation: 牢房怎么样？

english: A step down from what I'm used to.
translation: 比我习惯的差一步。

english: Well you'd better get used to it. This is where you'll spend the rest of your life, however long that ends up being.
translation: 嗯你最好习惯它。这就是你度过余生的地方，无论那有多长。

english: Oh, I'm all too aware of that. Here, I will fade into obscurity as the world forgets my actions. I've accepted it. Besides, it's for the best that I not be remembered.
translation: 哦，我非常清楚。在这里，随着世界忘记我的行为，我将默默无闻地消失。我已经接受了。此外，最好别被记住。
