english: This stump is all that remains of the Great Auburn Redwood. It was, and in many ways still is, one of the key holy sites of Varlamore.
translation: 这个树桩是伟大奥本红木仅存的部分。它过去是，而且在很多方面现在仍然是瓦拉莫尔的关键圣地之一。

english: What happened to it?
translation: 它怎么了？

english: The tree was destroyed during the War of Betrayal many years ago. It was here in the Auburn Valley that the fighting was at its most fierce.
translation: 这棵树多年前在背叛战争中被毁。正是在奥本山谷，战斗最为激烈。

english: Both sides resorted to tactics that most would consider to be beyond horrifying. The tree was sadly a casualty of such tactics.
translation: 双方都采取了大多数人认为极其可怕的战术。这棵树不幸成为了这些战术的牺牲品。

english: Which side was responsible?
translation: 是哪一方负责的？

english: That has never been clear. Ranul teaches us to find and preserve the truth, but in war, the truth is sadly left behind.
translation: 那从来都不清楚。拉努尔教导我们寻找并保存真相，但在战争中，真相不幸被抛在脑后。

english: So the battles that took place here... Is that why all these animal spirits are here now?
translation: 所以在这里发生的战斗……这就是为什么现在所有这些动物灵魂都在这里吗？

english: Yes. They are the spirits of the animals that died here during the War of Betrayal. They did not pass on to Mictl, for they have unfinished business in these lands.
translation: 是的。它们是在背叛战争中死在这里的动物的灵魂。它们没有前往米克特尔，因为它们在这片土地上还有未了之事。

english: What business?
translation: 什么事？

english: That is beyond our understanding. We believe they are here to guide the ents that live in the valley so that they may one day regrow the Great Auburn Redwood.
translation: 那超出了我们的理解。我们相信它们在这里是为了引导生活在山谷中的树精，以便它们有朝一日能重新长出伟大的奥本红木。

english: The ents can do that?
translation: 树精能做到吗？

english: Much of the valley was destroyed during the war. Most of what you see around you was regrown by the ents.
translation: 山谷的大部分在战争中被毁了。你周围看到的大多数东西都是树精重新长出来的。

english: That's incredible!
translation: 太不可思议了！

english: Indeed it is, my child. That is why it is our duty to ensure the ents are protected. The events of the war cannot be repeated.
translation: 确实是，我的孩子。这就是为什么确保树精受到保护是我们的责任。战争的悲剧不能重演。

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: Then go in peace, my child.
translation: 那就平安去吧，我的孩子。

english: Can you heal me? I'm injured.
translation: 你能治疗我吗？我受伤了。

english: What's the giant tree stump all about?
translation: 那个大树桩是怎么回事？

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: Would you like to buy some crafting equipment?
translation: 你想买些制作装备吗？

english: No thanks; I've got all the Crafting equipment I need.
translation: 不用了，谢谢；我已经有我需要的所有制作装备了。

english: Okay. Fare well on your travels.
translation: 好的。祝你旅途顺利。

english: What do you know about Ali Morrisane?
translation: 你对阿里‧莫里桑了解多少？

english: I know that one of his thugs has threatened to ruin my store if I don't cooperate with them!
translation: 我知道他的一个暴徒威胁说如果我不配合他们，就毁掉我的店！

english: He said he was a tailor, but those scissors looked more like a weapon than something used for Crafting.
translation: 他说他是个裁缝，但那把剪刀看起来更像是武器而不是制作工具。

english: What are you going to do, then?
translation: 那你打算怎么办？

english: As long as I have my store, I'll keep selling my Crafting equipment! Would you like to buy any?
translation: 只要我的店还在，我就会继续卖我的制作装备！你想买些吗？

english: Hi! I have this money-off voucher!
translation: 嗨！我有这张优惠券！

english: So I see! Unfortunately, it seems to have expired yesterday! Nevermind.
translation: 我看到了！不幸的是，它似乎昨天就过期了！没关系。

english: But I only just got it!
translation: 但我才刚拿到！

english: I'm sorry, there's nothing I can do.
translation: 抱歉，我无能为力。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: No thanks; I've got all the Crafting equipment I need.
translation: 不用了，谢谢；我已经有我需要的所有制作装备了。

english: Let's see what you've got, then.
translation: 那让我看看你有什么。

english: What do you know about Ali Morrisane?
translation: 你对阿里‧莫里桑了解多少？

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Not infected are you?
translation: 你没被感染吧？

english: I don't think so.
translation: 我想没有。

english: You don't seem very sure. We don't want any infected near the children. Be off with you!
translation: 你看起来不太确定。我们不想让任何感染者靠近孩子。快走！

english: Whatever it is you're selling, we ain't interested!
translation: 不管你在卖什么，我们没兴趣！

english: But I'm not...
translation: 但我不是……

english: Did you not hear me? Clear off!
translation: 你没听到我说的话吗？滚开！

english: ...(Don't Know What silently lets you in.)
translation: ……(不知何物默默让你进去。)

english: Player enters Weiss
translation: 玩家进入魏斯聚落

english: ...(Don't Know What silently lets you out.)
translation: ……(不知何物默默让你出来。)

english: Player exits Weiss
translation: 玩家离开魏斯聚落

english: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？

english: Just wondering if you were still here.
translation: 只是想知道你是否还在这里。

english: Of course I'm still here.
translation: 我当然还在这里。

english: I'm not going near that crack in the wall again.
translation: 我再也不会靠近墙上的那道裂缝了。

english: Rock falls and so on are fine, but sea monsters in caves - never!
translation: 岩石坠落什么的还好，但洞穴里的海怪——绝对不行！

english: What are you doing down in these caves?
translation: 你在这些洞穴里做什么？

english: I'm waiting to work on the excavations...
translation: 我在等着进行挖掘工作……

english: ...though I don't really want to start digging again.
translation: ……虽然我不太想再次开始挖掘。

english: Why not? I thought digging was something dwarves were good at.
translation: 为什么不？我以为挖掘是矮人擅长的事。

english: Not with monsters like that one in those caves.
translation: 但那些洞穴里有那样的怪物就不行了。

english: It had huge teeth and flaming red eyes, and was almost the size of the tunnel!
translation: 它有巨大的牙齿和火红的眼睛，几乎和隧道一样大！

english: If it attacks the town...
translation: 如果它攻击城镇……

english: Are you an adventurer, by any chance?
translation: 你该不会是个冒险者吧？

english: Adventurer and Regent of Miscellania.
translation: 冒险者兼米斯凯尼亚国摄政王。

english: In that case, could you go and deal with that monster?
translation: 那样的话，你能去处理那个怪物吗？

english: I don't want to have to face it again if it attacks the town.
translation: 如果它攻击城镇，我不想再次面对它。

english: Of course. Dealing with monsters is what I do best!
translation: 当然。对付怪物是我最擅长的！

english: You'll need to get into the other caves first, of course.
translation: 当然，你需要先进入其他洞穴。

english: There's a crack in the wall where the others are digging, but the rocks are loose, and can fall on you if you're not careful.
translation: 其他人挖掘的地方墙上有条裂缝，但岩石松动，如果不小心会砸到你。

english: I can give you a mining prop to keep them from falling, if you give me a minute to find it...
translation: 如果你给我一分钟找到它……我可以给你一个采矿支撑架防止它们坠落。

english: Okay, so all I have to do is get through that wall?
translation: 好的，所以我只需要穿过那面墙？

english: No, after that the only way you can get further is climbing up onto a high ledge, then crawling through a tunnel.
translation: 不，之后唯一能继续前进的方法是爬上一个高台，然后爬过一条隧道。

english: But the walls are slippery...
translation: 但墙壁很滑……

english: ...and I think I might have broken the lift when I fell off it on my way back.
translation: ……而且我想我回来时从上面摔下来可能把升降机弄坏了。

english: You'll probably need to fix the lift - I doubt you'd be able to climb.
translation: 你可能需要修理升降机——我怀疑你能爬上去。

english: And the monster's behind that tunnel?
translation: 怪物在那条隧道后面？

english: Somewhere behind it. I couldn't get very far, what with the flooding in the tunnel.
translation: 在它后面的某个地方。隧道里有积水，我没走多远。

english: There's some rope and some planks near the broken lift - those would probably come in handy.
translation: 坏掉的升降机附近有些绳子和木板——那些可能会派上用场。

english: Ah, here's that mining prop. I knew I had it somewhere.
translation: 啊，采矿支撑架在这里。我就知道我有放在某个地方。

english: Here you go. Good luck with fighting that monster.
translation: 给你。祝你打败那个怪物好运。

english: Why bother? It can't get through solid rock.
translation: 何必麻烦？它穿不过坚硬的岩石。

english: That's what I thought, until I saw the sheer size of it. This thing probably MADE the tunnels!
translation: 我也是这么想的，直到我看到了它的巨大体型。这东西可能就是挖出这些隧道的！

english: And you're sending me in to deal with it alone?
translation: 你就派我一个人去对付它？

english: I've heard stories from the Miscellanians. If you're the Regent, you must be quite a strong hero.
translation: 我听过米斯凯尼亚人的故事。如果你是摄政王，你一定是个很强的英雄。

english: So what are you worried about? You probably eat monsters like that for breakfast!
translation: 那你担心什么？你可能把那种怪物当早餐吃！

english: I wouldn't put it quite like that...
translation: 我不会那么说……

english: But I'll help you after all. Now, how do I find this monster?
translation: 但我还是会帮你。现在，我怎么找到这个怪物？

english: Of course. Dealing with monsters is what I do best!
translation: 当然。对付怪物是我最擅长的！

english: Why bother? It can't get through solid rock.
translation: 何必麻烦？它穿不过坚硬的岩石。

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: What?
translation: 什么？

english: I said hello!
translation: 我说你好！

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Why, I'm Dondakan, of course!
translation: 哎呀，我当然是东达坎！

english: Why are you firing a cannon at a wall?
translation: 你为什么朝墙开炮？

english: I can't tell you!
translation: 我不能告诉你！

english: Why not?
translation: 为什么不能？

english: You're a human! This is a dwarven thing!
translation: 你是人类！这是矮人的事！

english: Isn't there anything I can do that will make you tell me?
translation: 有没有什么我能做的能让你告诉我？

english: Perhaps if you were to help some of my fellow dwarves...
translation: 也许如果你能帮助我的一些矮人同胞……

english: I hear there is a fishing competition that a few of my distant kinsmen are keen on winning, for instance.
translation: 比如我听说有个钓鱼比赛，我的一些远房亲戚很想赢。

english: A fishing competition? What are dwarves doing in a fishing competition?
translation: 钓鱼比赛？矮人参加钓鱼比赛做什么？

english: They're not in it! They can't fish if their lives depended on it!
translation: 他们没参加！就算性命攸关他们也不会钓鱼！

english: That's where you come in! Run along now!
translation: 这就是你需要帮忙的地方！快去吧！

english: Well... you are the Fishing Champion... but I still can't really speak about this.
translation: 嗯……你确实是钓鱼冠军……但我还是不能说这个。

english: The cannon is a top-secret dwarven project, you know.
translation: 这门大炮是矮人的绝密项目，你知道的。

english: Doesn't look very secret to me, standing out there in the open.
translation: 在我看来一点也不秘密，就那样大摇大摆地放在外面。

english: Being cheeky eh?
translation: 胆子不小啊？

english: Maybe you should speak to Lawgof, the Commander of the Black Guard in Kandarin.
translation: 也许你应该去找坎达林黑卫队的指挥官劳戈夫谈谈。

english: Bit noisy here, isn't it?
translation: 这里有点吵，不是吗？

english: Cozy? No, not really, it's damp and cold!
translation: 舒适？不，一点也不，又湿又冷！

english: No! I said it's noisy!
translation: 不！我说的是吵！

english: Then stop shouting!
translation: 那你别喊了！

english: Goodbye!
translation: 再见！

english: How are you doing, Dondakan?
translation: 你怎么样，东达坎？

english: Oh, just fine, just fine! This gold is certainly creating a steady flow of income for me! After the company takes some of the cut, of course.
translation: 哦，很好，很好！这些金子确实给我带来了稳定的收入！当然是在公司抽成之后。

english: Can you shoot me into the rock again?
translation: 你能再把我射进岩石里吗？

english: You need to wear that golden helmet... unless you want to crack open your skull on the rock.
translation: 你需要戴上那个金头盔……除非你想在岩石上撞碎头骨。

english: Of course, just a second, let me adjust my cannon again.
translation: 当然，等一下，让我再调整一下大炮。

english: Say, are you selling those boots of yours?
translation: 话说，你卖你那双靴子吗？

english: What, you mean these granite boots?
translation: 什么，你是说这双花岗岩靴子？

english: Yes, I'd be happy to pay quite some money for them!
translation: 是的，我很乐意花不少钱买它们！

english: Haha, I bet you would, I bet you would!
translation: 哈哈，我打赌你会，我打赌你会！

english: But I no longer need the money, this rock is generating plenty!
translation: 但我不再需要钱了，这块岩石赚的钱足够了！

english: Besides, I'm rather fond of them now... best boots I ever had!
translation: 而且，我现在挺喜欢它们的……是我有过最好的靴子！

english: Oh please...
translation: 哦拜托……

english: No, I won't sell them.
translation: 不，我不卖。

english: Pretty please?
translation: 求求你了？

english: No!
translation: 不！

english: Oh come on!!!
translation: 哦拜托！！！

english: Well...
Yes?
translation: 嗯？

english: How much gold would you be willing to pay for it? Not that I'm selling my boots, mind, I'm just curious.
translation: 你愿意出多少金币买它？不是说我要卖靴子，我只是好奇。

english: What, are you trying to scam old Dondakan? You want me to sell these boots for a measly [number] coins?
translation: 什么，你想骗老东达坎？你想让我以区区 [number] 金币卖掉这双靴子？

english: I'm not selling them anyway.
translation: 反正我也不卖。

english: You're so poor, you don't even have that much gold on you...
translation: 你太穷了，身上连那么多金币都没有……

english: If I were selling my granite boots, which I'm clearly not, I would certainly not accept a mere [number] coins for them.
translation: 如果我要卖我的花岗岩靴子，而我显然不卖，我肯定不会接受区区 [number] 金币。

english: That's quite a sum of money, which I notice you don't even have on you.
translation: 那是一大笔钱，而我注意到你身上甚至没有那么多。

english: Haha, nice try [player name]!
translation: 哈哈，想得美 [player name]！

english: Pity I'm not selling my boots, not for any price or any item.
translation: 可惜我不卖靴子，无论什么价格或物品都不卖。

english: I just wanted to see how high you would go!
translation: 我只是想看看你能出到多高！

english: Bah, thanks a lot.
translation: 呸，多谢了。

english: Hey, that's quite a bit of money. Which you don't have on you. Oh well, I wasn't selling my boots anyway.
translation: 嘿，那是不少钱。而你身上没有。算了，反正我也不卖靴子。

english: Never mind, I don't want them anymore.
translation: 没关系，我不想要了。

english: Great, because I don't want to sell them.
translation: 太好了，因为我不想卖。

english: Okay.
translation: 好的。

english: Right.
translation: 对。

english: Check these out.
translation: 看看这些。

english: Where'd you get those from? Did you make your own?
translation: 你从哪儿弄来的？你自己做的吗？

english: Not quite, they were retrieved from the corpse of a wyvern.
translation: 不完全是，它们是从一只飞龙的尸体上取下来的。

english: You killed a wyvern? Last I heard they were all dead.
translation: 你杀了一只飞龙？我上次听说它们都死光了。

english: I never said I killed it! But perhaps I did, I am a grand adventureafter all!
translation: 我从没说我杀了它！但也许我杀了，我毕竟是个伟大的冒险者！

english: Oh dear, oh dear. It seems firing you head first into a rock was perhaps not the best idea, you've gone absolutely loony.
translation: 哎呀，哎呀。看来把你头朝前射进岩石可能不是最好的主意，你完全疯了。

english: Hmm, well you do have a point...
translation: 嗯，你说得有道理……

english: It's alright Laddie, I'm just joking.
translation: 没事的小伙子，我只是开玩笑。

english: That's great, but I have to go now.
translation: 太好了，但我现在得走了。

english: Come back any time!
translation: 随时回来！

english: I don't want anything from you right now.
translation: 我现在不想要你任何东西。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Why are you firing a cannon at a wall?
translation: 你为什么朝墙开炮？

english: Bit noisy here, isn't it?
translation: 这里有点吵，不是吗？

english: Goodbye!
translation: 再见！

english: Can you shoot me into the rock again?
translation: 你能再把我射进岩石里吗？

english: Are you selling those boots of yours?
translation: 你卖你那双靴子吗？

english: Oh please...
translation: 哦拜托……

english: Never mind, I don't want them anymore.
translation: 没关系，我不想要了。

english: That's great, but I have to go.
translation: 太好了，但我得走了。

english: Hello there, can I help you?
translation: 你好，我能帮你吗？

english: Where am I?
translation: 我在哪儿？

english: This is the town of Lumbridge my friend.
translation: 这是仑桥镇，我的朋友。

english: How are you today?
translation: 你今天怎么样？

english: Aye, not too bad thank you. Lovely weather in Gielinor this fine day.
translation: 嗯，还不错，谢谢。今天基利诺尔天气真好。

english: Weather?
translation: 天气？

english: Yes weather, you know.
translation: 是的天气，你知道的。

english: The state or condition of the atmosphere at a time and place, with respect to variables such as temperature, moisture, wind velocity, and barometric pressure.
translation: 大气在特定时间和地点的状态或状况，涉及温度、湿度、风速和气压等变量。

english: Not just a pretty face eh? Ha ha ha.
translation: 不只是个花瓶对吧？哈哈哈。

english: Do you know of any quests I can do?
translation: 你知道有什么任务我可以做吗？

english: What kind of quest are you looking for?
translation: 你在找什么样的任务？

english: Hmm.. dangerous you say? What sort of creatures are you looking to fight?
translation: 嗯……你说危险的？你想打什么样的生物？

english: Big scary demons!
translation: 又大又可怕的恶魔！

english: You are a brave soul indeed.
translation: 你真是个勇敢的人。

english: Now that you mention it, I heard a rumour about a fortune-teller in Varrock who is rambling about some kind of greater evil.. sounds demon-like if you ask me.
translation: 既然你提到了，我听说维洛克城有个算命的人在胡言乱语说什么更大的邪恶……要我说听起来像恶魔。

english: Perhaps you could check it out if you are as brave as you say?
translation: 如果你真像你说的那么勇敢，也许你可以去看看？

english: Thanks for the tip, perhaps I will.
translation: 谢谢提示，也许我会的。

english: I've already killed the demon Delrith. He was merely a stain on my sword when I was finished with him!
translation: 我已经杀了恶魔德尔里斯。我解决他时他只是我剑上的一块污渍！

english: Well done! However I'm sure if you search around the world you will find more challenging foes to slay.
translation: 干得好！不过我相信如果你环游世界，你会找到更有挑战性的对手来斩杀。

english: Vampyres!
translation: 吸血鬼！

english: Ha ha. I personally don't believe in such things. However, there is a man in Draynor Village who has been scaring the village folk with stories of vampyres.
translation: 哈哈。我个人不相信这种东西。不过，德雷诺村有个人一直在用吸血鬼的故事吓唬村民。

english: He's named Morgan and can be found in one of the village houses. Perhaps you could see what the matter is?
translation: 他叫摩根，可以在村里的一栋房子里找到。也许你可以去看看怎么回事？

english: Thanks for the tip.
translation: 谢谢提示。

english: Oh I have already killed that nasty blood-sucking vampyre. Draynor will be safe now.
translation: 哦我已经杀了那个讨厌的吸血吸血鬼。德雷诺现在安全了。

english: Yeah, yeah of course you did. Everyone knows vampyres are not real....
translation: 是啊，是啊，当然你杀了。谁都知道吸血鬼不是真的……

english: What! I did slay the beast..I really did.
translation: 什么！我真的杀了那野兽……我真的杀了。

english: You're not fooling anyone you know.
translation: 你知道你骗不了任何人。

english: ..Huh.. But... Hey! I did... believe what you like.
translation: ……哈……但是……嘿！我真的杀了……信不信由你。

english: Small.. something small would be good.
translation: 小的……一些小任务就好。

english: Small? Small isn't really that dangerous though is it?
translation: 小的？小的其实没那么危险吧？

english: Yes it can be! There could be anything from an evil chicken to a poisonous spider. They attack in numbers you know!
translation: 是的，可以很危险！可能从邪恶鸡到毒蜘蛛什么都有。它们会成群攻击，你知道的！

english: Yes ok, point taken. Speaking of small monsters, I hear old Wizard Mizgog in the wizards' tower has just had all his beads taken by a gang of mischievous imps.
translation: 是的好的，明白了。说到小怪物，我听说法师塔的老法师米兹戈格的珠子刚被一群淘气的小鬼偷走了。

english: Sounds like it could be a quest for you?
translation: 听起来像是个适合你的任务？

english: Thanks for your help.
translation: 谢谢你的帮助。

english: Yes I know of Mizgog and have already helped him with his imp problem. It took me ages to find those beads!
translation: 是的我认识米兹戈格，已经帮他解决了小恶魔问题。我花了好长时间才找到那些珠子！

english: Imps will be imps!
translation: 小鬼就是小鬼！

english: Maybe another time.
translation: 改天吧。

english: Something easy please, I'm new here.
translation: 请给些简单的，我是新来的。

english: I can tell you about plenty of small easy tasks.
translation: 我可以告诉你很多简单的小任务。

english: The Lumbridge cook has been having problems, the Duke is confused over some strange talisman and on top of all that, poor lad Romeo in Varrock has girlfriend problems.
translation: 仑桥厨师遇到了问题，公爵对某个奇怪的护符感到困惑，还有维洛克城那个可怜的小伙子罗密欧有女朋友问题。

english: Tell me about the Lumbridge cook.
translation: 跟我讲讲仑桥厨师。

english: It's funny really, the cook would forget his head if it wasn't screwed on. This time he forgot to get ingredients for the Duke's birthday cake.
translation: 说起来好笑，厨师要不是头拧在脖子上，他连头都能忘。这次他忘了给公爵的生日蛋糕准备食材。

english: Perhaps you could help him? You will probably find him in the Lumbridge Castle kitchen.
translation: 也许你能帮他？你可能会在仑桥堡厨房找到他。

english: Thank you. I shall go speak with him.
translation: 谢谢。我去跟他谈谈。

english: I have already helped the cook in Lumbridge.
translation: 我已经帮过仑桥厨师了。

english: Oh yes, so you have. I am sure the Duke will be pleased.
translation: 哦是的，确实如此。我相信公爵会很高兴。

english: Tell me about the Duke's strange talisman.
translation: 跟我讲讲公爵的奇怪护符。

english: Well the Duke of Lumbridge has found a strange talisman that no one seems to understand. Perhaps you could help him? You can probably find him upstairs in Lumbridge Castle.
translation: 仑桥公爵发现了一个奇怪的护符，似乎没人能理解。也许你能帮他？你可能会在仑桥堡楼上找到他。

english: Sounds mysterious. I may just do that. Thanks.
translation: 听起来很神秘。我可能会去看看。谢谢。

english: Yes, I have already solved the Rune mysteries.
translation: 是的，我已经解决了符石奥秘。

english: Ah excellent. Thank you very much adventurer.
translation: 啊太好了。非常感谢你冒险者。

english: Tell me about Romeo and his girlfriend please.
translation: 请跟我讲讲罗密欧和他的女朋友。

english: Romeo in Varrock needs help with finding his beloved Juliet, you may be able to help him out.
translation: 维洛克城的罗密欧需要帮助找到他心爱的朱丽叶，你也许能帮他。

english: Unless of course you manage to find Juliet first in which case she has probably lost Romeo.
translation: 除非你先找到朱丽叶，那样的话她可能把罗密欧弄丢了。

english: Right, ok. Romeo is in Varrock?
translation: 好的，明白了。罗密欧在维洛克城？

english: Yes you can't miss him, he's wandering aimlessly in the square.
translation: 是的，你不会错过他，他正在广场上漫无目的地游荡。

english: Oh yes, I've already helped Romeo in the best possible way I can...
translation: 哦是的，我已经用我能做到的最好方式帮助了罗密欧……

english: Really?
translation: 真的吗？

english: Yup.
translation: 是的。

english: ...How?
translation: ……怎么做到的？

english: He thinks Juliet is dead...
translation: 他以为朱丽叶死了……

english: Well.. ok.. well done... I think...
translation: 嗯……好吧……干得好……我想……

english: I'm a thinker rather than fighter, anything skill orientated?
translation: 我更喜欢思考而不是战斗，有什么技能相关的吗？

english: Skills play a big part when you want to progress in knowledge throughout Gielinor. I know of a few skill- related quests that can get you started.
translation: 当你想在基利诺尔各地提升知识时，技能起着重要作用。我知道几个与技能相关的任务可以让你开始。

english: You may be able to help out Fred the farmer who is in need of someones crafting expertise.
translation: 你也许能帮助农夫弗雷德，他需要一些人的制作专业知识。

english: Or, there's always Doric the dwarf who needs an errand running for him?
translation: 或者，总有矮人多里克需要你帮他跑腿？

english: Tell me about Fred the farmer please.
translation: 请跟我讲讲农夫弗雷德。

english: You can find Fred next to the field of sheep in Lumbridge. Perhaps you should go and speak with him.
translation: 你可以在仑桥镇的羊田旁边找到弗雷德。也许你应该去跟他谈谈。

english: Thanks, maybe I will.
translation: 谢谢，也许我会的。

english: I have already helped Fred the farmer. I sheared his sheep and made 20 balls of wool for him.
translation: 我已经帮过农夫弗雷德了。我剪了他的羊毛，为他做了20个毛线球。

english: He wouldn't let me kill his chickens though.
translation: 不过他不让我杀他的鸡。

english: Lumbridge chickens do make good target practice.
translation: 仑桥镇的鸡确实是很好的靶子练习。

english: You will have to wait until he isn't looking.
translation: 你得等他没注意的时候。

english: Tell me about Doric the dwarf.
translation: 跟我讲讲矮人多里克。

english: Doric the dwarf is located north of Falador. He might be able to help you with smithing. You should speak to him. He may let you use his anvils.
translation: 矮人多里克在法拉多城北边。他也许能在锻造方面帮你。你应该跟他谈谈。他可能会让你使用他的铁砧。

english: Yes, I've been to see Doric already. He was happy to let me use his anvils after I ran a small errand for him.
translation: 是的，我已经去过多里克那里了。我帮他跑了个小差事后，他很乐意让我使用他的铁砧。

english: Oh good, Thank you [player name]!
translation: 哦太好了，谢谢你 [player name]！

english: I want to do all kinds of things, do you know of anything like that?
translation: 我想做各种各样的事，你知道有什么类似的吗？

english: Of course I do. Gielinor is a huge place you know, now let me think...
translation: 当然知道。基利诺尔是个很大的地方，让我想想……

english: Hetty the witch in Rimmington might be able to offer help in the ways of magical abilities..
translation: 里明顿的女巫赫蒂也许能在魔法方面提供帮助……

english: Also, pirates are currently docked in Port Sarim, Where pirates are, treasure is never far away...
translation: 另外，海盗目前停靠在沙林港，有海盗的地方，宝藏就不远……

english: Or you could go help out Ernest who got lost in Draynor Manor, spooky place that.
translation: 或者你可以去帮助在德雷诺庄园迷路的欧内斯特，那地方阴森森的。

english: Tell me about Hetty the witch.
translation: 跟我讲讲女巫赫蒂。

english: Hetty the witch can be found in Rimmington, south of Falador. She's currently working on some new potions. Perhaps you could give her a hand? She might be able to offer help with your magical abilities.
translation: 女巫赫蒂在法拉多城南边的里明顿村可以找到。她目前正在研制一些新药水。也许你能帮她一把？她也许能在你的魔法能力方面提供帮助。

english: Ok thanks, let's hope she doesn't turn me into a potato or something..
translation: 好的谢谢，希望她别把我变成土豆什么的……

english: Yes, I have already been to see Hetty, she gave me super cosmic powers after I helped out with her potion! I could probably destroy you with a single thought!
translation: 是的，我已经去见过赫蒂了，我帮她配制药水后她给了我超级宇宙力量！我可能一个念头就能摧毁你！

english: Did she really?
translation: 她真的给了吗？

english: No not really...
translation: 不，其实没有……

english: Right.....
translation: 好吧……

english: Tell me about Pirate's Treasure.
translation: 跟我讲讲海盗宝藏。

english: RedBeard Frank in Port Sarim's bar, the Rusty Anchor, might be able to tell you about the rumored treasure that is buried somewhere in Gielinor.
translation: 沙林港的锈锚酒吧里的红胡子弗兰克也许能告诉你关于埋在基利诺尔某处的传闻宝藏。

english: Sounds adventurous, I may have to check that out. Thank you.
translation: 听起来很冒险，我可能得去看看。谢谢。

english: Yarr! I already found the booty!
translation: 呀！我已经找到财宝了！

english: Yarr indeed my friend. A most excellent find.
translation: 呀，确实我的朋友。真是个了不起的发现。

english: Yarr!
translation: 呀！

english: Yarrr!
translation: 呀！

english: YARRR!
translation: 呀！

english: Right, that's enough of that!
translation: 好了，够了！

english: ..Sorry.
translation: ……抱歉。

english: Tell me about Ernest please.
translation: 请跟我讲讲欧内斯特。

english: The best place to start would be at the gate to Draynor Manor. There you will find Veronica who will be able to tell you more.
translation: 最好的起点是德雷诺庄园的大门。在那里你会找到维罗妮卡，她能告诉你更多。

english: I suggest you tread carefully in that place; it's haunted.
translation: 我建议你在那地方小心行事；那里闹鬼。

english: Sounds like fun. I've never been to a Haunted Manor before.
translation: 听起来很有趣。我从没去过闹鬼的庄园。

english: Yeah, I found Ernest already. Professor Oddenstein had turned him into a chicken!
translation: 是的，我已经找到欧内斯特了。奥登斯坦教授把他变成了一只鸡！

english: A chicken!?
translation: 一只鸡！？

english: Yeah a chicken. It could have been worse though.
translation: 是的，一只鸡。不过情况可能更糟。

english: Very true, poor guy.
translation: 确实如此，可怜的家伙。

english: Where can I get a haircut like yours?
translation: 我在哪儿能理个像你这样的发型？

english: Yes, it does look like you need a hairdresser.
translation: 是的，看起来你确实需要个理发师。

english: Oh thanks!
translation: 哦谢谢！

english: No problem. The hairdresser in Falador will probably be able to sort you out.
translation: 没问题。法拉多城的理发师应该能帮你搞定。

english: The Lumbridge general store sells useful maps if you don't know the way.
translation: 如果你不认识路，仑桥杂货店卖有用的地图。

english: What's up?
translation: 怎么了？

english: I assume the sky is up..
translation: 我想天在上面……

english: You assume?
translation: 你想的？

english: Yeah, unfortunately I don't seem to be able to look up.
translation: 是的，不幸的是我似乎没法往上看。

english: Can I buy your stick?
translation: 我能买你的棍子吗？

english: It's not a stick! I'll have you know it's a very powerful staff!
translation: 那不是棍子！我要让你知道那是一根非常强大的法杖！

english: Really? Show me what it can do!
translation: 真的吗？给我看看它能做什么！

english: Um..It's a bit low on power at the moment..
translation: 嗯……它现在能量有点不足……

english: It's a stick isn't it?
translation: 它就是根棍子对吧？

english: ...Ok it's a stick.. But only while I save up for a staff. Zaff in Varrock square sells them in his shop.
translation: ……好吧是根棍子……但只是在我攒钱买法杖期间。维洛克广场的扎夫在他的店里卖法杖。

english: Well good luck with that.
translation: 那祝你好运。

english: Do you have anything of value which I can have?
translation: 你有什么有价值的东西能给我吗？

english: Are you asking for free stuff?
translation: 你是在要免费的东西吗？

english: Well... er... yes.
translation: 嗯……呃……是的。

english: No I do not have anything I can give you. If I did have anything of value I wouldn't want to give it away.
translation: 不，我没有什么能给你的。如果我有什么有价值的东西，我也不想送人。

english: Your shoe lace is untied.
translation: 你的鞋带松了。

english: No it's not!
translation: 没有！

english: No you're right. I have nothing to back that up.
translation: 不，你是对的。我没什么证据。

english: Fool! Leave me alone!
translation: 傻瓜！别烦我！

english: Do you know what happened in the castle cellar?
translation: 你知道城堡地窖里发生了什么吗？

english: I heard the wall collapsed or something. I don't know why. Perhaps you could get to the bottom of this mystery!
translation: 我听说墙塌了什么的。我不知道为什么。也许你能揭开这个谜团！

english: Where am I?
translation: 我在哪儿？

english: How are you today?
translation: 你今天怎么样？

english: Do you know of any quests I can do?
translation: 你知道有什么任务我可以做吗？

english: Your shoe lace is untied.
translation: 你的鞋带松了。

english: Are there any quests I can do here?
translation: 这里有什么任务我可以做吗？

english: I fancy a bit of a fight, anything dangerous?
translation: 我想打一架，有什么危险的吗？

english: Big scary demons!
translation: 又大又可怕的恶魔！

english: Vampyres!
translation: 吸血鬼！

english: Small.. something small would be good.
translation: 小的……一些小任务就好。

english: Maybe another time.
translation: 改天吧。

english: Something easy please, I'm new here.
translation: 请给些简单的，我是新来的。

english: The Lumbridge cook.
translation: 仑桥厨师。

english: The Duke's strange talisman.
translation: 公爵的奇怪护符。

english: Romeo and his girlfriend.
translation: 罗密欧和他的女朋友。

english: I'm a thinker rather than fighter, anything skill oriented?
translation: 我更喜欢思考而不是战斗，有什么技能相关的吗？

english: Fred the farmer.
translation: 农夫弗雷德。

english: Doric the dwarf.
translation: 矮人多里克。

english: I want to do all kinds of things, do you know of anything like that?
translation: 我想做各种各样的事，你知道有什么类似的吗？

english: Hetty the Witch.
translation: 女巫赫蒂。

english: Pirate's treasure.
translation: 海盗宝藏。

english: Ernest and Draynor Manor.
translation: 欧内斯特和德雷诺庄园。

english: Where can I get a haircut like yours?
translation: 我在哪儿能理个像你这样的发型？

english: What's up?
translation: 怎么了？

english: Can I buy your stick?
translation: 我能买你的棍子吗？

english: Do you have anything of value which I can have?
translation: 你有什么有价值的东西能给我吗？

english: Do you know what happened in the castle cellar?
translation: 你知道城堡地窖里发生了什么吗？

english: I have no interest in talking to gawkers.
translation: 我没兴趣和看热闹的人说话。

english: Thank you for all your help in solving the murder.
translation: 感谢你帮助解决谋杀案。

english: Here you go.
translation: 给，拿好。

english: Donovan has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
translation: 多诺万给了你 [another clue scroll/a casket]！

english: Dooooom!
translation: 末日！

english: Where?
translation: 哪里？

english: All around us! I can feel it in the air, hear it on the wind, smell it... also in the air!
translation: 我们周围！我能从空气中感觉到，在风中听到，闻到……也在空气中！

english: Is there anything we can do about this doom?
translation: 我们对这个末日能做些什么吗？

english: There is nothing you need to do my friend! I am the Doomsayer, although my real title could be something like the Danger Tutor.
translation: 你什么都不需要做，我的朋友！我是末日预言者，虽然我的真实头衔可能是危险导师之类的。

english: Danger Tutor?
translation: 危险导师？

english: Yes! I roam the world sensing danger.
translation: 是的！我漫游世界感知危险。

english: If you see the signs often enough, then you can turn them off; by that time you likely know what the area has in store for you.
translation: 如果你经常看到这些标志，那么你可以关闭它们；到那时你可能已经知道那个区域有什么危险等着你。

english: If I find a dangerous area, then I put up warning signs that will tell you what is so dangerous about that area.
translation: 如果我找到一个危险区域，我会竖起警告标志，告诉你那个区域有什么危险。

english: But what if I want to see the warnings again?
translation: 但如果我想再次看到警告呢？

english: That's why I'm waiting here!
translation: 这就是我在这里等的原因！

english: If you want to see the warning messages again, I can turn them back on for you.
translation: 如果你想再次看到警告信息，我可以帮你重新打开。

english: Thanks, I'll remember that if I see any warning messages.
translation: 谢谢，如果我看到任何警告信息我会记住的。

english: You're welcome!
translation: 不客气！

english: Do you need to turn on any warnings right now?
translation: 你现在需要打开任何警告吗？

english: Yes, I do.
translation: 是的，我需要。

english: Not right now.
translation: 现在不需要。

english: Ok, keep an eye out for the messages though!
translation: 好的，不过要留意那些信息！

english: I will.
translation: 我会的。

english: You got lucky this time, next time doom will be upon you.
translation: 你这次运气好，下次末日就会降临到你身上。

english: Ah! Here you go!
translation: 啊！给，拿着！

english: What?
translation: 什么？

english: I need you to answer this for me.
translation: 我需要你帮我回答这个问题。

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
translation: 请输入问题的答案。

english: How can that be? Try again!
translation: 怎么会这样？再试一次！

english: Spot on!
translation: 完全正确！

english: How am I doing hunting those breach monsters, Doomsayer?
translation: 末日预言者，我猎杀那些裂隙怪物做得怎么样？

english: You've dished out [X] damage to breach monsters. Keep up the dangerous activities! Anyway...
translation: 你对裂隙怪物造成了 [X] 点伤害。继续这些危险活动！话说……

english: I'd like to remove my PvP protection.
translation: 我想移除我的 PvP 保护。

english: You haven't got any PvP protection. Doom is already upon you.
translation: 你没有任何 PvP 保护。末日已经降临到你身上了。

english: That way doom lies, I cannot comply. Your protection will be finished in less than 5 minutes.
translation: 末日就在那边，我不能同意。你的保护将在不到5分钟内结束。

english: Are you sure? Much doom lies that way and it can not be undone!
translation: 你确定吗？那边有很多末日，而且无法挽回！

english: Yes, remove my PvP protection right now.
translation: 是的，现在就移除我的 PvP 保护。

english: On your head be it!
translation: 后果自负！

english: Yes, arrange for my PvP protection to end in 1 minute.
translation: 是的，安排我的 PvP 保护在1分钟后结束。

english: Much doom be with you.
translation: 愿大量末日与你同在。

english: You have 1 minute of PvP protection left.
translation: 你还有1分钟的 PvP 保护。

english: On second thoughts, leave it.
translation: 再想想，还是算了。

english: Yes, I do.
translation: 是的，我需要。

english: Not right now.
translation: 现在不需要。

english: How am I doing hunting those breach monsters, Doomsayer?
translation: 末日预言者，我猎杀那些裂隙怪物做得怎么样？

english: Is there anything we can do about this doom?
translation: 我们对这个末日能做些什么吗？

english: I'd like to remove my PvP protection.
translation: 我想移除我的 PvP 保护。

english: Yes, remove my PvP protection right now.
translation: 是的，现在就移除我的 PvP 保护。

english: Yes, arrange for my PvP protection to end in 1 minute.
translation: 是的，安排我的 PvP 保护在1分钟后结束。

english: On second thoughts, leave it.
translation: 再想想，还是算了。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？

english: Can I go in there?
translation: 我能进去吗？

english: Of course not! You have to be one of us, and you're clearly not. Now get out of here.
translation: 当然不能！你必须是我们中的一员，而你显然不是。现在滚出去。

english: Hmm... It seems to be locked.
translation: 嗯……看起来锁上了。

english: Yeah, well spotted. You have to be one of us to go in there, and you're clearly not. Now get out of here.
translation: 是啊，观察得不错。你必须是我们中的一员才能进去，而你显然不是。现在滚出去。

english: Are you new? I've never seen you around here before.
translation: 你是新来的吗？我以前从没在这里见过你。

english: You could say that. Long live General Khazard!
translation: 可以这么说。卡扎德将军万岁！

english: Er... yeah...
translation: 呃……是的……

english: You're [him/her/them]! The one who murdered the General's pet. Leave this place at once!
translation: 你是 [him/her/them]！那个杀害将军宠物的人。立刻离开这个地方！

english: Hello there. Interested in buying some silk?
translation: 你好。有兴趣买些丝绸吗？

english: Show me what you have.
translation: 给我看看你有什么。

english: I'm good, thanks.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

english: Very well.
translation: 很好。

english: Show me what you have.
translation: 给我看看你有什么。

english: I'm good, thanks.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

english: Hello traveller, what brings you to my humble smithy?
translation: 你好旅行者，什么风把你吹到我这简陋的铁匠铺？

english: I wanted to use your anvils.
translation: 我想用你的铁砧。

english: My anvils get enough work with my own use. I make pickaxes, and it takes a lot of hard work. If you could get me some more materials, then I could let you use them.
translation: 我的铁砧我自己用就已经够忙了。我制作镐子，这需要很多辛苦工作。如果你能给我弄些更多材料，那我就可以让你使用它们。

english: Yes, I will get you the materials.
translation: 好的，我去给你弄材料。

english: Clay is what I use more than anything, to make casts. Could you get me 6 clay, 4 copper ore, and 2 iron ore, please? I could pay a little, and let you use my anvils. Take this pickaxe with you just in case you need it.
translation: 粘土是我用得最多的，用来做模具。你能给我弄6个粘土、4个铜矿石和2个铁矿石吗？我可以付一点钱，并让你使用我的铁砧。带上这把镐子，以防你需要。

english: Where can I find those?
translation: 我在哪儿能找到那些？

english: You'll be able to find all those ores in the rocks just inside the Dwarven Mine. Head east from here and you'll find the entrance in the side of Ice Mountain.
translation: 你可以在矮人矿洞里面的岩石里找到所有这些矿石。从这里向东走，你会在冰山的侧面找到入口。

english: Certainly, I'll be right back!
translation: 当然，我马上回来！

english: You know, it's funny you should require those exact things!
translation: 你知道吗，真巧你正好需要那些东西！

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你什么意思？

english: I can usually fit 28 things in my backpack and in a world full of quite literally limitless possibilities, a complete coincidence has occurred!
translation: 我的背包通常能装28样东西，在这个充满无限可能的世界里，一个完全的巧合发生了！

english: I don't quite understand what you're saying?
translation: 我不太明白你在说什么？

english: Well, out of pure coincidence, despite definitely not knowing what you were about to request, I just so happened to have carried those exact items!
translation: 嗯，纯属巧合，尽管我肯定不知道你要什么，但我碰巧就带了那些东西！

english: In fact, in the exact quantities too!
translation: 事实上，数量也正好！

english: Oh my, that is a coincidence! Pass them here, please. I can spare you some coins for your trouble, and please use my anvils any time you want.
translation: 哎呀，那真是巧合！请把东西递给我。我可以给你一些金币作为酬劳，请随时使用我的铁砧。

english: Quest complete!
translation: 任务完成！

english: No, hitting rocks is for the boring people, sorry.
translation: 不，敲石头是给无聊的人做的，抱歉。

english: That is your choice. Nice to meet you anyway.
translation: 那是你的选择。很高兴认识你。

english: I wanted to use your whetstone.
translation: 我想用你的磨刀石。

english: The whetstone is for more advanced smithing, but I could let you use it as well as my anvils if you could get me some more materials.
translation: 磨刀石是给更高级的锻造用的，但如果你能给我弄些更多材料，我也可以让你使用它以及我的铁砧。

english: Mind your own business, shortstuff!
translation: 管好你自己的事，小矮子！

english: How nice to meet someone with such pleasant manners. Do come again when you need to shout at someone smaller than you!
translation: 能遇到这么有礼貌的人真好。下次需要向比你小的人吼叫时再来！

english: I was just checking out the landscape.
translation: 我只是看看风景。

english: Hope you like it. I do enjoy the solitude of my little home. If you get time, please say hi to my friends in the Dwarven Mine.
translation: 希望你喜欢。我确实享受我小家的宁静。如果你有时间，请代我向矮人矿洞里的朋友们问好。

english: Dwarven Mine?
translation: 矮人矿洞？

english: Yep, the entrance is in the side of Ice Mountain just to the east of here. They're a friendly bunch. Stop in at Nurmof's store and buy one of my pickaxes!
translation: 是的，入口就在东边冰山的侧面。他们是一群友好的人。去努莫夫的店里逛逛，买一把我的镐子！

english: Will do!
translation: 会的！

english: What do you make here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: I make pickaxes. I am the best maker of pickaxes in the whole of Gielinor.
translation: 我制作镐子。我是整个基利诺尔最好的镐子制造商。

english: Do you have any to sell?
translation: 你有卖的吗？

english: Who's Nurmof?
translation: 努莫夫是谁？

english: Nurmof has a store over in the Dwarven Mine. You can find the entrance on the side of Ice Mountain to the east of here.
translation: 努莫夫在矮人矿洞那边有个店。你可以在东边冰山的侧面找到入口。

english: Ah, fair enough.
translation: 啊，说得过去。

english: Hey, who said you could use that? My anvils get enough work with my own use. I make pickaxes, and it takes a lot of hard work.
translation: 嘿，谁让你用那个的？我的铁砧我自己用就已经够忙了。我制作镐子，这需要很多辛苦工作。

english: Sorry, would it be OK if I used your anvils?
translation: 抱歉，我可以用你的铁砧吗？

english: If you could get me some more materials then I could let you use them.
translation: 如果你能给我弄些更多材料，那我就可以让你使用它们。

english: I didn't want to use your anvils anyway.
translation: 反正我也不想用你的铁砧。

english: That is your choice.
translation: 那是你的选择。

english: Hello traveller, how is your metalworking coming along?
translation: 你好旅行者，你的金属加工进展如何？

english: Not too bad, Doric.
translation: 还不错，多里克。

english: Good, the love of metal is a thing close to my heart.
translation: 好，对金属的热爱是我心中珍视的事。

english: Well done.
translation: 干得好。

english: So, you've come to the right place?
translation: 所以，你来对地方了？

english: I wanted to use your anvils.
translation: 我想用你的铁砧。

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: Where can I find those?
translation: 我在哪儿能找到那些？

english: Certainly, I'll be right back!
translation: 当然，我马上回来！

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: I want to use your whetstone.
translation: 我想用你的磨刀石。

english: Mind your own business, shortstuff!
translation: 管好你自己的事，小矮子！

english: I was just checking out the landscape.
translation: 我只是看看风景。

english: Dwarven Mine?
translation: 矮人矿洞？

english: Will do!
translation: 会的！

english: What do you make here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Who's Nurmof?
translation: 努莫夫是谁？

english: Ah, fair enough.
translation: 啊，说得过去。

english: Sorry, would it be OK if I used your anvils?
translation: 抱歉，我可以用你的铁砧吗？

english: Yes, I will get you materials.
translation: 好的，我去给你弄材料。

english: No, hitting rocks is for the boring people, sorry.
translation: 不，敲石头是给无聊的人做的，抱歉。

english: I didn't want to use your anvils anyway.
translation: 反正我也不想用你的铁砧。

english: Hello again dearie. How are you doing?
translation: 又见面了亲爱的。你怎么样？

english: Pretty good!
translation: 挺好的！

english: That's good to hear.
translation: 那就好。

english: Not too good actually!
translation: 其实不太好！

english: Oh well.
translation: 哦好吧。

english: What's it like living so close to the wilderness?
translation: 住在离荒野这么近的地方是什么感觉？

english: Oh, it's not all that bad. It was a bit scary at first but as long as I don't go past the warning signs I'm all right.
translation: 哦，也没那么糟。一开始有点吓人，但只要我不越过警告标志就没事。

english: It's actually pretty quiet here. I used to live in Lumbridge and, let me tell you, that's the dangerous place for people like me.
translation: 其实这里相当安静。我以前住在仑桥镇，跟你说，那地方对我这样的人才危险。

english: Thieves were picking people's pockets with impunity, and killing them on the streets in broad daylight!
translation: 小偷肆无忌惮地偷窃，光天化日之下就在街上杀人！

english: And there weren't even any guards to protect us! Not that the guards in the other cities do much good to protect people from what I've heard.
translation: 而且连守卫都没有保护我们！据我所知其他城市的守卫也保护不了什么人。

english: I just thank goodness I haven't got an Attack option any more! I wouldn't last five minutes!
translation: 我只感谢老天我再也没有攻击选项了！我撑不过五分钟！

english: How did Dave come to be evil?
translation: 戴夫是怎么变邪恶的？

english: Oh, I don't know really. He's always been evil, I think. Maybe growing up so close to the wilderness has affected him in some way.
translation: 哦，我也不知道。我想他一直都很邪恶。也许在荒野附近长大以某种方式影响了他。

english: When he was little he used to want to go into Edgeville dungeon. You know how kids are, always wanting to be dungeon adventurers! But he didn't want to be a hero, he wanted to be a monster!
translation: 他小时候总想进埃奇维尔地牢。你知道小孩子什么样，总想当地牢冒险家！但他不想当英雄，他想当怪物！

english: And then he spent all summer building a tree-house. Except it wasn't a tree-house, of course, it was his Tower of Fear!
translation: 然后他花了一整个夏天建树屋。当然那不是树屋，是他的恐惧之塔！

english: Of course I was hoping he'd have grown out of it by now and maybe even left home. But at least it keeps him happy.
translation: 当然我希望他现在能长大懂事，也许甚至离开家。但至少这让他开心。

english: What's happened to my cat?
translation: 我的猫怎么了？

english: Oh, poor thing. The hell-rats do that, you know. I think a nice drink of milk would sort it out. Shall I give it one?
translation: 哦，可怜的东西。是地狱鼠干的，你知道。我想给它喝点牛奶就能好。我给它喝点？

english: Yes please!
translation: 好的，谢谢！

english: Here puss...
translation: 来，小猫咪……

english: Your hell-cat transforms into an ordinary cat.
translation: 你的地狱猫变成了普通猫。

english: No, I like it this way.
translation: 不，我喜欢它这样。

english: Well, I suppose as long as the cat is all right, it doesn't matter what it looks like.
translation: 嗯，我想只要猫没事，它长什么样不重要。

english: Pretty good!
translation: 挺好的！

english: Not too good actually
translation: 其实不太好

english: What's it like living so close to the wilderness?
translation: 住在离荒野这么近的地方是什么感觉？

english: How did Dave come to be evil?
translation: 戴夫是怎么变邪恶的？

english: What's happened to my cat?
translation: 我的猫怎么了？

english: Yes please!
translation: 好的，谢谢！

english: No, I like it this way.
translation: 不，我喜欢它这样。

english: I expect you to die!
translation: 我等着你死！

english: Well, hello again. Congratulations on your finds.
translation: 嗯，又见面了。恭喜你有收获。

english: Hey! Trying to steal from me are you? What do you think I am, stupid or something?!
translation: 嘿！你想偷我的东西？你以为我是什么，傻子还是什么？！

english: Err... Sorry.
translation: 呃……抱歉。

english: Can't talk now, pies to make! Bread to bake! Breaks to take!
translation: 现在没空说话，要做派！要烤面包！要休息！

english: You seem a bit stressed.
translation: 你看起来压力有点大。

english: Far from it, just busy busy busy! Best way to be!
translation: 远非如此，只是忙忙忙！这才是最好的状态！

english: Oi!
translation: 喂！

english: I've got to go!
translation: 我得走了！

english: Hello, I need some yeastier dough, do you have any?
translation: 你好，我需要一些更发酵的面团，你有吗？

english: Yeastier dough? I don't know.
translation: 更发酵的面团？我不知道。

english: What is that?
translation: 那是什么？

english: I think it's just particularly yeasty dough.
translation: 我想就是特别发酵的面团。

english: And why would I give you any of my lovely dough?
translation: 我为什么要给你我可爱的面团？

english: I'm making some Easter Buns to cheer up the Easter Bunny.
translation: 我在做一些复活节小面包让复活节兔子开心。

english: Oh that silly Eggrabbit! Anything for him.
translation: 哦那个傻蛋兔！为了他什么都行。

english: Of course you'll need space to carry the dough, come back when you can handle it.
translation: 当然你需要空间来拿面团，等你能拿的时候再来。

english: Alright.
translation: 好的。

english: Here you go, yeastier dough.
translation: 给你，更发酵的面团。

english: It's potent stuff!
translation: 这东西很厉害！

english: Thank you, that's very kind of you.
translation: 谢谢，你真好。

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: You again! What is it now?
translation: 又是你！这次什么事？

english: Thanks for the dough.
translation: 谢谢你的面团。

english: You're welcome!
translation: 不客气！

english: I need to get back to work now.
translation: 我现在得回去工作了。

english: Okay, I'll talk to you later. Bye!
translation: 好的，回头再聊。再见！

english: Quick quick, only a moment to spare, what's up?
translation: 快快快，只有一会儿空闲，什么事？

english: I need more of that yeastier dough.
translation: 我需要更多那种更发酵的面团。

english: Though thinking about it, I don't have enough space at the moment. I'll come back.
translation: 不过想想，我现在空间不够。我回头再来。

english: Yes yes, come back. Very good.
translation: 是是是，回来。很好。

english: Alright, alright, here you go. Please keep in mind I'm not made of dough.
translation: 好了好了，给你。请记住我不是面团做的。

english: You look like you are, all covered in flour.
translation: 你看起来就是，浑身都是面粉。

english: Occupational hazard! You get used to it.
translation: 职业危害！你会习惯的。

english: I hope you put that dough to good use.
translation: 希望你好好利用那面团。

english: Oh I did indeed.
translation: 哦我确实好好利用了。

english: theyrecomingtogetme theyrecomingtogetme...
translation: 他们来抓我了 他们来抓我了……

english: It is all you deserve. Lord Rologarth is master of this castle once more. Let him protect you - if he wants to.
translation: 这是你应得的。罗洛加斯领主再次成为这座城堡的主人。让他保护你——如果他想的话。

english: How are things going, doctor?
translation: 情况怎么样，医生？

english: After talking with these monks and seeing your efforts to save them...I'm starting to regret my past actions.
translation: 和这些僧侣交谈后，看到你为拯救他们所做的努力……我开始后悔我过去的行为。

english: Well, we all make mistakes.
translation: 嗯，我们都会犯错。

english: Admittedly, most of us don't accidentally trip and sew a bunch of dead bodies together.
translation: 诚然，我们大多数人不会不小心绊倒然后把一堆尸体缝在一起。

english: I know...I think that my time here will be well spent trying to atone for what I did.
translation: 我知道……我想我在这里的时间会好好用来弥补我所做的事。

english: Thank you for helping me see the error of my ways, [player name].
translation: 谢谢你帮我认识到我的错误，[player name]。

english: You steal the Ring of Charos from Fenkenstrain.
translation: 你从芬肯斯特莱恩那里偷走了查罗斯之戒。

english: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你以为你在做什么？

english: What, what do you want?
translation: 什么，你想要什么？

english: Why are you out here on your own?
translation: 你为什么一个人在这里？

english: I was drawn here... I use to be a traveling doctor, until I arrived in Al Kharid.
translation: 我被吸引到这里……我以前是个游医，直到我来到阿尔卡里德城。

english: Then I heard it call to me... I immediately gave up my profession and set up here.
translation: 然后我听到它在呼唤我……我立刻放弃了职业，在这里安顿下来。

english: I'm happy here... the voices tell me I'm happy here. I can continue my work.
translation: 我在这里很开心……声音告诉我我在这里很开心。我可以继续我的工作。

english: Uhh... what voices? There is no one else here.
translation: 呃……什么声音？这里没有别人。

english: Of course there isn't, the hole you idiot, the hole speaks to me and I listen... It says I will do great things, only if I listen...
translation: 当然没有，是那个洞，你这个白痴！洞在对我说话，我在听……它说我会成就大事，只要我听……

english: Well... alright then, I think I'm just going to go and leave then.
translation: 嗯……好吧，那我想我就走了。

english: Hello. What brings you to my surgery today?
translation: 你好。今天什么风把你吹到我的诊所？

english: Okay, this will hurt you more than it will me.
translation: 好的，这会让你比我更疼。

english: You look healthy to me!
translation: 你看起来挺健康的！

english: What did you do before you worked here?
translation: 你在这里工作之前是做什么的？

english: Oh, I used to be a travelling surgeon. Whenever I saw someone have an accident, I'd be there to check for concussion and offer treatment.
translation: 哦，我以前是个游医外科医生。每当我看到有人出事故，我都会去检查脑震荡并提供治疗。

english: It was a worthy cause, but I didn't feel properly appreciated, so I retired. Then I got bored, so I came to work here.
translation: 那是个有价值的事业，但我觉得没有得到应有的认可，所以我退休了。然后我无聊了，所以来这里工作。

english: So can I help you with something?
translation: 那我能帮你什么吗？

english: Nothing, I'm fine.
translation: 没什么，我没事。

english: Can you heal me?
translation: 你能治疗我吗？

english: What did you do before you worked here?
translation: 你在这里工作之前是做什么的？

english: Nothing, I'm fine.
translation: 没什么，我没事。

english: Buy me a drrink pleassh...
translation: 给我买杯酒求求你……

english: I think you've had enough.
translation: 我想你喝得够多了。

english: Have you got any guam leaf? I've fixed my Hyde problem, so it's not urgent, but I could do with a guam leaf.
translation: 你有瓜姆叶吗？我已经解决了我的海德问题，所以不急，但我需要一片瓜姆叶。

english: I don't have any.
translation: 我没有。

english: Fair enough. Here, have a spare potion, and thanks for your time.
translation: 说得过去。来，拿瓶备用药水，谢谢你的时间。

english: Have you got any torstol? I've fixed my Hyde problem, so it's not urgent, but I could do with a torstol.
translation: 你有托斯托尔草吗？我已经解决了我的海德问题，所以不急，但我需要一些托斯托尔草。

english: Here you are.
translation: 给，拿好。

english: Thank you so much! Here, take this potion in return.
translation: 非常感谢！来，拿这瓶药水作为回报。

english: No, I need it myself.
translation: 不，我自己需要。

english: Have you got any dwarf weed? I've fixed my Hyde problem, so it's not urgent, but I could do with a dwarf weed.
translation: 你有矮人草吗？我已经解决了我的海德问题，所以不急，但我需要一些矮人草。

english: Have you got any lantadyme? I've fixed my Hyde problem, so it's not urgent, but I could do with a lantadyme.
translation: 你有兰塔蒂姆吗？我已经解决了我的海德问题，所以不急，但我需要一些兰塔蒂姆。

english: Have you got any cadantine? I've fixed my Hyde problem, so it's not urgent, but I could do with a cadantine.
translation: 你有卡丹丁草吗？我已经解决了我的海德问题，所以不急，但我需要一些卡丹丁草。

english: Have you got any snapdragon? I've fixed my Hyde problem, so it's not urgent, but I could do with a snapdragon.
translation: 你有金鱼草吗？我已经解决了我的海德问题，所以不急，但我需要一些金鱼草。

english: Have you got any kwuarm? I've fixed my Hyde problem, so it's not urgent, but I could do with a kwuarm.
translation: 你有库阿姆草吗？我已经解决了我的海德问题，所以不急，但我需要一些库阿姆草。

english: Have you got any avantoe? I've fixed my Hyde problem, so it's not urgent, but I could do with aavantoe.
translation: 你有阿凡托草吗？我已经解决了我的海德问题，所以不急，但我需要一些阿凡托草。

english: Have you got any irit leaf? I've fixed my Hyde problem, so it's not urgent, but I could do with airit leaf.
translation: 你有伊瑞特叶吗？我已经解决了我的海德问题，所以不急，但我需要一些伊瑞特叶。

english: Have you got any toadflax? I've fixed my Hyde problem, so it's not urgent, but I could do with a toadflax.
translation: 你有蟾蜍亚麻吗？我已经解决了我的海德问题，所以不急，但我需要一些蟾蜍亚麻。

english: Have you got any ranarr weed? I've fixed my Hyde problem, so it's not urgent, but I could do with a ranarr weed.
translation: 你有拉纳尔草吗？我已经解决了我的海德问题，所以不急，但我需要一些拉纳尔草。

english: Have you got any harralander? I've fixed my Hyde problem, so it's not urgent, but I could do with a harralander.
translation: 你有哈拉兰德草吗？我已经解决了我的海德问题，所以不急，但我需要一些哈拉兰德草。

english: Have you got any tarromin? I've fixed my Hyde problem, so it's not urgent, but I could do with a tarromin.
translation: 你有塔罗明草吗？我已经解决了我的海德问题，所以不急，但我需要一些塔罗明草。

english: Have you got any marrentill? I've fixed my Hyde problem, so it's not urgent, but I could do with a marrentill.
translation: 你有马伦提尔草吗？我已经解决了我的海德问题，所以不急，但我需要一些马伦提尔草。

english: I'll be off now.
translation: 我现在走了。

english: Excuse me, I must be off now.
translation: 打扰一下，我现在必须走了。

english: Sorry, I'm trying to get a herb from [player name], but [he/she] seems to be ignoring me.
translation: 抱歉，我正想从 [player name] 那里拿草药，但 [he/she] 似乎在无视我。

english: Hello, [player name]. I need a herb.
translation: 你好，[player name]。我需要一棵草药。

english: Hey, [player name]!
translation: 嘿，[player name]！

english: Excuse me, [player name]?
translation: 打扰一下，[player name]？

english: Can you hear me, [player name]?
translation: 你能听到我吗，[player name]？

english: I just need a herb, [player name]!
translation: 我只需要一棵草药，[player name]！

english: I'll give you a free potion, [player name]!
translation: 我会给你一瓶免费药水，[player name]！

english: Maybe later.
translation: 也许以后吧。

english: Here you are.
translation: 给，拿好。

english: No, I need it myself.
translation: 不，我自己需要。

english: Quack!
translation: 嘎！

english: Looking to trade?
translation: 想交易吗？

english: What have you got?
translation: 你有什么？

english: Take a look.
translation: 看看。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Then we have nothing more to discuss.
translation: 那我们没什么好谈的了。

english: Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: 人类！在我叫守卫之前滚回奴隶栏！

english: What have you got?
translation: 你有什么？

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: What are you doing in my house...why the impertinence...the sheer cheek...how dare you violate my personal lodgings....
translation: 你在我家里做什么……怎么这么无礼……真是厚脸皮……你怎么敢侵犯我的私人住所……

english: I..I was just looking around....
translation: 我……我只是随便看看……

english: Well get out! Get out....this is my house....and don't go near my daughter Juliet...she's grounded in her room to keep her away from that good for nothing Romeo.
translation: 那就出去！出去……这是我的房子……别靠近我女儿朱丽叶……她被关在房间里，让她远离那个没用的罗密欧。

english: Yes....sir....
translation: 是……先生……

english: I suppose you're quite pleased with yourself now...
translation: 我想你现在对自己很满意吧……

english: Hey there, what can I do for ya?
translation: 嘿，有什么能帮你的？

english: My name is Drew and I man this here grinding machine. I call her Sandstorm!
translation: 我叫德鲁，我操作这台研磨机。我叫她沙尘暴！

english: I can also look after any buckets ya want me to.
translation: 我也可以帮你照看任何桶。

english: Me and Sandstorm go way back, we started off back in the desert mining camp, I was a slave and I had the honour of looking after Sandstorm.
translation: 我和沙尘暴认识很久了，我们是从沙漠采矿营开始的，我是奴隶，有幸照看沙尘暴。

english: How did you and Sandstorm get out of the mining camp?
translation: 你和沙尘暴是怎么离开采矿营的？

english: Well, because I was in charge of looking after Sandstorm, I was able to look at the inner workings.
translation: 嗯，因为我负责照看沙尘暴，我可以看到内部构造。

english: While the guards weren't looking, I would take apart Sandstorm piece by piece and place the pieces in boxes and barrels, when Sandstorms inners were all gutted, I tricked the cart driver by telling him cart jokes.
translation: 趁守卫不注意，我会把沙尘暴一件件拆开，把零件放进箱子和桶里，等沙尘暴的内部都被掏空后，我用车笑话骗过了车夫。

english: So, he didn't bother to check his cargo and I was able to board as he was driving off.
translation: 所以，他懒得检查货物，我就能在他开车时上车。

english: Anyway, that's all in the past. Can I help ya with anything else?
translation: 总之，那都是过去的事了。还有什么能帮你的吗？

english: You haven't got any buckets for me to hold.
translation: 你没有桶让我保管。

english: Ya don't have any buckets of sand to withdraw. Ya need to give me empty buckets, and grind sandstone in my grinder, then I'll sell ya buckets of sand.
translation: 你没有沙桶可取。你需要给我空桶，在我的研磨机里磨砂岩，然后我卖给你沙桶。

english: I have [number] of your buckets and you've ground enough sandstone for [number] buckets of sand.
translation: 我有 [number] 个你的桶，你已经磨了够 [number] 桶沙的砂岩。

english: Nothing sorry. I have to be going now.
translation: 没什么抱歉。我现在得走了。

english: Oh, bye then.
translation: 哦，那再见。

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 跟我讲讲你自己。

english: Deposit buckets.
translation: 存放桶。

english: Withdraw buckets of sand.
translation: 提取沙桶。

english: Check my buckets and sand.
translation: 查看我的桶和沙。

english: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: Greetings again adventurer. How go your travels in Morytania? Is it as evil as I have heard?
translation: 又见面了冒险者。你在莫利塔尼亚的旅行怎么样？有传闻中那么邪恶吗？

english: I've lost my wolfbane dagger.
translation: 我丢了狼毒匕首。

english: Yes I know, but you have no space for a it at the moment so I can't return it to you.
translation: 是的我知道，但你现在没有空间，所以我不能还给你。

english: Yes, I know! Luckily for you it washed up on the banks of the Salve earlier! Here, take it again, but please try and be more careful this time.
translation: 是的，我知道！算你幸运，它之前被冲到了萨鲁夫河岸！来，再拿一次，但这次请小心点。

english: It's a family heirloom after all!
translation: 毕竟是家族传家宝！

english: Thanks for that!
translation: 谢谢！

english: I've lost my library key.
translation: 我丢了图书馆钥匙。

english: Ok, here's another one for you.
translation: 好的，再给你一把。

english: Do you know of anything I can do in Morytania?
translation: 你知道我在莫利塔尼亚有什么可以做的吗？

english: Well... I don't think so. There's not much to do in that place.
translation: 嗯……我想没有。那地方没什么可做的。

english: You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Nature Spirit quest.
translation: 你不满足开始自然之灵任务的所有要求。

english: Well, what is it, I may be able to help?
translation: 嗯，什么事，我也许能帮？

english: There's a man called Filliman who lives in Mort Myre. He comes by the temple from time to time but I haven't seen him recently. I was wondering if you could check in on him?
translation: 有个叫菲利曼的人住在莫特迈耶。他时不时来寺庙，但我最近没见到他。我在想你能不能去看看他？

english: I must warn you though, it could be dangerous. Mort Myre is filled with ghasts!
translation: 但我必须警告你，可能有危险。莫特迈耶到处都是食尸鬼！

english: Yes, I'll go look for him.
translation: 好的，我去找他。

english: That's great! Many thanks!
translation: 太好了！非常感谢！

english: Now, please be aware of the ghasts, you cannot attack them, only Filliman knew how to take them on. Just run from them if you can. If you get lost, try to make your way back to the temple.
translation: 现在，请注意食尸鬼，你无法攻击它们，只有菲利曼知道怎么对付它们。能跑就跑。如果迷路了，尽量回到寺庙。

english: Drezel hands you some food.
translation: 德雷泽尔给你一些食物。

english: Please take this food to Filliman, he'll likely appreciate it. His home is somewhere in the southern end of Mort Myre. I don't know the exact location I'm afraid.
translation: 请把食物带给菲利曼，他可能会感激。他的家在莫特迈耶南端某处。恐怕我不知道确切位置。

english: Don't worry, if he's there and he's still alive, I'll find him.
translation: 别担心，如果他在那里还活着，我会找到他。

english: Sorry, I don't think I can help.
translation: 抱歉，我想我帮不了。

english: That's fine, I'm sure someone else will be along shortly who can. Now, if you excuse me, I do have some things to be getting on with.
translation: 没关系，我相信很快会有别人能帮忙。现在，如果你不介意，我还有些事要做。

english: Sorry, not interested.
translation: 抱歉，没兴趣。

english: Well, I understand. You must be busy.
translation: 嗯，我理解。你一定很忙。

english: Hi there! Filliman says I've completed the quest!
translation: 你好！菲利曼说我完成任务了！

english: That's fantastic, well done!
translation: 太棒了，干得好！

english: Hello, [player name]. How are things in Morytania?
translation: 你好，[player name]。莫利塔尼亚情况怎么样？

english: Not as well as I'd hope, Drezel. I'm still working with the Myreque. I just hope that we can find a way to defeat those Drakans.
translation: 不如我希望的，德雷泽尔。我还在和迈雷克合作。我只希望我们能找到打败那些德拉坎的方法。

english: You can be sure that a great many people hope for exactly the same thing, [player name]. Good luck to you, and Myreque prevail!
translation: 你可以肯定很多人都有同样的希望，[player name]。祝你好运，迈雷克必胜！

english: Myreque prevail, Drezel.
translation: 迈雷克必胜，德雷泽尔。

english: How's everything going, [player name]?
translation: 一切怎么样，[player name]？

english: We've managed to create a new weapon to fight the vampyres with. I used it to kill Ranis Drakan!
translation: 我们成功制造了一种新武器来对抗吸血鬼。我用它杀了拉尼斯‧德拉坎！

english: This is amazing news, [player name]. Myreque prevail!
translation: 这是个好消息，[player name]。迈雷克必胜！

english: [player name]. How are things?
translation: [player name]。情况怎么样？

english: As well as they could be, everything considered. We lost everything, Drezel.
translation: 考虑到一切，已经算好了。我们失去了一切，德雷泽尔。

english: Not everything. There's still you, me and Ivan. Veliaf is out there somewhere as well. It's not much, but it's something to be thankful for.
translation: 不是一切。还有你、我和伊万。维利亚夫也在某处。不多，但值得感恩。

english: I suppose.
translation: 我想也是。

english: Morytania has never been darker. Trust in Saradomin, friend. There is still a chance we will live through this darkness.
translation: 莫利塔尼亚从未如此黑暗。相信萨拉多明，朋友。我们仍有希望熬过这黑暗。

english: Ah! Here you go!
translation: 啊！给，拿着！

english: What?
translation: 什么？

english: I need you to help me with this.
translation: 我需要你帮我这个。

english: Drezel has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 德雷泽尔给了你一个挑战卷轴！

english: Please give me your answer!
translation: 请把你的答案告诉我！

english: Nope, not correct!
translation: 不，不正确！

english: Correct!
translation: 正确！

english: Drezel has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 德雷泽尔给了你另一个线索卷轴！

english: Well, what is it, I may be able to help?
translation: 嗯，什么事，我也许能帮？

english: Yes.
translation: 是。

english: No.
translation: 否。

english: Sorry, not interested.
translation: 抱歉，没兴趣。

english: Hey, friend of Snowflake!
translation: 嘿，雪花的朋友！

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Just a guard. If sneaky human come in here without permission, I chuck rocks at 'em, knock 'em out and chuck 'em out of Weiss.
translation: 只是个守卫。如果有狡猾的人类未经许可进来，我就朝他们扔石头，打晕他们，然后把他们扔出魏斯聚落。

english: I'm familiar with the idea, yeah.
translation: 我熟悉这个主意，是的。

english: Tell me about this place.
translation: 跟我讲讲这个地方。

english: This here is Weiss. Trolls built it years ago, after we got kicked out from caves further south. Now Weiss is our home.
translation: 这里是魏斯聚落。巨魔多年前建的，在我们被赶出更南边的洞穴后。现在魏斯聚落是我们的家。

english: It great here, now Snowflake an' her husband troll taught us goutweed farming. Food so much better now.
translation: 这里很好，现在雪花和她丈夫巨魔教我们种痛风草。食物现在好多了。

english: Do you like it here?
translation: 你喜欢这里吗？

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it getting better. Snowflake, she taught us goutweed farming. Goat, wolf, human all taste so much nicer with goutweed in.
translation: 呃，有点艰苦，但正在变好。雪花教我们种痛风草。山羊、狼、人类，加了痛风草后味道都好多了。

english: So yeah, Weiss is good place to live, now Snowflake in charge. All trolls like Snowflake. Her husband troll kinda weird, but that not our problem.
translation: 所以是的，魏斯聚落是个好地方，现在雪花管事。所有巨魔都喜欢雪花。她丈夫巨魔有点怪，但那不是我们的问题。

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我走了。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Tell me about this place.
translation: 跟我讲讲这个地方。

english: Do you like it here?
translation: 你喜欢这里吗？

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我走了。

english: Hissss!
translation: 嘶！

english: wooo wooo
translation: 呜呜 呜呜

english: Please, leave me alone.
translation: 求你，别烦我。

english: Your loss!
translation: 你的损失！

english: I have delivered the scroll, you can rest in peace now.
translation: 我已经送达卷轴，你现在可以安息了。

english: Thanks for telling me! I've been waiting for ages!
translation: 谢谢告诉我！我等了好久！

english: Good bye.
translation: 再见。

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！

english: 'Ello, welcome to my Mining shop, friend!
translation: 你好，欢迎来到我的采矿店，朋友！

english: Do you want to trade?
translation: 你想交易吗？

english: Hello, shorty.
translation: 你好，矮子。

english: I may be short, but at least I've got manners.
translation: 我可能矮，但至少我有礼貌。

english: Why don't you ever restock ores and bars?
translation: 你为什么从不补货矿石和金属锭？

english: The only ores and bars I sell are those sold to me.
translation: 我卖的矿石和金属锭都是别人卖给我的。

english: Do you want to trade?
translation: 你想交易吗？

english: Hello, shorty.
translation: 你好，矮子。

english: Why don't you ever restock ores and bars?
translation: 你为什么从不补货矿石和金属锭？

english: Get out of my house!
translation: 滚出我的房子！

english: Alright, alright, I was just leaving!
translation: 好了好了，我正要走！

english: Someone stole my beautiful boots... I had to buy some crummy replicas, the real boots were one of a kind.
translation: 有人偷了我漂亮的靴子……我不得不买些劣质复制品，真靴子是独一无二的。

english: Don't worry, if I find out who did it I'll take care of them.
translation: 别担心，如果我查出是谁干的，我会处理他们。

english: Stay away from my books!
translation: 别碰我的书！

english: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？

english: I didn't know dwarves kept cats.
translation: 我不知道矮人养猫。

english: And why wouldn't they?
translation: 他们为什么不养？

english: Friend of mine lives at the palace, actually. Well, I say friend. Used to be a friend.
translation: 我有个朋友住在宫殿，其实。嗯，我说朋友。曾经是朋友。

english: What happened?
translation: 发生了什么事？

english: He got adopted by Hreidmar. The director of the Red Axe.
translation: 他被赫雷德玛收养了。红斧的主任。

english: Oh?
translation: 哦？

english: I don't like the Red Axe! They stomp around everywhere, got to be careful of your tail with those people around.
translation: 我不喜欢红斧！他们到处乱踩，有那些人在周围得小心你的尾巴。

english: Get your hands off that, you dirty human!
translation: 把你的手拿开，你脏人类！

english: Stay away from there! Who do you think you are, coming into my house like that?
translation: 离那里远点！你以为你是谁，那样进我家？

english: You don't think you'll be able to get close to this boot without the old dwarf noticing you, what with his cat guarding.
translation: 你不认为你能靠近这只靴子而不被老矮人发现吧，毕竟有他的猫守着。

english: I know what you did, [player name]!
translation: 我知道你做了什么，[player name]！

english: What did I do?
translation: 我做了什么？

english: You stole a boot from my master.
translation: 你从我主人那里偷了一只靴子。

english: All for a greater good.
translation: 都是为了更大的利益。

english: Hiss.
translation: 嘶。

english: Meow!
translation: 喵！

english: Excuse me..
translation: 打扰一下……

english: Leave me or I'll destroy you!
translation: 离开我否则我毁了你！

english: You have your answers, now go away!
translation: 你有答案了，现在走开！

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Good day to you, may nature smile upon you.
translation: 你好，愿自然对你微笑。

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Good day to you. I've prepared this patch for you to plant the enriched snapdragon in.
translation: 你好。我为你准备了这块地种富集金鱼草。

english: Okay, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Good day to you. The enriched snapdragon is growing well. It should be ready soon.
translation: 你好。富集金鱼草长得很好。应该快好了。

english: Good day to you. The enriched snapdragon is fully grown and ready for you to harvest.
translation: 你好。富集金鱼草已经完全成熟，可以收获了。

english: Good day to you. You should take that enriched snapdragon to Thaerisk.
translation: 你好。你应该把富集金鱼草带给泰瑞斯克。

english: Okay, will do.
translation: 好的，会照做。

english: Good day to you.
translation: 你好。

english: I lost the enriched snapdragon I harvested.
translation: 我弄丢了收获的金鱼草。

english: Not to worry. There was some left over after you were done.
translation: 别担心。你完成后还剩了一些。

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

english: Ahh, a kind stranger. Get this old man another drink so that he may wet his throat and talk to you.
translation: 啊，好心人。给这老头再买杯酒，让他润润嗓子跟你说话。

english: What were we talking about again? Yes yes, when I was a boy... no, that's not it.
translation: 我们刚才在说什么来着？是是是，当我还是个男孩……不，不是那个。

english: Wha'? Are you lookin' at me? Are you lookin' at me? You know something? You're drunk, you are.
translation: 什麼？你在看我吗？你在看我吗？你知道吗？你醉了，真的。

english: Did you hear the one where the camel walks into the bar and orders a pint? The barman asks 'Why the long face!'.
translation: 你听过那个骆驼走进酒吧点一品脱的笑话吗？酒保问''为什么拉长脸！''。

english: Did you hear the one about the man who walked into a bar? He hurt his foot! Hah!
translation: 你听过那个走进酒吧的人的笑话吗？他伤了脚！哈！

english: I've got a lovely bunch of coconuts! Hehehe...
translation: 我有一堆可爱的椰子！嘿嘿嘿……

english: What are you looking at?
translation: 你在看什么？

english: Why does nobody like me?

english: Welcome to the Emir's Arena! Are you interested in Duels? We organise ranked Duels here, or alternatively you can organise your own unranked Duels.
translation: 欢迎来到埃米尔竞技场！你对决斗感兴趣吗？我们在这里组织排名决斗，或者你也可以组织自己的非排名决斗。

english: What's a Duel?
translation: 什么是决斗？

english: Two fighters are placed in a combat arena together, to battle to the death. The survivor wins the Duel.
translation: 两名战士被放在战斗竞技场中，生死搏斗。幸存者赢得决斗。

english: Ranked or unranked? What does that mean?
translation: 排名或非排名？那是什么意思？

english: Everyone has a rank. It's meant to indicate how good they are at fighting, compared to other people.
translation: 每个人都有排名。这意味着他们与其他人相比战斗能力如何。

english: In ranked fights, the winners gain rank and the losers lose rank. The Arena staff will decide who'll be fighting in each ranked Duel, and send the invitations.
translation: 在排名战斗中，赢家获得排名，输家失去排名。竞技场工作人员会决定谁参加每场排名决斗，并发送邀请。

english: But if you just want some casual fun, you can have an unranked Duel, where no-one gains or loses rank. You can organise your own unranked Duel against whoever you want to fight.
translation: 但如果你只想要休闲乐趣，你可以进行非排名决斗，没有人获得或失去排名。你可以组织自己的非排名决斗，与任何你想战斗的人。

english: Only the ranked fights offer access to the other rewards of the Arena.
translation: 只有排名战斗才能获得竞技场其他奖励。

english: How do I get invited to a Duel?
translation: 我怎么被邀请参加决斗？

english: For a ranked Duel, you'll need to sign up to the recruitment group...
translation: 对于排名决斗，你需要报名参加招募组……

english: You can carry on with your adventures while you're waiting for a ranked Duel to begin, since it may be a while before suitable fighters are available.
translation: 在等待排名决斗开始期间，你可以继续冒险，因为可能需要一段时间才能找到合适的战士。

english: For an unranked Duel, other people might challenge you while you're wandering around the PvP Arena, so keep an eye out for invitation messages.
translation: 对于非排名决斗，当你在 PvP 竞技场闲逛时，其他人可能会挑战你，所以留意邀请信息。

english: I want to organise my own Duel.
translation: 我想组织自己的决斗。

english: When you see other people wandering around the PvP Arena, you can challenge them directly, and they can challenge you. This would be an unranked Duel, so neither of you would gain rank or earn rewards.
translation: 当你看到其他人在 PvP 竞技场闲逛时，你可以直接挑战他们，他们也可以挑战你。这是非排名决斗，所以你们都不会获得排名或奖励。

translation: 在我父亲的时代，克兰多岛是个重要的城邦。政治上和法拉多城、维洛克一样重要，它的船与每个港口贸易。

english: But, one day, when I was little, all contact was lost. The trading ships and the diplomatic envoys just stopped coming.
translation: 但是，有一天，当我还小的时候，所有联系都断了。贸易船和外交使节都不来了。
