translation: 你有什么任务给我吗？

english: Well, it's not really a quest but I recently discovered this strange talisman.
translation: 嗯，不算任务，但我最近发现了这个奇怪的护符。

english: It seems to be mystical and I have never seen anything like it before. Would you take it to the head wizard at
translation: 它似乎很神秘，我从未见过类似的东西。你能把它带给

english: the Wizards' Tower for me? It's just south-west of here and should not take you very long at all. I would be awfully grateful.
translation: 法师塔的首席法师吗？就在我西南边，不会花你很长时间。我会非常感激。

english: Sure, no problem.
translation: 当然，没问题。

english: Thank you very much, stranger. I am sure the head wizard will reward you for such an interesting find.
translation: 非常感谢，陌生人。我相信首席法师会奖励你这个有趣的发现。

english: Not right now.
translation: 现在不要。

english: As you wish, stranger, although I have this strange feeling that it is important. Unfortunately, I cannot leave my castle unattended.
translation: 如你所愿，陌生人，虽然我有种奇怪的感觉这很重要。不幸的是，我不能让城堡无人看管。

english: The only task remotely approaching a quest is the delivery of that talisman I gave you to the head wizard of the Wizards' Tower,
translation: 唯一接近任务的工作就是把我给你的护符交给法师塔的首席法师，

english: south-west of here. I suggest you deliver it to him as soon as possible. I have the oddest feeling that it is important...
translation: 就在我西南边。我建议你尽快交给他。我有种最奇怪的感觉这很重要……

english: Did you speak to the head wizard for me yet, adventurer?
translation: 冒险者，你替我和首席法师谈过了吗？

english: No, I lost that air talisman that you gave me.
translation: 不，我把你给我的风护符弄丢了。

english: Ah, that would explain it. One of my servants found this outside, and it seemed too much of a coincidence that more than one strange
translation: 啊，那就说得通了。我的一个仆人在外面发现了这个，似乎太巧合了，不止一个奇怪

english: object would appear on my land in such a short period of time. Please take this to the head wizard at the Wizards' Tower, south-west of here, and don't lose it this time.
translation: 的东西会在这么短时间内出现在我的土地上。请把这个带给法师塔的首席法师，就在我西南边，这次别弄丢了。

english: The only job I had was the delivery of that talisman, so I'm afraid not.
translation: 我唯一的工作就是送那个护符，所以恐怕没有。

english: No, all is well for me.
translation: 不，我一切都好。

english: Where can I find money?
translation: 我在哪能找到钱？

english: I've heard that the blacksmiths are prosperous amongst the peasantry. Maybe you could try your hand at that?
translation: 我听说铁匠在平民中很赚钱。也许你可以试试？

english: I seek a shield that will protect me from dragonbreath.
translation: 我寻找能保护我免受龙息伤害的盾牌。

english: Elvarg, the dragon of Crandor island!
translation: 埃尔瓦格，克兰多岛的龙！

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: I'd better leave that dragon alone.
translation: 我最好别管那条龙。

english: So, are you going to give me the shield or not?
translation: 那么，你给不给我盾牌？

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: Oh, no dragon in particular
translation: 哦，没有特定的龙

english: Have you any quests for me?
translation: 你有什么任务给我吗？

english: Where can I find money?
translation: 我在哪能找到钱？

english: [player name]! So glad you could make it. I really do appreciate you rounding up all those monkeys for us.
translation: [player name]！很高兴你能来。我真的很感激你帮我们召集所有那些猴子。

english: No problem.
translation: 没问题。

english: I am grateful for your help, [player name]. If you could free up an inventory space, I wish to reward you.
translation: 我感谢你的帮助，[player name]。如果你能腾出一个物品栏空间，我想奖励你。

english: I am grateful for your help, [player name]. As proof of my gratitude, I have arranged a reward for you!
translation: 我感谢你的帮助，[player name]。作为我感激的证明，我为你准备了奖励！

english: Also, King Awowogei brought gifts from Ape Atoll as an apology for the trouble they caused. But I think you should receive them instead.
translation: 另外，阿沃沃盖国王从猿猴岛带来了礼物，为他们造成的麻烦道歉。但我想你应该收下它们。

english: The Duke awards you a Cursed banana.Happy 8th Birthday!
translation: 公爵奖励你一个诅咒香蕉。8岁生日快乐！

english: On a members-only world you'd have also received a Banana Cape. If you purchase membership you can reclaim it at any time from Diango in Draynor Village.
translation: 在会员专属世界你还会收到香蕉斗篷。如果你购买会员，可以随时从德雷诺村的迪安戈那里领取。

english: The Duke awards you a Cursed banana and a Banana cape.Happy 8th Birthday!
translation: 公爵奖励你一个诅咒香蕉和香蕉斗篷。8岁生日快乐！

english: Ah, [player name]. I hope you are enjoying the party?
translation: 啊，[player name]。希望你喜欢派对？

english: What is going to happen with the monkeys?
translation: 猴子们会怎么样？

english: Funny you should ask, actually.
translation: 其实你问得正好。

english: It turns out that on the way to King Awowogei, Postie Pete was called off for an urgent request for Molly. Her evil twin had escaped again and she was looking for an adventurer to help.
translation: 原来在去阿沃沃盖国王的路上，邮递员皮特被叫走处理莫利的紧急请求。她的邪恶双胞胎又逃跑了，她在找冒险者帮忙。

english: In the process of teleporting, he left the letter behind and these monkeys found it.
translation: 在传送过程中，他把信落下了，这些猴子捡到了。

english: They couldn't understand the letter so they took it to one of their elders, Mizaru, to translate. But 'Monster' didn't translate, so they assumed it said 'Monkey'.
translation: 他们看不懂信，所以拿给他们的长老之一观猴翻译。但''怪物''没翻译出来，所以他们以为是''猴子''。

english: So instead of a party invitation they interpreted it as a threat from an organisation called Humans Against Monkeys! They stole some amulets of humanspeak, then decided to come here and put an end to it!
translation: 所以他们把派对邀请理解成来自一个叫人类反猴子组织的威胁！他们偷了一些人类语护符，然后决定来这里结束这一切！

english: That explains what happened, I suppose. How did you find all of this out?
translation: 我想那解释了发生的事。你是怎么知道这些的？

english: Another elder, Kikazaru, found the letter. And once he understood the situation, he went straight to King Awowogei himself. The King is over in the corner if you want to speak to him.
translation: 另一位长老闻猴发现了信。一旦他理解了情况，就直接去找阿沃沃盖国王本人。如果你想和他说话，国王在角落那边。

english: Thanks. I'll go enjoy the party now.
translation: 谢谢。我现在去享受派对了。

english: Can you give me more reward items?
translation: 能给我更多奖励物品吗？

english: I think that is everything I have for you.
translation: 我想我给你的就这些了。

english: I have given you what you can hold. You may wish to visit Diango, in Draynor Village, to collect more rewards in a more convenient setting.
translation: 我已经给了你能拿的。你可能想去德雷诺村的迪安戈那里，在更方便的地方领取更多奖励。

english: I have nothing more for you.
translation: 我没有更多给你的了。

english: What is going to happen with the monkeys?
translation: 猴子们会怎么样？

english: Can you give me more reward items?
translation: 能给我更多奖励物品吗？

english: Thanks. I'll go enjoy the party now.
translation: 谢谢。我现在去享受派对了。

english: Can you give me more rewards?
translation: 能给我更多奖励吗？

english: Uh hey, are you the Duke?
translation: 呃嘿，你是公爵吗？

english: Shh shh, now is not your time to speak.
translation: 嘘嘘，现在不是你说话的时候。

english: Uhh...
Oh Great One, do I have to have broccoli for dinner?
translation: 哦伟大的，我晚餐必须吃西兰花吗？

english: Yes, Definitely.
translation: 是的，当然。

english: I hatesbroccoli, why must it torture me.
translation: 我讨厌西兰花，为什么它要折磨我。

english: Why are they here, you didn't command it.
translation: 他们为什么在这里，你没命令。

english: What do you mean? I was told to come here.
translation: 你什么意思？我被告知来这里。

english: We're not talking to you.
translation: 我们不是在跟你说话。

english: Great round one, should I rid us of this intruder?
translation: 伟大的一号，我应该除掉这个入侵者吗？

english: Ask again later.
translation: 稍后再问。

english: What is going on here, why are you talking to an egg?
translation: 这里发生什么了，你为什么跟一个蛋说话？

english: The Omlettesiah feels generous today, what do you want and why are you here?
translation: 欧姆雷特西亚今天心情好，你想要什么，为什么在这里？

english: I'm not sure, I was told to come here when I stepped out of the portal.
translation: 我不确定，我被告知走出传送门后就来这里。

english: WHAT DID YOU SAY?!
translation: 你说什么？！

english: Uuh, I mean, I was told to come here... after I hopped out of the portal.
translation: 呃，我是说，我被告知来这里……在我跳出传送门后。

english: YOU CAME BACK? THE EGG DIDN'T COMMAND IT.
translation: 你回来了？蛋没命令。

english: We need to punish them, but you have commanded me to wait...
translation: 我们需要惩罚他们，但你命令我等待……

english: Who are you talking to?
translation: 你在跟谁说话？

english: Our wise ruler, the divine egg. It is our great leader.
translation: 我们智慧的统治者，神圣的蛋。它是我们伟大的领袖。

english: It appeared to me one night when I was down by the coast, I have been its loyal servant ever since.
translation: 它有一天晚上在海边向我显现，从那以后我就是它忠诚的仆人。

english: I am its voice, I give action to its words, it serves a greater good than we can understand.
translation: 我是它的声音，我让它的言语变成行动，它服务于比我们理解的更大的利益。

english: Are you talking about that egg on the table?
translation: 你在说桌上的那个蛋吗？

english: YOU'RE TALKING TO A POWER YOU CANNOT COMPREHEND.
translation: 你在跟你无法理解的力量说话。

english: Wow... well then.
translation: 哇……那好吧。

english: Maybe there's someone more reasonable I can talk to.
translation: 也许有更理性的人可以跟我说话。

english: Great round one, will Jessica Rabbit ever love me?
translation: 伟大的一号，杰西卡兔子会爱我吗？

english: Outlook not so good.
translation: 前景不太好。

english: The almighty egg, will my kingdom ever fall?
translation: 全能的蛋，我的王国会灭亡吗？

english: Concentrate and ask again.
translation: 集中精神再问。

english: My mighty yolk, do you think I'd look good in a top hat?
translation: 我强大的蛋黄，你觉得我戴高帽好看吗？

english: As I see it, yes.
translation: 在我看来，是的。

english: Oh wise one, is there a wiser ruler than I?
translation: 哦智者，有比我更智慧的统治者吗？

english: My sources say no.
translation: 我的消息来源说没有。

english: Great golden one, will I gain incredible riches this year?
translation: 伟大的金色，我今年会获得巨额财富吗？

english: Better not tell you now.
translation: 现在最好不告诉你。

english: Maybe there's someone more sane I can talk to.
translation: 也许有更理智的人可以跟我说话。

english: Paws is probably the best person to talk to right now.
translation: 帕斯可能是现在最适合说话的人。

english: Your Dukeness, I've discovered a revelation!
translation: 公爵大人，我发现了一个启示！

english: What do they want, why can't they leave us?
translation: 他们想要什么，为什么不能离开我们？

english: That egg on the table... it is a fake!
translation: 桌上的那个蛋……是假的！

english: Don't be so foolish, of course it's real.
translation: 别这么傻，当然是真的。

english: How do you know? Someone could have easily swapped it out for a fake one.
translation: 你怎么知道？有人可能很容易把它换成假的。

english: That doesn't make sense, if this is a fake, how did you find the original?
translation: 那说不通，如果这是假的，你怎么找到真的？

english: Oh, I uh, found it in a burrow underneath the castle.
translation: 哦，我呃，在城堡下面的洞里找到的。

english: Unlikely story. Since I found it, I've been watching it like a falcon.
translation: 不太可能的故事。自从我找到它，我一直像猎鹰一样盯着它。

english: If you don't trust me, why don't you ask that egg?
translation: 如果你不信任我，为什么不问那个蛋？

english: Fine, but if you're trying to trick us, we'll dispose of you.
translation: 好吧，但如果你想骗我们，我们会处理你。

english: Your magical eggness: Are you a fake version and does this coney hold the real one?
translation: 你的魔法蛋：你是假的吗？这个兔子拿着真的吗？

english: -Sweating profusely- ...
translation: -大汗淋漓- ……

english: Without a doubt.
translation: 毫无疑问。

english: What the flying carrot!
translation: 什么飞行的胡萝卜！

english: Phew... see, I told you it's fake.
translation: 呼……看，我告诉你是假的。

english: I can't believe it, how long have I been made a fool of?
translation: 我不敢相信，我被愚弄了多久？

english: Give me the real one, we need to rid ourselves of this imposter.
translation: 把真的给我，我们需要除掉这个冒牌货。

english: Duke Rabbacio takes the fake egg off you and swaps it with the real one.
translation: 拉巴西欧公爵从你那里拿走假蛋，换成了真的。

english: I'm glad we got that sorted, feel free to ensure it works properly.
translation: 很高兴我们解决了，随意确保它正常工作。

english: I'll uh, dispose of this one for you.
translation: 我呃，帮你处理这个。

english: Wise one: Do I have to have broccoli with my carrots tonight?
translation: 智者：我今晚必须吃西兰花配胡萝卜吗？

english: [chosen negative option]
translation: [chosen negative option]

english: Yes! Just what I wanted to hear, thank you for your help.
translation: 太好了！这正是我想听的，谢谢你的帮助。

english: I will let you ask but one question to the great supreme.
translation: 我只允许你向至高者问一个问题。

english: Oh, ghee thanks, I'm not sure what to ask, maybe...
translation: 天哪，谢谢。我不知道该问什么，也许……

english: Egg: Should rabbits keep jumping through the strange portal that no one knows where it leads to?
translation: 蛋：兔子们应该继续跳进那个没人知道通向哪里的奇怪传送门吗？

english: Well, that settles it, I'll send the order for all rabbits to cease jumping through the portal at once.
translation: 好吧，就这样定了，我会下令所有兔子立即停止跳进传送门。

english: You may leave me, keep that fake egg and dispose of it.
translation: 你可以退下了，留着那个假蛋并处理掉它。

english: I'll also let everyone know you're a good rabbit, so if they need a paw, don't hesitate to help out.
translation: 我也会让大家知道你是只好兔子，所以如果他们需要帮助，别犹豫去帮忙。

english: Great! I should return to Gelt to let him know what has happened.
translation: 太好了！我得回去告诉格尔特发生了什么。

english: Leave me, I have many questions to ask the mythical one.
translation: 让我一个人待着，我有很多问题要问那位神秘存在。

english: The Duke brushes you off, returning his focus to the egg.
translation: 公爵把你打发走，重新把注意力集中在蛋上。

english: What are you doing?! Step away from it.
translation: 你在干什么？！离它远点。

english: Sorry Duke...
translation: 抱歉公爵……

english: Big Egg, will I ever...
translation: 大蛋，我会不会……

english: None can talk to it except me!
translation: 除了我没人能跟它说话！

english: What is it, human? I'm working.
translation: 什么事，人类？我在工作。

english: How do I use the furnace?
translation: 我怎么使用熔炉？

english: Put your ore on the conveyor belt to get it smelted. We'll stoke the boiler and operate the rest of the machinery for you.
translation: 把你的矿石放在传送带上就能冶炼了。我们会为你烧锅炉并操作其余机械。

english: You'll have to help repair the furnace whenever a pipe blows, though. Just hit it with a hammer - that usually works.
translation: 不过每当管道爆裂时，你得帮忙修理熔炉。用锤子敲它就行——通常都管用。

english: You'll have to put money in the coffer to pay for our services. We charge 72,000 coins per hour; money is deducted as long as you're in this room with us.
translation: 你得把钱放进保险箱来支付我们的服务费。我们每小时收费72,000金币；只要你和我们一起在这个房间里，钱就会扣除。

english: Gosh, you're a remarkably big dwarf.
translation: 天哪，你真是个特别高大的矮人。

english: My brothers and I have a rare genetic condition affecting our growth. Rather than treating us as freaks, you might like to appreciate how useful it is that we can operate the machinery.
translation: 我和兄弟们得了一种罕见的遗传病，影响了我们的生长。与其把我们当怪胎，不如感激我们能操作机械的用处。

english: Sorry.
translation: 抱歉。

english: That's ok, human. You're not the first to comment on it. Now, did you need anything? I've got work to do here.
translation: 没事，人类。你不是第一个评论这个的。现在，你需要什么吗？我这里还有工作要做。

english: Are you sure you're really a dwarf?
translation: 你确定你真的是矮人吗？

english: ... look, do you want help with something, or did you just come here to be rude? I've got work to do.
translation: ……听着，你是想要帮忙，还是专门来这里无礼的？我还有工作要做。

english: I'll let you get on with it.
translation: 我不打扰你了。

english: How do I use the furnace?
translation: 我怎么使用熔炉？

english: Gosh, you're a remarkably big dwarf.
translation: 天哪，你真是个特别高大的矮人。

english: Sorry.
translation: 抱歉。

english: I'll let you get on with it.
translation: 我不打扰你了。

english: Are you sure you're really a dwarf?
translation: 你确定你真的是矮人吗？

english: Hey, [player name], the teacher wants you to come to school for a test.
translation: 嘿，[player name]，老师叫你去学校参加考试。

english: Sure, I fancy an exam.
translation: 当然，我想参加考试。

english: I don't want to.
translation: 我不想去。

english: Nope, you're not the one the teacher wanted me to find!
translation: 不，你不是老师让我找的那个人！

english: Surprise exam, [player name]!
translation: 突击考试，[player name]！

english: Come to school, [player name]!
translation: 来学校，[player name]！

english: You're getting tested, [player name]!
translation: 你要被测试了，[player name]！

english: The teacher wants you, [player name]!
translation: 老师找你，[player name]！

english: Teacher gets angry when he's kept waiting, [player name]!
translation: 老师不喜欢等人，[player name]！

english: Maybe later.
translation: 也许以后吧。

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: Star yet?
translation: 已经是明星了吗？

english: Yes, yes you are.
translation: 是的，你确实是。

english: STAR!
translation: 明星！

english: Sure, I fancy an exam.
translation: 当然，我想参加考试。

english: I don't want to.
translation: 我不想去。

english: Dung cook human.
translation: 邓格煮人类。

english: Ash eat human.
translation: 阿什吃人类。

english: Dung will fry human.
translation: 邓格要炸人类。

english: Dung is wrong!
translation: 邓格错了！

english: My brother in stronghold best cook.
translation: 我兄弟在要塞是最好的厨师。

english: Ash will boil human 'till it tender.
translation: 阿什要把人类煮到软烂。

english: Much more tasty.
translation: 更美味。

english: Ash will not cook human!
translation: 阿什不煮人类！

english: Ash will boil!
translation: 阿什要煮！

english: Dung will boil Ash's head!
translation: 邓格要煮阿什的头！

english: Boil better!
translation: 煮更好吃！

english: Fry better!
translation: 炸更好吃！

english: Boil!
translation: 煮！

english: Fry!
translation: 炸！

english: Ow!
translation: 嗷！

english: Ugh!
translation: 呃！

english: Dung not hit Ash!
translation: 邓格别打阿什！

english: Ow!
translation: 嗷！

english: Ouch!
translation: 哎哟！

english: Dung hate Ash!
translation: 邓格恨阿什！

english: Ash hate Dung!
translation: 阿什恨邓格！

english: Well, if it isn't our very own sledder! What can I do for you today?
translation: 哟，这不是我们自己的雪橇手吗！今天有什么能帮你的？

english: Can I have another law talisman?
translation: 能再给我一个法令护符吗？

english: Well, I've got one here you can have for 1,000 coins if you'd like it?
translation: 嗯，我这里有一个，如果你想要的话，1,000金币卖给你？

english: Yes, I'll take it.
translation: 是的，我要了。

translation: 谢谢你！(拉丁语)

english: Hi.
translation: 嗨。

english: You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 你知道吗，跟人打招呼的方式可多了。你好、嘿、你好啊……

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: 那也只能算一种！

english: Hello. How are you today?
translation: 你好。你今天怎么样？

english: I'm great, thank you!
translation: 我很好，谢谢！

english: Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 你好！水晶城今天天气真好，哈？

english: Indeed.
translation: 确实。

english: What can I do for ya?
translation: 我能为你做什么？

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这里有什么可以做的？

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 可做的事可多了！塔楼就是绝妙景致。

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 像今天这样的好日子，我建议去市场逛逛。

english: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你以为你在做什么？

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这里有什么可以做的？

english: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: Oh no, why today of all days?
translation: 哦不，为什么偏偏是今天？

english: What's wrong Mr Rabbit?
translation: 怎么了兔子先生？

english: I'm having an eggceptionally bad day. But if you must know, my Egg making machine is shell dry and the next shipment of fuel will not be here for a while!
translation: 我今天过得特别“蛋”糕。但你一定要知道的话，我的造蛋机器彻底“壳”干了，下一批燃料要过一阵子才到！

english: I would love it if a cracking adventurer, such as yourself, would help a Bunny in need.
translation: 如果像你这样“破壳”出色的冒险者能帮助有需要的兔子，我会很高兴。

english: I would love to help you mix up some more fuel.
translation: 我很乐意帮你混合更多燃料。

english: Thanks for eggreeing to help me.
translation: 谢谢你“蛋”定同意帮我。

english: There are three ingredients that are needed to make the fuel.
translation: 制作燃料需要三种材料。

english: The first ingredient is Dried cocoa. During any other time of year this ingredient would be eggceptionally hard to get.
translation: 第一种是干可可粉。在其他任何季节，这种材料都难得要“蛋”疼。

english: But if I'm spot on with my information, there should be a merchant rolling into Al Kharid soon. He should sell you some.
translation: 但如果我消息准确，很快会有个商人来到阿尔卡里德城。他应该能卖给你一些。

english: Try not to bring me camel dung, they do look similar.
translation: 尽量别给我弄来骆驼粪，它们看着挺像的。

english: The second ingredient is really high quality milk.
translation: 第二种是高品质牛奶。

english: The most eggceptional milk around has got to be milk from Hosidius, I'm sure Duke Horacio's cook can help you out.
translation: 周围最“蛋”级的奶肯定是霍西迪乌斯城的，我相信霍拉西奥公爵的厨师能帮你。

english: The third ingredient is some cracking spices, very special ones. Can't go into detail, trade secret and all.
translation: 第三种是些绝妙香料，特别的那种。细节不能说，商业机密。

english: I'm sure if you talk to Martin in Draynor, he'll be a good egg and help you out if you ask for Special spices.
translation: 如果你找德雷诺的马丁，说是“特殊香料”，他会是个好“蛋”友帮你的。

english: Since you're doing errands for me. Feel Free to use my tunnels to get around.
translation: 既然你帮我办事，随意用我的隧道代步。

english: But don't make a yolk out of it, you may only use each tunnel once. Can't have you interrupting my workers any more than that.
translation: 但别开“蛋”疼的玩笑，每条隧道只能用一次。不想让你太多打扰工人。

english: Also, if you ever forget what you need, there will be a worker nearby who can remind you.
translation: 如果忘了需要什么，附近有工人会提醒你。

english: I'll get right on it. Be back soon.
translation: 我马上着手。很快回来。

english: See you soon!
translation: 回头见！

english: Get stuffed.
translation: 得了吧。

english: I'll have you know this is no yolking matter.
translation: 跟你说这可不是闹着玩(“蛋”疼)的事。

english: Where do I get the Dried cocoa?
translation: 我从哪儿得到干可可粉？

english: During any other time of year this ingredient would be a nightmare to get.
translation: 在其他任何季节，这材料都难得要命。

english: But if I'm spot on with my information, there should bea merchant making his way from the Kharidian Desert to Al Kharid.
translation: 但如果我消息准确，应该有个商人正从卡里迪安沙漠前往阿尔卡里德城。

english: I'd suggest checking the Shantay Pass.
translation: 我建议你去沙泰隘口看看。

english: Where do I get the bottle of Hosidius milk?
translation: 我从哪儿得到霍西迪乌斯牛奶瓶？

english: The most eggceptional milk around has got to be milk from Hosidius, I'm sure Duke Horacio's cook in Lumbridge castle can help you out.
translation: 周围最“蛋”香的奶肯定是霍西迪乌斯城的，我相信仑桥堡里霍拉西奥公爵的厨师能帮你。

english: Where do I get the Special spices?
translation: 我从哪儿得到特殊香料？

english: He should get the hint.
translation: 他应该能领会暗示。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Keep on rolling my friend!
translation: 继续努力，我的朋友！

english: Easter Bunny! I knew I would find you here.
translation: 复活节兔子！我就知道能在这儿找到你。

english: Easter Bunny... Now there's a name I haven't heard in a long time...
translation: 复活节兔子……这名字我好久没听到了……

english: How long exactly?
translation: 具体多久？

english: Oh, almost a year.
translation: 哦，快一年了。

english: What have people been calling you instead?
translation: 那人们都叫你什么？

english: I go by many names.
translation: 我有很多名字。

english: Some call me 'Eggrabbit'.
translation: 有人叫我“蛋兔”。

english: Others call me 'Long Ears Johnson'.
translation: 有人叫我“长耳约翰逊”。

english: Mhmm?
translation: 嗯哼？

english: Many times have I walked past Varrock West Bank and been called 'Sellin lobbies 200gp'.
translation: 很多次我路过维洛克城西部银行，被叫成“大厅售价200金币”。

english: I don't really understand that one.
translation: 我真不懂那个。

english: Do you think perhaps they weren't talking to you?
translation: 你觉得他们可能不是在叫你？

english: Who could blame them? I'm a failure!
translation: 谁能怪他们？我是个失败者！

english: Oh come on now, what do you mean?
translation: 哦拜托，你什么意思？

english: You call me the Easter Bunny? What right do I have to that name?
translation: 你叫我复活节兔子？我有什么资格配这名字？

english: I don't feel the spirit of Easter within me.
translation: 我内心感受不到复活节的精神。

english: *sniff*
translation: 抽泣

english: I'm just a big dumb rabbit!
translation: 我就是只又蠢又大的兔子！

english: Aww, that's... come on!
translation: 哎呀，那……拜托！

english: I've ruined Easter for everyone!
translation: 我把大家的复活节都毁了！

english: Aww...
translation: 哎呀……

english: WAHHHH!
translation: 哇啊啊啊！

english: The Easter Bunny is clearly very upset and needs cheering up. Perhaps the other people in the Rabbit Hole have some ideas?
translation: 复活节兔子显然很难过，需要振作起来。也许兔子洞里的其他人有主意？

english: Hello Easter Bunny, how are you feeling?
translation: 你好复活节兔子，你感觉怎么样？

english: Maybe I'll make my way through this sorry old world as a clown...
translation: 也许我就当个小丑混过这悲惨的旧世界……

english: Hello! Have you come to take part in the festivities?
translation: 你好！你是来参加庆典的吗？

english: The Easter Bunny is looking awfully glum this year.
translation: 复活节兔子今年看起来特别沮丧。

english: Perhaps we can help raise the Easter spirits?
translation: 也许我们能帮忙提振复活节气氛？

english: You want to do some necromancy... To cheer up the Easter Bunny?
translation: 你想搞点死灵法术……来让复活节兔子开心？

english: No no no! It's just a figure of speech.
translation: 不不不！只是个比喻。

english: I just wonder if we could do anything to help.
translation: 我只是想知道我们能帮什么忙。

english: Leave it to me boss.
translation: 交给我吧老板。

english: I happen to know the E.B. is a big fan of bowling. In fact, he used to be a wizard on the lanes. A champion!
translation: 我碰巧知道复活节兔子是保龄球粉丝。事实上，他曾是球道上的高手。冠军！

english: I also happen to have the ability to...
translation: 我也碰巧有能力……

english: ...Rig the game in his favour.
translation: ……操纵比赛对他有利。

english: Which is handy, he's very out of practise nowadays.
translation: 这很方便，他现在生疏得很。

english: Won't he suspect something?
translation: 他不会怀疑吗？

english: Oh no! You see, I have these gears set up just here.
translation: 哦不！你看，我在这儿设置了齿轮。

english: Wait, are you just trying to get my trade secrets?
translation: 等等，你只是想套我的商业机密？

english: This is strictly a humanitarian effort!
translation: 这纯粹是人道主义努力！

english: Bun-itarian..?
translation: 兔道主义……？

english: Look, I just want to get Easter back on track.
translation: 听着，我只是想让复活节回到正轨。

english: You can keep your hustle going, I just want to help the Easter Bunny.
translation: 你可以继续你的勾当，我只想帮复活节兔子。

english: Oh alright, since I do owe the big softie. But I've got my whiskers on you!
translation: 哦好吧，既然我确实欠那大块头人情。但我会盯着你的！

english: So, what is it you wanted to show me, [player name]?
translation: 那么，你想给我看什么，[player name]？

english: Well, Bowley here let me in on your secret. Bowling champion three years in a row.
translation: 嗯，这里的波利透露了你的秘密。连续三年保龄球冠军。

english: Oh. Those were the days, I haven't partaken for while now though...
translation: 哦。那是昔日辉煌，不过我好久没参与了……

english: I just haven't had the spring in my step with my egg responsibilities.
translation: 只是背负着蛋的责任，我脚步没了活力。

english: Well, here's your chance!
translation: 嗯，这是你的机会！

english: What do you mean? It's hardly fun without decent competition.
translation: 你什么意思？没有像样的竞争一点都不好玩。

english: And nobody here quite likes bowling.
translation: 而且这里没人喜欢保龄球。

english: They what now?
translation: 他们什么？

english: I've only just gone and spent ages digging out this place and installing the machinery!
translation: 我才刚花大功夫挖出这地方装上机械！

english: Nothing to worry about I'm sure!
translation: 肯定没什么好担心的！

english: Ah Bowley, it is good to see you again.
translation: 啊波利，很高兴又见到你。

english: Long Ears Johnson. Come to terrorise me pins again?
translation: 长耳约翰逊。又来吓唬我的瓶子？

english: We'll see about that.
translation: 走着瞧。

english: Oh yes, [player name] is apparently quite good.
translation: 哦是的，[player name] 显然很厉害。

english: It's been so long since I've had a decent set with a worthy opponent.
translation: 好久没和值得的对手好好打一场了。

english: Chin up bucko, I'm here and ready to challenge your rule of these alleys!
translation: 振作点伙计，我在这儿准备挑战你对这些球道的统治！

english: Well, I suppose I'm not doing anything else. Why not?
translation: 嗯，我想我也没别的事。何乐不为？

english: The player bowls down 3 carrot pins.
translation: 玩家击倒了3个胡萝卜球瓶。

english: A fine shot, but not quite enough!
translation: 好球，但还不够！

english: Watch this!
translation: 看这个！

english: The Easter Bunny bowls a strike.
translation: 复活节兔子打出了全中。

english: A lucky strike?
translation: 幸运的全中？

english: I'd better shape up or this will be quite one sided.
translation: 我最好振作起来，否则这就太一边倒了。

english: And that would be no fun at all.
translation: 那就一点意思都没了。

english: The player bowls down the middle 6 pins.
translation: 玩家击倒了中间6个瓶子。

english: Ah, so you have some fight in you.
translation: 啊，看来你还有点斗志。

english: I could do this all day.
translation: 我能打一整天。

english: That's exactly what I wanted to hear!
translation: 这正是我想听的！

english: The screen fades black with the text "Some time later..."
translation: 屏幕变黑，显示文字“一段时间后……''

english: I'm surprised I hadn't heard about your prowess before, [player name].
translation: 我很惊讶以前没听说过你的实力，[player name]。

english: Ah you know me, the most modest adventurer in Gielinor.
translation: 啊你了解我，基利诺尔最谦虚的冒险者。

english: Ah, well I suppose I should pack it in while I'm ahead.
translation: 啊，我想我应该在领先时收手。

english: But we should do this again.
translation: 但我们应该再来一次。

english: Aye we should! Also if you could get the word out about my establishment, I'll be raking it in!
translation: 是的我们应该！另外如果你能宣传一下我的店，我就发财了！

english: I mean... The Rabbit Hole will enjoy all the visitors?
translation: 我是说……兔子洞会欢迎所有访客？

english: Well, anyway...
translation: 嗯，总之……

english: It was a close match. How are you feeling now?
translation: 比赛很激烈。你现在感觉如何？

english: Oh it was fun but I think I'm just going to sit in the Rabbit Hole a bit longer.
translation: 哦很有趣，但我想我就在兔子洞再坐会儿。

english: I should be off. Always a pleasure, Bowley.
translation: 我该走了。总是很愉快，波利。

english: Aye, till next time.
translation: 是的，下次见。

english: I feel less horrible I suppose...
translation: 我想我感觉没那么糟了……

english: Well, that's a start!
translation: 嗯，这是个开始！

english: Hey Bunny, would you like a fancy carrot?
translation: 嘿兔子，想要根花哨胡萝卜吗？

english: Not really, I've eaten a lot of carrots recently.
translation: 不太想，我最近吃了很多胡萝卜。

english: They're really good.
translation: 它们真的很好。

english: I'm alright, thank you though.
translation: 我没事，不过谢谢。

english: Oh, hello again, [player name].
translation: 哦，又见面了，[player name]。

english: Hello! I have a surprise for you.
translation: 你好！我给你准备了惊喜。

english: Oh? A surprise? It's not something horrible I hope.
translation: 哦？惊喜？希望不是什么可怕的东西。

english: Oh no, it's something quite delicious actually.
translation: 哦不，其实是很好吃的东西。

english: Delicious?
translation: 美味？

english: A lovely mug of carrot juice!
translation: 一大杯美味的胡萝卜汁！

english: Oh please no more!
translation: 哦拜托别再来了！

english: Don't worry, this is fancy carrot juice. I made it myself with some fantastic carrots.
translation: 别担心，这是特制胡萝卜汁。我自己用极好的胡萝卜做的。

english: You made it? Well in that case I suppose I might give it a try. As long as Wheeler hasn't been near it.
translation: 你做的？那我想我可以试试。只要惠勒没碰过就行。

english: I made sure of that. Go on!
translation: 我保证了。来吧！

english: Here we go then...
translation: 那我们开始……

english: Oh...
Oh my...
translation: 哦天……

english: Wow!
translation: 哇！

english: That was delicious, nothing like the usual slop.
translation: 真美味，跟平时的泔水完全不同。

english: Thank you, [player name], I really needed that.
translation: 谢谢你，[player name]，我真需要这个。

english: You're welcome!
translation: 不客气！

english: How are you feeling now? Any better?
translation: 你现在感觉如何？好点了吗？

english: Hmm... I'm feeling a bit more hopeful. Like spring is about to, well, spring! But I'm not sure if Easter is really my thing any more.
translation: 嗯……我感觉更有希望了。就像春天正要……呃，爆发！但我不确定复活节是否还适合我。

english: I'm sure I can help you remember how wonderful it is.
translation: 我相信我能帮你记起它有多美好。

english: Hmmm... I should check in with Eggus before I give one of these buns to the Easter Bunny. Quality control or something.
translation: 嗯……在给复活节兔子这些小面包前，我应该先跟埃格斯确认一下。质量控制之类的。

english: Hello...
translation: 你好……

english: Hi! I'm back with an Easter treat, just for you.
translation: 嗨！我带了复活节零食回来，专门给你的。

english: Huh?
translation: 哈？

english: It's something special.
translation: 是特别的东西。

english: Special eh? Why would you give me something special?
translation: 特别嗯？你为什么给我特别的东西？

english: Because you deserve it.
translation: 因为你值得。

english: I don't know if I deserve anything.
translation: 我不知道我是否值得什么。

english: Of course you do!
translation: 当然你值得！

english: Here, it's an Easter bun. Fresh out of the oven.
translation: 给，这是复活节小面包。刚出炉的。

english: An Easter bun? I like those!
translation: 复活节小面包？我喜欢那个！

english: Yum! That was lovely. Thanks, [player name].
translation: 好吃！真棒。谢谢，[player name]。

english: You're a good friend.
translation: 你是个好朋友。

english: You are most welcome. Do you feel a bit more Easter- ey now?
translation: 不用客气。你现在感觉更有复活节气氛了吗？

english: Oh, I'm starting to remember now! Easter is great! But I just... Hmm, I don't know...
translation: 哦，我开始记起来了！复活节很棒！但我只是……嗯，我不知道……

english: I feel like I need one more little treat before I do anything to help with Easter.
translation: 我觉得在帮忙复活节之前，我需要再来点小零食。

english: Oh for goodness sake...
translation: 哦天哪……

english: Alright, let me think of something.
translation: 好吧，让我想想。

english: Excuse me, [player name], I believe I can help you.
translation: 打扰一下，[player name]，我想我能帮你。

english: Oh?
translation: 哦？

english: Come here!
translation: 过来！

english: I couldn't help overhearing that you're trying to cheer up the Easter Bunny, and I have an idea.
translation: 我无意中听到你想让复活节兔子开心，我有个主意。

english: Well that's sort of nosey, but go on.
translation: 嗯有点多管闲事，但说吧。

english: Let's put on a performance! that will cheer him up.
translation: 我们来场表演！那能让他开心。

english: A performance?
translation: 表演？

english: Yes! He's always enjoyed a good show.
translation: 是的！他一直喜欢好看的表演。

english: Well I suppose that could work...
translation: 嗯我想那可能行……

english: I have some classic material we can try if that sounds appropriate?
translation: 如果我有些经典素材可以试试，听起来合适吗？

english: I don't see why not.
translation: 我没理由拒绝。

english: Excellent! I've already talked to some of the other fellows in here about it too. They seem keen!
translation: 太好了！我已经跟这里的一些家伙谈过了。他们很有兴趣！

english: I wonder how Fry is getting on with that performance...
translation: 不知道弗莱那场表演进展如何……

english: What was that?
translation: 那是什么？

english: Oh, nothing. I just need to talk to Fry about something.
translation: 哦，没什么。我只是需要跟弗莱谈点事。

english: Oh, see you later then.
translation: 哦，那回头见。

english: One more treat and I'll be ready to work on Easter again.
translation: 再来一次零食我就准备好重新为复活节工作了。

english: ANOTHER treat?
translation: 又来零食？

english: The last one!
translation: 最后一次！

english: It better be.
translation: 最好是。

english: That dance was amazing! Well done. I feel so... Invigorated!
translation: 那舞蹈太棒了！干得好。我感觉如此……充满活力！

english: Lawks! Look at the time, I should get back to Varrock to set up the Eggs!
translation: 天哪！看看时间，我得回维洛克城布置彩蛋了！

english: See you up there!
translation: 上面见！

english: You need [1-5] free inventory [slots/slot] to receive your Easter event rewards.
translation: 你需要 [1-5] 个空闲物品栏 [ slots/slot] 来领取复活节活动奖励。

english: I have something fun for you, [player name]!
translation: 我有好玩的东西给你，[player name]！

english: Come back when you have more space.
translation: 有空位再来。

english: Thanks for saving our bacon and eggs again, [player name]!
translation: 谢谢再次拯救我们的培根和鸡蛋，[player name]！

english: You've completed the Easter event: One glum bunny
translation: 你完成了复活节活动：一只忧郁的兔子

english: Oh it's always my pleasure to get these delicious eggs!
translation: 哦拿到这些美味鸡蛋总是我的荣幸！

english: I mean... to help out a friend in need!

english: [player name]! Hero-of-the-humans!
translation: [player name]！人类英雄！

english: You are a mighty hero, aren't you? I bet you've slain dragons and all sorts of stuff.
translation: 你是个大英雄，对吧？我打赌你杀过龙和各种东西。

english: That's right. I'm awesome!
translation: 没错。我很棒！

english: I could be your sidekick! [player name] and Eek! We could have all sorts of adventures together!
translation: 我可以当你的搭档！[player name] 和伊克！我们可以一起冒险！

english: Yes!
translation: 是的！

english: Yay! [player name] and Eek! We'll travel all over the world fighting for justice! And freedom! And things like that!
translation: 耶！[player name] 和伊克！我们将环游世界为正义而战！为自由！以及类似的东西！

english: Come on, [player name]! Let's have an adventure!
translation: 来吧，[player name]！我们去冒险！

english: No. It's too dangerous.
translation: 不。太危险了。

english: Aww.
translation: 哎呀。

english: You know best, though. You're so BRAVE putting yourself in danger all by yourself!
translation: 不过你最清楚。你独自置身危险中真勇敢！

english: I'm not a great hero. I'm just an ordinary person.
translation: 我不是大英雄。我只是普通人。

english: Aww. I bet you'll be a mighty hero someday, though.
translation: 哎呀。但我打赌你总有一天会成为大英雄。

english: Yes, I'm trying to advance myself.
translation: 是的，我在努力提升自己。

english: Brilliant! You can do it! Come on, let's have an adventure!
translation: 太棒了！你能行！来吧，我们去冒险！

english: I don't know. I'm not very ambitious.
translation: 我不知道。我不太有野心。

english: Aww...well...never mind.
translation: 哎呀……嗯……没关系。

english: Hey, you've only got four legs. How do you manage? Don't you fall over?
translation: 嘿，你只有四条腿。怎么应付的？不会摔倒吗？

english: Actually, I've only got two legs.
translation: 其实，我只有两条腿。

english: Someone has stolen your legs! This is a DISASTER!
translation: 有人偷了你的腿！这是灾难！

english: We've got to catch the leg thief!
translation: 我们得抓住偷腿贼！

english: No one stole my legs.
translation: 没人偷我的腿。

english: You gave your legs away?
translation: 你把腿送人了？

english: That is so heroic...giving your legs away to someone without legs.
translation: 太英雄了……把腿送给没腿的人。

english: You're my hero!
translation: 你是我的英雄！

english: They're probably long gone by now.
translation: 它们现在可能早走了。

english: You're right. They probably used the machine to give themselves really long running-away type legs. We'll never catch them now.
translation: 你说得对。它们可能用机器给自己装了超长的逃跑腿。我们现在永远抓不到它们了。

english: Oh, it's not so bad.
translation: 哦，没那么糟。

english: Then again, your legs are much longer than mine.
translation: 话说回来，你的腿比我的长多了。

english: How's you get such long legs? Do you have some kind of leg-extending machine?
translation: 你怎么腿这么长？你有某种伸腿机器吗？

english: Where is the leg-extending machine? I want to use it!
translation: 伸腿机器在哪？我想用！

english: There is no leg-extending machine.
translation: 没有伸腿机器。

english: You would say that! You want to keep it for yourself!
translation: 你当然这么说！你想自己留着！

english: Well that's okay. Maybe I don't even need your leg-extending machine!
translation: 嗯那好吧。也许我甚至不需要你的伸腿机器！

english: I can do special leg-stretching exercises! Make my legs longer naturally! No artificial legs for me!
translation: 我可以做特殊的伸腿运动！自然让腿变长！我不要假腿！

english: You just wait! Soon I'll have the best legs ever!
translation: 你等着！很快我就会有最好的腿！

english: You can't use it. It's broken.
translation: 你用不了。它坏了。

english: Oh! I wouldn't want to use it if it's broken.
translation: 哦！如果坏了我也不想用。

english: It might malfunction and give me tiny, tiny legs! Like a slug, only with tiny legs!
translation: 它可能故障给我超小的腿！像蛞蝓一样，只是有小腿！

english: Or it might make some legs longer than others so I wouldn't be able to walk and I'd fall over!
translation: 或者让某些腿比其他腿长，我就走不了路会摔倒！

english: That would be TERRIBLE!
translation: 那太可怕了！

english: I'd better keep away from that machine!
translation: 我最好离那机器远点！

english: Hey, are you scared of spiders?
translation: 嘿，你怕蜘蛛吗？

english: Yes, I'm scared of spiders.
translation: 是的，我怕蜘蛛。

english: Oh no! I'm sorry!
translation: 哦不！对不起！

english: I've got to try not to be scary.
translation: 我得尽量别吓人。

english: You should just pretend I'm not a spider! Like, maybe I'm an eight-legged mouse!
translation: 你就假装我不是蜘蛛！比如，也许我是八腿老鼠！

english: Hello, I'm an eight legged mouse! Squeak squeak squeak, I like cheese, cats are bad, I'm definitely not a spider.
translation: 你好，我是八腿老鼠！吱吱吱，我喜欢乳酪，猫很坏，我绝对不是蜘蛛。

english: Is that better?
translation: 那样好些吗？

english: You still look like a spider.
translation: 你看起来还是像蜘蛛。

english: A spider? Oh no! I'm scared of spiders!
translation: 蜘蛛？哦不！我怕蜘蛛！

english: That's much better.
translation: 那好多了。

english: Yay! I'll be an eight-legged mouse forever until I forget.
translation: 耶！我会永远是八腿老鼠直到我忘记。

english: You know what? It's great being a spider.
translation: 你知道吗？当蜘蛛挺好的。

english: No, I'm not scared of spiders.
translation: 不，我不怕蜘蛛。

english: Not even a bit?
translation: 一点都不怕？

english: I bet I can make you scared of spiders!
translation: 我打赌我能让你怕蜘蛛！

english: Boo! Raaar! I'm a scary spider!
translation: 嘘！啊！我是可怕的蜘蛛！

english: Next time you go to sleep I'm going to crawl on your face and EAT YOUR EYEBALLS!
translation: 下次你睡觉我要爬到你脸上吃掉你的眼珠！

english: I'm still not scared.
translation: 我还是不怕。

english: Oh, wow! Even I was scared of me when I said that!
translation: 哦，哇！连我自己说的时候都怕了！

english: You're so brave! I bet you're not scared of anything!
translation: 你真勇敢！我打赌你什么都不怕！

english: That was a bit scary.
translation: 那有点可怕。

english: Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha! I made you scared of me! I made you scared of me!
translation: 哈哈哈哈哈哈！我让你怕我了！我让你怕我了！

english: It's okay, I'm not really going to eat your eyeballs. Spiders don't do that.
translation: 没事，我真不会吃你的眼珠。蜘蛛不那样做。

english: Well...I don't think they do.
translation: 嗯……我想它们不那样。

english: I'm going to learn how to fly! I'm going to be a flying spider!
translation: 我要学飞！我要成为飞蜘蛛！

english: How are you going to fly?
translation: 你怎么飞？

english: I'm going to spin webs between my legs to make wings! Then I can fly!
translation: 我要在腿间织网做翅膀！然后我就能飞！

english: Let's try it now!
translation: 现在试试！

english: Um...okay! I'll spin the webs...and then you throw me in the air.
translation: 嗯……好的！我来织网……然后你把我扔空中。

english: Okay. Three...
translation: 好的。三……

english: Two...
One...
Wait! I'm not ready!
translation: 等等！我没准备好！

english: I don't think I've got the webs right. I'm not ready yet. We'll do it another time.
translation: 我想网没织对。我还没准备好。下次吧。

english: Sounds dangerous.
translation: 听起来危险。

english: It's not dangerous! What's the worst that could happen?
translation: 不危险！最坏能怎样？

english: The worst that can happen is, like, the wings fail and I fall to my death.
translation: 最坏就是翅膀失效，我摔死。

english: Or I get eaten by a bird.
translation: 或者被鸟吃掉。

english: I'm going to rethink this.
translation: 我要重新考虑。

english: Spiders can't fly!
translation: 蜘蛛不会飞！

english: Some spiders can fly! They use web strands to float in the air!
translation: 有些蜘蛛会飞！它们用蛛丝飘在空中！

english: I think I know more about spiders than you, seeing how I am one!
translation: 我想我比你更了解蜘蛛，毕竟我就是！

english: I'm sorry, Eek.
translation: 对不起，伊克。

english: That's okay.
translation: 没事。

english: I don't want to fly now. I'm not in the mood.
translation: 我现在不想飞。没心情。

english: I don't believe you.
translation: 我不信你。

english: I don't care. I'm not talking to you any more.
translation: 我不在乎。我不跟你说话了。

english: Hey...there are so many humans in your world.
translation: 嘿……你们世界人类真多。

english: Back in my old web there are only spiders.
translation: 在我的旧网里只有蜘蛛。

english: Suppose I was bitten by a magically-irradiated man?
translation: 假设我被魔法辐射的人咬了？

english: I might become the Man-Spider! I'd gain all the powers of a man! Like um...
translation: 我可能变成蜘蛛侠！我会获得人类的所有力量！比如嗯……

english: Um...what can humans do that's special?
translation: 嗯……人类有什么特别的？

english: Walk on two legs.
translation: 两条腿走路。

english: Walk on two legs! Yes! Then I could use my other six legs to FIGHT CRIME!
translation: 两条腿走路！是的！那我可以用其他六条腿打击犯罪！

english: Use tools.
translation: 使用工具。

english: Yes! I could have all sorts of gadgets! Like a gadget that spins webs!
translation: 是的！我可以有各种小工具！比如织网工具！

english: Wait...I can already spin webs.
translation: 等等……我已经会织网了。

english: Never mind!
translation: 算了！

english: Project heat-rays from our eyes.
translation: 从眼睛发射热射线。

english: Oh! I didn't know humans could do that!
translation: 哦！我不知道人类能那样！

english: Please don't fry me with your heat rays!
translation: 别用热线烤我！

english: I'm too young to fry!
translation: 我还小不能被烤！

english: Nothing, really. Humans are pretty ordinary.
translation: 没什么，真的。人类挺普通的。

english: Aww, don't say that. Everyone is special!
translation: 哎呀，别那样说。每个人都是特别的！

english: That's right. I'm awesome!
translation: 没错。我很棒！

english: Yes!
translation: 是的！

english: No. It's too dangerous.
translation: 不。太危险了。

english: I'm not a great hero. I'm just an ordinary person.
translation: 我不是大英雄。我只是普通人。

english: Yes, I'm trying to advance myself.
translation: 是的，我在努力提升自己。

english: I don't know. I'm not very ambitious.
translation: 我不知道。我不太有野心。

english: Actually, I've only got two legs.
translation: 其实，我只有两条腿。

english: No one stole my legs.
translation: 没人偷我的腿。

english: They're probably long gone by now.
translation: 它们现在可能早走了。

english: Oh, it's not so bad.
translation: 哦，没那么糟。

english: There is no leg-extending machine.
translation: 没有伸腿机器。

english: You can't use it. It's broken.
translation: 你用不了。它坏了。

english: Yes, I'm scared of spiders.
translation: 是的，我怕蜘蛛。

english: You still look like a spider.
translation: 你看起来还是像蜘蛛。

english: That's much better.
translation: 那好多了。

english: No, I'm not scared of spiders.
translation: 不，我不怕蜘蛛。

english: I'm still not scared.
translation: 我还是不怕。

english: That was a bit scary.
translation: 那有点可怕。

english: How are you going to fly?
translation: 你怎么飞？

english: Let's try it now!
translation: 现在试试！

english: Sounds dangerous.
translation: 听起来危险。

english: Spiders can't fly!
translation: 蜘蛛不会飞！

english: I'm sorry, Eek.
translation: 对不起，伊克。

english: I don't believe you.
translation: 我不信你。

english: Walk on two legs.
translation: 两条腿走路。

english: Use tools.
translation: 使用工具。

english: Project heat-rays from our eyes.
translation: 从眼睛发射热射线。

english: Nothing, really. Humans are pretty ordinary.
translation: 没什么，真的。人类挺普通的。

english: Welcome to my store. Are you in search of any runes?
translation: 欢迎来到我的商店。你在找符石吗？

english: Can I see your wares?
translation: 我能看看你的货吗？

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Come back any time. I've always got something for anybody.
translation: 随时回来。我总有适合每个人的东西。

english: Can I see your wares?
translation: 我能看看你的货吗？

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Hi. Interesting building you have here.
translation: 嗨。你这建筑挺有意思。

english: What's it for?
translation: 它是干嘛的？

english: You like it? It's simply fabulous, isn't it? A real marvel of modern design made just for my fellow alchemists and I!
translation: 你喜欢吗？简直太棒了，对吧？专为我和其他炼金术士设计的现代设计奇迹！

english: I see some builders over there. So I assume it's not yet finished.
translation: 我看到那边有些建筑工人。所以我猜还没完工。

english: What a keen eye this chap has! But imagine this: a gargantuan cylinder of expert design, incorporating an inventive inner spiral walkway to multiple planes of wondrous inhabitance!
translation: 这家伙眼光真尖！但想象一下：一个巨大无比的圆柱体，设计专业，内部有创新的螺旋走道，通向多个奇妙的居住平面！

english: So, it's a tower.
translation: 所以，它是座塔。

english: Oh, no, no, no, no.
translation: 哦，不，不，不，不。

english: It's going to have a use that will change this world!
translation: 它将用来改变这个世界！

english: Or at least it would if we could ever get it finished.
translation: 或者至少如果能完工的话。

english: See those builders?
translation: 看到那些工人了吗？

english: They don't seem to be building much.
translation: 他们好像没怎么干活。

english: Exactly.
translation: 没错。

english: They've gone on strike for some petty reason about the tower being too weird. I really can't understand those men.
translation: 他们因为塔太奇怪这种琐事罢工了。我真不懂那些人。

english: Shame.
translation: 真可惜。

english: Hey! Maybe you could talk to them?
translation: 嘿！也许你能跟他们谈谈？

english: You look like a sturdy chap.
translation: 你看起来挺结实。

english: Maybe you could finish the work?
translation: 也许你能完工？

english: Me?
translation: 我？

english: Come on! This is the chance of a lifetime!
translation: 拜托！这是一生难得的机会！

english: Sure, why not.
translation: 当然，有何不可。

english: That's fantastic! Oh, I'm so pleased.
translation: 太棒了！哦，我太高兴了。

english: Calm down. I'm not making any promises.
translation: 冷静点。我没做任何承诺。

english: Oh, I have a good feeling about this.
translation: 哦，我有种好预感。

english: Right.
translation: 好吧。

english: Go have a word with Bonafido the head builder. See if you can't get him off his backside to do some work. Oh, and I'm Effigy by the way.
translation: 去跟工头博纳菲多谈谈。看看能不能让他动起来干点活。哦，顺便我叫埃菲吉。

english: Nice to meet you Effigy, I'm [player name]. Hold on and I'll see what I can do!
translation: 很高兴认识你埃菲吉，我是 [player name]。等着，我看看能做什么！

english: Wait a minute.
translation: 等一下。

english: Don't I recognise you from somewhere?
translation: 我是不是在哪见过你？

english: Erm, do you?
translation: 呃，是吗？

english: Do you know the outpost north of Ardougne?
translation: 你知道阿多尼城北边的前哨站吗？

english: Ah, yes, it's now a small museum. Jorral's looking after it. He's really making history with that place.
translation: 啊，是的，现在是个小博物馆。乔拉尔在照看。他真是在那里创造历史。

english: Well, the King was going to make that into an alchemy lab for us, but some fool ruined our plans!
translation: 嗯，国王本来要把它改成我们的炼金实验室，但有个傻瓜毁了我们的计划！

english: Ah, yes. Shame. Got to go. Bye.
translation: 啊，是的。可惜。得走了。再见。

english: Hey, wait up!
translation: 嘿，等等！

english: Best I go sort out this tower. Bye.
translation: 我最好去搞定这座塔。再见。

english: Sorry, feeling a bit ill today.
translation: 抱歉，今天有点不舒服。

english: A bit ill?
translation: 有点不舒服？

english: That's a weak excuse for a very feeble personality.
translation: 这借口真烂，就像你那软弱的性格一样。

english: Yes.
translation: 是。

english: No.
translation: 否。

english: You need to get the milk from the cook. He's the one with the white chef's hat, hop to it now!
translation: 你得从厨师那里拿牛奶。就是戴白色厨师帽的那个，快去！

english: Hello, Eggus!
translation: 你好，埃格斯！

english: Why hello there, [player name]!
translation: 哟你好啊，[player name]！

english: Have you seen the Easter Bunny lately?
translation: 最近见过复活节兔子吗？

english: Indeed I have, he's here! Though he's not his usual self. That's why I'm here actually. It would seem that he has strayed from the path of Easter.
translation: 确实见过，他在这儿！不过他状态不对。其实我就是为此而来的。似乎他偏离了复活节之道。

english: That's not good.
translation: 那不太好。

english: No, not good at all. Especially for those of us who walk the golden-yolked path. As soon as I found out, I set out to track him down.
translation: 不，一点都不好。尤其是对我们这些走“金蛋黄之路”的人。我一发现就出发去找他了。

english: That's nice of you. How did you find him?
translation: 你真好。怎么找到他的？

english: Well as luck would have it, I met a pair of hardy hunters who were up to the task. Glanton and Rinder are their names, and what a help they have been!
translation: 运气好，我遇到了一对能干的猎人。格拉顿和林德是他们的名字，帮了大忙！

english: Very capable, though they've yet to tell me what it is they usually hunt.
translation: 很能干，虽然还没告诉我他们通常猎什么。

english: Hopefully not rabbits!
translation: 希望不是兔子！

english: Don't even think it! They have been nothing but utmost gentlemen. We've been trying to cheer up that poor bunny together.
translation: 别想！他们一直是十足的绅士。我们一起努力让那只可怜的兔子开心。

english: How has that been going?
translation: 进展如何？

english: Not well. I've tried everything I can think of! Reading our holy Easter books to him, reciting eggy poetry, nothing has worked.
translation: 不太好。我想到的都试了！给他读圣复活节书，背诵蛋诗，都没用。

english: Is that really everything you can think of?
translation: 那真是你能想到的全部了？

english: I also considered egg juggling, but every time I do that I make a big mess.
translation: 我还想过玩杂耍蛋，但每次我都弄得一团糟。

english: Best leave that to the professionals.
translation: 最好留给专业人士。

english: Indeed.
translation: 确实。

english: He's in the next room if you want to talk to him, hopefully you can improve his mood.
translation: 如果你想跟他说话，他在隔壁房间，希望你能改善他的心情。

english: I hope so too. Talk to you later!
translation: 我也希望。回头聊！

english: What is this place? Seems a bit... unsavoury.
translation: 这是什么地方？好像有点……令人不快。

english: This my friend is the Rabbit Hole. A miserable pit for the most part, though I'm told it was previously much more pleasant.
translation: 我的朋友，这是兔子洞。大部分时间是个可怜的地方，不过听说以前愉快多了。

english: A home to all Easter-adjacent beings and their friends! Great feasts, parties, and performances were held here.
translation: 所有复活节相关生物及其朋友的家！这里曾举办盛大的宴会、派对和表演。

english: All to celebrate Easter! You see, most people would tire of Easter-based activities after a while. But not the denizens of the Rabbit hole.
translation: 都是为了庆祝复活节！你看，大多数人过会儿就厌倦复活节活动了。但兔子洞的居民不会。

english: Interesting, so if you felt a particularly eggy urge, you could come here and let loose?
translation: 有趣，所以如果你感到特别“蛋”动的冲动，可以来这里放纵？

english: Precisely! Though now those days are gone, and what Easter joy was once present has all but run out.
translation: 正是！不过那些日子过去了，曾经的复活节欢乐几乎耗尽。

english: Only a few devoted stragglers remain. Though what exactly they are devoted to is up for debate.
translation: 只剩下几个忠诚的留守者。不过他们到底忠诚于什么还有待争论。

english: Certainly not eggs.
translation: 肯定不是蛋。

english: That's a shame.
translation: 真可惜。

english: It is a great shame. Still, there is hope!
translation: 确实可惜。不过，还有希望！

english: I agree. I'll have a look around and see what's going on, perhaps I can help restore some egg-nergy.
translation: 我同意。我四处看看怎么回事，也许我能帮忙恢复些“蛋”力。

english: Oh you! I hope so, let me know if I can help!
translation: 哦你！希望如此，需要帮忙告诉我！

english: Where are all the other egg priests?
translation: 其他蛋祭司在哪？

english: A fine question!
translation: 好问题！

english: They're all very busy scribbling scrolls, rebinding books, replacing plaques, and fiddling with frescoes.
translation: 他们都忙着写卷轴、重装书籍、更换牌匾、修补壁画。

english: Once we were informed that our beloved 'Ayaster' was actually 'Easter', it became clear that we had a lot of corrections to sort out.
translation: 一旦我们得知 beloved 'Ayaster' 其实是 'Easter'，显然我们有很多修正要做。

english: So they're all making important changes, and there's quite a number to get through!
translation: 所以他们都在做重要改动，而且数量不少！

english: Wow, I don't envy them.
translation: 哇，我不羡慕他们。

english: Nor do I! Thank goodness the Easter Bunny is so upset, it's handy excuse to be elsewhere.
translation: 我也不！谢天谢地复活节兔子这么难过，这是个去别处的好借口。

english: ...That sounded horrible, I didn't mean it like that.
translation: ……那听起来很糟，我不是那个意思。

english: I should hope not.
translation: 希望不是。

english: Actually, nevermind.
translation: 其实，算了。

english: I need some help cheering up the Easter Bunny, what is your favourite part of Easter?
translation: 我需要帮忙让复活节兔子开心，你最喜欢复活节的哪部分？

english: I couldn't possibly choose!
translation: 我选不出来！

english: Oh fantastic! That's not useful at all! What if you HAD to choose? To help the Easter Bunny?
translation: 哦太棒了！一点用没有！如果你必须选呢？为了帮复活节兔子？

english: Well if I had to choose for his sake, I suppose it would be the Easter Buns.
translation: 嗯如果为了他必须选，我想是复活节小面包。

english: Easter Buns, eh?
translation: 复活节小面包，嗯？

english: Ohhhh yes, you know, Easter Buns! Delicious, sticky, spicy, Easter Buns!
translation: 哦是的，你知道，复活节小面包！美味、粘稠、辛辣，复活节小面包！

english: They're really that good?
translation: 真的那么好？

english: Oh my, you've.... you've really never had one?
translation: 哦天，你……你真没吃过？

english: We'll have to change that!
translation: 那得改改！

english: I have the recipe right here. I implore you to make some and try them. I don't have any ingredients with me but I'm sure you could ask around in here.
translation: 我这里有配方。我恳求你做一些试试。我没带材料，但肯定能在这里问问。

english: If anything is going to make the Easter Bunny happy, it's these Easter Buns.
translation: 如果有什么能让复活节兔子开心，就是这些复活节小面包。

english: Okay, I'll give it a go!
translation: 好的，我试试！

english: Please bring me one too! Heeheehee!
translation: 也给我带一个！嘿嘿嘿！

english: Have you read that recipe yet?
translation: 你读配方了吗？

english: Not yet, I lost it.
translation: 还没，我弄丢了。

english: You look burdened enough as it is, come back when you have room for it!
translation: 你看起来已经够忙了，有空位再来！

english: Oh really? Let me jot it down for you again quickly...
translation: 哦真的？让我再快速给你记下来……

english: Here you go!
translation: 给你！

english: Not yet, I'm waiting for the opportune moment!
translation: 还没，我在等合适时机！

english: Well don't wait too long, I want some Easter Buns!
translation: 别等太久，我想要复活节小面包！

english: YOU want some Easter Buns?
translation: 你想要复活节小面包？

english: To uh... Give to the Easter Bunny!
translation: 给……给复活节兔子！

english: Right...
translation: 好吧……

english: I need another copy of that recipe.
translation: 我需要另一份配方副本。

english: I need some yeastier dough to make the Easter Buns, do you have any?
translation: 我需要些更发酵的面团做复活节小面包，你有吗？

english: Do I look like a baker to you? I'm afraid I don't carry raw dough around with me. Maybe ask in the kitchen?
translation: 我看起来像面包师吗？恐怕我不随身带生面团。也许去厨房问问？

english: The kitchen eh? Good idea.
translation: 厨房嗯？好主意。

english: One thing I can tell you, about Eastery dough...
translation: 我能告诉你一件事，关于复活节面团……

english: Yeastier dough?
translation: 更发酵的面团？

english: Yes that's what I said, yeastery dough! What I can tell you about yeasteryear dough is that it is very yeasty!
translation: 是的我就是说那个，发酵面团！我能告诉你的是它非常发酵！

english: Oh really? Wow! Thanks for the education, Eggus.
translation: 哦真的？哇！谢谢教导，埃格斯。

english: It is my duty to teach those less knowledgeable than myself.
translation: 教导知识不如我的人是我的职责。

english: I'll see you later.
translation: 回头见。

english: The recipe says I need a special egg. Do you have any special eggs?
translation: 配方说需要特殊蛋。你有特殊蛋吗？

english: Well I do have some special eggs, but they're my personal supply I'm afraid. I couldn't possibly give them away.
translation: 嗯我确实有些特殊蛋，但那是我的个人储备。不能送人。

english: Of course. Where else could I get one then?
translation: 当然。那我从哪儿能得到？

english: Perhaps you should ask a chicken?
translation: 也许你该问问鸡？

english: No, really, there's one around here somewhere!
translation: 不，真的，附近某处有一只！

english: I do recall seeing a chicken in here actually.
translation: 我确实记得在这里见过一只鸡。

english: Well there you go! Eggs-a-plenty!
translation: 那就对了！蛋多的是！

english: And remember child, all eggs are special.
translation: 记住孩子，所有蛋都是特殊的。

english: I'll keep that in mind.
translation: 我会记住的。

english: Do you know where I might find Easter spices?
translation: 你知道我在哪能找到复活节香料吗？

english: Oh, yes I do. The lass behind the bar, what's her name, Rider? Winkle? Erm... In any case ask her, she puts it in drinks to give them a kick!
translation: 哦，知道。吧台后的女孩，叫什么，莱德？温克尔？呃……总之问问她，她把它放饮料里提味！

english: Okay, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: I need raisins. I also need to know what raisins are. What and where are raisins?
translation: 我需要葡萄干。也需要知道葡萄干是什么。葡萄干是什么在哪？

english: Raisins! Little tasty morsels! Rich and sweet and goopy! Not as good as eggs though, no no no. You should get some eggs!
translation: 葡萄干！美味小颗粒！丰富甜美粘稠！不过不如蛋，不不不。你应该弄些蛋！

english: But I need raisins...
translation: 但我需要葡萄干……

english: Hmmm, that Glanton fellow mentioned raisins, or was it racing? Something about hydration in any case. Yes, ask him about your eggs. My eggs are off limits.
translation: 嗯，那个格拉顿提到葡萄干，还是赛跑？反正关于补水。是的，问他关于你的蛋。我的蛋禁止触碰。

english: I need raisins!!!
translation: 我需要葡萄干！！！

english: Oh my child, you think you need raisins, but you need only embrace the runny yolk of a fine egg to be happy!
translation: 哦我的孩子，你以为需要葡萄干，但其实只需拥抱优质蛋的流心蛋黄就能快乐！

english: Urgh... Bye.
translation: 呃……再见。

english: Easter Buns! Eggy funs! Tasty wasty winky wuns! Oh bunny good and nunny noo..
translation: 复活节小面包！蛋趣！美味的小面包！哦，兔子真好吃，兔子真不……

english: Oh hello! I didn't see you there. Off in my own little world I was. How go the buns?
translation: 哦你好！没看到你。我沉浸在自己的小世界里。小面包怎么样？

english: I've made them, I just need to cook them.
translation: 我做好了，只需要烤一下。

english: Chop chop then! I can't stop thinking about them.
translation: 快点快点！我停不下来想它们。

english: All in good time.
translation: 适时就好。

english: Do my senses decieve me? Can I smell... Easter Buns?!
translation: 我的感官欺骗了我吗？我能闻到……复活节小面包？！

english: Indeed you can.
translation: 确实能。

english: Wonderful! Have you tried one yet?
translation: 太好了！你尝过了吗？

english: I have! They are fantastic. Great recipe.
translation: 尝了！太棒了。配方很好。

english: Why, thank you [player name]! How kind!
translation: 哎呀，谢谢你 [player name]！真客气！

english: Not yet.
translation: 还没。

english: How could you resist such a wonder?
translation: 你怎么能抗拒这样的奇迹？

english: I'm not very hungry I suppose.
translation: 我想我不太饿。

english: Let's not delay any longer, get one of these to the Easter Bunny pronto!
translation: 别耽搁了，快拿一个给复活节兔子！

english: And I would love one too, of course.
translation: 当然，我也想要一个。

english: Naturally, here you are.
translation: 当然可以。

english: Oh, I'm going to enjoy this!
translation: 哦，我要享受这个了！

english: Simply wonderful! These buns have the Eggus Manus seal of approval.
translation: 简直太棒了！这些小面包有埃格斯手册认证印章。

english: Good! I'll take one to the Easter Bunny now.
translation: 好！我现在拿一个给复活节兔子。

english: Hello again, Eggus.
translation: 又见面了，埃格斯。

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: The Easter Bunny seems happier.
translation: 复活节兔子看起来更开心了。

english: Indeed he does! Wonderful, isn't it?
translation: 确实！太好了，对吧？

english: It is, I think we've nearly got him back on track.
translation: 是的，我想我们快让他回到正轨了。

english: The rehearsal didn't go very well.
translation: 排练不太顺利。

english: No it did not. That Glanton has no respect for musicals.
translation: 确实不顺。那个格拉顿不尊重音乐剧。

english: You didn't read the script beforehand either though, did you?
translation: 不过你也没提前读剧本，对吧？

english: True, true. Though that is because I am familiar with the material.
translation: 确实，确实。不过那是因为我熟悉材料。

english: Is that right?
translation: 是吗？

english: Oh yes! Why I could burst into a rendition of 'Oh, is there not one maiden egg' at a moments notice!
translation: 哦是的！我可以随时爆发演唱“哦，难道没有一个处女蛋”！

english: Go on then.
translation: 那唱吧。

english: I can't right now, there's no ensemble. Plus, I don't have my singing socks on.
translation: 现在不行，没有合奏。而且，我没穿唱歌袜。

english: Well you'd better get them, we've got to perform for the Easter Bunny soon.
translation: 那你最好去弄，我们很快得为复活节兔子表演。

english: Hi, Eggus.
translation: 嗨，埃格斯。

english: Oh hello, [player name]!
translation: 哦你好，[player name]！

english: Good job with the performance, the Easter Bunny loved it.
translation: 表演得好，复活节兔子很喜欢。

english: I was impressed with your dancing, you're a natural!
translation: 你的舞蹈让我印象深刻，你是天生的！

english: I love a good dance. It's great eggs-ercise!
translation: 我喜欢跳舞。这是很好的“蛋”运动！

english: In fact, the show has re-eggnited my love for the stage.
translation: 事实上，这场表演重新“蛋”燃了我对舞台的热爱。

english: That's great, what are you thinking of doing?
translation: 太好了，你打算做什么？

english: Stand-up comedy! I've been writing jokes. Well, a joke.
translation: 单口喜剧！我一直在写笑话。嗯，一个笑话。

english: I think you'll need more than one, Eggus. Still, can I hear it?
translation: 我想你需要不止一个，埃格斯。不过，我能听听吗？

english: Absolutely!
translation: 当然！

english: What's big and small at the same time?
translation: 什么东西同时又大又小？

english: I dread to think.
translation: 我不敢想。

english: A big egg!
translation: 一个大蛋！

english: Ohohohoho!
translation: 哦呵呵呵！

english: I'm glad that you're enjoying yourself.
translation: 很高兴你玩得开心。

english: I'm having a blast! I think I'll try and write another egg joke soon.
translation: 我玩得很开心！我想很快再写个蛋笑话。

english: You crack on, Eggus! Good luck with it all.
translation: 你继续“蛋”定，埃格斯！祝一切顺利。

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

english: Hurrah! you've done it again, [player name]! Ayaster is saved again.
translation: 万岁！你又做到了，[player name]！Ayaster 又得救了。

english: Ayaster you say?
translation: 你说 Ayaster？

english: Oh, I mean Easter of course.
translation: 哦，我当然指的是复活节。

english: Have you seen the Easter Bunny?
translation: 你见过复活节兔子吗？

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: Where are the rest of the egg priests?
translation: 其他蛋祭司在哪？

english: Nevermind.
translation: 算了。

english: Talk about helping the Easter Bunny.
translation: 谈谈帮助复活节兔子。

english: Discuss something else.
translation: 讨论别的。

english: Ask about yeastier dough.
translation: 询问更发酵的面团。

english: Ask about a special egg.
translation: 询问特殊蛋。

english: Ask about Easter spices.
translation: 询问复活节香料。

english: Ask about raisins.
translation: 询问葡萄干。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Good day.
translation: 你好。

english: Good day, Your Royal Highness.
translation: 你好，殿下。

english: Oi!
translation: 喂！

english: Rahr!
translation: 啊！

english: No!
translation: 不！

english: Grr!
translation: 咕噜！

english: Aargh!
translation: 啊！

english: I'm a gonner!
translation: 我完了！

english: It's no use, I'm done for!
translation: 没用了，我完了！

english: Uggh!
translation: 呃！

english: Welcome to the Hefin Inn! What can I getcha?
translation: 欢迎来到海芬旅馆！想要点什么？

english: Just a beer.
translation: 只要啤酒。

english: I can get you a Beer for 2 coins.
translation: 我可以给你啤酒，2金币。

english: Here you go!
translation: 给你！

english: Actually, maybe not.
translation: 其实，也许不要了。

english: I don't have that much on me... Maybe later.
translation: 我身上没那么多钱……也许以后吧。

english: Something a bit fruity.
translation: 有点果味的。

english: I can get you a Cider for 2 coins.
translation: 我可以给你苹果酒，2金币。

english: Something to eat.
translation: 吃点东西。

english: I can get you a Stew for 20 coins.
translation: 我可以给你炖菜，20金币。

english: Some kind of local specialty.
translation: 某种当地特色。

english: I can get you an Elven dawn for 6 coins.
translation: 我可以给你精灵黎明，6金币。

english: Nothing. Maybe later!
translation: 没什么。也许以后！

english: Just a beer.
translation: 只要啤酒。

english: Here you go!
translation: 给你！

english: Actually, maybe not.
translation: 其实，也许不要了。

english: Something a bit fruity.
translation: 有点果味的。

english: Something to eat.
translation: 吃点东西。

english: Some kind of local specialty.
translation: 某种当地特色。

english: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: Hello. Who are you?
translation: 你好。你是谁？

english: Hi there. I'm Ektheme, an expert on the Xerician era.
translation: 我是埃克瑟姆，泽里克西亚时代的专家。

english: Who was Xeric?
translation: 谁是 Xeric？

english: Xeric was a dark mage who ruled Great Kourend for at least ten decades. A time period that is sometimes known as the Age of Strife.
translation: Xeric 是个黑暗法师，统治大库兰德王国至少十个十年。有时被称为纷争时代。

english: At least? Do you not know how long he was in power for?
translation: 至少？你不知道他掌权多久吗？

english: We do have records of course. However, while Xeric was indeed ruler of the kingdom from the 37th to the 47th decades, some believe that he actually ruled for longer.
translation: 我们当然有记录。不过，虽然 Xeric 确实从第37到47个十年是王国统治者，但有人相信他实际统治更久。

english: How come?
translation: 怎么会？

english: It is often speculated that Xeric and his predecessor, King Shayzien VII, were in fact the same person.
translation: 经常推测 Xeric 和他的前任，谢兹恩七世国王，其实是同一个人。

english: How could that be?
translation: 怎么可能？

english: Like Xeric, King Shayzien VII was fascinated with the Dark Altar.
translation: 像 Xeric 一样，谢兹恩七世国王迷恋黑暗祭坛。

english: The King was killed at the Battle of the Concourse during the 37th decade. We have many accounts of this, yet his body was never recovered.
translation: 国王在第37个十年的广场战役中被杀。我们有很多记录，但尸体从未找到。

english: Just days after his death, we have the first recorded mention of Xeric, an incredibly powerful mage who resembled the King.
translation: 他死后几天，我们有了第一次关于 Xeric 的记录，一个酷似国王的强大法师。

english: It is written that Xeric killed the rulers of Kourend's five cities and claimed the kingdom as his own.
translation: 记载说 Xeric 杀了库兰德王国五个城市的统治者，宣称王国归他。

english: So King Shayzien VII was resurrected as Xeric using the Dark Altar?
translation: 所以谢兹恩七世国王用黑暗祭坛复活成 Xeric？

english: It's possible. I am no expert on necromancy but we know the Dark Altar has the power to resurrect beasts. We also know that it can extend life. It's how the people of Arceuus are immortal.
translation: 可能。我不是死灵法术专家，但知道黑暗祭坛能复活野兽。也知道能延寿。阿西乌斯人就是这样不朽的。

english: King Shayzien VII may have found a way to combine these powers.
translation: 谢兹恩七世国王可能找到了结合这些力量的方法。

english: How did Xeric have so much power?
translation: Xeric 怎么有这么多力量？

english: Xeric drew much of his power from the Dark Altar, but he asserted his authority as ruler through his personal army of creatures, the lizardmen.
translation: Xeric 从黑暗祭坛汲取力量，但通过个人生物军队蜥蜴人确立统治权威。

english: Xeric created the lizardmen!?
translation: Xeric 创造了蜥蜴人！？

english: Sadly so, though we're not exactly sure how he did so. Xeric used the citizens of Kourend for many experiments, as well as for his own sadistic pleasures.
translation: 令人遗憾的是，我们并不确定怎么做。Xeric 用库兰德市民做实验，也为了自己的施虐乐趣。

english: We have little written record of the experiments, but we believe they might have led to the creation of the lizardmen.
translation: 实验记录很少，但相信可能导致了蜥蜴人的创造。

english: Do you know why he created the lizardmen?
translation: 你知道他为什么创造蜥蜴人吗？

english: Originally, we believed that Xeric created the lizardmen. However, recent discovieressuggest they were actually created during the time of King Shayzien VII.
translation: 最初相信 Xeric 创造了蜥蜴人。但最近发现表明其实是在谢兹恩七世国王时期创造的。

english: Do you know why Xeric needed the lizardmen?
translation: 你知道 Xeric 为什么需要蜥蜴人吗？

english: Xeric was undoubtedly powerful, but he couldn't rule the people singlehandedly, nor could he rely on human informants. He needed an army he could control.
translation: Xeric 无疑强大，但不能单独统治人民，也不能依赖人类线人。他需要能控制的军队。

english: Lizardmen are loyal creatures and would do as he commanded without question. With them at his disposal, the people were powerless to resist his authority.
translation: 蜥蜴人忠诚，会毫不犹豫地执行命令。有了他们，人民无力抵抗他的权威。

english: What happened to the lizardmen after Xeric's reign?
translation: Xeric 统治后蜥蜴人怎么了？

english: They remain loyal to Xeric. Even to this day they continue to attack the kingdom, as you may have seen.
translation: 他们仍忠诚于 Xeric。即使今天仍继续攻击王国，你可能见过。

english: Fortunately, the Shayzien Army keeps them under control.
translation: 幸运地，谢兹恩城卫军控制着他们。

english: Why do they keep fighting? Surely after a thousand years they must know Xeric is gone?
translation: 为什么他们继续战斗？一千年后他们肯定知道 Xeric 没了吧？

english: Without examining their minds, we will never know for sure. However, we assume Xeric genetically altered them to enforce that their duty is to serve him.
translation: 不检查他们的思想，永远无法确定。但假设 Xeric 基因改造了他们，强制他们的职责是服务他。

english: But if they are serving Xeric, why do they attack the kingdom?
translation: 但如果他们服务 Xeric，为什么攻击王国？

english: A good question. One that I'm afraid I do not know the answer to.
translation: 好问题。恐怕我不知道答案。

english: Is there anything else you would like to know?
translation: 还有什么想知道的吗？

english: What happened to Xeric?
translation: Xeric 怎么了？

english: During the 47th decade, after ten decades of oppression, the people revolted against Xeric and his army of lizardmen.
translation: 在第47个十年，经过十个十年压迫，人民反抗 Xeric 和他的蜥蜴人军队。

english: Why did the people suffer for so long?
translation: 为什么人民受苦这么久？

english: The events were triggered through the courage of one man, Byrne. He was not a man of particular stature of nobility, though he did proceed to become king.
translation: 事件由一个男人伯恩的勇气触发。他不是特别高贵的人，但后来成了国王。

english: What happened?
translation: 发生了什么事？

english: 'Twas the 312th day of decade 47. Byrne, a farmer by trade, is said to have witnessed a lizardman guard murder a child whilst working his farm.
translation: 那是第47个十年的第312天。伯恩，职业农民，据说目睹蜥蜴人守卫在农场工作时谋杀儿童。

english: Outraged at what he had just seen, Byrne grabbed his pitchfork and sprinted towards the guard.
translation: 对所见愤怒，伯恩抓起干草叉冲向守卫。

english: Blinded by fury, Byrne attacked the guard, slaughtering the lizardman in plain sight of all around.
translation: 被愤怒蒙蔽，伯恩攻击守卫，当众屠杀蜥蜴人。

english: Legend has it Byrne then gave a galvanizing speech, standing over the butchered guard with his bloodied pitchfork held aloft in the air, urging the people to fight back.
translation: 传说伯恩随后发表鼓舞演讲，站在被屠守卫上，高举血叉，敦促人民反击。

english: Do you know what he said?
translation: 你知道他说了什么吗？

english: Sadly no. While we have many witness accounts, they all differ, so we can not verify it at all.
translation: 可惜不是。虽然有很多目击记录，但都不同，无法验证。

english: Ah, so what happened next?
translation: 啊，那接下来发生了什么事？

english: Whatever Byrne said, the people responded. Together, the citizens of Kourend revolted, grabbing whatever they could use as a weapon. They fought the lizardmen.
translation: 无论伯恩说了什么，人民响应了。库兰德市民一起反抗，抓起任何能当武器的东西。他们对抗蜥蜴人。

english: The lizardmen, while strong and powerful, were simply outnumbered. In a matter of days, they had been driven back into the Kebos Lowlands.
translation: 蜥蜴人虽然强壮，但人数却处于劣势。几天内，他们被赶回凯博斯低地。

english: So what happened to Xeric?
translation: 那 Xeric 怎么了？

english: During the battle, the temple surrounding the Dark Altar was destroyed, weakening Xeric's power. We believe he fled to Quidamortem.
translation: 战斗中，黑暗祭坛周围寺庙被毁，削弱 Xeric 力量。相信他逃到了奎达莫特。

english: Some say Xeric was actually killed during the revolt, but we have no record of his remains being discovered.
translation: 有人说 Xeric 其实是在反抗中被杀，但没有发现遗体的记录。

english: So no one knows what really happened to him?
translation: 所以没人知道到底发生了什么事？

english: Xeric was incredibly powerful but we can reasonably assume that he soon perished. Without the power of the Dark Altar, Xeric would have become mortal.
translation: Xeric 无比强大，但我们可以合理假设他很快死了。没有黑暗祭坛力量，Xeric 会变成凡人。

english: Okay, thanks.

english: Sorry, human, but I'm not particularly interested in making conversation with those that I don't trust.

translation: 我可能会。那么，你一直专攻珊瑚吗？

english: No. I used to just focus on farming, but I found coral propagation to be similar in many ways, while also being far more interesting.
translation: 不。我以前只专注农业，但发现珊瑚繁殖很多方面相似，同时更有趣。

english: I'd better get going.

english: It's very rare for a human to set foot on the Little Pearl.
translation: 人类踏上小珍珠很罕见。

english: As are we. You've made a very good impression on us all.
translation: 我们也是。你给我们大家都留下了很好印象。

english: Hey! Itsh you again! Whatshyerfashe!
translation: 嘿！又是你！什么脸！

english: [player name]?
translation: [player name]？

english: Nah nah nah, not them, the other one, whatshyerfashe!

english: [Fremennik name]?
translation: [Fremennik name]？

english: Thatsh what I said diddle I?

english: Um.... okay. I'll leave you to your drinking.
translation: 嗯……好吧。我不打扰你喝酒了。

english: Thanksh pal! You're alright!

english: Here I come!

english: You can't escape me!
translation: 你逃不掉的！

english: Time to feel my strength!

english: Time to feel the strength of ice!

english: I'll crush you now!

english: No more running, face me now!

english: Ready to face my power!

english: Behold the power of ice!

english: Face the force of my fury!
translation: 面对我的怒火之力吧！

english: Let's see how you handle this!
translation: 看看你怎么应付这个！

english: Time to face your doom!
translation: 是时候面对你的末日了！

english: Time to taste my wrath!
translation: 尝尝我的愤怒吧！

english: Can you withstand this power?
translation: 你能承受这股力量吗？

english: Feel the wrath of the ice!
translation: 感受冰霜的怒火吧！

english: Tremble before the strength of ice!
translation: 在冰霜的力量面前颤抖吧！

english: Time to see the power of ice!

english: Time to show you my full strength!

english: The time has come to show you my true power!
translation: 是时候向你展示我真正的力量了！

english: Feel the full strength of my wrath now!

english: Now, there's nothing holding me back!
