english: Be prepare for the true power of ice!
translation: 准备好迎接冰霜的真正力量吧！

english: Shiny stones for shiny folks! Would you like to have a look?
translation: 闪亮的石头给闪亮的人！想看看吗？

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Fair enough. Do come back soon.
translation: 好吧。记得早点回来。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Hey Elena.
translation: 你好，埃琳娜。

english: Hey [player name].
translation: 嘿，[player name]。

english: Not bad. I won't lie though, the stuff you told me about elves and dark lords is all a bit frightening.
translation: 还不错。不过我不撒谎，你告诉我的关于精灵和黑暗领主的事都有点吓人。

english: I know. I'm working on it though, by the time I'm done we'll never have to worry about any of this again.
translation: 我知道。不过我在努力解决，等我完成后，我们就再也不用担心这些了。

english: I hope you're right. Be careful out there, I worry about you.
translation: 希望你是对的。外面小心点，我担心你。

english: I'll be fine Elena, don't you worry.
translation: 我会没事的，埃琳娜，别担心。

english: Well it just so happens that by freak accident, I had hundreds delivered the other day!
translation: 碰巧的是，前几天意外送来了几百个！

english: Elena hands you a large sieve.
translation: 埃琳娜递给你一个大筛子。

english: Thanks again.
translation: 再次感谢。

english: How's it going?
translation: 进展如何？

english: Do you have another sieve? I lost the last one.
translation: 你还有筛子吗？我把上一个弄丢了。

english: See you later.
translation: 回头见。

english: Good day to you.
translation: 你好。

english: Thank you for finding our son, you've done this kingdom a great service.
translation: 谢谢你找到我们的儿子，你为王国立了大功。

english: It's no...
translation: 没什么……

english: I do wonder if his father could have done more though. My brother would have had the entire army out searching.
translation: 我确实在想他父亲能不能做得更多。我兄弟会让整个军队出去搜寻。

english: Your brother...
translation: 你兄弟……

english: My brother is Lord Shiro Shayzien. He commands the Shayzien Army. A luxury my husband doesn't have.
translation: 我兄弟是谢罗‧谢兹恩领主。他统领谢兹恩城卫军。这是我丈夫没有的奢望。

english: So you...
translation: 所以你……

english: Maybe it doesn't always have to be that way. Things may well soon be different. Now be on your way, I have things to do.
translation: 也许未必总是那样。事情很快可能会不同。现在走吧，我有事要做。

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Isn't this wonderful! My son on the throne. I always knew he'd do great things.
translation: 这太棒了！我儿子登上了王位。我一直知道他会成就大事。

english: Shame about his father though, right?
translation: 不过他父亲真可惜，对吧？

english: Oh yes, terrible business. It breaks Artur's heart not to have him around.
translation: 哦是的，可怕的事。阿图尔为此心碎不已。

english: Still, always best to focus on the positives I say.
translation: 不过，我说啊，最好还是关注积极的一面。

english: I guess.
translation: 我想也是。

english: Hello. I...
translation: 你好。我……

english: You're the one helping to find our son.
translation: 你就是帮忙找我们儿子的人。

english: Yes I...
translation: 是的我……

english: It's good that you're hear to help. Artur is a good lad but he does have a habit of biting off more than he can chew.
translation: 你来帮忙真好。阿图尔是个好孩子，但他确实有贪多嚼不烂的习惯。

english: I was wondering if...
translation: 我在想是否……

english: He's meant for greatness you know. He'll be a king one day.
translation: 你知道他注定成就伟大。总有一天他会成为国王。

english: Don't you mean...
translation: 你不是指……

english: Lord. I meant to say lord. Now be on your way. Artur needs your help.
translation: 领主。我是说领主。请吧。阿图尔需要你的帮助。

english: Hi.
translation: 嗨。

english: You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 你知道吗，跟人打招呼的方式可多了。你好、嘿、你好啊……

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: 那仍然只算一种！

english: Hello. How are you today?
translation: 你好。你今天怎么样？

english: I'm great, thank you!
translation: 我很好，谢谢！

english: Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 你好！水晶城今天天气真好，哈？

english: Indeed.
translation: 确实。

english: What can I do for ya?
translation: 我能为你做什么？

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这里有什么可以做的？

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 可做的事可多了！塔楼就是绝妙景致。

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 像今天这样的好日子，我建议去市场逛逛。

english: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你以为你在做什么？

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这里有什么可以做的？

english: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: You! Time for some questions.
translation: 你！是时候问些问题了。

english: Why did you join the Emissaries?
translation: 你为什么加入使者团？

english: I wished to see my god in mortal form and serve his will. In return for my service, the Emissaries promised me they could grant that wish.
translation: 我希望见到我神的凡人形态并侍奉他的意志。作为服务的回报，使者团承诺能实现这个愿望。

english: I wished to see my god in mortal form and be granted eternity in Mictl. In return for my service, the Emissaries promised me they could grant that wish.
translation: 我希望见到我神的凡人形态并在米克特尔获得永恒。作为服务的回报，使者团承诺能实现这个愿望。

english: Who do you worship?
translation: 你崇拜谁？

english: I am a humble servant of Ranul. It has always been my hope to stand before him and be judged as worthy.
translation: 我是拉努尔的卑微仆人。我一直希望能站在他面前被判定为值得。

english: Tell me about the Final Dawn.
translation: 跟我讲讲最终黎明。

english: The Final Dawn is the will of Ranul. He will show us all that death is nothing to be feared as he and Ralos guide us into forming a new world.
translation: 最终黎明是拉努尔的意志。他将向我们展示死亡没什么可怕的，他和拉洛斯会引导我们形成一个新世界。

english: The Final Dawn is the will of Ranul. He will show us all that death is nothing to be feared. He and Ralos will lead us into forming a new world before then guiding us to Mictl.
translation: 最终黎明是拉努尔的意志。他将向我们展示死亡没什么可怕的。他和拉洛斯会引导我们形成一个新世界，然后引导我们去米克特尔。

english: Why did you join the Emissaries?
translation: 你为什么加入使者团？

english: Who do you worship?
translation: 你崇拜谁？

english: Tell me about the Final Dawn.
translation: 跟我讲讲最终黎明。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: How goes it?
translation: 怎么样？

english: Well thanks.
translation: 挺好的谢谢。

english: Welcome, adventurer. Are you in need of a staff?
translation: 欢迎，冒险者。你需要法杖吗？

english: What do you have?
translation: 你有什么？

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Don't be a stranger. Come on by any time you need anything.
translation: 别客气。需要任何东西随时来。

english: What do you have?
translation: 你有什么？

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Good day to you.
translation: 你好。

english: What brings you here?
translation: 什么风把你吹来？

english: The eternal quest for knowledge, of course! The name's Elias White. I'm something of an explorer.
translation: 当然是对知识的永恒追求！我叫伊莱亚斯‧怀特。算是个探险家吧。

english: Pleased to meet you. I'm [player name]. So you're searching for knowledge in an inn?
translation: 很高兴认识你。我是 [player name]。所以你在旅馆里寻找知识？

english: Not exactly. In fact, I was previously hunting down information on an ancient race deep within the desert.
translation: 不完全是。事实上，我之前一直在追查沙漠深处一个古老种族的信息。

english: However, I received an interesting yet concerning tip- off from a contact of mine regarding some of my research. I came here to investigate for myself.
translation: 不过，我从联系人那里收到了一些关于我研究的有趣但令人担忧的线索。我亲自来这里调查。

english: Oh, hello there. You look familiar. Have we met before?
translation: 哦，你好。你看起来眼熟。我们以前见过吗？

english: I think so. The name's [player name]. You're Elias, right? You had a camp out near Uzer.
translation: 我想是的。我叫 [player name]。你是伊莱亚斯对吧？你在乌泽附近扎过营。

english: Ah, of course. You offered to help with my work, didn't you? I'm still very keen to take you up on that offer at some point, but a more pressing matter has delayed that somewhat.
translation: 啊，当然。你提出过帮我工作，对吧？我仍然很想接受你的提议，但更紧迫的事推迟了。

english: Is that what's brought you here?
translation: 那就是你来这里的原因？

english: Indeed. I recived an interesting yet concerning tip-off from a contact of mine regarding some of my research. I came here to investigate for myself.
translation: 确实。我从联系人那里收到了一些关于我研究的有趣但令人担忧的线索。我亲自来这里调查。

english: Anything I can help with?
translation: 有什么我能帮忙的吗？

english: How kind of you to offer. I'm not in need of any extra help right now though.
translation: 你真好心。不过我现在不需要额外帮助。

english: How kind of you to offer. I definitely wouldn't complain about some extra support, if you're sure you're interested?
translation: 你真好心。如果你确定感兴趣，我肯定不会拒绝额外支持。

english: Absolutely! So what was this tip-off you received?
translation: 当然！那么你收到了什么线索？

english: Actually, I think I'll pass.
translation: 其实，我想算了。

english: Very well. If you change your mind, I'll be here.
translation: 很好。如果你改变主意，我会在这里。

english: Ah, hello there, [player name]. Good to see you.
translation: 啊，你好，[player name]。很高兴见到你。

english: And you, Elias. So you're back out here again?
translation: 你也是，伊莱亚斯。所以你又回到这里了？

english: Indeed. Turns out the desert was the best place to begin my research into Arrav and his heart. Not too surprising of course, given the burial practices here.
translation: 确实。结果沙漠是开始研究阿拉夫及其心脏的最佳地点。当然不太意外，毕竟这里的埋葬习俗如此。

english: In fact, as you might recall, I was here before to look into that old mastaba up on the plateau.
translation: 事实上，你可能记得，我之前来这里调查过高原上的那座古老马斯塔巴墓。

english: Yes, I remember. You said it might contain important information on the Mahjarrat.
translation: 是的，我记得。你说它可能包含关于玛哈加里特的重要信息。

english: Indeed I did. And I reckon it might also contain the knowledge we need to help old Arrav out.
translation: 我确实说过。而且我认为它可能也包含我们帮助老阿拉夫所需的知识。

english: Excellent!
translation: 太好了！

english: Now, I still have quite a bit of preparatory work to do before we consider heading inside, but once that's done, I'll be in touch.
translation: 现在，在考虑进入之前我还有不少准备工作要做，但一旦完成，我会联系你。

english: Sounds good. I'd best leave you to your work.
translation: 听起来不错。我最好不打扰你工作了。

english: Until next time.
translation: 下次见。

english: What brings you all the way out here?
translation: 什么风把你大老远吹来？

english: Are you searching for something here?
translation: 你在这里找什么吗？

english: Of course. As I said, my search is for knowledge.
translation: 当然。如我所说，我寻找的是知识。

english: What kind of knowledge?
translation: 什么样的知识？

english: Information lost to the ages. Specifically, information on an ancient race.
translation: 失传已久的信息。具体来说，关于一个古老种族的信息。

english: And you expect to find something here?
translation: 你指望在这里找到什么？

english: Not quite here, but up on the plateau. There's an old mastaba up there that I believe dates from a time when the race resided in these lands.
translation: 不完全是这里，而是高原上。那里有座古老的马斯塔巴墓，我相信那是该种族居住在这片土地时留下的。

english: Well if you ever need help raiding an ancient tomb, I reckon I can be of service.
translation: 如果你需要帮忙探索古墓，我想我能效劳。

english: A generous offer! I still have quite a bit of preparatory work to do before I dare head inside, but once that's done, maybe we can work something out.
translation: 慷慨的提议！在进入之前我还有不少准备工作要做，但一旦完成，也许我们可以商量。

english: Where do you call home?
translation: 你哪里是家？

english: Ah, I've lived in many places over the years, but I wouldn't really say I have a home. I guess Varrock would be the closest answer.
translation: 啊，多年来我住过很多地方，但我不太说自己有家。我想维洛克是最接近的答案了。

english: Sounds like you have quite the history.
translation: 听起来你很有历史。

english: Oh yes! If nothing else, I've definitely lived a varied life.
translation: 哦是的！至少可以说，我确实过着丰富多彩的生活。

english: So you weren't always an explorer?
translation: 所以你不一直是探险家？

english: Not at all. I've done all sorts of things in my time. In fact, at one point I was an adventurer like you!
translation: 完全不。我做过各种各样的事。事实上，有段时间我和你一样是冒险者！

english: What happened? Some sort of life-changing injury?
translation: 发生了什么事？某种改变人生的受伤？

english: Thankfully not. I just found that when it came to my work, it was the history I discovered that interested me more than the treasure.
translation: 谢天谢地不是。我只是发现，工作中我发现的历史比宝藏更让我感兴趣。

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: Hello again.
translation: 又见面了。

english: Yes.
translation: 是。

english: No.
translation: 否。

english: Are you searching for something here?
translation: 你在这里找什么吗？

english: Where do you call home?
translation: 你哪里是家？

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: Hello. Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: 你好。能给我些种植建议吗？

english: Can't you see I'm busy?
translation: 你没看到我很忙吗？

english: Oh, sorry. I thought you might be able to help me with farming like other gardeners.
translation: 哦，抱歉。我以为你能像其他园丁一样帮我打理种植地。

english: Well, I'm not the type of gardener you think I am. Just leave me alone please.

english: Apparently you aren't as stupid as you look.
translation: 显然你没看起来那么笨。

english: I can't believe we've finally arrived, I can't wait to explore!
translation: 真不敢相信我们终于到了，迫不及待要探索！

english: So much to see, I don't know where to start!
translation: 太多可看，不知从何开始！

english: A whole new continent to explore... what a time to be alive!
translation: 整个新大陆待探索……真是生逢其时！

english: Are you the tour guide?
translation: 你是导游吗？

english: Nope, I'm just as lost as you.
translation: 不，我和你一样迷路。

english: I overheard someone mention there are pirates and thieves here, be careful!
translation: 我偷听到有人说这里有海盗和小偷，小心！

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Hello, welcome to our maze. I'm Elkoy the tree gnome.
translation: 你好，欢迎来到我们的迷宫。我是树精地精埃尔科伊。

english: I haven't heard of your sort.
translation: 我没听说过你们这类。

english: There's not many of us left. Once you could find tree gnomes anywhere in the world, now we hide in small groups to avoid capture.
translation: 我们剩下的不多了。曾经世界各地都能找到树精地精，现在我们以小群躲藏避免被抓。

english: Capture by whom?
translation: 被谁抓？

english: Tree gnomes have been hunted for so called 'fun' since as long as I can remember.
translation: 据我所知，树精地精一直因所谓''乐趣''而被猎杀。

english: Our main threat nowadays are General Khazard's troops. They know no mercy, but are also very dense. They'll never find their way through our maze.
translation: 我们现在的主要威胁是卡扎德将军的部队。他们不知怜悯，但也很迟钝。他们永远找不到穿过我们迷宫的路。

english: Have fun.
translation: 玩得开心。

english: Hello, welcome to our village. I'm Elkoy the tree gnome.
translation: 你好，欢迎来到我们的村庄。我是树精地精埃尔科伊。

english: I haven't heard of your sort before.
translation: 我以前没听说过你们这类。

english: Hello Elkoy.
translation: 你好埃尔科伊。

english: Hi there, I hope life is treating you well. Would you like me to show you the way to the village?
translation: 你好，希望生活待你不薄。想让我带你去村庄吗？

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: The player is placed at the loose railing, the entrance to the Tree Gnome Village.
translation: 玩家被传送至松散栏杆处，即地精村庄入口。

english: Here we are. Feel free to have a look around.
translation: 到了，随意看看吧。

english: No thanks Elkoy.
translation: 不用了，谢谢埃尔科伊。

english: Ok then, take care.
translation: 好吧，保重。

english: Hi there, I hope life is treating you well. Would you like me to show you the way out of the village?
translation: 你好，希望生活待你不薄。想让我带你离开村庄吗？

english: The player is placed at the entrance of the maze.
translation: 玩家被传送至迷宫入口。

english: Here we are. Have a safe journey.
translation: 到了，祝你一路平安。

english: Not now, thanks.
translation: 现在不要，谢谢。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No thanks Elkoy.
translation: 不用了，谢谢埃尔科伊。

english: Not now, thanks.
translation: 现在不要，谢谢。

english: Hi.
translation: 嗨。

english: You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 你知道吗，跟人打招呼的方式可多了。你好、嘿、你好啊……

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: 那仍然只算一种！

english: Hello. How are you today?
translation: 你好。你今天怎么样？

english: I'm great, thank you!
translation: 我很好，谢谢！

english: Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 你好！水晶城今天天气真好，哈？

english: Indeed.
translation: 确实。

english: What can I do for ya?
translation: 我能为你做什么？

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这里有什么可以做的？

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 可做的事可多了！塔楼就是绝妙景致。

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 像今天这样的好日子，我建议去市场逛逛。

english: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你以为你在做什么？

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这里有什么可以做的？

english: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: Hello. Interested in honing your skills?
translation: 你好。有兴趣磨练技能吗？

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Ellen helps you improve your (selected skill) skill.
translation: 艾伦帮你提升你的(选定技能)技能。

english: That's all the training I can give you. I hope you find it useful.
translation: 我能给你的训练就这些。希望对你有用。

english: (Combat Training interface re-opens.)
translation: (战斗训练界面重新打开。)

english: I'll be here if you change your mind.
translation: 如果你改变主意我会在这里。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Hello again. I'm afraid I've given you all the training I can.
translation: 又见面了。恐怕我能给的训练都给了。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Yes.
translation: 是。

english: No.
translation: 否。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Would you look after my crops for me?
translation: 你愿意帮我照看作物吗？

english: You don't have a sapling planted in that patch. Plant one and I might agree to look after it for you.
translation: 那块种植地里没种树苗，你先种点什么，我才可能考虑帮你照管。

english: Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: 能给我些种植建议吗？

english: You can put up to five tomatoes, strawberries, apples, bananas or oranges into a fruit basket, although you can't have a mix in the same basket.
translation: 你可以在水果篮里放最多五个番茄、草莓、苹果、香蕉或橙子，但不能混装。

english: There are seven main Farming areas - Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Kragen's area near Ardougne, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius, Alan's area in the Farming Guild and
translation: 有七个主要种植区——法拉多城附近的埃尔斯坦区，凯瑟比镇附近的丹塔拉区，阿多尼城附近的克拉根区，莫利塔尼亚的莱拉区，霍西迪乌斯城的马里斯区，农业公会的艾伦区，以及

english: Oswallt's area in Prifddinas.
translation: 普里夫迪纳斯城的奥斯瓦尔特区。

english: Supercompost is far better than normal compost, but more expensive to make. You need to rot the right type of item; show me an item, and I'll tell you if it's super- compostable or not.
translation: 超级堆肥比普通堆肥强多了，但做起来也更费事。你得用对东西才能堆出来——拿件物品给我看看，我告诉你它能不能做成超级堆肥。

english: Vegetables, hops and flowers need constant watering - if you ignore my advice, you will sooner or later find yourself in possession of a dead farming patch.
translation: 蔬菜、啤酒花和花朵需要持续浇水——如果无视我的建议，你迟早会发现自己拥有一块荒废的种植地。

english: There is a special patch for growing Belladonna - I believe that it is somewhere near Draynor Manor, where the ground is a tad 'unblessed'.
translation: 颠茄有专门的种植地——我记得是在德雷诺庄园附近，那地方的土嘛，有点''不受祝福''。

english: Hops are good for brewing ales. I believe there's a brewery up in Keldagrim somewhere, and I've heard rumours that a place called Phasmatys used to be good for that type of thing. 'Fore they all died, of course.
translation: 啤酒花适合酿造麦酒。我相信凯尔达格林城某处有个酿酒厂，我还听说一个叫法斯玛提斯的地方以前也酿造这种酒。当然那是在他们都死光之前的事了。

english: Bittercap mushrooms can only be grown in a special patch in Morytania, near the Mort Myre swamp. There the ground is especially dank and suited to growing poisonous fungii.
translation: 苦帽菇只能种在莫利塔尼亚、莫特迈耶沼泽附近的特殊种植地里。那里阴暗潮湿，适合毒蘑菇生长。

english: You can buy all the farming tools from farming shops, which can be found close to the allotments.
translation: 你可以从种植店购买所有种植工具，就在分配地附近。

english: Tree seeds must be grown in a plantpot of soil into a sapling, and then transferred to a tree patch to continue growing to adulthood.
translation: 树木种子得先在装土的花盆里养成树苗，再移栽到树木种植地，才能继续长成大树。

english: The only way to cure a bush or tree of disease is to prune away the diseased leaves with a pair of secateurs. For all other crops I would just apply some plant-cure.
translation: 治愈灌木或树木疾病的唯一方法是用修枝剪剪掉病叶。其他作物我只需用些植物治愈剂。

english: You can fill plantpots with soil from any empty patch, if you have a gardening trowel.
translation: 如果你有园艺铲，可以用任何空地的土壤填满花盆。

english: If you need to be rid of your fruit trees for any reason, all you have to do is chop them down and then dig up the stump.
translation: 如果因任何原因需要除掉果树，只需砍倒然后挖掉树桩。

english: Don't just throw away your weeds after you've raked a patch - put them in a compost bin and make some compost.
translation: 耙完种植地后别直接扔掉杂草——放进堆肥箱制作堆肥。

english: Applying compost to a patch will not only reduce the chance that your crops will get diseased, but you will also grow more crops to harvest.
translation: 给种植地施堆肥不仅能降低作物生病几率，还能让你收获更多作物。

english: If you want to make your own sacks and baskets you'll need to use the loom that's near the Farming shop in Falador. If you're a good enough craftsman, that is.
translation: 如果想自己做袋子和篮子，你需要用法拉多城种植店附近的织布机。如果你是个足够好的工匠。

english: You don't have to buy all your plantpots you know, you can make them yourself on a pottery wheel. If you're a good enough craftsman, that is.
translation: 花盆不用全买，手艺够的话能在陶轮上自己做。如果你是个足够好的工匠。

english: You can put up to ten potatoes, cabbages or onions in vegetable sacks, although you can't have a mix in the same sack.
translation: 蔬菜袋里最多能装十个土豆、卷心菜或者洋葱，不过一袋里可不能混着装。

english: Can you sell me something?
translation: 能卖我点什么吗？

english: That depends on whether I have it to sell. What is it that you're looking for?
translation: 那取决于我是否有货可卖。你在找什么？

english: I'll come back another time.
translation: 我改天再来。

english: You're not done yet! Do this for me!
translation: 你还没做完！帮我做这个！

english: My produce can do puzzles better than that!
translation: 我的农产品解谜比那强！

english: Excellent work!
translation: 干得好！

english: Would you look after my crops for me?
translation: 你愿意帮我照看作物吗？

english: Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: 能给我些种植建议吗？

english: Can you sell me something?
translation: 能卖我点什么吗？

english: I'll come back another time.
translation: 我改天再来。

english: Hey, how can I help you?
translation: 嘿，怎么帮你？

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: This is one of the branches for Mahogany Homes, Gielinor's first construction company.
translation: 这是桃花心木家园的分支之一，基利诺尔第一家建筑公司。

english: Oh wow, how can I get involved?
translation: 哦哇，我怎么参与？

english: If you go see Amy in the Falador branch, she'll fill you in. Her office is just east of the Estate Agent in Falador.
translation: 如果你去法拉多城分支找艾米，她会告诉你详情。她的办公室就在法拉多城地产经纪东边。

english: Nice, thank you.
translation: 不错，谢谢。

english: Greetings friend. I am a manufacturer of leather.
translation: 你好，朋友。我是皮革制造商。

english: Can I buy some leather then?
translation: 那我能买些皮革吗？

english: I make leather from animal hides. Bring me some cowhides and one gold coin per hide, and I'll tan them into soft leather for you.
translation: 我用动物皮制作皮革。给我些牛皮，每张皮一枚金币，我会为你鞣制成软皮。

english: Leather is rather weak stuff.
translation: 皮革挺脆弱的。

english: Normal leather may be quite weak, but it's very cheap - I make it from cowhides for only 1 gp per hide - and it's so easy to craft that anyone can work with it.
translation: 普通皮革可能挺脆弱，但很便宜——我用牛皮制作，每张皮只要1金币——而且很容易制作，任何人都能加工。

english: Alternatively you could try hard leather. It's not so easy to craft, but I only charge 3 gp per cowhide to prepare it, and it makes much sturdier armour.
translation: 或者你可以试试硬皮。制作不太容易，但我每张牛皮只收3金币加工费，它能制作更坚固的护甲。

english: I can also tan snake hides and dragonhides, suitable for crafting into the highest quality armour for rangers.
translation: 我还能鞣制蛇皮和龙皮，适合制作游侠最高品质护甲。

english: Thanks, I'll bear it in mind.
translation: 谢谢，我会记住的。

english: I see you have brought me a hide. Would you like me to tan it for you?
translation: 我看你带了张皮。想让我为你鞣制吗？

english: I see you have brought me some hides. Would you like me to tan them for you?
translation: 我看你带了些皮。想让我为你鞣制吗？

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Very well, [sir/madam], as you wish.
translation: 很好，[sir/madam]，如你所愿。

english: Er... Thanks, but no thanks!
translation: 呃……谢谢，但不必了！

english: Can I buy some leather then?
translation: 那我能买些皮革吗？

english: Leather is rather weak stuff.
translation: 皮革挺脆弱的。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: I'm sorry to bother you, but could you spare me a little dung?
translation: 抱歉打扰，能分我点粪便吗？

english: The camel didn't seem to appreciate that question.
translation: 骆驼似乎不欣赏这个问题。

english: If I go near that camel, it'll probably bite my hand off.
translation: 如果我靠近那只骆驼，它可能会咬掉我的手。

english: Mmm... looks like that camel would make a nice kebab.
translation: 嗯……看起来那只骆驼能做不错的烤肉串。

english: I wonder if that camel has fleas...
translation: 不知道那只骆驼有没有跳蚤……

english: Are you serious?
translation: 你是认真的？

english: Oh yes. If you'd be so kind...
translation: 哦是的。如果你好心……

english: The camel ponders for a moment...
translation: 骆驼思考了片刻……

english: I'm sorry, but I can't really help you right now. Perhaps you should ask me again later, or try a different camel.
translation: 抱歉，我现在真帮不了你。也许你稍后再问我，或试试别的骆驼。

english: Fair enough.
translation: 好吧。

english: Well, just you close your eyes first. I'm not doing it while you're watching me!
translation: 嗯，你先闭上眼睛。我可不想你看着我做！

english: I hope that's what you wanted!
translation: 希望那是你想要的！

english: Ohhh yes. Lovely.
translation: 哦是的。真可爱。

english: Did you say something?
translation: 你说了什么吗？

english: No, er, nothing important.
translation: 没，呃，没什么重要的。

english: Well, it's nice to have someone to talk to.
translation: 嗯，有人说话真好。

english: Ollie is so remote, and I can't get up the courage to talk to him...
translation: 奥利太冷漠了，我没勇气跟他说话……

english: Who's Ollie?
translation: 谁是奥利？

english: He's the camel wandering around near that glider.
translation: 他是那只滑翔机附近游荡的骆驼。

english: Isn't he so strong-looking and handsome?
translation: 他看起来不强壮英俊吗？

english: Er... he just looks like any other camel to me.
translation: 呃……在我看来他跟其他骆驼一样。

english: How can you not see how wonderful he is?
translation: 你怎么看不出他多棒？

english: Why, he can cross the Kharidian Desert in three bounds, and he's so strong that he could haul the brick for the Emir's Arena in only a day!
translation: 为什么，他能三跳穿过卡里迪安沙漠，而且他很强壮，一天就能拖运埃米尔竞技场的砖！

english: You're a camel, I'm not. Maybe you can see these things better.
translation: 你是骆驼，我不是。也许你能更好地看出这些。

english: For someone who understands camel speech, you're not good at these things.
translation: 对于懂骆驼语的人，你不太擅长这些事。

english: Ask the camel about its dung.
translation: 问骆驼关于它的粪便。

english: Say something unpleasant.
translation: 说些不愉快的话。

english: Neither - I'm a polite person.
translation: 都不是——我是个有礼貌的人。

english: Can I help you today?
translation: 今天能帮你吗？

english: Can I go for a ride?
translation: 我能坐矿车吗？

english: Minecart rides are 20 coins.
translation: 乘坐矿车要20金币。

english: Of course.
translation: 当然。

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

english: As a loyal customer of the Lovakengj Minecart Network, you're entitled to this.
translation: 身为洛瓦肯吉矿车网络的忠实客户，你自然享有这项权益。

english: Now, can I help you today?
translation: 现在，今天能帮你吗？

english: You're already here, human.
translation: 你已经在这里了，人类。

english: Can I go for a ride?
translation: 我能坐矿车吗？

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

english: What's a gnome doing here?
translation: 地精在这里做什么？

english: I'm an investigator. I'm watching the implings.
translation: 我是调查员。我在监视小精灵。

english: Why would you want to do that?
translation: 你为什么想那样做？

english: My client has asked me to find out where certain missing items have been going.
translation: 我的客户让我找出某些丢失物品的去向。

english: Who is this client?
translation: 客户是谁？

english: I'm not at liberty to discuss that. Investigator-client confidentiality don't you know.
translation: 我不便讨论。调查员与客户之间的保密协议，你懂的。

english: Where is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: The fairies call it Puro-Puro. It seems to be the home plane of the implings.
translation: 仙女叫它普鲁普鲁。似乎是小精灵的家园位面。

english: I don't think these creatures have a name for it. As you can see there isn't a lot else here other than wheat.
translation: 我想这些生物没名字。如你所见，除了小麦这里没什么。

english: How did you get here?
translation: 你怎么来的？

english: The same way you did, I suspect. Through a portal in a wheat field. I followed one back.
translation: 我想跟你一样。通过麦田里的传送门。我跟了一个回来。

english: I haven't noticed them do that.
translation: 我没注意到它们那样做。

english: That's why I'm the investigator and you're the adventurer.
translation: 所以我是调查员，你是冒险者。

english: So, what are these implings?
translation: 那么，这些小精灵是什么？

english: That's a very interesting question. My best guess is that they are relatives to imps, which is why there are imps here as well.
translation: 这是个很有趣的问题。我最好的猜测是它们是小恶魔的亲戚，所以这里也有小恶魔。

english: Implings do appear to like collecting objects and, as my clients have noted, have no concept of ownership. However, I do not sense any malicious intent.
translation: 小精灵似乎喜欢收集物品，正如我的客户指出的，它们没有所有权概念。不过，我没感觉到任何恶意。

english: It is my observation that they collect things that other creatures want, rather than they want them themselves. It seems to provide them with sustenance.
translation: 据我观察，它们收集其他生物想要的东西，而不是它们自己想要。似乎为它们提供养分。

english: So they feed off our desire for things?
translation: 所以它们以我们对物品的欲望为食？

english: Possibly. Either way, it seems that they almost exclusively collect things that people want, except their younglings who I infer haven't learnt the best things to collect yet.
translation: 可能。无论如何，似乎它们几乎只收集人们想要的东西，除了幼崽，我推断它们还没学会收集最好的东西。

english: So the more experienced implings have the more desirable items?
translation: 所以经验越丰富的小精灵有更理想的物品？

english: That is my observation. Yes.
translation: 那是我的观察。是的。

english: Can I catch these implings, then?
translation: 那我能抓这些小精灵吗？

english: Indeed you may. In fact I encourage it. You will, however, require some equipment.
translation: 确实可以。事实上我鼓励你这样做。不过，你需要些装备。

english: Firstly you will need a butterfly net in which to catch them and at least one special impling jar to store an impling.
translation: 首先你需要捕虫网来捕捉它们，至少一个特殊小精灵罐来存储小精灵。

english: You will also require some experience as a Hunter since these creatures are elusive. The more immature implings require less experience, but some of the rarer implings are extraordinarily hard to find and catch.
translation: 你还需要些猎人经验，因为这些生物难以捉摸。越不成熟的小精灵需要的经验越少，但有些稀有小精灵极难找到和捕捉。

english: Once you have caught one, you may break the jar open and obtain the object the impling is carrying. Alternatively, you may exchange certain combinations of jars with me. I will return the jars to my clients. In
translation: 一旦抓到，你可以打破瓶子获得小精灵携带的物品。或者，你可以跟我交换某些瓶子组合。我会把瓶子还给我的客户。作为

english: exchange I will be able to provide you with some equipment that may help you hunt butterflies more effectively.
translation: 交换，我能提供些帮你更有效捕蝴蝶的装备。

english: Also, beware. Those imps walking around the maze do not like the fact that their kindred spirits are being captured and will attempt to steal any full jars you have on you, setting the implings free.
translation: 另外，小心。那些在迷宫游荡的小恶魔不喜欢同类被抓，会试图偷走你身上的任何满瓶子，释放小精灵。

english: I've heard I may find dragon equipment in Puro-Puro.
translation: 我听说可能在普鲁普鲁找到龙金装备。

english: Have you indeed? Well, that may well be true, though bear in mind that implings are quite small so they are unlikely to be lugging a sizeable shield around with them. However, since it seems that dragon items are
translation: 真的吗？嗯，那可能是真的，不过记住小精灵很小，不太可能拖着大盾牌。不过，既然龙金物品

english: very desirable to humans then it certainly is possible that the most expert implings may try to obtain such equipment.
translation: 对人类很有吸引力，那么最资深的小精灵确实可能尝试获得此类装备。

english: So, it's true then? Cool!
translation: 所以，是真的？酷！

english: I should warn you, though, if the impling is strong enough to collect dragon equipment, then you will have to be very skilled at hunting implings in order to catch them.
translation: 不过我应该警告你，如果小精灵强到能收集龙金装备，那你必须非常擅长猎捕小精灵才能抓到它们。

english: Ah, good day, it's you again. What can I do for you?
translation: 啊，你好，又是你。能帮你什么？

english: Ah, I notice you don't own an impling collector's scroll.
translation: 啊，我注意到你没有小精灵收集者卷轴。

english: Elnock gives you a scroll. If you check it whilst in the maze, you will see how many of each impling you have captured.
translation: 埃尔诺克给你卷轴。如果在迷宫中检查，你会看到每种小精灵抓了多少。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Can you remind me how to catch implings again?
translation: 能再提醒我怎么抓小精灵吗？

english: Certainly.
translation: 当然。

english: You cannot use an ordinary butterfly jar as a container as the implings will escape from them with ease. However, I have done some investigation and have come up with a solution - if a butterfly jar is coated
translation: 不能用普通捕虫瓶当容器，小精灵会轻易逃脱。不过，我做了一些调查，想出了解决方案——如果捕虫瓶涂上

english: with a thin layer of a substance noxious to them they become incapable of escape.
translation: 一层对它们有害的物质，它们就无法逃脱。

english: What substance is that, then?
translation: 那是什么物质？

english: I have tried a few experiments with the help of a friend back home, and it turns out that a combination of anchovy oil and flowers - marigolds, rosemary or nasturtiums - will work.
translation: 我在家乡朋友帮助下做了一些实验，结果是凤尾鱼油和花朵——金盏花、迷迭香或旱金莲——的组合有效。

english: How do you make anchovy oil then?
translation: 那怎么做凤尾鱼油？

english: I'd grind up some cooked anchovies and pass them through a sieve.
translation: 我会磨碎一些煮熟的凤尾鱼，过筛子。

english: Where do I make these jars?
translation: 我在哪制作这些瓶子？

english: Well, I believe there is a chemist in Rimmington that has a small still that you could use.
translation: 嗯，我相信里明顿村有个药剂师有小型蒸馏器可用。

english: Is there anywhere I can buy these jars?
translation: 有地方能买这些瓶子吗？

english: Well I may be able to let you have a few - if it means you will start hunting these implings - although I do not have an infinite supply.
translation: 嗯我也许能给你几个——如果这意味着你开始猎捕这些小精灵——虽然我没有无限供应。

english: Tell me more about these thieving imps.
translation: 跟我讲讲这些偷窃的小恶魔。

english: Imps and implings appear to be related, and the imps here are quite protective of their smaller relations. If you allow them to get too close then they will attempt to steal jarred implings from your pack, if you have them.
translation: 小恶魔和小精灵似乎是亲戚，这里的小恶魔很保护自己的弱小亲属。如果你让它们靠得太近，它们会试图从你的背包里偷走罐装小精灵。

english: They will then set them free, dropping your jar on the floor. So, if you're quick, you may be able to catch it again.
translation: 然后它们会放走小精灵，把你的罐子掉在地上。所以，如果你够快，也许能再抓一次。

english: I have some impling deterrent which I may trade if you prove that you can catch implings well.
translation: 我有一些小精灵驱避剂，如果你能证明自己善于捕捉小精灵，我可以跟你交易。

english: So what's this equipment you can give me, then?
translation: 那么你能给我的装备是什么？

english: I have been given permission by my clients to give three pieces of equipment to able hunters.
translation: 我的客户授权我给予有能力的猎人三件装备。

english: Firstly, I have some imp deterrent. If you bring me three baby implings, two young implings and one gourmet impling already jarred, I will give you a vial. Imps don't like the smell, so they will be less likely to
translation: 首先，我有一些小恶魔驱避剂。如果你给我带来三个罐装的幼年小精灵、两个青年小精灵和一个美食家小精灵，我会给你一个小瓶。小恶魔不喜欢这个味道，

english: steal jarred implings from you.
translation: 所以不太可能从你那里偷走罐装小精灵。

english: Secondly, I have magical butterfly nets. If you bring me three gourmet implings, two earth implings and one essence impling I will give you a new net. It will help you catch both implings and butterflies.
translation: 其次，我有魔法捕虫网。如果你给我带来三个美食家小精灵、两个大地小精灵和一个精华小精灵，我会给你一个新网。它能帮你捕捉小精灵和蝴蝶。

english: Lastly, I have magical jar generators. If you bring me three essence implings, two eclectic implings and one nature impling I will give you a jar generator. This object will create either butterfly or impling jars (up to
translation: 最后，我有魔法制罐器。如果你给我带来三个精华小精灵、两个奇特小精灵和一个自然小精灵，我会给你一个制罐器。这个物品可以制造蝴蝶罐或小精灵罐

english: a limited number of charges) without having to carry a pack full of them.
translation: (充能次数有限)，这样你就不用背着一包罐子了。

english: Yes! I have some spare equipment for you.
translation: 是的！我有一些备用装备给你。

english: There you go. You have everything you need now.
translation: 给你。你现在有所需的一切了。

english: I have already given you some equipment.
translation: 我已经给你一些装备了。

english: If you are ready to start hunting implings, then enter the main part of the maze.
translation: 如果你准备好开始捕捉小精灵，就进入迷宫的主体部分。

english: Just push through the wheat that surrounds the centre of the maze and get catching!
translation: 推开迷宫中心周围的小麦，开始捕捉吧！

english: Could you store some equipment for me?
translation: 你能帮我存放一些装备吗？

english: I suppose I could keep hold of a net and a few empty jars for you. Just give me what you want me to hold.
translation: 我想我可以帮你保管一张网和几个空罐子。把你想让我保管的给我就行。

english: Can you tell me about the wheat?
translation: 你能跟我讲讲小麦吗？

english: The wheat here can be hard to push through and pushing through it definitely makes you stronger. I found it easier to push through it for about half an hour just after coming through a temporary crop circle.
translation: 这里的小麦很难推开，但推开它确实能让你变强。我发现刚穿过一个临时麦田圈后的半小时内，推开它更容易。

english: I call it the Farmer's Affinity.
translation: 我称之为农夫亲和性。

english: What if I didn't want to become stronger pushing through the wheat?
translation: 如果我不想通过推小麦变强怎么办？

english: I could give you oil to rub on you to reduce friction. Still as hard to push but you don't get stronger.
translation: 我可以给你油涂在身上减少摩擦。推起来还是一样难，但你不会变强。

english: You gave me oil to stop me getting stronger. What if I changed my mind?
translation: 你给了我油阻止我变强。如果我改变主意怎么办？

english: I could lend you a cloth to wipe it off. That should let you become strong while pushing through the wheat.
translation: 我可以借你块布擦掉。那样应该能让你在推小麦时变强。

english: Turn wheat Strengh XP ON?
translation: 开启小麦力量经验值？

english: Can I buy a few impling jars?
translation: 我能买几个小精灵罐吗？

english: You've already purchased 10 jars today, that's enough. Please come back tomorrow if you'd like to buy more.
translation: 你今天已经买了10个罐子了，够了。如果想买更多请明天再来。

english: I usually prefer trading these jars for implings, but if you desperately need them I'm willing to sell you up to 10 jars per day.
translation: 我通常更喜欢用这些罐子交换小精灵，但如果你急需，我愿意每天卖给你最多10个罐子。

english: I will sell these jars for 2,000 coins each. How many would you like to purchase?
translation: 这些罐子我卖每个2,000金币。你想买多少个？

english: My time is valuable, please give me a serious offer next time.
translation: 我的时间很宝贵，下次请给我个认真的报价。

english: So you would like to purchase [number] [jar/jars], costing you a total of [number] coins. Is that correct?
translation: 所以你想买 [number] 个 [jar/jars]，总共花费 [number] 金币。对吗？

english: You don't seem to have brought enough coins, please come back with [number] coins if you'd like to buy the jars.
translation: 你似乎没带够金币，如果想买罐子请带 [number] 金币再来。

english: Here you go. You can come back if you need more and tomorrow I will have another 10 jars ready for purchase.
translation: 给你。如果需要更多可以再来，明天我会再准备10个罐子出售。

english: Here you go. If you need some more I'll have 10 new jars ready for purchase tomorrow.
translation: 给你。如果需要更多，明天我会准备好10个新罐子出售。

english: That's too many, I can let you purchase a maximum of [number] jars for a total of [number] coins today.
translation: 太多了，我今天最多让你买 [number] 个罐子，总共 [number] 金币。

english: Where is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: So what are these implings?
translation: 那么这些小精灵是什么？

english: Can I catch these implings then?
translation: 那我能捕捉这些小精灵吗？

english: I've heard I may find dragon equipment in Puro-Puro.
translation: 我听说可能在普鲁普鲁找到龙金装备。

english: Yes, please
translation: 是的，谢谢

english: No, thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Can you remind me how to catch implings again?
translation: 你能再提醒我怎么捕捉小精灵吗？

english: Tell me more about these jars.
translation: 跟我讲讲这些罐子。

english: Tell me more about these thieving imps.
translation: 跟我讲讲这些偷窃的小恶魔。

english: So what's this equipment you can give me then?
translation: 那么你能给我的装备是什么？

english: Do you have some spare equipment I can use?
translation: 你有我能用的备用装备吗？

english: Can I trade some jarred implings please?
translation: 我能交易一些罐装小精灵吗？

english: Could you store some equipment for me?
translation: 你能帮我存放一些装备吗？

english: Can you tell me about the wheat?
translation: 你能跟我讲讲小麦吗？

english: Yes
translation: 是

english: No
translation: 否

english: Can I buy a few impling jars?
translation: 我能买几个小精灵罐吗？

english: Hello dearie! What can old Elsie do for you?
translation: 你好亲爱的！老艾尔西能为你做什么？

english: What are you making?
translation: 你在做什么？

english: I'm knitting a new stole for Father Lawrence downstairs. He could do with something to keep his neck warm, standing in that draughty old church all day.
translation: 我在给楼下的劳伦斯神父织一条新披肩。他整天站在那个漏风的旧教堂里，脖子需要保暖。

english: Can you tell me a story?
translation: 你能给我讲个故事吗？

english: Maybe I could tell you a story if you'd fetch me a nice cup of tea.
translation: 如果你给我弄杯好茶，也许我能给你讲个故事。

english: I'll think about it.
translation: 我考虑一下。

english: Can you tell me how to get rich?
translation: 你能告诉我怎么致富吗？

english: Well, dearie, I'm probably not the best person to ask about money, but I think the best thing would be for you to get a good trade. If you've got a trade you can earn your way, that's what my old father told me,
translation: 嗯，亲爱的，我可能不是咨询赚钱的最佳人选，但我觉得最好的办法是学门好手艺。如果有手艺就能谋生，这是我老父亲告诉我的，

english: Saradomin rest his soul. I hear people try to get rich by fighting in the Wilderness north of here, but that's no way for honest folks to earn a living! So get yourself a good trade, and keep
translation: 愿萨拉多明安息他的灵魂。我听说有人想通过在北边的荒野战斗致富，但那不是诚实人谋生的方式！所以学门好手艺，坚持

english: working at it. There's always folks wanting to buy ore and food around here.
translation: 做下去。这附近总有人想买矿石和食物。

english: Thanks, old woman.
translation: 谢谢，老妇人。

english: Ooh - that looks like a lovely cup of tea, dearie. Is it for me?
translation: 哦——那看起来像杯好茶，亲爱的。是给我的吗？

english: Well, maybe I could tell you a story if you'd give me that lovely cup of tea you've got there.
translation: 嗯，如果你把那杯可爱的茶给我，也许我能给你讲个故事。

english: Yes, you can have it.
translation: 是的，你可以喝。

english: Ahh, there's nothing like a nice cuppa tea. I know what, I'll tell you a story to thank you for the lovely tea...
translation: 啊，没什么比得上一杯好茶。我知道该怎么做了，我要讲个故事感谢你给的好茶……

english: A long time ago, when I was a little girl, there was a handsome young man living in Varrock. I saw him here in the church quite often. Everyone said he was going to become a priest, and we girls were so sad about that.
translation: 很久以前，我还是个小女孩时，维洛克城住着个英俊的年轻人。我经常在教堂见到他。大家都说他要成为牧师，我们女孩们都为此难过。

english: But young Dissy - that was the young man's nickname - he was a wild young thing. One night he gathered some lads together, and after the evening prayer- meeting they all put on masks and sneaked down to the
translation: 但年轻的迪西——那是他的绰号——他是个狂野的年轻人。一天晚上他召集了一些小伙子，晚祷会后他们都戴上面具，偷偷溜到

english: evil temple in the south of the city, the evil one. The next day, there was quite a hubbub. The guards told us that someone had painted 'Saradomin pwns' on the wall of the Zamorakian temple!
translation: 城南的邪神庙，那个邪恶的地方。第二天，引起了一阵骚动。守卫告诉我们有人在扎莫拉克神庙的墙上涂了“萨拉多明无敌”！

english: Now, we'd always been taught to keep well away from that dreadful place, but it really did us all good to see someone wasn't afraid of the scum who live at that end of town. Old Father Packett was furious, but Dissy just
translation: 我们一直被教导要远离那个可怕的地方，但看到有人不怕住在城那头的那些渣滓，我们都觉得痛快。老帕克特神父很愤怒，但迪西只是

english: laughed it off.
translation: 一笑置之。

english: Dissy left town after that, saying he wanted to see the world. It was such a shame, he had the most handsome shoulders...
translation: 迪西之后离开了城镇，说想看看世界。真可惜，他有着最英俊的肩膀……

english: A young man came here looking for stories about Dissy - of course, that's not his proper name, but his friends called him Dissy - and I told him that one. He said Dissy had become a really famous man and there was
translation: 一个年轻人来这里寻找关于迪西的故事——当然，那不是他的真名，但朋友叫他迪西——我告诉了他那个故事。他说迪西成了非常有名的人，还要

english: going to be a book about him. Well, that's all good, but I do wish Dissy had just come back to Varrock. I did miss him so much... well, until I met my Freddie and we got married, but that's another story.
translation: 出一本关于他的书。嗯，那都好，但我真希望迪西能回维洛克城。我真的很想他……嗯，直到我遇到我的弗雷迪并结婚，但那是另一个故事了。

english: Thank you. I'll leave you to your knitting now.
translation: 谢谢。我不打扰你编织了。

english: No, keep your hands off my tea.
translation: 不，别碰我的茶。

english: Aww. Maybe another time. Anyway, what can old Elsie do for you?
translation: 哎呀。也许下次吧。总之，老艾尔西能为你做什么？

english: What are you making?
translation: 你在做什么？

english: Can you tell me a story?
translation: 你能给我讲个故事吗？

english: Can you tell me how to get rich?
translation: 你能告诉我怎么致富吗？

english: Yes, you can have it.
translation: 是的，你可以喝。

english: No, keep your hands off my tea.
translation: 不，别碰我的茶。

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: Hello, what an exquisite day.
translation: 你好，多么美好的一天。

english: It's lovely round here.
translation: 这附近真美好。

english: I simply can't wait to enter The Nutcracker.
translation: 我简直迫不及待要进入胡桃夹子了。

english: I've been training for quite some time.
translation: 我已经训练了一段时间了。

english: Oh yeah?
translation: 哦是吗？

english: Indeed.
translation: 确实。

english: In fact, I haven't slept for twelve days. HA.
translation: 事实上，我已经十二天没睡了。哈。

english: A... are you okay?
translation: 你……你没事吧？

english: Better than ever!
translation: 比以往任何时候都好！

english: Who's your little friend?
translation: 你的小朋友是谁？

english: This is Gizmo, a dear friend of mine.
translation: 这是吉斯莫，我的好朋友。

english: What a lovely name, he sure is handsome.
translation: 多可爱的名字，他真英俊。

english: No u.
translation: 不你。

english: Ooooo Ah Ah oooOOO.
translation: 哦哦哦 啊 啊 哦哦哦哦。

english: What did he say?
translation: 他说了什么？

english: He said...
translation: 他说……

english: Let me think here...
translation: 让我想想……

english: Okay Oo is Aah, and OOO is oh...
translation: 好的哦是啊，哦哦哦是哦……

english: I think he just said hello.
translation: 我想他刚说了你好。

english: Oh he's awesome.
translation: 哦他真棒。

english: Before I go, I think I heard Santa saying you aren't allowed things on your back in the games.
translation: 在我走之前，我想我听到圣诞老人说游戏里不允许背上带东西。

english: Don't worry about us [player name]. We are sneaky.
translation: 别担心我们 [player name]。我们很狡猾。

english: Good luck and Happy holidays!
translation: 祝你好运，节日快乐！

english: Hey [player name], good to see you.
translation: 嘿 [player name]，很高兴见到你。

english: And you Eluned.
translation: 你也是，埃卢内德。

english: You don't seem to have any crystals I can enchant. Return when you do.
translation: 你似乎没有我能附魔的水晶。有了再来。

english: Hey [player name], do you need me to re-enchant your teleport crystal?
translation: 嘿 [player name]，需要我重新附魔你的传送水晶吗？

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: I ask [charge price] coins to cover my costs.
translation: 我收 [charge price] 金币覆盖成本。

english: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Yes - [charge price] coins.
translation: 是的——[charge price] 金币。

english: Hello there. Where are Islwyn and Eluned?
translation: 你好。伊斯尔温和埃卢内德在哪？

english: They'll be in Prifddinas of course. With the city restored there's not much reason for them to come out here.

translation: 嗯年轻人，你进入了魔法师训练竞技场。它建于第五纪元初，符石刚被发现时。建造是因为经验不足的法师造成许多无意义事故。

english: mages.
translation: 法师。

english: Who created it?
translation: 谁创造的？

english: Good question. It was originally made by the ancestors of the wizards in the Wizards Tower. However, it was destroyed by melee and ranged warriors who took offence at the use of this new 'Magic Art'. Recently,
translation: 好问题。最初由法师塔的法师祖先建造。然而，被对使用这种新“魔法艺术”反感的近战和远程战士摧毁。最近，

english: the current denizens of the Wizards Tower have resurrected the arena including various Guardians you will see as you look around. We are here to help and to ensure things run smoothly.
translation: 法师塔的当前居民复活了竞技场，包括你环顾四周会看到的各种守护者。我们在这里帮助并确保事情顺利进行。

english: Interesting. So what can I do here?
translation: 有趣。那我在这里能做什么？

english: You may train up your skill in the magic arts by travelling through one of the portals at the back of this entrance hall. By training up in one of these areas you will be awarded special Pizazz Points unique to
translation: 你可穿过大厅后方的传送门，训练魔法技能。在这些区域训练，你将获得各房间专属的活力点数。

english: each room. With these points you may claim a variety of items from my fellow guardian up the stairs.
translation: 凭借这些点数，你可以向楼上的守护者同伴兑换各种物品。

english: How do you record the points I have earned?
translation: 你怎么记录我获得的点数？

english: You really are full of questions! You will need a special Pizazz Progress Hat! I can give you one if you so wish to train here.
translation: 你问题真多！你需要一顶特殊的活力进度帽！如果你想在这里训练，我可以给你一顶。

english: Yes please!
translation: 好的，谢谢！

english: Ah, I'm afraid I can't give it to you as you don't have room to carry it!
translation: 恐怕我没法给你，你的物品栏已满！

english: Here you go. Talk to the hat to find out your current Pizazz Point totals.
translation: 给你。跟帽子说话就能知道你当前的活力点数总数。

english: Talk to it?
translation: 跟它交谈？

english: Well of course, it's a magic Pizazz Progress Hat! Mind your manners though, hats have feelings too!
translation: 当然，这可是魔法活力进度帽！不过注意礼貌，帽子也是有感情的！

english: Er... if you insist.
translation: 呃……既然你坚持。

english: Oh, and a word of warning: should you decide to leave the rooms by any method other than the exit portals, you will be teleported to the entrance and have any items that you picked up in the room removed.
translation: 提醒一句：若你未通过出口传送门离开房间，将被传送回入口，且在房内拾取的物品均会被没收。

english: Can you explain the different portals?
translation: 你能解释一下不同的传送门吗？

english: They lead to four areas to train your magic: The Telekinetic Theatre, The Alchemists' Playground, The Enchanting Chamber, and The Creature Graveyard.
translation: 它们通向四个训练魔法的区域：念力剧场、炼金术士游乐场、附魔室和生物墓地。

english: What's the Telekinetic Theatre?
translation: 什么是念力剧场？

english: In there you can earn Telekinetic Pizazz Points for trade upstairs.
translation: 在那里你可以赚取念力活力点数，用于楼上交易。

english: What will I be doing in there?
translation: 我在那里要做什么？

english: That depends on how much of a time-waster you are! You are required to use the Telekinetic Grab spell in order to move a statue through a maze. Casting the spell will move the statue towards you until it reaches
translation: 这得看你有多磨蹭了！你需要使用意念取物法术在迷宫中移动雕像。施放该法术会使雕像朝你移动，直至撞墙。

english: a wall. So by standing on the different sides of the maze you can move the statue North, East, South or West. You will be rewarded Pizazz Points for each maze successfully solved.
translation: 因此，站在迷宫不同侧，你可将雕像向东南西北任意方向移动。每成功解开一座迷宫，你将获得活力点数奖励。

english: It will be clearer when you arrive and there's a Guardian through the portal that will be able to tell you more. There's a book you can buy from the Rewards Guardian upstairs that will explain it all.
translation: 你到了就会更清楚，传送门那边有位守护者能告诉你更多。你也可以从楼上的奖励守护者那里买本书，里面会解释一切。

english: What's the Alchemists' Playground?
translation: 什么是炼金术士游乐场？

english: In the playground you can earn Alchemist Pizazz Points for trading with the rewards guardian upstairs.
translation: 在游乐场你可以赚取炼金术士活力点数，用于和楼上的奖励守护者交易。

english: What's in there?
translation: 里面有什么？

english: You'll find eight cupboards containing items you can turn to gold using the low and high alchemy spells. The money you earn will be taken from you upon leaving the playground to pay for the upkeep of this training
translation: 你会发现八个橱柜，内含可用低级炼金术和高级炼金术转化为金币的物品。离开游乐场时，你赚取的钱币将被收回，

english: arena and to help fund magic shops around Gielinor. You will be rewarded with 1 Pizazz Point for every 100 coins deposited and a percentage of the money you create. Keep in mind that you will not be able to take
translation: 用于维护训练竞技场及资助基利诺尔各地的魔法商店。每存入100枚金币，你将获得1点活力点数，以及所创资金的一定比例。

english: more than 1000 coins back out with you.
translation: 请注意，你最多只能带出1000枚金币。

english: Sounds simple.
translation: 听起来很简单。

english: I am afraid not, for the cost of the items varies, as does their locations in the cupboards. You'll see a list of item costs that will help you decide what you should be converting to gold.
translation: 恐怕没那么简单，物品价格各异，在橱柜中的位置也不固定。你会看到一份物品成本列表，帮你决定应该把什么变成金币。

english: Fear not, it will be clearer when you arrive and there's a Guardian through the portal that will be able to tell you more. You can also buy a book from the Rewards Guardian upstairs that will explain it all.
translation: 别怕，你到了就会更清楚，传送门那边有位守护者能告诉你更多。你也可以从楼上的奖励守护者那里买本书，里面会解释一切。

english: What's the Enchanting Chamber?
translation: 什么是附魔室？

english: In here you will be able to earn Enchantment Pizazz Points for trade upstairs.
translation: 在这里你可以赚取附魔活力点数，用于楼上交易。

english: What will I have to do?
translation: 我要做什么？

english: You will find yourself amongst various piles of shapes. You can pick up these shapes and use one of your enchanting spells upon it to morph it into an orb. You'll also see a hole in the centre of the room; put the orbs
translation: 你会发现自己身处各种形状堆中。你可拾取这些东西，对其施放附魔法术，将其化为宝珠。房间中央还有个孔洞，放入宝珠，

english: in here and for every 20 we will credit you with a gift. You will get Pizazz Points for every 10 shapes that you convert and the amount of points depends on the spell you use.
translation: 每凑齐20枚我们将赠你一份礼物。每转化10个形状你会获得活力点数，点数数量取决于你使用的法术。

english: What's the difference between the shapes?
translation: 形状之间有什么区别？

english: Ah, you will be notified of a different shape that will give you a bonus Pizazz Point when you convert that shape. You should also look out for dragon stones, as these will give you more Pizazz Points when you
translation: 对了，系统会提示你哪种东西转化时可获额外活力点数。你还应该留意龙石，因为转化它们会给你更多活力点数。

english: convert them.
translation: 转化它们时。

english: It will be clearer when you arrive and there's a Guardian through the portal that will be able to tell you more. You can also buy a book from the Rewards Guardian upstairs that will explain it all.
translation: 你到了就会更清楚，传送门那边有位守护者能告诉你更多。你也可以从楼上的奖励守护者那里买本书，里面会解释一切。

english: What's the Creature Graveyard?
translation: 什么是生物墓地？

english: In here you will be able to earn Graveyard Pizazz Points for trade upstairs.
translation: 在这里你可以赚取墓地活力点数，用于楼上交易。

english: But what do I have to do in there?
translation: 但我在那里要做什么？

english: Patience young one. A great many creatures die in this world and much of their remains can cause clutter. We have taken it upon ourselves to teleport many bones from these creatures into this graveyard for a
translation: 耐心点，年轻人。这世上许多生物死去，它们的遗骸会造成杂乱。我们特意将这些生物的骨头传送至此墓地，以供利用。

english: use. It's up to you to practice your bones to bananas spell in order to put these bones into immediate use - nutritious food for monsters! Just convert the bones and put them in the holes in the walls. There is a
translation: 你要练习化骨为蕉法术，将这些骨头即时利用——化作怪物的营养餐！只需转化骨头，将其投入墙上的孔洞即可。

english: drawback to this room however, the bones often fall on people so you may want to eat some of those bananas to stay alive. When people die we confiscate Pizazz Points for the effort of teleporting incompetent mages.
translation: 不过此房间有个弊端，骨头时常坠落砸中玩家，你可能需要吃些香蕉保命。玩家死亡时，我们将没收其活力点数，作为传送无能法师的补偿。

english: What else do I get from this besides bruises?
translation: 除了淤青我还能得到什么？

english: As well as the Pizazz Points for giving us the bananas, you will be credited with runestones for your efforts, and you may be able to save up for a new kind of spell to use in the graveyard!
translation: 除因提供香蕉获得的活力点数外，你的努力还将奖励符石，甚至可能攒够资源习得墓地专用新法术！

english: It will be clearer when you arrive and one of my fellow guardians through the portal will be able to tell you more. You can also buy a book from the Rewards Guardian upstairs that will explain it all.
translation: 你到了就会更清楚，传送门那边的一位守护者同伴能告诉你更多。你也可以从楼上的奖励守护者那里买本书，里面会解释一切。

english: Thanks, bye!
translation: 谢谢，再见！

english: Use what you have learned.
translation: 运用你所学到的。

english: None, I don't really care.
translation: 没什么，我不在乎。

english: You won't gain with that attitude.
translation: 那种态度你不会有收获的。

english: Can you tell me about this place again?
translation: 你能再跟我讲讲这个地方吗？

english: Very well. You have entered the magic training arena. It was built at the start of the Fifth Age, when runestones were first discovered. It was built to put an end to many pointless accidents involving inexperienced
translation: 很好。你进入了魔法训练竞技场。它建于第五纪元初，那时刚发现符石。建造此竞技场，旨在减少经验不足者引发的无谓事故。

english: You may train up your skill in the magic arts by travelling through one of the portals at the back of this building. By training up in one of these areas you will be awarded Pizazz Points unique to each room. With
translation: 你可以通过穿过这个建筑后面的一个传送门训练魔法艺术技能。通过在这些区域之一训练，你将获得每个房间专属的活力点数。凭借

english: these points you may claim a variety of items from my fellow guardian up the stairs.
translation: 这些点数，你可以向楼上的守护者同伴兑换各种物品。

english: How do you record the Pizazz Points I have earned?
translation: 你怎么记录我获得的活力点数？

english: With the Pizazz Progress Hat I gave you, of course.
translation: 当然，用我给你的活力进度帽即可。

english: OK.
translation: 好的。

english: Oh, and a word of warning: should you decide to log out whilst in any of the rooms in the arena, you will be teleported to the entrance and have any items that you picked up in the room removed.
translation: 哦，提醒一句：如果你决定在竞技场的任何房间注销，你将被传送回入口，且在房间内捡到的任何物品都会被没收。

english: You want another one don't you.
translation: 你想要另一顶对吧。

english: Sorry, can I?
translation: 抱歉，可以吗？

english: Yes. What's it for?
translation: 可以。用来做什么？

english: Collect Pizazz Points from the various areas and the hat will remember your totals. Talk to the hat at any time to find out what points you have. Go upstairs and talk to the Rewards Guardian to claim items for the
translation: 收集各区域的活力点数，帽子会为你记录累计总值。随时跟帽子说话查看你有多少点数。去楼上跟奖励守护者说话兑换物品。

english: points.
translation: 点数。

english: I'm new to this place. Where am I?
translation: 我是新来的。我在哪？

english: What's the Telekinetic Theatre?
translation: 什么是念力剧场？

english: What's the Alchemists' Playground?
translation: 什么是炼金术士游乐场？

english: What's the Enchanting Chamber?
translation: 什么是附魔室？

english: What's the Creature Graveyard?
translation: 什么是生物墓地？

english: Thanks, bye!
translation: 谢谢，再见！

english: None, I don't really care.
translation: 没什么，我不在乎。

english: Can you tell me about this place again?
translation: 你能再跟我讲讲这个地方吗？

english: Can you explain the different portals?
translation: 你能解释一下不同的传送门吗？

english: About the progress hat...
translation: 关于进度帽……

english: Hello, thanks for rescuing me. Is there anything I can do for you?
translation: 你好，谢谢你救我。有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: How did you end up down here?
translation: 你怎么会到这下面的？

english: I travelled down here with my friend Olbertus in search for treasure. When we didn't find anything except his strange structure, he decided to prise off a coin from the stone relief in the other room. Before I knew it the entrance had closed and I was stuck down here.
translation: 我和朋友奥尔伯图斯来这里寻找宝藏。当我们除那座奇异建筑外一无所获时，他决定从另一房间的石浮雕上撬下一枚钱币。还没等我反应过来，入口就关闭了，我被困在了这里。

english: I tried calling out to Olbertus but he must not have heard me. I don't know what would've happened if you hadn't shown up and saved me.
translation: 我试着喊奥尔伯图斯，但他肯定没听见。我不知道如果你没出现救我会发生什么。

english: Well, it turns out Olbertus was corrupted by the coin he stole, I managed to get the coin from him and returned it to the relief, he should be fine now.
translation: 嗯，结果奥尔伯图斯被他偷的硬币腐蚀了，我设法从他那里拿回硬币并放回浮雕上，他现在应该没事了。

english: That's good news at least.
translation: 那至少是个好消息。

english: I am quite the proficient tanner, for helping me escape I will offer to tan hides for you. However, they'll be at a slightly higher cost for the convenience of being closer to the source.
translation: 我是个相当熟练的鞣皮匠，为了帮我逃脱，我愿意为你鞣制皮革。不过，因靠近货源更为便利，费用会略高一些。

english: Now that you're free, why don't you leave?
translation: 既然你自由了，为什么不离开？

english: To be honest, I tried to set up a Tannery on the surface but business was poor, there aren't a lot of dragons in Kourend.
translation: 老实说，我试过在地表开鞣皮厂，但生意很差，库兰德王国没多少龙。

english: I even heard a rumour that people have learned to tan hides with magic. It's always the same! Magic users stealing jobs from honest tradesman!
translation: 我甚至听说有传闻说人们学会了用魔法鞣制皮革。总是这样！魔法使用者从诚实商人那里抢工作！

english: Erm... Yeah! Those magic users...
translation: 呃……是啊！那些魔法使用者……

english: Oh, wow! I can see why that wouldn't help business.
translation: 哦，哇！我明白为什么那无助于生意了。

english: Anyway, I figured if I was closer to the source of the hides then I might get more business. So I'll try setting up shop down here for a while.
translation: 总之，我想如果离皮革货源更近，我可能会获得更多生意。所以我打算在这里开店一段时间。

english: How did you end up down here?
translation: 你怎么会到这下面的？

english: Now that you're free, why don't you leave?
translation: 既然你自由了，为什么不离开？

english: Can you tan some hides for me?
translation: 你能帮我鞣制一些皮革吗？

english: I'm good thanks.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

english: Hi!
translation: 嗨！

english: Hi, can I help?
translation: 嗨，能帮忙吗？

english: Welcome to Burthorpe Castle! Home to his Royal Highness the Prince of Burthorpe, Heir to the Throne of Asgarnia!
translation: 欢迎来到伯索普城堡！此地乃伯索普王子殿下——阿斯加尼亚王位继承人之居所！

english: Wow!
translation: 哇！

english: Anything else I can help you with?
translation: 还有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: Where is the prince?
translation: 王子在哪？

english: We do not disclose his majesty's business.
translation: 我们不透露陛下的事务。

english: Do you have any quests for me?
translation: 你有什么任务给我吗？

english: Yes actually I do, we need another servant.
translation: 是的，其实我有，我们需要另一个仆人。

english: Does this noble quest have a name?
translation: 这个高尚的任务有名字吗？

english: Yes, it's the... er... Empty the Cesspit Quest!
translation: 是的，是……呃……清理粪坑任务！

english: I'll give it a miss!
translation: 我还是算了！

english: No, I'm just looking around.
translation: 不，我只是随便看看。

english: I have a question for you.
translation: 我有个问题问你。

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
translation: 请输入问题的答案。

english: No, try again.
translation: 不，再试一次。

english: Correct!
translation: 正确！

english: What is this castle?
translation: 这是什么城堡？

english: Where is the prince?
translation: 王子在哪？

english: Do you have any quests for me?
translation: 你有什么任务给我吗？

english: No, I'm just looking around.
translation: 不，我只是随便看看。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Sorry, I cannot stop or Iona will catch me, we are playing tag!
translation: 抱歉，我不能停下，否则艾奥娜会抓到我，我们在玩捉人游戏！

english: Thank you for saving me. Mummy says you're a hero after what you did.
translation: 谢谢你救了我。妈妈说你做了那样的事后是个英雄。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Good day. What can I help you with?
translation: 你好。有什么能帮你的吗？

english: I would like to buy some equipment.
translation: 我想买些装备。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Well, you must be a new arrival. I am Erdan, a descendant of Uhld.
translation: 嗯，你一定是新来的。我是尔丹，乌尔德的后裔。

english: Uhld? I've seen that inscribed on that big old statue down below. What's that about?
translation: 乌尔德？我在下面那个古老大雕像上看到过刻字。那是怎么回事？

english: It's also on the fountain in the dungeon below, it displays their emblem.
translation: 下面地牢的喷泉上也有，展示着他们的徽章。

english: Whose emblem?
translation: 谁的徽章？

english: The Sect of Uhld, the founders of this here guild. I may not have gained entrance to this guild in the usual fashion, but I'd expect that they'd at least inform new members of this guild's history.
translation: 乌尔德教派，这个公会的创立者。我可能不是通过常规方式进入这个公会的，但我期望他们至少会告知新成员公会的历史。

english: Perhaps they expected you, a descendant of Uhld, to fill me in on the matter.
translation: 也许他们期望你，作为乌尔德的后裔，来跟我讲讲这件事。

english: Aye, that may well be the case.
translation: 是的，很可能就是这样。

english: Look, I'm awfully busy, what with the recent influx of members, so I'll give you the short version for now.
translation: 听着，我非常忙，最近成员涌入太多，所以我先给你讲个简略版。

english: Fair enough.
translation: 好吧。

english: The story my father told me was of a war on magic. Of god fearing men who believed nothing good would come of wielding a power that was never meant for them.
translation: 我父亲告诉我的故事是关于一场魔法战争。关于那些敬畏神明之人，他们坚信操控本不属于凡人的力量，绝不会带来善果。

english: And so the rune temples that man had created were under threat. Before long, all were destroyed and thus forgotten.
translation: 于是人类创造的符石神庙受到威胁。不久之后，所有神庙都被摧毁并被遗忘。

english: But the wrath that these Gunnites embraced rippled through the pocket dimensions. Supposedly, a new altar of power was discovered.
translation: 然而，贡尼特人所秉持的怒火，波及了各个口袋维度。据说，一个新的力量祭坛被发现了。

english: The wrath altar?
translation: 愤怒祭坛？

english: Indeed. The temple was destroyed just as construction had finished, and a nearby nomadic group called the Sect of Uhld were not pleased with the brutality they witnessed.
translation: 确实。神庙刚建成就被摧毁了，附近一个叫乌尔德教派的游牧群体对他们目睹的暴行感到不满。

english: They quickly established this guild with information preservation as their core goal, for men are recorders of history and magic is key for this to last.

english: How can I get a house?

english: I can sell you a starting house in Rimmington for 1000 coins. As you increase your construction skill you will be able to have your house moved to other areas and redecorated in other styles.
translation: 我可以卖给你里明顿村的起始房屋，价格1000金币。随着建筑技能提升，你将可将房屋迁至其他区域，并以不同风格重新装潢。

translation: 好的，谢谢！

translation: 我身上没1,000金币。

english: Well come back when you have it then.
translation: 那等你有了再来。

english: Thank you. Go through the Rimmington house portal and you will find your house ready for you to start building in it.
translation: 谢谢。穿过里明顿村的房屋传送门，你会发现你的房子已准备好让你开始建造。

english: This book will help you to start building your house.
translation: 这本书会帮你开始建造房屋。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Well enjoy your player-owned cardboard box or wherever you're going to sleep tonight!
translation: 那就好好享受你的玩家专属纸板箱，或今晚将就的其他栖身之所吧！

english: It all came out of the wizards' experiments. They found a way to fold space, so that they could pack many acres of land into an area only a foot across.
translation: 这一切都源于法师们的实验。他们找到了一种折叠空间的方法，这样他们就能把数英亩的土地塞进一个只有一英尺宽的区域里。

english: They created several folded-space regions across Gielinor. Each one contains hundreds of small plots where people can build houses.
translation: 他们在基利诺尔各地创造了几个折叠空间区域。每个区域包含数百个小地块，人们可以在那里建造房屋。

english: Ah, so that's how everyone can have a house without them cluttering up the world!
translation: 啊，所以这就是为什么每个人都能有房子而不会让世界变得杂乱！

english: Quite. The wizards didn't want to get bogged down in the business side of things so they hired me to sell the houses.
translation: 没错。法师们不想陷入商业事务中，所以他们雇我来卖房子。

english: There are various other people across Gielinor who can help you furnish your house.
translation: 基利诺尔各地还有各种其他人可以帮你布置房屋。

english: You should start by buying planks from a sawmill operator. Sawmills are located in north-east Varrock, the Woodcutting Guild located in south-west Hosidius and north-east Prifddinas.
translation: 你应该先从锯木厂操作员那里购买木板。锯木厂分布于维洛克城东北、霍西迪乌斯城西南的伐木公会，以及普里夫迪纳斯城东北。
