translation: 别那样做！我不喜欢鬼魂。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Sorry [player name], I'm talking to Oziach right now.
translation: 抱歉 [player name]，我正在跟奥齐亚克说话。

english: I'm going to head back to the office.
translation: 我要回办公室了。

english: Alright, I'll see you later. Can't wait to move in!
translation: 好的，回头见。迫不及待要搬进去了！

english: I know, it's a lovely place! See you!
translation: 我知道，那是个好地方！再见！

english: The estate agent leaves.
translation: 地产经纪人离开了。

english: Ahhh... soon to be mine.
translation: 啊……很快就是我的了。

english: The cutscene ends.
translation: 过场动画结束。

english: A cutscene starts. The estate agent arrives, and approaches Oziach.
translation: 过场动画开始。地产经纪人到达，走向奥齐亚克。

english: So many ghosts... I need some help!
translation: 这么多鬼魂……我需要帮助！

english: Oziach! Are you okay? I heard shouting!
translation: 奥齐亚克！你没事吧？我听到喊声！

english: Hello! It's not going well. There are a lot of ghosts here!
translation: 你好！情况不太好。这里有很多鬼魂！

english: That's not good at all!
translation: 那一点都不好！

english: Do you still want to go ahead with the purchase?
translation: 你还想继续购买吗？

english: Of course! TWO ghosts is scary, but not that scary!
translation: 当然！两只鬼很可怕，但没那么可怕！

english: I'll hire myself one of those slayers we see everywhere.
translation: 我会雇一个我们到处都能看到的杀戮者。

english: They will help with the ghost problem!
translation: 他们会帮忙解决鬼魂问题！

english: Phew, that is lovely news! I thought it was all over, then.
translation: 呼，那是个好消息！我还以为一切都完了。

english: I'll head back to the office, meet me there shortly.
translation: 我要回办公室了，稍后在那里见我。

english: I'll be doing the final paperwork.
translation: 我会处理最后的文书工作。

english: Are you here to fight the cold?
translation: 你是来对抗寒冷的吗？

english: Umm... I guess?
translation: 嗯……我想是吧？

english: Great! Ask me anything you like about the Bruma tree, I'm an expert.
translation: 太好了！关于布鲁玛树你想问什么都可以，我是专家。

english: Tell me about the Wintertodt.
translation: 跟我讲讲冬将军。

english: Some would say that ice preserves while fire destroys, but no amount of fire is destroying the Wintertodt. That's a cold that will freeze the air in your lungs.
translation: 有人会说冰能保存而火会毁灭，但再多的火也无法毁灭冬将军。那是会冻结你肺中空气的寒冷。

english: Even the heat generated from burning the Bruma roots only weakens it, and that doesn't last very long nowadays.
translation: 即使燃烧布鲁玛根产生的热量也只能削弱它，而且如今那效果持续不了多久。

english: Looks like an angry snow storm to me...
translation: 在我看来就像一场愤怒的暴风雪……

english: What you see in that pit is not the Wintertodt at full strength. It never will be while the Bruma tree still burns and the Doors of Dinh remain closed.
translation: 你在坑里看到的不是全盛状态的冬将军。只要布鲁玛树还在燃烧且丁之门紧闭，它就永远不会是全盛状态。

english: Tell me about the Bruma tree.
translation: 跟我讲讲布鲁玛树。

english: The Bruma tree is what keeps the Wintertodt weak. The prison was built here by Dinh because of its usefulness against the Wintertodt.
translation: 布鲁玛树是让冬将军保持虚弱的原因。丁因为其对对抗冬将军有用而在此建造了监狱。

english: Some legends say that Xeric is the cause for the Doors weakening, or maybe he made the Wintertodt stronger?
translation: 有些传说说泽里克是门变弱的原因，或者也许他让冬将军变强了？

english: Is Xeric really such a bad guy?
translation: 泽里克真的是个坏人吗？

english: It's a known fact that he was interested in the Bruma tree. For what purpose... there are only rumours.
translation: 众所周知他对布鲁玛树感兴趣。为了什么目的……只有传闻。

english: Regardless, the Bruma tree definitely contains powerful magic. I've been studying the sap for years and it has truly astounding properties.
translation: 无论如何，布鲁玛树肯定含有强大的魔法。我研究树液多年，它确实有惊人的特性。

english: There's not many fires that burn green now, are there?
translation: 现在没多少火是绿色燃烧的吧？

english: What about gnomish fire lighters?
translation: 那地精打火机呢？

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 跟我讲讲你自己。

english: Me? I'm a member of the Woodcutting Guild. More of a researcher though... I'm currently tasked with growing a new Bruma tree.
translation: 我？我是伐木公会的成员。不过更像是研究员……我目前的任务是种植一棵新的布鲁玛树。

english: How's that going?
translation: 进展如何？

english: Poorly. I believe the Bruma tree can only be grown in a freezing cold climate.
translation: 很差。我相信布鲁玛树只能在极寒气候下生长。

english: Well, isn't that here?
translation: 嗯，那不就是这里吗？

english: It's just an idea really. For all I know, it could be magic way beyond me, beyond even the Pyromancers.
translation: 其实只是个想法。据我所知，这可能是远超我甚至火术士能力的魔法。

english: See you later.
translation: 回头见。

english: Goodbye!
translation: 再见！

english: Tell me about the Wintertodt.
translation: 跟我讲讲冬将军。

english: Tell me about the Bruma tree.
translation: 跟我讲讲布鲁玛树。

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 跟我讲讲你自己。

english: See you later.
translation: 回头见。

english: This looks like an interesting island.
translation: 这看起来像个有趣的岛屿。

english: Oh it is.
translation: 哦确实是。

english: Fancy a race!?!
translation: 想比赛吗？！

english: What? That's a bit sudden. What kind of race?
translation: 什么？那有点突然。什么比赛？

english: I bet I can beat you to the other end of this island, I'll take the left route and you can take the right.
translation: 我打赌我能比你先到岛的另一端，我走左边路线，你走右边。

english: That doesn't seem fair - mine's all curvy and yours is straight.
translation: 那似乎不公平——我的全是弯道，你的是直的。

english: Well, that's life I'm afraid, it's never as easy as you would like, you have to take the path that's dealt!
translation: 嗯，恐怕这就是生活，它永远不会像你想要的那样容易，你必须走被分配的路！

english: If you insist.
translation: 如果你坚持。

english: You'll see, so how about it?
translation: 你会看到的，那么怎么样？

english: On your marks!
translation: 各就各位！

english: Get set!
translation: 预备！

english: Go !!!
No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Have it your way.
translation: 随你便。

english: You beat me.
translation: 你赢了我。

english: Woo hoo! Ha ha! You can try again if you want, but you'll never beat me, I'm far too fast!
translation: 呜呼！哈哈！如果你想可以再试一次，但你永远赢不了我，我太快了！

english: Eat my dust!
translation: 吃我的尘土吧！

english: You're right, I'm far too slow.
translation: 你说得对，我太慢了。

english: You give up too easily, but have it your way.
translation: 你放弃得太容易了，但随你便。

english: Oh, hello? Looks like you'll probably want to start again.
translation: 哦，你好？看起来你可能想重新开始。

english: I won!
translation: 我赢了！

english: Noooo! How could you beat me?
translation: 不！你怎么能赢我？

english: Very well.
translation: 很好。

english: I'm just making the most of the abilities I worked hard to develop. That's all!
translation: 我只是充分利用我努力培养的能力。就这样！

english: True. A very important thing to remember! Now be gone!
translation: 确实。要记住的非常重要的一点！现在走吧！

english: Ok.
translation: 好的。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Eat my dust!
translation: 吃我的尘土吧！

english: You're right, I'm far too slow.
translation: 你说得对，我太慢了。

english: Thank you for saving us.
translation: 谢谢你救了我们。

english: Don't mention it.
translation: 不用客气。

english: And thank you for saving Antos as well!
translation: 也谢谢你救了安托斯！

english: It's really not a problem.
translation: 这真的不算什么。

english: You're our hero!
translation: 你是我们的英雄！

english: Can I help you at all?
translation: 有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Yes please. What are you selling?
translation: 你在卖什么？

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: What is it you want?
translation: 你想要什么？

english: Can I kill the dragons up here?
translation: 我能杀这里的龙吗？

english: I suppose that's okay since you've got a Slayer assignment. But when you've finished it, leave the rest for me!
translation: 我想既然你有杀戮任务那就可以。但当你完成后，把剩下的留给我！

english: Don't even think about it - these dragons up here are for me!
translation: 想都别想——这里的龙是给我的！

english: There's a Slayer Master in my family, so I don't stop people doing their Slayer assignments, but otherwise these dragons are for me, not you.
translation: 我家里有位杀戮大师，所以我不阻止人们做杀戮任务，但除此之外这些龙是给我的，不是给你的。

english: What are you here for?
translation: 你来这里做什么？

english: Dragon-slaying, of course. Do I look like one of those serfs who wanders around scavenging scales off the floor? I'm just having a rest now, before I get back to the fight.
translation: 当然是屠龙。我看起来像那些在地上四处游荡捡鳞片的农奴吗？我只是在回去战斗前休息一下。

english: My cousin Slieve built the access routes through this blue dragon lair. But she's only really interested in black dragons, not blue ones, so she said I could have this area for myself.
translation: 我表妹斯莱夫建造了穿过这个蓝龙巢穴的通道。但她只对黑龙感兴趣，不是蓝龙，所以她说这个区域可以归我。

english: Why are you dressed like that?
translation: 你为什么穿成那样？

english: It's hot in here with all the dragonfire.
translation: 这里龙火很多，很热。

english: Don't you need armour, though?
translation: 但你不需盔甲吗？

english: I've got wizard boots on, see? What more would I want?
translation: 我穿着法师靴，看到了吗？我还想要什么？

english: Well, maybe you'd want something to help you fight the dragons? Wizard boots don't sound very useful.
translation: 嗯，也许你想要些东西帮你对抗龙？法师靴听起来不太有用。

english: They're useful enough for what I'm doing. Anyway, moving on...
translation: 它们对我做的事足够有用了。总之，继续……

english: Never mind.
translation: 没关系。

english: Off you go.
translation: 你走吧。

english: Oi, find yourself some other dragons - these are mine!
translation: 喂，去找些别的龙——这些是我的！

english: Can I kill the dragons up here?
translation: 我能杀这里的龙吗？

english: What are you here for?
translation: 你来这里做什么？

english: Why are you dressed like that?
translation: 你为什么穿成那样？

english: Never mind.
translation: 没关系。

english: Hey Eve!
translation: 嘿伊芙！

english: [player name]! You're back! Here to party some more?
translation: [player name]！你回来了！再来派对吗？

english: You never get sick of partying, do you?
translation: 你永远不会厌倦派对，对吧？

english: Well, you see, I spend the rest of the year in the afterlife. And that is quite boring.
translation: 嗯，你看，我一年中剩下的时间都在来世。那相当无聊。

english: The afterlife?
translation: 来世？

english: Yes. You know, where you go when you die. Anyway, that's boring stuff. Coming back here is fun!
translation: 是的。你知道，死后去的地方。总之，那是无聊的事。回到这里很有趣！

english: How do you come back?
translation: 你怎么回来的？

english: Magic, my friend!
translation: 魔法，我的朋友！

english: What kind of magic?
translation: 什么魔法？

english: You wouldn't understand. If you're so interested, talk to the other people around here. They've returned from the afterlife as well!
translation: 你不会理解的。如果你这么感兴趣，跟周围其他人谈谈。他们也从来世回来了！

english: Have they? Interesting.
translation: 是吗？有趣。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Come back soon!
translation: 早点回来！

english: What kind of magic?
translation: 什么魔法？

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Do you wanna meet my pet? His name's Pete. Or has this amulet of humanspeak broken again?
translation: 你想见见我的宠物吗？他叫皮特。还是这个人类语护符又坏了？

english: Player is teleported to ScapeRune prison
translation: 玩家被传送至 ScapeRune 监狱

english: You leave the cat alone, and the cat leaves you alone.
translation: 你不惹猫，猫不惹你。

english: Hey, [player name], come with me if you like fishing! Or has this amulet of humanspeak broken again?
translation: 嘿，[player name]，如果你喜欢钓鱼就跟我来！还是这个人类语护符又坏了？

english: Player is teleported to Evil Bob's Island
translation: 玩家被传送至邪恶鲍勃的岛屿

english: Evil Bob doesn't seem interested in you.
translation: 邪恶鲍勃似乎对你不感兴趣。

english: Evil Bob is no longer interested in you.
translation: 邪恶鲍勃不再对你感兴趣。

english: So you've been captured too?
translation: 所以你也被抓了？

english: Captured?
translation: 被抓？

english: Yes, Evil Bob captured me and stuck me in this prison.
translation: 是的，邪恶鲍勃抓了我并把我关在这个监狱里。

english: How do I get out of here? I can't be held captive by a cat!
translation: 我怎么出去？我不能被一只猫囚禁！

english: Some of these balloon animals have keys in them, and if you pull the big lever it tells you which shape animal contains the correct key, but I can never find it.
translation: 有些气球动物里面有钥匙，如果你拉动大杠杆，它会告诉你哪种形状的动物含有正确的钥匙，但我永远找不到。

english: You need to pull the lever to find out which shape animal contains the key, then pop that sort of animal to get the key.
translation: 你需要拉动杠杆找出哪种形状的动物含有钥匙，然后弄破那种动物拿到钥匙。

english: Bring me any keys you get and I'll try them on the doors.
translation: 把你拿到的任何钥匙带给我，我会试着开门。

english: Okay.
translation: 好的。

english: But I wan't to leave now.
translation: 但我想现在离开。

english: Oh. Well I guess you can leave but I'll still be stuck here.
translation: 哦。嗯我想你可以离开，但我还是会困在这里。

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: Don't you remember? This is ScapeRune's prison. Evil Bob caught you and brought you here.
translation: 你不记得了吗？这是 ScapeRune 的监狱。邪恶鲍勃抓了你并把你带到这里。

english: What gives him the right to lock me up? I demand to see a lawyer! I know my rights!
translation: 他有什么权利把我关起来？我要见律师！我知道我的权利！

english: Evil Bob doesn't care about people's rights. He's cruel and utterly merciless. He's a cat.
translation: 邪恶鲍勃不在乎人们的权利。他残忍且完全无情。他是只猫。

english: Come on, we should leave before Evil Bob comes back! You go first; I'll follow along.
translation: 来吧，我们应该在邪恶鲍勃回来之前离开！你先走；我跟着。

english: Oi! we'll be using the exit that's over here.
translation: 喂！我们要用那边的出口。

english: You're meant to pull the lever to find out which sort of animal to pop!
translation: 你应该拉动杠杆找出要弄破哪种动物！

english: That's right, pull it. Then remember what kind of animal shape you see. That's the animal that contains the right key.
translation: 没错，拉它。然后记住你看到的是什么动物形状。那就是含有正确钥匙的动物。

english: Great, now you've got a key! Bring it to me so I can try it on the doors.
translation: 太好了，现在你有钥匙了！把它带给我，我试着开门。

english: The player walks to Prison Pete
translation: 玩家走向监狱皮特

english: Ooh, thanks! I'll see if it's the right one...
translation: 哦，谢谢！我看看是不是对的……

english: Aww, that was the wrong key! You must have popped the wrong sort of animal. Try the big lever again - it'll tell you which animal to pop.
translation: 哎呀，那是错的钥匙！你肯定弄破了错误的动物。再试一次大杠杆——它会告诉你要弄破哪种动物。

english: Hooray, you got the right one! Now pull the lever again and let's get the next portal unlocked!
translation: 万岁，你拿到了对的！现在再拉杠杆，让我们解锁下一个传送门！

english: You did it, you got all the keys right! Thank you! You're my friend FOREVER!
translation: 你做到了，你把所有钥匙都拿对了！谢谢！你永远是我的朋友！

english: Let's get out of here before that cat notices.
translation: 我们在那只猫注意到之前离开这里吧。

english: Hey, bring me that key you've got! I wanna get out of here!
translation: 嘿，把你拿到的钥匙给我！我想出去！

english: Player is teleported back to their original spot
translation: 玩家被传送回原位

english: Thanks a lot for your help! Here, have a present:
translation: 非常感谢你的帮助！来，拿个礼物：

english: Thanks! See you around!
translation: 谢谢！回见！

english: Don't mind me, I was just leaving...
translation: 别在意我，我只是正要离开……

english: Huh?
translation: 哈？

english: Where am I?
translation: 我在哪？

english: On my island.
translation: 在我的岛上。

english: Take me to your leader!
translation: 带我去见你的首领！

english: I am your leader, you are but a slave!
translation: 我就是你的首领，你只是个奴隶！

english: I am not a slave, I am a free person!
translation: 我不是奴隶，我是自由人！

english: Ah-ha-ha-ha-ha-ha!
translation: 啊 - 哈 - 哈 - 哈 - 哈 - 哈！

english: Let me out of here!
translation: 让我出去！

english: I will never let you go, [player name]!
translation: 我永远不会放你走，[player name]！

english: Why not?
translation: 为什么不？

english: Uhm...
Because I say so! And because I can never have enough servants!
translation: 因为我说如此！而且因为我永远缺仆人！

english: Now catch me some fish, I'm hungry.
translation: 现在给我抓些鱼，我饿了。

english: What fish, where?
translation: 什么鱼，在哪？

english: Talk to my other servants, and hurry it up!
translation: 跟我的其他仆人谈谈，快点！

english: What's it all about?
translation: 这都是关于什么的？

english: Sit down and I'll tell you. It's a question of servant shortage.
translation: 坐下，我告诉你。这是因为仆人不够用。

english: Go on.
translation: 继续说。

english: You are a skilled worker. A human like you is worth a great deal as a slave.
translation: 你是个熟练工。像你这样的人类当奴隶可是很值钱的。

english: A slave?? I will have nothing to do with you. Is that clear? Absolutely nothing.
translation: 奴隶？？我才不跟你扯上关系。清楚吗？绝无可能。

english: Now be reasonable little human. It's just a matter of time before you will do everything I ask you to. Play along and this can be a very nice place.
translation: 现在理智点，小不点人类。你迟早会做我要求你做的一切。配合点，这里也能过得舒服。

english: I will not make any deals with you. I'm a human. I will not be pushed, numbered, meowed at, teleported or enslaved. My life is my own.
translation: 我不会跟你做任何交易。我是人类。我不会被推搡、编号、猫叫、传送或奴役。我的人生属于我自己。

english: Is it?
translation: 是吗？

english: Yes. You won't hold me.
translation: 是的。你困不住我。

english: Won't I?
translation: 困不住？

english: Let me assure you there's no way out.
translation: 让我告诉你，这里没有出路。

english: Just ask my servants!
translation: 问问我的仆人们！

english: How is it possible that you're talking?
translation: 你怎么可能会说话？

english: How is it possible that you're not meowing?
translation: 你怎么可能不猫叫？

english: Meowing?? Why would I be meowing?
translation: 猫叫？？我为什么要猫叫？

english: Most humans do, that's why I'm wearing this amulet of Man speak... but I do try to train my staff in civilised speech.
translation: 大多数人类都会，所以我才戴着这个人类语护符……但我确实努力训练我的员工说文明话。

english: Ah, but I suppose things are slightly different in your world... what a dreadful place that must be.
translation: 啊，但我想你们世界的情况可能略有不同……那地方一定很可怕。

english: I think I'm getting a headache...
translation: 我觉得头都要疼了……

english: What did you do to Bob?
translation: 你对鲍勃做了什么？

english: Bob? I am Bob!
translation: 鲍勃？我就是鲍勃！

translation: 嗯，不完全是小恶魔。结果它们毕竟不是最低级的恶魔形式。我弄到了这些地狱鼠。

translation: 如果你能找到路走出我的末日地下室的话！

translation: 我们将一起带领基利诺尔进入新的黑暗时代！

translation: 你当然会回来！没人能逃脱我的黑暗力量！

english: Weren't you going to give up evil?
translation: 你不是要放弃邪恶吗？

english: Yeah, well...
translation: 是啊，嗯……

translation: 我试过了。我穿了这件鲜红色的毛衣，早上起床在外面阳光下待了一天……

english: *Dave shudders*

english: But I couldn't keep it up. I just didn't find anything good very interesting, you know?
translation: 但我坚持不下来。我就是觉得任何好事都没什么意思，你懂的？

translation: 有时我担心邪恶的后果。我真的不想任何人受伤，不像德纳斯那次。

english: But I can't not be evil! It's just who I am!
translation: 但我不能不邪恶！这就是我的本性！

english: Let me try to explain the time travel thing again...

english: Although you're here, you're also still in the time freeze.
translation: 虽然你在这里，但你也仍处于时间冻结中。

english: What?

english: What? I didn't notice anything.
translation: 什么？我没注意到什么。

english: Of course you didn't! You were frozen!
translation: 当然你没注意到！你被冻结了！

english: So how can I be there and also here? Which one is me?
translation: 那我怎么能既在那里又在这里？哪个是我？

english: I mean, I feel like I'm me, but what if I'm not me?
translation: 我是说，我觉得我是我，但如果我不是我呢？

english: That would be terrible!
translation: 那就糟了！

english: They're both you!
translation: 它们都是你！

english: From YOUR point of view I've saved you, but from MINE I haven't.
translation: 在你看来我救了你，但在我看来可没有。

english: Well that's all right, as long as I'm saved from my point of view!
translation: 没关系，只要我觉得自己被救了就行！

english: But I have to save you, otherwise you won't be saved!
translation: 但我必须救你，否则你就不会被救！

english: But I'm here so you must already have saved me!
translation: 但我在这里，所以你肯定已经救了我！

english: That's what I meant, from your point of view I've saved you but from mine I haven't!
translation: 我就是那个意思，从你的角度来看我救了你，但从我的角度来看我没有！

english: I've to take the food back in time to give it to you.
translation: 我必须把食物带回到过去给你。

english: Why?

english: But I was saved from the spell! I remember it!
translation: 但我被从法术中救出来了！我记得！

translation: 没错！这就是我知道我必须回去救你的原因！

english: What will happen if you don't?

english: I can't not, because I already have!
translation: 我不能不，因为我已经做了！

english: The fact that you're here means I already did save you, which means that you have to tell me the correct recipe. It's logically impossible for you not to!
translation: 你在这里的事实意味着我已经救了你，这意味着你必须告诉我正确的配方。你不可能不告诉！

translation: 不错。比在那个该死的营地好，虽然我确实希望有自己的船。

english: I hope you're not considering mutiny!

english: Never, Captain!

english: Ah, time to stretch my legs!

english: Your crew start moving the contents of the cargo hold...

english: How are you getting on?

english: Doing well, thanks! Anything like this beats being behind a desk anyway.

english: I'd best be off.

english: This really is my passion.

english: Life is easier on the sea.

english: This is so much better than being cooped up in that camp.

english: I'm just happy to be here.

english: This reminds me of my last holiday.

english: Thank you, iknil. I shall use it to reinforce the seal.
translation: 谢谢你，伊克尼尔。我会用它来加固封印。

english: I wanted to ask you about your masters.
translation: 我想问问你关于你的主人。

english: What do you wish to know?
translation: 你想了解什么？

english: I guess anything really. I still know so little about them.
translation: 我想什么都行。我对他们仍然知之甚少。

english: If your hope is that I can tell you about a whole race, then I am likely to disappoint you, iknil. The masters were secretive individuals. They rarely divulged information that I did not require.
translation: 如果你希望我能告诉你关于整个种族的事，那我可能会让你失望，伊克尼尔。主人们是很隐秘的个体。他们很少泄露我不需要的信息。

english: All I can tell you about are the three individuals that I knew personally.
translation: 我能告诉你的只有我亲自认识的三个人。

english: That's still something. What were they like?
translation: 那也不错。他们是什么样的人？

english: They were kind, but filled with sadness. As you know, they summoned me after another of their kind unleashed the Moons of Peril.
translation: 他们很善良，但充满了悲伤。如你所知，他们在另一个同类释放灾厄之月后召唤了我。

english: It was a dark time. Their people had suffered great calamity years earlier and their extinction was inevitable.
translation: 那是个黑暗的时代。他们的人民多年前遭受了巨大灾难，灭绝是不可避免的。

english: It seems that many, such as the shaman who summoned the Moons, felt that the only salvation left was destruction.
translation: 似乎许多人，比如召唤月亮的萨满，觉得剩下的唯一救赎就是毁灭。

english: My masters, however, felt differently. They fought for a world that was no longer their own. They believed in preserving these lands for those who would inhabit them afterwards.
translation: 但我的主人们感觉不同。他们为一个不再属于他们的世界而战。他们相信为后来居住在这片土地上的人保护这些地方。

english: Us?
translation: 我们？

english: Yes. Humans and dwarves were recent arrivals here, but the masters saw you as inheritors. I believe in some ways, you offered them hope in a time filled with pain.
translation: 是的。人类和矮人是这里的新来者，但主人们把你们视为继承者。我相信在某种程度上，你们在充满痛苦的时代给了他们希望。

english: I see. Thanyou for sharing that with me.
translation: 我明白了。谢谢你跟我分享这些。

english: It is not a problem, iknil.
translation: 没问题，伊克尼尔。

english: Do you ever get tired of guarding this place?
translation: 你会厌倦守护这个地方吗？

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: Care to explain further?
translation: 愿意进一步解释吗？

english: Does the stream tire of eroding the earth? Does the earth tire of forming the mountain?
translation: 溪流会厌倦侵蚀大地吗？大地会厌倦形成山脉吗？

english: Not that I can tell.
translation: 据我所知不会。

english: I have more in common with them than I do with most of your kind, iknil. Think of me as you do them.
translation: 我与他们比与你们大多数同类更有共同点，伊克尼尔。把我当成他们那样想。

english: This place is beautiful. I thought it was supposed to be a prison?
translation: 这个地方很美。我以为这应该是个监狱？

english: It is a prison. Everything around us serves that purpose.
translation: 这是个监狱。我们周围的一切都服务于那个目的。

english: Even the plants and the streams?
translation: 连植物和溪流也是？

english: I am a nagua of earth and stream. Being close to both empowers me to do my task.
translation: 我是大地与溪流的那伽。亲近两者赋予我完成任务的力量。

english: Just as being far from moonlight weakens the Moons of Peril.
translation: 就像远离月光会削弱灾厄之月一样。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Congratulations on your reward, iknil. That is a treasure from ages past.
translation: 恭喜你的奖励，伊克尼尔。那是来自远古的宝藏。

english: Yeah, about that... I don't really like this one. Could I have a different one?
translation: 是啊，关于那个……我不太喜欢这个。能换一个吗？

english: Was that rude?
translation: 那粗鲁吗？

english: I was just... Processing. I suppose I could allow you another chance to obtain a piece of equipment, but it won't be guaranteed.
translation: 我只是……在处理。我想我可以再给你一次获得装备的机会，但不能保证。

english: Yes, that sounds good.
translation: 是的，听起来不错。

english: You're certain, Iknil? You could end up with nothing.
translation: 你确定吗，伊克尼尔？你可能最后什么都得不到。

english: Very well.
translation: 很好。

english: No luck this time, iknil.
translation: 这次运气不好，伊克尼尔。

english: Oh... Can I have it back?
translation: 哦……能还给我吗？

english: Congratulations, iknil. Enjoy your new equipment.
translation: 恭喜，伊克尼尔。享受你的新装备。

english: Congratulations, ik-
translation: 恭喜，ik-

english: This is the same thing I just gave you!
translation: 这就是我刚给你的东西！

english: So it seems. You're welcome to try again.
translation: 看来是这样。欢迎再试一次。

english: Actually, I don't dislike it that much. I think I'll keep it.
translation: 其实，我没那么讨厌它。我想我会留着它。

english: Eyatlalli's voice echoes through the surrounding earth...
translation: 埃亚塔利的声音在周围的大地中回荡……

english: Eyatlalli: Thank you, iknil. The Eclipse Moon of Peril is sufficiently distracted. You should now proceed on to the next one.
translation: 埃亚塔利：谢谢你，伊克尼尔。灾厄之月 - 月蚀已被充分分散注意力。你现在应该前往下一个。

english: Eyatlalli: Thank you, iknil. The Blue Moon of Peril is sufficiently distracted. You should now proceed on to the next one.
translation: 埃亚塔利：谢谢你，伊克尼尔。灾厄之月 - 蓝月已被充分分散注意力。你现在应该前往下一个。

english: Eyatlalli: Thank you, iknil. The Blood Moon of Peril is sufficiently distracted. You should now proceed on to the next one.
translation: 埃亚塔利：谢谢你，伊克尼尔。灾厄之月 - 血月已被充分分散注意力。你现在应该前往下一个。

english: Eyatlalli: Thank you, iknil. The Moons are sufficiently distracted. Return to me for your reward.
translation: 埃亚塔利：谢谢你，伊克尼尔。灾厄之月们已被充分分散注意力。回来找我领取奖励。

english: Eyatlalli's voice echoes through the surrounding earth.
translation: 埃亚塔利的声音在周围的大地中回荡。

english: Thank you, iknil. The Eclipse Moon of Peril is sufficiently distracted. You should now proceed on to the next one.
translation: 谢谢你，伊克尼尔。灾厄之月 - 月蚀已被充分分散注意力。你现在应该前往下一个。

english: Thank you, iknil. The Blue Moon of Peril is sufficiently distracted. You should now proceed on to the next one.
translation: 谢谢你，伊克尼尔。灾厄之月 - 蓝月已被充分分散注意力。你现在应该前往下一个。

english: Thank you, iknil. The Blood Moon of Peril is sufficiently distracted. You should now proceed on to the next one.
translation: 谢谢你，伊克尼尔。灾厄之月 - 血月已被充分分散注意力。你现在应该前往下一个。

english: Thank you, iknil. The Moons are sufficiently distracted. Return to me for your reward.
translation: 谢谢你，伊克尼尔。灾厄之月们已被充分分散注意力。回来找我领取奖励。

english: Welcome back, iknil. You have timed your arrival here well, for Neypotzli is in danger once more. There are interlopers present who have little regard for the dangers posed by the Moons of Peril.
translation: 欢迎回来，伊克尼尔。你来得正是时候，因为 Neypotzli 再次陷入危险。有一些闯入者不太在意灾厄之月带来的危险。

english: Well, that's exactly why I'm here. I know who these interlopers are and I know what they're after.
translation: 嗯，那正是我来这里的原因。我知道这些闯入者是谁，也知道他们在找什么。

english: Yes, I suspected that to be the case. Your arrival was too precise to be coincidence. Tell me, what do the interlopers seek?
translation: 是的，我怀疑就是这样。你来得太精准了，不可能是巧合。告诉我，闯入者在寻找什么？

english: They're after an Old One keystone.
translation: 他们在找一个古老者基石。

english: Old One? A curious term. We nagua measure time as the rivers change their paths and as the mountains erode away.
translation: 古老者？奇怪的术语。我们那伽以河流改道和山脉侵蚀来衡量时间。

english: The days of the masters are fresh memories to me, but to you, one who is so short lived, they are days of myth...
translation: 主人们的时代对我来说是鲜活的记忆，但对你这样寿命短暂的人来说，那是神话时代……

english: Tell me, why do the interlopers seek the magic of the masters?
translation: 告诉我，为什么闯入者寻求主人们的魔法？

english: There's a crypt in the Tlati Rainforest, but it's sealed using Old One magic. These interlopers are cultists who want to get inside. They think they can do so if they have a keystone of their own.
translation: 特拉蒂雨林里有个墓穴，但它是用古老者魔法封印的。这些闯入者是邪教徒，想进去。他们认为如果有自己的基石就能做到。

english: Provided they have the aptitude, I suspect their beliefs are correct.
translation: 只要他们有天赋，我怀疑他们的信仰是正确的。

english: Then we need to stop them before they get one.
translation: 那我们需要在他们拿到之前阻止他们。

english: The icosahedron behind me is a form of keystone, and the interlopers have already tried to tamper with it.
translation: 我身后的二十面体是一种基石，闯入者已经试图 摆弄它了。

english: But you stopped them?
translation: 但你阻止了他们？

english: Yes, but the danger remains. There is another keystone here. An earlier form of the icosahedron from when Neypotzli was being built.
translation: 是的，但危险依然存在。这里还有另一个基石。那是 Neypotzli 建造时二十面体的早期形式。

english: However, the Moons of Peril must remain my priority. I cannot stop the interlopers from trying to obtain it.
translation: 然而，灾厄之月必须是我的首要任务。我无法阻止闯入者试图获得它。

english: Don't worry, I can deal with them. I just need to know where they are.
translation: 别担心，我能对付他们。我只需要知道他们在哪。

english: I can give you a fragment of the icosahedron. It resonates with the magic of the other keystone. It will guide you to it. Go to the keystone, and you will no doubt find the interlopers.
translation: 我可以给你一块二十面体碎片。它与另一个基石的魔法产生共鸣。它会指引你找到它。去基石那里，你无疑会找到闯入者。

english: Thank you, but before I go, there's one other thing...
translation: 谢谢，但在我走之前，还有一件事……

english: What is it?
translation: 是什么？

english: The reason these cultists want to enter that crypt... It's because they think there's a path to Mokhaiotl inside.
translation: 这些 cultists 想进入那个 crypt 的原因……是因为他们认为里面有条通往 Mokhaiotl 的路。

english: Mokhaiotl?
translation: Mokhaiotl？

english: Do you know what it is?
translation: 你知道那是什么吗？

english: The masters were always secretive, especially towards the end. They rarely spoke of the world outside this place, but when they did, they only spoke of pain.
translation: 主人们总是很隐秘，尤其是临近结束时。他们很少谈论这个地方之外的世界，但当他们谈论时，只谈论痛苦。

english: They had already lost so much by the time they summoned me. Their extinction was already guaranteed, yet they kept going all the same.
translation: 他们召唤我时已经失去了太多。他们的灭绝已成定局，但他们仍然坚持。

english: This word... Mokhaiotl... I only heard it once, when things neared the end. It was not clear to me what it was, but when they spoke of it... it was the first time I'd heard them speak with hope.
translation: 这个词……Mokhaiotl……我只听过一次，当事情临近结束时。我不清楚它是什么，但当他们谈到它时……那是我第一次听到他们带着希望说话。

english: Now, I must return to my focus on the Moons of Peril. Seek me out in the chamber to the south east if you need my guidance. Go with haste, iknil. Good luck.
translation: 现在，我必须回去关注灾厄之月。如果你需要我的指引，去东南边的房间找我。抓紧时间，伊克尼尔。祝你好运。

english: Yes, iknil?
translation: 是的，伊克尼尔？

english: I wasn't able to stop those cultists.
translation: 我没能阻止那些 cultists。

english: So they now have the keystone? The magic of the masters is not for them.
translation: 所以他们现在有基石了？主人们的魔法不是给他们的。

english: I'm sorry.
translation: 我很抱歉。

english: Do not apologise, iknil. You still have a chance to stop them.
translation: 别道歉，伊克尼尔。你还有机会阻止他们。

english: That's true I suppose. I guess on that note, I should get going.
translation: 我想也是。既然如此，我该走了。

english: Good luck, iknil.
translation: 祝你好运，伊克尼尔。

english: I lost my weapon fighting the Blue Moon. Could I have it back?
translation: 我在与蓝月战斗时丢了武器。能还给我吗？

english: I found some essence whilst fighting the lesser nagua.
translation: 我在与小那伽战斗时发现了一些精华。

english: I wanted to ask you about your masters.
translation: 我想问问你关于你的主人。

english: Do you ever get tired of guarding this place?
translation: 你会厌倦守护这个地方吗？

english: This place is beautiful. I thought it was supposed to be a prison?
translation: 这个地方很美。我以为这应该是个监狱？

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Yes.
translation: 是。

english: I wasn't able to stop those cultists.
translation: 我没能阻止那些 cultists。

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: Nilsal. I'm afraid I must ask not to be disturbed. There are many things that one in my position must contemplate. If you seek conversation, I'm sure my companion would be willing.
translation: 你好。恐怕我必须请求不要被打扰。处于我这种位置的人有很多事情需要思考。如果你想交谈，我相信我的同伴会愿意。

english: Okay, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Well hello there; welcome to our little village. Pray, stay awhile.
translation: 嗯你好；欢迎来到我们的小村庄。请留步片刻。

english: You know, you sound just like the mayor?
translation: 你知道吗，你听起来就像市长？

english: Really? That's the nicest thing anyone has ever said.
translation: 真的吗？那是有人说过最好听的话。

english: I admire him a great deal. He works so hard for this town.
translation: 我非常钦佩他。他为这个城镇努力工作。

english: You look like him as well?
translation: 你看起来也像他吗？

english: Hmm, I don't think I do.
translation: 嗯，我不这么认为。

english: No really, what with the unhealthy skin tone and bulging eyes. The resemblance is uncanny.
translation: 不真的，看看这不健康的肤色和突出的眼睛。相似得惊人。

english: Well, I haven't spoken to him in a while.  I don't get out much.
translation: 嗯，我有一段时间没跟他说话了。我不常出门。

english: I can see why.
translation: 我明白为什么。

english: Maybe the Mayor has finally seen how much I admire him and has grown to admire me?
translation: 也许市长终于看到我有多钦佩他，并开始钦佩我了？

english: Anything's possible I suppose. Wait a minute, you mean you've always looked that odd?
translation: 我想什么都可能。等等，你是说你一直看起来那么奇怪？

english: Hey, I resent that!
translation: 嘿，我抗议！

english: I'm sorry, it's just...  Nevermind.
translation: 抱歉，只是……算了。

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: I supply the local fishermen with the tools and bait they need to do their job.
translation: 我为当地渔民提供工作所需的工具和鱼饵。

english: Interesting. Have you been doing it long?
translation: 有趣。你做了很久吗？

english: Why yes, all of my life.  I took over from my father, who inherited the business from his father and so on.
translation: 当然是，我的一生都是。我从父亲那里接手，他从他父亲那里继承生意，以此类推。

english: In fact, there have been Lovecraft's selling bait for over ten generations.
translation: 事实上，洛夫克拉夫特家族卖鱼饵已经超过十代了。

english: Wow, that's some lineage.
translation: 哇，那是个家系。

english: Oh yes, we have a long and interesting family history. For one reason or another the Lovecraft's have always been bait sellers or writers.
translation: 哦是的，我们有悠久有趣的家族史。出于这样或那样的原因，洛夫克拉夫特家族一直是鱼饵商或作家。

english: Hmm, yes well. I'm sure it's all fascinating, but I...
translation: 嗯，是的。我相信都很有趣，但我……

english: Oh very, very fascinating, for instance my great grandfather Howard...
translation: 哦非常、非常有趣，比如我的曾祖父霍华德……

english: Yawn. Oh, I'm sorry but I really must be getting on. I think my giraffe needs feeding.
translation: 打哈欠。哦，抱歉但我真的得走了。我想我的长颈鹿需要喂食了。

english: Your?
translation: 你的？

english: Giraffe. Sorry, but he gets cranky without enough sugar. Bye now!
translation: 长颈鹿。抱歉，但他糖不够就会暴躁。再见！

english: Oh right, goodbye.
translation: 哦好的，再见。

english: Can I buy some fishing supplies please?
translation: 我能买些钓鱼用品吗？

english: You are a bit too strange for me. Bye.
translation: 你对我来说有点太奇怪了。再见。

english: Sniff. Yes, everyone says that.
translation: sniff。是的，大家都这么说。

english: You know, you sound just like the mayor?
translation: 你知道吗，你听起来就像市长？

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Can I buy some fishing supplies please?
translation: 我能买些钓鱼用品吗？

english: You are a bit too strange for me. Bye.
translation: 你对我来说有点太奇怪了。再见。

english: Hello there, traveller.
translation: 你好，旅行者。

english: What's going on here? Where is everyone?
translation: 这里发生什么了？大家都在哪？

english: Most are in the city. As for the rest, hopefully somewhere nicer than this place.
translation: 大多数人都在城里。至于其他人，希望他们在比这里更好的地方。

english: In the city?
translation: 在城市里？

english: Yes. When we heard they were going to lock Menaphos down and shut the gates, most people here decided they'd be better off behind the walls than outside them.
translation: 是的。当我们听说他们要封锁梅纳菲斯并关闭大门时，这里的大多数人决定待在墙内比墙外好。

english: But you stayed?
translation: 但你留下了？

english: We didn't get much warning. People had to rush to gather whatever they could. Some things had to be left behind, along with some people...
translation: 我们没得到太多警告。人们不得不匆忙收拾能带走的一切。有些东西不得不留下，连同一些人……

english: That's horrible!
translation: 那太可怕了！

english: It could have been worse. Had we been in Sophanem, we'd have had no warning at all. I just hope it won't be long before things are back to normal.
translation: 可能更糟。如果我们在索菲亚涅姆，我们根本不会有警告。我只希望不久后一切恢复正常。

english: I hope so too.
translation: 我也希望如此。

english: Thank you, traveller. Stay safe out there. These are troubling times.
translation: 谢谢你，旅行者。在外面注意安全。这是动荡的时期。

english: I can't belive Xilo hasn't shown up.
translation: 我不敢相信 Xilo 还没出现。

english: Were you expecting to meet someone here?
translation: 你期望在这里见到某人吗？

english: My... friend, Xilo. I told her to meet me by the magic trees of the rainforest. We don't often have a chance to meet without a crowd of people around.
translation: 我的……朋友，希洛。我告诉她到雨林的魔法树旁见我。我们很少有机会在没有人群围绕的情况下见面。

english: Why? Is she not particularly local to you?
translation: 为什么？她对你来说不是特别本地吗？

english: Unfortunately not. I'm from Aldarin, but she lives in Tal Teklan. It usually takes a special event being hosted for us both to be in the same place.
translation: 不幸不是。我来自 Aldarin，但她住在 Tal Teklan。通常需要举办特殊活动，我们才能在同一个地方。

english: So you never really get any privacy?
translation: 所以你们从未真正有过隐私？

english: Privacy? Are you insinuating something?
translation: 隐私？你在暗示什么？

english: Not at all. Sorry if it seemed like I was.
translation: 完全没有。如果看起来像我很抱歉。

english: It's okay... Sorry... I just miss her.
translation: 没关系……抱歉……我只是想她。

english: Do you think she's just running a little late?
translation: 你觉得她只是迟到了一点吗？

english: It's possible.
translation: 有可能。

english: Could she maybe have considered another tree magical?
translation: 她会不会认为另一棵树是魔法树？

english: I suppose she may be where we first met... but this is where we shared our first... you know...
translation: 我想她可能在我们第一次见面的地方……但这是我们要分享第一次……你懂的……的地方。

english: Well, I'll keep my fingers crossed for you. I'm sure you'll be able to find one another soon!
translation: 嗯，我会为你祈祷。我相信你们很快就能找到彼此！

english: Thank you, iknami.
translation: 谢谢你，朋友。

english: Hang on... I think I might have met this Xilo.
translation: 等等……我想我可能见过这个希洛。

english: You have? Where is she?
translation: 你有？她在哪？

english: By a tree to the north of here.
translation: 在这里北边的一棵树旁。

english: Oh, Xilo! She's gone to where we first met instead! Thank you, iknami. I'll head over there at once!
translation: 哦，Xilo！她去我们第一次见面的地方了！谢谢你，朋友。我马上过去！

english: Fabia departs.
translation: 法比娅离开了。

english: Hello again, iknami! Thank you for helping us find each other!
translation: 又见面了，朋友！谢谢你帮我们找到彼此！

english: To think we were waiting by different trees! It was so silly of us!
translation: 想想我们竟在不同的树旁等待！我们真傻！

english: Well, I'm happy to see you together again. Now, I'm sure you have a lot of catching up to do. I'll leave you to it.
translation: 嗯，很高兴看到你们在一起。现在，我相信你们有很多话要叙旧。我不打扰了。

english: Timoiva, iknami!
translation: 再见，朋友！

english: Don't bother me, can't you see I'm busy?
translation: 别烦我，你没看到我很忙吗？

english: No, I can't... can I go into the factory?
translation: 不，我看不出来……我能进工厂吗？

english: You can go in. The Consortium, in their infinite wisdom, has decided to open up the factory to all and sundry.
translation: 你可以进去。联盟以其''无限的智慧''，决定向所有人开放工厂。

english: How come?
translation: 为什么？

english: We've built a new blast furnace and always have a shortage of people to work on it.
translation: 我们建了一个新高炉，总是缺人操作。

english: I'll have a look, thanks.
translation: 我去看看，谢谢。

english: Just don't go causing any trouble, I still run this factory!
translation: 只是别惹麻烦，我还是这个工厂的负责人！

english: I'm sorry, I'm looking for the blast furnace?
translation: 抱歉，请问高炉在哪？

english: Do I look like a guide to you?
translation: 我看起来像导游吗？

english: No, you look like a hard-working dwarf, but can you please tell me where the blast furnace is?
translation: 不，你看起来像个勤劳的矮人，但能告诉我高炉在哪吗？

english: Alright, just head down the stairs, it's easy to find.
translation: 好吧，就下楼梯，很容易找到。

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

english: Are you okay?
translation: 你没事吧？

english: Don't I look okay?
translation: 我看起来没事吗？

english: If you were any shorter you wouldn't exist.
translation: 如果你再矮点就不存在了。

english: Very funny, human.
translation: 真有趣，人类。

english: What are you dwarves doing in this factory?
translation: 你们矮人在这个工厂做什么？

english: Working of course, can't you see that?
translation: 当然是工作啊，你看不出来吗？

english: But working on what?
translation: 但做什么工作？

english: Refining the ore that is being brought into the factory, of course.
translation: 当然是精炼运进工厂的矿石。

english: And what does that mean?
translation: 那是什么意思？

english: It means you should stop asking so many questions and get back to work!
translation: 意思是你应该停止问这么多问题，回去工作！

english: Who owns this factory?
translation: 谁拥有这个工厂？

english: The Consortium does and that's all you need to know.
translation: 联盟拥有，你只需要知道这个。

english: But what company? I thought there were all these different companies?
translation: 但什么公司？我以为有好多不同的公司？

english: Oh yes, all the major companies own this plant. It's too vital to be in the hands of one company alone.
translation: 哦是的，所有大公司都拥有这个工厂。它太重要了，不能单独掌握在一家公司手中。

english: And what exactly are you doing here?
translation: 那你到底在这里做什么？

english: I tire of these questions. Let me get back to work!
translation: 我厌倦了这些问题。让我回去工作！

english: What?
translation: 什么？

english: What do you do?
translation: 你做什么？

english: You can store your stuff here if you want. You can dump anything you don't want to carry whilst you're fighting duels and then pick it up again on the way out.
translation: 如果你想，可以把东西存在这里。你可以在决斗时放下任何不想带的东西，然后在出去时再拿起来。

english: To be honest I'm wasted here.
translation: 老实说我在这里屈才了。

english: I should be winning duels in an arena! I'm the best warrior in Al Kharid!
translation: 我应该在竞技场赢得决斗！我是阿尔卡里德城最强的战士！

english: Easy, tiger!
translation: 冷静，老虎！

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: Isn't it obvious?
translation: 不明显吗？

english: This is the Emir's Arena...duh!
translation: 这是埃米尔竞技场……废话！

english: I'd like to access my bank, please.
translation: 我想使用我的银行。

english: Sure.
translation: 当然。

english: I'd like to collect items.
translation: 我想取物品。

english: Yeah, okay.
translation: 好的。

english: Do you watch any matches?
translation: 你看比赛吗？

english: Sure, I'll buy some rotten fruit.
translation: 当然，我去买些烂水果。

english: No, I'm not giving you money for rotten fruit.
translation: 不，我不会给你钱买烂水果。

english: Suit yourself.
translation: 随你便。

english: Goodbye, Fadli.
translation: 再见，法德利。

english: What do you do?
translation: 你做什么？

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: I'd like to access my bank, please.
translation: 我想使用我的银行。

english: I'd like to collect items.
translation: 我想取物品。

english: Do you watch any matches?
translation: 你看比赛吗？

english: Have you got any idea where Burthorpe is? The co- ordinator says I need to go there and paint all the leaves yellow, but I've never heard of that place!
translation: 你知道伯索普公国在哪吗？协调员说我要去那里把所有叶子涂成黄色，但我从没听说过那个地方！

english: Be careful when you pick mushrooms near the strange ruins to the south. Some of them will try to eat you!
translation: 在南部奇怪废墟附近采蘑菇时要小心。有些会试图吃掉你！

english: Err, hello. Do you have any idea what a Winter Fairy actually does?
translation: 呃，你好。你知道冬日仙子实际是做什么的吗？

english: No, no idea at all.
translation: 不，完全不知道。

english: Oh, pity. Neither do I, but I'm supposed to be one this week.
translation: 哦，可惜。我也不知道，但我本周应该是其中一个。

english: Sorry, I can't talk I'm looking for Sarah-Jane!
translation: 抱歉，我不能说话，我在找莎拉 - 简！

english: Is your name Freddie, and are you loosing your teeth?
translation: 你叫弗雷迪吗？你在掉牙吗？

english: Err, no. I'm afraid not.
translation: 呃，不。恐怕不是。

english: Oh, right.
translation: 哦，好的。

english: You don't have any idea where I can find him do you?
translation: 你不知道我在哪能找到他吧？

english: No, I don't know that either.
translation: 不，我也不知道。

english: Oh, ok then. If you do find out please let me know. The co-ordinator has sent me to find him.
translation: 哦，好吧。如果你知道了请告诉我。协调员派我来找他。

english: I'm afraid I can't stop to chat. I've just been told to get ready to go to Etceteria for some reason or other!
translation: 恐怕我不能停下聊天。我刚被告知要准备好去埃特塞特拉，出于某种原因！

english: Picking mushrooms near the forge will probably end quite badly for you.
translation: 在锻造厂附近采蘑菇可能会下场很惨。

english: I don't want to go back! That orc tried to kill me!
translation: 我不想回去！那个兽人想杀我！

english: We must find a way to fight back! To throw those villains out of our homes.
translation: 我们必须找到反击的方法！把那些恶棍赶出我们的家园。

english: I can't believe that there are orcs in Zanaris.
translation: 我不敢相信扎纳里斯有兽人。

english: Have you heard? The Godfather has allowed orcs into Zanaris!
translation: 你听说了吗？教父允许兽人进入扎纳里斯！

english: Those fairies that side with the Godfather are all traitors! The Queen is the true ruler of Zanaris!
translation: 那些站在教父一边的仙女都是叛徒！女王才是扎纳里斯真正的统治者！

english: Have you seen Fairy Cake? She went to talk to the Godfather and I haven't seen her since.
translation: 你见过仙子蛋糕吗？她去跟教父谈话，从那以后我再没见过她。

english: How is the Queen? Has she woken up yet?
translation: 女王怎么样？她醒了吗？

english: The Queen is the true ruler of Zanaris! We shall over- throw the tyrant!
translation: 女王是扎纳里斯真正的统治者！我们将推翻暴君！

english: Is the council finished yet?
translation: 议会结束了吗？

english: Once the council of war is finished we shall go and get rid of the Godfather.
translation: 一旦战争议会结束，我们就去除掉教父。

english: I'm so looking forward to going back home!
translation: 我很期待回家！

english: Thank you for waking our queen.
translation: 谢谢你唤醒我们的女王。

english: Now that the Queen is awake everything will be alright.
translation: 既然女王醒了，一切都会好起来的。

english: This fairy ring will take you out of Zanaris. It leads to the place known as Al-Kharid in your realm. Once passed you can not return this way.
translation: 这个仙女环会带你离开扎纳里斯。它通往你们领域称为阿尔卡里德城的地方。一旦通过你就不能原路返回。

english: Before leaving make sure that you have fully sampled the delights of our marketplace.
translation: 离开前确保你充分体验了我们市场的乐趣。

english: I think I'll stay down here a bit longer.
translation: 我想我会在这里多待一会儿。

english: As you wish.
translation: 如你所愿。

english: Yes, I'm ready to leave.
translation: 是的，我准备好离开了。

english: I think I'll stay down here a bit longer.
translation: 我想我会在这里多待一会儿。

english: Yes, I'm ready to leave.
translation: 是的，我准备好离开了。

english: Hello, my name is [player name]. Who are you?
translation: 你好，我叫 [player name]。你是谁？

english: Oh hello [player name]. I'm Aeryka. Aery for short.
translation: 哦你好 [player name]。我是艾莉卡。简称艾莉。

english: Airy Fairy?
translation: 轻盈仙女？

english: That's right. What can I do for you?
translation: 没错。我能为你做什么？

english: What's that crop circle thing doing here?
translation: 那个麦田圈在这里做什么？

english: Crop circle? Oh, you mean the Puromantic portal?
translation: 麦田圈？哦，你是说普罗曼蒂克传送门？

english: The pyromanic what?
translation: 什么普罗曼蒂克？

english: The Puromantic portal. At least that's what we call them. It's the way the implings travel from Puro-Puro to other planes.
translation: 普罗曼蒂克传送门。至少我们这么叫它们。这是小精灵从普鲁普鲁前往其他位面的方式。

english: Puro-Puro?
translation: 普鲁普鲁？

english: The impling home. We call it Puro-Puro. The implings just call it home, I think.
translation: 小精灵之家。我们叫它普鲁普鲁。我想小精灵只叫它家。

english: It's still here.
translation: 它还在这里。

english: Pardon?
translation: 什么？

english: It's still here. The crop circle is still here.
translation: 它还在这里。麦田圈还在这里。

english: Oh yes, thanks Aery. It didn't go anywhere in the meantime, then?
translation: 哦是的，谢谢艾莉。那期间它没去任何地方，对吧？

english: Nope. It just sat there.
translation: 没有。它就待在那里。

english: Jolly good. I can come back and visit Puro-Puro whenever I want then. Brilliant!
translation: 太好了。那我随时可以回来参观普鲁普鲁。太棒了！

english: What's in Puro-Puro?
translation: 普鲁普鲁里有什么？

english: Implings...and wheat.
translation: 小精灵……和小麦。

english: Erm, anything else?
translation: 呃，还有别的吗？

english: Not really. Though I have noticed quite a lot of you humans travelling through the portal recently. I suppose you must like wheat.
translation: 不太有。虽然我注意到最近很多你们人类穿过传送门。我想你们一定喜欢小麦。

english: Well, most of us prefer lobsters to be perfectly honest, but there must be something interesting there.
translation: 嗯，老实说我们大多数人更喜欢龙虾，但那里肯定有什么有趣的东西。

english: Oh, I did notice a very serious-looking gnome go into the portal. Maybe he knows what's going on.
translation: 哦，我确实注意到一个看起来很严肃的地精进了传送门。也许他知道发生了什么。

english: Do you remember what his name was?
translation: 你记得他叫什么吗？

english: Errm, Egg-nog, or something like that.
translation: 呃，蛋酒，或类似的东西。

english: Right, thanks! I'll have a chat with him when I go. Maybe he'll know what's going on.
translation: 好的，谢谢！我去的时候跟他聊聊。也许他知道发生了什么。

english: So what are these implings then?
translation: 那么这些小精灵是什么？

english: Well, no-one knows for sure. The mischievous little creatures are probably related to imps. And they fly as well.
translation: 嗯，没人确切知道。这些淘气的小生物可能跟小恶魔有关。而且它们也会飞。

english: Also, like imps, they love collecting things. I'm not sure why, though. They also seem to like being chased.
translation: 而且，像小恶魔一样，它们喜欢收集东西。不过我不确定为什么。它们似乎也喜欢被追逐。

english: So how would I get hold of what they are carrying, then?
translation: 那我怎么拿到它们携带的东西？

english: Catch them, I suppose. I don't know really. Why would you want to?
translation: 抓住它们，我想。我真的不知道。你为什么要？

english: Well, if they were carrying something useful. Maybe I could catch them with a big net - like butterflies.
translation: 嗯，如果它们携带有用的东西。也许我可以用大网抓住它们——像蝴蝶一样。

english: Sounds a bit cruel to me, but I suppose that's possible.
translation: 听起来有点残忍，但我想那是可能的。

english: I've heard I may find dragon equipment in Puro-Puro.
translation: 我听说可能在普鲁普鲁找到龙金装备。

english: Really? You humans like that stuff a lot, don't you? I don't like really old stuff myself.
translation: 真的吗？你们人类很喜欢那种东西，对吧？我自己不太喜欢太旧的东西。

english: Old?
translation: 旧？

english: Yes, dragon stuff feels really old.
translation: 是的，龙金装备感觉真的很旧。

english: How can you tell that?
translation: 你怎么看出来的？

english: From its magical aura, obviously. Oh, I forget you humans can't feel auras.
translation: 当然是从它的魔法光环看出来的。哦，我忘了你们人类感觉不到光环。

english: How old is old?
translation: 多旧算旧？

english: Really, really, old.
translation: 非常，非常，旧。

english: Can you be any more precise?
translation: 你能更精确点吗？

english: Not really. Time doesn't really mean a lot round here. Hundreds, maybe thousands of your human lifespans, I suppose. Anyway, it would have to be old since it all comes from the Necrosyrtes.
translation: 不太能。时间在这里没什么意义。我想是你们人类寿命的几百倍，也许几千倍吧。总之，它肯定很旧，因为它都来自尼克罗赛特斯。

english: Necrosyrtes? Who are they?
translation: 尼克罗赛特斯？他们是谁？

english: Old and powerful creatures. I don't think there have been any around here for aeons. I haven't seen one. I don't think they are very nice. Not like me. Anyway, this is all ancient history. Boooring!
translation: 古老而强大的生物。我想这里已经几亿年没有他们了。我没见过。我觉得他们不太好。不像我。总之，这都是古代历史了。好无聊！

english: While I'm on the subject do you have any dragon stuff I can have?
translation: 既然说到这个，你有什么龙金装备能给我吗？

english: Oh, I did have loads, but I threw it away.
translation: 哦，我确实有很多，但我扔掉了。

english: What?
translation: 什么？

english: Only joking.
translation: 开玩笑的。

english: No, sorry, I can't help you there. You'll have to look for it yourself. Although, maybe if you find Necrosyrtes then they'll give you some. I heard they give dragon stuff away to people they like. Not fairies. We're too
translation: 不，抱歉，我帮不了你。你得自己去找。不过，也许如果你找到尼克罗赛特斯，他们会给你一些。我听说他们会把龙金装备送给他们喜欢的人。不是仙女。

english: nice.
translation: 我们太好了。

english: No, bye!
translation: 不，再见！

english: See you around!
translation: 回见！

english: What's in Puro-Puro?
translation: 普鲁普鲁里有什么？

english: So what are these implings then?
translation: 那么这些小精灵是什么？

english: I've heard I may find dragon equipment in Puro-Puro.
translation: 我听说可能在普鲁普鲁找到龙金装备。

english: No, bye!
translation: 不，再见！

english: What is it, human? Busy busy busy!
translation: 什么事，人类？忙忙忙！

english: Why are you carrying that toolbox?
translation: 你为什么拿着那个工具箱？

english: It's the fizgog! It's picking up cable again!
translation: 是菲兹戈格！它又接收到信号了！

english: Uh, right. So is it safe to use the fairy rings then?
translation: 呃，好吧。那使用仙女环安全吗？

english: Sure, as long as you have been given permission to use them. You should just be aware that using the fairy rings sometimes has strange results, the locations that you have been to may affect the locations you are
translation: 当然，只要你被允许使用它们。你应该知道，使用仙女环有时会有奇怪的结果，

english: trying to reach. I could fix it by replacing the fizgog and the whosprangit, I've put in a request for some new parts but they're pretty hard to get hold of, it seems.
translation: 你去过的地点可能会影响你试图到达的地点。我可以通过更换菲兹戈格和胡斯普兰吉特来修复它，我已经申请了一些新部件，但似乎很难弄到。

english: I'm okay, thanks.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

english: Pssst! Human! I've got something for you.
translation: 嘘！人类！我有东西给你。

english: What have you got for me?
translation: 你有什么给我？

english: They said you'd helped cure our Queen. I haven't got a lot of rewards to offer, but my enchantment scrolls might help if you're working with fairy rings in your home.
translation: 他们说你帮助治愈了我们的女王。我没什么大奖励可提供，但如果你在家里使用仙女环，我的附魔卷轴可能会有帮助。

english: Not interested, thanks.
translation: 没兴趣，谢谢。

english: Why are you carrying that toolbox?
translation: 你为什么拿着那个工具箱？

english: I'm okay, thanks.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

english: What have you got for me?
translation: 你有什么给我？

english: Not interested, thanks.
translation: 没兴趣，谢谢。

english: The Godfather is ignoring you.
translation: 教父在无视你。

english: Err, Godfather, I can't help noticing that there seems to be Orcs wandering around Zanaris.
translation: 呃，教父，我不禁注意到似乎有兽人在扎纳里斯游荡。

english: Yous just-a better keep-a your nose outa my business. I's da Godfather and I's da one who's inna charge here.
translation: 你最好别多管闲事。我是教父，这里我说了算。

english: Do you know what these strange marks mean?
translation: 你知道这些奇怪标记是什么意思吗？

english: For why you show-a me dat? Eez very nice to see yous learning to draw! Bravo!
translation: 你为什么给我看那个？很高兴看到你在学画画！好极了！

english: Ah, iz-a you. I make-a you an offer, eh? Iz-a good offer. You can't-a refuse it.
translation: 啊，是你。我给你开个价，嗯？是个好价钱。你不能拒绝。

english: What?
translation: 什么？

english: You tell-a me ze answer to dis, si?
translation: 你告诉我这个的答案，是吗？

english: You tell-a me your answer, si?
translation: 你告诉我你的答案，是吗？

english: Iz-a no good.
translation: 不行。

english: Grazie infinite!
translation: 非常感谢！

english: What do you do around here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Oh, I'm the resident healer. My name is Nuff, Fairy Nuff. Who are you?
translation: 哦，我是这里的医师。我叫纳夫，仙子纳夫。你是谁？

english: My name is [player name].
translation: 我叫 [player name]。

english: Pleased to meet you, [player name]. As I was saying, I'm the healer in Zanaris. I graduated over 200 human years ago. Look, there's my Advanced Healing Certificate on the wall. I never go anywhere without it.
translation: 很高兴认识你，[player name]。正如我所说，我是扎纳里斯的医师。我200多个人类年前就毕业了。看，墙上那是我的高级治疗证书。我从不离身。

english: It's my job to look after the sick, wounded or dying fairies around here. Of course, fairies being magical by nature, not many of them get hurt, so I don't normally have much to do.
translation: 我的工作是照顾这里生病、受伤或垂死的仙女。当然，仙女天生有魔法，没几个会受伤，所以我通常没什么事做。

english: What about healing humans? Lots of adventurers must get hurt fighting the Otherworldly beings.
translation: 那治疗人类呢？很多冒险者跟异界生物战斗肯定会受伤。

english: Yes they do. Silly isn't it? I do use my healing magic on humans sometimes, but I don't like them attacking our other guests, so I charge them for the service.
translation: 是的他们会。很傻对吧？我有时确实对人类用治疗魔法，但我不喜欢他们攻击我们的其他客人，所以我收费。

english: How much do you charge to heal someone, then?
translation: 那你治疗一个人收多少钱？

english: Well, the gold that you humans are so fond of has no real value in Zanaris, so I ask my patients to pay me in gems.
translation: 嗯，你们人类喜欢的金币在扎纳里斯没什么实际价值，所以我让病人用宝石付钱。

english: I will heal 4 hitpoints for an opal, 5 hitpoints for either a sapphire or a piece of jade, 7 hitpoints for an emerald or red topaz, 9 for a ruby and 11 for a diamond.
translation: 我治4生命值收一个欧泊，5生命值收一个蓝宝石或一块翡翠，7生命值收一个祖母绿或红托帕石，9生命值收一个红宝石，11生命值收一个钻石。

english: Only 11 hitpoints for a diamond? Doesn't that seem a bit steep?
translation: 钻石才治11生命值？那是不是有点贵？

english: Maybe to you, but you'd be surprised how many adventurer's are willing to pay those prices.
translation: 也许对你来说，但你会惊讶有多少冒险者愿意付那个价。

english: Hello [player name], do you need any assistance?
translation: 你好 [player name]，需要帮助吗？

english: Yes, please. I need healing.
translation: 是的，谢谢。我需要治疗。

english: Yes, please. I need healing.
translation: 是的，谢谢。我需要治疗。

english: 4 Hitpoints.
translation: 4生命值。

english: That will cost you 1 opal.
translation: 那要你1个欧泊。

english: All right.
translation: 好的。

english: You don't have aopal to pay me!
translation: 你没有欧泊付给我！

english: Whoops, sorry.
translation: 哎呀，抱歉。

english: On second thoughts, no thanks.
translation: 再想想，不用了，谢谢。

english: Ok, suit yourself.
translation: 好吧，随你便。

english: 5 Hitpoints.
translation: 5生命值。

english: That will cost you 1 sapphire or 1 piece of jade.
translation: 那要你1个蓝宝石或1块翡翠。

english: You don't have a sapphire or a piece of jade with you!
translation: 你身上没有蓝宝石或翡翠！

english: 7 Hitpoints.
translation: 7生命值。

english: That will cost you 1 emerald or 1 red topaz.
translation: 那要你1个祖母绿或1个红托帕石。

english: You don't have an emerald or a red topaz to pay me with!
translation: 你没有祖母绿或红托帕石付给我！

english: 9 Hitpoints.
translation: 9生命值。

english: That will cost you 1 diamond.
translation: 那要你1个钻石。

english: You don't have a diamond to pay me!
translation: 你没有钻石付给我！

english: 11 Hitpoints.
translation: 11生命值。

english: That will cost you 1 ruby.
translation: 那要你1个红宝石。

english: You don't have a ruby to pay me!
translation: 你没有红宝石付给我！

english: No thanks. Just looking around.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。只是随便看看。

english: Ok. If you want to know anything, just ask.
translation: 好的。如果想知道什么，尽管问。

english: How is the Fairy Queen doing?
translation: 仙子女王怎么样？

english: Not too well; the Godfather hasn't given me those secateurs yet.
translation: 不太好；教父还没把修枝剪给我。

english: Why aren't you in the war room with the Fairy Queen and her advisors?
translation: 你为什么不在战室跟仙子女王和她的顾问在一起？

english: I don't like war! I don't believe that violence is ever justified, that's why I became a healer.
translation: 我不喜欢战争！我不认为暴力有任何正当性，这就是我成为医师的原因。

english: 4 Hitpoints.
translation: 4生命值。

english: All right.
translation: 好的。

english: On second thoughts, no thanks.
translation: 再想想，不用了，谢谢。

english: 5 Hitpoints.
translation: 5生命值。

english: 7 Hitpoints.
translation: 7生命值。

english: 9 Hitpoints.
translation: 9生命值。

english: 11 Hitpoints.
translation: 11生命值。

english: No thanks. Just looking around.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。只是随便看看。

english: How do crops and such survive down here? Surely they need a bit of sunlight?
translation: 庄稼之类的在这里怎么存活？肯定需要点阳光吧？

english: Clearly you come from a plane dependent on sunlight. Down here, the plants grow in the aura of faerie.
translation: 显然你来自依赖阳光的位面。在这里，植物在仙女光环中生长。

english: What's so good about this place?
translation: 这地方有什么好的？

english: Zanaris is a meeting point of cultures. Those from many worlds converge here to exchange knowledge and goods.
translation: 扎纳里斯是文化交汇点。来自许多世界的人在这里汇聚，交换知识和货物。

english: Have you managed to work out a plan yet?
translation: 你制定出计划了吗？

english: Not yet, [player name], but it looks like we'll need to ask you for your help again, I'm afraid. I'll be able to tell you more once we have finished making our battle plans.
translation: 还没有，[player name]，但看来我们恐怕得再次请求你的帮助。等我们制定好作战计划后，我能告诉你更多。

english: Please solve this for me. I have other things to be thinking about.
translation: 请帮我解决这个。我还有别的事要想。

english: The Fairy Queen has given you a puzzle box!
translation: 仙子女王给了你一个谜题盒！

english: Sorry but you haven't solved the puzzle yet.
translation: 抱歉但你还没解开谜题。

english: Thanks [player name]!
translation: 谢谢 [player name]！

english: The Fairy Queen has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 仙子女王给了你另一个线索卷轴！

english: How do crops and such survive down here?
translation: 庄稼之类的在这里怎么存活？

english: What's so good about this place?
translation: 这地方有什么好的？

english: How goes the council of war?
translation: 作战议会进展如何？

english: Slowly, I'm afraid. We're still trying to come up with a reasonable plan.
translation: 很慢，恐怕。我们还在试图制定一个合理的计划。

english: 'Ello, sugar. I'm afraid I can't gossip right now, I've got a cake in the oven.
translation: 你好，亲爱的。恐怕我现在不能闲聊，烤箱里有个蛋糕。

english: Oi you! Did you think I didn't see that? That's my chocolate bar, that is!
translation: 喂你！你以为我没看见吗？那是我的巧克力棒！

english: Oh, sorry. I didn't realise it belonged to anybody.
translation: 哦，抱歉。我没意识到它属于任何人。

english: That's alright, honey. You look a bit thin anyway. Take it if you need it.
translation: 没关系，亲爱的。反正你看起来有点瘦。需要就拿去吧。

english: Do you know what these strange marks mean?
translation: 你知道这些奇怪标记是什么意思吗？

english: Sorry dearie, no, but I have seen a sign with similar marks near the mysterious ruins. You know, the ones that lead you to the Cosmic Rune Altar.
translation: 抱歉亲爱的，不知道，但我在神秘废墟附近见过有类似标记的牌子。你知道，就是通向宇宙符石祭坛的那些。

english: Can I help you at all?
translation: 有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Yes please. What are you selling?
translation: 你在卖什么？

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Can I help you at all?
translation: 有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Yes please. What are you selling?
translation: 你在卖什么？

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Hi there [player name]. I am Falo the bard! Like my brother Olaf, who lives in Rellekka, I also write music.
translation: 你好 [player name]。我是吟游诗人法洛！像我住在雷勒克卡的兄弟奥拉夫一样，我也创作音乐。

english: (continues below)
translation: (见下文)

english: Hi there [Fremennik name]. I am Falo the bard! Like my brother Olaf, who lives in Rellekka, I also write music.
translation: 你好 [Fremennik name]。我是吟游诗人法洛！像我住在雷勒克卡的兄弟奥拉夫一样，我也创作音乐。

english: Do you write about anything in particular?
translation: 你写什么特别的东西吗？

english: Oh most certainly! I write about all the objects in the lands. From weapons and armour to palm trees and sands. That's why I wander far from Rellekka to seek inspiration.
translation: 哦当然！我写这片土地上的所有物体。从武器和盔甲到棕榈树和沙滩。这就是我远离雷勒克卡游历寻找灵感的原因。

english: I have one problem though. I am very forgetful, I can never remember which particular object a song was about.
translation: 不过我有个问题。我很健忘，永远记不住一首歌是关于哪个特定物体的。

english: Surely the lyrics for such a song would be enough to help you remember?
translation: 这种歌的歌词肯定足以帮你记住吧？

english: I am afraid not. It saddens me deeply, so I often send out messages to adventurers to help me discreetly.
translation: 恐怕不行。这让我很伤心，所以我经常悄悄发消息给冒险者帮我。

english: I'll keep a look out for them! Goodbye Falo.
translation: 我会留意的！再见法洛。

english: Hi there! Who are you?
translation: 你好！你是谁？

english: Get away! I do not speak to outlanders.
translation: 走开！我不跟外乡人说话。

english: Thank you for coming [Fremennik name], I need your help.
translation: 谢谢你前来，[Fremennik name]，我需要你的帮助。

english: I have one of my old songs stuck in my head, but I cannot remember what the object it refers to is. I am so forgetful. I'll sing it to you.
translation: 我脑子里卡着一首旧歌，但记不起它指的是什么物体。我太健忘了。我唱给你听。

english: What a beautiful song!
translation: 多美的歌！

english: You have very kind words. I would be extremely grateful if you could remind me which object the song was about.
translation: 你真好。如果你能提醒我这歌是关于什么物体，我将不胜感激。

english: I really hope you can help me. Please show me the object my song is about!
translation: 我真希望你能帮我。请给我看看我歌里唱的物体！

english: Can you sing me the song again?
translation: 你能再唱一遍那首歌吗？

english: Okay, here goes... [random song]
translation: 好的，开始了…… [random song]

english: You show your object to Falo.
translation: 你给法洛展示你的物体。

english: Falo's eyes light up.
translation: 法洛的眼睛亮了。

english: Yes yes yes! That is it, thank you so much [Fremennik name]. The memories have come flooding back. I get why the lyrics are what they are now.
translation: 是是是！就是它，非常感谢 [Fremennik name]。记忆涌回来了。我现在明白歌词为什么是这样了。

english: I'm glad to have helped, hopefully you'll never forget again!
translation: 很高兴能帮忙，希望你再也别忘了！

english: Falo's eyes fail to light up.
translation: 法洛的眼睛没亮。

english: No no no! That's not it. Please have another think about it, [Fremennik name].
translation: 不不不！不是那个。请再想想，[Fremennik name]。

english: Arr!
translation: 啊！

english: Is there something I can help ye with?
translation: 有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: I would like to join your crew.
translation: 我想加入你的船员。

english: Of course you would!
translation: 你当然想！

english: However, I don't let anyone on the team if they are wearing a hat or a helmet.
translation: 不过，如果有人戴着帽子或头盔，我不让他们加入队伍。

english: You can go and store it in the deposit box next to Jimmy's stall.
translation: 你可以去吉米摊位旁边的寄存箱存起来。

english: Why not?
translation: 为什么不？

english: Well, in order to tell my crew from San Fan's I will need to give you a hat like mine.
translation: 嗯，为了区分我的船员和 San Fan 的，我得给你一顶像我这样的帽子。

english: If you are wearing a hat it might get lost when I give you my crew's hat.
translation: 如果你戴着帽子，我给你船员帽时可能会弄丢。

english: You wouldn't want that would you?
translation: 你不想那样对吧？

english: No, that sounds very reasonable in fact.
translation: 不，那听起来其实很合理。

english: Well, I'll be glad to have you aboard, but you will need to go and store all of your gear first.
translation: 嗯，我很高兴你加入，但你需要先去存好所有装备。

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你什么意思？

english: Well, you will need all of your inventory space for the ingredients, and all of the other things I'll need you to haul about.
translation: 嗯，你需要所有物品栏空间放材料，以及我要你搬运的其他东西。

english: There is a bank deposit box next to Jimmy's stall if you need it. Come and see me when you have a fully empty inventory.
translation: 如果需要，吉米摊位旁边有个银行寄存箱。等你物品栏全空了再来找我。

english: Sadly for you however, I have more than enough people on my crew.
translation: 不过可惜，我船上的人已经够多了。

english: Oh, all right.
translation: 哦，好吧。

english: Is that...thing yours?
translation: 那是……你的东西吗？

english: You mean my cat?
translation: 你是说我的猫？

english: Yes, I mean your cat! I HATE cats! Get it out of here!
translation: 是的，我是说你的猫！我讨厌猫！把它弄走！

english: Filthy things, no better than the rats that they catch.
translation: 脏东西，不比它们抓的老鼠好多少。

english: You cannot take your follower into the game.
translation: 你不能带随从进入游戏。

english: Arr, well we'll get you sorted out with a team hat right away.
translation: 啊，好吧，我们马上给你弄顶队伍帽子。

english: Go wait in the waiting room, I'll call you when we are ready to begin.
translation: 去等候室等着，准备好开始时我叫你。

english: Who are you, and what is this place?
translation: 你是谁，这是什么地方？

english: Arrharrharr!
translation: 啊哈哈哈！

english: Do you not recognise me? I am the famous dandy pirate 'Fancy' Dan!
translation: 你不认识我吗？我是著名的花花公子海盗“花哨”丹！

english: Yes, of course, any pirate knows who you are.
translation: 是的，当然，任何海盗都知道你是谁。

english: But of course.
translation: 当然。

english: As for what this place is, it is my glorious still, producing the best quality 'rum' this side of Braindeath Island.
translation: 至于这是什么地方，这是我辉煌的蒸馏器，生产脑死岛这边质量最好的“朗姆酒”。

english: Oh, and the run-down swill-producing ditch that San Fan over there calls a still.
translation: 哦，还有那边 San Fan 称为蒸馏器的破败泔水沟。

english: So with two stills you have plenty of 'rum' right?
translation: 所以有两个蒸馏器，你们有很多“朗姆酒”对吧？

english: Well we would do, if that hatchet-faced harridan wouldn't keep trying to torch the place!
translation: 本来是的，如果那个斧头脸的泼妇不一直想烧了这里的话！

english: I say!
translation: 我说！

english: A little while ago we had some real problems getting rum to the island, hence the two stills.
translation: 不久前我们往岛上运朗姆酒有些大问题，所以有两个蒸馏器。

english: However, after a little misunderstanding involving San's still and a barrel of gunpowder our relationship seems to have become a little strained.
translation: 不过，在涉及桑的蒸馏器和一桶火药的小误会后，我们的关系似乎有点紧张。

english: Apparently it is perfectly within the pirate code to burn each others stills, so long as nobody directly attacks the other person's crew, so rum production has taken a slight dip of late.
translation: 显然互相烧毁蒸馏器完全符合海盗守则，只要没人直接攻击对方的船员，所以最近朗姆酒产量略有下降。

english: Can I help out?
translation: 我能帮忙吗？

english: Yes, probably. I have a bunch of jobs that need doing, if you feel up to it.
translation: 是的，可能。我有一堆工作要做，如果你愿意的话。

english: What would you like to know about?
translation: 你想了解什么？

english: How do I help you brew 'Rum'?
translation: 我怎么帮你酿“朗姆酒”？

english: Well the stills we have set up are based on the ones on Braindeath island... well roughly at any rate.
translation: 嗯，我们设置的蒸馏器是基于脑死岛上的……嗯，大致如此。

english: All you have to do is help put the ingredients into the hoppers and keep the boilers burning.
translation: 你只需帮忙把材料放进漏斗，并保持锅炉燃烧。

english: If you add enough ingredients to the hoppers then you have the ability to pick up a single bottle of rum when it brews.
translation: 如果你往漏斗里加了足够材料，酿造好时你就能拿一瓶朗姆酒。

english: So, if ye add 5 buckets of water to the hoppers, then ye get access to one bottle. If you add 3 bowls of coloured water you get access to one bottle, and if you add one of anything else you get access to one bottle.
translation: 所以，如果你往漏斗里加5桶水，你就能拿一瓶。如果你加3碗有色水，你就能拿一瓶，如果你加任何其他东西一个，你就能拿一瓶。

english: This is cumulative, meaning that if you add (for example) 10 buckets of water, 3 sweetgrubs and 6 bowls of coloured water, then you have a chance to collect 7 bottles of rum for the team.
translation: 这是累积的，意思是如果你加(例如)10桶水，3个甜虫和6碗有色水，你就有机会为队伍收集7瓶朗姆酒。

english: The boilers are easy as pie to sort out. You just put some logs in, light them with a tinderbox, and then keep putting logs in until they are good and hot.
translation: 锅炉很容易搞定。你只需放些原木，用火绒盒点燃，然后不断加原木直到烧得够热。

english: Three logs should do it, but it's best to keep heaping them in just in case.
translation: 三根原木应该够了，但最好不断加以防万一。

english: The ingredients are; Bitternuts, Scrapey Tree Bark, Sweetgrubs, Buckets of Water and some Coloured Water.
translation: 材料有：苦坚果、刮树皮、甜虫、水桶和一些有色水。

english: Where can I get Bitternuts?
translation: 我从哪儿能得到苦坚果？

english: There are plenty of Bitternut trees inside this walled off area. The problem is that the trees are too tricky for a human to climb.
translation: 这围墙区域内有很多苦坚果树。问题是树太难爬，人类爬不上。

english: You will need to catch a monkey and send it up the tree to get the nut for you.
translation: 你需要抓只猴子，让它上树帮你拿坚果。

english: Send it up the tree? How does that work?
translation: 让它上树？怎么操作？

english: Well, if you were a monkey, and some random person grabbed you, dumped some dye in your fur and shoved you up a tree, you would hurl the closest heavy object at them too.
translation: 嗯，如果你是猴子，有个陌生人抓住你，往你毛上倒染料，把你推上树，你也会朝他们扔最近的重物。

english: Wait a second, dye?
translation: 等一下，染料？

english: Yes, you'll need to get a bowl of coloured water and pour it on the monkey. Otherwise you won't be able to tell which team the monkey belongs too.
translation: 是的，你需要弄碗有色水倒在猴子身上。否则你分不清猴子属于哪队。

english: That makes sense...I think...
translation: 有道理……我想……

english: Anything else?
translation: 还有别的吗？

english: Can I ask about something else?
translation: 我能问别的吗？

english: Ok, what else?
translation: 好的，别的什么？

english: So...how would I go about sabotaging the enemy still?
translation: 那么……我怎么破坏敌方蒸馏器？

english: Where can I get Scrapey tree bark...and why do I get the feeling I won't like the answer?
translation: 我从哪儿能得到刮树皮……为什么我有种不会喜欢答案的感觉？

english: Inside this walled area there are a few Scrapey trees. They are the big, ill looking ones, you can't miss them.
translation: 这围墙区域内有几棵刮树。就是那些又大又难看的，你不会错过。

english: Basically, you cut them down and then carve the bark off with a knife.
translation: 基本上，你砍倒它们，然后用刀刮下树皮。

english: It's pretty simple, except the sap tends somake people feel kind offill if they get any on themselves.
translation: 很简单，只是树液沾到人身上后会让人感觉有点不舒服。

english: How ill?
translation: 多严重？

english: Don't worry, we aren't talking deadly ill or anything.
translation: 别担心，不是说会致命或什么的。

english: It's more like you'll feel quite dizzy and weak for a bit.
translation: 更像是你会感觉有点头晕虚弱一会儿。

english: Joy...
translation: 真高兴……

english: Sweetgrubs? What are they?
translation: 甜虫？它们是什么？

english: Well, lacking any sluglings in the area, we add these little grubs called Sweetgrubs. If you ignore the gag- inducing aftertaste, they are quite sweet.
translation: 嗯，这区域缺乏蛞蝓幼虫，我们加这些叫甜虫的小虫。如果你忽略催吐的余味，它们挺甜的。

english: How... how can you drink this stuff?
translation: 怎么……你怎么喝这东西？

english: Quite easily!
translation: 很容易！

english: Pirates are renowned as being tough for a reason.
translation: 海盗以强硬闻名是有原因的。

english: So where do I get these grubs from anyway?
translation: 那我从哪儿弄到这些虫？

english: Well, there are a few sweetgrub mounds inside there. We have a handful of rat meat that you can use on the mounds to draw the grubs to the surface.
translation: 嗯，里面有几个甜虫丘。我们有些鼠肉，你可以用在丘上把虫引到表面。

english: Mind your fingers though, they are voracious little things.
translation: 不过小心手指，它们是很贪婪的小东西。

english: And here was me thinking that nothing could be more disgusting than Braindeath 'Rum'.
translation: 我还以为没什么比脑死亡“朗姆酒”更恶心的了。

english: Arr, that's where ye'd be wrong [lad/lass], 'cos new, improved Braindeath 'Rum' Classic is now 200% more disgustin' than any leadin' competitor!
translation: 啊，那你可就错了 [lad/lass]，因为新的改进版脑死“朗姆酒”经典款现在比任何领先竞争对手恶心200%！

english: Legal disclaimer; the dangerous amount of disgustin' in new Braindeath 'Rum' Classic be too much for pregnant women, donkeys and anyone with more than seven letters in their last name.
translation: 法律声明；新脑死亡“朗姆酒”经典款中危险量的恶心成分，对孕妇、驴和姓氏超过七个字母的人来说太多了。

english: What was that?
translation: 那是什么？

english: What was what?
translation: 什么是什么？

english: Is there anything else?
translation: 还有别的吗？

english: How do I get...
translation: 我怎么得到……

english: Wait, no, that question makes me sound like I haven't a clue what I'm doing.
translation: 等等，不，那问题让我听起来像不知道自己在做什么。

english: Where can I get buckets in there?
translation: 我从哪儿能得到桶？

english: There are a few lying about. Help yourself.
translation: 周围有一些。自便。

english: There is a pump in the still, so long as it's working you should have almost unlimited water.
translation: 蒸馏器里有个泵，只要它工作，你几乎有无限的水。

english: Hold on, do I have to add anything disgusting and/or potential lethal to the water before I pour it in?
translation: 等等，我倒水之前得加什么恶心和/或潜在致命的东西吗？

english: Perish the thought!
translation: 别想！

english: Ok, just checking.
translation: 好的，只是问问。

english: What sort of coloured water are we talking about here?
translation: 我们这里说的是哪种有色水？

english: Well, the other still has an area of waste ground with a flower growing on it. If you go and grab one of the flowers and jam it in the kettle, the water will boil out the colour.
translation: 嗯，另一个蒸馏器有块荒地长着花。如果你去摘一朵花塞进壶里，水会煮出颜色。

english: We use the colour to keep our rum easily identifiable.
translation: 我们用颜色来区分我们的朗姆酒。

english: So I just empty the kettle into the hopper, right?
translation: 所以我直接把壶倒进漏斗，对吧？

english: No, no, you'll need to take an empty bowl and fill it from the kettle.
translation: 不，不，你需要拿个空碗从壶里装满。

english: That way you can use the stuff on a monkey if you need to.
translation: 这样如果需要你可以用在猴子身上。

english: Use it on a monkey...of course.
translation: 用在猴子身上……当然。

english: How do I repair the still?
translation: 我怎么修理蒸馏器？

english: Well, assuming those scurvy dogs have managed to set any of it on fire, then you'll need to tip a bucket of water on it before you can repair it.
translation: 嗯，假设那些坏蛋设法点燃了任何部分，那你得先倒一桶水在上面才能修理。

english: Then, it all comes down to what part of it was damaged.
translation: 然后，就看哪部分损坏了。

english: How can I repair hoppers?
translation: 我怎么修理漏斗？

english: Well, assuming that they are not on fire, all you need to do is use the heavy lumber patches. They are big enough to cover most holes.
translation: 嗯，假设它们没着火，你只需用重木补丁。它们足够大能覆盖大多数洞。

english: Will I need a hammer?
translation: 我需要锤子吗？

english: No, just shove it into place and whack it until it lines up.
translation: 不，直接塞进去敲直到对齐。

english: How do I repair pipes and the pump?
translation: 我怎么修理管道和泵？

english: Well, if you use a pipe section on the damaged part you should be able to replace it easily.
translation: 嗯，如果你用管道部件在损坏部分，你应该能轻松更换。

english: No, likely you'll just need to whack the old one out and slot the new one in with your hands.
translation: 不，可能你只需敲出旧的，用手把新的插进去。

english: How do I repair bridges?
translation: 我怎么修理桥？

english: Well, we have these handy bridge sections you can use to repair the bridges.
translation: 嗯，我们有这些方便的桥段，你可以用来修桥。

english: The main problem is, while a still will keep working if a bit of it is only damaged, the bridges are completely out of commission if they are even slightly damaged.
translation: 主要问题是，虽然蒸馏器损坏一点还能工作，但桥只要稍微损坏就完全不能用了。

english: Is that going to be a problem? I mean, I can jump across I think.
translation: 那会有问题吗？我是说，我想我能跳过去。

english: Don't try that! Our lawyers tell us we aren't covered for injuries sustained while jumping over burned bridges.
translation: 别试！律师告诉我们，跳过烧毁的桥受伤不在承保范围内。

english: Seriously, just keep off the bridges until they are fixed.
translation: 说真的，桥修好前别上去。

english: Where do I get all this stuff anyway?
translation: 我从哪儿弄到这些东西？

english: We have a load of items already on a table inside the still. You can also make new ones if you grab some logs.
translation: 蒸馏器内的桌子上已经有一堆物品。如果你拿些原木，也可以做新的。

english: How does that work?
translation: 怎么操作？

english: We have a work table set up in the still. If you use the logs in it you can craft up a handy replacement for part of the still.
translation: 蒸馏器内有个工作台。如果你在里面用原木，可以制作蒸馏器部件的方便替代品。

english: Don't worry about them fitting, the things are held together by nails, replacement parts and soot by now.
translation: 别担心是否合适，这些东西现在靠钉子、替换部件和烟灰固定。

english: Well...how sanitary...
translation: 嗯……多卫生……

english: Ok, I think I've heard enough.
translation: 好的，我想我听够了。

english: Fine. Glad I could help.
translation: 好的。很高兴能帮忙。

english: Ok, here's what you need to do.
translation: 好的，这是你需要做的。

english: The wood around here is really dry and flammable, so take one of the torches, light it up, and then go and attack the enemy still with it.
translation: 这里的木头非常干燥易燃，所以拿个火把，点燃，然后去攻击敌方蒸馏器。

english: That's it?
translation: 就那样？

english: Most of their still is soaked in 'alcohol' and made from tinder dry wood.
translation: 他们的大部分蒸馏器都浸在“酒精”里，由极干的木头制成。

english: Essentially, if it isn't ours, try using a torch on it and see what happens.
translation: 基本上，如果不是我们的，试着用火把点它看看会发生什么。

english: Ok, I get you.
translation: 好的，我明白了。

english: So what will you give me for helping out?
translation: 那你给我什么作为帮忙的报酬？

english: Hahahaha! What a mercenary attitude! You'll do fine here.
translation: 哈哈哈！多雇佣兵的态度！你在这里会很好的。

english: Well, for each bottle that your team produces, I'll give you onepiece of eight.
translation: 嗯，你队伍每生产一瓶，我给你一个八分币。

english: If you manage to set something on fire then I'll toss in another, same for repairing the still.
translation: 如果你设法点着什么东西，我再给一个，修理蒸馏器也一样。

english: What can I use these pieces of eight for?
translation: 我用这些八分币能做什么？

english: See Honest Jimmy there? He'll trade you some pretty nice stuff for them.
translation: 看到那边的诚实吉米了吗？他会用它们跟你换些不错的东西。

english: Great!
translation: 太好了！

english: I don't let anyone on the team if they are wearing a hat or a helmet.
translation: 如果有人戴着帽子或头盔，我不让他们加入队伍。

english: I'll be glad to have you aboard, but you will need to go and store all of your gear first.
translation: 我很高兴你加入，但你需要先去存好所有装备。

english: Sadly for you I have more than enough people on my crew.
translation: 可惜，我船上的人已经够多了。

english: Is that... thing yours?
translation: 那是……你的东西吗？

english: This minigame is unavailable on this world.
translation: 这个小游戏在这个世界不可用。

english: So, how well can you cook?
translation: 那么，你厨艺如何？

english: Well, I can, err, cook a bit...
translation: 嗯，我能，呃，做点饭……

english: Well 'a bit' doesn't cut it in here. Come back when you have a cooking level of 40.
translation: 嗯“做点饭”在这里不够。烹饪等级40级再来。

english: Anyone lookin' fer work?
translation: 有人找工作吗？

english: Arr! Looking fer good pirates!
translation: 啊！找好海盗！

english: Come join me crew!
translation: 来加入我的船员！

english: Don't join them, join us!
translation: 别加入他们，加入我们！

english: Free(ish) rum fer all!
translation: 所有人免费(差不多)朗姆酒！

english: Join the winnin' team now!
translation: 现在加入获胜队伍！

english: Need pirates fer brewin'!
translation: 酿酒需要海盗！

english: Recruiting!
translation: 招募！

english: Roll up, roll up!
translation: 快来，快来！

english: We have dental!
translation: 我们有牙科保险！

english: I would like to join your crew.
translation: 我想加入你的船员。

english: Who are you, and what is this place?
translation: 你是谁，这是什么地方？

english: Brewing 'Rum'
translation: 酿“朗姆酒”

english: Where can I get Bitternuts?
translation: 我从哪儿能得到苦坚果？

english: Can I ask about something else?
translation: 我能问别的吗？

english: Repairing the Still
translation: 修理蒸馏器

english: Sabotaging the Still
translation: 破坏蒸馏器

english: What will you pay me?
translation: 你付我什么？

english: Ok, I think I've heard enough
translation: 好的，我想我听够了

english: Where can I get Scrapey Tree Bark?
translation: 我从哪儿能得到刮树皮？

english: Where can I get Sweetgrubs?
translation: 我从哪儿能得到甜虫？

english: Where can I get buckets of water?
translation: 我从哪儿能得到水桶？

english: Where can I get coloured water?
translation: 我从哪儿能得到有色水？

english: How do I repair Hoppers?
translation: 我怎么修理漏斗？

english: How do I repair Pipes and the pump?
translation: 我怎么修理管道和泵？
