english: How do I repair Bridges?
translation: 我怎么修理桥？

english: How do I get repair items?
translation: 我怎么得到修理物品？

english: How Do I repair Hoppers?
translation: 我怎么修理漏斗？

english: How do I get repair items
translation: 我怎么得到修理物品

english: Sabotaging San's Still
translation: 破坏桑的蒸馏器

english: Ha, well I'm retired now, but in my heyday I was quite the expert fisherman! These days I just help out around the village where I can, my old bones don't allow me to do any more than that.
translation: 哈，嗯我现在退休了，但鼎盛时期我可是个专家渔夫！这些天我只能在村里帮忙，老骨头不允许我做更多。

english: Is there anything interesting to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么有趣的事做吗？

english: Bwana, if anyone else asks me that question today, I'll explode! Go and ask someone else!
translation: 伙计，如果今天还有人问我那个问题，我会爆炸的！去问别人！

english: Not that I'm aware of, just sit back and enjoy the sunshine bwana!
translation: 据我所知没有，只管坐下享受阳光伙计！

english: Well, I think that there's some work to be done...perhaps Murcaily can help you. He usually tends to the hardwood grove to the east of Trufitus's hut.
translation: 嗯，我想有些事要做……也许穆尔凯利能帮你。他通常照料特鲁菲图斯小屋东边的硬木林。

english: It's just village life as normal around here Bwana, always something interesting to find to occupy your time if you look hard enough.
translation: 这里只是正常的村庄生活伙计，如果你努力找，总有些有趣的事打发时间。

english: Sorry Bwana, I'm already busy, why not go and talk to Murcaily! He's around the village somewhere.
translation: 抱歉伙计，我已经忙了，何不去跟穆尔凯利谈谈！他在村里某处。

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Hello there...thanks for helping out Trufitus commune with the gods Bwana. We've been able to return to the village thanks to your help.
translation: 你好……谢谢你帮特鲁菲图斯与神沟通伙计。多亏你的帮助，我们才能回村。

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
translation: 我一直在村里做些工作。

english: Yeah, you've been doing a lot of good work around here. Let me give you something for your time and effort.
translation: 是的，你在这里做了很多好事。让我给你点东西作为时间和精力的报酬。

english: I've already given you some trading sticks and I don't have any more on me at the moment. Why not go and talk to some of the other villagers and get some contributions?
translation: 我已经给你一些交易棒了，目前身上没更多了。何不去跟其他村民谈谈弄点贡献？

english: Ahhhhhhhh - Get away from me you beast!
translation: 啊——离我远点你这野兽！

english: What's the problem....oh, I'm wearing this big scary mask! I'd better take it off before I start talking to the natives.
translation: 什么问题……哦，我戴着这个大可怕面具！我开始跟当地人说话前最好摘掉。

english: Ahhhhhhhh!
translation: 啊！

english: Ahhhhhhhh - It's a monster!
translation: 啊——是怪物！

english: Waahhhhh! - It's da evil broodoo beast come ta eat my very soul!
translation: 哇！——是邪恶的布鲁多兽来吃我的灵魂了！

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Is there anything interesting to do here?
translation: 这里有什么有趣的事做吗？

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
translation: 我一直在村里做些工作。

english: Hello, little boy.
translation: 你好，小男孩。

english: I would prefer it if you didn't speak to me in such a manner. I'll have you know I'm an accomplished merchant.
translation: 我希望你别这样跟我说话。让你知道我是个成功的商人。

english: Calm down, junior.
translation: 冷静点，小家伙。

english: Don't tell me to calm down! And don't call me 'junior'.
translation: 别叫我冷静！也别叫我“小家伙”。

english: I'll have you know I am Farid Morrisane, son of Ali Morrisane, the world's greatest merchant!
translation: 让你知道我是法里德‧莫里桑，世界上最伟大商人阿里‧莫里桑的儿子！

english: Then why are you here and not him?
translation: 那你为什么在这里而不是他？

english: My dad has given me the responsibility of expanding our business here.
translation: 我爸爸给了我在这里扩展生意的责任。

english: And you're up to the task? What a grown up boy you are! Mummy and daddy must be very pleased!
translation: 你能胜任吗？多成熟的男孩啊！爸爸妈妈一定很高兴！

english: Look, [mate/darling] - I may be young, I may be short, but I'm a respected merchant around here and don't have time to deal with simpletons like you.
translation: 听着，[mate/darling]——我可能年轻，可能矮，但我在这里是个受尊敬的商人，没空应付像你这样的傻瓜。

english: Can you show me the prices of ores and bars?
translation: 你能给我看看矿石和金属锭的价格吗？

english: I best go and speak with someone more my height.
translation: 我最好去找个跟我身高差不多的人说话。

english: Then I shall not stop you, [mister/miss]. I've too much work to do.
translation: 那我不拦你，[mister/miss]。我有太多工作要做。

english: My father shall be so pleased.
translation: 我父亲会很高兴的。

english: Hmm. If divide by 20 and take off 50%...
translation: 嗯。如果除以20再减去50%……

english: Woo hoo! What a sale!
translation: 呜呼！多好的买卖！

english: What shall I trade next...
translation: 我下次交易什么……

english: I can make so much money here!
translation: 我在这里能赚这么多钱！

english: Calm down, junior.
translation: 冷静点，小家伙。

english: Can you show me the prices of ores and bars?
translation: 你能给我看看矿石和金属锭的价格吗？

english: I best go and speak with someone more my height.
translation: 我最好去找个跟我身高差不多的人说话。

english: Hello there. How's it going?
translation: 你好。怎么样？

english: Well the work is going well, so I'm very good, thank you.
translation: 嗯工作进展顺利，所以我很好，谢谢。

english: Not too bad thanks.
translation: 还不错，谢谢。

english: I'm fine, how are you?
translation: 我很好，你呢？

english: Very well, thank you.
translation: 很好，谢谢。

english: Nilsal! I'm pretty good, thank you. It's always nice to be out in the sun.
translation: 你好！我很好，谢谢。在外面晒太阳总是很好的。

english: Hello there! Nice weather we've been having. Perfect for a day outdoors!
translation: 你好！天气真好。适合户外的一天！

english: Oi! Leave my wheat alone!
translation: 喂！别动我的小麦！

english: Hello stranger.
translation: 你好陌生人。

english: You look like a farmer. Don't see many farmers around here.
translation: 你看起来像个农夫。这附近不太见得到农夫。

english: Aye, that you don't. I'm from Hosidius, y'see. I just come here to drink.
translation: 是的，见不到。我来自霍西迪乌斯城，你看。我只是来这里喝酒。

english: You travel all the way out to Shayzien just for a few beers? Don't you have a pub back home?
translation: 你大老远跑到谢兹恩城就为了几杯啤酒？你家里没有酒馆吗？

english: Indeed we do... But I can't stand the place for more than a few minutes.
translation: 确实有……但我在那地方待不了几分钟。

english: Have you ever been in there? Such a rowdy crowd... people shouting across the bar about 'Farming this', 'Farming that'... can barely hear myself think half the time.
translation: 你进去过吗？那么吵闹的人群……人们在吧台对面大喊“种这个”，“种那个”……一半时间几乎听不见自己想什么。

english: No, no... Can't be doin' with it. That's why I make the trip out here for a nice quiet one.
translation: 不，不……受不了。这就是我来这里喝杯安静酒的原因。

english: Well I'd better leave you to it then!
translation: 那我还是不打扰你了！

english: Well, the work is going well, so I'm very good, thank you.
translation: 嗯工作进展顺利，所以我很好，谢谢。

english: Nilsal! I'm pretty good, thank you.
translation: 你好！我很好，谢谢。

english: Hello there! Nice weather we've been having.
translation: 你好！天气真好。

english: Exchuse me... I am trying to tell my verrry good friends 'bout the biggest bull I ever raised.
translation: 打扰一下……我正试图告诉我非常好的朋友们关于我养过的最大的公牛。

english: Exchuse me... I am lishning to my good friend.
translation: 打扰一下……我正在听我的好朋友说话。

english: Mean pair of horns he'd got.
translation: 他有一对厉害的角。

english: Got enough leather off 'im for a new carpet.
translation: 从他身上剥的皮够做块新地毯。

english: Grew to the size of a cart, I swear!
translation: 长到马车那么大，我发誓！

english: It's not like that these days.
translation: 现在不是那样了。

english: 'E went MOO MOO MOO all night.
translation: 他整晚哞哞哞叫。

english: Never had a year like that since.
translation: 从那以后没过过那样的年。

english: That prize should've been mine!
translation: 那奖本该是我的！

english: Ol' Hosidius thought we'd need a bigger barn.
translation: 老霍西迪乌斯以为我们需要个更大的谷仓。

english: Best bull I ever 'ad.
translation: 我有过的最好的公牛。

english: I've got a brand new plough!
translation: 我有个全新的犁！

english: No-one got so much corn out of one field before.
translation: 以前没人从一块地收过那么多玉米。

english: Sacks and sacks of grain like you've never seen!
translation: 一袋又一袋你从未见过的粮食！

english: Hosidius says we gotta optimise land use. Bleah!
translation: 霍西迪乌斯说我们得优化土地利用。呸！

english: Them dwarves won't pay a decent price anymore.
translation: 那些矮人再也不付像样的价钱了。

english: Best harvest we'd ever 'ad.
translation: 我们有过的最好的收成。

english: 'Course, the weather were better back then.
translation: 当然，那时候天气更好。

english: Fed the kids for a year off 'is beef.
translation: 靠他的牛肉养了孩子们一年。

english: Could 'ave passed for a mammoth.
translation: 可以冒充猛犸象。

english: Ain't no-one ever tipped that bull.
translation: 没人推倒过那头公牛。

english: You've never seen a bull like 'im.
translation: 你从未见过像他那样的公牛。

english: Pearls of wisdom!
translation: 智慧的珍珠！

english: Ah, tell it!
translation: 啊，说吧！

english: Best times ever!
translation: 最好的时光！

english: Right you are.
translation: 你说得对。

english: Great days!
translation: 好日子！

english: I'm going to be sick!
translation: 我要吐了！

english: You're right.
translation: 你是对的。

english: You're so right.
translation: 你太对了。

english: Those were the days!
translation: 那些日子啊！

english: Not like nowadays.
translation: 不像现在。

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: I have all the bad luck. My sheep all run off somewhere, and then those mourners tell me they're infected!
translation: 我倒霉透了。我的羊都跑某处去了，然后那些哀悼者告诉我它们感染了！

english: Well, I hope things start to look up for you.
translation: 嗯，我希望你的情况开始好转。

english: Hello there. Sorry about your sheep...
translation: 你好。对你的羊很抱歉……

english: That's okay, it had to be done for the sake of the town.
translation: 没关系，为了城镇不得不这样做。

english: That's okay, you are not to blame. I'm just glad the truth behind the plague was eventually revealed.
translation: 没关系，不怪你。我只是很高兴瘟疫背后的真相最终被揭露了。

english: Good day. What are you doing?
translation: 你好。你在做什么？

english: I'm tending to these farming patches. They need a little more work before I can plant anything.
translation: 我在照料这些种植地。在我能种东西之前还需要点工作。

english: Good luck with that.
translation: 祝你好运。

english: Thank you, [Fremennik name].
translation: 谢谢你，[Fremennik name]。

english: What's wrong with the patches?
translation: 种植地怎么了？

english: The centre patch is full of weeds, and as soon as I clear them they grow back. The south patch is always far too dry. And the soil in the north patch is terrible; it needs a good dose of compost.
translation: 中间的种植地长满杂草，我一清理它们就长回来。南边的种植地总是太干。北边种植地的土壤很糟；需要好好施点堆肥。

english: Can you tell me how the kingdom approves of me?
translation: 你能告诉我王国对我的认可度吗？

english: [amount]% of people approve of you.
translation: [amount]% 的人认可你。

english: Kingdom? Etceteria is ruled by a Queen and we don't approve of you.
translation: 王国？埃特塞特拉由女王统治，我们不认可你。

english: Don't trouble yourself further, Your Highness, you've already done so much!
translation: 别再麻烦自己了，殿下，你已经做了这么多！

english: Hey! This is the Queen's farm. You'll need her approval to make use of it.
translation: 嘿！这是女王的农场。你需要她的批准才能使用。

english: The storerooms are full, your Highness. You should talk to Advisor Ghrim to collect what we've gathered for you.
translation: 储藏室已满，殿下。请去找顾问格里姆领取我们为你收集的物资。

english: Good luck with that.
translation: 祝你好运。

english: What's wrong with the patches?
translation: 种植地怎么了？

english: Hello, young [sir/lady/one]. Did you want to work on my farm?
translation: 你好，年轻的 [sir/lady/one]。你想在我的农场工作吗？

english: Tell me about your farm.
translation: 跟我讲讲你的农场。

english: I grow fruit here. Special fruit. It grows very fast, but it needs a lot of tending, otherwise it gets the blight and dies.
translation: 我在这里种水果。特殊水果。长得很快，但需要很多照料，否则会得枯萎病死掉。

english: These days I'm getting old and slow. You can see all the dead plants from where I've tried to farm them.
translation: 这些天我变老变慢了。你可以看到我试着种的地方全是死植物。

english: Life here seems rather peaceful.
translation: 这里的生活似乎相当平静。

english: It is most of the time. Something very strange did happen recently though.
translation: 大部分时间是。不过最近发生了件很奇怪的事。

english: Oh yeah? What happened?
translation: 哦是吗？发生了什么事？

english: Well, you see... Two strange hooded figures recently visited the farm. They had an odd smell to them and kept their faces hidden.
translation: 嗯，你看……两个奇怪的戴兜帽的人最近拜访了农场。他们气味奇怪，遮着脸。

english: They said they represented some client from the far east and that they wanted to inspect the farm. They had a good look around but seemed rather disappointed when they left.
translation: 他们说代表某个来自远东的客户，想检查农场。他们四处看了看，但离开时似乎相当失望。

english: Oh... I'm sure it was nothing.
translation: 哦……我相信没什么。

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 跟我说说你自己。

english: I'm a fruit farmer. But now I'm a bit too old for that. Maybe I should try writing books again, like I did when I was younger.
translation: 我是果农。但现在有点太老了。也许我该再试试写书，像我年轻时那样。

english: I'd like to work on your farm.
translation: 我想在你的农场工作。

english: Well, I'm afraid you're not really suitable.
translation: 嗯，恐怕你不太合适。

english: You do not have enough Hosidius favour. Current favour: [number]% - Required: 100.0%
translation: 你没有足够的霍西迪乌斯好感度。当前好感度：[number]% - 需要：100.0%

english: Alright. Take a handful of seeds from the table, and head into the farm. When you've harvested some fruit, deposit it straight into the sacks.
translation: 好的。从桌上抓把种子，进农场。当你收获一些水果，直接存入袋子里。

english: Remember, you have to water the plants at each stage, otherwise they die of the blight. Fertiliser makes them grow faster... or die faster if you don't water them.
translation: 记住，你必须在每个阶段给植物浇水，否则它们会枯萎死掉。肥料让它们长得更快……如果你不浇水也会死得更快。

english: You'll gain a little extra experience if you grow enough of the fruit successfully.
translation: 如果你成功种出足够的水果，你会获得一点额外经验。

english: Have you any rewards?
translation: 你有什么奖励吗？

english: I need to go.
translation: 我得走了。

english: What on earth are you wearing?
translation: 你到底穿着什么？

english: I'm here to do some tithing. Blood tithing.
translation: 我来做什一奉献。血什一奉献。

english: Well this is not that kind of farm! I only let normal people work here, so get lost!
translation: 嗯这不是那种农场！我只让正常人在这里工作，所以滚开！

english: You show the book to Farmer Gricoller.
translation: 你给农夫格里科勒看书。

english: Oh, yes, I remember writing that a long time ago. I told the publisher it should be in the public domain, so that everyone could share the knowledge.
translation: 哦，是的，我记得很久以前写过那个。我告诉出版商它应该在公共领域，这样每个人都能分享知识。

english: Of course, that was before I got so old and found I couldn't afford to hire workers for my farm. Oh well, I hope it helped someone. It wasn't much use to anyone around here.
translation: 当然，那是在我变老发现雇不起农场工人之前。哦好吧，我希望它帮了某人。对这里的人没什么用。

english: Are you the 'Gric' this entry mentions?
translation: 你是这条目提到的“格里克”吗？

english: You show him 'Lunch by the Lancalliums'.
translation: 你给他看《兰卡利姆旁的午餐》。

english: Yes, I was friends with the last king, it was very sad when he died. The accusations aimed at poor little Rose were ridiculous.
translation: 是的，我和最后一位国王是朋友，他死时很伤心。针对可怜的小罗斯的指控很荒谬。

english: Accusations?
translation: 指控？

english: It was all nonesense, the king died naturally! He was old, he'd been on the throne for at least 40 years.
translation: 都是胡说，国王是自然死亡！他老了，在位至少40年。

english: Interesting, so he must have waited a while before having children?
translation: 有趣，所以他肯定等了一段时间才有孩子？

english: Indeed, he married late and his wife... Unfortunately didn't survive bringing Rose into this world.
translation: 确实，他结婚晚，他的妻子……不幸没能在把罗斯带到这世上时活下来。

english: Oh right, have you seen Rose recently?
translation: 哦好吧，你最近见过罗斯吗？

english: No... After the incident she was locked away. Most have forgotten about her now.
translation: 没有……事件后她被关起来了。大多数人现在都忘了她。

english: Thanks for the information, Gric. Perhaps it'll all make sense once I've found the other pages.
translation: 谢谢信息，格里克。也许等我找到其他页后就都明白了。

english: Perhaps.
translation: 也许。

english: Ah, fertiliser. I use a lot of that, but I get mine from Hosidius. If you want to give yours to them, go to their storehouse near the bank.
translation: 啊，肥料。我用很多，但我从霍西迪乌斯城获取。如果你想把你的给他们，去银行附近的仓库。

english: I'll give you 60 of my reward points for that.
translation: 我给你60个奖励点数。

english: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。

english: I'll give you 120 of my reward points for that.
translation: 我给你120个奖励点数。

english: I'll give you 100 of my reward points for that.
translation: 我给你100个奖励点数。

english: I'll give you 40 of my reward points for that.
translation: 我给你40个奖励点数。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Take some seeds from the table, otherwise you can't do any farming in there!
translation: 从桌上拿些种子，否则你没法在里面种地！

english: Hey, young [sir/lady/one], do you know what you're doing in there?
translation: 嘿，年轻的 [sir/lady/one]，你知道你在里面做什么吗？

english: Grow those seeds in the patches. When you've harvested some fruit, deposit it straight into the sacks.
translation: 在种植地里种那些种子。当你收获一些水果，直接存入袋子里。

english: You'll gain a little extra experience if you grow enough of the fruit successfully. So, are you ready to start?
translation: 如果你成功种出足够的水果，你会获得一点额外经验。那么，你准备好开始了吗？

english: Yes, I know what I'm doing.
translation: 是的，我知道我在做什么。

english: I'm an expert - don't ask me this again.
translation: 我是专家——别再问我这个。

english: Alright, young [sir/lady/one], I won't. Talk to me if you ever want a reminder.
translation: 好的，年轻的 [sir/lady/one]，我不问。如果你想提醒随时找我。

english: Tell me about your farm.
translation: 跟我讲讲你的农场。

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 跟我说说你自己。

english: I'd like to work on your farm.
translation: 我想在你的农场工作。

english: Have you any rewards?
translation: 你有什么奖励吗？

english: Life here seems rather peaceful.
translation: 这里的生活似乎相当平静。

english: I need to go.
translation: 我得走了。

english: Accept
translation: 接受

english: Cancel
translation: 取消

english: Tell me how to grow these crops.
translation: 告诉我怎么种这些作物。

english: Yes, I know what I'm doing.
translation: 是的，我知道我在做什么。

english: I'm an expert - don't ask me this again.
translation: 我是专家——别再问我这个。

english: I don't want to do this anymore.
translation: 我不想再做了。

english: Farmer Hayfield stares at one of his flower beds.
translation: 海菲尔德农夫盯着他的一个花坛。

english: Are you alive?
translation: 你还活着吗？

english: Me?
translation: 我？

english: Farmer Hayfield continues to stare at the flower bed.
translation: 海菲尔德农夫继续盯着花坛。

english: Tell me! How does it feel to be alive?
translation: 告诉我！活着是什么感觉？

english: Huh, what a strange guy.
translation: 哈，真是个怪人。

english: Hello there!
translation: 你好啊！

english: Greetings. It's nice to see another adventurer here.
translation: 你好，很高兴在这里见到另一位冒险者。

english: Adventurer? No. I'm a natural historian from Varrock. I'm working on a project to research the creatures of Kourend.
translation: 冒险者？不。我是来自维洛克城的自然历史学家。我在做一个研究库兰德王国生物的项目。

english: Don't you think this place is so fascinating? It looks like this cave is a major habitat for the giants.
translation: 你不觉得这地方很迷人吗？看起来这个洞穴是巨人的主要栖息地。

english: Yeah, there are many different giants here for sure. How did you manage to get this far? Those giants are quite hostile to visitors.
translation: 是啊，这里确实有很多不同的巨人。你是怎么走到这儿的？那些巨人对外来者很不友好。

english: Well, I just ran past them as fast as I could.
translation: 嗯，我只是尽可能快地从他们身边跑过去。

english: Anyway, I'd better get back to my research.
translation: 总之，我最好回去继续研究了。

english: Don' say nuffin' to me! Say it to da boss!
translation: 别跟我废话！跟老大说！

english: Go away I'm very busy!
translation: 走开，我很忙！

english: Sorry to disturb you.
translation: 抱歉打扰你。

english: What are you busy doing?
translation: 你忙什么呢？

english: I'm cooking pizzas for the people in this camp.
translation: 我在为营地里的人做披萨。

english: Not that these louts appreciate my gourmet cooking!
translation: 这些粗人哪懂欣赏我的美食！

english: So what is a gourmet chef doing cooking for bandits?
translation: 那么一位美食厨师在为强盗做饭是做什么？

english: Well I'm an outlaw. I was accused of giving the king food poisoning! The thought of it! I think he just drank too much wine that night.
translation: 我是个逃犯，被指控让国王食物中毒！想想看！我觉得他那晚只是酒喝多了。

english: I had to flee the kingdom of Misthalin! The bandits give me refuge here as long as I cook for them.
translation: 我不得不逃离米斯特林王國王国！强盗们庇护我，只要我给他们做饭。

english: Can I have some pizza too?
translation: 我也能要点披萨吗？

english: Well this pizza is really meant to be for the bandits. I guess I could sell you some pizza bases though
translation: 嗯这披萨其实是给强盗的。不过我想我可以卖你一些披萨饼底

english: Yes, Okay.
translation: 好的。

english: Oh if I have to pay I don't want any.
translation: 哦如果要付钱那我就不要了。

english: Okay, I'll leave you to it.
translation: 好的，我不打扰你了。

english: Have you anything to sell?
translation: 你有什么卖的吗？

english: Well I guess I can sell you some half made pizzas.
translation: 嗯我想我可以卖你一些半成品的披萨。

english: Sorry to disturb you.
translation: 抱歉打扰你。

english: What are you busy doing?
translation: 你忙什么呢？

english: So what is a gourmet chef doing cooking for bandits?
translation: 那么一位美食厨师在为强盗做饭是做什么？

english: Can I have some pizza too?
translation: 我也能要点披萨吗？

english: Yes, Okay.
translation: 好的。

english: Oh if I have to pay I don't want any.
translation: 哦如果要付钱那我就不要了。

english: Okay, I'll leave you to it.
translation: 好的，我不打扰你了。

english: Have you anything to sell?
translation: 你有什么卖的吗？

english: Welcome to the church of holy Saradomin.
translation: 欢迎来到神圣的萨拉多明教堂。

english: Who's Saradomin?
translation: 谁是萨拉多明？

english: Surely you have heard of the god, Saradomin?
translation: 你肯定听说过神明萨拉多明吧？

english: He who creates the forces of goodness and purity in this world? I cannot believe your ignorance!
translation: 那个在这个世界上创造善良与纯洁力量的神？我真不敢相信你如此无知！

english: This is the god with more followers than any other! ...At least in this part of the world.
translation: 这是信徒最多的神！……至少在这个世界的这部分。

english: He who created this world along with his brothers Guthix and Zamorak?
translation: 那个和他的兄弟古斯和扎莫拉克一起创造这个世界的神？

english: Oh, THAT Saradomin...
translation: 哦，那个萨拉多明……

english: There... is only one Saradomin...
translation: ……只有一个萨拉多明……

english: Yeah... I, uh, thought you said something else.
translation: 是啊……我，呃，以为你说了别的。

english: Oh, sorry. I'm not from this world.
translation: 哦，抱歉。我不是这个世界的人。

english: That's... strange.
translation: 那……很奇怪。

english: I thought things not from this world were all... You know. Slime and tentacles.
translation: 我以为不是这个世界的东西都是……你懂的。粘液和触手。

english: You don't understand. This is an online game!
translation: 你不明白。这是个在线游戏！

english: I... beg your pardon?
translation: 我……你说什么？

english: Never mind.
translation: 算了。

english: I am - do you like my disguise?
translation: 我是——你喜欢我的伪装吗？

english: Aargh! Avaunt foul creature from another dimension! Avaunt! Begone in the name of Saradomin!
translation: 啊！退散吧，来自异次元的不洁生物！退散！以萨拉多明之名滚开！

english: Ok, ok, I was only joking...
translation: 好了好了，我只是开玩笑……

english: Nice place you've got here.
translation: 你这地方不错。

english: It is, isn't it? It was built over 230 years ago.
translation: 确实是，对吧？它是230多年前建的。

english: I'm looking for a quest.
translation: 我在找任务。

english: That's lucky, I need someone to do a quest for me.
translation: 真巧，我需要有人帮我做个任务。

english: Sorry, I don't have time right now.
translation: 抱歉，我现在没时间。

english: Oh well. If you do have some spare time on your hands, come back and talk to me.
translation: 哦好吧。如果你有空闲时间，回来找我谈谈。

english: Thank you for getting rid of that awful ghost for me! May Saradomin always smile upon you!
translation: 谢谢你帮我除掉那个可怕的鬼魂！愿萨拉多明永远眷顾你！

english: I'm looking for a new quest.
translation: 我在找新任务。

english: Sorry, I only had the one quest.
translation: 抱歉，我只有一个任务。

english: The Wise Old Man of Draynor Village said you might reward me if I brought you this.
translation: 德雷诺村的老智者说如果我把这个带给你，你可能会奖励我。

english: Oh, did he?
translation: 哦，他说的？

english: I'd give you a reward, but you don't seem to have any space for it. Come back when you do.
translation: 我想给你奖励，但你似乎没空间拿。有了空间再来。

english: Well, it's still nice of you to bring the message here. Here, I shall bless you...
translation: 嗯，你把消息带来还是很好的。来，我祝福你……

english: Well, maybe you'll find a use for these seeds?
translation: 嗯，也许你会发现这些种子有用？

english: Well, maybe you'll have a use for these?
translation: 嗯，也许你会用得上这些？

english: I suppose gems are always acceptable rewards!
translation: 我想宝石总是可以接受的奖励！

english: I have a question for you.
translation: 我有个问题问你。

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
translation: 请输入问题的答案。

english: No, try again.
translation: 不，再试一次。

english: Correct!
translation: 正确！

english: Here, have this.
translation: 来，拿着这个。

english: Who's Saradomin?
translation: 谁是萨拉多明？

english: Oh, THAT Saradomin...
translation: 哦，那个萨拉多明……

english: Oh, sorry. I'm not from this world.
translation: 哦，抱歉。我不是这个世界的人。

english: You don't understand. This is an online game!
translation: 你不明白。这是个在线游戏！

english: I am - do you like my disguise?
translation: 我是——你喜欢我的伪装吗？

english: Nice place you've got here.
translation: 你这地方不错。

english: I'm looking for a quest!
translation: 我在找任务！

english: Yes
translation: 是

english: No
translation: 否

english: I'm looking for a quest!
translation: 我在找任务！

english: In this holy place I can only offer you calm and peace.
translation: 在这个神圣的地方，我只能给你平静与安宁。

english: Calm and Peace? Sounds like the quest for me! How should I start?
translation: 平静与安宁？听起来适合我！我怎么开始？

english: Yes, calm and peace. Just stay here with me and you will feel it eventually.
translation: 是的，平静与安宁。只要待在这里陪我，你最终会感受到的。

english: Oh... well... thank you.
translation: 哦……嗯……谢谢。

english: Sorry, there will be no sermon today, but you may offer a prayer to Saradomin yourself.
translation: 抱歉，今天没有布道，但你可以自己向萨拉多明祈祷。

english: Do the people here mostly worship Saradomin?

english: Can you give me any farming advice?

english: The only way to cure a bush or tree of disease is to prune away the diseased leaves with a pair of secateurs. For all other crops I would just apply some plant-cure.
translation: 治愈灌木或树木疾病的唯一方法是用修枝剪剪掉病叶。其他作物我只需用些植物治愈剂。

english: Don't just throw away your weeds after you've raked a patch - put them in a compost bin and make some compost.
translation: 耙完种植地后别直接扔掉杂草——放进堆肥箱做堆肥。

english: There are many Farming areas out there. I know of Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Kragen's area near Ardougne, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius and Alan's area in the Farming Guild. That said, I'm sure there's plenty more that I don't know about.
translation: 外面有很多种植区。我知道法拉多城附近的埃尔斯坦区，凯瑟比镇附近的丹塔拉区，阿多尼城附近的克拉根区，莫利塔尼亚的莱拉区，霍西迪乌斯城的马里斯区，以及农业公会的艾伦区。话说回来，肯定还有很多我不知道的。

english: Supercompost is far better than normal compost, but more expensive to make. You need to rot the right type of item; show me and item, and I'll tell you if it's super-compostable or not.
translation: 超级堆肥比普通堆肥效果好得多，但成本更高。你需要腐烂正确类型的物品；给我看个物品，我告诉你是否能超级堆肥。

english: There is a special patch for growing Belladonna - I believe that it is somewhere near Draynor Manor, where the ground is a tad 'unblessed'.
translation: 颠茄有专门的种植地——我记得是在德雷诺庄园附近，那地方的土嘛，有点''不受祝福''。

english: If you want to grow fruit trees you could try a few places: Catherby, Brimhaven, Gnome Stronghold and the Farming Guild all have fruit tree patches.
translation: 如果想种果树，可以试试几个地方：凯瑟比镇、布尔哈文镇、地精要塞和农业公会都有果树种植地。

english: You don't have tp buy all your plantpots you know, you can make them yourself on a pottery wheel. If you're good enough at crafting, that is.
translation: 花盆不用全买，手艺够的话能在陶轮上自己做。如果你工艺足够好的话。

english: You can put up to five tomatoes, strawberries, apples, bananas or oranges into a fruit basket, although you can't have a mix in the same basket.
translation: 你可以在水果篮里放最多五个番茄、草莓、苹果、香蕉或橙子，但不能混装。

english: Hops are good for brewing ales. I believe there's a brewery up in Keldagrim somewhere, and I've heard rumours that a place called Phasmatys used to be good for that type of thing. 'Fore they all died, of course.
translation: 啤酒花适合酿造麦酒。我相信凯尔达格林城某处有个酿酒厂，我还听说一个叫法斯玛提斯的地方以前也酿造这种酒。当然那是在他们都死光之前的事了。

english: Applying compost to a patch will not only reduce the chance that your crops will get diseased, but you will also grow more crops to harvest.
translation: 给种植地施堆肥不仅能降低作物生病几率，还能收获更多作物。

english: You can put up to ten potatoes, cabbages or onions in vegetable sacks, although you can't have a mix in the same sack.
translation: 蔬菜袋里最多能装十个土豆、卷心菜或者洋葱，不过一袋里可不能混着装。

english: You can fill plantpots with soil from  any empty patch, if you have a gardening trowel.
translation: 如果有园艺铲，你可以用任何空种植地的土壤填满花盆。

english: Vegetables, hops and flowers need constant watering - if you ignore my advice, you will sooner or later find yourself in possession of a dead farming patch.
translation: 蔬菜、啤酒花和花朵需要持续浇水——如果无视我的建议，你迟早会发现自己拥有一块荒废的种植地。

english: You can buy all the farming tools from farming shops, which can be found close to the allotments.
translation: 你可以从种植店买所有种植工具，就在分配地附近。

english: If you want to make your own sacks and baskets you'll need to use the loom that's near the Farming shop in Falador. If you're good enough at crafting, that is.

english: Tree seeds must be grown in a plantpot of soil into a sapling, and then transferred to a tree patch to continue growing to adulthood.
translation: 树木种子得先在装土的花盆里养成树苗，再移栽到树木种植地，才能继续长成大树。

translation: 反正我就这样了，孤零零一个人在这岛上。

english: I'd paid quite handsomely for my passage too!
translation: 我可是付了不少船钱的！

english: A tour to the rainforest, and then dinner in Tal Teklan.
translation: 本來是雨林之旅，还包塔尔泰克兰的晚餐。

english: This crew were all so very willing to get me where I wanted to go.
translation: 这帮船员当时可热心了，说一定送我去想去的地方。

english: Very helpful as they collected my belongings. Eager, even.
translation: 帮我收拾行李时特别殷勤，甚至有点急切。

english: It felt exclusive. I was the only passenger they took aboard.
translation: 感觉像是专属待遇，毕竟我是他们唯一的乘客。

english: I do see now that I was perhaps foolish.
translation: 现在想想，我当时可能太天真了。

english: Drawn in by their charms, throwing money around.
translation: 被他们哄得团团转，钱也撒了不少。

english: I just really wanted that dinner in Tal Teklan, you know?
translation: 我只是真的很想吃那顿塔尔泰克兰的晚餐，你懂的？

english: Now I'm going to die alone on an island, bereft of my worldly possessions.
translation: 现在我要孤零零死在这岛上，身外之物全没了。

english: Perhaps the bards of Temptestuswill write of my sorrow, should they hear my tale.
translation: 也许坦佩斯图斯城的吟游诗人听了我的遭遇，会把它写进歌里。

english: Tell people of my struggles!
translation: 把我的遭遇告诉别人吧！

english: Excuse me! Hello! I appear to have found myself in a situation here.
translation: 打扰一下！你好！我似乎发现自己陷入了某种境地。

english: Can you see any way for me to... defamiliarise myself with this island?
translation: 你能帮我想想办法……怎么离开这鬼地方吗？

english: I'm getting rather bored being stuck here waiting for the tide to swallow me.
translation: 困在这儿等潮水把我吞了，无聊得要命。

english: Though, that is reliant on me not throwing myself into the dark sea first.
translation: 不过这得看我会不会先跳进那黑漆漆的海里。

english: But fear not! I shan't do that, for it would be improper.
translation: 你别担心！我不会那么干的，那多不像话。

english: Though if it rains again, I may be tempted.
translation: 但要是再下雨，说不定我就真跳了。

english: Observe how I have nothing here on this island.
translation: 看看我在这岛上什么都没有。

english: There's myself and the occasional crab, but I've been left here... Abandoned! Forgotten!
translation: 就我跟偶尔爬过的螃蟹，被扔在这儿……被抛弃！被遗忘！

english: I don't suppose you could send for a boat to retrieve me?
translation: 你总没法派船来接我吧？

english: Or perhaps an armada.
translation: 要不派个舰队来？

english: Yes, this predicament needs excessive force to be resolved peacefully.
translation: 是啊，这种局面非得大动干戈才能和平解决。

english: Maybe I should pack a flag next time. Claim this land for myself.
translation: 下次我该带面旗来，直接宣称这地归我。

english: No! I can't be stuck here! It's far too small.
translation: 不行！我不能困在这儿！这地方也太小了！

english: Are you finding the air just chokes you here? It is the air, isn't it?
translation: 你是不是也觉得这儿空气闷得慌？就是空气的问题对吧？

english: Gosh, it feels as if my skin is just crawling.
translation: 天呐，感觉浑身皮肤都在发麻。

english: Nobody's going to find me here... I'm going to rot on this island alone.
translation: 没人会来这儿找我了……我要孤零零烂在这岛上了。

english: No, no, no!
translation: 不不不！

english: My regular baker will realise I've not come by in a day. He will send a search party!
translation: 我常去的那家面包师发现我一天没露面，肯定会派人来找！

english: They will send a search party, won't they?
translation: 他们总会派人来找吧？

english: What if they don't?
translation: 要是他们不来呢？

english: Someone will know I'm missing.
translation: 总该有人发现我失踪了吧。

english: This island is too small though... They won't be able to see it.
translation: 可这岛太小了……他们根本看不见。

english: I'd start a fire, if only I had the tools to do so.
translation: 我要是有工具，早就生火了。

english: This isn't how I was meant to die!
translation: 我不该落得这种下场！

english: I was meant to go down gloriously in the Colosseum!
translation: 我本该在竞技场光荣战死！

english: Can you train my cat to be a wily cat?
translation: 你能训练我的猫成为机灵的猫吗？

english: Your overgrown cat has grown into a lean mean hunting cat.
translation: 你的大肥猫已经练成精干的猎猫了。

english: Meeow Meeeoow!
translation: 喵 喵喵！

english: A heroic cat like yours needs a heroic name, don't you think?
translation: 像你这种英雄猫，总得有个配得上的英雄名字吧？

english: Shall we rename it?
translation: 我们要给它改名吗？

english: Can you tell me more about wily cats?
translation: 能多告诉我些关于机灵的猫的事吗？

english: Of course!
translation: 当然！

english: You already have a mature cat, look after that first.
translation: 你已经有成熟猫了，先照顾好那只。

english: I can only train overgrown cats into wily cats.
translation: 我只能训练大肥猫成为机灵的猫。

english: Can you rename my cat?
translation: 你能给我的猫改名吗？

english: Hey [player name], you finally got around to naming me.
translation: 嘿 [player name]，你终于给我起名了。

english: Sorry I took so long, [cat name], it took a while to come up with a name for you.
translation: 抱歉啊[cat name]，给你起个名花了不少时间。

english: Miaaow!
translation: 喵！

english: I'll only help you name wily or lazy cats. Bring me one and I'll help you out.
translation: 我只帮机灵的猫或懒猫起名，带一只来我帮你。

english: Can you tell me more about the pits?
translation: 能多告诉我些关于坑的事吗？

english: Here take this, you might find it useful.
translation: 来拿着这个，你可能觉得有用。

english: What do you want to know?
translation: 你想了解什么？

english: Do you have any pointers for me and my cat?
translation: 你有什么给我和猫的建议吗？

english: You should wear an Amulet of Catspeak. It will allow you to organise tactics with your cat.
translation: 你该戴上猫语护符，这样就能和猫商量战术了。

english: What would be the best tactic to adopt then?
translation: 那最好采用什么战术？

english: Well, that depends on your outlook, whether you're ready to risk your cat's life or not and how defensive or aggressive you want your cat to be.
translation: 这得看你怎么想：愿不愿意让猫冒险，还有你想让它偏防御还是偏进攻。

english: I will not risk my cat's life.
translation: 我不会拿我猫的生命去冒险。

english: Well if that's the case then you're left with two choices.
translation: 嗯如果是那样，你还有两个选择。

english: You can adopt an ultra defensive strategy, which increases your cat's hitpoints and defence but causes it to flee sooner.
translation: 你可以采用超防御策略，增加猫的生命值和防御，但会导致它更早逃跑。

english: Or you can adopt a less defensive strategy, which will allow your cat to stay in the pit for longer.
translation: 或者选偏防御策略，猫就能在坑里多待会儿。

english: I think I would adopt a very defensive strategy
translation: 我想我会采用非常防御的策略

english: In that case you should tell your cat: 'Just take care of yourself, cat.'
translation: 那样的话你就跟猫说：'照顾好自己就行。'

english: Thanks for your help.
translation: 谢谢你的帮助。

english: Do you have any other questions about the pits?
translation: 你关于坑还有其他问题吗？

english: I think I would adopt a less defensive strategy.
translation: 我想我会采取不那么保守的策略。

english: In that case you should tell your cat: 'Stay in for as long as you can.'
translation: 那样的话你就跟猫说：'能待多久待多久。'

english: I am willing to risk my cat, if it increases my chances of victory.
translation: 我愿意冒猫的危险，如果能增加胜利几率。

english: In that case you are left with two choices.
translation: 那样的话你还有两个选择。

english: You could go for all out attack which will boost your cat's attack and strength, but weaken it.
translation: 你可以选全力进攻，猫的攻击和力量会提升，但会更脆弱。

english: Or, go for a less aggressive stance, which will increase your cat's strength and attack to a lesser degree, but carries no defensive penalties.
translation: 或者选偏进攻姿态，猫的力量和攻击提升幅度小点，但不会降低防御。

english: I think I would adopt a very aggressive strategy.
translation: 我想我会采取非常激进的策略。

english: In that case you should tell your cat: 'Go berserk!'
translation: 那样的话你就跟猫说：'给我疯起来！'

english: I think I would adopt a less aggressive strategy.
translation: 我想我会采取不那么激进的策略。

english: In that case you should tell your cat: 'No guts, no glory!'
translation: 那样的话你就跟猫说：'不敢拼，哪有赢！'

english: What benefits does my cat get from training in the pits?
translation: 我的猫从坑里训练得到什么好处？

english: It depends on what kind of cat you have.
translation: 取决于你有什么样的猫。

english: In the Port Sarim pits, your cat will become happier and fitter after fighting.
translation: 在沙林港的坑里，你的猫战斗后会变得更开心更健康。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Can you tell me more about Wily cats?
translation: 能多告诉我些关于机灵的猫的事吗？

english: They're tougher, stronger and faster than other kinds of cats. They have superior hunting skills and can even catch butterflies and kalphite larvae.
translation: 它们比普通猫更强壮、更快、更猛，狩猎本事一流，连蝴蝶和卡尔夫特幼虫都能抓。

english: So are there any drawbacks to owning them?
translation: 那么拥有它们有什么缺点吗？

english: Wily cats need lots more exercise, otherwise they'll get fat and lazy.
translation: 机灵的猫需要更多运动，否则会变胖变懒。

english: What's the best way to exercise them?
translation: 锻炼它们的最好方法是什么？

english: Bring it hunting or take it to the Rat Pits regularly.
translation: 多带它去打猎，或者常去鼠坑练练。

english: Try and keep it happy too, wily cats can be a little nasty when they're cranky.
translation: 也尽量让它开心，机灵的猫烦躁时会有点恶劣。

english: What happens if I neglect my cat? Not that I would!
translation: 如果我忽视我的猫会怎样？不是说我会！

english: It'll get fat and lazy and become much worse at hunting. Plus, everyone will know you're a bad cat trainer.
translation: 它会变胖变懒，狩猎本事越来越差，到时候人人都知道你是个不合格的猫训练师。

english: Can I retrain my lazy cat?
translation: 我能重新训练我的懒惰猫吗？

english: Yes, you can get your lazy cat back in shape with lots of rat catching. But you really shouldn't let things get that bad.
translation: 可以，多抓老鼠就能让懒猫恢复状态，但真不该让它落到那地步。

english: How's the poem going?
translation: 诗写得怎么样了？

english: Ah yes, the poem... your performance was incredibly inspiring. I think it'll be a real masterpiece...
translation: 啊对，那首诗……你的表现太有灵感了，我觉得肯定能写成传世佳作……

english: Just as soon as I get around to writing it all down.
translation: 只要我一有空把它写下来。

english: Hello, the facesaid that you were looking to talk with me.
translation: 你好，face 说你想找我谈谈。

english: Indeed, word has gotten to me from our other ratcatcher chapters that you are quite a talent.
translation: 确实，其他捕鼠者分会都传话说你很有本事。

english: Well I can't take all the credit, I've had more than a little help from my cat.
translation: 这功劳可不能全算我的，我的猫可帮了大忙。

english: Modesty, a trait seldom displayed by adventurers these days.
translation: 谦虚啊，现在冒险者可少见这种品质了。

english: Too many more like you and I'll lose half of my business.
translation: 再多几个像你这样的，我会失去一半生意。

english: Why is that?
translation: 这是为什么？

english: Epic poems of bravery and heroics aren't usually commissioned by the shy and retiring.
translation: 勇敢和英雄主义的史诗通常不是由害羞和隐退的人委托的。

english: Smokin' Joe said that you know lots about training wily cats.
translation: 老烟枪‧乔说你对训练机灵的猫很在行。

english: Indeed I do. It's for this very reason that I requested to talk to you.
translation: 我确实知道。正是因为这个原因我才要求跟你谈谈。

english: So you will show me how to turn my cat into a wily cat?
translation: 所以你要教我怎么把猫训练成机灵的猫？

english: No, not yet.
translation: 不，还不是时候。

english: *Sighs.*
translation: 叹气。

english: No I need you to carry out just one task for me.
translation: 不，我只要你帮我办一件事。

english: Well experience has taught me to expect as much, what must I do?
translation: 唉，经验告诉我早有心理准备，要我做什么？

english: Nothing too difficult, just rid the port of every single rat, with just one action.
translation: 不难，一次动作把港口的老鼠全清掉就行。

english: What?
translation: 什么？

english: Are you serious?
translation: 你是认真的？

english: Deadly.
translation: 千真万确。

english: But why? Why one stroke, why not a slow eradication?
translation: 但为什么？为什么一次完成，为什么不慢慢根除？

english: I want to write a new poem.
translation: 我想写首新诗。

english: But...
I am touched that you want to write an epic poem about me, but why can't you write the poem about seagulls or daffodils or something?
translation: 我很感动你想为我写史诗，但为什么不能写关于海鸥或水仙花之类的诗？

english: Well seagulls rarely make good central characters. They're a bit too ... uhm.... flighty.
translation: 海鸥当主角可不太行，它们有点太……呃……飘忽不定。

english: Besides the poem is about me not you.
translation: 再说诗是写我的，又不是写你的。

english: Sorry I don't follow.
translation: 抱歉，我没太明白。

english: I myself carried out the very same feat once upon a time.
translation: 我自己曾经也完成过同样的壮举。

english: So why do you need me to repeat your most heroic of feats?
translation: 那你为什麼非要我再演一遍你的英雄壮举？

english: It's all about objectivity and integrity. I need to be utterly divorced from the process.
translation: 这关乎客观和真实，我得完全置身事外才行。

english: Umm... ok, I suppose.
translation: 嗯……好吧，我想也是。

english: So can you tell me how you went about achieving this?
translation: 那么你能告诉我你是怎么完成的吗？

english: No. Therein lies the challenge.
translation: 不。挑战就在于此。

english: *Sigh* Why does it always have to be like this?
translation: (叹气)为什么总是这样？

english: You haven't completed the task yet.
translation: 你还没完成任务。

english: What do I have to do again?
translation: 我要再做什么？

english: Rid the port of all its rats with one action.
translation: 一次行动清除港口里所有的老鼠。

english: I'd better get to it then.
translation: 那我最好去做。

english: I think I know how to carry out the task.
translation: 我想我知道怎么完成任务。

english: Has the facebeingtelling tall tales again?
translation: face 又在讲大话了吗？

english: Oh no, she didn't say a word.
translation: 哦不，她一个字没说。

english: Really she didn't.
translation: 真的她没说。

english: Ha! I did it. Did you see me?
translation: 哈！我做到了，看见没？

english: Yes I saw that, now what can I do for you? Don't keep me overly long, I'm trying to complete my poem.
translation: 是的我看到了，现在我能为你做什么？别耽误我太久，我在写诗。

translation: 你能教我怎么把猫训练成机灵的猫吗？

translation: 我只能训练大肥猫成为机灵的猫。

english: You should really name your cat.
translation: 你真该给你的猫起个名字。

english: Hey [username], you finally got around to naming me.
translation: 嘿 [username]，你终于给我起名了。

english: Sorry I took so long, [catname], it took a while to come up with a name for you.
translation: 抱歉啊[catname]，给你起个名花了不少时间。

translation: 你想了解什么？

translation: 你可以采用超防御策略，增加猫的生命值和防御，缺点是你的猫会更早逃跑。

english: Your other option is to adopt a less defensive strategy which will allow your cat to stay in the pit for longer.
translation: 另一个是选偏防御策略，猫就能在坑里多待会儿。

english: In that case you should tell your cat, 'Just take care of yourself cat.'
translation: 那样的话你应该告诉猫，‘照顾好自己猫。’

english: In that case you should tell your cat, 'Stay in for as long as you can.'
translation: 那样的话你应该告诉猫，‘尽可能待在里面。’

english: You could go for all out attack which will boost your cat's attack and strength, but weaken it
translation: 你可以选全力进攻，猫的攻击和力量会提升，但会更脆弱。

english: or go for a less aggressive stance which will increase your cat's strength and attack to a lesser degree, but carries no defensive penalties.
translation: 或者选个偏进攻的姿态，猫的力量和攻击提升幅度小点儿，但不会降低防御。

english: I think I would adopt a very aggressive strategy
translation: 我想我会采用非常攻击的策略

english: In that case you should tell your cat, 'Go berserk!'
translation: 那样的话你就跟猫说：''给我疯起来！''

english: In that case you should tell this to your cat, 'No guts, no glory!'
translation: 那样的话你就跟猫说：''不敢拼，哪有赢！''

english: Of course, of course, they're the highest form of cat that I know of.
translation: 当然，当然，它们是我知道的最高级形式的猫。

english: They're tougher, stronger and faster than other variations of cat, they can catch butterflies and kalphite larva and are far superior to any other type of cat at hunting.
translation: 它们比其他种类的猫更强壮、更强悍、更快，能抓蝴蝶和卡尔夫特幼虫，狩猎能力远超其他类型的猫。

english: So is there any drawbacks to owning them?
translation: 那么拥有它们有什么缺点吗？

english: Wily cats need looking after or else they get fat and lazy.
translation: 机灵的猫需要照顾，否则会变胖变懒。

english: So how do I look after them then?
translation: 那我怎么照顾它们？

english: The key is to keep it active, bring it hunting or to the ratpits regularly.
translation: 关键是保持活跃，定期带它打猎或去鼠坑。

english: Try keep it happy too, they can be a little nasty when they're cranky.
translation: 也尽量让它开心，它们烦躁时会有点恶劣。

english: What happens if I neglect my cat.. not that I would or anything?
translation: 如果我忽视我的猫会怎样……不是说我会或什么的？

english: They would get fat and lazy, be much worse at hunting and would show you up as a really poor cat trainer.
translation: 它们会变胖变懒，狩猎能力变差，会让你显得是个很糟糕的猫训练师。

english: Yes you can get your lazy cat back in shape with a lot of rat catching, but you really shouldn't let it get into that state in the first place.

translation: 如果保持连胜，明天可能不用去工作了。

english: Umm ok.

english: So how do these rat pits work?
translation: 那么这些鼠坑怎么运作？

english: The Keldagrim pits cater for those with the larger variety of cats.
translation: 凯尔达格林城的鼠坑专为饲养大型猫的玩家打造。

english: If you have an overgrown cat and a couple of coins you can challenge someone else who also has an overgrown cat and some spare change.
translation: 如果你有只大肥猫和一些金币，你可以挑战另一个也有长大的猫和零钱的人。

english: That sounds simple enough so far.
translation: 目前为止听起来够简单。

english: You then agree on a wager. It's rumoured that some ratcatchers can talk to their own cats and give them tactics to aid them.
translation: 随后双方商定赌注。传闻有些捕鼠者能与自己的猫交流，为其制定战术助战。

english: So then how do you win the challenge?
translation: 那么怎么赢得挑战？

english: I was just getting to that. Both the challengers' cats are placed inside the arena, and whichever kills 9 rats first wins.
translation: 我正要说。双方挑战者的猫会被放入竞技场，先击杀9只老鼠的一方获胜。

english: That sounds vile and cruel.
translation: 听起来邪恶又残酷。

english: It's a cruel world and the pits are no exception.
translation: 世界残酷，坑也不例外。

english: Each to their own, I say.
translation: 我说，各有所好。

english: It sounds a little dangerous for my cat.
translation: 听起来对我的猫来说有点危险。

english: I agree. Cats have been known to be killed in fights.
translation: 我同意。已知猫在战斗中会被杀死。

english: Oh how terrible. Is there nothing you can do to save your cat?
translation: 哦多可怕。没什么能救你的猫吗？

english: Of course there is, you can instruct it to be cautious, and it will leave once it feels as if it is in danger.
translation: 当然有办法，你可以指示它保持谨慎，一旦察觉危险它就会离开。

english: Oh that sounds quite wise.
translation: 哦那听起来很明智。

english: That depends on how you value your cat.
translation: 那取决于你多重视你的猫。

english: Sorry, I don't follow.
translation: 抱歉，我没跟上。

english: Well if your cat dies or it runs away you lose.
translation: 如果你的猫阵亡或逃跑，你便判负。

english: So the longer it stays in the fight the better chance you have of winning.
translation: 所以它在战斗中待越久你赢的机会越大。

translation: 嗯，那听起来像是赌猫斗的愚蠢金额。

english: You'd be surprised what some people would be willing to bet.

english: There is a minimum bet of 100 coins too.

english: Can I challenge you and your cat?

english: No, not now, we don't really bet with outsiders.
translation: 不行，我们一般不和外人赌。

english: But I'm not an outsider, am I not inside in the pits now?

english: I don't know, maybe once you've done something to win over my trust.
translation: 不好说，也许等你做点什么赢得我的信任之后吧。

translation: 你的信任。

english: Ahoy there! Here for a drink? You've picked the right place for it. Steve is thankfully a much better bartender than he was a sailor.
translation: 喂！来喝酒吗？你选对地方了。谢天谢地史蒂夫是个比水手好得多的酒保。

english: Sounds like there's a story here?
translation: 听起来这里有故事？

english: Indeed there is. Steve fancied himself a pirate, but on his first proper voyage he managed to crash his ship, the Pandemonium, right here.
translation: 确实有。史蒂夫自以为海盗，但第一次正式航行就把船“潘德莫尼姆”号撞在这里了。

english: He crashed? How?
translation: 他撞船了？怎么撞的？

english: He claims it was an unavoidable accident caused by the Storm Tempor, but I heard it was actually because he got distracted by a large flock of angry parrots.
translation: 他声称是风暴泰普尔造成的不可避免事故，但我听说其实是因为他被一大群愤怒的鹦鹉分心了。

english: So he crashed the boat and then decided to open a bar?
translation: 所以他撞了船然后决定开酒吧？

english: Pretty much.
translation: 差不多。

english: I see. Fair enough.
translation: 我明白了。说得过去。

english: The camera pans to the Fire Warrior of Lesarkus spawning when the player attempts to open the door.
translation: 玩家试图开门时镜头平移至莱萨库斯之火战士生成。

english: The Fire Warrior of Lesarkus casts a spell to push the player away from the door.
translation: 莱萨库斯之火战士施法把玩家推离门。

english: Your puny weapons do nothing against me human! Come back when you can give me a real fight!
translation: 你那微不足道的武器伤不了我，人类！等你有能力与我真正一战时再来吧！

translation: 谁敢进入伊科夫神庙！

english: A mighty hero!
translation: 一个强大英雄！

english: Pathetic fool! Prepare to die!
translation: 可怜蠢货！准备受死！

translation: 一个卑微朝圣者。

english: I haven't seen a pilgrim for thousands of years!
translation: 几千年没见过朝圣者了！

translation: 阿米图斯！塞提提！

english: A mighty hero!
translation: 一个强大英雄！

english: A humble pilgrim.
translation: 一个卑微朝圣者。

english: Gratias tibi ago!
translation: 谢谢你！(拉丁语)

english: What do you need, adventurer? There is a battle to fight!
translation: 你需要什么，冒险者？有战斗要打！

english: How do I help?
translation: 我怎么帮忙？

english: Get yerself a harpoon from the crate on the ship, then go fish around the island t' catch some harpoonfish. They make fer fine ammo against Tempoross!
translation: 先从船上箱子里取把鱼叉，再去岛屿周边钓些叉鱼。这些叉鱼可是对抗海灵的绝佳弹药！

english: Once ye caught some, ye can cook 'em at the shrines on the island if ye want 'em to pack more of a punch. Then come back t' the ship an' load 'em in the ammunition crates next to the cannons.
translation: 捕获一些后，若想增强威力，可在岛上的神龛处烹饪。随后返回船只，将它们装入大炮旁的弹药箱内。

english: Our cannoneers will get t' firin' the harpoonfish at Tempoross. When it's weak an' submerges to recover its energy, get down to the jetty next t' the ship an' fish those spirit pools.
translation: 我们的炮手会向海灵发射叉鱼。待其虚弱潜入水中恢复能量时，前往船旁的码头钓那些灵池里的鱼。

english: Be quick with fishin' those spirit pools though, or it'll come back so strong we'll have to abandon the fight! With any luck, we'll weaken those spirit fish enough t' subdue Tempoross. Now get t' the fight, sailor!
translation: 不过钓那些灵池里的鱼要快，否则它恢复得太强我们就得放弃战斗！运气好的话，我们会削弱那些灵魂鱼足以制服海灵。现在去战斗吧，水手！

english: Aye aye!
translation: 遵命！

english: What should I watch out for?
translation: 我该注意什么？

english: If Tempoross electrocutes a cannon t' stop it from firin', ya better load your harpoonfish into the other ammunition crates t' keep them cannons firin' instead.
translation: 如果海灵电击大炮阻止发射，你最好把叉鱼装进其他弹药箱让那些大炮继续发射。

english: Also, make sure t' grab a rope from the ship crates an' keep an eye out for big waves. We'll make sure t' shout about them. Then ye best quickly tether yerself t' an island totem pole or ship mast with that rope.
translation: 另外，确保从船箱拿绳子留意大浪。我们会确保大喊提醒。然后你最好尽快用绳子把自己拴在岛图腾柱或船桅上。

english: If the waves break the totem pole or ship mast, ye can grab a hammer from the ship crates t' fix 'em up before the next big wave hits.
translation: 如果浪打断图腾柱或船桅，你可以从船箱拿锤子在下个大浪前修好。

english: Oh, an' keep an eye out for lightnin' clouds causin' fires. Get a bucket from the ship crates, fill it with water at a pump, and get t' puttin it out before it spreads.
translation: 哦，还要留意闪电云引起火灾。从船箱拿桶，在泵处装满水，在蔓延前扑灭。

english: If ye get hit by the waves or fire, don't be surprised when ye lose those fish an' tools ye gathered. Now get t' the fight, sailor!
translation: 如果被浪或火击中，别惊讶丢失收集的鱼和工具。现在去战斗吧，水手！

english: I want to leave.
translation: 我想离开。

english: Really? You will receive no reward if you do.
translation: 真的？那样做你将没有奖励。

english: I'll get on with the fighting.
translation: 我继续战斗。

english: We did it! Tempoross has been sudbued once again. Well done!
translation: 我们做到了！海灵再次被制服。干得好！

english: Take a well deserved rest but don't get too comfy, it'll regain its energy soon enough!
translation: 好好休息但别太舒服，它很快会恢复能量！

english: What should I do now?
translation: 我现在该做什么？

english: We usually find some debris washed up near the docks back at Unkah. Feel free t' have a look. Ya might find somethin' useful!
translation: 我们通常在乌恩卡码头附近发现些冲上来的碎片。随意看看。可能找到有用东西！

english: It won't be long before Tempoross regains enough energy to be a problem and we'll have to wrangle it again. Hopefully we can count on you to 'elp!
translation: 不久海灵会恢复足够能量成问题，我们得再次制服它。希望能指望你帮忙！

english: I'm ready to leave.

english: Aye aye!
translation: 遵命！

english: Goodbye.

english: How do I help?
translation: 我怎么帮忙？

english: Get yerself a harpoon from the crate on the ship, then go fish around the island t' catch some harpoonfish. They make fer fine ammo against Tempoross!
translation: 先从船上箱子里取把鱼叉，再去岛屿周边钓些叉鱼。这些叉鱼可是对抗海灵的绝佳弹药！

english: Once ye caught some, ye can cook 'em at the shrines on the island if ye want 'em to pack more of a punch. Then come back t' the ship an' load 'em in the ammunition crates next to the cannons.
translation: 捕获一些后，若想增强威力，可在岛上的神龛处烹饪。随后返回船只，将它们装入大炮旁的弹药箱内。

english: Our cannoneers will get t' firin' the harpoonfish at Tempoross. When it's weak an' submerges to recover its energy, get down to the jetty next t' the ship an' fish those spirit pools.
translation: 我们的炮手会向海灵发射叉鱼。待其虚弱潜入水中恢复能量时，前往船旁的码头钓那些灵池里的鱼。

english: Be quick with fishin' those spirit pools though, or it'll come back so strong we'll have to abandon the fight! With any luck, we'll weaken those spirit fish enough t' subdue Tempoross. Now get t' the fight, sailor!
translation: 不过钓那些灵池里的鱼要快，否则它恢复得太强我们就得放弃战斗！运气好的话，我们会削弱那些灵魂鱼足以制服海灵。现在去战斗吧，水手！

english: Aye aye!
translation: 遵命！

english: What should I watch out for?
translation: 我该注意什么？

english: If Tempoross electrocutes a cannon t' stop it from firin', ya better load your harpoonfish into the other ammunition crates t' keep them cannons firin' instead.
translation: 如果海灵电击大炮阻止发射，你最好把叉鱼装进其他弹药箱让那些大炮继续发射。

english: Also, make sure t' grab a rope from the ship crates an' keep an eye out for big waves. We'll make sure t' shout about them. Then ye best quickly tether yerself t' an island totem pole or ship mast with that rope.
translation: 另外，确保从船箱拿绳子留意大浪。我们会确保大喊提醒。然后你最好尽快用绳子把自己拴在岛图腾柱或船桅上。

english: If the waves break the totem pole or ship mast, ye can grab a hammer from the ship crates t' fix 'em up before the next big wave hits.
translation: 如果浪打断图腾柱或船桅，你可以从船箱拿锤子在下个大浪前修好。

english: Oh, an' keep an eye out for lightnin' clouds causin' fires. Get a bucket from the ship crates, fill it with water at a pump, and get t' puttin it out before it spreads.
translation: 哦，还要留意闪电云引起火灾。从船箱拿桶，在泵处装满水，在蔓延前扑灭。

english: If ye get hit by the waves or fire, don't be surprised when ye lose those fish an' tools ye gathered. Now get t' the fight, sailor!
translation: 如果被浪或火击中，别惊讶丢失收集的鱼和工具。现在去战斗吧，水手！

english: We did it! Tempoross has been sudbued once again. Well done!

english: Take a well deserved rest but don't get too comfy, it'll regain its energy soon enough!

english: What does it take to become first mate on a ship?
translation: 成为船上的大副需要什么？

english: Good question. We have a diplomatic consessionat the turn of the financial year. Said pirate is chosen should the existing mate be absent without leave.
translation: 好问题。我们在财政年度交替时有外交让步。如果现任大副擅离职守则选该海盗。

english: I had no idea. I always figured it was all about popularity.
translation: 我不知道。我一直以为全靠人气。

english: It is. I'm just pulling your leg.
translation: 是的。我在逗你玩。

english: I don't sell to outerlanders.
translation: 我不卖给外乡人。

english: Only Fremenniks may purchase fish here.
translation: 只有费明尼克人能在这里买鱼。

english: Hello there [Fremennik name]. Looking for fresh fish?
translation: 你好 [Fremennik name]。找新鲜鱼吗？

english: Hey! Get your hands off there!
translation: 嘿！把手拿开！

english: It is [Fremennik name] the thief!
translation: 是小偷 [Fremennik name]！

english: Guardsguards!
translation: 守卫！守卫！

english: You're the one who stole something from me!
translation: 你就是偷我东西的人！

english: Could I buy some fish?
translation: 我能买些鱼吗？

english: Where do you get your fish from?
translation: 你的鱼从哪来？

english: Some questions are best left unanswered.
translation: 有些问题最好别回答。

english: Err...
So would you like to buy some fish?
translation: 那么你想买些鱼吗？

english: I'll pass.
translation: 我就算了。

english: Suit yourself.
translation: 随你便。

english: Could I buy some fish?
translation: 我能买些鱼吗？

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: I'll pass.
translation: 我就算了。

english: Good fish. Just keep swimming...swimming...swimming...
translation: 好鱼。只管游……游……游……

english: The fish swims. It is clearly an obedient fish.
translation: 鱼游了。显然是条听话的鱼。

english: Jump! Come on fishy, jump!
translation: 跳！加油小鱼，跳！

english: The fish bumps into the side of the fishbowl. Then it swims some more.
translation: 鱼撞到鱼缸边。然后继续游。

english: Good fish...
translation: 好鱼……

english: Hello there. How's it going?
translation: 你好。怎么样？

english: Hello! Nice day for fishing!
translation: 你好！钓鱼的好天气！

english: Well given how good today's catch was, I'd say it's going pretty well!
translation: 嗯鉴于今天渔获多好，我说相当顺利！

english: Nilsal! It's going well, thanks.
translation: 你好！顺利，谢谢。

english: I'm fine, how are you?
translation: 我很好，你呢？

english: Very well, thank you.
translation: 很好，谢谢。

english: Not too bad thanks.
translation: 还不错，谢谢。

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: His eyes are staring vacantly into space.
translation: 他的眼睛空洞地盯着前方。

english: You are not part of our family...
translation: 你不是我们家族的一部分……

english: Umm. Not last time I checked.
translation: 嗯。上次检查不是。

english: Soon you will be... Soon you will...
translation: 很快你会是……很快你会……

english: Lost to us.. She is Lost to us...
translation: 我们失去她了……她离我们而去了……

english: Who is lost?
translation: 谁失去了？

english: Trapped by the light... Lost and trapped...
translation: 被光困住……迷失且被困……

english: Ermm... So you don't want to tell me then?
translation: 呃……所以你不想告诉我？

english: Trapped... In stone and darkness...
translation: 被困……在石头和黑暗中……

english: Must find family...
translation: 必须找到家族……

english: What?
translation: 什么？

english: Soon we will all be together...
translation: 很快我们都会在一起……

english: Are you ok?
translation: 你没事吧？

english: Must find family... They are all under the blue... Deep deep under the blue...
translation: 必须找到家族……他们都在蓝色之下……深深蓝色之下……

english: Ermm... I'll leave you to it then.
translation: 呃……那我不打扰你了。

english: Free of the deep blue we are...
translation: 我们脱离深蓝……

english: We must find...
translation: 我们必须找到……

english: Yes?
translation: 是的？

english: a new home...
translation: 一个新家……

english: We must leave this place...
translation: 我们必须离开这地方……

english: Where will you go?
translation: 你们要去哪？

english: Away.. Away to her...
translation: 离开……离开去她那里……

english: Riiight.
translation: 好吧。

english: Below the deep, deep blue she waits...
translation: 在深深蓝色之下她等待……

english: Who waits?
translation: 谁等待？

english: They came to her with fire and faith...
translation: 他们带着火和信仰来到她那里……

english: Who? Who came to who?
translation: 谁？谁来找谁？

english: Too many... Too many...
translation: 太多……太多……

english: Too many what? Make sense!
translation: 太多什么？说清楚！

english: Locked away for all eternity...
translation: 永远锁住……

english: You'd better start making sense Sonny Jim or I'll...
translation: 你最好开始说清楚小子吉姆否则我……

english: Free... Soon to be free...
translation: 自由……很快自由……

english: Must escape the blue.. Deep deep blue
translation: 必须逃离蓝色……深深蓝色

english: Pardon?
translation: 什么？

english: Family... Under the blue... Must escape the blue...
translation: 家族……蓝色之下……必须逃离蓝色……

english: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？

english: What are you doing out here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Catching anglerfish! This is the only place you can find them!
translation: 钓鮟鱇鱼！这是唯一能找到它们的地方！

english: How can I catch anglerfish?
translation: 我怎么钓鮟鱇鱼？

english: I have heard good things about you, outsider, however, you will need to train your fishing skill before catching these.
translation: 我听说过你的好事，外乡人，不过，钓这些鱼之前你得先练练钓鱼技能。

english: You will need a fishing rod and some sandworms to use as bait. If you need supplies, try Tynan's shoreside store.
translation: 你需要一根鱼竿和一些沙虫做饵。如果需要补给，试试泰南的海边商店。

english: Thanks. I'll let you get back to fishing.
translation: 谢谢。我不打扰你钓鱼了。

english: I'll let you get back to it.
translation: 我不打扰你了。

english: What are you doing out here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: How can I catch anglerfish?
translation: 我怎么钓鮟鱇鱼？

english: I'll let you get back to it.
translation: 我不打扰你了。

english: Don't talk to me outerlander. Anything you have to say to me, you can say to the Chieftain. Goodbye.
translation: 别跟我说话，外乡人。有什么话跟酋长说。再见。

english: Welcome back [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It has been too long since last we spoke! The fish are really biting today!
translation: 欢迎回来，[兄弟/姐妹] [Fremennik name]。上次谈话已是许久之前！今天鱼咬钩特别凶！

english: Good day, Your Royal Highness.
translation: 你好，殿下。

english: Good day. What are you doing?
translation: 你好。你在做什么？

english: You know very well what I'm doing, Your Royal Highness.
translation: 殿下很清楚我在做什么。

english: Just teasing!
translation: 开玩笑的！

english: Can you tell me how the kingdom approves of me?
translation: 你能告诉我王国对我的认可度吗？

english: [amount]% of people approve of you.
translation: [amount]% 的人认可你。

english: The storerooms are full, your Highness. You should talk to Advisor Ghrim to collect what we've gathered for you.
translation: 储藏室已满，殿下。请去找顾问格里姆领取我们为你收集的物资。

english: Can you teach me the basics of fishing please?
translation: 能教我钓鱼基础吗？

english: Ah, you've lost your net have you? Have another!
translation: 啊，网丢了吧？再拿一个！

english: I see you already have a net.
translation: 我看你已经有网了。

english: Ahoy, to fish, you click on the shrimp fishin' spot while ye'r carrying a net.
translation: 要钓鱼的话，带着网点击钓虾点就行。

english: I see... is that it?
translation: 我明白了……就那样？

english: There's far more as you progress - not just shrimps. You get more equipment, bigger fish and other things too...
translation: 随着进步还有很多——不只是虾。你会得到更多装备、更大的鱼和其他东西……

english: When you have a full inventory, you can cook it or take it to the bank. You can find a bank on the roof of the castle in Lumbridge and a cookin' range in the castle kitchen.
translation: 物品栏满时，你可以烹饪或带去银行。仑桥堡屋顶有银行，城堡厨房有烹饪炉。

english: Arrr.. if yer lookin' fer quests you should head over to the Mountain Dwarf who lies north-west of Taverley and have a chat with him, I'm sure he can point you in the right direction.
translation: 啊……如果在找任务，应该去找塔韦利村西北边的山地矮人聊聊，我相信他能给你指路。

english: I can show ye on that map of yours if ya like?
translation: 如果你愿意，我可以在你地图上标出来？

english: I already know about the basics of fishing, got any tips?
translation: 我已经知道钓鱼基础了，有什么建议吗？

english: Arrr, chose carefully where and what you fish, you can get different fish in different places throughout the land.
translation: 啊，仔细选择钓鱼地点和鱼种，全国各地不同地方能钓到不同的鱼。

english: Make sure you hang on to your fish, don't throw them away as you can get valuable cooking experience from them, gar! Look out for other things too...
translation: 确保留住你的鱼，别扔掉，从中能获得宝贵的烹饪经验，哈！也要留意其他东西……

english: Then of course there is always the trawler...
translation: 当然还有拖网渔船……

english: If you venture to Port Khazard north of Yanille and speaks to me cabin boy Murphy, he can let you and a bunch of friends use his trawler to fish with... Just make sure you take a bailing bucket or two.
translation: 如果你冒险去亚尼勒城北边的卡扎德港跟我的船员墨菲谈谈，他能让你和一群朋友用他的拖网渔船钓鱼……只要确保带上一两个舀水桶。

english: Any advice for an advanced fisher?
translation: 有什么给高级渔夫的建议吗？

english: Aye, as you get better and better you'll find that you can fish for things like Tuna and Swordfish. These be very good for combat.
translation: 是的，随着你越来越强，你会发现能钓金枪鱼和剑鱼之类的。这些对战斗很有用。

english: Of course, after that you will get Shark, and if you venture out onto the Trawler from Port Khazard, you can then get Manta Ray or Sea Turtle, very good eatin' on one of them.
translation: 当然，之后你能钓鲨鱼，如果冒险去卡扎德港的拖网渔船，还能钓到魔鬼鱼或海龟，都很好吃。

english: You can also use a fishing potion if you can get your hands on one and just need that little edge.. ask someone who is familiar with herblore.
translation: 如果能弄到钓鱼药水，也可以用来获得那点优势……问问熟悉草药学的人。

english: Now.. quests...
translation: 现在……任务……

english: Head over to south of the Legends Guild and East of Ardougne and find Caroline. This will have you investigating some strange happenings on the fishing platform.
translation: 去传奇公会南边和阿多尼城东边找卡罗琳。这会让你调查钓鱼平台的一些怪事。

english: Head over to Tai Bwo Wannai Village on the Isle of Karamja and speak to Timfraku to solve a strange mystery.
translation: 去卡拉姆詹岛上的泰博瓦纳村跟蒂姆弗拉库谈谈，解开一个神秘谜团。

english: Can't rightly say's there's any I know of that you could handle at the moment, but come back when you're a bit more experienced and I'm sure I can give you a clue.
translation: 说不出现在有什么你能应付的，但等你更有经验些回来，我相信能给你点线索。

english: Tell me about different fish.
translation: 跟我讲讲不同的鱼。

english: Some rich rewards for big net fishin', make sure you be using a big net fishing spot though...
translation: 大网钓鱼有些丰厚奖励，不过确保你用大网钓鱼点……

english: Is that all?
translation: 就这些？

english: Ahoy, there's also the fishin' guild if ya skilled enough, you can find it south west of Seers' Village.
translation: 喂，如果你技能够高，还有钓鱼公会，在先知村西南边。

english: Where and what should I fish?
translation: 我在哪钓什么鱼？

english: A young and enthusiastic fisher. Try south of Draynor Village or the pier on the island of Karamja to fish for Shrimp at level 1 or Sardines at level 5. Aye, me parrot concurs.
translation: 年轻热情的渔夫。试试德雷诺村南边或卡拉姆詹岛码头，1级钓虾或5级钓沙丁鱼。是的，我的鹦鹉同意。

translation: 哦……好吧，当然，肩膀上有只鹦鹉。

translation: 啊！

english: Herrin' can be fished from south of Draynor Village or the pier on the island of Karamja when you reach level 10.
translation: 10级时可以在德雷诺村南边或卡拉姆詹岛码头钓鲱鱼。

english: You can use your small net to catch Anchovies from south of Draynor when you reach level 15.
translation: 15级时可以用小网在德雷诺南边钓鳀鱼。

english: You can practice your fly fishin' in the Lumbridge river to catch Trout at level 20.
translation: 20级时可以在仑桥河练习飞钓钓鳟鱼。

english: Pike can be fished from Lumbridge river using your fishing rod and some bait with at least level 25 fishing.
translation: 25级钓鱼时可以用鱼竿和饵在仑桥河钓狗鱼。

english: Use your harpoon and see if you can catch yourself a few Tuna from the pier on the island of Karamja at level 35.
translation: 35级时用鱼叉试试在卡拉姆詹岛码头钓几条金枪鱼。

english: You can use that Lobster pot from the pier on the island of Karamja to get yourself a whole bunch of the little critters once you reach level 40.
translation: 40级时可以用卡拉姆詹岛码头的龙虾笼抓一堆小家伙。

english: Congratulations, you can now harpoon Swordfish after level 50. Try the pier on the island of Karamja.
translation: 恭喜，50级后可以用鱼叉钓剑鱼。试试卡拉姆詹岛码头。

english: Herrin' can be fished from Catherby and some other places when you reach level 10.
translation: 10级时可以在凯瑟比镇和其他地方钓鲱鱼。

english: You can use a big net to catch Mackerel from Catherby when you reach level 16.
translation: 16级时可以用大网在凯瑟比镇钓鲭鱼。

english: Cod can be fished from Catherby and some other places once you reach level 23.
translation: 23级后可以在凯瑟比镇和其他地方钓鳕鱼。

english: You can use your fishin' rod and some bait to catch Slimy Eel in the swamps at level 28.
translation: 28级时可以用钓鱼竿和饵在沼泽钓黏液鳗。

english: You can use your fishin' rod and some bait to catch Cave Eel in the caves below Lumbridge Swamp at level 38.
translation: 38级时可以用钓鱼竿和饵在仑桥沼泽下的洞穴钓洞穴鳗。

english: Bass can be caught at level 46 in your big net if you wander along to Catherby.
translation: 46级时如果漫步到凯瑟比镇，可以用大网钓鲈鱼。

english: Tuna and Swordfish can be harpooned - if you're good enough - from the thrivin' fishing village of Catherby, or if you can get in try the Fishin' Guild. Level 35 for Tuna and 50 for Swordfish.
translation: 金枪鱼和剑鱼可以用鱼叉钓——如果你够厉害——从繁荣的凯瑟比镇渔村，或者如果能进去试试钓鱼公会。金枪鱼35级，剑鱼50级。

english: You can also go talk to Murphy and see if you can use his trawler to catch Manta Ray and Sea Turtle if you're really good... Gar!
translation: 如果你真的很厉害……哈！也可以去找墨菲谈谈，看能不能用他的拖网渔船钓魔鬼鱼和海龟！

english: Goodbye.

translation: 能教我钓鱼基础吗？

translation: 我已经知道钓鱼基础了，有什么建议吗？

translation: 小网鱼

translation: 竿钓和飞钓

translation: 龙虾笼

translation: 我在哪钓什么鱼？

translation: 再见。

english: Greetings. Get your fresh fish here!
translation: 问候。来这里买新鲜鱼！

english: I've heard that the Etceterian fish is stored in a cow shed.
translation: 我听说埃特塞特拉的鱼存在牛棚里。

english: Greetings, Your Royal Highness. Get your fresh fish here!
translation: 你好，殿下。来这里买新鲜鱼！

english: Welcome [Fremennik name]. My fish is fresher than any in Miscellania!
translation: 欢迎 [Fremennik name]。我的鱼比米斯凯利亚国的任何鱼都新鲜！

english: Can you tell me how the kingdom approves of me?
translation: 你能告诉我王国对我的认可度吗？

english: Kingdom? Etceteria is ruled by a Queen and we don't approve of you.
translation: 王国？埃特塞特拉由女王统治，我们不认可你。

english: [X]% of people approve of you.
translation: [X]% 的人认可你。

english: Wow, are you okay? What happendto you?
translation: 哇，你没事吧？你怎么了？

english: Ugh... Well met, adventurer. I wouldn't go down there if I were you. That trap is an absolute nightmare! The one who created it must be a sadist. I don't know of anyone who has cleared it.
translation: 呃……幸会，冒险者。如果是我就不去下面。那个陷阱绝对是噩梦！创建者肯定是虐待狂。我不知道有谁通过过。

english: Oh? I've cleared it.
translation: 哦？我通过了。

english: Oh? Are you pulling my leg, adventurer?
translation: 哦？你在逗我吗，冒险者？

english: I'm fairly certain that if I did that, it would fall off!
translation: 我很确定如果我那样做，它会掉下来！

english: No need to add salt in the wound.
translation: 没必要往伤口上撒盐。

english: Although I am curious, how did you beat the trap?
translation: 虽然我很好奇，你怎么通过陷阱的？

english: I just made sure to prioritise looking out for the arrows. The fire was fairly easy to get through if I just made sure to take one step at a time.
translation: 我只是确保优先留意箭。火陷阱很容易过，只要确保一次走一步。

english: I see, you're clearly more skillful than I. I'm not sure if I'd be agile enough to do that. Do tell, what was on the next floor?
translation: 我明白了，你显然比我熟练。我不确定我是否足够敏捷。说说，下一层有什么？

english: The place looked magnificent, gold lion statues, coffins untouched by anyone else and plenty of Hallowed marks compared to these floors. Although, the traps were significantly harder than the one below.
translation: 那地方看起来宏伟，金狮雕像，没人动过的棺材，比起这几层有很多圣痕。不过，陷阱比下面的难得多。

english: I see. Well, I guess I'd better brush up on my skills if I want to see it for myself. Nothing worth having in life comes easy right?
translation: 我明白了。嗯，我想如果我想亲眼看看，最好磨练下技能。生活中值得拥有的东西都来之不易对吧？

english: That's very true, I wish you the best of luck!
translation: 确实如此，祝你好运！

english: No one has cleared it? How hard can it be?
translation: 没人通过过？能有多难？

english: Well, unlike the rest of the traps I've seen so far, you have to deal with both an arrow trap and a fire trap at the same time.
translation: 嗯，不像我目前为止见过的其他陷阱，你得同时应对箭陷阱和火陷阱。

english: Wow, that does sound hard. Do you have any tips for me?
translation: 哇，听起来确实难。有什么建议给我吗？

english: Well, individually they aren't that hard to do. The fires are always swapping between on and off. I think that if you run to where the fire just was you should be safe.
translation: 嗯，单独来说都不难。火总是在开关之间切换。我想如果你跑到火刚灭的地方应该安全。

english: The hardest part for me is the arrows. You have to look forward to watch the fire trap whilst also looking over your shoulder to see where the arrows are.
translation: 对我来说最难的是箭。你得向前看火陷阱，同时回头看好箭在哪。

english: I certainly wish there was a way to see both at once. Perhaps it would help if a fellow adventurer was looking down from above to call out where the arrows are.
translation: 我确实希望有办法同时看到两者。也许如果有同伴冒险者从上面往下看喊出箭的位置会有帮助。

english: Yeah... I'd imagine having an aerial view of the situation would be pretty helpful.
translation: 是啊……我想有个空中视角会很有帮助。

english: Of course, but we both know that's impossible for one person! Ouch! Sorry, it hurts to laugh. I wish you luck adventurer!
translation: 当然，但我们都知道一个人不可能！哎哟！抱歉，笑会疼。祝你好运冒险者！

english: Oh? I've cleared it.
translation: 哦？我通过了。

english: No one has cleared it? How hard can it be?
translation: 没人通过过？能有多难？

english: Hello. I'm the flax keeper. I tend to the flax fields, keeping the yield and continued flax harvest healthy.
translation: 你好。我是亚麻守护者。我照料亚麻田，保持产量和持续收获健康。

english: Ooh! Great work!
translation: 哦！干得好！

english: Thank you. I must get back to work. You never know when a great flax harvest will begin!
translation: 谢谢。我得回去工作了。你永远不知道大丰收何时开始！

english: Hello. Do you want to exchange some flax banknotes for bowstrings? I'll exchange [amount] for you today, and you can come back tomorrow for more.
translation: 你好。想用亚麻票换弓弦吗？今天我能给你换 [amount] 个，明天再来换更多。

english: I didn't actually bring [amount] flax banknotes with me.
translation: 我其实没带 [amount] 张亚麻票。

english: Oh. Well, if you fetch that many flax banknotes, I'll swap them for bowstrings for you.
translation: 哦。嗯，如果你拿来那么多亚麻票，我会帮你换成弓弦。

english: Um... Actually, you seem to have so much stuff that you can't hold the bowstrings.
translation: 嗯……其实，你东西太多好像拿不下弓弦。

english: Hello again. I'm afraid I won't be able to exchange any more flax for bowstrings today. Try me again tomorrow.
translation: 又见面了。恐怕今天没法再换更多亚麻为弓弦了。明天再来试试。

english: Today I can exchange [amount] flax banknotes for bowstrings, if you bring me enough flax banknotes.
translation: 今天如果你带够亚麻票，我能换 [amount] 张亚麻票为弓弦。

translation: 抱歉，你物品栏东西太满了。

translation: 什么？所有的？

translation: 不，不。如果你戳那些没有闪光环的，那就糟了。

translation: 所以我得戳闪光的柱子？

translation: 你给狗艾伦的骨头。它高兴地啃着，但总觉得哪里不对劲。

translation: 嘿，是英雄！哇！你太厉害了，你到底是怎么对付那两个成熟吸血鬼和加德兰克斯的？这城镇现在真不错，你做得太棒了！

translation: 幸会！我叫弗洛林，我做点这个，做点那个。只是努力生存罢了，我们没什么别的事可做。

translation: 哦，没什么大事，我们都在躲避吸血鬼，在这个鬼地方艰难度日，希望很快我们有能力前往萨鲁夫神庙。

translation: 我卖花，15金币三朵。想要些吗？

translation: 好的，谢谢。

translation: 谢谢！给你。

translation: 你好，殿下。

translation: 我卖花，15金币三朵。殿下想要些吗？

english: No, thank you.

english: Bees are very active on this bush and there are pollen-rich flowers. You carefully collect some Strange pollen.
translation: 蜜蜂在这灌木上很活跃，有富含花粉的花。你小心收集了些奇异花粉。

english: You've been awarded [1 or 2] anima-infused bark.
translation: 你获得了 [1或2] 个灵魂灌注树皮。

english: Bees are very active on this bush and there are unpollinated flowers. You carefully apply it with the help of some nearby bees then extract some from the bush.
translation: 蜜蜂在这灌木上很活跃，有未授粉的花。你在附近蜜蜂帮助下小心涂抹，然后从灌木提取些。

english: You've been awarded [1 or 2] Anima-infused bark.
translation: 你获得了 [1或2] 个灵魂灌注树皮。

english: There are no open, unpollinated flowers on this bush yet.
translation: 这灌木上还没有开放的未授粉花。

english: You took the pollen from this bush and should apply it to a bush with unpollinated flowers.
translation: 你从这灌木取了花粉，应该涂到有未授粉花的灌木上。

english: A bush as started producing fruit, well done!
translation: 灌木开始结果了，干得好！

english: The bushes become dormant and the bees move on. You've helped make the forest a more diverse and beautiful place!
translation: 灌木休眠了，蜜蜂也飞走了。多亏你，这片森林变得更丰富美丽了！

english: You've been awarded [number] Anima-based bark.
translation: 你获得了 [number] 个灵魂基树皮。

english: You discard your left over pollen.
translation: 你丢掉了剩余花粉。

translation: 你好。想买或卖些钉锤吗？

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。
