translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Well, I'll have a look, at least.
translation: 嗯，至少我会看看。

english: We seed the hidden truths of this world! Ranul rewards all of us who are willing to find them!
translation: 我们播种这个世界的隐藏真相！拉努尔奖励所有愿意寻找它们的人！

english: Ralos and Ranul are the twin guardians of our fate! Trust in them, for they will lead us to our destinies!
translation: 拉洛斯和拉努尔是我们命运的双生守护者！信任他们，因为他们会引导我们走向命运！

english: Do not fear the dark of night! Embrace it, for it is a gift from Ranul!
translation: 不要惧怕夜晚的黑暗！拥抱它，因为它是拉努尔的礼物！

english: In times of sorrow, we look to Ralos and Ranul. They guide us through day and night.
translation: 在悲伤时刻，我们仰望拉洛斯和拉努尔。他们引导我们度过日夜。

english: Be bold in the day, but reflect in the night! Let the teachings of both Ralos and Ranul guide you equally!
translation: 白天要大胆，夜晚要反思！让拉洛斯和拉努尔的教诲同等引导你！

english: Ralos teaches us to be brave! To be bold! Let his warmth in, and it will burn away all doubts!
translation: 拉洛斯教我们勇敢！要大胆！让他的温暖进入，它会烧尽所有疑虑！

english: Ralos shines upon us who are brave! If we show the courage to act, he will reward us!
translation: 拉洛斯照耀勇敢者！如果我们展现行动的勇气，他会奖励我们！

english: Hey! You can't come through here! This is private land!
translation: 嘿！你不能从这里过！这是私人领地！

english: You will need to find another way in.
translation: 你得找别的路进去。

english: Nice weather we're having today.
translation: 今天天气真好。

english: It's so peaceful here, don't you agree?
translation: 这里真宁静，你不觉得吗？

english: There's plenty of trees around, couldn't you go to another spot?
translation: 周围有很多树，你不能去别的地方吗？

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: Hello friend. I wish to slay evil and avail them of their loot! Take me to Burgh de Rott!
translation: 你好朋友。我想斩妖除魔，夺取他们的战利品！带我去伯格德罗特镇！

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
translation: 你准备好与那里的邪恶势力对抗了吗？

english: I think so? At least my heart knows courage and that should be sufficient for the meantime. I expect that when we get to Burgh de Rott, we'll be able to purchase suitable provisions.
translation: 我想是的？至少我内心充满勇气，这暂时应该足够了。我想等我们到了伯格德罗特镇，我们能够购买合适的补给品。

english: But you do realise that the vampyres in Morytania are immune to everything except silver?
translation: 但是你难道不知道莫利塔尼亚的吸血鬼除了银以外，对其他任何东西都免疫吗？

english: Er...well, I've not heard mention of that fact, but I have faith that Saradomin will provide the means to furnish me with suitable weapons when I reach Burgh de Rott.
translation: 呃……好吧，我没听说过这件事，但我相信萨拉多明会在我到达伯格德罗特镇时提供合适的武器。

english: And if we happen to run into some vampyres on the journey down there?
translation: 如果我们在去那里的路上碰到一些吸血鬼怎么办？

english: I trust that you will help us to avoid them. You are a guide after all, aren't you? Anyway, you look like you can handle yourself. I presume you've fought such creatures before and won? How hard can it be?
translation: 我相信你会帮我们避开他们。毕竟你是向导，对吧？不管怎样，你看起来能照顾好自己。我猜你以前和这种生物交过手并赢了？能有多难？

english: It can be pretty difficult, actually. But you're right, I'll be your guide so I should be able to handle the situation.
translation: 其实挺难的。不过你说得对，我会做你的向导，应该能应付得了。

english: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: 你为什么想去伯格德罗特镇？

english: I'm going down there to teach those vampyres a lesson or two. I've heard about the terrible conditions down there and I intend to put a stop to it.
translation: 我要去给那些吸血鬼点教训。我听说过那里的糟糕状况，我打算阻止这一切。

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Burgh de Rott?
translation: 如果我们在前往伯格德罗特镇的路上遇到敌人，你有办法自保吗？

english: Let's just say that I'm somewhat experienced and I'm happy to take on my fair share of enemies. You don't need to worry about that.
translation: 这么说吧，我还算有点经验，而且我很乐意承担我该对付的那份敌人。你不需要为我担心。

english: I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
translation: 我可以带你去伯格德罗特镇。

english: Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: 嗯，看来你有个随从。我想若是让它独自乱跑，这趟路上恐怕会走丢。等你的随从安顿好了我们再动身。

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: 真的吗？那太好了！到达目的地后我会给你报酬的。

english: Burgh de Rott Ramble begins
translation: 伯格德罗特镇漫步之旅开始

english: Ok, which route should we take?
translation: 好的，我们应该走哪条路线？

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: 啊，所以你想给我一些补给？让我打开我的背包看看。

english: This place is a bit grim. How can people live here?
translation: 这地方有点阴森，人们到底是怎么在这种环境下生活下去的？

english: Do you visit Burgh de Rott often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: 你经常来伯格德罗特镇吗？你似乎很熟悉这条路。

english: When are we going to get to Burgh de Rott?
translation: 我们什么时候能到伯格德罗特镇？

english: We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on. I have loot to get.
translation: 我们没时间闲聊，赶紧前进吧。我还有战利品要拿。

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than the opulet life styles forced on us adventurer types. I'd much rather be up to my eyes in mud and having a good fight!
translation: 我讨厌这趟行程，但这总比强加在我们冒险者身上的那种奢华生活要好。我宁愿浑身泥泞，痛快地打一场！

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...
translation: 你没看见我正在挨打吗……

english: Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
translation: 谢谢，我会吃掉的。

english: Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Paterdomus. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: 天哪，看来我们得回帕多姆斯了。我们过不了那座桥！

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
translation: 我相信我们能找到办法的！

english: Player completes the bridge event
translation: 玩家完成了桥梁事件

english: Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Paterdomus.
translation: 这下糟了……看来我们过不了这片沼泽，得回帕多姆斯。

english: Player completes the bog event
translation: 玩家完成了沼泽事件

english: Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
translation: 太棒了！干得漂亮，我会跟紧你。

english: Whahay...that was great!
translation: 哇哈……太棒了！

english: But we really should be heading off now.
translation: 不过我们现在真得赶紧上路了。

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
translation: 放心，我们一定能找到路过去的！

english: Player completes the river event
translation: 玩家完成了河流事件

english: That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
translation: 太厉害了！我也得照做。

english: Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: 哇哈……太棒了！不过我们现在真得赶紧上路了。

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
translation: 那……那些气泡是什么？

english: This is scary!
translation: 这太可怕了！

english: Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
translation: 啊，那应该是触手……

english: Ahhh, two tentacles!
translation: 啊，两根触手！

english: ...three tentacles!
translation: ……三根触手！

english: I think I'm going to faint!
translation: 我觉得我要晕了！

english: Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: 天哪！看那怪物！你得自己解决那东西！

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the Burgh de Rott. Here's your reward.
translation: 多谢你平安把我带到伯格德罗特镇，这是你的报酬。

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
translation: 你准备好与那里的邪恶势力对抗了吗？

english: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: 你为什么想去伯格德罗特镇？

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
translation: 如果我们在路上遇到敌人，你能自保吗？

english: I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
translation: 我可以带你去伯格德罗特镇。

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Thanks so much for saving me from being a vampyre. Here, take this certificate, I'm sorry but it's all I can offer as a reward.
translation: 非常感谢救我不变成吸血鬼。给，拿着这个证书，抱歉这是我唯一能给的报酬。

english: Human.
translation: 人类。

english: Hello there. Who are you?
translation: 你好。你是谁？

english: Fornek quo Maten. I am a hunter for the Kahlith. Do you wish to serve the balance?
translation: 福内克‧夸‧马滕。我是卡利兹的猎人。你想服务平衡吗？

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: Then you should speak to Konar quo Maten. She will guide you.
translation: 那你应该跟科纳‧夸‧马滕谈谈。她会引导你。

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: A shame. You are a bringer of death, you could be of great use to the balance.
translation: 真可惜。你是死亡使者，本可对平衡大有用处。

english: I'm not sure.
translation: 我不确定。

english: Then you should speak with Xorrah quo Sihar. He will show you the way.
translation: 那你应该跟佐拉‧夸‧西哈尔谈谈。他会给你指路。

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: I'm not sure.
translation: 我不确定。

english: Can I help you at all?
translation: 有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: Yes, what are you selling?
translation: 是的，你卖什么？

english: Not at the moment.
translation: 目前还没有。

english: Then move along, you filthy ragamuffin, I have customers to serve!
translation: 那走开，你这脏乞丐，我有顾客要服务！

english: Oh...you've come back.
translation: 哦……你回来了。

english: Please...I haventgot any more vinegar. Give me some time I beg you.
translation: 求求你……我没醋了。给我点时间我求你。

english: I wasn't after vinegar today.
translation: 我今天不是来找醋的。

english: Oh, wonderful.
translation: 哦，太好了。

english: I will have some in soon, if he needs it.
translation: 如果他需要，我很快会有些。

english: In the meantime, can I interest you in something?
translation: 同时，有什么能让你感兴趣的吗？

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: Well, I'll put something special to one side for you.
translation: 嗯，我会给你留点特别的东西。

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

english: Well done.
translation: 干得好。

english: You've obtained a [new clue/casket]!
translation: 你获得了 [new clue/casket]！

english: Hey! Get your hands off there!
translation: 嘿！把手拿开！

english: You're the thief who stole from me!
translation: 你就是偷我东西的贼！

english: Guardsguards!
translation: 守卫！守卫！

english: Yes, what are you selling?
translation: 是的，你卖什么？

english: Not at the moment
translation: 现在没有

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: What can I do for you?
translation: 我能为你做什么？

english: I hear that I can present you with an offering and you will enchant my lyre for me.
translation: 我听说我可以给你供奉，你会为我附魔竖琴。

english: This is true. For a simple enchantment, you may place an offering on my Altar. Can I help you with anything else?
translation: 确实如此。简单附魔，你可以在我的祭坛放供奉。还有什么能帮你的吗？

english: You do not have a raw shark to offer.
translation: 你没有生鲨鱼供奉。

english: I offer you this enchantment for your worthy offering.
translation: 我为你的珍贵供奉提供此附魔。

english: Your lyre is now enchanted. You can use it to teleport to Rellekka.
translation: 你的竖琴现在附魔了。你可以用它传送到雷勒克卡。

english: When the enchantment wears off you will need to re-enchant it.
translation: 附魔失效后你需要重新附魔。

english: You do not have a raw manta ray to offer.
translation: 你没有生魔鬼鱼供奉。

english: You do not have a raw sea turtle to offer.
translation: 你没有生海龟供奉。

english: You do not have a raw bass to offer.
translation: 你没有生鲈鱼供奉。

english: A raw bass? You should know that is not a worthy offering, outerlander.
translation: 生鲈鱼？你应该知道那不是珍贵的供奉，外乡人。

english: Yes, you're right - I'll find something more worthy of you.
translation: 是的，你说得对——我会找些更配得上你的。

english: Can you enchant my lyre so that the enchantment will never fade?
translation: 你能附魔我的竖琴让附魔永不消失吗？

english: If the offering is great enough, I would be happy to offer you such a powerful enchantment.
translation: 如果供奉足够伟大，我很乐意提供如此强大的附魔。

english: Depending on your familiarity of the area, I will require less of an offering.
translation: 根据你对地区的熟悉程度，我会要求更少的供奉。

english: But for you, I would have you offer me 1000 raw shark, raw manta ray, raw sea turtle and raw bass. But if you had completed the Fremennik easy diary, it would have been 800.
translation: 但要你供奉的话，得拿1000条生鲨鱼、生魔鬼鱼、生海龟和生鲈鱼来。但如果你完成了费明尼克简单日记，那就是800。

english: But for you, I would have you offer me 800 raw shark, raw manta ray, raw sea turtle and raw bass. But if you had completed the Fremennik medium diary, it would have been 600.
translation: 但对你，我要你供奉我800条生鲨鱼、生魔鬼鱼、生海龟和生鲈鱼。但如果你完成了费明尼克中等日记，那就是600。

english: But for you, I would have you offer me 600 raw shark, raw manta ray, raw sea turtle and raw bass. But if you had completed the Fremennik hard diary, it would have been 400.
translation: 但对你，我要你供奉我600条生鲨鱼、生魔鬼鱼、生海龟和生鲈鱼。但如果你完成了费明尼克困难日记，那就是400。

english: But for you, I would have you offer me 400 raw shark, raw manta ray, raw sea turtle and raw bass. But if you had completed the Fremennik elite diary, it would have been 200.
translation: 但对你，我要你供奉我400条生鲨鱼、生魔鬼鱼、生海龟和生鲈鱼。但如果你完成了费明尼克精英日记，那就是200。

english: But for you, I would have you offer me 200 raw shark, raw manta ray, raw sea turtle and raw bass.
translation: 但对你，我要你供奉我200条生鲨鱼、生魔鬼鱼、生海龟和生鲈鱼。

english: You still need to offer me [number] raw shark, [number] raw manta ray, [number] raw sea turtle and [number] raw bass.
translation: 你还需要供奉我 [number] 条生鲨鱼、[number] 条生魔鬼鱼、[number] 条生海龟和 [number] 条生鲈鱼。

english: You present your offering.
translation: 你呈现供奉。

english: While I appreciate the thought of offering me fish, I am afraid I am unable to use the air you have offered me.
translation: 虽然我感激供奉鱼的想法，但我恐怕无法使用你供奉给我的空气。

english: Many thanks for your offering. You still need to offer me [number] raw shark, [number] raw manta ray, [number] raw sea turtle and [number] raw bass.
translation: 非常感谢你的供奉。你还需要供奉我 [number] 条生鲨鱼、[number] 条生魔鬼鱼、[number] 条生海龟和 [number] 条生鲈鱼。

english: You have given me a worthy offering, and I will bestow my enchantment whenever you bring me a suitable lyre. I regret I cannot return any of your fish in future, even if you become closer to the Fremenniks.
translation: 你给了我珍贵的供奉，每当你带来合适的竖琴我会赐予附魔。很遗憾将来无法归还任何鱼，即使你更接近费明尼克人。

english: I offer you this enchantment as you have earned my favour.
translation: 我赐予你此附魔，因为你赢得了我的青睐。

english: I will come back when I have an offering worthy of this power. Goodbye.
translation: 当我有配得上此力量的供奉时会回来。再见。

english: Farewell then.
translation: 那就再见。

english: Nothing, sorry.
translation: 没什么，抱歉。

english: Do not summon me for idle conversation! Come back when you have an offering.
translation: 别叫我闲聊！有供奉时再来。

english: You do not have a lyre with you that I can enchant. It must have been strung, but it cannot bear any existing enchantment.
translation: 你身上没有我能附魔的竖琴。它必须已上弦，但不能有任何现有附魔。

english: Present offering of a single fish.
translation: 呈现单条鱼供奉。

english: Raw shark.
translation: 生鲨鱼。

english: Raw manta ray.
translation: 生魔鬼鱼。

english: Raw sea turtle.
translation: 生海龟。

english: Raw bass.
translation: 生鲈鱼。

english: Ask about a permanent lyre enchantment.
translation: 询问永久竖琴附魔。

english: Present offering.
translation: 呈现供奉。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: Hello there. Do you have any fossils for me?
translation: 你好。你有化石给我吗？

english: I'm Mary. In the tent you'll find Tray, my dog. He's quite friendly and doesn't bite. I'm here for the fossils. I'll go anywhere for fossils!
translation: 我是玛丽。帐篷里你会找到特雷伊，我的狗。他很友好不咬人。我来找化石。为了化石我去哪都行！

english: Why are you here?
translation: 你为什么在这里？

english: What fossils would you like to trade?
translation: 你想交易什么化石？

english: All done. Would you like to trade in any more fossils?
translation: 完成了。想交易更多化石吗？

english: It looks like you don't have any fossils to trade.
translation: 看起来你没有化石可交易。

english: You don't have space for that.
translation: 你没空间放那个。

english: Of course, you left it here and I kept it for you.
translation: 当然，你把它留在这，我帮你保管了。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: I'd like to trade some fossils.
translation: 我想交易些化石。

english: Small fossils.
translation: 小化石。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Medium fossils.
translation: 中等化石。

english: Large fossils.
translation: 大化石。

english: Rare fossils.
translation: 稀有化石。

english: I've lost my notebook.
translation: 我丢了笔记本。

english: I hope they come home soon...
translation: 我希望他们很快回家……

english: He is ignoring you.
translation: 他在无视你。

english: Apparently you aren't as stupid as you look.
translation: 显然你没看起来那么蠢。

english: Welcome to Frankie's Fish Emporium, what can I do for you mate?
translation: 欢迎来到弗兰基鱼类帝国，能帮你什么伙计？

english: What have you got for sale?
translation: 你有什么卖的？

english: We serve the finest fresh fish Piscarilius has to offer.
translation: 我们提供皮斯卡里琉斯最好的新鲜鱼。

english: What do you do around here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: I trade the finest fish in Piscarilius. In this city you get two choices, fishing or thuggery. I've kept afloat without resorting to the latter, not something which can be said by many of the folk around here.
translation: 我交易皮斯卡里琉斯最好的鱼。在这城市你有两个选择，钓鱼或流氓行径。我没靠后者维持生计，这附近很多人做不到。

english: I'll be on my way.
translation: 我走了。

english: What have you got for sale?
translation: 你有什么卖的？

english: What do you do around here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: I'll be on my way
translation: 我走了

english: Hello again, [player name].
translation: 又见面了，[player name]。

english: Hello. How's the repair work going?
translation: 你好。维修工作进展如何？

english: I'm working on it. I can always do with more iron sheets, so if you've got any more, I'll give you 20 gp per sheet.
translation: 我在做。我总是需要更多铁皮，所以如果你有更多，每张我给你20金币。

english: Thanks, I'll remember that.
translation: 谢谢，我会记住的。

english: Hello again, [player name]. Were you wanting to sell me that iron sheet? I'd give you 20 gp for it.
translation: 又见面了，[player name]。你想卖我那张铁皮吗？我出20金币。

english: Hello again, [player name]. Were you wanting to sell me those iron sheets? I'd give you [amount] gp.
translation: 又见面了，[player name]。你想卖我那些铁皮吗？我出 [amount] 金币。

english: Yes, that'll do nicely.
translation: 是的，那太好了。

english: No, I'd rather not.
translation: 不，我还是算了。

english: That's ok.
translation: 没关系。

english: Yes, that'll do nicely.
translation: 是的，那太好了。

english: No, I'd rather not.
translation: 不，我还是算了。

english: Hey, [player name], can you come and help me with some pheasants?
translation: 嘿，[player name]，能来帮我处理些雉鸡吗？

english: Okay, I'll help with your pheasants.
translation: 好的，我帮你处理雉鸡。

english: Sorry, I'm busy.
translation: 抱歉，我很忙。

english: Hey there, [player name]. Could you kill a pheasant with [two/three/four] tails, please? Bring me the raw pheasant when you're done.
translation: 嘿，[player name]。能杀只 [两/三/四] 尾雉鸡吗？完成后把生雉鸡带来给我。

english: Hey there, [player name]. Can you kill the [2/3/4]-tailed pheasant please. Bring me the raw pheasant when you're done.
translation: 嘿，[player name]。能杀那只 [2/3/4] 尾雉鸡吗？完成后把生雉鸡带来给我。

english: Hey there, [player name]. I need you to kill a pheasant that has [2/3/4] tails. Bring me the raw pheasant when you're done.
translation: 嘿，[player name]。我需要你杀只 [2/3/4] 尾的雉鸡。完成后把生雉鸡带来给我。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Now bring me the raw pheasant.
translation: 现在把生雉鸡带来给我。

english: Thanks, [player name], you may use the portal to leave the area now.
translation: 谢谢，[player name]，你现在可以用传送门离开区域了。

english: Okay, [player name], you can leave the area now.
translation: 好的，[player name]，你现在可以离开区域了。

english: You don't need to attack any more pheasants. You're allowed to leave.
translation: 你不需要再攻击雉鸡了。允许你离开。

english: I don't need any more of those. You are free to exit the area now.
translation: 我不需要更多那些了。你现在可以自由离开区域。

english: You get a lederhosen [hat/top/shorts] for your help, many thanks!
translation: 你得到皮短裤 [帽子/上衣/短裤] 作为帮助报酬，非常感谢！

english: You get a lamp for your help, many thanks!
translation: 你得到一盏灯作为帮助报酬，非常感谢！

english: I'm looking for [player name].
translation: 我在找 [player name]。

english: [player name]!
translation: [player name]！

english: Hello? [player name]?
translation: 你好？[player name]？

english: Talk to me, [player name]!
translation: 跟我说话，[player name]！

english: [player name]? Are you there?!
translation: [player name]？你在那吗？！

english: I'd like to talk to you, [player name]!
translation: 我想跟你谈谈，[player name]！

english: Maybe later.
translation: 也许以后吧。

english: Okay, I'll help with your pheasants.
translation: 好的，我帮你处理雉鸡。

english: Sorry, I'm busy.
translation: 抱歉，我很忙。

english: Hello, what's going on?
translation: 你好，发生什么了？

english: Hey, [player name], can you help me with some pheasants?
translation: 嘿，[player name]，能帮我处理些雉鸡吗？

english: Collect the eggs from the uninhabited nests and bring them to me, and I'll reward you.
translation: 从无人居住的巢穴收集蛋带来给我，我会奖励你。

english: Well, come back if you change your mind.
translation: 嗯，改变主意再来。

english: I have an egg for you.
translation: 我有个蛋给你。

english: These pheasants will be finding new nesting grounds soon.
translation: 这些雉鸡很快会找新巢穴。

english: Sure, how can I help?
translation: 当然，怎么帮？

english: Greetings traveller. What brings you to my residence?
translation: 你好，旅行者。什么风把你吹到我家？

english: You keep a pet bat? That's a bit odd.
translation: 你养宠物蝙蝠？有点奇怪。

english: Squeak!
translation: 吱！

english: Yes traveller, this is not out of the ordinary for us. The bats respond well to the powers of the dark altar after being drawn here by the river of blood.
translation: 是的旅行者，这对我们来说不寻常。蝙蝠被血河吸引到这里后，对黑暗祭坛的力量反应良好。

english: Well I hope he keeps you 'mused.
translation: 嗯希望他让你开心。

english: What are you doing on my land? You're not the one who keeps leaving all my gates open and letting out all my sheep, are you?
translation: 你在我土地上做什么？你不是那个总把我门开着放走我羊的人吧？

english: I'm looking for a quest.
translation: 我在找任务。

english: You're after a quest, you say? Actually, I could do with a bit of help.
translation: 你在找任务，你说？其实，我需要点帮助。

english: My sheep are getting mighty woolly. I'd be much obliged if you could shear them. And while you're at it, spin the wool for me too.
translation: 我的羊变得非常毛茸茸。如果你能剪毛我会很感激。顺便也帮我把羊毛纺了。

english: Yes, that's it. Bring me 20 balls of wool. And I'm sure I could sort out some sort of payment. Of course, there's the small matter of The Thing.
translation: 是的，就是那样。给我20个毛线球。我相信能安排些报酬。当然，还有那个东西的小问题。

english: What do you mean, The Thing?
translation: 你什么意思，那个东西？

english: Well now, no one has ever seen The Thing. That's why we call it The Thing, 'cos we don't know what it is.
translation: 嗯，没人见过那个东西。所以我们叫它那个东西，因为我们不知道它是什么。

english: Some say it's a black hearted shapeshifter, hungering for the souls of hard working decent folk like me. Others say it's just a sheep.
translation: 有人说它是黑心变形怪，渴望像我这样勤劳正直百姓的灵魂。有人说它只是只羊。

english: Well I don't have all day to stand around and gossip. Are you going to shear my sheep or what!
translation: 我没时间站着闲聊。你到底剪不剪羊！

english: No, I'll give it a miss.
translation: 不，我还是算了。

english: Suit yourself.
translation: 随你便。

english: I'm looking for something to kill.
translation: 我在找东西杀。

english: What, on my land? Leave my livestock alone you scoundrel!
translation: 什么，在我土地上？别动我的牲畜你这恶棍！

english: I'm lost.
translation: 我迷路了。

english: How can you be lost? Just follow the road east and south. You'll end up in Lumbridge fairly quickly.
translation: 你怎么会迷路？只管沿路向东向南。很快就能到仑桥。

english: What are you doing on my land?
translation: 你在我土地上做什么？

english: Fred! Fred! I've seen The Thing!
translation: 弗雷德！弗雷德！我看见那个东西了！

english: You ... you actually saw it?
translation: 你……你真看见了？

english: Run for the hills! [player name] grab as many chickens as you can! We have to ...
translation: 快跑！[player name] 尽量多抓鸡！我们得……

english: Fred!
translation: 弗雷德！

english: ... flee! Oh, woe is me! The shapeshifter is coming! We're all ...
translation: ……逃！哦，我真惨！变形怪来了！我们都……

english: FRED!
translation: 弗雷德！

english: ... doomed. What!
translation: ……完了。什么！

english: It's not a shapeshifter or any other kind of monster!
translation: 那不是变形怪或任何怪物！

english: Well then what is it?
translation: 那它是什么？

english: Well ... it's just two Penguins; Penguins disguised as a sheep.
translation: 嗯……只是两只企鹅；伪装成羊的企鹅。

english: Have you been out in the sun too long?
translation: 你在外面晒太久太阳了吧？

english: I'm looking for a quest.
translation: 我在找任务。

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: I'm looking for something to kill.
translation: 我在找东西杀。

english: I'm lost.
translation: 我迷路了。

english: Fred! Fred! I've seen The Thing!
translation: 弗雷德！弗雷德！我看见那个东西了！

english: I cannot speak to you outerlander! Talk to Brundt, the Chieftain!
translation: 我不能跟你说话，外乡人！跟酋长布伦特谈！

english: You stay away from me outerlander!
translation: 离我远点外乡人！

english: They are too suspicious of you for you to get close enough to steal from them.
translation: 他们对你太怀疑了，你没法靠近偷东西。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Hello again [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. What need you of me this day? You can always rely on my assistance!
translation: 又见面了 [兄弟/姐妹] [Fremennik name]。今天需要我什么？你总能依靠我的帮助！

english: Nothing thanks. I just fancied a chat.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。只是想聊聊。

english: My door is always open should you ever need my help [Fremennik name].
translation: 如果需要帮助，我的门永远为你敞开，[Fremennik name]。

english: [Fremennik name]... It has been too long since last we met!
translation: [Fremennik name]……上次见面已是许久之前！

english: Welcome back [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It is always a pleasure to see you here!
translation: 欢迎回来 [兄弟/姐妹] [Fremennik name]。见到你总是很高兴！

english: My apologies [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! I have not time to tarry here with you!
translation: 抱歉 [兄弟/姐妹] [Fremennik name]！我没时间在这里逗留！

english: That's okay, I didn't really want anything.
translation: 没关系，我其实没什么想要的。

english: How are you [Fremennik name]? I hope all fares well with you this day!
translation: 你好吗 [Fremennik name]？希望你今天一切顺利！

english: I'm fine, thanks, how are you?
translation: 我很好，谢谢，你呢？

english: All is well with me also!
translation: 我也一切都好！

english: Hello to you, too!
translation: 也向你问好！

english: Hello. Did you want something [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你好。想要什么吗 [Fremennik name]？

english: No, not really.
translation: 不，不太想。

english: Well... okay then!
translation: 嗯……好吧！

english: Always good to see you [brother/sister] [Fremennik name].
translation: 见到你总是好事 [兄弟/姐妹] [Fremennik name]。

english: You shame us, [Fremennik name]!
translation: 你让我们蒙羞，[Fremennik name]！

english: How can you steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你怎么能偷我东西，[Fremennik name]？

english: You have betrayed your heritage, [Fremennik name]!
translation: 你背叛了你的遗产，[Fremennik name]！

english: Why would you try to steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你为什么试图偷我东西，[Fremennik name]？

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: Well met, adventurer.
translation: 幸会，冒险者。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: I'm Freja, the Kyattess of the Fremennik Province. Who are you?
translation: 我是弗雷娅，费明尼克省的女猎手。你是谁？

english: Oh me? I'm [player name], an adventurer... I guess.
translation: 哦我？我是 [player name]，一个冒险者……我想。

english: You must have done something impressive to gain entry here.
translation: 你一定做了些令人印象深刻的事才获准进入这里。

english: I may have killed some dragons.
translation: 我可能杀了些龙。

english: Ah, fantastic! I've yet to face one myself, but I look forward to the challenge.
translation: 啊，太棒了！我还没亲自面对过，但期待挑战。

english: What grand feats are you known for?
translation: 你以什么伟大事迹闻名？

english: Much like you, I have a book or two detailing such things, but it seems to have gone walkabouts.
translation: 跟你差不多，我有一两本详细记录此类事的书，但似乎走失了。

english: Anything particularly interesting?
translation: 有什么特别有趣的吗？

english: All of it is incredibly interesting! I slew the great Smolodin Kyatt that plagued the province for many years!
translation: 所有都极其有趣！我杀了困扰省份多年的伟大斯莫洛丁剑齿虎兽！

english: I retrieved the crown of many heads from the bottomless snake pit! I hunted the silver stag of the western provinces!
translation: 我从无底蛇坑取回了多头王冠！我猎杀了西部省份的银鹿！

english: None of that sounds at all boring. I look forward to finding your book.
translation: 听起来都不无聊。我期待找到你的书。

english: Funny you should mention boars. I'm currently hunting one... well, I was...
translation: 真巧你提到野猪。我正在猎杀一只……嗯，曾经是……

english: Why are you here?
translation: 你为什么在这里？

english: My current quest took me to Acheron, a horribly bitter northern territory, in search for this famous boar. As big as a hut, so the songs say.
translation: 我目前的任务带我去阿刻戎，一个极其寒冷的北方领地，寻找这只著名的野猪。歌谣说它有小屋那么大。

english: Anyway, my companions all met a rather grizzly end, so I guess I'm looking for new ones.
translation: 总之，我的同伴都落了个惨兮兮的下场，所以我猜我得找新搭档了。

english: Take me! I'm great.
translation: 带我去！我很棒。

english: Ha! You're very new here. You've certainly proved you are a worthy hero, but I'd rather someone with a few more years behind them.
translation: 哈！你初来乍到。你确实证明了自己是个值得尊敬的英雄，但我更想要个经验更丰富些的人。

english: What? I've literally defeated a group of dragons that threatened to kill everyone, I think I'm ready for a boar hunt.
translation: 什么？我可是真的打败了一群威胁要杀死所有人的龙，我想我准备好去猎野猪了。

english: Hmm... When it comes time for me to venture back to the Isle of Garmr, I'll consider inviting you.
translation: 嗯……等我要冒险回加姆尔岛的时候，我会考虑邀请你。

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！

english: I'll see you around.
translation: 回头见。

english: Ah, so you've found my latest donation to the guild. What do you think? Spooky, isn't it?
translation: 啊，所以你找到了我最近捐赠给公会的物品。你觉得怎么样？阴森吧，是不是？

english: Just a bit. Is this the original text? It doesn't look that old...
translation: 就有点。这是原文吗？看起来没那么古老……

english: Oh Guthix, no! These texts were inscribed in rock paper in a tome even I struggled to lift. The writer left it there as a warning, and I assume they didn't want it to be moved.
translation: 哦古斯，不！这些文字刻在岩纸上，装在一本连我都很难举起的书册里。作者把它留在那里作为警告，我想他们不希望它被移动。

english: Did you translate it?
translation: 你翻译了吗？

english: I certainly tried... Perhaps there are some date inconsistencies and a few words I had to guess at. I'd found a lot of scrolls detailing trade with early Fremennik tribes too, which certainly helped.
translation: 我确实试了……也许有些日期不一致，还有几个词我不得不猜。我还发现了很多详细描述与早期费明尼克部落贸易的卷轴，那确实有帮助。

english: Imcandoria... Do you think that's where the Imcando dwarves originate?
translation: 伊姆坎多利亚……你觉得那是伊姆坎多矮人的起源地吗？

english: It certainly seems reasonable.
translation: 确实看起来合理。

english: Interesting...
translation: 有趣……

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: What grand feats are you known for?
translation: 你以什么伟大事迹闻名？

english: Why are you here?
translation: 你为什么在这里？

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！

english: Would you like to buy some cooking equipment?
translation: 你想买些烹饪装备吗？

english: No thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

translation: 我不能跟你说话，外乡人！跟酋长布伦特谈！

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Hello again [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. What need you of me this day? You can always rely on my assistance!
translation: 又见面了 [兄弟/姐妹] [Fremennik name]。今天需要我什么？你总能依靠我的帮助！

english: Nothing thanks. I just fancied a chat.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。只是想聊聊。

english: My door is always open should you ever need my help [Fremennik name].
translation: 如果需要帮助，我的门永远为你敞开，[Fremennik name]。

english: [Fremennik name]... It has been too long since last we met!
translation: [Fremennik name]……上次见面已是许久之前！

english: Welcome back [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It is always a pleasure to see you here!
translation: 欢迎回来 [兄弟/姐妹] [Fremennik name]。见到你总是很高兴！

english: My apologies [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! I have not time to tarry here with you!
translation: 抱歉 [兄弟/姐妹] [Fremennik name]！我没时间在这里逗留！

english: That's okay, I didn't really want anything.
translation: 没关系，我其实没什么想要的。

english: How are you [Fremennik name]? I hope all fares well with you this day!
translation: 你好吗 [Fremennik name]？希望你今天一切顺利！

english: I'm fine, thanks, how are you?
translation: 我很好，谢谢，你呢？

english: All is well with me also!
translation: 我也一切都好！

english: Hello to you, too!
translation: 也向你问好！

english: Hello. Did you want something [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你好。想要什么吗 [Fremennik name]？

english: No, not really.
translation: 不，不太想。

english: Well... okay then!
translation: 嗯……好吧！

english: Always good to see you [brother/sister] [Fremennik name].
translation: 见到你总是好事 [兄弟/姐妹] [Fremennik name]。

english: How are you today?
translation: 你今天怎么样？

english: **sigh**
translation: 叹气

english: That good? Everyone around here seems a little depressed.
translation: 心情这么差？周围的人看起来都有些情绪低落。

english: And not particularly talkative.
translation: 而且不太爱说话。

english: I'll leave you to your sighing. It looks like you have plenty to do.
translation: 我不打扰你叹气了。看起来你有很多事要做。

english: It's a bit grey round here, isn't it?
translation: 这周围有点灰暗，不是吗？

english: It gets you down after a while, you know. There are 273 shades of grey, you know, and we have them all.
translation: 过会儿就会让你消沉，你知道的。有273种灰色调，你知道的，我们全都有。

english: That's grey-t.
translation: 那真是“灰”常棒。

english: That attempt at humour merely made me more depressed. Leave me alone.
translation: 那蹩脚的幽默只让我更心烦，别烦我。

english: How's the King treating you then?
translation: 国王怎么对待你的？

english: Like serfs.
translation: 像农奴。

english: Serf?
translation: 农奴？

english: Yes, you know - peons, plebs, the downtrodden. He treats us like his own personal possessions.
translation: 是的，你知道——苦力、平民、受压迫者。他把我们当作他的私人财产。

english: You should leave this place.
translation: 你应该离开这个地方。

english: I keep trying to save up enough to leave, but the King keeps taxing us! We have no money left.
translation: 我一直想攒够钱离开，但国王一直在收税！我们没钱了。

english: Oh dear.
translation: 哦天哪。

english: Cheer up! It's not the end of the world.
translation: 振作点！又不是世界末日。

english: I'd prefer that, if it meant I didn't have to talk to people as inanely happy as you.
translation: 我宁愿那样，如果意味着我不必跟像你这样傻乐的人说话。

english: Whoa! I think you need to get out more.
translation: 哇！我想你需要多出去走走。

english: Shhh! I'm waiting for the show!
translation: 嘘！我在等表演！

english: YOU ARE A TERRIBLE BARD!
translation: 你是个糟糕的吟游诗人！

english: Don't give up your day job outerlander!
translation: 外乡人，你还是别放弃本职工作吧！

english: I thought somebody was murdering a cat!
translation: 我以为有人在杀猫！

english: You know, I actually quite liked that verse...
translation: 你知道，我其实挺喜欢那段歌词……

english: That's kind of catchy. Irritating. But catchy.
translation: 有点洗脑，虽然烦人，但确实洗脑。

english: Hey, I've done that quest too!
translation: 嘿，我也做过那个任务！

english: I have produced better sounds in the outhouse!
translation: 我在茅房里发出的声音都比这好！

english: Your song makes no sense outerlander!
translation: 你的歌毫无意义，外乡人！

english: What kind of bard are you anyway?
translation: 你到底是什么样的吟游诗人？

english: I have met cows more musical than you!
translation: 我见过比你更有音乐细胞的牛！

english: When do you get to the good parts?
translation: 你什么时候讲到精彩部分？

english: would torture us so, outerlander?
translation: 会这样折磨我们，外乡人？

english: Truly, this is the worst sound I have ever heard!
translation: 真的，这是我听过最糟糕的声音！

english: looting and drinking part?
translation: 掠夺和喝酒的部分？

english: Please tell me that was the last verse...
translation: 请告诉我那是最后一节……

english: Please... Kill me now...
translation: 求求你……现在杀了我吧……

english: You call THAT singing?
translation: 你管那叫唱歌？

english: Never before have mine ears been so offended!
translation: 我的耳朵从未受过如此侮辱！

english: Worst. Bard. EVER.
translation: 最。糟糕。吟游诗人。永远。

english: Please, ye gods! Make it stop!
translation: 求求了，诸神！让它停下！

english: If you stopped singing
translation: 你要是能别唱了

english: The screams of my dying comrades sound better!
translation: 我垂死同伴的尖叫声都比这好听！

english: My grandmother could do better, and she is dead!
translation: 我祖母都能做得更好，而且她已经死了！

english: I do such feats before breakfast!
translation: 我早餐前就能做到这种壮举！

english: Is your singing some kind of outerlander weapon?
translation: 你的歌该不会是外乡人的某种武器吧？

english: Congratulations, Champion [Fremennik name]. Thank you for defeating the Troll King.
translation: 恭喜，冠军 [Fremennik name]。谢谢你打败巨魔国王。

english: Greetings! Have you come to talk forestry?
translation: 你好！你是来谈林业的吗？

english: Forestry?
translation: 林业？

translation: 没错！当今时代，我们比以往任何时候都更需要受过护林之道训练的人！

english: Way of the forester? What do you mean?
translation: 护林之道？你什么意思？

english: You know, helping the woodland flourish with your fellow foresters! And of course, drinking plenty of tea to fuel yourself while you do so!
translation: 你知道，和你的护林同伴一起帮助林地繁荣！当然，还要喝大量的茶来给自己加油！

english: Sounds interesting. How can I get started?
translation: 听起来有趣。我怎么开始？

english: Well, I'd recommend spending some more time in the forests before embarking on your forestry journey. Come back when you can fell a mighty oak!
translation: 嗯，我建议你在开始林业之旅前多在森林里花点时间。当你能砍倒一棵巨大的橡树时再回来！

english: I'll do that. Thanks for the information.
translation: 我会的。谢谢你的信息。

english: Good luck out there!
translation: 祝你好运！

english: First, you'll need a forestry kit. Once you have one, all you need to do is chop some trees while you have it on you. The woodland will do the rest!
translation: 首先，你需要一个林业工具包。一旦有了，你只需带着它砍些树。林地会搞定其余的！

english: Oh, and if you find any anima-infused bark while tending to the forests, I'll gladly trade with you. My shop has all sorts of useful items.
translation: 哦，如果你在照料森林时发现任何灵魂灌注树皮，我很乐意跟你交易。我的店里有各种有用的物品。

english: That's all rather vague...
translation: 那都有点模糊……

english: It is, but I find it's better to let the forests do the talking. You'll understand once you get going. Speaking of which, would you like one of those kits now? I have them free of charge in my shop.
translation: 确实是，但我发现最好让森林自己说话。一旦开始你就会明白。说到这个，你现在想要一个工具包吗？我店里免费提供。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Excellent!
translation: 太好了！

english: Hello again! How goes your forestry journey?
translation: 又见面了！你的林业之旅进展如何？

english: I'd like to trade with you.
translation: 我想跟你交易。

english: Of course!
translation: 当然！

english: Could you tell me more about forestry?
translation: 能多告诉我些关于林业的事吗？

english: Speaking of which, would you like to trade now?
translation: 说到这个，你现在想交易吗？

english: I'm good, thanks.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

english: Very well.
translation: 很好。

english: Pretty good, thanks.
translation: 挺好的，谢谢。

english: I'm glad to hear it.
translation: 很高兴听到这个。

english: I'll happily buy those off you in my shop.

english: Yes please.

english: Hello adventurer, welcome to the Entrana furnace.
translation: 你好冒险者，欢迎来到恩特纳岛熔炉。

english: Would you like me to explain my craft to you?
translation: 你想让我给你解释我的工艺吗？

english: Yes please. I'd be fascinated to hear what you do.
translation: 是的，谢谢。我很想听听你做什么。

english: I'm extremely pleased to hear that! I've always wanted an apprentice. Let me talk you through the secrets of glassblowing.
translation: 听到那个我太高兴了！我一直想要个学徒。让我跟你讲讲吹玻璃的秘密。

translation: 玻璃由苏打灰和硅砂制成。我们通过从岩石上收集海藻获得苏打灰——盛行洋流使岛屿西北角成为最佳寻找地，它也可以在

english: your nets sometimes when you're fishing, on Karamja island or at the Piscatoris Fishing Colony in the nets there. To turn seaweed into soda ash, all you need to do is burn it on a fire. Feel free to use the range in
translation: 你钓鱼时的网里找到，在卡拉姆詹岛或皮斯卡托里斯渔村的网里。要把海藻变成苏打灰，你只需在火上烧它。尽管用我屋里的炉灶就行，

english: my house for that; it's the one directly west of here. Next we collect sand from the sandpit that you'll also find just west of here, there are others located in Yanille and Shilo Village.
translation: 就在正西边。接着去沙坑挖沙子，你在这里西边就能找到，其他沙坑在亚尼勒和希洛村也有。

english: You'll need a bucket to carry it in. Tell you what, you can have this old one of mine.
translation: 你需要个桶来装，把我这个旧的给你用吧。

english: Bring the sand and the soda ash back here and melt them together in the furnace, and there you have it - molten glass!
translation: 把沙子和苏打灰带回来，在熔炉里一起熔化，就成了——熔融玻璃！

english: There are many things you can use the molten glass for once you have made it. Depending on how talented you are, you could try turning it into something, like a fishbowl, for example. If you'd like to try your hand at
translation: 一旦制成熔融玻璃，你可以用它做很多东西。取决于你多有才华，你可以试着把它做成东西，比如鱼缸。如果你想尝试

english: the fine art of glassblowing you can use my spare glassblowing pipe. I think I left it on the chest of drawers in my house this morning.
translation: 吹玻璃的精细艺术，你可以用我的备用玻璃吹管。我想今天早上我把它落在家里抽屉柜上了。

english: Alternatively I am always happy to buy the molten glass from you, saves me running about making it for myself.
translation: 或者我也很乐意从你那里买熔融玻璃，省得我到处跑自己制作。

english: That sounds good. How much will you pay me?
translation: 听起来不错。你会付我多少钱？

english: Tell you what, because you've been interested in my art, I'll pay you the premium price of 20 gold pieces for each piece of molten glass you bring me
translation: 告诉你吧，因为你对我的手艺感兴趣，我会以每块20金币的高价收购你带来的熔融玻璃。

english: No thanks, I doubt I'll ever turn my hand to glassblowing.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我估计自己永远也碰不了吹玻璃这行。

english: Ok, suit yourself. Nobody seems to be interested in the skilled crafts these days.
translation: 好吧，随你便。如今似乎没人对熟练工艺感兴趣。

english: If you should change your mind, come back and talk to me.
translation: 如果你改变主意，回来跟我谈谈。

english: Ah [player name], have you come to sell me some molten glass?
translation: 啊 [player name]，你是来卖我些熔融玻璃的吗？

english: Oh.

translation: ……呃，嗯如果你弄到任何，我很乐意付钱。记住，你为我弄到的每块熔融玻璃我会付你20金币。

english: So what did you want to talk to me about then?

english: Could you tell me how to make molten glass again, please?

english: Well, I am very busy at the moment, but I guess I can take 5 minutes off for my favourite student.

translation: 你好。

english: I am Fry, master of dramatics. Player of plays, singer of songs!
translation: 我是弗莱，戏剧大师。戏剧表演者，歌曲演唱者！

english: A creative type eh?
translation: 创意型人才嗯？

english: Yes indeed.
translation: 确实是。

english: Why are you here?
translation: 你为什么在这里？

english: I put on shows to entertain our patrons.
translation: 我表演节目娱乐我们的顾客。

english: At least, I used to. We don't get many punters these days.
translation: 至少，我曾经是。如今我们没多少顾客。

english: Why is that?
translation: 这是为什么？

english: I don't know, Easter isn't as big as it used to be I suppose.
translation: 我不知道，我想复活节没以前那么盛大了。

english: Well I had to crawl in here through a hole, do you think that's a factor?
translation: 嗯我得通过一个洞爬进来，你觉得那是个因素吗？

english: It wasn't before, but I suppose it could be putting people off...

english: Hmm... Maybe we need a door...

english: Maybe!

translation: 你好！我正试图让复活节兔子开心，你有什么主意吗？

translation: 嗯，我注意到他最近心情不好。让我想想……

translation: 啊哈！有了！我们来场表演！那能让他开心。

english: A performance?

translation: 是的！他一直喜欢好看的表演。

english: Well I suppose that could work...

english: Well, I'll need some time to find something appropriate to perform.
translation: 嗯，我需要点时间找合适的表演内容。

english: Okay, I'll come back later when you've worked something out.
translation: 好的，等你安排好我再来。

english: Of course, I'll need some performers.
translation: 当然，我需要些表演者。

english: Surely you don't mean me?
translation: 你肯定不是指我吧？

translation: 当然！我也会跟其他人谈谈，组建个好剧团！

english: Well, as long as it's not just me.
translation: 嗯，只要不只是我。

english: Of course not, you don't look deserving of a solo to me! Now run along, I shall begin my creative process.
translation: 当然不是，你看起来不值得独奏！现在快走吧，我要开始创作过程了。

english: See you later then.

translation: 又见面了弗莱，你在继续表演计划吗？

english: Oh yes, I'm perusing potential performances and am planning which parts will be picked.
translation: 哦是的，我在浏览潜在表演，计划选哪些部分。

english: Perfect!

translation: 塔兰塔 - 拉 塔兰塔 - 拉！

english: We, dun dun dun, er...
translation: 我们，噔噔噔，呃……

english: I don't know this! I do not know this one!
translation: 我不知道这个！我不知道这个！

english: For goodness sake.
translation: 看在老天份上。

english: That wasn't very Easter-ey.
translation: 那不太有复活节气氛。

english: No, it wasn't.
translation: 不，确实不是。

english: Oh come on, it's an old standard!
translation: 哦拜托，那是老标准曲目！

english: I don't even know what a foeman is!
translation: 我甚至不知道敌人是什么！

english: Could we try something else?
translation: 我们能试试别的吗？

english: Well I don't have anything to hand, but you're welcome to have a look backstage.
translation: 嗯我手头没有，但欢迎你去后台看看。

english: Backstage eh? Alright.
translation: 后台嗯？好吧。

english: Rinder, Eggus Manus, and Glanton leave the stage.
translation: 林德、埃格斯‧马努斯和格拉顿离开舞台。

english: You should have a look backstage to see if there's anything that could help with the performance.
translation: 你应该去后台看看有没有什么能帮到表演的。

english: Have you found anything useful backstage yet?
translation: 你在后台找到什么有用的东西了吗？

english: Not yet.
translation: 还没有。

english: Well get to it then!
translation: 那快去做！

english: In my own time.
translation: 按我自己的时间。

english: I found some old costumes we can use.
translation: 我找到些我们可以用的旧戏服。

english: Oh that's great, but we'll need more than just costumes to wow the audience.
translation: 哦那太好了，但我们需要不只是戏服来惊艳观众。

english: We need some material to perform!
translation: 我们需要些表演素材！

english: True, I'll have another look.
translation: 确实，我再看看。

english: I've found an old script, but I haven't read it yet.
translation: 我找到个旧剧本，但还没读。

english: Well perhaps you should read it?
translation: 嗯也许你应该读读？

english: I suppose I should.
translation: 我想我应该。

english: I've found an old script and some carrot costumes!
translation: 我找到个旧剧本和一些胡萝卜戏服！

english: An old script eh? Is it any good?
translation: 旧剧本嗯？好吗？

english: I would show you but I seem to have misplaced it, I'll go and find it again.
translation: 我想给你看但似乎放错地方了，我去再找找。

english: You silly sausage!
translation: 你这傻香肠！

english: You tell me, here have a look. It seems like it's all out of order.
translation: 你告诉我，来看看吧。似乎全乱序了。

english: Well this is very interesting! Though I'm not sure how it would have been put together originally.
translation: 嗯这很有趣！虽然我不确定最初是怎么组合的。

english: In any case, it's definitely got the spirit of Easter written into it. Carrot costumes should suit this well.
translation: 无论如何，里面肯定写进了复活节精神。胡萝卜戏服应该很适合。

english: I think we can use this, though the page order will need reviewing. Can you work out something good?
translation: 我想我们可以用这个，虽然页序需要审查。你能弄出个好东西吗？

english: I can give it a go if you wash those disgusting carrot costumes.
translation: 如果你洗洗那些恶心的胡萝卜戏服，我可以试试。

english: Wonderful, bring it to me once you're done and we shall get cracking! In the meantime, I'll get those costumes cleaned.
translation: 太好了，完成后带给我，我们就开始！同时，我去把那些戏服洗干净。

english: How is that script looking? Have you sorted it out yet?
translation: 剧本怎么样？你整理好了吗？

english: It looks good to me, let's put on the performance!
translation: 我觉得不错，我们表演吧！

english: Wonderful! I shall inform our colleagues, and fetch the Easter Bunny.
translation: 太好了！我去通知同事，去接复活节兔子。

english: See you after the show.
translation: 演出后见。

english: Cutscene: "Dance time."
translation: 过场动画：“舞蹈时间。”

english: That was amazing!
translation: 太棒了！

english: So much Easter energy! Wow!
translation: 好多复活节能量！哇！

english: The cutscene ends.
translation: 过场动画结束。

english: That dance was amazing! Well done. I feel so... Invigorated!
translation: 那舞蹈太棒了！干得好。我感觉如此……充满活力！

english: How could I ever lose my Easter spirit?
translation: 我怎么会失去复活节精神？

english: Sometimes you just need a break.
translation: 有时你只需要休息一下。

english: That's true. Thanks, [player name].
translation: 确实。谢谢，[player name]。

english: I'm glad you're feeling better.
translation: 很高兴你感觉好些了。

english: Lawks! Look at the time, I should get back to Varrock to set up the Eggs!
translation: 天哪！看看时间，我该回维洛克城布置彩蛋了！

english: See you up there!
translation: 上面见！

english: I'm not finished yet.
translation: 我还没完成。

english: Good job putting that script in order, I think that went well!
translation: 把剧本整理得很好，我觉得进展顺利！

english: I couldn't help overhearing that you're trying to cheer up the Easter Bunny, and I have an idea.
translation: 我无意中听到你想让复活节兔子开心，我有个主意。

english: We are the Easter carrots! Carrots!
translation: 我们是复活节胡萝卜！胡萝卜！

english: Orange and full of the joys of spring!
translation: 橙色且充满春天的喜悦！

english: Easter is here, it's time to frolic!
translation: 复活节到了，嬉戏时间！

english: Watch us carrots do our thing!
translation: 看我们胡萝卜表演！

english: Woo!
translation: 呜！

english: Orange, rooty, nice and juicy!
translation: 橙色，多根，美味多汁！

english: Pop out of the ground and then we sing!
translation: 从地里冒出来然后我们唱歌！

english: Whilst sun is warm we dance about!
translation: 阳光温暖时我们跳舞！

english: Easter joy we hope to bring!
translation: 我们希望带来复活节欢乐！

english: I'm finished with the script.
translation: 我完成剧本了。

english: The script isn't ready yet.
translation: 剧本还没准备好。

english: What can I do for you, traveller?
translation: 旅行者，我能为你做什么？

english: Let's see what you've got.
translation: 让我看看你有什么。

english: I don't want to talk about my pleasure.
translation: 我不想谈我的乐趣。

english: Ah, you sound like a human who's not been drinking yet. Would you like to start now?
translation: 啊，你听起来像还没喝酒的人类。想现在开始吗？

english: Have you heard any rumours here?
translation: 你在这里听到什么传闻了吗？

english: Apparently Veos is looking for some help with something. He hangs around the docks of Port Piscarilius.
translation: 显然维奥斯在寻找帮助。他在皮斯卡里琉斯港码头徘徊。

english: They say there's trouble in Port Piscarilius. Something about gangs uniting. Might be worth looking into.
translation: 他们说皮斯卡里琉斯港有麻烦。关于帮派联合。可能值得调查。

english: I hear that Lord Hosidius has misplaced one of his sons. The Hosidius family might pay a lot to see him returned safely.
translation: 我听说霍西迪乌斯领主有个儿子失踪了，霍西迪乌斯家族可能愿意付大钱让他安全回来。

english: Phileas Rimor has supposedly been looking for some assistance with something in Shayzien. Maybe worth investigating.
translation: 菲利亚斯‧里莫据说在谢兹恩城寻找帮助。也许值得调查。

english: I hear that the rulers of Lovakengj have some work available. You'll find them in the Lovakengj Assembly.
translation: 我听说洛瓦肯吉城的统治者有些任务委托，你可以在洛瓦肯吉城议会找到他们。

english: Apparently there's been some commotion in the middle of Arceuus. Might be worth checking out.
translation: 显然阿西乌斯城中心区域有些骚动，也许值得去看看。

english: That protest outside Kourend Castle is starting to attract some attention. Could be worth taking a look.
translation: 库兰德城堡外的抗议开始引起注意。可能值得看看。

english: No, it hasn't been very busy lately.
translation: 不，最近不太忙。

english: I'm alright, thank you.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

english: Let's see what you've got.
translation: 让我看看你有什么。

english: I don't want to talk about my pleasure.
translation: 我不想谈我的乐趣。

english: I'm alright, thank you.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

english: Have you heard any rumours here?
translation: 你在这里听到什么传闻了吗？

english: [Good day, sir/Good day, madam/Good day].
translation: [你好，先生/你好，女士/你好]。

english: What are you doing down here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: I'm working on the digging, of course.
translation: 我在做挖掘工作，当然。

english: It's a small excavation, so only two of us can work on it at a time.
translation: 这是个小挖掘点，所以我们一次只能两个人工作。

english: Thorodin and Donal were working on it earlier, but I hear Donal's run off to hide in the inn.
translation: 索罗丁和唐纳尔之前在这里干活，但我听说唐纳尔跑去躲在旅馆了。

english: Why is that?
translation: 这是为什么？

english: Apparently he saw a monster when he was in the caves.
translation: 显然他在洞穴里看到了怪物。

english: I'm not scared of monsters - I won't let them stop me from digging!
translation: 我不怕怪物——我不会让它们阻止我挖掘！

english: Good day.
translation: 你好。

english: What are you doing down here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Good day.
translation: 你好。

english: Hey there.
translation: 嘿。

english: Yes please! How many do you have?
translation: 好的，谢谢！你有多少？

english: How many what?
translation: 多少什么？

english: I'll take the lot!
translation: 我全要！

english: Right...
translation: 好吧……

english: Hello! I've had a few to drink!
translation: 你好！我喝了几杯！

english: I haven't had that many, have I?
translation: 我没喝那么多，对吧？

english: 'Oh there once was a dwarf named Tonalo! He started a fight with a buffalo!'
translation: ‘哦从前有个矮人叫托纳洛！他跟水牛打了一架！’

english: What?
translation: 什么？

english: 'He kicked and he punched, it was quite the show! But he tripped on a rock and stubbed his toe!'
translation: ‘他又踢又打，真是场好戏！但他被石头绊倒扭伤了脚趾！’

english: What? I didn't even do it!
translation: 什么？我根本没做！

english: Here, have this!
translation: 来，拿着这个！

english: Hello there. Want to trade some furs?
translation: 你好。想交易些毛皮吗？

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: What furs do you have?
translation: 你有什么毛皮？

english: I have a selection of both rare and common furs from all across the kingdom. Also, if you happen to have any furs you've brought from the east, I'd be pretty keen to buy some.
translation: 我有来自王国各地的稀有和普通毛皮。另外，如果你碰巧有从东方带来的毛皮，我很乐意买些。

english: So, want to trade?
translation: 那么，想交易吗？

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Tetamo! If you change your mind, you know where to find me.
translation: 特塔莫！如果你改变主意，知道去哪找我。

english: You're the one who stole from me! Guards! Guards!
translation: 你就是偷我东西的人！守卫！守卫！

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: What furs do you have?
translation: 你有什么毛皮？

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Would you like to trade in fur?
translation: 你想交易毛皮吗？

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: I don't sell to outerlanders.
translation: 我不卖给外乡人。

english: Only Fremenniks may purchase furs here.
translation: 只有费明尼克人能在这里买毛皮。

english: Welcome back [Fremennik name]! Have you seen the furs I have today?
translation: 欢迎回来 [Fremennik name]！看到我今天的毛皮了吗？

english: Hey! Get your hands off there!
translation: 嘿！把手拿开！

english: You think me stupid [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你觉得我蠢吗 [Fremennik name]？

english: Guardsguards!
translation: 守卫！守卫！

english: You're the one who stole something from me!
translation: 你就是偷我东西的人！

english: Furia?
translation: 芙莉雅？

english: Furia completely ignores you.
translation: 芙莉雅完全无视你。

english: You's better talk to Dad, We not talk to wierdly 'umans.
translation: 你最好跟爸爸谈，我们不跟奇怪的人类说话。

english: Thanks for da chompy, it was deloverly!
translation: 谢谢你的食人鸟，真美味！

english: Human done good!
translation: 人类做得好！

english: Hello there. What are you doing here?
translation: 你好。你在这里做什么？

english: I'm waiting here hoping that someone can guide me to the Paterdomus, the temple on the Salve.
translation: 我在这里等，希望有人能引导我去帕特多穆斯，萨鲁夫上的神庙。

english: Where is Paterdomus?
translation: 帕特多穆斯在哪？

english: Oh, Paterdomus is that rather impressive looking temple on the Salve... I'm sure you must have passed it on your way into Morytania.
translation: 哦，帕特多穆斯是萨鲁夫上那个看起来相当令人印象深刻的神庙……我相信你进入莫利塔尼亚时肯定经过它。

english: Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
translation: 你为什么想去帕特多穆斯？

english: I'm hoping to get back to civilisation and see what the lands of Misthalin look like.
translation: 我希望回到文明世界，看看米斯特林王國的土地什么样。

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Paterdomus?
translation: 如果我们在去帕特多穆斯的路上遇到敌人，你能自保吗？

english: Let's just say that I'm somewhat experienced and I'm happy to take on my fair share of bad guys. You don't need to worry about that.
translation: 这么说吧，我还算有点经验，而且我很乐意承担我该对付的那份坏人。你不需要为我担心。

english: I can take you to Paterdomus.
translation: 我可以带你去帕特多穆斯。

english: Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: 嗯，看来你有个随从。我想若是让它独自乱跑，这趟路上恐怕会走丢。等你的随从安顿好了我们再动身。

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: 真的吗？那太好了！到达目的地后我会给你报酬的。

english: Temple Trekking begins
translation: 神庙徒步开始

english: Ok, which route should we take?
translation: 好的，我们应该走哪条路线？

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: 啊，所以你想给我一些补给？让我打开我的背包看看。

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than staying in Burgh de Rott.
translation: 哦，我讨厌这趟行程，但比待在伯格德罗特镇好。

english: It's scary here...let's get going!
translation: 这里很可怕……我们走吧！

english: When are we going to get to Paterdomus?
translation: 我们什么时候能到帕特多穆斯？

english: We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on.
translation: 我们没时间站着闲聊；赶紧前进。

english: Do you visit Paterdomus often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: 你经常来帕特多穆斯吗？你似乎很熟悉这条路。

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...?
translation: 你没看见我正在挨打吗……？

english: Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
translation: 谢谢，我会吃掉的。

english: Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Burgh de Rott. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: 天哪，看来我们得回伯格德罗特镇了。我们过不了那座桥！

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
translation: 我相信我们能找到办法的！

english: Player completes the bridge event
translation: 玩家完成了桥梁事件

english: Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Burgh de Rott.
translation: 这下糟了……看来我们过不了这片沼泽，得回伯格德罗特镇。

english: Player completes the bog event
translation: 玩家完成了沼泽事件

english: Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
translation: 太棒了！干得漂亮，我会跟紧你。

english: Whahay...that was great!
translation: 哇哈……太棒了！

english: But we really should be heading off now.
translation: 不过我们现在真得赶紧上路了。

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
translation: 放心，我们一定能找到路过去的！

english: Player completes the river event
translation: 玩家完成了河流事件

english: That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
translation: 太厉害了！我也得照做。

english: Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: 哇哈……太棒了！不过我们现在真得赶紧上路了。

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
translation: 那……那些气泡是什么？

english: This is scary!
translation: 这太可怕了！

english: Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
translation: 啊，那应该是触手……

english: Ahhh, two tentacles!
translation: 啊，两根触手！

english: ...three tentacles!
translation: ……三根触手！

english: I think I'm going to faint!
translation: 我觉得我要晕了！

english: Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: 天哪！看那怪物！你得自己解决那东西！

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the temple. Here's your reward.
translation: 多谢你平安把我带到神庙，这是你的报酬。

english: Where is Paterdomus?
translation: 帕特多穆斯在哪？

english: Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
translation: 你为什么想去帕特多穆斯？

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
translation: 如果我们在路上遇到敌人，你能自保吗？

english: I can take you to Paterdomus.
translation: 我可以带你去帕特多穆斯。

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Caranock seems too busy to talk.
translation: 卡兰诺克似乎太忙了没法说话。

english: Get out of my office! We WILL have our revenge, human!
translation: 滚出我的办公室！我们一定会复仇的，人类！

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 虽然你找到了顾客，但你似乎没带正确的食物！你需要 [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]！

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 恐怕预制菜肴不合要求。唯有手工烹制的地精美食，才配得上阿卢夫航空的顾客。

english: You hand over your delivery of [item] to G.L.O. Caranock
translation: 你把 [item] 的配送交给 G.L.O. 卡兰诺克

english: Just hand over the order human.
translation: 把订单交出来，人类。

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: 你一定走了很远的路才把这个送到我这里，这里有点额外的小意思，拿着当小费。

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
translation: 你有 [number] 积分可兑换免费配送代币。你还没资格获得地精美食配送。

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 你有 [number] 积分可兑换免费配送代币。你可以让 [number] 份地精美食配送给你。

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: 别忘了从小阿卢夫‧吉安那里领取免费配送代币。

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 配送已超时！请返回小阿卢夫处重新接单。你丢掉了配送箱，因为不再需要了。

english: Welcome to GPDT!
translation: 欢迎到来基利诺尔物流团队！

english: Thank you very much.
translation: 非常感谢。

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Not much really... I run a local shop which earns me a few trading sticks, but that's about it. I keep myself to myself really.
translation: 没什么真的……我经营一家当地商店，赚些交易棒，就这样。我基本上独来独往。

english: What are trading sticks?
translation: 什么是交易棒？

english: They're the local currency Bwana, it's used in Tai Bwo Wannai, there's usually some odd jobs that need doing around the village which you could do to earn some trading sticks.
translation: 那是当地货币，伙计，在泰博瓦纳村使用，村里通常有些零活需要做，你可以做那些赚些交易棒。

translation: 我想是那个坠毁滑翔机的地精飞行员，也许他机上有个小吧台？想想看，你大概会指望那小家伙收拾好东西离开这里对吧？他

english: All sorts of things! There's plenty of coal rocks along with some iron, mithril and adamantite as well.
translation: 各种东西！有很多煤矿石，还有一些铁、秘银和精金。

english: Deeper in the guild you'll find even more rocks including some runite! The best bit though is our amethyst mine, the only one in the land!

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.

translation: 你闻起来很熟悉……

translation: 在这附近见过人类吗？我非 - 常 - 饿。
