english: What are you doing out here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: I'm here to talk about Combat Achievements.
translation: 我来谈谈战斗成就。

english: Could you explain what they are?
translation: 你能解释一下它们是什么吗？

english: Yes, tell me about Combat Achievements.
translation: 是的，跟我讲讲战斗成就。

english: Not at the moment, no.
translation: 目前不，没有。

english: I have to go.
translation: 我得走了。

english: No, I'm alright thanks.
translation: 不，我没事谢谢。

english: I think I've completed a combat tier!
translation: 我想我完成了一个战斗层级！

english: Woooo wooo wooooo woooo.
translation: 呜呜 呜呜 呜呜呜 呜呜。

english: We are waiting for you to join us.
translation: 我们在等你加入我们。

english: Woooo... Woooooo...
translation: 呜呜……呜呜呜……

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: You see me? You understand me?
translation: 你看见我？你理解我？

english: Yes. Who are you?
translation: 是的。你是谁？

english: Me Hopespear of Narogoshuun tribe. Who you?
translation: 我是纳罗古舒恩部落的霍普斯皮尔。你是谁？

english: I'm [player name].
translation: 我是 [player name]。

english: You not goblin. What you want here?
translation: 你不是哥布林。你想要什么？

english: Why are you here?
translation: 你为什么在这里？

english: Me dead, but me not go. Long ago, me have vision of Big High War God. Me chosen prophet of Big High War God.
translation: 俺死了，但俺没走。很久以前，俺有至高战神的幻象。俺是至高战神的被选先知。

english: Me think, when me die, Big High War God take me to reward in Yu'biusk. Every day great battle, every night great victory with feasting.
translation: 俺想，当俺死时，至高战神会带俺去尤比斯克受赏。每天大战，每晚大胜宴饮。

english: Big High War God not come, but me have faith. Someday Big High War God come for me, take me to him. Until then me hang on, not let go into death.
translation: 至高战神没来，但俺有信心。总有一天至高战神会来接俺，带俺去他那。在那之前俺坚持，不让死。

english: I visited Yu'biusk.
translation: 我访问了尤比斯克。

english: You go to Yu'biusk? What you see?
translation: 你去尤比斯克？你看到什麼？

english: It was a wasteland.
translation: 那是片荒地。

english: Wasteland? No goblins fighting glorious battles?
translation: 荒地？没有哥布林打光荣的仗？

english: No one. It was all empty.
translation: 没人。全是空的。

english: You lie!
translation: 你撒谎！

english: I'm not lying. It's what I saw.
translation: 我没撒谎。那就是我看到的。

english: Even so... Yu'biusk is place of Big High War God. Land of Goblins. It where goblins should go.
translation: 即使如此……尤比斯克是至高战神的地方。哥布林之地。那是哥布林该去的地方。

english: Will you do me favour?
translation: 你愿意帮俺个忙吗？

english: What favour?
translation: 什么忙？

english: High priests in this tomb, when they die they believe they go to Yu'biusk. But their spirits still here.
translation: 这墓里的大祭司，死时他们相信去尤比斯克。但他们的灵魂还在这里。

english: If you can go to Yu'biusk, you can take their bones and bury them there. Will you do this for me?
translation: 如果你能去尤比斯克，你可以拿它们的骨头埋在那里。你愿意为俺做这个吗？

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: Thank you!
translation: 谢谢！

english: How can I get the bones? When I defeated them before, the high priests just spoke to me and then went back into the ground.
translation: 我怎么拿到骨头？我以前打败它们时，大祭司只是跟我说话然后就回地下了。

english: Normally, undead goblin high priests cannot be destroyed, but there is ancient goblin combat ritual.
translation: 通常，不死哥布林大祭司不能被摧毁，但有古代哥布林战斗仪式。

english: You must defeat high priests without using any weapons, armour or spells. Once you have bones, take them to Yu'biusk and bury them there.
translation: 你必须不使用任何武器、盔甲或法术击败大祭司。一旦拿到骨头，带去尤比斯克埋在那里。

english: I'll do that.
translation: 我会做的。

english: Thank you, human.
translation: 谢谢你，人类。

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: Me should know better than to ask human to do favour for dead goblin.
translation: 俺早该知道不该让人类为死哥布林帮忙。

english: It was everything you hope for.
translation: 那是你希望的一切。

english: Thank you! I know Big High War God still care for us! I wait for him here. Someday he take me to Yu'biusk to live with him.
translation: 谢谢！俺知道至高战神还关心俺们！俺在这里等他。总有一天他带俺去尤比斯克跟他住。

english: In meantime, will you do me favour?
translation: 同时，你愿意帮俺个忙吗？

english: I should go.
translation: 我该走了。

english: Tell me about the Big High War God.
translation: 跟我讲讲至高战神。

english: Big High War God greatest of all gods! He take puny goblins from Yu'biusk and make them mighty warriors for great war of gods!
translation: 至高战神是所有神中最伟大的！他带走尤比斯克渺小的哥布林，让他们成为神之战的强大战士！

english: When gods go to war, goblin soldiers so good that Big High War God sell tribes to fight for different gods. Big High War God fight with other gods, sometimes for one, sometimes another.
translation: 当神开战时，哥布林士兵太好用了，至高战神把部落卖给不同的神战斗。至高战神与其他神战斗，有时为一个，有时为另一个。

english: Other gods fight for their own reasons, but Big High War God fight for war itself!
translation: 其他神为自己的理由战斗，但至高战神为战争本身战斗！

english: Tell me more about yourself.
translation: 多跟我讲讲你自己。

english: Me chosen prophet of Big High War God. Before I have prophecy, goblin tribes fight one another very much.
translation: 俺是至高战神的被选先知。在我有预言之前，哥布林部落互相打得厉害。

english: Long ago we fight other people: beardy-short-people, pointy-hat-short-people, tall people with keen blades. Other people build cities with walls, and we not able to attack them any more.
translation: 很久以前我们打其他人：大胡子矮人、尖帽子矮人、带利刃的高个子。其他人建城墙城市，我们再也攻不进去。

english: There not enough food for all tribes, so tribes with no food attack tribes who have food. Goblin war last many many years. Finally all tribes meet at this place, where temple is now.
translation: 没有足够食物给所有部落，所以没食物的部落攻击有食物的部落。哥布林战争持续很多很多年。最后所有部落在这个地方集合，现在神庙所在处。

english: It rain many days. But rain not stop goblins. Goblin feet churn up ground with rain and goblin blood. All ground turn to mud. That why it called Battle of Plain of Mud.
translation: 下了很多天雨。但雨没阻止哥布林。哥布林脚把地面跟雨水和哥布林血搅在一起。所有地面变成泥。那就是为什么叫泥泞平原之战。

english: Battle last many days. Both sides same size, none win, none lose. Goblin bodies everywhere. Many dead.
translation: 战斗持续很多天。双方规模相同，没赢没输。到处都是哥布林尸体。很多死了。

english: Me not important general, not mighty sergeant. Me just normal goblin. But one night, me have dream.
translation: 俺不是重要将军，不是强大中士。俺只是普通哥布林。但一天晚上，俺做了个梦。

english: Me see throne of Big High War God. He shine with light so bright me cannot see him, but me hear his voice.
translation: 俺看到至高战神的王座。他光芒太亮俺看不见他，但俺听到他的声音。

english: He say, 'Stop the fighting!' He say, 'Fighting good, but not if all my followers die! You must not fight one another so much you all die!'
translation: 他说，‘停止战斗！’他说，‘战斗好，但如果所有追随者都死了就不好！你们不能互相打得都死光！’

english: Then he say, 'Today I cannot lead you, but some day I will send Chosen Commander to lead you.'
translation: 然后他说，‘今天我不能领导你们，但总有一天我会派被选指挥官来领导你们。’

english: I see Chosen Commander in dream. He wear shining armour and stand at front of army of goblins. Behind Chosen Commander, goblins stretch to horizon. Many goblins, too many to count.
translation: 我在梦里看到被选指挥官。他穿闪亮盔甲站在哥布林军队前面。在被选指挥官后面，哥布林延伸到地平线。很多哥布林，多到数不清。

english: I see banners of every tribe. Banners of all tribes, even Dorgesh tribe.
translation: 我看到每个部落的旗帜。所有部落的旗帜，甚至多尔什部落。

english: Other races, they run away from mighty goblin army! Chosen Commander make goblins build siege machines and they break down walls of cities. Then goblins march in and kill everyone!
translation: 其他种族，他们从强大的哥布林军队逃跑！被选指挥官让哥布林建造攻城机器，它们打破城市城墙。然后哥布林进军进去杀掉所有人！

english: And when all dead, Big High War God himself appear and sit on great throne of bronze and rule over all, with Chosen Commander beside him.
translation: 当所有人都死了，至高战神本人出现，坐在伟大的青铜王座上统治一切，被选指挥官在他身边。

english: Then I wake from dream. I know it true vision from Big High War God. I run to general of my tribe, and he call other generals for emergency meeting.
translation: 然后我从梦中醒来。我知道那是至高战神的真实幻象。我跑向我部落的将军，他召集其他将军开紧急会议。

english: I tell all generals what I see. They decide to stop fighting so goblins not all die. By this time, so many had died that there enough food for all.
translation: 我告诉所有将军我看到的。他们决定停止战斗，这样哥布林不会都死光。到这时，死了太多，有足够食物给所有人。

english: Then generals set goblins to work building temple on site of battle. It sink into mud, so they turn it into underground temple, and keep it secret from others.
translation: 然后将军们让哥布林在战场遗址建神庙。它沉入泥中，所以他们把它变成地下神庙，并对其他人保密。

english: Goblins write my vision down in goblin holy book, along with history of goblins and commandments of Big High War God.
translation: 哥布林把我的幻象写在哥布林圣书中，连同哥布林历史和至高战神的诫命。

english: Tell me more about the Chosen Commander.
translation: 多跟我讲讲被选指挥官。

english: Me not know much more. In vision, Chosen Commander wear heavy armour and big helmet that cover face. Me not know what he look like. I see him give orders, but he far away so me not hear his voice.
translation: 俺不知道更多。在幻象中，被选指挥官穿重甲和大头盔遮住脸。俺不知道他长什麼样。我看到他下命令，但他太远俺听不到他的声音。

english: Me think Chosen Commander will be great goblin general, but Big High War God chose me to have vision, not great general, so Chosen Commander could be anyone.
translation: 俺想被选指挥官会是个伟大的哥布林将军，但至高战神选俺有幻象，不是伟大将军，所以被选指挥官可能是任何人。

english: Nothing. I should go.
translation: 没什么。我该走了。

english: You take bones to Yu'biusk yet?
translation: 你把骨头带去尤比斯克了吗？

english: Not yet.
translation: 还没。

english: You please do this for me, human. Remember, you must defeat high priests without using any weapons, armour or spells.
translation: 请你为俺做这个，人类。记住，你必须不使用任何武器、盔甲或法术击败大祭司。

english: I did.
translation: 我做了。

english: Thank you. Not many humans like you. Now goblin high priests can rest.
translation: 谢谢。没多少人类像你这样。现在哥布林大祭司可以安息了。

english: Why are you here?
translation: 你为什么在这里？

english: I visited Yu'biusk.
translation: 我访问了尤比斯克。

english: It was a wasteland.
translation: 那是片荒地。

english: What favour?
translation: 什么忙？

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: I'll do that.
translation: 我会做的。

english: Tell me about the Big High War God.
translation: 跟我讲讲至高战神。

english: Tell me more about yourself.
translation: 多跟我讲讲你自己。

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: It was everything you hope for.
translation: 那是你希望的一切。

english: I should go.
translation: 我该走了。

english: Tell me more about the Chosen Commander.
translation: 多跟我讲讲被选指挥官。

english: Nothing. I should go.
translation: 没什么。我该走了。

english: Welcome...
translation: 欢迎……

english: Where do you think you're going?
translation: 你以为你要去哪？

english: You think you can escape?
translation: 你以为你能逃掉？

english: You can't leave...
translation: 你走不了的……

english: It's been a while since I've had a new toy...
translation: 好久没玩新玩具了……

english: Don't give up yet...
translation: 别这么快放弃……

english: Until next time...
translation: 下次再见……

english: WOOOOO!
translation: 呜呜呜呜！

english: Aaaah!
translation: 啊啊啊！

english: Children, run quickly!
translation: 孩子们，快跑！

english: Oh my gods, the dragon is coming back!
translation: 哦我的神啊，龙回来了！

english: Quickly, run!
translation: 快跑！

english: WOOO woooo wooo WOOOO!
translation: 呜呜 呜呜 呜呜 呜呜呜呜！

english: Get the women and children to the boats!
translation: 把妇女和儿童送上船！

english: On the horizon! Do you see it?
translation: 在地平线上！你看到了吗？

english: Put that fire out!
translation: 把火扑灭！

english: Wooo wooo wooOOooOOoo!
translation: 呜呜 呜呜 呜呜哦哦哦哦！

english: Eeeek!
translation: 咦！

english: EIEEEEE!
translation: 咿！

english: Mummy, are we safe now?
translation: 妈妈，我们现在安全了吗？

english: Mummy! Where are you?
translation: 妈妈！你在哪？

english: Wooo wooo woooooooo!
translation: 呜呜 呜呜 呜呜呜呜呜！

english: I don't want to die like this!
translation: 我不想这样死！

english: Oh no!
translation: 哦不！

english: Someone help me! I'm trapped!
translation: 来人救救我！我被困住了！

english: AAARGH!
translation: 啊！

english: Come on, you monster! Just finish me!
translation: 来吧，你这怪物！干脆解决了我！

english: It's hopeless. We're all going to die!
translation: 没希望了。我们都得死！

english: We're all doomed.
translation: 我们都完了。

english: Woooo wooo wooooo woooo
translation: 呜呜 呜呜 呜呜呜 呜呜

english: You cannot understand the ghost.
translation: 你听不懂这个幽灵在说什么。

english: Don't send me back to that library!
translation: 别把我送回那个图书馆！

english: What?
translation: 什么？

english: It took me too long to get out of there... Just don't send me back!
translation: 我花了太久才从那出来……别送我回去！

english: Woooo wooo wooooo woooo.
translation: 呜呜 呜呜 呜呜呜 呜呜。

english: You there! Seek out the centurion at once. Inform him that the enemy leader has been identified and the Carnifex Maximus himself has been dispatched to bring back his head!
translation: 你！立刻去找百夫长。告诉他敌方首领已确认，最高行刑官瓦尔多维斯已亲自前去取他首级！

english: Err... What?
translation: 呃……什么？

english: Did you not hear me? Do I need to spell it out for you?
translation: 你没听见吗？要我给你拼出来吗？

english: If you could that would be great.
translation: 如果你能那就太好了。

english: Goodness you are a fool! Their leader is named Yonrith Lovakengj. He has fled to the west with his closest allies, but much of his army still remains. Carnifex Maximus Vardorvis is in pursuit of him.
translation: 天哪你真是个傻瓜！他们的首领叫约恩里斯‧洛瓦肯吉。他已和最亲密的盟友逃往西方，但他的大部分军队还在。最高行刑官瓦尔多维斯正在追捕他。

english: Yeah... I still have no idea what you're on about.
translation: 是啊……我还是不知道你在说什么。

english: Useless! Perhaps the headsman needs to take your head as well. I will find the centurion myself!
translation: 没用！也许行刑手也需要取走你的脑袋。我自己去找百夫长！

english: Okay... Good luck with that.
translation: 好吧……祝你好运。

english: Ah, there you are. Dire news I'm afraid. We've lost all contact with the capital. Worse, another dwarven clan has joined the Saradominists. They march upon the fortress as we speak.
translation: 啊，你在这。恐怕有坏消息。我们已与首都失去所有联系。更糟的是，另一个矮人氏族加入了萨拉多明信徒。他们正向我们堡垒进军。

english: Oh... Oh dear?
translation: 哦……哦天哪？

english: Is everything all right my friend? You don't seem to be yourself.
translation: 一切都好吗我的朋友？你看起来不太对劲。

english: I don't think I'm who you believe I am.
translation: 我想我不是你认为的那个人。

english: Hmm. You're clearly confused. The lack of sleep is getting to you. Go and have a lie down and we will discuss this later.
translation: 嗯。你显然很困惑。缺乏睡眠影响了你。去躺会儿，我们稍后再谈。

english: Alright...
translation: 好吧……

english: I've been doing some research into our new foes. Rumour has it they once lived in a great city in the far north. The city fell and now they are homeless.
translation: 我一直在研究我们的新敌人。传闻他们曾经住在极北的一座伟大城市。城市陷落了，现在他们无家可归。

english: It seems they have been promised a new home here in return for wiping us out. We must take great care. We may be fighting for our home, but it seems they are as well.
translation: 似乎他们被承诺在这里有个新家，作为消灭我们的回报。我们必须非常小心。我们可能是在为家园而战，但似乎他们也是。

english: Right... And err, how's the fight going so far?
translation: 好吧……那个，目前战斗进展如何？

english: You tell me, I'm no warrior. That said, I did hear that they'd managed to turn some of our own golems against us. If they can do that, I fear what else they may do.
translation: 你告诉我，我不是战士。话说回来，我确实听说他们设法让我们的某些魔像反过来对付我们。如果他们能做到那个，我害怕他们还会做什么。

english: Oh my... That doesn't sound good...
translation: 哦天……那听起来不太好……

english: Indeed. We have increased our offerings tenfold, but I fear they fall on empty ears. Perhaps our lord really has gone.
translation: 确实。我们将祭品增加了十倍，但恐怕它们落入了空耳。也许我们的领主真的走了。

english: Hmm. Well I hope it all works out.
translation: 嗯。嗯我希望一切顺利。

english: Whoooo wooo Whooooooooo.
translation: 呜呜呜 呜呜 呜呜呜呜呜。

english: I fought a really big ghost dog in here - is he gone now?
translation: 我在这里打了一只很大的幽灵狗——他现在走了吗？

english: You were well rewarded for you effort. But you should leave this place, for it is not wise to tarry.
translation: 你的努力得到了丰厚回报。但你应该离开这个地方，因为逗留是不明智的。

english: But I lost my shadow sword and I don't know how to get it back.
translation: 但我弄丢了阴影之剑，我不知道怎么拿回来。

english: Ah, so that is why you return. I can assist you in that and give you another.
translation: 啊，那就是你回来的原因。我可以帮你，再给你一把。

english: Who are you anyway...or were you...?
translation: 你到底是谁……或者曾经是……？

english: Who I was does not matter. Now, I am a guardian for the Shadow Realm and I am protecting this area from any more disturbances.
translation: 我曾经是谁不重要。现在，我是阴影领域的守护者，我正在保护这个区域免受任何进一步的干扰。

english: There are those who walk in the Shadow Realm who should not.
translation: 有些不该在阴影领域行走的人正在行走。

english: Good day, how may I help you?
translation: 你好，怎么帮你？

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: This is a branch of the Bank of Gielinor. We have branches in many towns.
translation: 这是基利诺尔银行的分行。我们在许多城镇有分行。

english: And what do you do?
translation: 那你做什么？

english: We will look after your items and money for you. Leave your valuables with us if you want to keep them safe.
translation: 我们会为你保管物品与金钱。若想确保贵重物品安全，可交由我们保管。

english: Woooo wooo wooooo woooo
translation: 呜呜 呜呜 呜呜呜 呜呜

english: The ghost banker wails incomprehensibly at you, but seems to understand that you wish to access your bank account. You can still quick-bank, but will have to communicate via a series of hand gestures.
translation: 幽灵银行职员对你发出难以理解的哀嚎，但似乎明白你想访问银行账户。你仍然可以快速银行，但必须通过一系列手势交流。

english: I'd like to access my bank account, please.
translation: 我想查看我的银行账户。

english: I'd like to check my PIN settings.
translation: 我想检查我的 PIN 设置。

english: I'd like to collect items.
translation: 我想领取物品。

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: Would you like to visit Dragontooth Island? It is a most pleasant island in the sea between Morytania and the lands of the east. It'll cost you 25 ectotokens for the return trip.
translation: 你想去龙齿岛吗？那是莫利塔尼亚和东方大地之间海域中一个非常宜人的岛屿。往返要花你25个生态代币。

english: Okay, here's 25 ectotokens. Let's go.
translation: 好的，这是25个生态代币。走吧。

english: After a long boat trip you arrive at Dragontooth Island.
translation: 经过漫长的船程，你到达了龙齿岛。

english: If I pay 500 ectotokens, can I get unlimited trips?
translation: 如果我付500个生态代币，能得到无限次行程吗？

english: Yes, that seems fair. Okay, hand them over and we can set off.
translation: 是的，那似乎公平。好的，交出来我们就可以出发了。

english: Yes, I'd accept that deal. But as you don't have enough ectotokens for that, would you like to pay 25 ectotokens for a trip now?
translation: 是的，我接受那个交易。但既然你没有足够的生态代币，你想现在付25个生态代币进行一次行程吗？

english: Not now, thanks.
translation: 现在不要，谢谢。

english: Would you like to visit Dragontooth Island? It is a most pleasant island in the sea between Morytania and the lands of the east.
translation: 你想去龙齿岛吗？那是莫利塔尼亚和东方大地之间海域中一个非常宜人的岛屿。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Player is rowed to Dragontooth Island
translation: 玩家被划船送到龙齿岛

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Can you take me back to Phasmatys, now?
translation: 你现在能带我回法斯蒂斯吗？

english: The ghost sailor wails at you incomprehensibly, and points at the boat, nodding his ghostly head.
translation: 幽灵水手对你发出难以理解的哀嚎，指着船，点着他那幽灵般的头。

english: Player is rowed to Port Phasmatys
translation: 玩家被划船送到波特法斯蒂斯

english: Yes, climb in.
translation: 是的，上来。

english: There isn't much on this island, is there?
translation: 这岛上没什么东西，对吧？

english: Woooo wooo wooooo woooo
translation: 呜呜 呜呜 呜呜呜 呜呜

english: Beautiful isn't it?
translation: 很美对吧？

english: But it cost me a lot of ectotokens to get here!
translation: 但我花了很多生态代币才到这里！

english: Worth every token, if you ask me.
translation: 要我说是物有所值。

english: Actually, I don't want anything.
translation: 其实我什么都不想要。

english: A return trip to Dragontooth Island costs 25 ectotokens.
translation: 返回龙齿岛的行程花费25个生态代币。

english: Okay, here's 25 ectotokens. Let's go.
translation: 好的，这是25个生态代币。走吧。

english: If I pay 500 ectotokens, can I get unlimited trips?
translation: 如果我付500个生态代币，能得到无限次行程吗？

english: Not now, thanks.
translation: 现在不要，谢谢。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Can you take me back to Phasmatys, now?
translation: 你现在能带我回法斯蒂斯吗？

english: There isn't much on this island, is there?
translation: 这岛上没什么东西，对吧？

english: Actually, I don't want anything.
translation: 其实我什么都不想要。

english: Where do you sail to?
translation: 你航行到哪？

english: At the moment, nowhere. The mini-Ectofuntus that powers the Ghostship is in major need of repair, and until it gets it, this ship is going nowhere.
translation: 目前，哪也不去。为幽灵船提供动力的迷你灵泉急需修理，在修好之前，这船哪也去不了。

english: What is this strange fountain?
translation: 这是什么奇怪的喷泉？

english: This is the Ectofuntus, the most marvellous creation of Necrovarus, our glorious leader.
translation: 这是灵泉，我们光荣的领袖奈克罗瓦鲁斯最奇妙的创造。

english: What is the Ectofuntus for?
translation: 灵泉是做什么的？

english: It provides the power to keep us ghosts from passing over into the next plane of existence.
translation: 它提供力量防止我们幽灵进入下一个存在位面。

english: And how does it work?
translation: 它怎么运作？

english: You have to pour a bucket of ectoplasm into the fountain, a pot of ground bones, and then worship at the Ectofuntus. A unit of unholy power will then be created.
translation: 你必须往喷泉里倒一桶灵质，一罐磨碎的骨头，然后在灵泉崇拜。然后会创造出一单位邪恶力量。

english: Can you do it yourself?
translation: 你们不能自己做吗？

english: No, we must rely upon the living, as the worship of the undead no longer holds any inherent power.
translation: 不，我们必须依赖活人，因为亡者的崇拜不再具有任何固有力量。

english: Why would people waste their time helping you out?
translation: 人们为什么要浪费时间帮你们？

english: For every unit of power produced we will give you five Ectotokens. These tokens can be used in Port Phasmatys to purchase various services, not least of which includes access through the main toll gates.
translation: 每生产一单位力量，我们会给你五个生态代币。这些代币可以在波特法斯蒂斯购买各种服务，其中包括通过主要收费大门。

english: Where do I get ectoplasm from?
translation: 我从哪得到灵质？

english: Necrovarus sensed the power bubbling beneath our feet, and we delved long and deep beneath Port Phasmatys, until we found a pool of natural ectoplasm. You may find it by using the trapdoor over there.
translation: 奈克罗瓦鲁斯感觉到我们脚下涌动的力量，我们在波特法斯蒂斯地下挖掘了很久很深，直到找到一池天然灵质。你可以通过那边的活板门找到它。

english: How do I grind bones?
translation: 我怎么磨骨头？

english: There is a bone grinding machine upstairs. Put bones of any type into the machine's hopper, and then turn the handle to grind them. You will need a pot to empty the machine of ground up bones.
translation: 楼上有个磨骨机。把任何类型的骨头放进机器的漏斗，然后转动手柄磨碎它们。你需要一个罐子把磨碎的骨头从机器里清空。

english: How do I receive Ectotokens?
translation: 我怎么获得生态代币？

english: We disciples keep track of how many units of power have been produced. Just talk to us once you have generated some and we will reimburse you with the correct amount of Ectotokens.
translation: 我们门徒跟踪生产了多少单位力量。一旦你生成了一些，就跟我们谈谈，我们会用正确数量的生态代币补偿你。

english: How do I generate units of power?
translation: 我怎么生成力量单位？

english: You have to pour a bucket of ectoplasm into the fountain and then worship at the Ectofuntus with a pot of ground bones. This will create a unit of unholy power.
translation: 你必须往喷泉里倒一桶灵质，然后用一罐磨碎的骨头在灵泉崇拜。这会创造出一单位邪恶力量。

english: Thanks for your time.
translation: 谢谢你的时间。

english: Can I have another bonecrusher, please?
translation: 能再给我一个碎骨器吗？

english: Compliments of Morytania for your efforts throughout the tasks set.
translation: 莫利塔尼亚对你在整个任务中努力的敬意。

english: You already appear to own such a device, mortal.
translation: 你似乎已经拥有这样一个设备了，凡人。

english: Woooo wooo wooooo woooo
translation: 呜呜 呜呜 呜呜呜 呜呜

english: Can I have the tokens I have earned?
translation: 能给我我赚的代币吗？

english: I have [number] ectotokens waiting for you mortal, but you do not have room in your inventory for them.
translation: 我有 [number] 个生态代币在等你，凡人，但你物品栏没空间放它们。

english: Certainly, mortal. Here's [number] ectotokens.
translation: 当然，凡人。这是 [number] 个生态代币。

english: What is the Ectofuntus for?
translation: 灵泉是做什么的？

english: Where do I get ectoplasm from?
translation: 我从哪得到灵质？

english: How do I grind bones?
translation: 我怎么磨骨头？

english: How do I receive Ectotokens?
translation: 我怎么获得生态代币？

english: Thanks for your time.
translation: 谢谢你的时间。

english: Can I have another bonecrusher, please?
translation: 能再给我一个碎骨器吗？

english: What is this strange fountain?
translation: 这是什么奇怪的喷泉？

english: All visitors to Port Phasmatys must pay a toll charge of 2 Ectotokens.
translation: 所有访问波特法斯蒂斯的游客必须支付2个生态代币的通行费。

english: I would like to enter Port Phasmatys - here's 2 Ectotokens.
translation: 我想进入波特法斯蒂斯——这是2个生态代币。

english: Player goes through the gate.
translation: 玩家穿过大门。

english: I'm not paying you Ectotokens just to go through a gate.
translation: 我不会只为过个门就付你生态代币。

english: Sorry - it's Town Policy.
translation: 抱歉——这是城镇政策。

english: Where can I get Ectotokens?
translation: 我在哪能得到生态代币？

english: You need to go to the Temple and earn some. Talk to the disciples - they will tell you how.
translation: 你需要去神庙赚一些。跟门徒谈谈——他们会告诉你怎么做。

english: The ghostly guards wail at you incomprehensibly, and though you cannot understand their exact words you understand their meaning - you may not pass the barriers of Port Phasmatys.
translation: 幽灵守卫对你发出难以理解的哀嚎，虽然你听不懂确切的话，但你明白他们的意思——你不能通过波特法斯蒂斯的屏障。

english: All visitors to Port Phasmatys must pay a toll charge of 2 Ectotokens. However, you have done the ghosts of our town a service that surpasses all value, so you may pass without charge.
translation: 所有访问波特法斯蒂斯的游客必须支付2个生态代币的通行费。不过，你为我们城镇的幽灵做了超越一切价值的服务，所以你可以免费通过。

english: The ghostly guards wail at you incomprehensibly, and though you cannot understand their exact words you understand their meaning - you may pass the barriers of Port Phasmatys without charge.
translation: 幽灵守卫对你发出难以理解的哀嚎，虽然你听不懂确切的话，但你明白他们的意思——你可以免费通过波特法斯蒂斯的屏障。

english: I would like to enter Port Phasmatys - here's 2 Ectotokens.
translation: 我想进入波特法斯蒂斯——这是2个生态代币。

english: I'm not paying you Ectotokens just to go through a gate.
translation: 我不会只为过个门就付你生态代币。

english: Where can I get Ectotokens?
translation: 我在哪能得到生态代币？

english: Hello there!
translation: 你好！

english: Greetings, traveller. Welcome to 'The Green Ghost' Tavern. What can I do you for?
translation: 你好，旅行者。欢迎来到“绿幽灵”酒馆。我能为你做什么？

english: Can I buy a beer?
translation: 我能买杯啤酒吗？

english: Sorry, but our pumps dried up over half a century ago. We of this village do not have much of a thirst these days.
translation: 抱歉，但我们的泵半个多世纪前就干了。我们村里的人这几天没什么口渴。

english: Can I hear some gossip?
translation: 我能听听八卦吗？

english: I suppose, as long as you keep it to yourself...
translation: 我想可以，只要你自己留着……

english: You see Gravingas out there in the marketplace? He speaks for the silent majority of Port Phasmatys, for those of us who would prefer to pass over into the next world.
translation: 你看到外面市场里的格雷文加斯了吗？他代表波特法斯蒂斯的沉默大多数，代表我们这些更愿意进入下一个世界的人。

english: What happened to the folk of this town?
translation: 这个城镇的人怎么了？

english: That's a long story, my friend, but you look like you have the time...
translation: 那是个长故事，我的朋友，但看起来你有时间……

english: Do you know why ghosts exist?
translation: 你知道为什么存在幽灵吗？

english: A ghost is a soul left in limbo, unable to pass over to the next world; they might have something left to do in this world that torments them, or they might just have died in a state of confusion.
translation: 幽灵是留在灵薄狱岛的灵魂，无法进入下一个世界；他们可能在这世界还有事要做折磨着他们，或者他们可能只是在困惑状态下死去。

english: Yes, that is normally the case. But here in Port Phasmatys, we of this town once chose freely to become ghosts!
translation: 是的，通常是那样。但在波特法斯蒂斯这里，我们镇上的人曾经自由选择成为幽灵！

english: Why on earth would you do such a thing?
translation: 你们到底为什么要做这种事？

english: It is a long story. Many years ago, this was a thriving port, a trading centre to the eastern lands of Gielinor. We became rich on the profits made from the traders that came across the eastern seas.
translation: 那是个长故事。许多年前，这是个繁荣的港口，基利诺尔东方土地的贸易中心。我们靠来自东方海域的贸易商利润变得富有。

english: We were very happy... until Lord Drakan noticed us.
translation: 我们很快乐……直到德拉坎领主注意到我们。

english: He sent unholy creatures to demand that a blood-tithe be paid to the Lord Vampyre, as is required from all in the domain of Morytania. We had no choice but to agree to his demands.
translation: 他派出不洁生物要求向吸血鬼领主缴纳血税，这是莫利塔尼亚领域内所有人都要求的。我们别无选择只能同意他的要求。

english: As the years went by, our numbers dwindled and many spoke of abandoning the town for safer lands. Then, Necrovarus came to us.
translation: 随着岁月流逝，我们人数减少，许多人说要放弃城镇去更安全的地方。然后，奈克罗瓦鲁斯来找我们。

english: He came from the eastern lands, but of more than that, little is known. Some say he was once a mage, some say a priest. Either way, he was in possession of knowledge totally unknown to even the most learned among us.
translation: 他来自东方土地，但除此之外知之甚少。有人说他曾经是法师，有人说他是牧师。无论如何，他拥有连我们中最博学的人都不完全了解的知识。

english: Necrovarus told us that he had been brought by a vision he'd had of an underground source of power. He inspired us to delve beneath the town, promising us the power to repel the vampyres.
translation: 奈克罗瓦鲁斯告诉我们，他是被他看到的地下力量源泉的幻象带来的。他激励我们挖掘城镇地下，承诺给我们击退吸血鬼的力量。

english: Deep underneath Phasmatys, we found a pool of green slime that Necrovarus called ectoplasm. He showed us how to build the Ectofuntus, which would turn the ectoplasm into the power he had promised us.
translation: 在法斯蒂斯深处，我们发现了一池奈克罗瓦鲁斯称为灵质的绿色粘液。他向我们展示如何建造灵泉，它将把灵质变成他承诺给我们的力量。

english: Indeed, this Ectopower did repel the vampyres; they would not enter Phasmatys once the Ectofuntus began working. But little did we know that we had exchanged one evil for yet another - Ectopower.
translation: 确实，这种生态力量确实击退了吸血鬼；一旦灵泉开始工作，他们就不会进入法斯蒂斯。但我们几乎不知道我们用一种邪恶交换了另一种——生态力量。

english: Little by little, we began to lose any desire for food or water, and our desire for the Ectopower grew until it dominated our thoughts entirely. Our bodies shrivelled and, one by one, we died.
translation: 一点一点地，我们开始失去对食物或水的任何欲望，我们对生态力量的渴望增长直到完全主导我们的思想。我们的身体萎缩，一个接一个，我们死了。

english: The Ectofuntus and the power it emanates keeps us here as ghosts - some, like myself, content to remain in this world; some becoming tortured souls who we do not allow to pass our gates.
translation: 灵泉及其发出的力量将我们作为幽灵留在这里——有些人，像我一样，满足于留在这个世界；有些人变成受折磨的灵魂，我们不允许他们通过我们的大门。

english: We would be able to pass over into the next world but Necrovarus has used his power to create a psychic barrier, preventing us.
translation: 我们本能够进入下一个世界，但奈克罗瓦鲁斯利用他的力量制造了一个精神屏障，阻止了我们。

english: We must remain here for all eternity, even unto the very end of the world.
translation: 我们必须永远留在这里，甚至直到世界尽头。

english: Do you have any jobs I can do?
translation: 你有什么工作我能做吗？

english: Yes, actually, I do. We have a very famous Master Bowman named Robin staying with us at the moment. Could you take him some clean bed linen for me?
translation: 是的，其实我有。我们目前有一位非常有名的神射手名叫罗宾住在我们这。你能帮我给他带些干净的床单吗？

english: Yes, I'd be delighted.
translation: 是的，我很乐意。

english: Oh, thank you. Be careful with that Robin, though - he's far too full of himself, that one.
translation: 哦，谢谢。不过小心那个罗宾——他太自大了，那个家伙。

english: No, I didn't mean a job like that.
translation: 不，我不是指那种工作。

english: Well, you could take that bedsheet through to Robin like I asked.
translation: 嗯，你可以像我要求的那样把那张床单带给罗宾。

english: Nothing, thanks.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。

english: Welcome, my friend! Be welcome in 'The Green Ghost' for as long as you live!
translation: 欢迎，我的朋友！只要你活着就欢迎在“绿幽灵”！

english: Can I buy a beer?
translation: 我能买杯啤酒吗？

english: Can I hear some gossip?
translation: 我能听听八卦吗？

english: What happened to the folk of this town?
translation: 这个城镇的人怎么了？

english: Do you have any jobs I can do?
translation: 你有什么工作我能做吗？

english: Yes, I'd be delighted.
translation: 是的，我很乐意。

english: No, I didn't mean a job like that.
translation: 不，我不是指那种工作。

english: Nothing, thanks.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。

english: Hi there. Why do you still bother having ships here? I mean - you're dead, what use are they to you?
translation: 你好。你为什么还麻烦在这里造船？我是说——你死了，它们对你有什么用？

english: We keep ships because we still need trade in Phasmatys. Every trader that comes to Phasmatys is made to worship the Ectofuntus, so that the Ectopower doesn't run out.
translation: 我们造船是因为我们在法斯蒂斯仍然需要贸易。每个来法斯蒂斯的贸易商都被迫崇拜灵泉，这样生态力量就不会用完。

english: So, without traders to worship in the Temple you're history, right?
translation: 所以，如果没有贸易商在神庙崇拜，你们就完了，对吧？

english: Aye, matey.
translation: 是的，伙计。

english: Woooo wooo wooooo woooo
translation: 呜呜 呜呜 呜呜呜 呜呜

english: Can I help you at all?
translation: 有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Woooo wooo wooooo woooo
translation: 呜呜 呜呜 呜呜呜 呜呜

english: You cannot understand the ghost.
translation: 你听不懂这个幽灵在说什么。

english: Yes please. What are you selling?
translation: 你在卖什么？

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: What do you want, mortal?
translation: 你想要什么，凡人？

english: We do not talk to the warm-bloods.
translation: 我们不跟温血动物说话。

english: Why did we have to listen to that maniacal priest?
translation: 我们为什么要听那个疯狂牧师的？

english: This cold wind blows right through you, doesn't it?
translation: 这冷风直接吹透你，对吧？

english: Worship the Ectofuntus all you want, but don't bother us, human.
translation: 你想崇拜灵泉就崇拜，但别烦我们，人类。

english: Woooo wooo wooooo woooo
translation: 呜呜 呜呜 呜呜呜 呜呜

english: You cannot understand the ghost.
translation: 你听不懂这个幽灵在说什么。

english: Hello, welcome to Aluft Aloft, the gnome food delivery service. We deliver gnome foods to customers all over Gielinor. Do you want a job? We are always looking for new staff.
translation: 你好，欢迎来到阿卢夫航空，地精美食配送服务。我们向基利诺尔各地的客户配送地精美食。你想要工作吗？我们一直在寻找新员工。

english: Yes, tell me more.
translation: 是的，多告诉我些。

english: First of all you will need some basic Gnome Cooking and Cocktail making training. Go and talk to my Father, Aluft Gianne snr. and Blurberry, if you haven't already, and they'll tell you what you need to do.

english: That's not an acorn!
translation: 那不是橡子！

translation: 我在看着你。

english: Give me your nuts!
translation: 把你的坚果给我！

english: Nothing is impossible to the squirrel who tries.
translation: 对尝试的松鼠来说没有什么是不可能的。

english: The determined squirrel persists until success is found.
translation: 坚定的松鼠坚持直到找到成功。

english: Face my squirrely wrath!.
translation: 面对我的松鼠之怒！

english: Hide your nuts!
translation: 藏好你的坚果！

english: Greetings! I see you are a new arrival to the world of Gielinor. My job is to welcome all new visitors. So welcome!
translation: 你好！我看你是刚来基利诺尔的新人。我的职责就是欢迎所有新访客。所以，欢迎！

english: You have already learned the first thing needed to succeed in this world: talking to other people!
translation: 你已经学会了在这个世界成功的第一要诀：与人交谈！

english: You will find many inhabitants of this world have useful things to say to you. By clicking on them you can talk to them.
translation: 你会发现这个世界的许多居民有有用的话要对你说。点击他们你可以跟他们交谈。

english: Before we get going, if you could be so kind to let me know how much experience you have with Old School Runescape, that would be wonderful!
translation: 开始之前，方便告诉我你对 Old School RuneScape 有多少经验吗？那就太感谢了！

english: I've played in the past, but not recently.
translation: 我以前玩过，但最近没玩。

english: I am an experienced player.
translation: 我是个有经验的玩家。

english: I am brand new! This is my first time here.
translation: 我是全新的！这是我第一次来这里。

english: Wonderful! Thank you.
translation: 太好了！谢谢。

english: Now then, let's start by looking at your options menu.
translation: 那么，让我们从查看你的选项菜单开始。

english: You will notice a flashing icon of a spanner. Please click on this to continue the tutorial.
translation: 你会看到一个闪烁的扳手图标，点它继续教程。

english: Looks like you're making good progress! The menu you've just opened is one of many. You'll learn about the rest as you progress through the tutorial.
translation: 看起来你进展顺利！你刚打开的菜单是众多菜单之一。随着你通过教程进展，你会了解其余的。

english: Anyway, I'd say it's time for you to go and meet your first instructor!
translation: 总之，该去见你的第一位导师了！

english: Welcome back. You have already learnt the first thing needed to succeed in this world: talking to other people!
translation: 欢迎回来。你已经学会了在这个世界成功的第一要诀：与人交谈！

english: You will find many inhabitants of this world have useful things to say to you. By clicking on them, you can talk to them.
translation: 你会发现这个世界的许多居民有有用的话要对你说。点击他们你可以跟他们交谈。

english: To continue the tutorial go through that door over there and speak to your first instructor!
translation: 要继续教程，穿过那边那扇门，跟你的第一个导师说话！

english: I've played in the past, but not recently.
translation: 我以前玩过，但最近没玩。

english: I am an experienced player.
translation: 我是个有经验的玩家。

english: I am brand new! This is my first time here.
translation: 我是全新的！这是我第一次来这里。

english: Hello, Gilbert!
translation: 你好，吉尔伯特！

english: Hey, [player name]!
translation: 嘿，[player name]！

english: The meadow is looking lovely!
translation: 草地看起来很美！

english: I know! It didn't always look like this though. It used to be dull and grey!
translation: 我知道！不过它并不总是这样。它曾经暗淡灰暗！

english: Dull and grey? How did it become so colourful?
translation: 暗淡灰暗？它怎么变得这么多彩？

english: An adventurer came along and helped me out. We cast a magic spell using flower seeds, and it created this lovely sunburst!
translation: 一个冒险者过来帮了我。我们用花种子施了一个魔法，它创造了这个可爱的太阳爆发！

english: Oh, I'd have liked to have seen that spell. It sounds impressive!
translation: 哦，我本想看那个法术。听起来令人印象深刻！

english: It was! The news travelled far. I've been getting lots of visitors. Many flower traders from across the lands have paid the meadow a visit.
translation: 确实是！消息传得很远。我一直有很多访客。许多来自各地的花卉贸易商参观了草地。

english: I know! Thank you again for your help with it. It fills me with happiness to see so much colour.
translation: 我知道！再次感谢你的帮助。看到这么多颜色让我充满快乐。

english: I've been getting lots of visitors too. Many flower traders from across the lands have paid the meadow a visit.
translation: 我也一直有很多访客。许多来自各地的花卉贸易商参观了草地。

english: I've even traded with a few for some new flower seeds with different colours!
translation: 我甚至跟其中几个交易了一些不同颜色的新花种子！

english: That's really cool. What do you do with all the flowers?
translation: 那真酷。你用所有的花做什么？

english: I make flower crowns in many different colours. I'm wearing one right now!
translation: 我制作许多不同颜色的花冠。我现在就戴着一个！

english: Sounds very colourful!
translation: 听起来很多彩！

english: You're welcome to have one if you'd like, just come back and ask me, anytime!
translation: 如果你想要，欢迎拿一个，随时回来问我！

english: Thank you. I might do just that!
translation: 谢谢。我可能会那样做！

english: New flower seeds? What types?
translation: 新花种子？什么类型？

english: Well as you may have noticed, you can change the colours of the flowers on your flower crown now!
translation: 嗯正如你可能注意到的，你现在可以改变花冠上花的颜色！

english: Turns out the spell we cast was more powerful than we first thought.
translation: 结果我们施的法术比我们最初想的更强大。

english: So powerful that it made eight new colourations, all as beautiful as the first!
translation: 如此强大以至于它创造了八种新颜色，都和第一种一样美丽！

english: That's amazing! And all because we wanted a little splash of colour.
translation: 太棒了！都因为我们想要一点色彩。

english: Don't underestimate the power of a little splash of colour!
translation: 别低估一点色彩的力量！

english: I'll make sure not too!
translation: 我保证不会！

english: Anything happening around here?
translation: 这附近有什么事发生吗？

english: Lots of things! It's been pretty busy. There was even a huge colourful parade with thousands of people, and they chose this meadow as the starting place!
translation: 很多事！一直很忙。甚至有一个数千人的巨大彩色游行，他们选择这片草地作为起点！

english: I know, I was there!
translation: 我知道，我在那！

english: You were? I didn't see you!
translation: 你在？我没看到你！

english: It was super crowded. I was the one in the colourful outfit.
translation: 超级拥挤。我是那个穿彩色服装的。

english: The one in the colourful outfit...?
translation: 那个穿彩色服装的……？

english: Ah, yes, like everybody else. I forgot, we were all in colourful outfits!
translation: 啊，是的，像其他人一样。我忘了，我们都穿着彩色服装！

english: Yes! Did you have a good time?
translation: 是的！你玩得开心吗？

english: I did thank you. It was really nice to see so many adventurers coming together to bring a splash of colour to Gielinor.
translation: 我确实，谢谢你。看到这么多冒险者聚在一起为基利诺尔带来一点色彩真好。

english: It truly was, and so many flower crowns too! I was a bit worried the large pile I'd made of them would go to waste, but in the end I almost ran out!
translation: 确实是，还有那么多花冠！我有点担心我做的那大堆会浪费，但最后我几乎用完了！

english: Really? That's cool! What made it colourful?
translation: 真的？那真酷！什么让它多彩？

english: Everyone turned up in colourful outfits, it was like a sea of rainbows.
translation: 每个人都穿着彩色服装出现，就像一片彩虹海。

english: So many flower crowns too! I was a bit worried the large pile I'd made of them would go to waste, but in the end I almost ran out!
translation: 还有那么多花冠！我有点担心我做的那大堆会浪费，但最后我几乎用完了！

english: Sounds like a nice problem to have! Will you be making more for the next parade they do?
translation: 听起来像是个好的烦恼！你会为他们的下一次游行做更多吗？

english: The next parade?
translation: 下一次游行？

english: Yes, I'm sure they'll do another one. If so many people turned up, it must have been a great success. Why wouldn't they want to do it again?
translation: 是的，我肯定他们会再做一次。如果这么多人出现，那一定是个巨大的成功。他们为什么不想再做一次？

english: That is a good point. I'll get to making some more right away.
translation: 那是个好观点。我马上开始做更多。

english: Maybe it'll become a yearly thing. A chance to show off some colour, and of course your fancy flower crowns, to all of Gielinor!
translation: 也许它会成为一年一度的事。一个向整个基利诺尔展示一些色彩，当然还有你花哨的花冠的机会！

english: Sounds good to me, gives me time to get lots made in advance.
translation: 听起来不错，给我时间提前做很多。

english: Right, well I clearly have work to be getting on with. See you soon!
translation: 好吧，显然我有工作要做。回头见！

english: See you!
translation: 回头见！

english: How’s the Glade coming along?
translation: 林地进展如何？

english: We are currently scouting locations for it. I have a good idea of the kind of place I’m looking for, and I hope we can find it soon. I’ll let you know if we need your help.
translation: 我们目前正在为它勘察地点。我对我要找的地方有个好主意，希望我们能很快找到。如果需要你的帮助我会告诉你。

english: Do you have any rainbow items I can claim?
translation: 你有什么彩虹物品我可以领取吗？

english: Absolutely! I have a cape, shirt, jumper, flower crown and scarf for you. Which would you like?
translation: 当然！我有斗篷、衬衫、毛衣、花冠和围巾给你。你想要哪个？

english: You should have all of the old rainbow items now!
translation: 你现在应该有所有旧的彩虹物品了！

english: Oh, you appear to already have one of those.
translation: 哦，你似乎已经有一个那些了。

english: The meadow is looking lovely!
translation: 草地看起来很美！

english: Can I have a flower crown?
translation: 能给我个花冠吗？

english: Sounds very colourful!
translation: 听起来很多彩！

english: Anything happening around here?
translation: 这附近有什么事发生吗？

english: I know, I was there!
translation: 我知道，我在那！

english: Really? That is cool!
translation: 真的？那真酷！

english: How’s the Glade coming along?
translation: 林地进展如何？

english: Do you have any rainbow items I can claim?
translation: 你有什么彩虹物品我可以领取吗？

english: All of them
translation: 所有的

translation: 斗篷

english: Shirt
translation: 衬衫

translation: 毛衣

translation: 更多

translation: 上一个

translation: 谢谢，希望你喜欢你的礼物。不过我现在得走了。

english: Sorry, that's just not the right answer!
translation: 抱歉，那只是不对的答案！

english: I must be leaving now.
translation: 我现在得走了。

english: Sorry, but I'm trying to talk to [other player's display name], but [he/she] seems to be ignoring me.
translation: 抱歉，但我正试图跟 [other player's display name] 说话，但 [he/she] 似乎在无视我。

english: Greetings [player name], I need your help.
translation: 问候 [player name]，我需要你的帮助。

english: Talk to me, [player name]!
translation: 跟我说话，[player name]！

english: Hello, [player name], are you there?
translation: 你好，[player name]，你在那吗？

english: I'd like to talk to you, [player name]!
translation: 我想跟你说话，[player name]！

english: ehem... Hello [player name], please talk to me!
translation: 呃……你好 [player name]，请跟我说话！

english: Maybe later.
translation: 也许以后吧。

english: Hello, I'm Gillie the Milkmaid. What can I do for you?
translation: 你好，我是挤奶女工吉莉。有什么能帮你的？

english: My name is Gillie Groats. My father is a farmer and I milk the cows for him.
translation: 我叫吉莉‧格罗茨。我父亲是农夫，我替他挤奶。

english: Do you have any buckets of milk spare?
translation: 你有备用的桶装牛奶吗？

english: I'm afraid not. We need all of our milk to sell to market, but you can milk the cow yourself if you need the milk.
translation: 恐怕没有。我们需要所有的牛奶卖给市场，但如果你需要牛奶，你可以自己挤奶。

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

english: So how do you get milk from a cow then?
translation: 那要怎么从奶牛身上取奶呢？

english: It's very easy. First you need an empty bucket to hold the milk.
translation: 很简单。首先你需要一个空桶来装牛奶。

english: Then find a dairy cow to milk - you can't milk just any cow.
translation: 然后找头奶牛挤奶——可不是随便哪头牛都能挤的。

english: How do I find a dairy cow?
translation: 我怎么找奶牛？

english: They are easy to spot - they are dark brown and white, unlike beef cows, which are light brown and white. We also tether them to a post to stop them wandering around all over the place.
translation: 它们很好认——深棕配白色，跟浅棕配白色的肉牛不一样。我们还会把它们拴在柱子上，省得它们到处乱跑。

english: There are a couple very near, in this field.
translation: 有几头离得很近，在这片田里。

english: Then just milk the cow and your bucket will fill with tasty, nutritious milk.
translation: 然后只要挤奶，你的桶就会装满美味营养的牛奶。

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

english: Tee hee! You've never milked a cow before, have you?
translation: 嘻嘻！你以前从未挤过奶，对吧？

english: Erm... No. How could you tell?
translation: 呃……不。你怎么知道的？

english: Because you're spilling milk all over the floor. What a waste! You need something to hold the milk.
translation: 因为你把牛奶洒得满地都是。真浪费！你需要东西装牛奶。

english: Ah yes, I really should have guessed that one, shouldn't I?
translation: 啊是的，我真该猜到那个，对吧？

english: You're from the city, aren't you... Try it again with an empty bucket.
translation: 你是城里人吧……拿个空桶再试试。

english: Right, I'll do that.
translation: 好的，我会那样做。

english: I should probably go somewhere that Gillie might actually see me.
translation: 我大概应该去吉莉实际能看到我的地方。

english: You hang the amulet on one of your branches and wait for Gillie to notice you...
translation: 你把护符挂在你的一根树枝上，等吉莉注意到你……

english: Oh my! That Christmas tree certainly did grow quickly.
translation: 哦天！那棵圣诞树确实长得很快。

english: And that necklace hanging on it! Is that...
translation: 还有挂在上面的项链！那是……

english: Gillie gleefully takes the amulet off of the branch and hangs it around her own neck as a clone of her appears before your very eyes.
translation: 吉莉高兴地取下树枝上的护符，挂在自己脖子上，同时她的一个克隆体出现在你眼前。

english: Hey... You look just like me!
translation: 嘿……你看起来跟我一样！

english: You are me! This is perfect!
translation: 你就是我！这太完美了！

english: Well, Gillie seems happy with that!
translation: 嗯，看来吉莉挺满意的！

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Can you tell me how to milk a cow?
translation: 你能告诉我怎么挤奶吗？

english: Player: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 玩家：我没事，谢谢。

english: Have ye come for an outfit like mine? Or else whatcha want?
translation: 你是来要像我这样的装扮吗？否则你想要什麼？

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Don't ye recognise the greatest angler in all the land? Never mind Grandpa Jack an' Big Dave, or that jack-of-all-trades Mac - I'm Gita Prymes!
translation: 你不认识全陆地最伟大的垂钓者吗？别管杰克爷爷和大戴夫，或者那个万事通麦克——我是吉塔‧普莱姆斯！

english: Have you won the Hemenster Fishing Competition?
translation: 你赢了赫门斯特钓鱼比赛吗？

english: Um...
Keep yer triflin' talk of poxy contests - Gita Prymes has bigger fish to catch! And I am Gita Prymes.
translation: 别提那些该死比赛的废话——吉塔‧普莱姆斯有更大的鱼要钓！我是吉塔‧普莱姆斯。

english: Okay, you're Gita Prymes.
translation: 好吧，你是吉塔‧普莱姆斯。

english: That I be! Now, are ye here for an outfit like mine?
translation: 我就是！现在，你是来要像我这样的装扮吗？

english: Let's talk about outfits.
translation: 我们聊聊装扮的事。

english: Aye. See, a lot of anglers wear ugly green stuff. It 'elps them wi' the fishing, to be sure, but they look so rotten in it. So Gita Prymes invented something better- looking.
translation: 是的。看，很多垂钓者穿难看的绿色东西。确实有助于钓鱼，但他们穿起来看起来太烂了。所以吉塔‧普莱姆斯发明了更好看的。

english: It'll cost ye some spirit flakes but Gita Prymes can change yer Spirit Angler back to normal Angler for free if ye want it. Which ever suits ye.
translation: 这得花你一些灵魂碎片，不过要是你想，吉塔‧普莱姆斯可以免费把你的海灵垂钓者套装变回普通的垂钓者套装。哪个适合你。

english: Can you turn my Angler outfit into the Spirit Angler outfit?
translation: 你能把我的垂钓者套装换成海灵垂钓者套装吗？

english: Sure, hand me a piece of the regular Angler kit. I'll want 1,200 spirit flakes for a hat, the top for 1,200 spirit flakes, the leggings for 1,200 spirit flakes and the footwear for 1,200 spirit flakes.
translation: 当然，给我一件普通垂钓者装备。我要1,200个灵魂碎片换帽子，上衣1,200个灵魂碎片，护腿1,200个灵魂碎片，鞋子1,200个灵魂碎片。

english: Actually, I don't have any Angler kit on me at the moment, sorry.
translation: 其实，我目前身上没有任何垂钓者装备，抱歉。

english: Can you turn my Spirit Angler outfit back into the regular Angler outfit?
translation: 你能把我的海灵垂钓者装扮变回普通垂钓者装扮吗？

english: Sure, hand me a piece of the Spirit Angler kit an' I'll convert it back for free.
translation: 当然，给我一件海灵垂钓者装备，我会免费把它变回来。

english: Actually, I don't have any Spirit Angler kit on me at the moment, sorry.
translation: 其实，我目前身上没有任何海灵垂钓者装备，抱歉。

english: Gita Prymes can exchange your Spirit Angler kit for regular Angler kit, but will not return your spirit flakes. You can convert it back to the Spirit Angler version for free.
translation: 吉塔‧普莱姆斯可以用你的海灵垂钓者装备交换普通垂钓者装备，但不会退还你的灵魂碎片。你可以免费把它变回海灵垂钓者版本。

english: I don't think I need anything from you.
translation: 我想我不需要从你这要什么。

english: Nay, Gita Prymes won't take that.
translation: 不，吉塔‧普莱姆斯不会收那个。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Have you won the Hemenster Fishing Competition?
translation: 你赢了赫门斯特钓鱼比赛吗？

english: Okay, you're Gita Prymes.
translation: 好吧，你是吉塔‧普莱姆斯。

english: Let's talk about outfits.
translation: 我们聊聊装扮的事。

english: Ask about the Spirit Angler outfit.
translation: 询问海灵垂钓者装扮。

english: Cancel
translation: 取消

english: Proceed
translation: 继续

english: Ask about the regular Angler outfit.
translation: 询问普通垂钓者装扮。

english: I don't think I need anything from you.
translation: 我想我不需要从你这要什么。

english: Hi.
translation: 嗨。

english: What brings you down here, [Colosseum rank]?
translation: 什么风把你吹到这下面，[Colosseum rank]？

english: I heard all the grunting and metal clanging. I wanted to see what was going on.
translation: 我听到所有的咕哝声和金属撞击声。我想看看发生了什么。

english: What do you think of our training area?
translation: 你觉得我们的训练区怎么样？

english: Well... It smells a bit.
translation: 嗯……有点味。

english: That is the smell of courage.
translation: 那是勇气的味道。

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Greetings, [Colosseum rank].
translation: 你好，[Colosseum rank]。

english: You lot sure look busy down here.
translation: 你们在这下面肯定很忙。

english: We strive to become the best.
translation: 我们努力成为最好的。

english: Well best of luck!
translation: 祝你好运！

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Hello, [Colosseum rank]. You'll have to excuse me. I'm keeping an eye on the other contenders.
translation: 你好，[Colosseum rank]。你得原谅我。我在盯着其他竞争者。

english: May the odds be ever in your favour.
translation: 愿好运常伴你左右。

english: What a nice thing to say.
translation: 这话听着真舒服。

english: You're not tired of doing that all day?
translation: 你整天做那个不累吗？

english: I'm going to slay anything in my path!
translation: 挡我路的，我见一个杀一个！

english: You certainly are determined!
translation: 你这决心可真够大的！

english: Hi there.
translation: 你好。

english: Stand back, [Colosseum rank]. I need to concentrate.
translation: 退后，[Colosseum rank]。我需要集中注意力。

english: You seemed to have that weapon mastered.
translation: 你似乎已经掌握了那武器。

english: Kill...
No...
... survivors!
translation: ……幸存者！

english: That's impressive. I'll leave you to it.
translation: 那令人印象深刻。我不打扰你了。

english: Can't talk... I've got 100 more to do.
translation: 不能说话……我还有100个要做。

english: Good luck.
translation: 祝你好运。

english: Hel-
translation: 嘿 -

english: Can't you see I'm busy here?
translation: 你没看到我很忙吗？

english: Of course... Enjoy your floor pushing.
translation: 行吧……你慢慢推地板玩。

english: Well met stranger, how do you come to be in this place?
translation: 幸会陌生人，你怎么来到这个地方的？

english: I'm a friend of the Easter Bunny, I've been looking for him.
translation: 我是复活节兔子的朋友，我一直在找他。

english: Is that so? Well that makes you my friend too. Me and Rinder here helped that crazy priest track him down.
translation: 是吗？那你也成了我的朋友。我和这里的林德帮那个疯狂牧师追踪到他。

english: That we did.
translation: 我们确实做了。

english: I see, that was good of you.
translation: 我明白了，你们真好。

english: I won't lie, it was no selfless act. We've been promised grand rewards.
translation: 实话实说，我们可不是无私奉献。人家可是许诺了丰厚报酬的。

english: Eggs! Big chocolate eggs!
translation: 蛋！大巧克力蛋！

english: It always comes down to eggs!
translation: 总是归结到蛋！

english: I'd like to make some Easter Buns, I don't suppose you have any raisins?
translation: 我想做些复活节小面包，我想你没有葡萄干吧？

english: And why would you think a man like me would have any raisins?
translation: 你为什么认为像我这样的人会有葡萄干？

english: I'm not sure, I don't actually know what raisins are to be honest.
translation: 我不确定，老实说我其实不知道葡萄干是什么。

english: Well I'll be! Kid, raisins are dried-up grapes.
translation: 嗯我会是！孩子，葡萄干是晒干的葡萄。

english: Oh, well do you have any of those?
translation: 哦，那你有吗？

english: Not yet.
translation: 还没有。

english: Not yet?
translation: 还没有？

english: That's what I said.
translation: 我就是那么说的。

english: As it happens I have a sackful of grapes in my possession.
translation: 碰巧我有一袋葡萄。

english: How convenient, dare I ask why?
translation: 真方便，敢问为什么？

english: There are great and terrible beasts in this world kid. We'd been hunting them, and believe me when I tell ye, some of 'em had an awful lot of grapes on their person.
translation: 这世上有些厉害又吓人的怪物，孩子。我们猎杀它们的时候，信我一句，有些家伙身上居然揣着好多葡萄。

english: The slaughter was feverish. We'd cut 'em down and they'd rise up, again and again.
translation: 那场面杀得可激烈了，我们砍倒它们，它们又爬起来，一遍又一遍。

english: Before we knew it, we'd collected a whole sackful o' grapes!
translation: 在我们知道之前，我们收集了整整一袋葡萄！

english: Seems to me we could make those into raisins, should that align with your intentions.
translation: 在我看来我们可以把它们做成葡萄干，要是这正合你意的话。

english: What luck! Shall we then?
translation: 真幸运！那我们开始吗？

english: Well alright, it'll be a long journey though.
translation: 嗯好吧，不过那是段长旅程。

english: Rinder!
translation: 林德！

english: What say ye, Glanton?
translation: 你怎么说，格拉顿？

english: Our friend here needs some raisins, let's head to the desert!
translation: 我们这里的朋友需要些葡萄干，我们去沙漠！

english: Pack yer grapes, then. Let's go.
translation: 打包你的葡萄，然后。走吧。

english: Cutscene starts: "After a long walk, you reach the desert."
translation: 过场动画开始：“经过漫长的行走，你到达了沙漠。”

english: Here we are.
translation: 到了。

english: Here? This big rock?
translation: 这里？这块大石头？

english: This big rock is perfect fer makin' raisins, kid. It's real warm.
translation: 这块大石头非常适合做葡萄干，孩子。它很暖和。

english: It's as he says kid, real warm.
translation: 就像他说的孩子，真暖和。

english: We'll leave the grapes here in good clean heat, give 'em time to think about their transgressions.
translation: 我们把葡萄留在这里干净的热量中，给它们时间思考它们的罪过。

english: I don't remember this rock being here before.
translation: 我记得这块石头以前不在这里啊。

english: This rock was always here, before man was, even.
translation: 这块石头一直在这里，甚至在人类之前。

english: That you ain't noticed it speaks to yer purview of the world.
translation: 你居然没注意到，可见你对这世界的了解有多有限了。

english: I'm almost certain this is new.
translation: 我敢肯定这是新出现的。

english: Perhaps more things in this world exist without yer knowledge than with it. Did ye consider that?
translation: 也许这个世界上存在的东西你不知道的比你知道的多。你考虑过那个吗？

english: Well no, it's just a rock.
translation: 嗯不，它只是块石头。

english: Alright alright already! Let's get these grapes going.
translation: 好吧好吧已经！让我们让这些葡萄开始。

english: We'd best I suppose. Lay them down and see to their transformation.
translation: 我想我们最好。放下它们，看着它们转变。

english: Hmm, let's see...
translation: 嗯，让我看看……

english: I judge these grapes to be...
translation: 依我看，这些葡萄……

english: ...Plump and juicy! But not fer long!
translation: ……饱满多汁！但不会太久！

english: We'll see them desiccated soon enough.
translation: 我们很快就会看到它们脱水。

english: It is their destiny. A curse on these grapes!
translation: 这是它们的命运。诅咒这些葡萄！

english: [player name], You've gotta make the grapes feel bad or they won't shrivel up.
translation: [player name]，你得让葡萄心里难受，不然它们可不会蔫下去。

english: Oh I see, um, curse those grapes! Suffer you foolish berries! Ha!
translation: 哦我明白了，嗯，诅咒那些葡萄！受苦吧你们愚蠢的浆果！哈！

english: Now yer gettin' it!
translation: 现在你懂了！

english: Insufferable fruits! Rank orbs of low repute!
translation: 可恶的水果！声名狼藉的破果子！

english: You tell 'em what for!
translation: 你告诉它们算什么！

english: Cutscene: "A long while later..."
translation: 过场动画：“很久以后……''

english: Well look at these! Perfect!
translation: 嗯看看这些！完美！

english: They're a fine example of raisins I'll say.
translation: 我要说它们是葡萄干的好例子。

english: Great! let's get back to the Rabbit Hole then.
translation: 太好了！那我们回兔子洞。

english: Player is returned to the Rabbit Hole
translation: 玩家被送回兔子洞

english: Well that was interesting.
translation: 嗯那真有趣。

english: Yes it was, come back when ye have some space and I'll give ye yer share of raisins.
translation: 是的确实是，等你有空间时回来，我会给你那份葡萄干。

english: Yes it was. Here's some raisins for yer troubles.
translation: 是的确实是。这是些葡萄干给你的麻烦。

english: Thank you!
translation: 谢谢！

english: Can I have some raisins please?
translation: 能给我些葡萄干吗？

english: I think ye have enough raisins at the moment.
translation: 我看你现在的葡萄干应该够用了。

english: Make some space for them and ye can have some more.
translation: 腾出点空间给它们，你就能多拿些。

english: Of course, we've plenty to spare after that trip.
translation: 当然，那次旅程后我们有很多富余。

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！

english: Thanks for taking me to make raisins.
translation: 谢谢带我去做葡萄干。

english: I was plenty happy to educate ye.
translation: 我很乐意教你。

english: I used those raisins to make some Easter Buns, and the Easter Bunny really enjoyed them!
translation: 我用那些葡萄干做了些复活节小面包，复活节兔子非常喜欢！

english: Well that's great, kid.
translation: 嗯那太好了，孩子。

english: Thanks again for the help.
translation: 再次多谢你的帮忙。

english: Any time. You owe me one.
translation: 随时客气。你欠我一个人情。

english: Oh, I uh, suppose I do.
translation: 哦，我呃，我想也是。

english: It won't catch on, Glanton.
translation: 那不会流行的，格拉顿。

english: Ah don't be like that Rinder, how will we know till we try?
translation: 啊别那样林德，不试试怎么知道？

english: Alright gents, what's going on here then?
translation: 好吧先生们，这里发生什么了？

english: I've had this great idea see.
translation: 我有个好主意你看。

english: Does it have anything to do with long walks in the desert again?
translation: 跟再次在沙漠长途跋涉有关系吗？

english: Well y'see thats the beauty of it.
translation: 嗯你看那是它的妙处。

english: It's a lot easier to melt chocolate than dry out grapes.
translation: 融化巧克力比晒干葡萄容易多了。

english: Chocolate? You've piqued my interest!
translation: 巧克力？你引起我的兴趣了！

english: Exactly! See Rinder, [player name] doesn't even know half the idea yet and wants in!
translation: 没错！看林德，[player name] 甚至还不知道一半主意就想加入！

english: It still seems terribly messy.
translation: 看起来还是很乱。

english: Okay so, what we do is use our connections with the Easter Bunny to acquire a lot of chocolate.
translation: 好吧所以，我们利用跟复活节兔子的关系弄到很多巧克力。

english: And give it to me for my outstanding contributions to the preservation of Easter?
translation: 然后因为我对保护复活节的杰出贡献而送给我？

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: And we melt it all up, and put it in a fountain.
translation: 然后我们把它全融化，放进喷泉里。

english: And then I get to have it all?
translation: 然后我就能全喝了？

english: No then we sell people the right to take a couple of small fruits to dip in the fountain and eat!
translation: 不然后我们卖给人们权利，拿几个小水果蘸喷泉吃！

english: That sounds delicious!
translation: 听起来好吃！

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: But I can get some for free?
translation: 但我能免费拿些？

english: See the amount people would pay for just a taste of chocolate is so much higher than we'd have to pay to source a lot of the stuff.
translation: 你看，人们愿意只为尝一口巧克力付的钱，远高于我们采购大量巧克力的成本。

english: Well, I'm not interested if I have to pay.
translation: 嗯，如果要付钱我就没兴趣了。

english: I saved Easter...
translation: 我救了复活节……

english: ... Again!
translation: ……又一次！

english: I think I'll go see if the Easter Bunny has some more eggs for me...
translation: 我想我去看看复活节兔子有没有更多蛋给我……

english: Be seeing you!
translation: 回见！

english: Here, look at my lovely gems.
translation: 来，看看我可爱的宝石。

english: Hey! Get your hands off there!
translation: 嘿！把手拿开！

english: You're the one who stole something from me!
translation: 你就是偷我东西的人！

english: Guards guards!
translation: 守卫！守卫！

english: Glod smash!
translation: 格洛德砸碎一切！

english: Glod bash!
translation: 格洛德猛撞！

english: Grind your bones!
translation: 磨碎你的骨头！

english: Stupid clouds make Glod angry!
translation: 愚蠢的云让格洛德生气！

english: You wouldn't like Glod when Glod angry!
translation: 格洛德生气时你不会喜欢格洛德！

english: Why everyone attack Glod?
translation: 为什么大家攻击格洛德？

english: Gods, give Glod strength!
translation: 神啊，给格洛德力量！

english: Glod appears to have more Strength and Attack power than before!
translation: 格洛德的力量和攻击好像比之前更强了！

english: Glod not die so easily!
translation: 格洛德不会那么容易死！

english: Glod heals himself slightly.
translation: 格洛德稍微恢复了一点。

english: GLOD SMASH!
translation: 格洛德砸碎一切！

english: Your prayer is drained by Glod's attack!
translation: 你的祈祷值被格洛德的攻击吸干了！

english: Flee, pesky mortal!
translation: 快滚，讨厌的凡人！

english: At Glod's cry you are forced to run away!
translation: 在格洛德的吼叫声中你被迫逃跑！

english: You puny human. Come to Glod!
translation: 你这渺小的人类。来找格洛德！

english: You are enraged by Glod's taunts and forced to charge towards him to fight!
translation: 你被格洛德的嘲讽激怒，被迫冲向他战斗！

english: Hi.
translation: 嗨。

english: You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 你知道吗，跟人打招呼的方式可多了。你好、嘿、你好啊……

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: 那仍然只算一种！

english: Hello. How are you today?
translation: 你好。你今天怎么样？

english: I'm great, thank you!
translation: 我很好，谢谢！

english: Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 你好！水晶城今天天气真好，哈？

english: Indeed.
translation: 确实。

english: What can I do for ya?
translation: 我能为你做什么？

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这里有什么可以做的？

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 可做的事可多了！塔楼就是绝妙景致。

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 像今天这样的好日子，我建议去市场逛逛。

english: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你以为你在做什么？

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这里有什么可以做的？

english: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: Hello there, [rank].
translation: 你好，[rank]。

english: I've not seen you round these parts before.
translation: 我以前没在这附近见过你。

english: Well I'm still fairly new here.
translation: 嗯我在这还挺新的。

english: [Rank]?
translation: [Rank]？

english: You heard correct.
translation: 你听对了。

english: The name's Gloria. Nice to meet you.
translation: 我叫格洛丽亚。很高兴认识你。

english: You too. I'm [player name]. What are you doing hanging round the Colosseum?
translation: 你也是。我是 [player name]。你在竞技场周围做什么？

english: I've become quite fond of keeping an eye on the contenders and sharing news of their progress to those around the city.
translation: 我变得很喜欢盯着竞争者，并把他们的进展消息分享给城里的人。

english: You see, inside the Colosseum you'll earn what's called Glory.
translation: 你看，在竞技场里你会赚取所谓的荣耀。

english: What's Glory?
translation: 什么是荣耀？

english: Glory will improve your status and reputation around the city. You might even get some rewards.
translation: 荣耀会提升你在城里的地位和声誉。你甚至可能得到些奖励。

english: How does Glory work?
translation: 荣耀系统具体是怎么运作的？

english: It's simple really, you get Glory from participating in the Colosseum! You'll get more Glory the better you perform.
translation: 其实很简单，你通过参加竞技场获得荣耀！你表现越好，获得越多荣耀。

english: Performance is measured by a few things. For example, how many hits you take or how quickly you complete the challenges.
translation: 表现由几件事衡量。例如，你受多少次击或多快完成挑战。

english: Sounds good to me. Have you earned any Glory yourself?
translation: 听起来不错。你自己赚过荣耀吗？

english: Ha! No. But I do have this fancy armour which is pretty glorious! You may be lucky enough to get some of your own from within the Colosseum.
translation: 哈！不。但我确实有这套华丽的盔甲，相当荣耀！你可能幸运到在竞技场里得到些你自己的。

english: Tell me more about these rewards.
translation: 多告诉我些关于这些奖励的事。

english: But of course! People all accross Varlamore will hear of your Glory.
translation: 当然！瓦拉莫尔各地的人都会听到你的荣耀。

english: You'll get a range of benefits depending on your status.
translation: 根据你的地位，你会得到一系列好处。

english: How do I improve my status?
translation: 我怎么提升地位？

english: Earn more Glory of course. The more you earn, the better your standing in the city.
translation: 当然赚更多荣耀。你赚得越多，你在城里的地位越好。

english: You can check your status on that board over there. I keep it up to date.
translation: 你可以在那边那个板上查你的地位。我保持它最新。

english: What exactly are the benefits?
translation: 具体有什么好处？

english: Well...
Reaching Brawler status will give you access to the bank within the Colosseum.
translation: 达到斗士地位会让你访问竞技场内的银行。

english: Reaching Challenger status will allow you to respawn in Civitas illa Fortis if you so desire.
translation: 达到挑战者地位将允许你按需选择在福蒂斯城复活。

english: Reaching Gladiator status might persuade some of the more shady folk around the city to give you more money for... Let's just say illicit valuables.
translation: 达到角斗士地位可能会说服城里一些更阴暗的人给你更多钱买……就说非法贵重物品吧。

english: Reaching Hero status will allow you to travel to the Colosseum via the Ring of Dueling.
translation: 达到英雄级别后，你即可通过决斗之戒传送至竞技场。

english: Reaching Champion status will grant you free herb patch protection just west of the city.
translation: 达到冠军级别后，你将免费获得城市以西的草药种植地守护权限。

english: And reaching Grand Champion status will unlock you the Fortis Salute emote.
translation: 达到大宗师级别后，将为你解锁福蒂斯致敬表情动作。

english: Do you know how much Glory I need for each status?
translation: 你知道每个级别需要多少荣耀值吗？

english: You'll have to figure that out on your journey to becoming a Grand Champion.
translation: 你得在通往大宗师的旅途中自己摸索了。

english: Fair enough.
translation: 好吧。

english: Do you know my Glory status?
translation: 你知道我当前的荣耀等级吗？

english: That I do, [player name].
translation: 我知道，[player name]。

english: It seems as though you are still a Rookie to the people of Fortis.
translation: 看来在福蒂斯人眼中，你还是个新人。

english: You'll make a name of yourself in no time, [player name].
translation: 你很快就会成名，[player name]。

english: I'll do my very best.
translation: 我会尽全力。

english: You are a Brawler!
translation: 你是个斗士！

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！

english: You are a Challenger!
translation: 你是个挑战者！

english: You are a Gladiator!
translation: 你是个角斗士！

english: You are a Hero!
translation: 你是个英雄！

english: You are a Champion!
translation: 你是个冠军！

english: You are a Grand Champion!
translation: 你是个大宗师！

english: You can check that board over there to see any details of your Glory. I try to update it regularly.
translation: 你可以去看看那边的布告板了解你的荣耀值详情。我会尽量定期更新上面的内容。

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: I see you've been trying to conquer the Colosseum, eh?
translation: 我看你一直试图征服竞技场，嗯？

english: I have indeed, and I will become a champion!
translation: 我确实，我会成为冠军！

english: That's it, positive thoughts.
translation: 就这样，积极思考。

english: I was watching when you became Grand Champion of the Colosseum. It was truly something to behold.
translation: 你成为竞技场大宗师时我在看。那真是值得一看。

english: What brings you over to me today?
translation: 今天什么风把你吹到我这里了？

english: I was wondering if we could talk about Glory?
translation: 我想问问关于荣耀值的事，可以吗？

english: But of course. What do you wish to know?
translation: 当然。你想了解什么？

english: Can you change my respawn point?
translation: 你能改变我的复活点吗？

english: What would you like changing about it?
translation: 你想怎么改？

english: Do you think you could change my respawn point to Civitas illa Fortis?
translation: 你觉得能把我的复活点改到福蒂斯城吗？
