translation: 拔剑吧战士，和我们一起战斗。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Death to Khazard, and all who serve him.
translation: 卡扎德必死，所有效忠他的人也一样。

english: I can't talk now, can't you see we're trying to win a battle here.
translation: 我现在没空说话，没看见我们正在这儿拼命打仗吗。

english: You won't take us without a fight!
translation: 你们休想不战而胜！

english: Get out of our lands!
translation: 滚出我们的土地！

english: Tally ho!
translation: 塔利霍！

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Hello adventurer, here's some wise words.
translation: 你好冒险者，这是些智慧之言。

english: OK.
translation: 好的。

english: Happiness is inward and not outward. So it does not depend on what we have but on what we are!
translation: 幸福是向内求，而非向外寻。所以它不取决于我们拥有什么，而取决于我们是什么样的人！

english: Some people grumble because roses have thorns. I'm thankful that thorns have roses!
translation: 有人因为玫瑰长刺而抱怨。我却感激荆棘之中竟能长出玫瑰！

english: Good attitude!
translation: 好态度！

english: Well good day to you. Are you new to these parts?
translation: 嗯你好。你是这附近的新人吗？

english: Kind of.
translation: 算是吧。

english: Well if you're looking for a good night out: Blurberry's cocktail bar is great!
translation: 如果你想找地方放松一下：布鲁贝瑞的鸡尾酒酒吧绝对是个好去处！

english: Hi. I've never seen so many humans in my life.
translation: 嗨。我这辈子没见过这么多人类。

english: I've never seen so many gnomes!
translation: 我从没见过这么多地精！

english: So we're both learning.
translation: 所以我们都在学习。

english: How are you?
translation: 你好吗？

english: Not bad, a little worn out.
translation: 不错，有点累。

english: Maybe you should have a lie down.
translation: 也许你应该躺会儿。

english: With three kids to feed I've no time for naps!
translation: 要养三个孩子我没时间打盹！

english: Sounds like hard work!
translation: 听起来很辛苦！

english: It is but they're worth it.
translation: 是但他们值得。

english: Hello traveller. Are you eating properly? You look tired.
translation: 你好旅行者。你吃得好吗？你看起来累了。

english: I think so.
translation: 我想是的。

english: Here get this worm down you. It'll do you the world of good.
translation: 来把这个虫子吃下去。对你大有好处。

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！

english: Hello! Don't get in the way around here, we've got a lot of work to do!
translation: 你好！别在这碍事，我们有很多工作要做！

english: Hello there, what are you working on?
translation: 你好，你在做什么工作？

english: Well, it's quite exciting... we're extending the glider network to include the Feldip Hills so that people can come and look at these curious ogres.
translation: 嗯，相当令人兴奋……我们正在扩展滑翔机网络包括费迪普丘陵，这样人们可以来看这些奇怪的食人魔。

english: They are impressive creatures aren't they - quite mystified they are by the technology we gnomes have invented.
translation: 它们是令人印象深刻的生物对吧——它们对我们地精发明的技术很迷惑。

english: What are you working on?
translation: 你在做什么工作？

english: Well, people will be able to visit this area, once construction has finished, by using the most advanced network of glider routes in the whole of Gielinor... in fact, the only network of glider routes!
translation: 嗯，一旦建设完成，人们将能够通过整个基利诺尔最先进的滑翔机路线网络访问这个区域……事实上，唯一的滑翔机路线网络！

english: Is there anything I can do?
translation: 有什么我能做的吗？

english: Not really, I'm afraid, it's probably all far too technical for someone like you.
translation: 恐怕没有，这可能对你这样的人来说都太技术化了。

english: Okay, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Hello, how's the work going?
translation: 你好，工作进展如何？

english: Getting there now, thanks to your help!
translation: 现在进展顺利，多亏你的帮助！

english: Can I take a flight in the glider?
translation: 我能坐滑翔机飞吗？

english: Sure, go ahead.
translation: 当然，去吧。

english: Have a nice day.
translation: 祝你愉快。

english: You too, human.
translation: 你也是，人类。

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 虽然你找到了顾客，但你似乎没带正确的食物！你需要 [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]！

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 恐怕预制菜肴不合要求。唯有手工烹制的地精美食，才配得上阿卢夫航空的顾客。

english: You hand over your delivery of [item] to Gnormadium Avlafrim
translation: 你把 [item] 的配送交给格诺马迪姆‧阿夫拉弗里姆

english: Oh my! I've had nothing to eat or drink but chompy birds and smelly water for days. Thank you.
translation: 哦天！我好几天除了食人鸟和臭水什么都没吃喝。谢谢。

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: 你一定走了很远的路才把这个送到我这里，这里有点额外的小意思，拿着当小费。

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
translation: 你有 [number] 积分可兑换免费配送代币。你还没资格获得地精美食配送。

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 你有 [number] 积分可兑换免费配送代币。你可以让 [number] 份地精美食配送给你。

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: 别忘了从小阿卢夫‧吉安那里领取免费配送代币。

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 配送已超时！请返回小阿卢夫处重新接单。你丢掉了配送箱，因为不再需要了。

english: Hello there, what are you working on?
translation: 你好，你在做什么工作？

english: What are you working on?
translation: 你在做什么工作？

english: Is there anything I can do?
translation: 有什么我能做的吗？

english: Okay, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Hello, how's the work going?
translation: 你好，工作进展如何？

english: Can I take a flight in the glider?
translation: 我能坐滑翔机飞吗？

english: Have a nice day.
translation: 祝你愉快。

english: Hello. What do you do here?
translation: 你好。你在这里做什么？

english: My name is Gnosi. I am here to assist the Varrock Museum in their research.
translation: 我叫格诺西，来帮维洛克博物馆做研究的。

english: I didn't know the Varrock Museum was familiar with this continent. What research are you conducting?
translation: 我不知道维洛克博物馆熟悉这个大陆。你们在进行什么研究？

english: We're studying the history of the region, origins of the lizardmen and how it all connects to Xeric.
translation: 我们在研究该地区的历史，蜥蜴人的起源，以及这一切如何与泽里克联系起来。

english: We've wanted to study this place for a while, but haven't been able to explore due to lizardmen blocking the way.
translation: 这地方我们早想研究了，可蜥蜴人一直拦着路，没法进去。

english: But now that the Shayzien Army have cleared the path and discovered the Chambers of Xeric in the process, there is much to explore!
translation: 好在谢兹恩军队把路打通了，还顺带发现了泽瑞克密室，这下可有的探索了！

english: Who is Xeric?
translation: 谁是泽里克？

english: Xeric was an incredibly powerful dark mage. He ruled Great Kourend for ten decades.
translation: 泽里克是个极其强大的黑暗法师。他统治大库兰德王国十个十年。

english: If you'd like to find out more you should visit the Historical Archive at the Grand Library.
translation: 想多了解的话，去大图书馆的历史档案室。

english: What are the Chambers of Xeric?
translation: 什么是泽里克圣所？

english: At the summit of this mountain we've found an ancient temple and a vast network of caves that we believe were formed by Xeric and his followers.
translation: 在这座山顶我们发现了一座古老神庙和庞大的洞穴网络，我们相信是由泽里克和他的追随者形成的。

english: The discovery of the Chambers tells us Xeric invested significant time and resources here, yet it was never documented.
translation: 密室的发现告诉我们泽里克在这里投入了大量时间和资源，但从未被记录。

english: While much of Kourend's history under Xeric remains unknown, it is very surprising to discover such a huge area that was previously undiscovered to us.
translation: 虽然泽里克统治下库兰德王国的许多历史仍然未知，但发现这样一个之前未被我们发现的巨大区域是非常令人惊讶的。

english: Can I explore the Chambers?
translation: 我能探索密室吗？

english: Of course, though be careful. The dangers of the Chambers of Xeric are as yet unknown. You should take a strong group of companions with you.
translation: 当然，不过要小心。泽里克圣所的危险尚未知。你应该带一群强壮的同伴。

english: What do you think Xeric used this area for?
translation: 你认为泽里克用这个区域做什么？

english: When he ruled Kourend, we know Xeric performed experiments on the living, using power drawn from the Dark Altar. After he was overthrown, he would have needed a new source of power.
translation: 当他统治库兰德王国时，我们知道泽里克对活物进行实验，使用从黑暗祭坛汲取的力量。被推翻后，他需要新的力量来源。

english: We believe he came here to seek it. Xeric would also have required a source of many creatures for these experiments, and the Chambers certainly contain many of those!
translation: 我们相信他来这寻找它。泽里克也需要许多生物来源进行这些实验，密室肯定包含许多那些！

english: He must have also had some form of teleportation in order to reach the temple unnoticed.
translation: 他肯定也有某种形式的传送才能不被注意地到达神庙。

english: With time and careful study we will uncover these secrets and be able to answer these questions.
translation: 随着时间和仔细研究我们将揭开这些秘密并能够回答这些问题。

english: We believe this altar is that source. It seems to act as an amplifier for the Dark Altar.
translation: 我们相信这个祭坛就是那个来源。它似乎充当黑暗祭坛的放大器。

english: As for what he used the Chambers for, that we still don't know. There's a lot of creatures in the Chambers. Maybe he used them in his experiments.
translation: 至于他用密室做什么，我们仍然不知道。密室里有很多生物。也许他在实验中用了它们。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Hello. How's it going?
translation: 你好。怎么样？

english: The discovery of this cave could change everything. We might finally be able to discover the link between the lizardmen, the Chambers of Xeric and Xeric himself.
translation: 这个洞穴的发现可能改变一切。我们可能最终能够发现蜥蜴人、泽里克圣所和泽里克本人之间的联系。

english: Who is Xeric?
translation: 谁是泽里克？

english: What are the Chambers of Xeric?
translation: 什么是泽里克圣所？

english: Can I explore the Chambers?
translation: 我能探索密室吗？

english: What do you think Xeric used this area for?
translation: 你认为泽里克用这个区域做什么？

english: Goodbye
translation: 再见

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Hey, human.
translation: 嘿，人类。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: My name is Goat Poo. But human not allowed to make big deal of it, 'cos it mean to tease people 'bout silly name.
translation: 我叫山羊屎。但人类不准大惊小怪，因为那意味着取笑人家的傻名字。

english: Why are you called Goat Poo?
translation: 你为什么叫山羊屎？

english: Look, trolls are named after first thing they try to eat, when they little kids. That is troll tradition.
translation: 听着，巨魔以他们小时候尝试吃的第一样东西命名。那是巨魔传统。

english: So the first thing you ate was goat poo?
translation: 所以你吃的第一样东西是山羊屎？

english: It my parents' fault - they should have been paying proper attention an' stopped me. But no, they just named me after it.
translation: 是我父母的错——他们本该好好注意并阻止我。但不，他们就用那个给我命名。

english: Still, it coulda been worse. Could have been called Yellow Snow. He got a really dumb name.
translation: 不过，可能更糟。可能叫黄雪。他有个真蠢的名字。

english: Okay, I won't ask why you're called Goat Poo.
translation: 好的，我不问为什么你叫山羊屎了。

english: Most people do eventually. Over an' over again.
translation: 大多数人最终都会。一遍又一遍。

english: Tell me about this place.
translation: 跟我讲讲这地方。

english: This here is Weiss. Trolls built it years ago, after we got kicked out from caves further south. Now Weiss is our home.
translation: 这里是魏斯聚落。巨魔多年前建的，在我们被从更南边的洞穴踢出来后。现在魏斯聚落是我们的家。

english: We done pretty good here. Got lots of goat and wolf to eat - they taste kinda boring after all this time, but there not much other choice.
translation: 我们在这做得不错。有很多山羊和狼吃——这么久后味道有点无聊，但没太多其他选择。

english: Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it. In fact My Arm is an expert on growing the stuff.
translation: 试过痛风草吗？我认识喜欢它的巨魔。事实上''我的手臂''是种那东西的专家。

english: Never heard of no gouty weed, no. But it sound like a vegetable, an' Mother not like eating those, so we probably not gonna try it.
translation: 没听说过什么痛风草，没。但听起来像蔬菜，而妈妈不喜欢吃那些，所以我们可能不会试。

english: Mother not like new ideas much, but he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: 妈妈不太喜欢新主意，但他真的大，他是老板，所以我们听他的。

english: I see.
translation: 我明白了。

english: Do you like it here?
translation: 你喜欢这里吗？

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it our home. Odd Mushroom say he can make it nicer with fancy fires what he invented, but Mother not interested in that, so Odd Mushroom not allowed to do it.
translation: 呃，是有点糙，但这是俺们的家。奇特蘑菇说他能用自己发明的花哨火炉把这儿弄好点儿，可老妈不感兴趣，所以奇特蘑菇不让弄。

english: Mother only care about stuff to help him fight better. An he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: 妈妈只关心帮他打得更好的东西。而他真的大，他是老板，所以我们听他的。

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我走了。

english: Hey, friend of Snowflake!
translation: 嘿，雪花的朋友！

english: It great here, now Snowflake an' her husband troll taught us goutweed farming. Food so much better now.
translation: 这里很好，现在雪花和她丈夫巨魔教我们痛风草种植。食物现在好多了。

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it getting better. Snowflake, she taught us goutweed farming. Goat, wolf, human all taste so much nicer with goutweed in.
translation: 呃，是有点粗糙。但正在变好。雪花，她教我们痛风草种植。山羊、狼、人类，加了痛风草后味道都好多了。

english: So yeah, Weiss is good place to live, now Snowflake in charge. All trolls like Snowflake. Her husband troll kinda weird, but that not our problem.
translation: 所以啊，魏斯聚落现在真是个好地方，现在雪花管事。所有巨魔都喜欢雪花。她丈夫巨魔有点怪，但那不是我们的问题。

english: You t'ink I want that? It not even from goat!
translation: 你以为我想要那个？它甚至不是来自山羊！

english: Look, human, it were one time. Just once. Let a troll move on, okay?
translation: 听着，人类，就一次。就一次。让巨魔翻篇吧，好吗？

english: Look, human, this not funny. You need goat poo in bucket, go find goat pen!
translation: 听着，人类，这不好笑。你需要桶里的山羊屎，去找羊圈！

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Why are you called Goat Poo?
translation: 你为什么叫山羊屎？

english: Okay, I won't ask why you're called Goat Poo.
translation: 好的，我不问为什么你叫山羊屎了。

english: Tell me about this place.
translation: 跟我讲讲这地方。

english: Ever tried goutweed?
translation: 试过痛风草吗？

english: I see.
translation: 我明白了。

english: Do you like it here?
translation: 你喜欢这里吗？

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我走了。

english: I kill you human!
translation: 我杀了你人类！

english: Go away smelly human!
translation: 走开臭人类！

english: What you doing here?
translation: 你在这干嘛？

english: I'm here to kill all you goblins!
translation: 我来这杀光你们哥布林！

english: I kill you!
translation: 我杀了你！

english: I'm just looking around.
translation: 我只是随便看看。

english: Me not sure that allowed. You have to check with generals.
translation: 俺不确定那允许。你得跟将军们确认。

english: Happy goblin new century!
translation: 哥布林新世纪快乐！

english: Happy new century!
translation: 新世纪快乐！

english: What is the goblin new century?
translation: 什么是哥布林新世纪？

english: Goblin century mark year of big battle on Plain of Mud. That when Big High War God give us commandments.
translation: 哥布林世纪标记泥泞平原大战之年。那是至高战神给我们诫命的时候。

english: Who is the Big High War God?
translation: 谁是至高战神？

english: Big High War God take goblins and make them strong! Without him, we small and weak and stupid. But thanks to Big High War God, we most powerful race in Gielinor!
translation: 至高战神让哥布林变强！没有他，我们又小又弱又笨，但多亏至高战神，我们是基利诺尔最强大的种族！

english: Umm... you're clearly not the most powerful race in Gielinor.
translation: 嗯……你们显然不是基利诺尔最强大的种族。

english: Not to doubt word of Big High War God! I kill you!
translation: 不许怀疑至高战神的话！我杀了你！

english: What are the goblin commandments?
translation: 什么是哥布林诫命？

english: Slay enemies of Big High War God! Not show mercy! Not run from battle! Not doubt word of Big High War God!
translation: 杀至高战神的敌人！不许心软！不许临阵脱逃！不许怀疑至高战神的话！

english: Without commandments we not know right from wrong. We be like other races who not know war is good!
translation: 没有诫命我们不知对错。我们会像其他不知战争好的种族！

english: Where is the Plain of Mud?
translation: 泥泞平原在哪？

english: That goblin secret! No human ever find Plain of Mud!
translation: 那可是哥布林的秘密！人类永远别想找到泥泞平原！

english: I need to go.
translation: 我得走了。

english: Brown armour best!
translation: 棕色盔甲最好！

english: Why is brown best?
translation: 为什么棕色最好？

english: General Wartface and General Bentnoze both say it is. And normally they never agree!
translation: 沃特费斯将军和本特诺兹将军都说是。而且他们通常从不一致！

english: But you're still wearing green armour!
translation: 但你还穿着绿色盔甲！

english: Um... my brown armour getting wash.
translation: 嗯……我的棕色盔甲在洗。

english: But you're still wearing red armour!
translation: 但你还穿着红色盔甲！

english: It not red, it just red-ish brown!
translation: 它不是红色，只是带红色的棕色！

english: Err, okay.
translation: 呃，好的。

english: I'm here to kill all you goblins!
translation: 我来这杀光你们哥布林！

english: I'm just looking around.
translation: 我只是随便看看。

english: Happy new century!
translation: 新世纪快乐！

english: What is the goblin new century?
translation: 什么是哥布林新世纪？

english: Who is the Big High War God?
translation: 谁是至高战神？

english: What are the goblin commandments?
translation: 什么是哥布林诫命？

english: Where is the Plain of Mud?
translation: 泥泞平原在哪？

english: I need to go.
translation: 我得走了。

english: Why is brown best?
translation: 为什么棕色最好？

english: But you're still wearing green!
translation: 但你还穿着绿色！

english: But you're still wearing red!
translation: 但你还穿着红色！

english: Err, okay.
translation: 呃，好的。

english: Which way should I go?
translation: 我该走哪边？

english: These dungeons are such a maze.
translation: 这些地牢真是个迷宫。

english: I've been wandering around down here for hours.
translation: 我在这下面徘徊了好几个小时。

english: How can I get back to the village?
translation: 我怎么回村？

english: I hate being so lost!
translation: 我讨厌这么迷路！

english: Where am I? I'm so lost.
translation: 我在哪？我迷路了。

english: I know the exit is around here, somewhere.
translation: 我知道出口就在这附近，某处。

english: Where's the exit?!?
translation: 出口在哪？！?

english: This is the fifth time this week! I'm lost!
translation: 这是这周第五次了！我迷路了！

english: How could I be so disoriented?
translation: 我怎么能这么迷失方向？

english: Hmm? Oh, hello, surface-dweller!
translation: 嗯？哦，你好，地表人！

english: What are you doing?
translation: 你在做什么？

english: I'm writing the definitive history of Dorgesh-Kaan!
translation: 我在撰写多吉需坎城的权威历史！

english: Actually, I wonder if you could help me...
translation: 其实，我在想你能不能帮我……

english: I know the ruler of Lumbridge is called Horacio, but I don't know what his title is. Can you tell me?
translation: 我知道仑桥镇的统治者叫霍拉西奥，但我不知道他的头衔是什么。你能告诉我吗？

english: He's a duke.
translation: 他是公爵。

english: Duke Horacio. Thank you.
translation: 霍拉西奥公爵。谢谢。

english: He's a general.
translation: 他是将军。

english: General Horacio. Thank you.
translation: 霍拉西奥将军。谢谢。

english: He's a king.
translation: 他是国王。

english: King Horacio. Thank you.
translation: 霍拉西奥国王。谢谢。

english: He's a lord.
translation: 他是领主。

english: Lord Horacio. Thank you.
translation: 霍拉西奥领主。谢谢。

english: You've talked to the goblins on the surface, haven't you? Do you know the name of the god that the surface goblins worship?
translation: 你跟地表的哥布林谈过，对吧？你知道地表哥布林崇拜的神的名字吗？

english: Nobody knows.
translation: 没人知道。

english: Oh well. Thanks anyway.
translation: 哦好吧。反正谢谢。

english: It's just called the Big High War God.
translation: 就叫至高战神。

english: Ah, thank you.
translation: 啊，谢谢。

english: It was Zamorak.
translation: 是扎莫拉克。

english: It was Guthix.
translation: 是古斯。

english: It was Saradomin.
translation: 是萨拉多明。

english: It was [player name].
translation: 是 [player name]。

english: [player name]? What a terrible, fear-inducing name!
translation: [player name]？多可怕、令人恐惧的名字！

english: I'm writing about the great war between the gods that happened thousands of years ago. Do you know the reason for this war?
translation: 我在写几千年前诸神之间的大战。你知道这场战争的原因吗？

english: It was for the gods' own entertainment.
translation: 是为了诸神自己的娱乐。

english: Just as I'd thought. Thank you.
translation: 正如我所想。谢谢。

english: Zamorak attacked the other gods.
translation: 扎莫拉克攻击了其他神。

english: Really? Thank you for the information.
translation: 真的？谢谢你的信息。

english: The other gods attacked Zaros.
translation: 其他神攻击了扎罗斯。

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

english: Guthix wanted to preserve balance so he made the other gods fight.
translation: 古斯想保持平衡所以他让其他神战斗。

english: A strange idea of balance! Thank you.
translation: 奇怪的平衡观念！谢谢。

english: What's the name of the group of surface-people that tried to destroy Dorgesh-Kaan?
translation: 试图摧毁多吉需坎城的地表人团体叫什么？

english: H.A.M.
translation: 反怪物人联

english: Hmm, I wonder what that stands for?
translation: 嗯，我想知道那代表什么？

english: It stands for Humans Against Monsters.
translation: 代表人类对抗怪物。

english: So we're monsters, are we? Thanks for telling me!
translation: 所以我们是怪物，是吧？谢谢告诉我！

english: B.A.C.O.N.
translation: B.A.C.O.N.

english: Hmm, I wonder what that stands for. Thank you.
translation: 嗯，我想知道那代表什么。谢谢。

english: P.O.R.K.
translation: P.O.R.K.

english: Hmm, I wonder what that stands for? Thank you.

english: What species are you, if you don't mind my asking? I know there are many different races living on the surface, but I don't know which one you are.
translation: 你是什么物种，如果不介意我问？我知道地表住着许多不同种族，但我不知道你是哪个。

english: I'm a human!
translation: 我是人类！

english: Ah, good, that's what I thought.
translation: 啊，好，那是我想的。

english: A human, hmm? Thank you.
translation: 人类，嗯？谢谢。

english: That's a relief! I thought you were some kind of horrible ogre!
translation: 松了口气！我以为你是某种可怕的食人魔！

english: Ah, of course. I thought you looked a little tall for a dwarf.
translation: 啊，当然。我以为你看起来对矮人来说有点高。

english: Oh! I thought you were an elf. Surface species are confusing!
translation: 哦！我以为你是精灵。地表物种真令人困惑！

english: I'm an ogre. Raah!
translation: 我是食人魔。啊！

english: Eek! An ogre! I had thought you were human!
translation: 咦！食人魔！我以为你是人类！

english: An ogre, hmm? Thank you.
translation: 食人魔，嗯？谢谢。

english: Ah, that's what I thought!
translation: 啊，那是我想的！

english: And I thought you were an elf! What a silly mistake!
translation: 我还以为你是精灵！多愚蠢的错误！

english: I'm a dwarf!
translation: 我是矮人！

english: Oh? I thought dwarves were shorter. I thought you were human!
translation: 哦？我以为矮人更矮。我以为你是人类！

english: A dwarf, hmm? Thank you.
translation: 矮人，嗯？谢谢。

english: Ah, yes, of course, you said.
translation: 啊，是的，当然，你说过。

english: I'm an elf!
translation: 我是精灵！

english: Oh? I thought elves were more graceful. I thought you were human!
translation: 哦？我以为精灵更优雅。我以为你是人类！

english: An elf, hmm? Thank you.
translation: 精灵，嗯？谢谢。

english: Oh? I thought elves were more graceful. I thought you were a dwarf!
translation: 哦？我以为精灵更优雅。我以为你是矮人！

english: Ah yes, that's what I thought.
translation: 啊是的，那是我想的。

english: What is this building?
translation: 这是什么建筑？

english: This is the Dorgeshuun Council chamber!
translation: 这是多格舒恩议会厅！

english: Whenever a decision needs to be made, the seven members of the Dorgeshuun Council meet here. The last meeting was when they decided to open up the city to surface-dwellers.
translation: 每当需要做决定时，多格舒恩议会的七名成员在这里会面。上次会议是他们决定向地表人开放城市。

english: In between meetings, I work here writing up the minutes of the meetings and working on the definitive history of Dorgesh-Kaan.
translation: 在会议之间，我在这里工作，写会议记录并撰写多吉需坎城的权威历史。

english: Can you tell me about the history of the city?
translation: 你能告诉我城市的历史吗？

english: Of course! I've gone through all of my predecessors' notes and compiled the definitive history of the Dorgeshuun! What would you like to hear about?
translation: 当然！我翻阅了所有前任的笔记并编纂了多格舒恩的权威历史！你想听什么？

english: Can you tell me about the founding of Dorgesh-Kaan?
translation: 你能告诉我多吉需坎城的建立吗？

english: Of course!  *Ahem*
translation: 当然！咳咳

english: Before Dorgesh-Kaan, the Dorgeshuun lived on the surface with many other goblin tribes. All goblins were ruled over by an evil god whose name has been forgotten.
translation: 在多吉需坎城之前，多格舒恩和许多其他哥布林部落住在地表。所有哥布林都被一个名字被遗忘的邪神统治。

english: The gods became bored and decided to make the mortal races fight for their amusement. The goblins were sent to fight in many bloody battles against each other and other races.
translation: 诸神变得无聊并决定让凡人种族为他们的娱乐战斗。哥布林被送去在许多血腥战斗中互相战斗并对抗其他种族。

english: The war lasted for thousands of years, and millions of goblins died. Eventually, the evil god sent the Dorgeshuun tribe to fight a battle that they could not win.
translation: 战争持续了数千年，数百万哥布林死亡。最终，邪神派多格舒恩部落去打一场他们赢不了的战斗。

english: But General Bloodfist of the Dorgeshuun refused to fight in this battle. Instead, he commanded the Dorgeshuun army to march down into a fissure in the ground.
translation: 但多格舒恩的血拳将军拒绝在这场战斗中战斗。相反，他命令多格舒恩军队行进进地面的裂缝。

english: General Bloodfist stood at the mouth of the fissure and defied the might of the evil god.
translation: 血拳将军站在裂缝口蔑视邪神的力量。

english: The evil god smote him with a mighty blast that shook the earth, but that blast also closed the fissure, sealing the Dorgeshuun away from the reach of the gods.
translation: 邪神用震撼大地的强大爆炸打击了他，但那爆炸也封闭了裂缝，将多格舒恩封印远离诸神的触及。

english: Lieutenant Strongaxe, now the leader of the Dorgeshuun, led the tribe deeper into the caves. They found this cavern, and here they founded Dorgesh-Kaan, city of the Dorgeshuun.
translation: 强斧中尉，现在是多格舒恩的领袖，带领部落更深进入洞穴。他们发现了这个洞穴，在这里他们建立了多吉需坎城，多格舒恩之城。

english: The god Zamorak attacked the other gods, starting a great war. The goblins were sent to fight in many bloody battles against each other and other races.
translation: 神扎莫拉克攻击了其他神，引发了一场大战。哥布林被送去在许多血腥战斗中互相战斗并对抗其他种族。

english: The other gods decided to remove the great god Zaros from power, and started a great war. The goblins were sent to fight in many bloody battles against each other and other races.
translation: 其他神决定移除大神扎罗斯的权力，并发动了一场大战。哥布林被送去在许多血腥战斗中互相战斗并对抗其他种族。

english: In order to preserve balance, the god Guthix made the other gods fight against one another. The goblins were sent to fight in many bloody battles against each other and other races.
translation: 为了保持平衡，神古斯让其他神互相战斗。哥布林被送去在许多血腥战斗中互相战斗并对抗其他种族。

english: Can you tell me about the Dorgeshuun civil war?
translation: 你能告诉我多格舒恩内战吗？

english: Certainly!  *Ahem*
translation: 当然！咳咳

english: At first, Dorgesh-Kaan was ruled over by generals, just as the tribe had been when it was on the surface. Each general succeeded the last by defeating him in combat.
translation: 起初，多吉需坎城跟在地表时一样，也是将军们管事儿，每位将军都是靠打败前任上位的。

english: The generals were advised by a council of elders, but the Dorgeshuun were no longer an army, and many of the people felt that the Council should have authority.
translation: 将军们有长老议会出主意，可多格舒恩早不是军队了，好多人都觉得该让议会说了算。

english: The people voted to become a republic, but General Bonehelm refused to give up power, and so the Dorgeshuun Civil War began.
translation: 大伙儿投票要搞共和，可骨盔将军不肯放权，多格舒恩内战就这么打起来了。

english: The republican faction was larger, but the military faction contained most of the trained warriors and controlled the magical equipment that the tribe had brought from the surface.
translation: 共和派人多，可军事派手里有大部分受过训练的战士，还管着部落从地表带来的魔法装备。

english: General Bonehelm was driven from the city, but dug his own base out of the caves nearby.
translation: 骨盔将军被赶出城市，但在附近洞穴挖了自己的基地。

english: General Bonehelm's army attacked the city using archers mounted on giant frogs. There was a bloody battle, and General Bonehelm was driven back again into his base.
translation: 骨盔将军的军队使用骑在巨型青蛙上的弓箭手攻击城市。有一场血腥战斗，骨盔将军又被赶回他的基地。

english: But General Bonehelm's mining had weakened the stone around his base, and the retreating army's footsteps caused the roof to collapse, crushing his army.
translation: 但骨盔将军挖矿把老巢周围的石头挖松了，撤退时大军一踩，洞顶塌了，把他的军队全埋里头了。

english: That was the last time one Dorgeshuun has raised arms against another. Since then, the city has been ruled peacefully by an elected council.
translation: 那是多格舒恩最后一次互相武装。从那以后，城市由选举产生的议会和平统治。

english: Can you tell me about recent years?
translation: 你能告诉我近年来的事吗？

english: Ah, this is where you come in!  *Ahem*
translation: 啊，这就轮到你上场了！(咳咳)

english: In the twenty-ninth century since the founding of the city, one of the miners broke through a wall into the cellar of a surface dwelling. The miners blocked up the tunnel and went back into their mines.
translation: 在城市建立后的第二十九世纪，一名矿工突破墙壁进入地表住宅的地下室。矿工们封锁了隧道并回到他们的矿井。

english: However, a human named [player name] found [his/her/their] way through the caves and made contact with the miners.
translation: 然而，一个名叫 [player name] 的人类找到了穿过洞穴的路并与矿工取得了联系。

english: Ur-tag, head of the Council, signed a peace treaty with Duke Horacio of Lumbridge, ruler of the town above the Dorgeshuuns' mine.
translation: 乌尔 - 塔格，议会首领，与仑桥镇的霍拉西奥公爵签署了和平条约，他是多格舒恩矿井上方城镇的统治者。

english: But not all surface-dwellers were friendly, and a faction called H.A.M. attempted to destroy the Dorgeshuun.
translation: 但并非所有地表人都友好，一个名叫反怪物人联的组织就想把多格舒恩给毁了。

english: The Council sent Zanik to explore the surface to see if the H.A.M. group was plotting anything. With [player name]'s help, Zanik defeated a H.A.M. plot to flood Dorgesh-Kaan.
translation: 议会派扎尼克去探索地表看反怪物人联团体是否在策划什么。在 [player name] 的帮助下，扎尼克击败了一个反怪物人联洪水淹没多吉需坎城的阴谋。

english: Despite reservations from many citizens, the Council eventually voted 4-3 to open Dorgesh-Kaan to surface-dwellers.
translation: 尽管许多市民有保留意见，议会最终以4-3投票决定向地表人开放多吉需坎城。

english: I'm an elf.
translation: 我是精灵。

english: What is this building?
translation: 这是什么建筑？

english: Can you tell me about the history of the city?
translation: 你能告诉我城市的历史吗？

english: The founding of Dorgesh-Kaan.
translation: 多吉需坎城的建立。

english: The Dorgeshuun civil war.
translation: 多格舒恩内战。

english: Recent years.
translation: 近年来。

english: What can I get you?
translation: 我能给你什么？

english: What are you serving?
translation: 你卖什么？

english: Can you tell me where I am?
translation: 你能告诉我我在哪吗？

english: You're in The Golden Field. There's a bank to the south and my grandfather's fruit farm is south-east near the beach. Fancy a drink now?
translation: 你在金色原野酒馆。南边有个银行我祖父的水果农场在东南靠近海滩。现在想喝一杯吗？

english: Have you heard any rumours here?
translation: 你在这听到什么传闻了吗？

english: Apparently Veos is looking for some help with something. He hangs around the docks of Port Piscarilius.
translation: 显然维奥斯在寻找帮助。他在皮斯卡里琉斯港码头徘徊。

english: They say there's trouble in Port Piscarilius. Something about gangs uniting. Might be worth looking into.
translation: 他们说皮斯卡里琉斯港有麻烦。关于帮派联合。可能值得调查。

english: I hear that Lord Hosidius has misplaced one of his sons. The Hosidius family might pay a lot to see him returned safely.
translation: 我听说霍西迪乌斯领主有个儿子失踪了，霍西迪乌斯家族可能愿意付大钱看他安全回来。

english: Phileas Rimor has supposedly been looking for some assistance with something in Shayzien. Maybe worth investigating.
translation: 菲利亚斯‧里莫据说在谢兹恩寻找帮助。也许值得调查。

english: I hear that the rulers of Lovakengj have some work available. You'll find them in the Lovakengj Assembly.
translation: 我听说洛瓦肯吉城的统治者有些任务委托，你可以在洛瓦肯吉城议会找到他们。

english: Apparently there's been some commotion in the middle of Arceuus. Might be worth checking out.
translation: 显然阿西乌斯城中心区域有些骚动，也许值得去看看。

english: That protest outside Kourend Castle is starting to attract some attention. Could be worth taking a look.
translation: 库兰德城堡外的抗议开始引起注意。可能值得看看。

english: No, it hasn't been very busy lately.
translation: 不，最近不太忙。

english: I'm okay, thanks.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

english: With some of these drinks inside you, you could be far more than merely okay!
translation: 喝了这些饮料，你可能远不止没事！

english: What are you serving?
translation: 你卖什么？

english: Can you tell me where I am?
translation: 你能告诉我我在哪吗？

english: I'm okay, thanks.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

english: Have you heard any rumours here?
translation: 你在这听到什么传闻了吗？

english: What are you doing down here? Leave before you get yourself into trouble.
translation: 你在这下面做什么？在惹麻烦前离开。

english: Hello Golrie.
translation: 你好戈尔里。

english: Hello again.
translation: 又见面了。

english: Do you mind if I have another look through this stuff?
translation: 你介意我再看看这些东西吗？

english: No, of course not.
translation: 不，当然不。

english: You look amongst the junk on the floor but find nothing of interest.
translation: 你在地板那堆破烂里翻了翻，没找着什么有意思的。

english: You look amongst the junk on the floor and find Glarial's pebble.
translation: 你在地板上的垃圾中看并找到了格拉利尔的鹅卵石。

english: Hello, Golrie.
translation: 你好，戈尔里。

english: Any luck getting out?
translation: 有办法出去吗？

english: Not yet, but don't worry. I'm sure I'll work something out. I just need some time to think.
translation: 还没有，但别担心。我相信我会想出办法。我只需要点时间思考。

english: Well good luck.
translation: 那祝你好运。

english: Hello, Golrie. How's it going?
translation: 你好，戈尔里。怎么样？

english: Better now I'm on the right side of these bars.
translation: 现在我在这栏杆的正确这边好多了。

english: Found anything interesting recently?
translation: 最近发现什么有趣的东西了吗？

english: It just so happens I have. Take a look at this book.
translation: 碰巧我有。看看这本书。

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

english: I managed to find that device.
translation: 我设法找到了那个设备。

english: Wonderful! Though you know, I don't think you ever actually mentioned what the device does.
translation: 太好了！不过你知道，我想你从未真正提过那个设备做什么。

english: It counteracts illusion magic in the surrounding area. This one should cover the whole of the Tree Gnome Village. It might be useful for someone to remember that in case it's needed again.
translation: 它抵消周围区域的幻术魔法。这个应该覆盖整个地精村庄。某人记住那个可能有用以防再次需要。

english: Oh, well I'll be sure to keep that in mind.
translation: 哦，嗯我肯定会记住那个。

english: I found Bolrie's diary. Do you know anything about it?
translation: 我找到了博尔里的日记。你知道关于它的什么事吗？

english: Of course! Bolrie is my grandfather... assuming he's still alive, at least.
translation: 当然！博尔里是我的祖父……假设他还活着，至少。

english: Bolrie... Golrie... I should have guessed. You seem to like giving your children similar names, just to be confusing.
translation: 博尔里……戈尔里……我该猜到。你们似乎喜欢给孩子相似的名字，只是为了令人困惑。

english: Certainly, in our family that's true. King Bolren is also Bolrie's younger brother, in case you didn't know.
translation: 当然，在我们家那是真的。博尔伦国王也是博尔里的弟弟，以防你不知道。

english: So that means you're King Bolren's grand-nephew, right?
translation: 所以那意味着你是博尔伦国王的侄孙，对吧？

english: That's right.
translation: 没错。

english: Does that mean that you're in line for the throne?
translation: 那意味着你有王位继承权吗？

english: Gnomes don't have a hereditary monarchy. We have a democratic monarchy. We vote for our kings.
translation: 地精没有世袭君主制。我们有民主君主制。我们投票选国王。

english: Oh, that's unusual. So you've never thought about being the King?
translation: 哦，那不寻常。所以你从未想过当国王？

english: That might be fun. I wouldn't want to be like gramps though. He liked wars a bit too much. I do sometimes discuss the Khazard War with the hobgobbos, but they don't have a particularly sharp political sense.
translation: 那可能有趣。不过我不想象祖父那样。他有点太喜欢战争了。我有时跟大哥布林讨论卡扎德战争，但他们没有特别敏锐的政治意识。

english: Personally, I don't think we should fight his troops head- on. We're smarter than that. We should come up with some ingenious method of defeating Khazard, like they did at the Battle of Atarisundri!
translation: 就我个人而言，我认为我们不应该正面迎战他的部队。我们比那聪明。我们应该想出一些击败卡扎德的巧妙方法，就像他们在阿塔里斯德里战役中做的！

english: You're very well informed for a gnome in a cave. Most gnomes I've talked to have forgotten most of their own history.
translation: 你对一个洞穴里的地精来说消息很灵通。我谈过的大多数地精都忘记了他们自己的大部分历史。

english: Gnomes don't tend to dwell on the past, but I suppose I'm not a typical gnome. I get lots of time to think and read in here.
translation: 地精不倾向于沉溺在过去，但我想我不是典型的地精。我在这有很多时间思考和阅读。

english: So have you heard from Bolrie recently?
translation: 那么你最近有博尔里的消息吗？

english: No, the parcels stopped arriving a few years ago. I guess he's either found what he was looking for, or has died in the attempt.
translation: 没有，包裹几年前就停止到达了。我想他要么找到了他在找的东西，要么在尝试中死了。

english: What was he looking for?
translation: 他在找什么？

english: I'm not sure. He was definitely obsessed with finding out as much as he could about elven magic. He also seemed to have a bit of a grudge against Glouphrie.
translation: 我不确定。他肯定痴迷于尽可能多地了解精灵魔法。他似乎也对格卢弗里有点怨恨。

english: Maybe he's looking for Glouphrie.
translation: 也许他在找格卢弗里。

english: Who knows, eh? Who knows?
translation: 谁知道，嗯？谁知道？

english: Where did that crystal bowl come from?
translation: 那个水晶碗从哪来的？

english: A huge battle tortoise arrived a while back carrying a crate with it in. Sent by gramps, of course. It looks pretty, doesn't it? Would probably look great with some plants in it.
translation: 一只巨大的战龟不久前带着一个板条箱抵达。当然是祖父送的。它看起来很漂亮，对吧？里面放些植物可能看起来很棒。

english: I don't think it's meant to be used as a plant pot.
translation: 我想它不是打算用作花盆。

english: Well, what's it for then?
translation: 嗯，那它是做什么的？

english: It's a singing bowl. You can use it to shape elven crystal.
translation: 它是个 singing bowl。你可以用它塑造精灵水晶。

english: Ohh... How exciting!
translation: 哦……多令人兴奋！

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: See you later.
translation: 回头见。

english: I have a question about your storeroom.
translation: 我有个关于你储藏室的问题。

english: I lost that pebble.
translation: 我把那个鹅卵石弄丢了。

english: Not to worry. It turned up here again.
translation: 别担心。它又在这出现了。

english: Can I use your key?
translation: 我能用你的钥匙吗？

english: If you wanna go in there with them hob-gobs, that's your business.
translation: 如果你想跟那些 hob-gobs 进去，那是你的事。

english: I'll leave you to it.
translation: 我不打扰你了。

english: Yes, lots to do. Them hob-gobs left my stuff out here in a right mess. Until next time.
translation: 是的，有很多事要做。那些 hob-gobs 把我的东西留在这乱七八糟。下次见。

english: Found anything interesting recently?
translation: 最近发现什么有趣的东西了吗？

english: I managed to find that device.
translation: 我设法找到了那个设备。

english: I found Bolrie's diary. Do you know anything about it?
translation: 我找到了博尔里的日记。你知道关于它的什么事吗？

english: Where did that crystal bowl come from?
translation: 那个水晶碗从哪来的？

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: I have a question about your storeroom.
translation: 我有个关于你储藏室的问题。

english: I lost that pebble.
translation: 我把那个鹅卵石弄丢了。

english: Can I use your key?
translation: 我能用你的钥匙吗？

english: I'll leave you to it.
translation: 我不打扰你了。

english: *HONK*
translation: 嘎

english: Of course, you honk. I don't know what I was expecting.
translation: 当然，你嘎。我不知道我在期待什么。

english: That is one large, loud chicken.
translation: 那是只又大又吵的鸡。

english: I take it that stealth is not your speciality.
translation: 我想 stealth 不是你的专长。

english: The goose looks at you knowingly. It remembers all of your Christmas Achievements!
translation: 鹅知情地看着你。它记得你所有的圣诞成就！

english: ...Six Geese a-laying...
translation: ……六只鹅在下蛋……

english: That's a loud honk.
translation: 那是个响亮的嘎。

english: Ha, HONK right back at you.
translation: 哈，嘎回你。

english: What would a goose want with a pub?
translation: 鹅想要酒吧做什么？

english: Looking closer at the Goose's hat. It's got the name 'Wolfy' written on it.
translation: 仔细看鹅的帽子。上面写着名字‘沃尔菲’。

english: You're actually pretty cute with that little hat.
translation: 你戴那顶小帽子其实挺可爱的。

english: Looking closer at the goose's hat, it's got the name 'Wolfy' written on it.
translation: 仔细看鹅的帽子，上面写着名字‘沃尔菲’。

english: I wonder where you came from?
translation: 我想知道你从哪来？

english: Hello. Who are you?
translation: 你好。你是谁？

english: The name's Gordon. Good day to you.
translation: 名叫戈登。你好。

english: It's a nice farm you've got here.
translation: 你在这有个不错的农场。

english: Thank you. We built it ourselves.
translation: 谢谢。我们自己建的。

english: Really? So you haven't been here long?
translation: 真的？所以你在这没多久？

english: Nope. Not too long ago you couldn't safely travel around these parts. Too many lizardmen. But then some Hosidius explorers discovered how fertile this land was.
translation: 没有。不久前你还不能安全地在这些地方旅行。太多蜥蜴人。但后来一些霍西迪乌斯探险家发现这片土地多肥沃。

english: Lord Hosidius made a deal with Lord Shayzien and the lizardmen were cleared out to make room for the Farming Guild.
translation: 霍西迪乌斯领主与谢兹恩领主达成协议，蜥蜴人被清除为农业公会腾出空间。

english: When we heard, we decided to come up here and start up our own farm.
translation: 听到这个消息后，我们决定来这里建立自己的农场。

english: Need a hand with anything?
translation: 需要帮忙吗？

english: Very nice. Well I hope it goes well for you.
translation: 很不错。嗯，希望你一切顺利。

english: Thank you friend. See you later.
translation: 谢谢你朋友。回头见。

english: Hello again. How are things?
translation: 又见面了。最近怎么样？

english: Hello there. Not too bad, thanks.
translation: 你好。还不错，谢谢。

english: Great to hear. All the best.
translation: 很高兴听到这个。祝一切顺利。

english: Hello again. Thank you for dealing with that beast.
translation: 又见面了。谢谢你处理了那只野兽。

english: Hello again. Thank you for dealing with that beast. As promised, here's your reward.
translation: 又见面了。谢谢你处理了那只野兽。这是答应给你的报酬。

english: It's my pleasure.
translation: 这是我的荣幸。

english: Need a hand with anything?
translation: 需要帮忙吗？

english: Very nice. Well I hope it goes well for you.
translation: 很不错。嗯，希望你一切顺利。

english: Great to hear. All the best.
translation: 很高兴听到这个。祝一切顺利。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Good day, can I help you?
translation: 你好，有什么能帮你的吗？

english: No thanks I'm just watching the world go by.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我只是在看世间百态。

english: Well I can think of no better place to do it, it is beautiful here is it not?
translation: 嗯，我想不出比这更好的地方了，这里很美不是吗？

english: Indeed it is.
translation: 确实是。

english: Well this was once the best place to do it, it used to be beautiful here.
translation: 这里曾经是做这件事的最佳地点，这里曾经很美。

english: Will you repair the damage?
translation: 你会把损坏修好不？

english: In time, once the war is over, assuming we survive it.
translation: 到时候吧，一旦战争结束，假设我们能活下来。

english: Here, solve this.
translation: 来，解这个。

english: Goreu hands you a [light/puzzle] box.
translation: 戈雷乌递给你一个 [light/puzzle] 盒子。

english: That doesn't look solved to me.
translation: 在我看来这还没解开。

english: Well done [player name]. Here you go.
translation: 干得好 [player name]。给你。

english: You've been given a [new clue/casket]!
translation: 你获得了 [new clue/casket]！

english: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你以为你在做什么？

english: Greetings human.
translation: 你好，人类。

english: Hello. What is this place?
translation: 你好。这是什么地方？

english: This is one of your human banks. We set it up here to help your kind serve the balance with us.
translation: 这是你们人类的银行之一。我们在这里设立它是为了帮助你们种族与我们一起维护平衡。

english: Do you not use it yourself?
translation: 你们自己不用吗？

english: No. We have no need for it. We have no possessions. We only have our cause.
translation: 不。我们不需要。我们没有财产。我们只有我们的事业。

english: To serve the balance?
translation: 为了维护平衡？

english: To serve the balance.
translation: 为了维护平衡。

english: There's some kind of commotion up at the Sinclair place I hear. Not surprising all things considered.
translation: 我听说辛克莱尔家那边有点骚动。考虑到所有情况，这并不奇怪。

english: Well, this has certainly been exciting! The Sinclairs under house arrest, Morgan Le Faye attempting yet again to interfere with King Arthur and Merlin, and even the Black Knights sticking their noses into it.
translation: 嗯，这确实令人兴奋！辛克莱尔家被软禁，摩根‧勒菲再次试图干涉亚瑟王和梅林，甚至连黑骑士也插手其中。

english: How do you know all that? It only just happened, and you weren't there!
translation: 你怎么知道所有这些？这才刚发生，你又不在那！

english: I have my sources. No secret is safe as long as I'm around!
translation: 我有我的消息来源。只要我在，没有秘密是安全的！

english: Ooh, a surface-dweller! Have you got any exotic surface foods to sell?
translation: 哦，一个地表人！你有什么异国情调的地表食物卖吗？

english: Not at the moment.
translation: 目前还没有。

english: A pity. Dorgeshuun food seems so dull now I've tasted surface food.
translation: 真可惜，尝过地表美食，多格舒恩的饭菜就显得太寡淡了。

english: Yes!
translation: 是的！

english: Splendid! Show me what you've got!
translation: 太好了！给我看看你有什么！

english: What kinds of food do you like?
translation: 你喜欢什么样的食物？

english: All kinds! I don't want to keep eating the same food, even if I like it. I want to try new tastes!
translation: 各种各样的！我不想一直吃同样的食物，即使我喜欢。我想尝试新口味！

english: Why not try something on me and see if I like it?
translation: 为什么不试试给我点什么，看看我喜不喜欢？

english: That's all very well, but do you have anything edible?
translation: 那都很好，但你有能吃的东西吗？

english: Eww! That looks disgusting! There's no way I'm buying that.
translation: 咦！那看起来真恶心！我绝不会买那个。

english: What's the point of selling me Dorgeshuun foods? I want to experience exotic surface cuisine!
translation: 卖给我多格舒恩食物有什么意义？我想体验异国情调的地表美食！

english: Not at the moment.
translation: 目前还没有。

english: Yes!
translation: 是的！

english: What kind of foods do you like?
translation: 你喜欢什么样的食物？

english: What can I do for you?
translation: 我能为你做什么？

english: I don't know. What can you do for me?
translation: 我不知道。你能为我做什么？

english: A good question indeed! I'm selling special clothing for Agility enthusiasts.
translation: 真是个好问题！我在卖给敏捷爱好者穿的特种服装。

english: Sometimes, when you're exploring the hidden rooftops of our cities, you'll find one of my Marks.
translation: 有时候，当你在探索我们城市隐藏的屋顶时，你会找到我的一个标记。

english: Once you've got enough Marks, I'll exchange them for my Graceful clothing. So, does that interest you?
translation: 一旦你收集了足够的标记，我会把它们换成我的优雅服装。那么，你感兴趣吗？

english: Can I see what you're selling?
translation: 我能看看你卖什么吗？

english: Can I see how many laps I've completed?
translation: 我能看看我完成了多少圈吗？

english: Can I toggle my lap counter?
translation: 我能切换我的圈数计数器吗？

english: Sure, I've disabled your lap counter messages, if you want to turn it back on, so you can see your total laps after you finish one, speak to me again.
translation: 当然，我已经禁用了你的圈数计数器消息，如果你想重新打开，以便在完成一圈后看到总圈数，再跟我说话。

english: Sure, I've turned on your lap counter, you'll get a message when you complete a lap on a rooftop course. To help you keep track.
translation: 当然，我已经打开了你的圈数计数器，当你在屋顶课程完成一圈时，你会收到一条消息。帮助你跟踪。

english: I'm alright, thanks.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

english: I don't know. What can you do for me?
translation: 我不知道。你能为我做什么？

english: Can I see what you're selling?
translation: 我能看看你卖什么吗？

english: I'm alright, thanks.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

english: Can I see how many laps I've completed?
translation: 我能看看我完成了多少圈吗？

english: Can I toggle my lap counter?
translation: 我能切换我的圈数计数器吗？

english: Ting-a-ling-a-ling!
translation: 叮 - 铃 - 铃 - 铃！

english: Welcome to the Grail castle. You should come inside, it's cold out here.
translation: 欢迎来到圣杯城堡。你应该进来，外面很冷。

english: Somehow you are now inside the castle.
translation: 不知怎的，你现在在城堡里面了。

english: Have you noticed all the bones around the room? These are teleported here from all over Gielinor to help clean up the landscape of countless bones left behind from combat. What better use for these bones than to convert them to nutritious fruit to be eaten by you mortals? You have to use your Bones to Bananas spell to convert the bones and then place them in the holes on the walls to earn Graveyard Pizazz Points. Unluckily for you, your health will constantly decrease from getting hit by these dropping bones so you will probably want to eat some of the bananas yourself to increase your stay here.
translation: 你注意到房间周围所有的骨头了吗？这些是从基利诺尔各地传送过来的，帮助清理战斗留下的无数骨头景观。把这些骨头变成供你们凡人食用的营养水果，不是不是物尽其用吗？你必须使用你的化骨为蕉法术来转化骨头，然后把它们放在墙上的洞里以获得墓地活力点数。不幸的是，你的生命值会因被掉落的骨头击中而持续下降，所以你可能想吃些香蕉恢复生命值，好在这里多待一会儿。

english: What are the rewards?

english: You will get experience from casting your bones to bananas spell and you will get Graveyard Pizazz Points when you put the bananas through the wall. Occasionally you will also be credited with a runestone to help you in your future spell casting.

english: Got any tips that may help me?

english: Different bones will provide you with different numbers of bananas, so try to find the best type. Collect enough points and you will be able to buy a 'Bones to Peaches' spell from my fellow guardian above the entrance hall. This spell can be used here just like the bones to bananas spell, except this spell will give you even more experience and the peaches will restore more health!

english: In this day and age we're all soldiers. No time to waste gassing, Fight! Fight! Fight!
translation: 当今时代我们都是士兵。没时间废话，战斗！战斗！战斗！

english: Well hello brave warrior. These ogres have been terrorising the area, they've eaten four children this week alone.
translation: 你好勇敢战士。这些食人魔一直在恐吓这片区域，光是这周他们就吃了四个孩子。

english: Brutes!
translation: 畜生！

english: So we decided to use them for target practice. A fair punishment.
translation: 所以我们决定把它们当靶子练习。公平的惩罚。

english: Indeed.
translation: 确实。

english: What do you want? Leave us be!
translation: 你想要什么？别管我们！

english: Welcome to the Seers' Village courthouse. Court is not in session today, so you're not allowed downstairs.
translation: 欢迎来到先知村法院。今天不开庭，所以你不允许下楼。

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: The Seers' Village courthouse. We give all criminals a fair trial, by a jury of their peers. Or whoever we can round up from the pub.
translation: 先知村法院。我们给所有罪犯公平审判，由他们的同行陪审。或者我们能从酒吧拉来的任何人。

english: Court is not in session today.
translation: 今天不开庭。

english: What are you looking at?
translation: 你在看什么？

english: You're a long way out from the city.
translation: 你离城市很远。

english: I know. We guards usually stay by banks and shops, but I got sent all the way out here to keep an eye on the brigands loitering just south of here.
translation: 我知道。我们守卫通常待在银行和商店旁，但我被派到这老远来盯着就在南边徘徊的强盗。

english: It sounds more exciting than standing around guarding banks and shops.
translation: 听起来比站着守卫银行和商店更刺激。

english: It's not too bad. At least I don't get attacked so often out here. Guards in the cities get killed all the time.
translation: 还不错。至少我在这里不常被攻击。城市里的守卫经常被杀。

english: Honestly, people these days just don't know how to behave!
translation: 老实说，现在的人就是不懂规矩！

english: Don't distract me while I'm on duty! This mine has to be protected!
translation: 别在我值班时分心！这个矿必须被保护！

english: What's going to attack a mine?
translation: 什么会攻击矿坑？

english: Goblins! They wander everywhere, attacking anyone they think is small enough to be an easy victim. We need more cannons to fight them off properly.
translation: 哥布林！它们到处游荡，攻击任何它们觉得足够小容易下手的受害者。我们需要更多大炮来有效地击退它们。

english: Cannons? Those sound expensive.
translation: 大炮？听起来很贵。

english: A new cannon can cost 750,000 coins, and the ammo isn't easy to get, but they do up to 30 hitpoints of damage with each shot. When you've got an important mine like this one to protect, it's worth the expense.
translation: 一门新大炮可能花费750,000金币，弹药也不容易弄到，但每发能造成高达30点生命值伤害。当你要保护像这个重要的矿坑时，这花费是值得的。

english: Thanks for the information.
translation: 谢谢你的信息。

english: You're welcome. Now please let me get on with my guard duties.
translation: 不用客气。现在请让我继续我的守卫职责。

english: Well, I've done my bit to help with that.
translation: 嗯，我已经尽力帮忙了。

english: Yes, I heard. Now please let me get on with my guard duties.
translation: 是的，我听说了。现在请让我继续我的守卫职责。

english: Alright, I'll leave you alone now.
translation: 好吧，我现在不打扰你了。

english: Please don't disturb me, I've got to keep any eye out for suspicious individuals.
translation: 请别打扰我，我得留意可疑人物。

english: What are you guarding here?
translation: 你在这里守卫什么？

english: The area under the palace is going to be excavated soon, and I'm guarding the entrance to it.
translation: 宫殿下方的区域很快要被挖掘，我在守卫入口。

english: Oh, I see. Can I go down there?
translation: 哦，我明白了。我能下去吗？

english: Of course not!
translation: 当然不能！

english: There's not even a rope to let you down there. You'd break both your legs if you tried it.
translation: 甚至连根绳子都没有让你下去。如果你试了会摔断双腿。

english: I'm surprised you managed to get out of there without breaking any bones.
translation: 我很惊讶你没摔断骨头就出来了。

english: Still, the Queen says it should be safe, and I'm to let you go back down if you want.
translation: 不过，女王说应该是安全的，如果你想去我可以让你下去。

english: Stand back. This area is restricted.
translation: 退后，此区域为禁区。

english: What's so special about it?
translation: 有什么特别的？

english: That's none of your business.
translation: 不关你的事。

english: I think I've left some of my loot in there. Can I get it quick?
translation: 我想我把些战利品落里面了。能快点拿吗？

english: Nice try, [Colosseum rank].
translation: 想得美，[Colosseum rank]。

english: What if I share some of it with you?
translation: 如果我跟你分享一些呢？

english: I do not care for wealth. Now move along.
translation: 我不在乎财富。现在走开。

english: May I pass?
translation: 我能通过吗？

english: You shall not... *cough*
translation: 你不能……咳嗽

english: No one is allowed past I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕没人能通过。

english: How suspicious...
translation: 真可疑……

english: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你以为你在做什么？

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: I'M ON SHOUTING DUTY!
translation: 我在执行喊叫任务！

english: No need to shout.
translation: 没必要喊。

english: I'M SORRY I'VE BEEN SHOUTING INSULTS SO LONG I CAN'T HELP IT!
translation: 抱歉我喊侮辱话太久了改不了！

english: Who are you insulting?
translation: 你在侮辱谁？

english: THE TOWER IN NEITIZNOT. THEY SHOUT INSULTS BACK.
translation: 奈提兹诺镇的塔。他们会回骂。

english: Err, why?
translation: 呃，为什么？

english: THE KING TELLS US TO.
translation: 国王让我们做的。

english: Your King is a strange person.
translation: 你们的国王是个奇怪的人。

english: Can I watch? I'm curious.
translation: 我能看吗？我好奇。

english: IF YOU LIKE!
translation: 随你便！

english: Oh well, I'd better get going
translation: 哦好吧，我最好走了

english: YOU WOULDN'T KNOW HOW TO KILL A TROLL IF IT CAME UP AND BIT YER ARM OFF!
translation: 如果巨魔过来咬掉你的胳膊你都不知道怎么杀它！

english: YOU WOULDN'T KNOW HOW TO SHAVE A YAK IF YOUR LIFE DEPENDED ON IT!
translation: 如果性命攸关你都不知道怎么给牦牛刮毛！

english: YAK LOVERS!
translation: 牦牛爱好者！

english: MISERABLE LOSERS!
translation: 可悲的输家！

english: CALL THAT A TOWN, I'VE SEEN BETTER HAMLETS!
translation: 那也叫城镇，我见过更好的村落！

english: YOUR MOTHER WAS A HAMSTER.
translation: 你妈是仓鼠。

english: AND YOUR FATHER SMELLED OF WINTERBERRIES.
translation: 你爸闻起来像冬莓。

english: AT LEAST WE HAVE SOMETHING OTHER THAN SMELLY FISH!
translation: 至少我们除了臭鱼还有别的东西！

english: WOODEN BRIDGES ARE RUBBISH!
translation: 木桥是垃圾！

english: AT LEAST WE CAN COOK!
translation: 至少我们会做饭！

english: OUR KING'S BETTER THAN YOUR BURGHER!
translation: 我们的国王比你们的市长强！

english: JATIZSO!
translation: 贾提兹索！

english: NEITIZNOT!
translation: 奈提兹诺镇！

english: Can I watch? I'm curious.
translation: 我能看吗？我好奇。

english: Oh well, I'd better get going
translation: 哦好吧，我最好走了

english: Welcome, [Fremennik name].
translation: 欢迎，[Fremennik name]。

english: Are you all right? Leftie?
translation: 你没事吧？左撇子？

english: No, I'm on the left.
translation: 不，我在左边。

english: Only from your perspective. Someone entering the gate should call you Rightie, right Leftie?
translation: 只从你的角度。进门的人应该叫你右撇子，对吧左撇子？

english: Right, Rightie. So you'd be Leftie not Rightie, right?
translation: 对，右撇子。所以你是左撇子不是右撇子，对吧？

english: That's right Leftie, that's right.
translation: 没错左撇子，没错。

english: Rightie-oh Rightie, or should I call you Leftie?
translation: 右撇子哦右撇子，还是我该叫你左撇子？

english: No, Rightie's fine Leftie.
translation: 不，右撇子就好左撇子。

english: Aaagh! Enough! If either of you mention left or right in my presence I'll have to scream! Can I come through the gate?
translation: 啊！够了！如果你们谁在我面前提左或右我就得尖叫！我能过门吗？

english: Don't let us stop you.
translation: 别让我们拦你。

english: Yes, head right on in, [sir/madam].
translation: 是的，直接进去，[sir/madam]。

english: You said it! You said it! ARRRRRRRRGGH!
translation: 你说了！你说了！啊————！

english: Halt! Who goes there?
translation: 站住！谁在那？

english: My name is [Fremennik name], will you not let me through?
translation: 我叫 [Fremennik name]，你不让我过吗？

english: I'm afraid the King won't give an audience to anyone except a worthy hero.
translation: 恐怕国王除了值得的英雄外不会接见任何人。

english: If you become a member of the Heroes' Guild, he will definitely grant you an audience.
translation: 如果你成为英雄公会成员，他肯定会接见你。

english: I am a member of the Heroes' Guild; does that not show my worth?
translation: 我是英雄公会成员；那不足以显示我的价值吗？

english: Then you may pass.
translation: 那你可以通过。

english: [Welcome back, Sir/Welcome back, Madam/Welcome back,].
translation: [欢迎回来，先生/欢迎回来，女士/欢迎回来，]。

english: Welcome back, Your Royal Highness.
translation: 欢迎回来，殿下。

english: Sorry, but nobody's allowed down there by order of the King.
translation: 抱歉，但国王命令不准任何人下去。

english: Oh, okay.
translation: 哦，好的。

english: You're free to go into the dungeons, your Highness.
translation: 你可以自由进入地牢，殿下。

english: Try not to get eaten by those monsters.
translation: 尽量别被那些怪物吃了。

english: Halt! Are you here to sabotage the Motherlode Mine?
translation: 站住！你是来破坏母矿脉矿坑的吗？

english: What's the Motherlode Mine?
translation: 什么是母矿脉矿坑？

english: Prospector Percy discovered unusual mineral veins in this cave. Now he's built a machine to let us extract useful ores.
translation: 勘探者珀西在这个洞穴发现了不寻常的矿脉。现在他建了台机器让我们开采有用矿石。

english: Percy calls it the Motherlode. I don't know why, and I'm not asking - that's between him and his mother.
translation: 珀西叫它母矿脉。我不知道为什么，我也不问——那是他和她母亲之间的事。

english: Dwarves don't normally let humans claim areas of the mine like this, but Percy's machine is really useful, so we struck a deal.
translation: 矮人通常不让人类像这样占有矿坑区域，但珀西的机器真有用，所以我们达成了协议。

english: No, I'm not.
translation: 不，我不是。

english: That's a relief. Have a nice day.
translation: 松了口气。祝你愉快。

english: What would you do if I said 'yes'?
translation: 如果我说‘是’你会怎么做？

english: I'd ask you not to.
translation: 我会叫你别。

english: What's the Motherlode Mine?
translation: 什么是母矿脉矿坑？

english: No, I'm not.
translation: 不，我不是。

english: What would you do if I said 'yes'?
translation: 如果我说‘是’你会怎么做？

english: You stay right there, outerlander.
translation: 你待在那别动，外乡人。

english: Don't worry, I'm not an outerlander, I am [Fremennik name], a Fremennik!
translation: 别担心，我不是外乡人，我是 [Fremennik name]，费明尼克人！

english: I said stay there, outerlander! You are not welcome in our camp.
translation: 我说待在那，外乡人！你不欢迎来我们营地。

english: Why, what's beyond here?
translation: 为什么，这后面是什么？

english: Our camp, outerlander, and we don't want any trouble there.
translation: 我们的营地，外乡人，我们不想在那惹麻烦。

english: I suppose I might as well let you pass now, since I can't seem to stop you anyway.
translation: 我想我现在最好让你过，反正我也似乎拦不住你。

english: Just remember that I'm watching you.
translation: 记住我在盯着你。

english: Go, outerlander, and do not hurry back.
translation: 走吧，外乡人，别急着回来。

english: You may pass freely, outerlander.
translation: 你可以自由通过，外乡人。

english: Hey, how did you get here?
translation: 嘿，你怎么到这的？

english: Can you come and help me? The chieftain's daughter -
translation: 你能来帮我吗？酋长的女儿 -

english: No, outerlander, I'm guarding this mountain pass from trolls and inquisitive people like you.
translation: 不，外乡人，我在守卫这个山口免受巨魔和像你这样好奇的人侵害。

english: Doesn't look like you were very successful in the last regard.
translation: 看起来你在后一方面不太成功。

english: If the chieftain would let me, I would correct that oversight.
translation: 如果酋长允许，我会纠正那个疏忽。

english: You may pass freely.
translation: 你可以自由通过。

english: Thanks... and try to lighten up a bit, alright?
translation: 谢谢……试着放松点，好吗？

english: Don't press your luck, outerlander.
translation: 别得寸进尺，外乡人。

english: Feel free to come in and see the highlight of our culture, outerlander.
translation: 欢迎进来看看我们文化的亮点，外乡人。

english: What's going on here?
translation: 这里发生什么了？

english: Ah, this is a strange ritual that has been going on for generations.
translation: 啊，这是个持续了几代人的奇怪仪式。

english: One of our clan stands on this tower and shouts insults at the other side.
translation: 我们氏族的一人站在这塔上朝另一边喊侮辱话。

english: I'm surprised your Burgher approves of this sort of thing.
translation: 我惊讶你们的市长批准这种事。

english: He suggested stopping it, but there was resistance from the rest of the village. We find it therapeutic.
translation: 他建议停止，但村里其他人反对。我们觉得这有治疗效果。

english: Can I watch? I like odd rituals.
translation: 我能看吗？我喜欢奇怪仪式。

english: Certainly.
translation: 当然。

english: Can I watch? I like odd rituals.
translation: 我能看吗？我喜欢奇怪仪式。

english: HALT! Who goes there?
translation: 站住！谁在那？

english: Don't worry, I'm not going to cause trouble.
translation: 别担心，我不会惹麻烦。

english: But you shouldn't be here - be off with you!
translation: 但你不该在这——走开！

english: I was going anyway.
translation: 反正我要走了。

english: I am [player name] the Mighty!
translation: 我是强大的 [player name]！

english: Mighty? You look like another of those silly adventurers who thinks they're the bee's knees just because they've done a few lousy quests!
translation: 强大？你看起来像那些愚蠢冒险者中的一个，就因为做了几个烂任务就自以为了不起！

english: Well it sounds better than sitting on this rooftop all day looking at trees!
translation: 嗯那比整天坐在这屋顶上看树听起来好！

english: I'll have you know it's a very important job guarding this jail!
translation: 我要让你知道守卫这监狱是很重要的工作！

english: If anyone comes sneaking in here to mess around with the prisoners, the lads downstairs will make mincemeat of them, and I'll be here to pick them off if they try to escape.
translation: 如果有人偷偷进来跟囚犯胡搞，楼下的伙计会把他们剁成肉泥，如果他们试图逃跑我会在这收拾他们。

english: You mean people aren't meant to be able to shoot the prisoners in the cells?
translation: 你的意思是人们不应该能射牢房里的囚犯？

english: Yes, that's right.
translation: 是的，没错。

english: Okay, it's been nice talking to you.
translation: 好的，跟你聊天很愉快。

english: No-one, there's no-one here.
translation: 没人，这里没人。

english: What? I can see you!
translation: 什么？我能看到你！

english: No, you're just imagining it. Perhaps you've been up here in the sun for too long?
translation: 不，你只是想象。也许你在这太阳下待太久了？

english: So who am I talking to?
translation: 那我在跟谁说话？

english: Oh dear, you've started talking to yourself. That's a common sign that you're going mad!
translation: 哦天，你开始自言自语了。那是你快疯了的常见迹象！

english: But... but... you're standing right there...
translation: 但……但……你就站在那……

english: Maybe you should leave him alone now.
translation: 也许你现在该别管他了。

english: Don't worry, I'm not going to cause trouble.
translation: 别担心，我不会惹麻烦。

english: I am [player name] the Mighty!
translation: 我是强大的 [player name]！

english: No-one, there's no-one here.
translation: 没人，这里没人。

english: Guh... mwww... zzzzz...
translation: 咕……喵……呼呼呼……

english: Hmph... heh heh heh...
translation: 哼……嘿嘿嘿……

english: Mmmm... big pint of beer... kebab...
translation: 嗯……大品脱啤酒……烤肉串……

english: Mmmmmm... donuts...
translation: 嗯……甜甜圈……

english: Maybe I should let him sleep.
translation: 也许我该让他睡。

english: Hello, can I go in?
translation: 你好，我能进去吗？

english: I'm afraid not. The city is on lockdown until the rebel elves are dealt with.
translation: 恐怕不能。城市封锁了直到叛乱精灵被处理。

english: Please, I won't cause any trouble.
translation: 求求了，我不会惹麻烦。

english: Rules are rules. No one enters until the criminals are gone.
translation: 规矩就是规矩。罪犯消失前没人能进。

english: Fine, doesn't look very exciting anyway, it's just an empty field.
translation: 好吧，反正看起来也不刺激，就是片空地。

english: Mind your tongue human. Our great city may be lost to us but that doesn't give you an excuse to talk like that.
translation: 注意你的言辞人类。我们伟大的城市可能丢失了但那不给你借口那样说话。

english: Welcome, adventurer.
translation: 欢迎，冒险者。

english: Hey! Get your hands off there!
translation: 嘿！把手拿开！

english: Greetings, traveller. Enjoy your time at the Ranging Guild.
translation: 你好，旅行者。享受你在射箭公会的时光。

english: *Whistles*
translation: 吹口哨

english: At least I'm not guarding the market.
translation: 至少我没守卫市场。

english: 10 green bottles... or was it 9 green bottles?
translation: 10个绿瓶子……还是9个绿瓶子？

english: 99 green bottles...
translation: 99个绿瓶子……

english: 508 green bottles...
translation: 508个绿瓶子……

english: Why me?
translation: 为什么是我？

english: Fun party...
translation: 有趣派对……

english: I need a new job.
translation: 我需要新工作。

english: I'd kill for a kebab.
translation: 我为烤肉串拼命。

english: Can't wait for the weekend.
translation: 等不及周末了。

english: I'm hungry.
translation: 我饿了。

english: Where's that relief guard?
translation: 那个换班守卫在哪？

english: I wonder if Ali Morissaneis hiring?
translation: 我在想阿里‧莫里桑在招人吗？

english: Halt thief!
translation: 站住小偷！

english: You've been spotted and teleported a small distance away.
translation: 你被发现了并被传送走了一小段距离。

english: Hey! Get your hands off there!
translation: 嘿！把手拿开！

english: The Sinclairs are under house arrest for crimes against a crown, and it's all thanks to you.
translation: 辛克莱尔家因危害王冠罪被软禁，这都多亏了你。

english: It's more luxury than they deserve.
translation: 那是他们不配的奢华。

english: The guard stares at you suspiciously.
translation: 守卫怀疑地盯着你。

english: Excuse me...
translation: 打扰一下……

english: I don' need a hand drinkin me beer, go 'way!
translation: 我不需要人帮忙喝啤酒，走开！

english: But...
translation: 但是……

english: Talk to tha' hand coz thish face ain't lishtnin'!
translation: 跟那只手说因为这张脸没在听！

english: Yeeeuuuch! I hatesh that shtuff, jusht bring ush a beer! Mmmmm beer!
translation: 噫！我讨厌那东西，就给我们拿啤酒！嗯嗯嗯啤酒！

english: *HIC*
translation: 嗝

english: What are you doing here? You're not one of the guards.
translation: 你在这做什么？你不是守卫之一。

english: I was just exploring. Is that okay?
translation: 我只是在探索。可以吗？

english: I suppose, but why would you want to explore down here?
translation: 我想可以，但你为什么想在这下面探索？

english: Well why not?
translation: 嗯为什么不？

english: It's cold for a start.
translation: 首先很冷。

english: I'd say it's still pretty warm compared to some places I've been.
translation: 我会说跟我去过的一些地方比还是挺暖和的。

english: If you say so. Just don't go causing any trouble.
translation: 你说是就是吧。别惹麻烦就行。

english: Good day. What are you up to?
translation: 你好。你在做什么？

english: My job is to ensure that everyone can use the bank safely. Shifty types always hang around banks, you know.
translation: 我的工作是确保每个人能安全使用银行。你知道狡猾的人总在银行周围徘徊。

english: You're not shifty, are you?
translation: 你不狡猾，对吧？

english: No, of course not.
translation: 不，当然不。

english: Jolly good. Carry on then.
translation: 很好。继续吧。

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 虽然你找到了顾客，但你似乎没带正确的食物！你需要 [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]！

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 恐怕预制菜肴不合要求。唯有手工烹制的地精美食，才配得上阿卢夫航空的顾客。

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Guard Vemmeldo
translation: 你把 [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] 的配送交给守卫维梅尔多

english: Thank you. Be vigilant.
translation: 谢谢。保持警惕。

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 你有 [number] 积分可兑换免费配送代币。你可以让 [number] 份地精美食配送给你。

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: 别忘了从小阿卢夫‧吉安那里领取免费配送代币。

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 配送已超时！请返回小阿卢夫处重新接单。你丢掉了配送箱，因为不再需要了。

english: Please help me with this!
translation: 请帮我这个！

english: Woof! Woof! Woof!
translation: 汪！汪！汪！

english: Woof Woof Bark!
translation: 汪 汪 吠！

english: Woof woof!
translation: 汪汪！

english: The guard dog doesn't take kindly to your presence.
translation: 守卫狗不欢迎你的存在。

english: *sigh* Not another one.
translation: 叹气 不是又一个吧。

english: Another what?
translation: 又一个什么？

english: Another 'archaeologist'.
translation: 又一个‘考古学家’。

english: I'm not going to let you plunder my Master's tomb you know.
translation: 你知道我不会让你掠夺我主人的坟墓。

english: That's a shame, have you got anything else I could do while I'm here?
translation: 真可惜，我在这期间还有什么能做的吗？

english: If it will keep you out of mischief I suppose I could set something up for you...
translation: 如果能让你别捣乱我想我可以给你安排点什么……

english: I have a few rooms full of some things you humans might consider valuable, do you want to give it a go?
translation: 我有几个房间装满了你们人类可能认为有价值的东西，你想试试吗？

english: What should I do?
translation: 我该做什么？

english: You have five minutes to explore the treasure rooms and collect as many artefacts as you can.
translation: 你有五分钟探索宝藏室并尽可能收集文物。

english: The artefacts are in the urns, chests and sarcophagi found in each room.
translation: 文物在每个房间发现的瓮、箱子和石棺里。

english: There are eight treasure rooms, each subsequent room requires higher thieving skills to both enter the room and thieve from the urns and other containers.
translation: 有八个宝藏室，每个后续房间需要更高的盗窃技能才能进入房间并从瓮和其他容器盗窃。

english: The rewards also become more lucrative the further into the tomb you go.
translation: 你越深入坟墓奖励也越丰厚。

english: You will also have to deactivate a trap in order to enter the main part of each room.
translation: 你还必须解除陷阱才能进入每个房间的主要部分。

english: When you want to move onto the next room you need to find the correct door first.
translation: 当你想进入下一个房间时你需要先找到正确的门。

english: There are four possible exits, you must open the door before finding out whether it is the exit or not.
translation: 有四个可能的出口，你必须在知道是否是出口前打开门。

english: Opening the doors require picking their locks. Having a lockpick will make this easier.
translation: 开门需要撬锁。有开锁器会更容易。

english: How do I leave the game?
translation: 我怎么离开游戏？

english: If at any point you decide you need to leave just use a glowing door.
translation: 如果任何时候你决定需要离开只需使用发光的门。

english: The game will end and you will be taken out of the pyramid.
translation: 游戏结束你将被带出金字塔。

english: What about the chests and sarcophagi?
translation: 那箱子和石棺呢？

english: The artefacts are in the urns, chests and sarcophagi.
translation: 文物在瓮、箱子和石棺里。

english: Urns contain snakes that guard them.
translation: 瓮里有蛇守卫。

english: The sarcophagi take some strength to open. They take a while to open.
translation: 石棺需要些力量打开。它们需要时间打开。

english: Of course, Mummies have been known to take a nap in the sarcophagi, so beware.
translation: 当然，众所周知木乃伊会在石棺里小睡，所以小心。

english: The golden chests generally contain better artefacts, but are also trapped with scarabs!
translation: 金箱子通常包含更好的文物，但也困着圣甲虫！

english: Tell me more about these artefacts.
translation: 多告诉我些关于这些文物的事。

english: There are a number of different artefacts, of three main types. The least valuable are the pottery statuettes and scarabs, and the ivory combs.
translation: 有许多不同文物，三种主要类型。最不值钱的是陶雕像和圣甲虫，以及象牙梳。

english: Next are the stone scarabs, statuettes and seals, and finally the gold versions of those artefacts.
translation: 其次是石圣甲虫、雕像和印章，最后是那些文物的金版本。

english: They are not old, but are well made.
translation: 它们不旧，但制作精良。

english: What do I do with artefacts once I've collected them?
translation: 我收集文物后做什么？

english: That Simon Simpleton, I mean Templeton, will probably give you some money for them.
translation: 那个西蒙‧辛普尔顿，我是说坦普尔顿，可能会给你些钱。

english: He couldn't spot a real artefact if it came up to him and bit him in the face.
translation: 如果真文物走到他面前咬他脸他都认不出。

english: He usually slinks about near the pyramid north-east of Sophanem. I expect he's trying to get some poor fools to steal things from that pyramid as well.
translation: 他通常在索菲亚涅姆东北的金字塔附近徘徊。我想他也试图让一些可怜傻瓜从那金字塔偷东西。

english: I expect he'll give you more gold for some than others.
translation: 我想他给某些东西的金币会比其他多。

english: What's this I've heard about a Golden Sceptre?
translation: 我听说关于黄金权杖的是什么？

english: Where did you hear about that?
translation: 你从哪听说的？

english: I couldn't possibly say.
translation: 我不可能说。

english: It's the only genuinely valuable artefact in this place.
translation: 这是这地方唯一真正有价值的文物。

english: It links all the great pyramids in the area, and can be used to travel between them.
translation: 它连接该区域所有大金字塔，可用于它们之间旅行。

english: It requires charging with offerings of fine craftsmanship, that's why we have so many spare artefacts lying around.
translation: 它需要用精美工艺品供奉来充能，那就是为什么我们有这么多备用文物散落在周围。

english: Anyway, I won't let you get your grubby little hands on the sceptre.
translation: 总之，我不会让你脏小手碰到权杖。

english: How do I get the artefacts?
translation: 我怎么得到文物？

english: What do I do with the artefacts I collect?
translation: 我收集的文物做什么？

english: Player is put in the Pyramid Plunder minigame.
translation: 玩家被放入金字塔掠夺小游戏。

english: Not right now.
translation: 现在不要。

english: Well, get out of here then.
translation: 嗯，那滚出去。

english: I know what I'm doing - let's get on with it.
translation: 我知道我在做什么——开始吧。

english: Fine, I'll take you to the first room now...
translation: 好吧，我现在带你去第一个房间……

english: Player is put in the Pyramid Plunder minigame
translation: 玩家被放入金字塔掠夺小游戏

english: I want to charge my sceptre.
translation: 我想给我的权杖充电。

english: What sceptre?
translation: 什么权杖？

english: Er... I don't know.
translation: 呃……我不知道。

english: Right...
translation: 好吧……

english: You shouldn't have that thing in the first place, thief!
translation: 你本来就不该有那东西，小偷！

english: Hmm... If I give you back some of the artefacts I've taken from the tomb, will you recharge the sceptre for me?
translation: 嗯……如果我把我从坟墓拿的一些文物还给你，你会给我 recharge 权杖吗？

english: No! Why would I waste the King's magic when it's already fully charged?
translation: 不！为什么既然已经充满了我还要浪费国王的魔法？

english: *sigh* Oh alright, but this is such a waste of the King's magic...
translation: 叹气 哦好吧，但这真是浪费国王的魔法……

translation: 你需要6个金文物来充能你的权杖。

translation: 好吧，6个文物给你 [x] 次充能。现在走吧。

translation: 你需要12个石文物来充能你的权杖。

translation: 好吧，12个文物给你 [x] 次充能。现在走吧。

translation: 你需要24个陶或象牙文物来充能你的权杖。

translation: 好吧，你已经有 [x] 次充能，我不给折扣。那意味着24个文物给你 [y] 次充能。现在走吧。

english: Right, 24 artefacts gives you [x] charges. Now be on your way.
translation: 好吧，24个文物给你 [x] 次充能。现在走吧。

english: You've had your five minutes of plundering. Now be off with you!
translation: 你五分钟掠夺时间到了。现在滚吧！

english: Right, you already had [amount] charge[s], and I don't give discounts. That means 6 artefacts gives you [amount] charge[s]. Now be on your way.
translation: 好吧，你已经有 [amount] 次充能，我不给折扣。那意味着6个文物给你 [amount] 次充能。现在走吧。

translation: 好吧，6个文物给你 [amount] 次充能。现在走吧。

english: Actually, I've changed my mind.
translation: 其实，我改变主意了。

english: Then clear off!
translation: 那滚开！

english: Can you remind me what I am supposed to do with these?
translation: 你能提醒我该拿这些做什么吗？

english: Thank you!
translation: 谢谢！

english: You have found my Master's Sceptre - You have been here long enough. Begone.
translation: 你找到了我主人的权杖——你在这待够久了。滚。

english: Grrr! Someone has found the Pharaoh's sceptre!
translation: 咕噜！有人找到了法老的权杖！

english: Right! That's it. I'm clearing all the urns and refilling them now.
translation: 好！就这样。我现在清空所有瓮并重新填满。

english: You're not done yet! Do this for me!
translation: 你还没完！为我做这个！

english: The guardian mummy has given you a puzzle box!
translation: 守卫木乃伊给了你一个谜题盒！

english: Scarabs can do puzzles better than that!
translation: 圣甲虫解谜都比那好！

english: Excellent work!
translation: 干得好！

english: The guardian mummy has given you another clue scroll!/You've obtained a casket!
translation: 守卫木乃伊给了你另一个线索卷轴！/你获得了箱子！

english: That sounds like fun, what do I do?
translation: 听起来有趣，我做什么？

translation: 陶和象牙文物。

english: Actually, I'm more interested in plundering the tombs.
translation: 其实，我对掠夺坟墓更感兴趣。

english: Nothing.

translation: 我打败了卢西安！

english: Well done friend! He will not be able to return for a while, this is good news!
translation: 干得好朋友！他一段时间内不能回来，这是好消息！

english: Cheers. Catch you later.
translation: 干杯。回头见。

translation: 我相信你某处存了一个。

english: Hello again Guidor. How are you doing?
translation: 又见面了吉多尔。你怎么样？

english: I'm hanging in there.
translation: 我撑着。

english: Good for you.
translation: 为你好。

english: I don't really want any visitors just now.
translation: 我现在真不想要访客。

english: Hunter Aco reporting for duty!
translation: 猎人助手报到！

english: [Player name] reporting for... nothing in particular, really.
translation: [Player name] 报到……其实没什么特别的。

english: What can I do for you?
translation: 我能为你做什么？

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Hunting, mostly.
translation: 主要狩猎。

english: Hmm, I probably could've guessed that.
translation: 嗯，我大概能猜到。

english: Perhaps you confused me for Teco over there? He's more into plants and all that.
translation: 也许你把我跟那边的特科搞混了？他更喜欢植物之类的。

english: What got you into hunting then?
translation: 那什么让你进入狩猎的？

english: Don't tell too many people, but it's much nicer here than wearing a uniform and marching around!
translation: 别告诉太多人，但这里比穿制服到处行进好多了！

english: I'm still not sure how I feel about having Teco around the whole time though. People confuse us too often for my liking.
translation: 不过我还是不确定让特科一直在周围感觉如何。人们太常把我们搞混了我不喜欢。

english: See you later.
translation: 回头见。

english: Can I get a rumour?
translation: 能接个传闻任务吗？

english: You're new here, aren't you? You might want to talk to Verity before you get started.
translation: 你是新来的，对吧？开始前你可能想跟维瑞蒂谈谈。

english: Could you check out the validity of this report for me? Someone thinks they've seen a [creature]. Once you find it, bring back one of its [rare parts].
translation: 你能帮我检查这个报告的有效性吗？有人觉得他们看到了 [creature]。一旦找到，带回它的一个 [rare parts]。

english: There's been rumours of a rare [creature] coming in. Once you find it, bring back one of its [rare parts].
translation: 有传闻说稀有 [creature] 来了。一旦找到，带回它的一个 [rare parts]。

english: We've got reports of a slightly different [creature] in the local population. Once you find it, bring back one of its [rare parts].
translation: 我们有报告说当地种群中有 slightly different [creature]。一旦找到，带回它的一个 [rare parts]。

english: Looks like we need some information on a unique specimen amongst the local [creature] population. Once you find it, bring back some of its [rare parts].
translation: 看来我们需要当地 [creature] 种群中独特标本的信息。一旦找到，带回它的一些 [rare parts]。

english: I've heard rumours of a strange [creature] that you could check out for me. Once you find it, bring back one of its [rare parts].
translation: 我听说奇怪 [creature] 的传闻你可以帮我检查。一旦找到，带回它的一个 [rare parts]。

english: Thanks for doing that for me. Here's your reward.
translation: 谢谢你为我做那个。这是你的奖励。

english: Would you like another rumour?
translation: 你想要另一个传闻吗？

english: Thanks for that. I'll mark off that report for you. Would you like another rumour?
translation: 谢谢，我帮你把这个报告标记为已完成。你想要另一个传闻吗？

english: You're hunting for me at the moment. This rumour was about a [creature]. You'll need to bring back some of its [rare parts].
translation: 你此刻在为我狩猎。这个传闻是关于 [creature] 的。你需要带回它的一些 [rare parts]。

english: I hear you're hunting for [Guild Hunter]. Aren't you looking for a [creature] at the moment? You'll need to bring back some of its [rare parts].
translation: 我听说你在为 [Guild Hunter] 狩猎。你现在不是在找 [creature] 吗？你需要带回它的一些 [rare parts]。

english: Unless you fancy hunting for me instead?
translation: 除非你想改为为我狩猎？

english: Now then... I asked you to hunt a [creature] for me and bring back one of its [rare parts].
translation: 那么……我让你为我狩猎 [creature] 并带回它的一个 [rare parts]。

english: Heard we're having an intel reshuffle. You should probably focus on your current task for now.
translation: 听说我们要情报重组。你现在应该专注于当前任务。
