english: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: You look like you could use a little colour in your life! Can I interest you in any dyes?
translation: 你看起来生活里缺了点色彩！要不要看看染料？

english: I could take a look.
translation: 我可以看看。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Well, don't be afraid to come back any time!
translation: 嗯，别怕随时回来！

english: I could take a look.
translation: 我可以看看。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: What a pretty bird you are!
translation: 你真是只漂亮的鸟！

english: Chirp chirp!
translation: 叽叽 叽叽！

english: Gull gobbles up the raw [fish].
translation: 海鸥吞下生 [fish]。

english: Chirp! chirp!
translation: 叽叽！叽叽！

english: Gull refuses the item.
translation: 海鸥拒绝物品。

english: Caw!
translation: 嘎！

english: Your pet grows up before your very eyes!
translation: 你的宠物在你眼前长大了！

english: Caw! That hit the spot.
translation: 嘎！那正合我意。

english: Chirp!
translation: 叽叽！

english: So what exactly are you? I can't tell if you're a bird or some kind of cat... thing.
translation: 那你到底是什么？我分不清你是鸟还是某种猫……东西。

english: What kind of question is that? I'm a gryphon.
translation: 那是什么问题？我是狮鹫。

english: You remind me of a seagull, except much bigger and with claws.
translation: 你让我想起海鸥，除了大得多且有爪子。

english: You remind me of a monkey, except well dressed and somehow even more annoying.
translation: 你让我想起猴子，除了穿着得体且不知怎的更烦人。

english: Well, they say that comparison is the thief of joy, so how about we stop this line of thought.
translation: 嗯，他们说比较是快乐的小偷，所以我们停止这个思路怎么样。

english: Fine by me. Caw!
translation: 我没意见。嘎！

english: If you talk to me like that again, you'll promptly find yourself down one finger.
translation: 如果你再那样跟我说话，你会很快发现自己少根手指。

english: Wow, you can talk! Can all gryphons talk? Are you like parrots?
translation: 哇，你会说话！所有狮鹫都会说话吗？你像鹦鹉吗？

english: I haven't met every gryphon. You took me from the nest remember?
translation: 我没见过每只狮鹫。你把我从巢里带走记得吗？

english: Oh, right.
translation: 哦，好的。

english: I'd rather enjoy the opportunity to meet a parrot. It sounds tasty.
translation: 我宁愿享受见鹦鹉的机会。听起来好吃。

english: Gulliver gobbles up the raw [fish].
translation: 格列佛吞下生 [fish]。

english: How delightful.
translation: 多愉快。

english: Mine!
translation: 我的！

english: Caw!
translation: 嘎！

english: Ca-caw!
translation: 嘎 - 嘎！

english: Finest silver in all of Keldagrim, come and see!
translation: 凯尔达格林城最好的银子，来看看！

english: Right, what do you have?
translation: 好吧，你有什么？

english: Silver, what else!
translation: 银子，还有什么！

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: That's my silver!
translation: 那是我的银子！

english: Halt, thief!
translation: 站住，小偷！

english: Guards, catch that thief!
translation: 守卫，抓住那个小偷！

english: Right, what do you have?
translation: 好吧，你有什么？

english: Not interested, thanks.
translation: 没兴趣，谢谢。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Good day brave adventurer! Could I interest you in my fine selection of weapons?
translation: 你好，勇敢的冒险者！要不要看看我的精选武器？

english: I'll take a look.
translation: 我看看。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Grrrr!
translation: 咕噜！

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 虽然你找到了顾客，但你似乎没带正确的食物！你需要 [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]！

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 恐怕预制菜肴不合要求。唯有手工烹制的地精美食，才配得上阿卢夫航空的顾客。

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Gulluck
translation: 你把 [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] 的配送交给古拉克

english: Thanks. Hmph.
translation: 谢谢。哼。

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
translation: 你有 [number] 积分可兑换免费配送代币。你还没资格获得地精美食配送。

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 你有 [number] 积分可兑换免费配送代币。你可以让 [number] 份地精美食配送给你。

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: 别忘了从小阿卢夫‧吉安那里领取免费配送代币。

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 配送已超时！请返回小阿卢夫处重新接单。你丢掉了配送箱，因为不再需要了。

english: I'll take a look.
translation: 我看看。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Hello, what are you doing out here?
translation: 你好，你在这里做什么？

english: I'm a banker, the only one around these dangerous parts.
translation: 我是银行职员，这危险区域唯一的银行职员。

english: Well, now I know.
translation: 嗯，现在我知道了。

english: Knowledge is power my friend.
translation: 知识就是力量，我的朋友。

english: Cool, I'd like to access my bank account please.
translation: 我想查看我的银行账户。

english: Right, so can I check my PIN settings?
translation: 好吧，那我能检查我的 PIN 设置吗？

english: I'd like to collect items.
translation: 我想领取物品。

english: Well, now I know.
translation: 嗯，现在我知道了。

english: Bat shish kebab! Spicy bat-meat on a stick! How about a bat kebab for 10gp, human?
translation: 蝙蝠烤肉串！串上的辣蝙蝠肉！来个蝙蝠烤肉串10金币怎么样，人类？

english: Yes please!
translation: 好的，谢谢！

english: There you go.
translation: 给，拿好。

english: But I don't have enough money on me.
translation: 但我身上没足够钱。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Spicy kebabs!
translation: 辣烤肉串！

english: Bat kebabs!
translation: 蝙蝠烤肉串！

english: Spicy bat kebabs!
translation: 辣蝙蝠烤肉串！

english: Bat shish kebabs!
translation: 蝙蝠烤肉串！

english: Kebabs!
translation: 烤肉串！

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Ah, isn't it a lovely day?
translation: 啊，今天不是个好日子吗？

english: It's not bad. What puts you in such a good mood?
translation: 不错。什么让你心情这么好？

english: Oh, I just love my job. The smell of the sea breeze, the smell of the arctic pine sap, the smell of the yaks. I find it all so bracing.
translation: 我就是爱这份工作。海风的气息、北极松脂的清香、牦牛的味道，这些都让我神清气爽。

english: Bracing? Hmmm. I think I might have chosen a different word.
translation: 神清气爽？嗯，我可能该换个词形容。

english: Haha welcome to my obstacle course. Have fun, but remember this isn't a child's playground. People have died here.
translation: 哈哈欢迎来到我的障碍课程。玩得开心，但记住这不是儿童游乐场。有人死在这里。

english: The best way to train, is to go round the course in a clockwise direction.
translation: 最好的训练方式，是顺时针绕课程走。

english: Please solve this for me. I have other things to be thinking about.
translation: 请帮我解这个。我有别的事要想。

english: Gunnjorn has given you a puzzle box!
translation: 冈约恩给了你一个谜题盒！

english: Sorry but you haven't solved the puzzle yet.
translation: 抱歉但你还没解开谜题。

english: I don't have the puzzle box with me.
translation: 我没带谜题盒。

english: That's not much use is it, go and fetch it!
translation: 那没什么用对吧，去把它拿来！

english: Thanks [player name]!
translation: 谢谢 [player name]！

english: What can I interest you in? We have something of everything here!
translation: 我能让你对什么感兴趣？我们这里什么都有！

english: Oh good!
translation: 哦好！

english: Nothing, thanks.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。

english: Hullo, [player name]. Interested in doing a little job for me?
translation: 你好，[player name]。有兴趣为我做点小工作吗？

english: Sounds interesting, what can I do for you?
translation: 听起来有趣，我能为你做什么？

english: I've got a very specific task for you, for a very special customer. Can you get me [item] in the next [15-20] minutes?
translation: 我有个非常具体的任务给你，为一个非常特别的顾客。你能在接下来的 [15-20] 分钟内给我 [item] 吗？

english: Er, you want [item]?
translation: 呃，你想要 [item]？

english: For a very special customer, yes.
translation: 为一个非常特别的顾客，是的。

english: Right, then... I'll get you [item] in the next [15-20] minutes. I'm on it.
translation: 好吧，那么……我会在接下来的 [15-20] 分钟内给你 [item]。我在做。

english: I'm not interested, no.
translation: 我没兴趣，不。

english: I'm really sorry to hear that, I thought you were just the human for the job.
translation: 听到那我真的抱歉，我以为你正是做这工作的人类。

english: Let's see now... Can you get me [X] [item] in the next [X] minutes?
translation: 让我看看……你能在接下来的 [X] 分钟内给我 [X] [item] 吗？

english: Right, then... I'll get you [X] [item] in the next [X] minutes. I'm on it.
translation: 好吧，那么……我会在接下来的 [X] 分钟内给你 [X] [item]。我在做。

english: Did you get me [item], [player name]? I don't really have an awful lot of time anymore.
translation: 你给我拿到 [item] 了吗，[player name]？我真的没太多时间了。

english: I don't know and I don't care. I quit!
translation: 我不知道我也不在乎。我不干了！

english: No need to be rude about it! Especially since you promised me!
translation: 没必要那么粗鲁！特别是既然你答应过我！

english: Just give me a little bit more time.
translation: 就给我多一点时间。

english: Sure, but please hurry up!
translation: 当然，但请快点！

english: [player name], you didn't get me my [item] within the [X] minutes I gave you. I'm disappointed.
translation: [player name]，你没在我给你的 [X] 分钟内给我 [item]。我很失望。

english: Sorry, I just ran out of time.
translation: 抱歉，我只是没时间了。

english: Don't worry about it, I've got your [item] right here.
translation: 别担心，我这里有你的 [item]。

english: It's too late for that. What am I supposed to do with [item] now?
translation: 那太晚了。我现在该拿 [item] 怎么办？

english: Am I still on time? I've got you [X] [item]!
translation: 我还准时吗？我给你拿到了 [X] [item]！

english: You certainly are! Thank you very much!
translation: 你当然是！非常感谢！

english: Do you want me to pay you in gold or would you prefer me to tell you about some crafting secrets?
translation: 你想让我用金币付你还是更愿意我告诉你一些制作秘密？

english: Do you want me to pay you in gold or would you prefer me to teach you a bit about how you can mine more efficiently?
translation: 你想让我用金币付你还是更愿意我教你一点如何更高效采矿？

english: Do you want me to pay you in gold or would you like me to show you some smithing tricks?
translation: 你想让我用金币付你还是愿意我展示你一些锻造技巧？

english: I'd like the gold.
translation: 我想要金币。

english: Please teach me that.
translation: 请教教我。

english: You feel more experienced.
translation: 你的经验值提升了。

english: Show me the gold!
translation: 把金币给我！

english: Enlighten me.
translation: 指点我吧。

english: Oh good!
translation: 哦好！

english: Nothing, thanks.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。

english: Sounds interesting, what can I do for you?
translation: 听起来有趣，我能为你做什么？

english: I'm not interested, no.
translation: 我没兴趣，不。

english: I don't know and I don't care. I quit!
translation: 我不知道我也不在乎。我不干了！

english: Just give me a little bit more time.
translation: 就给我多一点时间。

english: I'd like the gold.
translation: 我想要金币。

english: Please teach me that.
translation: 请教教我。

english: Show me the gold!
translation: 把金币给我！

english: Enlighten me.
translation: 指点我吧。

english: Ah, you've come for fight!
translation: 啊，你是来打架的！

english: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？

english: What are you offering?
translation: 你提供什么？

english: A fight!
translation: 打架！

english: You look funny!
translation: 你看起来好笑！

english: Wanna fight?
translation: 想打架吗？

english: Grrr!
translation: 咕噜！

english: Go away!
translation: 走开！

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: Hello sir, it's Christmas!
translation: 你好先生，是圣诞节！

english: Merry Christmas!
translation: 圣诞快乐！

english: Hello Buoy and Gurl!
translation: 你好波伊和格尔！

english: Hello sir!
translation: 你好先生！

english: How do you know our names?
translation: 你怎么知道我们的名字？

english: I had a chat with your dad. He's super busy, so he's asked me to help you build a snowman!
translation: 我和你爸爸聊了聊。他超级忙，所以他让我帮你们堆雪人！

english: Really? We get to make a snowman?
translation: 真的？我们可以堆雪人？

english: Yes! And I'm going to build whatever snowman you want!
translation: 是的！我要堆任何你们想要的雪人！

english: Yay! Can it be three snowballs tall?
translation: 耶！能有三个雪球高吗？

english: But I want it to be five tall!
translation: 但我想要五个高！

english: Five is a bad number, it should be three tall!
translation: 五是个坏数字，应该是三个高！

english: You're a bad number. Five is so much better.
translation: 你是个坏数字。五好多了。

english: Okay, okay, wait a second. Why don't we meet in the middle. How about four snowballs tall?
translation: 好吧，好吧，等一下。我们为什么不如折中。四个雪球高怎么样？

english: Fine, it can be four tall.
translation: 好吧，可以四个高。

english: Yes, four tall is okay.
translation: 是的，四个高可以。

english: Great. Now, we need to pick what size snowballs we want for each tier. Why don't you take it in turns? You can do two each.
translation: 太好了。现在，我们需要选每层想要什么尺寸的雪球。为什么不如轮流？你们可以各选两个。

english: The bottom one should be a huge snowball!
translation: 最下面的应该是个巨大的雪球！

english: The next one should be big!
translation: 下一个应该大的！

english: This is working nicely, we're half way! What about the top two parts?
translation: 进展挺顺利的，已经完成一半了！上面两部分怎么样？

english: The next one should be a small snowball!
translation: 下一个应该是个小雪球！

english: No, it should be little!
translation: 不，应该是小的！

english: But it needs to be small, little would look bad.
translation: 但它需要是小的，小的会看起来不好。

english: It wouldn't look bad. Small is better for decorations.
translation: 不会看起来不好。小的更适合装饰。

english: My decorations will fit on a little one.
translation: 我的装饰会适合小的。

english: Why do you always ruin everything?
translation: 你为什么总是毁了一切？

english: You ruin everything with your silly ideas!
translation: 你用你的愚蠢想法毁了一切！

english: Okay, okay, wait. This clearly isn't working, and I don't want you two to fall out. It's Christmas, we shouldn't be arguing!
translation: 好吧，好吧，等。这显然不行，我不想你们两个闹翻。是圣诞节，我们不该争吵！

english: How about I make you both a snowman? It can be whatever height and size you like. One each!
translation: 我给你们各堆个雪人怎么样？可以是你们喜欢的任何高度和尺寸。每人一个！

english: So mine can be five snowballs tall?
translation: 那我的可以五个雪球高？

english: And mine can be three snowballs tall?
translation: 那我的可以三个雪球高？

english: Yes, I'll make you both whatever snowman you like!
translation: 是的，我会给你们堆任何你们喜欢的雪人！

english: What would you both like?
translation: 你们两个想要什么？

english: I'd like mine to be three snowballs tall please! And I want the bottom one to be small, the middle one big, and the top one huge!
translation: 我想要我的三个雪球高！我想要最下面的小，中间的大，最上面的巨大！

english: I'd like mine to be five snowballs tall please! I want the bottom one to be humongous, then large, then normal, then big, and then a little one for the top!
translation: 我想要我的五个雪球高！我想要最下面的超大，然后大，然后正常，然后大，然后最上面一个小的！

english: That's two very different snowmen, I see why this didn't work before!
translation: 那是两个非常不同的雪人，我明白为什么这之前不行了！

english: What do all these different sizes mean? Humongous? Normal? Little? How big are those?
translation: 所有这些不同尺寸什么意思？超大？正常？小？那些多大？

english: You silly billy! Humongous is the biggest snowball of course!
translation: 你这傻孩子！超大当然是最大的雪球！

english: Normal is the normal size that you get when you make a snowball normally. It's easy!
translation: 正常是你正常堆雪球时得到的正常尺寸。很简单！

english: Right, thank you for clearing that up. I'll figure something out.
translation: 好吧，谢谢澄清。我会想办法。

english: What are you two going to do for decorations?
translation: 你们两个打算做什么装饰？

english: I already know what I want mine to look like!
translation: 我已经知道我想要我的看起来像什么！

english: Me too!
translation: 我也是！

english: Why don't you guys find some decorations while I build the snowmen? Then you can add them once I'm done.
translation: 不如你们去找装饰，我来堆雪人怎么样？然后我完成后你们可以加上。

english: Okay sir!
translation: 好的！

english: We will do that!
translation: 我们会那样做！

english: Well, that seems sorted. I should speak to Larry again, and see if he has any advice about building the snowmen.
translation: 嗯，那似乎解决了。我应该再跟拉里谈谈，看看他有没有关于堆雪人的建议。

english: Hello there!
translation: 你好！

english: Have you started making the snowmen yet?
translation: 你开始堆雪人了吗？

english: You should talk to dad if you need some help, he knows how to make snowmen!
translation: 如果你需要帮助应该跟爸爸谈谈，他知道怎么堆雪人！

english: Yeah, he always used to make really big ones with us!
translation: 是的，他总是跟我们一起堆真的很大的！

english: Maybe I'll go talk to him and see what advice he has.
translation: 也许我去跟他谈谈看看他有什么建议。

english: He'll say, make them really tall!
translation: 他会说，堆得真的很高！

english: He'll say make them shorter, because that's better!
translation: 他会说堆得矮点，因为那更好！

english: I should go and speak to Larry. I'm sure he has some handy advice for me!
translation: 我应该去跟拉里谈谈。我相信他有些方便的建议给我！

english: That looks good! It needs a [size] snowball next!
translation: 那看起来不错！接下来需要个 [size] 雪球！

english: They're done! They're so cool!
translation: 它们完成了！它们太酷了！

english: Yay! Can we decorate them now?
translation: 耶！我们现在能装饰它们吗？

english: Yes! Can we decorate them now please [player name]?
translation: 是的！我们现在能装饰它们吗请 [player name]？

english: Of course you can. Are they what you wanted?
translation: 当然可以。它们是你想要的吗？

english: Mine is perfect!
translation: 我的完美！

english: Mine too. It's just how I wanted it.
translation: 我的也是。正是我想要的。

english: I am happy to hear that. It was harder work than I thought.
translation: 我很高兴听到那个。那比我想的更难工作。

english: You did a good job. Thank you very much [sir/madam].
translation: 你做得好。非常感谢 [sir/madam]。

english: Yes, thank you [sir/madam]!
translation: 是的，谢谢 [sir/madam]！

english: It was no problem. Merry Christmas to you both!
translation: 没问题。祝你们两个圣诞快乐！

english: I should go and speak to Larry. Hopefully he has that festive white wine ready for me.
translation: 我应该去跟拉里谈谈。希望他为我准备好了节日白葡萄酒。

english: Those snowmen look amazing!
translation: 那些雪人看起来太棒了！

english: Thank you! Decorating them was quite hard!
translation: 谢谢！装饰它们相当难！

english: Yeah, they took ages to do! Do you like mine?
translation: 是的，它们花了好久做！你喜欢我的吗？

english: It's really good! Reminds me of something actually.
translation: 真的很好！其实让我想起某事。

english: What about mine? Do you like it?
translation: 那我的呢？你喜欢吗？

english: I like yours too. They both remind me of something!
translation: 我也喜欢你的。它们都让我想起某事！

english: Mine is Thermy! My favourite monster! She's so big and scary, makes me go woah!
translation: 我的是瑟米！我最喜欢的怪物！她那么大那么可怕，让我哇！

english: Mine is Tempy! My favourite monster! He lives in the water, a huge mass of angry wet!
translation: 我的是海灵！我最喜欢的怪物！他住在水里，就是一大团愤怒的水元素！

english: They're both amazing! I didn't know you guys would be so good at decorating.
translation: 它们都太棒了！我不知道你们这么擅长装饰。

english: Dad lets us decorate every year. We get a lot of practice!
translation: 爸爸让我们每年装饰。我们有很多练习！

english: Last year we made them into the Fragment of Seren and the King Black Dragon!
translation: 去年我们把它们做成瑟琳碎片和黑龙王！

english: What... really??? I'd like to have seen that. Those sound even more difficult than these two!
translation: 什么……真的？？？我想看看那个。那些听起来比这两个更难！

english: How do you know all these monsters anyway? There is no way your dad would let you anywhere near them!
translation: 你们怎么知道所有这些怪物的？你们爸爸绝不会让你们靠近它们！

english: Dad reads us lots of stories, and we hear about them from passing adventurers, like you.
translation: 爸爸给我们读很多故事，我们从路过的冒险者那里听说它们，像你。

english: You must meet some interesting and cool adventurers!
translation: 你们一定遇到些有趣酷的冒险者！

english: Not as cool as you though; none of them helped us make our snowmen!
translation: 不过没你酷；他们都没帮我们堆雪人！

english: Yes, you're the first to help us make them!
translation: 是的，你是第一个帮我们堆它们的！

english: Well, you're welcome. I really enjoyed it. What are you guys going to do now you're finished?
translation: 嗯，不用客气。我真的很享受。你们现在完成了打算做什么？

english: We're going to go and play! And maybe visit the festival. Will you be there?
translation: 我们要去玩！也许去参观节日。你会在那吗？

english: I sure will be. Maybe see you there!
translation: 我肯定会在。也许在那见！

english: Bye sir, Merry Christmas.
translation: 再见先生，圣诞快乐。

english: Merry Christmas, have fun!
translation: 圣诞快乐，玩得开心！

english: Look, here come 'nother wan'be jubbly chaser.
translation: 看，又来了个想追胖食人鸟的家伙。

english: Be nice, Gurt, or you'll scare off another one!
translation: 友善点，格特，不然你又要把人吓跑了！

english: Another what? What are you two doing here?
translation: 又一个什么？你们两个在这干嘛？

english: Me's big boss of of dis boatsie skill test. Call it Jubbly Jive. Only best wiv boatsies can hunt da jubblies.
translation: 俺是这船技测试的大老板。叫它胖食人鸟舞。只有船技最好的才能猎胖食人鸟。

english: Gurtob is da bestest jubbly hunter in all of da seas. No one surpass Gurtob.
translation: 格托布是所有海域最棒的胖食人鸟猎人。没人比得过格托布。

english: Boatsies? Jubblies? Skill test? What's going on here.
translation: 船？胖食人鸟？技能测试？这是怎么回事。

english: I'll take it from here, Gurt.
translation: 我来接手吧，格特。

english: Dis... Sorry, this corner of the Shrouded Ocean is where we Barracudas like to challenge ourselves to a fun Barracuda Trial called the Jubbly Jive.
translation: 这……抱歉，这片迷雾海的角落是我们梭鱼俱乐部喜欢挑战自己的地方，有个有趣的梭鱼试炼叫胖食人鸟舞。

english: While he may not look it, Gurtob here is actually an expert sailor and trial master for the Barracudas.
translation: 别看他这副模样，格托布其实是梭鱼俱乐部的资深水手兼试炼大师。

english: An ogre is a trial master for the Barracudas? That's surprising.
translation: 一个食人魔是梭鱼俱乐部的试炼大师？真令人惊讶。

english: Not at all! He may be rough around the edges and difficult to understand at times, but he's a fantastic sailor and that's the only thing us Barracudas care about.
translation: 一点也不！他可能有点粗鲁，有时难以理解，但他是个很棒的水手，那是我们梭鱼俱乐部唯一在乎的事。

english: I see. So what do I do here? What's the challenge?
translation: 我明白了。那我在这做什么？挑战是什么？

english: Creatures talk... talk... long. Go da fastest, grab da toadies, throw da toadies, trick da jubblies, eat da jubblies. Dat's it.
translation: 生物说话……说话……太长。跑最快，抓蟾蜍，扔蟾蜍，骗胖食人鸟，吃胖食人鸟。就这。

english: I'm not sure I follow.
translation: 我不太明白。

english: Weak creature needs more boatsie skills first.
translation: 弱小的生物需要先练练船技。

english: Yes, you'd probably benefit from testing your sailing skills elsewhere before attempting this trial.
translation: 是的，在尝试这个试炼前，你可能需要在别处测试一下你的航海技能。

english: Thanks for the advice. I'll bear that in mind.
translation: 谢谢你的建议。我会记住的。

english: You require a Sailing level of 55 to take on the Jubbly Jive.
translation: 你需要55级航海才能参加胖食人鸟舞。

english: The goal of this trial is to use balloon toads to lure jubblies. First up, you'll want to sail west to collect da... sorry, collect the balloon toads from a boat of ours.
translation: 这个试炼的目标是用气球蟾蜍引诱胖食人鸟。首先，你要向西航行，从我们的一艘船上收集……抱歉，收集气球蟾蜍。

english: On your way, keep an eye out for any lost supplies. You'll need to collect all of them to complete the trial.
translation: 路上留意任何丢失的补给。你需要收集所有补给才能完成试炼。

english: Sailing over rapids will give you a burst of speed! Try to go over as many as you can. The more rapids you go through in quick succession, the faster you'll go!
translation: 驶过急流能大幅提升航速！尽量多过几个。连续通过的急流越多，速度就越快！

english: As you continue sailing west, keep an eye out for the jubblies. Remembering where they are will help you later in the trial. They tend to be perched on top of rocky outcrops or trees growing out of the water.
translation: 继续向西航行时，留意胖食人鸟。记住它们的位置会在试炼后期帮到你。它们往往栖息在岩石突起或长出水面的树上。

english: The total number of them will depend on the rank you're going for. They're also fairly consistent, so your experience should be the same during each trial attempt.
translation: 数量取决于你想挑战的等级。它们的分布相当固定，所以每次尝试的路线基本一致。

english: Once you've sailed far enough west, you should be able to spot the boat where you can collect the balloon toads from. The maximum amount you can collect depends on the rank you're going for.
translation: 一旦你向西航行得足够远，你应该能看到可以收集气球蟾蜍的船。你能收集的最大数量取决于你追求的等级。

english: Once you've collected some balloon toads, you'll want to start sailing back this way so you can begin luring the jubblies.
translation: 一旦你收集了一些气球蟾蜍，你就该开始往回航行，这样可以开始引诱胖食人鸟。

english: As you sail, watch out for the extra thick stagnant patches of water. They'll slow down any boat, so do your best to avoid them.
translation: 航行时注意避开那些特别浓稠的死水区。它们会严重拖慢船只，尽量绕开。

english: As you keep making your way back, you'll want to start luring the jubblies back with you. The goal is to lure all of them back to us here.
translation: 当你继续往回走时，你要开始把胖食人鸟引诱回来。目标是将它们全部引诱回我们这里。

english: To lure a jubbly, look out for empty outcrops similar to the ones they like to perch on. If you throw a balloon toad at one of these outcrops, a nearby jubbly will move to it.
translation: 要引诱胖食人鸟，留意它们喜欢栖息的类似空突起。如果你把气球蟾蜍扔向其中一个突起，附近的胖食人鸟就会移过去。

english: It's worth noting that jubblies will only travel to the closest outcrop to them, so you'll need to lure them one outcrop at a time. Make sure to keep track of where you've thrown toads and where the jubblies started.
translation: 值得注意的是，胖食人鸟只会移动到离它们最近的突起，所以你需要一次一个突起地引诱它们。确保跟踪你扔了蟾蜍的位置和胖食人鸟的起始位置。

english: When attempting higher ranks, you may want to set up balloon toads at multiple outcrops ahead of time!
translation: 尝试更高等级时，你可能想提前在多个突起处设置气球蟾蜍！

english: While the jubblies are important, don't forget to keep collecting the lost supplies as you come back as well.
translation: 虽然胖食人鸟很重要，但回来时别忘了继续收集丢失的补给。

english: If you can lure all the jubblies and collect all the lost supplies in the time given, you'll be awarded a Barracuda rank! Each trial has three ranks: Swordfish, Shark or Marlin. Each rank is harder than the last.
translation: 如果你能在规定时间内引诱所有胖食人鸟并收集所有丢失的补给，你将获得梭鱼俱乐部等级！每个试炼有三个等级：剑鱼、鲨鱼或马林鱼。每个等级都比上一个难。

english: For this trial, you'll be asked to lure additional jubblies and collect even more lost supplies as the rank increases.
translation: 对于这个试炼，随着等级提高，你将被要求引诱额外的胖食人鸟并收集更多丢失的补给。

english: You can't attempt the next rank until you beat the one before it. You can also try unranked if you'd like to warm up beforehand.
translation: 你必须击败前一个等级才能尝试下一个等级。如果你想事先热身，也可以尝试无等级。

english: See, is like Gurtob said so. Go da fastest, grab da toadies, throw da toadies, trick da jubblies, eat da jubblies. Dat's it.
translation: 看，就像格托布说的。跑最快，抓蟾蜍，扔蟾蜍，骗胖食人鸟，吃胖食人鸟。就这。

english: I see. Do you have any tips or tricks for me?
translation: 我明白了。你有什么提示或技巧给我吗？

english: Of course!
translation: 当然！

english: First up, you're going to need a boat with at least a mithril helm in order to withstand the strong rapids here, but don't forget, provided you can withstand them, they'll give you a burst of speed!
translation: 首先，你的船至少得装上秘银舵，才能扛住这里的强劲急流。不过别忘了，只要扛得住，急流能给你大幅加速！

english: Secondly, you really want to try to avoid the fetid pools around us. They won't harm you or your boat, but they will completely kill all momentum you've built up.
translation: 其次，尽量避开周围的腐臭水潭。它们虽不会伤害船体，但会彻底抵消你积累的所有冲势。

english: The only way to get across them is by using a wind catcher, but even then the timing is tricky, so we only give those out to sailors who have achieved at least Shark rank here.
translation: 越过它们的唯一方法是使用捕风器，但即使那样时机也很棘手，所以我们只把它们发给在这里达到至少鲨鱼等级的水手。

english: Thirdly, trim your sails frequently to build up even more speed, but be careful! While it's important to go fast, doing so can make it harder to navigate around the fetid pools.
translation: 第三，勤调帆角能进一步提速，但要当心！追求高速的同时，也会让你更难绕过腐臭水潭。

english: If I were you, I'd consider briefly lowering your speed for those tricky turns to avoid getting your boat stuck.
translation: 如果我是你，我会考虑在这些棘手转弯处短暂降低速度，以避免船卡住。

english: Hah! Gurtob sail never go down. Only go fastest.
translation: 哈！格托布航行从不减速。只走最快。

english: Finally, and you probably don't need to be told, but watch out for those rocks, hitting them will put a stop to all of your momentum, just like the pools.
translation: 最后，虽然不用我多提醒，但小心那些暗礁，撞上它们会直接让你丧失所有冲势，跟进水潭一样。

english: I'd like to attempt the Jubbly Jive.
translation: 我想尝试胖食人鸟舞。

english: You should make sure your helm is manned before starting the trial.
translation: 开始前你应该确保船舵有人操作。

english: For this Barracuda Trial you are not allowed to bring any crewmates.
translation: 对于这个梭鱼试炼，你不允许带任何船员。

english: Can you help me transfer my crew away?
translation: 你能帮我把船员转移走吗？

english: Yes, I suppose so.
translation: 是的，我想可以。

english: I'll come back another time.
translation: 我改天再来。

english: Can you tell me about the Jubbly Jive?
translation: 你能跟我讲讲胖食人鸟舞吗？

english: Dis wat Gurtob best at! Dancin' wif da jubblies.
translation: 这是格托布最擅长的！跟胖食人鸟跳舞。

english: He's right, you know. Whilst exploring the ocean, a group of Barracudas saw Gurtob 'sailing' around this place on what could barely be described as a boat, hunting jubblies.
translation: 他是对的，你知道。当探索海洋时，一群梭鱼俱乐部看到格托布在这个地方“航行”，用的东西勉强能称为船，猎杀胖食人鸟。

english: Dey join in and try steal Gurtob jub jubs! But creatures nice and give Gurtob strong boatsie. Now Gurtob friends.
translation: 他们加入并试图偷格托布的胖食人鸟！但生物很好，给了格托布强壮的船。现在格托布是朋友。

english: Gurtob friends indeed! When the Barracudas tried it themselves, they realised how much fun it was sailing around these tight spaces. They worked with Gurtob to design this trial!
translation: 格托布确实是朋友！当梭鱼俱乐部自己尝试时，他们意识到在这些狭窄空间航行有多有趣。他们与格托布合作设计了这个试炼！

english: Gurtob make bestest trial back then! Now yous little creatures make it easier, but me think it still best.
translation: 格托布那时做了最好的试炼！现在你们这些小生物让它更容易了，但俺觉得它仍然最好。

english: It's true that some claim the trial is easier now than before due to new pathways being carved through the fetid pools. Still, don't let that fool you! The course is still a tricky one!
translation: 确实有人声称试炼现在比以前容易了，因为腐臭水潭中新开辟了路径。不过，别被那骗了！路线仍然很棘手！

english: So what do I need to do during the trial?
translation: 那么试炼期间我需要做什么？

english: Go da fastest, grab da toadies, throw da toadies, trick da jubblies, eat da jubblies. Dat's it.
translation: 跑最快，抓蟾蜍，扔蟾蜍，骗胖食人鸟，吃胖食人鸟。就这。

english: Let me explain it in non-Gurtob terms...
translation: 让我用普通人能听懂的话解释一下……

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Me's Gurtob. Da fastest jubbly hunter on boatsies and big boss of dis boatsie skill test.
translation: 俺是格托布。船上最快的胖食人鸟猎人，这船技测试的大老板。

english: And I'm Ros. I'm fairly new to the Barracudas and I help Gurtob out with managing this trial.
translation: 我是罗斯。我刚加入梭鱼俱乐部不久，我帮助格托布管理这个试炼。

english: He's not much of a speaker and is easily misunderstood, so I help translate and make sure that any up and coming prospective Barracudas understand exactly what they need to do.
translation: 他不太会说话，容易被误解，所以我帮忙翻译，确保任何有前途的预备梭鱼俱乐部成员确切理解他们需要做什么。

english: Why stay out here in this awful smelling place? Aren't there better places to be at sea?
translation: 为什么待在这个臭气熏天的地方？海上没有更好的地方吗？

english: Dis Gurtob home. Only funny smelly is you's scrawny creatures.
translation: 这是格托布的家。唯一好笑臭的是你们这些瘦弱生物。

english: Gurtob find funny when you's creatures gets stucks in bubbly watery. Gurtob also likes when you's creatures bring da jubblies.
translation: 格托布觉得你们这些生物卡在泡泡水里很有趣。格托布也喜欢你们这些生物带来胖食人鸟。

english: I get what's in it for him, but what's in it for you, Ros?
translation: 我明白他有什么好处，但你有什么好处，罗斯？

english: Well, after joining the Barracudas, I discovered a fascination for different cultures. This is just a small step in my personal journey to understand more about the world!
translation: 嗯，加入梭鱼俱乐部后，我发现了对不同文化的迷恋。这只是我个人旅程中了解世界的一小步！

english: Plus da jubblies do taste good!
translation: 而且胖食人鸟确实好吃！

english: Da jubblies do taste da bestest.
translation: 胖食人鸟确实最好吃。

english: Who are the Barracudas?
translation: 谁是梭鱼俱乐部？

english: Dey like da creatures which sound like da fishies but no taste like da fishes but fast like da fastest fishies.
translation: 他们像那种听起来像鱼但味道不像鱼但速度像最快鱼的生物。

english: Erm...
Gurtob sure has a way with words!
translation: 格托布真会用词！

english: Us Barracudas are the fastest sailors across the entire ocean! Our motto is 'Anyone from anywhere as long as they can sail.'
translation: 我们梭鱼俱乐部是整个海洋最快的水手！我们的座右铭是“无论来自何方，只要能航行”。

english: We work together to help hone each other's skills and test our mettle through challenges called Barracuda Trials.
translation: 我们共同努力帮助磨练彼此的技能，并通过称为梭鱼试炼的挑战测试我们的勇气。

english: Can I become a Barracuda?
translation: 我能成为梭鱼俱乐部吗？

english: Of course you can! There's a bunch of trial masters like Gurtob scattered across the seas. Best our trials and earn your spot in our ranks.
translation: 当然可以！有一群像格托布这样的试炼大师散布在海上。击败我们的试炼，赢得你在我们行列中的位置。

english: I'd best be off.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: Do you have any tips or tricks for me?
translation: 你有什么提示或技巧给我吗？

english: Do I have any rewards to claim?
translation: 我有什么奖励可以领取吗？

english: Gurtob no have re... rewa... prize for creature.
translation: 格托布没有给生物的奖……奖……奖品。

english: Das all re... rewa... prize Gurtob has for creature.
translation: 那是格托布给生物的所有奖……奖……奖品。

english: You go away! Busy eatin' da jubblies. Come back when belly full.
translation: 你走开！忙着吃胖食人鸟。肚子饱了再来。

english: The Sailing skill is not currently available.
translation: 航海技能目前不可用。

english: I'd like to attempt the Jubbly Jive.
translation: 我想尝试胖食人鸟舞。

english: Can you help me transfer my crew away?
translation: 你能帮我把船员转移走吗？

english: I'll come back another time.
translation: 我改天再来。

english: Can you tell me about the Jubbly Jive?
translation: 你能跟我讲讲胖食人鸟舞吗？

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Who are the Barracudas?
translation: 谁是梭鱼俱乐部？

english: I'd best be off.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: Do you have any tips or tricks for me?
translation: 你有什么提示或技巧给我吗？

english: Do I have any rewards to claim?
translation: 我有什么奖励可以领取吗？

english: More options...
translation: 更多选项……

english: Previous options...
translation: 上一个选项……

english: You pet the dog...
translation: 你抚摸狗……

english: Hey there, Gus. I see you've got yourself a new job. Much nicer than working for a cultist, I bet.
translation: 嘿，格斯。我看你找了个新工作。比给邪教徒工作好多了，我打赌。

english: Gus barks happily.
translation: 格斯高兴地叫了一声。

english: He licks your hand in return.
translation: 他舔了你的手作为回报。

english: There's not much time left.
translation: 没多少时间了。

english: Maybe I'll... No, stupid idea Guss!
translation: 也许我会……不，蠢主意格斯！

english: What am I going to do?
translation: 我要怎么办？

english: Are you okay?
translation: 你没事吧？

english: Hmm, I wonder... I could use a hand with something actually.
translation: 嗯，我在想……其实我有件事需要帮忙。

english: Oh yeah? What exactly do you need help with?
translation: 哦是吗？你到底需要帮什么？

english: You're willing to help? Great stuff.
translation: 你愿意帮忙？太好了。

english: I didn't say y-
translation: 我没说愿——

english: The name is Guss, Guss Mistletoad. You see that portal over there?

english: Oh, I didn't realise that's what the crystals were.

english: You've no need to feel sad here, adventurer. This is where we honour the dead by singing songs to remember them.

english: You require a Sailing level of 72 to take on the Gwenith Glide.

english: While you're out there, keep an eye out for any lost supplies. You'll need to collect all of them to complete the trial.
translation: 当你在外面时，留意任何丢失的补给。你需要收集所有补给才能完成试炼。

english: faster.

translation: 这条路线将真正测试你作为水手的能力。你会发现自己在狭窄空间和广阔开放空间之间交替航行，需要所需的速度和优雅。

english: While navigating the more narrow spaces, you should be wary of resonance crystals. These old ship defence systems can crystallise your helm, damaging those holding it.
translation: 在航行更狭窄空间时，你应该警惕共振水晶。这些旧船防御系统会使你的船舵结晶，伤害操作者。

english: If your helm does get crystallised, you should be able to break the crystals with three swift strikes.
translation: 如果你的船舵确实结晶了，你应该能用三次快速打击打破水晶。

english: When using the portals, you'll find that each crystal near me has a pair of them near it. Both will send you to the same location.
translation: 使用传送门时，你会发现我附近的每个水晶附近都有一对。两者都会把你送到同一个地方。

english: However, upon using a return portal, your arrival location will depend on which portal you first picked. Choosing which portals to use and planning ahead of time are critical for overcoming this trial.
translation: 然而，使用返回传送门时，你的到达位置取决于你最初选择了哪个传送门。选择使用哪个传送门和提前计划对于克服这个试炼至关重要。

english: If you can imbue all of the crystals and collect all the lost supplies in the time given, you'll be awarded a Barracuda rank. Each trial has three ranks: Swordfish, Shark or Marlin. Each rank is harder than the last.
translation: 如果你能在规定时间内灌注所有水晶并收集所有丢失的补给，你将获得梭鱼俱乐部等级。每个试炼有三个等级：剑鱼、鲨鱼或马林鱼。每个等级都比上一个难。

english: For this trial you'll be asked to imbue additional crystals and collect even more lost supplies as the rank increases.
translation: 对于这个试炼，随着等级提高，你将被要求灌注额外水晶并收集更多丢失的补给。

english: You can't attempt the next rank until you beat the one before it. You can also try unranked if you'd like to warm up beforehand.
translation: 你必须击败前一个等级才能尝试下一个等级。如果你想事先热身，也可以尝试无等级。

english: I see. Do you have any tips or tricks for me?
translation: 我明白了。你有什么提示或技巧给我吗？

english: Of course, that's why I'm here.
translation: 当然，那就是我在这的原因。

english: To start, traversing the portals will reward your boat with an incredible burst of speed, so use that to your advantage.
translation: 首先，穿过传送门会奖励你的船惊人的速度爆发，所以利用它。

english: Additionally, be aware that the portals will both displace your boat and change which direction it is headed for.
translation: 此外，注意传送门会位移你的船并改变其航向。

english: Aligning yourself properly before going through is not required, but you should try to anticipate where you'll end up and react quickly.
translation: 穿过前正确对齐不是必须的，但你应该尝试预测你会在哪结束并快速反应。

english: Next, avoid the resonance crystals in the area. They will target the helm of your boat. If you do get hit by them, make sure to break the crystals rapidly. Doing so will grant your boat a small speed boost.
translation: 其次，避开区域内的共振水晶。它们会瞄准你的船舵。如果你确实被击中，确保快速打破水晶。这样做会给你的船一个小速度提升。

english: Another thing to look out for are the crystal motes. If you have a wind catcher or gale catcher activated on your boat, they will be converted into wind motes and charge it up for you.
translation: 另一件要注意的是水晶微粒。如果你的船上激活了捕风器或狂风捕手，它们会被转化为风微粒并为你充能。

english: If you don't have a wind catcher, I'd suggest attempting the Jubbly Jive trial over in Backwater.
translation: 如果你没有捕风器，我建议尝试那边的回水胖食人鸟舞试炼。

english: Finally, keep your sails trimmed and try not to get lost out there. The portals can be disorientating at first, but I'm sure you'll learn the layout of the course over time.
translation: 最后，保持帆调整良好，尽量别在那迷路。传送门起初可能让人迷失方向，但我相信你会随时间了解路线布局。

english: I'd like to attempt the Gwenith Glide.
translation: 我想尝试格温尼斯滑翔。

english: Can you tell me about the Gwenith Glide?
translation: 你能跟我讲讲格温尼斯滑翔吗？

english: Certainly. The large crystals you see around us are actually remnants of large ships that were destroyed during the Siege of Prifddinas.
translation: 当然。你看到我们周围的大水晶实际上是在普里夫迪纳斯围城战中被摧毁的大船残骸。

english: Elven ships are not constructed from wood and metal, but are instead sung and woven into life over many moons from extraordinarily rare crystal seeds.
translation: 精灵船并非由木材与金属打造，而是用极其稀有的水晶种子，历经无数个满月周期，通过吟唱与编织孕育而成的生命。

english: The process is incredibly intimate and time consuming. Each ship created represents not just our goddess, but also the individual who brought it into existence.
translation: 这个过程极其亲密且耗时。每艘创造的船不仅代表我们的女神，也代表将其带入存在的个体。

english: Like all Barracuda Trials, the Gwenith Glide exists to push your sailing skills to the limit. However, it also acts as an opportunity to honour not just those that died here, but also the ships themselves.
translation: 像所有梭鱼试炼一样，格温尼斯滑翔存在是为了将你的航海技能推向极限。然而，它也作为一个机会来纪念不仅那些死在这里的人，还有船本身。

english: So what is it that I need to do within the trial?
translation: 那么试炼内我需要做什么？

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: My name is Gwyna of the Hefin Clan. I'm a trial master for the Barracudas and I provide guidance and counsel to those who attempt this trial, the Gwenith Glide.
translation: 我叫赫芬氏族的格温娜。我是梭鱼俱乐部的试炼大师，我为尝试这个试炼的人提供指导和咨询，格温尼斯滑翔。

english: It is my job to see that those who died here are honoured and that the sanctity of the course is upheld.
translation: 我的工作是确保那些死在这里的人被纪念，并且路线的神圣性得到维护。

english: Do those goals ever conflict? I'm not sure how the sanctity of the course is upheld as sailors race around the place.
translation: 这些目标会冲突吗？我不确定当水手们在那周围竞速时如何维护路线的神圣性。

english: I appreciate your concern, but you need not worry. Respect for the dead can be upheld in many ways. All who take on the trial have my blessing to proceed as they wish.
translation: 我感谢你的关心，但你无需担心。对死者的尊敬可以通过多种方式维护。所有参加试炼的人都得到我的祝福按他们意愿进行。

english: Who are the Barracudas?
translation: 谁是梭鱼俱乐部？

english: The organisation is a collection of like-minded individuals interested in furthering their own expertise and knowledge of sailing.
translation: 这个组织是一群志同道合的个体的集合，有兴趣进一步加深他们的专业知识和航海知识。

english: We're open to all with the spirit and patience to learn this delicate and precise skill.
translation: 我们对所有有精神和耐心学习这项精细精确技能的人开放。

english: Can I become a Barracuda?
translation: 我能成为梭鱼俱乐部吗？

english: Of course you can, but you'll have to prove yourself first. There are other trial masters like me across the seas. You'll need to overcome our trials to earn your place among us.
translation: 当然可以，但你得先证明自己。海上还有其他像我这样的试炼大师。你需要克服我们的试炼来赢得在我们中的位置。

english: Guess she can't hear me from over here.
translation: 猜她在那边听不见我。

english: Can you tell me about the Gwenith Glide?
translation: 你能跟我讲讲格温尼斯滑翔吗？

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Who are the Barracudas?
translation: 谁是梭鱼俱乐部？

english: I'd best be off.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: We are the righteous ones in his eyes alone.
translation: 我们仅在他眼中是正义的。

english: Let them not infest our cities and towns...
translation: 别让它们侵占我们的城市和城镇……

english: And lo, we become the power, indeed the force to stop these monsters in their tracks.
translation: 看哪，我们成为力量，确实是阻止这些怪物前进的力量。

english: Verily I urge you, my friends to take up your spades and farm your farms to feed our people in this blessed sanctuary.
translation: 诚然我敦促你，我的朋友们，拿起你们的铲子，耕种你们的农场，在这个受祝福的避难所养活我们的人民。

english: If thine monsters visage does frighten thee, then tear it off I say... tear it off!
translation: 如果怪物的面容确实吓到你，那么我说撕掉它……撕掉它！

english: For Saradomin will guide our sword arms and smash the enemies of humans till their bones become dust.
translation: 因为萨拉多明将指引我们的剑臂，粉碎人类的敌人直到它们的骨头变成灰尘。

english: And let us smite these monsters unto their deaths.
translation: 让我们击杀这些怪物直到它们死亡。

english: For they are not the chosen ones in Saradomin's eyes.
translation: 因为它们不是萨拉多明眼中的选民。

english: Where do we go for safety from these monsters... here, with our brethren!
translation: 我们去哪寻求安全免受这些怪物……这里，和我们的兄弟一起！

english: And let there be no cave or shelter for their spawn until the end of days.
translation: 让它们的后代没有洞穴或庇护所直到末日。

english: Hello, [brother/sister/friend], you fit in much better now that you're correctly attired. Before you stuck out like a sore thumb! Keep your eyes peeled though; I've heard there are thieves amongst us!
translation: 你好，[brother/sister/friend]，你现在穿着得体融入得更好了。之前你像 sore thumb 一样突出！不过睁大眼睛；我听说我们中间有小偷！

english: What are all you people doing here?
translation: 你们所有人在这做什么？

english: Many of us disagree with the king about what freedoms the local monster population should have. We're taking a stand and mobilising our forces against the monstrous hordes.
translation: 我们中许多人与国王关于当地怪物种群应有什么自由意见不合。我们正立场坚定并动员力量对抗怪物群。

english: I'm totally in awe of Johanhus, he really knows what's what. I know he keeps going on about monsters and it's clear there are too many of them, so hey, I agree with whatever Johanhus says.
translation: 我完全敬畏约翰纳斯，他真的知道怎么回事。我知道他一直谈论怪物，很明显它们太多了，所以嘿，我同意约翰纳斯说的任何话。

english: We're against the monsters..like Johanhus says...we don't like them...you know.
translation: 我们反对怪物……像约翰纳斯说的……我们不喜欢它们……你知道。

english: Who are you and what do you do here?
translation: 你是谁，你在这做什么？

english: I'm a strong believer in the non-monsters policy...we should really get rid of them...and if that means I have to live in a cave like a monster, so be it!
translation: 我是非怪物政策的坚定信徒……我们真的应该除掉它们……如果那意味着我必须像怪物一样住在洞穴里，那就这样吧！

english: What do you think you're going to achieve?
translation: 你认为你要实现什么？

english: We want a world without monsters, to live in safety and without fear of being attacked by these ferocious beasts.
translation: 我们想要一个没有怪物的世界，安全生活，不用担心被这些猛兽攻击。

english: But there aren't that many ferocious beasts in the towns and cities.
translation: 但城镇里没有那么多猛兽。

english: That's not enough, we want to get rid of them totally, we want to enjoy the surrounding lands and not worry about our children playing in caves and so on.
translation: 那不够，我们想彻底除掉它们，我们想享受周围土地，不担心我们的孩子在洞穴等地方玩耍。

english: Where did all you people come from?
translation: 你们所有人从哪来？

english: Most of us came from small towns that had been attacked by monsters. We all got fed up with it and so decided to join this movement. We're hoping to return to the towns and cities when we've cleaned up the areas
translation: 我们大多数人来自被怪物攻击的小城镇。我们都受够了，所以决定加入这个运动。我们希望在清理了这些怪物居住的区域后

english: that these monsters live in.
translation: 返回城镇。

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

translation: 你们所有人从哪来？

translation: 好的，谢谢。

translation: 把手放好。

english: We deal harshly with thieves around here!
translation: 我们在这严厉对待小偷！

translation: 你以为你在做什么？

english: Stop! Thief!
translation: 站住！小偷！

english: You're beaten unconscious and bundled out of the HAM Camp.
translation: 你被打晕并被捆着扔出反怪物人联营地。

english: You slowly wake up in an unknown place.

english: that these monsters live in.
translation: 返回城镇。

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: I hear you brother...
translation: 我听到你了兄弟……

english: You speak the truth brother...
translation: 你说的是真理兄弟……

english: Well said brother...
translation: 说得好兄弟……

translation: 你们所有人在这做什么？

english: Who are you and what do you do here?

english: Where did all you people come from?
translation: 你们所有人从哪来？

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Hello cat.
translation: 你好猫。

english: Meow!
translation: 喵！

english: One does not wish to be disturbed.
translation: 一人不希望被打扰。

english: What?
translation: 什么？

english: Good day to you.
translation: 你好。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: You don't look too happy.
translation: 你看起来不太开心。

english: True. We've not fallen on the best of times here.
translation: 确实。我们在这没遇上好时候。

english: Any way that I can help?
translation: 有什么我能帮忙的吗？

english: Possibly. I'd go talk to Awusah the Mayor of Nardah. He's in the big house on the east side of the town square.
translation: 可能。我会去找那尔达城主阿瓦萨。他在城镇广场东侧的大房子里。

english: How's life now the curse has been lifted?
translation: 诅咒解除后生活怎么样？

english: Much better thanks to you. We're all very impressed.
translation: 多亏你了好多了。我们都很印象深刻。

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Are you on holiday? If so you've come to the right place. I'm Hadley the tourist guide, anything you need to know just ask me. We have some of the most unspoilt wildlife and scenery in Gielinor.
translation: 你在度假吗？如果是那你来对地方了。我是导游哈德利，任何你需要知道的尽管问我。我们有基利诺尔一些最原始的自然野生动物和风景。

english: People come from miles around to fish in the clear lakes or to wander the beautiful hillsides.
translation: 人们从四面八方来这里在清澈的湖泊钓鱼或在美丽的山坡漫步。

english: It is quite pretty.
translation: 确实相当漂亮。

english: Surely pretty is an understatement [kind sir./kind lady./.] Beautiful, amazing or possibly life-changing would be more suitable wording. Have you seen Baxtorian Falls? Named after the elven king who was buried beneath them.
translation: 当然漂亮是轻描淡写 [kind sir./kind lady./.]。美丽、惊人或可能改变人生会更合适。你见过巴克斯托里安瀑布吗？以埋葬在其下的精灵国王命名。

english: Can you tell me what happened to the elven king?
translation: 你能告诉我精灵国王发生了什么吗？

english: Baxtorian? I guess he died a long long time ago, it's quite sad really. After leaving his kingdom to deal with invading forces, Baxtorian returned to find his wife Glarial had been captured by the enemy.
translation: 巴克斯托里安？我想他很久以前就死了，真相当悲伤。离开王国去对付入侵势力后，巴克斯托里安回来发现他的妻子格拉利尔被敌人俘虏了。

english: This destroyed Baxtorian, after years of searching he became a recluse. He went into the secret home he had made for Glarial under the waterfall and sealed himself in. To this day, no one has managed to enter.
translation: 这毁了巴克斯托里安，多年寻找后他成了隐士。他进入他为格拉利尔在瀑布下建造的 secret home 并把自己封在里面。直到今天，没人能进入。

english: Anyway, I believe we have a book on him upstairs if you want to learn more.
translation: 总之，如果你想了解更多，我相信楼上有关于他的书。

english: Where else is worth visiting around here?
translation: 这附近还有什么值得参观的？

english: There is a lovely spot for a picnic on the hill to the north east, there's a monument to the elven queen Glarial. It really is quite pretty.
translation: 东北边的山上有个适合野餐的可爱地点，那里有精灵女王格拉利尔的纪念碑。确实相当漂亮。

english: Who was Glarial?
translation: 谁是格拉利尔？

english: Baxtorian's wife, the only other person who could also enter the waterfall apart from him. She was queen when this land was inhabited by elven kind.
translation: 巴克斯托里安的妻子，除了他之外唯一能进入瀑布的人。当这片土地被精灵居住时她是女王。

english: Glarial was kidnapped while Baxtorian was away, but they eventually recovered her body and brought her home to rest.
translation: 格拉利尔在巴克斯托里安离开时被绑架，但他们最终找回了她的尸体并带回家安息。

english: That's sad.
translation: 真悲伤。

english: True, I believe we have a book on Baxtorian and Glarial upstairs if you want to learn more.
translation: 确实，如果你想了解更多，我相信楼上有关于巴克斯托里安和格拉利尔的书。

english: Is there treasure under the waterfall?
translation: 瀑布下有宝藏吗？

english: Ha ha... Another treasure hunter. Well if there is no one's been able to get to it. They've been searching that river for decades, all to no avail.
translation: 哈哈……又一个宝藏猎人。嗯如果有也没人能拿到。他们搜索那条河几十年了，都徒劳无功。

english: Thanks, goodbye.
translation: 谢谢，再见。

english: Enjoy your visit.
translation: 享受你的参观。

english: Can you tell me what happened to the elven king?
translation: 你能告诉我精灵国王发生了什么吗？

english: Where else is worth visiting around here?
translation: 这附近还有什么值得参观的？

english: Is there treasure under the waterfall?
translation: 瀑布下有宝藏吗？

english: Thanks, goodbye.
translation: 谢谢，再见。

english: What are you doing in our home?
translation: 你在我们家里做什么？

english: I just came to ask you a question.
translation: 我只是来问你个问题。

english: Hegir, why did you let this human into our home?
translation: 海吉尔，你为什么让这个人类进我们家？

english: I didn't let him in, he let himself in!
translation: 我没让他进，他自己进来的！

english: Now what do you want, human? Speak up, speak up!

translation: 我从没承诺过有价值的信息。

translation: 哦是的，他跟我们来。他常常发现自己陷入奇怪的境地，但他应付得来。

english: Do you care more for gold than you do your friend?
translation: 你更在乎金子还是你的朋友？

english: Excuse me, Hannibal.
translation: 打扰一下，汉尼拔。

english: Hello, Hannibal.
translation: 你好，汉尼拔。

english: Hello there, Hannibal.
translation: 你好，汉尼拔。

english: Hi there, Hannibal.
translation: 嗨，汉尼拔。

english: He appears to be sleeping peacefully, so you decide to leave him be.
translation: 他似乎睡得很安详，所以你决定不打扰他。

english: Hi [player name]. You woke me up, I was fast asleep!
translation: 嗨 [player name]。你吵醒我了，我睡得很熟！

english: I'm sorry, I didn't realise you were sleeping. I just wanted to say hello.
translation: 抱歉，我没意识到你在睡觉。我只是想打个招呼。

english: Hello then. Can I help you with anything?
translation: 那你好。有什么能帮你的吗？

english: No, that's it. You can go back to sleep, sorry to have disturbed you.
translation: 不，就这些。你可以回去睡了，抱歉打扰你。

english: It's no problem.
translation: 没问题。

english: Hannibal snuggles back down and is fast asleep in an instant.
translation: 汉尼拔缩回去瞬间睡熟了。

english: Hello [player name]. Did you need something?
translation: 你好 [player name]。你需要什么吗？

english: Nothing important. I'd like to ask you a question if that is okay?
translation: 没什么重要的。我想问你个问题可以吗？

english: Ask away.
translation: 问吧。

english: Why did you pick the kitchen as your spot to sleep? It must get quite noisy sometimes?
translation: 你为什么选厨房当睡觉地点？有时肯定很吵吧？

english: It does during meal times, but it's also lovely and warm near the fire, and look at all the food!
translation: 吃饭时确实，但火边也很温暖，而且看所有食物！

english: Good point. Now it seems like the best spot in the house!
translation: 有道理。现在看起来是屋里最好的地方！

english: You catch on quickly, for a human! Now I am going to go back to sleep, unless there is something else I can help you with?
translation: 你悟性真快，对人类来说！现在我要回去睡了，除非还有什么事我能帮你？

english: That was all I wanted to ask, thank you.
translation: 那就是我想问的，谢谢。

english: Hannibal curls up on the stool and goes back to sleep.
translation: 汉尼拔蜷在凳子上回去睡了。

english: Oh, hello [player name]. Did I hear a bark?
translation: 哦，你好 [player name]。我听到狗叫了吗？

english: A bark? Is there a dog here?
translation: 狗叫？这里有狗吗？

english: There is, sometimes...
translation: 有，有时……

english: It always wakes me up with its barking.
translation: 它总是用叫声吵醒我。

english: It seems to come and go. I can't figure out why or how.
translation: 它似乎来来去去。我搞不懂为什么或怎么。

english: That is indeed strange. I'll keep an eye out for it.
translation: 那确实奇怪。我会留意的。

english: There it is again, did you hear it?
translation: 又来了，你听到了吗？

english: I can't say I did.
translation: 我不能说我听到了。

english: Maybe I'm imagining it.
translation: 也许我在想象。

english: Hannibal settles back down and is sleeping in moments.
translation: 汉尼拔缩回去瞬间睡着了。

english: Hi [player name].
translation: 嗨 [player name]。

english: How are you doing?
translation: 你怎么样？

english: I'm okay, thank you. I've been enjoying the piano playing. Was it you playing earlier?
translation: 我没事，谢谢。我一直在享受钢琴演奏。是你刚才弹的吗？

english: Oh, that wasn't me.
translation: 哦，不是我。

english: Must have been Gem then. She often plays the piano when she thinks nobody is listening.
translation: 那肯定是杰姆。她经常以为没人听时弹钢琴。

english: She's actually quite good.
translation: 她其实弹得不错。

english: I'll have to keep an ear out.
translation: 我得留神听听。

english: Hannibal stretches and goes back to sleep.
translation: 汉尼拔伸懒腰回去睡了。

english: Hi there, [player name].
translation: 你好，[player name]。

english: I have another question for you, if that is okay?
translation: 我还有另一个问题问你，可以吗？

english: Go ahead.
translation: 问吧。

english: Do you ever leave the hall? I've only ever seen you in here.
translation: 你离开过大厅吗？我只在这里见过你。

english: I do sometimes. If I do go out, it's normally at night.
translation: 有时。如果我出去，通常在晚上。

english: I much prefer it in here though. Nice and warm with good food. There is even a bank, if I ever needed a bank for anything.
translation: 不过我更喜欢这里。温暖有好食物。甚至有个银行，如果我需要银行做什么。

english: That's fair enough. The world can be a pretty scary place out there anyway.
translation: 那很合理。反正外面世界可能很可怕。

english: Exactly. It's much nicer to relax here, even with the occasional adventurer disturbing me.
translation: 确实。在这里放松好多了，即使偶尔有冒险者打扰我。

english: That'll be me! Sorry, I'll let you get back to sleep.
translation: 那就是我！抱歉，我让你回去睡。

english: Hannibal goes back to sleep, enjoying the warmth of the fire.
translation: 汉尼拔回去睡了，享受火的温暖。

english: You pet Hannibal...
translation: 你抚摸汉尼拔……

english: He lets out a quiet purr before going back to resting.
translation: 他发出轻声呼噜声回去休息了。

english: You scratch Hannibal behind the ears...
translation: 你挠汉尼拔耳朵后面……

english: He purrs contentedly before going back to sleep.
translation: 他满足地呼噜着回去睡了。

english: I should give him some fish from my inventory!
translation: 我应该从物品栏给他些鱼！

english: Hannibal gobbles up the fish, then settles back down to rest.
translation: 汉尼拔吞下鱼，然后缩回去休息。

english: Thank you [player name]. That's very tasty, though it would be even more tasty if it was cooked.
translation: 谢谢你 [player name]。那很好吃，不过如果是熟的会更好吃。

english: You prefer cooked food?
translation: 你更喜欢熟食？

english: I do. Why do you think I'm in the kitchen? All this lovely food being cooked all the time!
translation: 是的。你以为我为什么在厨房？所有这些美味食物一直在烹饪！

english: That is a good point. I will see if I can find you something cooked.
translation: 有道理。我看看能不能给你找点熟的。

english: I look forward to it. You know where to find me.
translation: 我期待着。你知道在哪找我。

english: Hannibal settles back down to sleep.
translation: 汉尼拔缩回去睡了。

english: Thank you [player name]. That was lovely! Do you have any more?
translation: 谢谢你 [player name]。那真棒！你还有吗？

english: You just ate the entire thing, and you're still hungry?
translation: 你刚吃完整个，还饿？

english: Sleeping is hungry work.
translation: 睡觉是饿人的活。

english: I do often wake up hungry, maybe you're on to something.
translation: 我经常饿醒，也许你说得对。

english: I'll see if I can find you something else.
translation: 我看看能不能给你找点别的。

english: Lovely, I'll be right here, working hard.
translation: 太好了，我就在这里，努力工作。

english: Hello. What are you doing here?
translation: 你好。你在这里做什么？

english: I'm looking for whoever is in charge of this place.
translation: 我在找这里的负责人。

english: Who, the Duke? He's in his study, on the first floor.
translation: 谁，公爵？他在书房，一楼。

english: I have come to kill everyone in this castle!
translation: 我是来杀光这个城堡里所有人的！

english: Hans runs away from the player screaming

english: Help! Help!
translation: 救命！救命！

english: I don't know. I'm lost. Where am I?
translation: 我不知道。我迷路了。我在哪？

english: You are in Lumbridge Castle.
translation: 你在仑桥堡。

english: Can you tell me how long I've been here?
translation: 你能告诉我我在这里多久了吗？

english: Ahh, I see all the newcomers arriving in Lumbridge, fresh-faced and eager for adventure. I remember you...
translation: 啊，我看到所有新人到达仑桥镇，面带稚气且渴望冒险。我记得你……

translation: 哦！你是谁？

translation: 我是勇敢骑士！我要杀光仑桥堡附近的人！

english: Aaaaargh! Run away, run away!
translation: 啊！快跑，快跑！

translation: 嘿嘿。傻瓜！

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Who are you?

english: My name is Hari.
translation: 我叫哈里。

english: And what are you doing here Hari?
translation: 那你在这里做什么，哈里？

english: Like most people who come to Edgeville, I am here to seek adventure in the Wilderness.
translation: 像大多数来伊吉维尔的人一样，我来这里寻求荒野冒险。

english: I found a secret underground river that will take me quite a long way north.
translation: 我发现了一条秘密地下河，能带我向北走很远。

english: Underground river? Where does it come out?
translation: 地下河？它从哪里出来？

english: It comes out in a pond located deep in the Wilderness.
translation: 它从位于荒野深处的一个池塘出来。

english: I had to find a very special type of canoe to get me up the river though, would you like to know more?
translation: 不过我不得不找到一种非常特殊的独木舟才能上游，你想知道更多吗？

english: Could you teach me about canoes?
translation: 你能教我关于独木舟的知识吗？

english: Well, you don't look like you have the skill to make a canoe.
translation: 嗯，你看起来没有制作独木舟的技能。

english: You need to have at least level 12 woodcutting.
translation: 你需要至少12级伐木。

english: Once you are able to make a canoe it makes travel along the river much quicker!
translation: 一旦你能制作独木舟，沿河旅行会快得多！

english: It's really quite simple. Just walk down to that tree on the bank and chop it down.
translation: 其实很简单。走到岸边那棵树，把它砍倒。

english: When you have done that you can shape the log further with your axe to make a canoe.
translation: 完成后你可以用斧头进一步加工原木制作独木舟。

english: I can sense you're still a novice woodcutter, you will only be able to make a log canoe at present.
translation: 我感觉你还是新手伐木工，目前只能制作原木独木舟。

english: Is that good?
translation: 那好吗？

english: A log will take you one stop along the river. But you won't be able to travel into the Wilderness on it.
translation: 原木独木舟能带你沿河航行一站。但你不能用它进入荒野。

english: You are an average woodcutter. You should be able to make a Dugout canoe quite easily. It will take you 2 stops along the river.
translation: 你是普通伐木工。你应该能相当容易地制作独木舟。它能带你沿河两站。

english: Can I take a dugout canoe to reach the Wilderness?
translation: 我能乘独木舟到达荒野吗？

english: You would never make it there alive.
translation: 你活着到不了那里。

english: Best not to try then.
translation: 那最好别试。

english: You seem to be an accomplished woodcutter. You will easily be able to make a Stable Dugout
translation: 你似乎是个熟练伐木工。你将能轻易制作稳固[的独木舟

english: They are reliable enough to get you anywhere on this river, except to the Wilderness of course.
translation: 它们足够可靠，能带你去这条河上任何地方，当然，荒野除外。

english: Only a Waka can take you there.
translation: 只有瓦卡独木舟能带你去那里。

english: A Waka? What's that?
translation: 瓦卡？那是什么？

english: Come and ask me when you have improved your skills as a woodcutter.
translation: 等你提高伐木技能再来问我。

english: Your skills rival mine friend. You will certainly be able to build a Waka.
translation: 你的技能与我匹敌朋友。你肯定能建造瓦卡。

english: A Waka is an invention of my people, it's an incredible strong and fast canoe and will carry you safely to any destination on the river.
translation: 瓦卡是我人民的发明，它是种极其坚固快速的独木舟，能安全载你到河上任何目的地。

english: Any destination?
translation: 任何目的地？

english: Yes, you can take a waka north through the underground portion of this river.
translation: 是的，你可以乘瓦卡向北穿过这条河的地下部分。

english: It will bring you out at a pond in the heart of the Wilderness. Be careful up there, many have lost more than their lives in that dark and twisted place.
translation: 它会带你到荒野中心的一个池塘出来。上面小心，许多人在那个黑暗扭曲的地方失去了不止生命。

english: No thanks, not right now.
translation: 不用了谢谢，现在不要。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Yes
translation: 是

english: No
translation: 否

english: Can you teach me about Canoeing?
translation: 你能教我关于独木舟的知识吗？

english: Welcome, Effendi!
translation: 欢迎，埃芬迪！

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: Can I go in?
translation: 我能进去吗？

english: Come now Effendi, to pass you must tell me a story, one of grand heroics!
translation: 来吧埃芬迪，要通过你得告诉我一个故事，一个伟大英雄的故事！

english: You tell the tale of how you bested a goblin, it lacks heroics and sounds more like senseless murder.
translation: 你讲了如何击败哥布林的故事，这故事缺乏英雄气概，听起来更像无意义的谋杀。

english: You thought that was a story of heroics?! Come back when you have something worth telling.
translation: 你以为那是英雄故事？！等你有值得讲的故事再来吧。

english: To gain entrance to the resource area, you must first complete the quest 'Dragon Slayer'.
translation: 要进入资源区，你必须先完成“屠龙者”任务。

english: You tell the tale of how you bested the legendary dragon Elvarg in combat.
translation: 你讲了如何在战斗中击败传奇龙埃尔瓦格的故事。

english: ...And then I cut her head off, so as to make sure she was dead!
translation: ……然后我砍下她的头，以确保她死了！

english: Amazing! A story well worth telling! Please Effendi, enter at your leisure.
translation: 惊人！一个值得讲的故事！请埃芬迪，随意进入。

english: Of course Effendi! You have proved yourself worthy!
translation: 当然埃芬迪！你证明了自己值得！

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Me? I am Haris! Owner of the area north of here, it is has great resources, I assure you.
translation: 我？我是哈里斯！这片区域以北的所有者，我向你保证那里资源丰富。

english: You own the land? Who did you buy it from?
translation: 你拥有土地？你从谁那买的？

english: Buy? Oh no no no. Do you see this sword, Effendi?
translation: 买？哦不不不。你看到这把剑了吗，埃芬迪？

english: I do.
translation: 我看到了。

english: Well then, that is why it is mine! Hahaha.
translation: 那么，那就是为什么它是我的！哈哈哈。

english: Oh, so do I pay a toll? 10 coins should do, right?
translation: 哦，那我付过路费？10金币应该可以，对吧？

english: Not quite, while gold can get you to many places, I seek stories of heroics, for my land is only for the worthy.
translation: 不完全是，虽然金币能带你去很多地方，我寻求英雄故事，因为我的土地只给值得的人。

english: Is the story behind your sword one of heroics?
translation: 你剑背后的故事是英雄故事吗？

english: I promise you, the monkey I took it from was big! Hahaha!
translation: 我向你保证，我从它那拿的猴子很大！哈哈哈！

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！

english: Farewell, Effendi!
translation: 再会，埃芬迪！

english: Hey! I didn't say you could go in there!
translation: 嘿！我没说你可以进去！

english: Can I go in?
translation: 我能进去吗？

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: I'm rather busy right...
translation: 我现在相当忙……

english: ... Wait a minute... you're that adventurer that has been taking on the Colosseum!
translation: ……等一下……你就是那个挑战竞技场的冒险者！

english: The Champion!
translation: 冠军！

english: The Grand Champion!
translation: 大宗师！

english: That's me.
translation: 那就是我。

english: Wow, what are the chances you'd run into a simple farmer like me.
translation: 哇，你遇到像我这样简单农夫的几率多大。

english: Quite high actually...
translation: 其实相当高……

english: I suppose you might be needing a reliable herb supply if you're planning to continue fighting in the Colosseum?
translation: 我想如果你打算继续在竞技场战斗，可能需要可靠草药供应？

english: I suppose so?
translation: 我想是吧？

english: I'll keep an eye on any herbs you plant here. It's the least I can do for someone like you.
translation: 我会留意你在这里种的任何草药。这是我能为你这样的人做的最起码的事。

english: That's a really kind gesture, but aren't you meant to be focusing on growing your own food?
translation: 那真是好意，但你不是应该专注于种自己的食物吗？

english: It's no trouble. The soil around here is very rich, so it won't need much attention at all. I might even get a reward from the palace for helping such a valiant contender!
translation: 没问题。这附近的土壤很肥沃，所以根本不需要太多照料。我甚至可能因为帮助如此勇敢的竞争者而从宫殿得到奖励！

english: That's very kind of you.
translation: 你真好。

english: Best of luck on your journey, Champion!
translation: 祝你旅途顺利，冠军！

english: Best of luck on your journey, Grand Champion!
translation: 祝你旅途顺利，大宗师！

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Hi.
translation: 嗨。

english: Can I buy you a drink?
translation: 我能请你喝一杯吗？

english: Now you're talking! An Asgarnian Ale please!
translation: 这才像话！请来杯阿斯加尼亚麦酒！

english: I'll go and get you one.
translation: 我去给你拿一杯。

english: You give Harold an Asgarnian ale.
translation: 你给了哈罗德一杯阿斯加尼亚麦酒。

english: *burp*
translation: 嗝

english: You knock on the door.
translation: 你敲了敲门。

english: Come in!
translation: 进来！

english: I guess this will be my last day of blood tithes, one way or another.
translation: 我想这将是我缴纳血税的最后一天，无论如何。

english: It can't be that hard can it?
translation: 不会那么难吧？

english: Soon I will be free!
translation: 很快我就自由了！

english: I'm starting to think I made a mistake coming here.
translation: 我开始觉得来这儿是个错误。

english: Can't talk. I need to prepare myself.
translation: 不能说话。我需要准备一下。

english: I will survive the Theatre! Just like Serafina did!
