translation: 乘坐矿车要20金币。

english: Of course.
translation: 当然。

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

english: As a loyal customer of the Lovakengj Minecart Network, you're entitled to this.
translation: 身为洛瓦肯吉矿车网络的忠实客户，你自然享有这项权益。

english: Now, can I help you today?
translation: 现在，今天能帮你吗？

english: You're already here, human.
translation: 你已经在这里了，人类。

english: Can I go for a ride?
translation: 能坐矿车吗？

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: You have no place here! Leave now, before someone makes you!
translation: 你没地方待在这里！现在离开，趁有人强迫你！

english: The adventurer returns! Glory to you for your efforts in bringing about the return of Lord Hazeel!
translation: 冒险者回来了！为你努力促成哈兹尔领主回归向你致敬！

english: The mage starts to speak but all you hear is:
translation: 法师开始说话但你只听到：

english: Blah. Blah, blah, blah, blah...blah!
translation: 巴拉。巴拉，巴拉，巴拉，巴拉……巴拉！

english: You feel very strange - as if Hazelmere has started poking around in your head.
translation: 你感觉很奇怪——好像黑兹尔米尔开始在你脑袋里戳来戳去。

english: Well, I never expected to be impressed by a human, but you have done a good deed for the gnomes - even if most gnomes won't recognise it.  You humans are not as stupid as I first thought...
translation: 嗯，我从没指望被人类打动，但你为地精做了好事——即使大多数地精不会认可。你们人类不像我最初想的那么傻……

english: So you want to know what your crystal seed does?
translation: 所以你想知道你的水晶种子做什么？

english: How did you.. ? Oh I forgot about this mind meld thing.
translation: 你怎么……？哦，我忘了心灵融合这件事。

english: The seed is a piece of elven magic, all elven magic comes from the manipulation of seeds of crystal. The elves give it divine properties. Elves sing to their crystals and they form into the desired shape.
translation: 种子是一块精灵魔法，所有精灵魔法都来自水晶种子的操纵。精灵赋予它神圣属性。精灵对水晶歌唱，水晶就会形成想要的形状。

english: So how do I turn it into something useful?
translation: 那我怎么把它变成有用的东西？

english: Either talk to an elf or find some other way to sing the crystal. If this came from Oaknock, he must have found a way...
translation: 要么跟精灵说话要么找其他方法对水晶歌唱。如果这来自奥克诺克，他肯定找到了方法……

english: Thanks, I'll have a look round Oaknock's old workshop. I can have a chat with Brimstail while I'm at it! Thanks!
translation: 谢谢，我去看看奥克诺克的旧工作室。顺便可以跟布林斯泰尔聊聊！谢谢！

english: So you want to know what your crystal saw does?
translation: 所以你想知道你的水晶锯做什么？

english: Well, I do remember seeing Oaknock using the saw. He said it allowed him to build devices more complicated that even he was capable of constructing. The device he built must have been very complicated indeed.
translation: 嗯，我确实记得看到奥克诺克用锯子。他说它让他能建造连他自己都难以建造的更复杂装置。他建造的装置肯定非常复杂。

english: I'd say! Anyway, the saw looks like it could be pretty useful. Thanks.
translation: 我想也是！总之，锯子看起来相当有用。谢谢。

english: Hello, Hazelmere.
translation: 你好，黑兹尔米尔。

english: You're back. Come to disturb me, have you?
translation: 你回来了。来打扰我，是吧？

english: Ah, good old Hazelmere. Glad to see you're back to your grumpy self.
translation: 啊，老伙计黑兹尔米尔。很高兴看到你恢复那副暴躁的样子。

english: Do you actually want something from me, or are you simply making my life a misery again?
translation: 你真的想要我什么东西，还是只是再次让我的生活痛苦？

english: I just wanted to have a chat. You know, just check how you're doing.
translation: 我只是想聊聊。你知道， just 看看你怎么样。

english: Well I'm fine, thank you. Now leave me in peace.
translation: 嗯我没事，谢谢。现在让我安静。

english: Blah, blah, blah...blah!
translation: 巴拉，巴拉，巴拉……巴拉！

english: What?
translation: 什么？

english: Blah, blah.
translation: 巴拉，巴拉。

english: Hazelmere has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 黑兹尔米尔给了你一个挑战卷轴！

english: Blah, blah?
translation: 巴拉，巴拉？

english: Blah!
translation: 巴拉！

english: Blah, blah, blah!
translation: 巴拉，巴拉，巴拉！

english: Hazelmere has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
translation: 黑兹尔米尔给了你 [another clue scroll/a casket]！

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 虽然你找到了顾客，但你似乎没带正确的食物！你需要 [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]！

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 恐怕预制菜肴不合要求。唯有手工烹制的地精美食，才配得上阿卢夫航空的顾客。

english: You hand over your delivery of [item] to Hazelmere
translation: 你把 [item] 的配送交给黑兹尔米尔

english: *Hazelmere nods his thanks*
translation: 黑兹尔米尔点头致谢

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: 你一定走了很远的路才把这个送到我这里，这里有点额外的小意思，拿着当小费。

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
translation: 你有 [number] 积分可兑换免费配送代币。你还没资格获得地精美食配送。

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 你有 [number] 积分可兑换免费配送代币。你可以让 [number] 份地精美食配送给你。

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: 别忘了从小阿卢夫‧吉安那里领取免费配送代币。

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 配送已超时！请返回小阿卢夫处重新接单。你丢掉了配送箱，因为不再需要了。

english: After all that, are you sure I can't convince you to join the union?
translation: 经历了所有这些，你确定我不能说服你加入联盟吗？

english: Actually, I was wondering if...
translation: 其实，我在想是否……

english: Kuani! I'll need to run and grab my forms, but if you wait there just a moment...
translation: 库安尼！我得跑去拿表格，但如果你在那等一会儿……

english: I was going to ask if you had any spare equipment...
translation: 我正想问你是否有备用装备……

english: Spare equipment?
translation: 备用装备？

english: I may have a need to mask my identity again in the future... or perhaps carry a tray around.
translation: 我将来可能需要再次伪装我的身份……或者也许端个托盘。

english: You're certain you don't want to join the union as well?
translation: 你确定也不想加入联盟吗？

english: I'm sure.
translation: 我确定。

english: I see. In that case, which equipment would you like?
translation: 我明白了。那样的话，你想要什么装备？

english: The ram mask.
translation: 公羊面具。

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！

english: The wolf mask.
translation: 狼面具。

english: The bird mask.
translation: 鸟面具。

english: The jaguar mask.
translation: 美洲虎面具。

english: The snake mask.
translation: 蛇面具。

english: The butler's tray.
translation: 管家托盘。

english: None of them.
translation: 都不是。

english: Very well.
translation: 很好。

english: Changed your mind about joining the union? Or are you just after more equipment?
translation: 改变主意加入联盟了？还是只是想要更多装备？

english: Just the equipment please.
translation: 只要装备谢谢。

english: I see. In that case, what do you need?
translation: 我明白了。那样的话，你需要什么？

english: The ram mask.
translation: 公羊面具。

english: The wolf mask.
translation: 狼面具。

english: The bird mask.
translation: 鸟面具。

english: The jaguar mask.
translation: 美洲虎面具。

english: More options...
translation: 更多选项……

english: The snake mask.
translation: 蛇面具。

english: The butler's tray.
translation: 管家托盘。

english: None of them.
translation: 都不是。

english: Previous options...
translation: 上一个选项……

english: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你以为你在做什么？

english: Hey! Get your hands off there!
translation: 嘿！把手拿开！

english: This area is restricted. Leave now!
translation: 这个区域受限。现在离开！

english: Long live General Khazard!
translation: 卡扎德将军万岁！

english: Er... yes... quite right. Did you need something?
translation: 呃……是的……很对。你需要什么吗？

english: Just checking if you have any orders for me.
translation: 只是检查你是否有给我的命令。

english: Not right now. Things are all very boring at the moment. What I'd give to be over at the bar having a nice Khali brew...
translation: 现在没有。目前事情都很无聊。我多么想去酒吧喝杯不错的卡利酒……

english: Khali brew? Can't say I've ever had one.
translation: 卡利酒？不能说我有过。

english: Oh, nothing beats them! Mind you, don't make the mistake of having too many. Last time I did, I ended up falling straight to sleep.
translation: 哦，没什么比得上它们！提醒你，别犯喝太多的错误。上次我那样，结果直接睡着了。

english: Good to know, thanks.
translation: 很高兴知道，谢谢。

english: Hello again.
translation: 又见面了。

english: What a boring day. You'd think the slaves would be more entertaining.
translation: 多无聊的一天。你会以为奴隶会更有趣。

english: Not long now until you get a break though, right?
translation: 不过不久你就能休息了，对吧？

english: Too right! Then it's straight to the bar for a nice Khali brew.
translation: 太对了！然后直接去酒吧喝杯不错的卡利酒。

english: Do you still fancy a drink?
translation: 你还想喝一杯吗？

english: I really shouldn't...
translation: 我真不应该……

english: Are you sure?
translation: 你确定？

english: Oh... okay then, but just the one.
translation: 哦……好吧，但就一杯。

english: That is some gooood stuff... yeah... wooh, yeah!
translation: 那是一些好……东西……耶……呜，耶！

english: Are you alright?
translation: 你没事吧？

english: Yeesshh! Oooh, maybe I sshould relax for a while.
translation: 是——的！哦，也许我应——该放松一会儿。

english: Good idea. I'll look after the prisoners.
translation: 好主意。我会照看囚犯。

english: Yeesh... that shounds reasonable. Here, take the keysch. Any trouble, you give... you give 'em a good beating.
translation: 是——的……那听——起来合理。给，拿钥——匙。任何麻烦，你给……你给——他们一顿好打。

english: Don't worry, I'll keep them in line
translation: 别担心，我会让他们守规矩

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Pleash... leave me alone. Did the walls always shway soooo much?
translation: 请……别管我。墙一直这——么晃吗？

english: Thish areash resh... restricted! We don't like strangersh... 'specially ones who sway. Oooh!
translation: 这——区域受……限制！我们不喜——欢陌生人……特别是那些晃——的。哦！

english: Hi, er... I lost the keys.
translation: 嗨，呃……我丢了钥匙。

english: What? You're foolish... and I'm all drunk. Here... takes my shpare shh... set!
translation: 什么？你真傻……而我全醉了。给……拿我备——份钥……匙！

english: How did you get into West Ardougne? Ah well you'll have to stay, can't risk you spreading the plague outside.
translation: 你怎么进西阿多尼的？啊好吧你得待着，不能冒险让你在外面传播瘟疫。

english: So what's a mourner?
translation: 那么什么是哀悼者？

english: We're working for King Lathas of East Ardougne. He has tasked us with containing the accursed plague sweeping West Ardougne.
translation: 我们为东阿多尼城的拉萨斯国王工作。他指派我们遏制席卷西阿多尼城的该死瘟疫。

english: We also do our best to ease these people's suffering. We're nicknamed mourners because we spend a lot of time at plague victim funerals, no one else is allowed to risk attending.
translation: 我们也尽力减轻这些人的痛苦。我们被昵称为哀悼者因为我们花很多时间在瘟疫受害者葬礼上，不允许其他人冒险参加。

english: It's a demanding job, and we get little thanks from the people here.
translation: 这是个要求高的工作，我们从这里的人那里得到很少感谢。

english: I haven't got the plague though...
translation: 不过我没得瘟疫……

english: Can't risk you being a carrier. That protective clothing you have isn't regulation issue. It won't meet safety standards.
translation: 不能冒险让你成为携带者。你有的那防护服不是正规配发。它不符合安全标准。

english: So what's a mourner?
translation: 那么什么是哀悼者？

english: I haven't got the plague though...
translation: 不过我没得瘟疫……

english: Hello, welcome to the Cooking Guild. Only accomplished chefs and cooks are allowed in here. Feel free to use any of our facilities.
translation: 你好，欢迎来到烹饪公会。只有有成就的厨师和厨子才被允许进入这里。随意使用我们的任何设施。

english: Nice cape, you're wearing!
translation: 你穿的斗篷不错！

english: Thank you! It's my most prized possession, it's a Skillcape of Cooking; it shows that I've achieved level 99 Cooking and am one of the best chefs in the land!
translation: 谢谢！这是我最珍视的财产，它是烹饪技能斗篷；它显示我达到了99级烹饪并且是这片土地最好的厨师之一！

english: If you ever achieve level 99 cookingyou'll get to wear one too and doing so means you'll never burn any food!
translation: 如果你一旦达到99级烹饪你也能穿一个并且那样做意味着你永远不会烧焦任何食物！

english: Thanks, bye.
translation: 谢谢，再见。

english: Hello, welcome to the Cooking Guild. It's always great to have such an accomplished chef visit us. Say, would you be interested in a Skillcape of Cooking? They're only available to master chefs.
translation: 你好，欢迎来到烹饪公会。总有如此有成就的厨师拜访我们真好。说，你对烹饪技能斗篷感兴趣吗？它们只提供给大师级厨师。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Okay, come back to me if you change your mind.
translation: 好的，改变主意再来找我。

english: Can I buy a Skillcape of Cooking from you?
translation: 我能从你这买烹饪技能斗篷吗？

english: Most certainly, by wearing this cape you'll never burn any food, I will have to ask for 99000 gold coins for such a privilege.
translation: 当然，通过穿这个斗篷你永远不会烧焦任何食物，我得为这种特权要99000金币。

english: That's much too expensive.
translation: 那太贵了。

english: I'm sorry you feel that way.
translation: 很遗憾你那样感觉。

english: Sure.
translation: 当然。

english: But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: 但，不幸的是，我身上没带够钱。

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.
translation: 嗯，等你有钱了再来找我。

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 不幸的是所有技能斗篷只搭配免费兜帽出售，这是技能促销的一部分；买一送一，你知道的。所以你得先腾出一些物品栏空间我才能卖给你。

english: Now you can use the title Master Chef.
translation: 现在你可以使用大师级厨师头衔。

english: May I have another hood for my cape, please?
translation: 能再给我的斗篷要个兜帽吗？

english: Most certainly, and free of charge!
translation: 当然，而且免费！

english: The head chef hands you another hood for your skillcape.
translation: 主厨递给你另一个技能斗篷兜帽。

english: You can't come in here unless you're wearing a chef's hat, or something like that.
translation: 你不能进来除非你戴着厨师帽，或类似的东西。

english: Sorry. Only the finest chefs are allowed in here. Get your cooking level up to 32 and come back wearing a chef's hat.
translation: 抱歉。只有最好的厨师才被允许进入这里。把烹饪等级提升到32并戴着厨师帽回来。

english: Sorry. Only the finest chefs are allowed in here. Get your cooking level up to 32.
translation: 抱歉。只有最好的厨师才被允许进入这里。把烹饪等级提升到32。

english: You have done well, [player name]!
translation: 你做得很好，[player name]！

english: Nice cape you're wearing!
translation: 你穿的斗篷不错！

english: Thanks, bye.
translation: 谢谢，再见。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: That's much too expensive.
translation: 那太贵了。

english: Sure.
translation: 当然。

english: Skillcape
translation: 技能斗篷

english: Hood
translation: 兜帽

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Good day to you my friend, a beautiful one at that. Would you like some groceries? I have all sorts. Alcohol also, if you're partial to a drink.
translation: 你好我的朋友，而且是美好的一天。想要些杂货吗？我各种都有。也有酒，如果你喜欢喝一杯。

english: No thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Ahh well, all the best to you.
translation: 啊好吧，祝你一切顺利。

english: I'll have a look.
translation: 我看看。

english: There's a good human.
translation: 那是个好人类。

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 虽然你找到了顾客，但你似乎没带正确的食物！你需要 [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]！

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 恐怕预制菜肴不合要求。唯有手工烹制的地精美食，才配得上阿卢夫航空的顾客。

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Heckel Funch
translation: 你把 [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] 的配送交给赫克尔‧芬奇

english: Hey! Thanks a lot mate. You're a diamond.
translation: 嘿！非常感谢，伙计。你真是个好人。

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 你有 [number] 积分可兑换免费配送代币。你可以让 [number] 份地精美食配送给你。

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: 别忘了从小阿卢夫‧吉安那里领取免费配送代币。

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 配送已超时！请返回小阿卢夫处重新接单。你丢掉了配送箱，因为不再需要了。

english: Please do puzzle for me human!
translation: 请帮我解谜人类！

english: No, that's wrong I'm afraid.
translation: 不，那错了恐怕。

english: Well done, human!
translation: 干得好，人类！

english: No thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: I'll have a look.
translation: 我看看。

english: Nilsal. Here to pay respects, or just here to appreciate the calmness of this crypt?
translation: 你好。来致敬，还是只是来欣赏这个墓穴的宁静？

english: Just looking around really.
translation: 只是随便看看真的。

english: Please do. Many find this a nice place to come from time to time. The bustle of the city can be overwhelming. Here you can contemplate many things in peace, watched over by Ranul himself.
translation: 请便。许多人发现这是个时不时来的好地方。城市的喧嚣可能压倒一切。在这里你可以在平静中沉思许多事，由拉努尔本人看守。

english: Hello, can I ask you a question?
translation: 你好，能问你个问题吗？

english: Oh yes, young fellow? Yes, what do you want?
translation: 哦是的，年轻人？是的，你想要什么？

english: Who's that you're talking to Hegir?
translation: 你在跟谁说话海吉尔？

english: Let me see, he appears to be a human of some sort.
translation: 让我看看，他似乎是某种人类。

english: What was your name again, human?
translation: 你再说一次你叫什么名字，人类？

english: [player name].
translation: [player name]。

english: It's [player name]!
translation: 是 [player name]！

english: Well ask him what he wants then!
translation: 那问他想要什么！

english: What do you want, human?
translation: 你想要什么，人类？

english: Errr... I don't know... A quest, maybe?
translation: 呃……我不知道……一个任务，也许？

english: He says he's looking for his quest!
translation: 他说他在找他的任务！

english: What makes him think he lost his quest in here?
translation: 什么让他觉得他把任务丢在这里了？

english: What makes you think you lost your quest in here?
translation: 什么让你觉得你把任务丢在这里了？

english: No no, I mean, do you have a task of some sort for me?
translation: 不不，我是说，你有什么任务给我吗？

english: Now he says he wants a task!
translation: 现在他说他想要个任务！

english: Stop talking to that human and get back in here before I have a task for you!
translation: 别跟那个人类说话在我给你任务前回来！

english: No need to talk to me like that, Haera.
translation: 没必要那样跟我说话，海拉。

english: I'll talk to you in whatever way I like!
translation: 我想怎么跟你说话就怎么！

english: I think I hear someone calling my name in the distance…
translation: 我想我听到远处有人叫我的名字……

english: No need to shout!
translation: 没必要喊！

english: Calm down dear.
translation: 冷静点。

english: I don't see why.
translation: 我不明白为什么。

english: Yes you did!
translation: 你确实了！

english: I did not!
translation: 我没有！

english: What did you do that for?
translation: 你为什么那样做？

english: Welcome to the Heroes' Guild!
translation: 欢迎来到英雄公会！

english: So do you sell anything good here?
translation: 那你这里卖什么好东西吗？

english: Why yes! We DO run an exclusive shop for our members!
translation: 哦是的！我们确实为会员经营独家商店！

english: So what can I do here?
translation: 那我在这里能做什么？

english: Look around... there are all sorts of things to keep our guild members entertained!
translation: 四处看看……有各种东西让我们的公会会员娱乐！

english: So do you sell anything here?
translation: 那你这里卖什么吗？

english: So what can I do here?
translation: 那我在这里能做什么？

english: Hey look it's the hero! It's great to have you around.
translation: 嘿看是英雄！有你在真好。

english: Hello there. Did you see that dwarf by the big forge? I think he wanted to talk to you.
translation: 你好。你看到大熔炉旁那个矮人了吗？我想他想跟你说话。

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Hello. Sorry, I'd love to stop and chat, but I have a new find that I need to work on. If you need anything, I'm sure Prescott can help.
translation: 你好。抱歉，我想停下来聊聊，但我有个新发现需要处理。如果你需要什么，我相信普雷斯科特能帮忙。

english: Okay, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Not a problem.
translation: 没问题。

english: Excuse me...
translation: 打扰一下……

english: Can I help you?
translation: 我能帮你吗？

english: Can you tell me anything about the castle?
translation: 能说说城堡的情况吗？

english: There aren't many guards in it.
translation: 里面守卫不多。

english: We don't have an army, you see.
translation: 你看，我们没有军队。

english: How's the weather doing?
translation: 天气怎么样？

english: Could be better.
translation: 可能更好。

english: How's life in Etceteria?
translation: 埃西特利亚生活怎么样？

english: *sigh* Times are tough.
translation: (叹气)时世艰难。

english: Though they're getting better.
translation: 不过在好转。

english: What's it like being an Etceterian?
translation: 做埃西特利亚人怎么样？

english: Fairly pleasant, though it gets cold in the winter.
translation: 相当愉快，虽然冬天会变冷。

english: Nice town you have here.
translation: 你这里城镇不错。

english: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。

english: Yes, can I help you?
translation: 是的，能帮你吗？

english: Thank you for finding my shield for me. Did you find everyone's belongings?
translation: 谢谢你帮我找到盾牌。你找到所有人的物品了吗？

english: I did! Thank you for the reward.
translation: 找到了！谢谢奖励

english: You're more than welcome to it, for getting our belongings back.
translation: 你能帮我们找回物品，这是应该的。

english: Can you tell me how the kingdom approves of me?
translation: 你能告诉我王国对我的认可度吗？

english: [amount]% of people approve of you.
translation: [amount]% 的人认可你。

english: The storerooms are full, your Highness. You should talk to Advisor Ghrim to collect what we've gathered for you.
translation: 储藏室已满，殿下。请去找顾问格里姆领取我们为你收集的物资。

english: How are you doing?
translation: 你怎么样？

english: Great. Ready to take on another of those pesky rats!
translation: 很好。准备好对付另一只那些讨厌的老鼠！

english: Hungry. I wound like....
translation: 饿。我想……

english: One meeeeeellion tuna!
translation: 一——百万金枪鱼！

english: One meeeeeelion tuna? Don't be daft. No, I'll stick to pie thanks.
translation: 一——百万金枪鱼？别傻了。不，我还是吃派谢谢。

english: Rat pie?
translation: 老鼠派？

english: Yuck! I'd rather eat rock soup with the Trolls!
translation: 呸！我宁愿跟巨魔吃石头汤！

english: I've got this horrible itch behind my ears. Would you scratch it?
translation: 我耳朵后面有个可怕的痒。你能挠挠吗？

english: Ahhh, how sweet. Kitty want a cuddle?
translation: 啊，多甜。小猫想要抱抱？

english: Just because I look big and tough doesn't mean I can't let my guard down once in a while? No fair!
translation: 就因为我看起来又大又壮，并不意味着我不能偶尔放下防备？不公平！

english: Ahhh, I newyou were a big softie.
translation: 啊，我知——道你是个大软蛋。

english: Don't push your luck no-fur.
translation: 别得寸进尺没毛的。

english: I'm less than a month old.
translation: 我不到一个月大。

english: I'm just a month old.
translation: 我刚一个月大。

english: How old are you now?
translation: 你现在多大了？

english: I'm almost fully grown!
translation: 我几乎完全长大了！

english: Where do you want to go?
translation: 你想去哪？

english: Let's go steal some things from stalls. I do enjoy watching shopkeepers panic!
translation: 我们去从摊位偷点东西。我确实喜欢看店主恐慌！

english: Can we go tripping people up as they climb the stairs? It's my favorite.
translation: 我们能去绊倒爬楼梯的人吗？那是我的最爱。

english: Can we go and tear up some furniture? I love that!
translation: 我们能去撕碎些家具吗？我爱那个！

english: What do you want to do now?
translation: 你现在想做什么？

english: I need to crunch something - lets go ratting!
translation: 我需要嚼点东西——我们去抓老鼠！

english: Yawn. I need sleep.
translation: 哈欠。我需要睡觉。

english: You softly stroke your cat.
translation: 你轻轻抚摸你的猫。

english: Purr...purr...
translation: 呼噜……呼噜……

english: Who's a good little evil cat then?
translation: 那谁是只好小邪恶猫？

english: Me! Me! Find me some fish heads to crunch! Yum yum.
translation: 我！我！给我找些鱼头嚼！好吃好吃。

english: Chase Vermin
translation: 追逐害虫

english: I've had enough of your whiny attitude cat. Now get lost!
translation: 我受够了你那抱怨的态度猫。现在滚！

english: Me? Whiny? Well, if that isn't the demon calling the imp red! I'll hunt you down when I'm bigger and you'll be sorry!
translation: 我？抱怨？嗯，这真是恶魔说小恶魔红！等我大了我会追捕你你会后悔的！

english: I'm sorry... all is forgiven!
translation: 对不起……都原谅了！

english: It's too late for you, no-fur. I hope you get your sword stuck and a dragon falls on your head. Now shoo!
translation: 对你来说太晚了，没毛的。我希望你的剑卡住且龙掉你头上。现在走！

english: Shoo cat!
translation: 走猫！

english: Meeeooow!
The cat has run away.
translation: 猫跑掉了。

english: You choose not to shoo away the cat.
translation: 你选择不赶走猫。

english: Big, mean, and ready to rumble. Just the way I like it.
translation: 大，凶，准备好打架。正是我喜欢的。

english: Practically perfect in every way. Ready for world domination.
translation: 几乎各方面都完美。准备好统治世界。

english: Easy there tiger.
translation: 冷静点老虎。

english: I'm feeling a bit like one of those dog things, all fat and slow. I'd love to do some rat catching.
translation: 我感觉有点像那些狗东西，又胖又慢。我想去抓老鼠。

english: I fancy pointing and laughing at some demons. They always make me cackle.
translation: 我想指着些恶魔笑。它们总是让我咯咯笑。

english: Why's that?
translation: 为什么？

english: Well, have you never noticed how well ghouls and demons get on?
translation: 嗯，你从未注意到食尸鬼和恶魔相处得多好吗？

english: No... Can't say I have.
translation: 不……不能说我有。

english: Yeah... Demons are a ghoul's best friend.
translation: 是的……恶魔是食尸鬼最好的朋友。

english: Hmm. I'm not sure I understand that. Is it some kind of joke?
translation: 嗯。我不确定我理解那个。是某种笑话吗？

english: Sigh. I think you're the only joke round here, no-fur.
translation: 叹气。我想你是这周围唯一的笑话，没毛的。

english: Prey on the weak and injured. Let's try the wilderness!
translation: 捕食弱者和伤者。我们去试试荒野！

english: Purr...purr...
translation: 呼噜……呼噜……

english: Who's an evil little kitty then?
translation: 那谁是只邪恶小猫？

english: Hiss Hiss! Me! Do it again!
translation: 嘶嘶！我！再来！

english: Go on, get lost.
translation: 走吧，滚。

english: Thank Zamorak for that. Finally some freedom from your ugly face!
translation: 感谢扎莫拉克。终于从你那张丑脸解脱了！

english: Meeeooow!
Frankly, I could do with it being a bit hotter round here, but I'll survive.
translation: 老实说，我希望这里能热点，但我会活下去。

english: Why's that then?
translation: 那为什么？

english: Those of us more in touch with our past tend to like it warmer. It's the legacy of the Felis Silvestris Lybica, or desert cat as you would say.
translation: 我们这些更怀念过去的往往喜欢暖和些。那是非洲野猫的传承，或者如你所说的沙漠猫。

english: Cats? In the desert?
translation: 猫？在沙漠？

english: Oh yes. Many of us left due to the harsh conditions. Sand is the worst thing to lick yourself clean from.
translation: 哦是的。我们许多人因恶劣条件离开。沙子是最难舔干净的东西。

english: I'll bet!
translation: 我打赌！

english: Age is irrelevant. Time is irrelevant.
translation: 年龄无关。时间无关。

english: Erm, no, I mean, how are you doing?
translation: 呃，不，我是说，你怎么样？

english: Look into my eyes...
translation: 看着我的眼睛……

english: ...my belly is full from the crunching of bones you leave behind, and my paws ache.
translation: ……我的肚子因咀嚼你留下的骨头而饱，而且我的爪子疼。

english: Huh? Who said that?
translation: 哈？谁说的？

english: I did, via you. Shall I do it again?
translation: 我，通过你。要我再来一次吗？

english: Straight down the throat of destruction, grasping the tonsil of death as we swing into the belly of evil!
translation: 直下毁灭之喉，抓住死亡之扁桃体当我们冲进邪恶之腹！

english: I see. Is that located anywhere near Lumbridge?
translation: 我明白了。那位于仑桥镇附近吗？

english: Only in your nightmares, no-fur.
translation: 只在你噩梦里，没毛的。

english: I do have a name you know.
translation: 我确实有个名字你知道。

english: And so do I. But you didn't stop to ask before naming me yourself, did you?
translation: 我也是。但你在给自己命名前没停下来问我，对吧？

english: Touche my friend, touche.
translation: 说得好我的朋友，说得好。

english: I'd love to crunch up some rats. Mmm... rats.
translation: 我想嚼些老鼠。嗯……老鼠。

english: Hey, why do rats need oiling?
translation: 嘿，为什么老鼠需要上油？

english: Oiling? I have no idea.
translation: 上油？我不知道。

english: Because they squeak. Get it? They squeak!
translation: 因为它们吱吱叫。懂吗？它们吱吱叫！

english: Wow. That's so funny I almost laughed. I guess I'll have to eat something else then.
translation: 哇。那太有趣了我差点笑了。我想那我得吃点别的。

english: I don't like the way you're looking at me. We'll go get some rats soon, I promise.
translation: 我不喜欢你看着我的方式。我们很快去弄些老鼠，我保证。

english: Good answer, no-fur.
translation: 好回答，没毛的。

english: Purr...purr...
translation: 呼噜……呼噜……

english: Hey there fat cat! Fancy a stroke?
translation: 嘿那边胖猫！想被抚摸吗？

english: Only because I know it amuses you. I couldn't care less... mmmmmmmm.
translation: 只因为我知道那逗你开心。我才不在乎……嗯嗯嗯。

english: I've had just about all I can take from you and your bad attitude. Now scat, cat!
translation: 我受够了你和你那坏态度。现在滚，猫！

english: You bore me. I had my things packed weeks ago anyway, I was just hanging about to see how many little presents I could leave in your Bank.
translation: 你让我无聊。反正我几周前就收拾好东西了，我只是闲逛看能在你银行留多少小礼物。

english: If I find you've messed things up in there I'll...
translation: 如果我发现你在那里搞砸了我会……

english: You'll what? Come on now, let's be honest. You couldn't fight your way out of a cow field. I'm off!!
translation: 你会怎样？来吧，老实点。你连牛场都打不出去。我走了！！

english: Meeeooow!
Content. But a little more attention or rat hunting wouldn't go amiss.
translation: 满足。但多一点关注或抓老鼠也不错。

english: I'll see what I can do.
translation: 我看看我能做什么。

english: Whoa-oa-oa! I feel good, I knew that I would now... I feel nice!
translation: 哇 - 哦 - 哦！我感觉很好，我知道我现在会……我感觉不错！

english: Here in the sewers seems as good a place as any.
translation: 这里在下水道似乎跟任何地方一样好。

english: Let's go to the sewers of Varrock.
translation: 我们去维洛克下水道。

english: Anywhere dangerous is good with me!
translation: 任何危险的地方我都行！

english: Happy as a demon in a lava pit.
translation: 像熔岩坑里的恶魔一样快乐。

english: Good... I think.
translation: 好……我想。

english: I'm feeling a bit like a ghost in a cake shop.
translation: 我感觉有点像蛋糕店里的鬼。

english: A ghost in a cake shop? What do you mean?
translation: 蛋糕店里的鬼？你什么意思？

english: You know... In need of exorcise.
translation: 你知道……需要驱驱邪。

english: Oh, now that ones really bad. Guthix save me!
translation: 哦，那个真够烂的。古斯救我！

english: I reckon West Ardougne would be the best bet from here.
translation: 我觉得从这里去西阿多尼城是最好的选择。

english: Hunting!
translation: 狩猎！

english: Is there anywhere in particular that you would like to go?
translation: 你有什么特别想去的地方吗？

english: And what do you want?
translation: 那你想要什么？

english: I just wondered how you were, that's all. No need to bite my head off!
translation: 我只是想知道你怎么样，仅此而已。没必要咬我的头！

english: Ha! If I wanted to bite your head off, I would have done it while you were distracted with that other no-fur.
translation: 哈！如果我想咬你的头，早就在你被那个没毛的分散注意力时做了。

english: None of your business no-fur. What about you - how old are you?
translation: 不关你的事没毛的。你呢——你多大了？

english: I'm asking the questions here!
translation: 是我在问问题！

english: Hiss!
translation: 嘶！

english: I don't want to hear it. I don't want to hear anything! Oh, it's a nightmare I tell you, a nightmare!
translation: 我不想听。我什么都不想听！哦，我告诉你那是噩梦，简直是噩梦！

english: What on Gielinor are you talking about?
translation: 你到底在说什么？

english: Look! My thumbs have gone weird!
translation: 看！我的拇指变怪了！

english: But you don't have any thumbs.
translation: 但你根本没有拇指。

english: Argh! My thumbs!
translation: 啊！我的拇指！

english: Let's go find Bob! I've got a bone to pick with him anyway.
translation: 我们去找鲍勃！反正我有笔账要跟他算。

english: Let's go hunt some butterflies. They're so stupid and ugly.
translation: 我们去猎些蝴蝶吧。它们又蠢又丑。

english: They're not stupid. They study at school and everything.
translation: 它们不蠢。它们在学校学习什么的。

english: School? I guess I can humor you. What do they learn at school then?
translation: 学校？我想我可以迁就你。那它们在学校学什么？

english: Mothematics!
translation: 蛾子数学！

english: We went through all that just for a bad pun! One day no-fur, one day I'll get you back.
translation: 我们折腾半天就为了个烂双关！总有一天没毛的，总有一天我会报仇的。

english: More carnage! More rats! I seek BLOOD!
translation: 更多屠杀！更多老鼠！我渴望鲜血！

english: Purr...purr...
translation: 呼噜……呼噜……

english: You're too old. I'm upgrading to a newer model!
translation: 你太老了。我要升级成更新型号了！

english: Yes, me too. Have fun with whatever rock you crawl under.
translation: 是的，我也是。祝你躲在什么石头底下玩得开心。

english: Meeeooow!
Yawn. I'm too lazy to even bother answering you.
translation: 哈欠。我太懒了懒得理你。

english: Do you mind? I'm trying to clean!
translation: 你介意吗？我正忙着清理！

english: Your cat turns its back to you and continues washing.
translation: 你的猫背对着你继续清洗。

english: Oi, kitty! I'm talking to you!
translation: 喂，小猫！我在跟你说话！

english: Go away!
translation: 走开！

english: Anywhere but here. I'm feeling lucky!
translation: 除了这里任何地方。我感觉手气不错！

english: Let's go to the Emir's Arena, near Al Kharid, and watch some fights
translation: 我们去埃米尔竞技场吧，在阿尔卡里德城附近，看些打斗

english: Curling up on a nice rug in front of a fire... or in the fire. Either way is good.
translation: 蜷缩在火前的漂亮地毯上……或者在火里。都行。

english: You're a bit odd, really, aren't you?
translation: 你真的有点怪，对吧？

english: Old, but not too old. I could still scratch that cheeky face of yours.
translation: 老了，但还没太老。我还能抓花你那厚脸皮。

english: Awww, poor old kitty. I suppose all this were just fields when you were a nipper!
translation: 哎呀，可怜的老猫。我想你小时候这里还都是田野吧！

english: Most of it still is, you young whippersnapper!
translation: 大部分还是，你这个小毛孩！

english: Somewhere brutal and nasty. I could do with a snooze, you see.
translation: 某个残酷肮脏的地方。你知道，我想打个盹。

english: Let's go point and laugh at people getting killed by chickens.
translation: 我们去指着被鸡杀死的人嘲笑吧。

english: Nobody's ever died from chickens. What are you talking about?
translation: 没人被鸡杀死过。你在说什么？

english: Oh yes they have. Have you never met the evil chicken? He's my hero!
translation: 哦有的。你从未见过邪恶鸡吗？他是我的英雄！

english: Cripes! I forgot about that thing.
translation: 天哪！我忘了那回事。

english: Look, there he is now!
translation: 看，他现在就在那！

english: Argh! Where?
translation: 啊！在哪？

english: Humans are too gullible these days. Heee heee.
translation: 人类现在太好骗了。嘿嘿。

english: Grrr!! I'll turn you into violin strings yet, kitty!
translation: 咕噜！！我会把你变成小提琴弦的，小猫！

english: Hiss! What do you care?
translation: 嘶！你管得着吗？

english: I care!
translation: 我管得着！

english: Hiss!
translation: 嘶！

english: Oh dear.
translation: 哦天。

english: Too old to waste time talking to you about the price of fish.
translation: 太老了没时间跟你废话鱼价。

english: Fish? Selling lobsters, shout me me me to buy!
translation: 鱼？卖龙虾，喊我我我来买！

english: I give up with these humans. Oh cruel fate, why do you mock me so?
translation: 我放弃这些人类了。哦残酷的命运，你为何如此嘲弄我？

english: Let's go dig up King Rollie's garden. He was very pleased the last time he saw me in there.
translation: 我们去挖罗利国王的花园吧。上次他在那里见到我很高兴。

english: Hmm. Let's not.
translation: 嗯。还是别了。

english: Chicken!
translation: 鸡！

english: Anything evil is just fine with me.
translation: 任何邪恶的我都行。

english: Purr...purr...
translation: 呼噜……呼噜……

english: Hit the road cat. And don't you come back no more no more no more no more!
translation: 上路吧猫。别再回来了别再回来了别再回来了别再回来了！

english: You're the meanest old adventurer I've ever met - and your singing is terrible!
translation: 你是我见过最刻薄的老冒险者——而且你唱歌难听死了！

english: Meeeooow!
Your hell-cat transforms into an ordinary cat.
translation: 你的地狱猫变成了普通猫。

english: How are you doing?
translation: 你怎么样？

english: How old are you now?
translation: 你现在多大了？

english: Where do you want to go?
translation: 你想去哪？

english: What do you want to do now?
translation: 你现在想做什么？

english: Stroke

english: Shoo away
translation: 赶走

english: Yes I am.
translation: 是的我是。

english: No I'm not.
translation: 不我不是。

english: How many souls have you devoured?
translation: 你吞噬了多少灵魂？

english: None.
translation: 没有。

english: Awww p-
translation: 哎呀 p-

english: Yet.
translation: 还没。

english: Oh.
translation: 哦。

english: What a cute puppy, how nice to meet you.
translation: 多可爱的小狗，很高兴见到你。

english: It'll be nice to meat you too...
translation: 见到你也很“美味”……

english: Urk... nice doggy.
translation: 呃……好狗狗。

english: Grrrr....
translation: 咕噜……

english: Hell yeah! Such a cute puppy!
translation: 可不是嘛！好可爱的小狗！

english: Silence mortal! Or I'll eat your soul.
translation: 闭嘴凡人！否则我吃了你的灵魂。

english: Would that go well with lemon?
translation: 那配柠檬好吗？

english: Why were the hot dogs shivering?
translation: 为什么热狗在发抖？

english: Grrrrr...
translation: 咕噜……

english: Because they were served-
translation: 因为它们被端上——

english: GRRRRRR...
translation: 咕噜……

english: -with... chilli?
I wonder if I need to invest in a trowel when I take you out for a walk.
translation: 我在想带你出去散步时是否需要投资把铲子。

english: More like a shovel.
translation: 更像是铲子。

english: Grrr... cats.
translation: 咕噜……猫。

english: Soulless object.
translation: 无魂物体。

english: Cats smell
translation: 猫臭

english: Rawr
translation: 嗷

english: Wooooof
translation: 汪

english: Grrrrrr!
translation: 咕噜！

english: The spirit looks at you without saying a word. However, as you approach, he offers you some items.
translation: 灵魂看着你不说话。不过，当你靠近时，他给你提供一些物品。

english: The spirit gives you a strange look. You don't have enough room in your supply bag for what he's offering.
translation: 灵魂奇怪地看着你。你的补给袋没足够空间装他提供的东西。

english: The spirit gives you a strange look. You've clearly claimed all you can for now.
translation: 灵魂奇怪地看着你。你显然已经领取了目前能领的所有东西。

english: Hello?
translation: 你好？

english: You have reached the Lunar Communication Helpline. I'm sorry we can't answer your telekinetic question right now. Our opening times are carefully organised to coincide with you being busy. If you are having an
translation: 你已接通月幻沟通热线。抱歉我们现在无法回答你的心灵传动问题。我们的开放时间精心安排，正好趁你忙的时候。

english: emergency, you have our most profound apologies. Have a nice day. Good bye.
translation: 如果你有紧急情况，我们深表歉意。祝你愉快。再见。

english: Typical.
translation: 典型。

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: You do not have an appointment.
translation: 你没有预约。

english: Sorry, what?
translation: 抱歉，什么？

english: Appointment for what?
translation: 预约什么？

english: An appointment to see the Queen.
translation: 预约见女王。

english: How do you know that?
translation: 你怎么知道的？

english: First, because it is my job. Second, because she is not in Fortis at the moment.
translation: 第一，因为这是我的工作。第二，因为她现在不在福蒂斯。

english: Oh. Well where is she then?
translation: 哦。那她在哪？

english: She has important business elsewhere in the kingdom. Perhaps when she returns, you'll be able to see her, or perhaps you won't.
translation: 她在王国别处有重要事务。也许她回来时你能见到她，也许不能。

english: Yes, those generally are the two options.
translation: 是的，通常就这两个选项。

english: Now, if there's nothing else, please move along.
translation: 现在，如果没别的事，请让开。

english: If you wish to speak with the Queen, please be quick. She is very busy and does not need you taking up too much of her time.
translation: 如果你想跟女王说话，请快点。她很忙，不需要你占用太多时间。

english: Okay...
translation: 好吧……

english: Hello there. Want to sample my catch of the day? Or maybe you'd prefer to do some fishing yourself? If so, I have all the supplies you'll need.
translation: 你好。想尝尝我今天的渔获吗？或者也许你想自己钓鱼？如果是，我有你需要的所有补给。

english: Let's see what you have.
translation: 让我看看你有什么。

english: Nothing for me, thanks.
translation: 没什么给我的，谢谢。

english: As you wish.
translation: 如你所愿。

english: Let's see what you have.
translation: 让我看看你有什么。

english: Nothing for me, thanks.
translation: 没什么给我的，谢谢。

english: Hello there! If you have any ores to trade I'm always buying.
translation: 你好！如果你有任何矿石要交易，我一直收购。

english: Why don't you ever restock your shop?
translation: 你为什么从不补货？

english: The only ores I sell are the ones that are sold to me.
translation: 我卖的矿石只是那些卖给我的。

english: Anything else?
translation: 还有别的吗？

english: See you later.
translation: 回头见。

english: Until next time.
translation: 下次见。

english: Let's trade.
translation: 交易吧。

english: Why don't you ever restock your shop?
translation: 你为什么从不补货？

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Hi.
translation: 嗨。

english: You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 你知道吗，跟人打招呼的方式可多了。你好、嘿、你好啊……

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: 那仍然只算一种！

english: Hello. How are you today?
translation: 你好。你今天怎么样？

english: I'm great, thank you!
translation: 我很好，谢谢！

english: Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 你好！水晶城今天天气真好，哈？

english: Indeed.
translation: 确实。

english: What can I do for ya?
translation: 我能为你做什么？

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这里有什么可以做的？

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 可做的事可多了！塔楼就是绝妙景致。

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 像今天这样的好日子，我建议去市场逛逛。

english: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你以为你在做什么？

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这里有什么可以做的？

english: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: I'm just wandering around.
translation: 我只是随便逛逛。

english: You do realise you're wandering around in my house?
translation: 你意识到你在我家里随便逛逛吗？

english: Yep.
translation: 是的。

english: Well please get out!
translation: 那请出去！

english: Sheesh, keep your wig on!
translation: 哎呀，别激动！

english: I was hoping you'd give me some free stuff.
translation: 我本来希望你能给我些免费东西。

english: No, I jolly well wouldn't! Get out of my house!
translation: 不，我绝对不会！滚出我家！

english: Meanie!
translation: 小气鬼！

english: Aaaarrgh!
translation: 啊！

english: Eeeek!
translation: 咦！

english: I'm just wandering around.
translation: 我只是随便逛逛。

english: I was hoping you'd give me some free stuff.
translation: 我本来希望你能给我些免费东西。

english: I've come to kill you.
translation: 我来杀你。

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Hmm... You don't seem like a real guard to me. Who are you?
translation: 嗯……你看起来不像真守卫。你是谁？

english: No one important.
translation: 没什么重要人物。

english: You're not a guard. What are you doing in here?
translation: 你不是守卫。你在这里做什么？

english: Nothing important.
translation: 没什么重要的。

english: If you say so.
translation: 你说是就是吧。

english: Hello there. So Khazard got his hands on you too?
translation: 你好。所以卡扎德也抓到你了？

english: Unfortunately so.
translation: 不幸的是。

english: Well if you're lucky, you might last as long as me.
translation: 嗯如果你幸运，可能活得跟我一样久。

english: How long have you been here?
translation: 你在这里多久了？

english: As long as I can remember. I was a child when his men kidnapped me. My whole life has been spent killing and fighting, all in the hope that one day I might escape.
translation: 从我能记得起。我还是孩子时他的人绑架了我。我一生都在杀戮和战斗，都希望有一天能逃脱。

english: Don't give up.
translation: 别放弃。

english: Thanks, friend.
translation: 谢谢，朋友。

english: Wait... sounds like the guard is coming. Looks like you'll be going back into the arena. Good luck, friend.
translation: 等等……听起来守卫来了。看来你要回竞技场了。祝你好运，朋友。

english: Hello again.
translation: 又见面了。

english: I don't know how you managed to escape, but you may not be as lucky next time. Get out of here while you can.
translation: 我不知道你怎么逃脱的，但下次可能没这么幸运。趁能走赶紧走。

english: Sorry, we don't talk to strangers.
translation: 抱歉，我们不跟陌生人说话。

english: Thanks again for helping Uncle Eric. He thinks you're really really brave. I hope he'll visit again soon.
translation: 再次谢谢你帮助埃里克叔叔。他觉得你真的非常勇敢。希望他很快再来拜访。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Oh, hello. If you wish to look around the Carnillean family home, please refrain from touching anything with those grubby hands of yours.
translation: 哦，你好。如果你想参观卡尼利安家族宅邸，请别用你那脏手碰任何东西。

english: Okay...
translation: 好吧……

english: Hello again, adventurer. Since you dealt with those horrible cultists, things have vastly improved for us around here!
translation: 又见面了，冒险者。自从你处理了那些可怕的邪教徒，我们这里的情况大大改善了！

english: I'm happy to have helped.
translation: 很高兴能帮忙。

english: Oh, it's you. I'm very disappointed that you never found those awful cultists. You're quite useless really, aren't you?
translation: 哦，是你。我很失望你从未找到那些可怕的邪教徒。你真没用，对吧？

english: Yup, I guess I am.
translation: 是的，我想我是。

english: Are you hungry?
translation: 你饿吗？

english: That depends, what have you got?
translation: 那要看情况，你有什么？

english: I'm sure I could knock you up a decent salad.
translation: 我肯定能给你弄份不错的沙拉。

english: I'm actually an insectivore.
translation: 我其实是食虫动物。

english: Oh, but your name suggests that-
translation: 哦，但你的名字暗示——

english: I think you'll find I didn't name myself, you humans and your silly puns.
translation: 我想你会发现我不是自己取的名，你们人类和你们愚蠢的双关语。

english: No need to PUNish us for our incredible wit.
translation: 没必要因为我们惊人的机智而‘惩罚’我们。

english: Please. Stop.
translation: 拜托。停下。

english: Have your herbs died?
translation: 你的药草死了吗？

english: These old things? I guess they've dried up... I'm getting old and I need caring for. I've chosen you to do that by the way.
translation: 这些老东西？我想它们干了……我老了需要照顾。顺便说我选了你来做。

english: Oh fantastic! I spend all that time training the Farming skill, and now I'm supposed to care for your herbs as well?
translation: 哦太棒了！我花那么多时间训练种植技能，现在还要照顾你的药草？

english: I could try the next person if you'd prefer?
translation: 如果你愿意我可以试试下一个人？

english: I'm just joking you old swine!
translation: 我只是开玩笑你这老猪！

english: So you live in a hole? I would've thought Boars are surface dwelling mammals.
translation: 所以你住在洞里？我以为野猪是地表哺乳动物。

english: Well, I'm special! I bore down a little so I'm nice and cosy with my herbs exposed to the sun, it's all very interesting.
translation: 嗯，我很特别！我挖深一点所以我很舒适且我的药草暴露在阳光下，都很有趣。

english: Sounds rather... Boring!
translation: 听起来相当……无聊！

english: How very original...
translation: 多么原创……

english: Tell me... do you like Avacado?
translation: 告诉我……你喜欢牛油果吗？

english: I'm an insectivore, but even if I wasn't I'd hate Avacado!
translation: 我是食虫动物，但即使不是我也讨厌牛油果！

english: Why ever not? It's delicious!
translation: 为什么不？它很好吃！

english: I don't know why people like it so much... it tastes a likea ball of chewed up grass.
translation: 我不知道为什么人们这么喜欢它……它尝起来像嚼过的草球。

english: Sometimes you can be such a bore...
translation: 有时你真无聊……

english: When I was a young HERBIBOAR!!
translation: 当我还是只小药猪的时候！！

english: I'm standing right next to you, no need to shout...
translation: 我就站在你旁边，没必要喊……

english: I was trying to sing you a song...
translation: 我正想给你唱首歌……

english: Ever tried a butterfly before?
translation: 以前试过蝴蝶吗？

english: I've never been able to catch one, they've always eluded me.
translation: 我从没能抓到一只，它们总是躲开我。

english: Herbi chomps excitedly on the butterfly, he seems pleased.
translation: 赫比兴奋地嚼着蝴蝶，他似乎很高兴。

english: Woah! You should try those, they're amazing.
translation: 哇！你应该试试那些，它们太棒了。

english: I got you some grubs!
translation: 我给你弄了些幼虫！

english: My favorite!
translation: 我的最爱！

english: Herbi munches happily on the grubs. It's rather gross.
translation: 赫比快乐地嚼着幼虫。相当恶心。

english: How about some wyrms?
translation: 来些蛇龙怎么样？

english: I assume you mean worms, not sure I could stomach a wyrm, far too big.
translation: 我想你是指蠕虫，不确定我能吞下蛇龙，太大了。

english: Oh yeah, those words don't even sound the same.
translation: 哦是的，那些词听起来甚至不一样。

english: I don't judge you, now hand over those worms!
translation: 我不评判你，现在把那些蠕虫交出来！

english: Herbi hungrily devours the worms, you regret watching him do it.
translation: 赫比饥饿地吞下蠕虫，你后悔看着他做。

english: Slimy, yet satisfying.
translation: 黏糊糊，但满足。

english: I got you a spider carcass!
translation: 我给你弄了个蜘蛛尸体！

english: Not really an insect, but admittedly I'm not too fussy.
translation: 不算是昆虫，但承认我不太挑剔。

english: Herbi gobbles the spider down, several legs fall to the ground around him.
translation: 赫比吞下蜘蛛，几条腿掉在他周围地上。

english: You missed a bit.
translation: 你漏了点。

english: I'll save them for later.
translation: 我留着以后吃。

english: Oink!
translation: 哼！

english: THEY CALL ME MR. PIIIG!
translation: 他们叫我猪先生！

english: I'll show you a bacon salad!
translation: 我给你看个培根沙拉！

english: Hiya Hermie!
translation: 嗨赫米！

english: Ah, [player name]! How's the fishing going?
translation: 啊，[player name]！钓鱼怎么样？

english: Still working on it. How's the Colony?
translation: 还在努力。殖民地怎么样？

english: Flourishing, now that the colonists are coming back! Soon all the finest restaurants will be serving monkfish!
translation: 繁荣，现在殖民者回来了！很快所有最好的餐厅都会供应僧侣鱼！

english: It's a pity those skeletons you brought here haven't gone away again, though. They're in the dormitories, which is rather annoying! So please take a little time to kick 'em around a bit.
translation: 不过可惜你带来的那些骷髅还没再离开。它们在宿舍，相当烦人！所以请花点时间踢踢它们。

english: Oh, and please don't call me Hermie.
translation: 哦，还有请别叫我赫米。

english: Whatever you like, Hermie!
translation: 随你喜欢，赫米！

english: Hop inside my mouth if you want to live!
translation: 想活命就跳进我嘴里！

english: I'm not falling for that... I'm not a fish! I've got more foresight than that.
translation: 我才不上当……我不是鱼！我没那么没远见。

english: Got any Spirit flakes?
translation: 有灵屑吗？

english: I think you may have a problem.
translation: 我想你可能有问题。

english: I agree, you don't give me anywhere enough of those. So get to it.
translation: 我同意，你给我的那些远远不够。所以赶紧去。

english: Right.
translation: 好的。

english: Those look tasty. But I'm looking for a proper feast. Come back to me with 3000 of them.
translation: 那些看起来好吃。但我在找真正的盛宴。带3000个回来找我。

english: 3000!? Are you insane?!
Not really, I'm just a little bit peckish.
translation: 不算，我只是有点饿。

english: Good thing you have a beak then!
translation: 那幸好你有喙！

english: Touché.
translation: 说得好。

english: No thanks. I'm craving a Spirit flake right now.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。我现在渴望灵屑。

english: You really love those things.
translation: 你真的爱那些东西。

english: Yup. So get to it.
translation: 是的。所以赶紧去。

english: Righto.
translation: 好的。

english: Transmogrify your Heron?
translation: 变形你的鹭？

english: Your pet Heron gobbles up a Spirit flake and turns royal blue.
translation: 你的宠物鹭吞下一片灵屑变成宝蓝色。

english: What's the big idea? If you're going to offer me a Spirit flake, at least have one to hand!
translation: 什么意思？如果你要给我灵屑，至少手边拿一个！

english: You can unlock the pet Heron transmogrification for 3000 x Spirit flakes.
translation: 你可以用3000x 灵屑解锁宠物鹭变形。

english: Where's the fish? You don't have any!
translation: 鱼在哪？你一个都没有！

english: *slap*
translation: 拍

english: Grrr!
translation: 咕噜！

english: Grrrr!
translation: 咕噜！

english: Grarrr!
translation: 嘎噜！

english: Got any raw fish?
translation: 有生鱼吗？

english: Haven't you already eaten enough Spirit flakes?
translation: 你不是已经吃了足够灵屑吗？

english: Yes, I have. That's why I'm asking you for raw fish.
translation: 是的，我吃了。所以我才跟你要生鱼。

english: Sometimes I wonder whether getting stuck with you was my good luck or yours.
translation: 有时我在想，摊上你究竟是我的好运还是你的。

english: In a remarkable display of gluttony, your pet Heron consumes 3000 Spirit flakes. It turns blue in front of your very eyes.
translation: 在显著的贪吃展示中，你的宠物鹭消耗了3000灵屑。它在你眼前变蓝了。

english: That really hit the spot! Though I feel a little blue now that there are none left.
translation: 那真到位！不过我现在有点蓝因为没剩了。

english: You offer your pet Heron a Spirit flake, which it quickly gobbles up.
translation: 你给你的宠物鹭一片灵屑，它迅速吞下。

english: Oops! That was a mistake, you're already blue. If you give it back, I'll give you a raw fish?
translation: 哎呀！那是个错误，你已经蓝了。如果你还给我，我给你条生鱼？

english: Sorry, no can do. They're just too tasty. You should try one sometime!
translation: 抱歉，不行。它们太好吃了。你该什么时候试试！

english: I'll pass.
translation: 我就算了。

english: Your pet Heron gobbles up your [fish name] and turns a magnificent white.
translation: 你的宠物鹭吞下你的 [fish name] 变成华丽的白色。

english: Are you trying to annoy me?
translation: 你想惹恼我吗？

english: I put in a lot of effort cooking this for you.
translation: 我花了很多努力为你煮这个。

english: Exactly, you've cooked it! You've ruined a fine delicacy, now go and uncook it!
translation: 正是，你煮了它！你毁了美味，现在去把它变生！

english: Uncook? That's not even possible!
translation: 变生？那甚至不可能！

english: I once knew a cat who mastered uncooking. Nice guy, actually. Enough talk, go and get me some more raw fish!
translation: 我认识一只猫精通变生。其实是个好人。别说废话，去给我弄更多生鱼！

english: My little cousin is a Slayer Master, lucky girl. But one day I'll be a mighty dragon-slayer, and they'll give me a job like that too.

english: Hello again. How can I help you?
translation: 又见面了。我能怎么帮你？

english: How are things going here?
translation: 这里情况怎么样？

english: Things are slowly coming back to life in our city of the dead. The bank under the Temple of the Lesser Gods has been restored, and a number of our merchants have reopened their stalls.
translation: 事情在我们的死者之城慢慢恢复生机。小神神庙下的银行已恢复，我们许多商人已重新开张摊位。

english: What about the plagues?
translation: 那瘟疫呢？

english: We're making progress on them. With our citizens back, we had enough people to finally deal with the frogs and locusts that were filling the town up.
translation: 我们在它们上取得进展。随着市民回来，我们有足够人手最终处理填满城镇的青蛙和蝗虫。

english: We worried they'd just come back, but perhaps we have managed to appease whichever god sent them.
translation: 我们担心它们会回来，但也许我们已成功安抚派它们来的神。

english: The infected cows have been handled as well. The only plague left now is this infuriating pox. Still, at least it isn't contagious.
translation: 感染牛也已处理。现在唯一剩下的瘟疫是这恼人的痘。不过，至少它不传染。

english: Any sign of Menaphos opening up again?
translation: 有梅纳菲斯再次开放的迹象吗？

english: They are adamant that their city must remain closed until all the plagues have gone. Until we can get rid of the pox, I can't see their gates opening to us, or to anyone else.
translation: 他们坚决认为城市必须保持关闭直到所有瘟疫消失。直到我们摆脱痘，我看不到他们的门向我们或任何人打开。

english: Well at least things are moving in the right direction.
translation: 嗯至少事情在向正确方向移动。

english: Indeed. Now, is there anything else I can do for you?
translation: 确实。现在，还有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: Could I have another lamp?
translation: 能再给我一盏灯吗？

english: I'm afraid I only had the one.
translation: 恐怕我只有一个。

english: No. I should get going.
translation: 不。我该走了。

english: Hello again.
translation: 又见面了。

english: Wonderful! The city of the dead has fully come back to life, and it's all thanks to you!
translation: 太好了！死者之城完全恢复生机，都多亏了你！

english: Well I'm happy to have helped. Any news from Menaphos?
translation: 嗯我很高兴能帮忙。梅纳菲斯有消息吗？

english: They are continuing their preparations. It will take some time, but the city will soon be open once more.
translation: 他们继续准备。需要些时间，但城市很快会再次开放。

english: Great!
translation: 太好了！

english: Could I have another circlet?
translation: 能再给我一个头环吗？

english: Certainly, though it will cost you 10,000 coins.
translation: 当然，不过要花你10,000金币。

english: Here you go.
translation: 给，拿好。

english: You don't seem to have enough money for it.
translation: 你似乎没足够钱买。

english: Oh...
That's too much.
translation: 那太贵了。

english: Fair enough. Let me know if you change your mind.
translation: 说得过去。改变主意告诉我。

english: I should get going.
translation: 我该走了。

english: Until next time.
translation: 下次见。

english: Hey, hey, hey! What in the name of sweet suffering Icthlarin are you doing?
translation: 嘿，嘿，嘿！以甜美受苦伊克特拉林之名你在做什么？

english: I thought this acne potion might clear up your spots.
translation: 我想这痤疮药水可能清除你的斑点。

english: All that you'll achieve by pouring that potion on me is to ruin my lovely robes.
translation: 你把那药水倒我身上能达到的只是毁了我可爱的长袍。

english: Sorry, I was just trying to help.
translation: 抱歉，我只是想帮忙。

english: Hey there. I was wondering if you could do me a favour?
translation: 嘿。我在想你能帮我个忙吗？

english: Oh? What kind of favour?
translation: 哦？什么忙？

english: I know cremation isn't your way, but is there anything you could do with these ashes?
translation: 我知道火化不是你的方式，但你能对这些骨灰做什么吗？

english: Well, like you say, it is not really our way. Still, with all you've done for us, I'm willing to try.
translation: 嗯，像你说的，那真不是我们的方式。不过，鉴于你为我们做的一切，我愿意试试。

english: That's all I ask. Thank you.
translation: 那就是我所求。谢谢。

english: Could I have another lamp?
translation: 能再给我一盏灯吗？

english: No. I should get going.
translation: 不。我该走了。
