translation: 这里有几种你可以尝试抓的鸟，但两者的技术基本相同。你需要设置捕鸟陷阱。

english: Further, as the perch drops, it releases a noose that tightens around the bird's feet and captures it. Neat, huh?
translation: 此外，当栖木掉落时，它释放一个套索收紧在鸟的脚上并捕捉它。巧妙，对吧？

english: How do I get hold of a weasel?
translation: 我怎么抓到黄鼠狼？

english: Not with large quantities of rice and treacle as many people would have you believe. Besides, the Feldip weasel isn't technically a weasel, but, as is typical with any sort of colloquial name, it's been called that often enough
translation: 不是用大量米和糖浆像许多人让你相信的那样。此外，费迪普鼬技术上不是鼬，但，像任何俗名典型那样，

english: now that it's stuck.
translation: 它被叫得足够多现在固定了。

english: Anyway, the Feldip weasel's main survival technique is in hiding; other than that, it's pretty stupid. So, if you can actually find one, then you've probably got a fairly good chance of catching one.
translation: 总之，费迪普鼬的主要生存技术是隐藏；除此之外，它相当蠢。所以，如果你真能找到一个，那你可能有相当好的机会抓到它。

english: And how would I actually go about finding one?
translation: 那我实际上怎么找到一个？

english: The best place to start would probably be just south of here. You'll find lots of kebbit burrows there. Take a close look at some of them, follow the trails and you can't go far wrong.
translation: 最好的开始地方可能就在这南边。你会在那找到很多凯比特兔洞。仔细看看其中一些，跟随踪迹你不会错太远。

english: Well, seeing as you seem to like larupias so much...
translation: 嗯，既然你似乎这么喜欢棘刺狮……

english: Ah yes, yes, larupias are fun; just think of them as big kittens.
translation: 啊是的，是的，棘刺狮有趣；就把它们想成大小猫。

english: Uh huh, big kittens that just want to rip your throat out!
translation: 嗯哼，只想撕开你喉咙的大小猫！

english: Indeed, and you can use this to your advantage. If a larupia is keen to chase you then let it; that way you can happily lead it straight into your trap without any fuss or waiting around.
translation: 确实，你可以利用这点。如果棘刺狮热衷追你那就让它；那样你可以 happily 直接把它领进你的陷阱 without 任何麻烦或等待。

english: Into what sort of trap should I lead it?
translation: 我应该把它领进什么类型的陷阱？

english: A pit trap should do you. There are some appropriate pits to the east of here that you can use. Cover one with a few logs and branches, tease the kitty and then lead it to the pit. Simple.
translation: 坑陷阱应该适合你。这东边有一些合适的坑你可以用。用一些原木和树枝覆盖一个，逗猫然后把它领到坑。简单。

english: Barb-tails sound interesting.
translation: 钩尾凯比特兔听起来有趣。

english: They do sound interesting, don't they? Unfortunately, they're actually just another type of kebbit; those things get everywhere. Still, the tails of these particular kebbits can be useful for fishing.
translation: 它们确实听起来有趣，对吧？不幸的是，它们实际上只是另一种凯比特兔；那些东西到处都有。不过，这些特定凯比特兔的尾巴可以用于钓鱼。

english: So, how would I go about catching one them?
translation: 那么，我怎么抓它们中的一个？

english: Just squash them with a boulder, quick and simple.
translation: 就用巨石压扁它们，快且简单。

english: What, you mean just pick up some boulders and start throwing them at kebbits? That doesn't sound simple.
translation: 什么，你是说捡起一些巨石开始扔向凯比特兔？那听起来不简单。

english: No silly, you let the creature squash itself. Just use some sticks to hold a boulder in a nice precarious position, place some bait underneath and let the creature knock itself out.
translation: 不傻，你让生物压扁自己。就用一些棍子把巨石固定在一个危险位置，下面放点诱饵，等那家伙自己撞上去就晕了。

english: What on earth is a chinchompa?
translation: 到底什么是炸弹鼠？

english: Awwww, chinchompas are great. They're highly volatile little balls of fluff. Cute as you like, but for some reason they do have this tendency to spontaneously combust.
translation: 啊，炸弹鼠很棒。它们就是一团团毛茸茸的小球，特别不稳定。可爱是真可爱，但不知为什麼，它们老爱自己着火。

english: What? Why?
translation: 什么？为什么？

english: Probably something to do with the fact they'll eat anything and everything, especially spicy food.
translation: 可能和它们吃任何一切东西有关，尤其是辛辣食物。

english: Anyways, if you want to capture a chinchompa, I suggest using a box trap. That way, if the little fluffball does explode, then at least most of the blast will be contained within the box.
translation: 总之，如果你想捕捉炸弹鼠，我建议用箱子陷阱。就算那小毛球真炸了，至少大部分威力也能被箱子挡住。

english: Somehow butterflies don't strike me as your sort of thing.
translation: 不知怎的蝴蝶不像是你的菜。

english: Not really, but some people like them. The ones around here are at least vaguely interesting, though. The black ones are supposedly magical butterflies.
translation: 不完全是，不过有些人喜欢它们。这附近的蝴蝶至少还算有点意思。黑色的据说是魔法蝴蝶。

english: Doesn't that make them harder to catch?
translation: 那不会更难抓吗？

english: Not particularly; you can still catch them using an ordinary butterfly net. Oh, and you'll probably need some butterfly jars in which to keep them as well.
translation: 不特别；你仍然可以用普通捕虫网抓它们。哦，你可能还需要一些捕虫罐来保存它们。

english: How can I improve my chances of making a capture?
translation: 我怎么提高捕捉几率？

english: There are four key factors that will affect your chances: what bait you use, how close to the trap you are, your appearance and your smell.
translation: 有四个关键因素会影响你的几率：你用什么诱饵，你离陷阱多近，你的外观和你的气味。

english: How does bait help?
translation: 诱饵怎么帮助？

english: Unfortunately, creatures don't just jump into traps for the fun of it nearly as often as we as Hunters might like. However, it is possible to improve those odds. If you can find the right bait to use on your trap,
translation: 不幸的是，生物不像我们猎人希望的那样，为了好玩就老往陷阱里跳。然而，有可能改善那些几率。如果你能找到正确的诱饵用在你的陷阱，

english: something your prey really craves, then hunger overrides fear and the creature is just that little bit more likely to bounce to its furry little doom.
translation: 你的猎物真正渴望的东西，那么饥饿压倒恐惧，生物就那一点点更可能跳到它毛茸茸的小末日。

english: Why is it important how close I am to the trap?
translation: 为什么我离陷阱多近很重要？

english: However well you might be blending in, if you're standing with your nose pressed right up against your own trap, the poor little critters ain't going to go anywhere near it. So, you need to make sure you put
translation: 无论你融入得多好，如果你站着鼻子紧贴自己的陷阱，可怜的小生物不会去那附近。

english: a sensible distance - I'd say at least four strides - between yourself and your trap.
translation: 所以，你需要确保你保持一个合理距离——我说至少四步——在你自己和你的陷阱之间。

english: Why would the creatures care about my appearance?
translation: 为什么生物会在乎我的外观？

english: You're a human. From the point of view of a lot of creatures, you're big and scary. So, it'd be best if the furry little monsters didn't notice you. You need to blend in like the creatures themselves.
translation: 你是人类。从很多生物的观点，你又大又可怕。所以，最好如果毛茸茸的小怪物没注意到你。你需要像生物自己一样融入。

english: And how do I do that?
translation: 那我怎么做？

english: Easy, dress up like one of them. Even easier, dress up using the furs of the creatures themselves; then you're bound to get the colour right. And, I suppose, if you don't fancy just slinging a dead fur over your
translation: 简单，打扮得像它们中的一个。更简单，用生物自己的毛皮打扮；那你肯定颜色对。

english: shoulders, you can probably get them made into something more appealing. I hear there are tailors in Varrock who are good at that sort of thing.
translation: 而且，我想，如果你不介意只是把死毛皮披在你的肩膀，你可能可以让它们做成更吸引人的东西。我听说维洛克有裁缝擅长那种事。

english: What's wrong with my smell!?
translation: 我的气味怎么了！？

english: I'm sure there's nothing wrong with your smell...from a human point of view. But to your prey, any trap that you've set up will reek of human, and that's going to work against you if you don't do anything about it.
translation: 我肯定你的气味没什么问题……从人类观点。但对你的猎物，你设置的任何陷阱都会 reek 人类，如果你不做点什么那会对你不利。

english: So what should I do?
translation: 那我该做什么？

english: You need to mask that lovely human scent of yours with something else. Smoke works well. Take a lit torch and waft it around the trap a bit. You'll quickly overpower most of the other smells around the trap.
translation: 你需要掩盖你那可爱的人类气味用别的东西。烟效果很好。拿个点燃的火把在陷阱周围挥动一下。你会迅速掩盖陷阱周围大多数其他气味。

english: Where can I get clothes and equipment like yours?
translation: 我在哪能得到像你这样的衣服和装备？

english: Well, the equipment isn't too hard to get hold of. You've got specialist shops like Aleck's in Yanille that'll see you right. He's a bit pricey, mind, but it's pretty decent kit.
translation: 嗯，装备不太难 get hold of。你有像亚尼勒城 Aleck 的专卖店会帮你搞定。他有点贵，注意，但装备相当不错。

english: The clothing is a tad trickier to get hold of, the materials required being rather difficult to seperate from their reluctant owners.
translation: 衣服有点更难去获得，所需材料相当难从它们不情愿的主人那里分离。

english: But, if you can get the furs, there are shops like the tailor's in east Varrock that can help you.
translation: 但，如果你能拿到毛皮，有像维洛克东边裁缝的商店可以帮你。

english: I think I'll give it a miss right now, thanks.
translation: 我想我现在就算了，谢谢。

english: Suit yourself!
translation: 随你便！

english: What's a larupia?
translation: 什么是棘刺狮？

english: What's a larupia? You don't know? You mean you really don't recognise the significance of these clothes I'm wearing?
translation: 什么是棘刺狮？你不知道？你是说你真的不认识我穿的这些衣服的意义？

english: Well, they're certainly decorative...what about them?
translation: 嗯，它们确实装饰性……它们怎么了？

english: Well, these are the furs from a larupia. Caught the creature myself I did, and these make me blend in better, see?
translation: 嗯，这些是棘刺狮的毛皮。我自己抓的生物，这些让我融入更好，看？

english: If you want to be successful as a hunter you've got to be as stealthy as a kyatt, as quiet as a mouse and blend in like a, well, like a larupia, I guess!
translation: 如果你想作为猎人成功你必须像剑齿虎一样隐秘，像老鼠一样安静和融入像，嗯，像棘刺狮，我想！

english: What is that cool cape you're wearing?
translation: 你穿的那个酷斗篷是什么？

english: This? It's a Hunter's Skillcape. It shows that I am a true master of the art of Hunting and provides five daily teleports to either the Feldip Hills or Wilderness Hunter areas. If you ever manage to train your
translation: 这个？它是狩猎技能斗篷。它显示我是狩猎艺术的真正大师并提供每天五次传送到费迪普丘陵或荒野狩猎区域。

english: Hunter skill to its maximum level then I could sell you one.
translation: 如果你 ever 设法训练你的狩猎技能到最高等级那我可以卖你一个。

english: Ahh, leave me alone you crazy killing person.
translation: 啊，别管我你这疯狂杀人的人。

english: Heh, well I guess it's not everyone's thing.
translation: 嘿，嗯我想不是每个人的菜。

english: Can you give me some hunting traps?
translation: 你能给我些狩猎陷阱吗？

english: I do have a spare Hunter kit lying around, you can have it for free.
translation: 我确实有个备用的狩猎工具包闲着，你拿去用吧，免费的。

english: Thanks! I will put this to good use.
translation: 谢谢！我会好好利用这个。

english: Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 还有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: I don't have any more Hunter kits lying around, sorry. Maybe you could try one of the many shops that sell hunting traps, you can find one in Yanille.
translation: 我这里可没多余的狩猎工具包了，抱歉。也许你可以试试许多卖狩猎陷阱的商店之一，你可以在亚尼勒城找到一个。

english: Can I buy a Hunter's Skillcape from you?
translation: 我能从你这买狩猎技能斗篷吗？

english: I would be delighted to recognise you as a master hunter, the cape provides five daily teleports to either the Feldip Hills or Wilderness Hunter areas. I will need 99000 coins to cover the expense of making such a
translation: 我会很高兴认可你为大师猎人，斗篷提供每天五次传送到费迪普丘陵或荒野狩猎区域。

english: costly item!
translation: 我需要99000金币覆盖制作如此昂贵物品的费用！

english: 99000! That seems a bit expensive.
translation: 99000！那似乎有点贵。

english: Actually it's quite reasonable; it's made from the fur of the nearly extinct Raharni wildcat. Well, if you change your mind you know where to find me.
translation: 其实相当合理；它是用几乎灭绝的拉哈尼野猫毛皮做的。嗯，如果你改变主意你知道在哪找我。

english: Certainly, I'm happy to pay that.
translation: 当然，我很乐意付那个。

english: But it seems that I don't have enough money with me.
translation: 但似乎我身上没带够钱。

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.
translation: 嗯，等你有钱了再来找我。

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 不幸的是所有技能斗篷只搭配免费兜帽出售，这是技能促销的一部分；买一送一，你知道的。所以你得先腾出一些物品栏空间我才能卖给你。

english: Now you look like a true hunter!
translation: 现在你看起来像个真正的猎人！

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Okay, where's a good place to start?
translation: 好的，哪是个好的开始地方？

english: What other sorts of things are there to catch around here?
translation: 这附近还有什么其他东西可抓？

english: Thanks for your help.
translation: 谢谢你的帮助。

english: What sort of things are there to catch around here?
translation: 这附近有什么东西可抓？

english: How would I go about catching birds?
translation: 我怎么抓鸟？

english: I'd like to ask about another creature...
translation: 我想问关于另一种生物……

english: How can I improve my chances of making a capture?
translation: 我怎么提高捕捉几率？

english: Where can I get clothes and equipment like yours?
translation: 我在哪能得到像你这样的衣服和装备？

english: How do I get hold of a weasel?
translation: 我怎么抓到黄鼠狼？

english: Well, seeing as you seem to like larupias so much...
translation: 嗯，既然你似乎这么喜欢棘刺狮……

english: More...
translation: 更多……

english: Barb-tails sound interesting.
translation: 钩尾凯比特兔听起来有趣。

english: What on earth is a chinchompa?
translation: 到底什么是炸弹鼠？

english: Somehow butterflies don't strike me as your sort of thing.
translation: 不知怎的蝴蝶不像是你的菜。

english: Back...
translation: 返回……

english: How does bait help?
translation: 诱饵怎么帮助？

english: Why is it important how close I am to the trap?
translation: 为什么我离陷阱多近很重要？

english: Why would the creatures care about my appearance?
translation: 为什么生物会在乎我的外观？

english: What's wrong with my smell!?
translation: 我的气味怎么了！？

english: I think I'll give it a miss right now.
translation: 我想我现在就算了。

english: What's a larupia?
translation: 什么是棘刺狮？

english: So, what's good to hunt around here?
translation: 那么，这附近什么好猎？

english: What is that cool cape you're wearing?
translation: 你穿的那个酷斗篷是什么？

english: Ahh, leave me alone you crazy killing person.
translation: 啊，别管我你这疯狂杀人的人。

english: Can you give me some hunting traps?
translation: 你能给我些狩猎陷阱吗？

english: Skillcape of Hunter.
translation: 狩猎技能斗篷。

english: 99000! That seems a bit expensive.
translation: 99000！那似乎有点贵。

english: Certainly, I'm happy to pay that.
translation: 当然，我很乐意付那个。

english: Hunting.
translation: 狩猎。

english: What is this cave here for?
translation: 这个洞穴是做什么的？

english: Ah, a few of the most hunted creatures around here have been captured and secured in this cave to allow the most esteemed hunters to catch them with ease.
translation: 啊，这附近一些最被猎的生物被捕获并安置在这个洞穴允许最尊贵的猎人轻松抓它们。

english: Can I use the cave?
translation: 我能用这个洞穴吗？

english: Yes, you can. Head inside to hunt in peace.
translation: 是的，你可以。进去里面和平狩猎。

english: Unfortunately not. Only those who have completed the hard tier of the Western Provinces achievement diary may enter.
translation: 不幸的是不行。只有那些完成了西部省份成就日志困难层级的人可以进入。

english: Come back when you have and I shall allow you entry.
translation: 等你有了再来我会允许你进入。

english: Sorry, but only those who've completed the hard set of the Western Provinces tasks may enter my private hunting ground.
translation: 抱歉，但只有那些完成了西部省份任务困难套装的人可以进入我的私人狩猎场。

english: Ah, this is a wonderful area for a spot of hunting, don't you think?
translation: 啊，这是个狩猎的好地方，你不觉得吗？

english: I don't know, is it?
translation: 我不知道，是吗？

english: Oh absolutely; there's a huge variety of creatures to catch around here. You've got butterflies, polar kebbits, sabre-toothed kebbits, birds and even kyatts! Surely one of those piques your interest?
translation: 哦绝对；这附近有各种各样的生物可抓。你有蝴蝶、极地凯比特兔、剑齿凯比特兔、鸟甚至剑齿虎！肯定其中一个 piques 你的兴趣？

english: Where would I find polar kebbits?
translation: 我在哪能找到极地凯比特兔？

english: Funnily enough, you've just put your finger right on the problem. With polar kebbits, finding them is the hardest part! You'll have to track them down.
translation: 有趣的是，你正好指到了问题。对于极地凯比特兔，找到它们是最难的部分！你得追踪它们。

english: How would I go about doing that, then?
translation: 那我怎么做？

english: The easiest way to get started is by looking somewhere you can be sure a kebbit will have been and then working from there. You see the holes around here leading down into the ice? They're kebbit burrows!
translation: 最简单的开始方法是看你肯定凯比特兔去过的地方然后从那里工作。你看到这附近通向冰下的洞吗？它们是凯比特兔洞！

english: You'll be hard pressed to catch a polar kebbit in its home, but if you search around the entrance to a burrow then you might be able to find a trail.
translation: 你很难在它的家抓到极地凯比特兔，但如果你在洞入口周围搜索那你可能能找到踪迹。

english: Now, kebbit trails are usually fairly easy to follow once you've found them, but if the trail does peter out, you should try inspecting the surrounding scenery for clues as to where the creature may have gone.
translation: 现在，凯比特兔踪迹通常一旦你找到它们相当容易跟随，但如果踪迹确实消失，你应该尝试检查周围风景寻找线索生物可能去了哪。

english: Good places to look for clues include hollow logs in which the kebbit may have hidden or vegetation which may have been chewed or damaged.
translation: 找线索的好地方包括凯比特兔可能隐藏的空心原木或可能被啃咬或损坏的植被。

english: There are also tunnels running through the ice here that the kebbits use, so you should check those out as well.
translation: 还有隧道穿过这的冰凯比特兔使用，所以你也应该检查那些。

english: What's more, these tunnels can often help to shelter a trail from further snow, making it even easier for you to pick them up again.
translation: 更重要的是，这些隧道通常能帮助保护踪迹免受进一步雪，让你更容易再次找到它们。

english: Eventually, of course, the kebbit will have probably hidden somewhere. Polar kebbits don't hang about in the open for long for fear of their natural predators.
translation: 最终，当然，凯比特兔可能已经隐藏在某处。极地凯比特兔不会在开阔地逗留太久因为害怕它们的自然捕食者。

english: If you suspect a kebbit is close by, try looking around for signs of disturbed snow. Polar kebbits will often bury themselves in snow drifts as a means of hiding.
translation: 如果你怀疑凯比特兔在附近，尝试寻找被扰动雪的迹象。极地凯比特兔经常埋自己在雪堆作为隐藏手段。

english: If you think you've found a kebbit, use a noose wand to haul the creature out from the snow.
translation: 如果你认为你找到了凯比特兔，用套索棒把生物从雪里拉出来。

english: Wow, that's quite a lot to remember.
translation: 哇，那要记的相当多。

english: Don't worry; if you find yourself struggling to follow a trail, just come and ask me and I'll see if I can help.
translation: 别担心；如果你发现自己难以跟随踪迹，就来问我我会看看能不能帮。

english: But remember, the best place to start is by searching around their burrows.
translation: 但记住，最好的开始地方是搜索它们的洞周围。

english: Great, thanks.
translation: 太好了，谢谢。

english: How do you hunt birds?
translation: 你怎么猎鸟？

english: Ah, you can get cunning little bird snares for just that. You should be able to find them in specialist Hunter shops. Try to lay them in fairly open areas with lots of birds.
translation: 啊，你可以得到精巧小捕鸟陷阱就为那个。你应该能在专业狩猎商店找到它们。尝试把它们放置在相当开阔区域有很多鸟。

english: Do I need to place any bait on these traps?
translation: 我需要在这些陷阱上放任何诱饵吗？

english: No, that's not necessary. The idea is that the bird will see the trap as somewhere to perch. If the bird lands on the trigger stick, it should drop away and a small loop of wire should close around the bird's feet.
translation: 不，那没必要。想法是鸟会把陷阱看作栖木的地方。如果鸟落在触发棍上，它应该脱落，一个小金属环应该收紧在鸟的脚上。

english: And remember, it's important to collect any captures from your traps fairly quickly; otherwise, you risk losing them to various wild scavengers.
translation: 并且记住，迅速从你的陷阱收集任何捕捉很重要；否则，你风险失去它们给各种野生食腐动物。

english: How can I improve my chances of capturing a creature?
translation: 我怎么提高捕捉生物的几率？

english: Ah, the key there is concealment, both of yourself and your traps.
translation: 啊，那里的关键是隐蔽，你自己和你的陷阱。

english: The most obvious point is to stay out of sight of your own traps. If possible, hide around a wall, hedge or similar. Failing that, make sure you're a good few feet away from your trap.
translation: 最明显的点是避开你自己陷阱的视线。如果可能，隐藏在墙、树篱或类似周围。如果不行，确保你离你的陷阱好几英尺远。

english: You can hide yourself even better by wearing clothing appropriate to the area in which you are hunting.
translation: 你可以通过穿适合你狩猎区域的衣服更好地隐藏自己。

english: Your best bet is to use the skins of creatures native to the area. There is a very good tailor in east Varrock who may be able to help you with making clothing out of such skins.
translation: 你最好的选择是用该区域本地生物的皮肤。维洛克东边有个很好的裁缝也许能帮你用这种皮肤做衣服。

english: Finally, a lot of creatures may avoid your traps if they can smell a human scent on them. This is where smoking a trap can be useful.
translation: 最后，很多生物如果它们能闻到人类气味在它们上可能会避开你的陷阱。这是熏制陷阱可能有用的地方。

english: It takes a bit of practice, but by using the smoke from a torch, you can mask any other scents that may surround a trap.
translation: 这需要一点练习，但通过使用火把的烟，你可以掩盖任何可能环绕陷阱的其他气味。

english: Wow, thanks for your help.
translation: 哇，谢谢你的帮助。

english: You're welcome, good luck with the hunting.
translation: 不客气，狩猎好运。

english: What's so special about butterflies?
translation: 蝴蝶有什么特别？

english: That depends entirely on the butterfly.
translation: 那完全取决于蝴蝶。

english: I'll admit that the activities of many butterflies may be of no interest at all. However, we are lucky in having around here some fine examples of rare thaumic butterflies.
translation: 我承认许多蝴蝶的活动可能完全没兴趣。然而，我们幸运在这附近有一些稀有魔法蝴蝶的好例子。

english: These butterflies reputedly have magical powers that, when released, can make a person stronger or heal otherwise critical wounds.
translation: 这些蝴蝶据说有魔法力量，当释放时，可以让一个人更强或治愈否则危急伤口。

english: At this point, I should offer a note of caution, however: it is also said that these powers will not manifest themselves if the butterflies are captured for selfish purposes.
translation: 在这一点，我应该提供注意，然而：据说如果蝴蝶被捕捉为自私目的这些力量不会显现自己。

english: Rather, they are gifts that must be used by one person to aid another. Of course, you'll have to catch them first.
translation: 相反，它们是必须由一个人用来帮助另一个人的礼物。当然，你得先抓它们。

english: Why, with a butterfly net of course! You should also carry some empty butterfly jars with you in which to keep the butterflies.
translation: 为什么，当然用捕虫网！你也应该携带一些空捕虫罐和你一起保存蝴蝶。

english: How can I capture a sabre-toothed kebbit?
translation: 我怎么捕捉剑齿凯比特兔？

english: Ah, now for these creatures I would recommend using a deadfall trap. Deadfalls are quite easy to set up, and yet you can catch some very reasonably sized creatures with them.
translation: 啊，现在对于这些生物我建议用落石陷阱。落石相当容易设置，然而你可以用它们抓一些相当合理大小的生物。

english: Deadfall traps basically work by having a large dead weight, such as a boulder, positioned so as to be delicately balanced above some form of bait.
translation: 落石陷阱基本运作通过有一个大重物，比如巨石，放置以便微妙平衡在某种诱饵上面。

english: You will need to make sure you have a knife and some wood with you to create appropriate supports and a trigger for this sort trap.
translation: 你需要确保你有刀和一些木头和你一起创建合适支持和触发器对于这种陷阱。

english: In the case of sabre-toothed kebbits you should use some form of raw meat to bait your trap, but other animals may prefer other baits, such as fish or vegetables.
translation: 对于剑齿凯比特兔你应该用某种生肉诱捕你的陷阱，但其他动物可能偏好其他诱饵，比如鱼或蔬菜。

english: Oooh, kyatts soundsinteresting. I want to catch one of those.
translation: 哦，剑齿虎听起来有趣。我想抓一个那些。

english: Well, you've set your sights high, kyatts are incredibly fearsome creatures, but with determination like that I'm sure you'll make it.
translation: 嗯，你设定你的目标高，剑齿虎是极其可怕生物，但有那样的决心我相信你会成功。

english: Now, you're not going to be able to catch a kyatt with just a small box or a noose on a stick. You need a much bigger trap.
translation: 现在，你不能用只是小盒子或棍子上的套索捕捉剑齿虎。你需要大得多的陷阱。

english: Pit traps are a good bet. You'd be best off finding a natural dip in the ground as the basis for your trap. If you dig a pit yourself, you risk creatures noticing the disturbed ground nearby.
translation: 坑陷阱是个好选择。你最好寻找地面自然凹陷作为你的陷阱基础。如果你自己挖坑，你风险生物注意到附近被扰动地面。

english: Once you've found an appropriate spot, you'll need some logs and a knife. The logs serve two purposes.
translation: 一旦你找到合适地点，你需要一些原木和刀。原木用于两个目的。

english: Some can be carved into sharp skewers for the bottom of the pit; hopefully the kyatt will die when it falls onto these. Others can be used to conceal the trap.
translation: 一些可以雕刻成尖尖刺对于坑底；希望剑齿虎会死亡当它落在这些。其他可以用来掩盖陷阱。

english: Of course, even then the pit is going to look suspicious, so you're going to need to lure the kyatt onto the branches in some way. What actually tends to work best for this is, well, yourself!
translation: 当然，即使那样坑会看起来可疑，所以你需要引诱剑齿虎到树枝以某种方式。什么实际上倾向于最有效对于这个是，嗯，你自己！

english: What? I don't like the sound of that.
translation: 什么？我不喜欢那个听起来。

english: Yes, that's the normal response, but I kid you not. If you really want a kyatt to follow you over that pit then just give it a good poke!
translation: 是的，那是正常反应，但我没骗你。如果你真的想要剑齿虎跟随你越过那个坑那就 just 给它一个好戳！

english: Of course, I suggest you use something long to poke it with. Poking a kyatt with your finger is likely to end in unfortunate limb loss.
translation: 当然，我建议你用长的东西戳它。用手指戳剑齿虎可能以不幸肢体损失结束。

english: Fortunately, you can get very good sticks for poking from most Hunter shops.
translation: 幸运的是，你可以从大多数狩猎商店得到非常好的棍子用于戳。

english: Once you have...got the creature's attention, try to lead it to one of your traps. Make sure to jump the branches when you reach the trap yourself, of course; it would be embarrassing to fall into your own trap.
translation: 一旦你得到生物的注意，尝试引导它到你的一个陷阱。确保当你到达陷阱自己时跳过树枝，当然；掉进你自己的陷阱会尴尬。

english: Then, if the kyatt is giving you all of its attention, hopefully it won't notice the trap, and with any luck, it will stumble right into the pit.
translation: 然后，如果剑齿虎给予你所有它的注意，希望它不会注意陷阱，并且幸运的话，它会跌撞直接进坑。

english: That sounds a bit hit or miss, and kind of suicidal too!
translation: 那听起来有点碰运气，而且有点自杀式也！

english: Well that's what makes it exciting, isn't it? But honestly, if you want to capture a kyatt, that's your best bet.
translation: 嗯那是让它刺激的原因，对吧？但老实说，如果你想捕捉剑齿虎，那是你的最佳选择。

english: Can you teach me how to hunt?
translation: 你能教我怎么狩猎吗？

english: Why certainly. I reached the peak of my abilities some time ago, but I'm more than happy to help newcomers to the field. Was there anything in particular you had in mind?
translation: 为什么当然。我达到我的能力顶峰一段时间前，但我非常乐意帮助该领域新手。你有什么特别的想法吗？

english: Where's the best place to start?
translation: 哪是最好的开始地方？

english: I always say a good starting point is to learn how to follow the creatures you want to capture. Around here, that means practicing on polar kebbits.
translation: 我总是说好的起点是学习怎么跟随你想捕捉的生物。这附近，那意味着练习在极地凯比特兔。

english: So how do I track them down, then?
translation: 那我怎么 track 它们？

english: What sort of creatures are there to hunt around here?
translation: 这附近有什么生物可猎？

english: Well, there's pretty much anything you could want to hunt. You've got butterflies, polar kebbits, sabre-toothed kebbits, birds and even kyatts! Surely one of those interests you?
translation: 嗯，有几乎任何你想狩猎的。你有蝴蝶、极地凯比特兔、剑齿凯比特兔、鸟甚至剑齿虎！肯定其中一个引起你兴趣？

english: Sorry, I'm not that keen on hunting.
translation: 抱歉，我对狩猎没那么 keen。

english: Really? What a shame, you looked like someone who could have had some promise.
translation: 真的？真可惜，你看起来像本可有前途的人。

english: I don't know, is it?
translation: 我不知道，是吗？

english: Where would I find polar kebbits?
translation: 我在哪能找到极地凯比特兔？

english: How do you hunt birds?
translation: 你怎么猎鸟？

english: I'd like to ask about another creature.
translation: 我想问关于另一种生物。

english: How can I improve my chances of capturing a creature?
translation: 我怎么提高捕捉生物的几率？

english: What's so special about butterflies?
translation: 蝴蝶有什么特别？

english: How can I capture a sabre-toothed kebbit?
translation: 我怎么捕捉剑齿凯比特兔？

english: Oooh, kyatts sounds interesting.
translation: 哦，剑齿虎 sounds interesting。

english: Can you teach me how to hunt?
translation: 你能教我怎么狩猎吗？

english: Where's the best place to start?
translation: 哪是最好的开始地方？

english: What sort of creatures are there to hunt around here?
translation: 这附近有什么生物可猎？

english: Sorry, I'm not that keen on hunting.
translation: 抱歉，我对狩猎没那么 keen。

english: Greetings, fellow hunter. How can I be of help?
translation: 你好， fellow 猎人。我能怎么帮？

english: What kinds of food and drink do you serve?
translation: 你 serve 什么种类的食物和饮料？

english: In terms of drinks, we've got a Trapper's Tipple, and for food, a simple hearty stew.
translation: 就饮料而言，我们有陷阱猎人特饮，就食物而言，简单丰盛炖菜。

english: But you don't have room to hold either of them, so you'll have to come back later.
translation: 但你没空间携带它们任何一个，所以你得稍后回来。

english: Couldn't you just leave it on the ground for me?
translation: 你不能就把它放在地上给我吗？

english: We don't tend to just... leave things like that around here.
translation: 我们不倾向就……像那样留下东西在这附近。

english: I'd love a Trapper's Tipple!
translation: 我想要陷阱猎人特饮！

english: That'll be three coins then.
translation: 那是三个金币。

english: Oh, I can't afford one right now.
translation: 哦，我现在负担不起一个。

english: Could I grab a stew?
translation: 我能 grab 个炖菜吗？

english: Absolutely! They're 20 coins these days.
translation: 绝对！它们现在20金币。

english: Oh, I can't afford that right now.
translation: 哦，我现在负担不起那个。

english: I'll pass, thanks.
translation: 我就算了，谢谢。

english: Can we talk about rumours?
translation: 我们能谈谈传闻吗？

english: Looks like you could do with talking to Verity first, given you're new to this whole business.
translation: 看起来你可以先跟维瑞蒂谈谈，鉴于你是这整个事情的新手。

english: Yes, yes. How can I help you on that front?
translation: 是的，是的。我在那方面能怎么帮你？

english: Do you have any new ones for me?
translation: 你有什么新的给我吗？

english: Could you check out the validity of this report for me? Someone thinks they've seen a [creature]. Once you find it, bring back one of its [rare parts].
translation: 你能帮我调查这个报告的有效性吗？有人觉得他们看到了一个 [creature]。一旦你找到它，带回它的一个 [rare parts]。

english: There's been rumours of a rare [creature] coming in. Once you find it, bring back one of its [rare parts].
translation: 有传闻说稀有 [creature] 进来。一旦你找到它，带回它的一个 [rare parts]。

english: We've got reports of a slightly different [creature] in the local population. Once you find it, bring back one of its [rare parts].
translation: 我们有报告说当地种群中有略有不同 [creature]。一旦你找到它，带回它的一个 [rare parts]。

english: Looks like we need some information on a unique specimen amongst the local [creature] population. Once you find it, bring back some of its [rare parts].
translation: 看起来我们需要当地 [creature] 种群中独特标本的一些信息。一旦你找到它，带回它的一些 [rare parts]。

english: I've heard rumours of a strange [creature] that you could check out for me. Once you find it, bring back one of its [rare parts].
translation: 我听说奇怪 [creature] 的传闻你可以帮我调查。一旦你找到它，带回它的一个 [rare parts]。

english: Another one done? You're really doing a lot for the guild.
translation: 又一个完成？你真的为公会做了很多。

english: Are you up for another?
translation: 你准备好另一个吗？

english: Thanks for that. I'll mark off that report for you. Would you like another rumour?
translation: 谢谢，我帮你把这个报告标记为已完成。你想要另一个传闻吗？

english: Can you remind me which rumour I'm chasing right now?
translation: 你能提醒我现在正在追踪哪个传闻吗？

english: You're hunting for me at the moment. This rumour was about a [creature]. You'll need to bring back some of its [rare parts].
translation: 你此刻在为我狩猎。这个传闻是关于 [creature] 的。你需要带回它的一些 [rare parts]。

english: I can see you're following [Guild Hunter]'s rumour looking for a [creature] at the moment. You'll need to bring back some of its [rare parts].
translation: 我看你目前正在跟随 [Guild Hunter] 的传闻寻找 [creature]。你需要带回它的一些 [rare parts]。

english: I seem to remember sending you off to hunt a [creature] and bring back one of its [rare parts]. Would you prefer that one, or a new one entirely?
translation: 我似乎记得派你去猎杀 [creature] 并带回它的一个 [rare parts]。你更喜欢那个，还是全新的？

english: That was it. I asked you to hunt a [creature] and bring back one of its [rare parts]. Best of luck.
translation: 就是那个。我让你去猎杀 [creature] 并带回它的一个 [rare parts]。祝你好运。

english: I'm good, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。

english: What kinds of food and drink do you serve?
translation: 你提供什么种类的食物和饮料？

english: I'd love a Trapper's Tipple!
translation: 我想要陷阱猎人特饮！

english: Could I grab a stew?
translation: 我能要个炖菜吗？

english: I'll pass, thanks.
translation: 我就算了，谢谢。

english: Can we talk about rumours?
translation: 我们能谈谈传闻吗？

english: Yes.
translation: 是。

english: No.
translation: 否。

english: Yes, go back to his old one.
translation: 是的，回去做他那个旧的。

english: Yes, but with a brand new one.
translation: 是的，但要一个全新的。

english: I'm good, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。

english: 'Ello [player name].
translation: 你好 [player name]。

english: Hello, what's that you've got there?
translation: 你好，你在那拿着什么？

english: A crossbow. Every now and then I sell the bits to make them.
translation: 弩。我时不时卖制作它们的部件。

english: But not now?
translation: 但现在不？

english: That's right.
translation: 没错。

english: Sorry, I don't have anything to sell to you.
translation: 抱歉，我没什么卖给你的。

english: A crossbow, are you interested?
translation: 弩，感兴趣吗？

english: Maybe, are they any good?
translation: 也许，它们好用吗？

english: Are they any good?! They're dwarven engineering at its best!
translation: 它们好用吗？！它们是矮人工程的巅峰之作！

english: How do I make one for myself?
translation: 我怎么自己做一个？

english: Well, firstly you'll need to chop yourself some wood, then use a knife on the wood to whittle out a nice crossbow stock like these here.
translation: 嗯，首先你需要砍些木头，然后用刀把木头削成漂亮的弩托，就像这些一样。

english: Wood fletched into stock... check.
translation: 木头做成弩托……搞定。

english: Then get yourself some metal and a hammer and smith yourself some limbs for the bow, mind that you use the right metals and woods though as some wood is too light to use with some metal and vice versa.
translation: 然后弄点金属和锤子，自己锻造些弩臂，注意要用对的金属和木头，因为有些木头太轻配不了某些金属，反之亦然。

english: Which goes with which?
translation: 哪个配哪个？

english: Wood and Bronze as they're basic materials, Oak and Blurite, Willow and Iron, Steel and Teak, Mithril and Maple, Adamantite and Mahogany and finally Runite and Yew.
translation: 木头配青铜，因为它们是最基础的材料，橡木配蓝铁，柳木配铁，钢配柚木，秘银配枫木，精金配桃花心木，最后是符文配紫杉木。

english: Ok, so I have my stock and a pair of limbs... what now?
translation: 好的，那我有了弩托和一对弩臂……接下来呢？

english: Simply take a hammer and smack the limbs firmly onto the stock. You'll then need a string, only they're not the same as normal bows. You'll need to dry some large animal's meat to get sinew, then spin that on a spinning
translation: 只需用锤子将弩臂牢固地敲装到弩托上即可。然后你需要弦，不过它们和普通弓的弦不一样。你需要晾干些大型动物的肉得到筋腱，然后在纺车上纺成线，

english: wheel, it's the only thing we've found to be strong enough for a crossbow.
translation: 这是我们发现唯一够结实做弩的东西。

english: What about magic logs?
translation: 那魔法原木呢？

english: Well.. I don't rightly know... us dwarves don't work with magic, we prefer gold and rock. Much more stable. I guess you could ask the humans at the rangers guild to see if they can do something but I don't want
translation: 嗯……我真不知道……我们矮人不搞魔法，我们更喜欢金子和石头。稳定多了。我想你可以去问问游侠公会的人类看他们能不能做什么，

english: anything to do with it!
translation: 但我不想跟那有任何关系！

english: Thanks for telling me. Bye!
translation: 谢谢告诉我。再见！

english: Take care, straight shooting.
translation: 保重，射得准。

english: What about ammo?
translation: 那弹药呢？

english: You can smith yourself lots of different bolts, don't forget to flight them with feathers like you do arrows though. You can poison any untipped bolt but there's also the option of tipping them with gems then
translation: 你可以自己锻造很多不同的弩箭，不过别忘了像制作箭矢一样为它们装上箭羽。你可以给任何无尖弩箭涂毒，

english: enchanting them with runes. This can have some pretty powerful effects.
translation: 但也可以选择用宝石做尖然后用符石附魔。这能产生一些相当强大的效果。

english: Oh my poor bank, how will I store all those?!
translation: 哦我可怜的银行，我怎么存那些东西？！

english: Find Hirko in Keldagrim, he also sells crossbow parts and I'm sure he has something you can use to store bolts in.
translation: 去凯尔达格林城找希尔科，他也卖弩部件，我相信他有东西你可以用来存弩箭。

english: Thanks for the info.
translation: 谢谢你的信息。

english: How do I make one for myself?
translation: 我怎么自己做一个？

english: What about magic logs?
translation: 那魔法原木呢？

english: Thanks for telling me. Bye!
translation: 谢谢告诉我。再见！

english: What about ammo?
translation: 那弹药呢？

english: Hi!
translation: 嗨！

english: Let me at 'em!
translation: 让我对付他们！

english: Trolls? Schmolls!
translation: 巨魔？什么魔！

english: The trolls are coming!
translation: 巨魔来了！

english: The trolls took my baby son!
translation: 巨魔抓走了我的幼子！

english: Welcome to Burthorpe!
translation: 欢迎来到伯索普公国！

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！

english: Trolls!
translation: 巨魔！

english: Hello stranger.
translation: 你好陌生人。

english: Go away!
translation: 走开！

english: Run!
translation: 跑！

english: Hi!
translation: 嗨！

english: The Imperial Guard can no longer protect us!
translation: 帝国守卫不能再保护我们！

english: The White Knights will soon have control!
translation: 白骑士很快会控制！

english: I heard about what you did, thank you!
translation: 我听说你做了什么，谢谢！

english: The White Knights are still going to take over.
translation: 白骑士还是要接管。

english: I hear the Imperial Guard are preparing an attack!
translation: 我听说帝国守卫正准备攻击！

english: Thank you so much!
translation: 非常感谢！

english: Surely we are safe now!
translation: 我们现在肯定安全了吧！

english: Hello there, are you interested in buying one of my special capes?
translation: 你好，有兴趣买我的特殊斗篷吗？

english: What's so special about your capes?
translation: 你的斗篷有什么特别？

english: Ahh well they make it less likely that you'll accidently attack anyone wearing the same cape as you and easier to attack everyone else. They also make it easier to distinguish people who're wearing the same cape as you
translation: 啊嗯它们让你不太可能误伤任何穿同样斗篷的人，更容易攻击其他人。它们也让你更容易区分穿同样斗篷的人和其他人。

english: from everyone else. They're very useful when out in the wilderness with friends or anyone else you don't want to harm.
translation: 当和朋友或任何你不想伤害的人在荒野时非常有用。

english: So would you like to buy one?
translation: 那么你想买一个吗？

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: What's so special about your capes?
translation: 你的斗篷有什么特别？

english: Yes please!
translation: 好的，谢谢！

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Hur hur hur! Well look here, a puny fleshy human!
translation: 嘿嘿嘿！嗯看看这，一个弱小的人类！

english: You should beware of the icy wind that runs through this valley, it will bring a fleshy like you to a cold end indeed!
translation: 你应该小心穿过这个山谷的刺骨寒风，它确实会给像你这样的凡人带来寒冷的结局！

english: I don't really care for humans in my shop, so you'd better be buying something.
translation: 我店里不太欢迎人类，所以你最好买点东西。

english: What are you selling?
translation: 你在卖什么？

english: Shields.
translation: 盾牌。

english: I'll be on my way then.
translation: 那我走了。

english: Good.
translation: 好。

english: What are you selling?
translation: 你在卖什么？

english: I'll be on my way then.
translation: 那我走了。

english: Hey, human.
translation: 嘿，人类。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Just a guard. If sneaky humans come in here without permission, I chuck rocks at 'em, knock 'em out and chuck 'em out of Weiss.
translation: 只是个守卫。要是有狡猾的人类未经允许闯进来，我就朝他们扔石头，打晕他们，再把他们扔出魏斯聚落。

english: I'm familiar with the idea, yeah.
translation: 我熟悉这个主意，是的。

english: Tell me about this place.
translation: 跟我讲讲这地方。

english: This here is Weiss. Trolls built it years ago, after we got kicked out from caves further south. Now Weiss is our home.
translation: 这里是魏斯聚落。巨魔多年前建的，在我们被从更南边的洞穴踢出来后。现在魏斯聚落是我们的家。

english: We done pretty good here. Got lots of goat and wolf to eat - they taste kinda boring after all this time, but there not much other choice.
translation: 我们在这做得不错。有很多山羊和狼吃——这么久后味道有点无聊，但没太多其他选择。

english: Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it. In fact My Arm is an expert on growing the stuff.
translation: 试过痛风草吗？我认识喜欢它的巨魔。事实上''我的手臂''是种那东西的专家。

english: Never heard of no gouty weed, no. But it sound like a vegetable, an' Mother not like eating those, so we probably not gonna try it.
translation: 没听说过什么痛风草，没。但听起来像蔬菜，而妈妈不喜欢吃那些，所以我们可能不会试。

english: Mother not like new ideas much, but he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: 妈妈不太喜欢新主意，但他真的大，他是老板，所以我们听他的。

english: I see.
translation: 我明白了。

english: Do you like it here?
translation: 你喜欢这里吗？

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it our home. Odd Mushroom say he can make it nicer with fancy fires what he invented, but Mother not interested in that, so Odd Mushroom not allowed to do it.
translation: 呃，有点粗糙，但它是我们的家。奇特蘑菇说他可以用他发明的花哨火让它更好，但妈妈对那个不感兴趣，所以奇特蘑菇不允许做。

english: Mother only care about stuff to help him fight better. An he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: 妈妈只关心帮他打得更好的东西。而他真的大，他是老板，所以我们听他的。

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我走了。

english: Hey, friend of Snowflake!
translation: 嘿，雪花的朋友！

english: Just a guard. If sneaky human come in here without permission, I chuck rocks at 'em, knock 'em out and chuck 'em out of Weiss.
translation: 只是个守卫。要是有狡猾的人类未经允许闯进来，我就朝他们扔石头，打晕他们，再把他们扔出魏斯聚落。

english: It great here, now Snowflake an' her husband troll taught us goutweed farming. Food so much better now.
translation: 这里很好，现在雪花和她丈夫巨魔教我们痛风草种植。食物现在好多了。

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it getting better. Snowflake, she taught us goutweed farming. Goat, wolf, human all taste so much nicer with goutweed in.
translation: 呃，是有点粗糙。但正在变好。雪花，她教我们痛风草种植。山羊、狼、人类，加了痛风草后味道都好多了。

english: So yeah, Weiss is good place to live, now Snowflake in charge. All trolls like Snowflake. Her husband troll kinda weird, but that not our problem.
translation: 所以啊，魏斯聚落现在真是个好地方，现在雪花管事。所有巨魔都喜欢雪花。她丈夫巨魔有点怪，但那不是我们的问题。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Tell me about this place.
translation: 跟我讲讲这地方。

english: Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it.
translation: 试过痛风草吗？我认识喜欢它的巨魔。

english: I see.
translation: 我明白了。

english: Do you like it here?
translation: 你喜欢这里吗？

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我走了。

english: You found those people who went missing! Did you see them? Did you see the night people?
translation: 你找到那些失踪的人了！你见到他们了吗？你见到夜人了吗？

english: Sort of. I wouldn't call them people though.
translation: 算是吧。但我不会称他们为人。

english: But they're real! They're actually real! No one believed me, but I knew they were real!
translation: 但他们是真的！他们确实是真的！没人相信我，但我知道他们是真的！

english: Well, congratulations I guess...
translation: 嗯，恭喜我想……

english: Hi.
translation: 嗨。

english: You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 你知道吗，跟人打招呼的方式可多了。你好、嘿、你好啊……

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: 那仍然只算一种！

english: Hello. How are you today?
translation: 你好。你今天怎么样？

english: I'm great, thank you!
translation: 我很好，谢谢！

english: Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 你好！水晶城今天天气真好，哈？

english: Indeed.
translation: 确实。

english: What can I do for ya?
translation: 我能为你做什么？

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这里有什么可以做的？

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 可做的事可多了！塔楼就是绝妙景致。

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 像今天这样的好日子，我建议去市场逛逛。

english: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你以为你在做什么？

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这里有什么可以做的？

english: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: Would you like to buy or sell anything?
translation: 你想买或卖什么吗？

english: Yes, please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No, thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Yes, please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No, thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Hello Iffie!
translation: 你好伊菲！

english: Sorry, dearie, if I stop to chat I'll lose count. Talk to my sister instead; she likes to chat. You'll find her upstairs in the church.
translation: 抱歉，亲爱的，如果我停下来聊天我会数错。跟我妹妹谈吧；她喜欢聊天。你会在教堂楼上找到她。

english: Hello Iffie, remember our adventure?
translation: 你好伊菲，记得我们的冒险吗？

english: Me, forget? Never! I still hear the ringing in my head when I go to sleep sometimes!
translation: 我，忘记？绝不！我有时睡觉时还能听到头上的铃声！

english: From the rolling pin and saucepan?
translation: 来自擀面杖和平底锅？

english: Yes, it was surprisingly loud doing that.
translation: 是的，那样做出乎意料地响亮。

english: I don't know if it is that surprising. You were banging a metal saucepan on your head!
translation: 我不知道是否那么令人惊讶。你当时在头上敲金属平底锅！

english: Hello dearie, of course I remember it!
translation: 你好亲爱的，当然我记得！

english: I dream about it sometimes, especially sneaking into the Blue Moon Inn kitchens for the rolling pin and saucepan!
translation: 我有时梦到它，尤其是潜入蓝月旅馆厨房拿擀面杖和平底锅！

english: Although probably best I don't do that again, I still feel bad for the chef.
translation: 虽然最好我别再那么做了，但我仍为那位厨师感到过意不去。

english: Yes, probably best we don't!
translation: 是的，最好我们别！

english: I don't only remember it, I remember it fondly, I loved it!
translation: 我不只记得它，我深情地记得它，我太喜欢了！

english: It was a good adventure wasn't it!
translation: 那次冒险真不错，对吧！

english: Yes, very. I'm so happy that you picked me to help you.
translation: 是的，非常。我很高兴你选我帮你。

english: I couldn't have picked anyone else, you were the perfect accomplice!
translation: 我怎么可能选别人呢，你可是完美的搭档！

english: Thank you, dearie!
translation: 谢谢你，亲爱的！

english: Of course dearie! How could I ever forget it? I had such a great time.
translation: 当然亲爱的！我怎么能忘记？我玩得真开心。

english: Are you still adventuring?
translation: 你还在冒险吗？

english: I am doing my best to adventure. There are just so many things to do!
translation: 我在尽力冒险。只是有太多事要做！

english: Well keep it up, don't let an old lady like me distract you. I've had my fill of adventure now!
translation: 嗯继续保持，别让像我这样的老妇人分散你注意力。我现在冒险够了！

english: There is no way I could forget it. Thank you for letting me come on such an adventure!
translation: 我绝不可能忘记。谢谢你让我参加这样的冒险！

english: It was my pleasure, maybe we could do it again some day!
translation: 这是我的荣幸，也许某天我们可以再做一次！

english: That would be lovely dearie, but maybe we go on one that doesn't involve climbing trees?
translation: 那太好了亲爱的，但也许我们去一个不涉及爬树的？

english: I'm getting a bit old for that!
translation: 我有点老了不适合那个！

english: How could I not? It was amazing! I see you're still wearing that jumper I knitted you.
translation: 我怎么能不？太棒了！我看你还穿着我织给你的毛衣。

english: It's lovely, very versatile. Even keeps me warm in the coldest of places!
translation: 它很可爱，非常多才多艺。甚至在最冷的地方也让我温暖！

english: That is good to hear. Do you have a favourite way to wear it?
translation: 那很好听。你有喜欢的穿法吗？

english: I like the orange version the best!
translation: 我最喜欢橙色的那款！

english: I like it too! It reminds me of pumpkins and spooky things, just like our adventure!
translation: 我也喜欢！它让我想起南瓜和诡异的东西，就像我们的冒险！

english: I like the black version the best!
translation: 我最喜欢黑色版本！

english: I like it too! It's pretty scary looking, just like how we saw Death in our adventure!
translation: 我也喜欢！它看起来挺吓人，就像我们在冒险中看到死神！

english: Sorry, dearie, if I stop to chat I'll lose count.
translation: 抱歉，亲爱的，如果我停下来聊天我会数错。

english: Hello Iffie!
translation: 你好伊菲！

english: Hello Iffie, remember our adventure?
translation: 你好伊菲，记得我们的冒险吗？

english: Orange.
translation: 橙色。

english: Black.
translation: 黑色。

english: Can I help you at all?
translation: 有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: My name is Ignatius Vulcan. Once I was - like you - an adventurer, but that was before I realised the beauty and power of flame! Just look at this...
translation: 我叫伊格纳修斯‧瓦尔坎。曾经我和你一样是个冒险者，但那是之前我意识到火焰的美丽和力量！看看这个……

english: Yeeouch!
translation: 哎哟！

english: Stare into the flame and witness the purity and power of fire! As my attraction to flame grew, so did my skills at firelighting. I began to neglect my combat skills, my Mining skills and my questing. Who needs such
translation: 凝视火焰见证火的纯净和力量！随着我对火焰的吸引增长，我的生火技能也增长。我开始忽视我的战斗技能，我的采矿技能和我的任务。

english: mundane skills when one can harness the power of fire? After years of practice I am now the acknowledged Master of Flame! Everything must be purified by fire!
translation: 当一个人能驾驭火的力量时谁需要那些平凡技能？经过多年的练习我现在是公认的火焰大师！一切必须被火净化！

english: Okaaaay! Err, I'll be going now. Umm, get better soon.
translation: 好……吧！呃，我走了。嗯，早日康复。

english: What is that cape you're wearing?
translation: 你穿的是什么斗篷？

english: This is a Skillcape of Firemaking, so bright that wearing it lights up caves! I was given it in recognition of my skill as the greatest firemaker in the lands! I AM the Master of Flame!
translation: 这是生火技能斗篷，如此明亮以至于穿着它能照亮洞穴！我获得它是为了表彰我作为这片土地上最伟大生火大师的技艺！我就是火焰大师！

english: Hmm, I'll be going now. Keep a sharp look out for those men with their white jackets!
translation: 嗯，我走了。留心那些穿白夹克的人！

english: No, thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Okay, keep the fire burning.
translation: 好的，让火燃烧。

english: Can I buy a Skillcape of Firemaking?
translation: 我能买生火技能斗篷吗？

english: Of course you can. You are already a master of fire, you just need the cape to prove it. The cape is so bright that wearing it will light up dark caves. That'll be 99000 coins, please.
translation: 当然可以。你已是火焰大师，只需这件斗篷来证明你的身份。斗篷如此明亮以至于穿着它能照亮黑暗洞穴。那是99000金币，请。

english: No thanks, that's too much.
translation: 不谢谢，那太贵了。

english: Sorry to hear that, I'll be here if you change your mind.
translation: 很遗憾听到那个，如果你改变主意我会在这。

english: Okay, that seems reasonable.
translation: 好的，那似乎合理。

english: But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: 但，不幸的是，我身上没带够钱。

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.
translation: 嗯，等你有钱了再来找我。

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 不幸的是所有技能斗篷只搭配免费兜帽出售，这是技能促销的一部分；买一送一，你知道的。所以你得先腾出一些物品栏空间我才能卖给你。

english: I'm sure you'll look hot in that cape.
translation: 我相信你穿上那件斗篷一定会很帅气。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: May I have another hood for my cape, please?
translation: 能再给我的斗篷要个兜帽吗？

english: You don't appear to have enough space in your inventory, come back and see me when you do.
translation: 你似乎物品栏没足够空间，等你有了再来找我。

english: Most certainly, and free of charge!
translation: 当然，而且免费！

english: What is that cape you're wearing?
translation: 你穿的是什么斗篷？

english: No, thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Can I buy a Skillcape of Firemaking?
translation: 我能买生火技能斗篷吗？

english: No thanks, that's too much.
translation: 不谢谢，那太贵了。

english: Okay, that seems reasonable.
translation: 好的，那似乎合理。

english: Skillcape
translation: 技能斗篷

english: Hood
translation: 兜帽

english: Welcome, [brother/sister/my child].
translation: 欢迎，[brother/sister/my child]。

english: Er... Are we related?
translation: 呃……我们有亲戚关系吗？

english: We are all related, [brother/sister/my child], for we are all children of the flame.
translation: 我们都是亲人，[brother/sister/my child]，因为我们都是火焰之子。

english: Okayyy...
So what is this place?
translation: 那么这是什么地方？

english: You stand before the Doors of Dinh. Behind them lies the prison of the Wintertodt.
translation: 你站在丁之门面前。后面是冬将军的囚牢。

english: What's a Wintertodt?
translation: 什么是冬将军？

english: We do not know what it is. All we know is that it threatens to snuff out every flame in this land and plunge the world into eternal darkness.
translation: 我们不知道它是什么。我们只知道，它威胁着要熄灭这片土地上的每一簇火焰，并将世界拖入永恒的黑暗。

english: Oh dear... We should probably do something about that.
translation: 哦天……我们大概得为此做点什么。

english: That is why we are here, [brother/sister/my child]. Ever since the Wintertodt was imprisoned, members of the Order of the Sacred Flame, or Pyromancers as we're often known, have stood vigil over this place.
translation: 那就是我们在这的原因，[brother/sister/my child]。自冬将军被囚禁以来，圣火教的成员，也就是人们常说的火术士，便一直在此守夜。

english: But alas, despite our best efforts, the Wintertodt is growing in power again.
translation: 但唉，尽管我们竭尽全力，冬将军的力量却再度增强。

english: Well that's just no good. Is there anything I can do to help?
translation: 那真不好。有什么我能帮忙的吗？

english: Our order searches tirelessly for a way to defeat the Wintertodt. Until we discover it, the Wintertodt must be held at bay.
translation: 我们教团正不懈寻求击败冬将军之法。在那之前，我们必须将冬将军遏制住。

english: However, I fear your abilities are not great enough to withstand the cold of the Wintertodt. Learn the ways of the sacred flame and then return to me.
translation: 然而，我怕你的能力不足以抵挡冬将军的寒冷。学习圣火之道然后回来找我。

english: You require at least 50 Firemaking to take on the Wintertodt.
translation: 你需要至少50级生火才能对抗冬将军。

english: Pass through the Doors of Dinh to the prison within. You will find the finest of our order channeling the power of the sacred flame into the Wintertodt.
translation: 穿过丁之门到里面的监狱。你会发现我们 order 中最优秀的将圣火之力 channeling 进冬将军。

english: Help them keep the holy fires lit so that they can keep the Wintertodt subdued.

translation: 确有其事。在第13个十年，谢兹恩三世国王凭借麾下军队夺取了库兰德王国的控制权。

english: The full set of laws within the Accord haven't been followed since. However, some of them were reinstated in the 47th decade, by King Byrne I.
translation: 自此以后，协定中的全套律法便未被遵循。不过，其中部分条款在第47个十年由伯恩一世国王予以恢复。

english: Fascinating. What happened during that time?
translation: 迷人。那段时间发生了什么事？

english: During the 20th decade, King Shayzien VI married the daughter of Lord Hosidius. Four decades later their son was crowned king.
translation: 于第20个十年，谢兹恩六世国王迎娶了霍西迪乌斯领主之女。四十年后，其子加冕为王。

english: He took the name King Hosidius IV in an attempt to distance the family from the breaking of the Royal Accord of Twill.
translation: 他取名为霍西迪乌斯四世国王，意在使家族与违反特威尔皇家协议的事划清界限。

english: King Hosidius IV followed by his son, King Hosidius V ruled Kourend until the early days of the 33rd decade.
translation: 霍西迪乌斯四世国王之后，其子霍西迪乌斯五世国王继续统治库兰德王国，直至第33个十年初期。

english: It was then that King Shayzien VII took control of the kingdom. His rule was a notably violent one.
translation: 彼时，谢兹恩七世国王夺取了王国控制权。其统治以残暴著称。

english: King Shayzien VII was killed some five decades later during the Battle of the Concourse. He was succeeded by the dark mage, Xeric.
translation: 约五十年后，谢兹恩七世国王于竞技会战役中殒命。继任者是黑暗法师泽里克。

english: Xeric ruled Kourend for more than ten dark decades using an army of lizardmen. This time period was known as the Age of Strife.
translation: 泽里克凭借蜥蜴人大军统治库兰德王国逾十个黑暗十年。这段时期被称为纷争时代。

english: Xeric was eventually killed during the 47th decade and succeeded by King Byrne I.
translation: 泽里克最终在第47个十年被杀并被伯恩一世国王继任。

english: Can you tell me more about Xeric?
translation: 你能多告诉我些关于泽里克吗？

english: Ah, I do not have much more information on him. You should speak to Ektheme, our Xerician expert.
translation: 啊，关于他我并无更多情报。你不妨去请教埃克塞姆，他是我们研究泽里克的专家。

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: The Royal Accord of Twill no longer plays much part in the rulership of Kourend. It was breached in the 13th decade when King Shayzien III seized control of the kingdom. It hasn't been honoured since.
translation: 特威尔皇家协议已不再对库兰德王国的统治产生多大影响。它在第13个十年遭谢兹恩三世国王夺权时违反，此后便未被遵循。

english: That said, it was the basis for Rose's Accord, which sets out how the kingdom is currently ruled today. As decreed in Rose's Accord, the Hosidius family are now the royal family of Kourend.
translation: 话虽如此，它却是罗斯协定的基石，后者规定了王国如今的统治方式。正如罗斯协定所规定，霍西迪乌斯家族现为库兰德王国的皇室。

english: We have the original Royal Accord of Twill safely stored here. Although it's not available for public viewing, there are copies available within the Grand Library. Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 我们有原始特威尔皇家协议安全地存储在这里。虽然它不供公众观看，但大图书馆内有副本。还有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: So what is today's date?
translation: 那么今天的日期是什么？

english: I'm afraid I lose track of which day it is... but we are in the 141st decade.
translation: 恐怕我已记不清今日是第几日了……但我们正处于第141个十年。

english: So that means the Accord was signed almost 1,410 years ago?
translation: 那意味着协议是几乎1,410年前签署的？

english: That is correct. You seem to have understood our time and date format well.
translation: 那是正确的。你似乎很好地理解了我们的时间和日期格式。

english: What about the time before the Accord was signed?
translation: 那协议签署前的时间呢？

english: Very little is known about those ancient times, but we refer to them as decades 'Before Accord', or 'BA' for short.
translation: 关于那段远古岁月，我们所知甚少，但我们将之称为''协定前''十年，简称''BA''。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Hello, what do you do here?
translation: 你好，你在这里做什么？

english: Have you ever heard of Camorra?
translation: 你听说过卡莫拉吗？

english: I can't say I have. Who is she?
translation: 我不能说我有。她是谁？

english: She's a hero from nearly two thousand years ago. I believe she travelled to Kourend during the Dragonkin Conflicts. I was hoping to learn more about her.
translation: 她是近两千年前的英雄人物。我相信她曾在龙裔冲突期间游历至库兰德王国。我希望能了解更多关于她的事迹。

english: Two thousand years ago? That's long before the founding of Kourend. I'm afraid we have very few records from those times here.
translation: 两千年前？那远在库兰德王国建立之前。恐怕我们这里很少有那个时代的记录。

english: Oh. So you can't help me?
translation: 哦。所以你帮不了我？

english: I can't but someone might be able to. The five cities of Kourend were founded long before the kingdom itself. Each city has their own historian who might have more information on the early days of their house.
translation: 我虽不能，但或许有人可以。库兰德王国的五座城市早在王国建立之前便已创立。每座城市都有各自的历史学家，他们或许掌握更多关于本家族早期的信息。

english: Great. Is there a particular city you'd recommend?
translation: 太好了。你有什么推荐的城市吗？

english: Hosidius and Shayzien were the two cities founded during the Dragonkin Conflicts. They might be the best ones to start with. The other cities were founded much earlier, during the God Wars.
translation: 霍西迪乌斯城和谢兹恩是在龙裔冲突期间建立的两个城市。它们可能是最好的开始。其他城市建立得更早，在神战期间。

english: Where can I find the Hosidius and Shayzien historians?
translation: 我在哪能找到霍西迪乌斯城和谢兹恩历史学家？

english: Jonathan is the Hosidius historian. He lives west of the Hosidius General Store. Amelia is the Shayzien historian. She lives south west of the Shayzien Pub.
translation: 乔纳森是霍西迪乌斯历史学家。他住在霍西迪乌斯杂货店西边。阿米莉亚是谢兹恩历史学家。她住在谢兹恩酒吧西南。

english: Thanks for the help.
translation: 谢谢帮助。

english: I have not. Did you try talking to the Hosidius and Shayzien historians about her.
translation: 我没有。你试过跟她谈霍西迪乌斯和谢兹恩历史学家吗。

english: Where can I find them again?
translation: 我在哪能再找到他们？

english: Horologist? What does that mean?
translation: 计时学家？那是什么意思？

english: Tell me more about the Royal Accord of Twill.
translation: 多告诉我些关于特威尔皇家协议。

english: Is the Royal Accord of Twill still honoured today?
translation: 特威尔皇家协议今天还被遵守吗？

english: Can you tell me more about Xeric?
translation: 你能多告诉我些关于泽里克吗？

translation: 那么今天的日期是什么？

translation: 再见。

translation: 你好。怎么样？

translation: 你在这里做什么？

translation: 我让猎人们装备精良！我能以合理价格卖你狩猎装备。

english: What have you got for sale?
translation: 你有什么卖的？

translation: 你知道吗，跟人打招呼的方式可多了。你好、嘿、你好啊……

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: 那仍然只算一种！

translation: 你好。你今天怎么样？

translation: 我很好，谢谢！

translation: 你好！水晶城今天天气真好，哈？

english: Hello. So, what is this place?
translation: 你好。那么，这是什么地方？

english: This is my home, mundane human! What do you have in your pockets? Something tasty?
translation: 这是我的居所，凡俗人类！你口袋里装着什么？可有什么美味？

english: Stay out of my pockets! I don't have anything that you want.
translation: 别碰我的口袋！我没有你想要的东西。

english: Ah, but do you have anything that *you* want?
translation: 啊，但你有什幺你想要的吗？

english: Of course I do!
translation: 当然我有！

english: Then you have something that implings want.
translation: 那你有小精灵想要的东西。

english: Eh?
translation: 呃？

english: We want things you people want. They are tasty to us! The more you want them, the tastier they are!
translation: 我们想要你们人类想要的东西。它们对我们来说很美味！你越想要它们，它们越美味！

english: So, you collect things that humans want? Interesting... So, what would happen if I caught an impling in a butterfly net?
translation: 所以，你们收集人类想要的东西？有趣……那么，如果我用捕虫网抓一个小精灵会发生什么？

english: Don't do that! That would be cruel. But chase us, yes! That is good. Implings are not easy to catch. Especially ones with really tasty food.
translation: 别那样！那太残忍了。但追我们，是的！那很好。小精灵可不容易抓。尤其是那些带着真正美味食物的。

english: So, some of these implings have things that I will really want? Hmm, maybe it would be worth my while trying to catch some.
translation: 所以，有些小精灵带着我真的想要的东西？嗯，也许值得我花点时间抓一些。

english: Going so soon?
translation: 这么快就走？

english: Yes, get me out of here!
translation: 是的，带我离开这里！

english: Ah, no I'll hang around a bit longer.
translation: 啊，不，我会再待一会儿。

english: Back where you came from, of course!
translation: 当然是你来的地方！

english: So not back to where the crop circle is now?
translation: 所以不是回到麦田圈现在所在的地方？

english: The aetheric thread connecting you to your own plane leads back to the wheat field where you came from. Obviously. So you will always go back to where you came from! Don't you humans know anything?
translation: 连接你和你自己位面的以太线通向你来的麦田。显然。所以你总是会回到你来的地方！你们人类就什么都不知道吗？

english: Evidently not.
translation: 显然不知道。

english: You wanna leave?
translation: 你想离开？

english: You want to know about the portal? It is for leaving this place, of course!
translation: 你想知道关于传送门的事？当然是用来离开这个地方的！

english: Where will I go if I leave?
translation: 如果我离开会去哪？

english: Here, solve this.
translation: 来，解这个。

english: That doesn't look solved to me.
translation: 在我看来这还没解开。

english: Well done [player name]. Here you go.
translation: 干得好 [player name]。给你。

english: You've obtained a [new clue/casket]!
translation: 你获得了 [new clue/casket]！

english: Yes, get me out of here!
translation: 是的，带我离开这里！

english: Ah, no I'll hang around a bit longer.
translation: 啊，不，我会再待一会儿。

english: Hey imp, can you hear me?
translation: 嘿，小恶魔，你能听到我说话吗？

english: Of course I can hear ya, ya great big ape. You know, 'veres not even enuf space to swing Bob about in 'ere. How about a breather? You know, stretch me pins for a bit?
translation: 当然我能听到你，你这大个子猿猴。你知道，这里甚至没有足够的空间挥舞鲍勃。休息一下怎么样？你知道，伸展一下我的翅膀？

english: No, I'm going to keep you in there. I might keep you as a pet.
translation: 不，我要把你关在里面。我可能把你当宠物养。

english: Pet!! Nah mate. I fink you'd find dat you'd be my pet!! We is not makin good pets.
translation: 宠物！！不，伙计。我想你会发现你才是我的宠物！！我们可不是好宠物。

english: Really? Why not?
translation: 真的？为什么不是？

english: Coz...errr...
translation: 因为……呃……

english: We bite! Yeah we is biting and...and...er...
translation: 我们咬人！是的我们咬人而且……而且……呃……

english: We is fire risk! Yeah dat's it! We be burning down your housey and stealin' all ya shiny gems. Oh, and da beads!! Mmmm, beads.
translation: 我们是火灾隐患！对就是这样！我们会烧掉你的房子，偷走你所有闪亮的宝石。哦，还有珠子！！嗯，珠子。

english: Fire risk? How does that work?
translation: 火灾隐患？那怎么运作？

english: Is those wizzies. Dey don't like de imps so dey make us go BOOOM!!
translation: 是那些巫师。他们不喜欢小精灵，所以他们让我们 Boom！！

english: It's not that bad. You've got four big windows, charming company...er...
translation: 没那么糟。你有四个大窗户，迷人的同伴……呃……

english: Yeah, we's love tiny, crampt space. It be magical. But I is a busy imp, innit? Dragons needin' ticklin', shiny relics needin' stealin', you know how it goes.
translation: 是的，我们喜欢狭小拥挤的空间。那很魔法。但我是个忙碌的小恶魔，不是吗？龙需要挠痒痒，闪亮的遗物需要偷，你知道怎么回事。

english: So, if you's know whas good for ya, you'd be lettin' me go, right?
translation: 所以，如果你知道什么对你好，你就会放我走，对吧？

english: Don't I get three wishes?
translation: 我不是应该得到三个愿望吗？

english: Nah, mate. Dunno what you're chirpin' about.
translation: 不，伙计。不知道你在叽喳什么。

english: Well, you're a magical creature aren't you? Surely I get some wishes for capturing you, or releasing you, or something?
translation: 嗯，你是个魔法生物对吧？那我抓到你或者放了你，总该有些愿望吧？

english: I'm finking dat you be a bit confoosed. I is an imp, not some namby-pamby genie or some kinda fairy. Ye can tell by the horns.
translation: 我想你有点混淆了。我是小恶魔，不是那种软弱无力的精灵或者某种仙女。你可以从角看出来。

english: Sayin' dat, I don't fancy being cooped up like one of me uncle's pigeons. Tell you what, is there anything you need deliverin' to the bank? I may not be no cunjerer or sommink like dat, but I can get about nice
translation: 话说回来，我不想被关起来像我叔叔的鸽子一样。告诉你吧，你有什么需要送到银行的吗？我可能不是魔术师或什么的，

english: an quick like. If you let me scarper, I'll take a couple of fings to the bank for ya. You game?
translation: 但我行动起来又快又好。如果你让我溜走，我会帮你带几样东西去银行。你玩吗？

english: Okay, that sounds fair.
translation: 好的，听起来公平。

english: Surely it should be three items? Then it's one item per wish.
translation: 难道不应该是三样物品吗？那样就是一个愿望一件物品。

english: I've already told ya, I ain't no bloomin' fairy. Besides, you know wot dey say, three's a crowd innit? I don't fink I can hop about carryin' more dan 2 fings.
translation: 我已经告诉过你了，我不是该死的仙女。而且，你知道他们怎么说，三人行必有一挤不是吗？我不觉得我能跳着带超过2样东西。

english: I've got nothing I need banking right now.
translation: 我现在没什么需要存银行的。

english: Great, just blinkin great, dat is. I'll just sit about countin' zombie sheep then. One...two...two and a bit...three and a bit more... I don't fink sheep 'ave dat many legs...
translation: 太好了，简直太好了，真是。那我就坐这儿数僵尸羊好了。一……二……二多一点……三再多一点……我不觉得羊有那么多腿……

english: Hey imp, are you still there?
translation: 嘿，小恶魔，你还在那吗？

english: An who's fault is that, eh? EH? I got betta fings to do dan sit ere waitin' for ya. 'Ave ya made up ya mind what else I'm luggin about?
translation: 那是谁的错，嗯？嗯？我有更好的事要做而不是坐在这里等你。你决定好我还要搬什么别的了吗？

english: Yes I have.
translation: 是的，我决定好了。

english: No, I'm afraid you're going to have to wait a bit longer.
translation: 不，恐怕你得再等一会儿。

english: Dat's alright guv'nor. I'll get back to me luvverly dream about beads. Big shiny beads. Love it!
translation: 没关系老板。我会回去做我关于珠子的美梦。又大又亮的珠子。我爱死它了！

english: Sorry, guv'nor, I seem to 'ave caught meself; I can't do nuffink right now.
translation: 抱歉，老板，我好像卡住了；我现在什么也做不了。

english: What use would that be in a bank? You'd be better off leaving it in yer house.
translation: 那在银行有什么用？你最好把它留在你家里。

english: Ow! That's hot! Put it in yer bank yerself!
translation: 哦！好烫！你自己把它放进银行！

english: No way, I can't bank your looting bag.
translation: 没门，我不能帮你存战利品袋。

english: Nope, between me and you, that toad doesn't look stable.
translation: 不行，咱俩之间说说，那只蟾蜍看起来不稳定。

english: What good is banking that book? Just read it or throw it away!
translation: 存那本书有什么用？读了它或者扔掉！

english: I'm no expert, but when a mushroom glows that much, I'm guessing it's dangerous. Keep it away from me.
translation: 我不是专家，但当蘑菇发光到那种程度，我猜它很危险。别让它靠近我。

english: I'm not touching a gnome ball; that's a vicious game! I might die!
translation: 我不碰地精球；那是个危险的游戏！我可能会死！

english: Don't you know? You can get into trouble for giving alcohol to minors, and I'm pretty small, it has to be said.
translation: 你不知道吗？给未成年人酒精会惹麻烦，而且我很小，不得不说。

english: There's something weird about those bones; I ain't touching them.
translation: 那些骨头有点奇怪；我不碰它们。

english: It's a flipping stick; why bother banking that? You humans are crazy sometimes.
translation: 它就是根破棍子；何必存那个？你们人类有时候真疯了。

english: I know what lamps like that contain; I'm not touching it. I might get hurt.

translation: 我们不太确定。我来这里研究它就是为了弄清楚。

english: Have you tried....
translation: 你试过……

english: Well, someone drank it... that didn't turn out so well.
translation: 嗯，有人喝了它……结果不太好。

translation: 嗯，她现在还活着。是我妈妈，玛丽。她是个比我更好的化学家，但她喜欢实际操作。这次对她来说结果不太好。幸好我在场帮忙。

english: I hope she recovers soon.

english: Me too.

translation: 啊是的。取样。我们试了所有能想到的方法，但它似乎，嗯，不知怎么变了。

english: What changes?

english: The substance. It's almost like taking a finger off a human and assuming it will stay alive I guess. The sample sort of... goes inert once we take the sample from the main body of the pool.
translation: 物质。就像从人身上取下一根手指并假设它会活着一样，我想。一旦我们从池子主体取样，样本就……变得惰性了。

english: How awkward.
translation: 真尴尬。

english: Yes, we've had a bit of progress there. We've tried adding in a lot of things with varying results. The accident was the best though.
translation: 是的，我们在那里有了一点进展。我们试了添加很多东西，结果各异。不过事故是最好的。

english: Irene looks embarassed.
translation: 艾琳看起来很尴尬。

english: What happened?
translation: 发生了什么事？

english: Well, I slipped and dropped a fossilised leg bone from something in the pool. It... well it kind of ate it away.
translation: 嗯，我滑倒了，把某个东西的化石腿骨掉进了池子里。它……嗯，它把它吃掉了。

english: Was there anything left?
translation: 还剩什么吗？

english: Oh yes, it was quite interesting. It's as if it restored some of the biological content of the bone and stripped all the mineralisation of fosilisation away. The bone was, rather floppy though. Like when you remove all the
translation: 哦是的，很有趣。就好像它恢复了骨头的一些生物内容，并剥离了所有化石化的矿化。不过骨头相当软。

translation: 就像当你移除所有钙和磷酸盐时一样。

english: Have you tried putting calcium in the pool?
translation: 你试过把钙放进池子里吗？

english: Calcium and phosphate are highly reactive - you'd never find just those in any quantity! You could maybe find some within minerals around this island that could work.
translation: 钙和磷酸盐反应性很高——你永远不会发现只有那些且有数量！你也许能在这个岛周围的矿物中找到一些能用的。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: What's this pool for?
translation: 这个池子是做什么的？

english: Drinking it?
translation: 喝它？

english: Sampling it?
translation: 取样？

english: Putting random things in it?
translation: 把随机东西放进去？

english: If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: 如果我和你一样丑，我就不敢在公共场合露面！

english: Out of my way, punk.
translation: 滚开，小混混。

english: Hmm... you smell strange...
translation: 嗯……你闻起来很奇怪……

english: Strange how?
translation: 怎么奇怪？

english: Like a human!
translation: 像人类！

english: Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!

english: Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: 如果你珍惜生命就别再跟我说话！

english: Get lost!

translation: 我没什么可给你的，所以别烦我，乞丐。

english: Have you no manners?
translation: 你没有礼貌吗？

english: I don't have time for this right now.
translation: 我现在没空。

english: I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: 我没兴趣和你这样可怜的肉袋说话。

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
translation: 我打赌你的爪子很漂亮。

english: A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: 真是悲惨的一天啊……趁还能享受就享受吧。

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: 你要是抓到谁，答应分我一口。

english: You smell familiar...

translation: 附近瞧见人类了吗？我可饿——坏——了。

english: Tell me about Iron[men/women].

english: When you play as anIron[man/woman], you do everything for yourself. You don't trade with other players, or take their items, or accept their help.
translation: 当你作为铁人游玩时，你一切都要靠自己。你不与其他玩家交易，不拿他们的物品，也不接受他们的帮助。

english: As anIron[man/woman], you choose to have these restrictions imposed on you, so everyone knows you're doing it properly.
translation: 作为铁人，你选择接受这些限制，这样大家都知道你是正经玩的。

translation: 如果你觉得自己有那本事，可以选择成为硬核铁人。

english: If you have some friends, you could stand alone... Together, asGroup Ironmen. Group Ironmen have the same restrictions as regular Iron[men/women] except you can trade your items with each other!
translation: 如果你有一些朋友，你们可以独自站立……一起，作为组队铁人。组队铁人有与普通铁人相同的限制，除了你们可以互相交易物品！

english: If you are a daring bunch, you could even tryHardcore Group Ironmen. With Hardcore Group Ironmen you have a set number of lives, when they reach zero, you will become regularGroup Ironmen.
translation: 如果你们是一群大胆的人，甚至可以试试硬核组队铁人。使用硬核组队铁人，你们有一定数量的生命，当它们归零时，你们将成为普通组队铁人。

english: If you ever decided to invite experienced players to your group, you would becomeUnranked Group Ironmen, which are no longer shown on the Group Ironman hiscores.
translation: 如果你决定邀请有经验玩家加入你的组，你将成为无排名组队铁人，这将不再显示在组队铁人排行榜上。

english: For the ultimate challenge, you can choose to become anUltimate Iron[man/woman], a game mode inspired by the playerIronNoBank.
translation: 对于终极挑战，你可以选择成为终极铁人，这是一种受玩家 IronNoBank 启发的游戏模式。

english: In addition to the standard restrictions,Ultimate Iron[men/women]are blocked from using the bank, and they drop all their items when they die.
translation: 除了标准限制外，终极铁人被禁止使用银行，并且死亡时会掉落所有物品。

english: While you're on Tutorial Island, you can switch freely between being astandard Iron[man/woman], anUltimate Iron[man/woman], aHardcore Iron[man/woman], aGroup Ironman, aHardcore Group Ironmanor a regular character.
translation: 当你在新手岛时，你可以在标准铁人、终极铁人、硬核铁人、组队铁人、硬核组队铁人或普通角色之间自由切换。

english: Once you've left this island, you'll be able to find my colleague Adam in Lumbridge, but he'll only let you switch your restrictions downwards, not upwards.
translation: 一旦你离开这个岛，你可以在仑桥镇找到我的同事亚当，但他只允许你向下切换限制，不能向上。

translation: 所以他会允许硬核铁人或终极铁人降级为标准铁人，并且他会允许所有类型的铁人成为普通玩家。

english: Make sure you've got your Iron[man/woman] settings all sorted before you leave Tutorial Island. Some things can't be changed later.

translation: 你是标准铁人。如果你愿意，可以降级为普通玩家。

english: There you go. Wear it with pride.
translation: 给你。自豪地穿上它。

translation: 你好，[player name]。我是铁人导师。有什么能帮你的？

english: You can choose to become anIron[man/woman]while you're on Tutorial Island. Although you can't do that on this account, you might like to bear it in mind for the future.
translation: 你可以在新手岛时选择成为铁人。虽然你不能在这个账号上这样做，但你可以为未来记住这一点。

english: You're not an Iron[man/woman]. This armour is only for them.
translation: 你不是铁人。这盔甲只给他们。

english: Sorry, Iron Man mode isn't available on Deadman worlds.

translation: 你好，[player name]。每个参加联赛 II - 开拓者的人在离开新手岛后都受铁人限制。

english: If you're interested in the Fresh Start Worlds, you should know that you can't be an Iron Man on those.
translation: 如果你对新生世界感兴趣，你应该知道你不能在那里成为铁人。

english: What are Fresh Start Worlds?
translation: 什么是新生世界？

english: Fresh Start Worlds are worlds that have a fresh economy to build and fresh hiscores to chase.
translation: 新生世界是有全新经济可建设和全新排行榜可追逐的世界。

english: They're a way to experience Old School RuneScape as if it were new, today!
translation: 它们是体验 Old School RuneScape 就像它是新的一样，就在今天！

english: They will last for 6 months, after which your account will be transferedto the main game and you can carry on playing as normal there.
translation: 它们将持续6个月，之后你的账号将转移到主游戏，你可以在那里继续正常游玩。

english: There is a World First system, which are achievements only obtainable once on all worlds, so you can race against others for these!
translation: 有一个世界第一系统，这是所有世界上只能获得一次的成就，所以你可以与他人竞赛获得这些！

english: If a global race is a bit too much, then there is also an Achievement Point system. You can compete against your friends to get the most points.
translation: 如果全球竞赛有点太多，那么还有一个成就点数系统。你可以与朋友竞争获得最多点数。

english: Other than that, it's the same Old School experience you know and love, with all the same content as the main game.
translation: 除此之外，这是你熟知和喜爱的相同老学校体验，所有内容都与主游戏相同。

english: Do you still wish to proceed with selecting an Iron Man mode?
translation: 你还希望继续选择铁人模式吗？

translation: 是的，我对新生世界不感兴趣。

english: That's okay. If you change your mind you can find out more about Fresh Start Worlds by speaking to the Magic Instructor, assuming you're not an ironman.

english: You'll have to remove any ironman status first by speaking to me.

translation: 跟我讲讲铁人。

translation: 没关系，我对那些不感兴趣。

translation: 是的，我对新生世界不感兴趣。

english: No, Fresh Start Worlds sound like my sort of thing!
translation: 不，新生世界听起来像我的菜！

english: Hey, what do you do here?
translation: 嘿，你在这里做什么？

english: I help the main man over there. He can get a bit cantankerous. Every now and then he'll just start attacking people without warning. I act as a sort of home help...
translation: 我帮那边的大人物。他可能有点脾气暴躁。时不时他会毫无警告地开始攻击人。我充当某种家庭帮助……

english: How do you mean, home help?
translation: 你什么意思，家庭帮助？

english: Well, sometimes he'll fly right off the handle and just start, you know, 'raising the dead' to do his 'bidding'. That kind of activity is just so anti-social, so it tends to attract a lot of hero types, you know!
translation: 嗯，有时他会大发雷霆然后开始，你知道，“复活死者”来做他的“命令”。那种活动太反社会了，所以往往吸引很多英雄类型，你知道！

english: Yes, yes, I know the sort...full of themselves aren't they.
translation: 是的，是的，我知道那种……自以为了不起对吧。

english: Exactly! They come in all, 'Have at thee! ' and 'Death to you evil one', it's all a bit too dramatic for me to be honest.
translation: 正是！他们进来都说，“接招！”和“去死吧邪恶者”，老实说对我来说都太戏剧化了。

english: Anyway, he'll often end up getting killed and nothing get's done around the house while he's awaiting his mortal return.
translation: 总之，他经常最终被杀死，在他等待凡人回归期间家里什么事都做不成。

english: Mortal return? Sounds interesting.
translation: 凡人回归？听起来有趣。

english: Well, it's kind of interesting the first few times, but it's like falling off a bike...
translation: 嗯，前几次有点有趣，但就像从自行车上摔下来……

english: What, you graze your knees a lot?
translation: 什么，你经常擦伤膝盖？

english: I was going to say that you soon get fed-up with it. I guess it's one of those perks of the job though, ability to raise yourself from the dead.

translation: 在意识到冒险走向山顶会导致必死后，这座山被称为奎达莫特山。

english: Unfortunately, the expedition was a failure and the entire party was killed. The king himself died a few years later and was succeeded by the tyrant Xeric. No more expeditions were ordered under his rule.
