english: What's up with him?
translation: 他怎么了？

english: Another gift from the sea. Found him on the shore a few days ago.
translation: 大海的另一个礼物。几天前在岸边发现他的。

english: The moon... His face was the moon...
translation: 月亮……他的脸是月亮……

english: Is he going to be okay?
translation: 他会没事吗？

english: Maybe. Maybe not. Only time will tell.
translation: 也许。也许不。只有时间知道。

english: Okay... What are you going to do with him?
translation: 好的……你打算怎么处置他？

english: He'll get the same offer they all do. We don't need mouths to feed if they won't contribute. Once he's up, he can either stick around or ship out, but if he's staying, he has to help.
translation: 他会得到和大家一样的提议。如果不贡献我们不需要养闲人。一旦他起来，要么留下要么走人，但如果留下，他必须帮忙。

english: Help with what?
translation: 帮什么？

english: Salvage of course. We don't have the luxuries of Fortis out here. We have to make do with what we can find. Luckily for us, there's always plenty to be found thanks to all the wrecks.
translation: 当然是打捞。我们这里没有福蒂斯的奢侈品。我们得将就着用能找到的。幸运的是，多亏了所有沉船，总有足够的东西可找。

english: I see. Well I hope he gets well soon.
translation: 我明白了。嗯我希望他很快康复。

english: You've returned. Can I help you?
translation: 你回来了。我能帮你吗？

english: Is he doing any better?
translation: 他好些了吗？

english: What do you think?
translation: 你觉得呢？

english: What happens if he doesn't recover?
translation: 如果他不康复会怎样？

english: The sea can have him back.
translation: 大海可以把他收回。

english: Harsh.
translation: 严厉。

english: I told you before, we don't have the luxuries of Fortis out here. The dead are not useful, nor are they worth anything.
translation: 我之前告诉过你，我们这里没有福蒂斯的奢侈品。死者没用，也不值钱。

english: If he does live, he will have an opportunity. If he desires, he can have a home here, provided he's willing to contribute.
translation: 如果他活了，他会有机会。如果他愿意，他可以在这里有个家，只要他愿意贡献。

english: Hi there. Would you like to buy a cape?
translation: 你好。你想买斗篷吗？

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Suit yourself.
translation: 随你便。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Hello there. Who are you?
translation: 你好。你是谁？

english: Mum says I not to talk to strangers.
translation: 妈妈说我不跟陌生人说话。

english: That's pretty good advice!
translation: 那是很好的建议！

english: So I's can't says my name is Jack.
translation: 所以我不能说我叫杰克。

english: Okay then.
translation: 那好吧。

english: We's be new here, on the bana plantion.
translation: 我们是新来的，在香蕉种植园。

english: You mean banana plantation.
translation: 你是说香蕉种植园。

english: Yeah, we's be new here. Anyway, I gonna go play now.
translation: 是的，我们是新来的。总之，我现在要去玩了。

english: Jack!
translation: 杰克！

english: Oh, 'Jack', that's a lovely name.
translation: 哦，‘杰克’，那是个好名字。

english: Yes, that's me.
translation: 是的，那是我。

english: We play here.
translation: 我们在这里玩。

english: That must be fun.
translation: 那一定很有趣。

english: Yeah, it's fun. Bye.
translation: 是的，很有趣。再见。

english: No, I not say. You have to guess.
translation: 不，我不说。你得猜。

english: Okay. Is it Jack?
translation: 好的。是杰克吗？

english: How d'ya know that? Are you magic?
translation: 你怎么知道的？你是魔法吗？

english: Not really - just call it a gift.
translation: 不算——就叫它天赋吧。

english: If you were magic, you would know why the sea is blue... are you magic?
translation: 如果你是魔法，你会知道为什么海是蓝的……你是魔法吗？

english: Nope, I'm not magic, and I have no clue why the sea is blue.
translation: 不，我不是魔法，我也不知道为什么海是蓝的。

english: Oh, well. That's a bit sad. I was hoping you were magic and could magic me some sweets. But you can't, so I go find someone else who's magic. Bye.
translation: 哦，好吧。那有点伤心。我希望你是魔法能变些糖果给我。但你不能，所以我去找别的会魔法的人。再见。

english: Thanks so much for saving us from those stinky gublinch. They were awful! I hope Shanty gave you somefingcool for your efforts.
translation: 非常感谢你救我们脱离那些臭烘烘的哥布林奇。它们太可怕了！我希望尚蒂给了你些酷东西作为努力报酬。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: So how's life as a pirate?
translation: 海盗日子过得怎么样？

english: What kind of question is that? How's life as a... I dunno. Whatever it is that you do for a living.
translation: 这算什么问题？生活怎么样……我也不知道。就像你靠什么谋生一样。

english: I'm a freelance troubleshooter.
translation: 我是个自由接活的麻烦解决者。

english: What does that entail then?
translation: 那具体是做什么的？

english: Mostly killing things for money and delivering items around the planet for people.
translation: 主要是拿钱办事杀人，帮人把物品送到世界各地。

english: I collect stuff.
translation: 我喜欢收集东西。

english: So how's that life?
translation: 那生活怎么样？

english: Can't complain, can't complain...
translation: 还过得去啦……

english: Well, there you go.
translation: 给，拿好。

english: Aren't you a little short for a pirate?
translation: 你作为海盗是不是有点太矮了？

english: My mother was a gnome. Apparently it was a very painful birth.
translation: 我的母亲是地精，据说她生我时非常痛苦。

english: More info than I wanted, thanks!
translation: 这信息我可不想听，谢了！

english: Sorry, can't stop, the Captain will have my guts for garters if he catches me slacking off talking to the stowaway.
translation: 不能再聊了，要是船长发现我在偷懒跟偷渡客聊天，会把我大卸八块的！

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard!
translation: 我不是偷渡客！我是被邀请上船的！

english: Yeah, whatever [guy/lady], it doesn't really matter who you are I'll get in trouble!
translation: 随便啦 [guy/lady]，不管你是谁，反正我都会惹上麻烦！

english: You know, I've always wondered what life as a pirate actually entails.
translation: 你知道吗，我一直想知道海盗生活到底是怎样的。

english: Well, at the moment it mostly involves being asked random questions by a stowaway.
translation: 嗯，目前主要是被一个偷渡客问各种问题。

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard! By Lokar! Ask him!
translation: 我不是偷渡客！我是被邀请上船的！洛卡尔邀请的！你问他！

english: Hey, whatever [love/pal]. Just make sure the captain doesn't catch you, pirates don't like stowaways much.
translation: 随便啦 [love/pal]。只要别让船长抓到你就行，海盗都不太喜欢偷渡客。

english: Ah, good day to you [milady/sirrah]! Your face is unfamiliar, did you perhaps join us aboard the ship at Lunar Isle?
translation: 你好 [milady/sirrah]！你的面孔很陌生，你该不会是在月亮岛登上我们船的吧？

english: No, Lokar offered me a lift in Rellekka actually.
translation: 不，其实是洛卡尔在雷勒卡城让我搭的便船。

english: Oh, really? You don't look like a Fremennik to me!
translation: 真的吗？但你看起来不像费明尼克人啊！

english: Well... I kind of am, and I kind of aren't. It's a long story.
translation: 这个嘛……我算是，也不算吧。说来话长。

english: Sorry I don't have time to hear it then! See you around young fremennik-who-is-not-really-a-fremennik!
translation: 那抱歉我没时间听了！回头见啦，你这个不算真正费明尼克的年轻人！

english: 'Bye.
translation: 再见。

english: Brrrr! Its cold up here!
translation: 嘶！上面好冷！

english: You think this is cold? Up by Acheron it gets so cold that when you talk you see the words freeze in the air in front of you!
translation: 你觉得这算冷？在阿刻戎那边，冷到你连说出的话语都能冻在空中！

english: REALLY?
translation: 真的吗？

english: Nah, not really. I was exaggerating for humourous effect. It is very very cold though!
translation: 哈，当然不是真的。我只是为了搞笑夸张了一下。不过那里确实非常非常冷！

english: Hello to you too.
translation: 也向你问好。

english: Yar! We be pirates, yar! Avast, ye scurvy land-lubbing lychee!
translation: 呀！我们是海盗！停下，你这个可怜的旱鸭子荔枝 (羞辱性称呼)！

english: Please don't talk like that, it is extremely irritating.
translation: 请不要那样说话，这很令人討厌的。

english: Also, please don't call me a lychee, whatever that may be.
translation: 还有你别叫我荔枝 (羞辱性称呼)，不管那是什么。

english: Oh. Okay. Sorry.
translation: 好的，抱歉。

english: ARGH! SOUND THE ALARM! STOWAWAY ON BOARD! STOWAWAY ON BOARD!
translation: 啊！拉警报！船上有偷渡客！船上有偷渡客！

english: No! I'm not a stowaway! Honest! I was invited here!
translation: 我不是偷渡客，真的！我是被邀请来的！

english: Oh, sorry, my mistake then.
translation: 抱歉，那我弄错了。

english: You must admit you do look a lot like a stowaway though.
translation: 不过你得承认，你看起来确实很像偷渡客。

english: Why, what do they usually look like?
translation: 那他们通常长什么样？

english: Erm... I've never actually met one...
translation: 呃……其实我从没见过真正的偷渡客……

english: Okay then...
translation: 那好吧……

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: So... You're a pirate, huh?
translation: 那么……你是海盗，对吧？

english: It's what it says on my pay-packet at the end of the month.
translation: 我月底工资单上就这么写的。

english: How's that working out for you?
translation: 干得怎么样？

english: Pretty good so far. All the grog and loot that we can plunder, plus full medical including dental.
translation: 到目前为止还不错。有喝不完的格罗格酒和抢不完的战利品，甚至还有全套医疗保障，包括牙科。

english: You mean you have insurance?
translation: 你是说有保险？

english: Not as such. If any of us get sick we kidnap a doctor and don't let him go until we're better.
translation: 倒也不是。要是我们谁生病了，就绑架个医生，直到我们康复才放他走。

english: You'd be surprised what an incentive for expert health care that is.
translation: 说出来你可能不信，这可是让医疗水准提升的一大动力。

english: I can imagine.
translation: 这倒不难想象。

english: Hello there. So what brings you aboard the Lady Zay?
translation: 你好啊，是什么风把你吹上赛夫人号的？

english: Well, I was planning on visiting the Moon Clan, but I have to say your ship is very impressive.
translation: 我本来打算去拜访月氏族，但不得不说你们的船令人印象深刻。

english: Aye, she's a beauty alright! The Lady Zay has been my home for many hard months, through storm and sun, and she always gets us to here we were headed!
translation: 是啊，她确实是个美人！赛夫人号作为我的家陪伴我度过了许多艰苦岁月，风雨无阻，她总是能把我们送到目的地！

english: Yes, she's certainly one of the finest boats I've seen on my travels!
translation: 是的，她确实是我旅行中见过的最棒的船之一！

english: That she is [lad/lass], that she is.
translation: 确实是啊 [lad/lass]。

english: Arrr, matey!
translation: 啊，伙计！

english: I'm looking for Redbeard Frank.
translation: 我在找红胡子弗兰克。

english: Redbeard Frank ye say? He be outside. Says he likes the feel of the wind on his cheeks.
translation: 你说红胡子弗兰克？他在外头，说是喜欢海风吹拂在脸上的感觉。

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Drinking.
translation: 喝酒。

english: Fair enough.
translation: 好吧。

english: Have you got any quests I could do?
translation: 你有什么任务我可以做吗？

english: Nay, but the barkeep hears most of the news around here. Or Redbeard Frank, he's often spoken of buried treasure. Perhaps ye should be asking them for quests.
translation: 不，但酒保能听到这附近最多的消息。或者红胡子弗兰克，他经常提到埋藏的宝藏。也许你应该问他们要任务。

english: Nay, but Redbeard Frank has often spoken of buried treasure. Perhaps ye should be asking him for a quest.
translation: 不，但红胡子弗兰克经常提到埋藏的宝藏。也许你应该问他要任务。

english: Nay, but the barkeep hears most of the news around here. Perhaps ye should be asking him for a quest.
translation: 不，但酒保能听到这附近最多的消息。也许你应该问他要任务。

english: Nay, I've nothing for ye to do. But I hear there's an old landlubber in Draynor Village who's always a-looking for a lively [lad/lass] to do him a favour.
translation: 不，我没什么给你做的。但我听说德雷诺村有个老旱鸭子总是在找活泼的 [lad/lass] 帮他忙。

english: Yo ho ho!
translation: 哟嚯嚯！

english: So are you pirates?
translation: 那么你们是海盗吗？

english: Aye [laddie/lassie], that we are.
translation: 是的 [laddie/lassie]，我们是。

english: Aye, that we be.
translation: 是的，我们是。

english: Nay, always ye say it wrong! Tis 'we are', not 'we be'.
translation: 不，你总是说错！是'we are'，不是'we be'。

english: I be a pirate, not a scurvy schoolmaster!
translation: 我是海盗，不是该死的教师！

english: Ye be a fool, and a disgrace to piracy.
translation: 你是个傻瓜，海盗之耻。

english: Now ye be saying 'be' too!
translation: 现在你也说'be'了！

english: Arrr! Tis thy fault.
translation: 啊！是你的错。

english: I think I'll leave you two to sort it out.
translation: 我想我还是让你们两个自己解决吧。

english: I'm looking for Redbeard Frank.
translation: 我在找红胡子弗兰克。

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Have you got any quests I could do?
translation: 你有什么任务我可以做吗？

english: Have you had enough fun for now?
translation: 你现在玩得够久了吗？

english: Let's play a game!
translation: 我们玩个游戏吧！

english: Everyone copy me!
translation: 大家模仿我！

english: [Player name] is the winner!
translation: [Player name] 是赢家！

english: Goodbye!
translation: 再见！

english: Yes
translation: 是

english: No
translation: 否

english: Greetings warrior, how may I help you?
translation: 问候战士，我能怎么帮你？

english: How long have you worked here?
translation: 你在这里工作多久了？

english: Oh ever since the Guild opened. I like it here.
translation: 哦自从公会开放以来。我喜欢这里。

english: Why's that?
translation: 为什么？

english: Well.. what with all these warriors around, there's not much chance of my bank being robbed is there!
translation: 嗯……周围有这么多战士，我的银行被抢的机会不大对吧！

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！

english: Invest your time and money wisely.
translation: 明智地投资你的时间和金钱。

english: I'd like to access my bank account, please.
translation: 我想查看我的银行账户。

english: I'd like to check my PIN settings.
translation: 我想检查我的 PIN 设置。

english: I'd like to collect items.
translation: 我想领取物品。

english: How long have you worked here?
translation: 你在这里工作多久了？

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！

english: Hi!
translation: 嗨！

english: Well. This beats doing the shopping!
translation: 嗯。这比购物强！

english: I wouldn't want to be the poor guy that has to clean up after the duels.
translation: 我不想成为决斗后必须清理的可怜家伙。

english: Me neither.
translation: 我也是。

english: Hi!
translation: 嗨！

english: What did the skeleton say before it ate?
translation: 骷髅吃之前说了什么？

english: I don't know?
translation: 我不知道？

english: Bone-appetit.
translation: 祝你 (骨) 胃口好。(双关)

english: Ooh. This is exciting!
translation: 哦。这真令人兴奋！

english: Yup!
translation: 是的！

english: How can you make a very lively hankerchief?
translation: 怎么让手帕非常活泼？

english: Put a little boogey in it.
translation: 在里面放一点''鬼''东西。(双关)

english: Why did the skeleton burp?
translation: 为什么骷髅打嗝？

english: 'Cause it didn't have the guts to fart!
translation: 因为它没''肠子'' (胆子) 放屁！(双关)

english: My son just won his first duel!
translation: 我儿子刚赢了他的第一场决斗！

english: Congratulations!
translation: 恭喜！

english: He ripped his opponent in half!
translation: 他把对手撕成了两半！

english: That's gotta hurt!
translation: 那肯定疼！

english: He's only 10 as well!
translation: 他也才10岁！

english: You gotta start 'em young!
translation: 你得从小开始！

english: Can't you see I'm watching the duels?
translation: 你没看到我在看决斗吗？

english: I'm sorry!
translation: 抱歉！

english: Knock knock!
translation: 叩叩！

english: Who's there?
translation: 谁？

english: Boo.
translation: Boo。

english: Boo who?
translation: 是谁？(假哭声)

english: Don't cry, it's just me!
translation: 别哭，只是我而已！

english: Waaaaassssssuuuuupp?!
translation: 怎~么~了？！

english: Hi! I'm here to watch the duels!
translation: 嗨！我是来看决斗的！

english: Me too!
translation: 我也是！

english: My favourite fighter is Mubariz!
translation: 我最喜欢的战士是穆巴里兹！

english: The guy at the information kiosk?
translation: 信息亭的那个家伙？

english: Yeah! He rocks!
translation: 是的！他超厉害！

english: Takes all sorts, I guess.
translation: 我想什么样的人都有。

english: Hmph.
translation: 哼。

english: Did you know they think this place dates back to the second age?!
translation: 你知道他们认为这地方追溯到第二纪元吗？！

english: Really?
translation: 真的？

english: Yeah. The guy at the information kiosk was telling me.
translation: 是的。信息亭的家伙告诉我的。

english: Hello there...thanks for helping out Trufitus commune with the gods Bwana. We've been able to return to the village thanks to your help.
translation: 你好……谢谢你帮助特鲁菲图斯与神沟通 Bwana。多亏你的帮助我们才能回村。

english: You got beaten up by a troll!
translation: 你被巨魔揍了！

english: That monster? If it dares to come here again, I will be ready for it, and it shall taste my spear.
translation: 那个怪物？如果它敢再来，我会准备好，让它尝尝我的矛。

english: You didn't look so tough when the troll knocked you down.
translation: 巨魔把你打倒时你看起来没那么强硬。

english: Bwana, get knotted.
translation: Bwana，滚蛋。

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Why, it should be clear to even the most ignorant of people that I am a fearless jungle hunter...out of my way you sanitised civilian!
translation: 为什么，即使是最无知的人也该清楚我是个无畏的丛林猎人……让开你这消毒过的平民！

english: Is there anything interesting to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么有趣的事做吗？

english: Bwana, if anyone else asks me that question today, I'll explode! Go and ask someone else!
translation: 先生，如果今天还有人问我那个问题，我会爆炸！去问别人！

english: Not that I'm aware of, just sit back and enjoy the sunshine bwana!
translation: 据我所知没有，只管坐下享受阳光先生！

english: Sorry Bwana, I'm already busy, why not go and talk to Murcaily! He's around the village somewhere.
translation: 抱歉先生，我已经忙了，何不去跟穆尔凯利谈谈！他在村里某处。

english: Well, I think that there's some work to be done...perhaps Murcaily can help you. He usually tends to the hardwood grove to the east of Trufitus's hut.
translation: 嗯，我想有些事要做……也许穆尔凯利能帮你。他通常照料特鲁菲图斯小屋东边的硬木林。

english: It's just village life as normal around here Bwana, always something interesting to find to occupy your time if you look hard enough.
translation: 这附近只是正常的村庄生活 Bwana，只要你努力找，总有有趣的事打发时间。

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
translation: 我一直在村里做些工作。

english: I've already given you some trading sticks and I don't have any more on me at the moment. Why not go and talk to some of the other villagers and get some contributions?
translation: 我已经给你一些交易棒了，目前身上没更多了。何不去跟其他村民谈谈弄点贡献？

english: All rides on a magic carpet are now free and you'll receive extra Agility experience from the Pollnivneach rooftop course.
translation: 所有魔毯乘坐现在免费，并且你会从波尼尼镇屋顶课程获得额外敏捷经验。

english: I've completed all of the elite tasks in my Desert achievement diary!
translation: 我完成了沙漠成就日志的所有精英任务！

english: You need at least two inventory spaces, make some space and come back.
translation: 你需要至少两个物品栏空间，腾出空间再来。

english: I've upgraded your Desert amulet for you. You can now charge a Pharaoh's sceptre with 100 charges, the amulet will protect you from desert heat at all times, a shortcut has been opened in the Kalphite hive and the
translation: 我为你升级了沙漠护符。你现在可以给法老权杖充100次电，护符会随时保护你免受沙漠炎热，卡尔夫特蜂巢已打开捷径，

english: amulet will teleport you to Nardah and the kalphite hive to the East of the Shantay Pass as much as you desire. I've also negotiated completely free passage through the Shantay passes here and at the Ruins of
translation: 护符会按需传送你到那尔达城和沙泰隘口东边的卡尔夫特蜂巢。

english: Unkah.
translation: 我还协商了在这里和昂卡废墟完全免费通过尚塔通道。

english: Can I have another amulet?
translation: 能再给我一个护符吗？

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: I have a question about my Achievement Diary
translation: 我有个关于成就日志的问题

english: What is the Achievement Diary?
translation: 什么是成就日志？

english: What are the rewards?
translation: 奖励是什么？

english: Easy Rewards.
translation: 简单奖励。

english: Medium Rewards.
translation: 中等奖励。

english: Hard Rewards.
translation: 困难奖励。

english: Elite Rewards.
translation: 精英奖励。

english: How do I claim the rewards?
translation: 我怎么领取奖励？

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！

english: What do you want from me outerlander? It is our policy not to associate with those not of our tribe.
translation: 你想要我什么外乡人？我们的政策是不与非本部落的人交往。

english: Where is your chieftain? I find it highly discriminatory to refuse to talk to someone on the grounds that they are not part of your tribe.
translation: 你的酋长在哪？我发现以不属于你部落为由拒绝跟人说话非常歧视。

english: I don't rightly understand your speech outerlander, but my loyalty is with Chieftain Brundt.
translation: 我不太懂你的话外乡人，但我的忠诚属于酋长布伦特。

english: He resides in our longhall; it is the large building over there, you should speak to him for he speaks for us all.
translation: 他住在我们的大厅；就是那边的大建筑，你应该跟他说话因为他代表我们所有人。

english: So what are you doing here?
translation: 那么你在这里做什么？

english: This should not concern you, outerlander. I am awaiting other Fremenniks to join me on an expedition to Waterbirth Island.
translation: 这不关你事，外乡人。我在等其他费明尼克人加入我去水诞岛的探险。

english: It is a small crescent-shaped island just north-west of here, outerlander.
translation: 那是这里西北边的一个小月牙形岛屿，外乡人。

english: We have many legends about it, such as the tale of the broken sky, and the day of the green seas.
translation: 我们有很多关于它的传说，比如破碎天空的故事，和绿色海洋之日。

english: The reason I am travelling there is more serious Fremennik business, however. I doubt an outerlander would be interested.
translation: 不过我去那里的原因是更严肃的费明尼克事务。我怀疑外乡人不会感兴趣。

english: Can I come?
translation: 我能来吗？

english: An outerlander join us on an honoured hunt???
translation: 一个外乡人加入我们荣誉狩猎？？？

english: Well.... I guess... I might be able to allow you to join us, although it is a breach of many of our customs...
translation: 嗯……我想……我可能能让你加入我们，虽然这违反了我们许多习俗……

english: Oh, pleeeeease? I really LOVE killing stuff!
translation: 哦，求求你了？我真的超爱杀东西！

english: Well... I remain unconvinced that it would be wise to allow an outerlander to join us in such dangerous battle, but your enthusiasm seems genuine enough...
translation: 嗯……我仍然不确定让外乡人加入我们如此危险的战斗是否明智，但你的热情似乎足够真诚……

english: I will allow you to escort us, but you must pay me a sum of money first.
translation: 我允许你护送我们，但你必须先付我一笔钱。

english: What? That's outrageous, why charge me money? And, uh, how much does it cost me?
translation: 什么？那太离谱了，为什么收我钱？而且，呃，多少钱？

english: Ah, the outerlanders have stolen from my people for many years, in this way you can help my community with a small amount of money...
translation: 啊，外乡人多年来一直偷窃我的人民，这样你可以用少量钱帮助我的社区……

english: Let us say... 1,000 coins. Payable in advance, of course.
translation: 比如说……1,000金币。当然预付。

english: For this I will take you to Waterbirth Island on my boat, and will bring you back here when you have had your fill of the hunt. Assuming you are still alive to wish to leave, of course.
translation: 为此我会用我的船带你去水诞岛，并在你狩猎够了后带你回这里。假设你还活着想离开，当然。

english: So do you have the 1,000 coins for my service, and are you ready to leave now?
translation: 那么你有1,000金币给我的服务吗，你现在准备好离开了吗？

english: The player sets sail for Waterbirth Island
translation: 玩家起航前往水诞岛

english: I suggest you head to the cave with some urgency outerlander, the cold air out here might be too much for the likes of you…
translation: 我建议你赶紧去洞穴外乡人，这里的冷空气对你这样的人可能太过了……

english: No, actually I have some stuff to do here first.
translation: 不，其实我有些事要先在这里做。

english: As you wish. Come and see me when your bloodlust needs sating.
translation: 如你所愿。当你需要满足嗜血时来找我。

english: Hey, I have to say, that's a fine looking hat you are wearing there.
translation: 嘿，我得说，你戴的那帽子很好看。

english: It is actually a helm, outerlander, but the sentiment is appreciated nonetheless.
translation: 外乡人，那其实是头盔，不过还是多谢你的好意。

english: Wow, you Fremenniks sure know how to party. Well, see ya around.
translation: 哇，你们费明尼克人真会派对。好吧，回头见。

english: Actually, I don't think I have anything to speak to you about…
translation: 其实，我想我没什么跟你说的……

english: Ah, you live yet, outerlander!
translation: 啊，你还活着，外乡人！

english: Have you had your fill of the hunt and wish to return, or are you still feeling the joy of the cull?
translation: 你狩猎尽兴了想返回，还是仍沉浸在猎杀的快感中？

english: I wish to return to Rellekka.
translation: 我想回雷勒克卡城。

english: Then let us away; There will be death to bring here another day!
translation: 那我们这就走吧；改天再带死亡降临此地！

english: The player is sailed back to Rellekka
translation: 玩家被船送回雷勒克卡城

english: I want to stay here.
translation: 我想留在这里。

english: Ha Ha Ha! A true huntsman at heart!
translation: 哈哈哈！内心真正的猎人！

english: I myself have killed over a hundred of the dagger- mouths, and did not think it too many!
translation: 我自己都杀了一百多只匕首口怪，还不觉得多！

english: Greetings, [Fremennik name]!
translation: 你好，[Fremennik name]！

english: Ah, and what a glorious name that is! Worthy of only the finest warriors!
translation: 啊，多么光荣的名字！只配最优秀的战士！

english: Heh. Yup, you're right there.
translation: 嘿。是的，你说得对。

english: So what brings you back to fair Rellekka? It has been too long since you have drunk in the longhall with us and sang of your battles!
translation: 那么什么风把你吹回美丽的雷勒克卡？你太久没和我们在大厅喝酒唱战歌了！

english: You have not heard, [Fremennik name]? I am leading an expedition to Waterbirth Island!
translation: 你没听说吗，[Fremennik name]？我正带领探险队去水birth 岛！

english: You have not ever travelled to Waterbirth Island, [Fremennik name]? I am surprised, it is a place of outstanding natural beauty.
translation: 你从没去过水birth 岛，[Fremennik name]？我很惊讶，那是个自然美景出众的地方。

english: Or at least it used to be! But things have now changed...
translation: 或者至少曾经是！但现在情况变了……

english: Changed? How do you mean, changed?
translation: 变了？你怎么意思，变了？

english: It seems as though the sea-beasts known to us as the dagger-mouths have begun their hatching once again... And there may be others of their ilk there too.
translation: 似乎我们称之为“匕首口”的海兽又开始孵化了……那里可能还有它们的同类。

english: Dagger-mouths?
translation: 匕首口？

english: Aye, the dagger-mouths! The vile creatures lived near here once, but we had thought them all driven back to the ocean depths many moons past.
translation: 是的，匕首口！那些邪恶的生物曾经住在附近，但我们以为许多月前它们都被赶回深海了。

english: I can only imagine a dagger-mouth queen has nested somewhere nearby, and spawned her foul brood under the sea once more, and some of them have migrated to fair Waterbirth Island.
translation: 我只能想象一只匕首口女王在附近某处筑巢，又在海底产下了邪恶的后代，其中一些迁移到了美丽的水birth 岛。

english: So you're scared they might attack Rellekka?
translation: 所以你怕它们可能攻击雷勒克卡？

english: Scared? Ha ha ha!
translation: 怕？哈哈哈！

english: You wound us with your questioning, [Fremennik name]!
translation: 你的问题伤了我们要，[Fremennik name]！

english: We are glad the dagger-mouths have returned to these shores, for it means we will get the chance to hunt them once again as our ancestors did!
translation: 我们很高兴匕首口回到了这些海岸，因为这意味着我们将有机会像祖先一样再次猎杀它们！

english: When treated in the correct manner, the creatures' remains can be used to make fine battleworthy armour!
translation: 如果处理得当，这些生物的残骸可以用来制作优质的战斗护甲！

english: Of course, [Fremennik name]! Your presence is more than welcome on this cull! You wish to leave now?
translation: 当然，[Fremennik name]！欢迎你来参加这次狩猎！你现在想离开吗？

english: Player is transported to Waterbirth Island
translation: 玩家被传送至水birth 岛

english: Aye, that it is [Fremennik name]! Skulgrimen fashioned it for me from the carcass of one of the monsters on Waterbirth Island after our last hunt!
translation: 是的，确实是 [Fremennik name]！上次狩猎后斯库尔格里门用水birth 岛上一只怪物的尸骸为我打造了它！

english: I hope to kill enough creatures to fashion some fine armour as well when next we leave!
translation: 我希望下次离开时也能杀足够多的怪物来制作一些好护甲！

english: I picked up this, I was wondering if you could tell me about it...
translation: 我捡到了这个，我在想你能不能和我说说它的事……

english: Ah yes... The dagger-mouths' skin makes a good basis for many types of armour!
translation: 啊是的……匕首口的皮是许多类型护甲的良好基础！

english: Skulgrimen has made many sturdy helms from shells like that!
translation: 斯库尔格里门用那样的壳制作了许多坚固的头盔！

english: Skulgrimen once made a fine set of body armour from that kind of shell!
translation: 斯库尔格里门曾经用那种壳制作了一套精美的身体护甲！

english: Aha! That could be made into some fine leg armour by Skulgrimen, I'll wager!
translation: 啊哈！我打赌那可以被斯库尔格里门做成一些好的腿部护甲！

english: Hmmmm... I believe Peer could make a fine seers helm with that...
translation: 嗯……我相信皮尔可以用那个制作一个精美的先知头盔……

english: Many moons past, Peer had some fine bodyarmour made from just such bones.
translation: 许多月前，皮尔用正是这样的骨头制作了一些精美的身体护甲。

english: Peer could use that to make some mighty robes, I'll wager.
translation: 我打赌皮尔可以用那个制作一些强大的长袍。

english: Sigli might be able to make you some sturdy headgear with that!
translation: 西格利也许能用那个为你制作一些坚固的头饰！

english: That could make a fine piece of hunting armour, if I know Sigli like I think I do.
translation: 如果我对西格利的了解没错，那可以做成一件不错的狩猎护甲。

english: I'll wager Sigli can make that into some hunting legs for you.
translation: 我打赌西格利能把它做成一些狩猎腿甲给你。

english: Ah, it is always a pleasure [Fremennik name]! Now did you want something more from me?
translation: 啊，总是很愉快 [Fremennik name]！现在你还想要我什么吗？

english: Actually, I don't think I have anything to speak to you about...
translation: 其实，我想我没什么跟你说的……

english: Ah, [Fremennik name]! Such glorious battle makes you feel glad of life, does it not?
translation: 啊，[Fremennik name]！如此光荣的战斗让你感到生命的美好，不是吗？

english: So what say you, stay here for the hunt, or return home to sweet Rellekka to feast and drink with your tribe?
translation: 那么你怎么说，留在这里狩猎，还是回家去甜蜜的雷勒克卡与你的部落 feast 和喝酒？

english: Player is transported to Rellekka
translation: 玩家被传送至雷勒克卡

english: Thank you, but I have no need for that!
translation: 谢谢，但我不需要那个！

english: Forgive me exile, though I can't allow you to board my ship.
translation: 原谅我流亡者，但我不能让你上我的船。

english: Please Jarvald, it's really important!
translation: 求你了贾瓦尔德，这真的很重要！

english: Very well... for old times sake.
translation: 好吧……看在旧时光的份上。

english: Fair enough.
translation: 好吧。

english: I shouldn't do this... but for old times sake.
translation: 我不该这样做……但看在旧时光的份上。

english: Do you wish to return to Rellekka?
translation: 你想回雷勒克卡城吗？

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Very well, but do make sure you're not spotted leaving my ship.
translation: 好吧，但确保你离开我的船时没被发现。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Quickly [Fremennik name]. Once you arrive, leave my ship and make sure you're not spotted!
translation: 快点 [Fremennik name]。一旦到达，离开我的船并确保没被发现！

english: Where is your chieftain?
translation: 你的酋长在哪？

english: What Jarvald is doing.
translation: 贾瓦尔德在做什么。

english: Waterbirth Island?
translation: 水birth 岛？

english: Can I come?
translation: 我能来吗？

english: YES
translation: 是

english: NO
translation: 否

english: Nice hat!
translation: 好帽子！

english: Ok, 'bye.
translation: 好的，再见。

english: Nothing
translation: 没什么

english: I wish to return to Rellekka.
translation: 我想回雷勒克卡城。

english: I want to stay here.
translation: 我想留在这里。

english: The animal parts you have collected
translation: 你收集的动物部件

english: Please Jarvald, it's really important!
translation: 求你了贾瓦尔德，这真的很重要！

english: Fair enough.
translation: 好吧。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Got anything shiny I can swipe?
translation: 有什么闪亮的东西我可以顺手牵羊吗？

english: If I did, do you think I'd tell you so that you could then swipe it?
translation: 如果我有，你觉得我会告诉你让你顺手牵羊吗？

english: You make a fair point.
translation: 你说得有道理。

english: Hello, how can I help you?
translation: 你好，我能怎么帮你？

english: You can't; I'm beyond help.
translation: 你不能；我没救了。

english: I'm okay, thank you.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

english: What are you selling?
translation: 你在卖什么？

english: You can't; I'm beyond help.
translation: 你不能；我没救了。

english: I'm okay, thank you.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Nilsal.
translation: 你好。

english: Can you heal me? I'm injured.
translation: 你能治疗我吗？我受伤了。

english: Of course.
translation: 当然。

english: The teoki whispers a prayer and you suddenly feel a bit better.
translation: 特奥基低声祈祷，你突然感觉好点了。

english: What?
translation: 什么？

english: The egg that was living at the top of the temple!
translation: 住在神庙顶部的蛋！

english: Yes, I noticed the tourist had an egg with him... I didn't realise it had a name...
translation: 是的，我注意到那个游客带着一个蛋……我没意识到它有个名字……

english: We need to do something!
translation: 我们得做点什么！

english: Well... it's an egg, iknami. If it's broken, then there isn't much you can do about that.
translation: 嗯……它是个蛋，iknami。如果碎了，那你也没什么能做的。

english: I'm not giving up without at least trying first.
translation: 我不尝试至少一次不会放弃。

english: I see... Well, I don't think I can help you, iknami, but good luck.
translation: 我明白了……嗯，我想我帮不了你，iknami，但祝你好运。

english: What are you doing out here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: I am Jatziri, one of the seven teoki in service to Ralos. Along with my counterpart from the Sect of Ranul, I am responsible for the temple of Tal Teok.
translation: 我是贾齐里，服务于拉洛斯的七个特奥基之一。我和来自拉努尔教派的对应者一起，负责塔尔特奥克神庙。

english: Where is your counterpart?
translation: 你的对应者在哪？

english: Tecuani was unfortunately misled by the traitor Metzli. He joined with her cult along with a few other members of the Sect of Ranul.
translation: 特库瓦尼不幸被叛徒梅茨利误导。他和拉努尔教派的其他一些成员加入了她的邪教。

english: I'm sorry to hear that.
translation: 听到那个我很难过。

english: Don't be. He is no servant of Ranul. He will die the death of a traitor. Once that happens, a more fitting replacement will be chosen.
translation: 别难过。他不是拉努尔的仆人。他会像叛徒一样死去。一旦那样发生，会选一个更合适的替代者。

english: So for now you're here alone? Does that make the work harder?
translation: 所以你现在独自在这里？那会让工作更难吗？

english: Tal Teok is thankfully one of the easier holy sites to look after. That said, there was a small issue recently when some tourist decided to move in and make it their home.
translation: 谢天谢地塔尔特奥克是更容易照看的圣地之一。也就是说，最近有个小问题，某个游客决定搬进来把它当家。

english: I'll need to handle that at some point, but they don't seem to be causing much trouble, so it is thankfully not a pressing concern.
translation: 我需要在某个时候处理那个，但他们似乎没惹太多麻烦，所以谢天谢地不是紧迫问题。

english: However, the problem resolved itself in an unexpected way when he sadly fell from atop the temple steps. It seems it was a freak accident.
translation: 然而，问题以意想不到的方式解决了，当他不幸从神庙台阶顶部摔下来时。似乎是个意外事故。

english: Yes, I was actually there to witness it myself. It was horrible.
translation: 是的，我实际上在那里亲眼目睹了。很可怕。

english: Let us hope he can at least now find peace with Ranul.
translation: 让我们希望他现在至少能和拉努尔找到和平。

english: Tal Teok is thankfully one of the easier holy sites to look after. However, there is a small issue at the moment in that some tourist has decided to move in and make it their home.
translation: 谢天谢地塔尔特奥克是更容易照看的圣地之一。然而，目前有个小问题，某个游客决定搬进来把它当家。

english: Yes, along with his egg, [egg name], but there's a bit of a problem! [Egg name]'s broken!
translation: 是的，连同他的蛋，[egg name]，但有点问题！[Egg name] 碎了！

english: I'd better be off.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: Timoiva, and may the sun light your way.
translation: 再见，愿阳光照亮你的路。

english: Can you heal me? I'm injured.
translation: 你能治疗我吗？我受伤了。

english: [Egg name] fell off a wall!
translation: [Egg name] 从墙上摔下来了！

english: What are you doing out here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: I'd better be off.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: Hello there. What are you doing here?
translation: 你好。你在这里做什么？

english: I'm waiting here hoping that someone can guide me to the Paterdomus, the temple on the Salve.
translation: 我在这里等，希望有人能引导我去帕特多穆斯，萨鲁夫上的神庙。

english: Where is Paterdomus?
translation: 帕特多穆斯在哪？

english: Oh, Paterdomus is that rather impressive looking temple on the Salve... I'm sure you must have passed it on your way into Morytania.
translation: 哦，帕特多穆斯是萨鲁夫上那个相当令人印象深刻的神庙……我相信你进入摩利亚时一定经过它。
