english: Sorry, can't stop, the Captain will have my guts for garters if he catches me slacking off talking to the stowaway.
translation: 不能再聊了，要是船长发现我在偷懒跟偷渡客聊天，会把我大卸八块的！

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard!
translation: 我不是偷渡客！我是被邀请上船的！

english: Yeah, whatever [guy/lady], it doesn't really matter who you are I'll get in trouble!
translation: 随便啦 [guy/lady]，不管你是谁，反正我都会惹上麻烦！

english: You know, I've always wondered what life as a pirate actually entails.
translation: 你知道吗，我一直想知道海盗生活到底是怎样的。

english: Well, at the moment it mostly involves being asked random questions by a stowaway.
translation: 嗯，目前主要是被一个偷渡客问各种问题。

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard! By Lokar! Ask him!
translation: 我不是偷渡客！我是被邀请上船的！洛卡尔邀请的！你问他！

english: Hey, whatever [love/pal]. Just make sure the captain doesn't catch you, pirates don't like stowaways much.
translation: 随便啦 [love/pal]。只要别让船长抓到你就行，海盗都不太喜欢偷渡客。

english: Ah, good day to you [milady/sirrah]! Your face is unfamiliar, did you perhaps join us aboard the ship at Lunar Isle?
translation: 你好 [milady/sirrah]！你的面孔很陌生，你该不会是在月亮岛登上我们船的吧？

english: No, Lokar offered me a lift in Rellekka actually.
translation: 不，其实是洛卡尔在雷勒克卡城让我搭的便船。

english: Oh, really? You don't look like a Fremennik to me!
translation: 真的吗？但你看起来不像费明尼克人啊！

english: Well... I kind of am, and I kind of aren't. It's a long story.
translation: 这个嘛……我算是，也不算吧。说来话长。

english: Sorry I don't have time to hear it then! See you around young fremennik-who-is-not-really-a-fremennik!
translation: 那抱歉我没时间听了！回头见啦，你这个不算真正费明尼克的年轻人！

english: 'Bye.
translation: 再见。

english: Brrrr! Its cold up here!
translation: 嘶！上面好冷！

english: You think this is cold? Up by Acheron it gets so cold that when you talk you see the words freeze in the air in front of you!
translation: 你觉得这算冷？在阿刻戎那边，冷到你连说出的话语都能冻在空中！

english: REALLY?
translation: 真的吗？

english: Nah, not really. I was exaggerating for humourous effect. It is very very cold though!
translation: 哈，当然不是真的。我只是为了搞笑夸张了一下。不过那里确实非常非常冷！

english: Hello to you too.
translation: 也向你问好。

english: Yar! We be pirates, yar! Avast, ye scurvy land-lubbing lychee!
translation: 呀！我们是海盗！停下，你这个可怜的旱鸭子荔枝 (羞辱性称呼)！

english: Please don't talk like that, it is extremely irritating.
translation: 请不要那样说话，这很令人討厌的。

english: Also, please don't call me a lychee, whatever that may be.
translation: 还有你别叫我荔枝 (羞辱性称呼)，不管那是什么。

english: Oh. Okay. Sorry.
translation: 好的，抱歉。

english: ARGH! SOUND THE ALARM! STOWAWAY ON BOARD! STOWAWAY ON BOARD!
translation: 啊！拉警报！船上有偷渡客！船上有偷渡客！

english: No! I'm not a stowaway! Honest! I was invited here!
translation: 我不是偷渡客，真的！我是被邀请来的！

english: Oh, sorry, my mistake then.
translation: 抱歉，那我弄错了。

english: You must admit you do look a lot like a stowaway though.
translation: 不过你得承认，你看起来确实很像偷渡客。

english: Why, what do they usually look like?
translation: 那他们通常长什么样？

english: Erm... I've never actually met one...
translation: 呃……其实我从没见过真正的偷渡客……

english: Okay then...
translation: 那好吧……

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: So... You're a pirate, huh?
translation: 那么……你是海盗，对吧？

english: It's what it says on my pay-packet at the end of the month.
translation: 我月底工资单上就这么写的。

english: How's that working out for you?
translation: 干得怎么样？

english: Pretty good so far. All the grog and loot that we can plunder, plus full medical including dental.
translation: 到目前为止还不错。有喝不完的格罗格酒和抢不完的战利品，甚至还有全套医疗保障，包括牙科。

english: You mean you have insurance?
translation: 你是说有保险？

english: Not as such. If any of us get sick we kidnap a doctor and don't let him go until we're better.
translation: 倒也不是。要是我们谁生病了，就绑架个医生，直到我们康复才放他走。

english: You'd be surprised what an incentive for expert health care that is.
translation: 说出来你可能不信，这可是让医疗水准提升的一大动力。

english: I can imagine.
translation: 这倒不难想象。

english: Hello there. So what brings you aboard the Lady Zay?
translation: 你好啊，是什么风把你吹上赛夫人号的？

english: Well, I was planning on visiting the Moon Clan, but I have to say your ship is very impressive.
translation: 我本来打算去拜访月氏族，但不得不说你们的船令人印象深刻。

english: Aye, she's a beauty alright! The Lady Zay has been my home for many hard months, through storm and sun, and she always gets us to here we were headed!
translation: 是啊，她确实是个美人！赛夫人号作为我的家陪伴我度过了许多艰苦岁月，风雨无阻，她总是能把我们送到目的地！

english: Yes, she's certainly one of the finest boats I've seen on my travels!
translation: 是的，她确实是我旅行中见过的最棒的船之一！

english: That she is [lad/lass], that she is.
translation: 确实是啊 [lad/lass]。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: How's it going?
translation: 怎么样？

english: Good thanks. Just passing by.
translation: 很好谢谢。只是路过。

english: Please excuse me, I'm rather busy.
translation: 请原谅我，我相当忙。

english: Hey, I'm your contractor from Mahogany Homes, what did you want done?
translation: 嘿，我是桃花心木之家的承包商，你想做什么？

english: I'd like two Wooden drawers built.
translation: 我想建造两个木抽屉柜。

english: I'd like two Wooden cabinets built.
translation: 我想建造两个木柜子。

english: I'd like a Wooden bed built.
translation: 我想建造一个木床。

english: I'd like a Wooden table built.
translation: 我想建造一个木桌。

english: I'd like my clock fixed.
translation: 我想修我的钟。

english: I'd like my bath fixed.
translation: 我想修我的浴缸。

english: I'd like two Oak drawers built.
translation: 我想建造两个橡木抽屉柜。

english: I'd like two Oak cabinets built.
translation: 我想建造两个橡木柜子。

english: I'd like a Oak bed built.
translation: 我想建造一个橡木床。

english: I'd like a Oak table built.
translation: 我想建造一个橡木桌。

english: I'd like two Teak drawers built.
translation: 我想建造两个柚木抽屉柜。

english: I'd like two Teak cabinets built.
translation: 我想建造两个柚木柜子。

english: I'd like a Teak bed built.
translation: 我想建造一个柚木床。

english: I'd like a Teak table built.
translation: 我想建造一个柚木桌。

english: I'd like two Mahogany drawers built.
translation: 我想建造两个桃花心木抽屉柜。

english: I'd like two Mahogany cabinets built.
translation: 我想建造两个桃花心木柜子。

english: I'd like a Mahogany bed built.
translation: 我想建造一个桃花心木床。

english: I'd like a Mahogany table built.
translation: 我想建造一个桃花心木桌。

english: I've finished with the work you wanted.
translation: 我已经完成了你想要的工作。

english: Thank you so much! Would you like a cup of tea before you go?
translation: 非常感谢！你走前想喝杯茶吗？

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
translation: 是的，我想喝杯茶。

english: No thanks, I better be off.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我最好走了。

english: Aaah, nothing like a nice cupppa tea!
translation: 啊，没什么比得上一杯好茶！

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
translation: 是的，我想喝杯茶。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Hey kid, what's all the shouting about?
translation: 嘿孩子，吵什么呢？

english: Christmas is ruined!
translation: 圣诞节毁了！

english: Again? What's happened this time?
translation: 又？这次发生了什么事？

english: The man in the shop won't give us our Gingerbread Gnomes, he's keeping them for himself.
translation: 店里的人不给我们姜饼地精，他自己留着。

english: That doesn't sound right, are you sure that's really what he's doing?
translation: 那听起来不对，你确定他真那样做？

english: Of course he is, why else won't he give us any?
translation: 当然是，否则为什么不给我们？

english: Something seems off, maybe I should go talk to Santa to find out what's happened.
translation: 有些事不对，也许我该去跟圣诞老人谈谈发生了什么。

english: Do whatever you want, I want my Gingerbread Gnomes!
translation: 随你便，我要我的姜饼地精！

english: Where are our Gingerbread Gnomes!
translation: 我们的姜饼地精在哪！

english: I'm working on it, I'm working on it.
translation: 我在做，我在做。

english: Hurry up!
translation: 快点！

english: You've ruined Christmas!
translation: 你毁了圣诞节！

english: Give us the Gnomes!
translation: 把姜饼地精给我们！

english: Why are you still here? I saved Christmas, you can go home.
translation: 你为什么还在这里？我救了圣诞节，你可以回家了。

english: We still have to wait for the delivery to come in, dummy.
translation: 我们还得等送货进来，傻瓜。

english: I'll leave you to it then.
translation: 那我不打扰你了。

english: Christmas is Saved!
translation: 圣诞节得救了！

english: Hurry up with the delivery!
translation: 快点送货！

english: Nilsal, [player name]. How are things going?
translation: 你好，[player name]。怎么样？

english: Pretty good, thanks. How about you? Made any more discoveries down here?
translation: 挺好的，谢谢。你呢？在这里有什么新发现吗？

english: More than you can count! I've found so much new information on the Old Ones and naguanil. The museum are hoping to include it all in some new exhibits soon!
translation: 多到数不清！我发现了太多关于古老者和那伽的新信息。博物馆希望很快把它们纳入一些新展览！

english: Sounds awesome! I'll be sure to keep an eye out for them. On that note, I'll let you get back to it.
translation: 听起来很棒！我一定会留意它们。就此而言，我不打扰你了。

english: Nilsal, [player name]. There were a pair of strange people poking around earlier. That nagua had to come and scare them off.
translation: 你好，[player name]。早前有一对奇怪的人在附近探头探脑。那个那伽不得不来把他们吓跑。

english: Yes, I know about them. Don't worry, I'll make sure they don't cause any more problems.
translation: 是的，我知道他们。别担心，我会确保他们不再惹麻烦。

english: Glad to hear it. I'd hate for them to go damaging something around here!
translation: 很高兴听到那个。我讨厌他们在这里损坏什么东西！

english: Hello friend.
translation: 你好朋友。

english: Hello, what are you doing here?
translation: 你好，你在这里做什么？

english: My name is Jessie. I help look after the forest.
translation: 我叫杰西。我帮忙照看森林。

english: Nice to meet you. You must know this area very well then.
translation: 很高兴认识你。那你一定很熟悉这个区域。

english: I do. There're all sorts of interesting creatures around here. Be careful, some of them are not very friendly. A lot of travellers have become their victims.
translation: 我是。这附近有各种有趣的生物。小心，其中一些不太友好。许多旅行者成了它们的受害者。

english: I see. Thanks for the warning.
translation: 我明白了。谢谢警告。

english: No problem! Safe travels my friend.
translation: 没问题！旅途平安我的朋友。

english: Hello, I don't recognise you. We don't get many newcomers around here.
translation: 你好，我不认识你。我们这里不常来新人。

english: I'm surprised you're still here. Not many like to stick around this place if they have the choice.
translation: 我很惊讶你还在这里。如果有选择，没多少人喜欢待在这个地方。

english: Good to see you friend.
translation: 很高兴见到你，朋友。

english: Hey Jethick, how's things?
translation: 嘿杰西克，怎么样？

english: Not bad, the city is still a mess but we've finally got the chance to change that now the mourners have gone.
translation: 不错，城市还是一团糟但现在哀悼者走了我们终于有机会改变。

english: Good to hear, all the best.
translation: 很高兴听到，祝一切顺利。

english: Let's see if you have what it takes to answer this question.
translation: 让我们看看你有没有能力回答这个问题。

english: What question?
translation: 什么问题？

english: The one on this scroll.
translation: 这个卷轴上的。

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
translation: 请输入问题的答案。

english: Not even close!
translation: 差得远！

english: Spot on!
translation: 完全正确！

english: Jethick has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
translation: 杰西克给了你 [another clue scroll/a casket]！

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Hello there. Welcome to the Temple of the Lesser Gods.
translation: 你好。欢迎来到次级神神庙。

english: Could you tell me more about the lesser gods?
translation: 你能多告诉我些关于次级神的事吗？

english: Of course. The lesser gods, or avatars as some call them, were born from the dreams of Tumeken. They are Apmeken, Het, Crondis and Scabaras.
translation: 当然。次级神，或有些人称之为化身，生于图梅肯的梦境。他们是阿普梅肯、赫特、克伦迪斯和斯卡巴拉斯。

english: Could you tell me more about Apmeken?
translation: 你能多告诉我些关于阿普梅肯的事吗？

english: Apmeken is the goddess of companionship. She is known to be the most mischievous, playful and unpredictable of the minor deities. I'd say she's my personal favourite.
translation: 阿普梅肯是陪伴女神。她被认为是小神中最淘气、好玩和不可预测的。我会说她是我的个人最爱。

english: So I shouldn't trust you then?
translation: 那我不该信任你？

english: Apmeken can appeal to the most erudite scholar or the most barefaced liar. I'd like to be considered amongst the former category.
translation: 阿普梅肯能吸引最博学的学者或最厚颜无耻的骗子。我想我被归为前者。

english: I see. What does she look like?
translation: 我明白了。她长什么样？

english: She has the head of a monkey, or sometimes an ape. It changes depending upon what nature she is displaying. For example, the orangutan represents wisdom, while the baboon represents mischief.
translation: 她有猴子的头，有时是猿。这取决于她展示什么本性。例如，红毛猩猩代表智慧，而狒狒代表恶作剧。

english: Could you tell me more about Het?
translation: 你能多告诉我些关于赫特的事吗？

english: Het is the least strange of our deities to foreign eyes, for he looks just like us. I suspect this is why his shrines are particularly targeted by thieves like that infamous Templeton.
translation: 赫特对外国眼睛来说是我们神祇中最不奇怪的，因为他看起来就像我们。我怀疑这就是为什么他的神龛特别成为像那个臭名昭著的坦普尔顿这样的盗贼的目标。

english: What does he represent?
translation: 他代表什么？

english: Het is the god of health, both in mind and body. He is quite popular amongst soldiers as a result, especially up in Al Kharid.
translation: 赫特是健康之神，身心皆然。因此他在士兵中相当受欢迎，尤其是在阿尔卡里德城。

english: Just soldiers?
translation: 只是士兵？

english: Not at all! Like I said, the wellbeing of the mind is also key to Het. Many great orators also look to him for guidance. I imagine his teachings help with some of their strenuous speeches.
translation: 完全不！像我说的，心理健康也是赫特的关键。许多伟大的演说家也寻求他的指引。我想他的教导有助于他们的一些费力演讲。

english: How did his followers react to the plagues here?
translation: 他的追随者对这里的瘟疫反应如何？

english: With many arguments. They really couldn't decide whether it was a punishment from Het, or an affront to him. I stayed out of that debate.
translation: 许多争论。他们真的无法决定那是赫特的惩罚还是对他的冒犯。我没参与那场辩论。

english: Could you tell me more about Crondis?
translation: 你能多告诉我些关于克伦迪斯的事吗？

english: Crondis is a ferocious lady with the head of a mighty crocodile.
translation: 克伦迪斯是个凶猛的女士，有着强大鳄鱼的头。

english: That must be awkward when buying helmets.
translation: 那买头盔时一定很尴尬。

english: Luckily for her, I don't think deities have much need for them.
translation: 对她来说幸运，我想神祇不太需要它们。

english: So what is she the goddess of?
translation: 那她是女神什么？

english: Resourcefulness. A word which seems to be open to large interpretation.
translation: 足智多谋。一个似乎开放给大量解释的词。

english: How so?
translation: 怎么说？

english: Most consider her to be a teacher of modesty. They say we should be resourceful by only taking and using that which we absolutely need.
translation: 大多数人认为她是节制的老师。他们说我们应该足智多谋，只拿和使用我们绝对需要的。

english: But there's others with a different interpretation?
translation: 但其他人有不同解释？

english: Some believe she is actually the goddess of pleasure. They claim that the idea of modesty came from a misinterpretation, and that to be resourceful is to take all that you can.
translation: 有些人相信她其实是快乐女神。他们声称节制的想法来自误解，而足智多谋是拿走你能拿的所有。

english: That doesn't sound right.
translation: 那听起来不对。

english: No. It is a more recent take that I suspect was born in Menaphos. There are many in that city with more wealth than they'll ever need. Modesty is not an ideal they'll ever embody.
translation: 不。那是更近期的看法，我怀疑生于梅纳菲斯。那城市里有许多人拥有比他们需要的更多财富。节制不是他们会体现的理想。

english: Could you tell me more about Scabaras?
translation: 你能多告诉我些关于斯卡巴拉斯的事吗？

english: There are many opinions out there on Scabaras, but general knowledge isn't always the most accurate.
translation: 关于斯卡巴拉斯有许多意见，但常识并不总是最准确的。

english: Well what are the absolute facts then?
translation: 那绝对事实是什么？

english: Scabaras is the god of isolation. He takes on the appearance of a man with the head of a scarab. Both he and his followers were driven into hiding long ago.
translation: 斯卡巴拉斯是孤立之神。他呈现为有圣甲虫头的人。他和他的追随者很久以前就被迫隐藏。

english: And?
translation: 然后？

english: And that's it. You asked for the absolute facts. Anything beyond that is just speculation.
translation: 就这些。你问了绝对事实。超出那只是推测。

english: But there must be more. The High Priest told me that Scabaras tried to conquer these lands.
translation: 但一定有更多。大祭司告诉我斯卡巴拉斯试图征服这片土地。

english: So it is said, but the written accounts that exist contain many inconsistencies when it comes to what role Scabaras actually played. Of course, most would not know that.
translation: 据说是，但存在的书面记录在斯卡巴拉斯实际扮演什么角色方面包含许多不一致。当然，大多数人不知道。

english: How come?
translation: 为什么？

english: Many of the writings are only available to us priests. That does of course include the new High Priest, but perhaps he is yet to read them. They are definitely... illuminating.
translation: 许多著作只对我们祭司可用。那当然包括新大祭司，但也许他还没读它们。它们肯定是……启发性的。

english: Interesting...
translation: 有趣……

english: Interesting. Thanks for the information.
translation: 有趣。谢谢你的信息。

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: Hey! You don't have permission to go down there.
translation: 嘿！你没许可去下面。

english: Could you tell me more about the lesser gods?
translation: 你能多告诉我些关于次级神的事吗？

english: Could you tell me more about Apmeken?
translation: 你能多告诉我些关于阿普梅肯的事吗？

english: Could you tell me more about Het?
translation: 你能多告诉我些关于赫特的事吗？

english: Could you tell me more about Crondis?
translation: 你能多告诉我些关于克伦迪斯的事吗？

english: Could you tell me more about Scabaras?
translation: 你能多告诉我些关于斯卡巴拉斯的事吗？

english: Interesting. Thanks for the information.
translation: 有趣。谢谢你的信息。

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: Hello there. Who are you?
translation: 你好。你是谁？

english: Mum says I not to talk to strangers.
translation: 妈妈说我不跟陌生人说话。

english: That's pretty good advice!
translation: 那是很好的建议！

english: So I's can't says my name is Jill.
translation: 所以我不能说我叫吉尔。

english: Okay then.
translation: 那好吧。

english: We's be new here, on the bana plantion.
translation: 我们是新来的，在这个香蕉种植园。

english: You mean banana plantation.
translation: 你是说香蕉种植园。

english: Yeah, we's be new here. Anyway, I gonna go play now.
translation: 是的，我们是新来的。总之，我现在要去玩了。

english: Jill!
translation: 吉尔！

english: Oh, 'Jill', that's a lovely name.
translation: 哦，‘吉尔’，那是个好名字。

english: Yes, that's me.
translation: 是的，那是我。

english: We play here.
translation: 我们在这里玩。

english: That must be fun.
translation: 那一定很有趣。

english: Yeah, it's fun. Bye.
translation: 是的，很有趣。再见。

english: No, I not say. You have to guess.
translation: 不，我不说。你得猜。

english: Okay. Is it Jill?
translation: 好的。是吉尔吗？

english: How d'ya know that? Are you magic?
translation: 你怎么知道的？你是魔法吗？

english: Not really - just call it a gift.
translation: 不算——就叫它天赋吧。

english: If you were magic, you would know why the sea is blue... are you magic?
translation: 如果你是魔法，你会知道为什么海是蓝的……你是魔法吗？

english: Nope, I'm not magic, and I have no clue why the sea is blue.
translation: 不，我不是魔法，我也不知道为什么海是蓝的。

english: Oh, well. That's a bit sad. I was hoping you were magic and could magic me some sweets. But you can't, so I go find someone else who's magic. Bye.
translation: 哦，好吧。那有点伤心。我希望你是魔法能变些糖果给我。但你不能，所以我去找别的会魔法的人。再见。

english: Thanks so much for saving us from those stinky gublinch. They were awful! I hope Shanty gave you somefingcool for your efforts.
translation: 非常感谢你救我们脱离那些臭烘烘的哥布林奇。它们太可怕了！我希望尚蒂给了你些酷东西作为努力报酬。

english: Hello?
translation: 你好？

english: Ah... Another wayward traveller.
translation: 啊……又一个任性的旅行者。

english: Excuse me?
translation: 打扰一下？

english: You are not the first to make your way down here. Undoubtedly, you will not be the last.
translation: 你不是第一个来到这里的人。毫无疑问，你也不会是最后一个。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: My aeternal name, given to me long ago, is Jimp.
translation: 我的永恒之名，很久以前给的，是金普。

english: Jimp the imp?
translation: 小恶魔金普？

english: Yes, though my many centuries upon this realm have taught me that the newer tongues struggle with its pronounciation.
translation: 是的，虽然我在这个领域待了许多世纪，教会了我新语言很难发音。

english: So you may call me Jim.
translation: 所以你可以叫我吉姆。

english: Okay...
translation: 好的……

english: I see you still have questions. Before I answer them, I will need you to swear to secrecy.
translation: 我看你还有问题。在我回答之前，我需要你发誓保密。

english: Hang on... why would I do that?
translation: 等等……我为什么要那样做？

english: I believe you will find my cooperation helpful. Perhaps I shall find yours helpful one day too.
translation: 我相信你会发现我的合作有帮助。也许有一天我也会发现你的有帮助。

english: I've already entered one dubious contract.
translation: 我已经签了一个可疑的合同。

english: I'm not sure I should be signing any others.
translation: 我不确定我该签其他的。

english: You will find the nature of my contracts refreshing, then. My terms are simple: do not endanger me or take what is mine, and I shall do what I can to help you.
translation: 那你会发现我的合同性质令人耳目一新。我的条款很简单：不要危害我或拿走我的东西，我会尽力帮你。

english: Okay then, why not.
translation: 好吧，为什么不呢。

english: Excellent. It is a pleasure to make your acquaintance, [player name].
translation: 太好了。很高兴认识你，[player name]。

english: Wait, how do you know my name? Was this a trick?
translation: 等等，你怎么知道我的名字？这是个 trick 吗？

english: No, friend, you signed it right here.
translation: 不，朋友，你刚在这里签了。

english: Oh, right.
translation: 哦，好的。

english: Who are you really?
translation: 你到底是谁？

english: I suppose since you already know my name, you are asking who I am in the context of history and society.
translation: 我想既然你已经知道我的名字，你是在问我在历史和社会背景下的身份。

english: Yes, let's go with that.
translation: 是的，就那个吧。

english: I am afraid other agreements bar me from telling you much of my past. Nowadays, I am a humble servant of Yama, existing only to do as he pleases.
translation: 恐怕其他协议禁止我告诉你太多我的过去。如今，我是阎魔的卑微仆人，存在只为随他高兴。

english: And what is that?
translation: 那是什么？

english: Mostly fetching records, and dying. When I am not doing that, I rest here. The features of this isle remind me of those I once knew.
translation: 主要是取记录，然后死。我不做那些时，就在这里休息。这个岛的地形让我想起我曾经认识的那些。

english: Who do you mean by 'those'?
translation: 你说的“那些”是指谁？

english: I already skirt as closely as I can to what I am disallowed from sharing. I apologise, but I cannot answer further.
translation: 我已经尽量贴近我被禁止分享的内容了。我道歉，但我不能进一步回答。

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: This isle is a small wonder. The rock formations here bear a slight resemblance to those from my own realm.
translation: 这个岛是个小奇迹。这里的岩层与我 own 领域的略有相似。

english: The rock looks like it's crumbling.
translation: 岩石看起来像在崩塌。

english: Yes, infernal shale is kept together largely by the pressure from above. Once a piece is broken off, it can easily be broken down with a hammer and chisel.
translation: 是的，地狱页岩主要靠上方的压力保持在一起。一旦一块断裂，它很容易用锤子和凿子敲碎。

english: That's good to know. What about the smithy?
translation: 那很好知道。那铁匠铺呢？

english: I can say nothing more than that it was not here when I arrived.
translation: 我只能说它在我到达时不在这里。

english: So you brought it here?
translation: 所以你把它带到这里？

english: I cannot say.
translation: 我不能说。

english: It's rather hot here.
translation: 这里相当热。

english: Yes, the unique composition of this chasm does create a warm environment.
translation: 是的，这个裂缝的独特成分确实创造了温暖的环境。

english: I can see my sweat turning to vapour as soon as it appears.
translation: 我可以看到我的汗水一出现就变成蒸汽。

english: Yes, water is an ineffective coolant at this temperature. Perhaps I could offer an alternative.
translation: 是的，水在这个温度下是无效的冷却剂。也许我可以提供替代方案。

english: That would be handy.
translation: 那会很有用。

english: The liquid will only offer a brief respite from the heat, but I find it can help to apply it frequently between bursts of exertion.
translation: 液体只能提供短暂的避暑，但我发现它在努力间隙频繁涂抹会有帮助。

english: I see, thanks. I'll give that a try.
translation: 我明白了，谢谢。我会试试。

english: I can see you eyeing the liquid. It is best you do not ask.
translation: 我看到你在盯着液体。最好你别问。

english: Have another cloth. Remember, it only offers a brief respite from the heat. You'll want to time bursts of exertion right after using it.
translation: 再拿块布。记住，它只提供短暂的避暑。你想在使用后紧接着努力。

english: Why is there a smithy down here?
translation: 为什么下面有个铁匠铺？

english: I cannot speak to the purpose the smithy has, but I might be able to shed some light on the purposes it could be given.
translation: 我不能说铁匠铺的目的，但我也许能说明它可能被赋予的用途。

english: Go on.
translation: 继续。

english: The furnace is capable of extremely high temperatures. Whilst not very helpful for your ores, it can melt metal from our realm.
translation: 熔炉能达到极高温度。虽然对你的矿石不太有用，但能熔化我们领域的金属。

english: Like the rocks on this isle?
translation: 像这个岛上的岩石？

english: Not quite, though they are necessary to power the furnace. Nobody but Yama has access to the kinds of ores it was designed for.
translation: 不完全是，虽然它们是给熔炉供能所必需的。除了阎魔没人能接触到它设计的矿石。

english: But if I were to get my hands on some, I could work them here?
translation: 但如果我弄到一些，我可以在这里加工？

english: Yes. The process is quite involved. Smaller shards must be melted into nuggets for stability, and then combined into chunks.
translation: 是的。过程相当复杂。小碎片必须熔化成 nuggets 以稳定，然后结合成块。

english: I see. Maybe I can give that a go.
translation: 我明白了。也许我可以试试。

english: You're very friendly for a demon.
translation: 你作为恶魔很友好。

english: I am not alone in this amongst my kind, but I understand that I am rare. I have my reasons for being this way.
translation: 在我的同类中我不是唯一的，但我明白我很罕见。我有我这样的理由。

english: Well, if there is anything I can do for you, let me know.
translation: 嗯，如果有什么我能为你做的，告诉我。

english: Thank you. There is little I can ask of you given the nature of my other agreements, but watching you work on this isle does bring me some comfort.
translation: 谢谢。鉴于我其他协议的性质，我很少能要求你什么，但看着你在这个岛上工作确实给我带来些安慰。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Safe travels, [player name].
translation: 旅途平安，[player name]。

english: I've already entered one dubious contract.
translation: 我已经签了一个可疑的合同。

english: Okay then, why not.
translation: 好吧，为什么不呢。

english: Who are you really?
translation: 你到底是谁？

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: It's rather hot here.
translation: 这里相当热。

english: More options...
translation: 更多选项……

english: Why is there a smithy down here?
translation: 为什么下面有个铁匠铺？

english: You're very friendly for a demon.
translation: 你作为恶魔很友好。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Welcome to the Jungle Store. Can I help you at all?
translation: 欢迎来到丛林商店。我能帮你吗？

english: Yes please. What are you selling?
translation: 你在卖什么？

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Yes please. What are you selling
translation: 你在卖什么？

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: 'Ello there.
translation: 你好啊。

english: Tell me about this room?
translation: 跟我讲讲这个房间？

english: Well... s'like thish...
translation: 嗯……是这样的……

english: Thish here'sh a shtore room right?
translation: 这里是个储藏室对吧？

english: A store room you mean?
translation: 你是说储藏室？

english: That'sh what I shaid! *HIC* A shtore room.... Now technic'ly shpeaking, I should be outshide guarding it...
translation: 我就是那么说的！(嗝) 储藏室……现在技术上来说，我应该在外面守卫它……

english: But you just nipped in to have a quick drink?
translation: 但你只是溜进来快速喝一杯？

english: Yep... and to practish.
translation: 是的……还有练习。

english: Practish? I mean.. practise what?
translation: 练习？我是说……练习什么？

english: Keg balancin. I'm the besht.
translation: 酒桶平衡。我是最好的。

english: Tell me how to balance kegs?
translation: 告诉我怎么平衡酒桶？

english: Yer very very shtrange. But.... you pick the keg up, and balance it on yer head, then you pick another keg up and put that on top. S'really very eashy.
translation: 你非常非常奇怪。但是……你拿起酒桶，平衡在头上，然后拿起另一个酒桶放在上面。真的很容易。

english: Eashy?
translation: 容易？

english: Yesh. Eashy.
translation: 是的。容易。

english: But you couldn't ever balansh ash many ash meee!
translation: 但你永远不能平衡像我这么多！

english: That sounds like a challenge, I'll show you!
translation: 那听起来像挑战，我展示给你看！

english: May I claim my tokens please?
translation: 我可以领取我的令牌吗？

english: Wha'? You ain't earnt any mate!
translation: 什麼？你没赚任何令牌伙计！

english: Well... err.. ish not offishal or anyfin... but I got the ledger of tokensh 'ere. I'll jus' err.. write it in!
translation: 嗯……呃……不官方或什么的……但我这里有令牌账簿。我就……呃……写进去！

english: Won't they know?
translation: 他们不会知道？

english: Nah... hic.... I'm a wizsh at copyin' signaturesh! Jus' ashk an offishal mem'er of shtaff like Shloane fer yer tokensh.
translation: 不……(嗝)……我是模仿签名的专家！就问像斯洛恩这样的官方成员要你的令牌。

english: The rather drunk Jimmy scribbles the tokens you've earned from Keg Balancing in the Ledger so that you can claim them from an official member of training staff.
translation: 相当醉酒的吉姆在账簿上涂鸦你从酒桶平衡赚取的令牌，这样你可以从培训 staff 的官方成员那里领取。

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！

english: Shure you wouldn't like an ickle drinkie fore yer go?
translation: 确定你走前不想喝点小酒？

english: No thanks, got things to do, people to see, tokens to earn...
translation: 不用了谢谢，有事要做，有人要见，有令牌要赚……

english: Ya got no chance o' beatin' me [player name]!
translation: 你没机会打败我 [player name]！

english: No one's stronger than me, 'speshly not [player name]!
translation: 没人比我强，特别是 [player name]！

english: Wow! That'sh bery impr....imp...impresh.... good [player name]! Equalsh my record!
translation: 哇！那非常印……印……印象……好 [player name]！平了我的记录！

english: Tell me about this room.
translation: 跟我讲讲这个房间。

english: Tell me how to balance kegs.
translation: 告诉我怎么平衡酒桶。

english: May I claim my tokens please?
translation: 我可以领取我的令牌吗？

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！

english: Who are you, and what do you want?
translation: 你是谁，你想要什么？

english: My name is Dazaator, and I have a couple of questions for you.
translation: 我叫达扎托尔，我有几个问题问你。

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: What?
translation: 什么？

english: I don't know you, therefore I will not answer any questions. Now be gone from here, you're drawing attention.
translation: 我不认识你，因此我不会回答任何问题。现在离开这里，你在引起注意。

english: As if those clothes you're wearing wouldn't do that already.
translation: 好像你穿的衣服不会引起注意似的。

english: I can't see the bottom of the ladder. I think I'll leave it be, for now.
translation: 我看不到梯子底部。我想我还是别管它，暂时。

english: Ah, [player name]. Back for more intonation?
translation: 啊，[player name]。回来要更多语调？

english: Can you tell me where I can find Phingspet and Grimesquit?
translation: 你能告诉我在哪能找到芬格斯佩特和格里姆斯奎特吗？

english: They live in the sewers below Varrock.
translation: 他们住在维洛克城下面的下水道。

english: Please don't say hello from me.
translation: 请别代我问好。

english: Can you tell me where I can find Hooknosed Jack?
translation: 你能告诉我在哪能找到钩鼻杰克吗？

english: He hangs around in a rather unfashionable part of Varrock. He likes a good scrap, does Jack.
translation: 他在维洛克城一个相当不时髦的地方徘徊。杰克喜欢打架。

english: Can you tell me where I can find Smokin' Joe?
translation: 你能告诉我在哪能找到老烟枪‧乔吗？

english: If the old rascal's lungs haven't given up yet, you should find him in Keldagrim.
translation: 如果老流氓的肺还没放弃，你应该在凯尔达格林城找到他。

english: Can you tell me where I might find 'The Face'?
translation: 你能告诉我在哪可能找到“面孔”吗？

english: Port Sarim is your best bet.
translation: 沙林港是你最好的选择。

english: Can you tell me where I might find Felkrash?
translation: 你能告诉我在哪可能找到费尔克拉什吗？

english: The Boss?
translation: 老板？

english: You'll find her in Port Sarim, probably in the Rat Pits there.
translation: 你会在沙林港找到她，可能在那里的鼠坑。

english: She's your boss?
translation: 她是你的老板？

english: Well, sort of. She's the unofficial leader of the Ratcatchers.
translation: 嗯，算是吧。她是捕鼠者的非官方领袖。

english: Nobody elected her or anything.
translation: 没人选举她或什么的。

english: Got it. She's the boss.
translation: 明白了。她是老板。

english: Can you tell me more about the pits?
translation: 你能多告诉我些关于坑的事吗？

english: Here take this, you might find it useful.
translation: 给，拿着这个，你可能会发现有用。

english: What do you want to know?
translation: 你想了解什么？

english: Do you have any pointers for me and my cat?
translation: 你有什么给我和我的猫的建议吗？

english: You should wear an Amulet of Catspeak. It will allow you to organise tactics with your cat.
translation: 你应该戴上猫语护符，这样就能跟猫商量战术了。

english: What would be the best tactic to adopt then?
translation: 那最好采用什么战术？

english: Well, that depends on your outlook, whether you're ready to risk your cat's life or not and how defensive or aggressive you want your cat to be.
translation: 这得看你怎么想：愿不愿意让猫冒险，还有你想让它偏防御还是偏进攻。

english: I will not risk my cat's life.
translation: 我不会拿我猫的生命去冒险。

english: Well if that's the case then you're left with two choices.
translation: 嗯如果是那样那你还有两个选择。

english: You can adopt an ultra defensive strategy, which increases your cat's hitpoints and defence but causes it to flee sooner.
translation: 你可以采用超级防御策略，增加猫的生命值和防御但导致它更早逃跑。

english: Or you can adopt a less defensive strategy, which will allow your cat to stay in the pit for longer.
translation: 或者选偏防御策略，猫就能在坑里多待会儿。

english: I think I would adopt a very defensive strategy
translation: 我想我会采用非常防御策略

english: In that case you should tell your cat: 'Just take care of yourself, cat.'
translation: 那样的话你就跟猫说：'照顾好自己就行。'

english: Thanks for your help.
translation: 谢谢你的帮助。

english: Do you have any other questions about the pits?
translation: 你关于坑还有其他问题吗？

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: I think I would adopt a less defensive strategy.
translation: 我想我会采取不那么保守的策略。

english: In that case you should tell your cat: 'Stay in for as long as you can.'
translation: 那样的话你就跟猫说：'能待多久待多久。'

english: I am willing to risk my cat, if it increases my chances of victory.
translation: 我愿意冒猫的危险，如果它能增加我胜利的几率。

english: In that case you are left with two choices.
translation: 那样的话你还有两个选择。

english: You could go for all out attack which will boost your cat's attack and strength, but weaken it.
translation: 你可以选全力进攻，猫的攻击和力量会提升，但会更脆弱。

english: Or, go for a less aggressive stance, which will increase your cat's strength and attack to a lesser degree, but carries no defensive penalties.
translation: 或者选偏进攻姿态，猫的力量和攻击提升幅度小点，但不会降低防御。

english: I think I would adopt a very aggressive strategy.
translation: 我想我会采取非常激进的策略。

english: In that case you should tell your cat: 'Go berserk!'
translation: 那样的话你就跟猫说：'给我疯起来！'

english: I think I would adopt a less aggressive strategy.
translation: 我想我会采取不那么激进的策略。

english: In that case you should tell your cat: 'No guts, no glory!'
translation: 那样的话你就跟猫说：'不敢拼，哪有赢！'

english: What benefits does my cat get from training in the pits?
translation: 我的猫从坑里训练得到什么好处？

english: It depends on what kind of cat you have.
translation: 取决于你有什么样的猫。

english: In the Ardougne pits, your kitten will grow up faster whether it wins or loses.
translation: 在阿多尼坑，你的小猫无论输赢都会更快长大。

english: What if it wins then?
translation: 那如果它赢了？

english: It will gain more experience, it'll be happier, and it'll be fed, too.
translation: 它会获得更多经验，会更快乐，也会吃饱。

english: Can you show me to the Rat Pits?
translation: 你能带我去鼠坑吗？

english: See that ladder there? That's the way in.
translation: 看到那个梯子吗？那是入口。

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

english: Good luck!
translation: 祝你好运！

english: How do you spell your name again?
translation: 你怎么拼写你的名字？

english: J-I-M-M-Y D-A-Z-Z-L-E-R.
translation: J-I-M-M-Y D-A-Z-Z-L-E-R。

english: Why?
translation: 为什么？

english: Ever thought about putting a '1' in it?
translation: 想过在里面加个'1'吗？

english: Why on Gielinor would I do that?
translation: 我为什么要在基利诺尔那样做？

english: Might add a bit of pizzazz, that's all.
translation: 可能加点魅力，就这样。

english: Pizzazz, you say? I'll think about it.
translation: 魅力，你说？我会想想。

english: What's your name and your business here?
translation: 你叫什么名字，你在这里做什么？

english: My name is [player name], and I have a couple of questions for you.
translation: 我叫 [player name]，我有几个问题问你。

english: What do you mean by no?
translation: 你说不是什么意思？

english: That just isn't the ticket. I don't know you nor I will not answer any questions.Now get gone from here, you'll attract unwanted attention to me.
translation: 那不行。我不认识你也不会回答任何问题。现在离开这里，你会给我引来不必要的注意。

english: As if those 'clothes' you're wearing wouldn't do that already.
translation: 好像你穿的“衣服”不会那样似的。

english: Ah [player name] aren't you just the ticket?
translation: 啊 [player name] 你不正是那个吗？

english: Can you tell me where I could find Phingspet and Grimesquit?
translation: 你能告诉我在哪能找到芬格斯佩特和格里姆斯奎特吗？

english: You can find those vile harpies in the sewers of Varrock.
translation: 你可以在维洛克城的下水道找到那些邪恶的 harpies。

english: ~Jimmy shudders when he thinks of them.
translation: ~吉姆想到她们时颤抖。

english: If you ask me it's too good a place for them.
translation: 如果你问我，那地方对她们太好了。

english: Can you tell me where I could find Hooknosed Jack?
translation: 你能告诉我在哪能找到钩鼻杰克吗？

english: He should be in the roughest area of Varrock knowing him. He likes a good scrap does Jack.
translation: 了解他的话他应该在维洛克城最粗糙的区域。杰克喜欢打架。

english: Can you tell me where I could find Smokin Joe?
translation: 你能告诉我在哪能找到老烟枪‧乔吗？

english: You won't find him around here. They wouldn't let a filthy old dwarf like him into a civilised town like this.
translation: 你在这里找不到他。他们不会让他这样肮脏的老矮人进入像这样的文明城镇。

english: Well if he's not here where would I find him?
translation: 嗯如果他不在这里我在哪能找到他？

english: If the old rascal's lungs haven't given up yet, you should find him in Keldagrim, the city of Dwarves.
translation: 如果老流氓的肺还没放弃，你应该在凯尔达格林城，矮人之城找到他。

english: Can you tell me where I would find 'The Face'?
translation: 你能告诉我在哪能找到“面孔”吗？

english: Old pugly, my oh my but did she ever get her comeuppance.
translation: 老丑八怪，天哪但她确实得到了报应。

english: Old pugly?
translation: 老丑八怪？

english: Pug ugly.
translation: 丑得像哈巴狗。

english: She's worse than that.
translation: 她比那更糟。

english: She is?
translation: 她是？

english: Her looks are the stuff of legend. She's so ugly she ...
translation: 她的长相是传奇。她太丑了以至于她……

english: You guys are really nasty.
translation: 你们真讨厌。

english: Believe me she deserves everything she gets!
translation: 相信我她 deserve 她得到的一切！

english: What did she do?
translation: 她做了什么？

english: I couldn't possibly tell you, but be careful around her.
translation: 我不可能告诉你，但在她周围小心。

english: Will you please tell me where I could find her?
translation: 你能告诉我在哪能找到她吗？

english: She'll be in or around Port Sarim I reckon.
translation: 我想她会在沙林港或周围。

english: Can you tell me where I would find Felkrash?
translation: 你能告诉我在哪能找到费尔克拉什吗？

english: You'll find her in Port Sarim, probably in the ratpits.
translation: 你会在沙林港找到她，可能在鼠坑。

english: Well sort of, she's the unofficial head of the rat catchers.
translation: 嗯算是吧，她是捕鼠者的非官方头头。

english: Here take this, you might find it useful
translation: 给，拿着这个，你可能会发现有用

english: You are handed a manual concerning the ratpits.
translation: 你被递给一本关于鼠坑的手册。

english: Well what do you want to know?
translation: 嗯你想了解什么？

english: You should wear an amulet of catspeak. It will allow you to organise tactics with your cat.
translation: 你应该戴上猫语护符，这样就能跟猫商量战术了。

english: Well if that's the case then yourare left with two choices.
translation: 嗯如果是那样那你还有两个选择。

english: You can adopt an ultra defensive strategy, which increases your cat's hitpoints and defence, the drawback to this is that your cat will flee sooner.
translation: 你可以采用超级防御策略，增加猫的生命值和防御，缺点是你的猫会更早逃跑。

english: Your other option is to adopt a less defensive strategy which will allow your cat to stay in the pit for longer.
translation: 你的另一个是选偏防御策略，猫就能在坑里多待会儿。

english: In that case you should tell your cat, 'Just take care of yourself cat.'
translation: 那样的话你应该告诉你的猫，‘照顾好自己猫。’

english: In that case you should tell your cat, 'Stay in for as long as you can.'
translation: 那样的话你应该告诉你的猫，‘尽可能待在里面。’

english: You could go for all out attack which will boost your cat's attack and strength, but weaken it
translation: 你可以选全力进攻，猫的攻击和力量会提升，但会更脆弱。

english: or go for a less aggressive stance which will increase your cat's strength and attack to a lesser degree, but carries no defensive penalties.
translation: 或者选个偏进攻的姿态，猫的力量和攻击提升幅度小点儿，但不会降低防御。

english: I think I would adopt a very aggressive strategy
translation: 我想我会采用非常攻击策略

english: In that case you should tell your cat, 'Go berserk!'
translation: 那样的话你就跟猫说：''给我疯起来！''

english: In that case you should tell this to your cat, 'No guts, no glory!'
translation: 那样的话你就跟猫说：''不敢拼，哪有赢！''

english: In the Ardougne pits your kitten will grow up faster, whether it wins or loses.
translation: 在阿多尼坑你的小猫无论输赢都会更快长大。

english: It will gain more experience and will become happier and will be fed.
translation: 它会获得更多经验，会更快乐，也会吃饱。

english: Can you show me to the rat pits?
translation: 你能带我去鼠坑吗？

english: The pits lie below this very pub.
translation: 坑就在这个酒吧下面。

english: Can you tell me where I can find...
translation: 你能告诉我在哪能找到……

english: Grimesquit and Phingspet
translation: 格里姆斯奎特和芬格斯佩特

english: Hooknosed Jack
translation: 钩鼻杰克

english: Smokin' Joe
translation: 老烟枪‧乔

english: The Face
translation: 面孔

english: Felkrash
translation: 费尔克拉什

english: Can you tell me more about the Rat Pits?
translation: 你能多告诉我些关于鼠坑的事吗？

english: Do you have any pointers for me and my cat?
translation: 你有什么给我和我的猫的建议吗？

english: I will not risk my cat's life.
translation: 我不会拿我猫的生命去冒险。

english: I think I would adopt an ultra defensive strategy.
translation: 我想我会采用超级防御策略。

english: I'd like to ask you...
translation: 我想问问你……

english: No thanks
translation: 不用了，谢谢

english: I think I would adopt a less defensive strategy.
translation: 我想我会采取不那么保守的策略。

english: I am willing to risk my cat if it improves my chances.
translation: 如果能提高胜算，我愿意让猫冒点险。

english: I think I would adopt a very aggressive strategy.
translation: 我想我会采取非常激进的策略。

english: I think I would adopt a less aggressive strategy.
translation: 我想我会采取不那么激进的策略。

english: What benefits does my cat get from training in the pits?
translation: 我的猫从坑里训练得到什么好处？

english: Can you show me to the Rat Pits?
translation: 你能带我去鼠坑吗？

english: How do you spell your name again?
translation: 你怎么拼写你的名字？

english: Can you tell me where I would find...
translation: 你能告诉我在哪能找到……

english: The face
translation: 面孔

english: Can you tell me more about the pits?
translation: 你能多告诉我些关于坑的事吗？

english: I think I would adopt a very defensive strategy.
translation: 我想我会采取非常保守的策略。

english: Can you show me to the rat pits?
translation: 你能带我去鼠坑吗？

english: Hello mate!
translation: 你好伙计！

english: Are you one of them?
translation: 你是他们之一吗？

english: One of them? What do you mean?
translation: 他们之一？你什么意思？

english: Hmm... It's none of your concern. Move along.
translation: 嗯……不关你的事。走开。

english: Oh go on, tell me?
translation: 哦说吧，告诉我？

english: What's this game you're playing? Are you with them?
translation: 你在玩什么游戏？你和他们一起？

english: Who are they?
translation: 他们是谁？

english: Khazard's dogs!
translation: 卡扎德的狗！

english: Right... Well, no, I'm not with them.
translation: 好吧……嗯，不，我不和他们一起。

english: Good. They've decided they don't like me too much, what with me killing about eight of them...
translation: 好。他们决定不太喜欢我，因为我杀了大约八个他们……

english: Yes, I can see why that might have upset them. Anyway, I think I'm going to head off now, but good luck with... everything.
translation: 是的，我能明白为什么那可能惹恼他们。总之，我想我现在要走了，但祝你好运……一切。

english: Hmm...
Yes, I can see why that might have upset them. Perhaps it might be wise for you to put some distance between you and them.
translation: 是的，我能明白为什么那可能惹恼他们。也许你最好和他们保持些距离。

english: Is that you making me an offer?
translation: 那是你在给我提议？

english: I'm afraid not. At some point I hope to hire a crew to sail with, but I'm not really ready for that yet.
translation: 恐怕不是。在某刻我希望雇佣一个 crew 一起航行，但我还没准备好。

english: Hmm... Well, maybe you should let me know when you are...
translation: 嗯……嗯，也许你应该准备好时告诉我……

english: You need a Sailing level of 40 to manage a crew.
translation: 你需要40级航海来管理 crew。

english: Well, I guess you could join my crew.
translation: 嗯，我想你可以加入我的 crew。

english: Hmm... I don't know... You say you're not one of them, but I reckon you're trying to fool me!
translation: 嗯……我不知道……你说你不是他们之一，但我想你在试图骗我！

english: You require the following to recruit this crew member: Level 70 Sailing.
translation: 你需要以下来招募这个 crew 成员：70级航海。

english: Hmm... Dogs can't swim, can they? Yes... I think this might work...
translation: 嗯……狗不会游泳，对吧？是的……我想这可能行……

english: You recruit Jittery Jim as a crew member. He heads off in search of your boat.
translation: 你招募了 jittery 吉姆作为 crew 成员。他出发去寻找你的船。

english: No, I don't think so.
translation: 不，我不这么认为。

english: Hmm... If you say so.
translation: 嗯……如果你这么说。

english: You again.
translation: 你又来了。

english: I see you're still here. Do you not think it would be best if you put some distance between yourself and this place?
translation: 我看你还在这里。你不认为最好自己和这个地方保持些距离吗？

english: Captain.
translation: 船长。

english: Hello there. How are things going?
translation: 你好。怎么样？

english: Being on your crew is keeping me one step ahead of them, Captain, and that's all I ask.
translation: 在你的 crew 上让我领先他们一步，船长，那就是我所求。

english: It must be scary living in your own head...
translation: 活在自己脑子里一定很可怕……

english: The fear keeps me safe, Captain.
translation: 恐惧让我安全，船长。

english: Well, I guess you could join my crew.
translation: 嗯，我想你可以加入我的 crew。

english: No, I don't think so.
translation: 不，我不这么认为。

english: 'ello, guvna!
translation: 你好，老板！

english: Hello there. Who are you?
translation: 你好。你是谁？

english: Jim's me name. Just 'avin a butcher's for anyone who wants some stuff done.
translation: 吉姆是我的名字。只是瞧瞧有没有人需要做事。

english: Oh, in the meat business are you?
translation: 哦，你在做肉类生意？

english: Whatchu' on about? I'm after bees 'n honey.
translation: 你在说什么？我在找蜜蜂和蜂蜜。

english: Ah, so you're a farmer!
translation: 啊，所以你是农夫！

english: Ah, I'm something of a farmer myself!
translation: 啊，我自己也算是个农夫！

english: Use yer loaf! Why'd I be in the tub fer that. I'm brassic ain't I!
translation: 动动脑子！我为什么会在桶里。我可是穷光蛋！

english: Well, I have baked a loaf or two in my time as well.
translation: 嗯，我也曾烤过一两个面包。

english: You taking the mickey?
translation: 你在开玩笑？

english: I'm just trying to work out what you do.
translation: 我只是想弄清楚你做什么。

english: Well, then look at me boat and listen to wot's comin' out me gob!
translation: 嗯，那看看我的船，听听我嘴里出来的！

english: I'm sorry, but I have no idea what you're trying to say to me. I'm just going to leave you to it.
translation: 抱歉，但我完全不知道你想跟我说什么。我还是让你自己待着吧。

english: Hmph! Suit yourself, guvna.
translation: 哼！随你便，老板。

english: Ahh, a fellow sailor!
translation: 啊，一个水手同行！

english: There we go! Hmm... But tell you what, guvna... If yer in the salt yourself, maybe ye'd be wantin' a bit o' a hand on deck?
translation: 就这样！嗯……但告诉你，老板……如果你自己也出海，也许你想要甲板上帮把手？

english: Thanks for the offer, but I'm still pretty new to it all. I don't think I'm ready to be hiring a crew yet, but I'll let you know when I am.
translation: 谢谢提议，但我还是新手。我想我还没准备好雇佣 crew，但准备好我会告诉你。

english: You need a Sailing level of 40 to manage a crew.
translation: 你需要40级航海来管理 crew。

english: Sounds good to me. Why don't you join my crew?
translation: 听起来不错。你为什么不加入我的 crew？

english: Aye aye, guvna. Bound to make some sovs wiv you, ain't I?
translation: 是是，老板。肯定能跟你赚点钱，对吧？

english: You recruit Jobless Jim as a crew member. He heads off in search of your boat.
translation: 你招募了 Jobless 吉姆作为 crew 成员。他出发去寻找你的船。

english: You have recruited Jobless Jim as a crew member.
translation: 你招募了 Jobless 吉姆作为 crew 成员。

english: Thanks for the offer, but I'm good at the moment.
translation: 谢谢提议，但我现在很好。

english: 'ello again, guvna! Changed yer mind 'bout needin' a swab on deck? I can help out any way ye' fancy.
translation: 又见面了，老板！改变主意需要甲板上的 swab 了吗？我可以任何方式帮忙。

english: 'ello, Cap'n! 'tis a fine nanny goat ya 'av.
translation: 你好，船长！你有艘好船。

english: I find it odd that I have an easier time understanding ghosts than you, Jim.
translation: 我觉得奇怪，我理解鬼魂比理解你更容易，吉姆。

english: There ain't an amulet that can contain me rabbit, Cap'n.
translation: 没有护符能容纳我的兔子，船长。

english: 'Ello, Cap'n! Anyfin' I can help yer with?
translation: 你好，船长！有什么我能帮你的？

english: Yer hold's already empty, Cap'n.
translation: 你的货舱已经空了，船长。

english: Time to earn me shorts...
translation: 该赚我的短裤钱了……

english: Your crew start moving the contents of the cargo hold...
translation: 你的 crew 开始移动货舱的内容……

english: Yep, yer cargo hold's barren now. All's in yer' bank.
translation: 是的，你的货舱现在空了。都在你的银行。

english: How are you getting on?
translation: 你怎么样？

english: Could do with more dough, but can't complain 'bout conditions.
translation: 可以多赚点钱，但不能抱怨条件。

english: I'd best be off.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: C for miles. C for fish.
translation: 视野开阔。有鱼。

english: I'm a bit taters in this wind.
translation: 这风让我有点害怕。

english: Wish I had a boat.
translation: 希望我有艘船。

english: Been on me pins all day i 'ave.
translation: 我整天都在腿上。

english: Me mince pies are on the sails.
translation: 我的眼睛盯着帆。

english: There's somethin' in the drink to the [compass direction]!
translation: [compass direction] 方向的海里有东西！

english: Trimmed those sails good and proper, Captain!
translation: 把那些帆修剪得很好，船长！

english: 'avin a butchers at the hook.
translation: 瞧瞧那个钩子。

english: Managed to hook some salvage! I'll put it in the cargo hold.
translation: 成功钩到些 salvage！我把它放进货舱。

english: The cargo hold is full. I can't salvage anything.
translation: 货舱满了。我不能 salvage 任何东西。

english: I've caught a wind mote!
translation: 我抓到了一个风微粒！

english: Enabling the wind catcher!
translation: 启用捕风器！

english: Disabling the wind catcher!
translation: 禁用捕风器！

english: Aye, that's better.
translation: 是的，那更好。

english: I can't find any repair kits in the cargo hold.
translation: 我在货舱里找不到任何修理包。

english: Sounds good to me. Why don't you join my crew?
translation: 听起来不错。你为什么不加入我的 crew？

english: Thanks for the offer, but I'm good at the moment.
translation: 谢谢提议，但我现在很好。

english: Can you help bank my cargo hold contents?
translation: 你能帮我把货舱内容存银行吗？

english: Yes.
translation: 是。

english: No.
translation: 否。

english: How are you getting on?
translation: 你怎么样？

english: I'd best be off.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: Arr? Be ye wantin' te go on account with our gang o' fillibusters?
translation: 啊？你想跟我们的 filibusters gang 一起吗？

english: The powder monkey be takin' a caulk after gettin' rowdy on bumboo, so there be plenty of room for ye.
translation: 火药猴在 bumboo 上闹腾后去休息了，所以有很多空间给你。

english: Riiiiight...
I'll just be over here if you need me.
translation: 如果你需要我我就在这里。

english: Whadda ya want?
translation: 你想要什么？

english: Whadda ya got?
translation: 你有什么？

english: We gots grog and we gots food. Here, take a look.
translation: 我们有格罗格酒和食物。来，看看。

english: Nothing! Honest!
translation: 没什么！真的！

english: Then stop takin' up me floor space!
translation: 那别占我的地板空间！

english: I wanted to know where you got that harpoon hand.
translation: 我想知道你的鱼叉手从哪来的。

english: Yer new in town aintcha?
translation: 你是镇上新来的对吧？

english: Newish certainly.
translation: 算是新来的。

english: Well, if ye wants te hear the story, here goes.
translation: 嗯，如果你想听故事，开始了。

english: See, I was walkin' along the docks one day, and this fierce storm blew up.
translation: 看，有一天我沿着码头走，突然起了猛烈的风暴。

english: All of a sudden I turn an there, bearin' down on me is this albatross...
translation: 突然我转身，迎面而来的是这只信天翁……

english: Sorry to interrupt, but I would just like to clear something up.
translation: 抱歉打断，但我想澄清点什么。

english: What? I was just gettin' to the good bit.
translation: 什么？我刚讲到精彩部分。

english: When I said 'I wanted to know where you got that harpoon hand', I meant where did you get it made, or buy it from?
translation: 当我说‘我想知道你的鱼叉手从哪来的’，我是指你在哪做的，或从哪买的？

english: If ye don't wants to hear the story then I ain't gonna tell ye!
translation: 如果你不想听故事那我就不告诉你了！

english: Whadda ya got?
translation: 你有什么？

english: Nothing! Honest!
translation: 没什么！真的！

english: I wanted to know where you got that harpoon hand.
translation: 我想知道你的鱼叉手从哪来的。

english: Hi. Who are you guarding here?
translation: 嗨。你在这里守卫谁？

english: Can't say. It's all very secret. You should get out of here. I am not supposed to talk while I guard.
translation: 不能说。都是机密。你应该离开这里。我守卫时不该说话。

english: Who's a good boy!
translation: 谁是好孩子！

english: *Woof*
translation: 汪

english: Go get it!
translation: 去捡！

english: *Woof* Woof*
translation: 汪 汪*

english: Hello there. Would you like to see the goods I have for sale?
translation: 你好。你想看看我卖的货吗？

english: Yes please, Jofridr.
translation: 是的谢谢，约弗里德。

english: No thank you, Jofridr.
translation: 不谢谢，约弗里德。

english: Fairthee well.
translation: 祝你安好。

english: Why do you have so much wool in your store? I haven't seen any sheep anywhere.
translation: 为什么你店里有这么多羊毛？我没看到任何羊。

english: Ah, I have contacts on the mainland. I have a sailor friend who brings me crates of wool on a regular basis.
translation: 啊，我在大陆有联系人。我有个水手朋友定期给我成箱的羊毛。

english: What do you trade for it?
translation: 你用什么交换？

english: Rope of course! What else can we sell? Fish would go off before it got so far south.
translation: 绳子当然！我们还能卖什么？鱼在到这么南之前就坏了。

english: Where does all this rope go?
translation: 所有这些绳子去哪了？

english: Err, I don't remember the name of the place very well. Dreinna? Drennor? Something like that.
translation: 呃，我不太记得那地方的名字。德雷纳？德雷诺？类似那样的。

english: That's very interesting. Thanks Jofridr.
translation: 那很有趣。谢谢约弗里德。

english: Would you like to see the goods I have for sale?
translation: 你想看看我卖的货吗？

english: Yes please, Jofridr
translation: 是的谢谢，约弗里德

english: No thank you, Jofridr
translation: 不谢谢，约弗里德

english: Why do you have so much wool in your store?
translation: 为什么你店里有这么多羊毛？

english: Welcome [brother/sister/friend]... to our organisation... Ours is a fight for humanity in all its shapes and forms... and to rid mankind of the monsters that exist in our world.
translation: 欢迎 [brother/sister/friend]……加入我们的组织……我们为各种形式的人类而战……并消除我们世界中存在的怪物。

english: What kind of organisation is this?
translation: 这是什么类型的组织？

english: We're a proactive organisation working towards the cessation of monsters in normal civilised human society. There seems to be no backbone in this land so we're stepping up to the challenge.
translation: 我们是一个 proactive 组织，致力于在正常文明人类社会中停止怪物。这片土地似乎没有脊梁，所以我们站出来迎接挑战。

english: Hmm, how do you propose to do that? I mean, I see people everyday killing goblins around here!
translation: 嗯，你打算怎么做？我是说，我每天看到人们在这里杀哥布林！

english: We're mobilising people and we're starting our own society...cleaning out the caves once inhabited by these foul creatures and defending them so that they can never again shelter sub human species.
translation: 我们在动员人们，开始我们自己的社会……清理曾经被这些邪恶生物居住的洞穴，并保卫它们，让它们再也无法庇护 sub human 物种。

english: That sounds kind of strange, but hey it's your choice.
translation: 那听起来有点奇怪，但嘿这是你的选择。

english: Who are you and what do you do here?
translation: 你是谁，你在这里做什么？

english: My name is Johanhus and I lead these glorious people on a courageous mission called, 'Humans against Monsters', we mean to make this land free of monsters so we can all live in peace.
translation: 我叫约翰纳斯，我领导这些光荣的人进行一个勇敢的任务，叫‘人类对抗怪物’，我们打算让这片土地没有怪物，这样我们都能和平生活。

english: Okay, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Hey, I've found this, do you know anything about it?
translation: 嘿，我找到了这个，你知道关于它的事吗？

english: Yes, in fact I do. I wrote many essays for this book, it was a great seller, many people are stirred by the words and feelings in such a tome.
translation: 是的，事实上我知道。我为这本书写了很多文章，它很畅销，很多人被这样的书中的文字和情感打动。

english: What kind of organisation is this?
translation: 这是什么类型的组织？

english: Who are you and what do you do here?
translation: 你是谁，你在这里做什么？

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: ZzzzZzzZZzzZZzz.
translation: ZzzzZzzZZzzZZzz。

english: He's sleeping peacefully. Loudly, but peacefully.
translation: 他睡得很安详。大声地，但安详地。

english: Hello there!
translation: 你好！

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: I'm John, I specialise in archaeology and there's some very interesting ruins in this area.
translation: 我是约翰，我专攻考古，这个区域有一些非常有趣的遗迹。

english: Is that like fossils and stuff?
translation: 那是像化石之类的吗？

english: Oh my word no. Archaeology is the study of sentient races history through study of artefacts and ruins.
translation: 哦天不。考古学是通过研究 artefacts 和遗迹来研究 sentient 种族的历史。

english: Weren't fossils sentient?
translation: 化石不是 sentient 吗？

english: Well... we have no proof to suggest such.
translation: 嗯……我们没有证据证明那样。

english: What is going on here?
translation: 这里发生了什么事？

english: This is our base camp for exploration of this wonderful island.
translation: 这是我们探索这个奇妙岛的 base camp。

english: Anything I can do to help?
translation: 有什么我能帮忙的吗？

english: No, no. You've already helped admirably. Our lives are much more comfortable thank you.
translation: 不，不。你已经帮了大忙。我们的生活舒适多了谢谢。

english: What should I do?
translation: 我该做什么？

english: Explore! There's so much here we don't understand.
translation: 探索！这里有太多我们不理解的。

english: But where?
translation: 但去哪？

english: I've heard there's a pretty spectacular structure up near the mountain, but I haven't gone there yet.
translation: 我听说山附近有个相当壮观的结构，但我还没去。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: What is going on here?
translation: 这里发生了什么事？

english: What should I do?
translation: 我该做什么？

english: I am so very tired... Leave me be... to rest...
translation: 我很累……别管我……休息……

english: Hello again. My family now considers you a hero.
translation: 又见面了。我的家人现在认为你是英雄。

english: Maybe because... I am.
translation: 也许因为……我是。

english: Yes well... Is there anything I can help you with?
translation: 是的嗯……有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: Can you change my gauntlets for me?
translation: 你能帮我换手套吗？

english: Yes certainly, though it will cost you 25,000 coins.
translation: 是的当然，虽然要花你25,000金币。

english: Great thanks!
translation: 太好了谢谢！

english: Johnathon takes your gauntlets from you, and begins a low chant over them. You see them begin to glow and sparkle, before he returns them to you.
translation: 约翰森拿走你的手套，开始在它们上面低吟。你看到它们开始发光闪烁，然后他归还给你。

english: No that's okay thanks.
translation: 不那没事谢谢。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: I have received word from my father that you assisted us again! I get the feeling you weren't going to stop trying until you did though.
translation: 我收到父亲的消息说你再次帮助了我们！我感觉你不会停止尝试直到做到。

english: If you want, I'll provide you with as many pairs of Chaos gauntlets as you wish to say thanks!
translation: 如果你想要，我会提供你任意多双混沌手套作为感谢！

english: You will find the power of bolt spells increases substantially whilst wearing these gauntlets.
translation: 你会发现佩戴这些手套时 飞弹法术的力量大幅增加。

english: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。

english: Could I have some more chaos gauntlets, please?
translation: 能再给我些混沌手套吗？

english: You're welcome.
translation: 不用客气。

english: Can you change my gauntlets for me?
translation: 你能帮我换手套吗？

english: Great thanks!
translation: 太好了谢谢！

english: No that's okay thanks.
translation: 不那没事谢谢。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Could I have some more chaos gauntlets, please?
translation: 能再给我些混沌手套吗？

english: You're welcome.
translation: 不用客气。

english: Aren't you beautiful?
translation: 你不漂亮吗？

english: You are unusually helpful for an outerlander, [Fremennik name].
translation: 你对外乡人来说异常乐于助人，[Fremennik name]。

english: Ehm, thanks... I guess.
translation: 嗯，谢谢……我想。

english: 'tis a fine day!
translation: 今天天气真好！

english: You seem to be in a good mood.
translation: 你似乎心情很好。

english: Aye! I be the last o' me crew! Not even our ship left now!
translation: 是的！我是 crew 的最后一个！连我们的船都没了！

english: That doesn't seem like a reason to be happy...
translation: 那看起来不像高兴的理由……

english: Well, it means I be the winner!
translation: 嗯，那意味着我是赢家！

english: I see. So what happened to your crew?
translation: 我明白了。那你的 crew 怎么了？

english: It be a series o' bad luck! First, Bill, the lookout, collided with an albatross in the crows nest 'n took a tumble overboard.
translation: 是一系列坏运气！首先，比尔，瞭望员，在 crow's nest 撞上信天翁摔下船。

english: Finally, the Cap'n sank the Snake Eyes sailin' north out o' Catherby.
translation: 最后，船长在凯瑟比镇北边沉了蛇眼号。

english: Hmm... Well, congratulations on having survived all that. All the best.
translation: 嗯……嗯，恭喜你幸存下来。祝一切顺利。

english: Aye! 'til next time.
translation: 是的！下次见。

english: Then the ship's cook got squashed by a crate o' hard tack. Salty Robbie took a drunken nap in the bilge water 'bout the same time.
translation: 然后船的厨师被一箱硬饼干压扁了。咸味罗比同时在 舱底水里醉醺醺地午睡。

english: Hmm... Well, congratulations on having survived all that. What do you plan to do now?
translation: 嗯……嗯，恭喜你幸存下来。你现在打算做什么？

english: Well, I guess I be lookin' fer a new opportunity.
translation: 嗯，我想我在找新机会。

english: Well, at some point I hope to hire a crew to sail with myself, but I'm not really ready for that yet.
translation: 嗯，在某刻我希望雇佣一个 crew 一起航行，但我还没准备好。

english: Well, ye' know where t' find me when ye' are.
translation: 嗯，你知道到时候去哪找我。

english: You need a Sailing level of 40 to manage a crew.
translation: 你需要40级航海来管理 crew。

english: Hello again. How are things going?
translation: 又见面了。怎么样？

english: Aye, they be mighty good, but I'm still lookin' fer a new opportunity.
translation: 是的，它们很好，但我还在找新机会。

english: How about you join my crew?
translation: 你加入我的 crew 怎么样？

english: Hmm... Nay, me hearty. I be thinkin' ye'd be the end o' me lucky streak.
translation: 嗯……不，我的伙计。我想你会结束我的幸运 streak。

english: You require the following to recruit this crew member: Level 85 Sailing.
translation: 你需要以下来招募这个 crew 成员：85级航海。

english: Aye, I'm ready to take another roll o' the dice!
translation: 是的，我准备好再掷一次骰子了！

english: You recruit Jolly Jim as a crew member. He heads off in search of your boat.
translation: 你招募了 Jolly 吉姆作为 crew 成员。他出发去寻找你的船。

english: Well, good luck with it.
translation: 嗯，祝你好运。

english: There's been a worrying lack o' sinkin' lately, Cap'n. Worried it's affectin' the crew's morale.
translation: 最近缺乏沉船令人担忧，船长。担心它影响 crew 的士气。

english: That doesn't make much sense to me...
translation: 那对我来说没什么意义……

english: How're we supposed to score some free grog at the bar when we got no stories to be tellin'!
translation: 我们没有故事讲怎么在酒吧赚免费格罗格酒！

english: Sorry... I'll try to do worse, I guess.
translation: 抱歉……我想我会试着表现更差。

english: How about you join my crew?
translation: 你加入我的 crew 怎么样？

english: Well, good luck with it.
translation: 嗯，祝你好运。

english: This dish turned out horrendously.
translation: 这道菜结果很可怕。

english: How come?
translation: 为什么？

english: It... tastes like nothing...
translation: 它……尝起来像没什么……

english: Jon shows you an empty bowl.
translation: 乔恩给你看一个空碗。

english: Isn't that bowl empty?
translation: 那碗不是空的吗？

english: So nothing tastes the same cause nothing is never there?
translation: 所以没什么味道是一样的，因为那里根本什么都没有？

english: I'll be going...
translation: 我要走了……

english: That's probably for the best.
translation: 那可能是最好的。

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Hello, lovely day we're having.
translation: 你好，今天天气真好。

english: Same as every day really, the weather is very consistent around here.
translation: 其实每天都一样，这附近的天气很稳定。

english: Whatever you want, I'm not interested!
translation: 随便你想要什么，我没兴趣！

english: Can't stop to talk human. Lady Lovakengj might need me.
translation: 没空跟你说话人类。洛瓦肯吉女士可能需要我。

english: Hi there.
translation: 你好。

english: All is lost!
translation: 全完了！

english: Sorry?
translation: 抱歉？

english: Don't bother, you're not experienced enough to help me!
translation: 别麻烦了，你经验不够帮不了我！

english: Just look around you! This great building will soon be in ruin.
translation: 看看周围！这座伟大的建筑很快就会成为废墟。

english: Great building?
translation: 伟大的建筑？

english: Of course! This building has a history spanning generations!
translation: 当然！这座建筑有着跨越几代人的历史！

english: Ah, I see, a great history. But why will it be in ruin?
translation: 啊，我明白了，伟大的历史。但它为什么会成为废墟？

english: It's to be ripped apart to make way for King Lathas' new alchemists' lab.
translation: 它要被拆掉，为拉萨斯国王的新炼金实验室让路。

english: Does the king not respect the outpost's GREAT history?
translation: 国王不尊重这个前哨站的伟大历史吗？

english: Well, actually nobody knows what the history is. But there must be something.
translation: 嗯，其实没人知道历史是什么。但肯定有什么。

english: Wait a minute. You could help me!
translation: 等一下。你可以帮我！

english: Me?
translation: 我？

english: Yes! Uncover the history of this building to convince King Lathas to leave it alone. Do you want to know more?
translation: 是的！揭开这座建筑的历史，说服拉萨斯国王别动它。你想知道更多吗？

english: Tell me more.
translation: 告诉我更多。

english: A cutscene appears.
translation: 过场动画出现。

english: With many occupants over the years...
translation: 多年来有许多居住者……

english: ...the building has seen much action.
translation: ……这座建筑见证了许多行动。

english: It started life as an outpost...
translation: 它最初是作为一个前哨站……

english: ... its sole purpose being to see invading armies...
translation: ……它唯一的目的就是监视入侵军队……

english: ... before they saw the city of Ardougne.
translation: ……在他们看到阿多尼城之前。

english: The cutscene disappears.
translation: 过场动画消失。

english: If all goes well, I hope to be able to turn it into a museum as a monument to the area's history. What do you think?
translation: 如果一切顺利，我希望把它变成博物馆，作为该地区历史的纪念碑。你觉得呢？

english: OK, I will make a stand for history!
translation: 好的，我要为历史挺身而出！

english: Oh thank you so much, you really are my saviour!
translation: 哦太感谢你了，你真是我的救星！

english: But where should I start?
translation: 但我应该从哪里开始？

english: What do I need to do now?
translation: 我现在需要做什么？

english: There are three people that may be able to help:
translation: 有三个人可能能帮忙：

english: There is a silver trader in East Ardougne called Erin, who I believe can help.
translation: 东阿多尼城有个叫艾琳的银器商人，我相信他能帮忙。

english: In what way can he help?
translation: 他能怎么帮忙？

english: His Great Grandfather lived in this outpost according to the records. He must know something!
translation: 根据记录，他的曾祖父住在这个前哨站。他肯定知道些什么！

english: OK, I'll see what he has to say.
translation: 好的，我去看看他怎么说。

english: I've been told that there's a ghost far off in Port Phasmatys that moans of losing his life to this place.
translation: 我听说法斯玛提斯港远处有个鬼魂，哀叹他在这里丧命。

english: Sounds ominous. Does he have a name?
translation: 听起来不祥。他有名字吗？

english: He does indeed. It's Droalak.
translation: 确实有。叫德罗拉克。

english: I'll track him down.
translation: 我会找到他。

english: It might not be so simple! You'll need an amulet of ghostspeak to talk to him!
translation: 可能没那么简单！你需要鬼语护符才能跟他说话！

english: I've conversed with the dead before, that shouldn't be too much of a problem.
translation: 我以前跟死人交谈过，那应该不是大问题。

english: Up near the mountains, in Rellekka is a warrior called Dron whom I have spoken to in the past. He is always on the lookout for information that can improve his fighting and commanding skills.
translation: 在雷勒克卡靠近山脉的地方，有个叫德隆的战士，我以前跟他说过话。他总是在寻找能提高他战斗和指挥技能的信息。

english: And how's he related to this outpost?
translation: 他跟这个前哨站有什么关系？

english: He isn't directly, but he's studied many wars, and as this used to be an outpost it should have been involved in some war.
translation: 他没有直接关系，但他研究过许多战争，既然这里以前是前哨站，应该卷入过某场战争。

english: That sounds simple enough.
translation: 那听起来够简单。

english: He isn't the easiest person to talk to, so you may need to speak to his brother, Blanin, first.
translation: 他不是最容易说话的人，所以你可能需要先跟他兄弟布莱宁谈谈。

english: What's the story so far?
translation: 目前故事进展如何？

english: What do you mean? You've discovered nothing!
translation: 你什么意思？你什么都没发现！

english: Got to go, bye!
translation: 得走了，再见！

english: I don't care about some dusty building.
translation: 我不在乎什么积满灰尘的建筑。

english: It's doomed. DOOMED!
translation: 它注定要完蛋。注定要完蛋！

english: Thanks for the help again. Feel free to browse the room next door!
translation: 再次感谢帮助。随意浏览隔壁房间！

english: Hello there, I have this master clue he...
translation: 你好，我有这个大师线索他……

english: Stop! I can't help you unless you help me out first.
translation: 停下！除非你先帮我，否则我帮不了你。

english: Okay then, moving on...
translation: 好吧，继续……

english: Hi Jorral, I have come to ask you to help with something.
translation: 嗨乔拉尔，我来请你帮个忙。

english: What can I do for you [Player name]?
translation: 我能为你做什么 [Player name]？

english: Ah! Remember that enchanted key you had to use previously?
translation: 啊！记得你以前用过的那个附魔钥匙吗？

english: Yes, I do.
translation: 是的，我记得。

english: Well this should function much the same, the deeper magic of the key itself is stored within this strange device.
translation: 嗯这个功能应该差不多，钥匙本身的深层魔法存储在这个奇怪装置里。

english: You should feel it, and it will guide you to where you need to go.
translation: 你应该感受它，它会引导你去需要去的地方。

english: You should make some room for it before I can give you it.
translation: 在我给你之前，你应该腾出些空间。

english: Be careful with it, the raw magic can damage you unexpectedly when you feel it.
translation: 小心点，原始魔法在你感受它时可能意外伤害你。

english: No, I don't.
translation: 不，我不记得。

english: Ah, well the enchanted key can lead you to treasure. The magical nature of the key heats it up or cools it down, depending on your proximity to the treasure.

translation: 世界的第三纪元是巨大冲突的时期，是前所未见也后无来者的毁灭，当时所有神除了古斯都为控制而战。

english: The colossal Wyrms, of whom today's dragons are a pale reflection, turned all the sky to fire, while on the ground armies of foot soldiers, goblins and trolls and humans, filled the valleys and plains with blood.
translation: 巨大的蛇龙，今天的龙只是其苍白的反映，将整个天空变为火，而在地面上，步兵、哥布林、巨魔和人类的军队，用鲜血填满了山谷和平原。

english: In time the noise of the conflict woke Guthix from His deep slumber, and He rose and stood in the centre of the battlefield so that the splendour of His wrath filled the world, and He called for the conflict to cease!
translation: 最终冲突的噪音唤醒了古斯从祂的沉睡中，祂升起站在战场中心，使得祂愤怒的辉煌充满世界，祂呼吁冲突停止！

english: Silence fell, for the gods knew that none could challenge the power of the mighty Guthix -- for His power is that of nature itself, to which all other things are subject, in the end.
translation: 寂静降临，因为众神知道没人能挑战强大的古斯的力量——因为祂的力量是自然本身的力量，所有其他事物最终都受其支配。

english: Guthix reclaimed that which had been stolen from Him, and went back underground to return to His sleep and continue to draw the world's power into Himself.
translation: 古斯收回了被从祂那里偷走的东西，回到地下回到祂的睡眠中，继续将世界的力量吸入祂自身。

english: But on His way into the depths of the earth He sat and rested in this cave; and, thinking of the battle-scarred desert that now stretched from one side of His world to the other, He wept.
translation: 但在祂进入地球深处的路上，祂坐在这个洞穴里休息；想到现在从祂世界的一端延伸到另一端的战斗伤痕累累的沙漠，祂哭了。

english: And so great was His sorrow, and so great was His life- giving power, that the rocks themselves began to weep with Him.
translation: 祂的悲伤如此巨大，祂的赋予生命的力量如此巨大，以至于岩石本身开始与祂一起哭泣。

english: Later, Guthix noticed that the rocks continued to weep, and that their tears were infused with a small part of His power.
translation: 后来，古斯注意到岩石继续哭泣，它们的泪水 infused 了祂力量的一小部分。

english: So He set me, His servant, to guard the cave, and He entrusted to me the task of judging who was and was not worthy to access the tears.
translation: 所以祂派我，祂的仆人，守卫洞穴，祂委托我判断谁值得谁不值得 access 泪水。

english: Tell me about the Tears of Guthix.
translation: 和我说说古斯之泪。

english: I will tell you the story of the light-creatures.
translation: 我会告诉你光之生物的故事。

english: Myriad and beautiful were the creatures and civilizationsof the early ages of the world. Gielinor was a work of art, shaped lovingly over the millennia by the creative mind of Guthix.
translation: 世界早期时代的生物和文明无数而美丽。基利诺尔是一件艺术品，由古斯的创造性思维在千年间 lovingly 塑造。

english: Only the sturdiest races survived the Godwars, and even then only by abandoning their high culture and gearing their societies towards war. Of the more delicate races there is now no trace, and almost no memory.
translation: 只有最坚固的种族在神战中幸存，即使那样也只是通过放弃他们的高文化并将社会 geared 向战争。更脆弱的种族现在没有痕迹，几乎没有记忆。

english: One such race had bodies as fragile as snowflakes, yet they built crystal cities that stood for a thousand years.
translation: 这样一个种族身体像雪花一样脆弱，但他们建造了屹立千年的水晶城。

english: The wind would whisper through the spires and fill them with sweet harmonies, and the rising sun would shine through the precious gems that studded the towers and create inter plays of light as if rainbows were dancing.
translation: 风会在尖塔间低语，充满甜蜜的和谐，升起的太阳会穿过镶嵌在塔楼上的珍贵宝石，创造光的交织，仿佛彩虹在跳舞。

english: Indeed, so marvellous was this light-show at its height that the patterns of light themselves became alive, and great flocks of luminous creatures rode along the gem- cast beams, each drawn to its own colour.
translation: 确实，这个 light-show 在其巅峰如此奇妙，以至于光的图案本身变得有生命，大群发光生物沿着宝石投射的光束骑行，每个都被吸引到自己的颜色。

english: The creatures you see floating in this chasm are the last sorry remnants of that age. I do not know how they made their way here and survived to this time, but I am grateful for their company.
translation: 你看到漂浮在这个裂缝中的生物是那个时代最后可怜的残骸。我不知道它们如何来到这里并幸存到现在，但我感激它们的陪伴。

english: Tell me about the light-creatures.
translation: 和我说说光之生物。

english: Not long after the start of my vigil a party of goblins happened on my cave. These were the ugly brutes of the gods' armies, but their armour bore a faded patch where the symbol of a god had been removed.
translation: 在我守夜开始后不久，一队哥布林偶然发现了我的洞穴。这些是神军队的丑陋野兽，但他们的盔甲上有褪色的补丁，神的符号被移除了。

english: They looked around hesitantly, squinting in the light of crude torches, but as soon as they saw me they raised their spears and charged.
translation: 他们犹豫地环顾四周，在 crude 火把的光线下眯着眼，但一看到我就举起长矛冲锋。

english: No one may access the Tears of Guthix by force. I sent them tumbling into the chasm.
translation: 没人能强行 access 古斯之泪。我把他们翻滚着送进了裂缝。

english: Two hundred years later another goblin found me. This one was unarmed, and although she was very wary I succeeded in engaging her in conversation.
translation: 两百年后另一个哥布林找到了我。这个没有武装，虽然她很警惕，我成功让她参与交谈。

english: Since then I have had many more visits from the descendants of those lost warriors, and over the centuries I have seen them change.
translation: 从那时起，我有更多那些失落战士的后代来访，几个世纪以来我看到他们改变。

english: They have become timid rather than aggressive, and I have seen the light of intelligence grow in their bulging eyes.
translation: 他们变得 timid 而不是 aggressive，我看到智慧之光在他们突出的眼睛中增长。

english: Their stories are repetitive and grim, of scraping a living out of the harsh rock and through ingenuity and toil shaping it into a home.
translation: 他们的故事重复而 grim，从 harsh 岩石中 scraping 生活，通过 ingenuity 和 toil 将其塑造成家园。

english: I have followed the progress of their race, but their individual stories hold little interest for me.
translation: 我跟随了他们种族的进步，但他们个人的故事对我没什么兴趣。

translation: 我不想要任何消息提醒我返回这里。

english: Very well, it will be up to you to remember when you can return. It is good that you are willing to take responsibility for yourself in this way.
translation: 很好，将由你记住何时可以返回。你愿意以这种方式对自己负责是好的。

english: So many aeons have passed since these were made. So many mortals have been born, lived their lives, then died as Balancerequires. What stories they must have known!
translation: 自从这些被制造以来已经过去了如此多的纪元。如此多的凡人出生，生活，然后作为平衡要求死亡。他们肯定知道什么故事！

english: Hello friend. You're a long way from Lumbridge!
translation: 你好朋友。你离仑桥镇很远！

english: How do I get into the Kharazi Jungle?
translation: 我怎么进入卡哈兹丛林？

english: Well, I don't recommend just walking in! The last guy I saw try that barely escaped with his life.
translation: 嗯，我不建议直接走进去！我看到的上一个尝试的人 barely 逃命。

english: Apparently he was on a mission to map the area. How foolish is that?
translation: 显然他是在执行绘制该区域地图的任务。那有多愚蠢？

english: Actually, I plan to map the jungle myself.
translation: 其实，我计划自己绘制丛林地图。

english: Oh. Oops. Sorry if I sounded rude, it just seems like a really bad idea.
translation: 哦。哎呀。如果我听起来粗鲁抱歉，那似乎真是个坏主意。

english: I mean it's a noble calling. Lots of people around here could use a proper map to navigate with. But, you know... there's something not quite right about that jungle.
translation: 我的意思是那是个高尚的召唤。这里很多人可以用合适的地图导航。但是，你知道……那个丛林有些不太对劲。

english: Best of luck though... Guthix knows, you'll need it.
translation: 不过祝你好运……古斯知道，你会需要它。

english: Do you have any other tips about the Kharazi Jungle?
translation: 你有关于卡哈兹丛林的其他建议吗？

english: Not really. Just be careful - there's a lot of weird stuff going on in there lately.
translation: 不真的。只要小心——最近那里有很多奇怪的事情发生。

english: Are you calling me foolish?
translation: 你在叫我愚蠢吗？

english: Er... maybe? I'll just be on my way...
translation: 呃……也许？我还是走吧……

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: I'm a forester, and I specialise in exotic woods. I haven't gone into the Kharazi myself, but I've found some interesting tree specimens out here.
translation: 我是护林员，我专攻 exotic 木材。我自己没进过卡哈兹，但我在这里发现了一些有趣的树木标本。

english: If you do find a safe path into the jungle, do come and let me know. I'd love to have a nose around in there.
translation: 如果你真的找到进入丛林的安全路径，一定要来告诉我。我很想在那里嗅探一下。

english: Have you seen any Kharazi tribespeople in the jungle?
translation: 你在丛林里见过任何卡哈兹部落人吗？

english: Oh yes, I've met loads of them! Lovely lot. I haven't seen many about recently, though.
translation: 哦是的，我见过很多！可爱的一群。不过最近我没见过多少。

english: If you're looking to say hello, you'll need a Bullroarer. If you swing it above your head it makes a loud noise - that should attract someone's attention.
translation: 如果你想打招呼，你需要一个 Bullroarer。如果你在它头顶挥舞它会发出大声响——那应该能吸引某人的注意。

english: Do you have a Bullroarer I could borrow?
translation: 你有我可以借的牛吼器吗？

english: I wish I did! But I just have the one, and I've grown fond of it. Besides, I might need it if I ever get lost in the jungle.
translation: 我希望我有！但我只有一个，而且我已经喜欢上它了。此外，如果我在丛林里迷路了我可能需要它。

english: Will you trade something for it?
translation: 你会用什么交换它吗？

english: Hmm, maybe. Tell you what, you show me something interesting and I'll see if it's worth my Bullroarer. How about that?
translation: 嗯，也许。告诉你吧，你给我看些有趣的东西，我看看它是否值得我的 Bullroarer。怎么样？

english: It's a deal!
translation: 成交！

english: Okay, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: You're welcome! See you around...
translation: 不客气！回头见……

english: I have a question about my Achievement Diary.
translation: 我有个关于成就日志的问题。

english: Sorry, I don't do that kind of thing any more. You should go and talk to Pirate Jackie in Brimhaven instead.
translation: 抱歉，我不再做那种事了。你应该去布尔哈文镇跟海盗杰克谈谈。

english: Ugh, it's still raw! You can't serve me that. Take it away!
translation: 呃，它还是生的！你不能给我那个。拿走！

english: I lost my Bullroarer, can I swap this delicious wrap for yours?
translation: 我丢了牛吼器，我能用这个美味卷饼换你的吗？

english: Go on then. Forestry is hungry work.
translation: 那就去吧。护林是饥饿的工作。

english: On second thoughts, I might get hungry.
translation: 再想想，我可能会饿。

english: Sorry, but I have no use for that.
translation: 抱歉，但我用不着那个。

english: You'll have better luck getting someone's attention if you use it in the jungle.

english: I'd like to buy a new boat.
translation: 我想买艘新船。

english: Sure thing, mate. Which one do you fancy?
translation: 当然，伙计。你喜欢哪一艘？

english: I'd like to customise a boat.

translation: 我想恢复一艘船。

english: It's your boat's funeral, I guess.

english: Sure thing, mate.

english: Thanks!

english: Not a problem. Don't forget to see Charles down in the cave on the island if you need more help with charting.
