english: Do you have any tips on how I can become a better sailor?
translation: 你有什么建议让我成为更好的水手吗？

english: Yeah, I reckon I can probably chuck a few pointers your way. Let's have a butchers...
translation: 是的，我想我可以给你一些建议。让我们看看……

english: Right, you've got all sorts of ways you can buff up your sailing skills. There's port tasks, sea charting, shipwreck salvaging, Barracuda Trials, deep sea trawling, and probably loads more I've gone and forgotten about.
translation: 好的，你有各种方法可以提升航海技能。有港口任务，海图绘制，沉船打捞，梭鱼试炼，深海拖网，可能还有很多我忘了的。

english: Can you tell me more about port tasks?
translation: 你能多告诉我些关于港口任务吗？

english: Sure thing, mate. You'll find that a lot of ports will have a notice board where folks have gone and stuck up some ads for jobs they want sorting.
translation: 当然，伙计。你会发现很多港口有个公告板，人们在那里贴了一些他们想要解决的工作广告。

english: Might be they want some cargo lugging about, or maybe they're after someone to pop out and do a bit of killing for them.
translation: 可能是他们想要些货物搬运，或者他们在找人出去帮他们做点杀戮。

english: And is there anything I should keep in mind while doing these tasks?
translation: 我在做这些任务时有什么需要注意的吗？

english: Well, after you've gone and accepted a task or two, you'll want to keep your captain's log handy. It's good for keeping tabs on what jobs you're currently grafting away at.
translation: 嗯，在你接受了一两个任务后，你想把手头的船长日志放 handy。它有助于跟踪你目前正在努力的工作。

english: Also, if you're doing a bit of courier work, you might find it handy to get a couple of crewmates on board. They can help you shift the goods about so you're not knackering yourself by carrying one crate at a time.
translation: 另外，如果你在做些运送工作，你可能会发现带几个船员上船很有用。他们可以帮你搬运货物，这样你就不用一次搬一个箱子把自己累垮。

english: Makes sense. Thanks, Jim.
translation: 有道理。谢谢，吉姆。

english: No worries, mate. Wanting any other tips?
translation: 别担心，伙计。想要其他建议吗？

english: Can you tell me more about sea charting?
translation: 你能多告诉我些关于海图绘制吗？

english: Well, mate, sea charting is all about heading out and improving your own knowledge of the sea itself. Your captain's log has all sorts of cracking tips on how to do so.
translation: 嗯，伙计，海图绘制就是关于走出去提升你自己对海洋本身的知识。你的船长日志有各种关于如何做的绝佳建议。

english: If you want to know more, your best shout's going to be heading down into the cave on the island for a chinwag with Charles. He's the local expert on this sort of stuff.
translation: 如果你想知道更多，你最好的选择是去岛上的洞穴跟查尔斯聊聊。他是这类事情的当地专家。

english: I might just do that. Thanks, Jim.
translation: 我可能会那样做。谢谢，吉姆。

english: Not a problem, mate. Do you need any more tips?
translation: 没问题，伙计。你需要更多建议吗？

english: Can you tell me more about shipwreck salvaging?
translation: 你能多告诉我些关于沉船打捞吗？

english: Well, as the name suggests, mate, it's all about salvaging old shipwrecks from the sea. Keeps the place nice and tidy, and allows you to snag some swag from those that don't need it anymore.
translation: 嗯，顾名思义，伙计，就是关于从海里打捞旧沉船。保持地方整洁，让你从那些不再需要它的人那里捞点战利品。

english: To get started, you're going to want to head over to the shipyard and sort yourself out with a proper nice salvaging hook. The flashier the hook, the quicker you'll be able to salvage.
translation: 要开始，你想去船厂给自己弄个合适的打捞钩。钩子越炫酷，你能打捞得越快。

english: Once you've got your hook all nicely set up, it's time to head out and find a shipwreck. You've got plenty of different types to pick from. Once you spot a good one, just use the hook to get stuck in.
translation: 一旦你把钩子设置好，就该出去找沉船了。你有很多不同类型可选。一旦你发现一个好的，就用钩子开工。

english: You'll want to keep salvaging until you're feeling chuffed with your haul. Then you just need to use a salvaging station to sort through it all. Any half-decent port's going to have one.
translation: 你想继续打捞直到你对你的收获感到满意。然后你只需要用打捞站来整理所有东西。任何像样的港口都会有一个。

english: I see. Thanks for the information.
translation: 我明白了。谢谢你的信息。

english: Always a pleasure, mate. Wanting any other tips?
translation: 总是很愉快，伙计。想要其他建议吗？

english: Can you tell me more about Barracuda Trials?
translation: 你能多告诉我些关于梭鱼试炼吗？

english: Sure can, mate. The Barracudas are a top group of daredevils, but they're also proper show-offs. They like to head out in their fancy boats, giving it proper beans and pushing them right to the limit.
translation: 当然可以，伙计。梭鱼俱乐部是一群顶级冒险家，但他们也是真正的爱现的家伙。他们喜欢开着他们的炫酷船出去，全力以赴并把它们推到极限。

english: If you're a bit of a cheeky sod yourself, you might want to get involved in one of their trials. All of them are about speeding around and clocking the best time possible.
translation: 如果你自己是个调皮鬼，你可能想参与他们的一个试炼。所有这些都是关于四处飞驰和创下最佳时间。

english: Anyway, if you fancy it, the nearest one is just south of here in the Storm Tempor. Just don't go being a lemon and jumping in without a boat that's up to the task. Last thing you want is to go and sink!
translation: 总之，如果你 fancy，最近的一个就在南边的风暴 Tempor。别做个傻瓜没有合适的船就跳进去。你最不想的就是去沉船！

english: I'll be sure to keep that in mind. Thanks, Jim.
translation: 我一定会记住。谢谢，吉姆。

english: No worries, mate. Need any other tips?
translation: 别担心，伙计。需要其他建议吗？

english: Can you tell me more about deep sea trawling?
translation: 你能多告诉我些关于深海拖网吗？

english: To be honest, mate, it's not something I'm properly clued up on. The basic gist though is that it's all about heading out in your boat to snag some fish that you wouldn't normally be able to get your mitts on.
translation: 老实说，伙计，那不是我很清楚的事情。基本要点是开着你的船出去捞一些你通常无法弄到手的鱼。

english: Still, you don't need to worry, mate. I may not be able to help you, but word is there's a geezer who can over in Port Roberts. Kellan is his name apparently.
translation: 不过，你不需要担心，伙计。我可能帮不了你，但听说 Port Roberts 那边有个家伙可以。显然他的名字叫凯兰。

english: Is there anything else I should keep in mind?
translation: 还有什么我需要记住的吗？

english: Well, mate, you're going to want to keep taking full advantage of the shipyard. If you don't keep regularly upgrading your boat and the facilities on it, you're just holding yourself back for no good reason.
translation: 嗯，伙计，你想继续充分利用船厂。如果你不定期升级你的船和上面的设施，你只是无缘无故地阻碍自己。

english: Speaking of which, don't be afraid to sort yourself out with more than one boat. That way you can have different ones with different facilities on them. Do that, and you'll be golden regardless of what you're up to.
translation: 说到这个，别害怕给自己弄多于一艘船。那样你可以有不同的船上面有不同的设施。那样做，无论你在做什么你都会稳操胜券。

english: Another thing to remember is that you don't need to go it alone. Get yourself a proper bang up crew, mate. They'll be able to help you with all sorts of things on your boat.
translation: 另一件要记住的事是你不需要独自去。给自己弄个顶尖船员，伙计。他们能在你的船上帮你各种事情。

english: Just speak to the Crew Registrar down the docks and she'll get you properly sorted out.
translation: 就跟码头的船员登记官说话，她会给你安排妥当。

english: Finally, mate, while self-betterment is ace and all that, don't forget to kick back, chill out, and enjoy yourself! Sometimes it ain't about the destination, it's about the journey!
translation: 最后，伙计，虽然自我提升是很棒之类的，别忘了放松休息，享受自己！有时不是关于目的地，是关于旅程！

english: Very true. Thanks, Jim.
translation: 非常正确。谢谢，吉姆。

english: Always a pleasure, mate. Need any other tips?
translation: 总是很愉快，伙计。需要其他建议吗？

english: Oh, that's good to know, thanks for the tip! Out of curiosity, what outfit is that?

english: It's called the Rogue's outfit. I got it from the Rogue's Den in Burthorpe. I've found it helps me blend in when pickpocketing people, allowing me to steal more coins from them.
translation: 叫盗贼套装。我从伯索普公国的盗贼巢穴得到的。我发现它能在偷窃时帮我融入环境，让我能偷到更多金币。

english: It looks cool. Does it also help here?

english: Ha ha ha, of course not! I don't think the coffin cares whether or not I blend in.

english: Good point. Why are you wearing it though if it doesn't help you get more loot?

english: Honestly, I just really like how it looks. You've got to look your best while travelling right?

english: Each to their own I suppose. I'll be off. Best of luck down here.

english: Who, or what, are you anyway?

english: They then have the right to request one thing of me before returning my token.

translation: 平衡已恢复。

translation: 现在我们会帮你。

translation: 你忙的时候，我们也在忙。

translation: 我们找到了你问题的原因。

english: Be masterof your mind rather than master by your mind.
translation: 做你思想的主人而不是被思想主宰。

english: A reflection on a pool of water does not reveal its depth.
translation: 水池中的倒影不会揭示它的深度。

english: When you aim for perfection, you discover it's a moving target.
translation: 当你瞄准完美时，你会发现它是个移动靶。

english: He who speaks in anger makes his anger heard, but his words forgotten.
translation: 愤怒中说话的人让他的愤怒被听到，但他的话语被遗忘。

english: Patience and persistence can bring down the tallest trees.
translation: 耐心和坚持能推倒最高的树。

english: I don't need that.
translation: 我不需要那个。

english: Here, have this.
translation: 来，拿着这个。

english: Where are they from?
translation: 它们从哪来？

english: How did they get here?
translation: 它们怎么到这的？

english: Why are they here?
translation: 它们为什么在这里？

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！

english: Hello youngster!
translation: 你好年轻人！

english: The child is too busy playing to take any notice.
translation: 孩子太忙玩耍了没注意。

english: Hello. I Kangai Mau of the Rantuki tribe.
translation: 你好。我是兰图基部落的康盖‧毛。

english: I looking for someone brave to go on important mission for me. Someone skilled in thievery and sneaking about. I am told I can find such people in Brimhaven.
translation: 我在找勇敢的人为我执行重要任务。擅长偷窃和潜行的人。我听说能在布尔哈文镇找到这样的人。

english: Tell me of this mission.
translation: 告诉我这个任务。

english: I need someone to go on a mission to the city of Ardougne. There you will find the house of Lord Handelmort. In his house he has our tribal totem.
translation: 我需要有人去阿多尼城执行任务。在那里你会找到汉德尔莫特领主的房子。在他房子里他有我们的部落图腾。

english: We need it back.
translation: 我们需要它回来。

english: Why does he have it?
translation: 他为什么有它？

english: Lord Handelmort is an Ardougnese explorer which means he think he have the right to come to my tribal home, steal our stuff and put in his private museum.
translation: 汉德尔莫特领主是个阿多尼探险家，这意味着他认为他有权来我的部落家园，偷我们的东西放进他的私人博物馆。

english: Ok, I will get it back.
translation: 好的，我会把它拿回来。

english: Best of luck with that adventurer.
translation: 祝你好运冒险者。

english: How can I find Handelmort's house? Ardougne is a big place...
translation: 我怎么找到汉德尔莫特的房子？阿多尼城是个大地方……

english: I don't know Ardougne. You tell me.
translation: 我不认识阿多尼城。你告诉我。

english: Well good luck with that.
translation: 那祝你好运。

english: Let's hope I find some help soon.
translation: 希望我很快能找到些帮助。

english: I'm in search of adventure!
translation: 我在寻找冒险！

english: Adventure is something I may be able to give.
translation: 冒险是我可能能给予的东西。

english: Who are the Rantuki tribe?
translation: 谁是兰图基部落？

english: A proud and noble tribe of Karamja. But now we are few, as men come from across sea, steal our land, and settle on our hunting grounds.
translation: 卡拉姆詹岛一个骄傲高贵的部落。但现在我们很少了，因为人们从跨海而来，偷我们的土地，在我们的狩猎场定居。

english: And what are you doing in Brimhaven?
translation: 你在布尔哈文镇做什么？

english: Many greetings esteemed thief.
translation: 致以许多问候尊敬的盗贼。

english: Hey.
translation: 嘿。

english: Congrats. Here!
translation: 恭喜。给！

english: And what are you doing in Brimhaven?
translation: 你在布尔哈文镇做什么？

english: Yes.
translation: 是。

english: No.
translation: 否。

english: I'm in search of adventure!
translation: 我在寻找冒险！

english: Who are the Rantuki tribe?
translation: 谁是兰图基部落？

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: What brings you to our holy monument?
translation: 什么风把你吹到我们的神圣纪念碑？

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: We are the druids of Guthix. We worship our god at our famous stone circles. You will find them located throughout these lands.
translation: 我们是古斯的德鲁伊。我们在著名的石圈崇拜我们的神。你会发现它们位于这片土地各处。

english: What about the stone circle full of dark wizards?
translation: 那个满是黑暗法师的石圈呢？

english: That used to be OUR stone circle. Unfortunately, many many years ago, dark wizards cast a wicked spell upon it so that they could corrupt its power for their own evil ends.
translation: 那曾经是我们的石圈。不幸的是，很多很多年前，黑暗法师对它施了邪恶咒语，以便他们能腐化它的力量为他们自己的邪恶目的。

english: When they cursed the rocks for their rituals they made them useless to us and our magics. We require a brave adventurer to go on a quest for us to help purify the circle of Varrock.
translation: 当他们为了仪式诅咒岩石时，它们对我和我们的魔法没用了。我们需要一个勇敢的冒险者为我们执行任务帮助净化阿多尼城的石圈。

english: So what's so good about Guthix?
translation: 那么古斯有什么好的？

english: Guthix is the oldest and most powerful god in Gielinor. His existence is vital to this world. He is the god of balance, and nature; he is also a very part of this world.
translation: 古斯是基利诺尔最古老最强大的神。他的存在对这个世界至关重要。他是平衡与自然之神；他也是这个世界的一部分。

english: He exists in the trees, and the flowers, the water and the rocks. He is everywhere. His purpose is to ensure balance in everything in this world, and as such we worship him.
translation: 他存在于树木、花朵、水和岩石中。他无处不在。他的目的是确保这个世界万物的平衡，因此我们崇拜他。

english: He sounds kind of boring...
translation: 他听起来有点无聊……

english: Some day when your mind achieves enlightenment you will see the true beauty of his power.
translation: 总有一天当你的思想达到启蒙你会看到他力量的真正美丽。

english: Well, I'll be on my way now.
translation: 嗯，我现在走了。

english: Goodbye adventurer. I feel we shall meet again.
translation: 再见冒险者。我觉得我们会再见。

english: I'm in search of a quest.
translation: 我在寻找任务。

english: Hmm. I think I may have a worthwhile quest for you actually. I don't know if you are familiar with the stone circle south of Varrock or not, but...
translation: 嗯。我想我实际上可能有个值得的任务给你。我不知道你是否熟悉阿多尼城南边的石圈，但是……

english: Okay, I will try and help.
translation: 好的，我会尝试帮忙。

english: Excellent. Go to the village south of this place and speak to my fellow druid, Sanfew, who is working on the purification ritual. He knows what is required to complete it.
translation: 太好了。去这个地点南边的村庄跟我的德鲁伊同伴桑福说话，他在做净化仪式。他知道完成它需要什么。

english: Will do.
translation: 会做的。

english: No, that doesn't sound very interesting.
translation: 不，那听起来不太有趣。

english: I will not try and change your mind adventurer. Some day when you have matured you may reconsider your position. We will wait until then.
translation: 我不会试图改变你的想法冒险者。总有一天当你成熟了你可能重新考虑你的立场。我们会等到那时。

english: Did you build this?
translation: 你建了这个？

english: What, personally? No, of course I didn't. However, our forefathers did. The first Druids of Guthix built many stone circles across these lands over eight hundred years ago.
translation: 什么，亲自？不，当然我没有。不过，我们的祖先做了。古斯的第一批德鲁伊在八百多年前在这片土地建了许多石圈。

english: Unfortunately we only know of two remaining, and of those only one is usable by us anymore.
translation: 不幸的是我们只知道两个剩下的，其中只有一个我们还能用。

english: Hello again. How is the Herblore going?
translation: 又见面了。草药学进展如何？

english: Very well, thank you.
translation: 很好，谢谢。

english: That is good to hear.
translation: 那很好听。

english: I need more practice at it...
translation: 我需要更多练习……

english: Persistence is key to success.
translation: 坚持是成功的关键。

english: Can you explain the fundamentals again?
translation: 你能再解释一下基础吗？

english: Indeed I will...
translation: 当然我会……

english: Herblore is the skill of working with herbs and other ingredients, to make useful potions and poison.
translation: 草药学是使用草药和其他配料制作有用药水和毒药的技能。

english: First you will need a vial, which can be found or made with the crafting skill.
translation: 首先你需要一个小瓶，可以找到或用制作技能制作。

english: Then you must gather the herbs needed to make the potion you want.
translation: 然后你必须收集制作你想要的药水所需的草药。

english: You must fill your vial with water and add the ingredients you need. There are normally 2 ingredients to each type of potion.
translation: 你必须把小瓶装满水并加入你需要的配料。通常每种药水有2种配料。

english: Bear in mind, you must first clean each herb before you can use it.
translation: 记住，你必须先清洗每种草药才能使用。

english: You may also have to grind some ingredients before you can use them. You will need a pestle and mortar in order to do this.
translation: 你可能还需要在使用前研磨一些配料。你需要研钵和研杵来做这个。

english: Herbs can be found on the ground, and are also dropped by some monsters when you kill them.
translation: 草药可以在地上找到，杀死某些怪物时也会掉落。

english: Let's try an example Attack potion: The first ingredient is Guam leaf; the next is Eye of Newt.
translation: 让我们试个例子攻击药水：第一种配料是瓜姆叶；其次是蝾螈之眼。

english: Mix these in your water-filled vial, and you will produce an Attack potion. Drink this potion to increase your Attack level.
translation: 把这些在你的装满水的小瓶里混合，你会制作出攻击药水。喝这个药水增加你的攻击等级。

english: Different potions also require different Herblore levels before you can make them.
translation: 不同药水也需要不同草药学等级才能制作。

english: Good luck with your Herblore practices, and a good day to you.
translation: 祝你的草药学练习好运，祝你日安。

english: Thanks for your help.
translation: 谢谢你的帮助。

english: What must I do to wear a Herblore skillcape?
translation: 我必须做什么才能穿草药学技能斗篷？

english: To earn the right to wear any skillcape you need to have mastered that skill to the highest level possible and it is no different for Herblore.
translation: 要获得穿任何技能斗篷的权利你需要掌握该技能到最高等级，草药学也不例外。

english: With the cape equipped the Nardah Herbalist will create unfinished potions for you and you may search the cape for a pestle and mortar. When you have achieved a level of 99, come back and talk to me again.
translation: 装备斗篷后那尔达城草药师会为你制作未完成药水，你可以搜索斗篷寻找研钵和研杵。当你达到99级时，回来再跟我谈。

english: Most certainly; the Nardah Herbalist will recognize this cape and create unfinished potions for you and it may be searched for a pestle and mortar.
translation: 当然；那尔达城草药师会识别这个斗篷并为你制作未完成药水，它可以被搜索寻找研钵和研杵。

english: It has been a pleasure to watch you grow as a herbalist. I am privileged to have been instrumental in your learning, but I must ask for a donation of 99,000 coins to cover the expense of the cape.
translation: 看着你作为草药师成长很愉快。我很荣幸能在你的学习中起作用，但我必须要求捐赠99,000金币覆盖斗篷费用。

english: I'm afraid that's too much money for me.
translation: 恐怕那钱对我来说太多了。

english: Not at all; there are many other adventurers who would love the opportunity to purchase such a prestigious item. You can find me here if you change your mind.
translation: 一点也不；有许多其他冒险者会喜欢购买这样享有盛誉物品的机会。如果你改变主意可以在这里找到我。

english: Okay, here's 99,000 coins.
translation: 好的，这是99,000金币。

english: Good luck to you, [player name].
translation: 祝你好运，[player name]。

english: Most certainly, but I must ask for a donation of 99,000 coins to cover the expense of the cape.
translation: 当然，但我必须要求捐赠99,000金币覆盖斗篷费用。

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood; it's part of a skill promotion deal - buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 不幸的是所有技能斗篷只搭配免费兜帽出售；这是技能促销的一部分——买一送一，你知道的。所以你需要先腾出些物品栏空间我才能卖给你。

english: Can I get a hood for my skillcape, please?
translation: 我能给我的技能斗篷要个兜帽吗？

english: Most certainly, and free of charge!
translation: 当然，而且免费！

english: You don't appear to have enough space in your inventory, come back and see me when you do.
translation: 你似乎物品栏没足够空间，有了再来见我。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: What about the stone circle full of dark wizards?
translation: 那个满是黑暗法师的石圈呢？

english: Yes.
translation: 是。

english: No.
translation: 否。

english: So what's so good about Guthix?
translation: 那么古斯有什么好的？

english: Well, I'll be on my way now.
translation: 嗯，我现在走了。

english: I'm in search of a quest.
translation: 我在寻找任务。

english: Did you build this?
translation: 你建了这个？

english: I'm in search of a quest
translation: 我在寻找任务

english: Very well, thank you.
translation: 很好，谢谢。

english: I need more practice at it...
translation: 我需要更多练习……

english: Can you explain the fundamentals again?
translation: 你能再解释一下基础吗？

english: What must I do to wear a Herblore skillcape?
translation: 我必须做什么才能穿草药学技能斗篷？

english: May I buy a Herblore skillcape, please
translation: 我可以买草药学技能斗篷吗

english: I'm afraid that's too much money for me.
translation: 恐怕那钱对我来说太多了。

english: Okay, here's 99,000 coins.
translation: 好的，这是99,000金币。

english: Can I get a hood for my skillcape, please?
translation: 我能给我的技能斗篷要个兜帽吗？

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Oh, I'm a fisherman by trade and I sometimes help out my father, Safta Doc.
translation: 哦，我是职业渔夫，我有时帮我父亲萨夫塔‧多克。

english: Is there anything interesting to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么有趣的事做吗？

english: Bwana, if anyone else asks me that question today, I'll explode! Go and ask someone else!
translation: 布瓦纳，如果今天还有人问我那个问题，我会爆炸！去问别人！

english: Not that I'm aware of, just sit back and enjoy the sunshine bwana!
translation: 据我所知没有，只管坐下享受阳光布瓦纳！

english: Sorry Bwana, I'm already busy, why not go and talk to Murcaily! He's around the village somewhere.
translation: 抱歉布瓦纳，我已经忙了，何不去跟穆尔凯利谈谈！他在村里某处。

english: Well, I think that there's some work to be done...perhaps Murcaily can help you. He usually tends to the hardwood grove to the east of Trufitus's hut.
translation: 嗯，我想有些事要做……也许穆尔凯利能帮你。他通常照料特鲁菲图斯小屋东边的硬木林。

english: It's just village life as normal around here Bwana, always something interesting to find to occupy your time if you look hard enough.
translation: 这附近只是正常的村庄生活布瓦纳，只要你努力找，总有有趣的事发现来占用你的时间。

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
translation: 我一直在村里做些工作。

english: I've already given you some trading sticks and I don't have any more on me at the moment. Why not go and talk to some of the other villagers and get some contributions?
translation: 我已经给了你一些交易棒，目前我身上没更多了。何不去跟其他村民谈谈弄些贡献？

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Hey, I've seen you working around the village. You've been doing a lot of good work around here for us. Let me give you something for your trouble.
translation: 嘿，我看到你在村里工作。你为我们在这里做了很多好事。让我给你点东西作为麻烦的报酬。

english: Ahhhhhhhh - Get away from me you beast!
translation: 啊——离我远点你这野兽！

english: What's the problem....oh, I'm wearing this big scary mask! I'd better take it off before I start talking to the natives.
translation: 什么问题……哦，我戴着这个大可怕面具！我最好在跟当地人说话前摘掉。

english: Waahhhhh! - It's da evil broodoo beast come ta eat my very soul!
translation: 哇！——是邪恶的布鲁多兽来吃我的灵魂了！

english: Ahhhhhhhh - It's a monster!
translation: 啊——是个怪物！

english: Ahhhhhhhh!!
What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Is there anything interesting to do here?
translation: 这里有什么有趣的事做吗？

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
translation: 我一直在村里做些工作。

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: What are you doing now?
translation: 你现在做什么？

english: My squad and I are to remain on this island in secret. The monkeys think we are trying to break our friends out of the jail, but we are just biding our time.
translation: 我和我的小队要秘密留在这个岛上。猴子以为我们试图把朋友从监狱救出来，但我们只是在等待时机。

english: What are you still doing here?
translation: 你还在这里做什么？

english: I'm hunting for maniacal monkeys that escaped Glough's airship laboratory!
translation: 我在猎杀从格劳夫飞艇实验室逃跑的疯狂猴子！

english: Any luck?
translation: 有运气吗？

english: Not yet, I'm still perfecting my strategy... I'll let you know as soon as I find a way.
translation: 还没有，我还在完善我的策略……我一找到方法就告诉你。

english: You dare disturb my rest!
translation: 你敢打扰我的休息！

english: You dare steal from us!
translation: 你敢偷我们的东西！

english: Would you like to buy a nice kebab? Only one gold.
translation: 你想买个好吃的烤肉串吗？只要一个金币。

english: I think I'll give it a miss.
translation: 我想我就算了。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Oops, I forgot to bring any money with me.
translation: 哎呀，我忘了带钱。

english: Come back when you have some.
translation: 有了再来。

english: What do you think of Ali Morrisane?
translation: 你觉得阿里‧莫里桑怎么样？

english: I don't like him. He makes all these claims about being the best salesman in Gielinor, and he even has some thugs that he's hired to threaten us.
translation: 我不喜欢他。他声称自己是基利诺尔最好的销售员，他甚至雇了些暴徒威胁我们。

english: One of them came round here and threatened to cut my head off if I didn't cooperate with them!
translation: 他们中有一个来这里威胁如果我不合作就砍我的头！

english: I've also heard some rumours about them from my friend Ali in Pollnivneach...
translation: 我也从我在波尼尼镇的朋友阿里那里听到些关于他们的传闻……

english: What sort of rumours?
translation: 什么类型的传闻？

english: Apparently he has men there as well, who have also been threatening people.
translation: 显然他在那里也有人，也在威胁人。

english: And it's said that they even intend to steal from the ruler of Al Kharid himself!
translation: 据说他们甚至打算从阿尔卡里德城的统治者本人那里偷窃！

english: Really?
translation: 真的？

english: That's what I've heard. Anyway, are you sure you wouldn't like a kebab?
translation: 那是我听到的。总之，你确定你不想要烤肉串？

english: I've got a little problem for you to solve.
translation: 我有个小问题给你解决。

english: The salesman has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 销售员给了你一个挑战卷轴！

english: Please enter the answer to the riddle.
translation: 请输入谜语的答案。

english: No that's not right, think again.
translation: 不那不对，再想想。

english: Correct!
translation: 正确！

english: The salesman has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 销售员给了你另一个线索卷轴！

english: I think I'll give it a miss.
translation: 我想我就算了。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: What do you think of Ali Morrisane?
translation: 你觉得阿里‧莫里桑怎么样？

english: Hello there, human! Come in, come in!
translation: 你好，人类！进来，进来！

english: Hi, nice to see you!
translation: 嗨，很高兴见到你！

english: Tell me, what brings you here?
translation: 告诉我，什么风把你吹来？

english: Well, first I came to this city just for the adventure and excitement, but then I knocked over this statue, you see. Well, I didn't really knock it over myself, I was on this boat.
translation: 嗯，首先我来这个城市只是为了冒险和刺激，但后来我撞倒了这个雕像，你看。嗯，其实不是我自己撞倒的，我在船上。

english: A boat! Fascinating, go on!
translation: 船！迷人，继续！

english: Yes, well, this boatman was a bit rubbish, or there was something wrong with the ship, I don't know. And then I got arrested by the Black Guard.
translation: 是的，嗯，这个船夫有点垃圾，或者船有问题，我不知道。然后我被黑卫队逮捕了。

english: Not the Black Guard!
translation: 不是黑卫队！

english: Yes, and they took me to this Veldaban person, who pretended to be really angry but actually he was really nice and he asked me for my help.
translation: 是的，他们把我带到这个叫维尔达班的人那里，他假装很生气但实际上他很好，他请求我的帮助。

english: So here I am, helping to rebuild the statue.
translation: 所以我在这里，帮忙重建雕像。

english: And after a whole lot of running around, I finally managed to get the statue to be rebuilt.
translation: 经过一番奔波，我终于成功让雕像被重建。

english: Such an interesting tale!
translation: 如此有趣的故事！

english: Now how did you come to be in Keldagrim again?
translation: 现在你怎么又来凯尔达格林城了？

english: Never mind.
translation: 算了。

english: Well? Who are you?
translation: 嗯？你是谁？

english: I'm player, and you are?
translation: 我是 player，你是？

english: I think you already know the answer to that.
translation: 我想你已经知道答案了。

english: Er... Do I?
translation: 呃……我知道？

english: Shaw. Kasonde Shaw. Don't go acting like you haven't been following me for some time now.
translation: 肖。卡森德‧肖。别装作你这段时间没跟踪我。

english: Ah, of course. Those old ruins.
translation: 啊，当然。那些古老遗迹。

english: Exactly. Perhaps you took me for a fool, but I was on to you from the start. Considering what we learnt, I knew it was only a matter of time before you showed up.
translation: 没错。也许你把我当傻瓜，但我从一开始就注意到你了。考虑到我们学到的，我知道你出现只是时间问题。

english: You mean soul transference? Not actually something that interests me, to be honest.
translation: 你是指灵魂转移？老实说，那其实不是我感兴趣的。

english: Don't take me for a fool! If you had no interest in the Old Ones' secrets, why would you have followed me to those ruins? And why would you have come here?
translation: 别把我当傻瓜！如果你对古老者的秘密没兴趣，你为什么跟踪我到那些遗迹？你为什么来这里？

english: To be honest, I didn't even know what an Old One was. I still don't really. I was just exploring when I found your camp.
translation: 老实说，我甚至不知道什么是古老者。我现在还不知道。我只是在探索时发现了你的营地。

english: As for why I'm here, I'm looking for information about someone called Vardorvis.
translation: 至于我为什么在这里，我在寻找关于一个叫瓦尔多维斯的人的信息。

english: Really? You want me to believe that all of this is a coincidence?
translation: 真的？你想让我相信这一切都是巧合？

english: Well... yes.
translation: 嗯……是的。

english: You're lying! You're lying and...
translation: 你在撒谎！你在撒谎而且……

english: Hang on... do you hear that?
translation: 等等……你听到那个吗？

english: Hear what?
translation: 听到什么？

english: The Strangled! Did you disturb any tendrils on your way in here?
translation: 被扼者！你进来时打扰任何触须了吗？

english: I may have...?
translation: 我可能……？

english: They'll be coming. We've got no chance up here. Head down below! Now!
translation: 它们会来。我们在这里没机会。去下面！现在！

english: That's the lot of them. Let's head back up.
translation: 那是它们全部。我们回去吧。

english: That was too close. You nearly got us both killed!
translation: 太险了。你差点让我们俩都死了！

english: I don't understand... What are those things? Are they zombies?
translation: 我不明白……那些东西是什么？它们是僵尸吗？

english: You really want me to believe that you don't know anything about this place?
translation: 你真的想让我相信你对这个地方一无所知？

english: I already told you, I wasn't lying.
translation: 我告诉过你了，我没撒谎。

english: Well I don't have any reason to trust that.
translation: 嗯我没理由相信那个。

english: With how dangerous this place is, do you really have a choice?
translation: 这地方这么危险，你真的有选择吗？

english: Hmm...
Alright, fine. But I have no desire to see you get us killed, so you'd better wisen up fast.
translation: 好吧，行。但我不想看到你让我们死，所以你最好快点聪明点。

english: I'm listening.
translation: 我在听。

english: It all starts with the Old Ones. They lived here long before humans came to these lands, and these ruins here were once their home.
translation: 一切都从古老者开始。他们在人类来到这片土地很久以前就住在这里，这里的遗迹曾经是他们的家。

english: And these Old Ones discovered soul transference?
translation: 这些古老者发现了灵魂转移？

english: They did, and they did so long before House Arceuus even existed. It was their final attempt to overcome their extinction, but they failed.
translation: 他们发现了，而且在阿西乌斯之家存在之前很久。这是他们克服灭绝的最后尝试，但他们失败了。

english: What you see around you is the result of their failure. It's known as the Strangler.
translation: 你周围看到的是他们失败的结果。它被称为扼杀者。

english: The Strangler?
translation: 扼杀者？

english: It's some sort of parasite. It was presumably meant to play a role in their transference rituals, but instead it destroyed them. It has remained here ever since.
translation: 它是某种寄生虫。它本来应该在他们的转移仪式中起作用，但它反而摧毁了他们。从那以后它一直留在这里。

english: Hence the Strangled?
translation: 所以叫被扼者？

english: Exactly. Plenty of unwary fools have fallen victim to the Strangler. If you don't take care, you will share their fate.
translation: 没错。许多不小心的傻瓜成了扼杀者的受害者。如果你不小心，你会分享他们的命运。

english: So how do we deal with them?
translation: 那我们怎么对付它们？

english: The trick is to maintain your distance. They're relatively passive unless you get too close, but if you disturb one, the rest will quickly come running.
translation: 诀窍是保持距离。它们相对被动除非你太靠近，但如果你打扰一个，其余的会很快跑来。

english: If you need to fight one, try to do it away from the rest!
translation: 如果你需要打一个，尽量远离其他的打！

english: And stay off of the tendrils! You'll alert the lot of them to your location! It's like a network.
translation: 并且远离触须！你会 alert 它们全部到你的位置！它像个网络。

english: Keep my distance and stay off the tendrils. I can do that. So what's our next move?
translation: 保持距离并远离触须。我能做到。那么我们的下一步是什么？

english: The fact that you're still alive tells me you broke into my home and stole some of the potion I made.
translation: 你还活着的事实告诉我你闯进我家偷了我做的一些药水。

english: 'Broke in' is maybe a bit strong...
translation: ‘闯进’可能有点重……

english: Call it what you want, it's not important now. What is important is that I believe I can make a more powerful potion using ingredients found here.
translation: 随你怎么叫，现在不重要。重要的是我相信我可以用这里找到的配料制作更强大的药水。

english: If all goes well, this potion will provide increased immunity against the Strangler. If either of us are to find what we want here, it will be essential.
translation: 如果一切顺利，这个药水会提供对扼杀者增加的免疫力。如果我们中任何一个要在这里找到我们想要的，它至关重要。

english: So what ingredients do we need?
translation: 那么我们需要什么配料？

english: As you've no doubt seen, the Strangler infects plant life as well. However, I've come across a small number of plants that seem to have developed immunity.
translation: 正如你无疑看到的，扼杀者也感染植物生命。然而，我遇到少量似乎已经发展出免疫力的植物。

english: First, there's a herb growing atop the cliff just north west of the temple. Second, there are some berries in an old camp on the coast to the south west.
translation: 首先，神庙西北边悬崖顶上长着一种草药。其次，西南海岸一个旧营地里有些浆果。

english: Alright, I can gather those.
translation: 好的，我能收集那些。

english: I need to gather some additional ingredients from within the temple. I will meet you back here once I'm done.
translation: 我需要从神庙内收集一些额外配料。我完成后会在这里跟你汇合。

english: Kasonde! Are you okay?
translation: 卡森德！你没事吧？

english: Damn it! Damn it! This can't happen! It can't!
translation: 该死！该死！这不能发生！不能！

english: Kasonde?
translation: 卡森德？

english: Kasonde shows you his arm. There's a large bite from one of the Strangled.
translation: 卡森德给你看他的手臂。有个被扼者的大咬痕。

english: Kasonde...
translation: 卡森德……

english: It's fine! This doesn't change anything.
translation: 没事！这不改变任何事。

english: But the infection...
translation: 但感染……

english: The infection means nothing!
translation: 感染什么都不算！

english: I was a dead man either way...
translation: 我反正都是死人……

english: What are you on about?
translation: 你在说什么？

english: Koreps Syndrome. Common among botanists apparently. You'd have thought we'd have put some effort into finding a cure, but I guess no one ever thinks they'll be the unlucky one.
translation: 科雷普斯综合症。显然在植物学家中常见。你会以为我们会努力寻找治愈方法，但我想没人认为他们会是那个不幸的。

english: Kasonde, I...
translation: 卡森德，我……

english: Don't. Whatever you have to say, I don't want to hear it. Do you know how many times I've heard the word 'sorry'? Do you know how many times people have told me they understand?
translation: 别。无论你要说什么，我不想听。你知道我听过多少次‘对不起’吗？你知道多少人告诉过我他们理解吗？

english: Well they don't. I spent every day working away, telling myself that one day I'd finally be able to live my life, but it was all a lie. That was my life, and it was all so... meaningless!
translation: 他们不理解。我每天努力工作，告诉自己总有一天我终于能过我的生活，但那是谎言。那是我的生活，一切都如此……无意义！

english: I tried everything. I went to every healer, ever mage, every priest.
translation: 我试了一切。我找了每个治疗师，每个法师，每个牧师。

english: I went to House Arceuus, and they turned me away! What gives them the right?!
translation: 我去了阿西乌斯之家，他们把我拒之门外！他们有什么权利？！

english: So no, this doesn't change anything. The Old Ones are my last hope. I either find their secrets, or...
translation: 所以不，这不改变任何事。古老者是我最后的希望。我要么找到他们的秘密，要么……

english: Look, we're wasting time here! There's a ritual site to the west. Presumably it's where the Strangler was unleashed. It's my best hope now, and it may well be where you'll find what you're after as well.
translation: 看，我们在这里浪费时间！西边有个仪式地点。大概是扼杀者被释放的地方。现在这是我最好的希望，也很可能是你找到你想要的地方。

english: Take this potion and add those ingredients you gathered to it. It should strengthen your immunity against the Strangler. Now go!
translation: 拿着这个药水并加入你收集的那些配料。它应该增强你对扼杀者的免疫力。现在走！

english: Hello, you must be a traveller.
translation: 你好，你一定是旅行者。

english: Well guessed, adventurer.
translation: 猜得好，冒险者。

english: Are you from Lovakengj?
translation: 你来自洛瓦肯吉城？

english: You are wrong this time, adventurer. I'm actually from Ice Mountain.
translation: 你这次错了，冒险者。我其实来自冰山。

english: I always wanted to visit Lovakengj to see the Blast Mine. This year I finally saved up enough to travel here.
translation: 我一直想参观洛瓦肯吉城看爆破矿场。今年我终于攒够钱来这里旅行。

english: However, the war with the lizardmen means Lovakengj is dangerous to get to from here. I'll need to go the long way round.
translation: 然而，与蜥蜴人的战争意味着从这里去洛瓦肯吉城很危险。我需要绕远路。

english: What do you think about this place?
translation: 你觉得这个地方怎么样？

english: To be honest, Shayzien is a bit boring for visitors. It's all about war and military things.
translation: 老实说，谢兹恩城对游客有点无聊。都是关于战争和军事的事。

english: The only place I would recommend is the Cloak and Stagger. You'll find some pretty good drinks there.
translation: 我唯一推荐的地方是斗篷与踉跄。你会在那里找到些不错的饮料。

english: See you later.
translation: 回头见。

english: Are you from Lovakengj?
translation: 你来自洛瓦肯吉城？

english: How do you feel about this place?
translation: 你觉得这个地方怎么样？

english: See you later.
translation: 回头见。

english: Oh dear, oh dear, oh dear...
translation: 哦天，哦天，哦天……

english: Oh dear?
translation: 哦天？

english: It's terrible!
translation: 太可怕了！

english: What's terrible?
translation: 什么太可怕了？

english: Oh, never mind, dearie. What can I do for you?
translation: 哦，算了，亲爱的。我能为你做什么？

english: Can you take me downstream in your boat?
translation: 你能用你的船带我下游吗？

english: Ooh, it's dangerous up there at the moment!
translation: 哦，上面现在很危险！

english: I'm not afraid - let's go!
translation: 我不怕——走吧！

english: It's dangerous up there for me too, dearie.
translation: 上面对我来说也危险，亲爱的。

english: Would it help if I gave you some money?
translation: 如果我给你些钱会有帮助吗？

english: Ooh, that's better! I'll take you up north for 50 shiny coins.
translation: 哦，那更好！我带你去北方收50个亮闪闪的金币。

english: Alright, I'll pay.
translation: 好的，我付。

english: Kathy Corkat rows you down the river to the sea...
translation: 凯西‧科卡特划船送你下游到海……

english: Not a chance!
translation: 没门！

english: Then you can find your own way north, dearie!
translation: 那你自己找路去北方，亲爱的！

english: Dangerous? Nah, forget it!
translation: 危险？不，算了！

english: I don't think I want anything, thanks.
translation: 我想我不想要什么，谢谢。

english: Everybody wants something, dearie!
translation: 每个人都想要什么，亲爱的！

english: Huh? Oh, forget it!
translation: 哈？哦，算了！

english: I'll be glad to get away from this place, dearie! Fancy a lift up the river?
translation: 我很高兴离开这个地方，亲爱的！想搭便船上游？

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Kathy Corkat rows you up the river...
translation: 凯西‧科卡特划船送你上游……

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Hello dearie. Heading up north to the Fishing Colony, are we?
translation: 你好亲爱的。我们要去北方钓鱼殖民地，对吧？

english: Are ye wantin' a lift up the river, dearie?
translation: 你想搭便船上游吗，亲爱的？

english: Why don't you row right into the Colony? It'd make it much easier to get in there.
translation: 你为什么不直接划进殖民地？那会更容易进去。

english: Oh, Franklin doesn't like it if I take my boat too close. He says I'll damage the nets and scare the fish. But were you wanting a lift up to the river?
translation: 哦，如果我船太靠近富兰克林不喜欢。他说我会损坏网吓到鱼。但你想搭便船去河上吗？

english: Can you take me downstream in your boat?
translation: 你能用你的船带我下游吗？

english: I'm not afraid - let's go!
translation: 我不怕——走吧！

english: Alright, I'll pay.
translation: 好的，我付。

english: Not a chance!
translation: 没门！

english: Dangerous? Nah, forget it!
translation: 危险？不，算了！

english: I don't think I want anything, thanks.
translation: 我想我不想要什么，谢谢。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Why don't you row right into the Colony?
translation: 你为什么不直接划进殖民地？

english: Hello there. How's it going?
translation: 你好。怎么样？

english: Sorry, but I'm busy right now.
translation: 抱歉，但我现在忙。

english: Not too bad thanks.
translation: 还不错，谢谢。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: I'm a bold adventurer.
translation: 我是个大胆的冒险者。

english: Ah, a very noble profession.
translation: 啊，很高贵的职业。

english: I'm fine, how are you?
translation: 我很好，你呢？

english: Very well, thank you.
translation: 很好，谢谢。

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: I'm very well, thank you.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。

english: Nilsal!
translation: 你好！

english: Hello there! Nice weather we've been having.
translation: 你好！我们最近的天气真好。

english: Nilsal! I'm pretty good, thank you.
translation: 你好！我很好，谢谢。

english: Heya! What can I get you?
translation: 嘿！我能给你什么？

english: What ales are you serving?
translation: 你提供什么麦酒？

english: Well, we've got Asgarnian Ale, Wizard's Mind Bomb and Dwarven Stout, all for only 3 coins.
translation: 嗯，我们有阿斯加尼亚麦酒，法师心灵炸弹和矮人黑啤酒，都只要3金币。

english: One Asgarnian Ale, please.
translation: 一杯阿斯加尼亚麦酒，谢谢。

english: I said 3 coins! You haven't got 3 coins!
translation: 我说3金币！你没有3金币！

english: Sorry, I'll come back another day.
translation: 抱歉，我改天再来。

english: Thanks, Kaylee.
translation: 谢谢，凯莉。

english: I'll try the Mind Bomb.
translation: 我试试头脑炸弹。

english: Can I have a Dwarven Stout?
translation: 我能要杯矮人黑啤酒吗？

english: I don't feel like any of those.
translation: 那些我都不想。

english: I've got this beer glass...
translation: 我有这个啤酒杯……

english: We'll buy it for a couple of coins if you're interested.
translation: 如果你感兴趣我们花几个金币买。

english: Okay, sure.
translation: 好的，当然。

english: There you go.
translation: 给，拿好。

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！

english: No thanks, I like empty beer glasses.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我喜欢空啤酒杯。

english: I've got these beer glasses...
translation: 我有这些啤酒杯……

english: Ooh, we'll buy those off you if you're interested. 2 coins per glass.
translation: 哦，如果你感兴趣我们买下来。每个杯子2金币。

english: What's this about the party room?
translation: 派对房间怎么回事？

english: Have you heard? Someone's planning a big party!
translation: 你听说了吗？有人计划大派对！

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你什么意思？

english: Someone's put something very valuable into the party room drop chest! If you go to the party room and pull the lever you might have a chance to get it!
translation: 有人把很贵重的东西放进派对房间掉落箱！如果你去派对房间拉杠杆你可能有机会得到！

english: It could be your lucky day!
translation: 可能是你的幸运日！

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！

english: No thanks, I don't need that.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我不需要那个。

english: I have a question for you.
translation: 我有个问题问你。

english: Kaylee has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 凯莉给了你一个挑战卷轴！

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
translation: 请输入问题的答案。

english: No, try again.
translation: 不，再试一次。

english: Correct!
translation: 正确！

english: Kaylee has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 凯莉给了你另一个线索卷轴！

english: Party! Party!
translation: 派对！派对！

english: Something's happening in the party room!
translation: 派对房间有事发生！

english: Everyone get to the party room!
translation: 大家都去派对房间！

english: What's happening in the party room?
translation: 派对房间发生什么了？

english: Someone's having a big party!
translation: 有人在办大派对！

english: Get to the party room NOW!
translation: 现在就去派对房间！

english: Get to the party room!
translation: 去派对房间！

english: Get to the party room quick!
translation: 快去派对房间！

english: Big value items in the party room now!
translation: 派对房间现在有贵重物品！

english: Quick! Get to the party room!
translation: 快！去派对房间！

english: What ales are you serving?
translation: 你提供什么麦酒？

english: One Asgarnian Ale, please.
translation: 一杯阿斯加尼亚麦酒，谢谢。

english: I'll try the Mind Bomb.
translation: 我试试头脑炸弹。

english: Can I have a Dwarven Stout?

english: You don't say?
translation: 真的吗？

english: Woo! WOO WOOOOO WOOWOOWOO WOO WOOOOO!
translation: 呜！呜 呜呜呜 呜呜呜呜 呜 呜呜呜！

english: You don't say!
translation: 真的吗！

english: Wooowoowoooooo.... Woowoowoo? Woooo, wooowoo wooowooowooo!
translation: 呜呜呜呜呜呜……呜呜呜呜？呜呜，呜呜呜 呜呜呜呜呜！

english: Well, I guess you didn't say.
translation: 嗯，我想你没说。

english: Yeah, I don't want to brag, but seriously: I am SOOOO rich....
translation: 是啊，我不想吹牛，但说真的：我超级超级有钱……

english: Yeah, I know they say money doesn't bring you happiness, but sometimes I just like to open my bank account and look at all of the stuff I own and just think to myself:
translation: 是啊，我知道他们说钱买不来幸福，但有时我就是喜欢打开银行账户看着所有我拥有的东西然后对自己说：

english: Wow. I am soooooo rich.
translation: 哇。我真的超级超级有钱。

english: Well, us rich alive people don't want to waste all day spending time with you poor dead people, because I'm just sooooo rich I have to go now, and very possibly make myself even richer.
translation: 嗯，我们这些富有的活人不想整天浪费时间和你们这些可怜的死人在一起，因为我太有钱了得走了，很可能让自己更有钱。

english: See ya around ghosty!
translation: 回见鬼魂！

english: Yeah, I heard about that, ha-ha-ha!
translation: 是啊，我听说了，哈哈哈！

english: With a MACKEREL? Ouch!
translation: 用鲭鱼？哎哟！

english: Well, it was fun. Let's do it again sometime.
translation: 嗯，很有趣。改天再来一次。

english: Why, thank you very much!
translation: 哎呀，非常感谢！

english: I know, but what are you going to do?
translation: 我知道，但你能怎么办？

english: Well, I guess that's always true in the long run. See you around, weird invisible dead person!
translation: 嗯，我想长远来看总是对的。回见，奇怪的隐形死人！

english: Yeah it's not bad, but I prefer cooked chicken.
translation: 是啊不错，但我更喜欢熟鸡肉。

english: Maybe, but nothing beats a home cooked pie!
translation: 也许，但没什么比得上家里做的派！

english: Man, I love pie!
translation: 天哪，我爱派！

english: You don't say? I never knew that. Well, I must be going, see you around.
translation: 真的吗？我从不知道。嗯，我得走了，回见。

english: We get signal!
translation: 我们收到信号！

english: Somebody set up us the bomb!
translation: 有人给我们装了炸弹！

english: You have no chance to survive make your time.
translation: 你没有生存机会，抓紧时间吧。

english: Woo?
translation: 呜？

english: All your base are belong to us.
translation: 你们所有的基地都属于我们。

english: Hey, don't think you can talk to me like that!
translation: 嘿，别以为你能那样跟我说话！

english: Are you threatening me?
translation: 你在威胁我吗？

english: Just because you're already dead, doesn't mean I can't find a way to hurt you ghosty!
translation: 就因为你已经死了，不代表我没法伤害你，鬼魂！

english: No, I've never been there in my life and CERTAINLY didn't steal anything when I was!
translation: 不，我这辈子从没去过那里，当然活着时也没偷过任何东西！

english: Are you calling me a liar?!?! I have never stolen a thing in my life, and I resent the implication that I am the kind of morally depraved individual that would steal someone else's hard earned
translation: 你在说我是骗子？！我这辈子从没偷过东西，我反感这种暗示，

english: money from their very pockets!
translation: 好像我是那种会从别人口袋里偷走辛苦赚来的钱的道德败坏的人！

english: Or cakes. Or fur. Repeatedly. For long periods at a time.
translation: 或者蛋糕。或者毛皮。反复地。一次持续很长时间。

english: Well if you are going to take that attitude, then I have nothing further to say on the matter, and bid you good day!
translation: 好吧，如果你要这种态度，那我没什么好说的了，祝你日安！

english: Hello. So you must be Kharrim the messenger.
translation: 你好。所以你一定是信使卡里姆。

english: How do you know my name, stranger?
translation: 你怎么知道我的名字，陌生人？

english: Well now... I had a very interesting chat with Rennard the thief.
translation: 嗯……我和小偷伦纳德聊得很愉快。

english: It seems you redirected his message regarding a certain god-weapon for your own ends.
translation: 看来你为了自己的目的重定向了他关于某件神器的信息。

english: So THAT is what this is about... I should have known the deal was too good to have no repercussions...
translation: 所以这就是原因……我该知道这交易好得不会有后果……

english: It seems as though you might be responsible for this curse that has befallen you by not delivering Rennard's message to the correct person.
translation: 看来你可能因为没把伦纳德的信息交给正确的人而导致了降临在你身上的诅咒。

english: Ha! That is not a truthful assessment of the story... You might think differently if you had heard my side of events.
translation: 哈！那是对故事不真实的评价……如果你听过我的版本可能会想 不同地。

english: Please let me hear your side of the story then...
translation: 那请让我听听你的版本……

english: Well, if you have spoken to Rennard, then you will know that he had somehow managed to obtain a very valuable weapon, and was looking for buyers.
translation: 嗯，如果你和伦纳德谈过，你会知道他不知怎么弄到了一件非常有价值的武器，正在找买家。

english: What he probably didn't tell you, was that he met me in a drunken stupor in some smoke filled tavern, and I offered to arrange a purchaser for his item, in exchange for a small finders fee.
translation: 他可能没告诉你，他在某个烟雾缭绕的酒馆里醉醺醺地遇到我，我提出帮他安排买家，换取少量 中介费。

english: So you knew what the staff was?
translation: 所以你知道法杖是什么？

english: The god-staff of Armadyl? Well, of course I did.
translation: 阿玛杜尔的神杖？嗯，当然知道。

english: Honestly, you would have to be pretty slow-witted to not recognise a legendary artefact such as that.
translation: 老实说，你得相当迟钝才认不出那样的传奇神器。

english: Wait, I don't understand, Rennard said that he had a buyer already in mind, and that you diverted his message to a General Zamorak instead?
translation: 等等，我不明白，伦纳德说他已经有买家了，而你把他的信息转给了扎莫拉克将军？

english: Ha! Here is a word of advice for you adventurer; Never trust the words of a drunk.
translation: 哈！给你个建议冒险者；永远别信醉鬼的话。

english: Whatever he might have thought he was doing with it, in the end all that happened was he left me to arrange a purchaser for the item.
translation: 不管他以为自己在做什么，最后结果就是他让我安排买家。

english: So you thought you would offer it to General Zamorak?
translation: 所以你想把它提供给扎莫拉克将军？

english: Ah yes, Lord Zamorak. He was merely a mortal back then, you know?
translation: 啊是的，扎莫拉克领主。那时他只是个凡人，你知道？

english: Yet I could see great things in store for him even then. He had a kind of brilliant ruthlessness... And that special kind of vicious streak you see so rarely...
translation: 但即使那时我也能看到他前途无量。他有种辉煌的冷酷……还有那种你很少见的邪恶特质……

english: Well anyway, when given the task of selling a weapon forged by the very gods themselves, I naturally thought of Zamorak as a potential buyer.
translation: 总之，当接到销售神锻造的武器任务时，我自然想到扎莫拉克作为潜在买家。

english: I was a messenger in his employ anyway, so it was a mere trifle to find him and deliver the news, and I knew of his particular interest in armour and weaponry of all kinds.
translation: 我反正受雇于他做信使，所以找到他传递消息只是小事，我知道他对各种护甲和武器特别感兴趣。

english: Yes, he was always quite the connoisseur when it came to weaponry...
translation: 是的，说到武器他一直是鉴赏家……

english: But I digress. I let Lord Zamorak know that there was some drunken fool with an artefact of incredible power that could probably be bought off with a few jewels and trinkets,
translation: 但我扯远了。我让扎莫拉克领主知道有个醉鬼拿着力量惊人的神器，可能用些珠宝饰品就能买下，

english: and he escorted me to the tavern and made the purchase there and then.
translation: 他护送我去酒馆当场成交。

english: It was a satisfactory deal all around, I got a share of the sale price from Rennard, and I greatly increased my prestige amongst Zamorak and his followers.
translation: 各方面都满意，我从伦纳德那里分到售价，大大提升了在扎莫拉克及其追随者中的声望。

english: But maybe... Perhaps the events that followed were responsible for my cursed state...
translation: 但也许……随后发生的事导致了我的诅咒状态……

english: Events that followed?
translation: 随后发生的事？

english: I can not tell you of them precisely, for I myself was not there to witness them.
translation: 我不能准确告诉你，因为我没在场见证。

english: I am after all, simply a messenger. When... 'it' happened, I was busy elsewhere delivering a message from Zamorak to the rest of his Mahjarrat ilk.
translation: 我毕竟只是个信使。当……“它”发生时，我在别处忙著传递扎莫拉克给其他玛哈加里特同类信息。

english: When 'it' happened? What was 'it'?
translation: 当“它”发生时？“它”是什么？

english: As I have explained, I was not there, and I do not know what Zamorak did with the staff, but whatever it was resulted in his banishment by the other gods for many years.
translation: 如我解释，我不在场，不知道扎莫拉克用法杖做了什么，但无论什么导致他被其他神放逐多年。

english: The very strange thing was that Saradomin must have known about it, whatever it was, before it even happened...
translation: 很奇怪的是萨拉多明肯定知道，不管是什么，在发生前就知道……

english: Really? Why do you say that?
translation: 真的？为什么这么说？

english: Well, it was the contents of the message I was returning to Zamorak;
translation: 嗯，是我返回给扎莫拉克的信息内容；

english: Lucien seemed quite certain that there was a spy for Saradomin somewhere amongst his followers named Lennissa.
translation: 卢西安似乎很确定他的追随者中有个萨拉多明的间谍叫莱尼莎。

english: If whatever happened to the staff caused this curse to befall me, then it is certain that she too would have been afflicted, because she would have been in the very heart of the action.
translation: 如果法杖发生的事导致这诅咒降临我，那她肯定也受影响，因为她就在事件中心。

english: Hmmm....
You have given me much to think on adventurer. I would like to reward you with my sturdy messenger boots, may they aid you in your travels.
translation: 你给了我很多思考冒险者。我想奖励你我的结实信使靴，愿它们助你旅行。

english: But where can I find this Lennissa?
translation: 但我在哪能找到这个莱尼莎？

english: Ah yes, the whereabouts of the treacherous Lennissa...
translation: 啊是的，叛徒莱尼莎的下落……

english: Well, we knew little about her or she would have been caught and exposed as a traitor and a spy, but Lucien did mention that he had evidence that she was a great fan of ball games...
translation: 嗯，我们对她知之甚少否则她会被抓被揭露为叛徒间谍，但卢西安提到他有证据表明她是球类运动的超级粉丝……

english: Okay, well I'll try and find her for you then.
translation: 好的，那我试着帮你找她。

english: Well, she was always sickeningly obedient to Saradomin, so I would expect her to have run to some great place of worship of him if she was affected by the curse to try and gain his blessing.
translation: 嗯，她总是恶心地服从萨拉多明，所以如果她受诅咒影响试图获得祝福，我预期她会跑去他的某个大崇拜场所。

english: According to Lucien's intelligence report, she had been uncovered as a spy by her constant use of ships to ferry information...
translation: 根据卢西安的情报报告，她因 频繁使用船只运送信息而被揭露为间谍……

english: It is entirely possible she would be located somewhere coastal to this day!
translation: 完全可能她至今仍位于某个沿海地方！

english: Well, that's all fascinating, but I just don't particularly care. Bye-bye.
translation: 嗯，那都很有趣，但我就是不太在乎。拜拜。

english: Hello again Kharrim.
translation: 又见面了卡里姆。

english: Can you remind me where to find Lennissa?
translation: 你能提醒我在哪找到莱尼莎吗？

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Could I have more of those ghostly robes you gave me?
translation: 能再给我些你给我的幽灵长袍吗？

english: It seems as though the curse that keeps me here extends to my very clothing... which piece do you want?
translation: 似乎困住我的诅咒延伸到了我的衣服……你想要哪件？

english: Here you go.
translation: 给，拿好。

english: Tell me your story
translation: 告诉我你的故事

english: Goodbye then
translation: 那再见

english: Ask about Lennissa.
translation: 询问莱尼莎。

english: Ask for more ghostly robes.
translation: 索要更多幽灵长袍。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Hi, what can I get you? We have a range of quality brews.
translation: 嗨，能给你什么？我们有一系列优质酿造酒。

english: I'll have a beer please.
translation: 我要杯啤酒。

english: That'll be two coins.
translation: 两金币。

english: Oh, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: 哦，我身上没够钱。

english: Oh, I don't have enough room for one.
translation: 哦，我没足够空间放。

english: Got any news?
translation: 有消息吗？

english: Not really, but if you want to see some action, keep an eye on the arena. I've seen some grand battles in my time. Ogres, goblins and even dragons have fought there.
translation: 不太有，但如果你想看点动作，留意竞技场。我见过些宏大战斗。食人魔、哥布林甚至龙都在那里打过。

english: Now, can I get you something?
translation: 现在，能给你什么吗？

english: I'm good, thanks.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

english: I'll have a beer please.
translation: 我要杯啤酒。

english: Got any news?
translation: 有消息吗？

english: I'm good, thanks.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: I don't know you, stranger. Get off our land.
translation: 我不认识你，陌生人。离开我们的土地。

english: There should be some good fights today.
translation: 今天应该有些好战斗。

english: I think I'll head to the bar on my next break.
translation: 我想下次休息去酒吧。

english: Keep an eye out for anything suspicious.
translation: 留意任何可疑事物。

english: Don't bother me while I'm on duty.
translation: 我值班时别烦我。

english: What are you doing here? Leave at once!
translation: 你在这里做什么？立刻离开！

english: You! You're the one who killed Bouncer.
translation: 你！你就是杀了保镖的人。

english: Die you monster!
translation: 去死你这怪物！

english: Can I help you?
translation: 我能帮你吗？

english: I'm not sure.
translation: 我不确定。

english: Well I'm off-duty right now, so why don't you go and bother someone else.
translation: 嗯我现在下班了，所以你去烦别人吧。

english: Despicable thieving scum!
translation: 可鄙的偷窃渣滓！

english: What happened?
translation: 发生了什么事？

english: None of your business. Clear off!
translation: 不关你事。滚开！

english: Someone came in and stole my armour!
translation: 有人进来偷了我的护甲！

english: Oh no! I'll let you know if I see anyone suspicious...
translation: 哦不！我看到可疑人物会告诉你……

english: Hi.
translation: 嗨。

english: You're the fiend who killed Bouncer. Leave this place at once!
translation: 你是杀了保镖的恶魔。立刻离开这个地方！

english: Hello there. What can I do for you?
translation: 你好。能为你做什么？

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: I mainly take in washing and make sure it's good and clean for my customers. Times are tough though. Not everyone can afford such a service and it's affecting my takings.
translation: 我主要接洗衣并确保对顾客干净。但时机艰难。不是每个人都负担得起这服务影响我收入。

english: Do you find that very fulfilling?
translation: 你觉得那很有成就感吗？

english: Well it can be a bit monotonous and the pay isn't good, but I set myself some goals and deliver my washing clean. My customers rarely complain, so I guess I must be doing something right.
translation: 嗯可能有点单调报酬不好，但我给自己设目标 确保洗衣干净交付。顾客很少抱怨，所以我想我做对了什么。

english: Hello again. Do you need anything?
translation: 又见面了。你需要什么吗？

english: I'm good, thanks.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

english: Well in that case, all the best.
translation: 嗯那样的话，祝好。

english: What? How did you manage to get in here.
translation: 什么？你怎么进来的。

english: I've come for the orb.
translation: 我来拿宝珠。

english: I'll never let you take it.
translation: 我绝不让你拿走。

english: Oi! You! Get out of there.
translation: 喂！你！从那里出来。

english: Get off me, ya little pest!
translation: 从我身上下来，你这小害虫！

english: Argh, get the gnome!
translation: 啊，抓住地精！

english: You'll regret that!
translation: 你会后悔的！

english: Hello, how are you?
translation: 你好，怎么样？

english: Don't speak to me you insignificant wretch! Die in the name of Khazard!
translation: 别跟我说话你这微不足道的可怜虫！以卡扎德之名去死！

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: You think you're so clever. You know nothing!
translation: 你以为你很聪明。你什么都不知道！

english: What?
translation: 什么？

english: I'll crush you and those pesky little green men!
translation: 我会碾碎你和那些讨厌的小绿人！

english: You there, stop!
translation: 你，停下！

english: Go back to your pesky little green friends.
translation: 回你讨厌的小绿朋友那里去。

english: I've come for the orbs.
translation: 我来拿宝珠。

english: You're out of your depth traveller. These orbs are part of a much larger picture.
translation: 你力所不及旅行者。这些宝珠是更大图景的一部分。

english: They're stolen goods, now give them here!
translation: 它们是赃物，现在交出来！

english: Ha, you really think you stand a chance? I'll crush you.
translation: 哈，你真以为你有机会？我会碾碎你。

english: I thought I killed you?
translation: 我以为我杀了你？

english: Fool, warriors blessed by Khazard don't die. You can't kill that which is already dead. However I can kill you!
translation: 傻瓜，被卡扎德祝福的战士不死。你杀不了已死的。但我能杀你！

english: Bah, enough of you!
translation: 呸，受够你了！

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Ooooh, heeellooo! Anyshing a bright dwarf like me can help you with?
translation: 哦哦，嘿嘿！像我这样聪明的矮人能帮你什么吗？

english: The only thing you can help me with is finding the nearest place to get a drink, I think...
translation: 你能帮我的唯一事是找最近喝酒的地方，我想……

english: That ish shimple! Help yourshelf to the dwarvern shtout! I mean dwarfen! I mean...
translation: 那很简——单！随便喝矮人黑啤酒！我是说矮人！我是说……

english: I'm not shure what I mean.
translation: 我不确定我什么意思。

english: MMMGHGHGGMH!!!
translation: 嗯嗯嗯嗯！！！

english: What's going on ARRGH!
translation: 发生了什么啊！

english: Arrgh! Human! Scary! Go away!
translation: 啊！人类！可怕！走开！

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: How are you?
translation: 怎么样？

english: Busy.
translation: 忙。

english: Hello friend.
translation: 你好朋友。

english: It was the bewk that told me ta come here.
translation: 是书告诉我来这里的。

english: What book?
translation: 什么书？

english: Circles within trees it is. And hopping too.
translation: 树中有圈。还有跳跃。

english: Are you ok?
translation: 你没事吧？

english: I'll find the light, that will see me through.
translation: 我会找到光，那会带我度过。

english: Oookay then, I'll just go explore then.
translation: 哦好吧，那我去探索。

english: Jelly shards in the dark.
translation: 黑暗中的果冻碎片。

english: I'm lost!
translation: 我迷路了！

english: I'm lost too!
translation: 我也迷路了！

english: Welcome, iknami. What can I get you?
translation: 欢迎，iknami。能给你什么？

english: Let's see what you have.
translation: 看看你有什么。

english: Nothing, thanks.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。

english: Fair enough.
translation: 好吧。

english: Let's see what you have.
translation: 看看你有什么。

english: Nothing, thanks.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。

english: Welcome to my court. I am King Arthur of the Knights of the Round Table.
translation: 欢迎来到我的宫廷。我是圆桌骑士的亚瑟王。

english: I want to become a Knight of the Round Table!
translation: 我想成为圆桌骑士！

english: Really? Well then you will need to go on a quest to prove yourself worthy. My knights all appreciate a good quest.
translation: 真的？那你需要去做任务证明自己值得。我的骑士都欣赏好任务。

english: Unfortunately, our current quest is to rescue Merlin. He recently got himself trapped in some sort of magical crystal. We've moved him from the cave we found him in and now he's upstairs in his tower.
translation: 不幸的是，我们当前任务是救梅林。他最近被困在某种魔法水晶里。我们把他从发现他的洞穴移走现在他在楼上塔里。

english: I will see what I can do then.
translation: 那我看看能做什么。

english: Talk to my knights if you need any help.
translation: 需要帮助跟我的骑士谈。

english: I may come back and try that later.
translation: 我可能稍后回来试试。

english: Be sure that you come speak to me soon then.
translation: 确保你尽快来跟我说话。

english: So what are you doing in Gielinor?
translation: 那么你在基利诺尔做什么？

english: Well legend says we will return to Britain in its time of greatest need. But that's not for quite a while yet.
translation: 嗯传说说我们在最需时返回不列颠。但那还早。

english: So we've moved the whole outfit here for now.
translation: 所以我们暂时把整个队伍移到这里。

english: We're passing the time in Gielinor!
translation: 我们在基利诺尔消磨时间！

english: Thank you very much.
translation: 非常感谢。

english: Now I am a knight of the round table, do you have any more quests for me?
translation: 现在我是圆桌骑士，你有更多任务给我吗？

english: Aha! I'm glad you are here! I am sending out various knights on an important quest. I was wondering if you too would like to take up this quest?
translation: 啊哈！很高兴你在这里！我派出各种骑士执行重要任务。我在想你是否也想接这任务？

english: Tell me of this quest.
translation: 告诉我这任务。

english: Well, we recently found out that the Holy Grail has passed into Gielinor.
translation: 嗯，我们最近发现圣杯进入了基利诺尔。

english: This is most fortuitous!
translation: 这太幸运了！

english: None of my knights ever did return with it last time. Now we have the opportunity to give it another go, maybe this time we will have more luck!
translation: 上次我的骑士都没带它回来。现在有机会再试，也许这次运气更好！

english: Before starting this quest, be aware that your combat level is lower than the recommended level of 50.
translation: 开始任务前，注意你的战斗等级低于推荐的50级。

english: I'd enjoy trying that.
translation: 我想试试。

english: Go speak to Merlin. He may be able to give a better clue as to where it is now you have freed him from that crystal.
translation: 去跟梅林说话。既然你把他从水晶救出，他也许能给出更好线索。

english: He has set up his workshop in the room next to the library.
translation: 他在图书馆隔壁房间设立了工作室。

english: I am weary of questing for the time being...
translation: 我暂时厌倦任务……

english: Maybe later then?
translation: 那也许稍后？

english: Maybe so.
translation: 也许吧。

english: Thank you for retrieving the Grail! You shall be long remembered as one of the greatest heroes amongst the Knights of the Round Table!
translation: 谢谢你取回圣杯！你将被长久铭记为圆桌骑士中最伟大的英雄之一！

english: Welcome, brave knight. I am always happy to see you back at my court. Please feel free to roam the castle and make use of the training grounds.
translation: 欢迎，勇敢骑士。我总是高兴见你回宫廷。请随意漫游城堡使用训练场。

english: I want to become a Knight of the Round Table!
translation: 我想成为圆桌骑士！

english: Yes.
translation: 是。

english: No.
translation: 否。

english: So what are you doing in Gielinor?
translation: 那么你在基利诺尔做什么？

english: Thank you very much.
translation: 非常感谢。

english: Tell me of this quest.
translation: 告诉我这任务。

english: I am weary of questing for the time being...
translation: 我暂时厌倦任务……

english: Here, I think this belongs to you.
translation: 给，我想这属于你。

english: Hello again, Bolren.
translation: 又见面了，博伦。

english: Hello there. It's good to see you again.
translation: 你好。很高兴又见到你。

english: How are things here?
translation: 这里怎么样？

english: Those Khazard troops continue to be a menace, but things are much better now. All thanks to you, of course.
translation: 那些卡扎德部队继续是威胁，但现在好多了。当然都谢谢你。

english: You do not meet all of the requirements to start The Path of Glouphrie quest.
translation: 你不满足开始格卢弗里之路任务的所有要求。

english: Hello there. Any luck in the quest for Arposandra?
translation: 你好。寻找阿波桑德拉运气如何？

english: Sort of. I think I've worked out where Arposandra is, but my attempt to enter didn't go well. There seems to be quite an extensive set of defences.
translation: 算是吧。我想我弄清了阿波桑德拉在哪，但进入尝试不顺利。似乎有相当广泛的防御。

english: Ah, that is a problem. I wish I could offer more help, but the Khazard Army already poses a major threat to us. We can't afford to split ourselves fighting two different enemies.
translation: 啊，那是问题。我希望我能提供更多帮助，但卡扎德军队已对我们构成 重大威胁。我们负担不起分兵打两个不同敌人。

english: So we do nothing?
translation: 所以我们什么都不做？

english: For now, I'm afraid so. Glouphrie is a foe that must be dealt with one day, but that day is not today.
translation: 目前，恐怕是。格卢弗里是必须某天解决的敌人，但那天不是今天。

english: Hello again.
translation: 又见面了。

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: I fear the war against the Khazard Army is set to outlive us all. We keep making progress, but for every foe we defeat, Khazard sends two more.
translation: 我担心对抗卡扎德军队的战争将比我们所有人都长久。我们不断进步，但每击败一个敌人，卡扎德派来两个。

english: Still, we thankfully haven't had any more Glouphrie problems at least.
translation: 不过，谢天谢地至少没更多格卢弗里问题。

english: That's good to hear. All the best.
translation: 那很好听。祝好。

english: Congratulations, human!
translation: 恭喜，人类！

english: The king has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 国王给了你另一个线索卷轴！

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 虽然你找到了顾客但你似乎没带正确食物！你需要 [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]！

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 恐怕预制菜肴不合要求。唯有手工烹制的地精美食，才配得上阿卢夫航空的顾客。

english: You hand over your delivery of [item] to King Bolren
translation: 你把 [item] 的配送交给博伦国王

english: Thank you. I don't have any gnome cooks here. I should really do something about that.
translation: 谢谢。我这里没有地精厨师。我真该为此做点什么。

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: 你一定走了很远才送到我这。这里有点额外小费。

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
translation: 你有 [number] 积分可兑换免费配送代币。你还没资格获得地精美食配送。

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 你有 [number] 积分可兑换免费配送代币。你可以让 [number] 份地精美食配送给你。

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: 别忘了从小阿卢夫‧吉安那里领取免费配送代币。

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 配送已超时！请返回小阿卢夫处重新接单。你丢掉了配送箱因为不再需要了。

english: I don't dirty my hands with that sort of thing.
translation: 我不弄脏我的手做那种事。

english: Leave me citizen. I'm far too busy to talk.
translation: 离开我市民。我太忙了没时间说话。

english: Good day my lord.
translation: 你好我的领主。

english: Hello [player name]. I've got nothing for you right now.
translation: 你好 [player name]。我现在没什么给你。

english: Good day.
translation: 你好。

english: What are you doing here? All Mourners should know that if they need to contact me, they need to use the proper channels!
translation: 你在这里做什么？所有哀悼者都应该知道如果需要联系我，需要使用正确渠道！

english: Sorry, I'm a new recruit.
translation: 抱歉，我是新 新兵。

english: Well do not let it happen again.
translation: 嗯别再发生。

english: Adventurer! It is good to see you again.
translation: 冒险者！很高兴又见到你。

english: And you too, King. How fares the tree?
translation: 你也是，国王。树怎么样？

english: The tree? It is fine, as it has always been since we foiled Glough's plans.
translation: 树？它很好，自从我们挫败格劳夫计划后一直如此。

english: Good. What ever did happen to Glough?
translation: 好。格劳夫到底怎么了？

english: Oh, I forced him to resign. I have now appointed a new Head Tree Guardian, Daero. He is learning quickly and serves me well.
translation: 哦，我强迫他辞职。我现在任命了新树守护者首领，达罗。他学得快服务得好。

english: King, you look worried. Is anything the matter?
translation: 国王，你看起来担心。有什么事吗？

english: Nothing in particular ... Well actually, yes - there is.
translation: 没什么特别……嗯其实，是的——有。

english: What is it?
translation: 是什么？

english: Well, do you remember Glough's ship building facilities in Karamja?
translation: 嗯，你记得格劳夫在卡拉姆詹岛的造船设施吗？

english: Yes, they were on the eastern coast. What of them?
translation: 是的，他们在东海岸。它们怎么了？

english: After you defeated Glough's demon I sent an envoy of my Royal Guard, the 10th squad, to oversee the decommission of the shipyard. They were ordered to use force if necessary.
translation: 你击败格劳夫的恶魔后我派了皇家卫队使者，第10小队，去监督船厂退役。他们被命令必要时使用武力。

english: I see ... Were they successful?
translation: 我明白了……他们成功了吗？

english: I ... I don't know. I have heard nothing from them. I do not even know if they reached the shipyard!
translation: 我……我不知道。我没听到他们消息。我甚至不知道他们是否到达船厂！

english: It is a long way...
translation: 路很远……

english: But I need to know what happened. These are elite soldiers - their disappearance cannot simply be ignored. I cannot wait any longer.
translation: 但我需要知道发生了什么。这些是精英士兵——他们的失踪不能简单忽视。我不能再等。

english: And so I ask you: would you visit Glough's old shipyard in Karamja and find out if the 10th squad ever managed to reach?
translation: 所以我问你：你能去卡拉姆詹岛格劳夫的旧船厂看看第10小队是否成功到达吗？

english: Ok, I'll do it.
translation: 好的，我去做。

english: Thank you very much. You may need this Royal Seal to identify yourself as my envoy.
translation: 非常感谢。你可能需要这皇家印章证明你是我的使者。

english: Please report to me as soon as you have any information.
translation: 一有信息请向我报告。

english: I'm afraid I am too busy right now.
translation: 恐怕我现在太忙。

english: As you wish. Return to me when you have the time.
translation: 如你所愿。有时间时回来找我。

english: Hello there, King Narnode.
translation: 你好，纳罗德国王。

english: Good of you to stop by, human.
translation: 你停下来真好，人类。

english: How fares the kingdom today?
translation: 王国今天怎么样？

english: Everything seems fine, as far as I can tell... I will let you know if there is any trouble.
translation: 一切似乎很好，据我所知……有麻烦我会告诉你。

english: You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Monkey Madness II quest.
translation: 你不满足开始猴子疯狂 II 任务的所有要求。

english: Hello, King Narnode.
translation: 你好，纳罗德国王。

english: Good to see you again, [player name].
translation: 很高兴又见到你，[player name]。

english: Have you any more Royal Seed Pods?
translation: 你有更多皇家种子荚吗？

english: All is well in the Stronghold thanks to you, [player name].
translation: 多亏你要塞一切安好，[player name]。

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 虽然你找到了顾客但你似乎没带正确食物！你需要 [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]！

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 恐怕预制菜肴不合要求。唯有手工烹制的地精美食，才配得上阿卢夫航空的顾客。

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to King Narnode
translation: 你把 [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] 的配送交给纳罗德国王

english: Thank you my son.
translation: 谢谢你，儿子。

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 你有 [number] 积分可兑换免费配送代币。你可以让 [number] 份地精美食配送给你。

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: 别忘了从小阿卢夫‧吉安那里领取免费配送代币。

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 配送已超时！请返回小阿卢夫处重新接单。你丢掉了配送箱因为不再需要了。

english: Yes.
translation: 是。

english: No.
translation: 否。

english: Have you any more Royal Seed Pods?
translation: 你有更多皇家种子荚吗？

english: How fares the kingdom today?
translation: 王国今天怎么样？

english: Greetings, your majesty.
translation: 你好，陛下。

english: Do you have anything of importance to say?
translation: 你有什么重要的事说吗？

english: ...Not really.
translation: ……不太有。

english: You will have to excuse me, then. I am very busy as I have a kingdom to run!
translation: 那你得原谅我。我很忙因为我有个王国要治理！

english: Well hello there. What do you want?
translation: 嗯你好。你想要什么？

english: Ah, it's you again. Hello there.
translation: 啊，又是你。你好。

english: Is there a reason for you being here?
translation: 你来这里有原因吗？

english: Well, I'm on a treasure trail...
translation: 嗯，我在寻宝 线索……

english: Oh! Good, then you can answer this question for me!
translation: 哦！好，那你能帮我回答这个问题！

english: King Roald has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 罗尔德国王给了你一个挑战卷轴！

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
translation: 请输入问题的答案。

english: Err, that sounds a little wrong to me.
translation: 呃，那听起来有点不对。

english: Correct!
translation: 正确！

english: King Roald has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 罗尔德国王给了你另一个线索卷轴！

english: I will smite you, cur!
translation: 我会打击你，狗东西！

english: Have at you!
translation: 接招！

english: Take that, knave!
translation: 接招，无赖！

english: A member of the Phoenix Gang!
translation: 凤凰帮成员！

english: Your gang isn't here now!
translation: 你的帮派现在不在这里！

english: That garden was awful!
translation: 那花园太可怕了！

english: I'm allergic to roses!
translation: 我对玫瑰过敏！

english: I hate gardens!
translation: 我讨厌花园！

english: Back, minion of evil!
translation: 退下，邪恶爪牙！

english: You're with the Vampyres!
translation: 你和吸血鬼一伙！

english: On behalf of everyone in Ardougne, I thank you for your help adventurer. I'm afraid I don't have time to talk, my predecessor has left me with a lot of work to do.
translation: 代表阿多尼城所有人，我感谢你的帮助冒险者。恐怕我没时间说话，我的前任留给我很多工作。

english: Thank you for your work in bringing peace back to these islands, [Fremennik name].
translation: 谢谢你为这些岛屿带回和平的工作，[Fremennik name]。

english: I hear that the Etceterians have also pledged to give you some of their resources, as thanks for preventing war once again.
translation: 我听说埃西特利亚人也承诺给你一些资源，作为再次防止战争的感谢。

english: How is the kingdom faring?
translation: 王国怎么样？

english: Everything is fine, your Majesty.
translation: 一切很好，陛下。

english: Remember, speak to Ghrim if you require assistance.
translation: 记住，需要帮助跟格里姆说话。

english: I think Prince Brand would make the best heir.
translation: 我想布兰德王子会是最好继承人。

english: Is that your honest opinion after having spent time with my daughter? The Princess might receive the news rather coldly. A broken trust is difficult to mend.
translation: 那是你和我女儿相处后的诚实意见吗？公主可能收到消息相当冷淡。破碎的信任难修复。

english: Yes, Your Majesty.
translation: 是的，陛下。

english: As you wish. I will pay heed to your recommendation.
translation: 如你所愿。我会注意你的建议。

english: No, I changed my mind.
translation: 不，我改变主意了。

english: As you wish. I will keep this conversation between us.
translation: 如你所愿。我会保密这次谈话。

english: I think Princess Astrid would make the best heir.
translation: 我想阿斯特丽德公主会是最好继承人。

english: Is that your honest opinion after having spent time with my son? The Prince might receive the news rather coldly. A broken trust is difficult to mend.
translation: 那是你和我儿子相处后的诚实意见吗？王子可能收到消息相当冷淡。破碎的信任难修复。

english: Never mind.
translation: 算了。

translation: 我想布兰德王子会是最好继承人。

english: Yes, Your Majesty.
translation: 是的，陛下。

english: No, I changed my mind.
translation: 不，我改变主意了。

english: I think Princess Astrid would make the best heir.
translation: 我想阿斯特丽德公主会是最好继承人。

english: Never mind.
translation: 算了。

english: I take it you are [player name]? King Lathas sent this message for you. He's not a man you'd want to keep waiting.
translation: 我想你是 [player name]？拉萨斯国王送你这个信息。他不是你想让他等的人。

english: Please help me. I was transformed into a frog by a well-meaning but sadly frog-obsessed old wizard. Only your touch can turn me back. Will you help me?
translation: 请帮我。我被一个好心但 可惜是个青蛙迷的老巫师变成了青蛙。只有你的触摸能变回我。你会帮我吗？

english: Okay.
translation: 好的。

english: Alright.
translation: 好吧。

english: Sure, I will.
translation: 当然，我会。

english: Yeah, okay.
translation: 好的。

english: I suppose so, sure.
translation: 我想是的，当然。

english: All right.
translation: 好吧。

english: Very well, if a touch is all you need, I'll do it.
translation: 很好，如果触摸是你所需，我会做。

english: Yes, I will touch you.
translation: 是的，我会触摸你。

english: Sure, I'll touch you.
translation: 当然，我会触摸你。

english: No way, I'm not kissing you.
translation: 没门，我不吻你。

english: I'd rather not.
translation: 我还是算了。

english: Eww, no way!
translation: 咦，没门！

english: I don't want to.
translation: 我不想。

english: Leave me alone.
translation: 别管我。

english: A kiss? Not a chance.
translation: 吻？没门。

english: It looks better to be a frog. Make me one!
translation: 做青蛙看起来更好。把我变成一个！

english: I'd rather become a frog too!
translation: 我也想变成青蛙！

english: What if I want to be a frog like you?
translation: 如果我想成为像你一样的青蛙呢？

english: I would prefer not to, sorry.
translation: 我宁愿不，抱歉。

english: I'm sorry, I'd prefer not to do that.
translation: 抱歉，我宁愿不做那个。

english: How about if we kiss?
translation: 如果我们吻怎么样？

english: May I kiss you instead?
translation: 我可以吻你代替吗？

english: Would a kiss be acceptable?
translation: 吻可以接受吗？

english: Thank you so much, [player name]. I must return to my fairytale kingdom. But take this as a reward. You can exchange it at the Varrock clothes store for a costume.
translation: 非常感谢，[player name]。我必须回我的童话王国。但拿这个作为奖励。你可以在维洛克服装店换服装。

english: Player is transformed into a frog and teleported to Frogland
translation: 玩家被变成青蛙并传送到青蛙乐园

english: Yes!
translation: 是的！

english: Thank you so much, [player name]. I must return to my fairytale kingdom. But take this as a reward. You can exchange it at the Varrock clothes store for a costume.
