5,000, you must be joking!
translation: 5,000，你一定在开玩笑！

english: We don't joke down here friend...
translation: 我们在这里不开玩笑朋友……

english: Okay then, I'll take a pair.
translation: 好吧，我要一双。

english: There you go... I hope they help.
translation: 给你……希望它们有帮助。

english: I'll see you around Klank.
translation: 回头见克兰克。

english: Oh dear, I haven't got enough money...
translation: 哦天，我没足够钱……

english: Sorry, I can't sell them any cheaper than that.
translation: 抱歉，我不能卖得比那更便宜了。

english: Take care Klank.
translation: 保重克兰克。

english: You too adventurer...
translation: 你也是冒险者……

english: Have you anymore gauntlets?
translation: 你有更多手套吗？

english: 5,000, you must be joking!
translation: 5,000，你一定在开玩笑！

english: Okay then, I'll take a pair.
translation: 好吧，我要一双。

english: Take care Klank.
translation: 保重克兰克。

english: Hey, that's my ship!
translation: 嘿，那是我的船！

english: No, it's not. It may, to the untrained eye, at first appear to be the Lady Lumbridge, but it is definitely not. It's my new ship. It just happens to look slightly similar, is all.
translation: 不，它不是。对未受训练的眼睛来说，它起初可能看起来像伦布里奇女士号，但绝对不是。它是我的新船。只是碰巧看起来有点相似，仅此而已。

english: It has Lady Lumbridge painted out and 'Klarense's Cruiser' painted over it!
translation: 它把伦布里奇女士号涂掉了，上面漆着‘克拉伦斯的巡洋舰’！

english: Nope, you're mistaken. It's my new boat.
translation: 不，你错了。它是我的新船。

english: Well will you at least take me to Crandor in it?
translation: 那你至少能用它带我去克兰多岛吗？

english: Nope. I don't take passengers on my ship.
translation: 不。我的船不载乘客。

english: Argh!
translation: 啊！

english: Hey, stay off my ship! That's private property!
translation: 嘿，别上我的船！那是私人财产！

english: Wooo wooo wooooo!
translation: 呜呜 呜呜 呜呜呜！

english: The spirit tries to converse with you, but you can't understand him.
translation: 灵魂试图与你交谈，但你无法理解他。

english: Thank you, adventurer. You have given my soul some respite.
translation: 谢谢你，冒险者。你给了我的灵魂一些喘息。

english: Wait! I want to ask you a question...
translation: 等等！我想问你个问题……

english: Klenter disappears before you can ask him anything.
translation: 克兰特在你问他任何问题前消失了。

english: He is too busy dancing to talk!
translation: 他太忙跳舞了没法说话！

english: We're Knights of the Party Room
translation: 我们是派对房间骑士

english: We dance round and round like a loon
translation: 我们像疯子一样转圈圈跳舞

english: Quite often we like to sing
translation: 我们经常喜欢唱歌

english: Unfortunately we make a din
translation: 不幸的是我们制造噪音

english: Do you like our helmet plumes?
translation: 你喜欢我们的头盔羽饰吗？

english: Everyone's happy now we can move
translation: 现在我们能移动了大家都很高兴

english: Like a party animal in the groove
translation: 像沟里的派对动物

english: The party room is a silly place!
translation: 派对房间是个愚蠢的地方！

english: Who are you? What are you doing here in the snow?
translation: 你是谁？你在雪地里做什么？

english: My name is...Sir Gerry. I am...a member of a secret...society of knights. My time is short and I need...your help.
translation: 我叫……格里爵士。我是……一个秘密……骑士社会的成员。我的时间不多了我需要……你的帮助。

english: A secret society of knights? What a surprise! Is there an old charter or decree that says if you're a knight you have to belong to a secret order?
translation: 秘密骑士社会？真惊喜！有没有旧宪章或法令说如果你是骑士就必须属于秘密秩序？

english: I'm sorry, my friend... I do not understand your meaning. Please, time is short... Take this scroll to Sir Tiffy. You will find him in Falador park... You should not...read it... It contains information for his eyes only.
translation: 抱歉，我的朋友……我不理解你的意思。请，时间不多了……把这卷轴带给蒂菲爵士。你会在法拉多城公园找到他……你不应该……读它……它包含只给他看的信息。

english: A secret society of knights? You don't mean the Temple Knights, do you?
translation: 秘密骑士社会？你不是指神庙骑士吧？

english: Yes! Praise Saradomin! You...have been sent in...my hour of need. Please, take...this scroll to Sir Tiffy in Falador park... You should not...read it.
translation: 是的！赞美萨拉多明！你……在……我需要时被派来。请，把……这卷轴带给法拉多城公园的蒂菲爵士……你不应该……读它。

english: Cough... Hey, over here.
translation: 咳……嘿，这边。

english: He's still alive, but in no condition to talk. He appears to be almost comatose.
translation: 他还活着，但状况无法说话。他似乎几乎昏迷。

english: Good day.
translation: 你好。

english: Hello there citizen. What can I do for you?
translation: 你好公民。我能为你做什么？

english: What's down these stairs?
translation: 这些楼梯下面是什么？

english: These stairs lead to the Ardougne Prison. It's home to thieves, murderers and everything in between.
translation: 这些楼梯通向阿多尼监狱。它是小偷、谋杀犯和介于两者之间者的家园。

english: Sounds lovely. Can I go in?
translation: 听起来不错。我能进去吗？

english: I'm afraid not citizen. Only the Knights of Ardougne are allowed into the prison and I can see that you are no knight.
translation: 恐怕不行公民。只有阿多尼骑士被允许进入监狱，我看你不是骑士。

english: Sorry citizen. Only Knights of Ardougne are allowed in the prison.
translation: 抱歉公民。只有阿多尼骑士被允许进入监狱。

english: Hello there fellow knight. Isn't today a wonderful day to be a Knight of Ardougne?
translation: 你好骑士同伴。今天不是成为阿多尼骑士的美好日子吗？

english: I mean it's okay I suppose. The constant fear of some random adventurer murdering you and the fact that people are constantly picking your pockets isn't great. But hey ho, at least the benefits are good.
translation: 我是说我想还可以。对某个随机冒险者谋杀你的持续恐惧以及人们不断扒你口袋的事实不太好。但嘿，至少福利不错。

english: That they are fellow knight, that they are.
translation: 确实是骑士同伴，确实是。

english: Anyway, can I go down these stairs?
translation: 总之，我能下这些楼梯吗？

english: Of course you can! You're a Knight of Ardougne! There is no place where you can't go.
translation: 当然你能！你是阿多尼骑士！没有你不能去的地方。

english: Yeah... Thanks.
translation: 是啊……谢谢。

english: Good to see you [Tim/Sue].
translation: 很高兴见到你 [Tim/Sue]。

english: Who's [Tim/Sue]?
translation: 谁是 [Tim/Sue]？

english: You are?
translation: 你是？

english: Ah yes, I am [Tim/Sue].
translation: 啊是的，我是 [Tim/Sue]。

english: Hmm... Is your head working okay today [Tim/Sue]?
translation: 嗯……你的头今天工作正常吗 [Tim/Sue]？

english: Of course, my head has never been better.
translation: 当然，我的头从未这么好过。

english: If you say so...
translation: 如果你这么说……

english: Ah, nilsal! Hello!
translation: 啊，你好！

english: Ah, hello again!
translation: 啊，又见面了！

english: Hello to you too!
translation: 也向你问好！

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 和我说说你自己。

english: I'm a Knight of Varlamore, the Kingdom of Sun. I venture to Kourend on a mission, one I can say very little of.
translation: 我是瓦拉莫尔骑士，太阳王国。我来库兰德王国执行任务，一个我几乎不能说的任务。

english: How come?
translation: 为什么？

english: I'm afraid you must accept my secrecy adventurer, for who knows what the future holds.
translation: 恐怕你必须接受我的保密冒险者，因为谁知道未来会发生什么。

english: I found an ancient sun temple.
translation: 我发现了一个古代太阳神庙。

english: Oh, pray tell, where is this temple?
translation: 哦，请告诉，这个神庙在哪？

english: In a place called the Forthos Ruin to the south east of here. I was exploring there and I discovered symbology for an entity called Ralos.
translation: 在一个叫福索斯废墟的地方，在这东南边。我在那里探索时发现了一个叫拉洛斯的实体的符号。

english: I see. I think I shall check out this ruin. Thank you for letting me know adventurer.
translation: 我明白了。我想我会去看看这个废墟。谢谢你告诉我冒险者。

english: No problem... Oh, I don't know your name.
translation: 没问题……哦，我不知道你的名字。

english: Call me Astra! Now, I must see this discovery for myself. It may well help with my mission here. May the light shine upon you!
translation: 叫我阿斯特拉！现在，我必须亲自看看这个发现。它很可能有助于我在这里的任务。愿光芒照耀你！

english: Where's the Kingdom of Varlamore?
translation: 瓦拉莫尔王国在哪？

english: To the south, beyond Mount Quidamortem. It's a glorious land where the sun forever shines.
translation: 在南边，奎达莫特山之外。那是个太阳永远照耀的荣耀之地。

english: Sounds wonderful!
translation: 听起来很棒！

english: I have to go.
translation: 我得走了。

english: Stay vigilant, friend.
translation: 保持警惕，朋友。

english: Oh... nilsal, adventurer.
translation: 哦……你好，冒险者。

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: How are you, Astra?
translation: 你怎么样，阿斯特拉？

english: Not great... Can you believe what they've done?
translation: 不太好……你能相信他们做了什么吗？

english: Done what?
translation: 做了什么？

english: Are you blind? Look what they've done to the altar of Ralos!
translation: 你瞎了吗？看看他们对拉洛斯祭坛做了什么！

english: Oh... I guess it has seen better days.
translation: 哦……我想它有过更好的日子。

english: It was those others! Those undead druids. Blind moon worshippers...
translation: 是那些其他人！那些不死德鲁伊。盲目的月亮崇拜者……

english: Do you see what they've become? That's what turning your back on the light does. Even as I stand here in this desecrated temple, I feel the light fading from me.
translation: 你看到他们变成什么了吗？那就是背弃光明的后果。即使我站在这个被亵渎的神庙里，我也感到光芒从我身上消逝。

english: I suppose it is quite spooky down here.
translation: 我想这里相当阴森。

english: So you feel it too? A shadow hangs over this place.
translation: 所以你也感觉到了？阴影笼罩着这个地方。

english: What will you do now?
translation: 你现在要做什么？

english: My mission is still a secret, adventurer. Perhaps I'll share it with you one day.
translation: 我的任务仍然是个秘密，冒险者。也许有一天我会分享给你。

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 和我说说你自己。

english: I found an ancient sun temple.
translation: 我发现了一个古代太阳神庙。

english: Where's the Kingdom of Varlamore?
translation: 瓦拉莫尔王国在哪？

english: I have to go.
translation: 我得走了。

english: How are you, Astra?
translation: 你怎么样，阿斯特拉？

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Woo wooo!
translation: 呜呜！

english: Don't you know? I am a proud Knight of the Lion, serving under the Justiciar of the Lion.
translation: 你不知道吗？我是骄傲的狮子骑士，服务于狮子审判者。

english: And you are the adventurer who disturbed my rest!
translation: 你是那个打扰我休息的冒险者！

english: Yeah... I'm not really all that sorry about that. I was searching for Hallowed marks. Although I didn't actually intend to disturb you if that's any consolation.
translation: 是啊……我对此不是很抱歉。我在寻找神圣标记。虽然如果那有任何安慰的话，我其实没打算打扰你。

english: Hallowed marks? That currency is reserved only for the devout followers of holy Saradomin. Are you a follower, adventurer?
translation: 神圣标记？那货币只保留给神圣萨拉多明的虔诚追随者。你是追随者吗，冒险者？

english: Yes, I follow Saradomin.
translation: 是的，我追随萨拉多明。

english: I see! Yes, I can sense that you at least carry some items bearing his symbol. Well met fellow follower! Do tell, what is the Justiciar of the Lion up to these days?
translation: 我明白了！是的，我能感觉到你至少携带了一些带有他符号的物品。幸会追随者同伴！请告诉我，狮子审判者最近在做什么？

english: The Justiciar of the Lion? I've never heard of them.
translation: 狮子审判者？我从没听说过他们。

english: By Saradomin's mercy! Are you serious adventurer? You've never heard of her glory?
translation: 凭萨拉多明的仁慈！你是认真的冒险者吗？你从没听说过她的荣耀？

english: The statue in the south east bears her resemblance. I remember the day it was built in her honour.
translation: 东南边的雕像带有她的相貌。我记得那天是为纪念她而建的。

english: The Justiciar of the Lion is a title bestowed upon the most powerful wizard of our order. She was capable of wiping out an entire army of Zamorakian demons with a single spell!
translation: 狮子审判者是授予我们秩序最强大法师的称号。她能够用一个法术消灭整个扎莫拉克恶魔军队！

english: I lament that I could not learn more from her in life but I do not regret for a single instant following her to my grave.
translation: 我 lament 生前没能向她学习更多，但我一点也不后悔追随她到坟墓。

english: I see, she sounds like an inspirational figure indeed. Do you know where I can find her?
translation: 我明白了，她听起来确实是个鼓舞人心的人物。你知道我在哪能找到她吗？

english: I was hoping that you could tell me. Last I heard, she was residing in the college here in Hallowvale.
translation: 我希望你能告诉我。我上次听说，她住在神圣谷这里的学院里。

english: Oh dear...
translation: 哦天……

english: Is something wrong adventurer?
translation: 有什么事吗冒险者？

english: Never mind, you don't want to know.
translation: 算了，你不想知道。

english: You lie adventurer. I do not sense a single item of holy Saradomin on your person.
translation: 你撒谎冒险者。我身上没感觉到任何神圣萨拉多明的物品。

english: To think that our currency is being handled by non- followers. It's a disgrace! If I weren't dead, I'd incinerate you where you stand for your impudence!
translation: 想到我们的货币被非追随者 handling。这是耻辱！如果我没死，我会当场烧死你因为你的放肆！

english: Yeah well, you are dead and I have your currency so you're going to have to... live with that!
translation: 是啊，你死了而我拥有你的货币所以你得……接受现实！

english: I don't appreciate your attempts at humour, non- follower.
translation: 我不欣赏你的幽默尝试，非追随者。

english: No, I follow another god.
translation: 不，我追随另一个神。

english: Woo? Woo wooooooooo!
translation: 呜？呜呜呜呜呜！

english: You dare defile this sacred place? That treasure doesn't belong to you!
translation: 你敢亵渎这个神圣地方？那宝藏不属于你！

english: Yes, I follow Saradomin.
translation: 是的，我追随萨拉多明。

english: No, I follow another god.
translation: 不，我追随另一个神。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Woo wooo?
translation: 呜呜？

english: Who indeed? I am a wise Knight of the Owl. I serve the Justiciar of the Owl.
translation: 究竟是谁？我是智慧的猫头鹰骑士。我服务于猫头鹰审判者。

english: Who's this Justiciar of the Owl?
translation: 谁是这个猫头鹰审判者？

english: Saradomin's wisest of servants. It surprises me that you've not heard of his many feats.
translation: 萨拉多明最智慧的仆人。让我惊讶的是你没听说过他的许多事迹。

english: Do you know any?
translation: 你知道任何吗？

english: I know them all.
translation: 我都知道。

english: Care to share?
translation: 愿意分享吗？

english: Of course. Do you see the foliage around you, adventurer?
translation: 当然。你看到周围的枝叶了吗，冒险者？

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: For it to be in such a state means that there is unimaginable evil nearby. These plants were grown personally by Zachariah, the Justiciar of the Owl.
translation: 它处于这种状态意味着附近有难以想象的邪恶。这些植物是由扎卡里亚，猫头鹰审判者亲自种植的。

english: Anything he plants blossoms with unimaginable vigour. You may have noticed that he has a love for lilies. Perhaps he knew they'd serve multiple purposes in a place like this.
translation: 他种植的任何东西都以难以想象的活力绽放。你可能注意到他喜欢百合。也许他知道它们在这样的地方会有多种用途。

english: Hmm. Hopefully I'll meet him one day.
translation: 嗯。希望有一天我能见到他。

english: If you do, send my regards.
translation: 如果你见到，代我问候。

english: Do you have a name?
translation: 你有名字吗？

english: I'm but a loyal watcher, that is all.
translation: 我只是个忠诚的观察者，仅此而已。

english: So, was there anything else?
translation: 那么，还有别的吗？

english: Wait...
translation: 等等……

english: Your helmet looks familiar. I defeated a knight who wore one with a similar design.
translation: 你的头盔看起来熟悉。我击败过一个戴着类似设计头盔的骑士。

english: This helmet? It is based on the one worn by the Justiciar of the Owl. You mean to say you fought the great Zachariah and lived to tell the tale?
translation: 这个头盔？它是基于猫头鹰审判者戴的那个。你是说你打败了伟大的扎卡里亚还活着讲故事？

english: Well, I suppose so.
translation: 嗯，我想是的。

english: This can't be... You killed the great Zachariah?
translation: 这不可能……你杀了伟大的扎卡里亚？

english: Hmm, he didn't really die. He just sort of faded away and left behind a glowing magical hand.
translation: 嗯，他没真的死。他只是有点消失留下了一个发光的魔法手。

english: Strange, when I saw him last he had no magical hand to speak of... I suppose time has changed the world above beyond my recollection...
translation: 奇怪，我上次见到他时他没有魔法手可言……我想时间改变了上面的世界超出了我的记忆……

english: Yep, it probably has.
translation: 是的，可能吧。

english: What's with the owls?
translation: 猫头鹰怎么回事？

english: They are a symbol of the wise. You see, owls can see the light in the darkest of places. Their presence within the sepulchre is one of grave importance.
translation: 它们是智慧的象征。你看，猫头鹰能在最黑暗的地方看到光。它们在坟墓内的存在是极其重要的。

english: Yes, I saw some down there. They seemed incorporeal in some way, as if they were ghosts...
translation: 是的，我在下面看到了一些。它们在某种程度上似乎是非实体的，好像它们是鬼魂……

english: Indeed. These creatures have the blessing of Saradomin and the wisdom of ages long past. They are the watchers of the Hallowed Sepulchre. The last defence against unseen evils.
translation: 确实。这些生物有萨拉多明的祝福和远古时代的智慧。它们是神圣坟墓的守护者。对抗 unseen 邪恶的最后防御。

english: Err... past the wolves?
translation: 呃……过了狼？

english: The third floor... Home.
translation: 第三层……家。

english: Thank you for freeing me, adventurer. If the owls have already retreated that far back, it's best that I reside here. From this position I can more effectively watch for evil.
translation: 谢谢你释放我，冒险者。如果猫头鹰已经撤退到那么远，我最好住在这里。从这个位置我能更有效地监视邪恶。

english: Hmm... Perhaps I should steal from graves more often?
translation: 嗯……也许我应该更经常从坟墓偷窃？

english: Excuse me?
translation: 打扰一下？

english: Oh, nothing.
translation: 哦，没什么。

english: I'm off now, goodbye.
translation: 我现在走了，再见。

english: Stay watchful.
translation: 保持警惕。

english: Woo? Woo wooooooooo!
translation: 呜？呜呜呜呜呜！

english: You dare defile this sacred place? That treasure doesn't belong to you!
translation: 你敢亵渎这个神圣地方？那宝藏不属于你！

english: Who's this Justiciar of the Owl?
translation: 谁是这个猫头鹰审判者？

english: What's with the owls?
translation: 猫头鹰怎么回事？

english: I'm off now, goodbye.
translation: 我现在走了，再见。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Woo wooo!
translation: 呜呜！

english: I am a holy Knight of the Unicorn. I served under the Archpriest of this place who himself served under the Justiciar of the Unicorn.
translation: 我是神圣的独角兽骑士。我服务于这里的总祭司，他自己服务于独角兽审判者。

english: You don't look like a knight... Don't knights wear plate armour and wield swords and lances and stuff?
translation: 你看起来不像骑士……骑士不穿板甲挥舞剑和长矛之类的吗？

english: The title of knight perhaps has a different meaning to you adventurer. In fact, all of the knights of my order are priests who serve under Saradomin.
translation: 骑士的称号对你来说可能有不同含义冒险者。事实上，我秩序的所有骑士都是服务于萨拉多明的祭司。

english: During my life, I spent my time here consecrating the fallen followers of holy Saradomin. I would perform their final rites before laying them to rest within this place.
translation: 在我生前，我花时间在这里祝圣倒下的神圣萨拉多明追随者。我会在将他们安息在这个地方之前执行他们的最后仪式。

english: I see. So does this place only contain the bodies of these 'knights' who followed Saradomin?
translation: 我明白了。所以这个地方只包含这些追随萨拉多明的‘骑士’的尸体吗？

english: Not at all. We also provided these rites for all the citizens of Hallowvale. They were mostly laid to rest on the first two floors.
translation: 完全不。我们也为神圣谷的所有公民提供了这些仪式。他们大多安息在前两层。

english: Interesting. So who is this Justiciar of the Unicorn you spoke of?
translation: 有趣。那么你说的这个独角兽审判者是谁？

english: The Justiciar of the Unicorn? Why this title is only bestowed upon the holiest priest of Saradomin.
translation: 独角兽审判者？为什么这个称号只授予萨拉多明最神圣的祭司。

english: The justiciar I followed would spread the teachings of Saradomin everywhere he went, converting the masses to our religion.
translation: 我追随的审判者会走到哪传播到哪萨拉多明的教义，转化群众到我们的宗教。

english: The statue in the north east of this room was created in his likeness when the place was built. I must say though, it does concern me that this is the first you've heard of him and his feats.
translation: 这个房间东北边的雕像是为了纪念他而建的。但我必须说，这让我担心这是你第一次听说他和他的事迹。

english: Well I've certainly heard of the word justiciar, but nothing about the Justiciar of the Unicorn.
translation: 嗯我当然听说过审判者这个词，但没听说过独角兽审判者。

english: That saddens me greatly. I do hope that he is still carrying out Saradomin's will.
translation: 那让我很伤心。我希望他仍在执行萨拉多明的意志。

english: Anyway, do tell me adventurer, what brings you to the Hallowed Sepulchre?
translation: 总之，请告诉我冒险者，什么带你来神圣坟墓？

english: I found this place within the city of Darkmeyer and that mysterious stranger over there asked me to acquire some Hallowed marks which you and your bretherenwere buried with.
translation: 我在黑暗迈尔城内发现了这个地方，那边那个神秘陌生人让我获取一些你和你的兄弟们埋葬时带着的神圣标记。

english: I see. Did you say Darkmeyer? An interesting name, especially when this region is so bright and full of life.
translation: 我明白了。你说黑暗迈尔？有趣的名字，尤其当这个区域如此明亮充满生命。

english: When I was alive this place was known as Hallowvale. Do you know why the queen decided to change the name?
translation: 我活着时这个地方被称为神圣谷。你知道女王为什么决定改名吗？

english: Erm, simply put, the land here is... under new management.
translation: 呃，简单来说，这里的土地是……在新管理下。

english: Hmm, interesting. I wish I could see for myself but unfortunately, I am unable to leave this place. I do wonder if this new 'management' is the reason my spirit did not pass on to the afterlife.
translation: 嗯，有趣。我希望我能亲自看看但不幸的是，我无法离开这个地方。我想知道这个新‘管理’是否是我的灵魂没有通往来世的原因。

english: Perhaps so. However, it's probably best that you can't leave this place. I'm not sure you'd like what you'd find.
translation: 也许吧。然而，你可能不能离开这个地方是最好的。我不确定你会喜欢你会发现什么。

english: I fear you may be right adventurer. The last instruction I was given was to help protect this place from invaders by placing magical enchantments on the statues within.
translation: 我恐怕你可能是对的冒险者。我收到的最后指令是通过在内部的雕像上放置魔法附魔来帮助保护这个地方免受入侵者。

english: I admit, I never dared ask who or what we were protecting it from.
translation: 我承认，我从不敢问我们在保护它免受谁或什么。

english: If it's any consolation, the enchantments you placed did prevent the 'invaders' from entering. It's only us human adventurers who enter the Sepulchre.
translation: 如果有什么安慰，你放置的附魔确实阻止了‘入侵者’进入。只有我们人类冒险者进入坟墓。

english: Although we have been stealing some of your stuff... Sorry about that.
translation: 虽然我们一直在偷你的一些东西……对此抱歉。

english: It's not like I have any use for my stuff anymore. Thanks adventurer, your words do lighten my spirits somewhat.
translation: 反正我的东西我也没什么用了。谢谢冒险者，你的话确实让我的精神轻松了些。

english: Aren't you all spirit?
translation: 你们不都是灵魂吗？

english: Woo? Woo wooooooooo!
translation: 呜？呜呜呜呜呜！

english: You dare defile this sacred place? That treasure doesn't belong to you!
translation: 你敢亵渎这个神圣地方？那宝藏不属于你！

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Woo wooo?
translation: 呜呜？

english: Me? I am a Knight of the Wolf. I serve the fierce Justiciar of the Wolf!
translation: 我？我是狼骑士。我服务于凶猛的狼审判者！

english: Of the Wolf?
translation: 狼的？

english: Aye, the most loyal and fiercest of Saradomin's followers! We are the bastion against all that is evil.
translation: 是的，萨拉多明追随者中最忠诚和最凶猛的！我们是对抗一切邪恶的堡垒。

english: Who's this Justiciar of the Wolf?
translation: 谁是这个狼审判者？

english: You haven't heard of...
translation: 你没听说过……

english: What happened to her?
translation: 她怎么了？

english: I was hoping you could tell me... Ah, the white wolf we called her... For she had the brightest hair you'd ever seen. A silver so bright it could blind. Some said she had icyene blood, but those close to her knew better.
translation: 我希望你能告诉我……啊，白狼我们叫她……因为她有你见过最亮的头发。银色的如此明亮它能致盲。有人说她有 icyene 血，但那些亲近她的人知道更好。

english: I take it you were close?
translation: 我想你们很亲近？

english: Close enough. The white wolf was but a mere human, albeit with astounding prowess on the battlefield... She vied for Saradomin's attention the most out of all the justiciars.
translation: 足够亲近。白狼只是个普通人，尽管在战场上有惊人的 prowess……她在所有审判者中最争夺萨拉多明的关注。

english: Hmm... Why do you think that was?
translation: 嗯……你为什么认为那是？

english: Ah, well... She always wanted to be stronger and never seemed happy with what she had. There was always more.
translation: 啊，嗯……她总是想更强壮似乎从不满足于她拥有的。总有更多。

english: Was there anything else you wanted?
translation: 还有别的你想要的吗？

english: Any great battles to speak of?
translation: 有什么伟大的战役可说吗？

english: There was this time a great evil swept over Hallowvale...
translation: 有一次大邪恶席卷了神圣谷……

english: Ah! The vampyres?
translation: 啊！吸血鬼？

english: The what?
translation: 什么？

english: Y'know? The ones with the wings and all the blood sucking?
translation: 你知道？那些有翅膀和所有吸血的？

english: No, don't be so ridiculous. As I was saying... A great evil...
translation: 不，别这么可笑。正如我所说……一个大邪恶……

english: The common folk called it the Egregore. They said it could shift and change shape at a moments notice into creatures from the deepest abyss...
translation: 平民叫它 Egregore。他们说它能瞬间 shift 和 change shape 成来自最深 abyss 的生物……

english: Sounds terrifying.
translation: 听起来可怕。

english: These folk, they tend to exaggerate. It wasn't until the nobles started spreading word of its ghoulish features, each more horrible than the last...
translation: 这些人，他们倾向于夸张。直到贵族开始传播它的食尸鬼特征，一个比一个可怕……

english: Talons as sharp as runite, fire-breath, mind reading abilities... Worst of all though, they said it couldn't be killed!
translation: 爪子像符文武器一样锋利，喷火，读心能力……但最糟糕的是，他们说它不能被杀死！

english: That was when we took an interest in killing the thing. We are Knights of the Wolf after all! Our duty is to eradicate all evil.
translation: 那是我们对杀死那东西感兴趣的时候。我们毕竟是狼骑士！我们的职责是根除所有邪恶。

english: Woah! How does one vanquish such a foe?
translation: 哇！一个人如何 vanquish 这样的敌人？

english: Well, we made short work of it. That is what we do.
translation: 嗯，我们很快解决了它。那就是我们做的。

english: But, how?
translation: 但，如何？

english: With a big sword of course!
translation: 用一把大剑当然！

english: Ah... A favorite method of mine.
translation: 啊……我的一个喜欢的方法。

english: Ah... I prefer a carefully placed arrow myself. Each to their own though.
translation: 啊……我更喜欢 carefully placed 箭。各有所好。

english: It does the job! Once we had shown the head of the beast to the masses, talk of the Egregore soon died down. At least... for a while.
translation: 它完成了工作！一旦我们向群众展示了野兽的头，关于 Egregore 的谈论很快平息了。至少……一段时间。

english: It returned?
translation: 它回来了？

english: Yes. It was strange... As soon as the small folk had forgotten about the Egregore, rumours started to arise that it had returned. And so it had! That was the nature of this beast.
translation: 是的。很奇怪……一旦平民忘记了 Egregore，谣言就开始兴起它回来了。确实如此！那是这野兽的本质。

english: So it was truly undying?
translation: 所以它真的不死？

english: Does the Egregore still haunt these lands, human?
translation: Egregore 还在困扰这片土地吗，人类？

english: Hmm, I can't say I've seen it...
translation: 嗯，我不能说我见过它……

english: Then you must assume we were quite successful! At least by the time of my passing, the beast hadn't returned. Although, who knows? It could have taken any form by now.
translation: 那么你必须假设我们相当成功！至少在我去世时，野兽没回来。虽然，谁知道？它现在可能采取了任何形式。

english: Well I can't say for certain, but you look pretty old.
translation: 嗯我不能肯定，但你看起来很老。

english: Your humour is wasted on me.
translation: 你的幽默浪费在我身上。

english: I'm off now, goodbye.
translation: 我现在走了，再见。

english: May the light of Saradomin guide you, adventurer.
translation: 愿萨拉多明的光芒指引你，冒险者。

english: Woo? Woo wooooooooo!
translation: 呜？呜呜呜呜呜！

english: You dare defile this sacred place? That treasure doesn't belong to you!
translation: 你敢亵渎这个神圣地方？那宝藏不属于你！

english: Who's this Justiciar of the Wolf?
translation: 谁是这个狼审判者？

english: Any great battles to speak of?
translation: 有什么伟大的战役可说吗？

english: I'm off now, goodbye.
translation: 我现在走了，再见。

english: Hey, how's it go...
translation: 嘿，怎么样……

english: Sorry my friend, the Skipper has been grindin' me up the wrong way lately. If ye need anythin', talk t' Cap'ain Pudi over by the dock.
translation: 抱歉我的朋友，船长最近一直让我很不爽。如果你需要什么，跟码头那边的普迪船长谈。

english: That ungrateful Skipper. How dare he blame me for that freak storm?
translation: 那个忘恩负义的船长。他怎么敢怪我因为那场 freak 风暴？

english: Why are you angry at the Skipper?
translation: 你为什么生船长的气？

english: It be a long story.
translation: 那是个长故事。

english: I've got time. I would love to hear it.
translation: 我有时间。我很想听。

english: Fine, 'ere be me tale of misfortune.
translation: 好吧，这是我的不幸故事。

english: About a half moon ago, we set sail on our fortnightly fishin' trip. 'Twas smooth sailin' all the way t' our spot.
translation: 大约半个月前，我们起航进行我们的每两周一次的钓鱼之旅。一路一帆风顺到我们的地点。

english: Caught a load of manta ray an' snappers.
translation: 抓了一堆 manta ray 和 snappers。

english: What's a snapper?
translation: 什么是 snapper？

english: Ah, I should'a realised you were a landlubber. We on the ship call them snappers, but you lot call 'em lobsters.
translation: 啊，我应该意识到你是个旱鸭子。我们在船上叫它们 snappers，但你们叫它们龙虾。

english: Anyway, back to me tale.
translation: 总之，回到我的故事。

english: After a couple o' days, we pulled up the anchor an' sailed closer t' the Karamjan coast. There is where the big'ns are.
translation: 过了几天，我们起锚航行靠近卡拉姆詹岛海岸。那里是大家伙所在。

english: What's a big'n?
translation: 什么是 big'n？

english: You landlubbers... It be a shark.
translation: 你们旱鸭子……它是鲨鱼。

english: Oh, how was I supposed to know?
translation: 哦，我怎么会知道？

english: CAN YOU STOP INTERRUPTIN' ME TALE?
translation: 你能不能停止打断我的故事？

english: Ok...
translation: 好的……

english: Good, now where was I...
translation: 好，我刚说到哪了……

english: When we arrived at the spot, the Skipper saw a lack of fish swimmin' in the waters.
translation: 当我们到达地点时，船长看到水里缺乏鱼游泳。

english: I looked yonder onto the horizon an' noticed a storm was a brewin', so we adjusted our course accordin'.
translation: 我看向远方地平线注意到风暴正在酝酿，所以我们相应地调整了航线。

english: As if by magic, winds started a blowin' an' the storm started movin' in our direction.
translation: 仿佛魔法，风开始吹起 风暴开始向我们的方向移动。

english: Lightnin' struck the boat, an' a piece of wood holdin' up the sail fell an' struck me on the 'ead.
translation: 闪电击中了船，一块支撑帆的木头掉下来击中了我的头。

english: I woke up in a bed an' the Skipper started on me, tellin' me I ruined his ship an' I need t' pay him back.
translation: 我在床上醒来船长开始对我，告诉我我毁了他的船我需要还他。

english: That's awful. He does not sound like a nice man.
translation: 那太可怕了。他听起来不像个好人。

english: Nay, he usually is. He be upset about his ship, is all.
translation: 不，他通常是。他为他的船心烦，仅此而已。

english: Can I help ye with anythin' else?
translation: 我能帮你什么别的吗？

english: Got any tips for fighting Tempoross?
translation: 有什么对抗风暴大帝的建议吗？

english: Watch out for the waves. If ye get hit by that you could end up lost at sea.
translation: 小心波浪。如果你被击中你可能最终迷失在海上。

english: Ye might find tying yourself t' somethin' using a rope t' be a life saver.
translation: 你可能会发现用绳子把自己绑在某物上是救生员。

english: Or if ye manage to get yer hands on one of them there fancy Spirity Angler outfits, it comes with a built- in rope harness.
translation: 或者如果你设法得到那些精美的海灵垂钓者服装之一，它带有内置绳索背带。

english: I have to go.
translation: 我得走了。

english: Have a good'n. I know I won't.
translation: 祝你过得好。我知道我不会。

english: Would you care for an egg in this difficult time?
translation: 在这个困难时期你想要个蛋吗？

english: Oh, a damp egg! Yes, please!
translation: 哦，一个湿蛋！好的，谢谢！

english: Wait, really?
translation: 等等，真的？

english: Aye, I'll add it t' me collection!
translation: 是的，我会把它加入我的收藏！

english: You know there's a crate of them you could just help yourself t'...
translation: 你知道有一箱你可以自己拿……

english: Hush! Don't let Timallus hear ye speak o' the damp egg crate. It'll set 'im off!
translation: 嘘！别让蒂马卢斯听到你说湿蛋箱。那会惹恼他！

english: Just pass me the egg.
translation: 把蛋递给我。

english: Thank ye kindly!
translation: 谢谢你！

english: ...You're welcome.
translation: ……不用客气。

english: Oh, thanks.
translation: 哦，谢谢。

english: This is some comfort to be sure.
translation: 这确实是一些安慰。

english: Why are you angry at the Skipper?
translation: 你为什么生船长的气？

english: Got any tips for fighting Tempoross?
translation: 有什么对抗风暴大帝的建议吗？

english: I have to go.
translation: 我得走了。

english: Hello. What are you up to?
translation: 你好。你在做什么？

english: Nothing exciting, just keeping an eye out.
translation: 没什么 exciting，只是留意。

english: I wouldn't go in there if I were you. Only death awaits those who enter that place.
translation: 如果我是你我不会进去。只有死亡等待那些进入那个地方的人。

english: Hello Koftik.
translation: 你好科夫蒂克。

english: Hello adventurer, how's things?
translation: 你好冒险者，怎么样？

english: Not bad, yourself?
translation: 不错，你呢？

english: I'm good... just keeping an eye out.
translation: 我很好……只是留意。

english: I found this by the way. I guess you'll be wanting it back.
translation: 我顺便发现了这个。我想你会想要它回来。

english: Thanks Koftik.
translation: 谢谢科夫蒂克。

english: Hello [player name], how's things?
translation: 你好 [player name]，怎么样？

english: These traps don't get any easier. But I'm alright, thanks.
translation: 这些陷阱没有变得更容易。但我没事，谢谢。

english: Good to hear.
translation: 很高兴听到。

english: Hello there. What is this place?
translation: 你好。这是什么地方？

english: Do not waste my time with trivial questions. I am the Great Kolodion, master of battle magic. I have an arena to run.
translation: 不要用琐碎问题浪费我的时间。我是伟大的科洛迪恩，战斗魔法大师。我有个竞技场要运营。

english: Can I enter?
translation: 我能进入吗？

english: Hah! A wizard of your level? Don't be absurd.
translation: 哈！你这个等级的法师？别荒谬了。

english: Hello, Kolodion.
translation: 你好，科洛迪恩。

english: Hey there, how are you? Are you enjoying the bloodshed?
translation: 嘿，怎么样？你享受流血吗？

english: I think I've had enough for now.
translation: 我想我现在受够了。

english: A shame. You're a good battle mage. I hope to see you soon.
translation: 可惜。你是个好战斗法师。我希望很快见到你。

english: How can I use my new spells outside of the arena?
translation: 我怎么在竞技场外用我的新法术？

english: Experience, my friend, experience. Once you've used the spell enough times in the arena, you'll be able to use them in the rest of Gielinor.
translation: 经验，我的朋友，经验。一旦你在竞技场使用了法术足够次数，你就能在基利诺尔其余地方使用它们。

english: Good stuff.
translation: 好东西。

english: Not so good for the citizens; they won't stand a chance.
translation: 对公民不太好；他们没机会。

english: How am I doing so far?
translation: 我目前怎么样？

english: You still need to train with the strike spell inside the arena before you can use it outside.
translation: 你仍然需要在竞技场内训练冲击法术才能在外面使用。

english: You have completed over half of the training needed to use the strike spell outside of the arena.
translation: 你已经完成了在竞技场外用冲击法术所需训练的一半以上。

english: You are almost ready to use the strike spell outside of the arena.
translation: 你几乎准备好在竞技场外用冲击法术了。

english: You're experienced enough to use the strike spell anywhere.
translation: 你有足够经验在任何地方使用冲击法术。

english: You still need to train with the claw spell inside the arena before you can use it outside.
translation: 你仍然需要在竞技场内训练爪击法术才能在外面使用。

english: You have completed over half of the training needed to use the claw spell outside of the arena.
translation: 你已经完成了在竞技场外用爪击法术所需训练的一半以上。

english: You are almost ready to use the claw spell outside of the arena.
translation: 你几乎准备好在竞技场外用爪击法术了。

english: You're experienced enough to use the claw spell anywhere.
translation: 你有足够经验在任何地方使用爪击法术。

english: You still need to train with the flame spell inside the arena before you can use it outside.
translation: 你仍然需要在竞技场内训练火焰法术才能在外面使用。

english: You have completed over half of the training needed to use the flame spell outside of the arena.
translation: 你已经完成了在竞技场外用火焰法术所需训练的一半以上。

english: You are almost ready to use the flame spell outside of the arena.
translation: 你几乎准备好在竞技场外用火焰法术了。

english: You're experienced enough to use the flame spell anywhere.
translation: 你有足够经验在任何地方使用火焰法术。

english: Are there any more challenges available?

english: Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: 你能给我些种植建议吗？

english: The only way to cure a bush or tree of disease is to prune away the diseased leaves with a pair of secateurs. For all other crops I would just apply some plant-cure.
translation: 治愈灌木或树木疾病的唯一方法是用修枝剪剪掉病叶。其他作物我只需用些植物治愈剂。

english: Tree seeds must be grown in a plantpot of soil into a sapling, and then transferred to a tree patch to continue growing to adulthood.
translation: 树木种子得先在装土的花盆里养成树苗，再移栽到树木种植地，才能继续长成大树。

english: You can put up to ten potatoes, cabbages or onions in vegetable sacks, although you can't have a mix in the same sack.
translation: 蔬菜袋里最多能装十个土豆、卷心菜或者洋葱，不过一袋里可不能混着装。

english: You can buy all the farming tools from farming shops, which can be found close to the allotments.
translation: 你可以从种植店买所有种植工具，就在分配地附近。

english: Bittercap mushrooms can only be grown in a special patch in Morytania, near the Mort Myre swamp. There the ground is especially dank and suited to growing poisonous fungii.
translation: 苦帽菇只能种在莫利塔尼亚、莫特迈耶沼泽附近的特殊种植地里。那里阴暗潮湿，适合毒蘑菇生长。

english: Supercompost is far better than normal compost, but more expensive to make. You need to rot the right type of item; show me an item, and I'll tell you if it's super- compostable or not.
translation: 超级堆肥比普通堆肥强多了，但做起来也更费事。你得用对东西才能堆出来——拿件物品给我看看，我告诉你它能不能做成超级堆肥。

english: There is a special patch for growing Belladonna - I believe that it is somewhere near Draynor Manor, where the ground is a tad 'unblessed'.
translation: 颠茄有专门的种植地——我记得是在德雷诺庄园附近，那地方的土嘛，有点''不受祝福''。

english: Applying compost to a patch will not only reduce the chance that your crops will get diseased, but you will also grow more crops to harvest.
translation: 给种植地施堆肥不仅能降低作物生病几率，还能收获更多作物。

english: If you want to grow fruit trees you could try a few places: Catherby, Brimhaven, Gnome Stronghold and the Farming Guild all have fruit tree patches.
translation: 如果你想种果树可以试试几个地方：凯瑟比镇、布尔哈文镇、地精要塞和农业公会都有果树种植地。

english: You can fill plantpots with soil from any empty patch, if you have a gardening trowel.
translation: 如果你有园艺铲，可以用任何空地的土壤填满花盆。

english: Hops are good for brewing ales. I believe there's a brewery up in Keldagrim somewhere, and I've heard rumours that a place called Phasmatys used to be good for that type of thing. 'Fore they all died, of course.
translation: 啤酒花适合酿造麦酒。我相信凯尔达格林城某处有个酿酒厂，我还听说一个叫法斯玛提斯的地方以前也酿造这种酒。当然那是在他们都死光之前的事了。

english: Vegetables, hops and flowers need constant watering - if you ignore my advice, you will sooner or later find yourself in possession of a dead farming patch.
translation: 蔬菜、啤酒花和花朵需要持续浇水——如果无视我的建议，你迟早会发现拥有块死的种植地。

english: You can put up to five tomatoes, strawberries, apples, bananas or oranges into a fruit basket, although you can't have a mix in the same basket.
translation: 你可以在水果篮里放最多五个番茄、草莓、苹果、香蕉或橙子，但不能混装。

english: Don't just throw away your weeds after you've raked a patch - put them in a compost bin and make some compost.
translation: 耙完种植地后别直接扔掉杂草——放进堆肥箱做堆肥。

english: There are five other Farming areas like this one - Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius and Alan's area in the Farming Guild.
translation: 有五个其他像这样的种植区——法拉多城附近的埃尔斯坦区，凯瑟比镇附近的丹塔拉区，摩利亚的莱拉区，霍西迪乌斯城的马里斯区和农业公会的艾伦区。

english: What are you going to do about it? Eh? I totally owned you!
translation: 你打算怎么办？嗯？我完全碾压了你！

english: Hate you hate you hate you!!!
translation: 恨你恨你恨你！！！

english: What do you think about up there?
translation: 你对上面有什么想法？

english: Think?
translation: 想？

english: You know, what goes through your tiny stuffed head?
translation: 你知道，你那小小的填充头里在想什么？

english: Little bugs...
translation: 小虫子……

english: You have bugs living in you? Eww!
translation: 你体内有虫子活着？咦！

english: Little bugs! Stomp and crush and stomp!
translation: 小虫子！踩碎踩碎再踩！

english: Yeah! Stomp the bugs!
translation: 是啊！踩虫子！

english: Stomp crush splat!
translation: 踩碎啪！

english: Smash! Destroy! Crunch break tear destroy splunch! Hurt wound kill hit punch stab slash kill!
translation: 砸！毁灭！咔嚓撕裂毁灭啪叽！伤害伤口杀打击刺劈杀！

english: 'Splunch'? That is not a word!
translation: ‘啪叽’？那不是个词！

english: I HATE WORDS! Kill all words!
translation: 我恨词！杀光所有词！

english: You said 'kill' twice!
translation: 你说了两次‘杀’！

english: I like kill! Hur hur hur hur!
translation: 我喜欢杀！嘿嘿嘿嘿！

english: Yeah! Kill smash destroy!
translation: 是啊！杀砸毁灭！

english: Kill smash destroy! Hur hur hur!
translation: 杀砸毁灭！嘿嘿嘿！

english: What have the bugs done to you?
translation: 虫子对你做了什么？

english: Skitter skitter through head noise in ears behind eyes.
translation: 沙沙沙沙穿过头噪音在耳朵在眼睛后。

english: HATE THEM! Kill kill kill!
translation: 恨它们！杀杀杀！

english: You can't, you've got no feet!
translation: 你不能，你没脚！

english: No feet...
translation: 没脚……

english: Hate lack of feet! Stomp lack of feet! Kill crush destroy smash!
translation: 恨没脚！踩没脚！杀砸毁灭砸！

english: That makes no sense! You can't destroy the absence of something!
translation: 那没道理！你不能毁灭某物的缺失！

english: Hate requirement to make sense! Smash it kill it destroy kill kill!
translation: 恨要有道理的要求！砸它杀它毁灭杀杀！

english: You can't physically destroy an abstract concept! It's impossible!
translation: 你不能物理上毁灭一个抽象概念！那是不可能的！

english: Hate abstract concepts! Hate impossible! Kill kill kill destroy smash!
translation: 恨抽象概念！恨不可能！杀杀杀毁灭砸！

english: This is getting both surreal and repetitive.
translation: 这变得既超现实又重复。

english: Why are you so violent?
translation: 你为什么这么暴力？

english: You seemed pretty angry before I killed you
translation: 我杀你之前你似乎已经很生气了

english: I'm sorry I killed you
translation: 抱歉我杀了你

english: Please try to calm down
translation: 请试着冷静下来

english: I'm not really sorry
translation: 我其实不抱歉

english: I killed you really easily!
translation: 我杀你真的很容易！

english: What do you think about up there?
translation: 你对上面有什么想法？

english: Yeah! Stomp the bugs!
translation: 是啊！踩虫子！

english: 'Splunch'? That's not a word!
translation: ‘啪叽’？那不是个词！

english: You said 'kill' twice
translation: 你说了两次‘杀’

english: Yeah! Kill smash destroy!
translation: 是啊！杀砸毁灭！

english: What have the bugs done to you?
translation: 虫子对你做了什么？

english: You can't, you've got no feet!
translation: 你不能，你没脚！

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Not infected are you?
translation: 你没被感染吧？

english: I don't think so.
translation: 我不这么认为。

english: You don't seem very sure. We don't want any infected near the children. Be off with you!
translation: 你似乎不太确定。我们不想任何感染者靠近孩子。走开！

english: Whatever it is you're selling, we ain't interested!
translation: 不管你在卖什么，我们没兴趣！

english: But I'm not...
translation: 但我不是……

english: Did you not hear me? Clear off!
translation: 你没听到我吗？滚开！

english: Strewth! Nippy little blighters!
translation: 天哪！讨厌的小家伙！

english: Excuse me?
translation: 打扰一下？

english: Oh G'day! Sorry, didn't see you there!
translation: 哦你好！抱歉，没看到你在那！

english: That's okay. What seems to be the problem?
translation: 没关系。似乎有什么问题？

english: Oh, well I wanted to catch some minnows so I could use 'em as bait, but the little blighters are just too quick! I managed to get 'em all rounded up over on my fishing platform, but I still can't catch 'em!
translation: 哦，嗯我想抓些米诺鱼好把它们当诱饵，但这些小家伙太快了！我设法把它们都赶到我的钓鱼平台上，但我还是抓不到它们！

english: Then, to make things worse, any time I do finally catch some, those bloody flying fish jump out at me and gobble up me minnows!
translation: 然后，更糟的是，每当我终于抓到一些，那些该死的飞鱼就跳出来吞掉我的米诺鱼！

english: What I need is someone who can catch 'em for me!
translation: 我需要的是能帮我抓它们的人！

english: Well, maybe I could help out?
translation: 嗯，也许我能帮忙？

english: Well I don't know. I don't want to be letting just anyone onto me fishing platform! But I guess if you could show me that you are a worthy fisher than that would be okay. I can even give you shark in exchange
translation: 嗯我不知道。我不想让任何人上我的钓鱼平台！但我想如果你能向我证明你是个合格的渔夫那就可以。

english: for the minnows you catch, 'cos them I can catch no problem!
translation: 我甚至可以用鲨鱼换你抓的米诺鱼，因为那些我能抓没问题！

english: Sounds fair. What can I do to show that I am worthy?
translation: 听起来公平。我能做什么来证明我合格？

english: Well you should be very experienced in the art of fishing, own the proper attire, and be recognised by your peers as a great fisherman.
translation: 嗯你应该在钓鱼艺术上非常有经验，拥有合适的装备，并被同行认可为伟大的渔夫。

english: You must have level 82 Fishing, be wearing the complete Angler's outfit and have completed Fishing Contest in order to suitably impress Kylie.
translation: 你必须拥有82级钓鱼，穿着完整的渔夫套装并完成钓鱼竞赛才能合适地打动凯莉。

english: So, how about letting me out onto your fishing platform?
translation: 那么，让我上你的钓鱼平台怎么样？

english: Ripper! You certainly seem to be the real deal, so sure, go ahead and take the boat over there. Oh, and don't worry about wearing that angling gear if yous don't want to, I just wanted to see that you took fishing
translation: 太棒了！你似乎确实是真材实料，所以当然，去那边乘船吧。哦，如果你不想穿那套钓鱼装备也别担心，

english: serious enough to have the right attire.
translation: 我只是想看看你是否足够重视钓鱼而拥有合适的装备。

english: Sorry, but I just don't think you are experienced enough.
translation: 抱歉，但我只觉得你经验不够。

english: Sorry, but I just don't think you are renowned enough as a [fisherman/fisherwoman].
translation: 抱歉，但我只觉得你作为 [fisherman/fisherwoman] 不够有名。

english: Sorry, but I just don't think you are wearin' suitable fishing gear.
translation: 抱歉，但我只觉得你没穿合适的钓鱼装备。

english: G'day, only the best fishers are allowed onto the fishing platform. You need a fishing level of 82.
translation: 你好，只有最好的渔夫才被允许上钓鱼平台。你需要82级钓鱼。

english: I don't think I have given you access to my fishing platform. Come and speak to me if you would like to get access.
translation: 我想我还没给你访问我的钓鱼平台的权限。如果你想获得访问权限来跟我说话。

english: Have you got any minnows for trade? I have plenty of nice, fresh sharks waiting for ya!
translation: 你有米诺鱼交易吗？我有很多新鲜鲨鱼等你！

english: Yes, let's trade.
translation: 是的，我们交易吧。

english: I can give you a shark for every 40 minnows that you give me. How many sharks would you like?
translation: 你每给我40条米诺鱼我可以给你一条鲨鱼。你想要多少鲨鱼？

english: You'll be needing at least 40 minnows to trade for a shark! Come back and see me when you have some more!
translation: 你需要至少40条米诺鱼才能换一条鲨鱼！等你有了更多再来见我！

english: I can't trade you any sharks while you don't have any space for them!
translation: 你没空间放时我不能交易你任何鲨鱼！

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Yes, let's trade.
translation: 是的，我们交易吧。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Seren be with you friend.
translation: 塞伦与你同在朋友。

english: Hey there, how are things?
translation: 嘿，怎么样？

english: At long last we are back in our city, our home. Here in the light of Seren, we can properly continue our path to enlightenment.
translation: 终于我们回到了我们的城市，我们的家园。在塞伦的光芒下，我们可以正确地继续我们的启蒙之路。

english: How do you do that?
translation: 你怎么做到的？

english: We cleanse our minds in prayer, and hone our bodies through agility. You can join us if you like. Feel free to reflect at our altar, or take to the roofs on our agility course.
translation: 我们在祈祷中净化心灵，通过敏捷磨练身体。如果你喜欢可以加入我们。随意在我们的祭坛反思，或在我们的敏捷课程上屋顶。

english: I might just do that, thanks.
translation: 我可能就那么做，谢谢。

english: Good to see you again [player name]. Have you come to marvel at the beauty of Prifddinas?
translation: 很高兴又见到你 [player name]。你是来惊叹普里夫迪纳斯城的美丽吗？

english: It's definitely a sight to behold.
translation: 那绝对是值得一看的景象。

english: Indeed it is. I love exploring, seeking out the hidden secrets of this world. But nothing will ever compare to this place, to our home.
translation: 确实是。我爱探索，寻找这个世界的隐藏秘密。但没什么能比得上这个地方，我们的家园。

english: I'm very privileged to be able to see it.
translation: 我很荣幸能看到它。

english: And we are very privileged to have you here.
translation: 我们也很荣幸有你在这里。

english: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？

english: Nothing?
translation: 没什么？

english: Clear off then.
translation: 那滚开。

english: Who are you? Why are you in my home?
translation: 你是谁？你为什么在我家？

english: I'm [Vampyre name]. I was just looking around.
translation: 我是 [Vampyre name]。我只是四处看看。

english: You half-breeds are becoming too arrogant for your own good. If you're not careful, someone might call for a good culling. Now get out of my house!
translation: 你们混血儿变得太傲慢了。如果不小心，有人可能会要求好好清洗。现在滚出我家！

english: Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: 人类！在我叫守卫之前滚回奴隶栏！

english: Hello, Lady Servil.
translation: 你好，塞维尔女士。

english: Hello there. My husband and son are resting while I wait for the cart fixer.
translation: 你好。我丈夫和儿子在休息而我等待马车修理师。

english: Well I hope it doesn't take too long.
translation: 嗯我希望不会花太久。

english: I'm sure it won't. Thanks again for everything.
translation: 我确信不会。再次感谢一切。

english: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？

english: Tell me about the Saviours of Kourend.
translation: 和我说说库兰德救国会。

english: For many years I used my position to fight against the crime and corruption in this city. No matter what I did it was never enough though. I realised that to defeat my enemies I needed to act as they do.
translation: 多年来我利用我的职位对抗这个城市的犯罪和腐败。无论我做什么都不够。我意识到要击败敌人我需要像他们一样行动。

english: That's why I formed the Saviours of Kourend. We take the laws into our own hands and fight against all who would damage this city, no matter who they are.
translation: 那就是我组建库兰德救国会的原因。我们亲手执行法律并对抗所有会损害这个城市的人，不管他们是谁。

english: What else do you want?
translation: 你还想要什么？

english: Tell me about Port Piscarilius.
translation: 和我说说皮斯卡里琉斯港。

english: You've been here how long? You should know what we do by now.
translation: 你在这里多久了？你现在应该知道我们做什么。

english: Port Piscarilius is home to Kourend's fishermen and traders. We are the first port of call for any visitors to Kourend which means Port Piscarilius is home to a wide variety of individuals.
translation: 皮斯卡里琉斯港是库兰德王国渔夫和商人的家园。我们是任何库兰德王国访客的第一站这意味着皮斯卡里琉斯港是各种各样的人的家园。

english: All people and goods coming to or from Kourend go through Port Piscarilius. This unfortunatly means that we are a centre point for the majority of crime within the city.
translation: 所有来往库兰德王国的人和货物都经过皮斯卡里琉斯港。不幸的是这意味着我们是城市内大多数犯罪的中心点。

english: For many years I appealed to the Kourend Council for help in fighting this crime, but they cared little for us. Instead, I decided to beat them at their own game and fight fire with fire.
translation: 多年来我向库兰德议会求助对抗这种犯罪，但他们很少关心我们。相反，我决定以其人之道还治其人之身以火攻火。

english: Tell me about your plans.
translation: 和我说说你的计划。

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: How about you go away then?
translation: 那你走开怎么样？

english: Looking for your reward, idiot? Take it and get lost.
translation: 找你的奖励，白痴？拿着它滚蛋。

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 和我说说你自己。

english: Tell me about the Saviours of Kourend.
translation: 和我说说库兰德救国会。

english: Tell me about Port Piscarilius.
translation: 和我说说皮斯卡里琉斯港。

english: Tell me about your plans.
translation: 和我说说你的计划。

english: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: Hi there.
translation: 你好。

english: Good to see you [player name]. You're very brave to come see me.
translation: 很高兴见到你 [player name]。你来见我很勇敢。

english: How come?
translation: 为什么？

english: Most of the elves around here give me a wide berth. They seem to find me intimidating. How ironic that an old woman is more of a threat to them than the entire Iorwerth clan.
translation: 这里大多数精灵都躲着我。他们似乎觉得我令人畏惧。多么讽刺一个老妇人对他们比整个伊奥沃斯氏族更有威胁。

english: You must have seen a fair bit in your time.
translation: 你一定在你的一生中见过不少。

english: Oh yes, I'm the oldest elf still alive. You can thank this exoskeleton for that, one of our finer inventions.
translation: 哦是的，我是活着的最老的精灵。你可以感谢这个外骨骼，我们更好的发明之一。

english: You must have plenty of stories to tell.
translation: 你一定有很多故事要讲。

english: Yes, but not the time to tell them. They have plenty of books in the Tower of Voices if you want stories, most of them are from our Grand Library.
translation: 是的，但不是讲它们的时候。如果你想要故事声音塔里有很多书，大多数来自我们的大图书馆。

english: I'd personally recommend the one about Zalcano, a fun tale about how we trapped her beneath the city. She's still here now in fact, feel free to go give her a poke.
translation: 我个人推荐关于扎尔卡诺的那本，一个关于我们如何把她困在城市下的有趣故事。事实上她现在还在这里，随意去戳她。

english: I'll see about paying her a visit. See you later.
translation: 我会考虑去拜访她。回头见。

english: ...and he says that it's of the greatest urgency.
translation: ……他说这是最紧急的。

english: Greatest urgency? I don't like urgency. This is quite simply not on.
translation: 最紧急？我不喜欢紧急。这简直不行。

english: Hiya!
translation: 嗨！

english: Who is this human, Councillor Unkar? What are they doing here?
translation: 这个人类是谁，昂卡议员？他们在这里做什么？

english: I'm afraid I don't know.
translation: 恐怕我不知道。

english: Oh. Could you make them go away?
translation: 哦。你能让他们走开吗？

english: Sorry human. We're currently engaging in important official business. You'll need to come back another time.
translation: 抱歉人类。我们目前在进行重要的官方事务。你需要改天再来。

english: Oh look, it's the human. Hello human.
translation: 哦看，是人类。你好，人类。

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 和我说说你自己。

english: Myself? Oh.
translation: 我自己？哦。

english: Well I'm Vulcana Lovakengj, the head of Lovakengj House. I rule the city of Lovakengj.
translation: 嗯我是武尔卡纳‧洛瓦肯吉，洛瓦肯吉家族的首领。我统治洛瓦肯吉城。

english: Cool.
translation: 酷。

english: Anything else?
translation: 还有别的吗？

english: Oh... No I don't think so.
translation: 哦……不我不这么认为。

english: Huh, fair enough.
translation: 哈，说得过去。

english: Tell me about Lovakengj.
translation: 和我说说洛瓦肯吉城。

english: Lovakengj?
translation: 洛瓦肯吉城？

english: Yes! I know a lot about Lovakengj!
translation: 是的！我知道很多关于洛瓦肯吉城！

english: Lovakengj is a city of dwarves. It's the only non-human city in Kourend.
translation: 洛瓦肯吉城是矮人的城市。它是库兰德王国唯一非人类城市。

english: Lovakengj is very important you know. The resources mined here are used throughout the kingdom. Weapons, armour, tools, buildings...
translation: 洛瓦肯吉城非常重要你知道。这里开采的资源在整个王国使用。武器，护甲，工具，建筑……

english: All sorts of things come out of Lovakengj.
translation: 各种各样的东西出自洛瓦肯吉城。

english: Tell me about your plans.
translation: 和我说说你的计划。

english: My plans? Hmm let me see now...
translation: 我的计划？嗯让我看看……

english: Ah, I know. I'll have a sherry.
translation: 啊，我知道。我要喝雪利酒。

english: Jorra! Bring me a sherry.
translation: 乔拉！给我拿杯雪利酒。

english: Yes Lady Lovakengj.
translation: 是的洛瓦肯吉女士。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Goodbye human.
translation: 再见人类。

english: Apparently you need a reward or something? Here you go.
translation: 显然你需要奖励或什么？给你。

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 和我说说你自己。

english: Tell me about Lovakengj.
translation: 和我说说洛瓦肯吉城。

english: Tell me about your plans.
translation: 和我说说你的计划。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Clear off! Let me drink in peace!
translation: 滚开！让我安静喝酒！

english: Okay then.
translation: 好吧。

english: Hello, I'm Laidee. Welcome to the Warriors' Guild.
translation: 你好，我是莱迪。欢迎来到战士公会。

english: What are you doing out here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: I'm here to guard the Warrior's Guild and determine who's qualified to enter.
translation: 我在这里守卫战士公会并决定谁有资格进入。

english: So you're Ghommal's replacement?
translation: 所以你是戈马尔的继任者？

english: That I am. Ghommal and I used to adventure together before we joined the Guild. It felt only right that I take over from him. It is... strange not having him around.
translation: 我是。戈马尔和我在加入公会前一起冒险。我觉得我接替他是理所当然的。没有他在身边……很奇怪。

english: I'm sorry for your loss. He was a great warrior.
translation: 我为你的损失感到抱歉。他是个伟大的战士。

english: And an even greater friend.
translation: 更是个伟大的朋友。

english: I'm here to talk about Combat Achievements.
translation: 我来谈谈战斗成就。

english: Could you explain what they are?
translation: 你能解释它们是什么吗？

english: Combat Achievements are a set of tasks for all adventurers to try and accomplish. They range from simple missions to kill various creatures, to challenges that will push you to your limits.
translation: 战斗成就是一套所有冒险者尝试完成的任务。范围从杀死各种生物的简单任务，到将你推向极限的挑战。

english: The purpose of these tasks is for you to grow and improve, experience all that Gielinor has to offer, and become stronger in the process.
translation: 这些任务的目的是让你成长和改进，体验基利诺尔提供的一切，并在此过程中变得更强。

english: Is this something that sounds interesting to you?
translation: 这听起来对你有趣吗？

english: Yes, tell me about Combat Achievements.
translation: 是的，和我说说战斗成就。

english: Combat Achievements are broken down into six tiers: Easy, Medium, Hard, Elite, Master and Grandmaster.
translation: 战斗成就分为六个等级：简单，中等，困难，精英，大师和宗师。

english: That seems like a strange thing to ask for, but very well, I'll stop using your stored bracelet charges on you. Talk to me if you want to start using them again.
translation: 那似乎是个奇怪的要求，但很好，我会停止在你身上使用你存储的手镯充能。如果你想再次使用它们跟我说话。

english: I'd like to use my stored bracelet charges again.
translation: 我想再次使用我存储的手镯充能。

english: Ah, that's more like it! Yes, I'll start using your stored bracelet charges on you if you don't have a Castle Wars bracelet equipped when a game starts. Talk to me again if you decide you'd rather not have me do that.
translation: 啊，那更像样！是的，如果你在游戏开始时没有装备城堡战争手镯，我会开始在你身上使用你存储的手镯充能。如果你决定不想让我那样做再跟我说话。

english: Nothing interesting happens.
translation: 没什么有趣的事发生。

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: Really, how do I do that?
translation: 真的，我怎么做？

english: Are there any rules?
translation: 有什么规则吗？

translation: 我能赢什么？

translation: 看看我这只死鸡。

translation: 你有什么交易？

english: Do you have a manual? I'd like to learn how to play!
translation: 你有手册吗？我想学习怎么玩！

english: Is there something I can do with these bracelets?
translation: 我能用这些手镯做什么吗？

english: I cannot speak to you outerlander! Talk to Brundt, the Chieftain!
translation: 我不能和你说话外乡人！跟布伦特，酋长说话！

english: You stay away from me outerlander!
translation: 你离我远点外乡人！

english: They are too suspicious of you for you to get close enough to steal from them.
translation: 他们对你太怀疑了你无法靠近到足以偷他们。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Hello again [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. What need you of me this day? You can always rely on my assistance!
translation: 又见面了 [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]。你今天需要我什么？你总是可以依靠我的帮助！

english: Nothing thanks. I just fancied a chat.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。我只是想聊天。

english: My door is always open should you ever need my help [Fremennik name].
translation: 如果你需要我的帮助我的门总是为你敞开 [Fremennik name]。

english: [Fremennik name]... It has been too long since last we met!
translation: [Fremennik name]……我们上次见面已经太久了！

english: Welcome back [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It is always a pleasure to see you here!
translation: 欢迎回来 [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]。在这里见到你总是很高兴！

english: My apologies [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! I have not time to tarry here with you!
translation: 抱歉 [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]！我没时间在这里逗留！

english: That's okay, I didn't really want anything.
translation: 没关系，我其实没什么想要的。

english: How are you [Fremennik name]? I hope all fares well with you this day!
translation: 你好吗 [Fremennik name]？我希望你今天一切顺利！

english: I'm fine, thanks, how are you?
translation: 我很好，谢谢，你呢？

english: All is well with me also!
translation: 我也一切都好！

english: Hello to you, too!
translation: 也向你问好！

english: Hello. Did you want something [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你好。你想要什么 [Fremennik name]？

english: No, not really.
translation: 不，不太想。

english: Well... okay then!
translation: 嗯……好吧！

english: Always good to see you [brother/sister] [Fremennik name].
translation: 见到你总是好事 [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]。

english: You shame us, [Fremennik name]!
translation: 你让我们蒙羞，[Fremennik name]！

english: How can you steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你怎么能偷我的东西，[Fremennik name]？

english: You have betrayed your heritage, [Fremennik name]!
translation: 你背叛了你的遗产，[Fremennik name]！

english: Why would you try to steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你为什么试图偷我的东西，[Fremennik name]？

english: Woooo wooo wooooo woooo
translation: 呜呜 呜呜 呜呜呜 呜呜

english: Do you want something, mortal?
translation: 你想要什么，凡人？

english: Who are you and why are you here?
translation: 你是谁你为什么在这里？

english: Once I was a merchant. I worked hard and became wealthy, very wealthy. I was brave too, storing my possessions in two great chests here, where few would dare to interfere with them.
translation: 曾经我是个商人。我努力工作变得富有，非常富有。我也勇敢，把我的财产存在这里的两个大箱子里，那里很少有人敢干涉它们。

english: But I was not strong enough. One day a witch allied with the pirates of the north; between their strength and her magic, they killed me. The pirates carried one of my chests away to their ship.
translation: 但我不够强。一天一个女巫与北方海盗结盟；在他们的力量和她的魔法之间，他们杀了我。海盗把我的一个箱子带到他们的船上。

english: I keep vigil here now, as it interests me to watch adventurers come to raid this little chest, whenever they can find one of my keys.
translation: 我现在在这里守夜，因为看着冒险者来抢劫这个小箱子让我感兴趣，只要他们能找到我的一个钥匙。

english: My bigger chest was taken north to the pirates' ship - a brave adventurer may like to raid that one instead, if they can handle the perils of the north. I kept more wealth in that one.
translation: 我更大的箱子被带到北方的海盗船上——一个勇敢的冒险者可能喜欢抢劫那个，如果他能处理北方的危险。我在那个里面放了更多财富。

english: I've got your key.
translation: 我有你的钥匙。

english: Well done, adventurer. I have two chests, containing my wealth from the days when I was alive. The smaller one is here, and the bigger one was taken far to the north, to the pirates' ship.
translation: 干得好，冒险者。我有两个箱子，包含我活着时的财富。较小的这个在这里，较大的那个被带到很远的北方，到海盗船上。

english: You can use the key to open either of them. The bigger one, in the pirates' ship, contains more wealth than this small one.
translation: 你可以用钥匙打开其中任何一个。较大的那个，在海盗船上，比这个小箱子包含更多财富。

english: Can you give me anything?
translation: 你能给我什么吗？

english: If you want my worldly goods, open my chests with my keys. Adventurers occasionally find my keys while slaying monsters in the Wilderness, on assignment from the witch Krystilia.
translation: 如果你想要我的世俗物品，用我的钥匙打开我的箱子。冒险者偶尔在荒野杀戮怪物时发现我的钥匙，在女巫克里斯蒂利亚的任务上。

english: I do not know why Krystilia sends adventurers to find my keys instead of looting the chest herself. Perhaps it amuses her to send people into this land to risk their lives.
translation: 我不知道为什么克里斯蒂利亚派冒险者找我的钥匙而不是自己抢劫箱子。也许她觉得派人进入这片土地冒险很有趣。

english: I'll leave you to it.
translation: 我不打扰你了。

english: I will be here if you return.
translation: 如果你回来我会在这里。

english: Who are you and why are you here?
translation: 你是谁你为什么在这里？

english: I've got your key.
translation: 我有你的钥匙。

english: Can you give me anything?
translation: 你能给我什么吗？

english: I'll leave you to it.
translation: 我不打扰你了。

english: Oh, thank Armadyl! I am in such a worry... please help me!
translation: 哦，感谢阿玛杜尔！我很担心……请帮我！

english: With what?
translation: 用什么？

english: Oh... it is terrible... horrible... My boyfriend lives here in this lighthouse, but I haven't seen him the last few days! I think something terrible has happened!
translation: 哦……很可怕……可怕……我男朋友住在这个灯塔里，但我这几天没见到他！我想发生了可怕的事！

english: Look, you can see for yourself that the light has gone out, and the front door is locked up tight! He would NEVER do that!
translation: 看，你可以自己看到灯灭了，前门锁紧了！他绝不会那样做！

english: With the light off this coastline is terribly dangerous to ships! And to lock the front door so that nobody can turn the light back on?
translation: 灯灭了这个海岸线对船只非常危险！而锁上前门让没人能打开灯？

english: Maybe he just went on holiday or something? Must be pretty boring living in a lighthouse.
translation: 也许他只是去度假或什么？住在灯塔里一定很无聊。

english: That is terribly irresponsible! He is far too thoughtful for that! He would never leave it unattended! He would also never leave without telling me!
translation: 那非常不负责任！他太体贴了不会那样！他绝不会让它无人看管！他也绝不会不告诉我就离开！

english: Please, I know something terrible has happened to him... I can sense it! Please... please help me adventurer!
translation: 求求你，我知道发生了可怕的事……我能感觉到！求求……求求你帮我冒险者！

english: But how can I help?
translation: 但我怎么帮？

english: Well, we have to do something to get the lighthouse working again! Also, as you may have noticed, the storm that knocked the bridge out
translation: 嗯，我们得做些什么让灯塔再次工作！另外，如你可能注意到的，

english: has trapped me on this causeway! You seem to have got here okay somehow, so if you could go and visit my cousin and get the spare key I left him,
translation: 撞倒桥的风暴把我困在这个堤道上！你似乎不知怎么到了这里，所以如果你能去拜访我的表亲并拿到我留给他的备用钥匙，

english: as well as fix the bridge enough so that I can go and speak to my family in Rellekka and tell them whats happened, I will be eternally grateful!
translation: 以及修复桥足够让我能去雷勒克卡跟我的家人说话并告诉他们发生了什么，我将永远感激！

english: Okay, I'll help!
translation: 好的，我帮！

english: OH! THANK YOU SO MUCH! I know my darling would never have left with the lighthouse lights off and without even telling me where he's gone!
translation: 哦！非常感谢！我知道我亲爱的绝不会在灯塔灯灭甚至不告诉我去哪的情况下离开！

english: Where is your cousin?
translation: 你的表亲在哪？

english: My cousin was always interested in agility. He left our home in Rellekka many moons ago, so that he could pursue this interest.
translation: 我的表亲一直对敏捷感兴趣。他很多月前离开了我们在雷勒克卡的家，以便他能追求这个兴趣。

english: I don't exactly know where he has gone, but I am sure he went somewhere to practise his agility. If you see him, his name is Gunnjorn. Mention my name, he will recognise it.
translation: 我不确切知道他去哪了，但我确信他去某处练习他的敏捷了。如果你见到他，他的名字是冈约恩。提到我的名字，他会认出它。

english: How can I fix the bridge?
translation: 我怎么修复桥？

english: Well, I am not just some helpless girl! I have pretty good agility, so you will only need to use two planks to make a ledge that I can balance along.
translation: 嗯，我不只是个无助的女孩！我有相当好的敏捷，所以你只需要用两块木板做一个我能平衡的平台。

english: Just use a plank on each side of the bridge. You will need a hammer, and thirty steel nails for each plank you use as well. I believe there are some planks near here...
translation: 只需在桥的每边用一块木板。你需要一把锤子，以及你用的每块木板三十个钢钉。我相信附近有一些木板……

english: I'll see what I can do.
translation: 我看看我能做什么。

english: Thank you so much!
translation: 非常感谢！

english: Sorry, just passing through.
translation: 抱歉，只是路过。

english: Oh... my poor darling Jossik... I just know something terrible has happened...
translation: 哦……我可怜的亲爱的乔西克……我只知道发生了可怕的事……

english: Oh! Thank you so much for all of your help in rescuing my darling Jossik!
translation: 哦！非常感谢你所有帮助救了我的亲爱的乔西克！

english: I do not know what would have happened to him had you not chanced along this path!
translation: 我不知道如果你没偶然经过这条路他会发生什么！

english: Don't worry about it, I was glad to help out.
translation: 别担心，我很高兴帮忙。

english: Hey, I have something you might be interested in...
translation: 嘿，我有东西你可能感兴趣……

english: A book about lighthouses? I love it! I actually have something you might be interested in as well...
translation: 一本关于灯塔的书？我太喜欢了！我实际上也有东西你可能感兴趣……

english: I have way too much of that paint for the lighthouse. If you want more of it, just ask!
translation: 我有太多那种灯塔的油漆。如果你想要更多，尽管问！

english: Do you have any more paint?
translation: 你有更多油漆吗？

english: Certainly. How much do you want?
translation: 当然。你想要多少？

english: With what?
translation: 用什么？

english: But how can I help?
translation: 但我怎么帮？

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: Where is your cousin?
translation: 你的表亲在哪？

english: How can I fix the bridge?
translation: 我怎么修复桥？

english: I'll see what I can do
translation: 我看看我能做什么

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: Sorry, just passing through
translation: 抱歉，只是路过

english: Hello again. How are you doing?
translation: 又见面了。你怎么样？

english: Do you have any more paint?
translation: 你有更多油漆吗？

english: Hello. Do you need any help? I'm looking for a quest.
translation: 你好。你需要任何帮助吗？我在找任务。

english: I'm looking for an experienced adventurer and you're not it. Come back when you are more capable.
translation: 我在找个有经验的冒险者而你不是。当你更有能力时再来。

english: You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Cold War quest.
translation: 你不满足开始冷战任务的所有要求。

english: Are you working for them?
translation: 你为他们工作吗？

english: Uh, I'm not sure. Who are they?
translation: 呃，我不确定。他们是谁？

english: EXACTLY!
translation: 正是！

english: Seriously, what are you talking about?
translation: 说真的，你在说什么？

english: I think you can be trusted. What do you know about...
translation: 我想你可以被信任。你知道关于……

english: penguins?
translation: 企鹅？

english: Uh...they live in the cold? That's about all.
translation: 呃……它们住在冷的地方？就这些。

english: Would you like to learn more about them? I'm conducting a, uh, research project, to, uh, learn about their social habits in their natural environment.
translation: 你想了解更多关于它们吗？我在进行一个，呃，研究项目，来，呃，了解它们在自然环境中的社会习惯。

english: What do you need my help for?
translation: 你需要我帮助做什么？

english: Well, I need to build a shelter to hide from view, and it's always useful to have an extra pair of eyes, you know, for, uh, observing...Penguins.
translation: 嗯，我需要建个庇护所躲避视线，而且多一双眼睛总是有用的，你知道，为了，呃，观察……企鹅。

english: So, are you up for it?
translation: 那么，你愿意吗？

english: Okay, why not! But first, who are you and why are you researching penguins?
translation: 好的，为什么不！但首先，你是谁你为什么研究企鹅？

english: I, uh, was a zoo keeper here. But, I, uh, am on leave to go research penguins in their native habitat.
translation: 我，呃，曾是这里的动物园管理员。但，我，呃，在休假去研究企鹅在它们的原生栖息地。

english: Ok! Okay then. So, what did you need me to do?
translation: 好的！好吧。那么，你需要我做什么？

english: Right. I need you to gather materials for the bird hide, while I arrange for our transport.
translation: 好的。我需要你收集鸟舍的材料，而我安排我们的交通。

english: You need to get 10 oak planks, 10 steel nails, a hammer, and a spade so that we can build a bird hide.
translation: 你需要获得10块橡木木板，10个钢钉，一把锤子，和一把铲子以便我们能建个鸟舍。

english: Once you have those, meet me up by the entrance to Keldagrim, east of Rellekka. I'll be there with a boat to take us to our destination.
translation: 一旦你有了那些，在雷勒克卡东边的凯尔达格林城入口见我。我会在那里有船带我们去目的地。

english: Right, oak planks, steel nails, hammer, spade, east of Rellekka. Got it.
translation: 好的，橡木木板，钢钉，锤子，铲子，雷勒克卡东边。明白了。

english: You've started a new quest: Cold War
translation: 你开始了一个新任务：冷战

english: I don't think so.
translation: 我不这么认为。

english: What? Did you come to tell me I'm crazy too?
translation: 什么？你来告诉我我也疯了吗？

english: No, I...
translation: 不，我……

english: Oh, I don't have time for your lies. Go away
translation: 哦，我没时间听你的谎言。走开

english: Sorry, you can't use this boat.
translation: 抱歉，你不能使用这艘船。

english: I can't speak right now. I have too much to do. I will contact you when the time is right.
translation: 我现在不能说话。我有太多事要做。我会在合适的时候联系你。

english: On the way I'll tell you the 42 ways penguins can torture you using a feather...
translation: 在路上我会告诉你企鹅用羽毛折磨你的42种方法……

english: I've lost the clockwork book, could I have another?
translation: 我丢了发条书，能再要一本吗？

english: Well, lucky for you I did make another copy. But be more careful!
translation: 嗯，幸运为你我确实做了另一份副本。但更小心点！

english: What are we going to do about the penguins?
translation: 我们打算对企鹅做什么？

english: Thanks for helping My Arm earlier.
translation: 谢谢之前帮''我的手臂''。

english: Never speak to me about that again.
translation: 别再跟我提那个。

english: Okay, why not!
translation: 好的，为什么不！

english: I don't think so.
translation: 我不这么认为。

translation: 嘿，我是你的桃花心木家园承包商，你想做什么？

english: I'd like my range fixed.

english: I'd like two Wooden drawers built.
translation: 我想建造两个木制抽屉柜。

english: I'd like my hat stand fixed.

translation: 我想建造两个橡木抽屉柜。

english: I'd like a Oak table built.
translation: 我想建造一个橡木桌子。

english: I'd like two Teak drawers built.
translation: 我想建造两个柚木抽屉柜。

english: I'd like a Teak table built.
translation: 我想建造一个柚木桌子。

english: I'd like two Mahogany drawers built.
translation: 我想建造两个桃花心木抽屉柜。

translation: 我想建造一个桃花心木桌子。

english: I've finished with the work you wanted.
translation: 我完成了你想要的工作。

english: Thank you so much! Would you like a cup of tea before you go?
translation: 非常感谢！你走前想喝杯茶吗？

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
translation: 是的，我想喝杯茶。

english: No thanks, I better be off.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我最好走了。

english: Aaah, nothing like a nice cupppa tea!

translation: 是的，我想喝杯茶。

english: No thanks.

translation: 你好，有兴趣买我的一件特殊斗篷吗？

english: from everyone else. They're very useful when out in the wilderness with friends or anyone else you don't want to harm.
translation: 当和朋友或任何你不想伤害的人在荒野时非常有用。

english: So would you like to buy one?

english: What is this place?

english: This is the champions' arena. The champions of various races use it to duel those they deem worthy of the honour. If you find a challenge scroll in your travels, bring it here to face your challenger.
translation: 这是冠军竞技场。各种族的冠军用它来决斗他们认为值得荣誉的人。如果你在旅行中找到挑战卷轴，带这里来面对你的挑战者。

english: Have you any rewards for me?
translation: 你有什么奖励给我吗？

english: No, you've not earned any.
translation: 不，你没赢得任何。

english: Have a look in the chest by the Wall of Defeated Champions, on the north side of this gallery. I think you'll find something in there for you.
translation: 看看这个画廊北边被击败冠军墙旁的箱子。我想你会在那里找到些给你的东西。

english: You're holding it already. Go and rub your lamp.
translation: 你已经拿着它了。去擦你的灯。

english: I don't think I've got anything more for you.
translation: 我想我没什么更多给你的了。

english: Nothing thanks.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。

english: Leon d'Cour has issued you a challenge. He has stated there will be no items allowed except those you're wearing. Do you want to accept the challenge?

english: Your challenger is ready! Please go down through the trapdoor when you're ready.

english: No thanks, I'll pass.

english: Yes, please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: I'd like another one.

english: Thank you, and goodbye.

translation: 乘坐矿车要20金币。

translation: 你愿意帮我照看作物吗？

english: You don't have a sapling planted in that patch. Plant one and I might agree to look after it for you.
translation: 那块种植地里没种树苗。你先种点什么，我才可能考虑帮你照管。

english: Alright, I'll pay.
translation: 好的，我付。

english: That'll do nicely, sir. Leave it with me - I'll make sure that tree grows up good and strong.
translation: 那会很好，先生。把它留给我——我会确保那棵树长得又好又壮。

english: What the heck do you want with THAT?
translation: 你到底想用那个做什么？

english: They're for eating, silly! What else can you do with a monkey bar?
translation: 它们是吃的，傻瓜！你用猴子棒还能做什么？

english: And the Suqah tooth?
translation: 那苏卡牙齿呢？

english: Lots of gnomes like a bit of ground-up Suqah tooth. Just don't tell anyone about this, okay?
translation: 很多地精喜欢一点磨碎的苏卡牙齿。只是别告诉任何人这个，好吗？

english: Maybe some other time.
translation: 也许下次。

english: That patch is already fully grown! I don't know what you want me to do with it!

english: Can you give me any farming advice?

english: You can put up to five tomatoes, strawberries, apples, bananas or oranges into a fruit basket, although you can't have a mix in the same basket.
translation: 你可以在水果篮里放最多五个番茄、草莓、苹果、香蕉或橙子，但不能在同一个篮子里混装。

english: Can you sell me something?
translation: 你能卖我点什么吗？

english: That depends on whether I have it to sell. What is it that you're looking for?
translation: 那取决于我是否有卖。你在找什么？

english: Some plant cure.
translation: 些植物治愈剂。

english: Plant cure, eh? I might have some put aside for myself. Tell you what, I'll sell you some plant cure for 25 coins if you like.
translation: 植物治愈剂，嗯？我可能有些为自己留的。告诉你吧，如果你愿意，我卖你些植物治愈剂25金币。

english: Yes, that sounds like a fair price.
translation: 是的，那听起来像公平价格。

english: Latlink Fastbell hands over your purchase
translation: 拉特林克‧法斯特贝尔递过你的购买

english: No thanks, I can get that much cheaper elsewhere.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我在别处能便宜得多买到。

translation: 恐怕我没足够钱买那个。

translation: 一桶堆肥，嗯？我可能有个备用……告诉你吧，如果你愿意，我卖你35金币。

translation: 一把耙子，嗯？我可能有个备用……告诉你吧，如果你愿意，我卖你15金币。

english: Eh, I suppose I can spare you a plant pot, but I'll want 40 coins for it.
translation: 嗯，我想我能匀你一个花盆，但我要40金币。

english: A watering can, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 25 coins if you like.

english: A gardening trowel.

english: Forget it.
translation: 算了。
