translation: 我改天再来。

english: Hey, what are yo...
translation: 嘿，你是……

english: Sorry, can't talk to ye right now. Busy with paperwork. If ye need anythin', talk t' Captain Pudi over by the dock.
translation: 抱歉，现在不能和你说话。忙于文书工作。如果你需要什么，跟码头那边的普迪船长谈。

english: What can I do for ye? I be quite busy with paperwork.
translation: 我能为你做什么？我相当忙于文书工作。

english: I heard about your ship. Can you tell me what happened?
translation: 我听说关于你的船。你能告诉我发生了什么吗？

english: Aye, I can tell ye what happened.
translation: 是，我能告诉你发生了什么。

english: We be out on our fortnightly fishin' trip, I was doin' me normal work. Setting up the nets, swabbing the deck and the like.
translation: 我们在我们的双周钓鱼之旅上，我在做我的正常工作。设置网，擦拭甲板之类的。

english: 'Twas a good hawl t' start, plenty of manta ray and snappers. But we would be movin' on the next day to our deep sea fishin' spot.
translation: 开始是个好 haul，很多 manta ray 和 snappers。但我们第二天会移动到我们的深海钓鱼点。

english: 'Twas nothin' but smooth sailin' to our deep sea spot near Karamja, but on the way I noticed more debris in the water than usual.
translation: 到我们在卡拉姆詹岛附近的深海点只是一路顺风，但在路上我注意到水里有比平时更多的碎片。

english: What kind of debris? Was it ship debris?
translation: 什么种类的碎片？是船碎片吗？

english: Aye, 'twas. Most of the time, it be nets or items people throw off ships that they don't need. This had me worried a bit.
translation: 是，是。大多数时候，它是人们从船上扔掉的他们不需要的网或物品。这个让我有点担心。

english: There was a lack of fish in the water, 'twas kind of... eerie.
translation: 水里缺乏鱼，有点……诡异。

english: The next day, Koanee changed the ship's course, but that be because of a storm on the horizon.
translation: 第二天，科尼改变了船的航线，但那是因为地平线上的风暴。

english: But the storm seemed t' be... following us. As if it had a mind of its own.
translation: 但风暴似乎……在跟随我们。好像它有自己的思想。

english: The wind started a blowin' and the fog started a showin', huge waves crashing against the boat.
translation: 风开始吹，雾开始现，巨浪撞击船。

english: The ship started fallin' apart. I rushed to the cook's quarters and found 'im layin' on the floor with a plank over 'im.
translation: 船开始散架。我冲到厨师的房间发现他躺在地板上，一块木板在他身上。

english: I brought 'im up to the top deck and tied 'im to a piece of loose wood. I did the same t' the Skipper and Navigator.
translation: 我把他带到顶层甲板并把他绑在一块松动的木头上。我对船长和领航员做了同样的事。

english: Oh my, that's awful! You're very lucky you didn't get hit.
translation: 哦天，那太可怕了！你很幸运你没被击中。

english: Aye, it be lucky indeed. But that not be the end of it. As the ship finished sinking, I balanced out the wood so we did not slip.
translation: 是，确实幸运。但那不是结束。当船完成下沉，我平衡了木头所以我们没滑。

english: In the distance I saw glowing eyes and a large monster sorta thing in the fog movin' t'wards us.
translation: 在远处我看到发光的眼睛和一个大型怪物似的东西在雾中向我们移动。

english: But all of a sudden, it vanished. I then had to keep us afloat 'till we made it t' shore by Al Kharid.
translation: 但突然，它消失了。然后我不得不保持我们漂浮直到我们到达阿尔卡里德岸。

english: Pudi gathered us up and we went t' the Chancellor as soon as we could stand.
translation: 普迪召集我们，我们一能站就去了总理那里。

english: These ruins turned out t' be a great base to research the beast from undisturbed! Bit close to Menaphos though, aye?
translation: 这些废墟结果是个很好的基地来不受干扰地研究野兽！不过有点靠近梅纳福斯，是吧？

english: That be the end of me story. Can I help ye with anything else?
translation: 那是我的故事结束。我能帮你什么别的吗？

english: A pirate doing paperwork, that's new.
translation: 一个海盗做文书工作，那是新的。

english: Let me guess, ye thought we be doin' nothing but pluderin' and pillagin'?
translation: 让我猜，你以为我们除了掠夺和掠夺什么都不做？

english: Is that not what pirates do?
translation: 那不是海盗做的吗？

english: Ye be a funny one.
translation: 你是个有趣的。

english: Glad you can still smile after what happened.
translation: 很高兴你在发生后还能微笑。

english: I'm not goin' t' let one bit of bad luck keep me down.
translation: 我不会让一点坏运气让我消沉。

english: Can I help ye with anything else?
translation: 我能帮你什么别的吗？

english: Got any tips for fighting Tempoross?
translation: 有什么对抗 Tempoross 的建议吗？

english: Tempoross can summon clouds that shoot lightnin'. They can cause fires that will block ye from movin' about as freely.
translation: Tempoross 能召唤射击闪电的云。它们能引起火灾阻止你自由移动。

english: Ye best be ready to grab a bucket and douse the fire before it spreads!
translation: 你最好准备好抓个桶在火蔓延前扑灭它！

english: Can I help ye with anythin' else?
translation: 我能帮你什么别的吗？

english: I have to go.
translation: 我得走了。

english: Stay safe, ye hear?
translation: 保持安全，你听到吗？

english: Would you care for an egg in this difficult time?
translation: 在这个困难时期你想要个蛋吗？

english: Um... no, I don't want your damp egg, thanks...
translation: 嗯……不，我不想要你的湿蛋，谢谢……

english: I'll take my eggs elsewhere then.
translation: 那我去别处拿我的蛋。

english: A damp egg? No thanks.
translation: 一个湿蛋？不用了，谢谢。

english: I'd rather not. Thanks, though.
translation: 我还是算了，不过谢谢你。

english: Oh, thanks.
translation: 哦，谢谢。

english: This is some comfort to be sure.
translation: 这确实是一些安慰。

english: I heard about your ship, can you tell me what happened?
translation: 我听说关于你的船，你能告诉我发生了什么吗？

english: A pirate doing paperwork, that's new.
translation: 一个海盗做文书工作，那是新的。

english: Got any tips for fighting Tempoross?
translation: 有什么对抗 Tempoross 的建议吗？

english: I have to go.
translation: 我得走了。

english: Have I seen you before?
translation: 我以前见过你吗？

english: I don't think so... I've just got one of those faces.
translation: 我不这么认为……我只是有那种脸。

english: You're probably right.
translation: 你可能是对的。

english: I'm rather busy at the moment. I've got to organise my cupboards of jewels.
translation: 我现在相当忙。我得整理我的珠宝橱柜。

english: Want any help?
translation: 想要任何帮助吗？

english: Absolutely not! You stay away from my jewels.
translation: 绝对不！你离我的珠宝远点。

english: Interested in buying a house like mine?
translation: 有兴趣买像我这样的房子吗？

english: Not sure I've got enough coins to do that.
translation: 不确定我有足够金币做那个。

english: Silly me! I mistook you for one of us wealthy folk.
translation: 傻我！我误以为你是我们富裕人之一。

english: Well that's rude.
translation: 那很粗鲁。

english: You'll catch on.
translation: 你会明白的。

english: Hello there. Are you liking the city?
translation: 你好。你喜欢这个城市吗？

english: It's beautiful!
translation: 它很美！

english: It really is.
translation: 确实是。

english: Huh? Are you an encyclopediasalesman?
translation: 哈？你是个百科全书推销员吗？

english: No, madam, I'm a burglar. I burgle people.
translation: 不，女士，我是个窃贼。我盗窃人们。

english: Hmm... I think you're an encyclopediasalesman?
translation: 嗯……我想你是个百科全书推销员？

english: Not at all. I just want to ransack the place. Honestly.
translation: 完全不。我只是想洗劫这个地方。老实说。

english: Hmm... Alright then.
translation: 嗯……好吧。

english: I've just spent so much money!
translation: 我刚刚花了这么多钱！

english: Good for you.
translation: 为你好。

english: Sorry, but I don't have time to chat. I've got important errands to run.
translation: 抱歉，但我没时间聊天。我有重要差事要办。

english: I've got something in the back of my mind telling me I should go back home.
translation: 我脑子里有东西告诉我我应该回家。

english: You don't say...
translation: 你不会说……

english: Lovely day for a stroll, wouldn't you say?
translation: 散步的好日子，你不觉得吗？

english: It is!
translation: 是！

english: Time to go check how rich I am!
translation: 时间去检查我多富有了！

english: Lovely day for a stroll.
translation: 散步的好日子。

english: Time to see what's at the bazaar!
translation: 时间去集市看看有什么！

english: You are escorted out of the house as the owner has locked the door.
translation: 你被护送出房子因为主人锁了门。

english: You hear someone outside spot the homeowner coming back!
translation: 你听到外面有人发现房主回来了！

english: Now where did I put my keys...
translation: 现在我把钥匙放哪了……

english: Ah, there they are!
translation: 啊，它们在那！

english: It smells funny in here...
translation: 这里闻起来怪怪的……

english: There's mud all over the floor!
translation: 地板上全是泥！

english: Something isn't right here...
translation: 这里有些不对劲……

english: How did you get in here?
translation: 你怎么进来的？

english: Hello there...thanks for helping out Trufitus commune with the gods Bwana. We've been able to return to the village thanks to your help.
translation: 你好……谢谢你帮助特鲁菲图斯与神沟通 Bwana。多亏你的帮助我们能回村。

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Oh, I just walk around a bit...I have to help my Mum and Dad a lot though because I'm still only young. I'd love to visit the mainland one day though and get out of this boring village.
translation: 哦，我只是四处走走……但我得帮我爸爸妈妈很多因为我还年轻。不过我想有一天去大陆访问并离开这个无聊的村庄。

english: Bwana, if anyone else asks me that question today, I'll explode! Go and ask someone else!
translation: 先生，如果今天还有人问我那个问题，我会爆炸！去问别人！

english: Not that I'm aware of, just sit back and enjoy the sunshine bwana!
translation: 据我所知没有，只管坐下享受阳光先生！

english: Sorry Bwana, I'm already busy, why not go and talk to Murcaily! He's around the village somewhere.
translation: 抱歉先生，我已经忙了，何不去跟穆尔凯利谈谈！他在村里某处。

english: Well, I think that there's some work to be done...perhaps Murcaily can help you. He usually tends to the hardwood grove to the east of Trufitus's hut.
translation: 嗯，我想有些事要做……也许穆尔凯利能帮你。他通常照料特鲁菲图斯小屋东边的硬木林。

english: It's just village life as normal around here Bwana, always something interesting to find to occupy your time if you look hard enough.
translation: 这附近只是正常的村庄生活先生，只要你努力找，总有有趣的事来占用你的时间。

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
translation: 我一直在村里做些工作。

english: Yeah, you've been doing a lot of good work around here. Let me give you something for your time and effort.
translation: 是的，你在这里做了很多好事。让我给你点东西作为你的时间和努力。

english: You get [amount] trading sticks. You are left with [amount]% favour.
translation: 你得到 [amount] 交易棒。你剩下 [amount]% 好感。

english: I've already given you some trading sticks and I don't have any more on me at the moment. Why not go and talk to some of the other villagers and get some contributions?
translation: 我已经给了你一些交易棒，目前我身上没更多了。何不去跟其他村民谈谈弄点贡献？

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Hey, I've seen you working around the village. You've been doing a lot of good work around here for us. Let me give you something for your trouble.
translation: 嘿，我看到你在村里工作。你在这里为我们做了很多好事。让我给你点东西作为给你的报酬。

english: Ahhhhhhhh - Get away from me you beast!
translation: 啊——离我远点你这野兽！

english: What's the problem....oh, I'm wearing this big scary mask! I'd better take it off before I start talking to the natives.
translation: 什么问题……哦，我戴着这个大可怕面具！我最好在跟当地人说话前摘掉。

english: Waahhhhh! - It's da evil broodoo beast come ta eat my very soul!
translation: 哇！——是邪恶的布鲁多兽来吃我的灵魂了！

english: Ahhhhhhhh - It's a monster!
translation: 啊——是个怪物！

english: Ahhhhhhhh!!
What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Is there anything interesting to do here?
translation: 这里有什么有趣的事做吗？

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
translation: 我一直在村里做些工作。

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Well, thank you, adventurer. You've just deprived me of a wonderful chance to learn from one of Zamorak's first followers.
translation: 嗯，谢谢你，冒险者。你刚刚剥夺了我向扎莫拉克最早追随者之一学习的绝好机会。

english: What? What about that treasure you were looking for?
translation: 什么？那你寻找的宝藏呢？

english: You utter imbecile! Did you think I was looking for gold?
translation: 你完全是个白痴！你以为我在找金子？

english: Um... sorry.
translation: 呃……抱歉。

english: 'Sorry' won't bring those Mahjarrat back.
translation: ‘抱歉’不会把那些玛哈加里特带回来。

english: *sigh*I might as well stay to study this temple. It has some interesting magical properties.
translation: 叹气我最好留下来研究这个神庙。它有一些有趣的魔法属性。

english: Ooh, you're a mage? Can you teach me any spells?
translation: 哦，你是个法师？你能教我任何法术吗？

english: Well...
If you really want to learn my spells, you'll have to dedicate yourself to Zamorak.
translation: 如果你真想学我的法术，你必须奉献自己给扎莫拉克。

english: I couldn't do that!
translation: 我不能那样做！

english: Then you won't be learning any of my spells.
translation: 那你不会学我的任何法术。

english: Ha ha ha ha!
translation: 哈哈哈哈！

english: You're not very nice, are you?
translation: 你不太好，对吧？

english: What did you expect from a Zamorakian mage?
translation: 你期望从扎莫拉克法师得到什么？

english: Sure, sign me up!
translation: 当然，给我报名！

english: You really thought I would teach you my secrets just like that? Ha ha ha! You are a naive fool.
translation: 你真以为我会那样教你我的秘密？哈哈哈！你是个天真的傻瓜。

english: That's not very nice of you.
translation: 你那样不太好。

english: I'm a mage of Zamorak, after all. What else do you expect?
translation: 我毕竟是扎莫拉克的法师。你还期望什么？

english: How are you and your defective brain doing nowadays, adventurer?
translation: 你和你的有缺陷的脑子现在怎么样，冒险者？

english: I've lost the amulet that Akthanakos gave me.
translation: 我丢了阿克塔纳科斯给我的护符。

english: You really are an idiot, aren't you? You dropped it in here when you left. Try not to lose it next time.
translation: 你真是个白痴，对吧？你离开时把它掉在这里了。下次尽量别丢。

english: Hey! That's not very nice.
translation: 嘿！那不太好。

english: I'm not very nice. If you want to see who ruined all of my plans, adventurer, just look in a mirror.
translation: 我不太好。如果你想看谁毁了我所有的计划，冒险者，照镜子。

english: Suit yourself. At least I got a nice amulet for my trouble.
translation: 随你便。至少我为我的麻烦得到了个好护符。

english: About that amulet - I might be able to improve it for you, for a fee. Have you got it with you?
translation: 关于那个护符——我可能能为你改进它，收费。你带着它吗？

english: Yes, I've got it here.
translation: 是的，我带着它。

english: Yes, it's what I thought. This amulet will run out of charges all the time, if you keep using it. For one million coins I can give it unlimited charges.
translation: 是的，和我想的一样。这个护符会一直用完充能，如果你一直用它。一百万金币我可以给它无限充能。

english: Why do you need so much money for it?
translation: 你为什么需要那么多钱？

english: Three reasons. Firstly, I'm a Zamorakian mage - we're not big on charity work. Secondly, I want the money. Finally, in case you need reminding, I hate you.
translation: 三个原因。首先，我是扎莫拉克法师——我们不热衷慈善工作。其次，我想要金币。最后，以防你需要提醒，我恨你。

english: Right. Well, I haven't got that kind of money on me.
translation: 好吧。嗯，我身上没那种钱。

english: Okay, here's one million coins.
translation: 好的，这是一百万金币。

english: I'm not interested.
translation: 我没兴趣。

english: Your loss.
translation: 你的损失。

english: Maybe another time.
translation: 也许下次。

english: And don't forget who gave it unlimited charges for you!
translation: 别忘了谁给了它无限充能！

english: I couldn't do that!
translation: 我不能那样做！

english: Sure, sign me up!
translation: 当然，给我报名！

english: Why do you need so much money for it?
translation: 你为什么需要那么多钱？

english: Okay, here's one million coins.
translation: 好的，这是一百万金币。

english: I'm not interested.
translation: 我没兴趣。

english: Maybe another time.
translation: 也许下次。

english: How are you doing?
translation: 你怎么样？

english: I'm happy.
translation: 我快乐。

english: Really?
translation: 真的？

english: Really.
translation: 真的。

english: Really, really?
translation: 真的，真的？

english: Really, really.
translation: 真的，真的。

english: Really, really rea...
translation: 真的，真的真……

english: Stop right there.
translation: 停在那里。

english: Where?
translation: 哪里？

english: There.
translation: 那里。

english: Here?
translation: 这里？

english: No, there.
translation: 不，那里。

english: Argh! Now you're at it.
translation: 啊！现在你开始了。

english: At what?
translation: 在什么？

english: It.
translation: 它。

english: What's it?
translation: 它是什么？

english: You know... it...
translation: 你知道……它……

english: Stop, stop, stop! Right, we're going to play a little game now.
translation: 停，停，停！好，我们现在玩个小游戏。

english: Is it going to be fun? Is it? Is it? Is it?
translation: 会好玩吗？是吗？是吗？是吗？

english: It's called give the cat some peace.
translation: 它叫给猫一些安宁。

english: How do you play?
translation: 怎么玩？

english: You gently stroke your cat, then pick it up, and finally, you leave it for an extended snooze in your backpack.
translation: 你轻轻抚摸你的猫，然后抱起它，最后，你让它在你的背包里长时间小睡。

english: That doesn't sound like much fun. I'd rather spend quality time annoying you.
translation: 那听起来不太好玩。我宁愿花优质时间烦你。

english: I'd never have guessed. Well in that case, I would be really annoyed if you took me hunting rats.
translation: 我从未猜过。嗯那样的话，如果你带我去捕鼠我会很烦。

english: HISS!
translation: 嘶！

english: How old are you now?
translation: 你现在多大了？

english: I thought I asked you your age, not how you were?
translation: 我想我问的是你的年龄，不是你怎么样？

english: Oh! My fault. To answer your question, I'd like to go to the Varrock Sewers.
translation: 哦！我的错。回答你的问题，我想去维洛克城下水道。

english: What? Are you listening to me?
translation: 什么？你在听我说话吗？

english: It's a quarter past Caistleday.
translation: 现在是 Caistleday 一刻。

english: Are you trying to dodge the question?
translation: 你在试图回避问题吗？

english: I think your amulet might be on the blink. Meoow, Miiiaaoow!
translation: 我想你的护符可能坏了。喵，喵呜！

english: You examine the Amulet of Catspeak carefully.
translation: 你仔细检查猫语护符。

english: Strange, it looks okay to me.
translation: 奇怪，它看起来对我没事。

english: Hiss's'sss's.~Your cat tries to hold in a snicker, but fails miserably.
translation: 嘶嘶嘶嘶。~你的猫试图忍住窃笑，但惨败。

english: Where do you want to go?
translation: 你想去哪？

english: Well one place I don't want to go is the rat pits.
translation: 嗯一个我不想去的地方是鼠坑。

english: Why's that?
translation: 为什么？

english: All the other cats will make fun of me, I'm so badly out of shape. Take me hunting.
translation: 所有其他猫会取笑我，我身材太差了。带我去打猎。

english: Don't worry cat, I'll get you back in shape.
translation: 别担心猫，我会让你恢复身材。

english: What do you want to do now?
translation: 你现在想做什么？

english: I'm happy just pottering around.
translation: 我只是闲逛就快乐。

english: Do you fancy a bit of hunting?
translation: 你想打猎吗？

english: To be perfectly honest, I'd rather just lay about and groom myself. Looking at the state of your gear, you would do well to follow suit.
translation: 老实说，我宁愿躺着打扮自己。看看你装备的状态，你最好效仿。

english: There's nothing wrong with how I'm dressed.
translation: 我穿的方式没什么错。

english: That dragon armour you're wearing is so, like, last year.
translation: 你穿的那个龙金护甲太，像，去年了。

english: That thing you're wearing is so, like, last year.
translation: 你穿的那个东西太，像，去年了。

english: I refuse to take fashion advice from a cat - a fat lazy one to boot!
translation: 我拒绝从猫那里接受时尚建议——一只又胖又懒的猫！

english: Meeoow! Someone's feeling touchy!
translation: 喵！有人感觉敏感！

english: That's the last time I ask you what you want to do.
translation: 那是最后一次我问你想做什么。

english: I'm content. A little more action might be good, but then again you might ruffle up my fur and then I'd have to groom all over again.
translation: 我满足。多一点行动可能好，但再说你可能会弄乱我的毛然后我得重新打扮。

english: Pah! You're the laziest old bag of fluff I've ever met.
translation: 呸！你是我见过最懒的旧毛袋。

english: A little older than I was before, but not as old as I will be in a moment.
translation: 比我之前大一点，但没我一会儿后那么大。

english: What kind of answer is that?
translation: 那是什么答案？

english: Well, your idea of time and mine are too different for either of us to understand the other.
translation: 嗯，你的时间观念和我的太不同了，我们谁都理解不了对方。

english: Um... I don't really get it.
translation: 呃……我不太明白。

english: Well for one, I don't count the time I spend in your Bank - which is horribly boring - nor in your bag.
translation: 嗯首先，我不计算我在你的银行——那非常无聊——或你的袋子里花的时间。

english: Well that's not too complicated.
translation: 嗯那不太复杂。

english: I'm just getting started. Now there is also a difference in cat years and human years. To approximate time in cat years you take a value in years, subtract 1, multiply it by 4, and then add 16.
translation: 我只是刚开始。现在还有猫年和人的区别。要近似猫年的时间，你取年值，减1，乘以4，然后加16。

english: So... if a cat is newly born it's already 12 cat years old?
translation: 所以……如果猫刚出生它已经12猫岁了？

english: I said approximate not calculate. Anyway it only works once the cat is 1 year old.
translation: 我说近似不是计算。反正它只在猫1岁后有效。

english: The last complication is that time doesn't actually seem to move, outside of cats ageing.
translation: 最后的复杂是时间实际上似乎不移动，除了猫变老。

english: Anyway, back to the question. How old are you in cat years?
translation: 总之，回到问题。你猫年多大？

english: I don't know. I'm a cat, I can't do maths!
translation: 我不知道。我是猫，我不会数学！

english: Hmph!
translation: 哼！

english: Somewhere nice and quiet. I'm a bit behind in my snoozing schedule.
translation: 某个安静的好地方。我在我的小睡计划上有点落后。

english: Sleep.
translation: 睡觉。

english: How am I going to get you back in shape if all you want to do is sleep?
translation: 如果你只想睡觉我怎么让你恢复身材？

english: Surgery. That's the answer to all our problems.
translation: 手术。那是我们所有问题的答案。

english: Well smarty pants, where am I going to find a cosmetic surgeon who's willing to perform liposuction on a cat around here?
translation: 嗯聪明裤，我在哪能找到愿意在这给猫做抽脂的整容外科医生？

english: I don't know. To be honest I don't even know what those things are.
translation: 我不知道。老实说我甚至不知道那些东西是什么。

english: Me neither, actually...
translation: 我也是，其实……

english: Hiss! What do you care?
translation: 嘶！你关心什么？

english: Oh come on, you're not going to have a hissy fit with me now are you?
translation: 哦拜托，你现在不会跟我发脾气吧？

english: Hiss!
translation: 嘶！

english: Oh dear.
translation: 哦天。

english: I'd rather not say.
translation: 我宁愿不说。

english: Oh come on, tell me.
translation: 哦拜托，告诉我。

english: Okay, I'm very old and fat! Are you happy now? Do you feel good, having a laugh at my expense?
translation: 好的，我又老又胖！你现在高兴吗？拿我取笑你感觉好吗？

english: Oh cat, I'm sorry. I didn't mean it like that. How can I make it up to you?
translation: 哦猫，对不起。我不是那个意思。我怎么弥补你？

english: Well, maybe if you stroked me the odd time, or played with me...
translation: 嗯，也许如果你偶尔抚摸我，或和我玩……

english: Back to the pits. I want to tell the ratcatchers what a rotten master you've been.
translation: 回坑。我想告诉捕鼠者你是个多烂的主人。

english: What? You wouldn't do that would you?
translation: 什么？你不会那样做对吧？

english: If you paid me a little more attention I wouldn't, but I must admit I have been tempted for some time.
translation: 如果你多给我点关注我就不会，但我必须承认我已经被诱惑了一段时间。

english: Look cat, I promise I'll try to be a better friend to you from now on.
translation: 看猫，我承诺我会尽量从今以后做你更好的朋友。

english: I'll believe it when I see it.
translation: 我看到才信。

english: I'd like to go hunting, but since you've been neglecting me I'm too fat to do that properly anymore.
translation: 我想去打猎，但既然你一直忽视我我太胖了不能再那样做了。

english: Oh come on! I'm sure you're not that bad at hunting.
translation: 哦拜托！我相信你没那么差打猎。

english: You're having a laugh! I couldn't even catch a cold.
translation: 你在开玩笑！我甚至抓不到感冒。

english: Hmm.. I think we may have to work on your self esteem. With an attitude like yours it's no wonder you can't catch rats.
translation: 嗯……我想我们得处理你的自尊。有你这样的态度难怪你抓不到老鼠。

english: Hiss! The reason I can't catch any is because you neglect me.
translation: 嘶！我抓不到的原因是你忽视我。

english: leavingme in the Bank or in your bags for extended periods is not conducive to proper exercise!
translation: 把我长时间留在银行或你的袋子里不利于适当运动！

english: Um... sorry?
translation: 呃……抱歉？

english: Hmph!
translation: 哼！

english: Sorry human, but what are you wearing?
translation: 抱歉人类，但你穿着什么？

english: I got some cat ears made for me, don't they look meeeeeeeooooowvalous.
translation: 我做了些猫耳给我，它们看起来不喵——喵——喵——妙吗。

english: The cat looks you dead in the eye, unblinking.
translation: 猫直勾勾看着你，不眨眼。

english: Am I a joke to you?
translation: 我是你笑话吗？

english: UwU?
translation: UwU?

english: Why are you doing this?
translation: 你为什么这样做？

english: I thought it'd be cute and funny.
translation: 我想那会可爱有趣。

english: It's not, take them off now human, before I get myself a pair of human ears to wear.
translation: 不是，现在摘掉它们人类，在我给自己弄对人耳戴之前。

english: You softly stroke your cat.
translation: 你轻轻抚摸你的猫。

english: Purr...purr...
translation: 呼噜……呼噜……

english: What's a League?
translation: 什么是联赛？

english: Leagues are time-limited challenges that provide a unique twist on the world you know and love.
translation: 联赛是限时挑战，为你提供对你熟悉和喜爱的世界的独特转折。

english: With each League, you start afresh, with a limited amount of time to progress through the League.
translation: 每个联赛，你重新开始，只有有限时间通过联赛。

english: A fresh start? Why would I want that?
translation: 重新开始？我为什么想要那个？

english: Glory, rewards, and the chance to do things in a different way!
translation: 荣耀，奖励，和以不同方式做事的机会！

english: First up, the glory. Within a League, you can earn League Points by completing various tasks.
translation: 首先，荣耀。在联赛内，你可以通过完成各种任务获得联赛点数。

english: The more points you have, the better League Rank you will be given.
translation: 你点数越多，你获得的联赛等级越高。

english: Each League Rank will unlock a trophy for you. These trophies can be used to show off your accomplishments.

english: And if glory and rewards don't interest me?

translation: 联赛是限时挑战活动，为你熟悉和喜爱的世界带来独特变化。

translation: 但要提醒你——你无法解锁所有区域，所以要明智选择。

translation: 在这个联赛中，你最初被限制在米斯特林王国和卡拉姆詹岛。不过，随着你的进度，你可以解锁更多区域。

english: There are nine different areas in total. However, you can only unlock a maximum of five, including Misthalin and Karamja, so choose wisely.
translation: 总共有九个不同的区域。不过，你最多只能解锁五个，包括米斯特林王國和卡拉姆詹岛，所以要明智选择。

english: The first two area unlocks are given to everyone. However, the other three unlocks are unavailable to begin with.
translation: 前两个区域解锁是每个人都有的。不过，其他三个解锁一开始是不可用的。

english: You can access these additional area unlocks by completing tasks. The more tasks you've completed, the more areas you can unlock.
translation: 你可以通过完成任务来获得这些额外的区域解锁。完成的任务越多，可以解锁的区域就越多。

english: I see. Thanks!
translation: 我明白了。谢谢！

english: Would you like to take a look at the available areas now?
translation: 你现在想看看可用的区域吗？

english: Relics, or Trailblazer Relics to give them their full name, are powerful artefacts that grant unique abilities for the entire League!
translation: 遗物，或者叫开拓者遗物是它们的完整名称，是强大的神器，在整个联赛期间赋予独特能力！

english: There are eighteen separate Relics, split across six different tiers. You can only have one Relic from each tier though.
translation: 共有十八个不同的遗物，分为六个不同的等级。不过你每个等级只能拥有一个遗物。

english: The first Relic tier is available to everyone. However, the higher tiers are locked to begin with.
translation: 第一个遗物等级是每个人都有的。不过，更高等级一开始是锁定的。

english: You can unlock these higher tiers by earning League Points. League Points are earned by completing tasks.
translation: 你可以通过赚取联赛点数来解锁这些更高等级。联赛点数是通过完成任务获得的。

english: Be warned, you'll need to choose carefully when picking a Relic. Once you have selected a Relic, your choice can't be changed for the rest of the League.
translation: 要提醒你，选择遗物时需要仔细考虑。一旦你选择了一个遗物，在联赛剩余时间内你的选择无法更改。

english: Anyway, it looks like you have a Relic available for selection right now! Would you like to take a look?
translation: 不管怎样，看起来你现在有一个遗物可供选择！你想看看吗？

english: Tell me about League rewards.
translation: 跟我说说联赛奖励。

english: As well as letting you unlock new areas, completing tasks in the League will earn you League Points. The more League Points you have, the more Trailblazer Relic tiers you have available.
translation: 除了让你解锁新区域外，在联赛中完成任务还会为你赚取联赛点数。你的联赛点数越多，可用的开拓者遗物等级就越多。

english: However, alongside allowing you to unlock Trailblazer Relics, League Points can also be used to buy rewards from the Leagues Reward Shop.
translation: 不过，除了让你解锁开拓者遗物外，联赛点数还可以用来在联赛奖励商店购买奖励。

english: What rewards can I buy?
translation: 我能买什么奖励？

english: All sorts of things! There's some new furniture for your house, an alternate animation for your Home Teleport spell and some new stylish outfits, just to name a few.
translation: 各种各样的东西！有一些给你的房子的新家具，家园传送法术的替代动画，还有一些新的时尚服装，仅举几例。

english: Most of the rewards can be traded with others, so if you want, you can earn some money by selling them on. Of course, you might prefer to keep them for yourself instead.
translation: 大多数奖励可以与他人交易，所以如果你想的话，可以通过出售它们赚些钱。当然，你可能更愿意自己留着。

english: I see. That all sounds good to me.
translation: 我明白了。这些听起来都不错。

english: One thing to be aware of is that the Trailblazer rewards won't be available until the League has ended. You can still buy rewards from previous Leagues though.
translation: 要注意的一件事是，开拓者奖励要等到联赛结束后才会可用。不过你仍然可以购买之前联赛的奖励。

english: Now, alongside the rewards in the Leagues Reward Shop, there's also League Ranks.
translation: 现在，除了联赛奖励商店中的奖励外，还有联赛排名。

english: League Ranks? How do they work?
translation: 联赛排名？它们是怎么运作的？

english: At the end of the League, you will be given a League Rank. This is based upon the number of League Points you have earned compared to the other participants.
translation: 在联赛结束时，你会获得一个联赛排名。这是根据你与其他参与者相比获得的联赛点数来确定的。

english: Anyone who earns at least 100 League Points will be eligible for the Bronze rank. The top 80% of participants get the Iron rank. The top 60% get Steel.
translation: 任何获得至少100联赛点数的人都有资格获得青铜排名。前80% 的参与者获得铁排名。前60% 获得钢排名。

english: The top 40% get Mithril. The top 20% get Adamant. The top 5% get Rune. The best participants, those who make it to the top 1%, get the Dragon rank!
translation: 前40% 获得秘银排名。前20% 获得精金排名。前5% 获得符石排名。最好的参与者，那些进入前1% 的，获得龙金排名！

english: When the League ends, your rank will determine what trophy you get. These trophies symbolise your performance in the League.
translation: 当联赛结束时，你的排名将决定你获得什么奖杯。这些奖杯象征你在联赛中的表现。

english: Trophies?
translation: 奖杯？

english: That's right. Trophies are items that are given to you after the League. You can use them to show off your League Rank!
translation: 没错。奖杯是联赛结束后给你的物品。你可以用它们来展示你的联赛排名！

english: Connected to League Ranks are the League to League rewards. These are unlocked in the next League based upon the League Rank you earn in this one!
translation: 与联赛排名相关的是联赛间奖励。这些是根据你在这个联赛中获得的联赛排名在下一个联赛中解锁的！

english: League Starter Outfits and League Icons are some of things you can unlock for the next League. Also, any pets you earn in this League will transfer over to the next one.
translation: 联赛起始服装和联赛图标是你可以为下一个联赛解锁的一些东西。此外，你在这个联赛中获得的所有宠物都会转移到下一个联赛。

english: Finally, on top of the tasks for this League, there are some other activities for which I will recognise the first person who completes them.
translation: 最后，除了这个联赛的任务外，还有一些其他活动，我会认可第一个完成它们的人。

english: You can view the entire list of activities, as well as whether or not someone has completed them, by reading the board beside me.
translation: 你可以通过阅读我旁边的公告板查看完整的活动列表，以及是否有人已完成它们。

english: Not a problem. Now, is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 没问题。现在，还有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: Let's talk about pets.
translation: 我们聊聊宠物吧。

english: Can you tell me how pets work in Leagues?
translation: 你能告诉我宠物在联赛中是怎么运作的吗？

english: Of course! If you're lucky enough to obtain a pet during a League, it will automatically be insured for you.
translation: 当然！如果你幸运地在联赛期间获得宠物，它会自动为你投保。

english: This means that if you were to ever lose it, you can talk to me and I'll give it back to you. Insurance and reclaiming is all free!
translation: 这意味着如果你不小心弄丢了它，你可以找我，我会把它还给你。投保和领取都是免费的！

english: Additionally, each pet you obtain will be transferred to the next League. It'll be waiting with me for you to reclaim it!
translation: 此外，你获得的每只宠物都会转移到下一个联赛。它会和我一起等着你来领取！

english: Okay! Thank you.
translation: 好的！谢谢你。

english: No worries. Come back to me once you have some pets and you can view your collection! Now, is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 别担心。等你有了一些宠物后回来找我，你可以查看你的收藏！现在，还有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: You receive some items from the Leagues Tutor.
translation: 你从联赛导师那里收到一些物品。

english: Very well. I'll be here if you ever need to know anything about Leagues.
translation: 好吧。如果你需要了解任何关于联赛的事情，我随时在这里。

english: Every League has unique rules and features to set it aside from the world you're used to.
translation: 每个联赛都有独特的规则和特色，使其与你习惯的世界不同。

english: Not only that, but within this League, you can unlock powerful artefacts known as Fragments. Fragments completely change the way you progress through the League!
translation: 不仅如此，在这个联赛中，你还可以解锁称为碎片的强大神器。碎片会完全改变你在联赛中的进度方式！

english: So even if glory and gold are not for you, you'll still find Leagues to be a whole lot of fun!
translation: 所以即使荣耀和金币不是你的菜，你仍然会发现联赛非常有趣！

english: Well sadly you're not eligible to take part in a League right now. I'll be happy to help once you are though.
translation: 很遗憾，你现在没有资格参与联赛。不过等你有资格后我很乐意帮助你。

english: Yes! The current League is Leagues III - Shattered Relics.
translation: 是的！当前的联赛是联赛 III - 破碎遗物。

english: Within this League you are restricted to three skills: Defence, Fishing and Thieving, you can unlock more skills by completing tasks to earn Sage's Renown.
translation: 在这个联赛中，你被限制在三个技能：防御、钓鱼和偷窃，你可以通过完成任务赚取贤者声望来解锁更多技能。

english: Sage's Renown can be used to purchase access to Skills, Bosses and to Auto Complete Quests.
translation: 贤者声望可以用来购买技能、Boss 的访问权限和自动完成任务。

english: You can also collect powerful artifacts known as Fragments, each Fragment provides a different buff so be sure to collect them all.
translation: 你还可以收集称为碎片的强大神器，每个碎片提供不同的增益效果，所以一定要收集全部。

english: You can level up these Fragments to make them even stronger, you can also bring together different Fragments to activate powerful buffs known as Set Effects.
translation: 你可以升级这些碎片使它们更强大，你还可以将不同的碎片组合在一起激活称为套装效果的强大增益。

english: I heard there's one that lets you swap between Magic spellbooks whenever you want!
translation: 我听说有一个让你可以随时在魔法书之间切换！

english: Not only that, but you must participate as an Iron Man. This means you stand alone and cannot trade with other participants.
translation: 不仅如此，你还必须以铁人模式参与。这意味着你独自作战，不能与其他参与者交易。

english: Interesting. Maybe I should take part.
translation: 有意思。也许我应该参与。

english: I'd highly recommend it.
translation: 我强烈推荐。

english: The Leagues Reward Shop is temporarily closed.
translation: 联赛奖励商店暂时关闭。

english: League Trophies are a representation of how well you did in a specific League. Performance is judged on the number of League Points you earned compared to everyone else who participated.
translation: 联赛奖杯代表你在特定联赛中的表现。表现根据你与其他参与者相比获得的联赛点数来评判。

english: Of course!
translation: 当然！

english: You have not earned any League trophies. If you want a League trophy you should participate next time a League comes around!
translation: 你还没有获得任何联赛奖杯。如果你想要联赛奖杯，下次联赛来临时你应该参与！

english: You receive a League trophy from the Leagues Tutor.
translation: 你从联赛导师那里收到一个联赛奖杯。

english: You do not have enough space for all the League Trophies available to you. Come back to me when you do.
translation: 你没有足够的空间存放所有可用的联赛奖杯。等你有空间后再回来找我。

english: Ah! Looks like you have already claimed all of the League Trophies available to you.
translation: 啊！看起来你已经领取了所有可用的联赛奖杯。

english: You earned 0 League points which does not qualify you for any trophy.
translation: 你获得了0联赛点数，这使你没有任何资格获得奖杯。

english: Hi there.
translation: 你好。

english: Hello. Who are you?
translation: 你好。你是谁？

english: I'm the Tutor for Leagues. If you have any questions about Leagues, I can help you out.
translation: 我是联赛导师。如果你对联赛有任何问题，我可以帮你解答。

english: What changes have been made for this League?
translation: 这个联赛有什么变化？

english: Yes, please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Not right now.
translation: 暂时不用。

english: How do tasks work?
translation: 任务是怎么运作的？

english: How does the area system work?
translation: 区域系统是怎么运作的？

english: What are Relics?
translation: 什么是遗物？

english: Tell me about League rewards.
translation: 跟我说说联赛奖励。

english: Let's talk about pets.
translation: 我们聊聊宠物吧。

english: Do I have any League items to collect?
translation: 我有什么联赛物品可以领取吗？

english: Hello! Welcome to the Twisted League. I see you are new here.
translation: 你好！欢迎来到扭曲联赛。我看你是新来的。

english: Yes, this is my first League. Can you explain how they work?
translation: 是的，这是我的第一个联赛。你能解释一下它们是怎么运作的吗？

english: I'd be happy to!
translation: 我很乐意！

english: First of all, I'm your Leagues Tutor. If you have any questions about how Leagues work, you can come to me for help.
translation: 首先，我是你的联赛导师。如果你对联赛运作有任何问题，可以来找我帮忙。

english: Now, Leagues are time-limited modes that give you a new way to play the game. For this League, you are restricted to the Kourend and Kebos regions, and you play as an Iron Man.
translation: 现在，联赛是限时模式，为你提供新的游戏方式。对于这个联赛，你被限制在库兰德和凯博斯区域，并且以铁人模式游玩。

english: Let's take a look at all of the information available about this League. There is a new section in the journal tab whilst on a Leagues world. Click on the flashing quest icon to take a look.
translation: 让我们看看关于这个联赛的所有可用信息。在联赛世界上，日志标签中有一个新部分。点击闪烁的任务图标看看。

english: Now that you have your journal open, click on the flashing Leagues icon.
translation: 现在你已经打开了日志，点击闪烁的联赛图标。

english: This is the Leagues menu. Here you can view your progress through the current League. You can also open the various Leagues interfaces from here.
translation: 这是联赛菜单。在这里你可以查看你在当前联赛中的进度。你也可以从这里打开各种联赛界面。

english: Your objective in each League is to complete tasks and earn League Points.
translation: 你在每个联赛中的目标是完成任务并赚取联赛点数。

english: Tasks are split into five difficulty levels: Easy, Medium, Hard, Elite and Master. The harder the task, the more points awarded.
translation: 任务分为五个难度等级：简单、中等、困难、精英和大师。任务越难，获得的点数越多。

english: Let's have a look at the tasks interface now. Click on the flashing button to open it.
translation: 现在让我们看看任务界面。点击闪烁的按钮打开它。

english: This is the tasks interface. Here you can see all the tasks available to you in this League. When you are ready to continue, close the interface by clicking on the cross in the corner of it.
translation: 这是任务界面。在这里你可以看到在这个联赛中所有可用的任务。当你准备好继续时，点击界面角落的叉号关闭它。

english: Earning points during the League will allow you to unlock powerful Twisted Relics. The more League Points you have, the more Relics available to you.
translation: 在联赛期间赚取点数将让你解锁强大的扭曲遗物。你的联赛点数越多，可用的遗物就越多。

english: League Points are also transferred over to your main profile. There, they can be spent on rewards in the Leagues Reward Shop.
translation: 联赛点数也会转移到你的主账号。在那里，它们可以用来在联赛奖励商店购买奖励。

english: Now let's have a look at the Twisted Relics. Click on the flashing button to take a look at the Relics interface.
translation: 现在让我们看看扭曲遗物。点击闪烁的按钮看看遗物界面。

english: This is the Relics interface. Here you can unlock new Twisted Relics to be used during this League. When you are ready to continue, close the interface by clicking on the cross in the corner of it.
translation: 这是遗物界面。在这里你可以解锁新的扭曲遗物供这个联赛使用。当你准备好继续时，点击界面角落的叉号关闭它。

english: There are a few changes to Kourend and Kebos which you may not be used to. You can view all of these changes on the information interface.
translation: 库兰德和凯博斯有一些你可能不习惯的变化。你可以在信息界面上查看所有这些变化。

english: Right, I think that's everything. If you need reminding of any of this information, you can either talk to me or read the information interface.
translation: 好的，我想就这些了。如果你需要提醒任何这些信息，你可以找我或者阅读信息界面。

english: Before you head off though, it's time to pick your first Relic! Choose carefully though, once you've picked a Relic you can't go back and change your decision.
translation: 不过在你出发之前，是时候选择你的第一个遗物了！但要仔细选择，一旦你选择了一个遗物，你就不能回去更改你的决定。

english: Hi there.
translation: 你好。

english: Hello, who are you?
translation: 你好，你是谁？

english: I'm the Tutor for Old School Leagues.
translation: 我是 Old School 联赛的导师。

english: Old School Leagues are time-limited game modes that are separate from your main profile.
translation: Old School 联赛是限时游戏模式，与你的主账号分开。

english: With each League, you start afresh, with a limited amount of time to progress through the game mode.
translation: 每个联赛你都要从头开始，在有限时间内完成游戏模式进度。

english: So it's a fresh start? Why would I want that?
translation: 所以是从头开始？我为什么要那样做？

english: Glory, gold, and the chance to play the game in a different way!
translation: 荣耀、金币，以及用不同方式玩游戏的机会！

english: Each League Rank will unlock a trophy for you. These trophies can be used to show off how well you did.
translation: 每个联赛排名都会为你解锁一个奖杯。这些奖杯可以用来展示你的表现。

english: If that doesn't interest you, how about gold! When you earn League Points, they will be transferred over to your main profile.
translation: 如果那对你没吸引力，那金币怎么样！当你赚取联赛点数时，它们会转移到你的主账号。

english: These points can be used to buy things from the Leagues Reward Shop. You can keep these purchases for yourself or sell them on to other players!
translation: 这些点数可以用来在联赛奖励商店买东西。你可以把这些购买留给自己，或者卖给其他玩家！

english: Leagues aren't just a copy of the normal game. Every League has unique rules and features to set it aside from the game you're used to.
translation: 联赛不仅仅是普通游戏的复制品。每个联赛都有独特的规则和特色，使其与你习惯的游戏不同。

english: Not only that, but within each League, you can unlock powerful artefacts known as Relics. These Relics completely change the way you play the game!
translation: 不仅如此，在每个联赛中，你还可以解锁称为遗物的强大神器。这些遗物会完全改变你玩游戏的方式！

english: No, The most recent League was the Twisted League. You can now claim your trophies from the Twisted League and purchase rewards using your League points.
translation: 不，最近的联赛是扭曲联赛。你现在可以领取扭曲联赛的奖杯，并使用你的联赛点数购买奖励。

english: League trophies are a representation of how well you did in a specific League. Performance is judged on the number of League points you earned compared to everyone else who participated.
translation: 联赛奖杯代表你在特定联赛中的表现。表现根据你与其他参与者相比获得的联赛点数来评判。

english: There are seven tiers of Trophy: Bronze, Iron, Steel, Mithril, Adamant, Rune and Dragon. Each League trophy has a logo on the front so you can tell which League it was awarded from.
translation: 奖杯分为七个等级：青铜、铁、钢、秘银、精金、符石和龙金。每个联赛奖杯正面都有一个标志，所以你可以看出它是从哪个联赛获得的。

english: What are the League point cut-offs for the Twisted League?
translation: 扭曲联赛的联赛点数门槛是多少？

english: Bronze trophy: 10 points, Iron trophy: 80 points, Steel trophy: 510 points, Mithril trophy: 1770 points.
translation: 青铜奖杯：10点，铁奖杯：80点，钢奖杯：510点，秘银奖杯：1770点。

english: Adamant trophy: 5270 points, Rune trophy: 10820 points and the Dragon Trophy: 20830 points.
translation: 精金奖杯：5270点，符石奖杯：10820点，龙金奖杯：20830点。

english: You earned [number] League points which qualifies you for the all of the Twisted League trophies up to and including the Twisted [type] trophy!
translation: 你获得了 [number] 联赛点数，这使你有资格获得所有扭曲联赛奖杯，包括扭曲 [type] 奖杯及以下！

english: Can I purchase my League rewards?
translation: 我能购买我的联赛奖励吗？

english: Certainly, I have a number of unique rewards which you can purchase using points earned competing in a League. Here is what is available.
translation: 当然，我有一些独特的奖励，你可以使用在联赛中竞争获得的点数购买。以下是可用的内容。

english: I'd like to claim my League trophies.
translation: 我想领取我的联赛奖杯。

english: Of course, here are the trophies you have earned.
translation: 当然，这是你获得的奖杯。

english: You do not have enough space for all the League trophies you can claim. Come back to me when you have more space.
translation: 你没有足够的空间存放所有可领取的联赛奖杯。等你有更多空间后再回来找我。

english: You have already claimed all of the League trophies which you have earned.
translation: 你已经领取了所有已获得的联赛奖杯。

english: How do League trophies work?

english: Elder Krill sent me down here to catch some fish. These fish are boring though. It's much more fun when he lets me actually go properly fishing out at sea, but he says it's important I learn land fishing as well.
translation: 长老克里尔派我来这里抓些鱼。不过这些鱼很无聊。当他让我真正出海钓鱼时有趣多了，但他说我学习陆地钓鱼也很重要。

translation: 传奇公会成员靠近！

english: Do you wish to serve the balance? You'll need weapons if you do. These, I can provide.
translation: 你愿意为平衡服务吗？如果需要，你会需要武器。这些，我可以提供。

english: Let's see what you have.
translation: 让我看看你有什么。

translation: 你卖武器赚很多钱吗？

english: To be a Kahlith is to abandon all attachment. Both physical and emotional. I have no use for money.
translation: 成为卡利特意味着放弃所有依恋。无论是物质上还是情感上。我不需要钱。

english: So why don't you give out the weapons for free?
translation: 那你为什么不免费发放武器？

english: While we care not for money, your kind still do. While a Kahlith will do anything for the balance, your kind are not so generous.
translation: 虽然我们不在乎钱，但你们人类在乎。虽然卡利特愿意为平衡做任何事，但你们人类没那么慷慨。

english: So you use the money to pay us for things?
translation: 所以你们用钱来付钱给我们做事？

english: Exactly. For us to serve the balance, we must trade with your people. That is what the money is for.
translation: 没错。为了让我们为平衡服务，我们必须与你们人类交易。这就是钱的用途。

english: Anyway, would you like to purchase some weapons?
translation: 不管怎样，你想购买一些武器吗？

english: I'm good thanks.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

translation: 需要什么吗？

english: Had any more minotaur problems recently?
translation: 最近还有什么牛头怪问题吗？

english: Not since you killed that one. The beastmaster reckons there was a problem with it imprinting. Happens from time to time.
translation: 自从你杀了那只后就没有了。驯兽师认为那只牛头怪在印记上有问题。这种情况时有发生。

english: Imprinting?
translation: 印记？

english: Yup. They're meant to imprint on the beastmaster as soon as they're born, but this one seemingly didn't. As I say, it sometimes happens.
translation: 是的。它们应该在出生时就对驯兽师产生印记，但这只似乎没有。正如我所说，这种情况时有发生。

english: I see. Well, hopefully I don't find myself coming up against any more rogue minotaurs.
translation: 我明白了。嗯，希望我不会再遇到任何叛变的牛头怪。

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Wooo?  Woooo woo woooooo wooooo woooowooo wooo woooooo woo!
translation: 呜哦？呜哦哦 呜哦 呜哦哦哦哦 呜哦哦哦 呜哦哦呜哦哦 呜哦 呜哦哦哦哦 呜哦！

english: You don't say?
translation: 不会吧？

english: Woo! WOO WOOOOO WOOWOOWOO WOO WOOOOO!
translation: 呜哦！呜哦 呜哦哦哦哦 呜哦呜哦呜哦哦 呜哦 呜哦哦哦哦！

english: You don't say!
translation: 不会吧！

english: Wooowoowoooooo.... Woowoowoo? Woooo, wooowoo wooowooowooo!
translation: 呜哦哦呜哦哦哦哦……呜哦呜哦哦？呜哦哦，呜哦呜哦 呜哦呜哦哦呜哦哦！

english: Well, I guess you didn't say.
translation: 嗯，我想你什么都没说。

english: Yeah, I don't want to brag, but seriously: I am SOOOO rich....
translation: 是的，我不想吹牛，但说真的：我超级超级有钱……

english: Yeah, I know they say money doesn't bring you happiness, but sometimes I just like to open my bank account and look at all of the stuff I own and just think to myself:
translation: 是的，我知道人们说钱不能带来幸福，但有时我就是喜欢打开我的银行账户，看着我所有的东西，然后对自己说：

english: Wow. I am soooooo rich.
translation: 哇。我真的超级超级有钱。

english: Well, us rich alive people don't want to waste all day spending time with you poor dead people, because I'm just sooooo rich I have to go now, and very possibly make myself even richer.
translation: 嗯，我们这些富有的活人不想整天浪费时间陪你们这些可怜的死人，因为我太有钱了，我得走了，很可能让自己变得更富有。

english: See ya around ghosty!
translation: 回头见，鬼魂！

english: Yeah, I heard about that, ha-ha-ha!
translation: 是的，我听说过那件事，哈哈哈！

english: With a MACKEREL? Ouch!
translation: 用一条鲭鱼？哎哟！

english: Well, it was fun. Let's do it again sometime.
translation: 嗯，那很有趣。改天再来一次。

english: Why, thank you very much!
translation: 哦，非常感谢！

english: I know, but what are you going to do?
translation: 我知道，但你能怎么办？

english: Well, I guess that's always true in the long run. See you around, weird invisible dead person!
translation: 嗯，我想从长远来看这总是对的。回头见，奇怪的隐形死人！

english: Yeah it's not bad, but I prefer cooked chicken.
translation: 是的，还不错，但我更喜欢熟鸡肉。

english: Maybe, but nothing beats a home cooked pie!
translation: 也许吧，但没什么比得上家里做的派！

english: Man, I love pie!
translation: 天哪，我爱派！

english: You don't say? I never knew that. Well, I must be going, see you around.
translation: 不会吧？我从不知道。嗯，我得走了，回头见。

english: We get signal!
translation: 我们收到信号了！

english: Somebody set up us the bomb!
translation: 有人给我们设置了炸弹！

english: You have no chance to survive make your time.
translation: 你没有生存的机会，抓紧时间吧。

english: Woo?
translation: 呜哦？

english: All your base are belong to us.
translation: 你们所有的基地都属于我们。

english: Hey, don't think you can talk to me like that!
translation: 嘿，别以为你能那样跟我说话！

english: Are you threatening me?
translation: 你在威胁我吗？

english: Just because you're already dead, doesn't mean I can't find a way to hurt you ghosty!
translation: 就因为你已经死了，不代表我找不到方法伤害你，鬼魂！

english: No, I've never been there in my life and CERTAINLY didn't steal anything when I was!
translation: 不，我这辈子从未去过那里，当然也没在那里偷过任何东西！

english: Are you calling me a liar?!?! I have never stolen a thing in my life, and I resent the implication that I am the kind of morally depraved individual that would steal someone else's hard earned
translation: 你在说我是骗子？！我这辈子从未偷过任何东西，我讨厌这种暗示，好像我是那种道德败坏、会从别人口袋里偷走辛苦赚来的

english: money from their very pockets!
translation: 钱的人！

english: Or cakes. Or fur. Repeatedly. For long periods at a time.
translation: 或者蛋糕。或者毛皮。反复地。一次很长时间。

english: Well if you are going to take that attitude, then I have nothing further to say on the matter, and bid you good day!
translation: 如果你要采取这种态度，那我对此无话可说，祝你日安！

english: Hello. You would be Lennissa, I take it?
translation: 你好。我想你就是莱尼萨吧？

english: Who are you? Where did you hear that name? How comes it that you can see and speak to me?
translation: 你是谁？你从哪里听到那个名字的？你怎么能看见我并和我说话？

english: Well, a ghost called Kharrim directed me towards you.
translation: 嗯，一个叫卡里姆的鬼魂指引我找你。

english: So that weasel Kharrim has been blighted by this curse too?
translation: 所以卡里姆那只黄鼠狼也被这个诅咒困扰了？

english: Ha, a good thing too. If anybody deserved such a fate it would be one such as him.
translation: 哈，那也是好事。如果有人配得上这种命运，那就是他这样的人。

english: I guess you didn't get along then?
translation: 我想你们相处得不好吧？

english: No, evil scum such as he should never have been allowed to walk this world.
translation: 不，像他这样的邪恶渣滓根本不该被允许活在这个世界上。

english: What lies has he told you to come here? Have you come to try and kill me?
translation: 他对你撒了什么谎让你来这里？你是来杀我的吗？

english: Well, I'm not sure I could if I tried, but that is not why I have come to you.
translation: 嗯，我不确定我能不能做到，但那不是我来找你的原因。

english: Then speak, and speak well, for I may yet be dead, but am still a danger to those who cross me.
translation: 那就说吧，好好说，因为我虽然死了，但对冒犯我的人仍然是个威胁。

english: Actually, I'm trying to work out why all of you invisible ghosts seem to have been cursed.
translation: 其实，我正试图弄清楚为什么你们这些隐形的鬼魂似乎都被诅咒了。

english: I'm not sure how exactly, but the trail seems to have led me to you...
translation: 我不太确定具体是怎么回事，但线索似乎把我引到了你这里……

english: That makes no sense... I served Saradomin faithfully my entire life, then all of a sudden I find myself reduced to this state!
translation: 这说不通……我一生都忠实地为萨拉多明服务，然后突然间我就变成了这种状态！

english: Well, it seems as though that may have been the cause...
translation: 嗯，似乎那可能就是原因……

english: What? Explain yourself.
translation: 什么？解释清楚。

english: As I understand it, it was something to do with the Staff of Armadyl, and your refusal to tell Saradomin that it had been stolen...
translation: 据我了解，这与阿玛杜尔杖有关，以及你拒绝告诉萨拉多明它被偷了……

english: What? But... But that is not how it happened at all!
translation: 什么？但……但根本不是那样发生的！

english: Then please, go ahead and tell me the events of that day in your own words...
translation: 那就请你用自己的话告诉我那天的经过……

english: Let me see... I had been working as a spy for my Lord Saradomin, amongst the forces of... the Empty Lord.
translation: 让我想想……我一直在为我的主人萨拉多明做间谍，在……空无之主的势力中。

english: 'The Empty Lord'? Who is that?
translation: '空无之主''？那是谁？

english: I will not give you his name, for to do so would give him power here.
translation: 我不会告诉你他的名字，因为那样会在这里给他力量。

english: Let us just say that he was a fearsome deity, whose strength was greater than all the gods we knew of on this realm at the time.
translation: 我们只能说他是一位可怕的神祇，他的力量比当时我们在这个领域所知的所有神祇都要强大。

english: It is probably worth mentioning that at this time we had no knowledge of the mysterious nature god Guthix.
translation: 可能值得一提的是，当时我们并不知道神秘的自然之神古斯。

english: So he was stronger than Saradomin?
translation: 所以他比萨拉多明更强？

english: As Saradomin was, yes. As Saradomin is now? Who can say?
translation: 当时的萨拉多明，是的。现在的萨拉多明？谁能说得准？

english: I see... Please, continue.
translation: 我明白了……请继续。

english: As I say, I was working as a spy within the very camp of my Lord's enemies.
translation: 正如我所说，我在主人的敌人的营地中做间谍。

english: I knew that should I have been caught, I risked being killed upon the spot, but my combat skills were always formidable, and if truth be told, there was a fair amount of dissent amongst... 'his' followers anyway.
translation: 我知道如果我被抓，就有当场被杀的风险，但我的战斗技能一直很强，而且说实话，在……''他的''追随者中存在不少异议。

english: How do you mean 'dissent'?
translation: 你说的''异议''是什么意思？

english: Ah, to not understand this, you must have led a sheltered life...
translation: 啊，不理解这个，你一定过着受庇护的生活……

english: Let me tell you this: Evil will always breed more evil, and will never be satisfied with what it has.
translation: 让我告诉你：邪恶总会滋生更多邪恶，永远不会满足于已有的一切。

english: The Empty Lord chose to ally himself with the dark creatures of this world, fully aware that their own natures would cause them to rally against his rule, and take every opportunity they could to betray him.
translation: 空无之主选择与这个世界的黑暗生物结盟，完全清楚它们的本性会导致它们反抗他的统治，并抓住一切机会背叛他。

english: This has always been the nature of evil. Perhaps he thought his power could prevent such treachery?
translation: 这一直是邪恶的本质。也许他认为自己的力量可以防止这种背叛？

english: This allowed me freedom amongst their camp, for it was always easy to point the finger of suspicion at some unsuspecting necromancer or foolish Mahjarrat if it seemed as though my activities had been discovered.
translation: 这让我在他们的营地中有了自由，因为如果我的活动似乎被发现，总是很容易把怀疑的矛头指向某个毫无戒心的死灵法师或愚蠢的玛哈加特。

english: Similarly, should I ever be caught in the act of my sabotage, it was all too easy to bribe whoever found me or persuade them into believing it was just some minor treachery of my own, rather than my work for my
translation: 同样，如果我因破坏行为被抓，贿赂发现我的人，或说服他们相信这只是我个人的小背叛，

english: Lord Saradomin.
translation: 而非为我主萨拉多明效力，都太容易了。

english: Okay... Well, that makes sense, but I don't understand what the Staff of Armadyl had to do with this...?
translation: 好的……嗯，这说得通，但我不明白阿玛杜尔杖与此有什么关系……？

english: As I have told you, the Empty Lord was extremely powerful, but not so powerful that he could rule over the other deities of this world without opposition.
translation: 正如我告诉你的，空无之主极其强大，但还没强大到可以不受反对地统治这个世界上的其他神祇。

english: Should he have made a move against any other god, then he could still have been easily brought down by the combined efforts of the others.
translation: 如果他对任何其他神祇采取行动，他仍然可以被其他神祇的联合力量轻易击败。

english: The theft of Armadyl's staff changed this however.
translation: 然而，阿玛杜尔杖的失窃改变了这一点。

english: If he had taken possession of this god-weapon, then his power would have been so great that he could have overthrown all on this world, and made it into his own image!
translation: 如果他获得了这件神之武器，他的力量将强大到可以推翻这个世界上的一切，并将其塑造成他自己的形象！

english: I could not allow such a thing to happen!
translation: 我不能让这样的事情发生！

english: I went immediately to my comrade Dhalak, the mage, and told him that a message had come to the lair offering this weapon for sale!
translation: 我立刻去找我的同伴法师达拉克，告诉他有一个消息传到巢穴，说这件武器正在出售！

english: I knew that as soon as my Lord Saradomin heard this, he would contact Armadyl to inform them of the theft, and the matter would have been resolved quickly and discreetly.
translation: 我知道一旦我的主人萨拉多明听到这个消息，他会联系阿玛杜尔告知他们失窃一事，事情就会迅速而低调地解决。

english: So you passed this information to Dhalak instead of taking it to Saradomin yourself?
translation: 所以你把这条信息交给了达拉克，而不是亲自交给萨拉多明？

english: To my eternal shame, I indeed failed my Lord Saradomin...
translation: 令我永远羞愧的是，我确实辜负了我的主人萨拉多明……

english: I could not risk taking the message directly, for I feared my disguise had been uncovered.
translation: 我不敢冒险直接传递消息，因为我担心自己的伪装已经被识破。

english: Lucien particularly had been taking an unhealthy interest in my activities, and I had a gut feeling that to make any obvious moves against the Empty Lord would have been my undoing.
translation: 尤其是卢西安，对我的行动表现出了不寻常的关注，我有种直觉，如果对空无之主采取任何明显的行动，都会让我万劫不复。

english: But Dhalak was a noble man! I cannot believe that he would not have taken my message immediately to Lord Saradomin!
translation: 但达拉克是个高尚的人！我真不敢相信他没有立刻把我的消息带给萨拉多明大人！

english: Well, it seems like he didn't, but I don't know why not...
translation: 嗯，看来他确实没有，但我不知道为什么……

english: Please adventurer, discover what foul fate must have befallen him for him to have neglected his duty!
translation: 拜托了冒险者，去查明他究竟遭遇了什么不幸的命运，才会让他 neglect 自己的职责！

english: I have not much to offer as reward, but for these spare robes I wore while on assignment...
translation: 我没什么能作为报酬，但这套我执行任务时穿的备用长袍……

english: Please find him and discover why I am cursed like this!
translation: 请找到他，查明我为什么会受到这样的诅咒！

english: Where would I be able to find this Dhalak then?
translation: 那我在哪儿能找到这个达拉克呢？

english: Dhalak? I know not where, but he would try and make the most of his situation if he has been cursed, and find a place to lift his spirits!
translation: 达拉克？我不知道他在哪儿，但如果他也受到了诅咒，他会尽量适应自己的处境，找个地方振作精神！

english: Okay, well I'll try and find him for you then.
translation: 好吧，那我试试帮你找他。

english: Dhalak? Well, he was always a knowlegeable mage, so if this curse has befallen him as well, I would suspect he would be researching how to free himself of it.
translation: 达拉克？嗯，他一直是个知识渊博的法师，所以如果他也受到了这个诅咒，我猜他会在研究如何摆脱它。

english: I would look for a library to find him if I were you.
translation: 如果我是你，我会去图书馆找他。

english: Dhalak? He was always a loyal follower of Saradomin... I think he would have found an altar to Saradomin so that he may pray for this curse to be lifted.
translation: 达拉克？他一直是萨拉多明的忠诚追随者……我想他应该会找到一个萨拉多明祭坛，祈祷这个诅咒能被解除。

english: Well, that's all fascinating, but I just don't particularly care. Bye-bye.
translation: 嗯，这些都很有趣，但我就是不太在乎。再见。

english: Hello Lennissa. Can you remind me where to find Dhalak?
translation: 你好莱尼萨。你能提醒我在哪儿找到达拉克吗？

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Could I have more of those ghostly robes you gave me?
translation: 能再给我一些你给我的那些幽灵长袍吗？

english: It seems as though the curse that keeps me here extends to my very clothing... which piece do you want?
translation: 看来把我困在这里的诅咒也延伸到了我的衣物上……你想要哪一件？

english: Here you go.
translation: 给，拿好。

english: Tell me your story
translation: 跟我说说你的故事

english: Goodbye then
translation: 那就再见

english: Ask about Dhalak.
translation: 询问达拉克的事。

english: Ask for more ghostly robes.
translation: 索要更多幽灵长袍。

english: As you approach Lenny, he takes something out of his pocket.
translation: 当你走近莱尼时，他从口袋里掏出什么东西。

english: What'd you take out of that pocket?
translation: 你从那个口袋里掏出什么了？

english: Ain't a thing in my pocket...
translation: 我口袋里什么都没有……

english: I know there ain't. You got it in your hand...
translation: 我知道没有。东西在你手里……

english: I cannot speak to you outerlander! Talk to Brundt, the Chieftain!
translation: 我不能和你说话，外乡人！去找酋长布伦特！

english: You stay away from me outerlander!
translation: 离我远点，外乡人！

english: They are too suspicious of you for you to get close enough to steal from them.
translation: 他们对你太警惕了，你没法靠近偷东西。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Hello again [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. What need you of me this day? You can always rely on my assistance!
translation: 又见面了，[brother/sister][Fremennik name]。今天找我有什么事？你随时可以找我帮忙！

english: Nothing thanks. I just fancied a chat.
translation: 没什么。就是想聊聊天。

english: My door is always open should you ever need my help [Fremennik name].
translation: 如果你需要我的帮助，我的门随时为你敞开，[Fremennik name]。

english: [Fremennik name]... It has been too long since last we met!
translation: [Fremennik name]……我们上次见面已经是很久以前的事了！

english: Welcome back [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It is always a pleasure to see you here!
translation: 欢迎回来，[brother/sister][Fremennik name]。见到你总是很高兴！

english: My apologies [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! I have not time to tarry here with you!
translation: 抱歉，[brother/sister][Fremennik name]！我没时间在这儿和你久留！

english: That's okay, I didn't really want anything.
translation: 没关系，我其实也没什么想要的。

english: How are you [Fremennik name]? I hope all fares well with you this day!
translation: 你好吗，[Fremennik name]？希望你今天一切顺利！

english: I'm fine, thanks, how are you?
translation: 我很好，谢谢，你呢？

english: All is well with me also!
translation: 我也一切都好！

english: Hello to you, too!
translation: 也向你问好！

english: Hello. Did you want something [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你好。你想要什么吗，[Fremennik name]？

english: No, not really.
translation: 不，没什么。

english: Well... okay then!
translation: 那……好吧！

english: Always good to see you [brother/sister] [Fremennik name].
translation: 见到你总是很高兴，[brother/sister][Fremennik name]。

english: You shame us, [Fremennik name]!
translation: 你让我们蒙羞，[Fremennik name]！

english: How can you steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你怎么能偷我的东西，[Fremennik name]？

english: You have betrayed your heritage, [Fremennik name]!
translation: 你背叛了你的传承，[Fremennik name]！

english: Why would you try to steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你为什么要偷我的东西，[Fremennik name]？

english: How are you today?
translation: 你今天怎么样？

english: **sigh**
translation: 叹气

english: That good? Everyone around here seems a little depressed.
translation: 有那么好吗？这周围的人看起来都有点沮丧。

english: And not particularly talkative.
translation: 而且不太爱说话。

english: I'll leave you to your sighing. It looks like you have plenty to do.
translation: 我就不打扰你叹气了。看起来你有很多事要做。

english: It's a bit grey round here, isn't it?
translation: 这周围有点灰暗，不是吗？

english: It gets you down after a while, you know. There are 273 shades of grey, you know, and we have them all.
translation: 时间久了会让人消沉的。你知道吗，有273种灰色，而我们这儿全都有。

english: That's grey-t.
translation: 那真是''灰''常棒。(双关语)

english: That attempt at humour merely made me more depressed. Leave me alone.
translation: 你那蹩脚的幽默只会让我更沮丧。别烦我。

english: How's the King treating you then?
translation: 那国王待你如何？

english: Like serfs.
translation: 像农奴一样。

english: Serf?
translation: 农奴？

english: Yes, you know - peons, plebs, the downtrodden. He treats us like his own personal possessions.
translation: 是的，你知道的——苦力、平民、被压迫者。他把我们当作自己的私人财产。

english: You should leave this place.
translation: 你应该离开这个地方。

english: I keep trying to save up enough to leave, but the King keeps taxing us! We have no money left.
translation: 我一直想攒够钱离开，但国王一直在向我们征税！我们没钱了。

english: Oh dear.
translation: 哦，天哪。

english: Cheer up! It's not the end of the world.
translation: 振作点！又不是世界末日。

english: I'd prefer that, if it meant I didn't have to talk to people as inanely happy as you.
translation: 我宁愿世界末日，那样就不用和你这样傻乐的人说话了。

english: Whoa! I think you need to get out more.
translation: 哇！我觉得你需要多出去走走。

english: Hi.
translation: 嗨。

english: You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 你知道吗，跟人打招呼的方式可多了。你好、嘿、你好啊……

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: 那也只能算一种！

english: Hello. How are you today?
translation: 你好。你今天怎么样？

english: I'm great, thank you!
translation: 我很好，谢谢！

english: Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 你好！水晶城今天天气真好，是吧？

english: Indeed.
translation: 确实。

english: What can I do for ya?
translation: 我能为你做什么？

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可做的？

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 各种各样的事！那些塔楼是非常值得一看的景观。

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 像今天这样的好日子，我建议去市场逛逛。

english: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你觉得你在做什么？

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可做的？

english: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: Looking for a bit of meat?
translation: 想找点肉吗？

english: I beg your pardon?
translation: 你说什么？

english: Meat! We've got all the good stuff here.
translation: 肉！我们这儿什么好东西都有。

english: Show me what you've got.
translation: 让我看看你有什么。

english: Why do you have all this meat?
translation: 你为什么有这么多肉？

english: Some prefer solids to go with their blood. That, and the werewolf visitors need something to eat too.
translation: 有些人喜欢在喝血的同时吃点固体食物。而且，来访的狼人也需要吃东西。

english: Where does it all come from?
translation: 这些都从哪儿来的？

english: Look around you! There's no shortage of meat in these parts.
translation: 看看周围！这附近不缺肉。

english: You know what, I think I've heard enough.
translation: 你知道吗，我觉得我听得够多了。

english: Whatever you say. So, want some meat?
translation: 随你说。那么，想要点肉吗？

english: I'm good, thanks.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

english: Come back if you ever want some meat!
translation: 什么时候想要肉了再来！

english: Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: 人类！在我叫守卫之前滚回奴隶栏去！

english: Show me what you've got.
translation: 让我看看你有什么。

english: Why do you have all this meat?
translation: 你为什么有这么多肉？

english: I'm good, thanks.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

english: Can you come and help me, [player name]? I've got a problem with some graves.
translation: 你能来帮我吗，[player name]？我有些坟墓出了问题。

english: Okay, I'll help with your graves.
translation: 好的，我来帮你处理坟墓。

english: Player is teleported to Leo's graveyard
translation: 玩家被传送到莱奥的墓地

english: Sorry, I'm busy.
translation: 抱歉，我很忙。

english: You have to help me, [player name]! I've put the wrong coffins into these graves.
translation: 你必须帮我，[player name]！我把错误的棺材放进了这些坟墓。

english: I need you to pick up the coffin from each grave, see who's inside it, and bury it in the grave with the correct gravestone.
translation: 我需要你从每个坟墓里取出棺材，看看里面是谁，然后把它埋在有正确墓碑的坟墓里。

english: I think I've finished!
translation: 我想我完成了！

english: That's a good attempt, but it's just not right. Try looking in the coffins to learn who is in them, and read the gravestones to see who is supposed to be buried there.
translation: 尝试得不错，但还不对。试试看看棺材里是谁，再读读墓碑上写的是谁应该埋在那里。

english: All right, I'll give it another shot.
translation: 好吧，我再试一次。

english: Wonderful! That's taken care of them. I'll take you back, and give you your reward.
translation: 太好了！都处理好了。我带你回去，给你报酬。

english: Remind me what I'm supposed to do.
translation: 提醒我该做什么。

english: Pick up the coffins.
translation: 拿起棺材。

english: Check the body inside.
translation: 检查里面的尸体。

english: Find out where they need to be buried.
translation: 找出他们应该被埋在哪里。

english: Put all five coffins in the correct graves.
translation: 把所有五个棺材放进正确的坟墓。

english: You can store items in the mausoleum if you need more
translation: 如果你需要更多

english: inventory space.
translation: 物品栏空间，可以把物品存放在陵墓里。

english: I want to leave now.
translation: 我现在想离开。

english: In that case, I'll take you back to where I found you.
translation: 那样的话，我带你回我找到你的地方。

english: Player is teleported to back to the previous location
translation: 玩家被传送回之前的位置

english: Welcome back!
translation: 欢迎回来！

english: What? But how am I still here?
translation: 什么？但我怎么还在这儿？

english: You died, and now you are in a graveyard.
translation: 你死了，现在你在墓地里。

english: Where did you think you would go?
translation: 你以为你会去哪儿？

english: Sorry, I need help from [player name].
translation: 抱歉，我需要 [player name] 的帮助。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Hello, [player name]?
translation: 你好，[player name]？

english: Please help me, [player name].
translation: 请帮我，[player name]。

english: I need your help, [player name]!
translation: 我需要你的帮助，[player name]！

english: Can I borrow you for a minute, [player name]?
translation: 能借用你一会儿吗，[player name]？

english: Maybe later.
translation: 也许改天吧。

english: Okay, I'll help with your graves.
translation: 好的，我来帮你处理坟墓。

english: Sorry, I'm busy.
translation: 抱歉，我很忙。

english: I think I've finished!
translation: 我想我完成了！

english: Remind me what I'm supposed to do.
translation: 提醒我该做什么。

english: I want to leave now.
translation: 我现在想离开。

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: I'm blending in. Scopin' out the place.
translation: 我在融入环境。侦察这个地方。

english: Are you preparing for a heist? You're only a kid.
translation: 你在准备抢劫吗？你只是个孩子。

english: Let's just say there are some wealthy people about, with full pockets.
translation: 就这么说吧，附近有些有钱人，口袋满满的。

english: Any tips? I'm not having much luck myself.
translation: 有什么建议吗？我自己运气不太好。

english: I'm quite sneaky. Every now and then I'll get their attention so their pockets aren't being so carefully watched.
translation: 我很狡猾。时不时我会吸引他们的注意力，这样他们就不会那么小心看管口袋了。

english: That is sneaky. I'll keep an eye out for your... distractions.
translation: 那真狡猾。我会留意你的……干扰行动。

english: Now leave me be. I'm already distracting!
translation: 现在别烦我。我已经够让人分心了！

english: You notice an urchin distract a wealthy citizen nearby.
translation: 你注意到一个流浪儿在分散附近一位富裕市民的注意力。

english: I've been robbed!
translation: 我被抢了！

english: *Sobbing*
translation: 抽泣

english: My parents are gonna be so mad!
translation: 我父母会非常生气的！

english: Oh gosh!
translation: 哦，天哪！

english: What can I do?
translation: 我能做什么？

english: That's awful!
translation: 太糟糕了！

english: I'll keep you company for a moment.

english: What is this place?

english: This is Aleck's Hunter Emporium. Basically, it's just a shop with a fancy name; you can buy various weapons and traps here.
translation: 这是阿莱克的猎人用品店。基本上，就是个名字花哨的商店；你可以在这里买到各种武器和陷阱。

translation: 哦，这不是我的店；店主是阿莱克，就在柜台后面。

english: I experiment with weapon designs. I'm here because I've been trying to convince people to back my research and maybe sell some of my products - like this one I'm holding - in their shops.
translation: 我实验武器设计。我来这儿是因为我一直想说服人们支持我的研究，也许能在他们的店里卖一些我的产品——比如我手里拿的这个。

translation: 你能跟我说说你的弩吗？

english: It's good, isn't it? I designed it to incorporate the bones of various animals in its construction.
translation: 很不错，是吧？我设计它时在结构中融入了各种动物的骨头。

english: It's a fair bit faster than an ordinary crossbow too; it'll take you far less time to reload between shots.

translation: 他们对我的风力捕鼠器也是这么说的。

translation: 嗯，它们出问题只是因为人们非要在室内使用。

translation: 不管怎样，我觉得我的弩发明更有前景。

translation: 我需要凯比特兔刺，很多。不是所有凯比特兔都有刺。你需要带刺的凯比特兔，或者更好的是 razor-backed 凯比特兔，才能得到足够硬的材料。

translation: 我不能自己做吗？

translation: 可以，我想你可以，虽然你需要用刀和凿子时手要稳。

translation: 弩箭的直径不寻常，但基本上你只需要能把凯比特兔刺雕刻成直的箭杆。
