translation: 让开，小混混。

english: Hmm... you smell strange...
translation: 嗯……你闻起来很奇怪……

english: Strange how?
translation: 怎么奇怪？

english: Like a human!
translation: 像人类！

english: Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: 哦！呃……因为我刚吃了一个！

english: Leave me alone.
translation: 别烦我。

english: Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: 如果你珍惜生命就别再和我说话！

english: Get lost!
translation: 滚开！

english: I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: 我没什么能给你的，所以别烦我，乞丐。

english: Have you no manners?
translation: 你没有礼貌吗？

english: I don't have time for this right now.
translation: 我现在没时间处理这个。

english: I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: 我没兴趣和你这样可怜的肉袋说话。

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
translation: 我打赌你有漂亮的爪子。

english: A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: 真是悲惨的一天啊……趁还能享受就享受吧。

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: 你要是抓到谁，答应分我一口。

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
translation: 我之前没在这里闻到过你……

english: You smell familiar...
translation: 你闻起来很熟悉……

english: Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: 这附近有看到人类吗？我非——常饿。

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: 你看起来也是个嗜血之人。

english: Good day to you, my friend.
translation: 你好，我的朋友。

english: Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
translation: 想去城堡吃点零食吗？

english: Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
translation: 等一下，我牙缝里卡了点人肉渣……

english: Thanks so much for saving me from being a vampyre. Here, take this certificate, I'm sorry but it's all I can offer as a reward.
translation: 非常感谢你救我免于成为吸血鬼。给，拿着这个证书，抱歉这是我唯一能提供的报酬。

english: Thanks for changing me back, it must have been hard for you. I must be off now.
translation: 谢谢你把我变回来，这对你来说一定很难。我现在得走了。

english: Welcome to the Keldagrim library, human traveller!
translation: 欢迎来到凯尔达格林城图书馆，人类旅行者！

english: Can you tell me more about the library?
translation: 你能告诉我更多关于图书馆的事吗？

english: Why, certainly, it is one of my favourite subjects!
translation: 当然，这是我最喜欢的话题之一！

english: I am Hugi, you see, I am the chief librarian here. Hugi, my parents named me that, it means 'personification of thought' in the ancient dwarvish tongue.
translation: 我是胡吉，你看，我是这里的图书管理员长。胡吉，我父母给我取的名字，在古矮人语中意思是''思想的化身''。

english: Quite like the name myself.
translation: 我自己也很喜欢这个名字。

english: The books in this library have been collected for many centuries now, through various generous donations.
translation: 这座图书馆的书籍已经收集了几个世纪，通过各种慷慨的捐赠。

english: You'll find books dating from many different eras as well, such as the Era of Kings, the Rise of the Consortium and the Era of Prosperity, our current era.
translation: 你还会找到来自许多不同时代的书籍，比如国王时代、财团崛起时代和繁荣时代，我们当前的时代。

english: How do these eras correspond with the Ages of the world?
translation: 这些时代如何与世界纪元对应？

english: Oh, they are quite different, and most of them take place in the Fourth Age.
translation: 哦，它们很不同，大部分发生在第四纪元。

english: Since we dwarves hid underground for a long time to sit out the wars that raged above the ground our history books differ slightly from those written by humans.
translation: 由于我们矮人在地下躲藏了很长时间，避开了地面上肆虐的战争，我们的历史书与人类写的略有不同。

english: Thanks for the information!
translation: 谢谢你的信息！

english: What do you know about impenetrable rocks?
translation: 你对坚不可摧的岩石了解多少？

english: You're confusing me, what rock exactly are you talking about?
translation: 你把我搞糊涂了，你到底在说什么岩石？

english: The big one in the mines south of the city. Dondakan's big rock.
translation: 城市南部矿井里的那块大岩石。东达坎的大石头。

english: I see, I see.
translation: 我明白了，我明白了。

english: I heard there was a demon inside there that you banished.
translation: 我听说里面有个恶魔被你们驱逐了。

english: Yes, what exactly does that mean anyway?
translation: 是的，那到底是什么意思？

english: There are some demons that we cannot see properly as mortals. They also cannot be fought with normal weapons.
translation: 有些恶魔我们凡人无法正确看见。它们也无法用普通武器对抗。

english: But sometimes these creatures manifest themselves in a solid form in our world. Their avatar.
translation: 但有时这些生物会以实体形式出现在我们的世界。它们的化身。

english: When you defeat an avatar, you defeat the actual demon behind it. But they don't die, they are banished to where they came from originally.
translation: 当你击败一个化身，你就击败了它背后的真正恶魔。但它们不会死，而是被驱逐回它们原本来的地方。

english: Does that mean I will have to deal with this demon again some time?
translation: 那是不是意味着我将来某个时候还得对付这个恶魔？

english: Doubtful. He will grow stronger and stronger over time, but that's a process that will take a thousand years at least.
translation: 不太可能。它会随着时间变得越来越强，但这个过程至少需要一千年。

english: Even dwarves don't live so long.
translation: 连矮人都活不了那么久。

english: No, we won't see him again and the mines are safe to dig for gold now. Of course, that might lead to other problems eventually...
translation: 不，我们不会再见到它，现在矿井可以安全地开采黄金了。当然，这最终可能会导致其他问题……

english: Can you tell me more about the library?
translation: 你能告诉我更多关于图书馆的事吗？

english: What do you know about impenetrable rocks?
translation: 你对坚不可摧的岩石了解多少？

english: Greetings warrior, how can I fill your stomach today?
translation: 你好，战士，今天我怎么填饱你的肚子？

english: With food preferably.
translation: 最好用食物。

english: Come try my lovely pizza or maybe some fish!
translation: 来尝尝我美味的披萨或者一些鱼！

english: Stew to fill the belly, on sale here!
translation: 填饱肚子的炖菜，这里出售！

english: Potatoes are filling and healthy too!
translation: 土豆也能填饱肚子而且健康！

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Are you in charge of this squad?
translation: 你是这个小队的负责人吗？

english: Yes. We're guarding this entrance against demonic excursions.
translation: 是的。我们守卫这个入口防止恶魔入侵。

english: How's that going?
translation: 进展如何？

english: Not super well, I'm afraid. It's a nerve wracking post, and it's taking its toll on my soldiers.
translation: 恐怕不太好。这是个令人紧张的岗位，对我的士兵们造成了影响。

english: Can I do anything to help?
translation: 我能帮什么忙吗？

english: Not in any official capacity. Making any sort of move might spark a chain reaction.
translation: 不能以任何官方身份。采取任何行动都可能引发连锁反应。

english: But unofficially...
translation: 但非官方地……

english: It would be good to know what's going on down there. If you can handle yourself, and you can keep an eye on the demons, you might be able to help.
translation: 最好知道下面发生了什么。如果你能照顾好自己，并能监视恶魔，你可能能帮上忙。

english: We just need to know if it looks like they're preparing for anything. But if you do this, you're on your own. If anything happens, I won't be able to send help.
translation: 我们只需要知道他们是否在准备什么。但如果你这样做，你就靠自己了。如果发生什么事，我无法派遣援军。

english: Understood. Well, if I see anything suspicious, I'll be sure to casually mention it.
translation: 明白了。嗯，如果我看到任何可疑的东西，我一定会顺便提一下。

english: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢你。

english: What wrong with your soldiers?
translation: 你的士兵怎么了？

english: Some of them are afraid, others impatient. That's the biggest problem actually. They're all having different reactions. It's making it difficult to work as a unit.
translation: 有些人害怕，有些人不耐烦。这其实是最大的问题。他们都有不同的反应。这让团队合作变得困难。

english: Do they usually have this problem?
translation: 他们通常有这个问题吗？

english: No, they're good soldiers. I suspect it has something to do with those cultists and their little chats.
translation: 不，他们是好士兵。我怀疑这和那些邪教徒及其小谈话有关。

english: Not that we can do much about that. We can't afford to initiate hostilities. There's a lot at stake, and I'm honestly not sure we could handle a direct confrontation.
translation: 但我们对此无能为力。我们承担不起挑起敌对行动的后果。利害关系重大，老实说我不确定我们能否应对直接对抗。

english: That does sound like a difficult situation to be in.
translation: 那听起来确实是个困难的处境。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Can I do anything to help?
translation: 我能帮什么忙吗？

english: What's wrong with your soldiers?
translation: 你的士兵怎么了？

english: Move into position lads! eh? Who are you and what do you want?
translation: 各就各位，伙计们！呃？你是谁，想要什么？

english: Who are you then?
translation: 那你是谁？

english: Lieutenant Shepbur, commanding officer of the new Armoured Tortoise Regiment.
translation: 谢普伯中尉，新装甲龟团的指挥官。

english: There's only two tortoises here, that's hardly a regiment.
translation: 这里只有两只乌龟，那几乎不算一个团。

english: This is just the beginning! Gnome breeders and trainers are already working to expand the number of units.  Soon we'll have hundreds of these beauties, nay thousands! And they will not only carry mages and
translation: 这只是开始！地精繁殖者和训练师已经在努力扩大单位数量。很快我们就会有数百只这些美人，不，数千只！而且它们不仅会载着法师和

english: archers but other fiendish weapons of destruction of gnome devising. An army of giant tortoises will march upon this battlefield and rain the fire of our wrath upon all our enemies! Nothing will be able to stop us!
translation: 弓箭手，还会携带其他地精设计的邪恶毁灭武器。一支巨龟大军将行进在这个战场上，向我们所有的敌人倾泻我们的怒火之火！没有什么能阻止我们！

english: Oooookayy...... I'll leave you to it then....
translation: 哦……好吧……那我不打扰你了……

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 虽然你找到了你的顾客，但你似乎没有带正确的食物！你需要 [a/some][ordered gnome food/drink item]！

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 恐怕预制菜不行。只有手工制作的地精美食才配得上阿卢夫‧阿洛夫特的顾客。

english: You hand over your delivery of [item] to Lieutenant Schepbur
translation: 你把你的 [item] 递交给谢普伯中尉

english: Soon Gnome Cuisine will take over the world! Thanks.
translation: 很快地精美食将征服世界！谢谢。

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: 你一定走了很远的路才把这个送到我这儿。这是额外的一点小费。

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
translation: 你有 [number] 积分可以换取免费配送代币。你还没有资格获得地精美食配送。

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 你有 [number] 积分可以换取免费配送代币。你可以获得 [number] 份地精美食配送。

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: 别忘了从阿卢夫‧吉安尼小那里领取你的免费配送代币。

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 你的配送太晚了！回阿卢夫小那里重新接单。你丢弃了配送箱，因为你不再需要它了。

english: *hic* G'day! Do ya... ... well, do ya need any help with yer trident? *buuurrrp*
translation: (嗝) 你好！你……嗯，你需要帮助处理你的三叉戟吗？饱(嗝)

english: Bit early to be drinking, isn't it?
translation: 喝酒有点早了吧，不是吗？

english: Why?! What time *hic* is it?
translation: 为什么？！现在几点了(嗝)？

english: Hmm, I've no idea.
translation: 嗯，我不知道。

english: I can drink to that!
translation: 我可以为此干杯！

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: What!? Why I'm the infamous pirate Lieve McCracken! You've not heard of me?
translation: 什么！？我可是臭名昭著的海盗莉芙‧麦克拉肯！你没听说过我？

english: Hmm, can't say I have.
translation: 嗯，不能说听说过。

english: I'm wanted in several *hic* kingdoms - murder, armed robbery and even *hic* flag desecration!
translation: 我在好几个(嗝)王国被通缉——谋杀、武装抢劫甚至(嗝)亵渎旗帜！

english: Shouldn't you be in hiding?
translation: 你不应该躲起来吗？

english: I'm sorry, but *hic* do ya see anyone here?
translation: 抱歉，但(嗝)你看到这里有人吗？

english: I guess you could call this hiding. If you're some famous pirate, where's you ship?
translation: 我想你可以把这叫做躲藏。如果你是某个著名的海盗，你的船呢？

english: *hic* My last expedition didn't end too well for my boat... or crew *hic*.
translation: (嗝) 我上次探险对我的船……或者船员(嗝)来说结局不太好。

english: So, what's in the cave?
translation: 那么，洞穴里有什么？

english: The fruits o' my labour... and some waterfiends, those were a surprise *hic* to be sure, but a welcome one.
translation: 我劳动的果实……还有一些水魔，那些确实是惊喜(嗝)，但却是受欢迎的惊喜。

english: Umm, fruits?
translation: 嗯，果实？

english: Oh, not *hic* actual fruits, silly! A relative o' mine wanted a cave full o' Krakens, so here *hic* I am.
translation: 哦，不是(嗝)真正的果实，傻瓜！我的一个亲戚想要一个装满克拉肯海怪的洞穴，所以我就(嗝)在这儿了。

english: And why are you so drunk?
translation: 那你为什么喝得这么醉？

english: Well, the Krakens destroyed m' ship, killed m' crew, the rum it's... all I 'ave left.
translation: 嗯，克拉肯海怪毁了我的船，杀了我的船员，朗姆酒是……我仅剩的东西。

english: Sorry about that, so... Can I kill some Krakens?
translation: 对此我很抱歉，那么……我能杀一些克拉肯海怪吗？

english: If you've been assigned some by a slayer master, I don't see *hic* why not.
translation: 如果你被杀戮大师分配了一些任务，我不明白(嗝)为什么不行。

english: And if I havn't been?
translation: 如果我没有被分配呢？

english: Then ya can leave m' Krakens *hic* alone.
translation: 那你可以别动我的克拉肯海怪(嗝)。

english: Umm... ok then.
translation: 嗯……好吧。

english: Let's talk about tridents.
translation: 我们聊聊三叉戟吧。

english: If ya brings me a trident, I can enhance it for ya. It'll store 20,000 charges, not just 2,500. But I wants payin' fer the job.
translation: 如果你给我带一把三叉戟，我可以为你强化它。它能储存20,000次充能，不只是2,500次。但我需要报酬。

english: Give me 10 kraken tentacles first. I'll hold onto 'em for ya. Then ya can bring me a trident to enhance, an' I'll get to work for ya.
translation: 先给我10个克拉肯海怪触手。我会帮你保管。然后你可以带一把三叉戟来强化，我就为你工作。

english: If ya brings me a trident, I can enhance it for ya. It'll store 20,000 charges, not just 2,500. Ya brought me one tentacle so far, but I'll want 10 of 'em to do the job.
translation: 如果你给我带一把三叉戟，我可以为你强化它。它能储存20,000次充能，不只是2,500次。你目前给了我一个触手，但我需要10个才能工作。

english: Just pass me 9 more tentacles, then give me yer trident an' I'll get to work for ya.
translation: 再给我9个触手，然后把你的三叉戟给我，我就为你工作。

english: If ya brings me a trident, I can enhance it for ya. It'll store 20,000 charges, not just 2,500. Ya brought me [number] tentacles so far, but I'll want 10 of 'em to do the job.
translation: 如果你给我带一把三叉戟，我可以为你强化它。它能储存20,000次充能，不只是2,500次。你目前给了我 [number] 个触手，但我需要10个才能工作。

english: Just pass me [number] more tentacles, then give me yer trident an' I'll get to work for ya.
translation: 再给我 [number] 个触手，然后把你的三叉戟给我，我就为你工作。

english: If ya brings me a trident, I can enhance it for ya. It'll store 20,000 charges, not just 2,500. Ya brought me 9 tentacles so far, but I'll want 10 of 'em to do the job.
translation: 如果你给我带一把三叉戟，我可以为你强化它。它能储存20,000次充能，不只是2,500次。你目前给了我9个触手，但我需要10个才能工作。

english: Just pass me one more tentacle, then give me yer trident an' I'll get to work for ya.
translation: 再给我一个触手，然后把你的三叉戟给我，我就为你工作。

english: If ya brings me a trident, I can enhance it for ya. It'll store 20,000 charges, not just 2,500. Ya brought me [number] tentacles; I'll use up 10 of 'em to do the job.
translation: 如果你给我带一把三叉戟，我可以为你强化它。它能储存20,000次充能，不只是2,500次。你给了我 [number] 个触手；我会用掉10个来工作。

english: Just pass me yer trident an' I'll get to work for ya.
translation: 把你的三叉戟给我，我就为你工作。

english: I'll be, heh, leaving you now...
translation: 我，嘿，现在要离开你了……

english: Wow, so original.
translation: 哇，真有创意。

english: Oi, I'm Lieve McCracken and I say leave m' Kraken alone!
translation: 喂，我是莉芙‧麦克拉肯，我说别动我的克拉肯海怪！

english: Lieve McCracken wants you to stick to your Slayer assignments.
translation: 莉芙‧麦克拉肯希望你遵守你的杀戮任务。

english: Oi, I'm Lieve, and I say leave it!
translation: 喂，我是莉芙，我说别动它！

english: Ya gotta bring me 10 tentacles before I'll enhance yer tridents for ya. Just hand 'em to me when ye've got 'em.
translation: 你得给我10个触手我才能为你强化三叉戟。有了就交给我。

english: Ya gotta bring me 10 tentacles before I'll enhance yer tridents for ya. So far ya brought me one.
translation: 你得给我10个触手我才能为你强化三叉戟。目前你给了我一个。

english: Ya gotta bring me 10 tentacles before I'll enhance yer tridents for ya. So far ya brought me [number].
translation: 你得给我10个触手我才能为你强化三叉戟。目前你给了我 [number] 个。

english: That trident's already been enhanced, ya ninny!
translation: 那把三叉戟已经强化过了，你这个笨蛋！

english: I see ya got a tentacle there. Do ya want me to hold onto it for ya? For every 10 ya gives me, I'll enhance a trident for ya.
translation: 我看到你有个触手。你想让我帮你保管吗？每给我10个，我就为你强化一把三叉戟。

english: Remember, I won't give 'em back. Once ya gives me a tentacle, I keep it.
translation: 记住，我不会还给你。一旦你给了我触手，我就留着它。

english: Remember, I won't give 'em back. Once ya gives me a tentacle, I keep it. Ya already gave me [number].
translation: 记住，我不会还给你。一旦你给了我触手，我就留着它。你已经给了我 [number] 个。

english: Thanks. I've got one tentacle stored for ya now. Once ye've brought me 10, ya can hand me a trident, an' I'll enhance it.
translation: 谢谢。我现在为你保管了一个触手。等你给我10个后，你可以把三叉戟给我，我就强化它。

english: Thanks. I've got [number] tentacles stored for ya now. Once ye've brought me 10, ya can hand me a trident, an' I'll enhance it.
translation: 谢谢。我现在为你保管了 [number] 个触手。等你给我10个后，你可以把三叉戟给我，我就强化它。

english: Thanks. I've got [number] tentacles stored for ya now. For every 10, ya can hand me a trident, an' I'll enhance it.
translation: 谢谢。我现在为你保管了 [number] 个触手。每满10个，你可以把三叉戟给我，我就强化它。

translation: 又见面了 [Fremennik name]！我能为你做什么？

english: Do I still need the Seal of Passage?
translation: 我还需要通行印章吗？

english: Yeah, why?
translation: 是的，怎么了？

english: I lost it.
translation: 我弄丢了。

english: Silly you. You'll have to go back to Brundt the Chieftain to get another before you can go on to Lunar Isle.
translation: 你真傻。你得回去找酋长布伦特再拿一个，然后才能去月亮岛。

english: Can you take me back to Rellekka please?
translation: 你能带我回雷勒卡城吗？

english: Hey, if you want to go back to loserville with all the losers, who am I to stop you?
translation: 嘿，如果你想回失败者镇和所有失败者在一起，我凭什么拦你？

english: Player is transported to Rellekka
translation: 玩家被传送至雷勒卡城

english: Nothing thanks! I just saw you here and thought I'd say hello!
translation: 没什么谢谢！我只是看到你在这里，想打个招呼！

english: Hey, I knew you seemed cool when I met you [Fremennik name]!
translation: 嘿，我见到你时就知道你很酷 [Fremennik name]！

english: That's fine, I'm just going to Pirates' Cove.
translation: 没关系，我只是要去海盗湾。

english: Oh, I'd better go back and get it.
translation: 哦，我最好回去拿。

english: Go now.
translation: 现在走。

english: Don't go.
translation: 别走。

english: Can you take me back to Rellekka?
translation: 你能带我回雷勒卡城吗？

english: Nothing thanks.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。

english: Greetings human.
translation: 你好，人类。

english: Hello, who are you?
translation: 你好，你是谁？

english: Lokraa quo Sihar. I am one of the mystics of the Kahlith. Are you here to serve the balance?
translation: 洛克拉‧夸‧西哈尔。我是卡利特的神秘主义者之一。你是来为平衡服务的吗？

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: Then you should speak to Konar quo Maten. She will guide you.
translation: 那你应该跟科纳‧夸‧马滕谈谈。她会指引你。

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: A shame. You are a bringer of death, you could be of great use to the balance.
translation: 真可惜。你是死亡使者，本可以为平衡发挥巨大作用。

english: I'm not sure.
translation: 我不确定。

english: Then you should speak with Xorrah quo Sihar. He will show you the way.
translation: 那你应该跟佐拉‧夸‧西哈尔谈谈。他会给你指路。

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: I'm not sure.
translation: 我不确定。

english: Arrr, matey!
translation: 啊，伙计！

english: I'm looking for Redbeard Frank.
translation: 我在找红胡子弗兰克。

english: Redbeard Frank ye say? He be outside. Says he likes the feel of the wind on his cheeks.
translation: 你说红胡子弗兰克？他在外头，说是喜欢海风吹拂在脸上的感觉。

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

english: Why are you called Longbow Ben?
translation: 你为什么叫长弓本？

english: Arrr, that's a strange yarn.
translation: 啊，那是个奇怪的故事。

english: I was to be marooned, ye see. A scurvy troublemaker had taken my ship, and he put me ashore on a little island.
translation: 我本要被遗弃，你看。一个讨厌的捣蛋鬼抢了我的船，把我丢在一个小岛上。

english: Gosh, how did you escape?
translation: 天哪，你是怎么逃出来的？

english: Arrr, ye see, he made one mistake! Before he sailed away, he gave me a bow and one arrow so that I wouldn't have to die slowly.
translation: 啊，你看，他犯了一个错误！在他扬帆离去前，他给了我一把弓和一支箭，这样我就不必慢慢等死了。

english: So I shot him and took my ship back.
translation: 所以我射中了他，夺回了我的船。

english: Right...
translation: 好吧……

english: Have you got any quests I could do?
translation: 你有什么任务我能做吗？

english: Nay, but the barkeep hears most of the news around here. Or Redbeard Frank, he's often spoken of buried treasure. Perhaps ye should be asking them for quests.
translation: 没有，但酒保能听到这里的大多数消息。或者红胡子弗兰克，他经常提到埋藏的宝藏。也许你应该向他们打听任务。

english: Nay, but Redbeard Frank has often spoken of buried treasure. Perhaps ye should be asking him for a quest.
translation: 没有，但红胡子弗兰克经常提到埋藏的宝藏。也许你应该向他打听任务。

english: Nay, but the barkeep hears most of the news around here. Perhaps ye should be asking him for a quest.
translation: 没有，但酒保能听到这里的大多数消息。也许你应该向他打听任务。

english: Nay, I've nothing for ye to do. But I hear there's an old landlubber in Draynor Village who's always a-looking for a lively [lad/lass] to do him a favour.
translation: 没有，我没什么能让你做的。但我听说德雷诺村有个老旱鸭子，总是在找个活泼的 [lad/lass] 帮他忙。

english: Arrr, matey!
translation: 啊，伙计！

english: Yo ho ho!
translation: 哟吼吼！

english: So are you pirates?
translation: 那么你们是海盗吗？

english: Aye laddie, that we are.
translation: 是的孩子，我们是。

english: Aye, that we be.
translation: 是的，我们是。

english: Nay, always ye say it wrong! Tis 'we are', not 'we be'.
translation: 不，你总是说错！应该是''我们是''，不是''we be''。

english: I be a pirate, not a scurvy schoolmaster!
translation: 我是海盗，不是该死的教师！

english: Ye be a fool, and a disgrace to piracy.
translation: 你是个傻瓜，是海盗的耻辱。

english: Now ye be saying 'be' too!
translation: 现在你也说''be''了！

english: Arrr! Tis thy fault.
translation: 啊！是你的错。

english: I think I'll leave you two to sort it out.
translation: 我想我还是让你们俩自己解决吧。

english: I'm looking for Redbeard Frank.
translation: 我在找红胡子弗兰克。

english: Why are you called Longbow Ben?
translation: 你为什么叫长弓本？

english: Have you got any quests I could do?
translation: 你有什么任务我能做吗？

english: Hey, outerlander. You can't go through there. Talent only, backstage.
translation: 嘿，外乡人。你不能从那里过去。只有演职人员才能去后台。

english: You can't go through there. Talent only, backstage.
translation: 你不能从那里过去。只有演职人员才能去后台。

english: But I'm a Bard!
translation: 但我是个吟游诗人！

english: No you're not. I saw your performance. I was paid well to keep you from ever setting foot on stage here again.
translation: 不你不是。我看过你的表演。我收了钱不让你再在这里登台。

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Hello, Longramble. How goes the hunt for the edge of the world?
translation: 你好，朗拉姆布尔。寻找世界边缘的进展如何？

english: Truth be told, I've found myself getting a bit side- tracked. The potential discovery of Arposandra is quite an exciting one!
translation: 说实话，我发现自己有点分心了。阿尔波桑德拉的潜在发现相当令人兴奋！

english: And also quite dangerous.
translation: 而且相当危险。

english: Yes, that's why I've not dared go inside again. It's much safer out here. Slightly less smelly as well.
translation: 是的，这就是为什么我不敢再进去。外面安全多了。气味也稍微不那么难闻。

english: Slightly being the key word there.
translation: '稍微''是那里的关键词。

english: Hello there. How goes the hunt for Arposandra?
translation: 你好。寻找阿尔波桑德拉的进展如何？

english: I think I've found an entrance to the city, but it's too well defended. There's all these traps, and some talking terrorbird guards!
translation: 我想我找到了城市的入口，但防守太严密了。到处都是陷阱，还有一些会说话的骇鸟守卫！

english: Talking terrorbirds? There must be some strange magic being practised in there. What do you plan to do?
translation: 会说话的骇鸟？那里一定在施行某种奇怪的魔法。你打算怎么做？

english: I don't know. I think I've hit a dead end for now.
translation: 我不知道。我想我目前遇到了死胡同。

english: That's a shame. Still, you've made a big discovery. It will be quite the tale to tell... assuming anyone believes a story about talking terrorbirds, that is.
translation: 真可惜。不过，你有了重大发现。这会是个很好的故事……假设有人相信关于会说话骇鸟的故事的话。

english: I appear to have misplaced the grappling equipment I need to cross the river.
translation: 我似乎把过河需要的抓钩设备放错地方了。

english: That wasn't very clever, was it?
translation: 那不太聪明，是吧？

english: Er... no.
translation: 呃……不。

english: Well, it's a good job explorers like me know how to use their surroundings. I have an idea!
translation: 嗯，好在像我这样的探险家知道如何利用周围环境。我有个主意！

english: Longramble explains, in huge detail, a wildly complicated plan to get you across the river. It involves using various items scrounged from the local flora and fauna.
translation: 朗拉姆布尔非常详细地解释了一个极其复杂的过河计划。涉及使用从当地动植物中搜集的各种物品。

english: Before you know it, you find yourself on the other side of the river with a bump on your head and no recollection of how you got across. You wonder what Longramble's plan was. It must have been very clever.
translation: 不知不觉中，你发现自己已在河对岸，头上有个包，却不记得是怎么过来的。你想知道朗拉姆布尔的计划是什么。那一定非常聪明。

english: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？

english: What are you guarding?
translation: 你在守卫什么？

english: This path leads to the Doors of Dinh. You should be careful if you wish to travel any further.
translation: 这条路通往丁之门。如果你想继续前进，应该小心。

english: Tell me about the Doors of Dinh.
translation: 跟我讲讲丁之门。

english: They're to keep the Wintertodt at bay. No-one knows what it really is, but centuries ago it came out of the northern wastes to terrorise the kingdom.
translation: 它们是用来遏制冬将军的。没人知道它究竟是什么，但几个世纪前它从北方荒野出现，恐吓王国。

english: The Doors were created by Dinh, a master smither, to imprison the Wintertodt.
translation: 丁之门是由铁匠大师丁创造的，用来囚禁冬将军。

english: Now we keep a watch on the pass, so that the armies can be summoned if the Wintertodt ever escapes.
translation: 现在我们看守着这个关口，以便冬将军一旦逃脱就能召集军队。

english: Okay, thanks for the warning.
translation: 好的，谢谢警告。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: I'm the duty look-out on the northern pass. It's the worst assignment there is.
translation: 我是北部关口的值班哨兵。这是最差的差事。

english: As if the cold weren't bad enough, the snooty Arceuus magi always look down their noses at the Shayzien armies, just because we use muscle and steel rather than fancy magicks.
translation: 好像寒冷还不够糟糕似的，那些傲慢的阿西乌斯法师总是瞧不起谢兹恩城卫军，就因为我们用肌肉和钢铁而不是花哨的魔法。

english: I'll leave you alone now.
translation: 我现在不打扰你了。

english: What are you guarding?
translation: 你在守卫什么？

english: Tell me about the Doors of Dinh.
translation: 跟我讲讲丁之门。

english: Okay, thanks for the warning.
translation: 好的，谢谢警告。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: I'll leave you alone now.
translation: 我现在不打扰你了。

english: You! You're the one that lost me my tithes. Get out before I have you killed!
translation: 你！你就是让我损失什一税的人。在我让人杀了你之前滚出去！

english: Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: 人类！在我叫守卫之前滚回奴隶栏去！

english: You there. Who are you?
translation: 你在那儿。你是谁？

english: [Vampyre name].
translation: [Vampyre name]。

english: Tell me, [player vampyre name], what blood tastes the best?
translation: 告诉我，[player vampyre name]，什么血味道最好？

english: Err... Human?
translation: 呃……人类？

english: You misunderstand me, I mean what kind of human?
translation: 你误会我了，我是说哪种人类？

english: One with a face?
translation: 有脸的？

english: What? I mean, yes. But what else?
translation: 什么？我是说，是的。但还有呢？

english: I don't know... What's the actual answer?
translation: 我不知道……正确答案是什么？

english: Love. Blood tastes best when it comes from one who loves.
translation: 爱。来自爱人之血味道最佳。

english: Too many around here treat their tithes with discontentment. When they do, they miss out on the full potential blood has to offer.
translation: 这里太多人对他们的什一税心怀不满。这样做时，他们就错过了血液所能提供的全部潜力。

english: Treat your tithes with respect instead. They will come to love you, and their blood becomes so much better as a result.
translation: 相反，要尊重你的什一税民。他们会渐渐爱上你，他们的血也会因此变得更加美味。

english: I see. I'll keep that in mind.
translation: 我明白了。我会记住的。

english: Baxtorian.
translation: 巴克斯托里安。

english: [player name].
translation: [player name]。

english: How are things?
translation: 近况如何？

english: The city is flourishing, largely thanks to you. There's still some mistrust for the Iorwerth clan, but overall I'd say it's been over a thousand years since our people were doing this well.
translation: 城市蓬勃发展，很大程度上多亏了你。对伊尔沃斯家族仍有一些不信任，但总的来说，我们人民已经有一千多年没有过得这么好了。

english: That's great to hear. What about you though?
translation: 听到这个太好了。不过你怎么样？

english: I still mourn Glarial every day, until the end of time a part of me will be missing, never to be replaced.
translation: 我仍然每天悼念格拉利尔，直到时间尽头，我的一部分将永远缺失，无法被取代。

english: But I know now that I can't let that impact the elves here. Many of them never even knew their former queen. My grief is mine alone, they need not bear it.
translation: 但我知道不能让这影响到这里的精灵。他们中许多人甚至从未见过他们的前女王。我的悲伤只属于我自己，他们无需承受。

english: To them, I'm trying my best to be a leader they deserve, to correct the mistakes of the past. Lord Iorwerth believed we were nothing without Seren. We need to prove that we have a future with her gone.
translation: 对他们而言，我正努力成为他们应得的领袖，纠正过去的错误。伊尔沃斯领主认为没有塞伦我们一无是处。我们需要证明即使她离开了，我们仍有未来。

english: Thankfully I have the other elders to help this time. Ruling is not as hard when you share out the responsiblities.
translation: 幸好这次有其他长老帮助。分担责任后，统治就不那么艰难了。

english: Well I'm glad to hear things are going well.
translation: 很高兴听到一切顺利。

english: And we are glad to have you here with us. None of this would have been possible without you.
translation: 我们也很高兴你与我们同在。没有你，这一切都不可能实现。

english: Are you alright?
translation: 你没事吧？

english: You may speak.
translation: 你可以说了。

english: Oh, yes yes, I'm fine.
translation: 哦，是是，我没事。

english: You look a little beat up.
translation: 你看起来有点狼狈。

english: These scratches? Don't worry, just a disagreement with a thorn bush.
translation: 这些划痕？别担心，只是和荆棘丛有点''分歧''。

english: Sure...
translation: 好吧……

english: Is there something you wanted, bloodbag?
translation: 你有什么事吗，血袋？

english: Just looking around.
translation: 只是四处看看。

english: Well, I'd prefer you did it elsewhere, Crombwick is busy entertaining his guests.
translation: 嗯，我建议你到别处去，克伦布威克正忙着招待客人。

english: Strange bunch of guests...
translation: 一群奇怪的客人……

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: What want you, with the Lord of the Kinshra? Speak!
translation: 你想干什么，金什拉领主？说！

english: Erm, nothing actually.
translation: 呃，其实没什么。

english: Then begone knave, before I have my Knights put you to the sword!
translation: 那就滚吧，无赖，别让我的骑士们把你砍了！

english: Greetings [player name].
translation: 你好，[player name]。

english: Hey Iestin. So they made you the new Lord Iorwerth?
translation: 嘿，伊斯廷。所以他们让你当新伊尔沃斯领主了？

english: Indeed. Apart from Morvran, I am the closest living relative of the previous Lord Iorwerth.
translation: 确实。除了莫夫兰，我是前任伊尔沃斯领主在世的最近亲属。

english: Did Morvran not want the role?
translation: 莫夫兰不想要这个职位吗？

english: No. That's probably for the best though. Morvran was very close to my predecessor. It would have made many uncomfortable if he had taken on the role.
translation: 不。不过那可能最好。莫夫兰与我的前任关系非常密切。如果他接任这个职位，会让很多人不舒服。

english: How have things been since the city was reformed?
translation: 城市改革后情况如何？

english: The others still hold a lot of mistrust for our clan. It will take a long time for those rifts to be repaired. We are on the right path though.
translation: 其他人对我们家族仍有很多不信任。这些裂痕需要很长时间才能修复。不过我们正走在正确的道路上。

english: That's good to hear. All the best.
translation: 听到这个很好。祝一切顺利。

english: Likewise.
translation: 彼此彼此。

english: Good day [player name]. Have you come to hear the song of the elves?
translation: 你好，[player name]。你是来听精灵之歌的吗？

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你什么意思？

english: Do you not hear it? The sounds of a city in harmony. It is the song of the elves, the story of our people.
translation: 你听不到吗？和谐之城的声音。这是精灵之歌，我们人民的故事。

english: The last few verses were dark and quiet, but now our city is restored, we find ourselves singing a new verse, one of joy and light.
translation: 最后几节黑暗而寂静，但现在我们的城市恢复了，我们发现自己正在唱新的一节，充满欢乐与光明。

english: I see. I guess I've never been the type to reflect on that sort of thing.
translation: 我明白了。我想我从来不是那种会反思这种事情的人。

english: More of a fighter? We have a song for that too. If you wish to sing it, head to the Gauntlet and put yourself to the test.
translation: 更像是个战士？我们也有那样的歌。如果你想唱，去试炼场考验自己吧。

english: I might just give it a shot. Thanks.
translation: 我可能会试试。谢谢。

english: Good day.
translation: 你好。

english: Sorry, can't stop to talk. So much to do, so little time.
translation: 抱歉，不能停下聊天。事情太多，时间太少。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 跟我说说你自己。

english: I am Kandur Hosidius and I am the lord of Hosidius, the city of farmers and chefs. I live here with my wife, Elena, and my two sons, Artur and Pandur.
translation: 我是坎杜尔‧霍西迪乌斯，霍西迪乌斯城的领主，这是农民和厨师之城。我和妻子埃琳娜以及两个儿子阿图尔和潘杜尔住在这里。

english: My family and I have a peaceful existence here. That's mainly because I care not for the politics of the other houses. I instead devote my time to more meaningful pursuits.
translation: 我和家人在这里过着平静的生活。这主要是因为我不在乎其他家族的政治。我把时间投入到更有意义的追求上。

english: Such as?
translation: 比如？

english: Ensuring that Kourend is well fed. We may live in gentle times now but who knows how long it will be that way. Sooner or later another war or long winter will hit us. History has proven that.
translation: 确保库兰德人民衣食无忧。我们现在可能生活在和平时期，但谁知道能持续多久。迟早会有另一场战争或漫长寒冬袭击我们。历史已经证明了这一点。

english: Anything else I can help you with?
translation: 还有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: Tell me about Hosidius.
translation: 跟我讲讲霍西迪乌斯城。

english: Hosidius is home to the farmers and chefs of Kourend. We are the main food supplier to the kingdom and we ensure that her people are fed.
translation: 霍西迪乌斯城是库兰德农民和厨师的家园。我们是王国的主要食物供应者，确保人民有饭吃。

english: We also own more land than the other Kourend houses. We need the extra space for all of our crops.
translation: 我们拥有的土地也比库兰德王国其他家族多。我们需要额外的空间种植所有作物。

english: Do the other houses not get annoyed at how much land you have?
translation: 其他家族不会对你拥有这么多土地感到恼火吗？

english: Sometimes. They know it is necessary though. There was once a time when the land was shared equally. But then the great famine came, and Kourend did not have the food to last through it.
translation: 有时会。但他们知道这是必要的。曾经有段时间土地是平等分配的。但后来大饥荒来了，库兰德王国没有足够的食物度过难关。

english: After that, more space was given to Hosidius. We've had the most land ever since.
translation: 之后，更多土地被划给了霍西迪乌斯城。从那以后我们拥有的土地最多。

english: Tell me about your plans.
translation: 跟我讲讲你的计划。

english: Plans? My only plan is to keep providing food to this kingdom.
translation: 计划？我唯一的计划就是继续为王国提供食物。

english: But what of the Royal Accord of Twill? You must have kept it for a reason.
translation: 但斜纹皇家协议呢？你一定有理由保留它。

english: I did. The Accord has the potential to be a powerful weapon, for words cut deeper than a blade ever can. However, I have no need to use this weapon, not unless the other houses give me reason to.
translation: 我保留了。协议有可能成为强大的武器，因为言语比刀剑更能伤人。然而，我不需要使用这个武器，除非其他家族给我理由。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Until next time.
translation: 下次见。

english: I assume you're after that reward I promised you. Here you go.
translation: 我想你是来拿我答应给你的奖励的。给你。

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 跟我说说你自己。

english: Tell me about Hosidius.
translation: 跟我讲讲霍西迪乌斯城。

english: Tell me about your plans.
translation: 跟我讲讲你的计划。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Good day!
translation: 你好！

english: Isn't it just!
translation: 可不是嘛！

english: What brings you down here?
translation: 什么风把你吹到这里来了？

english: This and that... But mostly, I'm looking for a good place to mobilise my army.
translation: 这个那个……但主要是，我在找个好地方调动军队。

english: That's awfully specific, you sure this is a good place for it?
translation: 这目的可真具体，你确定这是个好地方？

english: I don't see why not!
translation: 我看不出有什么不行！

english: I'm not sure there's enough land, to be honest.
translation: 老实说，我不确定这里有足够的土地。

english: Tish tosh! I'm importing sand from Al Kharid, there'll be a base camp here in no time, do not fret!
translation: 胡说八道！我从阿尔卡里德城进口沙子，很快就会在这里建好基地营，别担心！

english: Oh. Okay then.
translation: 哦。那好吧。

english: The tithes are growing weak. That werewolf needs to do a better job of keeping them fed.
translation: 什一税民越来越虚弱了。那个狼人需要更好地养活他们。

english: What do you feed them?
translation: 你喂他们什么？

english: There's no shortage of corpses around here. The dead can still have some uses.
translation: 这里尸体不缺。死人还能有点用处。

english: You're feeding them corpses? No wonder they're becoming weak. That meat must have all sorts of problems.
translation: 你喂他们尸体？难怪他们越来越虚弱。那肉肯定有各种问题。

english: What else would you have me feed them? If I give them nicer food, I'm wasting more money than if I were to just kill them and buy some more.
translation: 不然你让我喂他们什么？如果我给他们更好的食物，我浪费的钱比直接杀了他们再买新的还多。

english: I... I suppose.
translation: 我……我想也是。

english: Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: 人类！在我叫守卫之前滚回奴隶栏去！

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Hello there young one. Interested in getting your hands dirty?
translation: 你好，年轻人。有兴趣弄脏你的手吗？

english: Err... maybe?
translation: 呃……也许？

english: Ah don't worry, it's nothing sinister. We leave that kind of thing to clan Iorwerth. I speak in a more literal sense, of the ground beneath us and the trees over us.
translation: 啊别担心，不是什么邪恶的事。那种事我们留给伊尔沃斯家族。我说的是字面意思，脚下的土地和头顶的树木。

english: Oh, I see. So it's your clan that looks after the plants of the city?
translation: 哦，我明白了。所以是你们家族负责照顾城市的植物？

english: Indeed. We maintain the farms and manage the trees. The produce we grow goes to the Meilyr clan to feed the city and the wood we provide is used by the Ithell clan in construction.
translation: 确实。我们维护农场和管理树木。我们种植的农产品交给梅利尔家族供养城市，我们提供的木材由伊塞尔家族用于建筑。

english: Feel free to join us. Our farming patches are open to you, as is our sawmill.
translation: 欢迎加入我们。我们的农田和锯木厂都对你开放。

english: Awesome, thank you.
translation: 太好了，谢谢。

english: How goes it, friend?
translation: 近来如何，朋友？

english: I stole the Ring of Charos from Fenkenstrain.
translation: 我从芬肯斯特莱恩那里偷来了查罗斯之戒。

english: I saw him climb up into the Tower to hide it. It doesn't matter - soon the werewolves will come for him, and his experiments will be forever ceased.
translation: 我看见他爬上塔楼把它藏起来。没关系——很快狼人就会来找他，他的实验将永远停止。

english: Do you want the ring back? It is yours after all.
translation: 你想把戒指拿回去吗？它毕竟是你的。

english: No, you keep it, my friend. Werewolves hunger for the scent of live flesh - I have no need for the ring. I have my castle back, if not my soul.
translation: 不，你留着吧，我的朋友。狼人渴望活肉的气味——我不需要戒指。我夺回了城堡，虽然没能夺回灵魂。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 跟我说说你自己。

english: Well citizen, you are speaking to Lord Shiro Shayzien. I am the ruler of Shayzien and the commander-in-chief of the Shayzien Army.
translation: 市民你好，你正在和希罗‧谢兹恩城领主说话。我是谢兹恩城的统治者，也是谢兹恩城卫军的总司令。

english: How long have you held this position?
translation: 你担任这个职位多久了？

english: Since my father passed away four years ago. He was a good man who took the defence of Kourend very seriously. I have been working hard to continue his legacy.
translation: 自从我父亲四年前去世以来。他是个好人，非常重视库兰德王国的防御。我一直在努力继承他的遗志。

english: Anything else I can help you with citizen?
translation: 市民，还有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: Tell me about Shayzien.
translation: 跟我讲讲谢兹恩城。

english: Most citizens of Shayzien are part of the Shayzien Army in some form or other. We are responsible for defending Kourend against external and internal threats.
translation: 大多数谢兹恩城市民都以某种形式属于谢兹恩城卫军。我们负责保卫库兰德王国免受外部和内部威胁。

english: What are the current threats against Kourend?
translation: 目前库兰德王国面临哪些威胁？

english: Externally, we have recently beingdealing with increased lizardman activity. We've also been keeping a close eye on Varlamore to the south, just in case they try anything.
translation: 外部方面，我们最近一直在应对蜥蜴人活动增加的问题。我们也一直在密切关注南方的瓦拉莫尔王国，以防他们有什么举动。

english: Internally, we have seen a rise in gang crime across the kingdom. It seems to be especially prevalent in Port Piscarilius.
translation: 内部方面，我们看到整个王国的帮派犯罪有所上升。似乎在皮斯卡里琉斯港尤为普遍。

english: How do you tackle these issues?
translation: 你们如何应对这些问题？

english: By doing what we do best citizen. There's no threat that can't be defeated by a Shayzien soldier with a sword in their hand.
translation: 做我们最擅长的事，市民。没有什么威胁是谢兹恩城士兵手持利剑无法击败的。

english: Tell me about your plans.
translation: 跟我讲讲你的计划。

english: Our war plans? I'm afraid most of that is confidential.
translation: 我们的战争计划？恐怕大部分是机密的。

english: What I can tell you is that our main focus right now is the lizardman threat. We've moved a great number of troops into the Kebos Lowlands to combat the issue.
translation: 我能告诉你的是，我们目前的主要重点是蜥蜴人威胁。我们已经派遣大量军队进入凯博斯低地应对这个问题。

english: Is that going well?
translation: 进展顺利吗？

english: Absolutely, we've pushed the lizardmen back to the point where we're finally able to allow citizens such as yourself into the region.
translation: 当然，我们已经把蜥蜴人逼退到终于能让像你这样的市民进入该地区的程度。

english: Apart from the lizardman, we are also preparing to support the King in the hunt for his father's killer. Once we know who they are, they will face the full might of the Shayzien Army.
translation: 除了蜥蜴人，我们也在准备支持国王追捕杀父仇人。一旦我们知道他们是谁，他们将面对谢兹恩城卫军的全部力量。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Farewell citizen.
translation: 再见，市民。

english: Can't talk right now citizen. I'm very busy.
translation: 现在不能聊天，市民。我很忙。

english: Here citizen. Your reward for helping with the expedition.
translation: 给你，市民。这是你帮助探险的奖励。

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 跟我说说你自己。

english: Tell me about Shayzien.
translation: 跟我讲讲谢兹恩城。

english: Tell me about your plans.
translation: 跟我讲讲你的计划。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Good day friend.
translation: 你好，朋友。

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 跟我说说你自己。

english: I am Trobin Arceuus, lord of Arceuus. It's a position I've held for a thousand years, ever since the Ascent of Arceuus.
translation: 我是特罗宾‧阿西乌斯，阿西乌斯领主。这个职位我已经担任了一千年，自从阿西乌斯崛起以来。

english: That's a long time. I guess you've seen quite a bit.
translation: 那是很长时间。我想你见过不少事。

english: Indeed. I've been present at some of the most notable moments in Kourend's history.
translation: 确实。我亲历过库兰德王国历史上一些最重大的时刻。

english: I was there when King Agata IV was deposed, I was there when Kharedst the Builder opened Kourend Castle and I was there when Emperor Imafore was executed.
translation: 阿加塔四世国王被废黜时我在场，建筑者卡雷德斯特开启库兰德城堡时我在场，伊马福尔皇帝被处决时我也在场。

english: I tend to keep out of public affairs these days though. My presence is often more of a distraction than a benefit. It also means I can focus on my work in peace.
translation: 不过这些天我倾向于远离公共事务。我的存在往往弊大于利。这也意味着我可以安心专注于我的工作。

english: Your work?
translation: 你的工作？

english: The freeing of souls. There are many souls that find themselves trapped here after death. My people and I do our best to release them.
translation: 解放灵魂。有许多灵魂死后发现自己被困在这里。我和我的人民尽力释放他们。

english: Tell me about Arceuus.
translation: 跟我讲讲阿西乌斯城。

english: If you find something magical in Kourend, chances are it came from Arceuus. Our people have lived for a thousand years. The knowledge we've gained in that time has resulted in many a magical discovery.
translation: 如果你在库兰德王国发现什么魔法物品，很可能来自阿西乌斯。我们的人民已经生活了一千年。那段时间我们获得的知识促成了许多魔法发现。

english: Most of our discoveries start with the Dark Altar. It is the source of our immortality and our people dedicate their lives to studying it.
translation: 我们的大多数发现都始于黑暗祭坛。它是我们不朽的源泉，我们的人民毕生致力于研究它。

english: Our people also serves an important role in the wider world. We work to free trapped souls so that they may pass on to the next world. It is a crucial task that the Dark Altar helps us to perform.
translation: 我们的人民在更广阔的世界中也扮演着重要角色。我们努力释放被困的灵魂，使他们能够前往下一个世界。这是黑暗祭坛帮助我们完成的关键任务。

english: Was the Dark Altar always here?
translation: 黑暗祭坛一直在这里吗？

english: Impossible to say. The Dark Altar has been mentioned in records dating back to the earliest days of Kourend. Before then, who knows.
translation: 无法确定。早在库兰德王国最初的日子里，记录中就提到了黑暗祭坛。在此之前，谁知道呢。

english: You weren't around back then?
translation: 那你那时候不在吗？

english: No. The Ascent of Arceuus didn't occur until after Xeric's Age of Strife, hundreds of years after Kourend was formed.
translation: 不在。阿西乌斯崛起直到泽里克的纷争时代之后才发生，那是库兰德王国形成数百年后的事了。

english: Tell me about the Ascent of Arceuus.
translation: 跟我讲讲阿西乌斯城崛起。

english: It was a thousand years ago, during the time of King Byrne II. I went to my people and shared the secrets of immortality with them.
translation: 那是一千年前，拜恩二世国王时期。我找到我的人民，与他们分享了不朽的秘密。

english: Not all of them accepted this gift of course, as was their right. Those that did, were granted new bodies to house their souls. These bodies are sustained by the Dark Altar.
translation: 当然，不是所有人都接受了这份礼物，这是他们的权利。那些接受的人获得了新的身体来容纳他们的灵魂。这些身体由黑暗祭坛维持。

english: It wasn't you that discovered this secret though was it?
translation: 但这个秘密不是你发现的，对吧？

english: No. It was granted to us by the Tasakaal. They are ancient beings, ones that make us seem like mere children.
translation: 不是。是塔萨卡尔授予我们的。他们是古老的生物，让我们显得如同孩童一般。

english: Their age and experience have granted them knowledge over life and death that we can only dream of.
translation: 他们的年龄和经历赋予了他们对生死的知识，那是我们只能梦想的。

english: The Tasakaal don't like you very much. They called you a liar and claimed you misused the knowledge.
translation: 塔萨卡尔不太喜欢你。他们称你为骗子，声称你滥用了这些知识。

english: The events that led to the Ascent of Arceuus are more complicated than even the Tasakaal know. But that is a story for another day.
translation: 导致阿西乌斯城崛起的事件比塔萨卡尔所知的还要复杂。但那是另一天的故事了。

english: Tell me about your plans.
translation: 跟我讲讲你的计划。

english: I had one of my people recover the remains of that device. The one that was absorbing the Dark Altars power.
translation: 我让我的人回收了那个装置的残骸。就是那个吸收黑暗祭坛力量的装置。

english: We're performing tests to see if we can learn more about it. We haven't made any meaningful progress yet though.
translation: 我们正在进行测试，看能否了解更多关于它的信息。不过我们还没有取得任何有意义的进展。

english: Once we've learnt more about it, we'll be in a better position to determine our next move.
translation: 一旦我们了解更多，我们将能更好地确定下一步行动。

english: I admit, the idea of someone sabotaging the Altar is more than a bit concerning. I hope we can make some progress soon.
translation: 我承认，有人破坏祭坛的想法让人非常担忧。我希望我们能尽快取得一些进展。

english: Now that we know Xamphur was responsible for the device that was absorbing power from the Dark Altar, we're hoping we can use it to help locate him.
translation: 既然我们知道扎姆弗尔负责那个从黑暗祭坛吸收力量的装置，我们希望能用它来帮助定位他。

english: Alas, so far we've had no luck. We're also scanning for energy that matches what we observed during that earthquake he caused, but again, nothing has been discovered so far.
translation: 唉，到目前为止我们还没有运气。我们也在扫描与他造成的地震期间我们观察到的能量相匹配的能量，但同样，到目前为止还没有发现什么。

english: It seems this work will take time. I assure you though, we will find him and his master.
translation: 看来这项工作需要时间。不过我向你保证，我们会找到他和他的主人。

english: What about that Pyromancer?
translation: 那个火术士呢？

english: We've begun an investigation into their order, but we have little to go on. Hopefully we find a good lead soon.
translation: 我们已经开始调查他们的教团，但我们几乎没有线索。希望我们很快能找到好的线索。

english: Well just let me know if you need my help.
translation: 如果需要我的帮助，告诉我。

english: I will, thank you.
translation: 我会的，谢谢。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Farewell.
translation: 告辞。

english: Thank you for helping our people. Please accept these gifts, they are the least you deserve.
translation: 感谢你帮助我们的人民。请接受这些礼物，这是你应得的最低回报。

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 跟我说说你自己。

english: Tell me about Arceuus.
translation: 跟我讲讲阿西乌斯城。

english: Tell me about the Ascent of Arceuus.
translation: 跟我讲讲阿西乌斯城崛起。

english: Tell me about your plans.
translation: 跟我讲讲你的计划。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Hello! I'm Lorelai. Welcome to the Warriors' Guild basement!
translation: 你好！我是洛蕾莱。欢迎来到战士公会地下室！

english: What are you doing down here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: I'm training this group of special Cyclopes to be stronger and more powerful for Kamfreena.
translation: 我正在训练这群特殊的独眼巨人，让他们为卡姆弗里纳变得更强大。

english: What's special about these Cyclopes?
translation: 这些独眼巨人有什么特别之处？

english: They have a chance of dropping a new, more powerful defender. Kamfreena doesn't want just anyone getting their hands on one so she moved them down here and tasked me with training them.
translation: 他们有机会掉落一种新的、更强大的格挡匕首。卡姆弗里纳不希望随便什么人得到它，所以她把她们移到这里，让我负责训练他们。

english: With a punishing routine of combat, fighting and the odd death!
translation: 用惩罚性的战斗、格斗和偶尔的死亡训练！

english: So, you just let them fight each other and hope they get stronger?
translation: 所以，你就让他们互相战斗，希望他们变强？

english: Of course not, that would just be cruel! Kamfreena and I only allow the most worthy of adventurers to fight these cyclopes.
translation: 当然不是，那太残忍了！卡姆弗里纳和我只允许最值得的冒险者与这些独眼巨人战斗。

english: I am a mighty adventurer! Can I fight them?
translation: 我是强大的冒险者！我能和他们战斗吗？

english: You'll need to display your skills as a Warrior before I can allow you to enter the room.
translation: 在我允许你进入房间之前，你需要展示你作为战士的技能。

english: How can I do that?
translation: 我该怎么做到？

english: Bring me a Rune Defender and I shall unlock the door for you, this shows me you have dedicated enough time to fighting the Cyclops upstairs.
translation: 给我带一个符石格挡匕首来，我会为你打开门，这向我证明你已经花了足够的时间在楼上与独眼巨人战斗。

english: I have a Rune Defender here, please let me in!
translation: 我这里有一个符石格挡匕首，请让我进去！

english: And the Wise Old Man is my Dad... come back when you have the Rune Defender!
translation: 那睿智老人还是我爸呢……等你有了符石格挡匕首再来！

english: Very well, I've unlocked the door but you'll still need 100 tokens from upstairs before you can enter as well as 10 for every minute you want to stay inside. Have fun in there!
translation: 很好，我已经打开门了，但你仍然需要从楼上获得100个令牌才能进入，而且你想在里面待多久，每分钟需要10个令牌。玩得开心！

english: Yes, you have already proved yourself to me, the door is unlocked.
translation: 是的，你已经向我证明了你自己，门已经打开了。

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！

english: See you around.
translation: 回头见。

english: I see you have a worthy defender! I'll release some cyclops to help you get an upgrade. They are quite mean and strong though...
translation: 我看你有一个值得拥有的格挡匕首！我会释放一些独眼巨人帮你升级。不过他们相当凶狠强壮……

english: You've already proved yourself to me, the door is unlocked.
translation: 你已经向我证明了你自己，门已经打开了。

english: Congratulations you've found a Dragon defender! You're welcome to go back inside and try to get more.
translation: 恭喜你找到了龙格挡匕首！欢迎你回去再试试获取更多。

english: Your time is up, please make your way to the exit.
translation: 你的时间到了，请前往出口。

english: Next time, please leave as soon as your time is up.
translation: 下次，时间一到请立即离开。

english: You must keep your attack skillcape or max cape equipped to stay in the area.
translation: 你必须装备攻击技能斗篷或至尊斗篷才能留在该区域。

english: May I claim my tokens please?
translation: 我可以领取我的令牌吗？

english: You don't have space to carry them.
translation: 你没有空间携带它们。

english: What's special about these Cyclopes?

english: I can't believe we've finally arrived, I can't wait to explore!
translation: 我真不敢相信我们终于到了，我迫不及待想探索！

english: So much to see, I don't know where to start!
translation: 太多东西可看了，我不知道从哪里开始！

english: A whole new continent to explore... what a time to be

english: Are you the tour guide?

translation: 不是，我和你一样迷路了。

translation: 我看到了！不幸的是它似乎昨天就过期了！没关系。

translation: 抱歉，我无能为力。

translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: I'm far too upset to talk to random people right now.
translation: 我现在太心烦了，不想和陌生人说话。

english: Thank you for all your help in solving the murder.
translation: 感谢你帮助解决谋杀案。

english: Hello again. How are you?
translation: 又见面了。你好吗？

english: What's that? How do I chew? With my teeth of course. You humans are odd.
translation: 那是什么？我怎么咀嚼？当然是用牙齿。你们人类真奇怪。

english: No, no I said HOW ARE YOU?
translation: 不，不，我是说你——好——吗？

english: No need to shout, I'm not deaf. I'm good thank you.
translation: 不用喊，我不聋。我很好，谢谢。

english: Here you go.
translation: 给，拿好。

english: Hey, I have something for you but you don't have any space for it!
translation: 嘿，我有东西给你，但你没有空间放！

english: Welcome to Lowe's Archery Emporium. Do you want to see my wares?
translation: 欢迎来到洛氏弓箭店。你想看看我的商品吗？

english: I have this voucher for completing the combat Adventure Path, it says to come talk to you about claiming my Adventure Path reward.
translation: 我有这个完成战斗冒险之路的凭证，上面说要来找你领取冒险之路奖励。

english: I will be able to give you your reward when you have some space for it.
translation: 等你有空间时我才能给你奖励。

english: Why yes, here are some high-quality iron arrows.
translation: 当然，这里有一些高品质铁箭。

english: I do have more rewards for you, but you need to be on a members world for me to give you the reward. Maybe there is something else I can help you with.
translation: 我确实还有更多奖励给你，但你需要在会员世界我才能给你奖励。也许有其他我能帮你的。

english: Since you are a member, I'll also give you extra arrows and one of my finest bows.
translation: 既然你是会员，我还会给你额外的箭和我最好的弓之一。

english: I sell a variety of range equipment in my shop if you wanted to take a look.
translation: 如果你想看看，我店里卖各种远程装备。

english: Is there anything else I can do for you?
translation: 还有什么我能为你做的吗？

english: I do have more rewards for you, but you need some free space for me to give you the rewards.

english: Can I help you with anything else?

translation: 当然，这是我最好的弓之一和一些高品质铁箭。

translation: 不，我更喜欢近身砸东西。

english: Humph, philistine.

english: Here you go!

english: Watch where you're going, young whippersnapper!
translation: 看着点路，小毛孩！

english: I wasn't going anywhere...
translation: 我哪儿也没去……

english: Well then go away from here!
translation: 那就离开这里！

english: What's a whippersnapper?
translation: 什么是小毛孩？

english: It's a whip. Which snaps. Like me. Now leave!
translation: 是一种鞭子。会啪啪响。就像我。现在走开！

english: I am Lubufu - the only fisherman who knows the secret of the Karambwan!
translation: 我是卢布富——唯一知道卡拉姆班鱼秘密的渔夫！

english: What's a Karambwan?
translation: 什么是卡拉姆班鱼？

english: What a foolish question! Now leave!
translation: 多愚蠢的问题！现在走开！

english: I said go away!
translation: 我说走开！

english: Ok, I'm going...

english: You deceived me you confoundering dolt! Because of you, my entire business is ruined! Get out of my sight!
translation: 你欺骗了我，你这个该死的蠢货！因为你，我的整个生意都毁了！滚出我的视线！

english: I wasn't going anywhere...
translation: 我哪儿也没去……

english: What's a whippersnapper?
translation: 什么是小毛孩？

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Hello. A fine day for stealing, wouldn't you say?
translation: 你好。偷东西的好天气，你不觉得吗？

english: I suppose so, just as long as you're not planning to steal from me.
translation: 我想也是，只要你不打算偷我的就行。

english: *whistle*
translation: 吹口哨

english: I could do with some information on houses.
translation: 我需要一些关于房子的信息。

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: I thought I killed you?!
translation: 我以为我杀了你？！

english: Ha! Ha! Ha!
translation: 哈！哈！哈！

english: You can not kill me human!
translation: 你杀不了我，人类！

english: I've lost the pendant you gave me.
translation: 我把你给我的吊坠弄丢了。

english: Have another, it will remind you of my power!
translation: 再拿一个，它会让你想起我的力量！

english: Hello, I wonder if you could help me on this whole brewing thing...
translation: 你好，我想知道你能否在酿酒这件事上帮我……

english: I might be able to - what do you need to know?
translation: 我可能可以——你需要知道什么？

english: How do I brew ales?
translation: 我怎么酿造麦芽酒？

english: Well first off you need to fill the vat with water - two bucketfuls should do the trick. Then you'll need to put in two handfuls of barley malt - that's roasted barley by the way.
translation: 首先你需要用水装满大桶——两桶就够了。然后你需要放入两把大麦麦芽——顺便说一下，那是烤过的大麦。

english: After that you'll be putting your main ingredient in - this will decide which ale it is you're brewing. There should be some good guides around with recipes in.
translation: 之后你会放入主要原料——这将决定你酿造的是哪种麦芽酒。周围应该有一些带有配方的好指南。

english: Lastly you pour a pot full of ale yeast in, which'll start it off fermenting. Then all you have to do is wait for the good stuff.
translation: 最后你倒入一壶麦芽酒酵母，这会开始发酵。然后你要做的就是等待美酒出炉。

english: How do I brew cider?
translation: 我怎么酿造苹果酒？

english: First you'll need some apples. You'll need to crush them using this cider-press - four apples should make a full bucket of apple-mush. Take four buckets of mush and fill up the vat.
translation: 首先你需要一些苹果。你需要用这个苹果压榨机把它们压碎——四个苹果应该能压满一桶苹果泥。取四桶苹果泥装满大桶。

english: After that you pour a pot full of ale yeast in, which'll start it off fermenting. Then all you have to do is wait for the good stuff.
translation: 之后你倒入一壶麦芽酒酵母，这会开始发酵。然后你要做的就是等待美酒出炉。

english: What do I do once my ale has matured?
translation: 我的麦芽酒成熟后我该做什么？

english: Well, once you've got a full vat of the good stuff, just turn the valve and your barrel will fill up with eight pints of whatever your chosen tipple is. Mind it's an empty barrel, though.
translation: 嗯，一旦你有一大桶美酒，只需转动阀门，你的酒桶就会装满八品脱你选择的酒。不过要注意，得是空桶。

english: Do you have any spare ale yeast?
translation: 你有多余的麦芽酒酵母吗？

english: Well, as a matter of fact I do, although I wouldn't describe it as spare. This ale yeast I've got is the best money can buy, but if you've got a pot I'll fill it for you for 25GP - very cheap as it happens.
translation: 嗯，事实上我有，虽然我不会说它是多余的。我有的这种麦芽酒酵母是花钱能买到的最好的，但如果你有个壶，我可以25金币帮你装满——碰巧很便宜。

english: I don't have an empty pot, or enough money I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕我没有空壶，也没有足够的钱。

english: That's all I need to know, thanks.
translation: 我知道这些就够了，谢谢。

translation: 嗨！我是露西。欢迎来到派对室！

translation: 露西，请来一杯啤酒！

english: Coming right up! That's two gold please.
translation: 马上来！请付两枚金币。

english: I'm sorry but I don't have enough money!
translation: 抱歉但我没有足够的钱！

translation: 马上来 [sir/ma'am]！作为生日派对的一部分，你前2杯啤酒免费！

english: Lucy has given you a beer.
translation: 露西给了你一杯啤酒。

english: You have 1 free beer left from either me or Megan!
translation: 你还剩1杯免费啤酒，可以从我或梅根那里领取！

translation: 那是你最后一杯免费啤酒 [username]！

english: Hey! Welcome to our shipyard. If you need anything, just check in with Seb outside. He'll help you out.
translation: 嘿！欢迎来到我们的造船厂。如果你需要什么，去找外面的塞布登记。他会帮你的。

english: Will do, thanks.

english: Hello.

english: Good day. What are you doing?
translation: 你好。你在做什么？

english: I'm cutting down maple trees for their wood. It's a living.
translation: 我在砍枫树取木材。这是谋生之道。

english: Good luck with that.

english: Thanks.

english: Good day, Your Royal Highness.

english: Can you tell me how the kingdom approves of me?

english: [amount]% of people approve of you.

english: The storerooms are full, your Highness. You should talk to Advisor Ghrim to collect what we've gathered for you.
translation: 储藏室已满，殿下。请去找顾问格里姆领取我们为你收集的物资。

translation: 我想今晚我要吃点牛肉。

translation: 我把你给我的护符弄丢了。

english: Not to worry. I found it again.
translation: 别担心。我又找到了。

translation: 不过，在我给你之前，你需要腾出空间。

english: Thanks. I'll try not to lose it this time.
translation: 谢谢。这次我会尽量不弄丢。

english: Any time.

english: Greetings, adventurer. I am Phileas, the Lumbridge Guide. I am here to give information and directions to new players. Is there anything I can help you with?
translation: 你好，冒险者。我是菲利亚斯，仑桥镇向导。我在这里为新玩家提供信息和指引。有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: Where can I find a quest to go on?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到任务？

english: I'm afraid I can't think of any more quests for you. Don't worry though, there'll be plenty more out there. You'll just need to find them.
translation: 恐怕我想不出更多任务给你了。不过别担心，外面还有很多。你只需要找到它们。

english: Is there anything else you need help with?
translation: 还有什么你需要帮助的吗？

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Well, I've heard my friend the cook is in need of a spot of help. He'll be in the kitchen of this here castle. Just talk to him and he'll set you off.
translation: 嗯，我听说我的朋友厨师需要点帮助。他就在这座城堡的厨房里。和他谈谈，他会给你安排任务。

english: Well, I heard that Father Aereck could use a hand. You'll find him in the church just here. Talk to him and he'll give you the details.
translation: 嗯，我听说艾瑞克神父需要帮手。你就在这里的教堂里能找到他。和他谈谈，他会告诉你详情。

english: Well, I heard that a chap called Veos needs help finding some treasure. Last I heard, he was looking for assistance in the pub just north of here. Talk to him and see if you can help.
translation: 嗯，我听说一个叫维奥斯的人需要帮助寻找宝藏。我上次听说，他在这里北边的酒馆里寻找帮助。和他谈谈，看看你能否帮忙。

english: Well, I heard that Farmer Fred could use some help. You'll find him on the farm just north of here. Talk to him and see if he needs a hand.
translation: 嗯，我听说农夫弗雷德需要些帮助。你就在这里北边的农场上能找到他。和他谈谈，看看他是否需要帮手。

english: Well, I heard there was some commotion in the swamp to the south. Might be worth looking into.
translation: 嗯，我听说南边的沼泽里有些骚动。可能值得去看看。

english: Well, I believe the Duke of Lumbridge requires an errand running for him. You can find him upstairs in the castle. Just talk to him to get the details.
translation: 嗯，我相信仑桥镇公爵需要有人帮他跑腿。你可以在城堡楼上找到他。和他谈谈就能了解详情。

translation: 我听说你已经在帮助维奥斯了。你确定需要另一个任务吗？

translation: 我听说你已经在帮助农夫弗雷德了。你确定需要另一个任务吗？

english: I heard you were already investigating the issue in the swamp. Are you sure you need another quest?
translation: 我听说你已经在调查沼泽里的问题了。你确定需要另一个任务吗？

english: I heard you were already helping the Duke. Are you sure you need another quest?
translation: 我听说你已经在帮助公爵了。你确定需要另一个任务吗？

translation: 我想要另一个任务。

translation: 我应该和什么怪物战斗？

english: It's going to be tough fighting monsters without a weapon. I suggest you find one of those first.
translation: 没有武器和怪物战斗会很艰难。我建议你先找一个。

english: How can I get a weapon?
translation: 我怎么才能得到武器？

english: Well you can either make them, find them or buy them.
translation: 嗯，你可以制作、找到或购买它们。

english: Where can I find a weapon?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到武器？

english: too.
translation: 也是。

english: I'd like to know about something else.
translation: 我想了解别的事情。

english: Well, what would you like to know?
translation: 嗯，你想了解什么？

english: How do I make a weapon?
translation: 我怎么制作武器？

english: You already have a reasonable Smithing level, so I think you know that already.
translation: 你已经有不错的锻造等级了，所以我想你已经知道了。

english: The Smithing skill allows you to make armour and weapons. Talk to the boy who smelts metal in the furnace, I'm sure he can help.
translation: 锻造技能让你可以制作装备和武器。和熔炉旁熔炼金属的男孩谈谈，我相信他能帮忙。

english: Where can I smith?
translation: 我在哪里可以锻造？

english: You will find a helpful Smithing tutor in the west of Varrock - that's north of here. Follow the path across the river and head north.
translation: 你可以在维洛克城西部找到一位有用的锻造导师——就在这里北边。沿着小路过河向北走。

english: I suggest you go and mine some ore; find the Mining symbol - with the guide symbol near it - in the swamp south of here. The Mining guide there can teach you how to mine ore.
translation: 我建议你去挖些矿石；在这里南边的沼泽里找到采矿符号——旁边有向导符号——那里的采矿向导可以教你怎么挖矿。

translation: 如果战斗导师认为你需要，你可以免费从他们那里得到武器。不行的话，最近会卖那种东西的商店就是这个镇上的鲍勃精品斧店。如果你想要更多

english: choice I suggest you head to one of the big cities. If you follow the road east over the bridge and then head north you will eventually reach Varrock, where you can buy all manner of things. You can use the world map
translation: 选择，我建议你去大城市之一。如果你沿着东边的路过桥然后向北走，最终会到达维洛克城，在那里你可以买到各种东西。你可以使用世界地图

english: to help you find your way.
translation: 帮你找到路。

english: Could I get a staff like yours?
translation: 我能得到一根像你这样的法杖吗？

english: There is no other staff like this in all the land. It's a very important staff. It shows who holds the job as the Lumbridge Guide, and that's me.
translation: 整个大陆没有别的法杖像这个。这是非常重要的法杖。它显示谁担任仑桥镇向导的职位，那就是我。

english: Yes, but what should I fight once I have got a weapon?
translation: 是的，但我有了武器后应该和什么战斗？

english: There's lots of beasts to fight in the woods around here, especially to the west. There are certainly some goblins and spiders that are pests and could do with being cleared out. There's also a chicken farm or two up the
translation: 这周围的森林里有很多野兽可以战斗，尤其是西边。肯定有一些哥布林和蜘蛛是害虫，可以清理一下。沿路往上还有一两个养鸡场

english: road for some fairly easy pickings. Non-player characters usually appear as yellow dots on your minimap, although there are some that you won't be able to fight, such as myself. A monster's combat level is
translation: 可以相当轻松地收获。非玩家角色通常在你的小地图上显示为黄点，虽然有些你无法与之战斗，比如我自己。怪物的战斗等级

english: shown next to their 'Attack' option. If that level is coloured green it means the monster is weaker than you. If it is red, it means that the monster is tougher than you.
translation: 显示在他们的''攻击''选项旁边。如果那个等级是绿色的，意味着怪物比你弱。如果是红色的，意味着怪物比你强。

english: Remember, you will do better if you have better armour and weapons and it's always worth carrying a bit of food to heal yourself.
translation: 记住，如果你有更好的装备和武器，你会表现得更好，而且带点食物治疗自己总是值得的。

english: Where can I get food to heal myself?
translation: 我在哪里可以得到食物治疗自己？

english: There are many different foods in the game such as cabbage, fish, meat and many more. Which do you wish to hear about?
translation: 游戏中有许多不同的食物，如卷心菜、鱼、肉等等。你想听哪个？

english: How do I get cabbages?
translation: 我怎么得到卷心菜？

english: There is a field a little distance to the north of here packed full of cabbages which are there for the picking.
translation: 在这里北边不远处有一片田地，种满了卷心菜，可以随意采摘。

english: You could also farm your own cabbages; there's a Farming patch just south of Falador.
translation: 你也可以自己种卷心菜；法拉多城南边就有一块农田。

english: No thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: How do I fish?
translation: 我怎么钓鱼？

english: I am confused. You are already an experienced fisher. You should know the answer to that already.
translation: 我很困惑。你已经是经验丰富的渔夫了。你应该已经知道答案了。

english: Fishing spots require different levels and equipment to use. To start Fishing, you'll want to talk to the Fishing tutor who can be found in the swamps south of here. He will also give you a small fishing net if you don't
translation: 钓鱼点需要不同的等级和装备才能使用。要开始钓鱼，你应该和在这里南边沼泽里找到的钓鱼导师谈谈。如果你没有

english: own one already.
translation: 他已经会给你一个小渔网。

english: Where could I find one of those?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到那种东西？

english: You can get them from a Fishing shop or our Fishing Tutor south of here in the swamp. There is a Fishing shop in Port Sarim; you can find it on the world map. Port Sarim is some way to the west of here, beyond
translation: 你可以从钓鱼店或我们在这里南边沼泽里的钓鱼导师那里得到。沙林港有一家钓鱼店；你可以在世界地图上找到它。沙林港在这里西边一段距离，经过

english: the village of Draynor.
translation: 德雷诺村。

english: Where can I find meat?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到肉？

english: I suggest you go and kill some chickens. The roads on either side of this river eventually go past a chicken farm. When you have killed some chickens, cook them. You could either make a fire or use a range.
translation: 我建议你去杀些鸡。这条河两边的路最终都会经过一个养鸡场。当你杀了一些鸡后，把它们煮熟。你可以生火或使用炉灶。

english: There is a range at the southern end in this town and a Cooking tutor in south Lumbridge near Bob's Brilliant Axes shop.
translation: 这个镇南端有一个炉灶，南仑桥镇鲍勃精品斧店附近有一个烹饪导师。

english: Well, you can make them, buy them or talk to the combat tutors just west of here.
translation: 嗯，你可以制作、购买或和这里西边的战斗导师谈谈。

english: Okay, thanks, I will go and kill things.
translation: 好的，谢谢，我去杀东西了。

english: Can I kill other players?
translation: 我能杀其他玩家吗？

english: Well, you can go to the Wilderness. That is the area for killing other players. Just keep heading north and eventually you will be bound to reach it. Be very careful, though. Player-killing is not for the unprepared.
translation: 嗯，你可以去荒野。那是杀其他玩家的地方。一直向北走，最终你一定会到达那里。不过要小心。玩家击杀不适合毫无准备的人。

english: I'd suggest that you leave any items you don't want to lose in the bank and take a good supply of food with you.
translation: 我建议你把自己不想丢失的任何物品留在银行，并带上充足的食物。

english: You're strong enough to work out what monsters to fight for yourself now, but the combat tutors might help you with any questions you have about the skills; they're just over there to the south of the general store.
translation: 你现在已经足够强大，可以自己决定和什么怪物战斗，但战斗导师可能会帮你解答关于技能的任何问题；他们就在杂货店南边那里。

english: Where can I make money?
translation: 我在哪里可以赚钱？

english: There are many ways to make money in the game. I would suggest either killing monsters or doing a trade skill such as Smithing or Fishing.
translation: 游戏中有很多赚钱的方法。我建议要么杀怪物，要么做贸易技能，如锻造或钓鱼。

english: Please don't try to get money by begging off other players. It will make you unpopular. Nobody likes a beggar. It is very irritating to have other players asking for your hard-earned cash.
translation: 请不要试图通过向其他玩家乞讨来赚钱。这会让你不受欢迎。没人喜欢乞丐。其他玩家向你讨要你辛苦赚来的钱是很烦人的。

english: Where can I find more information?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到更多信息？

english: What you'll want is the OSRS Wiki! I've taken the liberty of opening the useful links section of the account management tab for you. Here you can find a link to the wiki. There's information and guides on almost
translation: 你想要的是 OSRS Wiki！我已经擅自为你打开了账户管理标签的有用链接部分。在这里你可以找到 wiki 的链接。几乎

english: everything, all easily searched and it's even written and maintained by players.
translation: 所有事情的信息和指南都有，都很容易搜索，甚至是由玩家编写和维护的。

english: I'd like to know more about security.
translation: 我想了解更多关于安全的信息。

english: First I must warn you to take every precaution to keep your RuneScape password and PIN secure. The most important thing to remember is to never give your password to, or share your account with, anyone.
translation: 首先我必须警告你要采取一切预防措施保护你的 RuneScape 密码和 PIN 安全。最重要的是记住永远不要把你的密码告诉任何人，也不要和任何人分享你的账户。

english: I can also tell you about password security, avoiding item scamming and in-game moderation. I can also tell you about a place called the Stronghold of Security, where you can learn more about account security and
translation: 我还可以告诉你关于密码安全、避免物品诈骗和游戏内监管的信息。我还可以告诉你一个叫安全要塞的地方，在那里你可以了解更多关于账户安全的信息，

english: have a bit of an adventure at the same time.
translation: 同时还能有点冒险。

english: I'd like to know about password security.
translation: 我想了解密码安全。

english: Well, the first thing to remember with password security, which I can't stress enough, is to never tell your password, bank PIN or authenticator details to anyone, not even if they claim to be Jagex staff. Real
translation: 嗯，关于密码安全，首先要记住的，我再怎么强调也不为过，就是永远不要把你的密码、银行 PIN 或验证器详情告诉任何人，即使他们声称是 Jagex 员工。真正的

english: Jagex staff will NEVER ask for your password. Sharing your account is a very bad idea, even if you think that you know and trust the person you are sharing with. Players have lost items and even their
translation: Jagex 员工永远不会向你要密码。分享你的账户是个非常糟糕的主意，即使你认为你认识并信任与你分享的人。玩家已经因此丢失了物品甚至他们的

english: account this way. Sharing accounts is also against the rules.
translation: 账户。分享账户也违反规则。

english: Is there anything else to be aware of?
translation: 还有什么需要注意的吗？

english: Yes, also be careful where you enter your password. Be aware that fake Old School RuneScape websites exist. These are sites that claim to give things such as item/stat upgrades, free items, beta testing and
translation: 是的，还要注意你在哪里输入密码。要知道存在假的 Old School RuneScape 网站。这些网站声称提供物品/属性升级、免费物品、测试和

english: moderator applications. Jagex do not offer any of these services.
translation: 版主申请等服务。Jagex 不提供任何这些服务。

english: Also be aware of trojans and keyloggers. These nasty programs can send everything you type into your device back to the computers of malicious people, so you can lose more than just your Old School RuneScape
translation: 还要注意特洛伊木马和键盘记录器。这些讨厌的程序可以把你输入设备的所有内容发送回恶意人士的电脑，所以你可能会丢失的不仅仅是你的 Old School RuneScape

english: password in this way. To avoid getting these on your device, be very wary of what you download, especially when it comes to downloading third party software. Also be very wary of email attachments and instant
translation: 密码。要避免这些程序进入你的设备，要非常警惕你下载的内容，尤其是下载第三方软件时。还要非常警惕电子邮件附件和即时

english: messenger file transfers, which can contain such things.
translation: 通讯软件文件传输，它们可能包含这类东西。

english: Finally, remember the game doesn't censor your password or bank PIN when you type them; anyone who tells you otherwise is probably trying to steal your character or items.
translation: 最后，记住游戏在你输入密码或银行 PIN 时不会屏蔽它们；任何告诉你相反的人可能想偷你的角色或物品。

english: I'd like to know more about avoiding item scamming.
translation: 我想了解更多关于避免物品诈骗的信息。

english: There are many nice and helpful players in Old School RuneScape; unfortunately, as in real life, there are some who aren't so honest. Some people may try to trick you out of your items. Try not to fall for this as
translation: Old School RuneScape 中有许多友好乐于助人的玩家；不幸的是，和现实生活一样，也有一些人不太诚实。有些人可能会试图骗走你的物品。尽量不要上当，因为

english: Jagex policy is to never return lost items to players that have been scammed. Doing so just encourages users to claim they lost items they never had to gain an unfair advantage. However, people carrying out such
translation: Jagex 的政策是永远不会把丢失的物品归还给被诈骗的玩家。这样做只会鼓励用户声称他们丢失了从未有过的物品以获得不公平优势。然而，进行此类

english: scams will get banned as it is against the rules.
translation: 诈骗的人会被封禁，因为这违反规则。

english: When trading, you have a second trade confirmation screen. Always double check that you are getting the items you expect on this page as some people may try and change what they are trading at the last minute on
translation: 交易时，你有第二个交易确认屏幕。务必仔细检查你在这个页面上得到的是你期望的物品，因为有些人可能会在第一个交易屏幕上最后一刻更改他们交易的内容。

english: the first trade screen. Remember when you have clicked accept on the second trade screen, the trade is not reversible.
translation: 记住当你在第二个交易屏幕上点击接受后，交易不可逆转。

english: Try and find out from someone else what an item is before spending a lot of money on it. Not all merchants are honest about the rarity or the uses of their wares. For example, some people try to pass off spinach rolls as
translation: 在花大钱买物品之前，试着从别人那里了解物品是什么。不是所有商人都对他们的商品稀有度或用途诚实。例如，有些人试图把菠菜卷当作

english: rare when in fact they're as common as cabbages!
translation: 稀有物品，而实际上它们和卷心菜一样常见！

english: Be wary of people offering to improve your items. For example, some people will claim they can add a trim to your armour or upgrade your sword to a more powerful one. This is not possible and they are trying
translation: 警惕那些提出改进你物品的人。例如，有些人会声称他们可以为你的装备添加装饰或将你的剑升级为更强大的。这是不可能的，他们试图

english: to steal your hard-earned equipment.
translation: 偷走你辛苦获得的装备。

english: I'd like to know more about in-game moderation.
translation: 我想了解更多关于游戏内监管的信息。

english: You will, from time to time, see moderator characters in game. Remember: a real staff member will never ask for your password or any other personal information. There are two types of moderator. You may see Jagex
translation: 你会时不时在游戏中看到版主角色。记住：真正的员工永远不会向你要密码或任何其他个人信息。有两种版主。你可能会看到 Jagex

english: staff characters in game - these can be identified by a gold crown next to their name and are the people who work in the Jagex offices. They might be from Customer Support, or they might be a tester or a
translation: 员工角色在游戏中——这些可以通过名字旁边的金色皇冠识别，他们是在 Jagex 办公室工作的人。他们可能来自客户支持，也可能是测试员或

english: programmer. You may also see player moderators - these can be identified by a silver crown next to their name. Player moderators are trusted players of Old School RuneScape that help keep in-game behaviour in
translation: 程序员。你也可能看到玩家版主——这些可以通过名字旁边的银色皇冠识别。玩家版主是 Old School RuneScape 的受信任玩家，他们帮助保持游戏内行为符合

english: line with the Old School RuneScape rules.
translation: Old School RuneScape 规则。

english: How do I become a player moderator?
translation: 我如何成为玩家版主？

english: The only way to become a player moderator is to know and play by the rules laid down by Jagex. Report those who break the rules, help players who need it and one day you might find an invite to become a moderator in
translation: 成为玩家版主的唯一方法是了解并遵守 Jagex 制定的规则。举报违反规则的人，帮助需要帮助的玩家，有一天你可能会在

english: your Old School RuneScape inbox. Note that Jagex will never contact you in game or by email to become a player moderator.
translation: 你的 Old School RuneScape 收件箱中发现成为版主的邀请。注意 Jagex 永远不会在游戏中或通过电子邮件联系你成为玩家版主。

english: I'd like to know about the Stronghold of Security.
translation: 我想了解安全要塞。

english: An exciting new discovery has been made in the Barbarian Village. Soon after they started mining in the middle of the village, one of the miners got caught in a cave.
translation: 在野蛮人聚落有一个令人兴奋的新发现。他们开始在村子中间采矿后不久，一名矿工被困在一个洞穴里。

english: Sounds painful, did he fall on his head?
translation: 听起来很疼，他摔到头了吗？

english: No, but it turned out that he had discovered a place unlike any other.
translation: 不，但结果是他发现了一个与众不同的地方。

english: How so?
translation: 怎么说？

english: Well an explorer went to look down there, it's full of new and exciting creatures and other surprises on top of that. It turns out this place can also help you to secure your account more effectively.
translation: 嗯，一位探险家去下面看了看，那里充满了新的令人兴奋的生物和其他惊喜。此外，这个地方还可以帮助你更有效地保护账户。

english: Wow, that sounds good. Where can I find the explorer to learn more?
translation: 哇，听起来不错。我在哪里可以找到探险家了解更多？

english: Sadly the explorer went missing and has not been found. However, here is some information to get you started on securing your account. You can find the Barbarian Village north of Falador and west of Varrock.
translation: 不幸的是探险家失踪了，至今未被找到。不过，这里有一些信息帮助你开始保护账户。你可以在法拉多城北边、维洛克城西边找到野蛮人聚落。

english: Where can I find a bank?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到银行？

english: You'll find a bank upstairs in Lumbridge Castle - go right to the top.
translation: 你可以在仑桥堡楼上找到银行——一直走到顶层。

english: The minimap in the top right corner of the game screen has various icons showing the locations of things. This icon to the left shows where banks are.
translation: 游戏屏幕右上角的小地图有各种图标显示物品的位置。左边这个图标显示银行的位置。

english: No, I can find things myself thank you.
translation: 不，我自己能找到东西，谢谢。

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: What, who's that?
translation: 什么，那是谁？

english: Hehe... ahem...
translation: 嘿嘿……咳咳……

english: This is the voice of your conscience! You've been a very naughty boy haven't you?
translation: 这是你良心的声音！你一直是个很调皮的男孩，对吧？

english: What? No I haven't!
translation: 什么？不我没有！

english: You know what I'm talking about! Don't lie!
translation: 你知道我在说什么！别撒谎！

english: Okay, okay! I'm sorry, I'll never do it again!
translation: 好吧，好吧！对不起，我再也不会了！

english: If you do it again, you'll be in deep trouble.
translation: 如果你再犯，你就有大麻烦了。

english: I'm supposed to be the local source of knowledge, but I cannot even solve this puzzle! Do me a favour and solve it for me.
translation: 我应该是当地的知识来源，但我甚至解不开这个谜题！帮个忙，帮我解开它。

english: Sorry but you haven't solved the puzzle yet.
translation: 抱歉，但你还没有解开谜题。

english: Thanks [player name]!
translation: 谢谢 [player name]！

english: Does the name 'Philly' mean anything to you by chance?
translation: '菲莉''这个名字对你来说有什么意义吗？

english: That locket! Where did you get it?
translation: 那个挂坠盒！你从哪里得到的？

english: I found it in a magical rift. Does it belong to you?
translation: 我在一个魔法裂隙里找到的。它属于你吗？

english: Not exactly... It's a long and sad story.
translation: 不完全是……这是个漫长而悲伤的故事。

english: It's okay, I have time to listen.
translation: 没关系，我有时间听。

english: Well, if you're sure then.
translation: 好吧，如果你确定的话。

english: It all started in my youth when I was part of the Order of Wizards. I frequently spent time travelling across Gielinor, which kept me away from my beloved who worked here in Lumbridge.
translation: 这一切始于我年轻时，当时我是巫师教团的成员。我经常花时间在基利诺尔各地旅行，这让我远离了在仑桥镇工作的爱人。

english: Due to being apart, I would often send her gifts. This locket was one of them.
translation: 由于分离，我经常给她送礼物。这个挂坠盒就是其中之一。

english: I see... I'm not sure I like where this story is going. How come I found the locket in a magic rift then?
translation: 我明白了……我不太喜欢这个故事的发展方向。那我怎么会在魔法裂隙里找到挂坠盒呢？

english: As I said, my research often kept me away from home. During one of my trips away, our house was robbed. My dear Thenia tried to stop them, but they took her life in return. The locket was taken in the robbery.
translation: 正如我所说，我的研究经常让我离家在外。在我一次外出期间，我们家被抢劫了。我亲爱的塞尼亚试图阻止他们，但他们夺走了她的生命。挂坠盒在抢劫中被偷走了。

english: Oh my... I'm so sorry for your loss.
translation: 天哪……我为你的损失感到非常抱歉。

english: I appreciate your kind words, but this was a long time ago. The pain of losing a loved one never fades, but in time you come to live with it.
translation: 我感谢你的好意，但那是很久以前的事了。失去亲人的痛苦永远不会消失，但随着时间的推移，你会学会与之共存。

english: Anyway, after that I stepped down from the Order of Wizards. I now spend my days offering guidance to those who come through Lumbridge.
translation: 无论如何，之后我从巫师教团退出了。我现在每天为经过仑桥镇的人提供指导。

english: I'm still curious to know how it ended up in some rift. Do you have any theories?
translation: 我还是很好奇它是怎么进入某个裂隙的。你有什么理论吗？

english: Well... where was this rift?
translation: 嗯……这个裂隙在哪里？

english: In an ancient temple. Most things in the rift came from the Abyss.
