translation: 但我相信，在大多数人眼中，你定是英雄无疑！至少我很高兴见到你。

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: How do you like your town?
translation: 你觉得你的城镇怎么样？

english: What's happening around here?
translation: 这周围发生了什么事？

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: 有什么我能帮忙的吗？

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Hello I'm Luthas, I run the banana plantation here.
translation: 你好，我是卢萨斯，我经营这里的香蕉种植园。

english: Could you offer me employment on your plantation?
translation: 你能在你的种植园给我提供工作吗？

english: Yes, I can sort something out. There's a crate ready to be loaded onto the ship.
translation: 是的，我可以安排一下。有个箱子正准备装上船。

english: You wouldn't believe the demand for bananas from Wydin's shop over in Port Sarim. I think this is the third crate I've shipped him this month..
translation: 你简直不敢相信沙林港怀丁商店对香蕉的需求。我想这是我这个月发给他的第三箱了……

english: If you could fill it up with bananas, I'll pay you 30 gold.
translation: 如果你能把它装满香蕉，我会付你30金币。

english: That customs officer is annoying isn't she?
translation: 那个海关官员很烦人，是吧？

english: Well I know her pretty well. She doesn't cause me any trouble any more.
translation: 嗯，我跟她很熟。她不再给我找麻烦了。

english: She doesn't even search my export crates any more. She knows they only contain bananas.
translation: 她甚至不再检查我的出口箱了。她知道里面只有香蕉。

english: Really? How interesting. Whereabouts do you send those to?
translation: 真的吗？真有趣。你把那些送到哪里？

english: There is a little shop over in Port Sarim that buys them up by the crate. I believe it is run by a man called Wydin.
translation: 沙林港有家小店整箱收购。我想是一个叫怀丁的人经营的。

english: Have you completed your task yet?
translation: 你完成任务了吗？

english: What did I have to do again?
translation: 我要做什么来着？

english: There's a crate ready to be loaded onto the ship. If you could fill it up with bananas, I'll pay you 30 gold.
translation: 有个箱子正准备装上船。如果你能把它装满香蕉，我会付你30金币。

english: No, the crate isn't full yet...
translation: 不，箱子还没满……

english: Well come back when it is.
translation: 那满了再来。

english: So where are these bananas going to be delivered to?
translation: 那么这些香蕉要送到哪里？

english: I sell them to Wydin who runs a grocery store in Port Sarim.
translation: 我卖给沙林港经营杂货店的怀丁。

english: I've filled a crate with bananas.
translation: 我已经装满了一箱香蕉。

english: Well done, here's your payment.
translation: 做得好，这是你的报酬。

english: Will you pay me for another crate full?
translation: 你会再付我一整箱的钱吗？

english: Yes certainly.
translation: 当然会。

english: If you go outside you should see the old crate has been loaded on to the ship, and there is another empty crate in its place.
translation: 如果你出去，应该能看到旧箱子已经装上船了，原处有个新空箱子。

english: Thank you, I'll be on my way.
translation: 谢谢，我走了。

english: Congratulations.
translation: 恭喜。

english: Could you offer me employment on your plantation?
translation: 你能在你的种植园给我提供工作吗？

english: That customs officer is annoying isn't she?
translation: 那个海关官员很烦人，是吧？

english: What did I have to do again?
translation: 我要做什么来着？

english: No, the crate isn't full yet.
translation: 不，箱子还没满。

english: So where are these bananas going to be delivered to?
translation: 那么这些香蕉要送到哪里？

english: Will you pay me for another crate full?
translation: 你会再付我一整箱的钱吗？

english: Thank you, I'll be on my way
translation: 谢谢，我走了

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: Greetings.
translation: 问候。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Well, friend, I'm Arls Lutwidge of the Moonlight Broadsword! Renowned all over Gielinor!
translation: 嗯，朋友，我是月光阔剑阿尔斯‧拉特威奇！闻名整个基利诺尔！

english: Can't say I've heard of you before.
translation: 不能说以前听说过你。

english: You haven't... heard of... That's madness!
translation: 你没……听说过……太疯狂了！

english: Surely you've heard of my feats, but perhaps not the name?
translation: 你一定听说过我的事迹，但也许不是这个名字？

english: Perhaps.
translation: 也许。

english: And yourself?
translation: 你呢？

english: An adventurer mostly, but I've slain some dragons and I've conquered some nightmares.
translation: 主要是个冒险者，但我杀过一些龙，征服过一些噩梦。

english: Very good, young one! Very good indeed!
translation: 很好，年轻人！确实很好！

english: So... where's this famous sword of yours?
translation: 那么……你那把著名的剑呢？

english: Gone. I gave it to a fledgling when I retired and the damned fool went and died fighting some great monster in a far off land.
translation: 没了。我退休时把它给了一个新手，那个该死的傻瓜去远方打什么大怪物死了。

english: Say... if you find it, could you bring it to me? I won't pay you, as holding such a magnificent weapon should be payment enough.
translation: 话说……如果你找到它，能带给我吗？我不会付你钱，因为持有如此宏伟的武器本身就是足够的报酬。

english: I think you need to work on your bartering skills.
translation: 我想你需要练习一下你的讨价还价技巧。

english: Perhaps.
translation: 也许。

english: What grand feats are you known for?
translation: 你以什么伟大事迹闻名？

english: I peaked rather early and most know me for my first act of heroism when I defeated the Moonfly. It may sound cute, but it killed many of the smallfolk and their livestock, for it was a vile creature.
translation: 我成名较早，大多数人认识我是因为我第一次英雄事迹，击败了月蝇。听起来可能很可爱，但它杀死了许多平民和他们的牲畜，因为它是个邪恶的生物。

english: Where'd it come from?
translation: 它从哪来的？

english: It was I that discovered the creature. I pulled it from the Lum during a fishing trip of mine.
translation: 是我发现了那个生物。我有一次钓鱼时从仑河把它拉出来的。

english: As young and foolish as I was, I dropped it down a dried up well and went for help. However, upon my return, the creature was gone.
translation: 当时我年轻愚蠢，把它丢进一口干井里就去求援了。然而，等我回来，生物不见了。

english: And then what happened?
translation: 然后发生了什么事？

english: Many years passed until suddenly there were sightings of a winged demon around the River Lum. Some claimed it was an overly large heron and that it was nothing to be worried about.
translation: 很多年过去了，直到突然有人在仑河周围看到有翼恶魔。有些人声称那是只超大的鹭，没什么好担心的。

english: As time went on, folk started to go missing and I knew I had to return home and face this demon.
translation: 随着时间的推移，人们开始失踪，我知道我必须回家面对这个恶魔。

english: You left?
translation: 你离开了？

english: I had wars to fight, glory to be won and all that rubbish. Upon my return I spoke to an old crone who lived in the swamps and she gave me some advice.
translation: 我有仗要打，有荣耀要争取，诸如此类的废话。等我回来，我跟一个住在沼泽里的老巫婆谈了谈，她给了我一些建议。

english: She told me to spike my armour and described how to lure the creature toward me.
translation: 她告诉我给装备装上尖刺，并描述了如何把生物引向我。

english: And you defeated it? The Moonfly?
translation: 你击败了它？月蝇？

english: Some bard wrote a poem of the events. The telling of the battle is a little embellished and rife with errors. The poem can be found in this library somewhere, providing it has been returned.
translation: 有个吟游诗人写了首关于此事的诗。战斗的描述有点 embellished 且错误百出。这首诗可以在图书馆某处找到，前提是它被还回来了。

english: And did I defeat the creature? I wouldn't be here if I hadn't!
translation: 我击败了那个生物吗？如果没有我就不会在这里了！

english: I'll be sure to keep an eye out.
translation: 我一定会留意的。

english: Please do! And come to me if you have any burning questions about it.
translation: 请务必！如果你有任何急切的问题，来找我。

english: Sure thing.
translation: 没问题。

english: Why are you here?
translation: 你为什么在这里？

english: I've grown old, friend. Heroes need to know when to throw in the towel, so they say. I've always enjoyed a good book, so it seemed fitting to stay here as librarian for the guild.
translation: 我老了，朋友。英雄需要知道何时认输，他们是这么说的。我一直喜欢好书，所以留在这里当公会图书管理员似乎很合适。

english: Hmm... the books are very interesting. I thought there would be more though...
translation: 嗯……书很有趣。不过我以为会有更多……

english: Well, that's why I'm here! So many of you adventurers help yourself to any old book and never return the damn things!
translation: 嗯，这就是我在这里的原因！你们这么多冒险者随便拿旧书，从不归还那些该死的东西！

english: If I could have it my way, you wouldn't be allowed to wander off with them, but I'm not the guildmaster, as Alec likes to remind me.
translation: 如果按我的意思，就不允许你们带着它们乱跑，但我不是公会会长，正如亚历克喜欢提醒我的那样。

english: Certainly sounds like you have a problem.
translation: 听起来你确实有问题。

english: Well fear not. I'm working on it!
translation: 别怕。我正在解决！

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！

english: I'll see you around.
translation: 回头见。

english: Yes! Fantastic! Did you enjoy it?
translation: 是的！太棒了！你喜欢吗？

english: Yeah it was alright. Some of these words are a bit odd though. Did you really cover your sword in sheep blood?
translation: 嗯，还可以。不过有些词有点奇怪。你真的把剑浸在羊血里了吗？

english: Ah, a slight misunderstanding... I soaked it in sap from a yew tree, but I guess blood is a bit more dramatic.
translation: 啊，有点误会……我把它浸在紫杉树的汁液里，但我想血更有戏剧性。

english: Why?
translation: 为什么？

english: The crone, long dead now, I suppose... She claimed to be from the same world as the creature and knew of the ritual to summon it.
translation: 那个老巫婆，我想早就死了……她声称来自和那个生物相同的世界，知道召唤它的仪式。

english: The poem does mention sheep though, at the end?
translation: 但诗的最后确实提到了羊？

english: Perhaps some locals claimed to have lost some sheep, but my guess is that the bard was searching for a rhyme. Either way, I doubt it's a detail worth fretting over.
translation: 也许有些当地人声称丢了些羊，但我猜吟游诗人只是为了押韵。不管怎样，我怀疑这细节不值得烦恼。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: What grand feats are you known for?
translation: 你以什么伟大事迹闻名？

english: Why are you here?
translation: 你为什么在这里？

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: The man glances at you and grunts something unintelligible.
translation: 那人瞥了你一眼，咕哝了些听不懂的话。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Mac. What's it to you?
translation: 麦克。关你什么事？

english: Only trying to be friendly.
translation: 只是想友好点。

english: What do you have in your sack?
translation: 你袋子里有什么？

english: None of yer bis'ness.
translation: 不关你的事。

english: How rude! I was only being curious.
translation: 真粗鲁！我只是好奇。

english: S'me cape.
translation: 是我的斗篷。

english: Your cape?
translation: 你的斗篷？

english: What does your cape do?
translation: 你的斗篷有什么用？

english: All the things other skillcapes do.
translation: 其他技能斗篷有的功能它都有。

english: Can you tell me what they are?
translation: 你能告诉我是什么吗？

english: Fine... Ajjat gave me unlimited teleports to his Warrior's guild and Kamfreena lets me fight her Cyclopes without needing those annoying tokens.
translation: 好吧……阿加特给了我无限次传送到他的战士公会的权限，卡姆弗里纳让我无需那些烦人的令牌就能和她的独眼巨人战斗。

english: Melee combat tutor added a ring of life function and the armour salesman at the Ranging guild added a magnet and undead chicken thing.
translation: 近战导师添加了生命戒指功能，远程公会的装备销售员添加了磁铁和不死鸡功能。

english: Brother Jered attached a holy wrench and Wizard Sinina enchanted the cape so I can change me spellbook.
translation: 杰雷德兄弟附加了神圣扳手，西尼纳法师给斗篷附魔，让我可以切换法术书。

english: Aubury attached all of the runecrafting tiaras, an estate agent sold me some teleports and one of the nurses at the Emir's Arena made it give me faster hitpoints.
translation: 奥布里附加了所有符石头冠，房产代理卖给我一些传送，埃米尔竞技场的一名护士让它给我更快的生命值恢复。

english: Agility Arena guy with a Parrot pet made it lighter for me and Kaqemeex convinced the Nardah herbalist to make potions for me if I wear it and he attached a pestle and mortar, toos.
translation: 敏捷竞技场的鹦鹉宠物家伙让它更轻，卡格梅克斯说服那尔达城草药商在我佩戴时为我制作药水，他还附加了研钵和杵。

english: Martin Thwait made the cape better for being sneaky and the Master Crafter added a teleport to his guild before Hickton attached some grapples and a crossbow.
translation: 马丁‧斯韦特让斗篷更适合潜行，制作大师添加了传送到他的公会的功能，然后希克顿附加了一些抓钩和弩。

english: Duradel convinced all Slayer masters to give me a chance at repeating an assignment and the Hunting Expert added some useful teleports, too.
translation: 杜拉德尔说服所有杀戮大师给我重复任务的机会，狩猎专家也添加了一些有用的传送。

english: A dwarf gave it a chance to give me extra ores and another dwarf made it give more experience when making gold bars and the Master Chef stopped it from burning any food.
translation: 一个矮人让它有机会给我额外矿石，另一个矮人让它在我制作金锭时给更多经验，大师厨师让它不再烧焦任何食物。

english: Ignatius Vulcan added a torch for lighting up caves and the Woodcutting tutor made it easier to find bird's nests and Martin the Master Farmer made it yield more herbs.
translation: 伊格内修斯‧瓦尔坎添加了照亮洞穴的火把，伐木导师让它更容易找到鸟巢，农业大师马丁让它收获更多草药。

english: So yeah all of that.
translation: 所以是的，所有这些。

english: Can I have it?
translation: 我能要吗？

english: Nah. Not got space.
translation: 不。没空间。

english: Mebe.
translation: 也许。

english: I'm sure I could make it worth your while.
translation: 我肯定能让你觉得值得。

english: How much?
translation: 多少钱？

english: How about [amount of coins in inventory] gold?
translation: [amount of coins in inventory] 金币怎么样？

english: S'not enuff.
translation: 不够。

english: How about 2376000 gold?
Hello?
translation: 你好？

english: Huh, who's there?
translation: 嗯，谁在那？

english: It's Dionysius here. I'm using my magic to communicate to you. Don't worry.
translation: 我是狄奥尼修斯。我用魔法跟你交流。别担心。

english: What are you doing in my head?
translation: 你在我脑子里做什么？

english: I just wanted to say congratulations [player name]. I've been watching you in your adventures - very well done.
translation: 我只是想说恭喜 [player name]。我一直在关注你的冒险——做得很好。

english: Oh very well done [player name]. Taken you a while, but I knew you could do it.
translation: 哦做得很好 [player name]。花了不少时间，但我知道你能做到。

english: Ahhh [player name], I knew you had potential when I first met you. My compliments on reaching the pinnacle of your achievements.
translation: 啊 [player name]，我第一次见你就知道你有潜力。恭喜你达到成就的巅峰。

english: Meow!
translation: 喵！

english: Oh most excellently done old chap!
translation: 哦干得太好了老伙计！

english: Why do you keep it in a sack?
translation: 你为什么把它放在袋子里？

english: Get it dirty.
translation: 弄脏它。

english: Why are you so dirty?
translation: 你为什么这么脏？

english: Bath XP waste.
translation: 洗澡浪费经验。

english: Bye.
translation: 再见。

english: Yip. Show me the goods. I pay 80%.
translation: 是的。给我看看货。我付80%。

english: Nah. Need more space.
translation: 不。需要更多空间。

english: Yip. No cost. What cape do you want a hood for?
translation: 是的。免费。你想给什么斗篷配兜帽？

english: You don't have that cape. Choose another.
translation: 你没有那个斗篷。选另一个。

english: Mac hands you another hood for your cape.
translation: 麦克递给你另一个斗篷兜帽。

english: Show cape.
translation: 展示斗篷。

english: That's XP waste.
translation: 那是浪费经验。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: What do you have in your sack?
translation: 你袋子里有什么？

english: What does your cape do?
translation: 你的斗篷有什么用？

english: Can you tell me what they are?
translation: 你能告诉我是什么吗？

english: Can I have it?
translation: 我能要吗？

english: Why do you keep it in a sack?
translation: 你为什么把它放在袋子里？

english: Yes, pay the man.
translation: 是的，付钱给那人。

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: Why are you so dirty?
translation: 你为什么这么脏？

english: Bye.
translation: 再见。

english: Can I sell my max cape back to you?
translation: 我能把我的至尊斗篷卖回给你吗？

english: Yes - receive 1,900,800gp.
No, I've changed my mind.
translation: 不，我改变主意了。

english: Can I have another hood for my cape?
translation: 我能再要一个斗篷兜帽吗？

english: Hey there! Do you have a grapple I can borrow?
translation: 嘿！你有抓钩能借我吗？

english: I might have one, but I need it myself. Why do you need a grapple?
translation: 我可能有一个，但我自己也需要。你为什么需要抓钩？

english: I need it to grapple to that pillar over there and get some treasure of course. What else could I need it for?
translation: 我需要用它在对面的柱子上抓钩当然为了拿宝藏。我还能用它做什么？

english: I mean that makes sense I suppose. How did you end up here?
translation: 我想那有道理。你怎么到这里来的？

english: Well, I made my way to Morytania in search of a place called the Ba... Barlows? I've heard it's a great way to earn gold.
translation: 嗯，我前往莫利塔尼亚寻找一个叫巴……巴洛斯？的地方。我听说那是赚金币的好方法。

english: Barrows.
translation: 巴罗斯。

english: Yeah, that's what I said!
translation: 是的，我就是那么说的！

english: Anyways, I got lost on the way here and was abducted by some vampyres! However, I'm so sneaky I managed to escape and find this place.
translation: 不管怎样，我在路上迷路了，被一些吸血鬼绑架了！不过，我很狡猾，成功逃脱并找到了这个地方。

english: The weird hooded guy at the top said that if I get him some hollow marks, he'll help me escape.
translation: 顶上那个奇怪的戴兜帽的家伙说，如果我给他一些空心标记，他会帮我逃脱。

english: You mean Hallowed marks.
translation: 你是说神圣标记。

english: Yeah, that's what I said. Don't you listen?
translation: 是的，我就是那么说的。你没听吗？

english: *sigh*
translation: 叹气

english: So, can I borrow a grapple?
translation: 那么，我能借个抓钩吗？

english: No, I don't have a grapple on me.
translation: 不，我身上没带抓钩。

english: Well, you're clearly a noob then.
translation: 嗯，那你显然是个新手。

english: Yes, I do have a spare grapple. I'm not sure you'd be able to use it to get across that gap though, what is your Ranged level?
translation: 是的，我确实有个备用抓钩。不过我不确定你能用它跨过那个缺口，你的远程等级是多少？

english: Pfft,I'm level 50 Ranged. Over half-way to 99, getting over there will be a breeze.
translation: 噗，我远程50级。超过99级的一半了，过去易如反掌。

english: You need 62 Ranged to make it across that gap.
translation: 你需要62级远程才能跨过那个缺口。

english: Maybe you do with that attitude.
translation: 也许你有那种态度就需要。

english: Yes, I do have a spare grapple, although I spent a lot of Hallowed marks to obtain it so you can't have it.
translation: 是的，我确实有个备用抓钩，虽然我花了很多神圣标记才得到它，所以你不能拿。

english: Keep your grapple then noob. I can make that jump without it anyway.
translation: 那留着你的抓钩吧新手。反正没有它我也能跳过去。

english: Oh yeah? What's your agility level?
translation: 哦是吗？你的敏捷等级是多少？

english: None of your business.
translation: 不关你的事。

english: What, you gots the crystal...
translation: 什么，你有水晶……

english: Oh, okay then.
translation: 哦，那好吧。

english: You be on your way, then.
translation: 那你走吧。

english: Ah, greetings. What can I do for you?
translation: 啊，问候。我能为你做什么？

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: I'm Madam Sikaro.
translation: 我是西卡罗夫人。

english: ...Is that it?
translation: ……就这些？

english: Why shouldn't it be? You asked who I was, and I answered.
translation: 为什么不是？你问我是谁，我回答了。

english: I was hoping to learn something about you, like what you were doing here...!
translation: 我希望能了解你的一些事，比如你在这里做什么……！

english: Well, perhaps next time you'll ask a more direct question.
translation: 嗯，也许下次你会问个更直接的问题。

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Making a wizard hideout.
translation: 建造法师藏身处。

english: A wizard... hideout?
translation: 法师……藏身处？

english: A wizard hideout! You know how some wizards have their own towers? Think that but underground.
translation: 法师藏身处！你知道有些法师有自己的塔吗？想象那个但在地下。

english: So why not just get a tower?
translation: 那为什么不直接弄个塔？

english: Land price. Kingdoms want you to pay an extortionate amount of money to build on 'their' land, it turns out.
translation: 地价。结果王国想要你付巨额资金才能在''他们的''土地上建造。

english: So instead you ended up in the basement of a tavern.
translation: 所以你结果待在酒馆地下室。

english: Yep. Camarst said I could have it as long as I don't hurt any of his customers too badly.
translation: 是的。卡马斯特说只要我不太严重地伤害他的任何顾客，我就可以用它。

english: Not that I actually plan to hurt any of his customers.
translation: 不是我真的计划伤害他的任何顾客。

english: I have this part that looks like it's from a weapon...
translation: 我有这个看起来像武器部件的东西……

english: Ah yes, that does look like a part of a particularly powerful weapon.
translation: 啊是的，那看起来确实像某个特别强大武器的部件。

english: Can I do anything with it?
translation: 我能用它做什么吗？

english: You? Perhaps not, though if you could bring me all three pieces, I suspect I could put it back together for you.
translation: 你？也许不行，不过如果你能把三个部件都带给我，我想我可以帮你把它组装起来。

english: There should be a hilt, a blade and a conduit gemstone. Oh, and I'll want 500,000 coins as payment as well. Good hunting!
translation: 应该有一个剑柄、一个剑刃和一个导管宝石。哦，我还要500,000金币作为报酬。狩猎愉快！

english: Do you know where I could find the other parts?
translation: 你知道我在哪里可以找到其他部件吗？

english: I suspect the Wilderness would be a good place to start. There are monsters out there that have grown immense over time.
translation: 我想荒野是个好的起点。那里有些随着时间变得巨大的怪物。

english: Seeking out the strongest of them is where I'd start, anyway.
translation: 无论如何，我会从寻找其中最强的开始。

english: I have these parts of a weapon, do you think you could assemble it for me?
translation: 我有这些武器部件，你觉得能帮我组装吗？

english: Hmm... yes, these are the parts of a particularly powerful weapon indeed. I can reassemble it... for a fee, of course. 500,000 coins, no less.
translation: 嗯……是的，这确实是一个特别强大武器的部件。我可以重新组装它……当然要收费。500,000金币，一分不少。

english: I don't have that much on me...
translation: 我身上没那么多……

english: Well, if you come across some more, come find me again.
translation: 嗯，如果你凑够了，再来找我。

english: Actually, I've changed my mind.
translation: 其实，我改变主意了。

english: Curious, you come to me with all of the parts and the coin, yet you change your mind at the last second.
translation: 奇怪，你带着所有部件和金币来找我，却在最后一秒改变主意。

english: I do rather get the feeling you're toying with me. Very well, I shall do my part in playing with you.
translation: 我确实觉得你在耍我。很好，我也陪你玩玩。

english: You feel the contents of your inventory shift slightly.
translation: 你感觉物品栏里的东西轻微移动了一下。

english: Now, do talk to me again if you'd like to proceed more sensibly.
translation: 现在，如果你想更理智地进行，再跟我谈。

english: What are you doing with the money from combining the Voidwaker?
translation: 你用组装虚空唤醒者的钱做什么？

english: I'll spend some of it improving the hideout. The rest on general expenses.
translation: 我会花一部分改进藏身处。其余用于一般开支。

english: What kind of expenses?
translation: 什么开支？

english: Living isn't free, you know? A woman my age has expenses. Food, clothing, protection... It all adds up.
translation: 生活不是免费的，你知道吧？我这个年纪的女人有开支。食物、衣服、保护……加起来不少。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: You walked up to me just to say goodbye? Ok, sure, goodbye.
translation: 你走过来只是为了说再见？好吧，当然，再见。

english: So what exactly is this sword, anyway?
translation: 那么这把剑到底是什么？

english: Well, that largely depends on who you ask and when you ask it. The sword is not unique, but many like it have been referenced in folktales.
translation: 嗯，那很大程度上取决于你问谁以及何时问。这把剑不是唯一的，但民间故事中提到了许多类似的剑。

english: Some tell of great and prideful warriors roaming the lands, cutting down all who oppose them in great crashes of lightning.
translation: 有些故事讲述了伟大而骄傲的战士漫游大地，在巨大的闪电撞击中砍倒所有反对者。

english: Others tell of lovers, one bound by oath, the other free as the wind, cruely torn apart by fate.
translation: 其他故事讲述了恋人，一个被誓言束缚，另一个像风一样自由，被命运残酷地分开。

english: Others still tell of three great beasts that alone were powerful, but combined could destroy Gielinor.
translation: 还有一些故事讲述了三只伟大的野兽，单独就很强大，但结合起来可以毁灭基利诺尔。

english: Are we still talking about the sword?
translation: 我们还在说剑吗？

english: Amazingly, yes. In all of these tales, the sword is there, potential shining through the metal, thunder rolling in its wake.
translation: 令人惊讶的是，是的。在所有这些故事中，剑都在那里，潜力透过金属闪耀，雷声随之滚滚而来。

english: Are any of these tales... true?
translation: 这些故事有任何……是真的吗？

english: Oh, I'm sure there are elements of the truth buried in there, but folklore being what it is, I'm inclined to not believe any of it.
translation: 哦，我确信其中埋藏着真实的元素，但民间传说就是这样，我倾向于不相信任何部分。

english: Aside from the bit where it can summon lightning. It can absolutely do that.
translation: 除了它能召唤闪电的部分。它绝对能做到。

english: What about the name? You called it Voidwaker?
translation: 那名字呢？你叫它虚空唤醒者？

english: Well, in a lot of these tales, it's only ever refferedto as someone's sword. Like, [player name]'s sword.
translation: 嗯，在很多这些故事中，它只被称为某人的剑。比如，[player name] 的剑。

english: So, I chose a name for it.
translation: 所以，我为它选了个名字。

english: And you chose... Voidwaker? Why?
translation: 你选了……虚空唤醒者？为什么？

english: There are multiple reasons. I suppose you could say the sword is so powerful that it leaves a void in its wake.
translation: 有多个原因。我想你可以说这把剑如此强大，以至于它身后留下了虚空。

english: That makes sense.
translation: 有道理。

english: No thank you, I'm currently on a diet.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我正在节食。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: I have this part that looks like it's from a weapon...
translation: 我有这个看起来像武器部件的东西……

english: Yes
translation: 是的

english: No
translation: 不

english: What are you doing with the money?
translation: 你用钱做什么？

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: Good morrow, adventurer.
translation: 早安，冒险者。

english: I guess so.
translation: 我想是的。

english: You guess? The sun is shining, the sea breeze is salty, what's not to enjoy?
translation: 你想？阳光明媚，海风咸咸的，有什么不值得享受的？

english: I don't know... The sand? It's coarse and rough and irritating, and it gets everywhere.
translation: 我不知道……沙子？它粗糙、刺耳、刺激，而且到处都是。

english: Hmm, well my spa isn't quite ready yet, but when it is, I'm sure that'll solve all of your sand related issues!
translation: 嗯，我的水疗中心还没准备好，但准备好后，我相信那会解决你所有沙子相关的问题！

english: Okay.
translation: 好的。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: I am Madame Caldarium! A pirate's life was for me, but lately I've been looking to expand my business, I'm getting old, ya see.
translation: 我是卡尔达里姆夫人！海盗生活适合我，但最近我一直想扩展业务，我老了，你看。

english: A spa business? Do you really think these Corsairs are the washing type?
translation: 水疗业务？你真认为这些海盗是洗澡的类型？

english: Ha! That's what the Rum is for!
translation: 哈！那就是朗姆酒的用途！

english: I'm more concerned of their laziness, 'Can't work today Madame, I'm cursed!'. Bunch of idiots, the lot of 'em.
translation: 我更担心他们的懒惰，''今天不能工作夫人，我被诅咒了！''。一群白痴，全是。

english: Surely you never expected this lot to be any different... They're either stealing, killing or both!
translation: 你肯定从没指望这群人有什么不同……他们要么偷窃，要么杀人，要么两者兼施！

english: Yes... I have plans adventurer, the local cave dwelling population are... Let's say, sorting something out.
translation: 是的……我有计划，冒险者，当地的洞穴居住人口正在……这么说吧，解决一些问题。

english: Interesting, I'm sure that'll be an entertaining turn of events.
translation: 有趣，我相信那会是个有趣的转折。

english: We'll see...
translation: 我们等着瞧……

english: Goodbye!
translation: 再见！

english: Farewell, adventurer.
translation: 再见，冒险者。

english: I have a question for you.
translation: 我有个问题问你。

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
translation: 请输入问题的答案。

english: No, try again.
translation: 不，再试一次。

english: Correct!
translation: 正确！

english: I guess so.
translation: 我想是的。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Goodbye!
translation: 再见！

english: Hi.
translation: 嗨。

english: Hello. How are you today?
translation: 你好。你今天怎么样？

english: I'm great, thank you!
translation: 我很好，谢谢！

english: Isn't it wonderful? So many books, so much knowledge to be absorbed!
translation: 这不是很棒吗？这么多书，这么多知识要吸收！

english: You're right, it is.
translation: 你说得对，确实是。

english: Where did I see that book? It can't be far...
translation: 我在哪里见过那本书？应该不远……

english: Uh... Hello?
translation: 呃……你好？

english: I'm sure it was around here somewhere...
translation: 我肯定就在这附近某处……

english: Okay... Maybe later...
translation: 好吧……也许以后……

english: What can I do for ya?
translation: 我能为你做什么？

english: Got any good books to recommend?
translation: 有什么好书推荐吗？

english: I've always found Prifddinas' History to be fascinating!
translation: 我一直觉得普里夫迪纳斯城的历史很迷人！

english: I've always found The Journal of Randas to be fascinating!
translation: 我一直觉得兰达斯日记很迷人！

english: I've always found Big Book of Bangs to be fascinating!
translation: 我一直觉得爆炸大全很迷人！

english: I've always found The Great Divide to be fascinating!
translation: 我一直觉得大分裂很迷人！

english: I've always found Ode to Eternity to be fascinating!
translation: 我一直觉得永恒颂歌很迷人！

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！

english: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: Got any good books to recommend?
translation: 有什么好书推荐吗？

english: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: Hi.
translation: 嗨。

english: You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 你知道吗，跟人打招呼的方式可多了。你好、嘿、你好啊……

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: 那也只能算一种！

english: Hello. How are you today?
translation: 你好。你今天怎么样？

english: I'm great, thank you!
translation: 我很好，谢谢！

english: Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 你好！水晶城今天天气真好，是吧？

english: Indeed.
translation: 确实。

english: What can I do for ya?
translation: 我能为你做什么？

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可做的？

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 各种各样的事！那些塔楼是非常值得一看的景观。

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 像今天这样的好日子，我建议去市场逛逛。

english: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你觉得你在做什么？

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可做的？

english: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: Hello friend. I wish to slay evil and avail them of their loot! Take me to Burgh de Rott!
translation: 你好，朋友。我想斩妖除魔，夺取他们的战利品！带我去伯格德罗特镇！

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
translation: 你准备好与那里的邪恶势力对抗了吗？

english: I think so? At least my heart knows courage and that should be sufficient for the meantime. I expect that when we get to Burgh de Rott, we'll be able to purchase suitable provisions.
translation: 我想是的？至少我内心充满勇气，这暂时应该足够了。我想等我们到了伯格德罗特镇，我们能够购买合适的补给品。

english: But you do realise that the vampyres in Morytania are immune to everything except silver?
translation: 但是你难道不知道莫利塔尼亚的吸血鬼除了银以外，对其他任何东西都免疫吗？

english: Er...well, I've not heard mention of that fact, but I have faith that Saradomin will provide the means to furnish me with suitable weapons when I reach Burgh de Rott.
translation: 呃……好吧，我没听说过这件事，但我相信萨拉多明会在我到达伯格德罗特镇时提供合适的武器。

english: And if we happen to run into some vampyres on the journey down there?
translation: 如果我们在去那里的路上碰到一些吸血鬼怎么办？

english: I trust that you will help us to avoid them. You are a guide after all, aren't you? Anyway, you look like you can handle yourself. I presume you've fought such creatures before and won? How hard can it be?
translation: 我相信你会帮我们避开他们。毕竟你是向导，对吧？不管怎样，你看起来能照顾好自己。我猜你以前和这种生物交过手并赢了？能有多难？

english: It can be pretty difficult, actually. But you're right, I'll be your guide so I should be able to handle the situation.
translation: 其实挺难的。不过你说得对，我会做你的向导，应该能应付得了。

english: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: 你为什么想去伯格德罗特镇？

english: I'm going down there to teach those vampyres a lesson or two. I've heard about the terrible conditions down there and I intend to put a stop to it.
translation: 我要去给那些吸血鬼点教训。我听说过那里的糟糕状况，我打算阻止这一切。

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Burgh de Rott?
translation: 如果我们在前往伯格德罗特镇的路上遇到敌人，你有办法自保吗？

english: Let's just say that I'm somewhat experienced and I'm happy to take on my fair share of enemies. You don't need to worry about that.
translation: 这么说吧，我还算有点经验，而且我很乐意承担我该对付的那份敌人。你不需要为我担心。

english: I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
translation: 我可以带你去伯格德罗特镇。

english: Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: 嗯，看来你有个随从。我想若是让它独自乱跑，这趟路上恐怕会走丢。等你的随从安顿好了我们再动身。

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: 真的吗？那太好了！到达目的地后我会给你点小报酬。

english: Burgh de Rott Ramble begins
translation: 伯格德罗特镇漫步之旅开始

english: Ok, which route should we take?
translation: 好的，我们应该走哪条路线？

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: 啊，所以你想给我一些补给，呃？让我打开我的背包看看。

english: This place is a bit grim. How can people live here?
translation: 这地方有点阴森，人们到底是怎么在这种环境下生活下去的？

english: Do you visit Burgh de Rott often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: 你经常来伯格德罗特镇吗？你似乎很熟悉这条路。

english: When are we going to get to Burgh de Rott?
translation: 我们什么时候能到伯格德罗特镇？

english: We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on. I have loot to get.
translation: 我们没时间在这儿闲聊，赶紧前进吧。我还有战利品要拿。

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than the opulet life styles forced on us adventurer types. I'd much rather be up to my eyes in mud and having a good fight!
translation: 我讨厌这趟行程，但这总比强加在我们冒险者身上的那种奢华生活要好。我宁愿浑身泥泞，痛痛快快地打一场！

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...
translation: 你没看见我正在挨打吗……

english: Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
translation: 谢谢，我会把它灌下去的。

english: Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Paterdomus. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: 天哪！看来我们得回帕多姆斯了。我们过不了那座桥！

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
translation: 我相信我们能找到办法的！

english: Player completes the bridge event
translation: 玩家完成了桥梁事件

english: Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Paterdomus.
translation: 这下糟了……看来我们过不了这片沼泽，得回帕多姆斯。

english: Player completes the bog event
translation: 玩家完成了沼泽事件

english: Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
translation: 太棒了！干得漂亮，我会跟紧你。

english: Whahay...that was great!
translation: 哇哈……太棒了！

english: But we really should be heading off now.
translation: 不过我们现在真得赶紧上路了。

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
translation: 放心，我们一定能找到路过去的！

english: Player completes the river event
translation: 玩家完成了河流事件

english: That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
translation: 太厉害了！我也得照做。

english: Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: 哇哈……太棒了！不过我们现在真得赶紧上路了。

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
translation: 那……那些气泡是什么？

english: This is scary!
translation: 这太可怕了！

english: Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
translation: 啊，那应该是触手……

english: Ahhh, two tentacles!
translation: 啊，两根触手！

english: ...three tentacles!
translation: ……三根触手！

english: I think I'm going to faint!
translation: 我觉得我要晕了！

english: Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: 天哪！看那怪物！你得自己解决那东西！

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the Burgh de Rott. Here's your reward.
translation: 多谢你平安把我带到伯格德罗特镇，这是你的报酬。

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
translation: 你准备好与那里的邪恶势力对抗了吗？

english: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: 你为什么想去伯格德罗特镇？

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
translation: 如果我们在路上遇到敌人，你能自保吗？

english: I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
translation: 我可以带你去伯格德罗特镇。

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: This isn't the place to talk. Visit me in Varrock's Chaos Temple if you have something to discuss. Unless you're here to teleport or buy something?
translation: 这儿不是说话的地方。如果你有事要谈，去维洛克城的混沌神庙找我。除非你是来传送或买东西的？

english: Let's see what you're selling.
translation: 看看你在卖什么。

english: Could you teleport me to the Abyss?
translation: 你能传送我去深渊吗？

english: Veniens! Sallakar! Rinnesset!
translation: Veniens! Sallakar! Rinnesset!

english: Player is teleported to the Abyss.
translation: 玩家被传送至深渊。

english: Alright, I'll go.
translation: 好吧，我去。

english: Ah, you again. What do you want?
translation: 啊，又是你。你想干什么？

english: About that incantation your initiate gave me...
translation: 关于你的学徒给我的那段咒语……

english: Ah yes, the one to trace that amulet. Don't think I didn't notice that you modified the transmission spell I put on it. Next time you need help, we might not be so willing.
translation: 啊对，就是追踪那个护符的咒语。别以为我没发现你修改了我施加的传输法术。下次再需要帮忙，我们可未必这么乐意了。

english: Well maybe you should have asked first! Besides, you wouldn't have got anything useful out of it. In tracing that amulet, we accidently managed to open an uncontrollable rift to the Abyss.
translation: 嗯，也许你该先问一声！再说了，你也从中捞不到什么好处。追踪那个护符时，我们意外打开了一个通往深渊的不可控裂隙。

english: And does this 'we' include the Order of Wizards?
translation: 这个“我们”包括巫师教团吗？

english: Maybe...
translation: 也许……

english: I knew it! It's just like them to play with magic they don't understand. First they burnt down the Wizards' Tower, now they're opening uncontrollable abyssal rifts!
translation: 我就知道！他们向来如此，玩弄自己不懂的魔法。先烧了法师塔，现在又要打开不可控的深渊裂隙！

english: Perhaps the fools should leave the dangerous magic to us next time!
translation: 也许下次那些蠢货该把危险的魔法留给我们！

english: Oh, that reminds me. That incantation didn't appear to be written on parchment. What was it?
translation: 哦，这倒提醒我了。那段咒语看起来不是写在羊皮纸上的。那是什么？

english: Hmm... probably the flesh of an abyssal creature. Why do you ask?
translation: 嗯……可能是深渊生物的身体。你问这个干嘛？

english: Oh, I just thought it might be human flesh. I'm relieved it wasn't!
translation: 我只是以为可能是人肉，幸好不是！

english: You've been spending too much time with your friends in the Order of Wizards! I know that we Zamorakians have a bad reputation, but do you really think we'd be so barbaric?
translation: 你跟巫师教团的朋友待得太久了！我知道我们扎莫拉克信徒名声不好，但你真认为我们会那么野蛮吗？

english: Ah yes, the one that led those fools in the Order of Wizards to open an uncontrollable abyssal rift! Perhaps they should leave the dangerous magic to us next time!
translation: 啊是的，就是导致巫师教团那些傻瓜打开不可控深渊裂隙的那段！也许下次他们应该把危险的魔法留给我们！

english: Not to mention that they tried to convince you that we wrote that incantation on human flesh! Their lies never cease to amaze me!
translation: 更别说他们还试图让你相信那是我们用人肉写的咒语！他们的谎言真是层出不穷！

english: Right...
translation: 好吧……

english: Can you tell me more about the Abyss?
translation: 你能多告诉我一些关于深渊的事吗？

english: It is a hard place to describe. We often refer to it as another plane, but that isn't quite accurate. If anything, it is more like a plane that sits between all other planes.
translation: 那地方很难描述。我们常把它称作另一个位面，但这不太准确。真要说的话，它更像是一个夹在所有其他位面之间的位面。

english: Right... And what does it have to do with runecrafting?
translation: 好吧……那这和符石制作有什么关系？

english: In truth, nothing at all. However, it has everything to do with teleportation. You see, time and space work differently in the Abyss.
translation: 说实话，毫无关系。但是，它和传送息息相关。你看，时间和空间在深渊里的运作方式不同。

english: For example, you can travel to the Abyss, walk a few steps and then exit, only to find yourself somewhere completely different from where you entered. You might even find yourself on a different plane.
translation: 例如，你可以去深渊，走几步再出来，结果发现自己到了跟入口完全不同的地方。甚至可能发现自己到了另一个位面。

english: You can also enter the Abyss and spend days there, but on your return, only moments have passed.
translation: 你也可以进深渊待上几天，但回来时，可能只过了片刻。

english: This is why the Abyss is so useful. It can be used as an effective hub for teleportation. In fact, all teleportation that we know of uses the Abyss, you just don't realise it.
translation: 这就是深渊如此有用的原因。它可以作为传送的有效枢纽。事实上，我们所知的所有传送都使用了深渊，只是你没意识到。

english: Wait... So when I teleport, I'm actually travelling through the Abyss?
translation: 等等……所以我传送时，实际上是在穿越深渊？

english: In some ways, I suppose you are. Whenever you use a teleport spell, that spell is actually travelling through the Abyss and using it to link two places together.
translation: 某种程度上，我想是吧。每当你用传送法术时，那法术其实就是在穿越深渊，借它把两个地方连起来。

english: So did you discover the Abyss?
translation: 所以深渊是你们发现的？

english: No. Knowledge of the Abyss has existed for a long time, hence it being used for teleportation. However, we believe we may be the first to have properly gained access in centuries.
translation: 不。关于深渊的知识早就有了，所以才被用于传送。不过，我们觉得自己可能是几个世纪以来第一批真正进去的。

english: How did you manage it?
translation: 你们是怎么做到的？

english: By complete accident. One of our initiates was performing a routine teleportation experiment when something went wrong. Instead of ending up at their destination, they found themselves in the Abyss.
translation: 纯属意外。我们有个学徒在做常规传送实验时出了岔子。没到目的地，反倒发现自己到了深渊。

english: Now, did you want something else?
translation: 现在你还有别的事吗？

english: Can you tell me more about your group?
translation: 你能多告诉我一些关于你们组织的事吗？

english: I suppose you have proven yourself trustworthy. We are a group of mages in service to Zamorak. Our group is called the Zamorak Magical Institute, or Z.M.I. for short.
translation: 我想你已经证明自己值得信任了。我们是一群效忠扎莫拉克的法师，组织名叫扎莫拉克魔法学院，简称 Z.M.I.。

english: Few actually know of us. Saradominist groups like the Order of Wizards hold sway over these lands, so we are forced to work in the shadows. However, make no mistake, our power far exceeds theirs.
translation: 知道我们的人不多。像巫师教团这样的萨拉多明派组织在这片土地上势力很大，所以我们只能在暗处活动。不过别误会，我们的实力远超他们。

english: You don't seem to like the Order of Wizards very much.
translation: 你似乎不太喜欢巫师教团。

english: And why would we? Did you know that the Order of Wizards wasn't always a Saradominist group? Once they allowed mages of all faiths to study with them, but they became greedy.
translation: 我们为什么要喜欢？你知道巫师教团可不一直是萨拉多明派吗？以前他们允许各派法师一起学习，后来却变得贪婪了。

english: What happened?
translation: 发生了什么事？

english: They started to desire more control. They banned Zamorakian wizards from certain areas of study, claiming them to be too dangerous. In reality, they just wanted that knowledge for themselves.
translation: 他们开始想要更多控制权。禁止扎莫拉克法师研究某些领域，说那些太危险。其实，他们只是想独占那些知识罢了。

english: It all went wrong for them, of course. A Zamorakian wizard made a great breakthrough in teleportation magic, but the Saradominists stole his research.
translation: 当然，后来全让他们搞砸了。有位扎莫拉克法师在传送魔法上取得重大突破，结果萨拉多明派偷走了他的研究成果。

english: They used it to perform a ritual, but their lack of understanding caused it to go wrong. The entire Wizards' Tower burnt down. Many were killed, and years of research was destroyed.
translation: 他们用它来进行仪式，但由于缺乏理解导致出错。整个法师塔被烧毁。许多人丧生，多年的研究被毁。

english: Naturally, they blamed the Zamorakians. Claimed we intentionally burnt the tower down. After the tower was rebuilt, we were banished from the Order of Wizards and forced underground.
translation: 自然地，他们责怪扎莫拉克信徒。声称我们故意烧毁了塔。塔重建后，我们被逐出巫师教团，被迫转入地下。

english: And that's how the Z.M.I. was formed?
translation: Z.M.I. 就是这样成立的？

english: Exactly.
translation: 没错。

english: Nothing. I'm just looking around.
translation: 没什么，我只是随便看看。

english: Very well.
translation: 很好。

english: Here you go.
translation: 给，拿好。

english: You are handed a torn part of a clue scroll.
translation: 你获得了一张线索卷轴碎片。

english: Ah! You have chosen some quite fantastic attire. Maybe you are not such a fool after all.
translation: 啊！你选了一些相当棒的服装。也许你没那么蠢。

english: Let's see what you're selling.
translation: 看看你在卖什么。

english: Could you teleport me to the Abyss?
translation: 你能传送我去深渊吗？

english: Alright, I'll go.
translation: 好吧，我去。

english: About that incantation your initiate gave me...
translation: 关于你的学徒给我的那段咒语……

english: Can you tell me more about the Abyss?
translation: 你能多告诉我一些关于深渊的事吗？

english: Can you tell me more about your group?
translation: 你能多告诉我一些关于你们组织的事吗？

english: Nothing. I'm just looking around.
translation: 没什么，我只是随便看看。

english: What's that ladder next to the altar for?
translation: 祭坛旁边的梯子是做什么的？

english: An...archeological dig. Yeah, a dig.
translation: 一个……考古挖掘。是的，挖掘。

english: Why?
translation: 为什么？

english: Next to a Chaos Altar? That's a bit odd. Can I go down and have a look?
translation: 在混沌祭坛旁边？有点奇怪。我能下去看看吗？

english: Well...I suppose. See, we found this ancient altar, but it was pretty broken so the Z.M.I. sent some of its researchers to try and repair it.
translation: 嗯……我想可以。你看，我们发现了这个古老祭坛，但它破损严重，所以 Z.M.I. 派了一些研究人员试图修复它。

english: How'd that work out for them?
translation: 他们进展如何？

english: Pretty well - only one died. Still, they got it working...sort of. This ancient technology can be tricky.
translation: 相当不错——只死了一个。不过，他们让它运作起来了……某种程度上。这种古老技术可能很棘手。

english: What do you mean, 'sort of'? Altars either work or don't work.
translation: 你什么意思，“某种程度上”？祭坛要么能用，要么不能用。

english: This one works, just not as you'd expect. You put pure essence in, but get random runes back. Some of them we don't even know how to craft!
translation: 这个能用，只是不像你期望的那样。你放入纯净精华，但会得到随机符石。有些我们甚至不知道如何制作！

english: Sounds like a pretty good deal. Can I give it a go?
translation: 听起来相当划算。我能试试吗？

english: I don't think so. The mages don't like outsiders going in; they'll probably attack you. They only patrol the short path, though, so if you used the long path, through a tunnel near the entrance, you'd probably be safe.
translation: 我不这么认为。法师们不喜欢外人进去；他们可能会攻击你。不过他们只巡逻短路径，所以如果你走长路径，穿过入口附近的隧道，你可能就安全了。

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Good day, newcomer. My name is Terrova. I'm here to tell you about Magic. Let's start by opening your magic interface.
translation: 你好，新人。我叫特罗瓦。我是来告诉你关于魔法的事。我们先打开你的魔法界面。

english: All you have to do is open the magic interface by clicking on the flashing icon.
translation: 你只需点击闪烁的图标打开魔法界面。

english: Currently you can only cast one offensive spell called Wind Strike. Let's try it out on one of those chickens.
translation: 目前你只能施放一个攻击法术叫风击。我们在那只鸡身上试试。

english: Sorry, I don't have any more runes just now. But I see you have plenty.
translation: 抱歉，我现在没有更多符石了。但我看你有很多。

english: Well, you're all finished here now. I'll give you a reasonable number of runes when you leave.
translation: 好了，你在这儿都弄完了。等你走的时候，我给你一些符石。

english: When you get to the mainland you will find yourself in the town of Lumbridge. If you want some ideas on where to go next, talk to my friend Adventurer Jon. You can't miss him; he's wearing light blue armour with
translation: 当你到达大陆时，你会发现自己身处仑桥镇。如果你想知道接下来去哪，找我的朋友冒险者乔恩谈谈。你不会错过他的；他穿着浅蓝色盔甲，拿着一把巨剑。还有许多导师愿意教你各种技能。

english: a huge sword. There are also many tutors willing to teach you about the many skills you could learn.
translation: 准备好！

english: Prepare yourself!
translation: 顺便问一下，你打算成为铁人 [man/woman] 吗？

english: Were you planning to become an Iron[man/woman], by the way?
translation: 什么是铁人 [man/woman]？

english: What's an Iron[man/woman]?
translation: 什么是铁人 [man/woman]？

english: If you're interested in that, you should go and ask the Iron[man/woman] tutor before you leave this island. He's standing outside my house.
translation: 如果你对此感兴趣，离开这个岛之前你应该去问问铁人 [man/woman] 导师。他就站在我的房子外面。

english: Thanks, I'd better go and find him.
translation: 谢谢，我最好去找他。

english: Yes, I do want to become an Iron[man/woman].
translation: 是的，我想成为铁人 [man/woman]。

english: No, I'm not planning to do that.
translation: 不，我没打算那样做。

english: When you get to the mainland you will find yourself in the town of Lumbridge. If you want some ideas on where to go next, talk to my friend the Lumbridge Guide. You can't miss him; he's holding a big staff with
translation: 当你到达大陆时，你会发现自己身处仑桥镇。如果你想知道接下来去哪，找我的朋友仑桥镇向导谈谈。你不会错过他的；

english: a question mark on the end. He also has a white beard and carries a rucksack full of scrolls. There are also many tutors willing to teach you about the many skills you could learn.
translation: 他拿着一根顶端有问号的大法杖。他还留着白胡子，背着一个装满卷轴的背包。还有许多导师愿意教你各种技能。

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: What's an Iron[man/woman]?
translation: 什么是铁人 [man/woman]？

english: Yes, I do want to become an Iron[man/woman].
translation: 是的，我想成为铁人 [man/woman]。

english: No, I'm not planning to do that.
translation: 不，我没打算那样做。

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: Hello there adventurer, I am the Magic combat tutor. Would you like to learn about magic combat, or perhaps how to make runes?
translation: 你好冒险者，我是魔法导师。你想学习魔法，还是如何制作符石？

english: Tell me about magic combat please.
translation: 请和我说说魔法的事。

english: This is your spell book, this contains all the spells you can cast. To cast a spell, you will need to have the required magic level and have the right amount of the runes used to cast the spell.
translation: 这是你的法术书，里面有你所有能放的法术。要施放法术，你得达到要求的魔法等级，还得有足够的符石。

english: To check the level and runes required to cast a spell, hover your mouse cursor over the spell.
translation: 要检查施放法术所需的等级和符石，将鼠标光标悬停在法术上。

english: If you have the right amount of runes and the magic level the spell will light up, meaning you will be able to cast it.
translation: 如果你有足够的符石和魔法等级，法术会亮起，意味着你可以施放它。

english: When you have a combat spell available, click on it once, then select your target. A good target would be a monster that is below your combat level.
translation: 当你有可用的战斗法术时，点击它一次，然后选择你的目标。好的目标是低于你战斗等级的怪物。

english: Try rats in the castle or, if you're feeling brave, the goblins to the west have been causing a nuisance of themselves.
translation: 试试城堡里的老鼠，如果你有勇气，西边的哥布林一直在制造麻烦，你也可以试试。

english: Nemarti, the Ranged Combat tutor and I both give out items every 30 minutes, however you must choose whether you want runes or ranged equipment.
translation: 内玛蒂，远程战斗导师和我每30分钟都会发放物品，但你必须选择是要符石还是远程装备。

english: To claim runes, right-click on me and choose Claim, to claim ranged equipment right-click on the Ranged Combat tutor and select Claim.
translation: 要领取符石，右键点击我并选择领取，要领取远程装备右键点击远程战斗导师并选择领取。

english: If you need some more advice, you should talk to Adventurer Jon about Adventure paths. He may even have a handy starter kit you can use.
translation: 如果你需要更多建议，你应该和冒险者乔恩谈谈冒险之路。他甚至可能有现成的新手包供你使用

english: Is there anything else you would like to know?
translation: 还有什么你想知道的吗？

english: Of course [player name]! As a rule of thumb, if you cast the highest spell of which you're capable, you'll get the best experience possible.
translation: 当然 [player name]！一般来说，如果你施放你能使用的最高级法术，你将获得最好的经验。

english: Superheat Item and the Alchemy spells are good ways to level magic if you are not interested in the combat aspect of magic.
translation: 如果你不感兴趣魔法的战斗方面，超级加热物品和炼金法术是提升魔法等级的好方法。

english: There's always the Magic Training Arena. You can find it north of the Emir's Arena, north-east of Al Kharid. You will be able to earn some special rewards there by practicing your magic there.
translation: 还有魔法训练竞技场。你可以在埃米尔竞技场北边，阿尔卡里德城东北边找到它。在那里练习魔法你将能获得一些特殊奖励。

english: If you want a challenge, Kolodion, the master of battle magic, has set up an arena deep in the Wilderness. There you will have the chance to learn some extremely powerful spells.
translation: 如果你想要挑战，战斗魔法大师科洛迪恩在荒野深处设立了一个竞技场。在那里你将有机会学习一些极其强大的法术。

english: You should investigate the treasure in the desert, you may find great benefit to your magic.
translation: 你应该调查沙漠中的宝藏，你可能会发现对你的魔法大有裨益。

english: Speak to the Archaeologist in the Bedabin Camp, south- west of the Shantay Pass. But be careful, this quest is not for the faint of heart and can be very dangerous.
translation: 和沙泰隘口西南边的贝达宾营地的考古学家谈谈。但要小心，这个任务不适合胆小的人，可能非常危险。

english: I see you already have access to the ancient magicks. Well done, these will aid you greatly.
translation: 我看你已经可以使用古代魔法了。做得好，这些将大大帮助你。

english: I see you have already met Kolodion, you should keep practicing those spells. Maybe you will be able to use them outside the arena after practicing them enough times.
translation: 我看你已经见过科洛迪恩了，你应该继续练习那些法术。也许练习足够多次后，你就能在竞技场外使用它们。

english: How do I make runes?
translation: 我怎么制作符石？

english: There are a couple of things you will need to make runes, rune essence and a talisman to enter the temple ruins.
translation: 制作符石你需要几样东西，符文精华和进入神庙废墟的护符。

english: To get rune essence you will need to gather them somehow. You should talk to the Duke of Lumbridge, he may be able to help you with that. Alternatively, other players may sell you the essence.
translation: 要获得符文精华你需要以某种方式收集它们。你应该和仑桥镇公爵谈谈，他也许能帮你。或者，其他玩家可能会卖给你精华。

english: As you're fairly new to runecrafting you should start with air runes and mind runes.
translation: 由于你对符石制作相当陌生，你应该从风符石和心智符石开始。

english: You will need a talisman for the rune you would like to create. You can right-click on it and select the Locate option. This will tell you the rough location of the altar.
translation: 你需要一个你想创建的符石的护符。你可以右键点击它并选择定位选项。这将告诉你祭坛的大致位置。

english: When you find the ruined altar, use the talisman on it to be transported to a temple where you can craft your runes.
translation: 当你找到废墟祭坛时，在上面使用护符将被传送到一个你可以制作符石的神庙。

english: Clicking on the temple's altar will imbue your rune essence with the altar's magical property.
translation: 点一下神庙祭坛，就能让符文精华带上祭坛的魔法属性。

english: If you want to save yourself an inventory space, you could always try binding the talisman to a tiara.

translation: 要获得符文精华你需要在精华矿收集它们。你可以通过和维洛克东南方拥有符石店的奥布里谈话到达矿井。

translation: 我们聊聊当我捡起符石时它们的行为。

translation: 当你从地上捡起符石时，如果你携带着一个包含匹配符石的符石袋，我可以让捡起的符石直接进入袋子，只要有空间。

translation: 或者，你可以让它们像往常一样进入你的物品栏。

translation: 当然！当你捡起符石时，符石将进入你的物品栏，而不是进入符石袋。

english: You can also control this option via the Settings menu, rather than having to return to this Tutor in future.

translation: 我看你已经从我在维洛克的朋友奥布里那里知道了符文精华矿。所以你需要把那些精华变成符石，呃？

translation: 开始前你需要一个心智护符或风护符。这将使你能够找到并使用祭坛废墟。

english: When you have your talisman, right-click on it and select the Locate option. It will point you in the direction of the ruined altar.
translation: 当你有了护符，右键点击它并选择定位选项。它将指向废墟祭坛的方向。

english: You'll need some Rune Essence with you before you go looking. When you find the ruined altar, use the talisman on it to be transported to a temple where you can craft your runes.
translation: 出发寻找前你需要带一些符文精华。当你找到废墟祭坛时，在上面使用护符将被传送到一个你可以制作符石的神庙。

translation: 米卡西给你30个心智符石。

english: I work with the Ranged Combat tutor to give out consumable items that you may need for combat such as arrows and runes. However we have had some cheeky people try to take both!
translation: 我和远程战斗导师合作发放你可能需要的战斗消耗品，如箭和符石。不过我们遇到了一些厚脸皮的人试图两者都拿！

english: So, every half an hour, you may come back and claim either arrows OR runes, but not both. Come back in a while for runes, or simply make your own.
translation: 所以，每半小时，你可以回来领取箭或符石，但不能两者都拿。过会儿再来拿符石，或者干脆自己制作。

translation: 你好！水晶城今天天气真好，是吧？

translation: 各种各样的事！那些塔楼是非常值得一看的景观。

translation: 像今天这样的好日子，我建议去市场逛逛。

translation: 哦！请雇用我，[sir/madam]！我很能干，嗯，还不错，我的费用只要1000金币。

translation: 嗯，我可以，呃。我可以做饭泡茶等等，我甚至可以帮你存取银行物品。这次我不会犯错了，一切都会好的！

translation: 我不得不使用它因为盘子不够了。而且没人告诉我丹尼斯生病没喂狗，所以我没想到我端食物时它们会扑向我，

translation: 你被雇用了……嗯，我身上没带钱，但我能欠你吗？我说话算话，真的。

english: Oh... I'm terribly sorry, [sir/madam], but I'd really prefer to be paid before I start work.
translation: 哦……非常抱歉，[sir/madam]，但我真的更喜欢在工作前得到报酬。

english: You're hired!
translation: 你被雇用了！

english: Oh! Oh, thank you [sir/madam], thank you!
translation: 哦！哦，谢谢你 [sir/madam]，谢谢！

english: What can you do?
translation: 你能做什么？

english: Tell me about your previous jobs
translation: 跟我说说你以前的工作

english: You're hired!
translation: 你被雇用了！

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Oh! Take that horrid thing off your head immediately!
translation: 哦！立刻把你头上那个可怕的东西拿下来！

english: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。

english: You're not going into deeper water with that bowl.
translation: 你不能戴着那个碗进入更深的水域。

english: Why don't you like my helmet?
translation: 你为什么不喜欢我的头盔？

english: My sister was once trapped in one of those for a long time by your kind. It was awful and she's still terrified of them. We don't allow them beyond this point anymore.
translation: 我姐姐曾经被你们这种人困在那种东西里很长时间。太可怕了，她至今仍害怕它们。我们不再允许它们越过这个界限。

english: What shall I do with it?
translation: 我该怎么处理它？

english: Put it on the pile over there.
translation: 把它放在那边那堆上。

english: But how will I breathe?
translation: 但我怎么呼吸？

english: Breathing is for pesky humans.
translation: 呼吸是讨厌的人类才需要的。

english: Yes. I am one.
translation: 是的。我就是。

english: Oops. Nevermind. I'm sure you'll manage. Just look for bubbles.
translation: 哎呀。没关系。我相信你能应付。只要找气泡就行。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: I'm Mairin, one of the many merfolk here.
translation: 我是麦琳，这里众多人鱼族之一。

english: Many? I don't see that many...
translation: 众多？我没看到那么多……

english: Just because you don't see us, doesn't mean we're not there.
translation: 仅仅因为你没看到我们，不代表我们不在那里。

english: That's kind of creepy. What do you actually do?
translation: 有点吓人。你实际上做什么？

english: Mostly stop people entering beyond this wreck with those horrid fishbowls.
translation: 主要是阻止人们戴着那些可怕的鱼缸进入这片沉船区域。

english: How do I breathe underwater without a helmet.
translation: 我如何不戴头盔在水下呼吸。

english: Just find some bubbles, or other sources of air.
translation: 只要找些气泡，或其他空气来源。

english: Other sources?
translation: 其他来源？

english: Yes, some fish can be a good source of air too..
translation: 是的，有些鱼也可以是很好的空气来源……

english: Is there anything I can do to help you?
translation: 有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: Yes! You can collect the tears of my poor trapped sister.
translation: 是的！你可以收集我可怜的被困姐姐的眼泪。

english: What? Tears? But, they're water, surely underwater they would...
translation: 什么？眼泪？但是，那是水，在水下肯定会……

english: She's a mermaid, like me. Didn't you know our tears are the pearls of the sea? You humans.
translation: 她是美人鱼，像我一样。你不知道我们的眼泪是海之珍珠吗？你们人类。

english: Ok, keep your scales on. Where would I find these tears?
translation: 好吧，别激动。我在哪里能找到这些眼泪？

english: They usually end up secreted in clams or other places.
translation: 它们通常最终藏在蛤蜊或其他地方。

english: What do I get out of it?
translation: 我能得到什么？

english: Well, I have access to a lot of old stuff that's fallen down under the water, so I'm sure I could reward you in some way.
translation: 嗯，我可以接触到很多掉进水下的旧东西，所以我肯定能以某种方式奖励你。

translation: 如果你找到任何特殊的闪烁眼泪，我还可以教你一些有用的敏捷和偷窃技巧。所以你会帮我吗？

english: You're back! I just had an interesting chat with a group of lesser gods. Seems you dealt a heavy blow to the Devourer and made some powerful new friends in the process.
translation: 你回来了！我刚和一群次级神聊了聊。看来你给了吞噬者沉重一击，并在此过程中结交了一些强大的新朋友。

english: It didn't go perfectly. Amascut still escaped, and she'd already gained a fair amount of power by that point.
translation: 进展并不完美。阿玛斯卡特还是逃走了，而且那时她已经获得了相当多的力量。

english: True, but things could have wound up going a lot worse. You're right though, this is clearly far from over.
translation: 确实，但情况本可能变得更糟。不过你说得对，这显然远未结束。

english: Where do you think she'll have gone? Menaphos?
translation: 你认为她会去哪里？梅纳菲斯？

english: Most likely. She didn't go to all the effort of causing those plagues for nothing. This tomb was clearly only part of her plan.
translation: 最有可能。她费尽心机制造那些瘟疫不是没有目的的。这座墓显然只是她计划的一部分。

english: Still, she'll need to reconsider her strategy after her defeat. We have a little time now.
translation: 不过，战败后她需要重新考虑策略。我们现在有一点时间。

english: Hopefully time for the city to reopen again. What will you do in the meantime?
translation: 希望这段时间城市能重新开放。在此期间你会做什么？

english: The lesser gods were under the Devourer's control for a long time, and a lot's changed since they disappeared. I've offered to help them where I can.
translation: 次级神们被吞噬者控制了很久，自从他们消失后发生了很多变化。我已提出在力所能及的范围内帮助他们。

english: Then I guess this is goodbye for now.
translation: 那我想暂时再见了。

english: Indeed, but before I go, I have something for you.
translation: 确实，但在我走之前，我有东西给你。

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！

english: Don't mention it. Now, take care of yourself out there.
translation: 别客气。现在，在外面照顾好自己。

english: And you.
translation: 你也是。

english: Maisa departs.
translation: 麦莎离开。

english: Hello there! I am known as the Makeover Mage! I have spent many years researching magics that can change your physical appearance!
translation: 你好！我是改造法师！我花了多年研究可以改变你外貌的魔法！

english: I can alter your physical form with my magic, there's no fee. Would you like me to perform my magics upon you?
translation: 我可以用魔法改变你的形体，免费。你想让我对你施法吗？

english: Tell me more about this 'make-over'.
translation: 多告诉我一些关于这个“改造”的事。

english: Why, of course! Basically, and I will try and explain this so that you will understand it correctly,
translation: 为什么，当然！基本上，我会试着解释以便你正确理解，

english: I use my secret magical technique to melt your body down into a puddle of its elements.
translation: 我用我的秘密魔法技巧将你的身体融化成一滩元素。

english: When I have broken down all trace of your body, I then rebuild it into the form I am thinking of!
translation: 当我分解了你身体的所有痕迹后，我再将其重建成我想象中的形态！

english: Or, you know, somewhere vaguely close enough anyway.
translation: 或者，你知道，反正差不多接近就行了。

english: Uh... that doesn't sound particularly safe to me...
translation: 呃……这听起来不太安全……

english: It's as safe as houses! Why, I have only had thirty-six major accidents this month!
translation: 像房子一样安全！为什么，我这个月只发生了三十六起重大事故！

english: So what do you say? Feel like a change? There's no fee.
translation: 那么你怎么说？想改变一下吗？免费。

english: Sure, I'll have a makeover.
translation: 当然，我要改造。

english: Good choice, good choice. You wouldn't want to carry on looking like that, I'm sure!
translation: 好选择，好选择。我肯定你不想继续那样看起来！

english: Woah!
translation: 哇！

english: What?
translation: 什么？

english: You still look human!
translation: 你看起来还是人类！

english: Uh... Thanks, I guess.
translation: 呃……谢谢，我想。

english: Hmm... you didn't feel any unexpected growths anywhere around your head just then did you?
translation: 嗯……你刚才没感觉到头上任何地方有意外生长吧？

english: Good, good! I was worried for a second there!
translation: 好，好！我刚才担心了一下！

english: Whew! That was lucky!
translation: 呼！真幸运！

english: What was?
translation: 什么幸运？

english: Nothing! It's all fine! You seem alive anyway!
translation: 没什么！一切都好！你反正还活着！

english: Two arms... two legs... one head... it seems that spell finally worked okay!
translation: 两只胳膊……两条腿……一个头……看来那个法术终于起作用了！

english: Cool amulet! Can I have one?
translation: 很酷的护符！能给我一个吗？

english: No problem, but please remember that the amulet I will sell you is only a copy of my own. It contains no magical powers, and as such will only cost you 100 coins.
translation: 没问题，但请记住我卖给你的护符只是我自己的复制品。它不含魔法力量，因此只需100金币。

english: Oh, I don't have enough money for that.
translation: 哦，我没有足够的钱。

english: Anyway, would you like me to alter your physical form? For you, I'll do it for free!
translation: 不管怎样，你想让我改变你的形体吗？对你，我免费做！

english: No way! That's far too expensive.
translation: 没门！那太贵了。

english: That's fair enough, my jewellery is not to everyone's taste.
translation: 那也合理，我的珠宝不是人人都喜欢。

english: Sure, here you go.
translation: 当然可以。

english: I don't have room to hold it. Maybe another time.
translation: 我没空间拿。也许下次吧。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Ehhh... suit yourself.
translation: 呃……随你便。

english: Ahah!
translation: 啊哈！

english: Ooh!
translation: 哦！

english: Tell me more about this 'make-over'.
translation: 多告诉我一些关于这个“改造”的事。

english: Sure, I'll have a makeover.
translation: 当然，我要改造。

english: Cool amulet! Can I have one?
translation: 很酷的护符！能给我一个吗？

english: Sure, here you go.
translation: 当然可以。

english: No way! That's far too expensive.
translation: 没门！那太贵了。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Be lucky I have let you live, meat. Our deal is done, I wish no further dealing with you.
translation: 算你幸运我让你活着，蠢货。我们的交易完成了，我不想再和你打交道。

english: Your animals don't look too healthy.
translation: 你的动物看起来不太健康。

english: It's that fountain thingy in the temple to the east. It's turned them all into zombies.
translation: 是东边神庙里的那个喷泉玩意儿。把它们都变成了僵尸。

english: What use are zombie animals?
translation: 僵尸动物有什么用？

english: None at all, mate, except that those worshippers at that temple keep comin' and killin' 'em all for their bones. Don't ask me why.
translation: 一点用都没有，伙计，除了那个神庙的信徒们一直来杀它们取骨头。别问我为什么。

english: But you're a ghost - surely you know something about it.
translation: 但你是鬼魂——你肯定知道些什么。

english: I don't know nuthin' about nuthin'. Oim a simple ghost with simple needs. All I know is, years ago, that temple started glowing green and, a few months later, I woke up dead. That's all there is to it.
translation: 我什么都不知道。我只是个需求简单的鬼魂。我只知道，几年前，那个神庙开始发绿光，几个月后，我醒来发现自己死了。就这样。

english: Hey leave me alone, can't you see that I'm busy?
translation: 嘿别烦我，你没看见我很忙吗？

english: Oohh, my arms.
translation: 哦，我的胳膊。

english: Work, work, work, that's all I ever do.
translation: 工作，工作，工作，这就是我做的所有事。

english: I feel so weak, I could faint.
translation: 我觉得好虚弱，快要晕倒了。

english: I'm so tired, I could sleep standing up.
translation: 我太累了，站着都能睡着。

english: What I wouldn't give for a good night's rest.
translation: 只要能好好睡一晚我什么都愿意给。

english: Ooh, my back.
translation: 哦，我的背。

english: I'm rich in experience, poor in wealth.
translation: 我经验丰富，财富贫乏。

english: I can't think straight I'm so tired.
translation: 我太累了，脑子都转不动了。

english: I'm sick of this place.
translation: 我受够了这个地方。

english: Beware the rowdies, they're spoiling for a fight.
translation: 小心那些闹事者，他们正想找架打。

english: One day I'm gonna get out of here.
translation: 总有一天我要离开这里。

english: I need a new pick axe.
translation: 我需要一把新镐。

english: Work, work work, that's all I ever do!
translation: 工作，工作工作，这就是我做的所有事！

english: Good luck to ya, you're gonna need it.
translation: 祝你好运，你会需要的。

english: So, [player name], your curiosity leads you to speak to me?
translation: 那么，[player name]，你的好奇心驱使你来找我说话？

english: About those enchanted secateurs again...
translation: 关于那些附魔修枝剪……

english: What now, [player name], can't you just leave me alone to practice my art?
translation: 现在又怎样，[player name]，你就不能让我独自练习我的艺术吗？

english: Can I get another set of enchanted secateurs?
translation: 我能再要一套附魔修枝剪吗？

english: Well I guess it's your lucky day! Since your last visit I've been thinking, I never use my enchanted secateurs anymore, I could sell them to you, if you like.
translation: 嗯我想今天是你的幸运日！自从你上次来访我一直在想，我再也不用我的附魔修枝剪了，如果你喜欢我可以卖给你。

english: That's great!
translation: 太好了！

english: How much would they cost?
translation: 多少钱？

english: I could let you have them for a mere 40,000 gp.
translation: 我可以仅以40,000金币卖给你。

english: 40,000! That's outrageous!
Well, that's my price. If you change your mind, you can come back and talk to me. Good day.
translation: 嗯，那是我的价格。如果你改变主意，可以回来找我。你好。

english: That's too expensive for me I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕那太贵了。

english: Ok, great.
translation: 好的，太好了。

english: A pleasure doing business with you, [player name].
translation: 很高兴与你做生意，[player name]。

english: You don't have room to hold them. Stop wasting my time.
translation: 你没空间拿。别浪费我的时间。

english: You don't have 40,000 gp with you! Do you take me for a fool?
translation: 你身上没有40,000金币！你当我是傻瓜吗？

english: Sorry, I didn't realise. I'll have to visit a bank.
translation: 抱歉，我没意识到。我得去银行。

english: Fine, I might see you later then.
translation: 好吧，那也许待会儿见。

english: Sorry to have bothered you.
translation: 抱歉打扰你了。

english: That's ok, I shouldn't have been so abrupt with you.
translation: 没关系，我不该对你那么唐突。

english: Could you spare me a brown apron?
translation: 你能给我一条棕色围裙吗？

english: Oh, if you must.
translation: 哦，既然你坚持。

english: Can I have some more bone seeds?
translation: 我能再要一些骨头种子吗？

english: You fetch me a pot with a lid first.
translation: 你先给我拿个带盖的罐子。

english: Fortunately I do have another pot with a lid.
translation: 幸好我确实有另一个带盖的罐子。

english: Yes, yes, have fun with them!
translation: 是的，是的，玩得开心！

english: Who are you and what are you doing here?
translation: 你是谁，你在这里做什么？

english: I am the great Malignius Mortifer, wielder of strange and terrible powers. These lowly followers of mine are dedicated students of the magical arts. Their business is to follow me and learn all they can.
translation: 我是伟大的马利尼乌斯‧莫蒂弗，掌握着奇怪而可怕的力量。我这些卑微的追随者是魔法艺术的虔诚信徒。他们的任务是跟随我并尽他们所能学习。

english: They don't look very tough.
translation: 他们看起来不太厉害。

english: You may believe that, but even if you strike one down, another will rise up within minutes.
translation: 你也许那么认为，但即使你击倒一个，另一个也会在几分钟内站起来。

english: Yeah, right.
translation: 是啊，对。

english: Each of my followers is a master of his chosen element. His life becomes bound to that element in a way you could not hope to understand.
translation: 我的每个追随者都是他所选元素的大师。他的生命以你无法理解的方式与该元素绑定。

english: And what do you do?
translation: 那你做什么？

english: I am mastering a branch of magic that few dare to attempt: Necromancy! The fools in the Guild of Wizards shun anyone who practices this art, but there are a few in this land who know the rudiments.
translation: 我正在掌握一门很少有人敢尝试的魔法分支：死灵法术！法师公会里的傻瓜们回避任何练习这门艺术的人，但这片土地上还是有几个人知道基础知识。

english: Grayzag, Invrigar, Sithik... Even Melzar studied the methods of necromancy, until an accident affected his mind. Now his spells tend to result in...
translation: 格雷扎格，因弗里加，西锡克……甚至梅尔扎也研究过死灵法术的方法，直到一场事故影响了他的心智。如今他的法术往往会……

english: Grayzag and Invrigar... Even Melzar studied the methods of necromancy, until an accident affected his mind. Now his spells tend to result in...
translation: 格雷扎格和因弗里加……甚至梅尔扎也研究过死灵法术的方法，直到一场事故影响了他的心智。如今他的法术往往会……

english: ... well, let us simply say that he does NOT raise armies of undead minions.
translation: ……嗯，我们干脆说他并没有召唤出不死仆从大军。

english: Is this like Summoning? Can you teach me?
translation: 这和召唤一样吗？你能教我吗？

english: The obscure magical art of necromancy has nothing to do with Summoning.
translation: 晦涩的死灵法术艺术与召唤毫无关系。

english: Through necromancy, I may resurrect the bodies of those who have fallen, and bend them to my will, and even command them to tell me hidden knowledge.
translation: 通过死灵法术，我可以复活那些倒下者的身体，使他们屈从于我的意志，甚至命令他们告诉我隐藏的知识。

english: I shall not pass on my secrets lightly to any passer-by!
translation: 我不会轻易将我的秘密传给任何路人！

english: Even a mighty hero like me?
translation: 即使是像我这样的强大英雄？

english: Perhaps one day you shall learn ways to summon creatures to your side, but my own work is of a different sort.
translation: 也许有一天你会学习召唤生物到你身边的方法，但我自己的工作不同。

english: Deluded lover of Guthix, you will get no secrets from me!
translation: 被蒙蔽的古斯信徒，你从我这里得不到任何秘密！

english: Saradominist fool, you will get no secrets from me!
translation: 萨拉多明派傻瓜，你从我这里得不到秘密！

english: Although I note your respect for our Lord Zamorak, I am afraid the subtle secrets of necromancy must remain beyond your grasp.
translation: 虽然我注意到你对我主扎莫拉克的尊敬，但恐怕死灵法术的微妙秘密你难以掌握。

english: What happened to Melzar?
translation: 梅尔扎发生了什么事？

english: The forces required to wield power over the dead are very difficult to control. Melzar's concentration slipped, and his spell rebounded upon him.
translation: 驾驭亡者所需的力量极难掌控。梅尔扎的注意力松懈，他的法术反弹到了他身上。

english: Although he did not die, his mind broke. Now he dwells amidst the beasts that fill his strange home, and when he attempts to do magic he gets... amusing results.
translation: 虽然他没有死，但他的心智崩溃了。如今他栖身于那座怪异宅邸中，与野兽为伴，每当他尝试施法，便会得到……有趣的结果。

english: Why do you keep making fungi appear?
translation: 你为什么一直让真菌出现？

english: Necromancy is... still not fully understood. So few people dare to study it. Although my spells usually raise whichever undead creature I desire, they sometimes misfire. As Melzar has learnt!
translation: 死灵法术……仍未被完全理解。很少有人敢研究它。虽然我的法术通常能召唤出我想要的任何亡灵生物，但有时会出岔子。正如梅尔扎所学到的！

english: Thanks, I'll be off now.
translation: 谢谢，我现在走了。

english: I am sure your curiosity will eventually draw you to speak to me again, [player name].
translation: 我相信你的好奇心最终会驱使你再找我说话，[player name]。

english: Can you teach me something about magic?
translation: 你能教我一些关于魔法的事吗？

english: I see no glimmer of understanding in your eyes; my time would be wasted trying to teach you of the subtle arts.
translation: 你眼中毫无领悟之光；若要我教你这些精妙法术，不过是枉费时间。

english: If you are truly interested in magic, perhaps you should go and speak to the Duke of Lumbridge, who lives east of this place. Perchance he will have a mission for you that will teach you something.
translation: 如果你真的对魔法感兴趣，也许你应该去和住在此地东边的仑桥镇公爵谈谈。也许他会有任务教你一些东西。

english: Ah, you are an inquisitive fellow. I shall speak of the great Wizards' Tower, destroyed by fire many years ago...
translation: 啊，你是个好奇的家伙。我要说说伟大的法师塔，多年前被火摧毁……

english: Many say it was the greatest building in the history of Gielinor, a magnificent monument to human ingenuity.
translation: 许多人说它是基利诺尔历史上最伟大的建筑，是人类智慧的宏伟纪念碑。

english: Yet when humans are offered great power, they so often buy it at the cost of their principles.
translation: 然而当人类获得巨大力量时，往往不惜以原则为代价。

english: Wizards who claimed allegiance to Saradomin began to insist that magic be restricted to the few they deemed 'worthy' of such powers.
translation: 声称效忠萨拉多明的法师开始坚持魔法应限制在他们认为“值得”拥有此类力量的少数人。

english: Before long, those who did not share their fatuous obsession with Saradomin were excluded from the Tower completely. This state of affairs could not continue.
translation: 不久之后，那些不分享他们对萨拉多明的愚蠢痴迷的人被完全排除在塔外。这种状态无法持续。

english: One dark night, a brave band of magi loyal to the great Lord Zamorak stormed the Tower. Despite heavy losses, they fought their way up the levels until they reached the Great Library.
translation: 一个黑暗的夜晚，一群忠于伟大的扎莫拉克领主的勇敢法师突袭了塔。尽管损失惨重，他们一路奋战直到到达大图书馆。

english: Alas, they were trapped and could not steal the precious records. But before they could be defeated, the bravest of them took it upon himself to blast the writings into nothingness, destroying the library.
translation: 唉，他们被困住无法偷走珍贵的记录。但在他们被击败之前，他们中最勇敢的人承担起了将著作炸成虚无的责任，摧毁了图书馆。

english: The ensuing fire raced through the tower, and none escaped its fury. Some say that Lord Zamorak himself fanned the flames to ensure the destruction of his enemies!
translation: 随之而来的大火席卷了塔，无人逃脱其怒火。有人说扎莫拉克领主本人扇风以确保消灭他的敌人！

english: Much of that knowledge was lost, and some has never yet been rediscovered. Still, your efforts on behalf of my colleagues have not been wasted! Once again, the forces of Zamorak can create unlimited runestones!
translation: 许多知识丢失了，有些从未被重新发现。不过，你代表我同事的努力没有白费！扎莫拉克的力量再次可以创造无限的符石！

english: May the world cower in its boots!
translation: 愿世界吓得瑟瑟发抖！

english: I see...
translation: 我明白了……

english: I bid you farewell for now.
translation: 我暂时向你告别。

english: Much of that knowledge was lost, and some has never yet been rediscovered. Still, the power of magic remains in the world, and we who dedicate our lives to its study may yet perform great works...
translation: 许多知识丢失了，有些从未被重新发现。不过，魔法的力量仍存在于世界中，我们这些致力于研究的人仍可能完成伟大的作品……

english: Thanks, I'll be going now.
translation: 谢谢，我现在走了。

english: As you wish.
translation: 如你所愿。

english: About those skeletal magi in the Colony - why don't they disappear now the Colony's safe?
translation: 关于殖民地里的那些骷髅法师——为什么现在殖民地安全了他们不消失？

english: HAHAHA! I never specified how long they'd stay there!
translation: 哈哈哈！我从没指定他们要待多久！

english: So when will they go away? They're in the dormitories, and that's a real nuisance for the colonists!
translation: 那他们什么时候走？他们在宿舍里，这对殖民者来说真麻烦！

english: HAHAHA!
translation: 哈哈哈！

english: So you're not going to get rid of them?
translation: 所以你不打算除掉他们？

english: Oh, forget I asked.
translation: 算了，当我没问。

english: Where can I get clothes like those?
translation: 我在哪里能得到那样的衣服？

english: Bah! Our garments are an outward sign of our dominance of the magical arts. You cannot simply buy them in a shop!
translation: 呸！我们的服装是我们魔法艺术主导地位的外在标志。你不能直接在商店买到！

english: What happens if I kill you and take them?
translation: 如果我杀了你拿走它们会怎样？

english: Try it and see!
translation: 试试看！

english: How about if you teach me enough about magic so I can wear those clothes too?
translation: 如果你教我足够的魔法让我也能穿那些衣服怎么样？

english: How about if I turn you into a mushroom to make you stop bothering me?
translation: 如果我把你变成蘑菇让你别再烦我怎么样？

english: MMMmmph!
translation: 嗯嗯！

english: Actually, I don't want to talk to you.
translation: 其实，我不想和你说话。

english: Bah! Then go away!
translation: 呸！那走开！

english: You should take that pot a bit further away from me before you open it!
translation: 你在打开那个罐子之前应该把它拿得离我远点！

english: Da mihi potentiam!
translation: Da mihi potentiam!

english: Veni, cohortes malefici!
translation: Veni, cohortes malefici!

english: Curses - more fungi!
translation: 诅咒——更多真菌！

english: Blast - fungi again!
translation: 该死——又是真菌！

english: DUUUHHH
translation: 杜嗯

english: OooOOOooooOOOOooo
translation: 哦哦哦哦哦哦哦

english: Krrrrsssss
translation: 克rrrrsssss

translation: 克rrrrsssss

translation: 都是你的。我只要求你预付费用。

english: You'll stop them though, right?

english: Right...
