translation: 你好！

english: Do not think me rude outerlander, but our customs forbid me talking to you. All contact with outerlanders must be vetted by our chieftain, Brundt.
translation: 别认为我粗鲁，外乡人，但我们的习俗禁止我跟你说话。所有与外乡人的接触必须经过我们的酋长布伦特审查。

english: Where is this Brundt?
translation: 这个布伦特在哪？

english: He is standing just over there. He will speak for the tribe.
translation: 他就站在那边。他会代表部落说话。

english: Howdy!
translation: 你好！

english: Hey! It's [Fremennik name]! Let me buy you a drink!
translation: 嘿！是 [Fremennik name]！让我请你喝一杯！

english: There ya go! Anyone who can drink like you earns my respect!
translation: 给你！能像你这样喝酒的人赢得我的尊重！

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: You! I bet you're with them!
translation: 你！我敢打赌你是他们一伙的！

english: Them?
translation: 他们？

english: The frogs!
translation: 青蛙！

english: Frogs? What are you on about?
translation: 青蛙？你在说什么？

english: Ah, I see. So you're going to play dumb are you? Well I won't fall for your lies!
translation: 啊，我明白了。所以你要装傻是吧？好吧我不会上你的当！

english: I promise I have no idea what you're on about. If you explain, maybe I can help you?
translation: 我保证我不知道你在说什么。如果你解释一下，也许我能帮你？

english: It's those frogs on the other side of the oasis! They're out to get us! All of us! If someone doesn't kill them all, we'll be living our lives as their slaves!
translation: 是绿洲那边的青蛙！它们要对付我们！我们所有人！如果没人把它们都杀了，我们就得作为它们的奴隶过一辈子！

english: I see... How about I head over there and take a look?
translation: 我明白了……我去那边看看怎么样？

english: You want to go near them? Well then you're a fool! I will watch from a safe distance as they dine on your corpse!
translation: 你想靠近它们？那你就是傻瓜！我会安全地远远看着它们享用你的尸体！

english: Okay then... Well provided that doesn't happen, I'll be back shortly to let you know what I've found.
translation: 好吧……嗯，假如没发生那种事，我很快回来告诉你我发现了什么。

english: I think I'm just going to go now. You clearly have some... issues that you need to get on top of.
translation: 我想我现在就走了。你显然有一些……需要解决的问题。

english: That's it! You walk away! Just remember, I know the truth!
translation: 就这样！你走了！记住，我知道真相！

english: Hello again. You helped forge my alliance with the frogs against those disgusting flies. Please feel free to use my farming patch in return. It's the least I can do.
translation: 又见面了。你帮助我与青蛙结盟对抗那些恶心的苍蝇。作为回报，请随意使用我的种植地。这是我至少能做的。

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: Would you look after my crops for me?
translation: 你能帮我照看作物吗？

english: Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: 你能给我一些农业建议吗？

english: Can you sell me something?
translation: 你能卖我东西吗？

english: I'll come back another time.
translation: 我下次再来。

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Hello. Here for a drink? You've picked the right place if so.
translation: 你好。来喝酒吗？如果是的话你选对地方了。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Hi there. So much to see here!
translation: 你好。这里太多可看的了！

english: Yep, could be looking all day!
translation: 是的，可以看一整天！

english: Updated any displays yet?
translation: 更新过任何展示了吗？

english: Yes, I just learned more about some priestly warriors and a staff of the gods.
translation: 是的，我刚了解了更多关于祭司战士和神之法杖的事。

english: Sounds fun, how did you do that?
translation: 听起来有趣，你怎么做到的？

english: Ahh, I'm big on quests me, love questing. So when I've done one, I check here with 'Historian' Minas to see if I can help the Museum out with some information. Sometimes they already know it, or don't want to know,
translation: 我特别喜欢做任务。所以每次完成任务后，我都会来找''历史学家''米纳斯，看看能不能用任务所得帮到博物馆。有时他们已经知道了，

english: and sometimes it earns me a reward or two.
translation: 或者不感兴趣，但有时也能让我拿到一两个奖励。

english: That sounds really good. Perhaps I should do the same!
translation: 听起来真不错。也许我也该这么做！

english: You should, as well as everything else there is here in the Museum. Did you know they have a really fun- looking display down in the basement? I love monkeys.
translation: 你应该，还有博物馆里的其他所有东西。你知道他们地下室有个看起来很有趣的展示吗？我喜欢猴子。

english: I'll check it out. Got to get going now, nice talking to you.
translation: 我去看看。现在得走了，很高兴跟你聊天。

english: Have a good day!
translation: 祝你今天愉快！

english: Hi there!
translation: 你好！

english: Hello, what are you doing here?
translation: 你好，你在这里做什么？

english: Oh, just taking a look at these displays. I'm a bit of a history buff.
translation: 哦，只是看看这些展示。我有点是个历史迷。

english: Really? Tell me something I didn't know!
translation: 真的吗？告诉我些我不知道的事！

english: Well, did you know that Bob the Cat is... no, no... you'd never believe me anyway.
translation: 嗯，你知道猫鲍勃是……不，不……反正你也不会相信我。

english: He's what? Tell me!
translation: 他是什么？告诉我！

english: No, no. Couldn't possibly ruin the surprise.
translation: 不，不。可不能破坏惊喜。

english: ARG! Tell me!
translation: 啊！告诉我！

english: If you really want to know, go talk to Unferth in his house in Burthorpe.
translation: 如果你真想知道，去伯索普公国跟乌恩费斯谈谈，在他家里。

english: Hi!
translation: 嗨！

english: Oh, hello. I was just looking at this display here.
translation: 哦，你好。我只是在看这个展示。

english: Anything interesting?
translation: 有什么有趣的吗？

english: Yes, one I just updated by talking to 'Historian' Minas. I'm a bit of a quester you see.
translation: 是的，我刚跟“历史学家”米纳斯谈话更新了一个。你看，我有点是个任务爱好者。

english: Okay, I'll let you get on then.
translation: 好吧，那我不打扰你了。

english: Hmm, yes. Okay. Don't forget to check out the Natural History exhibit - you could learn a lot.
translation: 嗯，是的。好吧。别忘了看看自然历史展览——你能学到很多。

english: Right, bye!
translation: 好的，再见！

english: Hmm... 3rd Age.... No, no...maybe 4th...
translation: 嗯……第三纪元……不，不……也许第四……

english: Hello?
translation: 你好？

english: Yes, that's it, just like that. Mustn't forget the map either....hmm...what else?
translation: 是的，就是这样，就这样。也不能忘了地图……嗯……还有什么？

english: HELLO! Are you there?
translation: 你好！你在吗？

english: Oh, hello there. Sorry, was a bit engrosed in updating this display. I've just been out questing and thought I'd stop off here you see. It's quite rewarding too.
translation: 哦，你好。抱歉，有点专心更新这个展示。我刚出去做任务，想着顺道来这里看看。这也挺有回报的。

english: Yes, well, no need to ignore me.
translation: 是的，嗯，没必要不理我。

english: No offence intended, my dear chap. Just very interested in this history stuff, that's all.
translation: 无意冒犯，亲爱的伙计。只是对这些历史 stuff 很感兴趣，就这样。

english: Okay. Have you seen the Natural History exhibit in the basement?
translation: 好的。你看过地下室的自然历史展览吗？

english: Oh, yes, marvellous isn't it! I particularly like the wyvern, very interesting considering they've never found a live specimen. And to think they could possibly have been flapping around at one time!
translation: 哦，是的，很棒不是吗！我特别喜欢双足飞龙，考虑到他们从未发现过活体标本，这很有趣。想想它们曾经可能四处飞翔！

english: A bit like the crazy gnomes and their gliders. Have you seen the model they have upstairs?
translation: 有点像疯狂的地精和他们的滑翔机。你看过楼上的模型吗？

english: Yes, very intricate isn't it? Worrying to think some people risk their lives in them! You wouldn't catch me up in one. Had a chat with Jacques while I was up there, the art critic...he's a bit funny in the head.
translation: 是的，非常复杂不是吗？想到有些人冒着生命危险坐它们真让人担心！我可不会坐。我上去时跟雅克聊了聊，那个艺术评论家……他脑子有点怪。

english: That's not very nice!
translation: 那不太好！

english: Well, he thinks he's going to get an entire portrait gallery to himself!
translation: 嗯，他以为他能独占整个肖像画廊！

english: Who knows, the Museum just got really big and appears to have cash. They might entertain him with his very own floor - we'll see.
translation: 谁知道呢，博物馆刚变得很大，似乎有钱。他们可能会给他整整一层楼——我们等着瞧。

english: I guess so. Wonder what poetry he'll come up with then! Still, I must get on with this display. See you around I hope!
translation: 我想也是。不知道他会写出什么诗！不过，我得继续弄这个展示了。希望再见！

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: Hi, have you seen the Dig Site displays?
translation: 嗨，你看过挖掘现场展示吗？

english: Yes, good aren't they! Have you done the quest?
translation: 是的，不错吧！你做过那个任务吗？

english: Not yet.
translation: 还没有。

english: Oh you should, it lets you get into that bit where they clean the finds, and you can join in!
translation: 哦你应该做，它能让你进入他们清理发现物的地方，你可以参与！

english: Sounds fun, I should probably check it out.
translation: 听起来有趣，我应该去看看。

english: I do not speak to outlanders.
translation: 我不跟外乡人说话。

english: Maybe you should speak with Rellekka's Chieftain.
translation: 也许你应该跟雷勒卡城的酋长谈谈。

english: Hello, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你好，[Fremennik name]？

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: I am Maria Gunnars. What can I do for you?
translation: 我是玛丽亚‧冈纳斯。我能为你做什么？

english: Tell me about Neitiznot's geography.
translation: 跟我说说奈提兹诺镇的地理。

english: Sure.
translation: 当然。

english: Well, as I have mentioned, I am from an island called Jatizso, while my wife is from another island called Neitiznot. Neitiznot is a far less sophisticated and successful island which will not see reason with Jatizso.
translation: 嗯，如我所提，我来自一个叫贾提兹索的岛，而我妻子来自另一个叫奈提兹诺镇的岛。奈提兹诺镇是个远不如贾提兹索发达和成功的岛，不愿跟贾提兹索讲理。

english: Ne it iz not!
translation: 才不是呢！(奈提兹诺镇)

english: Ja it iz so!
translation: 就是如此！(贾提兹索)

english: Ahem, anyway, the islands are in a small volcanic archipelago north of here.
translation: 咳咳，不管怎样，这些岛屿在这里北边的一个小火山群岛上。

english: Along with the main isles there are numerous small islands and a frozen northern island that was recently overrun by trolls.
translation: 除了主岛外，还有许多小岛和一个最近被巨魔占领的北部冰冻岛。

english: Jatizso is rich in minerals, and trades extensively, while Neitiznot has stolen all the decent arable land.
translation: 贾提兹索矿产丰富，贸易广泛，而奈提兹诺镇偷走了所有好的耕地。

english: Only because Jatizso hogs all the wealth.
translation: 只是因为贾提兹索独占了所有财富。

english: Well, that wealth is needed to buy the food from Neitiznot at extortionate rates!
translation: 嗯，需要那些财富才能以敲诈性的价格从奈提兹诺镇购买食物！

english: Only because Jatizso hogs all the wealth!
translation: 只是因为贾提兹索独占了所有财富！

english: Ok Maria, stop that!
translation: 好了玛丽亚，别吵了！

english: Ok dear!
translation: 好的亲爱的！

english: Thank you!
translation: 谢谢！

english: Where was I? Yup, that covers the layout of the islands.
translation: 我刚说到哪了？是的，这涵盖了岛屿的布局。

english: Tell me about the islands' history.
translation: 跟我说说岛屿的历史。

english: Tell me more about Jatizso.
translation: 多跟我说说贾提兹索。

english: Well now, the history of the isles is a bloody tale. When told in its intended form it takes 9 days and 9 nights. However, I will give you the abridged version.
translation: 嗯，岛屿的历史是个血腥的故事。按原样讲需要9天9夜。不过，我给你个简略版。

english: Phew!
translation: 呼！

english: Four generations ago there was a mighty king who ruled wisely and was loved by all.
translation: 四代以前有一位强大的国王，统治明智，受所有人爱戴。

english: He had many sons, most of whom proved themselves in the usual Fremennik ways of fighting, sailing, drinking and so on.
translation: 他有许多儿子，大多数都通过费明尼克传统的战斗、航海、喝酒等方式证明了自己。

english: His youngest two sons, however, were a problem. Ever since they were old enough to hit one another they had bickered and fought.
translation: 然而，他最小的两个儿子是个问题。自从他们大到能互相殴打起，就一直争吵打斗。

english: Their names were Jatizso and Neitiznot.
translation: 他们的名字是贾提兹索和奈提兹诺镇。

english: Hey! Who's telling this story?
translation: 嘿！谁在讲这个故事？

english: Ahem. At the time it was customary for the Kings' sons to claim a prize from his treasury when they came of age.
translation: 咳咳。当时国王儿子成年时从国库领取奖品是习俗。

english: Each brother rallied support and strode out to confront the other on the field of battle to claim the same prize.
translation: 每个兄弟都召集支持者，走上战场与对方对峙，争夺同一件奖品。

english: The brothers met on the field, limbs were bruised, bones were crushed and heads clashed.
translation: 兄弟们在场上相遇，四肢瘀伤，骨头粉碎，头部碰撞。

english: They probably didn't notice the head-clashing bit. Too thick skulled!
translation: 他们可能没注意到头部碰撞的部分。头骨太厚了！

english: Can I finish the story without interruptions?
translation: 我能不打断讲完故事吗？

english: Carry on dear.
translation: 继续吧亲爱的。

english: Anyway, long into the night they fought, until they stood alone, facing each other.
translation: 总之，他们鏖战至深夜，直到只剩两人对峙。

english: On the second day the old king, whose patience was exhausted, strode out onto the field and demanded to know who had claimed his prize.
translation: 第二天，耐心耗尽的老国王走上战场，质问是谁夺走了他的奖品。

english: Jatizso looked at his father and told him yes, it was his, to which the other called out 'No! It's not'.
translation: 贾提兹索看着父亲告诉他是的，是他的，另一个则喊道“不！不是”。

english: And so, the argument continued through to the third day, with the sounds of 'Jah! 'tis so!', 'Ne! It's not!' echoing over the field, becoming more hoarse as the darkness enveloped the brothers.
translation: 于是，争吵持续到第三天，''是！它是！''，''不！它不是！''的声音在场上回荡，随着黑暗笼罩兄弟俩变得更加嘶哑。

english: Bah! What they needed was a good clip round the ear.
translation: 呸！他们需要的是一记耳光。

english: At the end of the third day, when the brothers lay unable to move, let alone stand, the King stood between them in shame.
translation: 第三天结束时，当兄弟俩躺着一动不动，更别提站立，国王羞愧地站在他们中间。

english: As punishment for their squabbling he banished his sons from his realm, ordering that neither should return until they had conquered lands of their own.
translation: 作为对他们争吵的惩罚，他将儿子们逐出王国，命令他们在征服自己的土地前不得返回。

english: Jatizso set sail with a band of loyal followers, sailing into the east, while Neitiznot went west.
translation: 贾提兹索带着一群忠诚追随者启航向东，而奈提兹诺则向西。

english: Jatizso ventured far into uncharted oceans, his crew dwindling as the trials of sailing and sea monsters took them.
translation: 贾提兹索冒险进入未知海洋，随着航海考验和海怪袭击，他的船员逐渐减少。

english: Jatizso's ship limped through the frozen wastes, in need of repairs, fighting off pirates who thought them easy pickings.
translation: 贾提兹索的船艰难航行于冰封海域，船体亟待修理，还要击退那些以为他们好欺负的海盗。

english: At last a promising land was sighted, a land rich in minerals, deep fjords and sweeping mountains.
translation: 终于看到一片有希望的土地，一片矿产丰富、峡湾深邃、山脉绵延的土地。

english: Jatizso claimed the land and named it after himself.
translation: 贾提兹索宣称拥有这片土地，并以自己的名字为之命名。

english: A mighty citadel was constructed to protect his land; then Jatizso set forth to explore his new kingdom.
translation: 一座宏伟的要塞拔地而起，守护他的领土；随后贾提兹索启程探索他的新王国。

english: Crossing a few fjords, Jatizso spied an island which remained green and fertile, even at such latitude.
translation: 穿过几个峡湾，贾提兹索发现了一个岛屿，即使在这样的纬度依然翠绿肥沃。

english: With a mighty cheer Jatizso and his men marched on the island. Upon reaching the island, however, they discovered a wooden stockade.
translation: 伴随着巨大的欢呼，贾提兹索和他的手下向岛屿进军。然而，到达岛屿后，他们发现了一个木栅栏。

english: Determined to be master of all the land, Jatizso stood in front of the gates. He looked up and demanded that those within the stockade surrendered.
translation: 决心成为所有土地的主人，贾提兹索站在大门前。他抬头要求栅栏内的人投降。

english: Jatizso was horrified when his brother appeared on the battlements and cried 'This is my land! Go find yer own'. To which his brother replied 'No it's not!', throwing some rocks for good measure.
translation: 当他的兄弟出现在城墙上喊道“这是我的土地！去找你自己的”时，贾提兹索惊呆了。他的兄弟回答“不，它不是！''，还顺手扔了些石头。

english: And so the blood feud continued.
translation: 于是血仇继续。

english: The fighting between the towns has continued for generations with little sign of improvement.
translation: 城镇间的战斗持续了几代人，几乎没有改善的迹象。

english: Quite recently a massive troll army seized one of the islands to the north, while our townships' militias were busy fighting one another.
translation: 最近，一支庞大的巨魔军队占领了北部的一个岛屿，而我们城镇的民兵正忙于互相战斗。

english: They marched down and razed Neitiznot to the ground while Neitiznot's troops laid siege to Jatizso.
translation: 他们南下将奈提兹诺镇夷为平地，而奈提兹诺镇的部队围攻贾提兹索。

english: The smoke damage was atrocious, I had to replace my entire wardrobe.
translation: 烟雾损害太严重了，我不得不更换整个衣柜。

english: Yes, dear.
translation: 是的，亲爱的。

english: Anyway, a hasty sort of peace has been agreed until the trolls are dealt with.
translation: 总之，双方已仓促达成休战，待巨魔威胁解除后再议。

english: But you can still see the bitter rivalry as guards hurl insults between the towns.
translation: 但你仍能感受到两镇间的宿怨，守卫们隔着城镇互相叫骂。

english: Tell me about BurgerMawnis Burowgar.
translation: 跟我说说市长莫尼斯‧布罗瓦加。

english: Well Burgher Mawnis Burowgar is a gentle soul at heart. His kinsfolk are happy and content with their lot.
translation: 嗯，市长莫尼斯‧布罗瓦加内心是个温和的灵魂。他的族人快乐且满足于现状。

english: 'Soft' is the word we use in Jatizso.
translation: “软”是我们在贾提兹索用的词。

english: Well a soft Burgher is better than a stupid King.
translation: 嗯，一个软的市长比一个愚蠢的国王好。

english: Anyway, there was a time when Burgher Burowgar was similar to King Sorvott.
translation: 不管怎样，曾有一段时间市长布罗瓦加跟索沃特国王相似。

english: Argumentative, short tempered; I am sure you know what I mean.
translation: 好争辩，脾气暴躁；我相信你知道我什么意思。

english: The change happened when the trolls came and razed Neitiznot to the ground.
translation: 变化发生在巨魔来袭将奈提兹诺镇夷为平地时。

english: You mean while Neitiznot's militias were assaulting Jatizso.
translation: 你是说当奈提兹诺镇的民兵袭击贾提兹索时。

english: Yes, well our tribes have been at war for nearly four generations now.
translation: 是的，嗯我们的部落已经交战近四代人了。

english: Anyway, the Burgher lost his wife and youngest son in the trolls' raid and has been a changed man since.
translation: 不管怎样，市长在巨魔袭击中失去了妻子和最小的儿子，从此变了个人。

english: May their journey to our ancestors' halls be swift.
translation: 愿他们前往祖先殿堂的旅程一路顺风。

english: Personally, I am much happier with the considerate Burgher we have now.
translation: 就我个人而言，我对现在这位体贴的市长满意得多。

english: Can you ferry me to Neitiznot?
translation: 你能渡我去奈提兹诺镇吗？

translation: 那我们启航吧。

translation: 我只是停下来打个招呼。

english: Hi, [Fremennik name], you should speak with Burgher Mawnis Burowgar in the main chambers. Do you have any questions?
translation: 嗨，[Fremennik name]，你应该去主厅跟市长莫尼斯‧布罗瓦加谈谈。你有什么问题吗？

english: Tell me about your husband.
translation: 跟我说说你丈夫。

english: My husband is a typical Fremennik, being both headstrong and brave.
translation: 我丈夫是个典型的费明尼克，既固执又勇敢。

english: We fell in love when we were young, but as there was a war between our isles, we were ordered to stop seeing each other by our parents.
translation: 我们年轻时相爱，但由于我们岛屿间有战争，父母命令我们停止见面。

english: This didn't stop Mord climbing the wailing tower, on his side of the channel between our isles, to sing to me every night.
translation: 这没能阻止莫尔德每晚爬上我们岛屿间海峡他那一侧的哭泣塔，为我唱歌。

english: After Mord's voice broke, his singing voice was lost, but I still listened to his terrible sonnets each and every night.
translation: 莫尔德变声后，他的歌声没了，但我仍每晚听他糟糕的十四行诗。

english: Until one night there was no singing! Then, far below me, I heard a gentle voice calling my name.
translation: 直到一晚没有歌声！然后，在我下方远处，我听到一个温柔的声音叫我的名字。

english: Mord had stolen his father's boat to come and fetch me from my prison
translation: 莫尔德偷了他父亲的船来接我离开监狱

english: and from that day forth we have lived in Rellekka.
translation: 从那天起我们住在雷勒卡城。

english: Tell me about Jatizso.
translation: 跟我说说贾提兹索。

english: My husband does not speak of the inhabitants of the isle of Jatizso much.
translation: 我丈夫不太谈论贾提兹索岛的居民。

english: He has little positive to say about his parents, so he chooses not to speak of them in my presence. The only thing I've noticed is that everyone on that island seems very sad...
translation: 他对父母没什么好话，所以选择不在我面前谈他们。我唯一注意到的是那个岛上的人似乎都很悲伤……

english: Tell me about King Sorvott IV.
translation: 跟我说说索沃特四世国王。

english: King Sorvott IV follows in the footsteps of a line of kings who have reigned since Jatizso himself passed away. It is rumoured that the King has no heir and is seeking a bride to bear him children. Given his
translation: 索沃特四世国王追随自贾提兹索去世以来统治的一系国王。传闻国王没有继承人，正在寻找新娘为他生孩子。

english: personality I'm not surprised he hasn't found a bride yet!
translation: 鉴于他的性格，我不惊讶他还没找到新娘！

translation: 跟我说说奈提兹诺镇。

english: To be honest with you, I do not keep up to date with all the goings on here now that I have a home in Rellekka.
translation: 老实告诉你，既然我在雷勒卡城有了家，我就不太关注这里的所有动态了。

english: However, Neitiznot seems a happy place! The Burgher seems a wiser rule than King Sorvott, although I believe he is worried about the trolls at the moment. They seem to be a big threat.
translation: 不过，奈提兹诺镇似乎是个快乐的地方！市长似乎比索沃特国王更明智的统治者，虽然我相信他目前担心巨魔。他们似乎是个大威胁。

translation: 那块种植地的作物染病了——你先治好再让我管！

english: No, that's too much.

english: Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: 你能给我一些农业建议吗？

english: The only way to cure a bush or tree of disease is to prune away the diseased leaves with a pair of secateurs. For all other crops I would just apply some plant-cure.
translation: 治疗灌木或树木疾病的唯一方法是用修枝剪修剪掉病叶。对于所有其他作物，我只需施用一些植物治疗药水。

english: Tree seeds must be grown in a plantpot of soil into a sapling, and then transferred to a tree patch to continue growing to adulthood.
translation: 树木种子得先在装土的花盆里养成树苗，再移栽到树木种植地，才能继续长成大树。

english: You can put up to ten potatoes, cabbages or onions in vegetable sacks, although you can't have a mix in the same sack.
translation: 蔬菜袋里最多能装十个土豆、卷心菜或者洋葱，不过一袋里可不能混着装。

english: You can buy all the farming tools from farming shops, which can be found close to the allotments.
translation: 你可以从农业商店购买所有农业工具，它们可以在耕地附近找到。

english: Bittercap mushrooms can only be grown in a special patch in Morytania, near the Mort Myre swamp. There the ground is especially dank and suited to growing poisonous fungii.
translation: 苦帽菇只能种在莫利塔尼亚、莫特迈耶沼泽附近的特殊种植地里。那里阴暗潮湿，适合毒蘑菇生长。

english: Supercompost is far better than normal compost, but more expensive to make. You need to rot the right type of item; show me an item, and I'll tell you if it's super- compostable or not.
translation: 超级堆肥比普通堆肥强多了，但做起来也更费事。你得用对东西才能堆出来——拿件物品给我看看，我告诉你它能不能做成超级堆肥。

english: There is a special patch for growing Belladonna - I believe that it is somewhere near Draynor Manor, where the ground is a tad 'unblessed'.
translation: 颠茄有专门的种植地——我记得是在德雷诺庄园附近，那地方的土嘛，有点''不受祝福''。

english: Applying compost to a patch will not only reduce the chance that your crops will get diseased, but you will also grow more crops to harvest.
translation: 在种植地上施用堆肥不仅会降低作物生病的几率，你还会收获更多作物。

english: If you want to grow fruit trees you could try a few places: Catherby, Brimhaven, Gnome Stronghold and the Farming Guild all have fruit tree patches.
translation: 如果你想种果树，可以尝试几个地方：凯瑟比镇、布尔哈文镇、地精要塞和农业公会都有果树种植地。

english: You can fill plantpots with soil from any empty patch, if you have a gardening trowel.
translation: 如果你有园艺铲，可以用任何空地的土壤填满花盆。

english: Hops are good for brewing ales. I believe there's a brewery up in Keldagrim somewhere, and I've heard rumours that a place called Phasmatys used to be good for that type of thing. 'Fore they all died, of course.
translation: 啤酒花适合酿造麦酒。我相信凯尔达格林城某处有个酿酒厂，我还听说一个叫法斯玛提斯的地方以前也酿造这种酒。当然那是在他们都死光之前的事了。

english: Vegetables, hops and flowers need constant watering - if you ignore my advice, you will sooner or later find yourself in possession of a dead farming patch.
translation: 蔬菜、啤酒花和花卉需要持续浇水——如果你忽视我的建议，你迟早会发现自己拥有一块死掉的种植地。

english: You can put up to five tomatoes, strawberries, apples, bananas or oranges into a fruit basket, although you can't have a mix in the same basket.
translation: 你可以在水果篮中放入最多五个西红柿、草莓、苹果、香蕉或橙子，虽然你不能在同一篮中混合。

english: Don't just throw away your weeds after you've raked a patch - put them in a compost bin and make some compost.
translation: 耙完地后别直接把杂草扔掉——把它们放进堆肥箱制作堆肥。

english: There are five other Farming areas like this one - Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius and Alan's area in the Farming Guild.
translation: 还有五个像这样的农业区域——法拉多城附近的埃尔斯坦区域、凯瑟比镇附近的丹塔拉区域、莫利塔尼亚的莱拉区域、霍西迪乌斯城的马里西区域和农业公会的艾伦区域。

translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Yes, how can I help out?
translation: 是的，我能怎么帮忙？

english: Well, you'll need to get your equipment first - it's all there on the tool rack. Use what you learned from your Earth Sciences exams. You'll need to be wearing your leather gloves and boots as well as have access to

english: your trowel, rock pick and specimen brush.
translation: 并使用你的泥铲、岩石鎬和标本刷。

english: I see you have your equipment - well done.
translation: 我看你有装备了——做得好。

english: To really give us a hand, you could clean some finds for us. They're mostly done - just some fine work to finish off. Take a find from the pile that the workmen are bringing in, then there are spare tables over there

english: to clean them on. If you find anything interesting, let us know and we'll see if it's good enough to go on display.

translation: 那太好了。传送到哪里？

english: Hmm...all the indications are that it's somewhere to the east of us, but I'm not sure how far. Perhaps it was a teleport back to Saranthium. Let me just take a closer look.
translation: 嗯……所有迹象表明它在我们东边某处，但我不确定有多远。许是传回萨兰提姆的。让我仔细看看。

english: So I just make a ruby necklace and use five fire runes and one cosmic rune to enchant it.
translation: 所以我只需制作一条红宝石项链，然后用五个火符石和一个宇宙符石附魔它。

english: Yes, indeed. Well done, youngster, thanks for helping us.
translation: 是的，确实。做得好，年轻人，谢谢帮我们。

english: Oh my! What a wonderful find! If this is what I believe it to be, it would allow us to date the Dig Site city.

english: Back again? Have you put the old coin in display case 45 yet?
translation: 又来了？你把古币放进45号展示柜了吗？

translation: 不，我现在就去。

english: I found this really old coin - is it of any use?

translation: 那时城市被称为森提斯顿。

english: This is a most remarkable discovery, as we have other evidence indicating that Zarosian followers were resident before the Saradominists took over, but it also seems that Zamorakian forces used it during a battle of some
translation: 这是个最显著的发现，因为我们有其他证据表明扎罗斯信徒在萨拉多明信徒接管前就居住在此，但似乎扎莫拉克军队也在某种战斗中用过它。

english: sort. Still, it allows us to roughly date when the city changed from following Zaros and Zamorak to following Saradomin. Put it in display case 44.
translation: 不过，它让我们能大致确定城市从追随扎罗斯和扎莫拉克转变为追随萨拉多明的时间。把它放进44号展示柜。

english: Back again? Have you put the ancient coin in display case 44 yet?
translation: 又来了？你把古币放进44号展示柜了吗？

english: No, I'll go do that now.
translation: 不，我现在就去。

english: I found this crumbly old decoration - is it of any use?

translation: 啊……那看起来像个祭坛部件。嗯，是的……看起来来自早期萨拉多明信徒。相当精致。把它放进37号展示柜。

english: Case 37 it is!

english: Back again? Have you put the ancient symbol in display case 37 yet?
translation: 又来了？你把古代符号放进37号展示柜了吗？

english: I found this really old decoration - is it of any use?
translation: 我发现了这个非常古老的装饰品——有用吗？

english: Wow!
translation: 哇！

translation: 状况相当不错，是吧？看起来是个旧祭坛装饰，无疑是来自萨拉多明城市的。把它放进36号展示柜。

translation: 啊……哦！嗯……是的……看起来是扎罗斯信徒制作的。形状很美。看起来很适合放进22号展示柜。这件物品加强了我们的证据，表明这座城市在萨拉多明教徒之前

translation: 啊，是的，我们发现很多那种——它们不重要。我们展示里已经有一些了。把它加到门附近的发现物箱子里。

english: If there is anything already in the crate, feel free to take it as a reward for your work.
translation: 如果箱子里已经有什么东西，随意拿走作为你工作的奖励。

translation: 啊，花瓶……我都数不清我们找到多少个了……唯一完全完好的那个已经在展示柜里了。把它加到门附近的发现物箱子里。
