english: Well done, young adventurer. You truly are a worthy knight.
translation: 做得好，年轻冒险者。你真是个配得上的骑士。

english: You receive access to the prayers Chivalry and Piety and 20,000 XP in your Hitpoints, Strength, Attack, and Defence skills. You may also speak to Merlin to set your respawn point to Camelot.
translation: 你获得祈祷骑士精神和虔诚的权限以及20,000经验值在你的生命值、力量、攻击和防御技能。你也可以跟梅林说话设置你的复活点到卡美洛城堡。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Excuse me for rushing off like this, but I must get back to my workroom.
translation: 抱歉这样匆忙离开，但我必须回我的工作室。

english: I have a piece of memorabilia, from our last adventure, for you.
translation: 我有一件我们上次冒险的纪念品给你。

english: I hear you are ready for a new respawn point.
translation: 我听说你准备好新复活点了。

english: Yes, I'm sure.
translation: 是的，我确定。

english: Actually, no thanks. I like my respawn point.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。我喜欢我的复活点。

english: Oh, hello! Children, say hello to the surface-dweller.
translation: 哦，你好！孩子们，跟地表人打招呼。

english: Haha! You look funny!
translation: 哈哈！你看起来好笑！

english: I'm sure you look just as funny to the surface-dweller!
translation: 我相信你在地表人看来也一样好笑！

english: You smell!
translation: 你臭！

english: There's no need to be rude!
translation: 没必要粗鲁！

english: I'm sorry about that, surface-dweller.
translation: 我很抱歉那个，地表人。

english: Are you really from the surface?
translation: 你真的来自地表吗？

english: Yes I am.
translation: 是的我是。

english: Are you [player name]? Did you help Zanik save the city?
translation: 你是 [player name] 吗？你帮助扎尼克救了城市吗？

english: Just because [he's/she's] a surface-dweller, doesn't mean [he's/she's] [player name]! There are lots of surface-dwellers!
translation: 仅仅因为 [he's/she's] 是地表人，不代表 [he's/she's] 是 [player name]！有很多地表人！

english: Actually I am [player name].
translation: 其实我是 [player name]。

english: [Player name]? Really?
translation: [Player name]？真的？

english: Zanik told me about you! I'm so pleased to meet you!
translation: 扎尼克跟我说过你！我很高兴见到你！

english: Shan't!
translation: 就不！

english: Well don't blame me if he doesn't want to talk to you either!
translation: 嗯，如果他也不想跟你说话别怪我！

english: Sorry about that.
translation: 抱歉那个。

english: I don't think I should just do that with no reasoning... perhaps they are going to try something sneaky. Then I can kick to my heart's content.
translation: 我不认为我应该毫无理由地那样做……也许他们要试什么狡猾的。那我就可以尽情踢了。

english: Noo don't put that in there!
translation: 不别把那个放那里！

english: I've got all the bad ones just for you!
translation: 我把所有坏的都给你留着的！

english: Curse you!
translation: 诅咒你！

english: Good day to you.
translation: 你好。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: You don't look too happy.
translation: 你看起来不太高兴。

english: True. We've not fallen on the best of times here.
translation: 真的。我们这里时运不济。

english: Any way that I can help?
translation: 有什么我能帮忙的吗？

english: Possibly. I'd go talk to Awusah the Mayor of Nardah. He's in the big house on the east side of the town square.
translation: 可能。我会去跟那尔达城主阿武萨谈谈。他在城镇广场东边的大房子里。

english: How's life now the curse has been lifted?
translation: 诅咒解除后生活怎么样？

english: Much better thanks to you. We're all very impressed.
translation: 多亏你好多了。我们都印象深刻。

english: Hello there. I have a message for you.
translation: 你好。我有消息给你。

english: Hello there. I have a message for you, but you'll need to make some room for it.
translation: 你好。我有消息给你，但你需要腾点空间。

english: Sorry, I don't have anything for you right now.
translation: 抱歉，我现在没什么给你的。

english: [player name]?
translation: [player name]？

english: Are you there [player name]?
translation: 你在吗 [player name]？

english: [player name]? I have a message for you.
translation: [player name]？我有消息给你。

english: [player name]? You've been sent a message.
translation: [player name]？你被发送了一条消息。

english: Maybe another time.
translation: 也许改天。

english: I have a letter for you. I'm told it's quite important. Please read it when you get a chance.
translation: 我有封信给你。我听说它很重要。有机会请读它。

english: Apparently you destroyed that last letter I gave you without reading it, or something like that. The sender doesn't appreciate that sort of thing, so I've got another one for you.
translation: 显然你毁了我给你的上一封信没读它，或类似的事。发送者不欣赏那种事，所以我又有另一封给你。

english: Look, you can destroy that letter as many times as you want, but it won't change anything. The sender isn't the kind of individual who takes no for an answer, so for both of our sakes, please just read it.
translation: 听着，你可以毁那封信任意次，但那不会改变任何事。发送者不是那种接受拒绝的人，所以为了我们俩，请读它。

english: Please... don't keep doing this. You don't know who you're dealing with...
translation: 请……别继续这样做。你不知道你在跟谁打交道……

english: Hello, I wonder if you could help me on this whole brewing thing...
translation: 你好，我想知道你能否在酿酒这件事上帮我……

english: Woooo wooo wooooo woooo.
translation: 呜哦 呜哦 呜哦哦 呜哦。

english: I might be able to - what do you need to know?
translation: 我可能可以——你需要知道什么？

english: How do I brew ales?
translation: 我怎么酿造麦芽酒？

english: Well first off you need to fill the vat with water - two bucketfuls should do the trick. Then you'll need to put in two handfuls of barley malt - that's roasted barley by the way.
translation: 嗯首先你需要用水装满大桶——两桶就够了。然后你需要放入两把大麦麦芽——顺便说一下，那是烤过的大麦。

english: After that you'll be putting your main ingredient in - this will decide which ale it is you're brewing. There should be some good guides around with recipes in.
translation: 之后你会放入主要原料——这将决定你酿造的是哪种麦芽酒。周围应该有一些带有配方的好指南。

english: Lastly you pour a pot full of ale yeast in, which'll start it off fermenting. Then all you have to do is wait for the good stuff.
translation: 最后你倒入一壶麦芽酒酵母，这会开始发酵。然后你要做的就是等待美酒出炉。

english: How do I brew cider?
translation: 我怎么酿造苹果酒？

english: First you'll need some apples. You'll need to crush them using this cider-press - four apples should make a full bucket of apple-mush. Take four buckets of mush and fill up the vat.
translation: 首先你需要一些苹果。你需要用这个苹果压榨机把它们压碎——四个苹果应该能压满一桶苹果泥。取四桶苹果泥装满大桶。

english: After that you pour a pot full of ale yeast in, which'll start it off fermenting. Then all you have to do is wait for the good stuff.
translation: 之后你倒入一壶麦芽酒酵母，这会开始发酵。然后你要做的就是等待美酒出炉。

english: What do I do once my ale has matured?
translation: 我的麦芽酒成熟后我该做什么？

english: Well, once you've got a full vat of the good stuff, just turn the valve and your barrel will fill up with eight pints of whatever your chosen tipple is. Mind it's an empty barrel, though.
translation: 嗯，一旦你有一大桶美酒，只需转动阀门，你的酒桶就会装满八品脱你选择的酒。不过要注意，得是空桶。

english: Do you have any spare ale yeast?
translation: 你有多余的麦芽酒酵母吗？

english: Well, as a matter of fact I do, although I wouldn't describe it as spare. This ale yeast I've got is the best you can get - if you've got a pot I'll fill it for you for 5 ectotokens. Coins are of no use to me.
translation: 嗯，事实上我有，虽然我不会说它是多余的。我有的这种麦芽酒酵母是你能得到的最好的——如果你有个壶，我可以5个生态代币帮你装满。金币对我没用。

english: I don't have an empty pot, or enough ectotokens I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕我没有空壶，也没有足够的生态代币。

english: That's all I need to know, thanks.
translation: 我知道这些就够了，谢谢。

english: How do I brew ales?
translation: 我怎么酿造麦芽酒？

english: How do I brew cider?
translation: 我怎么酿造苹果酒？

english: What do I do once my ale has matured?
translation: 我的麦芽酒成熟后我该做什么？

english: Do you have any spare ale yeast?
translation: 你有多余的麦芽酒酵母吗？

english: That's all I need to know, thanks.
translation: 我知道这些就够了，谢谢。

english: Take me to your leader.
translation: 带我去见你的领袖。

english: Wot?
translation: 什麼？

english: Isn't that what you're supposed to say when you meet a new race of people?
translation: 那不是当你遇到新种族的人时应该说的吗？

english: Well, mate, we don't av no leader, so I ain't gonna take ya to um. We auw av eqwuw right's un stuff, yeah? But if ya wont an intro go live it up wiv da Onerimancer.
translation: 嗯，伙计，我们没有领袖，所以我不会带你去见他们。我们都有平等权利之类的，对吧？但如果你想认识人，去找火焰法师吧。

english: OK. Is he rich and powerful?
translation: 好的。他富有且强大吗？

english: No man, SHE, is dead-wise yeah? She is responsible for initiation wituals an stuff.
translation: 不，伙计，是''她''，死神之智，懂吧？她负责入会仪式之类的事。

english: Great. Thanks. And where is she?
translation: 太好了。谢谢。那她在哪？

english: She angs out int souf east of ouw island.
translation: 她在我们岛的东南边晃悠。

english: Okey dokey....yeah.
translation: 好的好的……

english: Huh?
translation: 哈？

english: Yeah? Need something?
translation: 是啊？需要点什么？

english: What do you have?
translation: 你有什么？

english: Rock. Lots of it.
translation: 石头。很多。

english: What brings you here?
translation: 什么风把你吹来这里？

english: Rock. This here is Stonecutter Outpost. We get rock, cut it, then sell it.
translation: 石头。这里是石匠前哨站。我们开采石头，切割加工，然后出售。

english: So you're pretty far from home then?
translation: 那你离家挺远咯？

english: What? No. We go back to Cam Torum sometimes, but this is home.
translation: 什么？不。我们有时回卡姆托鲁姆城，但这里是家。

english: Fair enough.
translation: 好吧。

english: Need something else?
translation: 需要别的吗？

english: I'm good.
translation: 我没事。

english: Then why you keep staring? Get gone!
translation: 那你为什么一直盯着？走开！

english: What do you have?
translation: 你有什么？

english: What brings you here?
translation: 什么风把你吹来这里？

english: I'm good.
translation: 我没事。

english: Oh... Nilsal. Unusual to see someone up here. What can I do for you?
translation: 哦……你好，难得见到有人来这里。我能为你做什么？

english: What do you do around here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: I used to work downstairs... but I started using the lab after hours for my own projects and the supervisor found out. Now I've been assigned to rooftop duty to look after the plants.
translation: 我过去在楼下工作……但我开始在下班后用实验室做自己的项目，主管发现了。现在我被派到屋顶负责照料植物。

english: Sorry to hear that. At least the view is good!
translation: 真遗憾，不过至少风景不错！

english: Do you have any tips for potion production?
translation: 你有什么药水生产建议吗？

english: I do, but only for fellow members of the Alchemical Society. Perhaps you should join up if you're interested in Herblore.
translation: 我有，但只给炼金协会的成员。若你对草药学感兴趣，不妨加入我们。

english: Interesting... Perhaps I should.
translation: 有趣……也许我应该。

english: Yes... Make good use of the digweed once they're ready to pick. Choose which potion you use it on wisely!
translation: 是的……一旦地丁草可以采摘了就好好利用。明智地选择将它用于哪种药水！

english: Oh, and the processing tables can be sped up a bit if you use them correctly. You might need to do some experimenting to figure that out.
translation: 哦，若正确使用处理台，可略微加快处理速度。你可能需要做一些实验来弄清楚。

english: Interesting...
translation: 有趣……

english: Thanks! I'd better be going now.
translation: 谢谢！我得走了。

english: What do you do around here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Do you have any tips for potion production?
translation: 你有什么药水生产建议吗？

english: Thanks! I'd better be going now.
translation: 谢谢！我得走了。

english: Hello, you look worried.
translation: 你好，你看起来有心事。

english: My husband is serving near the Lizardman Canyon. I'm worried that something might happen to him.
translation: 我丈夫在蜥蜴人峡谷附近服役。我担心他可能出事。

english: And I lost my job last week. I need to find another one before my savings run out.
translation: 而且我上周丢了工作。我需要在积蓄耗尽前找到另一份工作。

english: Oh, that is bad. I'm sorry to hear that.
translation: 哦，真糟糕。很遗憾听到这件事。

english: Well, it's a difficult time for a lot of people I guess. The war with the lizardmen never ends.
translation: 嗯，我想对很多人来说这是艰难时期。与蜥蜴人的战争永不结束。

english: Thanks so much for saving me from being a vampyre. Here, take this certificate, I'm sorry but it's all I can offer as a reward.
translation: 非常感谢你救我免于成为吸血鬼。给，拿着这个证书，抱歉这是我唯一能提供的报酬。

english: Thanks for changing me back, it must have been hard for you. I must be off now.
translation: 谢谢你把我变回来，这对你来说一定很难。我现在得走了。

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: Oh, hello there. I'm afraid I don't have time to talk right now. I'm rather busy. Come back some other time please.
translation: 哦，你好。恐怕我现在没时间说话。我很忙。请改天再来。

english: Ok, sorry.
translation: 好的，抱歉。

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Oh, hello.
translation: 哦，你好。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Who am I? Why, how impertinent! I am a princess and I will be spoken to like one. Now be off with you. I have no time for scruffy adventurers like yourself!
translation: 我是谁？什么？竟敢如此无礼！我是公主，你要像对公主那样跟我说话。现在走开。我没时间应付像你这样邋遢的冒险者！

english: I notice there is a dwarf up in the tower there. Why is he up there?
translation: 我注意到那边塔上有个矮人。他为什么在上面？

english: I do believe that is none of your business, young scallyrumpit! Now kindly leave.
translation: 我相信那不关你的事，小流氓！现在请离开。

english: Uh...ok. Never mind then!
translation: 呃……好的。那算了！

english: Thanks again for finding my pendant. I felt so lost without it.
translation: 再次感谢找到我的吊坠。没有它我感到茫然若失。

english: You're welcome. Goodbye.
translation: 不用客气。再见。

english: Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: 嘿，是英雄！哇！你太厉害了，你到底是怎么对付那两个成熟吸血鬼和加德兰克斯的？这城镇现在真不错，你做得太棒了！

english: You're more than welcome.
translation: 不用客气。

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: I'm Mihail, I'm trying to stay warm by this fire.
translation: 我是米哈伊尔，我正试着在这火旁取暖。

english: How do you like your town?
translation: 你觉得你的城镇怎么样？

english: It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
translation: 简直完美，非常感谢你的努力。

english: What's happening around here?
translation: 这里发生什么事了？

english: Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: 哦，没什么特别的，我们都在躲避吸血鬼，在这个鬼地方艰难度日，希望很快我们就能足够强壮，前往萨尔韦神庙。

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: 有什么我能帮忙的吗？

english: Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: 据我所知没有，我们现在有一些基本设施，非常有用，我们都对你感激不尽。我从前没见过真正的英雄，没法比较，

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: 但我相信，在大多数人眼中，你定是英雄无疑！至少我很高兴见到你。

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: How do you like your town?
translation: 你觉得你的城镇怎么样？

english: What's happening around here?
translation: 这里发生什么事了？

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: 有什么我能帮忙的吗？

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: Arr? Be ye wantin' te go on account with our gang o' fillibusters?
translation: 啊？你想跟咱们这帮海盗一起干吗？

english: The powder monkey be takin' a caulk after gettin' rowdy on bumboo, so there be plenty of room for ye.
translation: 火药童子喝多了朗姆酒正在睡觉，所以船上还有很多空位给你。

english: Riiiiight...
translation: 好吧……

english: I'll just be over here if you need me.
translation: 有需要我就在这儿。

english: Wanna buy some clothes? Good quality, none of yer rags.
translation: 想买些衣服吗？质量好，可不是那些破烂货。

english: I'll take a look.
translation: 我看看。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Then what are you doin' in my shop? Move along.
translation: 那你在我店里做什么？走开。

english: Why does that shirt have a hole in it?
translation: 那衬衫为什么有个洞？

english: It's to put your head through.
translation: 那是让头穿过去的。

english: In the stomach? Isn't that an odd place for a neck hole?
translation: 在肚子上？领口开在这地方不奇怪吗？

english: Oh! It seems as if I must have slipped while cleaning it and put a bit of a hole in the front.
translation: 哦！好像是我清洗时手滑了，在前面弄了个洞。

english: Silly me.
translation: 我真蠢。

english: What were you cleaning it with, a blood-covered scimitar?
translation: 你用什么洗的？一把沾满血的弯刀吗？

english: If I say yes will you buy it?
translation: 建议改为''我要说是，你会买吗？''更自然

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: Then no, I was not cleaning it with a blood-covered scimitar.
translation: 那倒没有，我可没用沾满血的弯刀清洗它。

english: Where do you get these clothes?
translation: 你从哪得到这些衣服？

english: Found em.
translation: 找到的。

english: You found a bunch of slashed up clothing, some of which has been shoddily cleaned and stitched together?
translation: 你找到一堆被砍烂的衣服，有些被草草清洗过又拙劣地缝补起来？

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: Look, do you want in on this or not?
translation: 听着，你到底想不想掺和？

english: Where did that pillar come from?
translation: 那柱子哪来的？

english: You wanna buy it?
translation: 你想买吗？

english: Is it for sale?
translation: 它卖吗？

english: Would you buy it if it was?
translation: 如果卖你会买吗？

english: If it was could you sell it to me?
translation: 如果卖你能卖给我吗？

english: If I couldn't would you still give me the money?
translation: 如果我不能你还会给我钱吗？

english: Where did this pillar come from?
translation: 这柱子哪来的？

english: Dunno. There are a load of islands out this way, and a lot of them have little bits and pieces like this scattered around.
translation: 不知道。这方向有一堆岛屿，很多岛上都散落着这种零碎东西。

english: The way I see it, there must have been some people out here at one point, then they went away.
translation: 依我看，肯定曾经有人在这里待过，然后他们走了。

english: Where?
translation: 哪里？

english: Search me.
translation: 问我我也不知道。

english: I'd rather not.
translation: 我还是算了。

english: I'll take a look.
translation: 我看看。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Why does that shirt have a hole in it?
translation: 那衬衫为什么有个洞？

english: Where did that pillar come from?
translation: 那柱子哪来的？

english: Thank you, I hope you like your present. I must be leaving now though.
translation: 谢谢，希望你喜欢你的礼物。不过我现在得走了。

english: Sorry, that's just not the right answer!
translation: 抱歉，那可不是正确答案！

english: I must be leaving now.
translation: 我现在得走了。

english: Sorry, but I'm trying to talk to [other player's display name], but [he/she] seems to be ignoring me.
translation: 抱歉，我正试着跟 [other player's display name] 说话，但 [he/she] 似乎在无视我。

english: Greetings [player name], I need your help.
translation: 你好 [player name]，我需要你的帮助。

english: Talk to me, [player name]!
translation: 跟我说话，[player name]！

english: Hello, [player name], are you there?
translation: 你好，[player name]，你在吗？

english: I'd like to talk to you, [player name]!
translation: 我想跟你说话，[player name]！

english: ehem... Hello [player name], please talk to me!
translation: 咳咳……你好 [player name]，请跟我说话！

english: Maybe later.
translation: 也许改天。

english: If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: 如果我像你一样丑，我都不敢在公共场合露面！

english: Out of my way, punk.
translation: 滚开，小混混。

english: Hmm... you smell strange...
translation: 嗯……你闻起来很奇怪……

english: Strange how?
translation: 怎么奇怪？

english: Like a human!
translation: 像人类！

english: Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: 哦！呃……因为我刚吃了一个！

english: Leave me alone.
translation: 别烦我。

english: Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: 如果你珍惜生命就别再跟我说话！

english: Get lost!
translation: 滚开！

english: I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: 我没什么能给你的，所以别烦我，乞丐。

english: Have you no manners?
translation: 你没有礼貌吗？

english: I don't have time for this right now.
translation: 我现在没时间处理这个。

english: I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: 我没兴趣和你这样可怜的肉袋说话。

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
translation: 我打赌你有漂亮的爪子。

english: A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: 真是悲惨的一天啊……趁还能享受就享受吧。

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: 你要是抓到谁，答应分我一口。

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
translation: 我之前没在这里闻到过你……

english: You smell familiar...
translation: 你闻起来很熟悉……

english: Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: 这附近有看到人类吗？我非——常饿。

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: 你看起来也是个嗜血之人。

english: Good day to you, my friend.
translation: 你好，我的朋友。

english: Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
translation: 想去城堡吃点零食吗？

english: Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
translation: 等一下，我牙缝里卡了点人肉渣……

english: Have you found Elena yet?
translation: 你找到埃琳娜了吗？

english: Yes, she's safe at home.
translation: 是的，她安全在家。

english: I hope she comes and visits sometime.
translation: 我希望她有时间来拜访。

english: Maybe.
translation: 也许。

english: I hope Elena comes to visit soon.
translation: 我希望埃琳娜能尽快来拜访。

english: Hello Adventurer. Welcome to Mill Lane Mill. Can I help you?
translation: 你好冒险者。欢迎来到磨坊巷磨坊。我能帮你吗？

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: I'm Miss Millicent Miller the Miller of Mill Lane Mill. Our family have been milling flour for generations.
translation: 我是磨坊巷磨坊的磨坊主米莉森特‧米勒小姐。我们家世代磨面粉。

english: It's a good business to be in. People will always need flour.
translation: 这是个好生意。人们总是需要面粉。

english: How do I mill flour?
translation: 我怎么磨面粉？

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: This is Mill Lane Mill. Millers of the finest flour in Gielinor, and home to the Miller family for many generations
translation: 这是磨坊巷磨坊。基利诺尔最优质面粉的磨坊主，也是米勒家族许多代人的家园

english: We take grain from the field nearby and mill into flour.
translation: 我们从附近的田地取谷物磨成面粉。

english: Making flour is pretty easy. First of all you need to get some grain. You can pick some from wheat fields. There is one just outside the Mill, but there are many others scattered across Gielinor. Feel free to pick wheat
translation: 磨面粉很容易。首先你需要弄点谷物。你可以从麦田里采摘。磨坊外就有一片，但基利诺尔各地还有很多其他麦田。

english: from our field! There always seems to be plenty of wheat there.
translation: 随意从我们田里摘小麦！那里似乎总是有很多小麦。

english: Then I bring my wheat here?
translation: 然后我把小麦带到这里？

english: Yes, or one of the other mills in Gielinor. They all work the same way. Just take your grain to the top floor of the mill (up two ladders, there are three floors including this one) and then place some grain into the hopper.
translation: 是的，或者基利诺尔的其他磨坊之一。它们工作方式都一样。只需把谷物带到磨坊顶层(上两个梯子，包括这层共三层)，然后把一些谷物放入料斗。

english: Then you need to start the grinding process by pulling the hopper lever. You can add more grain, but each time you add grain you have to pull the hopper lever again.
translation: 然后你需要拉动料斗拉杆开始研磨过程。你可以添加更多谷物，但每次添加谷物你都得再次拉动料斗拉杆。

english: So where does the flour go then?
translation: 那面粉去哪了？

english: The flour appears in this room here, you'll need a pot to put the flour into. One pot will hold the flour made by one load of grain
translation: 面粉出现在这个房间里，你需要一个罐子来装面粉。一个罐子能装一批谷物磨出的面粉

english: And that's it! You now have some pots of finely ground flour of the highest quality. Ideal for making tasty cakes or delicous bread. I'm not a cook so you'll have to ask a cook to find out how to bake things.
translation: 就这样！你现在有一些最高品质的细磨面粉罐。非常适合制作美味蛋糕或美味面包。我不是厨师所以你得问厨师怎么烘焙东西。

english: Great! Thanks for your help.
translation: 太好了！谢谢你的帮助。

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

english: Hello Adventurers. Welcome to Mill Lane Mill. Can I help you?
translation: 你好冒险者们。欢迎来到磨坊巷磨坊。我能帮你吗？

english: I'm Zanik of the Dorgeshuun! What is this place?
translation: 我是多格舒恩的扎尼克！这是什么地方？

english: What's flour?
translation: 什么是面粉？

english: It's the stuff we get from milling the grain. We use it to make bread and cakes and things.
translation: 那是我们磨谷物得到的东西。我们用它做面包蛋糕之类的东西。

english: We don't have any of those things in Dorgesh-Kaan! They sound so interesting!
translation: 我们在多吉需坎城没有那些东西！它们听起来真有趣！

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: How do I mill flour?
translation: 我怎么磨面粉？

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

english: Do you want to buy a lamp, surface-dweller?
translation: 你想买盏灯吗，地表人？

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Suit yourself.
translation: 随你便。

english: Can you fill a lamp with oil please?
translation: 你能给灯加满油吗？

english: You can do that yourself! Just put some swamp tar in the lamp oil still here and then use the lamp on the still.
translation: 你可以自己做！只需把一些沼泽焦油放进这里的灯油蒸馏器，然后在蒸馏器上使用灯。

english: How do the lamps around the city work?
translation: 城市周围的灯怎么工作？

english: They work by our very own Dorgeshuun magic!
translation: 它们靠我们多格舒恩自己的魔法工作！

english: Sometimes they don't work very well, though. The light orbs blow and they have to be replaced.
translation: 不过有时它们工作得不太好。光球会坏，得更换。

english: If you ever see a lamp that's gone out, you can fix it by replacing the light orb. You can make new light orbs out of glass, and use a piece of wire on them to add the filament.
translation: 如果你看到灯灭了，可以通过更换光球来修理它。你可以用玻璃制作新光球，并在上面使用一根金属丝添加灯丝。

english: There's a machine in the south of the city that makes the wire you need.
translation: 城市南部有台机器能制作你需要的金属丝。

english: Lamps!
translation: 灯！

english: Lanterns!
translation: 灯笼！

english: Tinderboxes!
translation: 火绒盒！

english: Torches!
translation: 火把！

english: Lamp oil!
translation: 灯油！

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Can you fill a lamp with oil please?
translation: 你能给灯加满油吗？

english: How do the lamps around the city work?
translation: 城市周围的灯怎么工作？

english: Gah! Trolls everywhere. There's no escape!
translation: 啊！到处都是巨魔。无处可逃！

english: You could just leave the mine.
translation: 你可以直接离开矿洞。

english: Oh, I'd never thought of that.
translation: 哦，我从没想过那个。

english: This place rocks!
translation: 这地方太''岩''了！(双关：岩石/棒)

english: No it doesn't, it stays perfectly still.
translation: 不它不棒，它完全静止不动。

english: Bah! Be quiet, pedant.
translation: 呸！安静点，书呆子。

english: High hoe, high hoe!
translation: 高锄，高锄！

english: Why are you singing about farming implements at altitude?
translation: 你为什么在高处唱关于农具的歌？

english: I don't know, I've never thought about it. Ask my Dad, he taught me the song.
translation: 我不知道，我从没想过。问我爸，他教我的歌。

english: How's your prospecting going?
translation: 你的勘探进展如何？

english: Mine's going pretty well.
translation: 我的矿采得挺顺利。

english: Mine? Mine...you get it?
translation: 我的？我的……你懂吗？

english: Oh, I got it. That doesn't make it funny though.
translation: 哦，我懂了。但那并不好笑。

english: Suit yourself.
translation: 随你便。

english: I've been here for two days straight. When I close my eyes I see rocks.
translation: 我在这里连续待了两天。当我闭上眼睛我看到岩石。

english: Why would anyone stay here for so long?
translation: 为什么有人会在这里待这么久？

english: I fear the outside. I fear the big light.
translation: 我害怕外面。我害怕强光。

english: Oh dear. Being underground for so long may have driven you mad.
translation: 哦天哪。在地下待这么久可能把你逼疯了。

english: My back is killing me!
translation: 我的背疼死了！

english: Could be worse, it could be the trolls killing you.
translation: 可能更糟，可能是巨魔要杀你。

english: How very droll.
translation: 真有趣。

english: No, troll.
translation: 不，别''巨魔''了。(双关：巨魔/扫兴)

english: Bah! I resist your attempts at jollity.
translation: 呸！我抵制你试图逗乐。

english: Pay-dirt!
translation: 富矿！

english: Ow!
translation: 哎哟！

english: Exchuse me... I am trying to tell my verrry good friends 'bout my uncle's bushy beard.
translation: 打扰一下……我正试着告诉我非常好的朋友们关于我叔叔浓密胡须的事。

english: Exchuse me... I am lishning to my good friend.
translation: 打扰一下……我正听我好朋友说话。

english: He could hardly climb a ladder without tripping.
translation: 他几乎没法爬梯子而不绊倒。

english: Such a long beard it reached the floor!
translation: 胡须太长都拖到地板了！

english: The beard wasn't so clean after meals.
translation: 饭后胡须不太干净。

english: His beard used to get into everyone's dinner.
translation: 他的胡须曾经掉进每个人的晚餐里。

english: It was like a jungle on his chin!
translation: 他下巴上就像个丛林！

english: In the summer he didn't need clothes.
translation: 夏天他不需要衣服。

english: I mean, he needed to clean it more.
translation: 我的意思是，他需要更常清洁它。

english: He had the bushiest beard ever!
translation: 他有史上最浓密的胡须！

english: He was the hairiest dwarf in town.
translation: 他是镇上最多毛的矮人。

english: His wife could use it for a blanket.
translation: 他妻子能拿它当毯子。

english: Pearls of wisdom!
translation: 智慧箴言！

english: Ah, tell it!
translation: 啊，讲出来！

english: Best times ever!
translation: 最好的时光！

english: Right you are.
translation: 你说得对。

english: Great days!
translation: 美好的日子！

english: I'm going to be sick!
translation: 我要吐了！

english: You're right.
translation: 你是对的。

english: You're so right.
translation: 你太对了。

english: Those were the days!
translation: 那些日子啊！

english: Not like nowadays.
translation: 不像现在。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Good day. What are you doing?
translation: 你好。你在做什么？

english: I'm mining coal. It's pretty tough going.
translation: 我在采煤。相当艰难。

english: Good luck with that.
translation: 祝你好运。

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

english: Good day, Your Royal Highness.
translation: 你好，殿下。

english: Thank you, Your Royal Highness.
translation: 谢谢你，殿下。

english: Can you tell me how the kingdom approves of me?
translation: 你能告诉我王国对我的认可度吗？

english: [amount]% of people approve of you.
translation: [amount]% 的人认可你。

english: The storerooms are full, your Highness. You should talk to Advisor Ghrim to collect what we've gathered for you.
translation: 储藏室已满，殿下。请去找顾问格里姆领取我们为你收集的物资。

english: Ah! Here you go!
translation: 啊！给，拿着！

english: What?
translation: 什么？

english: I need you to answer this for me.
translation: 我需要你帮我回答这个问题。

english: Miner Magnus has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 矿工马格努斯给了你一个挑战卷轴！

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
translation: 请输入问题的答案。

english: How can that be? Go check again!
translation: 怎么会这样？再去确认一下！

english: Spot on!
translation: 完全正确！

english: Miner Magnus has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 矿工马格努斯又给了你一个线索卷轴！

english: Oi! Where d'you think you're going? Come and speak to me before you go wondering through there. You'll get yourself killed!
translation: 喂！你想去哪？在那边乱逛之前先来跟我说话。你会送命的！

english: Oi, get yer hands off that! It's reserved for survivors of the Colosseum.
translation: 喂，把手拿开！那是留给竞技场幸存者的。

english: You do not have enough Glory to use that.
translation: 你没有足够的荣耀使用那个。

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Welcome, Rookie.
translation: 欢迎，新人。

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: This place...? Why, This is the great Fortis Colosseum!
translation: 这个地方……？为什么，这是伟大的福蒂斯竞技场！

english: Adventurers come from near and far to test their might within these walls.
translation: 冒险者们从四面八方来这里在墙内测试他们的力量。

english: That sounds exciting!
translation: 听起来很刺激！

english: Indeed it is. If you are victorious in the Colosseum, the whole of Varlamore shall hear of your name.
translation: 确实是。如果你在竞技场获胜，整个瓦拉莫尔都会听到你的名字。

english: I imagine itsquite the challenge then?
translation: 我想那是相当大的挑战吧？

english: It'll put your skills to the test alright.
translation: 它确实会测试你的技能。

english: How do I participate?
translation: 我怎么参与？

english: Just head through that tunnel behind me and we'll get the show started! Make sure you've got everything you need. Once you're in you can't leave until the end of a wave!
translation: 只需穿过我后面的那条隧道，我们就开始表演！确保你有所需的一切。一旦进去，在一波结束前你不能离开！

english: Come and ask if you have any other questions.
translation: 如果有其他问题来问。

english: Can you tell me about modifiers?
translation: 你能和我说说修饰的事吗？

english: Yes! After all, they were my idea...
translation: 是的！毕竟，那是我的主意……

english: Oh...
Every time you complete a wave, I'll offer you a choice of three modifiers.
translation: 每次你完成一波，我会给你三个修饰的选择。

english: Each modifier will increase the challenge for the rest of the run - So choose wisely!
translation: 每个修饰都会增加剩余运行的挑战——所以明智选择！

english: Some modifiers can be offered multiple times, with the effects then growing in power!
translation: 一些修饰可以提供多次，效果随之增强！

english: Thanks for the heads up!
translation: 谢谢提醒！

english: Was there anything else?
translation: 还有什么吗？

english: How do I get rewarded?
translation: 我怎么获得奖励？

english: Well it's a bit different to just killing monsters and picking up items, as I'm sure you're used to...
translation: 嗯，这跟你习惯的只是杀怪捡物品有点不同……

english: How so?
translation: 怎么说？

english: After each wave inside the Colosseum, I'll show you the rewards you have earned, as well as what you'll earn from the next wave...
translation: 在竞技场内每波之后，我会显示你已获得的奖励，以及你将从下一波获得的奖励……

english: If you aren't confident that you can complete the next wave, you can claim your existing rewards and exit early.
translation: 如果你没信心完成下一波，你可以领取现有奖励并提前退出。

english: However, if you're confident you can beat the next wave, you can risk your whole reward pile to get even more!
translation: 不过，如果你有信心击败下一波，你可以冒险押上全部奖励以获得更多！

english: Be careful though. If you die or leave the arena before claiming your loot from me, you will lose all of the rewards you've earned.
translation: 但要小心。如果你在向我领取战利品前死亡或离开竞技场，你将失去所有已获得的奖励。

english: So I'm guessing the higher the wave, the better the rewards?
translation: 所以我猜波次越高，奖励越好？

english: Oh, you're good. Exactly that!
translation: 哦，你很聪明。正是如此！

english: Even better - if you manage to finish all of the waves and the final challenge, then you'll be awarded with Dizana's Quiver.
translation: 更好——如果你设法完成所有波次和最终挑战，那你将获得迪扎纳的箭袋。

english: It's a handy piece of kit that you wear on your back to store extra bolts or arrows.
translation: 那是个方便的工具，你背在背上储存额外的弩箭或箭。

english: That does sound handy! Thanks for explaining all of that.
translation: 那听起来真方便！谢谢解释所有这些。

english: Anytime, Rookie. Anything else?
translation: 随时，新人。还有别的吗？

english: What is Glory?
translation: 什么是荣耀？

english: It's the measure of your progress inside the Colosseum.
translation: 它是你在竞技场内进度的衡量。

english: Speak to Gloria over there if you want to know the details.
translation: 如果你想知道详情跟那边的格洛丽亚说话。

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

english: What do you do around here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: I'm Minimus. It's not my real name of course, but it seems to have stuck. I started out competing here as a gladiator when I was a young'n. After that I became one of the lanistas.
translation: 我是米尼穆斯。当然那不是我真名，但似乎粘上了。我年轻时开始在这里作为角斗士竞争。之后我成为了教练之一。

english: Lanistas?
translation: 教练？

english: The ones responsible for overseeing the selecting and training of the gladiators.
translation: 负责监督角斗士选拔和训练的人。

english: Eventually, the kingdom gave me the role of Colosseum Master. I still make sure to fit some fighting in, but now I have the honorof managing the fights themselves.
translation: 最终，王国给了我竞技场大师的角色。我仍确保安排一些战斗，但现在我有幸负责管理战斗本身。

english: So are you not training like the rest of the gladiators?
translation: 所以你不像其他角斗士那样训练？

english: I have no need! I'm already one of the greatest fighters to grace this arena.
translation: 我不需要！我已经是莅临这个竞技场最伟大的战士之一。

english: Are you at a disadvantage because of your height?
translation: 你因为身高处于劣势吗？

english: No! How dare you even suggest that! Those spindly human bodies are unfit to go toe to toe with a fine dwarf like myself!
translation: 不！你怎么敢那样建议！那些细长的人类身躯，哪配跟我这样优秀的矮人正面较量！

english: Hi there. You must be new around here. So what do I call you? 'Newcomer' seems so impersonal, and if we're going to be working together, I'd rather call you by name.
translation: 你好。你一定是这里的新人。那我怎么称呼你？''新人''似乎太冷漠了，如果我们要一起工作，我宁愿叫你的名字。

english: You can call me [player name].
translation: 你可以叫我 [player name]。

english: Ok then, [player name]. My name is Dezzick and I'm a miner by trade. Let's teach you how to mine.
translation: 好吧，[player name]。我叫德齐克，职业是矿工。让我教你怎么采矿。

english: Mining is very simple, all you need is a pickaxe. The rocks around here contain tin and copper. Why don't you get started by mining some?
translation: 采矿很简单，你只需要一把镐。这周围的岩石含有锡和铜。你为什么不开始采一些？

english: The rocks around here contain tin and copper. You should try mining some.
translation: 这周围的岩石含有锡和铜。你应该试试采一些。

english: Now that you have some ore, you should smelt it into a bronze bar. You can use the furnace over there to do so.
translation: 既然你有了一些矿石，你应该把它冶炼成青铜条。你可以用那边的熔炉这样做。

english: I have a bronze bar. What now?
translation: 我有个青铜条。现在呢？

english: Now that you've got a bar, you can smith it into a weapon. To smith something, you need a hammer and an anvil. There's some anvils just here that you can use. See if you can make a bronze dagger.
translation: 既然你有了条，你可以把它锻造为武器。要锻造东西，你需要锤子和铁砧。这里就有一些你可以用的铁砧。看看你能不能做把青铜匕首。

english: See if you can use the anvil here to make a bronze dagger.
translation: 看看你能不能用这里的铁砧做把青铜匕首。

english: Would you like me to recap anything?
translation: 你想让我重述什么吗？

english: Tell me about mining again.
translation: 再和我说说采矿的事。

english: Certainly. To mine you need a pickaxe. Different pickaxes let you mine more efficiently.
translation: 当然。采矿你需要一把镐。不同的镐让你采矿更高效。

english: Earlier I gave you a bronze pickaxe, which is the most inefficient pickaxe available, but is perfect for a beginner.
translation: 早些时候我给了你一把青铜镐，那是可用效率最低的镐，但非常适合初学者。

english: To mine, simply click on a rock that contains ore while you have a pickaxe with you, and you will keep mining the rock until you manage to get some ore, or until it is empty.
translation: 要采矿，只需在携带镐时点击含有矿石的岩石，你会持续采矿直到得到一些矿石，或者直到它空了。

english: The better the pickaxe you use, the faster you will get ore from the rock you're mining.
translation: 你使用的镐越好，你从正在采的岩石中得到矿石的速度越快。

english: You will be able to buy better pickaxes from the Dwarven Mine when you reach the mainland, but they can be expensive.
translation: 当你到达大陆时，你将能从矮人矿买到更好的镐，但它们可能很贵。

english: Also, the better the pickaxe the higher the Mining level required to use it will be. Was there anything else you wanted to hear?
translation: 另外，镐越好，使用它所需的采矿等级越高。还有什么你想听的吗？

english: Tell me about smelting again.
translation: 再和我说说冶炼的事。

english: Smelting is very easy. Simply take the ores required to make a metal to a furnace, then use the ores on the furnace to smelt them into a bar of metal.
translation: 冶炼很容易。只需把制作金属所需的矿石带到熔炉，然后在熔炉上使用矿石将它们冶炼成金属条。

english: Furnaces are expensive to build and maintain, so there are not that many scattered around the world. I suggest when you find one you remember its location for future use.
translation: 熔炉建造和维护昂贵，所以世界上散布的不多。我建议当你找到一个时记住它的位置以备将来使用。

english: An alternative to using a furnace to smelt your ore is to use high-level magic to do it.
translation: 使用熔炉冶炼矿石的替代方案是使用高级魔法来做。

english: As well as letting you smelt ore anywhere, it has a guaranteed success rate in smelting all ores.
translation: 除了让你在任何地方冶炼矿石，它在冶炼所有矿石时有保证的成功率。

english: Some metals, such as iron, contain impurities and can be destroyed during the smelting process in a traditional furnace, but magical heat does not destroy them.
translation: 一些金属，如铁，含有杂质，在传统熔炉冶炼过程中可能被销毁，但魔法热量不会销毁它们。

english: Anything else?
translation: 还有别的吗？

english: Tell me about Smithing again.
translation: 再和我说说锻造的事。

english: When you have acquired enough bars of the metal you wish to work with, you are ready to begin smithing.
translation: 当你获得了足够多的你想加工的金属条时，你就准备好开始锻造了。

english: Take the hammer I gave you, or buy a new one from a general store, and proceed to a nearby anvil.
translation: 拿起我给你的锤子，或者从杂货店买个新的，然后前往附近的铁砧。

english: By using a metal bar on an anvil you will be presented with a screen showing the objects you are able to smith at your current level.
translation: 通过在铁砧上使用金属条，你将看到一个屏幕显示你当前等级能够锻造的物品。

english: It's a pretty straightforward skill as I'm sure you discovered while making me that lovely bronze dagger.
translation: 这是个相当直接的技能，我相信你在给我做那把可爱的青铜匕首时发现了。

english: The higher Smithing level you are, the better quality the metal you can work with. You start off on bronze and work your way up as your smithing skills increase.
translation: 你的锻造等级越高，你能加工的金属质量越好。你从青铜开始，随着锻造技能提高逐步提升。

translation: 还有别的吗？

translation: 不，我准备继续前进了！

translation: 我已经知道采矿的基础了，有什么建议吗？

english: You can get different rocks in different places throughout the land, explore and find them.
translation: 你可以在各地不同地方得到不同的岩石，探索并找到它们。

english: You could start by traveling to the Al Kharid mine. Follow the path north and pay the 10 coins toll to go through the gate. Head north after passing through the gate and you will find the mine.
translation: 你可以从前往阿尔卡里德矿开始。沿着路向北走，付10金币过路费通过大门。通过大门后向北走你会找到矿。

translation: 但它们不都小！有些可以很大！

english: And they don't breathe air.
translation: 而且它们不呼吸空气。

english: But [player name] could tell you all about it! After all, [he's/she's] the Fishing Champion!
translation: 不过 [player name] 肯定能给你讲明白！毕竟 [他/她] 可是钓鱼冠军！

english: Maybe later...
translation: 也许改天……

english: What are these mines used for?
translation: 这些矿是做什么用的？

english: What does it look like they're used for?
translation: 它们看起来是做什么用的？

english: Isn't it obvious?
translation: 不明显吗？

english: For mining of course!
translation: 当然是为了采矿！

english: These mines are actually the territory of one of the eight major companies of the mining Consortium.
translation: 这些矿实际上是采矿财团八大主要公司之一的领地。

english: Mining companies? Where are they at then?
translation: 采矿公司？那它们在哪？

english: Oh, they all have their headquarters in the city.
translation: 哦，它们总部都在城市里。

english: First floor of the palace.
translation: 宫殿一楼。

english: No need to give [him/her] directions.
translation: 没必要给 [him/her] 指路。

english: We haul all our goods to the city by ship, you see.
translation: 我们所有的货物都用船运到城里。

english: Since the mine carts don't come here.
translation: 因为矿车不来这里。

english: But because the river goes right to the city, this is just as easy.
translation: 但因为河流直通城市，这同样容易。

english: Can you help me with this rock down in the mines?
translation: 你能帮我处理矿下的这块岩石吗？

english: It seems to be unbreakable. I need to know why.
translation: 它似乎不可破坏。我需要知道为什么。

english: Say, is that Dondakan's rock?
translation: 说，那是东达坎的石头吗？

english: That big unbreakable rock?
translation: 那块大不可破坏的石头？

english: That's what [he/she] said, isn't? Pay more attention!
translation: 那是 [他/她] 说的，对吧？多留点神！

english: Yes, yes, that's the one.
translation: 是的，是的，就是那个。

english: Oh, you're not going to get through there I'm afraid.
translation: 哦，恐怕你过不去那里。

english: It's unbreakable, you see.
translation: 它不可破坏，你看。

english: Dondakan's been there for...
translation: 东达坎在那里待了……

english: How long would you say he's been there, Miotvednir?
translation: 你说他在那里待了多久，米奥德维特尼尔？

english: Eighteen years, Derni, and not a year shorter!
translation: 十八年，德尼，一年不少！

english: That's some dedication!
translation: 真是有毅力！

english: But look at what it got him.
translation: 但看看那给他带来了什么。

english: Nothing, that's what.
translation: 什么也没有，就是那样。

english: Never mind.
translation: 没关系。

english: What material would break that rock? You know, the impenetrable one?
translation: 什么材料能打破那块石头？就是那个坚不可摧的？

english: Well... have you tried a rune pickaxe?
translation: 嗯……你试过符石镐吗？

english: An adamantite tool?
translation: 精金工具？

english: What about a bronze pickaxe?
translation: 青铜镐怎么样？

english: A bronze pickaxe??
translation: 青铜镐？？

english: What good would that do?
translation: 那有什么用？

english: Well, you never know...
translation: 嗯，你永远不知道……

english: Don't you think that's the first thing they tried?
translation: 你不觉得那肯定是他们最先试的吗？

english: Hey, it was just a suggestion!
translation: 嘿，那只是个建议！

english: Do you know anyone named Rolad? Some kind of a dwarven scholar?
translation: 你认识叫罗兰的人吗？某种矮人学者？

english: Sorry, doesn't ring a bell.
translation: 抱歉，没印象。

english: Oh yes, I know Rolad!
translation: 哦是的，我认识罗兰！

english: Oh, stop winding up the human, Dernu!
translation: 哦，别逗这个人类了，德努！

english: Do you know where he is right now?
translation: 你知道他现在在哪吗？

english: No idea, why?
translation: 不知道，为什么？

english: Dondakan wants to shoot me out of a cannon!
translation: 东达坎想把我从大炮里射出去！

english: Oh dear!
translation: 哦天哪！

english: How awful!
translation: 多可怕！

english: That's terrible!
translation: 太糟糕了！

english: He thinks I'm actually going to fly through it and land on the other side.
translation: 他以为我真能飞过去，落到另一头。

english: That sounds a bit daft.
translation: 那听起来有点傻。

english: How would that work?
translation: 那怎么运作？

english: I think you're going to hurt your head.
translation: 我想你会伤到头。

english: Old Dondakan might have finally lost it.
translation: 老东达坎可能终于疯了。

english: He was always obsessed with that rock.
translation: 他一直痴迷于那块石头。

english: And gold.
translation: 还有金子。

english: Right, and gold.
translation: 对，还有金子。

english: Any tips on how to defeat an evil demon?
translation: 有什么关于如何击败邪恶恶魔的建议吗？

english: An evil demon, you say?
translation: 邪恶恶魔，你说？

english: I'd run away if I ever ran into an evil demon.
translation: 如果我遇到邪恶恶魔我会逃跑。

english: Don't be such a coward, Dernu!
translation: 别这么懦弱，德努！

english: Well, what would you do then?
translation: 嗯，那你会做什么？

english: I don't know, I've never encountered an evil demon.
translation: 我不知道，我从没遇到过邪恶恶魔。

english: I once met a good demon though.
translation: 不过我曾经遇到过一个好恶魔。

english: Oh yes, what did he say?
translation: 哦是的，他说了什么？

english: He gave me a puzzle box and then went off again.
translation: 他给了我一个谜题盒然后又走了。

english: I think you must have had too much dwarven stout in you.
translation: 我想你一定是喝了太多矮人黑啤酒。

english: Could be, could be, but there's no telling, is there?
translation: 可能是，可能是，但说不准，对吧？

english: I defeated the spirit of the rock!
translation: 我击败了岩石之灵！

english: That's amazing!
translation: 太神奇了！

english: That's fantastic!
translation: 太棒了！

english: What rock was that again?
translation: 那是哪块石头来着？

english: Pay attention for once, Dernu! It's Dondakan's rock!
translation: 注意一次，德努！那是东达坎的石头！

english: That's quite impressive, Player. How did you manage to do that?
translation: 那相当令人印象深刻，玩家。你是怎么做到的？

english: Well, you see, I just-
translation: 嗯，你看，我只是——

english: What kind of question is that to ask? With [his/her/their] great might of course!
translation: 这还用问？当然是靠 [他/她/他们] 的强大力量！

english: Or vast magical skills!
translation: 或者强大的魔法技能！

english: No, you're more a ranger, aren't you Player?
translation: 不，你更像是个游侠，对吧玩家？

english: Actually, I-
translation: 其实，我——

english: Anyway, this calls for a celebration.
translation: 总之，这事儿得庆祝一下。

english: Oh yes, we should go down into Keldagrim to celebrate.
translation: 哦是的，我们应该去凯尔达格林城庆祝。

english: Tonight, of course, not now. We're on duty now.
translation: 今晚，当然，不是现在。我们现在值班。

english: Right... and I'm sure traffic here will pick up soon with that rock broken.
translation: 对……我相信那块石头碎了后这里的交通很快会恢复。

english: I heard there's vast amount of gold inside!
translation: 我听说里面有大量金子！

english: The company is going to be rich!
translation: 公司要发财了！

english: Now don't you go and discuss company business in front of this human, Dernu.
translation: 行了，别在这位人类面前讨论公司事务，德努。

english: Right. Let's get back to work.
translation: 对。让我们回去工作。

english: Anything else you wanted, Player?
translation: 你还想要什么，玩家？

english: I need some help with this statue... King Alvis' statue, to be precise.
translation: 我需要帮个忙，关于这个雕像……确切地说是阿尔维斯国王的雕像。

english: Oh yes, what's the problem then?
translation: 哦是的，那有什么问题？

english: It was knocked down, remember? Parts of it nearly landed on our heads?
translation: 它被推倒了，记得吗？部分差点落在我们头上？

english: A terrible noise it made too!
translation: 那动静可真够吓人的！

english: This sculptor has got me looking for a lot of items, you see.
translation: 这个雕塑家让我找很多物品，你看。

english: Items eh?
translation: 物品呃？

english: We love items.
translation: 我们爱物品。

english: Can't get enough of them.
translation: 对它们爱不释手。

english: Well, can you he-
translation: 嗯，你能帮——

english: I got this puzzle box once, you know.
translation: 我曾经得到过这个谜题盒，你知道。

english: Oh, not that story again.
translation: 哦，不是那个故事又来了。

english: You have told that story before, Dernu.
translation: 你以前讲过那个故事，德努。

english: Well forget about it then. I'll shut up if you don't want to hear about it.
translation: 那就算了吧。如果你不想听我就不说了。

english: Well, the sculptor only needs to build the head now. But I need to get the Consortium to help me with that.
translation: 嗯，雕塑家现在只需要制作头部了。但我需要让财团帮我搞定那个。

english: The Consortium, you say?
translation: 你说财团？

english: You're going to talk to the Consortium?
translation: 你要去找财团谈？

english: My, you're certainly moving up in the dwarven world, aren't you?
translation: 天哪，你在矮人界真是步步高升啊，不是吗？

english: What do you need us for then?
translation: 那你需要我们做什么？

english: We are but simple dwarves.
translation: 我们只是普通的矮人。

english: Especially you, Dernu.
translation: 尤其是你，德努。

english: Now now, Derni, there was no need for that.
translation: 好了好了，德尼，没必要那样。

english: I have rebuilt the statue for the [company name]!
translation: 我已经为 [company name] 重建了雕像！

english: What, really?
translation: 什么，真的吗？

english: Of course, really! Player wouldn't have said it otherwise, would [he/she/they]?
translation: 当然是真的！玩家不会乱说的，对吧 [he/she/they]？

english: And didn't you see Blasidar working on the statue?
translation: 而且你没看到布拉西达在制作雕像吗？

english: Oh yes, he was out there for quite a while.
translation: 哦是的，他在外面待了挺久。

english: That must have been a huge task.
translation: 那一定是个巨大的任务。

english: Nothing's too difficult for old Blasidar.
translation: 没什么能难倒老布拉西达。

english: He truly is a master builder.
translation: 他真是个建筑大师。

english: We can all take an example to his hard work and dedication.
translation: 我们都该以他的勤奋和敬业为榜样。

english: Speaking of, shouldn't we get back to work ourselves?
translation: 说到这个，我们是不是也该回去工作了？

english: Quite right. Anything else you wanted, Player?
translation: 很对。你还想要什么吗，玩家？

english: Do you know about this drunken dwarf...?
translation: 你认识这个醉矮人吗……？

english: Drunken dwarf?
translation: 醉矮人？

english: Yeah, we know a drunken dwarf!
translation: 是啊，我们认识一个醉矮人！

english: In fact we know plenty!
translation: 事实上我们认识好多！

english: There's this one really annoying dwarf though, he sometimes throws rocks at me for no reason.
translation: 不过有个特别讨厌的矮人，他有时无缘无故朝我扔石头。

english: Yeah, tell me about it.
translation: 是啊，谁说不是呢。

english: The one I mean is his relative, living in the northeast of Keldagrim. I wonder if you could help me with him.
translation: 我说的是他的亲戚，住在凯尔达格林城东北部。我在想你们能不能帮我对付他。

english: Ah yes, him.
translation: 啊是的，他。

english: Such a sad case, poor fellow.
translation: 真是个悲惨的案例，可怜的家伙。

english: Who is he?
translation: 他是谁？

english: Don't you know anything?
translation: 你什么都不知道吗？

english: Now now, there's no reason to get angry.
translation: 好了好了，没必要生气。

english: I suppose you're right. Well, he's a drunk dwarf that talks about kebabs a lot.
translation: 我想你说得对。嗯，他是个喝醉的矮人，老是念叨烤肉串。

english: Has some pretty odd tales to tell too.
translation: 还有些相当奇怪的故事要讲。

english: And I understand he's the relative of that dwarf I mentioned earlier.
translation: 而且我知道他是我刚才提到的那个矮人的亲戚。

english: I hope that helped, Player?
translation: 希望那有帮助，玩家？

english: I have this unforgettable tale to tell you!
translation: 我有个难忘的故事要告诉你们！

english: A tale!
translation: 一个故事！

english: We love tales!
translation: 我们爱故事！

english: We live for tales!
translation: 我们为故事而生！

english: Like, there was this one time when I lost my spanner in the mines...
translation: 比如，有一次我在矿里丢了扳手……

english: Player wants to tell a tale!
translation: 玩家要讲故事！

english: But my spanner... it's a very interesting tale you know.
translation: 但我的扳手……那是个非常有趣的故事你知道。

english: I think we've heard it before.
translation: 我想我们以前听过。

english: It was pretty forgettable.
translation: 相当容易忘记。

english: Excuse me, do you want to hear my tale or not?
translation: 喂，你们到底想不想听我讲故事？

english: Happy to.
translation: 乐意之至。

english: Would love to hear it.
translation: 很想听。

english: As long as it's better than my spanner story.
translation: 只要比我的扳手故事好就行。

english: So, what's your tale like?
translation: 那么，你的故事是什么样的？

english: Ah, I errrr...
translation: 啊，我呃……

english: I seem to have forgotten.
translation: 我好像忘了。

english: Must have been pretty forgettable as well then.
translation: 那肯定也相当容易忘记。

english: I must be off now, thanks for the chat.
translation: 我现在得走了，谢谢聊天。

english: No problem!
translation: 没问题！

english: Glad to be of service!
translation: 很高兴为你服务！

english: Come back any time!
translation: 随时再来！

english: What's down this river?
translation: 这条河下游是什么？

english: Any good spots to fish around here?
translation: 这附近有什么好钓鱼点吗？

english: What are these mines used for?
translation: 这些矿是做什么用的？

english: Can you help me with this rock?
translation: 你能帮我处理这块岩石吗？

english: What material would break that rock?
translation: 什么材料能打破那块岩石？

english: Do you know anyone named Rolad?
translation: 你认识叫罗兰的人吗？

english: Dondakan wants to shoot me out of a cannon!
translation: 东达坎想把我从大炮里射出去！

english: Any tips on how to defeat an evil demon?
translation: 有什么关于如何击败邪恶恶魔的建议吗？

english: I defeated the spirit of the rock!
translation: 我击败了岩石之灵！

english: I need some help with this statue...
translation: 我需要一些关于这个雕像的帮助……

english: I have rebuilt the statue for the [company name]!
translation: 我已经为 [company name] 重建了雕像！

english: Do you know about this drunken dwarf...?
translation: 你认识这个醉矮人吗……？

english: I have this unforgettable tale to tell you!
translation: 我有个难忘的故事要告诉你们！

english: I must be off now, thanks for the chat.
translation: 我现在得走了，谢谢聊天。

english: Can I help you today?
translation: 今天我能帮你吗？

english: Can I go for a ride?
translation: 我能坐矿车吗？

english: Minecart rides are 20 coins.
translation: 乘坐矿车要20金币。

english: Of course.
translation: 当然。

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

english: As a loyal customer of the Lovakengj Minecart Network, you're entitled to this.
translation: 身为洛瓦肯吉矿车网络的忠实客户，你自然享有这项权益。

english: Now, can I help you today?
translation: 现在，今天我能帮你吗？

english: You're already here, human.
translation: 你已经在这里了，人类。

english: Hello, human. Can I help you?
translation: 你好，人类。我能帮你吗？

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: This is the principal station of the Lovakengj Minecart Network. Once it's running, our people will be able to travel rapidly all across the city.
translation: 这是洛瓦肯吉矿车网络的总站。一旦启用，我们的同胞就能在整个城市快速往来。

english: Can I ride your minecart?
translation: 我能坐你的矿车吗？

english: The network is for the citizens of Lovakengj only, though I'll let you use it if you help me first. Free up some inventory space if you're interested.
translation: 这网络只供洛瓦肯吉市民使用，不过你要是先帮个忙，我可以破例让你用。感兴趣的话，先腾点物品栏空间。

english: The network is for the citizens of Lovakengj only, though I'll let you use it if you help me first.
translation: 网络仅供洛瓦肯吉市民使用，不过如果你先帮我，我可以让你使用。

english: Alright, what do you need me to do?
translation: 好吧，你需要我做什么？

english: The workers at the other stations got incorrect versions of the control scrolls, so they can't operate the minecarts. Please take these updated scrolls to them.
translation: 其他站点的工人拿到了错误版本的控制卷轴，所以他们无法操作矿车。请把这些更新后的卷轴带给他们。

english: That's one scroll each for the Arceuus station, the Shayzien station, the Hosidius station, the Piscarilius station and the Quidamortem station.
translation: 阿西乌斯站、谢兹恩城站、霍西迪乌斯站、皮斯卡里琉斯站和奎达莫特站各一个卷轴。

english: Where do I need to go?
translation: 我需要去哪？

english: The Arceuus station is just next to the Arceuus Library, in the north of the city.
translation: 阿西乌斯站就在阿西乌斯图书馆旁边，在城市北部。

english: The Shayzien station is east of the Shayzien Encampment.
translation: 谢兹恩城站在谢兹恩城营地东边。

english: The Hosidius station is north of the Woodcutting Guild.
translation: 霍西迪乌斯站在伐木公会北边。

english: The Piscarilius station is south of the city, next to a small mine.
translation: 皮斯卡里琉斯站在城市南部，紧邻一个小矿。

english: The Quidamortem station is at the peak of the mountain, deep in the Kebos Lowlands.
translation: 奎达莫特站在山顶，位于凯博斯低地深处。

english: Can I go for a ride now?
translation: 我能坐矿车吗？

english: No, you haven't unlocked any of the other stations yet.
translation: 不，你还没解锁任何其他站点。

english: Do I have to pay every time I use the carts?
translation: 我每次用车都要付钱吗？

english: Hmmm... We normally charge 50 coins per ride. For 100,000 coins, you'll never have to pay again.
translation: 嗯……我们通常每次收50金币。要是付100,000金币，你就终身免费了。

english: 100,000 coins is a rip-off!
Take it or leave it, human! You may enjoy being about to ride our carts without having to carry coins every time.
translation: 爱要不要，人类！能不用每次都带金币就坐矿车，这便利你总会喜欢的。

english: I'd rather not, thanks.
translation: 我宁愿不要，谢谢。

english: Can I do anything else for you, human?
translation: 我还能为你做什么吗，人类？

english: I'll get on with it.
translation: 我去办了。

english: I'm not interested.
translation: 我没兴趣。

english: Some of my stations still require control scrolls.
translation: 我的一些站点还需要控制卷轴。

english: Have you got any more scrolls?
translation: 你还有更多卷轴吗？

english: Yes, but you don't have room in your inventory.
translation: 有，但你物品栏没空间了。

english: Here you go, human.
translation: 拿着，人类。

english: No thanks, I don't want it back.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我不想要回它。

english: Thanks for delivering those control scrolls, human. What can I do for you today?
translation: 谢谢运送那些控制卷轴，人类。今天有什么能帮你的？

english: Can I go for a ride?
translation: 我能坐矿车吗？

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: Can I ride your minecart?
translation: 我能坐你的矿车吗？

english: Alright, what do you need me to do?
translation: 好吧，你需要我做什么？

english: Where do I need to go?
translation: 我需要去哪？

english: Can I go for a ride now?
translation: 我能坐矿车吗？

english: Oooh, my dear, have you heard the news?

english: Well, I know of him.
translation: 嗯，我听说过他。

english: When he first moved here, he didn't bring much. From the window you could see he just had some old furniture and a few dusty ornaments.
translation: 他刚搬来时没带多少东西。窗户就能看见，就些旧家具和几个落灰的摆件。

english: Here, look at this picture:

english: A cutscene of a poor Wise Old Man is shown
translation: 显示睿智老人贫穷的过场动画

english: Also he always seemed so poor. When I went round to collect donations for the Draynor Manor Restoration Fund, he couldn't spare them a penny!
translation: 而且他总是一副穷酸相。我四处为德雷诺庄园修复基金募捐时，他连一分钱都不肯掏！

english: So he's redecorated?

english: Well, just you look in there now!

english: A cutscene of a rich Wise Old Man is shown
translation: 显示睿智老人富有的过场动画

english: You see? It's full of jewellery and decorations! And all those expensive things appeared just after the bank got robbed.
translation: 看到了吗？里面全是珠宝和装饰品！而且那些值钱玩意儿都是银行被抢后才冒出来的。

english: He changed his hat too - he used to wear a scruffy old black thing, but suddenly he was wearing that party hat!
translation: 他还换了帽子呢——以前戴个邋里邋遢的旧黑帽，突然就戴上那个派对帽了！

english: So that's why you're telling people he was the bank robber?
translation: 所以这就是你为什么告诉人们他是银行劫匪？

english: Oooh, my dear, I'm SURE of it! I went upstairs in his house once, while he was out walking, and do you know what I found?
translation: 哎呀，亲爱的，我敢肯定！有回他出门散步，我溜进他家楼上，你猜我发现了什么？

english: A sign saying 'Trespassers will be prosecuted'?
translation: 一个写着“擅入者将被起诉”的牌子？

english: No, it was a telescope! It was pointing right at the bank! He was spying on the bankers, planning the big robbery!
translation: 不，是个望远镜！正对着银行呢！他肯定在监视银行职员，策划那场大劫案！

english: I bet if you go and look through it now, you'll find it's pointing somewhere different now he's finished with the bank.
translation: 我敢肯定，你现在去看看，准会发现既然他搞定了银行，那望远镜肯定指向别处了。

english: I'd like to go now.
translation: 我现在想走了。

english: Oh, really? Well, do keep an eye on him - I just KNOW he's planning something...
translation: 真的？你可得盯紧他——我就是知道他在谋划什么……

english: I've been around here for ages.
translation: 我在这里待了很久了。

english: Ah, so you'd have seen the changes here. It's that old man in this house here. Do you know him?

english: Oooh, my dear, had you not heard?

english: At this rate I don't think I want to know...

english: Oh, you must quickly go and speak to the bank guard outside the bank. He'll tell you all about it, oooh, such a shock it was...
translation: 哦，你得赶紧去找银行门口的那个守卫聊聊。他会告诉你一切，哎呀，那可真是令人震惊……

translation: 我嘛，是德雷诺村一位关心村务的市民。自从议会允许那些农民在这儿摆摊以来，我们这美丽的村庄就不断有小偷和杀手出没，

english: that someone HAD to stand up and keep an eye on the situation.

english: I also do voluntary work for the Draynor Manor Restoration Fund. We're campaigning to have Draynor Manor turned into a museum before the wet-rot destroys it completely.
translation: 我还为德雷诺庄园修复基金做志愿工作。我们正努力在湿腐病彻底摧毁庄园前，将其改造成博物馆。

english: Why do the Dorgeshuun live underground?
translation: 为什么多格舒恩人住在地下？

english: Our ancient legends say that goblins were created by an evil god in order to fight in a huge war. This god sent the Dorgeshuun tribe to fight a battle where all would die.
translation: 据古老传说，哥布林乃邪神所创，用以在一场浩劫中作战。此神曾派多格舒恩部落奔赴一场必死之役。

english: But our ancestors escaped by hiding in a deep hole in the ground where our god could not find us. Eventually an earthquake sealed the hole and they were forever safe.
translation: 但我们的祖先躲进一处深地洞得以逃脱，令邪神无法寻获。最终地震封死洞口，他们从此安然无恙。

english: The war is over now, so you can return to the surface.
translation: 战争现在结束了，所以你们可以回到地表。

english: Even if the gods are no longer at war, I find it hard to believe that a tribe of peaceful goblins would be safe above. I have heard of humans coming down into the caves to slaughter our people!
translation: 即使神不再战争，我也很难相信一个和平的哥布林部落在地表会安全。我听说过人类下到洞穴屠杀我们的人民！

english: But even if we could return, we would not want to. We are adapted to living underground, and we have built a home for ourselves that we do not want to leave.
translation: 但即便能够回归，我们也不愿回去。我们已适应地下生活，并在此建立了不愿舍弃的家园。

english: What was the name of your god?
translation: 你们的神名叫什么？

english: Our ancestors did not speak his name, thinking that to do so would attract his attention. His name has been unspoken for so long that it is now entirely forgotten.
translation: 我们的祖先从不提及他的名讳，唯恐此举会招致其注意。此名久未言说，如今已彻底湮没。

english: That is for the best. We have survived perfectly well without gods, and we do not want a return to the old ways.
translation: 那样最好。无神庇佑我们亦能安居乐业，我们无意重返旧日的生活方式。

english: I lost it in a mining accident a few years ago.

english: This area is very unstable. That's why we put markers on the wall showing the safest path.

translation: 发生了什么啊啊啊！

english: Arrgh! Human! Scary! Go away!
translation: 啊啊！人类！可怕！走开！

english: Do you seek guidance, traveller?
translation: 你在寻求指引吗，旅行者？

english: Sure, gimme your best advice.
translation: 当然，给我你最好的建议。

english: *sigh*
translation: 叹气

english: You flesh-temples always assume you can receive guidance merely by asking someone for it. But in this land there is a power that can teach us far more than any mere teacher could.
translation: 你们这些血肉之躯总以为只需开口询问便能获得指引。但在这片土地上，有一种力量所能传授的，远超任何凡师。

english: I speak of the Dark Altar. For generations our wisest scholars have studied it, yet still it has capacities beyond our comprehension.
translation: 我指的是黑暗祭坛。数代以来，我们最睿智的学者皆在研习它，然而它仍有超越我们理解范畴的能力。

english: The Dark Altar can distort the dimensions, warping the fabric of reality as you perceive it, and even bridging the gap between life and death.
translation: 黑暗祭坛能扭曲维度，扰乱你所感知的现实结构，甚至弥合生死之间的鸿沟。

english: But you are still a flesh-temple; you require a corporeal body to house your soul, and you perform disgusting bodily functions to maintain it.
translation: 但你仍是血肉之躯，需借肉体容纳灵魂，还要进行那些令人作呕的生理活动来维系它。

english: We of Arceuus have learnt, through the power of the Dark Altar, to move beyond the need for such a flesh- temple to house our souls.
translation: 我们阿西乌斯城之人，通过掌握黑暗祭坛之力，已超越了对血肉之躯容纳灵魂的依赖。

english: In the crypt below us, we freed our souls from the flesh-temples that had imprisoned them, and we took the form you see now.
translation: 在我们下方的墓穴中，我们将灵魂从囚禁它们的血肉之躯中解放，化作了你如今所见的形态。

english: Perhaps, if you allow the Dark Altar to work on your mind, one day you too will be able to ascend to our higher form.
translation: 也许，若你容许黑暗祭坛淬炼你的心智，有朝一日你亦能升华至我等的高等形态。

english: Thank you for explaining that.
translation: 谢谢你的解释。

english: I fear you are far from comprehending it. Now, is there anything I can do for you?
translation: 恐怕你远未理解它。现在，有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: No thanks, I like having a body. It's fun.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。我喜欢拥有肉身，这很有趣。

english: How disgusting - a flesh-temple that worships itself. Now, do you want anything?
translation: 真恶心——一个崇拜自己的血肉之躯。现在，你想要什么吗？

english: What god do you worship?
translation: 你崇拜什么神？

english: You sound like the Saradominist peasants from Hosidius, always assuming they must serve one god above all others.
translation: 你听起来像霍西迪乌斯那些信奉萨拉多明的平民，总以为必须独尊一神。

english: While the gods are useful for tedious matters such as granting prayers during combat, we of Arceuus have long moved beyond the need to pay them homage.
translation: 虽说诸神在战斗时赐予祈祷增益等琐事上确有用处，但我们阿西乌斯城之人早已无需再向他们顶礼膜拜。

english: This is a place of meditation, where a novice may contemplate the mysteries of the Dark Altar - without venturing too close to its power.
translation: 此乃冥想之所，新手可在此参悟黑暗祭坛的奥秘，而无需冒险靠近其力量。

english: Saradomin is popular with many uneducated citizens of Kourend, but you may use our church to worship any god you prefer. That would be an ecumenical matter.
translation: 萨拉多明在库兰德众多平民中颇受欢迎，但你亦可在此教堂崇拜任何你偏爱的神明。此乃宗教包容之事。

english: No, I'm fine.
translation: 不，我没事。

english: Who are you?
