english: Me? Well, let's see... I live here. So I suppose I'm your host, as long as you're in my house.
translation: 我？嗯，让我看看……我住这里。所以我想我是你的主人，只要你在我的房子里。

english: I used to work down at the beach, running the charcoal furnaces, but I've handed all that business to my son now. He's a good boy.
translation: 我过去在海滩工作，经营木炭熔炉，但我现在把所有生意都交给我儿子了。他是个好孩子。

english: Anyway, retiring isn't too bad. There's plenty of warmth from the lava pits, and my boy helps me carry my shopping from Munty's shop. I'll be alright.
translation: 总之，退休生活倒也惬意。熔岩坑提供了充足暖意，我儿也会帮我从蒙蒂店里取回买好的东西。我会没事的。

english: But you've never told me what you're doing in my house, young [man/lady]. Don't think I've forgotten!
translation: 但你从没告诉我你在我家做什么，年轻的 [man/lady]。别以为我忘了！

english: Have you got anything to trade?
translation: 你有什么货物要交易吗？

english: Oh, are you a door-to-door [salesman/saleswoman]? My boy said I shouldn't let people like you into the house, and to call the guards if you bothered me.
translation: 哦，你是上门推销的 [salesman/saleswoman] 吗？我儿子说我不该让你这样的人进屋，如果你烦我就叫守卫。

english: That won't be necessary.
translation: 那没必要。

english: So why are you in my house anyway?
translation: 那你到底为什么在我家？

english: I'm just wandering around.
translation: 我只是四处逛逛。

english: Be a dear and just wander off now.
translation: 乖，现在请离开吧。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Have you got anything to trade?
translation: 你有什么货物要交易吗？

english: I'm just wandering around.
translation: 我只是四处逛逛。

english: Human scare all da fishies!
translation: 人类吓跑所有鱼！

english: I smack you good!
translation: 我好好打你！

english: Da boom-boom kill all da fishies!
translation: 轰隆隆杀死所有鱼！

english: Tasty human!
translation: 美味人类！

english: Smash stupid human!
translation: 砸烂愚蠢人类！

english: I get you!
translation: 我抓到你了！

english: Human hit me on the head!
translation: 人类打我头！

english: Silly fishy! You lookin' like likkle Mogre wid your likkle arms an' wid your likkle legs!
translation: 傻鱼！你看起来像小 Mogre 带着你的小胳膊和小腿！

english: Swim along silly round head fishy!
translation: 游走吧傻圆头鱼！

english: Dont let dem big skippies eat you!
translation: 别让那些大跳鱼吃了你！

english: Hey! Nung says no fishies...
translation: 嘿！农格说没鱼……

english: I just spoke to Nung, he said it was ok.
translation: 我刚跟农格说话，他说可以。

english: Well...if Nung say it ok, den go ahead.
translation: 嗯……如果农格说可以，那就去吧。

english: The player enters the crab pen
translation: 玩家进入蟹池

english: Can I help you today?
translation: 今天我能帮你吗？

english: Can I go for a ride?
translation: 我能坐矿车吗？

english: Minecart rides are 20 coins.
translation: 乘坐矿车要20金币。

english: Of course.
translation: 当然。

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

english: As a loyal customer of the Lovakengj Minecart Network, you're entitled to this.
translation: 身为洛瓦肯吉矿车网络的忠实客户，你自然享有这项权益。

english: Now, can I help you today?
translation: 现在，今天我能帮你吗？

english: You're already here, human.
translation: 你已经在这里了，人类。

english: Sorry, human, you can't use the Lovakengj Minecart Network. Speak to Miriam, at the main station by the southern Lovakengj bank, if you've got any questions.
translation: 抱歉，人类，洛瓦肯吉矿车网络暂不对外族开放。如有疑问，请前往洛瓦肯吉南部银行旁的总站咨询米里亚姆。

english: Sorry, human, the Lovakengj Minecart Network is for citizens of Lovakengj only.
translation: 抱歉，人类，洛瓦肯吉矿车网络仅供洛瓦肯吉市民使用。

english: I've got this control scroll for you.
translation: 我有这个控制卷轴给你。

english: Thanks, human. I guess it's okay for you to ride my carts after all. So, can I help you?
translation: 谢谢，人类。我想毕竟你可以坐我的矿车了。那么，我能帮你吗？

english: Thanks again for bringing me that control scroll. Can I help you today?
translation: 再次谢谢你给我带那个控制卷轴。今天我能帮你吗？

english: No thanks, you've already given me one of those.
translation: 不用了谢谢，你已经给过我一个了。

english: Can I go for a ride?
translation: 我能坐矿车吗？

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

english: Excuse me...
translation: 打扰一下……

english: Can I help you?
translation: 我能帮你吗？

english: Can you tell me anything about the castle?
translation: 能说说城堡的情况吗？

english: There aren't many guards in it.
translation: 里面守卫不多。

english: We don't have an army, you see.
translation: 你看，我们没有军队。

english: How's the weather doing?
translation: 天气怎么样？

english: Could be better.
translation: 可能会更好。

english: How's life in Etceteria?
translation: 埃特塞特拉的生活怎么样？

english: *sigh* Times are tough.
translation: (叹气)时世艰难。

english: Though they're getting better.
translation: 不过在变好。

english: What's it like being an Etceterian?
translation: 做埃特塞特拉人怎么样？

english: Fairly pleasant, though it gets cold in the winter.
translation: 相当愉快，虽然冬天会变冷。

english: Nice town you have here.
translation: 你这城镇不错。

english: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。

english: What is it?
translation: 是什么？

english: Thank you for finding my arrows for me. Did you find everyone's belongings?
translation: 谢谢你帮我找到箭。你找到所有人的物品了吗？

english: I did! Thank you for the reward.
translation: 找到了！谢谢报酬。

english: You're more than welcome to it, for getting our belongings back.
translation: 你能帮我们找回物品，这是应该的。

english: Can you tell me how the kingdom approves of me?
translation: 你能告诉我王国对我的认可度吗？

english: [amount]% of people approve of you.
translation: [amount]% 的人认可你。

english: The storerooms are full, your Highness. You should talk to Advisor Ghrim to collect what we've gathered for you.
translation: 储藏室已满，殿下。请去找顾问格里姆领取我们为你收集的物资。

english: Wait! Do you know what you're doing here?
translation: 等等！你知道你在这里做什么吗？

english: Yes, I know, I've been here before.
translation: 是的，我知道，我以前来过这里。

english: Well good luck then!
translation: 那祝你好运！

english: Erm, no I don't actually.
translation: 不，我其实不知道。

english: Well, come on over and I'll fill you in on what happened.
translation: 嗯，过来我告诉你发生了什么。

english: Thanks for coming!
translation: 谢谢你来！

english: What's the problem then?
translation: 那有什么问题？

english: It's my evil twin sister! She's been galavanting around Gielinor committing crimes and now I'm getting the blame!
translation: 是我邪恶的双胞胎妹妹！她一直在基利诺尔到处犯罪现在我却背锅！

english: Well what's all this got to do with me then?
translation: 那这跟我有什么关系？

english: I'm glad you asked!
translation: 我很高兴你问了！

english: Through that door is a room with a cage and a control panel that operates a giant mechanical claw.
translation: 那扇门后是一间设有牢笼与控制面板的房间，面板可操控一具巨型机械爪。

english: I lured my sister into the room so I could imprison her in the cage by using the claw. The problem is my sister managed to herd some innocent civilians in there with her.
translation: 我把妹妹诱进房间以便用爪子把她关在笼子里。问题是我妹妹设法把一些无辜平民也赶进去了。

english: So what do you need me to do?
translation: 那么你需要我做什么？

english: I need you to go next door and use the claw to catch my sister.
translation: 我需要你去隔壁操控机械爪抓住我妹妹。

english: Once she's in prison, she won't be causing me anymore bother!
translation: 一旦她入狱，她就不会再给我添麻烦了！

english: Sounds easy enough to me.
translation: 听起来挺简单的。

english: Fabulous! Now take a good long look at me because the door will be locked behind you. My twin looks exactly like me, even her clothes!
translation: 太好了！现在好好仔细看看我，因为门会在你身后锁上。我的双胞胎妹妹与我容貌衣着都一模一样！

english: One more thing to make your life difficult; the magic powering the claw is running low so you'll only have two attempts to catch her.
translation: 还有一事给你增加点难度：驱动机械爪的魔法能量即将耗尽，所以你只有两次机会抓住她。

english: I'll do my best then!
translation: 那我会尽力！

english: By the way, would you like me to run through the controls for you, or do you think you'll manage?
translation: 顺便一问，需要我给你讲解一下操作方法，还是你觉得能自行搞定？

english: Yes please. I mean, it's always best to be prepared, right?
translation: 好的，麻烦你了。有备无患嘛。

english: Ok, when you turn the machine on you'll see the glowing mark on the floor where the claw is currently aiming, and you'll see a lever and button on the right hand side of your screen.
translation: 好的，启动机器后，你会看到地板上有一处发光标记，即机械爪当前瞄准的位置；屏幕右侧则设有拉杆与按钮。

english: To move the claw's current location, click on the direction you want it to move in, as indicated on the right hand panel.
translation: 要移动爪子的当前位置，点击你想让它移动的方向，如右侧面板所示。

english: You'll know which way the claw will go as the lever will point that way to show you.
translation: 你可通过拉杆指向判断机械爪的移动方向。

english: When you see someone on top of the glowing mark, then hit the button on the right hand panel, as this will send the claw down to pick them up.
translation: 当有人站在发光标记上时，点击右侧面板的按钮，机械爪便会下落将其抓起。

english: Do be careful and make sure that there is someone on the mark, and not just walking past it.
translation: 务必小心，确认标记上确实有人停留，而非只是路过。

english: Oh, and make sure that the person is my sister, so you don't end up catching a random civilian.
translation: 哦，还要确认那人是我妹妹，以免误抓其他无辜平民。

english: Does that help?
translation: 那有帮助吗？

english: Yes, that covers everything. Thanks!
translation: 好的，都讲清楚了。谢谢！

english: Good luck!
translation: 祝你好运！

english: No, thanks. I should be able to work it out.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。我应该能搞定。

english: I want to leave.
translation: 我想离开。

english: Fine. And there I was thinking you'd help.
translation: 好吧。我还以为你会帮忙。

english: The player is teleported back to their initial location
translation: 玩家被传送回初始位置

english: What do I have to do again?
translation: 我又要做什么？

english: One more time then.
translation: 那再来一次。

english: Through that door is a room with cage and a control panel that operates a giant mechanical claw.
translation: 那扇门后是一间设有牢笼与控制面板的房间，面板可操控一具巨型机械爪。

english: I lured my sister into the room so I can imprison her in the cage by using the claw. The problem is my sister managed to herd some innocent civilians in there with her.
translation: 我把妹妹诱进房间以便用爪子把她关在笼子里。问题是我妹妹设法把一些无辜平民也赶进去了。

english: Once she's in prison she wont be causing me anymore bother!
translation: 一旦她入狱她就不会再给我添麻烦了！

english: You need to finish grabbing my twin before you come back through!
translation: 你需先成功抓住我的双胞胎妹妹，才可以回去！

english: Okay.
translation: 好的。

english: But I want to leave.
translation: 但我想离开。

english: You need to use the control panel to use the claw!
translation: 你需用控制面板来操控机械爪！

english: Well, you tried your best I suppose. Come next door and talk to me.
translation: 嗯，我想你尽力了。来隔壁跟我说话。

english: Err, sorry. I seem to have messed it up a little.
translation: 呃，抱歉。我好像搞砸了一点。

english: Such incompetence! I should never have asked a baboon like you to do a complex task like this!
translation: 真无能！我真不该让像你这样的狒狒做这么复杂的任务！

english: Get out of my sight!
translation: 滚出我的视线！

english: Well done! You managed to catch my sister!
translation: 做得好！你成功抓到了我妹妹！

english: Come next door and talk to me.
translation: 来隔壁跟我说话。

english: Well, I've managed to get her into the cage.
translation: 嗯，我设法把她弄进笼子了。

english: Fantastic! For so many years I've had to put up with her and now she's locked up for good.
translation: 太棒了！这么多年我不得不忍受她，如今她终于被永远囚禁了。

english: Thank you for all your help. Take this as a reward.
translation: 谢谢你所有的帮助。拿这个当报酬。

english: Player is teleported back to their initial location
translation: 玩家被传送回初始位置

english: Yes, I know.
translation: 是的，我知道。

english: Erm, no I don't actually.
translation: 不，我其实不知道。

english: I want to leave.
translation: 我想离开。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Okay.
translation: 好的。

english: But I want to leave.
translation: 但我想离开。

english: Who's a good doggy!
translation: 谁是乖狗狗！

english: Woof!
translation: 汪！

english: Thbbbbt!
translation: 呸！

english: Whine!
translation: 呜咽！

english: Woof woof!
translation: 汪汪！

english: You give the dog a nice piece of meat. It gobbles it up.
translation: 你给狗一块好肉。它狼吞虎咽。

english: Grrrr!
translation: 咕噜！

english: That's disgusting - you can't give it to the poor dog!
translation: 真恶心——你不能给可怜的狗那个！

english: The dog doesn't seem interested in that.
translation: 狗似乎对那个没兴趣。

english: Greetings traveller.
translation: 你好，旅行者。

english: Can you heal me? I'm injured.
translation: 你能治疗我吗？我受伤了。

english: Ok.
translation: 好的。

english: Sorry, no.
translation: 抱歉，不。

english: Isn't this place built a bit out of the way?
translation: 这地方建得有点偏僻吗？

english: We like it that way actually! We get disturbed less. We still get rather a large amount of travellers looking for sanctuary and healing here as it is!
translation: 其实我们喜欢那样！这样便少受打扰。即便如此，仍有不少旅行者来此寻求庇护与治疗！

english: How do I get further into the monastery?
translation: 我怎么进一步进入修道院？

english: You'll need to talk to Abbot Langley about that. He's usually to be found walking the halls of the monastery.
translation: 此事需与兰利修道院长商议。他常于修道院大厅中巡视。

english: Only members of our order can go up there. You'll need to talk to Abbot Langley if you want to explore the monastery further.
translation: 只有我们教团的成员能上去。如果你想进一步探索修道院你需要跟兰利修道院长谈。

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: We offer sanctuary to those seeking the guidance of Saradomin.
translation: 我们为寻求萨拉多明指引的人提供庇护。

english: What if I want guidance from another god?
translation: 如果我想要另一个神的指引呢？

english: If Saradomin's not good enough for you, those otherworldly freaks from Arceuus are probably your kind of people.
translation: 如果萨拉多明无法满足你的需求，那些来自阿西乌斯城的异界异类或许正合你意。

english: They're always looking for hidden knowledge about souls and spirits, when any sensible person would just trust in Saradomin.
translation: 他们总是在寻找关于灵魂和精神的隐藏知识，而任何理智的人都会只信任萨拉多明。

english: I see.
translation: 我明白了。

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

english: Peace brother
translation: 平安兄弟

english: Can you heal me? I'm injured.
translation: 你能治疗我吗？我受伤了。

english: Isn't this place built a bit out of the way?
translation: 这地方建得有点偏僻吗？

english: How do I get further into the monastery?
translation: 我怎么进一步进入修道院？

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: What if I want guidance from another god?
translation: 如果我想要另一个神的指引呢？

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

english: Pray for salvation!
translation: 为救赎祈祷！

english: Protect our home!
translation: 保护我们的家园！

english: Save our monastery!
translation: 拯救我们的修道院！

english: Say no to Oziach!
translation: 对奥齐亚克说不！

english: Spook, don't spend!
translation: 幽灵，别花钱！

english: We're the only Monk robe spawn in the world!
translation: 我们是世界上唯一的修士袍生成点！

english: Hello! What is going on here?
translation: 你好！这里发生了什么事？

english: We're protesting of course!
translation: 当然，我们在抗议！

english: Yes, I can see that. What are you protesting about?
translation: 是的，我能看到。你们在抗议什么？

english: Our home! It's under attack! We must save it!
translation: 我们的家园！它受到攻击了！我们必须拯救它！

english: Under attack?!
translation: 受到攻击？！

english: Under attack by Oziach! He's trying to buy it!
translation: 受到奥齐亚克攻击！他正试图买下它！

english: Buy it? Buy the entire monastery?
translation: 买下它？买下整个修道院？

english: Yes! He's trying to buy our home, we need to stop him!
translation: 是的！他正试图买下我们的家园，我们需要阻止他！

english: Will you help us?
translation: 你会帮我们吗？

english: Of course I will help!
translation: 当然我会帮！

english: The player starts the 2021 Halloween event.
translation: 玩家开始2021万圣节事件。

english: Thank you! Maybe we still have a chance!
translation: 谢谢！也许我们还有机会！

english: You should talk to Brother Jered at the monastery. He's organising everything from there.
translation: 请去找修道院的杰雷德兄弟，他正在那里统筹一切。

english: His office is on the ground floor, north-west corner.
translation: 他的办公室在一楼，西北角。

english: I'll head over there right away!
translation: 我马上就去那里！

english: I'd like to, but I'm a bit busy right now.
translation: 我想，但我现在有点忙。

english: Oh, okay, well I need to get back to protesting.
translation: 哦，好吧，嗯我需要回去抗议。

english: If you change your mind, we'll be here.
translation: 如果你改变主意，我们会在这里。

english: Hello! How are the protests going?
translation: 你好！抗议进展如何？

english: Slowly, but surely. We're holding on!
translation: 虽进展缓慢，但稳步推进。我们坚持住了！

english: Have you spoken to Brother Jered yet?
translation: 你可与杰雷德兄弟谈过了？

english: Not yet, I'm heading there now.
translation: 还没有，我现在正去那里。

english: Good! His office is on the ground floor of the monastery, north-west corner. Be quick, I don't know how long we have!
translation: 好！他的办公室在修道院一楼，西北角。快点，我不知道我们还有多久！

english: Hi there!
translation: 你好！

english: Hello! I saw your friend heading up towards the monastery. She was carrying some kitchen equipment!
translation: 你好！我看到你的朋友往修道院走去。她拿着一些厨房设备！

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: Hi! Thank you for agreeing to help us, we've been protesting for ages!
translation: 嗨！谢谢你同意帮我们，我们已经抗议很久了！

english: Of course I will help!
translation: 当然我会帮！

english: I'd like to, but I'm a bit busy right now.
translation: 我想，但我现在有点忙。

english: Excuse me... Oh, wait, I thought you were someone else.
translation: 打扰一下……哦，等等，我以为你是别人。

english: No problem. Have a good day!
translation: 没问题。祝你今天愉快！

english: And yourself.
translation: 你也是。

english: You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Devious Minds quest.
translation: 你不满足开始邪恶思维任务的所有要求。

english: I knew you would save us! Bless you, my child!
translation: 我知道你会救我们！祝福你，我的孩子！

english: Thanks! Just stay indoors while those zombies are still prowling around.
translation: 谢谢！那些僵尸还在四处徘徊时待在室内。

english: May Saradomin's light shine upon you!
translation: 愿萨拉多明的光照耀你！

english: Tell him to save it for when I manage to defeat those zombies!
translation: 让他留到我成功击败那些僵尸时再用！

english: Saradomin smile upon you! You've saved us all!
translation: 愿萨拉多明对你微笑！你救了我们所有人！

english: All in a day's work, brother.
translation: 不过是分内之事，兄弟。

english: Your name will forever be listed amongst the virtuous!
translation: 你的名字将永远列在美德者之中！

english: I'll remember that the next time I go drinking...
translation: 我下次喝酒时会记得这话……

english: Why are all of you standing around here?
translation: 你们为什么都站在这里？

english: None of your business. Get lost.

translation: 嘿！谁在讲这个故事？

english: Ahem. At the time it was customary for the Kings' sons to claim a prize from his treasury when they came of age.
translation: 咳咳。当时国王儿子成年时从国库领取奖品是习俗。

english: Each brother rallied support and strode out to confront the other on the field of battle to claim the same prize.
translation: 每个兄弟都集结支持者，走上战场对抗对方以争夺同一个奖品。

english: The brothers met on the field, limbs were bruised, bones were crushed and heads clashed.
translation: 兄弟们在场上相遇，四肢瘀伤，骨头粉碎，头部碰撞。

english: They probably didn't notice the head-clashing bit. Too thick skulled!
translation: 他们可能没注意到头部碰撞的部分。头骨太厚了！

english: Can I finish the story without interruptions?
translation: 我能不打断讲完故事吗？

english: Carry on dear.
translation: 继续吧亲爱的。

english: Anyway, long into the night they fought, until they stood alone, facing each other.
translation: 总之，他们鏖战至深夜，直到只剩两人对峙。

english: On the second day the old king, whose patience was exhausted, strode out onto the field and demanded to know who had claimed his prize.
translation: 第二天，耐心耗尽的老国王走上战场，质问是谁夺走了他的奖品。

english: Jatizso looked at his father and told him yes, it was his, to which the other called out 'No! It's not'.
translation: 贾提兹索看着父亲告诉他是的，是他的，另一个则喊道“不！不是”。

english: And so, the argument continued through to the third day, with the sounds of 'Jah! 'tis so!', 'Ne! It's not!' echoing over the field, becoming more hoarse as the darkness enveloped the brothers.
translation: 于是，争吵持续到第三天，''是！它是！''，''不！它不是！''的声音在场上回荡，随着黑暗笼罩兄弟俩变得更加嘶哑。

english: Bah! What they needed was a good clip round the ear.
translation: 呸！他们需要的是一记耳光。

english: At the end of the third day, when the brothers lay unable to move, let alone stand, the King stood between them in shame.
translation: 第三天结束时，当兄弟俩躺着一动不动，更别提站立，国王羞愧地站在他们中间。

english: As punishment for their squabbling he banished his sons from his realm, ordering that neither should return until they had conquered lands of their own.
translation: 作为对他们争吵的惩罚，他将儿子们逐出王国，命令他们在征服自己的土地前不得返回。

english: Jatizso set sail with a band of loyal followers, sailing into the east, while Neitiznot went west.
translation: 贾提兹索带着一群忠诚追随者启航向东，而奈提兹诺则向西。

english: Jatizso ventured far into uncharted oceans, his crew dwindling as the trials of sailing and sea monsters took them.
translation: 贾提兹索冒险进入未知海洋，随着航海考验和海怪袭击，他的船员逐渐减少。

english: Jatizso's ship limped through the frozen wastes, in need of repairs, fighting off pirates who thought them easy pickings.
translation: 贾提兹索的船艰难航行于冰封海域，船体亟待修理，还要击退那些以为他们好欺负的海盗。

english: At last a promising land was sighted, a land rich in minerals, deep fjords and sweeping mountains.
translation: 终于看到一片有希望的土地，一片矿产丰富、峡湾深邃、山脉绵延的土地。

english: Jatizso claimed the land and named it after himself.
translation: 贾提兹索宣称拥有这片土地，并以自己的名字为之命名。

english: A mighty citadel was constructed to protect his land; then Jatizso set forth to explore his new kingdom.
translation: 一座宏伟的要塞拔地而起，守护他的领土；随后贾提兹索启程探索他的新王国。

english: Crossing a few fjords, Jatizso spied an island which remained green and fertile, even at such latitude.
translation: 穿过几个峡湾，贾提兹索发现了一个岛屿，即使在这样的纬度依然翠绿肥沃。

english: With a mighty cheer Jatizso and his men marched on the island. Upon reaching the island, however, they discovered a wooden stockade.
translation: 伴随着巨大的欢呼，贾提兹索和他的手下向岛屿进军。然而，到达岛屿后，他们发现了一个木栅栏。

english: Determined to be master of all the land, Jatizso stood in front of the gates. He looked up and demanded that those within the stockade surrendered.
translation: 决心成为所有土地的主人，贾提兹索站在大门前。他抬头要求栅栏内的人投降。

english: Jatizso was horrified when his brother appeared on the battlements and cried 'This is my land! Go find yer own'. To which his brother replied 'No it's not!', throwing some rocks for good measure.
translation: 当他的兄弟出现在城墙上喊道“这是我的土地！去找你自己的”时，贾提兹索惊呆了。他的兄弟回答“不，它不是！''，还顺手扔了些石头。

english: And so the blood feud continued.
translation: 于是血仇继续。

english: The fighting between the towns has continued for generations with little sign of improvement.
translation: 城镇间的战斗持续了几代人，几乎没有改善的迹象。

english: Quite recently a massive troll army seized one of the islands to the north, while our townships' militias were busy fighting one another.
translation: 最近，一支庞大的巨魔军队占领了北部的一个岛屿，而我们城镇的民兵正忙于互相战斗。

english: They marched down and razed Neitiznot to the ground while Neitiznot's troops laid siege to Jatizso.
translation: 他们南下将奈提兹诺镇夷为平地，而奈提兹诺镇的部队围攻贾提兹索。

english: The smoke damage was atrocious, I had to replace my entire wardrobe.
translation: 烟雾损害太严重了，我不得不更换整个衣柜。

english: Yes, dear.
translation: 是的，亲爱的。

english: Anyway, a hasty sort of peace has been agreed until the trolls are dealt with.
translation: 总之，双方已仓促达成休战，待巨魔威胁解除后再议。

english: But you can still see the bitter rivalry as guards hurl insults between the towns.
translation: 但你仍能感受到两镇间的宿怨，守卫们隔着城镇互相叫骂。

english: Tell me more about the King of Jatizso.
translation: 多跟我说说贾提兹索的国王。

english: Ha! Our benevolent King Gjuki Sorvott IV.
translation: 哈！我们仁慈的国王格朱基‧索沃特四世。

english: He is short-tempered, arrogant and cares little about anything except outdoing Neitiznot's Burgher.
translation: 他脾气暴躁，傲慢，除了胜过奈提兹诺镇的市长外什么都不关心。

english: He's not at all like Burgher Burowgar.
translation: 他一点也不像布罗瓦加市长。

english: I'm surprised King Sorvott wishes to talk to you. Don't expect much in the way of gratitude.
translation: 我很惊讶索沃特国王想跟你说话。别指望太多感激。

english: Can you ferry me to Jatizso?
translation: 你能渡我去贾提兹索吗？

english: Of course.
translation: 当然。

english: Leaving Rellekka for Jatizso.
translation: 离开雷勒卡城前往贾提兹索。

english: I'm too busy to help your King.
translation: 我太忙了没法帮你的国王。

english: I guess I won't be getting paid for finding you, then.
translation: 我想那我就找不到你，也拿不到报酬了。

english: I may be back later.
translation: 我可能稍后回来。

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！

english: Hi, [Fremennik name], you should speak with King Sorvott in the main chambers.
translation: 嗨，[Fremennik name]，你应该去主厅跟索沃特国王谈谈。

english: The chambers have the town's banner erected outside.
translation: 大厅外竖立着城镇的旗帜。

english: Thank you for bringing me here Mord.
translation: 谢谢你带我来这里，莫尔德。

english: Is there anything I can do for you?
translation: 有什么我能为你做的吗？

english: Jatizso is a small Fremennik town, which is far less closed to the world than other Fremennik tribes.
translation: 贾提兹索是个小费明尼克城镇，比其他费明尼克部落更开放。

english: We maintain trade links with many powers in the world and have moved beyond some traditions to take advantage of modern advances.
translation: 我们与世界许多强国保持贸易联系，并超越了一些传统以利用现代进步。

english: We do, however, continue to 'enlighten' our neighbours in Neitiznot. Unfortunately, some of the Islands are infested with trolls.
translation: 不过，我们继续“启发”我们在奈提兹诺镇的邻居。不幸的是，一些岛屿被巨魔侵扰。

english: We should really be trying to deal with the trolls, but the King tends to get a bit preoccupied with his cousin, the Burgher of Neitiznot.
translation: 我们本应努力对付巨魔，但国王倾向于有点专注于他的表亲，奈提兹诺镇的市长。

english: Ha! Our benevolent King Gjuki Sorvott IV. He doesn't have much of an opinion about anyone, apart from his cousin Mawnis who rules the other Island. He hates him with a passion that can occasionally be quite scary.
translation: 哈！我们仁慈的国王格朱基‧索沃特四世。他对任何人没什么意见，除了统治另一个岛屿的表亲莫尼斯。他恨他，那种激情有时相当可怕。

english: You might be able to talk to him if you help out around Jatizso. Don't expect much in the way of gratitude though.
translation: 如果你在贾提兹索周围帮忙，也许能跟他说话。不过别指望太多感激。

english: Can you ferry me to Rellekka?
translation: 你能渡我去雷勒卡城吗？

english: Sure.
translation: 当然。

english: Leaving Jatizso for Rellekka.
translation: 离开贾提兹索前往雷勒卡城。

english: No, I'm fine right now.
translation: 不，我现在没事。

english: Tell me more about Jatizso's history.
translation: 多跟我说说贾提兹索的历史。

english: Tell me more about the King of Jatizso.
translation: 多跟我说说贾提兹索的国王。

english: Can you ferry me to Jatizso?
translation: 你能渡我去贾提兹索吗？

english: I'm too busy to help your King.
translation: 我太忙了没法帮你的国王。

english: Tell me more about Jatizso.
translation: 多跟我说说贾提兹索。

english: Can you ferry me to Rellekka?
translation: 你能渡我去雷勒卡城吗？

english: No, I'm fine right now.
translation: 不，我现在没事。

english: Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: 人类！在我叫守卫之前滚回奴隶栏去！

english: What are you doing?
translation: 你在做什么？

english: Minding my own business. You should do the same.
translation: 管我自己的事。你也该这样。

english: Yes?
translation: 是的？

english: Did you want something?
translation: 你想要什么吗？

english: Nope.
translation: 没有。

english: Then why don't you get lost?
translation: 那你为什么不滚开？

english: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？

english: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: Go away then.
translation: 那走开。

english: Hey there.
translation: 嘿。

english: I'm not interested in making small talk.
translation: 我没兴趣闲聊。

english: Suit yourself.
translation: 随你便。

english: Please please help us, bold adventurer!
translation: 求求你帮帮我们，勇敢的冒险者！

english: What's the problem?
translation: 有什么问题？

english: Our little village has been dreadfully ravaged by an evil vampyre! He lives in the basement of the manor to the north, we need someone to get rid of him once and for all!
translation: 我们的小村庄被一个邪恶的吸血鬼严重摧残！他住在北边庄园的地下室，我们需要有人一劳永逸地除掉他！

english: Okay, I'm up for an adventure.
translation: 好的，我准备冒险。

english: I think first you should seek help. I have a friend who is a retired vampyre hunter, his name is Dr. Harlow. He may be able to give you some tips. He can normally be found in the Blue Moon Inn in Varrock, he's a bit
translation: 我想首先你应该寻求帮助。我有个朋友是退休的吸血鬼猎人，名叫哈洛博士。他也许能给你一些建议。他通常在维洛克的蓝月旅馆，

english: of an old soak these days. Mention his old friend Morgan, I'm sure he wouldn't want me killed by a vampyre.
translation: 他最近有点老酒鬼。提到他的老朋友摩根，我相信他不想我被吸血鬼杀死。

english: I'll look him up then.
translation: 那我去找他。

english: No, vampyres are scary!
translation: 不，吸血鬼很可怕！

english: I don't blame you.
translation: 我不怪你。

english: I have slain the foul creature!
translation: 我已经杀死了那个邪恶的生物！

english: Thank you, thank you! You will always be a hero in our village!
translation: 谢谢，谢谢！你永远是我们村的英雄！

english: Very well done, take this.
translation: 做得很好，拿着这个。

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: Afternoon. I'm Morgiana, and by all means, let yourself in...
translation: 下午好。我是莫吉安，请进……

english: Oh, hey! The door was open...
translation: 哦，嘿！门开着……

english: ... Yes?
translation: ……是的？

english: That armour looks mighty fancy!
translation: 那盔甲看起来真华丽！

english: Indeed! A family heirloom of mine, passed down from my father.
translation: 确实！我的家族传家宝，从我父亲传下来的。

english: Oh? Are you from a family of famous knights?
translation: 哦？你来自著名骑士家族吗？

english: You could say that...
translation: 你可以这么说……

english: What's wrong?
translation: 怎么了？

english: Oh, nothing... it's just... old memories. I'm getting old, as you can probably see. My family have all died to war. This is meant to be my retirement.
translation: 哦，没什么……只是……旧回忆。我老了，如你所见。我的家人都死于战争。这本应是我的退休生活。

english: Retirement? Then why still wear the armour? Especially with how hot it is here.
translation: 退休？那为什么还穿盔甲？尤其是这里这么热。

english: I find it's best to be prepared in this region. Bandits regularly visit this fine oasis, and they ask fewer questions when they see me in armour.
translation: 我发现在这个地区最好做好准备。强盗经常光顾这个美丽的绿洲，当他们看到我穿盔甲时问的问题就少了。

english: I see.
translation: 我明白了。

english: How's the tea here?
translation: 这里的茶怎么样？

english: Hmm...
Umm...
Well... I think it's quite nice! I prefer a warm cup of Saradomin's Wisdom, a special recipe of mine.
translation: 嗯……我觉得很不错！我更喜欢一杯温暖的萨拉多明之智，这是我的特殊配方。

english: Oh? How's it made?
translation: 哦？怎么做的？

english: Bit of a family secret. A fine blend of herbs that are quite magical.
translation: 有点家族秘密。一种相当神奇的草药混合。

english: Alright then. Keep your secrets.
translation: 好吧。保守你的秘密。

english: I'd best be off.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: Quite. Perhaps I'll see you around...
translation: 确实。也许我会再见到你……

english: Ah, hello again.
translation: 啊，又见面了。

english: That armour looks mighty fancy!
translation: 那盔甲看起来真华丽！

english: How's the tea here?
translation: 这里的茶怎么样？

english: I'd best be off.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: Hello Mori.
translation: 你好莫里。

english: Hello there. Thank you for helping us, you are a good friend to the people of Arceuus.
translation: 你好。谢谢你帮助我们，你是阿西乌斯人的好朋友。

english: It's not a problem. What brings you here?
translation: 没问题。什么风把你吹来这里？

english: I come here quite often now. This is a nice quiet place for me to think and reflect. It's my way of remembering Thana.
translation: 我现在经常来这里。这是个安静的好地方让我思考和反思。这是我纪念塔娜的方式。

english: I'll leave you in peace then.
translation: 那我不打扰你了。

english: Thank you friend.
translation: 谢谢你朋友。

english: Hello there. Did you manage to get that device hidden?
translation: 你好。你成功把那个装置藏起来了吗？

english: Oh yes. Got it all done with no problems at all.
translation: 哦是的。都完成了，没问题。

english: Good. Hopefully Kourend will have no more issues with the Disciples of Yama.
translation: 好。希望库兰德王国不会再有阎魔信徒的问题。

english: What are you sitting around here for?
translation: 你坐在这里做什么？

english: I'm making sure only those with a competition pass enter the fishing contest.
translation: 我在确保只有持有比赛通行证的人进入钓鱼比赛。

english: Competition pass please.
translation: 请出示比赛通行证。

english: I don't have one of them.
translation: 我没有。

english: Oh well. I can't let you past then.
translation: 哦好吧。那我不能让你过去。

english: What do I need that for?
translation: 我需要那个做什么？

english: This is the entrance to the Hemenster fishing competition. It's a high class competition. Invitation only.
translation: 这是赫门斯特钓鱼比赛的入口。这是个高级比赛。仅限邀请。

english: I need to catch a Hemenster Whitefish.
translation: 我需要抓一条赫门斯特白鱼。

english: Whitefish, eh? Okay, since you've won the competition before, I'll let you in.
translation: 白鱼，呃？好吧，既然你以前赢过比赛，我让你进去。

english: I don't have one of them.
translation: 我没有。

english: What do I need that for?
translation: 我需要那个做什么？

english: I need to catch a Hemenster Whitefish.
translation: 我需要抓一条赫门斯特白鱼。

english: Oh I feel much better for that super serum,  I really hate it when I'm afflicted!
translation: 哦用了那个超级药剂我感觉好多了，当我被折磨时我真讨厌！

english: The afflicted turns into a Mort'ton local
translation: 被折磨者变成莫顿镇当地人

english: Oh... thank you, you used the serum on me. Here have something for your trouble.
translation: 哦……谢谢你，你对我用了药剂。这点东西聊表谢意。

english: The local gives you [reward].
translation: 当地人给你 [reward]。

english: Oh... thank you, you used the permanent serum on me. Here have something for your trouble.
translation: 哦……谢谢你，你对我用了永久药剂。这点东西聊表谢意。

english: Good day to you.
translation: 你好。

english: Hello. What are you up to?
translation: 你好。你在忙什么？

english: Ah, today is a surströmming day! The herring I buried six months ago is ready to be dug up.
translation: 啊，今天是瑞典鲱鱼罐头日！我六个月前埋的鲱鱼准备好挖出来了。

english: Eughr! What are you going to do with it?
translation: 噫！你打算用它做什么？

english: Eat it, of course! It will be fermented just-right by now.
translation: 吃它，当然！现在应该发酵得刚刚好。

english: Fermented? You eat rotten fish?
translation: 发酵？你吃烂鱼？

english: Hmmm, tasty. I'm guessing you don't want to come round and try it?
translation: 嗯，美味。我猜你不想过来尝尝？

english: You guess correctly.
translation: 你猜对了。

english: Well look who it is! The hero of Prifddinas!
translation: 哇看看是谁！普里夫迪纳斯城的英雄！

english: Why do I feel like you're being sarcastic?
translation: 为什么我觉得你在讽刺？

english: That's likely due to the fact that I am being sarcastic.
translation: 那可能是因为我就是在讽刺。

english: Well you're no hero either. You blindly served Lord Iorwerth right to the very end. You're lucky the other elves pardoned you.
translation: 嗯你也不是英雄。你盲目地效忠伊尔沃斯领主直到最后。你很幸运其他精灵赦免了你。

english: You seem upset by that. I served Lord Iorwerth because I didn't have a choice. The other elves realised that, hence the pardon.
translation: 你似乎对此感到不安。我效忠伊尔沃斯领主是因为我没得选。其他精灵意识到了这一点，所以赦免了。

english: We always have a choice.
translation: 我们总有选择。

english: Do we?
translation: 我们有吗？

english: I did.
translation: 我有。

english: Yes, but you're a mercenary. You're lucky enough to be able to side with the highest bidder. Not all of us are so privileged.
translation: 是的，但你是个雇佣兵。你足够幸运能站在出价最高者那边。不是我们所有人都享有这种特权。

english: I was born into the Iorwerth clan, Lord Iorwerth was my uncle. Do you think I had a say in what my life would be? Do you think any of us did?
translation: 我出生在伊尔沃斯家族，伊尔沃斯领主是我叔叔。你认为我对我的生活有发言权吗？你认为我们任何人有吗？

english: We served Lord Iorwerth because he was our leader. We may not have agreed with all that he did, but that didn't matter. He was in charge and we were not.
translation: 我们效忠伊尔沃斯领主因为他是我们的领袖。我们可能不同意他做的所有事，但那不重要。他负责而我们不是。

english: Had I been born into the Cadarn clan, I'd be considered a hero right now. But I wasn't, so instead I am the villain.
translation: 如果我出生在卡达恩家族，我现在会被视为英雄。但我没有，所以我是反派。

english: You can make excuses, but Iestin served Lord Iorwerth and he switched sides.
translation: 你可以找借口，但伊斯廷效忠伊尔沃斯领主且他换了边。

english: He did. Iestin was brave, I respect that. His bravery has rewarded him with leadership over our clan. But bravery comes easy when you have nothing left to lose.
translation: 他确实。伊斯廷很勇敢，我尊重这一点。他的勇敢为他赢得了领导我们家族的地位。但当你没什么可失去时，勇敢很容易。

english: But I can see I will not change your mind. That's fine, I don't need to.
translation: 但我看得出我不会改变你的想法。那没关系，我不需要。

english: That said, you'd do well to remember that the actions of Lord Iorwerth should not be used to judge our entire clan.
translation: 话虽如此，你最好记住伊尔沃斯领主的行为不应被用来评判我们整个家族。

english: Hmm.
translation: 嗯。

english: Sorry Bwana, I cannot help you at this time. Go and talk to Trufitus at Tai Bwo Wannai, I believe he needs some help.
translation: 抱歉老爷，我现在帮不了你。去泰博瓦纳村找特鲁菲图斯，我相信他需要帮助。

english: Greetings!
translation: 你好！

english: Greetings Bwana! We've removed the threat of Rashiliyia and though there are still some random outbreaks of undead activity we are more than able to deal with it.
translation: 问候老爷！我们消除了拉希利娅的威胁，虽然仍有一些不死活动的随机爆发，但我们完全能处理。

english: You're welcome to enter the village now Bwana, shall I show you the way?
translation: 老爷，你现在可以进入村庄了，要我带路吗？

english: Mosol leads you into the village.
translation: 莫索尔带你进入村庄。

english: Mosol leaves you by the gate and walks back out into the jungle.
translation: 莫索尔把你留在门口然后走回丛林。

english: You decide not to visit the village.
translation: 你决定不访问村庄。

english: Yes, Ok, I'll go into the village!
translation: 是的，好的，我要进村庄！

english: I think I'll see it some other time.
translation: 我想我改天再看。

english: Hello. What you are doing here?
translation: 你好。你在这里做什么？

english: Hello, I am a mountain guide for this historical expedition. I led the team to this summit.
translation: 你好，我是这次历史探险的登山向导。我带领团队到了这个顶峰。

english: Would you be able to guide me up and down the mountain?
translation: 你能指导我上下山吗？

english: I don't see why not. I've not much to do while the historians are exploring.
translation: 我看不出为什么不。当历史学家探索时我没什么事做。

english: I make many trips each day so whenever you'd like to travel, just speak to me here, at the Shayzien outpost, or south of the mountain.
translation: 我每天多次往返，所以无论你想何时旅行，只需在这里、谢兹恩前哨站或山南边跟我说话。

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！

english: Can you take me somewhere?
translation: 你能带我去某处吗？

english: Of course. Where would you like to go?
translation: 当然。你想去哪？

english: The Shayzien Outpost.
translation: 谢兹恩前哨站。

english: Mount Quidamortem.
translation: 奎达莫特山。

english: South of Quidamortem.
translation: 奎达莫特南边。

english: Nowhere.
translation: 无处。

english: Okay. Come back if you change your mind.
translation: 好的。如果你改变主意再来。

english: The Shayzien Outpost.
translation: 谢兹恩前哨站。

english: Mount Quidamortem.
translation: 奎达莫特山。

english: South of Quidamortem.
translation: 奎达莫特南边。

english: Nowhere.
translation: 无处。

english: Looking to get across to the Auburn Valley?
translation: 想过到奥本谷吗？

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Alright then, let's get going...
translation: 好吧，那我们走……

english: You carefully follow the mountain guide to Nemus Retreat in the Auburn Valley.
translation: 你小心跟随登山向导到奥本谷的尼穆斯休养所。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: As you wish.
translation: 如你所愿。

english: Need a guide to get you to Quetzacalli?
translation: 需要向导带你去奎察卡利吗？

english: You carefully follow the mountain guide to Quetzacalli Gorge.
translation: 你小心跟随登山向导到奎察卡利峡谷。

english: Over the mountains?
translation: 过山吗？

english: Indeed. The journey isn't too long, but I can help you avoid the dangerous stretches, letting you focus on enjoying the fresh mountain air.
translation: 确实。旅程不太长，但我可以帮你避开危险路段，让你专注于享受清新的山间空气。

english: Do you charge anything for the journey?
translation: 旅程收费吗？

english: Nothing at all! So, shall we?
translation: 完全不！那么，我们走吗？

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: : Hello, I'm  a happy smiling food delivery gnome. If you are interested in delivering food, and earning a free delivery yourself then go and talk to Aluft Gianne jnr. in the Tree Gnome Stronghold.
translation: ：你好，我是个快乐微笑的食物配送地精。如果你有兴趣配送食物，并为自己赚取一次免费配送，那么去地精要塞跟小阿卢夫‧吉安尼谈谈。

english: : Have a nice day.
translation: ：祝你今天愉快。

english: Stand back citizen, do not approach me.
translation: 退后，市民，别靠近我。

english: Back away citizen. Only mourners are allowed inside the headquarters.
translation: 退后，市民。只有哀悼者允许进入总部。

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Do you have a problem traveller?
translation: 你有问题吗，旅行者？

english: No, I just wondered why you're wearing that outfit... Is it fancy dress?
translation: 不，我只是好奇你为什么穿那套衣服……是化装舞会吗？

english: No! It's for protection.
translation: 不！那是为了防护。

english: Protection from what?
translation: 防护什么？

english: The plague of course…
translation: 当然是瘟疫……

english: Can I help you?
translation: 我能帮你吗？

english: What are you doing?
translation: 你在做什么？

english: I'm guarding the border to West Ardougne. No one except we mourners can pass through.
translation: 我在守卫通往西阿多尼城的边界。除了我们哀悼者没人能通过。

english: Why?
translation: 为什么？

english: The plague of course. We can't risk cross contamination.
translation: 当然是瘟疫。我们不能冒险交叉感染。

english: What brought the plague to Ardougne?
translation: 什么把瘟疫带到阿多尼城？

english: It's all down to King Tyras of West Ardougne. It started came back from one of his visits to the lands west of here.
translation: 都怪西阿多尼城的泰拉斯国王。它是从他一次访问这里西边的土地后带回来的。

english: Some of his men must have unknowingly caught it out there and brought it back with them
translation: 他的一些人一定是在那里不知不觉染上并带回来了

english: Does he know how bad the situation is now?
translation: 他知道现在情况有多糟吗？

english: If he did he wouldn't care. I believe he wants his people to suffer, he's an evil man.
translation: 如果他知道他也不会关心。我相信他希望他的人民受苦，他是个邪恶的人。

english: Isn't that treason?
translation: 那不是叛国吗？

english: He's not my king.
translation: 他不是我的国王。

english: What are the symptoms of the plague?
translation: 瘟疫的症状是什么？

english: The first signs are typical flu symptoms. These tend to be followed by severe nightmares, horrifying hallucinations which drive many to madness.
translation: 最初迹象是典型流感症状。随后往往是严重噩梦，可怕幻觉使许多人发疯。

english: Sounds nasty.
translation: 听起来很恶心。

english: It gets worse. Next the victim's blood changes into a thick black tar-like liquid, at this point they're past help.
translation: 更糟的是。接下来受害者的血变成浓稠黑色焦油状液体，此时他们已无法挽救。

english: Their skin is cold to the touch, the victim is now brain dead. Their body however lives on driven by the virus, roaming like a zombie, spreading itself further wherever possible.
translation: 他们的皮肤摸起来冰冷，受害者现在脑死亡。但他们的身体在病毒驱动下继续活着，像僵尸一样游荡，尽可能传播。

english: I think I've heard enough.
translation: 我想我听得够多了。

english: Okay then, see you around.
translation: 好吧，回头见。

english: Maybe...
translation: 也许……

english: Hi.
translation: 嗨。

english: What are you up to?
translation: 你在忙什么？

english: Just sight-seeing.
translation: 只是观光。

english: This is no place for sight-seeing. Don't you know there's been a plague outbreak?
translation: 这不是观光的地方。你不知道爆发了瘟疫吗？

english: Yes, I had heard.
translation: 是的，我听说过。

english: Then I suggest you leave as soon as you can.
translation: 那我建议你尽快离开。

english: Thanks for the advice.
translation: 谢谢建议。

english: Hmmm, how did you get over here? You're not one of this rabble. Ah well, you'll have to stay. Can't risk you going back now.
translation: 嗯，你怎么过来的？你不是这群乌合之众的一员。啊好吧，你得留下。现在不能冒险让你回去。

english: So what's a mourner?
translation: 那么什么是哀悼者？

english: We're working for King Lathas of East Ardougne. He has tasked us with containing the accursed plague sweeping West Ardougne.
translation: 我们为东阿多尼城的拉萨斯国王工作。他指派我们控制席卷西阿多尼城的该死瘟疫。

english: We also do our best to ease these people's suffering. We're nicknamed mourners because we spend a lot of time at plague victim funerals, no one else is allowed to risk attending.
translation: 我们也尽力减轻这些人的痛苦。我们被昵称为哀悼者因为我们花很多时间在瘟疫受害者葬礼上，其他人不允许冒险参加。

english: It's a demanding job, and we get little thanks from the people here.
translation: 这是个要求高的工作，我们从这里的人那里得到很少感谢。

english: I haven't got the plague though...
translation: 但我没得瘟疫……

english: Can't risk you being a carrier. That protective clothing you have isn't regulation issue. It won't meet safety standards.
translation: 不能冒险让你成为携带者。你有的防护服不是规定发放的。它不符合安全标准。

english: I'm looking for a woman named Elena.
translation: 我在找一个叫埃琳娜的女人。

english: Ah yes, I've heard of her. A healer I believe. She must be mad coming over here voluntarily.
translation: 啊是的，我听说过她。是个治疗者我相信。她自愿来这里一定疯了。

english: I hear rumours she has probably caught the plague now. Very tragic, a stupid waste of life.
translation: 我听说传闻她可能现在染上了瘟疫。非常悲剧，愚蠢的生命浪费。

english: What brought the plague to Ardougne?
translation: 什么把瘟疫带到阿多尼城？

english: What are the symptoms of the plague?
translation: 瘟疫的症状是什么？

english: Okay then, see you around.
translation: 好吧，回头见。

english: Thanks for the advice.
translation: 谢谢建议。

english: So what's a mourner?
translation: 那么什么是哀悼者？

english: I haven't got the plague though...
translation: 但我没得瘟疫……

english: I'm looking for a woman named Elena.
translation: 我在找一个叫埃琳娜的女人。

english: What's the device saying now?
translation: 装置现在说什么？

english: I don't know. It's giving strange readings...
translation: 我不知道。它给出奇怪读数……

english: I'm not even sure it's working any more.
translation: 我甚至不确定它还在工作。

english: This is a wild goose chase! We trek halfway across the world and there's nothing down here but this bunch of useless goblins!
translation: 这是徒劳的追逐！我们跋涉半个世界，这里除了这群无用的哥布林什么都没有！

english: I am sure my triangulation calculations indicated that the source of power was in this rough area...
translation: 我确定我的三角测量计算表明力量源在这个大致区域……

english: I find it encouraging that it's pointed to somewhere where there actually are caves.
translation: 我觉得它指向实际有洞穴的地方令人鼓舞。

english: This part of the world is riddled with caves! It's hard not to hit a cave around here! Are you sure you're not just picking up these goblin lanterns or something stupid?
translation: 世界这部分遍布洞穴！在这里很难不碰到洞穴！你确定你不是只捡到这些哥布林灯笼或什么愚蠢的东西？

english: You should have more faith in my skills as a mage! I've been working on this for years-
translation: 你应该对我作为法师的技能更有信心！我在这方面工作多年——

english: Gah! We have an eavesdropper! Buzz off, adventurer - go talk to the goblins or something.
translation: 啊！我们有窃听者！走开，冒险者——去跟哥布林说话或什么。

english: Okay, I won't bother you.
translation: 好的，我不打扰你。

english: That's what I like to see: a polite adventurer! Now, where was I...
translation: 这就是我喜欢看到的：礼貌的冒险者！我刚说到哪了……

english: What are you looking for?
translation: 你在找什么？

english: None of your business!
translation: 不关你的事！

english: Hey, I'm one of you guys! See this pendant?
translation: 嘿，我是你们一伙的！看到这个吊坠了吗？

english: Where did you come from? Who sent you? I'll have you know I'm the mage's bodyguard for this job. We don't need anyone else!
translation: 你从哪来？谁派你来的？我要让你知道我是这个任务的法师保镖。我们不需要其他人！

english: No one sent me, I'm just nosy.
translation: 没人派我来，我只是好奇。

english: Well stick your nose somewhere else!
translation: 那把你的鼻子伸到别处！

english: I'm sorry, but pendant or no pendant, this is a secret. I'm sure you understand.
translation: 抱歉，但不管有没有吊坠，这是个秘密。我相信你理解。

english: Lucien sent me.
translation: 卢西安派我来的。

english: He did not! If he had, I would be aware of it!
translation: 他没有！如果他派了，我会知道！

english: Don't try to lie to us! Now go away!
translation: 别想对我们撒谎！现在走开！

english: I'm sure you're a much better bodyguard than me, but perhaps I can help in some non-bodyguarding way?
translation: 我相信你比我是个更好的保镖，但也许我能以非保镖的方式帮忙？

english: Well, we don't know how big this thing is. If we find it, I suppose we might need someone else to help us carry it.
translation: 嗯，我们不知道这东西多大。如果我们找到它，我想我们可能需要别人帮我们搬。

english: So, what are we looking for?
translation: 那么，我们在找什么？

english: You're not very well briefed, are you?
translation: 你简报得不太好，对吧？

english: To be honest I'm still a bit hazy on that point too.
translation: 老实说我对那点也有点模糊。

english: *sigh*
translation: 叹气

english: Lucien has asked us to search for artefacts that give off a very specific type of energy. After many years of research, I think I'm finally drawing near.
translation: 卢西安让我们寻找散发出特定能量波动的神器。经过多年的研究，我想我终于快找到了。

english: You don't sound very sure.
translation: 你听起来不太确定。

english: Bah! My detection device is totally shot. I don't understand it.
translation: 呸！我的探测装置彻底坏了。我弄不明白。

english: I wouldn't hang around for now, adventurer. It could be a long while before I can get a clear reading.
translation: 冒险者，你现在最好别在这逗留。我要想得到清晰的读数可能还得等上好一阵子。

english: Okay, I'll be on my way.
translation: 好的，那我走了。

english: Okay, I won't bother you.
translation: 好的，我不打扰你了。

english: What are you looking for?
translation: 你在找什么？

english: Hey, I'm one of you guys! See this pendant?
translation: 嘿，我是你们一伙的！看到这个吊坠了吗？

english: No one sent me, I'm just nosy.
translation: 没人派我来，我只是好奇。

english: Lucien sent me.
translation: 卢西安派我来的。

english: (Charm) I'm sure you're a much better bodyguard than me...
translation: (魅力)我相信你当保镖比我强多了……

english: Euat ami! Euat chua tepat!
translation: Euat ami! Euat chua tepat!

english: Uh huh...
translation: 嗯哼……

english: Zema ami iknil! Zema lini euat tal miki!
translation: Zema ami 伊克尼尔！Zema lini euat tal miki!

english: If you say so...
translation: 既然你这么说……

english: Zema ikam!
translation: Zema ikam!

english: Zema ates! Euat achi!
translation: Zema ates! Euat achi!

english: I'm listening, honest.
translation: 我在听，真的。

english: Euat tepat antil! Euat tepat kuhu! Euat rani!
translation: Euat tepat antil! Euat tepat kuhu! Euat rani!

english: That's very interesting...
translation: 那真有趣……

english: Tepat!
translation: Tepat!

english: Euat!
translation: Euat!

english: Ami!
translation: Ami!

english: Ah, it's you [player name]. You've been slacking in your studies, so it's time for an exam.
translation: 啊，是你 [player name]。你学习一直偷懒，所以是时候考试了。

english: There are two types of question. One type requires you to find the next object in a pattern.
translation: 有两种题型。一种需要你找出图案中的下一个物体。

english: In the second type I will present you with fifteen cards and a hint. Discover three cards related to the hint, select them and confirm.
translation: 第二种我会给你十五张卡片和一个提示。找出三张与提示相关的卡片，选中它们并确认。

english: Let's continue your exam. There are two types of question: In one question you must discover the logical object to come next in a pattern.
translation: 继续你的考试。有两种题型：一种你必须找出图案中符合逻辑的下一个物体。

english: Pick the object that should come next in the pattern.
translation: 选出图案中应该出现的下一个物体。

english: No. No, that's not right at all. Okay, next question.
translation: 不。不，那完全不对。好的，下一题。

english: Remember, the goal here is to find the pattern. Look for objects that would have a connection to each other.
translation: 记住，这里的目的是找出规律。寻找彼此之间有联系的物体。

english: That's WRONG. Take your time and think about the next question.
translation: 错了。慢慢来，想想下一题。

english: No, no, no... That's WRONG! Okay, next question.
translation: 不，不，不……错了！好的，下一题。

english: How unfortunate, you FAILED. You'd better hit the books and study up for next time.
translation: 真不幸，你不及格。你最好回去好好读书，为下次做准备。

english: To exit, use any of the doors in this room.
translation: 要离开，使用这个房间里的任何一扇门。

english: Wonderful! Keep up the good work. Next question.
translation: 太好了！继续保持。下一题。

english: Finally, a pupil using [his/her/their] brains rather than trying to eat them. Next question.
translation: 终于有个学生用 [his/her/their] 脑子而不是想着吃掉它们了。下一题。

english: That's correct! Next question.
translation: 正确！下一题。

english: WELL DONE! You've proven your aptitude for pattern recognition. You'll receive a book once you leave the classroom. It is a Book of Knowledge to further your education.
translation: 做得好！你证明了你在图案识别方面的天赋。离开教室后你会收到一本书。那是一本知识之书，可助你进一步深造。

english: WELL DONE! You've proven your aptitude for pattern recognition.
translation: 做得好！你证明了你在图案识别方面的天赋。

english: Hmm, you already appear to have a Book of Knowledge. You should read that! Still, I will reward you for your work once you leave the room.
translation: 嗯，你看起来已经有一本知识之书了。你应该读读那本！不过，等你离开房间后我还是会奖励你的努力。

english: Examine the hint on the right and find three objects that are related to it.
translation: 检查右边的提示，找出三个与之相关的物体。

english: Welcome to the Emir's Arena! What can I do for you?
translation: 欢迎来到埃米尔竞技场！我能为你做什么？

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: This is the Emir's Arena, recently renovated with his coin. Here, you can fight for glory and prestige in individual duels and tournaments.
translation: 这是埃米尔竞技场，最近用他的金币翻新过。在这里，你可以在个人决斗和锦标赛中为荣耀和声望而战。

english: Where did this Arena come from?
translation: 这个竞技场是哪来的？

english: The original building was excavated by the Varrock Museum a while ago. It dated back to the Second Age!
translation: 原来的建筑是维洛克博物馆不久前挖掘出来的。它可以追溯到第二纪元！

english: When the archaeologists moved out, a group of warriors, headed by myself, bought the land and converted it to a set of arenas for duels. The best fighters from around the world would come here to fight!
translation: 考古学家搬走后，一群战士，由我带头，买下了这块地并将其改造成了一套用于决斗的竞技场。来自世界各地的最佳战士都会来这里战斗！

english: More recently, the Emir of Al Kharid acquired the Arena and had it renovated to the state it's in now. He's kept me on to handle day-to-day running, though.
translation: 最近，阿尔卡里德城的首长收购了竞技场并将其翻新到现在这个样子。不过他还是留我来处理日常运营。

english: What would the Emir want to do with a bunch of fight pits?
translation: 埃米尔想用一堆斗兽坑做什么？

english: Something about a rowdy group of match-fixers, so I heard. I think the guards would know more about it than I would.
translation: 听说跟一群吵闹的操纵比赛者有关。我想守卫比我更清楚。

english: How do I get a fight?
translation: 我怎么参加战斗？

english: You can participate in Duels and Tournaments. These may be ranked, if you want rewards and prestige, or unranked if you're just fighting your friends for fun.
translation: 你可以参加决斗和锦标赛。如果你想要奖励和声望，可以是排名的；如果你只是跟朋友打着玩，可以是非排名的。

english: Ranked Duels and Tournaments take place on designated worlds, with stats and items provided to you on those worlds.
translation: 排名决斗和锦标赛在指定世界进行，在这些世界上会为你提供属性和物品。

english: Win or lose, you'll earn Reward Points for taking part in ranked Duels and Tournaments. You can trade your points here for supplies that might help in the Wilderness, or such places.
translation: 无论输赢，参加排名决斗和锦标赛你都会获得奖励点数。你可以在这里用点数兑换可能在荒野或其他地方有用的补给。

english: Now, if you want to choose your opponents, you can have an unranked Duel or Tournament instead, just for the fun of beating them.
translation: 现在，如果你想选择对手，你可以进行非排名决斗或锦标赛，只是为了享受击败他们的乐趣。

english: Use the recruitment boards outside the hospital to set up your own unranked tournament, or to apply to an existing one.
translation: 使用医院外的招募板来建立你自己的非排名锦标赛，或申请现有的锦标赛。

english: For an unranked Duel, look around the Arena for someone you wish to fight, and challenge them...
translation: 要进行非排名决斗，在竞技场周围寻找你想战斗的人，然后挑战他们……

english: You'll see a 'Challenge' option when you right-click other people around the Arena. Use that to set up an unranked Duel.
translation: 当你右键点击竞技场周围的其他人时，你会看到一个“挑战”选项。用那个来建立非排名决斗。

english: On PvP Arena worlds the Arena will supply stats and items for your fight. You'll get to choose your load-out from a menu.
translation: 在 PvP 竞技场世界上，竞技场将为你的战斗提供属性和物品。你可以从菜单中选择你的装备配置。

english: On other worlds, like this one, you must bring your own items, and fight with your own stats.
translation: 在其他世界上，像这个一样，你必须自带物品，并使用自己的属性战斗。

english: I challenge you!
translation: 我挑战你！

english: Ho! Ho! Ho!
translation: 嚯！嚯！嚯！

english: What kind of fights are happening today?
translation: 今天有什么样的战斗？

english: Every week, we'll rotate the active build, meaning you'll have access to a different set of stats and items. This week, the active build is [Zerker/1 Def Pure/Max/Med].
translation: 每周我们都会轮换活跃构建，意味着你可以使用一组不同的属性和物品。本周的活跃构建是 [Zerker/1Def Pure/Max/Med]。

english: Can I see your shop?
translation: 我能看看你的商店吗？

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我走了。

english: See you in the Arena!
translation: 竞技场见！

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: Where did this Arena come from?
translation: 这个竞技场是哪来的？

english: How do I get a fight?
translation: 我怎么参加战斗？

english: What kind of fights are happening today?
translation: 今天有什么样的战斗？

english: Can I see your shop?
translation: 我能看看你的商店吗？

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我走了。

english: I challenge you!
translation: 我挑战你！

english: Can I help you, human?
translation: 我能帮你吗，人类？

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Why, it's my little shop. I supply all kinds of items that the Lovakengj workers need. Though if you need pickaxes, you should visit Toothy in the sulphur mine.
translation: 哦，这是我的小店。我供应洛瓦肯吉工人需要的所有物品。不过如果你需要镐，你应该去硫磺矿找图西。

english: Now, can I help you today?
translation: 那么，今天我能帮你吗？

english: Let's trade.
translation: 我们交易吧。

english: No, I'm fine.
translation: 不，我没事。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Let's trade.
translation: 我们交易吧。

english: No, I'm fine.
translation: 不，我没事。

english: Who's the cutest little nightmare-spawn in all of Gielinor?
translation: 谁是整个基利诺尔最可爱的小噩梦之子？

english: Is it you?!
translation: 是你吗？！

english: Yes, it's you my little Muphin!
translation: 是的，是你，我的小穆芬！

english: Stop this at once.
translation: 立刻停止。

english: Can you teach me how to do that thing where you teleport around really quickly?
translation: 你能教我怎么做到那种快速传送的事情吗？

english: That requires moving between realms... Your simple form would not withstand it.
translation: 那需要在领域之间移动……你简单的形体无法承受。

english: You'd be surprised.
translation: 你会惊讶的。

english: You know... if you were bite-sized, I reckon you'd be quite nutritious.
translation: 你知道……如果你是一口大小，我想你会很有营养。

english: Do NOT eat me, human.
translation: 别吃我，人类。

english: Bleugh!
translation: 呕！

english: Hisssss!
translation: 嘶嘶嘶！

english: Sssssssss!
translation: 嘶嘶嘶嘶嘶！

english: Hello there...thanks for helping out Trufitus commune with the gods Bwana. We've been able to return to the village thanks to your help.
translation: 你好……谢谢你帮助特鲁菲图斯与神灵沟通，老爷。多亏你的帮助，我们才能返回村庄。

english: I see that you've been hacking away at the jungle...good, now if you have some thatching spars you can go and fix the fence. It's just to the south near the jungle, again, you'll need a machete for this.
translation: 我看你一直在砍伐丛林……很好，现在如果你有一些茅草杆，你可以去修理栅栏。就在南边靠近丛林的地方，同样，你需要一把砍刀。

english: Great, I saw you were fixing the fence earlier, it looks like you've got the hang of this now! Let me give you something for your effort!
translation: 太好了，我之前看到你在修栅栏，看来你现在已经掌握要领了！让我给你点东西作为努力报酬！

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Well, I tend the hardwood grove nearby, you can enter if you like and harvest some of the very fine hardwood that grows within.
translation: 嗯，我照料附近的硬木林，如果你喜欢可以进去收获一些里面生长的优质硬木。

english: Apart from that I'm a simple Tai Bwo Wannai villager...I like to try and find out what's going on in the mainland and the rest of the known world.
translation: 除此之外我只是个普通的泰博瓦纳村村民……我喜欢试着了解大陆和已知世界其他地方发生的事情。

english: Well Bwana, if you're stuck for something to do, you could always do a bit of handymanship about the village and cut away the jungle that lies here about.
translation: 嗯老爷，如果你没事做，你总可以在村里做些杂务，砍掉周围丛林。

english: If you's is good with da machete Bwana, you's can get's some thatching spars and put them to use repairing the run-down village fence.
translation: 如果你擅长用砍刀老爷，你可以弄些茅草杆用来修理破败的村栅栏。

english: Apart from cutting back the jungle and repairing the fence, I think we've got most things covered now Bwana.
translation: 除了砍伐丛林和修理栅栏，我想我们现在大部分事情都涵盖了老爷。

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Do I get anything for doing this?
translation: 我做这个能得到什么吗？

english: Yes Bwana, you gain experience in woodcutting. In addition many members of the community will reward you with trading sticks, our local currency, for your efforts.
translation: 是的老爷，你会获得伐木经验。此外，社区许多成员会用交易棒奖励你的努力，那是我们的本地货币。

english: Trading sticks?
translation: 交易棒？

english: Correct Bwana, trading sticks! It's our form of local currency! Everything you do to help out in the village will give you some favour, but there's a maximum limit!
translation: 正确老爷，交易棒！那是我们的本地货币！你在村里提供的所有帮助都会增加一些好感度，但有上限！

english: When you've reached one hundred percent, you cannot gain any more favour, you need to cash in your favour for trading sticks before you can increase your favour again.
translation: 当你达到百分之百时，你不能再获得更多好感度，你需要将好感度兑换成交易棒，之后才能继续积累好感度。

english: Who do I get trading sticks from?
translation: 我从谁那里得到交易棒？

english: Well Bwana, there's a good ten villagers I know of who would show their appreciation for your effort. Who do you want to ask about?
translation: 嗯老爷，我知道有十个村民会对你的努力表示感激。你想问谁？

english: Sharimika is married to Mamma Bufetta, Bwana. They live in the houses just in front of the tribal statue.
translation: 沙里米卡娶了妈妈布费塔，老爷。他们住在部落雕像前面的房子里。

english: Mamma Bufetta lives with her family in the building that faces the stone statue, she lives there with her husband Sharimika and her daughter Layleen.
translation: 妈妈布费塔和家人住在面对石像的建筑里，她和丈夫沙里米卡及女儿莱琳住在那里。

english: Layleen is a young girl, the daughter of Mamma Bufetta and Sharimika, she lives with her parents.
translation: 莱琳是个年轻女孩，妈妈布费塔和沙里米卡的女儿，她和父母住在一起。

english: Karaday is a young man and his chosen profession is fishing, he follows after his father Safta Doc in that respect. You can find him usually around the center of the village, that is when he's not off fishing.
translation: 卡拉代是个年轻人，他选择的职业是钓鱼，在这方面他追随父亲萨夫塔‧多克。你通常可以在村庄中心找到他，除非他去钓鱼了。

english: Safta Doc used to be a fisherman, but he's just about retired now. He has an interesting profession which you might like to talk to him about. You'll find him usually near the building with the anvil in it.
translation: 萨夫塔‧多克曾经是渔夫，但现在差不多退休了。他有个有趣的职业你可能想跟他谈谈。你通常会在有铁砧的建筑附近找到他。

english: It's just slightly north of the village statue.
translation: 就在村庄雕像稍微北边一点。

english: Gabooty is a bit of a mystery, no one's sure where he came from! He's quite helpful though, you can find him in the middle of the village enclosure, to the south of Sharimika's house.
translation: 加布蒂有点神秘，没人确定他从哪来！但他很有帮助，你可以在村庄围场中间找到他，沙里米卡房子的南边。

english: Fanellaman was a fisherman, he's retired now, but he'll try and regale you with tales of his salty sea dog days. He's often walking up and down the western beach.
translation: 法内拉曼曾经是渔夫，现在退休了，但他会试着给你讲他老海狗岁月的故事。他经常在西海滩走来走去。

english: Jagbakoba is a wild hunter. He can be a bit aggressive but he'll reward anyone who helps to keep the village in good order. You'll find him to the south of the enclosure, near the fires.
translation: 贾格巴科巴是个野生猎人。他可能有点 агрессивный，但他会奖励任何帮助维持村庄秩序的人。你会在围场南边，火堆附近找到他。

english: Ah Rionasta! He's an enterprising man! Had a very good idea and is now much in demand, you'll find him between the blacksmith's and Timfraku's hut.
translation: 啊里奥纳斯塔！他是个有进取心的人！有个非常好的主意现在很受欢迎，你会在铁匠铺和蒂姆弗拉库的小屋之间找到他。

english: Murcaily! That's me! Well, what do you want to know?! I look after the teak and mahogany trees and make sure that we get payment of anyone who uses the facility. And I'm usually standing just about here!
translation: 穆尔凯利！就是我！嗯，你想了解什么？！我照料柚木和红木树，确保任何使用设施的人向我们付款。我通常就站在这里附近！

english: Hey, I've seen you working around the village. You've been doing a lot of good work around here for us. Let me give you something for your trouble.
translation: 嘿，我看到你在村庄周围工作。你为我们在这里做了很多好事。让我给你点东西作为辛苦费。

english: Where can I get a machete from?
translation: 我从哪能得到砍刀？

english: You can purchase a standard machete from Jiminua's store. Gabooty has a selection of local items which you may like to purchase, including better machetes. Also, you may like to chat to Safta Doc, he may have a deal you'll find interesting.
translation: 你可以从吉米努亚的商店购买标准砍刀。加布蒂有一些你可能想购买的本地物品，包括更好的砍刀。另外，你可能想跟萨夫塔‧多克聊聊，他可能有你觉得有趣的交易。

english: Where is this jungle?
translation: 这片丛林在哪？

english: You'll find much of it to the southern end of Tai Bwo Wannai, outside of the village. Some is tougher than others so you may have difficulties cutting it back.
translation: 你会发现大部分在泰博瓦纳村南端，村庄外面。有些比其他更难砍，所以你可能会有困难。

english: Beware though Bwana, those bushes can conceal a great many dangers or trophies, it could be the death... or the making of you!
translation: 不过要小心老爷，那些灌木丛可能隐藏许多危险或战利品，它可能是你的死亡……或者成就你！

english: What do you mean by that?
translation: 你什么意思？

english: It means that you may find something you wish you hadn't but then discover something you never thought you could! If you find me too vague, go and have a chat with Sharimika about it!
translation: 意思是你可能找到你希望没找到的东西，但然后发现你从未想过能找到的东西！如果你发现我太模糊，去跟沙里米卡聊聊！

english: Where is the fence that needs to be repaired?
translation: 需要修理的栅栏在哪？

english: This is to the South Bwana, you should see that there are sections which are rotten, but some other passers-by sometimes help out repairing it.
translation: 就在南边老爷，你应该能看到有些部分腐烂了，但其他路人有时也会帮忙修理。

english: You'll need some thatching spars and a machete in order to repair the fence though Bwana.
translation: 不过你需要一些茅草杆和一把砍刀来修理栅栏老爷。

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
translation: 我在村庄周围做了一些工作。

english: I've already given you some trading sticks and I don't have any more on me at the moment. Why not go and talk to some of the other villagers and get some contributions?
translation: 我已经给了你一些交易棒，我现在身上没有更多了。为什么不去跟其他村民谈谈得到一些贡献？

english: Hey there, you wanna go in there to chop da special wood, for you my friend, it's free!
translation: 嘿，你想进去砍那种特殊木材吗，对你我的朋友，免费！

english: The player enters the Hardwood Grove.
translation: 玩家进入硬木林。

english: Nah thanks, I'll give it a miss at the moment I think.
translation: 不谢了，我想我现在就算了。

english: Fair enough, pop back if you change your mind.
translation: 好吧，如果你改变主意再回来。

english: Ahhhhhhhh - Get away from me you beast!
translation: 啊啊啊啊啊——离我远点你这野兽！

english: What's the problem....oh, I'm wearing this big scary mask! I'd better take it off before I start talking to the natives.
translation: 什么问题……哦，我戴着这个可怕的大面具！最好在跟当地人说话前摘下来。

english: Waahhhhh! - It's da evil broodoo beast come ta eat my very soul!
translation: 哇啊啊啊！——是邪恶的布鲁多兽来吃我的灵魂了！

english: Ahhhhhhhh - It's a monster!
translation: 啊啊啊啊啊——是怪物！

english: Ahhhhhhhh!!
translation: 啊啊啊啊啊！！

translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Is there anything interesting to do here?
translation: 这里有什么有趣的事可做吗？

translation: 询问关于砍伐丛林的事。

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

translation: 我做这个能得到什么吗？
