translation: 跟我讲讲龙。

english: Tell me about wyverns.
translation: 跟我讲讲双足飞龙。

english: That's enough education for one day.
translation: 今天的学习就到这里吧。

english: Tell me about snails.
translation: 跟我讲讲蜗牛。

english: Tell me about monkeys.
translation: 跟我讲讲猴子。

english: Tell me about sea slugs.
translation: 跟我讲讲海蛞蝓。

english: Tell me about snakes.
translation: 跟我讲讲蛇。

english: Tell me about natural history.
translation: 跟我讲讲自然历史。

english: Tell me about terrorbirds.
translation: 跟我讲讲恐鸟。

english: Tell me about the Kalphite Queen.
translation: 跟我讲讲卡尔夫特虫后。

english: Tell me about camels.
translation: 跟我讲讲骆驼。

english: Tell me about leeches.
translation: 跟我讲讲水蛭。

english: Tell me about moles.
translation: 跟我讲讲鼹鼠。

english: Tell me about penguins.
translation: 跟我讲讲企鹅。

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: Speak to me again and I will rend the soul from your flesh.
translation: 再敢跟我说话，我就将你的灵魂从肉身中剥离。

english: Nobody speaks to me unless I speak to them!!!
translation: 除非我主动开口，否则没人能跟我说话！！！

english: I do not answer questions, mortal fool!!
translation: 我不回答问题，凡人蠢货！！

english: I will answer questions when you are dead!!
translation: 等你死了我会回答问题的！！

english: You dare to speak to me??? Have you lost your wits????
translation: 你竟敢跟我说话？？？你疯了吗？？？？

english: What happened to everyone here?
translation: 这里的人都怎么了？

english: How do I get into the town?
translation: 我怎么进城？

english: Told you I'd defeat you, Necrovarus. My advice to you is to pass over to the next world yourself with everybody else.
translation: 告诉过你我会打败你，尼克罗瓦鲁斯。我劝你还是和其他人一起往生吧。

english: I should fry you for what you have done...
translation: 就凭你所做的一切，我真该把你炸了……

english: Quiet, evil priest!! If you try anything I will command you again, but this time it will be throw yourself into the Endless Void for the rest of eternity.
translation: 闭嘴，邪恶的祭司！！若敢轻举妄动，我会再次命令你——这次是让你永世堕入无尽虚空。

english: Please no! I will do whatever you say!!
translation: 求求你不要！我会按你说的做！！

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: What happened to everyone here?
translation: 这里的人都怎么了？

english: How do I get into the town?
translation: 我怎么进城？

english: Hello there! Looking to take advantage of the Mistrock mines? If so, I'm happy to buy any ores from you. I can also sell you some tools if needed.
translation: 你好！想利用米斯特洛克矿场吗？如果是的话，我很乐意从你那里购买任何矿石。如果需要，我也可以卖给你一些工具。

english: Let's trade.
translation: 我们交易吧。

english: Great!
translation: 太好了！

english: What can you tell me about this place?
translation: 你能和我说说这个地方的什么？

english: Mistrock? It's a mining outpost. It was set up by Cam Torum after you humans went and had another of your wars. We lost some good mines and needed to find new ones.
translation: 米斯特洛克？这是个采矿前哨站。是在你们人类又打了一场仗之后由卡姆托鲁姆城建立的。我们失去了一些好矿场，需要找新的。

english: Why here?
translation: 为什么选这里？

english: It wasn't the first choice, but both humans and dwarves alike were pretty poor after the fighting ended, so we all had to learn lessons in how to compromise.
translation: 这不是首选，但战斗结束后人类和矮人都很穷，所以我们都得学会如何妥协。

english: Still, it ended up not being too bad in the end. We found there was a reasonable supply of coal and iron here, along with some silver and gold.
translation: 不过最终结果还不错。我们发现这里有合理的煤炭和铁供应，还有一些银和金。

english: The location ended up being quite appealing for some as well. It makes for a nice change of scenery for those that appreciate that sort of thing.
translation: 这个位置对某些人来说也相当有吸引力。对于那些欣赏这类事物的人来说，这是个不错的风景变化。

english: So what was here before Mistrock?
translation: 那么米斯特洛克之前这里是什么？

english: Nothing much of note. The land here was owned by the Moonrise Brewery and Winery, but they found it wasn't much good for growing grapes.
translation: 没什么值得注意的。这里的土地归月升啤酒厂和葡萄酒厂所有，但他们发现这里不太适合种植葡萄。

english: So they were happy to give it up?
translation: 所以他们很乐意放弃？

english: Very happy. They saw an opportunity for a new business relationship. In return for giving us the land, we now give them favourable rates on what we mine here.
translation: 非常乐意。他们看到了建立新商业关系的机会。作为给我们土地的回报，我们现在给他们在这里开采的矿产提供优惠价格。

english: Does a winery have much need for metal?
translation: 葡萄酒厂需要很多金属吗？

english: Apparently so. I guess they use it to make and maintain all their fancy brewing and winemaking equipment.
translation: 显然需要。我想他们用金属来制造和维护所有那些花哨的酿造和酿酒设备。

english: But anyway, enough about that. Are you interested in buying or selling some ores?
translation: 但不管怎样，不说这个了。你有兴趣买卖一些矿石吗？

english: I'm good, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。

english: Well you know where I am if you change your mind.
translation: 如果你改变主意，知道我在哪里。

english: Let's trade.
translation: 我们交易吧。

english: What can you tell me about this place?
translation: 你能和我说说这个地方的什么？

english: I'm good, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。

english: Why, hello there, [lad/lass]. Me friends call me Ned. I was a man of the sea, but it's past me now. Could I be making or selling you some rope?
translation: 哎呀，你好啊，[lad/lass]。朋友们叫我内德。我曾经是个海员，但现在已经退休了。我能给你制作或出售一些绳子吗？

english: Hello again, [lad/lass]. Something I can help you with? Want to buy some rope perhaps?
translation: 又见面了，[lad/lass]。有什么我能帮你的吗？想买些绳子吗？

english: How did you get back from Crandor?
translation: 你是怎么从克兰多岛回来的？

english: I got towed back by a passing friendly whale.
translation: 我被一只路过的友好鲸鱼拖回来的。

english: Anyway, would you like me to make some rope while you're here?
translation: 话说，趁你在这里，要我帮你做点绳子吗？

english: Can you take me back to Crandor again?
translation: 你能再带我回克兰多岛吗？

english: Aye, that I could. I'll meet you at the Port Sarim docks again. I'll try to steer a little better this time!
translation: 是的，我可以。我会在沙林港码头再跟你见面。这次我会尽量掌好舵！

english: Yes, I would like some rope.
translation: 是的，我想要些绳子。

english: Well, I can sell you some rope for 15 coins. Or I can be making you some if you gets me 4 balls of wool. I strands them together I does, makes em strong.
translation: 嗯，我可以卖给你一些绳子，15枚金币。或者如果你给我4团羊毛，我可以给你做一些。我把它们编在一起，让它们更结实。

english: You make rope from wool?
translation: 你用羊毛做绳子？

english: Of course you can!
translation: 当然可以！

english: I thought you needed hemp or jute.
translation: 我以为你需要大麻或黄麻。

english: Do you want some rope or not?
translation: 你到底想不想要绳子？

english: You don't have enough coins to buy any rope!
translation: 你没有足够的金币买绳子！

english: Okay, please sell me some rope.
translation: 好的，请卖给我一些绳子。

english: There you go, finest rope in Gielinor.
translation: 给你，基利诺尔最好的绳子。

english: You hand Ned 15 coins. Ned gives you a coil of rope.
translation: 你递给内德15枚金币。内德给你一卷绳子。

english: Thanks. Hmmm, do you know something? This rope has a funny smell.
translation: 谢谢。嗯，你知道吗？这绳子有股怪味。

english: Really?
translation: 真的吗？

english: Yes, It reminds me of...yaks. I was travelling in the Fremennik Isles recently and, do you know what? They made rope out of yak's hair.
translation: 是的，它让我想起……牦牛。我最近在费明尼克群岛旅行，你知道吗？他们用牦牛毛做绳子。

english: What a coincidence?
translation: 真巧啊？

english: There was a lady over there who sold wool, she said she traded rope for the wool.
translation: 那边有位女士卖羊毛，她说她用绳子换羊毛。

english: Who would have thought it?
translation: 谁能想到呢？

english: I don't think you make rope at all. I think you trade balls of wool for rope.
translation: 我觉得你根本不是自己做绳子，而是用羊毛去换的。

english: Oh, I confess. You have found the truth. I used to make the rope myself, but my fingers aren't as nimble as they used to be and so many people wanted my rope. Demand was so high I had to find another
translation: 哦，我承认，被你识破了。我过去确实亲手做绳子，但如今手指不如从前灵活，偏偏又这么多人想要。需求太大，我只好另找货源。

english: source. But I couldn't tell anyone since Ned's Handmade Rope (100% Wool) is a high profile brand now.
translation: 可这事不能说，毕竟''内德手工绳(100% 羊毛)''如今可是知名品牌。

english: Yes, well, the wool is still pretty good, though yak hair makes fine rope. I don't suppose any harm will come of it.
translation: 是的，嗯，羊毛仍然相当不错，尽管牦牛毛能做更好的绳子。我想这不会有什么害处。

english: Thanks. Here take this, a free sample! Please, don't tell anyone.
translation: 谢谢。来，拿着这个，免费样品！请别告诉任何人。

english: Well, it's always good to keep on the good side of a sailor. Your secret is safe with me.
translation: 嗯，跟水手搞好关系总是好的。你的秘密在我这儿很安全。

english: Oh, if you're in the Isles again, tell Jofridr that her Neddie will be there soon.
translation: 哦，如果你再去群岛，告诉乔弗里德，她的内迪很快就会到那里。

english: I will do that!
translation: 我会的！

english: I have some balls of wool. Could you make me some rope?
translation: 我有一些羊毛团。你能给我做些绳子吗？

english: Sure I can.
translation: 当然可以。

english: You hand over 4 balls of wool. Ned gives you a coil of rope.
translation: 你交出4团羊毛。内德给你一卷绳子。

english: That's a little more than I want to pay.
translation: 这比我愿意付的多了点。

english: Well, if you ever need rope that's the price. Sorry. An old sailor needs money for a little drop o' rum.
translation: 嗯，如果你需要绳子，就是这个价格。抱歉。老水手需要点钱买一小杯朗姆酒。

english: I will go and get some wool.
translation: 我去弄些羊毛来。

english: Aye, you do that. Remember, it takes 4 balls of wool to make strong rope.
translation: 是的，你去吧。记住，需要4团羊毛才能做出结实的绳子。

english: No thanks Ned, I don't need any.
translation: 不用了内德，我不需要。

english: Well, old Neddy is always here if you do. Tell your friends. I can always be using the business.
translation: 嗯，如果你需要，老内迪一直在这儿。告诉你的朋友们。我随时欢迎生意。

english: Well done!
translation: 做得好！

english: Good work! I have new information to share with you. Listen carefully, now!
translation: 干得好！我有新信息要跟你分享。仔细听好了！

english: A place 65 steps forward and 17 to the right needs an inspection. The weather vane up high will guide you in the right direction.
translation: 往前走65步，再向右17步，那儿需要检查。高处的风向标会为你指引方向。

english: Under the ground lies the next clue you seek. Getting it out requires a little technique.
translation: 你要找的下一个线索就在地下，但把它弄出来得有点技巧。

english: Yes, I would like some rope.
translation: 是的，我想要些绳子。

english: No thanks Ned, I don't need any.
translation: 不用了内德，我不需要。

english: How did you get back from Crandor?
translation: 你是怎么从克兰多岛回来的？

english: Can you take me to Crandor again?
translation: 你能再带我去克兰多岛吗？

english: Okay, please sell me some rope.
translation: 好的，请卖给我一些绳子。

english: I have some balls of wool. Could you make me some rope?
translation: 我有一些羊毛团。你能给我做些绳子吗？

english: That's a little more than I want to pay.
translation: 这比我愿意付的多了点。

english: I will go and get some wool.
translation: 我去弄些羊毛来。

english: I'm sorry to bother you, but could you spare me a little dung?
translation: 抱歉打扰你，但能给我一点粪便吗？

english: The camel didn't seem to appreciate that question.
translation: 骆驼似乎不太欣赏这个问题。

english: Mmm... looks like that camel would make a nice kebab.
translation: 嗯……看起来那只骆驼做成烤肉串会不错。

english: If I go near that camel, it'll probably bite my hand off.
translation: 如果我靠近那只骆驼，它可能会把我的手咬掉。

english: I wonder if that camel has fleas...
translation: 不知道那只骆驼有没有跳蚤……

english: The camel tries to stamp on your foot, but you pull it back quickly.
translation: 骆驼试图踩你的脚，但你迅速缩了回来。

english: The camel turns its head and glares at you.
translation: 骆驼转过头瞪着你。

english: The camel spits at you, and you jump back hurriedly.
translation: 骆驼朝你吐口水，你急忙跳开。

english: Are you serious?
translation: 你是认真的吗？

english: Oh yes. If you'd be so kind...
translation: 哦是的。如果你能行个好……

english: The camel ponders for a moment...
translation: 骆驼思索了片刻……

english: I'm sorry, but I can't really help you right now. Perhaps you should ask me again later, or try a different camel.
translation: 抱歉，我现在真的帮不了你。也许你待会儿再来问我，或者试试别的骆驼。

english: Fair enough.
translation: 好吧。

english: Well, just you close your eyes first. I'm not doing it while you're watching me!
translation: 嗯，你先闭上眼睛。我可不想让你看着我这样做！

english: I hope that's what you wanted!
translation: 希望这就是你想要的！

english: Ohhh yes. Lovely.
translation: 哦是的。太好了。

english: What was that?
translation: 那是什么？

english: Er, nothing important.
translation: 呃，没什么重要的。

english: Wait, you're a human, aren't you? Have you come from outside this town?
translation: 等等，你是人类，对吧？你是从城外来的吗？

english: Yes, I have.
translation: 是的，我是。

english: Oh, how wonderful! Does that mean I can finally leave this place and see the world outside?
translation: 哦，太棒了！那是不是意味着我终于可以离开这个地方去看看外面的世界了？

english: Wouldn't your master have to take you?
translation: 你的主人不是得带你走吗？

english: The plagues mean that my master isn't allowed to leave. It's so boring here, and I'd like to travel.
translation: 瘟疫意味着我的主人不能离开。这里太无聊了，我想去旅行。

english: My master has no interest in leaving. It's so boring here, and I'd like to travel.
translation: 我的主人没有兴趣离开。这里太无聊了，我想去旅行。

english: Travelling's what camels do best, you know.
translation: 旅行是骆驼最擅长的，你知道的。

english: I don't suppose you could take me with you, could you?
translation: 我想你不能带我一起走，对吧？

english: How do I know you're not ill as well?
translation: 我怎么知道你没有生病？

english: Well, I haven't turned funny colours yet, so I'm probably not. Will you take me with you?
translation: 嗯，我还没有变成奇怪的颜色，所以我可能没有。你愿意带我一起走吗？

english: I don't really have space for a camel, sorry.
translation: 我真的没有空间容纳一只骆驼，抱歉。

english: Oh well. Come back some time, and bring me news of the rest of the world.
translation: 哦好吧。有空再回来，给我带些外面世界的消息。

english: Ask the camel about its dung.
translation: 找骆驼讨点粪便。

english: Say something unpleasant.
translation: 说些不愉快的话。

english: Neither - I'm a polite person.
translation: 都不——我是个有礼貌的人。

english: Hello there, are you interested in buying one of my special capes?
translation: 你好，有兴趣买一件我的特殊斗篷吗？

english: What's so special about your capes?
translation: 你的斗篷有什么特别的？

english: Ahh well they make it less likely that you'll accidently attack anyone wearing the same cape as you and easier to attack everyone else. They also make it easier to distinguish people who're wearing the same cape as you
translation: 啊嗯，它们能让你不太可能误伤穿着相同斗篷的人，也更容易攻击其他人。它们还能让你更容易区分穿着相同斗篷的人

english: from everyone else. They're very useful when out in the wilderness with friends or anyone else you don't want to harm.
translation: 和其他人。当你和朋友或任何你不想伤害的人一起在荒野时，它们非常有用。

english: So would you like to buy one?
translation: 那么你想买一件吗？

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: What's so special about your capes?
translation: 你的斗篷有什么特别的？

english: Yes please!
translation: 好的，谢谢！

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Hello. What's your name?
translation: 你好。你叫什么名字？

english: I shouldn't talk to strangers.
translation: 我不应该和陌生人说话。

english: Well, my name is [player name] and I'm pleased to meet you. So, now that I'm not a stranger anymore, what's your name?
translation: 嗯，我叫 [player name]，很高兴见到你。那么，既然我不再是陌生人了，你叫什么名字？

english: Hmm... Nice to meet you, [player name]. I'm Neite.
translation: 嗯……很高兴见到你，[player name]。我叫奈特。

english: How come you're the only cat around here?
translation: 为什么你是这里唯一的猫？

english: Oh there's far more than just me. The others are just shy. We do also get visitors from outside the city sometimes, like that Bob. He's quite a handsome beast...
translation: 哦，远不止我一个。其他的只是害羞。我们有时也会有城外的访客，比如鲍勃。他是个相当英俊的家伙……

english: Oh, I see. Romance is in the air, is it?
translation: 哦，我明白了。空气中弥漫着浪漫的气息，是吗？

english: Well, life here in the desert can be a lonely existence, even with all my busy work... Still, to be honest, he worries me.
translation: 嗯，沙漠里的生活可能很孤独，即使我有这么多忙碌的工作……不过，老实说，他让我担心。

english: In what way?
translation: 哪方面？

english: Well, I pride myself on my knowledge of the family lines of cats. Obviously, Bob features quite heavily in most family trees, but he himself has none!
translation: 嗯，我为自己对猫的血统了解而自豪。显然，鲍勃在大多数家谱中都占有重要地位，但他自己却没有家谱！

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你什么意思？

english: Nobody is sure where he came from. Not even the Sphinx knows. It's just one of those mysteries.
translation: 没人确定他从哪里来。连斯芬克斯都不知道。这就是个谜。

english: Interesting...
translation: 有趣……

english: What are you doing?
translation: 你在做什么？

english: I'm hunting frogs and locusts.
translation: 我在猎杀青蛙和蝗虫。

english: Why? Do they taste good?
translation: 为什么？它们好吃吗？

english: Yuck! No, I would never debase myself to eat such filth.
translation: 呸！不，我绝不会降低身份去吃那种脏东西。

english: I see you're a cat of taste then.
translation: 看来你是只有品味的猫。

english: I am a cat of high breeding! My family tree dates back before those of any ruler on Gielinor.
translation: 我是出身高贵的猫！我的家谱可以追溯到基利诺尔任何统治者之前。

english: What do you do with the frogs and locusts?
translation: 你用青蛙和蝗虫做什么？

english: What do you mean by 'do'?
translation: 你说的''做''是什么意思？

english: Well, seeing as you're hunting them, I thought you'd eat them too.
translation: 嗯，既然你在猎杀它们，我以为你也会吃它们。

english: No, no, I just hunt them, play with them for a bit and then kill them.
translation: 不，不，我只是猎杀它们，玩一会儿然后杀死它们。

english: Isn't that a little evil?
translation: 那是不是有点邪恶？

english: What's evil about a little destruction?
translation: 一点破坏有什么邪恶的？

english: What isn't? You destroy and take away life. What good is there in that?
translation: 有什么不邪恶的？你破坏并夺走生命。那有什么好处？

english: Life can come from destruction too. Take a volcano. It will destroy all life that surrounds it, but it will also fertilise and enrich the surrounding earth.
translation: 生命也可以从破坏中诞生。以火山为例。它会摧毁周围的所有生命，但也会肥沃和丰富周围的土地。

english: From that earth, more life will spring forth than there was in the first place.
translation: 从那片土地中，会涌现出比原来更多的生命。

english: How do you compare killing frogs to a volcano? A volcano has no choice about whether it explodes or not, but you do have a choice.
translation: 你怎么能把杀青蛙和火山相提并论？火山无法选择是否爆发，但你有选择。

english: I disagree. It's in my nature to prey on smaller life forms in the same way as it is in the volcanoes nature to explode.
translation: 我不同意。捕食较小的生命形式是我的天性，就像爆发是火山的天性一样。

english: Don't they sometimes call the Devourer the goddess of destruction? You seem to have a lot in common with a goddess that your kind oppose.
translation: 他们不是有时称吞噬者为毁灭女神吗？你似乎和你们族群反对的一位女神有很多共同点。

english: That is not too surprising. A long time ago, I served her. Her form has changed a lot since then, just as mine has.
translation: 这并不太令人惊讶。很久以前，我侍奉过她。从那以后，她的形态发生了很大变化，我的也是。

english: You mean you weren't always a cat?
translation: 你的意思是你不是一直都是猫？

english: No, I used to be human. At the time when Amascut became the Devourer, I was one of her chief priestesses.
translation: 不，我曾经是人类。当阿玛斯库特成为吞噬者时，我是她的大祭司之一。

english: So you stopped serving her because of that change?
translation: 所以你因为那个变化而停止侍奉她？

english: Not initially. Many of us tolerated her new habits for some time. She went too far though, so we took action.
translation: 起初没有。我们中的许多人容忍了她的新习惯一段时间。但她做得太过分了，所以我们采取了行动。

english: What did you do?
translation: 你们做了什么？

english: The last of her priestesses gathered and cursed her. Unfortunately, she also cast a spell of her own, condemning us to an eternity of walking Gielinor in her form.
translation: 她最后的祭司们聚集起来诅咒了她。不幸的是，她也施放了自己的咒语，谴责我们永远以她的形态在基利诺尔游荡。

english: So she's a cat then?
translation: 那她是只猫吗？

english: She's as much of a cat as Icthlarin is a dog.
translation: 她是猫的程度就像伊克特拉林是狗一样。

english: What curse did you cast upon her?
translation: 你们对她施了什么诅咒？

english: We trapped her in a human form, limiting her power. We also cursed her to never be willing worshipped again, though I fear that curse has started to wane.
translation: 我们把她困在人类形态中，限制了她的力量。我们还诅咒她永远不再被自愿崇拜，尽管我担心那个诅咒已经开始减弱。

english: So that's why she's scared of cats?
translation: 所以这就是她害怕猫的原因？

english: Indeed. There are fewer of us priestesses left now, but we still hold enough power to be quite the problem for her.
translation: 确实。现在我们剩下的祭司不多了，但我们仍然拥有足够的力量，足以成为她的大麻烦。

english: Do you talk to the Sphinx much?
translation: 你经常和斯芬克斯说话吗？

english: Not really. She is normally too wrapped up in preserving her immortality to be making conversation.
translation: 不太经常。她通常太专注于保持自己的永生，没空聊天。

english: So you don't like her then?
translation: 那你不喜欢她吗？

english: Nothing of the sorts. I have nothing but respect for her.
translation: 完全不是。我对她只有尊敬。

english: Why is that?
translation: 这是为什么？

english: Well, because her immortality is based on the fact that she keeps us cats safe. Her whole existence is dedicated to protecting us.
translation: 嗯，因为她的永生基于她保护我们猫的安全这一事实。她的整个存在都致力于保护我们。

english: That doesn't seem like much of a life.
translation: 那似乎不像是很好的生活。

english: True. Life shouldn't be hoarded, but lived. Of course, don't tell her I said that, otherwise I'd have to be on the lookout for a new guardian.
translation: 确实。生命不应该被囤积，而应该被活出意义。当然，别告诉她我说过这话，否则我就得找个新守护者了。

english: Tell me about you and the Devourer.
translation: 跟我讲讲你和吞噬者。

english: Before she was the goddess of destruction, she was Amascut, the goddess of rebirth. Back then, I was human, and I served as one of her chief priestesses.
translation: 在她成为毁灭女神之前，她是阿玛斯库特，重生之神。那时我还是人类，担任她的大祭司之一。

english: When she became the Devourer, many of us tolerated her new habits for some time. After all, destruction was key to being the goddess of rebirth, so it was something we were comfortable with.
translation: 当她成为吞噬者时，我们中的许多人容忍了她的新习惯一段时间。毕竟，毁灭是成为重生之神的关键，所以这是我们能够接受的。

english: But she went too far?
translation: 但她做得太过分了？

english: Yes, so we took action. The last of her priestesses gathered and cursed her. Unfortunately, she also cast a spell of her own, condemning us to an eternity of walking Gielinor in her form.
translation: 是的，所以我们采取了行动。她最后的祭司们聚集起来诅咒了她。不幸的是，她也施放了自己的咒语，谴责我们永远以她的形态在基利诺尔游荡。

english: Our curse trapped her in a human form, limiting her power. We also cursed her to never be willing worshipped again, though I fear that curse has started to wane.
translation: 我们的诅咒把她困在人类形态中，限制了她的力量。我们还诅咒她永远不再被自愿崇拜，尽管我担心那个诅咒已经开始减弱。

english: I'll leave you to it.
translation: 我不打扰你了。

english: Hello again, Neite.
translation: 又见面了，奈特。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Where's Bob?
translation: 鲍勃在哪？

english: Out gallivanting. I think he's hunting noobs in the Wilderness this time. You know what he's like.
translation: 出去闲逛了。我想他这次去荒野猎杀新手了。你知道他是什么样的人。

english: So, why aren't you out there with him?
translation: 那么，你为什么没和他一起出去？

english: I like to roam as much as the next cat, but, every so often, I do like to come home.
translation: 我和其他猫一样喜欢漫游，但偶尔我也喜欢回家。

english: So, you and Bob haven't had an argument?
translation: 那么，你和鲍勃没有吵架吧？

english: Who told you that?
translation: 谁告诉你的？

english: Er... nobody.
translation: 呃……没人。

english: He's meant to be with you. You haven't lost him have you?
translation: 他应该和你在一起。你没有弄丢他吧？

english: I don't think so.
translation: 我想没有。

english: Well keep an eye on him for me.
translation: 那帮我盯着他点。

english: How come you're the only cat around here?
translation: 为什么你是这里唯一的猫？

english: What are you doing?
translation: 你在做什么？

english: Do you talk to the Sphinx much?
translation: 你经常和斯芬克斯说话吗？

english: Where's Bob?
translation: 鲍勃在哪？

english: Tell me about you and the Devourer.
translation: 跟我讲讲你和吞噬者。

english: I'll leave you to it.
translation: 我不打扰你了。

english: Hi.
translation: 嗨。

english: You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 你知道吗，打招呼的方式有很多种。你好、嘿喽、你好啊……

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: 那仍然只算一种！

english: Hello. How are you today?
translation: 你好。今天怎么样？

english: I'm great, thank you!
translation: 我很好，谢谢！

english: Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 你好！水晶城的今天真不错，是吧？

english: Indeed.
translation: 确实。

english: What can I do for ya?
translation: 我能为你做什么？

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这里有什么可做的？

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 各种事情！塔楼是非常值得一看的景观。

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 像今天这样的好日子，我建议去市场逛逛。

english: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你觉得你在做什么？

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这里有什么可做的？

english: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: Nilsal, traveller.
translation: 你好，旅行者。

english: Can you heal me? I'm injured.
translation: 你能治疗我吗？我受伤了。

english: I could, but you don't appear to actually need healing right now.
translation: 我可以，但你看起来现在实际上不需要治疗。

english: Of course.
translation: 当然。

english: The nelta whispers a prayer and you suddenly feel a bit better.
translation: 内尔塔低声祈祷，你突然感觉好了一些。

english: So what do you do?
translation: 那么你是做什么的？

english: I am a nelta in service to Ralos.
translation: 我是侍奉拉洛斯的内尔塔。

english: What's a nelta?
translation: 什么是内尔塔？

english: We are the faithful servants of Ralos. We serve in a variety of roles across the Church of Ralos.
translation: 我们是拉洛斯的忠实仆人。我们在拉洛斯教会中担任各种角色。

english: So kind of like a priest?
translation: 所以有点像祭司？

english: Yes, I believe that would be the closest comparison to the Church of Saradomin, though I am no expert on their practices.
translation: 是的，我认为这与萨拉多明教会最接近，尽管我对他们的做法并不精通。

english: Above us mere neltas are the teoki, leaders of the key temples across the kingdom. And of course, above them you have the Teokan himself.
translation: 在我们这些普通内尔塔之上的是特奥基，他们是王国各地主要神庙的领袖。当然，在他们之上还有特奥坎本人。

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: This is the Teomat, home to both the Church of Ralos and the Sect of Ranul. The first and only time that Ralos appeared to us, he did so here on Ralos' Rise. The Teomat was built here as a result.
translation: 这里是特奥玛特，拉洛斯教会和拉努尔教派的所在地。拉洛斯第一次也是唯一一次向我们显现，就是在拉洛斯高峰的这里。因此特奥玛特建在这里。

english: I'd best get going.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: May the sun light your way.
translation: 愿阳光照亮你的道路。

english: Can you heal me? I'm injured.
translation: 你能治疗我吗？我受伤了。

english: So what do you do?
translation: 那么你是做什么的？

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: I'd best get going.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: Adventurer.
translation: 冒险者。

english: Can you heal me? I'm injured.
translation: 你能治疗我吗？我受伤了。

english: I would suggest you seek out a member of the Church of Ralos for that sort of thing. We are more concerned with the dead than the living.
translation: 我建议你去找拉洛斯教会的成员处理那种事情。我们更关心死者而非生者。

english: So what do you do?
translation: 那么你是做什么的？

english: I am a nelta of the Sect of Ranul.
translation: 我是拉努尔教派的内尔塔。

english: What's a nelta?
translation: 什么是内尔塔？

english: Both the Church of Ralos and the Sect of Ranul has neltas. For those of us dedicated to Ranul, our primary duty is to care for the dead and prepare them for their journey through the Gates of Mictl.
translation: 拉洛斯教会与拉努尔教派皆设有内尔塔。对于我们这些侍奉拉努尔的人而言，首要职责是照料亡者，助其穿越米克特尔之门。

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: This is the Teomat. Both the Church of Ralos and the Sect of Ranul are based here, though given us being atop Ralos' Rise, the location holds far more importance to the Church than it does to us.
translation: 此处乃特奥玛特，拉洛斯教会与拉努尔教派皆以此为据点。但因我们身处拉洛斯高峰，此地对教会的意义远胜于我们。

english: I'd best get going.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: Farewell.
translation: 告辞。

english: Can you heal me? I'm injured.
translation: 你能治疗我吗？我受伤了。

english: So what do you do?
translation: 那么你是做什么的？

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: I'd best get going.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: Nilsal, adventurer. I'm afraid I have a lot of work to do, so I can't stop to talk. Preparing for the Gathering is a large task at the best of times, never mind after recent events.
translation: 你好，冒险者。恐怕我有很多工作要做，所以不能停下来聊天。准备聚会在最好的时候也是个大任务，更不用说最近的事件之后了。

english: In that case, I'll leave you to it.
translation: 那样的话，我就不打扰你了。

english: Hi.
translation: 嗨。

english: You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 你知道吗，打招呼的方式有很多种。你好、嘿喽、你好啊……

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: 那仍然只算一种！

english: Hello. How are you today?
translation: 你好。今天怎么样？

english: I'm great, thank you!
translation: 我很好，谢谢！

english: Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 你好！水晶城的今天真不错，是吧？

english: Indeed.
translation: 确实。

english: What can I do for ya?
translation: 我能为你做什么？

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这里有什么可做的？

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 各种事情！塔楼是非常值得一看的景观。

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 像今天这样的好日子，我建议去市场逛逛。

english: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你觉得你在做什么？

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这里有什么可做的？

english: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: Hello! What's this then?
translation: 你好！这是什么？

english: How can you not know? YOU MUST KNOW! It is of course the shrine!
translation: 你怎么会不知道？你肯定知道！这当然是神龛！

english: Okay... what is the purpose of said shrine?
translation: 好的……这个神龛的用途是什么？

english: Do you not listen? It is the shrine to almighty one! BWAAAAAAAK!
translation: 你没听吗？这是全能者的神龛！呱啊啊啊啊！

english: You know, you're making me worried, are you okay?
translation: 你知道吗，你让我担心了，你还好吗？

english: DO NOT defy him! Give him your eggs! So colourful! So beautiful!
translation: 不要违抗他！把你的蛋给他！如此多彩！如此美丽！

english: I'm going to leave you alone now.
translation: 我现在要离开你了。

english: Well, what do we have e're? Another laddie lookin' fer old Kellan's deep sea trawlin' expertise?
translation: 哟，来者何人？又一个想向老凯伦请教深海拖网秘诀的小伙子？

english: Er.. Maybe?
translation: 呃……也许？

english: Well, trawlin's the art of catchin' fish with yer boat. It's the best way to harvest the highest quality fish o' the sea. If ye' be wantin' to learn more, I can tell ye' all ye' need t' know.
translation: 嗯，拖网捕捞是用船捕鱼的艺术。这是获取海洋最高品质鱼类的最佳方式。如果你想了解更多，我可以告诉你所有你需要知道的事情。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: The name's Kellan. Used to be a daft-hand at trawlin' back in m'day before the muscles began achin' and the bones started creakin'. These days are better spent helpin you young'uns get yer foot in the trade.
translation: 我叫凯伦。过去我是个拖网捕捞的好手，在肌肉开始酸痛、骨头开始嘎吱作响之前。现在这些日子最好用来帮助你们年轻人入行。

english: How do I deep sea trawl?
translation: 我如何进行深海拖网捕捞？

english: Well, it all starts with you buildin' a good ol' trawlin' net on yer boat. Rope will do, but linen, hemp and cotton are preferred. The better ye' net, the deeper ye'll be able t' lower it.
translation: 嗯，一切都始于你在船上建造一个好的拖网。绳子可以，但亚麻、大麻和棉花更受欢迎。你的网越好，就能放得越深。

english: After ye' got a net, ye' need t' find a shoal out at sea. In mos' cases, different shoals 'ave different fish, so make sure yer lookin' for the one ye' want.
translation: 有了网之后，你需要在海上找到鱼群。在大多数情况下，不同的鱼群有不同的鱼，所以确保你找的是你想要的那种。

english: Once ye' find a shoal, it'll probably be on t' move. They travel o'er pretty large distances, but ye'll find 'em stoppin' from time t' time. Once they stop, that be when it's time t' start catchin'.
translation: 一旦你找到鱼群，它可能在移动。它们会游过相当大的距离，但你会发现它们时不时停下来。一旦它们停下，就是开始捕捞的时候了。

english: So that's when I need to lower my net?
translation: 那就是我需要放下网的时候吗？

english: Aye, exactly. However, it's important for ye' to know that different shoals be at different depths, and plen'y of shoals will be swimmin' up and down as well.
translation: 没错。不过你得知道，不同的鱼群在不同深度，而且很多鱼群也会上下游动。

english: Yer gonna need t' lower the net to the same depth as the shoal, but remember, if the shoal is too deep and yer net ain't up to scratch, yer gonna be all outta luck.
translation: 你得把网放到和鱼群相同的深度，但记住，如果鱼群太深而你的网不够好，那你就没戏了。

english: Okay, so I get a good trawling net, find a shoal, wait for it to stop, and then lower the net to the same depth as the shoal. What else?
translation: 好的，所以我需要一张好的拖网，找到鱼群，等它停下来，然后把网放到和鱼群相同的深度。还有别的吗？

english: If yer wantin' to catch plenty o' fish from a shoal, then yer gonna 'ave to bait it. Best time t' do that is just after it's stopped. For the bait, ye'll be needing lots o' fish offcuts.
translation: 如果你想从鱼群中捕获大量鱼类，那你得给它下饵。最佳时机是它刚停下之后。至于鱼饵，你需要很多鱼块。

english: Ye' can get some offcuts by cuttin' up any kind o' fish, but fancier fish like shark an' such will give ye' higher quality ones.
translation: 你可以通过切割任何种类的鱼来获得鱼块，但像鲨鱼这样的高级鱼类能给你更高质量的鱼块。

english: And I'm guessing the fish in some types of shoals are only going to be interested in higher quality offcuts?
translation: 我猜某些鱼群里的鱼只对更高质量的鱼块感兴趣？

english: Aye, ye' learn fast, laddie.
translation: 没错，你学得真快，小伙子。

english: So these offcuts... Do I just throw them into the water?
translation: 那么这些鱼块……我直接把它们扔进水里吗？

english: Well, sort of, but ye'll need t' proper equipment to do it. Specifically, ye'll want to build a chum station on yer boat. They're what ye' use to spread t' offcuts.
translation: 嗯，差不多，但你需要合适的设备来做这件事。具体来说，你得在船上建造一个诱饵站。那就是你用来撒鱼块的东西。

english: Finally, don't forget that shoals travel o'er big distances. If ye' don't feel the shoals in ye' bones, ye' can build a fathom stone on yer boat. They can help ye' track down a shoals whereabouts.
translation: 最后，别忘了鱼群会游很远的距离。如果你无法凭直觉感知鱼群，你可以在船上建造一个测深石。它能帮你追踪鱼群的位置。

english: I see. This is all very different to normal fishing.
translation: 明白了。这和普通钓鱼完全不同。

english: Where can I deep sea trawl?
translation: 我可以在哪里进行深海拖网？

english: Ye' can do it wherever ye' can find a shoal. They're all across the ocean and yer got different ones fer different fish. I can tell ye' some good places t' find specific ones.
translation: 哪儿有鱼群，哪儿就能拖网。鱼群遍布四海，不同鱼种各有其群。你若想找特定的，我倒能指你几处好地方。

english: First up, krill an' haddock are the best shoals for gettin' started. There be a great spot for krill just west o' here in the Great Sound.
translation: 首先，磷虾和黑线鳕鱼群最适合新手起步。在大海峡这里往西就有一个很好的磷虾捕捞点。

english: Ye' can also find both krill an' haddock down in t' Unquiet Ocean, around places like Red Rock, the Great Conch and t' like.
translation: 你也可以在不宁海找到磷虾和黑线鳕，就在红岩、巨螺岛之类的地方附近。

english: Next ye' got yellowfin an' halibut. There be plen'y o' yellowfin in the Shrouded Ocean, such as near Deepfin Point. Halibut are extra easy! Ye' can find 'em right outside this here port!
translation: 接下来是黄鳍金枪鱼和大比目鱼。在迷雾海有很多黄鳍金枪鱼，比如深鳍岬附近。大比目鱼特别容易！你就在这个港口外面能找到它们！

english: Bluefin are more scattered. Ye' can't really pin 'em down, but I'd try farther south near the waters full of tangled kelp.
translation: 蓝鳍金枪鱼行踪飘忽，难以定位。不过我建议你往南走走，去那些海藻丛生的水域碰碰运气。

english: And then ye' got marlin. They can only be found in the' frigid Northern Ocean, but only the best o' boats can survive up there.
translation: 然后是旗鱼。它们只能在寒冷的北方之海找到，但只有最好的船才能在那里生存。

english: If yer put off by some o' the risks, ye' can try to get lucky. Shoals like t' migrate, an' sometimes them rarer fish mix and mingle with t' other shoals.
translation: 要是你怕冒险，不妨碰碰运气。鱼群喜欢迁徙，有时那些稀有鱼类也会跟其他鱼群混在一起。

english: What kind of fish can I catch while trawling?
translation: 拖网时我能捕获什么种类的鱼？

english: Well, there's giant krill, haddock, yellowfin, halibut, bluefin, and if yer up fer a challenge, the elusive marlin.
translation: 嗯，有巨型磷虾、黑线鳕、黄鳍金枪鱼、大比目鱼、蓝鳍金枪鱼，如果你想挑战一下，还有难以捉摸的旗鱼。

english: These ain't yer normal brand o' fish either. Some say that these are the tastiest fish ye' can get. Some even provide unique effects when ye' eat 'em!
translation: 这些也不是普通的鱼。有人说这是世间至鲜，有些吃了还能带来特殊效果呢！

english: Do you have any other advice for me?
translation: 你还有什么其他建议给我吗？

english: I'm sure ol' Kellan can think o' some stuff t' help ye' on yer trawlin' adventures, laddie.
translation: 我相信老凯兰能想出一些东西来帮你的拖网冒险，小伙子。

english: First, ye'll want t' get yer hands on some sturdy fish crates t' hold more fish. Skilled craftsmen can make empty crates out o' camphor logs then ye' pack em full o' ice. Them slayer masters often have ice fer sale.
translation: 首先，你得弄些结实的鱼箱来装更多的鱼。熟练的工匠可以用樟木原木制作空箱子，然后你把它装满冰。那些杀戮大师经常有冰出售。

english: Second, trawlin' is always better with a good crew by yer side to delegate up the workload. If ye' go it alone, ye'll be trying to man both t' net and chum station at t' same time!
translation: 其次，拖网时有个好船员在身边分担工作量总是更好的。如果你独自行动，你得同时操作网和诱饵站！

english: Third, remember that them rarer shoals don't just stay at one depth. Yer gonna find 'em swimmin' up and down. Ye' gotta pay attention and make sure yer net matches their depth.
translation: 第三，记住那些稀有鱼群不会只待在一个深度。你会发现它们上下游动。你得注意并确保你的网和它们的深度匹配。

english: Finally, don't be forgettin' to bait the shoal when it stops! It'll attract more fish to yer' boat.
translation: 最后，别忘了在鱼群停下时给它下饵！这会吸引更多鱼到你的船边。

english: What is Deadman mode?
translation: 什么是死亡模式？

english: Deadman mode is an incredibly dangerous survival game mode. Anyone can attack anyone, anywhere. Death comes at a huge cost and killing other players can be extremely lucrative.
translation: 死亡模式是一种极其危险的生存游戏模式。任何人都可以在任何地方攻击任何人。死亡代价巨大，而击杀其他玩家可能非常有利可图。

english: Lucrative, you say?
translation: 有利可图，你说？

english: Killing a player will earn you all of the items they had on them, plus the 10 most valuable items from their bank. The unfortunate soul will also lose half of their experience in most skills, or a quarter if they were not skulled. Regardless, it's quite the set-back.
translation: 击杀一名玩家将获得他身上所有的物品，加上他银行中最有价值的10件物品。那个不幸的家伙还会失去大部分技能一半的经验值，如果没有红名的话则是四分之一。无论如何，这都是相当大的挫折。

english: Wow, that is brutal!
translation: 哇，太残忍了！

english: It is, but it is no simple task to kill someone in Deadman mode.
translation: 确实，但在死亡模式中击杀某人并非易事。

english: Very high level guards patrol every major city and bank. They will kill anyone who has a skull. Getting yourself a kill is only half the battle.
translation: 非常高等级的守卫巡逻每个主要城市和银行。他们会击杀任何红名的人。完成击杀只是战斗的一半。

english: How do I play Deadman mode?
translation: 我如何玩死亡模式？

english: You can log into Deadman mode by selecting a Deadman mode world from the world list before you log in.
translation: 你可以在登录前从世界列表中选择死亡模式世界来登录死亡模式。

english: So I don't need a new account to play Deadman mode?
translation: 所以我不需要新账号就能玩死亡模式？

english: Nope! You can use your existing account on a Deadman world, providing you have membership.
translation: 不需要！你可以在死亡模式世界上使用现有账号，只要你有会员资格。

english: Do my stats and items transfer over to Deadman mode?
translation: 我的属性和物品会转移到死亡模式吗？

english: No, they do not. Your Deadman mode progress is completely separate from normal Old School worlds.
translation: 不，不会。你的死亡模式进度与普通 Old School 世界完全分开。

english: What happens when I die in Deadman mode?
translation: 我在死亡模式中死亡会发生什么？

english: If you die to a player you will lose the 10 most valuable stacks of items from your bank, all items that you have on your person and half of the experience you have gained in any unprotected skills.
translation: 若被玩家击杀，你将失去银行内最有价值的10组物品、身上所有物品，以及未保护技能所获经验值的一半。

english: If you die to a monster when you have a PK skull you will lose the 10 most valuable stacks of items from your bank, all items that you have on your person and half of the experience you have gained in any unprotected skills.
translation: 如果你红名时被怪物击杀，你将失去银行中最有价值的10组物品、身上所有物品以及在未保护技能中获得的一半经验值。

english: If you die to a monster when you do not have a PK skull you will lose all of the items on your person except for the 3 most valuable. You will not lose experience or any items from your bank.
translation: 如果你没有红名时被怪物击杀，你将失去身上除了最有价值的3件之外的所有物品。你不会失去经验值或银行中的任何物品。

english: What happens when I kill a player in Deadman mode?
translation: 我在死亡模式中击杀一名玩家会发生什么？

english: When you kill a player you will receive any items they have on their person and you will also be given a key. You can use this key on Deadman chests found in various banks across the map. Within the chest you will
translation: 击杀玩家后，你将获得其身上所有物品及一把钥匙。可用此钥匙开启地图各银行中的死亡模式宝箱，

english: find the 10 most valuable stacks of items from the bank of the player you struck down. From here you will be able to choose the items you would like to keep.
translation: 从中获取该玩家银行内最有价值的10组物品，并选择保留所需物品。

english: How can I protect my items in Deadman mode?
translation: 我如何在死亡模式中保护我的物品？

english: You can protect up to 10 items by placing them in your safe deposit box. Items in your safe deposit box will not be lost to a player who kills you, unlike those found in your bank. Remember that you can only place 10 single items into your safe deposit box, no stacks.
translation: 你最多可将10件物品放入保险箱来保护它们。与银行物品不同，保险箱中的物品不会在玩家击杀你时丢失。记住保险箱只能存放10件单独物品，不能存放堆叠物品。

english: How can I protect my stats in Deadman mode?
translation: 我如何在死亡模式中保护我的属性？

english: You can protect your levels in up to 2 combat skills and 3 non-combat skills. You can choose which by opening your items lost on death interface found in your equipment tab. Choose wisely!
translation: 你最多可保护2项战斗技能和3项非战斗技能的等级。通过装备栏中的''死亡掉落物品''界面即可选择。慎重选择！

english: You should be warned however. If you get killed by a guard, you will lose a tenth of your experience in those skills too!
translation: 不过你要被警告。如果你被守卫击杀，你也会失去那些技能十分之一的经验值！

english: Gelin over there also has some deals on insuring your hitpoints, speak to her to find out more about that.
translation: 那边的格琳也有一些关于保险生命值的交易，和她谈谈了解更多。

english: What are safe zones in Deadman mode?
translation: 死亡模式中的安全区是什么？

english: Safe zones are areas patrolled by very high level guards which can be found in various places across the map. The guards watch out for any player with a PK skull and will attack them if they're spotted. It is still possible to be attacked inside safe zones but the person doing the attacking will not stand a chance of making it out alive.
translation: 安全区是地图各处由极高等级守卫巡逻的区域。守卫会留意并攻击任何红名玩家。在安全区内仍可能被攻击，但攻击者几乎不可能活着离开。

translation: 我们能聊聊奖励吗？

english: Certainly! I sell various rewards to those who have earned Zeal from Soul Wars battles.
translation: 当然！我向那些从灵魂战争战斗中获得热忱的人出售各种奖励。

english: What kinds of rewards are there?
translation: 有什么样的奖励？

english: I can offer you some of my knowledge in various skills, I can use my abilities to imbue some of your items with additional power, and I also have some items I have found on my travels.
translation: 我可以向你传授一些我在各技能方面的经验，我可以用自身能力为你的部分物品灌注额外力量，我还有一些我在旅行中找到的物品。

english: Would you like to see?
translation: 你想看看吗？

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Very well. Is there something else you need?
translation: 很好。你还需要什么吗？

english: Can we talk about ammunition?
translation: 我们能聊聊弹药吗？

english: How are the new capes working out for you?
translation: 新斗篷你用得怎么样？

english: Just fine, thanks!
translation: 挺好的，谢谢！

english: Great, now get back in there and crush some souls!
translation: 太好了，现在回去粉碎些灵魂！

english: Yes, right away!
translation: 是的，马上！

english: Not bad. But I was wondering if they could be improved any further?
translation: 不错。但我想知道它们能否进一步改进？

english: Well if you show me a better device I might be able to sort something out for you.
translation: 嗯如果你给我看个更好的装置我可能能为你搞定点什么。

english: How about this one?
translation: 这个怎么样？

english: You've already shown me this deadchicken. I don't really need to see it again. I might be able to do something if you show me a better one, though.
translation: 你已经给我看过这个死鸡装置了。我真的不需要再看一次。不过如果你给我看个更好的我可能能做点什么。

english: Hmm, very interesting. Let's see what we can do.
translation: 嗯，很有趣。让我们看看能做什么。

english: There we go! It's not quite the same, but it should work out just fine for you.
translation: 成了！不太一样，但应该对你很管用。

english: Bear in mind that the enchantment is bound to my power and so will only work for you while you are in a Soul Wars battle.
translation: 记住附魔绑定于我的力量，所以只会在你处于灵魂战争战斗时对你生效。

english: Great! Thanks for the help!
translation: 太好了！谢谢帮助！

english: I don't really have time to discuss the finer points of Fletching, you know.
translation: 你知道我真没时间讨论制箭的细节。

english: No, not like that! You see, I helped create a device which returns my ammunition.
translation: 不，不是那样！你看，我帮助创造了一个能回收我弹药的装置。

english: Really? If you could show it to me, I might be able to sort something out for you.
translation: 真的吗？如果你能给我看看，我可能能为你搞定点什么。

english: I don't want to talk to you.
translation: 我不想跟你说话。

english: Huh?
translation: 哈？

english: Yikes!
translation: 哎呀！

english: Oh boy.
translation: 哦天哪。

english: Welcome to Soul Wars! Let's get started.
translation: 欢迎来到灵魂战争！我们开始吧。

english: So, what's this place all about?
translation: 那么，这地方是关于什么的？

english: To the south you will have seen an avatar. You must fight to protect your team's avatar, and defeat the opposing team's avatar.
translation: 在南边你应该看到了一个化身。你必须战斗以保护你团队的化身，并击败对方团队的化身。

english: Are you crazy? Have you seen the size of it?
translation: 你疯了吗？你看到它有多大吗？

english: You're here to fight, not whine.
translation: 你是来战斗的，不是来抱怨的。

english: But how am I supposed to take on one of those?
translation: 但我该怎么对付其中一个？

english: By capturing the Soul Obelisk, which lies at the centre of the battleground, and offering it soul fragments.
translation: 通过捕获位于战场中心的灵魂方尖碑，并向它提供灵魂碎片。

english: Let's head towards the Obelisk now. I can point out some of the important landmarks on the way. Meet me to the north when you are ready to learn more.
translation: 我们现在前往方尖碑。我可以在路上指出一些重要地标。当你准备好了解更多时到北边找我。

english: The screen fades to black and Nomad teleports northwards.
translation: 屏幕淡出至黑色，游牧者向北传送。

english: Hey! Where are you going?
translation: 嘿！你要去哪？

english: Only the red team may enter this graveyard.
translation: 只有红队可以进入这个墓地。

english: Hey! You don't need those. You're not in a real battle yet.
translation: 嘿！你不需要那些。你还没在真正的战斗中。

english: You've got no reason to bother that poor imp.
translation: 你没理由打扰那个可怜的小恶魔。

english: Hey! Don't attack those. You're not in a real battle yet.
translation: 嘿！别攻击那些。你还没在真正的战斗中。

english: To continue the demonstration, come speak to me. I'm by the avatar in the south-west of the battleground.
translation: 要继续演示，来跟我说话。我在战场西南边的化身旁。

english: This is one of the graveyards that your team can capture.
translation: 这是你团队可以捕获的墓地之一。

english: For the purposes of this demonstration, however, I have kept it inactive.
translation: 不过为了本次演示的目的，我让它保持非激活状态。

english: You might find this little area behind me useful for defending your avatar. There's one in the other team's base, too.
translation: 你可能会发现我身后这个小区域对防御你的化身有用。对方团队的基地也有一个。

english: During battle, you can gather supplies here to aid you and your teammates.
translation: 在战斗期间，你可以在这里收集补给以帮助你和你队友。

english: The Soul Obelisk is just a little way from here. Let's continue on; I'll meet you to the east.
translation: 灵魂方尖碑离这里不远。我们继续；我在东边等你。

english: The screen fades to black and Nomad teleports eastwards.
translation: 屏幕淡出至黑色，游牧者向东传送。

english: Now, to have a chance against an avatar, you are going to need souls. Lots of souls.
translation: 现在，要有机会对抗化身，你需要灵魂。很多灵魂。

english: What am I going to do with souls?
translation: 我要用灵魂做什么？

english: The Soul Obelisk is immensely powerful and, by channelling souls into it, you can weaken the enemy avatar.
translation: 灵魂方尖碑非常强大，通过将灵魂导入其中，你可以削弱敌方化身。

english: How does that work?
translation: 那是怎么运作的？

english: All I know is that it does, and that you should do it. Lots.
translation: 我只知道它确实有效，而且你应该这样做。多做。

english: So, where do I get these souls from?
translation: 那么，我从哪得到这些灵魂？

english: You can kill the souls that inhabit the arena ruins and harvest their soul fragments.
translation: 你可以杀死栖息在竞技场废墟的灵魂并收获它们的灵魂碎片。

english: For the purposes of this demonstration however, we will use my minion Zimberfizz.
translation: 不过为了本次演示的目的，我们将使用我的仆从金伯菲兹。

english: Zimberfizz! Heel!
translation: 金伯菲兹！过来！

english: Zimberfizz appears.
translation: 金伯菲兹出现了。

english: When you kill a creature in Soul Wars, they will leave a soul fragment behind, which you can use to charge the Soul Obelisk.
translation: 当你在灵魂战争中杀死一个生物时，它们会留下一个灵魂碎片，你可以用它来充能灵魂方尖碑。

english: Zimberfizz has such a soul fragment. Why don't you kill him and take it?
translation: 金伯菲兹就有这样一个灵魂碎片。你为什么不杀了他拿走它？

english: You want me to kill him?
translation: 你想让我杀了他？

english: Yes!
translation: 是的！

english: Come on! Kill him already and get that soul fragment.
translation: 来吧！快杀了他拿到那个灵魂碎片。

english: Good job! Let's carry on to the Soul Obelisk and channel this soul fragment into it. It's just to the east, over a bridge and on a small island.
translation: 干得好！让我们继续前往灵魂方尖碑并将这个灵魂碎片导入其中。就在东边，过一座桥在一个小岛上。

english: Good job! Now, you've got that soul fragment, right?
translation: 干得好！现在，你拿到那个灵魂碎片了吧？

english: About that...
translation: 关于那个……

english: You've lost it? You're lucky you're not in a real battle yet!
translation: 你弄丢了？你幸运还没在真正的战斗中！

english: Here, have this one. Just look after it this time.
translation: 给，拿这个。这次保管好。

english: Make some space and I'll give you one. Just look after it this time.
translation: 腾点空间我给你一个。这次保管好。

english: I'll try...
translation: 我试试……

english: Now! Let's carry on to the Soul Obelisk and channel this soul fragment into it. It's just to the east, over a bridge and on a small island.
translation: 现在！让我们继续前往灵魂方尖碑并将这个灵魂碎片导入其中。就在东边，过一座桥在一个小岛上。

english: Here we are at the Soul Obelisk. Now, you've got that soul fragment, right?
translation: 我们到灵魂方尖碑了。现在，你拿到那个灵魂碎片了吧？

english: Here we are at the Soul Obelisk. Now, to reap the full benefit of the soul fragment, you will need to first be in control of the Obelisk.
translation: 我们到灵魂方尖碑了。现在，要获得灵魂碎片的全部收益，你需要先控制方尖碑。

english: How do I do that?
translation: 我怎么做到？

english: Various areas of the battleground can come under your team's control. To gain control, you must have more team members than the opposing team in these areas.
translation: 战场的各个区域可以被你的团队控制。要获得控制，你必须在这些区域拥有比对方团队更多的团队成员。

english: If you outnumber the enemy, you will gradually take control. Let's try it out now.
translation: 如果你人数超过敌人，你将逐渐获得控制。我们现在试试。

english: We shall use Zimberfizz to represent an enemy team member.
translation: 我们将用金伯菲兹代表一个敌方团队成员。

english: Minion! Heel!
translation: 仆从！过来！

english: Zimberfizz appears again.
translation: 金伯菲兹再次出现。

english: Come on, give him a good kick.
translation: 来吧，好好踢他一脚。

english: I thought he was dead? Didn't we kill him earlier?
translation: 我以为他死了？我们刚才没杀了他吗？

english: Ha! He wishes! No, his service to me is far from over.
translation: 哈！他希望如此！不，他对我的服务远未结束。

english: Poor little guy.
translation: 可怜的小家伙。

english: Ha! I'm sure he loves the attention, right Zimberfizz?
translation: 哈！我肯定他喜欢这关注，对吧金伯菲兹？

english: Zimberfizz appears yet again.
translation: 金伯菲兹又一次出现。

english: Right, now that Zimberfizz is no longer in the Obelisk's capturable area, you outnumber the enemy! The Soul Obelisk will now begin to fall under your control.
translation: 好了，既然金伯菲兹不再在方尖碑的可捕获区域内，你人数超过敌人了！灵魂方尖碑现在将开始落入你的控制。

english: Right. Now, go and charge the Obelisk with that soul fragment and see what happens.
translation: 好的。现在，去用那个灵魂碎片给方尖碑充能看看会发生什么。

english: Go on, use the soul fragment on the Obelisk.
translation: 去吧，在方尖碑上使用灵魂碎片。

english: You charge the Soul Obelisk and weaken the enemy avatar.
translation: 你给灵魂方尖碑充能并削弱了敌方化身。

english: Good job! Now that you have charged the Obelisk, the enemy avatar will have been weakened.
translation: 干得好！既然你已经给方尖碑充能，敌方化身将被削弱。

english: Note the display in the top-left of the screen. See how the red avatar's strength has decreased.
translation: 注意屏幕左上角的显示。看到红色化身的力量如何下降了吗。

english: The number shown here represents the percentage of your damage that the avatar will block.
translation: 这里显示的数字代表化身将阻挡的伤害百分比。

english: So, once I've charged the Obelisk, can I just kick back and wait for the end of the game?
translation: 那么，一旦我给方尖碑充能，我就能休息等待游戏结束吗？

english: Ha! I think not! I'm not about to reward those who don't put the effort in!
translation: 哈！我想不行！我不会奖励那些不努力的人！

english: Note the orange bar in the top-left of the screen. This bar represents how active you have been during the game.
translation: 注意屏幕左上角的橙色条。这个条代表你在游戏期间的活跃程度。

english: Over the course of the battle, the bar will slowly drain. Should the bar drain completely you will be removed from the game due to your inactivity.
translation: 在战斗过程中，条会慢慢减少。如果条完全减少你将因不活跃被移出游戏。

english: You can refill the bar by performing actions in the game, such as dealing damage or charging the Obelisk.
translation: 你可以通过在游戏中执行动作来补充条，比如造成伤害或给方尖碑充能。

english: Oh well. Say, do you think the enemy avatar minds us weakening it like this?
translation: 哦好吧。话说，你觉得敌方化身介意我们这样削弱它吗？

english: Hmm, why don't we go find out?
translation: 嗯，我们为什么不去看看？

english: The screen fades to black. The player and Nomad are now by the red team's avatar area.
translation: 屏幕淡出至黑色。玩家和游牧者现在在红队的化身区域。

english: So, here we are in the enemy base.
translation: 那么，我们到了敌方基地。

english: Is that the enemy avatar over there?
translation: 那边那是敌方化身吗？

english: Yeah, and it looks like you made it pretty mad.
translation: 是的，看起来你把它惹得很生气。

english: What? You're the one that told me to weaken it!
translation: 什么？是你告诉我要削弱它的！

english: Ha! Don't worry - I won't let it kill you.
translation: 哈！别担心——我不会让它杀了你。

english: Phew!
translation: 呼！

english: Of course, that doesn't mean I won't kill you.
translation: 当然，那不代表我不会杀了你。

english: What did you say?
translation: 你说什么？

english: Argh!
translation: 啊！

english: Wooooooooooo!
translation: 呜哦哦哦哦！

english: What?
translation: 什么？

english: Woooooo! Woooooo!
translation: 呜哦哦哦！呜哦哦哦！

english: Sorry, I don't speak ghost.
translation: 抱歉，我不说鬼语。

english: There we go! Much better.
translation: 成了！好多了。

english: Hey! You killed me.
translation: 嘿！你杀了我。

english: At least it wasn't permanent! Think of it as an opportunity to learn.
translation: 至少不是永久的！把它当作一个学习的机会。

english: How so?
translation: 怎么说？

english: The other team will be after you and any soul fragments you have collected, after all.
translation: 毕竟对方团队会追杀你和任何你收集的灵魂碎片。

english: I needed to show you what happens when you fall in battle.
translation: 我需要向你展示你在战斗中倒下会发生什么。

english: Did you turn me into a ghost?
translation: 你把我变成鬼了吗？

english: Not exactly. The Soul Obelisk tried to claim your soul, as it does with all who perish in the battleground.
translation: 不完全是。灵魂方尖碑试图夺取你的灵魂，就像它对所有在战场阵亡的人做的那样。

english: Only my power brought you here, and returned you to life.
translation: 只有我的力量把你带到这里，并让你复活。

english: Erm, thanks, I guess.
translation: 呃，谢谢，我想。

english: You're more useful to me alive... for now.
translation: 你活着对我更有用……暂时。

english: Are there any other painful things to learn about this place?
translation: 关于这个地方还有什么痛苦的事要学吗？

english: There is much more to this place, but you don't need to know about it yet.
translation: 这个地方还有很多，但你还不需知道。

english: If you want to learn more, I can give you a Soul Wars guide upon our return to the waiting area.
translation: 如果你想了解更多，我们返回等待区时我可以给你一本灵魂战争指南。

english: Use the large blue portal at the back of this graveyard to return to the waiting area. Why not sign up for a battle while you're there?
translation: 使用这个墓地后面的大型蓝色传送门返回等待区。为什么不在那里报名参加一场战斗？

english: Use the portal over there to return to the waiting area. I'll see you on the other side!
translation: 使用那边的传送门返回等待区。我在另一边见你！

english: Here we are. The waiting areas are just south of here, but you won't be able to join a battle right now.
translation: 到了。等待区就在南边，但你目前还不能加入战斗。

english: Here we are. Just head south to the waiting areas if you want to join a battle.
translation: 到了。如果想加入战斗只需向南前往等待区。

english: That's all well and good, but what do I get out of all of this?
translation: 那都很好，但我能从这一切中得到什么？

english: I can offer you experience in various skills, and items I have found on my travels.
translation: 我可以提供你各种技能的经验，以及我在旅行中找到的物品。

english: I have a copy of the Soul Wars guide here. It contains information that I didn't have time to cover.
translation: 我这里有一本灵魂战争指南。它包含我没时间涵盖的信息。

english: You don't need to know it all to get started, but the section on burying bones could be useful.
translation: 你不需要知道所有就能开始，但关于埋骨的部分可能有用。

english: Did you want to take it and read it in your own time?
translation: 你想拿走它在自己时间阅读吗？

english: Yes,please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Hmm, it looks like you already have one.
translation: 嗯，看起来你已经有一本了。

english: Oh, alright then.
translation: 哦，那好吧。

english: Here you go.
translation: 给，拿好。

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！

english: Okay, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Check out this deadchicken!
translation: 看看这个死鸡装置！

english: You've already shown me this deadchicken. I don't really need to see it again.
translation: 你已经给我看过这个死鸡装置了。我真的不需要再看一次。

english: Fair enough.
translation: 好吧。

english: Nomad won't consider looking at Ava's devices until you've completed Animal Magnetism
translation: 在你完成''动物磁石''任务前，游牧者不会考虑查看阿瓦的装置

english: Hmm, very interesting.
translation: 嗯，很有趣。

english: I was wondering if you could maybe make your capes do something similar to what this does?
translation: 我在想你能否让你的斗篷做一些类似这个做的事？

english: Let's see what we can do.
translation: 让我们看看能做什么。

english: Nomad mutters an incantation and enchants your Soul Wars capes!
translation: 游牧者喃喃念咒并附魔了你的灵魂战争斗篷！

english: There we go. It's not quite the same, but it should work out just fine for you.
translation: 成了。不太一样，但应该对你很管用。

english: Hmm, very interesting. This one seems more powerful than the last one you showed me.
translation: 嗯，很有趣。这个似乎比你上次给我看的更强大。

english: That's right. I was wondering if you could maybe upgrade your capes again?
translation: 没错。我在想你能否再升级你的斗篷？

english: The time is now! Crush their souls!
translation: 就是现在！粉碎他们的灵魂！

english: Well I'm still getting things set up right now. Once everything is ready, return to me and I'll give you a demonstration.
translation: 嗯我现在还在设置东西。一旦一切准备好，回来找我我会给你做演示。

english: The Soul Wars minigame will be released on the 6th January 2021.
translation: 灵魂战争小游戏将于2021年1月6日发布。

english: Here to crush some souls? Just head into a waiting area to the south to get started.
translation: 来粉碎些灵魂吗？只需前往南边的等待区开始。

english: Let's do it.
translation: 我们走吧。

english: Actually, I'm good.
translation: 不用了。

english: I'll pass.
translation: 我就算了。

english: Can you tell me more about Soul Wars?
translation: 你能多告诉我一些关于灵魂战争的事吗？

english: Could you give me the demonstration again?
translation: 你能再给我做一次演示吗？

english: Could I have the book?
translation: 我能要那本书吗？

english: Can we talk about rewards?
translation: 我们能聊聊奖励吗？

english: Can we talk about ammunition?
translation: 我们能聊聊弹药吗？

english: I'm good.
translation: 我没事。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Yes, right away!
translation: 是的，马上！

english: Fair enough.
translation: 好吧。

english: Great! Thanks for the help!
translation: 太好了！谢谢帮助！

english: I see. I'll be back later.
translation: 我明白了。我稍后回来。

english: I don't want to talk to you.
translation: 我不想跟你说话。

english: Hello little one.
translation: 你好小家伙。

english: I may be small but at least I'm perfectly formed.
translation: 我可能小但至少我形态完美。

english: What's your favourite rock?
translation: 你最喜欢的岩石是什么？

english: You're going tufa with that question. That's personal.

translation: 没错，我是 [Vampyre name]。

english: Well, [Vampyre name], welcome to the essence mine.
translation: 好吧，[Vampyre name]，欢迎来到精华矿。

english: Essence mine?
translation: 精华矿？

english: That's right. Here, we use the slaves to mine daeyalt essence.
translation: 没错。这里，我们用奴隶开采戴亚特精华。

english: Daeyalt essence? Is that connected to daeyalt ore?
translation: 戴亚特精华？那和戴亚特矿石有关吗？

english: Indeed it is. Daeyalt ore is a weaker form of daeyalt essence. It still has uses, hence why we have the slaves mine it. The essence here is far more powerful though.
translation: 确实有关。戴亚特矿石是戴亚特精华的较弱形式。它仍有用处，所以我们要奴隶开采它。不过这里的精华强大得多。

english: Where did it come from?
translation: 它从哪来的？

english: They say that an object of great power was once stored in this very cave. Apparently, the presence of this object created the daeyalt deposits.
translation: 据说一个强大物体曾储存在这个洞穴里。显然，这个物体的存在创造了戴亚特矿床。

english: I see. What is the daeyalt used for?
translation: 我明白了。戴亚特用来做什么？

english: Its main use is as a key component in the vampyrification process. There's other uses though. It can be used to create runes, for example.
translation: 它的主要用途是作为吸血鬼化过程的关键成分。不过还有其他用途。比如它可以用来制作符石。

english: Am I allowed some?

english: The essence mined by the slaves is reserved. If you want some, you'll have to mine your own.
translation: 奴隶开采的精华是预留的。如果你想要一些，你得自己开采。

english: If you do choose to mine the deposits, you should know that the daeyalt shards you'll get are useless on their own. They'll need converting into essence to be used.

english: How do I do that?

english: Luckily for you, I can provide that service.
translation: 对你来说幸运，我能提供那个服务。

english: Whenever you have shards to convert, bring them to me. Normally I'd send the converted essence straight to your bank, but as you seem to carry all of your belongings yourself, I'll just give it right to you instead.
translation: 每当你有碎片要转换，把它们带给我。通常我会把转换后的精华直接送到你的银行，但既然你似乎自己携带所有物品，我就直接给你。

english: Whenever you have shards to convert, bring them to me. I will send the converted essence straight to your bank.
translation: 每当你有碎片要转换，把它们带给我。我会把转换后的精华直接送到你的银行。

english: Great! Thanks for the help.
translation: 太好了！谢谢帮助。

english: Oh, one other thing. The daeyalt almost seems to have a mind of its own. Only one deposit will be active at a time. You'll need to pay attention to which one it is.
translation: 哦，还有一件事。戴亚特似乎有自己的意志。一次只有一个矿床会激活。你需要注意是哪一个。

english: I see. I'll bear that in mind.
translation: 我明白了。我会记住。

english: Need something?
translation: 需要点什么？

english: Could you convert some shards for me?
translation: 你能帮我转换一些碎片吗？

english: As you wish. I'll give any shards I convert straight to you. How many would you like me to convert?
translation: 如你所愿。我会把任何我转换的碎片直接给你。你想让我转换多少？

english: As you wish. Once I convert these shards, I will send them to your bank. How many would you like me to convert?
translation: 如你所愿。一旦我转换这些碎片，我会把它们送到你的银行。你想让我转换多少？

english: No. You don't have any.
translation: 不。你没有任何碎片。

english: Tell me about daeyalt.
translation: 和我说说戴亚特的事。

english: It comes in two forms, essence and ores. Both have their uses, but the essence is far more powerful.
translation: 它有两种形式，精华和矿石。两者都有用处，但精华强大得多。

english: And it's only found here?
translation: 它只在这里找到吗？

english: Yes. They say that an object of great power was once stored in this very cave. Apparently, the presence of this object created the daeyalt deposits.
translation: 是的。据说一个强大物体曾储存在这个洞穴里。显然，这个物体的存在创造了戴亚特矿床。

english: The main use of daeyalt is as a key component in the vampyrification process. There's other uses though. The essence can be used to create runes, for example.
translation: 戴亚特的主要用途是作为吸血鬼化过程的关键成分。不过还有其他用途。比如精华可以用来制作符石。

english: And I'm allowed to mine it?
translation: 我能开采它吗？

english: Indeed. However, you should know that the daeyalt shards you'll get are useless on their own. They'll need converting into essence to be used. That is a service I can provide.
translation: 确实。不过，你应该知道你得到的戴亚特碎片本身无用。它们需要转换成精华才能使用。那是我能提供的服务。

english: I see. Thanks for the information.
translation: 我明白了。谢谢你的信息。

english: Do you need something else?
translation: 你还需要什么吗？

english: I'm good.
translation: 我没事。

translation: 你不是分配到这个矿的奴隶之一！在我叫守卫前滚回栏里去！

english: Could you convert some shards for me?

english: Tell me about daeyalt.
translation: 和我说说戴亚特的事。

english: I'm good.
translation: 我没事。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Quickly, tell me - is it still there?
translation: 快，告诉我——它还在那吗？

english: Is what still where?
translation: 什么还在哪？

english: The THING, the THING! It was just outside my house! Has it gone away yet? Or is it still lurking out there, waiting for me to go outside?
translation: 那个东西，那个东西！它就在我房子外面！它走了吗？还是仍潜伏在外面，等我出去？

english: I didn't see any THING out there, just a couple of guards. What did it look like?
translation: 我没看到外面有什么东西，只有几个守卫。它长什么样？

english: Ohhhh, it was HORRIBLE! It was an enormous THING, with TEETH and EYES and... and... and THINGS!
translation: 哦，它太可怕了！它是个巨大的东西，有牙齿和眼睛还有……还有……还有东西！

english: Um... would you care to be more specific?
translation: 嗯……你能具体点吗？

english: I can't. I only saw it in the dark.
translation: 我不能。我只在黑暗中看到了它。

english: You only saw this THING in the dark?
translation: 你只在黑暗中看到了这个东西？

english: I was sleeping peacefully one night, when suddenly I woke up and saw it through the window. It was LOOKING at me! I haven't dared go out since then. It's had me trapped in here for days! I've packed my
translation: 一天晚上我正和平睡觉，突然我醒来透过窗户看到了它。它在看我！从那以后我不敢出去。它把我困在这里好几天了！

english: bags so I can escape, but the THING's still out there waiting for me to come out! If I have to stay in here much longer I'll go mad! MAD!! MAD!!!
translation: 我打包了行李以便逃跑，但那个东西仍在外边等我出去！如果我必须在这里待更久我会疯的！疯！！疯！！！

english: There's no THING outside. Just come out and get some fresh air before you go funny in the head.
translation: 外面没什么东西。只需出来呼吸点新鲜空气趁你还没疯。

translation: 大家都去派对室！

english: Greetings, iknami. It's good to see so many who are willing to contribute to the Final Dawn. The word of the Augur has changed everything. The time to act is now.
translation: 你好，iknami。很高兴看到这么多愿意为最终黎明贡献的人。先知的言论改变了一切。行动的时候到了。

english: Augur?
translation: 先知？

english: You have not heard? She is the one who now leads the Emissaries. She has taken this once helpless collective and turned them into the ones who will guide us all to Mokhaiotl.
translation: 你没听说？她是现在领导使者的人。她接管了这个曾经无助的集体并把他们变成将引导我们所有人前往莫凯奥特的人。

english: How do you know all this? You're not even a member yet.
translation: 你怎么知道所有这些？你甚至还不是成员。

english: I was once. In my time of need, I turned to the Emissaries, but they were even more helpless than I was.
translation: 我曾经是。在我需要的时候，我转向使者，但他们甚至比我还无助。

english: Now though, she has changed everything. Now it is my duty to rejoin their ranks so that we may bring about the Final Dawn.
translation: 不过现在，她改变了一切。现在我的责任是重新加入他们的行列以便我们能带来最终黎明。

english: I see. Thanks for the information.
translation: 我明白了。谢谢你的信息。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Hello traveller, how's things?
translation: 你好旅行者，情况怎么样？

english: Not bad thanks, yourself?
translation: 不错谢谢，你呢？

english: I'm good, just working hard as usual...
translation: 我没事，就像往常一样努力工作……

english: I was hoping you might sell me a cannon.
translation: 我希望你可能卖我一个大炮。

english: Hmmmmmm...
I shouldn't really, but as you helped us so much, well, I could sort something out. I'll warn you though, they don't come cheap!
translation: 我真不应该，但既然你帮了我们这么多，嗯，我能搞定点什么。不过我要警告你，它们不便宜！

english: How much?

english: For the full setup, 750,000 coins. Or I can sell you the separate parts... but it'll cost extra!
translation: 全套设置750,000金币。或者我可以卖你单独部件……但会额外收费！

english: That's not cheap!

translation: 好的，请给我一个大炮。

english: Okay then, but keep it quiet... This thing's top secret!
translation: 好吧，但保持安静……这东西是绝密的！

english: You give the Cannon engineer 750,000 coins...
translation: 你给大炮工程师750,000金币……

english: He gives you the four parts that make the cannon, plus an ammo mould and an instruction manual.
translation: 他给你组成大炮的四个部件，加上一个弹药模具和一本说明书。

english: There you go, you be careful with that thing.
translation: 给你，你小心那东西。

english: Will do, take care mate.
translation: 会的小心，保重伙计。

english: Take care adventurer.
translation: 保重冒险者。

english: Oops, I don't have enough money.
translation: 哎呀，我没有足够的钱。

english: Sorry, I can't go any lower than that.
translation: 抱歉，我不能比那更低了。

english: Can I look at the separate parts please?
translation: 我能看看单独部件吗？

english: Of course!
translation: 当然！

english: Sorry, that's too much for me.
translation: 抱歉，那对我来说太多了。

english: Fair enough, it's too much for most of us.
translation: 好吧，对我们大多数人来说都太多了。

english: Have you any ammo or instructions to sell?
translation: 你有什么弹药或说明书卖吗？

english: Well, take care of yourself then.
translation: 嗯，那保重你自己。

english: Indeed I will adventurer.
translation: 确实我会的冒险者。

english: I want to know more about the cannon.
translation: 我想了解更多关于大炮的事。

english: There's only so much I can tell you, adventurer. We've been working on this little beauty for some time now.
translation: 我能告诉你的有限，冒险者。我们研究这个小美人已经一段时间了。

english: Is it effective?
translation: 它有效吗？

english: In short bursts it's very effective, the most destructive weapon to date. The cannon automatically targets monsters close by. You just have to make the ammo and let rip.
translation: 在短促射击中它非常有效，是迄今为止最具破坏性的武器。大炮自动瞄准附近的怪物。你只需制作弹药然后开火。

english: I've lost my cannon.

english: That's unfortunate... but don't worry, I can sort you out.
translation: 那不幸……但别担心，我能帮你搞定。

english: Keep that quiet or I'll be in real trouble!
translation: 保持安静否则我真有麻烦了！

english: Oh dear, I'm only allowed to replace cannons that were stolen in action. I'm sorry, but you'll have to buy a new set.
translation: 哦天哪，我只允许替换在行动中被偷的大炮。抱歉，但你得买一套新的。

translation: 我想了解更多关于大炮的事。

english: I've lost my cannon.
translation: 我丢了大炮。

english: What is it, human? I'm working.
translation: 什么事，人类？我在工作。

english: How do I use the furnace?
translation: 我怎么使用熔炉？

english: Put your ore on the conveyor belt to get it smelted. We'll stoke the boiler and operate the rest of the machinery for you.
translation: 将矿石放在传送带上即可进行冶炼。我们会为你们添锅炉并操作其余机械。

english: You'll have to help repair the furnace whenever a pipe blows, though. Just hit it with a hammer - that usually works.
translation: 不过每当管道爆裂你得帮忙修理熔炉。只需用锤子敲它——那通常有效。

english: You'll have to put money in the coffer to pay for our services. We charge 72,000 coins per hour; money is deducted as long as you're in this room with us.
translation: 你得把钱放进保险箱以支付我们的服务。我们每小时收费72,000金币；只要你和我们一起在这个房间钱就会被扣除。

english: Gosh, you're a remarkably big dwarf.
translation: 天哪，你是个特别大的矮人。

english: My brothers and I have a rare genetic condition affecting our growth. Rather than treating us as freaks, you might like to appreciate how useful it is that we can operate the machinery.
translation: 我和兄弟们有一种影响我们生长的罕见遗传病。与其把我们当怪胎，你可能想欣赏我们能操作机械有多有用。

english: Sorry.
translation: 抱歉。

english: That's ok, human. You're not the first to comment on it. Now, did you need anything? I've got work to do here.
translation: 没事，人类。你不是第一个评论的。现在，你需要什么吗？我这里有工作要做。

english: Are you sure you're really a dwarf?
translation: 你确定你真是个矮人吗？

english: ... look, do you want help with something, or did you just come here to be rude? I've got work to do.
translation: ……听着，你想要帮忙做什么，还是你只是来这里无礼？我有工作要做。

english: I'll let you get on with it.

translation: 嘿，傻鱼鱼带圆头！

translation: 呀！你以为你是什么鱼鱼？

translation: 嗯如果你不是鱼鱼你在这做什么？
