english: Dis fishy is a funny fishy!
translation: 这鱼鱼是个有趣鱼鱼！

english: Whats this fishy wanting?
translation: 这鱼鱼想要什么？

english: You see those big crabs? I want one of those.
translation: 你看到那些大螃蟹了吗？我想要其中一个。

english: You's here to stealin' my big crunchy claws?
translation: 你是来偷我大脆爪的吗？

english: Nung should smash your stoopid round head!
translation: 农格真该砸烂你这蠢圆脑袋！

english: Always the big nettings was taking my big crunchy claws, I put them in the cages, and now you's come to get them.
translation: 总是大网拿走我的大脆爪，我把它们放进笼子里，现在你来拿它们。

english: Swim away little fishy or I eat you till you's dead!
translation: 游走小鱼鱼否则我吃你直到你死！

english: Wait, could I buy some of the crab meat?
translation: 等等，我能买些螃蟹肉吗？

english: Silly round head fishy want to swaps big crunchy claws?
translation: 傻圆头鱼鱼想换大脆爪？

english: Naaah...you no real deal. I bet you no do Nung big favour.
translation: 不……你不是真交易。我打赌你不会做农格大忙。

english: Seriously, I need to get that meat. I'll do your big favour if you want.
translation: 说真的，我需要拿到那个肉。如果你想要我会做你的大忙。

english: Hah! Silly round head fishy! If you get Nung 5 big skippy skins, den maybe Nung thinking you ok.
translation: 哈！傻圆头鱼鱼！如果你给农格5张大跳鱼皮，那也许农格会觉得你还可以。

english: Big skippy skins?
translation: 大跳鱼皮？

english: Ya, da big skippies live over dere.
translation: 是的，大跳鱼住在那边。

english: You need lotsa big big stones to get down dere. Den you kill da big skippies and bring da skins to Nung.
translation: 你需要很多大石头去那边。然后你杀大跳鱼并把皮带给农格。

english: You do dis, den maybe Nung let you swaps da big crunchy claws.
translation: 你做这个，那也许农格让你换大脆爪。

english: Nung, I have your mudskipper hides.
translation: 农格，我有你的弹涂鱼皮。

english: What you say? Has da silly round headed fishy got da big skippy skins?
translation: 你说什么？傻圆头鱼鱼有大跳鱼皮了吗？

english: Sigh...
Yes, I have the big skippy skins.
translation: 是的，我有大跳鱼皮。

english: Silly round head fishy done good!  Gimme!
translation: 傻圆头鱼鱼做得好！给我！

english: Ya, da round head fishy does a good big favour for Nung.
translation: 是的，圆头鱼鱼为农格做了个大忙。

english: I am thinkin you's ok enough to swaps the giant crunchy claws now.
translation: 我想你现在 ok enough 换巨型脆爪了。

english: Great! How much do you want for them?
translation: 太好了！你想要多少换它们？

english: You's gotta get me somefing to make dese hides to a cloak and flippers and hat, den I lets you have all the big crunchy claws you can get.
translation: 你得给我弄点东西，把这些皮做成斗篷、脚蹼和帽子，那我就让你随便拿大脆爪。

english: But it not be easy
translation: 但这不容易

english: Well I'll do it. What do I need? An item of ancient power? Something from the deepest, darkest dungeon in the world?
translation: 嗯我会做。我需要什么？一个古代力量物品？来自世界最深最暗地牢的东西？

english: What sort of monsters will I need to fight? I'd best grab myself some potions too.
translation: 我需要打什么类型的怪物？我最好也给自己拿些药水。

english: Will there be traps? Should I bring cakes?
translation: 会有陷阱吗？我应该带蛋糕吗？

english: Ya, it real dangerous for a fishy.
translation: 是的，对鱼鱼真危险。

english: You's gotta go up to da topsies, and your gotta get a needly-thing and some wirey stuff.
translation: 你得去上面，你得拿个针状东西和一些线状东西。

english: A needle.
translation: 一根针。

english: Ya.
translation: 是的。

english: And bronze wire.
translation: 还有青铜线。

english: Ya. Tree wirey stuffs.
translation: 是的。三卷线状东西。

english: So, all I have to do is bring you three rolls of bronze wire and a needle, and I can have all the Giant Crabs I can kill?
translation: 所以，我只需带给你三卷青铜线和一根针，我就能拥有所有我能杀的巨型螃蟹？

english: Ya, but be a sneaky round head fishy. Da topsies has not water for a little fishy like you to breathing.
translation: 是的，但做个狡猾圆头鱼鱼。上面没有水给像你这样小鱼鱼呼吸。

english: It REAL dangerous.
translation: 真危险。

english: Yeah, sounds it.
translation: 是的，听起来是。

english: Nung, I have the needle and wire.
translation: 农格，我有针和线。

english: Nung thinks this is a useful fishy he finds. Gimme!
translation: 农格想这是他找到的有用鱼鱼。给我！

english: Nung have all da wiry stuff and needly things he needs to make da biggestest skippy skin hat ever!
translation: 农格有了所有需要的线和针，能做出史上最大的跳鱼皮帽子啦！

english: You's a good little fishy, you eat as many big crunchy claws as you want.
translation: 你是个好小鱼鱼，你想吃多少大脆爪就吃多少。

english: Maybe you get big and strong like Nung!
translation: 也许你变得像农格一样大和强！

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！

english: Greetings and welcome to my pickaxe shop. Do you want to buy my premium quality pickaxes?
translation: 问候并欢迎来到我的镐店。你想买我的优质镐吗？

english: No, thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Are your pickaxes better than other pickaxes, then?
translation: 那么你的镐比其他镐好吗？

english: Of course they are! My pickaxes are made of higher grade metal than your ordinary bronze pickaxes, allowing you to mine that ore just a little bit faster than normal.
translation: 当然是！我的镐由比普通青铜镐更高等级的金属制成，让你采矿速度比正常快一点点。

english: Hi Nurmof, I found this earlier...
translation: 嗨努莫夫，我 earlier found 这个……

english: Oh, a dragon pickaxe! And a broken one at that. I haven't seen one of those in a while.
translation: 哦，一把龙镐！而且是坏的。我有一阵子没见到那种了。

english: Can you fix it for me? I was told you're the dwarf to see!
translation: 你能帮我修吗？我被告知你是要找的矮人！

english: I did indeed fix pickaxes in the past, many years ago. They were a lot more common back then.
translation: 我过去确实修镐，很多年前。那时它们更常见。

english: In fact, this is the first broken pickaxe I've seen in a very long time!
translation: 事实上，这是我很久以来见到的第一把坏镐！

english: Why were there so many broken pickaxes back then?
translation: 为什么那时那么多坏镐？

english: Ore rocks used to be quite unstable. They would randomly explode when you were mining them.
translation: 矿石岩石过去很不稳定。当你开采它们时会随机爆炸。

english: That sounds terrifying!
translation: 那听起来太可怕了！

english: It was. But then one day, the explosions just... stopped. As if someone flipped an off switch somewhere.
translation: 确实是。但后来有一天，爆炸只是……停止了。好像有人在某处关了开关。

english: I've not seen a broken pickaxe since then!
translation: 从那以后我没见过坏镐！

english: Will you still be able to fix mine for me?
translation: 你仍能帮我修我的吗？

english: I should think so. I'll need to buy some new tools.
translation: 我想能。我需要买些新工具。

english: They're quite expensive, but they will get the job done. The pickaxe will be as good as new when I've finished with it.
translation: 它们很贵，但能完成工作。当我修完镐会像新的一样。

english: The cost will be about...
translation: 费用大约是……

english: ...let me see. I need another one of these, and I can reuse that if I replace the drill bit from there...
translation: ……让我看看。我需要另一个这个，如果我从那替换钻头我可以重用那个……

english: ...hmm, and this needs a full clean, oh and I don't have one of those anymore...
translation: ……嗯，这个需要彻底清洁，哦我没有那个了……

english: ...okay! It'll cost about 2,500,000 GP, give or take a few coins. Would you like me to fix it for you?
translation: ……好的！大约花费2,500,000金币，上下几枚硬币。你想让我帮你修吗？

english: Yes, let's do it.
translation: 是的，我们走吧。

english: Lovely! Okay, give me a moment. It may take a little while, it's a tough metal to work with.
translation: 太好了！好的，给我一会。可能需要一点时间，那是个难加工的金属。

english: Nurmof goes into a nearby hidden room, and from within, you hear the sound of a hammer striking metal.
translation: 努莫夫走进附近一个隐藏房间，从里面，你听到锤子敲击金属的声音。

english: ..he did say it would take a little while.
translation: ……他确实说需要一点时间。

english: There you go, good as new, just like I said!
translation: 给你，像新的一样，就像我说的！

english: Thank you very much. I'll take good care of it.
translation: 非常感谢。我会好好保管。

english: Oh, I actually don't have enough coins on me! I'll come back with more.
translation: 哦，其实我身上没有足够的金币！我会带更多回来。

english: I'll be here!
translation: 我会在这里！

english: That's rather expensive...
translation: 那相当贵……

english: It is! But you can't cheap out on quality. If a job's worth doing, do it well.
translation: 确实是！但你不能在质量上省钱。如果工作值得做，就做好。

english: I'm also the only one who can repair pickaxes these days, so you don't really have much choice!
translation: 而且我也是现在唯一能修镐的人，所以你其实没太多选择！

english: Okay then, let's do it.
translation: 好吧，那我们走吧。

english: I'll think about it.
translation: 我会考虑。

english: Yes, please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No, thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Are your pickaxes better than other pickaxes, then?
translation: 那么你的镐比其他镐好吗？

english: Yes, let's do it.
translation: 是的，我们走吧。

english: That's rather expensive...
translation: 那相当贵……

english: Okay then, let's do it.
translation: 好吧，那我们走吧。

english: I'll think about it.
translation: 我会考虑。

english: Patients, patients everywhere! We need to get these soldiers up and fighting again!
translation: 病人，到处都是病人！我们需要让这些士兵起来再次战斗！

english: I don't have time to chat, I have patients to attend to.
translation: 我没时间聊天，我有病人要照顾。

english: I can't take much more of this. As soon as we help one patient, another comes in!
translation: 我受不了了。只要我们帮助一个病人，另一个就来了！

english: Patients, patients everywhere! We need all the help we can get to get these soldiers up and fighting again. Can you help us?
translation: 病人，到处都是病人！我们需要所有能得到的帮助让这些士兵起来再次战斗。你能帮我们吗？

english: Sure, what do you need me to do?
translation: 当然，你需要我做什么？

english: Firstly, you're going to need to gather some medpacks. There should be plenty of boxes around here with some in.
translation: 首先，你需要收集一些医疗包。周围应该有很多箱子里面有。

english: After you've got some, we have several tents full of soldiers who've been hurt in the battle against the lizardmen.
translation: 在你拿到一些后，我们有几个帐篷满是战斗中受伤的士兵对抗蜥蜴人。

english: Good, you have already found some medpacks. Now, we have several tents full of soldiers who've been hurt in the battle against the lizardmen.
translation: 好，你已经找到一些医疗包了。现在，我们有几个帐篷满是战斗中受伤的士兵对抗蜥蜴人。

english: If you could help them out with those medpacks, that would be a massive help.
translation: 如果你能用那些医疗包帮助他们，那将是巨大帮助。

english: The people of Shayzien will thank you.
translation: 谢兹恩城人民会感谢你。

english: Thank you, I will get right to it.
translation: 谢谢，我马上做。

english: No, I'm sorry but I've got better things to be doing.
translation: 不，抱歉但我有更好的事要做。

english: Sure, what do you need me to do?
translation: 当然，你需要我做什么？

english: No, I'm sorry but I've got better things to be doing.
translation: 不，抱歉但我有更好的事要做。

english: Patients, patients everywhere! We need to get these soldiers up and fighting again!
translation: 病人，到处都是病人！我们需要让这些士兵起来再次战斗！

english: I don't have time to chat, I have patients to attend to.
translation: 我没时间聊天，我有病人要照顾。

english: I can't take much more of this. As soon as we help one patient, another comes in!
translation: 我受不了了。只要我们帮助一个病人，另一个就来了！

english: I hope we can stop the lizardmen, I can't take much more of this. As soon as we help one patient, another comes in.
translation: 我希望我们能阻止蜥蜴人，我受不了了。只要我们帮助一个病人，另一个就来了。

english: Argh! Where are the bandages? I've got to get on with my job, please leave me be.
translation: 啊！绷带在哪？我得继续我的工作，请别烦我。

english: Either help out or get out of the way!
translation: 要么帮忙要么让开！

english: Hello nurse.
translation: 你好护士。

english: I don't know how much longer I can cope here.
translation: 我不知道我在这里还能撑多久。

english: What? Is the plague getting to you?
translation: 什么？瘟疫影响到你了吗？

english: No, strangely enough the people here don't seem to be affected. It's just the awful living conditions that is making people ill.
translation: 不，奇怪的是这里的人似乎没受影响。只是糟糕的生活条件让人生病。

english: I was under the impression that everyone here was affected.
translation: 我以为这里每个人都受影响。

english: Me too, but that doesn't seem to be the case.
translation: 我也是，但似乎不是那样。

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好啊。

english: Hello my dear, how are you feeling?
translation: 你好亲爱的，感觉怎么样？

english: I'm okay thanks.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

english: Well in that case I'd better get back to work. Take care.
translation: 那我还是回去工作吧。保重。

english: You too.
translation: 你也是。

english: Patients, patients everywhere! We need to get these soldiers up and fighting again!
translation: 病人，到处都是病人！我们得让这些士兵重新站起来战斗！

english: I don't have time to chat, I have patients to attend to.
translation: 我没时间聊天，我得照顾病人。

english: I can't take much more of this. As soon as we help one patient, another comes in!
translation: 我快撑不住了。刚治好一个病人，另一个又来了！

english: Please help me with this!
translation: 请帮帮我！

english: Well done!
translation: 干得好！

english: You've been given a [new clue/casket]!
translation: 你获得了一个[新线索/箱子]！

english: I hope we can stop the lizardmen, I can't take much more of this. As soon as we help one patient, another comes in.
translation: 希望我们能阻止蜥蜴人，我快撑不住了。刚治好一个病人，另一个又来了。

english: Argh! Where are the bandages? I've got to get on with my job, please leave me be.
translation: 啊！绷带在哪？我得继续干活，请别打扰我。

english: Either help out or get out of the way!
translation: 要么帮忙，要么让开！

english: Hmph!
translation: 哼！

english: Oh, hello. Who are you?
translation: 哦，你好。你是谁？

english: Olga.
translation: 奥尔加。

english: What brings you out here?
translation: 什么风把你吹来了？

english: Werewolf? No werewolves here, pup.
translation: 狼人？这儿可没有狼人，小家伙。

english: Okay... I never mentioned werewolves though...
translation: 好吧……可我从来没提过狼人啊……

english: Oh... Well, I was hoping to join a new crew, but I had no luck at Phasmatys. The ghosts there didn't seem to like me much... I thought maybe someone here would have a boat instead, but it seems not.
translation: 哦……嗯，我本来希望能加入新船员队伍，但在法斯马提斯没运气。那里的鬼魂似乎不太喜欢我……我想也许这里有人会有船，但看来没有。

english: Well, I suppose it's not much of a bustling port. Still, I hope you find a crew soon.
translation: 嗯，我想这里也不算什么繁华港口。不过，希望你早日找到船员队伍。

english: Well, at some point I hope to hire a crew to sail with myself. I don't think I'm ready for that kind of thing yet though.
translation: 嗯，有朝一日我希望能雇佣一支船员队伍和我一起航行。不过我觉得我还没准备好做那种事。

english: Right... Not very helpful to me then, are you?
translation: 好吧……那你对我也没什么帮助咯？

english: You need a Sailing level of 40 to manage a crew.
translation: 你需要40级航海技能才能管理船员队伍。

english: Maybe you'd like to join my crew?
translation: 也许你想加入我的船员队伍？

english: I don't think so. You're not fit to lead a pack.
translation: 我想不必了。你不适合领导一群船员。

english: You require the following to recruit this crew member: Level 65 Sailing. Gained access to Burgh de Rott.
translation: 招募这名船员需要以下条件：65级航海技能。已进入罗特堡。

english: Hmm... Okay, I'll join your pack, but don't make me regret it.
translation: 嗯……好吧，我加入你的队伍，但别让我后悔。

english: You recruit Oarswoman Olga as a crew member. She heads off in search of your boat.
translation: 你招募了划船手奥尔加作为船员。她出发去寻找你的船了。

english: You recruit Oarswoman Olga as a crew member. She departs for the Pandemonium.
translation: 你招募了划船手奥尔加作为船员。她启程前往潘德莫尼姆号。

english: You have recruited Oarswoman Olga as a crew member.
translation: 你已招募划船手奥尔加作为船员。

english: Well, I hope you find a new crew soon.
translation: 嗯，希望你早日找到新船员队伍。

english: Oh, hello. Still here then?
translation: 哦，你好。还在这儿呢？

english: Yes, still trying to find a new crew.
translation: 是的，还在努力找新船员队伍。

english: Hey there. How are you doing?
translation: 嘿。过得怎么样？

english: Fine.
translation: 还行。

english: You sure you're not feeling any stronger than that?
translation: 你确定没感觉比那更好点？

english: No.
translation: 没有。

english: Fair enough.
translation: 好吧。

english: Maybe you'd like to join my crew?
translation: 也许你想加入我的船员队伍？

english: Well, I hope you find a new crew soon.
translation: 嗯，希望你早日找到新船员队伍。

english: Good day, adventurer.
translation: 你好，冒险者。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: I am Lord D'rows, leader of the Oathbreakers. Yourself?
translation: 我是德罗斯领主，誓约破碎者的领袖。你呢？

english: I'm [player name]. That sounds pretty important.
translation: 我是 [player name]。听起来挺重要的。

english: It is a job I do not take lightly.
translation: 这份职责我可不敢轻视。

english: So what's this oath that you're all so proud of breaking?
translation: 那你们如此自豪地打破的誓约是什么？

english: Pride? There is no pride in what we've done.
translation: 自豪？我们所做的事没什么可自豪的。

english: Which was?
translation: 那是什么？

english: We Oathbreakers were all once monks of Saradomin but have since seen that his light is false. The founder of this sanctuary had a similar story and that is why we follow in her footsteps.
translation: 我们誓约破碎者都曾是萨拉多明的僧侣，但后来发现他的光辉是虚假的。这座圣所的创始人也有类似的经历，这就是为什么我们追随她的脚步。

english: What caused your faith in Saradomin to wane?
translation: 是什么让你对萨拉多明的信仰动摇了？

english: How can order and wisdom prevail in a land where chaos and destruction reign supreme? That, and a few too many muggings during my travels. If you can't beat them, become them.
translation: 在一个混乱与毁灭肆虐的土地上，秩序与智慧如何能够取胜？再加上我旅途中遇到的无数次抢劫。打不过他们，就加入他们。

english: I see.
translation: 我明白了。

english: Was there anything else?
translation: 还有别的吗？

english: Why are you here?
translation: 你们为什么在这里？

english: We've been keeping an eye on Slepe lately. We could sense a darkness building as the citizens fell into their endless slumber.
translation: 我们最近一直在监视斯莱普。我们能感觉到随着市民陷入无尽沉睡，黑暗正在积聚。

english: Once we'd heard that the sanctuary had been broken into, we came here posthaste.
translation: 一听说圣所被闯入，我们就火速赶来了。

english: Broken into?
translation: 被闯入？

english: Indeed. This place was sealed, only to be reopened once Mother had awoken from her deep sleep.
translation: 确实。这个地方曾被封印，只有在母亲从沉睡中醒来后才会重新开启。

english: This nightmarish creature that the siren warned us of has made a home here. That was reason enough for her to unseal the entrance.
translation: 那位海妖警告过我们的梦魇生物在这里安了家。这足以让她解封入口。

english: Oh, um, whose mother? Yours?
translation: 哦，嗯，谁的母亲？你的？

english: Oh, not my actual mother, you fool. Phosani, the founder of this sanctuary went by the title of 'Mother' while her followers adopted the title of 'Sister'. I'm sure you've seen them around.
translation: 哦，不是我亲妈，你这个蠢货。福萨尼，这座圣所的创始人，称号是''母亲''，而她的追随者则采用''姐妹''的称号。我相信你见过她们。

english: I have. I suspect you're quite bothered about the sudden influx of visitors?
translation: 我见过。我猜你对突然涌入的访客相当困扰吧？

english: Well, yes, but that fish woman claims every warrior is needed to defeat the Nightmare and that everyone asleep here is at risk.
translation: 嗯，是的，但那个鱼女人声称需要每位战士来击败梦魇，而且这里每个沉睡的人都处于危险之中。

english: We must be strong, adventurer. Be strong for Mother.
translation: 我们必须坚强，冒险者。为了母亲而坚强。

english: Okay... Does this creature have treasure? That's kind of a sticking point for me.
translation: 好吧……这生物有宝藏吗？这对我来说是个关键点。

english: Treasure? This sanctuary is full of old trinkets which the hag has claimed as her own. Kill her and take them, as is the Zamorakian way.
translation: 宝藏？这座圣所到处都是老古董，那巫婆把它们都据为己有了。杀了她拿走它们，这是扎莫拉克的方式。

english: Oh yes, the iron price. My specialty.
translation: 哦对，铁价。我的专长。

english: Your friends are a quiet bunch.
translation: 你的朋友们挺安静的。

english: They took a vow of silence. I speak for them.
translation: 他们立下了沉默誓言。我替他们说话。

english: Oh, how come?
translation: 哦，为什么？

english: It is the way. When I fall, one of them will take my place as the Oath Lord.
translation: 这是规矩。当我倒下时，他们中的一人会接替我成为誓约领主。

english: No disagreements, that must be nice.
translation: 没有分歧，那一定很好。

english: I never claimed that they can't communicate. They know a rudimentary hand-talk to vent their frustrations with my leadership. Making decisions is easier when no one can shout at you.
translation: 我可没说他们不能交流。他们懂一种基本的手语来发泄对我领导的不满。当没人能对你大喊大叫时，做决定就容易多了。

english: Huh, I can imagine.
translation: 哈，我能想象。

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！

translation: 保持坚强，冒险者。

translation: 再见！

translation: 你好！

translation: 你好！

translation: 他们似乎不愿意说话。

english: Welcome to Obli's General Store Bwana! Would you like to see my items?
translation: 欢迎来到奥布利的杂货店，先生！想看看我的商品吗？

english: Yes please!
translation: 好的，谢谢！

english: No, but thanks for the offer.
translation: 不了，不过谢谢你的提议。

english: I'm getting out of here Bwana, the place is infested with zombies.
translation: 我要离开这里了，先生，这地方到处都是僵尸。

english: Yes please!
translation: 好的，谢谢！

english: No, but thanks for the offer.
translation: 不了，不过谢谢你的提议。

english: Hi, are you busy?
translation: 嗨，你忙吗？

english: Me? I'm always busy.
translation: 我？我一直都很忙。

english: See that man there? That's the professor. If he had his way, I think he'd never let me sleep!
translation: 看到那边那个人了吗？那是教授。要是按他的意思，我想他永远不会让我睡觉！

english: Anyway, how might I help you?
translation: 不管怎样，有什么能帮你的？

english: I was wondering what you do here.
translation: 我想知道你在这里做什么。

english: Glad you ask. This is the Observatory reception.
translation: 很高兴你问。这里是天文台接待处。

english: Up on the cliff is the Observatory dome, from which you can view the heavens.
translation: 悬崖上方是天文台圆顶，从那里你可以观测天空。

english: Usually...
translation: 通常来说……

english: What do you mean, 'usually'?
translation: 你说的''通常来说''是什么意思？

english: *Ahem*. Back to work, please.
translation: 咳咳。请回去工作。

english: I'd speak with the professor. He'll explain.
translation: 你去和教授谈谈。他会解释的。

english: What's that board for?
translation: 那块板子是做什么用的？

english: The one behind me? We use it to keep track of fallen stars and those that find them.
translation: 我身后那块？我们用它来记录坠落的星星以及发现它们的人。

english: Fallen stars?
translation: 坠落的星星？

english: That's right. From time to time, stars fall from the sky and land somewhere in Gielinor.
translation: 没错。时不时会有星星从天空坠落，落在基利诺尔的某个地方。

english: Whenever one does, we make a note on the board. If someone finds it, we note their name as well.
translation: 每当有星星坠落，我们都会在板上记录。如果有人找到它，我们也会记下他们的名字。

english: I see. And how do people find them?
translation: 我明白了。那人们是怎么找到它们的？

english: There's a lot of amateur astronomers out there. Many of them have small telescopes in their homes. They use them to work out when a star is going to fall.
translation: 外面有很多业余天文学家。他们中很多人在家里都有小型望远镜。他们用望远镜来计算星星何时会坠落。

english: Could I do that?
translation: 我能做吗？

english: I imagine so. Just get yourself a telescope and look out for stars.
translation: 我想可以。弄个望远镜，留意星星就行了。

english: Awesome. I might just give it a go.
translation: 太棒了。我可能会试试。

english: Good luck. If you're interested, I hear there's a dwarf at the Mining Guild who's keen on gathering stardust. If you find some, he might be willing to trade with you.
translation: 祝你好运。如果你感兴趣，我听说采矿公会有个矮人热衷于收集星尘。如果你找到一些，他可能愿意和你交易。

english: Good to know. Thanks.
translation: 知道了。谢谢。

english: Oh yes. I've seen one of those before.
translation: 哦对。我以前见过那种东西。

english: You're very lucky. They are quite rare. Anyway, whenever one falls, we make a note on the board. If someone finds it, we note their name as well.
translation: 你很幸运。它们相当稀有。不管怎样，每当有星星坠落，我们都会在板上记录。如果有人找到它，我们也会记下他们的名字。

english: I'd better be off.
translation: 我该走了。

english: Just looking around, thanks.
translation: 随便看看，谢谢。

english: Okay, just don't break anything. If you need any help, let me know.
translation: 好的，别弄坏任何东西就行。如果需要帮助，告诉我。

english: Can I have a look through that telescope?
translation: 我能用那个望远镜看看吗？

english: You can. You won't see much though.
translation: 可以。不过你不会看到什么。

english: And that's because?
translation: 那是因为？

english: Just talk to the professor. He'll fill you in.
translation: 去和教授谈谈。他会告诉你的。

english: Hi assistant.
translation: 嗨，助手。

english: Wait a minute, what's your real name?
translation: 等一下，你的真名是什么？

english: My real name?
translation: 我的真名？

english: I only know you as the professor's assistant. What's your actual name?
translation: 我只知道你是教授的助手。你的真名是什么？

english: Patrick.
translation: 帕特里克。

english: Hi, Patrick, I'm [player name].
translation: 嗨，帕特里克，我是 [player name]。

english: Well, hello again, and thanks for helping out the professor.
translation: 嗯，又见面了，谢谢你帮助教授。

english: Oh, and, believe it or not, his name is Mambo-duna- roona, but don't tell him I told you.
translation: 哦，还有，信不信由你，他的名字是曼博 - 杜纳 - 鲁纳，但别告诉他是你说的。

english: You made that up!
translation: 你编的！

english: No, honest! Anyways, you've made my life much easier. Have a drink on me!
translation: 不，真的！不管怎样，你让我的生活轻松多了。我请你喝一杯！

english: Thanks very much.
translation: 非常感谢。

english: No problem. Scorpius would be proud.
translation: 没问题。斯科皮乌斯会感到骄傲的。

english: Sorry?
translation: 抱歉？

english: You may want to check out the book on the table, and perhaps look around for a grave...
translation: 你可能想看看桌上的书，也许再找找坟墓……

english: Oh, sorry, I can't carry anything else.
translation: 哦，抱歉，我拿不了更多东西了。

english: Well, then, please come back when you do.
translation: 那好吧，等你有空再来。

english: How was the wine?
translation: 酒怎么样？

english: That was good stuff, *hic*! Wheresh the professher?
translation: 那是好东西，嗝！教……教授在哪？

english: The professor? He's up in the Observatory. Since the bridge was ruined, you will have to travel through the dungeon under the goblins' settlement.
translation: 教授？他在天文台上面。自从桥被毁坏后，你得穿过哥布林定居点下方的地牢。

english: That was good stuff! Where's the professor?
translation: 那是好东西！教授在哪？

english: Look what I have.
translation: 看看我有什么。

english: Good for you. As much as I want to admire your possessions, I do have work to do.
translation: 为你高兴。虽然我很想欣赏你的藏品，但我还有工作要做。

english: Oh, right. Sorry.
translation: 哦，对。抱歉。

english: What do you think of this?
translation: 你觉得这个怎么样？

english: I'd rather you show me the actual item, as opposed to the note form.
translation: 我宁愿你给我看实际物品，而不是纸条形式。

translation: 我想知道你在这里做什么。

translation: 我能用那个望远镜看看吗？

english: I'd better be off.
translation: 我该走了。

translation: 随便看看，谢谢。

translation: 等一下，你的真名是什么？

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Hi, I was...
translation: 嗨，我本来……

english: Welcome to the magnificent wonder of the Observatory, where wonder is all around you, where the stars can be clutched from the heavens!
translation: 欢迎来到天文台这一宏伟奇观，这里奇迹环绕，星星仿佛触手可及！

english: Wow, nice intro.
translation: 哇，开场白不错。

english: Why, thanks! How might I help you?
translation: 哎呀，谢谢！有什么能帮你的？

english: Lost? It must have been those pesky goblins that led you astray.
translation: 迷路了？肯定是那些讨厌的哥布林把你带偏了。

english: Head north-east to find the city of Ardougne.
translation: 往东北走就能找到阿多尼城。

english: I'm sure I'll find the way.
translation: 我相信我能找到路。

english: Thanks for all your help.
translation: 谢谢你的所有帮助。

english: No problem at all. Come and visit again!
translation: 完全没问题。欢迎再来！

english: The professor carries on with his studies.
translation: 教授继续他的研究。

english: An Observatory?
translation: 天文台？

english: Of course. We have a superb telescope up in the Observatory, on the hill.
translation: 当然。我们在山上的天文台有一台极好的望远镜。

english: A truly marvellous invention, the likes of which you'll never behold again.
translation: 这真是了不起的发明，你再也见不到类似的东西了。

english: Well, it would be if it worked.
translation: 嗯，如果它能用的话确实是。

english: Don't interrupt!
translation: 别打断！

english: What? It doesn't work?
translation: 什么？它不能用？

english: Oh, no, no, no. Don't listen to him, he's joking. Aren't you, my FAITHFUL assistant?
translation: 不不不，别听他的，他在开玩笑呢。对吧，我忠实的助手？

english: Nope, dead serious. Hasn't been working for a long time.
translation: 不，我是认真的。已经很久不能用了。

english: Arghhh! Get back to work and stop sticking your nose in!
translation: 啊啊啊！回去工作，别多管闲事！

english: So, it's broken. How come?
translation: 所以，它坏了。怎么回事？

english: Oh, I suppose there's no use keeping it secret. Did you see those houses outside?
translation: 哦，我想保密也没用了。你看到外面的那些房子了吗？

english: Up on the hill? Yes, I've seen them.
translation: 山上的？是的，我见过。

english: It's a horde of goblins.
translation: 那是一群哥布林。

english: Since they moved here they have caused nothing but trouble.
translation: 自从他们搬到这里，就只会惹麻烦。

english: Last week, my telescope was tampered with.
translation: 上周，我的望远镜被人动过手脚。

english: Now, parts need replacing before it can be used again. They've even been messing around in the dungeons under this area. Something needs to be done.
translation: 现在需要更换零件才能再次使用。他们甚至在这个区域下方的地牢里捣乱。得做点什么。

english: Strikes me that this visitor could help us.
translation: 我觉得这位访客可以帮我们。

english: Stop being so rude.
translation: 别这么无礼。

english: Although, he has a point. What do you say?
translation: 不过，他说得有道理。你怎么看？

english: What, me?
translation: 什么，我？

english: Sounds interesting, what can I do for you?
translation: 听起来很有趣，我能帮你们什么？

english: Oh, thanks so much.
translation: 哦，太感谢了。

english: I shall need some materials for the telescope, so it can be used again.
translation: 我需要一些材料来修理望远镜，这样才能再次使用。

english: Let's start with three planks of wood for the telescope base. My assistant will help with obtaining these, won't you?
translation: 先从三块木板开始，用于望远镜底座。我的助手会帮忙获取这些，对吧？

english: As if I don't have enough work to do. Seems I don't have a choice.
translation: 好像我的工作还不够多似的。看来我没得选。

english: Go talk to him if you need some advice.
translation: 如果需要建议，去和他谈谈。

english: Okay, I'll be right back.
translation: 好的，我马上回来。

english: Oh, sorry, I don't have time for that.
translation: 哦，抱歉，我没时间做那个。

english: Oh dear. I really do need some help.
translation: 哦天哪。我真的需要帮助。

english: If you see anyone who can help then please send them my way.
translation: 如果你看到能帮忙的人，请让他们来找我。

english: I'm just passing through.
translation: 我只是路过。

english: Fair enough. Not everyone is interested in this place, I suppose.
translation: 好吧。我想不是每个人都对这里感兴趣。

english: Welcome back! How can I help you today?
translation: 欢迎回来！今天有什么能帮你的？

english: Can you teach me to solve treasure trail clues?
translation: 你能教我怎么解寻宝线索吗？

english: Ah, I get asked about treasure trails all the time! Listen carefully and I shall tell you what I know...
translation: 啊，总是有人问我关于寻宝线索的事！仔细听，我告诉你我知道的……

english: Lots of clues havedegreesandminuteswritten on them. These are the coordinates of the place where the treasure is buried.
translation: 很多线索上写有度数和分。这些是宝藏埋藏地点的坐标。

english: You have to walk to the correct spot, so that your coordinates are exactly the same as the values written on the clue scroll.
translation: 你得走到正确的位置，让你的坐标和线索卷轴上的数值完全对上。

english: To do this, you must use asextant, awatchand achartto find your own coordinates.
translation: 要做到这一点，你必须使用六分仪、怀表和图表来找到自己的坐标。

english: Once you know the coordinates of the place where you are, you know which way you have to walk to get to the place where the treasure is!
translation: 一旦你知道自己当前位置的坐标，就知道该往哪走才能找到宝藏了！

english: Riiight. So where do I get those items from?
translation: 好吧。那我从哪里得到那些物品？

english: I think Murphy, the owner of the fishing trawler moored south of Ardougne, might be able to spare you a sextant. Then the nearest Clock Tower is south of Ardougne - you could probably get a watch there. I've
translation: 我想墨菲——那个把捕鱼拖网船停在阿多尼城南边的船主——说不定能给你一个六分仪。然后最近的钟楼在阿多尼城南面——你可能在那里得到怀表。我

english: got plenty of charts myself, here have one.
translation: 我自己有很多图表，给你一张。

english: Thanks, I'll see you later.
translation: 谢谢，回头见。

english: You don't have enough space for the chart. Come back to me when you do.
translation: 你没有足够的空间放图表。有了空间再来找我。

english: Um... Are you sure? I think you've got one stored somewhere.
translation: 嗯……你确定吗？我觉得你 somewhere 存了一张。

english: I've lost my chart.
translation: 我的图表丢了。

english: That's not a problem, I've got lots of copies.
translation: 那不是问题，我有很多副本。

english: Certainly. It's not difficult.
translation: 当然。不难。

english: Welcome back.
translation: 欢迎回来。

english: Thanks for all your help with the telescope. What can I do for you?
translation: 谢谢你帮忙修理望远镜。有什么能帮你的？

english: Not right now,
translation: 现在不用，

english: but the stars may hold a secret for you.
translation: 但星星可能为你隐藏着秘密。

translation: 你的真名是曼博 - 杜纳 - 鲁纳吗？

english: How do you know tha-
translation: 你怎么知道那——

english: I mean, of course not, what a silly idea.
translation: 我是说，当然不是，多傻的想法。

english: Nothing, thanks.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。

english: Okay, no problem. See you again.
translation: 好的，没问题。再见。

english: What do you see now?
translation: 你现在看到什么？

english: I can see a constellation through the telescope. It looks like Scorpio.
translation: 我透过望远镜能看到一个星座。看起来像天蝎座。

english: Scorpio? Interesting. How very fitting.
translation: 天蝎座？有趣。非常合适。

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你什么意思？

english: Scorpius, the founder of all we know relating to astronomy. There's a book about him in the reception. Perhaps you should check it out, you might learn something.
translation: 斯科皮乌斯，我们所知的天文学知识都源自于他。接待处有本关于他的书。也许你应该去看看，可能会学到点什么。

english: Then perhaps I shall.
translation: 那我可能去看看。

english: What do you think of this!
translation: 你觉得这个怎么样！

english: Wonderful. You must be very proud to have it.
translation: 太棒了。拥有它你一定很自豪。

english: What do you think of this?
translation: 你觉得这个怎么样？

english: I'd rather you show me the actual item, as opposed to the note form.
translation: 我宁愿你给我看实际物品，而不是纸条形式。

english: Talk about the Observatory quest.
translation: 谈谈天文台任务。

english: I'm totally lost.
translation: 我完全迷路了。

english: An Observatory?
translation: 天文台？

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: No.
translation: 不是。

english: I'm just passing through.
translation: 我只是路过。

english: Talk about Treasure Trails.
translation: 谈谈寻宝线索。

english: I've lost my chart.
translation: 我的图表丢了。

english: How do these work again?
translation: 这些是怎么运作的？

english: Do you need any more help with the telescope?
translation: 你还需要帮忙修理望远镜吗？

english: Is it true your name is Mambo-duna-roona?
translation: 你的真名是曼博 - 杜纳 - 鲁纳吗？

english: Nothing, thanks.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。

english: Hello. Do you need any help?
translation: 你好。需要帮忙吗？

english: Just soaking up the thirst of the land, man.
translation: 只是在吸收土地的渴望，伙计。

english: Is that a no?
translation: 那是拒绝吗？

english: Let me show you what I mean.
translation: 让我展示给你看我的意思。

english: The Ocean Man approaches the player's boat.
translation: 海洋人走近玩家的船。

english: Give me your hand.
translation: 把手给我。

english: I don't understand.
translation: 我不明白。

english: I once met a cyclops who sold some wonderful hand-made souvenirs.
translation: 我曾经遇到过一个独眼巨人，他卖一些很棒的手工纪念品。

english: That sounds lovely.
translation: 听起来不错。

english: Nice boat.
translation: 船不错。

english: It is, isn't it?
translation: 确实是，对吧？

english: The gang's all here.
translation: 大伙都在这儿了。

english: I can't stick around all day, I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕我不能整天待在这里。

english: A holiday is better if you bring a couple of goofy friends along.
translation: 如果带上几个傻朋友，假期会更美好。

english: Let's party 'til we're purple.
translation: 让我们狂欢到变紫。
