english: The trolls took my baby son!
translation: 食人魔抓走了我的小儿子！

english: Welcome to Burthorpe!
translation: 欢迎来到伯索普公国！

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！

english: Trolls!
translation: 食人魔！

english: Hello stranger.
translation: 你好陌生人。

english: Go away!
translation: 走开！

english: Run!
translation: 快跑！

english: Hi!
translation: 嗨！

english: The Imperial Guard can no longer protect us!
translation: 帝国卫队再也保护不了我们了！

english: The White Knights will soon have control!
translation: 白骑士很快就会掌控局面！

english: I heard about what you did, thank you!
translation: 我听说了你做的事，谢谢你！

english: The White Knights are still going to take over.
translation: 白骑士仍然会接管。

english: I hear the Imperial Guard are preparing an attack!
translation: 我听说帝国卫队正在准备进攻！

english: Thank you so much!
translation: 太感谢你了！

english: Surely we are safe now!
translation: 我们现在肯定安全了！

english: Have you ever wondered what sort of a tree leaves a stump this large?
translation: 你有没有想过什么样的树会留下这么大的树桩？

english: What if it was an ancient ent that grew too big? Can you imagine that walking around?
translation: 如果是一棵长得太大的古恩特树呢？你能想象它到处走动吗？

english: Imagine...
translation: 想象一下……

english: Can I help you with something?
translation: 我能帮你什么吗？

english: Well, err...who are you, and what are all these bones doing here?
translation: 嗯，呃……你是谁，这些骨头在这里做什么？

english: Errr...
Mumblemumble
translation: 咕哝咕哝

english: I'm an archaeologist. I work with the museum.
translation: 我是考古学家。我在博物馆工作。

english: An archaeologist?
translation: 考古学家？

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: Well that explains the bones...sort of...but what are you doing all the way out here?
translation: 嗯，那解释了骨头……某种程度上……但你大老远来这里做什么？

english: Mumblemumble. Mumblemumblemumble.
translation: 咕哝咕哝。咕哝咕哝咕哝。

english: I'm collecting bones for the museum.
translation: 我在为博物馆收集骨头。

english: They have asked me to rig up some displays of second and third age creatures using their bones, so that people can come and...well, look at them.
translation: 他们让我用骨头布置一些第二纪元和第三纪元生物的展品，好让大家能来看看。

english: I need to get them into some sort of order before I begin, but I've run into a bit of a snag.
translation: 开始之前我得先把它们整理妥当，可我遇到点小麻烦。

english: What sort of a snag?
translation: 什么样的麻烦？

english: Well, I need to have all the bones I'm going to use here, and placed into some sort of order.
translation: 嗯，我需要把所有要用的骨头都带到这里，并按某种顺序摆放。

english: However, I seem to have discovered I am a few short.
translation: 但我似乎发现还缺几根。

english: Anything I can do to help?
translation: 有什么我能帮忙的吗？

english: There is something you could do for me. I'm going to be busy...err...
translation: 有件事你可以帮我。我会很忙……呃……

english: Mumble
translation: 咕哝

english: Sorting, yes, sorting these bones out ready for the museum, but I need a few more.
translation: 整理，没错，为博物馆整理这些骨头，但我还需要几根。

english: Will you help me out by grabbing some?
translation: 你能帮我找一些吗？

english: Yes. I'll give you a hand.
translation: 好的。我帮你一把。

english: You will?Excellent!
translation: 你会？太好了！

english: Snicker.
translation: 窃笑。

english: Where do you need me to dig?
translation: 你需要我在哪里挖？

english: Dig?
translation: 挖？

english: Oh, you must have got the wrong end of the stick.
translation: 哦，你肯定误会了。

english: I need some fresh, whole bones to replace ones that have become damaged.
translation: 我需要一些新鲜完整的骨头，替换那些已损坏的。

english: What?
translation: 什么？

english: Err...
Mumblemumblemumblemumblemumble. Mumblemumblemumblemumble. Mumble.
translation: 咕哝咕哝咕哝咕哝咕哝。咕哝咕哝咕哝咕哝。咕哝。

english: Excuse me...
translation: 打扰一下……

english: Shhh!
translation: 嘘！

english: Sorry...
translation: 抱歉……

english: Ok, got it.
translation: 好的，明白了。

english: Ok, here is the thing. While sorting out what bones I do have I managed to lose or damage a few. If you can get me some fresh, unbroken bones to use as replacements then I can get on with things.
translation: 好的，情况是这样：整理现有骨头时，我弄丢或损坏了几根。如果你能帮我找些新鲜完整的骨头作为替换，我就能继续工作了。

english: That make things clearer?
translation: 这样说清楚些了吗？

english: Well, it makes some sense I suppose...
translation: 嗯，我想有点道理……

english: Great. If you can get me a bone from a Goblin, a Bear, a Big Frog, a Ram, a Unicorn, a Monkey, a Giant rat and a Giant Bat then I'll be able to move on with the...
translation: 太好了。如果你能帮我找来哥布林、熊、大青蛙、公羊、独角兽、猴子、巨鼠和巨蝙蝠的骨头，我就能继续……

english: Displays...
translation: 展示品……

english: So you just want me to bring you these bones and that will be that?
translation: 所以你只是想要我把这些骨头带给你就行了？

english: Well, I wouldn't mind you sticking them in a pot and boiling them in vinegar first, if you don't mind.
translation: 如果你不介意，我倒希望你能先将骨头放入锅中，用醋煮一下。

english: There is a Wine Merchant in Draynor called Fortunato that sells the stuff you'll need.
translation: 德雷诺有位名叫福图纳托的酒商，出售你所需的物品。

english: You can even use my pot-boiler if you want.
translation: 如果你愿意，甚至可以用我的锅灶。

english: Why do I need to boil them in vinegar?
translation: 我为什么需要用醋煮它们？

english: It gets them bright and sparking white.
translation: 这样能让它们变得明亮洁白。

english: It's an archaeologist thing.
translation: 这是考古学家的事。

english: Just put the bone in a pot of vinegar, throw some logs on the fire, put the pot in the holder and light the logs.
translation: 把骨头放进醋锅里，往火里扔些木柴，把锅放在支架上，点燃木柴。

english: It takes a while for the vinegar to evaporate, but the bone will be nice and clean in the end.
translation: 醋蒸发需要一段时间，但骨头最终会变得洁净如新。

english: All right, I'll be back later.
translation: 好的，我稍后回来。

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: Oh...I see.
translation: 哦……我明白了。

english: Well, never mind me young man, I'll just stagger over here under my massive burden, and continue my thankless task.
translation: 好吧，别管我了，年轻人。我就背着这沉重负担，踉踉跄跄地继续这吃力不讨好的差事吧。

english: Unaided and alone...
translation: 无人帮助，孤身一人……

english: Wow, trying a guilt trip much?
translation: 哇，这就开始打感情牌了？

english: Well good luck with that!
translation: 那祝你好运！

english: Thanks stranger!
translation: 谢谢陌生人！

english: What a polite young [man/woman]...
translation: 多么有礼貌的年轻[人]……

english: Well, back to work!
translation: 好吧，回去工作！

english: Where is that mumbling coming from?
translation: 那咕哝声是从哪来的？

english: What mumbling?
translation: 什么咕哝声？

english: Anyway, I have enough problems of my own without dealing with a delusional adventurer.
translation: 反正我自己的麻烦已经够多了，可没工夫应付一个有妄想症的冒险者。

english: You will? Excellent!
translation: 你会？太好了！

english: Sniggersnigger
translation: 窃笑窃笑

english: Hello there!
translation: 你好啊！

english: I was just passing and I wondered if you still needed someone to help with the bones?
translation: 我只是路过，想知道你是否还需要有人帮忙弄骨头？

english: So how is the sorting going?
translation: 整理工作进行得怎么样了？

english: It's going well, especially now I have all the bones I need.
translation: 进展顺利，尤其是现在我有了所有需要的骨头。

english: There are still a few bits and pieces I wouldn't mind, but that's the way things go.
translation: 还有些零碎物件我也不介意收集，但凡事总不能尽如人意。

english: Well if I see any bones I think you might like I'll bring them over.
translation: 嗯，如果我看到你可能会喜欢的骨头，我会带过来。

english: Cheers, we, err, that is myself and the museum staff, really appreciate it.
translation: 多谢，我们——呃，我是说我和博物馆的同仁——真的很感激。

english: Can I have a replacement helm? I managed to lose the last one.
translation: 能给我换个头盔吗？我把上一个弄丢了。

english: No problem. I have plenty after all.
translation: 没问题，反正我存货充足。

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！

english: Can I have a replacement bonesack? I managed to lose the last one.
translation: 能给我换个骨袋吗？我把上一个弄丢了。

english: How's the sorting going?
translation: 整理工作进行得怎么样了？

english: Oh, the 'sorting' is going very well, very well indeed.
translation: 哦，''整理''进行得非常顺利，确实非常顺利。

english: I'm glad to hear it!
translation: 很高兴听到这个！

english: Can I exchange this helm for the bonesack?
translation: 我能用这个头盔换骨袋吗？

english: I don't see why not.
translation: 我想没什么不行的。

english: There you go.
translation: 给，拿好。

english: Come up and see me if you want to swap back.
translation: 如果想换回来，上来找我。

english: Could I have a bonesack as well?
translation: 我也能要一个骨袋吗？

english: I... do have many of each. I suppose it wouldn't be a problem.
translation: 我……确实每种都有很多。我想应该没问题。

english: Come up and see me if you lose it.
translation: 如果弄丢了，上来找我。

english: Where was that mumbling coming from anyway?
translation: 那咕哝声到底是从哪来的？

english: You must be hearing things. I think you need to have a lie down.
translation: 你怕是听错了。我看你得躺下歇歇。

english: Can I exchange this bonesack for the helm?
translation: 我能用这个骨袋换头盔吗？

english: Could I have a helm as well?
translation: 我也能要一个头盔吗？

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Hello?
translation: 你好？

english: I found this amulet. Do you know what it is?
translation: 我找到了这个护符。你知道这是什么吗？

english: It doesn't look like anything I've seen in the past, I don't think I'll have a use for it.
translation: 它看起来不像我以前见过的任何东西，我想我用不上它。

english: Ahem!
translation: 咳咳！

english: Although actually, thinking about it, I can take it off your hands if you'd like?
translation: 不过实际上，想想看，如果你愿意的话，我可以接手？

english: For free? I've helped the museum enough, do you have anything I could exchange it for?
translation: 免费？我已经帮了博物馆够多了，你有什么可以让我交换的吗？

english: I could give you 30 big bones per amulet, I've built up quite a collection recently.
translation: 我可以每个护符给你30根大骨头，我最近收集了不少。

english: Here's 30 big bones, come back if you find another amulet.
translation: 这是30根大骨头，如果再找到护符就回来。

english: No thank you. maybeanother time.
translation: 不用了谢谢。也许下次吧。

english: Here's [input * 30] big bones, come back if you find another amulet.
translation: 这是 [input *30] 根大骨头，如果再找到护符就回来。

english: Anything I can do to help?
translation: 有什么我能帮忙的吗？

english: Yes
translation: 是的

english: No
translation: 不是

english: Well, good luck with that.
translation: 好吧，祝你好运。

english: Where is that mumbling coming from?
translation: 那咕哝声是从哪来的？

english: Could I exchange this helm for the bonesack?
translation: 我能用这个头盔换骨袋吗？

english: Could I have a bonesack as well?
translation: 我也能要一个骨袋吗？

english: Where was that mumbling coming from anyway?
translation: 那咕哝声到底是从哪来的？

english: Could I exchange this bonesack for the helm?
translation: 我能用这个骨袋换头盔吗？

english: Could I have a helm as well?
translation: 我也能要一个头盔吗？

english: Hey, human.
translation: 嘿，人类。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: I am Odd Stone. Got named after some odd stone thing I found in the snowfields south of Weiss.
translation: 我是怪石。名字来源于我在魏斯聚落南面雪地里发现的一块怪石头。

english: An odd stone thing?
translation: 一块怪石头？

english: Yeah, it were made of stone, and it were odd. Some weird bone-head human saw me trying to nibble it, an' he got really upset an' chased me away. He kinda scary.
translation: 是的，它是石头做的，而且很奇怪。某个奇怪的骨头脑袋人类看到我试图啃它，他非常生气把我赶走了。他有点吓人。

english: Anyway, my parents they named me Odd Stone after that, and now we trolls not go anywhere near the place. Bone-head human was, like, really scary! And probably magic.
translation: 总之，我父母从那以后就给我取名叫怪石，现在我们食人魔都不去那个地方附近。骨头脑袋人类，真的，很吓人！而且可能还会魔法。

english: Can I go looking for the odd stone?
translation: 我能去找那块怪石头吗？

english: No, we trolls blocked all routes to snowfields from here. Don't want scary bone-head human coming to Weiss.
translation: 不行，我们食人魔封锁了从这里通往雪地的所有路线。不想让吓人的骨头脑袋人类来魏斯聚落。

english: Thanks, that's interesting.
translation: 谢谢，挺有趣的。

english: Tell me about this place.
translation: 跟我讲讲这个地方。

english: This here is Weiss. Trolls built it years ago, after we got kicked out from caves further south. Now Weiss is our home.
translation: 这里是魏斯聚落。食人魔多年前建造的，在我们被从更南边的洞穴赶出来之后。现在魏斯聚落是我们的家。

english: We done pretty good here. Got lots of goat and wolf to eat - they taste kinda boring after all this time, but there not much other choice.
translation: 我们在这里过得还不错。有很多山羊和狼可以吃——吃了这么久味道有点无聊，但没什么其他选择。

english: Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it. In fact My Arm is an expert on growing the stuff.
translation: 试过痛风草吗？我认识喜欢它的食人魔。事实上''我的手臂''是种植那东西的专家。

english: Never heard of no gouty weed, no. But it sound like a vegetable, an' Mother not like eating those, so we probably not gonna try it.
translation: 没听说过什么痛风草，没有。但听起来像蔬菜，母亲不喜欢吃那些，所以我们可能不会尝试。

english: Mother not like new ideas much, but he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: 母亲不太喜欢新想法，但他真的很大，他是老大，所以我们听他的。

english: I see.
translation: 我明白了。

english: Do you like it here?
translation: 你喜欢这里吗？

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it our home. Odd Mushroom say he can make it nicer with fancy fires what he invented, but Mother not interested in that, so Odd Mushroom not allowed to do it.
translation: 呃，有点艰苦，但这是我们的家。奇特蘑菇说他可以用自己发明的漂亮火炉让这里更好，但母亲不感兴趣，所以奇特蘑菇不被允许这么做。

english: Mother only care about stuff to help him fight better. An he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: 母亲只关心能帮他更好战斗的东西。而且他真的很大，他是老大，所以我们听他的。

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我走了。

english: Hey, friend of Snowflake!
translation: 嘿，雪花的朋友！

english: I am Odd Stone. Got named after some odd stone thing I found in snowfields south of Weiss.
translation: 我是怪石。名字来源于我在魏斯聚落南面雪地里发现的一块怪石头。

english: Anyway, my parents, they named me Odd Stone after that, and now we trolls not go anywhere near the place. Bone-head human was, like, really scary! And probably magic.
translation: 总之，我父母从那以后就给我取名叫怪石，现在我们食人魔都不去那个地方附近。骨头脑袋人类，真的，很吓人！而且可能还会魔法。

english: It great here, now Snowflake an' her husband troll taught us goutweed farming. Food so much better now.
translation: 现在这里很棒，雪花和她丈夫食人魔教我们种植痛风草。食物现在好多了。

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it getting better. Snowflake, she taught us goutweed farming. Goat, wolf, human all taste so much nicer with goutweed in.
translation: 呃，有点艰苦，但正在变好。雪花教我们种植痛风草。山羊、狼、人类加了痛风草后味道都好多了。

english: So yeah, Weiss is good place to live, now Snowflake in charge. All trolls like Snowflake. Her husband troll kinda weird, but that not our problem.
translation: 所以是的，现在雪花负责，魏斯聚落是个居住的好地方。所有食人魔都喜欢雪花。她丈夫食人魔有点奇怪，但那不是我们的问题。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Can I go looking for the odd stone?
translation: 我能去找那块怪石头吗？

english: Thanks, that's interesting.
translation: 谢谢，挺有趣的。

english: Tell me about this place.
translation: 跟我讲讲这个地方。

english: Ever tried goutweed?
translation: 试过痛风草吗？

english: I see.
translation: 我明白了。

english: Do you like it here?
translation: 你喜欢这里吗？

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我走了。

english: What to buy? What to buy?
translation: 买什么？买什么？

english: Oh, hello human.
translation: 哦，你好，人类。

english: Anything I can help you with?
translation: 有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: Only if you can help me make a suggestion on what to buy.
translation: 只有你能帮我建议买什么才行。

english: I smell a quest!
translation: 我嗅到任务的气息了！

english: No, not really. I just need some advice on what to buy, that's all.
translation: 不，倒也不是。我只是需要些购买建议，仅此而已。

english: You should buy some new clothes. You can't go around town wearing what you're wearing.
translation: 你应该买些新衣服。你不能穿着这身衣服在城里逛。

english: You're right, this is a little drab. I shouldn't really go around Keldagrim-West wearing this, should I?
translation: 你说得对，这有点单调。我不应该穿着这身在凯尔达格林城 - 西区逛，对吧？

english: Of course I still don't know what colour I should get. I don't want to accidentally offend the wrong company of course.
translation: 当然我还是不知道该选什么颜色。我当然不想不小心冒犯错误的公司。

english: Never mind.
translation: 没关系。

english: You should get yourself a big mighty warhammer.
translation: 你应该给自己弄一把强大的战锤。

english: I don't think so. The warhammer shop is run by the Red Axe. I'd rather stay out of there.
translation: 我不这么想。战锤店是红斧帮经营的。我宁愿远离那里。

english: You don't like the Red Axe?
translation: 你不喜欢红斧帮？

english: They're all a lot of bullies if you ask me.
translation: 要我说，那帮人就是一群恶霸。

english: But I thought they left the city?
translation: 但我以为他们离开城市了？

english: They may have, but I still think that shopkeeper is in league with them, banners or no.
translation: 他们可能离开了，但我仍然认为那个店主和他们有勾结，不管有没有旗帜。

english: Get yourself a long piece of rope.
translation: 给自己弄根长绳子。

english: What would I do with a rope?
translation: 我要绳子做什么？

english: I don't know. I generally find a rope useful while adventuring.
translation: 我不知道。我一般在冒险时发现绳子很有用。

english: I don't do a lot of adventuring to be honest.
translation: 老实说，我并不常去冒险。

english: An oversized hat. In a ridiculous colour.
translation: 一顶超大号的帽子。颜色要荒谬。

english: No one is selling hats here, that's not a very helpful suggestion at all.
translation: 这里没人卖帽子，这根本不是什么有用的建议。

english: Nothing. You should buy absolutely nothing.
translation: 什么都不买。你应该什么都不买。

english: Now that's the best idea I've heard all day.
translation: 这才是我今天听到的最好的主意。

english: I thought so! Now why don't you give me some of the money I saved you?
translation: 我就知道！那为什么不把你省下的钱给我一些？

english: No, I don't think so. I think I'd rather buy something with my money after all.
translation: 不，我不这么想。我想我还是宁愿用钱买点东西。

english: New clothes.
translation: 新衣服。

english: A warhammer.
translation: 一把战锤。

english: A piece of rope.
translation: 一根绳子。

english: An oversized hat.
translation: 一顶超大号的帽子。

english: Nothing.
translation: 什么都不买。

english: Well met, fellow adventurer! How can I help you?
translation: 幸会，冒险者同伴！有什么能帮你的？

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: How frightfully rude of me, my dear [chap/girl]. My name is Odovacar and I work for that excellent enterprise, the Bank of Gielinor.
translation: 我真失礼了，亲爱的 [先生/小姐]。我叫奥多瓦卡，我为基利诺尔银行这家优秀企业工作。

english: If you work for the bank, what are you doing here?
translation: 如果你为银行工作，你在这里做什么？

english: As part of our ongoing service to provide you, the customer, with an absolutely world-class banking experience, we are investigating the option of opening a chain of travelling banks. These will provide you, our
translation: 作为我们持续为客户提供世界级银行体验服务的一部分，我们正在研究开设连锁流动银行的选项。这将为我们尊贵的客户

english: esteemed customer, with the convenience of having banking facilities where they will be of optimum use to you. Such as here!
translation: 提供便利，让银行设施出现在你最需要的地方。比如这里！

english: Huh?
translation: 哈？

english: I am the first of a new generation of travelling bankers that will wander the perilous areas of the world to provide you, the valued customer, with a bank when you need it most!
translation: 我是新一代流动银行职员中的第一位，将游历世界的危险区域，在你最需要的时候为你提供银行服务，尊贵的客户！

english: So I can access my bank account simply by talking to you?
translation: 所以我只要和你说话就能访问我的银行账户？

english: Absolutely correct, dear [sir/lady]. I must warn you, however, that due to the significantly increased overheads of an enterprise such as this, there is a small bank charge of 100gp every time you want to access your account.
translation: 完全正确，亲爱的 [先生/女士]。不过我必须提醒你，由于此类企业的运营成本显著增加，每次访问账户需要收取100金币的小额银行手续费。

english: I don't have the money. Can I get it from my bank?
translation: 我没钱。能从我的银行取吗？

english: It's not that I don't trust you to pay afterwards, old [chap/girl], but as the old adage goes, 'money comes before friends'.
translation: 不是我不信任你事后付款，老 [伙计/姑娘]，但俗话说得好，''钱在朋友前''。

english: That's preposterous! I'm not paying to withdraw my own money!
translation: 太荒谬了！我不会为了取自己的钱而付费！

english: I'm sorry to hear that, [sir/madam]. If you should reconsider, because I believe this service offers excellent value for money, do not hesitate to contact me.
translation: 很遗憾听到这个，[先生/女士]。如果你重新考虑，因为我相信这项服务物有所值，请随时联系我。

english: I'm afraid you don't have the necessary funds with you at this time so I can't allow you to access your account. Please come again, when you have 100 gold to cover the fee.
translation: 恐怕你现在没有足够的资金，所以我不能让你访问账户。请等你有100金币支付手续费时再来。

english: I'd like to check my PIN settings.
translation: 我想查看我的 PIN 设置。

english: I'd like to collect items.
translation: 我想领取物品。

english: I'm afraid you don't have the necessary funds with you at this time so I can't allow you to collect your items. Please come again, when you have 100 gold to cover the fee.
translation: 恐怕你现在没有足够的资金，所以我不能让你领取物品。请等你有100金币支付手续费时再来。

english: How frightfully rude of me, my dear [chap/lady]. My name is Odovacar and I work for that excellent enterprise, the Bank of Gielinor.
translation: 我真失礼了，亲爱的 [先生/女士]。我叫奥多瓦卡，我为基利诺尔银行这家优秀企业工作。

english: My services will cost you 100 coins.
translation: 我的服务将花费你100枚金币。

english: Here's 100 coins. Let me access my account now.
translation: 这是100枚金币。现在让我访问我的账户。

english: As an Ultimate Iron [Man/Woman] you cannot use the bank.
translation: 作为终极铁人 [模式]，你不能使用银行。

english: Here's 100 coins. Let me collect my items now.
translation: 这是100枚金币。现在让我领取我的物品。

english: I'd like to access my bank account, please.
translation: 我想查看我的银行账户。

english: Sorry, I don't perform that service.
translation: 抱歉，我不提供这项服务。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: If you work for the bank, what are you doing here?
translation: 如果你为银行工作，你在这里做什么？

english: I don't have the money. Can I get it from my bank?
translation: 我没钱。能从我的银行取吗？

english: That's preposterous! I'm not paying to withdraw my own money!
translation: 太荒谬了！我不会为了取自己的钱而付费！

english: I'd like to access my bank account, please.
translation: 我想查看我的银行账户。

english: I'd like to check my PIN settings.
translation: 我想查看我的 PIN 设置。

english: I'd like to collect items.
translation: 我想领取物品。

english: Here's 100 coins. Let me access my account now.
translation: 这是100枚金币。现在让我访问我的账户。

english: Here's 100 coins. Let me collect my items now.
translation: 这是100枚金币。现在让我领取我的物品。

english: Dad says you can get a lift to Karamja with us if you want? But you's gives us two chompy first!
translation: 爸爸说如果你想去卡拉姆詹可以搭我们的船？但你得先给我们两只食人鸟！

english: You's got no chompies...no boatsie trips!
translation: 你没有食人鸟……就没船可坐！

english: Player is transported west of Tai Bwo Wannai.
translation: 玩家被传送至泰博瓦纳村西部。

english: The barely sea-worthy log arrives at Karamja beach.
translation: 这根勉强能航行的原木抵达了卡拉姆詹岛海滩。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Dad says you can get a lift back with us if you want? But you's gives us two glug-glugs herbies first!
translation: 爸爸说如果你想的话可以搭我们的船回去？但你得先给我们两瓶咕噜咕噜草药酒！

english: Dad sez yous not bringin' da rummy stuff...das bad stuffsies un we get in big bads.
translation: 爸爸说你别带那些奇怪的东西……那是坏东西，我们会惹上大麻烦的。

english: You's got no glug-glugs herbies...no boatsie trips!
translation: 你没有咕噜咕噜草药酒……就别想坐船！

english: You hand over two herbs and accept a ride from Fycie and Bugs on the makeshift boat.
translation: 你交出两株草药，接受了菲西和巴格斯在简易船上的搭船邀请。

english: Player is transported to eastern Feldip Hills.
translation: 玩家被传送至费迪普丘陵东部。

english: The barely sea-worthy log arrives at the Feldip Hills.
translation: 这根勉强能航行的原木抵达了费迪普丘陵。

english: Yes please, I'll get a lift to Karamja with you.
translation: 好的，我想搭你们的船去卡拉姆詹岛。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Yes please, I'll get a lift back with you.
translation: 好的，我想搭你们的船回去。

english: Grrr! Go away from me, vermin!
translation: 咕噜！离我远点，害虫！

english: Stop, creature! Only ogres and their friends allowed in this city. Show me a sign of companionship, like a lost relic or somefing, and you may pass.
translation: 站住，生物！只有食人魔和他们的朋友才能进入这座城市。给我看看友谊的信物，比如遗失的遗物之类的，你才能通过。

english: Until then, back to whence you came!
translation: 在那之前，从哪儿来回哪儿去！

english: Halt! You cannot pass here.
translation: 站住！你不能从这里通过。

english: I am a friend to ogres.
translation: 我是食人魔的朋友。

english: You will be my friend only with gold. Bring me a bar of pure gold and I will let you pass.
translation: 只有金子才能让你成为我的朋友。给我带一根纯金锭来，我就让你通过。

english: Creature, did you bring me the gold?
translation: 生物，你给我带金子了吗？

english: No, I don't have it.
translation: 不，我没有。

english: No gold, no passage. Get out of this city!
translation: 没有金子就别想通过。滚出这座城市！

english: Here it is!
translation: 给你！

english: It's brought it! On your way.
translation: 它带来了！走吧。

english: Hey yous tryin' not to get da sickies else yous be da sick-un and mebe get to be a dead-un if yous be da unlucky fing.
translation: 嘿你最好别染病，不然你会生病，要是运气不好还可能死掉。

english: Don't worry, I know how to take care of myself.
translation: 别担心，我知道怎么照顾自己。

english: Yeah, whats yous wants creatures?
translation: 是啊，你想要什么生物？

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: I's is guardin' da coffins-ies- make sure no fieves nick stuff from 'em. If dey's do, dey get's bashed and shoved down da big 'ole and get deaded by da zogries in da deadies place. So yous creature be wares...ok!
translation: 我在守这些棺材——确保没小偷从里面偷东西。要是有人偷，他们会被揍一顿然后推进大洞里，被死地的僵尸怪弄死。所以你最好小心点……明白吗！

english: What's going on around here?
translation: 这里发生什么事了？

english: Da Zogries comes from da deadies place - deys attacking all da jig-dancers wot do da god stuff... jiggin an all. Dem zogries gonna dead all on us wiv da sickies.
translation: 僵尸怪从死地来的——它们攻击所有跳神之舞的人……跳舞什么的。那些僵尸怪要用疾病把我们全都弄死。

english: What are these coffins doing here?
translation: 这些棺材为什么在这里？

english: We's grabbed da closes dead-uns to stop da zogries gettin' em..de'se dead-uns coffins got da old-uns boneses and older-stuff in 'em, Grish seys we's needs to guard 'em...I's does what Grish seys.
translation: 我们把最近的死者抓来防止僵尸怪得到他们……这些死者的棺材里有老骨头和老东西，格里什说我们需要守着它们……我听格里什的话。

english: Are you always angry?
translation: 你总是这么生气吗？

english: Me's was born angry....me's wantin' to dead many peples...is what ogries meant to do...
translation: 我生来就生气……我想弄死很多人……这是食人魔该做的事……

english: Sorry, I have to go.
translation: 抱歉，我得走了。

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: What's going on around here?
translation: 这里发生什么事了？

english: What are these coffins doing here?
translation: 这些棺材为什么在这里？

english: Are you always angry?
translation: 你总是这么生气吗？

english: Sorry, I have to go.
translation: 抱歉，我得走了。

english: Does the little creature want to buy sumfin'?
translation: 小生物想买点什么吗？

english: Yes I do.
translation: 是的，我想买。

english: Welcome to Grud's Herblore Stall.
translation: 欢迎来到格鲁德的草药摊。

english: No, I don't.
translation: 不，我不想买。

english: Suit yourself.
translation: 随你便。

english: Yes I do.
translation: 是的，我想买。

english: No I don't.
translation: 不，我不想买。

english: Arr, small thing wants my food, does it? I'll teach you to deal with ogres!
translation: 啊，小东西想要我的食物是吧？我来教教你怎么跟食人魔打交道！

english: Grrr, little animal; I shall destroy you!
translation: 咕噜，小畜生；我要消灭你！

english: Trade with me? Who do you think you are?
translation: 跟我交易？你以为你是谁？

english: What the human be wantin'?
translation: 这人类想要什么？

english: Can I see what you are selling?
translation: 我能看看你在卖什么吗？

english: I suppose so.
translation: 我想可以。

english: I don't need anything.
translation: 我什么都不需要。

english: As you wish.
translation: 如你所愿。

english: Can I see what you are selling?
translation: 我能看看你在卖什么吗？

english: I don't need anything.
translation: 我什么都不需要。

english: Guards! I've spotted a human!
translation: 卫兵！发现人类！

english: So much blood flows through these lands.
translation: 这么多鲜血流淌在这片土地上。

english: Where does the blood come from?
translation: 这些血是从哪里来的？

english: Throughout the generations, countless people of this land have perished in times of strife, with their bodies left to rot where they fell.
translation: 世世代代以来，这片土地上无数人在战乱中丧生，尸体就倒在原地腐烂。

english: Some were slain by the deadly creatures that roam the land; others perished at the hands of their fellow citizens during the wars of this land.
translation: 有些人被在这片土地上游荡的致命生物杀死；其他人则在这片土地的战争中死于同胞之手。

english: Their blood flowed into the soil, pooling and percolating unseen in the dark, as the power of the Altar drew it to this sacred place to form the River.
translation: 他们的鲜血流入土壤，在黑暗中汇聚渗透，祭坛的力量将其引至这片圣地，形成了这条河。

english: Why are you here?
translation: 你为什么在这里？

english: The blood is the blood of Kourend's citizens. It is fitting that we honour their memory.
translation: 这些血是库兰德王国公民的血。我们纪念他们是应该的。

english: Also, it smells so good.
translation: 而且，闻起来真香。

english: I'll leave you to enjoy the view.
translation: 我就不打扰你欣赏风景了。

english: I see the river foaming with much blood.
translation: 我看到河里满是翻腾的鲜血。

english: Where does the blood come from?
translation: 这些血是从哪里来的？

english: Why are you here?
translation: 你为什么在这里？

english: I'll leave you to enjoy the view.
translation: 我就不打扰你欣赏风景了。

english: Hello there. So you're a bard?
translation: 你好。你是吟游诗人？

english: I am afraid I cannot speak to outerlanders. Besides, I am busy composing an epic.
translation: 恐怕我不能和外乡人说话。而且，我正忙着创作一首史诗。

english: Hello again to you [Fremennik name]. Us bards should stick together, what?
translation: 又见面了[Fremennik name]。我们吟游诗人应该团结一致，对吧？

english: About the Music Cape...
translation: 关于音乐斗篷……

english: I believe you are the person to talk to if I want to get a Music Cape?
translation: 我想如果我要获得音乐斗篷，应该找你谈吧？

english: That's right! If you know that then you'll also know that they cost 99000 coins.
translation: 没错！既然你知道这个，那你也应该知道它们售价99,000金币。

english: No, I hadn't heard that.
translation: 不，我没听说过。

english: Well, they do.
translation: 嗯，确实如此。

english: Have fun with it.
translation: 祝你玩得开心。

english: I don't have that much at the moment.
translation: 我现在没那么多钱。

english: Save up some more then!
translation: 那再多攒点吧！

english: Yes, I know.
translation: 是的，我知道。

english: May I have another hood for my cape, please?
translation: 能再给我的斗篷配一个兜帽吗？

english: Most certainly, and free of charge!
translation: 当然可以，而且免费！

english: The bard hands you another hood for your cape.
translation: 吟游诗人递给你另一个斗篷兜帽。

english: Yes, but you don't know all of the music in the land.
translation: 是的，但你并不了解这片土地上所有的音乐。

english: Do you know any great stories about Basilisk Jaws?
translation: 你知道关于石化蜥蜴下颚的精彩故事吗？

english: Why do you ask?
translation: 你为什么问这个？

english: Oh my! This must be the jaw of a legendary Basilisk Knight. There's a great song about how the Fremennik warriors of old would use these jaws to enhance their helmets.
translation: 天哪！这一定是传奇石化蜥蜴骑士的下颚。有一首很棒的歌讲的是古代费明尼克战士如何用这些下颚来强化他们的头盔。

english: I see. I have a nice helmet that Neitiznot's Burgher gave to me. I bet it would work well with that.
translation: 我明白了。我有一个奈提兹诺镇镇长给我的好头盔。我打赌用它配合这个会很好。

english: I'm sure it would, [Fremennik name]. Now, do you want to hear the song?
translation: 我相信会的，[Fremennik name]。那么，你想听这首歌吗？

english: Err... I think I'll pass. Thanks for the help though.
translation: 呃……我想还是算了。不过还是谢谢你的帮助。

english: I was wondering... Can I learn to play my lyre again?
translation: 我在想……我能再学弹我的竖琴吗？

english: Well, that is an interesting question. Let me let you into a little secret. If you make another offering to Fossegrimen you will learn a secret melody.
translation: 嗯，这是个有趣的问题。让我告诉你一个小秘密。如果你再向福瑟格里门献祭，你就会学会一首秘密旋律。

english: What kind of melody?
translation: 什么样的旋律？

english: It is the song of Rellekka. When you play it, it will bring you back to this town wherever you are in this world.
translation: 这是雷勒卡之歌。当你弹奏它时，无论你在这个世界的哪里，它都会把你带回这座城镇。

english: We often go adventuring with bards for precisely this reason; No matter where we have ended up we can return safe and sound to home.
translation: 我们正是出于这个原因才经常和吟游诗人一起去冒险；无论我们走到哪里，都能平安回家。

english: Thanks Olaf!
translation: 谢谢奥拉夫！

english: About the Music Cape...
translation: 关于音乐斗篷……

english: Cape
translation: 斗篷

english: No, I hadn't heard that!
translation: 不，我没听说过！

english: Ok, I'll pay.
translation: 好的，我付钱。

english: I'm not paying that!
translation: 我才不付那么多！

english: Yes, I do.
translation: 是的，我想买。

english: Hood
translation: 兜帽

english: Do you know any great stories about Basilisk Jaws?
translation: 你知道关于石化蜥蜴下颚的精彩故事吗？

english: Can I learn to play my lyre again?
translation: 我能再学弹我的竖琴吗？

english: It's mine. You can't have it, we found it!
translation: 这是我的。你不能拿走，是我们找到的！

english: What have you found?
translation: 你们找到了什么？

english: Not dragonstones. I like dragonstones, that's why I came here. However, I found a valuable coin instead, it speaks to me... but you can't have it! It's precious to me!
translation: 不是龙石。我喜欢龙石，这就是我来的原因。不过，我找到了一枚有价值的硬币，它在对我说话……但你不能拿走！它对我来说很珍贵！

english: I don't want it, I have something better.
translation: 我不想要，我有更好的东西。

english: What is it? Is it dragonstones? I like dragonstones!
translation: 是什么？是龙石吗？我喜欢龙石！

english: Ask it for five! It looks rich!
translation: 问它要五个！它看起来很有钱！

english: Five? Will it give us five?
translation: 五个？它会给我们五个吗？

english: No. I don't have five dragonstones.
translation: 不，我没有五个龙石。

english: Well then we are not interested!
translation: 那我们就不感兴趣了！

english: Yes. I have five dragonstones, tell you what, I'll trade you them for that coin you found.
translation: 是的。我有五个龙石，这样吧，我用它们换你找到的那枚硬币。

english: Yes! Yes! We'll trade it for the dragonstones.
translation: 好！好！我们用硬币换龙石。

english: No we will not! It is too precious!
translation: 不，我们不能！它太珍贵了！

english: But why? I like dragonstones...
translation: 但为什么？我喜欢龙石……

english: It is trying to trick us! Evil, nasty creature it is. Do not listen to it!
translation: 它在骗我们！它是个邪恶讨厌的生物。别听它的！

english: But it seems nice enough...
translation: 但它看起来挺友善的……

english: I am standing right here, you know? You really are crazy. Yes, I'll give you five! Do we have a deal or not?
translation: 我就站在这里，你们知道吗？你们真是疯了。是的，我给你们五个！成交不成交？

english: Yes! Yes!
translation: 好！好！

english: You give Olbertus a dragonstone and receive a very worn coin in return.
translation: 你给奥尔伯图斯一枚龙石，换回了一枚磨损严重的硬币。

english: Thanks for helping me, I'm not sure what would have happened if I had continued to listen to the voices in my head.
translation: 谢谢你帮我，我不确定如果我继续听脑海里的声音会发生什么。

english: I took that coin from the Stone Relief in the Crypt of the Moon and trapped my friend Eodan in a secret room behind the relief. Could you return the coin to the relief and set him free?
translation: 我从月亮墓穴的石浮雕上拿走了那枚硬币，把我的朋友伊欧丹困在浮雕后面的密室里。你能把硬币放回浮雕那里把他放出来吗？

english: On second thoughts, I'll keep it for myself.
translation: 再想想，我还是自己留着吧。

english: Since it's valuable, I think I'll just just kill you for it.
translation: 既然它这么值钱，我想我还是杀了你拿走它吧。

english: Please! No!
translation: 求求你！不要！

english: This is a dangerous fight, you will lose your items on death.
translation: 这是一场危险的战斗，死亡后你会丢失物品。

english: Foolish decision!
translation: 愚蠢的决定！

english: I require this one alive human!
translation: 我需要这个人类活着！

english: Just kidding!
translation: 开玩笑的！

english: You're crazy!
translation: 你疯了！

english: Thanks for killing that creature.
translation: 谢谢你杀了那个生物。

english: It appears that when I stole the coin, the creature possessed me.
translation: 看来当我偷走硬币时，那个生物附身了我。

english: I'm glad I no longer have that coin. I'm not sure what would have happened if I had continued to listen to the voices in my head.
translation: 我很高兴我不再有那枚硬币了。我不确定如果我继续听脑海里的声音会发生什么。

english: For some reason the coin returned to me. Here, take it before it corrupts me again!
translation: 不知为何硬币又回到了我手上。给你，趁它再次腐蚀我之前拿走！

english: I'm glad I no longer have that coin. I'm not sure what would have happened if I had continued to listen the voices in my head.
translation: 我很高兴我不再有那枚硬币了。我不确定如果我继续听脑海里的声音会发生什么。

english: What have you found?
translation: 你们找到了什么？

english: I don't want it, I have something better.
translation: 我不想要，我有更好的东西。

english: Yes, give him your dragonstones.
translation: 是的，把你的龙石给他。

english: No, don't give him your dragonstones.
translation: 不，别把你的龙石给他。

english: Since it's valuable, I think I'll just just kill you for it.
translation: 既然它这么值钱，我想我还是杀了你拿走它吧。

english: Attack Olbertus.
translation: 攻击奥尔伯图斯。

english: Just kidding.
translation: 开玩笑的。

english: You're crazy!
translation: 你疯了！

english: Hello again!
translation: 又见面了！

english: Hmph!
translation: 哼！

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Hmph! Why? What do I know? I'm just an old man; what would anyone want with an old man?
translation: 哼！为什么？我知道什么？我只是个老头子；有人会在意一个老头子吗？

english: I'm lost... Can you help me?
translation: 我迷路了……你能帮我吗？

english: Hmph! Who says I'm not lost, eh? Ever think of that, did you?
translation: 哼！谁说我没迷路，嗯？你有没有想过这个，嗯？

english: In a rush to find out all the answers, not thinking for a second that someone else might be just as lost, if not more lost, than you! And what do you care about them, huh?
translation: 急着找出所有答案，却从没想过别人可能和你一样迷路，甚至比你更迷路！你在乎过他们吗，嗯？

english: Do you know about the Myreque?
translation: 你知道密雷克组织吗？

english: Hmph! Why should I know about the Myreque, eh? What use have they ever been to me, huh? I ask you!
translation: 哼！我为什么要知道密雷克组织，嗯？他们对我有什么用，嗯？我问你！

english: Can you help me?
translation: 你能帮我吗？

english: Hmph! What makes you think that I can help you, eh? Do I look like a fountain of knowledge, eh? Do I?
translation: 哼！什么让你觉得我能帮你，嗯？我看起来像知识源泉吗，嗯？像吗？

english: Well, you've helped me before! You said something about symbols? To find the Myreque!
translation: 嗯，你以前帮过我！你说过关于符号的事？用来找到密雷克组织！

english: Hmph! Yes of course, that's how to get to them. Follow the symbols.
translation: 哼！是的当然，那就是找到他们的方法。跟着符号走。

english: Which symbols?
translation: 哪些符号？

english: The symbol of the Myreque - the silver sickle!
translation: 密雷克组织的符号——银镰刀！

english: Oh, and where would that be then?
translation: 哦，那它会在哪里呢？

english: Around and about; it should be an aid.
translation: 到处都有；它应该是个帮手。

english: Okay, thanks
translation: 好的，谢谢

english: But they live right under your house?
translation: 但他们就住在你房子下面？

english: Hmph! Suppose they do. Stupid Myreque...
translation: 哼！就算是吧。愚蠢的密雷克组织……

english: Well, you've helped me before! You helped me find the Myreque!
translation: 嗯，你以前帮过我！你帮我找到了密雷克组织！

english: Hmph! Yes of course, follow the symbols and all that. Pointless now though, they're right below us. Hmph!
translation: 哼！是的当然，跟着符号走什么的。不过现在没意义了，他们就在我们下面。哼！

english: Okay, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Hmph! Dead! That's what I know about the Myreque. You're lucky to not be dead as well. Don't talk about them any more!
translation: 哼！死了！这就是我对密雷克组织的了解。你没死算你走运。别再提他们了！

english: Hmph! Yes of course, follow the symbols and all that. Pointless now though, they're all dead! Hmph!
translation: 哼！是的当然，跟着符号走什么的。不过现在没意义了，他们都死了！哼！

english: Ah! vampyre!
translation: 啊！吸血鬼！

english: It's okay. It's just me.
translation: 没事。是我。

english: Here, solve this.
translation: 来，解这个。

english: Please make yourself some space, I have something for you.
translation: 请腾出点空间，我有东西给你。

english: That doesn't look solved to me.
translation: 在我看来这还没解开。

english: Well done [Player name]. Here you go.
translation: 做得好[Player name]。给你。

english: You've obtained [another clue scroll/a casket]!
translation: 你获得了[另一张线索卷轴/一个宝箱]！

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: I'm lost... Can you help me?
translation: 我迷路了……你能帮我吗？

english: Do you know about the Myreque?
translation: 你知道密雷克组织吗？

english: Can you help me?
translation: 你能帮我吗？

english: Okay, thanks
translation: 好的，谢谢

english: Okay, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: What brings you here, young [man/lady/one]?
translation: 什么风把你吹来了，年轻的[先生/女士/朋友]？

english: I'm just wandering around.
translation: 我只是随便逛逛。

english: Oh, that's nice. I used to wander around, back when my legs were better. So long ago.
translation: 哦，真好。我过去也到处逛，那时候我的腿还利索。那是很久以前的事了。

english: Nothing, really.
translation: 没什么，真的。

english: That's the trouble with young people these days. Not my boy, though. He's a good boy, always working. That's why he never visits. Run along now, young [man/lady/one].
translation: 这就是现在年轻人的问题。不过我儿子不是这样。他是个好孩子，总是在工作。所以他从不来看我。走吧，年轻的[先生/女士/朋友]。

english: Marlo sent me to fix your furniture.
translation: 马洛派我来修理你的家具。

english: My boy Marlo sent you? Oh yes, you've come to help with my furniture. It's in a terrible state. You'll want to start by removing all the tatty old furniture.
translation: 我儿子马洛派你来的？哦是的，你是来帮我修家具的。家具状况很糟糕。你得先把所有破旧的家具都拆掉。

english: There are two stools, two tables, a chair and a rotten carpet to replace. I need a better bed too. Let me know when you've removed all the old furniture.
translation: 有两个凳子、两张桌子、一把椅子和一块烂地毯需要更换。我还需要一张更好的床。等你把所有旧家具都拆掉后告诉我。

english: Ah, young [man/lady/one], how's the redecoration coming on?
translation: 啊，年轻的[先生/女士/朋友]，重新装修进展如何？

english: What am I supposed to be doing again?
translation: 我应该做什么来着？

english: You'll want to start by removing all the tatty old furniture. There are two stools, two tables, a chair and a rotten carpet to remove, as well as the campbed. Let me know when you've done that.
translation: 你得先把所有破旧的家具都拆掉。有两个凳子、两张桌子、一把椅子和一块烂地毯要拆，还有那张行军床。完成后告诉我。

english: I've been removing the old furniture.
translation: 我一直在拆旧家具。

english: You still need to remove: - A broken stool in the kitchen - A broken stool in the bedroom - A broken chair in the bedroom
translation: 你还需要拆掉：- 厨房里的一张破凳子 - 卧室里的一张破凳子 - 卧室里的一把破椅子

english: - A broken table in the kitchen - The old campbed - The rotten carpet
translation: - 厨房里的一张破桌子 - 旧行军床 - 烂地毯

english: I've finished removing all the old furniture.
translation: 我已经拆完所有旧家具了。

english: Jolly good, young [man/lady/one]. Now, we'll need to have a talk about what you'll build for me to replace it.
translation: 太好了，年轻的[先生/女士/朋友]。现在，我们得谈谈你要建什么来替换它们。

english: You see, I used to be a carpenter myself, before the arthritis got me. Such wonderful things I could build. Let me tell you about the things Construction can do for you...
translation: 你看，我在得关节炎之前自己也是个木匠。我能造出很棒的东西。让我告诉你建筑技能能为你做什么……

english: Is this necessary? I've got a house of my own, in [city], and I've been learning about Construction for a while.
translation: 这有必要吗？我在 [city] 有自己的房子，而且我已经学习建筑技能一段时间了。

english: A cutscene plays in which Old Man Yarlo is in a newly purchased player-owned house.
translation: 播放一段过场动画，亚洛老头身处一间新购买的玩家房屋中。

english: As a builder, in your own house, you can create your own rooms full of furniture. A house may start out very basic...
translation: 作为建造者，在你自己的房屋里，你可以创建装满家具的房间。房屋一开始可能非常简陋……

english: ... but in Building Mode, you'll see what you can add to it...
translation: ……但在建造模式下，你会看到你能添加什么……

english: Old Man Yarlo builds a fully furnished parlour.
translation: 亚洛老头建造了一间家具齐全的客厅。

english: ... with fancier options available as your Construction level rises.
translation: ……随着你的建筑等级提升，会有更花哨的选项可用。

english: Old Man Yarlo removes several furniture and builds fancier ones.
translation: 亚洛老头拆除几件家具并建造更花哨的。

english: You can add lots more rooms, and build their furniture too, unlocking really handy features.
translation: 你可以添加更多房间，并建造它们的家具，解锁真正实用的功能。

english: The camera shifts and Old Man Yarlo is now seen in a fully furnished home fitted with the highest-level furniture.
translation: 镜头切换，亚洛老头现在身处一间配备最高级家具的完整房屋中。

english: For example, in a study, you could build a lectern for creating spell tablets, powerful items that can cast spells without runes. You could sell your tablets to other people too.
translation: 例如，在书房里，你可以建造一个诵经台来制作魔法石板，这种强力物品无需符石即可施法。你也可以将石板出售给他人。

english: A Teleport Nexus can take you to a huge range of destinations, making your home a powerful travel hub.
translation: 传送枢纽可带你前往众多目的地，让你的家成为强大的旅行中转站。

english: Show your dedication to the gods by building an altar, where you can sacrifice bones for bonus Prayer XP.
translation: 通过建造祭坛来表达你对神明的虔诚，你可以在那里献祭骨头获得额外的祈祷经验。

english: With a regeneration pool, you can get healed quickly, before you teleport back to the action.
translation: 有了再生池，你可在传送重返战场前快速恢复生命。

english: The Estate Agents can redecorate your house in different styles, if you want something a bit more impressive.
translation: 如果你想让房子更令人印象深刻，地产代理商可以用不同风格重新装修你的房屋。

english: And, of course, to make your house feel truly like a home, you can fill it with adorable critters...
translation: 当然，为了让你的房子真正像家，你可以养些可爱的小动物……

english: ... and drop your guests into the monster pit beneath your throne room.
translation: ……还能把你的客人扔进王座室下方的怪物坑里。

english: All this could be yours, if you train Construction!
translation: 如果你训练建筑技能，这一切都可以属于你！

english: Now, I was just getting round to telling you about the furniture I want you to build for me. For a start, I'd like two new stools, two new tables and a new chair.
translation: 现在，我正想告诉你我想让你为我建造的家具。首先，我想要两张新凳子、两张新桌子和一把新椅子。

english: Some basic wooden planks and some nails should do, for those. I won't ask for anything more fancy - it'd only get stolen anyway, in this neighbourhood.
translation: 一些基础木板和一些钉子就够了。我不会要求更花哨的——反正在这个街区只会被偷。

english: I'll want a new carpet too. They can really change the atmosphere of a room, you know! You can buy cloth at the sawmill to make one.
translation: 我还想要一块新地毯。它们真的能改变房间的氛围，你知道吗！你可以在锯木厂买布料来做。

english: Now, for the bed, I've got something special in mind. This town's quite damp, and I don't want the moisture rising up the bed into my blankets. But I've found some wood that resists water.
translation: 至于床，我有个特别的想法。这个城镇相当潮湿，我不想让湿气从床上升到我的毯子里。但我找到了一些防水的木材。

english: Those abandoned crates in the kitchen were here when I moved in, and I found they contain waxwood logs. Waxwood isn't much used in carpentry, but it resists water, so I want a bed made from that.
translation: 我搬进来时厨房里就有那些废弃的板条箱，我发现里面装着蜡木原木。蜡木在木工中不太常用，但它防水，所以我想要一张用那种木材做的床。

english: You'll have to take three logs from the crate to the sawmill. The chap there will turn them into planks if you mention my name - I've known his family for years.
translation: 你得从箱子里拿三根原木去锯木厂。如果你提我的名字，那里的人会把它们做成木板——我认识他家很多年了。

english: I think that's everything - two stools, two tables, a chair, a bed and a carpet. Off you trot, young [man/lady/one]. I'll be here if you have any questions.
translation: 我想就这些了——两张凳子、两张桌子、一把椅子、一张床和一块地毯。去吧，年轻的[先生/女士/朋友]。有问题随时来找我。

english: You young people are always rushing around trying to optimise the fun out of life. There are other ways to enjoy the world, you know! But I'm sure you know best.
translation: 你们年轻人总是忙忙碌碌，想把生活中的乐趣都''优化''没了。还有其他享受世界的方式，你知道吗！不过我相信你最清楚。

english: Do you need some help with the building work, young [man/lady/one]?
translation: 你需要一些建筑工作的帮助吗，年轻的[先生/女士/朋友]？

english: How do I build furniture?
translation: 我如何建造家具？

english: Ah. Look in the place where the new furniture will go...
translation: 啊。看看新家具要放置的地方……

english: A talented builder will see a vision there of the furniture they could build. Interact with that, and you should find you can build furniture.
translation: 技艺精湛的建造者能在那里瞥见可建造的家具幻象。与它互动，你便能着手建造家具。

english: You'll need a hammer and saw. I can supply those if you need them.
translation: 你需要锤子和锯子。如果需要我可以提供。

english: Where do I get planks, nails and cloth?
translation: 我从哪里获得木板、钉子和布料？

english: From the sawmill! They sell nails and cloth at reasonable prices. You'd have to take your own logs there, though, to get planks, but there are plenty of trees to chop nearby.
translation: 从锯木厂！他们以合理的价格出售钉子和布料。不过你得自己带原木去那里才能做成木板，但附近有很多树可以砍。

english: Watch out, though - nails can bend, if you're not careful. You should probably get some spares, just in case.
translation: 不过要小心——如果不小心，钉子会弯。你应该多备一些，以防万一。

english: Look on your World Map to find the sawmill.
translation: 查看你的世界地图找到锯木厂。

english: You've got a hammer and a saw. I wouldn't be able to offer you anything else.
translation: 你已经有锤子和锯子了。我没法再给你别的了。

english: I need some tools.
translation: 我需要一些工具。

english: Would you like a [hammer/saw]? I can spare one.
translation: 你想要一把 [锤子/锯子] 吗？我可以匀给你一把。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Yarlo gives you a [hammer/saw].
translation: 亚洛给了你一把 [锤子/锯子]。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Tell me about the waxwood for the bed.
translation: 跟我讲讲做床的蜡木。

english: This town's quite damp, and I don't want the moisture rising up the bed into my blankets. But I've found some wood that resists water.
translation: 这个城镇相当潮湿，我不想让湿气从床上升到我的毯子里。但我找到了一些防水的木材。

english: You'll have to take three logs from the crate to the sawmill. The chap there will turn them into planks if you mention my name.
translation: 你得从箱子里拿三根原木去锯木厂。如果你提我的名字，那里的人会把它们做成木板。

english: I'll get on with it.
translation: 我这就去办。

english: That's everything! Thank you so much, young [man/lady/one]. Trot off back to my boy Marlo, now. He'll have something for you.
translation: 就这些了！非常感谢，年轻的[先生/女士/朋友]。现在回去找我儿子马洛吧。他会有东西给你。

english: Okay, I'll head back to Marlo.
translation: 好的，我这就回马洛那里。

english: Hello again, young [man/lady/one]. Has my boy Marlo rewarded you yet?
translation: 又见面了，年轻的[先生/女士/朋友]。我儿子马洛奖励你了吗？

english: Not yet. I'll get round to visiting him soon.
translation: 还没有。我很快就会去看他。

english: Yes, you should do that. You've earned it.
translation: 是的，你应该去。这是你应得的。

english: Hello again, young [man/lady/one]. You really did wonders for my little home. I feel so much happier living here now.
translation: 又见面了，年轻的[先生/女士/朋友]。你真的为我的小家创造了奇迹。我现在住在这里感觉开心多了。

english: That's good to hear. Goodbye now.
translation: 听到这个真好。再见。

english: Tell me about more things I can do with Construction.
translation: 告诉我更多关于建筑技能能做的事。

english: Thank you!
translation: 谢谢！

english: I'm just wandering around.
translation: 我只是随便逛逛。

english: Nothing, really.
translation: 没什么，真的。

english: Listen to Yarlo.
translation: 听亚洛讲解。

english: Skip Yarlo's lecture. He'll offer it later if you like.
translation: 跳过亚洛的讲解。如果你愿意他稍后会再提供。

english: How do I build furniture?
translation: 我如何建造家具？

english: Where do I get planks, nails and cloth?
translation: 我从哪里获得木板、钉子和布料？

english: I need some tools.
translation: 我需要一些工具。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Tell me about the waxwood for the bed.
translation: 跟我讲讲做床的蜡木。

english: I'll get on with it.
translation: 我这就去办。

english: That's good to hear. Goodbye now.
translation: 听到这个真好。再见。

english: Tell me about more things I can do with Construction.
translation: 告诉我更多关于建筑技能能做的事。

english: Hello, old woman.
translation: 你好，老太太。

english: I'm over 100 years old, you know.
translation: 你知道吗，我已经一百多岁了。

english: I'm here about Necrovarus.
translation: 我是来问奈克罗瓦鲁斯的事。

english: Good news - the enchantment worked!
translation: 好消息——附魔生效了！

english: So Necrovarus has let the ghosts go free.... You have achieved many wonderful things, my young friend.
translation: 看来奈克罗瓦鲁斯已让幽灵重获自由……你成就了诸多非凡之事，我的年轻朋友。

english: I'm here about the farmers east of here.
translation: 我是来问东边农民的事。

english: Hello there, just dropping in to thank you again. It all went perfectly. Alice and her husband can communicate again.
translation: 你好，特地来再次感谢你。一切都很顺利。爱丽丝和她丈夫又能交流了。

english: I can't help but shed a tear about my own family. My sisters are so vile, I refuse to talk to them these days.
translation: 我忍不住为自己的家人落泪。我的姐妹们太可恶了，我最近拒绝和她们说话。

english: Sorry to hear that.
translation: 听到这个我很抱歉。

english: Never mind; we've reunited a happy family of farmers; that's enough for me.

english: Can you tell me more about these rich folk?
translation: 你能多告诉我一些关于这些富人的事吗？

english: Yes I can. Some 'ave got houses full of loot, while others spend their days at the bazaar. What do you want to know?
translation: 是的我可以。有些人的房子满是战利品，而其他人整天在集市。你想了解什么？

english: Tell me about the houses.
translation: 和我说说房子的事。

english: Some of them round here are filled with loot for sure. They've got so many bits and bobs, trinkets and doodads, that they 'ardly ever notice they've been robbed.
translation: 这周围有些肯定满是战利品。他们有太多零碎东西，小饰品和小玩意儿，他们几乎注意不到被抢劫了。

english: You rob them?
translation: 你抢劫他们？

english: Oh yes.
translation: 哦是的。

english: How do you manage that?
translation: 你怎么做到的？

english: First we get keys for these houses, which are always conveniently under the doormat.
translation: 首先我们拿到这些房子的钥匙，它们总是很方便地藏在门垫下面。

english: Are you serious? It's that easy?
translation: 你是认真的？那么简单？

english: Ha... No. I was just pulling your leg.
translation: 哈……不。我只是在逗你。

english: You'll 'ave to steal the house keys from the citizens.
translation: 你得从市民那里偷房子钥匙。

english: All these wealthy folk buy and sell property like it's nothing, so they 'ave plenty of spare keys to go round.
translation: 所有这些有钱人买卖房产就像没事一样，所以他们有很多备用钥匙流通。

english: So how do you steal them?
translation: 那么你怎么偷它们？

english: We pick their pockets of course. I 'ave some of my crew in the bazaar. If you fancy gettin' involved, they might help you out every now and then.
translation: 我们当然扒他们的口袋。我在集市有我的一些手下。如果你想参与，他们可能时不时帮你。

english: Once you 'ave a key, you can break into a house. Not any ol' house though. It must be one that's ready to be robbed.
translation: 一旦你有了钥匙，你可以闯入房子。不过不是任何旧房子。必须是准备好被抢劫的房子。

english: The street urchins that roam the streets keep tabs on which houses are vulnerable.
translation: 在街上游荡的流浪儿会留意哪些房子易受攻击。

english: Once you know a house is vulnerable, wait for the owner to leave. Then just simply use your key to get in and steal to your heart's content!
translation: 一旦你知道房子易受攻击，等主人离开。然后只需简单地用你的钥匙进去随心所欲地偷！

english: But whatever you do, dont get caught!
translation: 但无论你做什么，别被抓！

english: So... steal keys, use keys on the houses that are ready to be robbed, make buckets of cash and don't be caught?
translation: 所以……偷钥匙，用钥匙进准备好被抢劫的房子，赚大笔钱且别被抓？

english: That's it!
translation: 就是这样！

english: If you're not sure where to begin, chat to the urchins in my crew posted round the houses. They'll help you find the next one to plunder.
translation: 如果你不确定从哪开始，跟我派在房子周围的流浪儿手下聊聊。他们会帮你找到下一个要掠夺的目标。

english: Though it might come at a price.
translation: 不过那可能有代价。

english: Tell me about the bazaar.
translation: 和我说说集市的事。

english: Some of the wealthiest citizens in Varlamore shop in the bazaar and nearby. A perfect place to pick some pockets!
translation: 瓦拉莫尔一些最富有的市民在集市及其周边购物。真是完美的偷窃地点！

english: Surely it's not so easy though?
translation: 肯定没那么容易吧？

english: You'd be right about that. If it were easy to steal from 'em, they wouldn't be so rich, would they?
translation: 你说得对。如果容易偷他们，他们就不会那么富有了，对吧？

english: Sounds like you might have some tips?
translation: 听起来你可能有些建议？

english: Some of the street urchins in my crew hang around in the bazaar and on the outskirts. They might be able to provide some sort of distraction.
translation: 我手下的一些街头流浪儿在集市和郊区闲逛。他们可能能提供某种干扰。

english: They do it just out of the goodness of their heart?
translation: 他们这样做只是出于好心？

english: You're funny, [player name].
translation: 你真有趣，[player name]。

english: They get a cut in all the wealth we make.
translation: 他们从我们赚的所有财富中分成。

english: Can I get a cut?
translation: 我能分成吗？

english: Cheeky! You're lucky I don't steal from you right now!
translation: 厚脸皮！算你幸运我现在没偷你！

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: See you later.
translation: 回头见。

english: Do you work alone?
translation: 你单独工作吗？

english: Nah! I 'ave a network of spies and pickpockets that roam the city. You might've seen 'em?
translation: 不！我有个在城市里活动的间谍和扒手网络。你可能见过他们？

english: Seen them? Not sure I have.
translation: 见过他们？不确定。

english: Hidden in plain sight. Perfect! Well it's all the street urchins of course. You can tell if they are part of my crew by the purple sash around their waist.
translation: 大隐隐于市。完美！嗯，当然是那些流浪儿。你可以通过他们腰上的紫色腰带来判断他们是否是我的手下。

english: Most of them lost their parents to the Colosseum, hoping to get glory for their family. The Colosseum 'owever, had other plans...
translation: 他们中大多数人的父母在竞技场丧生，曾希望为家族获得荣耀。然而，竞技场另有计划……

english: That's awful.
translation: 那太糟糕了。

english: It really is. They had nowhere to go and no food to eat, so I offered them a home, food, and all the gold they would ever need to 'ave a good life.
translation: 确实是。他们无处可去没东西吃，所以我给他们提供了一个家，食物，以及他们需要的所有金币来过好生活。

english: No one suspects them, which makes them perfect spies.
translation: 没人怀疑他们，这使他们成为完美的间谍。

english: Can they help me in anyway?
translation: 他们能以某种方式帮我吗？

english: Yes they can! Some in the residential area will point out houses free to rob, and some will be in and around the bazaar, distracting the wealthy citizens.
translation: 是的他们可以！住宅区的一些会指出可以抢劫的房子，有些会在集市和周围，干扰富有的市民。

english: Well that's handy.
translation: 嗯那很方便。

english: It sure is, but give them any trouble, and I'll throw you in the Colosseum myself.
translation: 确实是，但如果你给他们找麻烦，我会亲自把你扔进竞技场。

english: Understood.
translation: 明白了。

english: What's your story?
translation: 你的故事是什么？

english: Not much to tell really.
translation: 真的没什么可说的。

english: I was an orphan, much like these street urchins you see around the city. I spent my days running around scrounging for food and struggling to find somewhere to sleep.
translation: 我是个孤儿，很像你在城市周围看到的这些街头流浪儿。我整天跑来跑去觅食，努力找地方睡觉。

english: Eventually, I turned to a life of crime and thievery. Turns out I'm quite good at it.
translation: 最终，我转向了犯罪和偷窃的生活。结果我很擅长。

english: I took refuge in a small spot in the north east of the city. Out of sight, out of mind.
translation: 我在城市东北部的一个小地方避难。眼不见心不烦。

english: There I met with other orphans just like me. We all wanted payback. Payback on the city for forgetting about us.
translation: 在那里我遇到了其他像我一样的孤儿。我们都想要报复。报复这座城市忘记了我们的存在。

english: I'm sure there are better places for you and your crew to find refuge outside of the city. Even outside of Varlamore.
translation: 我相信城市和瓦拉莫尔之外有更好的地方让你和你的手下避难。

english: That may be the case, [player name], but I can't in good conscience leave any of the folk here who are struggling. I swore to help anyone in need.
translation: 可能是那样，[player name]，但我不能昧着良心离开这里那些正在挣扎的人。我发誓帮助任何需要帮助的人。

english: While the Colosseum still stands, family greed for glory will cost people. Some just their livelihoods, others their lives!
translation: 只要竞技场还存在，家族对荣耀的贪婪就会让人付出代价。有些人只是生计，有些人是生命！

english: So you really want to make a difference?
translation: 所以你真的想做出改变？

english: Well don't get me wrong, I still want to get filthy stinking rich as well!
translation: 嗯别误会我，我还是想变得富得流油！

english: Don't we all...
translation: 谁不是呢……

english: Managed to steal anything yet?
translation: 成功偷到什么了吗？

english: I have actually! I've found these valuables from some of the houses.
translation: 实际上我有！我从一些房子里找到了这些贵重物品。

english: Want some coin for those? I'll give you a good deal... One coin a piece.
translation: 想要换些金币吗？我给你个好价钱……一个换一枚金币。

english: One measly coin? That hardly seems worth it.
translation: 一枚可怜的金币？那似乎不值得。

english: The thing is, you won't be able to sell those yourself, making them worthless. Still, how 'bout five coins a piece?
translation: 问题是，你自己无法出售那些，使它们毫无价值。不过，五个金币一个怎么样？

english: That's crazy! Ever 'eard of inflation. It affects us thieves too...
translation: 那太疯狂了！听说过通货膨胀吗。它也影响我们小偷……

english: 30 coins. No higher.
translation: 30金币。不能再高。

english: 55 coins is my final offer.
translation: 55金币是我的最终报价。

english: 65 coins is my final offer. I've even throw in a little extra as you seem to be the talk of the town, [rank].
translation: 65金币是我的最终报价。我甚至额外加点因为你是城镇的热门话题，[rank]。

english: I suppose that's better than nothing.
translation: 我想那总比没有好。

english: Good. Do you want to trade them in now?
translation: 好。你想现在兑换吗？

english: Sure thing.
translation: 当然。

english: There ya go! Don't spend it all at once.
translation: 给你！别一次花光。

english: Not at the moment.
translation: 目前还没有。

english: Suit yourself. What to chat 'bout something else?
translation: 随你便。想聊点别的吗？

english: How's it going, [Player name]?
translation: 进展如何，[Player name]？

english: You don't seem to anything to trade in to me.
translation: 你似乎没什么要兑换给我的。

english: Do you know what these keys are for?
translation: 你知道这些钥匙是做什么的吗？

english: Can you tell me more about these rich folk?
translation: 你能多告诉我一些关于这些富人的事吗？

english: Tell me about the houses.
translation: 和我说说房子的事。

english: Tell me about the bazaar.
translation: 和我说说集市的事。

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: Do you work alone?
translation: 你单独工作吗？

english: What's your story?
translation: 你的故事是什么？

english: Sure thing.
translation: 当然。

english: Not at the moment.
translation: 目前还没有。

english: Uh, you guys aren't fairies - what are you doing here?
translation: 呃，你们不是精灵——你们在这里做什么？

english: Grunt! Smelly, stinky human! Urgh! Leave us alone before we hurt you.
translation: 哼！臭烘烘的人类！呃！在我们伤害你之前别烦我们。

english: G'day there, mate.
translation: 你好啊，伙计。

english: Good day. Are you alright? You look a little lost.
translation: 你好。你没事吧？你看起来有点迷路。

english: Well, mate, to tell you the truth, I think I've come a gutser with these displays.
translation: 嗯，伙计，说实话，我想我在这些展示上搞砸了。

english: Come a what?
translation: 搞砸了什么？

english: Gutser and no mistake. Me boss asked me to put together a quiz for the visitors.
translation: 搞砸了没错。我老板让我为游客准备一个测验。

english: But to be deadset with you, I wasn't paying much attention to me boss over there and I've done a bit of a rush job.
translation: 但老实跟你说，我没太注意那边的老板，我做得有点仓促。

english: You mean the natural historian?
translation: 你是说自然历史学家？

english: Yep, that's the bloke. Say, mate, you do me a favour?
translation: 是的，就是那家伙。说，伙计，帮我个忙？

english: Perhaps. What do you need?
translation: 也许。你需要什么？

english: Well, you look like a pretty smart cobber. Could you take a look at the display plaques and give 'em a runthrough?
translation: 嗯，你看起来是个聪明的伙计。你能看看展示牌并检查一遍吗？

english: Sure thing.
translation: 当然。

english: Bonza, mate! I reckon three questions per case should be bang to rights.
translation: 太棒了，伙计！我想每个箱子三个问题应该正好。

english: Take a gander at each case and I'll look over your shoulder to give some advice.
translation: 看看每个箱子我会在你身后给些建议。

english: Will do.
translation: 会的。

english: No thanks. I'm too busy.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。我太忙了。

english: Fair dinkum mate. I'm sure I'll get someone else to help me.
translation: 好吧。我肯定能找到别人帮我。

english: G'day there, mate. How're the display cases coming along?
translation: 你好啊，伙计。展示柜进展如何？

english: I haven't had the chance to take a look yet.
translation: 我还没机会看。

english: No worries, mate; just have a go when you can.
translation: 别担心，伙计；你有空就试试。

english: Hmm, I don't think that's right, mate. Try again.
translation: 嗯，我觉得那不对，伙计。再试一次。

english: Nice job, mate. That looks about right.
translation: 干得好，伙计。那看起来差不多对了。

english: Bonza, mate! I think that's all of them.
translation: 太棒了，伙计！我想就这些了。

english: Well done, mate. You finished all of the displays.
translation: 做得好，伙计。你完成了所有展示。

english: Come over and have a chat with me. I might have something for you.
translation: 过来跟我聊聊。我可能有东西给你。

english: I'm getting there. I still have a few left to do.
translation: 我正在做。我还有几个要做。

english: Bonza, mate. You're doing a great job so far.
translation: 太棒了，伙计。你目前做得很好。

english: Righty ho! I'll get back and finish the rest.
translation: 好的！我回去完成剩下的。

english: Good luck!
translation: 祝你好运！

english: All done. I've corrected the mistakes.
translation: 都完成了。我纠正了错误。

english: Beaut' mate! That's the best news I've had all day.
translation: 太好了伙计！那是我今天听到的最好的消息。

english: Glad I could help.
translation: 很高兴能帮忙。

english: Right, I'll have a chat to me boss over there and let him know you've helped me out.
translation: 好的，我去跟那边的老板聊聊让他知道你帮了我。

english: You know, with all this new information you've absorbed, I reckon you can say you're more experienced in Slaying and Hunting now.
translation: 你知道，吸收所有这些新信息后，我想你可以说你现在在杀戮和狩猎方面更有经验了。

english: Oh, thank you very much.
translation: 哦，非常感谢。

english: No worries, mate. You take care now.
translation: 别担心，伙计。你现在保重。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Thanks for all your help, mate. Hope you enjoy the museum!
translation: 谢谢你所有的帮助，伙计。希望你喜欢博物馆！

english: Sure thing.
translation: 当然。

english: No thanks I'm too busy.
translation: 不用了，谢谢我太忙了。

english: Hello, can I help?
translation: 你好，我能帮忙吗？

english: Yes please. What are you selling?
translation: 你在卖什么？

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Answer this, please.
translation: 请回答这个。

english: Well done.
translation: 做得好。

english: You've been given a [new clue/casket]!
translation: 你获得了一个 [new clue/casket]！

english: Yes please. What are you selling?
translation: 你在卖什么？

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Hi.
translation: 嗨。

english: You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 你知道吗，跟人打招呼的方式可多了。你好、嘿、你好啊……

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: 那也只能算一种！

english: Hello. How are you today?
translation: 你好。你今天怎么样？

english: I'm great, thank you!
translation: 我很好，谢谢！

english: Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 你好！水晶城今天天气真好，是吧？

english: Indeed.
translation: 确实。

english: What can I do for ya?
translation: 我能为你做什么？

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可做的？

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 各种各样的事！那些塔楼是非常值得一看的景观。

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 像今天这样的好日子，我建议去市场逛逛。

english: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你觉得你在做什么？

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可做的？

translation: 没什么。

english: Human.
translation: 人类。

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: This passage leads to the lair of what your kind call the Alchemical Hydra. It is an ancient beast, the only one of its kind.
translation: 这条通道通向你们称为炼金九头蛇的巢穴。它是古老的野兽，唯一的一种。

english: I am here to protect it. For protecting it will protect the balance. I make sure that only those who have permission can fight it.
translation: 我在这里保护它。因为保护它将保护平衡。我确保只有获得许可的人才能战斗。

english: How do I get permission?
translation: 我怎么获得许可？

english: Only Konar quo Maten can grant permission to fight the Alchemical Hydra. She will rarely grant this permission when the beast needs calming.
translation: 只有科纳‧夸‧马滕能授予战斗炼金九头蛇的许可。当野兽需要安抚时她很少授予此许可。

english: Thanks for the information.
translation: 谢谢你的信息。

english: Do you have any of my items?
translation: 你有我的任何物品吗？

english: I do not. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.
translation: 我没有。如果我确实有你的任何物品，但你在收集前死了，它们现在会丢失。

english: I do. I suppose you want them back.
translation: 我有。我想你想要回它们。

english: I have to go.
translation: 我得走了。

english: I don't have anything for you human. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.
translation: 我没有什么给你的，人类。如果我确实有你的任何物品，但你在收集前死了，它们现在会丢失。

english: Human! To attack that creature would be a threat to the balance. Only those with permission may fight it!
translation: 人类！攻击那个生物将威胁平衡。只有获得许可的人才能战斗！

english: I have some items of yours here human. I'd recommend you collect them before returning to the lair.
translation: 我这里有你的一些物品，人类。我建议你在返回巢穴前收集它们。

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Do you have any of my items?
translation: 你有我的任何物品吗？

english: Thanks for the information.
translation: 谢谢你的信息。

english: I have to go.
translation: 我得走了。

english: Enter the lair and risk losing those items.
translation: 进入巢穴并冒险丢失那些物品。

english: No - stay out.
translation: 不——别进去。

english: Hi there, friend!
translation: 你好，朋友！

english: Hello! You're not one of the hunters too, are you?
translation: 你好！你也不是猎人之一，对吧？

english: Oh no, but as someone that makes small soft versions of creatures, this is the place to be.
translation: 哦不，但作为制作生物毛绒玩偶的人，这是该来的地方。

english: These books and the hunters' reports all contain lovely details about my subject matter. I might never leave!
translation: 这些书和猎人的报告都包含关于我主题的精彩细节。我可能永远不离开！

english: I'd imagine this is the place to be for materials too. These hunters seem to find everything!
translation: 我想这也是获取材料的地方。这些猎人似乎能找到一切！

english: The cat is a great way to stress test some of the stitching too. He loves having something to play with!
translation: 猫也是压力测试一些缝线的好方法。他喜欢有东西玩！

english: Silver! Silver! Best prices for buying and selling in all Prifddinas!
translation: 银器！银器！普里夫迪纳斯全境买卖最佳价格！

english: No thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: You stole from me. Talk to me when you've considered your actions!
translation: 你偷了我的东西。等你考虑过你的行为后再跟我说话！

english: You're the one who stole something from me!
translation: 你是那个偷我东西的人！

english: Guards guards!
translation: 守卫守卫！

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Hello. I am Osman. What can I assist you with?
translation: 你好。我是奥斯曼。有什么能帮你的？

english: You don't seem very tough. Who are you?
translation: 你看起来不太厉害。你是谁？

english: I work for Al Kharid's Emir. That is all you need to know.
translation: 我为阿尔卡里德城的首长工作。那是你需要知道的全部。

english: Nothing. I'm just being nosy.
translation: 没什么。我只是好奇。

english: That bothers me not. The secrets of Al Kharid protect themselves.
translation: 那我不在意。阿尔卡里德的秘密自我保护。

english: Well done. A great rescue. I will remember you if I have anything dangerous to do.
translation: 做得好，救援得很出色。如果我有危险的事要做我会记住你。

english: Hello again.
translation: 又见面了。

english: I want to talk to you about Sophanem.
translation: 我想跟你谈谈索法尼恩城。

english: Yes, quite the interesting set of events. I suspect I won't be heading back down there any time soon.
translation: 是的，相当有趣的一系列事件。我想我短期内不会回那里了。

english: Do you have any more of those daggers?
translation: 你还有更多那种匕首吗？

english: Of course. They're a standard piece of equipment for us. The enchantments upon them make them very useful against both scarabs and kalphites. If you want, I can sell you another for 20,000 coins?
translation: 当然。那是我们的标准装备。上面的附魔使它们对圣甲虫和卡尔夫特虫都非常有用。如果你想要，我可以再卖你一个20,000金币？

english: I'll take one.
translation: 我要一个。

english: Actually, I don't seem to have enough money on me.
translation: 其实，我身上似乎没有足够的钱。

english: Actually, I don't seem to have enough room to carry it.
translation: 其实，我似乎没有足够的空间拿它。

english: That's too much.
translation: 那太多了。

english: Well you know where I am if you reconsider.
translation: 如果你考虑好，你知道在哪里找我的。

english: What are your plans for Menaphos now?
translation: 你现在对梅纳菲斯有什么计划？

english: I think you already know the answer to that.
translation: 我想你已经知道答案了。

english: I'm not allowed to know, am I?
translation: 我不被允许知道，对吧？

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们聊聊别的事。

english: As you wish.
translation: 如你所愿。

english: I should go.
translation: 我该走了。

english: Until next time.
translation: 下次见。

english: I need to go.
translation: 我得走了。

english: I have some sq'irk juice for you.
translation: 我有些香橙汁给你。

english: Osman imparts some Thieving advice to you ([amount] Thieving experience points) as a reward for the sq'irk juice.

english: Thank you very much [player name]. If you get some more sq'irks be sure to come back.
translation: 非常感谢 [player name]。如果你得到更多香橙务必回来。

english: I will. It's been a pleasure doing business with you.
translation: 我会的。很高兴跟你做生意。

english: I'd like to talk about sq'irks.
translation: 我想谈谈香橙。

english: Where am I meant to find sq'irks?
translation: 我应该在哪找到香橙？

english: There is a sorceress near the south-eastern edge of Al Kharid who grows them. Once upon a time, we considered each other friends.
translation: 阿尔卡里德城东南边缘附近有个女巫种植它们。曾经，我们视彼此为朋友。

english: What happened?
translation: 发生了什么事？

english: We fell out, and now she won't give me any more fruit.
translation: 我们闹翻了，现在她不给我更多水果了。

english: So all I have to do is ask her for some fruit for you?
translation: 所以我只需替你去向她要些水果？

english: I doubt it will be that easy. She is not renowned for her generosity and is very secretive about her garden's location.
translation: 我怀疑没那么容易。她不以其慷慨闻名且对其花园位置非常保密。

english: Oh come on, it should be easy enough to find.
translation: 哦拜托，应该足够容易找到。

english: Her garden has remained hidden even to me - the chief spy of Al Kharid. I believe her garden must be hidden by magical means.
translation: 她的花园甚至对我——阿尔卡里德城的首席间谍——都保持隐藏。我相信她的花园一定是被魔法隐藏了。

english: This should be an interesting task. How many sq'irks do you want?
translation: 这应该是个有趣的任务。你想要多少香橙？

english: I'll reward you for as many as you can get your hands on, but could you please squeeze the fruit into a glass first?
translation: 我会奖励你能拿到的所有香橙，但你能先把水果挤进杯子里吗？

english: I've another question about sq'irks.
translation: 我有关于香橙的另一个问题。

english: What would you like to know?
translation: 你想了解什么？

english: Thanks for the information.
translation: 谢谢你的信息。

english: Why can't you get the sq'irks yourself?
translation: 你为什么不能自己拿到香橙？

english: I may have mentioned that I had a falling out with the Sorceress. Well, unsurprisingly, she refuses to give me any more of her garden's produce.
translation: 我可能提过我和女巫闹翻了。嗯，不出所料，她拒绝给我更多她花园的产物。

english: How should I squeeze the fruit?
translation: 我该怎么挤水果？

english: Use a pestle and mortar to squeeze the sq'irks. Make sure you have an empty glass with you to collect the juice.
translation: 用研钵和杵挤香橙。确保你有个空杯子收集果汁。

english: Is there a reward for getting these sq'irks?
translation: 拿到这些香橙有奖励吗？

english: Of course there is. I am a generous man. I'll teach you the art of Thieving for your troubles.
translation: 当然有。我是个慷慨的人。我会为你的麻烦教你偷窃技艺。

english: How much training will you give?
translation: 你会给多少训练？

english: That depends on the quantity and ripeness of the sq'irks you put into the juice.
translation: 那取决于你放入果汁的香橙数量和成熟度。

english: That sounds fair enough.
translation: 那听起来相当公平。

english: What's so good about sq'irk juice then?
translation: 那么香橙汁有什么好？

english: Ah it's sweet, sweet nectar for a thief or spy; it makes light fingers lighter, fleet feet flightier and comes in four different colours for those who are easily amused.
translation: 啊，那是小偷或间谍的甜蜜甘露；它让巧手更巧，快腿更快，且有四种不同颜色给那些容易逗乐的人。

english: Osman starts salivating at the thought of sq'irk juice.
translation: 奥斯曼一想到香橙汁就开始流口水。

english: It wouldn't have addictive properties, would it?
translation: 它不会有成瘾性吧？

english: It only holds power over those with poor self-control, something which I have an abundance of.
translation: 它只对自控力差的人有力量，而我恰恰缺乏那个。

english: I see.
translation: 我明白了。

english: Well done. I have new information to share with you.

english: You can call me Osman, even though I am the man who is not Osman.

english: So... you're one of his agents then? But you look just like him?

english: Of course I look like him. I'm in disguise. What sort of spy would look like a spy?

english: Well the last time I worked with Osman there was some business with really bad wigs.

english: Right... Let's change the subject to something Osman might talk about. I don't want to blow my cover.

english: As you approach the spirit, you hear a voice echoing in your head.
translation: 当你靠近灵魂时，你听到一个声音在脑海中回荡。

english: You. You fought against the Devourer. Her influence here has been lessened as a result. You are to be commended for your strength.
translation: 你。你曾与吞噬者战斗过。因此她在这里的影响力已被削弱。你的实力值得称赞。

english: I take it you're Osmumten?
translation: 我想你就是奥斯穆滕吧？

english: Once, but who I was in life means nothing. Vengeance is all that matters now. The Devourer may be gone, but my home has been corrupted. This corruption must be destroyed.
translation: 曾经是，但我生前的身份已毫无意义。现在唯有复仇最重要。吞噬者或许已离去，但我的家园已被腐蚀。这种腐蚀必须被摧毁。

english: Can I help?
translation: 我能帮忙吗？

english: You can. Take your prize and leave, but when you are ready, return here. The Devourer's thralls will soon be back. You must fight them.
translation: 你可以。拿走你的奖赏离开吧，但当你准备好后，再回来这里。吞噬者的仆从很快就会回来。你必须与他们战斗。

english: I'll do what I can.

english: We shall see if it is enough.
translation: 我们拭目以待是否足够。

english: Yes.

english: No.

english: You have done well, but it is time for you to leave. The Devourer's thralls will soon return.

english: You fought well. The Devourer's influence here has lessened, but it will soon be restored. It is time for you to leave.

english: The Devourer's thralls will be back, but they have been weakened because of you. Now, leave this place.

english: We are done here, but the Devourer's thralls are everywhere. They must be removed.

english: Tell me more.

translation: 你可能已经知道，库兰德王国幅员辽阔。许多冒险者选择穿着特殊服装，让他们能够快速而优雅地探索。

english: As official tailor for Kourend, I can recolour this clothing, allowing adventurers to represent the city to which they are most loyal.
translation: 作为库兰德王国的官方裁缝，我可以重新染色这些服装，让冒险者代表他们最忠诚的城市。

english: If you are interested, I would be more than happy to offer my tailoring services in exchange for Marks of Grace.

english: I'd like to recolour my graceful clothing.
