english: Yes I'm sure.
translation: 是的我确定。

english: Actually, I've changed my mind.
translation: 其实我改变主意了。

english: Nevermind
translation: 没关系

english: Let's talk about normal ones.
translation: 我们聊聊普通的。

english: Rare.
translation: 稀有。

english: Normal.
translation: 普通。

english: Hi there Pete.
translation: 你好皮特。

english: Argh! Who be there?
translation: 啊！谁在那里？

english: Oh, it's just the adventurer, phew! Things can be scary around here, I've seen some weeeeeiiiird stuff in that cavern.
translation: 哦，只是冒险者，呼！这附近的事情可能很可怕，我在那个洞穴里见过一些奇奇怪怪的东西。

english: What is in the cavern?
translation: 洞穴里有什么？

english: Oh no, now I'm thinking about it again!*screams*
translation: 哦不，现在我又想起来了！尖叫

english: Okay okay, calm down! Why are you guarding it? What is the purpose of this cavern?
translation: 好了好了，冷静点！你为什么守着它？这个洞穴的目的是什么？

english: It's a mine. It's special but dangerous, things move around and the mine could collapse at any moment!.
translation: 这是个矿场。很特别但很危险，东西会移动，矿场随时可能坍塌！

english: I'd say you'll need at least level 50 Mining to be capable.
translation: 我想你至少需要50级采矿才能胜任。

english: I'm not quite up to scratch then...
translation: 那我还不够格……

english: Well sounds like I am capable then!
translation: 那听起来我够格了！

english: The main idea is to chip down the big boulders, in order to find the fragments inside. Deliver them to me and I'll show you some minin' tips to help you get better at it.
translation: 主要想法是敲碎大岩石，找到里面的碎片。把它们交给我，我会给你一些采矿技巧帮你做得更好。

english: How do I traverse the mine? Isn't it full of lava?
translation: 我如何穿越矿场？里面不是充满熔岩吗？

english: I have a handy supply of heat-proof water containers. I'll give them out to anyone going in with bit of water inside. They only hold so much though.
translation: 我有现成的耐热水容器。我会发给任何进去的人，里面装一点水。不过容量有限。

english: I reckon you could harden the lava with it! Just throw a bit of water on it. Make yourself a path, but be careful, they won't last forever.
translation: 我想你可以用它硬化熔岩！只要洒点水在上面。给自己铺条路，但小心点，它们不会永久存在。

english: Anything else?
translation: 还有别的吗？

english: Uh oh, there is one more thing, but it hurts. My backside has never felt the same since, one of the reasons I don't dare go in there anymore. There are some gas holes around, just feel 'em.
translation: 呃哦，还有一件事，但很疼。从那以后我的屁股再也没好过，这是我不敢再进去的原因之一。周围有一些气孔，摸摸它们就行。

english: How do I keep the mine stable?
translation: 我如何保持矿场稳定？

english: Don't let it collapse!! It's petrifying, it will stick with you forever. The rumbles create a flashback in my mind, arghhh.
translation: 别让它坍塌！！太可怕了，会永远留在你脑海里。轰鸣声让我产生闪回，啊啊啊。

english: There are some vents and chambers in there. Do better than I did with them, you want around a 50% gas level in each chamber.
translation: 里面有一些通风口和腔室。做得比我好点，你希望每个腔室内的气体浓度维持在50% 左右。

english: There are 3 in total, we spent awhile coming up with names, such as 'Vent west of the pillar near the entrance on the left hand side', but decided A, B and C would be easier.
translation: 总共有3个，我们花了一些时间想名字，比如''入口左侧柱子西边的通风口''，但决定用 A、B 和 C 更简单。

english: Presumably, a western chamber, central chamber and eastern chamber?
translation: 大概是西侧腔室、中央腔室和东侧腔室？

english: Yep! That's right. Block the chamber to let gas build up, unblock 'em to let gas out. Any creatures in there will cause instability too.
translation: 对！没错。堵住腔室让气体积聚，打开通道让气体排出。里面的任何生物也会造成不稳定。

english: Oh, also, if you have more than one rock to mine, keep them going at roughly the same pace too. Everything gets a bit wobbly if you proceed too quickly down one channel.
translation: 哦，还有，若你有多块岩石要开采，也请保持它们大致同步推进。若在某条通道上进展过快，整体结构都会有些不稳。

english: Explain the dangers for me.
translation: 给我解释一下危险。

english: It is bad, very bad in there. If you're not prepared, you will be done for. Wouldn't catch me in there.
translation: 里面很糟糕，非常糟糕。如果你没准备好，你就完了。我可不会进去。

english: Okay, so how do I prepare?
translation: 好的，那我如何准备？

english: Look out for the Lava beasts, they'll throw projectiles at anyone they see. You'll have stalacmitesfalling on you, fire jumping out the lava towards you. Seriously, you're insane.
translation: 小心熔岩兽，它们会向看到的任何人投掷投射物。会有钟乳石掉在你身上，火焰从熔岩中向你跳来。说真的，你疯了。

english: Thanks, I'll keep that in mind.
translation: 谢谢，我会记住的。

english: Can I go inside?
translation: 我能进去吗？

english: There are some crazy things down there, I don't think you're capable.
translation: 下面有些危险玩意儿，我看你还不够资格。

english: You need at least 50 Mining to enter the Volcanic Mine.
translation: 你需要至少50级采矿才能进入火山矿场。

english: Well luckily for you, or rather, unlucky for you, I'll let you go inside as you've definitely got the mining skills.
translation: 嗯，对你来说算幸运，或者说不幸，我会放你进去，毕竟你确实有采矿的本事。

english: I'll have to charge you though - upkeep of this place ain't cheap and cheerful. I'll need 30 Numulites for one visit or 3,000 for unlimited trips.
translation: 不过我得收费——维护这地方可不便宜也不轻松。单次进入需30枚纳穆莱特，无限次进入则需3,000枚。

english: I don't have 30 Numulites with me unfortunately.
translation: 不幸的是我身上没有30个纳穆莱特。

english: Thanks [player name]. That will grant you access to the mine. You're a crazy one.
translation: 谢谢 [player name]。这将授予你进入矿场的权限。你真是个疯子。

english: You can now enter the Volcanic Mine. Should you leave, Pete would expect payment again.
translation: 你现在可以进入火山矿场。若你离开，皮特会再次收取费用。

english: Thanks [player name]. That will grant you permanent access to the mine. You're a crazy one.
translation: 谢谢 [player name]。这将授予你永久进入矿场的权限。你真是个疯子。

english: You can now enter the Volcanic Mine. Pete will not ask you for payment again.
translation: 你现在可以进入火山矿场。皮特不会再向你收取费用。

english: You've already paid the entrance fee too, so you can head right on in.
translation: 你也已经付了入场费，所以可以直接进去。

english: I've got some of your stuff that you left here earlier. You'd better deal with it before trying to go into the cavern again.
translation: 我这儿有你之前落下的东西。你最好在再次进入洞穴前先处理一下。

english: Have you anything to trade?
translation: 你有什么可以交易的吗？

english: Have you picked up anything I left in the mine?
translation: 你捡到我留在矿场里的任何东西了吗？

english: Sorry, I've got nothing for you. I'm not sure what you'd have been doing in there anyway, since I wouldn't expect to let you in.
translation: 抱歉，我没什么能给你的。我也不确定你当初在里面做什么，毕竟我本来就没打算放你进去。

english: Sorry, I've got nothing for you. If I had some of your stuff earlier, but you died before collecting it, it'd be lost.
translation: 抱歉，我没什么给你的。如果我之前有你的一些东西，但你在收集前死了，那就丢失了。

english: I'll leave you be.
translation: 我就不打扰你了。

english: There are some crazy things down there, I don't think you're capable so I'll let you keep your Numulites.
translation: 下面有一些疯狂的东西，我认为你不够格，所以我让你保留你的纳穆莱特。

english: It doesn't look like you have 30 Numulites with you unfortunately.
translation: 不幸的是你身上好像没有30个纳穆莱特。

english: You've already paid up! You can head right on in. Better you than me...
translation: 你已经付过钱了！可以直接进去。你去比我好……

english: Sorry, I'll need paying before I can return your stuff.
translation: 抱歉，我需要先收到付款才能归还你的东西。

english: Sorry [player name], you won't last a minute in there. You got to prove yourself as a capable archeologist, and be good at the minin'.
translation: 抱歉 [player name]，你在那里撑不了一分钟。你得证明自己是个有能力的考古学家，并且擅长采矿。

english: Sorry [player name] I can't let people head in mid way through a mine out session. It's not safe and will cause mine collapse!
translation: 抱歉 [player name]，我不能让人们在采矿会话中途进入。这不安全，会导致矿场坍塌！

english: Pete quickly hands you a heat-proof vessel filled with some water.
translation: 皮特迅速递给你一个装满水的耐热容器。

english: The mine is currently dormant, and will awaken within the next 30 seconds.
translation: 矿场目前处于休眠状态，将在接下来30秒内苏醒。

english: Sorry [player name], I cannot allow someone to go in there without paying first. Come see me.
translation: 抱歉 [player name]，我不能允许有人不先付款就进去。来找我。

english: You should probably pick up the stuff you left in there earlier before you return. Come and see me.
translation: 你可能应该在返回之前先捡起你之前留在那里的东西。来找我。

english: Well why am I going to reward you for that?! Might wanna contribute next time. I am not standin' out here for nothin'.
translation: 那我为什么要为此奖励你？！下次可能想贡献一下。我不是无缘无故站在这里的。

english: I'll give you a bit of minin' trainin' and I'll remember the contribution you've made.
translation: 我会给你一些采矿训练，我会记住你做出的贡献。

english: I'll quickly take those fragments off your hands [player name], thank you! I'll give you a bit of minin' trainin' and I'll remember the contribution you've made.
translation: 我很快从你手中接过那些碎片 [player name]，谢谢！我会给你一些采矿训练，我会记住你做出的贡献。

english: [player name] has started up a mine! Join [him/her/them] down there now!
translation: [player name] 已经启动了一个矿场！现在加入 [him/her/them] 下去吧！

english: Hi Pete, I found this in one of my ore packs...
translation: 你好皮特，我在我的矿石包里发现了这个……

english: Woah, what is that you've got there?!
translation: 哇，你那里拿的是什么？！

english: It's... a pickaxe, a broken one.
translation: 是……一把镐子，一把坏的。

english: That's not just any broken pickaxe, it's a dragon one! They're really rare!
translation: 那可不是普通的坏镐子，是龙金镐！非常稀有！

english: I have no idea how that ended up in your ore pack, but you can keep it, it's broken anyway.
translation: 我不知道它怎么进了你的矿石包，但你可以留着，反正它坏了。

english: Maybe you can find someone to help you repair it! I've heard tales that some dwarves used to fix pickaxes.
translation: 也许你能找人帮你修理它！我听说过有些矮人以前会修理镐子。

english: One of them was called Nurmof. I think he used to reside in the Falador mines. If you're lucky, he could still be there.
translation: 其中一个叫努尔莫夫。我想他以前住在法拉多城矿场。如果你幸运，他可能还在那里。

english: Nice one [player name]! In futureI'll give you twice as much water when you go into the mine!
translation: 干得好 [player name]！以后你进矿场时我会给你两倍的水！

english: Sorry [player name], this a Deadman world. People are fighting all over the shop. No one gets in the mine here!
translation: 抱歉 [player name]，这是死人世界。人们到处打架。这里没人能进矿场！

english: What is in the cavern?
translation: 洞穴里有什么？

english: How do I traverse the mine?
translation: 我如何穿越矿场？

english: How do I keep the mine stable?
translation: 我如何保持矿场稳定？

english: Explain the dangers for me.
translation: 给我解释一下危险。

english: Can I go inside?
translation: 我能进去吗？

english: I'll leave you be.
translation: 我就不打扰你了。

english: Pay 30 Numulites for one visit.
translation: 支付30个纳穆莱特进行一次访问。

english: Pay 3,000 Numulites for permanent access.
translation: 支付3,000个纳穆莱特获得永久访问权。

english: Keep your Numulites.
translation: 保留你的纳穆莱特。

english: Have you anything to trade?
translation: 你有什么可以交易的吗？

english: Have you picked up anything I left in the mine?
translation: 你捡到我留在矿场里的任何东西了吗？

english: Pay the fee.
translation: 支付费用。

english: Yes, pay 150 x Numulite.
translation: 是的，支付150x 纳穆莱特。

english: Yes, pay 150 x Numulite and don't ask me again..
translation: 是的，支付150x 纳穆莱特，别再问我了。

english: No, don't pay.
translation: 不，不付钱。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Oh, hello! Have you come to see the minotaurs? No one ever comes to see the minotaurs, but they love having guests!
translation: 哦，你好！你是来看牛头人的吗？从没人来看牛头人，但它们喜欢有客人！

english: They do?
translation: 真的吗？

english: Of course! Most people are scared of them. It's sad in a way. They're such misunderstood creatures, but they're massive softies once you get to know them!
translation: 当然！大多数人都怕它们。从某种意义上说很悲哀。它们是被严重误解的生物，但一旦你了解它们，它们其实很温柔！

english: I see...
translation: 我明白了……

english: You'll find them down in the cave if you want to say hello! They'll be thrilled to see you!
translation: 如果你想打招呼，可以在洞穴里找到它们！见到你它们会很兴奋！

english: Oh, hello again! Have you been spending time with the minotaurs? They always love it when people come to visit! Such wonderful creatures...
translation: 哦，又见面了！你和牛头人待在一起了吗？它们总是喜欢有人来拜访！多么美妙的生物……

english: Wow, didn't expect to find a scientist out here.
translation: 哇，没想到在这里遇到科学家。

english: I'm out here on a mission, do you think I chose to hang around these lowlifes?
translation: 我是来这里执行任务的，你以为我选择跟这些混混混在一起吗？

english: I'm not one to judge.
translation: 我不是评判的人。

english: What is this 'mission' you mentioned?
translation: 你提到的这个''任务''是什么？

english: I'm out here to conduct research, I've been told a giant spider lurks in the heart of the Wilderness.
translation: 我是来这里做研究的，我听说一只巨型蜘蛛潜伏在荒野中心。

english: Her venom is priceless and it would aid me greatly in my research.
translation: 它的毒液无价，对我的研究有很大帮助。

english: Research? What could you possibly want with a giant spider's venom?
translation: 研究？你想要巨型蜘蛛的毒液做什么？

english: Venenatis is the last of her kind. Lots of giant spiders used to dwell deep in the mountains until the savage dwarves killed them all.
translation: 维尼纳蒂斯是同类中最后一只。很多巨型蜘蛛曾经栖息在深山深处，直到野蛮的矮人把它们都杀光了。

english: She is the last one left and I must have a sample of her venom.
translation: 她是最后一只，我必须拿到她的毒液样本。

english: What I want with the specimen however, is none of your business!
translation: 但我想用样本做什么，不关你的事！

english: Woah sorry, didn't mean to touch a nerve. Fighting a giant spider sounds like a great idea.
translation: 哇抱歉，没想到触到痛处。和巨型蜘蛛战斗听起来是个好主意。

english: I've tried to put it off for as long as I could, but this is the final component needed for my research.
translation: 我尽量拖延了很久，但这是我研究所需的最后成分。

english: Then what are you waiting around here for? Go out there and fight her.
translation: 那你在这里等什么？出去和她战斗吧。

english: Are you sure you're equipped to take it down? I've had the displeasure of dealing with Venenatis, she will not go down easily.
translation: 你确定你有装备能打败她？我曾不幸与维尼纳蒂斯交过手，她不会轻易被打败。

english: It will not be easy, but if I can get her when she's wounded in her lair, it should be a fairer fight.
translation: 不容易，但如果我能在她受伤时在巢穴里找到她，应该会是更公平的战斗。

english: I didn't know she had a lair. I thought she just roamed the Wilderness.
translation: 我不知道她有巢穴。我以为她只是在荒野中游荡。

english: She only returns there to lick her wounds and rest, I need to be patient.
translation: 她只回那里舔舐伤口和休息，我需要耐心。

english: So that explains why you're waiting here.
translation: 那就解释了你为什么在这里等了。

english: I would go out and fight her now, but I must admit, I am also a little scared. I've never been in a fight before.
translation: 我现在会出去和她战斗，但我必须承认，我也有点害怕。我以前从未参加过战斗。

english: I'm sure you'll be alright, it's just a gigantic spider!
translation: 我相信你会没事的，只是一只巨大的蜘蛛！

english: Thanks for your words of confidence...
translation: 谢谢你鼓励的话……

english: Hey. Do you know anything about this?
translation: 嘿。你知道关于这个的事吗？

english: Well, would you look at that. Most fascinating.
translation: 嗯，你看看这个。太迷人了。

english: Could you tell me what's so fascinating?
translation: 你能告诉我有什么迷人的吗？

english: It's a rare Zamorakian artifact. I haven't seen any quite like this one before.
translation: 这是一件稀有的扎莫拉克神器。我以前从未见过这样的。

english: If you look closely, you can see that it has a socket where you can place an item to increase its power.
translation: 如果你仔细看，可以看到它有一个插槽，你可以放置物品来增加它的力量。

english: Interesting! I'll be on the lookout for that.
translation: 有趣！我会留意的。

english: So it's real. Magnificent.
translation: 所以是真的。太棒了。

english: You've seen this before?
translation: 你以前见过这个吗？

english: No, but I have heard tales of the mighty Vet'Ion.
translation: 没有，但我听说过强大的维蒂安的传说。

english: It is said his skull can power a certain Zamorakian weapon.
translation: 据说他的头骨可以为某种扎莫拉克武器提供能量。

english: Oh, like this skull?
translation: 哦，像这个头骨？

english: Yes, like that one! That looks powerful indeed. I think that would do quite nicely.
translation: 是的，像那个！那看起来确实很强大。我想那会很好用。

english: A skilled crafter can combine the two. If you wish, I could do it for you... For a price, that is.
translation: 熟练的工匠可以把两者结合起来。如果你愿意，我可以为你做……当然，要收费。

english: I don't have the money for that.
translation: 我没有钱做那个。

english: Feel free to come back when you do.
translation: 有钱时随时回来。

english: There we go! All done.
translation: 好了！完成了。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: No, I'm afraid not.
translation: 不，恐怕不行。

english: Oh. Do you know someone who might know more?
translation: 哦。你认识可能知道更多的人吗？

english: Andros Mai is a very... Devoted man. If you can see past that, he may be able to help you.
translation: 安德罗斯‧迈是个非常……虔诚的人。如果你能看透那一点，他也许能帮你。

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！

english: Yes! Those belong to Venenatis!
translation: 是的！那些属于维尼纳蒂斯！

english: Ah, but they contain no more venom. That is disappointing.
translation: 啊，但它们不再含有毒液。真令人失望。

english: So you're saying they're useless?
translation: 所以你是说它们没用？

english: To me? Yes. But maybe not to you.
translation: 对我？是的。但也许对你不是。

english: I've seen that Derse Venator guy over there handle similar items. Perhaps he knows more.
translation: 我看到那边有个叫德斯‧维纳托的家伙处理过类似的物品。也许他知道更多。

english: Downstairs there's a strange looking person. I don't know what that item is, but if anyone would, I reckon she would.
translation: 楼下有个长相奇怪的人。我不知道那物品是什么，但如果有人知道，我想她会知道。

english: I think she said her name was Madam Sikaro.
translation: 我想她说她叫西卡罗夫人。

english: You look ready for combat.
translation: 你看起来准备好战斗了。

english: Ask about rare item.
translation: 询问稀有物品。

english: Yes
translation: 是

english: No
translation: 否

english: Hello, what is this place?
translation: 你好，这是什么地方？

english: This is Seers Village! We're an organisation of mystically gifted people with the power of foresight...we see things that have yet to come to pass.
translation: 这里是先知村！我们是一个有神秘天赋的组织，拥有预知能力……我们能看到尚未发生的事情。

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: A lot of our time is spent addressing everyday sorts of things, plus we meditate a lot and enhance our powers of mystical foresight.

english: I worked in a chapel dedicated to our lord, Saradomin. My task was to light the chapel candles, but I couldn't reach them myself and I kept getting dazzled by the light whenever I tried.
translation: 我在一个奉献给我们主萨拉多明的教堂工作。我的任务是点燃教堂蜡烛，但我自己够不到它们，每次尝试都会被光眩目。

english: I'd call adventurers from across the world, summoning them to my chapel to do the task for me. I needed them to light the tall candles, but not the short ones.
translation: 我会召唤来自世界各地的冒险者，召唤他们到我的教堂为我做任务。我需要他们点燃高蜡烛，而不是矮的。

english: However, adventurers got confused, and thought they should light the short candles as well as the tall candles, so I made them try again. And again.
translation: 然而，冒险者搞混了，认为他们应该点燃矮蜡烛和高蜡烛，所以我让他们再试一次。又一次。

english: Eventually my chapel was closed down. They said I'd trapped adventurers there for too long. All I wanted was for them to light the tall candles without lighting the short candles!
translation: 最终我的教堂被关闭了。他们说我把冒险者困在那里太久了。我只想要他们点燃高蜡烛而不点燃矮蜡烛！

english: Anyway, now I live here, and remember the good old days. It is nice to meet you, [player name].
translation: 不管怎样，现在我住在这里，回忆美好的旧时光。很高兴见到你，[player name]。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: So your name is Pete?
translation: 所以你的名字是皮特？

english: Yes, it is a common name. I also know of Party Pete, Parroty Pete, Postie Pete, Pirate Pete, Petrified Pete and 'Picarron' Pete. The Makeover Mage has used the name Pete too.
translation: 是的，这是个 common 名字。我还知道派对皮特、鹦鹉皮特、邮差皮特、海盗皮特、石化皮特和“皮卡龙”皮特。改造法师也用过皮特这个名字。

english: Although we are not related, the shared bond of that name can be a comfort in dark times.
translation: 虽然我们没有亲属关系，但那个名字的共同纽带可以在黑暗时期带来安慰。

english: What did you do before you came here?
translation: 你来这里之前做什么？

english: So your name is Pete?
translation: 所以你的名字是皮特？

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: Yo ho ho and bottle of alcopop!
translation: 哟吼吼和一瓶酒精饮料！

english: Oooh arrh!
translation: 哦啊！

english: No wait. That's a farmer.
translation: 不等等。那是个农夫。

english: Good day to you my dear sir!
translation: 你好我亲爱的先生！

english: Arrh be off with ye!
translation: 啊走开吧你！

english: 3 days at port for resupply then out on the high sea!
translation: 在港口补给3天然后出海！

english: Arrh arrh!
translation: 啊啊！

english: Arrh ye scurvy sea dog!
translation: 啊你这坏血病海狗！

english: A pox on ye!
translation: 诅咒你！

english: Arrh! I be in search of buried treasure!
translation: 啊！我在寻找埋藏的宝藏！

english: Ahoy there!
translation: 喂！

english: Avast me hearties!
translation: 停下我的伙计们！

english: Shiver me timbers!
translation: 吓死我了！

english: You'll be joining Davey Jones in his locker!
translation: 你要去见戴维‧琼斯了！

english: Arrrh ye lily livered landlubber!
translation: 啊你这胆小鬼旱鸭子！

english: Arrh!
translation: 啊！

english: Avast behind!
translation: 后面停下！

english: I'm not that fat!
translation: 我没那么胖！

english: Batton down the hatches there's a storm a brewin!
translation: 关上舱口风暴要来了！

english: All hands on deck!
translation: 所有人上甲板！

english: Yo ho ho me hearties!
translation: 哟吼吼我的伙计们！

english: Man overboard!
translation: 有人落水！

english: Keel haul them I say!
translation: 我说龙骨拖曳他们！

english: I think ye'll be taking a long walk off a short plank!
translation: 我想你要从短木板上走长路了！

english: Splice the mainbrace!
translation: 接主桅索！

english: I'm the scourge of the seven seas!
translation: 我是七海的祸害！

english: Yo ho ho and a bottle of rum!
translation: 哟吼吼和一瓶朗姆酒！

english: Pieces of eight! pieces of eight!
translation: 八里亚尔！八里亚尔！

english: Oh wait that's the parrot's line.
translation: 哦等等那是鹦鹉的台词。

english: Great blackbeard's beard!
translation: 伟大的黑胡子胡子！

english: I'm the scourge of the six seas!
translation: 我是六海的祸害！

english: Don't you mean seven seas?
translation: 你不是说七海吗？

english: Arrh I'll keel haul ye!
translation: 啊我要龙骨拖曳你！

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Arrr?
translation: 啊？

english: What are you doing down here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: You can't have me treasure!
translation: 你不能拿我的宝藏！

english: What treasure?
translation: 什么宝藏？

english: Where's the treasure? Who told ye about me treasure?
translation: 宝藏在哪？谁告诉你关于我的宝藏？

english: I don't know, you said something about treasure.
translation: 我不知道，你说了些关于宝藏的事。

english: Ain't no treasure down 'ere.
translation: 这里没宝藏。

english: So why are you here?
translation: 那你为什么在这里？

english: Takin' a walk, gettin' some air.
translation: 散散步，透透气。

english: Riiiiight.
translation: 好吧。

english: Arr? Be ye wantin' te go on account with our gang o' fillibusters?
translation: 啊？你想跟咱们这帮海盗一起干吗？

english: The powder monkey be takin' a caulk after gettin' rowdy on bumboo, so there be plenty of room for ye.
translation: 火药童子喝多了朗姆酒正在睡觉，所以船上还有很多空位给你。

english: Riiiiight...
translation: 好吧……

english: I'll just be over here if you need me.
translation: 有需要我就在这儿。

english: What's a landlubber like ye doin' here?
translation: 像你这样的旱鸭子在这里做什么？

english: Helping Cap'n Teach shoot his way through a little blockade.
translation: 帮蒂奇船长 shooting 通过一个小封锁。

english: Well done to ye. I'll see ye around.
translation: 干得好。回头见。

english: Why is this place walled off?
translation: 为什么这个地方被墙围起来？

english: Well [lad/lass], it's 'cos there be foul things in the jungle beyond.
translation: 嗯 [lad/lass]，因为那边的丛林里有脏东西。

english: What sort of foul things?
translation: 什么样的脏东西？

english: Big 'uns, nasty 'uns. You name it, we got it.
translation: 大的，脏的。你说得出，我们有。

english: There be Jungle Horrors in the jungles, and Cave Horrors in the caves.
translation: 丛林里有丛林恐怖，洞穴里有洞穴恐怖。

english: Tis no place te be havin' a picnic and no mistake.
translation: 那绝不是野餐的地方没错。

english: Watch where yer goin'!
translation: 看着点路！

english: I was!
translation: 我看着了！

english: Then it must have been my fault and I apologise [lad/lass].
translation: 那一定是我的错我道歉 [lad/lass]。

english: And I accept your apology. Good day.
translation: 我接受你的道歉。你好。

english: Aye, good day te ye too.
translation: 是的，也祝你日安。

english: Arr!
translation: 啊！

english: Arr?
translation: 啊？

english: Arr?
translation: 啊？

english: Arr!
translation: 啊！

english: Arr...
Arr.
translation: 啊。

english: Good morning!
translation: 早上好！

english: I suppose it is. What of it?
translation: 我想是的。怎么了？

english: I was just striking up a conversation.
translation: 我只是想搭个话。

english: Well...why would ye do a thing like that?
translation: 嗯……你为什么要那样做？

english: No reason.
translation: 没理由。

english: What ship did ye pull in on, stranger?
translation: 你坐什么船来的，陌生人？

english: The Adventurous.
translation: 冒险号。

english: That's a good ship, that it be.
translation: 那是艘好船，确实是。

english: Keep yer voice down [lass/lad], can't ye see I'm busy?
translation: 小声点 [lass/lad]，你没看见我很忙吗？

english: First off, it's [lad/lass], and second, other than busy being drunk I can't see what you are talking about.
translation: 首先，是 [lad/lass]；其次，除了光顾着喝醉，我实在听不懂你在说什么。

english: I can't feel me brains no more...
translation: 我脑袋都不听使唤了……

english: Wait...I recognise that smell. You've been drinking 'rum' haven't you?
translation: 等等……我闻出那个味道了。你一直在喝''朗姆酒''，对吧？

english: Arr...ye shufflin' muffle burble...
translation: 啊……你含糊咕哝……

english: I think that can be filed as a 'yes'.
translation: 我想这就算是个''是的''吧。

english: Are ye here for...you know...the stuff...
translation: 你是来……你知道……那个东西……

english: The what?
translation: 那个什么？

english: The stuff...you know...the stuff?
translation: 那个东西……你知道……那个东西？

english: I'm not sure I follow you.
translation: 我没太明白你的意思。

english: Aren't ye Toothless [Kevin/Lisa]?
translation: 你不是无牙 [Kevin/Lisa] 吗？

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: Sorry, sorry, my mistake!
translation: 抱歉，抱歉，我的错！

english: Ain't ye the scurvy curr that killed my brother?
translation: 你不是那个杀了我兄弟的坏蛋吗？

english: Well I'm not sure.
translation: 嗯我不确定。

english: I kill so many things on a daily basis that it all tends to blur together.
translation: 我每天杀的东西太多，都记混了。

english: Tell me, did they have any unusual features that would help me to recall them?
translation: 告诉我，他们有什么特别之处，能帮我想起他们来？

english: How many things de ye have te kill in a day te lose count?
translation: 你一天得杀多少东西才会数不清？

english: I don't know, if I did I wouldn't have lost count!
translation: 我不知道，如果我知道我就不会数不清了！

english: Now, about your brother...
translation: 现在，关于你的兄弟……

english: Never mind! I never liked him that much anyway!
translation: 算了！反正我也没那么喜欢他！

english: It's rather quiet around here for a pirate haven isn't it?
translation: 对海盗窝点来说这里相当安静不是吗？

english: Arr, we like te keep the peace around here.
translation: 啊，我们喜欢在这里保持和平。

english: Some of the older pirates don't like it, but Mos Le'Harmless be a hive of sense and civility.
translation: 一些老海盗不喜欢，但莫斯‧勒哈姆勒斯可是个充满理智与文明的地方。

english: How nice!
translation: 多好！

english: Arr, that it be.
translation: 啊，确实是。

english: What's yer business?
translation: 你有什么事？

english: I was wondering who you are.
translation: 我在想你是谁。

english: Well, I'm one of the militia, we try and keep the rest of the pirates in line.
translation: 嗯，我是民兵之一，我们试着让其他海盗守规矩。

english: Well, as in line as we reckon they need to be.
translation: 嗯，按我们认为他们需要守的规矩。

english: So how do you decide who becomes a member of the militia?
translation: 那么你们怎么决定谁成为民兵成员？

english: Well, if yer ship is in need of repairs and yer in port, then yer a member, simple as that.
translation: 嗯，如果你的船需要修理且你在港口，那你就是成员，就这么简单。

english: See, those of us that are here for a long haul tend to want to keep things peaceful, so we keep an eye on everyone else as and when they come in.
translation: 看，我们这些长期待在这里的人倾向于保持和平，所以我们在其他人进来时盯着他们。

english: Given the number of skirmishes we have with customs, there is never a shortage of repairs needed.
translation: 鉴于我们与海关的冲突不断，永远不缺需要修理的船。

english: Thanks, that was very informative.
translation: 谢谢，长见识了。

english: Just passing through.
translation: 只是路过。

english: See to it ye keeps outs trouble, stranger.
translation: 陌生人，管好你自己，别惹麻烦。

english: Just looking about.
translation: 只是看看。

english: Well good luck with that, landlubber.
translation: 嗯祝你好运，旱鸭子。

english: Adventuring!
translation: 冒险！

english: Adventurin' eh...that sounds like customs and excise work to my ears.
translation: 冒险呃……那在我听来像海关和消费税工作。

english: No, no, I'm a pirate, honest. I have the book and everything.
translation: 不，不，我真是海盗，证件什么的都有。

english: I'll have me eye on ye, customs [boy/girl]. One step out of line and bam.
translation: 我会盯着你，海关 [boy/girl]。一步出格就砰。

english: They won't find enough of ye to feed a hungry sea slug.
translation: 他们找不到足够的你喂一只饿海蛞蝓。

english: Just looking around. What is there to do here?
translation: 只是四处看看。这里有什么可做的？

english: Well, if yeve got some coins in yer purse ye can head over to Joe's house of 'Rum' and get yerself drunk.
translation: 嗯，如果你钱包里有些金币你可以去乔的“朗姆酒”屋喝醉。

english: Anything else?
translation: 还有别的吗？

english: Well, Smithin' Smith and Dodgy Mike have some stuff to sell, and ye can always try grabbin' some fish from Two Feet Charley if yer hungry.
translation: 嗯，铁匠史密斯和狡猾迈克有些东西卖，如果你饿了你总可以试试从两脚查理那里抓些鱼。

english: Is that it?
translation: 就这些？

english: Well, ye can head out to the brewery and have a word with Fancy Dan or San Fan. They always need a hand out there.
translation: 嗯，你可以去酿酒厂跟花哨丹或三番谈谈。他们那里总是需要帮手。

english: Doing what?
translation: 做什么？

english: Doin' each others heads in most of the time.
translation: 大部分时间互相找茬。

english: What is your business?
translation: 你有什么事？

english: Nothing much, just passing through.
translation: 没什么，只是路过。

english: Well have a good day, [sir/miss].
translation: 嗯祝你今天愉快，[sir/miss]。

english: I'm sorry, but you don't sound much like a pirate, how did you come to be here?
translation: 我很抱歉，但你听起来不太像海盗，你怎么来这里的？

english: I used to be a language tutor, teaching in a small school just outside of Lumbridge.
translation: 我曾经是个语言导师，在仑桥镇外的一所小学校教书。

english: However the place closed down due to ill attendance, and so I was forced to take up piracy.
translation: 然而那地方因出勤率低关闭了，所以我被迫从事海盗业。

english: Wasn't that a bit of a big jump in careers?
translation: 这职业转变是不是有点大？

english: Not really, I made my way through via a short stint as a lawyer.
translation: 也不算吧，我之前短暂当过律师，就这么转过来的。

english: Well, that makes sense.
translation: 嗯，那有道理。

english: I must return to my duties. Have a nice day!
translation: 我必须回去履行职责。祝你今天愉快！

english: You too!
translation: 你也是！

english: What's yours?
translation: 你的呢？

english: I asked first!
translation: 我先问的！

english: And very rudely too I might add.
translation: 而且我得说，非常粗鲁。

english: Fine! Go about yer 'business'!
translation: 好吧！去办你的“事”！

english: I will!
translation: 我会的！

english: Whaz yer bushinessssss...ssss?
translation: 你有什么事……事？

english: Are you drunk on duty?
translation: 你值班时喝醉了吗？

english: I'm not drunk! I'll knock down any man as sayin' I'm been having a drinking on my duties!
translation: 我没醉！我会打倒任何说我值班喝酒的人！

english: Well, I think you'll have a hard time explaining your slurred speech, odd behaviour, bitter, nostril dissolving stench and rolling, bloodshot eyes if yournot drunk.
translation: 嗯，要是你没醉，恐怕很难解释你这口齿不清、举止怪异、刺鼻的恶臭，还有那双滴溜溜转的充血眼睛。

english: Arrr, ye got me. I just can't leave the stuff alone.
translation: 啊，你抓到我了。我就是离不开那东西。

english: Cap'n Braindeath's Ten X With Added Cattle Medication just keeps singin' its siren song to me.
translation: 脑死亡船长的''十倍加牛药''一直诱惑着我。

english: Would ye care fer a drop?
translation: 你想来一滴吗？

english: No.  I would most certainly not.
translation: 不。我绝对不会。

english: Suit yerself.
translation: 随你便。

english: None of yours.
translation: 不关你的事。

english: Fair enough. Off ye go.
translation: 好吧。你走吧。

english: I'm just helping out a friend.
translation: 我只是帮个朋友。

english: Which friend?
translation: 哪个朋友？

english: Bill Teach.
translation: 比尔‧蒂奇。

english: Bill hired you eh? He must have been scrapin' the barrel and no mistake.
translation: 比尔雇了你？那肯定是实在没人可用了。

english: Hey! I resent that!
translation: 嘿！你这话什么意思！

english: The pirate captain ignores you and continues to stare lifelessly at nothing, as he has clearly been dead for some time.
translation: 海盗船长无视你并继续无生气地盯着虚无，因为他显然已经死了一段时间。

english: I don't think Mr Grip will like you opening that. That's his private drinks cabinet.
translation: 我想格里普先生不会喜欢你打开那个。那是他的私人饮料柜。

english: He won't notice me having a quick look.
translation: 他不会注意到我快速看一眼。

english: Stay out of my drinks cabinet!
translation: 别动我的饮料柜！

english: Grip walks into the room
translation: 格里普走进房间

english: You find a bottle of whiskey in the cupboard.
translation: 你在橱柜里找到一瓶威士忌。

english: Ok, I'll leave it.
translation: 好的，我不动它。

english: He won't notice me having a quick look.
translation: 他不会注意到我快速看一眼。

english: Ok, I'll leave it.
translation: 好的，我不动它。

english: Ahoy!
translation: 喂！

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: Welcome to the Brimhaven Agility Arena!
translation: 欢迎来到布尔哈文敏捷竞技场！

english: If ye want to know more talk to Cap'n Izzy, he found it!
translation: 如果你想知道更多跟伊兹船长谈谈，他发现它的！

english: What do you do?
translation: 你做什么？

english: I be the Jack o' Tickets. I exchange the tickets ye collect in the Agility Arena for more stuff. Ye can obtain more agility experience or some items ye won't find anywhere else!
translation: 我是票务杰克。我把你在敏捷竞技场收集的门票兑换成更多东西。你可以获得更多敏捷经验或一些你在别处找不到的物品！

english: Sounds good!
translation: 听起来不错！

english: I'd like to trade in my tickets, please.
translation: 我想兑换我的门票，请。

english: Aye, ye be on the right tack.
translation: 是的，你在正确的航向上。

english: I have a question about my Achievement Diary.
translation: 我有个关于成就日志的问题。

english: I've done all the easy tasks in my Karamja Achievement Diary.
translation: 我完成了卡拉姆詹成就日志中的所有简单任务。

english: Arr, ye have that, I see yer list. I s'pose ye'll be wantin' yer reward then!
translation: 啊，你有那个，我看到你的列表。我想你想要你的奖励吧！

english: Arrr, ye'll 'ave ta come back when ye has more space in yer pack.
translation: 啊，你得等背包里有更多空间时再回来。

english: These 'ere Karamja gloves be a symbol of yer explorin' on the island. I'll 'ave a word with some of the seafarin' folk who sail to Port Sarim and Ardougne, so they'll take ye on board half price if ye be wearin' them.
translation: 这些卡拉姆詹手套是你岛上探索的象征。我会跟一些航行到沙林港和阿多尼城的航海人说说，所以如果你戴着它们他们会让你半价上船。

english: I've done all the medium tasks in my Karamja Achievement Diary.
translation: 我完成了卡拉姆詹成就日志中的所有中等任务。

english: Arr, so ye have. I s'pose ye'll be wantin' yer reward upgraded then!
translation: 啊，确实是。我想你想要你的奖励升级吧！

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: The enchantment on these 'ere Karamja gloves be a symbol of yer further explorin' on the island. They'll take ye to an underground mine in Shilo,Cap'n Izzy's arranged it so ye gets a little extra benefit in our
translation: 这些卡拉姆詹手套上的附魔是你岛上进一步探索的象征。它们会带你去希洛的一个地下矿，伊兹船长安排了这样你在我们的敏捷竞技场能得到一点额外好处。

english: Agility Arena. Ye can have this lamp too.
translation: 你也可以拿这盏灯。

english: Hey there, is this where you live?
translation: 嘿，你住这里吗？

english: Yes it is! Don't look down your nose at me. I have to put up with an awful lot to earn my living, life is a daily struggle.
translation: 是的！别瞧不起我。我为了谋生忍受了很多，生活每天都在挣扎。

english: Sorry, I am just curious. Why is life so difficult here?
translation: 抱歉，我只是好奇。为什么这里的生活这么艰难？

english: Just look at the place, rats, flies and all sorts just swarming the area. Doesn't help that I stink but ain't no one who likes using those tin baths right in public view.
translation: 看看这地方，老鼠、苍蝇等各种东西到处都是。我身上发臭也没办法，但没人喜欢在公众面前用那些锡浴盆。

english: It is difficult to make ends meet. There are just so many skilled fishermen here that the competition is too much! Leaves no room for someone like me.
translation: 收支难以平衡。这里有太多熟练的渔民，竞争太激烈了！没有我这种人的立足之地。

english: Thieves! Thieves everywhere. Come to think of it, they always look remarkably like you! Adventurers running about stealing our things, get out of my sight.
translation: 小偷！到处都是小偷。说起来，他们看起来总是和你很像！冒险者到处偷我们的东西，滚出我的视线。

english: Look, this is none of your business, I'd appreciate it if you left me to it. I don't want to see another fancy adventurer again!
translation: 听着，这不关你的事，如果你能别管我我会很感激。我不想再见到另一个花哨的冒险者了！

english: Okay okay! I'll be off now.
translation: 好的好的！我现在就走。

english: Gang crime is everywhere! I see them sometimes... it makes me very uneasy. It becomes difficult to sleep at night, never mind the draft in here.
translation: 帮派犯罪到处都是！我有时能看到他们……这让我很不安。晚上难以入睡，更别提这里的穿堂风了。

english: I've heard about those gangs! The Shayzien soldiers do a lot of work to put an end to it.
translation: 我听说过那些帮派！谢兹恩士兵做了很多工作来制止他们。

english: Don't talk to me about those soldiers, all they ever do is blitz onto these docks with not a care in the world for us folk.
translation: 别跟我提那些士兵，他们只会突袭这些码头，根本不在乎我们这些人。

translation: 你好，我为皮斯卡里琉斯女士的归来保留这个泊位。

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

translation: 你好。

english: Hi there. How can I help you?
translation: 你好。有什么能帮你的？

english: What do you do around here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: I'm the port master. It's my job to keep everything around here running nice and smoothly for all the vessels coming and going.
translation: 我是港口管理员。我的工作是确保这里的一切对所有来往船只都运行顺畅。

english: So could you tell me how I could get my own vessel?

english: Shhh!! Don't let the others see me here! I'm on a top secret mission for the Burth..., no, nothing. Never mind. Oooo, look, the chaos elemental!! Quick, run!!
translation: 嘘！！别让别人看到我在这里！我在为伯索……执行绝密任务，不，没什么。别在意。哦哦，看，混沌元素！！快，跑！！

english: Argh!! Where?
translation: 啊！！在哪？

english: Hey Postie. Howstricks? Who are you interviewing here?
translation: 嘿邮差。怎么样？你在这里采访谁？

english: Everyone deserves ahicbreak you know. It gets pretty tiring luggingburpletters about all day.
translation: 你知道每个人都值得休息。整天搬运信件很累人的。

english: I see. Can I join you?
translation: 我明白了。我能加入你吗？

english: Why, am Ihiccoming apart?
translation: 怎么，我看起来散架了吗？

english: You've been here a while, haven't you?
translation: 你在这里待了一会儿了，对吧？

english: Maybe I haves, maybe I haves. It all goes straight to my head you see.
translation: 也许吧，也许吧。你看，这些都直接冲到我脑子里了。

english: Yes... I can see that. Bye Pete!
translation: 是的……我看得出来。再见皮特！

english: Hey Pete what you doing here?
translation: 嘿皮特你在这里做什么？

english: Just doing a quick survey on famous people and their favourite colour. It's a special feature for 'West Wyverns Women's Weekly'.
translation: just 在做个关于名人和他们最喜欢颜色的快速调查。这是''西双足飞龙女性周刊''的特别栏目。

english: Can I get a copy?
translation: 我能要一份吗？

english: Can you speak Wyvern?
translation: 你会说双足飞龙语吗？

english: No. Can you?
translation: 不会。你会吗？

english: Well obviously.
translation: 当然会。

english: Go on then.
translation: 那说吧。

english: Here! Are you mad? No, 'fraid I can't do that. Could cause all sorts of trouble.
translation: 嘿！你疯了吗？不，恐怕我不能那样做。会引起各种麻烦。

english: You're a bit mad really aren't you?
translation: 你有点疯了对吧？

english: So would you be if you could speak over 1000 languages. I bet it's bliss being ignorant of this world's trouble! I'm off!
translation: 如果你会说1000多种语言你也会疯的。我敢说对这个世界的问题一无所知才是幸福！我走了！

english: Hi Pete, how's things?
translation: 嗨皮特，怎么样？

english: Just chatting to my big brother Pete. Hee heee!!
translation: 正在和我哥哥皮特聊天。嘻嘻！！

english: What's so funny?
translation: 什么这么好笑？

english: Just a joke that he told me. Care to hear it?
translation: 他给我讲了个笑话。想听吗？

english: Yes, go on then.
translation: 想，说吧。

english: 2 Parrots sit on a perch. One says to the other 'Can you smell fish'? Hee heheee he ho ho.
translation: 两只鹦鹉坐在栖木上。一只对另一只说''你能闻到鱼味吗''？嘻嘻嘻嘿嘿。

english: And so what did the other one say?
translation: 那另一只说了什么？

english: Sigh. 2 Parrots sit on a perch. One says to the other 'Can you smell fish'? Hee heheee he ho ho.
translation: 唉。两只鹦鹉坐在栖木上。一只对另一只说''你能闻到鱼味吗''？嘻嘻嘻嘿嘿。

english: I see. So... what did the other one say?
translation: 我明白了。那……另一只说了什么？

english: You're serious aren't you. Listen again. 2 Parrots sit on a perch. One says to the other 'Can you smell fish'.
translation: 你是认真的对吧。再听一遍。两只鹦鹉坐在栖木上。一只对另一只说''你能闻到鱼味''。

english: Fish, right. So, what was the reply?
translation: 鱼，对吧。那，回复是什么？

english: ARGH!! 2 PARROTS. ON A PERCH. SMELLS FISHY.
translation: 啊啊！！两只鹦鹉。在栖木上。闻起来有鱼腥味。

english: No, still lost. Is one of them a penguin?
translation: 不，还是不懂。其中一只是企鹅吗？

english: You're doing it on purpose now aren't you? Please leave me alone!
translation: 你现在是故意的对吧？请别烦我！

english: Hey Pete, what you doing here?
translation: 嘿皮特你在这里做什么？

english: Just chatting to my brother Pete. He keeps Parrots.
translation: 正在和我哥哥皮特聊天。他养鹦鹉。

english: Doesn't sound too tough. What's the pay like?
translation: 听起来不太难。报酬怎么样？

english: Not very good I'm afraid. His bosses are pretty cheep.
translation: 恐怕不太好。他的老板很吝啬。

english: Groan. Don't give up the day job Pete.
translation: 唉。别辞掉正职啊皮特。

english: Arrrr. Avast shipmate. Arrr. I Likes the cut of your gibb. Arrr. That it be.
translation: 啊啊。嘿船员。啊啊。我喜欢你的样子。啊啊。就是这样。

english: Arrr?
translation: 啊啊？

english: Arrrr.
translation: 啊啊。

english: I have a strange feeling of Deja Vu. I must go now.
translation: 我有种奇怪的既视感。我得走了。

english: Hey Postie! What you doing all the way up here?
translation: 嘿邮差！你大老远来这里做什么？

english: I was just trying to get some wise words of wisdom from the Oracle. You know, she's been here a long, long time.
translation: 我只是想从神谕者那里得到一些智慧之言。你知道，她在这里已经很久很久了。

english: Yes, I thought as much. What did she have to say?
translation: 是的，我也这么想。她说了什么？

english: First she said 'I am the Oracle, And when I open my lips, let no dog bark!'
translation: 首先她说''我是神谕者，当我开口时，别让狗叫！''

english: I see. And then what?
translation: 我明白了。然后呢？

english: I didn't know she was familiar with the works of Shakespeare. So I said 'Et tu, brute?'
translation: 我不知道她熟悉莎士比亚的作品。所以我说''还有你吗，布鲁图？''

english: And then?
translation: 然后呢？

english: Well, she started leaping about and pointing to Ardougne, shouting something about betrayal. She was really angry.
translation: 嗯，她开始跳来跳去指着阿多尼城，喊着什么背叛的事。她真的很生气。

english: Cripes! What do you think it means?
translation: 天哪！你觉得是什么意思？

english: Who knows. Always cryptic to the last. See you around.
translation: 谁知道。总是神秘到底。回头见。

english: Anyone got post?
translation: 有人有邮件吗？

english: Reldo, have you found that book I was looking for yet?
translation: 雷尔多，你找到我在找的那本书了吗？

english: No, not yet... but I know I have seen it somewhere...
translation: 不，还没有……但我知道我在某处见过……

english: ... come back later.
translation: ……稍后再来。

english: Sure, no problems. See you later.
translation: 当然，没问题。回头见。

english: Bye! Say hi to the other Petes for me.
translation: 再见！替我向其他皮特问好。

english: Will do. Farewell!
translation: 会的。再见！

english: Psssst! How is the plan going?
translation: 嘘！计划进行得怎么样？

english: Perfectly. Everyone is prepared.
translation: 完美。每个人都准备好了。

english: Great. Now don't forget - nobody does anything until I give the word! OK?
translation: 太好了。现在别忘了——在我发令之前谁都不许行动！好吗？

english: Sure no problem. We'll be waiting.
translation: 当然没问题。我们会等着。

english: 'Till next time. Farewell.
translation: 下次见。再见。

english: 4 Pints of your finest please.
translation: 请来4品脱你最好的酒。

english: 4 Pints coming right up. Are you expecting guests?
translation: 4品脱马上来。你在等客人吗？

english: Just a few old friends.
translation: 就几个老朋友。

english: You want me to put it on your tab?
translation: 你想让我记在你账上吗？

english: That would be great, thanks. Oh cripes! I've left a fire burning! I'll be back in a mo.
translation: 那太好了，谢谢。哦天哪！我让火一直烧着！我马上回来。

english: Fight! Fight!.. Fight!!
Easy Pete, calm down. Don't lose your head!
translation: 冷静点皮特，别激动。别失去理智！

english: Cheeky!! If you're not careful I'll get you cursed too!
translation: 厚脸皮！！如果你不小心我也会让你被诅咒！

english: You wouldn't catch me double-crossing a witch!
translation: 你可别指望我会背叛女巫！

english: But which witch is which! Anyway, I'm late for an appointment with the oracle.
translation: 但哪个女巫是哪个！不管怎样，我和神谕者的约会要迟到了。

english: Take care and say hi to the kids for me.
translation: 保重，替我向孩子们问好。

english: Hey, bro! How's the party business?
translation: 嘿，兄弟！派对生意怎么样？

english: Great, thanks!
translation: 很好，谢谢！

english: Celebrating weddings and drop partys...
translation: 庆祝婚礼和掉落派对……

english: ...and getting paid for it!
translation: ……还能因此赚钱！

english: Nice. Well, I'm here to talk to some White Knights.
translation: 不错。嗯，我来这里是要和一些白骑士谈谈。

english: Want to take some cake with you?
translation: 想带点蛋糕吗？

english: No thanks, I'm still dieting!
translation: 不用了谢谢，我还在节食！

english: Just seafood for me.
translation: 我只要海鲜。

english: Hi Pete!
translation: 嗨皮特！

english: Mum wants to know if you're coming round for tea.
translation: 妈妈想知道你是否来喝茶。

english: No, I've got another late night here.
translation: 不，我今晚又要加班。

english: Ol' bluebeak's got the flu again!
translation: 老蓝嘴又得流感了！

english: Oh dear. Nothing too serious I hope.
translation: 哦天哪。希望不太严重。

english: Well, as long as he hasn't caught anything from that evil chicken.
translation: 嗯，只要他不是从那只邪恶的鸡那里传染的就行。

english: Got a taste for parrots now too has he?
translation: 他现在也对鹦鹉感兴趣了？

english: *Sigh.* Will nothing sacred be safe?
translation: 叹息。 还有什么神圣的东西是安全的吗？

english: Hey Pete. Any news from the fleet?
translation: 嘿皮特。舰队有什么消息吗？

english: No yo ho bruv.
translation: 没有哟吼兄弟。

english: 'Tis all quiet on the eastern front.
translation: 东线一切平静。

english: Good good.
translation: 好好。

english: Well, you know what to do if something goes wrong.
translation: 嗯，你知道如果出问题该怎么做。

english: Aye, that I do bruv.
translation: 是的，我知道兄弟。

english: Holler like a bosun without a bottle.
translation: 像没有酒瓶的水手长那样大喊。

english: That's it brother, and we'll come a running!
translation: 就是这样兄弟，我们会跑过来的！

english: Well, I'm back. And he said no. Again.
translation: 嗯，我回来了。他又说不。

english: Lemons? Both of them?
translation: 柠檬？两个都是？

english: Lemons? What are you talking about?
translation: 柠檬？你在说什么？

english: Fragile! Do not bend!
translation: 易碎！勿折！

english: I swear you get stranger every time.
translation: 我发誓你每次都变得更奇怪。

english: Ok, I'll ask again.
translation: 好的，我再问一次。

english: I'd better head off.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: Now, how's this thing work again...?
translation: 现在，这东西是怎么运作的来着……？

english: Hello [player name]. I've got a message for you from Molly. She needs your help urgently. Will you assist her now?
translation: 你好 [player name]。我有莫莉给你的消息。她急需你的帮助。你现在愿意帮她吗？

english: Sure, anything for Molly.
translation: 当然，为莫莉什么都愿意。

english: Player is teleported to the Evil twin claw machine place
translation: 玩家被传送到邪恶双胞胎抓娃娃机处

english: Tell her to get stuffed.
translation: 让她滚蛋。

english: Sorry, I don't have any messages for you.
translation: 抱歉，我没有任何消息给你。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Message for you, [player name]!
translation: 给你的消息，[player name]！

english: Hello, [player name]?
translation: 你好，[player name]？

english: Urgent message for you, [player name]?
translation: 给你的紧急消息，[player name]？

english: Someone needs your help, [player name]!
translation: 有人需要你的帮助，[player name]！

english: Will you accept the message, [player name]?
translation: 你愿意接受消息吗，[player name]？

english: Maybe later.
translation: 也许稍后。

english: Sure, anything for Molly.
translation: 当然，为莫莉什么都愿意。

english: Tell her to get stuffed.
translation: 让她滚蛋。

english: Hi cat!
translation: 嗨猫！

english: Miaooow!
translation: 喵嗷！

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: What are you doing?
translation: 你在做什么？

english: I think I'll go hunting soon, there's a warehouse with some rats in it nearby.
translation: 我想我很快要去打猎了，附近有个仓库里有些老鼠。

english: Happy hunting.
translation: 狩猎愉快。

english: The cat is too sick to respond.
translation: 猫病得太重无法回应。

english: Hello [player name].
translation: 你好 [player name]。

english: How are you feeling now?
translation: 你现在感觉怎么样？

english: Still a bit below purrrr. Thank you for fetching the medicine for me.
translation: 还是有点不舒服。谢谢你帮我取药。

english: No problem, I hope you get better soon.
translation: 没问题，希望你早日康复。

english: Good day, sister.
translation: 你好，姐妹。

english: Greetings, [player name]. Can I help you with anything, today?
translation: 你好，[player name]。今天我能帮你什么吗？

english: How can I train my prayer?
translation: 我如何训练祈祷？

english: I think you should be teaching me a thing or two, shouldn't you?
translation: 我想你应该教我一些东西，对吧？

english: Well, if you really want my advice...
translation: 嗯，如果你真的想要我的建议……

english: The most common way to train prayer is by either burying bones, or offering them to the gods at some kind of an altar.
translation: 训练祈祷最常见的方式是埋葬骨头，或在某种祭坛上献给神灵。

english: Lots of adventurers build such altars in their own homes, or there are a few frequent places of worship around the world.
translation: 许多冒险者在自己家里建造这样的祭坛，或者世界各地有一些常见的礼拜场所。

english: Different kinds of bones will help you to train faster. Generally speaking, the bigger they are and the more frightening a creature they come from, the better they are for it.
translation: 不同种类的骨头会帮助你更快训练。一般来说，骨头越大、来自的生物越可怕，效果越好。

english: Is there anything else you would like to know?
translation: 还有什么你想知道的吗？

english: What is prayer useful for?
translation: 祈祷有什么用？

english: The gods look kindly upon their devout followers. There are all kinds of benefits they may provide, if you pray for them!
translation: 神灵会眷顾他们虔诚的追随者。如果你向他们祈祷，他们会提供各种好处！

english: Really? What kind of benefits?
translation: 真的吗？什么样的好处？

english: They could help you in combat, help your wounds to heal more quickly, protect your belongings... There's a lot they can do for you!
translation: 他们可以在战斗中帮助你，帮助你的伤口更快愈合，保护你的物品……他们能为你做很多事！

english: You can find out more by looking in your prayer book.
translation: 你可以通过查看祈祷书了解更多。

english: Wow! That sounds great.
translation: 哇！听起来很棒。

english: You need to be careful that your prayers don't run out, though. You can get prayer potions to help you recharge, or you can pray at an altar whenever one's nearby.
translation: 不过你需要小心祈祷值不要耗尽。你可以获得祈祷药水来帮助补充，或者在附近有祭坛时祈祷。

english: No, thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Very well. Saradomin be with you!
translation: 很好。愿萨拉多明与你同在！

english: How can I train my prayer?
translation: 我如何训练祈祷？

english: What is prayer useful for?
translation: 祈祷有什么用？

english: No, thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Hello! Glad to see you're okay. I was worried you might have gone and got stuck down that hole.
translation: 你好！很高兴看到你没事。我担心你可能会卡在那个洞里。

english: No need to worry. I'm mostly quite capable when it comes to these kinds of things!
translation: 不用担心。对于这种事情我还是很有能力的！

english: Good to hear!
translation: 很高兴听到这个！

english: Hello there. Did you see that dwarf by the big forge? I think he wanted to talk to you.
translation: 你好。你看到大熔炉旁边的那个矮人了吗？我想他想和你谈谈。

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Hello! Look at this place. Isn't it amazing?
translation: 你好！看看这个地方。是不是很神奇？

english: It sure is! Not every day you find yourself in a lost city.
translation: 确实是！不是每天都能发现自己在一座失落的城市里。

english: So what can I do for you?
translation: 那我能为你做什么？

english: Does the name Lassar mean anything to you? It was an old fortress that once existed here, long before Camdozaal. I'm wondering if there might still be some traces left down here.
translation: 拉萨尔这个名字对你有意义吗？那是一座古老的堡垒，曾在卡姆多扎尔之前很久就存在于此。我想知道这里是否还留有痕迹。

english: A ruin within a ruin? How exciting! We have found the odd thing that doesn't seem to be dwarven in origin, but it's still early days for us here, so we haven't been able to learn much yet.
translation: 废墟中的废墟？太令人兴奋了！我们发现了一些似乎不是矮人起源的奇怪东西，但我们在这里还处于早期阶段，所以还没能学到太多。

english: One that was particularly interesting was this strange icon I found in the mine.
translation: 特别有趣的是我在矿井里发现的这个奇怪图标。

english: Could be a lot more to find over there, but I must admit, I haven't been back since... well...
translation: 那边可能还有很多东西可找，但我必须承认，自从……嗯……之后我就没回去过。

english: Since what?
translation: 自从什么？

english: It's probably nothing, but there's this big sinkhole on the other side of the mine. I'm probably just being silly, but I'm sure I heard a voice coming from inside.
translation: 可能没什么，但矿井另一边有个大地陷。我可能只是犯傻，但我肯定听到里面有声音。

english: Interesting... And if I wanted to go down this hole?
translation: 有趣……如果我想下这个洞呢？

english: Go down the hole?! You're far braver than I am! There's plenty of rocks around there. I'm sure you could tie a rope to one of them. You'd need a pretty long rope though. Here, you can use mine.
translation: 下洞？！你比我勇敢多了！那边有很多石头。我相信你可以把绳子绑在其中一块上。不过你需要一根很长的绳子。给，你可以用我的。

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！

english: Hi.
translation: 嗨。

english: Hello! What can I do for you today?
translation: 你好！今天我能为你做什么？

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: I'm Preswylwyr.
translation: 我是普雷斯威尔维尔。

english: It's nice to meet you Preswylwyr, I'm [player name].
translation: 很高兴见到你普雷斯威尔维尔，我是 [player name]。

english: And it's great to meet you, [player name].
translation: 也很高兴见到你，[player name]。

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: I'm Gwerin's partner, he runs the mill while it's my job to use up all the flour he produces.
translation: 我是格韦林的搭档，他经营磨坊，而我的工作是消耗他生产的所有面粉。

english: You bake? So that's what the wonderful smell is.
translation: 你烘焙？所以那就是美妙香味的来源。

english: Ha ha! Would you care for some bread? There should be some on the table.
translation: 哈哈！你想吃点面包吗？桌上应该有一些。

english: Really? That's very nice of you, thanks!
translation: 真的吗？你太好了，谢谢！

english: No problem! Was there anything else you wanted?
translation: 没问题！你还想要什么吗？

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！

english: Farewell, adventurer.
translation: 再见，冒险者。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Peace be with you, friend.
translation: 愿平安与你同在，朋友。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Greetings. May the blessings of Icthlarin rest on your tired shoulders and set you at ease during these strange times.
translation: 问候。愿伊克特拉林的祝福降临在你疲惫的肩膀上，让你在这奇怪的时期安心。

english: Good day, adventurer.
translation: 你好，冒险者。

english: What's that place to the south?
translation: 南边那个地方是什么？

english: That's the old necropolis. It's been abandoned for a long time. In fact, you couldn't even access most of it until fairly recently.
translation: 那是古老的亡灵城。它已被废弃很久了。事实上，直到最近你都无法进入大部分区域。

english: How come?
translation: 为什么？

english: It was mostly buried under the sand until a storm came in from the south.
translation: 它大部分被埋在沙子下面，直到一场风暴从南方袭来。

english: Interesting... I bet the place is a hotspot for grave robbers.
translation: 有趣……我敢打赌那地方是盗墓者的热点。

english: Not as many as you'd think. There's a lot of superstition about the place. People say that even the sand is marked by death.
translation: 没有你想的那么多。关于那地方有很多迷信。人们说连沙子都被死亡标记了。

english: You sound like you don't believe them.
translation: 你听起来好像不相信他们。

english: Not really. The sand is probably that colour due to the amount of salt in it. Still, if it keeps people from robbing the dead, that's no bad thing.
translation: 不完全是。沙子可能是那种颜色是因为里面的盐分。不过，如果这能阻止人们盗掘死者，那也不是坏事。

english: I see. Thanks for the information.
translation: 我明白了。谢谢你的信息。

english: Any time, adventurer.
translation: 随时效劳，冒险者。

english: Good day.
translation: 你好。

english: Hey, hey, hey! What in the name of sweet suffering Icthlarin are you doing?
translation: 嘿，嘿，嘿！以甜蜜受难的伊克特拉林之名，你在做什么？

english: I thought this acne potion might clear up your spots.
translation: 我想这祛痘药水可能会清除你的斑点。

english: All that you'll achieve by pouring that potion on me is to ruin my lovely robes.
translation: 你把那药水倒在我身上唯一能达到的效果就是毁掉我漂亮的长袍。

english: Sorry, I was just trying to help.
translation: 抱歉，我只是想帮忙。

english: What's that place to the south?
translation: 南边那个地方是什么？

english: Good day.
translation: 你好。

english: I wish there was more I could do for these people.
translation: 我希望我能为这些人做更多。

english: It's going to take a lot of work to fix the damage done to this city.
translation: 修复这座城市所受的损害需要大量工作。

english: You left the shrine. Did Zulrah reject your sacrifice?
translation: 你离开了神龛。祖尔拉拒绝了你的献祭吗？

english: I killed Zulrah.
translation: 我杀了祖尔拉。

english: Is that what you think? Board the boat again, and I am sure you will find Zulrah has overcome whatever pitiful attacks you used against him.
translation: 你是这么想的吗？再登上船，我相信你会发现祖尔拉已经克服了你用来对付他的任何可怜攻击。

english: Remind me how this ritual works.
translation: 提醒我这个仪式如何运作。

english: Once I have brought you to the shrine, I will leave you there as an offering to Zulrah. You cannot use the boat to return.
translation: 一旦我把你带到神龛，我会把你留在那里作为献给祖尔拉的祭品。你不能使用船返回。

english: You can use your magical powers to flee from Zulrah's grasp, though that would defeat the point of the sacrifice, and you'll have to try again.
translation: 你可以使用魔法力量逃离祖尔拉的掌控，但那样就违背了献祭的意义，你得再试一次。

english: When Zulrah inevitably kills you, I may be able to retrieve your dropped possessions. If so, I will hold them here.
translation: 当祖尔拉不可避免地杀死你时，我或许能取回你掉落的物品。如果是这样，我会在这里保管它们。

english: Now board the boat and prepare to be sacrificed.
translation: 现在登上船准备献祭。

english: I'm off.
translation: 我走了。

english: Leave me, human, I have a sacrifice to prepare. If you wish for information, go and see the High Priestess.
translation: 离开我，人类，我要准备献祭。如果你想要信息，去见大祭司。

english: The sacrificial boat is not for you! Begone, and do not meddle in our sacred rites.
translation: 献祭船不是给你的！走开，别干涉我们的神圣仪式。

english: But I really want to ride the boat!
translation: 但我真的很想坐船！

english: You display complete ignorance of our sacred rites. Perhaps the High Priestess will consent to enlighten you.
translation: 你表现出对我们神圣仪式的完全无知。也许大祭司会同意启发你。

english: The High Priestess said I could offer myself as a sacrifice to Zulrah.
translation: 大祭司说我可以将自己作为献给祖尔拉的祭品。

english: It is rare for a traveller to make such an offer! Very well, I shall explain the ritual to you...
translation: 旅行者提出这样的提议很罕见！很好，我来向你解释仪式……

english: Are you ready to face Zulrah?
translation: 你准备好面对祖尔拉了吗？

english: Yes, let's go.
translation: 是的，我们走吧。

english: I shall now transport you to Zulrah's shrine and offer your life on behalf of our tribe.
translation: 我现在将把你传送到祖尔拉的神龛，代表我们的部落献出你的生命。

english: No, I've changed my mind.
translation: 不，我改变主意了。

english: I've been there, but I left.
translation: 我去过那里，但我离开了。

english: Well, board the boat and let me take you there again quickly, before Zulrah becomes impatient!
translation: 好吧，登上船让我再快速带你去那里，在祖尔拉变得不耐烦之前！

english: I'm afraid I don't have anything for you to collect. If I had any of your items, but you died before collecting them from me, I'd lose them.
translation: 恐怕我没有任何东西给你领取。如果我有任何你的物品，但你在从我这里领取前死了，我会失去它们。

english: You left some stuff at Zulrah's shrine when you left earlier. I've returned it to you now.
translation: 你之前离开时在祖尔拉的神龛留下了一些东西。我现在已经归还给你了。

english: You left some stuff at Zulrah's shrine when you left earlier. Clear some more inventory space and I'll give you the rest.
translation: 你之前离开时在祖尔拉的神龛留下了一些东西。清理更多物品栏空间，我会给你剩下的。

english: You left some stuff at Zulrah's shrine when you left earlier. Clear some inventory space and I'll give it back.
translation: 你之前离开时在祖尔拉的神龛留下了一些东西。清理一些物品栏空间，我会归还给你。

english: You left some stuff at Zulrah's shrine when you left earlier. You'd better deal with it before returning.
translation: 你之前离开时在祖尔拉的神龛留下了一些东西。你最好在回来前处理掉。

english: I killed Zulrah.
translation: 我杀了祖尔拉。

english: Remind me how this ritual works.
translation: 提醒我这个仪式如何运作。

english: I'm off.
translation: 我走了。

english: But I really want to ride the boat!
translation: 但我真的很想坐船！

english: Yes, let's go.
translation: 是的，我们走吧。

english: No, I've changed my mind.
translation: 不，我改变主意了。

english: I've been there, but I left.
translation: 我去过那里，但我离开了。

english: Yes.
translation: 是。

english: No.
translation: 否。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Hello. Interested in learning about some potions?
translation: 你好。有兴趣了解一些药水吗？

english: Hello. Need anything?
translation: 你好。需要什么吗？

english: Let's trade.
translation: 我们交易吧。

english: What kind of potions?
translation: 什么种类的药水？

english: Here's one I think you'll like. I found this recipe whilst exploring some old frozen ruins.
translation: 这里有一个我想你会喜欢的。我在探索一些古老的冰冻废墟时发现了这个配方。

english: The herbalist teaches you how to make Super antifire potions.
translation: 草药师教你如何制作超级抗火药水。

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！

english: Don't mention it. Would you like to buy any herblore supplies?
translation: 别客气。你想买任何草药学用品吗？

english: I'm good, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。

english: Here, solve this.
translation: 给，解决这个。

english: Primula hands you a [light/puzzle] box!
translation: 普里姆拉递给你一个 [光/谜题] 盒子！

english: That doesn't look solved to me.
translation: 在我看来这还没解开。

english: Well done [player name]. Here you go.
translation: 干得好 [player name]。给你。

english: You've obtained a [new clue/casket]!
translation: 你获得了一个 [新线索/箱子]！

english: Let's trade.
translation: 我们交易吧。

english: What kind of potions?
translation: 什么种类的药水？

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: I'm good, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。

english: Shouldn't a prince only have two heads?
translation: 王子不应该只有两个头吗？

english: Why is that?
translation: 这是为什么？

english: Well, a standard Black dragon has one, the King has three so inbetweenmust have two?
translation: 嗯，标准黑龙有一个，国王有三个，所以中间的一定有两个？

english: You're overthinking this.
translation: 你想太多了。

english: *slap*
translation: 拍打

english: Grrr!
translation: 咕噜！

english: Grrrr!
translation: 咕噜噜！

english: Grarrr!
translation: 咕噜噜噜！

english: I hear you made peace between our kingdom and Etceteria once more. Well done, [Fremennik name].
translation: 听说你再次让我们王国和埃西特利亚岛之间达成和平。干得好，[费明尼克名字]。

english: I hear you made peace between our kingdom and Etceteria once more. Well done, dear friend.
translation: 听说你再次让我们王国和埃西特利亚岛之间达成和平。干得好，亲爱的朋友。

english: Prince Brand, will you marry me?
translation: 布兰德王子，你愿意娶我吗？

english: Oh, my darling, you've made me the happiest person alive.
translation: 哦，亲爱的，你让我成为了世界上最幸福的人。

english: Is that a yes?
translation: 那是同意吗？

english: Yes! We'll have to put off the actual ceremony until we can find a priest, but I will tell my father I have agreed to marry you.
translation: 是的！我们得推迟正式仪式直到找到祭司，但我会告诉我父亲我同意嫁给你。

english: I hear you made peace between our kingdom and Etceteria once more. Well done, darling.
translation: 听说你再次让我们王国和埃西特利亚岛之间达成和平。干得好，亲爱的。

english: Have you found a priest for our marriage yet?
translation: 你为我们的婚姻找到祭司了吗？

english: I'm afraid not, darling. I don't think there is one to be had on these islands for love nor money...
translation: 恐怕没有，亲爱的。我想在这些岛屿上无论用钱还是用爱都找不到祭司……

english: Do not fear, though; I shall call for you as soon as one is found.
translation: 不过别担心；一旦找到我会立刻叫你。

english: I'm having second thoughts about the wedding. This marriage would change things, with an increase in responsibilities and duties you were keen to avoid.
translation: 我对婚礼有些犹豫。这场婚姻会改变事情，增加你一直想避免的责任和义务。

english: While I want to support the kingdom, I don't want that to end up impacting your life negatively. Maybe it's too soon to make this kind of decision.
translation: 虽然我想支持王国，但我不想因此对你的生活产生负面影响。也许现在做这种决定还为时过早。

english: You're right, I am not interested in more responsibilities. I would have less time for poetry! Is that your final decision?
translation: 你说得对，我对更多责任不感兴趣。我会更少时间写诗！那是你的最终决定吗？

english: Yes, I think it's for the best.
translation: 是的，我想这样最好。

english: I think you'll make a great Thane for our kingdom.
translation: 我想你会成为我们王国伟大的领主。

english: Maybe not. It it hard, for I am so very fond of you. Let's leave it as it is for now and see what the future holds.
translation: 也许不是。这很难，因为我非常喜欢你。我们先保持现状，看看未来如何。

english: Agreed.
translation: 同意。

english: No thank you, [Fremennik name].
translation: 不用了谢谢，[费明尼克名字]。

english: You've already given me some, but thank you.
translation: 你已经给过我一些了，但谢谢。

english: You've already given me one, but thank you.
translation: 你已经给过我一个了，但谢谢。

english: You've already given me one, remember?
translation: 你已经给过我一个了，记得吗？

english: No thank you, [darling/dear friend].
translation: 不用了谢谢，[亲爱的/挚友]。

english: Discuss relationship
translation: 讨论关系

english: Never mind.
translation: 没关系。

english: Have you found a priest for our marriage yet?
translation: 你为我们的婚姻找到祭司了吗？

english: I'm having second thoughts about the wedding.
translation: 我对婚礼有些犹豫。

english: Yes, I think it's for the best.
translation: 是的，我想这样最好。

english: Maybe not.
translation: 也许不是。

english: Nilsal, [player name].
translation: 你好，[player name]。

english: Hey, Itzla. How are things going?
translation: 嘿，伊兹拉。事情进展如何？

english: Father should make a full recovery, though given that his would-be killers are still out there, that's not anywhere near as much comfort as it should be.
translation: 父亲应该会完全康复，但考虑到他的潜在杀手还在外面，这远没有应有的安慰。

english: I'm also still yet to hear from mother, but in the meantime, I've been thinking about what our next move should be. I don't have anything solid yet, but I'm sure I will soon.
translation: 我也还没收到母亲的消息，但与此同时，我一直在思考我们的下一步行动。我还没有具体的计划，但我相信很快会有。

english: In that case, I'll make sure to keep checking in.
translation: 那样的话，我会确保继续保持联系。

english: You do not meet all of the requirements to start The Heart of Darkness quest.
translation: 你不满足开始黑暗之心任务的所有要求。

english: I've sent word to mother about what happened here, but I've not heard back yet. However, in the meantime, I've devised a little plan for how we might go about dealing with our cultist problem.
translation: 我已经派人通知母亲这里发生的事情，但还没收到回复。不过，与此同时，我想出了一个小计划来处理我们的邪教徒问题。

english: What is it?
translation: 是什么？

english: We're going to go... undercover!
translation: 我们要去……卧底！

english: Undercover? What do you mean?
translation: 卧底？你什么意思？

english: The Twilight Emissaries of course! If they are the ones responsible for what is now two attempts on my father's life, their deaths will be swift and brutal.
translation: 当然是暮光使者！如果他们是两次试图杀害我父亲的罪魁祸首，他们的死亡将迅速而残酷。

english: However, given we're somewhat civilised people, we can't exactly start executing cultists without definitive proof. How do we get that? By joining up of course!
translation: 然而，鉴于我们是某种程度上的文明人，我们不能在没有确凿证据的情况下开始处决邪教徒。我们如何获得证据？当然是通过加入他们！

english: You want us to join the cult?
translation: 你想让我们加入邪教？

english: Exactly! Quite a clever plan, if I do say so myself.
translation: 没错！如果我自己说的话，这是个相当聪明的计划。

english: Right...
translation: 好吧……

english: Prepare for the arrival of Queen Zyanyi Arkan!
translation: 准备迎接扎雅妮‧阿坎女王驾到！

english: Ah... This should be fun.
translation: 啊……这应该很有趣。

english: I'd love to hear it, but I have some things I need to do first.
translation: 我很想听，但我有些事情需要先做。

english: Very well. I'll be here when you're ready.
translation: 很好。你准备好时我会在这里。

english: Hey, Itzla.
translation: 嘿，伊兹拉。

english: How are you doing?
translation: 你怎么样？

english: Well, now that the local cult of murderers is no longer trying to kill me or my father, I'd say things are looking up.
translation: 嗯，既然当地的杀手邪教不再试图杀害我或我的父亲，我想事情正在好转。

english: I'm also finding I've got a bit more time on my hands now that things are all sorted. I suggested to mother I spend that time in the Colosseum. I don't know if she was totally convinced.
translation: 我也发现事情都解决后我有了更多空闲时间。我建议母亲让我花时间在竞技场。我不知道她是否完全信服。

english: I can't imagine why...
translation: 我无法想象为什么……

english: Anyway, I won't keep you, iknami. I'm sure you've got plenty more adventures to go on. Timoiva, my friend.
translation: 不管怎样，我不耽误你了，iknami。我相信你还有很多冒险要去进行。Timoiva，我的朋友。

english: You don't happen to have another sword do you?
translation: 你碰巧没有另一把剑吧？

english: I'm afraid not, iknami. You'll have to go and find where you left the one I gave you. I'm sure you won't have lost it. After it, it's a one of a kind family heirloom.
translation: 恐怕没有，iknami。你得去找你把我给你的那把剑放在哪里了。我相信你不会弄丢它。毕竟，那是独一无二的家族传家宝。

english: Right... yes... I'll go see if I can find it.
translation: 好吧……是的……我去看看能不能找到它。

english: Well, iknami, as luck would have it, someone came along trying to sell a sword that perfectly matches the one I gave you. He claimed he just found it on the ground!
translation: 嗯，iknami，巧的是，有人来试图出售一把与我给你的那把完全匹配的剑。他声称他 just 在地上捡到的！

english: How odd...
translation: 真奇怪……

english: Indeed. I'm sure it can't be the same one. After all, that was a one of a kind family heirloom, so you'd definitely have taken good care of it.
translation: 确实。我肯定不可能是同一把。毕竟，那是独一无二的家族传家宝，所以你肯定会好好保管它。

english: Yeah... definitely...
translation: 是的……肯定……

english: Anyway, I had to pay 250,000 coins to buy this one, so if you want it, that's how much I'll have to charge you.
translation: 不管怎样，我花了250,000金币买了这把，所以如果你想要，我得收你这么多。

english: Ah, I don't have enough. I'll be back shortly.
translation: 啊，我没有足够的钱。我很快回来。

english: Sounds good to me.
translation: 听起来不错。

english: Use it well, iknami.
translation: 好好使用它，iknami。

english: I think I'll pass.
translation: 我想我还是不要了。

english: As you wish, iknami.
translation: 如你所愿，iknami。

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: Timoiva, my friend.
translation: Timoiva，我的朋友。

english: Yes.
translation: 是。

english: No.
translation: 否。

english: How are you doing?
translation: 你怎么样？

english: You don't happen to have another sword do you?
translation: 你碰巧没有另一把剑吧？

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: I hear you made peace between our kingdom and Etceteria once more. Well done, [Fremennik name].
translation: 听说你再次让我们王国和埃西特利亚岛之间达成和平。干得好，[费明尼克名字]。

english: I hear you made peace between our kingdom and Etceteria once more. Well done, dear friend.
translation: 听说你再次让我们王国和埃西特利亚岛之间达成和平。干得好，亲爱的朋友。

english: Princess Astrid, will you marry me?
translation: 阿斯特丽德公主，你愿意嫁给我吗？

english: Oh, my darling, you've made me the happiest person alive.
translation: 哦，亲爱的，你让我成为了世界上最幸福的人。

english: Is that a yes?
translation: 那是同意吗？

english: Yes! We'll have to put off the actual ceremony until we can find a priest, but I will tell my father I have agreed to marry you.
translation: 是的！我们得推迟正式仪式直到找到祭司，但我会告诉我父亲我同意嫁给你。

english: I hear you made peace between our kingdom and Etceteria once more. Well done, darling.
translation: 听说你再次让我们王国和埃西特利亚岛之间达成和平。干得好，亲爱的。

english: Have you found a priest for our marriage yet?
translation: 你为我们的婚姻找到祭司了吗？

english: I'm afraid not, darling. I don't think there is one to be had on these islands for love nor money...
translation: 恐怕没有，亲爱的。我想在这些岛屿上无论用钱还是用爱都找不到祭司……

english: Do not fear, though; I shall call for you as soon as one is found.
translation: 不过别担心；一旦找到我会立刻叫你。

english: I'm having second thoughts about the wedding. This marriage would change things, with an increase in responsibilities and duties that would overshadow the activities you like.
translation: 我对婚礼有些犹豫。这场婚姻会改变事情，增加的责任和义务会掩盖你喜欢的活动。

english: While I want to support you and the kingdom, I don't want that to end up impacting your life negatively. Maybe it's too soon to make this kind of decision.
translation: 虽然我想支持你和王国，但我不想因此对你的生活产生负面影响。也许现在做这种决定还为时过早。

english: My darling, that is very thoughtful of you and you make a convincing point. Are you... absolutely sure?
translation: 亲爱的，你考虑得很周到，你的观点很有说服力。你……绝对确定吗？

english: Yes, I think it's for the best.
translation: 是的，我想这样最好。

english: I think you'll make a great Thane for our kingdom.
translation: 我想你会成为我们王国伟大的领主。

english: Maybe not. It it hard, for I am so very fond of you. Let's leave it as it is for now and see what the future holds.
translation: 也许不是。这很难，因为我非常喜欢你。我们先保持现状，看看未来如何。

english: Agreed.
translation: 同意。

english: You've already given me some, but thank you.
translation: 你已经给过我一些了，但谢谢。

english: No thank you, [Fremennik name].
translation: 不用了谢谢，[费明尼克名字]。

english: You've already given me one, but thank you.
translation: 你已经给过我一个了，但谢谢。

english: You've already given me one, remember?
translation: 你已经给过我一个了，记得吗？

english: No thank you, [darling/dear friend].
translation: 不用了谢谢，[亲爱的/挚友]。

english: Discuss relationship
translation: 讨论关系

english: Princess Astrid, will you marry me?
translation: 阿斯特丽德公主，你愿意嫁给我吗？

english: Do nothing.
translation: 什么都不做。

english: Never mind.
translation: 没关系。

english: Have you found a priest for our marriage yet?
translation: 你为我们的婚姻找到祭司了吗？

english: I'm having second thoughts about the wedding.
translation: 我对婚礼有些犹豫。

english: Yes, I think it's for the best.
translation: 是的，我想这样最好。

english: Maybe not.
translation: 也许不是。

english: Welcome to ScapeRune.
translation: 欢迎来到 ScapeRune。

english: So you've been captured too?
translation: 所以你也被抓了？

english: Captured?
translation: 被抓？

english: Yes, Evil Bob captured me and stuck me in this prison.
translation: 是的，邪恶鲍勃抓了我把我关进这个监狱。

english: How do I get out of here? I can't be held captive by a cat!
translation: 我怎么出去？我不能被一只猫囚禁！

english: Some of these balloon animals have keys in them, and if you pull the big lever it tells you which shape animal contains the correct key, but I can never find it.
translation: 这些气球动物中有一些里面有钥匙，如果你拉大拉杆它会告诉你哪种形状的动物包含正确的钥匙，但我永远找不到。

english: You need to pull the lever to find out which shape animal contains the key, then pop that sort of animal to get the key.
translation: 你需要拉动拉杆找出哪种动物包含钥匙，然后戳破那种动物获得钥匙。

english: Bring me any keys you get and I'll try them on the doors.
translation: 把你得到的任何钥匙带给我，我会试开门。

english: Okay.
translation: 好的。

english: Oh. Well I guess you can leave but I'll still be stuck here.
translation: 哦。好吧我想你可以离开但我还是会困在这里。

english: You leave the prison.
translation: 你离开监狱。

english: The player leaves the prison through the east hallway.
translation: 玩家通过东走廊离开监狱。

english: You're meant to pull the lever to find out which sort of animal to pop!
translation: 你应该拉动拉杆找出该戳破哪种动物！

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: Don't you remember? This is ScapeRune's prison. Evil Bob caught you and brought you here.
translation: 你不记得了吗？这是 ScapeRune 的监狱。邪恶鲍勃抓了你把你带到这里。

english: What gives him the right to lock me up? I demand to see a lawyer! I know my rights!
translation: 他有什么权利把我关起来？我要见律师！我知道我的权利！

english: Evil Bob doesn't care about people's rights. He's cruel and utterly merciless. He's a cat.
translation: 邪恶鲍勃不在乎人们的权利。他残忍且毫无怜悯。他是只猫。

english: No thanks, I don't want that just now.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我现在不想要那个。

english: That's right, pull it. Then remember what kind of animal shape you see. That's the animal that contains the right key.
translation: 没错，拉它。然后记住你看到什么形状的动物。那就是包含正确钥匙的动物。

english: Great, now you've got a key! Bring it to me so I can try it on the doors.
translation: 太好了，现在你有钥匙了！把它带给我，我可以试开门。

english: Ooh, thanks! I'll see if it's the right one...
translation: 哦，谢谢！我看看是不是正确的……

english: Aww, that was the wrong key! You must have popped the wrong sort of animal. Try the big lever again - it'll tell you which animal to pop.
translation: 哎呀，那是错的钥匙！你一定戳错了动物。再试一次大拉杆——它会告诉你该戳哪种动物。

english: Hooray, you got the right one! Now pull the lever again and let's get the next portal unlocked!
translation: 太好了，你拿到正确的了！现在再拉拉杆让我们解锁下一个传送门！

english: Hey, bring me that key you've got! I wanna get out of here!
translation: 嘿，把你拿到的钥匙带给我！我想离开这里！

english: You did it, you got all the keys right! Thank you! You're my friend FOREVER!
translation: 你做到了，你拿到了所有正确的钥匙！谢谢你！你永远是我的朋友！

english: Let's get out of here before that cat notices.
translation: 我们在那只猫注意到之前离开这里吧。

english: Come on, we should leave before Evil Bob comes back! You go first; I'll follow along.
translation: 来吧，我们得在邪恶鲍勃回来之前离开！你先走；我跟着。

english: Oi! we'll be using the exit that's over here.
translation: 喂！我们会用这边的出口。

english: Oi! No dropping stuff in the exit! Chuck it somewhere else!
translation: 喂！别在出口丢东西！扔到别处去！

english: You quickly escape the prison with Pete.
translation: 你和皮特迅速逃离监狱。

english: Thanks a lot for your help! Here, have a present:
translation: 非常感谢你的帮助！给，拿个礼物：

english: Thanks! See you around!
translation: 谢谢！回头见！

english: Don't mind me, I was just leaving...
translation: 别在意我，我 just 要离开……

english: Okay.
translation: 好的。

english: But I want to leave now.
translation: 但我现在想离开。

english: Yes.
translation: 是。

english: No.
translation: 否。

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: How do I get out of here?
translation: 我怎么出去？

english: Hello there!
translation: 你好啊！

english: How are you doing in there?
translation: 你在里面过得怎么样？

english: Oh I'm great. Lord Jovkai takes good care of us.
translation: 哦我很好。约夫凯大人把我们照顾得很好。

english: So you don't want to escape?
translation: 所以你不打算逃跑？

english: Why would I want to do that? I'm very happy as I am.
translation: 我为什么要那样做？我现在很幸福。

english: If you say so.
translation: 你这么说就算了。

english: Hi, soldier.
translation: 嗨，士兵。

english: Why, hello there!
translation: 哟，你好啊！

english: You seem like a jolly chap.
translation: 你看起来是个快乐的家伙。

english: And why not? 'Tis a greeeaat day!
translation: 为什么不呢？今天真是个好日子！

english: Well, I suppose it is.
translation: 嗯，我想也是。

english: Hi.
translation: 嗨。

english: Shhh. Don't talk to me.
translation: 嘘。别跟我说话。

english: What? Why?
translation: 什么？为什么？

english: If I'm seen slacking off by talking to you, I'll be in deep trouble!
translation: 要是被人看到我和你闲聊偷懒，我就麻烦大了！

english: Oh... Sorry.
translation: 哦……抱歉。

english: Hi there.
translation: 你好。

english: Don't suppose you've seen a battleaxe around here?
translation: 你没在这附近见过战斧吧？

english: A battleaxe? Nope, afraid not.
translation: 战斧？没有，恐怕没见过。

english: The captain is going to kill me if he finds out I've lost my weapon.
translation: 要是队长发现我把武器弄丢了，他会杀了我的。

english: Hello. So you're just a private?
translation: 你好。所以你只是个列兵？

english: Show some respect! It's more than you'll achieve.
translation: 放尊重点！这成就你可达不到。

english: I beg to differ. I'm in perfect shape!
translation: 我不敢苟同。我状态好得很！

english: Prove it!
translation: 证明给我看！

english: How?
translation: 怎么证明？

english: Give me five star-jumps!
translation: 给我做五个开合跳！

english: The player begins to do star-jumps
translation: 玩家开始做开合跳

english: Five sit-ups.
translation: 五个仰卧起坐。

english: The player begins to do sit-ups
translation: 玩家开始做仰卧起坐

english: Run on the spot!
translation: 原地跑步！

english: The player begins to run in place
translation: 玩家开始原地跑步

english: Okay. Maybe you have what it takes. Best you speak with the captain.
translation: 好吧。也许你确实有点本事。你最好去和队长谈谈。

english: Welcome to the pet insurance bureau. How can I help you?
translation: 欢迎来到宠物保险局。有什么能帮你的？

english: Can you tell me about pets and pet insurance?
translation: 你能跟我说说宠物和宠物保险吗？

english: Certainly! You can find pets while out on your adventures. They're very rare, but you may be lucky enough to find one.
translation: 当然！你在冒险过程中可以找到宠物。它们非常稀有，但你也许足够幸运能找到一个。

english: You have a chance to find them when defeating bosses, playing minigames, and taking part in skilling activities.
translation: 你在击败头目、玩小游戏和参与技能活动时有机会找到它们。

english: If you do find one, they will be automatically insured against loss, for free!
translation: 如果你真的找到了，它们会自动获得免费保险！

english: If you then somehow lose your pet, you can reclaim it here for free also. The service used to cost Reclaim tokens worth 1,000,000 coins each. If you have any of those, I can refund you.
translation: 如果你之后不小心弄丢了宠物，也可以在这里免费领回。这项服务以前需要领取代币，每个价值1,000,000金币。如果你还有那些代币，我可以给你退款。

english: I see, thank you.
translation: 明白了，谢谢。

english: I've lost a pet. Have you got it?
translation: 我弄丢了一只宠物。你有吗？

english: If you've lost your pet, it will be reclaimable here!
translation: 如果你弄丢了宠物，可以在这里领回！

english: Let's have a look...
translation: 让我看看……

english: I have a pet that I'd like to insure.
translation: 我有一只宠物想投保。

english: You don't need to pay to insure your pet with me. They're automatically insured for free as soon as you find them!
translation: 你不需要付费给宠物投保。它们一找到就自动免费投保了！

english: If you lose a pet somehow, you can come here and reclaim them. It used to cost reclaim tokens, although we're now subsidised by the Grand Exchange and the service is free. If you have any reclaim tokens left, let
translation: 如果你不小心弄丢了宠物，可以来这里领回。以前需要领取代币，但我们现在由大交易所资助，服务是免费的。如果你还有领取代币，

english: us know and we will buy them back.
translation: 告诉我们，我们会回购。

english: What pets have I insured?
translation: 我投保了哪些宠物？

english: Every pet you've ever found is automatically insured here!
translation: 你找到的每只宠物都会在这里自动投保！

english: Here, take a look...
translation: 来，看看……

english: My pet is still lost. Could you look again?
translation: 我的宠物还是找不到。你能再查查吗？

english: It's possible there was an error in our records. Let me check again for you.
translation: 可能是我们的记录有错误。让我再帮你查查。

english: If you believe you have some pets that are not showing on your insurance record, please visit Probita with your pets and she will automatically insure them for you.
translation: 如果你认为有些宠物没有显示在你的保险记录上，请带着你的宠物去找普罗比塔，她会自动为你投保。

english: Maybe another time.
translation: 改天吧。

english: If you keep waving money at me, I might take it!
translation: 你要是继续在我面前晃钱，我可能会收下！

english: This is a pet insurance bureau. I'm not insuring that.
translation: 这里是宠物保险局。我不给那个投保。

english: Can you tell me about pets and pet insurance?
translation: 你能跟我说说宠物和宠物保险吗？

english: I've lost a pet. Have you got it?
translation: 我弄丢了一只宠物。你有吗？

english: I have a pet that I'd like to insure.
translation: 我有一只宠物想投保。

english: More options...
translation: 更多选项……

english: What pets have I insured?
translation: 我投保了哪些宠物？

english: My pet is still lost. Could you look again?
translation: 我的宠物还是找不到。你能再查查吗？

english: Maybe another time.
translation: 改天吧。

english: Previous options...
translation: 上一个选项……

english: Hey, human, can you do me a favour? That Librarian won't help me find a book.
translation: 嘿，人类，能帮我个忙吗？那个图书管理员不肯帮我找书。

english: Sure, what book do you want?
