translation: 当然，你想要什么书？

english: I'm looking for: '[book name]'
translation: 我在找：'[book name]'

english: I'll see what I can do.
translation: 我看看能做什么。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: I'm from the Stronghold. Mostly I teach magic, and stuff like that. Anyway, I heard they'd got magic here unlike anything I'd ever seen, so I came to learn what I could.
translation: 我来自要塞。我主要教魔法之类的东西。总之，我听说这里有我从未见过的魔法，所以我来学点东西。

english: It'd really help with my learning if you'd find my book for me. Will you?
translation: 如果你能帮我找到书，对我的学习会有很大帮助。你愿意吗？

english: No, sorry.
translation: 不，抱歉。

english: Have you found my book, human? '[book name]'
translation: 你找到我的书了吗，人类？'[book name]'

english: Not yet, sorry.
translation: 还没有，抱歉。

english: If you do, I bet the Arceuus citizens will be grateful for you helping their customers. They must know their Librarian's useless.
translation: 如果你找到了，我敢打赌阿西乌斯城的市民会感激你帮助他们的顾客。他们肯定知道他们的图书管理员没用。

english: Aren't you helping someone else at the moment? Don't let me interrupt.
translation: 你现在不是在帮别人吗？别让我打扰你。

english: Thanks, human. You can have this other book that I don't want.
translation: 谢谢，人类。这本我不想要的书你可以拿去。

english: Thanks for finding my book. I'm learning such a lot here.
translation: 谢谢你帮我找到书。我在这里学到了很多。

english: Sure, what book do you want?
translation: 当然，你想要什么书？

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: No, sorry.
translation: 不，抱歉。

english: I didn't realise gnomes were interested in magic.
translation: 我没想到地精也对魔法感兴趣。

english: Gnomes are interested in everything, [lad/lass].
translation: 地精对什么都感兴趣，[lad/lass]。

english: Of course.
translation: 当然。

english: We have a saying, 'Curiosity killed the cat'. But cats aren't clever enough to understand what they find. Gnomes are.
translation: 我们有句谚语，''好奇心害死猫''。但猫不够聪明，无法理解它们发现的东西。地精可以。

english: Hey! Some of my best friends are cats!
translation: 嘿！我最好的朋友里就有猫！

english: I think that says more about you than cats.
translation: 我觉得这更多说明的是你而不是猫。

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 虽然你找到了顾客，但你似乎没带对食物！你需要 [a/some][ordered gnome food/drink item]！

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 恐怕预制菜不行。只有手工制作的地精美食才够格给阿卢夫‧阿洛夫特的顾客。

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Professor Imblewyn
translation: 你把 [a/some][ordered gnome food/drink item] 的配送交给因布尔温教授

english: Hmmm, I wonder... Oh. My order. Thank you - mind you don't get any food or drink on the books.
translation: 嗯，我在想……哦。我的订单。谢谢——小心别把食物或饮料弄到书上。

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: 你一定走了很远的路才把这个送到我这里，这里有点额外的小意思，拿着当小费。

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
translation: 你有 [number] 积分可以兑换免费配送券。你还没有资格获得地精美食配送。

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 你有 [number] 积分可以兑换免费配送券。你可以获得 [number] 份地精美食配送。

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: 别忘了从小阿卢夫‧吉安那里领取你的免费配送券。

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 你的配送太晚了！回去找小阿卢夫接另一个订单。你丢弃了配送箱，因为不再需要它了。

english: Fascinating, fascinating. It's remarkable what these young dwarves have managed to create. Oh, hello young [man/woman/one].
translation: 太迷人了，太迷人了。这些年轻矮人居然能创造出这样的东西，真是了不起。哦，你好年轻的 [man/woman/one]。

english: Hello, what's a gnome like you doing in a place like this?
translation: 你好，像你这样的地精在这种地方做什么？

english: Ah, well I have been sent by King to talk with the dwarves here and find out more about their recent advances in technology.
translation: 啊，我是国王派来和这里的矮人交谈，了解他们最近的技术进展的。

english: Found anything interesting?
translation: 发现什么有趣的东西了吗？

english: The rideable carts are a very handy way to get to mining sites, and the Blast Furnace is a magnificent beast of a machine.
translation: 可乘坐的矿车是去采矿点非常方便的方式，而高炉是一台了不起的机器。

english: I'll have a look, thanks.
translation: 我去看看，谢谢。

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 虽然你找到了顾客，但你似乎没带对食物！你需要 [a/some][ordered gnome food item]！

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 恐怕预制菜不行。只有手工制作的地精美食才够格给阿卢夫‧阿洛夫特的顾客。

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food item] to Professor Manglethorp.
translation: 你把 [a/some][ordered gnome food item] 的配送交给曼格尔索普教授。

english: Just what I need. Dwarven cuisine is a bit ... solid for my tastes.
translation: 正是我需要的。矮人美食对我来说有点……太硬了。

english: Here, take these Grand Seed pods. Very useful in emergencies!
translation: 给，拿着这些大树种子荚。紧急情况下很有用！

english: Here have this, I traded for it with some of the dwarves.
translation: 给，拿着这个，我和一些矮人交易得来的。

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: 你一定走了很远的路才把这个送到我这里，这里有点额外的小意思，拿着当小费。

english: You are given [a/some] [reward item(s)] as a tip.
translation: 你获得了 [a/some][reward item(s)] 作为小费。

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 你的配送太晚了！回去找小阿卢夫接另一个订单。你丢弃了配送箱，因为不再需要它了。

english: Be careful in here, there's lots of dangerous equipment.
translation: 在这里要小心，有很多危险设备。

english: What does this machine do?
translation: 这台机器是做什么的？

english: Nothing at the moment... It's broken. It's meant to be a transmutation machine.
translation: 目前什么都做不了……它坏了。它本来是一台转化机器。

english: It has also spent time as a time travel machine, and a dramatic lightning generator, and a thing for generating monsters.
translation: 它还曾经被用作时间旅行机器、戏剧性闪电发生器，还有生成怪物的装置。

english: Is this your house?
translation: 这是你的房子吗？

english: No, I'm just one of the tenants. It belongs to the count who lives in the basement.
translation: 不，我只是租户之一。它属于住在地下室的那位伯爵。

english: What does the portal machine do?
translation: 传送门机器是做什么的？

english: Ah, an interesting question! I believe it should create a rift in the very fabric of space! Opening a portal to some, hitherto undiscovered plane that exists parallel to our own.
translation: 啊，有趣的问题！我相信它应该在空间结构上制造一道裂缝！打开通往某个与我们世界平行、尚未发现的位面的传送门。

english: Huh?
translation: 哈？

english: It's a teleport machine.
translation: 就是台传送机器。

english: Errr, just before you go through there...
translation: 呃，在你进去之前……

english: What's the problem?
translation: 有什么问题？

english: That portal opens into a plane populated with some very shocking creatures. You should wear some kind of insulated armour before going there.
translation: 那个传送门通向一个充满非常可怕生物的位面。你去那里之前应该穿某种绝缘盔甲。

english: Where can I get insulated armour from?
translation: 我从哪里能得到绝缘盔甲？

english: Well there were some pretty tough people here last week. Said they were Slayer Masters. They were planning on making some protective boots. You should speak to one of them.
translation: 嗯，上周有几个很厉害的人来过这里。说自己是杀戮大师。他们正计划制作一些保护靴子。你应该去找他们其中一个谈谈。

english: Thanks, I'll do that.
translation: 谢谢，我会的。

english: No problem. See you later.
translation: 没问题。回头见。

english: I don't want to run around after Slayer Masters, I'm going through.
translation: 我不想跑来跑去找杀戮大师，我要进去了。

english: Fair enough, just don't say I didn't warn you
translation: 好吧，别说我没警告过你

english: Thanks, I think I'll stay here for a while then.
translation: 谢谢，那我想我还是在这里待一会儿吧。

english: Thanks for the warning, but I'm not scared of any monster.
translation: 谢谢警告，但我不怕任何怪物。

english: Ok. Just don't say I didn't warn you
translation: 好吧。别说我没警告过你

english: [Player name] before you go through there I must warn you that there are flashing lights and strobe effects on the other side. If you are an epilepsy sufferer you must NOT enter! Do you still want to go through?
translation: [Player name]，在你进去之前我必须警告你，那边有闪烁灯光和频闪效果。如果你患有癫痫，绝对不能进入！你还要进去吗？

english: Yes I still want to go in.
translation: 是的，我还要进去。

english: All right. Good luck then.
translation: 好吧。祝你好运。

english: Yes I want to go in and don't show me this message again.
translation: 是的我要进去，别再显示这条消息了。

english: No, I dont want to go in.
translation: 不，我不想进去。

english: That's a good decision, if you ask me.
translation: 要我说，那是个好决定。

english: What does this machine do?
translation: 这台机器是做什么的？

english: Is this your house?
translation: 这是你的房子吗？

english: What does the portal machine do?
translation: 传送门机器是做什么的？

english: Where can I get insulated armour from?
translation: 我从哪里能得到绝缘盔甲？

english: Thanks, I'll do that.
translation: 谢谢，我会的。

english: I don't want to run around after Slayer Masters, I'm going through.
translation: 我不想跑来跑去找杀戮大师，我要进去了。

english: Thanks, I think I'll stay here for a while then.
translation: 谢谢，那我想我还是在这里待一会儿吧。

english: Thanks for the warning, but I'm not scared of any monster.
translation: 谢谢警告，但我不怕任何怪物。

english: Yes I still want to go in.
translation: 是的，我还要进去。

english: Yes I want to go in and don't show me this message again.
translation: 是的我要进去，别再显示这条消息了。

english: No, I dont want to go in.
translation: 不，我不想进去。

english: Do you live here too?
translation: 你也住在这里吗？

english: Oh no, I come from the Gnome Stronghold. I've been sent here by King Narnode to learn about human magics.
translation: 哦不，我来自地精要塞。我是纳罗德国王派来这里学习人类魔法的。

english: So where's this Gnome Stronghold?
translation: 那地精要塞在哪里？

english: It's in the North West of the continent - a long way away. You should visit us there some time. The food's great, and the company's delightful.
translation: 在大陆的西北部——很远的地方。你应该找个时间去拜访我们。食物很棒，同伴也很愉快。

english: I'll try and make time for it. Sounds like a nice place.
translation: 我会尽量抽时间去。听起来是个好地方。

english: Well, it's full of gnomes. How much nicer could it be?
translation: 嗯，那里全是地精。还能有多好？

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 虽然你找到了顾客，但你似乎没带对食物！你需要 [a/some][ordered gnome food/drink item]！

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 恐怕预制菜不行。只有手工制作的地精美食才够格给阿卢夫‧阿洛夫特的顾客。

english: You hand over your delivery of [item] to Professor Onglewip
translation: 你把 [item] 的配送交给翁格利普教授

english: Ah, now that's a familiar smell. Thank you.
translation: 啊，这味道真熟悉。谢谢。

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: 你一定走了很远的路才把这个送到我这里，这里有点额外的小意思，拿着当小费。

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
translation: 你有 [number] 积分可以兑换免费配送券。你还没有资格获得地精美食配送。

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 你有 [number] 积分可以兑换免费配送券。你可以获得 [number] 份地精美食配送。

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: 别忘了从小阿卢夫‧吉安那里领取你的免费配送券。

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 你的配送太晚了！回去找小阿卢夫接另一个订单。你丢弃了配送箱，因为不再需要它了。

english: Git back ter work, ye young varmint! There's treasure in them walls, and it's not gonna mine itself while ye stand here yappin'.
translation: 回去干活，你这个小混蛋！墙里有宝藏，你站在这里瞎扯可不会自己挖出来。

english: How do I mine here?
translation: 我怎么在这里采矿？

english: Git ahold of yer pickaxe, find a vein of ore, and set to work. If ye got a bit of skill, ye'll have a pocket o' pay- dirt in no time.
translation: 拿起你的镐，找到矿脉，然后开工。如果你有点技术，很快就能装满一口袋矿砂。

english: I've built me a contraption to wash the pay-dirt. Just drop yer pay-dirt in the hopper, an' wait fer it at the other end.
translation: 我建了个装置来洗矿砂。把矿砂倒进漏斗，然后在另一端等就行。

english: I won't charge ye fer usin' my contraption, but ye'd better fix it yerself when it breaks. A good whack with a hammer usually settles it.
translation: 我用这个装置不收费，但坏了最好你自己修。用锤子好好敲一下通常就能修好。

english: Now will ye be gettin' to work now, or are ye gonna keep yappin' like a doggone galoot?
translation: 现在你是要去干活，还是继续像个大笨蛋一样瞎扯？

english: Would you like to trade?
translation: 你想交易吗？

english: If ye've found yerself some golden nuggets in this 'ere mine, I'll do you a swap, yeah.
translation: 如果你在这个矿里找到了一些金块，我可以跟你交换，是的。

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 跟我说说你自己。

english: Why, I'm Percy. Prospector Percy, the roughest, toughest, gruffest miner in the land. I've been pannin' fer gold since I were a young-un, and here's where I've struck it lucky.
translation: 哟，我是珀西。勘探者珀西，这片土地上最粗犷、最强硬、最暴躁的矿工。我从小就淘金，在这里我交了好运。

english: Excuse me, but what language are you speaking?
translation: 打扰一下，但你说的是什么语言？

english: Don't ye give me any of yer lip, ye dern varmint! Young'uns these days got no respect.
translation: 别跟我顶嘴，你这个该死的小混蛋！现在的年轻人真没礼貌。

english: Do go on.
translation: 请继续。

english: This here's the richest seam of ore I've found in all my days. After I built a contraption for washing the pay- dirt, the dwarves let me run things down here.
translation: 这是我这辈子找到的最富的矿脉。在我建了洗矿砂的装置后，矮人让我在这里管事。

english: Now, have ye any more idjit questions, or are ye ready to do some real work?
translation: 现在，你还有更多蠢问题吗，还是准备好干点正事了？

english: You discovered this mine?
translation: 你发现了这个矿？

english: Is there anything else I can unlock here?
translation: 这里还有什么我可以解锁的吗？

english: Let me have a think...
translation: 让我想想……

english: If ye've got level 57 Mining, ye could pay to use my restricted mine, up the ladder. 100 nuggets gives unlimited access.
translation: 如果你有57级采矿，可以付费使用我的限制矿区，就在梯子上面。100个金块可以获得无限访问权限。

english: How would ye like it if the sack were bigger? I'll let ye have more ore in there if ye pays me 200 nuggets.
translation: 你想要个大点的袋子吗？如果你给我200个金块，我可以让你装更多矿石。

english: I can give ye access to a special hopper in the restricted mine for 50 nuggets, but you'll need access to the restricted mine first.
translation: 我可以给你访问限制矿区里的特殊漏斗，要50个金块，但你需要先获得限制矿区的访问权限。

english: I'd like to buy access to the restricted mine, please.
translation: 我想购买限制矿区的访问权限。

english: Right, ye can go up there whenever ye likes. Just behave yerself, or my Ma will tan yer hide.
translation: 好的，你随时可以上去。乖乖的，不然我老妈会揍你屁股。

english: Ye'll need level 57 Mining first. An' don't think ye can fool me with yer potions and fancy stat-boosts. Get yer level up for real.
translation: 你需要先有57级采矿。别以为用药水和那些花哨的属性提升能骗过我。老老实实把等级练上去。

english: That'll be 100 nuggets. If ye ain't got enough, ye'd better do some more mining - that's how ye gets stuff round here!
translation: 要100个金块。如果你不够，最好再去挖点矿——在这里东西都是这么来的！

english: I'd like to get the bigger sack, please.
translation: 我想买个大点的袋子。

english: That'll be 200 nuggets. If ye ain't got enough, ye'd better do some more mining - that's how ye gets stuff round here!
translation: 要200个金块。如果你不够，最好再去挖点矿——在这里东西都是这么来的！

english: Ye can already climb the ladder to the restricted mine. But how would ye like it if the sack were bigger? I'll let ye have more ore in there if ye pays me 200 nuggets.
translation: 你已经可以爬梯子去限制矿区了。但你想要个大点的袋子吗？如果你给我200个金块，我可以让你装更多矿石。

english: I can give ye access to a special hopper in the restricted mine for 50 nuggets, it connects to the hopper down here.
translation: 我可以给你访问限制矿区里的特殊漏斗，要50个金块，它和下面的漏斗相连。

english: Ye can now use that fancy new hopper in the restricted mine.
translation: 你现在可以使用限制矿区里那个花哨的新漏斗了。

english: Well, now, I think ye've got everything already. Ye can already go climb the ladder to the restricted mine, ye've got the bigger sack capacity too and ye have access to that restricted hopper.
translation: 嗯，现在我想你什么都有了。你已经可以爬梯子去限制矿区，也有更大的袋子容量，还能使用那个限制漏斗。

english: That'll be 50 nuggets. If ye ain't got enough, ye'd better do some more mining - that's how ye gets stuff round here!
translation: 要50个金块。如果你不够，最好再去挖点矿——在这里东西都是这么来的！

english: Well, now, I think ye've got everything already. Ye can already go climb the ladder to the restricted mine, and ye've got the bigger sack capacity too.
translation: 嗯，现在我想你什么都有了。你已经可以爬梯子去限制矿区，也有更大的袋子容量了。

english: I'll leave you alone.
translation: 我不打扰你了。

english: Dern straight ye will.
translation: 你最好是这样。

english: Oi, git yerself out of that hole!It's not safe in there.
translation: 喂，从那个洞里出来！里面不安全。

english: You must complete the Medium Tier tasks from the Falador Achievement Diary before Percy will let you use that tunnel.
translation: 你必须完成法拉多成就日志的中级任务，珀西才会让你使用那个隧道。

english: We got us a jammed wheel!
translation: 我们的轮子卡住了！

english: Ye'd better fix that wheel!
translation: 你最好把那个轮子修好！

english: Git yer hammer an' fix that wheel!
translation: 拿起你的锤子去修那个轮子！

english: That water ain't flowing!
translation: 水不流了！

english: Both them wheels be jammed!
translation: 两个轮子都卡住了！

english: Git yer hammer an' fix them wheels!
translation: 拿起你的锤子去修那些轮子！

english: How do I mine here?
translation: 我怎么在这里采矿？

english: Would you like to trade?
translation: 你想交易吗？

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 跟我说说你自己。

english: Excuse me, but what language are you speaking?
translation: 打扰一下，但你说的是什么语言？

english: You discovered this mine?
translation: 你发现了这个矿？

english: Is there anything else I can unlock here?
translation: 这里还有什么我可以解锁的吗？

english: Restricted mine access: 100 nuggets
translation: 限制矿区访问：100个金块

english: Bigger sack: 200 nuggets
translation: 更大的袋子：200个金块

english: Cancel
translation: 取消

english: Restricted hopper: 50 nuggets
translation: 限制漏斗：50个金块

english: I'll leave you alone.
translation: 我不打扰你了。

english: Power for the people!
translation: 权力归人民！

english: The Council must answer us!
translation: 议会必须给我们答复！

english: The Council is corrupt!
translation: 议会腐败！

english: Down with the Council!
translation: 打倒议会！

english: Democracy is a lie!
translation: 民主是谎言！

english: We want answers!
translation: 我们要答案！

english: We won't be denied!
translation: 我们不会被拒绝！

english: We want a King!
translation: 我们要国王！

english: It's time for a King!
translation: 是时候要国王了！

english: A King for Kourend!
translation: 库兰德王国的国王！

english: What is it, human? I'm working.
translation: 什么事，人类？我在工作。

english: How do I use the furnace?
translation: 我怎么使用熔炉？

english: Put your ore on the conveyor belt to get it smelted. We'll stoke the boiler and operate the rest of the machinery for you.
translation: 把你的矿石放在传送带上就能冶炼。我们会为你添锅炉并操作其他机器。

english: You'll have to help repair the furnace whenever a pipe blows, though. Just hit it with a hammer - that usually works.
translation: 不过每次管道爆裂时你得帮忙修理熔炉。用锤子敲一下——通常就能修好。

english: You'll have to put money in the coffer to pay for our services. We charge 72,000 coins per hour; money is deducted as long as you're in this room with us.
translation: 你得把钱放进保险箱来支付我们的服务费用。我们每小时收费72,000金币；只要你在这个房间里和我们在一起，钱就会扣除。

english: Gosh, you're a remarkably big dwarf.
translation: 天哪，你真是个特别大的矮人。

english: My brothers and I have a rare genetic condition affecting our growth. Rather than treating us as freaks, you might like to appreciate how useful it is that we can operate the machinery.
translation: 我和我的兄弟们有一种罕见的遗传疾病影响我们的生长。与其把我们当怪胎，你不如感激我们能操作机器有多有用。

english: Sorry.
translation: 抱歉。

english: That's ok, human. You're not the first to comment on it. Now, did you need anything? I've got work to do here.
translation: 没关系，人类。你不是第一个这么说的人。现在，你需要什么吗？我在这里有工作要做。

english: Are you sure you're really a dwarf?
translation: 你确定你真的是矮人吗？

english: ... look, do you want help with something, or did you just come here to be rude? I've got work to do.
translation: ……听着，你是想要帮助，还是只是来这里无礼的？我有工作要做。

english: I'll let you get on with it.
translation: 我不打扰你了。

english: How do I use the furnace?
translation: 我怎么使用熔炉？

english: Gosh, you're a remarkably big dwarf.
translation: 天哪，你真是个特别大的矮人。

english: Sorry.
translation: 抱歉。

english: I'll let you get on with it.
translation: 我不打扰你了。

english: Are you sure you're really a dwarf?
translation: 你确定你真的是矮人吗？

english: I'm too important to talk to the likes of you, leave.
translation: 我太重要了，没时间和你这种人说话，走吧。

english: My secretary will deal with any inquiries you have about the Purple Pewter.
translation: 我的秘书会处理你对紫锡公司的任何询问。

english: My secretary is sitting just over there, thank you.
translation: 我的秘书就坐在那边，谢谢。

english: I'm busy, please leave.
translation: 我很忙，请离开。

english: Today is not a good day, can you come back tomorrow?
translation: 今天不是好日子，你明天能再来吗？

english: If you're looking for the market, it's downstairs.
translation: 如果你在找市场，它在楼下。

english: Do you mind? You're blocking my view.
translation: 你介意吗？你挡住我的视线了。

english: How did you get in here? I don't have time to talk to you!
translation: 你怎么进来的？我没时间和你说话！

english: I can't help you, go and see my secretary.
translation: 我帮不了你，去找我的秘书。

english: Talk to my secretary, I don't have time to deal with you.
translation: 和我的秘书谈，我没时间应付你。

english: But...
translation: 但是……

english: I said go!
translation: 我说走！

english: I told you to leave, human!
translation: 我告诉过你离开，人类！

english: What can I do for you, human?
translation: 人类，我能为你做什么？

english: Can I help you with anything?
translation: 我能帮你什么吗？

english: Was there anything you wanted?
translation: 你有什么想要的吗？

english: What did you need of the Purple Pewter?
translation: 你需要紫锡公司什么？

english: Is there anything you need assistance with?
translation: 有什么你需要帮助的吗？

english: And what can I do for you?
translation: 我能为你做什么？

english: Oh, by the way, I really like that outfit of yours!
translation: 哦，顺便说一句，我真的很喜欢你那身装扮！

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: I am the head secretary of the Purple Pewter.
translation: 我是紫锡公司的首席秘书。

english: The what?
translation: 什么？

english: I said, the Purple Pewter. Together with the other companies, we rule Keldagrim and the dwarven realm.
translation: 我说，紫锡公司。和其他公司一起，我们统治凯尔达格林和矮人王国。

english: Where am I?
translation: 我在哪里？

english: These are the offices of the Purple Pewter.
translation: 这里是紫锡公司的办公室。

english: This is the official residence of the Purple Pewter.
translation: 这里是紫锡公司的官邸。

english: Why, you are in the headquarters of the Purple Pewter.
translation: 哟，你在紫锡公司的总部。

english: We share this floor of the palace with the other companies of the Consortium. And trade with them on the Trade Octagon.
translation: 我们和财团的其他公司共用这层宫殿。并在交易八角广场上与他们交易。

english: The Trade Octagon?
translation: 交易八角广场？

english: See those traders out there, just out the door? They're all standing in the Trade Octagon. There's an awful lot of trade going on in the palace, you know.
translation: 看到门外那些商人了吗？他们都站在交易八角广场里。要知道，宫殿里的交易可繁忙着呢。

english: Anything else of interest in the palace?
translation: 宫殿里还有什么有趣的东西吗？

english: You will have to find that out on your own, I'm afraid. I do have more work to do.
translation: 恐怕你得自己去找答案。我还有更多工作要做。

english: I have to go!
translation: 我得走了！

english: Goodbye, human.
translation: 再见，人类。

english: See you later.
translation: 回头见。

english: Okay.
translation: 好的。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Where am I?
translation: 我在哪里？

english: Is there anything I can help you with?
translation: 有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: I have to go!
translation: 我得走了！

english: That's no use!
translation: 那没用！

english: No need! I'm fine thanks.
translation: 不需要！我很好谢谢。

english: Looks like it's quiet for now. I don't need help, but thank you.
translation: 看起来现在很安静。我不需要帮助，但谢谢。

english: Light this brazier!
translation: 点燃这个火盆！

english: Yemalo shi cardito!
translation: Yemalo shi cardito！

english: Fix this brazier!
translation: 修理这个火盆！

english: Arg, it got me!
translation: 啊，它打到我了！

english: Mummy!
translation: 妈妈！

english: My flame burns low.
translation: 我的火焰变弱了。

english: We are doomed.
translation: 我们完蛋了。

english: I think I'm dying.
translation: 我想我快死了。

english: Ugh, help me!
translation: 呃，救救我！

english: We can rest for a time.
translation: 我们可以休息一会儿。

english: Good day [sir/miss]. I'm the quartermaster for this camp. We have a little we could trade here.
translation: 你好 [sir/miss]。我是这个营地的军需官。我们这里有些东西可以交易。

english: We should be getting a new stock soon. Would you like a look at what we do have?
translation: 我们很快会有新货。你想看看我们有什么吗？

english: Yes please. What are you selling?
translation: 你在卖什么？

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了谢谢。

english: We have a new stock of dragon halberds. Would you like a look at what we have?
translation: 我们有一批新的龙金戟。你想看看我们有什么吗？

english: Yes please. What are you selling?
translation: 你在卖什么？

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了谢谢。

english: Hey - what are you doing with that patch, peasant?!? One demands that you speak to one's self immediately!!
translation: 嘿——你在那块地上做什么，农民？！本王要求你立刻和本王说话！！

english: [Roughly translated, this means that Queen Ellamaria would like a word.]
translation: [粗略翻译，这意味着埃拉玛利亚女王想和你说句话。]

english: I shall not allow you to climb my trellis, peasant. Only providing your assistance to my project might cause me to reconsider.
translation: 我不会让你爬我的花架，农民。只有你协助我的项目，我才会重新考虑。

english: Can I use this garden for my own farming?
translation: 我能用这个花园自己种东西吗？

english: What, you want to dig up the plants that took one so long to grow? Don't be ridiculous, you silly little fool.
translation: 什么，你想挖掉本王花了这么久才种出来的植物？别傻了，你这个愚蠢的小傻瓜。

english: All right then, sorry I asked.
translation: 那好吧，抱歉我问了。

english: Impertinent peasant! Oh, if you promise to leave one alone then feel free to pick fruit from the White Tree. One is told that they are a great natural energy restorative.
translation: 无礼的农民！哦，如果你答应不打扰本王，那就随意从白树上摘果子吧。听说它们是很好的天然能量恢复剂。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Er...Hello, Your Majesty.
translation: 呃……你好，陛下。

english: Have you come for a particular reason? I am a busy Queen, you know. I had to attend the opening of a new orphanage this morning.
translation: 你来有什么特别的事吗？你也知道，本王日理万机。今天早上我还得参加一个新孤儿院的开幕式。

english: Yes, I...
translation: 是的，我……

english: And this afternoon I shall be receiving the Embassadorof Karamja and accompanying him on his week-long tour of Etceteria.
translation: 今天下午我还要接见卡拉姆詹的大使，陪他在埃克特西亚进行为期一周的访问。

english: Er, I...
translation: 呃，我……

english: Then this evening we shall be putting on a grand ball! All of the kingdom's nobility will be present!
translation: 然后今晚我们还要举办一场盛大的舞会！王国的所有贵族都会出席！

english: If I m...
translation: 如果我……

english: Oh, who am I kidding...nothing ever happens here. I always wanted to be a princess when I was a girl. If I'd been told it would be like this, I wouldn't have bothered.
translation: 哦，我在骗谁呢……这里什么都不会发生。我小时候一直想当公主。要是早知道会是这样，我才不会费这个劲。

english: Your Majesty!
translation: 陛下！

english: Yes? Did you want something?
translation: 什么事？你想要什么？

english: ...actually, no.
translation: ……其实没有。

english: Your Majesty...
translation: 陛下……

english: Vargas, you irritating fool. 'Warmongering harpy', indeed!
translation: 瓦加斯，你这个讨厌的傻瓜。''好战的鹰身女妖''，真是的！

english: Sorry?
translation: 抱歉？

english: Oh, I apologise. I was merely thinking out loud.
translation: 哦，抱歉。我只是在想事情。

english: How is your kingdom faring?
translation: 你的王国过得怎么样？

english: It could be better. Now, if you don't mind, I'm rather busy.
translation: 还可以更好。现在，如果你不介意，我很忙。

english: Very well, your Majesty.
translation: 很好，陛下。

english: Nilsal, [player name]. It is good to see you.
translation: 你好，[player name]。很高兴见到你。

english: Likewise, my Queen. How have things been since the Emissaries were dealt with?
translation: 我也是，女王陛下。自从使者事件解决后情况如何？

english: Well, with the cult out of the way, we've been able to refocus on the recent opening of the kingdom. Signing the treaties was only the first step.
translation: 嗯，邪教解决后，我们能够重新专注于王国最近的开放。签署条约只是第一步。

english: There are new opportunities for us in areas such as trade that we're still yet to fully explore.
translation: 我们在贸易等领域还有新的机会尚未充分探索。

english: Then of course you have Kourend. The complicated history between our kingdoms means we are yet to sign a treaty with them, but my hope is that will change soon.
translation: 当然还有库兰德王国。我们王国之间复杂的历史意味着我们尚未与他们签署条约，但我希望很快就会改变。

english: Then of course you have Kourend. The complicated history between our kingdoms means we are yet to sign a treaty with them.
translation: 当然还有库兰德王国。两国历史纠葛复杂，致使条约至今未能签署。

english: I was hoping to arrange one with their new king, but his reign turned out to be a rather short one. I must confess, I find the continued instability up there to be concerning.
translation: 我本来希望能和他们的新国王签署一份条约，但他的统治时间相当短。我必须承认，我觉得那里的持续不稳定令人担忧。

english: You're not the only one...
translation: 你不是唯一一个这么想的……

english: We will have to see how their new king fares. He is young and inexperienced, but he may still have potential...
translation: 我们得看看他们的新国王表现如何。他年轻缺乏经验，但可能仍有潜力……

english: Anyway, if there's nothing else, I'm afraid I must return to my work. May the sun light your way, [player name].
translation: 总之，如果没有其他事，恐怕我得回去工作了。愿阳光照亮你的道路，[player name]。

english: Ah. Welcome, adventurer. I'm here to tell you all about quests. Let's start by opening your quest list.
translation: 欢迎，冒险者。我来给你讲讲任务的相关事宜。我们先打开你的任务列表。

english: Have you not opened that menu yet?
translation: 你还没打开那个菜单吗？

english: Now that you have the quest list open, you can see all the quests within it. Clicking one of these quests will display some more information on it.
translation: 现在你打开了任务列表，可以看到里面的所有任务。点击其中一个任务会显示更多相关信息。

english: If you haven't started the quest, it will tell you where to begin and what requirements you need. If the quest is in progress, it will remind you what to do next.
translation: 如果你还没开始任务，它会告诉你从哪里开始以及需要满足什么条件。如果任务正在进行中，它会提醒你下一步做什么。

english: Clicking a quest in the journal will display some more information on it. If you haven't started the quest, it will tell you where to begin and what requirements you need.
translation: 点击日志中的任务会显示更多相关信息。如果你还没开始任务，它会告诉你从哪里开始以及需要满足什么条件。

english: It's very easy to find quest start points. Just look out for the quest icon on your minimap. You should see one marking this house.
translation: 找任务起点很容易。只要留意小地图上的任务图标。你应该能看到一个标记这所房子的图标。

english: The quests themselves can vary greatly from collecting beads to hunting down dragons. Completing quests will reward you with all sorts of things, such as new areas and better weapons!
translation: 任务类型多种多样，小到收集珠子，大到猎杀巨龙。完成任务能让你获得各种奖励，比如解锁新区域、获取更强的武器！

english: There's not a lot more I can tell you about questing. You have to experience the thrill of it yourself to fully understand.
translation: 关于任务我没什么更多可告诉你的。你得亲自体验个中滋味，才能真正体会。

english: Would you like to hear about quests again?
translation: 你想再听一次关于任务的介绍吗？

english: Yes!
translation: 是的！

english: Within your quest list, you'll unsurprisingly find a list of quests. Clicking one of these quests will display some more information on it.
translation: 在你的任务列表中，不出所料你会发现一个任务列表。点击其中一个任务会显示更多相关信息。

english: Nope, I'm ready to move on!
translation: 不，我准备好继续了！

english: Okay then.
translation: 那好吧。

english: Yes!
translation: 是的！

english: Nope, I'm ready to move on!
translation: 不，我准备好继续了！

english: Can I bother you for a moment?
translation: 我能打扰你一会儿吗？

english: Oh yes?
translation: 哦是吗？

english: Do you ever think you'd rather have one of my larger friends to be your companion? I can't carry you like they can.
translation: 你有没有想过更愿意让我的一个大个子朋友做你的同伴？我不能像他们那样载你。

english: I'm actually glad to have you with me! You may even grow up to be giant one day. Maybe then you could carry me everywhere.
translation: 我其实很高兴有你陪伴！也许有一天你会长成巨人。那时你就可以载我去任何地方了。

english: Except towards volcanoes... We birds aren't so good in those conditions.
translation: 除了火山……我们鸟类在那种环境下不太行。

english: Eeeep!
translation: 咿！

english: *Whistle*
translation: 口哨

english: It's your lucky day, [player name]! You've got a chance to win big prizes in my quiz show. Would you like to play?
translation: 今天是你的幸运日，[player name]！你有机会在我的问答节目中赢得大奖。你想玩吗？

english: Yes please, I'm so excited!
translation: 好的谢谢，我太兴奋了！

english: WELCOME to the GREATEST QUIZ SHOW in the entire of Gielinor!
translation: 欢迎来到基利诺尔最伟大的问答节目！

english: ODD!ONE!OUT!
translation: 找出不同的一项！

english: Please welcome our newest contestant:[player name]! Four questions right, and then you win! You know the rules, so let's begin!
translation: 欢迎我们最新的参赛者：[player name]！答对四题，你就赢了！你知道规则，那我们开始吧！

english: Sorry, it's [player name] that's having the lucky day.
translation: 抱歉，今天是 [player name] 的幸运日。

english: WRONG! That's just WRONG! Okay, next question!
translation: 错了！完全错了！好吧，下一题！

english: BZZZZZZZ! WRONG! Okay, next question!
translation: 滋滋滋！答错了！好，下一题！

english: No, you're WRONG! Okay, next question!
translation: 不，你错了！好吧，下一题！

english: No, sorry. Try harder! Okay, next question!
translation: 不，抱歉。再努力点！好吧，下一题！

english: Better luck next time! Okay, next question!
translation: 下次好运！好吧，下一题！

english: Nope, that's not it. Okay, next question!
translation: 不对，不是那个。好吧，下一题！

english: Huh...? Didn't you know that one? Okay, next question!
translation: 哈……？你不知道那个吗？好吧，下一题！

english: No, no, no... That's completely WRONG! Okay, next question!
translation: 不不不……完全错了！好吧，下一题！

english: WRONG WRONG WRONG! Okay, next question!
translation: 错错错！好吧，下一题！

english: DING DING DING! That's RIGHT! Good for you! Okay, next question!
translation: 叮叮叮！答对了！干得好！好吧，下一题！

english: Absolutely RIGHT! Keep going for the win! Okay, next question!
translation: 完全正确！继续争取胜利！好吧，下一题！

english: COR-RECT! Okay, next question!
translation: 正——确！好吧，下一题！

english: Hey, you're good at this! CORRECT! Okay, next question!
translation: 嘿，你很擅长这个！正确！好吧，下一题！

english: Wow, you're a smart one! You're absolutely RIGHT! Okay, next question!
translation: 哇，你真聪明！完全正确！好吧，下一题！

english: YES! You're RIGHT! Okay, next question!
translation: 是的！你答对了！好吧，下一题！

english: CONGRATULATIONS! You are aWINNER! Please choose yourPRIZE!
translation: 恭喜！你赢了！请选择你的奖品！

english: Hey [player name]! It's your lucky day!
translation: 嘿 [player name]！今天是你的幸运日！

english: Wakey-wakey, [player name]!
translation: 起床啦，[player name]！

english: You're in for a treat, [player name]!
translation: 你有好戏看了，[player name]！

english: Come along with me, [player name]!
translation: 跟我来，[player name]！

english: Maybe later.
translation: 也许以后吧。

english: Yes please, I'm so excited!
translation: 好的谢谢，我太兴奋了！

english: Quiz shows are stupid. Go away.
translation: 问答节目很蠢。走开。

english: 1000 Coins
Mystery Box
translation: 神秘盒子

english: How am I supposed to get past this?
translation: 我该怎么过去？

english: Gah!
translation: 啊！

english: If I'd been any slower, I would've lost my head!
translation: 要是再慢半拍，脑袋可就搬家了！

english: Buying that ring was definitely a wise investment.
translation: 买那个戒指绝对是明智的投资。

english: Well, the door to the next floor has already closed. Might as well take a break.
translation: 嗯，通往下一层的门已经关了。不如休息一下。

english: 96... 97... 98... 99 Hallowed marks! Almost enough for that grapple!
translation: 96……97……98……99枚神圣印记！差不多够换那副抓钩了！

english: I can't wait until I have enough Hallowed marks to obtain a dark graceful outfit.
translation: 我迫不及待想攒够神圣印记，换一套黑暗优雅套装。

english: I prefer this floor. Those owls on the next one creep me out!
translation: 我更喜欢这一层。下一层那些猫头鹰真让人发毛！

english: Who's a cute bunny!
translation: 谁是可爱的小兔子！

english: -sniff sniff-
translation: -嗅嗅 -

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: No time to talk, another time perhaps.
translation: 没时间说话，改天吧。

english: Hello fellow bunny, how's it hanging?
translation: 你好兔子朋友，最近怎么样？

english: Hello friend, no time to talk, the early rabbit gets the carrot as they say.
translation: 你好朋友，没时间说话，俗话说，早起的兔子有萝卜吃。

english: Hop along then.
translation: 那跳走吧。

english: Hey.
translation: 嘿。

english: The rabbit starts sniffing you.
translation: 兔子开始嗅你。

english: The rabbit keeps sniffing you.
translation: 兔子继续嗅你。

english: I'm going to go.
translation: 我要走了。

english: Hi there.
translation: 你好。

english: I'm late, I'm late for a very important date.
translation: 我迟到了，我有个非常重要的约会要迟到了。

english: You seem to be having an eggsistential crisis.
translation: 你似乎正面临蛋生危机。

english: You're not funny, it's rabbits like you that give us a bad name.
translation: 你不好笑，就是你这样的兔子给我们抹黑。

english: Hello friend, would you like to hear a joke?
translation: 你好朋友，想听个笑话吗？

english: Not really.
translation: 不太想。

english: What's a rabbit's favoritedance style?
translation: 兔子最喜欢的舞蹈风格是什么？

english: Hip-Hop!
translation: 嘻哈！

english: You hear the distant sound of a drum set going off.
translation: 你听到远处传来鼓声。

english: Fellow rabbit...
translation: 兔子朋友……

english: What are you up to?
translation: 你在做什么？

english: I'm just pondering.
translation: 我在思考。

english: About what?
translation: 思考什么？

english: Did the Wise Old Rabbit ever tell you about Duke Harrous the dumb.
translation: 智慧老兔子有没有告诉过你关于愚蠢的哈罗斯公爵的事。

english: No, I don't think he did?
translation: 没有，我想他没有？

english: Hmph, not a story he would ever tell you, it's a rabbit legend, but perhaps another time.
translation: 哼，这不是他会告诉你的故事，这是兔子传说，不过也许改天吧。

english: Isn't this wonderful, coming out here and looking out over the sea.
translation: 出来这里眺望大海不是很美妙吗。

english: I could stay here with you forever...
translation: 我可以永远和你待在这里……

english: They look a little pre-occupied.
translation: 他们看起来有点心事重重。

english: I could really do with your help, but the Duke hasn't given me permission to talk to you.
translation: 我真的很需要你的帮助，但公爵还没允许我和你说话。

english: What am I to do?
translation: 我该怎么办？

english: What's wrong?
translation: 怎么了？

english: Oh bother, oh bother, oh bother, I'm in a terrible terrible mess! It's the annual Egg Descendance Day tomorrow, and I should be making him a big carrot cake.
translation: 哦麻烦了，哦麻烦了，哦麻烦了，我陷入大麻烦了！明天是年度蛋降日，我应该给他做一个大胡萝卜蛋糕。

english: I've forgotten to buy the ingredients. I'll never get them in time now. The duke will turn me into soup! What will I do? I have 12 children to look after. Would you help me? Please?
translation: 我忘记买原料了。现在肯定来不及了。公爵非得把我炖成汤不可！我该怎么办？我还有12个孩子要照顾。你能帮我吗？求求你？

english: Yes, I'll help you.
translation: 是的，我会帮你。

english: Oh thank you, thank you. I need a carrot, a cabbage and a cake. I'd be very grateful if you can get them for me.
translation: 哦谢谢你，谢谢你。我需要一根胡萝卜、一棵卷心菜和一个蛋糕。如果你能帮我弄到我会非常感激。

english: I have all of those ingredients on me already!
translation: 我身上已经有所有这些原料了！

english: That's an odd coincidence... Were you planning on making a carrot cake too?
translation: 这巧合可真蹊跷……莫非你也打算做胡萝卜蛋糕？

english: Not exactly. I just had an odd feeling you might be needing these ingredients. If I see a rabbit cook, I presume there's food of some kind! Lucky guess I suppose.
translation: 不完全是。我只是有种奇怪的感觉你可能需要这些原料。如果我看到兔子厨师，我推测会有某种食物！我猜是运气好。

english: Well thank you! Hand them over, please.
translation: 那谢谢你！请把它们给我。

english: You hand the cook all of the ingredients.
translation: 你把所有原料交给厨师。

english: You've brought me everything I need! I am saved! Thank you!
translation: 你把我需要的都带来了！我得救了！谢谢！

english: So do I get to go to the Descendance Day dinner?
translation: 那我能去参加降日晚宴吗？

english: I'm afraid not, only the big carrots get to dine with the egg.
translation: 恐怕不行，只有大胡萝卜才能和蛋一起用餐。

english: Sounds lame anyway, I didn't want to be invited.
translation: 反正听起来很无聊，我也不想被邀请。

english: How dare you.
translation: 你好大的胆子。

english: Quest complete!
translation: 任务完成！

english: So where do I find these ingredients then?
translation: 那我在哪里找到这些原料？

english: It's something rabbits are constantly munching on, have a look in some of the houses nearby.
translation: 这是兔子们一直在啃的东西，去附近的一些房子里看看。

english: Won't they be annoyed I'm nicking their carrots?
translation: 他们不会因为我偷他们的胡萝卜而生气吗？

english: Who cares, Descendance day is far more important than their needs.
translation: 谁在乎，降日比他们的需求重要得多。

english: I normally get my cabbage from the fields, on the other side of the river.
translation: 我通常从河对岸的田地里获得卷心菜。

english: There are rabbit farmers too!? How cute.
translation: 还有兔子农民！？真可爱。

english: That you'll have to have a nosey round for, rabbits around here are always celebrating something.
translation: 这个你得四处打听一下，这里的兔子总是在庆祝什么。

english: Lots of theft in the rabbit realm...
translation: 兔子王国里有很多盗窃……

english: You gotta do what you gotta do.
translation: 该做的就得做。

english: I've got all the information I need. Thanks.
translation: 我得到了所有需要的信息。谢谢。

english: Actually, I know where to find this stuff.
translation: 其实，我知道在哪里找到这些东西。

english: No, I don't feel like it, maybe later.
translation: 不，我没心情，也许以后吧。

english: Fine. I always knew you Adventurer types were callous rabbits. Go on, hop off!
translation: 好吧。我一直知道你们冒险者都是无情的兔子。走吧，跳开！

english: You don't look very happy.
translation: 你看起来不太高兴。

english: No, I'm not. The world is caving in around me - I am overcome by dark feelings of impending doom.
translation: 不，我不高兴。世界在我周遭崩塌——我被厄运将至的阴霾所笼罩。

english: I'd take the rest of the day off if I were you.
translation: 如果我是你，我会休息一天。

english: No, that's the worst thing I could do. I'd get in terrible trouble.
translation: 不，那是我最不该做的。我会陷入大麻烦。

english: Well maybe you need to take a drink...
translation: 嗯也许你需要喝点东西……

english: That would be nice, but the great round one has banned all consumption of Cabbage flavoured drinks.
translation: 那会很好，但伟大的圆球家伙禁止了所有卷心菜味饮料的消费。

english: Hmm, why not something that doesn't taste of cabbage?
translation: 嗯，为什么不试试不含卷心菜味的东西？

translation: 那么，跟我说说你的提议。

english: Camdozaal is a shadow of what it once was. We Imcando Dwarves were the finest artisans in the world, but now I am all that remains. Today, you'll only find echoes of our once great city.
translation: 坎多扎尔只是昔日的阴影。我们伊姆坎多矮人曾是世界上最好的工匠，但现在只剩下我了。如今，你只能在这昔日伟城的废墟中寻觅余音。

english: But that which was once great can still be great again! We Imcando Dwarves know that better than most. There is hope for the future of Camdozaal. But I need help.
translation: 但曾经伟大的东西仍可再次伟大！我们伊姆坎多矮人比大多数人更清楚这一点。坎多扎尔的未来仍有希望。但我需要帮助。

english: What do you need?
translation: 你需要什么？

english: We have a Sacred Forge. You will find none other like it in all the world. Some of the greatest weapons of legend started life here.
translation: 我们有一个神圣熔炉。全世界你找不到第二个。一些传说中最伟大的武器就是在这里诞生的。

english: The Forge could be the key to Camdozaal's future, but it's going out. If it does, I fear it will never be lit again. I can no longer gather the fuel it needs. But perhaps you can?
translation: 熔炉可能是坎多扎尔未来的关键，但它快熄灭了。如果灭了，恐怕再也点不燃了。我再也无法收集它所需的燃料。但也许你可以？

english: Fuel?
translation: 燃料？

english: Barronite. You'll only find it in these ruins. If you can gather some for me, I can use it to keep the Forge lit. In return, I'll let you take what you want from our Great Vault.
translation: 巴隆石。你只能在这些废墟里找到。如果你能帮我收集一些，我可以用它保持熔炉燃烧。作为回报，我会让你从我们的大金库里拿走你想要的东西。

english: I no longer have use for anything in the Vault. Besides, material possessions mean nothing compared to the fire of the Sacred Forge.
translation: 我不再需要金库里的任何东西了。此外，与神圣熔炉的火焰相比，物质财产毫无意义。

english: So I find barronite in the ruins and bring it to you? Doesn't sound too difficult. Where should I start?
translation: 所以我在废墟里找到巴隆石然后带给你？听起来不太难。我应该从哪里开始？

english: Anywhere you like. The ruins are filled with barronite, so anything you do here should yield some. If you need more information on specific things you can do, just let me know.
translation: 任何你喜欢的地方。废墟里充满了巴隆石，所以你在这里做的任何事都应该能产出一些。如果你需要关于你能做的具体事情的更多信息，告诉我。

english: What happened to the other Imcando Dwarves?
translation: 其他伊姆坎多矮人怎么了？

english: Ah... It's a tough tale to tell. Even though it's been many years since the last of my kin died out, the memory is still fresh.
translation: 啊……这是个艰难的故事。虽然我的最后一个亲属去世已经很多年了，但记忆依然清晰。

english: You don't have to tell me if the memory hurts too much.
translation: 如果记忆太痛苦你不必告诉我。

english: No, I will. The legacy of my kin must live on.
translation: 不，我会的。我亲属的遗产必须延续下去。

english: As you can see around you, Camdozaal was once a great city. Alive with the hum of activity. We dug deep into the mountain and reaped the rewards.
translation: 正如你周围所见，坎多扎尔曾经是一座伟大的城市。充满活动的嗡嗡声。我们深入挖掘山脉并收获了回报。

english: Our methods would often differ from other dwarves. Whereas they just used traditional smithing techniques, we would combine them with magic as well.
translation: 我们的方法通常与其他矮人不同。他们只使用传统的锻造技术，而我们会将它们与魔法结合。

english: Alas, that was ultimately our undoing. We learned of a horde of barbarians pillaging across the land, hunting down and killing anyone who dared use magic.
translation: 唉，那最终导致了我们的灭亡。我们得知一群野蛮人在大地上掠夺，追捕并杀死任何敢于使用魔法的人。

english: We underestimated them. We believed our weapons would be enough to keep us safe. We were wrong.
translation: 我们低估了他们。我们相信我们的武器足以保护我们安全。我们错了。

english: The barbarians brought ruin upon Camdozaal. Most of my kind died as the city collapsed around them. Only a few of us survived until the end. Now, only I remain.
translation: 野蛮人给坎多扎尔带来了毁灭。我的大多数同类在城市倒塌时死去。只有我们少数人活到了最后。现在，只剩下我了。

english: The world has changed a lot, Ramarno. Magic is practiced freely. Those barbarians failed to wipe it from Gielinor.
translation: 世界变化很大，拉马诺。魔法被自由实践。那些野蛮人未能将其从基利诺尔抹去。

english: I'm glad they didn't win, I suppose. But it doesn't change much for me. I am still the last Imcando Dwarf.
translation: 我想我很高兴他们没有赢。但这对我也没太大改变。我仍然是最后一个伊姆坎多矮人。

english: I'm sorry Ramarno. I will do my best to help ensure the legacy of your kin lives on.
translation: 我很抱歉拉马诺。我会尽力帮助确保你亲属的遗产延续下去。

english: Thank you, [player name]. That gives me some hope. If you have any more questions, do not hesitate to ask.
translation: 谢谢你，[player name]。那给了我希望。如果你还有任何问题，尽管问。

english: I'll see you later.
translation: 回头见。

english: Ah [player name]. I'm sure you have plenty of questions. I will do my best to answer them.
translation: 啊 [player name]。我相信你有很多问题。我会尽力回答。

english: What can I do here?
translation: 我在这里能做什么？

english: As you can see, Camdozaal isn't the city it once was. That said, there are still a few things around here that might interest you. There's the golem workshop, the barronite mine and the offering altar.
translation: 如你所见，坎多扎尔不再是昔日的城市。话虽如此，这里仍有一些你可能感兴趣的东西。有魔像工坊、巴隆石矿和献祭祭坛。

english: Tell me more about the golem workshop.
translation: 多告诉我一些关于魔像工坊的事。

english: You'll find it to the east. It was once the forefront of our technological advances. Sadly, it was also one of the major factors that led to our doom.
translation: 你在东边能找到它。它曾是我们技术进步的前沿。不幸的是，它也是导致我们灭亡的主要因素之一。

english: What were you doing there?
translation: 你们在那里做什么？

english: Camdozaal was built upon the ruins of an older civilization. Little trace of them remained by the time we arrived. However, when building the city, ancient golems were discovered.
translation: 坎多扎尔建在一个更古老文明的废墟上。我们到达时几乎没留下他们的痕迹。然而，在建造城市时，发现了古代魔像。

english: These golems were very crude. They were mostly made from clay, of all things. We used our advanced Smithing knowledge to improve their form. Eventually, we were able to get them working again.
translation: 这些魔像非常粗糙。它们主要是用粘土做的。我们利用我们先进的锻造知识改进了它们的形态。最终，我们能够让它们再次工作。

english: We kept pushing with the golems. Many of them we imbued with magical energies. We started with mind and body energy, but eventually moved on to chaos as well.
translation: 我们继续推进魔像。我们给许多魔像注入了魔法能量。我们从精神和身体能量开始，但最终也转向了混乱。

english: Alas, the influence of chaos had grave results. We lost control of many. Those that became corrupt had to be locked away, but by then it was already too late.
translation: 唉，混乱的影响产生了严重后果。我们失去了对许多魔像的控制。那些变得腐败的必须被锁起来，但那时已经太晚了。

english: The barbarians had learnt of our experimentation, and were determined to destroy all traces of it.
translation: 野蛮人得知了我们的实验，并决心摧毁所有痕迹。

english: Ironically, locking them away meant the golems were among the few things to survive the barbarians. If you fancy a bit of combat, you might want to go take a look.
translation: 具有讽刺意味的是，把它们锁起来意味着魔像是少数在野蛮人手中幸存下来的东西之一。如果你想有点战斗，你可能想去看看。

english: They're largely made of barronite now, so they're a good source of the stuff.
translation: 它们现在主要由巴隆石制成，所以它们是这种东西的好来源。

english: Their cores are also very interesting. Apparently, the dwarves of the golem workshop once used old cores to craft runes. Maybe you could do the same.
translation: 它们的核心也非常有趣。显然，魔像工坊的矮人曾经用旧核心制作符石。也许你也可以这样做。

english: Tell me more about the barronite mine.
translation: 多告诉我一些关于巴隆石矿的事。

english: You'll find it to the north west. Unsurprisingly, it's the best place to find barronite in the city.
translation: 你在西北边能找到它。不出所料，那是城里找到巴隆石最好的地方。

english: At one time, our miners would work all through the day there to gather the barronite needed to power the Sacred Forge. That was a long time ago.
translation: 曾经，我们的矿工整天在那里工作，收集神圣熔炉所需的巴隆石。那是很久以前的事了。

english: If you're lucky, you might find other things while mining there. We were not the first to build a home beneath this mountain. Sometimes traces of an older civilization can be found.
translation: 如果你幸运，你可能在那里采矿时发现其他东西。我们不是第一个在这座山下建造家园的人。有时能找到更古老文明的痕迹。

english: What kind of traces?
translation: 什么样的痕迹？

english: You might find some ancient relics encased within barronite. If you do, you can use the anvils here to crack open the deposits.
translation: 你可能会发现一些包裹在巴隆石中的古代遗物。如果有，你可以用这里的铁砧敲开矿床。

english: The relics are of no interest to me. Maybe some of your race would find them interesting.
translation: 我对这些遗物没兴趣。也许你们种族中有些人会觉得它们有趣。

english: Tell me more about the offering altar.
translation: 多告诉我一些关于献祭祭坛的事。

english: You'll find it to the south west. It's not something that ever interested me, but most of my kind were followers of Saradomin - the god of order and wisdom.
translation: 你在西南边能找到它。那不是我感兴趣的东西，但我的大多数同类都是萨拉多明的追随者——秩序与智慧之神。

english: Many of my kin would visit the altar to make offerings in his name.
translation: 我的许多亲属会去祭坛以他的名义献祭。

english: First, they'd catch fish from the nearby reservoir. Next, they'd ritually prepare them at tables by the altar. Finally, they'd use the altar to offer the fish.
translation: 首先，他们会从附近的水库捕鱼。接下来，他们会在祭坛旁的桌子上仪式性地准备它们。最后，他们会用祭坛献祭鱼。

english: There's plenty of barronite to be found within the reservoir, so it might be worth checking out. Be warned though: worshipping gods never did my kind any good.
translation: 水库里有很多巴隆石可找，所以可能值得去看看。但要警告你：崇拜神从未给我的同类带来好处。

english: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们聊聊别的事。

english: Very well.
translation: 很好。

english: I have something I'd like you to examine.
translation: 我有东西想让你检查。

english: Well hand it over and I'll take a look.
translation: 好吧递给我，我看看。

english: Use an item on Ramarno for him to examine it.
translation: 在拉马诺身上使用物品让他检查。

english: Well... that isn't completely true.
translation: 嗯……那不完全正确。

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你什么意思？

english: While adventuring, I met another Imcando Dwarf called Thurgo.
translation: 在冒险时，我遇到了另一个叫瑟戈的伊姆坎多矮人。

english: An Imcando Dwarf survived outside the city?
translation: 一个伊姆坎多矮人在城外幸存了？

english: Yes. He looks to be doing quite well for himself. In fact, he seems to be a master of Smithing.
translation: 是的。他看起来过得很好。事实上，他似乎是个锻造大师。

english: I can't believe it. I hope to meet him one day. He must be a truly amazing smith to reach such heights.
translation: 我真不敢相信。我希望有一天能见到他。他一定是个真正了不起的铁匠才能达到这样的高度。

english: Well he's certainly an interesting dwarf.
translation: 他确实是个有趣的矮人。

english: Thank you, [player name]! You've given me hope that my kin can live on. If you need help with anything else, let me know.
translation: 谢谢你，[player name]！你给了我希望，我的亲属可以延续下去。如果你需要其他帮助，告诉我。

english: Can I use the Forge?
translation: 我能使用熔炉吗？

english: I'm afraid not. The Sacred Forge is like none other in existence. Only an Imcando Dwarf could use it correctly.
translation: 恐怕不行。神圣熔炉是独一无二的。只有伊姆坎多矮人才能正确使用它。

english: What makes it so special?
translation: 什么让它如此特别？

english: Truth be told, I don't fully know. It's far older than I am. It was supposedly built in the earliest days of the city.
translation: 说实话，我不完全知道。它比我老得多。据说它是在城市最早期建造的。

english: What I do know is that it's been imbued with powerful magic - some said that of the gods themselves. The Forge powers the entire city, or what's left of it at least.
translation: 我知道的是它被注入了强大的魔法——有人说那是神本身的魔法。熔炉为整个城市提供动力，或者至少是剩下的部分。

english: I've been doing my best to keep it lit over the years. It's not a job I'm capable of any more though. That's why I'm hoping you can help.
translation: 多年来我一直尽力保持它燃烧。但这不再是我能胜任的工作了。这就是为什么我希望你能帮忙。

english: Bring me any barronite you find. In return, I can channel enough power from the Forge into the city or even open the Great Vault.
translation: 把你找到的任何巴隆石带给我。作为回报，我可以从熔炉向城市输送足够的能量，甚至打开大金库。

english: What will powering the city do?
translation: 给城市供电会做什么？

english: From what I can tell, my ancestors linked the Forge to the entire city.
translation: 据我所知，我的祖先将熔炉与整个城市连接起来。

english: It truly is the heart of this place. From it, I can channel any barronite you have into empowering different aspects of the city.
translation: 它确实是这个地方的心脏。从中，我可以将你拥有的任何巴隆石引导到增强城市的不同方面。

english: What will that do?
translation: 那会做什么？

english: The Sacred Forge is a strange beast, but with its arcane power, you'll see an improvement to the various activities you can do in the city.
translation: 神圣熔炉是个奇怪的野兽，但凭借它的奥秘力量，你会看到你在城市中可以做的各种活动有所改善。

english: Would you like to take a look?
translation: 你想看看吗？

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Very well. Anything else you'd like to talk about?
translation: 很好。你还想聊什么吗？

english: What is the Great Vault?
translation: 什么是大金库？

english: It's one of the many marvels of this city. We used it to store our greatest creations, along with our most interesting finds.
translation: 它是这座城市众多奇迹之一。我们用它来储存我们最伟大的创作，以及我们最有趣的发现。

english: Of course, I have no use for those treasures myself. I'd happily give them up to keep the Sacred Forge alive.
translation: 当然，我自己不需要那些宝藏。我很乐意放弃它们以保持神圣熔炉 alive。

english: Now be warned - I won't be able to channel much power into the Vault. I can't afford to waste too much barronite. You'll only have a limited amount of time in there.
translation: 现在要警告你——我无法向金库输送太多能量。我浪费不起太多巴隆石。你在那里只有有限的时间。

english: Not only that, there's an automatic security system that activates if power to the Vault is lost. If that happens, you'll be removed. I imagine any treasures would be lost as well.
translation: 不仅如此，如果金库失去电力，自动安全系统会激活。如果发生那种情况，你将被移除。我想任何宝藏也会丢失。

english: How much barronite do you need to power it?
translation: 你需要多少巴隆石来供电？

english: Hmm, for a minute, I suppose 750 barronite shards should do the trick.
translation: 嗯，一分钟的话，我想750个巴隆石碎片应该够了。

english: If you do go in, I'd suggest heading to the back first. That's where the most valuable things are kept.
translation: 如果你进去，我建议先去后面。那是最有价值的东西存放的地方。

english: Is there anything else you wanted to talk about?
translation: 还有什么你想聊的吗？

english: Never mind, I have no questions for now.
translation: 没关系，我现在没问题。

english: I'll be here if you change your mind. Take care [player name].
translation: 如果你改变主意我会在这里。保重 [player name]。

english: Can you make me a knight's sword?
translation: 你能给我做一把骑士剑吗？

english: A sword? Why do you need me to make you one?
translation: 一把剑？你为什么需要我给你做一把？

english: I was told to find a Imacando dwarf to make a sword for me.
translation: 我被告知找一个伊姆坎多矮人给我做一把剑。

english: I'm afraid there's not much I can do to help you [player name]. My lack of vision means I can't work an anvil like I used to.
translation: 恐怕我帮不了你多少忙 [player name]。我视力不佳，没法像以前那样在铁砧上干活了。

english: Oh... that's a shame.
translation: 哦……那真可惜。

english: They were probably talking about someone else anyway. I don't think many surface dwellers remember the dwarves who lived in Camdozaal.
translation: 他们可能是在说别人。我想没多少地表人记得住在坎多扎尔的矮人。

english: Right, I'll see if I can find someone else to make one for me then.
translation: 好吧，那我看看能不能找别人给我做一把。

english: I found this encased within some barronite.
translation: 我发现这个包裹在巴隆石里。

english: Ah, that looks like one of the relics from the civilization that lived here before Camdozaal was built.
translation: 啊，那看起来像是在坎多扎尔建造之前住在这里的文明的遗物之一。

english: Do you want it?
translation: 你想要吗？

english: I have no use for it. Maybe one of your kind would find it interesting.
translation: 这东西对我没用。也许你们种族中有人会觉得它有趣。

english: Hmm. Maybe.
translation: 嗯。也许。

english: I found one of these deposits while mining.
translation: 我在采矿时发现了其中一个矿床。

english: Ah, a barronite deposit. You can use the anvils here to crack it open. If you're lucky, it might have something inside.
translation: 啊，一个巴隆石矿床。你可以用这里的铁砧敲开它。如果你幸运，里面可能有东西。

english: I have some barronite shards.
translation: 我有一些巴隆石碎片。

english: I could feed those shards into the Sacred Forge now, and keep their power for you to use later if you'd like?
translation: 我现在可以把这些碎片投入神圣熔炉，并为你保留它们的能量供以后使用，如果你愿意的话？

english: What can I use the power from the Forge for?
translation: 我能用熔炉的能量做什么？

english: Well there's a few things we could do with that.
translation: 嗯我们可以用它做几件事。

english: Well just bring it back if you change your mind.
translation: 嗯如果你改变主意就带回来。

english: I found this bit of barronite.
translation: 我发现了这块巴隆石。

english: That looks like part of a weapon. Hmm, I might be able to make something out of it. You'll need to have all the right pieces... and 1,500 barronite shards or if you'd prefer, I can smelt it down for Barronite shards?
translation: 那看起来像武器的一部分。嗯，我可能能用它做点什么。你需要所有正确的部件……和1,500个巴隆石碎片，或者如果你愿意，我可以把它熔炼成巴隆石碎片？

english: You need a Barronite [piece] and 1500 barronite shards.
translation: 你需要一个巴隆石 [piece] 和1500个巴隆石碎片。

english: Come back with all the parts, and I'll happily knock something up for you.
translation: 带着所有部件回来，我会很高兴为你敲点东西出来。

english: You have all the parts I need. Give me a second, and I'll fix it up for you.
translation: 你有我需要的全部部件。给我一秒，我帮你修好。

english: There you go, one Barronite Mace. Should come in handy when killing the golems around here.
translation: 给你，一把巴隆石钉锤。在杀这里的魔像时应该派上用场。

english: Alright then, I can smelt that down for 100 Barronite shards.
translation: 好吧，我可以把它熔炼成100个巴隆石碎片。

english: There you go. I can add those shards straight to the Forge as well if you'd like.
translation: 给你。如果你愿意，我也可以把这些碎片直接加到熔炉里。

english: Go ahead, that'd be great.
translation: 去吧，那太好了。

english: There you go, that's all done.
translation: 给你，都完成了。

english: No thanks I'll hold onto them.
translation: 不谢谢我会留着它们。

english: No problem, come back to me if you find anything else of interest.
translation: 没问题，如果你发现其他有趣的东西再回来找我。

english: No thank you, I'll hold onto it.
translation: 不谢谢，我会留着它。

english: I'll hold onto it for now.
translation: 我暂时留着它。

english: What's this mace good for?
translation: 这个钉锤有什么用？

english: I reckon you could give one of those golems a nasty whack with that thing.
translation: 我想你可以用那个东西给那些魔像一下狠的。

english: If you have no use for it, I could smelt it down for some Barronite shards?
translation: 如果你没用，我可以把它熔炼成一些巴隆石碎片？

english: Alright then, I can smelt that down for 500 Barronite shards.
translation: 好吧，我可以把它熔炼成500个巴隆石碎片。

english: No thanks I'll hold onto it.
translation: 不谢谢我会留着它。

english: I found this broken hammer within a barronite deposit.
translation: 我在一个巴隆石矿床里发现了这把破损的锤子。

english: Ah, the Imcando Hammer. A very useful tool for Smithing and Construction. I could repair it for 1,250 barronite shards if you like or if you'd prefer, I can smelt it down for Barronite shards?
translation: 啊，伊姆坎多锤。一个非常有用的锻造和建造工具。如果你愿意，我可以花费1,250个巴隆石碎片为你修理它；或者，我也可以把它熔炼成巴隆石碎片。

english: You need 1250 barronite shards.
translation: 你需要1250个巴隆石碎片。

english: Come back with the necessary items, and I'll happily repair the Imcando Hammer for you.
translation: 带着必要的物品回来，我会很高兴为你修理伊姆坎多锤。

english: Give me a second, and I'll fix it up for you.
translation: 给我一秒，我帮你修好。

english: All done! Here is your Imcando Hammer.
translation: 完成了！这是你的伊姆坎多锤。

english: Alright then, I can smelt that down for 350 Barronite shards.
translation: 好吧，我可以把它熔炼成350个巴隆石碎片。

english: The Imcando Hammer, one of my favourite tools for Smithing and Construction.
translation: 伊姆坎多锤，我最喜欢的锻造和建造工具之一。

english: I've brought you a redberry pie.
translation: 我给你带了个红莓派。

english: Why?
translation: 为什么？

english: Imcando dwarves love redberry pies. I thought you'd like one too.
translation: 伊姆坎多矮人喜欢红莓派。我想你也会喜欢一个。

english: Can't say I've ever had one.
translation: 不能说我曾经吃过一个。

english: Oh, well why don't you try it?
translation: 哦，那你为什么不试试？

english: So, what did you think?
translation: 那么，你觉得怎么样？

english: This is delicious! Where did you find such a excellent cuisine!
translation: 这真好吃！你在哪找到这么棒的美食！

english: I made it myself.
translation: 我自己做的。

english: You're an brilliant cook [player name]! Just don't bring me too many of these, I'm trying to watch my weight.
translation: 你是个很棒的厨师 [player name]！只是别给我带太多，我在努力控制体重。

english: Ah, [player name]. I'm sure you have plenty of questions. I will do my best to answer them.
translation: 啊，[player name]。我相信你有很多问题。我会尽力回答。

english: What can I do here?
translation: 我在这里能做什么？

english: I have something to tell you. It's about another dwarf.
translation: 我有事告诉你。是关于另一个矮人的。

english: Another dwarf? An Imcando Dwarf?
translation: 另一个矮人？一个伊姆坎多矮人？

english: Yes. I encountered someone I believed to be a dwarf, but it was a lie. It was a Mahjarrat in disguise as someone called Ketla.
translation: 是的。我遇到一个我以为是矮人的人，但那是谎言。那是一个伪装成叫凯特拉的人的玛哈加特。

english: Ketla...
translation: 凯特拉……

english: You knew her?
translation: 你认识她？

english: I did, long ago. Is she...
translation: 我认识，很久以前。她……

english: She's gone, Ramarno. I'm so sorry.
translation: 她走了，拉马诺。我很抱歉。

english: I see...
translation: 我明白了……

english: I'm sorry, [player name], but let us not speak of this further. To learn of the death of another of my kin is no surprise, but it pains me all the same. I would prefer to focus my thoughts elsewhere.
translation: 我很抱歉，[player name]，但我们别再谈这个了。得知另一个亲属的死讯并不意外，但同样让我痛苦。我宁愿把心思放在别处。

english: Of course.
translation: 当然。

english: I have something I'd like you to examine.
translation: 我有东西想让你检查。

english: What happened to the other Imcando Dwarves?
translation: 其他伊姆坎多矮人怎么了？

english: Can I use the Forge?
translation: 我能使用熔炉吗？

english: I'll see you later.
translation: 回头见。

english: Tell me more about the golem workshop.
translation: 多告诉我一些关于魔像工坊的事。

english: Tell me more about the barronite mine.
translation: 多告诉我一些关于巴隆石矿的事。

english: Tell me more about the offering altar.
translation: 多告诉我一些关于献祭祭坛的事。

english: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们聊聊别的事。

english: What will powering the city do?
translation: 给城市供电会做什么？

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: What is the Great Vault?
translation: 什么是大金库？

english: Never mind, I have no questions for now.
translation: 没关系，我现在没问题。

english: Can you make me a knight's sword?
translation: 你能给我做一把骑士剑吗？

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: Construct the weapon.
translation: 建造武器。

english: Convert into Barronite Shards.
translation: 转换成巴隆石碎片。

english: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: Repair the Imcando hammer.
translation: 修理伊姆坎多锤。

english: I have something to tell you. It's about another dwarf.
translation: 我有事告诉你。是关于另一个矮人的。

english: What do you want? I am busy supervising!
translation: 你想要什么？我正忙着监督！

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: This is the Hosidius Kitchen. Here, under my expert eye, we prepare the food that feeds most of the population.
translation: 这是霍西迪乌斯厨房。在这里，在我的专家眼光下，我们准备养活大部分人口的食物。

english: Much of the income of Hosidius derives from trade in cooked food, so our work is vital.
translation: 霍西迪乌斯城的大部分收入来自熟食贸易，所以我们的工作至关重要。

english: Can I cook here?
translation: 我能在这里烹饪吗？

english: Yes, you are most welcome to cook here. You may find you burn food less often under my supervision.
translation: 是的，非常欢迎你在这里烹饪。你可能会发现在我的监督下你烧焦食物的次数更少。

english: Why don't you do some work yourself?
translation: 你为什么自己不干点活？

english: Excuse me? My cooking level is higher than you could imagine - I have already done my share of the work. Now, with my expertise, I am guiding future generations of chefs.
translation: 你说什么？我的烹饪等级比你想象的高——我已经完成了我那份工作。现在，凭借我的专业知识，我在指导未来的厨师一代。

english: I'll leave you alone.
translation: 我不打扰你了。

english: Get more fish!
translation: 多弄点鱼！

english: Good, very good!
translation: 好，很好！

english: Now cook it!
translation: 现在煮它！

english: Try not to burn this one.
translation: 尽量别把这个烧焦了。

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: Can I cook here?
translation: 我能在这里烹饪吗？

english: Why don't you do some work yourself?
translation: 你为什么自己不干点活？

english: I'll leave you alone.
translation: 我不打扰你了。

english: Do you want to buy any armoured skirts? Designed especially for ladies who like to fight.
translation: 你想买装甲裙吗？专为喜欢战斗的女士设计。

english: No thank you, that's not my scene.
translation: 不谢谢，那不是我的菜。

english: Well done.
translation: 做得好。

english: You've [found a new clue/obtained a casket]!
translation: 你 [found a new clue/obtained a casket]！

english: Hi! I have this money off voucher!
translation: 嗨！我有这个打折券！

english: So I see! Unfortunately it seems to have expired yesterday! Nevermind.
translation: 我看到了！不幸的是它似乎昨天就过期了！没关系。

english: But I only just got it!
translation: 但我刚拿到！

english: I'm sorry, there's nothing I can do. Goodbye.
translation: 抱歉，我无能为力。再见。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No thank you, that's not my scene.
translation: 不谢谢，那不是我的菜。

english: Welcome to my stall! Come and buy some tasty bread, freshly baked just 2 months ago!
translation: 欢迎来到我的摊位！来买些美味面包，2个月前刚烤好的！

english: Sounds delicious!
translation: 听起来真好吃！

english: I think I'll pass.
translation: 我想我还是不要了。

english: Hey! Get your hands off there!
translation: 嘿！把手拿开！

english: You just stole something from me!
translation: 你刚偷了我的东西！

english: Guardsguards!
translation: 守卫守卫！

english: Sounds delicious!
translation: 听起来真好吃！

english: I think I'll pass.
translation: 我想我还是不要了。

english: Hey there adventurer, I am the Ranged combat tutor. Is there anything you would like to know?
translation: 嘿冒险者，我是远程战斗导师。有什么你想知道的吗？

english: How can I train my Ranged?
translation: 我怎么训练我的远程？

english: To start with you'll need a bow and arrows, you were given a Shortbow and some arrows when you arrived here from Tutorial island.
translation: 首先你需要一把弓和箭，当你从教程岛到达这里时你得到了一把短弓和一些箭。

english: Alternatively, you can claim a training bow and some arrows from me.
translation: 或者，你可以从我这里领取一把训练弓和一些箭。

english: Mikasi, the Magic Combat tutor and I both give out items every 30 minutes, however you must choose whether you want runes or ranged equipment.
translation: 米卡西，魔法导师和我都每30分钟发放物品，但你必须选择是要符石还是远程装备。

english: To claim the Training bow and arrows, right-click on me and choose Claim, to claim runes right-click on the Magic Combat tutor and select Claim.
translation: 要领取训练弓和箭，右键点击我并选择领取，要领取符石右键点击魔法导师并选择领取。

english: Not all bows can use every type of arrow, most bows have a limit. You can find out your bows limit by checking the Ranged skill guide.
translation: 不是所有弓都能使用每种箭，大多数弓有限制。你可以通过查看远程技能指南找出你的弓的限制。

english: If you do decide to use the Training bow, you will only be able to use the Training arrows with it. Remember to pick up your arrows, re-use them and come back when you need more.
translation: 如果你决定使用训练弓，你只能用它使用训练箭。记得捡起你的箭，重复使用它们，需要更多时再回来。

english: Once you have your bow and arrows, equip them by selecting their Wield option in your inventory.
translation: 一旦你有了弓和箭，通过在物品栏中选择它们的装备选项来装备它们。

english: You can change the way you attack by going to the combat options tab. There are three attack styles for bows. Those styles are Accurate, Rapid and Longrange.
translation: 你可以通过进入战斗选项标签页改变你的攻击方式。弓有三种攻击风格。这些风格是准确、快速和远程。

english: Accurate increases your bows attack accuracy. Rapid will increase your attack speed with the bow. Longrange will let you attack your enemies from a greater distance.
translation: 准确增加你的弓的攻击准确率。快速将增加你的弓的攻击速度。远程将让你从更远的距离攻击敌人。

english: If you need some more advice, you should talk to Adventurer Jon about Adventure paths. He may even have a handy starter kit you can use.
translation: 如果你需要更多建议，你应该跟冒险者乔恩谈谈冒险之路。他甚至可能有你可用的便捷新手包。

english: You should know the basics of ranged combat by now, but if you are looking for somewhere to test your skills and make some money, you should try hunting Moss giants in Varrock sewers.
translation: 你现在应该知道远程战斗的基础了，但如果你在寻找测试技能和赚钱的地方，你应该试试在维洛克城下水道猎杀苔藓巨人。

english: If you are lucky you might find a Mossy key, with this key you will be able to enter Bryophyta's lair. Make sure to bring plenty of food and good armour and weapons when you fight her as you will need it.
translation: 如果你幸运你可能会找到苔藓钥匙，有了这把钥匙你将能进入布里奥菲塔的巢穴。确保在她战斗时带足够的食物和好的装备武器，因为你会需要它。

english: If yourlucky you might snag some goodies that you can sell for a decent profit.
translation: 如果你幸运你可能会捞到一些好东西可以卖个不错的利润。

english: If you are looking to do something different, visit the ranging guild over near Hemenster, there you can practice your archery and earn tickets for it at the same time.
translation: 如果你想做点不同的事，去赫门斯特附近的远程公会，在那里你可以练习射箭同时赚取门票。

english: You can then hand those tickets in for a variety of goods you can use to train your Ranged skill.
translation: 然后你可以上交那些门票换取各种你可以用来训练远程技能的商品。

english: If you are ever in the market for a new bow or some arrows, you should head on over to Lowe's Archery Emporium in Varrock. I can show you where the shop is if you like.
translation: 如果你想买新弓或一些箭，你应该去维洛克的洛氏弓箭店。如果你愿意我可以告诉你商店在哪。

english: No thanks
translation: 不用了，谢谢

english: Is there anything else you want to know?
translation: 还有什么你想知道的吗？

english: Ahh the art of fletching. Fletching is used to create your own bow and arrows.
translation: 啊制箭艺术。制箭用于制作你自己的弓和箭。

english: To create your bow and arrows you would need to gather some wood, feathers, arrow heads and bow string. The wood would be to make arrow shafts which can be turned into unstrung bows and arrow shafts.
translation: 要制作你的弓和箭你需要收集一些木材、羽毛、箭头和弓弦。木材用于制作箭杆，可以变成未上弦的弓和箭杆。

english: Unfortunately, Fletching is a member only skill so you will have to get your ranging supplies from shops or other players.
translation: 不幸的是，制箭是会员专属技能，所以你必须从商店或其他玩家那里获取远程补给。

english: It's quite simple really. You'll need an axe to cut some logs from trees and a knife. Knives can be found in and around the Lumbridge castle and in the Varrock General store upstairs.
translation: 其实很简单。你需要一把斧头从树上砍些原木和一把刀。刀可以在仑桥堡内外和维洛克杂货店楼上找到。

english: Use your knife on the logs. This will bring up a menu listing items you can fletch.
translation: 在原木上使用你的刀。这会弹出一个菜单列出你可以制作的物品。

english: For arrows you will need to smith some arrow heads and kill some chickens for feathers.
translation: 对于箭你需要锻造一些箭头并杀一些鸡获取羽毛。

english: Add the feathers to your Arrow shafts to make Headless arrows, then use your chosen arrow heads on the Headless arrows to make your arrows.
translation: 将羽毛添加到你的箭杆上制作无镞箭，然后在无头箭上使用你选择的箭头制作你的箭。

english: Now for making bows. When accessing the fletching menu, instead of choosing Arrows shafts, you can make an unstrung bow instead.
translation: 现在制作弓。当访问制箭菜单时，你可以制作未上弦的弓而不是选择箭杆。

english: To complete the bow you will need to get your hands on a Bow string.
translation: 要完成弓你需要弄到一根弓弦。

english: First you will need to get some flax from a flax field. There's one south of Seers' Village. Gather flax, then spin it on a spinning wheel, there's one in Seers' Village too.
translation: 首先你需要从亚麻田弄些亚麻。先知村南边有一个。收集亚麻，然后在纺车上纺它，先知村也有一个。

english: This makes bow strings which you can then use on the unstrung bows to make a working bow!
translation: 这制作弓弦，然后你可以在未上弦的弓上使用它制作可用的弓！

english: Brilliant. If I forget anything I'll come talk to you again.
translation: 太棒了。如果我忘了什么我会再来找你。

english: Certainly. If you pick up ammo that is the same ammo you are currently using, I can make that ammo automatically equip for you, providing you have space of course!
translation: 当然。如果你捡起的弹药与你当前使用的弹药相同，我可以让你自动装备该弹药，当然前提是你有空间！

english: Or you can leave it to going into your inventory like normal.
translation: 或者你可以让它像往常一样进入你的物品栏。

english: There you go! Your ammo will now automatically be equipped when you pick it up.
translation: 给你！你的弹药现在会在你捡起时自动装备。

english: There you go! Your ammo will now go to your inventory when you pick it up.
translation: 给你！你的弹药现在会在你捡起时进入你的物品栏。

english: I work with the Magic tutor to give out consumable items that you may need for combat such as arrows and runes. However we have had some cheeky people try to take both!
translation: 我和魔法导师一起发放你可能需要的战斗消耗品，比如箭和符石。不过我们遇到了一些厚脸皮的人试图两者都拿！

english: So, every half an hour, you may come back and claim either arrows OR runes, but not both. Come back in a while for arrows, or simply buy some.
translation: 所以，每半小时，你可以回来领取箭或符石，但不能两者都拿。过会儿回来拿箭，或者直接买一些。

english: If you had any room in your pack I'd give you a training bow. That's a shame. Come back when you do.
translation: 如果你的包里有空间我会给你一把训练弓。真可惜。等你有了空间再回来。

english: You already have some training arrows.
translation: 你已经有一些训练箭了。

english: If you had enough space in your inventory I'd give you some training arrows, come back when you do.
translation: 如果你的物品栏有足够空间我会给你一些训练箭，等你有了空间再回来。

english: You already have a training bow.
translation: 你已经有一把训练弓了。

english: If you had any room in your pack I'd give you a training bow. That's a shame. Come back when you do. If you had enough space in your inventory I'd give you some training arrows, come back when you do.
translation: 如果你的包里有空间我会给你一把训练弓。真可惜。等你有了空间再回来。如果你的物品栏有足够空间我会给你一些训练箭，等你有了空间再回来。

english: Could I have a starter pack?
translation: 能给我个新手包吗？

english: Here you go. One starter pack. Enjoy.
translation: 给，好好用你的新手包。

english: Could you stop me receiving a starter pack after respawn?
translation: 能别让我复活后再领新手包吗？

english: Yes, I can help with that.
translation: 是的，我可以帮你。

english: You'll no longer receive a starter pack after respawn. Talk to me again if you change your mind.
translation: 你复活后将不再接收新手包。如果你改变主意再找我谈。

english: How can I train my Ranged?
translation: 我怎么训练我的远程？

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: How do I create a bow and arrows?
translation: 我怎么制作弓和箭？

english: Can you toggle my ammo to equip when I pick it up please?
translation: 你能切换我的弹药在捡起时装备吗？

english: Automatically equip it.
translation: 自动装备它。

english: Place it in my inventory.
translation: 放入我的物品栏。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Ask for a starter pack.
translation: 索要新手包。

english: Could you stop me receiving a starter pack after respawn?
translation: 能别让我复活后再领新手包吗？

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: Do I have any quest items or quest lamps to collect?
translation: 我有什么任务物品或任务灯可以领取吗？

english: Talk about something else.
translation: 谈谈别的事。

english: Tell me about melee combat.
translation: 和我说说近战的事。

english: Tell me about different weapon types I can use.
translation: 和我说说我可以使用的不同武器类型的事。

english: Tell me about skillcapes.
translation: 和我说说技能斗篷的事。

english: I'd like a training sword and shield.
translation: 我想要一把训练剑和盾。

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: Hello friend. I wish to slay evil and avail them of their loot! Take me to Burgh de Rott!
translation: 你好朋友。我想斩妖除魔，夺取他们的战利品！带我去伯格德罗特镇！

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
translation: 你准备好与那里的邪恶势力对抗了吗？

english: I think so? At least my heart knows courage and that should be sufficient for the meantime. I expect that when we get to Burgh de Rott, we'll be able to purchase suitable provisions.
translation: 我想是的？至少我内心充满勇气，这暂时应该足够了。我想等我们到了伯格德罗特镇，我们能够购买合适的补给品。

english: But you do realise that the vampyres in Morytania are immune to everything except silver?
translation: 但是你难道不知道莫利塔尼亚的吸血鬼除了银以外，对其他任何东西都免疫吗？

english: Er...well, I've not heard mention of that fact, but I have faith that Saradomin will provide the means to furnish me with suitable weapons when I reach Burgh de Rott.
translation: 呃……好吧，我没听说过这件事，但我相信萨拉多明会在我到达伯格德罗特镇时提供合适的武器。

english: And if we happen to run into some vampyres on the journey down there?
translation: 如果我们在去那里的路上碰到一些吸血鬼怎么办？

english: I trust that you will help us to avoid them. You are a guide after all, aren't you? Anyway, you look like you can handle yourself. I presume you've fought such creatures before and won? How hard can it be?
translation: 我相信你会帮我们避开他们。毕竟你是向导，对吧？不管怎样，你看起来能照顾好自己。我猜你以前和这种生物交过手并赢了？能有多难？

english: It can be pretty difficult, actually. But you're right, I'll be your guide so I should be able to handle the situation.
translation: 其实挺难的。不过你说得对，我会做你的向导，应该能应付得了。

english: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: 你为什么想去伯格德罗特镇？

english: I'm going down there to teach those vampyres a lesson or two. I've heard about the terrible conditions down there and I intend to put a stop to it.
translation: 我要去给那些吸血鬼点教训。我听说过那里的糟糕状况，我打算阻止这一切。

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Burgh de Rott?
translation: 如果我们在前往伯格德罗特镇的路上遇到敌人，你有办法自保吗？

english: Let's just say that I'm somewhat experienced and I'm happy to take on my fair share of enemies. You don't need to worry about that.
translation: 这么说吧，我还算有点经验，而且我很乐意承担我该对付的那份敌人。你不需要为我担心。

english: I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
translation: 我可以带你去伯格德罗特镇。

english: Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: 嗯，看来你有个随从。我想若是让它独自乱跑，这趟路上恐怕会走丢。等你的随从安顿好了我们再动身。

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: 真的吗？那太好了！到达目的地后我会给你报酬的。

english: Burgh de Rott Ramble begins
translation: 伯格德罗特镇漫步之旅开始

english: Ok, which route should we take?
translation: 好的，我们应该走哪条路线？

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: 啊，所以你想给我一些补给？让我打开我的背包看看。

english: This place is a bit grim. How can people live here?
translation: 这地方有点阴森，人们到底是怎么在这种环境下生活下去的？

english: Do you visit Burgh de Rott often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: 你经常来伯格德罗特镇吗？你似乎很熟悉这条路。

english: When are we going to get to Burgh de Rott?

english: We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on. I have loot to get.
translation: 我们没时间闲聊，赶紧前进吧。我还有战利品要拿。

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than the opulet life styles forced on us adventurer types. I'd much rather be up to my eyes in mud and having a good fight!
translation: 我讨厌这趟行程，但这总比强加在我们冒险者身上的那种奢华生活要好。我宁愿浑身泥泞，痛快地打一场！

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...

english: Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
translation: 谢谢，我会吃掉的。

english: Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Paterdomus. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: 天哪，看来我们得回帕多姆斯了。我们过不了那座桥！

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!

english: Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Paterdomus.

translation: 嗯，帽子和食人鸟数量有关，你射的食人鸟越多，帽子就越好。但你至少得射这么多才能得到一顶帽子。~兰茨对你比划手指，你觉得他的意思是30。~

english: You's creature show me da bow den!
translation: 那你生物把弓给我看！

english: Sorry Rantz, I don't have the bow.
translation: 抱歉兰茨，我没有弓。

english: Dat's da shame thing dat is! No flapper hat for you den!
translation: 那真可惜！那你没有猎手帽了！

english: Sorry, but der's no new hats for you this time! Go shoot some more chompies.
translation: 抱歉，但这次没有新帽子给你了！去多射些食人鸟吧。

english: Hey, yous creature needs to hunt da chompie  if you's wants der's flappy hat!
translation: 嘿，你们生物要想得到猎手帽就得去猎杀食人鸟！

english: Hey, yous creature needs to hunt more chompies if you's wants der's flappy hat!
translation: 嘿，你们生物要想得到猎手帽就得去猎杀更多食人鸟！

english: Hey, you did good wiv da stabbie chucker, der's a flappy hat for ya.
translation: 嘿，你用射箭的东西做得不错，给你一顶猎手帽。

english: You's person has too much junk for da flappy hat... Rantz keeps it insteads! ~ Rantz chuckles to himself. ~

english: Ok, thanks.

english: Hav' da stabbies. More toe'morrow if you come see Rantz.

translation: 你今天已经领过箭矢了人类。明天再来拿更多的。
