english: Hello! Who are you?
translation: 你好！你是谁？

english: Hi! My name is Raqueel. I work as a barmaid here in the clan hall. My friend, Gem, over there works here too.
translation: 嗨！我叫拉奎尔。我在这氏族大厅当女招待。我的朋友，杰姆，在那边也在这里工作。

english: Really? I don't recall hiring you.
translation: 真的吗？我不记得雇过你。

english: Wait, seriously? I could have sworn someone did. Oh no, Gem won't take this well.
translation: 等等，认真的吗？我发誓有人雇过我。哦不，杰姆不会接受这个的。

english: Either way, I have beer! Would you like to buy some?
translation: 不管怎样，我有啤酒！你想买一些吗？

english: I'd like to buy some beer.
translation: 我想买些啤酒。

english: No thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: That's alright. Just make sure your friends buy plenty of beer. If you're not paying my wages, we'll have to rely on commission!
translation: 没关系。只要确保你的朋友多买些啤酒就行。如果你不付我工资，我们就得靠佣金了！

english: I'll keep that in mind.
translation: 我会记住的。

english: Hi again, Raqueel.
translation: 又见面了，拉奎尔。

english: Oh hii! I just finished telling Gem about this time I was working with some geese. Ah, how time has flown since then. Anyway, what can I help you with?
translation: 哦嗨！我刚刚跟杰姆讲完我以前和一群鹅一起工作的故事。啊，从那时起时间过得真快。不管怎样，有什么能帮你的？

english: Oh hii! I was in the middle of singing this new song to Gem. She doesn't seem to like it much. Anyway, what can I do for you?
translation: 哦嗨！我正给杰姆唱这首新歌呢。她似乎不太喜欢。不管怎样，我能为你做什么？

english: Oh hii! I just thinking how I wish I had a pork and blue cheese pie right now. Mm-mmm. Anyway, how can I help?
translation: 哦嗨！我正想着要是现在能有个猪肉蓝乳酪派就好了。嗯 - 嗯。不管怎样，有什么能帮你的？

english: Yay! That will be 5 coins, please.

english: Oh dear, I don't seem to have enough money.

english: That's alright. Come back when you do.

english: No way, that's too expensive.

english: Look, I don't choose the prices here. I'm just trying to make a living selling beer.
translation: 听着，这里的价钱不是我定的。我只是靠卖啤酒谋生。

english: That's fair enough.
translation: 那倒也是。

english: Tell me more about yourself.
translation: 多跟我说说你自己。

english: You want to know about me? Oh where do I begin. Let's see...
translation: 你想了解我？哦从哪说起呢。让我想想……

english: Gem, my friend over there, isn't actually called Gem. I came up with that name for her. It suits her, don't you think?
translation: 杰姆，我那个朋友，其实不叫杰姆。是我给她取的名字。很适合她，你不觉得吗？

english: Fascinating. Thank you for sharing.
translation: 真有趣。谢谢你分享。

english: Sometimes, when the hall is empty, I like to stand up on the railing and pretend I'm singing at a stage in front of many people.
translation: 有时候，当大厅空无一人时，我喜欢站在栏杆上，假装自己在很多人面前的舞台上唱歌。

english: My favourite colour is purple!
translation: 我最喜欢的颜色是紫色！

english: I used to work with geese. One day they attacked me and since then I have had serious trust issues with them.
translation: 我以前和鹅一起工作过。有一天它们攻击了我，从那以后我对它们有了严重的信任问题。

translation: 我得走了。再见。

english: I'm afraid you have not earned any tokens yet. Try some of the activities around the guild to earn some.
translation: 恐怕你还没有获得任何代币。试试公会周围的一些活动来赚取一些。

english: Ok, I'll go see what I can find.
translation: 好的，我去看看能找到什么。

english: Do you have any tips for me?
translation: 你有什么建议给我吗？

english: Tips [Madam/Sir]?
translation: 建议 [女士/先生]？

english: Yes, like how can I do better than everyone else.
translation: 是的，比如我怎么能比别人做得更好。

english: [Madam/Sir] may find that a fine powder applied to the hands may give one an advantage when putting the shot.
translation: [女士/先生] 可能会发现手上涂些细粉在投掷铅球时会有优势。

english: You mean if I grind something up and put dust on my hands I'll chuck the ball further?
translation: 你的意思是如果我把什么东西磨成粉涂在手上就能把球扔得更远？

english: Yes [Madam/Sir].
translation: 是的 [女士/先生]。

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！

english: Good luck [Madam/Sir].
translation: 祝你好运 [女士/先生]。

english: Well done. You threw the shot [1-14] yards!
translation: 干得好。你扔了铅球 [1-14] 码！

english: Hey! You can't take that, it's guild property. Take one from the pile.
translation: 嘿！你不能拿那个，那是公会财产。从堆里拿一个。

english: Oi! Watch where you're throwing that [player name]!
translation: 喂！看着点你扔的地方 [player name]！

english: Tell me about the Shot Put area.
translation: 和我说说铅球区的事。

english: May I claim my tokens please?
translation: 我能领取我的代币吗？

english: Do you have any tips for me?
translation: 你有什么建议给我吗？

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！

english: What do you require, traveller? I deal in many things.
translation: 你需要什么，旅行者？我经营很多东西。

english: Let's see what you've got.
translation: 让我看看你有什么。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: My name is Regath, traveller.
translation: 我叫雷加斯，旅行者。

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: This place is a union of the mystical and the mundane, where the magical realm reaches out to touch the humdrum world of commerce.
translation: 这个地方是神秘与平凡的结合，魔法领域伸手触及单调的商业世界。

english: Or, in terms that you may understand more easily, this place is a shop that sells magic stuff for money. Though I also trade in various other items.
translation: 或者，用你更容易理解的话说，这个地方是一家用钱卖魔法物品的商店。虽然我也交易各种其他物品。

english: I don't need anything.
translation: 我什么都不需要。

english: I have a question for you.
translation: 我有个问题问你。

english: Nice work!
translation: 干得好！

english: You've [been given a new clue/obtained a casket]!
translation: 你 [获得了一个新线索/获得了一个箱子]！

english: Let's see what you've got.
translation: 让我看看你有什么。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: I don't need anything.
translation: 我什么都不需要。

english: That sounds really boring.
translation: 那听起来真的很无聊。

english: What does?
translation: 什么？

english: Whatever you plan on saying.
translation: 不管你打算说什么。

english: Oh.
translation: 哦。

english: I'll one day be the very best.
translation: 总有一天我会成为最棒的。

english: Oh yeah?
translation: 哦是吗？

english: That no was ever was.
translation: 前所未有的。

english: ...Uh huh.
translation: ……嗯哼。

english: To catch th-
translation: 去抓那——

english: I'm just going to stop you right there...
translation: 我就在这里打断你……

english: That's probably for the best.
translation: 那可能是最好的。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: I'm... Me.
translation: 我是……我。

english: Hi me.
translation: 嗨我。

english: Why, hello you!
translation: 哎呀，你好你！

english: ...I'm not you.
translation: ……我不是你。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Me.
translation: 我。

english: I'm me too!
translation: 我也是我！

english: But you're not the real you.
translation: 但你不是真正的你。

english: Woah.
translation: 哇。

english: Nilsal, adventurer. The name is Regulus Cento, one of the quetzal keepers for the Royal Family of Varlamore.
translation: 你好，冒险者。我叫雷古勒斯‧森托，是瓦拉莫尔王室的quetzal 饲养员之一。

english: Quetzal? What's a quetzal?
translation: Quetzal？什么是 quetzal？

english: Well just look here to my dear companion, Primio, and you'll have your answer. Varlamore is a large and diverse kingdom, but thanks to our quetzals, navigating it is as straightforward as can be.
translation: 嗯看看我亲爱的伙伴普里米奥，你就有答案了。瓦拉莫尔是一个庞大而多样化的王国，但多亏了我们的 quetzal，在这里航行变得尽可能简单。

english: Sounds exciting!
translation: 听起来很刺激！

english: You're not wrong there. Nothing beats taking to the skies.
translation: 你说得没错。没有什么比翱翔天际更棒的了。

english: Speaking of which, Crown Prince Itzla Arkan has asked Primio and I to escort you to our capital city of Civitas illa Fortis, or Fortis as we prefer to call it. Is that something you'd be interested in?
translation: 说到这个，伊兹拉‧阿坎王储让普里米奥和我护送你到我们的首都福蒂斯城，或者我们更喜欢称之为 Fortis。你有兴趣吗？

english: Of course!
translation: 当然！

english: Excellent! Now, I know Prince Itzla is very keen to meet with you once we reach the capital, so he's sending the Tullus twins to greet you on arrival. I'll be sure to point them out to you once we're there.
translation: 太好了！现在，我知道伊兹拉王子很想在抵达首都后与你见面，所以他派图卢斯双胞胎在你到达时迎接你。到了那里我一定会指给你看。

english: Sounds good.
translation: 听起来不错。

english: So, ready for your first journey to Varlamore?
translation: 那么，准备好第一次前往瓦拉莫尔了吗？

english: Let's do it!
translation: 我们走吧！

english: Kuani! We will depart at once.
translation: Kuani！我们立刻出发。

english: Well, here we are! Welcome to Fortis!
translation: 好了，我们到了！欢迎来到 Fortis！

english: It's beautiful!
translation: 太美了！

english: I'm glad you think so! Now, I'm sure you're keen to get exploring, but Prince Itzla is very keen to meet with you first.
translation: 很高兴你这么想！现在，我相信你很想开始探索，但伊兹拉王子很想先见你。

english: You mentioned he'd be sending some people to meet with me?
translation: 你提到他会派人来见我？

english: Yes, the Tullus twins. That's them just to the west, by the stairs up to the palace. Why don't you head on over and introduce yourself?
translation: 是的，图卢斯双胞胎。他们就在西边，通往宫殿的楼梯旁。你不过去自我介绍一下吗？

english: There's something I need to do first.
translation: 我有件事需要先做。

english: Very well. I will wait for you here.
translation: 很好。我会在这里等你。

english: Nilsal, adventurer. Are you ready for your first journey to Varlamore?
translation: 你好，冒险者。你准备好第一次前往瓦拉莫尔了吗？

english: Nilsal, adventurer. Do you wish to travel to Fortis?
translation: 你好，冒险者。你想前往 Fortis 吗？

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Then we will depart at once.
translation: 那我们立刻出发。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Very well.
translation: 很好。

english: Look'slike you won’t be taking to the skies just yet though...
translation: 看起来你暂时还不能翱翔天际……

english: Nilsal, adventurer. Do you wish to return to Varrock?
translation: 你好，冒险者。你想返回维洛克城吗？

english: Let's do it!
translation: 我们走吧！

english: There's something I need to do first.
translation: 我有件事需要先做。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Welcome to my home. Is there anything you wanted?
translation: 欢迎来到我家。你想要什么吗？

english: Nothing in particular. Got any sightseeing tips?
translation: 没什么特别的。有什么观光建议吗？

english: No, I'm just a factory worker. Don't do tours.
translation: 不，我只是个工厂工人。不做导游。

english: This doesn't look like a factory.
translation: 这看起来不像工厂。

english: This is my home. I'm off-duty.
translation: 这是我家。我下班了。

english: That idiot Armod should never have burned his diary!
translation: 那个白痴阿莫德真不该烧掉他的日记！

english: Good day, traveller.
translation: 你好，旅行者。

english: And to you.
translation: 也向你问好。

english: Good to see you, [Fremennik name]!
translation: 很高兴见到你，[费明尼克名字]！

english: Hello there. You're a long way from home.
translation: 你好。你离家很远啊。

english: Well what sort of Fremennik are you if you don't travel! Besides, we heard this was the land to visit for breaking skulls and spilling blood!
translation: 如果你不旅行算什么费明尼克！再说，我们听说这里是打破头颅、流血厮杀的好地方！

english: Of course! Have you not visited the Colosseum? You won't regret it if you do.
translation: 当然！你没去过竞技场吗？去了你不会后悔的。

english: Hmm... I might have to check it out.
translation: 嗯……我可能得去看看。

english: Ha! As if you didn't know! We've heard about your exploits in the Colosseum! Maybe you'll see us next time you're there!
translation: 哈！好像你不知道似的！我们听说了你在竞技场的壮举！也许下次你去那里会见到我们！

english: Do you want to buy some leather armour?
translation: 你想买些皮甲吗？

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Have a good day!
translation: 祝你有美好的一天！

english: Armour!
translation: 盔甲！

english: Get your leather armour here!
translation: 来这里买皮甲！

english: Leather!
translation: 皮革！

english: Frog-leather!
translation: 蛙皮！

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Hello, stranger.
translation: 你好，陌生人。

english: Hello there! The name's [player name]. Who are you?
translation: 你好！我叫 [player name]。你是谁？

english: My name is Reldo. I'm the palace librarian.
translation: 我叫雷尔多。我是皇宫图书管理员。

english: Ah, that explains why you're in the library then.
translation: 啊，那就解释了你为什么在图书馆了。

english: Well, truth be told, I would probably be here even if it wasn't where I worked. I very much like reading, not to mention sharing what I learn with all who are interested.
translation: 嗯，说实话，即使这里不是我的工作地点，我可能也会在这里。我非常喜欢阅读，更不用说与所有感兴趣的人分享我学到的东西了。

english: Sounds like a very noble goal!
translation: 听起来是个非常崇高的目标！

english: Hello there, [player name].
translation: 你好，[player name]。

english: I'm in search of a quest.
translation: 我在寻找任务。

english: Hmm... I don't believe there are any here.
translation: 嗯……我不认为这里有什么任务。

english: Let me think actually...
translation: 让我想想其实……

english: Ah, yes. I think I have something, if you're definitely interested?
translation: 啊，是的。我想我有些东西，如果你确实感兴趣的话？

english: Before starting this quest, be aware that you combat level is lower than the recommended level of 10.
translation: 在开始这个任务之前，请注意你的战斗等级低于推荐的10级。

english: Of course.
translation: 当然。

english: Well, if you look around for book called The Shield of Arrav, you'll find a quest in there.
translation: 嗯，如果你找一本叫《阿拉夫之盾》的书，你会在那里找到一个任务。

english: I'm not sure where the book is mind you... but I'm sure it's around here somewhere.
translation: 我不确定书在哪里……但我肯定它就在这附近某个地方。

english: Great! Thank you.
translation: 太好了！谢谢。

english: Actually, I don't think I am. Goodbye.
translation: 其实，我想我不感兴趣了。再见。

english: The Wise Old Man of Draynor Village sent you this message.
translation: 德雷诺村的睿智老人给你发了这条消息。

english: Ah, I am always delighted to hear from him. You would not imagine the depths of his wisdom!
translation: 啊，收到他的消息我总是很高兴。你无法想象他的智慧有多深！

english: I'd give you a reward, but you don't seem to have any space for it. Come back when you do.
translation: 我想给你奖励，但你似乎没有空间放。等你有了空间再来。

english: King Roald has been very generous with my salary, so I can spare you some coins for your trouble.
translation: 罗尔德国王给我的薪水很丰厚，所以我可以给你一些金币作为酬谢。

english: These little things seem to be everywhere these days! Perhaps you'd like them?
translation: 这些小东西最近似乎到处都是！也许你想要它们？

english: My old friend Aubury sent me some runes in return for some books he wanted. Perhaps you'd like them?
translation: 我的老朋友奥布里送给我一些符石作为他想要的书的交换。也许你想要它们？

english: Do you have anything to trade?
translation: 你有什么货物要交易吗？

english: Only knowledge.
translation: 只有知识。

english: How much do you want for that then?
translation: 那你想要多少钱？

english: No, sorry, that was just my little joke. I'm not the trading type.
translation: 不，抱歉，那只是我的小玩笑。我不是做交易的类型。

english: Ah well.
translation: 啊好吧。

english: What do you do?
translation: 你是做什么的？

english: I am the palace librarian.
translation: 我是皇宫图书管理员。

english: Ah. That's why you're in the library then.
translation: 啊。那就是你在图书馆的原因。

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: Although I would probably be in here even if I didn't work here. I like reading. Someday I hope to catalogue all of the information stored in these books so all may read it.
translation: 虽然即使我不在这里工作，我可能也会在这里。我喜欢阅读。有一天我希望将这些书中存储的所有信息编目，让所有人都能阅读。

english: What do you know about the Imcando dwarves?
translation: 你对伊姆坎多矮人了解多少？

english: The Imcando dwarves, you say? Let's see...
translation: 伊姆坎多矮人，你说？让我看看……

english: Ah, yes... For many hundreds of years, they were the world's most skilled smiths. They used secret smithing knowledge passed down from generation to generation.
translation: 啊，是的……数百年来，他们是世界上最熟练的铁匠。他们使用代代相传的秘密锻造知识。

english: Unfortunately, about a century ago, the once thriving group was wiped out during the barbarian invasions of that time.
translation: 不幸的是，大约一个世纪前，这个曾经繁荣的群体在当时的野蛮人入侵中被消灭了。

english: I believe a few of them survived, but with the bulk of their population destroyed, their numbers dwindled even further. If any are left now, they'll no doubt keep to themselves.
translation: 我相信有少数人幸存下来，但由于大部分人口被摧毁，他们的数量进一步减少。如果现在还有剩下的，他们无疑会隐居起来。

english: However, I have heard tales of their love for redberry pie. Perhaps one of those could convince one to reveal their true heritage.
translation: 不过，我听说过他们喜欢红莓派的故事。也许其中一个能说服他们透露自己的真正血统。

english: So I just go around offering random dwarves redberry pie?
translation: 所以我只要随便给矮人送红莓派就行了？

english: Well, not totally random. Apparently some of the surviving Imcando made a home for themselves near the cliffs on the Asgarnian southern peninsula. That would be a good place to start.
translation: 嗯，不是完全随便。显然一些幸存的伊姆坎多在阿斯加尼亚南部半岛的悬崖附近安了家。那是个不错的起点。

english: What can you tell me about this brooch?
translation: 你能和我说说这枚胸针的事吗？

english: I've never seen that symbol before. Where did you find it?
translation: 我以前从未见过那个符号。你在哪里找到的？

english: In a cave beneath Lumbridge.
translation: 在仑桥镇下方的一个洞穴里。

english: Very odd. Have you any idea how it got there?
translation: 很奇怪。你知道它是怎么到那里的吗？

english: A goblin might have dropped it.
translation: 可能是哥布林掉的。

english: I've never heard of a goblin carrying a brooch like this. But just a minute...
translation: 我从未听说过哥布林携带这样的胸针。但等一下……

english: The other day I filed a book about ancient goblin tribes. It's somewhere at the west end of the library, I think. Maybe that will be of some use.
translation: 前几天我归档了一本关于古代哥布林部落的书。我想它在图书馆西端的某个地方。也许那会有些用处。

english: I have a cat related question.
translation: 我有个关于猫的问题。

english: Yes?
translation: 是的？

english: Well...
Meow.
translation: 喵。

english: Hmm... My cat is trying to say something but I'm not wearing the Amulet of Catspeak.
translation: 嗯……我的猫想说什么但我没戴猫语护符。

english: Go on... ask him.
translation: 继续……问他。

english: Okay, okay. I'm on it.
translation: 好的，好的。我在处理。

english: Do you know anything about Robert the Strong?
translation: 你知道关于强者罗伯特的事吗？

english: Ah, Robert the Strong. There's some details on him in one of my books on the history of Gielinor. Let's see now...
translation: 啊，强者罗伯特。我的一本关于基利诺尔历史的书里有关于他的一些细节。让我看看……

english: Fourth Age... Popular Lore... Ah here we are, Robert the Strong!
translation: 第四纪元……民间传说……啊找到了，强者罗伯特！

english: 'Not much is known about the hero called Robert the Strong. Most folk tales describe him as being taller than the tallest human and far stronger than the strongest warrior.'
translation: '关于被称为强者罗伯特的英雄知之甚少。大多数民间故事将他描述为比最高的人类还高，比最强的战士还强。''

english: 'He wields a six foot tall longbow and travels with his faithful panther, Odysseus. He is said to have had a personal crusade against the dragonkin...'
translation: '他挥舞着一把六英尺高的长弓，与他忠诚的黑豹奥德修斯一起旅行。据说他曾对龙裔展开个人圣战……''

english: Dragonkin?
translation: 龙裔？

english: I'm coming to that.
translation: 我正要说那个。

english: 'The stories tell of the dragonkin being an intelligent race of bird-like creatures that walked rather than using their wings. They are said to be immortal, but cannot reproduce.'
translation: '故事讲述龙裔是一种聪明的类鸟生物，他们走路而不是用翅膀飞行。据说他们是不朽的，但不能繁殖。''

english: 'Because of this, they became very afraid of death and shunned all other races.'
translation: '正因为如此，他们变得非常害怕死亡，避开所有其他种族。''

english: 'Some even say the dragonkin made corrupted versions of themselves for protection, what we now know as dragons. However, this has never been proven.'
translation: '有些人甚至说龙裔为了保护自己制造了腐化版本的自己，也就是我们现在所知的龙。然而，这从未被证实。''

english: Hmm... Doesn't sound very believable.
translation: 嗯……听起来不太可信。

english: There's no doubt that some elements of these tales have been overexaggerated for storytelling purposes, but you should be careful of outright dismissing them.
translation: 毫无疑问，这些故事的某些元素为了讲述效果被夸大了，但你不该贸然完全否定它们。

english: Robert the Strong is a name that often comes up in stories from the Fourth Age. There's no reason not to believe that these folk tales are based on events that actually happened.
translation: “强大的罗伯特”是第四纪元故事中经常提到的名字。没理由不相信这些民间传说是基于真实事件。

english: Thank you Reldo, you've been most... helpful.
translation: 谢谢你，雷尔多，你真是……帮了大忙。

english: That was a nice tale for mothers to tell their children, but I don't see how this helps Bob?
translation: 那是个适合妈妈讲给孩子听的好故事，但我看不出这对鲍勃有什么帮助？

english: Don't you think it's odd that no one knows where Bob came from?
translation: 你不觉得没人知道鲍勃的来历很奇怪吗？

english: I guess, but he's just a cat... right?
translation: 我想也是，但他只是只猫……对吧？

english: I'd hoped you would've understood by now that there's more to cats than humans believe!
translation: 我本以为你现在该明白了，猫可不是人类想的那么简单！

english: Ok, ok! I get your point, after all I'm being dragged round Gielinor by... my cat!
translation: 好吧好吧！我明白你的意思了，毕竟我正被……我的猫拖着逛基利诺尔！

english: I wouldn't say dragged... let's call it a partnership!
translation: 别说得那么难听……咱们这叫合作关系！

english: Ok!
translation: 好吧！

english: So are you saying that Robert the Strong is... is...
translation: 所以你是说强大的罗伯特是……是……

english: Bob?!
translation: 鲍勃？！

english: Let's ask Bob!
translation: 咱们去问问鲍勃！

english: Let's go!
translation: 走吧！

english: Hello. I was wondering if you could help me with something.
translation: 你好。我在想你能不能帮我个忙。

english: What do you need?
translation: 需要什么帮助？

english: I'm looking for information on a Fourth Age hero. His name was Tristan and he fought alongside Robert the Strong.
translation: 我在找一位第四纪元英雄的信息。他叫特里斯坦，曾与强大的罗伯特并肩作战。

english: Ah you must mean Tristan Corvo. I can't remember anyone ever asking about him before, most prefer to hear about the bigger heroes like Arrav or Robert.
translation: 啊，你一定是指特里斯坦‧科沃。我不记得以前有人问过他，大多数人都更喜欢听像阿拉夫或罗伯特这样的大英雄的故事。

english: But you know about Tristan?
translation: 但你知道特里斯坦的事？

english: Oh yes. What was it you wanted to learn?
translation: 哦当然。你想了解什么？

english: I'd like to learn about his descendants. I know they lived in this area.
translation: 我想了解他的后代。我知道他们曾住在这片区域。

english: Well we do have census records which date back to when the city was still called Avarrocka. I'm afraid we don't have anything from before that time though.
translation: 嗯，我们确实有人口普查记录，可以追溯到这座城市还叫阿瓦罗卡的时候。不过恐怕我们没有那之前的记录。

english: Hmmm. It might still be worth a look. Where can I find this information?
translation: 嗯。可能还是值得一看。我在哪能找到这些信息？

english: I have a book around here somewhere with all of the details, why don't you see if you can find it. It's red if I remember right.
translation: 我有本书就在这附近，里面有所有细节，你不妨找找看。如果我没记错的话，它是红色的。

english: Have you found that book yet?
translation: 你找到那本书了吗？

english: I have it here.
translation: 我找到了。

english: Wonderful, let's have a look.
translation: 太好了，让我们看看。

english: So what does the book say?
translation: 书上怎么说？

english: Okay let's see... The Corvo family... Here we are! According to this there was a family by the name of Corvo living in Avarrocka for most of the Fourth Age.
translation: 好的让我看看……科沃家族……找到了！根据记载，有个姓科沃的家庭在第四纪元的大部分时间里都住在阿瓦罗卡。

english: The last entry is from the year 1770 of the Fourth Age.
translation: 最后一条记录是在第四纪元1770年。

english: What happened to them?
translation: 他们后来怎么了？

english: Impossible to say for sure but it was around that time that many people left Misthalin to settle in Morytania. It's possible that the Corvo family was among them.
translation: 很难确切说明，但差不多在那时，许多人离开米斯特林王國前往莫利塔尼亚定居。科沃家族可能就在其中。

english: I'm afraid that's all the help I can provide. Port Phasmatys is where most of the Morytania settlers wound up. Perhaps you'll find what you're looking for there.
translation: 恐怕我只能帮到这了。法斯提斯港是大多数莫利塔尼亚定居者的最终归宿。也许你在那里能找到线索。

english: Okay, thanks Reldo.
translation: 好的，谢谢雷尔多。

english: I found it but then I lost it.
translation: 我找到了，但后来弄丢了。

english: You lost it?
translation: 你弄丢了？

english: I'm sorry. I'm a terrible person.
translation: 对不起。我真是个糟糕的人。

english: Well you'd better find it again. These books are very valuable.
translation: 那你最好再把它找回来。这些书非常珍贵。

english: Not yet.
translation: 还没有。

english: I know it's around here somewhere. It's red if I remember right.
translation: 我知道它就在这附近。如果我没记错的话，它是红色的。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Did you have any luck finding the Corvo family?
translation: 你找到科沃家族的线索了吗？

english: Port Phasmatys might be a good place to look. It's where most of the Morytania settlers wound up.
translation: 法斯提斯港可能是个不错的寻找地点。那是大多数莫利塔尼亚定居者的最终归宿。

english: Hi Reldo, I have come to ask you to help with something.
translation: 嗨，雷尔多，我来是想请你帮个忙。

english: What can I do for you [player name]?
translation: 我能为你做什么，[player name]？

english: You show Reldo your clue scroll.
translation: 你向雷尔多展示了你的线索卷轴。

english: Ah! Do you know about hot and cold clues?
translation: 啊！你知道冷热线索吗？

english: Yes, I do.
translation: 是的，我知道。

english: Well then use this strange device to feel where your destination is and dig.
translation: 那就用这个奇怪装置感应你的目的地，然后挖掘。

english: You should make some room for it before I can give you it.
translation: 你得先腾出些空间，我才能给你。

english: No, I don't.
translation: 不，我不知道。

english: Ah, you use a strange device to tell you how far away you are from the place you need to be. When you get to your destination you dig.
translation: 啊，你用那个奇怪装置感应你离目的地有多远。到了目的地你就挖掘。

english: Hey Reldo, I have one of those clue scrolls again, do you have any advice?
translation: 嘿，雷尔多，我又拿到那种线索卷轴了，你有什么建议吗？

english: That strange device will guide you in the same way the key did. Feel it, but be careful as it is very powerful. Good luck.
translation: 那个奇怪装置会像钥匙一样引导你。感应它，但要小心，因为它力量强大。祝你好运。

english: I'm in search of a quest.
translation: 我在找任务。

english: No.
translation: 没有。

english: The Wise Old Man of Draynor Village sent you this message.
translation: 德雷诺村的睿智老人让我给你带个口信。

english: If the player receives coins:
translation: 如果玩家收到金币：

english: If the player receives seeds:
translation: 如果玩家收到种子：

english: If the player receives runes:
translation: 如果玩家收到符石：

english: Do you have anything to trade?
translation: 你有什么要交易的吗？

english: What do you do?
translation: 你是做什么的？

english: What do you know about the Imcando dwarves?
translation: 你对伊姆坎多矮人了解多少？

english: Ask about the brooch.
translation: 询问胸针的事。

english: Talk about something else.
translation: 聊聊别的。

english: I have a cat related question.
translation: 我有个关于猫的问题。

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我该走了。

english: Ask about Tristan.
translation: 询问特里斯坦的事。

english: Yes, I do.
translation: 是的，我知道。

english: No, I don't.
translation: 不，我不知道。

english: Hello, my friend. Would you like me to show you the prices of logs?
translation: 你好，朋友。想让我给你看看原木的价格吗？

english: You look like you've travelled a fair distance.
translation: 你看起来像是远道而来的。

english: What gave me away?
translation: 什么露馅了？

english: I don't mean to be rude, but the clothing and hair, for starters.
translation: 无意冒犯，但你的衣着和发型就是线索。

english: Ah, yes. I'm from Shilo Village on Karamja, it's a style I've had since I was little.
translation: 啊，是的。我来自卡拉姆詹岛的希洛村，这是我从小留的风格。

english: Then tell me, why are you so far from home?
translation: 那告诉我，你为什么离家这么远？

english: This Grand Exchange! Isn't it marvellous! I've never seen anything like it in my life.
translation: 这个大交易所！难道不奇妙吗！我这辈子没见过这样的地方。

english: My people were saddened when I chose to leave home and travel here, but I hope to make some serious profit, then return to my tribe.
translation: 我选择离家远行时，族人们都很伤心，但我希望能赚笔大钱，然后回归部落。

english: So, what are you selling?
translation: 那么，你在卖什么？

english: Logs! Of all kinds! That's my plan, at least. Living in the jungle as we do, my people understand exotic wood very well indeed.
translation: 原木！各种各样的！至少那是我的计划。毕竟我们生活在丛林里，族人对珍稀木材非常了解。

english: Okay, show me the prices of logs.
translation: 好的，给我看看原木的价格。

english: Sorry, I need to be making tracks.
translation: 抱歉，我得赶路了。

english: Okay, nice talking to you!
translation: 好的，很高兴和你聊天！

english: Just one more offer! One more!
translation: 就再报一次价！最后一次！

english: Such a joy it is to be in this building.
translation: 能在这栋建筑里真是莫大的喜悦。

english: Yes! Yet another great deal.
translation: 太好了！又是一笔大买卖。

english: My people shall be so proud!
translation: 我的族人一定会为我骄傲！

english: Hmmm. These numbers don't quite add up.
translation: 嗯……这些数字好像对不上。

english: You look like you've travelled a fair distance.
translation: 你看起来像是远道而来的。

english: Okay, show me the prices of logs.
translation: 好的，给我看看原木的价格。

english: Sorry, I need to be making tracks.
translation: 抱歉，我得赶路了。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Well done, well done. Not many find their way in here.
translation: 做得好，做得好。没多少人能找到这里。

english: I'm Remsai, a tree gnome. We live in this maze for our protection. Have a look around and enjoy.
translation: 我是雷姆赛，一名树精地精。我们住在这个迷宫里以求庇护。四处看看吧，好好享受。

english: Hi there traveller.  You're a legend around these parts.
translation: 你好啊，旅行者。你在这带可是个传奇人物。

english: Thanks Remsai.
translation: 谢谢，雷姆赛。

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Wooo?  Woooo woo woooooo wooooo woooowooo wooo woooooo woo!
translation: 呜哦？呜哦哦 呜哦 呜哦哦哦哦 呜哦哦哦 呜哦哦呜哦哦 呜哦 呜哦哦哦哦 呜哦！

english: You don't say?
translation: 不会吧？

english: Woo! WOO WOOOOO WOOWOOWOO WOO WOOOOO!
translation: 呜哦！呜哦 呜哦哦哦哦 呜哦呜哦呜哦哦 呜哦 呜哦哦哦哦！

english: You don't say!
translation: 不会吧！

english: Wooowoowoooooo.... Woowoowoo? Woooo, wooowoo wooowooowooo!
translation: 呜哦哦呜哦哦哦哦……呜哦呜哦哦？呜哦哦，呜哦呜哦 呜哦呜哦哦呜哦哦！

english: Well, I guess you didn't say.
translation: 嗯，我想你什么都没说。

english: Yeah, I don't want to brag, but seriously: I am SOOOO rich....
translation: 是的，我不想吹牛，但说真的：我超级超级有钱……

english: Yeah, I know they say money doesn't bring you happiness, but sometimes I just like to open my bank account and look at all of the stuff I own and just think to myself:
translation: 是的，我知道人们说钱买不来幸福，但有时我就是喜欢打开银行账户，看着所有属于我的东西，然后对自己说：

english: Wow. I am soooooo rich.
translation: 哇。我真的超级超级有钱。

english: Well, us rich alive people don't want to waste all day spending time with you poor dead people, because I'm just sooooo rich I have to go now, and very possibly make myself even richer.
translation: 嗯，我们这些富有的活人不想整天浪费时间陪你们这些可怜的死人，因为我太有钱了，我得走了，很可能让自己变得更富有。

english: See ya around ghosty!
translation: 回头见，鬼魂！

english: Yeah, I heard about that, ha-ha-ha!
translation: 是的，我听说过那件事，哈哈哈！

english: With a MACKEREL? Ouch!
translation: 用一条鲭鱼？哎哟！

english: Well, it was fun. Let's do it again sometime.
translation: 嗯，那很有趣。改天再来一次。

english: Why, thank you very much!
translation: 哦，非常感谢！

english: I know, but what are you going to do?
translation: 我知道，但你能怎么办？

english: Well, I guess that's always true in the long run. See you around, weird invisible dead person!
translation: 嗯，我想从长远来看这总是对的。回头见，奇怪的隐形死人！

english: Yeah it's not bad, but I prefer cooked chicken.
translation: 是的，还不错，但我更喜欢熟鸡肉。

english: Maybe, but nothing beats a home cooked pie!
translation: 也许吧，但没什么比得上家里做的派！

english: Man, I love pie!
translation: 天哪，我爱派！

english: You don't say? I never knew that. Well, I must be going, see you around.
translation: 不会吧？我从不知道。嗯，我得走了，回头见。

english: We get signal!
translation: 我们收到信号了！

english: Somebody set up us the bomb!
translation: 有人给我们设置了炸弹！

english: You have no chance to survive make your time.
translation: 你没有生存的机会，抓紧时间吧。

english: Woo?
translation: 呜哦？

english: All your base are belong to us.
translation: 你们所有的基地都属于我们。

english: Hey, don't think you can talk to me like that!
translation: 嘿，别以为你能那样跟我说话！

english: Are you threatening me?
translation: 你在威胁我吗？

english: Just because you're already dead, doesn't mean I can't find a way to hurt you ghosty!
translation: 就因为你已经死了，不代表我找不到方法伤害你，鬼魂！

english: No, I've never been there in my life and CERTAINLY didn't steal anything when I was!
translation: 不，我这辈子从未去过那里，当然也没在那里偷过任何东西！

english: Are you calling me a liar?!?! I have never stolen a thing in my life, and I resent the implication that I am the kind of morally depraved individual that would steal someone else's hard earned
translation: 你在说我是骗子？！我这辈子从未偷过任何东西，我讨厌这种暗示，好像我是那种道德败坏、会从别人口袋里偷走辛苦赚来的

english: money from their very pockets!
translation: 钱的人！

english: Or cakes. Or fur. Repeatedly. For long periods at a time.
translation: 或者蛋糕。或者毛皮。反复地。一次很长时间。

english: Well if you are going to take that attitude, then I have nothing further to say on the matter, and bid you good day!
translation: 如果你要采取这种态度，那我对此无话可说，祝你日安！

english: Hello. You must be Rennard.
translation: 你好。你一定是伦纳德。

english: What be this? You both see me and hear me, and also know my name?
translation: 这是怎么回事？你既能看见我，又能听见我，还知道我的名字？

english: Tell me what devilry brings you here, and be quick about it afore I gut you like a fish!
translation: 告诉我什么邪事把你带到这来，趁我还没像杀鱼一样把你开膛破肚之前快点说！

english: Well, apart from the fact I ain't scared of no ghost, I am here because I have spoken to Valdez.
translation: 嗯，除了我不怕鬼这个事实外，我来这里是因为我和瓦尔德兹谈过。

english: Valdez? Who be that? Some foul necromancer?
translation: 瓦尔德兹？那是谁？某个邪恶的死灵法师？

english: No, he was a ghost I met near Glarial's tomb.
translation: 不，他是我在格拉利尔墓附近遇到的一个鬼魂。

english: He seems convinced that the artefact you stole from him is responsible for him becoming cursed to be an invisible ghost.
translation: 他似乎确信，你从他那里偷走的神器是他被诅咒成为隐形鬼魂的罪魁祸首。

english: Seems like he might be onto something too, given the state of you.
translation: 看你这状态，他好像还真说中了什么。

english: A curse ye say... Aye, that makes sense...
translation: 诅咒，你说……嗯，那说得通……

english: And there was I thinking my fate be the fault of the thieving and murdering I spent me life a-doing...
translation: 我还以为我的命运是我一生偷盗杀戮的报应……

english: So it all began the day I stole that staff, ye say? Aye, that be a story I have never told another soul...
translation: 所以你是说一切都从我偷那根法杖那天开始？嗯，那是个我从未告诉过任何人的故事……

english: Why don't you tell me what happened? I might be able to help...
translation: 你为什么不告诉我发生了什么事？我也许能帮上忙……

english: Well, I was making me merry way along, having just pulled off a glorious jewellery heist from a bunch of stinking dwarves...
translation: 嗯，我当时正兴高采烈地走着，刚从一群臭矮人那里成功劫了一批珠宝……

english: Hey, that's no way to talk about dwarves! Some of my best friends are short!
translation: 嘿，你不能那样说矮人！我最好的朋友里就有矮子！

english: Ah, yer misunderstand me [lad/lass], I wasn't generalising about the whole dwarf species, I had just stolen a bundle of jewels from a very specific group of dwarves who happened to have an odious stench about them!
translation: 啊，你误会我了 [lad/lass]，我不是在概括整个矮人种族，我只是从一群特定的矮人那里偷了一批珠宝，他们碰巧身上有股恶臭！

english: Oh. Well I guess that's okay then. Please continue.
translation: 哦。那我想没事了。请继续。

english: Well, as I headed on me merry way, hoping the foul odours that lingered in me nostrils would soon pass, I see in front of me this explorer fella, all decked out in in his fine clothing, and carrying some long package
translation: 嗯，当我兴高采烈地继续赶路，希望鼻孔里残留的恶臭尽快散去时，我看见前面有个探险家家伙，穿着华丽的衣服，拿着一个用破布包裹的长条包裹

english: bundled in rags.
translation: 裹在破布里。

english: So I says to meself, 'Rennard', I says, 'Rennard, why would some fella all dressed in his finery be carrying something wrapped in dirty rags?'.
translation: 所以我对自己说，‘伦纳德’，我说，‘伦纳德，为什么有个穿着华丽的家伙会拿着一个用脏破布包裹的东西？’。

english: So I thinks to meself a little more, 'Rennard', I thinks, 'Rennard, maybe that fella has something valuable in there, and he covered it in dirty rags so it don't look so valuable'.
translation: 所以我再想了想，‘伦纳德’，我想，‘伦纳德，也许那家伙里面有值钱的东西，他用脏破布包着所以看起来不值钱’。

english: So I coshed this fella round the back of his head with me bag of jewels, picked up his package and was on me merry way afore he comes to.
translation: 所以我用我的珠宝袋猛击了这家伙的后脑勺，拿起他的包裹，在他醒来之前就兴高采烈地走了。

english: So what happened then?
translation: 然后发生了什么事？

english: Well, I makes me way to the closest tavern I knew of that catered to my sort of people...
translation: 嗯，我去了我知道的最近一家招待我这类人的酒馆……

english: You mean thieves?
translation: 你是说小偷？

english: Right ye are, so I makes me way to the nearest friendly tavern, and unwraps the bundle to see what it had inside.
translation: 你说得对，所以我去了最近一家友好的酒馆，打开包裹看看里面有什么。

english: The Staff of Armadyl?
translation: 阿玛杜尔杖？

english: Was it? Ah, I never knew that...
translation: 是吗？啊，我从不知道……

english: Anysways, I unwraps this staff, and sees it be a god- weapon; I may be just a common thief, but I recognises a weapon not made by mortal hands when I sees one.
translation: 总之，我打开这根法杖，发现它是件神器；我可能只是个普通小偷，但我认得出非凡人之手打造的武器。

english: So what did you do then?
translation: 那你当时做了什么？

english: Well, I knew such a weapon would be of great value to...
translation: 嗯，我知道这样的武器对……很有价值。

english: Now that's funny. Can't remember his name, now. The powerful god, lived in the North-east. Took the Mahjarrat away from under Icthlarin's
translation: 现在那很有趣。记不起他的名字了。那个强大的神，住在东北。把玛哈加特从伊克哈林的

english: control.
translation: 控制下夺走。

english: Anyway, I hired me a messenger to go off and let him know I had something I was prepared to sell that I thought he'd be interested in...
translation: 总之，我雇了个信使去告诉他，我有东西准备卖，我想他会感兴趣……

english: Now WHY can't I remember his name? Very odd that...
translation: 现在为什么我记不起他的名字？很奇怪……

english: So you sold the staff to this god you can't remember?
translation: 所以你把法杖卖给了这个你记不起名字的神？

english: Well, that's the other funny thing... He never showed up, he sent some General or other instead.
translation: 嗯，那是另一件有趣的事……他从未露面，而是派了个将军之类的代替。

english: Hmmm... You know... Thinking back on that, I'm getting the feeling that messenger did a little doublecross of his own, and took
translation: 嗯……你知道……回想起来，我觉得那个信使自己搞了点背叛，把

english: me message to the wrong fella.
translation: 我的消息送错了人。

english: So what was this General's name?
translation: 那这个将军叫什么名字？

english: His name was Zamorak. I remember thinking at the time it was odd, because the fella was a mighty powerful warrior, but was never fully trusted by...
translation: 他叫扎莫拉克。我记得当时觉得奇怪，因为那家伙是个非常强大的战士，但从未被……完全信任。

english: WHY can't I remember his name???
translation: 为什么我记不起他的名字？？？

english: So you suspect the messenger might have taken the message to the wrong person? So you think it was an accident or deliberate?
translation: 所以你怀疑信使可能把消息送错了人？你觉得是意外还是故意的？

english: Well that I can't tell ya, but if something happened to get me cursed, it's likely the messenger would know what more than me.
translation: 那我可说不准，但如果有什么事导致我被诅咒，信使可能比我更清楚。

english: His name was Kharrim, and if he caused me to be stuck like this, I'm gonna fillet him like a dog, ghost or no!
translation: 他叫卡里姆，如果是他害我变成这样，我要像宰狗一样把他片了，管他是鬼不是鬼！

english: I tell ye what, you've given me much to think about so I'd like to offer yer a gift; Here, take these, they were the gloves I stole me first cake with, they might bring yer some luck.
translation: 我跟你说，你给了我很多思考，所以我想送你个礼物；给，拿着这个，这是我偷第一个蛋糕时戴的手套，也许能给你带来好运。

english: Where can I find this Kharrim then?
translation: 那我在哪能找到这个卡里姆？

english: Kharrim the messenger... Well, he was always a devoted follower of old General Zamorak, and if I remember rightly Zamorak set up a small base in an old temple near Dareeyak...
translation: 信使卡里姆……嗯，他一直是老将军扎莫拉克的忠实追随者，如果我没记错，扎莫拉克在达里克附近的一个古老神庙里建立了个小基地……

english: You might want to check around there.
translation: 你可能想去那里查查。

english: Okay, well I'll try and find him for you then.
translation: 好吧，那我试试帮你找他。

english: Kharrim the messenger... Last I'd heard of him, he'd headed off to Carrallagar to seek his fortune. Ya might want to check around there somewhere.
translation: 信使卡里姆……我上次听说，他去了卡拉拉加发财。你可能想去那里查查。

english: Kharrim the messenger... The last I'd heard of that weasel he was claiming he'd found some underground deposit of runite ore guarded by demons and dragons.
translation: 信使卡里姆……我上次听说那个混蛋声称他发现了个被恶魔和龙守护的地下符文矿石矿床。

english: I suspect he was pulling some scam or other, but if you know of such a place, that might be a good place to start checking.
translation: 我怀疑他在搞什么骗局，但如果你知道这样的地方，那可能是个不错的开始检查的地方。

english: Well, that's all fascinating, but I just don't particularly care. Bye-bye.
translation: 嗯，这些都很有趣，但我就是不太在乎。再见。

english: Hello again Rennard.
translation: 又见面了，伦纳德。

english: Ah, it be you again! What can I do fer ya?
translation: 啊，又是你！我能为你做什么？

english: Can you tell me where I can find Kharrim again?
translation: 你能再告诉我我在哪能找到卡里姆吗？

english: Could I have more of those ghostly robes you gave me?
translation: 我能再多要些你给我的幽灵长袍吗？

english: It seems as though the curse that keeps me here extends to my very clothing... which piece do you want?
translation: 看来把我困在这里的诅咒也延伸到了我的衣服上……你想要哪件？

english: Here you go.
translation: 给，拿好。

english: The endless tragedy of fate... Why must you torment me so?
translation: 命运的无尽悲剧……你为何要如此折磨我？

english: Alright, alright, calm down, calm down. All I said was 'hello'!
translation: 好了好了，冷静点，冷静点。我只说了声‘你好’！

english: You can see me?
translation: 你能看见我？

english: Uh... yes?
translation: 呃……是的？

english: And you understand my words?
translation: 你能听懂我的话？

english: Well, most of them...
translation: 嗯，大部分能……

english: This is incredible! How can such a thing have come to pass?
translation: 这太不可思议了！这种事怎么会发生？

english: What can I say? I'm a professional.
translation: 我能说什么？我是专业的。

english: Hello back at you.
translation: 也向你问好。

english: So what's a nice ghost like you doing in a place like this?
translation: 那么像你这么好的鬼魂在这种地方做什么？

english: I suppose you think that's funny?
translation: 我想你觉得那很有趣？

english: Well... Mildly amusing I guess.
translation: 嗯……我想有点 amusing。

english: I don't think I want to talk to you anymore.
translation: 我想我不想再和你说话了。

english: Hello stranger. It is rare indeed that I meet one who can see my presence, let alone one who can understand my words.
translation: 你好陌生人。确实很少见到能看见我存在的人，更别说能听懂我话的人了。

english: Soooo.... Is it fun being a ghost?
translation: 那么……做鬼有趣吗？

english: Does it look like fun to you?
translation: 你觉得看起来有趣吗？

english: Erm... Well, yes actually.
translation: 呃……嗯，其实是的。

english: Then you are a fool, and I will waste no more words upon you.
translation: 那你是个傻瓜，我不会再浪费口舌在你身上。

english: What, not even 'goodbye'?
translation: 什么，连‘再见’都不说？

english: Sheesh, what a grouch. You'd think you'd have more of a sense of humour being dead and all.
translation: 天哪，真是个牢骚鬼。本以为你死了之后会更有幽默感。

english: Mortal... Take heed of my example, and waste not your life, lest you may suffer the same fate as myself...
translation: 凡人……以我为戒，不要浪费生命，以免你遭受和我同样的命运……

english: Huh? You mean someone did this to you?
translation: 哈？你是说有人对你做了这事？

english: You have ascertained the truth in my words...
translation: 你已确认了我话中的真相……

english: So who did it to you? And why?
translation: 那是谁对你做的？为什么？

english: Events of moons past, I remember not clearly...
translation: 数月前的往事，我记不清了……

english: Fine help you are then.
translation: 那你这忙帮得可真够好的。

english: Hello stranger.
translation: 你好陌生人。

english: So.... Invisible ghost haunting the same place for thousands of years, huh?
translation: 那么……隐形鬼魂在同一个地方徘徊了数千年， huh？

english: You have no idea...
translation: 你无法想象……

english: Well, bad luck and all that. See ya around!
translation: 嗯，运气不好之类的。回头见！

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: So you're a ghost, huh?
translation: 所以你是鬼魂， huh？

english: Apparently.
translation: 显然。

english: In which case I only have one thing to say to you:
translation: 那样的话我只有一件事要对你说：

english: ...what?
translation: ……什么？

english: Guess you don't have the amulet of humanspeak, huh?
translation: 猜你没有人类语护符， huh？

english: ...huh?
Yeah, that's right. WOO! WOOOWOOO WOO WOOOOWOO! Got no comeback for that, have you?
translation: 是的，没错。呜哦！呜哦哦哦 呜哦 呜哦哦哦！没话回了吧， huh？

english: You are very strange...
translation: 你真奇怪……

english: Tell me your story
translation: 跟我说说你的故事

english: Goodbye then
translation: 那就再见

english: Ask about Kharrim.
translation: 询问卡里姆的事。

english: Ask for more ghostly robes.
translation: 索要更多幽灵长袍。

english: Hello there. What are you doing here?
translation: 你好。你在这里做什么？

english: Just looking around at the moment.
translation: 只是四处看看。

english: Well, feel free to talk to me should you come across anything you can't figure out.
translation: 嗯，如果你遇到什么弄不明白的，随时可以找我谈。

english: Hello there! I heard all about your big find; well done!
translation: 你好！我听说了你的大发现；做得好！

english: Can you tell me more about the tools an archaeologist uses?
translation: 你能多告诉我一些考古学家使用的工具吗？

english: Of course! Let's see now... Rock picks are for splitting rocks or scraping away soil; you can get one from a cupboard in the Education Centre.
translation: 当然！让我看看……岩石鎬用来劈开岩石或刮去土壤；你可以在教育中心的橱柜里拿到一把。

english: What about sample jars?
translation: 样本罐呢？

english: I think you'll find them scattered about pretty much everywhere, but I know you can get one from a cupboard somewhere in the Education Centre, just like the rock pick!
translation: 我想你会发现它们几乎散落在各处，但我知道你可以在教育中心的某个橱柜里拿到一个，就像岩石鎬一样！

english: Okay, what about a specimen brush?
translation: 好的，标本刷呢？

english: We have a bit of a shortage of those at the moment. You could try borrowing one from a workman on the site... but I don't think they'd give it willingly.
translation: 我们现在有点短缺。你可以试试向现场的工人借一个……但我想他们不会 willingly 给。

english: Sounds like I'll need to be sneaky to get one of those, then... Okay - trowel?
translation: 听起来我得耍点花招才能拿到一个……好的——泥铲呢？

english: Ahh... that you must earn by passing your exams! The examiner holds those.
translation: 啊……那个你必须通过考试才能获得！考官拿着那些。

english: Anything else?
translation: 还有别的吗？

english: If you need something identified or are not sure about something, give it to Terry; he's the archaeological expert in the next room.
translation: 如果你需要鉴定什么东西或对什么不确定，交给特里；他是隔壁房间的考古专家。

english: Ahh, ok thanks.
translation: 啊，好的谢谢。

english: Thank you!
translation: 谢谢！

english: Can you tell me more about the tools an archaeologist uses?
translation: 你能多告诉我一些考古学家使用的工具吗？

english: Thank you!
translation: 谢谢！

english: Hey!
translation: 嘿！

english: Welcome to our camp, adventurer.
translation: 欢迎来到我们的营地，冒险者。

english: That sounds lovely, what tune is that?
translation: 听起来真不错，这是什么曲子？

english: Oh, this? It's just the beginning of something, still a lot more to come.
translation: 哦，这个？这只是个开始，后面还有很多呢。

english: Does it have a name?
translation: 它有名字吗？

english: I s'pose the working title is...'The Doors of Dinh'.
translation: 我想暂定名是……''丁之门''。

english: Where are you from?
translation: 你来自哪里？

english: We come from Varlamore... We're students of the College of Bards.
translation: 我们来自瓦拉莫尔……我们是吟游诗人学院的学生。

english: Oh...
Or did you want to know where I'm from specifically? My home was destroyed long ago by an evil saltwater deity.
translation: 还是你想具体知道我来自哪里？我的家乡很久以前被一个邪恶的盐水神祇摧毁了。

english: Well, that's certainly a dark and tortured backstory. Say, have you slain any dragons? Wooed a beautiful princess? Sought revenge on the fiend who killed your family?
translation: 嗯，这确实是个黑暗而痛苦的背景故事。话说回来，你杀过龙吗？追求过美丽的公主吗？向杀害你家人的恶魔复仇过吗？

english: ...Dragons? Slain. Princesses? Wooed... but revenge, that's still brewing.
translation: ……龙？杀过。公主？追求过……但复仇，还在酝酿中。

english: Huh, well... Fair enough.
translation: 哈，好吧……说得过去。

english: I have to go.
translation: 我得走了。

english: See you around, adventurer.
translation: 回头见，冒险者。

english: That sounds lovely, what tune is that?
translation: 听起来真不错，这是什么曲子？

english: Where are you from?
translation: 你来自哪里？

english: I have to go.
translation: 我得走了。

english: Here lies Viktor, the goat, gone but not forgotten.
translation: 维特科长眠于此，虽逝犹记。

english: The ground beneath the gravestone looks disturbed.
translation: 墓碑下的地面看起来被翻动过。

english: Baaaaaaah! Baaaaah!
Aaah! It's a ghost goat!
translation: 啊啊！是山羊鬼魂！

english: Baaaaaaah!
Aww, poor goat, I don't think it meant to scare me.
translation: 哎呀，可怜的山羊，我想它不是故意要吓我的。

english: Baah?
translation: 咩？

english: If only I had a goat speak amulet...
translation: 要是我有山羊语护符就好了……

english: You notice the ghost goat is missing one of its horns.
translation: 你注意到这只山羊鬼魂少了一只角。

english: Hmm, one of your horns is missing...
translation: 嗯，你少了一只角……

english: Baaah! Baaaaah!
It seems like it wants me to help recover its lost horn...
translation: 它似乎想让我帮它找回丢失的角……

english: The ghost goat seems very excited when you mention its lost horn.
translation: 当你提到它丢失的角时，山羊鬼魂显得很兴奋。

english: Hmm, how am I going to find this goat's horn?
translation: 嗯，我要怎么找到这只山羊的角呢？

english: Baaaaaah!!!
The ghost goat head butts the wall, I think he's pointing east...
translation: 山羊鬼魂用头撞墙，我想它是指向东边……

english: Alright then, I'll go have a look...that way...
translation: 好吧，我去看看……那边……

english: Hey goat, where did you baa where your horn was?
translation: 嘿山羊，你咩咩叫着说你的角在哪？

english: Right, got it, thanks goat.
translation: 好的，明白了，谢谢山羊。

english: Hello my goat friend, I have brought you a gift.
translation: 你好我的山羊朋友，我给你带了礼物。

english: Baaaah!
You show the ghost goat the horn.
translation: 你给山羊鬼魂看角。

english: Baaaah! Baaaaaaah! Baaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!
I think this might be the right one.
translation: 我想这可能是正确的那个。

english: You bury the horn with the rest of the goat skeleton.
translation: 你把角和山羊骨架的其余部分一起埋葬。

english: Quest complete!
translation: 任务完成！

english: Inspect the grave closer?
translation: 仔细检查坟墓？

english: Viktor is resting peacefully now...
translation: 维特科现在安息了……

english: Yes.
translation: 是。

english: No.
translation: 否。

english: Wooooo! Ooooooh!
translation: 呜哦哦！哦哦哦！

english: I can't understand a word you are saying. Maybe Father Aereck will be able to help.
translation: 我一个字都听不懂你在说什么。也许艾瑞克神父能帮忙。

english: Do you have something you'd like to trade, young [man/woman]?
translation: 你有什么想交易的吗，年轻的 [先生/女士]？

english: What kind of trade can you offer?
translation: 你能提供什么样的交易？

english: Well, we find a lot of soaked pages in our nets. If you've got something we really want, I could swap it for 25 soaked pages.
translation: 嗯，我们在网里发现很多浸湿的书页。如果你有我们真正想要的东西，我可以拿25张浸湿的书页跟你换。

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: Just a little place where we Spirit Anglers can store things, young [man/woman]. I used to be the chief mate on one of our ships, but now I just watch over the stores from the land.
translation: 只是我们海灵垂钓者存放东西的小地方，年轻的 [先生/女士]。我曾经是我们一艘船的大副，但现在我只在陆地上看守仓库。

english: Maybe you'd like to do a trade, though, while you're here?
translation: 不过既然你来了，也许你想做个交易？

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: The sailor will exchange certain reward items for 25 soaked pages each.
translation: 水手会用某些奖励物品交换，每张25张浸湿的书页。

english: You don't have any [item] to exchange.
translation: 你没有任何 [物品] 可以交换。

english: No thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: What kind of trade can you offer?
translation: 你能提供什么样的交易？

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: Hi.
translation: 嗨。

english: Greetings. What wisdom do you seek?
translation: 问候。你寻求什么智慧？

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Me? I'm here to grant you rewards for any of the Pizazz Points you may have earned in this training arena. Like my fellow Guardians, I am part of the arena and live to ensure its safe running.
translation: 我？我来这里是为了给你在这个训练竞技场中获得的任何魔力点数发放奖励。像我的守护者同伴一样，我是竞技场的一部分，活着就是为了确保它安全运行。

english: I see.
translation: 我明白了。

english: Can I trade my Pizazz Points please?
translation: 我能交易我的魔力点数吗？

english: Why of course.
translation: 当然可以。

english: Got anything else I can buy?
translation: 还有什么我可以买的吗？

english: Well, we do stock a special book that you may be interested in, which provides a comprehensive guide to this training arena. It costs 200 coins. Would you like one?
translation: 嗯，我们确实有一本你可能感兴趣的特殊书籍，它提供了这个训练竞技场的综合指南。售价200金币。你想要一本吗？

english: That sounds useful. Yes please.
translation: 听起来很有用。好的，谢谢。

english: Very good, that'll be 200 coins please!
translation: 很好，请付200金币！

english: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。

english: Sorry, I don't have enough money.
translation: 抱歉，我没有足够的钱。

english: I don't want some dusty old book.
translation: 我不想要什么积灰的旧书。

english: It's not old and it certainly isn't dusty, but suit yourself.
translation: 它不旧也肯定没有积灰，但随你便。

english: No thanks, I already have one.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我已经有一本了。

english: Let me know if you lose it.
translation: 如果你弄丢了告诉我。

english: Thanks, bye!
translation: 谢谢，再见！

english: Use what you've learned, young one.
translation: 运用你所学到的东西，年轻人。

english: Greetings. Have you spoken to my fellow Guardian downstairs?
translation: 问候。你和楼下的守护者同伴谈过了吗？

english: Nope.
translation: 没有。

english: Well, you need to talk to him first.
translation: 嗯，你需要先和他谈谈。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Can I trade my Pizazz Points please?
translation: 我能交易我的魔力点数吗？

english: Got anything else I can buy?
translation: 还有什么我可以买的吗？

english: That sounds useful. Yes please.
translation: 听起来很有用。好的，谢谢。

english: I don't want some dusty old book.
translation: 我不想要什么积灰的旧书。

english: Thanks, bye!
translation: 谢谢，再见！

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Oh, hellow adventurer. Can I help you with anything?
translation: 哦，你好冒险者。我能帮你什么吗？

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: This is the prison of Zalcano.
translation: 这里是扎尔卡诺的监狱。

english: Zalcano?
translation: 扎尔卡诺？

english: That's right. She's a powerful demon, one bearing an ancient curse.
translation: 没错。她是个强大的恶魔，背负着古老的诅咒。

english: A curse? That doesn't sound good.
translation: 诅咒？听起来不太好。

english: Don't worry, the curse only affects her. Because of it, her entire body has been turned to stone.
translation: 别担心，诅咒只影响她。因此，她的整个身体都变成了石头。

english: I see. So why is she here?
translation: 我明白了。那她为什么在这里？

english: She came to our lands long ago, before the curse had fully taken hold. We imprisoned her here for study, so that we might learn more about her affliction.
translation: 她很早就来到了我们的土地，那时诅咒还没有完全生效。我们把她囚禁在这里进行研究，以便更多地了解她的病症。

english: If you want to learn more, you should be able to find a book in the Grand Library about her.
translation: 如果你想了解更多，你应该能在 Grand Library 找到一本关于她的书。

english: Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 还有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: What can I do here?
translation: 我在这里能做什么？

english: Well we could always use some help in keeping Zalcano under control.
translation: 嗯我们总是需要一些帮助来控制扎尔卡诺。

english: How would I do that?
translation: 我该怎么做到？

english: Zalcano is formed completely from stone. Because of this, normal weapons won't work on her.
translation: 扎尔卡诺完全由石头构成。因此，普通武器对她无效。

english: That said, when she's vulnerable, you can still do some damage to her if you use a pickaxe.
translation: 话虽如此，当她脆弱时，如果你使用镐仍然可以对她造成一些伤害。

english: When she's vulnerable? How do I make her vulnerable?
translation: 当她脆弱时？我怎么让她变得脆弱？

english: The ore found within these caverns can be rather volatile, especially when heated. We've found that when imbued, this ore can damage her armour.
translation: 这些洞穴中发现的矿石可能相当不稳定，尤其是加热时。我们发现当注入魔力后，这种矿石可以伤害她的盔甲。

english: You'll want to head on in and mine the ore from the rocks around the prison. Once you have some, you can heat it using the furnace and then imbue it using the altar.
translation: 你应该进去从监狱周围的岩石中开采矿石。一旦你有一些，你可以用熔炉加热它，然后用祭坛注入魔力。

english: Once you've got some imbued ore, just give it a throw her way and she'll definitely feel it.
translation: 一旦你有一些注入魔力的矿石，只要朝她扔过去，她肯定会感觉到。

english: What do I get for helping out here?
translation: 我在这里帮忙能得到什么？

translation: 嗯假设你成功制服扎尔卡诺，她作为恶魔期间积累了很多矿石和魔法符石。

english: Not bad, what if I didn't want these resource? Is there anything you can give me instead?
translation: 不错，但如果我不想要这些资源呢？你有什么可以给我的吗？

english: Well we would always appreciate these resources, in exchange we could bestow upon you our elven knowledge for mining.
translation: 嗯我们总是感激这些资源，作为交换我们可以授予你精灵的采矿知识。

english: We wouldn't be asking for anything special though, just the common resources are what we require.
translation: 我们不会要求任何特殊的东西，只需要普通资源。

english: We won't take any resources from your successes, the resources are all your own.
translation: 我们不会从你的成功中拿走任何资源，资源都是你自己的。

english: We will automatically collect the resources and bestow you with our elven mining knowledge.
translation: 我们会自动收集资源并授予你精灵采矿知识。

english: No thanks.

translation: 嘿！今天我能为你做什么？

translation: 你是谁？

english: I'm Rhoddwr, a simple forest dweller.
translation: 我是罗德尔，一个简单的森林居民。

english: It's nice to meet you Rhoddwr, I'm [player name].
translation: 很高兴见到你罗德尔，我是 [player name]。

english: And it's great to meet you, [player name].
translation: 也很高兴见到你，[player name]。

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: I'm the leader of this small camp. We live amongst the trees, at one with the forest.
translation: 我是这个小营地的领袖。我们生活在树林中，与森林融为一体。

english: That sounds relaxing.
translation: 听起来很放松。

english: That's because it is! This is where we belong, this is where we began.
translation: 那是因为确实如此！这是我们的归属之地，这是我们的起源之地。

english: A nice sentiment, but we can't all live off the land.
translation: 很好的情感，但我们不能都靠土地生活。

english: Very true! As we expand and grow, nature refuses to adjust to our ways. The only other option is to destroy it to make room for growth.
translation: 非常正确！当我们扩张和成长时，自然拒绝适应我们的方式。唯一的其他选择是摧毁它以为成长腾出空间。

english: Hopefully nature understands the necessity of it all.
translation: 希望自然理解这一切的必要性。

english: History shows again and again that nature points out the folly of man.
translation: 历史一再表明，自然指出了人类的愚蠢。

english: Which is why we should learn from the past and avoid making such mistakes.
translation: 这就是为什么我们应该从过去学习，避免犯这样的错误。

english: Indeed, although some mistakes have lasting effects that cannot be undone. Is there anything else you wanted to know?
translation: 确实，尽管有些错误有无法挽回的持久影响。你还想知道什么吗？

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！

english: Farewell, adventurer.
translation: 再见，冒险者。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

translation: 你在这里做什么？

translation: 再见！

english: Ahoy, young whippersnapper. Have you come to hear a tale from old Ribs?
translation: 喂，年轻的小家伙。你是来听老肋骨讲故事的吗？

english: Could you tell me about Barnacle Barnaby?
translation: 能和我说说藤壶巴纳比的事吗？

english: He was a cruel and vicious pirate. Orchestrator of the Driftwood Massacre and unleasher of the Plague of Black Mists. He believed himself untouchable, but his arrogance was his undoing.
translation: 他是个残忍恶毒的海盗。漂流木大屠杀的策划者和黑雾瘟疫的释放者。他相信自己不可触碰，但他的傲慢导致了他的灭亡。

english: Despite the warnings of many, Barnacle Barnaby attempted to plunder the Skullhorde, but his only reward was a deadly curse. It destroyed the Crimson Kraken, condemning all on board to a watery grave.
translation: 尽管许多人警告，藤壶巴纳比仍试图掠夺骷髅宝藏，但他唯一的奖励是致命的诅咒。它摧毁了深红克拉肯号，让船上所有人都葬身水底。

english: And you had a map leading to the wreck of the Kraken?
translation: 你有一张通往克拉肯号残骸的地图？

english: Aye! I purchased the map from Ulrich the Unfortunate, the sole survivor of the Kraken, but I had no intention of using it. I knew that no good would ever come from seeking the Kraken.
translation: 是的！我从克拉肯号唯一幸存者不幸的乌尔里希那里购买了地图，但我无意使用它。我知道寻找克拉肯号不会有什么好结果。

english: Then why not destroy the map?
translation: 那为什么不销毁地图？

english: And risk the wrath of Barnaby's ghost? No. I thought it better the map be locked away, so that neither it nor the curse could harm anyone else, but those young fools put an end to that.
translation: 冒着巴纳比鬼魂的怒火？不。我认为最好把地图锁起来，这样它和诅咒都不会伤害其他人，但那些年轻傻瓜结束了这一切。

english: Now we can only hope that someone puts a stop to them before it's too late. Who knows, perhaps it will be you who does so.
translation: 现在我们只能希望有人在为时已晚之前阻止他们。谁知道呢，也许就是你来做这件事。

english: Well, on that note, I'd best be getting off. Until next time, Ribs.
translation: 好吧，既然如此，我最好走了。下次见，肋骨。

english: I don't think so.
translation: 我不这么想。

english: As you wish, but you would be wise to learn from your elders. My tales might one day save you from a one-way trip to see Davey Jones!
translation: 如你所愿，但你最好向长辈学习。我的故事也许有一天能救你免于单程去见戴维‧琼斯！

translation: 能和我说说藤壶巴纳比的事吗？

translation: 我不这么想。

translation: 你好。有什么能帮你的？

english: My pub's called The Golden Field. It's where all the local workers come to relax and unwind after a hard day. I try to keep it really nice here for them. Anyway, are you drinking?
translation: 我的酒馆叫金色原野。这里是所有当地工人在辛苦一天后放松的地方。我尽量为他们保持这里的美好。不管怎样，你喝酒吗？

english: Have you heard any rumours here?
translation: 你听到什么传闻了吗？

english: Apparently Veos is looking for some help with something. He hangs around the docks of Port Piscarilius.
translation: 显然维奥斯在找人帮忙做什么事。他常在皮斯卡里琉斯港的码头附近徘徊。

english: They say there's trouble in Port Piscarilius. Something about gangs uniting. Might be worth looking into.
translation: 听说皮斯卡里琉斯港有麻烦。好像是什么帮派联合的事。值得调查一下。

english: I hear that Lord Hosidius has misplaced one of his sons. The Hosidius family might pay a lot to see him returned safely.
translation: 我听说霍西迪乌斯领主有个儿子失踪了，霍西迪乌斯家族可能会花大价钱让他安全回来。

english: Phileas Rimor has supposedly been looking for some assistance with something in Shayzien. Maybe worth investigating.
translation: 据说菲利亚斯‧里莫尔在谢兹恩找人帮忙做什么事。也许值得调查一下。

english: I hear that the rulers of Lovakengj have some work available. You'll find them in the Lovakengj Assembly.
translation: 我听说洛瓦肯吉城的统治者有些任务委托，你可以在洛瓦肯吉城议会找到他们。

english: Apparently there's been some commotion in the middle of Arceuus. Might be worth checking out.
translation: 显然阿西乌斯城中心区域有些骚动，也许值得去看看。

english: That protest outside Kourend Castle is starting to attract some attention. Could be worth taking a look.

translation: 你好，有兴趣买一件我的特殊斗篷吗？

english: What's so special about your capes?
translation: 你的斗篷有什么特别的？

english: Ahh well they make it less likely that you'll accidently attack anyone wearing the same cape as you and easier to attack everyone else. They also make it easier to distinguish people who're wearing the same cape as you
translation: 啊嗯，它们能让你不太可能误伤穿着相同斗篷的人，也更容易攻击其他人。它们还能让你更容易区分穿着相同斗篷的人

english: from everyone else. They're very useful when out in the wilderness with friends or anyone else you don't want to harm.
translation: 和其他人。当你和朋友或任何你不想伤害的人一起在荒野时，它们非常有用。

english: So would you like to buy one?
translation: 那么你想买一件吗？

translation: 不用了，谢谢。

translation: 嘿伙计！有工作吗？只要500金币！

english: What can you do?
translation: 你能做什么？

english: I'm a great cook, me! I used to work with a rat-catcher, I used to cook for him. There's a dozen different ways you can cook rat!
translation: 我是个很棒的厨师！我以前和捕鼠人一起工作，我给他做饭。有十几种不同的方法可以烹饪老鼠！

english: Tell me about your previous jobs.
translation: 告诉我你以前的工作。

english: Well, city warder Bravek once threw a chair at me and yelled at me to get him a hangover cure. So I made it and I think it worked, 'cause then he threw another chair at me and that one hit!
translation: 嗯，城市守卫布拉维克曾经朝我扔椅子，大喊让我给他弄解酒药。所以我做了，我想它起作用了，因为然后他又朝我扔了一把椅子，那把椅子砸中了！

english: Sorry mate, but I'm not allowed to work for anyone without level 20 Construction. It's a safety 'azard!
translation: 抱歉伙计，但没有20级建造技能我不被允许为任何人工作。这是安全隐患！

english: You already have a servant.
translation: 你已经有一个仆人了。

translation: 你需要第二间卧室，里面有床供你的仆人睡觉。

translation: 你被雇用了……嗯，我身上没钱，但我能欠你吗？我肯定会还的，真的。

translation: 现在我的头归位了感觉好多了。再次谢谢你帮我！

english: You're very welcome. It was a night to remember, that's for sure.
translation: 不用客气。那确实是个难忘的夜晚。

english: Indeed. How are you finding the helm that I gave you? Does the headless illusion still work?
translation: 确实。你觉得我给你的头盔怎么样？无头幻觉还有效吗？

english: Yes it does. I've been told it looks terrifying - especially when I eat or drink.
translation: 是的。有人告诉我它看起来很恐怖——尤其是当我吃东西或喝水时。

english: I can imagine!
translation: 我能想象！

english: Do you have anything to sell?

english: As a matter of fact, I do! I was recently doing some research on cabbages. I was able to extract their essence and combine it with a t-
translation: 事实上，我有！我最近在做一些关于卷心菜的研究。我能够提取它们的精华并与 t-结合

translation: 你不是个很好的推销员，对吧？直接告诉我你在卖什么！

translation: 哦。对！我有这些水晶碎片，可以让你从特别危险的情况中逃脱。它们只在某些地方有效。我称之为逃脱水晶。

translation: 有时你会被困在无法通过正常方式传送出来的地方。这些水晶是特别制作的，让你能从那些情况中逃脱。

english: The crystals currently work in the Theatre of Blood, the Chambers of Xeric, TzHaar-Ket-Rak's Challenges, the Inferno, Pest Control, Barbarian Assault and the Tombs of Amascut.
translation: 水晶目前适用于血腥剧场、泽里克圣所、特扎尔 - 凯特 - 拉克的挑战、地狱、虫害治理、野蛮人突袭和阿玛斯库特之墓。

english: No way, that's too expensive!
translation: 不行，那太贵了！

english: Well, there's a lot that goes into it to drive the price up that high. But I understand why you feel that way.
translation: 嗯，有很多因素导致价格这么高。但我理解你为什么这么想。

english: What are you up to now that your head is back where it belongs?
translation: 现在你的头回到了它该在的地方，你在做什么？

english: I still study. I'm changing my field of study though. Hopefully if I don't mess up more spells, one day I can become the head wizard.

english: Oh. Right! I have these crystal shards that will let you escape from particularly dangerous situations. They only work in certain places. I call them Members objects.
translation: 哦，对了！我有这些水晶碎片，可以让你从特别危险的情况下逃脱。它们只在某些地方有效。我称之为会员物品。

english: Sometimes you get caught in places that won't let you teleport out by normal means. These crystals are specially crafted to let you escape those scenarios. I've recently enhanced them as well!
translation: 有时候你会被困在无法用正常方式传送离开的地方。这些水晶是特别制作的，可以让你从那些情况下逃脱。我最近还增强了它们！

english: Have you ever found yourself zoning out, and come back to reality to find yourself under attack and on the brink of death? Well you can configure them to teleport you to safety if !
translation: 你有没有发现自己注意力分散，回过神来时发现遭到攻击、命悬一线？嗯，你可以配置它们在！时把你传送到安全地带。

english: It does mean they are likely to trigger in combat, although I'm working on that. But they should let you run through a dangerous area as long as you don't stop in the middle.
translation: 这确实意味着它们可能在战斗中触发，虽然我正在改进这一点。但只要你不在中间停下，它们应该能让你跑过危险区域。

english: They also now work in any place a ring of life would. Talking about rings of life, they can also act just like one if you configure them to be so.
translation: 它们现在也在生命戒指有效的任何地方起作用。说到生命戒指，如果你配置它们，它们也可以像生命戒指一样工作。

english: Can I buy an Escape crystal?
translation: 我能买一块逃脱水晶吗？

english: Yes
translation: 是

english: No
translation: 否

english: Can I buy an Members object?
translation: 我能买会员物品吗？

english: Which places can the Members object teleport me out of?
translation: 会员物品能把我从哪些地方传送出来？

english: Can I buy a Escape crystal?
translation: 我能买一块逃脱水晶吗？

english: Today is your lucky day, [sirrah/madam/my liege]! I am donating to the victims of crime to atone for my past actions!
translation: 今天是你的幸运日，[sirrah/madam/my liege]！我正在向犯罪受害者捐款，以弥补我过去的行为！

english: I must leave you now, [sirrah/ma'am/my liege]!
translation: 我现在必须离开你了，[sirrah/ma'am/my liege]！

english: It is someone else with whom I desire to speak, but he seems to be preoccupied.
translation: 我想和另一个人说话，但他似乎很忙。

english: Good day to you, [milord/milady/my liege] [player name].
translation: 你好，[milord/milady/my liege][player name]。

english: I seek a moment of your time, [sirrah/ma’am/my liege]!
translation: 我想占用你一点时间，[sirrah/ma'am/my liege]！

english: [Milord/Milady/My liege] [player name], please speak to me!
translation: [Milord/Milady/My liege][player name]，请和我说话！

english: Maybe later.
translation: 也许晚点吧。

english: Sorry I can't let you through, find some bunny else to bother, I'm busy.
translation: 抱歉我不能让你通过，去找别的兔子麻烦吧，我很忙。

english: Can you see your own rift?
translation: 你能看到自己的裂隙吗？

english: No. From time to time I feel it shift and change inside me though. It is an odd feeling.
translation: 不能。但我时不时能感觉到它在我体内移动和变化。那是种奇怪的感觉。

english: Where would you like me to take you today Rifty?
translation: 今天你想让我带你去哪里，小隙？

english: Please do not call me that... we are a species of honour, [player name].
translation: 请不要那样叫我……我们是一个荣誉的物种，[player name]。

english: Sorry.
translation: 抱歉。

english: Hey! What's that!
translation: 嘿！那是什么！

english: You quickly poke your hand through the rift guardian's rift.
translation: 你迅速把手伸进裂隙守护者的裂隙里。

english: Huh, what?! Where?
translation: 哈，什么？！在哪里？

english: Not the best guardian it seems.
translation: 看来不是最好的守护者。

english: About your colour-changing...
translation: 关于你的变色……

english: If you take me to a Runecrafting Altar, I will adopt the altar's colour as you bind essence there.
translation: 如果你带我去符石制作祭坛，当你在那里绑定精华时，我会采用祭坛的颜色。

english: I want you to stay this colour instead.
translation: 我想让你保持这个颜色。

english: Very well, I will remain locked to this colour, even if you bind essence at a Runecrafting Altar.
translation: 很好，即使你在符石制作祭坛绑定精华，我也会保持锁定在这个颜色。

english: Okay, carry on adopting the colour of altars.
translation: 好的，继续采用祭坛的颜色吧。

english: Very well, I will adopt the altar's colour next time you bind essence at a Runecrafting Altar.
translation: 很好，下次你在符石制作祭坛绑定精华时，我会采用祭坛的颜色。

english: Even if you bind essence at a Runecrafting Altar, I will remain locked to this colour.
translation: 即使你在符石制作祭坛绑定精华，我也会保持锁定在这个颜色。

english: I'd like you to adopt the altar's colour next time.
translation: 我想让你下次采用祭坛的颜色。

english: Okay, please stay locked to this colour.
translation: 好的，请保持锁定在这个颜色。

english: Actually, never mind.
translation: 其实，没关系。

english: How are you doing today?
translation: 你今天怎么样？

english: The power of the Abyss grows. I fear for what will happen if our defence against it fails.
translation: 深渊的力量在增长。我担心如果我们对它的防御失败会发生什么。

english: The Guardians of the Rift have things under control. You don't need to worry.
translation: 裂隙守护者能控制住局面。你不需要担心。

english: Let us hope you are correct.
translation: 希望你是对的。

english: Feel my wrath!
translation: 感受我的愤怒！

english: Get out of my altar!
translation: 滚出我的祭坛！

english: Feel the power of my rift!
translation: 感受我裂隙的力量！

english: I'll convert your very essence into runes.
translation: 我会把你的精华转化为符石。

english: Can you see your own rift?
translation: 你能看到自己的裂隙吗？

english: Where would you like to go today, Rifty?
translation: 今天你想去哪里，小隙？

english: Hey! What's that?
translation: 嘿！那是什么？

english: About your colour-changing...
translation: 关于你的变色……

english: I want you to stay this colour instead.
translation: 我想让你保持这个颜色。

english: Okay, carry on adopting the colour of altars.
translation: 好的，继续采用祭坛的颜色吧。

english: I'd like you to adopt the altar's colour next time.
translation: 我想让你下次采用祭坛的颜色。

english: Okay, please stay locked to this colour.
translation: 好的，请保持锁定在这个颜色。

english: Actually, never mind.
translation: 其实，没关系。

english: How are you doing today?
translation: 你今天怎么样？

english: Hello there, what are you doing here?
translation: 你好，你在这里做什么？

english: I... am the sculptor's associate.
translation: 我……是雕塑师的助手。

english: His associate? What does that mean?
translation: 他的助手？那是什么意思？

english: Are you going to say anything meaningful at all?
translation: 你会说任何有意义的话吗？

english: No, apparantly not.
translation: 不，显然不会。

english: I'm glad I don't have to talk to you anymore!
translation: 很高兴我不用再和你说话了！

english: Hrm.
translation: 嗯。

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Welcome to the clothes store. How might I help you?
translation: 欢迎来到服装店。我能怎么帮你？

english: It's a very interesting island you have here.
translation: 你这里的岛屿很有趣。

english: Why thank you. It's been our haven for a great many generations.
translation: 谢谢。它已经是我们许多代人的避风港了。

english: Everything seems to have a magical feel to it.
translation: 一切都似乎有魔法的感觉。

english: Of course. We integrate magic into all areas of our lives. It is a part of everyone, so why deny it? It's best to make the most of this innate gift we have all been given.
translation: 当然。我们将魔法融入生活的各个方面。它是每个人的一部分，为什么要否认呢？最好充分利用我们都被赋予的这种天赋。

english: What sort of things do you use your magic for?
translation: 你们用魔法做什么事情？

english: Take a look around. We use it in our day to day lives, from making a cup of tea, to travelling around the island. You see our ancestors were the ones that found the first rune essence and put it to use! The various
translation: 四处看看。我们在日常生活中使用它，从泡茶到在岛上旅行。你看，我们的祖先是发现第一批符文精华并加以利用的人！各种

english: factions were eventually created, with people having different ideas on how the essence should be used (or not in some cases!)
translation: 派系最终形成，人们对精华应该如何使用(或在某些情况下不使用)有不同的想法！

english: What has kept you so secluded on this island?
translation: 是什么让你们在这个岛上如此与世隔绝？

english: It may be a bit beyond you, but although magic comes from within, we are all very strongly linked to the moon and the effects it has on us cannot be denied!
translation: 这可能有点超出你的理解，但虽然魔法来自内心，我们都与月亮有着强烈的联系，它对我们的影响不容忽视！

english: It can't?
translation: 不能吗？

english: Of course not. This very island has a great link to our moon, which helps us understand ourselves - especially our dreams, which is the path to understanding magic.
translation: 当然不能。这座岛屿本身与我们的月亮有着巨大的联系，这帮助我们了解自己——尤其是我们的梦想，这是理解魔法的途径。

english: I think I will just have to take your word on that.
translation: 我想我只能相信你的话了。

english: I'm good thanks, bye.
translation: 我很好，谢谢，再见。

english: What can you sell me?
translation: 你能卖我什么？

english: It's a very interesting island you have here.
translation: 你这里的岛屿很有趣。

english: I'm good thanks, bye.
translation: 我很好，谢谢，再见。

english: Come to visit my garden then, have you, human?
translation: 那么，你是来参观我的花园的，人类？

english: This is your garden?
translation: 这是你的花园？

english: No no, not quite. But I do look after it. It's the palace garden, you see. I keep it tidy, keep it living.
translation: 不不，不完全是。但我确实照料它。这是宫殿花园，你看。我保持它整洁，保持它生机勃勃。

english: It's hard to grow much on these hard rocks deep beneath these mountains, you know.
translation: 要知道，在这些山脉深处的坚硬岩石上很难种出很多东西。

english: I can imagine. Where do you get all your food from? Or even the soil for this garden?
translation: 我能想象。你们所有的食物从哪里来？甚至这个花园的土壤？

english: We can grow a little food underground, but most of it comes from the extensive steamcart network that runs beneath the earth.
translation: 我们可以在地下种一点食物，但大部分来自地下运行的庞大蒸汽车网络。

english: In the Era of Kings, many centuries ago, it was harder of course. Our steam technology was not developed as far yet and getting fresh supplies of food was always a problem.
translation: 在国王时代，许多世纪前，当然更难。我们的蒸汽技术当时还不够发达，获得新鲜食物供应一直是个问题。

english: Oh, I'm not boring you, am I?
translation: 哦，我没让你厌烦吧？

english: Not at all! Please, go on!
translation: 完全没有！请继续！

english: Oh yes, as I was saying, it was difficult to make a decent living here. I'm afraid this garden was rather neglected during that time.
translation: 哦是的，正如我所说，在这里谋生很困难。恐怕这个花园在那段时间被忽视了。

english: Why did you dwarves stay so deep under ground, then? Why not simply go above ground?
translation: 那你们矮人为什么待在地下这么深的地方？为什么不直接到地面上去？

english: What, with the wars raging up there?
translation: 什么，上面战火纷飞？

english: We dwarves went underground a long time ago, see. For a while the city of Keldagrim was completely cut off from the rest of Gielinor simply waiting out the wars of the humans and the gods.
translation: 我们矮人很久以前就下到地下了，你看。凯尔达格林城有一段时间完全与基利诺尔其他地方隔绝，只是为了等待人类和神明的战争结束。

english: This made it hard, though, to determine when the wars above the ground were over. Perhaps Keldagrim had remained hidden for far too long.
translation: 但这使得很难确定地上的战争何时结束。也许凯尔达格林城隐藏得太久了。

english: Only when King Alvis heroically defended the city against an invasion of trolls did we dare to venture out and see how much the world had changed.
translation: 只有当阿尔维斯国王英勇地保卫城市抵御巨魔入侵时，我们才敢冒险出去，看看世界发生了多大变化。

english: Of course, after that...
translation: 当然，在那之后……

english: Ah well, enough history lessons I should say. I must really get back to my gardening.
translation: 啊好吧，我想历史课足够了。我真的得回去园艺了。

english: Thanks for the info!
translation: 谢谢你的信息！

english: A little, yes. I don't really know what all this has to do with anything.
translation: 有一点，是的。我真的不知道这和什么有关系。

english: I suppose it doesn't, really, it's just the mumblings of an old dwarf.
translation: 我想确实没关系，真的，只是一个老矮人的唠叨。

english: Not really, no.
translation: 不太感兴趣，不。

english: Oh, alright then.
translation: 哦，那好吧。

english: This is your garden?
translation: 这是你的花园？

english: Not at all!
translation: 完全没有！

english: A little, yes.
translation: 有一点，是的。

english: Not really, no.
translation: 不太感兴趣，不。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Howdy.
translation: 你好啊。

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Same as you I'd wager, lookin' fer that big ol' bunny.
translation: 我敢打赌和你一样，在找那只大兔子。

english: Well we've found him.
translation: 嗯，我们找到他了。

english: That we have kid, that we have.
translation: 确实找到了，孩子，确实找到了。

english: Do you know what raisins are?
translation: 你知道葡萄干是什么吗？

english: Raisins? Talk to Glanton, kid. He's your raisin man.
translation: 葡萄干？去找格兰顿，孩子。他是你的葡萄干人。

english: Oh, okay then!
translation: 哦，那好吧！

english: Thanks for helping with the raisins.
translation: 谢谢帮忙处理葡萄干。

english: It was no skin off my nose, any time kid.
translation: 没什么大不了的，随时都行孩子。

english: Good work with those raisins kid, you've got real moxy. Tell me, do you like games?
translation: 葡萄干干得不错孩子，你很有胆量。告诉我，你喜欢游戏吗？

english: Games? Like Runelink?
translation: 游戏？像符石四子棋？

english: Runelink! Hah! I mean real games, games with a wager. Pride or humiliation. Stakes worth fighting for.
translation: 符石四子棋！哈！我说的是真正的游戏，有赌注的游戏。荣耀或耻辱。值得为之奋斗的赌注。

english: Sounds risky.
translation: 听起来很冒险。

english: There you have it, risk indeed.
translation: 就是这样，确实是风险。

english: Ever been to the wilderness?
translation: 去过荒野吗？

english: Real evil haunts that place...
translation: 真正的邪恶萦绕着那个地方……

english: ...And we haunt the evil right back.
translation: ……而我们反过来萦绕邪恶。

english: What say ye? Come hasten the reckoning of the horrible legions what dwell up there with us sometime?
translation: 你怎么说？什么时候来和我们一起加速清算住在那里的恐怖军团？

english: Ehh, I'll think about it.
translation: 呃，我会考虑的。

english: It won't catch on, Glanton.
translation: 不会流行的，格兰顿。

english: Ah don't be like that Rinder, how will we know till we try?
translation: 啊别那样林德，不试试怎么知道？

english: Alright gents, what's going on here then?
translation: 好吧各位，这里发生了什么事？

english: I've had this great idea see.
translation: 我有个好主意你看。

english: Does it have anything to do with long walks in the desert again?
translation: 又和沙漠长途跋涉有关吗？

english: Well y'see thats the beauty of it.
translation: 嗯你看这就是妙处。

english: It's a lot easier to melt chocolate than dry out grapes.
translation: 融化巧克力比晒干葡萄容易多了。

english: Chocolate? You've piqued my interest!
translation: 巧克力？你引起了我的兴趣！

english: Exactly! See Rinder, [player name] doesn't even know half the idea yet and wants in!
translation: 没错！看林德，[player name] 还不知道一半的想法就想加入了！

english: It still seems terribly messy.
translation: 这仍然看起来非常混乱。

english: Okay so, what we do is use our connections with the Easter Bunny to acquire a lot of chocolate.
translation: 好的，我们利用与复活节兔子的关系获取大量巧克力。

english: And give it to me for my outstanding contributions to the preservation of Easter?
translation: 然后因为我保护复活节的杰出贡献把它给我？

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: And we melt it all up, and put it in a fountain.
translation: 我们把它全部融化，放进喷泉里。

english: And then I get to have it all?
translation: 然后我就能全部拥有？

english: No then we sell people the right to take a couple of small fruits to dip in the fountain and eat!
translation: 不，然后我们出售给人们用几个小水果蘸喷泉吃的权利！

english: That sounds delicious!
translation: 听起来很好吃！

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: But I can get some for free?
translation: 但我能免费得到一些？

english: See the amount people would pay for just a taste of chocolate is so much higher than we'd have to pay to source a lot of the stuff.
translation: 看，人们愿意为尝一口巧克力支付的金额远高于我们采购大量巧克力的成本。

english: Well, I'm not interested if I have to pay.
translation: 嗯，如果要付钱我就不感兴趣了。

english: I saved Easter...
translation: 我拯救了复活节……

english: ... Again!
translation: ……又一次！

english: I think I'll go see if the Easter Bunny has some more eggs for me...
translation: 我想我去看看复活节兔子有没有更多蛋给我……

english: Be seeing you!
translation: 回头见！

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Well, it's funny you should ask that actually, I run the local parcel service to the mainland.
translation: 嗯，你问这个真巧，我经营当地到大陆的包裹服务。

english: Parcel service?
translation: 包裹服务？

english: Yes, we sometimes get asked to send items back to the mainland. We can send items to individuals' bank accounts, for a small fee of course.
translation: 是的，我们有时会被要求将物品送回大陆。我们可以将物品发送到个人账户，当然收取少量费用。

english: How much does it cost?
translation: 费用是多少？

english: It costs 10 trading sticks per item, unfortunately, even stackable items cost the same.
translation: 每件物品收费10根交易棒，不幸的是，即使可堆叠物品也收费相同。

english: What are trading sticks and how do I get some?
translation: 交易棒是什么？我如何获得一些？

english: Trading sticks are our local currency, you could perhaps earn some trading sticks by doing some work around the village.
translation: 交易棒是我们的当地货币，你也许可以通过在村庄周围做一些工作来赚取一些交易棒。

english: Have a chat with Murcaily, I think he was looking for someone to help him, he works near the hardwood grove to the east of Trufitus' hut.
translation: 和穆凯利聊聊，我想他在找人帮忙，他在特鲁菲图斯小屋东边的硬木林附近工作。

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Can I send a parcel please?
translation: 我能寄个包裹吗？

english: It costs at least 10 trading sticks to use this service. Sorry but you don't have enough.
translation: 使用这项服务至少需要10根交易棒。抱歉但你不够。

english: Of course...which items would you like to send to your bank?
translation: 当然……你想把哪些物品发送到你的银行？

english: Is there anything interesting to do here?
translation: 这里有什么有趣的事可做吗？

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
translation: 我一直在村庄周围做一些工作。

english: Yeah, you've been doing a lot of good work around here. Let me give you something for your time and effort.
translation: 是的，你在这里做了很多好事。让我给你一些东西作为你时间和努力的回报。

english: I've already given you some trading sticks and I don't have any more on me at the moment. Why not go and talk to some of the other villagers and get some contributions?
translation: 我已经给了你一些交易棒，目前我身上没有了。为什么不去和其他村民谈谈，获得一些贡献？

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Hey, I've seen you working around the village. You've been doing a lot of good work around here for us. Let me give you something for your trouble.
translation: 嘿，我看到你在村庄周围工作。你为我们在这里做了很多好事。让我给你一些东西作为回报。

english: Ahhhhhhhh - Get away from me you beast!
translation: 啊啊啊啊啊——离我远点你这野兽！
