translation: 哇啊啊啊！——是邪恶的布鲁多兽来吃我的灵魂了！

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
translation: 我一直在村庄周围做一些工作。

english: Fishies be mine, leave dem fishies!

translation: 不用了，谢谢。

translation: 你好，旅行者。欢迎来到''狗之毛''酒馆。我能为你做什么？

english: Can I buy a beer?
translation: 我能买杯啤酒吗？

english: Well that's my speciality! The local brew's named 'Moonlight Mead' and will set you back 5 gold. Whaddya say? Fancy a pint?
translation: 那是我的专长！当地酿造的名为''月光蜂蜜酒''，收你5金币。怎么说？想来一品脱吗？

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: I don't have the money on me right now though... can I start a tab?
translation: 但我现在身上没钱……能赊账吗？

english: You see that sign behind me there?
translation: 你看到我身后的那个牌子了吗？

english: The one that says; 'Please Do Not Ask For Credit As Being Attacked By A Large Angry Werewolf Inn Keeper Often Offends'?
translation: 就是写着''请勿要求赊账，因为被大型愤怒狼人酒馆老板攻击往往会冒犯''的那个？

english: Bingo.
translation: 没错。

english: Here ya go pal. Enjoy!
translation: 给你伙计。享受吧！

english: Actually, no thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Eh, suit yourself. You're missing out on a genuine taste experience.
translation: 呃，随你便。你错过了真正的味觉体验。

english: Can I hear some gossip?
translation: 我能听听八卦吗？

english: Well, I dunno... The village is kind of on the fringe out here, I dunno how up to date the stuff I hear about is...
translation: 嗯，我不知道……这个村庄有点偏僻，我不知道我听到的消息有多及时……

english: Tell me about this village.
translation: 跟我讲讲这个村庄。

english: You want to know about Canifis? I dunno why, not a lot happens here. We're just your typical everyday down at earth werewolf folk, after all...
translation: 你想知道坎尼非斯村？我不知道为什么，这里没什么大事发生。毕竟我们只是典型的普通狼人平民……

english: So... everyone here is a werewolf?
translation: 所以……这里的每个人都是狼人？

english: Yep. We are as Zamorak made us!
translation: 是的。我们是扎莫拉克创造的样子！

english: You mentioned Zamorak...
translation: 你提到了扎莫拉克……

english: Yeah, he's great isn't he? Every year we hold a big festival to give thanks to Zamorak for keeping us well fed and happy here.
translation: 是的，他很棒不是吗？每年我们都会举办大型节日，感谢扎莫拉克让我们在这里吃得饱过得开心。

english: I hear over in the West they worship Saradomin, but I dunno why! What's he ever done to help out us werewolves, huh?
translation: 我听说西方他们崇拜萨拉多明，但我不知道为什么！他为帮助我们狼人做过什么，嗯？

english: I hear he has all these crazy followers who say things like we shouldn't kill people and eat them! What's up with that?
translation: 我听说他有所有这些疯狂的追随者，说我们不应该杀人吃人！那算怎么回事？

english: ...So when is this festival?
translation: ……那么这个节日是什么时候？

english: Aaaah, not for a good few months yet. Come and ask me again nearer to the time, I'll keep some extra meat and mead back from the rest for ya pal.
translation: 啊，还要好几个月呢。临近时再来问我，我会给你留一些额外的肉和蜜酒，伙计。

english: Tell me about the land of Morytania.
translation: 跟我讲讲莫利塔尼亚这片土地。

english: Well, I don't know what to tell you really... This village is called Canifis and lies on the border between Morytania and Misthalin... so we're kind of on the front line if those Saradominists to the west ever decide to
translation: 嗯，我真的不知道告诉你什么……这个村庄叫坎尼非斯村，位于莫利塔尼亚和米斯特林王国之间的边界……所以如果西方的那些萨拉多明派决定

english: attack us... South East of here is the castle of Lord Drakan, our master.
translation: 攻击我们……这里东南方是我们主人德雷坎领主的城堡。

english: Lord Drakan? Who is that?
translation: 德雷坎领主？那是谁？

english: Ahhh... you must be new to these parts if you haven't heard of Lord Drakan! He's the lord of this land, and we all pledge allegiance to him.
translation: 啊啊……如果你没听说过德雷坎领主，你一定是新来这片地区的！他是这片土地的领主，我们都向他效忠。

english: In return for our allegiance, and the tithe of course, he keeps our land safe from any invaders and the Saradominists who want to kill us all.
translation: 作为我们效忠和什一税的回报，他保护我们的土地免受任何入侵者和想杀死我们所有人的萨拉多明派的侵害。

english: Tithe? What do you mean?
translation: 什一税？你是什么意思？

english: Ah, well, in return for his protection, we have to give Lord Drakan a share of blood every week. If we don't have any to spare from our hunts, then we need to pick a member of the village to give their life in return
translation: 啊，嗯，作为他保护的回报，我们每周必须给德雷坎领主一份血。如果我们狩猎后没有多余的血，那么我们需要挑选一名村民献出生命作为回报

english: for the blood so that the tithe is fulfilled.
translation: 以完成什一税。

english: You mean you kill someone you know in order to meet the tithe???
translation: 你的意思是你们杀死认识的人来完成什一税？？？

english: That's right, but only if we haven't managed to get enough spare blood from our hunts. It's kind of severe if you look at it that way, but frankly, I think the price is fair in return for his protection and his tolerance of
translation: 没错，但只有当我们狩猎后没有获得足够多余的血时。如果那样看确实有点严厉，但坦白说，我认为作为他保护和容忍我们村庄的回报，这个代价是公平的。

english: our village. He could probably kill us all if he wanted us gone, so keeping on his good side is worth the sacrifice to us. Lucky we're not human really!
translation: 我们的村庄。如果他想要我们消失，他可能会杀死我们所有人，所以保持和他的良好关系对我们来说值得这个牺牲。幸好我们不是人类！

english: Why's that?
translation: 为什么？

english: He hates humans! Apparently long ago his brother Draynor was trapped in Misthalin and lost much of his powers, and was recently killed by some human!
translation: 他讨厌人类！显然很久以前他的兄弟德雷纳被困在米斯特林王国，失去了大部分力量，最近被某个凡人杀死了！

english: He hates humans! Apparently long ago his brother Draynor was trapped in Misthalin, and adventurous little human wannabe-heroes keep trying to kill him!
translation: 他讨厌人类！显然很久以前他的兄弟德雷纳被困在米斯特林王国，而冒险的小人类 wannabe-英雄们不断试图杀死他！

english: Man, I'd hate to be a human around here, that's for sure. Drakan would really enjoy hunting them down and killing them!
translation: 天哪，我肯定不想在这里当人类。德雷坎会非常享受追捕和杀死他们！

english: Uh... thanks for the info...
translation: 呃……谢谢你的信息……

english: Tell me about the shopkeepers here.
translation: 跟我讲讲这里的店主。

english: Hmmm? Why, who did you want to hear the gossip about?
translation: 嗯？为什么，你想听谁的八卦？

english: Tell me what you know about Sbott the Tanner.

english: years old! You need stuff tanning, I recommend him!
translation: 岁了！你需要鞣制东西，我推荐他！

translation: 啊是的……老鲁弗斯……他有点上年纪了，不喜欢经常从狼形态出来，但让我告诉你：那家伙是个彻头彻尾的猎人。你看到他每天捕获多少食物

english: catches a day? That takes real dedication! Some of the young pups think just because a wolf has a bit of grey in his fur then he's past it, but I've seen him put those pups to shame in a hunt! He's a real inspiration to us

english: all!

translation: 呃，我不太喜欢那家伙，但你不能否认他存货的质量。你可以在那里买到一些优质布料。

english: What's wrong with him?
translation: 他有什么问题？

english: Eh... I can't really tell you to be honest. Something about the guy just gets my hackles up everytime he opens his yap, know what I mean?
translation: 呃……老实说我不能告诉你。那家伙每次开口说话就让我毛骨悚然，懂我意思吗？

english: No, not really.
translation: 不，不太懂。

english: Lucky for you. I can't really explain it, I just don't like the guy. Does great clothes though, you got to give him that.
translation: 你幸运。我没法解释，我就是不喜欢那家伙。但他做的衣服确实好，这点你得承认。

english: I bet you have some juicy gossip about Fidelio the general store owner.
translation: 我打赌你对杂货店老板菲德利奥有一些有趣的八卦。

english: That nut job? Oh sure, we all know about him. He was a real firebrand daredevil when he was younger, always taking risks to make himself a quick buck... he got himself caught up in the smuggling trade, sneaking over
translation: 那个疯子？哦当然，我们都知道他。他年轻时是个真正的火爆冒险家，总是冒险赚快钱……他卷入了走私贸易，偷偷越过

translation: 边界进入米斯特林王国，假装成人类以便购买异国物品出售。

translation: 异国物品？来自米斯特林王国？比如什么？

translation: 哦天哪，你说吧！面粉……桶……火绒盒……凿子……他都能弄到！但他做这么久了，神经已经崩溃了。

english: Nowadays he's a disgrace, he can barely string a sentence together and jumps at his own shadow. Makes you feel ashamed to be a werewolf.
translation: 如今他是个耻辱，几乎连不成句子，被自己的影子吓一跳。让你为身为狼人感到羞愧。

english: Tell me about the temple to the west.
translation: 跟我讲讲西方的神殿。

english: Well, I'm not old enough to remember the full story behind it, but it was a terrible day for our kingdom when it was built there.
translation: 嗯，我还不够老，记不住背后的完整故事，但当它建在那里时，对我们王国来说是可怕的一天。

english: Apparently Morytania had a once strong kingdom, with lands spreading far further west than they do today, and south into the desert, until the day when a sneak attack by the hated human forces who worship
translation: 显然莫利塔尼亚曾经有一个强大的王国，领土向西延伸得比今天远得多，向南延伸到沙漠，直到有一天被憎恨的人类军队偷袭，他们崇拜

translation: 萨拉多明，烧毁了我们的村庄，大规模屠杀我们的人民。

translation: 然后他们诅咒了河流，这样如果我们触碰它就会燃烧我们的同类！你能想象吗？？？让整条河对我们有毒？？？

english: Luckily they seem to have calmed down somewhat recently, and tend to stay on their side of the river... but the wrong they have done my people will never be forgotten, and will never be forgiven. What is worse is
translation: 幸运的是他们最近似乎冷静了一些，倾向于待在河的对岸……但他们对我的人民所做的错事永远不会被忘记，也永远不会被原谅。更糟糕的是

english: that they then had the nerve to build that gigantic statue on the river mouth to mock the slaughter of our people and the poisoning of our river! I can understand Lord Drakan's hatred for them even if I do not share
translation: 他们竟然有胆量在河口建造那座巨大的雕像，嘲笑对我们人民的屠杀和对河流的投毒！即使我不认同德雷坎领主对他们的仇恨程度，我也能理解

english: it to his extent.
translation: 他的仇恨。

english: So you hate humans too?
translation: 所以你也讨厌人类？

english: Absolutely! If I ever met one I would gobble him up where he stands! And then chew the bones for dessert!
translation: 绝对！如果我遇到一个，我会当场把他吞了！然后嚼骨头当甜点！

translation: ……嗯，好的，谢谢，再见。

translation: 故事？？？嘿，嗯我现在能想到的只有我亲爱的老妈妈在我小时候告诉我的一个……

english: Now how did it go... Ah yes!

translation: 从前有一只勇敢的年轻狼在森林里行走，遇到了一个穿红衣服的人类。''啊哈！''他心想，''这是一顿轻松的美餐！''但人类和他说话，因为他

translation: 一直被教导要做一只有礼貌的狼，他回应了。

translation: 最好在这所房子里得到更好的美餐，所以他用爪子能跑的最快速度跑到人类告诉他的房子……在里面他发现一个老人躺在床上，虽然肉有点硬，因为

translation: 人类比他想象的老，他还是美餐一顿，决定在房子里睡一会儿。但他没睡多久，就被敲门声吵醒了。穿红衣服的人类跟着

translation: 他到了房子！怀疑是人类陷阱，勇敢的年轻狼穿上老人的衣服跳进床里，这样他就可以假装成人类逃离这个可怕的陷阱！嗯现在，这个人类

translation: 根本不是人类！勇敢的年轻狼决定尝试逃跑，因为那只是个年轻人类，不是很强壮，所以勇敢的年轻狼说如果他们不让他逃跑他就吃了人类！当他说

translation: 拿着一把斧头，可怜的年轻狼就死在这个人类为他设置的可怕陷阱里。

translation: 你知道这个故事的寓意是什么吗？

english: Um... no, not really.

translation: 多么积极！

english: No time to talk. I have things to attend to.
translation: 没时间说话。我有事要处理。

english: It's nice to see another human face around here.
translation: 很高兴在这儿见到另一张人类面孔。

english: Leave me be, peasant - I am relaxing.
translation: 别打扰我，农民——我在放松。

english: Well, that's nice!
translation: 嗯，那真好！

english: Do you know who I am?
translation: 你知道我是谁吗？

english: I'm sorry, I haven't had the privilege.
translation: 抱歉，我没这个荣幸。

english: I, peasant, am Robin, Master Bowman. I am very famous you know.
translation: 我乃罗宾，神箭手是也。你可知道，我声名远扬。

english: Oh, Robin, Master Bowman, I see.
translation: 哦，罗宾，神箭手，我明白了。

english: So have you heard of me?
translation: 那你听说过我吗？

english: No.
translation: 没有。

english: Would you do me a favour? I appear to have run out of bed linen. Can you run along to the innkeeper and get me a clean bedsheet?
translation: 能帮我个忙吗？我的床单似乎用完了。你能去酒馆老板那儿给我取张干净的床单来吗？

english: Anything for a famous person such as yourself.
translation: 为你这样出名的人做什么都行。

english: Now that sounds more like it. Run along now, get me my sheet.
translation: 这才像话嘛。快去吧，给我把床单拿来。

english: Go and get it yourself.
translation: 自己去拿。

english: Oh charming. You just can't get the staff these days.
translation: 哦，真有魅力啊。如今就是招不到好手下。

english: I've brought you a clean bedsheet, Robin.
translation: 我给你带了干净的床单，罗宾。

english: Well it's about time. Run along now, I need some Robin time.
translation: 嗯，总算来了。快走吧，我需要独处一会儿。

english: So, still here then?
translation: 所以，你还在这里？

english: Do you want another game of Runedraw?
translation: 你想再来一局符石抽牌吗？

english: No!
translation: 不！

english: Sorry, my orders are that I can only give slime to those who have completed the Morytania medium, hard or elite diaries.
translation: 抱歉，我奉命只能向完成莫利塔尼亚中等、困难或精英成就日志的玩家提供粘液。

english: There's a diary master in Canifis, go and speak to her.
translation: 坎尼非斯村有位成就日志大师，去找她谈谈吧。

english: Can I have these bones converted into bonemeal with the promised amount of slime, please?
translation: 请问你能把这些骨头制成骨粉，并附上约定数量的粘液吗？

english: You do not have enough space for both bonemeal and slime. Come back to me when you have space.
translation: 你的物品栏空间不足，无法同时容纳骨粉和粘液。等有空位时再来找我吧。

english: You do not have any bones for me to convert for you.
translation: 你身上没有可以让我加工的骨头。

english: As THE Master Bowman, I am quite impressed by your equipment, but it's not the sort I'd recommend myself. Try more conventional forms of accuracy enhancement.
translation: 身为那位神箭手，我对你的装备颇感惊讶，但这并非我会推荐的类型。不妨试试更传统的精准提升方式。

english: Here you go.
translation: 给，拿好。

english: You are handed a torn part of a clue scroll.
translation: 你获得了一张线索卷轴碎片。

english: As THE Master Bowman, I am most impressed by your equipment, peasant.
translation: 作为神箭手，我对你的装备印象深刻，农民。

english: Anything for a famous person such as yourself.
translation: 为你这样出名的人做什么都行。

english: Go and get it yourself.
translation: 自己去拿。

english: Hello there! Is there anything I can help you with?
translation: 你好！有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: I'd like to buy something.
translation: 我想买点东西。

english: How's business going?
translation: 生意怎么样？

english: Its a little slow... There's a lot of soldiers around these parts, so many people just wear a uniform.
translation: 生意有点冷清……这一带士兵太多，很多人都只穿制服。

english: Although, I'm just happy to be here! Osten recently took me on as his assistant, you see. I've always wanted to work in fashion!
translation: 不过，能在这儿我就很开心了！奥斯滕最近收我当助手呢。我一直梦想在时尚圈工作！

english: Anyway, enough about me... Was there something I could help you with? Perhaps a new cape? ...Or a nice new chef's hat?
translation: 好了，不说我了……有什么能帮你的吗？要不要看看新斗篷？……或者一顶漂亮的新厨师帽？

english: No thanks, I'm just browsing.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我只是看看。

english: I'll be right here if you need anything!
translation: 如果你需要任何东西我就在这里！

english: I'd like to buy something.
translation: 我想买点东西。

english: How's business going?
translation: 生意怎么样？

english: No thanks, I'm just browsing.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我只是看看。

english: So you're made entirely of rocks?
translation: 所以你完全是由岩石制成的？

english: Not quite, my body is formed mostly of minerals.
translation: 不完全是，我的身体主要由矿物质构成。

english: Aren't minerals just rocks?
translation: 矿物质不就是岩石吗？

english: No, rocks are rocks, minerals are minerals. I am formed from minerals.
translation: 不，岩石是岩石，矿物质是矿物质。我由矿物质构成。

english: But you're a Rock Golem...
translation: 但你是岩石魔像……

english: Yes, I am. This conversation seems to be confusing you; perhaps you should stop.
translation: 没错，我正是。看来这番对话让你有些困惑，或许该到此为止了。

english: I feel strangely emotionless and empty. Maybe I should feel sad about it, but I can't.
translation: 我莫名地感到情感缺失、内心空虚。按理说我该为此悲伤，可我做不到。

english: You can't feel sad?
translation: 你不能感到悲伤？

english: Correct. Now, if I only had a heart...
translation: 正确。现在，如果我有一颗心……

english: I'm not sure it works like that around here.
translation: 我不确定这里是不是这样运作的。

english: I have an idea for a song.
translation: 我想到一首歌的点子。

english: Oh?
translation: 哦？

english: Copper-copper-copper Cophelia - you come and go, you come and go...
translation: 铜 - 铜 - 铜科菲莉亚——你来我往，你来我往……

english: Mmmhmm.
translation: 嗯嗯。

english: Truth is, I am Iron Golem.
translation: 事实上，我是钢铁魔像。

english: I can see that.
translation: 我能看出来。

english: I'm blue, da-ba-dee da-ba-da.
translation: 我是蓝色的，哒 - 吧 - 滴哒 - 吧 - 哒。

english: Oh dear, I've gone all pale.
translation: 哎呀，我脸色都发白了。

english: Are you okay?
translation: 你还好吗？

english: It must be something I ate.
translation: 一定是我吃了什么。

english: Did you ever hear the tragedy of Queen Efaritay the Fair?
translation: 你可曾听闻美丽女王埃法丽泰的悲剧？

english: No?
translation: 没有？

english: I thought not.
translation: 我就知道。

english: It's not a story the Myreque would tell you.
translation: 这可不是迈雷克会告诉你的故事。

english: So near and yet so far... if my atoms were arranged a little differently, I could be diamond.
translation: 近在咫尺却又遥不可及……若我的原子排列稍作调整，我本可化作钻石。

english: Would you enjoy being a diamond?
translation: 你想成为钻石吗？

english: I expect I would, until someone tried chipping bits off me with a chisel. I'm probably safer as coal.
translation: 我想我会喜欢，直到有人拿着凿子想从我身上敲下碎片为止。或许当煤炭反而更安全。

english: I am so in my element right now.
translation: 我现在如鱼得水。

english: Sigh...
translation: 叹气……

english: I'm totally showing the bling today.
translation: 我今天可是闪闪发光呢。

english: That's nice for you.
translation: 那对你真好。

english: A little. Though sometimes I just feel like I'm being used as a status symbol, and no-one appreciates me for me.
translation: 有一点。不过有时我只觉得自己被当作地位的象征，没人真正欣赏我本身。

english: Oh dear.
translation: 哦天哪。

english: Don't worry. At least I look good.
translation: 别担心。至少我看起来不错。

english: No-one appreciates granite.
translation: 没有人欣赏花岗岩。

english: Why do you say that?
translation: 为什么这么说？

english: I know how it works. No-one actually wants granite. They just chop us up and throw our pieces on the floor.
translation: 我清楚其中的门道。没人真正想要花岗岩，他们只是把我们敲碎，然后把碎片随手扔在地上。

english: Oh, I can see that must be upsetting for you.
translation: 哦，我能看出那一定让你很沮丧。

english: When you've seen your relatives cut into pieces, with their severed limbs cast aside like junk, THEN you will understand how I feel.
translation: 等你亲眼见过亲人被剁成碎块，断肢残骸如垃圾般被弃置一旁，那时你才能真正体会我的心情。

english: I'll bear it in mind.
translation: 我会记住的。

english: I feel sad today. Very blue.
translation: 我今天感到悲伤。非常忧郁。

english: No-one understands me.
translation: 没有人理解我。

english: Why not?
translation: 为什么不？

english: Because argle gargle gooble goop.
translation: 因为阿格尔加格尔古布尔古普。

english: ... I don't understand you either.
translation: ……我也不理解你。

english: *sigh*
translation: 叹气

english: So how do you pronounce Lovakengj?
translation: 那么洛瓦肯吉城怎么发音？

english: Silly human, it's pronounced Lova-Kane.
translation: 愚蠢的人类，这应该读作洛瓦 - 凯恩。

english: How did you not know that?
translation: 你怎么会不知道？

english: You know, it really isn't that obvious.
translation: 你要知道，这其实没那么显而易见。

english: I may be green, but I'm not an environmentalist.
translation: 我可能是绿色的，但我不是环保主义者。

english: There's no need. Whatever you may have read, even coal is a renewable energy source - just wait a minute and the rocks respawn.
translation: 没必要担心。不管你看过什么资料，就算是煤炭也算可再生能源——等上一分钟，岩石就会重新生成。

english: You can burn as much as you like, too, without needing to worry about it affecting the climate - we don't have a lot of weather here.
translation: 你也可以尽情燃烧，不必担心影响气候——毕竟我们这儿压根没什么天气变化。

english: That's handy.
translation: 那很方便。

english: Yes, I pity anyone whose world doesn't work like this one. I don't know how they can possibly cope.
translation: 是啊，我真同情那些世界规则与我们不同的人。真不知道他们是怎么熬过来的。

english: I'm confused. It takes incredible skill to smith anything from my ore, yet the items you'd get are terribly mediocre.
translation: 我很困惑。用我的矿石锻造物品需要极高的技巧，可成品却平平无奇。

english: Is that something that worries you?
translation: 那让你担心吗？

english: It just feels like my world doesn't make sense, sometimes. But I suppose it's always been like this, and I've got used to it.
translation: 只是有时候，我觉得这个世界的规则说不通。不过我想向来如此，我也早就习惯了。

english: Your world is amazing. I truly am in awe.
translation: 你的世界真奇妙。我确实心生敬畏。

english: Did you just make an ore joke?
translation: 你刚才开了个矿石笑话吗？

english: Maybe...
translation: 也许……

english: Well it was awful.
translation: 嗯那很糟糕。

english: Ha! Now you're making them as well.
translation: 哈！现在你也在开玩笑了。

english: Are we really doing this? Amethyst isn't an ore anyway.
translation: 我们真的在这样做吗？紫水晶反正不是矿石。

english: I can dream, [player name]!
translation: 我可以做梦，[player name]！

english: Why am I the one always following you?
translation: 为什么总是我跟着你？

english: What?
translation: 什么？

english: Well I'm the lead golem, so surely I should take the lead!
translation: 嗯我是领头魔像，所以我应该带头！

english: That joke doesn't even make sense... Those words aren't pronounced the same!
translation: 那个笑话甚至没有意义……那些词发音不一样！

english: Well, blame whoever decided they should have the same spelling then.
translation: 嗯，那就怪决定它们应该有相同拼写的人吧。

english: I reckon I'd make a good thief.
translation: 我觉得我当个小偷应该挺在行。

english: There are probably better ambitions.
translation: 可能有更好的抱负。

english: Maybe, but if I was one, I'd be able to nickel they have!
translation: 也许吧，但如果我真当小偷，肯定能把他们的镍币都顺走！

english: *slap*
translation: 拍打

english: Grrr!
translation: 咕噜！

english: Grrrr!
translation: 咕噜噜！

english: Grarrr!
translation: 咕噜噜噜！

english: *Whistles*
translation: 吹口哨

english: You slip your hand into Rocky's pocket.
translation: 你把手伸进洛奇的口袋。

english: OY!! You're going to have to do better than that! Sheesh, what an amateur.
translation: 喂！！你得再高明点才行！天哪，真是个外行。

english: Is there much competition between you raccoons and the magpies?
translation: 你们浣熊和喜鹊之间有很多竞争吗？

english: Magpies have nothing on us! They're just interested in shinies.
translation: 喜鹊哪能跟我们比！它们就只对亮闪闪的东西感兴趣。

english: Us raccoons have a finer taste, we can see the value in anything, whether it shines or not.
translation: 我们浣熊品味更高，不管东西闪不闪亮，我们都能看出它的价值。

english: Hey Rocky, do you want to commit a bank robbery with me?
translation: 嘿洛奇，你想和我一起抢劫银行吗？

english: If that is the level you are at, I do not wish to participate in criminal acts with you [player name].
translation: 如果你就这个水平，我不想和你一起参与犯罪活动 [player name]。

english: Well what are you interested in stealing?
translation: 那你对偷什么感兴趣？

english: The heart of a lovely raccoon called Rodney.
translation: 一只叫罗德尼的可爱浣熊的心。

english: I cannot really help you there I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕我在那里帮不了你。

english: Hi Rocky, how are you?
translation: 嗨洛奇，你好吗？

english: Your shoe laces are untied!
translation: 你的鞋带松了！

english: Rocky jumps into your backpack...
translation: 洛奇跳进你的背包……

english: The master thief strikes again! Here you go, have it back.
translation: 神偷再次出击！给你，拿回去。

english: Rocky flicks the coin back into your backpack
translation: 洛奇把硬币弹回你的背包

english: I better keep my eyes on you...
translation: 我最好盯着你……

english: Get robbed mate.
translation: 你被偷了，伙计。

english: Watch your pockets!
translation: 看好你的口袋！

english: Watch out! Rocky coming at ya!
translation: 小心！洛奇冲你来了！

english: Hey Ziggy, do you have any relation to a raccoon named Rocky?
translation: 嘿齐吉，你和一只叫洛奇的浣熊有关系吗？

english: Who me? No, me and Rocky are not related.
translation: 我？不，我和洛奇没有亲戚关系。

english: Really? But you look so similar.
translation: 真的？但你们看起来很像。

english: That's because a Tanuki is a master of disguise! I could pretend to be a human if I wanted to.
translation: 那是因为狸猫可是伪装高手！只要我愿意，我随时能扮成人类。

english: Wow! Why don't you do it now then?
translation: 哇！那你为什么不现在就做？

english: I said if I wanted to, I don't want to.
translation: 我说的是''如果我想''，可我现在不想啊。

english: Hey Ziggy, *giggles* do you happen to know any good plumbers?
translation: 嘿齐吉，(咯咯笑) 你碰巧认识什么好水管工吗？

english: Well that's a bit of a silly question isn't it.
translation: 嗯，这问题有点傻不是吗。

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你什么意思？

english: Why would I, a Tanuki, know any good plumbers?
translation: 为什么我，一只狸猫，会认识什么好水管工？

english: I don't know, you might have come across one before.
translation: 我不知道，你可能以前遇到过。

english: Well, clearly not, since I spend most of my time following you around.
translation: 嗯，显然没有，因为我大部分时间都在跟着你转。

english: Ziggy! I've got a treat for you!
translation: 齐吉！我有零食给你！

english: Really! Where! Let me have it!
translation: 真的！在哪里！给我！

english: You hold out your fist.
translation: 你伸出拳头。

english: Why are you hiding it? Let me have it! Please, please, please!
translation: 你为什么藏着？给我！求求你，求求你，求求你！

english: You open your fist... there is no treat.
translation: 你打开拳头……没有零食。

english: Oh, where did the treat go? Did you drop it?
translation: 哦，零食去哪了？你掉了吗？

english: Yeah, I must have dropped it, sorry about that Ziggy.
translation: 是的，我一定是掉了，对不起齐吉。

english: Rrowl!
translation: 嗷呜！

english: Hiss!
translation: 嘶！

english: Ssss!
translation: 嘶嘶！

english: *slap*
translation: 拍打

english: Grrr!
translation: 咕噜！

english: Grrrr!
translation: 咕噜噜！

english: Grarrr!
translation: 咕噜噜噜！

english: Have you ever seen a blue panda before?
translation: 你以前见过蓝色熊猫吗？

english: Blue Panda? That's ridiculous, there's only one type of panda and it is a beautiful red.
translation: 蓝色熊猫？太荒谬了，熊猫只有一种，那可是美丽的红色。

english: Hey Red, howsit going?
translation: 嘿小红，怎么样？

english: Hi! Want to see me do a really fast cartwheel?
translation: 嗨！想看我做超快的侧手翻吗？

english: Uh, yeah, sure go ahead.
translation: 呃，行，来吧。

english: Nothing happens...
translation: 什么都没发生……

english: Want to see me do it again?
translation: 想再看我做一次吗？

english: Huh? Nothing happened...
translation: 哈？什么都没发生……

english: To your eyes...
translation: 对你的眼睛来说……

english: Do you know a raccoon called Dufresne?
translation: 你认识一只叫杜弗雷恩的浣熊吗？

english: No, I don't believe I have.
translation: 不，我想我不认识。

english: Rrowl!
translation: 吼！

english: Hiss!
translation: 嘶！

english: Ssss!
translation: 嘶嘶！

english: *slap*
translation: 拍打

english: Grrr!
translation: 咕噜！

english: Grrrr!
translation: 咕噜！

english: Grarrr!
translation: 咕噜！

english: Hello there youngster.
translation: 你好啊，年轻人。

english: Who are you calling youngster??
translation: 你在叫谁年轻人？？

english: Why you. Unless you have seen the small village of Falador grow into a heaving city like I have of course!
translation: 当然是你。除非你也像我一样，亲眼见证法拉多从小村庄发展成繁华都市！

english: Err... no...
Well then! Enjoy your stay in our mountain home.
translation: 那好吧！享受你在我们山间家园的停留吧。

english: Hello again, youngster.
translation: 又见面了，年轻人。

english: How's your son getting on, now that I've rescued him from the time bubble and the culinaromancer?
translation: 自从我把你儿子从时间气泡和烹饪魔法师手里救出来后，他过得怎么样？

english: My son's fine. I'm not so sure about you, though. Maybe you should lay down in a dark room until the babbling stops.
translation: 我儿子没事。倒是你，我可不太放心。也许你该去黑屋子里躺会儿，等不再胡言乱语了再说。

english: You're already carrying one.
translation: 你已经带着一个了。

english: Aye, I've still got enough ingredients from before, but I'll want 100 coins.
translation: 是啊，我之前剩下的材料还够，不过你得给我100金币。

english: Maybe later.
translation: 也许改天吧。

english: I'm not doing it for less, even for a mate.
translation: 少一分都不行，即使是熟人。

english: About your son...
translation: 关于你儿子……

english: Can I have another rock cake?
translation: 我能再要一个石糕吗？

english: Yes, but I want another one.
translation: 是的，但我想要另一个。

english: Forget it.
translation: 算了。

english: Okay, 100 coins will be fine.
translation: 好的，100金币可以。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Come one, come all, buy my amazing choc ice invention here! Chocolate on the outside. Iced cream on the inside. Oh I also have some chocolate left over from making choc ices which I'm selling too.
translation: 来来来，走过路过不要错过！来买我神奇的巧克力冰棍！外裹巧克力，内藏冰淇淋。哦对了，做冰棍剩下的巧克力我也在卖。

english: No thanks, I'm not interested.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我没兴趣。

english: How do you stop your icy snacks melting? The middle of the desert is the last place I'd expect to see ice.

english: It's quite a surprise, isn't it, my friend. I actually have this special magic box of ice, which I bought for a princely sum, from a strange man while adventuring in lands far away. He said it is imbued with some sort of
translation: 这确实令人惊喜，对吧，朋友？其实我有个特制的魔法冰盒，是我在远方异域冒险时，从一个怪人手里花重金买来的。

english: powerful ice magic which keeps it cold all the time. I had never seen any ice magic before, it's clearly very rare and powerful, so I felt I had to buy it.
translation: 他说里面灌注了某种强大的冰系魔法，能始终保持低温。我从未见过冰系魔法，它显然既稀有又强大，所以我觉得非买不可。

english: How's business, now that the curse has gone?
translation: 诅咒解除后生意怎么样？

english: Ohh as good as ever. The people of Nardah seem to have taken well to the taste of chocolate and iced cream combined and, with the curse gone, all my friends are much happier too, so it's all good.
translation: 哦，一如既往的好。那尔达城的人民似乎很喜欢巧克力和冰淇淋结合的味道，而且诅咒解除后，我的朋友们也都开心多了，所以一切都好。

english: Cool I'd like to buy some.
translation: 酷，我想买一些。

english: No thanks, I'm not interested.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我没兴趣。

english: How do you stop your icy snacks melting?

english: How's business, now that the curse has gone?
translation: 诅咒解除后生意怎么样？

english: Oh, hello... do I know you?
translation: 哦，你好……我认识你吗？

english: Ehm... well... my name is [player name], if that rings any bell?
translation: 嗯……这个……我叫 [player name]，这有没有让你想起什么？

english: No, never heard of you.
translation: 不，从没听说过你。

english: Can you leave me alone please? I'm trying to study.
translation: 能请你别打扰我吗？我正在着学习呢。

english: Hello there. What are you doing here?
translation: 你好。你在这里做什么？

english: I'm waiting here hoping that someone can guide me to the Paterdomus, the temple on the Salve.
translation: 我在这里等候，盼着有人能指引我去帕特多穆斯，那座位于萨尔韦河上的神庙。

english: Where is Paterdomus?
translation: 帕特多穆斯在哪？

english: Oh, Paterdomus is that rather impressive looking temple on the Salve... I'm sure you must have passed it on your way into Morytania.
translation: 哦，帕特多穆斯就是萨尔韦河上那座相当气派的神庙……我相信你进入莫利塔尼亚时一定路过过。

english: Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
translation: 你为什么想去帕特多穆斯？

english: I'm hoping to get back to civilisation and see what the lands of Misthalin look like.
translation: 我希望能重返文明世界，看看米斯特林王國的土地是什么样。

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Paterdomus?
translation: 如果我们在去帕特多穆斯的路上遇到敌人，你能自保吗？

english: What sort of guide are you? I'm pretty healthy, but you'll have to protect me else I'll be sure to die... Oh, I do hope you can manage that.
translation: 你是什么类型的向导？我挺健康的，但你得保护我，否则我肯定会死……哦，我真希望你能做到。

english: I can take you to Paterdomus.
translation: 我可以带你去帕特多穆斯。

english: Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: 嗯，看来你有个随从。我想若是让它独自乱跑，这趟路上恐怕会走丢。等你的随从安顿好了我们再动身。

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.

translation: 神庙徒步开始

english: Ok, which route should we take?

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

translation: 啊，所以你想给我一些补给？让我打开我的背包看看。

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than staying in Burgh de Rott.
translation: 哦，我讨厌这趟行程，但这比待在伯格德罗特镇好。

english: It's scary here...let's get going!
translation: 这里好可怕……我们走吧！

english: When are we going to get to Paterdomus?
translation: 我们什么时候能到帕特多穆斯？

english: We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on.
translation: 我们没时间站在这里闲聊；赶紧前进吧。

english: Do you visit Paterdomus often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: 你经常来帕特多穆斯吗？你似乎很熟悉这条路。

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...?

english: Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
translation: 谢谢，我会把它灌下去。

english: Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Burgh de Rott. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: 天哪！看来我们得回伯格德罗特镇了。我们过不了那座桥！

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
translation: 我相信我们能找到办法的！

translation: 放心，我们一定能找到路过去的！

translation: 天哪！看那怪物！你得自己解决那东西！

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the temple. Here's your reward.
translation: 多谢你平安把我带到神庙，这是你的报酬。

english: Rolayne Twickit gives you a reward token!
translation: 罗莱恩‧特威基特给了你一个奖励代币！

english: Where is Paterdomus?
translation: 帕特多穆斯在哪？

english: Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
translation: 你为什么想去帕特多穆斯？

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
translation: 如果我们在路上遇到敌人，你能自保吗？

english: I can take you to Paterdomus.
translation: 我可以带你去帕特多穆斯。

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

translation: 我听说朱丽叶死了。真可怕。

translation: 不过我和她的表亲处得不错。谢谢你的帮助。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Hello traveller. Have a look at my latest range of gnome fashion. Rometti is the ultimate label in gnome high society.
translation: 你好，旅行者。瞧瞧我最新的地精时尚系列。罗梅蒂可是地精上流社会的顶级品牌。

translation: 真的吗。

translation: 好吧，那看看。

translation: 虽然你找到了顾客，但你似乎没带正确的食物！你需要 [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]！

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 恐怕预制菜不行。只有手工制作的地精美食才配得上阿卢夫‧阿洛夫特的顾客。

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Rometti
translation: 你把你的 [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] 递给罗梅蒂

english: Ooh, Thank you darling.
translation: 哦，谢谢你亲爱的。

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 你有 [number] 积分可以换取免费配送代币。你可以获得 [number] 份地精美食配送。

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: 别忘了从阿卢夫‧吉安尼小那里领取你的免费配送代币。

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 你的配送太晚了！回阿卢夫小那里重新接单。你丢弃了配送箱，因为你不再需要它了。

translation: 我没时间搞时尚。

translation: 你好，欢迎来到我的派店，我能怎么帮你？

translation: 其实我可以，你看我快没货了，我没时间烤更多派。你愿意帮我烤些派吗？我会好好付你钱。

english: I'm good thanks.

translation: 我有你想要的派。

translation: 你想买些工艺装备吗？

english: Okay. Fare well on your travels.
translation: 好的。祝你旅途顺利。

english: No thanks, I've got all the Crafting equipment I need.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我有所有需要的工艺装备。

english: Let's see what you've got, then.
translation: 那看看你有什么。

english: Hey, human.
translation: 嘿，人类。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: I am Root.
translation: 我是鲁特。

english: Is that all you have to say about yourself?
translation: 你就这点自我介绍？

english: Oh well, I suppose that's enough for some people.
translation: 哦好吧，我想对有些人来说够了。

english: Tell me about this place.
translation: 跟我说说这个地方。

english: This here is Weiss. Trolls built it years ago, after we got kicked out from caves further south. Now Weiss is our home.
translation: 这里是怀斯。巨魔们多年前建的，在我们被从更南边的洞穴赶出来后。现在怀斯是我们的家。

english: We done pretty good here. Got lots of goat and wolf to eat - they taste kinda boring after all this time, but there not much other choice.
translation: 我们在这里过得不错。有很多山羊和狼吃——这么久之后味道有点无聊，但没太多其他选择。

english: Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it. In fact My Arm is an expert on growing the stuff.
translation: 试过痛风草吗？我认识喜欢它的巨魔。事实上''我的手臂''是种这东西的专家。

english: Never heard of no gouty weed, no. But it sound like a vegetable, an' Mother not like eating those, so we probably not gonna try it.
translation: 没听说过什么痛风草，没。但听起来像蔬菜，母亲不喜欢吃那些，所以我们可能不会试。

english: Mother not like new ideas much, but he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: 母亲不太喜欢新主意，但他真的很大，他是老大，所以我们听他的。

english: I see.
translation: 我明白了。

english: Do you like it here?
translation: 你喜欢这里吗？

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it our home. Odd Mushroom say he can make it nicer with fancy fires what he invented, but Mother not interested in that, so Odd Mushroom not allowed to do it.
translation: 呃，有点粗糙，但这是我们的家。奇特蘑菇说他可以用他发明的花哨火让它更好看，但母亲对此没兴趣，所以奇特蘑菇不被允许做。

english: Mother only care about stuff to help him fight better. An he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: 母亲只关心帮他打得更好的东西。而且他真的很大，他是老大，所以我们听他的。

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我走了。

english: Hey, friend of Snowflake!
translation: 嘿，雪花的朋友！

english: It great here, now Snowflake an' her husband troll taught us goutweed farming. Food so much better now.
translation: 这里很好，现在雪花和她丈夫巨魔教了我们痛风草种植。食物现在好多了。

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it getting better. Snowflake, she taught us goutweed farming. Goat, wolf, human all taste so much nicer with goutweed in.
translation: 呃，有点粗糙，但正在变好。雪花，她教了我们痛风草种植。山羊、狼、人类，加了痛风草后味道都好多了。

english: So yeah, Weiss is good place to live, now Snowflake in charge. All trolls like Snowflake. Her husband troll kinda weird, but that not our problem.
translation: 所以是的，怀斯是个居住的好地方，现在雪花负责。所有巨魔都喜欢雪花。她丈夫巨魔有点怪，但那不是我们的问题。

translation: 嗯也许如果我出合适的价格？

english: Not a hope. Could you imagine the mess there'd be if people were constantly zooming through Al Kharid and Pollnivneach? It would be chaos. This way, we can keep the carpet traffic outside towns and other busy places.
translation: 没希望。你能想象如果人们不断穿梭于阿尔卡里德城和波尼尼镇会有多乱吗？那会是混乱。这样，我们可以让魔毯交通保持在城镇和其他繁忙区域之外。

english: I suppose getting stuck in a carpet jam could get a bit tiresome.
translation: 我想被困在魔毯堵塞里会有点烦人。

english: Just think of the friction burns you would get if you were in a carpet crash.
translation: 想想如果你在魔毯事故中会受到的摩擦烧伤。

english: Tell me about the enterprise then.
translation: 那跟我说说企业。

english: It's quite simple really, Ali Morrisane has hired myself and a few others to set up carpet stations at some of the desert's more populated places and run flights between the stations.
translation: 其实很简单，阿里‧莫里桑雇了我和其他人一些人在沙漠一些人口较多的地方建立魔毯站并在站间运行航班。

english: So why has he limited the service to just the desert?
translation: 那他为什么把服务限制在沙漠？

english: I don't think Ali is prepared to take on Gnome Air just yet, their gliders are much faster than our carpets, besides that I think we are in the short haul business, something that would only work in harsh conditions like
translation: 我想阿里还没准备好对抗地精航空，他们的滑翔机比我们的魔毯快得多，此外我想我们是做短途业务，

english: the desert.
translation: 只有在像沙漠这样恶劣条件下才有效。

english: Why is that?
translation: 这是为什么？

english: I suppose because people would just walk. Getting lost isn't too much of a problem generally, but it's a different matter when you're in the middle of the Kharidian desert with a dry waterskin and no idea
translation: 我想因为人们会直接走路。迷路通常不是大问题，但当你在卡瑞迪安沙漠深处，带着空水袋又不知该往哪走时，

english: which direction to go in.
translation: 情况就完全不同了。

english: You're right I guess. How's the business going then?
translation: 我想你是对的。那生意怎么样？

english: Not too bad, the hubs are generally quite busy. But the stations in Uzer and the Bedabin camp could do with a bit more traffic.
translation: 不错，枢纽通常很忙。但乌泽和贝达宾营地的站点需要更多流量。

english: A growth market I guess.
translation: 我想是个增长市场。

english: I have some questions.
translation: 我有些问题。

english: I'll try to help you as much as I can.
translation: 我会尽力帮你。

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Well this is a good position for desert traffic. Shantay seems to have a nice little money spinner setup, but I reckon, this could turn out even better.
translation: 嗯这是沙漠交通的好位置。沙泰似乎有个不错的小赚钱设置，但我想，这可能变得更好。

english: You mightn't realise it, but this is quite a busy station.
translation: 你可能没意识到，但这是个相当繁忙的站点。

english: Who would want to come here?
translation: 谁会想来这里？

english: Well you for one, and besides that we get quite a few archaeologists from the dig site passing through to examine the golem.
translation: 嗯你就是一个，此外我们有不少来自挖掘现场的考古学家路过检查魔像。

english: Well besides the obvious - looking after this station, I'm trying to figure out how these Tentis manage to cultivate such delicious pineapples.
translation: 嗯除了明显的——照看这个站点，我正试着弄清楚这些滕蒂人怎么种出这么好吃的菠萝。

english: Well Pollnivneach is the ideal location for setting up a carpet station.
translation: 嗯波尼尼镇是建立魔毯站的理想位置。

english: Why's that?
translation: 为什么？

english: You see it's located halfway between Al Kharid, and the Menaphite cities and close enough to Nardah too, so we get more than enough traffic to keep the business running.
translation: 你看它位于阿尔卡里德城和梅纳菲特城市中间，离那尔达城也够近，所以我们有足够的流量维持业务运行。

english: I work here renting out magic carpets. I'm from Pollnivneach so it is a handy job, I don't have to commute too far to work every day.
translation: 我在这里工作出租魔毯。我来自波尼尼镇所以这是份方便的工作，我每天不用通勤太远。

english: So I suppose you're called Ali then.
translation: 那我想你叫阿里。

english: Not the most remarkable of names, not that it matters, you see everyone in town knows me as Flash.
translation: 不是最显著的名字，不过这没关系，你看城里人都叫我Flash。

english: Really?
translation: 真的？

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: Oh right.
translation: 哦对。

english: Well I'd preferred to have been running one of the carpet stations at a hub such as Pollnivneach. I was a bit slow off the mark to get that gig though. Still business in Nardah isn't bad for a terminal. At least
translation: 嗯我更喜欢在像波尼尼镇这样的枢纽运营魔毯站之一。不过我动作慢了半拍，没抢到那份差事。尽管如此那尔达城的业务对于终点站来说不错。

english: people come here for the bank and to see the herbalist.
translation: 至少人们来这里是为了银行和看草药学家。

english: I look after the carpet station here. The place is a bit dead though. Ha! I'm just too much.
translation: 我照看这里的魔毯站。不过这地方有点冷清。哈！我只是太幽默了。

english: What?
translation: 什么？

english: You know, Sophanem, city of the dead and all that?
translation: 你知道，索法尼恩城，死者之城之类的？

english: Aw come on, the joke wasn't that bad.
translation: 哎拜托，这笑话也没那么差吧。

english: Until recently I was looking after one of the busiest carpet stations. But that all changed since Menaphos closed its gates.
translation: 直到最近我还在照看最繁忙的魔毯站之一。但自从梅纳菲斯关闭大门后一切都变了。

english: Right now I have to fill my day trying to come up with reasons why Ali M should keep this place open.
translation: 现在我得填满时间想出为什么阿里 M 应该保持这里开放的理由。

english: So have you come up with any good ideas then?
translation: 那你想出什么好主意了吗？

english: Not really. The only reason I have come up with to date is that by keeping the station open, people become familiar with it.
translation: 没有。到目前为止我想出的唯一理由是保持站点开放，人们会熟悉它。

english: Maybe once Menaphos opens her gates again, the station will make a fortune once more.
translation: 也许一旦梅纳菲斯再次打开大门，站点会再次发财。

english: Is that your pet monkey nearby?
translation: 那是你的宠物猴子吗？

english: He's his own monkey, he does whatever suits him, a total nuisance.
translation: 他是他自己的猴子，他做适合他的事，完全是个麻烦。

english: I detect a degree of hostility being directed towards the monkey.
translation: 我察觉到对猴子有一定程度的敌意。

english: I shouldn't say this really, but sometimes I begin to question some of Ali Morrisane's ideas, he says that associating a monkey with any product will increase sales. I just don't know, what will be next?
translation: 我真不该说这个，但有时我开始质疑阿里‧莫里桑的一些主意，他说把猴子和任何产品关联会增加销量。我就是不知道，下一个会是什么？

english: Frogs?
translation: 青蛙？

english: I doubt it, amphibians don't have the same cutesy factor as monkeys.
translation: 我怀疑，两栖动物没有猴子同样的可爱因素。

english: I'm confused. I thought you didn't like monkeys.
translation: 我困惑了。我以为你不喜欢猴子。

english: I don't dislike monkeys, it's just that monkey. I don't know, I might just be paranoid but I think he's... well... evil.
translation: 我不是不喜欢猴子，只是那只猴子有问题。我不知道，我可能只是多疑但我觉得他是……嗯……邪恶的。

english: Hmmm... Interesting.
translation: 嗯……有趣。

english: Hang on a minute, I think I have an amulet of monkeyspeak stored somewhere. Perhaps I could get it and see what it has to say for itself.
translation: 等一下，我想我有个猴语护符存放在某处。也许我能拿到它看看它自己说什么。

english: Would you? It sometimes gives me these stares...~A visible shiver runs down his back.
translation: 你会吗？它有时那样盯着我……(一阵明显的寒颤顺着他的背脊流下)

english: I would be really grateful if you could get that monkey off my back.
translation: 如果你能把那只猴子从我背上弄走我会非常感激。

english: Hang on a second, I have an amulet of monkeyspeak in my bag, perhaps I could have a word with him.
translation: 等一下，我包里有个猴语护符，也许我能跟他说句话。

english: Where did you get that hat?
translation: 你从哪得到那帽子？

english: My fez? I got it from Ali Morrisane, it's a uniform of sorts, apparently it makes us more visible, but I'm not too sure about it.
translation: 我的菲斯帽？我从阿里‧莫里桑那里得到的，算是某种制服，据说能让我们更显眼，但我不太确定。

english: Well it is quite distinctive.
translation: 嗯它很独特。

english: Do you like it? I haven't really made my mind up about it yet. You see it's not all that practical for desert conditions.
translation: 你喜欢吗？我还没真正决定。你看它对沙漠条件不太实用。

english: How so?
translation: 怎么说？

english: Well it doesn't keep the sun out of my eyes and after a while sitting out in the desert they really begin to burn.
translation: 嗯，它挡不住阳光刺眼，在沙漠里坐一会儿后眼睛真的会开始灼痛。

english: Come back anytime.
translation: 随时回来。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: I want to travel to Uzer.
translation: 我想去乌泽。

english: I want to travel to the Bedabin Camp.
translation: 我想去贝达宾营地。

english: I want to travel to Pollnivneach.
translation: 我想去波尼尼镇。

english: I don't want to travel to any of those places.
translation: 我不想去那些地方。

english: That sounds good, take me there.
translation: 听起来不错，带我去那里。

english: I don't want to travel there.
translation: 我不想去那里。

english: Take me there.
translation: 带我去那里。

english: Take me to the Pass then.
translation: 那带我去通道。

english: I want to travel to Nardah.
translation: 我想去那尔达城。

english: I want to travel to Menaphos.
translation: 我想去梅纳菲斯。

english: I want to travel to Sophanem.
translation: 我想去索法尼恩城。

english: Let's go then.
translation: 那我们走吧。

english: Pollnivneach will do.
translation: 波利尼切克就行。

english: Tell me about Ali Morrisane.
translation: 跟我讲讲阿里‧莫里森。

english: Tell me about this magic carpet fleet.
translation: 跟我讲讲这支魔法飞毯舰队。

english: Tell me about how the carpet works.
translation: 跟我讲讲飞毯是怎么运作的。

english: Tell me about the enterprise then.
translation: 那就跟我讲讲这个企业吧。

english: I have some questions.
translation: 我有些问题。

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Is that your pet monkey nearby?
translation: 那边那是你的宠物猴子吗？

english: Where did you get that hat?
translation: 你那帽子从哪来的？

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Ahoy there, sailor! Can't stop to talk right now, I'm afraid. You'll need to come back later.
translation: 喂，水手！恐怕我现在不能停下聊天。你得稍后再来。

english: You need to complete the Pandemonium quest to fully access the Sailing skill.
translation: 你需要完成潘德莫尼姆号任务才能完全访问航海技能。

english: Ahoy there, sailor, and welcome to the Storm Tempor!
translation: 喂，水手，欢迎来到风暴坦普尔！

english: Welcome? This place doesn't look very welcoming to me.
translation: 欢迎？这地方看起来可不太友好。

english: What do you mean? We've got the fresh sea breeze, the spray of the ocean water, a supply of the finest rum around, and one of the fiercest storms in Gielinor to contend with.
translation: 你什么意思？我们有清新的海风、飞溅的海水、周围最好的朗姆酒供应，还有基利诺尔最猛烈的风暴要应对。

english: What's not to love?
translation: 有什么不喜欢的？

english: Yeah, it's contending with that storm that worries me.
translation: 是啊，应对那场风暴让我担心。

english: Aye, it's true that the storm's bested many a sailor around these parts. Still, that's what makes things so exciting! We Barracudas live for the rush, and we trust that our skills will save us from a trip to the locker.
translation: 是的，这场风暴确实打败了这片海域的许多水手。不过，那正是让事情如此刺激的原因！我们梭鱼俱乐部为这种刺激而活，我们相信自己的技能能让我们免于葬身海底。

english: But why? Could you not just take the safer route around the storm?
translation: 但为什么？你们就不能走风暴周围更安全的路线吗？

english: Well, you see, there's value in sailors with skills like ours. Most common folk would think like you and avoid the storm, but that takes time, and as them merchants say, 'time is money.'
translation: 嗯，你看，像我们这样有技能的水手是有价值的。大多数普通人会像你一样避开风暴，但那需要时间，正如那些商人所说，''时间就是金钱''。

english: But that's where we come in! Those merchant folk sail up to the south end of the storm, drop off their shipments to one of our boats down there and we make sure it gets up to the Pandemonium!
translation: 但这就是我们的用武之地！那些商人航行到风暴南端，把货物交给我们的船，我们确保货物运到潘德莫尼姆号！

english: I see. That does make sense, but what's in it for you guys?
translation: 我明白了。那确实有道理，但你们能得到什么？

english: Why, the thrill of the sport! Sailing isn't just about going places, it's about mastery of the boat, the pull of the sails, the feeling of the helm in your hand and the taste of rum in your mouth!
translation: 当然是运动的刺激感！航海不仅仅是去某个地方，而是掌握船只、感受帆的拉力、手中舵的感觉和口中朗姆酒的味道！

english: Sailing as a sport? How does that work? What are the rules?
translation: 航海作为运动？那是怎么运作的？规则是什么？

english: Fancy getting involved, do you? Well, we Barracudas have trials set up all across the sea where you can test your mettle against the clock. I'm in charge of this here trial, the Tempor Tantrum.
translation: 想参与进来，是吧？嗯，我们梭鱼俱乐部在海上各处设置了试炼，你可以与时间较量。我负责这个试炼，叫坦普尔狂怒。

english: The objective of this trial is to collect rum shipments and bring them here. To do so, work your way around Tempoross Cove, towards our boat to the south.
translation: 这个试炼的目标是收集朗姆酒货运并带回此处。要做到这一点，绕着海灵湾航行，前往我们南边的船。

english: While you're out there, keep an eye out for any lost supplies. You'll need to collect all of them to complete the trial.
translation: 航行途中，请留意任何散落的补给品。你需要收集全部补给品才能完成试炼。

english: Sailing over rapids will give you a burst of speed! Try to go over as many as you can. The more rapids you go through in quick succession, the faster you'll go!
translation: 冲过急流会让你的船速爆发！尽量多过一些。你连续通过的急流越多，你的速度就越快！

english: The storm isn't going to make it easy for you. Those storm clouds are a nasty piece of work and they'll slow your boat down if they hit you.
translation: 风暴不会让你轻松过关。那些风暴云可不好对付，如果被它们袭击，你的船速肯定会减慢。

english: Keep a close eye on them. If they are growing in size, that means they are about to strike. However, don't let your guard down once they do, as they always strike twice!
translation: 密切关注它们。如果它们在变大，那就意味着它们即将发动攻击。不过，一旦它们攻击后也不要放松警惕，因为它们总是会攻击两次！

english: As you make your way around, don't forget your objective. You need to keep picking up lost supplies on routeto our southern boat.
translation: 当你绕行时，别忘了你的目标。你需要在前往我们南边船的路线上不断拾取丢失的补给品。

english: Once you reach the boat, collect a shipment of rum from it and then make your way back here.
translation: 一旦到达船那里，从船上收集一批朗姆酒货物，然后返回这里。

english: Make sure you come back the opposite side of Tempoross Cove to the way you went, otherwise you're going to end up missing some lost supplies.
translation: 确保你从海灵湾的另一侧返回，否则你会错过一些丢失的补给品。

english: If you can deliver all the rum shipments and collect all the lost supplies in the time given, you'll be awarded a Barracuda rank!
translation: 如果你能在规定时间内交付所有朗姆酒货物并收集所有丢失的补给品，你将获得梭鱼队等级！

english: Each trial has three ranks: Swordfish, Shark or Marlin. Each rank is harder than the last.
translation: 每个试炼有三个等级：剑鱼、鲨鱼或马林鱼。每个等级都比前一个更具挑战性。

english: For this trial, you'll be asked to fetch additional rum shipments and collect even more lost supplies as the rank increases.
translation: 对于这个试炼，随着等级提升，你将被要求运送额外的朗姆酒货物并收集更多的丢失补给品。

english: You can't attempt the next rank until you beat the one before it. You can also try unranked if you'd like to warm up beforehand.
translation: 你必须先通过前一个等级，才能尝试下一个等级。如果你想先热身，也可以尝试无等级模式。

english: That said, with your Sailing experience I'd suggest sailing elsewhere for now and coming back when you've learned a thing or two.
translation: 话虽如此，以你目前的航海经验，我建议你先去别处练习，等有所提升后再回来挑战。

english: Thanks for the advice, I'll bear that in mind.
translation: 谢谢建议，我会记住的。

english: I see. Do you have any tips or tricks for me?
translation: 我明白了。你有什么技巧或窍门给我吗？

english: Sure do, sailor!
translation: 当然有，水手！

english: First up, you're going to need a boat with at least an oak mast built in order to withstand the storm. Your boat's as good as a goner without that.
translation: 首先，你的船需要至少安装橡木桅杆，才能抵御风暴。没有那个，你的船就完蛋了。

english: Second, your boat will also need to have at least an iron helm to withstand the rapids, but provided you can withstand them, they'll provide a burst of speed to your boat.
translation: 其次，你的船还需要至少安装铁舵才能抵御急流，但只要你能承受住，急流反而会让你的船速爆发。

english: Third, avoid them lightning clouds! Even with a strong mast they'll still slow you down.
translation: 第三，避开那些闪电云！即使有坚固的桅杆，它们仍然会让你减速。

english: Fourth, keep your sails trimmed to gain even more speed. This aintno shipwreck salvaging. Go fast or go home!
translation: 第四，保持帆的调整以获得更多速度。这可不是打捞沉船。要么全速前进，要么打道回府！

english: Finally, watch out for those rocks. Hitting them will kill all of your boatsmomentum immediately.
translation: 最后，小心那些岩石。一旦撞上，你的船会立刻失去所有动力。

english: Thanks for the advice. I'll bear that in mind.
translation: 谢谢建议。我会记住的。

english: I'd like to attempt the Tempor Tantrum.
translation: 我想尝试坦普尔狂怒。

english: You should make sure your helm is manned before starting the trial.
translation: 在开始试炼前，你应该确保你的舵有人操作。

english: For this Barracuda Trial you are not allowed to bring any crewmates.
translation: 对于这个梭鱼队试炼，你不允许带任何船员。

english: Can you help me transfer my crew away?
translation: 你能帮我把船员转移走吗？

english: Yes, I suppose so.
translation: 是的，我想可以。

english: I'll come back another time.
translation: 我改天再来。

english: Can you tell me about the Tempor Tantrum?
translation: 能跟我讲讲坦普尔狂怒吗？

english: Well, you see, there's value in sailors with skills like ours. Most common folk would avoid the storm, but that takes time, and as them merchants say, 'time is money.'
translation: 嗯，你看，像我们这样有技能的水手是有价值的。大多数普通人会避开风暴，但那需要时间，正如那些商人所说，''时间就是金钱''。

english: That's where we come in! Those merchant folk sail up to the south end of the storm, drop off their shipments to one of our boats down there and we make sure it gets up to the Pandemonium!
translation: 但这就是我们的用武之地！那些商人航行到风暴南端，把货物交给我们的船，我们确保货物运到潘德莫尼姆号！

english: And what do I need to do during the trial?
translation: 那我在试炼中需要做什么？

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: The name's Ralph, Rum-Dashed Ralph. I'm a trial master for the Barracudas and I've been tasked with overseeing our operation over here by Storm Tempor.
translation: 我叫拉尔夫，朗姆酒拉尔夫。我是梭鱼俱乐部的试炼大师，风暴坦普尔指派我负责监督我们在这里的行动。

english: Are there any benefits to being a trial master?
translation: 当试炼大师有什么好处吗？

english: Plenty! Nothing brings a smile to my face quite like seeing a young budding sailor work at their skills and prove themselves capable of overcoming the storm.
translation: 很多！没有什么比看到年轻有潜力的水手努力提升技能、证明自己有能力战胜风暴更让我开心的了。

english: Not to mention, the free rum recovered while doing the trial doesn't go amiss either!
translation: 更不用说，试炼中回收的免费朗姆酒也不错！

english: What about those that fail?
translation: 那些失败的人呢？

english: I wish them a safe journey to the locker.
translation: 我祝他们一路平安，早日安息。

english: Who are the Barracudas?
translation: 梭鱼俱乐部是什么？

english: We're only the fastest, most competent, most skilled and good looking sailors to sail the seas! Our motto is 'Anyone from anywhere as long as they can sail.'
translation: 我们可是海上最快、最能干、最熟练、最帅气的航海好手！我们的座右铭是''只要能航海，来自哪里都可以''。

english: Our goal is to work together and teach anyone willing the skills required to be a master sailor capable of overcoming anything.
translation: 我们的目标是共同努力，教导任何愿意学习的人成为能够克服一切的大师级水手所需的技能。

english: Can I become a Barracuda?
translation: 我能成为梭鱼队成员吗？

english: Haha! That's the spirit! Of course you can, but only once you prove yourself in our trials. There's a bunch of trial masters like me scattered across the seas. Best our trials and earn your spot in our ranks.
translation: 哈哈！就是这种精神！当然可以，但只有你在我们的试炼中证明自己才行。像我这样的试炼大师散布在海上各处。通过我们的试炼，赢得你在我们队伍中的位置。

english: I'd best be off.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: Do you have any tips or tricks for me?
translation: 你有什么技巧或窍门给我吗？

english: Fourth, keep your sails trimmed to gain even more speed. This aint no shipwreck salvaging. Go fast or go home!
translation: 第四，保持帆的调整以获得更多速度。这可不是打捞沉船。要么全速前进，要么打道回府！

english: Finally, watch out for those rocks. Hitting them will kill all of your boats momentum immediately.
translation: 最后，小心那些岩石。一旦撞上，你的船会立刻失去所有动力。

english: Do I have any rewards to claim?
translation: 我有什么奖励可以领取吗？

english: Sorry, but I don't have anything for you at the moment.
translation: 抱歉，但我现在没有什么给你的。

english: That's everything I have for you. Good luck in future trials!
translation: 这就是我能给你的一切。祝你在未来的试炼中好运！

english: Woah, look at you go out there! You really surprised me with your mastery! A shark rank well earned.
translation: 哇，看看你在外面的表现！你的掌握程度真的让我惊讶！鲨鱼等级实至名归。

english: Thanks! I wasn't sure I was going to make it in time.
translation: 谢谢！我不确定我能否按时完成。

english: It's not often I see a sailor come through here with such promise. Here, I'll treat you to a drink on me. My speciality, the whirlpool surprise!
translation: 我不常看到这么有前途的水手来这里。来，我请你喝一杯。我的特色菜，漩涡惊喜！

english: It's made from rum, fresh bananas, more rum, some sugar cane, and here's the surprise... even more rum!
translation: 它以朗姆酒、新鲜香蕉、再加朗姆酒、少许甘蔗调制而成，惊喜来了……还是朗姆酒！

english: If you fancy some more, have a word with Steve Beanie over at the Pandemonium. I'll send word to let you have access to his premium selection, for a price of course.
translation: 如果你想再来一些，去潘德莫尼姆号找史蒂夫‧比尼谈谈。我会传话让你有机会获得他的高级精选，当然得付钱。

english: Thanks! Do I have any more rewards to claim?
translation: 谢谢！我还有什么奖励可以领取吗？

english: I'd like to attempt the Tempor Tantrum.
translation: 我想尝试坦普尔狂怒。

english: Can you help me transfer my crew away?
translation: 你能帮我把船员转移走吗？

english: I'll come back another time.
translation: 我改天再来。

english: Can you tell me about the Tempor Tantrum?
translation: 能跟我讲讲坦普尔狂怒吗？

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Who are the Barracudas?
translation: 梭鱼俱乐部是什么？

english: I'd best be off.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: Do you have any tips or tricks for me?
translation: 你有什么技巧或窍门给我吗？

english: Do I have any rewards to claim?
translation: 我有什么奖励可以领取吗？

english: More options...
translation: 更多选项……

english: Previous options...
translation: 上一个选项……

english: Would you like to try some fine Miscellanian ale, Your Royal Highness?
translation: 殿下，你想尝尝优质的米斯凯尼亚啤酒吗？

english: Well, I say Miscellanian, but it's actually brewed on the mainland.
translation: 嗯，我说是米斯凯尼亚国，但实际上是在大陆酿造的。

english: Would you like to try some anyway?
translation: 你还是想尝尝吗？

english: Yes, please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No, thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: What's it like living down here?
translation: 住在这里感觉怎么样？

english: Business is booming!
translation: 生意兴隆！

english: Now, if only I hadn't taken a loss with the beer I sold to those teenagers.
translation: 现在，要是我没在卖给那些青少年的啤酒上亏本就好了。

english: The dwarves living down here spend a lot of time and money in my inn.
translation: 住在这里的矮人在我的旅馆花了很多时间和钱。

english: One of them's been in here all day, and only bought one pint.
translation: 其中一个整天待在这里，只买了一品脱。

english: Could you ask him to at least order another drink?
translation: 你能让他至少再点一杯吗？

english: I'll see what I can do.
translation: 我看看能做什么。

english: Yes, please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No, thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: What's it like living down here?
translation: 住在这里感觉怎么样？

english: Pay-dirt!
translation: 发财了！

english: Ow!
translation: 哎哟！

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Good day, your Royal Highness.
translation: 你好，殿下。

english: Here, solve this.
translation: 给，解决这个。

english: Runolf hands you a puzzlebox!
translation: 鲁诺尔夫递给你一个谜题盒！

english: That doesn't look solved to me.
translation: 在我看来这还没解开。

english: Well done [player name]. Here you go.
translation: 干得好 [player name]。给你。

english: You've been given a [new clue/casket]!
translation: 你获得了一个 [新线索/箱子]！

english: Oh, leave an old dwarf in peace will you?
translation: 哦，让一个老矮人安静会儿行吗？

english: Why, what's wrong?
translation: 怎么了，出什么事了？

english: Ninentyyears down in the mines, and this is all I got out of it. All my life wasted away.
translation: 在矿下干了九十年，这就是我的全部收获。我的一生都浪费了。

english: You've still got a nice house, don't you?
translation: 你还有个好房子，对吧？

english: A crummy old house in East, that's all my life amounts to.
translation: 东区一栋破旧的老房子，这就是我的一生。

english: I'll leave you alone then.
translation: 那我不打扰你了。

english: Hello there!
translation: 你好啊！

english: I say! Where on Gielinor did that voice come from?
translation: 我说！基利诺尔哪个地方传来那个声音的？

english: Uh...hello there! Can you hear me?
translation: 呃……你好！你能听到我说话吗？

english: Why yes. Yes I can. My word. Is that...is that one of the gods? Guthix perhaps? Saradomin?
translation: 当然能。是的，当然能。我的天。那是……那是哪位神？古斯吗？萨拉多明？

english: No, no. I'm not either of them.
translation: 不，不。我不是他们中的任何一个。

english: Egad! You're not...Zamorak...are you? I mean, uh...begging your pardon of course, my Lord. No offence intended!
translation: 天哪！你不是……扎莫拉克……对吧？我是说，呃……当然请求你的原谅，大人。无意冒犯！

english: Ha ha! No, I'm speaking to you through the pipe here! I'm at the bottom of your tower.
translation: 哈哈！不，我是通过这里的管道跟你说话！我在你塔的底端。

english: Oh. Oh I see! Oh, yes. How clever! Remarkable idea! How ever did you think of that? Good show, old bean!
translation: 哦。哦我明白了！哦，是的。真聪明！了不起的想法！你怎么想到的？干得好，老伙计！

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Rupert the Beard. At your service, old fruit.
translation: 胡子鲁珀特。为你效劳，老伙计。

english: Rupert the Beard?
translation: 胡子鲁珀特？

english: Yes, old turnip. On account of my wonderfully long bearded chin, you see.
translation: 是的，老伙计。因为我那出奇长的胡子下巴，你看。

english: So what are you doing up there exactly? And how come you talk so strangely?
translation: 那你到底在上面做什么？还有你怎么说话这么奇怪？

english: What am I doing? Well, I guess I'm stuck in a matter of speaking. Dear me, yes! I'm stuck. And I speak in the King's speech, I'll have you know.
translation: 我在做什么？嗯，我想从某种意义上说我被困住了。天哪，是的！我被困住了。而且我用的是王室腔调说话，这你可得知道。

english: Really? Which king?
translation: 真的吗？哪个国王？

english: Which K...? Why, THE King old spud! THE King! Only one worth mentioning in my opinion.
translation: 哪个国……？当然是 THE 国王，老伙计！THE 国王！在我看来只有这一个值得一提。

english: Hey, you're not related to Sir Tiffy by any chance are you?
translation: 嘿，你不会和蒂菲爵士有什么关系吧？

english: What? That namby pamby nincompoop? Not on your nelly! More fluff in the ears than sense, that man!
translation: 什么？那个软弱无能的蠢货？绝对没有！那家伙耳朵里的绒毛都比脑子多！

english: I see. Well is there anything I can do to help you up there?
translation: 我明白了。那上面有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: Hmmm. No, no, I can't think of anything at the moment. I'm a bit stuck. Let me know if you get any ideas though.
translation: 嗯。不，不，我现在想不出什么。我有点被困住了。不过如果你有什么想法告诉我。

english: I'll do my best!
translation: 我会尽力的！

english: Hello again, old cheesecake! Wonderful to see you.
translation: 又见面了，老伙计！很高兴见到你。

english: How are the investigations going?
translation: 调查进展如何？

english: Thanks to you freeing me, very well! I have much more to do of course, but now I am free, I can continue where I left off.
translation: 多亏你解放了我，非常好！当然我还有很多事要做，但现在我自由了，我可以继续我之前中断的工作。

english: That's great news!
translation: 那真是好消息！

english: Have you another helmet like the one you gave me?
translation: 你还有像你之前给我的那种头盔吗？

english: You might be in luck, old bellybutton fluff - I have made replacements. You could have one for 60,000 coins - for the materials, you understand.
translation: 你可能运气不错，老伙计——我已经做了替换品。你可以花60,000金币买一个——这是材料费，你懂的。

english: I don't think I can afford that, sorry.
translation: 我想我买不起，抱歉。

english: No problem! Come back and see me any time, old garters.
translation: 没问题！随时回来找我，老伙计。

english: How are the investigations going?
translation: 调查进展如何？

english: Have you another helmet like the one you gave me?
translation: 你还有像你之前给我的那种头盔吗？

english: Okay, that sounds fair.
translation: 好的，听起来很公平。

english: I don't think I can afford that, sorry.
translation: 我想我买不起，抱歉。

english: Hiya. Are you carrying anything valuable?
translation: 嘿。你身上带着什么贵重物品吗？

english: Why are you asking?
translation: 你为什么问这个？

english: Um... It's a quiz. I'm asking everyone I meet if they're carrying anything valuable.
translation: 嗯……这是个测验。我问每个遇到的人是否带着贵重物品。

english: What would you do if I said I had loads of expensive items with me?
translation: 如果我说我带了很多贵重物品你会怎么做？

english: Ooh, do you? It's been ages since anyone said they'd got anything worth stealing.
translation: 哦，你有吗？好久没人说他们有值得偷的东西了。

english: 'Anything worth stealing'?
translation: '值得偷的东西''？

english: Um... Not that I'd dream of stealing anything!
translation: 嗯……我可没想过要偷东西！

english: Well, I'll say I'm not carrying anything valuable at all.
translation: 嗯，我会说我根本没带什么贵重物品。

english: Oh, what a shame.
translation: 哦，真可惜。

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: Why won't people leave me alone?!
translation: 为什么人们不肯让我安静会儿？！

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Have you got rid of those pesky trolls yet?
translation: 你摆脱那些讨厌的食人魔了吗？

english: They will be gone soon! The Imperial Guard will use a secret way that starts from the back of the Sherpa's hut to destroy the troll camp!
translation: 他们很快就会消失！帝国卫队会使用一条从夏尔帕小屋后面开始的秘密通道摧毁食人魔营地！

english: I shall have peace again at last!
translation: 我终于可以再次安宁了！

english: If those pesky humans don't start trampling all over Death Plateau again that is!
translation: 如果那些讨厌的人类不再践踏死亡高原的话！

english: I'm afraid there's been some trouble...
translation: 恐怕出了些麻烦……

english: You told me you'd get rid of the trolls!
translation: 你告诉过我会摆脱食人魔的！

english: I'm sure the Imperial Guard will deal with them in due course.
translation: 我相信帝国卫队会在适当的时候处理他们。

english: Hmph! They'd better!
translation: 哼！他们最好如此！

english: Here! Now leave me alone!
translation: 给！现在别烦我！

english: Hi!
translation: 嗨！

english: Well. This beats doing the shopping!
translation: 嗯。这比购物有趣多了！

english: I wouldn't want to be the poor guy that has to clean up after the duels.
translation: 我可不想成为那个必须在决斗后打扫的可怜家伙。

english: Me neither.
translation: 我也是。

english: Hi!
translation: 嗨！

english: What did the skeleton say before it ate?
translation: 骷髅吃饭前说了什么？

english: I don't know?
translation: 我不知道？

english: Bone-appetit.
translation: 祝你 (骨) 胃口好。(双关)

english: Ooh. This is exciting!
translation: 哦。这真刺激！

english: Yup!
translation: 是的！

english: How can you make a very lively hankerchief?
translation: 怎么让手帕变得非常活泼？

english: Put a little boogey in it.
translation: 在里面放一点''鬼''东西。(双关)

english: Why did the skeleton burp?
translation: 骷髅为什么打嗝？

english: 'Cause it didn't have the guts to fart!
translation: 因为它没''肠子'' (胆子) 放屁！(双关)

english: My son just won his first duel!
translation: 我儿子刚赢了他的第一场决斗！

english: Congratulations!
translation: 恭喜！

english: He ripped his opponent in half!
translation: 他把对手撕成了两半！

english: That's gotta hurt!
translation: 那肯定很疼！

english: He's only 10 as well!
translation: 他才10岁！

english: You gotta start 'em young!
translation: 你得从小培养！

english: Can't you see I'm watching the duels?
translation: 你没看到我在看决斗吗？

english: I'm sorry!
translation: 抱歉！

english: Knock knock!
translation: 叩叩！

english: Who's there?
translation: 谁呀？

english: Boo.
translation: 布。

english: Boo who?
translation: 是谁？(假哭声)

english: Don't cry, it's just me!
translation: 别哭，只是我！

english: Waaaaassssssuuuuupp?!
translation: 怎~么~了？！

english: Hi! I'm here to watch the duels!
translation: 嗨！我是来看决斗的！

english: Me too!
translation: 我也是！

english: My favourite fighter is Mubariz!
translation: 我最喜欢的斗士是穆巴里兹！

english: The guy at the information kiosk?
translation: 信息亭的那个家伙？

english: Yeah! He rocks!
translation: 是的！他超厉害！

english: Takes all sorts, I guess.
translation: 我想各有所好吧。

english: Hmph.
translation: 哼。

english: Did you know they think this place dates back to the second age?!
translation: 你知道他们认为这个地方可以追溯到第二纪元吗？！

english: Really?
translation: 真的吗？

english: Yeah. The guy at the information kiosk was telling me.
translation: 是的。信息亭的那个家伙告诉我的。

english: Hi!
translation: 嗨！

english: Hi. How can I help?
translation: 嗨。我能帮什么？

english: Can you heal me?
translation: 你能治疗我吗？

english: Sorry, I'm not on duty.
translation: 抱歉，我不在值班。

english: PLEASE DON'T KILL ME!
translation: 求求你别杀我！

english: I was... looking to be healed.
translation: 我……是想来治伤的。

english: No way, I'm out of here just as soon as I've packed up my stuff!
translation: 没门，我一收拾好东西就离开这里！

english: You look healthy to me!
translation: 你看起来挺健康的！

english: Of course!
translation: 当然！

english: Do you see a lot of injured fighters?
translation: 你看到很多受伤的斗士吗？

english: Yes I do. Thankfully we can cope with almost anything. Jaraah really is a wonderful surgeon, his methods are a little unorthodox but he gets the job done.
translation: 是的我看到。谢天谢地我们几乎能应付任何情况。贾拉赫真是个了不起的外科医生，他的方法有点非传统但能完成任务。

english: I shouldn't tell you this but his nickname is 'The Butcher'.
translation: 我不该告诉你这个，但他的绰号是''屠夫''。

english: That's reassuring.
translation: 这可真让人''安心''啊。

english: Do you come here often?
translation: 你经常来这里吗？

english: I work here, so yes!
translation: 我在这里工作，所以是的！

english: You're silly!
translation: 你真傻！

english: Can you heal me?
translation: 你能治疗我吗？

english: Do you see a lot of injured fighters?
translation: 你看到很多受伤的斗士吗？

english: Do you come here often?
translation: 你经常来这里吗？

english: The High Priestess says you're to be the sacrifice instead of me. I was so looking forward to meeting Zulrah.
translation: 大祭司说你要代替我成为祭品。我一直很期待见到祖尔拉。

english: Don't you understand that I've saved your life?
translation: 你不明白我救了你的命吗？

english: In death, the nutrients of my lowly body were destined to nourish the mighty Zulrah. I would have become one with my god.
translation: 在死亡中，我卑微身体的养分注定要滋养强大的祖尔拉。我本可以与我的神合为一体。

english: Still, it is nice to live a little longer. Thank you for what you have done.
translation: 不过，能多活一会儿也不错。谢谢你所做的一切。

english: I'm sorry.
translation: 我很抱歉。

english: While I am saddened that my destiny has not been fulfilled, it is nice to live a little longer. Thank you for what you have done.
translation: 虽然我为命运未能实现而感到悲伤，但能多活一会儿也不错。谢谢你所做的一切。

english: I am the chosen one. Soon I shall meet Zulrah face-to- face, and my sacrifice shall fulfil the sacred contract that protects our tribe.
translation: 我是被选中的人。很快我将与祖尔拉面对面，我的牺牲将履行保护我们部落的神圣契约。

english: Don't you care that you're going to die?
translation: 你不在乎你要死了吗？

english: In death, the nutrients of my lowly body shall nourish the mighty Zulrah. I shall become one with my god.
translation: 在死亡中，我卑微身体的养分将滋养强大的祖尔拉。我将与我的神合为一体。

english: Can I go and confront Zulrah myself?
translation: 我能自己去面对祖尔拉吗？

english: The High Priestess has chosen me. I don't know how she decides these things, but perhaps you should ask her.
translation: 大祭司选择了我。我不知道她如何决定这些事，但也许你应该问问她。

english: I'm off.
translation: 我走了。

english: Here, solve this.
translation: 给，解决这个。

english: Sacrifice hands you a [light puzzle box/puzzlebox]!
translation: 祭品递给你一个 [光谜题盒/谜题盒]！

english: That doesn't look solved to me.
translation: 在我看来这还没解开。

english: Well done [player name]. Here you go.
translation: 干得好 [player name]。给你。

english: You've been given [a casket/a new clue]!
translation: 你获得了 [一个箱子/一个新线索]！

english: Don't you understand that I've saved your life?
translation: 你不明白我救了你的命吗？

english: I'm sorry.
translation: 我很抱歉。

english: Don't you care that you're going to die?
