translation: 让我看看你有什么。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Be careful you don't regret it.
translation: 小心你别后悔。

english: Let's see what you have.
translation: 让我看看你有什么。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: We don't get many visitors here. Are you sure you wouldn't rather be somewhere else?
translation: 我们这里访客不多。你确定不想去别的地方吗？

english: I'm happy enough here.
translation: 我在这里挺开心的。

english: Fair enough.
translation: 好吧。

english: You lost?
translation: 你迷路了？

english: I don't think so.
translation: 我想没有。

english: If you say so.
translation: 如果你这么说。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: I'm a bold adventurer.
translation: 我是个大胆的冒险者。

english: Strange place for you to be then. I doubt there's much adventurer to be had here.
translation: 那你来的地方很奇怪。我怀疑这里没什么可冒险的。

english: I wouldn't stick around if I were you. Nothing here for a tourist to be interested in.
translation: 如果我是你，我不会待在这里。这里没什么游客会感兴趣的。

english: Traveller.
translation: 旅行者。

english: Can you help me find a book I want? That snotty Arceuus Librarian won't even say hello, never mind actually helping me.
translation: 你能帮我找一本我想要的书吗？那个傲慢的阿西乌斯图书管理员连招呼都不打，更别说帮我了。

english: Sure, what book do you want?
translation: 当然，你想要什么书？

english: I think I'd like to read: '[book name]'
translation: 我想我想读：'[book name]'

english: I'll see what I can do.
translation: 我看看能做什么。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: I'm about to join the crew of a cargo ship, trading goods with the eastern lands. I hear our voyages can last for weeks, especially if the winds are slack.
translation: 我即将加入一艘货船的船员队伍，与东方土地进行货物贸易。我听说我们的航行可能会持续数周，尤其是如果风力不足的话。

english: I don't want to run out of stuff to talk about with the other sailors, so I'm doing plenty of background reading before we sail. Will you find my book, please?
translation: 我不想和其他水手聊天时没话题，所以在航行前我做了很多背景阅读。你能帮我找书吗？

english: No, sorry.
translation: 不，抱歉。

english: Have you found my book yet? '[book name]'
translation: 你找到我的书了吗？'[book name]'

english: Not yet, sorry.
translation: 还没有，抱歉。

english: It's just typical of the Arceuus snobs that their Librarian's too good to help customers like me. They ought to be grateful to you for doing her job for her.
translation: 这就是阿西乌斯势利小人的典型，他们的图书管理员太高尚了，不屑于帮助像我这样的顾客。他们应该感激你替她做了工作。

english: I'll grab you later when you're not busy helping someone else.
translation: 等你不忙帮别人的时候我再找你。

english: Thanks, I'll get on with reading it. Meanwhile, you can have this other book of mine - I won't be wanting to read it again.
translation: 谢谢，我会继续阅读它。同时，你可以拿我这本其他的书——我不想再读它了。

english: Thanks for finding the book. I'll have to think up what I need next.
translation: 谢谢你找到这本书。我得想想接下来需要什么。

english: Sure, what book do you want?
translation: 当然，你想要什么书？

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: No, sorry.
translation: 不，抱歉。

english: Welcome to the Burthorpe Games Rooms!
translation: 欢迎来到伯索普游戏室！

english: How do I play board games?
translation: 我怎么玩棋盘游戏？

english: You can challenge someone to a game anywhere in the games rooms by using the right click option. Choose the type of game and then choose the options you want such as time per move. If you want to play a particular
translation: 你可以在游戏室的任何地方通过右键选项挑战某人玩游戏。选择游戏类型，然后选择你想要的选项，如每步时间。如果你想玩特定

english: game there are challenge rooms dedicated to that game. In the challenge rooms you can see other players ranks by right clicking them, their skill will be displayed instead of their combat level. Once you have enough
translation: 游戏，有专门用于该游戏的挑战室。在挑战室中，你可以通过右键点击其他玩家查看他们的等级，他们的技能将显示而不是战斗等级。一旦你有足够的

english: experience you will be able to use the challenge rooms on the first floor! If your opponent accepts the challenge you will be taken to one of the tables in the main room where you will play your game of choice.
translation: 经验，你将能够使用一楼的挑战室！如果你的对手接受挑战，你将被带到主房间的一张桌子旁，在那里你将玩你选择的游戏。

english: Once you have finished your game you will go back to the challenge room where you can challenge again!
translation: 一旦你完成游戏，你将回到挑战室，在那里你可以再次挑战！

english: What games can I play?
translation: 我能玩什么游戏？

english: Currently we offer Draughts, Runelink, Runesquares, and Runeversi.
translation: 目前开放的游戏有：跳棋、符石四子棋、符石点格棋及符石黑白棋。

english: Draughts?
translation: 跳棋？

english: Draughts uses standard rules, apart from: a draw is declared if no piece has been taken or promoted for forty moves. To play Draughts go to the challenge room in the SW corner.
translation: 跳棋采用标准规则，唯有一点不同：若四十回合内无棋子被吃或晋升，则判和局。要玩跳棋，去西南角的挑战室。

english: Runelink?
translation: 符石四子棋？

english: Yup, you have to get four runes in row. The challenge room for Runelink is in the SE corner.
translation: 是的，你必须连成四个符石。符石四子棋的挑战室在东南角。

english: Runesquares?
translation: 符石点格棋？

english: Yes, you take it in turns to add a line with the goal of making squares. Everytime you make a square you take another turn. The challenge room for Runesquares is in the SW corner.
translation: 是的，你们轮流添加线条，目标是制作方块。每完成一个方格，便可额外获得一回合。符石点格棋的挑战室在西南角。

english: Runeversi?
translation: 符石黑白棋？

english: Yep, the aim is to have more of your runes on the board than your opponent. You can take your opponents pieces by trapping them between your own. The challenge room for Runeversi is in the SE corner.
translation: 是的，目标是在棋盘上拥有比对手更多的符石。你可以通过将对手的棋子困在你的棋子之间来夺取它们。符石黑白棋的挑战室在东南角。

english: Can I buy a drink please?
translation: 我能买杯饮料吗？

english: Certainly miss, our speciality is Asgarnian Ale, we also serve Wizard's Mind Bomb and Dwarven Stout.
translation: 当然可以，小姐，我们的特色是阿斯加尼亚麦酒，我们也供应法师心灵炸弹和矮人黑啤酒。

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！

english: How do I play board games?
translation: 我怎么玩棋盘游戏？

english: What games can I play?
translation: 我能玩什么游戏？

english: Draughts?
translation: 跳棋？

english: Runelink?
translation: 符石四子棋？

english: Runesquares?
translation: 符石点格棋？

english: Runeversi?
translation: 符石黑白棋？

english: Can I buy a drink please?
translation: 我能买杯饮料吗？

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！

english: Hello there, are you interested in buying one of my special capes?
translation: 你好，有兴趣买一件我的特殊斗篷吗？

english: What's so special about your capes?
translation: 你的斗篷有什么特别的？

english: Ahh well they make it less likely that you'll accidently attack anyone wearing the same cape as you and easier to attack everyone else. They also make it easier to distinguish people who're wearing the same cape as you
translation: 啊嗯，它们能让你不太可能误伤穿着相同斗篷的人，也更容易攻击其他人。它们还能让你更容易区分穿着相同斗篷的人

english: from everyone else. They're very useful when out in the wilderness with friends or anyone else you don't want to harm.
translation: 和其他人。当你和朋友或任何你不想伤害的人一起在荒野时，它们非常有用。

english: So would you like to buy one?
translation: 那么你想买一件吗？

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: What's so special about your capes?
translation: 你的斗篷有什么特别的？

english: Yes please!
translation: 好的，谢谢！

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Life is better with a bit of spice! Would you like to buy some for yourself?
translation: 生活加点料更美好！你想给自己买一些吗？

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: I'll give it a miss, thanks.
translation: 我就不用了，谢谢。

english: You're missing out, but fair enough.
translation: 你错过了好东西，不过好吧。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: I'll give it a miss, thanks.
translation: 我就不用了，谢谢。

english: Hey you, you here for a reason or do you just like hanging around?
translation: 嘿你，你是有事而来还是就喜欢闲逛？

english: I would like to join your crew.
translation: 我想加入你的船员队伍。

english: Well you say that now, but I wonder if you can measure up.
translation: 话是这么说，但我怀疑你能不能胜任。

english: Well, for a start off, come and see me when you don't have that thing on your head.
translation: 首先，等你头上没戴那玩意儿的时候再来找我。

english: Why can't I help out while wearing this?
translation: 为什么我戴着这个就不能帮忙？

english: I need to know you aren't a spy for the other crew, so you'll need to wear a blue bandana.
translation: 我得确定你不是其他船队的间谍，所以你得戴条蓝色头巾。

english: If you still want to join my crew then go deposit it in the deposit box and come back without anything on your head.
translation: 如果你还想加入我的船队，就去把它存进存放箱，然后头上什么都不戴再回来。

english: Hah, think that I'm going to assign you the easy tasks eh?
translation: 哈，以为我会给你分配简单的任务是吧？

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你什么意思？

english: Well, I can see you have some items in your inventory. If you want to join my crew you will need all of it free so you are able to work as hard as everyone else.
translation: 嗯，我看你物品栏里塞满了东西。想上我的船，你得把背包清空，这样才能跟其他人一样卖力干活。

english: There is a bank deposit box next to that greasy oaf Jimmy's stall, go and use it and then come back.
translation: 那个油腻蠢货吉米的摊位旁边有个银行存放箱，去用它然后回来。

english: You seem keen enough, but I have plenty of people on my crew.
translation: 你看起来挺积极，但我船队里已经有很多人啦。

english: If that idiot Dan tries to pressgang more pirates I'll be glad to even the numbers out with you though.
translation: 不过要是那个白痴丹试图强征更多海盗，我很乐意让你来凑数。

english: Ok, fair enough.
translation: 好的，好吧。

english: That's quite a nice cat. Is it yours?
translation: 那猫挺不错。是你的吗？

english: Yes, why do you ask?
translation: 是的，你为什么问？

english: I'm a bit of a cat person myself. That's why I'll have to ask you to leave it outside.
translation: 我自己也挺喜欢猫的。所以我得让你把它留在外面。

english: There's likely to be quite a lot of stuff going on fire in there, and I don't want to see it get hurt.
translation: 里面很可能会有很多着火的东西，我不想看到它受伤。

english: You cannot take your follower into the game.
translation: 你不能把你的追随者带进游戏里。

english: Heh, ok, well we'll get you sorted out. Welcome to the crew.
translation: 嘿，好吧，我们会给你安排好的。欢迎加入船队。

english: Go wait in the waiting room. I'll call you when we are ready to start.
translation: 去等候室等着。我们准备好开始时我会叫你。

english: Who are you, and what is this place?
translation: 你是谁，这是什么地方？

english: Well, well, looks like someone is fresh off the boat and no mistake!
translation: 哎呀呀，看来有个刚下船的新手，没错！

english: A little while ago we had some real problem shipping 'rum' in the island. The Braindeath crew said it had something to do with zombies and the like.
translation: 不久前我们在岛上运输''朗姆酒''遇到了大麻烦。脑死亡船员说这和僵尸之类的东西有关。

english: All the pirates on the island got together and decided to make our own still, but of course things got a little out of hand, and now we have two.
translation: 岛上所有海盗聚在一起决定造自己的蒸馏器，但当然事情有点失控，现在我们有两个了。

english: So with two stills you have plenty of 'rum' right?
translation: 所以有两个蒸馏器，你们的“朗姆酒”管够，对吧？

english: Well we would do, if that scurvy, whelk-eating foppish dog wouldn't keep trying to burn our still to the ground!
translation: 本来是的，要不是那个患坏血病、吃海螺的纨绔狗一直想把我们的蒸馏器烧成平地！

english: I say!
translation: 我说！

english: Neither of us can really corner the 'rum' market at the moment, but we are giving it our best shot.
translation: 我们目前都无法真正垄断''朗姆酒''市场，但我们都在尽力而为。

english: The code of the island says that we can't attack each other, but after consulting with our fearsome pirate lawyers, we have discovered that destroying each other's property is fine.
translation: 岛上的规矩说我们不能互相攻击，但咨询了我们可怕的海盗律师后，我们发现摧毁对方的财产是可以的。

english: Hence, that sniveling, hat-wearing cur keeps trying to burn down my still.
translation: 所以，那个流鼻涕、戴帽子的杂种一直想烧掉我的蒸馏器。

english: Of course he claims I started this whole thing, but who would trust him anyway?
translation: 当然他声称是我挑起的事端，但谁会相信他呢？

english: Can I help out?
translation: 我能帮忙吗？

english: Yes, probably. I have a bunch of jobs that need doing, if you feel up to it.
translation: 是的，大概可以。我有一堆工作需要做，如果你觉得自己能行的话。

english: What would you like to know about?
translation: 你想了解什么？

english: How do I help you brew 'Rum'?
translation: 我怎么帮你酿造''朗姆酒''？

english: Well the stills we have set up are based on the ones on Braindeath island... well roughly at any rate.
translation: 嗯我们搭建的蒸馏器是基于脑死亡岛上的那些……嗯大致上是吧。

english: All you have to do is help put the ingredients into the hoppers and keep the boilers burning.
translation: 你要做的就是帮把原料放进料斗里，并保持锅炉燃烧。

english: If you add enough ingredients to the hoppers then you have the ability to pick up a single bottle of rum when it brews.
translation: 如果你往料斗里加了足够的原料，那么酿造完成后你就有能力拿起一瓶朗姆酒。

english: So, if ye add 5 buckets of water to the hoppers, then ye get access to one bottle. If you add 3 bowls of coloured water you get access to one bottle, and if you add one of anything else you get access to one bottle.
translation: 比如加5桶水、3碗有色水，或者其他任何原料各1份，你都能得到一瓶。

english: This is cumulative, meaning that if you add (for example) 10 buckets of water, 3 sweetgrubs and 6 bowls of coloured water, then you have a chance to collect 7 bottles of rum for the team.
translation: 这是累积的，意思是如果你加(例如)10桶水、3个甜虫和6碗有色水，你就有机会为团队收集7瓶朗姆酒。

english: The boilers are easy as pie to sort out. You just put some logs in, light them with a tinderbox, and then keep putting logs in until they are good and hot.
translation: 锅炉很容易搞定。你只需放些木头进去，用火绒盒点燃，然后不断添木直到它们烧得够热。

english: Three logs should do it, but it's best to keep heaping them in just in case.
translation: 三根木头应该就够了，但最好不断堆进去以防万一。

english: The ingredients are; Bitternuts, Scrapey Tree Bark, Sweetgrubs, Buckets of Water and some Coloured Water.
translation: 原料有：苦坚果、刮树皮、甜虫、水桶和一些有色水。

english: Where can I get Bitternuts?
translation: 我在哪能得到苦坚果？

english: There are plenty of Bitternut trees inside this walled off area. The problem is that the trees are too tricky for a human to climb.
translation: 这个围墙区域内有很多苦坚果树。问题是这些树太棘手，人类爬不上去。

english: You will need to catch a monkey and send it up the tree to get the nut for you.
translation: 你需要抓一只猴子，让它上树为你取坚果。

english: Send it up the tree? How does that work?
translation: 让它上树？怎么操作？

english: Well, if you were a monkey, and some random person grabbed you, dumped some dye in your fur and shoved you up a tree, you would hurl the closest heavy object at them too.
translation: 嗯，如果你是只猴子，有个陌生人抓住你，把染料倒在你毛上然后把你推上树，你也会把最近的重物朝他们扔过去。

english: Wait a second, dye?
translation: 等一下，染料？

english: Yes, you'll need to get a bowl of coloured water and pour it on the monkey. Otherwise you won't be able to tell which team the monkey belongs too.
translation: 是的，你需要弄一碗有色水倒在猴子身上。否则你就无法分辨猴子属于哪个队伍。

english: That makes sense...I think...
translation: 有道理……我想……

english: Anything else?
translation: 还有别的吗？

english: Where can I get Scrapey tree bark...and why do I get the feeling I won't like the answer?
translation: 我在哪能得到刮树皮……为什么我有种不会喜欢答案的感觉？

english: Inside this walled area there are a few Scrapey trees. They are the big, ill looking ones, you can't miss them.
translation: 这个围墙区域内有几棵刮擦树。它们是那些看起来很大、病恹恹的树，你不会错过的。

english: Basically, you cut them down and then carve the bark off with a knife.
translation: 基本上，你把它们砍倒然后用刀刮下树皮。

english: It's pretty simple, except the sap tends so make people feel kind off ill if they get any on themselves.
translation: 挺简单的，不过树汁沾到身上会让人有点恶心不适。

english: How ill?
translation: 多不舒服？

english: Don't worry, we aren't talking deadly ill or anything.
translation: 别担心，我们不是说会致命什么的。

english: It's more like you'll feel quite dizzy and weak for a bit.
translation: 更像是你会感到有点头晕虚弱一会儿。

english: Joy...
translation: 呵呵……

english: Sweetgrubs? What are they?
translation: 甜虫？那是什么？

english: Well, lacking any sluglings in the area, we add these little grubs called Sweetgrubs. If you ignore the gag- inducing aftertaste, they are quite sweet.
translation: 嗯，由于该地区没有任何小蛞蝓，我们添加这些叫甜虫的小幼虫。如果你忽略那令人作呕的余味，它们还挺甜的。

english: How... how can you drink this stuff?
translation: 你……你怎么能喝这种东西？

english: Quite easily!
translation: 很容易！

english: Pirates are renowned as being tough for a reason.
translation: 海盗以强硬著称是有原因的。

english: So where do I get these grubs from anyway?
translation: 那我到底从哪弄这些幼虫？

english: Well, there are a few sweetgrub mounds inside there. We have a handful of rat meat that you can use on the mounds to draw the grubs to the surface.
translation: 嗯，里面有几个甜虫丘。我们有一些老鼠肉，你可以用在丘上把幼虫引到表面。

english: Mind your fingers though, they are voracious little things.
translation: 不过小心你的手指，它们是贪婪的小东西。

english: And here was me thinking that nothing could be more disgusting than Braindeath 'Rum'.
translation: 我还以为没有什么比脑死亡''朗姆酒''更恶心的了。

english: Arr, that's where ye'd be wrong [lad/lass], 'cos new, improved Braindeath 'Rum' Classic is now 200% more disgustin' than any leadin' competitor!
translation: 啊，那你可就错了 [小伙子/姑娘]，因为新的、改良的脑死亡''朗姆酒''经典版现在比任何领先竞争对手都恶心200%！

english: Legal disclaimer; the dangerous amount of disgustin' in new Braindeath 'Rum' Classic be too much for pregnant women, donkeys and anyone with more than seven letters in their last name.
translation: 法律免责声明；新脑死亡''朗姆酒''经典版中危险量的恶心成分对孕妇、驴子和姓氏超过七个字母的人来说太多了。

english: What was that?
translation: 那是什么？

english: What was what?
translation: 什么是什么？

english: Is there anything else?
translation: 还有别的吗？

english: How do I get...
translation: 我怎么得到……

english: Wait, no, that question makes me sound like I haven't a clue what I'm doing.
translation: 等等，不，那个问题让我听起来像不知道自己在做什么。

english: Where can I get buckets in there?
translation: 我在里面哪能得到桶？

english: There are a few lying about. Help yourself.
translation: 周围散落着一些。自便。

english: There is a pump in the still, so long as it's working you should have almost unlimited water.
translation: 蒸馏器里有个泵，只要它工作你就应该有几乎无限的水。

english: Hold on, do I have to add anything disgusting and/or potential lethal to the water before I pour it in?
translation: 等等，我倒水进去之前得加什么恶心和/或潜在致命的东西吗？

english: Perish the thought!
translation: 千万别这么想！

english: Ok, just checking.
translation: 好的，随口问问。

english: What sort of coloured water are we talking about here?
translation: 我们这里说的是哪种有色水？

english: Well, the other still has an area of waste ground with a flower growing on it. If you go and grab one of the flowers and jam it in the kettle, the water will boil out the colour.
translation: 嗯，另一个蒸馏器有一块荒地，上面长着一朵花。如果你去摘一朵花塞进水壶里，水会把颜色煮出来。

english: We use the colour to keep our rum easily identifiable.
translation: 我们用颜色来让我们的朗姆酒易于识别。

english: So I just empty the kettle into the hopper, right?
translation: 所以我只要把水壶倒进料斗里，对吧？

english: No, no, you'll need to take an empty bowl and fill it from the kettle.
translation: 不，不，你需要拿个空碗从水壶里装满。

english: That way you can use the stuff on a monkey if you need to.
translation: 这样如果需要的话你可以把东西用在猴子身上。

english: Use it on a monkey...of course.
translation: 用在猴子身上……当然。

english: Can I ask about something else?
translation: 我能问点别的吗？

english: Ok, what else?
translation: 好的，还有什么？

english: How do I repair the still?
translation: 我怎么修理蒸馏器？

english: Well, assuming those scurvy dogs have managed to set any of it on fire, then you'll need to tip a bucket of water on it before you can repair it.
translation: 嗯，假设那些坏血病狗设法点燃了其中任何部分，那么你需要先倒一桶水在上面才能修理。

english: Then, it all comes down to what part of it was damaged.
translation: 然后，一切都取决于哪部分被损坏了。

english: How can I repair hoppers?
translation: 我怎么修理料斗？

english: Well, assuming that they are not on fire, all you need to do is use the heavy lumber patches. They are big enough to cover most holes.
translation: 嗯，假设它们没有着火，你要做的就是使用重型木材补丁。它们足够大可以覆盖大多数洞。

english: Will I need a hammer?
translation: 我需要锤子吗？

english: No, just shove it into place and whack it until it lines up.
translation: 不，只要把它塞到位然后敲打直到对齐。

english: How do I repair pipes and the pump?
translation: 我怎么修理管道和泵？

english: Well, if you use a pipe section on the damaged part you should be able to replace it easily.
translation: 嗯，如果你把管道部分用在损坏部分上，你应该能轻松更换。

english: No, likely you'll just need to whack the old one out and slot the new one in with your hands.
translation: 不，可能你只需要把旧的敲出来然后用手把新的插进去。

english: How do I repair bridges?
translation: 我怎么修理桥梁？

english: Well, we have these handy bridge sections you can use to repair the bridges.
translation: 嗯，我们有这些方便的桥梁部分你可以用来修理桥梁。

english: The main problem is, while a still will keep working if a bit of it is only damaged, the bridges are completely out of commission if they are even slightly damaged.
translation: 主要问题是，虽然蒸馏器如果只损坏一点还能继续工作，但桥梁即使稍微损坏也会完全无法使用。

english: Is that going to be a problem? I mean, I can jump across I think.
translation: 那会有问题吗？我是说，我想我能跳过去。

english: Don't try that! Our lawyers tell us we aren't covered for injuries sustained while jumping over burned bridges.
translation: 别试！我们的律师告诉我们，跳过烧毁桥梁造成的伤害不在承保范围内。

english: Seriously, just keep off the bridges until they are fixed.
translation: 说真的，在修好之前别上桥。

english: Where do I get all this stuff anyway?
translation: 我到底从哪弄这些东西？

english: We have a load of items already on a table inside the still. You can also make new ones if you grab some logs.
translation: 我们已经在蒸馏器内的桌子上放了一堆物品。如果你拿些木头也可以制作新的。

english: How does that work?
translation: 那是怎么运作的？

english: We have a work table set up in the still. If you use the logs in it you can craft up a handy replacement for part of the still.
translation: 我们在蒸馏器里设了一个工作台。如果你在里面使用木头，你可以制作出蒸馏器部分的方便替换件。

english: Don't worry about them fitting, the things are held together by nails, replacement parts and soot by now.
translation: 别担心它们是否合适，这些东西现在是由钉子、替换件和烟灰固定在一起的。

english: Well...how sanitary...
translation: 嗯……多卫生啊……

english: Ok, I think I've heard enough.
translation: 好的，我想我听够了。

english: Fine. Glad I could help.
translation: 好吧。很高兴能帮忙。

english: So...how would I go about sabotaging the enemy still?
translation: 那么……我该怎么破坏敌人的蒸馏器？

english: Ok, here's what you need to do.
translation: 好的，这是你需要做的。

english: The wood around here is really dry and flammable, so take one of the torches, light it up, and then go and attack the enemy still with it.
translation: 这里的木头非常干燥易燃，所以拿一个火把，点燃它，然后去用它攻击敌人的蒸馏器。

english: That's it?
translation: 就这样？

english: Most of their still is soaked in 'alcohol' and made from tinder dry wood.
translation: 他们的大部分蒸馏器都浸泡在''酒精''里，并且由极干燥的木头制成。

english: Essentially, if it isn't ours, try using a torch on it and see what happens.
translation: 基本上，如果不是我们的，试着用火把烧它看看会发生什么。

english: Ok, I get you.
translation: 好的，我明白了。

english: So what will you give me for helping out?
translation: 那么你给我什么作为帮忙的报酬？

english: Hahahaha! What a mercenary attitude! You'll do fine here.
translation: 哈哈哈！多么雇佣兵的态度！你在这里会做得很好。

english: Well, for each bottle that your team produces, I'll give you onepiece of eight.
translation: 嗯，你的团队每生产一瓶，我就给你一枚金币。

english: If you manage to set something on fire then I'll toss in another, same for repairing the still.
translation: 如果你设法点燃了什么东西，我会再扔给你一枚，修理蒸馏器也一样。

english: What can I use these pieces of eight for?
translation: 我用这些金币能做什么？

english: See Honest Jimmy there? He'll trade you some pretty nice stuff for them.
translation: 看到那边的诚实吉米了吗？他会用它们跟你交换一些相当不错的东西。

english: Great!
translation: 太好了！

english: Hah!
translation: 哈！

english: This minigame is unavailable on this world.
translation: 这个世界无法进行此小游戏。

english: Sorry, I don't take anyone that can't cook.
translation: 抱歉，我不收不会做饭的人。

english: Why not?
translation: 为什么不？

english: Aside from anything else, if you have less than 40 Cooking, then you don't have much of an idea of health and safety when it comes to food.
translation: 除了别的之外，如果你的烹饪等级低于40，那么你在食品安全方面就没有太多概念。

english: Oh yeah, Saradomin forbid that the 'rum' made from whatever is lying around gets a bit of hair in it.
translation: 哦是的，萨拉多明保佑，别让用周围随便什么东西做的''朗姆酒''里混进头发。

english: Anyone lookin' fer work?

translation: 啊！找好海盗！

translation: 需要海盗来酿造！

english: You have defeated me in battle, and still you search for the source?
translation: 你在战斗中击败了我，却仍在寻找源头？

english: San Tojalon: Prepare yourself...

translation: 你证明了自己是个光荣的对手。

translation: 你今天打了一场漂亮的仗。

english: Good day to you bwana.

english: Can you ferry me to that island?
translation: 你能渡我去那个岛吗？

english: Most certainly, but my services come at a price... of 10,000 coins
translation: 当然可以，但我的服务是有代价的……10,000金币

english: I don't have that sort of money!
translation: 我没有那么多钱！

english: Then you do not belong on my island.
translation: 那你就不属于我的岛。

english: Fine!
translation: 好吧！

english: Bye bye bwana.
translation: 再见，先生。

english: Ok, here's the ridiculous sum of money...
translation: 好的，这是那笔荒谬的钱……

english: Never mind.
translation: 没关系。

english: Why so much? You'd get more business if you charged less.
translation: 为什么这么多？如果你收费少点生意会更多。

english: The price is to keep the island quiet, bwana. It's a great place to train, but competing with others can be a hassle and so, for a price, you train in peace!
translation: 这个价格是为了保持岛屿安静，先生。这是个训练的好地方，但与他人竞争可能很麻烦，所以，付了钱，你就能安心训练！

english: Most certainly, but my services come at a price... of 5,000 coins
translation: 当然可以，但我的服务是要收费的……5,000金币。

english: You pay Sandicrahb 5,000 coins and depart for Crabclaw Isle.
translation: 你付给桑迪克拉布5,000金币，出发前往蟹爪岛。

english: That's too much for me.
translation: 那对我来说太贵了。

english: Of course! I won't even charge you for the privilege.
translation: 当然！我甚至不会为此向你收费。

english: Sure.
translation: 当然。

english: Sandicrahb transports you to Crabclaw Isle for free thanks to your completion of the Kourend & Kebos Medium diary.
translation: 鉴于你完成了库兰德与凯波斯中等日记，桑迪克拉布免费将你传送至蟹爪岛。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Why bwana, I'm Sandicrahb! I travel far over the ocean from the tropical land of Karamja.
translation: 哎呀先生，我是桑迪克拉布！我从卡拉姆詹的热带土地远渡重洋而来。

english: How come you're charging so much?
translation: 你为什么收费这么高？

english: The gold is for a good cause, I promise bwana.
translation: 这些钱是为了公益事业，我保证先生。

english: Uh huh, that's a mighty fine gold necklace you have.
translation: 嗯哼，你戴的金项链可真漂亮。

english: Well bwana, of course I take a cut, but the funds keep these beaches clean and tidy, I promise!
translation: 嗯先生，我当然会抽成，但这些资金能保持海滩整洁，我保证！

english: If you say so...
translation: 既然你这么说……

english: Good day to you too.
translation: 也祝你日安。

english: That's a nice boat! Would be a shame if something were to happen to it.
translation: 这船真不错！要是哪天“不小心”出了事，可就太可惜了。

english: Made from the wood of the Fyburglars tree, strong and light weight! Perhaps if it went missing, I'd find you.
translation: 用菲伯格勒树木材制成，坚固又轻便！也许要是它不见了，我会去找你。

english: Perhaps.
translation: 也许吧。

english: Shall I return you to the beach?
translation: 要我送你回海滩吗？

english: Yes please, I'm done here.
translation: 好的谢谢，我在这里完事了。

english: Actually, I've not quite finished yet, I'll stay.
translation: 其实我还没完全结束，我会留下。

english: Very well bwana.
translation: 好吧先生。

translation: 为什么这么贵？少收点你生意会更多。

translation: 你看起来饿了。我告诉你——吃个 [food option] 算我的。

english: Hope that fills you up!
translation: 希望能填饱你肚子！

english: Hey, I didn't say you could have that!
translation: 嘿，我可没说你可以吃那个！

english: I'd best be going - lots more sandwiches to deliver!
translation: 我最好走了——还有很多三明治要送！

english: This is for [player name], not you.
translation: 这是给 [player name] 的，不是给你的。

english: Sandwiches, [player name]!
translation: 三明治，[player name]！

english: Did you hear me, [player name]?
translation: 你听到我说话了吗，[player name]？

english: Sandwich delivery for [player name]!
translation: 给 [player name] 的三明治快递！

english: You think I made these just for fun?!!?
translation: 你以为我做这些只是为了好玩？！！？

english: All types of sandwiches, [player name].
translation: 各种类型的三明治，[player name]。

english: Come on [player name], I made these specially!!
translation: 来吧 [player name]，我特意做的！！

translation: 好吧，亲爱的！再见！

english: Nice day for sand isn't it?
translation: 今天沙子生意不错，不是吗？

english: Sand is yellow, Sand is grand, Sand puts money, In my hand!
translation: 沙子黄，沙子棒，沙子把钱，放我手！

english: I'm Sandy of Sandy's Sand Corp, are you in the sand business?
translation: 我是桑迪沙业公司的桑迪，你是做沙子生意的吗？

english: Errrr... no.
translation: 呃……不是。

english: Then go away!
translation: 那走开！

translation: 我能为你做什么，小家伙？

english: So... I've heard you druids might be able to teach me herblore...
translation: 那么……我听说你们德鲁伊也许能教我草药学……

english: Herblore eh? You're probably best off talking to Kaqemeex about that; he's the best herblore teacher we currently have. I believe at the moment he's at out stone circle just North of here.
translation: 草药学嗯？你最好去找卡奎梅克斯谈谈；他是我们目前最好的草药学老师。我相信他现在就在我们北边的石圈那里。

english: Thanks.

translation: 啊，你来得正好。我需要某种草药来进行净化仪式的下一部分……

english: It used to be quite common, but nowadays only the trolls know where to find it. They use it in their cooking, you see. It's a very prized ingredient.
translation: 它曾经很常见，但现在只有巨魔知道在哪能找到它。你看，他们拿它做菜。这可是非常珍贵的食材。

english: And what exactly do you want me to do?
translation: 那你到底想让我做什么？

translation: 向北进入食人魔的领地，找到食人魔称为“痛风草”的草药的秘密。

english: My friend Eadgar lives in the area, and he may be able to help you. Bring some goutweed back and I will teach you something useful.
translation: 我的朋友埃德加住在那片区域，他也许能帮你。带些痛风草回来，我会教你些有用的东西。

english: I'll do it.

english: Actually, I don't need to speak to you.
translation: 其实，我不需要跟你说话。

english: Hey there, can you tell me something about this Sanfew Serum, like how do I make it, and what does it do?
translation: 嘿，你能和我说说这桑福药剂的事吗，比如怎么制作，它有什么用？

english: Certainly. It was after all, my creation, and mine alone. If anyone should know how to make it, it should be me!
translation: 当然。毕竟这是我的创造，只属于我。如果有人知道怎么制作，那应该是我！

english: Can't fault that logic!
translation: 这逻辑没错！

english: Ok, essentially this potion is a mixture of a cure poison, cure disease and restore stats all rolled into one! Very handy for the adventurers with an eye on conserving inventory space.
translation: 好吧，本质上这药水是解毒、治病和恢复状态的混合物，三合一！对于想节省物品栏空间的冒险者来说非常方便。

english: Ok, I'm sold... How do you make it?
translation: 好吧，我心动了……你怎么制作它？

english: Well, it's actually my loom, but I don't mind you using it, if you like. You can use it to weave sacks and baskets in which you can put vegetables and fruit.
translation: 嗯，这其实是我的织布机，但如果你愿意我不介意你用。你可以用它编织袋子和篮子来装蔬菜和水果。

english: What do I need to weave sacks?
translation: 我需要什么来编织袋子？

english: Well, the best sacks are made with jute fibres; you can grow jute yourself in a hops patch. I'd say about 4 jute fibres should be enough to weave a sack.
translation: 嗯，最好的袋子是用黄麻纤维做的；你可以在啤酒花种植地里自己种黄麻。我说大约4根黄麻纤维就够编一个袋子了。

english: Thank you, that's very kind.
translation: 谢谢你，真好。

english: What do I need to weave baskets?
translation: 我需要什么来编织篮子？

english: Well, the best baskets are made with young branches cut from a willow tree. You'll need a very young willow tree; otherwise, the branches will have grown too thick to be able to weave. I suggest growing your own.
translation: 嗯，最好的篮子是用从柳树上砍下的嫩枝做的。你需要一棵非常年轻的柳树；否则树枝会长得太粗无法编织。我建议自己种。

english: You can cut the branches with a standard pair of secateurs. You will probably need about 6 willow branches to weave a complete basket.
translation: 你可以用标准的修枝剪剪下树枝。你可能需要大约6根柳枝来编一个完整的篮子。

english: I'm okay, thank you.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

english: I've come about the bounty.
translation: 我是为了赏金而来的。

english: Oh thank Saradomin! It's about time someone responded, something needs to be done!
translation: 哦感谢萨拉多明！终于有人回应了，得做点什么！

english: Can you explain what happened?
translation: 你能解释一下发生了什么吗？

english: Of course. I was making my monthly delivery to The Sheared Ram in Lumbridge, heading east near the Draynor Village crossroads.
translation: 当然。我当时正在每月向仑桥镇的剪毛公羊酒馆送货，在德雷诺村十字路口附近向东行驶。

english: Suddenly, out of the trees came a hulking monster! It chased me for a short distance, but luckily Rosie managed to spook it enough to give me a headstart.
translation: 突然，从树林里冲出一个巨大的怪物！它追了我一小段路，但幸运的是罗西成功地吓到了它，让我得以抢先逃跑。

english: Sounds like it must have given you quite the scare!
translation: 听起来一定把你吓坏了！

english: It certainly did. I even lost my cart full of farm produce!
translation: 确实如此。我甚至丢了一整车的农产品！

english: What did this monster look like?
translation: 这个怪物长什么样？

english: I didn't get a very good look at it I'm afraid. It was getting dark and as soon as I saw it charging at me, I ran.
translation: 恐怕我没看清楚。天快黑了，我一看到它向我冲来就跑了。

english: I can still hear the sound, though. A horrible grunting... squealing...
translation: 不过我还能听到声音。可怕的咕噜声……尖叫声……

english: Is there anything else you wanted?
translation: 你还有其他想要的吗？

english: Any tips on finding this thing?
translation: 有什么找到这东西的建议吗？

english: Tips...? You're supposed to be the professional monster slayer!
translation: 建议……？你应该是专业的怪物杀手！

english: Although, I suppose a good place to start would be checking the area I was attacked. See if you can find the remains of my cart.
translation: 不过，我想一个好的起点是检查我被袭击的区域。看看你能否找到我的车的残骸。

english: Ok, yes that could work.
translation: 好的，那应该可行。

english: Whereabouts were you attacked again?
translation: 你再次被袭击的地方在哪里？

english: I remember being somewhere near the crossroads, north of Draynor Village.
translation: 我记得是在德雷诺村北边的十字路口附近。

english: Sorry that I'm not much help. It happened so fast, the whole thing is a bit of a blur.
translation: 抱歉我帮不上什么忙。发生得太快了，整件事有点模糊。

english: That's okay. Crossroads north of Draynor... At least I have somewhere to start.
translation: 没关系。德雷诺北边的十字路口……至少我有个起点。

english: You mentioned that Rosie spooked the monster. Who's that?
translation: 你提到罗西吓到了怪物。那是谁？

english: Oh, that'll be our lady over there by the fire. She's such a good dog, always accompanies me on deliveries.
translation: 哦，那是我们在那边火堆旁的女士。她真是条好狗，总是陪我送货。

english: You can pet her if you like. She's very friendly.
translation: 如果你喜欢可以摸摸她。她很友善。

english: I think that'll be all for now.
translation: 我想暂时就这些了。

english: Excellent! Best of luck to you, I'll be waiting right here with your reward.
translation: 太好了！祝你好运，我会在这里等着给你奖励。

english: That monster certainly won't be troubling you from now on.
translation: 那个怪物肯定不会再打扰你了。

english: Oh that's fantastic news! I'm so relie-
translation: 哦那太好了！我太放——

english: Wait, how do I know you're not just saying that to get the bounty?
translation: 等等，我怎么知道你不是为了拿赏金才这么说的？

english: How about this as proof?
translation: 用这个作为证明怎么样？

english: You pull the foot out of your backpack and show it to Sarah.
translation: 你从背包里拿出脚给莎拉看。

english: Eugh! Yes, that certainly looks about right!
translation: 噫！是的，那看起来确实对！

english: Indeed, the smell is... something quite special.
translation: 确实，那味道……相当特别。

english: I'll probably just give it to the dog.
translation: 我可能就把它给狗了。

english: I'm glad you made it back. Some strange woman in a hood came asking about the job shortly after you left. I didn't really want her back in here.
translation: 我很高兴你回来了。你走后不久有个戴兜帽的陌生女人来问工作的事。我真不想让她再进来。

english: Anyway, thank you so much! Here's your reward.
translation: 总之，非常感谢！这是你的奖励。

english: Sarah hands you a heavy pouch of 5,000 coins.
translation: 莎拉递给你一个装有5,000金币的沉重袋子。

english: Perhaps I should speak with Spria and tell her that the monster's been dealt with.
translation: 也许我应该和斯普里亚谈谈，告诉她怪物已经处理了。

english: This gnome lady appears to be singing ... to her toads.
translation: 这位地精女士似乎在唱歌……给她的蟾蜍听。

english: La La La, toadies in their holeys! ..Oh hello, I didn't notice you.
translation: 啦啦啦，蟾蜍在洞里！……哦你好，我没注意到你。

english: Hello, Whatdo you do here?

english: I look after the toads and worms. They are very useful in gnome cooking, don't you know.

english: Does singing to the toads help them grow?

english: Don't be silly, I just sing to pass the time while looking after them!

english: Of course...

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Sarble
translation: 你把配送的 [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] 交给萨布尔

english: Thank you kindly, you might want to grab some toads and worms while you are here.
translation: 非常感谢，你在这里时可能想拿些蟾蜍和蠕虫。

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 你有 [number] 积分可以兑换免费配送代币。你可以获得 [number] 份地精美食配送。

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: 别忘了从小阿卢夫‧吉安那里领取你的免费配送代币。

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.

english: Welcome to my store, human! Are you interested in buying anything?
translation: 欢迎来到我的商店，人类！你有兴趣买什么吗？

english: Yes, I'm looking for some armour.
translation: 是的，我在找一些盔甲。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Say, would you be interested in doing a little task for me?
translation: 嘿，你有兴趣为我做点小任务吗？

english: What do you need me to do?
translation: 你需要我做什么？

english: A special client has a little request for me. I will need [3/4/5] [item] in the next [15/20/25] minutes.
translation: 有个特殊客户对我有个小请求。我需要在接下来 [15/20/25] 分钟内拿到 [3/4/5] 个 [item]。

english: Right, I'll get you [3/4/5] [item] in the next [15/20/25] minutes. I can do that, yes.
translation: 好的，我会在接下来 [15/20/25] 分钟内给你 [3/4/5] 个 [item]。我可以做到，是的。

english: I don't have time for that, no.
translation: 我没时间做那个，不。

english: That's really unfortunate. I hope I can find someone else.
translation: 那真不幸。希望我能找到别人。

english: What's the task?

english: I'm running a low on raw supplies at the moment. In the next [X] minutes, I need [X] [item]. Sounds agreeable?
translation: 我现在原材料不足。在接下来 [X] 分钟内，我需要 [X] 个 [item]。听起来可以吗？

english: Right, I'll get you [X] [item] in the next [X] minutes. I can do that, yes.
translation: 好的，我会在接下来 [X] 分钟内给你 [X] 个 [item]。我可以做到，是的。

english: How are you doing getting me my [X] [item]?
translation: 你给我弄 [X] 个 [item] 进展如何？

english: I don't want to look for them anymore.
translation: 我不想再找了。

english: Next time, can you decide on that in advance?
translation: 下次，你能提前决定吗？

english: You've put me in a spot of trouble now. I suppose I'll find a way out though.
translation: 你现在让我陷入困境了。不过我想我会找到出路的。

english: I'm still looking for them.
translation: 我还在找。

english: Good, good. Hurry back!
translation: 好，好。快点回来！

english: Great, now the [X] minutes are up and you didn't get me [X] [item].
translation: 太好了，现在 [X] 分钟到了你没给我弄到 [X] 个 [item]。

english: Er, yeah, sorry...
translation: 呃，是的，抱歉……

english: I've brought you your [X] [item]!
translation: 我给你带来 [X] 个 [item] 了！

english: Excellent, much appreciated!
translation: 太好了，非常感谢！

english: Do you want me to pay you in gold or would you prefer me to teach you a bit about how you can mine more efficiently?

translation: 又见面了，[brother/sister][Fremennik name]。今天找我有什么事？你随时可以找我帮忙！

translation: 没什么，谢谢。就是想聊聊天。

english: My door is always open should you ever need my help [Fremennik name].
translation: 如果你需要我的帮助，我的门随时为你敞开 [Fremennik name]。

english: [Fremennik name]... It has been too long since last we met!
translation: [Fremennik name]……我们上次见面已经太久了！

english: Welcome back [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It is always a pleasure to see you here!
translation: 欢迎回来 [brother/sister][Fremennik name]。在这里见到你总是很高兴！

english: My apologies [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! I have not time to tarry here with you!
translation: 抱歉 [brother/sister][Fremennik name]！我没时间在这里和你逗留！

translation: 你让我们蒙羞，[Fremennik name]！

translation: 你怎么能偷我的东西，[Fremennik name]？

english: You have betrayed your heritage, [Fremennik name]!
translation: 你背叛了你的传承，[Fremennik name]！

english: Why would you try to steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你为什么要试图偷我的东西，[Fremennik name]？

translation: 你今天怎么样？

translation: 那么好？这周围的人似乎都有点沮丧。

english: And not particularly talkative.
translation: 而且不太爱说话。

english: I'll leave you to your sighing. It looks like you have plenty to do.
translation: 我就不打扰你叹气了。看起来你有很多事要做。

english: It's a bit grey round here, isn't it?
translation: 这里周围有点灰暗，不是吗？

translation: 过一会儿就会让你沮丧，你知道。有273种灰色，你知道，我们全都有。

translation: 你那点幽默感只是让我更沮丧了。别烦我。

english: How's the King treating you then?
translation: 国王对你怎么样？

english: Like serfs.
translation: 像农奴。

english: Serf?

translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Not a lot.
translation: 没什么。

english: That's a big chasm you're standing by.
translation: 你站在一个大裂缝旁边。

english: Yep.
translation: 是的。

english: What did you think of the coronation?
translation: 你觉得加冕礼怎么样？

english: Pretty good.
translation: 挺好的。

english: That's a nice looking axe. Is it heavy?
translation: 那斧头看起来不错。重吗？

english: Thanks. Not really.
translation: 谢谢。不算重。

english: Interested in doing any trading?
translation: 有兴趣交易吗？

english: I've got everything I need.
translation: 我有我需要的一切。

english: I have vital information pertaining to the cult of Yama.
translation: 我有关于阎魔邪教的重要信息。

english: You should speak to the lieutenant.
translation: 你应该跟中尉谈谈。

english: That's it!
translation: 就这样！

english: What?
translation: 什么？

english: Why don't you want to talk to me!
translation: 你为什么不想跟我说话！

english: I'm confused.
translation: 我很困惑。

english: I've been trying to make conversation with you and I feel like I'm getting nowhere.
translation: 我一直试图跟你交谈，但感觉毫无进展。

english: I'm sorry. I didn't mean to make you feel that way. I'm not a very chatty person.
translation: 抱歉。我不是故意让你那样感觉的。我不是个健谈的人。

english: Your feelings are valid, and you deserve to be heard. That said, it might be good to examine your reaction.
translation: 你的感受是有效的，你值得被倾听。也就是说，检查你的反应可能是好的。

english: Thank you. What do you mean?
translation: 谢谢。你什么意思？

english: Would you agree that people aren't under any obligation to talk to anyone else?
translation: 你同意人们没有义务跟任何人说话吗？

english: I suppose so.
translation: 我想是的。

english: With us, it was just a misunderstanding. With somebody else, you might have been pushing a boundary.
translation: 跟我们，这只是个误会。跟别人，你可能越界了。

english: It risks coming off as having a bit of a 'main character' complex.
translation: 这风险是显得有点''主角''情结。

english: That's a fair point. Thank you for explaining it in that way.
translation: 有道理。谢谢你那样解释。

english: No problem. Have a good day, friend.
translation: 没问题。祝你有美好的一天，朋友。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Hello. Everything well?
translation: 你好。一切都好吗？

english: Hello. Yes, thank you.
translation: 你好。是的，谢谢。

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: That's a big chasm you're standing by.
translation: 你站在一个大裂缝旁边。

english: What did you think of the coronation?
translation: 你觉得加冕礼怎么样？

english: That's a nice looking axe. Is it heavy?
translation: 那斧头看起来不错。重吗？

english: Interested in doing any trading?
translation: 有兴趣交易吗？

english: More options...
translation: 更多选项……

english: I have vital information pertaining to the cult of Yama.
translation: 我有关于阎魔邪教的重要信息。

english: Previous options...
translation: 上一个选项……

english: Hello. What are you doing here?
translation: 你好。你在这里做什么？

english: We're here to keep the farmers safe from the lizardmen.
translation: 我们在这里保护农民免受蜥蜴人侵害。

english: There's not many of you though.
translation: 但你们人不多。

english: Luckily the lizardmen have been focusing their efforts elsewhere. They haven't tried to come up here yet.
translation: 幸运的是蜥蜴人一直把精力集中在别处。他们还没试过上来这里。

english: If they do, we can quickly call in reinforcements if required.
translation: 如果他们来了，我们可以根据需要快速呼叫增援。

english: I see. Well I'd better let you get on then.
translation: 我明白了。那我最好让你继续工作。

english: Private [player name], atten-SHUN! You've been recommended for my corps. Do you think you can be the best?
translation: [player name] 列兵，立——正！你被推荐加入我的军团。你认为你能成为最好的吗？

english: Sir, yes sir!
translation: 是的长官！

english: No thanks, I'm not interested.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我没兴趣。

english: Move yourself, Private! Follow my orders and you may, just may, leave here in a fit state for my corps!
translation: 动起来，列兵！听从我的命令，你也许，只是也许，能以适合我军团的状态离开这里！

english: I haven't given you the order yet, worm!
translation: 我还没给你命令，虫子！

english: (continues with the dialogue below)
translation: (继续以下对话)

english: I want to see you on that mat doing star jumps, private!
translation: 我想看到你在那个垫子上做开合跳，列兵！

english: Okay.
translation: 好的。

english: I want to leave.
translation: 我想离开。

english: Pathetic. Get out of here then.
translation: 可怜。那就滚出去。

english: Drop and give me push ups on that mat, private!
translation: 趴下在那个垫子上做俯卧撑，列兵！

english: Get yourself over there and jog on that mat, private!
translation: 去那边在那个垫子上慢跑，列兵！

english: Get on that mat and give me sit ups, private!
translation: 上那个垫子给我做仰卧起坐，列兵！

english: Well I'll be, you actually did it, Private. Now take this and get out of my sight.
translation: 好吧，你真的做到了，列兵。现在拿着这个滚出我的视线。

english: The player is teleported back to their original position.
translation: 玩家被传送回原始位置。

english: Wrong exercise, worm! Drop and give me push ups on that mat, private!
translation: 错误的练习，虫子！趴下在那个垫子上做俯卧撑，列兵！

english: Wrong exercise, worm! I want to see you on that mat doing star jumps, private!
translation: 错误的练习，虫子！我想看到你在那个垫子上做开合跳，列兵！

english: Wrong exercise, worm! Get on that mat and give me sit ups, private!
translation: 错误的练习，虫子！上那个垫子给我做仰卧起坐，列兵！

english: Wrong exercise, worm! Get yourself over there and jog on that mat, private!
translation: 错误的练习，虫子！去那边在那个垫子上慢跑，列兵！

english: As you were, soldier.
translation: 稍息，士兵。

english: Private [player name], atten-SHUN!
translation: [player name] 列兵，立——正！

english: Stop day-dreaming, Private [player name]!
translation: 别做白日梦了，[player name] 列兵！

english: Get your rear in gear, Private [player name]!
translation: 快点行动，[player name] 列兵！

english: I want you for my corps, Private [player name]!
translation: 我要你加入我的军团，[player name] 列兵！

english: Maybe later.
translation: 也许稍后。

english: Sir, yes sir!
translation: 是的长官！

english: No thanks, I'm not interested.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我没兴趣。

english: Okay.
translation: 好的。

english: I want to leave.
translation: 我想离开。

english: Adventurer, if you're looking to head back in there, I'd suggest you reconsider.
translation: 冒险者，如果你想回那里去，我建议你重新考虑。

english: Why?
translation: 为什么？

english: There is a horror within that has already claimed the lives of some of our soldiers.
translation: 里面有个恐怖东西已经夺走了我们一些士兵的生命。

english: Horror? What horror?
translation: 恐怖？什么恐怖？

english: A nightmare that should not exist. A phantom of the beast that Jhallan took the form of. General Khazard called it a muspah.
translation: 一个不该存在的噩梦。贾兰变身的那个野兽的幻影。卡扎德将军称它为穆斯帕。

english: A phantom? So it's not actually real?
translation: 幻影？所以它不是真的？

english: It is, and it isn't. Truth be told, I don't fully understand it myself. General Khazard called it a remnant of dark energy. Raw magic released from the prison that has taken form.
translation: 是，也不是。老实说，我自己也不太理解。卡扎德将军称它为黑暗能量的残余。从监狱释放出的已成形原始魔法。

english: All I know is that whatever it is, real or otherwise, it's very dangerous.
translation: 我只知道不管它是什么，真的还是别的，都非常危险。

english: So I can't go in?
translation: 所以我不能进去？

english: I won't stop you, but if it all goes wrong, don't expect me to come and save you either.
translation: 我不会阻止你，但如果出事了，也别指望我来救你。

english: I'll keep that in mind. Thanks for the information.
translation: 我会记住的。谢谢你的信息。

english: Be on your guard, adventurer. This place is dangerous.
translation: 保持警惕，冒险者。这地方很危险。

english: Ah, hello! Isn't it a wonderful day?
translation: 啊，你好！今天不是个好日子吗？

english: You seem happy.
translation: 你看起来很高兴。

english: And why wouldn't I be? I'm part of the best fighting force in the world! The Shayzien Army!
translation: 我为什么不高兴？我是世界上最好战斗力量的一部分！谢兹恩城卫军！

english: The best?
translation: 最好的？

english: Of course!
translation: 当然！

english: So the Shayzien Army has no weaknesses at all?
translation: 所以谢兹恩城卫军完全没有弱点？

english: Well... I suppose we don't really have any magical capabilities. That's more an Arceuus thing. Though of course, they're mostly pacifists. Apparently they didn't even properly fight in the War of the Five Houses.
translation: 嗯……我想我们确实没有什么魔法能力。那更多是阿西乌斯的事。当然，他们大多是和平主义者。显然他们在五大家族之战中甚至没有 properly 战斗。

english: Still, I guess 'War of the Four Houses while House Arceuus watched' isn't as catchy a name.
translation: 不过，我想''阿西乌斯家族旁观下的四大家族之战''不是个那么响亮的名字。

english: Right... But apart from magic, the Shayzien Army has no weaknesses?
translation: 好吧……但除了魔法，谢兹恩城卫军没有弱点？

english: Well... we are just an army. We don't have a navy, so can't really deal with any threats at sea. Lady Piscarilius is meant to be in charge of the Kourend Navy. Problem is, it doesn't actually exist.
translation: 嗯……我们只是陆军。我们没有海军，所以无法真正应对海上威胁。皮斯卡里琉斯女士应该负责库兰德海军。问题是，它实际上不存在。

english: How come?
translation: 为什么？

english: Lady Piscarilius has little interest in that sort of thing. Lord Shayzien wants to establish a Shayzien Navy instead, but there's a lot of pushback from the rest of the kingdom.
translation: 皮斯卡里琉斯女士对那种事没什么兴趣。谢兹恩领主想建立谢兹恩海军，但王国其他地方有很多阻力。

english: They worry about Shayzien having too much power. It does mean we'll have big problems against any enemy navy, but on their heads be it I suppose.
translation: 他们担心谢兹恩城权力太大。这确实意味着我们面对任何敌方海军会有大麻烦，但我想那是他们的问题。

english: Anyway, apart from those minor issues, the Shayzien Army has absolutely no weaknesses!
translation: 不管怎样，除了那些小问题，谢兹恩城卫军绝对没有弱点！

english: If you say so. See you later.
translation: 既然你这么说。回头见。

english: Goodbye!
translation: 再见！

english: Hi there; what is this room?
translation: 你好；这是什么房间？

english: Glad you asked. The first thing you will notice on trying to enter the room is that you will be asked to choose either the Attacker, Defender, Collector, Healer or 'any' role.
translation: 很高兴你问。你尝试进入房间时注意到的第一件事是，你会被要求选择攻击者、防御者、收集者、治疗者或''任意''角色。

english: Okay. I'm following so far.
translation: 好的。我目前跟得上。

english: Well, the idea with this room is that we will set up a game for you, choosing some other people from within the room. If there are enough players around we will start a game for you.
translation: 嗯，这个房间的想法是，我们会为你设置一场游戏，从房间内选择其他人。如果有足够多的玩家，我们会为你开始一场游戏。

english: I see. So I just have to wait around for a game?
translation: 我明白了。所以我只需要等着游戏开始？

english: If you want, or you can look around the other rooms and see if there is anyone waiting around.
translation: 如果你想，或者你可以看看其他房间，看看有没有人在等。

english: Good to see you, adventurer. Hope everything is going well for you out there.
translation: 很高兴见到你，冒险者。希望你在外面一切顺利。

english: Not bad, thanks.
translation: 不错，谢谢。

english: Glad to hear it. Did you end up travelling to Varlamore?
translation: 很高兴听到。你最终去瓦拉莫尔旅行了吗？

english: Not yet.
translation: 还没有。

english: Prince Itzla said that one of his people would meet you just outside the eastern gates. Might be worth heading over there.
translation: 伊兹拉王子说他的人会在东门外等你。值得去那边看看。

english: I might just do that. Thanks!
translation: 我可能会去。谢谢！

english: Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: 嘿，是英雄！哇！你太厉害了，你到底是怎么对付那两个成熟吸血鬼和加德兰克斯的？这城镇现在真不错，你做得太棒了！

english: You're more than welcome.
translation: 不用客气。

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Not that it makes much difference but my name's Sergiu. Like all the other survivors here, I just try to make do and get through each day at a time.
translation: 虽然没什么区别但我叫塞尔吉乌。像这里所有其他幸存者一样，我只是尽量应付，一天一天过。

english: How do you like your town?
translation: 你觉得你的小镇怎么样？

english: It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
translation: 太完美了，非常感谢你的努力。

english: What's happening around here?
translation: 这附近发生什么事了？

english: Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: 哦，没什么特别的，我们都在躲避吸血鬼，在这个鬼地方艰难度日，希望很快我们就能强大到足以前往萨鲁夫河的神庙。

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: 有什么我能帮忙的吗？

english: Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you.
translation: 据我所知没有，我们现在有了一些基本设施，非常有用，我们都非常感激你。

english: I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: 我从前没见过真正的英雄，没法比较，但我相信，在大多数人眼中，你定是英雄无疑！我个人很高兴能认识你。

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: How do you like your town?
translation: 你觉得你的城镇怎么样？

english: What's happening around here?
translation: 这附近发生什么事了？

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: 有什么我能帮忙的吗？

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: I'm not sure I should be here. Maybe all this was a bad idea.
translation: 我不确定我该不该来这里。也许这一切都是个坏主意。

english: What makes you say that?
translation: 为什么这么说？

english: I want to help... I want to believe... I really do! It's just all so intimidating...
translation: 我想帮忙……我想相信……我真的想！只是这一切太让人望而却步了……

english: I'm sure it will be fine.
translation: 我相信会没事的。

english: I hope so.
translation: 希望如此。

english: Hi!
translation: 嗨！

english: Hi!
translation: 嗨！

english: Look, I'd better not talk. I'll get in trouble.
translation: 听着，我最好别说话，不然会有麻烦的。

english: If you want someone to show you round the castle ask Eohric, the Head Servant.
translation: 如果你想找人带你参观城堡，去找首席仆人奥里克。

english: I need help, I've been kidnapped by an evil cat!
translation: 我需要帮助，我被一只邪恶的猫绑架了！

english: Meow! Errr... I c-c-c-can't help you... He'll kill us all!
translation: 喵！呃……我帮不了你……他会杀了我们所有人！

english: Now you listen to me! He's just a little cat! There must be something I can do!
translation: 现在你听我说！他只是只小猫！肯定有什么我能做的！

english: F-f-f-fish... give him the f-f-f-fish he likes and he might f- f-f-fall asleep.
translation: 鱼……给他他喜欢的鱼，他可能会睡着。

english: Look... over t-t-there! That fishing spot c-c-contains the f-f-f-fish he likes.
translation: 看……在那边！那个钓鱼点有他喜欢的鱼。

english: A cutscene starts, showing where to catch the fish that Evil Bob likes.
translation: 过场动画开始，显示在哪里可以钓到邪恶鲍勃喜欢的鱼。

english: Evil Bob has fallen asleep, come quickly!
translation: 邪恶鲍勃睡着了，快来！

english: Come? Come where?
translation: 走？走去哪？

english: Away from this place! To Gielinor!
translation: 离开这个地方！去基利诺尔！

english: You go, [player name], I don't belong there... I belong here, in ScapeRune. This is the only place I can ever go...
translation: 你走吧，[player name]，我不属于那里……我属于这里，在 ScapeRune。这是我唯一能去的地方……

english: But I love you!
translation: 但我爱你！

english: Our love can never be, sweet [player name].
translation: 我们的爱永远无法实现，亲爱的 [player name]。

english: Go now! Go, and don't look back!
translation: 现在就走！走吧，别回头！

english: Oh, alright then, I'll be off! See you around!
translation: 哦，那好吧，我走了！回头见！

english: Meow!!!
What? Why are you meowing?
translation: 什么？你为什么喵叫？

english: I mean... L-l-l-leave me alone!
translation: 我是说……别、别、别管我！

english: I just want to talk to you, that's all.
translation: 我只是想和你聊聊，就这样。

english: No, he's insane! He'll kill us all! Like he killed the others!
translation: 不，他疯了！他会杀了我们所有人！就像他杀了其他人一样！

english: Evil Bob is sleeping! You can escape!
translation: 邪恶鲍勃在睡觉！你可以逃跑了！

english: Escape? Escape where?
translation: 逃跑？逃到哪里去？

english: No, Evil Bob will track us down eventually and when he does...
translation: 不，邪恶鲍勃迟早会找到我们的，到时候……

english: No, I dare not leave this place.
translation: 不，我不敢离开这个地方。

english: Suit yourself then.
translation: 那随你便吧。

english: But I love you!
translation: 但我爱你！

english: Oh, alright then.
translation: 哦，那好吧。

english: Nilsal, my child. I imagine you're hoping for word on our plans for rescuing Itzla. I'm afraid nothing has been decided yet, but once that changes, I am sure you will have a part to play.
translation: 你好，我想你是在等我们营救伊茨拉的计划消息。恐怕目前还没决定什么，但一旦有变化，我相信你会有用武之地的。

english: : I see. Thank you, Servius.
translation: ：我明白了。谢谢你，塞尔维乌斯。

english: Do not lose heart, my child. May the sun light your way.
translation: 别灰心，愿阳光照亮你的前路。

english: M'arnin'....going to milk me cowsies!
translation: 早……要去挤我的奶牛了！

english: What are you?
translation: 你是什么东西？

english: You can see me!?
translation: 你能看见我！？

english: No matter. This creature will soon be corrupted and then I will finally have a pawn of my own to manipulate in this world!
translation: 没关系，这个生物很快就会被腐化，到时候我就能在这个世界拥有自己的棋子来操控了！

english: So... Sorry for killing you?
translation: 那么……抱歉杀了你？

english: Insolent human! You have merely delayed my return to this world. I will find another puppet soon...
translation: 无礼的人类！你只是推迟了我重返这个世界的时间。我很快就会找到另一个傀儡……

english: Yeah Yeah, world domination, that's great and all but do you see that altar you cursed? Could you undo that? I'd like to use it for training down here.
translation: 是是是，统治世界什么的确实很棒，但你看到你诅咒的那个祭坛了吗？你能解除吗？我想在这里用它训练。

english: Ha!Ha!Ha! You are bold adventurer, but this altar will remain a lingering memento of your decision to challenge me!
translation: 哈！哈！哈！你是个大胆的冒险者，但这祭坛将作为你挑战我的决定的永久纪念而存在！

english: Sigh...
I am the void in the universe. I am the answer to all things that cry out for destruction. I am the destroyer of worlds. I am the darkness that swallows the light. Ally to...
translation: 我是宇宙中的虚空。我是所有呼唤毁灭之物的答案。我是世界的毁灭者。我是吞噬光明的黑暗。盟友是……

english: Ok.
translation: 好的。

english: BEGONE!
translation: 滚开！

english: Hello effendi, I am Shantay.
translation: 你好，先生，我是沙泰。

english: I see you're new. Please read the billboard poster before going into the desert. It'll give yer details on the dangers you can face.
translation: 我看你是新来的，进入沙漠前请阅读公告牌。它会告诉你可能面临的危险。

english: There is a heartbroken mother just past the gates and in the desert. Her name is Irena and she mourns her lost daughter. Such a shame.
translation: 刚过大门的沙漠里有个心碎的母亲。她叫艾琳娜，正在哀悼她失去的女儿。真可怜。

english: Hello again friend. Please read the billboard poster before going into the desert. It'll give yer details on the dangers you can face.
translation: 又见面了，朋友。进沙漠前请阅读公告牌。它会告诉你可能面临的危险。

english: What is this place?

english: This is the pass of Shantay. I guard this area with my men. I am responsible for keeping this pass open and repaired.
translation: 这里是沙泰隘口。我和我的手下守卫这片区域。我负责保持这条通道畅通和修缮。

english: My men and I prevent outlaws from getting out of the desert. And we stop the inexperienced from a dry death in the sands. Which would you say you were?
translation: 我和我的手下阻止逃犯离开沙漠，也防止缺乏经验的人在沙海中干渴而死。你说你是哪种？

english: I am definitely an outlaw, prepare to die!
translation: 我绝对是逃犯，准备受死吧！

english: Ha, very funny.....
translation: 哈，真有趣……

english: Guards arrest [him/her]!
translation: 卫兵逮捕 [他/她]！

english: The guards arrest you and place you in the jail.
translation: 卫兵逮捕了你，将你关入牢房。

english: The player is put in the Shantay Pass jail.
translation: 玩家被关进沙泰隘口监狱。

english: You'll have to stay in there until you pay the fine of five gold pieces. Do you want to pay now?
translation: 你得待在里面，直到缴纳五枚金币的罚款。你现在想付吗？

english: Yes, okay.
translation: 好的。

english: Good, I see that you have come to your senses.
translation: 很好，看来你清醒过来了。

english: Great Effendi, now please try to keep the peace.
translation: 伟大的先生，现在请尽量保持和平。

english: You hand over five gold pieces to Shantay.
translation: 你把五枚金币交给沙泰。

english: Shantay unlocks the door to the cell.
translation: 沙泰打开了牢房的门。

english: You don't have that kind of cash on you I see.
translation: 看来你身上没带那么多现金。

english: You are to be transported to a maximum security prison in Port Sarim.
translation: 你将被转移到沙林港的最高戒备监狱。

english: I hope you've learnt an important lesson from this.
translation: 我希望你从中吸取了重要教训。

english: I would transport you to a maximum security prison in Port Sarim. However since you haven't unlocked access to Asgarnia consider yourself lucky.
translation: 我本可以将你转移到沙林港的最高戒备监狱。但既然你还没解锁阿斯卡尼亚的访问权限，算你走运。

english: But perhaps you have some in your bank? Or would you prefer the maximum security prison in Port Sarim.
translation: 但也许你银行里有一些？还是你更想去沙林港的最高戒备监狱。

english: Which is it going to be?
translation: 你选哪个？

english: I'll pay the fine.
translation: 我缴纳罚款。

english: Okay then..., you'll need access to your bank.
translation: 那好吧……你需要访问你的银行。

english: No thanks, you're not having my money.
translation: 不用了，你别想拿我的钱。

english: Very well, I grow tired of you, you'll be taken to a new jail in Port Sarim.

english: You have a choice. You can either pay five gold pieces or... You can be transported to a maximum security prison in Port Sarim.

english: I am a little inexperienced.

english: Can I recommend that you purchase a full waterskin and a knife! These items will no doubt save your life. A waterskin will keep water from evaporating in the desert.
translation: 我能建议你买个装满水的水袋和一把刀吗？这些东西无疑会救你的命。水袋能防止水分在沙漠中蒸发。

english: And a keen woodsman with a knife can extract the juice from a cactus. Before you go into the desert, it's advisable to wear desert clothes. It's very hot in the desert and you'll surely cook if you wear armour.
translation: 而且，熟练的樵夫用刀可以从仙人掌中提取汁液。进入沙漠前，建议穿着沙漠服装。沙漠里很热，如果穿着盔甲肯定会中暑。

english: To keep the pass bandit free, we charge a small toll of five gold pieces. You can buy a desert pass from me, just ask me to open the shop. You can also use our free banking services by clicking on the chest.
translation: 为了保持通道免受匪患，我们收取五枚金币的小额通行费。你可以从我这里买沙漠通行证，让我打开商店就行。你也可以点击箱子使用我们的免费银行服务。

translation: 为什么我进沙漠要付钱？

english: Effendi, you insult me! I am not interested in making a profit from you! I merely seek to cover my expenses in keeping this pass open.
translation: 先生，你侮辱我了！我无意从你身上牟利！我只是想弥补维持这条通道畅通的开支。

english: There is repair work to carry out and also the men's wages to consider. For the paltry sum of 5 Gold pieces, I think we offer a great service.
translation: 有修缮工作要完成，还要考虑手下的薪饷。区区五枚金币，我们提供的服务物超所值。

english: Er, neither, I'm an adventurer.
translation: 呃，都不是，我是一名冒险者。

english: Great, I have just the thing for the desert adventurer. I sell desert clothes which will keep you cool in the heat of the desert. I also sell waterskins so that you won't die in the desert.
translation: 太好了，我正好有适合沙漠冒险者的东西。我出售沙漠服装，能让你在沙漠酷热中保持凉爽。我也卖水袋，这样你就不会在沙漠中渴死。

english: A waterskin and a knife help you survive from the juice of a cactus. Use the chest to store your items, we'll take them to the bank. It's hot in the desert, you'll bake in all that armour.
translation: 水袋和刀能帮你依靠仙人掌汁液在沙漠中生存。用箱子存放你的物品，我们会把它们送到银行。沙漠里很热，穿着那些盔甲你会被烤熟的。

english: To keep the pass open we ask for 5 gold pieces. And we give you a Shantay Pass, just ask to see what I sell to buy one.
translation: 为了保持通道畅通，我们收取五枚金币。我们会给你一张沙泰隘口通行证，询问我所售商品即可购买。

english: You should be in jail! Well, no doubt the authorities in Port Sarim know what they're doing. But if you get into any more trouble, you'll be stuck back in jail.
translation: 你本该坐牢！好吧，沙林港的当局知道他们在做什么。但如果你再惹麻烦，你就得回监狱了。
