english: Hello there...thanks for helping out Trufitus commune with the gods Bwana. We've been able to return to the village thanks to your help.
translation: 你好……谢谢你帮助特鲁菲图斯公社与诸神沟通，先生。多亏你的帮助，我们才能回到村庄。

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: I's not doing a great deal now Bwana, as I'm no spring chicken. I do my fair share around the village bwana, though, I could tell you a thing or two about the jungle slashing.
translation: 我现在没做什么大事，先生，因为我年纪不小了。不过我在村里也尽我所能，先生，我可以告诉你一些关于丛林砍伐的事。

english: Ok, tell me about jungle slashing!
translation: 好的，跟我讲讲丛林砍伐！

english: Ok Bwana, I will! To begin with you'll need a machete in order to hack your way through the jungle. There are some better gem edged weapons which you may be able to purchase from Gabooty.
translation: 好的，我来讲！首先你需要一把砍刀才能在丛林中开辟道路。有一些更好的宝石刃武器，你可以从加布蒂那里买到。

english: Safta Doc makes them for him. You should be aware that hacking away at the jungle is not without its dangers though Bwana. Many times you may find some scary creatures lurking inside.
translation: 这些武器由萨夫塔‧多克为他制作。不过，先生，你应该知道丛林开拓并非毫无危险。很多时候你会发现一些可怕的生物潜伏其中。

english: What sort of creatures?
translation: 什么类型的生物？

english: Ok, to start with there are spiders! These are pretty tough but if you defeat it, you can get a good meal from it, if you know how to cook it that is. My wife cooks them to a turn - Mmmm, delicious.
translation: 好的，首先是蜘蛛！它们相当难对付，但如果你能击败它们，只要懂得烹饪方法，就能美餐一顿。我妻子把它们做得恰到好处——嗯，美味。

english: Ok go on!
translation: 好的，继续！

english: Yes Bwana, of course. Then there are snakes...these are dangerous because they're poisonous - so be prepared! However, they're not without their uses. A bush snake is large enough to have a useful hide.
translation: 是的先生，当然。然后是蛇……这些很危险，因为它们有毒——所以要小心！不过，它们也有用处。灌木蛇足够大，皮可以利用。

english: Once the hide is tanned you get a snakeskin and you're able to make things from it, the same way that mainlanders use normal leather! However, it's actually still quite small.
translation: 皮鞣制后你就得到蛇皮，你可以用它制作东西，就像大陆人用普通皮革一样！不过，它实际上还是相当小。

english: You may need several skins in order to make something useful.
translation: 你可能需要几张皮才能做出有用的东西。

english: Hmm, sounds interesting!
translation: 嗯，听起来很有趣！

english: Then there are giant mosquitoes bwana, they're fast and agile. You'll need to be quick if you're to hit them at all! However, it certainly does train your reactions. They're not very tough, just difficult to hit.
translation: 还有巨型蚊子，先生，它们又快又灵活。如果你想打中它们，你得动作快！不过，这确实能锻炼你的反应能力。它们防御不高，只是难以击中。

english: I also believe that their proboscis is useful in someway, I believe Timfraku's sons sometimes use them for hunting.
translation: 我也相信它们的口器有其用途，蒂姆弗拉克的儿子们似乎有时会用它们来狩猎。

english: Ok, that sounds helpful...anything else?
translation: 好的，听起来很有帮助……还有别的吗？

english: Yes Bwana, much much more! What next...Oh yes, the tribesmen...you've probably seen them scouting around the village, sometimes sneaking inside the enclosure to steal our chickens!
translation: 是的先生，还有很多！接下来……哦对了，是部落民……你可能见过他们在村庄周围侦察，有时偷偷溜进围栏偷我们的鸡！

english: They sometimes hide in the jungle bushes waiting for an opportunity to strike when we least expect it! Take care Bwana, these treacherous jungle natives use poison on their spears!
translation: 他们有时躲在丛林灌木丛中，等待我们最意想不到的时候出击！小心，先生，这些狡猾的丛林土著会在矛尖淬毒！

english: Right Ok, good advice... 'poison on spears....' Anything else I should know about?
translation: 好的，好建议……''矛尖淬毒……''还有什么我应该了解的吗？

english: Yes Bwana... and this is serious... The jungle is very ancient and many unspeakable acts have been witnessed on these lands. Bizarre supernatural curses were placed on criminals and then they were buried alive!
translation: 是的先生……这很严重……丛林非常古老，这片土地上发生过许多不可言说的事情。奇怪的超自然诅咒被施加在罪犯身上，然后他们被活埋！

english: These strange creatures have the curse of the Broodoo on them! They'll rise from their grave with their heads in their chests and move like crazy spirits of the afterlife.
translation: 这些奇怪的生物身上有布鲁多的诅咒！他们会从坟墓中爬出，头颅嵌于胸腔之内，如同来世的癫狂幽魂般游荡。

english: If they're disturbed they will attack anything in the area with their magical abilities! They suffer little from being attacked as they seem to be protected by some form of defence.
translation: 如果它们被惊扰，它们便会用魔法攻击区域内的任何目标！它们几乎不受攻击伤害，因为它们似乎受到某种防御机制的保护。

english: However... it is said that the means of their death provides the clue to their destruction. So far three distinct Broodoo have been identified. The Broodoo with a green hued skin is said to have died from poison.
translation: 不过……据说它们的死亡方式提供了摧毁它们的线索。目前已有三种不同的布鲁多被确认。肤色呈绿色的布鲁多，据说是因中毒而亡。

english: There is a broodoo of yellow hue and a pale skinned broodoo, but little is known of these two!
translation: 此外还有肤色呈黄色与苍白的布鲁多，但关于这两种的了解甚少！

english: Erk! Well that sounds pretty scary!
translation: 呃！听起来很可怕！

english: Yes Bwana...
translation: 是的先生……

english: Ok, thanks a lot....
translation: 好的，非常感谢……

english: Wait Bwana, there's more!
translation: 等等先生，还有更多！

english: More... Blimey! Ok carry on...
translation: 更多……天哪！好的，继续……

english: Some of the local villagers have found strange plants which grow here-abouts. If you cut away at the jungle and find one, it's considered a blessing, though the useful part of the plant is usually buried underground.
translation: 一些当地村民发现了生长于附近的奇异植物。若你在丛林开拓中发现一株，那被视为吉兆，尽管其有用部分通常埋于地下。

english: And also, you may find an uncommon rock type which is impregnated with mineral wealth! Well that concludes all the help I can give you regarding the jungle in Tai Bwo Wannai!
translation: 此外，你可能会发现一种罕见的岩石，其中蕴藏着丰富的矿物资源！关于泰博瓦纳村的丛林，我能给你的帮助就这些了！

english: I have to say, that's quite a lot of information...thanks very much!
translation: 我得说，信息量真大……非常感谢！

english: You're more than welcome bwana!
translation: 不用客气，先生！

english: Is there anything interesting to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么有趣的事可做吗？

english: Bwana, if anyone else asks me that question today, I'll explode! Go and ask someone else!
translation: 先生，如果今天再有人问我这个问题，我会爆炸的！去问别人吧！

english: Not that I'm aware of, just sit back and enjoy the sunshine bwana!
translation: 据我所知没有，就坐下来享受阳光吧，先生！

english: Sorry Bwana, I'm already busy, why not go and talk to Murcaily! He's around the village somewhere.
translation: 抱歉先生，我手头正忙，不如去找穆尔凯利聊聊？他就在村庄某处。

english: Well, I think that there's some work to be done...perhaps Murcaily can help you. He usually tends to the hardwood grove to the east of Trufitus's hut.
translation: 嗯，我觉得有些工作可以做……也许穆尔凯利能帮你。他通常在特鲁菲图斯小屋东边的硬木林照料。

english: It's just village life as normal around here Bwana, always something interesting to find to occupy your time if you look hard enough.
translation: 这里不过是寻常的村庄生活，只要你用心寻觅，总能找到有趣的事务来打发时光。

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
translation: 我在村庄周围做了一些工作。

english: Yeah, you've been doing a lot of good work around here. Let me give you something for your time and effort.
translation: 是的，你在此地做了不少善举。让我给你点东西，以酬谢你的时间与付出。

english: You get [amount] trading sticks. You are left with [amount]% favour.
translation: 你得到 [amount] 根交易棒。你还剩下 [amount]% 的好感度。

english: I've already given you some trading sticks and I don't have any more on me at the moment. Why not go and talk to some of the other villagers and get some contributions?
translation: 我已经给了你一些交易棒，现在我身上没有了。不如去和其他村民聊聊，获得一些贡献？

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Ahhhhhhhh - Get away from me you beast!
translation: 啊啊啊啊——离我远点你这野兽！

english: What's the problem....oh, I'm wearing this big scary mask! I'd better take it off before I start talking to the natives.
translation: 什么问题……哦，我戴着这个可怕的大面具！我和当地人说话前最好摘掉它。

english: Waahhhhh! - It's da evil broodoo beast come ta eat my very soul!
translation: 哇啊啊啊！——是邪恶的布鲁多野兽来吃我的灵魂了！

english: Ahhhhhhhh - It's a monster!
translation: 啊啊啊啊——是怪物！

english: Ahhhhhhhh!!
translation: 啊啊啊啊！！

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Ok, tell me about jungle slashing!
translation: 好的，跟我讲讲丛林砍伐！

english: Previous questions.
translation: 返回上一个问题。

english: Is there anything interesting to do here?
translation: 这里有什么有趣的事可做吗？

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
translation: 我在村庄周围做了一些工作。

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Thank you for saving us.
translation: 谢谢你救了我们。

english: Don't mention it.
translation: 不用客气。

english: And thank you for saving Antos as well!
translation: 也谢谢你救了安托斯！

english: It's really not a problem.
translation: 这真的不算什么。

english: You're our hero!
translation: 你是我们的英雄！

english: Greetings!
translation: 你好！

english: Oh hello there, I'm an architect.
translation: 哦，你好，我是建筑师。

english: I wondered if you might have some time to help...?
translation: 我在想你是否有点时间帮忙……？

english: So sorry, too busy at the moment.
translation: 很抱歉，现在太忙了。

english: Hello again. How are you?
translation: 又见面了。你好吗？

english: Great! Since working on that statue, everyone wants a miniature - very handy for business!
translation: 很好！自从做了那座雕像后，每个人都想要一个迷你版——生意真好！

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Quiet! I'm here observing the lizardmen shamans,try not to blow my cover.
translation: 安静！我在这里观察蜥蜴人萨满，尽量别暴露我的身份。

english: You don't seem to be hiding very well.
translation: 你好像藏得不太好。

english: As if you could do better!
translation: 好像你能做得更好似的！

english: Do you know how many lizardmen I've killed?
translation: 你知道我杀了多少蜥蜴人吗？

english: The Shayzien records say you've killed [#] lizardmen since they began tracking your kills. [#] were lizardman shamans.
translation: 谢兹恩的记录显示，自从他们开始追踪你的击杀数，你已经杀了 [#] 个蜥蜴人。其中 [#] 个是蜥蜴人萨满。

english: Quiet! I'm here observing the lizardmen shamans, try not to blow my cover.
translation: 安静！我在这里观察蜥蜴人萨满，尽量别暴露我的身份。

english: Riiiight, anyways, can I attack these lizardmen shaman?
translation: 好吧，不管怎样，我能攻击这些蜥蜴人萨满吗？

english: Absolutely not! Do you want to get me killed? Now get out of here and stop trying to blow my cover!
translation: 绝对不行！你想害死我吗？现在离开这里，别再试图暴露我的身份！

english: Well I don't like the idea of you risking my cover. You are trusted by the Shayzien people though, so I suppose you can. Just be careful.
translation: 我也不喜欢你冒险暴露我的身份。不过谢兹恩人信任你，所以我想你可以。只是要小心。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Do you know how many lizardmen I've killed?
translation: 你知道我杀了多少蜥蜴人吗？

english: Baa!
translation: 咩！

english: That's a sheep...I think. I can't talk to sheep.
translation: 那是只羊……我想。我不会和羊说话。

english: The... whatever it is... manages to get away from you!
translation: 那个……不管是什么……成功从你身边逃走了！

english: I can't speak to the penguins when I'm not in my disguise.
translation: 我没穿伪装时不能和企鹅说话。

english: Hello, I've just finished composing my latest poem. Would you like to hear it?
translation: 你好，我刚写完最新一首诗。你想听听吗？

english: Yes, please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Excellent! The humansan aficionado! Make yourself comfortable and I'll begin...
translation: 太好了！人类爱好者！请坐舒服点，我开始了……

english: Twinkle, twinkle little egg Wouldn't you like to grow some legs?And run around, on grass so green arguing with the milk and cream.
translation: 一闪一闪小蛋蛋，你不想长些腿吗？在绿草地上奔跑，与牛奶和奶油争吵。

english: T'was brillig and the slithey toathes Did gyre and gimbol in the wabe All mimsy were the borrowgroves And the mome raths outgrabe.
translation: 那是黄昏，滑腻的兽齿在草地上旋转跳跃，所有的洞穴都忧郁，远处的鼠兔在哀嚎。

english: That's not even your poem, you idiotic, animated ball of wool!
translation: 那根本不是你的诗，你这个愚蠢的、会动的毛线球！

english: How now foolish cow? Do you read poetry, instead of pulling a plow?
translation: 怎么了愚蠢的牛？你在读诗，而不是拉犁吗？

english: I'm not talking to you any more, you're nasty.
translation: 我不再和你说话了，你很讨厌。

english: Oh no! Cow's not talking to me!
translation: 哦不！牛不和我说话了！

english: Do I look like I care?
translation: 我看起来像在乎吗？

english: I wish I was a cow My life would be so simple I could lie around just eating grass And wonder if I was a pimple.
translation: 我希望我是头牛，我的生活将如此简单，我可以躺着吃草，然后怀疑自己是不是个痘痘。

english: Hahaha, I don't think!
translation: 哈哈哈，我不这么认为！

english: Well I thought it was funny.
translation: 嗯，我觉得很有趣。

english: How goes it, blade of grass? I'm glad you're not any thinner You should invite your friends around So I can have my dinner!
translation: 怎么样，草叶？我很高兴你没更瘦，你应该邀请你的朋友来，这样我就可以吃晚饭了！

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Huh, the cow's right. You humans have absolutely no understanding of art!
translation: 哼，牛说得对。你们人类完全不懂艺术！

english: Do you know what these strange marks mean?
translation: 你知道这些奇怪的标记是什么意思吗？

english: The humans found some symbolsAnd doesn't know what they meanSo now it's cross-examining meAnd spoiling my routine!
translation: 人类发现了一些符号，不知道它们的意思，所以现在它盘问我，破坏我的日常！

english: You give me a hair-cut and then expect me to talk to you? I think not!
translation: 你给我理了个发，然后指望我和你说话？想得美！

english: Yes, please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Hey, who're you?
translation: 嘿，你是谁？

english: I'm Sherlock, master of clues and challenges.
translation: 我是夏洛克，线索与挑战大师。

english: Clues and challenges?
translation: 线索与挑战？

english: If you find a scroll that requires my attention, bring it to me and I shall handle it.
translation: 如果你找到需要我注意的卷轴，带给我，我会处理。

english: I will! but...
translation: 我会的！但是……

english: You're not wearing a shirt?
translation: 你没穿衬衫？

english: Yeah, no shirt Sherlock.....
translation: 是的，没穿衬衫的夏洛克……

english: Ah, just what I was looking for. I have a challenge for you. If you complete it, I'll give you something.
translation: 啊，这正是我找的。我有个挑战给你。如果你完成它，我会给你点东西。

english: Fantastic! Here, have this.
translation: 太棒了！给，拿着这个。

english: That's nice, but.... I don't really need one of those.
translation: 那很好，但是……我真的不需要那个。

english: Welcome to the Cloak and Stagger! Anything I can get you?
translation: 欢迎来到斗篷与蹒跚酒馆！我能给你拿点什么？

english: I'd like to order a drink, please.
translation: 我想点杯饮料。

english: Of course, what would you like?
translation: 当然，你想要什么？

english: Got anything special on tap?
translation: 有什么特别的生啤吗？

english: We're always running a keg of our locally-brewed ale, Lizardkicker.
translation: 我们一直有本地酿造的麦酒，叫蜥蜴踢。

english: I will warn you though, its an acquired taste.
translation: 不过我得提醒你，这酒的口味比较独特，可能需要慢慢习惯。

english: What's in it?
translation: 里面有什么？

english: Oh, the usual... Wheat, hops, yeast...
translation: 老样子……小麦、啤酒花、酵母……

english: ...reptile scales...
translation: ……爬行动物鳞片……

english: Scales?!
translation: 鳞片？！

english: Don't worry about the scales.
translation: 别担心鳞片。

english: Was there anything else?
translation: 还有别的吗？

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: This here is the Cloak and Stagger. The finest drinking establishment in the whole of Shayzien.
translation: 这里是斗篷与蹒跚酒馆。整个谢兹恩城最好的饮酒场所。

english: Isn't it the only pub in the city?
translation: 这不是城里唯一的酒馆吗？

english: Like I say, the finest in all of Shayzien!
translation: 正如我所说，是整个谢兹恩城最好的！

english: Most of our patrons are soldiers returning on leave from the frontlines. We do get a few regular folk in too though.
translation: 我们的大多数顾客是从前线休假回来的士兵。不过也有一些普通百姓。

english: By the way, its generally considered polite to buy a drink if you're going to stand around and chat.
translation: 顺便说一句，如果你要站着聊天，通常买杯饮料被认为是礼貌的。

english: ...With that said, is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: ……话虽如此，还有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: Have you heard any rumours here?
translation: 你听到什么传闻了吗？

english: Apparently Veos is looking for some help with something. He hangs around the docks of Port Piscarilius.
translation: 显然维奥斯在找帮手做什么事。他常在皮斯卡里琉斯港的码头附近。

english: They say there's trouble in Port Piscarilius. Something about gangs uniting. Might be worth looking into.
translation: 听说皮斯卡里琉斯港有麻烦。好像是帮派联合什么的。值得调查一下。

english: I hear that Lord Hosidius has misplaced one of his sons. The Hosidius family might pay a lot to see him returned safely.
translation: 我听说霍西迪乌斯领主有个儿子失踪了，霍西迪乌斯家族可能会出大价钱让他安全回来。

english: Phileas Rimor has supposedly been looking for some assistance with something in Shayzien. Maybe worth investigating.
translation: 据说菲利亚斯‧里莫尔在谢兹恩找帮手做什么事。也许值得调查。

english: I hear that the rulers of Lovakengj have some work available. You'll find them in the Lovakengj Assembly.
translation: 我听说洛瓦肯吉城的统治者有些任务委托，你可以在洛瓦肯吉城议会找到他们。

english: Apparently there's been some commotion in the middle of Arceuus. Might be worth checking out.
translation: 显然阿西乌斯城中心区域有些骚动，也许值得去看看。

english: That protest outside Kourend Castle is starting to attract some attention. Could be worth taking a look.
translation: 库兰德城堡外的抗议开始引起注意了。值得去看看。

english: No, it hasn't been very busy lately.
translation: 不，最近不太忙。

english: Actually, I think I need to be going.
translation: 实际上，我想我得走了。

english: Safe travels!
translation: 旅途平安！

english: I'd like to order a drink, please.
translation: 我想点杯饮料。

english: Got anything special on tap?
translation: 有什么特别的生啤吗？

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: Have you heard any rumours here?
translation: 你听到什么传闻了吗？

english: Actually, I think I need to be going.
translation: 实际上，我想我得走了。

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Greetings adventurer.
translation: 你好，冒险者。

english: What's with all the shields?
translation: 这些盾牌是怎么回事？

english: Although archers like myself like to keep distance from our enemies, it's always good to have a bit of protection.
translation: 虽然像我这样的弓箭手喜欢与敌人保持距离，但有点保护总是好的。

english: Very sensible! Did you make these yourself?
translation: 很明智！这些是你自己做的吗？

english: I am a bit of a craftsman, I indeed made all these shields.
translation: 我算是个工匠，这些盾牌确实都是我做的。

english: How do you make them?
translation: 你怎么做的？

english: It's very simple! First you'll need to be skilled in crafting and fletching, the exact details you can find in your skill guide.
translation: 很简单！首先你需要精通工艺和制箭，具体细节你可以在技能指南中找到。

english: For every shield, you'll require some tools! A knife for fletching the wood and a hammer for crafting the shield.
translation: 做每个盾牌，你需要一些工具！一把刀用来削木头，一把锤子用来制作盾牌。

english: As for resources, you'll need 2 logs, 2 pieces of tanned leather and 15 nails.
translation: 至于资源，你需要2根原木、2块鞣制皮革和15颗钉子。

english: Where can I find out more information about the resources needed?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到更多关于所需资源的信息？

english: I have a flyer! It details all the shields and the resources needed for them.
translation: 我有传单！它详细列出了所有盾牌及其所需资源。

english: May I have a resource flyer?
translation: 能给我一份资源传单吗？

english: Of course! The more you know, the better!
translation: 当然！知道得越多越好！

english: The Shield Master hands you 'Leather Shields - Resource information flyer'.
translation: 盾牌大师递给你''皮革盾牌 - 资源信息传单''。

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！

english: You already have a flyer, I've only so many left.
translation: 你已经有一份传单了，我只剩这么多了。

english: Fair enough.
translation: 好吧。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: My name is William! And I'll tell you this, I'm the best crossbowman this side of White Wolf Mountain.
translation: 我叫威廉！我告诉你，我是白狼山这边最好的弩手。

english: Who's better than you on the other side of the mountain?
translation: 山那边谁比你强？

english: Couldn't tell you that myself, never been there.
translation: 我自己也不知道，从没去过那里。

english: Oh... How did you come across that crossbow then?
translation: 哦……那你怎么得到那把弩的？

english: Oh this? Some wandering merchant came by recently, told me it was the stealthiest crossbow there was.
translation: 哦这个？最近有个流浪商人来过，告诉我这是最隐蔽的弩。

english: Is it?
translation: 是吗？

english: Why howdy there, sailor! Welcome to this here fine shipyard. Anything I can help ya with?
translation: 哟，你好啊，水手！欢迎来到这个好船厂。有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: Can you tell me more about this place?
translation: 你能告诉我更多关于这个地方的事吗？

english: Why, this is the shipyard, of course! I'd say it's the finest one in all of Gielinor!
translation: 哎呀，这当然是船厂！我敢说这是整个基利诺尔最好的！

english: How many others even are there in Gielinor?
translation: 基利诺尔还有多少其他的？

english: Ha! You're a funny one, sailor! Anyhoo, this here is the place where ya can modify your boat to your heart's content! Ya can do that in two ways.
translation: 哈！你真有趣，水手！总之，这里是你可以随心所欲改装船的地方！你有两种方式可以做到。

english: Once you're on board, you'll find that you've got different spots on your boat for different facilities! If ya can't find what you're looking for, be sure to check the other spots as well!
translation: 一旦你上船，你会发现船上有不同的位置可以放置不同的设施！如果你找不到你想要的，一定要检查其他位置！

english: But what if I don't have the right skillsets?
translation: 但如果我没有正确的技能怎么办？

english: Well now, I reckon we might be able to help ya out there... for a price of course!
translation: 嗯，我想我们也许能帮你……当然要收费！

english: Now, the other way ya can modify your boat is by upgrading the core components of it. If ya fancy doing that, you'll wanna use this here schematics board!
translation: 另外，你还可以升级船的核心部件来改造你的船。如果你想这么做，就用这块设计图板！

english: Much like with building facilities, ya can use the board to pick the part of your boat ya wanna upgrade!
translation: 和建造设施一样，你可以用这块板来选择你想升级的船体部件！

english: Now, it's important ya keep in mind that these upgrades are the big ones! They're too much to handle solo, so we'll wrangle up some of the workers to lend ya a hand. They'll also supply the tools for ya!
translation: 重要的是你要记住，这些升级都是大工程！一个人干不了，所以我们会叫些工人来帮你。他们还会给你提供工具！

english: That's very kind of them. What's the catch?
translation: 他们真好。有什么条件吗？

english: Well, while they're happy to give ya a helping hand, they are going to expect ya to take the lead.
translation: 嗯，虽然他们乐意帮忙，但他们希望你能带头干。

english: And if I'm not skilled enough to take the lead?
translation: 如果我的技能不够带头怎么办？

english: Well, we might be able to help ya out there... for a price of course!
translation: 嗯，我们也许能帮你……当然得收费！

english: Of course.
translation: 当然。

english: Anyhoo, I think that just about covers the shipyard. Anything else I can do for ya?
translation: 总之，我想船厂的事差不多就这些了。还有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: What do you have for sale?
translation: 你有什么卖的？

english: I've got a few basic shipbuilding supplies that ya might find handy. Take a look, sailor!
translation: 我有一些基本的造船用品，你可能会用得上。看看吧，水手！

english: Looks like ya boat's already all fine and dandy, sailor.
translation: 看起来你的船已经完好无损了，水手。

english: Could you help me repair my boat?
translation: 你能帮我修理我的船吗？

english: Sure thing, sailor. That'll cost ya [..] coins.
translation: 没问题，水手。这需要花费你 [..] 金币。

english: Sounds good to me.
translation: 听起来不错。

english: Alrighty! Let's call some of the workers over...
translation: 好的！我叫些工人过来……

english: Some workers make repairs to your boat.
translation: 一些工人修理了你的船。

english: That's all done for ya, sailor.
translation: 都给你弄好了，水手。

english: Actually, I'd rather not.
translation: 不，我还是算了。

english: Fair enough, sailor.
translation: 好吧，水手。

english: Where can I get materials for my boat?
translation: 我从哪里能获得造船材料？

english: Well, ain't that the question on everyone's mind, sailor? But to answer, it depends on what materials you'll be wanting.
translation: 嗯，这不是每个人都在问的问题吗，水手？不过要说答案，得看你想要什么材料。

english: Ya look like a smart enough sailor to know where to find logs and bars. Nails, ya make from taking a metal bar to an anvil.
translation: 你看起来是个聪明的水手，应该知道去哪找原木和金属条。钉子，你可以把金属条拿到铁砧上制作。

english: For planks, you'll need to take matching logs to a sawmill. I know there's a few around, but I like to get mine from the one north east of Varrock.
translation: 至于木板，你需要把相应的原木拿到锯木厂。我知道附近有几个，但我喜欢去维洛克城东北边那个。

english: If ya need standard hull parts, you'll wanna take five planks to a workbench. We've got one right here, but any good shipwright's gonna have one.
translation: 如果你需要标准船体部件，就拿五块木板去工作台。我们这里就有一个，不过任何好船匠都会有一个。

english: If it's standard keel parts ya need, you'll wanna take five metal bars to any old anvil.
translation: 如果你需要标准龙骨部件，就拿五根金属条去任何铁砧。

english: For the larger hull parts or keel parts, don't overthink it. Just grab five of the standard parts and put them together in the same way!
translation: 至于更大的船体部件或龙骨部件，别想太复杂。就拿五个标准部件用同样的方式组装起来！

english: Obviously, some raw materials are rarer than others, and some of them ya might need to go sail that great blue marble to get.
translation: 显然，有些原材料比其他更稀有，有些你可能需要航行到那片蓝色大海才能获得。

english: Finally, if it helps ya at all, I've got some basic supplies for sale.
translation: 最后，如果对你有帮助的话，我有一些基本用品出售。

english: I might need help building things on my boat.
translation: 我可能需要帮助在船上建造东西。

english: Well, ya wouldn't be the first, sailor! I reckon ya probably won't be the the last either. Don't worry though, we can help ya out... for a price of course!
translation: 嗯，你不是第一个，水手！我想你也不会是最后一个。不过别担心，我们可以帮你……当然得收费！

english: And what sort of price should I expect?
translation: 那我应该预期什么样的价格？

english: Well, that there depends on how hard the job is. The more skills needed, the more money you're gonna need to part with.
translation: 嗯，那得看工作有多难。需要的技能越多，你要花的钱就越多。

english: So you're telling me you won't be able to spare your best shipwrights?
translation: 所以你是说你无法派出最好的船匠？

english: Yeah I'd say that's a good way of putting it. In general, we'll only be able to help ya with things that use less fancy materials. Mithril and mahogany are gonna be the limit.
translation: 对，这么说挺准确的。一般来说，我们只能帮你处理使用较普通材料的东西。秘银和红木是上限了。

english: We're also only gonna be able to help ya with the more standard parts and facilities, so hulls, sails, helms, keels, cannons, salvaging hooks and cargo holds.
translation: 我们也只能帮你处理更标准的部件和设施，比如船体、帆、舵、龙骨、火炮、打捞钩和货舱。

english: I see. So once things start to get complicated, I'm going to have to do it myself?
translation: 我明白了。所以一旦事情变得复杂，我就得自己动手了？

english: Afraid so, sailor. Oh, and don't forget that even when we're helping ya out, we're still gonna need ya to supply the materials.
translation: 恐怕是这样，水手。哦，别忘了即使我们帮你，你仍然需要提供材料。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: See ya later, sailor.

translation: 从我出生那一刻起，我所知道的只有梦魇。每晚她都会吞噬我们，用无法理解的恐怖填满我们的思想。

translation: 白天，我们的战士会进入她在岛下洞穴中的巢穴。我们不指望能击败她，我们知道，但我们的生存取决于确保她不会变得太强大。

translation: 他们告诉我一群萨满进行了一场未知的仪式，希望获得强大的力量。但仪式出错了，反而将梦魇释放到了这个世界。

english: So why were you the only one to come here?
translation: 那为什么只有你一个人来这里？

english: We took up arms against the Nightmare because we had to, not because we wanted to. We are a peaceful race, and most were all too eager to lay down their weapons once the Nightmare was gone.
translation: 我们拿起武器对抗梦魇是因为不得不，不是因为想。我们是一个和平的种族，一旦梦魇消失，大多数人都迫不及待地放下武器。

english: So why didn't you?
translation: 那你为什么没有？

english: My kind believe in something called Mo Kal. It means that anything bad that could happen, will happen. The others may have forgotten this, but I have not.
translation: 我的族人相信一种叫做莫卡尔的东西。意思是任何可能发生的坏事都会发生。其他人可能忘记了这一点，但我没有。

english: The Nightmare may have left my home, but I won't rest until I know for sure that she can never return.
translation: 梦魇可能已经离开了我的家园，但在我确定她永远不会回来之前我不会休息。

english: Do you have any of my items?
translation: 你有我的任何物品吗？

english: Doesn't look like it. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.
translation: 看起来没有。如果我确实有你的任何物品，但你在收集前死了，它们现在会丢失。

english: I do. Try to be more careful with them next time.
translation: 我有。下次试着小心点。

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: Good luck.
translation: 祝你好运。

english: Hey! Don't just go poking her without knowing what you're up against. Come talk to me first.
translation: 嘿！别在不知道面对什么的情况下就去戳她。先来跟我谈谈。

english: What's going on here?
translation: 这里发生了什么事？

english: Nothing good. This dungeon is tainted and has become the new home of the Nightmare.
translation: 没什么好事。这个地牢被污染了，成了梦魇的新家。

english: The Nightmare?
translation: 梦魇？

english: A being of pure darkness. No living creature is safe from her hunger. She feasts upon her victims while they sleep, draining their energy without even needing to touch them.
translation: 一个纯粹黑暗的存在。没有生物能免于她的饥饿。她在受害者睡觉时吞噬他们，甚至无需接触就能吸取他们的能量。

english: Those that she feeds upon experience horrifying nightmares, unlike anything you could possibly imagine. Eventually, they become too weak to even wake. Death claims them soon after.
translation: 那些被她吞噬的人会经历可怕的噩梦，超出你所能想象。最终，他们变得太虚弱甚至无法醒来。死亡很快就会降临。

english: Nightmares? Hence the name?
translation: 噩梦？所以叫这个名字？

english: Indeed. Our kind are not always the most creative.
translation: 确实。我们这类人并不总是最有创意的。

english: So how did she end up here?
translation: 那她怎么到这儿的？

english: For generations, she terrorised the island of Ashihama, my home. I lost a lot of good friends to her. Sometimes, I even thought I would lose myself. For some, the nightmares become too much to bear.
translation: 数代以来，她恐怖统治着阿什哈马岛，我的家乡。我失去了很多好朋友给她。有时，我甚至以为我会失去自我。对有些人来说，噩梦变得难以承受。

english: Some of us refused to give in though. Everything has a weakness, including the Nightmare, and eventually we found it. We drove her off the island, but she managed to endure.
translation: 但我们中有些人拒绝屈服。万物皆有弱点，包括梦魇，最终我们找到了。我们把她赶出了岛，但她设法撑住了。

english: The people here are ill, suffering from a deep sleep from which few wake. They call it the Sleeper Plague. The illness made these people easy prey for the Nightmare, so she made this place her new home.
translation: 这里的人病了，遭受着一种很少有人能醒来的沉睡。他们称之为沉睡瘟疫。这种疾病使这些人成为梦魇的易捕猎物，所以她把这地方当成了新家。

english: And you followed her here?
translation: 然后你跟着她到了这里？

english: While she still exists, my home will never be truly safe. Thanks to the Sleeper Plague, her power has grown faster than it ever did on Ashihama. If she is allowed to grow too strong, there won't be any way to stop her.
translation: 只要她还存在，我的家乡就永远不会真正安全。多亏沉睡瘟疫，她的力量比在阿什哈马时增长得更快。如果让她变得太强，将无法阻止她。

english: I've managed to contain her within this section of the dungeon. She has no desire to leave for the moment. She has no need to, after all.
translation: 我设法把她控制在地牢的这个区域。她目前没有离开的欲望。毕竟她不需要。

english: But make no mistake, I won't be able to stop her if she decides to move on.
translation: 但别搞错，如果她决定离开，我将无法阻止她。

english: She doesn't look too dangerous at the moment.
translation: 她目前看起来不太危险。

english: Looks can be deceiving. The battle with the Nightmare is a mental one, not a physical one. If you try to take her on, she will pull you into her dream - one where she makes the rules.
translation: 外表会骗人。与梦魇的战斗是精神层面的，不是物理层面的。如果你试图对抗她，她会把你拉进她的梦境——一个她制定规则的地方。

english: But if it's a dream, how can it be dangerous?
translation: 但如果是梦，怎么会危险？

english: It's her dream, not yours. Dying in her dream will destroy your mind, killing you in this world as well.
translation: 那是她的梦，不是你的。在她的梦中死亡会摧毁你的心智，也会杀死你这个世界的身体。

english: Sounds lovely. So how can we stop her?
translation: 听起来真棒。那我们怎么阻止她？

english: If you're willing to help, enter her dream and fight to keep her at bay. Our only hope is to prevent her from growing too strong.
translation: 如果你愿意帮忙，进入她的梦境并战斗以遏制她。我们唯一的希望是防止她变得太强。

english: You can go in alone, but I wouldn't recommend it. The more support you have, the better your chances.
translation: 你可以单独进去，但我不建议。支援越多，机会越大。

english: How do I keep her at bay?
translation: 我怎么遏制她？

english: There are four totems in the area that can be used to harm her. First, you'll need to take down her shield for the totems to have an effect. Once her shield is down, use your energy to charge up the totems.
translation: 区域里有四个图腾可以用来伤害她。首先，你需要破除她的护盾让图腾生效。一旦护盾破了，用你的能量给图腾充能。

english: She won't sit about while you do this though, so you'll need to take care if you want to survive.
translation: 不过在你做这些时她不会坐着不动，所以如果你想活下来得小心。

english: And what's in it for me if I do survive?
translation: 那我活下来有什么好处？

english: You mean apart from saving the world? She's claimed many victims over the years. I'm sure she's claimed many items as well. Maybe some of them will be of value to you.
translation: 你是说除了拯救世界？多年来她掠夺了许多受害者。我相信她也掠夺了许多物品。也许有些对你有价值。

english: Works for me. I'd better get started then.
translation: 对我来说行。那我最好开始了。

english: Good luck. Return to me if you need more information.
translation: 祝你好运。如果需要更多信息回来找我。

english: Sorry, but I don't have anything for you. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.
translation: 抱歉，但我没什么给你的。如果我确实有你的任何物品，但你在收集前死了，它们现在会丢失。

english: I think Sister Senga has your possessions instead, actually.
translation: 其实我想是你的物品在森加姐妹那里。

english: Hey! I have some of your things. You should come get them before fighting the Nightmare.
translation: 嘿！我有你的一些东西。你应该在打梦魇前来拿。

english: The Nightmare pulls you into her dream as you approach her.
translation: 当你靠近她时，梦魇把你拉进她的梦境。

english: Tell me about the Nightmare.
translation: 跟我说说梦魇。

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 跟我说说你自己。

english: Do you have any of my items?
translation: 你有我的任何物品吗？

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Do you need something?
translation: 你需要什么吗？

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: Well I have lots to do, so good day.
translation: 嗯我有很多事要做，所以日安。

english: Hello, Siamun?
translation: 你好，西亚穆恩？

english: What?
translation: 什么？

english: So you are Siamun then?
translation: 那你是西亚穆恩？

english: Yes now what do you want?
translation: 是的，现在你想要什么？

english: Wow, are you this friendly to everyone?
translation: 哇，你对谁都这么友好吗？

english: Just you. Now what do you want?
translation: 就对你。现在你想要什么？

english: A mutual friend of ours, Ali Morrisane, wants you to supply his stall in Al Kharid with your garments.
translation: 我们共同的朋友，阿里‧莫里桑，想让你给他的阿尔卡里德摊位供应你的服装。

english: Now why would I do that?
translation: 那我为什么要那样做？

english: Well for one, you'd probably sell more clothes and once the people of Al Kharid see your amazing works of tailoring, I'm sure they'd spread the word of your clothes far and wide.
translation: 嗯首先，你可能会卖出更多衣服，一旦阿尔卡里德城的人民看到你惊人的裁缝作品，我相信他们会把你的衣服名声传遍四方。

english: Interesting, but I would need more materials to accomplish what you ask of me.
translation: 有趣，但我需要更多材料来完成你要求的事。

english: Well then what do you need?
translation: 那你需要什么？

english: Either get me 3 pots of dye, or 3 animal pelts of the same variety and whatever you do, don't bring me any certs.
translation: 要么给我3罐染料，要么3张同种动物皮，无论做什么，别给我带任何票据。

english: What do you mean by animal pelt?
translation: 你所说的动物皮是什么意思？

english: Just get me 3 cowhides, 3 wolf or snake skins or the shearings of 3 sheep. Simpler still get me 3 pots of dye and whatever you do, don't bring me any certs.
translation: 就给我弄3张牛皮，3张狼皮或蛇皮，或者3份羊毛。更简单点是给我3罐染料，无论做什么，别给我带任何票据。

english: Ok, I'll get you the materials.
translation: 好的，我去给你弄材料。

english: Unless you've got the materials on you?
translation: 除非你身上就有材料？

english: Ummm.. No.
translation: 嗯……不。

english: Keh! Come back when you have what I need.
translation: 咳！有了我需要的东西再回来。

english: Yup, I've got what you want with me.
translation: 是的，我身上有你想要的。

english: You give the merchant the [dye/animal pelts].
translation: 你把 [dye/animal pelts] 给商人。

english: Thank you adventurer. I will get my goods up to that merchant thief - Ali Morrisane as quickly as possible.
translation: 谢谢你冒险者。我会尽快把我的货给那个商人小偷——阿里‧莫里桑。

english: Think nothing of it. I'm looking forward to seeing what you've produced for the Al Kharid market.
translation: 别客气。我期待看到你在阿尔卡里德市场生产的东西。

english: Hello Siamun.
translation: 你好西亚穆恩。

english: Have you got what I asked for yet?
translation: 你拿到我要的东西了吗？

english: A hello would have been nice.
translation: 打个招呼会更好。

english: Look I'm not nice, now did you get what I asked for or not?
translation: 听着我不友善，你到底拿到我要的东西了没？

english: Umm... What do you need again?
translation: 嗯……你需要什么来着？

english: Just get me 3 cowhides, 3 wolf or snake skins or the shearings of 3 sheep. Simpler still just get me 3 pots of dye and whatever you do, don't bring me any certs.
translation: 就给我弄3张牛皮，3张狼皮或蛇皮，或者3份羊毛。更简单点是给我3罐染料，无论做什么，别给我带任何票据。

english: Ok.
translation: 好的。

english: You give the merchant the [dye/hides].
translation: 你把 [dye/hides] 给商人。

english: Hello adventurer. Have you checked with Ali M whether my garments are selling or not?
translation: 你好冒险者。你跟阿里 M 确认过我的衣服卖得怎么样吗？

english: Not yet, I have a few things to do first.
translation: 还没有，我有几件事要先做。

english: Well I would be very much obliged if you could have a talk with him sooner rather than later, I'm not all that sure of the trustworthiness of those carpet men.
translation: 嗯如果你能尽快跟他谈谈我会非常感激，我不太确定那些魔毯人的可信度。

english: Don't worry, I'll get to it.
translation: 别担心，我会去的。

english: Hello adventurer. How are sales going?
translation: 你好冒险者。销售怎么样？

english: Not too bad, Ali was well impressed by the reaction and demand they had initially but he's a little concerned about how the sales have dropped off of recent.
translation: 不错，阿里对最初的反应和需求印象深刻，但他有点担心最近销量下滑。

english: Hmmm... Maybe I could produce a different range of products.
translation: 嗯……也许我可以生产不同系列的产品。

english: I tell you what, get me 3 animal pelts of the same variety and I'll change the shipments around and whatever you do, don't bring me any certs.
translation: 我告诉你，给我弄3张同种动物皮，我会改变发货，无论做什么，别给我带任何票据。

english: I'll tell you what, get me 3 pots of dye and I'll change the type of garments I'm sending to Ali and whatever you do, don't bring me any certs.
translation: 我告诉你，给我弄3罐染料，我会改变发给阿里的服装类型，无论做什么，别给我带任何票据。

english: What are you doing?
translation: 你在做什么？

english: I thought this acne potion might help ease your itching.
translation: 我想这个祛痘药水可能有助于缓解你的瘙痒。

english: Get away from me! I don't want your strange potions!
translation: 离我远点！我不想要你的奇怪药水！

english: Sorry.
translation: 抱歉。

english: What do you mean by animal pelt?
translation: 你所说的动物皮是什么意思？

english: Ok, I'll get you the materials.
translation: 好的，我去给你弄材料。

english: Umm... What do you need again?
translation: 嗯……你需要什么来着？

english: Ok.
translation: 好的。

english: Hey! You look like quite the sharp shooter. Can I interest you in a new bow?
translation: 嘿！你看起来是个神射手。对新弓感兴趣吗？

english: Let's see what you've got.
translation: 看看你有什么。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Well, if ya change your mind, I'll be right here.
translation: 嗯，如果你改变主意，我就在这儿。

english: Let's see what you've got.
translation: 看看你有什么。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Hello there and welcome to the shop of useful items. Can I help you at all?
translation: 你好，欢迎来到实用物品店。我能帮你吗？

english: What are you selling?
translation: 你在卖什么？

english: Take a look.
translation: 看看。

english: Do you sell Silverlight?
translation: 你卖银光剑吗？

english: Silverlight? No, Sir Prysin of Varrock explained that that was a unique sword and told us to stop selling it. If you want Silverlight, but don't have it, you should speak to him.
translation: 银光剑？不，维洛克城的普里辛爵士解释说那是把独特的剑，告诉我们停止出售。如果你想要银光剑但没有，应该跟他说话。

english: So would you like to see what else I have?
translation: 那你想看看我还有什么吗？

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Okay. Well, if you change your mind, do pop back.
translation: 好的。嗯，如果你改变主意，确实回来看看。

english: What are you selling?
translation: 你在卖什么？

english: Do you sell Silverlight?
translation: 你卖银光剑吗？

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: I'd be very careful going down there friend.
translation: 朋友，去下面我会非常小心。

english: Why what's down there ?
translation: 为什么，下面有什么？

english: Salarin the twisted. One of Kandarin's most dangerous chaos druids. I tried to take him on, then suddenly felt immensely weak.
translation: 扭曲的萨拉多明。坎达林王国最危险的混沌德鲁伊之一。我试图对付他，然后突然感到极度虚弱。

english: I hear he's susceptible to attacks from the mind. However I have no idea what that means, so it's not much help to me.
translation: 我听说他易受精神攻击。但我不知道那是什么意思，所以对我没太大帮助。

english: Fear not, I am very strong
translation: 别怕，我很强

english: You might find you are not so strong shortly...
translation: 你可能很快发现自己没那么强……

english: Why what's down there?
translation: 为什么，下面有什么？

english: Fear not, I am very strong
translation: 别怕，我很强

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: Can I help you?
translation: 我能帮你吗？

english: I was just curious as to what you do around here.
translation: 我只是好奇你在这里做什么。

english: I protect other travellers from monsters, both animal and human kind.
translation: 我保护其他旅行者免受怪物侵害，包括动物和人类。

english: Human? Can't say I've seen many human shaped monsters in the Wilderness.
translation: 人类？不能说我在荒野见过很多人形怪物。

english: When you've been in the Wilderness as long as I have, you learn that not all monsters show themselves on the outside.
translation: 当你在荒野待得像我一样久，你会学到不是所有怪物都表现在外表。

english: Uhm... alright then, I'll leave you to your duties.
translation: 嗯……好吧，那我不打扰你履行职责了。

english: Watch yourself out there, it can be hard to tell friend from foe in these lands.
translation: 在外面小心，在这片土地上很难分辨敌友。

english: Well done! I have new information to share with you.
translation: 做得好！我有新消息跟你分享。

english: I do not speak to outerlanders. If you have anything of import to say, go and speak to the Chieftain.
translation: 我不跟外乡人说话。如果你有什么重要的话要说，去跟酋长说。

english: Hello there. I have some spined dagannoth hides, and believe you might be able to make an armour of them for me...?
translation: 你好。我有一些棘深潜者皮，相信你可能能为我做些护甲……？

english: My apologies outerlander, but we are forbidden by decree to communicate with those not of our tribe, and this includes making armour for you.
translation: 抱歉外乡人，但法令禁止我们与部落外的人交流，包括为你制作护甲。

english: I suggest you speak to Brundt, our chieftain. He resides in the longhall and speaks for us all.
translation: 我建议你跟我们的酋长布伦特说话。他住在长厅，代表我们所有人。

english: Hello again Sigli.
translation: 又见面了，西格利。

english: Hello again to you [Fremennik name]. How goes the hunt?
translation: 又见面了 [Fremennik name]。狩猎进展如何？

english: The hunt? I've already done your task! That's why I'm a Fremennik now!
translation: 狩猎？我已经完成你的任务了！那就是为什么我现在是费明尼克人！

english: You think so do you? The Draugen is always out there, just as I and my hunters are always on its trail to keep it at bay.
translation: 你这么认为？德拉根总是在外面，就像我和我的猎人总是追踪它以遏制它。

english: The hunt will never end until I do.
translation: 狩猎永远不会结束，直到我结束。

english: That is fine, [Fremennik name]. What type of armour were you looking for?
translation: 那很好，[Fremennik name]。你在找什么类型的护甲？

english: It will cost you 5,000 coins to make that for you. Is that acceptable?
translation: 为你制作那个需要5,000金币。可以接受吗？

english: Sorry, [Fremennik name]. I will need 1 piece of dark dagger-mouth hide, 1 circular light dagger-mouth hide and 5,000 coins to make you a hunter's helmet.
translation: 抱歉，[Fremennik name]。我需要1张黑匕首口皮，1张圆形浅匕首口皮和5,000金币为你制作猎人头盔。

english: When you have them, I will still be here.
translation: 当你有了它们，我还会在这里。

english: It will cost you 10,000 coins to make that for you. Is that acceptable?
translation: 为你制作那个需要10,000金币。可以接受吗？

english: I'm sorry, but I need 3 pieces of dark dagger-mouth hide, 1 flattened hide and 10,000 coins to make you some hunter's body armour.
translation: 抱歉，但我需要3张黑匕首口皮，1张扁平皮和10,000金币为你制作猎人身体护甲。

english: I will still be here when you have obtained it.
translation: 当你获得它时，我还会在这里。

english: It will cost you 7,500 coins to make that for you. Is that acceptable?
translation: 为你制作那个需要7,500金币。可以接受吗？

english: That should do for any hunter! Did you want another set of hunters legs?
translation: 那应该够任何猎人用了！你想要另一套猎人腿甲吗？

english: My apologies but I will need 2 pieces of dark dagger-mouth hide, 1 stretched hide and 7,500 coins to make you some leg armour...
translation: 抱歉但我需要2张黑匕首口皮，1张拉伸皮和7,500金币为你制作腿甲……

english: Actually, I don't want anything
translation: 其实，我什么都不想要

english: ASyou wish.
translation: 如你所愿。

english: You're more than welcome.
translation: 不用客气。

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

translation: 我是西蒙娜，我正试着在这火旁取暖。

translation: 哦，没什么特别的，我们都在躲避吸血鬼，在这个鬼地方艰难度日，希望很快我们就能足够强壮，前往萨尔韦神庙。

translation: 啊！你的罪孽！它们闪瞎我！

translation: 哦，那个老混蛋？他还活着？哼。我不知道我有没有兴致管这事。

translation: 哦，这行有钱赚。我只是不怎么被邀请参加派对罢了。

translation: 你让我对邪恶阴谋兴奋了一番，现在却只是信任问题。我真的懒得为此费神。

translation: 看什么看，鸡骨头？你不是有个将军要去找吗？

translation: 哦？让我们看看……

english: I found this pretty necklace.
translation: 我发现了这条漂亮的项链。

english: Interesting...yes...yes...hmmm.... It looks like it's enchanted.
translation: 有趣……是的……是的……嗯……它看起来被附魔了。

english: With what?
translation: 用什么附魔？

english: Oh, I think it's just a benign teleportation spell. I tinker in magic when I'm not doing archaeology. I can teach you how to make more necklaces like this. Amazing that they had this kind of knowledge back then.
translation: 哦，我想只是个无害的传送法术。我不做考古时会捣鼓魔法。我可以教你怎么做更多这样的项链。真惊人，他们那时就有这种知识。

english: That would be good. Where is the teleport to?
translation: 那太好了。传送到哪？

english: Hmm...all the indications are that it's somewhere to the east of us, but I'm not sure how far. Perhaps it was a teleport back to Saranthium. Let me just take a closer look.
translation: 嗯……所有迹象表明它在我们东边某处，但我不确定有多远。也许是传回萨兰提姆的。让我再仔细看看。

english: So I just make a ruby necklace and use five fire runes and one cosmic rune to enchant it.
translation: 所以我只要制作一条红宝石项链，然后用五个火符石和一个宇宙符石附魔它。

english: Yes, indeed. Well done, youngster, thanks for helping us.
translation: 是的，确实。干得好，年轻人，谢谢帮我们。

english: I've cleaned this old coin - is it of any use?
translation: 我清理了这枚古币——有用吗？

english: Oh my! What a wonderful find! If this is what I believe it to be, it would allow us to date the Dig Site city.
translation: 天哪！多棒的发现！如果这是我相信的那样，它能让我们确定挖掘点城市的年代。

english: And look here, it has the name of the city too! Saranthium! That must be during the Saradominist occupation. This is a wonderful find. Please take it and place it in display case 45.
translation: 看这里，还有城市名字！萨兰提姆！那一定是在萨拉多明教徒占领时期。这是个极好的发现。请把它放在45号展示柜里。

english: Right, display case 45 it is...
translation: 好的，就放45号展示柜……

english: Back again? Have you put the old coin in display case 45 yet?
translation: 又来了？你把古币放进45号展示柜了吗？

english: No, I'll go do that now
translation: 没，我现在就去放。

english: You've already shown me one of those, but it was in better condition. It's in the display case over there. You can pop this one in the finds crate over in the corner.
translation: 你已经给我看过一个了，但那个状况更好。它在那边的展示柜里。你可以把这个放进角落的出土物箱子里。

english: I found this really old coin - is it of any use?
translation: 我发现了这枚非常古老的硬币——有用吗？

english: What have we here?
translation: 我们这里有什么？

english: Oh! This is very interesting...and confusing at the same time. This coin means that the city that we're excavating on the Digsite - Saranthium - was actually inhabited much, much earlier by followers of Zamorak,
translation: 哦！这非常有趣……同时也令人困惑。这枚硬币意味着我们在挖掘点挖掘的城市——萨兰提姆——实际上早在更早之前就被扎莫拉克信徒居住过，

english: at which time, the city was known as Senntisten.
translation: 那时，这座城市被称为森提斯坦。

english: This is a most remarkable discovery, as we have other evidence indicating that Zarosian followers were resident before the Saradominists took over, but it also seems that Zamorakian forces used it during a battle of some
translation: 这是个最非凡的发现，因为我们有其他证据表明扎罗斯信徒在萨拉多明教徒接管之前就居住在这里，但似乎也表明扎莫拉克军队在某场战斗中使用了它

english: sort. Still, it allows us to roughly date when the city changed from following Zaros and Zamorak to following Saradomin. Put it in display case 44.
translation: 之类。不过，它让我们能大致确定城市从追随扎罗斯和扎莫拉克转变为追随萨拉多明的时间。把它放进44号展示柜。

english: Case 44 it is!
translation: 就放44号柜！

english: Back again? Have you put the ancient coin in display case 44 yet?
translation: 又来了？你把古币放进44号展示柜了吗？

english: No, I'll go do that now.
translation: 没，我现在就去放。

english: I found this crumbly old decoration - is it of any use?
translation: 我发现了这个易碎的古老装饰品——有用吗？

english: Ahh... That looks like an altar piece. Hmm, yes...from the early Saradominist worshippers by the looks of it. Quite delicate, too. Put it in display case 37.
translation: 啊……那看起来像个祭坛部件。嗯，是的……看起来来自早期的萨拉多明教徒崇拜者。相当精致。把它放进37号展示柜。

english: Case 37 it is!
translation: 就放37号柜！

english: Back again? Have you put the ancient symbol in display case 37 yet?
translation: 又来了？你把古老符号放进37号展示柜了吗？

english: I found this really old decoration - is it of any use?
translation: 我发现了这个非常古老的装饰品——有用吗？

english: Wow!
translation: 哇！

english: That's in rather good condition, isn't it? An old altar decoration by the looks of things, from the Saradominist city no doubt. Put it in display case 36.
translation: 这状况相当不错，不是吗？看起来是个古老的祭坛装饰，无疑来自萨拉多明教徒城市。把它放进36号展示柜。

english: Case 36 it is!
translation: 就放36号柜！

english: Back again? Have you put the old symbol in display case 36 yet?
translation: 又来了？你把古老符号放进36号展示柜了吗？

english: I found this piece of pottery - is it of any use?
translation: 我发现了这块陶器——有用吗？

english: Ahh... Oh! Hmm...yes...made by Zaros worshippers, by the looks of it. Beautifully-shaped. It looks as if this would go nicely in display case 22. This piece reinforces our evidence that the city was occupied by
translation: 啊……哦！嗯……是的……看起来是扎罗斯崇拜者制作的。形状优美。看起来很适合放进22号展示柜。这件物品加强了我们的证据，表明这座城市在萨拉多明教徒之前

english: Zarosians before Saradominists.
translation: 被扎罗斯信徒占领。

english: Case 22 it is!
translation: 就放22号柜！

english: Back again? Have you put the pottery in display case 22 yet?
translation: 又来了？你把陶器放进22号展示柜了吗？

english: I found these old arrowheads.
translation: 我发现了这些古老箭头。

english: Ahh, yes, we find lots of those - they're not important. We already have some in our display. Just add it to the crate of finds over near the door.
translation: 啊，是的，我们发现很多那种——它们不重要。我们展示柜里已经有一些了。把它加到门附近的出土物箱子里就行。

english: If there is anything already in the crate, feel free to take it as a reward for your work.
translation: 如果箱子里已经有东西，随便拿一个作为你工作的奖励。

english: Oh, okay.
translation: 哦，好的。

english: Take a look at this...
translation: 看看这个……

english: I found these old necklaces.
translation: 我发现了这些古老项链。

english: An interesting find... Here, let me offer you something in return.
translation: 有趣的发现……来，我给你点东西作为回报。

english: Oh! Okay.
translation: 哦！好的。

english: I cleaned up this old vase.
translation: 我清理了这个古老花瓶。

english: Ah, the vases... I've lost count of how many we've found of those... The only completely intact one is in the display case already. Just add it to the crate of finds over near the door.
translation: 啊，花瓶……我都数不清我们找到多少个了……唯一完全完好的那个已经在展示柜里了。把它加到门附近的出土物箱子里就行。

english: Right.
translation: 好的。

english: Err... I seem to have lost it. Sorry.
translation: 呃……我好像把它弄丢了。抱歉。

english: Sounds like you never had it, [lad/lass]!
translation: 听起来你从来没有过，[小伙子/姑娘]！

english: No, just here to watch.
translation: 不，只是来看看。

english: Thank you, but I don't need that
translation: 谢谢，但我不需要那个

english: Yes, how can I help out?
translation: 是的，我怎么帮忙？

english: I found something interesting.
translation: 我发现了有趣的东西。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: My name iz Vlad. I come from far avay, vere the sun iz not so bright.
translation: 我叫弗拉德。我来自远方，那里的阳光不那么明亮。

english: You're a vampyre aren't you?
translation: 你是吸血鬼，对吧？

english: Just because I can't stand ze smell ov garlic und I don't like bright sunlight doesn't necessarily mean I'm ein vampyre!
translation: 就因为我受不了大蒜味而且不喜欢强烈阳光，并不一定意味着我是吸血鬼！

english: Is it nice there?
translation: 那里好吗？

english: It is vonderful! Ze beautiful und ze nights are long!
translation: 那里棒极了！景色美丽而且夜晚漫长！

english: So... you like fishing?
translation: 那么……你喜欢钓鱼吗？

english: My doctor told me to take up ein velaxing hobby. Vhen I am stressed I tend to get ein little...
translation: 我的医生告诉我培养个放松的爱好。当我压力大时我倾向于变得有点……

english: ..thirsty.
translation: ……口渴。

english: If you get thirsty you should drink something.
translation: 如果你口渴了应该喝点东西。

english: I tsink I may do zat soon...
translation: 我想我很快就会那么做……

english: Well, good luck with the fishing.
translation: 嗯，祝你钓鱼好运。

english: Luck haz notsing to do vith it it iz all in ze technique.
translation: 运气与此无关，全凭技巧。

english: Uurrggh! Get zat horrible tsing avay from me! How do people like to eat zat stuff? I can't stand even to be near it for tsen zeconds!
translation: 呃啊啊！把那可怕的东西拿开！人们怎么会喜欢吃那种东西？我甚至连靠近它十秒钟都受不了！

english: Umm... sorry
translation: 嗯……抱歉

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: You're a vampyre aren't you?
translation: 你是吸血鬼，对吧？

english: Is it nice there?
translation: 那里好吗？

english: So you like fishing?
translation: 所以你喜欢钓鱼？

english: So... you like fishing?
translation: 那么……你喜欢钓鱼吗？

english: If you get thirsty you should drink something.
translation: 如果你口渴了应该喝点东西。

english: Well, good luck with the fishing.
translation: 嗯，祝你钓鱼好运。

english: Hello Sir Amik.
translation: 你好阿米克爵士。

english: Hello, friend!
translation: 你好，朋友！

english: Well [player name], now that you are a White Knight, I expect you should be out there hunting Black Knights for us!
translation: 嗯 [player name]，既然你现在是白骑士了，我期望你应该出去为我们猎杀黑骑士！

english: Sadly we are not as rich as we once were, and there are many White Knights who foolishly lose their combat equipment.
translation: 可惜我们不像以前那么富有了，而且有许多白骑士愚蠢地弄丢了他们的战斗装备。

english: We do not think it fair to make a profit from our brethren, so we will sell you equipment at cost, and rebuy it at the same cost, but we will only sell equipment to those we consider responsible enough to
translation: 我们认为从同袍身上牟利不公平，所以我们会按成本价卖给你装备，并按相同成本价回购，但我们只把装备卖给那些我们认为足够负责任能

english: wield it correctly.
translation: 正确使用它的人。

english: By killing Black Knights, you will increase your reputation with us, by killing White Knights we will obviously think less of you.
translation: 通过杀死黑骑士，你会增加在我们这里的声誉，通过杀死白骑士我们显然会看低你。

english: You can check your White Knight reputation level by looking at your quest journal for the Wanted! Quest, or Sir Vyvin will let you know what level you are at when you go to purchase equipment.
translation: 你可通过任务日志中的''通缉！''任务查看白骑士声誉等级，或前往购买装备时由维文爵士告知当前等级。

english: Sir Vyvin can be found in Falador Castle, and he will sell you any equipment appropriate to your reputation level.
translation: 可以在法拉多城堡找到维文爵士，他会根据你的声誉等级卖给你任何合适的装备。

english: Have fun, and go kill some Black Knights for me!
translation: 玩得开心，去为我杀些黑骑士吧！

english: Okay Amik, thanks for explaining!
translation: 好的阿米克，谢谢解释！

english: Okay, bye!
translation: 好的，再见！

english: Okay, 'bye then Amik!
translation: 好的，再见了阿米克！

english: Can you explain the White Knight honour system again?
translation: 你能再解释一下白骑士荣誉系统吗？

english: May I help you?
translation: 我能帮你吗？

english: I'm really just looking for a quest...
translation: 我真的只是在找任务……

english: Fortune favours us both then adventurer. I suggest you go and speak to King Arthur.
translation: 看来命运眷顾你我，冒险者。我建议你去与亚瑟王谈谈。

english: Merlin's in a crystal. Little help?
translation: 梅林被困水晶里，能帮个小忙吗？

english: That is what we were hoping for from you, adventurer!
translation: 那正是我们对你所期望的，冒险者！

english: Hmmm. Well, ok, thanks anyway.
translation: 嗯。好吧，不管怎样谢谢。

english: I don't suppose you have any idea how to break into Mordred's fort do you?
translation: 我想你不知道怎么闯入莫德雷德的堡垒吧？

english: I am afraid not. Would that we could! Mordred and his cronies have been thorns in our side for far too long already!
translation: 恐怕不知道。要是我们知道就好了！莫德雷德和他的党羽已经成为我们的眼中钉太久了！

english: Ok. Thanks. See you later!
translation: 好的。谢谢。回头见！

english: Take care adventurer, Mordred is an evil and powerful foe.
translation: 保重冒险者，莫德雷德是个邪恶而强大的敌人。

english: Know anything about Excalibur?
translation: 知道关于王者之剑的事吗？

english: Um... it's a really good sword?
translation: 嗯……是把很好的剑？

english: Know where I can find it?
translation: 知道我在哪能找到它吗？

english: Nope, sorry.
translation: 不知道，抱歉。

english: All Knights of the Round thank you for your assistance in this trying time for us.
translation: 所有圆桌骑士都感谢你在这段艰难时期对我们的协助。

english: You are looking for the Grail now adventurer?
translation: 你现在在寻找圣杯吗，冒险者？

english: Absolutely.
translation: 当然。

english: The best of luck to you! Make the name of Camelot proud, and bring it back to us.
translation: 祝你好运！让卡美洛的名字为之骄傲，并把它带回来给我们。

english: How did you let a bunch of Black Knights get the better of you? I thought you guys were the toughest knights around.
translation: 你们怎么让一群黑骑士占了上风？我以为你们是最硬的骑士。

english: We are true knights who fight for honour. Those Black Knights didn't fight fair, so we were unprepared. Most unchivalrous of them.
translation: 我们是為荣誉而战的真正骑士。那些黑骑士战斗不公平，所以我们毫无准备。他们太不骑士了。

english: If we break out of this cell, do you reckon you can take on the Black Knights in the keep?
translation: 如果我们逃出这个牢房，你认为你能对付城堡里的黑骑士吗？

english: You just let me at them. We'll see how they like surprise attacks.
translation: 你只管让我对付他们。我们看看他们喜不喜欢突袭。

english: How are you going to get all of us out of here?
translation: 你打算怎么把我们所有人都弄出去？

english: I'm not sure yet. Have you got any useful objects in your pockets?
translation: 我还不确定。你口袋里有什么有用的东西吗？

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

english: I already gave you everything I had in my pockets.
translation: 我已经把口袋里所有东西都给你了。

english: Let me out! Let me out, I say!
translation: 放我出去！我说放我出去！

english: Give me an R. Give me an O. Give me a U..
translation: 给我个 R。给我个 O。给我个 U……

english: In the amount of time it will take you to spell out Round Table Knights, you could have found the Grail.
translation: 在你拼出圆桌骑士的这段时间里，你本可以找到圣杯了。

english: What am I supposed to do with that?
translation: 我该拿那个怎么办？

english: Thank you for your assistance in our time of need.
translation: 感谢你在我们需要时的协助。

english: You're welcome.
translation: 不用客气。

english: Good day to you [sir/madam]!
translation: 你好 [先生/女士]！

english: Good day.
translation: 你好。

english: Know you of any quests sir knight?
translation: 你知道有什么任务吗，骑士爵士？

english: The king is the man to talk to if you want a quest.
translation: 如果你想要任务，国王是你要找的人。

english: I think you've done the main quest we were on right now...
translation: 我想你已经完成了我们目前的主要任务……

english: Good day.
translation: 你好。

english: Know you of any quests sir knight?
translation: 你知道有什么任务吗，骑士爵士？

english: Good morrow [madam/sirrah]!
translation: 早安 [女士/先生]！

english: Morning. Know where an adventurer has to go to find a quest around here?
translation: 早。知道冒险者要去哪才能在这里找到任务吗？

english: An adventurer eh? There is no service finer than serving the bountiful King Arthur, and I happen to know there's an important quest to fulfill.
translation: 冒险者嗯？没有什么服务比侍奉慷慨的亚瑟王更好了，我碰巧知道有个重要任务要完成。

english: Sir Knight! Many thanks for your assistance in restoring Merlin to his former freedom!
translation: 骑士爵士！非常感谢你协助恢复梅林的自由！

english: We owe you a great debt for freeing us from that dungeon.
translation: 你把我们从那个地牢救出来，我们欠你一大笔债。

english: Awww, shucks. It was nothing.
translation: 哎呀，没什么。这只是小事。

english: A valiant effort!
translation: 英勇的努力！

english: I have a question for you.
translation: 我有个问题问你。

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
translation: 请输入问题的答案。

english: No, try again.
translation: 不，再试一次。

english: Correct!
translation: 正确！

english: Greetings! I am Sir Lancelot, the greatest Knight in the land! What do you want?
translation: 你好！我是兰斯洛特爵士，这片土地上最伟大的骑士！你想要什么？

english: You're a little full of yourself aren't you?
translation: 你有点太自大了吧？

english: I have every right to be proud of myself.
translation: 我完全有权利为自己骄傲。

english: My prowess in battle is world renowned!
translation: 我在战斗中的英勇举世闻名！

english: I seek a quest!
translation: 我寻求任务！

english: Leave questing to the professionals.
translation: 把任务留给专业人士。

english: Such as myself.
translation: 比如我自己。

english: Sir Knight! Many thanks for your assistance in restoring Merlin to his former freedom!
translation: 骑士爵士！非常感谢你协助恢复梅林的自由！

english: Humph. You are indeed a better knight than I first suspected.
translation: 哼。你确实比我最初怀疑的要像个更好的骑士。

english: Gee, it was nothing saving you all from the clutches of Morgan Le Faye and freeing your King.
translation: 哎呀，把你们从摩根‧勒‧菲的魔爪中救出来并释放你们的国王只是小事。

english: You're a little full of yourself aren't you?
translation: 你有点太自大了吧？

english: I seek a quest!
translation: 我寻求任务！

english: Hello there adventurer.
translation: 你好冒险者。

english: I'm looking for a quest...
translation: 我在找任务……

english: Talk to the King then adventurer. He is always looking for men of bravery to aid him in his actions.
translation: 那就跟国王谈谈，冒险者。他总是在寻找勇敢的人来协助他的行动。

english: Congratulations on freeing Merlin!
translation: 恭喜释放梅林！

english: That was a grand adventure. I can see why you make it your profession.
translation: 那是场伟大的冒险。我明白你为什么以此为业。

english: I think you should stick to being a knight.
translation: 我想你应该坚持做骑士。

english: Hello there adventurer, what do you want of me?
translation: 你好冒险者，你想要我做什么？

english: I'd like some advice on finding a quest.
translation: 我想要一些关于寻找任务的建议。

english: I do not know of any myself... but it would perhaps be worth your while asking the King if he has any tasks for you.
translation: 我自己不知道有什么……但也许值得你去问问国王是否有任务给你。

english: After your help freeing Merlin, my help is the least I can offer as a man of honour.
translation: 在你帮助释放梅林之后，作为一个荣誉之人，我能提供的帮助只是微不足道的。

english: Nothing right now, but I'll bear it in mind. Thanks.
translation: 现在没什么，但我会记住的。谢谢。

english: I was glad to get my revenge on those knights in the keep. They were no match for us.
translation: 我很高兴能向城堡里的那些骑士复仇。他们不是我们的对手。

english: Makes you wonder how they kidnapped you in the first place.

english: Good day Proselyte. Is there anything I can do for you?
translation: 你好，见习骑士。有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: Sorry old bean but we are still in the process of organising.
translation: 抱歉老伙计，但我们还在组织过程中。

english: I'm sure that we will have something for you soon, so please feel free to check back later. Anything else I can do for you in the meantime?
translation: 我相信我们很快会有东西给你，所以请稍后再来看看。在此期间有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: I have news on that assassin who attacked Entrana.
translation: 我有关于那个袭击恩特纳岛的刺客的消息。

english: Ah yes, you've been helping out the Ardougne authorities I hear.
translation: 啊是的，我听说你一直在帮助阿多尼城当局。

english: You knew?
translation: 你知道？

english: Of course! Knowledge is my business, old bean, and it pays to know what's happening across the other kingdoms.
translation: 当然！知识是我的生意，老伙计，了解其他王国发生的事情是值得的。

english: Now, as for your assassin, quite messy stuff, what? We've been trying to track him down ever since the Entrana incident, but he's proven quite the tricky one to pin down. Curious him showing up in Ardougne.
translation: 现在，关于你的刺客，相当棘手的事，对吧？自从恩特纳岛事件以来我们一直在试图追踪他，但事实证明他很难被锁定。他在阿多尼城出现很奇怪。

english: What are your plans?
translation: 你们的计划是什么？

english: Sadly, very little. Until we can learn more about what he's up to, we don't have much to go on. You have nothing to fear though, we'll find him sooner or later!
translation: 可惜，很少。在我们了解更多他的动向之前，我们没有太多线索。不过你没什么可怕的，我们迟早会找到他！

english: Now, anything else you need, [milady/sirrah]?
translation: 现在，你还需要什么，[女士/先生]？

english: Well did you also know he was a Mahjarrat?
translation: 嗯，你还知道他是玛哈拉拉特吗？

translation: 玛哈拉拉特！你一定在开玩笑，对吧？

translation: 他叫斯利斯克。你听说过他吗？

translation: 斯利斯克，嗯？我们有许多玛哈拉拉特的档案，但我必须承认，这名字对我来说是新的。真差劲！我得看看档案里藏了什么。

english: While you're there, it might be worth looking up something called the Elder Horn. It's an artefact that Sliske has now claimed. One that has the ability to control minds.

translation: 你说控制思想的神器？听起来我得向高层报告这个。看不出他们会对此太兴奋。谢谢你的更新，老伙计。

english: A mind controlling artefact you say? First Lucien and the Stone, and now this! The top brass will need to be made aware. Can't see them being too thrilled about it. Thank you for the update, old bean.

english: And when I say personally favoured, I don't mean that sometime off in the future he's going to buy us all a drink!

english: You are at Peon level within the White Knights, not much to choose from I'm afraid.
translation: 你在白骑士中处于苦力等级，恐怕没什么可选的。

english: And it is so very rare that I see any White Knight who has reached Adept level!
translation: 而且很少见到有白骑士能达到专家等级！

english: Well of course! I AM the White Knights armourer after all!

english: And for a dedicated White Knight to have reached Master level like yourself, you get only the very best of all equipment available!

……什么？

english: I'm... not sure what you're asking me... you want to join the White Knights?
translation: 我……不确定你在问什么……你想加入白骑士吗？

english: Nope. I'm just trying to distract you.
translation: 不。我只是想分散你的注意力。

english: ... ...you are very odd.
translation: ……你真奇怪。

english: So can I distract you some more?
translation: 那我能再分散你一会儿注意力吗？

english: ... ...I don't think I want to talk to you anymore.
translation: ……我想我不想再跟你说话了。

english: Ok. My work here is done. 'Bye!
translation: 好的。我的工作完成了。再见！

english: Excellent work! I have new information to share with you.
translation: 干得好！我有新消息跟你分享。

english: You're not done yet! Do this for me!
translation: 你还没完呢！帮我做这个！

english: The black knights can do puzzles better than that!
translation: 黑骑士解谜都比那强！

english: Excellent work!
translation: 干得好！

english: Here you go.
translation: 给，拿好。

english: You are handed a torn part of a clue scroll.
translation: 你获得了一张线索卷轴碎片。

translation: 白骑士链甲腿甲

translation: 这是什么地方？

english: This is a branch of the Bank of Gielinor. We have branches in many towns.
translation: 这是基利诺尔银行的一个分行。我们在许多城镇有分行。

english: And what do you do?
translation: 那你做什么？

english: We will look after your items and money for you. Leave your valuables with us if you want to keep them safe.
translation: 我们会为你保管物品与金钱。若想确保贵重物品安全，可交由我们保管。

english: Hi, I...
translation: 嗨，我……

english: What are you doing here, Fremennik?!
translation: 你在这里做什么，费明尼克人？！

english: I have a Seal of pass...
translation: 我有通行印玺……

english: No You do not! Begone!
translation: 不你没有！滚开！

translation: 我想查看我的银行账户。

english: I'd like to check my PIN settings.
translation: 我想检查我的PIN设置。

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: Greetings, traveller.
translation: 问候旅行者。

english: What's with all these Oathbreakers?
translation: 这些背誓者是怎么回事？

english: Gah! A bunch of fanatical cultists. Nothing more.
translation: 呸！一群狂热的邪教徒。仅此而已。

english: You don't sound impressed?
translation: 你听起来不太满意？

english: No! Well I wouldn't be, would I? I've spent my whole life dedicated to my sect. I dreamed of one day entering the Sanctuary and finally meeting Mother!
translation: 不！嗯我也不会，对吧？我一生都奉献给了我的教派。我梦想着有一天能进入圣所，终于见到母亲！

english: Yet instead I'm greeted by this condescending 'Lord' who feels I could try being 'a little more chaotic' for once.
translation: 然而取而代之的是，我被这位居高临下的“领主”迎接，他觉得我可以试着“稍微混乱一点”。

english: I see...
translation: 我明白了……

english: And to top it all off, Mother hasn't awoken at all. I fear she is probably being held captive by this Nightmare, or worse.
translation: 更糟糕的是，母亲根本没有醒来。我担心她可能被这个梦魇囚禁了，或者更糟。

english: The only things these oafs are breaking is my head with their silent stares and furious hand-talk.
translation: 这些蠢货唯一让我头疼的，就是他们那沉默的凝视和愤怒的手势。

english: I'm sorry your day hasn't been going well.
translation: 很抱歉你今天过得不好。

english: Ah... Thank you, traveller. Are you here to fight the Nightmare?
translation: 啊……谢谢你，旅行者。你是来对抗梦魇的吗？

english: We'll see. Sounds pretty tough.
translation: 走着瞧吧。听起来相当艰难。

english: I'll pray for you.
translation: 我会为你祈祷。

english: They seem to be carrying dangerous weapons.
translation: 他们似乎携带着危险的武器。

english: Indeed. Speaking of weapons, I assume you have heard of the immensely powerful orbs the Nightmare is protecting?
translation: 确实。说到武器，我想你听说过梦魇守护的那些极其强大的宝珠？

english: Yes I have. In fact, I've managed to beat the Nightmare myself.
translation: 是的我听说过。事实上，我已经成功击败了梦魇。

translation: 总之，既然你听说了宝珠，我想你也听说过更强大的阿什哈马重击锤？

english: The what?
translation: 什么？

english: The Smashyhammer of Ashihama.
translation: 阿什哈马粉碎锤。

english: But you just said...
translation: 但你刚才说……

english: ...Trashyhammer of Ashihama. Yes, I know what I said.
translation: ……阿什哈马垃圾锤。是的，我知道我说了什么。

english: Wha-
Slashyhammer?
translation: 劈砍锤？

english: That doesn't even make sense.
translation: 那甚至说不通。

english: Dashyhammer? Mashyhammer?
translation: 猛冲锤？捣碎锤？

english: Flashyhammer?
translation: 闪光锤？

english: Too far. I'm done.
translation: 太过了。我受够了。

english: What's with the mask?
translation: 那个面具是怎么回事？

english: These are the masks of the Sisterhood. While symbolic, they also have practical uses.
translation: 这些是修女会的面具。虽然具有象征意义，但它们也有实际用途。

english: Oh really? What like?
translation: 哦真的吗？比如什么？

english: Herbs can be stored within the beak, masking the smell of death and preventing us from becoming infected.
translation: 草药可以储存在喙内，掩盖死亡的气味并防止我们被感染。

translation: 那听起来很方便。我能要一个吗？

english: You ask too many questions.
translation: 你问的问题太多了。

english: Is that a yes?
translation: 那是同意吗？

english: It's a no. To wear a mask of the Sisterhood, you need to join the Sisterhood.
translation: 是不行。要佩戴修女会的面具，你需要加入修女会。

english: What is the Sisterhood?
translation: 什么是修女会？

english: An ancient order, born right here in Slepe.
translation: 一个古老的组织，就诞生在斯莱普这里。

english: Well sign me up!
translation: 那给我报名！

english: You lack the qualities we're currently looking for. Perhaps another time.
translation: 你缺乏我们目前寻找的品质。也许下次吧。

english: Tell me more about the Sisterhood.
translation: 多告诉我一些关于修女会的事。

english: Many years ago, the Sisterhood were a group of healers dedicated to Saradomin.
translation: 许多年前，修女会是一群致力于萨拉多明的治疗者。

english: However, our leader, a justiciar known as Phosani, saw the truth in Saradomin's teachings and turned away from his false light.
translation: 然而，我们的领袖，一位名叫福萨尼的审判官，看到了萨拉多明教义中的真相，并背离了他的虚假之光。

translation: 福萨尼拥抱了扎莫拉克的荣耀，我们组织的大多数人也一样。从那以后，她被称为审讯官，尽管我们组织称她为“母亲”。

english: After the order reached enlightenment through Zamorak, we made our home in an abandoned hermitage. Over time, that hermitage grew into the town you see today.
translation: 在组织通过扎莫拉克获得启蒙后，我们在一座废弃的隐修院安了家。随着时间的推移，那座隐修院发展成了你今天看到的城镇。

english: What happened to those that refused to turn away from Saradomin?
translation: 那些拒绝背离萨拉多明的人怎么样了？

english: They were shown the error of their ways through fire and blood.
translation: 他们通过火与血认识到了自己道路的错误。

english: How wonderful.
translation: 真美妙。

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！

translation: 我在这里建了这座教堂，以便战士们在战前前来祈祷。忽视精神需求的战士无异于自残双足。

english: People keep claiming they're not interested in religion, but as soon as they're under attack they're yelling for 'Protect from Melee'. Sad, really.
translation: 人们总是声称对宗教不感兴趣，但一旦受到攻击，他们就会大喊“保护免受近战”。真可悲。

english: So is there something I can do for you?
translation: 那么有什么我能为你做的吗？

english: So whose sister are you?
translation: 那你是谁的姐妹？

english: Ahahahahahaha, very funny! With jokes like that, you should become a banker.
translation: 哈哈哈哈哈哈，真有趣！有这种笑话水平，你应该去当银行职员。

english: But no I am a sister to the broken and down trodden, I heard talk of this enclave being built and knew that my skills could be put to good use.
translation: 但不，我是破碎者和受压迫者的姐妹，我听说要建这个飞地，就知道我的技能可以派上用场。

english: I've found a worthy cause here running my little chapel, so I'm happy enough. Now, can I help you with something?
translation: 我在这里经营我的小教堂找到了有价值的事业，所以我很满足。现在，有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。

english: Actually, that's a bit of a sore point. Asgarnia has a building full of monks, all living happily as a community of brothers, but they don't let women join.
translation: 其实，那有点让人痛心。阿斯加尼亚有一座满是僧侣的建筑，他们都像兄弟社区一样快乐地生活，但他们不让女性加入。

english: I'd heard rumours that there was an Abbey up here somewhere, which sounded marvellous, but I seem to be in the wrong place.
translation: 我曾听说这附近某处有一座修道院，听起来很棒，但我似乎来错地方了。

english: Anyway, I've found a worthy cause here, running my little chapel, so I'm happy enough. Now, can I help you with something?
translation: 不管怎样，我在这里经营我的小教堂找到了有价值的事业，所以我很满足。现在，有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: So whose sister are you?
translation: 那你是谁的姐妹？

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。

english: Greetings, traveller.
translation: 你好，旅行者。

english: Tell me about the Nightmare.
translation: 跟我讲讲梦魇的事。

english: You're better off speaking with the Siren, that is her area of expertise. All I know is that the beast poses a huge risk to Mother.
translation: 你最好去和塞壬谈谈，那是她的专业领域。我只知道那头野兽对母亲构成了巨大的威胁。

english: At least for the moment, Mother is not in any direct danger. I fear it is only a matter of time before the beast enters her mind again though.
translation: 至少目前，母亲没有直接的危险。但我担心野兽再次侵入她的思想只是时间问题。

english: What's with the mask?
translation: 这面具是怎么回事？

english: These are the masks of the Sisterhood. While symbolic, they also have practical uses.
translation: 这是修女会的面具。虽然具有象征意义，但也有实际用途。

english: Oh really? What like?
translation: 哦真的吗？比如什么？

english: Herbs can be stored within the beak, masking the smell of death and preventing us from becoming infected.
translation: 草药可以储存在喙里，掩盖死亡的气味，防止我们被感染。

english: That sounds handy. Can I have one?
translation: 听起来很方便。能给我一个吗？

english: No. To wear a mask of the Sisterhood, you need to join the Sisterhood.
translation: 不行。要戴修女会的面具，你得加入修女会。

english: Well sign me up!
translation: 好吧，算我一个！

english: I'm afraid you lack the qualities we're currently looking for. Perhaps another time.
translation: 恐怕你缺乏我们目前寻找的特质。也许下次吧。

english: Do you have any of my items?
translation: 你有我的任何物品吗？

english: Sorry, but I don't have anything for you. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.
translation: 抱歉，我没有什么给你的。如果我确实有你的任何物品，但你在领取前死了，它们现在就已经丢失了。

english: I do, traveller. You should be more cautious with them.
translation: 我有，旅行者。你应该对它们更小心些。

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: Be safe, traveller.
translation: 一路平安，旅行者。

english: I would advise against doing that, traveller. You do not yet know what you are up against.
translation: 我不建议你那样做，旅行者。你还不知道你面对的是什么。

english: What are you doing up here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Keeping an eye on Mother.
translation: 照看着母亲。

english: Mother?
translation: 母亲？

english: Phosani, the founder of our sect and creator of this sanctuary. She is our mother, and always will be.
translation: 佛萨尼，我们教派的创始人和这座圣所的创造者。她是我们的母亲，永远都是。

english: I see... So where is she?
translation: 我明白了……那她在哪？

english: She lies in this coffin.
translation: 她躺在这口棺材里。

english: Oh... So she's dead?
translation: 哦……所以她死了？

english: Dead? No. She sleeps the everlasting slumber.
translation: 死了？不。她陷入了永恒的沉睡。

english: Right. The coffin looks pretty secure to me. Why do you need to keep an eye on her.
translation: 好吧。在我看来棺材挺安全的。你为什么需要照看着她。

english: The creature down there, the one that Siren calls the Nightmare. It has been invading Mother's mind, feeding on her.
translation: 下面的那个生物，塞壬称之为梦魇的那个。它一直在侵入母亲的意识，吞噬她。

english: Mother is strong, but not strong enough to fight it off alone. She needs help.
translation: 母亲很强大，但还不足以独自击退它。她需要帮助。

english: Needs help does she? Maybe I could be of assistance?
translation: 她需要帮助吗？也许我能帮上忙？

english: The offer is appreciated. Luckily for us though, the Nightmare is not present in Mother's mind at the moment.
translation: 感谢你的好意。不过幸运的是，梦魇此刻并不在母亲的意识中。

english: Fair enough. If that changes, I'm more than willing to help.
translation: 好吧。如果情况有变，我非常乐意帮忙。

english: The offer is appreciated. I fear you do not have the abilities to take on that sort of challenge though.
translation: 感谢你的好意。但我恐怕你没有能力应对那种挑战。

english: What abilities do I need?
translation: 我需要什么能力？

english: The horror that has manifested itself in Mother's mind is far stronger than the one fought in the Nightmare's dream.
translation: 在母亲意识中显现的恐怖远比在梦魇梦境中战斗的那个强大得多。

english: If you hope to have a chance, you'll want to take on the weaker form first. That Siren down there can help you.
translation: 如果你希望有机会，最好先对付较弱的形态。下面的塞壬可以帮你。

english: Fair enough. I'll be back once I have more experience.
translation: 好吧。等我有更多经验后会回来的。

english: That would be appreciated, traveller. You can use the pool here to enter Mother's mind and take on the Nightmare within.
translation: 那将不胜感激，旅行者。你可以利用这里的池子进入母亲的意识，对抗其中的梦魇。

english: Be warned though. If you enter, you enter alone. No one else can help you with this one.
translation: 不过要警告你。如果你进入，就是独自进入。没人能在这方面帮你。

english: I see. I'll have to be careful then.
translation: 我明白了。那我得小心点。

english: Indeed. Good luck, traveller.
translation: 确实。祝你好运，旅行者。

english: However, our leader, a justiciar known as Phosani, saw the truth in Saradomin's teachings and turned away from his false light.
translation: 然而，我们的领袖，一位名叫佛萨尼的审判官，看穿了萨拉多明教义中的“真相”，并背离了他的虚假之光。

english: They were shown the error of their ways through fire and blood.

english: What's wrong with that old man?

english: He's not looking great, is he? We fear he is a victim of the Sleeper Plague.

english: Sleeper Plague?
translation: 沉睡瘟疫？

english: Many years ago, this village was beset by a terrible plague. Those infected fell into a deep sleep, never to wake. Now we fear the plague has returned.
translation: 许多年前，这个村庄遭受了一场可怕的瘟疫。感染者陷入深度睡眠，再也无法醒来。现在我们担心瘟疫又回来了。

english: Do you any theories on why it's come back?
translation: 你对它为何卷土重来有什么看法吗？

english: Well, there's the strange man being accused out in the centre, but personally I think he's innocent.
translation: 嗯，中心那边有个奇怪的男人被指控，但我个人认为他是无辜的。

english: Hmm, so how long has the old man been asleep?
translation: 嗯，那老头睡了多久了？

english: Oh, I can't recall exactly, but at least a few weeks. He has spoken a few times though, in his sleep.
translation: 哦，我记不清确切时间了，但至少有几周了。不过他睡梦中说过几次话。

english: What did he say?
translation: 他说了什么？

english: It was nonsense, but I recall the words 'Inyetat' and 'Coshmar', whatever those means.
translation: 全是胡言乱语，但我记得“Inyetat”和“Coshmar”这两个词，不管那是什么意思。

english: How peculiar.
translation: 真奇怪。

english: How are things with the Sleeper Plague?
translation: 沉睡瘟疫的情况怎么样了？

english: The one responsible was found out and executed. We haven't had any new cases since.
translation: 责任人已被找出并处决。从那以后我们就没有新病例了。

english: I see... And what of those still ill?
translation: 我明白了……那那些还没好的人怎么办？

english: Well now that the cause has been dealt with, we can focus more heavily on a cure.
translation: 嗯，既然根源已经处理了，我们可以更专注于寻找解药。

english: And how long will that take?
translation: 那需要多久？

english: Well that depends...
translation: 嗯，那得看……

english: On what?
translation: 看什么？

english: On how things progress... down below.
