translation: 在教团通过扎莫拉克获得启蒙后，我们在一座废弃的隐修所安了家。随着时间的推移，那座隐修所发展成了你今天看到的城镇。

english: What happened to those that refused to turn away from Saradomin?
translation: 那些拒绝背离萨拉多明的人怎么样了？

english: They were shown the error of their ways through fire and blood.
translation: 他们通过火与血见识到了自己道路的错误。

english: How wonderful.
translation: 太美妙了。

english: What's going on here?
translation: 这里发生了什么事？

english: With this strange tattooed man? He is on trial.
translation: 关于这个奇怪的纹身男？他正在受审。

english: For what crime?
translation: 犯了什么罪？

english: It is suspected he might have caused the return of the Sleeper Plague.
translation: 怀疑他可能导致了沉睡瘟疫的回归。

english: Sleeper Plague?
translation: 沉睡瘟疫？

english: Yes. A long time ago, Slepe was beset by an illness called the Sleeper Plague. Those infected fell into a deep sleep, never to wake.
translation: 是的。很久以前，斯莱普遭受了一种叫做沉睡瘟疫的疾病困扰。感染者陷入深度睡眠，再也无法醒来。

english: But now it's back?
translation: 但现在它又回来了？

english: It would appear so. This man showed up in town around the same time the first victim fell ill. We fear this is no coincidence.
translation: 看来是这样。这个人在第一个受害者生病的同时出现在镇上。我们担心这不是巧合。

english: That doesn't make him guilty though.
translation: 但这并不意味着他有罪。

english: No. That is for the trial to determine.
translation: 不。那是审判要决定的事。

english: What happened to the tattooed man?
translation: 那个纹身男怎么了？

english: His trial has concluded. The citizens have passed their judgement.
translation: 他的审判已经结束。市民们已经做出了判决。

english: And?
translation: 然后呢？

english: The accused was found guilty of causing the return of the Sleeper Plague. He has now been executed.
translation: 被告被判犯有导致沉睡瘟疫回归的罪行。他现在已被处决。

english: Executed? That's pretty dark.
translation: 处决？那挺黑暗的。

english: Morytania is a dark place, traveller. If you wished for light, you should have picked a better holiday destination.
translation: 莫利塔尼亚是个黑暗的地方，旅行者。如果你想要光明，你应该选个更好的度假胜地。

english: So that's it?
translation: 就这样了？

english: Since the execution, we have had no new occurrences of the Sleeper Plague. So yes, that's it.
translation: 自从处决之后，我们就没有再发生沉睡瘟疫的新病例了。所以是的，就这样了。

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！

english: Be safe, traveller.
translation: 一路平安，旅行者。

english: What's with the mask?
translation: 这面具是怎么回事？

english: Tell me more about the Sisterhood.
translation: 多跟我讲讲修女会的事。

english: What's going on here?
translation: 这里发生了什么事？

english: What happened to the tattooed man?
translation: 那个纹身男怎么了？

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！

english: Hey...who gave you permission to come in here! Get out, get out I say.
translation: 谁允许你进来的！出去，给我出去！

english: Alright, alright...keep your night cap on.
translation: 好吧，好吧……别激动。

english: Hey! What do you think you're doing? Leave my tea alone!
translation: 嘿！你觉得你在做什么？别动我的茶！

english: Hey! What do you think you're doing? Don't go casting that kind of spell anywhere near my tea!  Leave my tea alone you telegrabbing fiend!
translation: 嘿！你觉得你在做什么？别在我的茶附近施那种法！别动我的茶，你这个隔空取物的恶魔！

english: Oh, so you're back then, come to gloat have you?
translation: 哦，所以你回来了，是来幸灾乐祸的吗？

english: Nope, I've just come to ask you a couple of questions.
translation: 不，我只是来问你几个问题。

english: How do I get rid of the undead ogres?
translation: 我怎么除掉亡灵食人魔？

english: Haven't I already explained this to you once before?
translation: 我以前不是已经跟你解释过一次了吗？

english: Humour me!
translation: 迁就我一下！

english: Ok, similar spells have been cast before and the only way to deal with the resulting creatures is to cordon off the area and not go in there again. The undead creatures usually manifest some sort of disease so it's
translation: 好的，以前施过类似的法术，处理由此产生的生物的唯一方法是封锁该区域并不再进入。亡灵生物通常会表现出某种疾病，

english: best to attack them from a distance with a ranged weapon.
translation: 所以最好用远程武器从远处攻击它们。

english: Normal missiles like arrows and darts do very little damage to them because they're designed to destroy internal organs. This is a waste of time with undead creatures like undead ogres.
translation: 像箭和飞镖这样的普通投射物对它们造成的伤害很小，因为它们是用来破坏内脏的。这对像亡灵食人魔这样的亡灵生物来说是浪费时间。

english: Yeah, clearly so what should we use?
translation: 是啊，很明显，那我们应该用什么？

english: From my research it looks like a flat ended arrow was designed called a 'Brutal arrow'. This does large amounts of crushing damage to the creature.
translation: 根据我的研究，似乎设计了一种平头箭，叫做“残暴箭”。这能对生物造成大量的挤压伤害。

english: You can make them by using larger arrows, I think some Ogre hunters make them. But instead of adding an arrow tip, you hammer a large nail into the end of the shaft.
translation: 你可以用更大的箭来制作它们，我想有些食人魔猎人会做。但不是加箭头，而是把一个大钉子锤进箭杆的末端。

english: How do I get rid of the disease?
translation: 我怎么除掉这种疾病？

english: Haven't I already explained this disease thing to you once before?
translation: 我以前不是已经跟你解释过这种病的事了吗？

english: Just tell me again or else I'll turn you back into an ogre!
translation: 再告诉我一次，否则我就把你变回食人魔！

english: No...noo...please, I'll tell you.
translation: 不……不……求你了，我会告诉你的。

english: My research shows that two jungle based herbs can be used, one is found near river tributaries and looks like a vine, the other is found in caves and grows on the wall.
translation: 我的研究表明可以使用两种丛林草药，一种在河流支流附近发现，看起来像藤蔓，另一种在洞穴中发现，长在墙上。

english: It's quite well camouflaged so it's unlikely that you'll find it.
translation: 它的伪装很好，所以你不太可能找到它。

english: We'll see about that!
translation: 我们走着瞧！

english: Sorry, I have to go.
translation: 抱歉，我得走了。

english: How do I get rid of the undead ogres?
translation: 我怎么除掉亡灵食人魔？

english: How do I get rid of the disease?
translation: 我怎么除掉这种疾病？

english: Sorry, I have to go.
translation: 抱歉，我得走了。

english: Krrrrsssss
translation: 咔嘶嘶嘶嘶

english: Krrrrsssss
translation: 咔嘶嘶嘶嘶

english: Are you all right? You seem a little...incoherent.
translation: 你还好吗？你看起来有点……语无伦次。

english: Inc'hearnt? Inc'herant! You...you...with yer fancy book- lernin' words. You'd be more than inc'herant if youd seen...
translation: 语无伦次？语无伦次！你……你……用你那花哨的书本词汇。如果你见过……你会更语无伦次！

english: (Dramatic pause)
translation: (戏剧性停顿)

english: THEM!
translation: 它们！

english: I'm sure I would as well.
translation: 我相信我也会的。

english: I'm going over here to talk to non-crazy people now.
translation: 我现在要去那边跟正常人说话。

english: Yeah? Yeah? Well when THEY come floppin' into your house and eat your furniture you'll be sorry!
translation: 是吗？是吗？好吧，等它们扑进你家吃掉你的家具时，你就会后悔了！

english: Who are
translation: 谁是

english: (Dramatic pause)
translation: (戏剧性停顿)

english: THEY?
translation: 它们？

english: They! Those bloodthirsty, flesh-tearing devils! They are the reason I'm out here every day hurlin' bottles into the sea!
translation: 它们！那些嗜血、撕肉的恶魔！它们就是我每天在这里往海里扔瓶子的原因！

english: They are the reason I've lost everything, except the horrifying memory of what THEY look like...
translation: 它们就是我失去一切的原因，除了它们样子的恐怖记忆……

english: And what do THEY look like?
translation: 那它们长什么样？

english: Mudskippers!
translation: 弹涂鱼！

english: Mudskippers?
translation: 弹涂鱼？

english: Aye, Mudskippers! Those ferocious, ravening, evil, beady-eyed terrors of the deep!
translation: 是的，弹涂鱼！那些凶猛、贪婪、邪恶、小眼睛的深海恐怖！

english: I...see...
translation: 我……明白了……

english: I was ambushed by them way back, see. They got the drop on me...I can't remember where, somewhere around here though.
translation: 很久以前我被它们伏击了，明白吗。它们偷袭了我……我不记得在哪了，大概就在这附近。

english: These would be the mudskippers, right?
translation: 这些就是弹涂鱼，对吧？

english: Aye! The mudskippers! Huge they were! Ten feet of glistening, muddy flesh floppin' towards me with white foam flying from their gnashing fangs!
translation: 是的！弹涂鱼！它们巨大无比！十英尺长的闪闪发光的泥泞肉体向我扑来，獠牙间飞溅着白色泡沫！

english: I fought them up and down the beach, with the tide rising and more of them leaping towards me with cutlasses drawn!
translation: 我在海滩上上下下与它们战斗，潮水上涨，更多的它们拔出弯刀向我跃来！

english: This is fascinating, but I have to be...
translation: 这很迷人，但我得……

english: Shut yer' word-hole and listen! I can't remember all the details, as I'm sure they must have hit me quite hard, but the last thing I remember before it all went black...
translation: 闭上你的嘴听我说！我不记得所有细节了，因为我确定它们肯定打我很重，但在一切变黑之前我记得的最后一件事……

english: ...was one of those devils rearing over me, its eyes glowin' red with the fires of hell!
translation: ……是其中一个恶魔俯身逼近我，它的眼睛因地狱之火而发出红光！

english: Fires of hell...right. I believe you.
translation: 地狱之火……好吧。我相信你。

english: No you don't! You think I'm crazy, like all the rest! Well, if I'm crazy, how did I get these?
translation: 不，你不信！你觉得我疯了，像其他人一样！好吧，如果我疯了，我是怎么得到这些的？

english: Get what?
translation: 得到什么？

english: Skippy shows you what appears to be massive bite scars on his legs. You're no expert, but they look like... giant mudskipper bites!
translation: 斯基皮向你展示了他腿上看起来像是巨大的咬痕。你不是专家，但它们看起来像……巨型弹涂鱼的咬痕！

english: Giant mudskipper bites! Where did you get those?
translation: 巨型弹涂鱼咬痕！你从哪弄到的？

english: I can't remember... I've been drinking to forget the horror, and all I seem to have forgotten is where it all happened...
translation: 我不记得了……我一直在喝酒以忘记恐怖，而我似乎唯一忘记的就是这一切发生在哪里……

english: Hmmm...I suppose if I sober you up you may well start to recall.
translation: 嗯……我想如果帮你醒酒，你可能会开始回忆起来。

english: You'll have a job. I've been drinking this for a week.
translation: 那你有的忙了。我已经喝这个一个星期了。

english: 'Captain Braindeath's Extra Strength Rum/Drain Cleaner. Now 50% more debilitating'?
translation: “脑死亡船长的特强朗姆酒/管道疏通剂。现在致残性增强50%”？

english: It's the extra sheep tranquilizers that gives it that added kick!
translation: 是额外的绵羊镇静剂给了它额外的劲头！

english: Stay here and I'll be right back. Try not to move. Or go near any open flames.
translation: 待在这，我马上回来。尽量别动，也别靠近任何明火。

english: You know, I could shock him out of it if I could find some cold water...
translation: 你知道，如果我能找到些冷水，我可以把他激醒……

english: Hey, Skippy.
translation: 嘿，斯基皮。

english: Hey you!
translation: 嘿！

english: How do I annoy the Mogres again?
translation: 我怎么再次惹恼摩格雷？

english: Go south to Mudskipper Point and lob a Fishing Explosive into the sea. You can grab them from the Slayer masters.
translation: 向南走到弹涂鱼点，把钓鱼炸弹扔进海里。你可以从杀戮大师那里拿到它们。

english: Thanks! So, what are you going to do now?
translation: 谢谢！那么，你现在打算做什么？

english: Well, I was planning on continuing my hobby of wandering up and down this bit of coastline, bellowing random threats and throwing bottles.
translation: 嗯，我打算继续我的爱好，在这段海岸线上来回游荡，大声吼出各种威胁并扔瓶子。

english: And you?
translation: 你呢？

english: I was planning on wandering up and down the landscape, bugging people to see if they had mindblowingly dangerous quests for me to undertake.
translation: 我打算在这片土地上游荡，烦扰人们看看他们是否有让我去执行的令人震惊的危险任务。

english: Well, good luck with that!
translation: 嗯，祝你好运！

english: You too!
translation: 你也一样！

english: Weirdo...
translation: 怪人……

english: Loony...
translation: 疯子……

english: I think he's sober enough. And I don't want to use another bucket of water.
translation: 我想他清醒得差不多了。而且我不想再用一桶水了。

english: Thanks! Now I have two right boots!
translation: 谢谢！现在我有两只右靴子了！

english: Do you wanna skip the Tutorial?
translation: 你想跳过教程吗？

english: Send me to the mainland now.
translation: 现在送我去大陆。

english: Right on. I'll read you the official messages first, then send you on your way. Ahem...
translation: 没问题。我先给你读官方消息，然后送你上路。咳咳……

english: I am now going to teleport you to Kourend Castle where your journey in the Twisted League will begin. Once you arrive, the Leagues Tutor will fill you in on how the Twisted League works. Good luck!
translation: 我现在要将你传送到库兰德城堡，你的扭曲联赛之旅将在那里开始。一旦你到达，联盟导师会向你介绍扭曲联赛的运作方式。祝你好运！

english: Prepare yourself!
translation: 做好准备！

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: My name's Skippy. Normally I live down by Rimmington.
translation: 我叫斯基皮。通常我住在里明顿村那边。

english: Although I guess you won't be able to get to Rimmington on this League world...
translation: 不过我想在这个联盟世界里你可能去不了里明顿村……

english: Just lately the Council wants to let people skip the Tutorial, so - ha ha ha - they dump the job on Skippy. Bah!
translation: 最近委员会想让人们跳过教程，所以——哈哈哈——他们把这工作丢给了斯基皮。呸！

english: So, anyway, do you want to skip the Tutorial?
translation: 所以，不管怎样，你想跳过教程吗？

english: Can I decide later?
translation: 我可以稍后再决定吗？

english: Sure. You'll find me all over this island. Ask me again any time you like.
translation: 当然。你会在这个岛上到处找到我。随时可以再问我。

english: I'll stay here for the Tutorial.
translation: 我会留在这里参加教程。

english: Good choice. Let me know if you change your mind.
translation: 好选择。如果你改变主意告诉我。

english: When you arrive on the mainland you will be a Deadman. If you die when skulled, or if you are killed by another Deadman you will lose the most valuable items from your bank.
translation: 当你到达大陆时，你将是一个死人模式玩家。如果你在骷髅状态下死亡，或者被另一个死人模式玩家杀死，你将失去银行中最有价值的物品。

english: To help you get started, you'll have 12 hours of immunity before anyone can attack you. Speak to the Doomsayer in Lumbridge to waive your immunity and get on with the killing!
translation: 为了帮助你起步，在任何人可以攻击你之前，你将有12小时的免疫时间。与仑桥镇的末日预言者交谈可放弃免疫，开始杀戮！

english: For more information, speak to Nigel in the Lumbridge graveyard. You may choose where to begin - where would you like to start?
translation: 欲知更多信息，请与仑桥镇墓地的奈杰尔交谈。你可以选择从哪里开始——你想从哪里开始？

english: You are teleported to your preferred starting location
translation: 你被传送到你选择的首选起始位置

english: My name's Skippy. Normally I live down by Rimmington. You should come and see me when you're passing.
translation: 我叫斯基皮。我通常住在里明顿村那边。你路过时应该来看看我。

english: I'm sure I would as well.
translation: 我相信我也会的。

english: Who are (Dramatic pause) THEY?
translation: 他们(戏剧性停顿)是谁？

english: Send me to the mainland now.
translation: 现在送我去大陆。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Can I decide later?
translation: 我可以稍后再决定吗？

english: I'll stay here for the Tutorial.
translation: 我会留在这里参加教程。

english: Lumbridge
translation: 仑桥镇

english: Varrock
translation: 维洛克城

english: Falador
translation: 法拉多

english: East Ardougne
translation: 东阿多尼城

english: Gnome Stronghold
translation: 地精要塞

english: :Gar mulno ful taglo!
translation: :Gar mulno ful taglo!

english: I do not thinke thou understand the depths of the darkness you have unleashed upon the world. To dub it in such a scintillant manner is offensive to mine being.
translation: 我不认为你理解你释放到这个世界上的黑暗有多深。用如此轻浮的方式称呼它是对我的冒犯。

english: So why are you following me around?
translation: 那你为什么跟着我？

english: Dark forces of which ye know nought have deemed that this is my geas.
translation: 你所不知的黑暗势力认为这是我的使命。

english: Your goose?
translation: 你的鹅？

english: *Sighs* Nae. But thine is well and truly cooked.
translation: 叹息 不。但你的确实完蛋了。

english: I am spawned of darkness. I am filled with darkness. I am darkness incarnate and to darkness I will return.
translation: 我生于黑暗。我充满黑暗。我是黑暗的化身，我将回归黑暗。

english: Sounds pretty... dark.
translation: 听起来很……黑暗。

english: Knowest thou not of the cursed place? Knowest thou not about the future yet to befall your puny race?
translation: 你难道不知道那被诅咒的地方吗？你难道不知道即将降临在你这渺小种族身上的未来吗？

english: Oh yes, I've heard that before.
translation: 哦是的，我以前听过。

english: Then it is good that ye can laugh in the face of the end.
translation: 那么你能在末日面前大笑是好事。

english: The end has a face? Which end?
translation: 末日有脸？哪个末日？

english: *Sighs* The darkness giveth, and the darkness taketh.
translation: 叹息 黑暗给予，黑暗索取。

english: Nothing. Ye are already tainted in my sight by the acts of light. However there may be some hope for you if you continue to aid the darkness.
translation: 没什么。在我眼中你已被光明之举污染。不过如果你继续帮助黑暗，或许还有些希望。

english: I do have a lantern around here somewhere.
translation: 我确实这里有盏灯。

english: Do not bring that foul and repellant thing near mine self.
translation: 别把那肮脏讨厌的东西靠近我。

english: A book of darkness? I don't usually read, but that seems like a good book!
translation: 黑暗之书？我通常不读书，但那看起来是本好书！

english: I told thee to keep thy filthy light away from me!
translation: 我告诉过你让你那肮脏的光远离我！

english: Darkness take ye.
translation: 黑暗带走你。

english: Rest in darkness.
translation: 安息于黑暗。

english: Let the darkness come forth.
translation: 让黑暗降临。

english: You look cute.
translation: 你看起来很可爱。

english: Where did you come from?
translation: 你从哪里来？

english: What can you do for me?
translation: 你能为我做什么？

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Good day.
translation: 你好。

english: Hey! Get your hands off there!
translation: 嘿！把手拿开！

english: Good day, Your Royal Highness.
translation: 你好，殿下。

english: Oi!
translation: 喂！

english: Rahr!
translation: 吼！

english: No!
translation: 不！

english: Grr!
translation: 咕噜！

english: Aargh!
translation: 啊啊！

english: I'm a gonner!
translation: 我完蛋了！

english: It's no use, I'm done for!
translation: 没用了，我死定了！

english: Uggh!
translation: 呃啊！

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: Sorry. I can't sell weapons to outerlanders. Wouldn't be right. Against our beliefs.
translation: 抱歉。我不能向外乡人出售武器。这不合适。违背我们的信仰。

english: Only Fremenniks may purchase weapons and armour here.
translation: 只有费明尼克人才能在这里购买武器和盔甲。

english: Hello again [Fremennik name]. Come to see what's for sale?
translation: 又见面了 [费明尼克名字]。来看看有什么卖的？

english: Oh, hello again. Want to buy some weapons?
translation: 哦，又见面了。想买些武器吗？

english: I'll have a look.
translation: 我看看。

english: Not right now.
translation: 现在不用。

english: I'll have a look.
translation: 我看看。

english: Not right now...
translation: 现在不用……

english: I think I'll give the Skullball Course a go.
translation: 我想试试骷髅球训练。

english: What are the instructions for using the skullball course?
translation: 使用骷髅球训练的说明是什么？

english: The skullball comes out of one of these four spawnholes. Just kick the ball through the middle of each goal, through the skeleton's feet.
translation: 骷髅球从这四个生成洞之一出来。只要把球踢过每个球门的中间，穿过骷髅的脚。

english: There are 10 goals, which you must complete in order, and one final goal.
translation: 有10个球门，你必须按顺序完成，还有一个最终球门。

english: An arrow will point to your ball, just in case lots of people are using the course at the same time as yourself.
translation: 会有箭头指向你的球，以防很多人同时使用课程。

english: The better your time, the more agillity XP you will be awarded. The timer starts when you score your first goal.
translation: 你的时间越好，获得的敏捷经验值就越多。计时器在你进第一个球时开始。

english: I seem to have lost my ball - can I have another one?
translation: 我好像把球弄丢了——能再给我一个吗？

english: No problem, here's another one. You'll have to start from the beginning again, but the timer will be restarted too.
translation: 没问题，再给你一个。你得从头开始，但计时器也会重新开始。

english: I give up, I can't do it - take my ball away.
translation: 我放弃了，我做不到——把球拿走吧。

english: Oh dear, such a defeatist.
translation: 哦天哪，真是个失败主义者。

english: Grrr - you don't belong in here, human!
translation: 嗷呜——人类，你不该待在这儿！

english: I would like to do the skullball course.
translation: 我想做骷髅球训练。

english: What are the instructions for the skullball course?
translation: 骷髅球训练的说明是什么？

english: What are the instructions for using the skullball course?
translation: 使用骷髅球训练场的说明是什么？

english: I seem to have lost my ball - can I have another one?
translation: 我好像把球弄丢了——能再给我一个吗？

english: I give up, I can't do it - take my ball away.
translation: 我放弃了，我做不到——把球拿走吧。

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: This is the Skullball Course.
translation: 这是骷髅球训练场。

english: You have truly gifted paws!
translation: 你真是有天赋的爪子！

english: I've never seen anything like it!
translation: 我从没见过这样的事！

english: You need a few more skullball lessons.
translation: 你需要再多上几节骷髅球课。

english: Keep it up!
translation: 继续保持！

english: Don't give up the day job!
translation: 别辞掉正职！

english: Look at [her/him] go!
translation: 看 [她/他] 的表现！

english: Pathetic!
translation: 真差劲！

english: What - a - goal !!!
That was just plain lucky.
translation: 那只是纯粹运气好。

english: [He/She] shoots - [He/She] scores!!!!!
Humans play skullball worse than puppies!
translation: 人类玩骷髅球比小狗还差！

english: The human's scored!
translation: 人类得分了！

english: Eyup. They call me Skully. I run this Wilderness Loot Chest. What can I do for you?
translation: 是的。他们叫我斯库利。我经营这个荒野战利品箱。有什么能帮你的？

english: Well, you know how when you kill someone all of their stuff just ends up in a pile on the floor and it's really hard to pick it all up quickly?
translation: 嗯，你知道当你杀死某人时，他们所有的东西都会堆在地上，很难快速全部捡起来吗？

english: Actually, I've never killed anyone else.
translation: 其实，我从未杀过其他人。

english: ...Oh. Well, when you do, all of their stuff just ends up in a pile on the floor and it's really hard to pick it all up quickly.
translation: ……哦。好吧，当你这么做时，他们所有的东西都会堆在地上，很难快速全部捡起来。

english: Yeah?
translation: 是吗？

english: So, I made an enchantment that teleports the loot to another dimension instead!
translation: 所以，我制作了一个咒语，把战利品传送到另一个维度！

english: How does that help?
translation: 那有什么用？

english: Well, instead of getting a pile of rubbish, you get a single key. You just take the key to this chest and BAM! There's your loot!
translation: 嗯，你不会得到一堆垃圾，而是得到一把钥匙。你只需把钥匙拿到这个箱子前，砰！你的战利品就出来了！

english: So the loot is safe in this other dimension?
translation: 所以战利品在这个另一个维度是安全的？

english: Eh, seems like it. As long as they've had the key, I've never had anyone unable to get the stuff back out. Though if you lose the key, you can't get the stuff out.
translation: 嗯，似乎是。只要他们有钥匙，我从没见过有人拿不出东西。不过如果你丢了钥匙，就拿不出东西了。

english: Oh, and be careful running about with too many keys on you. Other people will know you've got them, and I'm not gonna stop them opening the chest!
translation: 哦，还要小心身上带太多钥匙乱跑。别人会知道你有钥匙，我不会阻止他们开箱！

english: So if I kill someone and take their keys, I can use them myself?
translation: 所以如果我杀了人拿了他们的钥匙，我自己能用吗？

english: ...Eh, if you wanna think about it that way, sure.
translation: ……嗯，如果你想这么想，当然。

english: I got nothing better to do, so I'll keep track of the value of the stuff you unlock.
translation: 我没什么更好的事做，所以我会追踪你解锁物品的价值。

english: And anything you don't want, you can have the chest destroy it.
translation: 任何你不想要的东西，你可以让箱子销毁它。

english: Except the food. I'll eat that instead.
translation: 除了食物。我会吃掉它。

english: Now, if you want your own keys instead of relying on the misfortune of others, I can put the enchantment on you as well, but it's gonna cost ya.
translation: 现在，如果你想要自己的钥匙而不是依赖别人的不幸，我也可以给你施咒，但得要花钱。

english: Can I have access to the chest?
translation: 我能使用这个箱子吗？

english: So, if you have keys from someone else, you're more than welcome to put them in the chest and see what comes out.
translation: 所以，如果你有别人的钥匙，欢迎你把它们放进箱子看看能取出什么。

english: If you want the enchantment that makes the keys, I'm afraid it's gonna cost you 1 million coins.
translation: 如果你想要制作钥匙的咒语，恐怕要花你100万金币。

english: Sure, I'll pay for that.
translation: 当然，我会付钱。

english: Are you sure? 1 million is a lot of coins, and you won't get them back!
translation: 你确定吗？100万是很大一笔钱，而且你不会拿回来！

english: Hmm... I don't think you have enough money on you there, mate.
translation: 嗯……我觉得你身上没那么多钱，伙计。

english: Ok, let me just... and a bit of... and we're done! You'll now get loot keys whenever you kill someone in the Wilderness. Talk to me again if you have any questions.
translation: 好的，让我 just……再加一点……完成了！现在你在荒野杀死任何人时都会获得战利品钥匙。有问题再找我。

english: Fair enough mate, talk to me again if you change your mind.
translation: 好吧伙计，如果你改变主意再找我。

english: Not right now, thanks.
translation: 现在不用，谢谢。

english: Fair enough mate, want to talk about something else?
translation: 好吧伙计，想聊点别的吗？

english: How much?!
translation: 多少？！

english: 1 million coins.
translation: 100万金币。

english: Why do you charge so much?!
translation: 你为什么收这么多？！

english: Runes. People don't wanna deliver across the Wilderness, and I'm in no shape to go to them, so I have to pay through the nose.
translation: 符石。人们不想穿越荒野送货，我也没法去找他们，所以我得花大价钱。

english: I make maybe a couple hundred coins of profit, which at least lets me buy a few beers.
translation: 我大概赚几百金币利润，至少能买几杯啤酒。

english: Why is the beer so cheap if it's so expensive to get deliveries out here?
translation: 如果送货这么贵，为什么啤酒这么便宜？

english: The barman makes it himself with whatever scraps he can get his hands on.
translation: 酒保用他能找到的任何废料自己酿造。

english: You'd think it'd turn out horrible, but compared to every other 2 coin beer out there, it's not half bad.
translation: 你会以为会很糟糕，但比起外面其他2金币的啤酒，还算不错。

english: But enough about beer. If you want access to the loot keys, it's gonna cost you 1 million coins.
translation: 但别说啤酒了。如果你想使用战利品钥匙，要花你100万金币。

english: Can I change how these loot keys work?
translation: 我能改变这些战利品钥匙的工作方式吗？

english: Well, I can turn the enchantment that creates the loot keys on and off for you. Won't cost you anything to turn it back on again, either.
translation: 嗯，我可以为你开启或关闭制作战利品钥匙的咒语。重新开启也不会收费。

english: If you'd like it so stuff like food and potions stay out of the keys so you can use them yourself, I can do that too.
translation: 如果你希望食物和药水等物品不进入钥匙以便你自己使用，我也可以做到。

english: And if you like the feeling of picking up valuables, I can make it so that anything above a certain value hits the floor as well.
translation: 如果你喜欢捡贵重物品的感觉，我也可以让超过一定价值的物品掉在地上。

english: Ok, whenever you kill someone else now, their items will go to the floor like normal. Just remember, they could have loot keys on them, and they'll still go to your inventory!
translation: 好的，现在每当你杀死其他人时，他们的物品会像正常一样掉在地上。记住，他们身上可能有战利品钥匙，那些还是会进入你的物品栏！

english: Ok, you'll now get loot keys when you kill another person in the Wilderness.
translation: 好的，现在你在荒野杀死另一个人时会获得战利品钥匙。

english: Ok, food and potions will now be dropped to the floor instead of stored in a loot key.
translation: 好的，食物和药水现在会掉在地上而不是存入战利品钥匙。

english: Ok, food and potions will now be sent to your loot keys.
translation: 好的，食物和药水现在会发送到你的战利品钥匙。

english: Ok, valuable items will now be dropped to the floor instead of stored in a loot key.
translation: 好的，贵重物品现在会掉在地上而不是存入战利品钥匙。

english: Ok, valuable items will now be sent to your loot keys.
translation: 好的，贵重物品现在会发送到你的战利品钥匙。

english: Currently, if you were to have valuable items drop to the floor, they'd need to be worth at least [number]gp. What do you want to change that value to?
translation: 目前，如果你要让贵重物品掉在地上，它们需要至少价值 [number] 金币。你想把这个值改成多少？

english: Hmph. Yeah, real funny, wise guy.
translation: 哼。是啊，真有趣，聪明人。

english: Ok, now items worth at least [entered amount]gp will drop to the floor.
translation: 好的，现在价值至少 [entered amount] 金币的物品会掉在地上。

english: How much loot have I claimed?
translation: 我领取了多少战利品？

english: Well, seeing as you haven't claimed a key yet, I reckon you've claimed a total of 0gp worth of loot.
translation: 嗯，鉴于你还没领取过钥匙，我想你总共领取了价值0金币的战利品。

english: You've claimed 1 key, containing loot worth about [number]gp. I haven't seen you destroy anything of value yet, though.
translation: 你已领取1把钥匙，包含价值约 [number] 金币的战利品。不过我还没见你销毁过任何有价值的东西。

english: You've claimed 1 key, containing loot worth about [number]gp, and you destroyed everything of value.
translation: 你已领取1把钥匙，包含价值约 [number] 金币的战利品，并且你销毁了所有有价值的东西。

english: You've claimed [number] keys, containing loot worth about [number]gp. I haven't seen you destroy anything of value yet, though.
translation: 你已领取 [number] 把钥匙，包含价值约 [number] 金币的战利品。不过我还没见你销毁过任何有价值的东西。

english: You've claimed [number] keys, containing loot worth about [number]gp. You've destroyed [number]gp worth of it.
translation: 你已领取 [number] 把钥匙，包含价值约 [number] 金币的战利品。你已销毁价值 [number] 金币的物品。

english: You've claimed [number] keys, containing loot worth about [number]gp, and you destroyed everything of value.
translation: 你已领取 [number] 把钥匙，包含价值约 [number] 金币的战利品，并且你销毁了所有有价值的东西。

english: Who are you, exactly?
translation: 你到底是谁？

english: Ah, used to be an adventurer like you, I guess. Used to roam the world, killing monsters for a living. 'Cept then, I discovered the Wilderness.
translation: 啊，曾经是个像你一样的冒险者，我想。曾经周游世界，靠杀怪物为生。直到后来，我发现了荒野。

english: Used to take on anyone and everyone who stood in me way, and made myself a small fortune doing it too.
translation: 曾经挑战任何挡路的人，也因此赚了一小笔财富。

english: It's how I got the name, used to go anywhere and everywhere with a skull over my head!
translation: 我就是这样得到这个名字的，曾经头上顶着骷髅到处走！

english: So how'd you end up like... this?
translation: 那你怎么变成……这样的？

english: Ah, you live a life feeding on others, eventually something higher up the food chain finds you.
translation: 啊，你靠吞噬他人为生，最终食物链上更高级的东西会找到你。

english: I used to have a hidden outpost out near the Bone Yard, somewhere to keep my stuff in an emergency. One day all I come back to is a smouldering pile of rubble.
translation: 我曾经在骨园附近有个隐藏前哨，用来在紧急情况下存放物品。有一天我回来只看到一堆冒烟的废墟。

english: Next thing I know, someone's snuck up behind me and has put a spear through my back.
translation: 接下来我知道的是，有人悄悄从我背后靠近，把长矛刺穿了我的背。

english: And you survived?!
translation: 你活下来了？！

english: Always carry a ring of life, friend! Never know when you'll need it.
translation: 永远带着生命戒指，朋友！永远不知道什么时候需要它。

english: Still, the damage was done. Everything I ever owned up in smoke, and even though the wound's fully healed, I can still feel that spear in my back to this day.
translation: 不过，伤害已经造成。我所有的一切都化为乌有，即使伤口完全愈合，我至今仍能感觉到背上的那根长矛。

english: Thankfully, Ferox was kind enough to take me in, and I managed to repurpose some of my old storage magic for adventurers like you.
translation: 谢天谢地，费罗克斯好心地收留了我，我设法将一些旧的存储魔法改造成像你这样的冒险者使用。

english: But why come back to the Wilderness?
translation: 但为什么回到荒野？

english: What, go lifea normal life behind a shop counter so I can pedalswamp paste for a living instead? I'll pass!
translation: 什么，去过商店柜台后的正常生活，靠卖沼泽糊糊为生？我就算了！

english: Anyhow, enough about me. What can I do for you?
translation: 不管怎样，不说我了。有什么能帮你的？

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: I'll be here if you need anything.
translation: 如果你需要什么我在这里。

english: Don't waste my time trying to change settings on a thing you haven't bought yet!
translation: 别浪费我的时间试图更改你还没买的东西的设置！

english: I know you Iron people are weird about taking other people's stuff, so if you just wanna have the chest destroy it all, that's fine by me.
translation: 我知道你们铁人模式的人对拿别人的东西很古怪，所以如果你只想让箱子销毁所有东西，我没意见。

english: Except the food. I'm eating that instead.
translation: 除了食物。我会吃掉它。

english: Sorry mate, can't run the Loot Chest on a Deadman World.
translation: 抱歉伙计，不能在死人世界运行战利品箱。

english: How does the chest work?
translation: 箱子怎么运作？

english: Can I have access to the chest?
translation: 我能使用这个箱子吗？

english: Sure, I'll pay for that.
translation: 当然，我会付钱。

english: Yes, pay 1 million coins!
translation: 是的，付100万金币！

english: No, I've changed my mind!
translation: 不，我改变主意了！

english: Not right now, thanks.
translation: 现在不用，谢谢。

english: How much?!
translation: 多少？！

english: Can I change how these loot keys work?
translation: 我能改变这些战利品钥匙的工作方式吗？

english: Turn loot keys off
translation: 关闭战利品钥匙

english: Turn loot keys on
translation: 开启战利品钥匙

english: Drop food to floor
translation: 食物掉在地上

english: Send food to loot key
translation: 食物发送到战利品钥匙

english: Drop valuables to floor
translation: 贵重物品掉在地上

english: Send valuables to loot key
translation: 贵重物品发送到战利品钥匙

english: Change valuable item threshold
translation: 更改贵重物品阈值

english: How much loot have I claimed?
translation: 我领取了多少战利品？

english: Who are you, exactly?
translation: 你到底是谁？

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: So... tired...
The monkey looks a little too sleepy to talk to.
translation: 猴子看起来太困了，没法交谈。

english: Alright, mate. How's it going?
translation: 好吧，伙计。过得怎么样？

english: Er... Who are you?
translation: 呃……你是谁？

english: Sleve McDichael, mate.
translation: 斯莱夫‧麦克迈克尔，伙计。

english: What kind of name is Sleve McDichael?
translation: 斯莱夫‧麦克迈克尔是什么名字？

english: Came up with it myself, mate. I'm a bit of a naming specialist you see.
translation: 我自己想的，伙计。我算是个命名专家。

english: You are?
translation: 你是？

english: Aye. Tell you what, mate, you look like a bit of a sailor. Want me to rename your boat for you? Will only cost you a single glass of cider.
translation: 是的。告诉你，伙计，你看起来像个水手。想让我帮你重命名你的船吗？只要一杯苹果酒。

english: Could I not just rename it myself?
translation: 我不能自己重命名吗？

english: Well, have you?
translation: 嗯，你有吗？

english: No...
translation: 没有……

english: Well, there you go then.
translation: 嗯，那就对了。

english: I'd like to rename my boat.
translation: 我想重命名我的船。

english: Sure thing, mate. Which one do you want me to rename?
translation: 当然，伙计。你想让我重命名哪一艘？

english: Alright, the price is one glass of cider.
translation: 好的，价格是一杯苹果酒。

english: Oh, I don't have any cider.
translation: 哦，我没有苹果酒。

english: Crying shame, mate. A crying shame indeed.
translation: 真可惜，伙计。真是太可惜了。

english: Alright, mate, I name your boat... [new boat name]!
translation: 好吧，伙计，我把你的船命名为……[new boat name]！

english: I love it.
translation: 我喜欢。

english: Glad to hear it, mate.
translation: 很高兴听到，伙计。

english: I'm not a fan.
translation: 我不喜欢。

english: Sorry, mate. No refunds.
translation: 抱歉，伙计。不退款。

english: Actually, I'd rather not.
translation: 不，我还是算了。

english: How did you end up here?
translation: 你怎么到这里来的？

english: Was crew on some fancy merchant ship, but me and Biles went and fell off. Now we live here. It's just the two of us, but it's quite the effective kingdom we've established.
translation: 曾经是一艘豪华商船的船员，但我和拜尔斯掉下来了。现在我们住在这里。只有我们两个，但我们建立了一个相当有效的王国。

english: Kingdom?
translation: 王国？

english: Aye. Biles is the King. He's the one that runs things. Meanwhile, I handle the naming of everything.
translation: 是的。拜尔斯是国王。他负责管理事务。同时，我负责给所有东西命名。

english: I see...
translation: 我明白了……

english: I'd best be off.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: Until next time, mate.
translation: 下次见，伙计。

english: I'd like to rename my boat.
translation: 我想重命名我的船。

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: I love it.
translation: 我喜欢。

english: I'm not a fan.
translation: 我不喜欢。

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: How did you end up here?
translation: 你怎么到这里来的？

english: I'd best be off.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: Hello. Are you here for my black dragons?
translation: 你好。你是来找我的黑龙的吗？

english: I have a Slayer assignment to kill those, yes.
translation: 我有杀戮任务要杀那些，是的。

english: Fair enough. Do what you have to do.
translation: 好吧。做你该做的事。

english: They're not my Slayer target.
translation: 它们不是我的杀戮目标。

english: Oh, good. In that case you're welcome to go and admire them, but don't get any ideas about killing them.
translation: 哦，好。那样的话欢迎你去欣赏它们，但别动杀它们的念头。

english: Why are you here asking about that?
translation: 你为什么在这里问这个？

english: Because I like my black dragons, and I had to work hard to get access to their lair, and I don't want people using them for training without a reason.
translation: 因为我喜欢我的黑龙，我好不容易才进入它们的巢穴，我不希望人们无缘无故用它们训练。

english: So if one of the Slayer Masters sent you to slay black dragons, that's fine, but otherwise you should go and train elsewhere.
translation: 所以如果是杀戮大师派你来杀黑龙，那没问题，否则你应该去别处训练。

english: I'd rather people didn't train on my dragons at all, but I've got a distant cousin who's a Slayer Master, so I've got to support the family business.
translation: 我宁愿人们根本不用我的龙训练，但我有个远房表亲是杀戮大师，所以我得支持家族生意。

english: Excuse me, I've got to go.
translation: 抱歉，我得走了。

english: Hey, go and train somewhere else! I'm not having people mess with my dragons unless a Slayer Master's told them to do it.
translation: 嘿，去别处训练！我不允许人们乱动我的龙，除非杀戮大师让他们这么做。

english: I have a Slayer assignment to kill those, yes.
translation: 我有杀戮任务要杀那些，是的。

english: They're not my Slayer target.
translation: 它们不是我的杀戮目标。

english: Why are you here asking about that?
translation: 你为什么在这里问这个？

english: Excuse me, I've got to go.
translation: 抱歉，我得走了。

english: Ah don' talk to humans! Yous wanna talk, talk to da boss!
translation: 啊别跟人类说话！你们想说话，跟老板说！

english: He's too busy playing some succulent beats to stop and talk.
translation: 他正忙着演奏一些美味的节拍，没空停下来说话。

english: Ahhh, hello there, [player name].
translation: 啊，你好，[player name]。

english: Can you tell me a bit about skillcapes?
translation: 你能告诉我一些关于技能斗篷的事吗？

english: Sure. You can buy a skillcape when you reach level 99 in a skill. Apart from boosting your statistics in that skill, they can also be used to perform some pretty amazing emotes!
translation: 当然。当你在某项技能达到99级时可以购买技能斗篷。除了提升该技能的属性外，它们还可以用来表演一些非常惊人的表情动作！

english: The Cape of Strength also provides you with unlimited teleports to our guild. Is there anything else you would like to know?
translation: 力量斗篷还为你提供无限次传送到我们公会的功能。还有什么你想知道的吗？

english: What can I do here?
translation: 我在这里能做什么？

english: Ahh, the shot put is a great test of strength and can be quite rewarding. Mind you do it properly though, you might want to dust your hands with some powdery substance first. It'll give better grip.
translation: 啊，铅球是力量的绝佳测试，回报也很丰厚。不过要注意正确操作，你可能想先用一些粉末状物质擦手。这样抓握更好。

english: I'll remember that. What should I use?
translation: 我会记住的。我该用什么？

english: I personally prefer ground ashes, it makes a nice fine powder and gives some really good grip.
translation: 我个人喜欢骨灰，它能制成很好的细粉，抓握效果很好。

english: Ok, what else?
translation: 好的，还有什么？

english: Basically you'll need to go in there, make sure you've got nothing cluttering up your hands, pick up a shot and throw it.... depending upon your technique, you can get quite long throws.
translation: 基本上你需要进去，确保手里没拿其他东西，拿起铅球扔出去……根据你的技巧，你可以扔得很远。

english: What was your best?
translation: 你最好的一次是多少？

english: Ahh that would be telling...
translation: 啊那就不能说了……

english: That's a big axe!
translation: 那是把大斧头！

english: Yes indeed it is. Have to be mighty strong to wield it too.
translation: 确实是。挥舞它也需要非常强壮。

english: But you don't look that strong!
translation: 但你看起来没那么强壮！

english: Maybe, maybe not, but I still had to beat a Barbarian to get it. Mind you, usually they don't part with them. This was an unusual circumstance.
translation: 也许吧，也许不是，但我还是得打败一个野蛮人才能得到它。要知道，他们通常不会放手。这是特殊情况。

english: Oh?
translation: 哦？

english: I bet him he couldn't catch a squirrel whilst still holding his axe but that I could... and that if I won I'd get his axe.
translation: 我跟他打赌他拿着斧头时抓不到松鼠，但我可以……如果我赢了就能得到他的斧头。

english: What happened?
translation: 发生了什么事？

english: He went running after the squirrel... nearly caught it too... it shot up a tree and he tried to climb up it, only got a bit tangled up with his axe cause he couldn't hang on to it at the same time... he fell out of the tree and it
translation: 他去追松鼠……差点抓到了……松鼠窜上树，他试图爬树，但被斧头缠住了，因为他不能同时抓住它……他从树上摔下来，

english: was my turn....
translation: 轮到我了……

english: I simply went and chopped the tree down with this big old axe, still holding it. The squirrel was so petrified it simply jumped straight out of the tree onto me, I won the axe and let the poor creature go!
translation: 我只是拿着这把大旧斧头把树砍倒了。松鼠吓得直接从树上跳到我身上，我赢了斧头，放走了那个可怜的小家伙！

english: I sense a moral in there somewhere.
translation: 我感觉这里面有某种寓意。

english: Aye indeed. Brawn isn't all you need to wield a big axe, brains are required too!
translation: 确实。挥舞大斧头不仅需要肌肉，还需要头脑！

english: May I claim my tokens please?
translation: 我能领取我的代币吗？

english: I'm afraid you have not earned any tokens yet. Try some of the activities around the guild to earn some.
translation: 恐怕你还没获得任何代币。试试公会周围的一些活动来赚取一些。

english: Ok, I'll go see what I can find.
translation: 好的，我去看看能找到什么。

english: You don't have space to carry them.
translation: 你没有空间携带它们。

english: Of course! Here you go, you've earned [amount] tokens!
translation: 当然！给你，你获得了 [amount] 个代币！

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！

english: Be well, warrior [player name].
translation: 保重，战士 [player name]。

english: Ah, but I can see you are already as strong as is possible! Perhaps you have come to me to purchase a Cape of Strength, and thus join the elite few who have mastered this exacting skill?
translation: 啊，但我看你已经强壮到极点了！也许你来找我购买力量斗篷，从而加入掌握这项严苛技能的少数精英？

english: As an additional recognition of your achievement, the Cape of Strength can teleport you to our guild.
translation: 作为对你成就的额外认可，力量斗篷可以传送到我们公会。

english: May I have another hood for my cape, please?
translation: 我能再要一个斗篷的兜帽吗？

english: You don't appear to have enough space in your inventory, come back and see me when you do.
translation: 你物品栏似乎没有足够空间，有了空间再来找我。

english: Most certainly, and free of charge!
translation: 当然可以，而且免费！

english: May I buy a Skillcape of Strength, please?
translation: 我能买一件力量技能斗篷吗？

english: Hmm, yes, you certainly look strong enough. That'll be 99000 gold coins, please.
translation: 嗯，是的，你看起来确实足够强壮。请付99000金币。

english: Sorry, that's just too much to pay.
translation: 抱歉，那太贵了。

english: Not at all; there are many other adventurers who would love the opportunity to purchase such a prestigious item! You can find me here if you change your mind.
translation: 没关系；还有很多其他冒险者很乐意有机会购买这样有声望的物品！如果你改变主意可以来这里找我。

english: Sure.
translation: 当然。

english: But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: 但，不幸的是，我身上没带够钱。

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.
translation: 嗯，等你有了钱再来找我。

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 不幸的是所有技能斗篷都只配免费兜帽出售，这是技能促销的一部分；买一送一，你知道的。所以你得先腾出一些物品栏空间我才能卖给你。

english: Excellent! Wear that cape with pride my friend.
translation: 太好了！自豪地戴上那件斗篷吧，我的朋友。

english: Can you tell me a bit about skillcapes?
translation: 你能告诉我一些关于技能斗篷的事吗？

translation: 再见！

english: Not very talkative are you?

english: Nope.
translation: 不。

english: I'll be off then.
translation: 那我走了。

english: Yup.

english: The blue fish leap northwards at dawn..
translation: 蓝色的鱼在黎明时向北跳跃……

english: Oranges are not the only fruit.
translation: 橙子不是唯一的水果。

english: The cabbages bloom in the spring.
translation: 卷心菜在春天开花。

english: My cows produce milk in the evening.
translation: 我的奶牛在晚上产奶。

english: I bought an aardvark from Ardougne market.
translation: 我从阿多尼市场买了一只食蚁兽。

english: Yellow balloons are heavier in boxes.
translation: 黄色气球在盒子里更重。

english: ...err...sprockets wangle burps in the forked flan.
translation: ……呃……链轮在分叉的烤饼中骗取打嗝。

english: You have no idea what you are talking about do you?
translation: 你根本不知道自己在说什么，对吧？

english: No, not really.
translation: 不，不太知道。

english: It rains frogs during the Winter in Neitiznot.
translation: 奈提兹诺镇的冬天会下青蛙雨。

english: (continues with "Oranges are not the only fruit")
translation: (继续''橙子不是唯一的水果'')

english: Free stuff please.
translation: 来点免费的东西吧。

english: Ah, Operative Budgie. Welcome to the island.
translation: 啊，特工鹦鹉。欢迎来到岛上。

english: Budgie? That's not my name, you can call me-
translation: 鹦鹉？那不是我的名字，你可以叫我——

english: Shh!
translation: 嘘！

english: No names! Names are unnecessary. Loose lives cost tongues.
translation: 不许说名字！名字没必要。说漏名字会丢命。

english: Shouldn't that be...never mind. So Mr Hemli-
translation: 那不应该是……算了。那么赫姆利先生——

english: Shhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!
translation: 嘘嘘嘘嘘嘘嘘嘘嘘嘘嘘嘘嘘嘘嘘！

english: Sorry, no names. I forgot.
translation: 抱歉，不能说名字。我忘了。

english: Call me Operative Nighthawk.
translation: 叫我夜鹰特工。

english: How come you get the cool name, and I get called Budgie? Can't I be called Operative Panther? Yeah I like that, panthers are cool. Rarrrr!
translation: 为什么你得到酷名字，我却叫鹦鹉？我不能叫黑豹特工吗？是的我喜欢，黑豹很酷。嗷呜！

english: This is not a democracy, Operative! Panther already exists and he's working on a mission in Al Kharid. It's my way or the highway.
translation: 这不是民主社会，特工！黑豹已经存在，他正在阿尔卡里德城执行任务。要么听我的，要么走人。

english: Fine, whatever, I don't care anyway.
translation: 好吧，随便，反正我不在乎。

english: To business. Here are the details of your operation. You will infiltrate Burgher Burowgar's hall, deep undercover as a travelling entertainer. Burgher Burowgar and his men are known to relax in the
translation: 说正事。这是你的行动详情。你将作为流动艺人深入潜伏进入布尔格‧布洛加的大厅。众所周知布尔格‧布洛加和他的手下在小丑

english: presence of a jester - and a few barrels of beer. To get the information required from the court of Burgher Burowgar you must entertain him.
translation: 和几桶啤酒面前会放松。要从布尔格‧布洛加的宫廷获取所需信息，你必须娱乐他。

english: While you are obeying the Burgher's instructions you should listen in on the conversations of his council and make note of what they discuss.
translation: 在你服从布尔格指令的同时，你应该偷听他议会的谈话并记录他们讨论的内容。

english: When you return I shall ask you a few questions about what you have learned.
translation: 当你回来时，我会问你几个关于你所学内容的问题。

english: Very well.
translation: 很好。

english: You must wear all four pieces of the jester costume without anything in your hands, as the Burgher's guards will search you thoroughly.
translation: 你必须穿上小丑服装的全部四件，手里不能拿任何东西，因为布尔格的守卫会彻底搜查你。

english: Are you ready to begin?
translation: 你准备好开始了吗？

english: I am ready.
translation: 我准备好了。

english: Not dressed like that you're not! You'd better get the rest of your kit, or empty your hands if you have anything in them.
translation: 穿成那样还没准备好！你最好拿到其余装备，或者如果手里有东西就清空。

english: I just need to visit the bank.
translation: 我只需要去银行。

english: Hurry back; we must know what Neitiznot's ruler is planning.
translation: 快点回来；我们必须知道奈提兹诺镇统治者的计划。

english: I shall return soon.
translation: 我很快回来。

english: Colourless green ideas sleep furiously.
translation: 无色的绿色想法愤怒地睡觉。

english: Have you infiltrated the Burgher's leisure quarters?
translation: 你潜入布尔格的休闲区了吗？

english: Not yet. I'll do that now.
translation: 还没有。我现在就去。

english: Shhh. Go away. I'm not allowed to talk to you.
translation: 嘘。走开。我不允许跟你说话。

english: Fine, whatever ...
translation: 好吧，随便……

translation: 蓝色的鱼在黎明时向北跳跃。

english: It rains frogs during the Winter in Neitiznot.

translation: 我准备好了。

english: I just need to visit the bank.
translation: 我只需要去银行。

english: Colourless green ideas sleep furiously.
translation: 无色的绿色想法愤怒地睡觉。

english: Hi there.
translation: 你好。

english: Hey, ids me matesh!
translation: 嘿，是我伙计们！

english: Sorry, have we met?
translation: 抱歉，我们见过吗？

english: Yeah! you wazsh wiv me in dat pub overy by hill!
translation: 是的！你之前在山上那家酒吧跟我在一起！

english: I have no idea what you're going on about.
translation: 我完全不知道你在说什么。

english: Glad yeeash remembers.
translation: 很高兴你记得。

english: Doh ray meeee laa doh faaa!
translation: 哆来咪发嗦！

english: La la la! Do di dum dii!
translation: 啦啦啦！哆嘀嗒嘀！

english: Hello there. What are you doing here?
translation: 你好。你在这里做什么？

english: I'm waiting here hoping that someone can guide me to the Paterdomus, the temple on the Salve.
translation: 我在这里等待，希望有人能引导我去帕特多穆斯，萨鲁夫河上的神庙。

english: Where is Paterdomus?
translation: 帕特多穆斯在哪？

english: Oh, Paterdomus is that rather impressive looking temple on the Salve... I'm sure you must have passed it on your way into Morytania.
translation: 哦，帕特多穆斯是萨鲁夫河上那座相当宏伟的神庙……我相信你进入莫利塔尼亚时一定经过它。

english: Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
translation: 你为什么想去帕特多穆斯？

english: I'm hoping to get back to civilisation and see what the lands of Misthalin look like.
translation: 我希望回到文明世界，看看米斯特林王國的土地是什么样子。

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Paterdomus?
translation: 如果我们在去帕特多穆斯的路上遇到敌人，你能自卫吗？

english: What sort of guide are you? I'm pretty healthy, but you'll have to protect me else I'll be sure to die... Oh, I do hope you can manage that.
translation: 你是什么向导？我很健康，但你得保护我否则我肯定会死……哦，我希望你能做到。

english: I can take you to Paterdomus.
translation: 我可以带你去帕特多穆斯。

english: Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: 嗯，看来你有个随从。我想若是让它独自乱跑，这趟路上恐怕会走丢。等你的随从安顿好了我们再动身。

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: 真的吗？那太好了！到达目的地后我会给你小奖励。

english: Ok, which route should we take?
translation: 好的，我们应该走哪条路线？

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: 啊，所以你想给我一些补给，嗯？让我打开我的背包。

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than staying in Burgh de Rott.
translation: 哦，我讨厌这趟旅程，但比待在伯格德罗特镇好。

english: It's scary here...let's get going!
translation: 这里很可怕……我们走吧！

english: When are we going to get to Paterdomus?
translation: 我们什么时候能到帕特多穆斯？

english: We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on.
translation: 我们没时间站着聊天；继续前进吧。

english: Do you visit Paterdomus often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: 你经常去帕特多穆斯吗？你似乎很熟悉路线。

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...?
translation: 你没看见我正在挨打吗……？

english: Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
translation: 谢谢，我把它喝下去。

english: Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Burgh de Rott. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: 天哪！看来我们得回伯格德罗特镇了。我们过不了那座桥！

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
translation: 哦，我相信我们能找到办法！

english: Player completes the bridge event
translation: 玩家完成了桥梁事件

english: Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Burgh de Rott.
translation: 这下糟了……看来我们过不了这片沼泽，得回伯格德罗特镇。

english: Player completes the bog event
translation: 玩家完成了沼泽事件

english: Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
translation: 太棒了！干得漂亮，我会跟紧你。

english: Whahay...that was great!
translation: 哇哈……太棒了！

english: But we really should be heading off now.
translation: 不过我们现在真得赶紧上路了。

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
translation: 哦，我相信我们能找到路穿过去！

english: Player completes the river event
translation: 玩家完成了河流事件

english: That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
translation: 太厉害了！我也得照做。

english: Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: 哇哈……太棒了！不过我们现在真得赶紧上路了。

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
translation: 那……那些气泡是什么？

english: This is scary!
translation: 这太可怕了！

english: Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
translation: 啊，那应该是触手……

english: Ahhh, two tentacles!
translation: 啊，两根触手！

english: ...three tentacles!
translation: ……三根触手！

english: I think I'm going to faint!
translation: 我觉得我要晕了！

english: Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: 天哪！看那怪物！你得自己解决那东西！

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the temple. Here's your reward.
translation: 多谢你平安把我带到神庙，这是你的报酬。

english: Smiddi Ryak gives you a reward token!
translation: 斯米迪‧莱克给你一个奖励代币！

english: Where is Paterdomus?
translation: 帕特多穆斯在哪？

english: Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
translation: 你为什么想去帕特多穆斯？

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
translation: 如果我们在路上遇到敌人，你能自保吗？

english: I can take you to Paterdomus.
translation: 我可以带你去帕特多穆斯。

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: Arr? Be ye wantin' te go on account with our gang o' fillibusters?
translation: 啊？你想跟我们这群私掠者记账吗？

english: The powder monkey be takin' a caulk after gettin' rowdy on bumboo, so there be plenty of room for ye.
translation: 火药童在喝了朗姆酒后闹腾完正在休息，所以有很多空间给你。

english: Riiiiight...
translation: 好吧……

english: I'll just be over here if you need me.
translation: 如果你需要我我就在这边。

english: Yer standin' in me light stranger. Can I sell ye somethin' that'll make ye move?
translation: 你挡着我的光了陌生人。我能卖你点什么让你移动吗？

english: Probably, let's see what you have.
translation: 可能吧，让我看看你有什么。

english: I doubt it.
translation: 我怀疑。

english: Then move on stranger.
translation: 那走开吧陌生人。

english: That depends on if you have any cutlasses.
translation: 那取决于你有没有弯刀。

english: Cutlasses! Think yer a pirate now [lad/lass/kid]?
translation: 弯刀！以为自己是海盗了 [小伙子/姑娘/孩子]？

english: Well, yes.
translation: 嗯，是的。

english: Well, I have some cutlasses.
translation: 嗯，我有些弯刀。

english: I have Brass Hand Harry's Cutlass. Well, a load of them to be honest.
translation: 我有铜手哈利的弯刀。嗯，老实说有很多。

english: Then there's Unlucky Jenkins' Lucky Cutlass. Lovely blade that.
translation: 还有倒霉詹金斯的幸运弯刀。那是把好刀。

english: I've also got Gentleman Mallard's Rapier. Not a cutlass I know, but the finest blade ever wielded by a privateer.
translation: 我还有绅士马拉德的刺剑。不是弯刀我知道，但这是私掠者挥舞过的最好的刀。

english: Now, which would ye like to hear about?
translation: 现在，你想听哪个的故事？

english: Brass Hand Harry's Cutlass.
translation: 铜手哈利的弯刀。

english: A good choice!
translation: 好选择！

english: Ye may end up meeting Brass Hand Harry if ye hang around long enough.
translation: 如果你待得够久，可能会遇到铜手哈利。

english: He lost his left arm to a canister round, but that didn't stop him much.
translation: 他的左臂被炮弹炸断，但那没怎么阻止他。

english: Then he lost his right hand at the wrist fightin' the excise men off the coast of Karamja.
translation: 然后他在卡拉姆詹海岸与税务官战斗时失去了右手腕。

english: Not bein' the sort to lie about mopin', he asked me to make him a cutlass with a brass gauntlet fixed to the handle, and rig it up with a load of straps so he could keep fightin'.
translation: 他可不是那种闲着的人，他让我给他做一把弯刀，手柄上固定铜护手，并用很多带子绑好，这样他能继续战斗。

english: He's a great man is Harry, but he keeps snappin' the straps while he's at sea, so he sells the cutlasses back to me in exchange for a new one.
translation: 哈利是个好人，但他在海上时总是弄断带子，所以他把弯刀卖回给我换新的。

english: It's quite a good blade, but the big, brass gauntlet is what makes it worthwhile. It's big enough to fit over even a real gauntlet, so ye get extra protection to yer sword hand.
translation: 这是把好刀，但大铜护手让它物有所值。它大到可以套在真正的护手上，所以你的持剑手有额外保护。

english: I can sell ye one fer 1040 coins.
translation: 我可以1040金币卖给你一把。

english: Interested?
translation: 有兴趣吗？

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: Smart [lad/lass/kid]! Come and see me when ye have the coins fer it.
translation: 聪明的 [小伙子/姑娘/孩子]！等你有了钱再来找我。

english: Here ye go. I've got a load of these left over if ye need more.
translation: 给你。如果你需要更多我还有很多剩余。

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: Well I'll still be here if ye change yer mind.
translation: 嗯，如果你改变主意我还会在这里。

english: Unlucky Jenkins' Lucky Cutlass.
translation: 倒霉詹金斯的幸运弯刀。

english: Arr, tis a sad tale to this sword.
translation: 啊，这把剑有个悲伤的故事。

english: Jenkins was the lookout on the Jonah, a cursed vessel if there ever was one.
translation: 詹金斯是约拿号的瞭望员，那是艘被诅咒的船。

english: One day his ship were attacked by another group of pirates durin' a fierce storm. One of their bowmen took a shot at the Cap'n of the vessel, but it were deflected off his compass and hit Jenkins in the back.
translation: 有一天他的船在猛烈风暴中被另一群海盗袭击。他们的一个弓箭手向船长射击，但被指南针弹开击中了詹金斯的背部。

english: How unlucky!
translation: 多倒霉！

english: That weren't the worst of it [lad/lass/kid]. He survived the fight, and the ship's surgeon was trying to get the arrow out when...
translation: 那还不是最糟的 [小伙子/姑娘/孩子]。他在战斗中幸存，船医正试图取出箭时……

english: Are ye familiar with the spell bones to bananas?
translation: 你熟悉化骨为蕉的咒语吗？

english: Yes, why?
translation: 是的，为什么？

english: Well, due to a blow to the head he took in the fight, the surgeon cast that spell, thinking it was some sort of new healing spell.
translation: 嗯，由于他在战斗中头部受伤，船医施了那个咒语，以为是什么新的治疗咒语。

english: And he did so while touching Jenkins' ribs.
translation: 他施咒时碰到了詹金斯的肋骨。

english: And that killed him?
translation: 那杀了他？

english: No [lad/lass/kid]!
translation: 不 [小伙子/姑娘/孩子]！

english: See, he survived, his bones turned to bananas, as a huge storm blew up and the crew debated what to do with him.
translation: 看，他幸存了，他的骨头变成了香蕉，一场大风暴袭来，船员们争论怎么处理他。

english: But you see, the storm was actually the tail end of a hurricane that had swept the nearby jungle islands, and when it approached the ship it petered out, droppin' all manner of strange things onto the deck and into the
translation: 但你看，风暴实际上是席卷附近丛林岛屿的飓风尾部，当它接近船时减弱了，

english: ocean.
translation: 把各种奇怪的东西掉到甲板上和海里。

english: The worst part was when the ship was bombarded with ravenous, hunger-crazed monkeys, the majority of which landed on Jenkins as he lay recoverin'.
translation: 最糟的是船被饥饿疯狂的猴子轰炸，大多数落在了正在恢复的詹金斯身上。

english: See, what happened next, after the monkeys had had their way with him was...
translation: 看，接下来发生的，在猴子们对他为所欲为之后是……

english: Look, I don't want to hear any more. Why would I want to buy his cutlass?
translation: 听着，我不想再听了。我为什么要买他的弯刀？

english: Well, after the poor man passed on...
translation: 嗯，在那个可怜人去世后……

english: In a final, terrifying, mashed potato coated tragedy...
translation: 在最后，可怕的，裹着土豆泥的悲剧中……

english: His shipmates found his cutlass was completely untouched.
translation: 他的船友发现他的弯刀完全没被碰过。

english: See, having been exposed to all the bad luck that Jenkins went through, the thing is unlikely to ever see anything that bad again.
translation: 看，经历了詹金斯经历的所有厄运，这东西不太可能再遇到那么糟的事。

english: Hence, it must be lucky.
translation: 因此，它一定是幸运的。

english: Ye can have it fer 2560 coins.
translation: 你可以2560金币买下它。

english: Here ye go. I hope it brings you luck.
translation: 给你。希望它给你带来好运。

english: Gentleman Mallard's Rapier.
translation: 绅士马拉德的刺剑。

english: Well, I'll tell ye the story, but it'll take a great deal of convincin' for me to sell you this rapier.
translation: 嗯，我会告诉你故事，但要我卖你这把刺剑需要很多说服力。

english: See, gentleman Mallard is a legend in these parts. His family had been rich, shipping all sorts of goods up and down the coast.
translation: 看，绅士马拉德是这些地方的传奇。他的家族曾经很富有，沿海岸运输各种货物。

english: Then their rivals got together and had their ships sunk, one after the other, and his business partners were all either bought off or had...accidents.
translation: 然后他们的竞争对手联合起来，一艘接一艘地击沉他们的船，他的商业伙伴都被收买或出了……意外。

english: With no money and only one ship left, he took to the life of a pirate, but no brigand was he.
translation: 没钱只剩一艘船，他成了海盗，但不是强盗。

english: He took only from those men that had brought about his downfall, was fair with his men, and generous with his loot.
translation: 他只从那些导致他垮台的人那里夺取，对部下公平，对战利品慷慨。

english: Why, this island would have been wiped out by the shakes if he hadn't turned over his stash to buy medicine.
translation: 要不是他拿出积蓄买药，这个岛屿早就被瘟疫摧毁了。

english: One day his ship was attacked by a huge sea creature that swept the decks of men with its tentacles.
translation: 有一天他的船被一只巨大的海洋生物袭击，用触手把甲板上的人扫落。

english: The crew took to the lifeboats, and the last they saw of him the gentleman was stabbin' at the thing as it hauled the ship under the water.
translation: 船员们上了救生艇，最后看到他时，绅士正刺向那个把船拖入水中的生物。

english: A week later about ten foot of tentacle washed up on the beach, with his rapier embedded in it to the hilt.
translation: 一周后大约十英尺长的触手冲上海滩，他的刺剑深深嵌入其中。

english: I took it, cleaned it up, and I've been lookin' after it ever since.
translation: 我拿了它，清理干净，从那以后一直保管着。

english: I can't let it go for less than 25600 coins, and even then that's a bargain.
translation: 我不能以低于25600金币的价格出售，即使那样也是便宜货。

english: Ye think ye have what it takes to wield it?
translation: 你认为你有能力挥舞它吗？

english: I hope yer worthy enough to wield this, stranger. I'd hate te think Gentleman Mallard would be disappointed in me fer sellin' it to ye.
translation: 我希望你足够配得上挥舞它，陌生人。我不想让绅士马拉德因为我卖给你而失望。

english: I have this anchor, can you fix it?
translation: 我有这个锚，你能修好吗？

english: Well, this is a very unusual job. This thing looks more suited to bashin' peoples heads in than securing a ship.
translation: 嗯，这活儿真不寻常。这东西看着更像用来砸烂人脑袋的，哪像固定船的。

english: Where did ye get it?
translation: 你从哪里得到的？

english: You wouldn't believe me if I told you.
translation: 我告诉你你也不会相信。

english: Stole it eh? Well I can sort it out for 230,000 coins, if you like.
translation: 偷的吧？嗯，如果你愿意，我可以230,000金币帮你修好。

english: That's too much for me at the moment.
translation: 那对我来说现在太贵了。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Right, let's get to work.
translation: 好的，开始工作吧。

english: There ye go, good as new!
translation: 好了，跟新的一样！

english: Thanks Smith!
translation: 谢谢铁匠！

english: Probably, let's see what you have.
translation: 可能吧，让我看看你有什么。

english: I doubt it.
translation: 我怀疑。

english: That depends on if you have any cutlasses.
translation: 那取决于你有没有弯刀。

translation: 铜手哈利的弯刀。

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: No.

translation: 倒霉詹金斯的幸运弯刀。

english: Gentleman Mallard's Rapier
translation: 绅士马拉德的刺剑

translation: 我有这个锚，你能修好吗？

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No

english: Can you teach me the basics of smelting please?
translation: 你能教我冶炼的基础知识吗？

english: You'll need to have mined some ore to smelt first. Go see the mining tutor to the south if you're not sure how to do this.
translation: 你需要先开采一些矿石来冶炼。如果你不确定怎么做，去南边找采矿导师。

english: I see you have some ore with you to smelt, so let's get started.
translation: 我看你身上有些矿石可以冶炼，那我们开始吧。

english: Click on the furnace to bring up a menu of metal bars you can try to make from your ore.
translation: 点击熔炉，打开金属锭制作菜单，你可以尝试用矿石制作各种金属锭。

english: When you have a full inventory, take it to the bank, you can find it on the roof of the castle in Lumbridge.
translation: 物品栏满后，把它带到银行去，银行就在仑桥堡的屋顶上。

english: If you have a hammer with you, you can smith the bronze bars into equipment on the anvil outside.
translation: 如果你带着锤子，可以在外面的铁砧上把青铜锭锻造成装备。

english: I'm afraid the weather over the years has rusted it down, so it can only be used to work bronze.
translation: 恐怕经过多年的风吹雨打，它已经生锈了，所以只能用来锻造青铜。

english: Alternatively you can run up to Varrock. Look for my Master, the Smithing Tutor, in the west of the city, he can help you smith better gear.
translation: 或者你可以跑去维洛克城。找我师父，就是那位锻造导师，他在城西，能帮你锻造更好的装备。

english: I already know about the basics of smelting, got any tips?
translation: 我已经知道冶炼的基础知识了，有什么技巧吗？

english: I find it useful to stockpile my ore before smelting it in one go, or even do it on the way to the bank in such places as Al Kharid or Falador. But you can do it anyway you want, one load at a time is fine too!
translation: 我觉得先把矿石囤起来，然后一次性冶炼很有用，或者在去银行的路上冶炼也行，比如在阿尔卡里德城或法拉多城。不过你想怎么做都行，一次一炉也没问题！

english: Not too much can go wrong with smelting.
translation: 冶炼不会出什么大岔子。

english: You will lose some iron when smelting that ore, but a Ring of Forging or the Superheat Item spell will soon solve that.
translation: 冶炼那种矿石时会损失一些铁，但用锻造戒指或矿石冶炼术法术就能解决这个问题。

english: You should also investigate Keldagrim, the dwarven city, you may find better places to smelt your ore with friends.
translation: 你还应该去凯尔达格林城看看，那座矮人城市，你可能会找到更好的地方和朋友一起冶炼矿石。

english: What do I do after smelting the ore?
translation: 冶炼完矿石后我该做什么？

english: Ahh you'll need to learn to smith. Go to Varrock, that's where my master, the Smithing Tutor, plies his trade. Ask him to teach you how to smith.
translation: 啊，你需要学习锻造。去维洛克城吧，我师父，就是那位锻造导师，在那里干活。请他教你怎么锻造。

english: Smelt some ore and store it in the bank. Grab a hammer from the general store before you go too!
translation: 冶炼一些矿石并存到银行里。出发前也去一般商店拿把锤子！

english: Are you here to make juniper charcoal?
translation: 你是来制作杜松木炭的吗？

english: Tell me about juniper charcoal.
translation: 跟我讲讲杜松木炭。

english: They use it in the blast mine, out near Lovakengj. It's powerful stuff, more volatile than the regular charcoal you get elsewhere.
translation: 他们在爆破矿场用它，就在洛瓦肯吉城附近。这东西很厉害，比其他地方弄到的普通木炭更易燃。

english: To make juniper charcoal, put some juniper logs in my furnaces, then set them alight. I'll keep an eye on it for a fee of 600 coins.
translation: 要制作杜松木炭，把一些杜松原木放进我的熔炉里，然后点燃。我帮你看着，收费600枚金币。

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 跟我讲讲你自己。

english: Juniper charcoal is my trade, always has been, ever since my mum taught me. She's retired now, and returned to Lovakengj - that's where we're from.
translation: 制作杜松木炭是我的行当，一直都是，自从我妈教我之后。她现在退休了，回洛瓦肯吉城去了——那是我们的家乡。

english: I just live out here in the Hosidius farmlands because it's handy for the juniper trees.
translation: 我就住在霍西迪乌斯农田这边，因为离杜松树近，方便。

english: What can you do for me?
translation: 你能为我做什么？

english: For a small fee, I watch the charcoal furnace so that you can make charcoal here. Also, I do a great back- rub, if you're ever in the mood.
translation: 收点小费，我帮你看管木炭熔炉，这样你就能在这里制作木炭。另外，如果你有兴趣，我按摩技术也很棒。

english: Have you got a spare tinderbox?
translation: 你有备用的火绒盒吗？

english: Yup, but I'll keep it for someone who needs it.
translation: 有，但我要留给需要的人。

english: Yup, but you can't hold it.
translation: 有，但你拿不了。

english: Sure, you can have it.
translation: 当然，你可以拿去。

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我走了。

translation: 把你当宠物养安全吗？

english: Yes, human.
translation: 安全，人类。

translation: 那火在哪？

translation: 我没有火。

english: No smoke without fire!
translation: 无火不生烟！

english: Please stop, human.
translation: 别说了，人类。

english: So you don't cause lung disease?
translation: 所以你不会导致肺病？

english: We're safe if you don't inhale.
translation: 只要你别吸入就安全。

english: Good to know.
translation: 知道了。

english: So you don't leave soot everywhere?
translation: 所以你不会到处留煤灰？

english: Would you defecate on the floor like a camel? Neither would I. So no, I do not leave soot everywhere.
translation: 你会像骆驼一样在地板上排便吗？我也不会。所以不，我不会到处留煤灰。

english: That's nice of you.
translation: 你真好。

english: Never mind.
translation: 算了。

english: Your kind comes in three different sizes?
translation: 你们这种生物有三种不同体型？

english: Four, actually.
translation: 其实是四种。
