english: The way they saw this universe, their modes of impression, differed so greatly from one another that to read their stories, to know their lives, is to wonder if they were not many species in one.
translation: 他们看待这个宇宙的方式、他们的印象模式彼此差异如此之大，以至于阅读他们的故事、了解他们的生活时，会让人怀疑他们是否是一个体内的多个物种。

english: It was as if they had ranged across the actions of a thousand species and taken them for their own.
translation: 就好像他们跨越了上千物种的行为，并将其据为己有。

english: For nearly two thousand years they dreamed in a creative mania without antecedent.
translation: 近两千年来，他们在前所未有的创造狂热中做梦。

english: They looked into the eyes and minds of other species and with their own intellect superseded them.
translation: 他们凝视其他物种的眼睛和心灵，用自己的智慧超越它们。

english: They destroyed many, coopted others, and in the space between necessity and carelessness, left some to grow as untended as any species could in the wake of their ubiquity.
translation: 他们摧毁了许多，拉拢了其他一些，在必要与疏忽之间，让一些物种在他们无处不在的影响下任其生长。

english: They swarmed across the continents and oceans of a Gielinor they called their own, and shattered it into a billion imbricate worlds.
translation: 他们蜂拥穿过他们称之为自己的基利诺尔的大陆和海洋，将其粉碎成数十亿个重叠的世界。

english: And they were, by the twisted jungles of their slaughterhouses, ruthless and aloof beyond measure.
translation: 在他们屠宰场扭曲的丛林中，他们无情冷漠得无以复加。

english: The worst of us.
translation: 我们中最糟糕的。

english: A superpredator.
translation: 超级掠食者。

english: A bringer of mass extinction.
translation: 大灭绝的带来者。

english: All mountains move and all giants are mountains.
translation: 所有的山都在移动，所有的巨人都是山。

english: We rest upon their shoulders.
translation: 我们栖息在他们的肩膀上。

english: The world has grown older, senescent.
translation: 世界已变得更老，衰老了。

english: We are chimpanzee, we are gorilla, we are orangutan, and we are baboon and more.
translation: 我们是黑猩猩，我们是大猩猩，我们是红毛猩猩，我们是狒狒，还有更多。

english: We are, whether we like it or not, the blood legatees of humanity.
translation: 无论我们是否喜欢，我们都是人类的血脉继承者。

english: We are the children of men, but our mistakes will not be their mistakes.
translation: 我们是人类的孩子，但我们的错误不会是他们的错误。

english: We are telling a story.
translation: 我们在讲述一个故事。

english: We are telling a story of life, of what it means to live together in this universe, with vastly different modes of being, of seeing, of knowing.
translation: 我们在讲述生命的故事，讲述在这个宇宙中共同生活意味着什么，有着截然不同的存在、观察和认知方式。

english: Of sharing our own internal worlds with each other and making the universe we live in better for it. The empathy of a mind speaking to another mind, a vastly different mind, and yet each understanding each.
translation: 讲述彼此分享我们内心世界，并因此让我们生活的宇宙变得更美好。一个心灵与另一个心灵对话的共情，一个截然不同的心灵，但彼此理解。

english: And if not, if the barriers seem too great, then striving to overcome them.
translation: 如果不能，如果障碍似乎太大，那就努力克服它们。

english: Sorrow in what humanity did to this world, in the horrors they unleashed, in their cataclysm of despair, in the tens of thousands of species that will never walk or swim or fly again.
translation: 为人类对这个世界所做的一切感到悲伤，为他们释放的恐怖，为他们绝望的灾变，为成千上万再也无法行走、游泳或飞翔的物种。

english: Extinctions abounded in their wake, and yet look now at this sunbright land, at the joys we have brought to it, to have bound the chaotic climate to our will.
translation: 灭绝在他们身后比比皆是，但看看现在这片阳光明媚的土地，看看我们给它带来的欢乐，看看我们如何将混乱的气候束缚于我们的意志。

english: To have thought deeply of the future of this world, a sense of respect, of shared reverence for it and all who live within it.
translation: 深入思考这个世界的未来，对它和所有生活在其中的生命怀有尊重和共同的敬畏。

english: We have strung the close sky with life.
translation: 我们用生命编织了近在咫尺的天空。

english: Be proud.
translation: 感到自豪吧。

english: And empathy, once limited only to mankind and some few species, now extends across all lands, across all time.
translation: 而共情，曾经只限于人类和少数物种，现在延伸到所有土地，跨越所有时间。

english: I'm sorry, but what?!
translation: 对不起，你说什么？！

english: Gah
translation: 嘎

english: Ha!
translation: 哈！

english: Hng!
translation: 哼！

english: How much did you pay for your ring of stone?
translation: 你的石头戒指花了多少钱买的？

english: What are you talking about?
translation: 你在说什么？

english: They're so expensive, but so much fun!
translation: 它们太贵了，但太好玩了！

english: Right...
translation: 好吧……

english: So why do they call you Zalcano?
translation: 那他们为什么叫你扎尔卡诺？

english: Well....
Is it because you're like a vol-
translation: 是因为你像火——

english: Don't say it!
translation: 别说出来！

english: Hiss!
translation: 嘶！

english: Meow!
translation: 喵！

english: Rrowl!
translation: 嗷呜！

english: Ssss!
translation: 嘶嘶！

english: Eat stone!
translation: 吃石头！

english: Bow down to me.
translation: 向我臣服。

english: Let the pain run through you.
translation: 让痛苦贯穿你。

english: Another contender for the podium!
translation: 又一个奖台竞争者！

english: There's a podium?
translation: 有奖台？

english: Sadly not, I just say that because it sounds cool.
translation: 可惜没有，我只是这么说因为听起来很酷。

english: Let's wait a bit for the other games to finish up.
translation: 我们等一会儿，等其他比赛结束。

english: You wait around in the snow, the temptation to do snow angels is almost unbearable.
translation: 你在雪地里等着，想做雪天使的冲动几乎无法忍受。

english: Now they are starting to trickle in, the game will start shortly!
translation: 现在他们开始陆续进来了，比赛很快开始！

english: Hey, haven't we met before?
translation: 嘿，我们以前见过吗？

english: No, no, must have been another dwarf, plenty round these parts.
translation: 不，不，肯定是另一个矮人，这附近有很多。

english: Hmm... Well I hope you both brought your snow boots, it's going to be carnage.
translation: 嗯……我希望你们都带了雪靴，这将是一场大混战。

english: Pssssst [player name].
translation: 嘘嘘嘘 [player name]。

english: PSSSST [player name].
translation: 嘘嘘嘘 [player name]。

english: Let's talk strategy, come here.
translation: 我们谈谈策略，过来。

english: I don't hear any foul play going on, do I?
translation: 我没听到什么不正当行为吧？

english: No of course not, I'm just playing mind games with poor [player name]. They have no chance.
translation: 不当然没有，我只是在和可怜的 [player name] 玩心理战。他们没机会的。

english: You cheeky little...
translation: 你这厚脸皮的小……

english: We are down to our last two finalists.
translation: 我们只剩下最后两名决赛选手了。

english: This calls for one thing and one thing only...
translation: 这需要一件事，而且只有一件事……

english: Sudden.
translation: 突然。

english: Death.
translation: 死亡。

english: Snowball.
translation: 雪球。

english: I'm so very scared of [player name].
translation: 我好怕 [player name]。

english: Guss waves at you.
translation: 格斯向你挥手。

english: The rules are as follows.
translation: 规则如下。

english: You each get one snowball each to throw.
translation: 你们每人各有一个雪球可以扔。

english: Whomever get's hit first, is out.
translation: 谁先被击中，谁就出局。

english: Do you both understand the rules?
translation: 你们都明白规则吗？

english: Guss?
translation: 格斯？

english: Yes!
translation: 是的！

english: [player name]?
translation: [player name]？

english: Yes sir.
translation: 是的，先生。

english: Coming at you [player name].
translation: 向你来了 [player name]。

english: Oh no...
translation: 哦不……

english: What are you playing at dwarf! I haven't even started the countdown.
translation: 你在搞什么矮人！我还没开始倒数呢。

english: My bad... I'm just very eager.
translation: 我的错……我只是太心急了。

english: Also, you didn't even go for [player name]. What's that about?
translation: 而且，你甚至没朝 [player name] 扔。怎么回事？

english: Honestly... I'm just an awful shot.
translation: 说实话……我射击技术太差了。

english: Could've sworn a dwarf in a previous festive games final did the same thing and knocked me clean out.
translation: 我敢肯定以前节日游戏决赛中有个矮人也这么干，把我直接淘汰了。

english: Then proceeded to sneak into the pub.
translation: 然后溜进酒馆。

english: Ha, you don't say.
translation: 哈，真的吗。

english: Moving on...
translation: 继续……

english: I'll ignore you ever did that.
translation: 我就当没发生过。

english: On the count of three, you will both be able to throw a snowball.
translation: 数到三，你们都可以扔雪球。

english: One...
Two...
Three!
translation: 三！

english: Snowball!
translation: 雪球！

english: Is that a golden sn-
translation: 那是个金——

english: Oof!
translation: 哎哟！

english: Wooo!
translation: 哇哦！

english: There we have it folks!
translation: 就是这样各位！

english: Our Festive Games champion!
translation: 我们的节日游戏冠军！

english: Guss...
translation: 格斯……

english: Mmmmistletoad!
translation: 槲寄生蟾蜍！

english: Who are you talking to?
translation: 你在跟谁说话？

english: That's not important. You just won the Festive games!
translation: 这不重要。你刚赢了节日游戏！

english: Oh my!
translation: 天哪！

english: I don't know what to say.
translation: 我不知道该说什么。

english: You now get access to...
translation: 你现在可以进入……

english: The Nutcracker pub!
translation: 胡桃夹子酒馆！

english: Alongside your win, you also get a free plus one to take into the pub with you!
translation: 除了获胜，你还可以免费带一个人进酒馆！

english: Did you hear that [player name]?
translation: 你听到了吗 [player name]？

english: [player name] we can go into the pub together!
translation: [player name] 我们可以一起进酒馆！

english: [player name]...?
translation: [player name]……？

english: Ehem, [player name]...?
translation: 咳咳，[player name]……？

english: Oh dear.
translation: 哎呀。

english: Fancy a pint?
translation: 想喝一杯吗？

english: I though't you'd never ask.
translation: 我还以为你永远不问呢。

english: You wake up after being dragged into what seems like a pub.
translation: 你被拖进一个看似酒馆的地方后醒来。

english: Gosh, my head hurts.
translation: 天哪，我头疼。

english: I better see how Guss is getting on.
translation: 我最好看看格斯怎么样了。

english: How's it going [player name]?
translation: 怎么样 [player name]？

english: I'm alright, but I'm rather chilly round this part of the pub.
translation: 我还好，但这酒馆这边有点冷。

english: You'll get used to it.
translation: 你会习惯的。

english: Do you enjoy doing all this?
translation: 你喜欢做这一切吗？

english: Eh... It's alright I suppose.
translation: 呃……还行吧我想。

english: You don't really like it then?
translation: 那你其实不太喜欢？

english: It's not that I don't like it, moreso that I'm on a journey of redemption.
translation: 不是我不喜欢，更多是因为我在赎罪之旅上。

english: Oh yeah?
translation: 哦是吗？

english: I wasn't the most friendly Fremennik before I came here.
translation: 我来这里之前可不是最友好的费明尼克人。

english: I did many awful things...
translation: 我做了很多糟糕的事……

english: Shoo-ing away stray dogs.
translation: 赶走流浪狗。

english: Sacrificing cats in West Ardougne.
translation: 在西阿多尼城献祭猫。

english: Stealing snow and making my own snowcone business.
translation: 偷雪做自己的刨冰生意。

english: The list goes on.
translation: 不胜枚举。

english: I hope you didn't sell the golden snowballs.
translation: 我希望你没把金雪球卖了。

english: Also... You did WHAT to stray dogs?!
translation: 还有……你对流浪狗做了什么？！

english: Sorry.. I didn't mean to snap. You are on your journey to redeem yourself.
translation: 抱歉……我不是故意发火的。你在赎罪之旅上。

english: That I am, [player name]
translation: 确实是，[player name]

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 跟我讲讲你自己。

english: Well, there's not much to tell really.
translation: 嗯，真的没什么可说的。

english: I used to take part in great big snowball tournaments around Gielinor.
translation: 我以前参加基利诺尔各地的大型雪球比赛。

english: I won every single one.
translation: 我每场都赢了。

english: I was unstoppable.
translation: 我势不可挡。

english: Some might say there was snow stopping you.
translation: 有人可能会说没什么能阻挡你。

english: Oh dear...
translation: 哎呀……

english: I was an awful person back then... Didn't make time for anyone. It was all about winning.
translation: 那时候我是个糟糕的人……没时间为任何人停留。一切都只为赢。

english: I missed my pet rock's first birthday, what kind of person does that?
translation: 我错过了我的宠物石的一岁生日，什么样的人才会那样？

english: I was a monster...
translation: 我是个怪物……

english: The last thing I remember before getting this gig with Santa was me trying to help someone.
translation: 在得到这份给圣诞老人干活的工作之前，我记得最后一件事是我试图帮助别人。

english: Apparently I tried to save some Gnome children from a catastrophic avalanche to the north.
translation: 显然我试图从北方的灾难性雪崩中救出一些地精孩子。

english: Next thing I knew, I was talking to Santa and he asked me to come to The Nutcracker.
translation: 接下来我知道的就是我在和圣诞老人说话，他邀请我来胡桃夹子酒馆。

english: Wow, so now you're on your journey to be a better person?
translation: 哇，所以你现在在成为更好的人的旅程上？

english: Yup, though I do get thorough enjoyment watching people being pelted with snowballs.
translation: 对，不过我确实很享受看人们被雪球砸。

english: Happy Holidays!
translation: 节日快乐！

english: You too [player name].
translation: 你也是 [player name]。

english: Dodge the attack.
translation: 躲避攻击。

english: Let the ball hit you.
translation: 让球击中你。

english: Do you enjoy being a festive game host?
translation: 你喜欢当节日游戏主持人吗？

english: What's your story?
translation: 你的故事是什么？

english: Happy Holidays!
translation: 节日快乐！

english: Thank you for getting our herb patches to work. Now Boulder can grow goutweed for my people, and they are very happy.
translation: 谢谢你让我们的药草田恢复运作。现在 Boulder 可以为我的人民种植痛风草，他们很高兴。

english: Can I have another copy of that book?
translation: 能再给我一本那本书吗？

english: Yes, I have another copy for you.
translation: 可以，我还有一本给你。

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

english: How are you two doing?
translation: 你们两个怎么样？

english: Snowflake an' My Arm very happy. Maybe new herbie patch not da only place where new life gonna be growin' soon!
translation: 雪花和 My Arm 很高兴。也许新药草田不是唯一很快会有新生命成长的地方！

english: Let's not get ahead of ourselves, dear! But the town is thriving; my people are much happier now they are no longer terrified of Father.
translation: 亲爱的，别太乐观！但小镇正在繁荣；我的人民现在不再害怕父亲，开心多了。

english: Dem trolls likin' da goutweed too!
translation: 那些巨魔也喜欢痛风草！

english: That's nice.
translation: 太好了。

english: Can you note my basalt for me?
translation: 能帮我把玄武岩记为票据吗？

english: You aren't carrying any basalt.
translation: 你没带任何玄武岩。

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我走了。

english: You will always be welcome back.
translation: 欢迎你随时回来。

english: Here, solve this.
translation: 给，解这个。

english: My Arm hands you a puzzlebox!
translation: My Arm 递给你一个谜题盒！

english: That doesn't look solved to me.
translation: 在我看来这还没解开。

english: Well done [player name]. Here you go.
translation: 干得好 [player name]。给你。

english: You've been given a [new clue/casket]!
translation: 你获得了一个 [new clue/casket]！

english: Can I have another copy of that book?
translation: 能再给我一本那本书吗？

english: How are you two doing?
translation: 你们两个怎么样？

english: Can you note this basalt for me?
translation: 能帮我把这个玄武岩记为票据吗？

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我走了。

english: Kuani! Someone's come to visit the birds!
translation: 快来看！有人来拜访鸟儿们了！

english: I've spotted you working hard to help the guild. How would you like a basic quetzal whistle blueprint to help you get back here in the future?
translation: 我看到你一直在努力帮助公会。你想要一个基础克察尔哨子蓝图吗？这样以后可以帮你回到这里。

english: I'd love one!
translation: 我很想要！

english: You'll need to use the blueprint to craft a whistle from a willow log. Make sure it works for you. There's no standard size whistle nowadays.
translation: 你需要用蓝图从柳木原木制作一个哨子。确保它适合你。现在没有标准尺寸的哨子了。

english: When you want to charge your whistle, be sure to bring some of those lovely meats you're gathering up here for the birds. If they eat well you'll get a lot more use out of them!
translation: 想给哨子充能时，一定要带些你在这里为鸟儿收集的美味肉类。如果它们吃得好，你就能更多次使用哨子！

english: Not right now, thanks.
translation: 现在不用，谢谢。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: I'm Pitri, though most of the others call me birdbrain.
translation: 我是皮特里，不过大多数人都叫我鸟脑袋。

english: On account of the...?
translation: 因为……？

english: The birds, yes. I just feel so at home amongst them... Though I am more partial to cooked food than the raw stuff they get.
translation: 因为鸟儿，是的。我和它们在一起感觉很自在……不过我比它们更喜欢熟食而不是生食。

english: Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 还有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: Can you teach me about the birds?
translation: 你能教教我关于鸟儿的事吗？

english: Absolutely! Like many in Varlamore, we here at the guild use quetzals to help us move people and reports throughout the entire network of transport nodes.
translation: 当然！像瓦拉莫尔的许多人一样，我们公会用克察尔鸟帮助我们在整个运输节点网络中运送人员和报告。

english: We also have these handy quetzal whistles that allow us to call for one to take us back to the guild. They're pretty magical and work at very long ranges.
translation: 我们还有这些方便的克察尔哨子，可以召唤一只带我们回公会。它们很神奇，作用范围很远。

english: Could I get my hands on one of those whistles?
translation: 我能弄到一个那样的哨子吗？

english: Once you've become more settled in with us at the guild, absolutely.
translation: 等你在公会更安定下来后，当然可以。

english: Sure! I have a blueprint set aside for you to grab when you're ready.
translation: 当然！我给你留了一份蓝图，准备好了就来拿。

english: So how do you motivate the birds?
translation: 那你怎么激励鸟儿们？

english: Food, mostly. They're big fans of the raw meats that the hunters bring back with them. I'm worried they may be waiting to eat us, quite honestly!
translation: 主要是食物。它们非常喜欢猎人带回来的生肉。说实话，我担心它们可能在等着吃我们！

english: Well, they're certainly big enough to try.
translation: 嗯，它们确实大到可以尝试。

english: Can you recharge my whistle?
translation: 能给我的哨子充能吗？

english: Doesn't look like you've got anything I can feed to the birds here. You'll want to get some of the raw meats that the hunters bring back with them.
translation: 看起来你这里没有什么我可以喂给鸟儿的东西。你需要弄些猎人带回来的生肉。

english: Sure thing!
translation: 当然！

english: Looks like the birds are all full for now. Make them work a bit before feeding them again!
translation: 看起来鸟儿们现在都饱了。让它们再干点活再喂！

english: There you go. Some whistle charges for you!
translation: 给你。一些哨子充能！

english: How do I get my hands on more whistles?
translation: 我怎么弄到更多哨子？

english: I can produce another blueprint for you, for a small cost.
translation: 我可以再给你做一份蓝图，收点小费。

english: What sort of small cost?
translation: 多少小费？

english: 500 coins. These blueprints are my art, and before you say anything, 'exposure' is the last thing I want out here in the savannah.
translation: 500枚金币。这些蓝图是我的艺术作品，在你开口之前，''曝光''是我在这片草原上最不想要的东西。

english: Here you go, one whistle blueprint.
translation: 给你，一份哨子蓝图。

english: I'd better be off.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: Odd. You don't seem to have a whistle I can recharge.
translation: 奇怪。你好像没有我可以充能的哨子。

english: Please solve this for me. I have other things to be thinking about.
translation: 请帮我解这个。我还有其他事要想。

english: Sorry but you haven't solved the puzzle yet.
translation: 抱歉，但你还没解开谜题。

english: Thanks [player name]!
translation: 谢谢 [player name]！

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Can you teach me about the birds?
translation: 你能教教我关于鸟儿的事吗？

english: Can you recharge my whistle?
translation: 能给我的哨子充能吗？

english: How do I get my hands on more whistles?
translation: 我怎么弄到更多哨子？

english: I'd better be off.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: 如果我和你一样丑，我都不敢在公共场合露面！

english: Out of my way, punk.
translation: 让开，小混混。

english: Hmm... you smell strange...
translation: 嗯……你闻起来很奇怪……

english: Strange how?
translation: 怎么奇怪？

english: Like a human!
translation: 像人类！

english: Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: 哦！呃……我刚吃了一个，就这样！

english: Leave me alone.
translation: 别管我。

english: Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: 如果你珍惜生命就别再跟我说话！

english: Get lost!
translation: 滚开！

english: I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: 我没什么可给你的，别烦我，乞丐。

english: Have you no manners?
translation: 你没礼貌吗？

english: I don't have time for this right now.
translation: 我现在没时间应付这个。

english: I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: 我没兴趣和你这样可怜的肉袋子说话。

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
translation: 我打赌你有漂亮的爪子。

english: A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: 真是悲惨的一天啊……趁还能享受就享受吧。

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: 你要是抓到谁，答应分我一口。

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
translation: 我以前没在这里闻过你……

english: You smell familiar...
translation: 你闻起来很熟悉……

english: Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: 在这附近见过人类吗？我非——常饿。

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: 你看起来也是个嗜血之人。

english: Good day to you, my friend.
translation: 你好，我的朋友。

english: Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
translation: 想去城堡吃点零食吗？

english: Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
translation: 等一下，我牙缝里卡了点人肉渣……

english: By Ralos, we finally have a worthy challenger.
translation: 以拉洛斯之名，我们终于有了一个值得挑战的对手。

english: You've torn through multiple waves of combatants and you're still standing. I'm almost impressed.
translation: 你闯过了多波战斗者，还站着。我都要对你刮目相看了。

english: Now let's see how you handle a real foe...
translation: 现在让我们看看你如何应对真正的敌人……

english: Sol Heredit jumps down from his seat...
translation: 索尔‧赫雷迪特从座位上跳下……

english: You're back so soon? A lesser combatant would've retired in shame after the show you put on last time...
translation: 你这么快就回来了？上次你那样表现后，换成别的战士早就羞愧退场了……

english: But you're clearly different. Let's see what you have this time...
translation: 但你显然不同。让我们看看你这次有什么本事……

english: What is it they say? Third time's the charm? Let's see if that's true.
translation: 他们怎么说来着？第三次就成功了？让我们看看是不是真的。

english: To arms!
translation: 拿起武器！

english: You might be an incapable fighter, but at least you're persistent. Shall we?
translation: 你可能是个无能战士，但至少你很执着。开始吧？

english: Let's start by testing your footwork.
translation: 我们先测试一下你的步法。

english: Not bad. Let's try something else...
translation: 不错。让我们试试别的……

english: Impressive. Let's see how you handle this...
translation: 令人印象深刻。让我们看看你如何应对这个……

english: You can't win!
translation: 你赢不了！

english: Ralos guides my hand!
translation: 拉洛斯指引我的手！

english: LET'S END THIS!
translation: 让我们结束这一切！

english: Sol Heredit doesn't take kindly to your eager prayer.
translation: 索尔‧赫雷迪特对你的急切祈祷不以为然。

english: I'LL BREAK YOURBACK!
translation: 我要打断你的背！

english: I'LL CRUSH YOURBODY!
translation: 我要压碎你的身体！

english: I'LL TWIST YOURHANDSOFF!
translation: 我要扭断你的手！

english: I'LL BREAK YOURLEGS!
translation: 我要打断你的腿！

english: I'LL CUT YOURFEETOFF!
translation: 我要砍掉你的脚！

english: Sol Heredit grabs hold of your [body part/item] and deals massive damage!
translation: 索尔‧赫雷迪特抓住你的 [body part/item] 并造成巨大伤害！

english: You defended the wrong body part!
translation: 你防御错了身体部位！

english: You successfully defend your [body part] from Sol Heredit's grapple!
translation: 你成功防御了索尔‧赫雷迪特对你的 [body part] 的抓取！

english: You perfectly parry Sol Heredit's grapple!
translation: 你完美格挡了索尔‧赫雷迪特的抓取！

english: Your light shines... brightly...
translation: 你的光芒闪耀……明亮……

english: A worthy... opponent...
translation: 一个值得……的对手……

english: Ralos has smiled upon you...
translation: 拉洛斯已对你微笑……

english: My compliments, champion...
translation: 我的赞美，冠军……

english: How disappointing...
translation: 真失望……

english: I knew you weren't the one.
translation: 我就知道你不是那个人。

english: You had me excited for a moment.
translation: 你让我兴奋了一会儿。

english: Your lack of coordination is concerning.
translation: 你缺乏协调性令人担忧。

english: Your light shines no more.
translation: 你的光芒不再闪耀。

english: Maybe next time...
translation: 也许下次……

english: Pathetic, really...
translation: 真可怜，真的……

english: I was just getting into my rhythm...
translation: 我刚进入状态……

english: Hi!
translation: 嗨！

english: What?!
translation: 什么？！

english: Huh?!
Er...
OK...
translation: 好的……

english: Are you insulting me in Latin?
translation: 你是在用拉丁语侮辱我吗？

english: Yes!
translation: 是的！

english: Hmm...
Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: I've been posted here to guard this chasm.
translation: 我被派来这里守卫这个裂隙。

english: And how's that going?
translation: 进展如何？

english: Not great. There's constant bursts of hot air, demon roars and strange lights coming from inside.
translation: 不太妙。里面不断喷出热气、恶魔咆哮和奇怪的光芒。

english: And then there's the cultists. They just climb out like it's normal to be down there. Try to talk to you like it's business as usual.
translation: 还有那些邪教徒。他们爬出来就像在下面很正常一样。还试图跟你搭话，仿佛一切如常。

english: That does sound stressful.
translation: 那听起来确实很有压力。

english: How long are you posted here?
translation: 你要在这里驻守多久？

english: Indefinitely. We don't know what the cult is up to and we don't want to be caught unprepared.
translation: 无限期。我们不知道邪教在搞什么鬼，不想被打个措手不及。

english: Have you considered quitting?
translation: 你考虑过辞职吗？

english: No. I signed up to to protect Kourend, even if that means standing outside of a demon nest. Besides, it's not like any demons have come out of it yet.
translation: 没有。我参军是为了保护库兰德王国，即使这意味着要站在恶魔巢穴外面。况且，还没有恶魔从里面出来过。

english: Well, good luck.
translation: 好吧，祝你好运。

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

english: What do you want? Are you with those cultists?
translation: 你想要什么？你和那些邪教徒是一伙的吗？

english: What? No.
translation: 什么？不是。

english: Good. I've had enough of their games.
translation: 很好。我受够他们的把戏了。

english: Games? What do you mean?
translation: 把戏？你什么意思？

english: They start off polite, but before you know it, they're trying to get you to agree to something.
translation: 他们开始时很礼貌，但不知不觉就想让你同意某些事。

english: They're not fooling me though. The next one that crosses me is going to regret it!
translation: 但他们骗不了我。下一个惹我的会后悔的！

english: About the cultists... What sort of things do they ask you to agree to?
translation: 关于邪教徒……他们通常想让你同意什么？

english: Usually they want you to follow them somewhere private. Some of the bolder ones try to get you to join them inside the chasm.
translation: 通常他们想让你跟他们去某个私密的地方。有些大胆的会试图让你跟他们一起进入裂隙。

english: If it were up to me, we'd launch a sortie right now. See how they like it if we come down on our own terms.
translation: 如果由我决定，我们现在就会发动突袭。看看按我们的条件下去他们会怎样。

english: Aren't you worried about the demons?
translation: 你不担心恶魔吗？

english: You sound like the lieutenant.
translation: 你听起来像中尉。

english: You sound eager to fight.
translation: 你听起来很想战斗。

english: I am. If you ask me we should be out fighting lizardmen. That means we need to go on the offensive and wrap this chasm business up.
translation: 我确实想。要我说我们应该出去打蜥蜴人。这意味着我们需要主动出击，把裂隙这事解决了。

english: I take it the rest of your squad aren't as keen.
translation: 我想你小队的其他人没那么积极。

english: You'd be right. The lieutenant is too cautious and the rest are too timid. The way some of them speak you'd think they had demon families.
translation: 你说对了。中尉太谨慎，其他人太胆小。他们有些人说话的样子，你会以为他们有恶魔亲戚。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: If you see any cultists lurking around, let me know.
translation: 如果你看到任何邪教徒在附近潜伏，告诉我。

english: You look comfortable.
translation: 你看起来很自在。

english: I might as well be if we're going to continue this performance.
translation: 既然我们要继续这场表演，我不妨自在点。

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你什么意思？

english: There are no demons coming out of this chasm. If there were, we wouldn't last long.
translation: 这个裂隙里没有恶魔出来。如果有，我们撑不了多久。

english: You think the demons would overrun you?
translation: 你认为恶魔会压倒你们？

english: Demons don't die the same way we do. We could hold back a few of them, but not an endless stream.
translation: 恶魔的死法和我们不一样。我们可以挡住几个，但挡不住无穷无尽的。

english: You seem to know a lot about them.
translation: 你似乎很了解他们。

english: I do, which means I know that guarding the chasm is a pointless endeavour. Not that the lieutenant cares what I think.
translation: 我确实了解，这意味着我知道守卫裂隙是徒劳的。不过中尉不在乎我怎么想。

english: Launching an attack into the chasm would also be pointless. That leaves us with only one other option.
translation: 发动攻击进入裂隙也是徒劳。那我们只剩下一个选择。

english: Fleeing?
translation: 逃跑？

english: No. We should talk to them. Try to reach an understanding.
translation: 不。我们应该和他们谈谈。试着达成谅解。

english: Somehow I don't think negotiating with demons will end well.
translation: 不知怎么的，我觉得和恶魔谈判不会有好结果。

english: If you have a better idea, go ahead.
translation: 你有更好的主意，尽管说。

english: Aren't you a bit too calm about this?
translation: 你对这事是不是太冷静了？

english: No. If they wanted to, Yama and his demons could overrun this little squad.
translation: 不。如果他们想，阎魔和他的恶魔可以轻易压倒这个小队。

english: The fact they haven't means they're probably not interested in doing so. As a matter of fact, they seem quite polite.
translation: 他们没这么做意味着他们可能没兴趣。事实上，他们似乎相当礼貌。

english: You've spoken to them?
translation: 你和他们说过话？

english: I didn't say that, But there's evidence to suggest that Yama and his cult can be reasoned with.
translation: 我没这么说，但有证据表明阎魔和他的邪教是可以沟通的。

english: If Lord Shayzien is interested in diffusing the threat, he should consider trying to reach an agreement with them.
translation: 如果谢兹恩领主有兴趣化解威胁，他应该考虑试着和他们达成协议。

english: I've met Lord Shayzien. He doesn't seem like the type to compromise.
translation: 我见过谢兹恩领主。他看起来不是那种会妥协的人。

english: You've met Lord Shiro Shayzien?
translation: 你见过白袍谢兹恩领主？

english: Yes, I've met the leaders of all of the houses. Even King Artur Hosidius himself.
translation: 是的，我见过所有家族的领袖。甚至阿图尔‧霍西迪乌斯国王本人。

english: Interesting. You're quite the worldly fellow. Perhaps King Hosidius would make a more level headed negotiator. Maybe you could talk to him?
translation: 有趣。你真是个见多识广的人。也许霍西迪乌斯国王会是更冷静的谈判者。也许你可以和他谈谈？

english: I imagine he's quite busy at the moment.
translation: 我想他现在很忙。

english: How long are you posted here?
translation: 你要在这里驻守多久？

english: Have you considered quitting?
translation: 你考虑过辞职吗？

english: Well, good luck.
translation: 好吧，祝你好运。

english: About the cultists...
translation: 关于邪教徒……

english: You sound eager to fight.
translation: 你听起来很想战斗。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: You think the demons would overrun you?
translation: 你认为恶魔会压倒你们？

english: Aren't you a bit too calm about this?
translation: 你对这事是不是太冷静了？

english: Are you OK?
translation: 你还好吗？

english: Urrrgggh.....
translation: 呃呃呃……

english: I'll be OK, the trolls only leave the plateau at nightfall. The guys are bringing a stretcher shortly.
translation: 我会没事的，巨魔只在天黑时离开高原。伙计们很快就会带担架来。

english: As long as you're sure.
translation: 你确定就好。

english: It's my own fault really, I was having a walk and wandered past the danger sign. The trolls throw rocks down at any one who goes up the path!
translation: 其实是我自己的错，我散步时走过了危险标志。巨魔会向任何走上那条路的人扔石头！

english: Don't go up there!
translation: 别上去！

english: OK, thanks for the warning.
translation: 好的，谢谢提醒。

english: The Shayzien records say you've killed [X] lizardmen since they began tracking your kills.
translation: 谢兹恩城记录显示，自从他们开始追踪你的击杀数以来，你已经杀了 [X] 个蜥蜴人。

english: The Shayzien records say you've killed [X] lizardmen since they began tracking your kills. [X] were lizardman shamans.
translation: 谢兹恩城记录显示，自从他们开始追踪你的击杀数以来，你已经杀了 [X] 个蜥蜴人。其中 [X] 个是蜥蜴人萨满。

english: Are you here to fight the lizardmen? Be careful - they're fierce!
translation: 你是来这里打蜥蜴人的吗？小心——他们很凶猛！

english: Tell me about the lizardmen.
translation: 跟我讲讲蜥蜴人。

english: The lizardmen are the bane of Kourend. I'm not much for history, but the Shayzien Army have been fighting them off for as long as anyone can remember.
translation: 蜥蜴人是库兰德王国的祸害。我不太懂历史，但谢兹恩城卫军自古以来一直在和他们作战。

english: They can be aggressive, and they've got something nasty in their bite that can make you pretty ill.
translation: 他们很有攻击性，咬一口会让你病得很重。

english: Why are you up here instead of fighting?
translation: 你为什么在这里而不是在战斗？

english: I got a bite from a lizardman. I'm all cured, but I'm not going down there again until I feel stronger, otherwise I'll be no use in the fight.
translation: 我被蜥蜴人咬了。我已经治好了，但在感觉更强壮之前我不会再下去，否则我在战斗中派不上用场。

english: Do you know how many I've killed already?
translation: 你知道我已经杀了多少了吗？

english: The Shayzien records say you've killed [COUNT] lizardmen since they began tracking your kills. [COUNT] were lizardman shamans.
translation: 谢兹恩记录显示，自从他们开始追踪你的击杀数以来，你已经杀了 [COUNT] 个蜥蜴人。其中 [COUNT] 个是蜥蜴人萨满。

english: Thanks for the warning.
translation: 谢谢提醒。

english: I see no adventurers in the canyon to the east.
translation: 我在东边的峡谷没看到冒险者。

english: I see no adventurers in the canyon to the west.
translation: 我在西边的峡谷没看到冒险者。

english: Tell me about the lizardmen.
translation: 跟我讲讲蜥蜴人。

english: Why are you up here instead of fighting?
translation: 你为什么在这里而不是在战斗？

english: Do you know how many I've killed already?
translation: 你知道我已经杀了多少了吗？

english: Thanks for the warning.
translation: 谢谢提醒。

english: Hello, are you interested in our agility training courses?
translation: 你好，你对我们的敏捷训练课程感兴趣吗？

english: Yes, is it difficult?
translation: 是的，难吗？

english: Nothing is difficult for a Shayzien soldier. If you do the training every day, you can be as good as us.
translation: 对谢兹恩士兵来说没什么难的。如果你每天训练，你可以和我们一样好。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Fair enough. Feel free to give it a go if you change your mind.
translation: 好吧。如果你改变主意，随时可以试试。

english: Hi, I've seen your moves on the agility course, well done!
translation: 嗨，我在敏捷训练场上看到你的表现了，干得好！

english: Do you want to know more about how you've been doing?
translation: 你想了解更多关于你的表现吗？

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: You've not completed any laps of our basic agility course yet. There's been [number] completions and the global best time is [time].
translation: 你还没有完成任何一圈基础敏捷训练。目前已有 [number] 次完成记录，全球最佳时间是 [time]。

english: You've completed 1 lap of our basic agility course with a lap time of [time]. There's been [number] global completions and the global best time is [time].
translation: 你已完成1圈基础敏捷训练，用时 [time]。目前全球已有 [number] 次完成，全球最佳时间是 [time]。

english: You've completed [number] laps of our basic agility course with a best time of [time]. There's been [number] global completions and the global best time is [time].
translation: 你已完成 [number] 圈基础敏捷训练，最佳用时 [time]。目前全球已有 [number] 次完成，全球最佳时间是 [time]。

english: You've not completed any laps of our advanced agility course yet. There's been [number] completions and the global best time is [time].
translation: 你还没有完成任何一圈高级敏捷训练。目前已有 [number] 次完成记录，全球最佳时间是 [time]。

english: You've completed 1 lap of our advanced agility course with a lap time of [time]. There's been [number] global completions and the global best time is [time].
translation: 你已完成1圈高级敏捷训练，用时 [time]。目前全球已有 [number] 次完成，全球最佳时间是 [time]。

english: You've completed [number] laps of our advanced course with a best time of [time]. There's been [number] global completions and the global best time is [time].
translation: 你已完成 [number] 圈高级训练，最佳用时 [time]。目前全球已有 [number] 次完成，全球最佳时间是 [time]。

english: Yes, is it difficult?
translation: 是的，难吗？

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Shayzien Basic Course.
translation: 谢兹恩基础训练。

english: Shayzien Advanced Course:
translation: 谢兹恩高级训练：

english: Not often you see a couple of soldiers out for a drink.
translation: 不常见到几个士兵出来喝酒。

english: We've just finished our first duties in the Lizardman Canyon. A few drinks at the Cloak and Stagger to celebrate is always traditional.
translation: 我们刚完成在蜥蜴人峡谷的首次任务。在斗篷与蹒跚酒馆喝几杯庆祝是传统。

english: Sounds like you earned it. Enjoy!
translation: 看来这是你们应得的。好好享受！

english: Don't expect me to deal with the likes of you.
translation: 别指望我会和你这种人打交道。

english: You do not have enough Shayzien favour. Current favour: [current favour in %] - Required: 60.0%
translation: 你的谢兹恩城声望不足。当前声望：[current favour in %] - 需要：60.0%

english: If you're planning on fighting me for a set of my armour, I'm afraid I'm not interested. The combat XP from fighting you isn't worthwhile. Get a Defence level of 20 first.
translation: 如果你打算和我战斗来赢取我的盔甲，恐怕我没兴趣。和你战斗获得的战斗经验不值得。先把防御等级升到20吧。

english: Hello. Do you fancy a fight? It's just a bit of fun, so I can practice melee combat. I'll give you a piece of my armour if you win.
translation: 你好。想打一架吗？只是玩玩，我可以练习近战。如果你赢了，我会给你一件我的盔甲。

english: Okay, I reckon I can take you. Did you just say you wanted to practice melee combat in particular?
translation: 好的，我想我能打败你。你刚才说你想特别练习近战？

english: Yes, I'm not interested in fancy magicks. We leave that namby-pamby stuff to the Arceuus weirdos. And no ranging either. We'll fight just with melee.
translation: 是的，我对花哨的魔法没兴趣。我们把那种软绵绵的东西留给阿西乌斯城的怪人。也不用远程。我们只用近战打。

english: Remember, if you lose, you'll probably drop some items, and you probably won't get them back again. Just run away if you want to stop the fight.
translation: 记住，如果你输了，你可能会掉落一些物品，而且可能拿不回来。如果想停止战斗，逃跑就行。

english: I understand. Let's fight.
translation: 我明白了。我们打吧。

english: To the arena!
translation: 去竞技场！

english: Let's forget about fighting for now.
translation: 我们先别打了吧。

english: In that case you probably shouldn't be hanging around an army camp.
translation: 那样的话你可能不应该在军营附近闲逛。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Let me know if you change your mind. I need combat practice if I'm ever going to level up.
translation: 如果你改变主意告诉我。我要升级需要战斗练习。

english: Fancy another fight? The combat practice is good for me. I'll give you some more of my armour if you win.
translation: 想再打一场吗？战斗练习对我有好处。如果你赢了，我会再给你一些我的盔甲。

english: Sure, let's fight.
translation: 当然，我们打吧。

english: Let me know if you change your mind. The combat practice is good for me.
translation: 如果你改变主意告诉我。战斗练习对我有好处。

english: Don't you already have a set of my armour?
translation: 你不是已经有我的一套盔甲了吗？

english: Let's fight again - I don't mind duplicates.
translation: 我们再打一场——我不介意重复的。

english: Okay, I guess I needn't fight you again.
translation: 好吧，我想我不需要再和你打了。

english: I'll be here if you ever change your mind.
translation: 如果你改变主意我会在这里。

english: Focus on your fight!
translation: 专心战斗！

english: Okay, I reckon I can take you.
translation: 好的，我想我能打败你。

english: I understand. Let's fight.
translation: 我明白了。我们打吧。

english: Let's forget about fighting for now.
translation: 我们先别打了吧。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Sure, let's fight.
translation: 当然，我们打吧。

english: Let's fight again - I don't mind duplicates.
translation: 我们再打一场——我不介意重复的。

english: Okay, I guess I needn't fight you again.
translation: 好吧，我想我不需要再和你打了。

translation: 你想买或卖一些食物吗？

english: Yes, please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No, thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Yes, please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No, thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Can you hear me?
translation: 你能听到我说话吗？

english: Of course! I'm wearing an amulet of ghostspeak.
translation: 当然！我戴着鬼语护符。

english: ...I can, but I'm not wearing an amulet of ghostspeak... A-am I dead?
translation: ……我能听到，但我没戴鬼语护符……我、我死了吗？

english: ...I can. Are you a ghost?
translation: ……我能听到。你是鬼魂吗？

english: I'm no ghost! I'm a spirit, I'm injecting my thoughts into your head.
translation: 我不是鬼魂！我是灵体，我将想法传入你的脑海。

english: Oh, that's... interesting. Also rather disturbing...
translation: 哦，那……很有趣。也相当令人不安……

english: Try not to think about it.
translation: 尽量别想太多。

english: Could you imbue my sceptre?
translation: 你能强化我的权杖吗？

english: Of course I can... But first, you must show me whatever treasure lies within that cradle and make sure that your account is safe.
translation: 当然可以……但首先，你必须给我看看那个摇篮里的宝藏，并确保你的账户安全。

english: Is my account safe?
translation: 我的账户安全吗？

english: To make sure your account is secured, please turn on the authenticator. Simply visit the support link on the oldschool.runescape.com website.
translation: 为确保你的账户安全，请开启身份验证器。只需访问 oldschool.runescape.com 网站上的支持链接。

english: Oh, that sounds like a great idea, I'll go do that.
translation: 哦，听起来是个好主意，我去做。

english: It seems you have the authenticator set up, that's perfect! Now just show me the treasure.
translation: 看来你已经设置了身份验证器，太好了！现在给我看看宝藏。

english: Is this the treasure?
translation: 这是宝藏吗？

english: Oh marvellous! If only I had corporeal form I'd be able to wear them, but alas...
translation: 哦太棒了！如果我有实体我就能戴上它们，但唉……

english: So could you imbue my sceptre?
translation: 那你能强化我的权杖吗？

english: It seems your account isn't as secure as it could be, I'm afraid I can't imbue your sceptre.
translation: 看来你的账户不够安全，恐怕我不能强化你的权杖。

english: Oh.
translation: 哦。

english: Of course, of course! In fact if you have more than one I'll imbue all of them!
translation: 当然，当然！事实上如果你不止一个，我会全部强化！

english: There you go, now that I've imbued all of your sceptres, once they run out of charges they will no longer break and they can be charged with any piece of the sceptre you find.
translation: 好了，现在我已经强化了你的所有权杖，一旦它们耗尽充能次数就不会再损坏，可以用你找到的任何权杖碎片充能。

english: Thank you very much! How many charges does each piece give?
translation: 非常感谢！每个碎片提供多少充能次数？

english: Most of them give 3, although the left skull gives 5. Each completed tier of the Varrock achievement diary will get you one extra charge per piece and allow your sceptre to hold 4 more charges.
translation: 多数碎片提供3次充能，左头骨则提供5次。每完成一级维洛克城成就日志，每个碎片会额外提供1点充能次数，权杖容量也可增加4次充能次数。

english: You can use a chisel to break a sceptre piece into fragments, then use those to charge the sceptre instead. More flexible if you ask me.
translation: 你可以用凿子把权杖碎片敲成小块，然后用那些来给权杖充能。要我说这样更灵活。

english: Finally, be warned that if you disable your authenticator, the imbue on the sceptre will be removed.
translation: 最后提醒，如果你禁用身份验证器，权杖的强化会被移除。

english: Fantastic! It's best I keep my authenticator activated then. Good byeSolztun!
translation: 太好了！那我最好保持身份验证器开启。再见索尔兹顿！

english: Stay safe, adventurer.
translation: 保重，冒险者。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: I am Solztun, the greatest barbarian explorer!
translation: 我是索尔兹顿，最伟大的野蛮人探险家！

english: It's very nice to meet you, Solztun! I'm [player name].
translation: 很高兴见到你，索尔兹顿！我是 [player name]。

english: I know.
translation: 我知道。

english: ... so, you were exploring this place?
translation: ……所以，你在探索这个地方？

english: Yes, my sister told me not to go, she said it was dangerous and that I'm no fighter. Unfortunately... she was correct.
translation: 是的，我姐姐告诉我别去，她说那里很危险，我不是战士。不幸的是……她说对了。

english: Oh! Your sister is Litara, the woman out on the surface? How come she was correct?
translation: 哦！你姐姐是利塔拉，那个在地面上的女人？她怎么就说对了？

english: I died... Of course, I tried escaping, long before I'd made it to the treasure, but I was shot with arrows just as I approached the exit.
translation: 我死了……当然，我试图逃跑，在到达宝藏之前很久，但就在我接近出口时被箭射中了。

english: As I said, I am Solztun, the greatest barbarian explorer! I came to explore this place, but unfortunately I died long before I made it to the treasure.
translation: 正如我所说，我是索尔兹顿，最伟大的野蛮人探险家！我来探索这个地方，但不幸的是我在到达宝藏之前就死了。

english: Nobody came to help?!
translation: 没人来帮忙？！

english: Oh no, they had no idea I was hurt, I guess they assumed I'd found the treasure and made a new life for myself.
translation: 哦不，他们不知道我受伤了，我想他们以为我找到了宝藏，开始了新生活。

english: Were you not a fan of the barbarian life style?
translation: 你不喜欢野蛮人的生活方式吗？

english: It was all death and pillaging, I prefer the finer things in life, like exploration and discovery!
translation: 全是死亡和掠夺，我更喜欢生活中更美好的事物，比如探索和发现！

english: Ah, I too enjoy those.
translation: 啊，我也喜欢那些。

english: Why are you here?
translation: 你为什么在这里？

english: I came for treasure!
translation: 我来找宝藏！

english: Oh right, you were looking for what's in that cradle?
translation: 哦对，你在找那个摇篮里的东西？

english: Yes, but alas, I'm dead.
translation: 是的，但唉，我死了。

english: I guess I could show you... for a price.
translation: 我想我可以给你看……代价是。

english: Hmm... I don't have much to offer, but if you happen upon a skull sceptre, I could make it stronger.
translation: 嗯……我没什么可提供的，但如果你碰到头骨权杖，我可以让它更强。

english: Stronger you say... In what way?
translation: 更强你说……在什么方面？

english: Currently the sceptre is fragile, it breaks once all charges have been used. Show me the treasure and I could imbue it so it can be recharged with any sceptre piece.
translation: 目前权杖很脆弱，充能次数用尽就会损坏。给我看看宝藏，我可以强化它，这样它可以用任何权杖碎片充能。

english: You, my dead friend, have a deal!
translation: 你，我死去的朋友，成交！

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！

english: No, that's not it.
translation: 不，不是那个。

english: But I didn't show you anything.
translation: 但我什么都没给你看。

english: I sense that you don't have the treasure.
translation: 我感觉到你没有宝藏。

english: Could you imbue my sceptre?
translation: 你能强化我的权杖吗？

english: Is my account safe?
translation: 我的账户安全吗？

english: Is this the treasure?
translation: 这是宝藏吗？

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Why are you here?
translation: 你为什么在这里？

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！

english: Hmm... You're not my usual kind of customer, but I reckon I can still make this work. What will it be? Haircut or a shave?
translation: 嗯……你不是我平常的客户类型，但我想我还能应付。要什么？理发还是刮胡子？

english: I'd like a haircut please.
translation: 我想理发。

english: Then let's get to it.
translation: 那我们开始吧。

english: I'd like a shave please.
translation: 我想刮胡子。

english: I'm good, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。

english: Suit yourself.
translation: 随你便。

english: I'd like a haircut please.
translation: 我想理发。

english: I'd like a shave please.
translation: 我想刮胡子。

english: I'm good, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。

english: Sorry, I can't chat while I'm on duty. I have to keep alert.
translation: 抱歉，我在执勤时不能聊天。我必须保持警惕。

english: How can I help you?
translation: 我能怎么帮你？

english: What are you doing down here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: We're here to guard the bank and make sure no one tries anything.
translation: 我们在这里守卫银行，确保没人搞鬼。

english: Do you have a tinderbox?
translation: 你有火绒盒吗？

english: I have one I could sell you for 50 coins.
translation: 我有一个可以50金币卖给你。

english: I'll take it.
translation: 我要了。

english: Actually, I don't seem to have enough money on me.
translation: 其实，我身上好像没带够钱。

english: Sorry, that's too expensive.
translation: 抱歉，那太贵了。

english: No problem. Come back if you change your mind.
translation: 没问题。如果你改变主意再来。

english: I do, but I'd like to hold on to it for now.
translation: 我有，但我想先留着。

english: That's okay; I've one with me anyway.
translation: 没关系；反正我身上有一个。

english: Do you have a torch?
translation: 你有火把吗？

english: I'll sell you an unlit one for 200 coins.
translation: 我可以200金币卖给你一个未点燃的。

english: How come you're not spotty?
translation: 你怎么没长斑点？

english: Ah, the pox. We weren't here when the outbreak took place. We were out of town trying to catch an antiques thief called Simon Templeton. We've only just got back.
translation: 啊，痘疫。爆发时我们不在这里。我们在城外追捕一个叫西蒙‧坦普尔顿的古董贼。我们刚回来。

english: Aren't you afraid you'll fall ill as well?
translation: 你不怕也会生病吗？

english: The only reason we've been let back into the city is because the High Priest believes the pox isn't contagious.
translation: 我们被允许回城的唯一原因是大祭司认为痘疫不会传染。

english: Besides, Sophanem is my home. It will take a lot more than the threat of a few spots to keep me away.
translation: 况且，索法尼恩城是我的家。几个斑点的威胁可赶不走我。

english: You can't. I'd better go.
translation: 你不能。我最好走了。

english: Be careful down there!
translation: 在下面小心！

english: What are you doing down here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Do you have a tinderbox?
translation: 你有火绒盒吗？

english: I'll take it.
translation: 我要了。

english: Sorry, that's too expensive.
translation: 抱歉，那太贵了。

english: Do you have a torch?
translation: 你有火把吗？

english: How come you're not spotty?
translation: 你怎么没长斑点？

english: You can't. I'd better go.
translation: 你不能。我最好走了。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: You! You're the reason I'm in here.
translation: 你！你就是我关在这里的原因。

english: Yeah... Sorry about that. This is what happens when you make poor life choices though.
translation: 是啊……抱歉。这就是你做出糟糕人生选择的后果。

english: I hope you enjoy this moment, it won't last.
translation: 希望你享受这一刻，不会持久的。

english: Tell me about Tumeken.
translation: 告诉我图梅肯。

english: Tumeken is the god of light and husband to Elidinis. He is the leading god of the Menaphite Pantheon.
translation: 图梅肯是光明之神，伊莉迪尼斯的丈夫。他是梅纳菲特神系的主神。

translation: 人们似乎不太谈论他。我以为作为主神会更受欢迎。

translation: 关于图梅肯有句俗语：你随处可见他，但从未真正注意到他。

english: Okay... And what kind of god is he? The desert is a harsh place, so does that make him harsh as well?
translation: 好的……他是什么样的神？沙漠是个严酷的地方，那他也严酷吗？

english: In some ways. You humans sometimes say that 'you have to be cruel to be kind'. That seems a fitting way to describe Tumeken.
translation: 在某些方面。你们人类有时说''为了善良必须残忍''。这似乎是描述图梅肯的恰当方式。

english: So he's harsh, but for good reasons?
translation: 所以他很严酷，但有正当理由？

english: Indeed.
translation: 确实。

english: Tell me about Elidinis.
translation: 告诉我伊莉迪尼斯。

english: Elidinis is the goddess of fertility. The River Elid is named in her honour, for it brings life to the whole region.
translation: 伊莉迪尼斯是生育女神。艾利德河以她的名字命名，因为它为整个地区带来生命。

english: There are some who even believe the river to be Elidinis herself.
translation: 有些人甚至认为这条河就是伊莉迪尼斯本人。

english: That's an interesting take. I guess being a bringer of life makes her quite popular?
translation: 这观点很有趣。我想作为生命使者她很受欢迎？

translation: 比神系中许多其他神更受欢迎，但不如从前。

english: Why not?
translation: 为什么不？

translation: 听起来不太可能。

english: Well if you're after the human take on things, you'd be better off asking a human.
translation: 如果你想了解人类的看法，最好去问人类。

translation: 告诉我伊克哈林。

translation: 伊克哈林是死亡之神。他是图梅肯和伊莉迪尼斯的儿子，吞噬者的兄弟。因为这里是死者之城，他在这里很受欢迎。

english: So are you a follower of Icthlarin?
translation: 那你是伊克哈林的追随者吗？

translation: 完全不是。我对神或他们的追随者没兴趣。相反，我和伊克哈林有默契。

translation: 猫在保护死者免受吞噬者侵害方面起着重要作用。因此，它们是伊克哈林的伟大盟友。

english: As a thank you for looking after them, Icthlarin grants me eternal life.
translation: 作为照顾它们的感谢，伊克哈林赐予我永生。

translation: 我有兴趣听听你的看法。

translation: 很好。吞噬者是毁灭女神。因此，她通常被认为是邪恶女神，但这过于简化了。

translation: 造成死亡就足以让人邪恶吗？伊克哈林是死亡之神。按你的说法，他肯定是最邪恶的。

english: Icthlarin doesn't actually kill people though. He just looks after those that have died.
translation: 但伊克哈林实际上不杀人。他只是照顾已死之人。

english: It's sort of mesmerising...

english: Do you have a spare fishing net I could have?

english: Thanks...

english: Goodbye.

english: I have come to seek a blessing.

english: I see you have the unholy symbol of our Lord. It is blessed with the Lord Zamorak's power.
translation: 我看到你有我们主君的邪符。它已被扎莫拉克主君的力量祝福。

english: Come to me when your faith weakens.

english: The ghost hands you another mould.

english: Leave me be.

english: I seek your wisdom.

english: My Lord instructs me to help you.

english: Here is a mould to make a token for our Lord; a mould for the unholy symbol of Zamorak.

english: Can I have some?
translation: 能给我一些吗？

english: Oh, it's not cooked yet. But they sell frogburgers in the market!
translation: 哦，还没熟。但市场里有卖青蛙汉堡！

english: Boo!

english: Woof!

translation: 汪汪！

english: You give the dog some nice bones.
translation: 你给狗一些好吃的骨头。

translation: 它开心地啃着。

translation: 你给狗一块好吃的肉。

english: It gobbles it up.
translation: 它狼吞虎咽地吃了。

english: Grrrr!
translation: 咕噜！

translation: 狗似乎对那个不感兴趣。

english: Bark!
translation: 吠！

english: He doesn't approve of your ears.
translation: 他不认可你的耳朵。

english: I see you.
translation: 我看到你了。

english: You do?
translation: 是吗？

english: Indeed! It's kind of what I do. The name's Virginia. I'm a lookout for the spirit anglers, as well as a six time eye spy world champion.
translation: 确实！这算是我的本职工作。我叫弗吉尼亚。我是海灵垂钓者的瞭望员，也是六届间谍世界冠军。

english: And what are you on the lookout for at the moment?
translation: 那你现在在留意什么？

english: To be honest, a new adventure. The anglers have been good to me, but after the chaos with Tempoross, I'd like a fresh start.
translation: 老实说，新的冒险。渔夫们对我很好，但在海灵混乱之后，我想重新开始。

english: Makes sense. Well, I hope one finds you soon.
translation: 有道理。嗯，希望你早日找到。

english: I hope so too, but not before I find it first!
translation: 我也希望，但得在我先找到它之前！

english: To be honest, a new adventure. The angler's have been good to me, but after the chaos with Tempoross, I'd like a fresh start.
translation: 老实说，新的冒险。渔夫们对我很好，但在海灵混乱之后，我想重新开始。

english: Well, at some point I plan to hire a crew of my own. I'm not ready for that sort of thing yet, but when I am, maybe you'd be interested?
translation: 嗯，我打算将来雇佣自己的船员。我还没准备好，但到时候也许你有兴趣？

english: I think I might be! You just let me know once you start recruiting... provided I don't spot you first, of course!
translation: 我想我可能会有兴趣！你开始招募时告诉我……当然前提是我没先发现你！

english: You need a Sailing level of 40 to manage a crew.
translation: 你需要40级航海技能才能管理船员。

english: Spotted again!
translation: 又被发现了！

english: Ah, hello again. How are things going?
translation: 啊，又见面了。过得怎么样？

english: Pretty well, though I'm still on the lookout for a new adventure.
translation: 挺好的，不过我还在寻找新的冒险。

english: Maybe I could help? How about you join my crew?
translation: 也许我能帮忙？你加入我的船员队伍怎么样？

english: Sorry, but I can't see that happening right now. Maybe once you're more experienced.
translation: 抱歉，我看现在不太可能。也许等你更有经验些。

english: You require the following to recruit this crew member: Level 90 Sailing. Have subdued the Tempoross 100 times.
translation: 招募这名船员需要以下条件：90级航海技能。已制服海灵100次。

english: Sure! I can watch your back!
translation: 当然！我可以掩护你！

english: You recruit Spotter Virginia as a crew member. She departs for the Pandemonium.
translation: 你招募了瞭望员弗吉尼亚作为船员。她启程前往潘德莫尼姆号。

english: Well, I hope one finds you soon.
translation: 嗯，希望你早日找到。

english: Nice to see you, Captain.
translation: 很高兴见到你，船长。

english: Hello there. How are things going?
translation: 你好。过得怎么样？

english: Pretty good. I'm very much enjoying seeing the sights.
translation: 挺好的。我很享受观光。

english: Well, let me know if you spot anything worth looking into.
translation: 嗯，如果你发现什么值得调查的东西告诉我。

english: Aye, Captain!
translation: 是，船长！

english: How about you join my crew?
translation: 你加入我的船员队伍怎么样？

english: Well, good luck with it.
translation: 嗯，祝你好运。

english: I've only recently moved in and I'm still getting unpacked. Could you come back later?
translation: 我才刚搬进来，还在收拾行李。你能稍后再来吗？

english: 'Ello, and what are you after then?
translation: 嘿，那你想要什么？

english: I need another assignment.

english: You're actually very strong, are you sure you don't want Chaeldar in Zanaris to assign you a task?
translation: 你其实很强，确定不想让扎纳里斯的凯尔达给你分配任务吗？

english: No that's okay, I'll take a task from you.
translation: 不没关系，我从你这接任务。

english: Oh okay then, I'll go talk to Chaeldar.
translation: 哦那好吧，我去找凯尔达。

english: Excellent, you're doing great. Your new task is to kill [amount] [task monster].
translation: 太好了，你做得很好。你的新任务是杀死 [amount] 只 [task monster]。

translation: 我觉得那任务不适合你。要我取消吗？这不会清除你的任务连续完成次数。

english: Yes, please cancel it.
translation: 是的，请取消。

english: Alright, consider the task cancelled. You can now get a new assignment when you want one.
translation: 好的，任务已取消。你现在可以随时接新任务。

english: No, thanks, I want to try doing it.
translation: 不，谢谢，我想试试。

english: Good luck with that.
translation: 祝你好运。

english: Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
translation: 你有什么奖励给我，或者有什么可交易的吗？

english: I have quite a few rewards you can earn, and a wide variety of Slayer equipment for sale.
translation: 我有不少你可以获得的奖励，还有各种杀戮装备出售。

english: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
translation: 我们谈谈我任务的难度。

english: The Slayer Masters may currently assign you any task in our lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: 杀戮大师目前可能会分配列表中的任何任务，无论你的战斗等级。

english: That's fine - I can handle any task.
translation: 没关系——我能应付任何任务。

translation: 这才是态度。

translation: 以后请别给太难的任务。

translation: 好的，从现在开始，所有杀戮大师在为你选择任务时会考虑你的战斗等级，所以你不会接到太难的任务。

translation: 你好朋友！非常感谢你的帮助！维文甚至没意识到那是把不同的剑，我还保住了工作！

english: I'm glad the new sword worked out alright.
translation: 很高兴新剑没问题。

translation: 抱歉，大人，你不能进入这个区域。

translation: 训练场仅限近战区域。梅林已对场地施法，防止任何人使用祈祷、远程或魔法。

translation: 进入场地后，你将依次与每位圆桌骑士战斗。每位骑士都比前一位更熟练，但都有不同的攻击风格可以利用。总共有八位骑士，

translation: 如果你是一位伟大的战士并击败了所有骑士中最强大的兰斯洛特爵士，你将获得丰厚奖励。你将获得两个新祈祷，重生点将设为卡美洛，

english: Would you like me to repeat any of that for you?
translation: 你想让我重复任何内容吗？

english: Tell me about the training ground.
translation: 和我说说训练场的事。

english: Only melee combat is allowed within the training grounds. Merlin will prevent the use of Prayer, Ranged and Magic.
translation: 训练场内只允许近战 combat。梅林将阻止使用祈祷、远程和魔法。

english: Why?
translation: 为什么？

english: These grounds are for only the best knights of the land. It is not just testing your combat ability, but your honour and your chivalry. You must face your enemy head on, honourably and bravely.
translation: 这些场地只供国内最优秀的骑士使用。这不仅是测试你的 combat 能力，还有你的荣誉和骑士精神。你必须正面、光荣且勇敢地面对敌人。

english: Be watchful of your stats, as the Knights can do damage to your combat stats as well as your hitpoints.
translation: 注意你的属性，因为骑士不仅会伤害你的生命值，还会伤害你的战斗属性。

english: Tell me about dying or leaving the grounds.
translation: 和我说说死亡或离开场地的事。

english: As these are only training grounds, we keep our knights safe. If you should die, you will be teleported back to here and all of your items will be safe.
translation: 由于这只是训练场，我们保护骑士的安全。如果你死亡，你将被传送回这里，所有物品都将安全。

english: However, leaving the training grounds, in anyway, will mean you will have to start from the beginning the next time you enter. These grounds do not favour cowards.
translation: 但是，以任何方式离开训练场，都意味着下次进入时必须从头开始。这些场地不青睐懦夫。

english: I have to start again? What do you mean?
translation: 我必须重新开始？你什么意思？

english: You fight each knight of the Round Table, starting with Sir Bedivere and finishing with Sir Lancelot. Leaving means you will have to begin fighting Sir Bedivere again and work your way back up.
translation: 你与每位圆桌骑士战斗，从贝狄威尔爵士开始，到兰斯洛特爵士结束。离开意味着你必须再次从贝狄威尔爵士开始打起，一路打回去。

english: What if I log out during the fights?
translation: 如果我在战斗中注销怎么办？

english: If you log out during a fight, upon logging back in you will fight the knight you were fighting when you logged out.
translation: 如果你在战斗中注销，登录回来后你将继续与注销时正在战斗的骑士战斗。

english: Tell me about the rewards.
translation: 和我说说奖励的事。

english: King Arthur believes in rewarding his knights for their chivalry. Having proven yourself in combat against his knights, and in your services rendered to Camelot, you will be rewarded with two new prayers, and a new
translation: 亚瑟王相信奖励骑士的骑士精神。在证明了自己能与他的骑士 combat，并为卡美洛提供服务后，你将获得两个新祈祷，

english: Ah, patience is a virtue in knights, my lord. Fight in the training ground and earn your reward to find out!

translation: 我是维克斯，卡勒‧弗莱夫爵士的侍从。他去伯索普公国执行监视任务了，所以派我来这里打扫。

translation: 别告诉骑士们，但我就是没心情！我服役多年，工作很努力，但他们甚至没想过让我成为骑士。

english: This place? It's the castle crypt. The greatest White Knights are buried here, after a lifetime in the service of Saradomin. At least, that's how it used to be.
translation: 这个地方？这是城堡墓穴。最伟大的白骑士在侍奉萨拉多明一生后葬在这里。至少，过去是这样。

english: It's because of something the Temple Knights have, called the Gaze of Saradomin. They get the option of being brought to Falador when they die, so Death has to maintain a presence in the area.
translation: 这是因为神殿骑士有个叫萨拉多明之眼的东西。他们死后可以选择被带到法拉多，所以死神必须在该区域维持存在。
