translation: 搅拌器会将混合物均质化。

english: And finally, theRetortwillConcentratethe mixture.
translation: 最后，蒸馏瓶会将混合物浓缩。

english: After processing, place the finished mixture on theConveyor Beltand move on to the next order.
translation: 加工完成后，将完成的混合物放在传送带上，然后继续下一个订单。

english: What if I get an order wrong, or am unable to fulfil any of the orders?
translation: 如果我弄错订单，或者无法完成任何订单怎么办？

english: We always have need for spares, so fulfilling an incorrect order will still grant you a small reward and will refresh the orders.
translation: 我们总有备用需求，所以就算完成错误订单也能获得小奖励，同时订单会刷新。

english: One final thing to mention... We have someDigweedgrowing in the lab.
translation: 最后提一件事……实验室里种了一些地丁草。

english: These rare herbs will occasionally come into maturity for a short period of time. Harvest them while you can!
translation: 这些稀有草药偶尔会短暂成熟。趁能收获时收获它们！

english: Mixing some into your product will increase its potency and grant you bonus rewards.
translation: 将一些混入你的产品会增强其效力并给你额外奖励。

english: Bonus rewards?
translation: 额外奖励？

english: That's right. As you produce potions, you'll find yourself collecting three types ofResin. The types obtained depend on what reagents are used, with the quantities being determined by the complexity of the
translation: 没错。当你生产药水时，你会发现自己收集三种类型的树脂。获得的类型取决于使用什么试剂，

english: potion.
translation: 数量由药水的复杂度决定。

english: Potions usingDigweedwill reward additionalResin, as will handing in multiple potions in one go.
translation: 使用地丁草的药水会奖励额外树脂，一次性提交多个药水也会。

english: Got it! So, refine herbs, deposit into the hopper, mix some products, process them, and then throw them on the conveyor. Seems easy enough!
translation: 明白了！所以，精炼草药，放入料斗，混合一些产品，加工它们，然后把它们扔到传送带上。看起来足够简单！

english: I'm sure I can work it out.
translation: 我相信我能搞定。

english: Suit yourself. I'll be here if you change your mind.
translation: 随你便。如果你改变主意我还会在这里。

english: What is it?
translation: 是什么？

english: Can you explain how to make potions?
translation: 你能解释如何制作药水吗？

english: Can I have some rewards?
translation: 我能拿些奖励吗？

english: As you wish.
translation: 如你所愿。

english: Can you tell me more about the Alchemical Society?
translation: 你能告诉我更多关于炼金协会的事吗？

english: Can't imagine there's much to tell beyond what you already know. We exist to bring about advancements in Herblore, but in truth, a lot of what we produce doesn't directly contribute to that.
translation: 想不出除了你已经知道的还有什么可说的。我们存在是为了推动草药学的进步，但事实上，我们生产的很多东西并不直接贡献于此。

english: Instead, many of the potions we make here are simply to sell. Doing so is what provides the funding we need to further our true goals.
translation: 相反，我们在这里制作的许多药水只是为了出售。这样做为我们进一步实现真正目标提供资金。

english: Makes sense. So how did the society first get established?
translation: 有道理。那么协会最初是如何建立的？

english: For a long time, it was just a couple of us operating out of a makeshift lab we'd built in my garden. Our big break came when the Moonrise Brewery and Winery learnt about us.
translation: 很长一段时间，只有我们几个人在我花园里建的临时实验室工作。我们的重大突破是月升啤酒厂和酿酒厂了解到我们时。

english: They provided us with some initial funding to properly get things going, but more importantly, they provided this lab space. This was actually one of their old wine cellars before we moved in.
translation: 他们为我们提供了一些启动资金让事情正常运转，但更重要的是，他们提供了这个实验室空间。在我们搬进来之前，这实际上是他们的一个旧酒窖。

english: Why were they so interested in your work?
translation: 他们为什么对你的工作这么感兴趣？

english: They never properly said why, just that they were very keen to see us grow. Maybe they're hoping our work can help them create new beers and wines.
translation: 他们从未真正说明为什么，只是说他们非常希望看到我们成长。也许他们希望我们的工作能帮助他们创造新的啤酒和葡萄酒。

english: I see. I suppose that makes sense.
translation: 我明白了。我想那有道理。

english: Nothing, I'll be going now.
translation: 没什么，我该走了。

english: Hey! I haven't given you permission to do that!
translation: 嘿！我可没允许你这么做！

english: To know what needs making, you'll need to check the order list. There will always be three orders to choose from. Demand shifts fast here so every time you fulfil an order, a new set will come through.
translation: 要想知道需要制作什么，你得查看订单列表。总会有三个订单供你选择。这里的需求变化很快，所以每当你完成一个订单，就会有一批新订单进来。

english: Let's do that run through.
translation: 咱们过一遍流程吧。

english: I'm sure I can work it out.
translation: 我相信我能搞定。

english: Can you explain how to make potions?
translation: 你能解释一下如何制作药水吗？

english: Can I have some rewards?
translation: 能给我一些奖励吗？

english: Can you tell me more about the Alchemical Society?
translation: 你能多跟我讲讲炼金术协会吗？

english: Nothing, I'll be going now.
translation: 没什么，我该走了。

english: I hear you are the human that Veldaban has employed to help rebuild the statue. How is that going?
translation: 我听说你就是维尔达班雇来帮忙重建雕像的人类。进展如何？

english: How did you know about that?
translation: 你怎么知道的？

english: Veldaban is in my employ.
translation: 维尔达班是我的手下。

english: Veldaban told me about your involvement in the rebuilding of the statue. Congratulations.
translation: 维尔达班告诉我你参与了雕像重建工作。恭喜你。

english: Thank you!
translation: 谢谢！

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: I am Bisi. I am the Supreme Commander of the Black Guard.
translation: 我是比西。我是黑卫队的最高指挥官。

english: I thought Veldaban was in command?
translation: 我以为指挥官是维尔达班？

english: Only of our regiment in Keldagrim, and a most honourable position it is as well.
translation: 他只是凯尔达格林城我们军团的指挥官，那也是个非常光荣的职位。

english: But the Black Guard has many regiments across the dwarven realm. All the Commanders of those regiments report to me.
translation: 但黑卫队在矮人王国有很多军团。那些军团的指挥官都向我汇报。

english: Oh yes, I helped Commander Lawgof once, in his fight against the goblins.
translation: 哦对，我曾经帮过洛戈夫指挥官，在他对抗哥布林的战斗中。

english: That's good to hear.
translation: 听到这个真好。

english: What news have you?
translation: 你有什么消息？

english: Apart from the statue of King Alvis falling down, you mean? I don't know. There is something suspicious about the whole case.
translation: 你是说除了阿尔维斯国王的雕像倒塌之外？我不知道。整个事件有些可疑。

english: How do you mean?
translation: 你什么意思？

english: We've had several incidents recently. For a while we even closed off the city. And now this.
translation: 我们最近发生了几起事件。有一段时间我们甚至封锁了城市。现在又出了这事。

english: The Red Axe has withdrawn from the city to some unknown location. I believe Commander Veldaban has asked you to assist him in finding their secret headquarters?
translation: 红斧帮已经撤出城市，去了某个未知地点。我相信维尔达班指挥官已经请你协助他找到他们的秘密总部？

english: Oh yes, you're right.
translation: 哦是的，你说得对。

english: Apart from you helping to rebuild the statue for the [company name]?
translation: 除了你帮 [company name] 重建雕像之外？

english: There seems to be some general unrest in the city. There is trouble brewing in Keldagrim.
translation: 城市里似乎有些普遍的不安。凯尔达格林城正酝酿着麻烦。

english: But I'm sure Commander Veldaban is on top of it. He's a very capable officer, and I'm starting to get too old for this sort of thing.
translation: 但我相信维尔达班指挥官能处理好。他是个非常能干的军官，而我开始太老了，不适合处理这类事情了。

english: Well, I heard that you helped Veldaban's father in the mines to the south. That's caused quite a bit of an upset in the Consortium, so I understand.
translation: 嗯，我听说你帮维尔达班的父亲在南边的矿场里。据我所知，这在商会里引起了不小的震动。

english: How so?
translation: 怎么说？

english: The amount of wealth that goldmine is generating might cause some distortion in the balance of power in the Consortium. But we'll see.
translation: 那个金矿产生的财富可能会造成商会权力平衡的扭曲。但我们拭目以待。

english: Apart from that there seems to be some general unrest in the city. Trouble is brewing in Keldagrim.
translation: 除此之外，城市里似乎有些普遍的不安。凯尔达格林城正酝酿着麻烦。

english: I must go now.
translation: 我现在必须走了。

english: Then I bid you farewell, human.
translation: 那我向你告别了，人类。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: What news have you?
translation: 你有什么消息？

english: I must go now.
translation: 我现在必须走了。

english: Hi!
translation: 嗨！

english: Hi. How can I help?
translation: 嗨。我能怎么帮你？

english: Can you heal me?
translation: 你能治疗我吗？

english: Sorry, I'm not on duty.
translation: 抱歉，我不在值班。

english: PLEASE DON'T KILL ME!
translation: 求求你别杀我！

english: I was... looking to be healed.
translation: 我……是想来治疗的。

english: No way, I'm out of here just as soon as I've packed up my stuff!
translation: 没门，我一收拾好东西就离开这里！

english: You look healthy to me!
translation: 你看起来挺健康的！

english: Of course!
translation: 当然！

english: Surgeon General Tafani heals you for 21 Hitpoints.
translation: 军医塔法尼为你治疗了21点生命值。

english: Do you see a lot of injured fighters?
translation: 你见过很多受伤的战士吗？

english: Yes I do. Thankfully we can cope with almost anything. Jaraah really is a wonderful surgeon, his methods are a little unorthodox but he gets the job done.
translation: 是的，我见过。谢天谢地我们几乎能应付任何情况。贾拉赫真是个了不起的外科医生，他的方法有点非传统，但他能把事情搞定。

english: I shouldn't tell you this but his nickname is 'The Butcher'.
translation: 我不该告诉你这个，但他的绰号是''屠夫''。

english: That's reassuring.
translation: 真让人放心。

english: Do you come here often?
translation: 你常来这里吗？

english: I work here, so yes!
translation: 我在这里工作，所以是的！

english: You're silly!
translation: 你真傻！

english: Can you tell me about your cape?
translation: 能说说你的斗篷吗？

english: Certainly! Skillcapes are a symbol of achievement. Only people who have mastered a skill and reached level 99 can get their hands on them and gain the benefits they carry.
translation: 当然！技能斗篷是成就的象征。只有精通某项技能并达到99级的人才能获得，并享受其带来的好处。

english: The Cape of Hitpoints doubles the speed of your hitpoints replenishing when worn. Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 生命值斗篷在穿戴时会使你的生命值恢复速度加倍。还有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: Can I buy a Skillcape of Hitpoints from you?
translation: 我能从你这里买生命值技能斗篷吗？

english: Sorry, I'm under orders to not sell capes right now.
translation: 抱歉，我接到命令现在不能出售斗篷。

english: You cannot do that on this game world.
translation: 你不能在这个游戏世界里这么做。

english: Why, certainly my friend. However, owning such an item makes you part of an elite group and wearing it will double the speed of your hitpoints replenishing.
translation: 当然可以，我的朋友。不过，拥有这样的物品会让你成为精英群体的一员，穿戴它会使你的生命值恢复速度加倍。

english: Such a privilege will cost you 99,000 coins.
translation: 这样的特权需要花费你99,000金币。

english: Sorry, that's much too pricey.
translation: 抱歉，那太贵了。

english: I'm sorry you feel that way. Still if you change your mind...
translation: 很抱歉你这么想。不过如果你改变主意……

english: Sure, that's not too expensive for such a magnificent cape.
translation: 当然，对于如此华丽的斗篷来说，那不算太贵。

english: But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: 但遗憾的是，我身上没带够钱。

english: Well come back and see me when you do.
translation: 那你有了钱再来找我吧。

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 不幸的是，所有技能斗篷都只附带免费兜帽出售，这是技能促销活动的一部分；买一送一，你懂的。所以在我能卖给你之前，你需要腾出一些物品栏空间。

english: Wear this cape in good health, my friend.
translation: 健康地穿戴这件斗篷吧，我的朋友。

english: May I have another hood for my cape, please?
translation: 能再给我的斗篷配一个兜帽吗？

english: Most certainly, and free of charge!
translation: 当然可以，而且免费！

english: Tafani hands you another hood for your skillcape.
translation: 塔法尼递给你另一个技能斗篷兜帽。

english: Can you heal me?
translation: 你能治疗我吗？

english: Do you see a lot of injured fighters?
translation: 你见过很多受伤的战士吗？

english: Do you come here often?
translation: 你常来这里吗？

english: Can you tell me about your cape?
translation: 能说说你的斗篷吗？

english: Can I buy a Skillcape of Hitpoints from you?
translation: 我能从你这里买生命值技能斗篷吗？

english: Skillcape
translation: 技能斗篷

english: Sorry, that's much too pricey.
translation: 抱歉，那太贵了。

english: Sure, that's not too expensive for such a magnificent cape.
translation: 当然，对于如此华丽的斗篷来说，那不算太贵。

english: Hood
translation: 兜帽

english: He's too busy playing some succulent beats to stop and talk.
translation: 他正忙着演奏一些动听的节拍，没空停下来聊天。

english: Excuse me...
translation: 打扰一下……

english: What do you want? ...Oh, wait. I know! You're probably just like all the others, aren't you? After some fancy spell or potion from me, I bet!
translation: 你想要什么？……哦，等等。我知道了！你可能和其他人一样，对吧？我打赌你想要我的一些花哨法术或药水！

english: What? No! At least, I don't think so. What sort of spells do you have?
translation: 什么？不！至少我不这么认为。你有什么样的法术？

english: Hah! I knew it! I expect you want my Aphro-Dizzy-Yak spell! Want someone to fall madly in love with you, eh?
translation: 哈！我就知道！我猜你想要我的爱神迷醉牦牛法术！想让某人为你疯狂坠入爱河，嗯？

english: That spell sounds very interesting, but I didn't mean to disturb you!
translation: 那个法术听起来很有趣，但我不是想打扰你！

english: Well, I see that you do have some manners. I'm glad to see that you use them.
translation: 嗯，看来你确实有些礼貌。很高兴看到你会用礼貌。

english: Now, if it's all the same, I am very busy at the moment. Unless you want something specific, please come back another time.
translation: 现在，如果可以的话，我现在很忙。除非你有具体的需求，否则请改天再来。

english: Yes, of course. Goodbye!
translation: 是的，当然。再见！

english: Ummm...
Oh, it's you again! Well, what is it this time?
translation: 哦，又是你！嗯，这次是什么事？

english: Do you have any jobs or quests that I could do for you?
translation: 你有什么工作或任务可以让我做吗？

english: Hah! There are plenty of things I need done, but something tells me you're not quite ready for them right now. Come back another time!
translation: 哈！我有很多事情需要做，但有什么告诉我你现在还没准备好。改天再来吧！

english: Okay.
translation: 好的。

english: Can't you see I'm very busy here? Be off with you!
translation: 你看不出我很忙吗？走开！

english: Oh. Sorry.
translation: 哦。抱歉。

english: Hello there, newcomer. My name is Brynna. My job is to teach you about the skills you can use to survive in this world.
translation: 你好，新人。我叫布林娜。我的工作是教你关于在这个世界生存可以使用的技能。

english: The first skill we're going to look at is Fishing. There's some shrimp in this pond here. Let's try and catch some.
translation: 我们要看的第一个技能是钓鱼。这个池塘里有一些虾。我们试着抓一些。

english: Hello again. First up, we're going to do some fishing. There's some shrimp in this pond here. Let's try and catch some.
translation: 又见面了。首先，我们要去钓鱼。这个池塘里有一些虾。我们试着抓一些。

english: Hello again. You should take a look at that menu before we continue.
translation: 又见面了。在我们继续之前，你应该看看那个菜单。

english: I've managed to catch some shrimp.
translation: 我抓到了一些虾。

english: Excellent work. Now that you have some shrimp, you're going to want to cook them. To do that, you'll need a fire. This brings us on to the Woodcutting and Firemaking skills.
translation: 干得好。现在你有了一些虾，你会想煮熟它们。要做到这一点，你需要生火。这就引出了伐木和生火技能。

english: Next up you need to make a fire. First, you'll need to cut down a tree to get some logs.
translation: 接下来你需要生火。首先，你需要砍倒一棵树来获取一些原木。

english: Now that you have some shrimp, you're going to want to cook them. To do that, you'll need a fire.
translation: 现在你有了一些虾，你会想煮熟它们。要做到这一点，你需要生火。

english: Now that you have some shrimp, you're going to want to cook them. All you need to do is use them on a fire.
translation: 现在你有了一些虾，你会想煮熟它们。你只需要在火上使用它们。

english: Hello again. Is there something you'd like to hear more about?
translation: 又见面了。有什么你想多了解的吗？

english: Tell me about my skills again.
translation: 再跟我讲讲我的技能。

english: Every skill is listed in the skills menu. Here you can see what your current levels are and how much experience you have.
translation: 每个技能都列在技能菜单里。在这里你可以看到你当前的等级和你有多少经验。

english: As you move your mouse over the various skills the small yellow popup box will show you the exact amount of experience you have and how much is needed to get to the next level.
translation: 当你将鼠标移到各种技能上时，黄色小弹出框会显示你确切有多少经验以及升级到下一级需要多少经验。

english: You can also click on a skill to open up the relevant skillguide. In the skillguide, you can see all of the unlocks available in that skill.
translation: 你也可以点击一个技能来打开相关的技能指南。在技能指南中，你可以看到该技能中所有可用的解锁内容。

english: Is there anything else you'd like to hear more about?
translation: 还有什么你想多了解的吗？

english: Tell me about Woodcutting again.
translation: 再跟我讲讲伐木。

english: Woodcutting, eh? Don't worry, newcomer, it's really very easy. Simply equip your axe and click on a nearby tree to chop away.
translation: 伐木，嗯？别担心，新人，这真的很容易。只需装备你的斧头，点击附近的树开始砍伐。

english: As you explore the mainland you will discover many different kinds of trees that will require different Woodcutting levels to chop down.
translation: 当你探索大陆时，你会发现许多不同种类的树，砍伐它们需要不同的伐木等级。

english: Logs are not only useful for making fires. Many archers use the skill known as Fletching to craft their own bows and arrows from trees.
translation: 原木不仅可用于生火。许多弓箭手使用称为制箭的技能，用树木制作自己的弓和箭。

english: Tell me about Firemaking again.
translation: 再跟我讲讲生火。

english: Certainly, newcomer. When you have logs simply use your tinderbox on them. If successful, you will start a fire.
translation: 当然，新人。当你有原木时，只需在上面使用火绒盒。如果成功，你就会生起火来。

english: You can also set fire to logs you find lying on the floor already, and some other things can also be set alight...
translation: 你也可以点燃已经躺在地上的原木，还有一些其他东西也可以被点燃……

english: A tinderbox is always a useful item to keep around!
translation: 火绒盒总是一件值得随身携带的有用物品！

english: Tell me about Fishing again.
translation: 再跟我讲讲钓鱼。

english: Ah, yes. Fishing! Fishing is undoubtedly one of the more popular hobbies here in Gielinor!
translation: 啊，是的。钓鱼！钓鱼无疑是基利诺尔这里更受欢迎的爱好之一！

english: Whenever you see sparkling waters, you can be sure there's probably some good fishing to be had there!
translation: 每当你看到波光粼粼的水域时，你可以肯定那里可能有一些不错的钓鱼点！

english: Not only are fish absolutely delicious when cooked, they will also heal lost health.
translation: 鱼不仅煮熟后绝对美味，它们还能恢复失去的生命值。

english: I would recommend everybody has a go at Fishing at least once in their lives!
translation: 我建议每个人一生中至少尝试一次钓鱼！

english: Tell me about Cooking again.
translation: 再跟我讲讲烹饪。

english: Yes, the most basic of survival techniques. Most simple foods can be used on a fire to cook them. If you're feeling a bit fancier, you can also use a range to cook the food instead.
translation: 是的，最基本的生存技巧。大多数简单食物可以在火上烹饪。如果你想更讲究一点，你也可以使用炉灶来烹饪食物。

english: Eating cooked food will restore lost health. The harder something is to cook, the more it will heal you.
translation: 吃熟食会恢复失去的生命值。越难烹饪的食物，恢复的生命值越多。

english: Nothing thanks.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。

english: Tell me about my skills again.
translation: 再跟我讲讲我的技能。

english: Tell me about Woodcutting again.
translation: 再跟我讲讲伐木。

english: Tell me about Firemaking again.
translation: 再跟我讲讲生火。

english: Tell me about Fishing again.
translation: 再跟我讲讲钓鱼。

english: Tell me about Cooking again.
translation: 再跟我讲讲烹饪。

english: Nothing thanks.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。

english: You're putting me in prison?!
translation: 你要把我关进监狱？！

english: Hello there. What are you doing here?
translation: 你好。你在这里做什么？

english: That's not really any of your business, is it?
translation: 那其实不关你的事，对吧？

english: Fair enough.
translation: 好吧。

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: Is everything okay?
translation: 一切都好吗？

english: *mumble mumble*
translation: 嘟囔嘟囔

english: I didn't catch that.
translation: 我没听清。

english: Right... Well, have a nice day.
translation: 好吧……嗯，祝你有美好的一天。

english: *mumble*
translation: 嘟囔

english: If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: 如果我像你一样丑，我就不敢在公共场合露面！

english: Out of my way, punk.
translation: 让开，小混混。

english: Hmm... you smell strange...
translation: 嗯……你闻起来很奇怪……

english: Strange how?
translation: 怎么奇怪？

english: Like a human!
translation: 像人类！

english: Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: 哦！呃……我刚吃了一个，这就是原因！

english: Leave me alone.
translation: 别烦我。

english: Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: 如果你珍惜生命就别再跟我说话！

english: Get lost!
translation: 滚开！

english: I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: 我没什么可给你的，所以别烦我，乞丐。

english: Have you no manners?
translation: 你没有礼貌吗？

english: I don't have time for this right now.
translation: 我现在没时间处理这个。

english: I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: 我没兴趣和像你这样可怜的肉袋子说话。

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
translation: 我打赌你有漂亮的爪子。

english: A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: 真是悲惨的一天啊……趁还能享受就享受吧。

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: 你要是抓到谁，答应分我一口。

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
translation: 我以前没在这里闻到过你的气味……

english: You smell familiar...
translation: 你闻起来很熟悉……

english: Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: 在这附近见过人类吗？我非——常饿。

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: 你看起来也是个嗜血之人。

english: Good day to you, my friend.
translation: 你好，我的朋友。

english: Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
translation: 想去城堡吃点零食吗？

english: Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
translation: 等一下，我牙缝里卡了点人肉渣……

english: Hello. Where are you going?
translation: 你好。你要去哪里？

english: None of your business! Leave me alone!
translation: 不关你的事！别烦我！

english: It just seemed as if you were walking in circles.
translation: 只是看起来你好像在绕圈子走。

english: No I'm not! Now leave me alone!
translation: 我没有！现在别烦我！

english: Okay, okay.
translation: 好的，好的。

english: Why are you still wandering around here?
translation: 你为什么还在这里闲逛？

english: I'm now the official liaison between Rellekka and our camp. It involves a fair bit of walking around, you know.
translation: 我现在是雷勒卡城和我们的营地之间的官方联络人。这需要相当多的走动，你知道的。

english: I can imagine.
translation: 我能想象。

english: Yessss, adventurer?
translation: 是的sss，冒险者？

english: You smell funky.
translation: 你闻起来有怪味。

english: As do you, adventurer.
translation: 你也是，冒险者。

english: How come you live with the lizardmen?
translation: 你怎么和蜥蜴人住在一起？

english: They are my sssaviours, I owe them my life.
translation: 他们是我的救星，我欠他们一条命。

english: What did they save you from? Is it to do with your eye?
translation: 他们把你从什么中救出来？和你的眼睛有关吗？

english: Why, yesss it isss... Many yearsss ago now. 30? 40? I've lost count.
translation: 为什么，是的……已经是很多年前了。30年？40年？我记不清了。

english: I wasss a Captain of the Shayzien Army, Captain Reynard Koil, ssstationed up on Shayziens' wall.
translation: 我曾是谢兹恩城卫军的上尉，雷纳德‧科伊尔上尉，驻扎在谢兹恩的城墙上。

english: We were told to attack the lizardmen, for they were apparently attacking usss. I led the charge.
translation: 我们被告知要攻击蜥蜴人，因为他们显然在攻击我们。我率领了冲锋。

english: Apparently? Were they attacking?
translation: 显然？他们在攻击吗？

english: Alasss, I took an arrow to the eye and missed the battle. I woke up here, worried for my life.
translation: 唉，我的眼睛中了一箭，错过了战斗。我在这里醒来，担心自己的性命。

english: The lizardmen took you prisoner?
translation: 蜥蜴人把你当俘虏了？

english: At first, that isss what I thought, but they tended my woundsss and fed me well.
translation: 起初，我是这么想的，但他们照顾我的伤口，给我很好的食物。

english: I assssumed my people would come for me once they sssaw my body wasn't amongssst the dead, but they never did.
translation: 我假设我的人看到我尸体不在死者之中会来找我，但他们从来没有。

english: Would the lizardmen let you leave?
translation: 蜥蜴人会让你离开吗？

english: Oh yesss, once my ssstrength returned, I went and ssspoke to the Shayzien Army.
translation: 哦是的，一旦我的力量恢复，我就去和谢兹恩城卫军谈了。

english: ...And?
translation: ……然后？

english: They thought I wasss a lizardman and fired arrowsss at me, ssso I returned here.
translation: 他们以为我是蜥蜴人，向我射箭，所以我回到了这里。

english: What is that you're wearing?
translation: 你穿的是什么？

english: I found these in thisss shrine. I guesss they belonged to sssome long dead priest.
translation: 我在这个神殿里找到这些的。我猜它们属于某个早已死去的祭司。

english: What would a priest be doing in this gross swamp?
translation: 祭司会在这个肮脏的沼泽里做什么？

english: This grossss ssswamp is my home. You sssure do ask a lot of questionsss, adventurer.
translation: 这个肮脏的沼泽是我的家。你确实问了很多问题，冒险者。

english: What is the symbol on the shrine?
translation: 神殿上的符号是什么？

english: You do not recognissse it, adventurer? It would ssseem hissstory is written by the winnersss, for that isss the sssymbol of the Great Lord Xeric.
translation: 你不认识它吗，冒险者？似乎历史是由胜利者书写的，因为那是伟大领主泽里克的符号。

english: Or at leassst, that isss what the lizardmen tell me...
translation: 或者至少，那是蜥蜴人告诉我的……

english: Goodbye, swampy man.
translation: 再见，沼泽人。

english: Goodbye, adventurer.
translation: 再见，冒险者。

english: Are you the 'Rey' this entry mentions?
translation: 你就是这条记录提到的''雷''吗？

english: You show him 'The Fisher's Flute'.
translation: 你向他展示''渔夫的长笛''。

english: Oh, that wasss a lifetime ago... Sssuch a wonderful little one.
translation: 哦，那是一辈子以前的事了……如此可爱的一个小家伙。

english: So you've not seen her recently?
translation: 所以你最近没见过她？

english: Lassst I heard, her mind had cracked. Her father died and...
translation: 我上次听说，她的精神崩溃了。她父亲死了然后……

english: And?
translation: 然后？

english: Gone.
translation: 走了。

english: Oh, how mysterious.
translation: 哦，真神秘。

english: You smell funky.
translation: 你闻起来有怪味。

english: How come you live with the lizardmen?
translation: 你怎么和蜥蜴人住在一起？

english: What is that you're wearing?
translation: 你穿的是什么？

english: What is the symbol on the shrine?
translation: 神殿上的符号是什么？

english: Goodbye, swampy man.
translation: 再见，沼泽人。

english: Ribbit
translation: 呱呱

english: Croak
translation: 呱

english: You manage to catch the toad and inflate it with swamp gas.
translation: 你成功抓住了蟾蜍，并用沼泽气体给它充气。

english: Come here toady!
translation: 过来，小蟾蜍！

english: You add the bloated toad to your inventory.
translation: 你把鼓胀的蟾蜍放入物品栏。

english: One of your bloated toads manages to escape.
translation: 你的一只鼓胀蟾蜍成功逃走了。

english: Ribbitt!
translation: 呱呱！

english: Hissss....
translation: 嘶嘶嘶……

english: The air seems too thin to stay in the toad.
translation: 空气似乎太稀薄，无法留在蟾蜍体内。

english: Perhaps you need something thicker than air.
translation: 也许你需要比空气更稠密的东西。

english: You release the toad[s] and see [it/them] hop off into the distance.
translation: 你释放了蟾蜍 [s]，看着 [它/它们] 跳到远处。

english: Free the fatsy toady!
translation: 释放胖蟾蜍！

english: Ribbet!
translation: 呱呱！

english: Croak!
translation: 呱！

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: Hello outerlander. This is my home, I would be grateful if you would leave.
translation: 你好，外乡人。这是我的家，如果你能离开我会很感激。

english: Oh. Okay.
translation: 哦。好的。

english: I am sorry outerlander, I will not offer you hospitality until my Chieftain has vouched for your honesty. This is our way.
translation: 抱歉，外乡人，在我的酋长证明你的诚实之前，我不会招待你。这是我们的规矩。

english: Greetings to you [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! How fare you today?
translation: 向你问好 [brother/sister][Fremennik name]！你今天过得怎么样？

english: I am fine thanks Swensen. How are you doing?
translation: 我很好，谢谢斯文森。你怎么样？

english: I am fine too!
translation: 我也很好！

english: Hello Sylas.
translation: 你好赛拉斯。

english: Ah, [player name]! Good to see you again.
translation: 啊，[player name]！很高兴再次见到你。

english: How is the collection going now?
translation: 收藏进展如何？

english: Thanks to you finding the golden goblin for me, I am the envy of the collector's group. I can't thank you enough.
translation: 多亏你帮我找到了金色哥布林，我成了收藏家群体羡慕的对象。我怎么感谢你都不够。

english: I think I've lost Rupert's helmet.
translation: 我想我弄丢了鲁珀特的头盔。

english: Not to worry, [player name] Go and speak to Rupert. These items have a strange way of returning to their owners sometimes!
translation: 别担心，[player name] 去找鲁珀特谈谈。这些物品有时会以奇怪的方式回到主人身边！

english: Ok, I will. Thanks.
translation: 好的，我会的。谢谢。

english: No, no. Thanks for everything you've done!
translation: 不，不。谢谢你做的一切！

english: I'm just happy that I could help. Goodbye!
translation: 我只是很高兴能帮上忙。再见！

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Selling Magic Beans!
translation: 出售魔法豆！

english: You there, you look like you could use some beans!
translation: 你，你看起来可能需要一些豆子！

english: All beans must go!
translation: 所有豆子必须卖掉！

english: Buy 1 bean get a bean free!
translation: 买1颗豆送1颗豆！

english: Selling bags of Magic Beans!
translation: 出售袋装魔法豆！

english: Excuse me, human! Perhaps you shouldn't just go wandering through there without knowing what you're dealing with!
translation: 打扰了，人类！也许你不应该在不知道自己在对付什么的情况下就在那里闲逛！

english: Hello! Are you the leader of this expedition?
translation: 你好！你是这次探险队的领袖吗？

english: Indeed I am, human! What's on your mind?
translation: 我确实是，人类！你在想什么？

english: What's going on here?
translation: 这里发生了什么事？

english: Well, the Hueycoatl has awoken.
translation: 嗯，休伊科特尔已经苏醒。

english: The Huey- what?
translation: 休伊——什么？

english: Huey-co-at... oh, I don't have time for this! The thing you need to know is that it's dangerous and it's coiled throughout this entire mountain!
translation: 休伊 - 科 - 亚特……哦，我没时间解释这个！你需要知道的是它很危险，它盘踞在整个山脉中！

english: Do you know where it came from?
translation: 你知道它从哪里来的吗？

english: We're not sure. There are some records of our ancestors having dealings with it, but the details have been lost, assuming they were ever recorded.
translation: 我们不确定。有一些关于我们祖先与它打交道的记录，但细节已经丢失，假设它们曾经被记录过。

english: So it's old?
translation: 所以它很古老？

english: Does it really matter how old it is?
translation: 它有多古老真的重要吗？

english: I suppose not. I guess I just want to get a better understanding of what this thing is.
translation: 我想不重要。我想我只是想更好地了解这个东西是什么。

english: We don't know how old it is. It could be extremely old, or this could be just one in a lineage of them. Still, we haven't heard of any others so maybe it is some sort of ancient creature.
translation: 我们不知道它有多古老。它可能非常古老，或者这可能只是它们谱系中的一个。不过，我们没听说过其他的，所以它可能是某种古代生物。

english: And given that you're here, I assume it poses some sort of threat?
translation: 既然你在这里，我假设它构成了某种威胁？

english: Now you're getting it! While it doesn't seem to be innately aggressive, our concern is the potential risk of it tunnelling into Cam Torum.
translation: 现在你明白了！虽然它似乎没有天生的攻击性，但我们担心它可能挖掘进入卡姆托鲁姆城的潜在风险。

english: Oh, and given that it does lash out from time to time, I suppose it does pose a threat to your nearby human villages. A lesser priority for us, but maybe something for you to care about.
translation: 哦，鉴于它确实时不时会攻击，我想它确实对你附近的人类村庄构成了威胁。这对我们来说是次要优先事项，但可能是你需要关心的事情。

english: Anyway, for now, our only option is to keep it in check while we figure out what to do in the long term.
translation: 无论如何，目前我们唯一的选择是在我们找出长期解决方案之前控制住它。

english: Unfortunately, that means recruiting all the help we can get, even from you humans...
translation: 不幸的是，这意味着要招募我们能得到的所有帮助，即使来自你们人类……

english: How can I help?
translation: 我能帮什么忙？

english: Well, despite what some of us may think of your kind, we need all the help we can get.
translation: 嗯，尽管我们中有些人可能对你们人类有看法，但我们需要所有能得到的帮助。

english: Well, as you've already proven yourself useful to Cam Torum, I'd be glad to have you help here!
translation: 嗯，既然你已经证明了自己对卡姆托鲁姆城有用，我很高兴你能在这里帮忙！

english: However, I'm not sure you have enough combat experience to face the Hueycoatl.
translation: 不过，我不确定你是否有足够的战斗经验来面对休伊科特尔。

english: To face the Hueycoatl, it's recommended you have a combat level of 85 and a Prayer level of 43.
translation: 要面对休伊科特尔，建议你的战斗等级达到85，祈祷等级达到43。

english: We need to keep the Hueycoatl under control which, until we find a more permanent solution, means wearing it out through combat.
translation: 我们需要控制住休伊科特尔，在我们找到更永久的解决方案之前，这意味着通过战斗消耗它。

english: Don't go killing it, mind you! Not that I think you could, but such a magnificent creature doesn't deserve destruction.
translation: 别去杀它，记住！不是说我认为你能做到，但如此宏伟的生物不值得被毁灭。

english: Do you have any tips for surviving?
translation: 你有什么生存建议吗？

english: We've found our prayers can protect us from its shards, so keep an eye out for those.
translation: 我们发现我们的祈祷可以保护我们免受它的碎片伤害，所以留意那些碎片。

english: To reach the Hueycoatl's head, you'll need to get it to move its great body out of the way. We've found we can persuade it by giving the exposed parts a helpful nudge!
translation: 要到达休伊科特尔的头部，你需要让它把庞大的身体移开。我们发现可以通过给暴露的部位一个有用的推挤来说服它！

english: Once you reach its head, you'll need to work with your comrades and the seer to balance your prayers and weaken the beast.
translation: 一旦你到达它的头部，你需要与你的同伴和先知合作，平衡你的祈祷并削弱这头野兽。

english: But I'm sure you'll figure it out!
translation: 但我相信你会搞定的！

english: Move the body, then attack the head while keeping prayers balanced. Got it!
translation: 移动身体，然后在保持祈祷平衡的同时攻击头部。明白了！

english: What's on your mind, human?
translation: 你在想什么，人类？

english: Remind me, what's going on here?
translation: 提醒我，这里发生了什么事？

english: Are there any rewards for helping?
translation: 帮忙有什么奖励吗？

english: Ugh, you greedy humans.
translation: 呃，你们贪婪的人类。

english: The Hueycoatl displaces a lot of materials as it moves, including all sorts of items and treasures.
translation: 休伊科特尔在移动时会置换大量材料，包括各种物品和宝藏。

english: We collect as much as we can, so I suppose you can have a share for helping.
translation: 我们尽可能多地收集，所以我想你可以分一份作为帮助的回报。

english: That sounds good, thank you.
translation: 听起来不错，谢谢。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Bye.
translation: 再见。

english: Remind me, what's going on here?
translation: 提醒我，这里发生了什么事？

english: How can I help?
translation: 我能帮什么忙？

english: Are there any rewards for helping?
translation: 帮忙有什么奖励吗？

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Hi, my name is [player name]. What's wi...
translation: 嗨，我叫 [player name]。怎么回……

english: I not be in the mood t' talk, sorry. If ye need anythin', talk to Cap'ain Pudi over by the dock.
translation: 我没心情聊天，抱歉。如果你需要什么，去码头找普迪船长谈谈。

english: I cannot believe that beast ruined me ship.
translation: 我不敢相信那野兽毁了我的船。

english: What happened to your ship?
translation: 你的船怎么了？

english: Was awful, me crew an' I were out on our fortnightly fishin' excursion. We set sail from Al Kharid t' the deep-sea fishin' spot we usually use.
translation: 太可怕了，我和船员们出去进行每两周一次的钓鱼远足。我们从阿尔卡里德城启航，前往我们通常使用的深海钓鱼点。

english: Was nothin' but smooth sailin' all the way, we got t' the spot an' started fishin'.
translation: 一路顺风，我们到达钓点开始钓鱼。

english: Sounds like a normal day of fishing to me.
translation: 听起来像是普通的钓鱼日。

english: Aye, I s'pose it was. After a few days, the crew an' I sailed further t' the Karamjan coast t' catch some sharks. More plunder from sellin' sharks.
translation: 是的，我想是的。几天后，我和船员们航行到更远的卡拉姆詹海岸去抓一些鲨鱼。卖鲨鱼能赚更多钱。

english: While sailin', I noticed there was more debris than usual. Koanee said there must have been a storm recently.
translation: 航行时，我注意到残骸比平时多。科尼说最近一定有风暴。

english: How did she know that?
translation: 她怎么知道的？

english: Koanee is in charge of plottin' a course t' our destination an' watchin' the weather. I thought she was good at her job.
translation: 科尼负责规划到我们目的地的航线和观察天气。我以为她工作做得很好。

english: We got to our final fishin' spot an' Lauretta let down the net. Almost a whole day went by an' we still 'ad not caught any fish.
translation: 我们到达最后的钓鱼点，劳蕾塔放下了网。几乎一整天过去了，我们还是没有抓到任何鱼。

english: In fact, I could not see any fish in the waters at all. Such a strange sight.
translation: 事实上，我根本看不到水里有任何鱼。真是奇怪的景象。

english: Not even bass?
translation: 连鲈鱼都没有？

english: Nothin'. We decided t' pack it in for the day an' I told Koanee t' leave the nets down, hoping we would catch some fish overnight.
translation: 什么都没有。我们决定当天收工，我告诉科尼把网留着，希望我们能在夜间抓到一些鱼。

english: That sounds like a bad idea. What would have happened if your net got too full or your ship started drifting and the net got caught on some rocks?
translation: 听起来像是个坏主意。如果你的网太满或者你的船开始漂流，网被岩石挂住怎么办？

english: 'Twas a risk we 'ad to take t' catch some fish.
translation: 那是我们为了抓到鱼必须冒的风险。

english: The next day Koanee woke me up t' tell me a storm was on the horizon, so we lifted the anchor up an' adjusted our course.
translation: 第二天科尼叫醒我告诉我地平线上有风暴，所以我们起了锚，调整了航线。

english: Not sure what she was playing at with that decision, but out o' nowhere winds started t' change an' the storm was headin' in our direction, we couldn't outrun it.
translation: 不确定她做那个决定在想什么，但不知从哪里开始风向变了，风暴朝我们的方向来了，我们跑不过它。

english: 'Twas also too dangerous to anchor down, so we 'ad to weather it.
translation: 抛锚也太危险了，所以我们只能硬扛。

english: Thick fog rolled in, giant waves crashin' against the ship's hull. So much lightnin', it felt like Saradomin was angry with us.
translation: 浓雾滚滚，巨浪撞击船体。闪电太多，感觉像是萨拉多明在生我们的气。

english: The lightnin' struck our sails, settin' them ablaze despite the 'eavy rain!
translation: 闪电击中了我们的帆，尽管下着大雨还是把它们点燃了！

english: The last thing I see is glowin' fish an' a monster in the distance with a twisted face. Next thing I know, I'm lying on the shore just south of Al Kharid with Pudi waving a kebab in me face!
translation: 我最后看到的是发光的鱼和远处一个扭曲面孔的怪物。接下来我知道的是，我躺在阿尔卡里德城南边的海岸上，普迪在我面前挥舞着烤肉串！

english: That must have been awful. At least you and the crew survived.
translation: 那一定很可怕。至少你和船员们活下来了。

english: Aye, we survived, but the same cannot be said for me poor ship! Koanee should 'o known better!
translation: 是的，我们活下来了，但我的可怜船只就没那么幸运了！科尼本该更清楚！

english: Once Pudi and the others helped us back on our feet, the Chancellor sent us 'ere t' setup shop and recruit others.
translation: 一旦普迪和其他人帮助我们重新站起来，总理就派我们到这里来开店并招募其他人。

english: Not really my area of expertise, mind, but Pudi sorts most of it out!
translation: 这不是我擅长的领域，不过普迪处理了大部分事情！

english: Anythin' else I can help ye with?
translation: 还有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: Got any tips for fighting Tempoross?
translation: 有什么对抗海灵的建议吗？

english: Always carry an 'ammer. That beast has a habit of destroyin' ships. You can fix it up by using said 'ammer.
translation: 始终携带一把锤子。那野兽有摧毁船只的习惯。你可以用锤子修理它。

english: The Spirit Anglers' ships you fight the beast from are kitted out with everythin' ye need.
translation: 你用来与野兽战斗的灵体渔夫船只配备了你需要的一切。

english: Can I help ye with anythin' else?
translation: 还有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: I found your ship's log.
translation: 我找到了你的航海日志。

english: Ye be stealin' me booty are ye?
translation: 你在偷我的财宝是吗？

english: No, I jus...
translation: 不，我只是……

english: I be yankin' ye chain, 'tis all good. I put that 'ere book on that shelf so I may spread me tale.
translation: 我在逗你玩，没事的。我把那本书放在那个架子上，这样我可以传播我的故事。

english: It was a good tale. Is it true?
translation: 那是个好故事。是真的吗？

english: Of course 'tis true! Ye can ask me all about it.
translation: 当然是真的！你可以问我关于它的一切。

english: I have to go.
translation: 我得走了。

english: Be seein' ye.
translation: 回头见。

english: Would you care for an egg in this difficult time?
translation: 在这个困难时期你想要一个蛋吗？

english: Um... no, I don't want your damp egg, thanks...
translation: 嗯……不，我不想要你的湿蛋，谢谢……

english: I'll take my eggs elsewhere then.
translation: 那我去别处拿我的蛋。

english: A damp egg? No thanks.
translation: 湿蛋？不用了，谢谢。

english: I'd rather not. Thanks, though.
translation: 我还是算了，不过谢谢你。

english: Oh, thanks.
translation: 哦，谢谢。

english: This is some comfort to be sure.
translation: 这确实是一种安慰。

english: What happened to your ship?
translation: 你的船怎么了？

english: Got any tips for fighting Tempoross?
translation: 有什么对抗海灵的建议吗？

english: I found your ship's log.
translation: 我找到了你的航海日志。

english: I have to go.
translation: 我得走了。

english: Get out of my way! Argh! I'm hunting!
translation: 让开！啊！我在狩猎！

english: Die! Die!!
translation: 死！死！！

english: Move, lest I slay not the beast but you!
translation: 走开，否则我杀的不是野兽而是你！

english: Hello, Tamayu, first son of Timfraku.
translation: 你好，塔马尤，蒂姆弗拉库的长子。

english: Stranger, why you have returned?
translation: 陌生人，你为什么回来了？

english: I'm just passing through.
translation: 我只是路过。

english: Using your new found poison I have been creating spears. Would you like to buy some?
translation: 我用你新发现的毒药制作了长矛。你想买一些吗？

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: As you wish, stranger.
translation: 如你所愿，陌生人。

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: Busy Busy Busy.
translation: 忙忙忙。

english: Why are you so busy?
translation: 你为什么这么忙？

english: Aluft Aloft is a bustling new business, here in the Gnome restaurant. We're getting food orders all the time.
translation: 阿卢夫‧阿洛夫特是地精餐厅里一家繁忙的新业务。我们一直在收到食物订单。

english: Do you have any jobs then?
translation: 那你有什么工作吗？

english: If you want to get a job, talk to Aluft Gianne jnr. I'm sure he has plenty.
translation: 如果你想找工作，去找小阿卢夫‧吉安谈谈。我相信他有很多工作。

english: Have a nice day.
translation: 祝你有美好的一天。

english: How are you doing today?
translation: 你今天怎么样？

english: I am Tangleroot!
translation: 我是缠根！

english: Hello there pretty plant.
translation: 你好，漂亮的植物。

english: I am Tangleroot!
translation: 我是缠根！

english: I am [player name]!
translation: 我是 [player name]！

english: Everything is crystal clear now.
translation: 现在一切都清楚了。

english: I can't believe they made dragonfruit trees into a real thing!
translation: 我不敢相信他们把火龙果树变成了真实的东西！

english: I am Tangleroot?
translation: 我是缠根？

english: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: Are you related to Herbiboar now?
translation: 你现在和草药野猪有关系吗？

english: I am Tangleroot.
translation: 我是缠根。

english: I should have guessed.
translation: 我早该猜到。
347加73等于多少？

english: Nevermind.
translation: 没关系。

english: Oh dear, you've gone all red!
translation: 哦天哪，你变红了！

english: It must be something you ate.
translation: 一定是你吃了什么。

english: I love your new hair cut!
translation: 我喜欢你的新发型！

english: Grrrr
translation: 咕噜噜

english: Tangleeeee!
translation: 缠根根！

english: Greetings friend. I am a manufacturer of leather.
translation: 你好朋友。我是皮革制造商。

english: Can I buy some leather then?
translation: 那我能买一些皮革吗？

english: I make leather from animal hides. Bring me some cowhides and one gold coin per hide, and I'll tan them into soft leather for you.
translation: 我用动物皮制作皮革。给我一些牛皮，每张皮一枚金币，我会把它们鞣制成软皮革给你。

english: Leather is rather weak stuff.
translation: 皮革挺脆弱的。

english: Normal leather may be quite weak, but it's very cheap - I make it from cowhides for only 1 gp per hide - and it's so easy to craft that anyone can work with it.
translation: 普通皮革可能很脆弱，但它非常便宜——我用牛皮制作，每张皮只需1金币——而且它很容易制作，任何人都可以使用它。

english: Alternatively you could try hard leather. It's not so easy to craft, but I only charge 3 gp per cowhide to prepare it, and it makes much sturdier armour.
translation: 或者你可以试试硬皮革。它不那么容易制作，但我每张牛皮只收3金币来准备它，它能制作更坚固的盔甲。

english: I can also tan snake hides and dragonhides, suitable for crafting into the highest quality armour for rangers.
translation: 我还可以鞣制蛇皮和龙皮，适合为游侠制作最高质量的盔甲。

english: Thanks, I'll bear it in mind.
translation: 谢谢，我会记住的。

english: I see you have brought me a hide. Would you like me to tan it for you?
translation: 我看到你给我带了一张皮。你想让我帮你鞣制吗？

english: I see you have brought me some hides. Would you like me to tan them for you?
translation: 我看到你给我带了一些皮。你想让我帮你鞣制吗？

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Very well, [sir/madam], as you wish.
translation: 很好，[先生/女士]，如你所愿。

english: Er... Thanks, but no thanks!
translation: 呃……谢谢，但不用了！

english: Er... I have no use for that, I make the stuff!
translation: 呃……那对我没用，我就是做这个的！

english: Can I buy some leather then?
translation: 那我能买一些皮革吗？

english: Leather is rather weak stuff.
translation: 皮革挺脆弱的。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Not infected are you?
translation: 你没被感染吧？

english: I don't think so.
translation: 我想没有。

english: You don't seem very sure. We don't want any infected near the children. Be off with you!
translation: 你看起来不太确定。我们不希望任何感染者靠近孩子。走开！

english: Whatever it is you're selling, we ain't interested!
translation: 不管你在卖什么，我们没兴趣！

english: But I'm not...
translation: 但我不是……

english: Did you not hear me? Clear off!
translation: 你没听到我说话吗？滚开！

english: Greetings human. These Hydras are not to be harmed unless you have permission. To act otherwise would be a danger to the balance.
translation: 你好，人类。这些九头蛇不得伤害，除非你有许可。否则行动会危及平衡。

english: Human! To attack these creatures would be a threat to the balance. Only those with permission may fight them!
translation: 人类！攻击这些生物会威胁平衡。只有获得许可的人才能与它们战斗！

english: Would you look after my crops for me?
translation: 你能帮我照管作物吗？

english: You don't have any seeds planted in that patch. Plant some and I might agree to look after it for you.
translation: 那块地里还没播种。你先种点什么，我才可能考虑帮你照管。

english: That patch is already fully grown! I don't know what you want me to do with it!
translation: 那块种植地的作物已经完全成熟了！我不知道你还想让我做什么！

english: That patch is dead - it's too late for me to do anything about it now.
translation: 那块种植地的作物已经枯死了——现在我也无能为力了。

english: That patch is diseased - you should cure it before asking me to be responsible for it!
translation: 那块种植地的作物染病了——你先治好再让我管！

english: I don't know what you're talking about - I'm already looking after that patch for you.
translation: 我不知道你在说什么——我已经在帮你照管那块地了。

english: Oh sorry, I forgot.
translation: 哦抱歉，我忘了。

english: If you like, but I want 4 sacks of cabbages for that.
translation: 可以，但我要4袋卷心菜作为报酬。

english: I'm afraid I don't have any of those at the moment.
translation: 恐怕我现在没有那些。

english: Well, I'm not wasting my time for free.
translation: 嗯，我不会免费浪费时间。

english: I'm afraid I don't have enough of those at the moment.
translation: 恐怕我现在没有足够的数量。

english: Okay, it's a deal.
translation: 好的，成交。

english: That'll do nicely, [sir/madam]. Leave it with me - I'll make sure that patch grows for you.
translation: 那太好了，[先生/女士]。交给我吧——我会确保那块地为你生长。

english: No, that's too much.
translation: 不，那太多了。

english: If you like, but I want 3 baskets of tomatoes for that.
translation: 可以，但我要3篮番茄作为报酬。

english: If you like, but I want 3 baskets of strawberries for that.
translation: 可以，但我要3篮草莓作为报酬。

english: If you like, but I want 6 watermelons for that.
translation: 可以，但我要6个西瓜作为报酬。

english: If you like, but I want 8 Bittercap mushrooms for that.
translation: 可以，但我要8个苦帽蘑菇作为报酬。

english: Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: 你能给我一些农业建议吗？

english: The only way to cure a bush or tree of disease is to prune away the diseased leaves with a pair of secateurs. For all other crops I would just apply some plant-cure.
translation: 治愈灌木或树木疾病的唯一方法是用修枝剪修剪掉病叶。对于所有其他作物，我只需使用一些植物治疗药水。

english: Tree seeds must be grown in a plantpot of soil into a sapling, and then transferred to a tree patch to continue growing to adulthood.
translation: 树木种子得先在装土的花盆里养成树苗，再移栽到树木种植地，才能继续长成大树。

english: You can put up to ten potatoes, cabbages or onions in vegetable sacks, although you can't have a mix in the same sack.
translation: 蔬菜袋里最多能装十个土豆、卷心菜或者洋葱，不过一袋里可不能混着装。

english: You can buy all the farming tools from farming shops, which can be found close to the allotments.
translation: 你可以从农业商店购买所有农业工具，这些商店可以在种植地附近找到。

english: Bittercap mushrooms can only be grown in a special patch in Morytania, near the Mort Myre swamp. There the ground is especially dank and suited to growing poisonous fungii.
translation: 苦帽菇只能种在莫利塔尼亚、莫特迈耶沼泽附近的特殊种植地里。那里阴暗潮湿，适合毒蘑菇生长。

english: Supercompost is far better than normal compost, but more expensive to make. You need to rot the right type of item; show me an item, and I'll tell you if it's super- compostable or not.
translation: 超级堆肥比普通堆肥强多了，但做起来也更费事。你得用对东西才能堆出来——拿件物品给我看看，我告诉你它能不能做成超级堆肥。

english: There is a special patch for growing Belladonna - I believe that it is somewhere near Draynor Manor, where the ground is a tad 'unblessed'.
translation: 颠茄有专门的种植地——我记得是在德雷诺庄园附近，那地方的土嘛，有点''不受祝福''。

english: Applying compost to a patch will not only reduce the chance that your crops will get diseased, but you will also grow more crops to harvest.
translation: 在种植地上施用堆肥不仅可以降低作物染病的几率，你还可以收获更多作物。

english: If you want to grow fruit trees you could try a few places: Catherby, Brimhaven, Gnome Stronghold and the Farming Guild all have fruit tree patches.
translation: 如果你想种植果树，可以尝试几个地方：凯瑟比镇、布尔哈文镇、地精要塞和农业公会都有果树种植地。

english: You can fill plantpots with soil from any empty patch, if you have a gardening trowel.
translation: 如果你有园艺铲，可以用任何空地的土壤填满花盆。

english: Hops are good for brewing ales. I believe there's a brewery up in Keldagrim somewhere, and I've heard rumours that a place called Phasmatys used to be good for that type of thing. 'Fore they all died, of course.
translation: 啤酒花适合酿造麦酒。我相信凯尔达格林城某处有个酿酒厂，我还听说一个叫法斯玛提斯的地方以前也酿造这种酒。当然那是在他们都死光之前的事了。

english: Vegetables, hops and flowers need constant watering - if you ignore my advice, you will sooner or later find yourself in possession of a dead farming patch.
translation: 蔬菜、啤酒花和花卉需要持续浇水——如果你忽视我的建议，你迟早会发现自己拥有一块枯死的种植地。

english: You can put up to five tomatoes, strawberries, apples, bananas or oranges into a fruit basket, although you can't have a mix in the same basket.
translation: 你可以在水果篮中放入最多五个番茄、草莓、苹果、香蕉或橙子，但不能在同一篮中混合。

english: Don't just throw away your weeds after you've raked a patch - put them in a compost bin and make some compost.
translation: 在你耙完一块地后不要直接把杂草扔掉——把它们放进堆肥箱里制作堆肥。

english: There are five other Farming areas like this one - Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius and Alan's area in the Farming Guild.
translation: 还有五个像这样的农业区域——法拉多附近的埃尔斯坦区域、凯瑟比镇附近的丹塔拉区域、莫利塔尼亚的莱拉区域、霍西迪乌斯城的马里西区域和农业公会的艾伦区域。

english: There are fiveother Farming areas like this one - Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius, Alan's area in the Farming Guild and Oswallt's
translation: 还有五个像这样的农业区域——法拉多附近的埃尔斯坦区域、凯瑟比镇附近的丹塔拉区域、莫利塔尼亚的莱拉区域、霍西迪乌斯城的马里西区域、

english: area in Prifddinas.
translation: 农业公会的艾伦区域和普利夫迪纳的奥斯瓦尔特区域。

english: If you want to make your own sacks and baskets you'll need to use the loom that's near the Farming shop in Falador. If you're a good enough [craftsman/craftswoman], that is.
translation: 如果你想自己制作袋子和篮子，你需要使用法拉多农业商店附近的织布机。如果你是个足够好的 [工匠/女工匠] 的话。

english: You don't have to buy all your plantpots you know, you can make them yourself on a pottery wheel. If you're a good enough [craftsman/craftswoman], that is.
translation: 你知道你不必购买所有花盆，你可以在陶轮上自己制作。如果你是个足够好的 [工匠/女工匠] 的话。

english: Can you sell me something?
translation: 你能卖我东西吗？

english: That depends on whether I have it to sell. What is it that you're looking for?
translation: 那取决于我是否有货可卖。你在找什么？

english: Some plant cure.
translation: 一些植物治疗药水。

english: Plant cure, eh? I might have some put aside for myself. Tell you what, I'll sell you some plant cure for 25 coins if you like.
translation: 植物治疗药水，嗯？我可能给自己留了一些。这样吧，如果你愿意，我25金币卖给你一些植物治疗药水。

english: I don't have enough money for that, I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕我没有足够的钱。

english: Actually, I don't think I'd be able to carry it.
translation: 其实，我想我拿不动。

english: Yes, that sounds like a fair price.
translation: 是的，那听起来是个公平的价格。

english: No thanks, I can get that much cheaper elsewhere.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我可以在别处便宜得多地买到。

english: A bucket of compost.
translation: 一桶堆肥。

english: A bucket of compost, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 35 coins if you like.
translation: 一桶堆肥，嗯？我可能有一个多余的……这样吧，如果你愿意，我35金币卖给你。

english: A rake.
translation: 一把耙子。

english: A rake, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: 一把耙子，嗯？我可能有一个多余的……这样吧，如果你愿意，我15金币卖给你。

english: A plant pot.
translation: 一个花盆。

english: Eh, I suppose I can spare you a plant pot, but I'll want 40 coins for it.
translation: 嗯，我想我可以给你一个花盆，但我要40金币。

english: A watering can.
translation: 一个喷壶。

english: A watering can, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 25 coins if you like.
translation: 一个喷壶，嗯？我可能有一个多余的……这样吧，如果你愿意，我25金币卖给你。

english: A gardening trowel.
translation: 一把园艺铲。

english: A gardening trowel, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: 一把园艺铲，嗯？我可能有一个多余的……这样吧，如果你愿意，我15金币卖给你。

english: A seed dibber.
translation: 一个种植锥。

english: A seed dibber, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: 一个种植锥，嗯？我可能有一个多余的……这样吧，如果你愿意，我15金币卖给你。

english: Forget it, you don't have anything I need.
translation: 算了，你没有什么我需要的。

english: I'll come back another time.
translation: 我改天再来。

english: I have a question for you.
translation: 我有个问题问你。

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
translation: 请输入问题的答案。

english: No, try again.
translation: 不，再试一次。

english: Correct!
translation: 正确！

english: Would you look after my crops for me?
translation: 你能帮我照管作物吗？

english: Okay, it's a deal.
translation: 好的，成交。

english: No, that's too much.
translation: 不，那太多了。

english: Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: 你能给我一些农业建议吗？

english: Can you sell me something?
translation: 你能卖我东西吗？

english: Some plant cure.
translation: 一些植物治疗药水。

english: Yes, that sounds like a fair price.
translation: 是的，那听起来是个公平的价格。

english: No thanks, I can get that much cheaper elsewhere.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我可以在别处便宜得多地买到。

english: A bucket of compost.
translation: 一桶堆肥。

english: A rake.
translation: 一把耙子。

english: A plant pot.
translation: 一个花盆。

translation: (查看更多物品)

translation: 一个喷壶。

translation: 一把园艺铲。

english: Forget it.
translation: 算了。

english: I'll come back another time.
translation: 我改天再来。

english: Ouch!
translation: 哎哟！

english: Are you alright?
translation: 你还好吗？

english: I'm fine, I'm fine. Just a scratch.
translation: 我没事，我没事。只是擦伤。

english: If you're sure. Who are you?
translation: 如果你确定。你是谁？

english: Me? I'm Tarik.
translation: 我？我是塔里克。

english: That hat you're wearing doesn't look like it comes from around here?
translation: 你戴的那顶帽子看起来不像是本地货？

english: It was a present. My employer thought it would suit me. I'm not sure it does, though it does keep the sun off very well.
translation: 那是份礼物。我的雇主觉得它很适合我。我不太确定，不过它确实很能遮阳。

english: Who is this employer?
translation: 这位雇主是谁？

english: Simon Templeton. He's an archaeologist. I worked as an assistant for him, though I haven't seen him since the plague business started, so I work for myself now.
translation: 西蒙‧坦普尔顿。他是个考古学家。我曾是他的助手，不过自从瘟疫事件开始后我就没见过他了，所以我现在单干。

english: I see. So what have you been up to?
translation: 我明白了。那你最近在忙什么？

english: Simon suggested that there might be riches to be found in this pyramid.
translation: 西蒙暗示这座金字塔里可能有宝藏。

english: All I've found so far are injuries though.
translation: 不过到目前为止，我只找到了伤痛。

english: Interesting... What can you tell me about this pyramid?
translation: 有趣……关于这座金字塔你能告诉我些什么？

english: Well, I'm not sure. It's called Jalsavrah apparently. It's a strange place.
translation: 嗯，我也不太确定。它似乎叫贾尔萨夫拉。这是个奇怪的地方。

english: How so?
translation: 怎么个奇怪法？

english: First of all, there's something odd about the doors. There's four of them, but three of them lead to an empty tomb.
translation: 首先，那些门有点古怪。一共有四扇，但其中三扇通向空墓穴。

english: The other one is guarded by something, and whatever it is, it doesn't like visitors.
translation: 另一扇由某种东西把守，不管那是什么，它都不喜欢访客。

english: The thing is, the doors seem to change around sometimes. It's all quite confusing.
translation: 问题是，那些门的位置似乎有时会变动。这一切都挺让人困惑的。

english: What's this thing guarding one of them.
translation: 把守其中一扇门的是什么东西？

english: I think it might be a mummy. It's not very friendly, but it does allow you to enter some of the rooms in the tomb. They are dangerous though.
translation: 我想可能是具木乃伊。它不太友善，但它确实允许你进入墓穴中的一些房间。不过那些房间很危险。

english: Well I'm not afraid of a little danger.
translation: 好吧，我不怕一点危险。

english: Are you sure? The place is full of poisonous snakes and scarabs along with some rather nasty mummies as well. You could die in there.
translation: 你确定吗？那地方到处都是毒蛇和圣甲虫，还有一些相当凶恶的木乃伊。你可能会死在里面。

english: I managed to get into one room, but the next room was harder. My lockpicking skills weren't good enough. Maybe I should have taken a lockpick.
translation: 我设法进了一个房间，但下一个房间更难了。我的开锁技术不够好。也许我该带把开锁器的。

english: It all sounds like fun to me. So, is there anything valuable in there?
translation: 对我来说听起来都很有趣。那么，里面有什么值钱的东西吗？

english: There are lots of artefacts that you should be able to sell to a legitimate trader...
translation: 有很多文物，你应该能卖给合法的商人……

english: Like your friend Simon Templeton?
translation: 比如你的朋友西蒙‧坦普尔顿？

english: Of course. He's as 'legitimate' as you can get.
translation: 当然。他是最“合法”不过的了。

english: Is there anything else of value in there?
translation: 里面还有其他有价值的东西吗？

english: I've heard a rumour that there is an ancient magic sceptre somewhere inside.
translation: 我听说有个传言，里面某处有一根古老的魔法权杖。

english: Ah, now you've piqued my interest. What do you know about this sceptre?
translation: 啊，这下你勾起我的兴趣了。关于这根权杖你知道些什么？

english: Not a lot. It's apparently made of gold and covered in jewels. It's supposed to have some magical powers as well.
translation: 不多。据说它是金子做的，镶满了宝石。它应该还拥有一些魔法力量。

english: Magical powers? This sounds good. What are they?
translation: 魔法力量？听起来不错。是什么样的力量？

english: I'll let you know when I find it!
translation: 等我找到它就告诉你！

english: Not if I find it first!
translation: 要是我先找到可就不一定了！

english: Hey! if you find it, I deserve a share of the profits! You wouldn't have known it existed without my help.
translation: 嘿！如果你找到了，我也该分一杯羹！要不是我帮忙，你根本不知道它的存在。

english: I'll think about it...
translation: 我会考虑的……

english: Yes, it's an odd place, isn't it?
translation: 是的，这是个奇怪的地方，不是吗？

english: You've been inside? Did you find anything?
translation: 你进去过吗？找到什么了吗？

english: Nothing of particular note...
translation: 没什么特别值得注意的……

english: Well if you do, I'd appreciate a share of any profits.
translation: 好吧，如果你找到了，希望能分我一份利润。

english: Right... I'll think about it...
translation: 好吧……我会考虑的……

english: Hello again.
translation: 又见面了。

english: Oh, hello. Any luck in the pyramid? I'd appreciate a cut of anything you find.
translation: 哦，你好。在金字塔里运气如何？如果你找到什么，希望能分我一份。

english: Right... I'll be sure to let you know if I come across anything good...
translation: 好吧……如果我遇到什么好东西，一定会告诉你的……

english: Great!
translation: 太好了！

english: You show the artefact to Tarik.
translation: 你把文物展示给塔里克看。

english: Ohh... That looks nice. I'm looking forward to my cut.
translation: 噢……看起来不错。我期待着我的那份。

english: Ah, yes... I'll bring it round later.
translation: 啊，是的……我稍后给你送过来。

english: I'll be waiting...
translation: 我会等着的……

english: You show the sceptre to Tarik.
translation: 你把权杖展示给塔里克看。

english: Hey, look at this sceptre I found!
translation: 嘿，看看我找到的这根权杖！

english: Wow! It looks very valuable. What's my share?
translation: 哇！看起来非常值钱。我的那份呢？

english: Well given the work I had to go through to get it, I think I earned it all by myself.
translation: 嗯，考虑到我为了得到它所经历的艰辛，我觉得这完全是我应得的。

english: Hey, that's not fair. I told you about this pyramid!
translation: 嘿，这不公平。是我告诉你这座金字塔的事的！

english: The world is a harsh place. Live and learn.
translation: 世界是残酷的。吃一堑长一智吧。

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Hello old bean. Is there something I can help you with?
translation: 你好，老伙计。有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: My name is Tarquin Marjoribanks.
translation: 我叫塔昆‧马乔里班克斯。

english: I'd be surprised if you haven't already heard of me?
translation: 如果你还没听说过我，那我倒是很惊讶？

english: Why would I have heard of you Mr. Marjoribanks?
translation: 我为什么会听说过你呢，马乔里班克斯先生？

english: It's pronounced 'Marchbanks'!
translation: 发音是“马奇班克斯”！

english: You should know of me because I am a member of the royal family of Misthalin!
translation: 你应该知道我，因为我是米斯塔林王室成员！

english: Are you related to King Roald?
translation: 你和罗尔德国王有亲戚关系吗？

english: Oh yes! Quite closely actually.
translation: 哦是的！其实关系还挺近的。

english: I'm his 4th cousin, once removed on his mothers side.
translation: 我是他母亲那边的第四代堂表亲(隔一代)。

english: Er... Okay. What are you doing here then?
translation: 呃……好吧。那你在这里做什么？

english: I'm canoeing on the river! It's enormous fun! Would you like to know how?
translation: 我在河上划独木舟！非常有趣！你想知道怎么划吗？

english: Could you teach me about canoes?
translation: 你能教教我关于独木舟的事吗？

english: Well, you don't look like you have the skill to make a canoe.
translation: 嗯，你看起来不像具备制作独木舟的技能。

english: You need to have at least level 12 woodcutting.
translation: 你至少需要12级伐木技能。

english: Once you are able to make a canoe it makes travel along the river much quicker!
translation: 一旦你能制作独木舟，沿河旅行就会快得多！

english: It's really quite simple. Just walk down to that tree on the bank and chop it down.
translation: 其实很简单。只要走到岸边那棵树旁把它砍倒。

english: When you have done that you can shape the log further with your axe to make a canoe.
translation: 做完之后，你可以用斧头进一步加工原木来制作独木舟。

english: My personal favourite is the Stable Dugout canoe. A finer craft you'll never see old bean!
translation: 我个人最喜欢的是稳固型独木舟。老伙计，你再也见不到比这更精良的船了！

english: A Stable Dugout canoe will take you pretty much the length of the Lum river.
translation: 一艘稳固型独木舟几乎可以带你走完仑河的全程。

english: Of course there are other canoes.
translation: 当然还有其他类型的独木舟。

english: Further up river, near the Barbarian Village, I saw some darned fool 'canoeing' on a log!
translation: 再往上游走，靠近野蛮人聚落的地方，我看到有些笨蛋在一根原木上“划船”！

english: Unfortunately, you don't have the skill to create anything more than one of those logs. I dare say it will only get 1 stop down the river!
translation: 不幸的是，你的技能还不足以制作比那种原木更好的东西。我敢说那只能让你顺流漂一站！

english: Still, I'm sure it will satisfy one such as yourself.
translation: 不过，我相信那也能满足像你这样的人。

english: What's that supposed to mean?
translation: 那是什么意思？

english: Do not profane the royal house of Varrock by engaging me in further discourse you knave!
translation: 别再跟我废话亵渎维洛克王室了，你这个无赖！

english: Pfft! I doubt he even knows the King!
translation: 噗！我怀疑他连国王都不认识！

english: You seem to be quite handy with an axe though!
translation: 不过你看起来挺会用斧头的！

english: I'm sure you can build a Dugout canoe. Not as fine as a Stable Dugout but it will carry you 2 stops on the river.
translation: 我相信你能造出一艘简易独木舟。虽然不如稳固型的精良，但能载你在河上行两站。

english: I should imagine it would suit your limited means.
translation: 我想这应该适合你有限的财力。

english: What do you mean when you say 'limited means'?
translation: 你说“有限的财力”是什么意思？

english: Well, you're just an itinerant adventurer!
translation: 嗯，你只是个流浪冒险者！

english: What possible reason would you have for cluttering up my river with your inferior water craft!
translation: 你有什么理由用你那劣质的船只来堵塞我的河流！

english: Ah! Perfect! You can make a Stable Dugout canoe! One of those will carry you to any civilised place on the river.
translation: 啊！完美！你能造出稳固型独木舟了！那种船能带你去河上任何文明的地方。

english: If you were of good pedigree I'd let you join my boat club. You seem to be one of those vagabond adventurers though.
translation: 如果你出身名门，我会让你加入我的游艇俱乐部。不过你看起来像是那种流浪冒险者。

english: Charming!
translation: 真迷人！

english: Be off with you rogue!
translation: 滚开，流氓！

english: Well ... erm. You seem to be able to make a Waka!
translation: 嗯……呃。你似乎能造出瓦卡独木舟！

english: Sounds fun, what's a Waka.
translation: 听起来很有趣，什么是瓦卡独木舟？

english: I've only ever seen one man on the river who uses a Waka. A big, fearsome looking fellow up near Edgeville.
translation: 我在河上只见过一个人使用瓦卡独木舟。是个在边陲镇附近的大块头，看起来很吓人。

english: People say he was born in the Wilderness and that he is looking for a route back.
translation: 人们说他出生在荒野，正在寻找回去的路。

english: Is that true!
translation: 那是真的吗！

english: How should I know? I would not consort with such a base fellow!
translation: 我怎么知道？我才不会和那种下等人交往！

english: No thanks, not right now.
translation: 不用了，现在不需要。

english: Can you teach me about canoes?
translation: 你能教教我关于独木舟的事吗？

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Yes
translation: 是的

english: No
translation: 不

english: Can you teach me about Canoeing?
translation: 你能教教我划独木舟吗？

english: Please feel free to use the pottery wheel, I won't be using it all the time. Put your pots in the kiln when you've made one.
translation: 请随意使用陶轮，我不会一直占着它。做好陶器后就放进窑里烧制。

english: And make sure you tidy up after yourself!
translation: 还有，用完记得收拾干净！

english: What'you want?
translation: 你想要什么？

english: Do you-
What? Speak up, I can't hear you!
translation: 什么？大声点，我听不见！

english: Uhm... I'm just looking for some pickaxes! Do you have any?
translation: 嗯……我只是在找些镐子！你有吗？

english: Do I have any pickaxes? Do I? Of course I do, this is a pickaxe shop, isn't it!
translation: 我有镐子吗？我有吗？当然有，这是镐子店，不是吗！

english: What? Stop mumbling!
translation: 什么？别嘟囔！

english: I want a quest!
translation: 我想要个任务！

english: I don't have any lousy quests... I've got someone who's helping me already!
translation: 我没有什么烂任务……已经有人在帮我了！

english: Well, I say helping... he takes his merry time to do his chores, my son does.
translation: 嗯，说是帮忙……我那儿子做事慢吞吞的。

english: Then perhaps I can help in some way?
translation: 那也许我能帮上什么忙？

english: Pfft, I doubt it... maybe when my son fouls up again, but not now.
translation: 噗，我怀疑……也许等我儿子再搞砸的时候吧，但现在不行。

english: Nothing really.
translation: 没什么特别的。

english: Then clear off!
translation: 那就滚开！

english: My no good son must be down the pub again, drinking away all our money instead of getting one simple item from the market for me.
translation: 我那不成器的儿子肯定又去酒馆了，把我们的钱都喝光了，而不是去市场给我买件简单的东西。

english: Now, I have another errand. Perhaps you will be more useful?
translation: 现在，我有另一个差事。也许你会更有用？

english: What's it about?
translation: 是关于什么的？

english: I'm in need of some raw supplies. Get me [2-3] [item] and be quick about it! I need them within the next [X] minutes!
translation: 我需要一些原材料。给我弄 [2-3] 个 [item]，动作快点！我要在接下来的 [X] 分钟内拿到！

english: Hmm, [2-3] [item] in [X] minutes, that sounds about alright.
translation: 嗯，[X] 分钟内弄到 [2-3] 个 [item]，听起来还行。

english: I don't work for rude people.
translation: 我不为粗鲁的人工作。

english: You're just as bad as my son, or worse!
translation: 你跟我儿子一样糟糕，甚至更糟！

english: Where're my [X] [item]? My son could've gotten them faster!
translation: 我的 [X] 个 [item] 在哪？我儿子都能比你更快弄到！

english: I've had enough of this wild goose chase.
translation: 我受够了这种白忙活。

english: Why you useless little human! I should thrownyou in the Kelda! With a lump of granite attached to your feet!
translation: 你这没用的小人类！我应该把你扔进凯尔达河里！脚上还绑块大花岗岩！

english: Ha, who are you calling little here?
translation: 哈，你说谁小呢？

english: Get out!
translation: 滚出去！

english: I'm still trying to collect them.
translation: 我还在努力收集它们。

english: Try a little harder! I don't have all day you know!
translation: 再努力点！我可没一整天时间等你！

english: I need a couple of iron pickaxes, I'm always short on the darned things. But hurry up! I will need them before [15/20/25] minutes are up.
translation: 我需要几把铁镐，我总是缺这该死的东西。但快点！我要在 [15/20/25] 分钟内拿到。

english: Hmm, [3/4/5] iron pickaxes in [15/20/25] minutes, that sounds about alright.
translation: 嗯，[15/20/25] 分钟内弄到 [3/4/5] 把铁镐，听起来还行。

english: You're as bad as my soon! Clear off before I beat you with this stick!
translation: 你跟我儿子一样糟糕！在我用这根棍子揍你之前滚开！

english: Oops.
translation: 哎呀。

english: I've collected all [X] [item] for you!
translation: 我已经为你收集好了所有 [X] 个 [item]！

english: Give 'em to me quick before I change my mind about rewarding you!
translation: 快把它们给我，趁我还没改变主意不奖励你！

english: Do you want me to pay you for these or can I get away with teaching you how to mine properly?
translation: 你是想让我为此付钱，还是我教你正确采矿的方法就能打发你了？

english: Do you want me to pay you in gold or would you prefer me to teach you a bit about how you can mine more efficiently?
translation: 你是想让我付金币，还是更愿意让我教你一些如何更高效采矿的技巧？

english: Do you want me to pay you in gold or would you like me to show you some smithing tricks?
translation: 你是想让我付金币，还是想让我展示一些锻造技巧？

english: I'd like the gold.
translation: 我想要金币。

english: Please teach me that.
translation: 请教教我。

english: You feel more experienced.
translation: 你的经验值提升了。

english: Show me the gold!
translation: 把金币给我！

english: Enlighten me.
translation: 指点我吧。

english: Do you have any pickaxes?

translation: 你帮助挖掘出的头盔派上了用场。我去托儿所给孩子们讲我们的历史时，用它作了教具。

translation: 真神奇，古代哥布林的眼睛甚至比孩子的还小！

translation: 奥尔达克检查了你挖出的斧刃，发现它有微弱的魔法光环。看来钉锤并不是我们祖先从地表带来的唯一魔法武器。

translation: 事实上，他们的许多装备可能都是魔法的。这意味着要么古代哥布林是熟练的魔法工匠，要么有其他势力在为他们提供魔法装备。

translation: 我们利用你挖掘出的盔甲碎片重建了原始盔甲的形状，进而也还原了穿戴该盔甲的哥布林的体型。

english: This told us a lot about how the goblin body shape changed from its surface form to that of the cave goblins.
translation: 这让我们了解了很多关于哥布林体型如何从地表形态转变为洞穴哥布林形态的信息。
