translation: 你想了解更多关于哪个等级的奖励？

english: Tell me more about the Easy rewards please!
translation: 请多告诉我一些关于简单奖励的事！

english: If you complete all of the easy tasks in the Fremennik Province, Peer the Seer can bank items for you at all times and your enchanted lyre can hold an extra charge.
translation: 如果你完成了费明尼克行省的所有简单任务，先知皮尔可以随时为你存取物品，你的魔法竖琴可以多储存一次充能。

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！

english: Tell me more about the Medium rewards please!
translation: 请多告诉我一些关于中等奖励的事！

english: In addition to the easy rewards, your boots can teleport you to Rellekka once per day as well as an increased rate of gaining approval with your subjects.
translation: 除了简单奖励外，你的靴子现在每天可以传送你一次到雷勒卡城，并且能提高你获得子民认可的速度。

english: Tell me more about the Hard rewards please!
translation: 请多告诉我一些关于困难奖励的事！

english: In addition to the easy and medium benefits, you'll be able to change your lyre teleport location to Waterbirth Island, access two new Lunar spells and you'll receive extra Agility experience from the Rellekka rooftop
translation: 除了简单和中等的福利外，你还可以将竖琴的传送地点改为水诞岛，解锁两个新的月魔法，并且在雷勒卡屋顶敏捷课程中获得额外的

english: course.
translation: 敏捷经验值。

english: Tell me more about the Elite rewards please!
translation: 请多告诉我一些关于精英奖励的事！

english: In addition to the previous tiers of rewards, your boots now have unlimited teleports to Rellekka, your lyre can be attuned to teleport you to Jatiszo or Neitiznot, you'll no longer need a seal of passage on Lunar Isle,
translation: 除了之前的奖励等级外，你的靴子现在可以无限次传送到雷勒卡城，你的竖琴可以调整为传送到贾蒂佐或奈提兹诺，你在月亮岛不再需要通行印玺，

english: Dagannoth bones will be dropped as notes and your subjects will approve of your kingdom management even faster than before.
translation: 深潜者骨头将以票据形式掉落，而且你的子民对你王国管理的认可速度会比以前更快。

english: Just complete the tasks in the Fremennik Province so they're ticked off, then come and speak to me for your rewards.
translation: 只需完成费明尼克行省的任务并将它们勾选掉，然后来找我领取你的奖励。

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！

english: See you later.
translation: 回头见。

english: About the Dagannoth Kings...
translation: 关于深潜者之王……

english: Ah, yes. Because you've completed the elite tasks for the Fremennik Province, their bones will be noted for you.
translation: 啊，是的。因为你完成了费明尼克行省的精英任务，它们的骨头会为你以票据形式掉落。

english: If you'd prefer, I can change it so they will drop their bones as they normally would?
translation: 如果你更愿意，我可以将其改回让它们像往常一样掉落骨头？

english: Very well. In future, when you kill a Dagannoth King, they will drop their bones normally.
translation: 很好。以后当你杀死深潜者之王时，它们会正常掉落骨头。

english: Very well. If you change your mind, come talk to me again.
translation: 很好。如果你改变主意，再来找我谈谈。

english: Ah, yes. You wanted the bones from the Dagannoth Kings to remain unnoted when you killed them.
translation: 啊，是的。你希望杀死深潜者之王时，它们的骨头保持非票据形式。

english: If you'd prefer, I can change them back to being noted instead?
translation: 如果你更愿意，我可以将它们改回票据形式？

english: Very well. In future, when you kill a Dagannoth King, their bones will be noted.
translation: 很好。以后当你杀死深潜者之王时，它们的骨头将以票据形式掉落。

english: Exile. You don't have many friends around here at the moment.
translation: 流亡者。你现在在这里没什么朋友。

english: How do you feel about it?
translation: 你对此感觉如何？

english: Doesn't bother me. Some people take these things more seriously than others. On that note, do you need something?
translation: 我不在意。有些人比其他人更把这些事当真。说到这，你需要什么吗？

english: I've completed all of the easy tasks in my Fremennik Achievement Diary!
translation: 我完成了费明尼克成就日志中的所有简单任务！

english: I can see that, well done! You'll be wanting your reward then!
translation: 我看到了，做得好！那你一定想要你的奖励了！

english: Yes please!
translation: 好的，谢谢！

english: These boots are a symbol of your exploration of the Fremennik lands. They can teleport you here once per day, Peer the Seer can now bank items for you at all times and your enchanted lyre can hold an extra
translation: 这双靴子是你探索费明尼克土地的象征。它们每天可以传送你到这里一次，先知皮尔现在可以随时为你存取物品，

english: charge.
translation: 你的附魔竖琴可以多储存一次充能。

english: Wow, thanks!
translation: 哇，谢谢！

english: If you ever lose your boots, come back to me to reclaim them.
translation: 如果你弄丢了靴子，回来找我重新领取。

english: I've completed all of the medium tasks in my Fremennik achievement diary!
translation: 我完成了费明尼克成就日志中的所有中等任务！

english: I've upgraded your Fremennik sea boots for you. They can now teleport you here three times per day and have an increased rate of gaining approval with your subjects.
translation: 我已经为你升级了费明尼克海靴。它们现在每天可以传送你到这里三次，并且能提高你获得子民认可的速度。

english: I've completed all of the hard tasks in my Fremennik achievement diary!
translation: 我完成了费明尼克成就日志中的所有困难任务！

english: You need to complete all of the easy and medium tasks too before I can reward you for the more difficult sets.
translation: 在你完成所有简单和中等任务之前，我无法奖励你更困难等级的任务。

english: I've upgraded your Fremennik sea boots for you. They can now teleport you here five times per day, you can now change your lyre teleport location to Waterbirth Island, access two new Lunar spells and you'll receive
translation: 我已经为你升级了费明尼克海靴。它们现在每天可以传送你到这里五次，你可以将竖琴的传送地点改为水诞岛，解锁两个新的月魔法，

english: extra Agility experience from the Rellekka rooftop course.
translation: 并且在雷勒卡城屋顶敏捷课程中获得额外的敏捷经验值。

english: I've completed all of the elite tasks in my Fremennik achievement diary!
translation: 我完成了费明尼克成就日志中的所有精英任务！

english: I can see that, well done! You've completed all of the tasks in the Fremennik Province! Here's your reward!
translation: 我看到了，做得好！你完成了费明尼克行省的所有任务！这是你的奖励！

english: I've upgraded your Fremennik sea boots for you. In addition to all of the previous benefits, your boots now have unlimited teleports to Rellekka, your lyre can now teleport you to Jatiszo or Neitiznot, you'll no longer
translation: 我已经为你升级了费明尼克海靴。除了之前的所有福利外，你的靴子现在可以无限次传送到雷勒卡城，你的竖琴现在可以传送到贾蒂佐或奈提兹诺，

english: need a seal of passage on Lunar Isle, Dagannoth bones will be dropped as notes and your subjects will approve of your kingdom management even faster than before.
translation: 你在月亮岛不再需要通行印玺，深潜者骨头将以票据形式掉落，而且你的子民对你王国管理的认可速度会比以前更快。

english: Can I have some more boots?
translation: 我能再要些靴子吗？

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: I have a question about my Achievement Diary
translation: 我有个关于我的成就日志的问题

english: What is the Achievement Diary?
translation: 什么是成就日志？

english: What are the rewards?
translation: 奖励是什么？

english: Easy Rewards.
translation: 简单奖励。

english: Medium Rewards.
translation: 中等奖励。

english: Hard Rewards.
translation: 困难奖励。

english: Elite Rewards.
translation: 精英奖励。

english: How do I claim the rewards?
translation: 我怎么领取奖励？

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！

english: About the Dagannoth Kings...
translation: 关于深潜者之王……

english: Yes, give me unnoted bones.
translation: 是的，给我非票据形式的骨头。

english: No, keep the bones noted.
translation: 不，保持骨头为票据形式。

english: Yes, give me noted bones.
translation: 是的，给我票据形式的骨头。

english: No, keep the bones unnoted.
translation: 不，保持骨头为非票据形式。

english: [Good day, sir/Good day, madam/Good day].
translation: [你好，先生/你好，女士/你好]。

english: What are you doing down here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: We're extending the cave so more people can live in it.
translation: 我们正在扩建洞穴，以便更多人能住在这里。

english: These Miscellanians aren't so bad. They appreciate the benefits of living underground.
translation: 这些米斯凯尼亚人还不错。他们很欣赏住在地下的好处。

english: ...such as?
translation: ……比如呢？

english: You don't get rained on, for example.
translation: 比如，你不会淋到雨。

english: Of course, there are some problems, like the monsters Donal saw...
translation: 当然，也有一些问题，比如多纳尔看到的怪物……

english: Someone saw a monster?
translation: 有人看到了怪物？

english: Could you tell me more? The King asked me to investigate.
translation: 你能多告诉我一些吗？国王让我去调查。

english: One of the other dwarves who was working with us saw it. His name's Donal.
translation: 和我们一起工作的另一个矮人看到了它。他叫多纳尔。

english: He went further into the caves to plan our excavations, and a while later he came out shaking.
translation: 他深入洞穴去规划我们的挖掘工作，过了一会儿他颤抖着出来了。

english: He's been in the inn ever since.
translation: 从那以后他就一直待在旅馆里。

english: Good day.
translation: 你好。

english: Have you spoken to Donal?
translation: 你和多纳尔谈过了吗？

english: Not yet, no.
translation: 还没有，没。

english: Well, if you want to hear stories about monsters, he's the best one to ask.
translation: 嗯，如果你想听关于怪物的故事，他是最好的人选。

english: Not getting rained on, for example.
translation: 比如，不会淋到雨。

english: I have. The monster he talked about could be in the caves nearby.
translation: 我谈过了。他提到的怪物可能就在附近的洞穴里。

english: You'd better get in there and do something about it, then.
translation: 那你最好进去处理一下。

english: It's not safe. I need to shore up the walls before I can go through.
translation: 不安全。我得先加固墙壁才能通过。

english: Did you do anything about that monster Donal was talking about?
translation: 你对多纳尔提到的那个怪物做了什么吗？

english: It's been taken care of.
translation: 已经处理好了。

english: Glad to hear it. Now we can get on with excavating.
translation: 很高兴听到这个。现在我们可以继续挖掘了。

english: What are you doing down here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Good day.
translation: 你好。

english: Leave me be, outerlander. I have nothing to say to the likes of you.
translation: 别烦我，外乡人。我跟你这种人没什么好说的。

english: Howdy Thorvald!
translation: 你好，索瓦尔德！

english: And greetings to you too. It is good to see new blood entering the Fremennik; we gain our strength by bringing new warriors into the tribe.
translation: 也向你问好。很高兴看到新血液加入费明尼克；我们通过吸纳新战士进入部落来获得力量。

english: Welcome to the Realm of Memories, [player name].
translation: 欢迎来到记忆领域，[player name]。

english: Who were you?
translation: 你以前是谁？

english: I am Thrander. Long ago I used to live in Varrock, converting plate armour. For example, if you'd got a plate skirt, but you preferred leggings instead, I'd convert it, free of charge.
translation: 我是瑟兰德。很久以前我住在维洛克城，专门改造板甲。例如，如果你有板甲裙但更喜欢腿甲，我会免费帮你改造。

english: Are you happy here?
translation: 你在这里开心吗？

english: Maybe retiring was a mistake. If the world ever wanted me again, I could come out of retirement and offer my services as before. Though people might fret about the economic impact if I did.
translation: 也许退休是个错误。如果世界再次需要我，我可以复出并提供以前的服务。不过如果我那样做，人们可能会担心经济影响。

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

english: Who were you?
translation: 你以前是谁？

english: Are you happy here?
translation: 你在这里开心吗？

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

english: Urg!
translation: 呃！

english: Urg!
translation: 呃！

english: What is it, human? I'm working.
translation: 什么事，人类？我在工作。

english: How do I use the furnace?
translation: 我怎么使用熔炉？

english: Put your ore on the conveyor belt to get it smelted. We'll stoke the boiler and operate the rest of the machinery for you.
translation: 把你的矿石放在传送带上进行冶炼。我们会为你添煤烧锅炉并操作其余的机器。

english: You'll have to help repair the furnace whenever a pipe blows, though. Just hit it with a hammer - that usually works.
translation: 不过每当管道爆裂时，你得帮忙修理熔炉。只要用锤子敲一下——通常这就行了。

english: You'll have to put money in the coffer to pay for our services. We charge 72,000 coins per hour; money is deducted as long as you're in this room with us.
translation: 你得把钱放进金库来支付我们的服务费。我们每小时收费72,000金币；只要你和我们在这个房间里，钱就会被扣除。

english: Gosh, you're a remarkably big dwarf.
translation: 天哪，你是个特别大的矮人。

english: My brothers and I have a rare genetic condition affecting our growth. Rather than treating us as freaks, you might like to appreciate how useful it is that we can operate the machinery.
translation: 我和我的兄弟们有一种罕见的遗传病影响了我们的生长。与其把我们当怪胎，不如欣赏一下我们能操作机器是多么有用。

english: Sorry.
translation: 抱歉。

english: That's ok, human. You're not the first to comment on it. Now, did you need anything? I've got work to do here.
translation: 没关系，人类。你不是第一个评论这个的人。现在，你需要什么吗？我这里有工作要做。

english: Are you sure you're really a dwarf?
translation: 你确定你真的是个矮人吗？

english: ... look, do you want help with something, or did you just come here to be rude? I've got work to do.
translation: ……听着，你是需要帮忙，还是只是来这里找茬的？我有工作要做。

english: I'll let you get on with it.
translation: 我不打扰你工作了。

english: How do I use the furnace?
translation: 我怎么使用熔炉？

english: Gosh, you're a remarkably big dwarf.
translation: 天哪，你是个特别大的矮人。

english: Sorry.
translation: 抱歉。

english: I'll let you get on with it.
translation: 我不打扰你工作了。

english: Are you sure you're really a dwarf?
translation: 你确定你真的是个矮人吗？

english: What is that cape you're wearing?
translation: 你穿的那件斗篷是什么？

english: It's a Skillcape of Smithing. It shows that I'm a master blacksmith, but that's only to be expected - after all, my ancestors were the greatest blacksmiths in dwarven history.
translation: 那是锻造技能斗篷。它表明我是个铁匠大师，但这也在意料之中——毕竟，我的祖先是矮人历史上最伟大的铁匠。

english: If you ever achieve level 99 Smithing you'll be able to wear a cape like this, and receive more experience when smelting gold ore.
translation: 如果你达到99级锻造，你就能穿上这样的斗篷，并且在冶炼金矿时获得更多经验值。

english: Can you make me another of Sir Vyvin's swords?
translation: 你能再给我做一把维文爵士的剑吗？

english: You want that knight's sword again? I suppose you brought me a lovely pie, so I don't mind. I'll need a blurite ore and two iron bars, like before.
translation: 你又想要那把骑士剑？我想你带了美味的派给我，所以我不介意。我需要一块蓝铁矿石和两根铁锭，像以前一样。

english: Okay, I'll go and find that.
translation: 好的，我去找那些材料。

english: Would you like a redberry pie?
translation: 你想要个红莓派吗？

english: You see Thurgo's eyes light up.
translation: 你看到瑟戈的眼睛亮了起来。

english: I'd never say no to a redberry pie! We Imcando dwarves love them - they're GREAT!
translation: 我绝不会拒绝红莓派！我们伊姆坎多矮人最爱它们——它们太棒了！

english: You hand over the pie. Thurgo eats the pie. Thurgo pats his stomach.
translation: 你递过派。瑟戈吃了派。瑟戈拍了拍肚子。

english: By Guthix! THAT was good pie! Anyone who makes pie like THAT has got to be alright!
translation: 凭古斯之名！那真是个好派！能做出那种派的人肯定不错！

english: Can we talk about skillcapes?
translation: 我们能谈谈技能斗篷吗？

english: What do you need, human?
translation: 你需要什么，人类？

english: Now that I am so skilled at Smithing, can I buy a Skillcape of Smithing from you?
translation: 既然我现在锻造技术这么高超，我能从你这里买一件锻造技能斗篷吗？

english: I reckon so; we master smiths must stick together! I'll give it to you for just 99000 coins.
translation: 我想可以；我们大师级铁匠必须团结互助！我只收你99,000金币。

english: Sorry, that's too much money.
translation: 抱歉，那太多了。

english: Too much money? A smith of your calibre should be able to make that amount in an hour!
translation: 太多钱？像你这样水平的铁匠应该一小时就能赚到那么多！

english: Of course I'll pay you.
translation: 当然我会付给你。

english: All Skillcapes come with a free hood. It's part of a deal: buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 所有技能斗篷都附带免费兜帽。这是交易的一部分：买一送一，你懂的。所以你得先腾出一些物品栏空间我才能卖给你。

english: Excellent! Wear that cape with pride my friend.
translation: 太好了！自豪地戴上那斗篷吧，我的朋友。

english: I've met another Imcando dwarf.
translation: 我遇到了另一个伊姆坎多矮人。

english: I very much doubt that [player name]. I'm the last Imcando dwarf left in Gielinor.
translation: 我很怀疑那一点 [player name]。我是基利诺尔仅存的最后一个伊姆坎多矮人。

english: No it's true. I was accidentally helping some grave robbers unearth some treasure below Ice Mountain. Long story short, it turned out to be the ruins of Camdozaal.
translation: 不，是真的。我不小心帮一些盗墓贼在冰山下挖出了宝藏。长话短说，结果那是坎多扎尔的废墟。

english: Camdozaal?
translation: 坎多扎尔？

english: Yes!
translation: 是的！

english: I don't believe me ears! Tell me what else you know!
translation: 我不敢相信我的耳朵！告诉我你还知道什么！

english: Well there's not much left there really. It's just a ruin.
translation: 嗯，那里其实没剩多少东西了。只是个废墟。

english: But there's a lone Imcando dwarf keeping it alive. His name is Ramarno.
translation: 但有一个孤独的伊姆坎多矮人在维持它的生机。他叫拉马诺。

english: Ramarno...
translation: 拉马诺……

english: He's managed to keep the city going all these years, even with his lack of vision.
translation: 尽管他失明，但他多年来一直设法让城市运转下去。

english: Thank you for bringing me this news [player name]. I'll need to make some time to see the city with my own eyes.
translation: 谢谢你给我带来这个消息 [player name]。我得找个时间亲眼去看看那座城市。

english: What do you make of this, Thurgo?
translation: 你怎么看这个，瑟戈？

english: Thurgo quickly reads the book.
translation: 瑟戈快速阅读了这本书。

english: Hmph, who wrote this text? It seems new.
translation: 哼，谁写的这篇文章？看起来很新。

english: I-
Nevermind! If you ever plan on going back to this island, I'll happily come along.
translation: 算了！如果你打算回那个岛，我很乐意同行。

english: Oh... Umm... Err...
So you believe it could possibly lead to the ancient ruins of your race?
translation: 所以你相信这可能通向你们种族的古代废墟？

english: I'll believe it when I see it... Now begone, I've got things to do.
translation: 眼见为实……现在走开，我有事要做。

english: Alright, Thurgo. I'll see you later.
translation: 好吧，瑟戈。回头见。

english: The Wise Old Man says he's got the information you wanted. Here's his message.
translation: 睿智老人说他有你想要的信息。这是他的口信。

english: Ooh, thanks. I've been hoping he'd send me that information soon, although I wouldn't mind if he'd send me a pie instead!
translation: 哦，谢谢。我一直希望他能尽快把信息发给我，虽然他要是给我送个派我也不介意！

english: I'd give you a reward, but you don't seem to have any space for it. Come back when you do.
translation: 我想给你奖励，但你似乎没有空间拿它。等你有了空间再回来。

english: Some guy died down in the hole just north of my house, and he dropped these herbs. Here, take them.
translation: 有个人死在我家北边的坑里，他掉了这些草药。给，拿着。

english: Here's some cash for your time.
translation: 这是给你的一点现金作为报酬。

english: I found this while I was mining. Hope you like it.
translation: 我在采矿时发现了这个。希望你喜欢。

english: Magic isn't really my thing. Here, take these.
translation: 魔法不是我的强项。给，拿着这些。

english: Can you make me another of Sir Vyvin's swords?
translation: 你能再给我做一把维文爵士的剑吗？

english: Would you like a redberry pie?
translation: 你想要个红莓派吗？

english: What is that cape you're wearing?
translation: 你穿的那件斗篷是什么？

english: Can we talk about skillcapes?
translation: 我们能谈谈技能斗篷吗？

english: Sorry, that's too much money.
translation: 抱歉，那太多了。

english: Of course I'll pay you.
translation: 当然我会付给你。

english: I've met another Imcando dwarf.
translation: 我遇到了另一个伊姆坎多矮人。

english: Emerald
translation: 祖母绿

english: Looking to protect that nice brain of yours? Then you'll be wanting one of my helmets.
translation: 想保护你那聪明的大脑吗？那你一定想要我的一顶头盔。

english: [Fremennik name]! Looking to protect that nice brain of yours? Then you'll be wanting one of my helmets.
translation: [Fremennik name]！想保护你那聪明的大脑吗？那你一定想要我的一顶头盔。

english: I'll have a look.
translation: 我看看。

english: Good choice.
translation: 好选择。

english: I'm good.
translation: 我没事。

english: If you're sure.
translation: 如果你确定的话。

english: I'll have a look.
translation: 我看看。

english: I'm good.
translation: 我没事。

english: Greetings stranger. If you wish to browse my wares, you will need to be more favoured by the people of Arceuus.
translation: 问候陌生人。如果你想浏览我的商品，你需要获得阿西乌斯人更多的好感度。

english: What do you require, traveller? I deal in runes.
translation: 你需要什么，旅行者？我做符石生意。

english: Let's see what you've got.
translation: 看看你有什么。

english: I don't need anything.
translation: 我什么都不需要。

english: Let's see what you've got.
translation: 看看你有什么。

english: I don't need anything.
translation: 我什么都不需要。

english: Hello, Tiadeche.
translation: 你好，蒂亚德切。

english: Hello, Bwana! Would you like to buy some Karambwan?
translation: 你好，老爷！你想买些卡拉姆班鱼吗？

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: Very well. Let me know if you change your mind.
translation: 很好。如果你改变主意告诉我。

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: Can I buy a ticket?
translation: 我能买张票吗？

english: There's no need. Under our agreement with the Dorgeshuun, you get free train travel in return for services rendered.
translation: 没必要。根据我们与多格舒恩的协议，作为提供服务的回报，你可以免费乘坐火车。

english: Can I buy a ticket?
translation: 我能买张票吗？

english: You don't need to buy a ticket! You're [player name]! Without you, this train wouldn't exist!
translation: 你不需要买票！你是 [player name]！没有你，这列火车就不存在！

english: Just board the train and wait for it to travel to Keldagrim.
translation: 直接上车，等它开往凯尔达格林城。

english: Hi. What are you doing out here?
translation: 嗨。你在这里做什么？

english: Oh, just looking out at the tide...
translation: 哦，只是在看看潮汐……

english: What tide?
translation: 什么潮汐？

english: Is that a boat I see in the distance?
translation: 远处那是艘船吗？

english: It's great, isn't it?
translation: 很棒，不是吗？

english: Hello. Do you wish me to exchange banknotes for you? I charge only 5 coins for each banknote.
translation: 你好。你想让我帮你兑换银行票据吗？每张票据我只收5金币。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Hand me the banknotes you wish me to exchange.
translation: 把你想让我兑换的银行票据给我。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: I am Tiles. I can exchange banknotes for real items. Do you want any banknotes converted?
translation: 我是泰尔斯。我可以把银行票据兑换成实物。你想兑换任何银行票据吗？

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: You poke 10 flashing pillars, right? You NOT poke other pillars, right? Okay, you go play now.
translation: 你戳10根闪烁的柱子，对吧？你不戳其他柱子，对吧？好的，你去玩吧。

english: Err...what am I supposed to do here again?
translation: 呃……我该在这里做什么来着？

english: You gotta poke dem pillars.
translation: 你得戳那些柱子。

english: What? All of them?
translation: 什么？所有的？

english: No, no. If you poke dem ones dat don't have a dem flashin' rings, den dats bad.
translation: 不，不。如果你戳那些没有闪烁光环的柱子，那就糟了。

english: So I have to poke the pillars that are flashing?
translation: 所以我得戳那些闪烁的柱子？

english: Yer. You do dat ten times, you get prize.
translation: 是的。你做十次，就能得到奖品。

english: So...I'm free to go now, right?
translation: 那么……我现在可以走了，对吧？

english: Yer, get going. We get break now.
translation: 是的，走吧。我们现在休息。

english: Ok. Err...have a nice break.
translation: 好的。呃……祝你休息愉快。

english: Hey, how's it go...
translation: 嘿，进展如……

english: Apples, trout. Maybe some spi... Oh sorry matey, busy getting the grub together for our next voyage. If ye need anything, talk t' Captain Pudi over by the dock.
translation: 苹果，鳟鱼。也许一些香……哦抱歉伙计，正忙着为下次航行准备食物。如果你需要什么，去码头跟普迪船长谈谈。

english: I wonder what jelly would be like with cooked eels? Maybe a pie of some sor... Oh hey there stranger. What can I do for ye?
translation: 我在想果冻配熟鳗鱼会怎么样？也许是某种派……哦嘿陌生人。我能为你做什么？

english: Crab meat would do wonders in an admir... Oh hey there stranger. What can I do for ye?
translation: 蟹肉在海军……哦嘿陌生人。我能为你做什么？

english: Maybe some pineapple. That could enhance the flavour of a summer pi... Oh hey there stranger. What can I do for ye?
translation: 也许一些菠萝。那能提升夏日派的口味……哦嘿陌生人。我能为你做什么？

english: How was your last fishing trip?
translation: 你上次钓鱼之旅怎么样？

english: 'Twas a good and bad trip.
translation: 那是次好坏参半的旅程。

english: During the trip, I was cookin' up a nice fish pie for the crew. But then a storm 'it the ship.
translation: 旅途中，我正为船员们烤一个美味的鱼派。但随后风暴袭击了船。

english: Water came a spewin' through the windows and with the water came some glowing fish. It flew straight into me cooking pie.
translation: 水从窗户喷涌而入，随着水进来了一些发光的鱼。它直接飞进了我正在烤的派里。

english: I couldn't 'elp it, I 'ad to try it... The taste was amazin'! Never 'ad anythin' like it in me life before.
translation: 我忍不住，不得不尝尝……味道太棒了！我这辈子从没吃过这样的东西。

english: Maybe one day I will make that amazing pie again.
translation: 也许有一天我会再做那个神奇的派。

english: That sounds great. If you ever do make it again, tell me the recipe so I can make it myself please.
translation: 听起来很棒。如果你真的再做一次，请告诉我食谱，这样我也能自己做。

english: Me recipes are a secret and I am not sharin' 'em with anyone!
translation: 我的食谱是秘密，我不跟任何人分享！

english: On with me story. after trying that amazing pie, the floor boards above fell down and the ship's wheel knocked me out.
translation: 继续我的故事。尝了那个神奇的派后，上面的地板塌了下来，船舵把我撞晕了。

english: I woke up in Al Kharid with the others. Pudi and some local fisherfolk helped us out and now we're 'ere. Lots o' mouths t' feed now!
translation: 我和其他人一起在阿尔卡里德城醒来。普迪和一些当地渔民帮助了我们，现在我们在这里。现在有很多张嘴要喂！

english: Anythin' else ya be needin'?
translation: 还需要别的吗？

english: You really like cooking. Can you share any recipes with me?
translation: 你真的很喜欢烹饪。能跟我分享些食谱吗？

english: Unfortunately for ye, me recipes are a secret and I am not sharin' 'em with anyone!
translation: 不幸的是，我的食谱是秘密，我不跟任何人分享！

english: Aw, please tell me! I've always wanted to try sailor food.
translation: 哎呀，请告诉我！我一直想尝尝水手的食物。

english: Ye best become a sailor then.
translation: 那你最好去当个水手。

english: Got any tips for fighting Tempoross?
translation: 有什么对抗海灵的建议吗？

english: Ye should bring a harpoon t' fish for them harpoonfish. They be very effective against the beast.
translation: 你应该带把鱼叉去钓那些叉鱼。它们对那头野兽非常有效。

english: Ye could try cooking them too. Helps 'em shoot true.
translation: 你也可以试着把它们煮熟。这有助于更精准地射击。

english: I have to go.
translation: 我得走了。

english: See ya around!
translation: 回头见！

english: Would you care for an egg in this difficult time?
translation: 在这艰难时刻，你想来个蛋吗？

english: A damp egg! What a tragedy!
translation: 一个湿蛋！真是个悲剧！

english: What?
translation: 什么？

english: A fate most foul has befallen our eggy friend 'ere!
translation: 我们这位蛋朋友遭遇了最恶劣的命运！

english: Wait a min-
translation: 等一下——

english: This egg, once so full o' promise, set out on an adventure t' become somethin' more...
translation: 这颗蛋，曾经充满希望，踏上冒险之旅想要变得更好……

english: ...alas, it fell victim t' the briny depths thanks t' Tempoross. That fiend!
translation: ……唉，多亏了海灵，它成了咸水深处的受害者。那个恶魔！

english: Perhaps a cake, this egg dreamt t' be? We shall never know, for a damp egg is only good as a solemn reminder of the things we've lost.
translation: 也许这颗蛋梦想成为蛋糕？我们将永远无法知晓，因为湿蛋只能作为我们要失去的东西的庄严提醒。

english: Wow. You really like eggs, don't you?
translation: 哇。你真的很喜欢蛋，对吧？

english: Aye, they truly are the most majestic an' versatile item in the culinary world. An inspiration t' us all!
translation: 是的，它们确实是烹饪界最宏伟且多才多艺的物品。是我们所有人的灵感来源！

english: Timallus sniffles.
translation: 蒂马勒斯抽了抽鼻子。

english: There there, it'll be okay.
translation: 没事没事，会好起来的。

english: Thank ye, friend.
translation: 谢谢你，朋友。

english: Oh a gloriously dry egg! What a gift!
translation: 哦，一颗光荣的干蛋！真是份大礼！

english: Thank ye!
translation: 谢谢！

english: You're welcome!
translation: 不客气！

english: Would you like a salmon?
translation: 你想要条三文鱼吗？

english: Wha' am I supposed t' do wit' a raw salmon?
translation: 我拿生三文鱼能干嘛？

english: Cook and eat it, of course.
translation: 当然是煮熟了吃。

english: Do I look like some sort o' on demand chef t' ye.
translation: 我看起来像是那种随叫随到的厨师吗？

english: Fine, I'll take my salmon elsewhere then.
translation: 好吧，那我带着我的三文鱼去别处了。

english: Would you like a freshly cooked salmon?
translation: 你想要条刚煮好的三文鱼吗？

english: Aye, I be very hungry today. Skipped breakfast.
translation: 是的，我今天很饿。没吃早饭。

english: Thanks a lot, landlubber. I appreciate it.
translation: 多谢了，旱鸭子。我很感激。

english: What do you make of this egg?
translation: 你觉得这蛋怎么样？

english: AAAHH!!
translation: 啊啊啊！！

english: What is it?
translation: 怎么了？

english: That egg!
translation: 那个蛋！

english: 'Tis horrifyin'!
translation: 太恐怖了！

english: Just looks like an egg to me...
translation: 在我看来就是个蛋……

english: Cautiously, Timallus peers more closely at the egg before recoiling suddenly.
translation: 蒂马勒斯小心翼翼地凑近看了看蛋，然后突然退缩。

english: Shiver me timbers!
translation: 吓死我了！

english: That there egg that ye unfortunately possess 'as a spooky soul.
translation: 你不幸拥有的那颗蛋有个幽灵般的灵魂。

english: Surely an egg doesn't have a soul-
translation: 蛋肯定没有灵魂——

english: An omen, perhaps? Is our fight against Tempoross about t' take a turn for the worse?
translation: 也许是预兆？我们要对抗海灵的战斗要恶化了吗？

english: Perhaps it's even bigger than that...
translation: 也许比那更严重……

english: Look, I was just given this egg as a trick while Trick- or-Treating. It's just a joke!
translation: 听着，我只是在“不给糖就捣蛋”时被恶作剧给了这个蛋。只是个玩笑！

english: A cruel trick is what it be! I wouldn't trust whoever gave yetthat... thing!
translation: 这是个残酷的恶作剧！我不会信任任何给你那个……东西的人！

english: There be shady dealings goin' on there, me friend, mark me words!
translation: 那里有不可告人的勾当，我的朋友，记住我的话！

english: If you say so...
translation: 既然你这么说……

english: How was your last fishing trip?
translation: 你上次钓鱼怎么样？

english: You really like cooking. Can you share any recipes with me?
translation: 你真的很喜欢烹饪。能跟我分享些食谱吗？

english: Got any tips for fighting Tempoross?
translation: 有什么对抗海灵的技巧吗？

english: I have to go.
translation: 我得走了。

english: Good Day, how can I help you?
translation: 你好，有什么能帮你的？

english: I was just wondering what you were up to.
translation: 我只是想知道你在忙什么。

english: I work for Aluft Aloft Gnome Food Delivery Service. It's a growing business you know. We get more customers every day!
translation: 我为阿鲁夫特‧阿洛夫特地精送餐服务工作。你知道，这是家成长中的企业。我们每天都有更多顾客！

english: So do you have any spare jobs then?
translation: 那你有什么闲职吗？

english: Aluft Gianne jnr. is in charge - he'll be able to help you.
translation: 小阿鲁夫特‧吉安负责——他能帮你。

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

english: Have a nice day.
translation: 祝你有美好的一天。

english: Ah, [adventurer/wayfarer/Nobody], welcome back to Tai Bwo Wannai.
translation: 啊，[冒险者/旅人/无名氏]，欢迎回到泰博瓦纳村。

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: It should be clear to anyone that I am the chief of Tai Bwo Wannai. I ensure that things run smoothly in this village.
translation: 任何人都应该清楚我是泰博瓦纳村的首领。我确保这个村庄运转顺畅。

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Is there anything interesting to do here?
translation: 这里有什么有趣的事可做吗？

english: Yes Bwana, plenty of interesting things to do. Firstly you could make an effort to tidy the place up a little. Equip yourself with a machete and start cutting down the jungle that seems to be growing all around here.
translation: 是的先生，有很多有趣的事可做。首先你可以努力把这地方稍微整理一下。装备一把砍刀，开始砍伐周围似乎到处生长的丛林。

english: Go and have a chat with Murcaily for information, he's tending the hardwood grove to the east of here.
translation: 去和穆尔凯利聊聊获取信息，他正在照料东边的硬木林。

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
translation: 我一直在村子里做些工作。

english: That's good Bwana, I would hate to think that you were just being lazy while you're in my kingdom!
translation: 那很好先生，我可不想觉得你在我的王国里只是在偷懒！

english: I'm just passing through.
translation: 我只是路过。

english: Ahhhhhhhh - Get away from me you beast!
translation: 啊啊啊啊——离我远点你这野兽！

english: What's the problem....oh, I'm wearing this big scary mask! I'd better take it off before I start talking to the natives.
translation: 出什么问题了……哦，我戴着这个可怕的大面具！我最好在开始和当地人说话前把它摘下来。

english: Waahhhhh! - It's da evil broodoo beast come ta eat my very soul!
translation: 哇啊啊——是邪恶的布鲁多兽来吃我的灵魂了！

english: Ahhhhhhhh - It's a monster!
translation: 啊啊啊啊——是怪物！

english: Ahhhhhhhh!!
translation: 啊啊啊啊！！

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Is there anything interesting to do here?
translation: 这里有什么有趣的事可做吗？

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
translation: 我一直在村子里做些工作。

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: I'm just passing through.
translation: 我只是路过。

english: Heya! What can I get you?
translation: 嘿！你要点什么？

english: What ales are you serving?
translation: 你供应什么麦芽酒？

english: Well, we've got Asgarnian Ale, Wizard's Mind Bomb and Dwarven Stout, all for only 3 coins.
translation: 嗯，我们有阿斯加尼亚麦酒、法师心灵炸弹和矮人黑啤酒，都只要3枚金币。

english: One Asgarnian Ale, please.
translation: 请给我一杯阿斯加尼亚麦酒。

english: I said 3 coins! You haven't got 3 coins!
translation: 我说了3枚金币！你没有3枚金币！

english: Sorry, I'll come back another day.
translation: 抱歉，我改天再来。

english: Thanks, Tina.
translation: 谢谢，蒂娜。

english: I'll try the Mind Bomb.
translation: 我要试试心灵炸弹。

english: Can I have a Dwarven Stout?
translation: 能给我一杯矮人黑啤酒吗？

english: I don't feel like any of those.
translation: 我都不想喝那些。

english: I've got this beer glass...
translation: 我有这个啤酒杯……

english: We'll buy it for a couple of coins if you're interested.
translation: 如果你有兴趣，我们会花几枚金币买下它。

english: Okay, sure.
translation: 好的，当然。

english: There you go.
translation: 给，拿好。

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！

english: No thanks, I like empty beer glasses.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我喜欢空啤酒杯。

english: I've got these beer glasses...
translation: 我有这些啤酒杯……

english: Ooh, we'll buy those off you if you're interested. 2 coins per glass.
translation: 哦，如果你有兴趣我们会买下它们。每个杯子2枚金币。

english: What's this about the party room?
translation: 派对房间是怎么回事？

english: Have you heard? Someone's planning a big party!
translation: 你听说了吗？有人正计划办个大派对！

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你什么意思？

english: Someone's put something very valuable into the party room drop chest! If you go to the party room and pull the lever you might have a chance to get it!
translation: 有人把非常贵重的东西放进了派对房间的掉落箱！如果你去派对房间拉下拉杆，你可能有机会得到它！

english: It could be your lucky day!
translation: 这可能是你的幸运日！

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！

english: No thanks, I don't need that.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我不需要那个。

english: Party! Party!
translation: 派对！派对！

english: Something's happening in the party room!
translation: 派对房间有事发生！

english: Everyone get to the party room!
translation: 大家都去派对房间！

english: What's happening in the party room?
translation: 派对房间发生了什么事？

english: Someone's having a big party!
translation: 有人正在办大派对！

english: Get to the party room NOW!
translation: 现在就去派对房间！

english: Get to the party room!
translation: 去派对房间！

english: Get to the party room quick!
translation: 快去派对房间！

english: Big value items in the party room now!
translation: 派对房间现在有高价值物品！

english: Quick! Get to the party room!
translation: 快！去派对房间！

english: One Asgarnian Ale, please.

english: Fair enough. I'll be here if you change your mind.
translation: 好吧。如果你改变主意，我还会在这里。

english: What's the Kourend Council?
translation: 什么是库兰德议会？

english: Although it's called a kingdom, Great Kourend hasn't actually had a king for many years. These days Kourend is a republic and it is ruled by the Kourend Council.
translation: 虽然被称为王国，但大库兰德王国实际上已经很多年没有国王了。如今库兰德王国是一个共和国，由库兰德王国议会统治。

english: The Council consists of four councillors who are elected by the people every four years. The current councillors are Councillor Hughes, Councillor Unkar, Councillor Orson and Councillor Andrews.
translation: 议会由四名议员组成，每四年由人民选举产生。现任议员是休斯议员、昂卡尔议员、奥森议员和安德鲁斯议员。

english: I see. So what are you investigating?
translation: 我明白了。那你在调查什么？

english: I'm looking for a quest.
translation: 我在找任务。

english: Well there is something I could use some help with. However, you're not really the person I need for this task.
translation: 嗯，确实有件事我需要帮助。不过，你并不是我这项任务需要的人。

english: Well there is something I could use some help with. I'm here on behalf of the Kourend Council to investigate some unusual happenings in Port Piscarilius.
translation: 嗯，确实有件事我需要帮助。我代表库兰德议会来调查皮斯卡里琉斯港的一些异常事件。

english: Well good luck with that.
translation: 那祝你好运。

english: Nothing thanks.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。

english: Very well. Until next time.
translation: 很好。下次再见。

english: Let's talk about my quest.
translation: 我们来谈谈我的任务。

english: Very well. How goes things?
translation: 很好。进展如何？

english: I haven't had any luck finding the Queen of Thieves. However, I've come across this letter which you might find interesting.
translation: 我还没找到盗贼女王。不过，我发现了这封信，你可能会感兴趣。

english: Blimey! Forget the Queen of Thieves. If this letter is to be believed, Councillor Hughes is working with those vile Disciples of Yama. I must report this to the council immediately.
translation: 天哪！别管盗贼女王了。如果这封信属实，休斯议员正在与那些邪恶的阎魔信徒合作。我必须立即向议会报告此事。

english: Great! So can I have a reward?
translation: 太好了！那我能有奖励吗？

english: You've done a great service to the people of Kourend. As I'm sure you know, there is no greater reward than the satisfaction of a job well done.
translation: 你为库兰德人民做了件大好事。正如你肯定知道的，没有比圆满完成工作更大的奖励了。

english: Now be on your way. I have a lot of work to do.
translation: 现在你走吧。我还有很多工作要做。

english: What do you know of the Disciples of Yama?
translation: 你对阎魔信徒了解多少？

english: They're a group of deranged cultists that worship some sort of demon. They're not a big threat compared to the lizardmen, but they're still an enemy to Kourend.
translation: 他们是一群崇拜某种恶魔的疯狂邪教徒。与蜥蜴人相比，他们不算大威胁，但仍然是库兰德王国的敌人。

english: And Councillor Hughes is helping them? That's not good.
translation: 而休斯议员在帮助他们？这可不好。

english: Indeed. I must report this to the Council immediately.
translation: 确实。我必须立即向议会报告此事。

english: So can I have a reward?
translation: 那我能有奖励吗？

english: Hello Tomas. How's things?
translation: 你好，托马斯。最近怎么样？

english: Very well thank you. My work in bringing down Councillor Hughes means that I'm finally starting to get the recognition that I deserve.
translation: 非常好，谢谢。我扳倒休斯议员的工作意味着我终于开始获得应得的认可。

english: But that was my work!
translation: 但那是我的工作！

english: Yes, yes, very good job. I'll make sure to mention you in my acceptance speech when I'm voted in as her replacement.
translation: 是的，是的，干得很好。当我被选为她的继任者时，我一定会在就职演说中提到你。

english: Hello Tomas.
translation: 你好，托马斯。

english: Oh... Hello there.
translation: 哦……你好。

english: Something wrong?
translation: 有什么不对吗？

english: I'm ruined. Everything was perfect under the Council, but now I'm right back in the dirt again.
translation: 我完了。在议会统治下一切都很完美，但现在我又回到了底层。

english: You were very close to the Council. You should be glad you got to keep your job at all.
translation: 你与议会关系密切。你应该庆幸还能保住工作。

english: But I didn't keep my job. Now I spend every day doing boring administrative work. It's a nightmare.
translation: 但我没保住工作。现在我每天做着无聊的行政工作。简直是噩梦。

english: Come now Tomas, it can't be all bad. Show a little enthusiasm.
translation: 得了吧托马斯，不可能全那么糟。表现出点热情来。

english: Eugh.
translation: 呃。

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Anything I can help with?
translation: 有什么我能帮忙的吗？

english: Absolutely.
translation: 当然。

english: Nah.
translation: 不了。

english: What's the Kourend Council?
translation: 什么是库兰德议会？

english: I'm looking for a quest.
translation: 我在找任务。

english: What are you investigating?
translation: 你在调查什么？

english: Well good luck with that.
translation: 那祝你好运。

english: Nothing thanks.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。

english: Let's talk about my quest.
translation: 我们来谈谈我的任务。

english: Great! So can I have a reward?
translation: 太好了！那我能有奖励吗？

english: What do you know of the Disciples of Yama?
translation: 你对阎魔信徒了解多少？

english: Say, aren't you a bit tall for a dwarf?
translation: 话说，你作为矮人是不是有点太高了？

english: Was there anything in particular you wanted?
translation: 你有什么特别想要的吗？

english: I'd like a quest please.
translation: 我想要个任务，谢谢。

english: I have nothing to do for you, I'm afraid. Ask around town, though, there are always people who need some work done around here.
translation: 恐怕我没什么能为你做的。不过在镇上打听打听吧，这里总有人需要帮忙干活。

english: No, I just like talking to strangers.
translation: 不，我只是喜欢和陌生人聊天。

english: Well I don't.
translation: 可我不喜欢。

english: I'd like a quest please.
translation: 我想要个任务，谢谢。

english: No, I just like talking to strangers.
translation: 不，我只是喜欢和陌生人聊天。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: So how's life as a pirate?
translation: 海盗日子过得怎么样？

english: What kind of question is that? How's life as a... I dunno. Whatever it is that you do for a living.
translation: 这算什么问题？生活怎么样……我也不知道。就像你靠什么谋生一样。

english: I'm a freelance troubleshooter.
translation: 我是个自由接活的麻烦解决者。

english: What does that entail then?
translation: 那具体是做什么的？

english: Mostly killing things for money and delivering items around the planet for people.
translation: 主要是拿钱办事杀人，帮人把物品送到世界各地。

english: I collect stuff.
translation: 我喜欢收集东西。

english: So how's that life?
translation: 那生活怎么样？

english: Can't complain, can't complain...
translation: 还过得去啦……

english: Well, there you go.
translation: 给，拿好。

english: Aren't you a little short for a pirate?
translation: 你作为海盗是不是有点太矮了？

english: My mother was a gnome. Apparently it was a very painful birth.
translation: 我的母亲是地精，据说她生我时非常痛苦。

english: More info than I wanted, thanks!
translation: 这信息我可不想听，谢了！

english: Sorry, can't stop, the Captain will have my guts for garters if he catches me slacking off talking to the stowaway.
translation: 不能再聊了，要是船长发现我在偷懒跟偷渡客聊天，会把我大卸八块的！

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard!
translation: 我不是偷渡客！我是被邀请上船的！

english: Yeah, whatever [guy/lady], it doesn't really matter who you are I'll get in trouble!
translation: 随便啦 [guy/lady]，不管你是谁，反正我都会惹上麻烦！

english: You know, I've always wondered what life as a pirate actually entails.
translation: 你知道吗，我一直想知道海盗生活到底是怎样的。

english: Well, at the moment it mostly involves being asked random questions by a stowaway.
translation: 嗯，目前主要是被一个偷渡客问各种问题。

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard! By Lokar! Ask him!
translation: 我不是偷渡客！我是被邀请上船的！洛卡尔邀请的！你问他！

english: Hey, whatever [love/pal]. Just make sure the captain doesn't catch you, pirates don't like stowaways much.
translation: 随便啦 [love/pal]。只要别让船长抓到你就行，海盗都不太喜欢偷渡客。

english: Ah, good day to you [milady/sirrah]! Your face is unfamiliar, did you perhaps join us aboard the ship at Lunar Isle?
translation: 你好 [milady/sirrah]！你的面孔很陌生，你该不会是在月亮岛登上我们船的吧？

english: No, Lokar offered me a lift in Rellekka actually.
translation: 不，其实是洛卡尔在雷勒卡城让我搭的便船。

english: Oh, really? You don't look like a Fremennik to me!
translation: 真的吗？但你看起来不像费明尼克人啊！

english: Well... I kind of am, and I kind of aren't. It's a long story.
translation: 这个嘛……我算是，也不算吧。说来话长。

english: Sorry I don't have time to hear it then! See you around young fremennik-who-is-not-really-a-fremennik!
translation: 那抱歉我没时间听了！回头见啦，你这个不算真正费明尼克的年轻人！

english: 'Bye.
translation: 再见。

english: Brrrr! Its cold up here!
translation: 嘶！上面好冷！

english: You think this is cold? Up by Acheron it gets so cold that when you talk you see the words freeze in the air in front of you!
translation: 你觉得这算冷？在阿刻戎那边，冷到你连说出的话语都能冻在空中！

english: REALLY?
translation: 真的吗？

english: Nah, not really. I was exaggerating for humourous effect. It is very very cold though!
translation: 哈，当然不是真的。我只是为了搞笑夸张了一下。不过那里确实非常非常冷！

english: Hello to you too.
translation: 也向你问好。

english: Yar! We be pirates, yar! Avast, ye scurvy land-lubbing lychee!
translation: 呀！我们是海盗！停下，你这个可怜的旱鸭子荔枝 (羞辱性称呼)！

english: Please don't talk like that, it is extremely irritating.
translation: 请不要那样说话，这很令人討厌的。

english: Also, please don't call me a lychee, whatever that may be.
translation: 还有你别叫我荔枝 (羞辱性称呼)，不管那是什么。

english: Oh. Okay. Sorry.
translation: 好的，抱歉。

english: ARGH! SOUND THE ALARM! STOWAWAY ON BOARD! STOWAWAY ON BOARD!
translation: 啊！拉警报！船上有偷渡客！船上有偷渡客！

english: No! I'm not a stowaway! Honest! I was invited here!
translation: 我不是偷渡客，真的！我是被邀请来的！

english: Oh, sorry, my mistake then.
translation: 抱歉，那我弄错了。

english: You must admit you do look a lot like a stowaway though.
translation: 不过你得承认，你看起来确实很像偷渡客。

english: Why, what do they usually look like?
translation: 那他们通常长什么样？

english: Erm... I've never actually met one...
translation: 呃……其实我从没见过真正的偷渡客……

english: Okay then...
translation: 那好吧……

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: So... You're a pirate, huh?
translation: 那么……你是海盗，对吧？

english: It's what it says on my pay-packet at the end of the month.
translation: 我月底工资单上就这么写的。

english: How's that working out for you?
translation: 干得怎么样？

english: Pretty good so far. All the grog and loot that we can plunder, plus full medical including dental.
translation: 到目前为止还不错。有喝不完的格罗格酒和抢不完的战利品，甚至还有全套医疗保障，包括牙科。

english: You mean you have insurance?
translation: 你是说有保险？

english: Not as such. If any of us get sick we kidnap a doctor and don't let him go until we're better.
translation: 倒也不是。要是我们谁生病了，就绑架个医生，直到我们康复才放他走。

english: You'd be surprised what an incentive for expert health care that is.
translation: 说出来你可能不信，这可是让医疗水准提升的一大动力。

english: I can imagine.
translation: 这倒不难想象。

english: Hello there. So what brings you aboard the Lady Zay?
translation: 你好啊，是什么风把你吹上赛夫人号的？

english: Well, I was planning on visiting the Moon Clan, but I have to say your ship is very impressive.
translation: 我本来打算去拜访月氏族，但不得不说你们的船令人印象深刻。

english: Aye, she's a beauty alright! The Lady Zay has been my home for many hard months, through storm and sun, and she always gets us to here we were headed!
translation: 是啊，她确实是个美人！赛夫人号作为我的家陪伴我度过了许多艰苦岁月，风雨无阻，她总是能把我们送到目的地！

english: Yes, she's certainly one of the finest boats I've seen on my travels!
translation: 是的，她确实是我旅行中见过的最棒的船之一！

english: That she is [lad/lass], that she is.
translation: 确实是啊 [lad/lass]。

english: Nilsal, traveller. You walk on holy ground. Please ensure you are respectful.
translation: 你好，旅行者。你正踏足圣地，请保持恭敬。

english: Nilsal, traveller. You walk on holy ground. Please ensure you are respectful.
translation: 你好，旅行者。你正踏足圣地，请保持恭敬。

english: I'm sorry, traveller, but access into the Crypt of Tonali is restricted. You may not enter.
translation: 抱歉，旅行者，但托纳利墓穴的进入是受限的。你不能进入。

english: Nilsal, adventurer. Good work in dealing with those cultist!
translation: 你好，冒险者。处理那些邪教徒干得好！

english: Nilsal, adventurer. I hope you are doing well?
translation: 你好，冒险者。希望你一切都好？

english: Very well, thank you.
translation: 非常好，谢谢。

english: Glad to hear it.
translation: 很高兴听到。

english: Ah, 'tis a foine day to be sure! Were yez wantin' me to store yer tools, or maybe ye might be wantin' yer stuff back from me?
translation: 啊，今天真是个好日子！你是想让我帮你存放工具，还是想把东西从我这里取回去？

english: Why are you here in Weiss?
translation: 你为什么在魏斯聚落？

english: An' why would I not be here? Now that there be farming patches, there'll be folk needing a leprechaun to hold their stuff! So, dod ye want to be using the store?
translation: 那我为什么不在这里呢？既然有了种植地，自然有人需要小精灵帮忙保管东西！所以，你想使用仓库吗？

english: Can you tell me about the Lost City?
translation: 你能和我说说失落之城的事吗？

english: Nay, ye be wantin' to ask Shamus if ye wants to know about the Lost City. He be living up a tree somewhere near Draynor Village. Last I heard he were wailin' about some biggun tryin' to chop his tree down!
translation: 不，你想知道失落之城的事得去问沙姆斯。他住在德雷诺村附近某棵树上。上次听说他在哀嚎，说有个大块头想砍他的树！

english: What can you store?
translation: 你能存放什么？

english: We'll hold onto yer rake, yer seed dibber, yer spade, yer secateurs, yer waterin' can and yer trowel - but mind it's not one of them fancy trowels only archaeologists use!
translation: 我们可以帮你保管耙子、种植锥、铲子、修枝剪、浇水壶和泥刀——但注意，别是那种只有考古学家才用的花哨泥刀！

english: We'll take a few buckets off yer hands too, and even yer compost, supercompost an' ultracompost! Also plant cure vials.
translation: 我们也可以帮你收几个桶，甚至你的堆肥、超级堆肥和超强堆肥！还有植物治疗药剂。

english: Aside from that, if ye hands me yer farming produce, I can mebbe change it into banknotes for ye.
translation: 除此之外，如果你把农产品给我，我可以帮你换成钞票。

english: So... do ye want to be using the store?
translation: 那么……你想使用仓库吗？

english: What do you do with the tools you're storing? They can't possibly all fit in your pockets!
translation: 你存放的工具都放哪儿了？不可能都塞进你口袋里吧！

english: We leprechauns have a shed where we keep 'em. It's a magic shed, so ye can get yer items back from any of us leprechauns whenever ye want. Saves ye havin' to carry loads of stuff around the country!
translation: 我们小精灵有个棚子专门放这些。那是个魔法棚子，所以你随时可以从任何一个小精灵那里取回你的物品。省得你带着大包小包在全国跑！

english: No thanks, I'll keep hold of my stuff.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我还是自己拿着吧。

english: Ye must be dafter than ye look if ye likes luggin' yer tools everywhere ye goes!
translation: 你要是喜欢拖着工具到处跑，那脑子肯定比看起来还不好使！

english: Nay, I've got no banknotes to exchange for that item.
translation: 不，我没有可以兑换那件物品的钞票。

english: Nay, there's no such thing as a banknote for that.
translation: 不，没有那种物品的钞票。

english: That IS a banknote!
translation: 那本身就是钞票！

english: A cabbage? Don't ye go showing me yer cabbage; this whole farm stinks of the things! Take it away and get it exchanged somewhere else.
translation: 一颗卷心菜？别拿你的卷心菜给我看，整个农场都臭着这玩意儿！拿走，去别处兑换吧。

english: Ye did foine, yer'll be wanting this!
translation: 你干得不错，你会想要这个！

english: Why are you here in Weiss?
translation: 你为什么在魏斯聚落？

english: Can you tell me about the Lost City?
translation: 你能和我说说失落之城的事吗？

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: What can you store?
translation: 你能存放什么？

english: What do you do with the tools you're storing?
translation: 你存放的工具都放哪儿了？

english: No thanks, I'll keep hold of my stuff.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我还是自己拿着吧。

english: Aye, top o' th' mornin' to ya! Are ye wantin' help with th' tool store?
translation: 啊，早上好！你需要工具仓库的帮助吗？

english: Why are you sunbathing up a mountain?
translation: 你为什么在山上晒太阳？

english: We tool leprechauns work hard, that we do. An' nary a penny do we get in return. So ye cannae begrudge me mah holiday an' a wee drink or twelve!
translation: 我们工具小精灵工作很辛苦，真的。却一分钱回报都拿不到。所以你不能怪我度假喝上一两杯小酒！

english: Yes, very nice, but why are you sunbathing up a mountain? Surely a beach would be more appropriate?
translation: 是的，很不错，但你为什么在山上晒太阳？海滩不是更合适吗？

english: Ahh, but I likes th' ruggedy mountain, ye see. Also, I ha' a terrible allergy to sand.
translation: 啊，但我喜欢崎岖的山，你懂的。而且，我对沙子严重过敏。

english: Fair enough, I suppose.
translation: 好吧，我想也是。

english: So were ye wantin' help with th' tool store?
translation: 那么你需要工具仓库的帮助吗？

english: Would you like to trade?
translation: 你想交易吗？

english: Ach! Can ye no' leave a body to ha' a little peace? Very well, I have a bit o' stuff to trade with ye. But don't be expectin' yerself any discounts.
translation: 唉！就不能让人清净会儿吗？好吧，我有点东西可以和你交易，但别指望有折扣。

english: Are you going to move that other deckchair?
translation: 你打算挪开那把躺椅吗？

english: An' get ambushed by that damn bird again? Nae, I'll be keeping my distance, thank ye very much!
translation: 然后再被那只该死的鸟伏击？不，我会保持距离，多谢了！

english: Plus, if ye've got a farmin' patch up 'ere, th' union boys'll want me posted nearer it.
translation: 而且，如果你在这里有种地，工会的小伙子们会希望我驻守得更近一些。

english: I'm not one of them farmin' leprechauns! I don't want yer garbage!
translation: 我不是那种种田小精灵！我不想要你的垃圾！

english: Why are you sunbathing up a mountain?
translation: 你为什么在山上晒太阳？

english: Would you like to trade?
translation: 你想交易吗？

english: Are you going to move that other deckchair?
translation: 你打算挪开那把躺椅吗？

english: Aye? What do ye need?
translation: 嗯？你需要什么？

english: Tell me about this mine.
translation: 跟我讲讲这个矿。

english: 's a sulphur mine. Ye get sulphur here. For making the dynamite, ye know? Folks use it in the blast mine. Watch the poison gas clouds, though - they'll choke ye.
translation: 是个硫磺矿，可以在这里挖硫磺，用来制作炸药，懂吧？人们在爆破矿场用它。不过小心毒气云——会呛死你的。

english: Grab yerself a pickaxe if ye wants to mine some sulphur. Make sure ye keeps yer mouth an' nose covered too.
translation: 想挖硫磺就给自己弄把镐子。也记得捂住口鼻。

english: What have you got to trade?
translation: 你有什么可以交易的？

english: Pickaxes. For the mining. An' pots to make dynamite in.
translation: 镐子，挖矿用的。还有制作炸药的罐子。

english: Why are you called Toothy?
translation: 你为什么叫''牙牙''？

english: 'Cos of my teeth.
translation: 因为我的牙齿。

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我走了。

english: Tell me about this mine.
translation: 跟我讲讲这个矿。

english: What have you got to trade?
translation: 你有什么可以交易的？

english: Why are you called Toothy?
translation: 你为什么叫''牙牙''？

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我走了。

english: You dare disturb my rest!
translation: 你竟敢打扰我的休息！

english: You dare steal from us!
translation: 你竟敢偷我们的东西！

english: YOU ARE A TERRIBLE BARD!
translation: 你是个糟糕的吟游诗人！

english: Don't give up your day job outerlander!
translation: 外乡人，你还是别放弃本职工作吧！

english: I thought somebody was murdering a cat!
translation: 我以为有人在杀猫！

english: You know, I actually quite liked that verse...
translation: 你知道吗，我其实挺喜欢那段歌词……

english: That's kind of catchy. Irritating. But catchy.
translation: 有点洗脑，虽然烦人，但确实洗脑。

english: Hey, I've done that quest too!
translation: 嘿，我也做过那个任务！

english: I have produced better sounds in the outhouse!
translation: 我在茅房里发出的声音都比这好！

english: Your song makes no sense outerlander!
translation: 你的歌毫无意义，外乡人！

english: What kind of bard are you anyway?
translation: 你到底是什么类型的吟游诗人？

english: I have met cows more musical than you!
translation: 我见过比你更有音乐天赋的牛！

english: When do you get to the good parts?
translation: 你什么时候才能唱到精彩的部分啊？

english: would torture us so, outerlander?
translation: 为什么要这样折磨我们，外乡人？

english: Truly, this is the worst sound I have ever heard!
translation: 真的，这是我听过最难听的声音！

english: looting and drinking part?
translation: 抢掠和喝酒的部分？

english: Please tell me that was the last verse...
translation: 请告诉我那是最后一段……

english: Please... Kill me now...
translation: 求你了……直接杀了我吧……

english: You call THAT singing?
translation: 你管那叫唱歌？

english: Never before have mine ears been so offended!
translation: 我的耳朵从未受过如此冒犯！

english: Worst. Bard. EVER.
translation: 史上。最。糟糕。吟游诗人。

english: Please, ye gods! Make it stop!
translation: 求你了，诸神！让它停下来！

english: If you stopped singing
translation: 你要是能别唱了

english: The screams of my dying comrades sound better!
translation: 我垂死同伴的尖叫声都比这好听！

english: My grandmother could do better, and she is dead!
translation: 我祖母都能唱得更好，可她人都没了！

english: I do such feats before breakfast!
translation: 我早餐前就能做到这种程度！

english: Is your singing some kind of outerlander weapon?
translation: 你的歌该不会是外乡人的某种武器吧？

english: Watch yourself, outerlander.
translation: 小心点，外乡人。

english: Good day to you, [Fremennik name].
translation: 你好，[Fremennik name]。

english: Good day to you [Fremennik name]. Do you want to go to Ungael?
translation: 你好，[Fremennik name]。你想去恩盖尔吗？

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Player is transported to Ungael
translation: 玩家被传送到恩盖尔

english: Do you have any of my items?
translation: 你有我的物品吗？

english: I do have some of your items here [Fremennik name]. Try not to lose them next time.
translation: 我这里确实有一些你的物品，[Fremennik name]。下次尽量别弄丢了。

english: I'm afraid not [Fremennik name]. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.
translation: 恐怕没有，[Fremennik name]。如果我确实有你的物品，但你在领取前就死了，那它们现在已经丢失了。

english: No thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Well met [Fremennik name]. Do you want to return to Rellekka?
translation: 幸会，[Fremennik name]。你想返回雷勒卡城吗？

english: Player is transported to Rellekka
translation: 玩家被传送到雷勒卡城

english: I'm afraid I don't have anything for you [Fremennik name]. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.
translation: 恐怕我没有什么能给你的，[Fremennik name]。如果我确实有你的物品，但你在领取前就死了，那它们现在已经丢失了。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Do you have any of my items?
translation: 你有我的物品吗？

english: No thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Hi there. So much to see here!
translation: 你好啊。这里可看的东西真多！

english: Yep, could be looking all day!
translation: 是啊，看一整天都行！

english: Updated any displays yet?
translation: 更新过任何展品了吗？

english: Yes, I just learned more about some priestly warriors and a staff of the gods.
translation: 是的，我刚了解了更多关于祭司战士和神之法杖的事。

english: Sounds fun, how did you do that?
translation: 听起来很有趣，你是怎么做到的？

english: Ahh, I'm big on quests me, love questing. So when I've done one, I check here with 'Historian' Minas to see if I can help the Museum out with some information. Sometimes they already know it, or don't want to know,
translation: 我特别喜欢做任务。所以每次完成任务后，我都会来找''历史学家''米纳斯，看看能不能用任务所得帮到博物馆。有时他们已经知道了，

english: and sometimes it earns me a reward or two.
translation: 或者不感兴趣，但有时也能让我拿到一两个奖励。

english: That sounds really good. Perhaps I should do the same!
translation: 听起来真不错。也许我也该这样做！

english: You should, as well as everything else there is here in the Museum. Did you know they have a really fun- looking display down in the basement? I love monkeys.
translation: 你应该试试，博物馆里其他展品也值得看看。你知道地下室有个看起来特别有趣的展品吗？我可喜欢猴子了。

english: I'll check it out. Got to get going now, nice talking to you.
translation: 我会去看看。现在我得走了，和你聊天很愉快。

english: Have a good day!
translation: 祝你今天愉快！

english: Hi there!
translation: 你好！

english: Hello, what are you doing here?
translation: 你好，你在这里做什么？

english: Oh, just taking a look at these displays. I'm a bit of a history buff.
translation: 哦，只是看看这些展品。我有点历史迷。

english: Really? Tell me something I didn't know!
translation: 真的吗？告诉我一些我不知道的事！

english: Well, did you know that Bob the Cat is... no, no... you'd never believe me anyway.
translation: 嗯，你知道猫鲍勃是……不，不……反正你也不会相信我。

english: He's what? Tell me!
translation: 他是什么？告诉我！

english: No, no. Couldn't possibly ruin the surprise.
translation: 不，不。可不能破坏惊喜。

english: ARG! Tell me!
translation: 啊！告诉我！

english: If you really want to know, go talk to Unferth in his house in Burthorpe.
translation: 如果你真想知道，去布斯索普找昂弗斯聊聊。

english: Hi!
translation: 嗨！

english: Oh, hello. I was just looking at this display here.
translation: 你好，我只是在看看这个展品。

english: Anything interesting?
translation: 有什么有趣的吗？

english: Yes, one I just updated by talking to 'Historian' Minas. I'm a bit of a quester you see.
translation: 是的，我刚跟''历史学家''米纳斯聊完更新了一个。你看，我这人就爱做任务。

english: Okay, I'll let you get on then.
translation: 好的，那我就不打扰你了。

english: Hmm, yes. Okay. Don't forget to check out the Natural History exhibit - you could learn a lot.
translation: 嗯，别忘了去看看自然历史展区——能学到不少东西呢。

english: Right, bye!
translation: 好的，再见！

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: Hi, have you seen the Dig Site displays?
translation: 嗨，你看过挖掘场展品了吗？

english: Yes, good aren't they! Have you done the quest?
translation: 是的，很棒对吧！你做过那个任务了吗？

english: Not yet.
translation: 还没。

english: Oh you should, it lets you get into that bit where they clean the finds, and you can join in!
translation: 哦你应该试试，它能让你进入他们清理发现物的区域，你可以参与其中！

english: Sounds fun, I should probably check it out.
translation: 听起来很有趣，我应该去看看。

english: Yes, I did it all.
translation: 是的，我都做完了。

english: Did you know after the quest you can get the teddy bear back by stealing it from the female student?
translation: 你知道任务完成后你可以通过从女学生那里偷回来拿回泰迪熊吗？

english: I shall have to try that sometime.
translation: 我得找个时间试试。

english: Hmm... 3rd Age.... No, no...maybe 4th...
translation: 嗯……第三纪元……不，不……也许是第四纪元……

english: Hello?
translation: 你好？

english: Yes, that's it, just like that. Mustn't forget the map either....hmm...what else?
translation: 是的，就是这样，就这样。也不能忘了地图……嗯……还有什么？

english: HELLO! Are you there?
translation: 你好！你在吗？

english: Oh, hello there. Sorry, was a bit engrosed in updating this display. I've just been out questing and thought I'd stop off here you see. It's quite rewarding too.
translation: 哦，你好。抱歉，刚才有点专注于更新这个展品。我刚做完任务，想着顺便来这里看看。也挺有回报的。

english: Yes, well, no need to ignore me.
translation: 是的，嗯，没必要无视我。

english: No offence intended, my dear chap. Just very interested in this history stuff, that's all.
translation: 无意冒犯，亲爱的伙计。只是对历史这东西很感兴趣，仅此而已。

english: Okay. Have you seen the Natural History exhibit in the basement?
translation: 好的。你看过地下室的自然历史展品了吗？

english: Oh, yes, marvellous isn't it! I particularly like the wyvern, very interesting considering they've never found a live specimen. And to think they could possibly have been flapping around at one time!
translation: 哦，是啊，太棒了对吧！我特别喜欢飞蜥，想想他们从没发现过活体标本，这就很有意思了。谁能想到它们曾经可能还在天上扑腾过呢！

english: A bit like the crazy gnomes and their gliders. Have you seen the model they have upstairs?
translation: 有点像那些疯狂地精和他们的滑翔机。你看过楼上他们做的模型吗？

english: Yes, very intricate isn't it? Worrying to think some people risk their lives in them! You wouldn't catch me up in one. Had a chat with Jacques while I was up there, the art critic...he's a bit funny in the head.
translation: 是的，非常精细对吧？想到有些人冒着生命危险坐上去就令人担忧！我可不会坐那玩意儿。我在楼上时和雅克聊了聊，那位艺术评论家……他脑子有点怪。

english: That's not very nice!
translation: 那不太好吧！

english: Well, he thinks he's going to get an entire portrait gallery to himself!
translation: 哼，他以为自己能独占一整间肖像画廊呢！

english: Who knows, the Museum just got really big and appears to have cash. They might entertain him with his very own floor - we'll see.
translation: 谁知道呢，博物馆刚扩建完，看着也挺有钱的。说不定真会给他弄个专属楼层呢——走着瞧吧。

english: I guess so. Wonder what poetry he'll come up with then! Still, I must get on with this display. See you around I hope!
translation: 我想也是。不知道他会写出什么诗来！不过，我得继续弄这个展品了。希望回头见！

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！

english: Would you look after my crops for me?
translation: 你能帮我照看作物吗？

english: You don't have a sapling planted in that patch. Plant one and I might agree to look after it for you.
translation: 那块种植地里没种树苗，你先种点什么，我才可能考虑帮你照管。

english: I don't know what you're talking about - I'm already looking after that patch for you.
translation: 我不知道你在说什么——我已经在帮你照管那块地了。

english: Oh sorry, I forgot.
translation: 哦抱歉，我忘了。

english: That patch is already fully grown! I don't know what you want me to do with it!
translation: 那块种植地的作物已经完全成熟了！我不知道你还想让我做什么！

english: Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: 你能给我一些农业建议吗？

english: You can buy all the farming tools from farming shops, which can be found close to the allotments.
translation: 所有农业工具都能在农业商店买到，这些店一般就在分配地附近。

english: Supercompost is far better than normal compost, but more expensive to make. You need to rot the right type of item; show me an item, and I'll tell you if it's super- compostable or not.
translation: 超级堆肥比普通堆肥强多了，但做起来也更费事。你得用对东西才能堆出来——拿件物品给我看看，我告诉你它能不能做成超级堆肥。

english: Tree seeds must be grown in a plantpot of soil into a sapling, and then transferred to a tree patch to continue growing to adulthood.
translation: 树木种子得先在装土的花盆里养成树苗，再移栽到树木种植地，才能继续长成大树。

english: You can put up to ten potatoes, cabbages or onions in vegetable sacks, although you can't have a mix in the same sack.
translation: 蔬菜袋里最多能装十个土豆、卷心菜或者洋葱，不过一袋里可不能混着装。

english: You can fill plantpots with soil from any empty patch, if you have a gardening trowel.
translation: 如果你有园艺铲，可以用任何空地的土壤填满花盆。

english: Bittercap mushrooms can only be grown in a special patch in Morytania, near the Mort Myre swamp. There the ground is especially dank and suited to growing poisonous fungii.
translation: 苦帽菇只能种在莫利塔尼亚、莫特迈耶沼泽附近的特殊种植地里。那里阴暗潮湿，适合毒蘑菇生长。

english: Vegetables, hops and flowers need constant watering - if you ignore my advice, you will sooner or later find yourself in possession of a dead farming patch.
translation: 蔬菜、啤酒花和花卉需要持续浇水——如果你无视我的建议，迟早你会发现自己的种植地枯死了。

english: You don't have to buy all your plantpots you know, you can make them yourself on a pottery wheel. If you're good enough at crafting, that is.
translation: 其实花盆不用全买，手艺够好的话，自己用陶轮做就行。

english: If you want to make your own sacks and baskets you'll need to use the loom that's near the Farming shop in Falador. If you're good enough at crafting, that is.
translation: 想自己做袋子和篮子的话，得去用法拉多农业商店附近的织布机，当然手艺得够好才行。

english: There are many Farming areas out there. I know of Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Kragen's area near Ardougne, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius and Alan's area in
translation: 外面有很多农业区域。我知道法拉多附近的埃尔斯坦区域、凯瑟比镇附近的丹塔拉区域、阿多尼城附近的克拉根区域、莫利塔尼亚的莱拉区域、霍西迪乌斯城的马瑞西区域，以及

english: the Farming Guild. That said, I'm sure there's plenty more that I don't know about.
translation: 农业公会的艾伦区域。话虽如此，我相信还有很多我不知道的。

english: If you want to grow fruit trees you could try a few places: Catherby, Brimhaven, Gnome Stronghold and the Farming Guild all have fruit tree patches.
translation: 如果你想种果树，可以尝试几个地方：凯瑟比镇、布尔哈文镇、地精要塞和农业公会都有果树种植地。

english: You can put up to five tomatoes, strawberries, apples, bananas or oranges into a fruit basket, although you can't have a mix in the same basket.
translation: 你可以在水果篮中最多装五个西红柿、草莓、苹果、香蕉或橙子，但不能在同一篮中混装。

english: There is a special patch for growing Belladonna - I believe that it is somewhere near Draynor Manor, where the ground is a tad 'unblessed'.
translation: 颠茄有专门的种植地——我记得是在德雷诺庄园附近，那地方的土嘛，有点''不受祝福''。

english: Applying compost to a patch will not only reduce the chance that your crops will get diseased, but you will also grow more crops to harvest.
translation: 在种植地施用堆肥不仅能降低作物生病的几率，还能让你收获更多作物。

english: The only way to cure a bush or tree of disease is to prune away the diseased leaves with a pair of secateurs. For all other crops I would just apply some plant-cure.
translation: 治疗灌木或树木疾病的唯一方法是用修枝剪剪掉病叶。对于所有其他作物，我只需施用一些植物治疗药水。

english: Hops are good for brewing ales. I believe there's a brewery up in Keldagrim somewhere, and I've heard rumours that a place called Phasmatys used to be good for that type of thing. 'Fore they all died, of course.
translation: 啤酒花适合酿造麦酒。我相信凯尔达格林城某处有个酿酒厂，我还听说一个叫法斯玛提斯的地方以前也酿造这种酒。当然那是在他们都死光之前的事了。

english: Don't just throw away your weeds after you've raked a patch - put them in a compost bin and make some compost.
translation: 耙完种植地后别直接把杂草扔掉——把它们放进堆肥箱制作堆肥。

translation: 你能卖我东西吗？

english: That depends on whether I have it to sell. What is it that you're looking for?
translation: 那得看我有没有卖的。你在找什么？

translation: 啊啊啊啊！

translation: 你杀不死亡灵，凡人！

translation: 嗨，你们供应什么麦酒？

translation: 嗯 [mister/miss]，我们的特色是阿斯加尼亚麦酒，我们还供应法师心灵炸弹和矮人黑啤酒。

translation: 啊好吧……那么嗯……灰松鼠会在树林里唱歌吗？

english: Er... nevermind.

translation: 啊，你想要吧台后面的活板门。

translation: 不……当然不会……

translation: 好的，谢谢。
