english: Hey there.
translation: 嘿。

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: Hello there! The weather here is wonderful, isn't it?
translation: 你好啊！这里的天气真棒，不是吗？

english: Hello there, or should I say nilsal?
translation: 你好。

english: I can't wait to visit the rest of the kingdom!
translation: 我迫不及待想去王国的其他地方看看！

english: Isn't this place wonderful?
translation: 这地方不是很棒吗？

english: Hi there. Hope you're enjoying your time in Varlamore.
translation: 你好。希望你在瓦拉莫尔玩得愉快。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: I'm a bold adventurer.
translation: 我是个大胆的冒险者。

english: Ah, a very noble profession.
translation: 啊，很高尚的职业。

english: Hello there, what do you do here?
translation: 你好，你在这里做什么？

english: Hi. We are in charge of this practice area.
translation: 嗨。我们负责这个练习区。

english: This is a practice area?
translation: 这是个练习区？

english: Surrounding us are four towers. Each tower contains trained archers of a different level. You'll notice it's quite a distance, so you'll need a longbow.
translation: 我们周围有四座塔。每座塔都有不同等级的训练有素的弓箭手。你会发现距离相当远，所以你需要一把长弓。

english: As you're not very skilled, so I advise you to practise on the north tower. That'll provide the best challenge for you.
translation: 由于你技能不太高，我建议你练习北塔。那会给你提供最好的挑战。

english: You seem to have some skill, so I advise you to practice on the east tower. That'll provide the best challenge for you.
translation: 你似乎有些技能，所以我建议你练习东塔。那会给你提供最好的挑战。

english: You appear to be fairly skilled with a bow, so I advise you to practice on the south tower. That'll provide the best challenge for you.
translation: 你看起来弓箭技能相当不错，所以我建议你练习南塔。那会给你提供最好的挑战。

english: Looks like you're very skilled, so I advise you to practice on the west tower. That'll provide the best challenge for you.
translation: 看起来你技能非常高超，所以我建议你练习西塔。那会给你提供最好的挑战。

english: The [north/east/south/west] tower is occupied, get them!
translation: [北/东/南/西] 塔被占领了，去解决他们！

english: The [north/east/south/west] tower is defeated! Hurray!
translation: [北/东/南/西] 塔被击败了！万岁！

english: The [north/east/south/west] tower has received reinforcements, kill them quickly!
translation: [北/东/南/西] 塔收到了增援，快消灭他们！

english: The Tower of Magic is off limits. Lord Arceuus does not wish his experiments to be disturbed.
translation: 魔法塔禁止进入。阿西乌斯领主不希望他的实验被打扰。

english: You have been granted permission to enter the Tower of Magic. Move along.
translation: 你已获得进入魔法塔的许可。请继续前进。

english: I can't talk I'm afraid. I need to time this experiment.
translation: 恐怕我不能说话。我需要给这个实验计时。

english: Please be careful near the apparatus.
translation: 请在仪器附近小心。

english: Hmmm... Maybe eye of newt will work...
translation: 嗯……也许蝾螈眼会管用……

english: It's going to be interesting to see the results of this test.
translation: 看看这次测试的结果会很有趣。

english: Hello. What are you doing here?
translation: 你好。你在这里做什么？

english: We are the tower guards - our business is our own!
translation: 我们是塔楼守卫——我们的事与你无关！

english: You can't go up there. That's private, that is.
translation: 你不能上去。那是私人区域。

english: Hello citizen!
translation: 你好，市民！

english: What do you do around here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: I'm a Town Crier. It's my job to let people know of any recent news. After all, there's all sorts of things happening around here.
translation: 我是城镇公告员。我的工作是让人们了解最近的新闻。毕竟，这里各种事情都在发生。

english: I see. See you later.
translation: 我明白了。回头见。

english: Until next time.
translation: 下次再见。

english: See you later.
translation: 回头见。

english: Hear ye! Hear ye! Player Moderators massive help to RuneSc-
translation: 听好了！听好了！玩家版主对 RuneSc——

english: Oh, hello citizen. Are you here to find out about Player Moderators? Or perhaps would you like to know about the laws of the land?
translation: 哦，你好市民。你是来了解玩家版主的吗？或者你想知道这片土地的律法？

english: Tell me about Player Moderators.
translation: 跟我讲讲玩家版主。

english: Of course. What would you like to know?
translation: 当然。你想了解什么？

english: What is a Player Moderator?
translation: 什么是玩家版主？

english: Player Moderators are normal players of the game, just like you. However, since they have shown themselves to be trustworthy and active reporters, they have been invited by Jagex to monitor the game and
translation: 玩家版主是游戏的普通玩家，和你一样。不过，由于他们表现出值得信赖且积极举报的行为，Jagex 邀请他们监督游戏，

english: take appropriate action when they see rule breaking. You can spot a Player Moderator in game by looking at the chat screen - when a Player Moderator speaks, a silver crown appears to the left of their name.
translation: 并在发现违规行为时采取适当措施。你可以在游戏中通过聊天界面识别玩家版主——当玩家版主发言时，他们的名字左侧会出现一个银色皇冠。

english: Remember, if there's not silver crown there, they are not a Player Moderator!
translation: 记住，如果没有银色皇冠，他们就不是玩家版主！

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！

english: Is there anything else you'd like to know?
translation: 还有其他你想知道的吗？

english: What can Player Moderators do?
translation: 玩家版主能做什么？

english: Player Moderators, or 'P-mods', have the ability to mute rule breakers and Jagex view their reports as a priority so that action is taken as quickly as possible. P- Mods also have access to the Player Moderator Centre.
translation: 玩家版主，或称''P 版主''，有权禁言违规者，Jagex 会优先处理他们的举报以便尽快采取行动。P 版主还可以访问玩家版主中心。

english: Within the Centre are tools to help them Moderate Old School RuneScape. These tools include dedicated forums, the Player Moderator Guidelines and the Player Moderator Code of Conduct.
translation: 中心内有帮助他们管理 Old School RuneScape 的工具。这些工具包括专属论坛、玩家版主指南和玩家版主行为准则。

english: How do I become a Player Moderator?
translation: 我如何成为玩家版主？

english: Jagex picks players who spend their time and effort to help better the Old School RuneScape community. To increase your chances of becoming a Player Moderator:
translation: Jagex 会选择那些花费时间和精力帮助改善 Old School RuneScape 社区的玩家。要增加成为玩家版主的机会：

english: Keep your account secure! This is very important, as a player with poor security will never be a P-Mod. Read our Security Tips for more information.
translation: 保护你的账户安全！这非常重要，因为安全状况不佳的玩家永远不会成为 P 版主。阅读我们的安全提示了解更多信息。

english: Play by the rules! The rules of Old School RuneScape are enforced for a reason, to make the game a fair and enjoyable environment for all.
translation: 遵守规则！ Old School RuneScape 的规则有其存在的理由，旨在为所有人创造公平愉快的游戏环境。

english: Report accurately! When Jagex consider an account for review they look for quality, not quantity. Ensure your reports are of a high quality by following the report guidelines.
translation: 准确举报！当 Jagex 考虑审核账户时，他们看重质量而非数量。遵循举报指南确保你的举报质量上乘。

english: Be excellent to each other! Treat others as you would want to be treated yourself. Respect your fellow player.
translation: 善待彼此！以你希望被对待的方式对待他人。尊重你的其他玩家。

english: What can Player Moderators not do?
translation: 玩家版主不能做什么？

english: P-Mods cannot ban your account - they can only report offences. Jagex then take action based on the evidence received. If you lose your password or get scammed by another player, P-Mods cannot help you
translation: P 版主不能封禁你的账户——他们只能举报违规行为。然后 Jagex 会根据收到的证据采取行动。如果你丢失密码或被其他玩家诈骗，

english: get your account back. All they can do is recommend you to go to Customer Support. They cannot retrieve any items you may have lost and receive no free items from Jagex for helping moderate the game. They are
translation: P 版主无法帮你找回账户。他们能做的只是建议你去联系客服。他们无法找回你可能丢失的任何物品，也不会因帮助管理游戏而从 Jagex 获得免费物品。

english: players who give their efforts to help the community out of the goodness of their hearts! P-mods do not work for Jagex and so cannot make you a Moderator, or recommend other accounts to become moderators. If
translation: 他们是出于好心付出努力帮助社区的玩家！P 版主不为 Jagex 工作，因此不能让你成为版主，也不能推荐其他账户成为版主。

english: you wish to become a Moderator, please feel free to ask me how!
translation: 如果你想成为版主，请随时问我怎么做！

english: Tell me about the Rules of Conduct.
translation: 跟我讲讲行为准则。

english: At once. Take a look at my book here...
translation: 马上。看看我这里的书……

english: Can you give me a handy tip please?
translation: 能给我一个小贴士吗？

english: Did you know most skills have right click 'Make-X' options to help you train faster?
translation: 你知道大多数技能都有右键''制作 X''选项来帮助你更快训练吗？

english: Make your recovery questions and answers hard to guess but easy to remember.
translation: 让你的恢复问题和答案难以猜测但容易记住。

english: Don't use your RuneScape password on other sites. Keep your account safe!
translation: 不要在其他网站使用你的 RuneScape 密码。保护你的账户安全！

english: If you think someone knows your password - change it!
translation: 如果你认为有人知道你的密码——改掉它！

english: The squirrels! The squirrels are coming! Noooo, get them out of my head!
translation: 松鼠！松鼠来了！不，把它们从我脑子里赶出去！

english: Did you know you burn food less often on the range in Lumbridge castle than other ranges?
translation: 你知道在仑桥堡的炉灶上烧焦食物的频率比其他炉灶低吗？

english: Players can not trim armour. Don't fall for this popular scam!
translation: 玩家无法装饰盔甲。别被这个流行的骗局骗了！

english: Feeling harassed? Don't forget your ignore list can be especially useful if a player seems to be picking on you!
translation: 感觉被骚扰了？别忘了如果有玩家似乎在针对你，忽略列表会特别有用！

english: If you're lost and have no idea where to go, use the Home Teleport spell for free!
translation: 如果你迷路了不知道去哪，免费使用家园传送法术！

english: If you see someone breaking the rules, report them!
translation: 如果你看到有人违规，举报他们！

english: Did you know? Superheat Item means you never fail to smelt ore!
translation: 知道吗？超级加热物品意味着你永远不会冶炼矿石失败！

english: Did you know that at high levels of Runecrafting you get more than one rune per essence?
translation: 你知道在高等级符石制作中，每颗精华可以获得多于一枚符石吗？

english: Never lend your items out unless you expect them not to come back.
translation: 永远不要借出你的物品，除非你预期它们不会回来。

english: Never question a penguin.
translation: 永远不要质疑企鹅。

english: Melee armour actually gives you disadvantages when using magic attacks. It may be better to take off your armour entirely!
translation: 近战盔甲实际上在使用魔法攻击时会给你劣势。完全脱下盔甲可能更好！

english: If the chat window is moving too quickly to report a player accurately, run to a quiet spot and review the chat at your leisure!
translation: 如果聊天窗口移动太快无法准确举报玩家，跑到安静的地方悠闲地回顾聊天记录！

english: Take time to check the second trade window carefully. Don't be scammed!
translation: 花时间仔细检查第二个交易窗口。别被骗了！

english: Did you know having a bank pin can help secure your valuable items?
translation: 你知道设置银行密码可以帮助保护你的贵重物品吗？

english: Did you know that mithril equipment is very light?
translation: 你知道秘银装备非常轻吗？

english: There are no cheats in RuneScape! Never visit websites promising otherwise!
translation: RuneScape 中没有作弊器！永远不要访问承诺有作弊器的网站！

english: Jagex will never e-mail you. Do not believe any e-mails that claim to be from us.
translation: Jagex 永远不会给你发邮件。不要相信任何声称来自我们的邮件。

english: If you're stuck on a skill, talk to the Lumbridge Tutors for help and tips.
translation: 如果你在某项技能上卡住了，找仑桥镇导师寻求帮助和建议。

english: Did you know that you can wear a shield with a crossbow?
translation: 你知道你可以同时穿戴盾牌和弩吗？

english: Beware of players trying to lure you into the wilderness. Your items cannot be returned if you lose them!
translation: 小心试图引诱你进入荒野的玩家。如果你丢失物品，它们无法找回！

english: If a player isn't sure of the rules, send them to me! I'll be happy to remind them!
translation: 如果玩家不确定规则，把他们送到我这里！我很乐意提醒他们！

english: Never tell your password to anyone, not even your best friend!
translation: 永远不要告诉任何人你的密码，即使是你最好的朋友！

english: Be careful when fighting wizards! Wearing heavy armour can lower your Magic resistance!
translation: 与法师战斗时要小心！穿戴重甲会降低你的魔法抗性！

english: Hear ye! Hear ye! Player Moderators massive help to Rune... Oh great, a P-mod! I know all about the great job you guys do, would you like me to prove my extensive knowledge to you?!
translation: 听好了！听好了！玩家版主对 Rune……哦太好了，一个 P 版主！我知道你们做的伟大工作，你想让我向你证明我的渊博知识吗？！

english: Can you show me the Guidelines please?
translation: 能给我看看指南吗？

english: Of course, but I can't let you keep it - I've only got a few copies!
translation: 当然，但我不能让你留着——我只有几份副本！

english: Do you have a copy of the Code of Conduct?
translation: 你有行为准则的副本吗？

english: Oh yes, but I can't let you keep it - I've only a few copies!
translation: 哦是的，但我不能让你留着——我只有几份副本！

english: Can you give me a moderating tip please?
translation: 能给我一个管理小贴士吗？

english: Add other Player Moderators to your friends list for quick advice and moral support in-game. It does help!
translation: 将其他玩家版主添加到好友列表，以便在游戏中获得快速建议和道义支持。这确实有帮助！

english: To avoid reporting the wrong player, add an offender to your friends list, switch your public chat to friends and then use your right-click report from there. Easy!
translation: 为避免举报错误的玩家，将违规者添加到好友列表，将公共聊天切换为好友，然后从那里使用右键举报。很简单！

english: Did you know that Free-to-Play P-mods CAN visit the moderator forums, by logging into the regular forums at the top right hand side of the forum screen, despite it saying Members only.
translation: 你知道免费玩家 P 版主可以访问版主论坛吗，只需在论坛屏幕右上角登录常规论坛即可，尽管它写着仅限会员。

english: Don't be tempted to report anything you didn't see, no matter how much you trust the player who is informing you.
translation: 不要被你未亲眼所见的事情诱惑去举报，无论你多么信任告知你的玩家。

english: Don't eat something messy when on a first date - it won't look good!
translation: 初次约会时不要吃弄脏的东西——看起来不好看！

english: Don't forget to add the mute if needed, before selecting the report category. This cuts down on those duplicate reports for one player.
translation: 别忘了在选择举报类别之前，如果需要的话先添加禁言。这可以减少针对同一玩家的重复举报。

english: The forums are the best place to keep abreast of any procedure changes that might not yet be included in the Player Mod guidelines!
translation: 论坛是了解任何可能尚未包含在玩家版主指南中的程序变更的最佳场所！

english: Got players asking you to unban them or help them retrieve a stolen or hacked account? There's nothing you can do so just send them to the Customer Support Team. If they think you can help, send them to me; I'll
translation: 有玩家请求你解封他们或帮他们找回被盗或被黑的账户？你无能为力，所以只需把他们送到客服团队。如果他们认为你能帮忙，把他们送到我这里；

english: put them straight!
translation: 我会让他们明白！

english: Have the P-Mod Oracle open in a separate window when playing Old School RuneScape - that way you'll always have the most up-to-date guidelines to hand!
translation: 在玩 Old School RuneScape 时将 P 版主神谕在单独窗口打开——这样你就能随时掌握最新指南！

english: If the chat is scrolling too fast for you to see that suspect line you want to double check, just run up a ladder or to a quieter spot to stop the chat screen scrolling. Then you can scroll back and read that
translation: 如果聊天滚动太快让你看不到想复查的可疑信息，只需跑上梯子或到更安静的地方停止聊天屏幕滚动。

english: suspect line and judge the situation in your own time!
translation: 然后你可以滚动回去阅读那条可疑信息，按自己的节奏判断情况！

english: If you're a new mod, don't forget to read the guidelines before you log into the game! If you've been a P-mod for a while, why not have another read of them to refresh your memory and to get up to date
translation: 如果你是新版主，别忘了在登录游戏前阅读指南！如果你已经是 P 版主一段时间了，

english: with any changes you may have missed!
translation: 何不再读一遍来刷新记忆并了解你可能错过的任何变更！

english: If you've got a player asking you questions about P- mods, feel free to send them to me; I can answer questions about P-mods for you!
translation: 如果有玩家向你询问关于 P 版主的问题，尽管把他们送到我这里；我可以为你回答关于 P 版主的问题！

english: If you get harassed by a player in game, don't take it personally - the player is reacting to your silver crown, not to you!
translation: 如果你在游戏中被玩家骚扰，别往心里去——玩家是对你的银色皇冠做出反应，而不是对你！

english: If you notice a player trying to buy something common for an extremely high price, look about and see if there's someone else selling the same item for a much lower price. Chances are they're team scamming. If so,
translation: 如果你注意到有玩家试图以极高的价格购买普通物品，环顾四周看看是否有人以低得多的价格出售相同物品。很可能他们是团队诈骗。如果是这样，

english: write their names down and send your J-mod curators a query!
translation: 记下他们的名字并向你的 J 版主策展人发送查询！

english: If you see a player abusing a bug in game, there's no need to report the player, just submit a bug report via the in-game report form.
translation: 如果你看到玩家在游戏中滥用漏洞，无需举报该玩家，只需通过游戏内举报表单提交漏洞报告即可。

english: An important part of being a P-mod is to act as an ambassador for the game. Keeping your cool even when faced with the rudest players goes a long way towards this!
translation: 成为 P 版主的重要部分是充当游戏的形象大使。即使面对最粗鲁的玩家也能保持冷静，这对实现这一目标大有帮助！

english: It's always better to report in secret. Telling a player that you are about to report them rarely makes you a friend, and can often lead to a player being offensive to you!
translation: 秘密举报总是更好。告诉玩家你将要举报他们很少会让你交到朋友，而且常常会导致玩家对你做出冒犯行为！

english: Make sure you log out of the game and the forums whenever you leave your device. Don't allow others to see confidential info!
translation: 确保每次离开设备时都退出游戏和论坛。不要让他人看到机密信息！

english: Never answer questions if you feel the answer will breach confidentiality.
translation: 如果你觉得回答会违反保密原则，永远不要回答问题。

english: The P-mod forums are your friend! They're the best place to talk to and meet other P-mods and are absolutely packed with useful advice!
translation: P 版主论坛是你的朋友！它们是与其他 P 版主交流和见面的最佳场所，绝对充满了有用的建议！

english: Remember, if in doubt, report without a mute! It's very frustrating not to be able to speak if you're innocent!
translation: 记住，如果有疑问，举报时不要禁言！如果你是无辜的却无法说话，那会非常沮丧！

english: Remember, if offensive language has been completely filtered out then there's no need to report or mute it!
translation: 记住，如果冒犯性语言已被完全过滤，则无需举报或禁言！

english: Think twice before applying that mute. Will it really prevent further damage from surrounding players?
translation: 在实施禁言前三思。这真的能防止周围玩家造成进一步伤害吗？

english: Use the Jagex PMod team if you need to - they're there to help!
translation: 如果需要就使用 Jagex P 版主团队——他们就是来帮忙的！

english: You'll be amazed how often a bit of humour can diffuse a potentially unpleasant situation, before it becomes too serious.
translation: 你会惊讶于一点幽默能在事态变得太严重之前化解潜在的不愉快情况，这种情况有多常见。

english: Your J-mods are there to help you. If you ever need their advice, send them a query. They are always very happy to help. Don't be afraid to use them!
translation: 你的 J 版主就在那里帮助你。如果你需要他们的建议，给他们发送查询。他们总是很乐意帮忙。别害怕使用他们！

english: Your Player Moderator identity must never be revealed on the regular Old School RuneScape forums. However, you're more than welcome to chat about all aspects of being a Player Moderator in the official
translation: 你的玩家版主身份绝不能在日常 Old School RuneScape 论坛上透露。不过，非常欢迎你在官方玩家版主论坛上畅聊

english: Player Moderator forums!
translation: 成为玩家版主的方方面面！

translation: 首先我让它们适应过度的听觉刺激和简单的身体对抗。

english: You shout at them and beat them with sticks?
translation: 你对它们大喊大叫并用棍子打它们？

english: Of course. Then I re-educate them to become comfortable with riders and military combat situations.
translation: 当然。然后我再教育它们适应骑手和军事战斗情况。

english: You sit on their backs and prod them with sharp pointy things.
translation: 你坐在它们背上用尖锐的东西戳它们。

english: If you like.
translation: 如果你喜欢的话。

english: Doesn't seem very fair on the tortoises.
translation: 对陆龟来说似乎不太公平。

english: This is War! Fairness is a luxury of the weak.
translation: 这是战争！公平是弱者的奢侈品。

english: Hmmm, profound but disturbing.
translation: 嗯，深刻但令人不安。

english: So why tortoises?
translation: 那为什么是陆龟？

english: Isn't it obvious? Surely even to your untrained eye that giant tortoises are the perfect mobile armoured field unit?
translation: 这还不明显吗？即使以你未经训练的眼睛，难道看不出巨龟是完美的移动装甲野战单位吗？

english: They are sturdy animals, and well protected by their shell. They can even swim! All we need to do is put a bit of fire in their bellies.
translation: 它们是结实的动物，外壳保护得很好。它们甚至会游泳！我们只需在它们肚子里加点火。

english: I suppose so....
translation: 我想是吧……

english: Where do these tortoises come from?
translation: 这些陆龟从哪里来？

english: We breed them. The originals were found by gnome explorers back in King Healthorg the Great's rule. On their discovery King Healthorg authorised a small party to go there and transport a breeding pair back here. He
translation: 我们繁殖它们。原始种群是在伟大的健康王统治时期由地精探险家发现的。发现后，健康王授权一个小队前往那里并将一对繁殖个体运回这里。

english: kept one for himself to ride into battle.
translation: 他留了一只自己骑乘参战。

english: Trouble is they take a lot of skill and time to breed, so we're only just getting them battle ready.
translation: 问题是繁殖它们需要很多技巧和时间，所以我们才刚刚让它们做好战斗准备。

translation: 恐怕预制菜不行。只有手工制作的地精美食才配得上阿卢夫‧阿洛夫特的顾客。

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Trainer Nacklepen
translation: 你把配送的 [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] 交给训练师纳克尔彭

english: Huzzah!

translation: 你有 [number] 积分可以兑换免费配送代币。你可以获得 [number] 份地精美食配送。

translation: 别忘了从小阿卢夫‧吉安那里领取你的免费配送代币。

translation: 你的配送太晚了！回去找小阿卢夫再拿一份订单。你扔掉了配送箱，因为不再需要它了。

english: So what are you training these tortoises to do?
translation: 那你训练这些陆龟做什么？

english: As a loyal customer of the Lovakengj Minecart Network, you're entitled to this.

english: Sorry, human, the Lovakengj Minecart Network is for citizens of Lovakengj only.

english: I've got this control scroll for you.

english: Thanks, human. I guess it's okay for you to ride my carts after all. So, can I help you?

english: [player name] has found me!

english: Hello?
translation: 你好？

english: Ssshhh! What do you want?

translation: 嗯，不是每天都能看到一个人在树上。

english: I'm trying to observe a suspect. Leave me alone!
translation: 我正在观察一个嫌疑人。别烦我！

english: What's this all about?
translation: 这是怎么回事？

english: Hadn't you heard? You'd better go and talk to the other guard, the one by the bank door. He'll tell you all about it.
translation: 你没听说过吗？你最好去和另一个守卫谈谈，就是银行门口那个。他会告诉你一切。

english: Go on, ask him what's wrong with the bank wall. He loves when people ask him that.
translation: 去吧，问他银行墙有什么问题。他喜欢人们问他这个。

english: Ok, if you say so..
translation: 好吧，如果你这么说……

english: This is about the bank robbery, right?
translation: 这是关于银行抢劫案，对吧？

english: Yes, that's right. We're keeping the suspect under tight observation for the moment.
translation: 是的，没错。我们目前正严密监视嫌疑人。

english: Can't you just... I dunno... arrest him?
translation: 你们不能直接……我不知道……逮捕他吗？

english: I'm not meant to discuss the case. You know what confidentiality rules are like.
translation: 我不应该讨论案件。你知道保密规则是怎样的。

english: Fair enough.
translation: 好吧。

english: You're not being very subtle up there.
translation: 你在上面不够隐蔽。

english: I'd be doing a lot better if nits like you didn't come crowding around me all day!
translation: 如果没有像你这样的蠢货整天围着我，我会做得更好！

english: But your legs are hanging down!
translation: 但你的腿垂下来了！

english: Go away!
translation: 走开！

english: Please yourself!
translation: 随你便！

english: Can I do anything to help?
translation: 我能帮什么忙吗？

english: That's very kind of you. I'd rather like a nice bowl of stew, if you could fetch me one. I don't get many meal breaks.
translation: 你真好。如果你能给我弄一碗美味的炖菜，我会很感激。我没什么吃饭休息时间。

english: You want a bowl of stew?
translation: 你想要一碗炖菜？

english: If you wouldn't mind...
translation: 如果你不介意的话……

english: I'll think about it!
translation: 我会考虑的！

english: Yes, what do you... I say, is that stew for me?
translation: 是的，你想……我说，那炖菜是给我的吗？

english: Ok, take the stew!
translation: 好的，拿走炖菜！

english: Gosh, that's very kind of you! Here, have a few coins for your trouble...
translation: 天哪，你真好！给，拿几枚金币作为酬劳……

english: The guard eats the stew
translation: 守卫吃掉炖菜

english: The guard drops the empty bowl out of the tree!
translation: 守卫把空碗从树上扔下来！

english: No, I want to keep this stew!
translation: 不，我想留着这碗炖菜！

english: Fair enough. But if you change your mind, I'll probably still be here.
translation: 好吧。但如果你改变主意，我可能还会在这里。

english: Here's some stew.

english: I think I should leave him in peace to finish his stew!
translation: 我想我应该让他安静地吃完炖菜！

translation: 呃……不用了，谢谢！现在，如果你不介意，我正在观察这个嫌疑人！

english: Sorry!

english: Ooooch!

english: Oi!
translation: 喂！

english: Watch what you're doing with that axe, you nit!
translation: 小心你用那斧头在做什么，蠢货！

translation: 你会暴露我的！我应该藏起来！

translation: 我能帮什么忙吗？

english: Ok, take the stew!
translation: 好的，拿走炖菜！

english: No, I want to keep this stew!
translation: 不，我想留着这碗炖菜！

english: You must defeat me before touching the tree!
translation: 在碰树之前你必须打败我！

english: Grr ... Get out of my way...

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

translation: 你好，旅行者。你对任何投掷武器感兴趣吗？

translation: 哦，[Fremennik name]！勇敢的战士回来了！

english: It was a hard-fought battle, but we Fremennik prevailed!
translation: 那是一场艰苦的战斗，但我们费明尼克人胜利了！

english: I expect we'll be hearing songs about the 'Slayer of the Troll King' for many years to come.
translation: 我想未来多年我们都会听到关于''巨魔之王杀手''的歌谣。

english: It would be an honour to be remembered in such a way! Thanks.
translation: 能以这种方式被铭记是一种荣幸！谢谢。

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Thanks for rescuing my mum and dad!
translation: 谢谢你救了我的爸爸妈妈！

english: Thanks again for freeing me from that ice block! I might be a troll, but it was real uncomfortable in there!
translation: 再次感谢你把我从那个冰块里救出来！我可能是巨魔，但里面真的很不舒服！

english: Thanks again for freeing me from that ice block! I don't know what my little snookums would have done without us!
translation: 再次感谢你把我从那个冰块里救出来！我不知道我的小宝贝没有我们会怎么样！

english: Can I help you, traveller?
translation: 我能帮你吗，旅行者？

english: Why do you stand here?
translation: 你为什么站在这里？

english: This is the northernmost reach of Kourend. Beyond these cliffs you will find the Doors of Dinh and the prison of the Wintertodt.
translation: 这是库兰德王国的最北端。越过这些悬崖，你会发现丁之门和冬将军的囚牢。

english: The Pyromancers do what they can to keep the Wintertodt contained but I fear it will not be enough.
translation: 火术士尽其所能控制冬将军，但我担心这还不够。

english: I come here to keep watch, whenever my time permits, so that the city may be warned if the Wintertodt escapes.
translation: 我只要时间允许就会来这里守望，以便在冬将军逃脱时警示城市。

english: Interesting... Thanks.
translation: 有趣……谢谢。

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。

english: What's this for?

english: For your troubles.

english: Right... Well, thanks.
translation: 好吧……嗯，谢谢。

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

english: About this circle of dead mushrooms...
translation: 关于这圈死蘑菇……

english: You know very little of such circles, traveller. Perhaps one day we will have more to discuss. Now, can I help you with anything else?
translation: 旅行者，你对这种圈子知之甚少。也许有一天我们会有更多可谈的。现在，我还能帮你什么吗？

english: Yes, the circle is dead. Crops die quite often, according to the Hosidius peasants. Do you wish me to reanimate it? I can, for a mere 80,000 coins.
translation: 是的，这圈作物死了。据霍西迪乌斯农民说，作物经常死亡。你想让我复活它吗？我可以，只需80,000金币。

english: I don't have the money.
translation: 我没有钱。

english: In that case the circle will remain dead. Now, can I help you with anything else?
translation: 那样的话这圈作物将保持死亡。现在，我还能帮你什么吗？

english: Okay, here's 80,000 coins.
translation: 好的，这是80,000金币。

english: Trossa casts a reanimation spell on the mushrooms
translation: 特罗莎对蘑菇施放复活法术

english: There, the deed is done. Now, can I help you with anything else?

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Oh, what do you want? Can't you see I'm trying to nap?
translation: 哦，你想要什么？你没看到我在打盹吗？

english: Shouldn't you be catching rats?
translation: 你不应该去抓老鼠吗？

english: Oh my, no. I have humans for that.
translation: 哦天哪，不。我有人类做那个。

english: Meow.
translation: 喵。

english: Greetings Bwana! I am Trufitus Shakaya of the Tai Bwo Wannai village.
translation: 你好，布瓦纳！我是泰博瓦纳村的特鲁菲图斯‧沙卡亚。

english: Welcome to our humble village.
translation: 欢迎来到我们简陋的村庄。

english: What does Bwana mean?
translation: 布瓦纳是什么意思？

english: It means friend, and friends come in peace. I assume that you come in peace?
translation: 意思是朋友，朋友是和平而来的。我想你是和平而来的吧？

english: Yes, of course I do.
translation: 是的，我当然是。

english: Well, that is good news, as I may have a proposition for you.
translation: 嗯，那是好消息，因为我可能有个提议给你。

english: A proposition eh? Sounds interesting!
translation: 一个提议，嗯？听起来很有趣！

english: I hoped you would think so. My people are afraid to stay in the village.
translation: 我希望你这么想。我的族人害怕留在村子里。

english: They have returned to the jungle and I need to commune with the gods
translation: 他们已经回到丛林，我需要与神灵沟通看看我们的命运。

english: to see what fate befalls us. You can help me by collecting some herbs that I need.
translation: 你可以通过收集一些我需要的草药来帮助我。

english: Me? How can I help?
translation: 我？我怎么帮？

english: I need to make a special brew! A potion that helps me to commune with the gods. For this potion, I need very special herbs, that are only found in the deep jungle.
translation: 我需要制作一种特殊药剂！一种帮助我与神灵沟通的药水。为了这种药水，我需要非常特殊的草药，它们只在丛林深处才能找到。

english: I can only guide you so far as the herbs are not easy to find. With some luck, you will find each herb in turn and bring to me. I will give you details of where to find the next herb.
translation: 我只能引导你到这里，因为草药不容易找到。如果运气好，你会依次找到每种草药并带给我。我会告诉你去哪里找下一种草药。

english: In return for this great favour I will give you training in Herblore.
translation: 作为这个巨大恩惠的回报，我会给你草药学训练。

english: It sounds like just the challenge for me. And it would make a nice break from killing things!
translation: 听起来正是适合我的挑战。而且这会是杀戮之外的不错休息！

english: That is excellent Bwana! The first herb that you need to gather is called
translation: 那太好了布瓦纳！你需要收集的第一种草药

english: Snake Weed.
translation: 叫做蛇草。

english: It grows near the vines in an area to the south west where
translation: 它生长在西南部一个靠近藤蔓的区域，

english: the ground turns soft and the water kisses your feet.
translation: 那里地面变软，水亲吻你的双脚。

english: Hmmm, sounds difficult, I don't know if I am ready for the challenge.
translation: 嗯，听起来很难，我不知道我是否准备好接受挑战。

english: Very well then Bwana, maybe you will return to me invigorated and ready to take up the challenge one day?
translation: 那好吧布瓦纳，也许有一天你会精神焕发地回来，准备好接受挑战？

english: I am very sorry, but I don't have any time for that.
translation: 非常抱歉，但我没时间做那个。

english: Very well then, may your journeys bring you much joy.
translation: 那好吧，愿你的旅程带给你许多快乐。

english: Maybe you will pass this way again and you then take up my proposal?
translation: 也许你会再次路过这里，然后接受我的提议？

english: But for now, fare thee well.
translation: 但现在，祝你一路顺风。

english: I am sorry, but I am very busy.
translation: 我很抱歉，但我很忙。

english: What does a warrior like me know about peace?
translation: 像我这样的战士对和平了解什么？

english: Do you know what's south of here?

english: Then suddenly they returned, with a wild gleam in their eyes, raving about gods and snakes and all kinds of madness.

english: We had to drive them out, in case their condition infected the rest of the troops. Their wives will be given a full widow pension when we return home.

english: General Hining concluded that, whatever is down there, it's not affiliated with any of the elf factions, and it should be left alone.

translation: 你好，JalYt-[TzHaar caste]-[player name]。

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: You need help little JalYt?
translation: 你需要帮助吗，小 JalYt？

english: Not unless you can help me in the Inferno.
translation: 除非你能在地狱里帮我。

english: It is not for us to help. You must fight alone.
translation: 这不是我们能帮忙的。你必须独自战斗。

english: Oh... Worth a try I suppose.
translation: 哦……我想值得一试。

english: Kot e TzHaar-Hur!
translation: Kot e TzHaar-Hur!

english: Oi JalYt!
translation: 喂，JalYt！

english: Why can't I go past here?
translation: 为什么我不能过去？

english: Why's that?
translation: 为什么？

english: That's a shame.
translation: 真遗憾。

english: What if I could prove I am capable?
translation: 如果我能证明我有能力呢？

english: How about a large stack of gold?
translation: 一大堆金币怎么样？

english: I managed to defeat TzTok-Jad and obtain this firecape.
translation: 我成功击败了特兹托克‧贾德并获得了这件火焰斗篷。

english: Sorry, I don't think I am capable.
translation: 抱歉，我觉得我还不够格。

english: I'm a hardened adventurer, nothing can stop me!
translation: 我是个身经百战的冒险者，没什么能阻挡我！

english: What are you guarding?
translation: 你在守卫什么？

english: Oh well, Goodbye.
translation: 哦好吧，再见。

english: Oh well, [TzHaar caste]-[player name] over and out.
translation: 哦好吧，[TzHaar caste]-[Player name] 完毕，over。

english: Fair enough.
translation: 有道理。

english: What did you call me?
translation: 你叫我什么？

english: What are you then?
translation: 那你是什么东西？

english: Thanks for explaining it.
translation: 谢谢你的解释。

english: I guess so...
translation: 我想是吧……

english: No I'm not!
translation: 不，我不是！

english: No I'm fine thanks.
translation: 不，我很好，谢谢。

english: Yes, JalYt-[caste]-Xo-[player name]?
translation: 是的，JalYt-[caste]-Xo-[player name]？

english: Tell me about the Inferno.
translation: 跟我讲讲地狱的事。

english: TzHaar are born from eggs incubated in lava pools. When hatched, we retain memories. Memories and knowledge passed on from ancestors who returned to the lava.
translation: 特扎尔是从熔岩池中孵化的蛋里诞生的。孵化后，我们会保留记忆。这些记忆和知识来自回归熔岩的祖先。

english: When TzHaar hatch, some memories are lost. Those about earliest ancestors are not retained. We experiment.
translation: 当特扎尔孵化时，一些记忆会丢失。关于最早祖先的记忆无法保留。我们在做实验。

english: This here was once our largest birthing pool. We use it for experiment. We increased the depth at which eggs are incubated. Over time, newly hatched TzHaar had more memories of lost history!
translation: 这里曾经是我们最大的孵化池。我们用它做实验。我们增加了蛋孵化的深度。随着时间的推移，新孵化的特扎尔拥有了更多失落历史的记忆！

english: But we kept pushing. We wanted answers, but we went too deep.
translation: 但我们不断深入。我们想要答案，但我们走得太深了。

english: Eventually the pool collapsed into a sinkhole. At the bottom we found some sort of ancient incubation chamber, from before earliest memories. We now call it the Inferno.
translation: 最终，水池坍塌成了一个天坑。在底部我们发现某种古老的孵化室，存在于最早的记忆之前。我们现在称它为地狱。

english: We decide to experiment more. We take eggs from creatures in Fight Cave and incubate them down there.
translation: 我们决定进行更多实验。我们把战斗洞穴中生物的蛋拿下去在那里孵化。

english: When eggs hatched, we see that it was not good decision. They were bigger and stronger, and fought each other for dominance.
translation: 当蛋孵化后，我们发现那不是个好决定。它们更大更强壮，并且为了统治地位互相争斗。

english: Instead of knowledge, we now have chamber of dangerous creatures, and they're not alone. Another being lives in the Inferno, one more powerful than any TzHaar.
translation: 我们没有得到知识，反而得到了一个充满危险生物的房间，而且它们并不孤单。地狱里还住着另一个生物，比特扎尔都要强大。

english: We do not know where he came from. All we know is that TzKal-Zuk is hungry. Hungry for memories, memories beyond the Inferno.
translation: 我们不知道他从哪里来。我们只知道特兹卡尔‧祖克很饥饿。渴望记忆，渴望地狱之外的记忆。

english: We think his goal is the city itself. Lots of TzHaar memories here for him. Luckily, he is trapped in prison down there, and we are keeping him at bay by offering sacrifices.
translation: 我们认为他的目标就是这座城市本身。这里有大量特扎尔的记忆供他享用。幸运的是，他被囚禁在下面，我们通过献祭来遏制他。

english: We fear he can't be defeated, but maybe we can hold back his creatures and keep city safe.
translation: 我们担心他无法被击败，但也许我们可以阻挡他的爪牙，保护城市安全。

english: You, a mere JalYt, showed us he can be stopped though. Thanks to you, we still have hope.
translation: 但你，一个普通的 JalYt，向我们展示了他可以被阻止。多亏了你，我们仍有希望。

english: Instead of knowledge, we now have chamber of dangerous creatures. It gets worse, but I don't know if I can trust JalYt-[caste]-Xo-[player name] with this knowledge.
translation: 我们没有得到知识，反而得到了一个充满危险生物的房间。情况更糟了，但我不知道是否能把这个知识告诉 JalYt-[caste]-Xo-[player name]。

english: I like to think I'm pretty trustworthy. If you tell me, maybe I can help in some way.
translation: 我认为我很值得信任。如果你告诉我，也许我能帮上忙。

english: I have one idea. If you sacrifice your fire cape to me, I can take your word.
translation: 我有个主意。如果你把你的火焰斗篷献祭给我，我就相信你的话。

english: Okay, I'd like to sacrifice my fire cape.
translation: 好的，我愿意献祭我的火焰斗篷。

english: Very well, just hand it over.
translation: 很好，把它交给我吧。

english: Sorry, I want to keep it for now.
translation: 抱歉，我想暂时留着它。

english: Thank you, JalYt-[caste]-Xo-[player name]. You can enter Inferno now.
translation: 谢谢你，JalYt-[caste]-Xo-[player name]。你现在可以进入地狱了。

english: What should I do down there?
translation: 我在下面该做什么？

english: The creatures down there are dangerous. If you can kill some of them, it would be very helpful to TzHaar.
translation: 下面的生物很危险。如果你能杀死其中一些，对特扎尔将非常有帮助。

english: But now you can be trusted, I must also give warning. Another being lives in the Inferno, one more powerful than any TzHaar.
translation: 但现在你可以被信任了，我也必须发出警告。地狱里还住着另一个生物，比特扎尔都要强大。

english: Well I definitely think I can help with that.
translation: 嗯，我绝对认为我能帮上忙。

english: Thank you, JalYt-[caste]-Xo-[player name].
translation: 谢谢你，JalYt-[caste]-Xo-[player name]。

english: I'll need to take it off first.
translation: 我得先把它脱下来。

english: I don't have a fire cape on me unfortunately.
translation: 不幸的是，我身上没有火焰斗篷。

english: Can I help here in some way?
translation: 我能在这里帮上什么忙吗？

english: I think maybe you can, but first you need to prove I can trust you.
translation: 我想也许你可以，但首先你需要证明我可以信任你。

english: If you sacrifice your fire cape to me, I can take your word.
translation: 如果你把你的火焰斗篷献祭给我，我就相信你的话。

english: Never mind.
translation: 没关系。

english: A great power is starting to shake the cavern...
translation: 一股巨大的力量开始震动洞穴……

english: No! TzKal-Zuk's prison is breaking down. There's nothing I can do for you now, JalYt!
translation: 不！特兹卡尔‧祖克的监狱正在崩塌。我现在帮不了你了，JalYt！

english: You are very impressive for a JalYt. You managed to defeat TzKal-Zuk, for now...
translation: 作为一个 JalYt，你非常令人印象深刻。你成功击败了特兹卡尔‧祖克，暂时……

english: Please accept this cape as a token of appreciation.
translation: 请接受这件斗篷作为感激的象征。

english: Impressive JalYt, but why do you show me this?
translation: 令人印象深刻的 JalYt，但你为什么要给我看这个？

english: I have conquered the most difficult challenges across Gielinor. But I wish to challenge myself further.
translation: 我已经征服了基利诺尔最艰难的挑战。但我希望进一步挑战自己。

english: You wish for more?
translation: 你想要更多？

english: I wish to challenge the Inferno on my own terms, without the endorsement of a slayer master.
translation: 我希望按照自己的方式挑战地狱，无需杀戮大师的认可。

english: Hmm. You ask for much, JalYt. But if anybody has proven themselves worthy it is you.
translation: 嗯。你要求很多，JalYt。但如果有人证明了自己值得，那就是你。

english: Very well. I shall be the one to endorse your attempts to reach even greater heights.
translation: 很好。我将认可你尝试攀登更高巅峰的努力。

english: Thank you TzHaar-Ket-Keh. You won't regret it.
translation: 谢谢你，特扎尔 - 凯特 - 凯赫。你不会后悔的。

english: Wow what has happened here? That doesn't look good!
translation: 哇，这里发生了什么事？看起来不太妙！

english: We pushed it too far! JalYt would not understand. The memories, we needed them. Now big Inferno.
translation: 我们做得太过了！JalYt 不会理解。那些记忆，我们需要它们。现在有了大地狱。

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: This is our birthing pool. TzHaar are born from eggs incubated in this large pool here.
translation: 这是我们的孵化池。特扎尔是从这里的大池中孵化的蛋里诞生的。

english: When hatched, we retain memories. Memories and knowledge passed on from ancestors who returned to the lava.
translation: 孵化后，我们会保留记忆。这些记忆和知识来自回归熔岩的祖先。

english: Something doesn't seem right... There's a large opening.
translation: 有些不对劲……那里有个大开口。

english: What happened here?
translation: 这里发生了什么事？

english: We went too far... way too far, we need the memories. JalYt would not understand.
translation: 我们做得太过了……太过分了，我们需要那些记忆。JalYt 不会理解。

english: Please help me to understand then.
translation: 那请帮我理解一下。

english: We TzHaar have special ability. When incubated in lava, a hatched TzHaar retains knowledge and memories of ancestors who returned to the lava.
translation: 我们特扎尔有特殊能力。在熔岩中孵化时，孵化的特扎尔会保留回归熔岩的祖先的知识和记忆。

english: Not all memories though, those about earliest ancestors were not being retained. We experiment.
translation: 但不是所有记忆，关于最早祖先的记忆无法保留。我们在做实验。

english: We increased the depth at which the eggs are incubated. Over time this worked, newly hatched TzHaar had more memories of lost history!
translation: 我们增加了蛋孵化的深度。随着时间的推移，这奏效了，新孵化的特扎尔拥有了更多失落历史的记忆！

english: That sounds fantastic though, uncovering the past to determine where your species originated?
translation: 那听起来很棒，揭开过去以确定你们物种的起源？

english: Yes, but you JalYt do not understand, we kept pushing it. We wanted answers, but too deep we went.
translation: 是的，但你 JalYt 不明白，我们不断深入。我们想要答案，但走得太深了。

english: Eventually the pool collapsed into a sink hole, huge Inferno there. This was big ancient incubation chamber.
translation: 最终，水池坍塌成了一个天坑，那里变成了巨大的地狱。这是一个巨大的古老孵化室。

english: We decide to experiment. We take eggs from creatures in Fight Cave and incubate them.
translation: 我们决定进行实验。我们把战斗洞穴中生物的蛋拿去孵化。

english: We hatched eggs in there and it was not a good decision. They were so different, bigger, stronger and fought each other for dominance.
translation: 我们在那里孵化了蛋，那不是个好决定。它们截然不同，更大、更强壮，并且为了统治地位互相争斗。

english: Instead of knowledge, we now have a prison of dangerous TzHaar creatures - it gets worse but I cannot trust JalYt with this knowledge yet.
translation: 我们没有得到知识，反而得到了一个关押危险特扎尔生物的监狱——情况更糟了，但我还不能把这个知识告诉 JalYt。

english: Instead of knowledge, we now have a prison of dangerous creatures... and they're not under our control.
translation: 我们没有得到知识，反而得到了一个关押危险生物的监狱……而且它们不受我们控制。

english: One grew incredibly strong, powerful. He controls those creatures in the prison. TzKal-Zuk, as we call him...is hungry.
translation: 其中一个变得异常强大。他控制着监狱里的那些生物。特兹卡尔‧祖克，正如我们所称呼的……他很饥饿。

english: Hungry for memories, memories beyond the Inferno, which only TzHaar in the city can provide.
translation: 渴望记忆，渴望地狱之外的记忆，只有城里的特扎尔能提供。

english: Do you know what he's planning? What are you doing?
translation: 你知道他在计划什么吗？你们在做什么？

english: We can only guess one day he will want to scale up into the city himself. We are keeping him at bay by offering sacrifices for him to feast on.
translation: 我们只能猜测有一天他会想亲自攻入城市。我们通过提供献祭供他吞噬来遏制他。

english: Is there no way to take him out?
translation: 没有办法除掉他吗？

english: We fear not. But we hoped you, with your fancy JalYt weaponry, would be able to help hold back his creatures. You proved your commitment by sacrificing your fire cape.
translation: 恐怕没有。但我们希望你，凭借你精良的 JalYt 武器，能帮助阻挡他的爪牙。你通过献祭火焰斗篷证明了你的决心。

english: Can I go down there?
translation: 我能下去吗？

english: JalYt, we need help, but this is extremely dangerous. TzHaar not strong enough to take control back.
translation: JalYt，我们需要帮助，但这极其危险。特扎尔不够强大，无法夺回控制权。

english: We are worried about trusting JalYt to take on this task for us.
translation: 我们担心让 JalYt 为我们承担这项任务。

english: Let me prove it.
translation: 让我证明给你看。

english: I have one idea, if you could sacrifice your fire cape to me, I can take your word.
translation: 我有个主意，如果你能把火焰斗篷献祭给我，我就相信你的话。

english: You hand over your cape to TzHaar-Ket-Keh.
translation: 你把斗篷交给了特扎尔 - 凯特 - 凯赫。

english: Give it your best shot JalYt-[caste]-Xo-[player name].
translation: 全力以赴吧，JalYt-[caste]-Xo-[player name]。

english: Let me just take it off first.
translation: 让我先把它脱下来。

english: You can head into The Inferno anytime. We trust you to help us JalYt-[caste]-Xo-[player name].
translation: 你可以随时进入地狱。我们信任你会帮助我们，JalYt-[caste]-Xo-[player name]。

english: I'll do my best.
translation: 我会尽力的。

english: I have a spare infernal cape, perhaps I could offer it back to you for a littlun to take with me?
translation: 我有一件备用的地狱斗篷，也许我可以把它给你，让你带个小家伙跟我走？

english: Maybe. Hand it over and if you make lucky TokKul toss, it can be yours JalYt.
translation: 也许吧。把它交给我，如果你幸运地掷出托库尔，它就是你的了，JalYt。

english: But do know, you do not get cape back.
translation: 但要知道，你拿不回斗篷。

english: Luck be a TzHaar tonight. Jal-Nib-Rek is yours.
translation: 愿今晚特扎尔眷顾你。贾尔 - 尼布 - 雷克归你了。

english: No Jal-Nib-Rek for you.
translation: 你没有贾尔 - 尼布 - 雷克。

english: No, I want to keep my cape.
translation: 不，我想留着我的斗篷。

english: Nevermind.
translation: 算了。

english: Tell me about the Inferno.
translation: 跟我讲讲地狱的事。

english: Yes.
translation: 是。

english: No.
translation: 否。

english: Can I help here in some way?
translation: 我能在这里帮上什么忙吗？

english: Never mind.
translation: 没关系。

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: What happened here?
translation: 这里发生了什么事？

english: Can I go down there?
translation: 我能下去吗？

english: No, I'd like to keep it.
translation: 不，我想留着它。

english: Yes, I'd like to sacrifice it.
translation: 是的，我想献祭它。

english: I have a spare infernal cape.
translation: 我有一件备用的地狱斗篷。

english: Yes, I accept that I won't get my cape back.
translation: 是的，我接受拿不回我的斗篷。

english: JalYt-[caste]-Xo-[player name]. The challenge awaits, if you're brave enough.
translation: JalYt-[caste]-Xo-[player name]。挑战在等待，如果你够勇敢的话。

english: Of course I'm brave enough.
translation: 当然我够勇敢。

english: Then select your challenge, JalYt-[caste]-Xo-[player name].
translation: 那么选择你的挑战吧，JalYt-[caste]-Xo-[player name]。

english: I'll pass.
translation: 我放弃。

english: Few can match TzHaar bravery.
translation: 很少有人能媲美特扎尔的勇敢。

english: JalYt-[caste]-Kal-[player name]. Few match your strength. Do you wish to take on the challenge again?
translation: JalYt-[caste]-Kal-[player name]。很少有人能媲美你的力量。你想再次接受挑战吗？

english: Let's do it.
translation: 让我们开始吧。

english: Then select your challenge, JalYt-[caste]-Kal-[player name].
translation: 那么选择你的挑战吧，JalYt-[caste]-Kal-[player name]。

english: The challenge is now beneath you? So be it.
translation: 这个挑战现在对你来说太低级了？那就这样吧。

english: JalYt-[caste]-Xo-[player name].
translation: JalYt-[caste]-Xo-[player name]。

english: Nice chair.
translation: 不错的椅子。

english: The finest obsidian. Cost many TokKul.
translation: 最优质的黑曜石。花费了许多托库尔。

english: Now, have you come for the challenge?
translation: 现在，你是来接受挑战的吗？

english: Err, what challenge?
translation: 呃，什么挑战？

english: Deep in inferno, many offspring of TzTok-Jad. More powerful though. More dangerous.
translation: 在地狱深处，有许多特兹托克‧贾德的后代。但它们更强大。也更危险。

english: The offspring need dealing with. A challenge for you perhaps, if you're brave enough.
translation: 这些后代需要被处理。这也许是个挑战，如果你够勇敢的话。

english: Failure. Maybe the challenge is not for you.
translation: 失败。也许这个挑战不适合你。

english: Challenge complete. Have some TokKul. Now, a new challenge awaits.
translation: 挑战完成。拿些托库尔吧。现在，新的挑战在等待。

english: Six challenges complete. Very impressive JalYt. Have some TokKul, and a little extra something.
translation: 六个挑战全部完成。非常令人印象深刻的 JalYt。拿些托库尔，还有一点额外的东西。

english: Challenge complete. Have some TokKul.
translation: 挑战完成。拿些托库尔吧。

english: All challenges complete. Very impressive JalYt. Have some TokKul, and a little extra something.
translation: 所有挑战全部完成。非常令人印象深刻的 JalYt。拿些托库尔，还有一点额外的东西。

english: You need to complete TzHaar-Ket-Rak's [Previous number] Challenge before taking on TzHaar-Ket-Rak's [Number] Challenge.
translation: 你需要先完成特扎尔 - 凯特 - 拉克的第 [Previous number] 个挑战，才能接受第 [Number] 个挑战。

english: You need to defeat TzKal-Zuk in the Inferno at least once before taking on TzHaar-Ket-Rak's Third Challenge.
translation: 你需要在地狱中至少击败一次特兹卡尔‧祖克，才能接受特扎尔 - 凯特 - 拉克的第三个挑战。

english: Of course I'm brave enough.
translation: 当然我够勇敢。

english: I'll pass.
translation: 我放弃。

english: Let's do it.
translation: 让我们开始吧。

english: Can I help you JalYt-Hur-[TzHaar caste]-[player name]?
translation: 我能帮你吗，JalYt-Hur-[TzHaar caste]-[player name]？

english: Are you not [TzHaar caste]-[player name]?
translation: 你不是 [TzHaar caste]-[player name] 吗？

english: What's a '[TzHaar caste]'?
translation: 什么是'[TzHaar caste]'？

english: That what you are... you tough and strong no?
translation: 那就是你……你很坚韧强壮对吧？

english: Well yes I suppose I am...
translation: 嗯，是的，我想我是……

english: Then you [Tzhaar caste]!
translation: 那你就是 [Tzhaar caste]！

english: What are you then?

english: Hello there. What brings you here?

english: I am the teoki responsible for the Colosseum. I am in charge of all that happens here.
translation: 我是负责竞技场的提奥基。这里发生的一切都由我负责。

english: Hang on... The Colosseum is run by a priest?

english: Well much of the day-to-day running is handled by the Colosseum Master, but yes, I am the one in overall charge of this place.
translation: 嗯，大部分日常运作由竞技场大师处理，但是的，我是这里的总负责人。

english: So why is that?
translation: 这是为什么？

english: This is more than just a place of spectacle. You stand in one of the holiest sites in all of Varlamore. Each drop of blood spilt here is a glorious offering to Ralos.
translation: 这不仅仅是一个观赏的地方。你站在瓦拉莫尔最神圣的场所之一。这里流下的每一滴血都是献给拉洛斯的荣耀祭品。

english: It is these offerings that sustain him. Without them, he will not have the strength to light our way.
translation: 正是这些祭品维持着他。没有它们，他将没有力量照亮我们的道路。

english: Interesting... Thanks for the information.
translation: 有趣……谢谢你的信息。

english: How did it go with Aga?
translation: 和阿加怎么样了？

english: I give Trollweiss to Aga and she say it taste very nice. She very happy and we together now.
translation: 我把巨魔花给了阿加，她说味道很好。她很高兴，我们现在在一起了。

english: What?! I went through all that trouble to get a snack for a hungry troll?
translation: 什么？！我费了那么大劲就是为了给一个饥饿的巨魔弄点零食？

english: Thank you many for getting Ug together with Aga. We much happy together! I so happy I can't stop crying!
translation: 非常感谢你让乌格和阿加在一起。我们在一起非常幸福！我太高兴了，哭个不停！

english: Hey, what's going on here?
translation: 嘿，这里发生了什么事？

english: Dem's dead ogre's come out of da ground...dey's makin' da rest of us into sick-uns ...and dead-uns.
translation: 那些死掉的食人魔从地里出来了……他们把我们其他人变成了病号……还有死人。

english: That doesn't sound good!
translation: 那听起来不妙！

english: Grish want's da person go down der - see what's what!
translation: 格里什想让人下去看看——看看到底怎么回事！

english: Me's not got no glug-glugs to sell, yous bring me da sickies glug-glug den me's open da stufsies for ya.
translation: 我没有咕噜咕噜药卖，你把病人的咕噜咕噜药带给我，我就为你打开东西。

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Hello again.
translation: 又见面了。

english: Hey yous creature...yous did good fings gedin that glug-glugs for da sickies! All is ogries pepels are not gettin dead cos of you.
translation: 嘿你这生物……你做了件好事，给病人弄到了咕噜咕噜药！所有的食人魔同胞都因为你而没有死去。

english: What are you selling?
translation: 你卖什么？

english: Me's showin' you da stufsies for yous creatures!
translation: 我给你看看你们这些生物用的东西！

english: Hey, here you go! I brought you some of the potion which should cure the disease. You said that you would buy some from me.
translation: 嘿，给你！我带了些能治病的药水给你。你说过会从我这里买一些的。

english: Yous creatures is da funny ones...yous already solds me's ones now..and us can now sell un to yous!
translation: 你们这些生物真奇怪……你们已经把东西卖给我了……现在我们可以卖回给你们了！

english: Yous creatures done da good fing...yous get many bright pretties for dis...!
translation: 你们这些生物做得好……你们会得到很多亮晶晶的东西作为奖励……！

english: I's gots a thinky number puzzley for yous!
translation: 我有个数字谜题给你们！

english: Yous gots da numbers?
translation: 你们有数字吗？

english: I's thinks yous needs to thinks again.
translation: 我觉得你们得再想想。

english: Dats da right answer!
translation: 那是正确答案！

english: Hey, what's going on here?
translation: 嘿，这里发生什么事了？

english: What are you selling?
translation: 你卖什么？

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Hello again.
translation: 又见面了。

english: Mmm... looks like that camel would make a nice kebab.
translation: 嗯……那只骆驼看起来能做串不错的烤肉。

english: If I go near that camel, it'll probably bite my hand off.
translation: 如果我靠近那只骆驼，它可能会咬掉我的手。

english: I wonder if that camel has fleas...
translation: 不知道那只骆驼有没有跳蚤……

english: The camel tries to stamp on your foot, but you pull it back quickly.
translation: 骆驼试图踩你的脚，但你迅速缩了回来。

english: The camel turns its head and glares at you.
translation: 骆驼转过头瞪着你。

english: The camel spits at you, and you jump back hurriedly.
translation: 骆驼朝你吐口水，你急忙跳开。

english: Come over here, I'll bite your leg off!
translation: 过来，我咬掉你的腿！

english: Prepare to die, you two-legged combat wrangler!
translation: 准备受死吧，你这个两条腿的战斗驯兽师！

english: Your mother was a jackal, and your father smelt of cactuses!
translation: 你妈是只胡狼，你爸闻起来像仙人掌！

english: Say, aren't you the human who got arrested here the other day, by the boat?
translation: 话说，你不是前几天在船边被抓的那个人类吗？

english: Yes, but we cleared up the whole situation.
translation: 是的，但我们已经澄清了整个情况。

english: Right, right.
translation: 对，对。

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: What... Oh, don't creep up on me like that... I thought you were a Ghast!
translation: 什么……哦，别那样悄悄靠近我……我还以为是恶魂！

english: Can I go through the gate please?
translation: 请问我能通过这扇门吗？

english: Absolutely not! I've been given strict instructions not to let anyone through. It's just too dangerous. No one gets in without Drezelssay so!
translation: 绝对不行！我接到严格命令不能让任何人通过。太危险了。没有德雷泽尔的允许谁都不能进！

english: Where is Drezel?
translation: 德雷泽尔在哪？

english: Oh, he's in the temple, just go back over the bridge, down the ladder and along the hallway, you can't miss him.
translation: 哦，他在神庙里，只要过桥，爬下梯子，沿着走廊走，你不会错过他的。

english: But I'm doing a quest for Drezel!
translation: 但我正在为德雷泽尔做任务！

english: Ok, on your way then!
translation: 好的，那你走吧！

english: Yes of course my friend, you seem to be able to handle yourself with those ghasts really well.
translation: 当然可以，我的朋友，你看起来对付那些恶魂很有一套。

english: Oh my! You're still alive!
translation: 天哪！你还活着！

english: Very well done! Here you go!
translation: 干得非常好！给你！

english: Ulizius has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
translation: 乌利修斯给了你 [another clue scroll/a casket]！

english: The serum it works...but it's not too fresh, make some yourself and then it might work for longer.
translation: 药剂有效……但不太新鲜，你自己做一些，效果可能会更持久。

english: Ah, hello again, what can I do for you now?
translation: 啊，又见面了，现在有什么能帮你的？

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Hello again! Many thanks for helping us to solve the  riddle with the Shades, we can start to work now  putting all those Shade spirits to rest and get  a little bit of a reward to go along with it!
translation: 又见面了！非常感谢你帮我们解开了阴魂的谜题，我们现在可以开始让那些幽影灵魂安息了，还能得到一点奖励！

english: Well done...I feel this serum is really working on me. I think you've cracked it my friend!  I'd like to give you something for your trouble!
translation: 干得好……我感觉这药剂真的对我有效。我想你搞定它了，我的朋友！我想给你点东西作为回报！

english: You've already used the permanent serum on me, you don't need to use that any more.
translation: 你已经对我用过永久药剂了，不需要再用了。

english: You can't milk this cow, as its udders seem to have fallen off at some point.
translation: 你挤不了这头牛的奶，它的乳房似乎什么时候掉下来了。

english: Hello there [laddie/lass].
translation: 你好 [laddie/lass]。

english: Tell me about the Wintertodt.
translation: 跟我讲讲冬将军。

english: They say it's some kind of powerful fire spirit.
translation: 据说它是某种强大的火焰之灵。

english: Don't you mean ice?
translation: 你不是指冰吗？

english: Aye that as well.
translation: 是的，也是冰。

english: What it is doesn't bother me, just as long as we keep it behind the Doors.
translation: 它是什么我不在乎，只要我们能把它关在门后就行。

english: Tell me about the Doors of Dinh.
translation: 跟我讲讲丁之门。

english: The Doors were built by Dinh to contain the Wintertodt. This was over a thousand years ago and they still stand today.
translation: 丁之门是丁建造的，用来困住冬将军。那是一千多年前的事了，它们至今仍然屹立。

english: Who was Dinh?
translation: 丁是谁？

english: Dinh was the greatest smith that the world has ever seen. I am the finest smith around today and even I cannot match his abilities.
translation: 丁是世间最伟大的铁匠。我是当今最出色的铁匠，但即使我也无法与他相比。

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 跟我讲讲你自己。

english: The name's Undor. You'll struggle to find a dwarf in this land who knows more about metalwork than me.
translation: 我叫昂多尔。你很难在这片土地上找到比我更懂金属加工的矮人。

english: One day I hope to be as good as the legendary Dinh himself.
translation: 我希望有一天能像传奇的丁本人一样出色。

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: They say the doors are failing and the Wintertodt is trying to escape. I'm here to prove to them that the Doors are fine.
translation: 据说门快撑不住了，冬将军正试图逃脱。我来这里是为了向他们证明门没问题。

english: And are they?
translation: 它们没问题吗？

english: Of course they are! They were made by Dinh himself.
translation: 当然没问题！它们是丁亲手建造的。

english: I'm just here to keep an eye on things. Even though the Doors are fixed now, it will take many years for things to get back to normal.
translation: 我只是来这里监视情况。即使门现在已经修好了，也要很多年才能恢复正常。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Until next time [laddie/lass].
translation: 下次再见 [laddie/lass]。

english: Tell me about the Wintertodt.

english: Tell me about the Doors of Dinh.

english: Goodbye.

english: Hi Unferth. How are you doing?
translation: 嗨，昂弗斯。你怎么样？

english: It's just not the same without Bob around.
translation: 鲍勃不在，感觉就是不一样。

english: I'm so sorry Unferth.
translation: 我真为你难过，昂弗斯。

english: Gertrude asked me if I'd like one of her new kittens. I don't think I'm ready for that yet.
translation: 格特鲁德问我要不要她的一只新小猫。我觉得我还没准备好。

english: Give it time. Things will get better, I promise.
translation: 给点时间。情况会好起来的，我保证。

english: Thanks [player name].
translation: 谢谢 [player name]。

english: Your Legendary exploits are travelling the whole jungle.
translation: 你的传奇事迹传遍了整个丛林。

english: Gujuo has been to see me. He told me that you have been given a sacred totem pole. It was constructed by one of my ancestors many moons ago. It is a noble prize Bwana, you have earned it. Look after it well.
translation: 古朱奥来找过我。他告诉我你得到了一根神圣图腾柱。那是我的祖先许多月前制作的。这是崇高的奖赏，先生，你应得的。好好保管它。

english: Ungadulu unleashes a bolt of magical energy at you. You're knocked out of the octagram by the power of the spell.
translation: 昂加杜鲁向你释放一道魔法能量。你被法术的力量击出了八芒星。

english: I hope that teaches you to respect your elders!
translation: 希望这能让你学会尊重长辈！

english: The spell fizzles and has no effect as it passes through the flames.
translation: 法术穿过火焰时失效了，没有任何效果。

english: You feel certain that your weapon would melt if you tried to attack through these magical flames.
translation: 你确信如果试图穿过这些魔法火焰攻击，你的武器会熔化。

english: You missed!
translation: 你打偏了！

english: The vial smashes on Ungadulu, soaking him in sacred water.
translation: 小瓶在昂加杜鲁身上摔碎，把他浸透了圣水。

english: Vile serpent, thou wilt pay for that!
translation: 邪恶的毒蛇，你会为此付出代价！

english: ...What, what happened? Why am I all wet?
translation: ……什么，发生什么了？我怎么全身湿透了？

english: The shaman somehow resists the power of the spell.
translation: 萨满不知何故抵抗住了法术的力量。

english: What...what's happening...
translation: 什么……发生什么了……

english: Perhaps you should try again?
translation: 也许你应该再试一次？

english: Ha ha ha ha! Die, Vacu!
translation: 哈哈哈哈！去死吧，瓦库！

english: Ungadulu casts a spell!
translation: 昂加杜鲁施法了！

english: Please, just run...
translation: 求你了，快跑……

english: The shaman seems to be fighting an inner battle.
translation: 萨满似乎在进行内心斗争。

english: The shaman's expression changes entirely.
translation: 萨满的表情完全改变了。

english: Welcome Vacu, to eternal...
translation: 欢迎瓦库，进入永恒……

english: Foolish Vacu... now thou shalt be my pawn...
translation: 愚蠢的瓦库……现在你将成为我的棋子……

english: The thing that was the shaman begins to chant...
translation: 那个曾经是萨满的东西开始吟唱……

english: Iles Resti Yam Darkus Spiritus Possesi Yanai...
translation: 伊莱斯‧雷斯蒂‧亚姆‧达库斯‧斯皮里图斯‧波塞西‧亚奈……

english: You feel a strange power coming over you...
translation: 你感到一股奇怪的力量笼罩着你……

english: You feel very weak..
translation: 你感到非常虚弱……

english: The thing seems to get stronger!
translation: 那个东西似乎变得更强了！

english: Run, Bwana! Stay away from here!
translation: 快跑，先生！离这里远点！

english: Just in time, the shaman wrests back control.
translation: 千钧一发之际，萨满夺回了控制权。

english: Thank you, Bwana! You have released me from the demon's grasp, but only for a short while! You must seek out the Book of Binding - it's hidden in these caves somewhere!.

english: I have a story about that.
translation: 我有个关于那个的故事。

english: I heard that the tall man fears only strong winds.
translation: 我听说高个子只害怕强风。

english: I quite fancy an onion.
translation: 我挺想要个洋葱。

english: In Canifis the men are known for eating much spam.
translation: 在坎尼非斯村，人们以吃很多午餐肉闻名。

english: In the end, only the three-legged will survive.
translation: 最后，只有三条腿的能活下来。

english: It is possible to commit no mistakes and still lose.
translation: 有可能不犯任何错误但仍然失败。

english: Loser says what.
translation: 输家说什么。

english: My magic carpet is full of eels.
translation: 我的魔毯上全是鳗鱼。

english: Once, I was a poor man, but then I found a party hat.
translation: 曾经，我是个穷人，但后来我找到了一顶派对帽。

english: Quickly! I've got a bee sticking out of my arm!
translation: 快！我胳膊上扎了只蜜蜂！

english: The slowest of fishermen catch the swiftest of fish.
translation: 最慢的渔夫能抓到最快的鱼。

english: *sneezes* What?
translation: 打喷嚏 什么？

english: The sudden appearance of a deaf squirrel is most puzzling, comrade.
translation: 聋松鼠的突然出现最令人困惑，同志。

english: There were three goblins in a bar, which one left first?
translation: 酒吧里有三个哥布林，哪个先离开？

english: Up in the north, I hear they keep milk in bags rather than buckets.
translation: 在北方，我听说他们用袋子装牛奶而不是桶。

english: Want to see me bend a spoon?
translation: 想看我把勺子弄弯吗？

english: What's cheese?
translation: 什么是乳酪？

english: Would you like to buy a pewter spoon?
translation: 你想买把锡镴勺吗？

english: What?
translation: 什么？

english: You have been given a [new clue/casket]!
translation: 你获得了一个 [new clue/casket]！

english: I do not believe we have any business, Comrade.
translation: 同志，我不认为我们有什么事要谈。

english: The puffins are up to something!
translation: 海鹦在搞什么名堂！

english: 9 years my princess, forever my light.
translation: 九年我的公主，永远我的光。

english: Ahhhhhh, leeches!
translation: 啊啊啊，水蛭！

english: The Ankou's are a lie.
translation: 昂骷是谎言。

english: (Breathing intensifies)
translation: (呼吸加剧)

english: Brother, do you even lift?
translation: 兄弟，你举重吗？

english: Connection lost. Please wait - attempting to reestablish.
translation: 连接丢失。请稍候 - 正在尝试重新建立。

english: Do you want ants? Because that's how you get ants.
translation: 你想要蚂蚁吗？因为这就是你得到蚂蚁的方式。

english: Don't forget to find the jade monkey.
translation: 别忘了找到玉猴。

english: Fancy a holiday? I heard there was a whole other world to the west.
translation: 想度假吗？我听说西边有另一个世界。

english: Guys, let's lake dive!
translation: 伙计们，我们去湖潜吧！

english: I don't like pineapple, it has that bone in it.
translation: 我不喜欢菠萝，它里面有那个骨头。

english: I gave you what you needed; not what you think you needed.
translation: 我给了你需要的东西；不是你认为你需要的东西。

english: I once named a duck after a girl. Big mistake, they all hated it.
translation: 我曾经用女孩的名字给鸭子命名。大错特错，它们都讨厌那样。

english: I told him not to go near that fence, and what did he do? Sheesh....
translation: 我告诉他别靠近那个栅栏，他做了什么？天哪……

english: I took a college course in bowling; still not any good.
translation: 我上过大学保龄球课程；还是不行。

english: I'm going to get married, to the night.
translation: 我要结婚了，和夜晚。

english: I'm looking for a girl named Molly. I can't seem to find her. any assistance?
translation: 我在找一个叫莫莉的女孩。我似乎找不到她。能帮忙吗？

english: Init doe. Lyk, I hope yer reward iz goodd aye?
translation: 不知道。希望你的奖励不错，对吧？

english: Is that Deziree?
translation: 那是德西蕾吗？

english: It is quite easy being green.
translation: 做绿色很简单。

english: Mate, mate... I'm the best.
translation: 伙计，伙计……我是最棒的。

english: Mother's parsnips tasted like onion.
translation: 妈妈的欧洲防风草尝起来像洋葱。

english: Oranges are the fruit of the vegetable.
translation: 橙子是蔬菜的水果。

english: Some say...
translation: 有人说……

english: There's this guy I sit next to. Makes weird faces and sounds. Kind of an odd fellow.
translation: 有个坐我旁边的家伙。做奇怪的表情和声音。有点怪。

english: This is the last night you'll spend alone.
translation: 这是你独自度过的最后一晚。

english: Tonight we dine................quite nicely actually.
translation: 今晚我们用餐……实际上相当不错。

english: Took a hair dryer to a party in my handbag. Ah, so fabulous!!
translation: 我带了吹风机去派对，放在手提包里。啊，太棒了！！

english: Good day to you.
translation: 你好。

english: It's not that good, it's a bit warm.
translation: 没那么好，有点热。

english: The curse has been removed. Word around the town is that you were the one who helped remove it.
translation: 诅咒已经被解除了。镇上传闻是你帮忙解除的。

english: Yes that is correct. The spirits of the Elid cursed the town for throwing away a statue to Elidinis. I got it back
translation: 是的，没错。伊利德之灵因为镇上丢弃了伊莉迪尼斯的雕像而诅咒了这里。我把它找回来了

english: Well we thank you. You're pretty much a local hero now.
translation: 嗯，我们感谢你。你现在几乎是当地英雄了。

english: All this mining is tiring work.
translation: 所有这些采矿都是累人的工作。

english: But you're not even mining at the moment.
translation: 但你现在根本没在采矿。

english: Hey! I've been mining all day thank you very much! I'm allowed a break ain't I?
translation: 嘿！我采了一整天矿了，非常感谢！我总该休息一下吧？

english: Yes, I suppose.
translation: 是的，我想也是。

english: I should think so. Anyway did you need anything?
translation: 我也这么想。总之你需要什么吗？

english: What are these rocks?
translation: 这些是什么石头？

english: Rocks? They're not rocks, they're minerals!
translation: 石头？它们不是石头，是矿物！

english: Oh okay. What are they though?
translation: 哦好的。那它们是什么？

english: Amethyst! We use it a lot back in Keldagrim but this is the only place we've managed to find it.
translation: 紫水晶！我们在凯尔达格林城用得很多，但这是我们唯一找到它的地方。

english: What can I use it for?
translation: 我能用它做什么？

english: We've found it's quite good for ranging ammunition, something you adventuring lot might like.
translation: 我们发现它很适合做远程弹药，你们这些冒险者可能会喜欢。

english: We use it a lot for Construction back in Keldagrim as well.
translation: 我们在凯尔达格林城也用它做很多建筑。

english: Awesome! Does that mean I can use it in my house?
translation: 太棒了！那我能在我的房子里用它吗？

english: No.
translation: 不能。

english: Why not?
translation: 为什么不能？

english: Because I said so that's why! Even the best human builders wouldn't know how to build with this stuff.
translation: 因为我说了算！即使最好的人类建筑商也不知道怎么用这东西建造。

english: And you're a long way off the best, believe me.
translation: 而且你离最好的还差得远，相信我。

english: Awww.
translation: 哎呀。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Well be on your way then. I've got mining to do!
translation: 那你走吧。我还要采矿呢！

english: What are these rocks?
translation: 这些是什么石头？

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Hello, who are you?
translation: 你好，你是谁？

english: Greetings human. I am Uurrak quo Narga, a guardian for the Kahlith. Have you come to serve the balance?
translation: 问候人类。我是乌拉克‧夸‧纳尔加，卡利特的守护者。你是来为平衡服务的吗？

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: Then you should speak to Konar quo Maten. She will guide you.
translation: 那你应该和科纳尔‧夸‧马滕谈谈。她会指引你。

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: A shame. You are a bringer of death, you could be of great use to the balance.
translation: 真可惜。你是死亡使者，本可以为平衡发挥很大作用。

english: I'm not sure.
translation: 我不确定。

english: Then you should speak with Xorrah quo Sihar. He will show you the way.
translation: 那你应该和佐拉‧夸‧西哈尔谈谈。他会给你指路。

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: I'm not sure.
translation: 我不确定。

english: Good day, Uwogo.
translation: 你好，乌沃戈。

english: Get away from me, you foul commoner!
translation: 离我远点，你这个卑贱的平民！

english: Guards! I've spotted a human!
translation: 卫兵！发现人类！

english: Hello. Shouldn't you be on guard duty?
translation: 你好。你不应该在值勤吗？

english: In this state? I've had too many beer s'already, beside' s'I'm off duty.
translation: 就我这状态？我已经喝了太多啤酒了，而且我下班了。

english: The commander 's'given me the day off.
translation: 指挥官给我放了一天假。

english: Hi.
translation: 嗨。

english: You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 你知道，打招呼的方式有很多种。你好，嘿，你好啊……

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: 那也只算一种！

english: Hello. How are you today?
translation: 你好。今天过得怎么样？

english: I'm great, thank you!
translation: 我很好，谢谢！

english: Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 你好！水晶城今天天气真不错，是吧？

english: Indeed.
translation: 确实。

english: What can I do for ya?
translation: 我能为你做点什么？

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可做的？

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 各种各样的事！那些塔楼景色很棒。

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 像今天这样的日子，我建议去逛逛市场。

english: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你觉得你在做什么？

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可做的？

english: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: Hello there. Want to have a look at what we're selling today?
translation: 你好。想看看我们今天卖什么吗？

english: No thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Hello there. What are you doing here?
translation: 你好。你在这里做什么？

english: I'm waiting here hoping that someone can guide me to the Paterdomus, the temple on the Salve.
translation: 我在这里等，希望有人能带我去帕特多穆斯，萨鲁夫河上的神庙。

english: Where is Paterdomus?
translation: 帕特多穆斯在哪？

english: Oh, Paterdomus is that rather impressive looking temple on the Salve... I'm sure you must have passed it on your way into Morytania.
translation: 哦，帕特多穆斯就是萨鲁夫河上那座看起来很宏伟的神庙……我相信你进入莫利塔尼亚时一定经过它了。

english: Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
translation: 你为什么想去帕特多穆斯？

english: I'm hoping to get back to civilisation and see what the lands of Misthalin look like.
translation: 我希望能重返文明世界，看看米斯塔林王國的土地是什么样子。

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Paterdomus?
translation: 如果我们在去帕特多穆斯的路上遇到敌人，你能自保吗？

english: I can defend myself somewhat if we run into trouble...yes, but let's hope that we don't, eh!
translation: 如果遇到麻烦我能稍微自保……是的，但希望不会遇到，对吧！

english: I can take you to Paterdomus.
translation: 我可以带你去帕特多穆斯。

english: Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: 嗯，看来你有个随从。我想若是让它独自乱跑，这趟路上恐怕会走丢。等你的随从安顿好了我们再动身。

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: 真的吗？那太好了！到达目的地后我会给你报酬。

english: Temple Trekking begins
translation: 神庙徒步开始

english: Ok, which route should we take?
translation: 好的，我们应该走哪条路线？

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: 啊，所以你想给我一些补给？让我打开我的背包看看。

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than staying in Burgh de Rott.
translation: 哦，我讨厌这趟旅程，但总比待在洛特堡强。

english: It's scary here...let's get going!
translation: 这里好可怕……我们走吧！

english: When are we going to get to Paterdomus?
translation: 我们什么时候能到帕特多穆斯？

english: We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on.
translation: 我们没时间站在这里聊天；我们继续前进吧。

english: Do you visit Paterdomus often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: 你经常去帕特多穆斯吗？你似乎很熟悉这条路。

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...?
translation: 你没看见我正在挨打吗……？

english: Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
translation: 谢谢，我把这个喝下去。

english: Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Burgh de Rott. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: 天哪！看来我们得回洛特堡了。我们过不了那座桥！

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
translation: 哦，我相信我们能找到办法！

english: Player completes the bridge event
translation: 玩家完成了桥梁事件

english: Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Burgh de Rott.
translation: 这下糟了……看来我们过不了这片沼泽，得回洛特堡了。

english: Player completes the bog event
translation: 玩家完成了沼泽事件

english: Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
translation: 太棒了！干得漂亮，我会跟紧你。

english: Whahay...that was great!
translation: 哇哈……太棒了！

english: But we really should be heading off now.
translation: 不过我们现在真得赶紧上路了。

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
translation: 放心，我们一定能找到路过去的！

english: Player completes the river event
translation: 玩家完成了河流事件

english: That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
translation: 太厉害了！我也得照做。

english: Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: 哇哈……太棒了！不过我们现在真得赶紧上路了。

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
translation: 那……那些气泡是什么？

english: This is scary!
translation: 这太可怕了！

english: Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
translation: 啊，那应该是触手……

english: Ahhh, two tentacles!
translation: 啊，两根触手！

english: ...three tentacles!
translation: ……三根触手！

english: I think I'm going to faint!
translation: 我觉得我要晕了！

english: Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: 天哪！看那怪物！你得自己解决那东西！

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the temple. Here's your reward.
translation: 多谢你平安把我带到神庙，这是你的报酬。

english: Valantay Eppel gives you a reward token!
translation: 瓦兰泰‧埃佩尔给了你一个奖励代币！

english: Where is Paterdomus?
translation: 帕特多穆斯在哪？

english: Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
translation: 你为什么想去帕特多穆斯？

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
translation: 如果我们在路上遇到敌人，你能自保吗？

english: I can take you to Paterdomus.
translation: 我可以带你去帕特多穆斯。

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Wooo?  Woooo woo woooooo wooooo woooowooo wooo woooooo woo!
translation: 呜？呜呜呜 呜 呜呜呜呜 呜呜呜 呜呜呜呜呜 呜呜 呜呜呜呜 呜！

english: You don't say?
translation: 真的吗？

english: Woo! WOO WOOOOO WOOWOOWOO WOO WOOOOO!
translation: 呜！呜 呜呜呜呜 呜呜呜呜呜 呜 呜呜呜呜！

english: You don't say!
translation: 真的吗！

english: Wooowoowoooooo.... Woowoowoo? Woooo, wooowoo wooowooowooo!
translation: 呜呜呜呜呜呜……呜呜呜呜？呜呜，呜呜呜 呜呜呜呜呜！

english: Well, I guess you didn't say.
translation: 嗯，我想你什么都没说。

english: Yeah, I don't want to brag, but seriously: I am SOOOO rich....
translation: 是啊，我不想吹牛，但说真的：我超级超级有钱……

english: Yeah, I know they say money doesn't bring you happiness, but sometimes I just like to open my bank account and look at all of the stuff I own and just think to myself:
translation: 是啊，我知道人们说钱不能带来幸福，但有时候我就喜欢打开银行账户，看着我所有的东西，然后对自己说：

english: Wow. I am soooooo rich.
translation: 哇。我超级超级有钱。

english: Well, us rich alive people don't want to waste all day spending time with you poor dead people, because I'm just sooooo rich I have to go now, and very possibly make myself even richer.
translation: 嗯，我们这些富有的活人不想整天和你们这些可怜的死人浪费时间，因为我太有钱了，我得走了，很可能让自己变得更富有。

english: See ya around ghosty!
translation: 回见，鬼魂！

english: Yeah, I heard about that, ha-ha-ha!
translation: 是啊，我听说过那事，哈哈哈！

english: With a MACKEREL? Ouch!
translation: 用鲭鱼？哎哟！

english: Well, it was fun. Let's do it again sometime.
translation: 嗯，挺有趣的。改天再来一次。

english: Why, thank you very much!
translation: 哎呀，非常感谢！

english: I know, but what are you going to do?
translation: 我知道，但你能怎么办？

english: Well, I guess that's always true in the long run. See you around, weird invisible dead person!
translation: 嗯，我想从长远来看那总是对的。回见，奇怪的隐形死人！

english: Yeah it's not bad, but I prefer cooked chicken.
translation: 是啊还不错，但我更喜欢熟鸡肉。

english: Maybe, but nothing beats a home cooked pie!
translation: 也许吧，但没什么比得上家常派！

english: Man, I love pie!
translation: 天哪，我爱派！

english: You don't say? I never knew that. Well, I must be going, see you around.
translation: 真的吗？我从不知道。嗯，我得走了，回见。

english: We get signal!
translation: 我们有信号了！

english: Somebody set up us the bomb!
translation: 有人给我们设置了炸弹！

english: You have no chance to survive make your time.
translation: 你没有生存机会，抓紧时间吧。

english: Woo?
translation: 呜？

english: All your base are belong to us.
translation: 你们所有的基地都属于我们。

english: Hey, don't think you can talk to me like that!
translation: 嘿，别以为你能那样跟我说话！

english: Are you threatening me?
translation: 你在威胁我吗？

english: Just because you're already dead, doesn't mean I can't find a way to hurt you ghosty!
translation: 就因为你已经死了，不代表我找不到方法伤害你，鬼魂！

english: No, I've never been there in my life and CERTAINLY didn't steal anything when I was!
translation: 不，我这辈子从没去过那里，当然也没在那里偷过任何东西！

english: Are you calling me a liar?!?! I have never stolen a thing in my life, and I resent the implication that I am the kind of morally depraved individual that would steal someone else's hard earned
translation: 你在说我是骗子？！我这辈子从没偷过东西，我讨厌这种暗示，说我是那种会偷别人辛苦赚来的

english: money from their very pockets!
translation: 钱的人！

english: Or cakes. Or fur. Repeatedly. For long periods at a time.
translation: 或者蛋糕。或者毛皮。反复地。一次很长时间。

english: Well if you are going to take that attitude, then I have nothing further to say on the matter, and bid you good day!
translation: 好吧，如果你要采取那种态度，那我对此无话可说，祝你日安！

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。
