english: Do I look like I care? To me you're just another newcomer who thinks they're ready to fight.
translation: 我看起来像在乎吗？对我来说你只是另一个自以为准备好战斗的新人。

english: I am Vannaka, the greatest swordsman alive, and I'm here to teach you the basics of combat. Let's get started by teaching you to wield a weapon.
translation: 我是瓦纳卡，在世最伟大的剑客，我来教你战斗基础。我们先从教你使用武器开始。

english: Let's get started by teaching you to wield a weapon.
translation: 我们先从教你使用武器开始。

english: Very good, but that little butter knife isn't going to protect you much. Let's get you something a bit better. Once you're properly equipped we can move on to some actual combat.
translation: 很好，但那把小餐刀保护不了你多少。我给你弄点更好的。等你装备好了我们就可以进行实际战斗了。

english: Let's get you equipped.
translation: 给你装备好。

english: You should check out the combat interface.
translation: 你应该看看战斗界面。

english: Time for some actual combat! Head into the pen and kill one of those rats.
translation: 实际战斗时间！进入围栏杀死一只老鼠。

english: I did it! I killed a giant rat!
translation: 我做到了！我杀死了一只巨型老鼠！

english: I saw. You seem better at this than I thought. Now that you have grasped basic swordplay, let's move on.
translation: 我看到了。你似乎比我想象的更擅长这个。既然你已经掌握了基本剑术，我们继续。

english: Next up we have ranged attacking. With this you can kill foes from a distance. With ranged, you'll be able to attack the rats without entering the pit meaning they won't be able to fight back.
translation: 接下来是远程攻击。用这个你可以从远处杀死敌人。使用远程，你可以在不进入坑的情况下攻击老鼠，意味着它们无法反击。

english: Use your bow and arrows to kill one of those rats from outside the pen.
translation: 用你的弓和箭从围栏外杀死一只老鼠。

english: Do you need something?
translation: 你需要什么吗？

english: Tell me about combat stats again.
translation: 再跟我讲讲战斗属性。

english: Certainly. You have three main combat stats: Strength, Defence and Attack.
translation: 当然。你有三个主要战斗属性：力量、防御和攻击。

english: Strength determines the maximum hit you will be able to deal with your blows, Defence determines the amount of damage you will be able to defend and Attack determines the accuracy of your blows.
translation: 力量决定你攻击能造成的最大伤害，防御决定你能抵挡的伤害量，攻击决定你攻击的准确度。

english: Other stats are used in combat such as Prayer, Hitpoints, Magic and Ranged. All of these stats can go towards determining your combat level, which is shown near the top of your combat interface screen.
translation: 其他属性也用于战斗，如祈祷、生命值、魔法和远程。所有这些属性都会影响你的战斗等级，显示在战斗界面屏幕顶部附近。

english: You will find out on the mainland that certain items can also affect your stats. There are potions that can be drunk that can alter your stats temporarily, such as raising Strength.
translation: 你会在大陆发现某些物品也会影响你的属性。有一些药水可以喝来临时改变你的属性，比如提升力量。

english: You will also raise your Defence and Attack values by using different weapons and armours.
translation: 使用不同的武器和盔甲也会提升你的防御和攻击值。

english: Before going into combat with an opponent it is wise to put the mouse over them and see what combat level they are.
translation: 在与对手战斗前，明智的做法是把鼠标放在他们身上看看他们的战斗等级。

english: Green coloured writing usually means it will be an easy fight for you, red means you will probably lose, yellow means they are around your level and orange means they are slightly stronger.
translation: 绿色文字通常意味着对你来说是轻松的战斗，红色意味着你可能会输，黄色意味着他们和你等级相近，橙色意味着他们稍强。

english: Sometimes things will go your way, sometimes they won't. There is no such thing as a guaranteed win, but if the odds are on your side, you stand the best chance of walking away victorious.
translation: 有时事情会如你所愿，有时不会。没有必胜这回事，但如果胜算在你这边，你最有希望胜利。

english: Now, was there something else you wanted to hear about again?
translation: 现在，还有什么你想再听的吗？

english: Tell me about melee combat again.
translation: 再跟我讲讲近战。

english: Ah, my speciality. Close combat fighting, which is also known as melee fighting, covers all combat done at close range to your opponent.
translation: 啊，我的专长。近身战斗，也称为近战，涵盖所有与对手近距离进行的战斗。

english: Melee fighting depends entirely upon your three basic combat stats: Attack, Defence, and Strength.
translation: 近战完全取决于你的三个基本战斗属性：攻击、防御和力量。

english: Also, of course, it depends on the quality of your armour and weaponry. A high-levelled fighter with good armour and weapons will be deadly up close.
translation: 当然，也取决于你的盔甲和武器质量。一个高等级战士带着好盔甲和武器在近身时是致命的。

english: If this is the path you wish to take, remember your success depends on getting as close to your enemy as quickly as possible.
translation: 如果这是你想走的路，记住你的成功取决于尽快接近你的敌人。

english: Personally, I consider the fine art of melee combat to be the ONLY combat method worth using.
translation: 就我个人而言，我认为近战艺术是唯一值得使用的战斗方法。

english: Now, did you want to hear anything else?
translation: 现在，你还想听别的吗？

english: Tell me about ranged combat again.
translation: 再跟我讲讲远程战斗。

english: Thinking of being a ranger, eh? Well, okay. I don't enjoy it myself, but I can see the appeal.
translation: 想当游侠，嗯？好吧，行。我自己不喜欢，但我能理解它的吸引力。

english: Ranging employs a lot of different weapons as a skill, not just the shortbow you have there. Spears, throwing knives, and crossbows are all used best at a distance from your enemy.
translation: 远程作为技能使用很多不同的武器，不只是你那里的短弓。长矛、飞刀和弩都在远离敌人时使用效果最好。

english: Now, those rats were easy pickings, but on the mainland you will be very lucky if you can find a spot where you can shoot at your enemies without them being able to retaliate.
translation: 那些老鼠容易对付，但在大陆上，如果你能找到一个可以射击敌人而它们无法反击的地方，那你就很幸运了。

english: At close range, rangers often do badly in combat. Your best tactic as a ranger is to hit and run, keeping your foe at a distance.
translation: 在近身时，游侠往往战斗表现不佳。作为游侠，你最好的战术是打了就跑，让敌人保持距离。

english: Your effectiveness as a ranger is almost entirely dependent on your Ranged stat. As with all skills, the more you train it, the more powerful it will become.
translation: 你作为游侠的效果几乎完全取决于你的远程属性。和所有技能一样，你训练得越多，它就会变得越强大。

english: Anything else you wanted to know?
translation: 还有什么你想知道的吗？

english: Tell me about the Wilderness again.
translation: 再跟我讲讲荒野。

english: Ah yes, the Wilderness. It is a place of evil, mark my words. Many is the colleague I have lost in that foul place.
translation: 啊是的，荒野。那是个邪恶之地，记住我的话。我在那里失去了很多同事。

english: It is also a place of both adventure and wealth, so if you are brave enough and strong enough to survive it, you will make a killing. Literally!
translation: 那也是冒险和财富之地，所以如果你足够勇敢和强大能生存下来，你会大赚一笔。字面意义上的！

english: It is also the only place in the land of Gielinor where players are able to attack each other at will, and as such is the haunt of many Player Killers, or PKers if you will.
translation: 那也是基利诺尔大陆上唯一玩家可以随意互相攻击的地方，因此是许多玩家杀手(或称 PKer)的聚集地。

english: There are a few things different in the Wilderness in comparison to the rest of the lands of Gielinor. Firstly, as I just mentioned, you can and will be attacked by other players.
translation: 与基利诺尔大陆其他地方相比，荒野有几点不同。首先，正如我刚才提到的，你会被其他玩家攻击。

english: For this reason, you will be given a warning when you approach the Wilderness, as it is not a place you would wish to enter by accident.
translation: 因此，当你接近荒野时会收到警告，因为那不是你想意外进入的地方。

english: Secondly, there are a number of 'levels' to it. The further into it you travel, the greater the range of people you can attack.
translation: 其次，它有很多''等级''。你进入得越深，你能攻击的人等级范围越大。

english: In level 1 wilderness you will only be able to attack, or be attacked by, those players within one combat level of yourself.
translation: 在1级荒野，你只能攻击或被攻击那些与你战斗等级相差一级以内的玩家。

english: In level 50, any player within fifty levels of you will be able to attack, or be attacked by you. Always keep an eye on what level of the Wilderness you are currently in.
translation: 在50级荒野，任何与你等级相差五十级以内的玩家都能攻击你或被你攻击。时刻注意你当前在荒野的等级。

english: Your current Wilderness level is shown at the bottom right of the screen. The final thing you should know about the Wilderness is being 'skulled'.
translation: 你当前的荒野等级显示在屏幕右下角。关于荒野你最后应该知道的是''骷髅标记''。

english: If you attack another player without them having attacked first, you will gain a skull above your character's head.
translation: 如果你攻击另一个玩家而他们没先攻击你，你角色头上会出现骷髅标记。

english: What this means is that if you die while skulled, you will lose EVERYTHING that your character was carrying.
translation: 这意味着如果你带着骷髅标记死亡，你会失去角色携带的所有东西。

english: When skulled, you should try to avoid dying for the twenty minutes or so it will take for the skull to wear off.
translation: 带着骷髅标记时，你应该尽量避免在骷髅标记消失前的大约二十分钟内死亡。

english: If you wish to find the Wilderness, head north from where you start on the mainland. It is rather large and hard to miss.
translation: 如果你想找到荒野，从大陆起点向北走。它相当大，很难错过。

english: If you don't wish to end up there, take notice of the warning you will receive when getting near to it.
translation: 如果你不想去那里，注意接近时会收到的警告。

english: Now, was there anything more?
translation: 现在，还有什么吗？

english: Nope, I'm ready to move on!
translation: 不，我准备好继续了！

english: Okay then.
translation: 那好吧。

english: Here, have this.
translation: 给，拿着这个。

english: Here, have this!
translation: 给，拿着这个！

english: I need another assignment.
translation: 我需要另一个任务。

english: Got any tips for me?
translation: 有什么建议给我吗？

english: Okay, great!
translation: 好的，太好了！

english: Yes, please cancel it.
translation: 是的，请取消。

english: No, thanks, I want to try doing it.
translation: 不了，谢谢，我想试试。

english: Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
translation: 你有什么奖励给我，或者有什么可以交易的吗？

english: Look at rewards.
translation: 查看奖励。

english: Look at shop.
translation: 查看商店。

english: Cancel.
translation: 取消。

english: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
translation: 我们聊聊我的任务难度。

english: That's fine - I can handle any task.
translation: 没关系——我能应付任何任务。

english: In future, please don't give anything too tough.
translation: 以后请不要给太难的任务。

english: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.
translation: 没关系——我不想要太难的任务。

english: Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!
translation: 别再检查我的战斗等级了——我什么都能应付！

english: Er... Nothing...
translation: 呃……没什么……

english: Err... Nothing...
translation: 呃……没什么……

english: Tell me about combat stats.
translation: 跟我讲讲战斗属性。

english: Tell me about melee combat again.
translation: 再跟我讲讲近战。

english: Tell me about ranged combat again.
translation: 再跟我讲讲远程战斗。

english: Tell me about the Wilderness.
translation: 跟我讲讲荒野。

english: Nope, I'm ready to move on!
translation: 不，我准备好继续了！

english: Now you look like a vyre in need of some new threads.
translation: 现在你看起来像个需要新衣服的吸血鬼。

english: Let's trade.
translation: 我们交易吧。

english: Do I?
translation: 是吗？

english: Oh yes. And luckily for you, I have everything you could ever need. Clothes, or the materials to make them if that's more your thing. All pre-scented as well.
translation: 哦是的。而且幸运的是，我有你需要的一切。衣服，或者如果你更喜欢的话，制作衣服的材料。全部都预先喷了香水。

english: Pre-scented?
translation: 预先喷了香水？

english: Oh don't go acting like you don't know what I mean. You've done a decent job, but behind that scent, I can tell you're just a lowly vyre.
translation: 哦别装作不知道我什么意思。你做得不错，但在那香味背后，我能看出你只是个低等吸血鬼。

english: Fear not, I am no judge. I know that there are many like you who want a taste of upper class life. That's why all my outfits are scented. Helps you fit right in.
translation: 别怕，我不是法官。我知道有很多像你一样的人想体验上流社会生活。这就是为什么我所有的服装都喷了香水。帮你融入其中。

english: Does it not bother you having lower class vampyres up here?
translation: 有低等吸血鬼在这里你不介意吗？

english: Me? No. As long as you've got money, I don't care who you are.
translation: 我？不。只要你有钱，我不在乎你是谁。

english: Fair enough.
translation: 好吧。

english: So, want to take a look?
translation: 那么，想看看吗？

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

english: I'll be here if you change your mind.
translation: 如果你改变主意我会在这里。

english: Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: 人类！在我叫守卫之前滚回奴隶围栏！

english: Let's trade.
translation: 我们交易吧。

english: Do I?
translation: 是吗？

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。

english: Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: 嘿，是英雄！哇！你太厉害了，你到底是怎么对付那两个成熟吸血鬼和加德兰克斯的？这城镇现在真不错，你做得太棒了！

english: You're more than welcome.
translation: 不用客气。

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Oh, hello, Vasile is the name and I help to keep the village clear of rat infestations. Clearly I love my work, as I bring it home with me...on a stick!
translation: 哦，你好，我叫瓦西尔，我帮助村庄清除鼠患。显然我热爱我的工作，因为我把它带回家……在棍子上！

english: How do you like your town?
translation: 你觉得你的小镇怎么样？

english: It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
translation: 太完美了，非常感谢你的努力。

english: What's happening around here?
translation: 这里发生什么事了？

english: Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: 哦，其实没什么，我们都在躲避吸血鬼，在这个鬼地方艰难度日，希望很快我们能强大到可以前往萨鲁夫河上的神殿。

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: 有什么我能帮忙的吗？

english: Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: 据我所知没有，我们现在有一些基本设施，非常有用，我们都非常感激你。我从前没见过真正的英雄，没法比较，

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: 但我相信，在大多数人眼中，你定是英雄无疑！至少我很高兴见到你。

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: How do you like your town?
translation: 你觉得你的小镇怎么样？

english: What's happening around here?
translation: 这里发生什么事了？

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: 有什么我能帮忙的吗？

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Boots alone do not make an Araxyte.
translation: 光有靴子成不了阿拉克希特。

english: It's a step in the right direction, proceed.
translation: 这是朝着正确方向迈出的一步，继续。

english: Go.
translation: 走。

english: I thought you were going to pass over to the next world.
translation: 我以为你要去下一个世界了。

english: All in good time, [player name]. We stand forever in your debt, and will certainly put in a good word for you when we pass over.
translation: 时机成熟时会的，[player name]。我们永远欠你的情，当我们过去时一定会为你美言几句。

english: Can I have another Ectophial?
translation: 能再给我一个灵瓶吗？

english: Really? You've already got an Ectophial.
translation: 真的？你已经有一个灵瓶了。

english: I know, but can I have another one anyway?
translation: 我知道，但我能再要一个吗？

english: Of course you can, you have helped us more than we could ever have hoped.
translation: 当然可以，你帮助我们的程度超出了我们的期望。

english: Have I? Okay, forget it.
translation: 是吗？好吧，算了。

english: I thought you were going to pass over to the next world.
translation: 我以为你要去下一个世界了。

english: Can I have another Ectophial?
translation: 能再给我一个灵瓶吗？

english: I know, but can I have another one anyway?
translation: 我知道，但我能再要一个吗？

english: Have I? Okay, forget it.
translation: 是吗？好吧，算了。

english: Thank you for rescuing me! It isn't very comfy in this cell.
translation: 谢谢你救我！这个牢房不太舒服。

english: So... do you know anywhere good to explore?
translation: 那么……你知道有什么好地方可以探索吗？

english: Well, this dungeon was quite good to explore ...until I got captured, anyway. I was given a key to an inner part of this dungeon by a mysterious cloaked stranger!
translation: 嗯，这个地牢探索起来相当不错……直到我被抓为止。一个神秘的斗篷陌生人给了我一把这个地牢内部的钥匙！

english: It's rather tough for me to get that far into the dungeon however... I just keep getting captured! Would you like to give it a go?
translation: 不过对我来说要深入那个地牢相当困难……我总是被抓！你想试试吗？

english: Yes please!
translation: 好的，谢谢！

english: No, it's too dangerous for me too.
translation: 不，对我来说也太危险了。

english: I don't blame you!
translation: 我不怪你！

english: Do I get a reward? For freeing you and all...
translation: 我有奖励吗？毕竟我救了你……

english: Well... not really... The Black Knights took all of my stuff before throwing me in here to rot!
translation: 嗯……不太有……黑骑士把我扔进来腐烂之前拿走了我所有的东西！

english: Are you still here?
translation: 你还在这里吗？

english: Yes... I'm still plucking up the courage to run out past those Black Knights...
translation: 是的……我还在鼓起勇气跑过那些黑骑士……

english: So... do you know anywhere good to explore?
translation: 那么……你知道有什么好地方可以探索吗？

english: Yes please!
translation: 好的，谢谢！

english: No, it's too dangerous for me too.
translation: 不，对我来说也太危险了。

english: Do I get a reward for freeing you?
translation: 我救你有奖励吗？

english: It's a damn good thing I don't have arachnophobia.
translation: 幸好我没有蜘蛛恐惧症。

english: We're misunderstood. Without us in your house, you'd be infested with flies and other REAL nasties.
translation: 我们被误解了。如果没有我们在你家里，你会被苍蝇和其他真正的害虫侵扰。

english: Thanks for that enlightening fact.
translation: 谢谢这个有启发性的事实。

english: Everybody gets one.
translation: 每人一个。

english: *slap*
translation: 拍打

english: Grrr!
translation: 咕噜！

english: Grrrr!
translation: 咕噜噜！

english: Grarrr!
translation: 咕噜噜噜！

english: Hello, who are you?
translation: 你好，你是谁？

english: I am Veos and I've just arrived in Port Sarim from the distant Kingdom of Great Kourend.
translation: 我是维奥斯，我刚从遥远的库兰德王国来到沙林港。

english: Where's that?
translation: 那在哪里？

english: Across the sea, to the far west.
translation: 跨过大海，在遥远的西方。

english: Tell me more about Great Kourend.
translation: 多跟我讲讲库兰德王国。

english: Great Kourend is a magnificent kingdom comprising of five cities. They are the cities of Arceuus, Lovakengj, Shayzien, Piscarilius and Hosidius. Each city is ruled by one of the five houses of Kourend.
translation: 库兰德王国是一个宏伟的王国，由五座城市组成。它们是阿西乌斯城、洛瓦肯吉城、谢兹恩城、皮斯卡里琉斯城和霍西迪乌斯城。每座城市由库兰德五大家族之一统治。

english: At one time, the kingdom as a whole was ruled over by a king or queen that the five houses answered to.
translation: 曾经，整个王国由一位国王或女王统治，五大家族向其效忠。

english: However, since the last King died 20 years ago, the kingdom has instead been ruled by the Kourend Council.
translation: 然而，自从20年前最后一位国王去世后，王国改由库兰德议会统治。

english: That's great, can you take me there please?
translation: 太好了，你能带我去那里吗？

english: Certainly! I hope you don't get seasick, it is a long voyage.
translation: 当然！希望你不要晕船，航程很长。

english: Unfortunately it seems that you're not quite ready to visit Great Kourend yet. Come back when you are and I'll happily take you there.
translation: 不幸的是，你似乎还没准备好访问库兰德王国。等你准备好了回来，我很乐意带你去。

english: I'm afraid access to Great Kourend is currently prohibited.
translation: 恐怕目前禁止进入库兰德王国。

english: You cannot pass as you haven't unlocked access to the Great Kourend and Kebos Lowlands area in this League.
translation: 你不能通过，因为你在这个联盟中还没解锁库兰德王国和凯博斯低地区域的访问权限。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Hello Veos.
translation: 你好维奥斯。

english: Hello there. What can I do for you?
translation: 你好。我能为你做什么？

english: Can you take me somewhere?
translation: 你能带我去某个地方吗？

english: I'm afraid that you're not eligible to travel to Great Kourend at the moment. Come back when you are and I'll happily take you there.
translation: 恐怕你现在没有资格前往库兰德王国。等你有资格了回来，我很乐意带你去。

english: Where would you like to go?
translation: 你想去哪里？

english: I'd like to travel to Port Piscarilius, please.
translation: 我想去皮斯卡里琉斯港。

english: As you wish, I hope you don't get seasick, it is a long voyage.
translation: 如你所愿，希望你不要晕船，航程很长。

english: I'd like to travel to Land's End, please.
translation: 我想去兰兹角村。

english: Actually I'd like to stay here.
translation: 其实我想留在这里。

english: As you wish.
translation: 如你所愿。

english: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: Hello again, Azacor! What can I do for you?
translation: 又见面了，阿扎科尔！我能为你做什么？

english: Where am I exactly?
translation: 我到底在哪里？

english: This is the port of Piscarilius. Home to Kourend's finest fisherman, but beware of the thieves!
translation: 这里是皮斯卡里琉斯港。库兰德王国最优秀渔民的家园，但要小心小偷！

english: Can you tell me about the other parts of Kourend?
translation: 你能告诉我库兰德王国的其他地方吗？

english: Certainly. To the west is the city of Arceuus, where they study magic at Kourend's Grand Library.
translation: 当然。西边是阿西乌斯城，他们在那里库兰德大图书馆研究魔法。

english: Further west is Lovakengj, where you'll find our best miners and smithers working to arm the Shayzien soldiers to the south west.
translation: 再往西是洛瓦肯吉城，你会在那里找到我们最好的矿工和铁匠，为西南方的谢兹恩士兵提供装备。

english: Finally, to the south you'll find Hosidius. They focus on agriculture to provide food for all of Great Kourend.
translation: 最后，南边是霍西迪乌斯城。他们专注于农业，为整个库兰德王国提供食物。

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

english: I'd like to travel to Port Sarim, please.
translation: 我想去沙林港。

english: Could you tell me more about Kourend?
translation: 你能多告诉我一些关于库兰德王国的事吗？

english: Certainly. The Kingdom of Great Kourend is made up of five main cities. They are the cities of Arceuus, Lovakengj, Shayzien, Piscarilius and Hosidius. Each city is ruled by one of the five houses of Kourend.
translation: 当然。库兰德王国由五座主要城市组成。它们是阿西乌斯城、洛瓦肯吉城、谢兹恩城、皮斯卡里琉斯城和霍西迪乌斯城。每座城市由库兰德五大家族之一统治。

english: However, since our last King died 20 years ago, the kingdom has instead been ruled by the Kourend Council.
translation: 然而，自从20年前我们最后一位国王去世后，王国改由库兰德议会统治。

english: I've lost something you've given me.
translation: 我弄丢了你给我的东西。

english: But I haven't given you anything recently.
translation: 但我最近没给你任何东西。

english: Yes you did. You gave me a reward for helping your client.
translation: 你给了。你给了我奖励，因为我帮助了你的客户。

english: Client? I don't...
translation: 客户？我不……

english: Veos suddenly jumps.
translation: 维奥斯突然跳起来。

english: Ah I remember now. Apologies friend, my mind isn't what it once was.
translation: 啊我现在想起来了。抱歉，我的记性不如从前了。

english: I do remember rewarding you. I'm afraid I don't have anything else for you though.
translation: 我确实记得奖励过你。不过恐怕我没什么别的给你了。

english: I do have some things for you. Enjoy!
translation: 我确实有些东西给你。享受吧！

english: Nothing, thanks.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。

english: What's this old book you gave me?
translation: 你给我的这本旧书是什么？

english: Ah that. I bought it at an auction a while back. Apparently, it belonged to the daughter of King Kharedst IV, the final king of Great Kourend.
translation: 啊那个。我不久前在一次拍卖会上买的。显然，它属于库兰德王国最后一位国王哈雷德斯特四世的女儿。

english: Why did you give it to me?
translation: 你为什么把它给我？

english: I'd hoped it might have some interesting information in it. Most of the pages are missing though so I have no use for it. I thought you might be able to find something to do with it.
translation: 我希望里面可能有一些有趣的信息。不过大部分书页都丢失了，所以我用不上。我想你也许能找点事做。

english: Fair enough. Thanks!
translation: 好吧。谢谢！

english: These remind me of a pet I once had. Please... put them away.
translation: 这些让我想起我曾经养过的一只宠物。请……把它们收起来。

english: Sorry, Veos. I didn't know.
translation: 抱歉，维奥斯。我不知道。

english: Would you feel comfortable sharing your story?
translation: 你愿意分享你的故事吗？

english: I once had a wolf, [player name]. His name was Copper. He was loyal. Brave... Gentle. He'd wear this beautiful crimson red collar.
translation: 我曾经有一只狼，[player name]。它叫铜。它忠诚、勇敢……温柔。它戴着这个漂亮的深红色项圈。

english: One day, I was travelling on the mainland, nearby a tribe of Fremenniks. Not exactly a spring chicken at this point, my own wolf was pushing 19...
translation: 有一天，我在大陆旅行，靠近一个费明尼克部落。那时我已经不算年轻了，我的狼也快19岁了……

english: 19 years old? That's an incredible amount of time for a wolf to live!
translation: 19岁？对狼来说那是惊人的寿命！

english: Indeed. Sadly, a group of feral foxes ambushed us. I fought back, along with Copper, though he took wounds that even a young wolf would struggle dealing with.
translation: 确实。不幸的是，一群野狐伏击了我们。我和铜一起反击，但它受的伤即使是年轻的狼也难以承受。

english: What did you do?
translation: 你做了什么？

english: I ran, [player name]... Like a coward.
translation: 我跑了，[player name]……像个懦夫。

english: Did you ever find him?
translation: 你找到它了吗？

english: I did not... I searched for days, but I was unable to find even his collar.
translation: 我没有……我找了几天，但连它的项圈都找不到。

english: I can help! I'll search for Copper's collar. I'm sure I can find the fox that has it...
translation: 我可以帮忙！我会寻找铜的项圈。我相信我能找到戴着它的狐狸……

english: Truly? You'd do that for me? Thank you so much, [player name]. I can't thank you enough! My heart's been filled with regret ever since it happened... and I think having a small part of Copper back, would make me complete again.
translation: 真的？你愿意为我做这个？非常感谢你，[player name]。我怎么感谢都不够！从那件事发生后我的心里充满了遗憾……我想如果能找回铜的一小部分，会让我重新完整。

english: I'll return when I have found Copper's collar. Take care!
translation: 我找到铜的项圈后会回来。保重！

english: How goes the hunt for Copper's collar, [player name]?
translation: 寻找铜的项圈进展如何，[player name]？

english: I haven't had any luck finding it yet, Veos. Where would you recommend searching?
translation: 我还没找到，维奥斯。你建议去哪里找？

english: I'd imagine the fox which killed Copper will likely still have the collar in their possession. They were nearby a Fremennik town.
translation: 我想杀死铜的狐狸可能还留着项圈。它们在费明尼克城镇附近。

english: Thanks, Veos. I'll return when I have the collar!
translation: 谢谢，维奥斯。我拿到项圈后会回来！

english: [Player name]... I can't thank you enough. I don't have a reward, but know that to me, this means so much. Perhaps in the future, I can repay you.
translation: [player name]……我怎么感谢都不够。我没有奖励，但要知道这对我来说意义重大。也许将来我可以报答你。

english: You're more than welcome Veos, and don't worry about a reward. Losing your best friend is always hard. Hopefully that item will bring you some comfort. Take care!
translation: 不客气维奥斯，别担心奖励。失去最好的朋友总是很难的。希望那件物品能给你带来一些安慰。保重！

english: [Player name]... I can't thank you enough for what you've done for me. I don't have a reward, but know that to me, this means so much. Perhaps in the future I can repay you.
translation: [player name]……我为你为我所做的一切怎么感谢都不够。我没有奖励，但要知道这对我来说意义重大。也许将来我可以报答你。

english: I am Veos and I've just arrived in Port Sarim from a distant land.
translation: 我是维奥斯，我刚从一个遥远的地方来到沙林港。

english: Where are you from?
translation: 你来自哪里？

english: I am from the magnificent kingdom of Great Kourend on the continent of Zeah, to the far west.
translation: 我来自遥远的西方，泽阿大陆上的宏伟王国库兰德。

english: Great Kourend is a magnificent kingdom comprising of five districts called Houses. The houses are ruled by the Lords of Arceuus, Lovakengj, Shayzien, Piscarilius and Hosidius.
translation: 库兰德王国是一个宏伟的王国，由五个称为家族的地区组成。这些家族由阿西乌斯城、洛瓦肯吉城、谢兹恩城、皮斯卡里琉斯城和霍西迪乌斯城的领主统治。

english: Since our last King died 20 years ago the kingdom has been ruled by an elected council.
translation: 自从20年前我们最后一位国王去世后，王国由选举产生的议会统治。

english: Tell me more about Zeah.
translation: 多跟我讲讲泽阿。

english: Zeah is a huge continent far to the west of here full of new adventures and hidden treasures. Sadly, the kingdom of Great Kourend is besieged by lizard creatures and it is not possible to get out of the kingdom just yet.
translation: 泽阿是这里西方远处的一个巨大大陆，充满了新的冒险和隐藏的宝藏。不幸的是，库兰德王国正被蜥蜴生物围攻，目前还无法离开王国。

english: Good bye.
translation: 再见。

english: Who're you? I've never seen you around these parts before.
translation: 你是谁？我以前没在这附近见过你。

english: I am Veos. Port master and scout for an elite Triumvirate.
translation: 我是维奥斯。精英三巨头的港口主管和侦察员。

english: Triumvirate?
translation: 三巨头？

english: Who? Where? Why have you suddenly docked here?
translation: 谁？在哪里？你为什么突然在这里停靠？

english: These are questions to which you shall not find answers, adventurer.
translation: 这些问题你找不到答案，冒险者。

english: Then why are you here?
translation: 那你为什么在这里？

english: There are secrets in this world for which you are not ready.
translation: 这个世界上有你还没准备好的秘密。

english: Veos whispers...
translation: 维奥斯低语……

english: Yo.... we, are not alone.
translation: 我们……并不孤单。

english: Where's that?
translation: 那在哪里？

english: That's great, can you take me there please?
translation: 太好了，你能带我去那里吗？

english: Tell me more about Great Kourend.
translation: 多跟我讲讲库兰德王国。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Can you take me somewhere?
translation: 你能带我去某个地方吗？

english: I'd like to travel to Port Piscarilius, please.
translation: 我想去皮斯卡里琉斯港。

english: I'd like to travel to Land's End, please.
translation: 我想去兰兹角村。

english: Actually I'd like to stay here.
translation: 其实我想留在这里。

english: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: Where am I exactly?
translation: 我到底在哪里？

english: Could you tell me more about Kourend?
translation: 你能多告诉我一些关于库兰德王国的事吗？

english: Let's talk about your client...
translation: 我们聊聊你的客户……

english: Travel to Port Sarim.
translation: 前往沙林港。

english: Travel to Land's End.
translation: 前往兰兹角村。

english: Stay where you are.
translation: 留在原地。

english: I've lost something you've given me.
translation: 我弄丢了你给我的东西。

english: Nothing, thanks.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。

english: Would you feel comfortable sharing your story?
translation: 你愿意分享你的故事吗？

english: I can help! I'll search for Copper's collar.
translation: 我可以帮忙！我会寻找铜的项圈。

english: I'm sorry. Thank you for sharing your story.
translation: 我很抱歉。谢谢你分享你的故事。

english: I'll leave you be. Sorry.
translation: 我不打扰你了。抱歉。

english: Where are you from?
translation: 你来自哪里？

english: Tell me more about Zeah.
translation: 多跟我讲讲泽阿。

english: Good bye.
translation: 再见。

english: If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: 如果我像你一样丑，我就不敢在公共场合露面！

english: Out of my way, punk.
translation: 让开，小混混。

english: Hmm... you smell strange...
translation: 嗯……你闻起来很奇怪……

english: Strange how?
translation: 怎么奇怪？

english: Like a human!
translation: 像人类！

english: Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: 哦！呃……我刚吃了一个，这就是原因！

english: Leave me alone.
translation: 别烦我。

english: Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: 如果你珍惜生命就别再跟我说话！

english: Get lost!
translation: 滚开！

english: I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: 我没什么可给你的，所以别烦我，乞丐。

english: Have you no manners?
translation: 你没有礼貌吗？

english: I don't have time for this right now.
translation: 我现在没时间处理这个。

english: I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: 我没兴趣和像你这样可怜的肉袋子说话。

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
translation: 我打赌你有漂亮的爪子。

english: A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: 真是悲惨的一天啊……趁还能享受就享受吧。

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: 你要是抓到谁，答应分我一口。

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
translation: 我以前没在这里闻到过你的气味……

english: You smell familiar...
translation: 你闻起来很熟悉……

english: Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: 在这附近见过人类吗？我非——常饿。

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: 你看起来也是个嗜血之人。

english: Good day to you, my friend.
translation: 你好，我的朋友。

english: Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
translation: 想去城堡吃点零食吗？

english: Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
translation: 等一下，我牙缝里卡了点人肉渣……

english: You dare disturb my rest!
translation: 你敢打扰我的休息！

english: You dare steal from us!
translation: 你敢偷我们的东西！

english: Thanks so much for saving me from being a vampyre. Here, take this certificate, I'm sorry but it's all I can offer as a reward.
translation: 非常感谢你救我免于变成吸血鬼。给，拿着这个证书，抱歉这是我唯一能给的奖励。

english: Thanks for changing me back, it must have been hard for you. I must be off now.
translation: 谢谢你把我变回来，对你来说一定很难。我现在得走了。

english: Welcome to my clothes stall, can I help you with anything?
translation: 欢迎来到我的服装摊，有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: Yes, what clothes do you have in stock?
translation: 是的，你有什么衣服现货？

english: Not a lot, I'm afraid, most of what I produce goes to my sister. Her shop is in Keldagrim-West.
translation: 恐怕不多，我生产的大部分都给我妹妹了。她的店在凯尔达格林城西区。

english: Well, show me what you do have then.
translation: 好吧，那给我看看你有什么。

english: No, I'm just browsing.
translation: 不，我只是看看。

english: Yes, what clothes do you have in stock?
translation: 是的，你有什么衣服现货？

english: No, I'm just browsing.
translation: 不，我只是看看。

english: Can you please help me? I'm in a terrible spot of trouble.
translation: 你能帮我吗？我遇到了大麻烦。

english: Aha, sounds like a quest. I'll help.
translation: 啊哈，听起来像个任务。我来帮你。

english: Yes yes, I suppose it is a quest. My fiance Ernest and I came upon this house.
translation: 是是，我想是个任务。我和未婚夫欧内斯特来到了这所房子。

english: Seeing as we were a little lost Ernest decided to go in and ask for directions.
translation: 因为我们有点迷路，欧内斯特决定进去问路。

english: That was an hour ago. That house looks spooky, can you go and see if you can find him for me?
translation: 那是一小时前的事了。那房子看起来阴森森的，你能去看看能不能帮我找到他吗？

english: Ok, I'll see what I can do.
translation: 好的，我看看能做什么。

english: Thank you, thank you. I'm very grateful.
translation: 谢谢，谢谢。我非常感激。

english: No, I'm looking for something to kill.
translation: 不，我在找可以猎杀的东西。

english: Oooh, you violent person you.
translation: 哦，你这个暴力的人。

english: Thank you for rescuing Ernest.
translation: 谢谢你救了欧内斯特。

english: Where is he now?
translation: 他现在在哪？

english: Oh he went off to talk to some green warty guy. I'm sure he'll be back soon.
translation: 哦他去找一个长满绿疣的家伙谈话了。我相信他很快就会回来。

english: Well done.
translation: 干得好。

english: You've obtained a [new clue/casket]!
translation: 你获得了 [new clue/casket]！

english: Aha, sounds like a quest. I'll help.
translation: 啊哈，听起来像个任务。我来帮你。

english: No, I'm looking for something to kill.
translation: 不，我在找可以猎杀的东西。

english: Now that was quite the show! I haven't been that entertained in a long time.
translation: 那真是一场精彩的表演！我很久没这么尽兴了。

english: Of course, you know I can't let you leave here alive. Time for your final performance...
translation: 当然，你知道我不能让你活着离开这里。是你最后表演的时候了……

english: Oh I'm going to enjoy this...
translation: 哦我会好好享受这个……

english: Back again for more? I admire your perseverance. Shall we begin?
translation: 又回来要更多了？我佩服你的毅力。我们开始吗？

english: You think you can defeat me?
translation: 你以为你能打败我？

english: There's nothing for you there!
translation: 那里没什么给你的！

english: Behold my true nature!
translation: 看我的真面目！

english: I'm not finished with you just yet!
translation: 我还没跟你算完呢！

english: You think this is over?!
translation: 你以为这就结束了？！

english: Yes, let's begin.
translation: 是的，我们开始吧。

english: No, don't start yet.
translation: 不，先别开始。

english: Hmmph. What do you want?
translation: 哼。你想要什么？

english: I was just wondering what was down those stairs?
translation: 我只是想知道那些楼梯下面是什么？

english: You can't go down there!
translation: 你不能去那里！

english: I didn't want to anyway.
translation: 反正我也不想去。

english: Good. Because you can't.
translation: 好。因为你不能。

english: I... uh... of course. Enjoy your meal.

english: Oh. Yeah, I suppose so.

translation: 保护营地免受野生动物和盗贼侵害。

translation: 哈！既然你们这些愚蠢的人类这么愿意把自己送到它嘴里，我何必急着上去？

english: Besides, someone needs to keep an eye on the happenings down here.
translation: 而且，得有人盯着下面的动静。

english: Seriously though, [player name], do be careful up there.

english: Okay, bye!

english: Oh, more antelope. You know, I think I've had enough. Thanks, though.

english: Hello there.

english: Wooo?  Woooo woo woooooo wooooo woooowooo wooo woooooo woo!
translation: 呜哦？呜哦哦 呜哦 呜哦哦哦哦 呜哦哦哦 呜哦哦呜哦哦 呜哦 呜哦哦哦哦 呜哦！

translation: 呜哦！呜哦 呜哦哦哦哦 呜哦呜哦呜哦哦 呜哦 呜哦哦哦哦！

english: You don't say!
translation: 不会吧！

english: Wooowoowoooooo.... Woowoowoo? Woooo, wooowoo wooowooowooo!
translation: 呜哦哦呜哦哦哦哦……呜哦呜哦哦？呜哦哦，呜哦呜哦 呜哦呜哦哦呜哦哦！

english: Well, I guess you didn't say.
translation: 嗯，我想你什么都没说。

english: Yeah, I don't want to brag, but seriously: I am SOOOO rich....
translation: 是的，我不想吹牛，但说真的：我超级超级有钱……

english: Yeah, I know they say money doesn't bring you happiness, but sometimes I just like to open my bank account and look at all of the stuff I own and just think to myself:
translation: 是的，我知道人们说钱买不来幸福，但有时我就是喜欢打开银行账户，看着所有属于我的东西，然后对自己说：

english: Wow. I am soooooo rich.
translation: 哇。我真的超级超级有钱。

english: Well, us rich alive people don't want to waste all day spending time with you poor dead people, because I'm just sooooo rich I have to go now, and very possibly make myself even richer.
translation: 嗯，我们这些富有的活人不想整天浪费时间陪你们这些可怜的死人，因为我太有钱了，我得走了，很可能让自己变得更富有。

english: See ya around ghosty!
translation: 回头见，鬼魂！

english: Yeah, I heard about that, ha-ha-ha!
translation: 是的，我听说过那件事，哈哈哈！

english: With a MACKEREL? Ouch!
translation: 用一条鲭鱼？哎哟！

english: Well, it was fun. Let's do it again sometime.
translation: 嗯，那很有趣。改天再来一次。

english: Why, thank you very much!
translation: 哦，非常感谢！

english: I know, but what are you going to do?
translation: 我知道，但你能怎么办？

english: Well, I guess that's always true in the long run. See you around, weird invisible dead person!
translation: 嗯，我想从长远来看这总是对的。回头见，奇怪的隐形死人！

english: Yeah it's not bad, but I prefer cooked chicken.
translation: 是的，还不错，但我更喜欢熟鸡肉。

english: Maybe, but nothing beats a home cooked pie!
translation: 也许吧，但没什么比得上家里做的派！

english: Man, I love pie!
translation: 天哪，我爱派！

english: You don't say? I never knew that. Well, I must be going, see you around.
translation: 不会吧？我从不知道。嗯，我得走了，回头见。

english: We get signal!
translation: 我们收到信号了！

english: Somebody set up us the bomb!
translation: 有人给我们设置了炸弹！

english: You have no chance to survive make your time.
translation: 你没有生存的机会，抓紧时间吧。

english: Woo?
translation: 呜哦？

english: All your base are belong to us.
translation: 你们所有的基地都属于我们。

english: Hey, don't think you can talk to me like that!
translation: 嘿，别以为你能那样跟我说话！

english: Are you threatening me?
translation: 你在威胁我吗？

english: Just because you're already dead, doesn't mean I can't find a way to hurt you ghosty!
translation: 就因为你已经死了，不代表我找不到方法伤害你，鬼魂！

english: No, I've never been there in my life and CERTAINLY didn't steal anything when I was!
translation: 不，我这辈子从未去过那里，当然也没在那里偷过任何东西！

english: Are you calling me a liar?!?! I have never stolen a thing in my life, and I resent the implication that I am the kind of morally depraved individual that would steal someone else's hard earned
translation: 你在说我是骗子？！我这辈子从未偷过任何东西，我讨厌这种暗示，好像我是那种道德败坏、会从别人口袋里偷走辛苦赚来的

english: money from their very pockets!
translation: 钱的人！

english: Or cakes. Or fur. Repeatedly. For long periods at a time.
translation: 或者蛋糕。或者毛皮。反复地。一次很长时间。

english: Well if you are going to take that attitude, then I have nothing further to say on the matter, and bid you good day!
translation: 如果你要采取这种态度，那我对此无话可说，祝你日安！

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Hello yourself.
translation: 你也你好。

english: I really liked your little story. Can you tell me another one?
translation: 我真的很喜欢你的小故事。能再讲一个吗？

english: Preferably something with a big fight and lots of explosions!
translation: 最好是有大战斗和很多爆炸的！

english: ...You are a very strange young [man/woman].
translation: ……你是个非常奇怪的年轻 [man/woman]。

english: Could I have more of those ghostly robes you gave me?
translation: 我能再多要些你给我的幽灵长袍吗？

english: It seems as though the curse that keeps me here extends to my very clothing... which piece do you want?
translation: 看来把我困在这里的诅咒也延伸到了我的衣服上……你想要哪件？

english: Here you go.
translation: 给，拿好。

english: Hey, I have something for you but you don't have any space for it!
translation: 嘿，我有东西给你，但你没有空间放！

english: Talk about Viggora's story.
translation: 谈谈维戈拉的故事。

english: Ask for more ghostly robes.
translation: 索要更多幽灵长袍。

english: What do you want, human?
translation: 你想要什么，人类？

english: Ehm, anything on offer?
translation: 嗯，有什么优惠吗？

english: Can you wield a warhammer? If not, then go away.
translation: 你能挥舞战锤吗？如果不能，那就走开。

english: Of course I can.
translation: 我当然能。

english: I can, but I won't.
translation: 我能，但我不愿。

english: Yeah, right.
translation: 是的，好吧。

english: That furnace is the property of the Red Axe! Hands off!
translation: 那熔炉是红斧的财产！别碰！

english: That furnace is my property! Hands off!
translation: 那熔炉是我的财产！别碰！

english: Didn't all this belong to the Red Axe? And weren't you a member?
translation: 这些不都是属于红斧的吗？你不是成员吗？

english: I don't know what you're talking about.
translation: 我不知道你在说什么。

english: Who do you think are, coming in here and using the property of the Red Axe!
translation: 你以为你是谁，进来这里使用红斧的财产！

english: Who do you think are, coming in here and using my property?
translation: 你以为你是谁，进来这里使用我的财产？

english: Hands off! That fireplace belongs to the Red Axe, not some puny arrogant human!
translation: 别碰！那壁炉属于红斧，不属于某个弱小傲慢的人类！

english: Hands off! That fireplace belongs to me! Not some puny arrogant human!
translation: 别碰！那壁炉属于我！不属于某个弱小傲慢的人类！

english: Who gave you permission to use that?
translation: 谁允许你使用那个了？

english: Of course I can.
translation: 我当然能。

english: I can, but I won't.
translation: 我能，但我不愿。

english: I am offering a cart ride to Brimhaven, if you're interested. It will cost [amount] coins. Is that okay?
translation: 我提供去布尔哈文镇的马车服务，如果你感兴趣。费用是 [amount] 金币。可以吗？

english: Yes please, I'd like to go to Brimhaven.
translation: 好的，我想去布尔哈文镇。

english: You hop into the cart and the driver urges the horses on. You take a taxing journey through the jungle to Brimhaven. You feel tired from the journey, but at least you didn't have to walk all that distance.
translation: 你跳上马车，车夫催促马匹前进。你经历了一段艰难的丛林之旅到达布尔哈文镇。你感到旅途疲惫，但至少不用走那么远的路。

english: Sorry, but it looks as if you don't have enough money. Come and see me when you have enough for the ride.
translation: 抱歉，但看起来你没有足够的钱。等你有足够的钱再来找我。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Okay, Bwana, let me know if you change your mind.
translation: 好的，老爷，如果你改变主意告诉我。

english: I am offering a cart ride to Brimhaven, if you're interested. For you, it's free.
translation: 我提供去布尔哈文镇的马车服务，如果你感兴趣。对你来说，是免费的。

english: Sorry, I'm busy. I've got to get out of here! This place is swarming with zombies.
translation: 抱歉，我很忙。我得离开这里！这地方到处都是僵尸。

english: Yes please, I'd like to go to Brimhaven.
translation: 好的，我想去布尔哈文镇。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Hello, how's it going?
translation: 你好，情况怎么样？

english: Hello there! Nice weather we've been having.
translation: 你好！最近天气不错。

english: All these newcomers - what are they up to?
translation: 所有这些新来的人——他们在做什么？

english: What are you talking about?
translation: 你在说什么？

english: Argh! Another one! No, I don't want to help with your scheme! I'm very busy!
translation: 啊！又一个！不，我不想帮你的忙！我很忙！

english: Ohhh kaaay... I'll leave you to it then.
translation: 哦……好吧……那我不打扰你了。

english: I'm fine, how are you?
translation: 我没事，你呢？

english: Very well, thank you.
translation: 很好，谢谢。

english: Do you wish to trade?
translation: 你想交易吗？

english: No, I have nothing I wish to get rid of. If you want to do some trading, there are plenty of shops and market stalls around though.
translation: 不，我没什么想处理的。不过如果你想交易，周围有很多商店和市场摊位。

english: Argh! Don't rob me!
translation: 啊！别抢我！

english: Sorry, I thought you were a bandit.
translation: 抱歉，我以为你是强盗。

english: There are a lot of them around here...
translation: 这附近有很多……

english: None of your business.
translation: 不关你的事。

english: Get out of my way, I'm in a hurry!
translation: 让开，我很急！

english: Not too bad, thanks.
translation: 还不错，谢谢。

english: I'm in search of enemies to kill.
translation: 我在找敌人杀。

english: The desert just outside of town is full of wolves, snakes, and even wild Ugthanki. Try there.
translation: 城外的沙漠里到处都是狼、蛇，甚至野生乌格坦基。去那里试试。

english: I'm in search of a quest.
translation: 我在找任务。

english: I'm sorry, I can't help you there.
translation: 抱歉，我帮不了你这个。

english: How can I help you?
translation: 我能怎么帮你？

english: Do I know you? I'm in a hurry!
translation: 我认识你吗？我赶时间！

english: I'm very well thank you.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: I'm a bold adventurer.
translation: 我是个大胆的冒险者。

english: Ah, a most noble profession.
translation: 啊，非常高尚的职业。

english: Do you wish to trade?
translation: 你想交易吗？

english: I'm in search of a quest.
translation: 我在找任务。

english: I'm in search of enemies to kill.
translation: 我在找敌人杀。

english: Traveller, will you assist me? I seek a certain book, but the Librarian seems unwilling to find it for me. The Arceuus people will be grateful for any help you provide to the customers here.
translation: 旅行者，你愿意帮我吗？我在找某本书，但图书管理员似乎不愿帮我找。阿西乌斯人会感激你为这里的顾客提供的任何帮助。

english: Sure, what book do you want?
translation: 当然，你想要什么书？

english: You are very kind. Please find: '[book name]'
translation: 你真好。请找：'[book name]'

english: I'll see what I can do.
translation: 我看看能做什么。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Just a historian. Will you find the book that I seek?
translation: 只是个历史学家。你会帮我找我找的书吗？

english: No, sorry.
translation: 不，抱歉。

english: Do you have the book I require, traveller? '[book name]'
translation: 你有我需要的书吗，旅行者？'[book name]'

english: Not yet, sorry.
translation: 还没有，抱歉。

english: I am sure the people of Arceuus will be very grateful for any help you provide to the customers here. They will most certainly be aware of the Librarian's deficiencies.
translation: 我相信阿西乌斯人会非常感激你为这里的顾客提供的任何帮助。他们肯定会意识到图书管理员的不足。

english: I believe you are currently assisting another customer of this Library. I shall not trouble you with my needs at this time.
translation: 我相信你目前正在帮助这位图书馆的另一位顾客。我现在就不麻烦你了。

english: Thank you very much. In return, please accept a token of my thanks.
translation: 非常感谢。作为回报，请接受我的一点谢意。

english: Thank you for finding my book. It is most interesting.
translation: 谢谢你找到我的书。非常有趣。

english: Sure, what book do you want?
translation: 当然，你想要什么书？

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: No, sorry.
translation: 不，抱歉。

english: Nilsal, friend. How goes it?
translation: 你好，朋友。进展如何？

english: Do you need any help in the vineyards?
translation: 葡萄园需要帮忙吗？

english: Well we could always use a spare pair of hands!
translation: 嗯，我们总是需要多一双手！

english: Here, fill this barrel with four sets of ripe grapes and bring it back to me.
translation: 给，把这个桶装满四串熟葡萄，然后带回来给我。

english: Got it! One barrel full of grapes coming right up.
translation: 明白了！马上装满一桶葡萄。

english: Just remember, I need them to be ripe. Generally, perfectly ripe grapes are full and vibrant. They'll shine in the sunlight more than others.
translation: 记住，我需要它们是熟的。通常，完全成熟的葡萄饱满且有活力。它们比其他的在阳光下更闪亮。

english: Hopefully you know what you’re doing now. Just fill this barrel with four sets of ripe grapes and bring it back to me.
translation: 希望你现在知道该做什么了。把这个桶装满四串熟葡萄，然后带回来给我。

english: We could always use a spare pair of hands! I have a grape barrel here for you, but you don't have enough room for it at the moment. Come back once you can carry it.
translation: 我们总是需要多一双手！我这里有个葡萄桶给你，但你目前没空间放。等你有能力携带时再回来。

english: You've already got that grape barrel I gave you. Fill it with four sets of ripe grapes and bring it back to me.
translation: 你已经有了我给你的那个葡萄桶。把它装满四串熟葡萄，然后带回来给我。

english: Doesn't it get hot standing out here all day?
translation: 整天站在这里不热吗？

english: Ah, you get used to it. Besides, I have a near-infinite supply of lukewarm grape juice to keep me hydrated!
translation: 啊，习惯了。而且，我有几乎无限的温葡萄汁供应来保持水分！

english: I'm good. I'll be going now.
translation: 我没事。我现在走了。

english: One barrel o' grapes here for you, boss!
translation: 给你一桶葡萄，老板！

english: Great work! Here, keep some grapes as payment.
translation: 干得好！给，留些葡萄当报酬。

english: Can I have some gold instead?
translation: 我能要些金币吗？

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: Oh...
Now, if you're up for it, I wouldn't say no to you filling the barrel up again.
translation: 现在，如果你愿意，我不介意你再装满一次桶。

english: Do you need any help in the vineyards?
translation: 葡萄园需要帮忙吗？

english: Doesn't it get hot standing out here all day?
translation: 整天站在这里不热吗？

english: I'm good. I'll be going now.
translation: 我没事。我现在走了。

english: Hello there. How's it going?
translation: 你好。进展如何？

english: Lovely day for some wine!
translation: 喝酒的好天气！

english: I wish these grapes could pick themselves.
translation: 我希望这些葡萄能自己摘。

english: The grapes are in good shape for this harvest.
translation: 这次收获的葡萄状况很好。

english: I'm sorry, but the vineyards need tending to.
translation: 抱歉，但葡萄园需要照料。

english: Have you tried the wine? You won't regret it if you do!
translation: 你试过酒吗？试了就不会后悔！

english: Nilsal. Do you wish me to exchange banknotes for you? I charge only 10 coins for each banknote.
translation: 你好。你想让我帮你兑换银行票据吗？每张票据我只收10金币。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Then hand me the banknotes you wish me to exchange.
translation: 那把你想让我兑换的银行票据给我。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: I am Virilis. I can exchange banknotes of bones for real items. Do you want any banknotes converted?
translation: 我是维里利斯。我可以把骨头银行票据兑换成实物。你想兑换任何银行票据吗？

english: What can I do here?
translation: 我在这里能做什么？

english: I'm glad you've asked! Next to me is an old altar of Ralos, upon which you can ask for bones and wines to be blessed.
translation: 很高兴你问！我旁边有个古老的拉洛斯祭坛，你可以在上面请求祝福骨头和酒。

english: You should beware though, Ralos won't hear your prayers if you aren't experienced enough. I wouldn't want you to get caught in the cold just waiting for nothing to happen.
translation: 不过你要小心，如果你经验不足，拉洛斯不会听到你的祈祷。我不希望你白白等待却什么都没发生。

english: Anyway, once you've had Ralos' blessing, you can break the bones down into shards. Then, along with your blessed wine, you can take them to the libation bowl and sacrifice them in Ralos' honour!
translation: 总之，一旦你得到拉洛斯的祝福，你可以把骨头敲成碎片。然后，连同你的祝福酒，你可以把它们带到祭酒碗，为纪念拉洛斯而牺牲它们！

english: Libation bowl?
translation: 祭酒碗？

english: Yes! You'll find it inside the Teomat, near the library.
translation: 是的！你会在特奥马特里面，图书馆附近找到它。

english: I see. And what happens if I drink the blessed wine?

english: Hey Vorki, got any interesting dragon facts?
translation: 嘿沃基，有什么关于龙的趣闻吗？

english: Although they have wings, dragons rarely fly. This is because the animals they prey on are all ground dwelling.
translation: 虽然它们有翅膀，龙很少飞。这是因为它们捕食的动物都是陆栖的。

english: Unlike their creators, dragons have the ability to reproduce. Like most reptiles, they are oviparous. This means that they lay eggs rather than birthing live young.
translation: 与它们的创造者不同，龙有繁殖能力。像大多数爬行动物一样，它们是卵生的。这意味着它们产卵而不是胎生。

english: Dragons have a very long lifespan and can live for thousands of years. With a lifespan that long, most dragons die to combat instead of age.
translation: 龙有很长的寿命，可以活几千年。寿命这么长，大多数龙死于战斗而不是衰老。

english: While very closely related, dragons and wyverns are actually different species. You can easily tell the difference between them by counting the number of legs, dragons have four while wyverns have two.
translation: 虽然关系非常密切，龙和双足飞龙实际上是不同的物种。你可以通过数腿的数量轻松区分它们，龙有四条腿而双足飞龙有两条。

english: Metallic dragons were created by inserting molten metal into the eggs of other dragons. Very few eggs survived this process.
translation: 金属龙是通过将熔融金属插入其他龙的卵中创造的。很少有卵能在这个过程中存活。

english: The dragonkin created dragons by fusing their own lifeblood with that of a lizard. The dragonkin created other species in similar ways by using different types of reptile.
translation: 龙裔通过将自己的生命之血与蜥蜴的融合创造了龙。龙裔以类似的方式使用不同类型的爬行动物创造了其他物种。

english: Dragons have the ability to speak. However, most dragons don't have the brain capacity to do it very well.
translation: 龙拥有说话的能力。然而，大多数龙的大脑容量不足以让它们说得很好。

english: Dragons share their name with dragon equipment, which was also created by the dragonkin. This equipment is fashioned out of Orikalkum.
translation: 龙与龙装备同名，后者也是由龙族创造的。这些装备是用奥利卡尔克姆打造的。

english: Although very aggressive, dragons do not typically stray from their own territory. They instead make their homes in places where there is plenty of prey to be found.
translation: 尽管非常具有攻击性，龙通常不会离开自己的领地。相反，它们会在猎物丰富的地方安家。

english: Dragons have a duct in their mouth from which they can expel various internally produced fluids. The most common of these is a fluid which ignites when it reacts with air. This is how dragons breathe fire.
translation: 龙的嘴里有一条导管，可以排出各种体内产生的液体。其中最常见的是遇空气即燃的液体。这就是龙喷火的方式。

english: Who are you?

english: I am Watson, the master of clue scrolls. I have lived a long life here in Kourend. The lands are beautiful here.
translation: 我是沃森，线索卷轴大师。我在库兰德王国生活了很长时间。这里的土地很美。

english: You're the master are you?
translation: 你是大师是吗？

english: Ha! It is not so much due to my ego, but the fact that I give out master tier clue scrolls.
translation: 哈！这不完全是因为我的自负，而是因为我发放大师级线索卷轴这一事实。

english: Interesting. Do you get many treasure hunters here in Kourend?
translation: 有趣。你在库兰德王国这里遇到很多寻宝猎人吗？

english: I have seen many, but few are good enough. I only give out my clue scrolls to the very best.
translation: 我见过很多，但没几个够格的。我只把线索卷轴发给最优秀的人。

english: Ah! I am just the adventurer you are looking for. If you hand me a clue, I'll be on my way.
translation: 啊！我就是你要找的冒险者。如果你给我一个线索，我就上路了。

english: Not so fast [player name]. I require payment. You must bring me a clue scroll of all lower tiers.
translation: 别急，[player name]。我需要报酬。你必须给我带来所有低等级的线索卷轴。

english: I will remember which ones you have given me though. I expect you'll find that useful.
translation: 不过我会记住你给过我哪些。我想你会发现这很有用。

english: Have you heard of Sherlock?
translation: 你听说过夏洛克吗？

english: Never heard of the bloke. I haven't a clue who he is.
translation: 从没听说过这家伙。我完全不知道他是谁。

english: He also claims to be the master of all clue scrolls.
translation: 他也声称自己是所有线索卷轴的大师。

english: As I said, I've never heard of him. If he was such a big deal, I would have heard of him...
translation: 正如我所说，我从没听说过他。如果他真有那么重要，我应该会听说过……

english: Something tells me you're lying! I bet you're just his underling aren't you.
translation: 我觉得你在撒谎！我敢打赌你只是他的手下，对吧？

english: So what are master clue scrolls anyway?
translation: 那么，大师级线索卷轴到底是什么？

english: Master clue scrolls are the most challenging of all clue scrolls. They will test you in ways you have not been tested before.
translation: 大师级线索卷轴是所有线索卷轴中最具挑战性的。它们将以你从未经历过的方式考验你。

english: You will be led all over Gielinor with your strengths, your weaknesses, your mental strength and your reactions all scrutinised.
translation: 你将走遍基利诺尔各地，你的长处、短处、精神力量和反应能力都将受到审视。

english: I assume there is treasure to be found?
translation: 我想应该有宝藏可寻吧？

english: That is for you to find out, [player name].
translation: 那就得靠你自己去发现了，[player name]。

english: You need to bring me clue scroll you haven't already given me [player name].
translation: 你需要给我带来你还没给过我的线索卷轴，[player name]。

english: Thank you very much.
translation: 非常感谢。

english: I have a master scroll box for you, but you already have too many of them! Finish them or discard them, I don't care which.
translation: 我有一个大师级卷轴盒给你，但你已经有太多了！把它们做完或者扔掉，我不在乎选哪个。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Nice work [player name], I've had one of each lower tier clue scroll from you.
translation: 干得好 [player name]，我已经从你那里收到了每种低阶线索卷轴各一份。

english: What is that noticeboard for?
translation: 那个公告板是做什么用的？

english: It lets you view any of your S.T.A.S.H units that you have built around Gielinor.
translation: 它可以让你查看你在基利诺尔各地建造的任何S.T.A.S.H.单元。

english: Oh that seems really useful! It's a bit of a shame I need to come here everytime to check though.
translation: 哦，那看起来真有用！不过每次都得来这里检查有点可惜。

english: Well it's just a board with some notes on it. I'm sure you could figure something out.
translation: 嗯，它只是个贴着些笔记的板子。我相信你能想出办法来的。

english: I suppose you're right, I don't suppose you have a spare one I could buy off you to save me the hassle?
translation: 我想你是对的，不知道你是否有备用的可以卖给我，省得我麻烦？

english: No, but I could write down the instructions to make one. Then all you'd need is a house with a study to build it in, and a bolt of cloth.
translation: 没有，但我可以写下制作说明书。那你只需要一间带书房的家来建造它，再加上一卷布。

english: I'm not giving it away for free, 500 coins is just covering my expenses!
translation: 我不是免费赠送，500枚金币只是覆盖我的成本！

english: You don't have enough space for it.
translation: 你没有足够的空间放它。

english: Here you go.
translation: 给，拿好。

english: Alright, feel free to carry on using mine.
translation: 好吧，请随意继续用我的。

english: Can you tell me about scroll boxes?
translation: 你能跟我讲讲卷轴盒吗？

english: Well, the long and short of it is that scroll boxes contain clue scrolls, but in a much easier to carry form factor.
translation: 嗯，长话短说，卷轴盒里装着线索卷轴，但携带起来方便得多。

english: Now, just because they're easier to carry, it doesn't mean you can take as many as you want. You'll need scroll cases to be able to store them.
translation: 不过，虽然它们更容易携带，但这并不意味着你想带多少就带多少。你需要卷轴匣才能存放它们。

english: You can get scroll cases by completing clues. You can get up to two extra scroll cases for each clue tier by doing that kind of clue.
translation: 你可以通过完成线索获得卷轴匣。每完成一种线索等级，你最多可以获得两个额外的卷轴匣。

english: I can give you the exact numbers, but I wouldn't worry too much about them. You'll get them eventually.
translation: 我可以给你确切的数字，但不用太担心。你最终会得到的。

english: If you want to help deal with the strange casket I have upstairs, I think it also has some scroll cases as well.
translation: 如果你想帮我处理楼上那个奇怪的箱子，我想里面也有一些卷轴匣。

english: So how many scrolls can I carry right now?
translation: 那么我现在能带多少卷轴？

english: You'll find that information written on the statistics board by the door.
translation: 你可以在门边的统计板上找到这些信息。

english: You said you didn't know Sherlock!
translation: 你说你不认识夏洛克！

english: Sure is windy today, did you hear that?
translation: 今天风真大，你听到了吗？

english: Sorry [player name]. That scroll is for you, not me.
translation: 抱歉 [player name]。那卷轴是给你的，不是给我的。

english: Do you want to trade that in? You'd need another copy to take your scrolls out again. But I'll swap it for some teleport scrolls if you like, so you can travel here more easily.
translation: 你想把它换掉吗？你需要另一份副本才能再次取出你的卷轴。但如果你愿意，我可以把它换成一些传送卷轴，这样你来这里就更方便了。

english: Come again if you change your mind.
translation: 如果你改变主意，欢迎再来。

translation: 我们要回坠机岛吗？

english: It's truly spectacular.
translation: 真是壮观。

english: I'd recommend the Colosseum. Me and a few associates always wager bets on the contenders.
translation: 我推荐斗兽场。我和几个伙伴总是在参赛者身上下注。

english: As you can tell, I'm doing quite well winning! Plenty of coin to pass around.
translation: 如你所见，我赢了不少！有很多钱可以分发。

english: Got any spare for me?
translation: 有闲钱分给我点吗？

english: No! We don't care for begging in the city!

english: How am I supposed to get past this?

english: Gah!

english: I can't wait until I get full graceful, then I can head back to the rooftop courses.
translation: 我等不及凑齐全套优雅套装了，那样我就能回到屋顶课程训练了。

english: I wonder if the Hallowed grapple is worth it?
translation: 我在想神圣钩爪值不值得入手？

english: I wish I could trade Hallowed marks in for amylase crystals.
translation: 真希望能用神圣印记兑换淀粉酶结晶。

english: Two pieces dyed, four more to go!

english: Well, this is definitely more difficult than training on rooftop courses.

english: Greetings, stranger. How can I help you?
translation: 你好，陌生人。有什么能帮你的？

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: It's a cave filled with araxytes, a rare form of arachnid. I've been here researching them for some time.
translation: 这是一个充满了阿拉克希特的洞穴，这是一种罕见的蛛形纲生物。我在这里研究它们有一段时间了。

english: My niece, Nieve, is one of those Slayer Masters. You know, they tell people what to go kill. I also look after this cave for people on assignments like that.
translation: 我的侄女尼芙是那些杀戮大师之一。你知道的，他们告诉人们去杀什么。我也为那些接了此类任务的人照看这个洞穴。

english: My nephew, Steve, is one of those Slayer Masters. You know, they tell people what to go kill. I also look after this cave for people on assignments like that.
translation: 我的侄子史蒂夫是那些杀戮大师之一。你知道的，他们告诉人们去杀什么。我也为那些接了此类任务的人照看这个洞穴。

english: Discovered anything interesting?
translation: 发现什么有趣的东西了吗？

english: Hmm... Not really.
translation: 嗯……并没有。

english: However, the araxytes here are rather venomous... and when I say venomous, I mean venomous.
translation: 不过，这里的阿拉克希特毒性相当强……当我说毒性强时，我是真的指毒性强。

english: Is that really noteworthy?
translation: 那真的值得注意吗？

english: Well, I didn't think so by itself, but lots of other people seem to find it very interesting.
translation: 嗯，我自己倒不觉得，但似乎很多人都觉得这很有趣。

english: For example, there were some particularly pale wanderers doing their own research in here. They didn't bother me though.
translation: 例如，有一些特别苍白的流浪者在这里做他们自己的研究。不过他们没打扰我。

english: Hmm...
Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: Bye bye.
translation: 拜拜。

english: I found this Jar, I think it's full of venom.
translation: 我找到了这个罐子，我想里面装满了毒液。

english: Oh wow, can I see it?.
translation: 噢哇，我能看看吗？

english: That is really fascinating. Thank you for sharing that with me.
translation: 那真是太迷人了。谢谢你与我分享。

english: Next I'll need to find something a little more potent to progress my research...
translation: 接下来我需要找些效力更强的东西来推进我的研究……

english: I'll keep my eyes open!
translation: 我会留意的！

english: Did you want to see the Jar again?

english: No that's quite alright, I've nothing else to learn from that particular sample. I need to find something else to progress my research...
translation: 不，没关系，那个样本我已经没什么可学的了。我需要找别的东西来推进我的研究……

english: Three stories... Multiple entries... Numerous butlers...
translation: 三层楼……多个入口……无数管家……

english: Hello! What're you doing up here?
translation: 你好！你在上面做什么？

english: I'm here on business. I'd suggest you not worry about it. My line of work can be rather... cutthroat.
translation: 我来这里办事。建议你不用担心。我的行当可能相当……残酷。

english: I'm not sure what you're up to, but if it's got anything to do with that villa, then I think someone might've beaten you to it...
translation: 我不确定你在搞什么鬼，但如果和那栋别墅有关，那我想可能有人已经捷足先登了……

english: Then it seems I now have a gap in my schedule...
translation: 那么看来我现在的日程表上有个空档……

english: Well you enjoy it!
translation: 那你好好享受吧！

english: What a nice man.
translation: 真是个好人。

english: I'm just watching and observing. I find that doing so offers plenty of... opportunities.
translation: 我只是在观察。我发现这样做能提供很多……机会。

english: I'm just enjoying the view. I find a place like this good when you want to... elimitatedistractions.

english: What can I interest you in? Need any pipes? I make very sturdy pipes.

english: No, not really... what kind of shop is this anyway?

english: Why, it's Wemund's Wrench Warehouse. Wemund, that's me.
translation: 哎呀，这里是韦蒙德扳手仓库。韦蒙德，就是我。

english: I don't really sell just wrenches, you know, I sell anything related to the maintenance of dwarven steam machines.

english: What business?
translation: 办什么事？

english: My business is none of your business. Go poke your nose somewhere else.
translation: 我的事与你无关。去别处打听吧。

english: Don't disturb me. I need to guard the tithes.
translation: 别打扰我。我得看守什一税。

english: Why? Where would they even go if they escaped?
translation: 为什么？就算它们逃了又能去哪？

english: Escape? I'm not here to stop them escaping. I'm here to stop them getting stolen.
translation: 逃跑？我不是来阻止它们逃跑的。我是来防止它们被偷的。

english: Oh...
Now take your stupid questions somewhere else. I have a job to do.

translation: 你不该在这里，奴隶。在被杀掉之前回你主人那儿去。

translation: 好的，我想让你粉碎点东西。

english: What sort of things do you crush?
translation: 你粉碎什么样的东西？

translation: 各种各样的东西！独角兽角、山羊角、蓝龙鳞等等。把你的东西给我，我试着粉碎它。每件物品收费50枚金币。

translation: 你是谁？

english: I'm Wesley. I used to work on a big ship, exploring the world with my mother, but then I didn't get on very well at the fleet's training school, so I quit all that.
translation: 我是韦斯利。我以前在一艘大船上工作，和我母亲一起探索世界，但后来我在舰队训练学校过得不太好，所以就辞职不干了。

english: So I moved to Nardah and took up this job crushing stuff instead. It's always been a passion of mine, crushing things. I'm a lot happier now.
translation: 所以我搬到了纳尔达，转而从事这份粉碎东西的工作。粉碎东西一直是我的热情所在。我现在快乐多了。

english: The world is so much simpler when you're crushing. You know you just have to grind for long enough until you get the job done. It might take hours, but you just grind until you're done.
translation: 当你粉碎东西时，世界变得简单多了。你知道只要磨得够久就能完成任务。可能需要几个小时，但只要一直磨直到做完就行。

english: I'm not interested, thanks.
translation: 我没兴趣，谢谢。

english: No, that's not the sort of thing I like crushing.
translation: 不，那不是我喜欢粉碎的东西。

english: Sorry, I charge 50 coins per item.
translation: 抱歉，我每件物品收费50枚金币。

english: Wesley puts your item[s] in his mortar and crushes it. You pay him [amount] coins.
translation: 韦斯利把你的物品放进研钵里粉碎。你付给他 [amount] 枚金币。

english: I'm not very good at Herblore, so you'll only get 3 shards from lava scales that I crush. You might get more if you do it yourself.
translation: 我不太擅长草药学，所以我粉碎的熔岩鳞片你只能得到3个碎片。如果你自己做可能会更多。

english: 3 shards per scale is fine.
translation: 每片鳞片3个碎片也行。

english: Forget it - I'll do it myself.
translation: 算了——我自己来。

english: Grind it!
translation: 磨碎它！

english: Crush it!
translation: 粉碎它！

english: The grind is real!
translation: 研磨是真实的！

english: Griiiiiiind!
Gotta crush 'em all!
translation: 必须粉碎它们全部！

english: Crush crush crush!
translation: 粉碎粉碎粉碎！

english: Round and round and round we go!
translation: 转啊转啊转个不停！

english: Okay, I'd like you to crush something.
translation: 好的，我想让你粉碎点东西。

english: What sort of things do you crush?
translation: 你粉碎什么样的东西？

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: I'm not interested, thanks.
translation: 我没兴趣，谢谢。

english: 3 shards per scale is fine.
translation: 每片鳞片换3个碎片就行。

english: Forget it - I'll do it myself.
translation: 算了——我自己来。

english: Hello, what's a little boy like you doing down here?
translation: 你好，像你这样的小男孩怎么跑到这下面来了？

english: I ain't no little boy. Me dad, Steve, said I was big enough to take care of these 'ere wyverns, as the pal- palint-palintililiolog- those blokes from the museum are too scared of them.
translation: 我才不是小男孩。我爸史蒂夫说我已经够大了，可以照顾这些飞蜥，因为那些古……古生物……就是博物馆那帮家伙太怕它们了。

english: Yeah, whatever. I know how to look after myself, my entire family are slayer guardians or something like that.
translation: 行吧，随便你怎么说。我知道怎么照顾自己，我全家都是杀戮守护者之类的。

english: To guard the wyverns of course.
translation: 当然是为了守护飞蜥。

english: Guard them? From what?
translation: 守护它们？防谁？

english: From people like you who just want to kill 'em.
translation: 防像你这样只想杀它们的人。

english: But... that's what they're for?
translation: 可是……它们不就是用来杀的吗？

english: They have lives too. They were created for a purpose. But whatever, you can only kill these ones if the Slayer Masters say you can.
translation: 它们也有生命。它们生来自有使命。不过不管怎么说，只有杀戮大师允许你杀，你才能杀这些。

english: I'm Weve, son of Steve.
translation: 我是韦夫，史蒂夫的儿子。

english: That's... an interesting name.
translation: 这……名字挺有意思。

english: Well, it's kinda a family tradition you might say. Plus I'm good at looking after wyverns and fast enough to weave between their legs and not get hurt.
translation: 嗯，你可以说是家传传统吧。再说我很擅长照顾飞蜥，而且动作够快，能在它们腿间穿梭而不受伤。

english: Ok, bye.
translation: 好的，再见。

english: Hey! Leave them alone! My dad Steve will beat you up unless a Slayer Master has given you special permission.
translation: 嘿！别碰它们！除非杀戮大师给了你特别许可，否则我爸史蒂夫会揍你的。

english: Calm down, I was just worried.
translation: 冷静点，我只是担心而已。

english: Why are you here?
translation: 你为什么在这里？

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Ok, bye.
translation: 好的，再见。

english: Hi there, nice to see you! Care for a mug of beer?
translation: 你好，很高兴见到你！要来杯啤酒吗？

english: I'm a bit busy at the moment, maybe later.
translation: 我现在有点忙，也许晚点吧。

english: Well alright then.
translation: 那好吧。

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: Can I interest you in a drink?
translation: 有兴趣喝一杯吗？

english: Not right now, thank you. I was wondering if you might be able to help me with something else.
translation: 现在不用，谢谢。我在想你是否能帮我做点别的事。

english: And what would that be?
translation: 那是什么事呢？

english: Do you know the Easter Bunny?
translation: 你认识复活节兔子吗？

english: I do! He's just over there. Lovely guy.
translation: 认识！他就在那边。人很不错。

english: Does he seem unhappy to you?
translation: 你觉得他看起来不开心吗？

english: Now that you mention it, yes he does.
translation: 经你这么一说，确实如此。

english: He was always so cheery, bouncing around like a fuzzy avatar of joy.
translation: 他总是那么快乐，像个毛茸茸的快乐化身一样蹦蹦跳跳。

english: He's been in a sorry state lately though.
translation: 不过最近他状态很糟糕。

english: Indeed, I've never seen him like this.
translation: 确实，我从没见过他这样。

english: Have you noticed anything odd?
translation: 你注意到什么奇怪的地方了吗？

english: Hmm... He used to drink pint after pint of carrot juice! Barely sips the stuff now though, just stares into the glass.
translation: 嗯……他以前是一品接一品地喝胡萝卜汁！现在却几乎不喝了，只是盯着杯子发呆。

english: He used to LOVE it.
translation: 他以前超爱喝的。

english: Interesting, could I try the carrot juice please?
translation: 有趣，我能尝尝这胡萝卜汁吗？

english: Absolutely! One C.J. coming right up!
translation: 当然！一杯C.J.马上就好！

english: Euargh! That's...
translation: 呃啊！这……

english: Good right? I make it myself.
translation: 不错吧？我自己做的。

english: It's definitely an experience, how do you make it?
translation: 确实是一种独特的体验，你是怎么做的？

english: I put some carrots into a juice press, then add some good old-fashioned elbow grease.
translation: 我把一些胡萝卜放进榨汁机，然后加点老式的体力活(使劲压)。

english: That would explain the flavour.
translation: 那就难怪这味道了。

english: Do you have any particularly nice carrots we could use to make some special juice just for the Easter Bunny?
translation: 你有没有什么特别好的胡萝卜，我们可以用来给复活节兔子做些特制果汁？

english: I think he would perhaps appreciate something different.
translation: 我想他也许会喜欢点不一样的。

english: You can ask Weasel in the kitchen, he chooses which carrots get used for juice.
translation: 你可以去厨房问问威塞尔，是他决定用哪些胡萝卜榨汁的。

english: Be warned though, he's not much of a people person.
translation: 不过得提醒你，他不太爱跟人打交道。

english: What do you mean by that?
translation: 你这是什么意思？

english: Oh you'll soon find out! Don't worry though, just tell him I sent you and that you're trying to help the Easter Bunny.
translation: 哦，你很快就会知道了！不过别担心，只要告诉他是我派你来的，而且你是想帮复活节兔子。

english: He'll give you some fantastic carrots.
translation: 他会给你一些很棒的胡萝卜。

english: Once you have them, you can use the juice press to extract their goodness!
translation: 拿到胡萝卜后，你就可以用榨汁机提取它们的精华了！

english: Alright, I'll be back soon!
translation: 好的，我很快回来！

english: Have you been to see Weasel in the kitchen about those nice carrots yet?
translation: 你去厨房找威塞尔要那些好胡萝卜了吗？

english: Not yet.
translation: 还没。

english: Well there's no need to be scared of him! Fetch some carrots and I'll let you use my juice press.
translation: 没必要怕他！去拿些胡萝卜来，我就让你用我的榨汁机。

english: I'm not scared, I just haven't gotten round to it yet.
translation: 我不怕，只是还没腾出空来。

english: Whatever you say.
translation: 随你怎么说。

english: I need more carrots..
translation: 我需要更多胡萝卜……

english: Why? What happened?
translation: 为什么？发生什么事了？

english: Let's call it a quality control incident.
translation: 我们就叫它质量控制事故吧。

english: You drank the juice didn't you?
translation: 你把果汁喝了对吧？

english: Perhaps.
translation: 也许吧。

english: Right well you best go see Weasel again, but he won't be happy.
translation: 好吧，那你最好再去见见威塞尔，但他不会高兴的。

english: Is he ever happy?
translation: 他有过高兴的时候吗？

english: Hah! Good point! Best hurry along now!
translation: 哈！说得好！最好赶紧去吧！

english: Bye.
translation: 再见。

english: Ooh look at those carrots, fantastic! This juice is sure to be a treat.
translation: 噢看看这些胡萝卜，太棒了！这果汁肯定很棒。

english: Let's hope so.
translation: 希望如此。

english: You'll need a special glass for the juice, come back when you have space for one.
translation: 你需要一个特殊的杯子装果汁，等你有空间放一个时再回来。

english: Here's a carrot juice glass, make sure you use this!
translation: 这是胡萝卜汁专用杯，一定要用这个！

english: Isn't this just a beer glass?
translation: 这不就是个啤酒杯吗？

english: Ha! Just a beer glass! You're a real joker!
translation: 哈！只是个啤酒杯！你真会开玩笑！

english: It's VERY important that you use the correct glassware.
translation: 使用正确的玻璃器皿非常重要。

english: Alright, I will. Goodness me.
translation: 好吧，我会的。天哪。

english: The juice press is in the storage room behind the bar. Have fun, and don't make too much mess!
translation: 榨汁机在吧台后面的储藏室里。玩得开心，别弄得太乱！

english: Will do, thanks!
translation: 会的，谢谢！

english: How's the juicing going?
translation: 榨汁进行得怎么样了？

english: Erm, I lost the glass.
translation: 呃，我把杯子弄丢了。

english: Lost or broke? I'm not stupid. Those glasses are expensive you know!
translation: 丢了还是碎了？我不傻。那些杯子很贵的你知道吗！

english: Sorry, can I have another glass please?
translation: 抱歉，能再给我一个杯子吗？

english: Make some room for a new one and you can, yes.
translation: 腾出点空间放一个新的就可以，是的。

english: Yes you can, but take care of it this time!
translation: 是的可以，但这次要小心点！

english: Thanks, and I will.
translation: 谢谢，我会的。

english: I'm about to get juicing!
translation: 我正准备开始榨汁！

english: Well hurry up, we don't want to keep the Easter Bunny waiting!
translation: 那就快点，我们不想让复活节兔子久等！

english: Remember, the juice press is in the storage area behind the bar.
translation: 记住，榨汁机在吧台后面的储藏区。

english: I remember!
translation: 我记得！

english: Then why are you still here?
translation: 那你怎么还在这？

english: Good question, I'll go and make some juice.
translation: 问得好，我去榨点汁。

english: Ohhhh! Look at that juice! Such colour. It smells divine too.
translation: 噢！看那果汁！颜色真棒。闻起来也香极了。

english: Oh it's good stuff, I should know.
translation: 哦，这可是好东西，我最清楚。

english: Well let's see what the Easter Bunny thinks.
translation: 好吧，让我们看看复活节兔子怎么想。

english: I'll go and give it to him now, bye!
translation: 我现在就去给他，再见！

english: Hello again!
translation: 又见面了！

english: Hi [player name].
translation: 嗨 [player name]。

english: I think that fancy carrot juice has cheered the Easter Bunny up a bit, he really seemed to like it!
translation: 我想那特制胡萝卜汁让复活节兔子高兴了一点，他看起来真的很喜欢！

english: That's great!
translation: 太好了！

english: Thanks for the help.
translation: 谢谢帮忙。

english: Any time.
translation: 随时效劳。

english: I'm making some Easter Buns for the Easter Bunny, and I need some Easter Spices.
translation: 我正在给复活节兔子做一些复活节面包，需要一些复活节香料。

english: Do you have any I could use?
translation: 你有我可以用的吗？

english: Oh yes of course, we keep plenty behind the bar for cocktails.
translation: 哦当然有，我们在吧台后面存了很多用来调鸡尾酒。

english: Of course I can't give you the spices unless you can carry them. Come back when you have space!
translation: 当然，除非你能拿得动，否则我不能给你香料。等你有空间了再回来！

english: There you go, I hope they work well!
translation: 给你，希望它们好用！

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！

english: I bet those spices will bring those buns to life!
translation: 我敢打赌那些香料会让那些面包活起来！

english: Judging by the smell, I'd say so. Powerful stuff.
translation: 光闻味道我就这么觉得。劲道十足。

english: Thanks for both juice and spices, EB really liked the buns!
translation: 谢谢你的果汁和香料，EB(复活节兔子)真的很喜欢那些面包！

english: Talk about carrot juice.
translation: 谈谈胡萝卜汁。

english: Talk about Easter Buns.
translation: 谈谈复活节面包。

english: I'm too important to talk to the likes of you, leave.
translation: 我太重要了，没空跟你这种人说话，走开。

english: My secretary will deal with any inquiries you have about the White Chisel.
translation: 关于白凿公司的任何询问，我的秘书会处理。

english: My secretary is sitting just over there, thank you.
translation: 我的秘书就坐在那边，谢谢。

english: I'm busy, please leave.
translation: 我很忙，请离开。

english: Today is not a good day, can you come back tomorrow?
translation: 今天不太方便，你明天再来好吗？

english: If you're looking for the market, it's downstairs.
translation: 如果你在找市场，它在楼下。

english: Do you mind? You're blocking my view.
translation: 介意吗？你挡住我的视线了。

english: How did you get in here? I don't have time to talk to you!
translation: 你怎么进来的？我没时间跟你说话！

english: I can't help you, go and see my secretary.
translation: 我帮不了你，去找我的秘书。

english: Talk to my secretary, I don't have time to deal with you.
translation: 跟我秘书谈，我没空应付你。

english: But...
translation: 但是……

english: I said go!
translation: 我说走！

english: I told you to leave, human!
translation: 我叫你走，人类！

english: What can I do for you, human?
translation: 人类，我能为你做什么？

english: Can I help you with anything?
translation: 有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: Was there anything you wanted?
translation: 你有什么想要的吗？

english: What did you need of the White Chisel?
translation: 你需要白凿公司提供什么？

english: Is there anything you need assistance with?
translation: 有什么需要协助的吗？

english: And what can I do for you?
translation: 我能为你做什么？

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: I am the head secretary of the White Chisel.
translation: 我是白凿公司的首席秘书。

english: The what?
translation: 什么公司？

english: The White Chisel. We are one of the most powerful companies in the whole of the dwarven realm, we are. We have grown so powerful that we are now part of the Consortium.
translation: 白凿公司。我们是整个矮人领域最强大的公司之一。我们已经强大到成为了财团的一部分。

english: Where am I?
translation: 我在哪？

english: These are the offices of the White Chisel.
translation: 这里是白凿公司的办公室。

english: This is the official residence of the White Chisel.
translation: 这里是白凿公司的官方驻地。

english: Why, you are in the headquarters of the White Chisel.
translation: 哎呀，你在白凿公司的总部。

english: We share this floor of the palace with the other companies of the Consortium. And trade with them on the Trade Octagon.
translation: 我们和财团的其他公司共用宫殿的这一层。并在贸易八角场与他们交易。

english: The Trade Octagon?
translation: 贸易八角场？

english: See those traders out there, just out the door? They're all standing in the Trade Octagon. There's an awful lot of trade going on in the palace, you know.
translation: 看到门外那些商人了吗？他们都站在交易八角广场里。要知道，宫殿里的交易可繁忙着呢。

english: Anything else of interest in the palace?
translation: 宫殿里还有什么有趣的地方吗？

english: You will have to find that out on your own, I'm afraid. I do have more work to do.
translation: 恐怕你得自己去发现了。我还有更多工作要做。

english: Goodbye, human.
translation: 再见，人类。

english: See you later.
translation: 回头见。

english: Okay.
translation: 好的。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Where am I?
translation: 我在哪？

english: Is there anything I can help you with?
translation: 有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: I have to go!
translation: 我得走了！

english: Hi!
translation: 嗨！

english: Hi!
translation: 嗨！

english: So, what you up to out here?
translation: 那么，你在这外面做什么？

english: Oh...er...nothing!
translation: 哦……呃……没什么！

english: Ah, look what we have here, Will! This looks like someone who needs a good job!
translation: 啊，看看这是谁，威尔！这人看起来需要一份好工作！

english: What?
translation: 什么？

english: Goodness, Anne, I think you're right! This one's clearly never worked an honest day in their life, and it's about time someone changed that!
translation: 天哪，安妮，我想你是对的！这家伙显然一辈子都没正经工作过一天，是时候有人改变这种情况了！

english: But I don't need a...
translation: 但我并不需要……

english: Alas! We are sadly not currently in a place where we can take on any more staff, but let us hope that changes soon!
translation: 唉！遗憾的是我们现在没法招更多人，但希望情况很快会有所改变！

english: Okay...
translation: 好吧……

english: The Sailing skill will release on the 19th November.
translation: 航海技能将于11月19日发布。

english: Hello there, are you interested in buying one of my special capes?
translation: 你好，有兴趣买一件我的特制斗篷吗？

english: What's so special about your capes?
translation: 你的斗篷有什么特别的？

english: Ahh well they make it less likely that you'll accidently attack anyone wearing the same cape as you and easier to attack everyone else. They also make it easier to distinguish people who're wearing the same cape as you
translation: 啊，它们能让你不容易误伤穿着同样斗篷的人，同时也更容易攻击其他人。它们还能让你更容易区分穿着同样斗篷的人

english: from everyone else. They're very useful when out in the wilderness with friends or anyone else you don't want to harm.
translation: 和其他人。当你和朋友或任何你不想伤害的人在荒野时，它们非常有用。

english: So would you like to buy one?
translation: 那么你想买一件吗？

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: What's so special about your capes?
translation: 你的斗篷有什么特别的？

english: Yes please!
translation: 好的，谢谢！

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Hello there. What are you doing all the way out here?
translation: 你好。你大老远跑这来做什么？

english: Nothing you need to worry about.
translation: 没什么你需要担心的。

english: So this is where you scampered off to after the monster awoke?
translation: 所以怪物醒来后你就溜到这来了？

english: Look [player name], it was a simple misunderstanding, that's all...
translation: 听着 [player name]，那只是个简单的误会，仅此而已……

english: Oh really? You threatening to kill me was just a misunderstanding?
translation: 哦真的吗？你威胁要杀我也只是误会？

english: Things got a little heated down there, but we all made it out alive, right?
translation: 当时气氛有点紧张，但我们都活着出来了，对吧？

english: Barely... I had to defeat that monster on my own!
translation: 勉强……我得独自打败那个怪物！

english: What are you doing out here, anyway?
translation: 话说你在这做什么？

english: We thought you'd rat us out to the authorities, so we came out here to hide.
translation: 我们以为你会向当局告发我们，所以躲到这来了。

english: Plus, we heard there are some sealed tombs in the desert that haven't been touched in hundreds of years...
translation: 另外，我们听说沙漠里有些密封的墓穴几百年来没人动过……

english: Ah, of course... scoping out your next grave to rob.
translation: 啊，当然……是在勘察下一个要抢劫的坟墓吧。

english: Hello youngster!
translation: 你好，小家伙！

english: [I/We] don't talk to strange old people.
translation: [我/我们] 不和奇怪的老人说话。

english: Hey who you calling old?! And strange?!
translation: 嘿，你说谁老？！还有奇怪？！

english: Hello again.
translation: 又见面了。

english: You think you're tough do you?
translation: 你觉得自己很厉害是吗？

english: Pardon?
translation: 什么？

english: I can beat anyone up!
translation: 我能打倒任何人！

english: He can you know!
translation: 他可以的，你知道！

english: Really?
translation: 真的吗？

english: The boy begins to jump around with his fists up. You decide it's best not to kill him just yet.
translation: 男孩开始挥拳跳来跳去。你决定最好先别杀他。
