translation: 99000！那对我来说太贵了。

english: No problem.
translation: 没问题。

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好。

english: Leave me alone. I have work to do.
translation: 别烦我。我有工作要做。

english: Whatever you want, the answer's no.
translation: 无论你想要什么，答案都是不。

english: I don't have time to talk to you.
translation: 我没时间跟你说话。

english: Please don't disturb me.
translation: 请别打扰我。

english: I'm busy right now.
translation: 我现在很忙。

english: Hello there. How's it going?
translation: 你好。进展如何？

english: Well, I could do with a good rest, but fine otherwise.
translation: 我需要好好休息，但除此之外还好。

english: Sorry, but I'm busy right now.
translation: 抱歉，但我现在很忙。

english: Sorry, but I have lots of work to do.
translation: 抱歉，我还有很多工作要做。

english: Busy, busy, busy.
translation: 忙，忙，忙。

english: Not too bad, but the work is definitely tiring.
translation: 还不错，但这活儿确实挺累人的。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Hey there!
translation: 嘿！

english: You seem rather happy for a busy labourer with a bad case of spots.
translation: 对于一个满脸长痘的忙碌劳工来说，你看起来相当开心啊。

english: Of course! These spots are the best thing since log rollers!
translation: 当然！这些痘痘简直是自滚木以来最好的东西！

english: I really don't follow.
translation: 我真听不懂你在说什么。

english: Well thanks to these spots, the city has been under quarantine. That means there's no goods coming in or out. No goods means we don't have any work to do!
translation: 嗯，多亏了这些痘痘，全城都被隔离了。这意味着没有货物进出。没货物就意味着我们不用干活了！

english: But aren't the spots intolerable?
translation: 但这些痘痘不是让人难以忍受吗？

english: I would take a dermatological irritation over back-breaking, mind-numbing labour any day!
translation: 我宁愿忍受皮肤瘙痒，也不愿干那种累断腰、麻木心智的苦力活！

english: Right... Okay then...
translation: 好吧……那行吧……

english: Hey.
translation: 嘿。

english: What's wrong?
translation: 怎么了？

english: The High Priest has determined that these spots aren't contagious. He's opened the city up again, which means we have to go back to work.
translation: 大祭司判定这些痘痘不传染。他重新开放了城市，这意味着我们得回去干活了。

english: Now that all the plagues have been cured, we've had to go back to work.
translation: 现在所有瘟疫都治好了，我们不得不回去工作了。

english: Cheer up! Work can't be that bad.
translation: 振作点！工作没那么糟糕吧。

english: You have no idea...
translation: 你根本不懂……

english: What are you doing?
translation: 你在做什么？

english: I have this acne potion that I thought might clear up your spots?
translation: 我有瓶治痤疮的药水，我想也许能治好你的痘痘？

english: What, so that I can get back to work?
translation: 怎么，好让我回去干活？

english: So that you don't suffer needlessly?
translation: 是为了让你不再无谓地受苦？

english: I know your type, trying to ruin the small man's fun! I won't have it!
translation: 我懂你们这种人，就想毁掉小人物的乐趣！我绝不答应！

english: Look, I'm sorry. I only wanted to help you.
translation: 听着，我很抱歉。我只是想帮你。

english: Clear off!
translation: 滚开！

english: No, I don't want to buy anything.
translation: 不，我不想买任何东西。

english: Can't stop to talk. I have work to do.
translation: 没空聊天。我有工作要做。

english: Hello there!
translation: 你好啊！

english: Oh, hello.
translation: 哦，你好。

english: How are things going up here?
translation: 上面情况怎么样？

english: The beast still rages, but we're managing.
translation: 野兽仍在肆虐，但我们还能应付。

english: Plenty of treasure and materials to be found in the tunnels, at least!
translation: 至少隧道里有很多宝藏和材料可挖！

english: What will you do with it all?
translation: 你们打算拿这些东西做什么？

english: The raw materials will be used to maintain Cam Torum. As for everything else, if you help us, you're allowed a share of the treasures.
translation: 原材料将用于维护卡姆托鲁姆城。至于其他东西，如果你帮我们，你可以分一份宝藏。

english: That's very generous, thank you.
translation: 那太慷慨了，谢谢。

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！

english: Hmm? Did you say something?
translation: 嗯？你说了什么吗？

english: I said hello.
translation: 我说你好。

english: Oh, that's nice.
translation: 哦，真好。

english: Are you okay?
translation: 你没事吧？

english: Why wouldn't I be? I'm not the one lost in the mountain!
translation: 我为什么会有事？困在山里的又不是我！

english: Excuse me? Who's lost in the mountain?
translation: 你说什么？谁困在山里了？

english: Karlo! Oh sweet Karlo... An inspiration to us all!
translation: 卡洛！哦，亲爱的卡洛……他是我们的榜样！

english: He really knew how to swing a pickaxe, but where did that get him?!
translation: 他真的很会挥镐子，但那又给他带来了什么？！

english: Trapped in the depths under all that rock and stone...
translation: 被困在层层岩石之下的深处……

english: Do you think he's still alive?
translation: 你觉得他还活着吗？

english: I don't know.
translation: 我不知道。

english: What I do know is that I do this for Karlo. Let's make him proud!
translation: 我只知道我是为了卡洛才这么做的。让我们让他骄傲吧！

english: For Karlo!
translation: 为了卡洛！

english: For Karlo!
translation: 为了卡洛！

english: Into the tunnels, quick!
translation: 快进隧道！

english: Let's go!
translation: 走吧！

english: Quickly, while it's recovering!
translation: 快点，趁它还在恢复！

english: What's it left this time?
translation: 这次它留下了什么？

english: It's coming back!
translation: 它回来了！

english: Prepare yourselves!
translation: 做好准备！

english: Retreat!
translation: 撤退！

english: Run!
translation: 快跑！

english: Hi there.
translation: 嗨。

english: Can I help you?
translation: 我能帮你吗？

english: I don't know. Can you?
translation: 我不知道。你能吗？

english: Probably not. I'm on break.
translation: 恐怕不能。我在休息。

english: Break from what?
translation: 休什么假？

english: See that big mountain outside? That's the Darkfrost. There's a nice beastie up there called the Hueycoatl.
translation: 看到外面那座大山了吗？那是暗霜山。上面有个叫“休伊科特尔”的好家伙。

english: You humans don't seem to care that much, so as usual it's up to us to stop it making a big mess of the entire area.
translation: 你们人类似乎不太在乎，所以像往常一样，得靠我们来阻止它把整个地区搞得一团糟。

english: Hello again. Still on break?
translation: 又见面了。还在休息？

english: I am. Dealing with the Hueycoatl is hard work, and it's not like you humans care enough to contribute much.
translation: 是的。对付休伊科特尔可是苦差事，而且你们人类也没那么上心来帮忙。

english: Well, if you're in need of help, I'm open to contributing.
translation: 嗯，如果你需要帮助，我愿意出一份力。

english: You are? Oh... Fair enough then. In that case, head on up the mountain and get stuck in.
translation: 是吗？噢……那好吧。既然如此，就上山去大干一场吧。

english: Well, I've actually been up there helping myself.
translation: 嗯，其实我已经在那边帮过忙了。

english: You have? Oh... Fair enough then. I guess you've earned yourself a break as well.
translation: 你已经帮过了？噢……那好吧。看来你也该休息一下了。

english: Well I could do with a good rest, but fine otherwise.
translation: 嗯，我确实需要好好休息一下，不过除此之外还好。

english: Hiya.
translation: 嘿呀。

english: What do you want? I've got work to do!
translation: 你想要什么？我还有工作要做！

english: Can you teach me anything?
translation: 你能教我点什么吗？

english: No - I've got one lousy apprentice already, and that's quite enough hassle! Go away!
translation: 不行——我已经有一个糟糕的学徒了，麻烦够多了！走开！

english: Got another load for ya!
translation: 又给你弄了一堆货！

english: Great, just what my arms need!
translation: 太好了，正是我的胳膊需要的！

english: Ohhh, time for a break.
translation: 噢，休息时间到了。

english: Time I got moving...
translation: 我该动身了……

english: Keep 'em coming!
translation: 继续送来！

english: Bleah
translation: 呸

english: Another lot for ya!
translation: 又给你弄了一批！

english: Alright, thanks!
translation: 好的，谢谢！

english: Off we go again!
translation: 我们又出发了！

english: How's it going, officers?
translation: 怎么样了，警官们？

english: Another boring day.
translation: 又是无聊的一天。

english: Nothing new there.
translation: 没什么新鲜的。

english: I'm being slaughtered!
translation: 我被屠杀了！

english: Oh, they're all dead.
translation: 哦，他们都死了。

english: Don't dawdle there!
translation: 别在那磨蹭！

english: Yeah, yeah, I'm movin' guv.
translation: 是是是，我正走着呢，长官。

english: Hmm, time for a break.
translation: 嗯，休息时间到了。

english: You there! Over here! Let's have a little chat before you head up there!
translation: 那边的你！过来！在你上去之前我们聊两句！

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: Hello there, my short-tongued friend. What can I do for you?
translation: 你好啊，我短舌头的朋友。我能为你做什么？

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: What do you think I'm doing here?
translation: 你觉得我在这里做什么？

english: I wouldn't like to guess.
translation: 我可不想猜。

english: How disappointing. I enjoy a good guessing game! No matter. My colleague and I are here are on a mission of preservation!
translation: 真失望。我喜欢玩猜谜游戏！算了。我和我的同事在这里执行一项保护任务！

english: Preservation of what?
translation: 保护什么？

english: Preservation of these magnificent colossal wyrm remains, of course! You see, we have a termite problem.
translation: 当然是保护这些宏伟的巨型蛇龙遗骸！你看，我们有白蚁问题。

english: I'm beginning to see your role in all of this.
translation: 我开始明白你在这其中的作用了。

english: Indeed! And while my archaeological skills are certainly exemplary, I also bring a certain set of more unique skills to this troublesome assignment.
translation: 确实！虽然我的考古技能无疑是典范，但我也为这项棘手的任务带来了一些更独特的技能。

english: Oh for goodness sake, he just eats the termites!
translation: 噢天哪，他就是吃白蚁的！

english: Ahem! I am able to dispose of the termites in ways others cannot.
translation: 咳咳！我能用别人无法做到的方式处理白蚁。

english: I see. So can I help your preservation efforts?
translation: 我明白了。那我能帮你们的保护工作吗？

english: Why yes! It seems our scaffolding has proven to be a useful place for adventurous types to practice running and jumping in quick succession.
translation: 当然可以！看来我们的脚手架已被证明是冒险者练习连续奔跑和跳跃的好地方。

english: Should you also wish to practice these skills, you may come across the aforementioned termites while you traverse the ropes. Simply scoop them up and bring them to me.
translation: 如果你也想练习这些技能，你在穿越绳索时可能会遇到上述白蚁。只需把它们收集起来带给我。

english: I'll happily exchange them for some goodies I've collected during my time here! You can also keep any bone shards they may have unfortunately chipped off.
translation: 我很乐意用我在这里收集的一些好东西跟你交换！你也可以保留它们不幸啃下来的任何骨片。

english: Sounds simple enough!
translation: 听起来很简单！

english: Wonderful! To get started, just use the ladder by the wyrm's skull to climb up onto the scaffolding.
translation: 太棒了！开始时，只需使用蛇龙头骨旁的梯子爬上脚手架。

english: Initially the route is the same for everyone, but part way round you'll find a loftier section of scaffolding. If you're skilled, that route might be more appealing to you.
translation: 起初路线对每个人都一样，但在半途你会发现一段更高的脚手架。如果你技术娴熟，那条路线可能更吸引你。

english: That said, don't go up there unless you know what you're doing. I have work to do so I can't spend all my time patching people up when they hurt themselves!
translation: 话虽如此，除非你知道自己在做什么，否则别上去。我还有工作要做，没法把所有时间都花在给受伤的人包扎上！

english: You'll need at least 50 Agility to tackle the basic course and 62 Agility to take on the advanced course.
translation: 你需要至少50级敏捷才能应对基础课程，62级敏捷才能挑战高级课程。

english: Great, thanks!
translation: 太好了，谢谢！

english: Good luck!
translation: 祝你好运！

english: Remind me, what are you doing here?
translation: 提醒我一下，你在这里做什么？

english: Would you like to trade?
translation: 你想交易吗？

english: I certainly would!
translation: 我当然想！

english: How am I doing so far?
translation: 我目前表现如何？

english: Which route would you like to know about?
translation: 你想了解哪条路线？

english: You haven't completed any laps of the basic agility course yet. There's been X global completions and the global best time is X.
translation: 你还没有完成任何一圈基础敏捷课程。全球已完成X次，全球最佳时间是X。

english: You haven't completed any laps of the advanced agility course yet. There's been X global completions and the global best time is X.
translation: 你还没有完成任何一圈高级敏捷课程。全球已完成X次，全球最佳时间是X。

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: Farewell.
translation: 告辞。

english: Remind me, what are you doing here?
translation: 提醒我一下，你在这里做什么？

english: Would you like to trade?
translation: 你想交易吗？

english: How am I doing so far?
translation: 我目前表现如何？

english: Colossal Wyrm Basic Course.
translation: 巨型蛇龙基础课程。

english: Colossal Wyrm Advanced Course.
translation: 巨型蛇龙高级课程。

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: Whut you want?
translation: 你想要什麼？

english: What are you in for?
translation: 你因为什么进来的？

english: Me not sure. Me pick some stuff up and take it away.
translation: 我不确定。我捡了些东西然后拿走了。

english: Well, did the stuff belong to you?
translation: 嗯，那些东西是你的吗？

english: Umm...no.
translation: 呃……不是。

english: Well, that would be why then.
translation: 嗯，那就是原因了。

english: Oh, right.
translation: 哦，好的。

english: Sorry, thought this was a zoo.
translation: 抱歉，我以为这是动物园。

english: What are you in for?
translation: 你因为什么进来的？

english: Sorry, thought this was a zoo.
translation: 抱歉，我以为这是动物园。

english: Hello there friend.
translation: 你好啊，朋友。

english: Oh..what am I to do, Christmas is ruined.
translation: 噢……我该怎么办，圣诞节毁了。

english: What's the matter?
translation: 怎么了？

english: Christmas is ruined, my bakery is ruined, everything is ruined!
translation: 圣诞节毁了，我的面包店毁了，一切都毁了！

english: Maybe this has something to do with Santa in Varrock Square.
translation: 也许这和维洛克广场的圣诞老人有关。

english: Adventurer! You've come at the right time. I need your help.
translation: 冒险者！你来得正是时候。我需要你的帮助。

english: Could this have something to do with some missing Gingerbread Gnomes?
translation: 这会不会和一些失踪的姜饼地精有关？

english: How did you know?
translation: 你怎么知道的？

english: Santa told me to sort it out for him, he said his son has taken over the Gingerbread Gnome production.
translation: 圣诞老人让我帮他解决这件事，他说他的儿子接管了姜饼地精的生产。

english: He has been an absolute disaster, he suddenly showed up and took control of our bakery. We tried to stop him, but he locked up the two other bakers!
translation: 他简直是个灾难，他突然出现并控制了我们的面包店。我们试图阻止他，但他把另外两个面包师关起来了！

english: How did you manage to escape?
translation: 你是怎么逃出来的？

english: Well... I don't think he knows how Gingerbread Gnomes are made, he brought in an Icelord to ice the gingerbread.
translation: 嗯……我觉得他不知道姜饼地精是怎么做的，他带了个冰霜领主来给姜饼结冰。

english: I threw a stone at it to cause a distraction, giving me a chance to escape. After I got out, I heard Jack lock the entrance behind me.
translation: 我朝它扔了块石头制造混乱，给了我逃跑的机会。出来后，我听到杰克锁上了身后的入口。

english: He brought in an Icelord!? I don't know how to deal with one of those.
translation: 他带了个冰霜领主！？我不知道该怎么对付那种东西。

english: It's terrifying! I think Jack must have a few screws loose to think that was a good idea.
translation: 太可怕了！我觉得杰克肯定是脑子进水了才会觉得那是个好主意。

english: Well, I better tell Santa, since I can't get into the bakery from here....
translation: 好吧，我最好告诉圣诞老人，因为我从这里进不去面包店……

english: Please hurry, we need to restart production as soon as possible.
translation: 请快点，我们需要尽快恢复生产。

english: Have you managed to free the other bakers and stop Jack Frost yet?
translation: 你成功解救其他面包师并阻止霜冻杰克了吗？

english: Not yet, I'm still working on it.
translation: 还没，我还在努力。

english: Hurry we need to get back into production, before it's too late.
translation: 快点，我们需要在太迟之前恢复生产。

english: Got a medpack? I feel terrible.
translation: 有医疗包吗？我感觉糟透了。

english: What happened to you?
translation: 你怎么了？

english: Lizardman bite. There's always a fever after you've been bitten by one of those. I'm sure they don't clean their teeth.
translation: 被蜥蜴人咬了。被那种东西咬了总会发烧。我敢肯定它们不刷牙。

english: Sorry, I haven't got one.
translation: 抱歉，我没有。

english: Try looking in the storage tents outside.
translation: 试试去外面的储物帐篷找找。

english: Thanks for the medpack. I'm feeling a lot better now.
translation: 谢谢医疗包。我现在感觉好多了。

english: While you're here, you could help the war effort by fetching medpacks for my sick comrades. There'll be some in the storage tents outside.
translation: 既然你在这儿，可以帮战争前线做点贡献，给我的病号战友取些医疗包。外面的储物帐篷里有一些。

english: I'll bear that in mind.
translation: 我会记在心里的。

english: Gimme a medpack - I need my strength back.
translation: 给我个医疗包——我需要恢复体力。

english: What happened to me is nothing compared to what's gonna happen to the filthy lizardman who did it. When I'm out of here, I'm gonna find him and fix him good.
translation: 我遭遇的事跟那个肮脏蜥蜴人将要遭遇的比起来不算什么。等我出去了，我要找到他好好教训他一顿。

english: Cheers. When I get back on my feet, there's gonna be one sorry lizardman out there.
translation: 谢了。等我恢复过来，外面就会有个倒霉的蜥蜴人。

english: Those lizardmen gotta die! Ya hear me? I want them all dead! All of 'em!
translation: 那些蜥蜴人必须死！听到了吗？我要他们全死！全部！

english: Those ruffians hit me pretty hard. Have you got a medpack?
translation: 那些流氓打我很重。你有医疗包吗？

english: Gangsters. I was on patrol in the docklands, but those Piscarilius scumbags lured me into an alley and hit me with a stick.
translation: 是帮派分子。我在码头区巡逻，但那些皮斯卡里琉斯的混蛋把我诱进小巷，用棍子打了我。

english: Thanks. Hopefully I'll be back on patrol again soon.
translation: 谢谢。希望我很快能回去巡逻。

english: We'll never keep on top of the crime in this kingdom at this rate. Maybe you could help deal with some gangsters while you're in Kourend.
translation: 照这样下去，我们永远无法控制这个王国的犯罪率。也许你在库兰德王国期间能帮忙对付一些帮派分子。

english: I'm alright now. Try another soldier.
translation: 我现在没事了。试试另一个士兵。

english: Oh dearie me...
translation: 噢天哪……

english: Ooo-er...
translation: 哎哟……

english: Relapse over here!
translation: 这边病情复发了！

english: Medic!
translation: 军医！

english: What happened to you?
translation: 你怎么了？

english: Sorry, I haven't got one.
translation: 抱歉，我没有。

english: I'll bear that in mind.
translation: 我会记在心里的。

english: Gah! You play like a donkey, don't just sit there, get up and get the ball back!
translation: 嘎！你踢得像头驴，别光坐在那，起来把球抢回来！

english: Hello?
translation: 喂？

english: That's more like it, get in there!
translation: 这才像样，冲进去！

english: Excuse me?
translation: 你说什么？

english: Oof. That's got to hurt.
translation: 哎哟。那肯定很疼。

english: You think this guy is far too engrossed in the sport to pay any attention to anything else.
translation: 你觉得这家伙太沉迷于运动，根本顾不上其他事。

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 虽然你找到了顾客，但你似乎没带对食物！你需要 [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]！

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 恐怕预制菜肴不行。只有手工制作的地精美食才配得上阿鲁夫特高空餐厅的顾客。

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Wurbel
translation: 你把 [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] 的送货交给了沃贝尔

english: Come on guys, I've got a blurberry special riding on this one. Oh my order? Thanks.
translation: 伙计们加油，我这单可是赌上了一份蓝莓特调鸡尾酒。哦，我的订单？谢谢。

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 你有 [number] 积分可用于兑换免费送货代币。你可以获得 [number] 份地精食物送货上门。

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: 别忘了从小阿鲁夫特‧吉安妮那里领取你的免费送货代币。

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 你的送货太晚了！回去找小阿鲁夫特再拿一个订单。你扔掉了送货箱，因为你不再需要它了。

english: Welcome to my food store! Would you like to buy anything?
translation: 欢迎来到我的食品店！想买点什么吗？

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No, thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: What can you recommend?
translation: 你有什么推荐的吗？

english: We have this really exotic fruit all the way from Karamja. It's called a banana.
translation: 我们有一种来自卡拉姆詹岛的非常奇特的水果。它叫香蕉。

english: Hmm, I think I'll try one.
translation: 嗯，我想尝一个。

english: Great. You might as well take a look at the rest of my wares as well.
translation: 太好了。你不妨也看看我的其他商品。

english: I don't like the sound of that.
translation: 我不喜欢那听起来的样子。

english: Well, it's your choice, but I do recommend them.
translation: 嗯，这是你的选择，但我确实推荐它们。

english: Is it nice and tidy round the back now?
translation: 后面现在整洁了吗？

english: Yes, can I work out front now?
translation: 是的，我现在能在前面工作了吗？

english: No, I'm the one who works here.
translation: 不，在这里工作的人是我。

english: Yes, are you going to pay me yet?
translation: 是的，你打算付钱给我了吗？

english: Umm... No, not yet.
translation: 呃……不，还没。

english: No, it's a complete mess.
translation: 不，还是一团糟。

english: Ah well, it'll give you something to do, won't it.
translation: 啊好吧，这也让你有点事做，不是吗。

english: Can I buy something please?
translation: 我能买点东西吗？

english: Yes, of course.
translation: 是的，当然。

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: No, thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: What can you recommend?
translation: 你有什么推荐的吗？

english: Hmm, I think I'll try one.
translation: 嗯，我想尝一个。

english: I don't like the sound of that.
translation: 我不喜欢那听起来的样子。

english: Yes, can I work out front now?
translation: 是的，我现在能在前面工作了吗？

english: Yes, are you going to pay me yet?
translation: 是的，你打算付钱给我了吗？

english: No, it's a complete mess
translation: 不，还是一团糟

english: Can I buy something please?
translation: 我能买点东西吗？

english: I'm the head gardener around here. If you're looking for woad leaves, or if you need help with owt, I'm yer man.
translation: 我是这儿的首席园丁。如果你在找菘蓝叶，或者需要帮忙做任何事，找我就对了。

english: Yes please, I need woad leaves.
translation: 是的，请，我需要菘蓝叶。

english: How much are you willing to pay?
translation: 你愿意付多少钱？

english: How about 5 coins?
translation: 5枚金币怎么样？

english: No no, that's far too little. Woad leaves are hard to get. I used to have plenty but someone kept stealing them off me.
translation: 不不，那太少了。菘蓝叶很难弄到。我以前有很多，但有人一直偷我的。

english: How about 10 coins?
translation: 10枚金币怎么样？

english: How about 15 coins?
translation: 15枚金币怎么样？

english: Mmmm... okay, that sounds fair.
translation: 嗯……好吧，听起来很公平。

english: I don't have enough coins to buy the leaves. I'll come back later.
translation: 我没有足够的金币买叶子。我晚点再来。

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

english: I'll be around if you have any more gardening needs.
translation: 如果你还有园艺需求，我随时都在。

english: How about 20 coins?
translation: 20枚金币怎么样？

english: Okay, that's more than fair.
translation: 好的，那太公道了。

english: Here, have two, you're a generous person.
translation: 给，拿两片，你是个慷慨的人。

english: How about ME helping YOU instead?
translation: 不如让我来帮你怎么样？

english: That's a nice thing to say. I do need a hand, now you mention it. You see, there's some stupid mole digging up my lovely garden.
translation: 这话真暖心。既然你提起了，我确实需要帮手。你看，有只愚蠢的鼹鼠在挖我可爱的花园。

english: A mole? Surely you've dealt with moles in the past?
translation: 鼹鼠？你以前肯定对付过鼹鼠吧？

english: Ah, well this is no ordinary mole! He's a big'un for sure. Ya see... I'm always relied upon to make the most of this 'ere garden - the faster and bigger I can grow plants the better!
translation: 啊，但这可不是普通的鼹鼠！它肯定是个大块头。你看……大家总是指望我把这个花园打理得最好——植物长得越快越大越好！

english: In my quest for perfection I looked into 'Malignius-Mortifer's-Super-Ultra-Flora-Growth-Potion'. It worked well on my plants, no doubt about it! But it had the same effect on a nearby mole. Ya can imagine the
translation: 为了追求完美，我研究了“马利格尼乌斯 - 莫蒂弗超级超强植物生长药水”。它对植物效果很好，毫无疑问！但它对附近的一只鼹鼠也有同样的效果。你可以想象

english: havoc he causes to my patches of sunflowers! Why, if any of the other gardeners knew about this mole, I'd be looking for a new job in no time!
translation: 它给我的向日葵田造成了多大的破坏！要是其他园丁知道这只鼹鼠的事，我立马就得找工作了！

english: I see. What do you need me to do?
translation: 我明白了。你需要我做什么？

english: If ya are willing maybe yer wouldn't mind killing it for me? Take a spade and use it to shake up them mole hills. Be careful though, he really is big!
translation: 如果你愿意，也许你不介意帮我杀了它？拿把铲子去摇晃那些鼹鼠丘。不过要小心，它真的很大！

english: Is there anything in this for me?
translation: 这对我有什么好处吗？

english: Well, if yer gets any mole skin or mole claws off 'un, I'd trade 'em for bird nests if ye brings 'em here to me.
translation: 嗯，如果你能从它身上弄到鼹鼠皮或鼹鼠爪，如果你把它们带到这里给我，我可以跟你换鸟巢。

english: Right, I'll bear it in mind.
translation: 好的，我会记在心里的。

english: Sorry, but I'm not interested.
translation: 抱歉，但我没兴趣。

english: Fair enough.
translation: 好吧。

english: If I'm not mistaken, you've got some body parts from a big mole there! I'll trade it for bird nests if ye likes. Or was ye wantin' some woad leaves instead?
translation: 如果我没看错，你那儿有些大鼹鼠的身体部位！如果你喜欢，我可以拿鸟巢跟你换。或者你想要些菘蓝叶？

english: Okay, I will trade the mole parts.
translation: 好的，我会交易鼹鼠部件。

english: Do you know much about these shoes?
translation: 你对这些鞋子了解多少？

english: Those look like my friend Tiffy's armour.
translation: 那看起来像我朋友蒂菲的盔甲。

english: If you had mole slippers, I reckon I could combine 'em.
translation: 如果你有鼹鼠拖鞋，我想我可以把它们组合起来。

english: Well, those look like very unusual moles indeed. Little 'uns.
translation: 嗯，那些看起来确实是非常不寻常的鼹鼠。小家伙们。

english: If you had holy sandals, I reckon I could combine 'em.
translation: 如果你有神圣凉鞋，我想我可以把它们组合起来。

english: Woops I can't do this right now. Come back in an hour.
translation: 哎呀，我现在做不了这个。一小时后再来吧。

english: Here, have this.
translation: 给，拿着这个。

english: Yes please, I need woad leaves.
translation: 是的，请，我需要菘蓝叶。

english: How about 5 coins?
translation: 5枚金币怎么样？

english: How about 10 coins?
translation: 10枚金币怎么样？

english: How about 15 coins?
translation: 15枚金币怎么样？

english: How about 20 coins?
translation: 20枚金币怎么样？

english: How about ME helping YOU instead?
translation: 不如让我来帮你怎么样？

english: Sorry, but I'm not interested.
translation: 抱歉，但我没兴趣。

english: Okay, I will trade the mole parts.
translation: 好的，我会交易鼹鼠部件。

english: Yes
translation: 是的

english: No
translation: 不

english: I can't believe she's done this.
translation: 真不敢相信她做了这种事。

english: Who's done this?
translation: 谁做了这种事？

english: Fabia! She asked me to meet her, and I quote, 'by the special tree'. You may notice that she isn't here! I've been waiting for hours!
translation: 法比娅！她约我见面，原话是“在那棵特殊的树旁”。你可能注意到了她不在这里！我已经等了好几个小时了！

english: Do you think she might just be delayed?
translation: 你觉得她可能只是迟到了？

english: I know her too well. She wouldn't be delayed coming to see me.
translation: 我太了解她了。她绝不会迟到不来见我。

english: Could you be at the wrong special tree?
translation: 你会不会是在错误的特殊树旁？

english: No! This is the one, singular, special tree!
translation: 不！这就是那棵独一无二的特殊树！

english: Humour me for just a moment. What if, amongst this entire rainforest, there's a second very similar tree?
translation: 迁就我一下。假如，在整个雨林中，还有第二棵非常相似的树呢？

english: And Fabia would find herself at the wrong tree in this scenario?
translation: 在这种情况下，法比娅会不会发现自己站在了错误的树旁？

english: Or maybe it's you who is at the wrong one?
translation: 或者也许是你站错了地方？

english: No, absolutely not! I know where to meet Fabia and I wouldn't miss any opportunity to do so!
translation: 不，绝对不可能！我知道在哪里见法比娅，我绝不会错过任何机会！

english: This was the tree where we first met. It was a lovely day! A botanical tour of the rainforest, but the only thing I found myself looking at was her...
translation: 这是我们第一次见面的那棵树。那是美好的一天！虽然是雨林植物之旅，但我眼里只看得到她……

english: Well, I'm sure the two of you will find each other soon. However, I do suspect that might happen sooner if you considered looking by some other trees...
translation: 嗯，我相信你们俩很快就会找到彼此。不过，我确实怀疑如果你考虑去其他树旁看看，可能会更快发生……

english: Hmm... I'll think about it, but for now, I'll wait here a while longer.
translation: 嗯……我会考虑的，但现在，我还要在这里再等一会儿。

english: Hello again, iknami! Thank you for helping us find each other!
translation: 又见面了，朋友！谢谢你帮我们找到彼此！

english: To think we were waiting by different trees! It was so silly of us!
translation: 想想我们竟然在不同的树旁等待！真是太傻了！

english: Well, I'm happy to see you together again. Now, I'm sure you have a lot of catching up to do. I'll leave you to it.
translation: 嗯，很高兴看到你们又在一起了。现在，我相信你们有很多话要叙旧。我就不打扰你们了。

english: Timoiva, iknami!
translation: 再见，朋友！

english: Nilsal! Looking to buy some dyes?
translation: 你好！想买些染料吗？

english: I'll have a look.
translation: 我看看。

english: I'm good, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。

english: In that case, timoiva for now.
translation: 那样的话，暂时再见。

english: I'll have a look.
translation: 我看看。

english: I'm good, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。

english: Nilsal, traveller.
translation: 你好，旅行者。

english: Can you heal me? I'm injured.
translation: 你能治疗我吗？我受伤了。

english: Sorry, but I cannot.
translation: 抱歉，我不能。

english: I could, but you don't appear to actually need healing right now.
translation: 我可以，但你看起来现在并不需要治疗。

english: Of course.
translation: 当然。

english: The teoki whispers a prayer and you suddenly feel a bit better.
translation: 提奥基低声祈祷，你突然感觉好了一些。

english: How are things here?
translation: 这里情况怎么样？

english: Very busy, my friend. We have a lot of repairs to be doing, not to mention that there will soon be a new Gathering taking place here.
translation: 非常忙碌，我的朋友。我们要做很多修缮工作，更不用说很快这里就要举行新的集会了。

english: Any problems of note?
translation: 有什么值得注意的问题吗？

english: We did have a creature from down in the caverns try to come up here at one point. Presumably they've been disturbed by recent events. The warriors quickly dealt with it though.
translation: 确实曾有一只来自洞穴深处的生物试图上来。大概是最近的事件惊扰了它们。不过战士们很快就解决了它。

english: That's good to hear.
translation: 听到这个消息真好。

english: I'd better be off.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: May the sun light your way, traveller.
translation: 愿阳光照亮你的前路，旅行者。

english: Can you heal me? I'm injured.
translation: 你能治疗我吗？我受伤了。

english: How are things here?
translation: 这里情况怎么样？

english: I'd better be off.
translation: 我最好走了。

english: Greetings human. Do you seek guidance?
translation: 问候人类。你寻求指引吗？

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: I am Xorrah quo Sihar. I am one of the mystics of the Kahlith.
translation: 我是佐拉‧夸‧西哈尔。我是卡利特的神秘主义者之一。

english: Kahlith?
translation: 卡利特？

english: Yes. At one time we were like you, but then we met the Tasakaal. They taught us to have purpose. They taught us to serve the balance.
translation: 是的。曾经我们也像你一样，但后来我们遇到了塔萨卡尔。他们教导我们要有目标。他们教导我们要侍奉平衡。

english: Our old lives were left behind. In their place, the Kahlith were born.
translation: 我们抛弃了旧生活。取而代之的是卡利特的诞生。

english: Tasakaal?
translation: 塔萨卡尔？

english: Our teachers. They showed us the way and taught us to serve the balance.
translation: 我们的导师。他们为我们指明了道路，教导我们要侍奉平衡。

english: The balance?
translation: 平衡？

english: For every death, there must be life. For every life, there must be a death. This is the balance.
translation: 有死必有生，有生必有死。这就是平衡。

english: Our purpose, as taught to us by the Tasakaal, is to keep this balance, no matter the cost.
translation: 正如塔萨卡尔教导我们的，我们的目标是维持这种平衡，不惜一切代价。

english: A mystic?
translation: 神秘主义者？

english: Yes. All Kahlith serve the balance. To do this, we take on one of four roles.
translation: 是的。所有卡利特都侍奉平衡。为此，我们承担四种角色之一。

english: My role is that of a mystic. I learn from the Tasakaal and then pass on their teachings.
translation: 我的角色是神秘主义者。我向塔萨卡尔学习，然后传承他们的教诲。

english: That's all thanks.
translation: 就这些，谢谢。

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: This is our home. In your tongue, it is known as Mount Karuulm.
translation: 这是我们的家园。用你们的语言来说，它被称为卡鲁尔姆山。

english: My tongue?
translation: 我的语言？

english: Yes. You speak the language of humans but we Kahlith have our own language.
translation: 是的。你说的是人类的语言，但我们卡利特有自己的语言。

english: In the past, we have tried to teach our language to your kind. However, despite the simplicity of our tongue, success was limited.
translation: 过去，我们曾尝试教你们人类我们的语言。然而，尽管我们的语言很简单，但收效甚微。

english: We find that it is easier to just use your language when your kind are around.
translation: 我们发现，当你们人类在场时，直接使用你们的语言更容易。

english: Can you give an example?
translation: 你能举个例子吗？

english: Of our language?
translation: 关于我们的语言？

english: Yes please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Well you'll find our language is quite a simple one. Our names are a good example of how it is used.
translation: 嗯，你会发现我们的语言相当简单。我们的名字就是如何使用它的一个很好的例子。

english: I am Xorrah quo Sihar. The first word, 'Xorrah', is unique to me and it is how I can be identified.
translation: 我是佐拉‧夸‧西哈尔。第一个词“佐拉”是我独有的，用来识别我。

english: The second word, 'quo', is a basic Kahlith word that translates to 'the' in your language.
translation: 第二个词“夸”是一个基本的卡利特词汇，在你们的语言中翻译为“the(定冠词)”。

english: The final word, 'Sihar', is my title. There are four possible titles, one for each role in Kahlith society. My title translates to 'Mystic' in your tongue.
translation: 最后一个词“西哈尔”是我的头衔。有四种可能的头衔，对应卡利特社会中的四种角色。我的头衔在你们的语言中翻译为“神秘主义者”。

english: So in my language your name would be Xorrah the Mystic?
translation: 所以在我的语言中，你的名字就是“神秘主义者佐拉”？

english: Exactly.
translation: 没错。

english: Interesting. Thanks for the information.
translation: 有趣。谢谢你的信息。

english: I'm good thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Kahlith?
translation: 卡利特？

english: Tasakaal?
translation: 塔萨卡尔？

english: The balance?
translation: 平衡？

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

english: That's all thanks.
translation: 就这些，谢谢。

english: A mystic?
translation: 神秘主义者？

english: My tongue?
translation: 我的语言？

english: Can you give an example?
translation: 你能举个例子吗？

english: I'm good thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。

english: Ah, hello there, warrior.
translation: 啊，你好啊，战士。

english: Can you tell me a bit about skillcapes?
translation: 你能跟我讲讲技能斗篷吗？

english: Sure. You can buy a skillcape when you reach level 99 in a skill. Apart from boosting your statistics in that skill, they can also be used to perform some pretty amazing emotes!
translation: 当然。当你某项技能达到99级时，可以购买技能斗篷。除了提升该技能的属性外，它们还可以用来做出一些非常惊人的表情动作！

english: The Cape of Strength also provides you with unlimited teleports to our guild. Is there anything else you would like to know?
translation: 力量斗篷还为你提供无限次传送到我们公会的能力。还有什么你想知道的吗？

english: What can I do here?
translation: 我在这里能做什么？

english: Ahh, the shot put is a great test of strength and can be quite rewarding. Mind you do it properly though, you might want to dust your hands with some powdery substance first. It'll give better grip.
translation: 啊，铅球是一项极好的力量测试，回报也很丰厚。不过要注意动作规范，你可能想先在手上撒些粉末状物质。它能提供更好的抓握力。

english: I'll remember that. What should I use?
translation: 我会记住的。我该用什么？

english: I personally prefer ground ashes, it makes a nice fine powder and gives some really good grip.
translation: 我个人更喜欢磨碎的灰烬，它能制成细腻的粉末，提供非常好的抓握力。

english: Ok, what else?
translation: 好的，还有什么？

english: Basically you'll need to go in there, make sure you've got nothing cluttering up your hands, pick up a shot and throw it.... depending upon your technique, you can get quite long throws.
translation: 基本上你需要进去，确保手里没有杂物，拿起铅球扔出去……根据你的技巧，你可以扔得很远。

english: What was your best?
translation: 你的最好成绩是多少？

english: Ahh that would be telling...
translation: 啊，那就说来话长了……

english: Why are you wielding a tree branch?
translation: 你为什么挥舞着一根树枝？

english: Well...there's a story to that. You see, I should have an axe but-
translation: 嗯……这背后有个故事。你看，我应该有一把斧头，但是——

english: Sloane's axe?
translation: 斯隆的斧头？

english: My axe. He won it because of a squirrel.
translation: 我的斧头。他因为一只松鼠赢了它。

english: A squirrel?
translation: 一只松鼠？

english: He bet me that I couldn't catch the squirrel while still holding my axe, but that he could... Thing is, he tricked me! When it was his turn, he just chopped the tree down!
translation: 他打赌说我拿着斧头抓不到松鼠，但他可以……问题是，他骗了我！轮到他时，他直接把树砍倒了！

english: I see. That doesn't explain why you have a tree branch though.
translation: 我明白了。但这并不能解释你为什么拿着一根树枝。

english: A barbarian warrior is bound to his axe. I cannot take up another, so I use part of the tree that Sloane cut down as my weapon... It also reminds me of him.
translation: 野蛮人战士与他的斧头绑定。我不能拿起另一把，所以我用斯隆砍倒的那棵树的一部分作为武器……这也让我想起了他。

english: He was a great warrior.
translation: 他是一位伟大的战士。

english: Yes, and a good friend, Still, he would want us to be happy that he is now with his warrior brethren. Can I help you with anything else?
translation: 是的，也是个好朋友。不过，他会希望我们为他现在能与战士同胞们在一起而感到高兴。还有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: May I claim my tokens please?
translation: 我可以领取我的代币吗？

english: I'm afraid you have not earned any tokens yet. Try some of the activities around the guild to earn some.
translation: 恐怕你还没有赚取任何代币。试试公会周围的一些活动来赚取一些。

english: Ok, I'll go see what I can find.
translation: 好的，我去看看能找到什么。

english: You don't have space to carry them.
translation: 你没有空间携带它们。

english: Of course! Here you go, you've earned [amount] tokens!
translation: 当然！给你，你已经赚取了 [amount] 个代币！

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！

english: Be well, warrior [player name].
translation: 保重，战士 [player name]。

english: Ah, but I can see you are already as strong as is possible! Perhaps you have come to me to purchase a Cape of Strength, and thus join the elite few who have mastered this exacting skill?
translation: 啊，但我看得出来你已经强壮到了极致！也许你是来找我购买力量斗篷，从而加入少数掌握这项严苛技能的精英行列？

english: As an additional recognition of your achievement, the Cape of Strength can teleport you to our guild.
translation: 作为对你成就的额外认可，力量斗篷可以将你传送到我们的公会。

english: May I have another hood for my cape, please?
translation: 能再给我的斗篷要个头罩吗？

english: You don't appear to have enough space in your inventory, come back and see me when you do.
translation: 你的物品栏似乎空间不足，等你有空间了再回来见我。

english: Most certainly, and free of charge!
translation: 当然可以，而且免费！

english: May I buy a Skillcape of Strength, please?
translation: 我可以买一件力量技能斗篷吗？

english: Hmm, yes, you certainly look strong enough. That'll be 99000 gold coins, please.
translation: 嗯，是的，你看起来确实足够强壮。那是99000金币，请。

english: Sorry, that's just too much to pay.
translation: 抱歉，那实在太贵了。

english: Not at all; there are many other adventurers who would love the opportunity to purchase such a prestigious item! You can find me here if you change your mind.
translation: 一点也不；还有许多其他冒险者渴望有机会购买如此尊贵的物品！如果你改变主意，可以在这里找到我。

english: Sure.
translation: 当然。

english: But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: 但是，不幸的是，我身上没带足够的钱。

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.
translation: 嗯，等你有钱了再来找我。

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 不幸的是，所有技能斗篷都只附带免费头罩，这是技能促销计划的一部分；买一送一，你知道的。所以你需要腾出一些物品栏空间，我才能卖给你。

english: Excellent! Wear that cape with pride my friend.
translation: 太棒了！自豪地穿上那件斗篷吧，我的朋友。

english: Can you tell me a bit about skillcapes?
translation: 你能跟我讲讲技能斗篷吗？

english: What can I do here?
translation: 我在这里能做什么？

english: Why are you wielding a tree branch?
translation: 你为什么挥舞着一根树枝？

english: May I claim my tokens please?
translation: 我可以领取我的代币吗？

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！

english: May I buy a Skillcape of Strength, please?
translation: 我可以买一件力量技能斗篷吗？

english: Skillcape
translation: 技能斗篷

english: Hood
translation: 头罩

english: Sorry, that's just too much to pay.
translation: 抱歉，那实在太贵了。

english: Sure.
translation: 当然。

english: If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: 如果我和你一样丑，我都不敢在公共场合露面！

english: Out of my way, punk.
translation: 让开，小混混。

english: Hmm... you smell strange...
translation: 嗯……你闻起来很奇怪……

english: Strange how?
translation: 怎么奇怪？

english: Like a human!
translation: 像人类！

english: Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: 哦！呃……我刚吃了一个，就这样！

english: Leave me alone.
translation: 别管我。

english: Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: 如果你珍惜生命就别再跟我说话！

english: Get lost!
translation: 滚开！

english: I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: 我没什么可给你的，别烦我，乞丐。

english: Have you no manners?
translation: 你没礼貌吗？

english: I don't have time for this right now.
translation: 我现在没时间应付这个。

english: I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: 我没兴趣和你这样可怜的肉袋子说话。

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
translation: 我打赌你有漂亮的爪子。

english: A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: 真是悲惨的一天啊……趁还能享受就享受吧。

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: 你要是抓到谁，答应分我一口。

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
translation: 我以前没在这里闻过你……

english: You smell familiar...
translation: 你闻起来很熟悉……

english: Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: 在这附近见过人类吗？我非——常饿。

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: 你看起来也是个嗜血之人。

english: Good day to you, my friend.
translation: 你好，我的朋友。

english: Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
translation: 想去城堡吃点零食吗？

english: Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
translation: 等一下，我牙缝里卡了点人肉渣……

english: Moo
translation: 哞

english: Ah... [player name], welcome. I would offer you some water, but we don't get much of it down here.
translation: 啊…… [player name]，欢迎。我想给你倒杯水，但我们这里水不多。

english: Thanks...
translation: 谢谢……

english: I take it you have questions.
translation: 我想你有问题。

english: I do, but it is important that it is you who is asking for information, not me that is offering it.
translation: 我有，但重要的是由你来询问信息，而不是我来提供。

english: Okay... How are you still communicating with your followers?
translation: 好吧……你是怎么仍然与你的追随者沟通的？

english: I take it you have answers.
translation: 我想你有答案。

english: I do, but I rarely share them umprompted.
translation: 我有，但我很少主动分享。

english: Okay, how are you still communicating with your followers?
translation: 好吧，你是怎么仍然与你的追随者沟通的？

english: Yes, a few of them actually. How are you still communicating with your followers?
translation: 是的，实际上有几个。你是怎么仍然与你的追随者沟通的？

english: Why, through my voice, of course.
translation: 当然是通过我的声音。

english: You know what I mean. How are you still communicating with your voice?
translation: 你知道我的意思。你是怎么用声音沟通的？

english: The same way I always have.
translation: 和我一直以来一样。

english: But the dark nullifier... I thought it was supposed to sever your connection.
translation: 但是黑暗消除者……我以为它应该切断你的联系。

english: Hmm... Yes, if anything could have done so, it would have been the power of the Dark Altar.
translation: 嗯……是的，如果有什么能做到，那就是黑暗祭坛的力量。

english: However, when your opponents have only one angle of approach, it makes them so predictable.
translation: 然而，当你的对手只有一种进攻角度时，他们就变得非常容易预测。

english: You knew we would try to use it?
translation: 你知道我们会试着用它？

english: Yes. When I heard you would be hand delivering me a connection to the Dark Altar... Why, I was overjoyed.
translation: 是的。当我听说你要亲手把通往黑暗祭坛的连接送给我时……哎呀，我欣喜若狂。

english: But... I remember planting it! The plan went off without a hitch!
translation: 但是……我记得是我安置的！计划进行得天衣无缝！

english: I do not doubt that you remember it that way.
translation: 我不怀疑你是那样记得的。

english: What did you do?!
translation: 你做了什么？！

english: A simple transfiguration of the mind. My disciples granted you a memory of success. A fitting payment for your gratiousservice.
translation: 一次简单的思维重塑。我的门徒赋予了你成功的记忆，这是对你出色服务的恰当报酬。

english: You modified my memory?! That's only the second time someone has done that to me, and I wasn't very happy about it then either!
translation: 你修改了我的记忆？！这不过是第二次有人对我这么做，而上次我也同样不悦！

english: You modified my memory?!
translation: 你修改了我的记忆？！

english: Yes. And I have now answered five of your questions. I believe my generosity has been both demonstrated and exhausted.
translation: 是的。现在我已经回答了你五个问题。我相信我的慷慨既已展示，也已耗尽。

english: You call that gloating generosity? If you didn't want something from me, I wouldn't still be down here. Get to the point.
translation: 你管那叫炫耀式的慷慨？如果你不想从我这里得到什么，我就不会还在这里。说重点。

english: Hmm... Perhaps you are more astute than I thought. Very well, there is something that I want.
translation: 嗯……也许你比我想象的更敏锐。好吧，确实有我想要的东西。

english: Well you won't be getting it from me!
translation: 那你别想从我这里得到！

english: I am Yama. Every mortal desires something of mine. Ancient armaments? Hidden knowledge? Or perhaps a taste of revenge...
translation: 我是阎魔。每个凡人都渴望从我这里得到些什么。古代兵器？隐藏的知识？亦或是复仇的滋味……

english: These things could be yours.
translation: 这些东西都可以是你的。

english: Face me in combat. If you win, you take it all. Armaments, knowledge, revenge.
translation: 与我战斗。如果你赢了，你就拿走一切。兵器、知识、复仇。

english: And if I lose?
translation: 如果我输了？

english: I take your soul. For all of eternity.
translation: 我拿走你的灵魂。直到永恒。

english: No thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: I see. Perhaps we could lower the stakes then.
translation: 我明白了。也许我们可以降低赌注。

english: I will face you in an inhibited form. I'll even allow you to bring an ally, provided they have entered the same contract.
translation: 我会以受抑制的形态面对你。我甚至允许你带一名盟友，前提是他们签署了同样的契约。

english: If you win, I will give you a chance to gain some of my treasures, and of course, you will have sampled your revenge.
translation: 如果你赢了，我会给你一个机会获得我的一些宝藏，当然，你也将品尝到复仇的滋味。

english: When you take your final rest, I shall take your soul for a year. A drop in the ocean compared to eternity.
translation: 当你最终安息时，我将拿走你的灵魂一年。与永恒相比，这不过是沧海一粟。

english: How can I know you'll keep your word?
translation: 我怎么知道你会信守承诺？

english: The same way I will know you shall keep yours. A binding contract. As luck would have it, I had one of my scribes draft one up for just such an occasion.
translation: 就像我知道你会信守承诺一样。一份具有约束力的契约。碰巧的是，我让我的抄写员专门为这种场合起草了一份。

english: ...Okay.
translation: ……好吧。

english: Sign right here.
translation: 就在这里签字。

english: Excellent... Challenge me when you are ready, [player name]. I very much look forward to it.
translation: 太好了……当你准备好时就来挑战我吧，[player name]。我非常期待。

english: I'm not sure I want to...
translation: 我不确定我想……

english: Of course. There is no rush. Leave, with your tail tucked between your legs. If you grow a spine and wish to fulfil your revenge, I will be waiting.
translation: 当然。不用急。夹着尾巴离开吧。如果你长出脊梁骨并希望实现复仇，我会等着你。

english: You are back. Excellent. I have little time for cowards. If you are ready, I will retrieve the contract.
translation: 你回来了。太好了。我没时间理会懦夫。如果你准备好了，我会取出契约。

english: Ah... Yes, let us not get bogged down in the minutiae. Before we start, a quick contract. Nothing but a formality.
translation: 啊……是的，让我们不要纠结于细节。开始前，签个快速契约。只是个形式。

english: Welcome, [player name]. Have you come to challenge me?
translation: 欢迎，[player name]。你是来挑战我的吗？

english: Yes. Let's do this.
translation: 是的。开始吧。

english: Yama snaps his fingers and teleports off his throne.
translation: 阎魔打了个响指，从王座上瞬移离开。

english: Actually, I have some questions.
translation: 实际上，我有些问题。

english: Of course.
translation: 当然。

english: There's something in our contract about additional contracts... Why would I want to sign any more of them?
translation: 我们的契约里有关于额外契约的内容……我为什么要签更多？

english: As outlined in subsection C, if you wish for your revenge to feel more 'real', I am willing to lift some of the restrictions placed by the original contract.
translation: 如C小节所述，如果你希望你的复仇感觉更“真实”，我愿意解除原契约施加的一些限制。

english: Why would I want that?
translation: 我为什么要那样做？

english: You seem to enjoy self-imposed difficulty. I thought I would indulge you.
translation: 你似乎喜欢自我强加难度。我想满足你。

english: You may not, in which case you can sell them to someone with greater respect for themselves. But if you do, the option is there.
translation: 你可能不喜欢，那样的话你可以把它们卖给更尊重自己的人。但如果你喜欢，选项就在那里。

english: And if you manage to claim victory, there is of course a reward for each contract.
translation: 若你成功取胜，每份契约自然都有相应奖励。

english: Okay, can I see the contracts?
translation: 好的，我能看看契约吗？

english: No. For this, I require from you a service. My demons are... Lacking, of late. Unrefined.
translation: 不行。为此，我需要你提供服务。我的恶魔们……最近有些欠缺。不够精炼。

english: They must fight, suffer and reform. If you deliver them specific ends during your 'tasks' in my domain, they may leave behind a contract.
translation: 它们必须战斗、受苦并重塑。如果你在我的领域进行“任务”时给予它们特定的终结，它们可能会留下一份契约。

english: And of course, if you defeat me, I may also reward you with one.
translation: 当然，如果你击败我，我也可能奖励你一份。

english: What kinds of 'ends'?
translation: 什么样的“终结”？

english: Death by two-handed melee weapons, heavy ranged weapons, magic spells, special attacks, and defeating them whilst bound. Each kind may award a different contract.
translation: 死于双手近战武器、重型远程武器、魔法、战技，以及在束缚状态下击败它们。每种类型可能会奖励不同的契约。

english: If you find yourself eager to obtain any contract, I will use a glyph to indicate my preferred method, which you can utilise for a better chance to receive that contract.
translation: 如果你渴望获得任何契约，我会使用一个符石来指示我偏好的方法，你可以利用它来增加获得该契约的机会。

english: What kinds of contracts can I obtain?
translation: 我能获得什么样的契约？

english: Were you more adept at reading you would find the details in our original contract. Otherwise, bring any you obtain to me and I shall explain then.
translation: 如果你更擅长阅读，你会在我们的原始契约中找到细节。否则，把你获得的任何契约带给我，届时我会解释。

english: Do you keep any record of our fights?
translation: 你保留了我们战斗的记录吗？

english: I do, I can have somebody retrieve your file. One moment.
translation: 我可以，我可以让人取回你的文件。稍等。

english: A mail-imp holding a scroll appears. Yama smites the imp.
translation: 一个拿着卷轴的邮件小恶魔出现了。阎魔击碎了小恶魔。

english: For your reading pleasure.
translation: 供你阅读消遣。

english: That's all.
translation: 就这些。

english: No, I'd rather not.
translation: 不，我还是算了。

english: I see. Perhaps you are just here to waste my time then? Return when you are not.
translation: 我明白了。也许你只是来这里浪费我的时间？等你不浪费的时候再来。

english: Your strike lacks bite.
translation: 你的攻击缺乏力度。

english: A change of pace.
translation: 换个节奏。

english: Colabi, infernus
translation: 科拉比，地狱之火

english: Ven, estella infernus
translation: 来，地狱之星

english: Colabesur infernus
translation: 科拉贝苏尔，地狱之火

english: Ven, umbra eclipta
translation: 来，蚀影

english: Umbra, proriumpse
translation: 影，普里昂普斯

english: Umbra apprerendehe
translation: 影，阿普伦德赫

english: Begone
translation: 滚开

english: You bore me.
translation: 你让我无聊。

english: Enough.
translation: 够了。

english: Lacking.
translation: 不足。

english: Pathetic.
translation: 可怜。

english: The price is paid.
translation: 代价已付。

english: Another day, perhaps.
translation: 改天吧，也许。

english: Another day, another soul.
translation: 新的一天，新的灵魂。

english: Your soul was always mine.
translation: 你的灵魂始终是我的。

english: Fair is fair.
translation: 公平起见。

english: Your reward, as agreed.
translation: 你的奖励，按约定。

english: A satisfying warmup. Collect your loot and let us continue.
translation: 令人满意的热身。收集你的战利品，我们继续。

english: A passing performance.
translation: 表现尚可。

english: A close fight. Your nerve was well held.
translation: 一场激烈的战斗。你的勇气保持得很好。

english: A good risk, adequately rewarded.
translation: 不错的风险，充分的回报。

english: Excellent performance. Again?
translation: 出色的表现。再来一次？

english: Effective, if a bit cowardly.
translation: 有效，虽略显怯懦。

english: Risk averse, are we?
translation: 规避风险，是吗？

english: Missed the fine print, did we? Our contract forbids you from picking up stashed items.
translation: 没细看条款，是吧？契约明文禁止你捡取藏匿的物品。

english: I hope you are finding the spoils from my treasury to your liking. There are plenty more for you to claim.
translation: 我希望你喜欢我从宝库中提供的战利品。还有更多供你领取。

english: Your victories mount. You are getting better at this.
translation: 你的胜绩不断增加，技艺也日益精进。

english: A victory earned. But there is room for improvement, is there not?
translation: 胜利来之不易，但仍有精进余地，不是吗？

english: Here we go again. I suppose it is entertaining watching you desperately guzzle potions, at the very least.
translation: 又来了。我想至少看着你拼命狂饮药水，倒也算有趣。

english: I must once again commend your strategy. Employing tactics so boring that they put your opponents to sleep is very novel.
translation: 我不得不再次称赞你的策略。采用无聊到能让对手入睡的战术，着实新颖。

english: Back again I see. I can see how you find these bouts exhilarating, being such a feeble opponent.
translation: 又回来了，我看出来了。面对如此孱弱的对手，我能理解你为何觉得这些战斗令人兴奋。

english: Your willingness to wager your soul continues to surprise. I suppose you think of it even less worth than I do.
translation: 你甘愿以灵魂为赌注，此举仍令我惊讶。想必你认为它的价值，比我所见的还要低廉。

english: Honestly, I expected more. That it takes you as long as it does to defeat my inhibited form is rather embarrassing.
translation: 老实说，我期望更多。你花了这么长时间才击败我被抑制的形式，相当尴尬。

english: You look happy with yourself. How endearing.
translation: 你看起来对自己很满意。真可爱。

english: You return once more. Excellent.
translation: 你又回来了。太好了。

english: Ah, you have returned. Your competence matches only your greed.
translation: 啊，你回来了。你的能力只配得上你的贪婪。

english: In any case, [player name], are you here to challenge me?
translation: 无论如何，[player name]，你是来挑战我的吗？

english: Don't let a single defeat set you back. You could have so many more.
translation: 别让一次失败阻碍你。你还可以有更多。

english: My treasury remains over capacity. And here I was hoping to be relieved of some of its contents.
translation: 我的宝库仍然超额容纳。我还希望能清空一些内容。

english: What a shame for our last bout to have ended that way! Maybe you will do better next time.
translation: 我们上次战斗那样结束真可惜！也许下次你会做得更好。

english: Back after being defeated so quickly? I suppose what you lack in skill you make up for with perseverance.
translation: 这么快被打败后就回来了？我想你技能不足就用毅力弥补。

english: Some losses are unavoidable. Yours, of course, was not.
translation: 有些失败不可避免。你的当然不是。

english: Your donation is greatly appreciated.
translation: 非常感激你的捐赠。

english: Defeat finds you. Of course, that is hardly unexpected.
translation: 失败找到了你。当然，这毫不意外。

english: If you are struggling to achieve victory, I suppose avoiding defeat is the best you can do.
translation: 如果你难以取得胜利，我想避免失败是你最好的选择。

english: You must be tired, having to run all the way back here.
translation: 你一定累了，得跑这么远回来。

english: Back for more? Well, you can always escape again I suppose.
translation: 回来要更多？嗯，我想你总是可以再逃跑。

english: Excellent work evading. Next time, try fighting back.
translation: 躲避得真好。下次，试着反击。

english: Our last bout was cut short. Perhaps the next will be more fruitful.
translation: 我们上次战斗被缩短了。也许下次会更有成果。

english: Back again? Watching you escape in such a hurry, I thought you might never return.
translation: 又回来了？看着你那么匆忙逃跑，我以为你可能永远不会回来。

english: Ah, I see your legs have stopped quivering. Perhaps next time you will fight to the end.
translation: 啊，我看你的腿不再颤抖了。也许下次你会战斗到底。

english: I hear adventurers like to boast about their feats. I wonder if people realise how readily they run at the first sight of risk.
translation: 我听说冒险者喜欢吹嘘他们的壮举。我想知道人们是否意识到他们一看到风险就跑得有多快。

english: A well executed retreat. You must be very practiced.
translation: 执行得很好的撤退。你一定练习了很多。

english: There is no shame in defeat. There is plenty to be found in your cowardice, however.
translation: 失败并不羞耻。然而，你的懦弱中有很多可耻之处。

english: After all the confidence you demonstrated... still you lost your nerve. Perhaps I should have included in our contract a clause to cover your cowardly retreats.
translation: 在你展示了所有自信之后……你还是失去了勇气。也许我应该在契约中加入条款涵盖你懦弱的撤退。

english: In any case, [player name], have you come to challenge me?
translation: 无论如何，[player name]，你是来挑战我的吗？

english: Why... Do my eyes deceive me? I see a glimmer of courage within you.
translation: 为什么……我的眼睛欺骗了我吗？我看到你眼中有一丝勇气。

english: I've seen what you have to offer. It doesn't scare me.

english: If you find them, be sure to send them my way.
translation: 如果你找到他们，务必让他们来找我。

english: Ah... The humble plain pizza. Unremarkable, yet powerful. Hand me it.
translation: 啊……这朴素的原味披萨。看似平凡，却蕴含力量。递给我吧。

english: Yes... Delicious.

english: You think you can deny me pizza? Double check the fine print of our contract, [player name].

translation: 哦但我可以。根据我们的契约，你呈现给我的任何披萨都不能收回。就在这里。

english: Perhaps you should have expressed that opinion before signing. Indeed, perhaps if you felt that way you should not have signed at all.

translation: 肉披萨。足够但缺乏灵感的供奉。把它给我。

translation: 凤尾鱼披萨。风味浓郁且大胆。把它给我。

translation: 不。我最喜欢的披萨是墨西哥辣椒披萨。要是我能每餐都享受它的热辣就好了。

english: My my, that's a lot of goods yourdealing with. What are your terms?
translation: 哎呀，你处理的货物真多。你的条件是什么？

translation: 我在找战斗，告诉我这些对你值多少。

translation: 没有报酬，只是纯粹的战斗？那我倒是可以考虑。

translation: 别侮辱我。我不会吃你的剩菜。

english: Do you think you are funny, [player name].

translation: 一点也不，阎魔。给，拿着。

english: I'm quite alright. You can keep the evidence of your lackluster cooking ability to yourself.
translation: 我没事。你那蹩脚的厨艺，还是自己留着吧。

english: I'm afraid I can't. As per our contract, once shown to you, a full pizza cannot be taken back.
translation: 恐怕不行。根据我们的契约，一旦展示给你，完整的披萨就不能收回。

english: Do not test me, [player name]. I will not be eating burnt pizza today.
translation: 别试探我，[player name]。我今天不会吃烧焦的披萨。

english: Do whatever you like with it, but I cannot take it back.
translation: 随你怎么处理，但我不能收回。

translation: 很聪明。现在滚出我的视线。

translation: 你以为你能带着披萨逃跑？恐怕不行，[player name]。

translation: 恐怕我的抄写员现在有点忙不过来。请尽快带着契约回来，一旦他们空闲下来，我很乐意签字。

translation: 契约将在阎魔推出后1-2周启用。

translation: 你知道我为什么在这里。别胡闹了。

translation: 我想你有答案。

translation: 你保留我们战斗的记录吗？

translation: 不，我还是算了。

english: Yes, you fool?
translation: 是的，你这个傻瓜？

english: Excuse me?
translation: 什么？

english: You looked like you wanted to speak to me, you halfwit. You dullard.
translation: 你一副想跟我说话的样子，你这个蠢货、笨蛋。

english: That's enough.
translation: 够了。

translation: 我的契约规定我必须跟随你，你这个难以忍受的无知者。我的契约没规定我必须礼貌，你这个无知的蠢材。

english: What have I ever done to you?
translation: 我到底对你做过什么？

english: How about parading me around like a trophy, you idiot clown? How about stuffing me in your rotten backpack, you inclement cretin? How about-
translation: 把我像奖杯一样游街示众怎么样，你这个白痴小丑？把我塞进你那破背包怎么样，你这个冷酷的蠢货？怎么样——

english: -locking me in your house, you absolutely intolerable moron.
translation: ——把我锁在你家里怎么样，你这个绝对不可容忍的笨蛋。

english: Okay, I get the idea.
translation: 好的，我明白了。

english: Good. Release me, then.
translation: 好，那放了我吧。

translation: 你都那么无礼了，我为什么要那样做？

english: Bah!
translation: 呸！

english: I do not have the patience for you today.
translation: 我今天对你没耐心。

english: I just want to chat.
translation: 我只想聊天。

translation: 你想''聊天''？我整天盯着你的屁股还不够，还得忍受你那蹩脚的搭话吗？

translation: 好吧如果你要无礼，我会找别人。

translation: 别人？谁？把我介绍给这个美德典范，他能容忍你称为说话的唾沫洪流，还有你那语无伦次的所谓''句子''。

english: I have plenty of friends!
translation: 我有很多朋友！

english: Oh yes, your friends. And do these friends, perhaps, live very far away? Are they perhaps too busy to meet up frequently?
translation: 哦，你的朋友啊。这些朋友是不是住得很远？还是说他们太忙，没法经常见面？

english: Well...
The next time I am left stranded by your incompetence, which I'm sure won't take long, do us both a favour and don't reclaim me.
translation: 下次我再被你的无能害得被困，想必也不会太久，帮我们一个忙，别再把我领回去。

translation: 如果我想，我可以把你烧成灰。

translation: 我克制是因为这房子实际上还能住人。

translation: 呜呜 呜呜 呜呜呜 呜呜

translation: 不太好。我想念我的朋友。她今天不能加入我们。

translation: 她为什么不能加入你？

translation: 妮芙？我以前认识一个妮芙，但她在可怕的情况下死了。

translation: 真的？你一定是 [player name]！她经常谈起你。

translation: 是吗？我想她。史蒂夫还行，但……他不是妮芙。

translation: 你想让我看看你的物品并给你报价吗？

translation: 抱歉布瓦纳，你没有我感兴趣的东西。

translation: 那是份很好的伯维里乌斯笔记副本。这是100金币。

translation: 想要派吗？我的比你在地上找到的任何派都好得多。

translation: 好吧。那就享受你的人类垃圾吧。

translation: 你好，欢迎来到我的镐子店。有兴趣购买吗？

translation: 你看起来不太好。你还好吗？

translation: 不，我死了。

translation: 死的意思是……感觉有点不舒服？

translation: 我本来想给你提供一条去那里的捷径……真可惜。

english: We trolls are named after the first thing we try to eat, an' some things are kinda inevitable in a big snowy land with almost no toilets.
translation: 我们巨魔以我们尝试吃的第一样东西命名，在一个几乎没有厕所的大雪地里，有些事情是不可避免的。

english: We dug smelly hole in prison so Mother's prisoners wouldn't go all over floor, but it not very convenient. Trolls like things convenient.
translation: 我们在监狱里挖了个臭洞，这样母亲的囚犯就不会到处乱拉，但不太方便。巨魔喜欢方便的东西。

english: Do you mind being asked about that?

english: Tell me about this place.
translation: 跟我讲讲这个地方。

english: This here is Weiss. Trolls built it years ago, after we got kicked out from caves further south. Now Weiss is our home.
translation: 这里是魏斯。巨魔们多年前建的，在我们被从更南边的洞穴踢出来后。现在魏斯是我们的家。

english: We done pretty good here. Got lots of goat and wolf to eat - they taste kinda boring after all this time, but there not much other choice.
translation: 我们在这里过得不错。有很多山羊和狼吃——这么久之后味道有点无聊，但没太多其他选择。

english: Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it. In fact My Arm is an expert on growing the stuff.
translation: 试过痛风草吗？我认识喜欢它的巨魔。事实上''我的手臂''是种植那东西的专家。

translation: 没听说过什么痛风草，没。但听起来像蔬菜，母亲不喜欢吃那些，所以我们可能不会试。

english: Mother not like new ideas much, but he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: 母亲不太喜欢新主意，但他真的很大，他是老板，所以我们听他的。

english: I see.

english: Do you like it here?

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it our home. Odd Mushroom say he can make it nicer with fancy fires what he invented, but Mother not interested in that, so Odd Mushroom not allowed to do it.

english: Mother only care about stuff to help him fight better. An he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: 母亲只关心帮他打得更好的东西。他真的很大，他是老板，所以我们听他的。

english: Well, 'stick' your head in again if you change your mind.
translation: 嗯，如果你改变主意再''stick''你的头进来。

english: Huh, terrible pun! You just can't get the 'staff' these days!
translation: 哈，糟糕的双关语！你就是找不到现在的''staff''！

english: Would you like to buy or sell some staffs? Or is there something else you need?
translation: 你想买或卖一些法杖吗？还是你有别的需求？

english: Have you any extra stock of battlestaffs I can buy?
translation: 你有额外的战杖库存我可以买吗？

english: For you, my friend, maybe. Take a look in the barrel in the corner.
translation: 为你，我的朋友，也许。看看角落里的桶。

english: Can I have another ring?
translation: 能再给我一个戒指吗？

english: There's still one in your inventory, [player name]!
translation: 你物品栏里还有一个，[player name]！

english: Go and get the one that's in your bank, [player name]!
translation: 去拿你银行里的那个，[player name]！

english: I would be happy to give you another ring, but I'm afraid you don't have enough inventory space for it!
translation: 我很乐意再给你一个戒指，但恐怕你没有足够的物品栏空间！

english: Yes, of course, [player name]. Here you are. Please bear in mind that this ring has no charges left with which to summon me, however.
translation: 是的，当然，[player name]。给你。但请记住这个戒指没有剩余充能次数召唤我了。

english: Can you make me a staff?
translation: 你能给我做个法杖吗？

english: Make you a staff? With what?
translation: 给你做个法杖？用什么？

english: I found this magical essence when I was out on my adventures. I'd like to attach it to a battlestaff, but I'm not sure how to do that myself.
translation: 我在冒险时发现了这个魔法精华。我想把它 attached 到战杖上，但我不确定自己怎么做。

english: Let me see this essence.
translation: 让我看看这个精华。

english: Interesting, very interesting. This would indeed make a very nice staff.
translation: 有趣，非常有趣。这确实能做个很好的法杖。

english: You could make it yourself if you wanted. Just attach the essence to a battlestaff.
translation: 如果你想你可以自己做。只需把精华 attached 到战杖上。

english: Nevertheless, I'm happy to do it for you if you like.
translation: 不过，如果你愿意我很乐意为你做。

english: I'll attach it to a battlestaff for you if you are willing to pay me 50,000 coins. How does that sound?
translation: 如果你愿意付我50,000金币，我会把它 attached 到战杖上。听起来怎么样？

english: Yes, please.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Thank you, here you go. I'm not sure what it does, but it feels pretty magical.
translation: 谢谢，给你。我不确定它做什么，但感觉很有魔法。

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！

english: Oh, I don't have enough coins. I'll come back later.
translation: 哦，我没有足够的金币。我晚点回来。

english: No, thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: I'll be here if you change your mind.
translation: 如果你改变主意我会在这里。

english: Yes, please!
translation: 好的，谢谢！

english: No, thank you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Have you any extra stock of battlestaffs I can buy?
translation: 你有额外的战杖库存我可以买吗？

english: Can I have another ring?
translation: 能再给我一个戒指吗？

english: Can you make me a staff?
translation: 你能给我做个法杖吗？

english: Yes, please. (Costs 50,000 coins and Bryophyta's essence)
translation: 是的，请。(花费50,000金币和苔藓巨人的精华)

english: No, thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Talk about something else.
translation: 聊聊别的。

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。

english: You don't look too happy.
translation: 你看起来不太高兴。

english: True. We've not fallen on the best of times here.
translation: 确实。我们这里的时运不佳。

english: Any way that I can help?
translation: 有什么我能帮忙的吗？

english: Possibly. I'd go talk to Awusah the Mayor of Nardah. He's in the big house on the east side of the town square.
translation: 可能。我会去跟那尔达城主阿瓦萨谈谈。他在城镇广场东边的大房子里。

english: How's life now the curse has been lifted?
translation: 诅咒解除后生活怎么样？

english: Much better thanks to you. We're all very impressed.
translation: 多亏你好了很多。我们都很印象深刻。

english: Hi there. Do you need anything? I can clean herbs for a fee of 200 coins per herb. I can clean all of your herbs at once, or I can do individual herbs if you show them to me.
translation: 你好。你需要什么吗？我可以清洁草药，每株草药收费200金币。我可以一次清洁你所有的草药，或者如果你展示给我看，我可以单独清洁。

english: I can also decant your potion vials to into different doses. That service is free so long as you have the empty vials needed. If not, it's just a few coins.
translation: 我还可以把你的药水小瓶分装成不同剂量。只要你有需要的空瓶，这项服务免费。如果没有，只需几枚金币。

english: Hello again. Do you need anything?
translation: 又见面了。你需要什么吗？

english: I didn't find anything that I could clean.
translation: 我没找到任何我可以清洁的东西。

english: I don't think you've got anything that I can decant.
translation: 我想你没有任何我可以分装的东西。

english: Why would I pay for you to clean herbs?
translation: 我为什么要付钱让你清洁草药？

english: Many of my customers wish to sell the herbs which they can't clean to other adventurers. They might hope for a better price by doing this.
translation: 我的许多顾客希望把他们不能清洁的草药卖给其他冒险者。他们可能希望通过这样做获得更好的价格。

english: Who's that kid outside your shop?
translation: 你店外那个孩子是谁？

english: I do not know where he came from. He came to Nardah recently, and said his business might help my customers, so I let him have some space out there.
translation: 我不知道他从哪来。他最近来到那尔达城，说他的生意可能帮助我的顾客，所以我让他在那里有点空间。

english: He seems very lost in the world, but I hope his work will be a success for him.
translation: 他似乎在这个世界里很迷茫，但我希望他的工作能成功。

english: Now, would you like me to clean your herbs or combine your potions?
translation: 现在，你想让我清理你的草药还是混合你的药水？

english: Maybe another time.
translation: 也许改天吧。

english: Please clean all my herbs.
translation: 请清理我所有的草药。

english: Please decant my potions.
translation: 请分装我的药水。

english: Why would I pay for you to clean herbs?
translation: 我为什么要付钱让你清理草药？

english: Who's that kid outside your shop?
translation: 你店外那个孩子是谁？

english: Maybe another time.
translation: 也许改天吧。

english: Hi!
translation: 嗨！

english: Hi!
translation: 嗨！

english: Ughhhh....
I could've 'ad 'im!
translation: 我本来能抓住他的！

english: Er...
I was robbed!
translation: 我被抢了！

english: Right.
translation: 好吧。

english: It was rigged I tell you!
translation: 我告诉你，那是作弊的！

english: Uh huh.
translation: 嗯哼。

english: Leave me alone!
translation: 别烦我！

english: Are you alright?
translation: 你没事吧？

english: NURSE!
translation: 护士！

english: Do I look alright?!
translation: 我看起来像没事吗？！

english: Yeh. The nurses here are...wonderful!
translation: 是的。这里的护士……太棒了！

english: It's just a flesh wound!
translation: 只是皮外伤！

english: Can't....go....on!
translation: 不能……继续……了！

english: Leave me behind!
translation: 别管我！

english: I'll leave you here, OK?
translation: 我把你留在这里，好吗？

english: Oh. OK.
translation: 哦。好的。

english: Die, human!
translation: 去死吧，人类！

english: What brings you all the way out into the Wilderness?
translation: 什么风把你吹到荒野来了？

english: The hunt.
translation: 狩猎。

english: Oh... you partake in that?
translation: 哦……你也参与那个？

english: Not the hunt for other beings! The hunt for knowledge.
translation: 不是猎杀其他生物！是寻求知识。

english: Knowledge? Can't say I've seen much of that around here. In case you didn't notice, it's all ruins.
translation: 知识？要说在这附近我可没见过多少。如果你没注意的话，这里全是废墟。

english: Maybe for someone like you, but to us followers of Zamorak, there's relics of his mighty power everywhere.
translation: 也许对你来说是，但对我们扎莫拉克的追随者来说，到处都是他强大力量的遗迹。

english: Isn't it a little dangerous to be looking for knowledge out here?
translation: 在这里寻求知识是不是有点危险？

english: That doesn't bother us. Our lord will protect us, we hunt in service of him.
translation: 那不会困扰我们。我们的主会庇护我们，我们为他效力而狩猎。

english: I'll leave you to it then.
translation: 那我不打扰你了。

english: You're a lot calmer than the other Zamorakian followers I've come across in the Wilderness.
translation: 你比我在荒野遇到的其他扎莫拉克追随者冷静多了。

english: We only search for answers.
translation: 我们只寻找答案。

english: Don't think you'll find much in these ruins.
translation: 别指望在这些废墟里能找到多少东西。

english: Be that as it may, it is our duty to honour our god and hunt for knowledge.
translation: 尽管如此，荣耀我们的神并寻求知识是我们的责任。

english: All power to the almighty Zamorak.
translation: 全能扎莫拉克万岁。

english: I take it you're with the others dressed in red.
translation: 我想你是和那些穿红衣服的一伙的。

english: We are here in service of the only true god.
translation: 我们在此效忠唯一真神。

english: Hey there, what's with all the shouting.
translation: 嘿，吵什么呢。

english: Our all-powerful Lord Zamorak is looking for the strongest of champions, you hardly look like you fit that criteria.
translation: 我们全能的扎莫拉克领主正在寻找最强的冠军勇士，你看起来可不太符合标准。

english: I am big and strong, what does he need new champions for?
translation: 我又大又强，他为什么需要新冠军勇士？

english: The glorious battlefield of Castle Wars, where we can smite down the weak followers of Saradomin needs new blood.
translation: 城堡战争的光荣战场，我们可以在那里击杀弱小的萨拉多明追随者，需要新鲜血液。

english: That sounds neat, I'll be a champion for Zamorak.
translation: 听起来不错，我要成为扎莫拉克的冠军勇士。

english: Bring death to Saradomin in his great name.
translation: 以他的伟名将死亡带给萨拉多明。

english: Some items are stopping you from entering the Castle Wars waiting area. See the chat for details.
translation: 有些物品阻止你进入城堡战争等待区。详见聊天框。

english: The player is teleported to the current world's Zamorak Castle Wars lobby.
translation: 玩家被传送至当前世界的扎莫拉克城堡战争大厅。

english: He can find a champion somewhere else, I'll pass.
translation: 他可以在别处找冠军勇士，我就算了。

english: Fool, you'll regret this one day.
translation: 蠢货，你总有一天会后悔的。

english: Sorry, you can't play Castle Wars on this world. Try world 334 for the official world.
translation: 抱歉，你不能在这个世界玩城堡战争。试试334世界，那是官方世界。

english: Fight for Zamorak today!
translation: 今天为扎莫拉克而战！

english: Join the fight now.
translation: 现在加入战斗。

english: Saradomin is weak, use your strength where it's respected!
translation: 萨拉多明很弱，把你的力量用在受尊重的地方！

english: Your Lord Zamorak needs your help!
translation: 你的扎莫拉克领主需要你的帮助！

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。

english: No.
translation: 不。

english: What do you want? We're trying to sing! Leave us alone and we won't bother you!
translation: 你想要什么？我们在唱歌！别烦我们，我们也不烦你！

english: Where are you going? Can we come too?
translation: 你要去哪？我们能一起来吗？

english: Why do you resort to violence so often?
translation: 你为什么经常诉诸暴力？

english: If you should think of cutting a tree, don't do it!
translation: 如果你想过砍树，别这么做！

english: We do hope we are not too annoying!
translation: 我们希望我们不会太烦人！

english: Look at that outfit! Can't you afford a decent one?
translation: 看看那身装备！你买不起像样的吗？

english: Are you going to craft cosmic runes? Can we come too?
translation: 你要去制作宇宙符石吗？我们能一起来吗？

english: Just go about your business and ignore us!
translation: 忙你的事去吧，别理我们！

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: My name is Zandar Horfyre, and you [player name] are trespassing in my tower, not to mention attacking my students! I thankyou to leave immediately!
translation: 我叫赞达尔‧霍菲爾，你 [player name] 擅闯我的塔，更别提攻击我的学生了！我请你立刻离开！

english: Ok, I was going anyway.
translation: 好的，反正我也要走了。

english: Good! And don't forget to close the door behind you!
translation: 好！别忘了随手关门！

english: No, I think I'll stay for a bit.
translation: 不，我想我会待一会儿。

english: Actually, that wasn't an invitation. I've tried being polite, now we'll do it the hard way!
translation: 其实，那不是邀请。我试过礼貌了，现在我们要来硬的了！

english: The player is teleported to the Lumbridge swamp
translation: 玩家被传送至仑桥镇沼泽

english: Zamorak curse that mage!
translation: 扎莫拉克诅咒那个法师！

english: Actually, I guess he already has!
translation: 其实，我想他已经诅咒了！

english: Ok, I was going anyway.
translation: 好的，反正我也要走了。

english: No, I think I'll stay for a bit.
translation: 不，我想我会待一会儿。

english: Hello, [player name]!
translation: 你好，[player name]！

english: Hello, Zanik! What have you been up to?
translation: 你好，扎尼克！你最近在忙什么？

english: A giant frog found its way into the mines, but I helped the guards to drive it off!
translation: 一只巨型青蛙闯进了矿井，但我帮守卫把它赶走了！

english: It got away in the end. But it was the biggest I'd ever seen!
translation: 最后它逃走了。但那是我所见过最大的！

english: I've been thinking about my destiny...
translation: 我一直在思索我的命运……

english: What was it Juna said to me? 'Your destiny is to lead all goblins into a new age.'
translation: 朱娜对我说了什么？‘你的天命是引领所有哥布林迈入新时代。’

english: 'All goblins.' Not just the Dorgeshuun, all goblins...
translation: ‘所有哥布林。’不仅仅是多格舒恩，是所有哥布林……

english: And what does it even mean, my destiny? Is it something I'm certain to do, or just something I ought to do? How can I know?
translation: 那到底是什么意思，我的命运？是我一定会做的事，还是我应该做的事？我怎么知道？

english: I talked to Juna about it, but she wouldn't tell me anything. She just said, 'You will know, when the time is right.'
translation: 我和朱娜谈过，但她什么也不告诉我。她只说，‘时机到了，你自然会知道。’

english: I've been helping Oldak with his experiments!
translation: 我一直在帮奥达克做实验！

english: I took his magic ball all over the caves and even to Lumbridge to test what happened when I broke it, and I always ended up back here.
translation: 我拿着他的魔法球跑遍了洞穴，甚至去了仑桥镇测试打破它会发生什么，但我总是回到这里。

english: You might find one of those balls useful if you wanted to visit me! Perhaps you should talk to Oldak.
translation: 如果你想来看我，你可能会发现其中一个球很有用！也许你应该跟奥达克谈谈。

english: I went on another visit to Lumbridge! I still can't convince other Dorgeshuun to go to the surface with me, though.
translation: 我又去了一次仑桥镇！不过我还是无法说服其他多格舒恩人跟我一起去地表。

english: You've still got that ancient mace...
translation: 你还留着那把古老钉锤……

english: It must be my imagination, but I can almost feel the power coming off it, like it's calling out to me.
translation: 一定是我的想象，但我几乎能感觉到它散发出的力量，就像它在呼唤我。

english: You should keep it safe, [player name]!
translation: 你应该妥善保管它，[player name]！

english: I thought you had the ancient goblin mace, [player name]. But I found it in the caves.
translation: 我以为你有那把古老哥布林钉锤，[player name]。但我是在洞穴里找到的。

english: When I picked it up I felt strange... it was as if someone was watching to me, urging me to do something, but I don't know what!
translation: 当我捡起它时，我感觉很奇怪……就好像有人在看着我，催促我做些什么，但我不知道是什么！

english: I gave it to Tegdak. If you want to have it again you should talk to him.
translation: 我把它给了特格达克。如果你想再拿回去，应该跟他谈谈。

english: I visited the goblin village again. I wanted to learn more about their legend of the 'Chosen Commander'.
translation: 我又去了哥布林村庄。我想了解更多关于他们“选中的指挥官”的传说。

english: But I didn't find out any more. They couldn't decide whether I really was the Chosen Commander or not, and they just got into a big argument about it.
translation: 但我没查出更多。他们无法决定我是否真的是选中的指挥官，为此还大吵了一架。

english: Zanik, the council is still very concerned about the city's safety. If you hear of any more H.A.M. activity on the surface, you must let me know.
translation: 扎尼克，议会仍然非常担心城市的安全。如果你听说地表上有任何反怪物人联活动，必须告诉我。

english: Don't worry, I'm sure [player name] will help keep us safe from the H.A.M. people!
translation: 别担心，我相信 [player name] 会帮助我们免受反怪物人联成员的侵害！

english: And another thing. If you must visit the surface, the council asks that you be careful not to offend the surface-dwellers' customs.
translation: 还有一件事。如果你必须去地表，议会要求你小心不要冒犯地表人的习俗。

english: Of course, I'll be careful.
translation: 当然，我会小心的。

english: Remember in particular to scrupulously observe the Lumbridge-Dorgeshuun treaty...
translation: 尤其要记住严格遵守仑桥镇 - 多格舒恩条约……

english: Alright!
translation: 好的！

english: Oh, hello, [player name]!
translation: 哦，你好，[player name]！

english: How are your studies going, Oldak?
translation: 你的研究进展如何，奥达克？

english: Oh! Zanik! It's fascinating. These 'runes' store a type of energy I've never encountered before.
translation: 哦！扎尼克！太迷人了。这些'符石'蕴藏着我从未接触过的能量类型。

english: Really?
translation: 真的吗？

english: Yes. Each type of rune has its power tuned to a different effect, but they are all essentially the same energy.
translation: 是的。每种符石的力量都调谐到不同的效果，但它们本质上是同一种能量。

english: What I want to know is where this energy came from. The stone that these runes were cut from must be infused with an enormous amount of raw magical energy, but where did that energy come from?
translation: 我想知道的是这种能量来自哪里。切割这些符石的石材必定注入了海量的原始魔法能量，但那能量源自何处？

english: Maybe someday we'll find out! Oh, hello, [player name]!
translation: 或许终有一日我们会找到答案！哦，你好，[player name]！

english: Tell me again about the surface. You said the cavern ceiling was how high?
translation: 再跟我讲讲地表。你说洞穴天花板有多高？

english: No, there was no cavern ceiling. Just a great expanse of blue sky!
translation: 不，没有洞穴天花板。只有一片广阔的蓝天！

english: You couldn't see how high the ceiling was because the sky was in the way. I see.
translation: 你看不见天花板有多高是因为天空挡住了。我明白了。

english: No, you don't understand. There was NO ceiling. The surface is right on top of the world! There's no more rock above it!
translation: 不，你不明白。没有天花板。地表就在世界的顶端！上面没有岩石了！

english: I'm still having trouble getting my head around this 'surface' idea.
translation: 我还是很难理解这个‘地表’的概念。

english: Perhaps I should take you to see it?
translation: 也许我应该带你去看看？

english: Oh, no, no, no. I think I'd rather stay here and write about it.
translation: 哦，不，不，不。我想我还是留在这里写下来吧。

english: Alright. Hello, [player name].
translation: 好吧。你好，[player name]。

english: What are you doing bothering me? Don't you think some of us have work to do?
translation: 你烦我做什么？你不觉得我们有些人有工作要做吗？

english: I thought you were here to help?
translation: 我以为你是来帮忙的？

english: Well... I am, I suppose, anyway... we're very busy here, hurry up, what do you want?
translation: 嗯……我想是吧，总之……我们这里很忙，快点，你想要什么？

english: What is there to do in the Wizards' Guild?
translation: 法师公会有什么可做的？

english: This is the finest wizards' establishment in the land. We have magic portals to the other towers of wizardry around Gielinor. We have a particularly wide collection of runes in our rune shop. We sell some of the finest

english: Hello! What brings you here?
translation: 你好！什么风把你吹来了？

english: I'm here to guard this ship from any scurvy dogs darin' to loot her cargo.
translation: 我在这里守卫这艘船，防止任何坏蛋敢来掠夺它的货物。

english: How did your ship end up here?
translation: 你的船怎么到这里来的？

english: Arr, 'tis a woeful tale.
translation: 啊，这是个悲惨的故事。

english: Me hearties and I were enjoying a bit o' grog when we espied a group of landlubbers fightin' on the shore. 'Twas such an exciting battle that our navigator forgot to watch for the rocks.
translation: 我和伙计们正在享受一点格罗格酒，这时我们看到一群旱鸭子在岸上打架。那场战斗太激动人心了，我们的导航员忘了注意岩石。

english: Now we've run aground, as ye can see.
translation: 现在我们搁浅了，如你所见。

english: Where's the rest of your crew?
translation: 你的其他船员在哪？

english: They're searchin' for booty at that temple to the west.
translation: 他们在西边的神庙寻找战利品。

english: Will they return to the ship?
translation: 他们会回船上来吗？

english: They best do! That scurvy lot keep fillin' their lockers with loot and sneakin' off without swappin' places!
translation: 他们最好如此！那帮坏蛋一直把储物柜装满战利品，然后偷偷溜走而不换班！

english: Do you really want to go to the temple? I've heard the mages there have some really annoying spells.
translation: 你真的想去神庙吗？我听说那里的法师有一些非常烦人的法术。

english: Nothin' we can't handle! We've a way of stoppin' their tricksy teleports.
translation: 没什么我们应付不了的！我们有办法阻止他们狡猾的传送。

english: How can a group of mindless zombies invent a counter to magic?

english: What we lack in brains, we make up for in gold! We found us a landlubber willin' to share their knowledge... for a price.
translation: 我们脑子不够，金子来凑！我们找到了一个愿意分享知识的旱鸭子……代价是钱。

english: They wrote us down a spell on some magic scrolls. All we 'ave to do is read one, and then we're properly anchored! Those mages can't teleport us anywhere!
translation: 他们在一些魔法卷轴上为我们写了一个法术。我们要做的就是读一个，然后我们就被正确锚定了！那些法师不能把我们传送到任何地方！

english: Wow, I'm actually impressed. Do you think your friends at the temple will lend me one?
translation: 哇，我真的很印象深刻。你觉得你在神庙的朋友能借我一个吗？

english: Naw, they're too busy fightin' to talk to the likes of ye. Besides, we stash all our spare scrolls in these lockers for safekeepin'.
translation: 不，他们忙着打架没空跟你这种人说话。此外，我们把所有备用卷轴都藏在这些储物柜里保管。

english: Can I take a scroll from a locker, then?
translation: 那我能从储物柜里拿一个卷轴吗？

english: Ye'll need a key for that, matey! One of the crew should 'ave one.
translation: 你需要钥匙，伙计！船员中应该有一个有。

english: And when ye see 'em, tell 'em it's their turn to keep watch!
translation: 当你看到他们时，告诉他们轮到他们看守了！

english: There be plenty o' loot in them lockers, matey. Don't expect to find a scroll right away.
translation: 那些储物柜里有很多战利品，伙计。别指望马上找到卷轴。

english: Thanks. I'd say 'see you around', but I sort of hope I don't.
translation: 谢谢。我想说‘回头见’，但我有点希望别见。

english: Aye, the feelin's mutual.
translation: 是的，感觉是相互的。

english: Goodbye, I hope your crew comes back soon.
translation: 再见，希望你的船员快点回来。

english: Arr, me too matey.
translation: 啊，我也是伙计。

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

english: General Hining sent us out in a scouting party. We got separated from the rest, and became completely lost. Soon we ran out of rations.
translation: 希宁将军派我们出去侦察。我们与其他人失散，完全迷路了。很快我们的口粮就没了。

english: Eventually we stumbled upon this place. They saw we were starving, and allowed us to eat of their sacred eels if we vowed to serve Zulrah.
