english: Since then, we've settled here. We went back up north once, to see how the king's campaign was going, but they drove us out of the camp, calling us unclean.
translation: 从那时起，我们就在这里定居了。我们曾回过一次北方，看看国王的战役进展如何，但他们把我们赶出了营地，称我们不洁。

english: It's probably the sacred eels that did it. They change you, you know. Once you've tasted them, you're part of the tribe forever.
translation: 可能是圣鳗鱼造成的。它们会改变你，你知道。一旦你尝过它们，你就永远是部落的一部分。

english: Since then, we've settled here. We went back up north once, to see how the king's campaign was going, but they drove us out of the camp, calling us unclean.
translation: 从那时起，我们就在这里定居了。我们曾回过一次北方，看看国王的战役进展如何，但他们把我们赶出了营地，称我们不洁。

english: It's probably the sacred eels that did it. They change you, you know. Once you've tasted them, you're part of the tribe forever.
translation: 可能是圣鳗鱼造成的。它们会改变你，你知道。一旦你尝过它们，你就永远是部落的一部分。

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

english: I'm off.
translation: 我走了。

english: How did you come to be here?
translation: 你怎么到这里来的？

english: I'm off.
translation: 我走了。

english: You queue-jumper! My eldest son was chosen as a sacrifice to Zulrah, but now the priests say you're going to sacrifice yourself first.
translation: 你这个插队的！我的长子被选为献给祖尔拉的祭品，但现在祭司说你要先牺牲自己。

english: You're angry that I've saved your son's life?
translation: 你生气我救了你儿子的命？

english: The sacrifice is the greatest honour to which any of us can aspire! He was so excited to be coming face-to-face with Zulrah, and offering himself on behalf of the tribe.
translation: 牺牲是我们任何人都能渴望的最大荣誉！他非常兴奋能与祖尔拉面对面，并代表部落献出自己。

english: Also, I won't get the extra large ration of sacred swamp eels if my son doesn't make the sacrifice. Shame on you!
translation: 而且，如果我儿子不牺牲，我就得不到额外的神圣沼泽鳗鱼配给。你真丢脸！

english: I see.
translation: 我明白了。

english: I'm sorry.
translation: 我很抱歉。

english: Quite right. Now get on with sacrificing yourself.
translation: 很对。现在继续牺牲你自己吧。

english: Have you heard? My eldest son has been chosen as a sacrifice to the mighty Zulrah!
translation: 你听说了吗？我的长子被选为献给强大的祖尔拉的祭品！

english: How do you feel about that?
translation: 你对此感觉如何？

english: Oh, it's such an honour. He's so excited to be coming face-to-face with Zulrah, and offering himself on behalf of the tribe.
translation: 哦，这是莫大的荣誉。他非常兴奋能与祖尔拉面对面，并代表部落献出自己。

english: Also, when the sacrifice is made, his brother and I will get an extra large ration of the sacred swamp eels that Zul-Onan catches. I can't wait!
translation: 而且，当牺牲完成后，他的兄弟和我将获得祖尔 - 奥南捕获的额外大型神圣沼泽鳗鱼配给。我迫不及待了！

english: Don't you mind that your son will die?
translation: 你不介意你儿子会死吗？

english: It's the greatest honour to which any of us can aspire! I only hope that the High Priestess will one day choose me.
translation: 这是我们都渴望的最大荣誉！我只希望大祭司有一天会选择我。

english: The extra large ration of sacred swamp eels will be nice too.
translation: 额外的神圣沼泽鳗鱼配给也会很好。

english: I'm off.
translation: 我走了。

english: You have done well, [player name]!
translation: 你做得很好，[player name]！

english: You're angry that I've saved your son's life?
translation: 你生气我救了你儿子的命？

english: I'm sorry.
translation: 我很抱歉。

english: How do you feel about that?
translation: 你对此感觉如何？

english: Don't you mind that your son will die?
translation: 你不介意你儿子会死吗？

english: I'm off.
translation: 我走了。

english: My brother was chosen as a sacrifice to Zulrah, but now the priests say you're going to sacrifice yourself first. You ruined everything!
translation: 我的兄弟被选为献给祖尔拉的祭品，但现在祭司说你要先牺牲自己。你毁了一切！

english: You're angry that I've saved your brother's life?
translation: 你生气我救了你兄弟的命？

english: You don't get it, do you? He'd been looking forward to this for ages, and you ruined it. Now we won't even get the extra ration of sacred swamp eels.
translation: 你不明白，对吧？他一直期待这个很久了，你毁了它。现在我们甚至得不到额外的神圣沼泽鳗鱼配给。

english: I hope Zulrah chews you slowly when you sacrifice yourself.
translation: 我希望当你牺牲自己时，祖尔拉慢慢咀嚼你。

english: I'm sorry.
translation: 我很抱歉。

english: Have you heard? My brother has been chosen as a sacrifice to the mighty Zulrah!
translation: 你听说了吗？我的兄弟被选为献给强大的祖尔拉的祭品！

english: How do you feel about that?
translation: 你对此感觉如何？

english: I'm jealous! I want to see Zulrah face-to-face too. Maybe next year they'll let me go.
translation: 我嫉妒！我也想面对面见祖尔拉。也许明年他们会让我去。

english: Also, when the sacrifice is made, our mother and I will get an extra large ration of the sacred swamp eels that Zul-Onan catches. I can't wait!
translation: 而且，当牺牲完成后，我们的母亲和我将获得祖尔 - 奥南捕获的额外大型神圣沼泽鳗鱼配给。我迫不及待了！

english: I'm off.
translation: 我走了。

english: You're angry that I've saved your brother's life?
translation: 你生气我救了你兄弟的命？

english: I'm sorry.
translation: 我很抱歉。

english: How do you feel about that?
translation: 你对此感觉如何？

english: I'm off.
translation: 我走了。

english: Shhh! Don't disturb the sacred eels.
translation: 嘘！别打扰圣鳗鱼。

english: Tell me about the sacred eels.
translation: 和我说说圣鳗鱼的事。

english: As Zulrah's skin is shed, the scales fall to the bottom of the swamp, where I believe the eels are permitted to consume them. Thus the eels become sacred, dumb though they are.
translation: 当祖尔拉蜕皮时，鳞片落到沼泽底部，我相信鳗鱼被允许食用它们。因此鳗鱼变得神圣，尽管它们很笨。

english: Then the mighty Zulrah sends the eels to us. Once you eat of them, and absorb their sacred properties yourself, you become part of our tribe forever - no other community will let you in.
translation: 然后强大的祖尔拉把鳗鱼送给我们。一旦你吃了它们，并吸收了它们的神圣属性，你就永远成为我们部落的一部分——没有其他社区会让你加入。

english: Can you give me any eels?
translation: 你能给我一些鳗鱼吗？

english: Zul-Cheray and her younger son are due for an extra large ration of eels when her older son is sacrificed, so I can't spare any for you.
translation: 祖尔 - 切雷和她的小儿子在她的大儿子牺牲时将获得额外的大型鳗鱼配给，所以我不能分给你任何。

english: But I'm being sacrificed first.
translation: 但我先被牺牲。

english: All the same, after your sacrifice is complete, Zulrah will return for Zul-Cheray's son, and she will want her eels at that time.
translation: 尽管如此，在你的牺牲完成后，祖尔拉将回来找祖尔 - 切雷的儿子，那时她会想要她的鳗鱼。

english: Can I catch some eels myself?
translation: 我能自己抓一些鳗鱼吗？

english: The mighty Zulrah sends us the eels as part of a sacred contract with our tribe, as the High Priestess told you. Although you are not of our tribe, Zulrah may be willing to grant you eels too. You may try.
translation: 强大的祖尔拉把鳗鱼送给我们，作为与我们部落的神圣契约的一部分，正如大祭司告诉你的。虽然你不是我们部落的人，祖尔拉可能也愿意给你鳗鱼。你可以试试。

english: I'm off.
translation: 我走了。

english: You know nothing of the sacred contract between our tribe and the mighty Zulrah! Ask the High Priestess to educate you about Zulrah before you meddle further.
translation: 你对我们部落与强大的祖尔拉之间的神圣契约一无所知！在你进一步干涉之前，请大祭司教育你关于祖尔拉的事。

english: Ignorant tourist! The mighty Zulrah sends us the eels as part of a sacred contract with our tribe - you know nothing of these matters. Ask the High Priestess to educate you about Zulrah first.
translation: 无知的游客！强大的祖尔拉把鳗鱼送给我们，作为与我们部落的神圣契约的一部分——你对这些事一无所知。先请大祭司教育你关于祖尔拉的事。

english: Tell me about the sacred eels.
translation: 和我说说圣鳗鱼的事。

english: Can you give me any eels?
translation: 你能给我一些鳗鱼吗？

english: Can I catch some eels myself?
translation: 我能自己抓一些鳗鱼吗？

english: I'm off.
translation: 我走了。

english: Human agreed to sacrifice [himself/herself] to mighty Zulrah! We all most grateful.
translation: 人类同意牺牲 [himself/herself] 给强大的祖尔拉！我们都非常感激。

english: Puny human show respect to Zulrah or I smash you head.
translation: 弱小的人类向祖尔拉表示尊敬，否则我砸碎你的头。

english: Zulrah the great god. He mighty. You go see High Priestess, she tell you lots and lots.
translation: 祖尔拉是伟大的神。他很强大。你去找大祭司，她会告诉你很多很多。

english: I'm off.
translation: 我走了。

english: You leave that alone, human. You not one of us.
translation: 你别动那个，人类。你不是我们的一员。

english: Tell me about Zulrah.
translation: 和我说说祖尔拉的事。

english: I'm off.
translation: 我走了。

english: Nilsal, [player name].
translation: 你好，[player name]。

english: Hello, Zuma. How are things?
translation: 你好，祖玛。情况怎么样？

english: A lot less stressful up here. I think I might leave the adventuring to people like you from now on.
translation: 这里压力小多了。我想从现在起我可能把冒险留给像你这样的人。

english: Still, at least it gave me a lot to talk about. Those Moons of Peril are concerning, but exciting! I just wish we knew more about their potential links to Ranul.
translation: 不过，至少它给了我很多话题。那些危险之月令人担忧，但令人兴奋！我只希望我们能更多关于它们与拉努尔的潜在联系。

english: So you still think there is a link?
translation: 所以你还是认为有联系？

english: Oh yes. It may not have been the one I originally thought, but there must be something! They're called Moons after all!
translation: 哦是的。可能不是我最初想的那个，但肯定有什么！它们毕竟被称为月亮！

english: The all-powerful Ranul wouldn't have just let some random creatures take on a name like that!
translation: 全能的拉努尔不会让一些随机生物取这样的名字！

english: Hmm... It's an interesting thought.
translation: 嗯……这是个有趣的想法。

english: Indeed. And on that note, I have some research to do! Until next time.
translation: 确实。就此而言，我有些研究要做！下次见。

english: I'm coming for you!
translation: 我来找你了！

english: Click here to continue
translation: 点击这里继续

english: Please wait...
translation: 请稍候……

english: I was taking a break!
translation: 我在休息！

english: What would you do without me?
translation: 没有我你会做什么？

english: What do I pray next?
translation: 我接下来祈祷什么？

english: Honey, I'm home!
translation: 亲爱的，我回来了！

english: I hope you get a drop soon.
translation: 我希望你很快得到掉落。

english: I'll never leave your side!
translation: 我永远不会离开你身边！

english: I've got your back!
translation: 我支持你！

english: Eat up!
translation: 吃吧！

english: Greetings, adventurer. I am Phileas, the Lumbridge Guide. I am here to give information and directions to new players. You can also speak to my good friend Adventurer Jon about Adventure Paths.
translation: 你好，冒险者。我是菲利亚斯，仑桥镇向导。我在这里为新手玩家提供信息和指引。你也可以和我的好朋友冒险者乔恩聊聊关于冒险之路的事情。

english: I'm not too sure what to do.
translation: 我不太确定该做什么。

english: Select an option
translation: 选择一个选项

english: There are many monsters around the world which you can fight. They will vary in difficulty but no matter what monster you fight, I would always recommend using a weapon.
translation: 世界各地有许多你可以战斗的怪物。它们的难度各不相同，但无论你面对什么怪物，我都建议你使用武器。

english: Can you give me some tips on what to fight instead?
translation: 你能给我一些关于该打什么怪物的建议吗？

english: Can I ask you something eles?
translation: 我还能问你其他事情吗？

english: Ok, I'll go talk to him now.
translation: 好的，我现在就去找他聊聊。

english: Very well then, let's see here…
translation: 那好吧，让我看看……

english: It's going to be tough fighting monsters without a weapon. I suggest you first get a weapon from the bank or see the combat tutors south of the general store.
translation: 没有武器打怪会很困难。我建议你先去银行拿把武器，或者去杂货店南边的战斗导师那里看看。

english:
The minimap in the top right corner of the game
screen has various icons showing the location of things.
This icon to the left shows where general stores are.
translation: 游戏屏幕右上角的小地图有各种图标显示物品的位置。左侧这个图标显示杂货店的位置。

english:
The minimap in the top right corner of the game
screen has various icons showing the locations of things.
This icon to the left shows where banks are.
translation: 游戏屏幕右上角的小地图有各种图标显示物品的位置。左侧这个图标显示银行的位置。

english: Tell me more about security.
translation: 告诉我更多关于安全方面的信息。

english: Firstly, keep your RuneScape password and bank PIN secure. Never tell anyone your password or share your account with them - they might steal it or get it banned for breaking rules.
translation: 首先，保护好你的 RuneScape 密码和银行密码。永远不要告诉任何人你的密码，也不要与他人共享你的账号——他们可能会盗取你的账号，或因违规导致账号被封。

english: Now, I can tell you more about password security, avoiding item scamming and in-game moderation.
translation: 现在，我可以告诉你更多关于密码安全、避免物品诈骗以及游戏内管理的信息。

english: I can also tell you about the Stronghold of Security, a place where you can learn more about account security and have a bit of an adventure at the same time. So how can I help you?
translation: 我还可以告诉你关于安全要塞的事情，在那里你可以了解更多账号安全知识，同时还能体验一点小冒险。那么，我能帮你什么呢？

english: There are many nice and helpful players in Old School RuneScape; unfortunately, as in real life, there are some who aren't so honest. Some people may try to trick you out of your items.
translation: Old School RuneScape中有许多友善乐于助人的玩家；但遗憾的是，就像现实生活中一样，也有些人不太诚实。有些人可能会试图骗走你的物品。

english: Try not to fall for this, as you won't get your items back.
translation: 尽量不要上当，因为一旦被骗，你的物品就拿不回来了。

english: When trading, you have a second trade confirmation screen. Always double-check it to ensure you are getting the items you expect, as scammers may change their offer suddenly, hoping you won't notice.
translation: 交易时，你会有第二次交易确认界面。务必仔细核对，确保你收到的是预期的物品，因为骗子可能会突然更改报价，希望你不会注意到。

english: Remember, once you have clicked Accept on the second trade screen, the trade is not reversible.
translation: 记住，一旦你在第二次交易界面上点击了接受，交易就无法撤销了。

english: Try and find out from someone else what an item is before spending a lot of money on it. Not all merchants are honest about the rarity or the uses of their wares.
translation: 在花费大量金钱购买物品之前，尽量向其他人了解该物品的情况。并非所有商人都如实告知他们商品的稀有度或用途。

english: For example, some people try to pass off spinach rolls as rare, when in fact they're as common as cabbages!
translation: 例如，有些人试图把菠菜卷说成是稀有物品，但实际上它们和卷心菜一样常见！

english: Be wary of people offering to improve your items. For example, some people will claim they can add a trim to your armour or upgrade your sword to a more powerful one.
translation: 要警惕那些声称可以帮你强化物品的人。例如，有些人会声称可以给你的盔甲加镶边，或者把你的剑升级成更强大的武器。

english: <colNum0>Please wait...</col>
translation: <colNum0>请稍候...</col>

english: More options…
translation: 更多选项...

english: There is also the wilderness. The wilderness is north of Varrock and you can fight other players there. But bare in mind if you die to another player in the wilderness you will lose your stuff.
translation: 还有荒野地区。荒野位于维洛克城以北，你可以在那里与其他玩家战斗。但要记住，如果你在荒野中被其他玩家杀死，你会掉落身上的物品。

english: Tell me about different weapon types I can use.
translation: 告诉我关于我可以使用的不同武器类型的信息。

english: Harlan gives you a Training sword and shield.
translation: 哈兰会给你一把训练剑和一面盾牌。

english: I can't help you with that at the moment, sorry.
translation: 抱歉，我目前无法帮你处理这件事。

english:
On a members-only world, you could ask for runes to
be put directly in a rune pouch when you pick them up
from the ground.
translation: 在会员世界中，当你从地上拾取符石时，可以要求它们直接放入符石袋中。

english: To get rune essence you will need to gather them in the Rune Essence Mine. You can get to the mine by talking to Aubury who owns the runes shop in south east Varrock.
translation: 要获取符文精华，你需要在符文精华矿场采集。你可以与维洛克城东南角符石店老板奥伯里交谈前往矿场。

english: Let's discuss how my ammo acts when I pick it up.
translation: 我们来讨论一下拾取弹药时的处理方式。

english: When you pick up ammo from the ground, if it matches what you've got equipped in your quiver, or what's in your bolt pouch, I can make the ammo you've picked up go straight into there, provided there's space.
translation: 当你从地上拾取弹药时，如果它与你箭袋中装备的或弩箭袋中的类型匹配，只要有空间，我可以让拾取的弹药直接进入其中。

english: Alternatively, you can let it go into your inventory like normal.
translation: 或者，你也可以让它像平常一样进入你的物品栏。

english: How do you want to handle picking up ammo?
translation: 你希望如何处理拾取弹药？

english: There you go! Your ammo will go to your inventory when you pick it up, rather than going to your quiver or bolt pouch.
translation: 好了！你拾取的弹药会进入物品栏，而不是箭袋或弩箭袋。

english:
You can also control this option via the Settings menu, rather than
having to return to this Tutor in future.
translation: 你也可以通过设置菜单控制此选项，而无需将来再回到这位导师这里。

english: You would then use the feathers and arrow heads on the arrow shafts to make arrows. The bow string would be used on the unstrung bow to make a bow.
translation: 然后你可以将羽毛和箭头用在箭杆上制作箭矢。弓弦则用在未上弦的弓上制作成弓。

english: Thanks for the ingredients you have got so far. Please get the rest quickly - I'm running out of time! The Duke will throw me into the streets!
translation: 感谢你目前收集到的食材。请尽快把剩下的找来——我时间不多了！公爵会把我扔到街上去的！

english: You still need to get: A bucket of milk
translation: 你还需要获取：一桶牛奶

english: Where do I find some flour?
translation: 我在哪里能找到面粉？

english: How about milk?
translation: 那牛奶呢？

english: And eggs? Where are they found?
translation: 还有鸡蛋？在哪里能找到？

english: There is a Mill fairly close, go North and then West. Mill Lane Mill is just off the road to Draynor. I usually get my flour from there.
translation: 附近就有一座磨坊，先往北走再往西。磨坊巷磨坊就在通往德雷诺村的路上。我通常从那里获取面粉。

english: Talk to Millie, she'll help, she's a lovely girl and a fine Miller. Make sure you take a pot with you for the flour though, there should be one on the table in here.
translation: 去找米莉谈谈，她会帮你的，她是个可爱的女孩，也是位优秀的磨坊主。不过记得带个罐子来装面粉，这里桌上应该就有一个。

english: There is a cattle field on the other side of the river, just across the road from the Groats' Farm.
translation: 河对岸有一片牧场，就在格罗茨农场的马路对面。

english: Talk to Gillie Groats, she looks after the Dairy cows - she'll tell you everything you need to know about milking cows!
translation: 去找吉利·格罗茨谈谈，她负责照料奶牛——她会告诉你挤奶所需的一切知识！

english: You'll need an empty bucket for the milk itself. The general store just north of the castle will sell you one for a couple of coins.
translation: 你需要一个空桶来装牛奶。城堡北边的杂货店会卖给你，只要几枚金币。

english: I normally get my eggs from the Groats' farm, on the other side of the river.
translation: 我通常从河对岸的格罗茨农场获取鸡蛋。

english: But any chicken should lay eggs.
translation: 不过任何鸡都会下蛋。

english: I'll get right on it.
translation: 我这就去办。

english: The minimap in the top right corner of the screen has various icons to show different points of interest. Look for the icon to the left to find quest start points.
translation:
屏幕右上角的小地图有各种图标显示不同的兴趣点。
查看左侧的图标可以找到任务起始点。

english: You should go talk to my friend Adventurer Jon, he might have an Adventure Path that could help you with what to fight.
translation: 你应该去找我的朋友冒险者乔恩谈谈，他可能有冒险路径能帮你了解该与什么战斗。

english: Very well then, let's see here...
translation: 那好吧，让我看看……

english: Where can I get better armour and weapons?
translation: 我在哪里能获得更好的盔甲和武器？

english: This is not possible - they are probably trying to steal your hard-earned equipment. Now, is there anything else I can tell you about?
translation: 这不可能——他们可能想偷走你辛苦得来的装备。那么，还有什么其他事情我可以告诉你吗？

english: An exciting discovery has been made in the Barbarian Village. Soon after they started mining in the middle of the village, one of the miners found a cave.
translation: 野蛮人村庄有了一项令人兴奋的发现。他们开始在村庄中央采矿后不久，一名矿工发现了一个洞穴。

english: An explorer ventured into it, finding new and exciting creatures and other surprises on top of that. It turns out this place can also teach you to secure your account more effectively.
translation: 一位探险家冒险进入其中，发现了新奇刺激的生物以及其他惊喜。此外，这个地方还能教你如何更有效地保护账号安全。

english: staff characters in game - these can be identified by a gold crown next to their name and are the people who work in the Jagex offices. They might be from Player Support, or they might be a tester or a programmer.
translation: 游戏中的工作人员角色——可通过名字旁的金色皇冠识别，他们是在 Jagex 办公室工作的人员。他们可能来自玩家支持团队，也可能是测试员或程序员。

english: You may also see player moderators - these can be identified by a silver crown next to their name. Player moderators are trusted players of Old School RuneScape that help keep in-game behaviour in line with
translation: 你也可能会看到玩家版主——可通过名字旁的银色皇冠识别。玩家版主是Old School RuneScape中受信任的玩家，他们帮助维护游戏内行为符合

english: the Old School RuneScape rules.
translation: Old School RuneScape的规则。

english: Play the game by the rules. Report those who break the rules, help players who need it, and one day you might find an invitation in your Old School RuneScape inbox.
translation: 遵守规则进行游戏。举报违规者，帮助有需要的玩家，有一天你可能会在Old School RuneScape收件箱中发现一封邀请函。

english: Remember, Jagex will never send player moderator invitations via in-game chat, via social media or via email. Any messages like that are scams. Jagex uses the inbox on the RuneScape website.
translation: 请记住，Jagex 永远不会通过游戏内聊天、社交媒体或电子邮件发送玩家版主邀请。任何此类消息都是诈骗。Jagex 使用符文官网的收件箱。

english: Unfortunately these are members only but I will explain them to you.
translation: 很遗憾这些仅限会员，但我会为你解释。

translation: 从晶球、瓶子和鸟巢中获得更高等级线索的几率会随着等级提高而降低。但如果你砍伐更高等级的树木，你获得包含线索的鸟巢的几率会更高。钓鱼和采矿也是如此。

translation: 很遗憾，你只会遇到技能挑战这一种类型的挑战。

translation: 这类线索可能很简单，比如与指定人物交谈或在指定地点搜索箱子。

english: Unfortunately, you will only be given the easier ones in beginner clues.
translation: 很遗憾，新手线索中你只会遇到较简单的类型。

translation: 对于新手线索，你只需与雷尔多交谈即可。

english: The map will show you where you will need to dig, or what you will need to search to get the next clue.
translation: 地图会显示你需要挖掘的位置，或需要搜索的物品，以获取下一个线索。

english: You will then need to use the numbers to figure out where you will need to dig after arriving to your destination.
translation: 到达目的地后，你需要利用这些数字来确定需要挖掘的位置。

english: The name's Veos. I'm a treasure hunter from the wonderous Kingdom of Great Kourend.
translation: 我叫维奥斯。我是一名来自宏伟库兰德王国的宝藏猎人。

english: Across the sea to the far west. It is a truly magnificent place.
translation: 在大海彼岸的遥远西方。那真是一个宏伟壮丽的地方。

english: I am here on a bit of a hunt. The hunt for treasure. Back in my home of Great Kourend I came across a scroll. I believe it will lead me to something of great value.
translation: 我来这里是为了寻找宝藏。在我的家乡库兰德王国，我偶然发现了一卷卷轴。我相信它会指引我找到极具价值的东西。

english: Alas, I've hit a bit of a blocker. The scroll has led me here but as I don't really know the area, I'm not sure what to do next.
translation: 唉，我遇到了一点阻碍。卷轴指引我来到这里，但因为我不太了解这片区域，我不确定接下来该怎么做。

english: Hmmm. Maybe you can. You probably know this area better than I do. You might be able to work the scroll out. I'll be able to reward you if you help.
translation: 嗯。也许你可以。你可能比我更了解这片区域。你或许能解读出卷轴的内容。如果你帮忙，我会给你报酬。

english: Great Kourend? Where's that?
translation: 库兰德王国？那在哪里？

english: Interesting. So what brings you to Lumbridge?
translation: 有趣。那么是什么让你来到仑桥镇的？

english: Well good luck with it.
translation: 那么祝你好运。

english: You look hungry to me. I tell you what - have a square sandwich on me.
translation: 你看起来饿了。这样吧——请你吃个方形三明治。

translation: 我叫吉利·格罗茨。我父亲是个农夫，我帮他挤牛奶。

english: I'm afraid not. We need all of our milk to sell to market, but you can milk the cow yourself if you need milk.
translation: 恐怕不行。我们需要把所有牛奶都拿到市场上去卖，但如果你需要牛奶，可以自己挤。
